Hardin, known as Bug for most of his life due to the custom of his homeworld Somov Rit, was a Force-sensitive Human who was recruited into Jedi Lord Hoth's Army of Light as a youth, in the service of which he died.

Been was a male Otolla Gungan who was a member of the Gungan High Council at the time of the Invasion of Naboo and lived during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
Atali was a male Human who served as First Officer aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Mathayus under Admiral Coy.

Arren Kae was a female Jedi Master, known for her part in training Revan. She joined her former apprentice in the Mandalorian Wars after her exile from the Jedi Order and was lost in the close of the conflict. She was the mother of the Echani Brianna.

Jolee was the daughter of the Jedi Master Dorin Se'ol and his wife Vorena, and was born on the planet Volik during the early years of the Galactic Empire. The waterfall Jolee Falls was named after her.

Keiran Halcyon was a Human male Corellian Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic roughly four hundred years before the rise of the Galactic Empire and the start of the Great Jedi Purge.
Kud'ar Mub'at was the only known fully-developed member of the assembler species. He served as a go-between and middleman for many of the less legal activities of the galaxy.

Danetta Pitta was a Near-Human who served in the Imperial Navy. A rabid xenophobe, Pitta was one of the fiercest champions of Human High Culture in the Galactic Empire, and he would cite his zeal for the cause to hide the fact that he was not quite Human.

Josef Grunger was a Human male serving in the Navy of the Galactic Empire. A Grand Admiral, Grunger was one of the twelve original beings elevated to the rank by Emperor Palpatine two years before the Battle of Yavin.

Kirtan Loor was an agent with Imperial Intelligence and former liaison officer to CorSec who played a large role in the events surrounding the capture of Coruscant by the New Republic. In time, Loor would prove to be one of Rogue Squadron's most persistent enemies.
Afsheen Makati was a Grand Admiral in the Imperial Navy who commanded the Imperial Star Destroyer Steadfast in the final years of the New Order.

affiliation: Commission for the Protection of the Republic
Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: A fanatical supporter of the New Order and its core precepts, Ishin-Il-Raz was one of the original twelve Grand Admirals of the Imperial Navy appointed by Emperor Palpatine two years before the Battle of Yavin.

Peccati Syn was one of the twelve original Grand Admirals of the Imperial Navy. Raised as a devout Sacred Way follower, the young Syn was forced to abandon his religion under the Galactic Empire oppression.
Kueller was a Force-sensitive Human male who was originally known as Dolph. At some point before 17 ABY, he was a student at Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4.

Arden Lyn was a female Human and master of Teräs Käsi who belonged to the Followers of Palawa. In 24,500 BBY, this Dark Side Adept became the lover of Xendor and, upon the advent of the First Great Schism, his right hand in the Legions of Lettow.

Kiph is a Twi'lek slicer from Onderon. He helped Meetra Surik to get an open starport visa and to retrieve information from a broken droid regarding the murder of Captain Sullio of the Onderonian military.

Etahn A'baht was a pragmatic career naval officer, devoted to military service. A male Dornean, he served in the Dornean Navy with distinction, rising to command the entire eighty-ship force and using it to keep the Galactic Empire from conquering Dornea.
Skent Graff was a captain in the New Republic Defense Fleet who served during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Augwynne Djo was a Force-sensitive female Human who was the clan mother of the Singing Mountain Clan of the Witches of Dathomir, and eventually rose to be the nominal Queen of Dathomir by 8 ABY; however, this was little more than a constitutional formality.

Knol Ven'nari was a Bothan female Jedi Master who lived during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. She was nicknamed the Fire Eater by her fellow Bothans for her ability to manipulate fire with the Force.

Nico Diath was a Human male Jedi Master who lived during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. Diath was descended from the ancient Jedi Master Sidrona Diath, and took his nephew Tae as his Padawan, helping him to control his telepathy.

Vaklu was an Onderonian general and commander-in-chief of Onderon's armed forces during the Mandalorian Wars, the Jedi Civil War, and the Dark Wars. During the Mandalorian Wars, Vaklu led the resistance movement against the Mandalorian occupiers.

Dor Gal-ram was a Sith Lord in the years leading up to the Great Hyperspace War, 5,000 years before the Battle of Yavin. A member of the Sith species, Gal-ram was native to an area of space known as the Sith Empire.
Oron Kira was a Beast Rider leader and King of Onderon who played a pivotal part in his homeworld's history, reigning as monarch during the onset of the Great Sith War.
Shada D'ukal was a deceptively decorative-looking mercenary from a mysterious militaristic order of female warriors known as the Mistryl Shadow Guard.
Gorm, also known as Gorm the Dissolver, was an Assimilator cyborg assembled by the Renegades of the Arkanian Revolution.
Jangotat, previously known as Nate, was an Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando captain in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Tk'lokk was a small insectoid creature that could often be seen sitting on Ssk Kahorr's shoulder.
Shodon Ko was a bureaucrat who worked for the Navigators' Guild on the planet Koros Major in 5000 BBY.
Neela was a female Rodian who was the wife of Greedo the Elder, mother of the younger Greedo and Pqweeduk, and the younger sister of Nok and Teeku.
Nok was the uncle of Greedo. He was the elder brother of Neela, Greedo's mother.
Anarc was a Kitonak member of the band Hutt. He was the lead jizz wailer.

Tahl was a female Noorian Jedi Master, a librarian of the Jedi Archives, and was also a close friend of Qui-Gon Jinn, with whom she fell in love. She was also the master of Padawan Bant Eerin. During a mission on Melida/Daan, she was blinded in a prison.

Kitster Chanchani Banai was a Human slave boy on Tatooine, and the best friend of Anakin Skywalker. After not seeing his smuggler father, Rakir Banai, in many years, Kitster gave up hopes of being rescued from Tatooine and instead hoped to one day be a majordomo for a wealthy …

Ajuur was a Hutt who found work as a bookmaker for the Exchange, a criminal syndicate, in the Upper City Cantina of the planet Taris. He also owned a combat arena where duels to the death were broadcast as a spectator sport.

Turland Hack, known as "Hack," was a lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic early in the Galactic Civil War. After he failed to become a starfighter pilot, Hack took a role in communications and tactical assistance at the Alliance's Anchorhead Base on Tatooine.

D'harhan was a male Niordi bounty hunter who hailed from the planet of Niorde in the Unknown Regions. Niorde came under attack by members of the Leech Legions during the Clone Wars, who were hired by a neighboring planet to attack Niorde as part of a war that had been fought b…
Maks Leem was a female Gran Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Deadeye Duncan was a Human male duelist who lived on the city-world of Taris during the time of the Jedi Civil War, a conflict between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Gerlon Two-Fingers was a male Human who was at one point considered one of the greatest duelists in the Taris dueling ring.
Ice was a Human female competitor at the Taris dueling ring that operated at the Upper City Cantina during the Jedi Civil War.

Twitch was a male Rodian who was the only alien duelist in the Taris dueling ring at the time of the destruction of Taris. He was thought to be mentally unstable, but it did not stop him from becoming the dueling champion of Taris after he defeated the former champion, Marl.

Marl was a Human male who made his living as a duelist on the planet Taris during the Jedi Civil War. Marl's career spanned nearly twenty years, and by 3956 BBY, he became the dueling champion after the retirement of Bendak Starkiller.

Bera Kazan was a Human female smuggler and pilot of the Sarpazian Rose, a vessel marked with scratches and scorch marks from her various escapades. During the early stages of the Clone Wars, Kazan became a hired mercenary for the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Gheeta was once in charge of the design of the terminal and diplomatic reception site on Circumtore, and was high up in the Shell Hutt hierarchy. After a bungled attempt to have Emd Grahvess killed he was demoted to a negotiator. Grahvess had been saved by Boba Fett.

Venka was a Human male officer in the Imperial Navy during the height of the Galactic Civil War. A native of the Imperial throne world of Coruscant, Venka had a spoiled childhood, raised the son of a wealthy industrialist.

Emd Grahvess was considered one of the best architects in the galaxy who did not work for the Galactic Empire or Prince Xizor. He was once contracted by Gheeta to design the terminal and diplomatic reception site on the planetoid Circumtore.

General Odosk was an Imperial officer who served in Daala's fleet. An Imperial Army commander, he was about to retire when Daala and Tarkin offered him a promotion and a place in the Maw Installation. He was well beyond retirement age by the time Daala finally left the Maw.
Ocheron was a member of the Nightsisters clan of the Witches of Dathomir. She was skilled in the art of deception and proved it by luring Teneniel Djo and Luke Skywalker into a trap.
Sprax was a Nalroni, a Vigo of Black Sun, and operator of various illegal trade groups.
Odumin was a male Tynnan who became a legend as one of the most effective and successful agents and executives in the Corporate Sector Authority during the Imperial Era.
Halla was a Human female who helped Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker in their search for the Kaiburr crystal.
Shar Dakhan was a Sith Lord active during the years leading up to the Great Hyperspace War. Dakhan ruled over the Sith Space world of Ch'hodos, which served as his primary base of operations.
Hoggon was a Human male spacer of short stature who was fascinated with the Jedi Order and its history.

Quanto was a male gangster living in the Stenness star system four thousand years before the Battle of Yavin. A space pirate, Quanto was in the employ of crime lord Bogga the Hutt as one of his enforcers.

Rek was a tall male humanoid gangster who worked as an enforcer for the Hutt crime lord Bogga in the years leading up to the Great Sith War. Rek was a member of Bogga's enforcer gang, which operated out of the Stenness Node region of the Inner Rim.
Skritch was a small Gorm-worm kept as a pet by the space-pirate Gudb. The tiny reptile took advantage of his venomous bite by killing Andur Sunrider at the order of Bogga the Hutt.

Gudb was a male gangster and scourge of the Stenness star system in the name of Great Bogga the Hutt. He was the primary henchman in Bogga's enforcer gang, a group of beings that exercised Bogga's will throughout Stenness.

Bogga was a Hutt crime lord who operated out of the Stenness Node in the years leading up to the Great Sith War. Bogga was the head of a criminal empire that encompassed the Stenness system, and led an enforcer gang that was feared throughout the area.
Orlok was a Human commander serving with the Galactic Empire and the leading Imperial authority on ground-based facilities during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Nampi was a female of a species native to the planet Orooturoo.
Tresk Ortola was a New Republic officer who had served with the Rebel Alliance.

Accompanied by his subordinate Dareb, Commander Orvak flew under the Jedi Praxeum's shield and blew up the shield generators using thermal detonators. He then sneaked into the Great Temple where he planted further detonators.

Hortel Ossilege was a male Bakuran admiral who served under Prime Minister Gaeriel Captison. He was the leader of the Bakuran Defense Fleet that was loaned to the New Republic during the Corellian Crisis.

Calder Nettic was a Human male who lived on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. Nettic was murdered in 3956 BBY by a colonist named Handon Guld after Nettic had an affair with his wife. An investigation into his death was carried out by the Jedi Investigator Bolook and Revan.
Nandreeson was a Glottalphib crime lord and one of the most powerful in the galaxy by 17 ABY. He was the undisputed kingpin of Smuggler's Run.

Dia was a Human female who lived on the planet Taris during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. She worked as a waitress at Javyar's Cantina, located in Taris's Lower City.
The Keeramak was a mutant Ssi-ruu who possessed all the colors of the Ssi-ruuvi castes: gold, blue, yellow, red, black, green, and brown.

Holdan was a denizen of Taris and a henchman for Davik Kang, crime lord of the Exchange, serving as one of his top couriers during the Jedi Civil War. Holdan's penchant for alcohol and womanizing antagonized Dia, a waitress at Javyar's Cantina, who injured him with a vibroblade.

Amise Griff was a Human male admiral of the Imperial Navy who commanded the Sector Group in the Bright Jewel Oversector and oversaw the development and construction of the Executor-class Star Dreadnought at Fondor.

Dreebo was a starfighter pilot in the employ of the crime lord Bogga the Hutt in 3999 BBY. That year, Dreebo was chosen to escort a pirate-threatened Ithullan ore hauler that was captained by a man named Gruna.
Ktriss was a female Hssiss dragon and the pet of Great Bogga, the Hutt crime lord of the Stenness star system. Ktriss served as the Hutt's executioner and was often seen sitting at her master's side.

Jaina was the wife of Jonash Solo and mother of Han Solo. When Han was only two years old he was orphaned when his parents mysteriously vanished. Han remembered a few details about his mother, but his mind would slam shut on certain memories to bury his childhood trauma.
Jonash Suul was a Human male who was the firstborn son of Denn Solo and Tira Gama Solo, the twin brother of Tiion Sal-Solo, and the father of Han Solo.

Randil Sal was the husband of Tiion Sal-Solo and father of Thrackan Sal-Solo. Thrackan met Han Solo around 18 BBY and told him his dad died when he was only one year old. Randil was a wealthy man, and left Tiion in his will before dying.

Tira Gama Solo was a Human female who was the mother of Tiion Sal-Solo and Jonash Solo. She was the grandmother of Han Solo and Thrackan Sal-Solo. She was married to Denn Solo. After she gave birth, the planet was attacked by pirates, forcing the family to flee.
Denn Solo was a Corellian who was believed to have been the paternal grandfather of Han Solo.
Gruna was the male Nessie captain of an Ithullan ore hauler, which carried valuable mutonium ore through the Stenness Node in the years leading up to the Great Sith War.
Finhead Stonebone was an alien pirate who operated out of the Stenness system during the height of the Galactic Republic, around 3999 BBY.
Roko was the first mate of pirate Captain Finhead Stonebone in the years leading up to the Great Sith War.
Fnnbu was a Zexx confederate of the notorious pirate Captain Finhead Stonebone, active in the years leading up to the Great Sith War.

Rufaan Tigellinus was a Grand Admiral and later a Grand Moff of the Galactic Empire until his death in 5 ABY. Known for his political savvy and charisma, Tigellinus was widely followed in the media and was considered to be a key player in Imperial Court politics.

Osvald Teshik was a Human male who served as a Grand Admiral in the Imperial Navy. A respected strategist, he was one of the original twelve individuals to be appointed to the rank of Grand Admiral by Emperor Palpatine two years before the Battle of Yavin.

Kalgrath, also known as the "Night Beast," was a Massassi warrior put into hibernation within the isolation chambers beneath the temples by the Dark Lord of the Sith Exar Kun, to guard Yavin 4 against intruders prior to the Republic/Jedi assault on the moon.
Asyr Sei'lar was a female Bothan pilot who served on Rogue Squadron for the New Republic Defense Force. She was also the long-time lover of Gavin Darklighter. Asyr was named for a Bothawui flower.

Karreio was the daughter of an important Imperial diplomat and the fiancée of Crix Madine. She was a firm believer in the New Order. Madine defected to the Rebel Alliance without telling Karreio, fearing that any knowledge she possessed could put her life in danger.
Galia was a Human female and the Queen of the Inner Rim planet of Onderon during the era of the Great Sith War.
Tott Doneeta, né Tottdon'eeta, was a male Twi'lek from the planet Ryloth. Subjected to slavery in his youth, he was found by Jedi Master Arca Jeth and trained as a Knight of the Galactic Republic.
Nejaa Halcyon was a Human male Corellian Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Oss Wilum was a Vultan male who served as a Jedi Knight during the days of the Old Republic. He was originally apprenticed to Jedi Master Garnoo, and would later train alongside Nomi Sunrider under Jedi Master Thon.

Dace Diath was a male Human and one of many Jedi Knights who trained under Master Vodo-Siosk Baas. He spent the majority of his early life on Tatooine being taught his initial training by his father, the Jedi Master Sidrona Diath.

Shoaneb Culu was a female Miraluka who served as a Jedi Knight in the days of the Old Republic. She traveled from her homeworld of Alpheridies to seek out a Jedi who could train her in the ways of the Force, planning to return one day to her homeworld and establish a Jedi acad…
Kith Kark was a Gotal male who served as a Jedi Knight during the days of the Old Republic. He received his training under the Jedi Master Mroon Jassa on the planet of Truuine.

Qrrrl Toq, known as Crown Prince Qrrrl Toq in his youth, was a male Nazzar who served as a Jedi Knight in the days of the Old Republic. Upon the discovery of his family's roots, and their colored past, Toq traveled from his homeworld of Nazzri in search of wisdom and knowledge.

Aleema Keto was a Human female, the daughter of Lady Magda Keto and niece of the elder Lord Keto, as well as the cousin of Satal Keto. As she progressed down the path of the dark side of the Force, Aleema became a Sith sorceress, gaining proficiency in the arts of Sith magic.
Shynne was a Human female who was raised on the Deep Core planet Prakith during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Tor Vizsla was a male Human Mandalorian warrior and the first leader of the Death Watch faction during the Mandalorian Civil War.
Jev Sunrider was a Human male who served as a Jedi Master and Watchman of the Darada system in the decades leading up to the Great Sith War.
Grimorg was a male Weequay enforcer in the employ of the Stenness Node–based crime lord Bogga the Hutt around 4,000 years before the Battle of Yavin.
Gil "Billey" Bastra was a Human male CorSec police officer and former coworker who worked with Hal Horn during the Galactic Civil War.

Elegos A'Kla was a Caamasi Senator of the New Republic who played a substantial role in the resolution of the Caamas dispute and the peace process initiated by Gilad Pellaeon that resulted in the Bastion Accords.

Rostek Horn was a Human male who was the step-grandfather of Corran Horn. Although Corran grew up thinking Rostek was his biological grandfather, he found out as an adult that Rostek was a friend of his real grandfather, Nejaa Halcyon.
Pash Cracken was a Human male career starfighter pilot who throughout his life served in the Rebel Alliance, the New Republic, and the Galactic Alliance.
Diric Wessiri was a Human male who was married with Iella Wessiri. After escaping from Corellia, he settled on Coruscant with his wife.

Qwi Xux was a female Omwati weapons designer who was responsible due to mental conditioning for aiding in the creation of the Death Star, the Sun Crusher, and other important superweapons for the Galactic Empire.

Komad Fortuna was a Twi'lek hunter on Tatooine during the Jedi Civil War. Following in the footsteps of his father, a hunter famous on Tatooine for once hunting and killing a krayt dragon, he hunted honorably and only with traditional methods.
B'dard Tone was a male Coway Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Ph'ton was a male Bith Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Z'meer Bothu was a female Human Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.
Gilthos Uksaris was the founder and manager of The Twisted Rancor Trio.
Elinda was a female Human singer who was the first member and original lead singer of the The Twisted Rancor Trio, a band hailing from the planet Taris.
Ujaa was a male Bith musician who was the second member of the Twisted Rancor Trio, playing the kloo horn.
Ujii was a Bith musician and the third member of the Twisted Rancor Trio, playing the kloo horn.
Loopa was a male Bith musician who played the kloo horn and served as Ujaa's replacement in the Twisted Rancor Trio.
Fodo was a Bith musician that played the kloo horn for the Twisted Rancor Trio.
Ashana was Human female singer from Taris and sister of Elinda, the original lead singer of The Twisted Rancor Trio.
Matrik was a male Twi'lek who served as a former member of the Exchange on Taris during the Jedi Civil War.

Thire, designated CC-4477, was a clone shock trooper who served as a clone trooper officer in the Coruscant Guard of the Galactic Republic and subsequent Galactic Empire, beginning his military service as a lieutenant in the Guard's diplomatic service branch before eventually …

Sil Sorannan was a red-haired Human male and officer who served in the Imperial military. He served as a Major the 6th Sector Army, otherwise known as Black Sword Command, in the Koornacht Cluster in 4 ABY.
Doolb Snoil was a male Vippit barrister who served the Galactic Republic during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Ja'Gatcha was a male Paaerduag from the planet known in Galactic Basic Standard as "Sorjus." The joined being left his homeworld to travel the galaxy.
Rebus was a Human male Imperial Moff at the start of the Galactic Civil War. He was a noted weapons designer and created the prototype weapons for the Empire's dark trooper battle droids.
Whie Malreaux was a Force-sensitive human male Jedi Padawan who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Delak Krennel was a Human male native to Corulag. Krennel would eventually enroll within the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. Krennel was an aggressive commander, and was extremely Humanocentric, displaying hatred towards Non-humans.
Sylvn was a female Cerean who was the daughter of Ki-Adi-Mundi and his fourth wife, Mawin.

Ashaar Khorda was an Annoo-dat Prime revolutionary. Sometime before 27 BBY, he tried to seize control of his homeworld, Annoo, only to have the Galactic Republic end his rebellion. Khorda hated the Republic as a result.

Kirana Ti was a member of the Singing Mountain Clan of Force-sensitive, rancor-riding witches on the world of Dathomir. She was a member of the inaugural class at Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4 as member of the New Jedi Order.
Jurokk was a Human male Jedi Master and Gate Keeper of the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars, having risen to the position by 22 BBY.
Lusa was a female Chironian from the planet Chiron. She joined the New Jedi Order after deserting the Diversity Alliance, and was killed by voxyn during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

affiliation: Jasod Revoc and his Galactic Revue
x: Epoh Trebor was a famous male HoloNet entertainer who, during the Clone Wars, was a driving force behind the entertainment tours that traveled across the galaxy entertaining Republic troops and personnel on the battlefields.

Morag was a Tulgah sorceress who resided on the Forest Moon of Endor. The sworn enemy of the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village, she once stole from them a powerful artifact, the Sunstar-Shadowstone, believing that it would help her conquer the forest moon.

Taggor Bren was a Human male bounty hunter who hailed from the planet Tatooine and worked with his family on a moisture farm as a young child. One night, a group of Tusken Raiders raided his farm and took Bren.
Dunhausen was a high-ranking Imperial officer and member of the Central Committee of Grand Moffs. He was Grand Moff Bertroff Hissa's most trusted Grand Moff.
Muzzer was a Grand Moff in the Central Committee of Grand Moffs. He was one of the Moffs who supported Trioculus in his rise as new Emperor.
Thistleborn was a loyal member of the Central Committee of Grand Moffs.

Kallabow (meaning "wild worker" in Shyriiwook) was a female Wookiee who was the daughter of Attichitcuk, the sister of Chewbacca, the wife of Mahraccor, and the mother of Lowbacca and Sirrakuk. She had blue eyes and dark-reddish brown fur.

Rivoche Tarkin was the daughter of Brigadier Gideon Tarkin and the niece of Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin. After her father's death, she lived with her uncle, during which time she came to question the Tarkin family's adherence to the Galactic Empire.
Freyyr was a Wookiee Chieftain, the father of Zaalbar and Chuundar, from the village of Rwookrrorro on Kashyyyk.
Lo Vapeet, a male Muun from the planet Muunilinst, was the Vice-Chair of Communications for the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the months prior to the Clone Wars.

Domb Treetor, a male Skakoan from Skako, served as a Appropriations Chief with the Techno Union prior to the formation of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. After the Clone Wars began, Treetor became a Major in the Confederacy military.

Trask Ulgo was a Human male who was born into the Alderaanian House Ulgo on the planet Alderaan. By the height of the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, he had attained the rank of ensign with the Republic Navy.
Attiera was a female Wookiee from Kashyyyk, the mother of Froera and a member of the Myyydril tribe.

Bacca, often remembered as the Great Bacca, was a male Wookiee from Kashyyyk who lived centuries prior to the Old Sith Wars era. He was famed for crafting a ceremonial sword that came to symbolize leadership among his people.
Rothrrrawr was a Wookiee Chieftain who died several years before the Jedi Civil War.

Zahn was a Human male specialist of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was stationed at Mos Anek on Tatooine where he asked an Imperial ally to mark locations of several hostile targets for further precise demolition.

Dustil Onasi was the Force-sensitive son of Morgana Onasi and war veteran Carth Onasi. He was taken by the Sith during the bombing of Telos IV, and later trained at the Sith Academy on Korriban before turning away from the Sith and returning home.

Darman Skirata, formally known as RC-1136 during service to the Galactic Republic, later as IC-1136 after its reorganization into the Galactic Empire, and affectionately known as Dar, was a clone commando of the Grand Army of the Republic and member of Theta Squad, Omega Squad…

Jay, also identified by the clone trooper number RC-1135, was a male clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. Born on the planet Kamino, Jay was created by Kaminoan cloners for use in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic.

Vin, whose number was RC-1134, was a male clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. Born on the planet Kamino, Vin was created by Kaminoan cloners for use in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic.

Taler, also known by the number RC-1133, was a male Human clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. He, along with many other clones, was bred by the Kaminoan cloners on the planet Kamino for use in the Grand Army of the Republic.

Niner Skirata—formally known as RC-1309 during service to the Galactic Republic, then as IC-1309 after its reorganization into the Galactic Empire—was a clone of the bounty hunter Jango Fett, created on Kamino to serve in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Fi Skirata, formerly known as RC-8015, was a clone commando member of the Galactic Republic's Teroch Squad, and later Omega Squad, serving as the team medic and sniper in both.

Atin (pronounced /aah-TEEN/), the Mando'a word for "persistent", or "stubborn", was the name taken by a clone commando in the Galactic Republic's Omega Squad during the Clone Wars. Designated RC-3222, he was trained by Sergeant Walon Vau.

Prefect Dooje Brolo was in command of the third worldship in the first invasion force of the Yuuzhan Vong War. He also commanded a thousand coralskippers. Brolo was killed as Jedi used shieldships to melt the Yuuzhan Vong base planet of Helska IV.
Twool was a young Rodian apprentice in Luke Skywalker's Jedi order, five years after the peace treaty between the Galactic Alliance and the Yuuzhan Vong.

Zayne Carrick was a male Human who was a Jedi Padawan during the Mandalorian Wars. Born to a banker and a gardener, Carrick was barely accepted into the Jedi Order, with his level of Force sensitivity described as "marginal," and spent his Youngling days at the Jedi Enclave on…
Brin Stiels was a male lieutenant with the New Republic after the Battle of Endor.
Krasov Hara was a female Barabel Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order, who was the hatchmate of Tesar Sebatyne and Bela Hara.
Talia was a female Human who served as the Queen of the planet Onderon during the years prior to and following the Jedi Civil War.
Narmlé was an ancient King of the planet Naboo whose short-lived reign took place around 2032 BBY. Known as "the Explorer," King Narmlé colonized Naboo's swampy moon of Rori.

Nolaa Tarkona was a female Twi'lek who was the leader of the Diversity Alliance. Her teeth were filed sharp and one lek was missing, but she had an ocular implant in its place, allowing her to see behind herself.
Gaeriel "Gaeri" Captison was a member of an influential political family on Bakura. Her father, Dol Captison, and his brother, Yeorg Captison, were both senators in the Bakuran Senate.

Xutoo, designated CT-X270, was a clone commando pilot in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, Xutoo was chosen alongside three other clone troopers by Advanced Recon Commando Nate for a mission to the planet Ord Cestus.

Sirty, designated CT-36/732, was a Clone commando sergeant in the Galactic Republic's Ord Cestus Squad during the Clone Wars. He was a logistics expert. In 21 BBY, Sirty took part in a demonstration of a JK security droid at the T'Chuk Colliseum on Coruscant.
Forry, designated CT-44/444, was a clone commando who served in the Galactic Republic's Ord Cestus Squad during the Clone Wars. He specialized in physical training.
Seefor, designated CT-12/74, was a Clone Commando in the Galactic Republic's squad on Ord Cestus during the Clone Wars. He was a communications expert.

Winama Naberrie was a female weaver who lived on the planet Naboo. In 77 BBY, she gave birth to the Human male Ruwee Naberrie, who later married a woman named Jobal following machinations of Winama and Jobal's mother Ryoo Thule, although the two mothers were both surprised by …

Marmor was a Human who hailed from the planet Corellia and lived during the Galactic Civil War. He served in the Galactic Empire but eventually defected to the Alliance to Restore the Republic along with Imperial Army storm commando leader—and later Rebel general—Crix Madine.

Midge was a Human male native of a rural region of the planet Chandrila. By the year 4 ABY, Midge was a corporal in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and was newly recruited into General Crix Madine's commando unit as a field technician.
s'Too Vees, a Human, was a gambler who was present in the Bespin mining complex of Cloud City during the Galactic Empire's subjugation of the city in 3 ABY.
Bendodi Ballow-Reese was the eldest member of the crew stationed on the research outpost ExGal-4 on Belkadan in 25 ABY. He had been a soldier for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Olander Brit was a fair-skinned Human with brown hair who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic by 4 ABY, following Major Panno to the Alliance. He was a communications expert and was politically minded.

Panno was a Dressellian male hailing from his species' homeworld of Dressel who became a general and aided fellow Dressellian General Orrimaarko in leading the militant resistance against the Galactic Empire's occupation of their native planet.
Malorum was a Human male who as one of the original members of the Inquisitorius, became its first Grand Inquisitor during the time following the formation of the Galactic Empire.
Weasy was a male Bothan smuggler, who was well known for taking on any cargo, no questions asked, along with being an excellent reporter of information who didn't exaggerate.
Riiken was a Human male who served as an officer in the planet Onderon's military prior to and during General Vaklu's militaristic rebellion in 3951 BBY.

Ved Kennede served as a Royal Guard to Emperor Palpatine. Palpatine considered him one of his most loyal followers and, as a result, entrusted him with the position of Master Instructor at the Imperial Royal Guard facility on Yinchorr.

Gurion Silizzar was a Human male bounty hunter. Seven of his relatives had perished at the hands of Doctor Cornelius Evazan, causing Silizzar to seek revenge against him. He and five other family members went after Evazan, eventually locating him on the planet Ando.
Malinza Thanas was a Human female born on Bakura to Gaeriel Captison and Pter Thanas, who were respectively the planet's Prime Minister and Defense Fleet Commander.

Tiree Captison was the wife of Yeorg Captison. The sister-in-law of Dol Captison and the aunt/adoptive mother of Gaeriel Captison, Tiree married Yeorg Captison sometime before the latter became a senator in 26 BBY.
Dol Captison was a Human male senator who served in the Bakuran Senate since the days of the Galactic Republic.

Eppie Belden, maiden name Eppie Antruse, was a Bakuran female member of the Antruse family of Bakura. She joined the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. With her husband, Orn Belden, she had a son named Roviden Belden.

Orn Belden was a Bakuran male senator in the Bakuran Senate, a position he held since before the foundation of the Galactic Empire and represented the Bakur RepulsorCorp in the Senate that was instrumental in the export industry that Bakura was chiefly known for.
Blaine Harris was the Defense Minister of Bakura during the administration of Prime Minister Yeorg Captison.

Menndo was a Rodian who, like most of his species, began his career working as a bounty hunter. However, he later learned that greater profits could be earned with less hassle in the endeavors of assassination and espionage rather than collecting bounties.

Freja Covell was a human male from the planet Corulag who served as a general in the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire. Covell took part in the Battle of Hoth during the Galactic Civil War under the command of Maximilian Veers that saw the Rebel Alliance almost crushed.

Jorj Car'das was a Human male from Corellia who lived during the time of the Galactic Republic, the Galactic Empire, and the New Republic. Early in his life, Car'das joined the crew of the smuggling ship Bargain Hunter, working mainly as a bootlegger for the Hutts.

Yeorg Captison was a member of the notable Bakuran Captison family of politicians. His grandfather or great-grandfather may have been Deredith Arden. Trim, athletic-looking, and refined, Yeorg was elected to the Bakuran Senate around 26 BBY.

Cede was an admiral of the Republic Navy in the years following the Jedi Civil War until at least 3951 BBY. He served in Carth Onasi's fleet during the Dark Wars, participating in the Battle of Telos IV.
Bor Gracus was a male Human Senator who represented Sluis Van and the Sluis sector in the Galactic Senate.

Xarga was a Human male Mandalorian drill instructor who served under the command of Mandalore the Preserver during the time of the Mandalorian Wars. He wore yellow Neo-Crusader armor reserved for Mandalorian high-ranking warriors.
Kelborn was a Mandalorian warrior under the command of Mandalore the Preserver.

Alfreda Goot was a female Togorian mercenary who became a bounty hunter after washing out of Fenn Shysa and Tobbi Dala's covert elite police training program on Mandalore during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Rugor Nass was a Gungan male who served as the Boss of the Gungan High Council during the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo. At some point, Nass served in the Gungan Grand Army.

Aalto was a male Force-sensitive Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. They were accepted by the Jedi Order to be trained at the Jedi Temple on the Republic's capital planet, Coruscant. There, Aalto befriended fellow Jedi Initiate Bruck Chun.
Sar Agorn was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the early Galactic Republic. He was an amorphous, blob-like sentient whose form was constantly surrounded in green gases.
Kel Algwinn was a male Human student at the Sith Academy on Korriban during the Jedi Civil War.

Alicka was a Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. The Knight was known for making blumfruit muffins and Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker was instantly able to identify some crumbs as belonging to one of Alicka's muffins while sear…
Ali-Vor was a male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order during the final days of the Galactic Republic.
Allara was a female Human Jedi Initiate who studied in the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.
Serifa Altunen was a female Arkanian Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order in the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Kadrian Sey was a female Zabrak Jedi Knight who recently served the Jedi Order before she fell to the dark side and joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems, becoming one of Count Dooku's Dark Acolytes during the Clone Wars.
Alurali was a female Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order in the years prior to the Clone Wars. Unlike most Jedi, Alurali was trained at the experimental Almas Academy in the Cularin system.
Lora Nadad was a female Human Padawan in service to the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic in the decades leading up to the Clone Wars.

Ambaln was a male Mon Calamari Dark Jedi who was prior to the Clone Wars, a Jedi Knight and investigator. Ambaln fell to the dark side of the Force while undercover and fled to the Outer Rim Territories with plans to build his own version of the Jedi High Council.
Geith Eris was a Human male Jedi Knight who was trained on the second Chu'unthor by Djinn Altis in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He wore a single gold earring.

Plett was a male Ho'Din from the planet Moltok who served as a Jedi Master during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. A talented botanist and ecologist, he settled on the remote Outer Rim world of Belsavis, in an isolated valley that came to be known as Plett's Well.

Ameesa Darys was a female Human Inquisitor of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius. Formerly a Jedi Knight who served as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, after Order 66 she followed in the footsteps of the Jedi Master who trained her as a Padaw…
Lagan Ismaren was a Human male from Alderaan.

Golorno was the young Human sensor officer aboard Mon Remonda during General Han Solo's hunt for Warlord Zsinj. He died when he was sucked into the vacuum of space after Nuro Tualin's brainwashed assault on Mon Remonda.

Gar Anstak was a Mairan Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Great Sith War. Recently from Maires in the Hapes Consortium, Anstak was shunned by his fellow Mairans, as all Jedi were by the peoples of the Consortium.
Aqinos was a male Sunesi Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Jedgar was a Jedi youngling who joined Dark Jedi Kadann and became a Prophet of the Dark Side.

Vel Ardox was a female Blubreen Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. Like all members of her species, Ardox could breathe under water; she was also a skilled technician.

Aru-Wen was a male Jedi Knight who joined Lord Hoth's Army of Light and fought on Ruusan. Aru-Wen did not take his Padawan, Set Harth, with him, leaving Harth behind on Coruscant. Aru-Wen was killed by Lord Kaan's thought bomb on Ruusan.

Set Harth was a male Human Dark Jedi active during the decades following the Ruusan Reformations of the Galactic Republic. Once a Padawan of the Jedi Order, his Master Aru-Wen was slain during the waning days of the Ruusan campaign in the New Sith Wars.
Ausar Auset was a male Kajain'sa'Nikto Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General during the Clone Wars.
Daye Azur-Jamin was a Human male from Druckenwell, a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later a Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order.
Tam Azur-Jamin was a Force-sensitive Human male who served the New Republic as a Jedi Knight and the son of Jedi Knight Daye Azur-Jamin and Tinian I'att.
Nyo was a male Force-sensitive Human from Morado who lived during the Galactic Empire and dreamed of being a Jedi Knight.
Felanil Baaks was a male Duros Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. A rarity within the Order, Baaks was considered an artisan of lightsabers.
Bala Nisi was a female Human Jedi Master and member of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council during the Great Hunt and Mandalorian Wars.

Soon Bayts was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. When the Yinchorri Uprising came to bear, Bayts was charged with supervising communications between the Jedi strike teams and the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

Nayama was a female Human Force-sensitive who began training with the Jedi Order before quickly succumbing to the dark side of the Force and joining the Brotherhood of the Sith. Before her fall, Nayama was the wife of Padawan Jolee Bindo.
Bobby was a male Human Jedi Initiate studying with the Jedi Order during the final decade of the Galactic Republic.
Mirax Terrik Horn, born Mirax Terrik and nicknamed Myra as a child, was a Human female smuggler who was the daughter of the famous smuggler Booster Terrik.
Harkov was an male human admiral who served in the Alliance Fleet and before his defection in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

The Suprema, born Ampotem Za, was a tall, reptilian alien of the Shimholt species. A leader on his homeworld of Kar'a'katok, he was captured by Major Stafuv Rahz during an Imperial raid, a dishonor that caused his radically isolationist species to ostracize him.
Ung Kusp was a male Mandalorian mercenary who commanded the loyalty of a Mandalorian clan many centuries before the Clone Wars.
Hart Daele was a male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order.
Banz was a male Human Jedi Initiate who studied in the Jedi Order's academy during the Clone Wars.

Belaya was a Human female Jedi Guardian who resided in the Jedi Enclave on the planet Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. A student of the renowned Jedi Master Zhar Lestin, Belaya was devoted to the Jedi traditions but struggled with controlling her emotions.
Hran Beling was a male Vicon Jedi Initiate studying in the Jedi Order at the Coruscant Jedi Temples academy during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Jilst Bindalin was a dark side adept hailing from the planet Alsakan. At some point by 3 ABY, he learned the location of a Killik Sith warrior's tomb on the world Sarafur and, after stealing an artifact, traveled there.
Huff Darklighter was the father of Biggs Darklighter, the brother of Jula Darklighter, the uncle of Gavin Darklighter, and a land baron on Tatooine.

Ashka Boda was an aged and wise Jedi Master from the period of the Clone Wars. A revered member of the Librarian's Assembly of the Jedi Order, Boda maintained the large collection of holocrons and other Jedi artifacts located within the Jedi Temple's Archives.
Jabidus Inspra was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic.

Aidan Bok was a male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. At some point during his service to the Order, Bok was tasked with guarding the Jedi library on the ancient space station of Nespis VIII.
Gerrick was a young male Human Force-sensitive who studied to become a Jedi during the Galactic Civil War.

Harlan was a young female Force-sensitive alive around 11 ABY. She was once attacked by an alien that could control the dark side of the Force. The alien tried to use telekinesis against Harlan, who defended herself using a skill known as Force of Will.

Streen was an elderly Jedi Master of the New Jedi Order. Originally a tibanna gas prospector from the planet Bespin, Streen had a powerful untrained Force empathy that caused him to be constantly affected by the thoughts and feelings of those around him.

Bolook was a male Twi'lek Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order at the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, he was assigned as an investigator for the murder of Calder Nettic and received assistance from an amnesiac Revan.

Winso Bykart was a Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order around 32 BBY. Bykart was a pilot who often ferried Master and Padawan pairs to the planet Ragoon-6 for a traditional field exercise, where Bykart would go into hiding and the pair would try to track down their fellow Jedi.
Wren Honoran was an elderly male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Rallcema Bylissura was a female Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Like many Jedi of the era, Bylissura took up the rank of General during the Clone Wars.

Sana-Jis Ilowa was a female Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Like many Jedi of the era, Ilowa took up the rank of General during the Clone Wars. She was killed during the Battle of Jabiim by the Separatist Droid Army.
Dalnus Cam was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Noro Zak was a male Baxthrax Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Capable of flight, Jedi Zak was a noted tracker.
Teela Panjarra, a female Human, was an Initiate of the Jedi Order at the time of the 32 BBY invasion of Naboo.
Ylanda Captison was a female Human who was the daughter of Senator Dol Captison and Marga Captison and the sister of Gaeriel Captison.

Maxim was a male Human senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the waning years of the Republic. In 33 BBY, he caused a minor scandal, resulting in charges of corruption to be made against him.
Fillorean was a Supreme Chancellor of the Old Republic circa 15,500 BBY.

Arwen Cohl was a Mirialan mercenary from the planet Mirial. He became a hero among his people after leading them to victory in a conflict against a nearby planet, but was betrayed by leaders on his own side.

Ghorin was a Human male who served as Imperial overlord of the Greater Plooriod Cluster during the early Galactic Civil War. His territory contained several agricultural worlds, and he was a major food supplier to the Empire.

Chodo Habat was a male Ithorian Force Adept, and leader of the herd that oversaw the Telosian Restoration Project after the Bombing of Telos IV. He was a respected spiritual leader among his people because of his ability to feel the Force.
J'Mikel was a male Anx Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Clutch, designated TK-571, was a clone trooper commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Like all clone troopers, Clutch was cloned from the genetic code of Jango Fett—a Human male bounty hunter who served as the template of the Kamino clone army.
Zuth was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the final years of both institutions.
Ali-Alann was a Human male Jedi Master who was in charge of the nursery where he watched over Jedi younglings during the time of the Clone Wars.
Merili was a Human female from the planet Dathomir who served as a dark side Prophetess during the time of the Galactic Empire.
"Priest" was a Lesser Prophet of the Secret Order of the Emperor.
Argor was a Human male and a Lesser Prophet of the Dark Side, one of the Emperor's Mages at the time of the Battle of Yavin.

Arrizza was a male Kurtzen healer from Bakura, who in 28 ABY helped Tahiri Veila deal with her increasingly-dominant Yuuzhan Vong personality. He was a friend of the Ryn Goure Conor, who also was also a worker employed underneath the city of Salis D'aar.
Izrina was the queen of the Wisties, the glowing, fairy-folk of the forest moon of Endor, shortly before the Galactic Civil War.

Jovan Drark was a male Rodian Jedi Knight during the Yuuzhan Vong War, known for his withdrawn personality. A year into the war, Jovan joined Tenel Ka Djo on a mission to monitor the Bilbringi system.
Burr Danid was a Human male and an aspiring Royal Guard.
Dean Jinzler was a Human male starship technician, who was the youngest of the four Jinzler children.
Lorana Jinzler was a Human female Jedi Knight, born on the planet Coruscant in 49 BBY, and was the former Padawan of Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth.

Mirith Sinn was an agent of New Republic Intelligence and the leader of New Republic guerrilla forces on the planet Phaeda who met and fell in love with Kir Kanos. She later became Chief of Security of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant.

Sish Sadeet was one of the few known Trandoshans to serve in the New Republic military. He was second in command to Commander Mirith Sinn of the New Republic forces stationed on Phaeda. Due to his history, he was naturally suspicious of those he did not know well.

Huoba Neva was a female Sullustan, and the daughter of a SoroSuub Corporation Executive Board member. Neva attended the Imperial Academy, graduating fourth in her class. However, her status as a female non-Human severely stunted her progression through the ranks.

Lady Theala Vandron was the name of both the wife and daughter of Lord Crueya Vandron, the founder of COMPNOR and head of House Vandron, considered the eldest of the Ancient Houses of Senex sector, and thus the Galaxy's senior aristocratic lineage by precedent.
Neva was a female Human Alderaanian who lived during the Cold War and worked as an assistant to Peema Ahuff, the curator of the House Alde Royal Museum.
Ziering was a capable and dedicated Imperial General.
Bex was a captain and a HAV/w A5 Juggernaut commander in the Imperial Army. He was killed by Amanin raiders on Maridun when they shot though the HAVw A5 Juggernaut's pilot cockpit window.
Dix was an officer in the Galactic Empire.
Syub Snunb was a Sullustan military officer of the Rebel Alliance and New Republic.
Barse was a male Human who served as a stormtrooper lieutenant attached to the Imperial Army during the Galactic Civil War.

Banno was a male Bothan Lieutenant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic as a starfighter pilot during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, Banno held the rank as lieutenant and was stationed on Azure under the command of General Solomahal.

Bavris was a general in the Grand Army of the Republic. In the early stages of the Clone Wars, Bavris won praise from his men and Republic politicians for posting a bounty on the location and capture of Separatist equipment, a bounty that led directly to the apprehension of th…
Lej Carner was the son of an Imperial Army Major General on Garos IV. He was killed by Chanceller, a resistance fighter and contemporary of his romantic interest, Alexandra Winger.
Fyefee Tiis was a male Iktotchi General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the early months of the Clone Wars.
Andrel Lacmar was a Human military officer during the Galactic Civil War.

Belia Darzu was a female Shi'ido who reigned as a Dark Lord of the Sith during the last quarter of the New Sith Wars. A born shape-shifter, Darzu typically appeared as a tall Human woman with short brown hair.

In around 1750 BBY during the New Sith Wars, a dark side spirit known as the "Dark Underlord" reigned as a Dark Lord of the Sith. A shadowy figure of unknown origins, he was rumored to have been summoned from the realm of chaos.

Murrtaggh was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order active during the New Sith Wars of 2000 BBY–1000 BBY. At one point he negotiated a deal with mercenaries of the Mandalorian warrior culture, hiring them to stage a diversionary attack on the camp of the Dark Underlord, a mysterious…
Tedryn was a Jedi Master who lived prior to the Great Sith War. They were a Gatekeeper of the Tedryn Holocron, which was named after them.

Andeddu was an ancient Sith Lord who was the subject of the phrase "Andeddu's flames." During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Sith Lord Darth Vader's servant, Vaneé, used the expression when he swore to capture the Rebel Alliance Lieutenant Thom Hudd after the latter esc…

Shug Ninx was a Near-Human outlaw tech from Corellia. On Nar Shaddaa, Ninx owned and operated his famous Spacebarn, an enormous shipyard where smugglers could repair and modify their ships. The only access to the Spacebarn was through a cleverly-disguised tunnel called The Chute.

Broden Kel Verdox was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who served the Galactic Republic. They installed a cloaking device on the planet of Yalara to keep the entire world hidden and thus protect the indigenous primitive species, the Yalarans, whom they thought were not yet prep…

Rax Joris was a corrupt human male prison warden in the Disciples of Ragnos who oversaw the compound on Dosuun. Occasionally, when boredom struck, he would let his prisoners loose and see if they could escape his clutches.
Coorta was a Miner at the Peragus Mining Facility in 3951 BBY with a notorious reputation for criminal activities and a strong desire to leave the facility to do something more profitable.

Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy, better known by her nickname Scout, was a Force-sensitive female Human Jedi Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the time of the Clone Wars.

Eelysa was a Force-sensitive female Human Jedi Master within Luke Skywalker's New Jedi Order. Born on the planet Coruscant after Emperor Palpatine's death at Endor, she was discovered to be strong in the Force and came to the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4 at a young age.

Guun Han Saresh was a Twi'lek male Jedi Knight best known for his exploits during the Great Hunt of 3993 BBY. A native of the planet Taris, Saresh was born into a rich and powerful family with a history of Force-sensitivity.

Valin Horn was a male Human Jedi Knight, the son of Corran Horn and Mirax Terrik Horn, and the older brother of Jysella Horn. In 43 ABY he became one of the first Jedi to become infected with Force psychosis, resulting in his encasement in carbonite.

Jysella Horn, nicknamed Sella, was a female Human Jedi Knight in the New Jedi Order. As of 43.5 ABY, Jysella carried a blue-bladed lightsaber. She was the daughter of Corellian parents, Corran Horn and Mirax Terrik Horn, and the younger sister of Valin Horn.
Lyric was a female Melodie Jedi trainee from Yavin 8. She was the daughter of Gyle.
Sannah was a female Melodie Jedi Knight from Yavin 8.
Jai Maruk was a Human male from the planet Druckenwell who served as a Jedi Master during the Clone Wars.

Shaela Nuur was a female Human who served as a Jedi Knight during the Great Sith War and its aftermath. Trained on the Jedi Order's library world of Ossus, Nuur became a strong and promising Knight under the tutelage of her Neti Jedi Master, Ood Bnar.
Moruth Doole was a male Rybet who was the administrator of the spice mines of Kessel and de facto ruler of the planet after the revolt against Imperial rule.

Daragi Hoba was the First Minister of the world Ando who led his homeworld during its secession from the Galactic Republic on the date 13:2:28, before the Clone Wars broke out between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems on 13:5:21.
Unga Torr was an Aqualish clerk at the Galactic Senate shortly before the Clone Wars. He left Coruscant for his homeworld of Ando after its secession from the Galactic Republic.
AndroosinLiann was a male Troig and the host of Essence.
Salacious B. Crumb was a male Kowakian monkey-lizard who worked as a jester in the court of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Galactic Civil War.
Saldith was a male Ithorian Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Caryn was a female Jedi who had served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during both institutions' final decade.

Ana Tathis was a female Human Jedi trained as the Padawan of Lady Caryn at some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire. After Caryn taught Tathis all she could, she disappeared, leaving Tathis on her own.
Cal was a male Human Jedi Padawan who served in the Clone Wars, a galaxy-wide conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Tyr was a male Weequay Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Tyffix was a Gand Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, Tyffix and their Padawan, Cal, were dispatched to lead a Republic clone trooper force on the planet Thustra when the world's populace attempted to secede from the Republic.
Pix, a Force-sensitive Human female, was a Padawan who served the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Lanus Wrede was a male Human Senator of Sermeria who served in the Galactic Senate during the waning years of the Republic.

Wuuden Malnic was a Rodian courier living on the galactic capital planet Coruscant in 22 BBY. Malnic was once asked by a journalist from HoloNet News CoCo District Edition what the Rodian thought of the Jedi Order refusing to return the six-month-old Force-sensitive Human Ludi…
Eeshrin Ot'Hyne was a male Caamasi senator who represented Caamas in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Separatist Crisis.
Beruga was a female Wookiee slave until she was inadvertently saved by Nim Abek, whom she repaid with a life debt by becoming his pilot for life.

Broadside was the Wookiee bartender at the Starboard Broadside Club, a cantina aboard Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport. He was overweight, and several patches of hair were missing due to scars from injuries sustained during his life as a gladiator.
Burtiin was a Wookiee who had his Trast A-A2 Speeder Truck stolen by F'ej D'aw.

Busurra was a male Wookiee who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the Atrivis sector. There, he was an able administrator and an assistant to the sector's Chief of Staff, and on a number of occasions was himself acting Chief of Staff.
Cecil was a Wookiee mechanic aboard the starship that he, Rosen, Benchar, and Carewa served on. He was also an excellent sabacc player.

Chambamakk was a Wookiee bounty hunter who worked to free the Wookiees on Kashyyyk enslaved by the Empire. After the Battle of Endor, he sought to track down those who brought suffering upon the Wookiees and kill them.

Ilena Xan served in the rank of Jedi Master during the last days of the Galactic Republic. She was a close friend of Master Jai Maruk and worked in the Jedi Temple as a hand-to-hand combat trainer, her specialty being the bondage holds.

Chankar Kim was a Jedi Master who lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic. Sometime around 22 BBY, Kim took Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy as her Padawan, even though the girl was weak in the Force.
Chenlambec was a male Wookiee bounty hunter with rare and recessive silvertip fur who fled Kashyyyk after killing an Imperial officer for beating a Wookiee child.
Cherioer was a Wookiee who assisted the Rebel Alliance in the Zaric sector. Due to this fact, Moff Linis, governor of the sector, placed a 25,000-credit bounty on Cherioer's head.

Chorrawl was a Wookiee hunter who lived during the Jedi Civil War. When he first met an amnesiac Revan, who came to Kashyyyk in search of a Star Map, he misjudged the Jedi as just another Czerka slaver because he was a Human.

Quiyyen was a male Anx ambassador of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 20 BBY, Quiyyen was kidnapped by the Confederate General Grievous, who planned to use him as bait to lure several Jedi into a trap in a dug-out cave on the planet Vandos.
R'shinnos Sh'neel was a senator who hailed from the planet of Genassa and served in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Separatist Crisis.

affiliation: Galactic Federation of Free Alliances (in free association)
x: Harrar was a Yuuzhan Vong of the Priest caste, often referred to as Eminence Harrar in accordance with his respected position. Worshiping the deception goddess Yun-Harla, Harrar was also a close advisor to Warmaster Tsavong Lah.
Gopple was the senator of Erigorm in the Galactic Senate during the onset of the Clone Wars.
Gorothin Vagger was a Aqualish Senator who represented the Andoan Free Colonies during the Clone Wars.
Abron Mar was an alien lieutenant in Takara's criminal organization. He was known to frequent a cantina located in the Katraasii Spaceport.
Takara was a crime lord and rival to Ka'Pa the Hutt. During 10 ABY Takara had stolen a Global Communications Transponder from Ka'Pa which allowed him to listen in on the Hutt's communications.
Ka'Pa was a Hutt, and crime rival to Takara.
Jang Li-Li was a Human female Jedi Knight who served as a Jedi General in the Clone Wars. In her youth, she was trained by many Masters at the Jedi Temple, Dooku being one of them.

Rees Alrix was a female Jedi who lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic. Alrix was the first Padawan of the Gran Jedi Master Maks Leem, and she later left her tutelage and became a Knight in the Jedi Order.

Eremin Tarn was a Force-sensitive individual who lived during the Galactic Republic's reign. At the age of thirteen, Tarn was taken as a Jedi Padawan by Jedi Master Maks Leem and trained to wield the Force, serving in the Jedi Order as a protector for the Republic.
Lena Missa was a female Chagrian Jedi Padawan who learned at the Jedi Order's Temple academy located on the planet Coruscant, the Galactic Republic capital, during the last years of the Clone Wars.
Atresh Pikil was a female Human Jedi Padawan who was an acolyte of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

Gumbrak Hoxz was a young Mon Calamari male who was a student at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant during the last years of the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, he was a contemporary of Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy.
Flerp was a Jedi Initiate studying at the Jedi Order's Coruscant Temple academy during the Clone Wars.
Zrim was a Jedi Padawan who was an acolyte of the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Page was a Jedi Initiate studying at the Jedi Order's Coruscant Temple academy during the Clone Wars.
Gilp was a Jedi Initiate studying at the Jedi Order's Coruscant Temple academy during the Clone Wars.
Boofer was a Jedi Initiate studying at the Jedi Order's Coruscant Temple academy during the Clone Wars.

Pax Chizzik was a male Human Jedi Initiate studying at the Jedi Order's Temple academy on the Republic capital planet of Coruscant during the Clone Wars. Charismatic and popular, Chizzik had grown used to unwittingly using mind tricks to help him succeed.
Horororibb was a Jedi Initiate studying at the Jedi Order's Coruscant Temple academy during the Clone Wars.
Bear was a male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Caudle was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Tycho was a Jedi Master and one of the many instructors at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars—among those who direct about using scenarios from the war in training—and taught military strategy to Jedi Padawan students for a term.
Hanna Ding was an Arkanian female Jedi who studied at the Jedi Order's Temple academy on the planet Coruscant, the capital of the Galactic Republic.

Sisseri Deo was a male Firrerreo Padawan serving the Jedi Order during the final days of the Galactic Republic. Stationed at the Coruscant Jedi Temple during the latter stages of the Clone Wars, Deo participated in the Jedi Temple Apprentice Tournament in 19 BBY.
Forzi Ghul was a male Jedi Initiate studying at the Jedi Order's Coruscant Temple academy during the Clone Wars.
Pirt Neer was a female Jedi Initiate studying at the Jedi Order's Coruscant Temple academy during the Clone Wars.
Enver Hoxha was a male Jedi Padawan during the Clone Wars, stationed at the Jedi Temple. During the Jedi Temple Apprentice Tournament he was pitted against Pirt Neer in the eighth round.
Hera Tuix was a female Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Politrix was a member of the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. She had red hair and was friends with fellow Jedi Jang Li-Li and Jai Maruk.
Evan Asani was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order.
Bargu was a female Clawdite Jedi Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Cale Berkona was a Human male Jedi Knight who took part in the Great Hunt, a Jedi campaign to eradicate Sith-created beasts from the the galaxy in the years following the Great Sith War.
Kaerobani was a Human male smuggler who led the Lumini Pirates. Operating out of Rathalay, he was known for his obsession over acquiring rare objects for his private collection.
Captain Mordaph Clafdatha was an officer who served during the Galactic Civil War.
Patricia Katarn was the wife of Morgan Katarn and the mother of Kyle Katarn.
Noa-Jek Darillian was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waring days of the Galactic Republic.
Rekpa De was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic.
Ivixa Delbaeth was a Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the height of the Galactic Republic.
Sidrona Diath was a male Human Jedi Master from Tatooine who served the Jedi Order up until his death in the Battle of Basilisk in 4017 BBY.
Tor Difusal was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a member of the Jedi High Council, the leading body of the Order.
Vant was a female Rutian Twi'lek Jedi who served the Jedi Order as a docent.
Reesa Doliq was a female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the final decades of peace.

Dominus was a Jedi Master who was active up to and during the Great Sith War. A respected and venerable member of the Jedi Order, Dominus took multiple apprentices, his favorite of which was the Vultan Zona Luka.
Tho-Mes Drei was a male Human Jedi Master who served as an instructor at the Jedi Temple, known for his lectures on making and keeping promises.
Jaled Dur was a male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order.

Everen Ettene was a Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order during the Separatist Crisis. While Ettene took Halagad Ventor as a Padawan, only Ventor returned from diplomacy talks in the Virgillian Civil War.
Jonas Fel'Kona was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as a recruiter for the Acquisition Division during the Galactic Republic's last years.
Devan For'deschel was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order in the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Newar Forrth, or New'arforrth in his native tongue, was a male Twi'lek Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the latter decades of the Republic Dark Age.
Fy-Tor-Ana was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as an instructor at the Coruscant Jedi Temple during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Garnoo was an ancient and long-lived Neti Jedi Master. They had an illustrious career among the Jedi, working to defend what the Order believed in and training many Jedi Knights to carry on that tradition, even until the preceding years before the Great Sith War began.
Gra'aton was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order.
Vulatan was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: Kenth Hamner was a Human male Jedi Master in the New Jedi Order, and later its acting Grand Master. A native of the planet Corellia, he took Izal Waz as his apprentice.

Lady Selnia Harbright was a young Human female senator from Salliche, who served in the Imperial Senate of the Galactic Empire. She followed proudly in the footsteps of her family for nearly three centuries.
Mammon Hoole, also known as (Indeterminate) Hoole after he dropped his first name, was a male Shi'ido from Sh'shuun.

Chlar Kotchmin was a male biologist who assisted his friend, Senior Anthropologist Mammon Hoole. After the rise of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, the two visited the planet Arzid, where Kotchmin was captured within a cocoon by a native arachnor.

Hawk Carrow was a male smuggler during the Galactic Civil War. Carrow often accompanied Roark Garnet as a co-pilot aboard the freighter Dorion Discus. During one mission, the Dorion Discus crashed on New Bakstre and Carrow was captured by Imperial forces.

Stellskard was a male Human from Banvhar Station who worked as a miner during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic. In 20 BBY, he joined Flynn Kybo's hunt for General Grievous.

Cal-i-Vaun was a male Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Part of the Temple Security Force, Cal-i-Vaun was stationed at a checkpoint at one of the Coruscant Jedi Temple's many entrances.
Alysun Celz was a Human female Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. In 25 BBY, Celz fell to the dark side and began committing crimes.

Et Rex was a male alien Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. In 25 BBY, Rex was framed for crimes that he did not commit by his friend and fellow Jedi Knight Alysun Celz, who had fallen to the dark side.

Chamma was a Devaronian male who served as a Jedi Master during the days of the Galactic Republic. Following his elevation to the rank of Jedi Knight, Chamma was selected to be part of a team of Jedi sent to investigate the distress call of a trading ship on the planet of Athiss.

Noab Hulis was a male Miraluka Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order in the years leading up to the Great Sith War. He sired three daughters, each of whom would go on to serve the Jedi Order themselves.

Mazer Rackus, a Twi'lek, was a longtime starfighter pilot of the Rebel Alliance. Rackus originally joined the Rebellion at age sixteen, well before the Battle of Yavin, after stealing his first starship from his father and crashing it on a Rebel-held planet.
Ilum was an Iron Knight who served the Jedi of the Old Republic and, after the Great Jedi Purge, joined the New Jedi Order.
Durnar was a Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Xeltek was a Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
T'Bolton was a Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Chitter was a large, blue-skinned, birdlike being with beady black eyes who trained in the Junior Jedi Academy, a class of the youngest students at the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4. Chitter was in the same class at the Praxeum as fellow Jedi trainees Anakin Solo and Tahiri Veila.

Artel Darc was a Dark Acolyte, who worked for Count Dooku during the Clone Wars. He was in charge of the Separatist forces on Dagu, where he enslaved the Rybet inhabitants. The Jedi Shaak Ti and her forces attacked Dagu. The Battle on Dagu was won for the Galactic Republic.
Ur-Sema Du was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order in the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Kai Justiss was a Human male who served as a Jedi Knight during the time surrounding the Clone Wars, and who managed to evade Order 66 and survive for a long time during the Great Jedi Purge.
Galak was a volunteer soldier for the Royal Naboo Security Forces.

Nerra Ziveri was a male Twi'lek Jedi Master. He took Lanius Qel-Bertuk as his Padawan and trained him to be a Jedi Knight. At some point, he met Klis Joo, a Duros female who was a Jedi in training at that time.
Sia-Lan Wezz was a female Human Jedi Knight and General in the waning years of the Galactic Republic, the former Padawan of Master Lo-Jad.

Wonetun was a Brubb male from Baros, powerfully built, and had a voice as raspy as his pitted hide. He was one of the Wild Knights, a fighter squadron made up of Force-sensitive pilots, and was personally trained by Saba Sebatyne.

Dané was a Human female in training to become one of the elite handmaidens serving the Queen of Naboo. Trained by Captain Quarsh Panaka, she was a competent fighter, and later went into business for herself as a bodyguard, spy, and assassin.
Toba was a male Gungan who flew the hyperlanes near the Naboo system as a smuggler during the Great Peace of the Republic.
Toma Hi'Ilani was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as a foremost tech expert

Tolan Hing was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Republic's final decades. Based in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, he was revered for being an expert in lightsabers' inner workings as well as the weapons' construction.
Binn Ibes was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic.
Belsed-Qan Idan was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Mroon Jassa was a Jedi Master who established the Jedi Praxeum on Truuine. Over the course of nearly a year, Kith Kark thrice came to Truuine and asked Jassa to train him, but the first two times only as a hobby or a task, meeting with refusal from Jassa.

Jojighar was a male Jedi Master famed for his service to the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic, alive sometime between the Ruusan Reformation and the Separatist Crisis. He was commemorated by the Biscuit Baron food chain by way of a holocube dispensed with certain food orders.

Jrul was a Jedi Master who lived sometime before the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The Master was attributed with formulating the famous Question of Master Jrul.

Jurahi was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. A member of the Almas Council, a satellite Jedi Council which oversaw Jedi business in the Cularin system, Jurahi held the title Master of Visions during the Clone Wars.
Kagoro was a Jedi Master known for expounding upon the Jedi Code's insistence of Jedi not having personal belongings.
Karena was a female Jedi scholar who first coined the term praxeum to refer to a Jedi academy. The word basically referred to a place for "the distillation of learning through action."

Ludwin Katarkus was a Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order during the years leading up to the Clone Wars. They were sent on a diplomatic mission to mediate the Virgillian Civil War with their Padawan, Danyawarra, and two other Jedi.

Danyawarra was a Jedi who was the Padawan of Jedi Master Ludwin Katarkus. In 23 BBY, they accompanied Katarkus as part of a Jedi envoy attempting to resolve the Virgillian Civil War, but the mission ended in disaster when their ship was attacked upon arrival.
Kirlocca was a renowned Wookiee male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as an instructor of lightsaber technique during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.
Kai Hudorra was a male Bothan Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Asli Krimsan was a plump Humanoid female Jedi Master with black hair who was fond of wearing a burgundy cloak. She lived thousands of years before the Battle of Yavin and trained Jedi for over 200 years. Krimsan later created a holocron.
Dav Kylanu was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Nan Latourain was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Lo-Jad was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic in the decades leading up to the Invasion of Naboo; an event which would later be recognized as part of the end of the Golden Age of the Old Republic.

Lunis was a male Weequay Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Before the war erupted, Master Lunis selected Obs Kaj as his Padawan.
Obs Kaj was the female Falleen Jedi Padawan of Lunis and a Commander during the Clone Wars.
Willm Lywin was a male Duinuogwuin Jedi Master. During the first four hundred years of his life, Lywin was part of a group of "living snubfighters" which escorted a praxeum ship.
Easal Mar was a famous Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the time proceeding the Ruusan Reformation and the sweeping changes within the Order.
Ainvar ul-Esca was a famous Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the time proceeding the Ruusan Reformation and the sweeping changes within the Order.
Marspa was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic sometime after the Ruusan Reformations that served as the catalyst for the Golden Age of the Old Republic.

Imina was a female Padawan who was trained by Jedi Master Marspa. Marspa answered Imina's question as to why Jedi could intervene to prevent domestic violence on Ord Mantell but not slavery on Nal Hutta with the answer: "For a Jedi to interfere with a culture on their homeworl…
Ma'tien was a Jedi Master who had trained Keval Raffaan.

Keval Raffaan was a male Human Jedi Knight from Chandrila. He studied at the Diplomatic Institute on Coruscant before becoming the Padawan of Jedi Master Ma'tien. He was sent to Muzara to negotiate the disputes between the Human colonists and the indigenous Muza.
A Force-sensitive, Dav-Wes Renno was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order in the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Sen Udo-Mal was a male Cerean Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Consular.
