Ronhar Kim was a male Human Jedi Master from Naboo and a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He was eventually betrayed by his close friend, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, which led to his death.
Tap-Nar-Pal, nicknamed "Tap", was a male Cerean Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Niquon was the Jedi Watchman of Yabosta and its moon, Skalokor.
Nason Laric was a male Human Jedi Padawan of Niquon, who trained him on Skalokor. Laric wielded a green lightsaber.
Norcuna was a male Rutian Twi'lek Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Leska was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Tannis was a female Omwati Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Great Sith War.

Ma'Shraid was the second intendant of the Yuuzhan Vong, and prefect of the second worldship to enter the galaxy. Her newly arrived extra-galactic forces helped bolster the forces of Prefect Da'Gara of the Praetorite Vong.

Cei Vookto was a Duros male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He trained two Padawans, including the Human Dama Montalvo.

Dama Montalvo was a Human male Jedi Padawan that served the Jedi Order and Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Three months after the war's initiation, Montalvo and his Master, Cei Vookto, fought on behalf of the Republic on the planet Lianna.
Lomi Plo was a Human female Nightsister and a Sith Master, active during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Etain Tur-Mukan was a female Human Jedi Knight and General who lived during the Clone Wars. She was the Padawan of Jedi Master Kast Fulier.
Wurth Skidder was a Jedi Knight who died during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Dorsk 82 was a Khommite Jedi Knight and clone of Dorsk 81 from Khomm. After the martyrdom of his predecessor and the devastating assault on Khommite civilization by Admiral Daala, Dorsk 82 decided to leave his homeworld behind and pursue the path of a Jedi.
Daeshara'cor was a green-skinned female Twi'lek Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order who died in battle during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Kelbis Nu was a Force-sensitive Rodian male who grew up on Susevfi as part of the Jensaarai community. The Jensaarai were in enforced service to former Imperial Moff Leonia Tavira, who threatened to kill the population of Susevfi if the Jensaarai did not serve her.

Miko Reglia was a male Human Jedi Knight who had been the apprentice of Jedi Master Kyp Durron, and co-founder of the Dozen-and-Two Avengers. He was in love with fellow Jedi Knight Octa Ramis. Miko was a very quiet and humble man who kept mostly to himself.
Swilja Fenn was a female Twi'lek Jedi Knight in the New Jedi Order and a member of Clan Fenn.

Thrynni Vae was a female Human Jedi apprenticed to Master Tresina Lobi. With Tresina she oversaw the freight transport on Duro in year 26 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War. They discovered that CorDuro Shipping held back relief goods from SELCORE at the orbital city Urrdorf City.

Drif Lij was a male Barabel Jedi Knight during the war against the Yuuzhan Vong. He was a member of Saba Sebatyne's Wild Knights Squadron, and trained under Saba. Two years into the war, Drif died when his X-Wing was destroyed in the Battle of Coruscant.
Tresina Lobi was a female Chev Jedi Master during the war against the Yuuzhan Vong. She had a noted ability for blending into crowds.
Klin-Fa Gi was a Human female Jedi Knight who served during the Yuuzhan Vong War. She wielded a gold-bladed lightsaber.

Markre Medjev was a male Human who served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Knight during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He later went on to obtain the rank of Jedi Master and Chief Librarian after the conclusion of the Second Galactic Civil War.
Octa Ramis was a female Human Jedi, originally from the planet Chandrila. Found to be Force-sensitive, Ramis joined the Jedi Order that had been established by Luke Skywalker.

Tyria Sarkin Tainer was a female Human from Toprawa and an Antarian Ranger. She was also somewhat Force-sensitive, a fact which helped her gain entrance to the New Republic Starfighter Command, but she initially showed little aptitude for either Jedi or pilot training.
Hortath (or possibly Hartoth) was a kind Jedi Master prior to the Great Sith War. As an elderly man, he became near-sighted, but refused to admit it or submit to proper treatment due to pride.
Kras'dohk was a rogue male Trandoshan Jedi Master who wandered the galaxy in the time before the Ruusan Reformation of the Galactic Republic.
Nystammall was a male Vuvrian Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Puroth was a four-armed female Eirrauc Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

The male Jedi Master Ortraag lived approximately four thousand years before the Battle of Yavin. He trained and promoted Shalavaa, a Human male, to the rank of Jedi Protector, and charged him with protecting a fenti bean colony.

Shalavaa was a Human male Jedi Knight active in the Jedi Order around the time of the Great Sith War. The Padawan of Jedi Master Ortraag, Shalavaa completed his Jedi training in 4000 BBY and was sent on his first assignment shortly afterward.
Peerce was a male Skrilling Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. He was one of Jedi hunter Aurra Sing's earlier kills.

Qalsneek the Bull was a Swimmer from Dellalt. He was a Jedi Master during the Great Sith War. He was responsible for many of the water-culture artifacts evacuated from Ossus, following its destruction in the Cron Drift supernova.
Qual was a male Selkath Jedi Master who served on the Jedi Council of the planet Dantooine's Jedi Enclave in the years following the Great Sith War.
Quatra was a female Jedi Master during the Jedi Civil War. She took Juhani as her Padawan and trained her at the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine.
Paouoish Rahhdool was a Jedi Master who was part of the Jedi Order prior to the Clone Wars. He discovered the infant Shistavanen Voolvif Monn abandoned on a world near the Arah asteroid belt.

Raltharan was a student at Jedi Master Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum on the moon Yavin 4. Master Corran Horn took Raltharan as an apprentice in 14 ABY at the same time that Jedi Jaden Korr and Rosh Penin were taken as apprentices by Jedi Master Kyle Katarn.

Alta Ranga was a male Ensel Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Master Ranga was present at the opening battle of the conflict on Geonosis in 22 BBY.
Noor R'aya was an elderly force-sensitive human male who served as a Jedi Master the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Clee Rhara was a red-headed female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Ry-Gaul was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the twilight years of the Galactic Republic. Serving the Republic as a Senior General in the Grand Army of the Republic, Ry-Gaul fought in the Clone Wars against the Separatist Droid Army.
Siolo Ur Manka, or Siolo'urmanka in Twi'leki, was a male Twi'lek Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic prior to the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY.

Ti-Amun Tiro was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a member of the Almas Academy, a board of Masters and instructors who oversaw operations of the Order's academy on Almas.
Welk was a Human Male Dark Jedi and later Sith who was a former member of the Shadow Academy, who became the apprentice of Tamith Kai after the death of her student, Vilas.
Urias Xhaxin was a male Human privateer and pirate working for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He primarily operated in the Mid Rim, including the Ado sector.
Gizor Dellso was a Geonosian male engineer who worked for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
Lura Tranor was a female Jedi Master served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Jem Ysanna was a female Human Jedi trainee. A member of the Ysanna tribe from the planet Ossus, Jem was the descendant of Jedi who had survived the destruction of Ossus by the Cron Supernova.
Tnani Ikon was a female Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Damaya was a Dathomiri female who was one of the witches of the Singing Mountain Clan. She was the niece of Baritha. Damaya fought against Gethzerion and her Nightsisters during the Battle of the Singing Mountain in 8 ABY.

Gantoris was a Human male native to the planet of Eol Sha. He was a Force-sensitive and was believed by Luke Skywalker to be a descendant of Ta'ania, herself the daughter of a Jedi Knight who exiled herself to the isolated world.
Tresk Im'nel was a male Bothan, who joined the Bothan Diplomatic Corps when Coruscant was captured by the Rebel Alliance.

Seyyerin Itoklo was a Force-sensitive Etti from the planet Etti IV who trained as a Jedi in Luke Skywalker's New Jedi Order. In 25 ABY, the galaxy was invaded by the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong, who targeted Skywalker's Order as a threat to their plans of conquest.
Jorallen was a dark-haired Human male. A Jedi Knight with a dark past, he met Danni Quee during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Waxarn Kel was a young male Human Jedi Knight in the New Jedi Order during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Kel became infuriated by the New Republic Senate's lack of support for the Jedi. During the Battle of Ebaq 9, Kel was badly scarred and became filled with anger.

Yabeley was a young male Human Jedi Knight who served the New Jedi Order during the Yuuzhan Vong War. In 26 ABY, he was trained alongside Bey Gandan and Klin-Fa Gi, and would later develop a crush on Klin-Fa.
Bey Gandan was a young Force-sensitive male Human Jedi Knight who trained in Luke Skywalker’s New Jedi Order during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Garik "Face" Loran was a male Human Imperial holovid child star who joined the Rebel Alliance as a starfighter pilot and became a member of Wraith Squadron by Wedge Antilles.

Rokur Gepta was a Force-sensitive Croke and the last Sorcerer of Tund. Born millennia before the Battle of Yavin, Gepta joined the Sorcerers in 5 BBY. After learning all that they had to offer, he killed them all, using a bioweapon to ravage the planet Tund.
Chayka was a Jedi from the Jedi Order who joined the Army of Light during the New Sith Wars. A follower of Lord Hoth, Chayka was killed during the Ruusan campaign
Nygreena Clo was a Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Ixian Rovieda was a Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Plessus Ghon was a male Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Renxis Dielle was a Jedi Padawan serving the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Kaloor Cofi was a Jedi who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Antyard-Wo Shissan was one of six in the Jedi task force involved in the Roshu Sune hostage standoff on Atzerri prior to the Clone Wars.
A Mon Calamari Jedi Knight served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during their last decades.
Shannur Darkstar was a Jedi Knight around 3000 BBY. She was one of the investigators of the ruins of Pelgrin, following the archaeological team of Ermin Phin-Mar.

Miro Daroon was a male Piton Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. A Sentinel and the tech supervisor of the Coruscant Jedi Temple, Daroon was a contemporary of the Dark Jedi Xanatos.
Dorsk 83 was a Khommite from Khomm. He was created to serve in the cloning facility where his forebears had worked, shortly before Dorsk 82 departed to train in the ways of the Jedi.
Dree-Tekes was a female Gran Jedi Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the decade leading up to the Clone Wars.
Lirondo was a male Half-Bothan Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order. He was the chief lieutenant of Lord Valenthyne Farfalla during the New Sith Wars.
Dorn Tavers was a male Human and a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Tavers had once been Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Noga-ta was an Ithorian Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic, and became the legendary "Lost Jedi" on the planet of Barab I after having prevented warfare from engulfing the native Barabel.
Awdrysta Pina, known as the Green Blade, was a male Human Jedi Master who led the Jedi Order as its Grand Master during the time of the First Great Schism.

Shon Kon Ray was a Human male Jedi Master who served as a General during the Clone Wars. Five months into the war, the Galactic Republic invaded the planet Brentaal IV when clan leader Shogar Tok, who was allied with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, caused the local pop…
Arligan Zey was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic and the Director of Special Forces during the Clone Wars.
Mana Veridi was a female Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order in the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Ranik Solusar was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic up to and during the Clone Wars. He married, and fathered a son, Kam, against the wishes of the Jedi Council, and was disciplined for his actions.
Rana was a Human female Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Known to be a noted pilot, Rana became a member of the Jedi Starfighter Corps.

Lari Oll was a Human female Jedi Knight who served as a communications technician in the Jedi Temple during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, Oll was on duty in the Jedi Temple communication center when the Separatists attacked the planet Coruscant.
Bruck Chun was a Force-sensitive twelve-year old male Human Jedi Initiate from Telos IV enrolled in the academy at the Jedi Temple in the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Halagad Ventor was a male Human Jedi Knight who was trained at an unusually late age, due to the fact that he was passed over for training initially during his childhood on Alderaan. Jedi Master Everen Ettene eventually agreed to take him as a Padawan at the Almas Academy.
Aryn Dro Thul was a Human female who was the wife of Bornan Thul and co-founder of Bornaryn Trading.

Crado was a Cathar male from the planet Cathar, and a Jedi apprentice of Master Vodo-Siosk Baas. He studied the Force, along with his fellow Cathar and life-mate, Sylvar, as well as the Human Exar Kun, on the world of Dantooine.

Tyko Thul was a Human male who was the younger brother of Bornan Thul, and he used his share of the family fortune to buy and run the droid factory on Mechis III. There he found the shell of the abandoned IG-88A, and had it refitted as a personal bodyguard.

Rii'ke En was a Human Jedi Knight who served the Galactic Republic as a general during the Clone Wars. In 20 BBY, En and the cruiser under his command engaged the Separatist cruiser Gahenna over the planet Honoghr.
Rillao was a Force-sensitive female Firrerreo who was trained by Darth Vader alongside her husband, Hethrir.

Waru was a trans-dimensional being hailing from a universe parallel to the galaxy's own. His species differed from those known to New Republic databases. Waru was considered a healer by many, due to his ability to treat injuries utilizing his own body.

Cem Fel was a Human male and one of the sons of General Baron Soontir Fel and Syal Antilles Fel. Raised as a shadow child first on Nirauan and then on Csilla, Fel was kept secret from all those outside the family until 28 ABY, when his name was leaked to a visiting group of Ga…

Cherith Fel was a Human female and fourth child of General Baron Soontir Fel and Syal Antilles Fel. She was raised on the planet Nirauan in Wild Space, and when she came of age she entered military service in the Empire of the Hand.

Davin Fel was the eldest son of the Baron Soontir Fel and Syal Antilles Fel. Raised on Corellia, he moved with his parents to the Unknown Regions when his father decided to serve Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Empire of the Hand.
Wynssa Fel, called Wyn by her family, was the younger daughter of General Baron Soontir Fel and Syal Antilles Fel.
Orame was a civilian worker at the Ossus Jedi Academy during the events of the Dark Nest Crisis. She often worked as a flight controller supervisor at the hangar.

Madurrin was a female Anx Jedi Knight who trained at Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, she was assigned to the bridge of the Mon Adapyne due to her size making her unsuitable to fly a starfighter.

Theen Fida was a male Anx Jedi Padawan who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. The apprentice of Jedi Master Tsui Choi, Padawan Fida was killed during the Yinchorri Uprising of 33 BBY.

Zule Xiss was a female Falleen who served as a Jedi Padawan during the waning days of the Old Republic. Aggressive and headstrong, she was apprenticed to the Human Jedi Master Glaive prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
Vaabesh was a male breather Gand Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Tae Diath was a male Human Jedi Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He was the apprentice of his uncle, Jedi Master Nico Diath.
Mak Lotor was a male Human Jedi Padawan and Commander during the Clone Wars.

Aubrie Wyn was the female Human Jedi Padawan of Jedi Master Sirrus and a Jedi healer who served as a Jedi Commander during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Windo Nend, called "Warble" by his friends, was a male Quara Aqualish Padawan and Jedi Commander during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, he was stationed on the planet Jabiim, where Republic and Jedi forces vied with the Separatist contingent under General Alto Stratus.
Elora Sund was a female Sullustan Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Kass Tod was a female Zabrak Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Jinkins was a male Bith who served as an engineer and general aide to the pirate captain Nym, in the years surrounding the Invasion of Naboo.
Kole was a male Chadra-Fan who was part of Nym's Lok Revenants, and served as the Feeorin's co-pilot and first mate onboard his ship, Havoc.
Thrynka Padaunete was the founder and leader of the People's Inquest, a grassroots populist Jedi-accountability watch-group.

Knire Dark was a Syboona female smuggler and Podracer pilot. Dark was active during the final decades of the Galactic Republic, during which she used the sport of Podracing as a front for her illegal smuggling activities around 24 BBY.
Tzidik Wrantojo was a Sulituan from the planet Archae Teuthis who performed as a professional Podracer pilot during 24 BBY.
"Scorch" Zanales, a male Daimlo from Daimla, was a successful Podracer.
Salmakk was a Mon Calamari pirate and smuggler during the Galactic Civil War.
Hivrekh'wao'Cheklev, also known as Cheklev, was a Devaronian male from the planet Devaron. During the Yuuzhan Vong War of 25–29 ABY, he served as a Jedi Knight in the New Jedi Order.

Hohass Ekwesh, also known as Runt, was a male Thakwaash from the planet of Thakwaa, serving the New Republic as a founding member of the starfighter/covert operations unit, Wraith Squadron and fighting in the campaign against Warlord Zsinj.

Aeron Azzameen was one of four children born into the Azzameen family. The lone daughter and next-to-last child of Tomaas Azzameen, Aeron learned of the family trade and was later employed as a freighter pilot by Twin Suns Transport Services, a shipping company owned by her fa…
Mira was a near-Human female Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Winna Di Yuni was a female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Tharence Wo was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Golden Age of the Old Republic.
Naeshahn was a female Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Ebor Taulk was a male Jedi Padawan serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Astaal Vilbum was a male Baragwin Jedi Consular and the Caretaker of First Knowledge during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Roblio Darté was a male Human Jedi Master and Jedi General who fought in the Clone Wars. He was noted for his skilled use of the crossguard lightsaber. Though he survived Order 66, he was killed during the Conclave on Kessel by Darth Vader.
Karist Dem was a Jedi killed by Sith Lord Kaox Krul during the New Sith Wars.

Vydel Dir'Nul was a Human female Jedi Knight who lived during the Clone Wars. One month before the initiation of the Clone Wars, the Jedi Council assigned Dir'Nul to serve as a bodyguard for an individual.
Iann Doaba was a male Human Jedi Knight who was one of the first colonists of Socorro.
Gruu Dunrik was a male Human doctor who was once a Jedi Initiate who studied at the Coruscant Jedi Temple in the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Allynic E'Kles was a Caamasi Jedi Master from Caamas who served as a Jedi investigator of the Jedi Order during the Golden Age of the Old Republic. His knowledge was stored in his holocron, including many of his memnii, which could be accessed by telepathic Jedi.

Neth Enasteri was a male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Having survived Order 66 and the rise of the Galactic Empire Enasteri went into hiding on Rhamalai with his secret family.
Minos Fel'Kona was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Fel'Kona was the son of the famed Jedi recruiter Master Jonas Fel'Kona.

Sylvar was a Cathar Jedi Knight from the planet Cathar. The mate of Crado, she trained in the Jedi arts under the Krevaaki Jedi Master Vodo-Siosk Baas on Dantooine, along with Crado and the Human known as Exar Kun.

Alexi Garyn, nicknamed "Lex", was a male Human member of the criminal syndicate Black Sun. Serving as a Vigo for decades, Garyn eventually attained the rank of Underlord, the highest position in the organization.
Mighella was a Human female Nightsister from the planet Dathomir. She served as the personal bodyguard and enforcer of crime lord Alexi Garyn, leader of the infamous Black Sun criminal syndicate.

Kast Fulier was a male Human Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic in the decades leading up to the Clone Wars. Along with his Padawan, Etain Tur-Mukan, Fulier was assigned to the planet Qiilura to investigate oppression by the Trade Federation.
Ginger was a male Human who was recruited into the Army of Light during the New Sith Wars to train in the ways of the Jedi Order and help defend the Galactic Republic.
Gira was a Human male Jedi Knight who survived the initial stages of the Great Jedi Purge, which was ordered by Galactic Emperor Palpatine after the end of the Clone Wars.
Glynn-Beti was a female Bothan Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Ulu Ulix was a male Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Glaive was a muscular, bald, tall Human male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic dutifully during the Clone Wars. Serving as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic, Glaive fought bravely until his death on Ohma-D'un in 22 BBY.

Zao was a blind, elderly male Veknoid Jedi Master, and an accomplished chef, who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. He did not accept missions from the Jedi High Council, but followed the will of the Force as he traveled about the galaxy.
Ferus Olin was the Human Jedi Padawan of Jedi Master Siri Tachi. Considered very mature for his age by many Jedi, Olin was well-respected for his dedication to the Jedi Order.
Tendra Risant Calrissian was a wealthy female Human Sacorrian businesswoman who was the wife of Lando Calrissian and the mother of Lando Junior.
Umak Leth was an Imperial engineer. He was one of the chief weapons engineers on the original Death Star.
Visquis was a Quarren crime lord of the Exchange responsible for its business on Nar Shaddaa until 3951 BBY.
Xor was a Twi'lek male Mandalorian slaver who fought in the Battle of Cathar prior to the Mandalorian Wars, participating in the speciecide of the Cathar people.

Maris Magneta was a Human female who served as chief of the Royal Naboo Security Forces under King Ars Veruna of Naboo. After Veruna first abdicated in 33 BBY, then was assassinated, Magneta stepped down; the new regent, Padmé Amidala, replaced her with Captain Quarsh Panaka.
Deredith Arden was a male Human and the captain of the colony ship that settled on the planet Bakura in Wild Space around 150 BBY.
Avarik was a Human male who served the Galactic Empire as a scout trooper corporal in Tempest Force during the Galactic Civil War.

Adye Prittick was a male admiral serving in the navy of the Galactic Empire. In 4 ABY, Prittick was one of the Imperial officers who survived the Imperial defeat at the Battle of Endor, being the ranking admiral following the Imperial Death Squadron's withdrawal to the planet …
Clis Prithann was a round-faced Human woman who was Eppie Belden's nurse during the Galactic Civil War.
Aari Covitenn was a Human female who served as the secretary of Gaeriel Captison at the time of the Invasion of Bakura.
Zilpha was a Human female who served as the secretary of Yeorg Captison at the time of the Invasion of Bakura.

Dren Jamer was a Human male officer who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY when the planet Bakura in Wild Space was attacked by the alien Ssi-ruuk, he was second-in-command of the Galactic Empire's military presence in the system, and the capta…
Yusanis was a legendary Echani general, prior to and during the Mandalorian Wars.

Roviden Belden was the son (and only child) of Bakuran senator Orn Belden and his wife, Eppie Belden. He was an operative of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and was executed by the Galactic Empire when it annexed Bakura in 0 ABY.
J'ilk Torlin was a male Ishi Tib Jedi Master who used a training remote to teach his students.
Dol Grenn was a Human male and a native of Telos IV who served as a lieutenant in the Telos Security Force.

Eru Matalis, best known by his title of Havac, was a Human male born on Eriadu. He was a freelance journalist, media correspondent, and holodocumentarian; among other employers, he worked for the Eriadu Free HoloDaily.
Lope was a Human male who was described as being large and muscular enough to be a smashball player. He was a veteran of the Stark Hyperspace War.
Ratrin Vhek was a Human male known to frequent the moon Nar Shaddaa.
Nap Lagard was a Neimoidian ship commander for the Trade Federation. In 32 BBY, he commanded the Lucrehulk-class freighter Acquisitor, which was stationed in the Outer Rim Territories.
Rella was a Human female with short brown hair. She was the right-hand-woman, as well as lover, of Arwen Cohl.
Wilek Nereus was a human male who served as governor of Bakura during its short tenure within the Galactic Empire.
Wynl was a male Baragwin Senator who represented the various Baragwin communities in the New Republic Senate twenty-five years after the Battle of Yavin.

A Rebel spy, Ensign Waldron infiltrated the Imperial base on Argavat and stole the Imperial Battle Codes. When the base commander realized the theft, the garrison was put under full alert, and Waldron was unable to escape.
Boiny was a male Rodian accomplice of Arwen Cohl, and a member of the Nebula Front. Along with Cohl and Rella, Boiny was one of the few surviving mercenaries of the Dorvalla Incident.
Cindar was a male Kajain'sa'Nikto who was a high-ranking member of the Nebula Front prior to the Battle of Naboo. He was Eru Matalis' second-in-command of the Nebula Front's militant wing.
Jerris Rudd was a henchman of Jabba the Hutt.

Rannd Delckis was a Human male lieutenant of the Virgillian Free Alignment who served aboard the Quasar Fire-class bulk cruiser Flurry as communications officer during the latter stages of the Virgillian Civil War, and later went into the service of the Alliance to Restore the…

Tessa Manchisco was a Human female officer who served in the Virgillian Free Alignment during the latter stages of the Virgillian Civil War. She had green eyes and black hair that she wore, in Virgillian fashion, in six braids, three on either side of her head.
Durga was an influential Hutt crime lord based on Ulmatra. He notably possessed a yacht.

Ivak was a Human male agent of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence at the time of the Battle of Endor. He was one of the agents assigned by Ysanne Isard to interrogate the arrested Mara Jade; it was Ivak's stupidity that allowed Jade to escape.

Clat'Ha was a Human female who worked as the chief operations manager for Arcona Mineral Harvest Corporation. She also had a deep rivalry with Jemba the Hutt and was a close friend to the Arcona miner Si Treemba.

Master Firwirrung was the lead entechment specialist onboard the Ssi-ruuk ship Shriwirr. He was the master of Dev Sibwarra, and, along with Elder Sh'tk'ith, had been responsible for studying him since his capture.
Sh'tk'ith was a Ssi-ruu who, along with Firwirrung, was responsible for studying the captured Dev Sibwarra. Sh'tk'ith was a hypnotist who kept Sibwarra submissive to the Ssi-ruuk.
Leviathor was the name of an ancient white Whaladon from the oceans of Mon Calamari.
Jesra Loture was a Human female who served as Captain of the Guard (and commander of the Senate Guard) of the Galactic Republic during the Separatist Crisis and the start of the Clone Wars.
Ydra Kilwallen Sibwarra was a female Human Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic, survived the Great Jedi Purge, and gave birth to a son named Dev.
Rouge Organa was a female Human who was a member of the Organa family of Alderaan and the sister of Bail, Celly and Tia Organa, as well as the adopted aunt of Leia Organa.
Tia Organa was a female Human who was a member of the Organa family of Alderaan and the sister of Bail, Celly, and Rouge Organa, and the adopted aunt of Leia Organa.
Nial Organa was a male Human who was a member of House Organa of Alderaan.
Xandel Carivus was a Human male. He came from a wealthy family which had the long ties to the Galactic Empire—so when Xandel was old enough he became a bureaucrat to serve the Imperial cause.
Nivek was one of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's minions, one of six men recruited by Bib Fortuna to assassinate the Hutt.

Count Borert Harbright of House Harbright was the owner of the conglomerate Salliche Agricultural Corporation, which owned eighteen planets in different systems, including Yulant, Broest and Ruan, being Ruan one of the headquarters of the corporation with another one on the pl…
Amer Tariq was an old statesman and former physician who served as Governor-General of Rhinnal during the first stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Shirka was a male Human who served as the Minister of Ralltiir during the first stages of the Yuuzhan Vong invasion.
Cola Quis was a male Twi'lek, senator of Ryloth to the New Republic and member of the Commerce Council.
Doman Beruss was a human female Corellian politician and a signator of the New Republic.
Verrinnefra B'thog Indriummsegh was an Elomin serving in the Rebel Alliance who was active during the last years of the Galactic Empire.
Rennimdius B'thog Indriummsegh was a male Elomin who served as the leader of the Elomin Council and represented Elom in the Galactic Senate of the Republic.
Triebakk was a Wookiee politician in the times of the New Republic. He had become the senior Senator of Kashyyyk by 24 ABY.
Ta'laam Ranth was a male Gotal senator of Antar 4 to the New Republic and head of the Senate Justice Council. He was known for being very polite and soft-spoken.

Dwuirsintabb, also known as Dwuir and Tabb, was a male Troig native to Pollillus. During the Separatist Crisis, one of his two independent heads, Dwuir, wanted to be surgically separated from the other head, Tabb, a process that would give Tabb no chance for survival.
Keos Myto was a male scout employed by the Galactic Republic, who first discovered the hyperlane that was named Myto's Arrow.

Teek was a male member of the Teek species and a native of the Forest Moon of Endor. He was a playful, mischievous being, the only companion of a stranded Human scout by the name of Noa Briqualon, with whom he shared a cabin on Endor.

Jeng Droga was an Emperor's Hand who served Emperor Palpatine during the Galactic Civil War. A Jar'Kai practitioner, he was fanatically loyal and dedicated to his master, with whom he shared a psychic link.

Syal Antilles was the eldest daughter of Wedge Antilles and Iella Wessiri Antilles. She was born in 17 ABY on Corellia, and though her father was often away due to his New Republic Defense Force obligations, she inherited his love of piloting.

Rango Tel was a particularly dim-witted Human male who hailed from the Outer Rim planet Sernpidal. Growing up as a street ruffian, an instance of utter luck led him to believe that it was his life's calling to become a bounty hunter.
Syal Antilles Fel was a famous Human actress during the days of the Galactic Empire, drawing innumerable male admirers under the stage name Wynssa Starflare.

Chelch Dravvad was a Human male who served as the senator for the Corellian sector during the first decades of the New Republic. He was also a member of the New Republic Advisory Council some twenty-five years after the Battle of Yavin.

Sien Sovv was the male Sullustan Supreme Commander of the Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic and later the Galactic Alliance Defense Force from roughly 23 ABY to 29 ABY, commanding the Defense Force just prior to and throughout the whole Yuuzhan Vong War, and again fr…
Viscountess Whirry Malreaux was the mother of the Jedi Padawan Whie Malreaux and his brother. She was one of the last surviving members of the House Malreaux on Vjun.
Viqi Shesh was a female Human politician from the Kuat system who attained galactic infamy due to her collaboration with the invading Yuuzhan Vong species during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Alpha—a name that came from his designation Alpha-17, which in turn could be shortened to A-17—was an Alpha-class ARC trooper in the Republic's clone army during the Clone Wars.
Hoth Stuff was a fathier that competed in a fathier race in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in 34 ABY.
Rakir Banai was a male Human smuggler and the father of Kitster Chanchani Banai.
Andor Vex was a male Human Jedi who served in the Jedi Order and a good friend of Jolee Bindo.
Tem Chesko was a Human male cargo jockey.

Bezzem was an alien who frequented Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on Tatooine. While drinking a Blue Dwarf, he listened to the 90-year-old Tem Chesko's tale of his 71-year syntonium crystal haul from Cirus II in 3 ABY. Bezzem was also a friend of Greedo.
Veratil was a male t'landa Til priest who, with Teroenza, took part in the Ylesia operation masterminded by the Besadii Hutt clan during the Galactic Civil War.

Mrrov was a Togorian female and the betrothed mate of Muuurgh. She had fur that was creamy white in color with orange stripes and sported vivid yellow eyes; this was considered a particularly striking appearance among her species.
Renn Tharen was a Human male Corellian who was the father of Bria Tharen and was a wealthy businessman on Corellia. Renn was married to Sera Tharen and had a son named Pavik Tharen.
Teroenza was a male t'landa Til who served as High Priest on Ylesia and worked for the Besadii Hutt clan. Like all male t'landa Til, he was able to produce a "pleasure wave" termed Exultation.
Kibbick Besadii was a cousin of Durga Besadii Tai and nephew of Zavval and Aruk Besadii Aora and member of the Besadii clan.

Zavval was the Hutt overlord of the spice refining operation on Ylesia, sibling of Aruk Besadii Aora and brother of Borga Besadii Diori. Teroenza reported directly to Zavval, who in turn reported directly to Aruk.
Mekel was a force-sensitive male human who was a prospective student of the Sith Academy on Korriban during the waning years of the Jedi Civil War.

Lashowe was a young Force Adept who sided with the Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War. Desiring power, influence and greater knowledge of the dark side, she aspired to become a full-fledged Sith student at the prestigious Korriban Academy.

Xaverri was a Human female traveling magician and illusionist who performed across the galaxy several years before the Battle of Yavin. Constantly roving and usually alone, Xaverri never settled down due to the pain she experienced in her past.
Gadon Thek was leader of the Hidden Beks, a swoop gang operating in the Lower City of Taris. He had run-ins with Marn Hierogryph, whom he referred to as a "rodent".
Brejik was the leader of the Black Vulkars, a swoop gang of the Lower City on Taris that, under his direction, led a gang war against their rivals the Hidden Beks in the time of the Jedi Civil War.

Sarn Shild was a human male who prior to the Galactic Civil War served as the Moff of the Baxel sector in the Outer Rim Territories, however Shild made little attempt to enforce Galactic Empire law in the Hutt Space region and often accepted "gifts" from powerful Hutts to ensu…
Rann I-Kanu was the a male Human Padawan of Jedi Master Ali-Vor and served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Arani Korden was a Human female who was the daughter of a Theed noble and later served as Senator to represent Naboo in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Rorworr, born in 49 BBY, was a male Wookiee who lived on Naboo with his father, an ambassador. With help from his translator droid TD0-2, Rorworr studied at the Royal House of Learning in Naboo's capital city, Theed, and often explored the wilderness areas surrounding the city.

Deel Surool was a young Twi'lek male who attended the Royal House of Learning on the planet Naboo, where he befriended several teenagers, such as the Jedi Sia-Lan Wezz, and the scouts Rorworr and Toba.
Anchor Blue was a fierce Houk gladiator who participated in the free-for-all gladiatorial brawls in the Cauldron on Rattatak, during the final years of the Old Republic.
Winstel Greelanx was a Human male who served as an Admiral in the Imperial Navy.
Tarfang was a male Ewok smuggler. He served as copilot on the freighters XR808g and later DR919a alongside the Sullustan Jae Juun.
Jae Juun was the Sullustan pilot of the XR808g, and later the DR919a, and a smuggler. His copilot was a feisty and unfriendly Ewok named Tarfang.
Larrad Shrike was the brother of Garris Shrike. Shrike was a tall, heavy-set Human male who carried a blaster. He was allowed to be armed aboard Trader's Luck because he was an officer.

Batu Rem was a Human male officer in the Telos Security Force aboard Citadel Station over Telos following the Jedi Civil War. He served under the command of Dol Grenn. When Rem went on leave, he was replaced by an impostor who assumed his name.

Luxa was a Zeltron female who worked for the Bumani Exchange Corporation aboard Citadel Station over Telos IV. She was a high-ranking member who reported directly to Loppak Slusk, chief of operations for the Exchange's activities in the Telos system.
Sera Tharen was the mother of Bria Tharen and Pavik Tharen, and married to Renn Tharen. She wrote a book entitled The Perfect Corellian Dinner Party.

Pavik Tharen was the brother of Bria Tharen and son of Sera Tharen and Renn Tharen. When Bria returned to Corellia with Han Solo after escaping Ylesia, Pavik and Sera were disgusted by Bria's companion.

Nahkee was a Phlog infant (or Phlogling), the son of Zut and Dobah. Nahkee was stolen by Morag. She framed the Ewoks by placing Ewok hoods, bows and arrows at the scene of the abduction so that the infants parents would think that the Ewoks were responsible and seek revenge.

Jagged Antilles was a male Human and the father of New Republic pilot Wedge Antilles and Holodrama actress Syal Antilles Fel. Jagged owned the Corellian Inter-System Marketing Station and fuel depot on the Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station with his wife, Zena.

At Borleias, Derricote used stolen Imperial funds to turn an abandoned Alderaan Biotics facility into a profitable personal enterprise, and implemented a number of secret defense measures that led to an overwhelming victory against New Republic forces at the First Battle of Bo…
Vett Fori was the chief supervisor of a mining operation on the asteroid Oseon 2795 during the Imperial Period, where she was assisted by Arun Feb.
Arun Feb was an asteroid miner who worked as the assistant to supervisor Vett Fori for an outfit based on Oseon 2795.
T. Lund Phuna was the local Constable on the mining asteroid Oseon 2795, appointed by the Administrator Senior of the Oseon system during the Imperial Period.

Zena Antilles was a Human female who was the wife of Jagged Antilles and the mother of Wedge Antilles and Syal Antilles Fel. Zena and Jag owned and operated outer Gus Treta, a fueling depot and spaceport located in the Corellian sector.
Roa was a Human male smuggler who operated out of Nar Shaddaa for many years, and established himself as one of the most honorable smugglers ever known.

Lwyll was a Human female who lived on the moon of Nar Shaddaa prior to the Galactic Civil War and was in love with the smuggler Roa. Roa proposed marriage numerous times and was continually rejected unless he retire from smuggling.
Dzym was a genetically altered male Droch from Nam Chorios. He was grown from his small insectoid form to take the appearance and height of a humanoid.
Veni Ramunee was a male Human Padawan of the Jedi Order serving the Galactic Republic during the Great Sith War.
Vici Ramunee was a female Human Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order serving the Galactic Republic during the Great Sith War.

Adas was King of Korriban and the Sith in a reign that lasted nearly three hundred years. He was large for his species, his skin was unusually charcoal-colored, and he was raised as a chosen being from his youth.

Spiker was a Chiss male mercenary and a member of Big Gizz's swoop gang, working for Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine. One of few Chiss to ever leave the Unknown Regions during the time of the Galactic Empire, none knew of his heritage, not even Spiker himself.
Wrenga Jixton, better known as Jix, was an Imperial agent working directly for Darth Vader.

Gizman, better known by the nickname Big Gizz, was the leader of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's swoop gang just prior to Jabba's death. He was a gargantuan Moggonite hybrid standing nearly three meters tall.
Bufus Ritsomas was, until just before the start of the Clone Wars, the senator of Till Chorios and the Meridian sector.

Wuja Wojaine represented the moon Pydyr in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic during 22 BBY. That year, Wojaine and other senators were implicated in letting slaving occur in their respective sectors, causing their positions to be suspended and their detainment.
Wim Magwit, commonly called Magwit or The Magician, and going by the stage-name The Magnificent Magwit, was a performer whose most famous act involved a "mystifying hoop."
Bellina Magwit was the wife of Wim Magwit. She performed in his magic acts along with their two children and a plethora of animals, including their green rabbit.

Toxus Li was a male pirate who was hunted down by Boba Fett during the Galactic Civil War. Although many of Li's crew members fought in his defense and were killed by Fett, Li's bounty was the only one Fett was concerned about.

Bar-Kooda was a notorious Herglic pirate who had a reputation of eating his victims. At some point by 6 ABY, the Bloodstar, the massive starship captained by Bar-Kooda, attacked a spaceliner aboard which was the magician Wim Magwit.

Yomin Carr was a male Yuuzhan Vong who belonged to the warrior caste. Tasked as an advance agent, he was sent by the Praetorite Vong vanguard force from the Unknown Regions in preparation for the imminent invasion of the galaxy.
Vua Rapuung was a Yuuzhan Vong warrior who, in 26 ABY, attained legendary status among the Shamed Ones, the shunned underclass of his species.
Nas Choka was a distinguished Yuuzhan Vong warrior who rose through the ranks of his caste to become the final warmaster of his species.
Quoreal was one of the last Supreme Overlords of the Yuuzhan Vong species and a conservative leader whose reluctance to invade the galaxy led to his usurpation and death.

Elan was a Yuuzhan Vong Priestess. Young at the start of the invasion, by Yuuzhan Vong standards she was devastatingly beautiful, with ice-blue eyes and intricately patterned lavender and maroon markings on her face.
Seef was a Yuuzhan Vong of the intendant caste. She was considered beautiful, and mated with Warmaster Tsavong Lah. She served as a Villip Mistress.
P'loh was a female Yuuzhan Vong and one of future shaper Nen Yim's crèche-mates. At one point P'loh, Yim and another of her crèche-mates, Zhul, stole a korsk.
Zhul was one of Nen Yim's crèche-mates. He was a shaper adept on the worldship Baanu Ghezh.

Ekh'm Val was a Yuuzhan Vong commander who searched for and found the living planet Zonama Sekot. When he returned to Supreme Overlord Shimrra, he was killed due to the fact that Jamaane feared Zonama Sekot, and refused to allow the knowledge of its presence in the galaxy to b…

Zhat Lah was a relative of Tsavong Lah and a Yuuzhan Vong commander. He retreated his forces from the battle at Fondor in the face of an attack launched by overwhelming Galactic Alliance forces, an unusual action for Yuuzhan Vong warriors, who typically fought to the death.
Ahsi Yim was a female Yuuzhan Vong and a member of the species' shaper caste, who experimented with the science of biotechnology to aid the Yuuzhan Vong warriors in their conquests.
Kunra was a Yuuzhan Vong Shamed One who served as the leading lieutenant of Nom Anor in the revolutionary movement constructed around the Jeedai heresy.
Shoon-mi Esh, crèche-brother to Niiriit Esh, was a Yuuzhan Vong Shamed One living in the dark underbelly of Yuuzhan'tar, the former capital of the New Republic.
Swilla Corey was a female Human jerba tender and pickpocket who lived on the planet of Tatooine. Born a slave, she was liberated by raiding Karazak slavers while her master was visiting Tatooine.

Zel was one of the leaders of the Freedom movement, serving Malinza Thanas during the height of the Yuuzhan Vong War. When Malinza escaped from jail, with the help of Jedi Jaina Solo, it was Zel's hot temper that led him to accuse Jaina of betraying them.
Zorba, also known as Zorba the Hutt, was a male Hutt who had ties with the galactic underworld during the reign of Emperor Palpatine and operated out of his palace in the Southern Rim.

Vogga was a Hutt crime lord operating on Nar Shaddaa, Nal Hutta's moon, in the years following the Jedi Civil War. His business included managing shipments of fuel from the planet Sleheyron, the largest fuel source in that part of the galaxy after the destruction of Peragus II.

Ushk Choka was a Yuuzhan Vong commander sent to pick up Nom Anor on Zonama Sekot after the former executor promised Supreme Overlord Shimrra that he would poison the living planet. Ushk Choka brought a lander with 30 warriors. It was called the Red Qurang.
Nil Spaar was a male Yevetha and member of the Spaar clan. He was the Darama, or "chosen one," of his species as well as leader of the Duskhan League during the Black Fleet Crisis.

Ry-Kooda was the older brother of the Herglic pirate Bar-Kooda. He became obsessed with revenge against Boba Fett who captured his brother and turned him over to Orko and Gorga, two Hutts who ended up eating Bar-Kooda.
Essic Daroom (nicknamed "Cartographer" by his fellow workers) was an Ithorian in the Hyperspace Navigator's Guild during the Great Hyperspace War.
Sebban Keto was a descendant of the Empress Teta legacy who owned several shops in Cinnagar, Empress Teta's capital.
Tamith Kai was a female Human Nightsister from the Great Canyon Clan on the planet Dathomir. She was Brakiss's assistant instructor at the Shadow Academy.

Vilas was a Force-sensitive male Dathomirian who belonged to the Great Canyon Clan on Dathomir. He was the Nightsister Vonnda Ra's student and eventually earned her praise for becoming what she considered to be her best male student.
Jerrod Maclain was the governor of Brentaal IV.
Shaala Doneeta was a female Rutian Twi'lek bureaucrat who was the personal aide of Count Dooku.
Tol Skorr was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic in its final decades.

Anachro the H'uun, or Anachro the Hutt, was a female H'uun (a low-caste Hutt) who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was the daughter of Orko and wife of Gorga, Orko's nemesis.

Ratri Tane was a male researcher from the planet Coruscant who worked for the Techno Union prior to the Clone Wars. He stole files from the Techno Union related to a droid prototype and was rescued by two Jedi named Ylenic It'kla and Aayla Secura.
Ooryl Qrygg was a male lungless Gand who served the New Republic as a pilot. Ooryl flew an X-Wing with Rogue Squadron and was designated Rogue Ten, serving as wingman to Corran Horn (Rogue Nine).
Shayla Paige-Tarkin was a Human female who became senator of the Seswenna sector at some point following the Eriadu Trade Summit in 32.5 BBY.
Vilmarh Grahrk, or Villie as he was often known, was a male Devaronian smuggler during the waning years of the Galactic Republic and the early days of the Galactic Empire.

Czulkang Lah was once one of the greatest warmasters of the Yuuzhan Vong, a hero to his species, and an experienced commander responsible for developing many of the tactics that the Yuuzhan Vong warrior caste would use in the invasion of the galaxy.
Mosko Bolpa was a male Moggonite from Arorua who lived a decade before the Invasion of Naboo.
Locus Geen was a General in the Grand Army of the Republic, who fought with distinction in the Clone Wars. He later became an informant for the Rebel Alliance.

Nikkos Tyris was a male Anzati who had served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Knight during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. Tyris fell to the dark side of the Force and became one of the founders of the Jensaarai.
Foolookoola was young Ootoolan princess, she was the only surviving member of her family; they were staunch loyalists who were murdered by thugs of the Revolutionary Purist Council.
Tinté Vos was a Kiffar female who was the great-aunt of Kiffar Jedi Master Quinlan Vos and ruler of the twin worlds Kiffu and Kiffex during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Dominic Raynor was a human business mogul who owned Raynor Mining Enterprises and was a widely reputed gangster. Prior to 22 BBY, Raynor took control of the Wheel space station, and embezzled millions of credits from the station to support mining operations on various planets.

Hoole was a researcher who looked after Zak and Tash Arranda. The Arrandas, alongside a droid, assisted him in his work. On one occasion, Hoole tasked his charges with studying energy spiders, though the two were disinterested, wishing to instead research the Jedi Knights.
Bandor was a Moff who represented the planet of Questal. Bandor championed the Hurlothrumbic Generator project: a device which could stimulate the brain into feeling fear.
Edan was a moff on the Imperial Remnant's Moff Council in 19 ABY. He was a skeptic of a proposed truce between the Remnant and the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Volfe Karkko was a learned Anzat Jedi Master–turned–Sith magician who lived more than a thousand years before the Invasion of Naboo.

Quian Vos was a female Kiffu Guardian. She was married to Pethros Vos with whom she had a son, Quinlan. She was the cousin of Tinté Vos, who arranged to give Quian and Pethros to the Anzati as a sacrifice in exchange for the Anzati feeding on the Kiffex prisoners.

Pethros Vos was a male Kiffu Guardian. He was married to Quian Vos with whom he had a son, Quinlan. Pethros and Quian were given as a sacrifice to the Anzati by Tinté Vos, in exchange for the Anzati feeding on the Kiffex prisoners.
Ebareebaveebeedee was the Squib king of Skor II from the last decades of the Galactic Republic into the time of the Galactic Empire and the Galactic Civil War.
Kurlin Vos was a sheyf of Kiffu and Kiffex around 60 BBY. His sister was Tinté Vos.

Chom Frey Kaa was a corpulent white-skinned male Twi'lek senator who represented the Twi'leks of the Gaulus sector in the Galactic Republic Senate. Along with Orn Free Taa and Connus Trell, Kaa was a loud voice in the Senate, but was ultimately brought up on corruption charges.
Molierre Cundertol was a Bakuran male New Republic Senator from Bakura, who later became the planet's Prime Minister and a member of the Defense Council.
Stanton Rendar was a male Human and the brother of Dash Rendar.
Simonelle was an Ingoian scientist based in the Minos Cluster. His enclave was hidden.
Heater was a high-ranking male henchman of Jabba the Hutt in Mos Eisley. He was fat and grotesque and therefore often posed as Jabba for public functions.
Kh'aris Fenn was a white-skinned Twi'lek in the days of the Galactic Republic. He was the son of Ro Fenn, leader of Clan Fenn, and had been exiled from Ryloth for heinous crimes.

The Human male Jace Dallin was a career military man from the planet Rendili with a deep love for the Galactic Republic. He served as an aide to Militarist Senator Ranulph Tarkin and as second-in-command of Tarkin's military, the Republic Outland Regions Security Force.
Harsh was a Human male who served the Galactic Empire as Moff of the Bosph sector in the Outer Rim Territories during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Zac'ryah Vos was a male Kiffar General of the Galactic Republic who represented Kiffu and Kiffex at sector security conferences during the Clone Wars. He was heavily scarred, with severe burns across his face, and his left eye replaced by a cybernetic implant.
Asanté Vos was a female Kiffar, and cousin to Quinlan Vos.
Holmar Grahrk was a Devaronian, and, like his cousin Vilmarh was a smuggler, bounty hunter and all-round criminal.
Sise Fromm was an elderly male Annoo-dat who at one time, was the head of the most powerful crime syndicate in the galaxy. He had two sons, Sonko and Tig.
Tig Fromm was a male Annoo-dat Blue gangster and, as the son of Sise Fromm, heir to the most powerful crime family in the galaxy.

Sa Cuis was a Human male Dark Jedi and an Emperor's Hand. During the early months of his master Palpatine's Galactic Empire, Cuis commanded the Imperial Commando Special Unit, a unit tasked with hunting down Jedi and deserters.

Erv Lekauf was a lieutenant in the Imperial Army who served as Darth Vader's personal aide for several years. On a mission to Vohai in 19 BBY, Lekauf helped Vader fight the Emperor's Hand Sa Cuis, impressing the Dark Lord with his courage and loyalty.

Vlix Oncard was a Male Annoo-dat Blue who worked as the head of security for the infamous Fromm Gang, reporting directly to Sise Fromm. He was a close friend and confidant of Tig Fromm, and was fiercely loyal to the family.
Brenn Tantor was a young Human male from Garos IV who dreamed of becoming one of the Imperial stormtroopers who kept the peace on his homeworld.

Meeko Ghintee was a male Muttani criminal who was operating during the time of the Invasion of Naboo. A known cheat, Meeko made his dishonest living in the underworld of beast pit-fighting games, such as those held on Outland Transit Station.
J'tt'sa was a transport pilot. He transported Mara Jade to Kintoni in 4 ABY.
Barkale was the Imperial Governor of Kintoni around 4 to 5 ABY.
Brass Marshoo was a Gungan male chef who lived in Otoh Gunga on the planet Naboo during the rise of the Galactic Empire and during the Galactic Civil War.
Sirrakuk was the younger sister of Lowbacca and niece of the famous Rebel hero Chewbacca. She shaved distinctive patches into her fur and loved to fly starships.

Finn was a Human male Sith Master who operated as a terrorist during the final years of the New Sith Wars. During his tenure as Sith, he trained a young man as his apprentice. Finn and his pupil traveled to a planet and planted a bomb in a building.
The Humans Tia and her twin sister Ghia were born on Bestine IV and joined the Rebellion to fight the Galactic Empire.
The Human Ghia and her twin sister Tia were born on Bestine IV and joined the Rebellion to fight the Galactic Empire.

Morn was a male Mon Calamari member of the criminal syndicate Black Sun. Having attained the rank of Vigo, Morn was based on his homeworld Dac and oversaw Black Sun operations in that sector of the galaxy.
Darnada was a male Dug member of the criminal syndicate Black Sun and the owner of Deep Space Demolition and Removal.

Dardo was a male Rodian member of the criminal syndicate Black Sun. Having attained the rank of Vigo, Dardo and the rest of the Black Sun leadership were brutally slaughtered during an attack by the Sith Darth Maul in 33 BBY.
Tef Shabiak was the most senior executive, and Clone Master, at Arkanian Microtechnologies on the planet Vohai.

Nep Chung was a male Phuii member of the criminal syndicate Black Sun. Having attained the rank of Vigo, Chung and the rest of the Black Sun leadership were brutally slaughtered during an attack by the Sith Darth Maul.

Whee Tillatch was a Yarkora male who was a member of the criminal syndicate Black Sun. Having attained the rank of Vigo, Tillatch and the rest of the Black Sun leadership were brutally slaughtered during an attack by the Sith Lord Darth Maul.
Nara Dun was a New Republic information officer who survived an attack by an Eclipse-class dreadnought.
Horgo Shive was a Muun commander for the InterGalactic Banking Clan and particularly favored Hailfire droids when conquering new planets.

Jo Ewsli was the author of The Anthropology of Engineering and the designer of the I-7 Howlrunner starfighter. He designed the starfighter after being inspired by the hunting strategies of the howlrunners of the planet Kamar.

Fitch was a short, stout Ferroan shipbuilder living on Zonama Sekot. In 29 BBY he helped complete the Zonama Sekotan ship, Jabitha, for Anakin Skywalker, whom he was responsible for teaching the basic information needed to pilot the ship.
Miranda Doni was a female Human who served as a starfighter pilot with the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Hexler Pend was a male Human Officer for the Royal Naboo Security Forces who was stationed in the city of Keren. His group was attacked by Trade Federation MTT's during their blockade of the planet.

Hurkk was an Imperial Admiral who commanded the Imperial forces in the Battle of Oovo IV. They were furious that the Rebel Alliance was using Nebulon-B frigates, originally designed for use by the Imperial Navy to protect convoys from Rebel starfighter actions.

Tobias Pall was a sergeant in the Security Guard of the Royal Naboo Security Forces. During the invasion of the planet Naboo by the Trade Federation in 32 BBY, Pall was rooted from Naboo's swamps by Single Trooper Aerial Platforms.

Moza was an Ithorian and the primary representative of Chodo Habat on Citadel Station. Moza approached Meetra Surik about assisting with the restoration of Telos IV by thwarting Czerka Corporation and the Exchange who sought to undermine the work of the Ithorians.
Mebla Dule was a Human female. She was an enthusiastic player of Pazaak who encountered Meetra Surik in the cantina on Citadel Station over Telos IV.

Dendis Dobo was a Duros merchant encountered by Meetra Surik on Citadel Station over the planet Telos IV. Dendis co-owned the Dobo Brothers' Emporium with his brother, Samhan; the two shared a module but often disagreed over the ethics of their business.

Samhan Dobo was a male Duros merchant who was living on Citadel Station over Telos IV as of 3951 BBY. He co-owned the Dobo Brothers' Emporium along with his brother, Dendis; although the two established their shops in the same module, each brother held great resentment for the…

Tharil Tavira was a Human male Imperial Grand Moff who was appointed by Emperor Palpatine to oversee Eiattu 6 during the Galactic Civil War. Although married, he began an affair with a young native girl named Leonia, whom he married when his wife died suddenly and unexpectedly.

Pol Secura was a male Twi'lek who was the uncle of Jedi Knight Aayla Secura and Nat Secura and the brother of Lon Secura. He was also a member of the Twi'lek Ruling Council and the Clan Chief of Clan Secura.
Nat Secura was a male Twi'lek who was the cousin to Jedi Knight Aayla Secura and son of Lon Secura. He was also the Secura heir.
Nikki Vul was a female Human who worked as a HoloNet news reporter near the end of the Clone Wars.
Inc was a clone trooper lieutenant who fought in the Clone Wars as a part of the Grand Army of the Republic's 327th Star Corps under the command of Jedi General Aayla Secura and Clone Commander Bly.

Osted Wermis was an Imperial admiral and the commandant of Anaxes. Following the Battle of Endor and the New Republic's capture of Coruscant, he held the Axum system even as the Republic gained control of the Core Worlds.

Savan was a member of a Falleen royal family and the niece of Prince Xizor. While the rest of Xizor's family was on Falleen, Savan was offworld working for her uncle, therefore escaping Darth Vader's incineration of their home city.
Alum Frost was a trainee at the Imperial Royal Guard Academy on Yinchorr who did not pass its final examination.
Lemmet Tauk was a trainee at the Imperial Royal Guard Academy on Yinchorr and a close friend of Kir Kanos.
The One was the leader of a Rakatan tribe known as the Black Rakata, who settled on Lehon beneath the Star Forge.
Grappa was a Hutt criminal who lived on Genon. At one point, he owned the starship Moldy Crow and employed the smuggler Roark Garnet.
Green Wizard, known also as CT-19/39, was a clone trooper sergeant during the Clone Wars. He was a Clone commando and died during the Battle of Praesitlyn.
Soonis was a Jedi Knight who single-handedly defeated a vicious, mysterious group of raiders in the days of the Galactic Republic.
Ylan Ghalir was a male Mon Calamari who designed and produced the Leviathan Power Armor for use by the Rebel Alliance. Ghalir was captured by the Empire and taken to an Imperial prison.

Mungo Baobab was a male Human merchant from Manda. During his youth, Baobab displayed a love of travel and adventure which left the family elders concerned about his suitability as heir to the famous Baobab Merchant Fleet.

Carl was a Shikitari insectoid who was purchased to participate as a gladiator in free-for-all mortal brawls in the Cauldron arena, the largest combat pit on the planet Rattatak, shortly after the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
Crix Madine was a human male who led a commando unit of the Galactic Empire's military until he defected to the Rebel Alliance, where he served as a general.

Pqweeduk was a Rodian. He was the son of Greedo the Elder and Neela and the younger brother of Greedo. After her husband was murdered by Navik the Red during the clan purges, Neela fled Rodia with her then-two-year-old son, along with other members of her family and Tetsu clan.
Teeku was a Rodian member of the Tetsu Clan. Along with Teeko, he was one of the uncles of Greedo, a bounty hunter active during the Imperial Period.
Hulas was a Rodian Overseer of the GenoHaradan who tried to persuade the Jedi Revan to join the organization during his visit to Manaan.

Malo was a Rodian smuggler and an associate of Han Solo. He and another Rodian sometimes employed Solo to smuggle spice. Malo and his partner made one such exchange with Solo in 0 ABY, allowing Imperial prisoner Mira Volz to sneak aboard Solo's Millennium Falcon.
By't Disombe was a Twi'lek podracer who participated in the Vinta Harvest Classic on the planet Malastare around 32 BBY.

Ephin Sarreti was a human male politician who was the Grand Moff of the Imperial Remnant from 19 ABY. As the Moff of the Braxant sector, Sarreti was relatively progressive and was a loyal supporter of Grand Admiral Gilad Pellaeon.

At the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War, Moff Crowal was a Human female who served as a member of the Moff Council and governor of Valc VII. She had a habit of requesting more resources than her world could ever need and preferred to let the Yuuzhan Vong destroy the New Republic.

Kurlen Flennic was the Human male bureaucrat who served as Moff of Yaga Minor. Under Galactic Empire, Flennic was appointed to that position by Emperor Palpatine himself, and was still a Moff as of the signing of the Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty in 19 ABY.

Freyborn was a Human Moff of the Imperial Remnant during the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. He refused to believe that the Galactic Alliance was more capable of handling the Far Outsiders and their biots, even after the Battle of Borosk.

Granta Omega was a human male criminal and the son of the Dark Jedi Xanatos and the grandson of Telosian Governor Crion. Omega vowed revenge on the Jedi Order for his father's death, not wanting to accept the fact that Xanatos killed himself.
Cole Fardreamer was a New Republic mechanic from Tatooine.
Orr Agg R'orr was a Tusken who served the Sand People and was known for sniping and disabling Teemto Pagalies' Podracer at the Boonta Eve Classic on Tatooine in 32 BBY.
URoRRuR'R'R was a skilled Tusken Raider hunter who once attacked Luke Skywalker as the latter was trying to find R2-D2 in the Jundland Wastes.

Raito was a Tusken Raider known for having once killed a young Jedi. The tribe that orally recorded this event was destroyed early in galactic history, but Raito's gaderffii at some point was recovered by another tribe's Storyteller.
A-Zulmun was a Tusken Raider tribal leader, and the slayer of Ranon Djelkh.

The Jundland Banshee was a mysterious Tusken Raider that operated in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. Acting alone, this Tusken Raider would attack settlements in and around the wastes, earning a reputation as a fearsome warrior.
Romm Zqar was a Yuuzhan Vong commander, in charge of the landings on Coruscant during the attack on the planet in 27 ABY.

Tyger was a Wookiee who operated a nightclub on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Around 31 BBY, a group of freelance agents spoke to Tyger during the course of an investigation to locate the Human Selima DeWitt, an acquaintance of the Wookiee.
Darra Thel-Tanis, also known as Darra Haariden, was a female Human Jedi Padawan of Master Soara Antana during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Jenna Zan Arbor was a Human female, and a deranged scientist from the planet of Ventrux. Throughout her career, she had numerous confrontations with the Jedi Knights Qui-Gon Jinn, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Anakin Skywalker.

Jolli was a Human female pirate who served on the crew of the notorious Crimson Jack's gang during the Galactic Civil War. Short-tempered and quick-triggered, Jolli was abandoned by her fugitive father as a young girl, instilling in her a deep hatred of men.

Kex was a male Mandalorian warrior who worked as a quartermaster of the Mandalorian camp on Dxun after the Jedi Civil War. Prior to joining the camp, he was found by Mandalore the Preserver while working as muscle for Hutts on Nar Shaddaa.
Davrel was a blue-armored Mandalorian recruit on the jungle world of Dxun during the Dark Wars, serving under Mandalore the Preserver.
Bralor was a Human male Mandalorian Field Marshal and the champion of the Battle Circle at the Mandalorian base on Dxun following the Jedi Civil War.

Tagren was a Mandalorian male warrior under Mandalore the Preserver on Dxun. In 3951 BBY, he was a strong Mandalorian and a great warrior, but he failed to defeat Meetra Surik in the Battle Circle within the camp even though the fight was unarmed and Surik wasn't allowed to us…
Azkul was a Sith veteran of the Jedi Civil War who later became a mercenary in the employ of the Exchange.
Warto was a male Boltrunian who served the Cloud-Riders under the leadership of Serji-X Arrogantus. Originally a laborer on a Corellian freighter, his behavior and temper addled his crewmembers.

Azoora was a female Wroonian who lived on the Outer Rim world of Aduba-3 during the Galactic Civil War. Known for her beauty among the residents of the spaceport Tun Aduban, Azoora frequented the town's nightlife and developed a troublesome reputation.

Serji-X Arrogantus was a male Human swoop jockey who toured the professional circuit on Caprioril during the Imperial Era. He was nicknamed "the Arrogant One," due to his continual flagrant disregard for the rules and the dangers of professional swoop racing.
Hedji was a member of the near-extinct Spiner species who found work as a mercenary during the Imperial Era.
Anavus Svag was a Near-Human Jedi Guardian during the events that surrounded the Great Hyperspace War, when the Sith Empire made their thrust for domination of the Galactic Republic.

Don-Wan Kihotay, born Hess Korrin, was a Force-sensitive male Human who served as a librarian on Obroa-skai. A fanatic of the fallen Jedi Order, Korrin fantasized about being a Jedi Knight, as he had much spare time to read their lore and history.

Jimm Doshun, also known as "the Starkiller Kid" was a Human male native to the village of Onacra on Aduba-3. Orphaned at the age of three, Doshun was raised by an obsolete tractor-robot, FE-9Q, and grew to become a rebellious teenager.

Walon Vau was a Human male who became a Mandalorian. Born on Irmenu as heir to the title of Count of Gesl, he was exiled from his homeworld after a love affair with the princess of a neighboring province fell afoul of the Imperius priesthood.
Zeth Durron was the older brother of Kyp Durron who was conscripted into the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire.

Sano Sauro was a male Human prosecutor for the Galactic Senate and later the senator of Eeropha for a number of decades near the end of the Galactic Republic. He had a number of political confrontations with the Jedi, particularly Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Tyro Caladian was a male Svivreni lawyer and bureaucrat working as a Senatorial aide during the last years of the Galactic Republic. He was cousin to Curran Caladian, also a Senatorial aide.

Roan Lands was a young Human male who was the partner of the former Jedi Ferus Olin. They founded the business Olin and Lands, and started the resistance group The Eleven to oppose the Galactic Empire.

Lorian Nod was a male Human Jedi serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a member of the Agricultural Corps following his expulsion from the Coruscant Jedi Temple's academy in the decades preceding the Clone Wars.
Ramiz was a male Human farmer who lived on the Outer Rim planet Aduba-3 during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Khabarakh was a Noghri male member of Clan Kihm'bar hailing from the planet of Honoghr. He participated in Chiss Grand Admiral Thrawn's campaign to destroy the New Republic, attempting to kidnap Princess Leia Organa Solo during a Mission to the Mid Rim planet of Kashyyyk.

Patch Bruit was Lommite Limited's chief of field operations in 33 BBY. Although he served the company for nearly twenty years, working his way up from the lommite pits, he had long dreamed of starting over and relocating to Coruscant or one of the other Core worlds and making …
Bobolo Baker was a Bith musician who founded the Bobolo Baker's All-Bith Band.

Pi-Lippa was an alien enslaver who, for a time, acquired the Human Shmi Skywalker as property. Pi-Lippa taught Skywalker technical skills and intended to grant her freedom, however, the alien died suddenly in approximately 41 BBY, shortly after the birth of Shmi's son Anakin.

Joram Kithe was male Human accountant for the Galactic Republic who received a temporary commission as a lieutenant in Republic Intelligence in order to study the performance of clone troopers on Pengalan IV.

Danni Quee was a female Human New Republic scientist active during the Yuuzhan Vong War. She was present at the very first Yuuzhan Vong incursions into the galaxy, experiencing the horrors of war and the ferocity of the invaders at Helska IV, a planet she was taken to after be…
Owen was the perceived brother of Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi seen through a vision from the Force. In reality, Kenobi was actually seeing Owen Lars, Anakin Skywalker's stepbrother.

Miracle Meriko was a musician during the Clone Wars, and into the Galactic Civil War whose song "Stardance" reached number two on the charts in 22 BBY. He eventually died while under Imperial custody in 6 BBY with a bounty of 20,000 credits on his head.
Annadale Fayde was a female Ho'Din musician who often wrote melancholic lyrics. She also never used the same backing band twice.
Rorax Falken was a renowned physicist and one of the multitude of scientists and engineers whose work was incorporated into the first Death Star.
Gaeriel Capens was a musician during the last years of the Galactic Republic. She was a member of the Melody Fellowship.
Bachenkall, a male Human Imperial Navy officer, was one of the Star Dreadnought Executor helmsmen during the events leading up to the Battle of Hoth.

Hekula was a male Dug and the son of the famous podracer pilot Sebulba. Following in his father's footsteps, Hekula inherited Anakin Skywalker's Podracer, which Sebulba had purchased from Qui-Gon Jinn.
Cavik Toth was a human male mercenary who pledged the support of Sabaoth Squadron to the Confederacy of Independent Systems, becoming an early ally to Count Dooku prior to the Clone Wars.

Snoova was a Wookiee bounty hunter and mercenary active during the Galactic Civil War. He was ostracized from Wookiee society and faced the death penalty on his homeworld, Kashyyyk, due to his violation of the Wookiee injunction against the use of his species' natural claws fo…
Deej Warrick was an adventurous Ewok warrior.

Shodu Warrick was an Ewok female from the Forest Moon of Endor. She lived in Bright Tree Village and was married to the Ewok warrior Deej Warrick, with whom she had four children: Weechee, Widdle, Wicket, and Winda, whom she raised to be considerate to others.
The Ewok Weechee Warrick was the oldest son of Deej and his wife Shodu. He had two brothers, Willy and Wicket, and a sister, Winda. Weechee was the love interest of Chirita.

Shey Tapani was an Old Republic noble and the man who united the Expanse. In a twenty year civil war, Tapani, the lord of House Melantha, waged a war against the other Noble Houses, which were then independent kingdoms.
Avaro Sookcool was an obese Rodian who was the uncle of Greedo and spoke Basic albeit with a lisp.
Benedict Vidkun was a henpecked engineer working in the sewers on Coruscant in Imperial City.

Furlag was a small-time bounty hunter with large, batlike ears. Operating during the height of the Galactic Empire, he was not well-known, but often worked with other prominent bounty hunters, such as Zuckuss and 4-LOM.
Howzmin was a loyal servant of Prince Xizor, and was short, squat, and bald Human.
Skahtul was a Barabel bounty hunter who captured Luke Skywalker and tried to negotiate a larger reward for the capture by playing the two factions who wanted Skywalker against each other.

Jurnel Arrant was a Human male from Corellia, serving as a the executive officer of Lommite Limited around the time of the Invasion of Naboo. Secretly, Darth Sidious manipulated events to put Lommite Limited out of business and allow the Trade Federation to take their mines.

Caba'Zan was the male Falleen head of security for InterGalactic Ore up until it merged with Lommite Limited to become Dorvalla Mining. He hired the Toom clan to sabotage LL in 33 BBY. The clan betrayed both companies, sabotaging them instead.
Nort Toom was the Weequay leader of the criminal organization known as the Toom clan.
Kumus was a Human male Mandalorian warrior who was recruited into Clan Ordo who had been sent into the jungle planet of Dxun.
Zuka was a Mandalorian warrior who was aided by Meetra Surik in fixing a telemetry computer in the Mandalorian base on Dxun.

Fodo Medoo was a Rodian male gambler who lived during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire. In 3956 BBY, he worked loading cargo for the Czerka Corporation on the Mid Rim planet of Kashyyyk. He spent his time off playing the card game pazaak.
Dehno was a Human male patrol captain who worked for the Czerka Corporation branch on Kashyyyk.

Gorwooken was a male Wookiee who operated the elevator that allowed for easy transport between the tree cities and the Shadowlands of Kashyyyk, during the time of the Jedi Civil War. He was from the village of Rwookrrorro.

Charal was a Force-wielding Nightsister who turned her back on the sisterhood and left her homeworld of Dathomir. Before getting off the planet for good, she stole the Talisman of the Raven, a prized artifact that allowed her to metamorphose into a bird known as a raven.
Burr Nolyds was a wealthy and arrogant Human male aristocrat who briefly ruled the Galactic Empire in 11 ABY as head of the Imperial Interim Ruling Council.

Vess Kogo was a Human male Emperor's Hand. After his mother was injured as a bystander during a Rebel protest against Imperial taxes on the planet Hanofar, Kogo developed a burning hatred for the Rebellion, which he fueled with the dark side after becoming one of Emperor Palpa…
Alabar Double Ax was a Sikurdian berserker pirate, one of the first quarries to be apprehended by the bounty hunter Beilert Valance. Their ship was confiscated by Valance, and renamed Kill Switch.

Macus Kayniph was a Near-Human member of Black Sun. At the time of Palpatine's final death in 11 ABY, he was one of the higher-ranking members of the organization, and in charge of their operations on Smarck.

Y'ull Acib was a male Human member of the criminal syndicate Black Sun. A hardened criminal and among the galaxy's most dangerous, Acib had been serving out a prison sentence in the spice mines of Kessel when the New Republic released him and sixteen others on Coruscant to fos…
Feena D'Asta was a politician in the Imperial Remnant and the daughter of Baron Ragez D'Asta. Noted for her ambition, she was friends with Mirith Sinn, the wife of her father's business partner.
