Ragez D'Asta was a powerful shipping magnate and Baron of the Galactic Empire, as well as a firm supporter of Emperor Palpatine.
Blotus was a Hutt male who served as the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic for a 275-year term during the Rianitus Period, an era that lasted from 9000 to 8000 BBY.
Maze, formerly known as Alpha-26 or A-26 was an Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando captain in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Ian Rim was a male Lieutenant in Kyp's Dozen, a New Republic affiliated starfighter unit, during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He was killed during the Battle of Coruscant.
Nas Ghent was a male Human and hotshot starfighter pilot of the Imperial Navy who originally fought for the Confederacy of Independent Systems fleet during the Clone Wars.
Tojjevvuk, son of Tvrrdko, was an albino Wookiee who was a master at freeing his fellow Wookiees from slavery.

Jipoly Numifolis was the captain limmie player for the planet Coruscant's limmie team. The issue of HoloNet News' CoCo District Edition on the date 13:3:14 reported that the inexperienced Team Coruscant was soundly defeated by the planet Fondor's team in the opening round of t…

Onila Richblum was a limmie player for the planet Yag'Dhul's team in 22 BBY. That year, Team Yag'Dhul triumphed over the planet Kinyen's team in the opening round of the Galactic Cup of Limmie with two unanswered points from Richblum.
Hodrix was a male Dug who was a swoop racer and a member of Team NaKuda. As a newcomer to the sport, racing on Caprioril, he quickly upstaged the former favorite, Serji-X Arrogantus.

Jo-Mau-Rinti was a male Cerean swoop racer who served as a member of Team NaKuda during the Separatist Crisis. He perished in a massive explosion which killed nearly 200,000 swoop race spectators by an assassin droid.
Maxo Vista was a celebrated, award-winning athlete from the planet Euceron.
Boon Soniita was a swoop racing legend, and the grandfather of swoop racer Boon Soniita III.

Boon Soniita III was a swoop racer during the last years of the Galactic Republic. He was the grandson of swoop racing legend Boon Soniita. Boon Soniita III was seriously injured during races at least twice in his career.
Dretti Grond was a swoop racer who served as a member of Team Millennium Holos during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Ignar Ominaz was a swoop racer during the last years of the Galactic Republic. He was a member of Team Millennium Holos. He was killed in a terrorist attack on Caprioril during the Galactic Empire's reign.

Shedao Shai was a Yuuzhan Vong warrior and commander who, following the defeat of the Praetorite Vong at Helska IV, took over it and led the fleet that attacked the Outer Rim Territories during the invasion of the galaxy.

Charza Kwinn was a legendary male Priapulin starship pilot, pirate and smuggler who occasionally aided the Jedi Order for well over a century and was known to have transported Jedi to various planets and other locations across the galaxy.

Savuud Thimram was one of Emperor Palpatine's trusted Dark Side Adepts. A Human male from Chandrila, Thimram was personally trained by the Emperor on the Deep Core world of Byss and became one of Palpatine's most faithful servants.
Pwoe was a Quarren New Republic Senator and who proclaimed himself Chief of State after the fall of Coruscant.

Oncho Shen was a Human male who lived on the Outer Rim planet Aduba-3 during the Galactic Civil War. Shen lived in the farming village of Onacra with his daughter Merri and her grandfather, a local mystic known as the Old One.
Merri Shen Doshun was a Human female who lived in the small farming village of Onacra on the Outer Rim planet Aduba-3.
Berethron e Solo was a King of Corellia. During Solo reign, he initiated democratic reforms in the Corellian empire.
Grabda Weng was a professor of socio-politics at the University of Alderaan during the Clone Wars.
Halcor Raystel was the dean of the University of Alderaan just prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

Dalus Othona was the Provost of the University of Alderaan in 22 BBY. That year, the university's Dean, Halcor Raystel, caused a three-month scandal when it came to light that he was addicted to ryll spice and had offered class credits in exchange for sexual favors to two fema…

The "almighty Sarlacc," also known as the Sarlacc of Carkoon, was the sarlacc that inhabited the Great Pit of Carkoon on the planet Tatooine. It floated through space until landing on Tatooine, during the time when the planet still had lush rainforests.
Nobam Nol was a prophet who was able to convince the people of the planet N'ildwab that he was a powerful Sith Lord, and as a result garnered a fervent following on the planet.
Adler Roty was a professional stage performer who claimed to be one of the Sorcerers of Tund, an ancient sect of sorcerers based on the Outer Rim planet Tund.

Havidald Guffin was the principal of the public subadult school PSAS-5128, located in the Jrade District of the Core World planet Coruscant, in 22 BBY. That year, the Jrade School Board discovered several students in the school who possessed death sticks.
Shelbin Dang was the Director of Monument Plaza on Coruscant during the time of the Separatist Crisis and Clone Wars.
Senator Jheramahd Greyshade was a Human male who represented the Commonality in the Galactic Senate of the Republic.
Keller was a clone trooper commander of the Grand Army of the Republic who served under Jedi Generals Simms and Kai Hudorra, as well as Jedi Commander Noirah Na, toward the end of the Clone Wars.
Jai'galaar, also known simply as Jag and designated CT-55/11-9009, was a clone trooper captain who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Kile Hannad was a Royal Guard who survived the aftermath of the Emperor's defeat at Byss and death on Onderon.
Tem Merkon was an informer on Phaeda and a double agent for both the New Republic and local Imperial garrison.
Fynn Torve was a member of Talon Karrde's smuggling organization.

Candobar Inglet was the khedive of Sluis Van and the Sluis sector during the Clone Wars and the era preceding it. Shortly before the start of the war, he and his sector seceded to the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Corlissi Ludar was a Sluissi male senator who represented Sluis Van and the Sluis sector in the Galactic Senate, succeeding Senator Bor Gracus.
The legendary Steng was warmaster of the strongest domain that fought in the Cremlevian War.

Tyl, called Tyl the Deplorable, was a legendary Trunsk warlord who united the Trunsks by conquering all of Trunska. He quickly converted his triumphant armies into a police force and diverted resources that formerly had gone toward war into technological development.
Emperor Belgoa was a Trunsk male who served as the emperor and nominal ruler of the planet Trunska during the Imperial era. In reality, he was little more than an Imperial puppet.

Marka was a Force-sensitive Human female who was enslaved to the Toydarian Lod. Prior to the end of the New Sith Wars in 1000 BBY, she encountered the Sith Master Finn and his apprentice. After Lod struck Marka for disobeying her, the apprentice killed the Toydarian, freeing her.

Jasper McKnives was a Kajain'sa'Nikto swordsman from Kintan. During the Clone Wars, he was a mentally unstable fanatic who served with devotion to the Cult of M'dweshuu, a deadly blood cult that had long terrorized the people of his homeworld.
Niuk Niuv was a Sullustan Senator of Brema sector.

However, Danni Quee and other scientists, escaped and found the base. As the Yuuzhan Vong prefect's forces moved to attack the scientist's shuttle, Quee attempted to escape, forcing the Yuuzhan Vong to shoot down her vessel, ultimately crashing on Helska.

The Yuuzhan Vong male Tu Shoolb served the Yuuzhan Vong empire as an intendant of the Domain Shoolb. He assisted Prefect Da'Gara aboard the latter's worldship during the Yuuzhan Vong invasion of the galaxy.

Bensin Tomri was a Human male member of ExGal-4 on Belkadan in 25 ABY. Shortly before the Yuuzhan Vong War, he, Danni Quee, and Cho Badeleg took the Spacecaster to investigate a presumed comet crashing on Helska IV.

Garth Breise was a Human male astronomer at the scientific organization known as the Extragalactic Society. He was stationed at ExGal-4 exploratory base on the Outer Rim world of Belkadan, where he worked the night shift at the facility's sensor station by 25 ABY.
Tee-ubo Doole was a female Twi'lek scientist at ExGal-4 on Belkadan in 25 ABY. She was jealous of the attention the men at the station gave to Danni Quee, and enjoyed ryll.

Bolpuhr was the Noghri bodyguard of Leia Organa Solo at the beginning the Yuuzhan Vong War as recompense for her and her brother Luke Skywalker helping rebuild the Noghri homeworld of Honoghr after its oppression under the Galactic Empire.
Kalen was the elder brother of Prince Isolder of the Hapes Cluster.
Reh'mwa was a Bothan radical and a leader of the True Victory Party, a group of Bothans who tried to continue the ar'krai against the Yuuzhan Vong.

Kell Tainer was a Human male pilot, commando and member of Wraith Squadron starting from its inception in 7 ABY. A naturalized citizen of Sluis Van, he was a skilled demolitions expert, hand-to-hand combatant, and starfighter mechanic.
Krdys Mordi was a Human male Dark Jedi who served the reborn Galactic Emperor Palpatine during the Galactic Civil War as part of his selected cadre of darksiders, the Dark Side Elite.
Tedryn-Sha was a Human Dark Side Adept loyal to Galactic Emperor Palpatine, who reigned over his Dark Empire after being reborn in a clone body.

Kal Skirata, born Falin Mattran—sometimes called Kal'buir (Mando'a for "Papa Kal") by the clone commandos that he trained—was a Human male Mandalorian instructor who trained clone commandos in the Grand Army of the Republic during the time of the Separatist Crisis.

Sentepeth Findos was a Neimoidian, who following the end of the Clone Wars, became the acting Viceroy of the Trade Federation and transferred control of the Federation to the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY.

Frona Zeffla was a female individual who served as an employee in the Imperial Palace on the planet Coruscant. Zeffla died at her desk in her office within the Palace sometime prior to 16 ABY. Following her death, Zeffla's body was not discovered for over a year.
Releqy A'Kla was a female Caamasi who served the New Republic and the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances during the Yuuzhan Vong War. She was the daughter of Elegos A'Kla.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Ardus Kaine was a Human Grand Moff who founded the Pentastar Alignment, and was the successor of Wilhuff Tarkin as Grand Moff of Oversector Outer following Tarkin's death at the Battle of Yavin. His flagship was the Reaper.
Luther De'Ono was a Human male scientist working at ExGal-4 on Belkadan in 25 ABY.

Jerem Cadmir, born on Corellia, was a Human male scientist of ExGal-4 on Belkadan in 25 ABY. When he, Tee-ubo Doole, Bendodi Ballow-Reese, and Luther De'Ono were sent out to investigate an incoming storm, all but Jerem succumbed to noxious fumes being emitted by dweebits plant…
Timi Rotramel was a male Mon Calamari Senator who represented the planet Dac and Calamari sector in the Imperial Senate during the Galactic Civil War.
The Old One was the name given to a Human male shaman who lived on the planet Aduba-3 during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Fyor Rodan was a Human male who served as a New Republic Senator, and a member of Chief of State Borsk Fey'lya's Advisory Council. Rodan was believed to have connections to smuggling interests on his homeworld Commenor when in reality it was his elder brother Tormak who did.

Tormak Rodan was the older brother of New Republic Senator Fyor Rodan. Rodan was a smuggler who worked for Jabba the Hutt until Jabba's death and later operated out of his native Commenor working for himself; many believed that his brother was also involved in the trade.

Cho Badeleg was a male Human scientist at ExGal-4 on Belkadan in 25 ABY. He, Danni Quee, and Bensin Tomri went to Helska IV to investigate what they believed was an extragalactic comet crashing on the barren planet's surface, and were kidnapped by the true occupants of the pla…
Gebnerret Vibrion was a Human male senator who represented the planet Ghorman and Sern sector in the Imperial Senate.
Mirkovig Hirken was a Human male who served as the warden and administrator of the highly secretive Corporate Sector prison known as Stars' End.
Rin Assid, also known as "Assid the Lucky", was a near-mythical merchant who lived during the fourth millennium of the Old Republic. He was a good-natured man with a love of good food and good drink.
Arlo Hirken was a native of Alsakan who lived in the Old Republic's fourth millennium. He was a partner of the legendary merchant Rin Assid, and was quite economically and politically ingenious.
Denn Wessex was a male Human and one of the first to be appointed to the rank of Moff, or regional governor.
Carmilla Vandangante was a Human female who was a Deputy Viceprex of the Rigahuerr Publishing Combine. She gave birth to her son and only child, Klaus Vandangante, on Coruscant.

Shardra was an outlaw tech working in the Corporate Sector. She was in grease up to her elbows tweaking a spice freighter's alluvial dampers when she met Klaus "Doc" Vandangante, and the two mechanics immediately fell in love.
Doman Beruss was a Human male Senator who represented the Illodia sector under the Galactic Empire and later the New Republic. His aunt was another Doman Beruss, the senator of Corellian sector.

Lysire Donabelle was a female Human scientist at ExGal-4 on Belkadan in 25 ABY. While repairing the ExGal-4 building in the midst of noxious dweebit fumes, she was killed dishonorably by the Yuuzhan Vong Yomin Carr.

Krystal was a Human male who served as a senator under the Galactic Empire of Palpatine. He represented the planet of Malastare in the Imperial Senate. The professional gambler and notorious womanizer Lando Calrissian once dated his daughter.

Massimo was a New Republic lieutenant under the command of Mirith Sinn and Sish Sadeet on Phaeda following the defeat of the cloned Emperor. He eventually betrayed Sinn to Grappa the Hutt, however, and as a "reward" was to be sacrificed to the Zanibar.
Marcellin Wessel was a Human male who was one of the first regional governors, or Moffs, of the Galactic Empire.
Redd Wessel was a Human male who served as an Imperial Army general under Carnor Jax of the Crimson Empire.
Jinart was a shapeshifting female Gurlanin native from the planet Qiilura who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. She was the mate of Valaqil.

Valaqil was a male Gurlanin from the planet Qiilura, and was an ally to the Galactic Republic, and Jinart's mate. Valaqil was present at the Omega Squad mission briefing on Ord Mantell before their departure to Qiilura.
Hoolidan Keggle was the Duros Chief Representative Officer of Jyvus Space City during the Clone Wars.

Lanius Qel-Bertuk was a renowned male Human Jedi Master who was Headmaster of the Jedi academy on Almas. Lanius Qel-Bertuk was considered by some to be one of the wisest Jedi in the Order and somewhat of a maverick by the Jedi High Council.
Reess Kairn was a male Twi'lek Jedi Knight of the Galactic Republic, who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

The Verpine priest known only as "Pera" was a clergyman of the Sacred Way religion who lived on Aduba-3. Working from the House of a Higher Power in Tun Aduban, Pera set about trying to convert the local spacers to the Sacred Way, to little avail.

Kina Ha was a female Kaminoan Jedi Master trained during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. A wizened and distant Jedi, she allied herself with the Jedi Code, more than the Jedi Order, remaining reclusive and rarely appearing at the Jedi Temple.
The Ugnaught Ugnor, being 1.5 meters tall, was considered by Ars Fivvle to be the tallest and most noble Ugnaught in the history of Bespin.
Locru was the original owner of Locru's Central Saloon in Tun Aduban on Aduba-3.

Vivant served as first officer and later commander of the Imperial Star Destroyer Steadfast. He was first officer under Grand Admiral Afsheen Makati and served during an investigation into a Rebel base on Thila.
Jodelle Foxtrain was the twin sister of Amaiza Foxtrain.
Quatrain Pudundruh was a Twi'lek entrepreneur on Ord Mantell. He managed the dancing duo of Amaiza and Jodelle Foxtrain for a year before selling them into slavery to recover lost assets.

Kayso was a pirate and leader of the Black Hole Gang. He was not a very capable leader, and kept much of the group's spoils to himself. When this was discovered, he was killed by Amaiza Foxtrain, who took his place as leader.
Drokko Kira was a Human male, the father of Beast-Lord Modon Kira, grandfather of Oron Kira, and a native of the capital city Iziz on Onderon.
Uul-Rha-Shan was a male Tiss'shar smuggler, mercenary and gunfighter who worked as the bodyguard for Corporate Sector Authority Viceprex of Corporate Security Mirkovig Hirken.
San-kur-lor was a successful Tiss'shar businessbeing who became a notable constituent of the Tiss'sharl League.
Si-Di-Ri was a male Tiss'shar and the President of the Tiss'sharl League on the planet Tiss'sharl during 0 ABY.

Tzizvvt was a male Brizzit who hailed from Jandoon. Claiming to be a professor of xenoarchaeology searching for a treasure known as "The Eye of the Beyonder," he was believed to be a fugitive from the Galactic Empire named Ilna.
Dunari was a Human male entrepreneur who was an old friend of Tomaas Azzameen and the founder and owner of Dunari's Rest Casino during the Galactic Civil War.

Marsune was a male Otolla Gungan who lived on the planet Naboo in the year 3000 BBY. During a period of war between the Gungan tribes at that time, Marsune formed a rogue gang and gained a reputation among the Gungans as a thief who would steal from the greedier Bosses and dis…
Iunist was a Force-sensitive individual who trained as a member of the Jedi Order many hundreds of years prior to the Galactic Empire.
Zona Luka was a female Vultan Jedi Knight who was active during the Great Sith War. She was trained in the Jedi ways by the respected Jedi Master Dominus, who considered Luka his dearest student.

Kadir was a male Human Imperial Moff who served as commander of the Coruscant Security Force. He became one of the conspirators in Grand Moff Trachta's plot to overthrow the Order of the Sith Lords and take control of the Galactic Empire.
Char Bibbeck was a senator from Colunda Prime, representing the Colunda sector in the Galactic Senate during the Separatist Crisis.

Jonas Wallen was the senator of Eucer sector during the Separatist Crisis. He was involved in a gambling scandal with fellow senator Char Bibbeck, in which the two senators were accused of betting on which planets would secede from the Galactic Republic.

Reidi Artom was a female Near-Human space explorer that discovered and named the Reidi Artom I, Reidi Artom II, Reidi Artom III, Reidi Artom IV, and Reidi Artom V systems. Additionally, she rediscovered the Cularin system (initially Reidi Artom VI) in 232 BBY.
Arnoth Draenell was a male scout for the Galactic Republic who discovered the Bissillirus system after his scout ship's hyperdrive cut out.

Tohno was a Human female who served as a Jedi Padawan in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Before the Clone Wars erupted, Tohno trained under a Jedi who taught her in architecture and engineering.

Conn Doruggan was a Human male Imperial officer from Alderaan during the Rebellion era. He was assigned to the Imperial garrison on the Wild Space world of Bakura during the first Ssi-ruuvi invasion in 4 ABY.
Lujayne Forge was a Human female from Kessel who served as a pilot for Rogue Squadron for the New Republic Defense Force.

Green, designated CT-53/21-8778, was a clone of the Human male bounty hunter Jango Fett, one of the many such clones created on the planet Kamino to fight in the Grand Army of the Republic. Like Fett, Green was 1.83 meters tall and had tan skin.

Barr, designated as CT-41/14-0301, was a clone trooper lieutenant in the Grand Army of the Republic who fought in the Clone Wars. Barr was the leader of the 2nd Platoon of the 327th Star Corps's Bacta Company.

Tyto, designated CT-52/89-9204, was one of the many clones of Jango Fett—a 1.83 meter–tall Human male bounty hunter with tan skin—created on the planet of Kamino for service in the Grand Army of the Republic.

Dif Scaur was a member of the New Republic Defense Force. Originally an admiral in the Fourth Battle Group, Scaur was appointed Director of New Republic Intelligence Service when General Airen Cracken retired. While frail looking, he had a very commanding voice.

Fordo, also known by the designation ARC-77, was an Advanced Recon Commando captain in the Grand Army of the Republic born on Kamino. In 22 BBY, he was assigned to a task force led by the Jedi Knight General Obi-Wan Kenobi, to take the Confederate-held world of Muunilinst.
Stauz Czycz was a soldier from a world that was razed by the Empire. Holding Darth Vader responsible, he devoted himself and his life utterly to revenge, styling himself as the mercenary Awarru Tark.
Hanna Doshun was a Human female and the daughter of Jimm and Merri Doshun. She lived in the town of Onacra on Aduba-3.
Abin-Ral-Xufush was a ruthless and cunning Tiss'shar trader who turned to piracy.
Fa-Loh-Sui was a Tiss'shar assassin. Beautiful and deadly, she caught the eye of Abin-Ral-Xufush, who courted her for a time. He would later name his flagship after her.
Silais was a male Twi'lek who served as a Representative for the Galactic Republic. In 33 BBY, he led the negotations for Cerea to join the Republic.
Daggibus Scoritoles was a male Givin senator who represented the planet Yag'Dhul in the Galactic Senate.
Havriso Looruya was a senator who represented the planet Yir Tangee in the Galactic Senate. During the Separatist Crisis, he was a member of the Loyalist Committee.
Ronet Coorr was a male of a humanoid species who represented the planet of Iseno in the Galactic Senate during the Separatist Crisis.

CT-43/002 was a clone trooper and member of The Muunilinst 10, a mixed group of elite Advanced Recon Commandos and regular clone troopers that participated in a battle on the planet Muunilinst in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars.
Beryl Chiffonage was a commander of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Xaart was one of the ground troops under the command of Meetra Surik during the Battle of Dagary Minor, one of the early losses for the Galactic Republic during the opening of the Mandalorian Wars.
Anwis Eddicus was a Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic around 700 BBY. At this time, the Death Seed plague struck the galaxy, killing millions of beings.
Vaila Pecivas was a female Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic who was in office until 60 BBY. Her tenure was noted for a particular lack of style.
Eixes Valorum was a member of the Valorum family of Coruscant. He eventually became a senator and later served as Supreme Chancellor, some time prior to 62 BBY.

S'diawae was a famous Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic sometime between the Ruusan Reformation and the Separatist Crisis, a period known as the Golden Age of the Old Republic.

Roridan Temquill was the CEO of Biscuit Baron during the Separatist Crisis. During the Clone Wars, he devised the restaurant chain's month-long "Heroes of the Republic" promotion in the interests of educating young customers about the history of the Galactic Republic using an …

Dex was a Corellian member of the Peace Brigade who tried, with Roxi Barl and Gad Sluggins, to kill Jedi Master Eelysa on Corellia, where he ran into Leia Organa Solo in 26 ABY. He was killed by Han Solo in the firefight.
Grelb was the errand boy who served Jemba the Hutt.

Twelve, designated CT-12/12-0068, was one of the numerous clones created from bounty hunter Jango Fett's DNA on the planet Kamino to serve in the Grand Army of the Republic. Like Fett, Twelve was a Human male who stood 1.83 meters tall and had tan skin.
A'den (pronounced AH-den), designated CT-80/88-3009, was a senior clone commander in command of the 7th Legion, a division of the 327th Star Corps.

Narees was a male Iktotchi member of the criminal syndicate Black Sun. Having attained the rank of Vigo, Narees and the rest of the Black Sun leadership were brutally slaughtered during an attack by the Sith Darth Maul in 33 BBY.
Seviss Vaa was a male Sith Lord and a powerful member of Lord Skere Kaan's Brotherhood of Darkness during the late movements of the New Sith Wars.
Bingo Mehndra was a Balti smuggler and rival of Jabba Desilijic Tiure. He operated out of a base on the planet Hoth.

Ezam Nhor was a young male Ithorian who served his people as their liaison to the New Jedi Order. In 35 ABY he joined Han and Leia Organa Solo in their scouting mission to the planet Borao, which later became the new Ithorian homeworld.
Sarcev Quest was a Human male who served as one of the Emperor's Hands, secretive operatives active in the Galactic Empire, answerable only to Emperor Palpatine.
H'kig was a male Galandan who served as a religious leader and the founder of a religion named for him. Born on Galand, he preached morals and goodness, and that people should live simpler lives.
Meelto was a famous Rodian gunfighter. He was outfought and killed by the Tiss'shar assassin Uul-Rha-Shan.
Iri Camas was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Nek Bwua'tu was a male Bothan who served in the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet as a naval officer, rising to the rank of admiral and later serving as Chief of Naval Operations.

Romeo Treblanc was a Human male holodrama actor and later businessman who owned the Galaxies Opera House of Coruscant during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Always in the limelight, Treblanc used his fame to mask the fact that he had a severe gambling problem.
Pax Bonkik was a male Rodian mechanic, and along with his brother, Trax Bonkik, served as a slave to the Podracer Mars Guo. Guo worked the siblings to near-exhaustion.
Yavid was a Sanyassan male and a soldier in the Sanyassan Marauders. Born into Sanyassan aristocracy, Yavid was constantly looked down upon due to his short stature.

Kur was a male Twi'lek who served as head of Ryloth's government in the New Republic Senate. He had formerly been a clan leader until his clan was defeated by Nolaa Tarkona, founder of the anti-Human Diversity Alliance.
Shawnkyr Nuruodo was a female Chiss officer in Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx and a Clawcraft pilot.
Trax Bonkik was a Rodian male mechanic who, with his older brother, Pax, was a slave to the Podracer Mars Guo.

After Yoda saved her life, Rell negotiated with him over the remains of the Chu'unthor. Yoda had left the records with Rell, and had told her that one day in the far-off future, a Jedi Knight and his apprentice would come looking for the records located within the ship.

Barukka was a female Dathomiri, a former Nightsister, and the sister of the Nightsister leader Gethzerion. The daughter of the Singing Mountain Clan's leader, Augwynne Djo, she turned to the dark side of the Force but was able to break away from its influence and exiled herself.
Myri Antilles, a Human female, was the second daughter of Wedge Antilles and Iella Wessiri Antilles.

Chak Fel was an elder son of Baron Soontir Fel and Syal Antilles Fel. Raised first on Corellia and then on Nirauan in the Unknown Regions, Fel followed his father into the Empire of the Hand's military, becoming a commander of a fleet-arm of Nssis-class clawcraft and gaining c…

Den Dhur was a Sullustan journalist and war correspondent for the Galactic Wave who gained brief acclaim for his reporting during the battles on Drongar, including a report on the exploits of the cold-blooded mercenary Phow Ji who was spun by the media despite Dhur's efforts o…

Koffi Arana was a Human male Jedi Master who hailed from the planet Turkana. During the Clone Wars, he served as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic. In the final year of the crisis, Arana fought against Separatist forces in the Battle of Boz Pity.
Jorga was a Duros gunnery officer serving aboard the Admiral Ackbar, under the command of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu during the Dark Nest Crisis.

Aramb was a male Gotal Lieutenant in the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances. In 36 ABY, he was stationed on the Victory I-class Star Destroyer Admiral Ackbar as part of its engineering staff, and had been there for several years.

Firith Olan was a male Twi'lek who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. It was rumored that he possessed knowledge of the location of Jabba the Hutt's secret weapons cache, located somewhere in the Tatooine desert.
Yuul was a Sullustan ensign assigned to the engineering staff onboard the Admiral Ackbar during the blockade of the Murgo Choke.

Urbok was a Captain serving as part of the engineering staff aboard the Victory I-class Star Destroyer Admiral Ackbar during the blockade of the Utegetu Nebula by the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances in 36 ABY.

Reo was a Lieutenant Commander in the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances. In 36 ABY, he was serving as part of the engineering staff aboard the Victory I-class Star Destroyer Admiral Ackbar during the blockade of the Utegetu Nebula.
Zan Yant was a male Zabrak surgeon who worked for the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Terena Adare was a Human female who had been the Agricultural Administrator of Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War up until that world was sacked by forces of the Sith Empire under the command of Darth Malak.
Moog Ulur was the male Rodian senator of Rodia in the Galactic Alliance Senate following the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Gara Petothel, also known as Lara Notsil and Kirney Slane, was an Imperial Intelligence spy who defected to the New Republic during a covert mission as a pilot with Wraith Squadron.

A'den Skirata (pronounced AH-den), originally known as Null-12, also known as N-12, was one of the six surviving Null-class Advanced Recon Commandos. Like the other Null ARCs, he was named and trained by the Mandalorian Kal Skirata.
B'shith Vorrik was the Yuuzhan Vong commander assigned to undertake the Yuuzhan Vong invasion of the Imperial Remnant. His face and scalp were almost completely devoid of skin.

Phow Ji was a male Human mercenary from the planet Bunduki. He was hired as a hand-to-hand combat instructor for the Galactic Republic forces during the Battle of Drongar and made a lieutenant. He was later killed while single-handedly taking on a group of Salissian mercenaries.

affiliation: Jasod Revoc and his Galactic Revue
x: Eyar Marath was a female Sullustan singer and dancer who, at the height of her popularity during the Clone Wars, traveled the galaxy with a troupe of entertainers led by Epoh Trebor, providing entertainment for Republic troops and personnel stationed on various battlefields.
Astarta was a female Hapan privateer and personal guard of Prince Isolder.
Taug Molou was a Master Shaper of the Yuuzhan Vong during their massive conquest campaign directed against all worlds of the Galactic community.

Sinsor Khal was a male Hapan scientist who was once a Jedi trainee during the time of the Galactic Republic. For reasons unknown, he was considered a failure as a Jedi, and as such was overlooked during the Great Jedi Purge.
CRC-09/571, or simply Seven-One, was a clone battalion commander and later clone regimental commander during the Clone Wars.
Ian Lago was a Human male from Naboo who was the son of King Veruna's Prime Councilor, Kun Lago.
Volpau was a Human male about whom little is known other than that he apparently was Emperor Palpatine's third cousin.
Tolk le Trene was a female Lorrdian nurse who was stationed at RMSU-7 on Drongar during the Clone Wars.
Jos Vondar was a Human male Corellian surgeon who served the Galactic Republic as chief medical officer of Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7 during the Clone Wars.
Erel Kersos was a Human male Corellian surgeon, holding the rank of Admiral during the Clone Wars, and Commanding Officer in charge of a MedStar-class frigate during the Battle of Drongar.
Tarnese Bleyd was a male Sakiyan who served as an admiral of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.

Kaird was a male Nediji Black Sun assassin who served as a member of the Black Sun. In 20 BBY, he was sent to Drongar during the Clone Wars to investigate the disappearance of fellow operative Mathal, who had been overseeing the smuggling of bota off Drongar.
Vrad Dodonna was a Human male Rebel pilot and the son of General Jan Dodonna, the Alliance's top military strategist during the Galactic Civil War.
Belindi Kalenda was a female member of the New Republic Intelligence who first joined the intelligence service in 13 ABY.
Myn Donos, a Human male from Corellia, was an X-wing pilot who served with Talon, Wraith and Rogue Squadrons, primarily noted for his efforts during the hunt for Warlord Zsinj.
Malvander Bren was a male, and the Imperial Governor of the planet Solem during the Galactic Civil War.

Mynar Devis was a male Human who served as an officer in the Imperial Navy during the last years of the Galactic Civil War and afterward. He was the illegitimate son of Gilad Pellaeon and Hallena Devis.

Aald was a Rodian arms dealer operating during the early years of the New Order. He worked with fellow Rodians Gredori, Keesi, and Vosso. Aald was known to travel on the space barge Lost Lady, which often made illicit smuggling trips between Nal Hutta and Nar Shaddaa.

Keesi was a Rodian arms dealer operating during the early years of the New Order. He worked with fellow Rodians Gredori, Aald and Vosso. Keesi was known to travel on the space barge Lost Lady, which often made illicit smuggling trips between Nal Hutta and Nar Shaddaa.

Gredori was a Rodian arms dealer operating during the early years of the New Order. He worked with fellow Rodians Keesi, Aald and Vosso. Gredori was known to travel on the space barge Lost Lady, which often made illicit smuggling trips between Nal Hutta and Nar Shaddaa.

Vosso was a Rodian arms dealer operating during the early years of the New Order. He worked with fellow Rodians Gredori, Aald and Keesi. Vosso was known to travel on the space barge Lost Lady, which often made illicit smuggling trips between Nal Hutta and Nar Shaddaa.

Hako Armado, an elderly male Rodian, was known as a skilled dramatist operating during the early years of the New Republic. Few realized that this was but a pretense, and that Hako was in fact a deadly assassin.

Emala was a Squib who, along with Grees and Sligh, formed the dubious group the Directors. For a while they made their profits by selling information they had collected to the New Republic Intelligence Service, but later they found a new break on the planet Tatooine.

Sligh was a Squib who, along with Grees and Emala, formed the dubious group the Directors. For a while they made their profits by selling information they had collected to the New Republic Intelligence Service, but later they found a new break on Tatooine.

Grees was a Squib who, along with Sligh and Emala, formed the dubious group the Directors. For a while they made their profits by selling information they had collected to the New Republic Intelligence, but later they found a new break on Tatooine.
Riwwel was an Imperial Admiral during the first years of the Galactic Empire. He led the forces that were tasked with quelling the resistance movement on the Outer Rim world of Acherin.
Sancor was a humanoid male Inquisitor who served the Galactic Empire.
Aris-Del Wari, born Ludi Billane, was a Jedi youngling who lived in the era known as the Great Peace of the Republic.
Kom'rk Skirata (pronounced KOM-or-rohk), originally known as Null-6 or N-6, was a Null-class Advanced Recon Commando in the Grand Army of the Republic.

Jaing Skirata, originally known as Null-10 or simply N-10, was a Null-class Advanced Recon Commando in the Grand Army of the Republic. After the Clone Wars, he became a Mandalorian member of Clan Skirata.
Liat Tsayv was a Sullustan smuggler who worked for the organizations of Booster and Mirax Terrik. As of 7 ABY, he was the copilot of their ship, Pulsar Skate.
Toma was a Human male who was the leader of the resistance movement on the planet Acherin. He was a tall man with a shaven head.

Hynla was an elderly male Chadra-Fan and head of the CarsinShare corporation. He had taken interest in gladiatorial death matches as a sporting way for his company to demonstrate its superiority on Nonsu. Hylna had also developed an appreciation for the scent of blood.

Matta Tremayne was a Human female from the planet Corroth who served as a Master within the Jedi Order. Tremayne's delicate physical appearance belied her true nature as a consummate lightsaber duelist, one highly acclaimed for her expertise with the weapon.

Shylar was a Human female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, she tried to infiltrate the headquarters of Confederacy of Independent Systems leader and Sith Lord Count Dooku.
Obo Rin was a controversial Human sentientologist and xenobiologist who worked for the Galactic Empire.
Bolabo Hujaan was a Sullustan starship technician.
Brant Rumble was a Sullustan podracer on the Tatooine circuit. Rumble's small stature and cybernetic enhancements made him a formidable racer during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.
Bungo Bung was a male Sullustan from the planet Sullust. Despite growing up working on his father's boaboo fungus farm, Bung harbored a desire to pilot starships.
Geric was an SAGroup member who was stationed on Coruscant in 19 BBY. He and two other SAGroup members brought Drake Lo'gaan to the Jrade District to join SAGroup.
Jenssar SoBilles was a male Duros resistance fighter and later Councilor on the New Republic Provisional Council.

Burbakker Teep was a Gran male with orange skin and black eyes from the planet Kinyen. By 32 BBY, they had become a part-time demolitions expert affiliated with arms dealers and smugglers and destroyed several important Republic Security Force facilities.

Brakko Gaz was a male Rodian from the planet Rodia. By 32 BBY, Gaz had become affiliated with the death stick dealer Groff Haugg and had murdered several prominent business owners on the planet Coruscant.

Sobel Zeelesi was a Rodian male with green skin, red head spines, and black eyes from the planet Rodia. By 32 BBY, Zeelesi had become affiliated with arms dealers and smugglers and was wanted for the destruction of several important Republic Security Force facilities.

Moranda Savich, a Human woman, was a professional thief, con artist, and master of disguise who worked independently and in association with Talon Karrde's smuggling organization. In 0 BBY, she helped the Rebel Alliance get information on the construction of the Death Star I.
Ninopas Orocc was a Gran gambling addict. In 32 BBY, Orocc attended the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on Tatooine to place various wagers.

Drend Navett was a Human male who was a specialized covert operative working with the "Vengeance" unit of the Imperial Remnant. In 9 ABY, he was stationed on the homeworld of the Myomarans, during Grand Admiral Thrawn's return.

Pixolga was a male Dug who served the Anti-Artist Federation during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by the Pixelito Art Guild for claiming that painted paw prints by a tamed nexu did not constitute true art.
Zadalgo was a male Dug who worked as a death stick dealer for Sebolto's gang during the years following the Battle of Naboo.

Dewanga was a male Dug slaver who worked for Sebolto during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Gorga the Hutt for stealing several of Gorga's personal Twi'lek dancers. He was captured by Jango Fett who claimed the bounty.

U'Han Swinol was an out-of-work male Bith musician who lived the during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Haugg Nerf Industries for defaulting on a loan and had a bounty of 2,000 credits alive and 1,000 credits dead.
Guanolta was a male Dug who worked for the crime lord Sebolto during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Niktha was a Jawa beggar who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted dead for 200 credits by the owner of the Dust Bowl saloon in Mos Gamos for turning away potential patrons with his aggressive begging.
Biktha was a Jawa wanted by Watto for stealing one of his pit droids. In 32 BBY, this bounty was claimed by Jango Fett.
Senator Ravein was a Human male who represented Alderaan and the Alderaan sector in the Galactic Senate during the early years of the Galactic Republic. He was the father of Kayala Ravein.
E'thinaa was a male Yuuzhan Vong agent during the years of the Yuuzhan Vong War. He was active in the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium, the government of the Ssi-ruu species, disguised as a Ssi-ruu.
Harribore Onuta was the Medxec of the Coruscant Health Administration during the Separatist Crisis which plagued the Galactic Republic.
Alix Balan was a general serving the Imperial Coalition in 10 ABY.
Loowil Galt was a Human male, originally from the planet Naboo, who served as a police officer of the Coruscant Police Force in the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Jord Stokk was a male Human prison guard in Desolation Alley from Corellia who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted dead by the Galactic Podracing Circuit Underwriters' Union for the pre-race crippling of a visiting podracer.
Lan Starburn was a Human male prison guard from Alderaan who guarded in the Desolation Alley and was also a correctional officer during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Riknak was a Weequay male saboteur affiliated with the crime boss Gardulla the Hutt. He was a native of the planet Sriluur, but had been off-world by 32 BBY.
Reez Andor was a male Human criminal. By 32 BBY, Andor was wanted dead or alive by Coruscant Police for being a known death stick dealer.
Jervis Gloom was a Human male death stick dealer who lived on Coruscant and had long posed problems for the Coruscant Security Force during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Klif was an Imperial Intelligence agent who was part of the "Vengeance" cell during the Caamas Document crisis of 19 ABY.
Horvic was an Imperial Intelligence agent who was part of the "Vengeance" cell during the Caamas Document crisis of 19 ABY.
Pensin was an Imperial Intelligence agent who was part of the "Vengeance" cell during the Caamas Document crisis of 19 ABY.
Dhagon Ghent was a male Human who served with the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders during the Mandalorian Wars alongside future Mandalore Canderous Ordo.
Raina Quill was a Humanoid woman from the planet Acherin who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Ukon Eyste was a male Gran hitman and convicted killer who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Having a death sentence on six star systems, the Republic Security Force placed a bounty worth 3,000 credits alive and 1,500 dead.
Raabakyysh, or Raaba for short, was a Wookiee, and a friend of Lowbacca and his sister Sirrakuk, and it is thought that Lowbacca had thoughts of choosing her for a mate.
Trever Flume was a Human male from the world of Bellassa, who helped Obi-Wan Kenobi and Ferus Olin in their quest to find survivors of Order 66 in the aftermath of the Clone Wars.
Sinya was Twi'lek bodyguard employed by the Black Sun crime syndicate. Although she was not a Force user, she did wield a pair of perpendicular-gripped, guard shotos with deep purple blades.

Dodra F'ass was a male Bith who represented Clak'dor VII and the Mayagil sector in the Galactic Senate of the Republic until that planet seceded to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems just before the start of the Clone Wars.
Ssorku was a Trandoshan mercenary that operated during the Galactic Civil War.
Taieb was a Human male artisan who lived in Mos Espa, Tatooine during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. As a gift, he crafted a small podracing helmet for Anakin Skywalker in 32 BBY.
Chokk was a Klatooinian bodyguard employed by Jabba Desilijic Tiure in 32 BBY.
Ghez Hokan was a Human male Mandalorian mercenary who rented his services to the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Prouk was a Korun male Akk Guard from Haruun Kal who liked to gamble and recently lost 60 credits to Nick Rostu during the start of the Summertime War.
Iolu was a Korun male Akk Guard from Haruun Kal during the Summertime War.

Four-Nine, designated CC-8/349, was a clone trooper captain during the Clone Wars. He commanded a platoon of heavy assault troopers. After landing on the planet, he and his troops were instructed by Jedi General Mace Windu to counter any militia attacks on Haruun Kal.

Liane Trevval, referred to as Chalk, was a young female Korun rebel from Haruun Kal who joined the Upland Liberation Front so that no other Korunnai women would have to endure what she had. She was large with red hair, and had extreme difficulty with speaking Basic.
Boganni Hrul was a female Human Senator who represented Ord Thoden and Dynali sector in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Separatist Crisis.

Mort was a Human male, a clone of Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. During the Clone Wars, Mort served as a clone commando in the Republic's Grand Army, but following a betrayal by his commanding officer Morkov and a period of brutal experimentation, ended up a drunkard on…

Longo Two-Guns, known as the "fastest blaster on Tatooine" in the waning years of the Galactic Republic, was a male Clantaani who was the leader of a criminal gang on Tatooine and worked for Gardulla the Hutt.
T'laalak-s'lalak-t'th'ak was the Xi Charrian who designed the holographic-projector chair that Trade Federation of Planets Viceroy Nute Gunray used to communicate with Darth Sidious.
Narro Sienar was CEO of Santhe/Sienar Technologies during the last years of the Galactic Republic, and the father of Raith Sienar and a daughter.
Dyne was a Human male officer who served as a captain in the Judicial Forces. He was transferred to Republic Intelligence about the time that the Clone Wars began.
Garen Muln was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Egome Fass was a male Houk who worked as an enforcer for a criminal mining outfit on the planet Dellalt during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Kybacca was a Wookiee who served as a senior senator in the New Republic. She opposed allowing former Imperials to serve in the Senate. When translated into Galactic Basic Standard, the suffix in Kybacca's name, "Bacca," meant "Ally/Friend/Sister."
Thal K'sar was a Bith who worked for the Commerce Guild.

Travale was a male Human Senate Bureau of Intelligence agent during the last years of the Galactic Republic. Travale was not his true name, but rather a code name, as he had been inserted into the Confederate facility on the asteroid of Escarte near the end of the Clone Wars.
Bronnel was a Mon Calamari bounty hunter.
Fa'ale Leh was a female Lethan Twi'lek. She was a pilot for Sienar Advanced Projects Labratory. She was the one who flew the Scimitar to Darth Maul.
Viento was a Human male senator who served in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Valiant was an Advanced Recon Commando who held the rank of commander within the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Roan Shryne was a Human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars and briefly avoided Order 66. He wielded a blue lightsaber.

Nat-Sem was a male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic prior to the rise of the Galactic Empire. Taking Padawan Roan Shryne as his apprentice, he trained the boy to Knighthood before being killed in the Battle of Geonosis at the start of the Clone Wars.

Saras Loorne was a male Jedi Master and a Jedi General during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, Loorne, along with five other Jedi and a clone trooper task force, was dispatched to occupy the Outer Rim planet Murkhana, a Corporate Alliance stronghold.
Garret Callron was the Moff of the Clacis sector during the Galactic Civil War. Callron employed the services of the bounty hunter Rodick Tag during the early days of Tag's career.

Toka was a male Mon Calamari member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who held the rank of admiral. In the year 0 ABY, Admiral Toka was in Tak Base when it was attacked by dark troopers and was subsequently killed in the assault.
Ackdool was the Mon Calamari Commander of the New Republic Star Cruiser Mediator in 25 ABY.
Turk Brand was a Human male Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic officer.

Xecr Nist was a Human male who served as chief advisor to the reborn Galactic Emperor Palpatine, who had been in clone bodies after his death at the hands of Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker and his sister Leia Organa Solo.

Aga Culpa was a male humanoid who ruled the moon of Nar Shaddaa during the years leading up to the Clone Wars. He was a puppet-ruler for the Hutts, crime-lords who owned the factories; his job was to keep the Hutts rich.
P'Lor was a Human male cyborg who served as an aide to Orion Ferret, the owner and operator of the black market space station Bazarre during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Jakan was the High Priest of the Priest caste and one of the highest members of the Yuuzhan Vong Elite.
Hali Ke was a Kaminoan and the senior research geneticist of the cloning facilities on the planet Kamino in Wild Space.
Voli Quana was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order.
Kossex was a female Weequay Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Rhad Tarn was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
E'koth Tassjun was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic and he trained Ephaan Kenzon as a Padawan.
Dree Vandap was a young female Rodian Jedi during the New Sith Wars, in particular, the period when the Army of Light was battling the Sith Brotherhood of Darkness.

Shang-Troy Thanabo was a Jedi Master whose history was long lost to the tides of time. However, Shang-Troy's story did survive as a myth and a fable, passed down for generations among the Jedi Knights.
Hoche Trit was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic following the defeat of the Brotherhood of Darkness and the passage of the Ruusan Reformations in the Galactic Senate.

Salen Toth was a Jedi around the time of the New Sith Wars. Salen was sent to the planet Harpori in the Balowa system to investigate the mysterious disappearance of Jedi Knight Crian Maru and her apprentice, Dree Vandap.

The Bothan Golm Fervse'dra was considered the first leader of the Stone Clan. In his time, Bothawui was divided among the clans, and conflict was common. However, there were no domesticated animals that could carry the weapons of the Bothans, leading to ineffective warfare.

Saun Dann, also known as Sohn Dann, was a jovial Human male who worked as a trader on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk. He is also reffered to as Trader Dann for some people. He was also secretly a member of the Rebel Alliance who maintained his own network of connections.
Marus Timpel was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order approximately six centuries prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

Alam Syk was a Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. In 25 BBY, Syk had come to be known as one of the foremost security experts at the Jedi Temple on the Republic's capital planet Coruscant.

Inyri Forge was a human female Kesselian from Kessel. In 7 ABY, when the New Republic sent Rogue Squadron to Kessel to release criminal members of Black Sun from prison, Forge tagged along with her sweetheart, Zekka Thyne, as he and his fellow rascals were sent to the Coruscan…

Griff Vao was a male Rutian Twi'lek, the elder brother of Mission Vao. Griff was always getting loans for his schemes of easy enrichment. They failed, of course, and he was never able to repay his debts.

Sirrus was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He was also the master of Padawan Aubrie Wyn.

A Force-sensitive Ewok, Grael was a warrior, a master hunter, an exceptional musician, and an agent of the New Republic. A native of Tribe Panshee village on the Forest Moon of Endor, he was named after an Ewok deity, and was a devout follower of the way of the Tree Spirits.
Erpham Warrick was an Ewok male who created the battle wagon, a machine the Ewoks used to defend themselves from the threat of Duloks.
Winda Warrick was the youngest member of the Warrick family.
Malani was a female Ewok from the forest moon of Endor. She was the daughter of Warok and Batcheela and the younger sister of Teebo.
Maal Lah was a male Yuuzhan Vong Warrior and crèche-brother to Warmaster Tsavong Lah. He served as Commander during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Chaf'orm'bintrano, also known by the core name Formbi, was a Chiss male who served as an Aristocra of the Ruling Chaf family of the Chiss Ascendancy. He held the rank of ranking distant within the family. At some point he served as an officer of the Empire of the Hand.
Dennix Graeber was the Governor of Ralltiir during the Galactic Civil War.

Spike was a male New Republic strike team leader who participated in the liberation of Ralltiir. His team was responsible for disabling the planet's ion cannon and its power generators, paving the way for a task force of Mon Calamari Star Cruisers to secure the system.
Bettle was a Human female smuggler and teammate of Jaxa. The two became notable in smuggling circles, and their exploits were regularly featured in Cynabar's InfoNet.
Dreddon was a Hutt crime lord and arms dealer based on Tatooine.

Zho Krazhmir was Supreme Commander of the Yuuzhan Vong forces in the First Battle of Zonama Sekot, and the one who agreed to take Vergere back to the rest of the fleet in return for calling off the attack.
Leor Hal was a male Human Jedi Padawan who served the Jedi Order during the Galactic Republic's Golden Age.
Jabitha Hal, nicknamed Wind by her father, was a Human-Ferroan hybrid born on Zonama Sekot.

Rana Mas Trehalt was a female Duros, and a legendary Queen of Duro who was considered a benevolent ruler and a wise lawgiver. She ushered her people into a cultural golden age by encouraging the exploration of various arts and sciences, particularly interstellar flight.
Feynir was a male Draedan dictator who ruled one of the planet Sesid's major nations.
Arvel Trace was the Imperial Governor of Sesid, the Draedan homeworld.

Rayno Vaca was a Tarnab and a member of the Judicial Department. He piloted an air taxi on Coruscant in 32 BBY, and took Anakin Skywalker, Jar Jar Binks, Senator Palpatine, and Queen Padmé Amidala to 500 Republica.
Shawn Valdez was a Human captain of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and an evacuation officer of the Alliance Special Forces during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Hestiv was a High General of the Imperial Remnant, in command of the Imperial forces of Yaga Minor at the time of the Caamas Document Crisis and the attempted coup of the Imperial Remnant by Moff Disra, Royal Guardsman Grodin Tierce, and the con-artist Flim in 19 ABY.
Sutt Ramic was a competent and respected officer of the Imperial Remnant.
Halley Kadorto was a veteran of the Clone Wars who became a famed pilot of the Alliance to Restore the Republic prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Lord Graemon was a civilian financial expert of some standing on the planet of Muunilinst by 19 ABY and carried some heavy influence within the Imperial Remnant
Jessa Vandangante was a female Human who was the daughter of Klaus "Doc" Vandangante and Shardra, leaders of a group of outlaw techs operating in and around the Corporate Sector.
Adalric Cessius Brandl was a Force-sensitive Human male from Trulalis who was the father of Jaalib Brandl and became one of the most notorious Imperial Inquisitors during the rise of the Empire.
Jaxa was a smuggler who, along with teammate Bettle and their ship, the Mallixer, became notable in smuggling circles.

Meck Odom was a Human male Imperial officer who served the Galactic Empire and later joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was assigned to the research facility on Danuta.
Voort saBinring, or "Piggy", was a Gamorrean male and member of Wraith Squadron from its inception in 7 ABY through most of the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Eurrsk Thri'ag, nicknamed Grinder, was a male Bothan slicer and pilot on the verge of washing out from the New Republic armed forces during the Galactic Civil War. In 7 ABY, Thri'ag agreed to transfer to a new squadron that Commander Wedge Antilles was forming.
Severian was a Shistavanen bounty hunter.

Tartuta was a male Dug bounty hunter who was hired by the newly-formed Galactic Empire two weeks after the end of the Clone Wars to find Sagoro Autem, an Imperial naval captain that was slated for purging from the military.
The World Brain, known as pazhkic Yuuzhan'tar al'tirrna in Yuuzhan Vong, was a dhuryam tasked with overseeing the Vongforming of Coruscant during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Traavis was a Human male Jedi Knight who served as a general during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, during the Galactic Republic's sieges in the Outer Rim, Traavis led a campaign for five months against the Cassandran Worlds of Monhudle, New Bakstre, and Biitu.

Falynn Sandskimmer was a Human female from Tatooine who served as a starfighter pilot in New Republic Starfighter Command. Already a Y-wing starfighter ace but with a record marked by insubordination, she was among the first to join Wraith Squadron in 7 ABY.
Bartam was a Human Grand Moff of the Galactic Empire.
Yag Shushin was a Givin male from the planet Yag'Dhul.

Mon Halan was a high-ranking officer in the Galactic Republic who fought in the Mandalorian Wars. Halan defected to the Sith at the start of the Jedi Civil War, along with other famed officers such as Admiral Karath and General Derred.

Durundo was an up-and-coming Pacithhip Podracer who joined the professional circuit shortly after the Battle of Naboo. He competed in the final race of the Vinta Harvest Classic on Malastare in 32 BBY. Durundo lost the race to the Dug pilot Sebulba.
Dankko Verrimuch was an Anx Podracer pilot who competed in the final race of the Vinta Harvest Classic on the planet Malastare around 32 BBY.
Marath Vooro of Enarc was Customs Vizier of the Trade Federation at the time of the formation of the Galactic Empire.
Coy was a Grand Moff and later an admiral in the Imperial Navy, commanding officer of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Mathayus.
Olee Starstone was a female Human Padawan who was trained first by the Jedi librarian Jocasta Nu and later by Jedi Master Bol Chatak during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Kiro was a Chuhkyvi from Iskalon. He was one of the few Iskalonians to leave his planet, accompanying Luke Skywalker on several adventures.
KkH'Oar'Rrhr, also known as Hoar, was a Force-sensitive male Tusken Raider from Tatooine, and a Teräs Käsi artist practicing during the Galactic Civil War.
Jigger Wraith was a particularly notorious bounty hunter who plagued the Old Republic in the era of the Great Sith War.
Gargonn the Hutt was a very powerful crime lord and sponsor of the Circus Horrificus on Nar Shaddaa.

Jak Bremen was a Human male colonel of the New Republic serving as Director of Security for the New Republic Inner Council during the campaigns of Grand Admiral Thrawn against the New Republic around 9 ABY.
Gaen Drommel was a Human male officer of the Imperial Navy.
Sair Yonka was a Human male from Commenor who served with both the Galactic Empire and the New Republic as the captain of the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Avarice—later renamed the Freedom.
Kallin Bremen was a Human male who was the father of Colonel Jak Bremen, New Republic Director of Security for the New Republic Council.

Lupo Shar was an unscrupulous Twi'lek denizen of Nar Shaddaa who, circa 3951 BBY, began taking advantage of all the rich-merchant and naïve-foreigner traffic there by fixing the planetary swoop races.
Cariaga Sin was a female Human Jedi who lived in the time of the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War.
Talvon Esan was a male Human Jedi who lived in the time of the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War.
Nisotsa was a female Human Jedi who lived in the time of the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War.
Xaset Terep was a male Human Jedi who lived in the time of the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War.

Nanda-Ree Janoo was a Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Janoo was made a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, serving alongside such esteemed Jedi as Master Obi-Wan Kenobi.

Jimke Weet was a male renowned kloo horn soloist and the father of Salak Weet. When Salak went missing in 26 BBY during the first voyage of him and his friend, Noa Briqualon, Jimke funded a massive four-year-long rescue search for the pair, in which they spent nearly every cre…

Dezsetes was an Admiral in the Imperial Navy, who was serving aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Mathayus in 1 BBY, initially as Second Officer with the rank of Captain under Admiral Coy and First Officer Atali.

Dera Darklighter was a Human female who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. She was the daughter of Huff Darklighter and his second wife and the younger half-sister of Rebel Alliance pilot Biggs Darklighter.
Xarcce Huwla was a Tunroth who volunteered to join the Alliance of Free Planets' Rogue Squadron following the Battle of Endor.

Yoog Skell was the High Prefect of the Intendant caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. Nom Anor often went to him for advice, and Skell told him much about the gatherings of the Elite, including Supreme Overlord Shimrra's god-given ability to turn them into a mob (which was actually Onim…
Bas was a human male colonel of the Imperial Remnant serving as wing commander of the starfighters aboard the Star Destroyer Chimaera in 19 ABY.

Nalgol was a Human of the noble Kuat family serving as captain and commanding officer of the Star Destroyer Tyrannic of the Starfleet of the Imperial Remnant some fifteen years after the Battle of Endor.

Trazzen was a Human male who served as captain and commanding officer of the Star Destroyer Obliterator of the Starfleet of the Imperial Remnant some fifteen years after the Battle of Endor. Trazzen had a reputation for being soft-spoken belying his reputation for ruthlessness.
Argona was the male Human captain and commanding officer of the Star Destroyer Ironhand of the Starfleet of the Imperial Remnant some fifteen years after the Battle of Endor.
Rith Tar'ak was an Ebranite operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Signet Mezzileen was a Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic. He ruled over the planet of Coruscant for 70 years, and often praised it as the galaxy's "biggest little neighborhood."

Borz'Mat'oh was a philosopher of the Duinuogwuin species. In 15,500 BBY, Borz'Mat'oh's species became embroiled in the Duinuogwuin Contention, a conflict with the Galactic Republic, but the philosopher was able to forge a peace between the Duinuogwuin and the Republic after me…

Like all clone troopers, Deviss was created on the planet of Kamino based on the genetic template of the human male bounty hunter Jango Fett, stood 1.83 meters and had tan skin. Deviss received training through the ARC program to prepare them for special missions.

Kaox Krul, also known as The Marauder, The Dark Killer, and The Madman, was a Sith Lord and warlord of the New Sith Empire. He was a formidable warrior within the Brotherhood of Darkness and targeted as a threat by the Jedi near the end of the New Sith Wars.

Crian Maru was a Human female Jedi General in the Army of Light during the latter days of the New Sith Wars. She had a Rodian Padawan named Dree Vandap and flew the Golden Song, named after her impression of the Force.
Flight Officer Esege "Tuke" Tuketu was a Narvath pilot who served in the New Republic Defense Fleet's Fifth Battle Group.
Remel Fud was a mercenary and bounty hunter who worked for the notorious hunter Beilert Valance during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Warshack Rojo was a Corellian officer in the New Republic Defense Force. He was an intense but confident man with a shaven scalp and a diamond earring in one ear, and in 25 ABY he commanded the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Rejuvenator and led a task force based out of Ord …

Dafi was a H'nemthe bounty hunter who was active during the Galactic Civil War. A longtime rival of the Lepi smuggler Jaxxon, Dafi developed a lifelong grudge against the Lepi after a botched run that cost Dafi two fingers and his starship.
Slssk was a Hutlarian male who served as the first mate on former Imperial stormtrooper commander Beilert Valance's bounty hunter crew during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Zakul was a Sanyassan Marauder and the new King of Endor. He was one of the sons of Terak, leader of the stranded Sanyassan Marauders.
Lon Secura was Aayla Secura's uncle, Pol Secura's brother and Nat Secura's father. He was also the Clan Chief of the influential Clan Secura following Pol's death.
Tas Kee was a Weequay enforcer for the crime lord Hat Lo. She protected Lo's interests on the planet Coruscant and kept watch over his consort, Ayy Vida.
Yuka Laka was a Ithorian male who was a droid dealer in the Anchorhead settlement on Tatooine, during the Jedi Civil War.
Khwir was the Twi'lek First Mate on the pirate Urias Xhaxin's Nebulon-B escort frigate, Free Lance.
Doctor Anet Karl was the ship surgeon on the pirate Urias Xhaxin's EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Free Lance. She was a Human woman with long dark hair.
Mirip Pag was a male Iotran gunnery officer who served onboard the pirate Urias Xhaxin's EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Free Lance during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Kandar was the Duros pilot and astrogator of the pirate Urias Xhaxin's Nebulon-B escort frigate Free Lance.

Netus was a Human male politician who served in the Galactic Republic government during the Great Sith War. After a five-year term in the Republic rocket-jumper corps, Netus devoted his life to politics, successfully running for a position within the Galactic Senate.
Bron was a male Human who served as a representative for the Galactic Republic

Kuat of Kuat was a male Human, from a planet which bore a name identical to his. At the time of the Galactic Civil War, he was the hereditary CEO and chief designer of Kuat Drive Yards, one of the three largest starship manufacturers in the galaxy.

Lena was a Twi'lek female who lived in the Lower City of the planet Taris, spending most of her time with her boyfriend, Griff Vao. Griff, who was trying to survive with his sister, Mission, borrowed a large sum of money from Lena to pay for a series of get-rich quick schemes.
Kleyn Selid was an officer of the Army of the Thrawn's confederation in command of Mount Tantiss on the planet Wayland some five years after the Battle of Endor.
He was present when Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, and Chewbacca rescued Princess Leia Organa from her prison cell. Prescott was the third casualty of the battle.
Ivan Cronus was an officer in the military of the Galactic Empire, who had become second-in-command to the breakaway warlord Delvardus some eight years after the Battle of Endor.
Elena Shelvay was an Imperial Security Bureau operative and sister of Corwin Shelvay.
Zorneth was an Ithorian that made and named the savorium herb. At one point, the botanist owned C-3PO and R2-D2.
Captain Orsai was a male Human member of the Mere Resistance movement led by Sol Sixxa and Nym prior to the Clone Wars.
Cort Davin was a male native of Concord Dawn. He served as a Journeyman Protector before he later joined the Cuy'val Dar.

Jorrigar SoBilles was a prominent Duros businessman at the time of the Clone Wars. After his homeworld's fall to the Confederacy of Independent Systems in the 20 BBY Battle of Duro, it was revealed that two corrupt senators had diverted several Venator-class Star Destroyers sl…

Sander Delvardus was a Human male admiral in the Galactic Empire who became an independent warlord after the Battle of Endor. A member of the prestigious Tarkin family by marriage, he was a known womanizer, and had fallen for a refugee aid worker, Seledra-Zin.
Jana Lorso was a female Mirialan Czerka Corporation executive who worked for the Telos IV Citadel Station Czerka branch during the Jedi Civil War.

Bo-Ro-Tara was the President of Cerea during the Clone Wars. President Bo-Ro-Tara was in office when war erupted on his homeworld in a battle that would last for a month. The Battle of Cerea ended with Bo-Ro-Tara's assassination at the hands of Gossam Commandos.
Gularg the Hutt was the owner and bartender of Gularg's Libation Emporium on Celanon. Gularg was approximately 600 years old at the time of the Battle of Yavin.

Sibarra the Hutt was based on the planet Kluistar, where he secretly ran the Ace of Sabres. He had his fingers in smuggling, bribery, slavery, counterfeiting, black market operations, data fixing, and trafficking in stolen information.

Grejic was a Hutt who was the Executive Secretary of the Hutt Grand Council a few years before the Battle of Yavin. Grejic apparently succeeded Mardoc. He decreed that the Besadii should suffer for raising the price of spice after the Battle of Nar Shaddaa.
Mardoc was the Executive Secretary of the Hutt Grand Council a few years before the Battle of Yavin. Mardoc apparently preceded Grejic.
Dorosii the Hutt served as the Appointed Intermediate of the Periphery sector to the Galactic Senate during the Galactic Republic's period.
Sarin Virgilio was a Masterran Human starship officer of the Rebel Alliance and New Republic.
Bok was a male Mon Calamari Rebel who commanded the Grey Damsel as its Captain during the Galactic Civil War.
Aron Peacebringer was a Human male native of the planet Shiva IV who ascended to the title of Warlord of the Calian Confederacy and helped end generations of warfare on his homeworld.

Bentilais san Sk'ar was a Kaleesh general in the Galactic Empire who served during the Galactic Civil War. Originally a warlord on his native Kalee, his resistance forces had been routed by Imperial Captain Thrawn, who leveled the planet Oben with his Star Destroyers.

Devir became the empress of the Krytollak people circa 20 BBY. As the Krytollaks had a rigid social and political structure, and strongly believed that monarchs were destined to rule, she and her people welcomed the Galactic Empire when they first made contact.
Reti was an overly talkative male Toydarian mechanic who operated during the Invasion of Naboo. He later joined the Lok Revenants, under the leadership of the pirate chief Nym.
Deign Lian was a Yuuzhan Vong warrior and the ambitious subordinate of Commander Shedao Shai.

In 1 BBY, he led the assault to abduct Morgan Katarn, disguised as Rebel volunteers. Before the mission he had registered a formal complaint that the unit's poor disguise might jeopardize the mission; namely the all-Human composition of the team, and the standard-issue weapons…
Ackli was a male Mon Calamari vagrant who lived on Tatooine.

Don Danga was a male Human who served as the patriarch of the Danga family on Sulon during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, his estate was attacked by a Corellian light freighter controlled by Imperial commandos of the Ghost Battalion, in an attempt to blame the Rebel Alliance.
Vester was a Human male from Carida who served as a pilot in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Ahleazah was a female Mon Calamari healer who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Ambak was a Mon Calamari physicist. Ambak proposed that there was a distance from a planet beyond which moons could exist or be created by the accretion of left-over matter. Inside of this distance, moons would not form due to the mother planet's gravitational pull.

Ibtisam was a female Mon Calamari pilot who flew for the Rebel Alliance and the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Driven by a refusal to stand by and watch as her people were destroyed by the Empire, she joined the Alliance Starfighter Corps around 4 ABY.

Apted Squelsh was a female Mon Calamari major in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, she oversaw clone troopers at a training camp on the moon Vandor-3, under Admiral Arikakon Baraka.

Arboga was a gravelly-voiced captain of the New Republic Defense Fleet. In the chaos that followed the Imperial retaking of Coruscant after Grand Admiral Thrawn's death, Arboga served as the commanding officer of the MC80 Liberty type Star Cruiser Hope.
Basz Maliyu was known for his ease around Imperial officers, which spawned a number of stories and suspicions.

Originally a Mon Calamari miner in the Alopia Rift, Bringe was forced to wear an articulated environment suit after an accident damaged his body and removed his ability to breathe at standard atmospheric pressure.

A founding member of the Foamwander Five, Guarran was an early organizer of Mon Calamari Resistance to the Imperial subjugation of Dac. After the liberation of Dac, Guarran sought to play a larger role in the defense of his homeworld.
Bella was a female Twi'lek who served as a lieutenant to Captain Cavik Toth during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, she flew a personal assault transport and commanded the destroyer Reaver.
Sol Sixxa was a male Mere from Maramere, and the leader of the Mere Resistance. He joined forces with the pirate captain Nym to battle the Trade Federation in the Karthakk system.
Ob Khaddor was a Human male who served as an outspoken radical Alderaanian artist and grass painter, most famous for having created the moss painting Killik Twilight.
Toggan was an Imperial Moff and the governor of the planet Quellor during the Galactic Civil War.
Zothip was the leader of the Cavrilhu Pirates from roughly ten years before the Thrawn campaign through his death near the end of the Caamas Document conflict.
Vuul was the President of the planet Bri'ahl during the Clone Wars. He made the decision to side with the Galactic Republic after Senator Amidala visited the planet.

Sarge, also identified by the number RC-1013, was a clone commando sergeant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he survived the war's initiation on the planet Geonosis.
Tyto was a Human male and a clone of Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett, who served in the Grand Army of the Republic as a clone commando during the Clone Wars.
Di'kut was a Human male and a clone of Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett, who served in the Grand Army of the Republic as a clone commando during the Clone Wars.
Lorn Pavan was a Human male who worked as a business clerk at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during the last years of the Galactic Republic before becoming an information broker.

Lia Reicheds was a clerk who worked in the Senate Building during the time of the Separatist Crisis. In 22 BBY, before the Clone Wars began, Reicheds witnessed a violent protest against the Military Creation Act outside the Senate which forced the clerk to come through the ang…
Aach Een was a male Zabrak treasure hunter who was friends with Oolak Goyl.
Quarg was a Human male who served as governor of a group of exiles on the watery planet Drexel during the Galactic Civil War.
The Master Machinesmith was the chief technician of the ship-dwellers of Drexel.
Tigris was a male Firrerreo who was the son of Hethrir and Rillao.
Nefta, a humanoid male, was a member of the Imperial Ruling Circle and a Dark Side Adept loyal to Galactic Emperor Palpatine during his reign in clone bodies.

Farlie was an Imperial cook stationed at the Krake Data Vault on Krake's Planet in 3 ABY. Farlie often allowed higher ranked Imperial officers to eat in his kitchen on paydays, so they could avoid busy rushes.
Ona Nobis was a bounty hunter hired by the scientist Jenna Zan Arbor to capture Jedi and anyone else who was Force-sensitive for her experiments. She was a member of the near-Human Sorrusian race.

Immodet was an elderly male Human general in the Imperial Army, and one of the funders of Carnor Jax's plan to sabotage Palpatine's Clones. After Palpatine's death, Immodet became a member on Jax's Interim Ruling Council.

Kooloota-Fyf was the Givin leader of the Shipbuilders and Astromechs Guild and one of the funders of Carnor Jax's plan to sabotage Palpatine's clones. He served on the Imperial Interim Ruling Council.

Ch'Unkk was a male Whiphid spearmaster leader of the largest Whiphid clan of Toola. He used his clan-members as bodyguards for a large number of ranking Imperials. As Ch'Unkk did not speak Basic, his protocol droid was always nearby.
Llon Banjeer was a Human male and Imperial admiral in command of one of the Empire's largest fleets following the Battle of Endor.

Jeratai was an Admiral of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy. Although considered brilliant, he had a reputation for recklessness, and enjoyed putting his men in danger to push for his own victory. Despite this, Jeratai himself was a coward who feared danger.
Governor Tann Starpyre was an elderly male Human and a member of the Diet of Imperial Planetary Governors.
A blond-haired woman, Mahd Windcaller was part of the Interim Ruling Council.
Norym Kim was a Myke pirate that had conquered an entire sector near Imperial space by defeating rival pirate bands.

One of the nonhumans on the Interim Ruling Council, Za was a Defel Prince. Za's family controlled several key hyperspace routes. He used his family's wealth to fund Carnor Jax's plan to sabotage Palpatine's Clones.

Lord Manos was the Devaronian head of the galaxy's largest labor union, specializing in representing repressed alien workers. Although naturally greedy, Manos had a genuine desire for equality between people of all species.
Zasm Katth was a Human male Dark Jedi and a member of the Dark Side Elite, a group of darksiders who served the reborn Galactic Emperor Palpatine.

Kvag Gthull was a male Human Dark Jedi and a member of Emperor Palpatine's Dark Side Elite. Chief interrogator at the Elite's stronghold, Bast Castle on the planet Vjun, he was responsible for gathering information from New Republic Major Ntthan after his capture in 10 ABY, in…
Sa-Di was a male Human Dark Side Adept and an advisor to the reborn Emperor Palpatine.

Lo Khan was a male smuggler who was active during the early years of the Galactic Empire. Khan was a calm individual and tried to stay on the safer side of smuggling, avoiding dispute and armed conflict whenever possible, and spending time joking and drinking with his friends …
