Donn Gulek was the Chief Historian at the Kellmer Institute of Galactic History as late as 17 ABY. He specialized in the history, development, and structure of the New Republic.
Wooyou Senn was a Human male who served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War, and commanded Task Force Vengeance.

Akanah Norand Goss Pell was a female Fallanassi practitioner of the White Current. Isolated from her parents at an early age, she later married Andras Pell, who died shortly afterward. She later met up with Jedi Master Luke Skywalker around the time of the Black Fleet Crisis.
Alole was a female who served as a diplomatic aide to New Republic Chief of State Leia Organa Solo during the Black Fleet Crisis.

Archimar was a military doctor in the New Republic Defense Fleet. During the Black Fleet Crisis, Archimar was attached to the New Republic cruiser Glorious. The doctor would later be assigned to the Intrepid as surgeon.

Ayddar Nylykerka was a male Tammarian fleet tracking officer who was responsible for discovering the Black Fleet and became the head of the New Republic Defense Fleet's Asset Tracking Office during the Galactic Civil War.
Baintorf was a New Republic Defense Force officer.

Balancesheet was a member of the Assembler species, large arachnids that grew many semi-autonomous nodes. Balancesheet was originally a node of the infamous information broker, a much smaller version of his creator, Kud'ar Mub'at.
Behn-Kihl-Nahm was a male senator who served in the Senate of the New Republic during the Black Fleet Crisis.
Belezaboth Ourn was a Paqwe male, who worked as a diplomat.

K'Sheek was the name of a Human female who was abducted and raised by Sand People on Tatooine. The Tusken who took her was named Yark, and she became a sister to A'Yark. She was also the wife of Sharad Hett, and mother of A'Sharad Hett.
Meres Ulcane was a soldier in the Imperial Army, who later staged a mutiny aboard his own ship and formed the Kaarenth Dissension in the Outer Rim.
Jain Havero was a male Calian warrior and a comrade of powerful warlord Aron Peacebringer on the remote planet Shiva IV during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Ygal Delois was a Human male warrior from the planet Shiva IV who was a companion, and later betrayer, of Calian Confederacy Warlord Aron Peacebringer.
Kéral Longknife was a male T'Syriél who served as the Demarch of the Twelve Tribes of T'Syriél on the planet Shiva IV during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Hirog was a male Hiromi, and First Officer of the Hiromi Empire mothership Kuratcha. He proved to be an extremely unlucky spy and saboteur as he tried to expedite the Hiromi dream of galactic conquest.

Kharys was a female S'kytri from the planet Skye. She was Force-sensitive and met Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars. After saving her planet from destruction, Skywalker promised that he would train her to use the Force once the war had ended.

Minka was a Cantrosian female who served as a starfighter pilot in a Cantrosian faction loyal to the Rebel Alliance. In 4 ABY, she became embroiled in a conspiracy in her home system and fought alongside the heroes of the Rebellion against a suspected Imperial cell.

Griggor Tower was a Human male Imperial Admiral who led the subjugation of the Iskalon system during the Galactic Civil War. Under Tower's command, Imperial forces rendered Telfrey uninhabitable and enslaved the people of Gamandar, subsequently making the world his headquarters.
Kateel of Kuhlvult, also known as "Neelah", was a Human female from Kuat who worked as a dancer in Jabba's Palace.
Cale was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Brusc was a captain in the Imperial Starfleet and commanding officer of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Manticore in the Maw fleet.

Meizh Vermel was a colonel in the Imperial Army, and a trusted subordinate of Gilad Pellaeon. In 19 ABY, he was sent to Morishim by the Fleet Admiral on a mission to open peace negotiations between the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant.
Tavell Geen was a male Centran who served as Scrivinir, of the Centrality for most of the Galactic Civil War and several years afterward.
Nirama was an Oblee male who worked both as accountant for the criminal organization of Riboga the Hutt, and later as Riboga's personal majordomo.

Boz was a Lizling and the companion of the aggressive Herglic Ry-Kooda by 10 ABY. That year, after the pair learned that the bounty hunter Boba Fett had killed Ry-Kooda's brother, Bar-Kooda, they set out to take vengeance upon Fett and a trio of Hutts who had been involved wit…
Spurch "Warhog" Goa was a Diollan bounty hunter and former mercenary.
Baga was a young bordok who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. He was the pet of Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka.
Corporal Koyo was a Human male commando who served in the Second Platoon, B Company of the Imperial Army Special Ops Ghost Battalion during the Galactic Civil War.
Santo was a commando in Second Platoon, B Company of the Imperial Army Special Operations group Ghost Battalion.
Abano was a male Aruzan native to the planet Aruza, where he worked as a dola tree farmer. He was the father of Manaroo, a tattooed dancing girl who eventually married the bounty hunter Dengar.
Cos Dashit was the Emperor of the New Galactic Empire. His titles included Consul to the Supreme Tribunal.
Azrakel, also known as The Dark Warrior, was a Dark Jedi who served Kadann in the Secret Order of the Empire.
Deathstick was a female Dathomirian assassin and daughter of the Nightsister Shelish, active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Cian Marook was a New Republic Senator of the Hrasskis species.

During Nil Spaar's operation to seize Black Sword Command from the Galactic Empire in 4 ABY, Dar Bille was the future Viceroy's second-in-command. Dar Bille led Spaar's backup assault team through Section 21 in the seizure of the Super Star Destroyer Intimidator.

Sera Faleur Darklighter was female Human who was born on the planet Chandrila, growing up near the Silver Sea. She worked as a social worker and eventually met New Republic pilot Gavin Darklighter. The two married a few years after the Battle of Bilbringi (around 12 ABY).
Feskitt Bobb was a Mandallian Giant who operated as a mercenary and bounty hunter during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.

Titus Klev was a Human male officer of the Imperial Navy. An active member of the Sub-Adult Group, he was accepted into CompForce despite his young age and later became the thirty-seventh generation of Klevs to enter the Imperial Naval Academy after being rejected once.
Tour Aryon was the Human female who served as governor of the desert planet Tatooine under the Galactic Empire. She was a native from Treylon II.

Lob Doluff was the Administrator Senior of the Oseon system during the Imperial Era. A very wealthy man, Doluff entered civil service because of a desire to help the common people of his home system, one of the richest in the galaxy.
Del Cycer was a Human male who played sabacc with smuggler Lando Calrissian during Calrissian's second visit to the Oseon system.
Allaya Djo was the daughter of Augwynne Djo, mother of Teneniel Djo, and grandmother of Tenel Ka Djo. She was the warmaster of the Singing Mountain Clan until her untimely death in the desert.

Tian Chyler was a Human female who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Initially a member of the Galactic Empire's Sub-Adult Group, Chyler was selected by her superiors for training from the Imperial Security Bureau.

Gela Yeens was an ill-tempered smuggler who earned credits by helping Jabba Desilijic Tiure collect his debts. Well respected for his uncanny anticipation in battle, Yeens was searching for Debnoli on Tatooine.
Ket Maliss was a Dashade male assassin from the time of the Great Sith War who was cryogenically frozen for nearly 4,000 years following the near-extinction of his species.
Zzzanmxl was the leader of a band of Zanibar mercenaries and bounty hunters.
Mirx was an officer of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Farley 'Stony' Carson was an officer of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Tolokus was an officer of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Tolsk was an officer of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Morano was an officer of the New Republic Defense Force.
Logirth was an officer of the New Republic Defense Force.
Sreas was a demanding but fair officer in the New Republic Defense Force. In late 16 ABY, Captain Sreas commanded the fleet shuttle Tampion carrying Commodore Han Solo to the Fifth Battle Group.
Corgan was an officer of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Mauit'ta was an officer of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Trenn Gant was an officer of New Republic Intelligence.

Nrin Vakil was a Quarren pilot who flew for Rogue Squadron. He joined the squadron after their mission on Mrlsst. Vakil saw himself as a knight, and wore a modified flight suit filled with salt water to remind himself of home.
Loka Hask was a notorious Human male pirate who was responsible for the deaths of Wedge Antilles's parents.

Koyi Komad was a student in the Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy where she studied hyperspatial physics under Professor Rorax Falken, with xenopsych as an elective. There she became friends with Anki Pace.
Kapp Dendo was a male Devaronian who served as one of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's most respected intelligence agents during the Galactic Civil War.
Herian I'ngre was a Bith starfighter pilot who flew X-wings with Rogue Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Gade Yedan was Gyr Keela's assistant at the Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy. He held Keela in great contempt, feeling that the Mrlssi was nothing more than bluster and had no ability.
Feylis Ardele was a Human female pilot who served in the New Republic Defense Force's famous Rogue Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.

Elscol Loro was a Human female resistance leader and New Republic starfighter pilot during the Galactic Civil War. A native of the Colonies planet Cilpar, Loro joined the Cilpari Resistance to oppose Imperial rule on her homeworld.

Groznik was a Wookiee who played key roles in Rogue Squadron operations on Cilpar and Mrlsst. Enslaved by the Galactic Empire prior to the Battle of Endor, he swore a life debt to Throm Loro after the freedom fighter liberated him and saved his life.
Dllr Nep was a Force-sensitive Sullustan X-wing pilot who served under Wedge Antilles as part of Rogue Squadron following the Battle of Endor.
Fearful of the changes Plourr Ilo attempted to institute on Eiattu 6, Laabann attempted to kidnap her to maintain the Priamsta's power.
Cartariun was a Force-sensitive Imperial technician stationed in an Imperial garrison on the world of Malrev IV.
Sol Mon was a Human male and the leader of a pirate gang that rose to power during the Galactic Empire's fragmentation following the Battle of Endor.
Bassi Vobah was a Human female police officer who served in the Oseon system during the Galactic Civil War.
Waywa Fybot was a male Quor'sav who served the Galactic Empire as an undercover narcotics agent in the Oseon system during the Imperial Period.
Ekisp was a Human male who worked as a servant for wealthy industrialist Bohhuah Mutdah and Mutdah's private estate on Oseon 5792 during the Imperial Period.
Den Siva was a part of the Nagai invasion force that attempted to conquer the Galaxy shortly after the Battle of Endor.

Kahr'corvh Clan Kihm'bar was the Noghri representative to the New Republic. In 10 ABY, Kahr'corvh was a signatory of Why Do We Fight the Empire?, the New Republic's affirmation of their resolve to fight the Galactic Empire.

Aiaks Fwa was a male Whiphid mercenary who served Jabba the Hutt during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, Aiaks Fwa served as a suicide bomber who carried out a job for Jabba. His mission was to infiltrate the Ylesian slave trade and kill the t'landa Til priest that led it.
In 2 ABY, the Tombat bested his estate's security system and stole Baron Galrowk's famed art collection.

During Rogue Squadron's search for Eidolon and its weapons cache, Betsi attempted to pick up Tycho Celchu outside the Darklighter estate on Tatooine. Luckily, Winter stepped in to save Celchu from the embarrassment.

Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Black Tongue attempted to extort millions of credits from Jabba the Hutt by ransoming Grubba, a nephew of Jabba. Han Solo happened upon Grubba on Faldos and took the young Hutt back to Tatooine in the hopes of lessening his debt to Jabba.
Talloryn was the Imperial governor of Aldraig IV.
Benja Da'aapp was a Gruvian tourist often seen at Kuat Passenger Port. Da'aapp was always accompanied by Olall Da'aapp, though it is unclear how they were related.

Olall Da'aapp was an intensely friendly Gruvian tourist who traveled the galaxy with their companion Benja Da'aapp. The pair, both from the location Gruvia, frequently visited the Kuat Passenger Port on the planet Kuat.
Sollaine was a Human male who served as the Central Commander of the Imperial Security Bureau during the Galactic Civil War.
Cilas Veckon was an officer of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Gunham was a Commander and Imperial Pilot Coordinator of the Imperial Navy.

Landau was a male Human officer in the Imperial Navy. During the Galactic Civil War, Commander Landau was stationed on Naboo to oversee the recruitment of new pilots under Admiral Veckon's push for additional enlistments.
Hyris-Well Madorin was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Separatist Crisis.

Kres'ten'tarthi, better known by his core name of Stent, was one of the Chiss followers of Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo, better known as Grand Admiral Thrawn. Stent served the Grand Admiral as a TIE pilot and the leader of his Household Phalanx troops.

Tanis Mothma was a Human female politician who served as governor of Hanna City on Chandrila during the years prior to the Clone Wars. Her husband was an arbiter-general of the Galactic Republic and their daughter, Mon Mothma became the senator of the Bormea sector.

Lieda Mothma was the daughter of Senator Mon Mothma and the sister of Jobin. Mon wished that she could dedicate her time to Lieda, but she was steadfast in her commitment to the Rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Gurdun was an official of the Galactic Empire who took charge of several technological projects during the last years of Palpatine's reign. He held the rank of Supervisor.
Minor Relsted was an official of the Galactic Empire. He was initially an assistant to Supervisor Gurdun during which he skimmed funds to create the IG series of assassin droids.

Loruss was the manager and chief technician of the IG Series Prototype Project at Holowan Laboratories who produced five assassin droids—namely, IG-72 and the four IG-88 droids (A, B, C, and D). These droids, ordered by Imperial Supervisor Gurdun, were meant to serve the Empire.

Lik Ankkit was a male Neimoidian. He lived in a villa on the planet Qiilura, where he controlled the production of barq and other luxury foods, exploiting the poor farmers who couldn't afford the food that grew on their fields.
Vyn Narcassan was a high-ranking Senate Bureau of Intelligence official during the time of the Separatist Crisis.
Dyslogia Twang was a contributor to the HoloNet News channel at the time of the Separatist Crisis. He covered gossip in such topics as fashion, celebrity news, and high-class social events.

Qorl was a male human that fought as a TIE Fighter pilot for the Second Imperium, a splinter faction of the Galactic Empire, where he was stationed on the first Death Star, who was shot down during the Battle of Yavin.
Remis Vehn was a member of the Peace Brigade who helped in the assault on the Jedi Praxeum in 26 ABY. He piloted one of the Brigade's transports that participated in the Jedi-seeking raid on Yavin 4.
Lynia Delline was a half-Human female who worked as an aide to Chief of State Mon Mothma during the early years of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Wirriz was a male Quarren Vice Admiral serving in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Mace Towani was a Human male who was the son of Catarine Towani and Jeremitt Towani and brother to his sister, Cindel Towani during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY the Towani family's starcruiser crash-landed on the forest moon of Endor.

Si was a Gran exile and a commander within the Galactic Alliance Defense Force in 28 ABY. He was based on the planet Esfandia which was home to the Brrbrlpp. During his off-duty hours at the Galactic Alliance base, he studied the Brrbrlpp and studied their language and culture.

Niles Ferrier was a Human male ship thief who in 9 ABY worked as an agent for Grand Admiral Thrawn during his campaign to conquer the galaxy, helping with efforts to find the Katana fleet and trying to undermine the embryonic Smugglers' Alliance.

Seven-Four, designated CT-6/774, was a clone trooper auxiliary heavy-weapons specialist who served as a turret gunner on a LAAT/i. His LAAT/i was stationed on Halleck immediately prior to the Battle of Haruun Kal.
Jeremitt Towani was a Human male who was the husband of Catarine Towani, and the father of Cindel and Mace Towani.

Catarine Towani was a Human female who had two children with her husband, Jeremitt: Cindel and Mace. In 3 ABY, the Towani family was marooned on the Forest Moon of Endor after their star cruiser crashed there.

Sris Lehhett was a male Centran Fleet Admiral in the Centrality Navy. In 25 ABY, shortly after the start of the Yuuzhan Vong War, he launched a bloody military coup, overthrew Scrivinir Tavell Geen, and declared himself Scrinivir.

Barney was a Human male native of Belderone who served in the Rebel Alliance and later the Alliance of Free Planets. Barney and his lifelong friend Flint worked in an Imperial AT-AT factory until a team of Rebel agents arrived on Belderone in 3 ABY.
Captain Juno was a starship captain with the Mere Resistance. He flew the Mere cruiser Tritus into battle against Cavik Toth's forces prior to and at the onset of the Clone Wars.

T'un was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the last centuries of the Republic's reign over the galaxy. Around 94 BBY, T'un was tasked with maintaining all holographic data files on Jedi Initiates within the Order.
Skorg Jameson was a Human male colonist from Sulon.
Ejagga Pakkpekatt was a Hortek officer in New Republic Intelligence.

Eri Palle was a personal aide to Nil Spaar. Palle assisted the Viceroy in a wide variety of methods, from managing Spaar's daily tasks to plotting the assassination of his political enemies. Eri was present when Spaar killed Kiv Truun.

Ygabba Hise was a young girl who stole Boba Fett's Mandalorian helmet. She wore tattered clothes, like an Ugnaught mechanic's smock, which was too big, and tied at the waist with a filthy rope. She was skinny and starved looking, because she rarely got that much to eat.
Paxi Sylo was a Human male born to parents Griggen and Tashna Sylo on a farm on the Outer Rim planet of Dantooine between the years 30 BBY and 31 BBY.

Griggen Sylo was a Human and the spouse of Tashna Sylo. The two owned a large outback farm, which had been in the Sylo family for ten generations, on the Outer Rim planet of Dantooine in the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Tashna Sylo was a Human and the spouse of Griggen Sylo. The two owned a large farm in the outback of the Outer Rim planet Dantooine in the waning years of the Galactic Republic, a farm that had been in the Sylo family for ten generations.
Elise Montagne was a Human female who lived on an estate north of the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine during the time of the Jedi Civil War.

Kebla Yurt was a Human female who by 3963 BBY was the owner of the Equipment Emporium, the largest store in the Upper City of Taris. In 3956 BBY, the Sith Empire invaded the planet, confiscating her heavy weapons and impounding her flight-worthy transports.
Zaerdra was a pale-skinned female Twi'lek who lived in the Lower City of the Outer Rim world of Taris during the time of the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War.

Kaeira was a Human female who lived in the Lower City of Taris during the time of the Jedi Civil War and the Sith occupation of that world. She was a member of the Hidden Beks swoop gang and a bodyguard of its leader, Gadon Thek.
Pollard Seario was a male who served as the president of Czerka Corporation from roughly 4000 BBY to 3950 BBY.
Sherruk was a Human Mandalorian Rally Master who fought in the Mandalorian Wars. He was killed on Dantooine by the amnesiac Jedi Padawan Revan at Jon's request.

Reeza was a Human male Mandalorian who fought in the Mandalorian Wars. Following the end of the war, he joined Sherruk's group of bandits. They eventually came to Dantooine, where they terrorized and extorted the local populace.

Jarg was a Human male Mandalorian who joined the Neo-Crusaders during the Mandalorian Wars. Following the end of the war, he joined Sherruk's group of bandits, along with Reeza. He was a pilot of XT-model bike.
Adum Larp was a Rodian male operated on Dantooine as a merchant during the Jedi Civil War.
Kni was a Duros male who lived during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. During the war, the Sith bombed Kni's homeworld.

Fall Topas was Plat Mallar's Grannan mother and wife of Plat Hovath. Before being killed in the Yevethan Purge, she was a plant biologist on the planet Polneye. Her son would later recant that she was quite beautiful.
Fe Sun was a Jedi Knight and the second Padawan of Jedi Master Shaak Ti. Soon after achieving knighthood, Sun was murdered by the Zeltron criminal Lyshaa.
Eppon was the name Tash and Zak Arranda gave to the infant they discovered in the laboratory of Borborygmus Gog, hidden on the lifeless planet of Kiva.
Trol was a teenage Human male who was living on Sulon during the early part of the Galactic Civil War.

Jen was a teenaged Human female from Sulon who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, she was one of the twenty-six Rebel resistance soldiers that were led by Morgan Katarn and participated in the missile team during Jerec's attack.
Crowley was a female who served as a Master Sergeant in the Grand Army of the Republic and later a member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Hong was a male Imperial stormtrooper Sergeant major assigned aboard the Star Destroyer Imperator as of 1 BBY. He was killed at the Battle of AX-456.
Morley was a Human male stormtrooper sergeant who served in the Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War. He spoke with a characteristic drawl.

Trang was a Human male who served as a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, he was assigned aboard the Star Destroyer Imperator where he served as a scout in the platoon to Cadet leader Kyle Katarn. He was killed during an attack on AX-456.

Dobbs was a Human male stormtrooper who served in the Imperial Military during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, he was assigned aboard the Star Destroyer Imperator where he served in the platoon assigned to Cadet leader Kyle Katarn.

Sutu was a Human male stormtrooper who served in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, he was assigned aboard the Star Destroyer Imperator where he served as a scout in the platoon, led by Cadet Leader Kyle Katarn.

Dass Jennir was a Human male Jedi Master who served as a general during the Clone Wars, and survived Order 66. During the Clone Wars, he was stationed on New Plympto, leading the Galactic Republic's war effort against the Separatist Nosaurians.

Bomo Greenbark was a male Nosaurian native from New Plympto, who served as a scout to the Separatists and fought against the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Like all Nosaurians, Greenbark was capable of producing a phosphorent flash from his mouth.
Noirah Na was a female Human Jedi Padawan who was trained by Master Simms and wielded a blue lightsaber during the Clone Wars.
Casus Sandral was a Human male living on Dantooine during the time of the Jedi Civil War. He was a member of the Sandral family, being the son of Nurik and the brother of Rahasia.
Gonster was a member of a sapient, humanoid species with large, pointed ears, and two heads with wide mouths. He lived in the Twin Hills of the forest moon of Endor with his pet hoosha.

The Raich was a carnivorous beast that resided on the forest moon of Endor. The creature was known to prey on a variety of animals that inhabited the woodland of the moon. In order to capture and feast upon the forest fauna, the Raich employed a unique natural mechanism.
The Bobog was a gigantic being who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, the young Ewoks Wicket Wystri Warrick, Teebo, Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka, and Latara went to the Bobog to trade.
Bothel was a top hat-wearing trunked sentient who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor with his partner Trud. The pair, who enjoyed frolicking in the mud, used the Ewok Malani to get the sunstar.
Trud was a trunked sentient who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor with his partner Bothel. The pair, who enjoyed frolicking in the mud, used the Ewok Malani to get the sunstar.

Elbo was an underwater monarch who dwelt on the forest moon of Endor. The king lived in a Coral Castle at the bottom of a sea on Endor, but he delighted in coming to the surface to test the integrity of the creatures that lived there.

Gracca was a winged sapient who lived on the Floating Mountain on the moon of Endor. At some point in the early history of Bright Tree Village, an Ewok settlement on the moon, Gracca invaded the village and stole the Ewoks' magical Crystal Cloak, which gave the owner the power…
Norky was a persta child who lived with his parents on the forest moon of Endor.

Horville was an alien individual who ran Horville's Hut of Horrors on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, Horville's establishment was visited by a group of Ewoks, who were searching for something more exciting than the Tumble Bunnies show.
The Stranger was the name given to a Wizard of the Night Spirit by the Ewok children of Bright Tree Village on the Forest Moon of Endor.
a: Dark Wizard of the Night Spirit

x: The Sun King was a powerful entity who, along with his siblings, controlled the seasons of the Forest Moon of Endor using the season scepter. His sisters were the Flower Queen and the Leaf Queen, and his brother was the Snow King.

The Snow King was a powerful being who ruled the winter season of the forest moon of Endor. He could only bring about winter with the season scepter. He was the brother of the Leaf Queen, the Sun King, and the Flower Queen.

The Leaf Queen was a powerful being and sorceress who ruled the autumn season of the forest moon of Endor. She could only bring about autumn with the Season Scepter, a powerful artifact that was shared among the other rulers of the Endorian seasons.

The Flower Queen was a being who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. She and her siblings, the Sun King, Leaf Queen, and Snow King, were responsible for controlling the weather of Endor using the season scepter, but in 3 ABY, the Snow King fell under the influence of a nefariou…
Givens was a Human male who served as a stormtrooper, holding the rank of corporal, during the Galactic Civil War.

Dendu was a Human male stormtrooper who was member of the Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, he was assigned aboard the Star Destroyer Imperator, along with the platoon led by Cadet Leader Kyle Katarn. He was a part of the battle on AX-456.

Blim Shahar was a male member of the Rebel Alliance who fought against the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, he was stationed aboard AX-456 when his birthday was coming up. He was then killed during the attack.
Haber Trell was a trader, who unknowingly got involved in a devious scheme devised by Grand Admiral Thrawn.
Jonsey was a male Human who served as a stormtrooper in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

Haku was a stormtrooper assigned aboard the Star Destroyer Imperator as of 1 BBY. He was a member of the platoon assigned to Cadet Leader Kyle Katarn. Along with Morley, he was used as a demolitions expert while the crew took the asteroid, AX-456.
Nathan Donar III was a Human male Imperial Stormtrooper who served in the Imperial Military during the Galactic Civil War.
Rissa Donar was a Human female who was the mother of Nathan Donar III and the wife of Governor Dol Donar II.
Kaiya Adrimetrum was a female Human resistance fighter, a Rebel unit commander who became a member of Page's Commandos and commanded the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar.
Ma'w'shiye was an expert scout, a graduate of the Galactic Outdoor Survival School and later a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Eclipse Team and security task force.

Stor was a Human male student who attended the Academy of Carida during the Imperial era. During his graduation in 4 BBY, he served as Cadet Company Commander; when his company was marching towards the cliff, he forgot to call halt, and as a result, the first rank fell to thei…
Roget Jiriss was a Human female and one of the most successful smugglers in the early years of the New Republic. Brash and confident, Jiriss had an intense hatred of all pirates.

Tura Raftican was an investigative reporter working for the HoloNews Network. During the Galactic Civil War, she joined the Intelligence department of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, working under Major Arhul Hextrophon and General Airen Cracken.

Dol Donar II was a Human male who served as the Imperial governor of Derra IV during the Galactic Civil War. His wife was Rissa Donar, and his youngest son, Nathan Donar III, was a graduate of the Academy of Carida. He had a strong dislike of the Rebel Alliance.
Bane Nothos was, at one time, an aspiring Imperial District Commander, responsible for the territory surrounding the Roche asteroid field.

Labansat was a well-known Weequay male mercenary active during the Galactic Civil War. Fierce, brutal, and a skilled fighter, Labansat operated out of the Lesser Plooriod Cluster and the Karstaxon Regions, plying the two areas of galactic space.

Noval Garaint was a Human male who served as a bounty hunter during the height of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Imperial invasion of Kheedar, Garaint was able to take over the planet's criminal syndicate which had previously been under the control of the crime lord Horch.

Shenir Rix was a Mon Calamari female reputed to be one of the most reliable information dealers in the galaxy during the Galactic Civil War. Formerly an employee of Fergriss Pharmaceuticals, Rix was forced out of her job after an Imperial assault put the company out of business.

Villar was a male Devaronian information broker who often aided the Galactic Empire. A skilled fighter who excelled at espionage, Villar was a typical member of his species. He longed to see the galaxy, but such travels required money.

Zuggs was a Human male who served as an officer in the naval forces of Palpatine's Galactic Empire. Following the death of Emperor Palpatine at the Battle of Endor, the Imperial throne was left empty.
Green was a Human Black Sun Vigo under Prince Xizor.
Laddinare Torbin was a male Grand Inquisitor who served the Imperial Inquisitorius during the years of the Imperial era.
Rav Bralor was a Human female Mandalorian warrior who was active during the Clone Wars.
Jorir"—which meant "to carry" or "to bear" in Mando'a—was one of the clones of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett who were grown on the planet Kamino to serve in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Pfilbee Jhorn was a sergeant in the Imperial Navy who served as the records officer for Emperor Palpatine's second expedition to the forest moon of Endor.

Halmere was a High Inquisitor during the Galactic Civil War. At the conclusion of the Clone Wars, Halmere was one of the many Force-sensitive adepts held by the Galactic Empire on the Deep Core world of Byss.
Drolen Antig was a male Nalroni smuggler and thief. The goods he smuggled included jellied canron and spice, and the criminal operated along routes such as the Kessel Run.
Mexnean was a Berrite female con artist and thief.
Gorzima was a male Quarren gambler and crime lord living on Nar Shaddaa circa 31 BBY.
Vonya was a Witch of Dathomir and princess of the Nightsister clan in 31 BBY. She was second in command of the clan led by the Nightsister Mother, Zalem.

C'borp was Finhead Stonebone's chief gunner aboard the pirate vessel Marauder Starjacker. In 3999 BBY, C'borp used the ship's laser turret to fire on an Ithullian ore hauler, which was transporting valuable ore that Stonebone wanted to siphon and was protected by a hired secur…

Cailshh was a sly and unpredictable Ubese mercenary who was hired by Lik Ankkit on Qiilura. Cailshh's sex was unknown, though Ghez Hokan believed it was a male. Cailshh was ordered by Hokan to search for the Republic spies.
Deesra Luur Jada was a male Twi'lek Jedi Knight who was trained by Jedi Master Dorak to succeed him as the Chronicler of the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine.

Pekt was a male Trandoshan from Trandosha who was born into a powerful family, and became a slaver. After the Battle of Endor, he joined with the Imperial Moff Hindane Darcc to enslave the Wookiees on Kashyyyk.
Pollux was a male Human and captain of the passenger starship Nebula Chaser during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Simms was a female Chalactan Jedi Master who served as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Reymet Autem, a Human male, was the son of Sagoro Autem. Reckless by nature, he loved to participate in daredevil swoop-bike racing through Coruscant's garbage pits.

Keets Freely was a Human male writer who worked for The Coruscant Holo Net during the Clone Wars. He was one of the first to wonder why Palpatine was "grabbing all the power while still smiling at us."
Rhya Taloon was a Human female Senator of Agridorn who served in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the time of the Clone Wars.
Oryon was a male Bothan spy who worked for the Republic Intelligence during the Clone Wars and later the Erased.
Hume was a Human male officer and pilot who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Gilly was a Human male who joined the Erased along with his twin brother, Spence, after the Galactic Republic was reorganized into the Galactic Empire by Emperor Palpatine. After the brothers engaged a band of robbers in 18 BBY, Gilly showed his skill with weapons to Solace.
Spence was a Human male who joined the Erased along with his twin brother, Gilly, after the Galactic Republic was reorganized into the Galactic Empire by Emperor Palpatine.
Curran Caladian was a male Svivreni who worked in the Senate as an aide. His cousin was Tyro Caladian.
Drathul was a member of the Yuuzhan Vong, and the High Prefect of the Intendant caste.

Ngaaluh was a female Yuuzhan Vong deception sect priestess, and loyally worshiped the goddess Yun-Harla for much of her life. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, however, Ngaaluh had her belief in the True Way eroded by an interrogation subject; the Fosh Jedi Vergere.

Yal Phaath was a Master Shaper of the Shaper caste. Venerable even by the standards of his long-lived race, the marks of Domain Phaath had faded by the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War due to his many escalations.
Halbret was a Human Jedi Knight. During the Old Republic she brought together a contingent of Jedi Knights to defeat a powerful Dark Jedi who had enslaved the Kathol species and sought their Codex.

Furgan was a Caridan male warlord of the former Galactic Empire native to the planet of Carida, home to the Imperial Military Academy. Despite his second-class status as a non-human, he rose to become a Imperial ambassador for Carida.
Mazzic was a male Human smuggler from Corellia. Originally a free trader, he turned to smuggling and ran an independent smuggling organization during the Galactic Civil War.

affiliation: Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification
x: Alexandra "Alex" Winger was a Force-sensitive female Human. Her biological father was Matt Turhaya, but she grew up as the adopted daughter of the Imperial Governor of Garos IV, Tork Winger.

Dyyz "Megadeath" Nataz was once a Sector Ranger officer who worked alongside a Diollan named Spurch Goa. He served with the Sector Rangers for several years, but his missions eventually led him into conflicts with the Hutt crime lords of Nal Hutta.
Gwellib Ap-Llewff was an Imperial Inquisitor and Dark Side Adept during the Galactic Civil War. Originally a Jedi, he was not selected to become a Padawan, instead joining the Agricultural Corps.
Saquesh was a male Quarren who oversaw the Exchange's presence in the Refugee Sector on Nar Shaddaa as of 3951 BBY, during the First Jedi Purge.

Marn "Gryph" Hierogryph, also known as Baron Hieromarn, Remulus Horne, Professor Gryphomarn, Junior Saber-Twirler, and Bulgryph Mandrake, was a confidence trickster, black marketeer, entrepreneur, and restaurant host who rose to prominence during the Mandalorian Wars.
Jessica Meade was a traveler and tramp freighter captain that R2-D2 and C-3PO met during their adventures in the early days of the Empire.
Denua Ku was a Yuuzhan Vong soldier during their invasion of the galaxy. Shortly after the Battle of Coruscant, he was serving with Warmaster Tsavong Lah's personal bodyguard.
Samnt was a Human male living on the planet Dantooine during 3956 BBY. While visiting the world's Jedi Enclave in that year, he ran into the grieving woman Elise Montagne, who he began talking with.

The Kothos twins, also known as the Reborn twins, referred to Vil Kothos and Dasariah Kothos. They did not use lightsabers but instead were extremely skilled in using the dark side of the Force, primarily utilizing Force Push and Force lightning to dispatch their foes.
Jann Tosh was a young miner living on the backwater world of Tyne's Horky. He was about twenty years old when he met the droids C-3PO and R2-D2.

Putch Gundarian, also known as Uncle Gundy, was an elderly miner who worked in the caverns of the planet Tyne's Horky. Gundarian's adventurous nephew Jann Tosh often assisted him in the grueling work.

Acros-Krik was the corrupt Ongree male mayor of Coruscant's Uscru Entertainment District. Granted his position by the galaxy-wide crime syndicate Black Sun, he served as an informant for them, gathering valuable intelligence on the denizens of the district.
Palo Torshan was a Human Rebel Alliance major and one of the top security personnel at Echo Base, the Alliance High Command headquarters on the ice planet Hoth.
Vega Sepen was a female Corellian spacer, known as a tough, sharp-edged platinum-blonde who served as the first mate of Uldir Lochett's starship, the No Luck Required.

The Duros Vook Gehu was a member of Uldir Lochett's crew aboard the rescue starship No Luck Required. His natural dourness was only intensified following the Yuuzhan Vong conquest of his homeworld and the death of his uncle.

The Dug Leaft was a member of the crew aboard the No Luck Required, the rescue starship captained by Uldir Lochett during the Yuuzhan Vong War. With his species' natural agility and fast reactions, he often manned the ship's weapons when she was forced to go into combat.

Uldir Lochett was a Human male who, as a young man, attempted to join Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum in 22 ABY in the hope of becoming a Jedi and later became a starfighter pilot working with the Space Rescue Corps.
Dacholder was a Human male known to his friends as Doc. He was a member of the New Republic's Search and Rescue Corps.

Havet Storm was the young Rebel agent who stole the Death Star superlaser plans for the Rebel Alliance. He later joined the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4 under the tutelage of Luke Skywalker, where he was killed by the Dark Jedi Desann.

Boorka was a male Hutt crime lord who operated on the planet Tatooine around 22 BBY. Around the time of the outbreak of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Boorka received information from Bogeega Bu'Daay, an operative on th…
Danielle Kieran, known to her friends as Dani, was a hot-shot Corellian pilot, who believed herself to be Han Solo's illegitimate daughter.

Viglo was a male Human officer who served Darth Malak's Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, he was stationed on Manaan, where he passed the time getting drunk and spending his time with women.
Duan was a female Human officer who served Darth Malak's Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, she was stationed on Manaan. During her stay, she was known to be a heavy drinker.
Elassa Huros was a female Human Sith apprentice, during the Jedi Civil War.
Roland Wann was a Human male officer who served in the Galactic Republic's military during the Jedi Civil War.
Lord Slagorth was a Galderian member of the Galderian Slave Traders, and was tasked with setting up a base of operations in the Trebodar system.
Shaelas was a male Selkath who lived during the Jedi Civil War. His daughter was Shasa. After Shasa and several other Selkath youth went missing, Shaelas asked Revan to investigate.

apprentices: Various members of the Order of Shasa
x: Shasa was a Force-sensitive Selkath female who lived during the Jedi Civil War, a conflict initiated by the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Revan and his Sith apprentice, Darth Malak.

Nubassa was a male Selkath who lived during the Jedi Civil War. He was interested in buying alien animals for use in a zoo on Manaan, although due to Manaan's rules in the matter, Nubassa was forced to utilize slightly less-than-legal means.

Nilko Bwaas was a male Selkath who lived during the Jedi Civil War. He was a member of Manaan's government, and hired Revan to investigate why the Republic Embassy was hiring so many mercenaries. He offered Revan five hundred credits in recovering any vital information for him.
Jhosa was a male Selkath who lived during the Jedi Civil War. He was a judge on the Ahto City Civil Authority court.
Duula was a male Selkath who lived in Ahto City on Manaan before and during the Jedi Civil War. He was a judge on the Ahto City Civil Authority court, and a strong advocate for the Sith Empire.

Kota was a male Selkath who lived during the Jedi Civil War. He was a judge on the Ahto City Civil Authority court. Despite Manaan's strict neutrality policy, Kota in his personal view was an avid defender of the Galactic Republic.

Shelkar was a male Selkath. During the Jedi Civil War he was a Chief Justice on the Ahto High Court. He was sympathetic to the Republic and helped set up a deal to supply extra kolto to the Republic by allowing them to build the Hrakert Station.
Naleshekan was a male Selkath who lived in Ahto City on the world of Manaan during the Jedi Civil War. He was a judge within the Ahto City Civil Authority's court.
Ta-mara Greenly was one of two sisters of Tag Greenley. She, like her other sibling De-hoff, dated Lando Calrissian.
De-hoff Greenly was one of two sisters of Tag Greenley. She, like her other sibling Ta-mara, dated Lando Calrissian.
Mooth was a trader who lived on the forest moon of Endor.
The Totem Master was a thief who lived on the forest moon of Endor. He traveled from village to village in a covered wagon, looking for targets that could be robbed easily.
Gabby was a pilot for the Astrographic Survey Institute. He overflew more than a thousand planets, though setting foot on only three of these.
Ijix Harona was an officer of the New Republic Defense Force and later Galactic Alliance Defense Force.

Duno Dree was a Human male pilot who accompanied the Jedi Master Qu Rahn to the planet Dorlo during the year 5 ABY. Also known as Druno, he originally worked for his father, piloting in-system freighters.
Cee Norley was a Human female Rebel who was trained by Tech Sergeant Hooly.
Rolanda Gron was a male Klatooinian technologist who worked for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Porg was a Trandoshan male bounty hunter who was active during the time of the New Republic. In 5 ABY, the droid information broker 8t88 hired Porg as an extra hand to kill the former Rebel Alliance agent Kyle Katarn if Katarn managed to escape death at the hands of other hire…
Wires was a computer expert on board the New Hope, the flagship of the Rebel fleet.

Brollo was a Gamorrean mercenary who worked for Jerec's division of the Imperial remnants in 5 ABY. He wore a bloodsucking morrt on each bicep as a symbol of status. He was stationed on Sulon to guard the Katarn house.
Blotho was a Gamorrean mercenary working for Jerec in 5 ABY. He was a cousin of Brollo.
Rogg was a male Tusken Raider who succeeded KkH'Oar'Rrhr as leader of the Grave Tuskens, a swoop gang of Tusken mercenaries in service to the Dark Jedi Maw.

A male Tusken Raider, Bordo was one many Tuskens to be recruited by the Galactic Empire affiliated Dark Jedi Maw. Originally from the planet Tatooine, Bordo was a follower of the Tusken Jedi A'Sharad Hett.

Kine was a male Human TIE pirate active during the Galactic Civil War. A former captain of the Imperial Navy, Kine continued to aid his former Imperial comrades during their crusades against the fledgling New Republic.
Pel Talon was a Force-sensitive Human male Imperial senator who was in the lines to be promoted to the rank of Grand Moff under Emperor Palpatine's Galactic Empire.
Briggs was a Human male stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, he served alongside Cadet Leader Kyle Katarn's platoon in the assault on AX-456.
Lek was a male Human who served as the assistant Huntmaster in the Great Hunt during the Cold War.
A Rodian male, Slyder operated as a bounty hunter several years until 1 BBY, who based his entire operation out of the luxury cruiser Star of Empire.

Ris Waller was a Human male who served as a member of the same Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Waller worked with Rebel agent Jan Ors, Rosco Ross and A-Cee on the luxury liner Star of Empire.
Rosco Ross was a muscular Human male who served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Horst was a Human male who served as an officer with the rank of major for the Galactic Empire during 0 BBY. The officer was stationed on the Imperial held planet Danuta, located in the Mid Rim.

Grif Grawley was a Human male farmer who lived on the moon Sulon with his wife Carole and their daughter Katie. When the Grawleys became involved in an anti-Imperial demonstration, the Empire retaliated by burning their home in an attack that killed Katie and scarred Carole.
Horley was a Human male smuggler who lived at Fort Nowhere on Ruusan during the Galactic Civil War.
Byron Devo III was a corpulent Human male smuggler who served as the mayor of Fort Nowhere during the Galactic Civil War.
Lieutenant Marie Peeno was a Human female smuggler who lived in Fort Nowhere during the Galactic Civil War.
Lasko was a Human male settler from Sulon who migrated to Ruusan during the Galactic Civil War.
Purdy M. Trico was a Human male who served as the captain of an Imperial Star Destroyer that would later be renamed the Crynyd during the Galactic Civil War.

Alfonso Luiz Obota, also known as Al, was a Human male native of the Adega system. A graduate of the Merchant Academy, Obota joined the Rebel Alliance and became the Second Officer on the Alliance Special Operations transport Pride of Aridus.
He was member of a group of Bouncers who witnessed the invasion of Ruusan by Jerec, an Imperial Warlord who coveted the Force nexus of the Valley of the Jedi found on that planet.

A trainer of Tumble Bunnies found work as an entertainer on the Forest Moon of Endor. They were popular with the woklings of Bright Tree Village. In 3 ABY, the Tumble Bunny trainer hosted a Tumble Bunny exhibition at the Bright Tree Fête for a wokling audience.
Jadru was a female enchantress of a feline species who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. She dwelled in an elaborate lair a short distance from an Ewok settlement known as Bright Tree Village.

Teebo's fish friend was a sentient talking fish native to the Forest Moon of Endor. The fish took a home in a lake on the forest moon sometime before or during the Rebellion era, and had an encounter with King Elbo at one point, perhaps even going to the king's Coral Castle at…
Bilbob the Mystic was a fortune teller of thin, purple-skinned species at Horville's Hut of Horrors on the Forest Moon of Endor.
Ch'thoqua was once a Tusken Raider from the planet Tatooine, until his entire tribe was wiped out by Imperial troops.
The guardian of the sun crystal was a sapient monster that dwelt within the Black Cavern on the forest moon of Endor.
Boogutt was a Dulok prince, the son of Gorneesh and Urgah and a member of Gorneesh's tribe of Duloks who lived in a swamp village near the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village.
Mount Sorrow was a mountain on the Forest Moon of Endor. The tip of the mountain was in fact sentient, and had the power to both blow people off the summit, or cry tears of healing.

The Black Cavern was a sentient cave on the Forest Moon of Endor. It contained sun crystals, which, on occasion, had been stolen from the cavern. In 3 ABY, the Ewok Wicket Warrick mistakenly broke the sun crystal that had been a symbol for the Ewoks for around a hundred years.

Zol was a member of a crew of green-skinned sapients who came to the forest moon of Endor in a Factory ship. Along with Rok, he used the indigenous foonars in an attempt to harvest lumber with the crew's harvester. The plan was stopped by the Ewoks.

Rok was a member of a crew of green-skinned sapients who came to the forest moon of Endor in a factory ship. Along with Zol, he used the indigenous foonars in an attempt to harvest lumber with the crew's harvester. The plan was stopped by the Ewoks.
Laeca Valorum was a politician and member of House Valorum. The Valorums were a highly regarded political dynasty that stretched back to over 1000 years before the Battle of Yavin.

The politician Tullius Valorum was a member of House Valorum, a renowned political dynasty that began over 1000 years prior to the Battle of Yavin. Alongside Tullius, the Valorum lineage included figures such as Tarsus and Laeca Valorum.
Selnia Trigg was a native of the planet Alderaan, a personal page for Senator Bail Organa and, through him, one of the earliest members of the Rebel Alliance.
Darth Vader's valet was an assassin and a telekinetic who worked for Darth Vader. He and two other assassins accompanied Vader to Aargau to kill the finance minister of the Rebellion, Viscount Tardi.
Darth Vader's secretary was in reality a shapeshifting assassin who accompanied Darth Vader to Aargau, along with two other assassins, to kill Viscount Tardi.
Stormtrooper X was the alias of a Human male mercenary who ran a pirate gang in the Outer Rim Territories.
Keoulkeech was an Ewok shaman and the older brother of Leektar.
Chesea was a female Ewok, and wife of Leektar, with whom she mothered three woklings. She and presumably all three of her children were killed in an fire in Red Bush Grove, their home village.

Vance Rego was a member of the Cilpari Resistance in 4 ABY. He was supposed to meet Winter—the New Republic case officer for Cilpar—and obtain aid in fighting the Imperials. He was also working for the local Imperial Moff, Boren Tascl, as a double agent.

CL-33/890, or simply Nine-Oh, was a clone trooper 2nd Lieutenant in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He worked with Four-One, Seven-Four, and Eight-Three on a LAAT/i gunship during the Battle of Haruun Kal, operating the navigation system.

Eight-Three, designated CT-014/783, was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He served as a gunner on a LAAT/i along with Seven-Four during the Battle of Haruun Kal.

Ne Thruska was a male Bothan pilot in the Rebellion with unparalleled skill. He was trained from an early age as a spy, as was the tradition of his race, and because of this he developed a sense of paranoia that rivaled most in the Alliance.
Climber was the clone commando captain of Ion Team in the 22nd Air Combat Wing during the Clone Wars.
Trace was a clone commando and the small-arms expert of Ion Team in the 22nd Air Combat Wing during the Clone Wars.
Ras was a clone commando of Ion Team in the 22nd Air Combat Wing during the Clone Wars.
Idis was a Human male mercenary who served as a member of the Vibroblade Brigade during the Clone Wars.
Gyr Keela was a male Mrlssi who taught at the Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy during the Galactic Civil War. He was known for his beautiful yellow and red facial plumage.
Nera Dantels was a Human female smuggler and captain of the freighter Starduster who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
TK-664 was a stormtrooper during the time of the New Republic. He was stationed at the Cairn Installation and was killed by Kyle Katarn.
Nevo was a former Imperial assassin whose team slaughtered an entire crowd of innocent bystanders while seeking their target.

Fraal was a doglike humanoid companion of Nevo and traveled with him in search of Boba Fett after their executions were commuted by Darth Vader. Fraal specifically was like the Bloodhound and could sniff Fett out (on foot).

Abal Karda was a Human male who served as a colonel in the Imperial Army's Lightning Battalion. A well-respected soldier by his troops, Karda earned recognition for his service in the grueling Icarii Campaign on Vestar, which ultimately resulted in the extermination of the ent…
Nim was a pudgy Imperial general in the Lightning Battalion.

Selestrine was an Icarii Queen and sorceress with precognitive powers captured by the Imperial Lightning Battalion during the Icarii Campaign on Vestar. Selestrine's long hair was intricately woven with jewelry and precious stones worth billions of credits.
Weggit Arpor was a male Human who represented the Tenloss Syndicate's operations within the Vergesso Asteroids.
Mora was a female Human who was heir to the monarchy on M'haeli. She was quite skilled in repairing machinery of all types, from speeders to droids, to cybernetic limbs.

Ch'no was a male H'drachi who joined the Rebel Alliance. A scrounger and collector of junk, he adopted an infant Human named Mora after finding her in the rubble of her ruined home after her family was killed.
Wialu was a human female and leader of the Fallanassi who used the White Current to create a "phantom fleet" which aided the New Republic in its defeat of the Yevethans.

Fiolla, more formally Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla of Lorrd, was an executive in the Corporate Sector Authority. She started off her career in the Authority on Etti IV while still a university student when she helped capture a fugitive holostar.

Kraaken was the Deputy Commander of the Aquaris Freeholders, a notorious smuggling and pirate gang, serving as the right-hand man of Freeholder leader Silver Fyre during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Tork Winger was a male Human Imperial Governor of Garos IV. When the Empire forced a peace during a fierce civil war on Garos IV, they placed Tork Winger as the Governor. He was a respected local politician who tried to find a middle ground between the Imperials and the locals.
Kazan was a who captained the RS Revenge, a cruiser that served in the Rebel Alliance's fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
LaTor was a male fallen Jedi in service to Lord Kaan and his Brotherhood of Darkness.

Zevulon Veers, called Zev for short, was the eldest Human son of Imperial Army General Maximilian Veers and a defector to the Rebel Alliance. Veers lost his mother at a young age, causing him to be strictly raised as a loyal Imperial youth by his father.

Nick Rostu was a Korun male who fought in the Summertime War, the Clone Wars, and the Galactic Civil War. He was a nidôsh (clan-child, or orphan) of Ghôsh Rostu. Like all Korunnai, he was Force-sensitive.

Brother Mabob was a member of the Ancient Order of Pessimists on Maryx Minor. A particularly zealous pessimist, Mabob begged the head of his order, the High Hermit, not to admit the Enemy of the Empire Abal Karda when he arrived at the hermitage seeking sanctuary and pursued b…
Boog was a Near-Human trader who served aboard the Port-Esta Queen during the Imperial campaign against the Icarii on Vestar.

Lumus was a former Imperial assassin condemned to death for his part in a brutal massacre. However, his sentence was commuted by Darth Vader along with those of Nevo, Fraal, and Gann so that they could follow Boba Fett along his hunt of Abal Karda.

Tsumo was a male of a sentient species, and a captive of the bounty hunter Boba Fett in 1 ABY. Having been wanted dead or alive, Tsumo was initially kept living by Fett, but when the bounty hunter encountered the ZZ-class freighter Mingula while en route to Imperial Center, he…

Nuubsal the Hutt was the slave pen overseer on board the Consolidations Unlimited starship Tarnta's Fang. He belonged to a clan which was on the losing end of an extended intra-Hutt conflict, its survivors were scattered throughout the galaxy.

Talbot was a captain in the Galactic Republic Navy in 21 BBY, during the Clone Wars. He commanded the Acclamator-class assault ship Arrestor, which responded to the clone commando team Delta Squad's distress call during their investigation of the Republic Navy assault ship Pro…

Tarnta Bane was an opportunistic smuggler who formed the slaving group Consolidations Unlimited. He took advantage of the chaos caused by the Galactic Civil War, and gathered a small army of equally ruthless scum to carve out his own little criminal empire.
Kugg was a green-skinned, porcine, non-Human male who acted as dictator of the planet Dodz. He referred to himself as governor, and grew angry when not called by that title.
Qelah Kwaad was a Master Shaper of the shaper caste. The Domain sister of Mezhan Kwaad, Kwaad was constantly forced to make up for Mezhan's heresy.

Pello Scrambas was a lieutenant in the service of the Royal House of Alderaan. Scrambas's father was Tash Scrambas, the captain of the Qel-Droma, who served Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth during the Alderaan Ascendancy Contention.
Kitik Keed'kak was a Yam'rii female from the planet Huk.
Treva Horme was a Lutrillian Female and the primary saleswoman and executive planner for Planet Dreams, Incorporated. Her duties included accounting and the monitoring of production schedules.

Wiorkettle was a Snivvian on Cloud City during Lando Calrissian's administration. He worked for Planet Dreams, Incorporated, a company that terraformed asteroids and inhospitable planets and used them to create habitable atmospheres.

Cecius was a lieutenant of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. A native of the planet Vogel 7 and formerly of the Imperial Army, Cecius served as a bridge officer aboard Darth Vader's personal flagship, the Super Star Destroyer Executor.
B'olba was a male Quarren who served as an aide to Senator Tikkes during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Tracton was a male Quarren scientist who served as an assistant to Senator Tikkes of Mon Calamari during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Delurin was a tall, powerfully built Human male. He was a Moff.

Taj Junak was a male Human Jedi Knight and a noble of the Tapani Pelagian bloodline. Serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the final years of both institutions, Junak survived the early years of the Great Jedi Purge, taking refuge within the Freeworlds Territ…
CSL (SEE eh sel) Danenberger was a Force-sensitive Human from the planet Kyrouac.
Rei was a Nagai guard assigned to the Dark Lady Lumiya's base alongside Mendo and Taru on Kinooine, during the early days of the Nagai invasion of the galaxy.
Taru was a Nagai guard assigned to the Dark Lady Lumiya's base alongside Mendo and Rei on Kinooine, during the early days of the Nagai invasion of the galaxy.
Mendo was a Nagai guard assigned to the Dark Lady Lumiya's base on the planet Kinooine, alongside fellow Nagai Taru and Rei.
Taikotelai Akikoma or "Tai" was a male Nagai soldier during the Nagai–Tof War.
Unknown to Sho, Siva had been captured by Tof forces who were forcing the Nagai commander to set his people up for an ambush.
Bioto was a male Koorivar smuggler from Murkhana, serving as the captain of the Dead Ringer and a rival of Cash Garrulan.
Skeck Draggle was the first mate of the Drunk Dancer. He belonged to the same six-fingered, lanky, severe-faced humanoid species as Archyr Beil.
Archyr Beil was the security chief of the Drunk Dancer. He belonged to the same six-fingered, lanky, severe-faced humanoid species as Skeck Draggle.
Eyl Dix was a female communications expert aboard the Drunk Dancer. She belonged to a sharp-eared, dark green-skinned humanoid species that possessed two pair of antennae.
Nasta was a humanoid in charge of the local underground on Mrlsst, during the early years of the New Republic.
Siadem Forte was a male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Deran Nalual was a female Togruta Padawan serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Klossi Anno was a female Chalactan Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the final years of the Republic.
Iwo Kulka was a male Ho'Din Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Jambe Lu was a Human male serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Holding no official rank within the Order, Lu had failed out of the Jedi Temple's academy and been placed within the Agricultural Corps.

Nam Poorf was a Human male serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Holding no official rank within the Order, Poorf had failed out of the Jedi Temple's academy and been placed within the Agricultural Corps.

Jarik Solo was a street urchin from Nar Shaddaa who claimed to be a long lost relative of Han Solo. Han soon discovered that was not true, but he liked the boy, and perhaps because of his skills, worshipful demeanor toward Han, or sympathy of his past, Han let Jarik tag along …
Barbo was a small-time Gran vendor in Mos Espa in 32 BBY who owned a mechanical shop and dealt generally with podracer parts such as fuel converters and servo control systems.
Maritan Kas was a Kiffar, and member of the Kiffu Guardians, who flew Quinlan Vos to Kiffex during his Anzati-related investigation there.

Yongti was a princess of a Nightsister clan on the planet Dathomir. During a raid to steal males of breeding suitability from a rival clan, she tried to capture Jedi Knight Quinlan Vos, who was masquerading as a slave.
Ros Lai was a female Human hybrid who was a member of the Nightsisters that lived on the planet Dathomir.

Yani was a Nightsister of Dathomir. After discovering fellow clanswoman Ros Lai was mysteriously healed of her deformities, she became terrified of Ros Lai's vengeance after she quickly and brutally murdered another sister, Leela.

Leela was a female Dathomirian Witch who worked as a nurse to the clan leader Zalem on Dathomir. When she and two others found out Ros Lai's true identity in 31 BBY, Leela asked Lai to forgive her. Lai did so, but later killed her.

Pule was a female Neimoidian who worked in the customs office of Pelek Baw, the capital city of Haruun Kal, in 22 BBY. She was to inspect Jedi Master Mace Windu, but he bribed her with two ten-credit coins.
Phootie was a male Pho Ph'eahian comedian who traveled during the Clone Wars with a Kitonak to Haruun Kal. On this trip, he traveled in the same shuttle as Mace Windu during the Jedi's mission there.

Quaffug the Hutt was a crime lord on Blimph 3, the self-styled Overboss of Blimph. Quaffug lost his Ceramo-Werx manufacturing facility to Lando Calrissian in a game of sabacc, which resulted in the ruin of his criminal empire.

Skosef was a Human male general in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army. By 1 BBY, Skosef had joined a plot led by Grand Moff Trachta to overthrow the two Sith Lords leading the Empire, Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader.
Varko was a Human male who served as an admiral for Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Malak's Sith Empire during the final year of the Jedi Civil War.
Cazne'olan was a Twi'lek and was one of the leaders of the Olan Clan in the city of Kala'uun on Ryloth.

Zekka Thyne, known to some as "Patches" due to the blue mottling of his skin, was a half-Human, half-alien, who was regarded as one of the most vicious associates in the Black Sun criminal organization.
Vandalor was a Chiss male bounty hunter who once shared a romantic relationship with the Dark Acolyte Sev'rance Tann before she chose to apprentice under Count Dooku during the Clone Wars.
Sigit Ranth was an male scientist who was involved in the plot to sabotage Emperor Palpatine's clone bodies, leading to his final death on Onderon.
Gann was a former Imperial assassin condemned to death for his part in a brutal massacre.

Cheryl Trinja was a Force-sensitive Human. She was orphaned on a lightly-populated farming planet when her parents were killed during Imperial military action. She grew up alone in a forest, where her natural Force ability manifested itself in unusual ways.

Cash Garrulan was a Twi'lek male who was once a former Black Sun Vigo until he became the most powerful crime lord on Murkhana. His hideout was located in the basement of an abandoned building to the south of Murkhana City.
Jen Shryne was a Human male from Weytta and a loyal citizen of the Galactic Republic. He and his wife Jula Shryne had a son, Roan Shryne, who like his mother was Force-sensitive.
Jula Shryne was a Human female from Weytta and the smuggler captain of the Drunk Dancer.

Guania was a Wookiee who lived on the planet Kashyyyk at the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY. In that year, Jedi Masters and clone troopers of the Galactic Republic came to the Wookiee world and helped its inhabitants resist an assault by the Separatist Droid Army in one of th…
Brudi Gayn was a Human male and freelance pilot.
Cudgel was a Human male who worked as a translator and facilitator among the Wookiees of Kashyyyk during the final years of the Galactic Republic and into the era of the New Order.

Celana Aldrete was a Human female from Alderaan and an aide of Bail Organa during the early days of the Galactic Empire. She may have been related to Agrippa Aldrete, an aide of Senator Bail Antilles during the time of the Invasion of Naboo, and Alya Aldrete, a noblewoman.
Bol Chatak was a female Zabrak Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Jally was a muscular and extensively tattooed Human male who worked as the right-hand man and bodyguard of Cash Garrulan on Murkhana. He used a DC-17. In 19 BBY, he assisted Jedi Master Roan Shryne and Padawan Olee Starstone, who were trying to flee from Order 66.

Dif Istuvi was a hierophant of the religion known as Cosmic Balance, and was largely responsible for that religion's expansion on Bakura. Istuvi also wrote the Fulcrum, the Cosmic Balance's holy text, and established the Zanazi, an order of priest-prophets of the Cosmic Balance.

The Progenitor was a massive firaxan shark that lived in the Hrakert Rift of Manaan. The native Selkath believed that she may be a legendary figure in their mythology of the same name, who was the ancestor of their species as well as the firaxan sharks.

Ardax was a male Human colonel of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army who served as second-in-command to the Ambassador Furgan. He also commanded the Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser Vendetta. Ardax was killed when the Vendetta was destroyed during the Battle of Anoth.

Jesmin Ackbar was a female Mon Calamari and the niece of the famed Admiral Gial Ackbar who chose to embark on a career as a pilot for the New Republic; however, prior to her placement in Wraith Squadron, Jesmin rarely saw combat from the cockpit of a starfighter.
Bwa'lass was a male Selkath who lived in Ahto City during the time of the Jedi Civil War. Serving as an Arbiter, he was appointed by the Ahto High Court for various cases.

Galas was a young Force-sensitive male Selkath who lived during the time of the Jedi Civil War. He, along with his friend Shasa and many other Selkath youth, was taken in by the Sith in an attempt to subvert the Manaan government.
Kono Nolan was a Human male scientist who worked for the Galactic Republic on Manaan during the time of the Jedi Civil War.

Marko Tyne was a Zygerrian active during the Galactic Civil War, who conducted unlicensed slavery in nine of Thesme sector's star systems at some point prior to 0 ABY. For these acts, he was wanted by Thesmian authorities.
Sunry was a Galactic Republic soldier who fought in the Great Sith War alongside Jolee Bindo. It was in that war that he won the Hero's Cross for his bravery, and received a crippling injury.

Skinker was a Human male salvage yard owner on the planet Feriae Junction, who became acquainted with notorious bounty hunter Beilert Valance in 0 ABY. A committed hater of droids, Valance paid Skinker handsomely to acquire scavenged automatons for him to destroy.
Ana, was a female, who was accused of being drunk. When she was affected by Sense Force, she would rant about disturbances in the Force.
Elora was a female Human who lived on Manaan during the Jedi Civil War. She was the longtime wife of the crippled former Galactic Republic soldier and war hero Sunry.

Tyler Lucian was a Human male Rebel soldier who deserted from the Alliance in 0 BBY. While stationed in the Yavin system, Lucian was present when the Imperial Death Star superweapon appeared in the immediate run-up to the Battle of Yavin.
Isaru Omin was a Force-sensitive Human male who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was rejected by the Jedi Order due to his age and later served as a Senate Guard.
Brolis was a Clone Commander who served in the Grand Army of the Republic after the start of the Clone Wars, and was one of the few survivors in the disastrous Battle of Axion.

Onnelly Praji was the daughter of Tannon Praji, the First Minister of the Coruscant Ministry of Ingress. In 19 BBY, she and her family were to be relocated to the "Emerald Splendor Estates" on the planet Byss for a short time as part of a recolonization effort.
Jess Allashane was a veteran soldier of the Alliance Special Forces during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Jerrol Blendin was a Wing Guard on Bespin.
Hatirma Havighasu was a male smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Bochaba was a male Hutt crime lord on the planet Sleheyron around the time of the Jedi Civil War. He gained notoriety when he took possession of an HK-series assassin droid with the designation HK-47.

Several weeks later, Wankle's Star Destroyer once again encountered the Chubby Gundark. This time, Captain Bung allowed Wankle to confiscate his last remaining crate of Bantha Breakfast Biscuits without argument.
An alien worked as a salesman for Acme Droid Service in the city of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine in 0 BBY.
The Rock Wizard was a powerful wizard who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. He resided in a large fortress that towered over a fair stretch of land.
Hodidiji was a New Republic Senator during the Black Fleet Crisis.

Silus was a Force-sensitive Drovian. Strong in the Force, Silus competed in pit fights on an unknown Outer Rim world. His strength made him almost unbeatable, and his expressed goal was to make enough credits to get off the planet.
Trey Duna was a male Human who served as the mayor of Galactic City on Coruscant during the time of the Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, and New Republic.
Dreyba was considered a great Hutt artist.

Vill Goir was a Human Dark Side Adept in the service of the cloned Emperor Palpatine during the Galactic Civil War. A member of the Dark Side Elite, Goir was the organization's second-in-command, subordinate only to its leader, Military Executor Sedriss QL.
Utric Sandov was a male Bothan spy who worked for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Darth Bandon was a Human male Jedi Padawan who defected to the Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War, a conflict initiated by the Sith Lords Darth Revan and Darth Malak.

The wife of Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, Lady Thalassa Tarkin was a Human female of the influential Motti family of Phelarion. Wilhuff Tarkin married Thalassa for power, not for love—he had an affair with Natasi Daala while he was still married.
Zindra Daine was a female Human Corellian pilot and daughter to Cubber Daine, former mechanic to Wraith Squadron, a New Republic starfighter and commando unit.
Sharr Latt was a Human male from the planet Coruscant and a member of Wraith Squadron during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Tilath Keer was a Commenorian female pilot in Twin Suns Squadron, serving under first Luke Skywalker, and later Jaina Solo as Twin Suns Eleven.

Beelyath was a Mon Calamari pilot during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Originally a shuttle pilot, he was brought into Twin Suns Squadron to pilot the B-wing that served as mobile command base for Sharr Latt to control the Goddess missile on the recommendation of Jagged Fel.

Scerra Horn was the wife of Jedi Nejaa Halcyon. She was the mother of Valin Halcyon. After the death of her first husband and the rise of the Empire, Scerra married her husband's friend Rostek Horn and had her son's name changed to Valin Horn (nicknamed "Hal"), all in an effor…

Alaric was a male Sephi and the king of Thustra during the Clone Wars. He was a friend of Jedi Grand Master Yoda for some 200 years, despite their friendship being somewhat strained by the demanding nature of their positions.
Damon Krell was a Human male Admiral in the Imperial Navy in command of a Star Destroyer shortly after the Battle of Hoth.
Rad Torlent was a Rebel junior officer serving aboard a CR90 corvette during the Galactic Civil War. A native of Neutra Four, Torlent joined the Rebels after the Galactic Empire seized his homeworld.

Klo Merit was an Equani male from Equanus, who was a trained physician and, due to the empathic abilities possessed by all Equani, he was also a minder. Merit also helped Jos Vondar on Drongar as a physician pretending to be an ally of the Republic.

Roons Sewell was a general in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and a former actor. He was one of the early commanders of Massassi Station. Known for his courage and devotion, Sewell was admired by those under his command, including General Jan Dodonna.
Mala Tinero was a Human female who lived on Gus Talon, a moon of Corellia, in 2 BBY. An apt mechanic, she lived and worked with her father, Rallo, who was a clandestine supporter of the Rebellion.

Hodo was a pilot of the New Republic Defense Fleet who commanded Black Flight of the 24th Bombardment Squadron, attached to the Fifth Battle Group. Hodo was in constant competition with Esege Tuketu for squadron command.

Bo Vanda was a female practitioner of Sith alchemy in the old Sith Empire. She enjoyed torturing and performing cruel experiments on captured enemies, especially Jedi, and this contributed to her immense knowledge of alchemy.
Kla was a humanoid male Sith Lord from the time after the Great Hyperspace War.
Rin Shuuir was a Sith sorcerer active around 4000 BBY. At one point, he accompanied the Sith warrior Utris, who became incapacitated.
Lucien Draay was a Jedi Master during the era of the Mandalorian Wars who, in 3964 BBY, helped perpetrate the infamous Padawan Massacre of Taris.
Dasariah Kothos was a male Human Dark Jedi who was one of the high-ranking cult members of the Disciples of Ragnos.
Vil Kothos was a Human male Dark Jedi who was a high-ranking cult member of the Disciples of Ragnos.
Mathal was a male Human who was employed as a Black Sun agent during the Clone Wars. He oversaw the pan-galactic criminal organization's bota smuggling operations on Drongar.
Filba the Hutt was quartermaster for the Galactic Republic forces. He worked on Jabiim and Drongar.
Ame Llom was an Near-Human alien female from the planet Coruscant who frequented the Outlander Club on her homeworld during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Rruurrfhurra was a Wookiee firefighter from Rwookrrorro, on Kashyyyk. During the Clone Wars, Rruurrfhurra served as coordinator of the firefighters in his home city.
Turren Lonarr was the president of Temporary Droids. He worked on Kashyyyk delivering droids during the Clone Wars.
Porgo Goo was a short, plump, furry native of Chortose.
Shlith-dan was a male Arcona with dark gray skin striated with brown streaks. He was addicted to salt and his golden eyes attested to this.

The father of the Otolla Gungan Jar Jar Binks was a Gungan male. Both of Binks' parents had died by 32 BBY. When Binks's clumsiness caused an accident, Boss Rugor Nass lessened his punishment out of respect for Binks's parents. The memory of his father saddened him.

Kelly Vermillion was a Human-Orlak halfbreed of slight build, with red hair and light red fur on his extremities. He had pointy ears and a prehensile "nasty-looking" tail. He stood roughly five-and-a-half feet tall, or 1.67 meters.

Sheebla was a Gungan warrior-woman who was the true love of George R. Binks. Unfortunately, as she was infertile, he forced himself to marry another woman, as an heir was more important to him than love.

Krelman was a lonely humanoid who lived on the desert world of Tatooine. During the Galactic Civil War, after the destruction of the first Death Star, Krelman visited Chalmun's Cantina and became infatuated with Ackmena, a bartender who worked the nighttime hours.
Jes was a young Human female pilot who served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Rel Farley was a male who served as the assistant manager of the Brodsport Mining Corporation in Trid, on Danuta. He was also a sympathizer for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Uwlla Iillor was one of the few female Human officers in the Imperial Navy. She served as captain of the Black Asp, an Interdictor cruiser.

Uda-Khalid was a humanoid mass killer active during the Great Peace of the Republic. The criminal murdered members of a wide range of species in pursuit of power, but was able to escape justice due to his policy of never leaving survivors, which erased any evidence of his acti…

Karoc a Human male was the twin brother of Vinoc and a Dark Acolyte of Count Dooku during the Clone Wars. He and his brother Vinoc were both assigned by Count Dooku to protect the cortosis droid factories on Metalorn.

Zana was a female Human living on Belderone during the Galactic Civil War. During the Clone Wars, Zana had a romance with a Jedi Knight named Flint Torul who was posted to Belderone—the two conceived a son, also called Flint, before Torul was killed in battle by General Grievous.

Jordo was a male Human from Telos IV who served as a soldier with the Republic Military, serving alongside Carth Onasi for a time. However, while Carth stayed on with the fleet after the devastation of Telos, Jordo left, taking a job with Czerka Corporation.
