Caal Jordan was a Human male scientist who worked for the Galactic Republic during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, he was assigned to Hrakert Station on the planet Manaan where he developed a sonic weapon for use against Firaxan sharks.
Sami was a Human female scientist who was living on Manaan during the time of the Jedi Civil War.
Polyp was a blue-skinned alien who lived on the Outer Rim world Feriae Junction during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Q-Varx was a Mon Calamari that represented the Calamari sector in the New Republic Senate. Q-Varx was a leader of the Rationalist Party on the planet Dac.

Mokka Falanthas was Minister of State for the New Republic during the Empire Reborn insurgency and Black Fleet Crisis. When Leia Organa Solo disappeared to rescue her kidnapped children, Falanthas took over her duties to keep the government running.
Gron Marrab was a male Mon Calamari senator. He represented Calamari sector in the New Republic Senate and its Galactic Alliance successor. He served on the Council on Security and Intelligence.

Galen Derlin was a Human male senator who represented Tiisheraan in the Galactic Senate during the final years of the Galactic Republic, and was a close associate of Bail Organa. After the rise of Emperor Palpatine, Derlin resigned his post and withdrew from politics.

Spy 189, or Red as he was known to the Rebellion was a Proliferan operative sent by the Proliferan Empire to discover and evaluate other empires near them. During his travels, he learned much about Humans and the Rebellion itself.

Tyric was a Shaliz'Na from the forested planet of Shar'Ack who loved to play music. He was roughly 2.14 meters tall and very muscular with a twelve-foot wingspan, talon-like fingernails, black hair, and light down covering skin.

Nana was a member of the mysterious shape-changing race known as Homanans. She was able to change her shape to anything from the size of a Wookiee to that of an Ewok, but rarely changed her personality. She almost always seemed loving and carefree.

x: Po Ruddle Lingsnot was an alien used–cloud car salesman who was elected to the Council of Tourism and Extra-Planetary Investment of his home city, Cloud City on the planet Bespin.
Hari Seldona was an Alderaanian poet who wrote many famous odes about the planet Alderaan, and was so famous that she traveled among the galaxy reading them to any who would listen.

Com Fordox was the senator of the Corellian sector during the crises of the Eriadu Trade Summit and Blockade of Naboo. After Supreme Chancellor Valorum was attacked, he visited Valorum along with Bail Antilles, Palpatine, and Orn Free Taa.

Silvu Donte was a male Advozse who was a member of the Zorzsin family during the final years of the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, he represented his homeworld Riflor in the Galactic Senate until he and his people joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Zardra was a tall bounty hunter with long, dark hair.

Omeesh was a Hutt who lived on Sleheyron at some point prior to the Jedi Civil War. He enjoyed torturing his slaves. He was eventually murdered by one of them, a Twi'lek girl named Yuthura Ban, who stabbed him in his bedchamber.
Karoly D'ulin was a member of the mysterious militaristic order of female warriors known as the Mistryl Shadow Guards.
Billan was a male Human employee of the Czerka Corporation.
Senni Vek was a male green-skinned Twi'lek bounty hunter who worked for GenoHaradan Overseer Ithorak Guldar in Ahto City on Manaan during the Jedi Civil War.
Ithorak Guldar was a Selkath Overseer of the GenoHaradan during the Jedi Civil War.
Vorn Daasraad was a Gamorrean Overseer of the GenoHaradan during the Jedi Civil War. He was always accompanied by his trusted assault droid, the two making a deadly pair.
Gurke was a Gamorrean living in Anchorhead on Tatooine during the time of the Jedi Civil War. He often spent time in search of Krayt dragons to kill.
Chanchaz Iryt was a male member of a sentient species who was Zhen Mirat's chief lieutenant and co-founder of The Fatal Visionaries.
Cyra Feliz was the wife of the free-trader Vazan Felix.

Pollo Tipn was a Devaronian history student and pupil of Voren Na'al. Nearly ten years after the destruction of Mount Tantiss, Na'al enlisted Tipn to join him in a confidential fact-finding mission to the Kathol sector, investigating for Mon Mothma some unusual reports connect…

Jurec Tre was a male Spiner criminal imprisoned on the Spice Mines of Kessel for several counts of murder on Corulag. He was the toughest and most aggressive prisoner in his block and a natural bully. He had intimidated a small group of prisoners to act as his personal thugs.
Quist was a fair-skinned Human male with a blond beard and hair. Streaks of white through his hair were the only indication of his true age. His right hand had been replaced with a knife blade.
Tritos Nal was a humanoid Sith Lord of the old Sith Empire.

Garu was a male humanoid Sith Lord of the Sith Empire who lived during the Empire's final years and fought in the Great Hyperspace War. A warlord on the planet Korriz, Garu was the rival of the Sith Lord known as the Patron.
Polo Se'lab was a male Bothan junior senator who represented the Bothan sector in the Galactic and Imperial Senates.

Gabrial Atanna was a male from the planet Esseles in the Core Worlds. He served as Esseles' senator in the senates of both the Galactic Republic and its successor state, the Galactic Empire, until Emperor Palpatine dissolved the body in 0 BBY.
Sayer Mon Neela was a female Human Bureaucrat of the Galactic Republic and later joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Raan Stasheff was a Human male in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served as the bodyguard of Sayer Mon Neela during the Galactic Civil War. His grandfather had served in CorSec and his father had served in the Alliance since the time of the Battle of Yavin.

Sergus Lanox was a male Human who served as a captain in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. He commanded the Victory-class Star Destroyer Imperial Hazard, and his abilities gained him the respect of both his crew and other officers within the Fleet.
Heedon was a Human male who hated his own first name enough to never use it.
Mak Sezala was a Bothan senator who represented the Bothan sector in the New Republic Senate following Borsk Fey'lya's election to Chief of State.

x: Denetrus, often referred to as Den, was a small-time Human criminal on his native planet, Telos IV. There, he worked for various companies because of his skills with computing, including UniFy, each hiring and subsequently firing him because of how he utilized his abilities to…
Areta Bell was a red-haired Human female native from the planet Corellia, who served in both the Alliance Fleet and the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

Baljos Arnjak was a member of Wraith Squadron during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Skilled in biology, he was stationed at the Borleias garrison after the New Republic seized the planet following the fall of Coruscant to the Yuuzhan Vong.
Cambira Ralle was a Human male from Esseles who was a decorated veteran of the Clone Wars. He later became President of the Esselian Hall and a member of the anti-Imperial Forad Party.
Jamson Freller was a Human male from the planet Esseles and leader of the Esselian New Order Party. He continually opposed Esselian Hall President Cambira Ralle.

Daclif Gallamby was a Human male statesman who was remembered as the last Diktat of the Corellian republic and was Governor-General of the Corellian sector following the death of his predecessor, Dupas Thomree, in the first days of the Galactic Civil War.
Jedidiah was a male Velmoc who hailed from the planet Velmor. Early in his life, he was offered training to become a Jedi Knight, but he refused.
Lorac was the king of the planet Velmor during the era of the rise of the Galactic Empire. The husband of Queen Denira, Lorac fathered two sons, the crown prince Denid and his younger brother Anod.
Loren died in the crash, but Denid and Jedidiah went on to survive for the next two decades in the harsh, wild environment of their new world.
Denid was a Human male who took the throne of the planet Velmor in 3 ABY, after a prolonged succession crisis.

Herat was a female Jawa who was the shaman of Wittin's tribe. She was Wittin's advisor during his negotiations with Jabba the Hutt, and agreed to serve as one of Jabba's retainers as long as he helped Wittin.

Miktha was a male Jawa criminal who lived on the planet Tatooine during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. He joined the gang of the gunslinger Longo Two-Guns when they arrived on Tatooine and managed to bolster their numbers with local muscle.

Thedit was a Jawa who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He organized perimeter patrols for the Jawa Chief Kalit's territory. Thedit kept a watchful eye for krayt dragons, Tusken Raiders, and bandits working for Kalit's rival, Wittin.

Trhin Voss'on't was a stormtrooper commander and commando. He was used as an instrument in the plans of Prince Xizor and Emperor Palpatine to destroy the Bounty Hunters' Guild and further the Bounty Hunter Wars.
Allania Jakien was an eleven-year-old female Human who lived in Cloud City on Bespin. In 3 ABY, she witnessed the climactic battle there between Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader.
Anod was a male Human who served for a time as the crown prince of the planet Velmor during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Captain Traal suspected that Korl Marcus was the sort of hunter whose allegiance was owed to whoever had the most money. She attempted to seduce Korl one evening and offered him a reward if he would agree to assassinate Prince Denid.
Són Halliikeenovich was a Human male hailing from House Halliikeenovich, a lesser noble house perceived as greedy and grasping that hailed from the planet Dramassia in the Juvex sector.
Zelor was a Human male who served as the royal regent under King Lorac and Queen Denira of the planet, Velmor, some 20 years before the Galactic Civil War.
Denira was the queen of the planet Velmor some twenty years before the Galactic Civil War. She was the wife of King Lorac and mother to Prince Denid and Prince Anod.

Yamarus was an admiral in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Commanding the MC80 Star Cruiser Liberty and its task force, Yamarus served in a variety of campaigns against both the Galactic Empire and mercenary forces in 3 ABY.
Vultar the Ugly was a Trandoshan criminal killed by cyborg bounty hunter Gorm the Dissolver many years before the Battle of Yavin. Gorm removed Vultar's left forearm and grafted it onto his own body.

Talesan "Taly" Fry was a Human male from the world of Cirrus who was targeted for assassination by bounty hunters at age ten, a successful businessman, and the owner of an important device that could have potentially decided the fate of the Clone Wars.
Mageye was a Hutt crime lord from the planet of Taboon. In 1 BBY, he was caught in a crossfire between the Thig Brothers and Jodo Kast.
BolBol was the Hutt crime lord in charge of the Stenness System. He occasionally worked with Mageye the Hutt and the Thig Brothers.
Arb Skynxnex was a tall, lanky Human who was Moruth Doole's enforcer on Kessel. He used a specially modified weapon known as a double blaster.
Tine Felix was the daughter of the free-trader Vazan Felix and his wife Cyra Felix.
Vazan Felix was one of the most respectable and likable free-trader in the galaxy.

Freon Drevan was a male Xexto con artist who ran a bootlegging business on his homeworld of Troiken prior to 32 BBY. After he promoted factory worker Niai Fieso to a position as his right–hands Xexto, the two expanded the business into a smuggling operation.
Dia Passik, born Diap'assik, was a female Twi'lek who served as a member of Wraith Squadron during their campaign against the rogue Imperial warlord Zsinj.

Bosbit Matarcher was a Human male from the astronomical object Delemede who, after a relativistic shield malfunction during a brief hyperspace jump aboard a Delemedian starhopper in 222 BBY, found himself two hundred years in the future.
Tenk Lenso was a Human male native of the planet Glova who served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a starfighter pilot during the Galactic Civil War.

Tarn Mison was a Human male from Las Lagon who served as an Imperial pilot and smuggler before defecting to the Rebel Alliance after witnessing the mass execution of colonists on the celestial body Farbinda III by the Empire.

He was born on the planet Tatooine to a family of moisture farmers, and grew up lonely and bitter. His physical differences made the heat from the planet's twin suns unbearable, which often kept him indoors and away from his siblings.

Sakhisakh was a Noghri bodyguard of Leia Organa Solo. He was one of Leia's highest bodyguards. Sakhisakh came from the clan Tlakh'sar. When Han Solo decided to head to Bastion to retrieve the Caamas Document, Sakhisakh recommended to Han to take him, something that was refused.

Barkhimkh was a Noghri warrior, who, with Sakhisakh, was assigned as Leia Organa Solo's bodyguard during the Caamas Document Crisis. He and Sakhisakh accompanied Organa Solo throughout the Crisis, including her journeys to Bothawui and Pakrik Minor.
Ral Yekkiv was a Rebel and an associate of Roger Stern. He met with a group of rebels on Greyman's Planet when they came to meet with Stern.

Roger Stern was the owner of Stern Traders, as well as being a Rebel sympathizer. He was meant to meet with a group of rebels on Greyman's Planet but was unfortunately captured by the Empire when they discovered his rebel ties.

Lieutenant Wes Gevar was a Rebel ULAV pilot stationed at Karinda Outpost. He met with a group of rebels who came to the planet to deliver much needed supplies, but was shot by an Imperial biker scout and wounded so badly that he could not participate in the fight to the base, …
Collus was a Human male who was one of the galaxy's most advanced philosophers.

Tarkov was a male Wookiee woodsmith who lived near the city of Kachirho on the planet Kashyyyk. In 19 BBY, during the Clone Wars, Tarkov stumbled upon a large Separatist invasion army while he was hunting with his son, Jaccoba.

Komm Karsh was a male Yuuzhan Vong warrior holding the rank of Supreme Commander in 28 ABY. Under Supreme Overlord Shimrra Jamaane, the Yuuzhan Vong invaded the galaxy, and Karsh was the leader of the Vong's only strategic buffer in case of a major enemy reprisal.

Plaristes was a philosopher who lived in the time before the formation of the Galactic Republic, over 25,000 years before the Battle of Yavin. In his book Of Minds, Men, and Machines, he argued that droids were incapable of attaining artificial sentience.

Jaccoba was a young Wookiee male who lived near the city of Kachirho on the planet Kashyyyk. In 19 BBY, during the Clone Wars, Jaccoba accompanied his father, Tarkov, on a grantaloupe hunt, during which the pair discovered a Separatist invasion army on Kashyyyk.
Pter Nyklas was a Human male officer who served in the Imperial Navy.

Mitt'swe'kleoni, also known by his core name of Tswek, was a Chiss Aristocra who led a delegation to the Galactic Alliance in 35 ABY, to protest to Cal Omas and the Masters' Council about the Jedi survivors of the Myrkr strike team allying with the Killiks.

Prard'ras'kleoni, otherwise known by his core name of Drask, was a general in the Chiss Defense Fleet, who served as the military counterpart to Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano on the mission to repatriate the survivors of Outbound Flight in 22 ABY.
A male kybuck was owned by Jedi Grand Master Yoda during the last years of the Galactic Republic. It was employed during the earliest and last days of the Clone Wars.
Kalebb Orn worked his entire life on the planet Mechis III on an assembly line. His only job was to occasionally intervene in the completely automated processes of the assembly line.
This Human was present at the victory parade in Theed following the Invasion of Naboo.

Fodesinbeed Annodue, better known as Fode and Beed, was a Troig celebrity podracing announcer. He appeared only at the most prestigious podraces, and commanded an excessive fee. Both heads acted as separate beings, with the red head named Fode and the green head named Beed.
Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn was a Swokes Swokes senator who represented the planet Makem Te in the Galactic Republic Senate around the time of the Invasion of Naboo.
Solipo Yeb was a Human Senator in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate. In 19 BBY, Yeb was one of the many thousands of mourners to attend the funeral of Senator Padmé Amidala on the planet Naboo.

Jak Sazz was an Ab'Ugartte who frequented the Byss Bistro on the Imperial Freight Complex above the planet Byss. Unsociable and unhygienic, Sazz was often mocked and looked down upon by those around him.
Dryanta (meaning "old judge" in Shyriiwook) was a Wookiee and cousin of Chewbacca. During the Imperial occupation of Kashyyyk, Dryanta served in the Wookiee resistance under Katarra.

Fahraark was a male Wookiee associate of Dayla Kev during the Galactic Civil War. Along with his fellow Wookiee Friyahrr, Fahraark shipped a group of Hoojibs to Galactic Horizon to help in Dayla's revenge on Milac Troper.
Freyrr was a Wookiee and second cousin of Chewbacca. During Lumpawarrump's Test of Ascension, Freyrr informed Chewbacca that his friend Han Solo had been captured by the Yevetha.

Friyahrr was a Wookiee slaver, and an associate of Dayla Kev during the Galactic Civil War. Along with fellow Wookiee Fahraark, Friyahrr shipped a group of Hoojibs to Galactic Horizon to help in Dayla's revenge on Milac Troper.
Froera was a female Wookiee who, along with her mother Attiera, was part of the Myyydril tribe shortly before the Clone Wars.

Furellas was a Force-sensitive female Wookiee with light brown fur and shaved shoulders. She was an associate of the Ithorian Kikow and a lieutenant in the Kalmec, a Wookiee criminal organization with rumored ties to the Separatists.
Gaartatha was a Wookiee who worked as a scout during the Galactic Civil War. His partner was captured by Imperial slavers, a fate that the Wookiee barely escaped himself.
Gailid was a Human tax collector, assistant to Mosep Binneed, the Nimbanel accountant in charge of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's affairs in Mos Eisley.
Utris M'Toc was a former member of the High King's Guard on the planet Couronne, but a bloody coup forced him to leave his homeworld.

Opun "Black Hole" Mcgrrrr was the son of Hethra Mcgrrrr, the founder of the Black Hole Pirates. He was also the former owner of the Holiday Towers hotel on Cloud City, though Jabba Desilijic Tiure later took control.

Ahita Othar was a woman affiliated with the Exchange. She owned the Ebon Hawk at one point, and later met a tragic death, an occurrence that helped contribute to the underworld rumor that the Hawk was an unlucky ship.

Forii Haxa was a being affiliated with the Exchange and an owner of the Ebon Hawk. Haxa later met a tragic death, an occurrence that helped contribute to the underworld rumor that the Hawk was an unlucky ship.
Ardon "Vapor" Crell was a Human moisture farmer on the planet Tatooine who had joined the local 253 sector of the Moisture Farmers of Tatooine organization by 4 ABY.

Lars was a member of a pirate group in the Cularin system. They had been hired by Velin Wir to steal high tech supplies from various Cularin trading companies, the pirates keeping any extra loot they took in the process.
Phylo Gandish was a Human female pilot from the planet Naboo. Her family owned a galactic transportation company. From years of travel, Gandish learned many loopholes in spaceport protocol.

Vune Willic was a Human male native to the world of Carida who became an Imperial Intelligence agent during the Galactic Civil War. He was assigned to Imperial Center, where he worked under Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard.

Korval Willic was a male Human spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic on Imperial Center during the time of the Galactic Empire. A resident of the Senate District, Korval claimed to spend all of his credits and time in the Outlander Club.
Cesi "Doc" Eirriss was a female Twi'lek pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Red Squadron prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Jorg Sacul was a native of the planet Tatooine who suffered a near fatal crash on a T-16 skyhopper while on his homeworld, changing his life course.

Boelo was a Human who served in the crime lord Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire on the planet Tatooine. For a time, he served as Jabba's right-hand man, before eventually being replaced by Naroon Cuthus several years before the Battle of Yavin.

Debnoli was a marksman who frequented Chalmun's Cantina in Mos Eisley. He sought revenge on the Galactic Empire for impounding his ship. From time to time, Debnoli worked with Bron Burs, a former commando from the planet Nentan.

R'kik D'nec was a Jawa from the planet Tatooine. At some point by the year 4 ABY, D'nec allegedly encountered a tribe of Tusken Raiders, a herd of angry banthas, and a raging krayt dragon in the Dune Sea, and defeated all of them within minutes, emerging from the Dune Sea with…

Jade, codename Watcher, was a female Mikoan with piercing green eyes, long black hair, and an athletic figure. Every move she made was confident and hinted at the competence and training she has undergone.
Dergar Chester was a male individual who was the Head Technician of the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine and had an assistant named Tarn.
Helm Iskraker was a known small-time criminal. A large Nothoiin with rolling layers of gold-colored skin, he traveled the galaxy in his ship, the Erratic Orbit.

Aran Starfire was a tall, lean Human with silver-red hair by the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was once a soldier in the Galactic Republic army, but retired to the planet Gellefon to escape the madness of the New Order.

He always wore the most regal attire, and his dress uniforms were always perfectly pressed, sparkling clean, and covered with every official decoration he ever received. His steel-gray hair, cold-gray eyes, and pale skin added to his intimidating appearance and mannerisms.
Rievale Creterk was a female flight attendant who witnessed a brawl between Houk and Weequay in Eastport, which was located on the planet Coruscant.

Taki was a member of the Rebel strike team sent to the forest moon of Endor to destroy the second Death Star's shield generator. She carried a portable comm jammer which stopped an Imperial AT-ST from reporting the strike team.

He dressed in the ground assault armor favored by AT-AT commanders. He looked like a formidable Imperial officer; however, while he was a good officer, he had no desire to die needlessly for the Imperial cause.

T'kyl was the chief Lucent navigator and scientist on the Crystal Web Station, though she generally delegated common navigation tasks to her staff. She was usually found wandering around the station, observing the different factions and races the station served.
Chamberlyn was a Human who served as a lieutenant in the Royal Naboo Security Forces during the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo.
Murr Danod was an Ithorian who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic. A smuggler, he worked for a trade guild that operated out of an Ithorian Herdship.

Televan Koreyy was a notorious Human information broker who worked in the city Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine. Koreyy was the leader of the Street Performers And Panhandlers' Guild and kept tight control over its members.

Yade M'rak was a Human Corellian who settled in the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine by 32 BBY. Addicted to gambling on the outcomes of Podraces, he lost the majority of his belongings to the crime lord Gardulla the Hutt.
Grotto Werribee was a Human junior traffic controller for an interstellar shipping corporation. By 32 BBY, he had left that job and began to work as an information broker.

Ingoda, also known as Ingoda the Hutt, was a minor Hutt male crime lord who operated during the last years of the Galactic Republic. A brutal being, Ingoda enjoyed accumulating Theelins—an artistic but increasingly rare species—as slaves.

Yerka Mig was a Human from the planet Ralltiir who became an Imperial officer, pilot, and bureaucrat. When the Galactic Empire subjugated his homeworld in 1 BBY, Mig resigned and fled in remorse, becoming a fugitive from both Imperial Intelligence and the Imperial Security Bur…
Devin Cant was a male Human Death Star trooper, one of the elite soldiers trained in combat techniques and weapon skills onboard the battle station.

Grondorn Muse was a Human member of the Corellian militia, who eventually left and became a popular folk singer before the Galactic Empire blacklisted him for the political content of his songs. By 0 BBY, Muse had joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Keder, also known as Keder the Black, was a highly-paid assassin and spy during the final years of the Galactic Republic. On the planet Coruscant, the capital planet of the Republic, Keder infiltrated the Galactic Senate in the disguise of a Senate Guard.

Merc Sunlet was a human male thief from Tirac Munda. Skilled in multiple languages, Sunlet was often hired by the wealthy for advice on how to keep their own property safe. In the year 0 BBY, Sunlet was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina, and stood near the bar.

Jobin was a Human male who served as a corporal in the military of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was also the son of Mon Mothma, one of the founders of the Alliance, and was brother to Lieda Mothma.

Kara'Teel was a female witch and member of the Singing Mountain Clan of Dathomir. She gave her life while protecting her mother and clan leader Augwynne Djo from the machinations of her older sister Gethzerion.

affiliation: Clawfish Roaming Auction of Illicit and Illegal Weaponry
x: Clawfish was a Quarren outlaw tech who established the Event Horizon cantina on Rrudobar, an orbital city over Duro. He had but one remaining facial tentacle, and became enraged whenever inquired about it.
Prid Shan served Supreme Chancellor Palpatine as a Captain, possibly of the Senate Guard. His concerns over the Chancellor's life gave Darth Sidious the chance to create the Red Guard.
Sheeka Tull was a Human woman who was born in 59 BBY and grew up on Atrivis 7. Her parents were killed in a range war on that world, leaving her orphaned.

Onicrop K'Cin was an Ugnaught male with white hair and light skin from the planet Gentes. He was affiliated with code breakers and the Galactic Podracing Mechanics' Union. The Ugnaught wore a dark gray apron over lighter gray clothing.

Jabrogg Thung was a male Gamorrean with green skin and yellow eyes from the planet Gamorr. By 32 BBY, Thung had become an intergalactic nerf-throwing champion who had mortally injured several nerfs—an herbivorous non-sentient species.

Obees Ramee was a Gran male counterfeiter with orange skin and black eyes from the planet Malastare. By 32 BBY, he was a member of the criminal Meeko Ghintee's thugs who sold counterfeited Galactic Republic credits on the space station known as Outland Station.

Tuba Ancho was a male Aqualish who stole fuel cell shipments from Rozatta's Outland Station, costing her hundreds of credits. In 32 BBY, a bounty worth 3,000 credits alive and 1,500 dead was posted, which was then claimed by Mandalorian-turned bounty hunter Jango Fett.
And-Yees was a Gran male from the planet Malastare. They had black eyes and orange skin. A rogue assassin, And-Yees was affiliated with weapons dealers and fellow assassins.

Bobot Beka was a Klatooinian male who lived during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. A lowly thug, Beka initially worked for an individual named Petson Lizze for some time but by 32 BBY was no longer in her employment.

Odnalor Chull was a male Klatooinian thief who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Kukul the Hutt for repeatedly stealing finished starships from Guarja Shipyards on Nal Hutta.

Eno Arba was an Ualaq Aqualish male thief associated with the criminals Meeko Ghintee and Magro Slim. He had a bounty placed on him by the Toydarian Rozatta for robbing numerous guests in her Outer Rim Territories Outland Transit Station.

Alby Ermad was a male Ugnaught armorsmith whose speciality was designing battle armor suits. Alby Ermand was wanted by Sienar Fleet Systems for stealing architectural designs. He was the accomplice of Artzam Hathan, who was wanted for the same crime.

Boozoo "Bogey" Boga was a male Aqualish bounty hunter hijacker who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He recruited criminals into the Galactic Radicals. He was also known as Boozoo Bogs. He was wanted by the bounty hunter Papeh Blangko.
B'inka Fibuna was a Twi'lek female who, with the help of the Freedom Convoy, escaped from her enslavement from Ka'Pa the Hutt.
Bardack was a male Klatooinian who was wanted by the Republic Security Force for suspected smuggling of narcotics in the Core Worlds.

Yol Areebi was a male Guineo criminal who was alive during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. By 32 BBY, Areebi had worked as a enslaver and was wanted by the Republic Security Force for taking kidnapped members of a native species from the Forest Moon of Endor to be u…
Kip Bunyea, or "The Kip," was a Human male from the planet Naboo with affiliations to data slicers and smugglers. A dead-or-alive bounty on him was posted by Aruk the Hutt no later than 32 BBY.

Natt Bordo was a male Human guard who lived in Desolation Alley during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was wanted by the Hutt Cartel for skimming profits from a smuggling operation. His bounty was collected by the bounty hunter Jango Fett.
"Shank" Ballax was a male Human guard who worked at the prison Desolation Alley during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Frissk was a male Trandoshan who became a prisoner at Desolation Alley on Oovo IV. While there, he started working with the Helmet Squad to skim profits from a clan of Hutts, double-crossing them.

Peez Bonko was a male Gran who was the leader of the Gran supremacists during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted dead by Freedom for the Incarcerated for leading a supremacy group of Gran inmates.

Sann Dekker was a male Human Corellian guard who lived in Desolation Alley during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted dead for 2,000 credits by the Hutts for being an extortionist. His bounty was claimed by Jango Fett who killed the man.

Brawn Dunkee was a male Weequay criminal who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted dead by the Techno Union for kidnapping one of their dignitaries. He was killed by Jango Fett who claimed the bounty.

"Lips" Meyer was a male Gran criminal and resident of Outland Transit Station wanted by the members of Outland Station Sanitary Service Union 233-34 for informing on them in exchange for credits and immunity for his past crimes.

Gabo Tychee was a male Rodian criminal who was employed by Jabba Desilijic Tiure and the Hutt crime syndicate during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. After committing a terrible crime against the Hutts, his bounty was 4,000 credits alive and 2,000 dead.

Magro Slim was a male Klatooinian criminal affiliated with Eno Arba and Meeko Ghintee. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Administrator Rozatta with a bounty of 1,500 credits alive and 750 dead for damaging many of the Outland Transit Station's bathrooms and sanitary facilities.

affiliation: Pepeh Blangko, The Lluch, Admiral Shott
x: Gabo, also known as Gabo the Wicked, was an Aqualish, wanted by the Republic Security Force for indecent exposure and illegal hologram distribution. His bounty was 3,000 credits alive and 1,500 dead.

Artzam Hathan was a male Ugnaught who was a chief engineer at some point. Artzam Hathan was wanted by Sienar Fleet Systems for stealing design schematics and architectural layouts which he intended to sell.

Hatras Nikk was a Human female. She used her charm to attract—and then rob—rich Human visitors. She was wanted for this by Rozatta because it must have been damaging her business. Her bounty, worth 2,000 credits alive and 1,000 dead, was claimed by Jango Fett.

Sobo Leeda was a male Ualaq Aqualish who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. By 32 BBY Leeda lived on the Outland Transit Station in the Baxel sector, where he stole fuel cells from the stations Toydarian administrator Rozatta.
Qualung Tulla was a male Aqualish who worked for Meeko Ghintee during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he wanted by the Toydarian Rozatta for stealing her fuel cell shipments.
Grillo Zammon was a male Aqualish who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Rozatta for stealing her fuel cell shipments.
Bado Karpa was a male Aqualish who worked for Meeko Ghintee during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was wanted by Rozatta for stealing her fuel cell shipments.

UrrOr'Ruur was a Tusken Raider warrior who was part of a group of at least four other Tuskens that, while at the Mos Espa Circuit on the planet Tatooine, hoped to take out podracers and their vehicles during the Boonta Eve Classic.

affiliation: Kram Balut the Dug, Organized Crime Syndicates
x: Jah-kii Vaargaz was a Human female wanted alive by the Republic Security Force for being an informant for many criminal organizations, including a crimelord called Kram Balut the Dug. The bounty was 3000 credits which was claimed by Jango Fett.

Tossk was a male Trandoshan who was wanted dead by Gardulla the Hutt for unknown reasons; though, it was known he worked for Jabba the Hutt, Gardulla's biggest rival. This bounty was claimed by Jango Fett.
Nelia Fry was a female Human who was the mother of Talesan Fry. She was killed by the bounty hunter Magus along with her husband Grove.
Grove Fry was a male Human who was the father of Talesan Fry. He was killed by the bounty hunter Magus along with his wife Nelia.

Nuri was an impoverished Clawdite who lived on the Banking planet of Aargau. Nuri had his finger on the pulse of information, knowing the value of it, and paying good money to have it. He frequently visited the Aargau Undercity where spies congregated to sell information.
Pordimer, often referred to by the name Pordy, was a thin, brown-haired Ugnaught that lived in the artificial city known as Ugnorgrad, one kilometer below Cloud City on the planet Bespin.
Hugo Treece was a male Human who served as an Imperial commander who acted as governor of Cloud City after Darth Vader left the city.
Ars Fivvle, sometimes called A.F., was an Ugnaught of the Isced tribe who lived in the artificial city known as Ugnorgrad, one kilometer below Cloud City on the planet Bespin.
Mart Ringatz was a male Ishi Tib who was wanted by the Republic Security Force for the theft of jewels belonging to Sullustans visiting Dantooine.

Yoland Fee was a male Jedi serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic. Master Fee maintained the gardens of the Jedi Temple until the end of Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems ended in 19 BBY, and the Supreme Chancellor of…
Mien Rumba was a male Sullustan who was a former miner wanted by the SoroSuub Corporation for stealing jewels and selling them off.

Tike Flume was the older brother of Trever Flume. He participated in the resistance movement against the Galactic Empire on the planet Bellassa with his father. In an attempt to prevent the seizure of a defense plant on their homeworld, Tike went off to protest inside the plant.

Kahleeko Sik was a Kadas'sa'Nikto male native to the planet Naboo. An extortion kingpin, he was affiliated with Klatooinian and Nikto street gangs. By 32 BBY, a four thousand credit bounty was placed on Sik, as he wanted dead for extortion by an anonymous originator.
Max Ryko was a Human male living on the planet Coruscant. He served as a police officer with the Coruscant Police Force where he held the rank of captain.
Mill Timmer was a male Human from the planet Corellia who served as an officer with the Coruscant Police Force during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Raim Tibekk was a Human male police officer living on the planet Coruscant. He served in the Coruscant Police Force during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Lye Rooker was a Human male living on the planet Coruscant. He served as a police officer with the Coruscant Police Force where he held the rank of captain.
Stu Hemphawar was a male Human smuggler working in the Core Worlds during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Karsunn Nepto was a Kajain'sa'Nikto criminal wanted by the Republic Security Force for having ties to several prominent crime syndicates. The bounty for his arrest was posted by the Security Force to interrogate him.
Haangok was a male pirate active in the years before 32 BBY. His several ambushes on Commerce Guild convoys yielded the Kajan'sa'Nikto his own bounty.

Dairn Maggli was a small-time Human male smuggler and arms dealer after the Uprising on Naboo. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by the Republic Security Force for hijacking an artillery shipment on its way to Sullust.

Panza Hondi was a male Guineo criminal living in the Industrial District of the planet Coruscant after the Battle of Naboo. During the year 32 BBY, Hondi worked for Haugg Nerf Industries, a death stick manufacturer that disguised itself as a nerf-packing plant.

J'Meeb Gumb was a male Guineo criminal from the planet Dohlban. In 32 BBY, he was working in the Industrial District of the Republic's capital planet of Coruscant at Haugg Nerf Industries, a death stick distributor operating under the guise of a nerf-packaging plant.

Regg Kuuga was a male Draag who was wanted by the Coruscant Police for stealing medical frigates, scrapping parts, and transforming them into tourist-attacking melee ships. In 32 BBY, his bounty was claimed by Jango Fett.

Slaag Lado was a male Draag wanted by the Mon Calamari Civil Authority for creating a seismic shock pulse. In 32 BBY, this created a rift in the Salinrerian Sea, causing large amounts of environmental damage and perpetual rain.

Keezo Stoolee was a male Weequay and a prisoner at the penal colony on Oovo IV. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by the governor Kuchcel of an unknown planet for destroying their millennium celebration. This bounty was claimed by the Mandalorian-turned Bounty hunter Jango Fett.

Wim "Smootie" Smoot was a male Peripleen inmate at Desolation Alley around the time of the Battle of Naboo. He had been there for over 150 years, though he did not even know his own age, or why he was imprisoned in the first place (though it did get him a life sentence).
Daran Tal was an ambitious individual who saw the potential of the Crystal Web Station, and whose careful planning and attention to details made his plan successful.
Three-Eye was a pirate who preyed on shipping and vessels of RePlanetHab, a massive corporation that worked to rebuild worlds devastated after the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Redstar was a Yaka pirate who preyed on Galactic Alliance shipping lanes in his ship, Night Lady, between the Yuuzhan Vong War and the Dark Nest Crisis.
Sayn Ta was a female Kaminoan Master Cloner on Kamino.

Moko Jax was the owner of Moko's Cantina on the Crystal Web Station. Although Moko was a Force-sensitive, he never learned how to tap into his potential abilities (and if asked, he'd scoff at the idea of "Jedi stuff," anyway).
Lianna was unfailingly polite but very firm in her dealings with both the new arrivals to the station and its permanent residents.
Egroeg Sacul was a Star Tours travel agency passenger. He was asked to see a Star Tours agent at gate number three before departing on a trip to Endor.
Klaar was a male Defel and the security chief aboard the Crystal Web Station.

Orta the Hutt was the "fringe" element that represented a consortium of "independent businesses" with interests on the Crystal Web Station in the negotiations to get a piece of Lucent technology in 4 ABY.
Taver Soren was just like many of the men recruited into the Galactic Empire.
RuuR'Ur was a Tusken Raider who camped out at the Canyon Dune Turn, taking shots at the podracers during the Boonta Eve Classic in 32 BBY.

Corix Venne was a Bith musician who was seen in Mos Espa around 32 BBY. He later became a cultural scientist and studied Jawas. While in Mos Espa during 32 BBY, Venne wore a Coarseweave beige long sleeve tunic with a black belt with a gold buckle.
Reike Th'san was a Human arms smuggler who operated in Mos Espa, a city on Tatooine, as of 32 BBY.
Orloc was a self-proclaimed Emperor's Mage that claimed to have Force powers. He had a dark hair and beard, and tawny eyes.
Meddun was a Kajain'sa'Nikto mercenary in Mos Espa on Tatooine in 32 BBY.

Aehrrley Rue was a humanoid male freelance pilot. He frequented Mos Espa, a city on the planet Tatooine, during the Boonta Eve Classic in 32 BBY. In that year, he passed by Qui-Gon Jinn, R2-D2, Jar Jar Binks, and Padmé Amidala heading into Watto's junkshop.
Jedwar Seelah was a Human male, an explorer and scout in Mos Espa 32 BBY.

Tryst Veila was a Force-sensitive male Human who fathered the Jedi Knight Tahiri Veila with his wife Cassa Veila. Both Tryst and his wife were strong in the Force, though they were never trained, as the Jedi Order had been virtually wiped out by then.
After the destruction of the Second Death Star, Jeckor found it harder and harder to obtain new crew for his capital ships, as most of the Imperial academies were shut down.

Cassa Veila was a female Human from the planet Tatooine. She was the mother of the Jedi Knight Tahiri Veila and the wife of Tryst Veila. Cassa and her husband were both moisture farmers that lived on their farm. Both were strong in the Force despite receiving no formal training.
Bey was a male Human-Nagai hybrid from Corellia. He was a friend of Han Solo's and, growing up, he acted as a big brother to Solo, defending him from bullies and teaching him to fight.

Lelin-Dor was the First Patriarch of Serroco until the Jedi Civil War. During the war, Darth Revan had him killed, seeing him as a political leader whose removal could lead to governmental destabilization.

Mimas Yoon was a Corellian diplomat whose assassination was ordered by Darth Revan at some point during the Jedi Civil War. Revan supposedly saw Yoon as being of vital importance to the stability of the Galactic Republic.
Rhysati Ynr was a Human female who served as a pilot in the New Republic's legendary Rogue Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
A notorious pirate, Arrissa n'Osnyi became famous enough to have a Naboo asteroid field, Arrissa's Field, named after her.

Uriah was a male Twi'lek who lived on Taris during the Old Sith Wars. He was present in 3956 BBY when Darth Malak's Sith Empire imposed a planet-wide quarantine on the ecumenopolis. He frequented Javyar's Cantina in the Lower City, and would sell Pazaak cards there.

Lyn Sekla was a female yellow Twi'lek who wanted desperately to get off Taris. In 3956 BBY, she heard that Bib Surool of the Starlight Entertainers was stuck on Taris due to the Sith quarantine, and auditioned for him as a dancer.
Bib Surool was a green male Twi'lek and a manager for the Starlight Entertainers. He was recruiting new talent for the group on Taris when the Sith invaded and instituted a quarantine in 3956 BBY.
An Imperial artisan, Sonal Serore named the Rebellion Remnants station in the Naboo system.

Gelrood was a Human male pazaak gambler who lived on the Outer Rim world of Taris during the Jedi Civil War. After winning fifteen games straight in the Upper City Cantina, he was accused of cheating.

Bostuco was a Human male who served in the Onderonian military, having earned the rank of Captain. He was the leader of the security detail that guarded the Sky Ramp, one of the passageways that led to the Iziz Royal Palace on his native world of Onderon.

Larrim was a Twi'lek male who lived on the Outer Rim planet Taris during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. They ran a kiosk in the South Apartments of the Upper City, where they sold various goods to residents and passers-by.
Kadir was an elderly Human male who worked as a janitor in the Upper City's South Apartments on the Outer Rim planet Taris in 3956 BBY.
Ixgil was a Duros male who lived in the South Apartments on the Outer Rim world Taris during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, the apartments were raided by members of Darth Malak's Sith Empire.
Selven was a female Human high-profile assassin who became infamous for her extermination of the Ulgo family on Taris.

Luugro was a Rodian assassin present on the Outer Rim planet Taris during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He had black eyes, green skin, wore a red, white, and brown flight suit with a black harness and boots, and carried a blaster pistol.
Largo was a Human male merchant living in the Upper City of Taris.

Anglu was a Twi'lek who was a swoop pilot for the Hidden Beks. They attended the Tarisian Season Opener and talked to the former Sith Lord Revan there. They fled shortly thereafter when a fight broke out between Black Vulkar leader Brejik and Revan.
Doba was a male Rodian, and a swoop pilot for the Black Vulkars on Taris in 3956 BBY. He was not as skilled as Redros in swoop racing, and was rarely, if ever, favored because of this.
Phirk was a male Quara Aqualish and a swoop pilot for the Hidden Beks on Taris during 3956 BBY.
Redros was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto and a swoop racer for the Black Vulkars on Taris as of 3956 BBY. He was considered to be the best swoop racer that the Vulkars had to offer.
Malya was Rukil's last apprentice, a Human female native to the Undercity of Taris.
Esala was a Human female native to the Undercity of Taris.
Gendar was a male Human native to the Undercity of Taris.
Hendar was a Human male who was a member of the Outcasts and native of the Tarisian Undercity.
Hester was a Human female native to the Undercity of Taris.
Trewin was a Human male native to the Undercity of Taris. He was the gatekeeper who attended the gate between the Outcast village and the rakghoul-infested lands.
Igear was a young Human male native to the Undercity of Taris. He was the Outcast village's primary salvager and trader, and was very jealous of Gendar's position of leadership.
Kandon Ark was a green-skinned male Twi'lek who lived on Taris during the Jedi Civil War. During the Bek–Vulkar gang war, he ran the swoop bike garage within the Black Vulkar Base.

Rukil was a Human male who lived in an Outcast village, located in the Undercity of the planet Taris, from around the year 4056 BBY up until the time of the Jedi Civil War. By this time, he had lived a large portion of his life in the village as an Outcast.

Shaleena was a Human female born into the Undercity Outcasts on the planet Taris. Kept away from the world's surface, they would dream about it and listened to the storyteller Rukil's tales of the fabled Promised Land, even into her adulthood.

Gorton Colu was a Human who lived on the planet Taris. He was the creator of the Anti-Alien League, an organization that lobbied for the slaughter of all non-Humans living on Taris and spent time in the Upper City promoting his beliefs.

Gurney was a Human male from Taris who lived in the Upper City during the Sith Empire's occupation of that world. He worked as Zelka Forn's assistant in Zelka Forn's medical facility; however, he also worked as an informant for the crime lord Davik Kang through Zax the Hutt.

Zelka Forn was an elderly Human male doctor who was running a clinic in a part of the Upper City on the planet Taris by the year 3956 BBY. Forn would not refuse help to anyone, regardless of social or xenophobic reasons that would cause others to turn them away.

Christya was a Human female who met the Galactic Republic soldier Revan in the Upper City Cantina on the planet Taris in 3956 BBY. After being impressed by Revan's pazaak skills, Christya offered to buy him drinks.

Gana Lavin was a Human woman who grew up in the Upper City of Taris. In 3956 BBY, she ordered drinks at the Upper City Cantina with a friend. When her order was delayed, she mistook Revan, a Galactic Republic soldier, for a waiter.

Garouk was a Human who traveled the galaxy as a professional gambler in his younger years. He eventually retired, choosing to spend his time in Taris's Upper City Cantina, where he would teach individuals the rules of pazaak for a small fee.
Jergan was a Human male con artist and a patron of the Upper City Cantina on the planet Taris during the Jedi Civil War. Inside the cantina, Jergan spent his time looking for women.

Niklos was a male Human who frequented the Upper City Cantina on Taris during the time of the Jedi Civil War, claiming to be the "unofficial champion of the pazaak circuit on Taris." He used to have frequent games with fellow player Gelrood, until the latter was banned from th…

Hoddas Umgil was one of Nichos Marr's childhood friends and a youth of the Old Jedi Order who survived Order 66 issued by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine. Nichos remembered how they searched for Plett's Well. Umgil was one of the Children of the Jedi, hidden on Belsavis.
Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin was a Human female who was the heiress of I'att Armament until she later became a bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War.
Alisande was a female Human who was the wife of Aron Peacebringer, Warlord of the Calian Confederacy on Shiva IV, and mother to their children during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Jax Pavan was a Human male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. His father, Lorn Pavan, was once employed at the Jedi Temple. He was trained by Even Piell, and during the Great Jedi Purge wielded a blue lightsaber.
Tyanna Tymb was the Sullustan Top OpEx of the SoroSuub Corporation's Varada sector holdings.

Doran Sarkin-Tainer was the son of Jedi Knight Tyria Sarkin and Wraith Squadron pilot Kell Tainer. He was named after Kell's original family name, Doran. He was handsome and square-jawed, and described as "the size of a dwarf Wookiee.".

Galduran Calrissian was an individual who gained a measure of notoriety for running a smuggling ring in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy that was under the control of the Hutts, a species with a crime-oriented culture.

Andur Thorsim was a scout in the Rebel Alliance and later lieutenant in the New Republic Army. He was also a member of the Republic's Astrographic Survey Institute. He was the modern documentarian of the planet Corellia.
Snoke Loroan was a Corellian pilot who fought with the Rebel Alliance. They participated in the Battle of Endor, where they were killed.
Tanis Venn was a wraid hunter from Tatooine.

Marlena Venn was the wife of Tanis Venn. She had married him despite the warnings of her mother, warnings that proved to be all too true. Marlena came to realize that her husband was a shameless womanizer and grew to hate him.
Gluupor was a Rodian living in Ahto City in 3956 BBY. Being poor and wanting to live richly for a short time, Gluupor saved up enough money to stay in the Ahto City visitor's hotel.
Zherron was a Human male and the captain of the Khoonda Militia on Dantooine 3951 BBY. A man of straightforward speech and direct action, Zherron did not believe in wasting time or words.

Rilka was a Human female farmer who lived on the agrarian Outer Rim planet of Dantooine. During the Jedi Civil War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and Darth Revan's Sith Empire, she lived on one of Dantooine's northern farms with her husband, Gar.

Jon was a Human male farmer who lived on Dantooine near the Jedi Enclave with his daughter, Ilsa, during the years before the Jedi Civil War. Ilsa was killed by a group of Mandalorians in 3956 BBY due to her defiance against their assumed authority.

Sol'aa was an orange-skinned, blue-eyed Twi'lek who lived on the pastoral Outer Rim planet Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War in 3956 BBY. They lived in a room located on the north end of the Dantooine Jedi Enclave and occasionally played the gambling card game pazaak.

Lur Arka Sulas was a green-skinned male Twi'lek who lived on Outer Rim planet of Dantooine c. 3956 BBY. He worked for the rancher Rundil ot Sulem, and met an amnesiac Revan on his visit to the Jedi Enclave there.
Karal Kaar was a green-skinned male Twi'lek employed by Aratech Droids Inc.. He worked at the Aratech Mercantile on Dantooine in 3956 BBY.

Crattis Yurkal was a Twi'lek male who ran the general store Aratech Mercantile inside the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine in 3956 BBY. He was very talkative, and despised the Czerka Corporation. He owned a blade that belonged to Sanasiki.
Ahlan Matale was a Human living on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. He was native to the Core Worlds, but moved to Dantooine to get his family away from the crowded bustle of city life.
Rickard Lusoff was a Human male who lived on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. He planned to murder his business partner Calder Nettic for cheating him out of a business deal.

Handon Guld was a Human male who lived on Dantooine with his wife during the Jedi Civil War. He would often go running on the Dantooine plains, as he didn't like using speeders. However, he was known to rent a speeder between Calder Nettic and himself.
Burtt was a Rebel Alliance officer and part of a survey team under Princess Leia Organa assigned to scout out the planet Arbra in the hopes of establishing a permanent Rebel base.
Stridus Darkov was a male businessman alive during the time of the New Republic.
Guta-Nay was a male Weequay and served as Lieutenant of Ghez Hokan's mercenaries on Qiilura. Before he was employed by Hokan, he was a known criminal, rapist, and murderer. His brother was Gar-Ul.
Gar-Ul was a male Weequay criminal active on Qiilura. He and his brother Guta-Nay were mercenaries employed by Ghez Hokan. It was said about Gar-Ul that he had more muscle than brains.
Tork was a bouncer who worked at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley on Tatooine, circa 0 ABY. He often worked with Ackmena and her assistant.

This Advanced Recon Commando Lieutenant was a part of the Muunilinst 10 and piloted the Muunilinst 10's Low Altitude Assault Transport during the Mission to Hypori, where the ARCs were sent to rescue the surviving Jedi of Jedi Master Daakman Barrek's task force.
Bror Jace was a Human male who was one of the original members of Rogue Squadron's second reformation, briefly serving as Rogue Four.

Dakar was a male port administrator and ion miner on Exis Station, active in the years following the Great Sith War. Along with being a leader of mining expeditions in the Teedio system, Dakar was in charge of the space station's hangar bay.
Kaevee was a female Padawan studying on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War.
Shen Matale was a Human male living on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. The son of Ahlan Matale, he was the heir to his estate.

Sasha ot Sulem was a Human female, the daughter of Rundil ot Sulem. She was kidnapped and long raised by the Mandalorians on Dantooine, and knew only an odd version of Mando'a, the Mandalorian language, and Galactic Basic Standard.
Nurik Sandral was a Human male who moved to Dantooine shortly after Ahlan Matale moved there. The two men owned the largest farms on Dantooine, and soon developed a vicious feud.
Rahasia Sandral was a Human female who lived on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. She was the daughter of landowner Nurik Sandral.

Hudrow was a Human male that served as Exchange crime lord Davik Kang's personal pilot for the Ebon Hawk. During the Sith Empire's occupation of Taris, he angered Kang by stealing spice from the spice lab at his estate.
Kharr was a male Cathar holy man who was a leader of his city-tree on his homeworld, Cathar. Kharr was a mentor to Sylvar, who went on to become a famous and celebrated Jedi.
Portha was a Trandoshan that lived on the planet Coruscant in Invisec during Rogue Squadron's operation there in 6 ABY.
Kordren was a male Cerean who served as a member of the Techrats, along with Skeel and Maj-Odo-Nomor during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Maj-Odo-Nomor was a young male Cerean from Cerea who served as a member of the Techrats swoop gang.

Mawin was a Cerean female who was the fourth wife of Ki-Adi Mundi and the mother of Ki-Adi's daughter Sylvn. Even though the Jedi Code forbade emotional attachments, the low Cerean male birthrate granted an exception.

Tsyr was a male Morgukai Kajain'sa'Nikto from the planet Kintan. He had a very close bond with his Morgukai son Bok. The two's appearances were exactly the same except that Tsyr had three big scars on his face which he gained in a duel with Ma'kis'shaalas.
Shahn was a Human male communications officer working for the Rebel Alliance under the command of Princess Leia Organa.
Hilly was a member of the Rebel Alliance stationed at the base on the planet of Arbra shortly after the Battle of Hoth.
Josta Cracken was a Human female from Corellia who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Dena Cracken was a Human female from Contruum, who was the daughter of Airen and Josta, and the sister of Pash.

Phan Riizolo was a pirate associated with the Invids and the captain of the Booty Full. He was captured by Rogue Squadron at Alakatha in 11 ABY, after attempting to leave the Invids in order to strike out on his own.
Skeel was a muscled young Cerean. He was the leader of the Band of Techrats, along with Kordren and Maj-Odo-Nomor.
Twin was a young female Cerean and the girlfriend of Skeel. After the death of Skeel, Twin went directly to Maj-Odo-Nomor, who fell for Twin's charms.
Ydde was a male Ortolan trader who lived in the Outsider Citadel on Cerea, shortly before the Invasion of Naboo.

Simon, known as Simon the Killer Ewok, was an Ewok with brown fur and black eyes. Simon wielded a staff weapon that fired devastating blaster bolts capable of quickly destroying buildings, beings, droids, and vehicles.

Nak Pitareeze was a young male Human from Kalarba, the son of Jarth and Meg Pitareeze. He at one time owned C-3PO and R2-D2, until they were stolen by the pirate Captain Huba. Though the two droids were returned to Nak, they soon ventured off to Nar Shaddaa.
Dvakvar Grahrk was a Devaronian Jedi and user of the Dark side of the Force who hunted down Sith.
Neema-Da-Boda was the daughter of Jedi Knight Vima-Da-Boda and a descendant of Vima Sunrider.
Alara Fax was the founder of Fax Ventures and a fierce rival of Tyanna Tymb.
Sassich was a Human woman from Corellia. She was a member of CorSec, and became its director at the age of forty, a great achievement.
Myk'chur Finux Zug was a male Lannik revolutionary, and a major power in the Red Iaro terrorist group.

Wald was a Rebel Alliance pilot stationed at the Salvation base on the planet Arbra, shortly after the Battle of Hoth. He flew a T-65 X-wing starfighter and served under the command of Luke Skywalker.
Orion Ferret was a Human male weapons trader and gunrunner who owned and operated the space station Bazarre, which served as a large black market hub during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Quad-Lo was a short, green alien male slaver who frequented the space station Bazarre during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Ceasar was a male watchbeast and a pet of Orion Ferret, the administrator of the space station known as Bazarre. Kept on the junk planet of Patch-4, Ceasar was tasked with guarding whatever Ferret chose to store on the planet.
Serja Kesselrook was a Human male vagabond drifter that lived in an underground community on the planet Patch-4.

Roy Teda was the corrupt dictator of the planet Romin a number of years before the Clone Wars. He was an associate of the galactic criminals Granta Omega and Jenna Zan Arbor and, as such, became an enemy of the Jedi Order.

Niado Duegad was a native of the planet Vodran. His species was similar to the dianoga, a creature native to Duegad's homeworld. During the Galactic Civil War, a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Duegad served as a mercenary.
Jysella Terrik was the wife of Booster Terrik and mother to Mirax Terrik. She died when Mirax was just a child.

Novar was an Onderonian politician and Sith initiate in the years leading up to the Great Sith War. Born into one of the wealthiest families in the Onderonian capital city of Iziz, Novar quickly became a high-ranking member of the Onderonian government after graduating from Ov…

Mils Giel was a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy. With relatives who had been serving Emperor Palpatine since 19 BBY, Giel became an admiral in the Navy, and personally oversaw the creation of the largest armada in Imperial history.
Kodu Terrafin was a male Arcona who worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

Mika Anjiliac Chiera was a male Force-sensitive Dark Jedi Hutt of the Anjiliac kajidic, one of the two offspring of Popara Anjiliac Diresto, and a crime lord. Mika owned an Esral'sa'Nikto aide named Orgamon.
Popara Anjiliac Diresto was a Hutt who owned a large financial empire. His main home was a spire on Nar Shaddaa.
Garil Dox was a Human male who served as a gunner on the Imperial Star Destroyer Reprisal during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Gerdy was a Human male Imperial officer stationed on the remote outpost of Spindrift during the Galactic Civil War. By 3 ABY, Gerdy was in a relationship with a woman on the planet Aduba-4, and often broke Imperial regulations by calling her on priority frequencies.
Thwim was a Kubaz security guard employed by the Whiphid, Lady Valarian. He worked at the front reception area of the Lucky Despot Hotel & Casino shortly before the Battle of Yavin.
Roskin was a Human woman from Sulon who served as a sympathizer of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the early Galactic Civil War.

Jerg was a Human male smuggler who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was commanding the ship called the Cyclops. He chanced upon the forgotten planet Ruusan which he made his base of operation, unaware of its rich ancient history.

Tyreca Bremack was a female senator in the Galactic Republic who represented the 245 systems of the Lahara sector, which seceded from the Republic and joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems prior to the start of the Clone Wars.

Rasit Brun was a senator who represented Rintonne and the Lambda sector prior to the Clone Wars. After Kendra Tissido was attacked by a frigate and five droid starfighters in Andoan space, Brun stated it was an act of war, and accused the senator of the Trade Federation, Lott …

Candabrine Bu was a senator hailing from the celestial body Lansono in the Galactic Senate during the Separatist Crisis. A militarist, the Lansono senator supported the Military Creation Act, which aimed to create an army to assist the beleaguered Republic.
Vi Callen was a male Senator of the Galactic Republic c. 44 BBY. He was sympathetic to the Jedi. He was one of the Senators who investigated Obi-Wan Kenobi's involvement in the death of Bruck Chun.

Chelo was an Imperial senator who represented the planet Gerrard V in 0 BBY. Following a rebel uprising on the planet that had to be put down by elements of the Imperial Navy, Chelo and Governor Dannal were ordered to report to Emperor Palpatine to explain why they failed to p…
Crote was a Human male senator who represented Frego until his arrest in 40 BBY, when he was found to be in league with the criminal Cobral family of his homeworld.

Harkon Dell was a senator of the Galactic Empire. Dell was known to voice displeasure at Emperor Palpatine's New Order, and was suspected by Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin of being, along with Mon Mothma and Leia Organa, a source of support for the Rebellion in the Imperial Senate.

Bog Divinian, nicknamed Bantha Bog by Keets Freely, was a male Human senator of the Galactic Republic from 26 BBY until 24 BBY; he represented Nuralee. Later, he fell in with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Galim Eddawan was a male Human senator who represented Tyan in the Galactic Senate of the Republic.
Elrood was a Galactic Republic senator who fought to acquire the funding necessary to undertake the colonization of the planet Elrood. The planet was subsequently named in the senator's honor.

Farazzish was a Senator in the Imperial Senate who was exiled to the prison moon Captivity by the Galactic Empire. Farazzish fell in with the group led by the former Imperial Navy captain, Dedelin, and was eventually rescued by a team from the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Kare Fontin was a male Senator of the Galactic Republic and a diplomat of the New Republic.

Gno was a male who served as a senator within the Galactic Republic Senate during the Clone Wars. He remained in this role during the time of the Galactic Empire, aiding the Rebel Alliance after he was forced to resign.
Iridik'k-stallu was a female Senator of the Galactic Republic in 19 BBY. She had multiple hearts, and supported Bail Organa's and Mon Mothma's efforts to limit Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's powers.

Nemrileo irm-Drocubac was a Tanjayan male senator who represented the planet Tanjay IV in the Republic Senate on Coruscant during the Separatist Crisis. Irm-Drocubac had a family, which included a wife and two children.
Risi Lenoan, a Human senator handpicked for the interests of the Kuat Drive Yards company, represented the planet Kuat in the Galactic Senate during the Separatist Crisis.
Garlan Limoth was a male Human Senator of the Galactic Republic who represented the Trans-Nebular sector from at least 32 BBY until his death in a tragic accident in 19 BBY.

Ilov Maas was a male Human Senator who represented Delphon in the Imperial Senate of the Galactic Empire. He was a vocal supporter of Emperor Palpatine, a trait that he instilled in his daughter, Nima.

Quorl Matrin was the Imperial Governor of the planet Stenos during the Galactic Civil War. Formerly an Imperial Senator, Matrin led the Imperial invasion and occupation of Stenos, which succeeded due partly to the complete apathy of the Stenax natives.

Arcel Mosbree was a male Human senatorial representative of the Galactic Republic who represented Brentaal IV until after the Battle of Brentaal IV in 22 BBY and was taken into custody by Republic forces.
Mousul was a male Ansionian Senator of the Galactic Republic who represented Ansion during the Separatist Crisis before the Clone Wars.
Navi was a male Sephi senator of the Galactic Republic who represented Thustra and joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Bicon Ransa was a male Human Senator who served in the Galactic Senate of the Republic in 44 BBY.

Rodd was a male Human Senator of the Galactic Republic who represented Fondor and the Tapani sector until he joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 23 BBY and was replaced by Canny Mandary Bertar.
Mael Sidras was a Senator. Sidras was subject to an assassination attempt by the Galactic Empire, which resulted in the deaths of all beings aboard the passenger liner Savage Pleasure.
Zafiel Snopps was a Human male from the planet Corulag who was one of the dominant political figures on his homeworld for several decades.
Uta S'orn was a female Human Senator of the Galactic Republic who represented Belasco until her retirement and subsequent arrest in 43 BBY. Her son, Ren S'orn, was Force-sensitive.

Spince was a male Human senator of the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire, who represented Corellia and the Corellian sector. After the Clone Wars, he secured a posting for his son, Mako, at the Imperial Space Academy.
Berm Tarturi was a male Human who represented Andara in the Galactic Senate during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Tashrikam was a senator who represented the planet Grizmallt in the Galactic Senate of the Republic. In 22 BBY, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine announced the formation of the Loyalist Committee, a group of politicians united to diplomatically address the growing Separatist Crisis.
Pi T'Egal was a male Senator who served the Galactic Republic prior to and through 44 BBY.

Templeton was a Senator in the Imperial Senate who was exiled to the prison moon Captivity by the Galactic Empire. Falling in with the group led by the former Imperial Navy captain, Dedelin, Templton was eventually rescued by Alliance to Restore the Republic agents.
Alku Vordu was a male senator who represented Daroon in the Imperial Senate of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

V'troren Tara was a male Twi'lek Senator who served in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Clone Wars until he served in the Imperial Senate, following the declaration of the New Order. He sat on the Procurement Panel of the Senate Naval Subcommittee.
Wena Havid was a male Human panjandram, or senator, of the Galactic Empire. He represented Kalarba.
Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren was a female Human Senator of the Galactic Republic who represented the Cularin system from 32 BBY to 19 BBY.

Wuxod was a male senator of the Galactic Empire who represented Derilyn and the Elrood sector during the early years of the Empire. Born in the city of Paran, he was an open critic of Emperor Palpatine and disappeared after stating Derilyn's opposition to Palpatine's power grab.
Zurros was a male Falleen senator of the Galactic Republic who represented Falleen in the Senate during the Clone Wars.

Jollin Resbin was a Sneevel senator who represented the planet Sneeve in the Republic Senate during the Separatist Crisis. In 22 BBY, Resbin supported the Military Creation Act, a piece of legislation considered by the Senate that would create an army for the Republic.

Canny Mandary Bertar was a female Mrlssi senator who served as chair of the Senate Dispensation Committee and represented Mrlsst and the Tapani sector to the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Separatist Crisis in 23 BBY.
Blix Annon was a male Human who served as a senator in the Galactic Republic Senate during the final decades of the institution.
Vivendi Allum was a male Senator of the Galactic Republic who was part of a commission assigned to investigate the death of Bruck Chun in 44 BBY.
Amamanam was a male B'das Senator of the New Republic who represented the B'das people c. 16 ABY. He was a member of the Senate's Council on Security and Intelligence.
Allana Djo Solo was the daughter of Jedi Knight Jacen Solo and Jedi Knight Tenel Ka Chume'Ta Djo, Queen Mother of Hapes.
Darial Anglethorn was a female Human moisture farmer and peacekeeper who later became her homeworld of Beheboth's first representative in the New Republic Senate.
Arastide was a male Human Senator of the New Republic who represented Gantho in 13 ABY. He was a member of the Defense Council.

Fyg Boras was a Vor senator of the New Republic who represented the planet Vortex in the New Republic Senate in 27 ABY. During the Yuuzhan Vong invasion of the galaxy, Vortex was among the many worlds that fell to the invaders.

C-Gosf was a female Gosfamling senator of the New Republic who represented Gosfambling c. 17 ABY. She was also a member of the Senate's Inner Council. She ran at great personal risk, because a Gosfamling who failed any contest was forever shunned by other Gosfamlings.
ChoFï was a male senator of the New Republic. He was an ardent supporter of Leia Organa Solo since the beginnings of the New Republic.

R'yet Coome was a male Exodeenian Senator of the New Republic who represented Exodeen in 17 ABY after M'yet Luure was killed as a result of bombing of the Senate Building. Later he was elected to the Inner Council.

Nara Deega was a male Bith Senator of the New Republic who represented Clak'dor VII and the Mayagil Sector c. 16 ABY and was replaced by E'noro. He was named to the Senate Defense Council after replacing Tig Peramis.
Ala Cornin was a female Senator of the New Republic in 6 ABY. She was captured by Imperial forces near the Gacerian system.
Carib Devist was a clone of Soontir Fel, and the unofficial leader of Imperial sleeper cell Jenth-44 on Pakrik Minor.
Drankin was a male Human Senator of the New Republic who served c. 16 ABY.
Dall Thara Dru was a female Human Senator of the New Republic who represented Raxxa.
Ghic Dx'ono was a male Ishori Senator who represented Isht and the Ishori Confederene in the Senate of the New Republic.

E'noro was a female Bith Senator of the New Republic who represented Clak'dor VII and the Mayagil sector circa 26 ABY. She sat on the Corruption Panel. She formally relieved Viqi Shesh of senatorial duties after being convicted of treason.
Chau Feswin was a male Human Senator of the New Republic representing the Elrood sector.
Frammel was a Senator of the New Republic who served circa 16 ABY. He held a seat on the Defense Council during the Yevethan Purge.
Addath Gadan was a female Human senator of the New Republic. She represented Vannix, serving from 8 ABY until 27 ABY, when she lost an election to Apelben Werl.

J'mesk Iman was a male Tamran Senator of the New Republic who represented the Tamran People circa 24 ABY. It is possible he was a supporter of the Diversity Alliance, as he spoke in its defense in the New Republic Senate Chambers.

Kvarm Jia was a male Human Senator of the New Republic who represented the Tapani sector circa 27 ABY. At the bidding of Leia Organa Solo, he convened the Corruption Panel that investigated Viqi Shesh prior to the Appeasement Vote.
Lillald was a male Human Senator of the New Republic who served circa 16 ABY.
M'yet Luure was a male Exodeenian Senator of the New Republic who represented the planet Exodeen. He was a major supporter of the New Republic amnesty bill in the New Republic Senate.

Meido was a male non-Human senator of the New Republic who represented Adin circa 17 ABY. He was one of the senators elected after the New Republic amnesty bill allowed former supporters of the Galactic Empire to run for elected offices within the government that had replaced …
Porolo Miatamia was a male Diamal senator of the New Republic who represented the Diamala people by 19 ABY and was one of the largest supporters of peace during the Caamas Document Crisis.
Umwaw Moolis was an Ithorian Senator of the New Republic who represented Ithor and the Ottega sector circa 12 ABY.
Muchardis Mulaxis was a male Ayrou Senator of the New Republic who represented Maya Kovel and the Moddell sector up until 19 ABY.
Cair Tok Noimm was a female Senator of the New Republic who served circa 16 ABY. She was a member of the New Republic Security Council.
Nyxy was a senator of the New Republic who represented Rudrig and the Tion Hegemony until being replaced by Thuv Shinev in 17 ABY.

Tig Peramis was a male Human Senator of the New Republic who represented Walalla and the Seventh Security Zone until being censured in 16 ABY. He was not a full senator, but also not a former one, as his position retained some complicated legal clauses.

Krall Praget was a male senator of the New Republic who represented Edatha circa 16 ABY. Praget chaired the Council on Security and Intelligence during the Black Fleet Crisis, and was still on the council advising the New Republic Senate during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Drextar Pym was a male Human senator from Exargan of the New Republic who represented Excarga and the Herios sector.
Quedlifu was a Senator of the New Republic who served circa 19 ABY. Quedlifu chaired the Economics Committee.
Rattagagech was a male Elomin Senator of the New Republic who represented Elom circa 16 ABY. He was chairbeing of the Science and Technology Council.
Shibatthi was a Senator of the New Republic who served circa 19 ABY. During the Caamas Document Crisis, Shibatthi took an anti-Bothan stance.
Thuv Shinev was a male Human Senator of the New Republic and later Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.
Trubor was a male Chadra-Fan Senator of the New Republic who represented the planet Chadra.
Tuomi was a male senator of the New Republic who represented Bosch circa 16 ABY and challenged Chief of State Leia Organa Solo's credentials.
Typia was a New Republic senator who served circa 13 ABY and was a member of Daysong.
Wwebyls was a humanoid male senator of the New Republic who hailed from Yn. In 17 ABY, he was newly elected to the Inner Council. He was tiny in stature.

Tolik Yar was a male Oolid Senator who represented the planet of Oolidi, his homeworld, in the New Republic Senate during the Black Fleet Crisis. In 16 ABY, he served as a member of the Council on Security and Intelligence.
Zilar was a Human senator of the New Republic who represented Praesitlyn and the Sluis sector during the Yevethan Purge. He was a member of the Senate Defense Council.
Berec Tanaal was a Rebel Alliance officer stationed at Echo Base around the time of the Battle of Hoth. He was a specialist in hunting. He escaped from Hoth in the transport Bright Hope.
Vildar Blin was a Human male corporal and scout of the Alliance Special Forces during the Galactic Civil War.

Fixit was a human male scrumrat of the White Worms gang on the Core Worlds planet Corellia. Around 13 BBY, he and the fellow human scrumrat Broon prepared to help raid a Corellia shipyard by taking watch shifts to monitor the facility, often taking turns with the Rodian scrumr…
Nala Hetsime was a Human male pilot from Pa Tho, who had joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic by 3 ABY. In that year, Hetsime was stationed at Echo Base on the planet Hoth.

Kira Lar was a Human female Alderaanian who served as a Rebel Alliance officer at Echo Base around the time of the Battle of Hoth. Shortly before the destruction of Alderaan, she was preparing to join the Imperial Navy.

Maer was a humanoid who served as a corporal in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed at the Alliance High Command headquarters of Echo Base on the ice planet Hoth shortly before the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.
Lag Mettier was a Rebel Alliance ground crew officer stationed at Echo Base around the time of the Battle of Hoth and was captured during the battle.
Tamizander Rey was a Human commander of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Corman Quien was a Human corporal and scout of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Although he never thought his love of animals would benefit the Rebellion, Quien found use for his skills as a beast tamer.
Jeroen Webb was a Human native of the planet Ralltiir who became a spy for the local Ralltiir underground following the Imperial subjugation of his homeworld.

Hanc Thorben was a Human male officer who served in the Rebel Alliance holding the rank of Captain. Stationed at Haven Base on the planet Arbra, he also served as a pilot for the flight group known as Rogue Squadron during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Zytho was a Human male farmer who lived on Dorlo during the Galactic Civil War. In 5 ABY, he was driven off his property when SoroSuub Corporation discovered a huge ore load under his Braal fields. He was soon killed by the Empire.
Grentho was a Human male who was a bodyguard for 8t88 during the Galactic Civil War.
