Professor Nij Por Ral was a fat male Human scientist specializing in linguistics, hired by SoroSuub during the Galactic Civil War; later he defected to follow Jedi Master Qu Rahn.

Turk was the proper name of an Imperial stormtrooper stationed at an outpost on Krake's Planet. Turk had a close working relationship with another trooper named Grotto, but more often than not found himself telling his friend to "Shaddup".
Grotto was the proper name of a less-than-competent Imperial stormtrooper stationed at an outpost on Krake's Planet.
Milo Fourstar was a Human male member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, who was stationed at Haven Base on the planet Arbra in 3 ABY.

Fazza Utral was an Ithorian hunter. As the proprietor of the Hunting Lodge of Anchorhead during the Jedi Civil War, Fazza provided wraid and krayt dragon hunters with a location for buying supplies, a market for their goods, and a place to relax and share tales.
Esok was a Humanoid male who was the leader of Mandalorian clan that came to Dantooine to earn a living.

Gaff was a male Kobok living on Roon during the early days of the Galactic Empire. He was the aide-de-camp to Governor Koong of the Tawntoom province. Gaff was a yellow-skinned humanoid with three orange compound eyes—the third was located in the back of his head.
Rol was a Human male bodyguard who worked for the droid information broker 8t88 during the year 5 ABY.
Trox was a male Human henchman of 8t88, along with Hontho and Rol. In 5 ABY, he was killed by Kyle Katarn who infiltrated the Government House in order to get information on the Valley of the Jedi.
Hontho was a male Gamorrean henchman of 8t88, along with Trox and Rol after the Battle of Endor.
Venco Autem was a Human male of the Autem family. He was the older brother of Sagoro, and like him, was a Senate Guard.
Fliry Vorru was a famed Corellian Human male who served as a politician and criminal underlord.

Maltaz was an Imperial general who commanded Battle Group Turak during the Battle of Turak IV. During the assault, Maltaz ordered two battalions of the Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit to assault the main Alliance base directly while he attempted to flank the installation to …
Katie Grawley was a young Human female settler of Sulon. She was the daughter of Grif and Carole. In 1 BBY, she was killed in an Imperial attack on the planet.
Carole Grawley was a Human female farmer from the moon Sulon who was the wife of Grif and the mother of Katie Grawley.

While in orbit over Milagro, the ship was under attack by an Imperial Star Destroyer. While they were waiting for reinforcements, Tola could do more than allocating the resources for repairs as the New Hope suffered damage. He ordered to get the backup antenna online.
Dinko was a Human male colonist who lived in Fort Nowhere on Ruusan during the Galactic Civil War.
Goru Rainstealer was a male weapons designer who designed the Zicx-bug bomb, an illegal grenade-like weapon made using Zicx bugs and sarlacc bile.

Jowir Ar'Lensa was a Sullustan from Wayfar, Tatooine. He ran a small stand in the town, but dealt only with Jabba the Hutt and those who worked with the crime lord. He hated Valarian very much, and often hired people to slay her men.

Ton Phanan was a doctor from Rudrig who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Phanan was badly wounded while serving aboard a frigate at the Battle of Endor; allergic to bacta, he had to accept cybernetic replacement parts to survive.
Rajan was a male Human Jedi who fought in the Army of Light during the end of the New Sith Wars. He had a black beard and a shaven head.
Tal was a Jedi Master during the time of the later Draggulch Period. A Human male, he fought in the Ruusan campaign.

Borna was a composer who lived during the Imperial Period, a time when the Galactic Empire ruled the galaxy. Described as immortal, the composer's music furthered understanding between different species and cultures.

Brast'alshi'barku, also known by his core name of Talshib, was a Chiss male of the Brast family who held the rank of Captain in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force. In 22 ABY, he served aboard the diplomatic ship Chaf Envoy as a line commander.
Ranif Parlan was a male captain of the Imperial Navy.
Kodin was a male Aqualish droid and junk dealer on Nar Shaddaa who had ties to the Exchange. He met Meetra Surik, who was searching for IT-31. Kodin had stolen IT-31 from Tien Tubb.

Al, known as Big Al, was a male human who resided on the Colossus refueling station on Castilon in the later stages of the Cold War between the First Order and the Resistance. He sported a bushy mustache and was a regular at Aunt Z's tavern.
Captain Nord was the commanding officer of the Alliance Special Forces ship, Pride of Aridus.
Yondalla was a Zabrak female working for Jabba the Hutt as a lieutenant. She resided in Wayfar, Tatooine, near Jabba's Palace.

Gursan Bryes was a male Bothan from Kachirho, Kashyyyk. He was helping the residents of Kachirho defeat the "Enslaver of Kachirho," Lord Cyssc Blackscale. This confrontation came down to the heroes willing to help against the many space forces of Lord Cyssc.
Lord Cyssc Blackscale was a male Trandoshan and the leader of a group of slavers (called the Blackscale) in Kachirho, Kashyyyk. He was a very powerful being, with an army of guards at his command.
Eyma was a male Nautolan from Kachirho on Kashyyyk. He was a member of the Civilian Protection Guild. He was an enemy of the Ghrag Mercenaries and often sent out mercenaries to deal with them.
Yoshi Raph-Elan was a Human male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order prior to the Clone Wars.

Lourdes was the female Near-Human princess of a fairly low-tech planetoid. When her homeworld was conquered by the Yahk-Tosh Lord Gar-Oth, Lourdes joined forces with a Jedi Knight named Yoshi Raph-Elan to end the invasion and free her people.
Thuku was a Rodian from Rodia who belonged to the Chattza Clan. During the Galactic Civil War, Thuku became an accomplished bounty hunter and often worked alongside his fellow clan-member, Neesh.
Skee was a portly Rodian who was a member of the Tetsu Clan.
Prard'enc'iflar was an officer in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force, and a relative of General Drask. He was tall, with white-streaked hair.
Ina'ganet'nuruodo, also known by her core name Ganet, was a Chiss military officer and a pilot who served as a commander of the syndic's phalanx.

Martz was a captain in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. They commanded the Acclamator-class assault ship Prosecutor, which was commandeered by Trandoshan mercenaries roughly one year into the war. They were presumed dead, most likely killed by the Trandoshan forces.

Anky Fremp was the name of a Skup who lived on Level 88 in the Corellian Sector on the moon of Nar Shaddaa. As a biomorph, Anky had a natural talent for stealing, and made an ample career for himself as a professional thief.
Garn was a warleader of The One's tribe of Rakata on Lehon. A group of Garn's scouts were killed by Mandalorians who were stranded on Lehon.

Spane Covis was a male Human who served with the Alliance Special Forces as a sentinel. He was stationed at Port Tower One on Level 88, in the Corellian Sector of Nar Shaddaa, one of the moons of Nal Hutta.
Warb was an ambidexterious Corellian hyperdrive mechanic. He worked for Shug Ninx in a repair shop in the Corellian Sector of Nar Shaddaa.

Led Daragon was a Human member of the planet Coruscant's elite society during the Clone Wars, a conflict that lasted between 22 BBY to 19 BBY. He was a frequenter of the Galaxies Opera House in the Uscru Entertainment District of Coruscant.
Slenn was an Imperial Vice Admiral who served under the command of Darth Vader.
Kimber was a male human settler who was living on Ruusan during the Galactic Civil War.

TK8252 was the call sign of a male field stormtrooper in service with the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 10 ABY, TK8252 was stationed aboard one of the two artificial asteroids that attacked a New Republic base on the planet Altyr V.

Inat Rangoon was a male friend of General Airen Cracken who was cybernetically enhanced with a Vessel cyborg system. Rangoon infiltrated BlasTech Industries after he learned about an upgraded blaster galven pattern in development.
Fitz Roi was a male Human jatz musician from the Tapani sector who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Geelo was a Rodian shipjacker, who was labeled as "the resident Rodian cynic" of the Crosstown cantina on Cularin.
Maxa Jandovar was a Human vandfillist who performed during the last decades of the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Civil War.
Dace Bonearm was a male Human bounty hunter active in the Outer Rim Territories during the height of the Galactic Civil War. Dace would frequently associate with the assassin droid IG-72.

Lannik Racto was a crime lord based on Coruscant and a member of the Disciples of Ragnos. He possessed a bust of Marka Ragnos in his office, along with a number of other Force-related artifacts, such as artusian crystals, a stuffed ysalamir, and vornskr statues.

Jorman Thoad was a Human male who ran a starship dealership on the Mid Rim planet Centares. By 0 ABY, Thoad claimed to be Centares' largest dealer in used spacecraft, and often referred customers to a cousin who dealt droids in Centares' Old Town.
Benok was a male Human, and chief of security for Loppak Slusk, head of operations for the Exchange on Citadel Station over Telos IV.

Loppak Slusk was a male Quarren crime boss on Citadel Station representing the Exchange, an intergalactic crime syndicate. Instructed by G0-T0, the Nar Shaddaa crime boss, Slusk came to Citadel Station over Telos IV to try and integrate the Exchange into the new Telos.

Matu was a male Rodian thug who worked for the Exchange under the command of Benok, the chief of security, and Loppak Slusk, the Exchange boss on Citadel Station. He was one of the best melee fighters in Loppak's force, wielding twin Rodian death blades with deadly precision.

Nahata was a male thug who worked for the Exchange under the command of Benok and Loppak Slusk on Citadel Station, and quickly became one of the more prominent and feared thugs due to his murderous deeds.

Opo Chano was a Duros droid repairman and parts salesman on Telos IV Citadel Station during the time of the Dark Wars. He owed a gambling debt to the Exchange that he was unable to pay off, leading him into trouble.
Vula was a Human female who worked as a receptionist for the Bumani Exchange Corporation, a front for the Exchange, on Citadel Station over Telos IV.
Corrun Falt was a male Human employee of Czerka Corporation on Citadel Station who greatly disliked Jana Lorso, his superior.
Tarn was a male Human mechanic living in Khoonda on Dantooine in 3951 BBY.

Pato Ado was a male Ithorian ecologist and xenobiologist who met Meetra Surik on Dantooine. He had spent a great deal of time studying the native plants and animals, and so was desperate to return to his herd on Telos to aid in the restoration project there.
Dillan was a Human female who lived on the planet Dantooine prior to and during the Jedi Civil War and in the years following.
Gerevick was a male Humanoid who earned a living as a salvager and bounty hunter. He was living on the world of Dantooine some five years after the end of the Jedi Civil War.
Saedhe was a Human male and a former Customs Inspector for the Galactic Republic.
Dopak was a veteran of the Mandalorian Wars and Jedi Civil War who ended up as a mercenary on Dantooine under the leadership of former elite Sith commando Azkul.
Nallek was a male Human and a veteran of the Jedi Civil War.
Daraala was a female Human salvager on Dantooine.
Ralon was a male Human salvager on Dantooine.
Jorran was a male Human living on the planet Dantooine in the year 3951 BBY. As a scavenger, he was one of the many that worked out of a camp near the ruins of the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine.
Akkere was a male Sullustan droid repairman and parts merchant on Dantooine in 3951 BBY. He set up a small stall right outside Khoonda, the center of government on the planet.
Lekket was a female Quarren smuggler from the planet Mon Calamari during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Vrox was the governor of Mandalore before the time of the Clone Wars. He was a secret supporter of Palpatine while he was still a senator, and comments by Fenn Shysa could be interpreted that Vrox was aware of his dual nature as a Senator and Dark Lord of the Sith.

Grond was a Human who served as a lieutenant in the Military of the Galactic Empire. Native to the planet Corellia, Grond was a swoop racer in his youth prior to his service with the Imperial Military. In 4 ABY, he was stationed on the Forest Moon of Endor.
Leth Liav was a Sullustan female fighter pilot, who had been shot down and captured by the Yuuzhan Vong.
Dakorse Teep was a teenager living during the Yuuzhan Vong War who served as a starfighter pilot for Rogue Squadron in 27 ABY.
RW957 was a stormtrooper assigned to Jerec's fleet in 5 ABY. He was killed on Ruusan.
Leeno was a Human male stormtrooper who was assigned to join Jerec's fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Portia was a dark-skinned Human female colonist on Ruusan.

Jaru was a male stormtrooper serving the Imperial warlord Jerec during his search for the Force nexus called the Valley of the Jedi. When the Valley was finally discovered in 5 ABY on the planet Ruusan, Jaru was among the stormtroopers assigned to excavate it.
Corporal Niko Smith was a Human male stormtrooper who was assigned to Jerec's battle group during the Galactic Civil War. In 5 ABY, he was a member of a squad led by Sergeant Zonka.
Sergeant Zonka was a Human male stormtrooper of the Imperial Remnant.

Doodnik Sharpelz was a male Jillsarian who worked as a bartender and chef on the planet Tyne's Horky. Originally from the planet Ojom, he left his homeworld before 19 BBY and found bartending work on Tyne's Horky alongside his old friend Dexter Jettster.

Berl was a Human male pilot of the Rebel Alliance who flew an X-wing starfighter under the command of Luke Skywalker. Some time after the Battle of Hoth, Berl and fellow Rebel pilot Cinda Tarheel attended Skywalker as wing-men on a mission to the planet Serphidi.

Chahis was a Serp warrior from the planet Serphidi in the Belial system. He worked in service to the planet's monarch King S'Shah. In 3 ABY, Chahis and several other warriors noticed the ruins of a downed Rebel T-65 X-wing starfighter on a mountain butte.
Ralrracheen, also called Ralrra, was a male Wookiee who served as an ambassador for Kashyyyk after dealing with the Galactic Republic.

Vossk was a male Trandoshan bounty hunter living on Nal Hutta's moon Nar Shaddaa during the years after the Jedi Civil War. He eventually left the Bounty Hunters' Guild and gave up his position as leader of the organization.
Orko the H'uun, formally known as Orko the Hutt or Orko the Foultrader, was a Hutt crime lord who had a strong rivalry with his daughter Anachro's lover, Gorga the Hutt, Jabba the Hutt's nephew.
Margar was an Aqualish illegal arms dealer in Iziz starport on Onderon whom Meetra Surik met, while searching for Kavar.

Terlyn is a female Human who lived on the Inner rim planet of Onderon during the Dark Wars. Terlyn was married to a man, with whom she had two children. Terlyn's husband was a royalist member of the Council of Lords, and attempted to assassinate General Vaklu.

Ponlar was an outspoken Human from Iziz on Onderon who supported General Vaklu's opposition to Queen Talia. He was met by Meetra Surik while protesting in Iziz's Merchant Quarter where he later instigated a riot.
Bahima was a male Bith bartender in the Iziz cantina during the Onderon Civil War. In 3951 BBY, he owned S-0D3-GE3, and assisted Meetra Surik during her investigation of Captain Sullio's murder.
Sullio was a female Human and Captain of the Onderon military who was murdered in Iziz shortly before the start of the Onderon Civil War.
Nikko was a Human male pazaak player who lived in Iziz, the capital city of the planet Onderon, during the Onderon Civil War in 3951 BBY. He spent most of his time playing pazaak in the Iziz Cantina.
Gormo was a male Duros stranded in the Iziz cantina for two weeks just prior to the Onderon Civil War without a starport visa. He was the captain of the freighter Tweigar.
Panar was a male Human Beast Rider living in Iziz on the planet of Onderon. He was a swoop racer encountered by Meetra Surik while she was on the world in 3951 BBY.

Bakkel was a female Human Beast Rider killed by Meetra Surik in Iziz on Onderon while she was seeking holodiscs for Dhagon Ghent. Bakkel refused to give the holodiscs to Surik and became hostile forcing Surik to kill her and her companions.

Sakarie was a Human criminal and smuggler who lived a thriving life of crime. During the Dark Wars, she did transport work for the criminal Exchange organization and was in possession of a rare Qixoni crystal used in the constuction of lightsabers.
Qimtiq was a male Quarren and proprietor of the cantina in Iziz on Onderon during the Onderon Civil War. He was also the arranger of swoop races.
Ejai was a fair-skinned Human with brown hair who served the Galactic Empire as a lieutenant colonel in 19 BBY. With the Empire having formed that year, Ejai was one of the first Imperial officers.
M'sadaar was a disagreeable male Kadas'sa'Nikto swoop racer encountered by Meetra Surik in the cantina in Iziz on Onderon.

Vix was a Rodian male who lived in the city of Iziz on the planet Onderon during the Onderon Civil War in 3951 BBY. He was an avid fan of the local swoop races and visited a local cantina in Iziz to watch them. There, the Rodian talked of nothing but the swoop races.
Gegorran was a Human weapons merchant who had set up shop on the Merchant Quarter of Onderon's only city, Iziz, prior to the Onderon Civil War.

Oondar was a male Duros trader and salesman with close connections to Visquis and the Exchange who was encountered by the Jedi Exile on Nar Shaddaa. He wanted to get rid of fellow merchant Geeda by bribing the Exile.
Rutum was a male Human living as a refugee on Nar Shaddaa in 3951 BBY.
Borna Lys was a Twi'lek female swoop racer who visited the planet Nar Shaddaa.

Nodobo was a male Rodian swoop racer on Nar Shaddaa. When Meetra Surik met him in the year 3951 BBY he had spent all of his credits on upgrading his swoop bike in order to become the champion of the circuit; the prize money was a large enough sum to allow him to leave Nar Shad…
Gurun was a Rodian swoop technician met by Meetra Surik on Nar Shaddaa. He enjoyed the view of the city.

Quello was a pale-skinned Toydarian landing pad owner who was met by Meetra Surik after the landing of the Ebon Hawk in the Refugee Sector on Nar Shaddaa. Quello protested that the landing pad was reserved for other clients, but Surik promised to pay him for his troubles.
Cahhmakt was a Trandoshan pirate and captain of the slaver ship Red Eclipse. The slavemaster fought with a vibro double-blade with which he could be very deadly.

Elglih was an aging male Serp who lived on the planet Serphidi with his wife during the Galactic Civil War. A committed opponent of the Serp King S'Shah, Elglih began training for a deadly Doom-Joust in an effort to seize the throne, despite his advanced age.
Ro Fenn was a corpulent white Twi'lek male who was a member of the Twi'lek Ruling Council of Lessu in 28 BBY. He was the head of Clan Fenn.
Rootrock was the General of Nosaurian rebel forces fighting for the Confederacy of Independent Systems on New Plympto during the Clone Wars.
Anda was a female Human who was a supporter of General Vaklu and a political extremist during the lead-up to the Onderon Civil War.

Twik'gar was a Gran thug on Nar Shaddaa who lived on Nar Shaddaa during the Old Sith Wars. In 3951 BBY, he was accompanied by two Trandoshan mercenaries to capture Geredi, who borrowed him a large sum of credits.
Geredi was a Duros pazaak player in the Pazaak Den on Nar Shaddaa. Twik'gar wanted Meetra Surik to fetch Geredi for a pazaak debt.

Kaalah-Nah was a diminutive yet knowledgeable Chadra-Fan information broker on Nar Shaddaa. She met Meetra Surik near the Pazaak Den, into which she was not permitted. She offered to put a bad word in to the Exchange for Surik, for the right price.
Sarko was a male Human bounty hunter who tried to capture Quinlan Vos on Ord Mantell in 30 BBY.

Yorpo Mog was a brown-hued alien of an unknown species found in the mining colonies of Tyne's Horky. He worked as a assistant bounty hunter for an unscrupulous crime lord, bounty hunter named Kleb Zellock.
Sollag Den, also spelled Zolag, was an alien from Tammuz-an. He was a loyal servant to Prince Mon Julpa and played an integral part in helping Julpa maintain control of the throne.
Dessicus was the leader of the GenoHaradan faction on Nar Shaddaa.
Grissom was a Gamorrean with a strong sense of honor and a noble character.
Tek was a Jawa with a taste for explosions. Stranded on Otunia and blamed for the death of a farmer, Tek was a wanted man with a bounty of twelve thousand credits on his head.

Lod was a Toydarian male slave master who owned a young Human female named Marka during the final years of the New Sith Wars. The two encountered the Sith Master Finn and his apprentice after they destroyed a building on the planet.

Lyshaa was a renowned Zeltron murderer who killed her own family and the Jedi Fe Sun, the Padawan of Jedi Master Shaak Ti. Imprisoned for her crimes on the planet Brentaal IV, she participated in a prison breakout during a battle on the world during the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.

Kleb Zellock was a male Dirconite crime lord who lived on the mining world of Tyne's Horky. He claimed ownership to numerous local businesses in the planet's eponymous town and ran his criminal empire out of the popular Doodnik's Café dining establishment.

Kissek Doran was a Human male who was the father of Wraith Squadron pilot Kell Tainer and also a freighter pilot from the planet Alderaan. During the time around the Battle of Yavin, he joined the Tierfon Yellow Aces along with Jek Tono Porkins and Wes Janson.

Ko Zatec-Cha was a magic user and royal vizier of the planet Tammuz-an. Unsatisfied with his station, he sought to become absolute ruler of the planet and went to extremes to subvert the authority of the ruling monarch, Prince Mon Julpa.
Vinga was a native of Tammuz-an and loyal servant to Ko Zatec-Cha. Vinga's chief function was to sing the vizier's praises, proclaiming him as the rightful heir to the throne of Tammuz-an.

Kara was a Force-sensitive medic training in the ways of the Jedi. She served on board the New Republic picket ship, which discovered the only remaining Outrider-class cruiser belonging to the Order of the Silver Jedi.
Bar Oplut was a male Jedi Knight and a member of the Order of the Silver Jedi.
Duron Veertag was a Human male who served as a major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic by 0 BBY.
Rostat Manr was a male Sullustan fighter pilot.
Carli was a Human male Imperial stormtrooper who in 3 ABY was a member of an expedition led by Lieutenant Mils Giel to investigate the formerly Rebel-held Golrath Station.
Scraper was a Human male Imperial stormtrooper who in 3 ABY was a member of an expedition led by Lieutenant Mils Giel to investigate the formerly Rebel-held Golrath Station.

Arista Kabul was a young female Human from Otunia and the daughter of Lorn Kabul, who owned a mining operation. Despite being a crack shot and perfectly able to take care of herself, her father made her perpetually wear a tracking device around her ankle.
Lorn Kabul, addressed as "Lord Kabul" and "Master Kabul", was the owner of a mining operation on Otunia and the father of Arista Kabul.
Seth Kabul was the brother of the noble Lorn Kabul and the uncle of Arista Kabul.

Gorrlyn was a female Wookiee from Kashyyyk. She was Salporin's wife and participated in the Battle of Kashyyyk during the final days of the Clone Wars. After the formation of the Galactic Empire, Gorrlyn and her spouse were both enslaved and separated.
Jenn was a Human female starfighter pilot who served as a commander in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Till was a Human male starfighter pilot who served as an ensign in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Krane was a Human male who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War and held the rank of admiral.

Ina Rece was a Human female starfighter pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. As part of Rascal Squadron, Rece was sent to the Belt of Arah in 3 ABY to locate and disable the Empire's hidden mining facility.
Darnell Reggs was a Human male BTL Y-wing starfighter pilot who served under Admiral Krane in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Fassa was a gaunt male Rutian Twi'lek who served as dock manager for Vogga the Hutt's docks on the Hutt homeworld Nal Hutta's moon, Nar Shaddaa.

"The Champ" was the nickname for a male Chadra-Fan who lived on Nar Shaddaa, a moon of the planet Nal Hutta, during the time known as the Dark Wars. He was a pazaak champion at the local pazaak den in the Refugee Sector.

Dahnis was a female Twi'lek from Nar Shaddaa. She liked playing Pazaak with men in particular, and so spent much of her time at the Pazaak Den. She also sold cards there. Meetra Surik stumbled upon her when she was searching for one of the missing Jedi Masters, Zez-Kai Ell.

Geeda was a female Rodian from Nar Shaddaa. She was a trader and owned a shop on the Smugglers' Moon while working as a spy for the Republic. Geeda encountered Meetra Surik when the latter came to the planet in search for Zez-Kai Ell, a missing Jedi Master.
Kirby was a starfighter pilot who held the rank of commander in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Deyd Llnewe was an Imperial captain just prior to the Battle of Yavin. He was in command of the Carrack-class cruiser Vigilant.
Bens Figg was an Imperial stormtrooper who, in 3 ABY, served in Lieutenant Mils Giel's expedition to investigate the formerly Rebel-held Golrath Station.
Bardan Jusik, later known as Bardan Skirata, was a Mandalorian Human male who donned a Beskar'gam and joined Clan Skirata and lived on Kyrimorut in the northern hemisphere of Mandalore.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Vandolay was a Human who served as the Imperial Security Bureau attaché aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor during the Galactic Civil War.
Trenox was a Force-sensitive Human Dark Acolyte who served as one of Count Dooku's devoted apprentices during the Clone Wars.

Warkin was a huge, unkempt male Wookiee who didn't brush his hair and cared little for his appearance. He was easily provoked into Wookiee rage, and only Jedgar was able to keep him from lashing out randomly.
The Force Vampire, formerly known as Jedi Knight Tel Angor, was the result of the Order of the Silver Jedi's experiments into creating a living symbol of the light side of the Force.
Taepalae was a Human female and the leader of a small group of salvagers on Dantooine.

Lasavvou was a male Ithorian stranded on the moon Nar Shaddaa after the Jedi Civil War. The Ithorian couriered assorted cargo around the galaxy and was in the middle of such a delivery in 3951 BBY, taking a large shipment of cryogenic power cells to a contact that was supposed…
Modo So was a male Aqualish who managed the Nar Shaddaa swoop circuit owned by Lupo Shar in 3951 BBY.

Fahjay was a Force-sensitive individual who once saved Admiral Ackbar's life from two terrorists. He kicked the door open into the room in which Ackbar was being held captive and immediately saw one terrorist with a knife at Ackbar's throat and the other reaching for a switch …
Mongei Shai was a male Yuuzhan Vong warrior and the grandfather of Shedao Shai.

Commander Darnak was in command of the Radra Surveillance Post on the planet Radra IV. He helped fight off a snowtrooper attack when a group of rebels came to get equipment from the base and later joined them in evacuating aboard the Starhound.
Zalk't was the Vratix senator of Thyferra in the Galactic Alliance Senate during the Swarm War. He was on Coruscant at the time of the Tarhead Coup.

Castin Donn was a Human male from Coruscant who was a member of the New Republic commando group Wraith Squadron. In 7.5 ABY, Donn was brought in to replace the Wraiths' former slicer, Eurrsk Thri'ag, during the New Republic's campaign against Warlord Zsinj.
Shalla Nelprin was a female Human X-wing pilot from Wraith Squadron who was selected for her proficiency in hand-to-hand combat, and for her knowledge of Imperial Intelligence doctrine and tactics.

Vula Nelprin was a Human female hand-to-hand combat instructor for the New Republic. She was the sister of Wraith Squadron pilot Shalla Nelprin, and the daughter of Old Republic intelligence officer Vyn Narcassan.

Elassar Targon was a superstitious male Devaronian from Devaron. He joined the New Republic Defense Force and eventually served in Wraith Squadron as the unit medic in the campaign against Warlord Zsinj.
Morvet Storm was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Bhindi Drayson was a Human female and daughter of New Republic Admiral Hiram Drayson. She served with Wraith Squadron as a tactics expert during the Yuuzhan Vong War, and was with the Wraiths on Borleias after the Battle of Coruscant.
Kallos Sook was the first regent of Kaadara, a small city located on the Mid Rim world of Naboo. Sook was remembered for hiring a large contingent of Gungans to act as the city's security force.
Harro Ruuk was an ambitious and somewhat violent male Neimoidian who served the Trade Federation during the Separatist Crisis and the beginning of the Clone Wars.

Kosh Kurp was a male Pantoran who worked as an explosives expert for the Galactic Empire. Having witnessed his families' murder as a child during the riots on his homeworld of Intuci, he vowed to exact revenge on Sonopo Bomoor, the Governor responsible for the massacres.
Astri Oddo was a cook, adopted daughter of Didi Oddo, and pre-owner of Dex's Diner.
Evan was a young Human farmboy from the planet Garqi.
Of course, he was simply planning on leading the group of Rebels down to the hangar personally where he had set an ambush for them to be captured and imprisoned along with the others.
Lieutenant Yima was a female officer in the Telos Security Force following the Jedi Civil War. Dol Grenn assigned her to investigate how the Batu Rem impostor infiltrated the TSF.

Soka Linu was a Human female officer who served in the Telos Security Force during the Dark Wars. In 3951 BBY, she and others guarded Meetra Surik, Kreia, and Atton Rand when they were placed on house arrest on the Citadel Station.
Harra was a Twi'lek living on Citadel Station, an orbital space station above Telos IV, in the year 3951 BBY. He worked for Czerka Corporation as a data processor.
Ramana was a green-skinned female Twi'lek who lived during the Old Republic era. Ramana was enslaved by a male Twi'lek, Doton Het on Telos IV after her partner Harra traded her away in a lost bet.

Doton Het was a male Twi'lek who won Ramana from a pazaak game from Harra. Harra had begged for him to give her back and found that the price was 2,000 credits. Eventually Harra would send Meetra Surik to free Ramana.

Batono was a Human male and a former employee of Czerka Corporation. He disagreed with many of their practices and began to seek shelter with the Ithorians on Citadel Station. The leader of the Ithorians, Chodo Habat, put Batono in a secure apartment.

Sien was the Mine Foreman of the Peragus Mining Facility leading up to the Skirmish at Peragus II in 3951 BBY. He was a part of the facility staff when the Jedi Exile, fleeing from Darth Sion, was brought to Peragus aboard a critically damaged Ebon Hawk.
Bik was a male Twi'lek who lived on Nar Shaddaa. During Meetra Surik's visit to the Smugglers' Moon she visited the swoop racing establishment there.
Zag, or RC-2088, was a Clone commando and sergeant of a team of clone commandos. Later, after the rest of his team was killed in action, he was reassigned to Aiwha Squad.
Lorca Oviedo was a Human who served the Galactic Republic as the director of Oviedo Engineering, a corporation that built military weaponry, holding the title of Director General.
Dellis Tantor was a young stormtrooper recruit whose brother's success helped advance his career until he could bring his considerable talents to Imperial Intelligence.
Carsan was a Human Imperial Army officer and part of the Anti-Sith conspiracy. He was responsible for training Grand Moff Trachta's clone stormtroopers.
Gauer was an assassin and agent employed by the Galactic Empire, and a conspirator in Grand Moff Trachta's plan to overthrow the Sith in 1 BBY.
Riv Shiel was a male Shistavanen pilot who joined Rogue Squadron after the Battle of Endor.
Basso and his older brother Jiir were members of the Ralltiir resistance just before the Battle of Yavin.
Jiir was a male Human who joined the Rebel Alliance and was the older brother of Basso. They were both in the Ralltiir resistance, just prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Mia Ikova was a Human female who was the elected leader of Haleodaon, capital city of the Colonies planet Kattada and also served as a Rebel Alliance sympathizer during the Galactic Civil War.
Glurrg was a male pirate who served under Captain Huba in the Indobok Pirates.

Mya Nalle was one of the Nalle triplets, a trio of Human females offered by Mayor Acros-Krik as guides to targets he wanted monitored. She reported to the mayor any useful information their guests foolishly divulged.

Yma Nalle was one of the Nalle triplets, a trio of Humans offered by Mayor Acros-Krik as guides to targets he wanted monitored. She reported to the mayor any useful information their guests foolishly divulged.

Ganwick Trag was a Human male bartender who worked as fellow bartender Bufon Taire's assistant at the Outlander Club, an establishment located in the Uscru Entertainment District of the planet Coruscant.

Immi Danoo was a stylish Human female from the planet Coruscant who was friends with Nyrat Agira and Rosha Vess. In 22 BBY, she was inside the Outlander Club on Coruscant with her friends at the same time as bounty hunters Jango Fett and Zam Wesell.

Bren Derlin was a human male officer of the Rebel Alliance. Bearing the rank of Major, Derlin served as the operations and security chief at Echo Base, the Alliance headquarters on the planet Hoth, under the command of General Carlist Rieekan.
Grond was a Human male member of the Alliance Military's 4th Squad, which was under the command of Corporal Jobin during the Galactic Civil War.

Jielu was a member of the Alliance Military's 4th Squad, which was under the command of Corporal Jobin, during the war against the Galactic Empire. In the year 3 ABY, he was stationed at Echo Station 5-7 in the beginning of the Battle of Hoth.
Roj was a Human male who served as an enlisted trooper within the Alliance Military's 4th Squad, which was under the command of Corporal Jobin.
Sora was a member of the Alliance Military's 4th Squad, under the command of Corporal Jobin. He was also a pilot.

Rikummee was a brash and trouble-prone Wookiee male who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was the son of the Wookiee royal King Grakchawwaa, and so lived as a prince on his species' homeworld of Kashyyyk.

Ghraggka was a Wookiee warrior living on Kashyyyk during the time of the Clone Wars. The Wookiee was assigned by King Grakchawwaa to watch over his son, Prince Rikummee. Ghraggka was unable to save the prince from Separatist probe droids, however.
Smada the Hutt was a powerful crime lord who employed Gank killers as bodyguards, similar to the way Jabba Desilijic Tiure employed Gamorreans.

Alistar Dadefra was a Human male who served as the captain of the Victory-class Star Destroyer Bombard during the Battle of Khuiumin. He later commanded the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Brazen in the Elrood sector.
Heliesk was a Human male Imperial captain who commanded the Rand Ecliptic during the Galactic Civil War, with Biggs Darklighter and Derek Klivian as his executive officers.
Peate Kurin was a Human male Imperial TIE pilot who served the Galactic Empire until he joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a member of Twilight Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Jynne Celwik was a Human female waitress at the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant prior to the Clone Wars.

Ror Ithh was an unsavory Ithorian cantina crawler and carouser who frequented the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall in the Uscru Entertainment District of the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, in the years surrounding the First Battle of Geonosis of 22 BBY.

Booton Piton was a Human female who, in 22 BBY, visited the Uscru Entertainment District of the planet Coruscant. While walking in the district, the Human witnessed bounty hunter Zam Wesell's airspeeder descending down into the district.

Seib Nod was a Lorrdian female member of the Sisterhood of the Beatific Countenance on the planet Lorrd. A lifelong member, she grew bored of her cloistered lifestyle and opted for a life of crime instead.

Di Mantid was a Human female from the planet Coruscant. Mantid and her acquaintances Nyrat Agira and Wilst Molan visted the Outlander Club in the Uscru Entertainment District of the planet, seeking out a rich and powerful mate.

Nardi Shodu was a Rodian female who frequented the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant. In 22 BBY, she visited the planet's Uscru Entertainment District, approaching the crash site of bounty hunter Zam Wesell's airspeeder.

Necil Sing was a Human female from the planet Coruscant. In 22 BBY, she visited the Outlander Club in on that planet. During her visit, the bounty hunter Zam Wesell hid in the club from the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.

Sne Wo was a Human female with dark hair and light skin. During a night in 22 BBY, the woman visited the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall in the Uscru Entertainment District of the planet Coruscant.

Kell Borean was a Human female from the planet Coruscant who frequented the Outlander Club prior to the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY. She seemed to be a permanent fixture around the club's gambling tables despite not being an employee.

Wilst Molan was a Human female from the planet Coruscant who frequented the Outlander Club in the Uscru Entertainment District of the planet. At the club, she and her acquaintances Nyrat Agira and Di Mantid sought out a rich and powerful mate.
Jib Kopatha was a male Bothan information broker stationed on Void Station, he was killed by Darth Vader for his failure to provide information.
Tabbins Vee was an Imperial stormtrooper who, in 3 ABY, served in Lieutenant Mils Giel's expedition to investigate the formerly Rebel-held Golrath Station.

Kazak was First Elder of the Ewok Council of Elders and an advisor to Chief Chirpa. He was light-gray/blue fur skinned and wore a brown hood. He was also one of the many Ewoks that aided the Rebel Alliance in the Battle of Endor.
Orsaa was a Rakata of Lehon who was a member of the Elders, a group of Rakata who refused to revert to cannibalism and barbarism like the tribes led by The One.

Strok was an Imperial officer in the staff of High General Touno in the southern district of the planet Svivren. A blond-haired blue-eyed Human male, he was also a spy for both Black Sun and Black Nebula.
Cevva Xuz was a Rodian male living in the city of Wrils on the planet Svivren as of 4 ABY. Imperial authorities suspected him of ties to the Rebellion.
Tal Burren was a grade-four tech of Imperial Intelligence as of 4 ABY. His superior was Ivak.

Gorb Drig was a male Houk owner of a cantina on Phorliss. His son was killed during one of the Houks' wars. In 4 ABY, he took Mara Jade on as a waitress in his cantina. A few weeks later, he was murdered by several Black Nebula thugs during an extortion attempt.

Jorshmin was a frequent customer at the cantina of Gorb Drig on Phorliss. He and Mara Jade struck up a friendship during her few weeks as a waitress there. He was killed in 4 ABY by Black Nebula members coming to extort credits from Drig.

Shoran was a male Wookiee and a close friend of the famous Wookiees Chewbacca and Attichitcuk. Shoran was one of the main leaders in the colonization of the moon Alaris Prime, where he, Chewbacca and Attichitcuk fought the Trade Federation for the rights to the world.

Gir Kybo Ren-Cha, commonly known as Kybo Ren, was a male Ropagu space pirate active during the early years of the Galactic Empire. Operating out of a base on his homeworld of Tarnoonga, Ren's crew frequently raided shipping in the vicinity of the planet Tammuz-an.
Dirk Harkness was an independent Rebel operative from Salliche. He wore an eye patch over his left eye.
Plattahr was a Black Nebula enforcer on the planet Phorliss. He was killed by Mara Jade in 4 ABY when he attempted to extort Gorb Drig.
Clomv was a Jeodu member of Black Nebula, a personal guard for Dequc as of 4 ABY.
Eoodso was a Jeodu member of Black Nebula, a personal guard for Dequc as of 4.5 ABY.
Chackra was a male Jeodu who served as a member of Black Nebula, a personal guard for Dequc during the Galactic Civil War. He was killed by Mara Jade.

Hayde Gofai was a Human female club-hopper from the planet Coruscant. In 22 BBY, she socialized with the fellow Human Sne Wo at the Outlander Club on Coruscant when the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker entered, searching for bounty hunter Zam Wesell.

Lela Nalle Mayn was a female Human from Commenor who studied architecture at Coruscant University. As one of the Nalle triplets she worked for the corrupt Mayor Acros-Krik as a spy and was in the Outlander Club on Coruscant before the outbreak of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.

Lillea Bringbit, a Human female, hailed from the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. Around the time of the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic, she frequented the Uscru Entertainment District of her homeworld.

Palee Ruda was a Human female clubgoer native to the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. During a night in 22 BBY, Ruda visited the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall in the Uscru Entertainment District of Coruscant.

Rosha Vess was a Human female from the planet Coruscant who was a member of the Zealots of Psusan cult. In 22 BBY, she was inside the Outlander Club on Coruscant with her friends Nyrat Agira and Immi Danoo at the same time as bounty hunters Jango Fett and Zam Wesell.

Whimper Save was a mysterious Human female who, in 22 BBY, was on the planet Coruscant inside the Outlander Club with the con artist Dannl Faytonni while the bounty hunters Jango Fett and Zam Wesell visited.

Yee Moh was a rather lonely-looking Neimoidian male who lost his job by 22 BBY. During a night in that year, Moh visited the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall in the Uscru Entertainment District on the planet Coruscant, and found companionship with the Neimoidian s…

Daro Willits was a Human who visited the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant, spending a great deal of time with the socialite Sel Maa when she visited during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.
Onyeth Canavar was a Tarnab male who roamed the alleys and visited the streets of the Uscru Entertainment District of the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.
Zey Nep was a Human female from the planet Coruscant. She frequented the Outlander Club on her homeworld, was friends with Dixon Just and Civ Sila, and was mentored by the archeologist Artuo Pratuhr.

Ren-Quarr was a Quarren barfly with orange skin and well-groomed tentacles. He frequented the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall located in the Uscru Entertainment District of the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.
Artuo Pratuhr was a Human archaeologist who was the mentor of his assistant Zey Nep, and a patron of the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant in the final days of the Galactic Republic.
Nic Whoma was an unsavory Gran gambler. During a night in 22 BBY, the Gran attended the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

Dixon Just was a Human who frequented the underworld of the planet Coruscant in the years before the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY. That year, he visited the Outlander Club on Coruscant with his friends Zey Nep, Artuo Pratuhr, and Civ Sila.
Civ Sila was a Human individual. In 22 BBY, they visited the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant with their friends Zey Nep and Dixon Just, and their associate Artuo Pratuhr.
Todra Mayn was a Human female from Commenor who served the New Republic and later the Galactic Alliance during the Yuuzhan Vong War. She was the daughter of Lela Nalle Mayn.
Jyn Obah was a Schiav space pirate and first mate to Captain Gir Kybo Ren-Cha during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.
Malka was a Human male Colonel who served in the Imperial Navy, and served aboard Admiral Mils Giel's flagship during the Galactic Civil War.
Facet Anamor was a female Human and the daughter of Druth Anamor.

Ganne was an Ankura Gungan who served as the boss of the city Rellias on the planet Naboo. In 32 BBY, during the Trade Federation's Invasion of Naboo, Ganne was sought out by the Federation-aligned Sith apprentice Darth Maul so that the Trade Federation Droid Army could attack…
Vermilion was a Human male who was the leader of the Rebel Alliance cell on Toprawa. In order to avoid Imperial attention Vermilion took on several codenames, including Scarlett and Carmile.
Turr Phennir was a Human male hailing from the Valahari Provinces who served for years as an ace starfighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 181st Imperial Fighter Group.

Mulchive Wermis was a Human male captain of the Star Destroyer Devastator while that vessel was the flagship of Darth Vader, and at times felt the grip of Vader's Force choke. Wermis was a coward, and Vader enjoyed tormenting him psychologically.

Kit was a Tintinna associate of the mechanic Shug Ninx. When the spacer first met the Tintinna, he mistook the being for a non-sentient animal. He found the Tintinna incredibly cute, so he took him in as a pet on his ship and named him Kit.
Reezen was a Force-sensitive Human male who served as a corporal within the faction of the former Galactic Empire that served under Warlord Zsinj in 8 ABY.
Gal Brello was an Imperial Moff who governed the Trans-Nebular sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Nebo was a Human male street philosopher and Naddist who preached the virtues of a Naddist regime in the Onderonian capital city of Iziz in the years leading up to the Great Sith War.
Rask was a Human male and native of the planet Onderon who worked as a street preacher and philosopher in the Onderonian capital city of Iziz in the years leading up to the Great Sith War.

Sixtus Quin was an Imperial Special Intelligence operative who later defected to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He eventually left the Rebel Alliance and went into business with Elscol Loro, forming an anti-Imperial mercenary organization.
Ban Papeega was an avian agent of the Galactic Empire who worked for the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader shortly after the Battle of Yavin.
Jal Te Gniev was an experienced but argumentative Human male pilot for the Rebel Alliance.
Nevana was a female Dubravan and local dweller at the cantina on Dubrava.
Sarma was a Dubravan bounty hunter on Dubrava following the Battle of Yavin.
Choraw was a Jazbinan guide for Luke Skywalker while he "rescued" Princess Syayna on Jazbina. Choraw disappeared upon the arrival of a Tikulini.
Prepredenko was ruler of Jazbina and father of Princess Syayna.
Syayna was the Jazbinan Princess of Jazbina after the Battle of Yavin.
Raol was a Jazbinan resistance fighter for the Rebel Alliance and lover of Princess Syayna.
Tookarti was a Chadra-Fan denizen of the Wheel during the early days of the Clone Wars.
Sebb was a local Jazbinan bar fly on Jazbina.
Mala Mala was a crippled and burned spy of the Sephi species.
Selle was a Human bounty hunter who, along with their brother Brazzo, worked to find who destroyed of the Galactic Empire's Death Star battle station.
Lord Malameu Toda was a Tammuz-an warrior-chieftain from the planet of the same name. He lived in a large castle with his feisty daughter Gerin and his idealist son Coby.
Vien'sai'Malloc was a female Devaronian senator who jointly represented Devaron in the Galactic Senate with her colleague, Elsah'sai'Moro.
Aven'sai'Ulrahk was a female Devaronian and the President of Devaron during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, she continued a policy of supporting the Galactic Republic.

Has Doneeta was a male Twi'lek and the owner of Ryloth Ventures. His daughter was Tuulaa Doneeta. He had holdings throughout the galaxy, and his daughter was raised in a variety of places. In 22 BBY, he was interested in opening trade on Devaron.

Fenn Booda was the alien warden of Desolation Alley, a prison and labor camp located on the moon Oovo IV that was affiliated with the Correctional Authority of the Galactic Republic by the year 32 BBY.
Ceok Orou'cya was a Bothan male and First Secretary of the Bothan Council during the Caamas Document Crisis.
Gatrar Shey'Tyan was male Bothan who was the last Bothan Ambassador of Bothawui to the Galactic Empire.

Karaksk Vey'lya was a Bothan male who joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems, serving as a Chief of Staff to Admiral Pors Tonith during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Praesitlyn, he was captured by Anakin Skywalker and his troops.

Koth Melan was a male Bothan spymaster and head of the Bothan Spynet during the Galactic Civil War. After the Galactic Empire executed his father in 17 BBY for supposed espionage, Melan was sympathetic to the Alliance to Restore the Republic and sought to help them in order to…
Kursk Mal'ia was a Bothan naval officer serving the New Republic, noted as both a combat commander and a military analyst.
Brasck was a Brubb smuggler and mercenary.

Par'tah was a female Ho'Din smuggler who worked for Billey and was one of the few who agreed with Talon Karrde's arguments in favor of a unified front at the first meeting of the Smugglers' Alliance before the raid by Lieutenant Reynol Kosk's forces.
Samuel Tomas Gillespee was the head of a small but respected smuggling group. He was a well-known criminal with a reputation as a con-artist and not always paying the pilots under his employ.
Ellor was a Duros smuggler who worked for Billey.
Rei'Kas, sometimes known as Rei'Kas the Rodian, was a Rodian slaver and pirate.

Zeena was a yellow-skinned female Twi'lek living in Ahto City on the planet Manaan in and around 3956 BBY. As an amateur swoop racer, she would refuse to talk to anyone unless they were a racer as well.
Yortal Ixlis was a male Ithorian who lived in Ahto City during the Jedi Civil War. Around 3956 BBY, he owned Yortal's Emporium and was often harassed by the local Sith.
Vek was an Almanian male who was personally saved by Kueller, during one of the former's attacks on the populace.
Tyvark Luowan was a male Rodian who ran a store in Ahto City, selling Aratech equipment during the Jedi Civil War.
T'sllth was a Selkath male who worked with Sslamoth to run the swoop races in Ahto City in 3956 BBY. With Sslamoth, they cooperated the Ahto City swoop track.
Sslamoth was a Selkath male who worked with T'sllth to run the swoop races in Ahto City 3956 BBY. Together with T'sllth, the duo operated the Ahto City swoop track.

Queedle Molto was a male Ithorian from Ando who was an amateur swoop racer in Ahto City on the aquatic planet Manaan. In 3956 BBY, he raced on the Ahto City swoop track, and met the mind-wiped Jedi Revan during his visit to Manaan.

Jolan Aphett was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto who had been tutored in the game of pazaak by Daoy during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, he was traveling around the galaxy attempting to build up his pazaak deck so that he could be good enough to be in the championships.
Ignus was a Human male who was the owner and proprietor of the Visitor's Hotel in Ahto City during the Jedi Civil War.

Hukta Jax was a male Gamorrean who was one of the professional swoop racers that Revan met in Ahto City during the Jedi Civil War. Around 3956 BBY, he held the position of Sector Champion, having raced on the Ahto City swoop track, until Revan beat his record.

Gonto Yas was an elderly Human male pazaak gambler who Revan met in Ahto City in 3956 BBY. When Revan asked him about the missing Selkath he attempted to charge him two hundred credits for some information.
Firith Me was a male Human pazaak addict staying at the Visitor's Hotel in Ahto City on Manaan during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, he was a witness in the Sunry case.
Casandra Mateil was a female yellow-skinned Twi'lek who worked as a professional swoop racer during the Jedi Civil War.
Zoriis Bafka was a female Twi'lek with green skin, who was one of the professional swoop racers Revan met in Anchorhead in 3956 BBY.

Yuka Rill was a male Ithorian swoop racer who lived in Anchorhead in 3956 BBY. In 3958 BBY, he was involved in a large crash during a race on Taris. He had the top time of the second-tier. Rill had raced for many years, but rode an aging swoop.
Ugzak was a bull Gamorrean hunter dwelling in Anchorhead 3956 BBY, a partner of Narkal and Gurke. He attempted to kill Revan along with his friends in the wastes, but was persuaded out of it.

Sheyvan was a Force-sensitive Human male assassin who, in the early years of the Galactic Empire, served as one of the Emperor's Hands. He was assigned to train the cloned stormtroopers of the deceased Dark Jedi Sa Cuis in the techniques of lightsaber and Force combat.
Bearsh was the Vagaari General during the Battle of the Redoubt in 22 ABY.
Ingey was a small, white feline animal identified as a Tessellated Arboreal binjinphant.
Coby was a young boy who lived on the planet Tammuz-an around 15 BBY.

Katya M'Buele was a Corellian smuggler who was an early flame of Han Solo, with whom she served on the crew of a Corellian rim-runner. M'Buele flew with Solo during the Battle of Ylesia, and the two Corellians were the only two survivors of a doomed smuggling mission to Skye.

Gerin Toda was a young woman who lived on Tammuz-an. She was the daughter of warlord-chieftain Lord Malameu Toda and older sister to the young boy Coby. Several years prior to the Battle of Yavin, Toda's rival King Mon Julpa arrived at Toda's castle offering a charter of peace.

Nico Senvi was a male green Twi'lek. He was one of the swoop racers that Revan met in Anchorhead 3956 BBY and the local favorite. Nico was a skilled swoop pilot, ready to tackle the intergalactic circuit.

Narkal was a bull Gamorrean hunter dwelling in Anchorhead on Tatooine during the Jedi Civil War. Narkal was noted for his talkativeness, which wound up fellow hunters Ugzak and Gurke. Both of the other Gamorreans thought of Narkal as stupid, and frequently told him to shut up.

Mic'Tunan'Jus Orgu was a Paaerduag merchant. Around 3956 BBY, he took up residence in Anchorhead, Tatooine. Orgu had a kiosk set up in Czerka Corporation's docking bay, plying their wares to travelers.

Kudos was a Rodian who stayed in the settlement Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine when their ship broke down and they had to wait for parts. Kudos did not step foot outside of Anchorhead, and didn't understand why anyone would.

Junix Nard was a Human male. He was the owner and bartender of the Junix's Joint cantina in Anchorhead on Tatooine. He also ran a small store within the cantina where he sold pazaak cards, among other goods.

Greeta Holda was a Rodian living in Anchorhead on Tatooine prior to and during the Jedi Civil War. An employee of the Czerka Corporation, she sold standard provisions and supplies at the settlement's general store.
Garm Totryl was a male Rodian who was living in Anchorhead, on the desert world of Tatooine during the Jedi Civil War.
Furko Nellis was a Human male living during the time of the Jedi Civil War. He was an experienced pazaak gambler who Revan encountered in Anchorhead on Tatooine in 3956 BBY.
Sharina Fizark was a Human female whom Revan met in Anchorhead on Tatooine in the year 3956 BBY.

Dorak Quinn was a male Human hunter whom Revan met in Anchorhead during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, he was one of the newer hunters on Tatooine. Dorak was, at first, rude to Revan when he met him in Fazza's Hunting Lodge.

Aia was a male humanoid thief that lived on the moon known as Bogg 4, one of the numerous small satellites circling the planet Bogden. Aia was tall and lean, with white feather-like hair and webbed hands.
Gjon, also known as Honest Gjon, was a male H'drachi who lived on the various moons of Bogden during the Clone Wars. Gjon owned a landing pad on the moon of Bogg 4 and a repair shop on Bogg 11.
Peckhum was a male spacer who owned the freighters Lightning Rod and Thunderbolt.

Nan Mercador was the proprietor of a drinking establishment on Coruscant known as the Golden Cuff Tavern. Throughout his long career, Nan developed a network of contacts within the bounty hunter community and used his bar as a stopgap locale for luring wanted marks to their doom.

Iolan Gendarr was a male Human from Commenor who served the Galactic Empire as an officer in the Imperial Navy. Promoted to the rank of captain following the Battle of Hoth, Gendarr was assigned as the commanding officer of the Star Destroyer Reliance.

Quelev Tapper was a Human male smuggler who operated during the Galactic Civil War. Formerly the head of his own organization, Tapper agreed to merge with fellow smuggler Talon Karrde's smuggling group after Imperial forces leveled his headquarters and destroyed three quarters…
Hoffner was a smuggler who worked for Jorj Car'das alongside Talon Karrde.
Bel Att was a male Iotran who served as a member of the Black Sun and an enforcer for the crimelord Sprax during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Bullkey was a member of the Brommstaad boys. In 2 ABY, he was ordered by Grobber to escort Maranne Darmic and Riij Winward back to Zekka Thyne's fortress, along with Promk and Selty. He was rendered unconscious by Rathe Palror before he could complete the task.
Deif was a member of the Brommstaad Mercenaries. He was stunned by Corran Horn and then later captured by Imperials during a raid on Zekka Thyne's fortress.
Gargachykk, or Garga, was a Wookiee enforcer in the employ of Vigo Darnada of the Black Sun crime syndicate.

Grobber was an underling of Black Sun, sent by Zekka Thyne to capture Rebel agent Riij Winward and trader Maranne Darmic in Mynock's Haven cantina in Coronet, on Corellia. He was also a member of the Brommstaad Mercenaries.
Gyran was a male Human bounty hunter who worked for Black Sun.
Kymn was a member of Black Sun in 24 ABY.
Asa Naga was a member of Black Sun, in which he was an enforcer for Vigo Darnada.
Zan Pike was a female Epicanthix and the twin sister of Zu Pike. The only way to tell them apart was the fact that Zan had green eyes whereas Zu had one green and one blue eye.
Zu Pike was a female Epicanthix and the twin sister of Zan Pike. The only way to tell them apart was the fact that Zan had green eyes and Zu had a green eye and a blue eye.
Kalend Thora was a smuggler who worked for Black Sun.

Limna Yith was a one-time agent of Black Sun. She was born on Kerest after the collapse of its civilization, becoming a ruthless mercenary. Amongst other misdeeds, she was implicated in the bombing of the Alaspin casino, killing the criminal Kassandre family in the process.
Oolth was a Fondorian male servant of Black Sun and the only survivor of Darth Maul's attack on Black Sun's Ralltiir fortress in 33 BBY.
Shotarr Kass was a Tunroth who worked as the chief bodyguard for Black Sun Vigo Sprax.
Antonin was a male Human who served as a Vigo of Black Sun prior to the Clone Wars.
Clezo was a Rodian of the Chattza clan and Vigo of Black Sun during the time of Prince Xizor.
Kreet'ah was a Kian'thar Vigo of Black Sun during Prince Xizor's time.

Lonay was a male Twi'lek Vigo of Black Sun during the time of Prince Xizor's reign, and a cousin of smuggler Tru'eb Cholakk. He was described as sly, clever, and cowardly. He wore his lekku draped over his left shoulder, and was usually seen wearing garish jewelry.
Perit was a Mon Calamari Vigo of Black Sun during the time of Prince Xizor.
Vekker was a male Quarren Vigo of Black Sun during Prince Xizor's reign.
Wumdi was an Etti Vigo of Black Sun during Prince Xizor's reign.

Yanth was a member of the Hutt species, and was a Vigo of Black Sun. He owned the Tusken Oasis nightclub. In 32 BBY, he was interested in buying a holocron from Lorn Pavan, containing information about the Invasion of Naboo for half a million credits.
Czethros was a leader of Black Sun in 24 ABY. His face was concealed beneath a visor and he had a single cybernetic eye that glowed red. Czethros also had green hair.

Ziagrom was a male green Twi'lek businessman Revan met in Dreshdae, 3956 BBY. He was Mika Dorin's partner. Through several contacts he had in the Sith fleet, he subsequently learned of the amnesiac Revan's true identity as the former Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Revan.

Toll Apkar was a Rodian gambler who lived during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. In 3956 BBY, they were present in the settlement of Dreshdae on the Sith world of Korriban.

Tariga was a male Human raised on a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. She spoke the Twi'lek language rather than Basic as her native tongue. She was a student at the Sith Academy on Korriban 3956 BBY.
Tamlen was a male Human Sith Acolyte and a member of the Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War.

Shaardan was a male Human who was a prospective student of the Sith Academy on Korriban during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, he would go into the local colony of Dreshdae and intimidate and embarrass the locals.

Mika Dorin was a Rodian male who worked as the manager of The Drunk Side, a cantina in Dreshdae on Korriban, in 3956 BBY during the Jedi Civil War. He, along with his partner Ziagrom, learned of the amnesiac Revan's true identity after the Ebon Hawk capture by the Leviathan.

Lurze Kesh was a male Rodian who met Revan in Dreshdae on Korriban, in 3956 BBY. He had been expecting a cargo of spice from Davik Kang, and hoped Revan had it on the Ebon Hawk, Davik's former ship. He also gave Revan a Rakatan prison to deliver to Motta the Hutt on Tatooine.

Luo was a male Rakata warrior serving under the One in 3956 BBY. Luo spent most of his time at the entrance to the black Rakata enclave, where he hoped someone would teach him how to become a great warrior.

Ll'awa was a male Rakata Elder and researcher, attempting to restore Force-sensitivity to the Rakata species. He hoped to achieve this by breeding potential Force-sensitive individuals to re-inherit the ability to use the Force—which they had possessed in times past.
Hijata was a Human. He was a student at the Sith Academy on Korriban in the year of 3956 BBY.

Gjarshi was a male Black Rakata. It was his job to chronicle the conquests and achievements of The One. When Revan visited the Rakata for a second time, he chose to side with the Elders—which angered The One, who then attacked Revan, but was slain.

Galon Lor was a Human male student at the Sith Academy on Korriban during the Jedi Civil War. During his absence from the academy, he was working on translating the ruins of some of the tombs of Korriban.
Dak Vesser was a Human male Padawan who served the Jedi Order at the Enclave on Dantooine during the Mandalorian Wars. He was also a close friend of Juhani.
Adrenas was a male Human from the Outer Rim who spoke Ryl rather than Basic as his native tongue. Although he could also speak Basic, he refused because he feared his strong accent would be mocked.

B'ree was a Rodian male weapons merchant who lived on the Outer Rim Sith world of Korriban during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire. He ran a kiosk in the settlement of Dreshdae, at which he sold weapons.
Harmon was a human male who served against the Empire with the Mykapo insurgents in Iron Squadron.
Krai H'voc was a Nagai and mother of Ozrei N'takkilomandrife and Bey.

Lusubrin T'shkali, also known as Brin was a Nagai who fought in the Nagai–Tof War. Before that time he competed in the Dool Arena at The Broken Tusk as a top contender challenging the reign of champion Tull Raine.
Worrroznor was a male Wookiee who was living in Rwookrrorro Village on the world of Kashyyyk around 3956 BBY, during the Jedi Civil War.
Woorwill was a young male Wookiee living in Rwookrrorro village in 3956 BBY. Like most of the youth in his village, he was a great admirer of the famous hunter Rorworr.
Rorworr was a male Wookiee who lived in Rwookrrorro Village on Kashyyyk in 3956 BBY, during the time of the Jedi Civil War.
Matton Dasol was a male Human starship mechanic living on Kashyyyk in 3956 BBY as an indentured servant of Eli Gand.

Janos Wertka was an Ithorian male who was the administrator of the Czerka Corporation outpost on Kashyyyk near Rwookrrorro in 3956 BBY. Unlike most of his species, he seemed to have little regard for life, and was more than willing to exploit Kashyyyk and the Wookiees.
Jaarak was a male Wookiee living in Rwookrrorro village on Kashyyyk in 3956 BBY.
Grrrwahrr was a male Wookiee hunter living in Rwookrrorro in 3956 BBY.
Dern was a male Human serving as a Czerka Corporation patrol officer on Kashyyyk in 3956 BBY.

Maban was a male Human who was a miner at the Peragus Mining Facility. When HK-50 took control of the facility in 3951 BBY and turned the droids of Peragus on the miners, he retreated to the facility's dormitories.
Dezanti Zhug was a Duros male bounty hunter from Duro who was a leader of the Zhug brothers bounty hunter organization.

Laane was a Human male scout in the Onderonian military. In 3951 BBY, during the Dark Wars, he was part of the Onderon separatists that followed General Vaklu in the Onderon Civil War against the Republic-backed Onderonian Queen Talia.

Pepin was the navigation officer of one of Emperor Palpatine's Lambda-class shuttles during the time of the Galactic Empire. He, along with Erv Lekauf, helped Darth Vader quell a mutiny of stormtroopers onboard the shuttle, led by the Emperor's Hand Sheyvan.

Tolas was an elderly Human male living on Onderon in 3951 BBY. Tolas was a successful merchant who was not afraid to utilize shady practices to make money, though all his dealings were legal, as he said.

Kadron was a Human male who served as a captain in the Onderonian military. Assigned to the position of head of Royal Palace security in the Onderonian capital of Iziz, he was the leader of the Royalist forces protecting Queen Talia from her cousin, General Vaklu who, with the…

Jonra Far was a female Twi'lek swoop racer from Onderon. She was known to have had the best swoop track record on Onderon. She looked down upon both Panar, for being a thug, and M'sadaar, for racing only to earn credits.

Gelesi was a Human male who lived in the planet of Onderon's walled city of Iziz with his wife and daughter. In 3951 BBY, after his superior officer and good friend, Sullio, was murdered outside a cantina, he inherited her rank as Captain of the Guard and her former post.
Azanti Zhug was a male Duros bounty hunter from the planet Duro and a leader of a bounty hunter group called the Zhug brothers.
Suulru was a farmer on Dantooine and a veteran of the Jedi Civil War. A moisture vaporator was stolen from him by a salvager named Jorran, who sold it back to Suulru for 500 credits.
Ahrnell was a Force-sensitive male Twi'lek who worked as part of a mercenary group that had set up operations on Dantooine following the Jedi Civil War.

Berun Modrul was a member of the Khoonda Militia 3951 BBY, second in command to Zherron. He was an opinionated young male Human who often suspected he knew better than Zherron what was best and had wanted to try to compromise with Azkul and the mercenaries.
Tienn Tubb was an elderly Sullustan male. Although nearly blind, he retained excellent hearing. He was a mechanic and scientist on Nar Shaddaa during the year 3951 BBY, assisted by IT-31 and TT-32.

Odis was a Human male pilot who lived in the Refugee Sector of Nar Shaddaa, the largest moon of the planet Nal Hutta, in the year 3951 BBY. He was a refugee displaced by the conflicts of the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War.

Nadaa was a Human female refugee who lived with her daughter, Adana, in the Refugee Sector on Nar Shaddaa, a moon of the planet Nal Hutta, in 3951 BBY. During this time, her daughter was kidnapped by the local Exchange crime boss Saquesh as Nadaa owed the Exchange 600 credits.

Adana was a Human female refugee who lived in the Refugee Sector with her mother, Nadaa, on Nar Shaddaa, a moon of the planet Nal Hutta, in 3951 BBY. She and her mother were both displaced by the Jedi Civil War and Mandalorian Wars.

Lootra was a Human male from Telos IV. He was separated from his wife, Aaida during the Sith bombing of the planet in 3958 BBY. Lootra had come to Nar Shaddaa following the end of the Mandalorian Wars, searching for his lost wife Aaida.
Aaida was a Human female who lived on Telos IV during the Jedi Civil War. A survivor of the Sith bombardment of the world in 3958 BBY, she was separated from her husband, Lootra, during evacuation.

Kaul was a Twi'lek male infochant who lived in the Refugee Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa in 3951 BBY. When Meetra Surik, a former Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order, visited the Refugee Sector, the Twi'lek offered her information for a few credits.

Kahranna was a Human female who lived in the Refugee Sector of Nar Shaddaa, the largest moon of the planet Nal Hutta, in the year 3951 BBY. She and her family were refugees of the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War.

A Human male, Hussef was the benevolent, unofficial leader of the refugees in the refugee sector on Nar Shaddaa. Following the Jedi Civil War many refugees found their way to Nar Shaddaa, and Hussef tried to look out for them by keeping them together, safe, and in high spirits.
Guron was a male Duros. He was a swoop racer who met Meetra Surik on Nar Shaddaa in 3951 BBY.

Geriel was a Human male refugee from the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War. He lived in the Refugee Sector on the moon of the planet Nal Hutta, Nar Shaddaa, during the last days of the Dark Wars in 3951 BBY.

Aruteous "Rute" Gunnay was a male Neimoidian member of the Trade Federation, serving as an aide and adviser to Viceroy Nute Gunray and Settlement Officer Rune Haako during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Throgg was a tall humanoid alien spice smuggler and one time addict who lived on Tatooine.
Orvos was the elderly shaman of the village of Rokrul on the Outer Rim planet of Nelvaan during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Kael was a captain in the Royal Naboo Security Forces during the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY.

Ashielle Skamini was a Human female who served as the proprietor of an ore prospecting launch base on Mon Gazza, along with her husband Sembric Skamini and was the mother of Warpoc Skamini, who became Padawan Zett Jukassa.

Sembric Skamini was a Human male who served as the proprietor of an ore prospecting launch base on Mon Gazza, along with his wife Ashielle Skamini and was the father of Warpoc Skamini, who became Padawan Zett Jukassa.
Lowle Ch'red was a Human female from the planet Coruscant. The woman was a frequenter of Dex's Diner and the Outlander Club on her homeworld, prior to the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.

Honka was a Rodian male frequenter of Dex's Diner on the planet Coruscant prior to the Clone Wars in 22 BBY. Before the war's start that year, he visited the diner with his friend Sidewa, a fellow Rodian, when Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi met with diner owner Dexter Jettster.
Sidewa was a Rodian, known to frequent Dex's Diner in the years leading up to the Clone Wars. She was often accompanied by Honka.

Borvo the Hutt was a powerful male Hutt crime lord who operated a large and profitable business, smuggling everything from blasters to spices. As an influential figure, he had dozens of strongholds on worlds located throughout the Outer Rim.
Mierme Unill was a female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Teeda was an empress of the Arkanis Regency who died long before the Galactic Civil War. They had lovely green eyes. The empress was documented in the annals of the Arkanis Regency.
Mir Tork was an Imperial admiral and commander of the infamous Azgoghk, an Imperial death ship created for the sole purpose of exterminating alien species.
Leonis Murthé was the science officer on board the Imperial extermination ship Azgoghk alongside Admiral Mir Tork.
Slique Brighteyes was a Gulmarid native of Gulma who survived the atrocities committed by the Imperial extermination ship Azgoghk.
Brazzo was a Human male bounty hunter on Centares.
Jerresk was a pirate who, with Nosstrick, attacked several New Republic supply shipments, earning very large bounties and moving them from the Hundred Club to the list of "Most Wanted".
Gideon Longspar was a warlord and bandit who, in 3 ABY, terrorized the moisture farmers of Beheboth by raiding their farms for every drop of water they had and re-selling it on the black market.
Cas Ennyl Yllek was an employee and liaison for the House Benelex on Paqualis III. She hired Jodo Kast for Sava Brec Madak, the identity used by Boba Fett in his plan to kill Kast.
Clongor was a Skakoan Elder on Skako during the Clone Wars.
Blleen was a doctor at the Citadel of B'omarr on Tatooine.
Ding was the majordomo of Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo. He oversaw the protection of Anachro, Gorga's wife.

Onoh was a male Lizling who served Gardulla Besadii the Elder during the last decades of the Galactic Republic, and later as the watchman of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's private storehouse in Glass Mountain.

Larisselle Chatrunis was a Pa'lowick female who was crowned Miss Coruscant in a beauty pageant held on the Republic homeworld shortly before the outbreak of the Clone Wars. She was a native of Coruscant's Jrade District at the time of her crowning.
Milmit was a mercenary working for Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo after the death of Jabba Desilijic Tiure. While interrogating Onoh at Glass Mountain, he inadvertently discovered the Spirit of Jabba.
1138 was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire based on Corulag under the command of Admiral Droon.

Volven Roxe, also known as "the wolfman," was a Shistavanen male who operated as a spice lord and crime kingpin on the planet Coruscant. He was the owner of several nightclubs in Coruscant's Uscru Entertainment District, one of which was the Outlander Club.

Grugnak was an elderly Ugnaught male living on Bespin's Cloud City when the Galactic Empire invaded the city. He hated the Empire for occupying his home, and helped the Rebel Alliance move personnel on Cloud City after the occupation.

Lee Phenets was an engineer living and working on Bespin's Cloud City when the Galactic Empire occupied the city in the clouds. Phenets was a maintenance specialist who had to ensure of the smooth operation of Cloud City.
Spurlick was a Confederate air-traffic controller on Antar 4 as of 21 BBY.
Ryyk was a Wookiee male prisoner imprisoned on Warlord Shogar Tok's headquarters prison on Brentaal IV.
Suribran Tu was a male Ishi Tib politician who lived during the years just before the rise of the Galactic Empire.
Korto Vos was a Force-sensitive male Human-Kiffar hybrid born on the planet Kashyyyk less than eight months after the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY.
Calder Byra was a blue-eyed socialite connected to the planet Coruscant's high society.
Archa Sabis was a Human male who, due to illness, received cybernetic implants.
Ottegru Grey was an agent for the Bank of the Core, who served as Chairman Tannon Praji's bodyguard during the Clone Wars.
Milessa Kand was a female Human who served as a rebel sympathizer who lived on Alderaan. A proponent of pacifism and coexistence, she viewed the Empire as the greatest threat to her beliefs.

Hilas Bannack was a member of the Imperial Intelligence's Bureau of Operations, which was responsible for finding/reporting seditious movements and traitorous elements within territories held by the Galactic Empire.
Tosk-tar'ilya was a Bothan spy/commando who was tasked with the sabotage of Caamas' energy shield bunker 14.
Ratambo Gale was a member of the Malkite Poisoners, which were adept assassins on the world of Chandrila.
Groola was a Hutt and owner of Groola's Place. He insisted that he was not a typical representative of the Hutts.

Vanar was a fashion designer contacted to design a wedding dress for Mara Jade's wedding to Luke Skywalker. He believed in the philosophy that "minimal is maximal" and his skimpy dresses reflected this.
Jari'kyn was a female Twi'lek fashion designer who was employed by Vanar.

Banner Sumptor was an Imperial soldier who planned to sabotage the wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade with his compatriots, Chala Venan, Chik Apla, Iry Danta, Anlys Takkar, and Moff Derran Takkar.

Chala Venan was an Imperial commando who planned to sabotage the wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade with his compatriots, Banner Sumptor, Chik Apla, Iry Danta, Anlys Takkar, and Moff Derran Takkar.

Chik Apla, a Human male, was an Imperial commando from the planet Coruscant and, at one point, a member of the Emperor's Royal Guard. While serving the Galactic Empire, Apla had an active career, and he eventually received a distinguished scar that ran down his right cheek.
Anlys Takkar was a female Human Imperial loyalist, the wife of the exiled Moff Derran Takkar, and also the lover of one of his few remaining followers, Chik Apla.
Derran Takkar was a male Human Imperial Moff, appointed to that position by Emperor Palpatine just before the Battle of Endor. In the many years of retreat, however, he lost control of his sector.

Egot Pai-4-Yem, or The Boneman as he was often referred to as on Harridan, was a tall, almost skeletal humanoid with large, staring eyes and saggy, corpse-colored skin. He had a lisping voice which echoed deeply from his large, bony chest.

Willel was a leading administrator in the Imperial Corps of Bioengineers in the early days of the Galactic Civil War. One of his most accomplished scientists was the female xenobiologist, Dusque Mistflier.

Okko, stylized as the Great Okko, was the chief of a tribe of Ysanna on Ossus and was regarded as the mightiest force user in his people's history. He participated in the Battle of Ossus. He was the father of Jem and Rayf Ysanna.
Rai-Kalei was a male Sullustan pilot who lived in times of the Galactic Empire.
Mastivo was a native of the planet Coruscant. He was a close friend of the Ithorian known as Tendau Nandon.
Eban Trey was a Rodian who was the host of the grand opening of the Aerie Casino on the planet Naboo in 1 ABY.
