Mother Grotrugga was a Force-sensitive Gamorrean leader of the Nuns of G'aav'aar'oon. She appeared to be a typical Gamorrean female who was motherly (if it was possible to call a 200 kilogram, fanged, pig-like alien motherly), kind, and placidly calm.

Transe Decar was a Human minister on the planet of Zaloriis during the rule of the Galactic Empire. Sometime between 2 ABY and 3 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War, Decar and a group called the Zalorian Separatists defected from the Empire to the growing Rebellion against it.
Gnarhk was a male Devaronian servant of the Black Sun Vigo Antonin. In 27 BBY, Jango Fett slit his neck in order to get to Antonin.

Nilo was a male Rodisar from the planet Rodis, where he had served as a general during the planet's seasonal wars. During the final years of the Old Republic, he was kidnapped and sold to Rattataki war barons.
Sena Leikvold Midanyl was a Human female from Corellia.
Tiu Zax was an Omwati female serving as a Jedi Knight in the time following the resolution of the Swarm War. She was knighted shortly before the Second Galactic Civil War.

Kolir Hu'lya was a tan-furred Bothan female serving as a Jedi Knight in the time following the resolution of the Swarm War. She had been knighted only weeks before the start of the Second Galactic Civil War.

Nelani Dinn was a female Human Jedi Knight during the time of the Second Galactic Civil War. At some point during her early life, Dinn was taken for Jedi training and was taught for a time by Jacen Solo, eventually graduating to become a Jedi Knight.

Thann Mithric was a male Falleen who served as a Jedi Knight in the time following the resolution of the Swarm War. At the beginning of the Second Galactic Civil War he was constantly chastised by Kolir Hu'lya for using his Falleen pheromones along with Jedi mind tricks.
Doctor Toval Seyah was a Human male scientist and part-time Galactic Alliance spy following the resolution of the Swarm War.

Rayc Ryjerd was a male smuggler and the son of the trader Rycar Ryjerd. He was considered to be even more of an idiot than his father. By 4 ABY, he had accumulated debts and began working for the crime lord Jabba the Hutt in an effort to pay them off.

Lomina Argo was a Human systems analyst on the galactic capital planet Coruscant in 22 BBY. That year, Argo was interviewed by a HoloNet News journalist about the "Baby Ludi" custody case, which concerned the Jedi Order refusing to return a six-month-old Force-sensitive Human,…
Doby Tyerell was a male Aleena from Aleen who was the son of the famous Podracer Ratts Tyerell and the younger brother of Deland Tyerell.

Hraashi Lool was a Human who was attending university on the galactic capital of Coruscant in 22 BBY. They had red hair that fell past their shoulders, green eyes, and light skin that was colored with two vertical pink stripes.
Jonava Billane was the mother of "Baby Ludi" and a central character in the Case of "Baby Ludi".

A semi-sentient black fog–like creature was created by the Galactic Empire aboard the escort frigate–turned-laboratory Imperial Research Station 13 as part of experiments aiming to tap into the dark side of the Force.
Tendau Nandon was a male Ithorian who worked as a scientist for the Imperial Corps of Bioengineers until he joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Tanith Shire was a Human female from the planet Ophideraan. As a young woman, she and her father crashed their ship on Ophideraan, and her people were enslaved by the Serpent Masters, a scavenger group who forced them to maintain the Great Well, their base of operation.

"Fingers" was the nick-name attributed to a female Zabrak animal herder. She specialized in training Borgle bats for arena pit-fighting competition. She hunted the dangerous creatures in their native jungle environment on the Naboo moon of Rori.
Ilippi Skirata, born Ilippi Jiro, was a female Human of non-Mandalorian origin, and the wife of Mandalorian Kal Skirata. Kal met her in a Corellian nightclub where she worked as a waitress.

Tabor was a Force-sensitive Aleena who participated in a fighting sport involved in the ways of the Force on an unnamed planet in the Outer Rim Territories. When Darth Sidious sent Darth Maul to kill the champion of the sport, Silus, Tabor engaged Silus in combat.

Jastus Farr was an alien male Jedi Master who served as a Jedi General during the Clone Wars. Farr survived the initial stages of Order 66, Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's order to all clone troopers to murder their Jedi Generals.
Control was the name of the second-in-command of the Cavrilhu pirate gang, under Captain Zothip.
Moegid was a Verpine smuggler and slicer.
Rooz was a Sarkan Lord who served as the Advisor to Queen Zil.

Zyn Javeb was a Pau'an who, during the last decades of the Galactic Republic, was a lesser aide to Port Administrator Tion Medon. Javeb was one of the committee members that joined Medon on the landing platform to welcome Obi-Wan Kenobi to Utapau.

Siin Suub, sometimes styled as Sin Suub, was a Sullustan male who served as a board member of the SoroSuub Corporation. During his time as Chairman of SoroSuub, the company overthrew and replaced the government of Sullust and pledged allegiance to the Galactic Empire.
Ledre Okins, a Human male, was one of the oldest admirals in the upper echelons of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

Baji was a male Ho'Din healer who mainly worked in the rain-forests of Yavin 4. He always spoke in rhyme, and, like almost all his species, he was a botanist. He was very peaceful but loathed the Empire.
Del Korrot was a Cerean freelance Jedi hunter that offered his services to Emperor Palpatine, promising to hunt down and destroy Jedi Knights and Force-sensitives who survived the Great Jedi Purge.
Avan Beruss was a Human male pilot who served in Rogue Squadron during the early days of the New Republic.

Plat Mallar was a Grannan from the Imperial colony world of Polneye in the Koornacht Cluster, and a member of that world's defense force, piloting several varieties of TIE fighters. He was the only son of Plat Hovath and Fall Topas.
Hin was a Yuzzem and the companion of Kee.
Kee was a Yuzzem and the companion of Hin.

Jenks was a clone trooper commander during the Clone Wars. They were created on the planet Kamino from the clone template of bounty hunter Jango Fett. As a clone of Fett, Jenks stood at 1.83 meters tall and had tan skin.
Rixes Antab was a male Human thief who worked on the planet Tatooine during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Dusque Mistflier was a Human female xenobiologist who was employed by the Imperial Corps of Bioengineers. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, she became embittered towards her employers and defected to the Rebel Alliance.

Didi Oddo was the adoptive father of Astri Oddo and onetime owner of Dex's Diner. He was a good friend to the Jedi, including Yoda, Tahl and Qui-Gon Jinn. When his daughter married Bog Divinian, he sold his café to Dexter Jettster.

N.J. Opuh was a Phuii frequenter of Dex's Diner in the CoCo Town district of the planet Coruscant. The Phuii visited while the diner was active no earlier than 28 BBY to its closure between 19 BBY and 18 BBY.
Excellence Lathe Parthenian was the leader of Libreck city and leader of the Hanoon Imperial Resistance.

Matric Klauskin was a Human male from Commenor. As of 40 ABY, he was an admiral in the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet. He served as captain of the Dodonna, as well as commander of the Second Fleet task force that invaded the Corellian system and occupied Tralus.

Davin Kotras was a smuggler and pilot before and during the time of the Jedi Civil War. He was a good friend of Jolee Bindo, Sunry, and Elora, and had shared many adventures with Bindo during his adventuring days.
Gandroff was a Human male who was a professional swoop racer from Taris.

01/425 was a clone advisor who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He often found himself tasked with overseeing the operations of Delta Squad, a unit of elite clone commandos that included Boss, Fixer, Sev, and Scorch, with whom he would communicat…
Rigard Matl was a TIE fighter pilot during virtually every major conflict from the Galactic Civil War to the Yuuzhan Vong War, fighting on one or the other—or even both—sides of the conflicts.
Merglyn was a Human female smuggler. In 30 BBY, she and Havor were killed above Kiffex by the Kiffu Guardians while attempting to smuggle blasters to that planet.

Havor was a male smuggler. In 30 BBY, he and his copilot Merglyn were killed above Kiffex by the Kiffu Guardians, due to a faulty shield generator sold to them by Watto, while attempting to smuggle blasters to that planet.

Horsea was a female Kiffar, and a member of the Kiffu Guardians. In 30 BBY, she and Vanlin shot down a smuggling ship piloted by Merglyn and Havor, who were attempting to smuggle blasters onto Kiffex.

Vanlin was a male Kiffar and a member of the Kiffu Guardians. In 30 BBY he and Horsea shot down a smuggling ship that had been piloted by Merglyn and Havor, who were attempting to smuggle a shipment of blasters onto Kiffex.
Gorto Zaga was a male Aqualish, and chief of the Kiffex town of Deadend, who could often be found in that settlement's Black Hole cantina.
Haum Do was a female Kaminoan journalist with a bubbly personality.
Tulak was a male Advozse Warlord. He conquered Koba three centuries before the Battle of Yavin, imprisoning the native Kobans. Jedi Knight Polvin Kut and his Padawan, Yaddle went there to stop him.

Kalut was a male Warlord in the Koba system. He was heir to former Warlord Tulak. After Yaddle escaped from the prison Tulak ordered her sealed in a century prior, she decided to stay on Koba for a while and help the people of the planet.

Sarkli was a Human male captain in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War. A member of the elite storm commandos, Sarkli was the nephew of Admiral Firmus Piett and one of the Empire's best spies, even finding audience with Emperor Palpatine.

Klorr Vilia was a male Human botanist who helped the Ithorian Zorneth develop the savorium herb. While trying to create a new kind of herb, they made the savorium and Vilia tried it to see what it did. Klorr's mind was then replaced with nothing but peace and joy.
Trad Mays was a male student at the University of Garos on Garos IV. He was clumsy but charming, and was attracted to Alexandra Winger.

affiliation: Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification
x: Doro was a male member of the Garos Underground during the early years of the New Republic. Born in 22 BBY, Doro was twenty-eight years old by 6 ABY.

affiliation: Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification
x: Magir Paca was a male Human who served the New Republic as a leader of the underground resistance on Garos IV.

affiliation: Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification
x: Carl Barzon was a male Human professor at the University of Garos and a secret member of the Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification.

affiliation: Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification
x: Scat was a male member of the Garosian Underground. Part of Team Two, Scat was captured by Imperial forces, but later rescued by Alexandra Winger and other Garosian resistance fighters from detention in the Imperial Headquarters.
Sali Winger was a Human female who is the wife of Tork Winger and adoptive mother of Alexandra "Alex" Winger.
Drayneen was a Force-sensitive Human female member of the Imperial Inquisitorius.

Root was the nickname of a Human male with black hair living on Somov Rit as of 1000 BBY. He was the cousin and guardian of Zannah, Darovit, and Hardin. He was an ally of the Jedi Order, a friend of Torr Snapit, and apparently a Force-sensitive.

Kar Yang was a male Hiitian, considered to be the second-most skilled and feared bounty hunter in the galaxy. He was often accompanied by Lintu, his assistant droid. He came to prominence after the Battle of Endor and hunted Guri.
Ogo Buugi was a male Bith doctor in the Galactic Alliance who operated on Mara Jade Skywalker.
Yittreas was a Moff of the Galactic Empire.
Derliff was the Human male Imperial Moff of a region that contained the Wild Space's Silken Asteroids cluster.
Sladak was a male Human Jedi Initiate serving the Jedi Order briefly during the Ruusan campaign at the end of the New Sith Wars.
Slatka was a female Human Jedi Initiate serving the Jedi Order briefly during the Ruusan campaign at the end of the New Sith Wars.

Laa was a Bouncer living on Ruusan around 1000 BBY at the height of the New Sith Wars fought between the Jedi and the Sith. Laa saved a young Force-sensitive human girl, the future Darth Zannah, after a Sith attack.

Gyle was an Elder of the Melodie species and the father of Lyric. During their journey to Yavin 8, it was from him and another Melodie named Aragon that the young Jedi trainees Anakin Solo and Tahiri Veila learned of the existence of ancient Massassi carvings which provided in…
Aragon was a male Elder of the Melodie species who lived on the moon of Yavin 8 around 22 ABY.
Esla was an Elder of the Melodie species and the mother of Aragon. She was the "Keeper of Legends" for Sistra Mountain's Melodie community.
Lahzar was a Jedi king who lived during the New Sith Wars between the Jedi Order's Army of Light and the Sith Brotherhood of Darkness.
Bats was a sentient who worked for Jerf Huxley as of 22 ABY.
Becker was a dark-skinned Human member of the Rebellion.

Lon was a light-haired Human member of the Rebellion. He was imprisoned at Balis-Baurgh where he met and befriended Junas Turner and Grael the Ewok. After Turner and Grael escaped the prison, they resolved to rescue Lon and fellow inmate Becker.
Rakra was the shaman of the Ewok tribe Panshee.
Fersin was the High Master of the Ewok tribe Panshee.
Mintinee was the clan mother of one of the tribes of Dathomiri Witches.
Chaf'ees'aklaio, known by her core name of Feesa, was a member of the Chaf family, and the second niece and aide of Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano, core name "Formbi".
Ponto was the son of Grael and his wife, and a member of the Panshee tribe.
Weebacca was a Wookiee spacer who tended to get into trouble and who had a habit of gambling and smuggling. He was a childhood friend of fellow Wookiee Chewbacca.
Lai Nootka was a male Duros arms dealer and trader.
Gunner Groth, alias Dengar Roth, was a low-grade bounty hunter.
Hovrak was the Adjutant Advisor of Nolaa Tarkona, head of the fanatical Diversity Alliance. He was a Shistavanen and a cannibal as well. On one occasion, he ate a Human convict from Concord Dawn.

Rehtul Minnau was the older brother of both the Human female Teckla Minnau and her half-sister Nandi, the former of whom was born on the planet Naboo in the city of Parrlay to a middle-class merchant family.

Talos Merkin was a veteran starfighter pilot of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. He participated in numerous campaigns prior to joining the Rebellion's assault on the Galactic Empire's Death Star battle station during the Battle of Yavin.
Tra's M'ins was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Neena was a female Human musician from Alderaan who lived in the Minos Cluster.

Dannen Lifehold was Human male Alderaan-based smuggler who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic and was captain of the Lifeline during the Galactic Civil War. As an adult he was tall with green eyes.
Captain Twolz was a Human male smuggler and Dannen Lifehold's mentor. A decent man, he taught Dannen everything he knew. Twolz was killed when Imperial stormtroopers raided his operation.

Krell was originally smuggler Captain Twolz's regular gunner. When Twolz was killed, Krell and Twolz' protégé, Dannen Lifehold, set up a small shop on Alderaan. He was killed during the destruction of Alderaan in 0 BBY.
A loanshark of the worst kind, Linkaas was a criminal Pliith. He loaned Dannen Lifehold the smuggler the credits to purchase a ship in exchange that Lifehold would work for him whenever needed.

Bogeega Bu'Daay was an operative for the criminal Hutt Cartel around 22 BBY who discovered information relating to the Decimator superweapon and reported it to Boorka the Hutt, a member of the cartel.

Feq was a smuggler and a skilled mechanic. He worked with Dannen Lifehold, who was also his best friend, on Lifehold's ship the Lifeline. He was shot dead by a stormtrooper during a customs inspection of the Lifeline.

Chokk was a male Bloxian and the brother of Bakk. Chokk and his brother worked as Linkaas' goons. Since they were not considered to be smart, they were given jobs that required great strength and little thinking.

Bakk was a male Bloxian and the brother of Chokk. They worked as Linkaas' goons. Considered not the brightest sentients in the galaxy, they were given jobs that required a lot of muscle but no thinking.

Purr was a female Tinnell and Force-sensitive. She was an exceptionally skilled mechanic and worked for Dannen Lifehold, whom she also considered her best friend. She appeared not to be too bright, but that was primarily to be attributed to naïveté rather than stupidity.
Kemmel Attapi was a male Silika who was the ruling champion of the Contest, a Silika water drinking game and was undefeated until he challenged the Human smuggler, Dannen Lifehold.
Ledd Pinot was a male Human who served as a guard in Desolation Alley around the time of the Invasion of Naboo.

Kenta Anwa was a male Silika. He once challenged Dannen Lifehold to the Contest, a drinking game. However, Lifehold was not affected by the Silika water, it had a much stronger affect on Anwa's species. Anwa was propelled by the defeat of Kemmel Attapi against Lifehold.

Klin Anwa was a male Silika and the brother of Kenta Anwa, who had been defeated by Dannen Lifehold in the Contest, a Silika water drinking game. Klin and a group of Silika friends saved Lifehold's life when he was assaulted by Linkaas' thugs Chokk and Bakk.

Zee Ethda was an alien mercenary and bounty hunter employed by Grappa the Hutt. He was given the job of capturing Imperial customs officer Tarrant Snil, but failed. He was then given to a group of Zanibar for their rituals.

Tarrant Snil was an Imperial customs officer who worked in Lay Pa-Sidian on G'wenee. As part of his plan to ingratiate himself with Grappa the Hutt, Kir Kanos captured Snil under the guise of bounty hunter Kenix Kil.
Tront was a Gamorrean pirate who worked for Grappa the Hutt under the command of Sol Mon. Tront hated droids, and never missed an opportunity to damage or destroy one, particularly 4/NG.

Jahren Sinn was a farmer on Nez Peron during the Galactic Civil War and husband of Mirith Sinn. He had business dealings with Ragez D'Asta. On Nez Peron, there was talk among the citizens of a Rebellion and an end to the Galactic Empire.

Chessa Dohhenty was a Human female who served as First Mate aboard the bulk freighter Colders Watch. She was in a relationship with the vessel's Chief Engineer, Dirk Harkness, and was also a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Atton Repness was a New Republic training officer who specialized in remedial pilot training but also abused his position to run a black market ring.

RC-5093 was a clone commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Ultimately surviving the conflict, RC-5093 went on to retire from the military and began living in the CF VetCenter located on the galactic capital planet, Coruscant.

Themion was a lieutenant in the Eriaduan judicial forces in 26 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He was a tall and thin man with a craggy face and a black eye. Themion was also a Humanocentricist, evidenced by describing Rodians as "a vile and murderous lot".

Su-mil was an Eickarie from the planet Kariek. Shortly before 22 ABY, he joined the military of the Empire of the Hand, and became a stormtrooper with the 501st Legion, using the warrior name Grappler.
Cloud was one of the four members of Unit Aurek-Seven of the 501st Legion in the Empire of the Hand. The Unit consisted of Twister, Shadow, Watchman, and Cloud.

Watchman was one of the four members of Unit Aurek-Seven of the 501st Legion in the Empire of the Hand. The unit consisted of Twister, Cloud, Shadow and Watchman. Watchman was the tech specialist of the unit and thus was equipped with more advanced sensors.
Shadow was one of the four members of Unit Aurek-Seven of the 501st Legion in the Empire of the Hand. The Unit consisted of Twister, Cloud, Watchman, and Shadow.
Mika Kaebra was a Human male communications officer who worked for the Garos Resistance movement, specializing in the monitoring of Imperial communications frequencies.
Wink Tasion was a Human male who worked for the Garos Resistance movement as a communications technician. He was a teacher at the University of Garos and a good friend of Alexandra Winger.
TK-21 was an Imperial scout trooper stationed on Garos IV.
TK-16 was an Imperial scout trooper stationed on Garos IV.
Jaytee was a male Human who lived on Garos IV and served as an operator with the Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification.
TK-32 was an Imperial scout trooper stationed on Garos IV.
Zakar was a male Human Imperial general stationed on Garos IV. He was ill-tempered and known for taking frustration out on his subordinates.
Nilo was a male Human Imperial lieutenant who was stationed on Garos IV.

affiliation: Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification
x: Dair Haslip was a Human male Garosian Imperial lieutenant who worked as an agent for the Garos Resistance movement.
Baro was a Human male councilor from Zila on Garos IV during the era of the New Republic. He was deeply concerned with the Imperial activities in Zila.

affiliation: Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification
x: Cardy was a Human male who served as a member of the Garos Resistance and father of a small baby. He would handle their Plex, but was killed during an ambush on an Imperial convoy, leaving it up to Alexandra Winger to take out the remaining AT-ST that was escorting the convoy.

Tru'eb Cholakk was a male Twi'lek smuggler who worked together with Platt Okeefe. He was tall and preferred to wear gray and black tunics. His voice was deep and resonant, which gave his speech a pinch of respectable pride.

Ku'amar was a Twi'lek and the cousin of Tru'eb Cholakk. Ku'amar kidnapped Tru'eb and gave him to slavers, thus preventing Tru'eb from fulfilling his dream of becoming a head-clan member of the city of Kala'uun.

Quintik Kahr, better known as "Big Quince", was an Outer Rim-based Sludir slaver and the brother of Omze'kehr Kahr. Before turning to slavery, he was a famous gladiator, fighting primarily in the pits of Loovria, using a force pike that he would carry for the rest of his life.
Antoll Jellrek was a Human male Imperial Moff who administered the Galov sector in the Outer Rim Territories during the Galactic Civil War. He was tall and pale and sported a forked beard.

Theus Paddox was High Lord of House Pelagia during the Rebellion era. He was very young during the House Mecetti sponsored purge and downfall of his house but grew up quickly in the difficult years that followed.
Trad Paddox was the brother of Theus Paddox, High Lord of House Pelagia. Trad (aged 8) and his sister Verinia Paddox (aged 10) disappeared during the House Mecetti purge of their House.
Verinia Paddox was the sister of Theus Paddox, High Lord of House Pelagia.

Hefrar Birhan was a Human male and barq farmer on the planet Qiilura. When the Clone Wars broke out between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, he provided sanctuary to Etain Tur-Mukan, a Jedi Padawan on the run from the local militia, in his farm.

Melvin Fett was a humanoid male bounty hunter who operated during the time of the Galactic Empire. He was the cousin of the renowned hunter Boba Fett, making his repeated failures at apprehending bounties even more comical to his peers.

Drake Paulsen was a Human male native of the planet Socorro and the son of the legendary pirate Kaine Paulsen. Drake was himself a pirate and smuggler, which he had been doing since his father brought him along on a smuggling run at the age of five.
Kaine Paulsen, also known as Chu'la, was a legendary Socorran smuggler and the father of Drake Paulsen.
Lom was a mercenary working for Vrath Xizor in 3653 BBY. That year, he participated in a skirmish on Vulta involving Xizor's quarry, the spice smuggler Zeerid Korr.

Abdi-Badawzi was a black-skinned Twi'lek gangster boss based on Socorro. His base of operation was hidden in the Rym Mountains. He dealt primarily in arms and drug smuggling, and was one of the three founding members of the Ethra Brewery.
Elias Halbert was an alcoholic Corellian smuggler who worked for Abdi-Badawzi.

Koobis was the door guard of the Bumani Exchange Corporation, the legal face of the Exchange's presence on Citadel Station. When Meetra Surik received a mission from Luxa to speak with Loppak Slusk, he let the former Jedi enter. The Rodian then promptly deserted the area.

Mereel Skirata, formerly known as Null-7 or N-7 and better known as Mereel, was a lieutenant and one of six Null-class Advanced Recon Commandos created for use in the Grand Army of the Republic. He was named after former Mandalore Jaster Mereel, Jango Fett's mentor.

Deena Shan was a Human female who, looking for adventure and a better life for herself, left her homeworld of Etti IV and became a private in the Alliance to Restore the Republic shortly after the Battle of Yavin.
Jorin Sol was a young Human male mathematician who served the Rebellion during the early part of the Galactic Civil War.

Daer'ey'ath, known by her core name Reya, was a Chiss intelligence officer of the Chiss Intelligence. By 35 ABY, Reya had joined and become the Prime of the Taat Killik nest, from this point on she became known as ReyaTaat.
Swagg was a male Chiss pirate operating in the Mid Rim shortly before the Battle of Naboo. Swagg was killed by Captain Roos Tarpals while stealing ancient Gungan art on Naboo.
Gimald Nuruodo was a Chiss male flight instructor and military officer. He believed very strongly in tradition and loyalty to the group.

Jer'Jo Cam'Co was a male Chiss and one of the founding syndics of the Chiss Ascendancy. He proposed the creation of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet after exploration efforts revealed several resource rich worlds.
Sarlim Gastess was one of the few Gotals with non-functional head cones. Without the natural ability to sense emotions, he was a clinical psychopath by Gotal standards.
Vontaige, a male Human native of the planet Koros Major, and served the ruler of the Koros system, Empress Teta.
Halleb Harmion was an executive with Gastess' Finance, Inc. His specialty was taking over the operations of corporations which the ruthless financier Sarlim Gastess had acquired.

K'yne Harmion was an executive who worked for Gastess' Finance, Inc. Like his brothers Halleb and Sarell, his specialty was taking over the operations of corporations which the ruthless financier Sarlim Gastess had acquired.

Sarell Harmion was an executive who worked for Gastess' Finance, Inc. Like his employer Sarlim Gastess and his brothers Halleb and K'yne, he operated by taking control of well-run corporations, ruthlessly running them for short-term profit, and leaving the ruins behind once ev…

Corrsk was a Trandoshan member of Diversity Alliance in 24 ABY. He was part of Nolaa Tarkona's inner council and a general in the Alliance military forces. Corrsk represented the Trandoshan species in the organization. He also was easily stirred and enraged.
Kambrea was a female Devaronian and a member of the alien-supremacist Diversity Alliance. She was part of Nolaa Tarkona's inner circle though she only joined the Alliance for personal glory.
Rullak was the Quarren representative of the alien-supremacist Diversity Alliance in 24 ABY. He was a member of Nolaa Tarkona's inner council, though he joined only to gain personal glory.
Fett was a human male Mandalorian farmer of Clan Fett who served as the constable Journeyman Protector of Concord Dawn after the exile of his predecessor, Jaster Mereel.

Bana Besadii Diori was a Hutt in the Besadii clan. He was a member of the Hutt resistance during the Yuuzhan Vong War, and helped supply some funds for Shelter after meeting with Lando Calrissian, Han, Leia and Jacen Solo.

Brigta Hejaran was a member of House Mecetti who represented the Hejaran family on Coruscant for several seasons. Unbeknownst to her family and House, while on Coruscant, Lady Hejaran received tutoring by Emperor Palpatine's Dark Side Adepts under the direction of Sate Pestage.
Lucian Hejaran was a prominent member of the influential and wealthy Hejaran family of House Mecetti.
Arrianya Bel Iblis was a Human female who served the Galactic Empire and was the wife of the powerful Corellian Senator Garm Bel Iblis.
Ayjae was a male Rutian Twi'lek treasure hunter who was mauled by Tuk'ata on Korriban.

Feraa was a smuggler who was to meet Suyin in Visquis's underground lair to accept a shipment of spice for Vogga the Hutt, only to get lost in its maze and die. Meetra Surik later found Feraa's corpse and datapad.

Suyin was an individual who was transporting spice to give to Feraa in Visquis's underground lair, only to die in its maze after stepping on a mine and injuring a leg. Meetra Surik later found Suyin's corpse and datapad.

Nebelish was a Human male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the time of the Jedi Civil War. In 3951 BBY, he was found dead in the Tomb of Ludo Kressh on Korriban by Meetra Surik. The body contained a datapad belonging to the late Jedi.

Squik was a male Twi'lek who was selling merchandise to a Trandoshan thug and his cronies on Nar Shaddaa. When Meetra Surik accidentally entered the fray, Squik was killed and Surik had to defend herself against the Trandoshan and his thugs.
Corell Muntique was a Lord of House Calipsa and has represented Calipsa in the annual Vor-cal safari hunt. He owned a domesticated vornskr that he called Crill. Crill was trained as a hunting dog.
Crill was a domesticated vornskr owned by Lord Corell Muntique of the Calipsa House.
Magg was a Human male Security Police agent in the Corporate Sector who secretly headed a large slaving ring in the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Fassa was a female Gungan and niece to Boss Rugor Nass.
B4711 was an Imperial stormtrooper present during the Blockade of Kashyyyk in 1 ABY.
Chine-Kal was a Yuuzhan Vong Commander during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He was the commanding officer aboard a yammosk clustership.
Hinch Beltane was the Governor of Balmorra which was the primary manufacturer of AT-STs and SD-series battle droids.
Naradan D'ulin was a Mistryl Shadow Guard who served as an attendant and caretaker to Princess Foolookoola from the planet Ootoola during the last decade of the Galactic Republic.

Reck Desh was a Human male smuggler. He had black hair, brown eyes, and in 25 ABY received extensive tattooing. He once partnered with Han Solo to bring R'alla mineral water to Rampa III, and later raced Solo for fifty cases of Gizer ale, which he lost.

Cakhmaim, clan Eikh'mir, was a Noghri warrior, and the head of Leia Organa Solo's honor guard. He served as chief bodyguard of Leia and her family for over 31 years, beginning at the Thrawn crisis and throughout the Yuuzhan Vong War and Swarm War, until both he and Meewalh wer…
Daroe was a Jawa who hailed from the planet Tatooine. He lived in that planet's spaceport town of Mos Eisley, and was one of many informants for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Derek Torent was a fair-skinned Human male with brown hair and brown eyes. He served as an Imperial Navy trooper sergeant during the Galactic Civil War fought between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Samara Kebyc, a Human female working in Cloud City on her homeworld Bespin during the Galactic Civil War, was a senior accountant for the Cloud City Miner's Guild, administering the annual dues of the miners with membership in the organization.
Reya was as a male Neimoidian baron of Cato Neimoidia in the decades following the Battle of Endor. A member of House Reya, he attempted to do business with Leia Organa, the leader of the Resistance.

Bearus was a humanoid male who served as chairman of the Empress Teta system's Carbonite Guild. Bearus presided over the carbonite smelter that orbited Empress Teta, where he facilitated annual tours of progress that were conducted by Lord and Lady Keto, rulers of the Tetan wo…

Halkans was a Human male minister and carbonite smelter active in the Empress Teta system in the years prior to the Great Sith War. In 3997 BBY, a dark side-using secret society known as the Krath overthrew the Tetan Monarchy, and took control of the system.

Magda Keto was a Human female who ruled as Queen Mother of the Empress Teta system with her brother, Lord Keto, in the years leading up to the Great Sith War. Keto had a daughter named Aleema Keto who, along with Lord Keto's son Satal, was the heir to the Tetan throne.
Korus was a Human male citizen of the Empress Teta system who served as the royal tutor of Satal and Aleema Keto, heirs to the Tetan throne.

Shayoto was a Human male Jedi Master active in the Jedi Order in the years leading up to the Great Sith War. Born sometime before the year 4800 BBY, Shayoto was trained in the Jedi way by a long-lived Jedi Master, who in turn had a Master who lived for thousands of years.
Farng was a Human male carbonite trader and the leader of the Carbonite Miners' Union active in the Empress Teta system in the years leading up to the Great Sith War.

Norgor was a male Human henchman of Empress Teta system rulers Satal and Aleema Keto in the years leading up to the Great Sith War. In 3997 BBY, a Jedi Knight named Ulic Qel-Droma came to the Empress Teta system, claiming to want to join the Ketos' Sith cult, the Krath.
Thrasher was Oron Kira's personal drexl which he took to Empress Teta in an attempt to rescue Ulic Qel-Droma. The Jedi tried to force Ulic onto Thrasher, but Nomi Sunrider forbid it.
Norys was a Human male who served as a TIE pilot with the Second Imperium as of 23 ABY.
Rooks was a Human male and a captain in the service of the Krath during the era of the Great Sith War.
Sidrona was a sentient male who served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic. He was a firm supporter of the Jedi, and a friend of Jedi Master Vodo-Siosk Baas and Minister of Defense Netus.

Aleema Keto's pet was an unknown species of serpentine constrictor owned by Aleema Keto, who used the beast to kill dissenters to the rule of her Krath government. Aleema often used this pet as a torture and execution device. It secreted a yellow mucus from its quills.
Vulpe was the General of the Tetan Military forces loyal to the Krath.
The father of Valenthyne Farfalla, was the leader of the half-Bothan people. Pernicar persuaded him to join the Galactic Republic some years prior to the Battles of Ruusan.

A winged female envoy was in the service of Jedi Lord Valenthyne Farfalla during the Ruusan campaign against the Sith Brotherhood of Darkness. The charismatic Farfalla had departed Ruusan to recruit more Jedi to join Lord Hoth's Army of Light.

Loam Redge was a Force-sensitives Chief Imperial Inquisitor of unknown age whose topmost priorities, as befitted an Inquisitor, were to capture Force-sensitives, torture them, and then destroy them; a task at which he was very good. He had rich brown hair and dirt-colored eyes.
Zian Finnis was a Human male Officer who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems and held Mount Corvast after Sev'rance Tann's capture during the Clone Wars.
Ilsa was the daughter of Dantooine farmer Jon.

Bethrogg was an admiral in the Imperial Starfleet. Sometime prior to the Battle of Endor, Bethrogg commanded the Imperial star destroyer Behemoth and spearheaded Operation Venom, a military operation aimed at eliminating the Pegasus Strike Force, an element of the Rebel fleet,…

Nils Wender was a minor Noble of House Calipsa, a trained astrogator and captain of the Bright Seeker mining survey ship. He was in command of the ship when it encountered the Regal Destiny and its cargo of Theus Paddox's long lost siblings.
Neesada Bari was a female Gungan who served on the Gungan High Council on three occasions during her lifetime. She was the mother of Toba, and the wife of Bullba Bari.

Lwothin was the advanced leader of the P'w'eck Emancipation Movement. Arriving at Bakura, he was to prepare everything for the arrival of the Keeramak, and be used for evidence that the P'w'eck had overthrown the Ssi-ruuk.
Gumbaeki was a Wookiee chieftain, Master of the Claatuvac Guild, and the leader of Palsaang, a small village on the outskirts of the Wawaatt Archipelago.
Drazin was an Imperial stormtrooper corporal assigned to assigned to Gamma Squad during the Occupation of Bespin. He later served in Commander Igar's honor guard on Endor.
Soth Petikkin was a native of Tefau. A blue-skinned Tefaun, Petikkin served as a persuasive recruiter for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Thul Fain was a Human who served as a pilot in the Galactic Empire and worked alongside Lieutenant Tanbris prior to the Battle of Yavin. Fain left Imperial service by the year 4 ABY and worked as a smuggler for the crime lord Jabba the Hutt.

Bo-Pe Sommo was a hapless space trader with business on the Byss Run. He bought a clearance code from fellow spacer Shug Ninx and made the run along with Ninx; however, unbeknownst to him, the code was illegal.

Quinn Sheffield was a Baron of House Reena. He represented his house in the Vor-cal on at least seven occasions. He was, however, not a very good hunter and participated because it gave him an opportunity to socialize and escape from the rigors of bureaucratic life.
Damara Decrilla was a Lady of House Mecetti.

Ayk Arko was a male Gran who worked with the Dug crime lord Sebolto during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was wanted for questioning by the planet Coruscant's Security Force, who put a bounty on his head.
Jaw-knee Rise, probably not his real name, was a male Gran hitman who worked for the RavinsBlud Crime Syndicate during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Jurgan Kalta was a Zabrak male mercenary who was active during the time before the Great Sith War of 3996 BBY.
Narik was the senator of Rodia during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Pershon was the servant of the Hejaran family of House Mecetti. He served several generations of the family including Baron Lucian Hejaran. Pershon knew the families inner most secrets but was alway loyal to his master Lucian.

Dupas Thomree was a Human male Diktat of Corellia who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Thomree made a deal with Emperor Palpatine so he could govern the Corellian sector as he wished as long as the Corellian paid taxes, war materiel, and homage to the Emperor whi…
Micamberlecto was a male Frozian appointed by the New Republic to replace Diktat Daclif Gallamby as Governor-General of the Corellian sector when it joined the New Republic in 12 ABY.
Marcha was a female Drall. She had a prized garden of nannariums. On her homeworld she was duchess of Mastigophorous, and she was the aunt of Ebrihim.

Mar Barezz was a Human male officer in the Investigations branch of the Imperial Security Bureau. An ardent supporter of Emperor Palpatine and the New Order, Barezz was charged with eliminating spies and traitors throughout the Galactic Empire, be they Rebel fugitives or membe…
Ganig was a captain in the Imperial Army.
Stecker was a Sergeant in the Imperial Army.
Bevven was a commodore serving in the Imperial Navy.
Theol Drost was a Human male Imperial Army officer serving the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Ref Mawber was an Imperial Security Bureau agent. Mawber was the head of a network of spies which were working undercover in the different criminal syndicates on the planet Questal. He answered personally to the Moff assigned to Questal, Bandor.
Lanni Peggann was an intelligence agent who worked for the Rebel Alliance at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Loreli Ro was a female Mere from Maramere, serving as an ambassador during the waning years of the Republic. She used information from Vana Sage to track down Nym on Rodia.
Evo the Blue was a male Rodian who was the leader of the Cairn Clan from Rodia. During a Clan War in 24 BBY, he was killed by Nym with a thermal detonator.

A pale-skinned Rodian from Rodia, Jannik, commonly known as Jannik the White, was the leader of the Reeven Clan around the time of the Separatist crisis, and fought in a Rodian honor war against the Cairn Clan in 24 BBY.

R'cardo Sooflie IX was the Prince of the planet Lannik and the head of the House of Lannik. He was known as an arrogant, uncaring monarch, and was very unpopular on his planet. This gave the planetary insurgents more and more support.

Tajis Durmin was a male Human Death Star trooper who was stationed on the first Death Star during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he guarded the Death Star conference room and was among the Imperials when Siward Cass reported the Rebel Alliance base on Dantooine.
a: Death Star Trooper in Conference Room

x: Sliven was the adopted Tusken Raider father of the Human Jedi Knight Tahiri Veila. He was the leader of a Tusken tribe though he was opposed by many in the tribe since he adopted Tahiri, a Human and an outsider.
Bangor was the pet bantha of Tahiri Veila during her childhood as a Tusken Raider on the desert world of Tatooine.
Tay Vanis was an Alliance Intelligence agent who operated during the Galactic Civil War under the codename Tiree.
Ardan was a Human male native of the Core World Brentaal IV and a lieutenant commander of the Imperial Navy during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Toat was a male Neimoidian who served as a top-ranking official in the Trade Federation on Maramere during the Separatist Crisis.
Rini was a male Skrilling communications expert and slicer who worked at Banvhar Station during the Clone Wars.
Tak-tak was a male Whiphid Padawan who studied in the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

Mika was a female Farghul who was born to a pair of death stick dealers. After her parents went down with the Jedi, she held a grudge against the Jedi while growing up to become a bounty hunter and joined the Crimson Nova.
Stroth was a Human male member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. He was the leader of Crimson Nova for a long time before turning it over to Mika.
Fernooda was a male Dug follower of Ashaar Khorda. Fernooda acted as Khorda's intermediary, hiring Jango Fett and Zam Wesell to retrieve the Infant of Shaa from Seylott.

Dean was an obese female Human member of the criminal syndicate Black Sun. Having attained the rank of Vigo, Dean and the rest of the Black Sun leadership were brutally slaughtered during an attack by the Sith Darth Maul in 33 BBY.

Feen Fenoob was a bald, male Sullustan who had black eyes and lived during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. Through gambling, he came to owe a large debt to the Black Sun crime syndicate vigo Darnada.

Vaskel Savill was a high-ranking Lord of House Melantha and member of High Lord Bal Jaset's Privy council during the Imperial Period. Vaskel was a tall, handsome man who often wore short sleeve shirts which allowed for his muscular arms.
Kelko was a Rodian fringer and later businessman.
She married successful businessman Kelko and had two children with him. It is believed that they met only after Kelko discovered his family fortune.
A poor entrepreneur living in Ryloth, Dindoo owned a small mechanic's shop. He was also a sabacc player on his free time.

Akku Seii was one of the great masters of the Anzati, training assassins on his homeworld in the decades before the Clone Wars. He was also the teacher of the late Jedi Master Tholme and the contract killer Katichak.

Govenni was a Rodian, and a relative of Kelko. It is known that Govenni's clan was at war with another Rodian clan. A pair of Rodians, one of each clan, fell in love. Knowing that they would not be allowed to marry, the two left Rodia.

Squawk was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. While stationed on the planet Devaron, Squawk served under Clone Commander Ganch and Jedi Master Bolla Ropal.

Olmar Grahrk was a Devaronian male and the son of Vilmarh Grahrk's cousin, Holmar Grahrk. He married the daughters of the Yinchorri ruling councilors to forge an alliance between Villie and the Yinchorri. He was captured by the Jedi.
Jude Rozess was a female Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic.
Kettch was a fictional Ewok X-wing pilot serving with Wraith Squadron, invented as a prank by pilot Wes Janson.
Vexa was a female Tusken Raider and a member of the same tribe that Sliven led. She resented Sliven since he had adopted a Human girl named Tahiri Veila into his tribe in 16 ABY.

Baddon Fass was a male Dark Jedi and a member of Emperor Palpatine's Dark Side Elite. In 10 ABY, he was dispatched with fellow darksider Zasm Katth to the moon of Nar Shaddaa on a mission to locate the Millennium Falcon, the starship belonging to New Republic heroes, Han Solo …
Dyemma Reel was a Human female native to the planet Coruscant who participated in their homeworld's party scene.

Pucumir Thryss was a former Tibanna gas miner. He was one of the Rebellion's contacts on Cloud City before it was captured and taken over by the Galactic Empire. He left Bespin for Jabba's Palace in order to hide from the Imperials.

Vul Tazaene was a Kiffar security officer from the planet Kiffex. By 4 ABY, he was looking for a pair of identical twin con artists called the Tonnika sisters. He had also fallen in love with one of them, though he was not sure if it was Brea or Senni Tonnika.
Murttoc Yine was a Human who worked as an information broker and a spy during the Galactic Civil War. By the year 4 ABY, Yine worked at the crime lord Jabba the Hutt's palace on the planet Tatooine.
Galen Torg was a Human male native of the planet Alderaan, who served as a military officer on his homeworld.
Isela Talsava Norand was a member of the Fallanassi council on Lucazec. She betrayed the order to the Galactic Empire and was subsequently exiled. She was the mother of Akanah Norand Goss Pell.
Paloma D'asima was one of the Eleven Elders of Emberlene at the time of the Caamas Document crisis.

Threkin Horm was a Human male from the planet of Alderaan. Before the planet's destruction, his family controlled a spaceline that serviced Alderaan. Because he was grossly overweight, Horm often traveled in a repulsorlift chair in his later years.

At this time, he was of very advanced years and appeared to be very thin and as wrinkled as Yoda. His appearance, however, conveyed his experience. He graduated from the academy at the top of his class and was already a captain by the end of the Clone Wars.
Shen-and-Gretta Pikeual-Angeles of Lorrd, or Pike Angeles for short, was a trim Lorrdian male with ash-blond hair and an innocent-looking, round face.

Quat Ralto was the first officer and security chief of the Bright Seeker mining survey ship. He was a stern, competent man with a strict honor code. Although he was a member of a House Calipsa crew, he made a point of treating all aboard the ship with respect.
Edas Vasti was a member of the Bright Seeker mining survey ship under the command of Captain Nils Wender.
Parto Nethathanin was a member of the Bright Seeker mining survey ship under the command of Captain Nils Wender.
Kalista Banto was a member of the Bright Seeker mining survey ship under the command of Captain Nils Wender.
Peta Lactril was a female Human and a noble of House Barnaba. She hosted the Unification Gala that was held prior to the Battle of Endor.
Alric Adannon was a male Human Lord of House Cadriaan. He represented his house in the annual inter-house Vor-cal safari hunt in which he once came second.
Barleos was a minor Lord of House Melantha, a saber rake and protégé of Lord Vaskel Savill.

Winslo was the governess of Theus Paddox's siblings, Trad Paddox and Verinia Paddox. She was killed onboard the Regal Destiny starship when a House Mecetti agent infiltrate the ship and released a deadly bio-agent into the air supply, during the time of the Pelagian purge.
Galemus Hejaran was a member of the influential Hejaran family of House Mecetti. He was the uncle of Baron Lucian Hejaran, Themion Hejaran and Lady Brigta Hejaran.
Odie Subu was a Human female who served as a reconnaissance trooper in a reconnaissance platoon of the Praesitlyn Defense Force. She was slightly younger than Anakin Skywalker.

Kun Lago was a Human male who was King Ars Veruna's Prime Counselor and the father of Ian Lago. At the end of the corrupt King's reign, his son Ian purportedly fell in love with the then-Princess of Theed, Padmé Amidala.

Schmood was a male Yuzzum who worked for Grappa the Hutt. In 11 ABY, Schmood heard Grappa calling for help, and found him locked up. While freeing him, Schmood informed Grappa that Sol Mon, a follower of Grappa's, had left his palace because of the Black Sun.
Sebastian Parnell was an Imperial general who served as governor of the Sil'Lume system during the time of the New Order. He was distinguishable with his silver hair and ice-blue eyes.

Laudica was a Human female from the planet Corellia who worked as a gun-runner during the Galactic Civil War. She was known for her skills as a markswoman and was one of many criminals who frequented the palace of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine.
Leslomy Tacema was a Duros female native to her species' eponymous homeworld. By 4 ABY, she became a pilot who helped run the docking facilities in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine.
Arnet was a human male who was a veteran Imperial AT-ST pilot and lieutenant. He piloted the Walker Blizzard Scout 1 during the Battle of Hoth, and later Tempest Scout 1 in Battle of Endor.
Rypka was the dour female Twi'lek copilot for Hawker Bryce-Kelley's two ships, the medium freighter Royal Mistress and the bulk freighter Queen's Victory.
Slopper was a Saurian who worked for Sithless Leethe. He was not very intelligent however, and was rather easy to dupe if someone were to attempt it.

Halomar Corros was a Human male general who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Assigned as commander of Reginard Base, Corros oversaw the day-to-day operation of the outpost.

Sithless Leethe was a minor Saurian crime boss who occasionally ran scams for Jabba the Hutt. Unlike most members of his species, he wore flashy robes with sashes and did not have any visible weapons, though he always had a pair of knives up his sleeves.
Joreb Goss was married to the traitorous Fallanassi Isela Talsava Norand, and the father of Akanah Norand Goss Pell.

Darca Nyl was a Human male mercenary who, after falling in love with a woman named Teril, retired and settled in the Outer Rim Territories. His wife died in childbirth, and Nyl devoted his life to raising his son Neas.
At'raoth was a Shamed One trained by Nom Anor in his guise as Yu'shaa.

Allegedly, a female Force-sensitive Yuuzhan Vong was to have been seduced and trained in the dark side of the Force in the aftermath of the Yuuzhan Vong War. Her existence and nature were described by her victim, Daye.
Krayn was a male T'surr slave-raider, or pirate, posing as a 'legitimate' business-dealing slaver in the galactic slave trading industry around the time of the Invasion of Naboo.
Palejo Reshad was a native of the planet Corellia. He worked as a spice trader, and operated out of his homeworld's city of Bela Vistal.
Kal'Falnl C'ndros (sometimes known as Kal Fal) was a female Quor'sav trader.

Embra was a compassionate Hutt who could often be found at Jabba's Palace on Tatooine, with fellow Hutts Jabba and Malta. He was known for wearing a nose ring through both nostrils. Embra based his operations on the jungle planet Mazhar.

Ull Murub was a Force-sensitive male Sullustan Padawan of the Jedi Order with the rank of Guardian. During the Imperial Era, Murub and his master survived the Galactic Empire's Great Jedi Purge while stationed on the planet Sullust.

Hawker Bryce-Kelley was a male Human smuggler who was the owner of both the medium freighter Royal Mistress and the bulk freighter Queen's Victory along with his co-pilot Rypka during the Galactic Civil War.

Galen Panos was the High Lord of House Reena during the Imperial Era, and at the time of the Battle of Hoth, had been in office for about 30 years. His reign as High Lord was quiet, in contrast to his predecessor.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: A male Duros starfighter pilot, Lensi fought in both the Yuuzhan Vong War and the Second Galactic Civil War. Young when the galaxy was invaded by a race of extra-galactic aliens known as the Yuuzhan Vong, Lensi suffered the loss of his homeworld of Duro to the warfaring species.

Ewwen Glayyd was a Human male who served as the Mor, or clan patriarch, of the powerful House Glayyd on the Corporate Sector world of Ammuud. Glayyd ascended to the position of Mor in 2 BBY, when his father Agmor was mysteriously poisoned.
Gamgalon was a Krish big-game hunter who also headed a criminal operation on Varonat.

Jobath Knox was the Chief Councilor of Galantos during to the Black Fleet Crisis and the Yuuzhan Vong War. Originally a member of the Fian Security Force, he entered politics at the age of forty, when he became a devotee of the God of Age known as Gotagei.
Anni Capstan was a female from the planet Corellia who served in Rogue Squadron as a starfighter pilot in 25 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Tagta the Hutt was a member of the Desilijic clan. He was cousin to, and subordinate of, Jiliac
Vram was a young Human boy associated with the Empire Reborn in 14 ABY.

Neg was a captain who was active in 32 BBY. Neg lived in a house in the Tatooine city of Mos Espa, where he kept a deadly beast. Around the time of the Invasion of Naboo, he captured an Ithorian boy named Tomo, whom Neg forced to work without respite for months.

Malik Carr was a male Yuuzhan Vong warrior who fought during the Yuuzhan Vong War. A skilled tactician and leader, Carr was promoted to the rank of commander shortly before the invasion, and took his flotilla to the conquered world of Obroa-skai.

Triton Squad Leader was a clone commando lieutenant who led Triton Squad into the depths of the Kashyyyk jungles to chase fugitive Wookiees following the Battle of Kashyyyk, most notable of whom was Chewbacca. He and all of his squad were ambushed and killed in the conflict.
Teril Nyl was a Human female and the wife of Darca Nyl. She was considered beautiful. She died from complications after giving birth to their son Neas.
Neas Nyl was a Human male and the son of Darca and Teril Nyl.
Tyerle was a strong-willed woman, and the sister of Alliance to Restore the Republic agent Tay Vanis.

Rogan was the husband of Tyerle and the brother-in-law of Rebel agent Tay Vanis. Rogan's past is a mystery until the time he married Tyerle. They traveled to the planet Questal, trying to escape from the pressures of the Empire.
Beekly Grimlok was a Rodian saboteur who referred himself as "the best technological assassin of the New Order".
Kaz Lo was a male Zabrak who made his living as a tech specialist during the last years of the Galactic Republic. His first name, Kaz, meant "clever" or "innovative" in the Zabraki language.

Brabe was a male Fian who worked as a Vert'bo airship driver on his homeworld of Galantos during the early years of the New Republic. He tried to fight back against Stima Ardella and the Black Hammer pirates because they drove off his customers.

Hurnoj Arqu'uthun was a male Arkanian captain who protected his homeworld, the planet of Thule, in the final years of the Old Republic. He was very loyal and wanted to make the innocent's casualties to its least.
Valara Saar, also known as the Prophetess, was a female Human Force Adept from Yashuvhu who lived sometime during the waning years of the Galactic Republic and into the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Jedi was the name of Valara Saar's second pet Duuvhal.
Adarakh was a male Noghri who served as the bodyguard of Leia Organa Solo alongside Meewalh, following the Battle of Duro during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Ap'Sareb was a young swoop racer who lived on Citadel Station some time after the Jedi Civil War. By 3951 BBY, Ap'Sareb was ranked fourth of the swoop racers on the station, but was later bested by the score set by Meetra Surik when she took up the sport.
Nikylitis was a swoop racer on Citadel Station after the Jedi Civil War. By 3951 BBY, Nikylitis was ranked third of the swoop racers on the station.
Requel Sorm was a swoop racer on Citadel Station after the Jedi Civil War. By 3951 BBY, Sorm was ranked second of the swoop racers on the station.

Plaan was a male Weequay. In 25 ABY he was the chief of security on Tholatin. He later was first mate on the Sweet Surprise, and encountered Han and Leia Organa Solo on Nova Station looking for someone to pilot refugees to Coruscant.
Tomo was an Ithorian boy in Mos Espa during 32 BBY, who was held in servitude by Captain Neg. He was often promised freedom, although Neg had no intention of fulfilling his promise.

Jym Lang was a young male Rodian bounty hunter in Mos Espa around the time of the Blockade of Naboo, who encountered Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn at the Boonta Eve Classic Podrace. Lang attempted to intimidate him with his threatening demeanor.

Trefaren was an Imperial Admiral stationed on Corellia approximately in 3 BBY. Admiral Trefaren asked Bria Tharen to accompany him to a reception held by the Corellian government for Imperial officers.

Wallen was a Human stormtrooper who held the rank of sergeant, and was assigned to Colonel Dyer's command on the Forest Moon of Endor in 4 ABY during the construction of the second Death Star prior to the Battle of Endor.
Yount was an Imperial Governor posted on the planet Wakeelmui, whose duties included being in charge of a stormtrooper garrison on the world.
Chad Hilse was an Alderaanian ensign in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Brindy Truchong was a Human female Corellian smuggler. She flew a modified freighter and was an ally of gun-runner and fellow Corellian Laudica.
Neb Dulo was a Tocoyan hailing from the desert planet Tocoya. A blue-gray-skinned Tocoyan with pink eyes, Dulo was a disciple of Davrilat, a complicated religion based on the sanctity of harmonics.

Lord Qaqquqqu was a member of the Empire Reborn which was lead by the Dark Jedi Hethrir, the former Imperial Procurator of Justice. He was rich and powerful, owning vast resources including starships and having several followers.

During a meeting with Hethrir in 14 ABY, Ucce was present along with Lords Qaqquqqu and Cnorec. When Hethrir suggested sending the then three-year old Anakin Solo back to where he came from, she suggested memory wiping Anakin and then putting him back, before concluding by say…

Lord Cnorec was a member of the Empire Reborn which was led by the Dark Jedi Hethrir, the former Imperial Procurator of Justice. He was rich and powerful, owning vast resources including starships and having several followers.
Zeev was a duuvhal and the first pet of Force adept Valara Saar. Zeev's sex is unknown.

Bisad Koong was the governor of Roon's Tawntoom province during the early years of the Galactic Empire. He was a megalomaniac, running his own illegal operations from his fortress, including theft and hijacking. He was also an expert in political intrigue.
Q'Anilia was a female Miraluka Jedi Master who served the secret cabal known as the Jedi Covenant as a seer during the era of the Mandalorian Wars.
Shad Jelavan was a Human male Jedi Padawan apprenticed to Miraluka Jedi Master Q'Anilia at the planet Taris' Jedi Tower.
Reeft was a male Dressellian Jedi Knight and a contemporary of the famed Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi. Jedi Reeft served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Rotar Lopani was a thief with ties to the Bando Gora criminal organization who lived during the reign of the Galactic Republic. In 22 BBY, representatives of the Circarpous sector placed a bounty of 8,000 credits on his head.
Ganar Tos was the elderly Zisian male majordomo of the High Priest Teroenza on the spice factory planet of Ylesia. He had greenish skin, saggy jowls and rheumy eyes.
Rekkon was a Human male university professor who, in 2 BBY, formed a secret group of citizens searching for lost loved ones who had disappeared after running afoul of the Corporate Sector Authority.
Ephaan Kenzon was a Force-sensitive discovered on the Outer Rim world of Baltimn, who was brought back to Coruscant for Jedi training.
Luxum was a female Shard Jedi Knight that trained under Master Aqinos. Like the rest of the Iron Knights, Luxum joined the New Jedi Order when discovered on the planet Dweem.
This Human male served as Sith Master Finn's apprentice during the final years of the New Sith Wars. He traveled to a planet with Finn and helped him plant a bomb in a building.
Salla was a female Jenet, and the Chief Assistant of Chief of State Cal Omas.

Yom Argo, also known as Dart, was a Human male spy who served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. A native of Telfrey, Argo and his partner Tay Vanis drew Imperial ire for fomenting rebellious sentiment in the Iskalon system, leading to Telfrey's destruction.
Tsaak Vootuh commanded the Yuuzhan Vong force on Yavin 4 in 26 ABY. He was also responsible for arresting Mezhan Kwaad and Nen Yim for their heretical shaping of Tahiri Veila.
Hul Rapuung was the brother of Vua Rapuung and a Warrior of the Yuuzhan Vong. He was assigned to Yavin 4 when the Yuuzhan Vong took the moon.
Dauren was a lieutenant on the Imperial planet of Carida.

An individual was a member of the Jedi Order by 6900 BBY. Becoming a Dark Jedi, they fought against the Order during the Hundred-Year Darkness, at the conclusion of which they were among the group of Dark Jedi exiled from known space.

Todr Fel was a Corellian, the younger brother of Imperial fighter ace Soontir Fel. He grew up on an Allied Grain and Roughage agro-combine, where he learned the values of loyalty, duty, and hard work from his family.

Fyric Fel was the son of Todr Fel and Ajai Fel and the nephew of Baron Soontir Fel. Born in late 2 ABY, he was kidnapped by Ilir Post nearly five years after the Battle of Yavin when Soontir Fel defected to the New Republic.
Ajai Fel was the wife of Todr Fel and the mother of Fyric Fel. Her brother-in-law was Baron Soontir Fel, and she lived on the estate Soontir had gained through his barony.

Dagga Marl was the bodyguard of Thrackan Sal-Solo during his brief time as President of the Ylesian Republic. Sal-Solo chose her for her skill—something his official guard lacked in abundance—and her mercenary nature.
Lorfo was a Toydarian who lived in Coronet during the latter days of the Galactic Republic. He ran a shop on Treasure Ship Row and was friends with both Rostek Horn and Nejaa Halcyon.
Saato was a humanoid female Sith witch from the planet Dathomir who left the Witches of Dathomir to work as a Dark Acolyte under Count Dooku.

Tendir Blue was a male Separatist agent working for the Techno Union. He was heavyset, with red hair, freckles, and crooked teeth. Tendir was used by Jedi Knights Aayla Secura and Ylenic It'kla to help extract Ratri Tane and his family from Corellia.

Royce was a Kadas'sa'Nikto prospector who, partnered with Samuel, discovered an inhospitable planet rich with ore. Cheated out of his discovery Royce kidnapped his partner's daughter, Leddar. During the credit exchange for Leddar, Royce was brought down by Darca Nyl.
Mak was an Imperial general who, in the company of Darth Vader and Nas Ghent, searched for the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Crucible during the Galactic Civil War.

Dorin Millavec was a commander on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Crucible during the Galactic Civil War. He first sees Nas Ghent making an unauthorized boarding of the Crucible in a Headhunter-model fighter.
Resjin Resjic was a Human male Imperial officer aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Crucible during the Galactic Civil War. He was a close confidant of Commander Dorin Millavec.
Jaalib Brandl was a Human male Dark Side Adept who doubled as an actor, much like his father, the High Inquisitor Adalric Cessius Brandl.

Thaddeus Ross was a Corellian Human male captain of the YT-1300 light freighter Kierra. Following in the footsteps of his forefathers, most likely his grandfather who had been captured by the Empire, he became a smuggler prior to the Battle of Yavin, but was a bounty hunter in…

Byrom was a former mercenary who upon meeting his wife Ensa decided to live a more quiet and bloodless life in the Outer Rim Territories. He settled on the planet Molavar and became a moisture farmer.
Ensa was a moisture farmer on Molavar and the wife of the protective Byrom.

Ament was a male Human who, though normally kind and gentle, was cursed with uncontrollable rage. He murdered many people in his fits. He once escaped from jail with the help of Darca Nyl, who later put him back in prison after learning of his true nature.
Malgio was a corpulent Quarren who was academically proficient and it was said that he was witty. He owned many ships and was one of the best inventors of Starship Customizations.

Shallamar was a female Barabel, and one of several beings with whom Han Solo played sabacc on Devaron. Solo's luck led her to believe he was cheating, so she attempted to kill him. Fortunately for Solo, Chewbacca disagreed violently with this course of action.

Malak was a Rodian female enslaver born in 26 BBY and active during the Galactic Civil War. She was known to attack ill-defended communities with her gang and kidnap victims, sometimes severely injuring them.

Si Treemba was an Arconan miner who was one of the first to befriend Obi-Wan Kenobi on the ship Monument, on their way to Bandomeer. He worked for Clat'Ha at the Arcona Mineral Harvest Corporation along with many other Humans and Arconans.

Sora Mobari was a Human female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, while on a mission to stop Ithorian terrorists, Mobari's Padawan, Evan-Ott, betrayed his Master and tried to kill her in an explosion.
The Governor of Galidraan was a Human male who was appointed to the position by the Galactic Republic in 44 BBY.

Miat Temm was a human female who served as one of Grand Admiral Gilad Pellaeon's civilian aides in the Imperial Remnant during the early period of the Yuuzhan Vong War. She was Force-sensitive, and used this ability to shield her thoughts from other users of the Force.
Shel Jelavan was a Human female who lived in the Middle City of Taris prior to the Mandalorian Wars. She, along with her brothers Shad and Shay, was orphaned when her parents died in an accident.
Jaren was an acquaintance of the former mercenary Darca Nyl and the sister of the convicted killer Ament.

Leddar was the daughter of prospect magnate Samuel. One day, while she was playing with her friend, an estranged partner who her father had cheated, kidnapped her, taking Leddar into the inhospitable surface of the planet to await the ransom.

Zel Johans was a Human male who served in the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire. Johans would earn the nickname "The Rancor" from men who served alongside him. He was a well respected tactician, and played a key role in the development of repulsortanks for the army.

Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Raygar took control of a Lorrdian archaeological dig which had uncovered the ancient Slave Pits of Lorrd, as ancient Lorrdian legend told of a powerful Argazdan superweapon hidden in the Slave Pits.

Drell Kahmf was a Zabrak scientist who acquired and preserved Darth Maul's brain and spinal cord alive in a bacta tank in his lab a few years after the Battle of Endor. He used Maul's brain to create a solid-state hologram of Maul, which terrorized Iridonia's capital.

Edor Crespin was a Human male from Corulag, who served as a General in the New Republic Defense Fleet's Starfighter Command. As of 7 ABY, he was the commander of the starfighter training base established on the Commenorian moon of Folor.
Fenri Dalso was a male human Mandalorian warrior and member of the Death Watch who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Rageon Vart was a male human Mandalorian warrior and member of the Death Watch who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Klin Nif was a male human Mandalorian warrior and member of the Death Watch who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Entha Kandela was the Zabrak female scout who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

Jorak was a member of the Sanyassan Marauders from the forest moon of Endor. During the Galactic Civil War, he paid an individual 25 credits to eliminate a bloodseeker mite which was attacking the Sanyassan's livestock.
Balog was a Human male who served as the Chief Security Controller of the planet New Apsolon and an active Absolute. He was the one responsible for the death of Jedi Master Tahl.
Dorn Tlo was a famous Kel Dor Baran Do Sage Master who contacted the New Jedi Order in 30 ABY and sent them old Republic-era records from the Jedi to attest to the Baran Do's long history.
Laen Pieweto was a Chiss poacher during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He led a group of poachers in the Etyyy hunting grounds on the planet Kashyyyk.
Mikdanyell Guh'rantt was a male Rodian who served as mayor of Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.

Morkov was once a commander in the Clone Wars. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, he had become an arms dealer selling illegal Imperial hardware. He resided in the Keren hotel on the planet Naboo.

Nagem Dr'Lar, also known as Megan Dr'Lar, was an independent Selonian salvager who was salvaging technology and information from the debris left by the first Death Star for the Galactic Empire on the planet Yavin 4.

The Old Man was a male Human Force-sensitive who lived sometime after the Battle of Yavin during the Galactic Civil War, a galaxy-wide conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Arns Grimraker was a cyborg salvage operator who visited the planet of Hoth in the wake of the Battle of Hoth. He and his crew flew Gun tugs and used a GR-75 medium transport, the Death Merchant, to haul their spoils.

Lekk Bazak was a male Rodian pirate who gallivanted the edges of Brak sector with a small crew of Rodians and Humans known in some circles as Bazak's Gang. He was affiliated with the Nalmar crime family.
Besha was a female Rodian who, along with her friends Kesha and Nesha, worked with the Wookiee Nerrowr.
Bormm Biveedo was a Rodian business associate of Drooto Sploonore. Much of their business centered on the shipment of spice along the Hydian Way.
Gespo Bomu was a Rodian soldier. He was a member of the Bomu Clan and occasionally worked form Zonnos the Lesser of the Anjiliac kajidic.
Osae Meilea was a female Sullustan working for the Hutt kajidics during the Galactic Civil War.
The Chosen One was a male Lannik cult leader operating on the planet Lannik two decades prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

Auren Yomm Baobab was a Human female from the planet Roon. The daughter of Nilz and Bola Yomm, by the age of fifteen, Auren Yomm was an accomplished athlete and served as the leader of the Umboo Racing Team during the Roon Colonial Games of 15 BBY.
Tieren Nie-Tan was a male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Nilz Yomm was a male Human doctor from Roon, father of Auren Yomm and husband of Bola Yomm. When Auren won the Roon Colonial Games, Governor Koong, the Governor of Roon, poisoned the province they lived in, Umboo with a chemical called rooze.

Falan Iniro was a hotheaded Corellian pilot that was present at the Battle of Nar Shaddaa. He and his gunner, Gadaf, were part of the smugglers' First Strike Element in the YT-1210 light freighter, Take That!.
Evram Lajaie was a Human commander of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 0 BBY, he was at the Alliance's base on Yavin 4.
Darez Wuht was a male Duros admiral, and the commanding officer of the Duro Defense Force a year into the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Xora was a female Falleen who was employed by the Bothan information broker Jib Kopatha during the Galactic Civil War.
Darv Eldon was captain of the Carrack-class light cruiser Vigilance under Admiral Winstel Greelanx, during the Battle of Nar Shaddaa.
Krafte was a male Squib and the son of Emala. He served as her accountant during the Swarm War.
Ark'ik was a male Verpine who, along with Ra'tre, smuggled TibannaX gas to Tenupe for the Squibs Sligh, Grees and Emala.
Ra'tre was a male Verpine who along with Ark'ik, were running Tibanna for Sligh, Grees and Emala to Tenupe.

Athadar Gyad was a female Human. After Jaina Solo, Lowbacca, and Tesar Sebatyne arrested the Yaka pirate Redstar aboard his ship, the Night Lady, in 35 ABY, she was the Reconstruction Authority inquisitor who tried the case on the maximum security space station MaxSec Eight.

Zelara was a female Ishi Tib who along with her companion Lyari was at the Lizil nest in 35 ABY. They became attracted to Luke Skywalker as part of a botched attempt on his part to use Force persuasion on them, resulting in an uncomfortable situation for the Jedi Master.

Lyari was a female Ishi Tib who was at the Lizil nest at 35 ABY with her companion Zelara. They became attracted to Luke Skywalker as part of a failed attempt on his part to use Force persuasion on them, resulting in an uncomfortable situation for the Jedi Master.

Sal Ghator was a male Yuuzhan Vong who was living in the mixed class village of La'okio on Zonama Sekot. A former subaltern, Sal was caught by the Extolled Bava, stealing out of the Extolled's crops, who brought this information to Tahiri Veila.

Bava was a male Yuuzhan Vong who caught Sal Ghator stealing from the Extolled's crops. After the Yuuzhan Vong War, he was allowed to live on Zonama Sekot, where he attempted to build a community in La'okio.
Ooamu Waoabi was a male Ithorian who was the eldest of the Ithorian Elders.
Niev Jaub was a Sullustan trader that operated on Nar Shaddaa. He specialized in delivering exotic foods to the Hutt casinos that were established on the moon.
Krag Val was a Yuuzhan Vong stationed on Bimmiel early in the invasion.

Tetengo Noor was a human male pilot for the New Republic Defense Fleet from the planet Churba. He flew A-Wings as part of the training group Blue Squadron, alongside what would become Wraith Squadron, on Folor.
Kiles L'toth was a Dornean male who served as the Associate Director of the Astrographic Survey Institute and an officer in the Dornean Navy.
Qual'do Herm was a male Aqualish who served as an officer for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
San'sii "the Kursk" was a male Human who became the leader of the Force-using organization known as the Blackguard on the planet Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War.
Sawtooth was a legendary Uller who resided in the Dead Forest on Kashyyyk. He was responsible for the maiming of the great Rodian hunter Qakkee, who eventually hired an individual to kill him.

Scholar Szingo was a member of the Sanyassan Marauders who resided in the Marauder's Stronghold on the forest moon of Endor. He had bitter feelings of rivalry with the Nightsister Charal, the cohort of King Terak.

Burrk was an human male former stormtrooper who deserted the Galactic Empire after the Battle of Endor. He teamed up with two Cathar siblings, Nodon and Nonak, and hunted Wampas on Hoth even though it was illegal.
Trehla Keelo was a female Human who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Uwo Poal was a male who worked for Morkov in Dee'ja Peak on Naboo. Morkov sent an individual to him to pick up five crates of E-11 blaster rifles, but he attacked them along with his bodyguards.
Vourk ver'Zremp was a male Twi'lek who was on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire.
Thorne Kraym was the leader of the Jabiimi Nationalists after Alto Stratus's death, and later the Imperial Governor of Jabiim.
Malthorn was a Human publicity agent employed by Alexis Cov-Prim. He also worked as bounty hunter to fund some of Alexis' dealings.
Jervo Thalien was a male Skrilling who served as chairman of Lhosan Industries during the Mandalorian Wars.

Haydel Goravvus was a male part-Human, part-Hamadryas businessman who went on to become the first Republic Senator for the planet Taris and gained fame as the leader of the Taris Resistance against Mandalorian invaders in 3964 BBY.
Andor Javin was a TriNebulon News reporter.
Toorka was a police investigator on Elshandruu Pica. He was placed in charge of an investigation following Tombat's theft of quella stones from the resort hotel Margath's on Elshandruu Pica.

Krotorra was a male Wookiee who served as a New Republic representative from Kashyyyk. Following the Battle of Endor, he was captured by the Twi'lek slaver Slar-dan ti Gardi and sold to the Vax Mining Group.
Lamorrack was a Wookiee New Republic representative from Kashyyyk. Following the Battle of Endor, he was captured by the Twi'lek slaver Slar-dan ti Gardi and sold to the Vax Mining Group.
Tauran Nartal was a Kajain'sa'Nikto Special Forces sergeant for the New Republic.
Cade Skywalker was a Human male bounty hunter, smuggler, and pirate, who in his youth was once the Jedi Padawan of Wolf Sazen.

Rav was a male Feeorin pirate who was the owner of a bounty clearing house and cantina, the Golden Gorg, during the era of the Sith–Imperial War and the Second Imperial Civil War. He was also a collaborator to the One Sith and Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire.

Nat Skywalker was a Human male who served as a Jedi Master during the Sith–Imperial War. Born into a strong Force-sensitive family, Skywalker was a descendant of Anakin and Luke Skywalker, the older brother of Jedi Council member Kol Skywalker, and uncle of Kol's son, Cade.

Gadaf was the Rodian gunner aboard Take That! at the Battle of Nar Shaddaa. When pilot Falan Iniro took his ship out of the debris field prematurely, Take That! was immediately assailed by TIE fighters.
Conil Barje was a Human male from Corellia.

Hoonta was a Rodian henchman of Jabba Desilijic Tiure. A member of the Chattza clan, he was killed when he, along with a group of other henchmen, attempted to assassinate the Jedi Knight Ki-Adi-Mundi during a skiff ride through the Jundland Wastes.

Willham Burke was the Admiral of the Fourth Battle Group of the Rebel Alliance, operating in the Outer Rim. He later served as a commander in the New Republic's Third Fleet, winning numerous victories in the years immediately following the Battle of Endor.

Reldo Dovlis was captain of the Imperial Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser Peacekeeper at the Battle of Nar Shaddaa. He was killed when Peacekeeper was sent hurtling into Nar Shaddaa's planetary shield.
Malare was a female Twi'lek who had been employed to serve as a governess for Bastila Shan before Shan was given to the Jedi Order as a young girl.
