Reiva Carrick, a Human female, was a gardener from the planet Phaeda and the mother of Jedi Padawan Zayne Carrick. Reiva was married to a banker named Arvan Carrick, with whom she had five children, Zayne being the only son.

A Human male was the Overlord of the Death Watch remnant during the Galactic Civil War. They were based inside the Death Watch bunker on the forest moon of Endor, virtually hidden from the rest of the galaxy.
DS-181-4 was the callsign of a Human male starfighter pilot who served the Galactic Empire in the Galactic Civil War.
Onoma was the Mon Calamari captain of the MC80B Star Cruiser Mon Remonda. He led the warship in the Liberation of Coruscant, where he captured the Imperial Star Destroyer Triumph.
Lieutenant Ch'arb was an officer aboard the Star Destroyer Avenger in 3 ABY. Ch'arb was responsible for escorting the bounty hunter Awarru Tark to Darth Vader's chamber.
Carithlee was a starfighter pilot who served in the elite Rogue Squadron at some point by 7 ABY before leaving the unit.
Choba was a Dug torturer employed by Jib Kopatha. He was killed by Sheel Odala when she, together with Chewbacca, attempted to rescue Han Solo from Kopatha's torture room.

Teren Rogriss was a Human male who held himself to a strict code of personal honor and duty. He was a career officer in the Imperial Navy, rising to the rank of admiral, while at the same time managing to raise a family.
Alima was a male Human who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Aron Harcourt was a disgraced former captain of the Imperial Navy, who served administratively on a remote outpost in 0 ABY.
Qurang Lah was a male Yuuzhan Vong warrior and a crèche-brother of Warmaster Tsavong Lah.

Shok Choka was a male Yuuzhan Vong warrior. He was the leader of a boarding party aboard a space station in the Yag'Dhul system. He challenged Corran Horn to a duel, but Anakin Solo took Corran's place. During the fight Shok Choka swept Anakin's legs from under him.

Qau Lah was the leader of the warriors on the space station that the Yuuzhan Vong attacked in the Yag'Dhul system after Shok Choka was killed by Anakin Solo. Nom Anor told him to go and find the 'infidels'. He turned and the Intendant shot him in the back of the head.
Vhonte Tervho was a female Mandalorian soldier, who lived during the Galactic Republic's twilight years.
Garreth Holtz was a male Human Admiral who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Dalton was an Imperial Navy officer and captain of the Engager, an Imperial-class Star Destroyer.

A Chief Justice was the head of the Galactic Republic's Supreme Court as of 33 BBY. He heard the corruption case against Chancellor Finis Valorum brought by Senator Bail Antilles, and presumably presided over the four trials of Nute Gunray.
Brion Peck was a Rebel Alliance commando shrouded in mystery.
Axkva Min was a Nightsister who was situated in the Nightsister Stronghold on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War, and used a specialized energy lance as her main weapon.

Baritha was a female Dathomirian who was one of the founding members of the Nightsisters of the planet Dathomir and served as leader Gethzerion's right hand until the Nightsisters were defeated by the Singing Mountain Clan.

Leandra was a female Human who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she operated at the Nightsister Stronghold. There, she served the Nightsisters as a Spell Weaver.
Azzenaj was an Arch Witch of the Singing Mountain Clan on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War. Her pet rancor was named Lurrexu.
Dageerin was a male Aqualish situated in the village of Aurilia on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War. He was part of the forces who were in constant battle with the Sith Shadows.
Daktar Bloodmoon was a male Trandoshan member of the Sith Shadows who had a cybernetic arm. He was killed by a Force-sensitive individual who was sent to kill Mellichae by the Old Man.
Clynn was an Imperial lieutenant during the Galactic Civil War and was stationed on Kalist VI in 0 ABY.
Noils was an Imperial General during the Galactic Civil War and the base commander of the Kalist VI garrison.
Goran was a slave, imprisoned in the Imperial base on Kalist VI.
Mouse was a Duros agent in the Rebel Alliance.

Kale Roshuir was a Human male Imperial captain assigned to the garrison on the planet Kalist VI in 0 ABY. Following a Rebel attack on the Imperial tanker Nuna's Twins, Roshuir was charged with leading an assault on the Rebel Alliance's base on Thila.

Bravo 4 was a Clone trooper pilot who served in the Clone Wars. Bravo 4 piloted one of three TX-130 Saber-class fighter tanks that composed Bravo Squadron. The unit was led by Anakin Skywalker. They saw action during the Battle of Thule.
Mellor Yago was an officer in the Rendili Home Defense Fleet during the Clone Wars, serving aboard the flagship Mersel Kebir.
Geor-Dan-Thi was a male Tiss'shar who served as the President of the Tiss'sharl League in 0 ABY, replacing Si-Di-Ri in the office.
Dolac Legasi was Human male assassin who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

RC-1080, also referred to as Ten-Eighty, was a clone commando pilot during the Clone Wars. He was part of the team sent to Aviles Prime to catch Lorca Oviedo, a powerful corporate leader who conspired with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Gruthashaal was a female Human Nightsister during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She somehow obtained a lightsaber which Singular Nak attempted to buy from her.

Olof was an Imperial Inquisitor during the Galactic Civil War. He was seen in the Imperial Prison on the planet Dathomir and once heard of a clan of dangerous Nightsisters, the Spiderclan, who had developed a strange symbiosis with some other creatures than the Rancor.
Mellichae was a male Zabrak Dark Jedi who had a cybernetic arm wearing Mandalorian armor and led the Sith Shadows on Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War.
Morathax was a Nightsister living on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War. She organized many attacks against the Singing Mountain Clan, the enemies of the Nightsisters.

Paemos was a male Rodian and ranged weapons expert found in the village of Aurilia on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War. He was friendly with everyone he met, a trait that made him few friends on Rodia but many elsewhere.

Herrit was a male Human who served in Imperial Intelligence, where he reached the rank of Major. His responsibilities included gathering information on both enemies and potential allies of the Galactic Empire and sending these profiles to such leaders as Emperor Palpatine and …
Nem Bees was a male Ortolan Jedi Knight who served the Galactic Republic during the pan-galactic Clone Wars.
Avan Post was a Human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the last decades of both.

Solistein was an individual who served the Galactic Empire as a captain and an aide to the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader at the time the controversial sentientologist and xenobiologist Obo Rin was writing the Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy under Vader's patronage.

Belo Tusus was the ruler of Orto in the late stages of the Clone Wars. Originally the neutral Ortolan government's Financial Minister, Tusus aligned himself with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, which was embroiled in the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic at the …
Heilan Rotham was a Human professor at the famous Lorrd University around the time of the Second Galactic Civil War. She was an old, wheelchair-bound woman with white hair, pale skin, and blue eyes.

Lirran Aro was the founder and chief designer of the droid manufacturing corporation Aro. The corporation went into bankruptcy due to the attempted assassination of a Corellian official with one of Aro's security droids. Aro lived on Selonia in the Corellian system.
Zuud was a female officer with the rank of Lieutenant attached to the Analysis Bureau of Imperial Intelligence. Zuud was one of the Empire's most effective interrogators.
Ja Bardrin, a ruthless and power-hungry Human male, was the leader of the Bardrin Group.

Siv Kav was a male Neimoidian vicelord and fleet commander who served the Trade Federation and Techno Union task force supervised by Kinman Doriana, dispatched on orders of Darth Sidious to intercept and destroy Outbound Flight in 27 BBY. He wore a five-pointed hat.

Wasser Barer was a Quarren who lived at the time of the blockade of Naboo. He was one of the racers that were enlisted for a pod race on the planet Malastare, participating in the Vinta Harvest Classic.
Dix Rivan, known as Dixie, was a starfighter pilot of the Rebel Alliance's elite Rogue Squadron. He flew as Rogue Five in the months following the Battle of Hoth, during the Galactic Civil War.
Glamaxon Tvurl, known as the Blade of Barab was a Barabel gladiator in the Circus Horrificus on Nar Shaddaa.

Lido Mufrenes was a Rodian who attempted to kill Quinlan Vos in order to win a bet on how long the Jedi would survive on Nar Shaddaa. He was killed by Vilmarh Grahrk, who also wanted to kill Vos to win the bet.

4/163 was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic. During the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, they participated in the Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY.

6/298 was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic. 6/298 participated in the First Battle of Geonosis, and was one of the troopers who assisted in the rescue of Jedi Mace Windu's strike team from the Petranaki arena.
Progga, also known as Progga the Hutt, was a minor Hutt crime lord and pirate from the edge of the Unknown Regions. He was active during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Adela Tyché was a female Human and a skilled pilot. She worked for Borvo the Hutt around the time of the Invasion of Naboo and temporarily joined the Naboo resistance before Borvo betrayed the Naboo people.
The male Gran Kol Kotha led a dangerous life, and years of piracy and smuggling had hardened him. His dealing of illegal arms in the Outer Rim attracted the attention of Borvo the Hutt on Naboo.
Tooth was an Advanced Recon Commando and one of a group of clone troopers left behind on Pengalan IV after their LAAT/i was shot down during a full scale Republic retreat.
Hannser was a male officer who served within the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Mermeia was a holographic fantasy woman who existed within virtual reality as an erotic entertainer for users of mind evaporators and holoprojectors.

Kukul was a Hutt who placed a bounty on Odnalor Chull for stealing starships from the Guarja Shipyards on Nal Hutta. He also offered money for several other criminals for their wrongdoings against him.

In 14 ABY, Jedi Knight Jaden Korr discovered a mutant rancor within a Tanaab spaceport that was created by the Disciples of Ragnos. They planned on releasing the rancor into the city so that they could steal arms, credits, and other needed goods during the chaos.

Boss Roke was a male Human who was head of one of the mining operations on the world of Kessel, serving as a subordinate to Moruth Doole. He was killed by a mysterious, many-legged creature while seeking out a large deposit of glitterstim deep within one of the mines.
"One-Arm" was the appellation given to the female wampa that Luke Skywalker encountered in the ice cave on Hoth in 3 ABY.

Lycan was a male Jedi Knight who was the master of Sardoth until he fell to the dark side and became a dangerous Dark Jedi. He escaped from Republic custody when the shuttle carrying him to trial on Coruscant crashed on Darca Nyl's home planet.

Irenez was a Human female who served second-in-command of Garm Bel Iblis' movement. A former mercenary, Irenez had heeded Bel Iblis's quiet call for soldiers after his split from the Rebel Alliance. Alongside her counterpart Sena she served as Bel Iblis' chief advisor.
Bwahl was a one-eyed Hutt salesman/crimelord who operated on Torque.
Jake was a large Human male miner who worked on Mimban.
Dal Konur was a Force-sensitive male Human who fought for the Rebel Alliance and its successor, the New Republic, in the Galactic Civil War against the authoritarian Galactic Empire.
Turrant was a Human male captain who served in the Imperial Army some time before the Galactic Civil War.

Arien Yage was a Human female commissioned as a Captain in the Navy of the Imperial Remnant. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, she held command of the Imperial frigate Widowmaker, and following the Battle of Borosk she and her crew joined the expedition of Jedi Master Luke Skywalke…

Soron Hegerty was a human female xenobiologist who served the Imperial Remnant during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Hegerty had previously worked for the Galactic Empire under the Imperial Species Identification Bureau.
Rallo was a Human male who was the leader of a Rebel cell on the Corellian moon of Gus Talon.
Quharek was a Mon Calamari living in the village of Aurilia on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War.

Mallatobuck, also known as Malla, was the wife of Chewbacca, the Wookiee co-pilot of the Corellian smuggler Han Solo. During the Imperial Era, Malla and her family were enslaved by the Galactic Empire. She was separated from her husband Chewbacca and her son Lumpawaroo.
Tanass Brila owned and operated Brila Industrial Supplies. Along with his wife, Renia, he was a member of the Rebel Alliance.

Renia Brila, wife of Tanass Brila, was a doctor and a member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. A respected physician, she was recruited into the Alliance along with her husband and operated a safehouse for the local Rebel cell.
Rejlii Mithel was a male Human weapons technician who served the Galactic Empire. He was the son of "Mauler" Mithel, an Imperial TIE pilot who fought and died in the Battle of Yavin.
Throm Loro was a Human male native to the world of Cilpar. He was the founder of the Cilpari Resistance and husband of Elscol Loro.

Koruu was a furred pirate who worked as a member of thugs Lemo and Sanda's gang on Arcan IV. In 3 ABY, Koruu was with the gang at a cantina when they were approached by disguised Rebel agents Lando Calrissian and Chewbacca, who were searching for information on the whereabouts…

Eckla Shoolb was a female Shamed One and member of Yu'shaa's Jeedai heresy. She was tortured and beaten, but did not break under Supreme Overlord Shimrra's interrogation. She was then sentenced to death.

Hantic was a Ankura Gungan who was the boss of the city of Otoh Langua on the planet Naboo in the year 3000 BBY. During a period of war between the Gungans around that time, Otoh Langua's treasury was severely depleted, forcing the city's inhabitants to continue fighting.
Raccyx Staffa was the Imperial governor of Berchest.
Marsh Limoth was a Human male Imperial Governor of Goroth Prime installed in 17 BBY.
Serdif Tount was the Imperial governor of the planet Rintonne. A native of Coruscant, Governor Tount was under the orders of Moff Par Lankin of the Lambda sector.
Thorsh was a male Jenet operating as a scout and reconnaissance agent in the Galactic Alliance military during the Yuuzhan Vong War, on Duro and Gyndine among other worlds.
Niiriit Esh, crèche-sister to Shoon-mi Esh, was a Yuuzhan Vong Shamed One living in the dark underbelly of Yuuzhan'tar, the former capital of the New Republic.
Raxsus Nuli was a male space pirate who nursed strong ambitions for planetary conquest.

Dashel was a member of the Onderon Council of Lords in 3951 BBY who was a supporter of General Vaklu. In the aftermath of the First Battle of Onderon, which forced the Ebon Hawk to land on Dxun, Dashel hailed Colonel Tobin as a hero and called for him to be decorated.
Samuel was the operator of a mining facility on an unidentified planet in the Outer Rim Territories. He had a daughter named Leddar.

Aves was a male Human who served as the chief aide and communications officer for the smuggler Talon Karrde. Having worked with Karrde since the early days of his organization, Aves was Karrde's spokesman for dealings with Han Solo and Rogue Squadron.
This Hutt was the short-lived offspring of Jiliac Desilijic Tiron, leader of the Desilijic clan in the years preceding the Battle of Yavin.

Kav Dryfus was a male Elom soldier who fought against the Galactic Empire. He originally met Ryannar N'on Dikasterar, an Elomin, during a mining accident, and they were unsteady with each other. Later however, they met again and became friends.

Ryannar N'on Dikasterar was a male Elomin miner who was the first to discover the Elom. He was friends with Kav Dryfus, one of the first Eloms he met. After the Galactic Empire took many of his people captive, he and Dryfus went on a rescue mission. It was a success.

Hallis Saper was a freelance holodocumentarian who served with the New Republic Intelligence Service. A tall, slender Human female from Bonadan, Saper typically wore her long, brown hair either in a braid or in large, elaborate pilings atop her head.

Duttes Mer was the colonial governor of the Rafa system during the Imperial Period. A massive Human male, Mer became obsessed with the ancient Sharu artifact known as the Mindharp after assuming his seat on Rafa IV, partnering with Sorcerer of Tund Rokur Gepta to form a plan t…
Rohak was a male Human and a member of the group that founded the village of Aurilia on the planet of Dathomir. He would later become the village elder as well as its spiritual guide.
Shaki Hamachil was a female Mon Calamari who worked for the Galactic Empire in the Science Outpost on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Shibb Nisshil was an Ishi Tib who worked for the Galactic Empire in the Science Outpost on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War and showed interest in rancors.
Singular Nak was a male Bothan who was found in the Dathomir Trade Outpost on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War.
Vurlene was a Witch of Dathomir who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she was a healer for the Singing Mountain Clan.

Whip was a young Human male with extraordinary reflexes who lived on the planet Dathomir in the village of Aurilia during the Galactic Civil War. He was alleged to be the best pilot there. His personal hatred of the Galactic Empire stemmed from its ban on podracing.

Jorad Pressor was a survivor of the Outbound Flight Project. Unknown to him, his family was selected because his father, Dillian Pressor, had a glimmer of Force-sensitivity and his descendants may have had Jedi potential.

Gronn was an Imperial Moff who controlled the Allied Tion sector around 10 ABY. When one of the principal worlds under his control, Lianna, declared independence in the wake of the Battle of Endor, Gronn was aware that a shortage of TIE/LN starfighters would leave him in a pre…

Dubrak "Rak" Qennto was a Human male from Corellia, and the captain of the smuggling vessel Bargain Hunter. With a crew of two—Jorj Car'das and Maris Ferasi—he ran cargo shipments such as firegems and furs across the Outer Rim.
Xarot Korlin was a male Human in the Imperial Inquisitorius serving on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War.
Aldalad was a Male criminal who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.

Amarent Loren was a Human male bureaucrat who lived on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he worked for the Corellian Port Authority at the Tyrena Starport, in the city of Tyrena.

Chertyl Ruluwoor was a Human female who resided on the planet Corellia at the height of the Galactic Civil War. Ruluwoor had been assigned to build a case against a group of terrorists who were continually attacking Selonian dens on Corellia.
Bola Yomm was a female Human from Roon who was the wife of Nilz Yomm. Together they had one child, Auren Yomm.

Coraline Dynes was a female Human found in Doaba Guerfel on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. She once asked an individual to help her by escorting a witness to her and protect him from Black Sun.

Denell Kel'Vannon was a male Human private investigator located in Kor Vella on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. He was formerly part of Corellian Security Force and maintained a friendship with Shaedra Valouri who helped him track leads.
Maris Ferasi was a female Human from Corellia. In 27 BBY Ferasi acted as a co-pilot on smuggling vessel Bargain Hunter, which was captained by Ferasi's boyfriend Dubrak Qennto.
Borborygmus Gog was the Shi'ido scientist who was placed in charge of Project Starscream by Emperor Palpatine.
Falton Molard was a male Human member of the Rebel Alliance found in the Hidden Rebel Base on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Antha-Kres was a male Tiss'shar of considerable influence residing on Tiss'sharl, where he served as the Mayor.
At one point, an individual served as the Mandalore, the leader of the Aka'liit faction of the Mandalorian warrior culture.
Zurel Darillian was a male Human Captain in the Imperial Navy, who joined Warlord Zsinj some time after the Battle of Endor.

Edda Gast was a Human female and the scientist behind the mutating and "Humanizing" of alien species in an attempt to expand their minds allowing them to think and feel like Humans. Some of the main species that were used in Dr.
Zephata'ru'tor was a Duinuogwuin Padawan apprenticed to Jedi Master B'dard Tone during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Ganner was head of security for the Imperial Ruling Council at De-Purteen.

Pookie Baobab was a female Human who was the wife of renowned author, poet, and philologist Ebenn Q3 Baobab. Together on Manda, Pookie and Ebenn raised four children, who went on to have eighteen grandchildren. Pookie's pride and joy was their pet miniature bantha named Nuke.
Nuke was the name of the pet miniature dwarf bantha owned by Pookie and Ebenn Q3 Baobab.
Ronderu lij Kummar was a Kaleesh female and a close confidant of Qymaen jai Sheelal, the warrior who would later be known as General Grievous.
Lord Xist was a Black Sun Vigo who lived in New Coronet, on the planet Trigalis, during the Clone Wars. Ostensibly, he ruled the lawless world from his position there.
Nrross was a Trandoshan pirate hired by Captain Naz Felyood of the ship Jynni's Virtue. He served as added intimidation and a yes-man to the captain.

Klepti B'ay was a Jawa on Tatooine whose clan picked up the wreckage of a Rebel spaceship as salvage. Unbeknownst to them, a dark trooper aboard was in working condition. After freeing itself of the wreckage, it killed most of the Jawas aboard the sandcrawler.
Ichi-Tan Micoda was a male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. A Jedi Consular, Micoda worked closely with the Republic Diplomatic Corps.
Naz Felyood was the Corellian captain of the pirate ship Jynni's Virtue up until its destruction in 1 BBY.

Gee Long was a male alien from the Umboo province on Roon. Gee was friends with Auren Yomm a champion of the Roon Colonial Games. Long was a competitor as well and rode alongside a droid named BIX and was lead by Yomm.

Gillam Tarturi was a Human male who was the son of Senator Berm Tarturi who represented the planet Andara and, at face value, the entire Andaran system in the Galactic Senate during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, before the Clone Wars.
Marit Dice was a Human female student from the planet Hali, who attended the elite Leadership School on Andara before the Clone Wars.

After the ancient Neti Jedi Master Ood Bnar sacrificed himself to destroy Imperial Executor Sedriss QL on the planet Ossus in 10 ABY, a Neti seedling burst out of the ground after his death to preserve Bnar's legacy and watch over Ossus and the ruins of the Great Jedi Library.
Typtus the First was a legendary Geonosian of the Gehenbar hive.

Acklay Chopper was a notorious Geonosian slavemaster and fight manager of the Petranaki arena. He gave combat training to gladiators and slaves who fought in the arenas of Geonosis. A scar ran down Acklay Chopper's right side, and he walked with a heavy limp.

Yref Orgege was an Imperial Moff who was given control of the Hutt Space region after Moff Sarn Shild committed suicide. Orgege tried to fix the mistakes of his predecessor, namely the failed military invasion of Nar Shaddaa, by keeping his forces in tighter control.

Grodo was the Hutt physician of Aruk Besadii Aora and he had advised the elderly crimelord to keep better care of himself by exercising and eating nutritiously. Unfortunately, Aruk had been poisoned by Teroenza acting under orders from Jabba and Jiliac.
Sk'kot Burrid was a Human male corporal who served in Bria Tharen's Red Hand Squadron of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Bogey 3856 was a clone trooper and member of Bogey Squad during the Great Jedi Purge on Kashyyyk. Under Clone Commander Faie, 3856 and his squad hunted down Jedi Master Quinlan Vos after he survived the initial Order 66 attack.
Bogey 1212 was a clone trooper and member of Bogey Squad during the Great Jedi Purge on Kashyyyk.
Bogey 9662 was a clone trooper and member of Bogey Squad during the Great Jedi Purge on Kashyyyk. He wore the armor of a clone scout trooper.

Duefgrin was a male teenage Brolf living on Barlok who was part of the assassination plot against several negotiators in a Corporate Alliance and Brolfi government mining dispute. Some of the negotiators included Passel Argente, Guildmaster Gilfrome and Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth.
Tuzin Gast was a Human male researcher for Binring Biomedical Product.
Gatterweld was a Human male Imperial stormtrooper, and later an Ensign in the forces of Warlord Zsinj.
Kuma Nai was a female Kaminoan who was involved in the production of clone troopers for the Galactic Republic, yet was also secretly a member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Planore was an individual who, in 3951 BBY, offered to arrange transport off the moon Nar Shaddaa for the Human Kahranna and her family. He charged Kahranna fifty credits for a referral to his pilot friend, whom he claimed would take the family off world for 500 credits.

Ergeron was a male Mandalorian soldier who fought during the Mandalorian Wars alongside Canderous Ordo. After the war, he began working as a freelance mercenary, ending up on Manaan by the last year of the Jedi Civil War.
Chak, born Cha'ka, was a Wookiee smuggler, whose long life spanned from the last years of the Galactic Republic until the resurgence of the Galactic Empire after the Sith–Imperial War.

Huey was a male dewback that was pet to Luke Skywalker and Windy Starkiller when they were kids. He was very friendly and playful, and the boys were very happy with him. One morning, Huey was ramming against the exit gate. Windy and his father woke up due to the noise.
This magister, a small, wiry male, was the son of Leor Hal and the second Magister of the living and rogue planet of Zonama Sekot in the Unknown Regions.
Bal Jaset was a Human male who served as an Imperial Advisor and was the High Lord of House Melantha.
Jerv Riske, a Human male, was a former bounty hunter who served as the personal bodyguard of Passel Argente.

Gilfrome was the guildmaster for the Barlok mining company and an opponent of the Corporate Alliance plant to usurp control of the mines. He was nearly assassinated along with Corporate Alliance leader Passel Argente while negotiating over the dispute.

Klis Joo was a female Duros Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. Unlike most Jedi of the era, Joo held a position in a local government, becoming the elected governor of the city of Forard on the planet Almas.

A doppelgänger of Dooku, seemingly identical to the real Count Dooku although less adept in the Force, served the Confederacy of Independent Systems as one of the real Dooku's Dark Acolytes during the Clone Wars.
Sheel Odala was a brown-haired Human woman, and was an old acquaintance of Han Solo.
Vansk was a female Near-Human leader of the Force organization the Blackguard, which operated on the planet Mustafar. She along with a large number of other Blackguard were killed by spacers.
Gilker Budz was a male Human working for CorSec outside Kor Vella on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Donatellinsar R'a Pereriansa was a male Elomin that served as Mine Director of Ryannar N'on Dikasterar, the Elomin who discovered the Elom.

This rock lizard was kept as a pet by Jacen Solo. After some time, it always tried to escape from its cage. It almost hurt itself many times and even when Solo tried to heal it through the Force, it would not stay calm.

Pohtarza was a male t'landa Til who was the Head Sacredot of Colony Five on the Hutt-controlled world of Ylesia. While he was officiating over a ceremony of Exultation, Pohtarza was assassinated by an Aar'aa on the payroll of Jabba the Hutt just prior to the Battle of Ylesia.
Noy Waglla was a female Hyallp assassin who was in the employ of Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Galactic Civil War.

Tuga SalPivo was a Human male Corellian who was in the employ of Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Galactic Civil War. He was tasked with the mission of killing the t'landa Til priests that resided in Colony Eight on Ylesia.
Sniquux was a Rodian in the employ of Jabba the Hutt who was tasked with the mission of killing all the t'landa Til priests that resided in Colony Nine of Ylesia.
Tarrz was a male t'landa Til who was the head Sacredot of Colony Nine on the spice-factory world of Ylesia.
Tilenna was a female t'landa Til who was the mate of High Priest Teroenza during the Galactic Civil War.
Femon was a faithful assistant to Kueller, a fallen student to the dark side of the Force.
Vaecta was a priestess of Yun-Yammka, the Yuuzhan Vong god of war, and was attached to Warmaster Tsavong Lah during the Yuuzhan Vong invasion.

Surna was a Rebel Alliance soldier during the Galactic Civil War. She was stationed on the planet of Toprawa and participated in the liberation of the Death Star Superlaser plans and destruction of the Imperial research station located on the planet in 0 BBY.
Thanis Gul-Rah was a member of the bounty hunter organization known as Qulok's Fist. He was later a member of the crew of the FarStar during the hunt for Moff Kentor Sarne.

Kolig was a male Human bounty hunter and criminal. Serving as the unofficial leader of the bounty hunter group known as Qulok's Fist, he was also the pilot and owner of the organization's vessel, the Steel Fist, a heavily modified YT-1300 light freighter.
Sufar was a Human male from a Corellian colony world. An outlaw, he was exiled from his home in 2 BBY for committing several murders.

Padak was a Human male bounty hunter who utilized a customized suit of armor. Part of the Qulok's Fist bounty hunter gang, he worked with them in slavery, smuggling, and mercenary operations throughout the Outer Rim Territories, the Minos Cluster, and the Kathol sector.

B'ink Utrila was a female lethan Twi'lek who served as an instructor and Master in the Jedi Order. During the Clone Wars, she was the master of the Human Padawan Rennax Omani, who accompanied her and a squad of clone troopers to the moon Draay 2.

Flint Torul was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars; a conflict in which Torul gave his life.

L'lacielo Sageon was an aged male Lorrdian Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Sageon served as a General of the Grand Army of the Republic through the Clone Wars.

Quarmall was a male Abyssin Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. A controversial Master, the Jedi High Council censured him for taking the entire Bergruutfa Clan as his Padawans.
Waldan Bridger was a bald and burly male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Hrekin Thorm was an obese Human Senator from Fedalle and served in both the Imperial Senate and the New Republic Senate.
Jace Paol was a Human male Corellian who served in the Rebellion during the Galactic Civil War.
Zier was a member of the Besadii Hutt clan and was one of Durga Besadii Tai's primary rivals for clan leader in the wake of Aruk Besadii Aora's death. He was also Durga's cousin.

Ashpidar was the commander of the Esfandia Long-Range Communications Base during the Yuuzhan Vong War. A Gotal female from Antar 4, she was once engaged to a commercial entrepreneur, with whom she intended to raise a family. However, he was killed in a mining accident.
Bogey 5632 was a clone trooper and member of Bogey Squad during the Great Jedi Purge on Kashyyyk.
Bogey 4409 was a clone trooper and member of Bogey Squad during the Great Jedi Purge on Kashyyyk.
Krini-shen was a Vor and Chief Council of Vortex. Krini-shen made a statement when Admiral Ackbar destroyed the Cathedral of Winds in 11 ABY.
Tonaa Rikstnns was a maintenance worker for Sluis Van Shipyards who had bad problems with mynocks.
Firkrann was an Iron Knight, a Force-sensitive Shard Jedi who utilized an FLTCH-series battle droid body as a host.
Dif Gehad was a male Neimoidian who served as the Master Creator of New Products for the Cartao Expeditionary Army during the Clone Wars.
Tok Ashel was the Neimoidian commander of the Cartao Expeditionary Army during the Clone Wars.

Gustav Zenlav was a male Mandalorian soldier, who lived several centuries prior to the Galactic Civil War. A renowned Mandalorian shocktrooper, Zenlav served as a general in the Mandalorian army for a time, and later contracted out his services as a mercenary.
Ferrox was the governor of the Naboo moon of Rori. During the reign of Queen Kylantha in the Imperial Period, he was a member of the Naboo Royal Advisory Council.
Burro Flats was a philologist of the Baobab Archives on Manda. Through his interaction with the Gungans of Naboo, Flats was able to create a limited dictionary of Gunganese and Old Gungan terms.
Daino Hyx was a Human male chief medical officer who was attached to Red Hand Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed aboard the ship Retribution.
As a technician of the Galactic Empire, a Human individual became disillusioned with the Emperor's New Order and developed sympathies for the Rebel Alliance.
A Jedi Knight active prior to 20,000 BBY, Roni von Wasaki was respected as both an able administrator and a skilled warrior.
Gammid was a member of Leshy Drobo's crew who was killed attempting to capture Roni von Wasaki. Drobo was not saddened by his death, as he considered Gammid to be incompetent.

Drea Renthal was a Human female who served as commander of a pirate fleet in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin. Drea was not typical of other pirates since she had a code of ethics that tried to minimize casualties.

Leshy Drobo was a bounty hunter around 20,000 BBY. He used freight hauling as a front for his hunting, and occasionally worked with another hunter, Gammid. His most notable catch was the Jedi Knight Roni von Wasaki although Drobo did not survive to collect the bounty.

Genkal was a Mon Calamari captain of the MC80a Star Cruiser Naritus serving the New Republic. He was known as an excellent leader and admired by his crews. He was instrumental in destroying the notorious pirate band, the Khuiumin Survivors.

Elpfel was a Mon Calamari with orange eyes and mottled brown skin who served as an officer in the Rebel Fleet, holding the rank of commander during the Galactic Civil War fought between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Din Tinray was a deaf, female Sullustan. Since deaf Sullustans were not active at all, she went to see a physician for help, Doctor Rachael Tikaris. Tikaris was able to create an ear for her, and after surgery, Din was welcomed back into society.
Vuurok I'pan was a Shamed One living in the Coruscant underworld after it was Vongformed into Yuuzhan'tar.
Ruati was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. In 20 BBY, Ruati was beheaded by an assassin on the planet Nauton IV.
Yerkys ne Dago was a notorious Twi'lek loan shark operating out of the Minos Cluster. There, he was one of the most powerful individuals, with numerous individuals owing debts and lives to him.
Jula Darklighter was a male Human moisture farmer on the planet Tatooine. He was the brother of Huff Darklighter, the husband of Silya Darklighter, and the father of Rasca and Gavin Darklighter.

Silya Darklighter was a Human female and the wife of Jula Darklighter, the sister-in-law of Huff Darklighter and the mother of Rasca, Gavin and Anya Darklighter. She and her husband purchased the Lars moisture farm from Luke Skywalker after he left the planet Tatooine.

Jowart Typok was once a member of the Interplanetary Charts and Surveys but was forced to leave due to Imperial cut-backs on exploration. He later praised these cut-backs for forcing him to discover the lucrative business of professional game hunting.
Jes Flon was Jowart Typok's follower and pilot of his stock light freighter for smuggling ivory. She wore a blaster pistol in a shoulder holster at all times.

Hurst was a Human male cortosis miner on the planet Apatros. Hurst's wife died giving birth to their son, Dessel, which led to Hurst resenting his son and blaming him for his life's problems, specifically the death of his wife and being stuck working on Apatros.
Treun Lorn was a Human scientist who assisted Nycolai Kinesworthy in the creation of N-K Necrosis. After Necrosis was completed, Lorn later broke down psychotically.
Zakrinand Minus was a notable male warlord who lived just prior to the founding of the Galactic Republic.
Pakmillu was male Mon Calamari captain of the Outbound Flight, as well as a officer of the Judicial Forces.
Godherdt was a Human captain who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Godherdt was stationed on the Dark Lord Darth Vader's personal flagship, the Super Star Destroyer Executor.

Desanne was an Imperial Navy Commander from Kalist VI. Due to a political blunder in 3 ABY, Commander Desanne was stripped of most official duties and relegated to shuttling dignitaries and high-ranking Imperial officials.

Ossluk Noslee was a particularly skilled Gand warrior. Considering that—as in their traditional culture—most Gand never earned a name of their own, the fact that he had earned two was a testimony to his accomplishments.

Luna was Hakon deVille's secretary and bodyguard. She was tall, elegant, efficient, and completely loyal to Hakon. She also appeared to be his companion and was the only person onboard the Ananuru Express to hold a weapon, having a blaster in her handbag.
Tanis Hal was Hamnet's secretary. She was beautiful and well-paid but was constantly harassed while attempting to keep Icomia Hamnet, her employer's daughter under control.

Nar-Somo-Dali was an Elder of the planet of Cerea around the year 33 BBY. He was a friend of Jedi Watchman Ki-Adi-Mundi, and with his help, uncovered a plot to smuggle illegal technology to the planet by fellow Elder Dorr-Femi-Bonmi, in association with the Chevin smuggler Eph…
Dorr-Femi-Bonmi was a Cerean male senator who represented the planet Cerea in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic and served in the Cerean Council of Elders.

Shea was a female Cerean who was the bond-wife of Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi and was known to have bore him at least one child. Although most Jedi were not allowed to marry, Ki was an exception because of the extremely low male birthrate on Cerea.

Camelle "Camella" Barje was a native of Corellia who moved with her husband Conil to Tatooine to begin a simple life as moisture farmers. The lives of her and her son were saved from Tusken warriors by their Jedi leader, Sharad Hett.
Tekil Barje was a native of Corellia who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Wesson DeLameter was Hamnet's bodyguard and was always well-dressed and quiet. He accompanied Hamnet on board the Ananuru Express when the RNA brainwashing virus was up for auction.

Hamnet was a crime boss whose illegalities were sufficiently under cover that he was able to double as a respectable and wealthy businessman who enjoyed the trappings of success. The illegal activities were performed on his behalf by Wesson DeLameter, his personal bodyguard.

Havas Rar was an employee of an arms manufacturer intent on acquiring the secret Imperial RNA brainwashing virus. He was sent with Quil Nathan when it was discovered to be up for auction on the Ananuru Express.
Phoedris Bos was a male Nalrithian sympathizer who served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Cypher Bos was a notorious Nalrithian bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. He worked predominantly for the Galactic Empire, but also for Jabba Desilijic Tiure, building up a reputation as a violent and capable hunter.
A male Miskara, and also known as The Miskara addressed to as "Your Eminence", was a member and ruler of the Vagaari sentient species.
Yus Sh'roth was a Shamed One living in the Coruscant underworld after it was Vongformed into Yuuzhan'tar.
Cubber Daine was a male Human who served as a mechanic to Wraith Squadron, a New Republic commando unit, shortly after their formation as a temporary squadron.
Droe was a female Cerean and the older sister of Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi.
Bin-Garda-Zon was a male Cerean with a crippled left hand that had two missing fingers. He was also a leader of a band of raiders on the planet Cerea around 88 BBY.

Tanda Pryl was the captain of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Thunderflare, which was part of Moff Villis Andal's fleet in the Elrood sector. She had a great rivalry with Akal Zed, captain of the Stalker.
Hakon deVille was the proprietor of the Ananuru Express at the time of the Galactic Civil War. He appeared to be smooth and mundane, but could also be ruthless when it suited him.
DS-181-3 was the call sign of a Human male starfighter pilot who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
DS-61-4, nicknamed "Dark Curse," served the Galactic Empire as a starfighter pilot during the time before, and during, the Battle of Yavin.

Fenson was a Human male Rendili native who worked for the Galactic Empire as an Imperial Navy trooper and was skilled at close-quarters combat. He worked with Trooper Vesden during the Battle of Endor.
Davod Jon was a Human colonel who served the Galactic Empire as a Special Forces leader in the Galactic Civil War. Jon was promoted for his skills and bravery as a scout.

Mod Terrik was a Human male Imperial officer of the Desert Sands sandtrooper unit. Fearless and highly motivated, Terrik was willing to sacrifice as many troops as he felt necessary in order to achieve his objectives.
Elsek was a Human from the planet Kuat who served as a sergeant and a scout trooper in the Stormtrooper Corps, eventually serving in Tempest Force.

Firin Morett was a fair-skinned Human with brown hair who worked as an engineer in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War fought by the Alliance against the Galactic Empire.
Yutani was a Human captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and a scout and a heavy weapon specialist in Alliance Special Forces.
Junkin was a Human male scout and demolitions expert in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and held the rank of sergeant.
Janse was a Human native of the planet Ukio who worked as a weapons design evaluator with BlasTech Industries during the Galactic Civil War. At some point, Janse became a sharpshooter.
Dansra Beezer was a Human female native of the planet Alderaan who held the rank of corporal in the Alliance to Restore the Republic by 4 ABY.

Delevar attended the briefing aboard the Alliance flagship Home One, during which Madine laid out the intended plan of attack, and he later traveled to Endor on board the stolen Imperial Lambda-class T-4a shuttle Tydirium.
Beyghor Sahdett was a Verpine Jedi Master who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic, and into the reign of the new Galactic Empire.

A Human Jedi served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, the Human Jedi survived the initial execution of Order 66, a directive commanding clone troopers to execute the Jedi Knights.
Hutar Zash was royal advisor to the Lannik High Court under Prince R'cardo Sooflie IX.
Gujdim Wiphshun was a male Gran who served as governor of the Gran Protectorate on Malastare.

affiliation: Commission for the Protection of the Republic
x: Nenevanth Tion was a human male citizen of the Galactic Republic and one of the earliest members of SAGroup, the youth chapter of the political lobbyist organization known as COMPOR.
Aunuanna was a Human woman living on Nar Shaddaa a few years after the Battle of Naboo. She was the mother of Aurra Sing.

Kyood Vurd was a short Ugnaught businessman who ran a cantina on the moon of Nar Shaddaa around the time of the Invasion of Naboo. He recently had a scuffle with Jedi Masters Mace Windu and Depa Billaba when he attempted to kill a street-vendor on his turf.

T'iaz was an alien Dark Side Adept who served Emperor Palpatine. He was killed at Kira Fortress in 11 ABY aiding the Dark Lord of the Sith in the abduction of Anakin Solo. While there he engaged in a duel with Rayf Ysanna who sliced off his hand and disarmed him.
In 11 ABY, an Imperial spy infiltrated the New Republic base on the ancient Space City of Nespis VIII.

Although General Lando Calrissian warned Tekba of the missile, which was approaching the Pelagia through hyperspace, Tekba did not have enough time to retreat and instead attempted to intercept and destroy the warhead.
Do-Forow Nadon was a male Ithorian native to the planet Ithor. He was the son of Momaw and Fandomar Nadon.
Modon Kira was the King of Onderon during the Galactic Civil War. He resided in Kira Fortress and was the husband of Lady Kira.
Vasi was a warrior of the Yuuzhan Vong. A slavemaster, Vasi was in charge of the slaves, Workers, and Shamed Ones on Yavin 4. Vasi was sadistic even by Yuuzhan Vong standards.

Ugan was a Human male who served as the captain of an Imperial Detainer CC-2200 Interdictor Cruiser that served in the Battle of Kashyyyk over Kachirho. In 19 BBY, he was killed when a Recusant-class light destroyer rammed into his ship on a suicide run.

Nullip was a Human male who served as an ensign of a Detainer CC-2200 interdictor cruiser that served in the Battle of Kashyyyk over Kachirho. He was killed when a Recusant-class light destroyer was rammed into his ship.
Drevveka Hoctu was once a great female Human Jedi Knight of the Galactic Republic, until she was consumed by the dark side of the Force many years before the Battle of Naboo.

Honi was a Force-sensitive Human female who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. Recruited into the Jedi Order before the age of three, she trained as an Initiate at the Jedi Temple on the Republic capital of Coruscant in 44 BBY.

Demos Traxen was an Imperial bounty hunter sent to Kallistas to capture Pallas Quintell, shortly after the Battle of Yavin. He booked passage on the Red Fang with Tarquin Zian. Upon his arrival, Traxen learned that Quintell had already been captured by rival hunters.

Dovish Hokken was a Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Along with two other Knights, Hokken was killed aboard the Monitor III during the Separatist Crisis.
Bashinan Hodizwen was a Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Kibh Jeen was a male Jedi Padawan who was trained by the Jedi Master Qornah during the last millennium of the Galactic Republic.
Qornah was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Golden Age of the Old Republic.
Kal-Don was a famous Jedi Master stationed at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. During his tenure as Jedi Master, Kal-Don accepted the infamous Cerean, Ter-Idi as his Padawan.
Aruden Kej was a Jedi Knight serving the the Jedi Order during the Separatist Crisis which threatened to tear the Galactic Senate apart in the final years of the Galactic Republic.
A baby was a relative to the Force-sensitive human male Obi-Wan Kenobi prior to joining the Jedi Order.

Jerjerrod was a Human male admiral serving in the Navy of the Galactic Republic. Coming from a well-to-do family, Jerjerrod was an ally of Republic Supreme Chancellor Palpatine; this association provided the admiral's family with many connections.

A Twi'lek was the owner and announcer for the famed Circus Horrificus. The circus was well known for gladiatorial events which usually pitted one or more beings against savage creatures from around the galaxy.
Covah was a Nothoiin on the run from the Galactic Empire who hired Solomahal to transport him to a safehold in the Greater Javin.
V-Nen was a male Human from Kegan that was the husband of O-Melie and the father of Jedi Knight Olana Chion (born O-Lana).

Justyn Ma'Ning was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Ma'Ning was middle-aged, balding, and had a deep voice; he was most noted for taking part in the Outbound Flight Project.

Tosinqas was a Xexto bounty hunter active during the reign of the Galactic Republic. In 22 BBY, the Xexto took part in a hunt for the criminal Rotar Lopani. Tosinqas found and killed Lopani on the planet Brentaal IV.
Joi Eicroth was a fair haired female who, for a short time, was the wife of Hiram Drayson.

Zarrak was an Ewok from the moon of Endor and was a member of the tribe that inhabited Bright Tree Village. As a young Ewok, he was discovered to have magical abilities and was taken as the Shaman Logray's first apprentice.

Skeeter was a male of an unknown flying species who served as an assistant to Princess Lourdes. He had six limbs and resembled a giant fly. During the duel between the Princess and Lord Gar-Oth, Skeeter held guns to the heads of Gar-Oth's guards to prevent them from interfering.
Syron Aalun was a male Gand ruetsavii—commonly known as observers—sent to monitor Rogue Squadron pilot Ooryl Qrygg during the Bacta War.
Zeen Afit was a craggy-faced male Human smuggler who first introduced Han Solo to Smuggler's Run. He owned a freighter named Corona.

Mari'ha Andona worked as a flight controller for a sector on the planet Coruscant. In 19 ABY, the New Republic general Han Solo—an old friend of Andona's who was experiencing nostalgia for his prior smuggling career—contacted flight control to request a flight plan.

Anton Brunwin was a humanoid front desk attendant at Lady Valarian's Lucky Despot hotel in Mos Eisley, along with their twin, Sturn Brunwin. The two were swindlers, and also ran a money laundering business in addition to working the front desk.
Drixo was a female Hutt gangster and a rival of Progga the Hutt.

Atuarre () was a female Trianii who served in the elite Trianii Rangers during the era of the Galactic Civil War. Atuarre joined the elite law enforcement squad after marrying a Ranger, Keeheen, with whom she had a cub, Pakka.

Alexsandr Badure, also known by the nickname Trooper, was a former Imperial naval officer who in 2 BBY played a key role in the discovery of the fabled treasure of the Queen of Ranroon, the long-lost treasure ship of Xim the Despot.

T'nun Bdu was the captain of the Sullustan, a Corellian corvette. His ship was intercepted by Admiral Natasi Daala and destroyed when she found heavy weapons, communications equipment, and prefabricated building material that could be used to aid the Rebel Alliance, as well as…

Ber'asco was the Prophet of the Void, leader of the Charon Death Cult, which believed that the extermination of all life in the universe would lead to a final enlightenment. He was also the commander of the spacecraft Desolate.

Caulfmar was a male Brolf governor of Barlok during the Separatist Crisis. In 27 BBY, Palpatine sent Kinman Doriana to deliver files to him. Doriana used this trip as an excuse to stir up trouble on Barlok.

Ana Blue (also known as Sinewy Ana Blue) was a female Human smuggler who ran the sabacc games at Skip 1 in the Smuggler's Run. She was known as Blue because of a blue jewel she had embedded in a tooth.
Bômlas was an infamous Ychthytonian bartender on Skip 1. He lost one of his four arms in a sabacc game, but, according to Han Solo, the loss did not slow Bômlas down by much.

Filvian, codenamed "Patriot", was a male Brolf terrorist and resistance fighter who sought to reclaim full planetary control over mining operations on Barlok. The resistance was obsessed with what they viewed as the Corporate Alliance's attempt to steal their planet's wealth.
Denlace Sachoore was a female Corporate Alliance clerk in the Fakir sector.

Vissfil was a male Brolf who worked for the resistance leader codenamed Patriot in 27 BBY. Patriot was in turn working for Kinman Doriana codenamed 'Defender' who was building a missile that he said was to assassinate Passel Argente.

Migress was a male Brolf working under Patriot (Filvian) on the planet Barlok to assassinate Passel Argente in 27 BBY, when negotiations were held on the planet between the Corporate Alliance and the guildmaster of Barlok's mining operations.
Jhompfi was a male Brolf working under Patriot (Filvian) to assassinate Passel Argente.
Davonn was a Human male lieutenant who served in the air forces of Naboo.
Talbrek was a male Kubaz informer who worked on the Kwilaan Spaceport, in Naboo during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.
Tols Vengra was a Jenet thug working for Opun Mcgrrrr during the Galactic Civil War.

Macemillian-winduarté was a Squib trader. He began his career as chief bartender officer in the reclamation cruiser Two-For-One. In this capacity, he traveled the galaxy, indulged his snit-spore habit, and learned a great deal of useless trivia.
Aguilae, born Khea Nkul, was a female Jawa who was the manager of the Jawa Traders, a droid store in Mos Eisley. The Squib Macemillian-winduarté was indebted to her.
Terpfen was a Mon Calamari ship mechanic, who served as the personal mechanic of Admiral Ackbar.
Chas Uliar was a Human male crewman of the Outbound Flight, born 49 BBY.

Brace Tarkosa was a Human male who worked as a crewman on Outbound Flight. He was a strongly built man and one of the first hundred people recruited to the project at its start in 29 BBY. He was two years older than his friend on the crew, Chas Uliar.
Jobe Keely was a human male crewman of Outbound Flight in 27 BBY. Among his onboard technician friends were Chas Uliar and Brace Tarkosa.
Brooks was a male technician that worked for Senate Support Services. He was sent by the Office of the Supreme Chancellor to work on Outbound Flight prior to its departure from Yaga Minor.

Omano was a commander of Dreadnaught-Four, one of the six Dreadnaughts that made up the Republic starship Outbound Flight. He had the command of Dreadnaught-Four, but had to share this task with the Jedi Master Justyn Ma'Ning, who coordinated the Jedi affairs on this ship.
Simikarty was a Jedi Master of the Old Republic era.
Dillian Pressor was one of the crewmen of Outbound Flight. His wife, their daughter Katarin, and their son Jorad accompanied him on the flight.
Katarin Pressor was the Human female daughter of Dillian Pressor and his wife and the sister of Jorad and Rosemari Pressor. She was one of the passengers on Outbound Flight.
Evlyn Tabory was the daughter of Rosemari Pressor Tabory, the niece of Jorad Pressor, and the granddaughter of Dillian Pressor.
Feeven was a male Rodian passenger aboard Outbound Flight. His quarters were situated on the titanic ship's Dreadnaught-Two.

Evrios was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Along with four other Masters, Evrios joined Master Jorus C'baoth aboard Outbound Flight as part of the experimental Outbound Flight Project in 27 BBY.
B'Crevnis was a large male Pho Ph'eahian who was in charge of fluid-flow maintenance on Outbound Flight.
O-Melie was a female Human from Kegan that was the wife of V-Nen and the mother of Jedi Knight Olana Chion (born O-Lana).

V-Davi, known to friends as Davi, was an orphaned Human male from Kegan. He was a young, slender boy with long, sandy hair that reached to his shoulders. His parents died during an outbreak of Toli-X when he was two standard years old.
Taselda, also known as Sel was a centuries-old Human female who once served as a Jedi Knight during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.
Ob Fortuna was a male Twi'lek from Ryloth, and a distant relative of Bib Fortuna, majordomo to Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Spore was a Vesuvague/Bafforr tree hybrid imprisoned during the Golden Age of the Old Republic in an asteroid by the Ithorians.
Algrann was a male senior watch and technical officer on Outbound Flight during the time of the Separatist Crisis.
Grassling was a male who served aboard Outbound Flight during the time of the Separatist Crisis.
Sivv was a male senior watch officer on Outbound Flight during the time of the Separatist Crisis.
Harll was a male Farghul bounty hunter and a member of the Crimson Nova.

Kolot was an Ewok male upon whom Imperial Warlord Zsinj's Project Chubar experimented. The experiments, which left Kolot able to pilot a shuttle, were inspired by the tale of Lieutenant Kettch, a semi-fictional Ewok member of the pirating Hawk-bat Independent Space Force.

Raana Tey was a Togruta female and one of the five Jedi Masters implicated in the Padawan Massacre of Taris. Tey maintained a reputation among the Jedi Order as being intense and untamed due to her individualism in combat, in no small part caused by her Togruta background.
Feln was a famed Feeorin warrior who left his homeworld behind to become a Jedi Master and one of the most renowned seers of his day.
Xamar was a male Khil trained as a Jedi by Krynda Draay following the Great Sith War, who later took part in the Padawan Massacre of Taris.

During their meeting, Rossik discovered that Petothel's escort, Myn Donos, was lurking outside the house where the meeting took place. He was fairly certain that the New Republic had holos of him in their records, and decided to kill Donos and take Petothel back to Iron Fist.

Remart Sasyru was a large, attractive, Human male member of the Khuiumin Survivors serving the Invids in Bolt. He was a tall, muscular, and handsome Human male, with dark black mid-length hair and blue eyes. He wore a goatee and long, winged mustaches.

Yakun Kwaad was a male Yuuzhan Vong who was an initiate of the shaper caste and a member of Domain Kwaad. As a shaper, Kwaad was schooled in bioengineering and the use of the Yuuzhan Vong's organic technology.

Tla was a male Yuuzhan Vong Warrior who was promoted to the rank of commander during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He led an invasion fleet following the death of Commander Shedao Shai at Ithor, into whose vacant position Tla was escalated.

Mosh was a shuttle pilot who served aboard Outbound Flight. After a movement against Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth had arisen on board and the passengers hoped to be able to get Thrawn to free them from C'baoth, Mosh brought a group of the dissatisfied to D-Eins with a shuttle, an…
Jander Graffe was the male Imperial Moff of Darpa sector.
Septaas was an operative of the Imperial Special Intelligence.
On an industrial wasteland world in the Outer Rim Territories, a certain cyberneticist worked circa 1500 BBY.

Kooroo was an ancient sage and visionary. Supposedly the author of meditations contained in the scroll known as the Teachings of Kooroo, Kooroo came to be regarded as the spiritual leader of the cult known as the Fellowship of Kooroo.

Nilwoon was a corrupt Wookiee agent of a syndicate found on the planet Tatooine. He approached a group of Rebels to offer them 15,000 credits to rescue Maxine Baytor from Imperial custody with no questions asked.

Elsen Barthis was a member of Galactic Alliance Intelligence who, along with Lieutenant Titch, tried to convince Wedge Antilles to give information to the Galactic Alliance on Rogue Squadron just prior to the start of the Second Galactic Civil War.
Titch, a member of Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service, was a Human male in his mid-twenties as of 40 ABY. He was dark-haired, broad-shouldered, and had the appearance of a wrestler.
A clone stormtrooper served as a clone trooper commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars under the Aleena Jedi General Tsui Choi.
Verral Kayrell was a member of the police force in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. He was the police station's speeder bike mechanic and was sometimes seen in the cantina's of Mos Eisley.

Ugmush was the Gamorrean captain of the Subla Ransom Medium Cargo Hauler Zicreex and had three husbands. She often presented herself in a garish combination of off-world clothes, with eye-paint and diamond nose-rings.

Tantor was an Esoomian born on Esooma in 32 BBY. He worked as a pirate brawler and stopped several mutiny attempts that threatened his captain. After the captain and Tantor argued about a raise in Tantor's salary, the Esoomian attacked and jettisoned the captain into space.

Gnifmak Dymurra was the CEO of the Loronar Corporation in 13 ABY. During the New Republic era, Loronar had gained a reputation for corruption, initiating riots on Ampliquen, staging a coup on King's Galquek, committing rights violations in the Gantho system and supplying insur…
Nyiestra was a female Human from Alderaan and the fiancée of Tycho Celchu. She perished in the destruction of her home planet.

Gror Pernon was a male Human who was the brother of Emperor Antbbianplourr III of Eiattu 6 and the grand uncle of Plourr Ilo. He was a member of the Priamsta and served as the Grand Duke. His son was Count Rial Pernon.

Antbbianplourr III was the Emperor of Eiattu 6 during the final days of the Galactic Republic. He bartered with the Galactic Empire to keep the throne and Imperials away from the world. He was succeeded by his only son Uthorrferrell Cartha. His brother was Grand Duke Gror Pernon.
Rial flew a modified Z-95 Headhunter starfighter.
Ashaad was a male Human and a Sergeant in the People's Liberation Battalion on Eiattu 6. He was shot and wounded when Plourr Ilo confronted the impostor of Prince Harran.

Cinzero Gann was a Human who served the Galactic Empire. After Emperor Palpatine declared his Empire in 19 BBY, Gann was made Grand Moff of Sector 5 and assumed the role of commander of the Fifth Deep Core Army based at Odik II.
Cojahn was a Human business associate of Lando Calrissian.
Llollulion was a wealthy Borlovian who, weary of his race's predisposition with stability, became Booster Terrik's copilot during the smuggler's early years aboard the freighter Starwayman.

Yrada Soludisan was a Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. Along with two other Knights, Soludisan was killed aboard the Monitor III during the Separatist Crisis.
Raal Yorta was a Human male Sabacc player and who worked the with bounty hunter Sammie Staable and the pickpocket Smileredon-Verdont.
"Never Die" was the code name of an Alderaanian slicer during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Bledsoe was a Human male doctor who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He served the Galactic Empire as an expert in the areas of disease and medicine. He was an ardent supporter of the Empire's xenophobic policies.
Heedron Bomu was a Rodian pilot and soldier. He was a member of the Bomu Clan, and a pirate captain.
Hreeda Bomu was a female Rodian soldier. She was a member of the Bomu Clan and occasionally worked for Zonnos the Lesser of the Anjiliac kajidic.

Mahraccor was a male Wookiee. He was the husband of Kallabow and the father of Sirrakuk and the Jedi Lowbacca. Mahraccor and his wife worked at the computer fabrication factory in Thikkiiana City, Kashyyyk.
Kalast was an Moff who betrayed the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Garowyn was a Nightsister from the Great Canyon Clan on Dathomir. She captained a shuttle named the Shadow Chaser and was tasked with using it to ferry supplies and recruits for the Shadow Academy.
Varin Arabella was the High Lady of House Barnaba during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Two-Eight, also identified by the number RC-8028, was the name of a clone commando created on the Wild Space planet Kamino at some point during or after 32 BBY. As a male Human clone of the bounty hunter Jango Fett, Two-Eight stood 1.83 meters tall and had tan skin.
Dama Whitesun Brunk was a Human female from the planet Tatooine.
Fal Tivvik was a female Intendant of the Yuuzhan Vong, and one-time advisor to High Prefect Yoog Skell. Following complications during her Escalation process, however, she became a Shamed One.

Tito was a Flakax Joiner who, with Yugi, was assigned by the Squibs (known as the Directors) to assassinate Han and Leia Organa Solo. He failed in his mission, and was convinced by Han and Leia that the Directors and the Fefze were plotting to kill him and the other Flakax.
Droog'an was a Yuuzhan Vong warrior during the Yuuzhan Vong War, who fought at the Battle of Ebaq.

Yugi was a Flakax Joiner, sent along with Tito, assigned to assassinate Han Solo and Leia Organa by the Squibs known as the Directors. He failed in his mission and was sliced in two by Leia's lightsaber.
Ash'ett was a member of the Intendant caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. When the Yuuzhan Vong conquered Coruscant and Vongformed the planet into Yuuzhan'tar, Ash'ett was appointed Prefect of Vishtu.
Ona Shai was the Prefect of the Baanu Miir. She was a Yuuzhan Vong.

Ghithra Dal was a member of the Shaper caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. A Master Shaper, Dal was assigned to oversee the grafting of Warmaster Tsavong Lah's new radank forearm. However, the arm continued to rot, and Dal could supply no reason for this.
Takhaff Uul was a member of the priest caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. Uul was a High Priest of Yun-Yuuzhan, the Creator. After the Battle of Coruscant, Uul approached Warmaster Tsavong Lah.

Veda was a Force-sensitive Jedi Initiate studying within the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. At a young age, Veda was identified and inducted into the Jedi Order and began her studies in the ways of the Force at the Jedi Temple on the Republic's capital world, Coruscant.
"Backstabber" was a human TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's Black Squadron who served as the wingman of Darth Vader during the Battle of Yavin.
Maloc was a commander in the Imperial Starfleet serving as commanding officer of the Victory I-class Star Destroyer Stalwart approximately one year before the Battle of Endor.

Dagon Niriz was a fourth-generation navy officer, a captain in the Imperial Navy, and the commanding officer of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Admonitor in the years leading up to the Battle of Endor.

Orun Wa was a Kaminoan male scientist who was responsible for creating the Null-class ARC Troopers during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was a perfectionist, and was disappointed with what were seen as defects in the Null troopers.
Deacon (or Deak) was a boyhood friend of Luke Skywalker who lived in Anchorhead on Tatooine.
Deak was a male non-Jedi pilot in the resurrected Kyp's Dozen squadron.

This Bando Gora Captain was a prominent figure among the Bando Gora. The alien cultist was Komari Vosa's chief lieutenant and relayed information about the outside world to her. Unlike lesser cultists, the captain was still capable of speaking.
Maxine Baytor was once a general in the Galactic Republic, during which time she participated in the Battle of Denubba.
Ten-Suckers Madoom, alias Deeto, was a male Rodian criminal noted for his lack of common sense and lack of two fingers/suckers during the Galactic Civil War. He wielded a custom Widowmaker blaster.
Orman was a male Chev businessman who lived on Lianna. He had extensive black market connections, and was an occasional spy for the Galactic Empire.
Kay Tallon was a female Human who was Adar Tallon's wife.

Morr Wenn was Adar Tallon's servant. Wenn carried out household tasks on Tallon's home while he was living on Tatooine with his wife Kay. Cala Wenn worked at the same home. He was not a brave man, but was loyal to Tallon.

Wenn performed household tasks on Tallon's home while he was living on Tatooine with his wife Kay. Morr Wenn worked at the same home. Years later, Adar Tallon decided to leave Tatooine with his wife and droid LN-26. The Wenns were left behind.
Westen was an officer in the Imperial Navy. He became a captain soon after the Battle of Yavin.
Dana was a female who served as an intelligence agent with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Corr Skirata, formally known as CT-5108/8843 during his service in the Galactic Republic, was a clone trooper munitions disposal specialist who was assigned to a desk job on Coruscant GAR logistics base after he was severely injured by an explosive.

Zeebo was the pet Mooka, a four-eared creature with both fur and feathers, belonging to the Jedi Prince Ken while he lived in the Lost City of the Jedi on Yavin 4. He was very loving towards his owner, and was always wanting to be with him.
Michael Unther was an officer in the Imperial Navy, a veteran of twenty years of front-line service who became a respected Academy instructor after his retirement from active duty.

Dassid was a male Duros who was the king of Duro, his reign started after the death of his mother, Queen Rana Mas Trehalt. He continued his mother's policies of offworld exploration, expansion, and diplomacy.

Drosh Khalii was a member of the Intendant caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. After the Battle of Coruscant and the terraforming of Coruscant into Yuuzhan'tar, Khalii was appointed Prefect of the Geling Sector, becoming very powerful in the process.

Tjulan Kwaad was a Master Shaper of the Yuuzhan Vong, the head of Domain Kwaad, and the lord of Domain Yim. However, his domains suffered humiliation by events that occurred on the moon Yavin 4 in 26 ABY.

Kaaldar was a Human male doctor in the employ of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Kaaldar genetically modified the highly infectious illness known as Bledsoe's disease as part of a intelligence program targeting the Rebel Alliance, which caused world-devastat…
An Ithorian female, Fandomar Nadon was the wife of Momaw Nadon and the mother of Do-Forow Nadon.
Voor was a Lieutenant in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Prudii Skirata, formerly known as Null-5 or N-5 was one of twelve Null-class ARC troopers created for use in the Grand Army of the Republic as a lieutenant.

Gett was a clone trooper commander who served in the 41st Elite Corps of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Throughout the conflict against the Separatists, he was assigned to Jedi General Etain Tur-Mukan.
Jez was the nickname of a clone commando who served in Aiwha-3 Squad of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Stoker was the nickname of a clone commando that was trained by the Mandalorian sergeant Kal Skirata. A clone of the Human bounty hunter Jango Fett and a member of Gamma Squad, Stoker was born on the planet Kamino to serve in the Grand Army of the Republic's Special Operations…

Ram was a male clone commando who served in Bravo Squad. Cloned from the Human bounty hunter Jango Fett, Ram was born on the planet Kamino and trained to become a clone commando in the Grand Army of the Republic's Special Operations Brigade by the Mandalorian sergeant Kal Skir…
Zareb was a member of the Intendant caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. After the Yuuzhan Vong conquered and Vongformed the planet Coruscant into Yuuzhan'tar, Zareb was appointed Prefect of Numesh.

Mullinore was a captain in the Imperial Navy and commanding officer of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Basilisk placed under the command of Admiral Daala to protect the Maw Installation. Born on Taanab, he learned to always keep a formal air.

Kratas was a commander in the Imperial Navy serving as commanding officer of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Gorgon, which served under the command of Admiral Daala in the defense of the Maw Installation.

Cy Yunga was an alien Podracer pilot who was active during the year 32 BBY. Yunga piloted a red and white Podracer during his career, which included at least one race on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine.
Jinn Reeso was a member of a bluish-gray-skinned humanoid alien species who competed as a professional Podracer pilot during the year 32 BBY, flying a massive black-and-gray Podracer.

Illiet was a Givin Dodecian during the Yuuzhan Vong War who was in command of Yag-prime, the space station orbiting Yag'Dhul. He had mathematical symbols painted on his exoskeleton, indicating his high rank among the Givin people.
Tal Hesz was a leader of the Jabiimi resistance alongside Nolan Gillmunn during the Galactic Civil War.
Nolan Gillmunn was a Human male who served as the leader of the Jabiimi resistance during the Galactic Civil War, and son of famed Clone Wars leader Orliss Gillmunn.
Catronus Steffans was the Galactic Republic Defense Ministry Director for Public Information during the Mandalorian Wars.
Kamlin was a female Falleen Padawan training at the Jedi Temple on Taris in the years following the Great Sith War.
Gharn was a Nagai Jedi Padawan who was active in the Jedi Order during the era of the Mandalorian Wars.
Oojoh was a male Ho'Din with green skin who lived in the period just after the Great Sith War of 3996 BBY. As a Force-sensitive, he was selected by the Jedi Order for training.

Desperately wanting the glory that been denied to her for so long, Plikk ordered her ships to attack and destroy the city, using the last of the remaining power in their hyperdrives to fuel the assault.

Drakka Judarrl was a female Zabrak Jedi Padawan who served the Jedi Order until she escaped with her Master from the ravages of the Great Jedi Purge. Later, she hid out on Dantooine during the Galactic Civil War, directing the resistance among the local Dantari tribes.
Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka was an Ewok female who resided in Bright Tree Village on the Forest Moon of Endor. She was the daughter of the village chief, Chirpa, and she held the title of princess.

Mookiee, a female wokling, lived on the forest moon of Endor around the time of the Battle of Endor. She came of age and received her hood—together with Malani and Gwig—at the Festival of Hoods. She could often be seen playing with a wheeled animal toy.
Jaizen Suel was female Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order as a pilot in the Jedi Starfighter Corps during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Paltr Carvin was a human male who held the rank of General in the military of the Galactic Empire and Tribune of the Imperial Ruling Council in 5 ABY. Carvin and the council seized control after Interim Emperor Sate Pestage was accused of treason and fled Coruscant.

Vinoc was a Human male who was one of Count Dooku's Dark Acolytes during the Clone Wars. He was also the brother of Karoc and wielded a red-bladed lightsaber. They were sent by Count Dooku to protect the cortosis droid factories on Metalorn.
Tassida Judrelle was a Jedi Knight who was assigned to a team of Jedi to break up a salt smuggling ring in an asteroid belt near Cona.
This individual was a male Rutian Twi'lek who served the Jedi Order during the final decade of the Galactic Republic.
Sors Bandeam was a male Human Jedi Initiate enrolled in the Jedi Order's Temple academy on Coruscant during the Clone Wars.

Oggem Baobab, known locally as "Old Ogger," was a Human male prospector and a member of the Baobab family. In 75 BBY, he traveled to the planet Roon, searching for Roonstones. While he did find some—six bags' worth—his freighter crashed and caused him to be marooned.
Savax Clan-Vorsazg, War-Master of the Southern Wastes, was the Ubese clan leader who led a coalition of "True" Ubese clans from Uba IV against the "yrak pootzck" Ubese of Ubertica.
Bryyn Woolery was a male merchant who owned a business in Mos Espa, a spaceport settlement on the desert world of Tatooine.

Qibbu was a Hutt and owned Qibbu's Hut, a shady cantina/hotel in Coruscant's Entertainment district. Before the Clone Wars, the entrepreneur owed Kal Skirata half a million credits. After Skirata became involved in the GAR he waived the debt.

Adonar Dellox was a Rebel and Chief Technician at Reginard Base on the planet Reginard during the Galactic Civil War. He was one of the commanding officers of the base and was known to be a determined man who preferred to work alone.
Four unidentified Imperial Royal Guards led an Imperial splinter faction known as the Second Imperium. These four had formerly been stormtroopers promoted by Admiral Daala to guardsman status.
Sammie Staable was a Human bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War.
Buudro was an Imperial customs inspector found aboard Imperial Customs Frigate 517. He once boarded a ship orbiting the planet Reginard where he was escorted by two stormtroopers.
Nazzer was a bounty hunter for the Crimson Nova during the Clone Wars.
Egoreg was the leader of Tatooine's super-vaporator project.
Bor-Kal Vuluk was a Jedi Master who served the order during the New Sith Wars. Vuluk died on the battlefield of Ruusan, leaving his or her lightsaber to be sought by future archaeologists.
Talilia Weden was a Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Mann Ozzel was a merchant who lived many years prior to the Galactic Civil War. They orchestrated the trading of several varieties of mineral from the world of Carida, earning their family a considerable amount of wealth.
Leeni was a female wokling who lived around the time of the Battle of Endor. She was named for a spirit in Ewok mythology.
Brangus Glee was a Force-sensitive, brown-skinned member of a dexterous species of renowned travelers. He hailed from Dor Nameth, but had left his homeworld by the time he was considered an elder.
Meloque was a female Ho'Din scientist during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Rashtah was a Wookiee slave trader and an associate and bodyguard of the crime lord Krayn. Involvement in such a 'profession' was, of course, unusual for a Wookiee.

Dranae Shai was a Warrior of the Yuuzhan Vong. A member of Domain Shai, Dranae and his younger cousin, Neira, were sent by Commander Shedao Shai to recover the body of their ancestor, Mongei Shai, on Bimmiel.

Neira Shai was a warrior of the Yuuzhan Vong. A member of Domain Shai, he was dispatched by Commander Shedao Shai to Bimmiel, along with Dranae Shai, his elder cousin (and possibly his teacher) to recover the body of Mongei Shai, their ancestor.

Saluup Fing was a member of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. A Supreme Commander, Fing was placed in charge of the defenses of Yuuzhan'tar while Warmaster Nas Choka led the Yuuzhan Vong fleet during the Defense of Mon Calamari.

Falung was a Yuuzhan Vong female of the Priest caste. A Priestess of Yun-Harla, she was a part of Supreme Commander Zho Krazhmir's force which attacked the living world of Zonama Sekot. When Vergere offered to go with the Yuuzhan Vong, she became Falung's familiar.
