Phaa Anor was a male Yuuzhan Vong of the intendant caste and a relative of Nom Anor. Phaa Anor was a subordinate to Nom Anor, who acted as an advance agent in the galaxy, which the Yuuzhan Vong had targeted for invasion.

Brunok was a construction worker who was part of a crew on the Imperial superweapon known as the Tarkin around 3 ABY. While on the planet Hockaleg, he and another crew member were subdued by the Rebels Leia Organa, Chewbacca, and Luke Skywalker.
Voal was the Imperial Navy captain who commanded the Tarkin, during its construction in the Patriim system.
Kuhru was a Human male major in the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire and a distinguished AT-AT walker commander.
Wiley was a male wokling who lived on the forest moon of Endor. He was the son of Lumat and Zephee and the brother of Latara and Nippet. Wiley was named after a legendary hunter in Ewok mythology.

Yander was a Human male miner who is the father of Tarl, Tonoté, and Mithail and lived on Ord Cestus during the time of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Fi was a clone trooper who served in the 41st Elite Corps's Sarlacc Battalions during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, he fought in a skirmish on Dinlo until he was mortally wounded during the firefight.

Wets Tranoj was a Human male who served as a Coruscant Security Force police officer. In 22 BBY, Tranjo investigated the disappearance of Simon Greyshade's speeder and arrested Reymet Autem for the theft.

The president of Galladinium Galactic Exports was a Duros during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The president wrote a foreword for the Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology 50th anniversary edition.
Laseema was a blue skinned, possibly Rutian, female Twi'lek who worked for Qibbu the Hutt, as a waitress in Qibbu's Hut.
Blorga was a gladiator who participated in free-for-all mortal brawls in the Cauldron arena, the largest combat pit on the planet Rattatak.
Grunda Dolma was an Ualaq Aqualish who fought as a gladiator in a ritual battle in the Cauldron arena on the planet Rattatak in 22 BBY.

Flalios was a gladiator in the Cauldron arena on Rattatak, where he used twin ball-and-chain weapons against other fighters. Shortly after the outbreak of the Clone Wars, Flalios was killed by falling rocks caused by Asajj Ventress.

Krutch was an insectoid gladiator in the Cauldron arena on the planet Rattatak. It wielded several blades and a net against the other combatants, but during one battle, it was defeated by Kulltu Kutta.
Swyy'm-Ee was a Trogodile gladiator in the Cauldron arena on the planet Rattatak. Swyy'm-Ee wielded twin fi'langs against the other combatants but was later defeated by assassin Asajj Ventress.
Crockagor was a member of a green reptilian species. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, he served the Sith Lord Count Dooku.
Kulltu Kutta was a gladiator who participated in free-for-all mortal brawls in the Cauldron arena, the largest combat pit on the planet Rattatak, during the final years of the Old Republic.

Hreven Karsh was a member of the warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong, and during the Yuuzhan Vong War was escalated to the position of commander following the death of his relative, Supreme Commander Komm Karsh.

Bhu Fath was a Yuuzhan Vong of Domain Fath. Though Domain Fath were members of the Intendant caste, Bhu Fath was made a Commander within the Warrior caste, due to petitions from Domain Fath's many Consuls.
Tsun Qel was a member of the Shaper caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. A Shaper Initiate of Domain Qel, he went to Yavin 4, to look in on the shaping of Tahiri Veila.
Winda was the youngest Ewok child of the Ewok Deej and his wife who was born no earlier than 7 BBY. They were the younger sister of three brothers: Weechee, Widdle Warrick, and Wicket Warrick.
Vox Chun was the father of Bruck Chun and Kad Chun. He was also the treasurer on Telos IV during the reign of Xanatos.

O-Bin, also known as Bin, was a Teaching Guide at the Learning Circle on the planet of Kegan during the rule of V-Tan and O-Vieve. She was strict with her students, especially Obi-Wan Kenobi and Siri Tachi.

V-Tan, also known as Tan, was a Human male who was one of the Benevolent Guides during Kegan's isolationist period. He often had dreams about future events, which led him to O-Vieve, who had visions of the Galactic Empire's invasion of Kegan.

O-Vieve, also known as Vieve, was a Human female who was one of the Benevolent Guides during Kegan's isolationist period. She often had visions of the Galactic Empire's invasion of Kegan, which led her to V-Tan, who had dreams about future events.
Lena Cobral was a young woman who testified against her family so that she could overthrow their web of corruption on the planet of Frego.

Zanita Cobral was the true leader of the Cobral family and the mother of Rutin, Solan, and Bard Cobral. She committed suicide in 40 BBY after failing to assassinate her daughter-in-law, Lena Cobral, who had testified before the Galactic Senate earlier that day.

Solan Cobral was the son of Zanita Cobral and the figurehead behind the Cobral family's crime syndicate. He was manipulated by his mother, though he never admitted it. He was involved in the death of his younger brother, Rutin Cobral.

Drama Korr was a Human female and a wealthy Corellian merchant. She was assassinated by the bounty hunter Durge in her yacht while on a business run on the Karthakk system. Her murder was arranged by Dooku on behalf of Xist, her business rival.

Rutin Cobral was the husband of Lena Cobral and the son of Zanita Cobral. He grew sick of the Cobral family's plundering on the planet of Frego and compiled a case against them. However, his siblings and mother caught on and executed him.
Bard Cobral, a member of the criminal Cobral family, was a male Fregan from the planet Frego. Bard was the brother of Solan Cobral and Rutin Cobral, and the son of Zanita Cobral and her husband.
Mica was a female Fregan and cousin of Lena Cobral. Though they were close, Mica tried to stop Lena from testifying against the Cobral family, although Obi-Wan Kenobi stopped her plans.

V-Tarz was a gruff Truant Guide at the Learning Circle on Kegan. He apprehended Obi-Wan Kenobi and Siri Tachi during a truant sweep, mistakenly thinking they were students escaping from the Learning Circle.
V-Haad was a tall, balding male Human, one of two Hospitality Guides who introduced Jedi Knights Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn to the planet of Kegan. His female counterpart was O-Rina.
O-Rina was a female Human, one of two Hospitality Guides who introduced Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn to the planet of Kegan. Her male counterpart was V-Haad.

Fortunately for Beju, Queen Veda did not know about his transactions, so he was able to proceed with the elections. When everyone found out that Veda had been poisoned, Beju arranged for her to be locked up for protection.
Tessala Corvae was a Major General and one of the handful of high-ranking female officers in the Imperial Army.
Tolokai was a Gotal aide to Chief of State Mon Mothma during the early years of the New Republic.

O-Iris was a small, red-haired, female student at the Learning Circle on Kegan. Young and shy, O-Iris obeyed her teachers and their lessons until Obi-Wan Kenobi and Siri Tachi exposed the truth about The Learning's falsehoods.
Uunu was a Yuuzhan Vong female Shamed One who was alive in 26 ABY, when the Yuuzhan Vong were invading a galaxy other than their own.
Tetran Cowall was Garik "Face" Loran's rival when "Face" still made holodramas.
Rasha Bex was a Human female who served as a spy for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. She was a Human female with brown eyes and long brown hair.
Tam was an old Human male who lived on Stoga during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Karn was a large, dark-skinned Human male who joined the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Lhira was a Twi'lek female who joined the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Siolle Tinta was a woman from Corellia, the daughter of the owner of Tinta Lines. Once she was the subject of a kidnapping threat, and was placed under the protection of CorSec agents Corran Horn and Iella Wessiri.

Jocoro Desilijic Tiure was a Hutt who became a crime lord of the Desilijic kajidic by some time following the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY. In the years that followed the Battle of Endor, Jocoro ran a small criminal empire from a base on the planet Du Hutta.
Pazda Desilijic Tiure was a member of the Desilijic kajidic and an uncle of Jabba.
Ganji was an alien bounty hunter living during the time of the Galactic Empire.
Fonterrat was a scavenger of an unknown alien species of rodent-like beings with big eyes and ears, a sharp snout, and gray-brown fur which covered much of the body.

Braxas was an infochant on the planet Solay. Confined to a wheelchair, Braxas was a member of the Asogian species. When the Galactic Empire subjugated Solay in 4 ABY, Braxas fled the planet with Luke Skywalker as his pilot.
Nagraoao was a Wookiee spacer during the Galactic Civil War. He often worked with smuggler Roark Garnet.

Urartu was a Wookiee bouncer who worked at the Contumely Club, enforcing the Club's policies of allowing no Humans or droids on the premises. Urartu made use of a small creature who translated for the Wookiee.
Tavin Notsil was a Human male native of Aldivy.
Novin Bress was a scientist at Binring Biomedical Product.
Imsatad was an officer in the Imperial military who later fought for the New Republic, and afterwards defected to the Peace Brigade.
Niebur Boton was a female Zeltron Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Lilmit was a Black Sun lieutenant in 24 ABY of an unknown species with a small size, gray skin, wing-like eyebrows, ridged scalp and webbed hands. He was the owner of the Rude Awakening, a cargo hauler from Ord Mantell which had been shipping illegal weaponry to war-torn Anobis.
Zovius Mendu was an infamous criminal on the planet Taris during the era of the Mandalorian Wars. By 3964 BBY, he had built enough of a reputation to have the Jedi Master Feln personally hunting him.

In the face of withering attacks from the Mandalorians, Sowrs and the Taris Resistance managed to join forces with the powerful swoop gang known as the Hidden Beks, who ingratiated themselves with Sowrs' group by returning her two children.

Tanya Madera was an Imperial spy who infiltrated the Rebel Alliance, becoming a Major who was the second-in-command of Reginard Base. She was in charge of the base's more mundane operations such as supply logistics, personnel, and schedules.
Tony Franco was a youthful Human male Captain of Reginard Base's X-wing squadron during the Galactic Civil War.

Kim Yeasson was the Junior Technician for the Rebel Alliance's Reginard Base during the Galactic Civil War. She supervised the X-wing technical crews and was a capable X-wing technician as well, often being found on the flight line repairing a starfighter.

"Eyes" was a Rodian who had once been imprisoned on Kessel. However, when a smuggler came to the planet, "Eyes" stowed away on board the smuggler's YT-1300 freighter, paying the crew 50 credits per day to keep him safe.
Selnia was a female Human gambler who was once found on the planet Kessel. She was once hired by a smuggler who owned a YT-1300 freighter and paid her 100 credits per day.
Bolto was a Rodian gunman who was once found on the planet Bespin. While there he was hired by a smuggler who owned a YT-1300 freighter and paid him 50 credits per day for the work.
T'Sal was a Jawa "shuttle jockey" found on the planet Tatooine. They were once hired by a smuggler who owned a YT-1300 freighter and was paid 50 credits per day.
Rooarwaa was a Wookiee mercenary who was once hired by a smuggler on the planet Kashyyyk to serve aboard the smuggler's YT-1300 freighter. The cost for his services was 200 credits per day.
Aabatar was a male Mon Calamari smuggler who was once hired by another smuggler on the planet Dac to work on his YT-1300 freighter. Aabatar was paid two hundred credits per day for his services.
Thuugar was a Gamorrean "leg-breaker" who was once hired on the planet Gamorr by a smuggler who owned a YT-1300 freighter. The price for his services was 50 credits per day.

Huutar was a Human male who worked as a mechanic on the world of Corellia. He was once hired by a smuggler who owned a YT-1300 freighter; the price for Huutar's services was set at one hundred credits per day.

Yaawl was a Wookiee and Imperial fugitive who was once found on the planet Hoth. A Corellian smuggler with a YT-1300 freighter took him from Hoth, despite the fact that it meant the Galactic Empire was on their back more.
Chal Haan was a Neimoidian and the leader of his people at some point following the Trade Federation's dissolution in 19 BBY until at least the early days of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Hyobu Sulloran was a Human male who was one of many Force-sensitives captured for Emperor Palpatine to be trained as a Dark Side Adept.
Ward Fizark was a male Human hunter from Tatooine who was the husband of Sharina Fizark.
K'Armyn Viraxo was an alien Male and the patriarch of the Viraxo family and head of the shipping conglomerate, Viraxo Shipping (also known as Viraxo Industries).

Aggaba was a Hutt assistant who worked for Jemba of the Offworld Mining Corporation. During a flight to Bandomeer on the Monument, pirates shot down the freighter and left Aggaba and the ship's other occupants temporarily stranded on an unknown world.

Jemba was a Hutt in charge of the Offworld Mining Corporation's Bandomeer operations. He crash-landed on an unknown planet, and enslaved Arconans on the ship, forcing them to work for the dactyl nutrition which he stole from them which was critical for Arconans to survive.
Commodore Mabettye was a Mon Calamari officer in the New Republic Defense Fleet.

Vallikor En-Vahdi was a male Ipharian-Da'Lor bounty hunter who frequented the Glow Dome, a nightclub on Adarlon. He was extremely dangerous and possessed a set of Nullifier Energy Diffusion Armor, a power ancient artifact.

Raff was a male Yuuzhan Vong who served as a Battle Tactician for Commander Tla during the early stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War. When Shedao Shai died at Ithor, Tla was promoted and on Raff's advice assaulted the library world of Obroa-skai.
Kaim was a young male Twi'lek Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Chaan was a Supreme Commander of the Yuuzhan Vong.
Doshao was a Yuuzhan Vong male of the warrior caste who distinguished himself in 25 ABY as a subaltern during the Battle of Dantooine as part of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Sata'ak was a warrior of the Yuuzhan Vong. A Subaltern, he was escalated to Commander by Supreme Commander Nas Choka for his actions on Ithor. He was to be given a vessel of his own to command.
Harmae was a warrior of the Yuuzhan Vong. A Subaltern, he was escalated to Commander by Supreme Commander Nas Choka for his actions on Obroa-skai. He was to be given a vessel of his own to command.

Tugorn was a warrior of the Yuuzhan Vong. A Subaltern, he was escalated to Commander by Supreme Commander Nas Choka for his actions on Belkadan and Gyndine. He was to be given a vessel of his own to command.
Gchalla was a Wookiee female spacer who piloted the Silver Claw. After being captured by the Imperial Navy on Byblos, she was rescued by a group of spacers she had worked with previously.
Gerraba, a Wookiee, ran afoul of Jabba the Hutt circa 3 ABY. Jabba posted a small bounty on the Wookiee in retaliation.

Grashk was a young male Wookiee. After joining the Alliance to Restore the Republic, he worked with Tamarc, Almera Zan, and Roz to attempt to rescue Enid Vahr from Demophon prior to the Demophon supernova.
Perrive was a male Human who served as the leader of a group of Jabiimi terrorists that were stationed on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars.

Peshk Vri'syk was a male Bothan pilot who served in Rogue Squadron, the New Republic's elite starfighter unit, in 6 ABY. Born on Bothawui, Vri'syk was trained in flight combat at the Bothan Martial Academy.
Andoorni Hui was a Rodian female who served as one of the inaugural pilots of the reformed Rogue Squadron in 6.5 ABY.

TK-717 was a stormtrooper stationed aboard an Imperial Star Destroyer headed for the first Death Star shortly before of the Battle of Yavin. Before reaching the battle station, TK-717 and TK-622 discussed the planet Ralltiir and its Rebel extremists.
Zuur was a male Falleen employed on Void Station by Jib Kopatha.

Kol Yabu was an apostle of the Undying Flame, the cult of the Lover Gods, and a reader. Kol Yabu's body had been ritually burned and scarred, so that one side appeared male, representing Yun-Q'aah, and another side female, representing Yun-Txiin.
Moorsh was the Yuuzhan Vong chief priest of the Crèche, a yammosk clustership. He was fascinated by the tales that said the Ryn had the power of divination by using sabacc cards.

Four-One was a clone trooper lieutenant in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He piloted a LAAT/i gunship during the Battle of Haruun Kal. Under his command were 2nd Lieutenant CL-33/890 and two Auxiliary Heavy-Weapons Specialists, Seven-Four, and Eight-Three.
Lehesu was a male Oswaft who, during the Imperial Era, became one of the first of his species to ever set forth from the ThonBoka nebula.
Senwannus'gourkahipaff was a male Oswaft who served as one of three Elders of his space-dwelling species by 3 BBY.
Feytihennasraof was a male Oswaft who served as one of three Elders of his space-dwelling species by 3 BBY.
Bhoggihalysahonues was a female Oswaft who served as one of three Elders of her massive, vacuum-breathing species during the Imperial Period.

Ozrei N'takkilomandrife, also known as Knife, was a male Nagai and one of the foremost leaders of his species' invasion fleet during the Nagai–Tof War in 4 ABY. He commanded several early missions into territory belonging to the Alliance of Free Planets.

Nebulba was a male Dug and a member of the famous Sebulba family, and The Sebolto Clan of Malastare. He had a bounty posted on his head around 32 BBY, which had been specifically ordered by a hateful rival of his podracing relative, the Gran Mawhonic.

Xijulba was a male Dug who was a member of the family of the famous Sebulba and also the Sebolto Clan on Malastare. In 32 BBY, he had a bounty posted on his head by a hateful rival of his podracing relative, Mawhonic.
Graak was a cunning Ewok warrior from Bright Tree Village.
Rabin was an Ewok male who lived on the moon of Endor during the Battle of Endor. Aside from being a beast tamer, he was known as a thief, a loner, a hunter, and a survivor.
Devers was a male Human who served as an officer in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War, having achieved the rank of Commander.

Wuta was an Ewok male scout on the forest moon of Endor. He tracked predators and searched for fallen trees to make tools. He was the first Ewok to notice the Galactic Empire when they began establishing a presence on Endor. He shares his name with a spirit in Ewok mythology.
Smileredon-Verdont, better known as Smiley, was a male Squib with blue fur and yellow eyes.
Lanu Pasiq was a member of the Imperial Inquisitorius, who helped hunt down the fugitive Jedi Padawan Drake Lo'gaan and his friends, Ekria and Zonder.
Golov Nakhym was a male pirate who was the leader of the notorious Outer Rim group, the Hurrim, during the Galactic Civil War.
Ta'a Chume's consort was the father of Kalen and Isolder. Described by Ta'a Chume as adventurous, he once took Isolder camping on Dreena. He died while his children were small.
S'yito was a Yuuzhan Vong male and a member of the warrior caste. During his species' invasion of the galaxy, S'yito was assigned to the prison planet Selvaris, holding the rank of subaltern.
Besany Wennen was an agent of the Republic Treasury Audit Division.
Romany was the leader of one of two clans of Ryn refugees stranded on the planet Duro during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He was a former biologist and had a bushy mane.
Mezza was a Ryn female and the leader of one of two clans of Ryn refugees stranded on the planet Duro during the Yuuzhan Vong War. She was an aging female with graying, red-orange fur.

Melisma was a female Ryn, and the sister of Droma. A refugee of the Yuuzhan Vong War, she was evactuated from Ord Mantell to Gyndine to Ruan. Along with many other refugees, Melisma was later taken from Ruan to Fondor by smugglers hired by the Peace Brigade.

Beed Thane was the archon of the planet Vergill, a member of the Hapes Consortium. He insulted Ambassador Leia Organa Solo after she attempted to persuade the Hapans to support the New Republic in its war against the Yuuzhan Vong.
Ewane was a Human male who served as the Supreme Governor of New Apsolon, and was the father of Alani and Eritha.
Nuro Tualin was a Twi'lek male flight officer in the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Jart Eyan was a male Twi'lek lieutenant in the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Radaf Netbers was a captain in the military forces of Warlord Zsinj.
Galey was a Human male support staffer in the New Republic Defense Fleet.

Rimkar was a Podracer pilot on Tatooine, circa 32 BBY, who flew a peculiar "bubble pod". His pod was destroyed by Sebulba in a Podrace not long before the Invasion of Naboo when the Dug slammed his Podracer into the cliff face at Metta Drop.

Runck Das of Domain Das was a member of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. During the Battle of Garqi, Das was dispatched by Krag Val to inform Commander Shedao Shai that three Jedi had engaged the Yuuzhan Vong, and they seemed to be protecting something (the secret of baf…

Joak Drysso was an officer in the Imperial Navy, and a staunch New Order loyalist—a squat, dangerous looking man whose hair and goatee turned gray early, and who hid his thoughts and worries behind a stern mask of command.

Skivvers was a male Ho'Din who operated out of Ord Mantell as a slicer. Due to a bounty placed on his head, he was forced to keep a low profile, yet this did not prevent him from keeping in contact with his underworld connections.
Elam Mattic was an individual from Alderaan who moved to the planet Taris.
Vareesa Enan was a naïve Ithorian tourist who traveled to Ralltiir in the years leading up to the Clone Wars. Vareesa was the cousin of Vanster Enan, who ran a sop house on Cularin.

Kikow was a pale Ithorian who left his herdship at an early age and eventually settled on Ralltiir. A superb cook with a highly developed sense of smell, he ran a restaurant and had a business trading in culinary herbs and spices.

Harvos was a male Nelvaanian scout from Rokrul village on the Outer Rim planet Nelvaan. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Confederacy-aligned Techno Union built a laboratory on Nelvaan that drained the planet of geo…
Tuzes-Adaz was a Nelvaanian female who was the mother of multiple sons and who served as the chieftain of the village Rokrul on the Outer Rim planet Nelvaan during the Clone Wars.

Dux Pike was an Epicanthix who was skilled in the art of Teräs Käsi during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 22 BBY, before the Clone Wars started, he participated in a Teräs Käsi competition on Bunduki until he was killed by Phow Ji.
Ish-Bel Tur was a male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order at the Almas Academy, a Jedi training institution on the planet Almas, during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Loiin Sool was one of the Shamed Ones working at the Eighth cortex damutek on Yuuzhan'tar. When Master Shaper Nen Yim contacted the Prophet Yu'Shaa about taking her to Zonama Sekot, Loiin Sool delivered the message to Yu'shaa.

Hul Qat was a member of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. Originally one of the hunters, his implants rotted, and he was declared a Shamed Ones and cast from Domain Qat. Hul lost his hope and just waited to die.

Bhasu Ruuq was a male Yuuzhan Vong warrior at the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. On the former New Republic capital world of Coruscant, renamed "Yuuzhan'tar," Ruuq was assigned to watch over a shaper damutek, a laboratory where shapers—Yuuzhan Vong bioengineers—worked to improv…
Tyrn Jiton was a male Devaronian who operated as a bounty hunter within the Borderland Regions of the galaxy during the first years of the New Republic in order to fund his gambling expenses.

Tanniel was a military officer who served the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire. During the Clone Wars, he was appointed Moff of the Quelii Oversector under the Sector Governance Decree and assumed the role of commander of the 10th Sector Army.
Hask's involvement in the scheme was discovered by the Jedi Tholme and Quinlan Vos while he met with co-conspirator Adol Bel of the Xucphra Corporation.
Adol Bel was a male Human who served as the director of Xucphra Corporation during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Trodos was a male Gamorrean and one of the co-directors of the Stark Commercial Combine. Alongside fellow co-director Lom Portom, he led the Stark Collective forces in the Fifth Battle of Qotile in 44 BBY.

Zur was a male Zabrak who was a member of the Stark Collective. He was the captain of its flagship, the Raptor, and was killed aboard it when the ship was destroyed in the Fifth Battle of Qotile in 44 BBY.

Shorshone was a male Human who was a member of the Stark Collective. He was a bridge officer on its flagship, Raptor, and was killed aboard it when the ship was destroyed in the Fifth Battle of Qotile in 44 BBY.

Alph was a male Human guard at the City of Bone slave camp on Mandalore, where he was sometimes admonished for brutally beating hapless slaves. He perished when the city was destroyed by a chain reaction started by the destruction of Shrike Squadron in 3 ABY.

Vorol was an alien who lived on the Wheel space station during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, Rebel leaders Lando Calrissian and Chewbacca, who were searching for information on the whereabouts of the bounty hunter Bossk, were led to believe that Vorol knew their target's w…
H. Voolai was the "Human & Other Resources" manager of the Alliance.reb network.
Khiss was a Human investment advisor, who was present at the Circus Horrificus on Nar Shaddaa around 32 BBY.

Gallan was a male Human officer of the Rendili Home Defense Fleet. He served as a Lieutenant and was stationed aboard the flagship Mersel Kebir and supported fellow Lieutenant Mellor Yago's coup against Captain Jace Dallin.
Billibango was a male Xexto from Troiken who supported the Galactic Republic.

bel-dar-Nolek was a Human male serving as director of the Obroan Institute during the Black Fleet Crisis and up into the Yuuzhan Vong invasion of the galaxy. The obese man wore custom-tailored suits and walked with a greel wood cane.

Joc Sah was a Human male Jedi Padawan who served as a commander during the Clone Wars. In the war's final year, Sah and his Jedi Master, Sev, were dispatched to the Outer Rim planet Ragmar V, which was considered a vital staging world for a planned assault on a Separatist base.
Loiric Kaan was the Supreme Commander of the Yammka's Mount, the flagship of Warmaster Nas Choka during the Yuuzhan Vong's assault on Mon Calamari.
Lurll was a Wol Cabasshite ambassador who hired hunters to eliminate lairs of creatures on Tatooine where Brainworm Rot Type B was detected c. 1 ABY.

Yakown Reth served the New Republic during the Yuuzhan Vong War, leading first Green Squadron and then Blackmoon Squadron of E-wing starfighters. He did not favor the newer tactics employed against the Yuuzhan Vong, preferring a more straightforward approach in dogfighting.

Ryoo Thule was a Human female from Naboo. She was the mother of Jobal Naberrie, the maternal grandmother of Sola Naberrie and Padmé Amidala, and the great-grandmother of Ryoo and Pooja Naberrie, Luke Skywalker, and Leia Organa.
Gar-Oth was the ruler of an empire. In 31 BBY, under his command, the Yahk-Tosh invaded the homeworld of a rival empire, killing their ruler and enacting a form of martial law.

Jun Seros was a Whiphid member of the Rebel Alliance, living in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. There he owned a diner, well known to provide hearty meals to tired travelers. He was forced to pay Jabba the Hutt to allow himself and his business to survive.
Volytar was an Imperial High Inquisitor who was intercepted outside of his personal Star Destroyer by Arani Korden, Rorworr, and Deel Surool at the planet of Skorrupon.
Budmle Otbor was a male Neimoidian and the primary representative of the Trade Federation on the planet Sucharme. He was killed by Clone Commander Jai'galaar at some point during the Clone Wars.

Jaller Obrim was a lifelong police officer on the galactic capital of Coruscant. During his career, he served as a Senate Guard, a Coruscant Security Force officer, and a member of the Imperial Security Bureau.
Nye was a clone trooper who fought in the Skirmish at Dinlo.

"Lady Blue" was a Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot stationed aboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Liberty in the months leading up to the Battle of Endor. She was considered attractive and held the title of Miss Liberty in 2 ABY.
Brauken was a male individual who served as the mayor of the trading outpost Harlequin Station during the Galactic Civil War.

R'Ytha Myr was a female who may have in the past dated Ace Azzameen (or perhaps another individual called "Ace"). Months before the Battle of Endor, she sent an e-mail message to Ace Azzameen, saying that if he was the Ace she dated at Luxiar 7, he should: "DROP DEAD, YOU LOUSE!"

Rustyn Jarl was member of the Rebel Alliance and recruiter for a group of fighter pilots known as Red Group, shortly after the Battle of Hoth. Jarl once sent out an e-mail message to Alliance members urging them to join Red Group.

Chez Ulan was a member of the Rebel Alliance and recruiter for a group of fighter pilots known as Blue Group, shortly after the Battle of Hoth. He once sent out an e-mail message to Alliance recruits urging them to join Blue Group.

Jorgis was a fighter pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance as a member of Green Group during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, Jorgis was stationed onboard the Mon Calamari cruiser Defiance after joining the Rebellion about same time as Ace Azzameen.

L'Urak was a Rebel Alliance fighter pilot stationed onboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Defiance. The pilot was killed in the months leading up to the Battle of Endor, and was honored at a funeral service along with fellow pilots Gaad, Jorgis and Parch.

Gaad was a Rebel Alliance fighter pilot stationed onboard the Mon Calamari cruiser Defiance. Gaad was killed in the months leading up to the Battle of Endor. He was honored at a funeral service along with fellow pilots Jorgis, L'Urak and Parch.

Parch was a Rebel Alliance fighter pilot stationed onboard the Mon Calamari cruiser Defiance. He was killed in the months leading up to the Battle of Endor. He was honored at a funeral service along with fellow pilots Gaad, Jorgis and L'Urak.

Natalie Darr was a Rebel Alliance personnel officer stationed onboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Defiance, in the months leading up to the Battle of Endor. During that time, she sent an e-mail to pilot Ace Azzameen confirming his transfer to the cruiser Liberty.

Bralla Hemm was a Rebel Alliance personnel officer stationed onboard the Mon Calamari cruiser Liberty in the months leading up to the Battle of Endor. Hemm sent out a message seeking volunteers with military experience from among refugees from Kothlis on board Liberty.

Ariq Joanson was a moisture farmer on Tatooine. His best friend was a fellow moisture farmer named Eyvind. Aside from his moisture farming, Joanson tried to create peace between the Sand People, the Jawas, and the moisture farmers.
Unut Poll was a male Arcona and Rebel Alliance collaborator during the Galactic Civil War.

Nariss Siv Loqesh, later known as Andov Syn, was a Kerestian male who forged a successful career for himself as a bounty hunter during the reign of the Galactic Empire and the early years of the New Republic.

Aran Cho was a captain in the Imperial Navy. Born into a family of strict naval officers, he thus received his officers commission at a relatively young age. He quickly gained rank and was reputed to be a brilliant strategist and motivator.
Warlug was one of nine Gamorreans in Jabba's Palace. He was a member of the Groogrun clan.
Tyionsis Cex was a Srrors'tok bounty hunter who served the Galactic Empire during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Reglis Taal was a male. Due to a misunderstanding, a bounty was posted on the head of Taal's brother Philo, who was killed by two overzealous bounty hunters. Motivated by revenge, Taal tracked and killed the murderers.
Baraduk was a Barabel male from Barab I. Captured by slavers and sent to the Imperial settlement of the planet Herios IV, Baraduk raided the settler's armory and escaped.
Malis was an Imperial-licensed bounty hunter with a twisted sense of justice.
Olag Greck was a businessman and later a crime lord who lived during the Imperial Era.
H'rinnrada was a female Rodian bounty hunter.
Windy Starkiller, otherwise known as Windom Marstrap, was a Human male, and a childhood friend of Luke Skywalker when he lived on Tatooine. He often spent time with Luke at Tosche Station.
Grefnakk was a Gamorrean bounty hunter who was active during the Galactic Civil War.
A Dimean warlord, Kraat led the Dimean fleet in various raids across the galaxy. His reign of terror came to an end when he captured two Jedi Knights, Jolee Bindo and Andor Vex.

Gerd was a Human male miner who lived during the time of the New Sith Wars. Gerd worked in a cortosis mine on the Outer Rim planet Apatros, where he stayed for nearly twenty years. He was good friends with a miner named Hurst and often bullied Hurst's son, Dessel.
Boor-Daa was a male Kajain'sa'Nikto who was one of the co-directors of the Stark Commercial Combine.

Lom Portom was one of the co-directors of the Stark Commercial Combine. Alongside fellow co-director Trodos, he led the Stark Collective forces in the Fifth Battle of Qotile in 44 BBY. During the battle, Portom was trapped with his troops in a cave and devoured by challat eaters.

Tam Gozon was one of the co-directors of the Stark Commercial Combine. Iaco Stark killed him, along with the other co-directors, in the Combine's headquarters during the Fifth Battle of Qotile in 44 BBY.

Joey Orsel was a Human male who, during the time of the Galactic Republic, was a passenger on a pleasure cruiser headed for Alderaan under the command of Captain Quasar. Also on the ship was Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi, who was accompanied by a protocol droid called 68-RKO.
Augustus Tryll was a Human male with a widespread reputation as a slaver and criminal during the era of the Galactic Republic.

Rork was a Human male who served as a crewman on Captain Quasar's pleasure cruiser during the era of the Galactic Republic. Rork was aboard Quasar's cruiser during a journey through the Merson asteroid belt when they noticed Merson pirate vessels tailing their ship.

Quasar was a Human male who captained a commercial pleasure cruiser during the time of the Galactic Republic, which transported important dignitaries and lowlifes alike. Quasar's ship once carried Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi on a trip to Alderaan.
Enacca was a brown-furred female Wookiee who lived on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. An associate of Kal Skirata, she was often put in charge of logistics for Skirata's black ops missions.
Suung Aruh was a male Yuuzhan Vong and a member of the Shaper caste. A Shaper Initiate, he was stationed on the worldship Baanu Miir.

Sakanga Shai was a Warrior of the Yuuzhan Vong. A member of Domain Shai, by the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War, Sakanga was extremely old, having a mummy-like appearance, and as such was too old to take part in the fighting.

Malindin Gevarak was a small-time counterfeiter from Ord Mantell who was wanted by the Galactic Empire for forging Imperial credits for use by Rebel Alliance personnel. Gevarak traveled with the Wookiee, Cherioer.

Illist Mandrep was a deranged Arcona who was strongly addicted to salt, which resulted in severe delusions of being persecuted. He became a bounty hunter, sliding through the Imperial bureaucracy despite his mental state, and becoming something of a walking arsenal.
Tesslar was a male Human bounty hunter working for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Vinna Jiss was a female Human Grand Army of the Republic logistics employee who worked under Besany Wennen and sided with the Separatists during the Clone Wars.
Selong Lian was a male Yuuzhan Vong and a member of the Warrior caste. He served as the aide to Warmaster Tsavong Lah while he was stationed aboard the Sunulok.

Shanks was a Human male who served as a Lieutenant in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Shanks served as a military liaison between the Galactic Empire and the House of Tagge in 0 ABY, working directly under Baron Orman Tagge.

A Ssi-ruu was the Shreeftut of the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium in the time of the Galactic Civil War. During his reign, the Shreeftut began having dreams of a cloaked Human: Emperor Palpatine, contacting him through the Force.
Meloria was a female Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during both institutions' final century.

Eshin Worr was a member of the Intendant caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. An executor, she oversaw the management of slaves. She would do what she could to keep her slaves alive, however, she did not tolerate disobedience.
Ter-Idi was a male Cerean Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic before falling to the dark side of the Force and establishing a major criminal empire on Coruscant.
Mynnic was a male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Pal-Han-Das was a tough, young male Cerean noble and a member of Mynnic's band of adventurers around 32 BBY. He wore robes and trappings that signified his rank in Cerean society. He was the intellectual and tactician of the band, but didn't mind getting his hands dirty.
Vinto was a green male Rodian scoundrel and a member of Mynnic's band of adventurers around 32 BBY. He wore goggles, a flashy cape, and many pockets in which he hid weapons and treasures.
Wertsnik was a male Trandoshan soldier and a member of Mynnic's band of adventurers around 32 BBY. He was a veteran of many battles.

Jafer Torles was a male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. A Jedi Watchman, Torles resided on Cartao as he watched over the Prackla sector for thirty standard years.
Mar'ek was an Advanced Recon Commando under the command of Senior Jedi General Darrus Jeht.
Beau was a pilot who flew an X-wing fighter in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Their callsign was Red Ten.

Smithy was a Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot stationed onboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Defiance. Smithy was killed in the months leading up to the Battle of Endor. The Rebel was honored at a funeral service along with fellow pilots Blue Eight, Roanda, Voxx and Waudok.
Roanda was a Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot who was stationed aboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Defiance. Roanda was killed in action during the months leading up to the Battle of Endor.
Voxx was a fighter pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the Rebel was stationed onboard the Mon Calamari cruiser Defiance.

Waudok was a Rebel Alliance fighter pilot stationed onboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Defiance. Waudok was killed in the months leading up to the Battle of Endor. The Rebel was honored at a funeral service along with fellow pilots Blue Eight, Smithy, Roanda and Voxx.
Nor Fik was the lead negotiator for the Colicoids who sought total control of the spice-processing operations on Nar Shaddaa prior the Clone Wars.
Tabba was a Rebel Alliance fighter pilot who was stationed onboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Defiance during the Galactic Civil War.

Kraigg was a Rebel Alliance fighter pilot stationed onboard the Mon Calamari cruiser Defiance. Kraigg was killed in action near the Japai system in the months leading up to the Battle of Endor, along with fellow pilots Tabba and Lady Blue.
Mazie was a female Twi'lek from Ryloth living in the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Berri was a female Twi'lek child from Tatooine who worked in the kitchens at Krayn's palace.
Lieutenant D. Wolren was an officer working for Alliance Security in the months leading up to the Battle of Endor.

Zed Emmers was a starfighter pilot who served as Cadet 2nd Class in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Emmers once sent pilot Ace Azzameen an e-mail message praising Ace's skill when flying Z-95 Headhunters, and asking for him to share his "secret" to flying them.
Hokker was a male Trandoshan slaver working for the pirate and crime-lord Krayn in the final years of the Galactic Republic, before the Clone Wars.

Hala was a female Human slave on Tatooine in the final years of the Galactic Republic, before the Clone Wars. She was the mother of Amee, a close friend of Anakin Skywalker, and was owned by Yor Millto.
Gogol was a male humanoid criminal who haunted the Dor on Coruscant in the final years of the Galactic Republic, before the Clone Wars.
Anf Dec was a male Colicoid and starship captain in the final years of the Galactic Republic, before the Clone Wars.
Krayn's bosun was a male Ranat slaver working for the pirate and crime-lord Krayn in the final years of the Galactic Republic, before the Clone Wars.

Condi was a male Human from the world of Zoraster in the final years of the Galactic Republic, before the Clone Wars. He was taken as a slave by the Nar Shaddaa crime-lord Krayn and forced to work, under penalty of death, as a guard upon his pirate ship.

Yor Millto was a Toong male who lived on the desert world of Tatooine. Like many others on this planet, he had a few slaves who had to work for him. When Space Pirate Krayn kidnapped his slave Hala and Amee, he considered the loss to be annoying but not tragic.
Elza Monimi was a male slave who lived on Tatooine prior to the Invasion of Naboo. He was captured by Krayn.
Titi Chronelle was a male Human slave in Mos Espa.
Leed Quarrezz was an insurance agent for Allied Life Inc. Quarrezz sent an e-mail message offering a pilot's life insurance policy to Rebel Alliance pilot Ace Azzameen.

Farsa Zirl was an employee of the LV Labs pharmaceutical company. Zirl sent out e-mail messages advertising a laser burn medication designed to relieve Imperial laser burns, and claimed it was also helpful to those recovering from carbonite encasement.

JR Yakar was the president of Yakar's Parts, a company that sold new & used transport parts. During the time prior to the Battle of Endor, Yakar sent out an e-mail advertising the company to recipients that included Ace Azzameen.

Jibb Swaine was an employee of Pruett Products, a company that sold mechanical replacement limbs. Swaine once sent out an advertisement claiming that Luke Skywalker's mechanical hand was made by Pruett.
Raleigh Dawn was a young female Human who also operated under the pseudonym Kestrel during the Galactic Civil War. In her past, she had some sort of deeply disturbing encounter with fire.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: Greni was a Wing Commander in the Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic during the Thrawn campaign. She was the commanding officer of Gold Squadron.

Kad Chun, later known as Uni, was the second of the two sons born to Vox Chun, a political manipulator and powerful presence on Telos IV. His father was long under the influence of Xanatos, the rogue Jedi, and Kad was born into a world of distrust and manipulation.

Kram Ayuk was a male Gran from Hok who worked for RavinsBlud Crime Syndicate during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was wanted by the Coruscant Security Force for questioning, involving smuggling of death sticks on Malastare.
Papeh Blangko was the bounty hunter responsible for the bounty on the head of "Bogey" Boga.
Nikohler Elee was a member of the Galactic Radicals organization who was affiliated with the Aqualish bounty hunter, "Bogey" Boga.
Nancifer Sandsee was a member of the Galactic Radicals organization and was affiliated with the Aqualish bounty hunter Boozoo Boga.
Jokomo Barillard was a member of the Galactic Radicals organization and was affiliated with the Aqualish bounty hunter "Bogey" Boga.

Malfkla Yzu was a male Human and one of the thirteen Imperial warlords killed by Admiral Natasi Daala at Tsoss Beacon in 12 ABY. Under the Empire, Yzu was an admiral in the 15th Deep Core Reserve Fleet.

Ssssk! was a telepathic member of a feline species who served as an adjutant of the Galactic Empire. In 4 ABY, Ssssk! was stationed on the planet Seoul 5 under Imperial Captain Drezzel, where he telepathically monitored a pair of Imperial-funded scientists researching there.
Aril Nunb was a Sullustan female who defied her employers and fought against the Empire, eventually becoming a starfighter pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The tree-like Jedi was a female Jedi student at Luke Skywalker's Jedi Academy around the crisis of the Second Imperium.
Loom Carplin was a Human male who served as Travia Chan's Chief of Staff during the Galactic Civil War.

Baladdok was a male Weequay affiliate of Gardulla the Hutt, who was based on Tatooine during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. A bounty, 2,500 credits dead, was posted on him after slaughtering a ronto belonging to a Jawa village in the Jundland Wastes.
Bazurkah was a male Dug who was leader of the Bazurkah Clan on Malastare during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Bog'Ruhx was a male Dug and the head of the Ruhx clan on Malastare. He posted a bounty on the entire Bazurkah family, in a consecutive process, after Bazurkah insulted his kin.
Tolok Naap was a member of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. Tens of cycles before the Invasion of Yavin 4, Naap was part of the war party of Vua Rapuung.

Sinan Mat was a member of the warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. A field commander, Mat was dispatched into the jungles of Yavin 4 in 26 ABY in order to search for fugitive Jedi who had escaped the destruction of the Jedi Praxeum.
Clanky was a clone trooper sergeant who served in Jedi General Etain Tur-Mukan's Improcco Company.

Tih Qiqah was a member of the Shaper caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. A Master Shaper, Qiqah was assigned to the Baanu Miir in his final years. However, either by senility or sheer greed, Qiqah did not teach any Adepts during his final years.
Taan was a Shamed One of the Yuuzhan Vong. Stationed aboard the Stalking Moon, Taan offered to help Corran Horn in communicating with the rest of the Yuuzhan Vong fleet preparing to attack Yag'Dhul.
DD was the nickname of a male Human clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. He was created by the Kaminoan cloners on the planet Kamino for use in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic.

O-Four, also known by the number RC-1304, was a male Human clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. He was created by the Kaminoan cloners on the planet Kamino for use in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic.

Sev was the name taken by a male Human clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. He was created by the Kaminoan cloners on the planet Kamino for use in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic.
Billey was a prominent Human male smuggler. His origin was unknown, but he was widely assumed to be Corellian.

Farr Orjul was a Human male Separatist terrorist and a supplier of explosives ordnance for Perrive's terror net on the planet Coruscant. He was apprehended by Omega Squad during a TIOPS mission and was interrogated by the Mandalorian Walon Vau and Jedi Etain Tur-Mukan.

Merl was the owner and bartender of a tavern located in Old Town on the planet of Centares. He smuggled food to Tyler Lucian until killed in a firefight with Beilert Valance, who was searching for Lucian.

M'truli was a Kajain'sa'Nikto terrorist assisting in the supply of a Separatist terror net on Coruscant. He was captured by Omega Squad during a TIOPS mission. He was later unsuccessfully interrogated by Walon Vau and executed along with his comrades, Farr Orjul and Gysk.
Dravis was a former Imperial pilot, and the chief lieutenant of smuggler kingpin Billey. His father was a pilot in the elite Scimitar assault wing.

Gysk was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto terrorist who was supplying ordnance for a Separatist terror net on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, he was captured by Omega Squad during a TIOPS mission in the Tynna sector.
Vaas Ga was a Duros male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Tammia Hollusen, also known as Tammi, was a Human who, in her youth, lived and worked for the Galactic Empire on Metalorn. She aided in Princess Leia Organa's escape from Orman Tagge. Tammi planted a single flower on Metalorn to show the first seeds of rebellion to the Empire.

Corwyth was a Human male who reigned as the Imperial Governor of the planet Metalorn in 0 ABY. Corwyth's rule was characterized by a tight regimentation of society and a complete control over the flow of information, which led Metalorn's citizens to not even know a Rebellion e…
Arn Horada was a renowned historian and professor of galactic history, who during the years following the Clone Wars served as a personal teacher to Alderaanian Princess Leia Organa during her youth.
Mistress Dragon was the name of the sand dragon which served as the guardian of Hethrir's base on his private Worldcraft.
Iyon (also known as Mr. Iyon) was the Chamberlain of the Codru-Ji species from the remote Outer Rim planet of Munto Codru in 14 ABY.

Grake was a female member of the insectoid Veubg species. She was a slave at Hethrir's private Worldcraft in 14 ABY during the Empire Reborn insurgency. Grake worked as a cook in Hethrir's kitchen, preparing food for the captive children.
Liegeus Sarpaetius Vorn was a male Human from a wealthy family. He became a producer of fake holograms and entered into an arrangement with Seti Ashgad.

Belinda Vog was the owner and operator of Vog Salvage, Inc. She led a team of salvagers to the Graveyard to follow a rumor that the Aldera Royal Palace had somehow survived the Destruction of Alderaan and that the wealth of the building was contained in one of the asteroids in…
Spilferithimus-narlamos, often called Spilfer for short, was a blue-furred Squib male diplomat—a status that allowed him to sign agreements on behalf of his entire species.
Kandji was a Human female from Tatooine who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Seggor Tels was a Quarren leader who, motivated by hatred and jealousy of the Mon Calamari people, helped the Galactic Empire conquer the planet Mon Calamari (also known as Dac) in 19 BBY.

Kir Vantai was a Duros Admiral in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. Admiral Vantai commanded the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Moonshadow. He was one of several officers who participated in the Battle of Liinade III.

Dethro Glok was an unscrupulous alien ruler of the scrap dealers who scavenge the abandoned mines and gas refineries of Ord Ibanna. He designed three of the planet's Podracing courses: Scrapper's Run, Dethro's Revenge, and Abyss.
Corvastan Benelex was a bounty hunter and entrepreneur in the times of the Galactic Empire.
Gavrilonnis Tejere was a Givin male who, in 22 BBY, performed an act of sabotage on the Yag'Dhul Ambassadorial Landing Platform, located on the planet Coruscant.
Jujiran Halbeet was a Givin maintenance worker at the Yag'Dhul Ambassadorial Landing Platform.

Dono was a Squib who lived aboard the Imperial Armored Transport Elusive. In the eyes of the Squib Reclamation Fleet, Dono was a secret agent who transmitted the Elusive coordinates to the fleet so they could follow behind the Imperial ship and snatch up the garbage it dumped …
Tragg Brathis was a human male who was an alleged Moff that led the Grand Imperial Union.
Movo Brattakin was an acquaintance of Olag Greck. After Greck nearly murdered him, Movo merged his mind with the metallic body of his aide B-9D7.

Tav Breil'lya was a top aide to Borsk Fey'lya. However, he lacked Fey'lya's political guile, and his actions on New Cov trying to get Garm Bel Iblis to ally with Fey'lya's faction were exposed to the New Republic Provisional Council.

Hamo Blastwell was a Rebel starfighter pilot who served in Red Squadron on the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence during the Galactic Civil War. He served as the squadron's orientation officer, helping to introduce new pilots to the squadron and assisting with their training.
Hodge was a pilot, a chief officer miner and a man who was infected by the monster Spore.

Kannen Doom was a noted Human female bounty hunter who aged at a far slower rate than normal. In the last years of the Galactic Republic, she favored form-fitting hot pink outfits with low necklines, but by the time of the Battle of Endor, she typically dressed in blue armor.

Nuriin-Ar was a male Korun terrorist who led a group of three other Korunnai and held six Galactic Republic civilians, including a Mon Calamari senator and his aide and a member of the CSA Direx Board hostage for three hours.
All-Terrain Attack Vehicle, or AT-AV for short, was the nickname of a female pittin that was a pet belonging to Tia Organa, one of Princess Leia Organa's adoptive aunts on Alderaan.

Ship was an organic, sentient spacecraft that dwelled in the solitude of the intergalactic void. Once one of the sole survivors of a destructive extragalactic war, the mecho-organic vessel and its pilot fled into the void after a plague bomb wiped out all life in their galaxy.
Gengi Tung was a male Yuuzhan Vong species who served as a member of the shaper caste of the for the Yuuzhan Vong empire following its capture of the New Republic planet Coruscant in 27 ABY.
Kazz was an Imperial Navy officer who served since the early years of the New Order, which was established in 19 BBY. He was an admiral by 3 ABY.

Grubba Desilijic Aarrpo, also known as Grubba the Hutt, was the nephew of Jabba of the Desilijic clan. He was kidnapped by the Whiphid "Black Tongue" while in transit to Tatooine. However, the Hutt was rescued by Han Solo, who hoped to have the bounty on his head rescinded.
Laskar was a Human male who occupied a place of high prestige on the planet Tirahnn during the Imperial Period.

affiliation: Supreme Council of the Highland Clans
x: Aragh was a male S'kytri warrior and Lord of the Highlands of the planet of Skye. Serving as the people's Patriarch, he resided in the planet's capital city, the City of the Winged People.

affiliation: Supreme Council of the Highland Clans
x: Deverén was a S'kytri female spokesbeing for the Supreme Council of the Highland Clans on the planet Skye during the Galactic Civil War.
Omwaan was an Ithorian who resided on Kashyyyk sometime after 0 BBY.
Mystra was an alien assassin who served as an enforcer for Raskar, a former pirate and the ruler of the planet Antipose.

Antes Belladar was the Human governor of the agricultural planet Reytha during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 0 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War, Reytha was taken over by the Alliance to Restore the Republic, which Belladar was unable to prevent.
Elrod was the pet of a Human civilian on the planet Nadiem.

Ke Daiv was a male Blood Carver assassin who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In the service of Wilhuff Tarkin, and dispossessed by his own people, he had the unfortunate distinction, in 29 BBY, of being the "first personal kill" of Anakin Skywalker, the…

Meen Burtak was a death stick-addicted male Gran from Malastare, who was known to be a smart, manipulative informant to Jaw-knee Rise and a member of the RavinsBlud Crime Syndicate during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Brine Eyes-Li was a male Gran hitman from Malastare who served the RavinsBlud Crime Syndicate and Sebolto during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Bot was a enigmatic and mute hooded henchman of Captain-Supervisor Grammel on Circarpous V. As he could not speak, he nodded when speaking with Grammel.
Choday Hrakness was a Human male from the planet Agamar.
Gribbet was a Rybet bounty hunter operating on Ord Mantell in the times of the Galactic Empire.
Clive Flax was a double agent and a friend of Ferus Olin. He would often pose as a musician in nightclubs to gather the information he needed unnoticed.
Louie Mattic was the an individual from Alderaan and uncle to Elam Mattic, who moved to Taris by 3956 BBY.

Trillka was a repair-shop owner on the planet Kalarba. She fixed C-3PO's head plate in a way that made him look like the assassin droid C-3PX. Later, when the criminal Olag Greck tried to blow up Hosk Station, she foiled the scheme by undoing the sabotage to the power core.
Saalo Morn was a male Near-Human Dark Jedi who abandoned the Jedi Order during the Inter-Sith Wars period.
Shala was a minor but very old Hutt crime lord whose pirate gang was associated with the Invids. He was, after the "Ghost Jedi," the most hated being on Courkrus.
Dracmus was a female Selonian and a member of the Hunchuzuc Den living on Corellia. As with all Selonians, she was bred for a single task, which in her case was negotiating with alien races.

Lord Mirdalan, affectionately called Mird or Mird'ika, was a pet strill belonging to Walon Vau. Mird was often referred to as "it" in conversation and in writings, which was considered acceptable given strills simultaneously possessed multiple types of reproductive organs.
Dar Keyis was a Human male from the planet Churba who served as a member of the New Republic Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War.
Standro Jcir was a Rodian male from Rodia who served as an X-wing starfighter pilot with the New Republic Defense Force during the Galactic Civil War.
Grania was a young platinum blonde Human female from Brentaal IV who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Yotts Orren was a Kadas'sa'Nikto guard who often worked onboard Jabba's sail barge, Khetanna. During the Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon, he rode on the second Bantha-II cargo skiff.
Gaddatha In'Kro was a male Caamasi who served as a Republic diplomat during the Clone Wars.

Karia Ver Seryan was a life-bearer from Leria Kerlsil who nearly married Lando Calrissian. A life-bearer was a woman born with the mystical ability to prolong the life of an elderly or terminally ill man by linking her life essence to his in a marriage pact that doubled as a b…
Telsij Cayr was a blonde, blue-eyed Human woman who became a Y-wing pilot for the New Republic Defense Force shortly before the Battle of Brentaal IV.
Sam Snootles, a Pa'lowick, was seen on his way to a business for his day at work on Coruscant. He carried a briefcase and wore a tie. He shared his surname with fellow Pa'lowick Singer Sy Snootles.

O'nja Rambolt was a male Gran who lived on Malastare during the waning years of the Republic. In 32 BBY, he believed that he could escape his massive financial debts by gaining a life sentence on the Oovo IV prison.

Byhdee Kees was a male Gran who was active during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by the Coruscant Police for questioning, relating to the smuggling of death sticks on Malastare. He had known connections to the RavinsBlud Crime Syndicate.

Machar Heng was a member of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. A Subaltern, he was charged by Warmaster Tsavong Lah to coordinate the Yuuzhan Vong's efforts with the Peace Brigade to locate the Jedi. Heng was granted a small flotilla in his task.

Vob Bitas was a gambler and the owner of Blob 14, an Umgullian blob. Bitas enhanced Blob 14's viscosity with the aid of illegal substances and, in 22 BBY, entered the blob in the third blob race at the Fondine Blob Raceways on the planet Umgul.
Kavil was a pirate who led the Kavil's Corsairs pirate group. He was a Human male with blue eyes, balding brown hair, and a heavily-scarred face.
Erk H'Arman was a pilot and lieutenant in the Praesitlyn Defense Force. During the Clone Wars he flew T-19 starfighters for the Praesitlyn Defense Force with his wingman, Ensign Pleth Strom.

9779 was an adolescent clone trooper in training from Generation Five Thousand. While on the planet Aargau 9779 lost his way from his ship. He and Boba Fett met when 9779 returned the misplaced journal of Boba's father.
Aarn was a male Shamed One living on Coruscant after the Yuuzhan Vong had conquered
Qe'u was a Shamed One sent to Yavin 4 after the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the small moon. When Vua Rapuung faked his death and disappeared, Qe'u was given his trawling duties and his vangaak.

Chidee Na Maak was a male Duros mechanic, starshipwright, and proprietor of the StarForge Shipyard that he inherited after his parents had been killed in an accidental fuel explosion. He was a friend of Han Solo's and was always trying to acquire Chewbacca as an employee.

Rayt was a male Human smuggler who resembled like a shorter, fatter Han Solo. He lived and worked on StarForge Station and had a Verpine copilot. Six months after the Battle of Endor he was responsible for shipping Tycho Celchu and Winter from Eiattu 6 to Leonia Tavira.
Kotaa Zun-qin was a member of the Shaper caste of the Yuuzhan Vong.
Fazak Tsun was a male Yuuzhan Vong who served as a member of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong empire. He underwent a simple Escalatier Ceremony under Master Shaper Ch'Gang Hool.
Director Lenzer was the head of research for Imperial Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's TIE Experimental Project.
Raala Ponchar was a female Human spy for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Lon Donell was human male pirate who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy before the Battle of Endor.
Gwen Habbert was a starfighter pilot who served with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

affiliation: The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania
x: Vandrayk and Jarael rarely left their home until 3964 BBY, when an underworld acquaintance of Vandrayk's, a Snivvian criminal named Marn Hierogryph, showed up at The Last Resort with the most wanted man on Taris in tow: Zayne Carrick, a former Jedi Padawan falsely accused in t…

Lorz Geptun was a Balawai Human colonel during the Clone Wars in the Pelek Baw militia, and, by extension, the army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, with which his homeworld of Haruun Kal was aligned.

Cerasi was a Human female who was one of the leaders of the Young, a youth organization that brought a halt to the civil war between the Melida and the Daan on the planet Melida/Daan. Her father was Wehutti, a Melida leader.

Nield was a Human male who was one of the teenage leaders of the Young, a youth organization that halted the civil war between the Melida and the Daan on the planet Melida/Daan. Nield was a strict leader, primarily in the way he disciplined the other children.

Aemont Sillib was a Muun that served the InterGalactic Banking Clan as a loan officer during the early years of the New Order. He worked diligently to change his position in the social and economic hierarchy of Muunilinst.

Zlece Oonaar was a male Human who served as an officer in the Imperial Navy. During the Galactic Civil War he was captain of the Victory-class Star Destroyer Crusader, partaking the Battle of Khuiumin.

Cody Sunn-Childe was a male Jashwik freedom fighter of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who disappeared for many years after dedicating himself to a pacifist way of life. Sunn-Childe was one of Senator Mon Mothma's earliest supporters.

Nardix was male Imperial Sector governor who was captured by the bounty hunters Zuckuss and 4-LOM during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the two turned him over to the Rebel Alliance, who tried and convicted Nardix for "crimes against Humanity".
Gukandar Huath was a Warleader of the Yuuzhan Vong. He was noteworthy in his religious views: he cared only for Yun-Yammka, and was indifferent toward Yun-Yuuzhan.

Reina Faleur was a female Human from Chandrila who held the rank of lieutenant under the New Republic Defense Fleet's Quartermaster Corps. Several months after the Battle of Endor, Faleur was tasked with supplying Rogue Squadron the equipment it needed.
Brothic was the Imperial governor of Ciutric IV.
X14 was the code name of a New Republic Intelligence Service agent in Kapp Dendo's Commando Team One who served on Ciutric IV just prior to the evacuation of Ciutric.
Vaartsoon was a commando for Imperial Intelligence. He was sent to Ciutric with several commando squads by Ysanne Isard to either capture or kill Sate Pestage.

Plumba was a male Human who sat on the Imperial Ruling Council until 5 ABY. He was a member of the Cabal during Sate Pestage's reign, and later was one of the three Tribunes, along with General Paltr Carvin and Challer.
Challer was a male Human who sat on the Imperial Ruling Council until 5 ABY.

gender: Listed as "Unknown" by Alliance Intelligence, frequently referred to a
x: "Eyes" was a Force-sensitive information broker who operated during the reign of the Galactic Empire. A member of an unknown alien species, Eyes wound up at some point on the planet Camden in the Outer Rim Territories, observing activities in the "Snakes' Den" spaceport and bu…
Ansible Beelyard was a Human male who was a well-known hero of the Rebel Alliance during the early days of the Galactic Civil War.

Aarno Dering was a tall humanoid male who served as a sports "timing" official for the swoop obstacle race during the Galactic Games on Euceron during the Separatist Crisis. The information dealer Fligh gave Dering the false alias "Quentor," in order to protect him.

Cheriss ke Hanadi was a Human female from Adumar and the Cartann Ground Champion in the sport of blastsword-dueling. She served as Red Flight's (Wedge Antilles, Tycho Celchu, Wes Janson, and Derek Klivian) guide during their time on Adumar.

Jarael, born Edessa, was a female Arkanian Offshoot. She always was hot-tempered with eyes and hands like Humans and pointed ears, bearing tattoos that were known as the Flames of the Crucible bearing the name "Jarael" in the ancient language of the Crucible, meaning "protecto…
After the loss of many skilled Imperial pilots during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Ryad gave up her political career to become a pilot.
Later, between the Earth-years 1942 and 1943, Jones embarked on an expedition to find the legendary "Sasquatch" in a jungle on behalf of a museum.

"Short Round," also known as "Shorty," was the Human companion of Doctor Indiana Jones. 126 years after the YT-1300 light freighter Millennium Falcon crash-landed on the planet Earth, Short Round and Jones undertook an expedition to the starship's ruins in search of the "Sasqu…
Themion Hejaran was a member of the Hejaran family of House Mecetti (Tapani sector). He was the younger brother of Baron Lucian Hejaran, cousin of Lady Brigta Hejaran and nephew of Galemus Hejaran.
Myrial was a female Argazdan who served as the Provisional Governor of Argazda and the leader of a secessionist Vianist religious sect named after her during the Old Sith Wars.
Colonel Raibat was a knight of House Reena of the Tapani sector and an Imperial Army officer. He was described by many as a thick-necked bull of a man and was a strong supporter of the New Order.
Vo Lian was a Yuuzhan Vong warrior who served under Commander Tsaak Vootuh in the second year of the Yuuzhan Vong invasion as a subaltern.

Tar Monevv was a Yuuzhan Vong male born aboard a Koros-Strohna Worldship, and a member of the warrior caste. Holding the rank of commander, Monevv was an advance agent sent to destabilize enemy governments in advance for the Yuuzhan Vong to better conquer.

Laait was a Supreme Commander of the Yuuzhan Vong in 29 ABY. During the Battle of Yuuzhan'tar, Warmaster Nas Choka relayed to Supreme Commander Laait that the flotilla he sent to Zonama Sekot had encountered living vessels, and instructed Laait to inform Supreme Overlord Shimrra.
Rolex was the Sergeant-at-Arms for the Bank of Aargau Security Planetary Customs Security Checkpoint LH48 during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Darth Vader's porter was in reality an assassin who together with two others accompanied Darth Vader to Aargau on a mission to kill Viscount Tardi, the Minister of Finance of the Rebel Alliance.
Benno was a leader in the Black Vulkars swoop gang on the planet Taris' Lower City during the Mandalorian Wars.
Sir Ajax Wennel was a Knight of House Cadriaan of the Tapani sector. He was a dynamic noble and a saber rake with an anti-Galactic Empire attitude.

Sir Trevas Jotane was a handsome man with blond hair who was in his late twenties when he attended the Unification Gala held prior to the Battle of Endor. He appeared to be a Knight of House Calipsa but was in fact an ISB agent.
Torino Kyber was a member of the Kyber Royal Family and the son of the King Natas.

Sev Buzk was the commander of the small Imperial garrison on the Outer Rim world of Troska. He tricked the locals into thinking the Empire was on the verge of full scale occupation, enabling him to extort them.

Kelmont was an officer of the small Imperial garrison on Troska, and a close friend of then Lieutenant Manech; however he was unaware that Manech was attempting to expose their commanding officer, Sev Buzk, for his abuse of power.

Treyz Manech was a male Human Imperial commander serving on the Outer Rim Territories world of Troska. Originally a lieutenant, Manech was removed from duty aboard an Imperial-class Star Destroyer after an attempt to commandeer the ship.
Sien Siev was a member of the New Republic High Council in 19 ABY. Siev was also a historical expert, and had an extensive knowledge of the history of the Galactic Empire.
Brixus Aldine was a male Human who served as a Guard Captain for House Melantha. The soldiers under his command were known as the Aldine Brigade.

Janna Pallask was a female Human who served as an undercover agent for House Pelagia and was an associate of Pellas Agri ("Coros Telari"). She was involved in attempts to recover a file that would potentially reveal House Mecetti's involvement in anti-Imperial activities.

Tazur Pheron was a fiercely loyal Mecetti Knight. He was the grand-nephew of Lord Leobund, the High Lord of Mecetti during the Imperial Period. He was a danger seeker who spent most of his time engaging in extreme sports or dueling.

Zraii was a Verpine who was in charge of repairs and maintenance for Rogue Squadron's fleet of X-wings, as well as other Alliance ships. He also mind wiped and upgraded Wedge Antilles' droid, R5-D2 (commonly known as Mynock), turning it into an R5-G8 named Gate.
Amie Antin was a female Human who lived on Bellassa as a doctor during the first few years of the Empire's existence. She was also the mother of Adem Antin.
Arikakon Baraka was a male Mon Calamari Admiral from Dac who served in the Galactic Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.

Lido Shan was a female humanoid technician who worked for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, she was stationed on Coruscant for most of the war, but served in the Battle of Ord Cestus.
Trillot was an X'Ting from Ord Cestus who had been an employee of Cestus Cybernetics until he began his criminal ascent for the local Tenloss Syndicate during the Clone Wars.

Fizzik was a male X'Ting from Ord Cestus. who served as the broodmate of gang leader Trillot, who later became leader of Cestus Cybernetics. Prior to the Clone Wars, Trillot ordered Fizzik to escort Asajj Ventress through the warrens.

Resta Shug Hai was a female X'Ting from Ord Cestus who was the last living member of her clan and also a terrorist group known as Desert Wind, which opposed the Five Families of the planet. As a farmer, she and her husband worked the land near Kibo Lake.

Thak Val Zsing was a red-bearded Human male from Ord Cestus. His great-grandfather had been a murderer sent to that world. He was originally a history professor until he lost his job in a government cut of social programs. He was then forced to become a miner.

Brother Nicos Fate was a male X'Ting from Ord Cestus where he was descended from 500 years of hive healers. A loyal supporter to the Galactic Republic, he participated in the Mission to Ord Cestus where he assisted in healing wounded clone troopers and later killed.

Skot OnSon was a Human male from Ord Cestus who served as the youngest member of the terrorist group known as Desert Wind. He was tall and thin, with long blond hair and a crescent-shaped scar on his forehead.
Grakko was a male Quarren mercenary who worked for the Falleen crime lord Zenex on the Wheel space station.
Zenex was a male Falleen who worked as a crime lord on The Wheel space station, and was secretly in league with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Yperio Baobab was a male Human from Manda. A droid programmer by trade, he was considered to be the father of modern-day droidspeak by New Republic standards.

Fenig Nabon, called "Fen" by friends, was a Human female smuggler and part-time con artist, likely hailing from Corellia. Nabon's partner was a Coruscanti woman named Ghitsa Dogder, and together they owned a ship called the Star Lady.

Pellas Agri was a male Human House Pelagia deep cover operative and associate of Janna Pallask. He used the alias "Coros Telari" while on assignment. When he was young his father was unjustly imprisoned on the orders of a House Mecetti nobleman and subsequently died in custody.
Trel Modetto was an outlaw tech/smuggler native to the Tapani sector. He spent many years traveling around the Outer Rim Territories with the Void Demons pirate gang.

Zyix K'zzt was a Human male born into a family loyal to the Galactic Empire. While growing up he quickly learned obedience and how to serve the Empire, studying long and hard to please his parents as well as his teachers.
Koobis "Target" Nu was a young Rodian male who flew as Rogue Eight in Rogue Squadron during the campaign against Warlord Zsinj.
Khe-Jeen Slee was an Issori male who replaced Koobis Nu as Rogue Eight in Rogue Squadron. He was born of a Whoon-cha, or inter-noble bond.

Stormtrooper Colonel TC-1289 was one of many stormtroopers produced for the Galactic Empire by Zyix K'zzt in a clone vat who would have simply become one of many normal, mindless drones if not for the fact that K'zzt was discovered to be a secret member of the Rebel Alliance b…
Zaletta was a Human male who served as a high ranking commander in the Imperial Military until he later defected to the Rebel Alliance, attaining his rank during the Galactic Civil War.

Pleth Strom was a Human male Ensign pilot who served the Galactic Republic and the Praesitlyn Defense Force during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he flew a T-19 starfighter alongside Erk H'Arman when the Confederacy of Independent Systems invaded Praesitlyn.
Valsi Nocurja was a systems analyst working in the Jrade District of Coruscant. This individual was unhappy with the rise in recharge rates.
Kupalo was a Human male Rebel tactical officer who was captured during the Battle of Hoth and brainwashed into becoming an Imperial double agent.

The Sullustan con artist, Dugo Bagy was solicited for information about Lando Calrissian's operations by Han Solo and Chewbacca while at Riebold's Foam and Sizzle. Bagy stated that Calrissian was mining platinum on Kerane's Folly, an asteroid in the Hoth system.

Once the mayor of Redhaven, Tamaktis Breetha quickly became a member of an independent senate on Rhommamool run by Nom Anor. He, along with Shok Tinoktin escorted Leia Organa and Jaina Solo, Mara Jade, and C-3PO to a meeting with the costumed Nom Anor.

Rorr'hn of Drgi, who shared their name with the Drgi system of the Expansion Region's Tokamac sector, served as a Jedi Knight at some point after 1 BBY and piloted an X-wing starfighter, a type of fighter used by the Rebel Alliance and its successor organizations.
Hepmaga MiOrd was a male of an sentient species who lived on Gamorr. He belonged to a rogue offshoot of a Remplish clan whose ancestors had been cast off Sullust many years prior during a holy war.
Amara was a Human male Senator of the New Republic. He had many enemies, including Black Sun, who once tried to kidnap his son.

Boddu Bocck was a bounty hunter, wanted for crimes against the New Republic. He had a reddish beard and long hair, and he often dressed in camouflage outfits suited for the terrain his particular jobs would require. He also wore a blast vest for added protection.
Alek Ben-Faris was a Human male during the Clone Wars. He was one of House Pelagia's greatest diplomats and advisers during the Clone Wars. He was a native of the Core World of Brentaal.

Jeigh Esse was a female Stellan who was cast off-world at an early age when it was discovered that she had an aggressive temperament. She later became a bounty hunter after having been raised by a group of Rodians.

Tarron Neb was a member of a species that hailed from the mountainous moon Yavin 8, located within the Yavin system. When Emperor Palpatine of the Galactic Empire became disgusted by the Yavin 8 natives, he ordered their destruction.

The individual known as Wikyochee belonged to a vaguely humanoid species. Ten years of age, he was in possession of an angry machine, which allowed him to calm his turbulent demeanor, and resort to a more placid temper.

Brock Lar was once a high-ranking warrior on his homeworld of Gryphon, a planet continually embroiled in clan wars. When his youngest son died, Lar left Gryphon, realizing that the planet could never attain peace.
Although no one was able to prove it, Mother was a former smuggler who retired from smuggling when the Imperials made the business less cost-effective.
Garox Tronten was the producer of the popular Eriaduan talk show, Essence.

Chog was an alien clothing designer on Coruscant who used mathematics to tailor each piece of clothing to a client. He designed one of the many dresses for Mara Jade's wedding, but it was one of the many that were rejected by the bride-to-be.

Astraal Vao was a Rutian Twi'lek female who was born before 126 ABY. When she was a young child, she and her twin brother, Shado, were traveling in their parents' starship when it crashed onto the surface of the planet Vendaxa.

Jariah Syn was a male Human bounty hunter who was the son of Zareb Syn and a co-pilot of the starship Mynock, the crew of which also included his friends Deliah Blue and Cade Skywalker during the time of the Second Imperial Civil War against Darth Krayt and the One Sith.

A child lived in the slums of Coruscant in 27 BBY. Spiz's hoodlums chased the child with intent to kill for no apparent reason, calling their victim "brat" until they were scared off by a rancor illusion created by Jedi Master Yarael Poof.
Spiz was a young Human male. He was the leader of Spiz's hoodlums, a gang of young miscreants who terrorized the slums of Coruscant prior to the Clone Wars.
Mawkran was a Mantellian Savrip leader on Ord Mantell in 37 BBY.
