Buck was a Green Forge ecoterrorist. A muscular opportunist, he would have affairs with wealthy women and use them to achieve his Green Forge ends.

Saul Moegantz was a criminal gangster. After his rival Clode Rhoden tried to kill his wife in an elaborate insurance scam, she joined forces with Moegantz and planned to sue Clode for divorce and then split Clode's wealth.
Galidon Okanor was a Human male art appraiser and fence who lived on Corellia. He liked to haggle, but was willing to pay high prices.
Dame Needa was an employee of Gardulla Oola hotel and casino in Mos Eisley and Tatooine. She gained notoriety for impersonating the deceased dancer Oola.
Annah Dublavviane was a scatterbrained female Jediboh Opera actress, part of the Tantrellius Theatre Groupe, and was the grand dame of Two Jedi Men From Baronis.

Atril Tabanne of Coruscant was a Human female officer in the New Republic Defense Fleet. She was a graduate of the Imperial Academy, and was a TIE/LN starfighter pilot before defecting to the Rebel Alliance.

CT-8770 was a clone trooper who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Like the rest of their brethren, CT-8770 was a clone of the tan-skinned 1.83 meter–tall Human male bounty hunter Jango Fett, and was born and raised on the planet Kamino to fight in the Grand A…
Bow was the name of a clone stormtrooper who served as a commander within the Galactic Empire's 501st Legion.
Eight-eight-six-eight was a clone trooper that served as part of the 212 Attack Battalion's "A" Squad during the Battle of Sarrish.

CT-8910 was one of many clones of the Human male bounty hunter Jango Fett created on the planet Kamino to fight in the Grand Army of the Republic. Like Fett, CT-8910 stood 1.83 meters tall and had tan skin.

CT-3423 was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He was part of the 91st Reconnaissance Corps under Clone Commander Neyo during the Siege of Saleucami in 19 BBY.

Nammo was a male Mon Calamari admiral who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, he commanded the MC80 Cruiser Defiance and her task force during the time of the Battle of Hoth.
Gorak Khzam was a Rodian male who was once a member of the Sabiador Slavers. In 8 ABY, he became the security officer, and later first officer, of the FarStar.
Darryn Thyte was a Human male who served as a lieutenant with the New Republic, and as the bridge operations officer aboard the FarStar.
Jessa Dajus was a Force-sensitive Human Female Imperial tactical officer, and later a member of the crew of the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar.

Zanthe Nadia was the leader of the Rebel Alliance cell called the Pelagia Freedom Force that operated in the Tapani sector of the Colonies. She was a native of the planet Pelagon in the Pelagia Province, and was devastated by the Imperial attack on her homeworld.
Andray was a male individual who served as Moff of one of the Imperial Remnant's remaining eight sectors in the Outer Rim near the end of the Galactic Civil War.

Bemos was a Moff on the Imperial Remnant's Moff Council. In 19 ABY, he attended a meeting with the Council and Imperial Supreme Commander Gilad Pellaeon on the Outer Rim Territories Imperial capital planet Bastion.

Hort was a Moff on the Imperial Remnant's Moff Council who was in charge of a sector in 19 ABY. That year, he attended a meeting with the other Moffs and Supreme Commander Gilad Pellaeon on the Outer Rim Territories Imperial capital planet Bastion.

Quillan was a Moff on the Council of Moffs in 19 ABY. He was one of the most vehement opponents of Pellaeon's suggestion for negotiated peace with the New Republic, going so far as to say that Pellaeon had no business running the military.

Sander was a Moff on the Council of Moffs in 19 ABY. He was a realist, acknowledging both that some systems in his sector would leave the Imperial Remnant if given the choice and that Pellaeon was right about the need to negotiate peace while they could.
Vered was a Moff on the Council of Moffs in 19 ABY. He met with the other council members on Bastion to discuss Admiral Pellaeon's proposed peace treaty with the New Republic.

Deliah Blue was a female Zeltron chief mechanic of the Mynock and a longtime companion of Cade Skywalker and Jariah Syn during their careers as bounty hunters in the wake Sith–Imperial War and the Second Imperial Civil War.

Darth Talon was a female Lethan Twi'lek who became a Sith Lady in Darth Krayt's One Sith in 137 ABY. Talon was styled with black Sith tattoos covering her body including her head and lekku; each tattoo had been earned in ritual combat and inscribed by Krayt himself.

Rkk'Tl'Kt was a Tusken Raider in the warband led by Sharad Hett. During A'Sharad Hett's initiation rite, Rkk'Tl'Kt's hand was bitten off by a canyon krayt dragon female. Unable to wield a gaffi stick one-handed, Rkk'Tl'Kt chose suicide.
Nugtosh was a male alien individual who was known to preside over podraces on Malastare, including the Vinta Harvest Classic in 32 BBY.
Londrah was a male Defel assassin who used his species' natural ability at stealth to infiltrate heavily secured facilities.
Wermyn was an Aquellan in charge of plant operations and keeping the Maw Installation up-and-running. One-handed, he wore the traditional green-purple tattoos found on all Aquellan men.
Golanda was a female Human who led the artillery innovations and tactical deployment at the Maw Installation.
Melchi was a Herglic spacer native to the Tapani sector, captain of the medical frigate Benevolence and agent of House Pelagia.

Yunabana was a male Gungan pilot who lived during the time when the Galactic Republic was reorganized into the Galactic Empire. In 18 BBY, he rescued Ferus Olin, Trever Flume, and Solace after their encounter with Inquisitor Malorum at Ryoo Thule's home.

Tav Kennede was the son of Ved Kennede, the head training instructor for the Emperor's Royal Guard. In 11 ABY, Kennede's father, along with many other Royal Guardsmen, was killed on Yinchorr by stormtroopers under the command of Carnor Jax, a rogue Guardsman who participated i…
Gar Gastinin was a Duros spacer who was a known associate of Vilmarh Grahrk. He frequented the Cluster cantina on Nar Shaddaa, where he drank with Vletho, Keluda, a Kubaz, and a Trandoshan.
Keluda was a male Dug spacer who served as a known associate to Vilmarh Grahrk.

Vletho was a Rodian spacer, and a debtor of Vilmarh Grahrk. He did not speak Basic. Vletho made several unsuccessful attempts at ending Grahrk's life at the Cluster Cantina on Nar Shaddaa. He frequently drank there with Gar Gastinin, Keluda, a Kubaz, and a Trandoshan.

Gzin was the four-armed Shipyard Master of the Golden Nyss Shipyards during the final decade of the Galactic Republic. In 33 BBY, the smuggler Vilmarh Grahrk incited the reptilian species known as the Yinchorri to launch an aggressive expansion beyond their system.

Loh'khar the Finder was a Twi'lek free-trader and procurement specialist. He was a member of the crew of the FarStar during its hunt for Moff Kentor Sarne. He had the uncanny ability to source virtually any item needed in a matter of minutes to a few hours, depending on the item.
Kl'aal was a Defel criminal who served as a forward scout and later security officer on the FarStar during the search for Moff Kentor Sarne.

Jowdrrl was a female Wookiee mechanic and ship systems engineer from the planet Kashyyyk. She grew up on the Wookiee homeworld with her extended family, which included her cousins Chewbacca, Kallabow, and Shoran, as well as with her friend Mallatobuck.

Urgah, also known as Urgah Lady Gorneesh, was the queen of a tribe of Duloks on the Forest Moon of Endor. She was the mate of the tribe's leader, King Gorneesh, and the mother of several children, including Prince Boogutt.
Jek Nkik was the male Jawa relative of Het Nkik. He was killed by sandtroopers.
Cel was a female Human Lieutenant and a communications officer of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and Defense Force.

Umwak was a Dulok shaman from the Forest Moon of Endor. Serving as the religious leader of the Dulok band ruled by King Gorneesh, he sometimes had dealings with the Dulok oracle Murgoob, and Morag, the Tulgah witch.
Palestro was a small time businessman that owned Palestro's Wholesale Firearms. He was a member of the Rebel cell on Wroona, and was known among Rebel agents as a friendly supplier of weapons.
Argon was a male Imperial Grand Moff during the Galactic Civil War. He was conned out of 25,000 credits by the Tonnika sisters and vowed to track them down no matter where they hid in the galaxy.
Big Jak Targrim was the male pirate chief of the Riders of the Maelstrom. He was an extremely large humanoid with four arms.
Rodin Higron was a male Corellian gambler-turned-pirate who operated during the Galactic Civil War. His base of operations was located on the Oasis mining colony, in The Maelstrom.
Murgoob, also known as the Great Murgoob and Murgoob the Cranky, was the oracle for King Gorneesh's tribe of Duloks on the Forest Moon of Endor. By 3 ABY, Murgoob had lived for more than 600 seasons.

Osted Alater was an officer in the Imperial Navy and captain of the Crusader's Shield. In the early days of the Galactic Empire, Alater was sent by Governor Paro Lanto to investigate the dealings of Planetary Safaris Inc., a business that specialized in providing challenging h…

Paro Lanto was a Sector Governor under Imperial rule. Lanto sent Captain Osted Alater to investigate Planetary Safaris Inc.'s claim that the Barabels were a violent and dangerous species that needed to be eliminated under the Dangerous Species Act.

Shaka-ka was a Barabel who led her people in raids against the Planetary Safaris Inc. hunting parties. The company had organized hunting expeditions of Barabels on the planet. To counteract this atrocity, the Barabels under Shaka-ka began to decimate the hunting parties.
King Natas Kyber was the ruler of the Imperial backwater world of Troska.
Grania was a Singing Mountain Clan sister from the planet Dathomir and friend of Teneniel Djo who turned to the dark side and joined the Nightsisters.
Vila was a female Human from Naldar who was the planet's Princess during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Darth Krayt, born A'Sharad Hett, revered as the Dragon of the Sith, and known to some members of the Skywalker family as the Dark Man, was a long-lived Force-sensitive Human male who served as both a Jedi Master and general in the waning days of the Galactic Republic and as Da…

Prall was a Hutt who was the head of PharmCorp, a successful business on the planet Nubia. Prall also owned the Nubian Palace, a well known and luxurious resort on the planet. However, these businesses were cover for his crime empire.
Kenn Nitram was a young X-wing pilot recruited by Wedge Antilles.

"Captain Cautious" was the nickname given to the captain of a Galactic Republic freighter which made routine freight jobs for the Jedi High Council. He was known for being indecisive when it came to important decisions, but a stickler for detail.

Vannix was experiencing a power vacuum after the previous Presider, Sakins, fled the planet with his family, mistresses, and most of the treasury. An election was held to fill the vacant position, between Admiral Werl and Vannix's Senate representative, Addath Gadan.
Akanseh was a male Mon Calamari doctor from the planet Dac. A philanthropist and accomplished surgeon, he wanted to use his skills to take medical care to the backwater worlds of the galaxy.
Brophar Tofarain was a civilian mechanic who joined the crew of the FarStar during the hunt for Moff Kentor Sarne.

Milar Travis was a Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot during the Galactic Civil War. By 0 BBY, Travis, alongside fellow Rebel pilots Fin Danglot and Keyan Farlander, was mentored by the pilot Puck Naeco.
Devish was a male Human lieutenant of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War.

Squeak was a Tintinna (Tin-Tin Dwarf) messenger who worked for Big Bunji. On the day that Han Solo and Chewbacca were to transport Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi to Alderaan, Squeak met the smuggler in Mos Eisley to offer him a cargo of chak-root.

CT-57/11-9048 was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Galactic Republic's 127th Gunship Wing during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, they fought on the planet Cato Neimoidia, flying an ARC-170 starfighter.

Bozzie was an Ewok from the forest moon of Endor. She was the sister or sister-in-law of Chief Chirpa, mother of Paploo and the aunt of Princess Kneesaa and Asha. She had a matronly manner, but at times, she could be bossy and domineering.

Rulan Prolik was a polymorphic being who, by 3956 BBY, was an Overseer of the secretive assassin guild known as the GenoHaradan. Another Overseer, the Rodian Hulas, plotted to kill him and other Overseers, which would make him the de facto leader of the GenoHaradan.
Bruiser was a Human male criminal who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Sothek was a male Yinchorri who served as a member of the Council of Elders during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 33 BBY, he and his fellow Councilors were persuaded by Vilmarh Grahrk to raid the Golden Nyss Shipyards.
Kardek was one of the Yinchorri Council of Elders. He first proposed a marital alliance between Vilmarh Grahrk and the Yinchorri, specifically his daughter Vooma.
A female Yinchorri, Vooma was the daughter of Elder Kardek and one of the five brides of Olmar Grahrk.
Jorek was a male Yinchorri and a member of the Council of Elders in 33 BBY. He, along with his fellow councilors, was convinced by Vilmarh Grahrk to raid the Golden Nyss Shipyards.

Fluffy was—allegedly—Vilmarh Grahrk's female pet stalking onsonker, to which he fed Bobo after he failed to produce the "Secret Treasure of the Jedi." Grahrk supposedly planted Fluffy's seeds inside Bobo so that the onsonker could hunt him down and devour him.

Morgot was a red-skinned Skrilling friend of the Kiffar Jedi Quinlan Vos. Morgot was a ready source of information for Vos and was a notoriously bad gambler who often got into trouble covering his debts.

Nastyboy was a Human male thug on Ord Mantell. He was beating up Morgot, who owed him money, when Aayla Secura and Quinlan Vos arrived seeking Morgot. Aayla used a mind trick, persuading Nastyboy to go home.
Hamar-Chaktak was a Herglic merchant based in the Freeworlds Territory of the Tapani sector who owned the Cargo Consolidated, Incorporated shipping company.
Valka was a Vaathkree employed as a henchman by the Herglic merchant, Hamar-Chaktak.
Kasdakh Bhul was a member of the Yuuzhan Vong Warrior caste and Czulkang Lah's second-in-command aboard his worldship at the Battle of Borleias.
Penzak Kraal was a Yuuzhan Vong warrior who, along with the other members of Domain Kraal, was assigned to guard over the captured world of Borleias during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Kelbo was a M'shento'su'Nikto who frequented Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina. He and his friend Zutmore often borrowed credits from Ackmena.
Gotspar was a Herglic who worked as a bartender at the Green Mist Tavern on Lamuir IV. For the right price he was also an information broker.

Narloch, also known as Narloch of Giju, was a Herglic entrepreneur and gambler from Giju. He was known to own a casino on the planet Emmer, and was rumored to also have a stake in others on other worlds.

Widdle Warrick, also known as Willy, was a reckless young Ewok hunter from Bright Tree Village on the moon Endor. Widdle was the brother of Winda, Weechee, and Wicket W. Warrick, and the son of Deej and a female Ewok.
Zut was a male Phlog who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. He was the mate of Dobah and the father of Hoom and Nahkee.
Dobah was a female Phlog who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. She was the mate of Zut and the mother of Hoom and Nahkee.
Hoom was a Phlog male on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, his little brother Nahkee was kidnapped. He and his parents, Zut and Dobah, found evidence—planted by the witch Morag—of Ewok involvement.
Hue was a male Phlog who served before the Clone Wars as the bodyguard of Jenna Zan Arbor while she was on the planet Romin.
Hoona was a female Phlog from the Forest Moon of Endor. She was an adolescent just prior to the Battle of Yavin.

Mring-Mring was the king of the Gupins on the Forest Moon of Endor. Born sometime before the Battle of Yavin, he was the brother of Oobel and the cousin of Punt. Unlike most Gupins, Mring-Mring was born without wings.
Oobel was a Gupin from the Forest Moon of Endor. He was the brother of Mring-Mring and the cousin of Punt.
Punt was the king of the Gupins of the Forest Moon of Endor. He was the cousin of Mring-Mring and Oobel. He cast out Mring-Mring for being wingless.

Bondo was the leader of the Travelling Jindas, a nomadic tribe of Jindas on the Forest Moon of Endor. The overweight Jinda wore a red tunic and much jewelry. Bondo was a jovial leader, although he frequently got his tribe lost in the forests of Endor.

Chituhr was a member of the Travelling Jindas on the Forest Moon of Endor. He served as the tribe's animal trainer. He was large, well-muscled, and frightening in appearance. He wore his fur in a pom-pom atop his head and sported a blue jumpsuit.

Kina Margath was a Human female who resided on the planet Elshandruu Pica. A businesswoman, she managed Margath's on Elshandruu Pica, a complex of hotels, bars, and casinos—including the famous 27th Hour Social Club—with a galaxy-wide reputation for excellence.

Mariana was a native of Bellassa who owned and operated a custom tailoring shop known as Mariana's Exquisite Designs and Alterations, during the last years of the Galactic Republic and the rise of the Galactic Empire.
Deela was a woman captured by the Galactic Empire, alongside her husband and daughter, during the invasion of her home planet, nine months after the Battle of Yavin.

Tepar was a girl who was captured alongside her father and mother, during the invasion of her home planet by the Galactic Empire in the Galactic Civil War. This occurred about nine months after the Battle of Yavin.
Marlo was a female Twi'lek who was an acquaintance of Geredi in 3951 BBY.
Udo Broxin was a Herglic who was a regular at the entertainment and gambling establishment known as the Ace of Sabres on the planet Kluistar.

Yrrcanna was a black furred Wookiee who participated in fights in the Dool Arena of the The Broken Tusk on Reuss VIII. He was a former Imperial slave who retained a moody and violent nature following his freedom.
Bahm Gilyad was a doctor who lived during the Great Hyperspace War fought between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Kaylo NaKuda was a male Herglic businessman who owned the Kuda's Compound, a large garage and vehicle dealership that specialized in modifying and repairing swoops. He also oversaw the day-to-day operations of the cantina located on Stend VI called The Pits.

Seed Machees was a male Gran who worked for Sebolto during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Coruscant Police for questioning, as well as being involved in the smuggling of death sticks on Malastare shortly after the Uprising on Naboo.
Neeko Payvees was a male Gran who had a bounty placed on his head by an unknown individual, who referred to him as "worthless scum".

Iseeya Yado was a younger brother to the Yad sisters. He was a pilot and a musician in their smuggling operations. He was wanted by Coruscant Police for these smuggling operations and his bounty was claimed by Jango Fett.
Meeks Fees was wanted dead by Gorga the Hutt for betraying him. The bounty was worth 5,000 credits and it was claimed by Jango Fett.

Leekz Kleng was a male Gran who was affiliated with a number of freelance Gran hitmen by the year 22 BBY. By this time, a bounty had been placed on Kleng by an individual who considered the Gran a murderous thug.
Aycee Lameers was a famous Gran male death stick addict and smuggler who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, a bounty was placed on his head.

Reek Payvees was a male Gran who was targeted for death by an unknown individual for being a "worthless scum" during the waning years pof the Galactic Republic. His bounty, set for 5,000 credits, was collected by Jango Fett in 32 BBY.
Leek Onees was wanted by the Coruscant Police for questioning involving smuggling of death sticks.

Mawz Dakko was a male Gran from the planet Malastare, living during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he worked for the Dug crimelord Sebolto, and owed the Hutts a large sum of money for hijacking spice shipments.
Yan Vrees was a male Gran who lived on Hok during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

N'dru Suhlak was a hunt saboteur during the Bounty Hunter Wars and former Rebel. Despite being an accomplished pilot having learned from both Wes Janson and Jek Porkins, Suhlak was removed from the Tierfon Rebel Outpost for excessive insubordination and found work elsewhere fe…

Charat Kraal was a member of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. Unlike most of his species, his forehead was flat, like a human's. He was ridiculed for this, and eventually pulled out his hair to draw attention away from his forehead.

Palleus Chuff was a male actor during the reign of the Galactic Republic. Since childhood, his passion was pretending; specifically, pretending to be a hero. His small height, which was below one meter, forced him to portray dubious characters in his early acting career.
Arnod served the Galactic Empire's Navy as a TIE pilot during the Galactic Civil War fought between the Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Jord Dusat was a speeder racer in the early years of the Galactic Empire who, along with his friend and rival Thall Joben, came into the possession of the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 while they were separated from Raymus Antilles.
Larry was a three-eyed alien who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. In his childhood, Larry ran away from his home and became a hermit, living alone inside of a tree.
Vargi was a male Wookiee from Kashyyyk who was responsible for the capture and enslavement of many members of his species.

A Gungan diplomat held an official position in the government of the New Republic. The diplomat, an elderly Gungan belonging to the Otolla subspecies, enjoyed bringing pets from their homeworld of Naboo to Coruscant, capital of the Republic.

Utchakkaloch, more commonly known as Chakk, was a male Wookiee who was the son of Dewlannamapia and was also Han Solo's "adopted brother". Known as Chakk to his friends, this dark brown Wookiee met Han Solo at Chewbacca's wedding to Mallatobuck.
Rith Murisson was a young female from Krnay. She received Umgullian blob massage therapy on Umgul while there. Unfortunately, some of the blob's secretions left disfiguring marks on her back.

Handree Braman was an Ortolan chef whose restaurant, the CardSafe, was one of the most lauded on the planet Coruscant. They wrote one of the most famous cookbooks on the preparation of hawk-bats, non-sentient reptavians found on Coruscant.
Cha Niathal was a female Mon Calamari and senior Admiral of the Galactic Alliance Defense Force, serving as an advisor to Supreme Commander Gilad Pellaeon.
Siena Pavan was a Force-sensitive Human female who was the short-time wife of Lorn Pavan and mother to Jax Pavan.
G'Mai Duris was a female X'Ting Regent of Ord Cestus who lived during the Clone Wars. She was related to the original hive queen, but only tangentially.

Zomil was a male Defel assassin who retired to the Reuss system to become a fighter in the Dool Arena. He was powerful enough to be considered a top contender against the reigning champion Tull Raine.

Kimar Walc was a Arcona spokesperson in 22 BBY. That year, the cartel kingpin Lojrak Shrag, who dealt the drug salt on the planet Cona, was arrested by the Jedi Knights Tassida Judrelle, Quarmall, and Stass Allie.

Denn Walc was a male Arcona from Cona. He was the son of Grand Nest Leader, Kimar Walc. When it was time for him to select a mate, he interviewed fellow female Arconans. When he finally selected a mate, he went up to her nest with a crowd.

Nautag d'al' Gargan was the husband of Yarna d'al' Gargan. They had three children: Luka, Leia, and his namesake, Nautag. While raising their cubs in their home on Askaj, Nautag and his family were kidnapped and sold to Jabba the Hutt.
Leia d'al' Gargan was the daughter of Nautag and Yarna d'al' Gargan and sister of Luka d'al' Gargan and Nautag d'al' Gargan II. She was named after Leia Organa Solo.

Luka d'al' Gargan was the daughter of Nautag and Yarna d'al' Gargan, and sister of Leia d'al' Gargan and Nautag d'al' Gargan II. She was named after Luke Skywalker in honor of the fact that he was the ringleader of the Rebel team that overthrew and killed Jabba.

Rilla was a Human female who lived during the Clone Wars and became a resistance fighter and member of The Eleven during the formation of the Galactic Empire which was established by Emperor Palpatine.

Loran was a Human male who lived through the Clone Wars and into the Rise of the Empire era. He became a resistance fighter and member of The Eleven after Emperor Palpatine reorganized the Galactic Republic into his New Order.
Dona Telemark was a female Human who lived during the first years of the Galactic Empire.
Jyl Somtay was a female Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Looie was a Psadan and a member of the Crimson Nova chapter of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. He ran the Redemption Center prison on the Rig.

Raskar was a smuggler and pirate, formerly a member of the dreaded Pirates of Iridium. While most of his fellow bloodthirsty thieves had perished at the hands of the Jedi Knights immediately prior to the start of the Clone Wars, Raskar managed to survive with the galaxy's sole…

Rh'ajah Fenn was a male Twi'lek member of Clan Fenn. During the Clone Wars he was loyal to Dooku and an accomplice of his relative, Kh'aris Fenn. Kh'aris was murdered by Quinlan Vos seventeen months after the Battle of Geonosis when Vos disguised himself as Rh'ajah.

Spetbecca was a Wookiee who ran the Great Hoary Mastmot Trading Station on Toola shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. Spetbecca rescued a Human named Haaken Baranar after they were mauled by a snow demon.

J'aahn was a fair-skinned, male Human member of the Disciples of Ragnos, a cult attempting to revive the long-dead Sith Lord Marka Ragnos. He wore the uniform of his cult, a dark-red jumpsuit with knee high boots and a helmet with attached goggles.
Pekaelic ke Teldan was the Perator of Cartann, the largest and most powerful nation on Adumar, until 13 ABY.

Kentor Sarne was a male Human Moff who held control over the Kathol sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The Raptor, an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer, served under him, as did a special contingent of stormtroopers.
Narek-Ag was a female Human who was captain of the Moon Dash and by extension, in charge of the small-time shipping operation that the cargo shuttle comprised the backbone of.
Trebor was a male Human who served as Narek-Ag's copilot aboard the Moon Dash, a small cargo shuttle. They both made a living by ferrying supplies between planets and were also romantically involved.
Wyrpuuk Cha was a member of the warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong, who held the rank of commander during his species' invasion of the galaxy.

Wils was a male Human officer serving in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In 20 BBY, he was a deck chief onboard the Sundiver at the time of the Battle of Rendili. He was responsible for overseeing maintenance of the Azure Angel II.
DS-61-3, nicknamed "Backstabber," was a Corellian Imperial TIE pilot, known for his viciousness in combat, and Darth Vader's right wingman in Black Squadron.
Lady Agatha was a Tapani sector noble during the Galactic Civil War. She was a domineering social matriarch of an unknown noble house and she was said to run her manor like a stormtrooper.
Munsk was a noble of an unknown noble house of the Tapani sector. He was known to put on a good social event.
Boss Tosk was a crime lord and leader of the Jalk Syndicate during the Galactic Civil War. He was a Columi and as such had a large overdeveloped head with bulbous eyes and a diminutive body.
Batcheela was a female Ewok from Endor. She lived in Bright Tree Village with her husband, Warok, and their children, Teebo and Malani.

Rathe Camalon was a male member of the Noble House Cadriaan within the Tapani sector. By around the year 3 ABY, Camalon had come to hold the title of Baron, although he was looked down upon by some other members of the house due to his heritage.

Elspeth Strobestock was the wife of Sir Heron of House Barnaba who was a colonel in the Imperial Army. Prior to the battle of Hoth Elspeth was a beautiful middle-aged women with styled, long, honey-blonde hair.
Colonel Heron Strobestock was a petty knight of House Barnaba, that governed the Barnaba Province of the Tapani sector, and a officer in the Imperial Army. He was married to Dame Elspeth Strobestock.

Arbo was an Ewok who lived in Bright Tree Village on the Forest Moon of Endor as the village's legend keeper. When it was revealed that the wokling Malani had been kidnapped, Arbo suggested that the Ewoks ask their shaman, Logray, for advice before any decisions were made.

Pondo was an Ewok warrior who lived in Bright Tree Village on the forest moon of Endor. When he was still a young adult, Pondo accompanied Chief Chirpa, Warok, and other warriors to track down a monster that, according to a Dulok named Vulgarr, had kidnapped the wokling Malani.
Ulgo, who claimed to hold the title King Ulgo the Magnificent, was a male Dulok from the forest moon of Endor, where he lived in a cave near the Canyons of Mist.
Crooked Tail was the nickname given to a Dulok warrior by the Ewok Teebo.
Lady Areilla Nastascha was a House Cadriaan noble from the Tapani sector and a member of Lady Bathos's Privy council.
The Grudakk was a gigantic sapient humanoid living on the Forest Moon of Endor. It served as the guardian of the Father Tree, the largest tree in the forest.

Tudrath Dyn was a young Yuuzhan Vong warrior and student of Czulkang Lah's class on strategy. When members of the class could not answer one of Lah's questions on the Battle of Coruscant, he decided to give them all a Czulkang Lah pit.
Sir Jared Rutledge was a minor House Mecetti noble from the Tapani sector. He had a brooding nature and was said to be a loner.

Bervin was a Human soldier serving in the Rebel Alliance's Special Forces who was trained in cold-climate combat. In 3 ABY, he was among the 1,000 SpecForce troopers who were assigned to protect Echo Base, the Alliance High Command headquarters on the ice planet Hoth.

Colonel Bors Teraud was the commanding officer of operations at the top-secret Imperial research facility known as the Warren. Stories told that Teraud, together with a scientist, tried to build an army of cyborgs and overthrow the Emperor.
Tyr Taskeen was a skilled Human male Alderaanian who served as a general in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Gaph was a male Ryn refugee from the planet Gyndine. During the Battle of Gyndine he was evacuated along with his fellow Ryn Melisma to the world of Ruan.

Sapha was a female Ryn prisoner with red hair. She along with her fellow prisoners Roa, Fasgo, and the Jedi Knight Wurth Skidder, under the alias of Keyn, were part of the growing of a yammosk aboard the Yuuzhan Vong ship Crèche.
Showolter was a Human male with pale skin and brown eyes. He served with New Republic Intelligence during the Yuuzhan Vong War as a major.

Nodon was a Cathar poacher and hunter. Along with his brother Nonak and a stormtrooper deserter named Burrk, they tried to hunt wampas on Hoth (which was highly illegal) in 12 ABY, but were killed by them.

Frak was a Human male private who served the Sons and Daughters of Freedom. He was deployed to help the Galactic Republic take back the Intergalactic Communications Center on Praesitlyn after being taken by the Separatists.
Tedris Bjalin was an officer in the Imperial Navy who later defected to the Rebel Alliance.
Bastori Rak was a member of the warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. He led a boarding party aboard the Jeolocas, where he encountered a female Twi'lek captain who put up no resistance.

Raglath Nur was a member of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. He was assigned to Denua Ku's war party responsible for hunting down any Jeedai who may have survived the Battle of Coruscant. What they found instead, however, was Irek Ismaren.

An Aqualish male worked as a bounty hunter during the year 5 ABY. While on the moon Nar Shaddaa, the Aqualish was hired by the droid information broker 8t88 to hunt down and kill Kyle Katarn: an individual whom 8t88 double-crossed.
Mrp-Mrp Poo was considered the Lothario Smerg of the Quenk jazz scene. She hosted annual Vector Day parties at the Boulderdash terrarium.
Manda D'ulin was the leader of the group of six Mistryl Shadow Guard warrior-women.

When Kellering contacted Manda D'ulin and her Mistryl Shadow Guard team to secure their help in transporting Hammertong off-world, he told them that Eloy wanted them to reinforce the Imperial security team led by Captain Drome.
Kellering was a young scientist working on the Hammertong project, who contacted a Mistryl Shadow Guard team in 0 BBY.
The Ortolan monk lived in Trid on Danuta. He was encountered by Jan Ors during her search for Kyle Katarn.
The Kubazian landlord lived in Trid on Danuta. He rented a room to Jan Ors.

Leading his Stormtroopers into Chalmun's Cantina, the sand-blasted and sweating Colonel was delighted to recognize the Tonnika sisters at the bar, and promptly arrested them on behalf of Grand Moff Argon.
Predne Balu was a male Imperial Assistant Security Officer from Tatooine. He was a coworker of Feltipern Trevagg.

Kadlah Cha was member of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. She served as a battle tactician to Commander Wyrpuuk Cha, a member of her Domain. Her facial markings were similar to Wyrpuuk's, and served to enlarge her features.

Mujmai Iinan was a member of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong. A direct subordinate of Warmaster Tsavong Lah, he told the Warmaster that Kubindi could be taken with half the number of ships originally expected to conquer the planet.

Pedetsen was a Cadet in the Imperial Navy during one of the most pivotal battles in the history of the Rebellion. A crew member of OSETS 2711, He served under Lieutenant Virar Needa during Rogue Squadron's liberation of Coruscant.

Larens was a Human male soldier who served in the Corellian Resistance and joined the army of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Throughout the war, he became a member of Red Hand Squadron under the leadership of Bria Tharen.
Drub McKumb was a blue-eyed smuggler and spacer whom Han Solo and Mara Jade each knew from their smuggling days. Drub was a plump Human male.
Captain Drome was named by Doctor Kellering as the Imperial officer in charge of security on the Hammertong project.
Cai was a Mistryl Shadow Guard warrior-woman.
Pav D'armon was a member of the Mistryl Shadow Guard team involved in the Hammertong incident in 0 BBY.
Corask Slen'da was a Bothan archaeologist who claimed to be a Jedi.
The Jedi student was a male Jedi student at Luke Skywalker's Jedi Academy around the crisis of the Disciples of Ragnos.

This fair-skinned Human male with dirty-blond hair served on a merchant vessel in 14 ABY and survived a crash in the starship. The incident occurred when the vessel crossed paths with an Imperial Interdictor cruiser and was shot down on the desert planet Blenjeel.

Sakins was the Presider of Vannix until the Yuuzhan Vong War. When word reached Vannix that the Yuuzhan Vong had conquered Coruscant, Sakins decided to flee the planet with his family and mistresses, but not without looting the planetary treasury, leaving Vannix essentially ba…
Delund was a Human male Imperial pilot stationed on the Rand Ecliptic who later joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Tars Nandy was an Imperial TIE pilot stationed on the Rand Ecliptic.
The Jedi Trainer was among the first members of Luke Skywalker's New Jedi Order.
Masla was a Human female actress in the same drama group as Roons Sewell.

affiliation: House Mecetti (Married to a Pelagian noble)

x: Plure Barron was a female Neimoidian Trade Federation commander and administrator of the mining colony on the mineral-rich Krantian moon of Aereen. She was killed during the Clone Wars during the battle led by Echuu Shen-Jon.
Dunc T'racen was a Mistryl Shadow Guard warrior. In 8 ABY, she was teamed as junior partner to Shada D'ukal, serving alongside her as co-pilot and gunner of The Fury.
Baloob, nicknamed "Big Nose" by Den Dhur, was an Ortolan male who worked as a pubtender of the cantina stationed on Drongar during the Clone Wars.

CT-914 was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Having trained, fought, and spent his entire life with fellow trooper CT-915, Nine-one-four regarded him as his brother.

CT-915 was a clone trooper who fought in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars along with fellow trooper CT-914. Raised and trained together on the planet Kamino, the two troopers shared a close bond, viewing each other as brothers.
Kithra was a Human female. She was one of two Mistryl Shadow Guard warrior-women who served as escorts for Mara Jade when Jade was acting as a Smugglers' Alliance representative in 11 ABY.
Shana was a female Human from Emberlene and one of two Mistryl Shadow Guard warrior-women who served as escorts for Mara Jade when she was acting as a Smugglers' Alliance representative in 11 ABY.
Variise, a member of the all-female Mistryl Shadow Guard, served Moff Caerbellak as his bodyguard and trusted agent following the Battle of Endor.

Kardash Josen was a surgeon who served the Republic during the Clone Wars on Drongar. He survived the attack of the Separatist forces against the medical center, and the Republic Mobile Surgical Unit was moved to a new location.

Orrh Or'Ur was a male Tusken Raider who was active during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted dead for leading raids on Gardulla the Hutt's compound. Gardulla's bounty of 3,000 credits was collected by Jango Fett.

Obron Mettlo was a male Moorin who worked as a mercenary and assassin during the Galactic Civil War. After hiring on with Jabba the Hutt, he was fed to the rancor as punishment for killing two of the Hutt's other hirelings.
Toryl, also known as Truthful Toryl, was a male Duros starship merchant. He owned and operated Truthful Toryl's Used Spaceship Lot on the planet Tralus, in the Corellian system.
Aemele was a female Twi'lek thief who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Pharnis Gleasry was a shady agent for the Human League as of 18 ABY.

Jenica Sonsen was the administrator of Centerpoint Station during the First Corellian Insurrection and throughout the Yuuzhan Vong War. She was a Human woman with expressive eyebrows, curly black hair, and a long thin face.

Leemoth was a Duros male surgeon who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars on Drongar. He specialized in amphibious and semi-aquatic species. He survived the attack of the Separatist forces against the medical center, and the RMSU was moved to a new location.
Annora Calandra was a Mining Guild regional Inspector Auditor during the Galactic Civil War who operated in the Tapani sector.

The Artus Imperial warden was stationed at the Imperial mining facility on Artus Prime, which was based primarily on slave labor. The warden was in possession of access codes to the main security doors.
Lady Cynthia Maladori was a noble of House Melantha that governed the Melantha Province of the Tapani sector.

Major Shep Jion was a Baron of House Melantha and a officer in the Imperial Army. Prior to the Battle of Hoth he was a lanky man in his thirties with close cut blonde hair. He was an honorable man who was often torn between loyalty to his house and the Emperor.

Leocald VII was Emperor of the Tapani sector and was known as the patron saint of the Tapani Opera. The Leocald Opera House in the Historical District of Estalle Island on Procopia was named after the former Emperor.
Gorgano IV was the Emperor of the Tapani sector. The Gorgano IV Museum, in the Historical District of Estalle Island on Procopia, was named after the former Emperor.
Tela was the wife of a Sith prisoner caught and interrogated at the Republic Embassy on Manaan in 3956 BBY.

N'do Maetrecis was a Human male who served as a major in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 20 BBY, after being injured in a battle on the planet Drongar, he underwent a heart transplant due to a shrapnel injury.
Rorand Zuzz was a male Ugnaught who was a tech specialist skilled in working with medical equipment.
Tanisuldees was a male Dressellian who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars on Drongar. He also was the field assistant of Filba the Hutt.

Usu Cley was a Human male hand-to-hand combat instructor for RMSU-5 who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars on Drongar. He was the Teräs Käsi champion of the Ninth Fleet in his category for two consecutive years.
Tuwas was a Hutt that was allied with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Vialco was a Human male Dark Side Adept in the service of the Galactic Empire. An apprentice of High Inquisitor Antinnis Tremayne, he forged a reputation for hunting down fugitive Jedi and pervading their dreams with disturbing visions of his own design.
Biggs Bogan was a male Human pilot of the private ship of Admiral Erel Kersos, who served the Republic during the Clone Wars on the medical ship MedStar of Drongar.

CT-802 was a clone trooper who fought for the Galactic Republic in the Battle of Drongar in 20 BBY during the Clone Wars. During the battle, he was injured and contracted a lethal infection. On the brink of death, he was transported to the Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7.
Nars Dojah was the Twi'lek male quartermaster for the Galactic Republic forces at RMSU-7 on Drongar. He achieved this position because of the death of Filba the Hutt.
Ord Vorra was a female Twi'lek who served as a food service tech in the Grand Army of the Republic. She was stationed on the planet Drongar during the Clone Wars.
Elana Divini was the mother of Kornell Divini. She was a famous mudopterist.
Feleema was the wife of the surgeon Erel Kersos.
Thalia May was a Human female Sith student who attended the Sith Academy on Korriban during the Jedi Civil War.
UrrOr' Shurk was a male Tusken Raider who was active
Doctor Leig Duwan was a male Human surgeon and professor at Coruscant Medical. He was known for always having a smile on his face.
Rachott was a female Ugnaught xenobiologist who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars on Drongar.
Lasro Javeq was a male freighter captain who was responsible for the explosion of a Xizor Transport Systems freighter at the Baobab Merchant Fleet Complex on Manda.

Sebairns was a Human male pilot of the private ship of Admiral Erel Kersos who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 20 BBY, he served onboard the MedStar under the command of Admiral Erel Kersos over the planet Drongar.

In 33 BBY, the Science Services Chief Scientist at Corulag Academy, Frexton, a tall, slender Human male, kidnapped the Force-sensitive child Teela Panjarra to study the Force in more depth—using experimental methodologies similar to those that deranged scientist Jenna Zan Arbo…

This Ugnaught worker, like so many of his species, worked in Cloud City. This one was Mind tricked, by Kyle Katarn into opening a door, granting Katarn access to further areas of Cloud City in the events leading up to the Battle of Cloud City.

A Human male senator served in the Imperial Senate as a representative of his homeworld of Corulag. Influential and corrupt, he pampered his son, Judder Page, who in turn despised him and used his wealth to train in combat.
Forridel was a Human male resistance leader and self-proclaimed Governor of Corulag in 29 ABY after the Galactic Alliance liberated the planet from the Yuuzhan Vong.
Lissarkh was a female Trandoshan Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Gotar was an acid lizard to whom the mole creatures of Tatooine offered the unfortunate victims which fell into their lair as meals. R2-D2 and C-3PO once encountered him.

Randi was a young rookie pilot who joined Rogue Squadron sometime during the First Galactic Civil War. They fought in the Battle of Endor as a pilot in Red Squadron. Prior to the battle he attended a briefing held by Wedge Antilles.
Qakkee was a male Rodian hunter from Rodia.
Tam Elgrin was a male Human, and the holocam operator for holodocumentarian Wolam Tser. In 27 ABY, after the Battle of Coruscant, Elgrin was stranded on the world, armed with only his camera.
Wolam Tser was a noted holodocumentarian and historian of the New Republic. His voice was easily recognized by those who lived in the years following the Battle of Endor.
Karke was a female Phindian from Phindar who was a good friend of Senior Anthropologist Mammon Hoole and an anthropologist in her own right.

Glie'oleg Kru was a Twi'lek serving the New Republic Defense Force during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Holding the rank of Brevet Admiral, he was in command of the Bothan Assault Cruiser, Champion and led New Republic forces during the Battle of Kalarba.
Tann was a Human male who was the brother of Toprawan Rebel Surna and a skilled pilot and captain of the Rust Bucket, which he bought with financing from the crimelord Jabba the Hutt.
Amil Karsk was a Human male pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he was a member of Red Squadron prior to the Battle of Yavin.

Rigo was a bounty hunter who lived at the time of the Clone Wars. During the conflict between the Republic and the Separatists, he and a gang of bounty hunters attacked Obi-Wan Kenobi and the Advanced Recon Commando Alpha-17, which had previously landed on Riflor.
Dekluun was a male Sephi commander who led troops when the planet Thustra was invaded by the Republic military after the Sephi had seceded from the Republic in 21 BBY.
Moje was a Sephi male who served as an Associate Planetary Representative to Senator Navi during the Clone Wars.

An Imperial briefing officer, also known as a Flight Officer, was an officer responsible for assigning Imperial TIE pilots to their missions, providing tactical analysis of the pilot's role both pre- and post-flight, as well as explaining the various hazards and ship movements…
Lady Wineth Lastemin was a young Human woman who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was an avid socialite who attended the Unification Gala before the Battle of Endor.
A Human pilot with blue eyes was in command of the Yavin Runner II, a four-engined shuttle that ferried Jedi students, including Jaden Korr and Rosh Penin, of the New Jedi Order.
Grigmin was a Human male stunt pilot who operated Grigmin's Traveling Airshow, a traveling barnstorming company, during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Gru'um Ropple was an associate of Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Ait Convarion was a Human male who was a commander in the Imperial Navy, and captain of the Victory II-class Star Destroyer, Corrupter.

Squa Tront was a talented Umbaran swindler and smuggler. He and the Falleen Thula were employed by the Black Sun agent Kaird. They both had to infiltrate into the sending system and managed to steal the Bota.
Khamar was a male Human Corellian and a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He was the commander of the Praesitlyn Defense Force.
Makx Maganinny was a male Human sergeant in the Republic Army of the Galactic Republic.
Karl Mathieu Ancher was a male Human smuggler known to operate alongside Drake Paulsen. He became known as one of the fathers of modern smuggling on the planet Socorro.

While in a local bar, a moisture farmer who lived on the planet Tatooine in 14 ABY overheard a conversation about the Disciples of Ragnos, a cult of Dark Jedi who were attempting to return the dead Sith Lord Marka Ragnos to life.
Thula was a talented swindler and smuggler. She and the Umbaran Squa Tront were employed by the Black Sun agent Kaird. They both had to infiltrate the sending system and stole the Bota.

Zheepho was a male Rodian lieutenant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars' Battle of Drongar in the year 20 BBY. During the battle, Zheepho was struck by smashbone fever, a chronic disease that threatened to kill him.

One male member of King Gorneesh's tribe of Duloks on the Forest Moon of Endor was distinguished from his green-furred brethren by a yellow X that adorned his belly and chest, as well as by a white cloth that he often tied around his head.

A male member of a Dulok tribe who inhabited the Dulok Swamp on the Forest Moon of Endor was distinguished from the other swamp dwellers by a yellow O on his green-furred torso. He served as a scout and soldier during the tribe's war with the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village.
Three-Five, also known as 35, was a clone trooper who fought in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A male Dulok was a member of the tribe ruled by King Gorneesh and and was a nephew of the tribe's shaman, Umwak. In 3 ABY, when the Dulok was still young, he accompanied his uncle on a mission for Gorneesh.

Ahnjai Rahmma was a Srrors'tok warrior. He worked for High Inquisitor Antinnis Tremayne for a time onboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Interrogator. As Tremayne's servant, Rahmma acted as a personal bodyguard and assassin.
Tor Skylow was a tall, physically fit, Human woman with shoulder length red hair. Her left arm was replaced with a cybernetic unit that was designed to increase her resistance to damage in combat.
Scuppa was the captain of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's personal starship Star Jewel as well as his second-in-command for many years.
Chordak was the Rodian owner and pilot of the Oo-Ta Goo-Ta. Commonly an independent merchant, he also worked as a pirate and slaver, even if he did not enjoy violence as much as most Rodians.
Charpp was a Human male security guard stationed at the Chancellor Palpatine Spaceport on the planet Coruscant. He was a great admirer of the Jedi and possessed great knowledge about their Order.
Quecks was the Major of the Sentient Property Crime Bureau of the Phindar Station. He was responsible for checking if droids in the spaceport were properly licensed.
Miss Vix was a female Vjun fox native to Vjun. She was a Force familiar of Viscountess Whirry Malreaux, who she constantly followed. She lived with her master in the Château Malreaux.

A rebellious mercenary was a Human male who worked for the Sith cult known as the Disciples of Ragnos. He was a former stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire who hated taking orders, so he left without any notice when he had the chance.
As a member of King Gorneesh's tribe from the Forest Moon of Endor, one Dulok distinguished himself from the other members of his species via a yellow diamond shape emblazoned on his torso.

A green-skinned individual was the leader of the swamp swoop gang on the planet Trigalis during the Clone Wars. He and his gangsters tried to steal Obi-Wan Kenobi's lightsaber, but the Jedi Master defeated them.

Besh was a male Korun Human from the world of Haruun Kal. Besh fought for the Korun Upland Liberation Front during the Summertime War and the Clone Wars against the ruling offworld Balawai government and its militia.
A Hutt crime lord was based on the planet of Nar Kreeta, where he ran a gambling business. The crime lord would arrange gambling matches in which prisoners were pitted against a rancor.

A fair-skinned Human spaceport worker with brown hair worked in a spaceport on the planet of Zonju V. In 14 ABY, he gained important information on the Disciples of Ragnos, a cult attempting to revive the dead Sith Lord Marka Ragnos.
Galthra was a female Akk dog native to Haruun Kal. She had a Force bond with Liane Trevval. When Chalk died, she went mad and disappeared into the jungle.
Gemmy or Gemmie was a Korunnai woman who was married to a Balawai militia officer during the years leading up to the Clone Wars.

Nocturno was a female Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. A former member of the Knights of Zakuul, she became known as the gladiator in the Arena Grand of Zakuul under the title "The Fallen Knight" by 3630 BBY.
Lissahl was a double-jointed Zeltron female working as a carafel—high demand courtesans that fulfilled physical desires—on the Inner Rim planet Zeltros.
Nuboocha was a Hutt businessman who decided to stay on Zeltros due to its party atmosphere. His only regret was that he couldn't move his business there, due to its strict zoning laws.
"Red Eye" Baldarek was a Chiss bartender who worked in Baruk's Bar on Nar Shaddaa during the Empire Reborn conflict.
Jojo was the name of a character from the popular holodrama, Zeltrons in Love. He was a fat Devaronian bartender who was friends with Derc.
Derc was a male Zeltron in the popular holodrama Zeltrons in Love that released episodes during the Post-Imperial era.

Kevzod Stenir was a male individual who served as the Fourth Assistant Attorney General of the Galactic Republic during the Separatist Crisis. For several years when the Clone Wars started, he had been prosecuting legal cases against the Commerce Guild.

"Dusty" Rengo was a male Clantaani member of Longo Two-Guns' gang of criminals, who hid on the desert planet of Tatooine. In 32 BBY, Rengo was wanted by Jabba the Hutt for skimming profits from a "legitimate" protection agency on Tatooine.

"Wrong-Way" Wint was a male Clantaani who belonged to a gang of criminals in Mos Espa led by Longo Two-Guns during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Jabba the Hutt placed a bounty on Wint for skimming profits from a "legitimate" protection agency on Mos Espa.
A'jidre Skrigatov was the rotund Devaronian Provisional Governor of the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War.

Al T. Nadder was a Devaronian business owner in the resort city of Le Yer on the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War. He ran a simple repair shop, but was known for being quite talented at what he did.

Bascko was a Verpine male business owner in the resort city of Le Yer on the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War. He ran a droid repair shop, and was known for being extremely hyperactive in all his dealings.

Malric Blaene was a squat, balding male who was a seasoned bartender of the Lost Loves Casino located on Phyrstal Island in the resort city of Le Yer on the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War.

Brinaloy N'Vaari was a Devaronian female from the the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War. She was the granddaughter of the previous Provincial Governor and as such, grabbed the attention of the current Governor, A'jidre Skrigatov.

Cyru was a security guard at the large bar and casino, the LoBue Cantina located in the Abregado-rae Spaceport on the planet Abregado-rae during the Grand Admiral Thrawn's bid for galactic conquest in 9 ABY.

Friizt was the Herglic owner of the gaudy Triple Nova Casino located in the resort city of Le Yer on the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War. A friend of Governor A'jidre Skrigatov, he worked tirelessly to get the Devaronian re-elected.
Hirth was a crime lord in the early years of the New Republic. His base of operations was located somewhere on the planet Abregado-rae.

Kampl was a security guard at the large bar and casino, the LoBue Cantina located in the Abregado-rae Spaceport on the planet Abregado-rae during the Grand Admiral Thrawn's bid for galactic conquest in 9 ABY.

Vikas Sleer was the Quarren owner of a pawn shop on Phyrstal Island in the resort city of Le Yer on the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War. He loved to haggle and would spend hours bargaining over the most mundane of items.

Yorl Niba was a male Twi'lek singer at the Starlight Theater on Phyrstal Island in the resort city of Le Yer on the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War. He was openly hostile to Brinaloy N'Vaari.

Phluche Maltrid was a business owner on Phyrstal Island in the resort city of Le Yer on the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War. The stooped Herglic was known for his strange eerie stares, and also for running a small Hydrobike business.

Malkoi was a Male Rodian gangster on the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War. Leading the Malkoi Gang, he attempted to kidnap Brinaloy N'Vaari so as to blackmail Provincial Governor A'jidre Skrigatov out of office.

Trarr was a Gados transparisteel maker near the Old Patch in Abregado-rae Spaceport on the planet Abregado-rae in the early years of the New Republic. This Gados was talented at forgery and was often hired by the Tundei regime as a spy.
The Reverend was a huge, bushy-bearded regular of the LoBue Cantina located in the Abregado-rae Spaceport on the planet Abregado-rae during Grand Admiral Thrawn's bid for galactic conquest in 9 ABY.

Shelov was a Herglic inhabitant of the planet Abregado-rae during the Galactic Civil War. Shelov, with the support of numerous other offworlders, first established the Tundei Tribunal, the new government of the planet.

Anjet Okeco was a HoloNet News reporter for the Jrade District of Coruscant. In 22 BBY, he wrote an article about the use of death sticks among Coruscant's youths, which included an interview with a fifteen-year-old drug abuser known as Pori Nate.
Roan was a male Human who was the Supreme Governor of the planet New Apsolon.
Arla Fett was the older sister of the bounty hunter and Mandalore Jango Fett, and the only daughter of their Journeyman Protector father. She was also the long-lost aunt of Boba Fett.

Tyber Zann was a human male crime lord from Anaxes who rose to prominence after the Battle of Yavin during the Galactic Civil War and led his own crime syndicate, known as the Zann Consortium, a powerful underworld consortium.

Tonkoss Rathba was a being who was dictator of Daluba. Leia Organa Solo had been involved in diplomacy with Rathba some time prior to the Osarian-Rhommamool conflict in 25 ABY, and she considered Rathba to be something of a tyrant. C-3PO compared Rathba to Icknya and Nom Anor.
Grappa was a male Rodian mercenary hired by the government of the planet Osarian to serve as a captain in the Osarian First-Force.

Garr was an Excargan whose mother and father were presumed dead after Confederacy of Independent Systems invaded Excarga. Along with other orphans, Garr traveled on the Republic starship Candaserri to an orphanage on Bespin.
Oberk was an Imperial scout trooper and a corporal at the time of the Battle of Endor.
Caet Shrovl was an albino Shistavanen Wolfwoman.

Ran Kether was the communications officer for Rogue Squadron during the Zsinj campaign. He flew as Rogue Seven, and his wingmate was Koobis Nu. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, Kether was flying refugee transports at Kalarba, where he was killed.
Nig was a male Gotal who was also a member of the Raptor gang on Coruscant.
Shok Tinoktin was a Human native of Rhommamool. In 25 ABY, he became allied with Nom Anor, a fanatical despiser of machines and his followers, the Red Knights of Life.

Shunta Osarian Dharrg was the leader of the planet Osarian in 25 ABY and an opponent of Nom Anor's actions on Rhommamool who viewed Leia Organa Solo's meeting with Anor as giving him unacceptable legitimacy.
Domisari was a female Human assassin who worked for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Rath Kelkko was an Anzati assassin who was recruited to train and lead the uprising army on Saleucami of Morgukai. Sora Bulq hired him and his fellow Anzati assassins to train a "shadow army" for the purposes and wills of Count Dooku.

Lilith was a Human female Jedi trainee who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. When the Great Jedi Purge was initiated, she betrayed her fellow Jedi and joined the Galactic Empire.

affiliation: Umjing Baab and His Swinging Trio
x: Umjing Baab was a male Rughja who led an orchestra-band called Umjing Baab and His Swinging Trio—which, despite its name, was made up of Baab and only two, not three, other musicians.
Tobbert Dalonbian was president of the Extragalactic Society, an institute searching for extragalactic life, in 22 BBY.
Yfra was a personal female ambassador of the Hapan matriarch Ta'a Chume, in 23 ABY.

Gorth was a Trandoshan male who served as a bodyguard on the planet Coruscant. In 32 BBY, Gorth was hired by the Neimoidian Hath Monchar to protect him while Monchar was trying to sell a holocron that contained plans for the Trade Federation to invade the planet Naboo.
Ean was a male Mon Calamari who served as a sensor officer aboard the New Republic Cruiser Yavin under Wedge Antilles.

Chu-Gon Dar was a male Jedi Master of the Old Republic who took his residence on Mustafar, within the Enclave there. His mastery of the Physical Force was unmatched throughout the galaxy, until his death.
Thorn Drumheller, also known as Willow Ufgood or Weazel, was a Nelwyn from Andowyne.
Sorsha was an individual from Andowyne and was the daughter of the Demon Queen Bavmorda and the good Prince Mikal Tanthalos of Tir Asleen whose fiery red hair she inherited.

Madmartigan was a male Human knight from Andowyne. The knight of Galadoorn disgraced himself by having an illicit love affair with a princess. He later took up a sword to fight Queen Bavmorda alongside his childhood friend Airk Thaughbaer.
Elora Danan was a female Daikini empress from Andowyne.

Jerell was a male Human who was one of the leaders in the Ralltiir resistance to Imperial rule. He was the father of two daughters; one of them, Bettle, was a smuggler, while the other was dead by the end of the New Republic capture of Ralltiir, a death he blamed on Ralltiir's…
Blaine Hansom was a human smuggler who flew an old YT-1300 light freighter. He was known for his trademark trenchcoat and long brown sideburns.

Dembaline was a Mon Calamari composer whose most recognizable work, the song "Shwock Dubllon," was produced prior to the Clone Wars. By 22 BBY, the HoloNet News agency regarded "Shwock Dubllon" as a classic, and the song had been remixed by musician Gaeriel Capens.
Moss Deevers was a Bothan smuggler who paired with Twingo. The two were known for their wild boasts. They set the record for running the Lando's Folly course.
Twingo was a Sullustan smuggler who paired with Moss Deevers. The two were known for their wild boasts.

Soe was a female Human soldier living during the war against Zakuul. She was a member of the Eternal Alliance and was part of the Alliance Recon Unit, created and deployed in response to various uprisings sparkling across the galaxy following the death of the Eternal Empire Em…
Tagg Sivrak was a male Shistavanen and brother of Lak Sivrak. He was married to Nira Sivrak. Their son studied at the University of Coruscant.

In the first phase of the battle, his ship was infiltrated by two Imperial Intelligence agents, Pensin and Horvic, who took control of the ship's weapons and fired on the Bothan capital city, Drev'starn.
Torm Dadeferron was a Human male who worked as a double agent for the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Police during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Gauch was a male smuggler on Dubrillion in 25 ABY, at the start of the Yuuzhan Vong War; he worked for Lando Calrissian. When the Vong attacked the planet at the start of the war, he was one of the pilots in the rag-tag starfighter fleet who defended the world.

Silri was a powerful Nightsister, a dark side witch of Dathomir. She worked for Tyber Zann and his criminal syndicate, the Zann Consortium, in the time following the Battle of Yavin in the hopes of being able to witness and partake in the destruction that Zann intended on caus…

A pale, red-haired young officer with a brisk, efficient manner, Waroen served as the primary aide to Captain Joak Drysso on the bridge of the Super Star Destroyer Lusankya during the Battle of Thyferra.
Eermik was a male Bith bounty hunter who was among the group who agreed to help Risso Nu eliminate Boba Fett on Ma'ar Shaddam.

Hoxie was a Ankura Gungan who was the boss of the city of Otoh Raban on the planet Naboo in the year 3000 BBY. During a period of war at that time between the Gungan tribes, Hoxie was kidnapped by the warlord Boss Rogoe to keep Otoh Raban in the war, leaving the city leaderless.

CT-4/619 was the designation of a clone trooper who served in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army during the Clone Wars, the galaxy-wide conflict between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Hunter Of Winds was the father of Child Of Winds. This elder Qom Qae decided that contacting Luke Skywalker for help against the Threateners was too risky, an act that the Eater Of Fire Creepers disagreed with and called Skywalker himself.

Child Of Winds was a male Qom Qae, the son of Qom Qae Bargainer Hunter Of Winds. Child of Winds helped Luke Skywalker find Mara Jade and later assisted them during their infiltration of the Hand of Thrawn.
Pann was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Sev was a Weequay male Jedi Master who served as a general during the Clone Wars. During the war, he trained the Human Joc Sah as his Padawan.

Onara Kuat was head of the Kuat family and principal director of Kuat Drive Yards during the Clone Wars. In a position to select the Kuat sector's representative in the Galactic Senate, Onara ensured that both her family and her shipyards would benefit from her selections.
Lun Deverin was a male Duros sensor officer aboard the pirate ship Free Lance; he served under Urias Xhaxin.
Ahk'laht was a male Noghri bodyguard, assigned to protect Leia Organa Solo in her duties as ambassador.
Onibald Daykim, also known as King Daykim, was a low-level civil servant on Coruscant, who hid in the Undercity and led a group of fugitives, collectively known as Daykim's Kingdom.
Eater Of Fire Creepers was the Bargainer of the Qom Jha. He received his name must likely because he ate a dangerous insect called fire creepers.

Murk Lundi was a male Quermian from the planet of Ploo II, and an expert on the history of the Sith. Working as a teacher on Coruscant, he gave lectures on the mysterious darksiders and was considered one of Coruscant's most knowledgeable beings on the Sith.

Kath Talor was a female Human who was the wife of Rand Talor. She was found on Sarapin while Rebel forces infiltrated the planet around the Battle of Yavin. A decrease in production alerted the Galactic Empire to that, and in a few days, the planet was back in Imperial hands.
The Imprisoned One was a Rakata who lived during the Infinite Empire's dominance over the galaxy. His quest for personal power resulted in his own kind imprisoning his consciousness in a mind prison.

Masst kept a journal, which he wrote using the same Atrisian script that Special Operations personnel frequently used when creating and transmitting tightly-coded, spurious mission plans for the purpose of tying up the resources of Imperial Intelligence, a practice known as "s…

Rosemari Pressor Tabory was a female Human who was the sister of Jorad, and the mother of Evlyn. She grew up aboard the wreckage of Outbound Flight Project and eventually became a teacher for the young people of the colony.
Keth Beamis was a male Human Alliance Intelligence member who worked as a talent scout during the start of the Galactic Civil War.
Bimmiel was the leader of the Imperial survey team that discovered the MZX33291 system. Its main planet, Bimmiel, was named after him.
Keela Nakay was a Balawai teenager who lived in Haruun Kal during the Clone Wars. She was Pell's sister.
Rasca Darklighter was a female Human from the planet Tatooine. She was the sister of Rogue Squadron pilot Gavin Darklighter and the daughter of Silya and Jula Darklighter.
Kral Nevil was a male Quarren member of Rogue Squadron. From 25 ABY to 27 ABY, he flew as Rogue Two and Gavin Darklighter's wingman.

Dareb an Imperial pilot and partner of Commander Orvak. He was killed by crashing his TIE stealth into a tree and went spinning directly to the invisible shield that the Jedi Praxeum's shield generator was making.
Denna was a Human male student at the University of Agamar.

Trista Orlanis was a Human female with a slender build and black hair. She attended the University of Agamar and in 25 ABY accompanied Doctor Anki Pace on an archaeological dig to Bimmiel as a grad student.
Jens was a Human female student at the University of Agamar who had blue eyes and blonde hair. In 25 ABY, she was one of the members of Dr. Anki Pace's team to journey to Bimmiel.

Beidlo was a young boy who grew up with his parents on Tatooine. When his parents were killed by Tusken Raiders, he joined the B'omarr monks and they took care of him. One day, Mammon Hoole came to Jabba's Palace to research the B'omarr monks with Tash and Zak Arranda.
Splitter Of Stones was one of the three Qom Jha, along with Keeper Of Promises and Builder With Vines, to help Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade find the entrance to the Hand of Thrawn.
Builder With Vines was a Qom Jha who lived during the Caamas Document Crisis.
Scri Oscuro was the High Priest of the religious cult Zealots of Psusan. He used his position in the cult to hide his illegal ventures, though this led to a bounty being placed on his head.

The Great Goblin was a mute, Anx gladiator who fought in the gladiatorial pits of the planet Loovria. He died of terror after being purchased by a Hutt crime lord who tried to transport him alone to the planet Nal Hutta.
Iliox Arguun was a male Anx, who worked at the University of Sanbra for a number of years as a Professor of Anatomy.
Sajax Astiax was a historically famous Anx male member of his species.

Dinger was a male starfighter pilot who was serving in Rogue Squadron, a famed New Republic unit, as of 25 ABY. Assigned the callsign Rogue Eleven, Dinger flew under the command of Rogue Leader, Colonel Gavin Darklighter.
Tik was a male starfighter pilot who flew as Rogue Twelve in New Republic Starfighter Command's Rogue Squadron in 25.2 ABY.
Sasso was a Rodian who helped Team Meloque destroy the yammosk implanted on Caluula during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Merciless was a massiff owned by Colonel Kedar Blackgate on the planet Sacorria during the Galactic Civil War. Blackgate owned a second massiff, named Emperor, and both were said to be loyal pets.
Rennek was a Human who worked as a nerf herder for the Tatooine-based Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

Vetria Scoth was a male member of a horn-faced species, who hailed from Ord Mantell. He worked as a bounty hunter, and donned a suit of armor, which contained several items of equipment. He was armed with a blaster rifle.

Shao to Gok was a member of a bipedal, yellow-skinned species that had a pointed tail and three digits on each hand and foot. Shao to Gok's skin was covered in red blotches, and he had yellow eyes. He worked as both an information scout and an itinerant preacher.
This individual was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Caldera Righim was a Talz. He resided on Tatooine, and was often spotted enjoying a drink at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina. He was often present during the night when Ackmena was the bartender. Like most Talz, Caldera was a pacifist. He was a good friend of Wuher.
Deneb Both was an Ithorian forester. She made her home on Tatooine and frequented Chalmun's Cantina. Deneb was hoping to leave Tatooine and was often found at the Cantina during Ackmena's shift.

Zutmore was a Snivvian known to cheat her family and lovers. When her deceitful ways were revealed, her family abandoned her on Tatooine. She could often be seen at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina sitting in a stupor, reflecting on her past.
Tuber was the nickname Anakin Solo gave to an elder Dantari tribesman that he encountered on Dantooine in 25 ABY, during the early part of the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Lounha was an executive of the Corporate Sector Authority. The crew of the No Luck Required stole a float bearing his likeness to save Uldir Lochett and Klin-Fa Gi on Bonadan. At that time, he had been secretly negotiating with a Yuuzhan Vong executor for two weeks.
Txer was a male Myneyrsh from Wayland and was the leader of the Free People who were fighting the Yuuzhan Vong. Txer found and aided Uldir Lochett in his search for Klin-Fa Gi.

Jarril was a male smuggler who frequented the Smuggler's Run and was an acquaintance of Han Solo. He met with him on Coruscant in the Crystal Jewel Casino. Jarril was the owner of the Spicy Lady, which he designed after the Millennium Falcon. He was killed in 17 ABY.
Seluss was a male Sullustan and smuggler who smuggled with his partner Jarril on Smuggler's Run when Jarril was killed in 17 ABY.
Hartzig was a male Human and a military officer during the reign of the New Republic.
OS-72-10 was a TIE pilot in the Imperial Navy who had at certain points served aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyers Conquest and Thunderflare, as well as the Super Star Destroyer Executor.
Kid DXo'ln was a male smuggler who was an acquaintance of Han Solo and took him to his first visit to Little Kessel onboard his starship, the Starfire.
Wynni was a female Wookiee smuggler from Kashyyyk who tried to seduce Chewbacca on his first visit to the Smuggler's Run.

Iisner was a male Glottalphib who was an assistant of the Glottalphib crimelord Nandreeson. He was killed at an old age by Davis on the Millennium Falcon. Iisner had followed Seluss onto the ship and ambushed Davis, Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Seluss.
Davis was a male Human smuggler who aided Han Solo and Chewbacca on Skip 5 when they were attacked by Glottalphib bounty hunters hired by Nandreeson.

Yanne was Dark Jedi Kueller's assistant after Femon who was chosen because he expressed his opinion even if it was not in sync with Kueller's. After Kueller's death in 17 ABY, Yanne assumed control of Almania and opened talks with the New Republic.
Hurdiss was a Human who served as a communications chief aboard the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Executor during the Galactic Civil War.
Tchiery was a male Farnym who was an officer in the New Republic.

Gant was a male Human who Kueller decided would replace Yanne as his advisor if he were to kill him. After Kueller's death, Yanne became the leader of Almania. Gant overthrew him and assumed leadership of the world, but was in turn overthrown by an unstable military junta.

Narthax was a Human male clone from the planet Ukio. He served the Galactic Empire as a clone stormtrooper during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict between the Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Sela was General Wedge Antilles' second-in-command onboard the Yavin.
Ginbotham was a male Hig who served aboard the Yavin in 17 ABY as part of the command crew, alongside Wedge Antilles.
Ceousa was a general in the New Republic who participated in the Battle of Almania in which he commanded the Calamari.
Bur was one of Kueller's favorite military commanders. He commanded Kueller's fleet during the Battle of Almania.

Merrejk was a Human commander of the Imperial Navy during the height of the Galactic Civil War. As an elite Imperial spy and scout, he often posed as a freighter captain making supply runs to the Outer Rim Territories, monitoring Rebel and criminal activity.
Myn Kyneugh served as a Royal Guard in service to Emperor Palpatine of the Galactic Empire.
Bron Burs was a member of a species with horny spines on the back of its face and two pointed protrusions surrounding a mouth.

Gamall Wironicc was an individual who found himself stranded on the planet Tatooine. A strange wanderer, he was rumored to have sacrificed himself in battle so that his comrades could live on, at some point prior to being stuck on Tatooine.

Shanko was the insectoid owner and bartender of Shanko's Hive, a drinking establishment located on the inner floor of Borgo Prime. He was a capable bartender and could stay focused on his job despite the constant chaos that erupted inside the walls of Shanko's Hive.

Murzz, a young Tatooinian boy, was one of the children enslaved by Gilramos Libkath. He was used as an example by Libkath of what would become of the other children if he did not receive absolute obedience from them.
Jip Toorr was a Yevethan primate of the warship Devotion, formerly the Valorous, during the Black Fleet Crisis.
Toklar was a famous Mon Calamari philosopher. He was active seven centuries before the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Tornik was a male Human guard for the famous gangster, Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

Valsil Torr was an elderly male Twi'lek merchant who controlled operations on Yag-prime. After an encounter with the ex-members of Rogue Squadron, he and his men surrendered and allowed them to remove the bacta being stored onboard the station by Warlord Zsinj.

Totolaya was a hostage taken by the Yevetha during the attack on the Kubaz colony Doornik-319. Along with the other hostages taken during the Yevethan Purge, Totolaya was forced to record a message begging the New Republic not to fire on Yevethan ships carrying prisoners.

Tralkpha was the Mon Calamari navigator of the ship Jade's Fire. He was described as taciturn. After the resolution of the First Corellian Insurrection, Mara Jade surmised that he was most probably dead, but hoped there was a chance he had only been captured or had hidden on C…

Poas Trell was the executive aide to New Republic First Administrator Nanaod Engh. When Chief of State Leia Organa Solo granted immediate membership of the New Republic to planets in Farlax sector under threat from the Yevetha after the Yevethan Purge, Poas Trell acted as witn…
Nanaod Engh was the First Administrator of the New Republic's General Ministry during the Black Fleet Crisis.
Laird Gustavu was Moff of the Tapani sector during Imperial rule. He was in his late fifties.
Hasti Troujow was a Human female who played a crucial part in the discovery of the long-lost treasure ship Queen of Ranroon in 1 BBY.
Torsha Dawun was an Ithorian female who owned Meirm Speeder Emporium in Meirm City on Sriluur. She was one of the few non-natives that both the Houk and Weequay of Sriluur respected.
Lanni Troujow was a Human female who, while piloting a surface-to-surface run for a mining outfit on the planet Dellalt, found the log-recorder of the ancient lost treasure ship Queen of Ranroon.
Rimsen was a male officer in the New Republic Defense Fleet. In 25 ABY he held the rank of captain and commanded the Corusca Fire.
Geoff f'Tuhns was a Human male and Imperial recruit. Around 1 BBY, f'Tuhns arrived at the Academy of Carida to begin his military training in hopes of becoming an Imperial stormtrooper.
Phloremirlla Tenk, ubiquitously known simply as Flor, was a Republic Intelligence agent. She was a Human woman with a red face, roughly Mace Windu's age. She joined Republic Intelligence in 55 BBY.
