Vonnda Ra was a female Dathomirian and a Nightsister of the Great Canyon Clan and a member of the Shadow Academy during the Second Imperium Crisis.
Yolan Bren, also known as the "Poet," was a resistance leader affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the world of Solem.
An eccentric Jedi alive nineteen millennia before the Galactic Civil War, Humat maintained a collection of unusual, mostly sinister artifacts, including the talisman known as the soul stealer.
Surenit Kli'qiy was a male Caamasi who served the galaxy as a Jedi Knight.

Shayl Le'tah was a female Bothan Jedi Knight who was able to combine her innate abilities offered by the Force and her inherent talent for covert operations that come from being a Bothan. She was known for her skills as a Jedi investigator.

Tensh Ly'alu was a male Bothan Jedi Knight who served the New Jedi Order. His first assignment, upon reaching the rank of Jedi Knight, was to monitor the Twi'lek homeworld, Ryloth, both for Force-sensitives and to watch for Jedi interests on planet.

This Shadow Academy student was much like other students that had attended the Shadow Academy. He hoped to accomplish his goal of becoming a Jedi by attending the Shadow Academy. What kind of Jedi he was destined to become if he did so was clear.

Silky was a Quarf that lived on the forest moon of Endor. He befriended the Ewok Princess Kneesaa so that he could eventually kidnap her for his mistress, Jadru, who planned to ransom the princess for the Ewoks' Sunstar.

Basbakhan was a male Noghri warrior and bodyguard. After the death of Bolpuhr, he and Olmahk were assigned to be the bodyguards of Leia Organa Solo. He was likely killed by Yuuzhan Vong warriors during the Battle of Duro while guarding Randa Besadii Diori.

Olmahk was a male Noghri warrior. After the death of Bolpuhr, he and Basbakhan were assigned to be the bodyguards of Leia Organa Solo. He was killed by Yuuzhan Vong warriors during the Battle of Duro.
M. Tuyay was a Human male and the Chief Operating Officer for Ororo Transportation. He was a major competitor of Prince Xizor's Xizor Transport Systems. He was a fitness buff and bulged with muscles.

Harrak was an officer who served in the Army of the Imperial Remnant as a colonel. During his military career, he would also serve as an adviser to Grand Admiral Gilad Pellaeon. He was suspicious of the New Republic and viewed any request of military help from them a trap.

Bulgan was an Ansionian, an Alwari tribal outcast of the Tasbir clan, who had a hunched back and was missing an eye due to a suubatar accident he suffered as a child. His brain was also damaged during the accident—that is, until the Jedi healer Barriss Offee fixed it.
Ogomoor, an Ansionian male, was the majordomo of Soergg Vosadii Bezhin. He was killed in 22 BBY by Soergg when he attempted to give the Unity Council evidence of his criminal activities.

Llanmore was a Human male commander in the Republic Army and General Khamar's second-in-command of security for the Praesitlyn Defense Force. He was stationed on Praesitlyn prior to the Separatist attack on the world in 22 BBY.
Reija Momen was a Human female from Alderaan, middle-aged as of 22 BBY. Anakin Skywalker believed she resembled his mother.
Slith Skael was a Sluissi male from Sluis Van, who served as a chief communications technician of the Intergalactic Communications Center and assistant to Reija Momen.
"Waterboy" was the callsign of a young, petite, female ensign in the Praesitlyn Defense Force. She was a friend of T-19 starfighter pilots Lieutenant Erk H'Arman and Ensign Pleth Strom.

Tami was a male Human scout in the recon squad of the Praesitlyn Defense Force under Sergeant Makx Maganinny and a personal friend of fellow scout Odie Subu. He was later killed during his first combat experience in the Battle of Praesitlyn.
Flyer Through Spikes was one of the Qom Jha sent by the Eater Of Fire Creepers to help Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade find the Empire of the Hand, following the death of the Builder With Vines.
Kreen was a human male Lieutenant Colonel and commander of engineer battalion in the Praesitlyn Defense Force during the Clone Wars.

Sergeant Omin L'Loxx was a Human male recon trooper in the Sons and Daughters of Freedom and was the partner of Jamur Nath during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Jamur Nath was a male Human recon trooper in the Sons and Daughters of Freedom. He and his partner, Sergeant Omin L'Loxx fought in the Battle of Praesitlyn. Nath was killed by enemy speeder bikes while transporting Lieutenant Erk H'Arman to Captain Zozridor Slayke's encampment.
Mess Boulanger was a male Human who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as a quartermaster.
B'wuf was a male senior control technician who worked for the Confederacy of Independent Systems and serving under Admiral Pors Tonith during the Battle of Praesitlyn.
Captain Luhar was a middle-aged Human male officer in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. He commanded the corvette Neelian in the Battle of Praesitlyn.
Quegh was an officer who served as a captain in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. He commanded the Centax-class heavy frigate Ranger at the Battle of Praesitlyn.
Lench was a male captain who served the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. He captained the heavy cruiser By'ynium during the Battle of Praesitlyn, and was killed when the starship was destroyed.
Ram Raders was a Human male who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars, holding the rank of corporal.

Slane Vick was a Human male private who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. He was a guard aboard the Ranger, along with Corporal Ram Raders, when General Nejaa Halcyon repelled battle droids boarding the ship.
Jorm Whistler Mackenni, also known by the warrior-name Twister, was a stormtrooper serving in the forces of the Empire of the Hand many years after the Battle of Endor.
Hadocrassk was a male Trandoshan and the Speaker-Above-All of Trandosha prior to the start of the Clone Wars.

RR'uruurrr was a hunter of the Sand People on Tatooine. He was a member of URoRRuR'R'R's hunting party that captured Luke Skywalker in the Jundland Wastes. While in the village, he tended the banthas.
Ur'Ru'r was a Tusken Raider. He accompanied his fellow tribesmen URoRRoR'R'R and RR'uruurrr on a hunt in the Jundland Wastes where they had captured Luke Skywalker.

Uutkik was a Jawa scout and a member of Nebit's clan. In addition to being a scout, Uutkik was also an experienced thief who pilfered equipment and hijacked vehicles from unwary bystanders in Mos Eisley, a large spaceport on the planet Tatooine.
Gray Tucker was the Security Administrator for MerenData.
Cebann Veekan was a Hamadryas actor who, after 4 ABY, performed in a stage production based on Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker's exploits and adventures.

Colonel Gris Manks was a male Human commander of artillery for the Sons and Daughters of Freedom. During the Battle of Praesitlyn against the Confederacy of Independent Systems, he and his artillery units supported Jedi Nejaa Halcyon and Anakin Skywalker.
Sosio Kakra was a small, white-skinned female present at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in 1 ABY who assisted Ackmena.

Myhr Rho was a tour guide who ran the "Skywalker Tour" in the wake of the Battle of Endor. A member of the Cathar species, he was born on the planet of the same name, but was raised on the arid Outer Rim Territories world of Tatooine.
Captain Dondo Foth was a male Human officer who served the Galactic Republic and the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Graven R'ube was a Y'bith and a patron at Chalmun's Cantina. R'ube was present in the cantina around 1 ABY, when the Imperial curfew went into effect.
Barada Rakul was captain of the Moulee-rah Patogga, a smuggling vessel working with the Hutt kajidics. It was originally owned by Aruk Besadii Aora, but later sold to Jiliac Desilijic Tiron.

Chalco was a vagrant and a drifter who often hung around Docking Bay 9372 on Coruscant finding information on people. He aided Jedi Master Luke Skywalker in his search for rogue Jedi Daeshara'cor in 25 ABY.

Ch'ord Sy'fon was a brown-skinned Bothan male with light brown hair and black eyes who wore a light brown tunic with a collar. Around 19 BBY, he encountered the former Human Senate Guard Sagoro Autem, who considered Sy'fon a friend, in a cantina on the planet Coruscant.

Lou was a lieutenant in the Pelek Baw militia as of the time of the Battle of Haruun Kal. When Jedi Master Mace Windu arrived at Haruun Kal, he was stationed at the spaceport, where he worked as a customs broker. There he confronted Master Windu, who eventually broke his nose.
Crutag was a Taloron Hunter, both fierce and determined. He was known to boast that he never failed to capture his bounty targets. He considered Boba Fett to be vastly overrated.

Ada was a Human female who was enslaved under the Black Vulkars on the planet Taris to settle her father's debt. In 3956 BBY, during the Jedi Civil War, she encountered Revan, who freed her from enslavement.

Darth Vectivus, in the life he enjoyed prior to becoming a Sith, was a male Human who served as the director of the Jonex Mine Eight Eleven B asteroid mining colony in the MZX32905 star system near the planet Bimmiel.
Klysk was a male spokesman who served a group of exiles from the Red Nebula. In 0 ABY, Klysk plotted to steal and destroy a pair of crimson jewels held in a temple in the Red Nebula.
The Red Nebula priest resided in the temple in the Red Nebula which housed two crimson jewels important to the priest's religion.
The Red Nebula temple guardian was a giant hairy beast who, along with a priest, was charged with protecting the sacred crimson jewels which were important to the temple priests.
Zud was one of a number of pirates, smugglers and mercenaries captured by the Red Nebula exile Klysk and forced to attempt to steal the Nebula's Great Life Jewels in 0 ABY.
Jub Vegnu was an extremely obese Sullustan aide for Jabba the Hutt. He gave him news from Mos Eisley.
Vinda was a starshipwright and the co-owner of Starshipwrights and Aerospace Engineers Incorporated, a corporation based on the planet Oslumpex V, along with his partner D'rag.

Jalan was a male Human and associate of Captain Arwen Cohl. He went with Cohl to Dorvalla, on a mission for the Nebula Front, to steal a shipment of aurodium ingots from the Trade Federation freighter Revenue.

Nykl was a Balawai child who lived in Haruun Kal during the Clone Wars. He was Urno's brother. While fleeing a battle during the Summertime War, he, Pell Nakay, Terrel Nakay, Keela Nakay, and Urno had an accident when their steamcrawler was stuck in a lava flow, but Jedi Maste…
Jace was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who worked as part of the crew of an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate around 3 ABY.
Shem-Lern was a male gunrunner who held information regarding the capture of Han Solo by the bounty hunter Boba Fett.

Nord was a Human male Imperial colonel stationed on the Tarkin superweapon as a member of the bridge crew. He became involved in a conspiracy to assassinate Darth Vader, due to his frequent executions of officers for minor failures.

General Biel was a Human male Imperial officer stationed aboard the Tarkin superweapon around 3 ABY. He became involved in a conspiracy with several fellow officers to kill Darth Vader for his frequent executions of subordinates.

Berl was an Imperial stormtrooper stationed aboard the superweapon known as the Tarkin in 3 ABY. He confronted the Rebel droids C-3PO and R2-D2 as they were attempting to sabotage the Tarkin tractor beam generator.

Pek Rankin was a Balawai man who lived in Haruun Kal during the Clone Wars. One night, the Korunnai destroyed a entire Balawai village, but Pek and few survivors were able to get away. During the escape, they lost five children: Terrel Nakay, Pell, Keela, Urno, and Nykl.

Pell Nakay was a Balawai child who lived in Haruun Kal during the Clone Wars. She was Keela's sister. While fleeing a battle during the Summertime War, she, Keela, Terrel Nakay, Urno, and Nykl had an accident when their steamcrawler became stuck in a lava flow, but Jedi Master…
Grubbat Fhilch was a Lepi with blue-gray fur, long ears, and a long bushy tail.
Klyn Shanga was a Human male from Renatasia III who became one of the last warriors defending his civilization's honor after its destruction at the hands of the Galactic Empire.

Bilk was a beady-eyed male Gamorrean bodyguard employed by the Toydarian merchant Zippa in the years prior to the rise of Palpatine. According to Lorn Pavan, he stank like 'a silage bin at high noon'.

Zippa was a male Toydarian merchant in the lower levels of Coruscant in the years prior to the rise of Palpatine. He once tried to sell Lorn Pavan a Sith holocron, which he mistakenly believed to be a Jedi Holocron.

Guerra Derida, a self-described "freedom fighter who steals," was a male Phindian, the brother of Paxxi and Terra Derida and the son of Duenna Derida. At some stage in his life, Guerra was enslaved and sent to work in the mines of the planet Bandomeer.
Mahwi Lihnn was a female Human bounty hunter who was active during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
"Green Hair" was the name Darsha Assant gave to one of the leaders of the Raptor gang.
Tuden Sal was a male Sakiyan who lived as a restaurant owner and associate of Black Sun and other smugglers on Coruscant in the decade prior to the Clone Wars.

Dal Perhi was a short Human male. He was muscular, with a braid running down his back, and he worked as a representative of Black Sun on Coruscant prior to the Battle of Naboo. Two years after the Battle of Naboo, he became Vigo.
Elan Tallah was a Galacian leader of the hill people of Gala.

Dynba Tesc was a Human female native to the world Garqi. In 6 ABY, while studying at Garqi Agricultural University, Tesc became involved with a group of students who opposed Imperial rule of their homeworld by slicing New Republic slogans and graphics into the comnet.
Rade Dromath was a tall blond, blue-eyed Human male native to Garqi.

Tiatkin, also known as Tia, was a female Twi'lek who worked with the Alliance to Restore the Republic against the Eiattu pirates on the planet Radix alongside Lando Calrissian and Giza. Tiatkin worked closely alongside Giza in their spaceship.

A male Noghri from Clan Baikh'vair, Mushkil was one of a team of Noghri commandos from Honoghr that accompanied a New Republic reconnaissance team to the Yuuzhan Vong occupied world of Garqi in 25 ABY.

Vianna D'Pow was an albino Zeltron female from the planet Zeltros who was reviled by her peers due to her ash-white skin. D'Pow grew to hate herself, and needing an outlet for her pent-up aggression, she sought out the life of a bounty hunter.

Sirhka was one of the six Noghri to accompany Corran Horn's commando team to Garqi in 25 ABY. During their escape from Garqi, Ganner Rhysode asked Sirhka to seal the wound on his face, purposefully leaving a scar.

Arr'yka was a female Bothan who served in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the early stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War. As a lieutenant, she was assigned to the role of communications officer aboard the Ralroost.

Dor Reder was a Human male Imperial Navy officer from the planet Pirralor. A junior officer aboard the Star Destroyer Pulsar during the Battle of Endor, Reder was captured by the Alliance to Restore the Republic but managed to escape by stealing an Alliance transport.

Relal Tawron was the High Priest and leader of the Ithorians of Tafanda Bay as of 25 ABY, having succeeded Momaw Nadon. He gave the New Republic and Imperial Remnant permission to enter the forbidden area of Ithor's surface to prepare defenses against the Yuuzhan Vong.
Iasa was a male Jawa who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Choral was a stormtrooper of Unit Aurek-Four of the Aurek Company in the 501st Legion of the Empire of the Hand.
Dropkick was a stormtrooper of Unit Aurek-Three of Aurek Company in the 501st Legion of the Empire of the Hand.
Isolde Siro was a purple-haired Human female fringe criminal.
The commandos traveled to the planet Radix located within the system and were soon ambushed by pirate forces when their local pilot, Kine, betrayed them.
Katarra was a female Wookiee who was the daughter of Tarkazza and helped lead the anti-Imperial resistance on Kashyyyk. She met with Bria Tharen, who was also active in the resistance on Corellia.

Tarkazza (meaning "mist ghost" in Shyriiwook) was a male Wookiee, with a silver stripe down his back, who was the father of Katarra. He once took Han Solo beneath Rwookrrorro by placing him in a quulaar on his back.

Mif Kumas was a male Calibop Sergeant at Arms for the New Republic Senate. In 25 ABY, he quieted everyone down as Director bel-dar-Nolek explained the Yuuzhan Vong attack on Obroa-skai at Coruscant's Grand Convocation Chamber. By then he had held the position for two terms.
Tomla El was a male Ithorian healer who was considered small for his kind.

Doctor Ism Oolos was a Ho'Din doctor who gained some fame for his research into the Death Seed plague. Years later, he was one of the doctors to try and treat Mara Jade Skywalker after her coomb spore infection.
Clat, also known as Clat the Shamer, was a mutant empath, a Force user working on behalf of the Guild of Vindicators following the formation of the Galactic Empire.
J'uoch was a Human female who ran a criminal gang along with her twin brother R'all on the Tion Hegemony world of Dellalt during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Venutton was a scrawny, uptight male Human assistant to the Whiphid crimelord, Lady Valarian. He was the manager of the Lucky Despot.
Ussar Vlee was a Gand ruetsavii who, along with two other companions, was sent to observe Ooryl Qrygg's life and determine whether or not he was worthy of becoming janwuine.

Ixidro Legorburu was a male from M'haeli. He was once a member of New Republic Intelligence Service, and had been a tactical aide during the Black Fleet Crisis. By 25 ABY he held the rank of colonel and was the director of the Home Fleet's Battle Assessment Division.
Kav Muja was a colorful Elomin smashball analyst. He was known for his vocal support of Elomin smashball players over non-Elomin players.
Barich was a human male Imperial scout trooper who held the rank of sergeant.
Irol was a Human male clone native of an Outer Rim forest planet, where he learned how to fly a speeder bike.
Misik was a Human male who served the Galactic Empire as a scout trooper. He was a deadly shot and helped develop Imperial speeder bike tactics.
Drelosyn was a Human male who served as a Scout trooper Corporal in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps.
Tamaab Moolis was an Ithorian researcher that escaped the destruction of his homeworld. In 25 ABY, he was the Director of the Institute for Sentient Studies.
Been L'toth was a male Dornean, the son of Kiles L'toth. By 25 ABY he had taken his father's place as director for the Astrographic Survey Institute.

Doctor Saychel was a Human male who served as an officer within the New Republic Intelligence Service. He once worked with a Coruscant safe house located in the Government District alongside Showolter, and was in contact with Han Solo, Luke Skywalker, and Lando Calrissian.

Yintal was a short Human male. In 16 ABY he was working as a doctor on Coruscant and treated Plat Mallar. As of 25 ABY he was an analyst for Fleet Intelligence. He was killed in 25 ABY when the Yuuzhan Vong attacked New Nystao in an attempt to silence Elan.
Mobvekhar was a member of Clan Hakh'khar who was one of the members of the honor guard of the Mal'ary'ush.
Khakraim was a member of Clan Hakh'khar who had been transplanted to Wayland. He was attached to the NRI safe house in New Nystao.

Boz was a Human customs official on the Jubilee Wheel during the Yuuzhan Vong War. When Han Solo, using the alias of Roaky Laamu, and Roa went through a security station Boz referred to Solo's DL-44 heavy blaster pistol as an antique.
Cisgat was a male Ryn who Han Solo met in the Bet's Off tapcafe on the Jubilee Wheel in 25 BBY. He was trying to secure passage to Rhinnal.
Omal was a Human male who was a student of Sith history under the tutelage of Murk Lundi, who lived on Coruscant circa 38 BBY.

Dedra was a student interested in the Sith who studied under Doctor Murk Lundi. Following the incident which drove the doctor and his two prized students, Norval and Omal, insane, Dedra took care of the unstable Omal.

Norval was a dark-haired Human youth who studied Sith lore on Coruscant circa 39 BBY. When his professor, Murk Lundi, took a sabbatical to scour Kodai for a long-lost Sith holocron, Norval was disheartened to not accompany his mentor.

Tho Voota was a Yevethan nitakka who served during the Black Fleet Crisis as of defence for the spawnworld, an immediate subordinate of the ruling viceroy charged with the protection of the planet N'zoth.

Wadda was a male humanoid who worked as a henchman in a large slaving ring led by Zlarb around 2 BBY. A massive individual from a little-known species—very few of Wadda's kind ever left their homeworld—Wadda towered over most other beings at over 2.2 meters tall, and helped se…
Warton was a male Human former colonist from the volcanic planet of Eol Sha. He led Jedi Master Luke Skywalker to Gantoris, a Force-sensitive, for his new Jedi Academy.
Tsillin Wel was a Quarren working with New Republic Intelligence, and specialized in tracking accounts used by Imperial Intelligence to pay their operatives, spies, and other ancillary agents.
Mayli Weng was a Human female representing the Exotic Entertainers' Union on the planet Coruscant around 3.5 ABY.
Vviir Wiamdi was a Gand ruetsavii. He, along with two other members, were sent to study the Gand pilot Ooryl Qrygg and see if he was worthy of being named janwuine.
Wimateeka was the Jawa leader of the Nkik clan.
Ab'el Bogen was a Senator of the New Republic.
Some time prior to the Battle of Yavin, the Darpa sector was represented in the Imperial Senate by a female from Ralltiir. She was known for pandering to Palpatine's every demand.
Yald Sutel was a Human male officer in the New Republic Defense Force. He had a blocky head and by 25 ABY held the rank of general.

Ark Poinard was a Human male officer in the Imperial Starfleet. By 25 ABY, he held the rank of Vice Admiral. His brother was once an AT-AT commander. Poinard always revered the Force and would always utter "may the Force be with you" during battle, if only to himself.
Ven was a member of the Peace Brigade, a group of galactic citizens that cooperated with the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong invaders during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Wotson was a large male in the Peace Brigade, a band of galactic citizens that cooperated with extra-galactic invaders called the Yuuzhan Vong during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Sajé Tasha was a female Anzati assassin who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. She had long, white hair and sported clawed cortosis gauntlets that had been given to her as gifts.

Darda was a tall, dark-haired Human male who lived during the time of the New Republic. Darda was a Peace Brigader disguised as one of the NRI guards covertly stationed aboard Queen of Empire to watch over Elan and Vergere to oversee their transfer from Myrkr to Coruscant.

Capo was a Rodian male. He was a Peace Brigader disguised as one of the NRI guards covertly stationed aboard Queen of Empire to watch over Elan and Vergere to oversee their transfer from Myrkr to Coruscant. He was shot by Showolter but escaped from the cabin alive.

Jode Tee was a Human male who was an agent serving in New Republic Intelligence. As one of the guards covertly stationed aboard the passenger liner Queen of Empire, he was tasked with watching over the defecting Yuuzhan Vong priestess Elan and her familiar Vergere to oversee t…

Saiga Bre'lya was a Bothan female. She was one of the New Republic Intelligence Service guards covertly stationed aboard Queen of Empire to watch over Elan and Vergere to oversee their transfer from Myrkr to Coruscant. She was killed by blaster fire from Darda and Capo.

Antinnis Tremayne was a Human male cyborg who served as an Imperial High Inquisitor during the Galactic Civil War. An agent of Darth Vader, Tremayne was initially trained as a Padawan by Master Dav Kylanu.
Mak Jorlen was an officer in the New Republic Navy. He was the commander of the Thurse. He knew Han Solo.

Katichak was a male Anzati who learned the assassins' arts from the ancient and wise Akku Seii. He did something to warrant being tracked down and presumably killed by a Jedi named Tholme sometime before 32 BBY. Tholme had also trained under Seii.

Milo Thirk was the Intelligence Bureau Chief for Alliance Intelligence in the Bespin system. Thirk gathered information about Cloud City's new Baron Administrator, Lando Calrissian, for Alliance Intelligence officer Eddriss Sark by engaging Calrissian in small talk during seve…
Eddriss Sark was an officer in Alliance Intelligence. Milo Thirk, the Intelligence Bureau Chief in the Bespin system, sent a report on Cloud City's new Baron Administrator, Lando Calrissian, to Sark.

Jin-Jin, known as "Jin-Jin the Smuggler," was a Human smuggler and mercenary who roamed the Outer Rim Territories in his battered freighter, the Beggar's Solace, and who seemed to be haunted by bad luck.
Bora Boru was a male Bosph smuggler who operated in the Outer Rim Territories.
Pizztov was a Human who drew the ire of both Boba Fett and Sintas Vel, both of whom disliked him with much intensity.

Jericho Donovan was a smuggler in the Outer Rim and the older sister of Josephine Donovan, whom she hated immensely, and daughter of James Ortell Donovan. She was an excellent pilot, but lacked astrogation skills.
Josephine Donovan was an ambassador and smuggler in the Outer Rim and the younger sister of Jericho Donovan, whom she loathed, and daughter of James Ortell Donovan. She was a skilled astrogator.
Eldo Davip was a male Human who served as a commander of the New Republic Defense Force at the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War and general of the Galactic Alliance during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Brimon Yarar was a General in the anti-alien Human League, and lead the group's Heritage Squads.

The mysterious bounty hunter Cragus 12 was wanted by Airen Cracken and the New Republic for murder of New Republic personnel and destruction of New Republic property, as well as theft. Many considered him as mysterious as he was dangerous.

Lesh was a young male Korun rebel and the brother of Besh. Lesh had an addiction to thyssel bark, which stained his teeth and infected him with fever wasps around the time that Mace Windu arrived on Haruun Kal during the Summertime War.

After they were mined and packed on automated cargo pods, Corusca gems that were mined by GemDiver Station were sent to Lando Calrissian's Corusca gem broker, who lived and did business on Borgo Prime. He was responsible for the actual selling of the gems to interested parties.

Loci Rosen was a Mon Calamari male. He was formerly a merchant while looking for work, although everywhere he went, he turned up empty handed. Rosen served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a pilot during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, where he served as an officer.
Ghitsa "Ghits" Dogder was a female Coruscanti Human, con artist, smuggler, and partner of Fenig "Fen" Nabon, with whom she traveled with on the ship the Star Lady.

Roak was a male Human who served as the first officer aboard a Rebel Alliance blockade runner commanded by Captain Chedaki. In 3 ABY, the ship was assigned to take Princess Leia Organa to the Shiva system, in order to investigate suspicious Imperial activity in the remote region.
Jubilee was a Human Rebel Alliance officer who served alongside Captain Chedaki and First Officer Roak aboard their blockade runner during the Galactic Civil War.
Finn Darktrin was an undercover agent working for the Galactic Empire.
Leenik was the male Rodian majordomo for Borga the Hutt.
Morgan Q. Raventhorn was a Human female who served as major in the Rebel SpecForces during the Galactic Civil War. A tall dark-haired and blue-eyed woman, she was killed in the Battle of Endor.

K'zk was a Qwohog who piloted a rented barge. He was present on Zelos II, and betrayed Solum'ke and Diergu-Rea Duhnes'rd alongside two Corellians in a treasure hunt during the Day of the Sepulchral Night.
Krassis Trelix was a pilot and slaver who worked for the Karazak Slavers Cooperative.

Zubindi Ebsuk was a male Kubaz provider of fine droch appetizers, often genetically modifying them for increased size and flavor which caused mutations to occur like Dzym. Borga was a large customer and like Beldorion hired him as his personal chef.
Fhnark was the creator of Fhnark and Company.

Gardulla Besadii the Younger was the son of Gardulla Besadii the Elder and the brother of Decca Besadii Diori. He was a Hutt advisor to Borga Besadii Diori during the Yuuzhan Vong War, who suggested giving information of the Vong to the New Republic.
Velpar Raftin was a thin, hawk-faced and quite ambitious Human, who served as the planetary commandant of Sevarcos II during the Galactic Civil War.

Gab'borah Hise was Ygabba's father and a dessert chef for Jabba the Hutt. Once a head chef at a cantina in Mos Eisley, Gab'borah was considered "too successful" and was taken to serve Jabba. He was a friend of Boba Fett in Jabba's Palace.

affiliation: The clans of the Southern Deserts
x: Xerxes Quintas was a Sevari spice lord during the Galactic Civil War who ruled the clans of the Southern Deserts.

affiliation: The clans of the Equatorial Belt
x: Cassius Nolath Rha was a Sevari spice lord during the Galactic Civil War. He governed the spice rich Equatorial Belt of Sevarcos II. He was quite trim for his age and, to many, was considered a paragon of health and strength.
Slar-dan ti Gardi was a Twi'lek male criminal from the planet Ryloth. While imprisoned sometime during or after 4 ABY, he met the Quarren enslaver Borun Call and began to work with him.

Chay Praysh was a Drach'nam who controlled the planet Kvabja during the time of the New Republic. Praysh himself did not live on Kvabja, residing instead on the planet Torpris, headquarters of his slaver consortium. He held a great hatred for females, Human females in particular.
R'vanna was a male Ryn from somewhere in the Tion Hegemony. In 25 ABY, he was the leader of the Ryn City refugee group. In 26 ABY, he served as Romany's lieutenant in Settlement 32.
Lol Miilarta was a female Hapan from Terephon. She was that world's delegate in the Hapes Consortium, and voted to ally with the New Republic in the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Rol'Waran was a male Twi'lek employed by the Hutts to oversee spice shipment on the Starmaster.

Bracha e'Naso once ran Esau's Ridge. After his boss, Plothis, was shot and killed by a customer, he took over Plothis' business. During the Black Fleet Crisis he tried to cheat Chewbacca in a business deal, though he lost and allowed Chewbacca to name his price.
Golga Besadii Fir was a Hutt diplomat that served as the final ambassador on behalf of his government to the New Republic.

Orma Hundeen was a female Human. Along with Zeela Nall, Nuri Pravada, Sheyne Tyndos, and Leia Organa, she went on a mission on Elerion to recover the holocube map containing the location of Rebel bases from Nescan Tal'yo, Hermos, and Gogol.
Although appearing to be Human, her eyes had cat-like irises and were completely green-yellow.
Nuri Pravada was a female near-Human member of the Quetzal Sisters, a squad of 'femme-fatales' who worked for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

An unidentified Mandalore rose to power among the Mandalorian clans following the death of Mandalore the Ultimate at the hands of the Jedi Knight Revan at the final battle of the Mandalorian Wars. He was the last Taung to hold the title of Mandalore.

Ebrihim was a male Drall just entering middle age, the nephew of Duchess Marcha. He was somewhat tall for his species and had deep gray fur with hints of light gray around his face and throat, signifying his age.
Bow was a Human male who worked for Salliche Ag on the planet of Ruan. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, Bow escorted Han Solo through Ag's headquarters so that Solo could attempt to free a captive Droma.
Dees Harbright was a male Human who was a member of House Harbright.
Antone was a Human male from the planet Bakura. He had a thin face and a pale complexion.

Jolee Bindo was a male Human Jedi who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Great Sith War. Having participated in several Rimward missions, Bindo fought against Exar Kun, and went into self-imposed exile on Kashyyyk soon afterwards.
A pirate and starship thief, Black Jack was a nuisance to the New Republic, which issued a reward of 25,000 credits on him for piracy, theft of New Republic property, sabotage, and kidnapping.

Happy Go Lucky was a mercenary who worked with a paramilitary unit until she was fired from it for compromising a mission that cost the lives of several of her comrades. She was later employed by the pirate Black Jack who made her his second-in-command.

Uggo was a surly Whiphid present in the recreational area of the Mensix Mining Facility on Mustafar, sometime during the Galactic Civil War. He possessed little intellect and couldn't speak Basic very well, making him easily susceptible to scams.
Gramm Rile was a Human male who served as mayor of the town of Mos Taike on the Outer Rim desert world of Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Creed Mitsun was the foreman of Orbital Shipyard 1321.

Talandro Starlyte was most famous for renting the Gateway Space Station from the Galactic Empire, which he renamed Starlyte Station. His various criminal enterprises were for the most part overlooked by the Empire.

Scizzic was a male Ugnaught mechanic who worked for Talandro Starlyte on the space station Starlyte Station during the Galactic Civil War after the Battle of Yavin. A skilled mechanic, he was hired to be the primary technician for the station.

Stima Ardella was the leader of the Black Hammer pirates. Based primarily from the planet Galantos, she terrorized the local Fia, and was known to scour the Widek Bypass in her flagship, the Smokeswimmer.
Riij Winward was a male Human who served with the Rebel Alliance as a procurement specialist. He was stationed on Tatooine around the time of the Battle of Yavin.

Wiwa was a female Jedi Master during the time of the Old Republic and an instructor at the Jedi Temple. In her teachings, she stressed the importance of patience in tense situations, and to allow time for analysis before committing to any form of action.
Garve was a Human mercenary with red hair and flamboyant earrings.
Bara was a Mikan. She killed Dando and took his uniform, allowing her to move in daylight. She tried to kill Garve, but was instead killed by him.
Maia was the Human female girlfriend of Tem Chesko.
Jeet Travis was a Human male bounty hunter. He drank Vaschean rye, and was once conned out of a bottle of it by Sam Heggs in Mos Eisley.

Eero Iridian was a friend of Count Dooku's during his years at the Jedi Temple, and he aspired to be a senator in the Galactic Republic. Though he ran twice for senator, he never managed to gain any political success.
Kei was a Yevethan female, the first mate of Nil Spaar, and the darna of his family. Her birth-cask produced two nitakka—males—and one marasi—female—but eventually succumbed to the gray death.
Utoxx Prentioch was a human male who became a warlord shortly after the Battle of Endor and commanded a short-lived breakaway faction of the Galactic Empire.
Rojahn was a male Human who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Devlia was a Human male who served as an officer with the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. He came out of retirement after the Battle of Endor to help the struggling Galactic Empire.

Dracos, a Lizard Warrior, was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was part of a group of recruits that Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker was given charge of to train just after the Battle of Endor.

An unidentified Grand Protector oversaw an honor duel between Jannik the White and Evo the Blue on Rodia in 24 BBY. He consecrated the armor of the battle himself, and had Loreli Ro observe the battle with him as a guest of honor.
Mone was an Inleshat, the son the leader of the School, Primor.

Samuel Raider was a captain in the Alliance Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War. After he was captured by the Galactic Empire, Raider was sent to Stars' End prison, but was able to escape with the help of other captive Rebels.
Pei Yi was a female Human dancer, a member of a little-known troupe.

His ship came under attack by pirates while he was transporting dancer Pei Yi to Naboo. His ship's engine was damaged in the attack, though he was able to land on Mustafar for repairs and supplies. He was stranded on the Mensix Mining Facility with Yi for a long period of time.

Oolak Goyl was a Twi'lek male who had something of an obsession for collecting anything and everything, no matter what the cost. He had little interest in school as a child, and left to pursue a career of collection at an early age.

Danaan Kerr was a Human male Jedi Knight during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. After the fall of the Republic and the rise of Emperor Palpatine's New Order, Kerr gave in to the dark side of the Force and went insane.

Brashaa was a member of the Empire Reborn, which was led by the Dark Jedi Hethrir, the former Procurator of Justice of the Galactic Empire. He was rich and powerful, owning vast resources including starships and having several followers.
Kiv Truun was the Viceroy of N'zoth when the Yevetha were conquered by the Galactic Empire. Nil Spaar killed Kiv in the presence of Eri Palle, and succeeded him as viceroy.

Nimondro was a male Hobor who served as the Chief of the Hobor people of Tahlboor around 5.5 BBY. He managed to learn about the sky cannon and how to use it, attempting to use it as leverage for peace talks with the Troobs. He truly wanted peace between the two peoples.
Larka Nimondro was a female Hobor and the daughter of Chief Nimondro who led the species. She was in love with Ket Krax, and was framed for his murder by Jake Harthan.

Stigrit Krax was a female Troob, the wife of General Krax and the mother of Ket Krax. She tried to sabotage Counselor Harthan's attempts to mediate a truce between the Troobs and Hobors by deliberately misinterpreting what the Hobor delegate said, and then by buying C-3PO from…
Counselor Harthan was a human male diplomat of the Tion Hegemony who once owned C-3PO and R2-D2.
Jake Harthan was a male Human from the Tion Hegemony, the son of Counselor Harthan.
Ket Krax was a male Troob. He was the son of General Krax and Stigrit Krax. He was secretly in love with Larka Nimondro, the daughter of the enemy Chief Nimondro.

Torvon was a male of an unknown humanoid species whose features included a shiny forehead split into brain-increasing hemispheres, pupilless pale green eyes, and size that had a Sullustan's shoulders come only to his kneecaps.
Milo Mensix was the founder of Mensix Corp and the Mensix Mining Facility on Mustafar.

Kinnin Vo-Shay was a slightly Force-sensitive gambler. He was considered a handsome man, with stony features and a jagged scar starting at his lip and running past his nose. His hair had turned white by the time he reached his fifties.
Nicta was Jacen Solo's childhood pet gort.
Sulamar was a Human officer in the Imperial Army and an ally to Durga Besadii Tai in his Darksaber project. Sulamar falsely claimed to be an Imperial General.
Milnn was a male Imperial Navy TIE pilot captain who was the leader of Delta Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.

Alph was a Human male pilot in the Rebel Alliance's Rogue Squadron in the year 3 ABY. When the Alliance learned that a massive Imperial armada was transporting a communications-amplifying Teezl creature to the Empire's capital planet of Coruscant, Alph was one of four Rogues s…

Erl was a Human male who served as a member of the Imperial Star Destroyer crew commanded by Major Voss. Their ship was part of the secret armada commanded by Admiral Mils Giel, tasked with transporting a mysterious creature known as the teezl to the Imperial capital.

One of his several responsibilities was to ensure the mining crews received their appropriate supplies. On one occasion where supply droids were failing to deliver their shipments, Chivos resorted to employing random spacers to do the job.

Tocneppil was a smuggler at the height of the New Order, a political ideology declared with the Galactic Empire's formation in 19 BBY. Corellian smuggler Han Solo worked with Tocneppil, with the pair once getting lost and not being able to find their ship.

Estosh was the Vagaari male that was the Supreme Commander of the Vagaari Empire who played an important role in the capture of one of the six original Dreadnaughts from the ruins of Outbound Flight. He was born sometime after 27 BBY.

Jai Raventhorn was a Human female Rebel commando. In 2 ABY she led a Rebel team to Bevell Three to capture four Imperial agents, but the mission was compromised: only Jai escaped. The four Infiltrators commandos who died included Leong.

Akkik was a male Jawa living on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. During this time, he collected protection money from local businesses for Jabba Desilijic Tiure. He was protected by Gorrt the Gamorrean.
Valius Ying was a male Twi'lek pirate who was notorious in the Outer Rim during the Mandalorian Wars. Ying was the captain of the starship Oroko, and headed a crew of several gangsters.

Tal Pak was a notorious smuggler during the Galactic Civil War. He was an oily fellow with a rat-like face and rotting teeth. He met with Rebel agents in the Red Moon Saloon on Tatooine where he sold them information on the location of vital starship spare parts.

Vassk was a sinister-looking Twi'lek smuggler working for Tal Pak. He accompanied Pak to the Red Moon Saloon on Tatooine to rendezvous with Rebel agents. Prior to that Vassk had tipped off the Galactic Empire for a substantial reward, thus betraying Pak.

Dagnian Sark was a fanatically loyal Imperial Security Bureau agent sent to Sirpar to identify Rebel spies. He posed as a regular recruit, hoping to one day catch a Rebel spy in the act and thus get a promotion. He was slender and agile, with an overly friendly attitude.

Vreel was a recruit at Training Camp IMIIF-138 on Sirpar. He was tall and slender with visible tattoos on the sides of his scalp. He hailed from a backwater world on the fringes of the Galactic Empire.
Yemm was a male Devaronian. He supervised and provided documentation and legal counsel over the Maw Installation.
Dellis Yuls was a male Quarren. He was Chief of Security for Ororo Transportation, the main rival of the Falleen crime lord Prince Xizor's cargo company.

Shalo was a Human male who owned a cantina on Mos Eisley during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Once a petty thug for Durga Besadii Tai, Shalo later worked for Hirth, though that relationship soured and he became reconnected with the Hutts, who sent him to Tatooine.
Toile Senn was a male Rodian Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order who served in the time after the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Orinn Tathis was an Alderaanian politician. During the early years of the Galactic Empire, Tathis served on the Council of Elders.

Dorsk 80 was the genetic predecessor to Dorsk 81. He was much more conservative than either Dorsk 81 or Dorsk 82, and had fully expected Dorsk 81 to return to his former position at the Cloning facility. Dorsk 80 was killed when Colonel Ivan Cronus attacked Khomm.
Kaell 116 was the leader of Dorsk 81's home city at the time he returned from the Jedi Praxeum in 12 ABY. His line had been running the city's politics for decades.
Kaell was the original Khomm politician that started the cloned lineage that would later include Kaell 115 and Kaell 116.
Kaell 115 was the leader of Dorsk 81's home city at the time he left for the Jedi Praxeum in 11 ABY. His line had been running the city's politics for decades.

A male Abyssin, Cyceyed was an aggressive individual who was known to visit Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina during the year 1 ABY. During one particular visit, Cyceyed pulled a knife on his fellow patron Arleil Schous.
Dratun was a Gotal who, around 1.5 ABY, sat drinking with the Rodian Bludlow in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina, located in the planet Tatooine's city of Mos Eisley.
Yamnoss was a H'nemthe patron at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.
Korrda was a Hutt slave and adjutant to Durga. He suffered from a wasting disease which left him thin, and as a result mocked by his fellow Hutts.

Nonak was a Cathar poacher and hunter. Along with his brother Nodon and a stormtrooper deserter named Burrk, they tried to hunt wampas on Hoth (a highly illegal act) in 12 ABY. Nonak cared about his brother greatly. He was torn apart by a pack of wampas while saving him.

Drom Guldi, a Human male, was the Baron-Administrator of the Kelrodo-Ai gelatin mines, and a big-game hunter. In 12 ABY, Guldi went on a hunting expedition run by the former stormtrooper Burrk in search of wampas on Hoth.
Sinidic was the aide to Baron Administrator Drom Guldi. He was a nervous-looking Human male with gray-blonde hair and a wrinkled face. He was killed by a wampa on Hoth.

Trandia was a Human woman with blue eyes and long strawberry-blond hair. She was Crix Madine's most capable female commando. She killed herself by detonating her explosives onboard the Darksaber after being cornered by guards.
Korenn was a Human male with spiky, sandy hair who looked younger than his experiences foretold. He was one of Crix Madine's commandos.

Tull Raine was a pit-fighting Barabel shock boxer. He held the Outer Rim Title for many years during the Age of the Galactic Empire and into the New Republic. He did most of his fighting in the Dool Arena of the The Broken Tusk on Reuss VIII.

Orem Ulum was an Imperial chief customs inspector at Brentaal IV starport. He typically wore an officer's cap to control his mop of blonde hair, his credit pouch prominently visible in his belt, and a silly expectant smile when greeting freighter captains.

Vleen appeared cool, calm, and patient, but was in reality extremely short-tempered. She was known to shoot freighter captains at point blank for mouthing off and to blast ships out of the sky for not following procedure.
She was driven by vengeance towards the Empire who had done great injustice to her in the past. She constantly drove her pilots to performing their best.

Testan ke Harran was an Adumari guide of Jacen Solo and Ben Skywalker during a Mission to Adumar in 40 ABY. Balding, black-bearded ke Harran toured the two young Jedi around the Dammant Killers concussion missile factory, covering up whole assembly lines of missiles.
Meewalh was one of Leia Organa Solo's personal Noghri bodyguards, one of the few in service to the Princess to survive the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Durgard Brarun was a male Duros who served as vice-director of CorDuro Shipping during the Yuuzhan Vong War. His sister was Ducilla, and he was married, with a married son. He was an admirer of Palpatine, whose reign he had lived through.

Swori Mdimu was an Etti spacer who shipped weaponry to the Peace Brigade. His vessel, the Tinmolok, was captured by the Millennium Falcon (under the guise of Princess of Blood), and the Tinmolok was confiscated. Mdimu and his crew were then jettisoned in an escape pod.
Dainsom was a Human native of the planet Algarian who served as an Imperial Navy trooper during the Galactic Civil War.
Ta'a Chume was the Queen Mother of the Hapes Consortium during the first part of the Galactic Civil War, the mother of Isolder, and the grandmother of Tenel Ka Djo.
Melaan Nar was a male Yuuzhan Vong who was a member of the Intendant caste. A Consul of Domain Nar, he developed a rivalry with Consul Von of Domain Shul.
Roonyard Noon was a Sy Myrthian lawyer whose wife and three children were aboard the hijacked Elegant Wake.

Deme Tryshyn was Grav-ball's highest scorer in history. In 22 BBY, he signed the most lucrative product endorsement deal in sports history, with Ardees Beverage Company for 3.1 billion credits over three standard years.
Toniv was an officer of the Imperial Navy.
Snayd was a male Bothan and a member of the New Republic Defense Force. He served as an aide to Admiral Traest Kre'fey.

Lilla Dade was a Human female who served as a member of the Katarn Commandos and was considered one of their best trackers. In preparation for the assault on Kal'Shebbol, she was sent planetside as the primary infiltrator in Moff Kentor Sarne's base.
Peralli was a male Mon Calamari spacer associated with Nym around 1.5 ABY. He was killed by Finn Darktrin when Imperials attacked his ship while bringing Dusque Mistflier and Finn to Corellia.

Giles Durane, also known as the "Weapons Master," was a Human male veteran who was a friend of Bail Prestor Organa, whom he served with during the Clone Wars. Durane's family was killed when his homeworld was hit with a plague; left poor and cynical, Durane became a mercenary.
Thorp was a pale-skinned Sakiyan. Residing on Tatooine, Ackmena had done him an important favor in the past. Because of this, he was often a guest of hers at the Mos Eisley cantina.
Commander Fuce served in the Galactic Empire. He commanded a small garrison of stormtroopers on Dantooine around 1 ABY.
During the insurrection she became increasingly exasperated at the Admiral's childish behavior, sporadic loss of thought processes and lack of improvisation at crucial moments.

Borth Pazz was a citizen of Lorrd as of 40 ABY. Despite lacking Force-sensitivity, he dressed himself in Jedi-style robes and carried a non-functional, pre-Clone Wars lightsaber he'd stolen from a museum.
Ordith Huarr was a Lorrdian male and lifetime citizen of Lorrd.
During a visit by Jacen Solo and Ben Skywalker, Samran witnessed a rise in Jedi-related crimes and suicide attempts, including sightings of Force ghosts - including Borth Pazz and Ordith Huarr.
Karniss was a Trandoshan slaver working for the Confederacy of Independent Systems. He led a slaver unit to the Wawaatt Archipelago during the Battle of Kashyyyk of the Clone Wars.

Mich Flenn was a Human male who worked as an old bar owner on Nar Shaddaa. In his younger days, he was a smuggler. When he earned enough money, he bought small bar in the Corellian Sector—the Blue Light.

Najus was a Sith artisan who at one point pursued a vendetta against the Jedi Order. To aid with his efforts, Najus crafted the powerful and legendary dark side artifacts known as the Bracers of Najus.

Ernek Marskan was a captain in the Alliance Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War by 1 BBY. He served as a pilot with Blue Squadron on the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence, participating in many missions by that year.

Casal Marskan was a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served aboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence during the Galactic Civil War. Casal was the younger brother of Ernek Marskan, another pilot serving aboard the Independence.
Gilflyn was a male Human who became a corrupt and psychotic Dark Jedi who lived on Corellia at the time of the founding of the New Republic.
Zueb Zan was Syal Antilles' gunner during the Battle of Tralus in the Second Galactic Civil War. Hailing from Sullust, Zan was among the first involved to test the Aleph starfighter.
The Head Proctor was the head of the Proctors used by Lord Hethrir. He was a young Human male and was distinguished from other Proctors by his numerous medals.
Barid Mesoriaam was a high-ranked male Human agent of the Corellian Resistance. He was one of the few who had Bria Tharen's personal holocomm code.
Cardacs was a lieutenant and pilot in the Rebel Alliance's Red Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Tol Getelles was a male Human Moff who was in control of the Antemeridian sector.

Faime Gosan was a young Human female who hailed from the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. During the last few years of the Galactic Republic, she frequented the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall located in the Uscru Entertainment District of her homeworld.
Fenn Rizaar was a highly successful bounty hunter from the Mantis Syndicate who later joined the Black Bha'lir.
Nomi was a female Selonian advocate from the Corellian Tribunal and supporter of the Rebel Alliance. She was killed in Nashal by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Gregor Raquoran was the Commerce Master Commissioner of the Velcar Free Commerce Zone.
Wyrn Otro worked for Galentro Heavy Works corporation, unswervingly loyal as he regarded it as his only family. He represented the corporation at the Pentastar Talks in 7 ABY.
Kol Skywalker was a Force-sensitive Human male Jedi Master and the head of the Jedi High Council. Descended from Anakin Skywalker and Luke Skywalker, he grew to be a powerful and respected Jedi.
Darth Nihl was a Nagai male Sith Lord serving in Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the Sith–Imperial War and the Second Imperial Civil War.

Shado Vao was a male Rutian Twi'lek Jedi Master who was the apprentice of Kol Skywalker and a close friend to Kol's son, Cade Skywalker during the time of the Sith–Imperial War and the subsequent Second Imperial Civil War against Darth Krayt and the One Sith.

Wolf Sazen was a male Zabrak Jedi Master who was active during the Sith–Imperial War and the subsequent Second Imperial Civil War against Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire. He was Kol Skywalker's Padawan and the Jedi Master of Kol's son, Cade.

Darth Wyyrlok was a male Chagrian Sith Lord and foremost loremaster of the One Sith. He was afforded a title of hereditary esteem in his capacity as the most trusted servant of the Dark Lord Darth Krayt, only to whom Wyyrlok was second in knowledge and power.

Darth Stryfe was a brutal man who was a member of the One Sith Order led by Darth Krayt, a Dark Lord of the Sith. Eventually rising to the rank of Sith Lord, Stryfe served Krayt after the deposing of Emperor Roan Fel at the end of the Sith–Imperial War.

Darth Maladi, born Malincha, was a Force-sensitive Devaronian female who was taken by the Sith from her homeworld of Devaron following the death of her Jedi parent at the hands of Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt.

Morlish Veed was a male human who served as the Grand Moff of the Fel Empire, as well as Grand Admiral and one of the foremost leaders as a High Moff in the Council of Moffs around 130 ABY until he reached the rank of Lord Regent of the Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the…

Roan Fel was a Human male who served as the third Galactic Emperor of the galaxy under the Fel dynasty to rule the Fel Empire. Roan was the grandson of Jagged Fel, the head of the Moff Council following the Second Galactic Civil War.
Marasiah Fel, affectionately known as Sia, was a Force-sensitive Human female who became Empress of the Fel Empire by the end of the Second Imperial Civil War.
Ganner Krieg was a Human Master of the Imperial Knights who served Emperor Roan Fel's Empire-in-exile during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Antares Draco was a Force-sensitive Human male who led the Imperial Knights during the Second Imperial Civil War. A skilled pilot and lightsaber duelist, Draco was fiercely loyal to and willing to die for Roan Fel, Emperor of the Galactic Empire and later the Empire-in-exile.
Sigel Dare was a Human female who served Emperor Roan Fel of the Empire-in-exile as an Imperial Knight Master during the Second Imperial Civil War.
Lagrane was a male commander who served in the Rebel Alliance aboard the MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser Independence during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.

Wex "TIE-Die" Dafid was a commander in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served as Starfighter Command's tactical training officer on the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence during the early Galactic Civil War.

H. S'man was a commander in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served as one of the chief mission planning officers on the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War.
Rulf Yage was a hardliner Human male Moff and a decorated Grand Admiral during the time of the Fel Empire in 130 ABY.

Morrigan Corde was a Human female who served as an Imperial Intelligence agent before and during the Sith–Imperial War and later a Moff in the Moff High Council of the new Galactic Empire around 137 ABY under the persona of Nyna Calixte.

Kee was a female Devaronian smuggler copilot and mechanic onboard the Grinning Liar, a YX-1980 space transport belonging to the Wookiee Chak. She enjoyed taking mechanical things apart just for the joy of reassembling them and specialized in micro/biocircuitry.

Attatag Gosem was a Gotal who won the Big Game, a gladiatorial event on The Wheel space station, for three consecutive years around 130 ABY. The competition was abolished when The Wheel changed ownership, and he turned to a life of crime, working as a spy and information broker.

Finn was a Sakiyan male who worked as a bartender for Rik's Cantina in the galactic capital Coruscant's underworld during the Second Imperial Civil War. He also served as the main bouncer of Rik's, which was owned by the Hutt Queen Jool.
Queen Jool was the Hutt owner of two cantinas who doubled as an information broker and also a member of the Hutt Grand Council during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Naxy Screeger was a compulsive Sakiyan gambler who was perpetually in debt. Screeger tended to stop in the middle of sentences to think about what he would say next, usually in the form of "whaddya call it."

Rasi Tuum was a Cathar who, along with his littermates, Ahn and Zho, served the Jedi Order during the Sith–Imperial War and Second Imperial Civil War. Eventually ascending to the rank of Master, he trained the Human female Azlyn Rae as his Padawan in the ways of the Force.

Hosk Trey'lis, a male Bothan Jedi Knight and healer, was one of the Jedi who worked on the Ossus Project—the project to have the Yuuzhan Vong terraform the worlds that had been ravaged by their invasion of the galaxy.
Gunn Yage was a Human female pilot in the Imperial Navy around 137 ABY. Piloting Skull One—a Predator-class starfighter—under the call sign of "Gunner", she led Skull Squadron.
Tev Rimon, a Human male, was a starfighter pilot in the service of Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt's New Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Jae Akura, a Human male, was a starfighter pilot in the service of Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt's Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War. He flew under the call sign of "Storm" in Captain Gunn Yage's Skull Squadron, a Predator-class fighter unit.

Brodie Coburn, a Human male, was a starfighter pilot in the service of Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt's Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War. He flew Skull Three under the call sign of "Cannon" in Captain Gunn Yage's Skull Squadron, a Predator-class fighter unit.

Konrad Rus was a Human male who served as a Moff of the Fel Empire. During the Sith–Imperial War, Rus was a member of the Moff High Council and the leader of the Imperial Mission, an organization born out of Emperor Jagged Fel's Victory Without War program.
Fel II was the second Galactic Emperor of the galaxy under the Fel dynasty.
Demmings was a Human male who served as a commander in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire, as well as an intermediary between the Empire and the Tiss'sharl League on Tiss'sharl.
"Winged Gundark" was the nickname among the peers of a TIE pilot in the Imperial Navy who attained the nickname for an impressive number of career kills in high-altitude battles by 3 ABY.

Urup Fal'co was a Mustafarian of the Mensix Mining Company. He was present in the Mensix Mining Facility on Mustafar at the point where the company was suffering a small labor crisis. Many miners went on strike, and refused to talk to company representatives.
Nos'lyn was a male Human Jedi who managed to escape the Great Jedi Purge. As of 1 ABY, he could be found hiding out at the Tansarii Point Station.

Urootar was a male Human Jedi who had served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic before the rise of the Galactic Empire. Going into hiding on Kashyyyk, he had descended into madness and strayed from the Jedi Path.

Roxi Barl was a freelance assassin and thug in the Corellian sector, well known to CorSec. She and her sister, Deli, long dreamed of getting rich, and finally managed it when Deli married CorDuro's Vice-President of Fleets.

Aved Luun was a female Jawa shaman from Tatooine. By 4 ABY, she and her mate Kalit led a clan that almost got into a war with another clan led by Jawas Wittin and Herat, who arranged raids and stealing salvaged goods from other Jawas and accused Luun and Kalit's clan for the a…

Sla Tsun was a member of Domain Tsun and one of six Yuuzhan Vong Supreme Commanders that commanded the flotilla sent to attack Zonama Sekot during the Battle of Yuuzhan'tar. Warmaster Nas Choka ordered him and Supreme Commander Tivvik to drive their mataloks into Zonama Sekot.
Lol was a male native of Solem, living during the Galactic Civil War. He was part of a resistance movement against the planetary Governor, Malvander Bren.

Akal Zed was the captain of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Stalker, part of Villis Andal's fleet in the Elrood sector. He had a great rivalry with Tanda Pryl, captain of the Thunderflare, whom he considered to be incompetent and unfit.

Stempel was a Human male major and commanding officer in the Pelek Baw militia during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Haruun Kal, Stempel was ordered by Lorz Geptun to send a specific code to the droid starfighters in order to attack the city.

Mayth Duvel was a Black Sun sublieutenant during the Galactic Civil War. He was among the few loyal underlings of Dark Prince Xizor, Underlord of Black Sun, who could claim the privilege to visit Xizor within his personal sanctum on the planet Coruscant.

Colby Hoff was a male and formerly a pesky business competitor of Prince Xizor, the leader of the Black Sun crime syndicate. After a failed gamble to outsmart Xizor left him ruined, Colby committed suicide by firing a blaster into his mouth and blowing off the back of his head.

Ali Tarrak was a female Nami who was the leader of her people during the Galactic Civil War. Operating as pirates in the Outer Rim Territories, the Nami captured a prototype of the TIE Defender starfighter from the Galactic Empire around 3.5 ABY.

Damien Tantrellius was a Jedi Knight who served during the Clone Wars. Following an incident that resulted in the death of future-Governor Zannen's wife, Tantrellius lost his memory, and subsequently took up a new career as an actor.
Tarania Lona was an actress of note during the period surrounding the Battle of Tralus. She appeared in the holosquirmer genre. By some accounts, she possessed superlative qualities.
This Quarren Commander commanded the Quarren Isolation League forces against Jedi Master Kit Fisto's clone SCUBA trooper forces during the Battle of Mon Calamari in the Clone Wars.
Terrel Nakay was a Balawai teenager who lived in Haruun Kal during the Clone Wars.
Thaffal was a Korun male Akk Guard from Haruun Kal during the Summertime War.
In 1 ABY a man-eating tulrus attacked several of Glost's mining teams, wounding several and killing eight miners who had been out on survey missions in the area near the Tulrus Nesting Grounds.
Trent was a male captain in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. He was in command of the Acclamator-class assault ship Halleck when it was assigned to Jedi Master Mace Windu in 22 BBY.

Urhal was an officer in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. Urhal held the rank of commander, and was stationed on the Republic warship Halleck. In 21 BBY, Urhal was a commander on the cruiser Halleck in Haruun Kal's orbit during the battle there.

Urno was a Balawai child who lived in Haruun Kal during the Clone Wars. He was Nykl's brother. While fleeing a battle during the Summertime War, he, Pell Nakay, Terrel Nakay, Keela Nakay, and Nykl had an accident when their steamcrawler was stuck in a lava flow, but Jedi Maste…
Bullba Bari was a Gungan who founded BullbaBong, a successful manufacturer and seller of bongos. He was the father of Toba and the husband of Neesada Bari.
Verga Nus was one of the founders of the Verga Mer Mining Company around 62 BBY, along with fellow Sullustan businessman Mer Stodiz.
Mer Stodiz was one of the founders of the Verga Mer Mining Company around 62 BBY, along with fellow Sullustan businessman Verga Nus.

Gad "Slug" Sluggins was a member of the Peace Brigade who in 26 ABY tried to capture Leia Organa Solo on Corellia only to be shot between the shoulder blades with a stun bolt by Han Solo. His leader Roxi Barl was killed.
Jasper Nimbi was a doctor on Corellia in 26 ABY who treated Leia Organa Solo and Jedi Master Eelysa. He was pro-Jedi and opposed Thrackan Sal-Solo and the Peace Brigade.
Victor Pomt was a male Human and the Staff Chief of Senator Viqi Shesh. Pomt aided Shesh on several bribery assassination attempts, hiring freelance assassin Roxi Barl for the senator.

Manuel "Manny" Both-Hanz was a Human agent of the Rebel Alliance. He had a romantic relationship with Mon Mothma, the Alliance Chief of State, and died while trying to get the plans to the Death Star II to the Alliance.
Kintaro was one of the first twenty Grand Moffs of the Galactic Empire, ruling over the Sarin Oversector as its regional governor from 19 BBY until his death around 3.5 ABY.

Tchai was an Imperial governor, presumably of Challon. While he disagreed with some of the Emperor's increasing restrictions, he saw no alternative. He expressed these views to Princess Leia Organa after she gave a speech while on visit to Challon.

Caiza Quill was a male X'ting leader who was one of the Cestus Cybernetics Families, a member of the Hive Council and the cousin of the Regent of Ord Cestus, G'Mai Duris. He was descended from a 500-year-old assassin family and was married to Sabit.
Lamuu Bianco was a pirate and founder of Port Bianco on Lammax.
Shanto Dhil was a bacta pirate and former mayor of Port Bianco on Lammax.
Z. Limmer was the chief financial officer of Ororo Transportation, a thin, short, and nervous man.
Gimlet was the partner of "Weapons Master" Giles Durane. He and his partner Durane had been hired by Bail Organa to train his daughter, Leia Organa, in the use of weapons.

"Aach" was the code name of a Human male who served as a Rebel agent during the Galactic Civil War. In 2 BBY, he informed Garm Bel Iblis of the Death Star plans. Directly answerable to Bail Organa, Aach was a special messenger that was only used for top-level Alliance business.
Emir was an Imperial general who attempted to assassinate Princess Leia Organa with members of the Assassin's Guild on Challon.
Fé was a female Human who served as a handmaiden to Queen Amidala in Theed. In 32 BBY, she was present during the celebrations held in the wake of the Invasion of Naboo.
Darth Wyyrlok was a Chagrian Sith Lord who served as the chief lieutenant and protector of Darth Krayt, Dark Lord of the One Sith, as well as the role of Voice during his time in stasis.

Darth Wyyrlok was a female Chagrian who served the Sith Lord Darth Krayt as a Sith Master. She became Krayt's closest advisor sometime after 41 ABY, following in the footsteps of her father, who had also been called Darth Wyyrlok.
Zlato was a Toydarian and professional thief. He and his alien friend worked Cloud City stealing from rich denizens.
Ymile was a Human female who was the wife of Baron Administrator Dominic Raynor.
Tungo Li was the head of the Rebel Alliance spy network in 0 ABY. He was small with large pointed ears, a tail, and brown fur on his arms and back.
Wyl Tarson was an undercover agent for the Alliance to Restore the Republic who infiltrated the organization of the crime lord Raze.
Raze was the head of a multi-species information brokering organization.
Noop Yeldarb was an elderly Human man from Roon who maintained the lightstation in the Cloak of the Sith.
Spero was a male Ho'Din who lived in the Southern Underground on Coruscant.
Daiv was a Human male brother of Lair and of Benedict Vidkun's wife.

Evet Scy'rrep was a noted shipjacker who stole over fifteen large ships before getting caught, with riches of millions. When asked why he only hijacked luxury liners, he merely replied: "Because that's where the credits are."

Bentu Pall Tarlen was the head of the Imperial Center Construction Contracts Division around 3.5 ABY. He had contacts with Xizor, and provided him information on how to get in on buying possible construction contracts.
Wendell Wright-Sims, a Human, was a well-to-do Coruscanti socialite and Imperial Center's premier spice dealer during the Galactic Civil War.

For'ali was an elderly Twi'lek scholar during the reign of the Galactic Alliance. A tan-skinned Twi'lek from Ryloth, For'ali was an expert in non-verbal communication, and was an acquaintance of Jacen Solo.
Faye Patrick was a female Zabrak criminal who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Bandor Mokk was a male Bothan who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Alana Walden was a female Corellian officer of the CorSec security division during the Galactic Civil War.
Marx Grocco was a Human male who lived in the the Corellian system during the Galactic Civil War. He worked for the Cluster World Relations agency.
The Kiisa Kimotte was a Selonian Female who lived on Talus during the Galactic Civil War. She was the den mother of the Neetha Den.

Stevan Makintay, also known as "Mak," was a Human male born on the planet of Hargeeva. The son of the world's High King, Makintay was raised in wealth and privilege. Despite his heritage, Lord Makintay, as he was known, held the view that all beings were equal.
Digger was an Advanced Recon Commando and one of a group of clone troopers left behind on Pengalan IV after their LAAT/i was shot down during a full scale Republic retreat.

Morrs was a lieutenant with the New Republic Defense Fleet. He was the head of the scanning team sent to Yavin 4 in 11 ABY to determine if Kyp Durron had stolen the Sun Crusher. His team was unable to find conclusive readings.

Tyrann was a male Human living on Ophideraan during the Galactic Civil War. He was the Supreme Master of the Serpent Masters, ruling from the Great Well. He was an imposing man with a short beard and commonly wore a white cloak and headwrap.
Fyg was a male Weequay security guard on the Errant Venture around 11 ABY.
Kruqr was a scrawny male Human security guard on the Errant Venture around 11 ABY.

Bjork Umi was called a "Vermin Hunter" by Tsavong Lah who used him to try to assassinate Borsk Fey'lya in 27 ABY. He was killed by Leia Organa Solo along with his associate when they tried to kill Fey'lya.
Yarsroot was a Ho'Din chef who worked on the Lady Luck during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He was a part of the plan to turn over the Myrkr strike team so they could destroy the voxyn.
Bedamyr was a male general in the New Republic charged with protecting Coruscant during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He owned pet mynocks which he occasionally lost. He worked with Wedge Antilles.

Ingo Dar was a male Yuuzhan Vong warrior who escorted Viqi Shesh when she tried to kidnap Ben Skywalker from the Solos' apartment. He wore an ooglith masquer during the operation to disguise himself as a Human male.
Rabb was a male Sullustan admiral who owed his rise in rank to Sien Sovv. He protested Chief of State Borsk Fey'lya's dismissal of Sovv during the Battle of Coruscant.
Godt was a male Sullustan Commander of the New Republic who owed his rise in rank to Sien Sovv. He later fought in the Battle of Coruscant.

Anga was the communications officer for the Bail Organa under Garm Bel Iblis. In 27 ABY, she served under his command during the fall of Coruscant and was ordered by him to tell Fleet Command that he would not withdraw.
Dab Hantaq was a male Human from Coruscant. He worked as a documentarian, and later became an Alliance Marshal assigned as a Jedi supervisor.
Tosruk was a house servant of Rostek Horn. He was a small, wiry Human male with olive skin and brown eyes. He worked for the Corellian government, although his true loyalty was to Horn.

Vana Dorja was a Human female who served as a commander in the Navy of the Imperial Remnant during the Yuuzhan Vong War. She was an inquisitive and observant woman with a partisan Imperial frame of mind.
Hhen was a pilot who served in the New Republic and flew during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Thespar Trode was a female Ishi Tib astrophysicist and a friend of Danni Quee's.
Kartha was a male Elomin captain of the Pulsar in the New Republic and served under General Keyan Farlander.
Otias Atori was a male Human who served as a stage coach of Adalric Cessius Brandl and surrogate father of Jaalib Brandl during the Empire's rise by Emperor Palpatine.
Deke Holman was a male Socorran who served as a member of the Rebel Alliance Harrier Infiltration Team during the Galactic Civil War. He was also a crew member on the Prodigal.
Denin was the prince of the planet Naldar, who led a native resistance to Imperial forces during the Galactic Civil War.

affiliation: Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification
x: Chanceller or Chance was a Human male lieutenant who served the Galactic Empire during the height of the Galactic Civil War. His horror of the war eventually caused him to defect from his line of duty.
Keevy Spart was a Human male from Corellia. He was slender, freckled, had short red hair, and resembled Kirtan Loor.
Biril was a large Human male member of the Khuiumin Survivors. He had previously worked as a manicurist.
Annissya was a Human female flight attendant working for Tinta Lines. She was stationed on Tinta Blue Seven.
Hassla'tak was the male Twi'lek helmsman of the Errant Venture.

Jacob Nive was a Human male who employed himself as a pirate with the Eyttyrmin Batiiv organization based on Courkrus during the Galactic Civil War. When the band was all but wiped out by Imperial forces, he became the leader of their remnants, dubbed the Khuiumin Survivors.
Nakk Kech was the commander of the Khuiumin Survivors' Rock Squadron. He had thinning gray and brown hair and his cheeks were covered in stubble.
Timmser was a tall Human female with short blond hair. She was a tri-fighter pilot flying with the Khuiumin Survivors pirate gang, specifically their Rock Squadron.

Parma was a Human male freedom fighter who lived on the planet of Mandalore. He served under Mandalorian Protector Fenn Shysa, who set his broken leg after one skirmish. Parma was present when Princess Leia Organa visited Shysa's forest base in 3 ABY.

J'ane Khan was an assassin for the GenoHaradan, a secret society of bounty hunters. They wore durasteel heavy armor and wielded two GenoHaradan poison blades. Khan was a Human male with light skin, brown eyes, and black hair.

Az-Iban was an eccentric smuggler who flew the Rampaging Ranat, a YT-2400 light freighter. The Force-sensitive Kowakian monkey-lizard Picaroon C. Boodle was Iban's pet and first mate, until Eriadu forces quarantined Pic, accusing him of carrying Cyborrean rabies.
Daushoroc was an Eirrauc. He and another Eirrauc named Tamoss helped each other escape from Imperial slavery, settling other slaves on a safeworld before striking out on their own.

Tamoss, like his partner Daushoroc, was an Eirrauc and a former slave of the Galactic Empire. After escaping together, and settling some other escaped slaves on a safeworld, they became dealers in gems, curiosities, and rare artifacts.
Ferleen Snee was a Jedi Master. He was noted for his curmudgeonly personality, and his mastery of telekinesis, as illustrated in one unverified legend about him.
T'dai was a male Zabrak Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic three hundred years after the passage of the Ruusan Reformations.
Michael Tandre was a male Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order.

Tooka was a Jedi who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, two colonists, Calder Nettic and Rickard Lusoff, engaged in a drunken altercation in a cantina at the spaceport of Garang, the capital city of the Outer Rim planet Dant…

Travgen was a male Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final days of the Galactic Republic. At some point in his life, Travgen lost his way and strayed down the path of the dark side of the Force.
Remoh was a male Squidge and the den-brother of Otalp who lived long after the death of Luke Skywalker. His species was being oppressed by the Vindar.
Tik Tali Talosh was the President of the Max Rebo Fan Club's Derf Chapter.

Breedo was a Rodian enforcer thought to be a cousin of the bounty hunter Greedo. In the year 32 BBY, the Rodian watched the Boonta Eve Classic podrace from the Toydarian junk dealer Watto's private box in the Mos Espa Grand Arena on the planet Tatooine.

Dax Gazaway was a Podracing announcer who covered many races on the Outer Rim prior to the Clone Wars during the year 24 BBY. Dax's hometown was Mos Espa, a city located on the Outer Rim planet of Tatooine. He was said to know every pilot in the circuits he broadcast.

Ony Bobissia was a Triffian who was on the planet Coruscant during the year 22 BBY. By that time, Bobissia had become a regular at the eatery Dex's Diner, and one day outside of the diner, the Triffian chatted with a Nuknog named Slyther Bushforb.
Rasper was a mercenary who presumably worked with Arwen Cohl's team in the Nebula Front. He was shot and killed by a droid prior to the incident at Dorvalla.
Wallon was the commander of Slash Squadron.
Colonel Lamner was a TIE fighter pilot for the Imperial Navy.
Donni Bratz was a sentient male being who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 20 BBY, he went on a trip with his brother, Chuck Bratz, aboard the starship Reasonable Doubt.

Chuck Bratz was a young boy and the older brother of Donni Bratz. On the ship Reasonable Doubt, they were in the Kidz Arkade. Chuck was playing Wookiee Warpath for his fourth consecutive game, shutting his brother up as he pleaded for a try at the game.

This female was the mother of Chuck and Donni Bratz. She was always trying to break up arguments between the two. She told Chuck to not call Donni a "meatface", yet she reminded Donni that Chuck was the best older brother one could ask for.

Blook was a pirate and a starfighter pilot who flew for the Khuiumin Survivors' Rock Squadron. He was killed during Admiral Leonia Tavira's assault on Xa Fel when he attacked a formation of New Republic A-wings that were going after the Backstab.
Yander was a member of the Khuiumin Survivors Rock Squadron. He was killed at the Second Battle of Xa Fel when he attacked New Republic A-wings.
Kea Moll was a Human female member of an anti-Imperial resistance cell on the Outer Rim planet Annoo during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Demma Moll was a woman in her mid-forties during the early years of the Galactic Empire and the leader of a resistance cell on her homeworld, Annoo. She was the mother of Kea Moll.
