Alres Demophon was one of the founders of the Republic Scout Service. Demophon's discoveries included the Demophon system; the star and a planet in the system were named after Demophon.
Rogar Farnoster was the acclaimed author of The Slug Named Grendel and Night Mynock, the latter a HoloNet News Top 5 seller.
Dustrose was the name given to the female Dark Acolyte serving alongside Nikkos Tyris by Jedi Knight Ylenic It'kla during the Clone Wars.
Rach'talik was a male Twi'lek, the explosives specialist of Shala the Hutt on Courkrus. In 11 ABY, in an attempt to catch the "Ghost Jedi," Shala had Rach'talik rig his warehouse with explosives.
Bargthron was a Tof who was second in command under an unidentified Supreme of the invasion force during the Battle of Zeltros in 4 ABY.
Ummar was a stocky female Human major in the Galactic Alliance who was General Airen Cracken's adjutant in 29 ABY. She had dark skin.
Owell was a Ferroan who lived on Zonama Sekot.

Darak was a female Ferroan who lived on Zonama Sekot. Of high-rank in Ferroan society, she was the partner of Rowel; the two of whom were initially suspicious of the Jedi, until Sekot itself trusted them.
Captain Saz was the leader of Blackmoon Squadron during the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Hobyo was a male Klatooinian serving the New Republic when he was captured during the failed Operation Trinity. Infiltrating the Peace Brigade and sabotaging their engines in the attempt to rescue prisoners being sent to Coruscant to be sacrificed, he was captured.
Maydh was a young male Ferroan from Zonama Sekot who joined Luke Skywalker and several other Jedi in a meeting with the Yuuzhan Vong priest Harrar.

Lorgal was an anti-Republic radical bent on destroying the Galactic Republic through terrorist actions. Styling himself "Lorgal the Great Liberator", he was responsible for over two dozen bombings and hundreds of civilian deaths.

Denev was a Human male who had a long history of military service. He was a veteran of the Battle of Endor, serving as part of Han Solo's strike team targeting the Death Star's shield generator. Later, he left the military and served as a mechanic and captain on Caluula Station.
Shal Tor was a male Yuuzhan Vong Consul who became a Shamed One due to an implant rejection.

Wraw was a male Bothan Intelligence officer who was a part of Meloque's infiltration of Caluula in order to destroy the planet's yammosk. He was also there to see if Alpha Red would work outside of a laboratory.

Ferfer was a male Ryn who was a part of the Ryn Network, as gatherer One-Six-Four out of Balmorra, during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He was a member of Team Meloque, who infiltrated Yuuzhan Vong-occupied Caluula in order to destroy that world's yammosk in the last year of the war.
Aken was a female Ferroan who flew a Sekotan ship to pick up the Solos from the Millennium Falcon and take them to Zonama Sekot's surface.
Eprill was a Chiss pilot who flew with Vanguard Squadron and Twin Suns Squadron during the final stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Bahb was a male Zeltron, who, along with three other Zeltrons—Jahn, Marruc and Rahuhl, volunteered to be attaché to Princess Leia Organa in 4 ABY.
Jahn was a male Zeltron, who, along with three other Zeltrons—Bahb, Marruc and Rahuhl, volunteered to be attaché to Princess Leia Organa in 4 ABY.
Marruc was a male Zeltron, who, along with three other Zeltrons—Bahb, Jahn and Rahuhl, volunteered to be attaché to Princess Leia Organa in 4 ABY.
Rahuhl was a male Zeltron, who, along with three other Zeltrons—Bahb, Jahn and Marruc, volunteered to be attaché to Princess Leia Organa in 4 ABY.

The Darker was a being composed entirely of the hate, anger, fear and other negative emotions of the Arbran species, who purged their bodies of such ill feelings before leaving their homeworld Arbra behind to start anew.

Gosden was a captain in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War fought between the Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Gosden served aboard the Empire's DS-1 Orbital Battle Station at some point prior to its destruction in the Battle of Yavin.
Slag Flats was a female Ithorian crime lord on Tatooine. In 85 BBY, she came to Tatooine on the colony ship that founded Mos Eisley after she was exiled from Ithor.
A Yuuzhan Vong warrior served as the chief battle tactician to Warmaster Nas Choka in the prelude to the Defense of Mon Calamari.

This Yuuzhan Vong priestess served as the warrior-seer of Warmaster Nas Choka in the prelude to the Defense of Mon Calamari. She was greatly concerned about Supreme Overlord Shimrra's order to attack Mon Calamari, openly saying that Shimrra was deranged in Choka's command grotto.

Fin Danglot was a starfighter pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. By 0 BBY, prior to fellow Rebel pilot Puck Naeco's death during the Battle of Yavin, Naeco was a mentor for Danglot as well as pilots Keyan Farlander and Milar Travis.
Mici Shabandar was a Human female operative of the Rebel Alliance who aided Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa during the Galactic Civil War.
Krono Relt was a Human male Rebel saboteur who spied aboard the first Death Star during the Galactic Civil War.

Edela Klauskin was the deceased wife of Admiral Matric Klauskin who appeared to him as a spirit created by Dark Lady of the Sith Lumiya and used for his manipulation aboard Dodonna. She had long brown hair, streaked with gray and worn in an older Coruscanti style.
Tarla Limpan was a female Duros who served in the New Republic, and later the Galactic Alliance Defense Forces.

Denjax Teppler was a Human male Corellian who served in various posts in the Corellian system's Five Worlds government throughout his life. He married Aidel Saxan, a fellow politician, before 40 ABY, but the two eventually separated and remained on good terms.

Siron Tawaler was a Human male and head of security for Toryaz Station. In 40 ABY, during the negotiations between Corellia and the Galactic Alliance on the station, Lumiya used the Force to manipulate Captain Tawaler into believing he was to be her telbun and convinced him to…

Darjeelai Swan was a Human female from Corellia who lived during the Yuuzhan Vong War. In 28 ABY, she joined Thrackan Sal-Solo on his journey to Yuuzhan'tar in order to have the Centerpoint Party and Corellia sign a peace accord with the Yuuzhan Vong.
Tosh was a Human male colonel in the New Republic who commanded the rear guard of speeders during the Battle of Yag'Dhul.
Korol Solo was a man of Corellian descent who lived on Duro during the decades before the Clone Wars, and who was sometimes identified as great-grandfather to Han Solo.
Geist was a Human male who served as both a High Moff and the general in command of the Imperial Army in the Fel Empire and later in Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire.

Tai was a Force-sensitive human Jedi Padawan who lived during the New Republic Era, having joined the Jedi Order under Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, Tai learned the ways of the Force alongside other students, including Skywalker's nephew Ben Solo.
Kruskob Tiltanka, or "Kob," was a Nagai general.
The Supreme was a Tof pirate, and was in command of the invasion force during the Battle of Zeltros in 4 ABY.

Regga was an Ithorian podracer who competed in a race on Tatooine around 32 BBY. Racing through Beggar's Canyon, he stayed too high and brushed the cliffs, dying instantly. After his death, pit droids searched for the parts from his podracer for a month.
Balass ke Teldan was a male Human from the nation of Cartann on the planet Adumar. He was the oldest son and successor of Pekaelic ke Teldan's as Perator of Cartann.

Pol SulliVaan was an ambassador of the Givin. When Leia Organa Solo and Luke Skywalker arrived on Yag'Dhul, SulliVaan greeted Leia in a mathematical formula that was different from their standard greeting.
Nawruun was an elderly male Wookiee of the Nysshyyyk clan from Kashyyyk.

Zythmnr was a male Massassi temple priest who lived on the moon of Yavin 4 in the years leading up to the Great Sith War. Zythmnr belonged to a Massassi tribe that was descended from the followers of deceased Dark Lord of the Sith Naga Sadow, who came to Yavin 4 in 5000 BBY.
Lanyss Gutierrace was a female Human member of the Judicial Department.
Tahkay was a Hiromi chief navigator of the Hiromi Empire starship Kuratcha. He took part in Operation: Glorious Destiny and the Battle of Zeltros in 4 ABY.

Borra Chambo was a musician who worked at around the time in which hyperspace travel was introduced, a period considered a golden age for classical music. During that time, Chambo composed the piece known as Dissolution by Self-Intention, which included a prelude.

Tarnese Lyanne was a male Sakiyan who was the Republic Admiral Tarnese Bleyd's pride-father in the wild world of Sakiya. His investments in Black Sun operations led the betrayal of Shiltu the Hutt, who ruined the Sakiyan and the whole Clan Tarnese.
Annloc Yerj was a famous male HoloNet actor who was active during the Clone Wars.

affiliation: Jasod Revoc and his Galactic Revue
x: Epoh Bahb was a famed Bith musician who performed with Jasod Revoc and his Galactic Revue throughout the Clone Wars at the end of the Great Peace of the Republic.

affiliation: Jasod Revoc and his Galactic Revue
x: Jasod Revoc was a famous HoloNet actor who was very popular during the Clone Wars. In 20 BBY, he was given top billing by HoloNet Entertainment at shows set up to entertain Republic troops and personnel, due to the fact that he was younger than fellow HoloNet star Epoh Trebor.
Mohris was a Human male who served as the head bartender of the Rimsoo Seven cantina on Drongar during the Clone Wars.
Paleel was a female Human nurse who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars on Drongar.

Threndy was a nurse who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars on Drongar. She survived the attack of the Separatist forces against the medical center, and the RMSU was moved to a new location.
Tiran was a prestigious Drall scientist who lived over ten thousand years before the founding of the Galactic Republic in 25,053 BBY.
Wildis Jiklip, also known as Red Stepla, was a female Human who was known for her mathematical genius.

Evan Chan was a Human male who was employed as an environmental hydrographer for the Galactic Republic. His job required him to travel to different planets in order to evaluate the condition of their bodies of water.
Zorug Briefly was a correspondent sent to Ithor in order to broadcast Master Yoda's supposed death after his decoy's ship was destroyed by Asajj Ventress.
Debbikin the Young was a Human male who was the leader of one of the Cestus Cybernetics Families and the son of Debbikin the Elder.
Debbikin the Elder was a member of the Cestus Cybernetics Family led by his son, Debbikin the Young.
Filian was a male X'Ting who was the partner of G'Mai Duris and Regent on the council that was formed by the Five Families of Cestus Cybernetics before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
Glorii Profus was a Galactic Republic–affiliated Kaminoan who served as a mentop—a part psychiatric, part spiritual adviser—to the Grand Army of the Republic's clone troopers.
Gritt Chipple was a X'Ting male who served as an air taxi driver from Ord Cestus.
Guntar was a male Zeetsa who worked for the criminal X'Ting Trillot and took charge of bringing the drugs to Trillot's customers in the city of ChikatLik.

Janu was a male chef who worked for the criminal X'Ting Trillot as a cook. In 22 BBY, he cooked two wind snakes for Asajj Ventress until he and Trillot were later murdered by the Dark Acolyte. He was large, brown, and had a distended chin and a horned crest.

Kefka was a male humanoid who was the leader of one of the Five Families of Cestus Cybernetics during the Clone Wars. He was tall, broad, and pale. He looked human with a little Kiffar spliced in, although this was never specified as such.

Llitishi was a Wroonian male who was the leader of one of the Cestus Cybernetics Families during the Clone Wars. His particular family was descended from the son of a murderer and the daughter of an ore miner.

Pefederan Lloyn was the chairwoman of the Galactic Alliance Finance Council as of 40 ABY. Prior to the Second Galactic Civil War, she sold off her holdings on Corellia and replaced them with new property on Kuat, violating the theory that Financial officers were to be unable t…
Deevan Plirr was the son of Loreza Plirr.

Loreza Plirr was a female Human with extremely fine blue-black hair. She was a cartographer mapping Centerpoint Station, and was one of the pro-Corellian scientists allowed in after the Corellian government put restrictions up near the start of the Second Galactic Civil War.
Arlo Tyre was a man who joined the Rebellion after an Imperial raid cost him everything he held dear. He became a Master Scout and was partnered with Wadie Firestone.

Wadie Firestone was a Master Scout for the Rebellion and a partner of Arlo Tyre. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, both men were dispatched from headquarters to Alashan to investigate why a Rebel archaeological station had missed three routine communications.

The Huntress was a female Iktotchi assassin who operated in the years following the end of the New Sith Wars. An impeccable record of success saw the Huntress employed by Lucia, a bodyguard working for the royal house of the planet Doan.

A Zeltron general was a member of the Black Knights under the command of the Sith Lord known as the Dark Underlord; he faced Mandalorian mercenaries who intruded upon the Underlord's fortress on Malrev IV.

Mithail was a male Human individual who was the son of Yander, a native miner of Ord Cestus, who once was the partner of Sheeka Tull. He had a brother, Tarl, and a sister, Tonoté. He was the youngest of his siblings.
Lady Por'Ten was a Human female who was the leader of one of the Cestus Cybernetics Families and the wife of Lord Por'Ten. She had a narrow face, tattooed lips, and blue-veined hands.

Lord Por'Ten was a male Human from Ord Cestus, and member of the Cestus Cybernetics Family, whose leader was his wife, Lady Por'Ten. The Families of Cestus Cybernetics aspired to overthrow the Regent G'Mai Duris from the government.

Remlout was a male X'Ting who served as a loyal bodyguard to Trillot during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, Remlout knew that Asajj Ventress never declined a challenge, and when she met Trillot, the bodyguard challenged the Dark Jedi.
Sabit was a female X'Ting who was the wife of Caiza Quill by the time of the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, she was present with many members of the Five Families that took refuge in a secret bunker.
Hokk was a member of the Disciples of Ragnos, a cult that wanted to revive the Sith Lord Marka Ragnos, who had died in 5000 BBY.
Shar Shar was the Regent G'Mai Duris' assistant at the time of the Clone Wars. During a private meeting around 22 BBY, Shar and Duris were visited by Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and Doolb Snoil.
Sheevis Tull was the father of Sheeka Tull and a younger daughter. He and his wife died during a range war on Atrivis 7. Prior to his death, he taught Sheeka to fly.

Tarl was a male Human individual who is the son of Yander, a native miner of Ord Cestus, who once was the husband of Sheeka Tull. He had a sister, Tonoté, and a brother, Mithail. Tarl had a burly build.
Tonoté was a Human female who was the daughter of Yander, a native of Ord Cestus who worked as a miner; her father was once the partner of Sheeka Tull. She had two brothers named Tarl and Mithail.
Mudlath was a captain in the Aphran Planetary Exosecurity, and a member of the Peace Brigade. His accent indicated a Corporate Sector birthplace.

Hurlo Holowan was a female Human droid designer and engineer from Kuat and the daughter of a wealthy merchant house patriarch. She designed the Razor Eater, the fiercest killing machine ever seen on the planet.

Groodo the Hutt—the brother of Rigorra and the father of Boonda—operated what he claimed to be 'legitimate' business interests, particularly in starship manufacturing, during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Mazumoda was a male Worrite who served as a freelance thug-for-hire in the underworld of Coruscant during the rise of the Galactic Empire. He was known as "The Big Bug" due to his frightening appearance that served as an asset in his line of work.

Rajah Ubooki was a male Bimm who served as an Imperial Intelligence agent. He masqueraded as Supreme Prophet of the dark side Kadann in 5 ABY, becoming known as the false Kadann to the select few who knew of the deceit.
Heingort Giddis was a male Null Imperial Intelligence agent masquerading as Jedgar, a Prophet of the Dark Side.
Ables was a female member of the Corellian transportation team onboard Centerpoint Station in 40 ABY.
Razi Khan was a member of an ancient order of Force-using assassins, the Seyugi Dervishes.
Harval Tommick was a male who served as the chief of security for Five World Prime Minister Aidel Saxan as of 40 ABY. He was a political ally of Thrackan Sal-Solo.
Yorvin had hair a darker shade of red than that of Mara Jade Skywalker.
Dren Kuu'la was a former Twi'lek female dancer who became a personal escort and a bodyguard. She was very loyal to the beings she guarded.

Gorvan Peel was a male pilot in Nebula Flight. In the Battle of Tralus, during the Second Galactic Civil War, Peel flew as Nebula Eleven. His fighter was destroyed, but he ejected and was apparently rescued by Galactic Alliance forces.
Jiyam Solo was a professional Han Solo impersonator around 40 ABY. He changed his name to better suit the part, and his voice was deeper than the original's.
Kennis Radi was a Human male who served as a member of the Legislative Youth Program during the Separatist Crisis.
Needo Farr was a male Rodian from Rodia who served as a member of the Legislative Youth Program during the Separatist Crisis.
Trevor Insevade was an Alderaanian male member of the Legislative Youth Program during the beginning of the Separatist Crisis.
Dashé Borreno was a female from the Mid Rim planet Naboo, born around 31 BBY. A noted political prodigy, Borreno was a member of the Legislative Youth Program during the Separatist Crisis.

Suz Tanwa was a famous Rodian treasure hunter and archaeologist. She was notable for her work in the Yavin system, where she tracked down the treasure of her ancestor, Suvam Tan on Yavin 22. She flew a starship called the Reeko.
Robetheri was a Nightsister War Chief from the misty world of Dathomir. In the later years of the Galactic Civil War, the witch ruled over the wardens of an Imperial prison as a dark queen.

B'dasssa, an Akwin scout, was one of many such scouts who kept track of the Humans on Lazerian IV. The information the scout gathered on the Humans in Lazeria City helped the aquatic Akwin—considered mere legends by the Human inhabitants—to completely understand their neighbors.

Serom Haxan was a male Lorrdian professor at the University of Pangalactic Cultural Studies during the years after the Dark Nest Crisis. In 40 ABY, Haxan was taken hostage by his colleague, Professor Movac Arisster.
Movac Arisster was a Human male from Lorrd City. He had a dark-haired mustache and beard, weighed 150 kilos, was well muscled, and had considered a career in wrestling.
Deleta was a Human female participant of the Katharsis, the game founded by the failed Jedi Xanatos and the Telosian treasurer Vox Chun.
Ellisa Shallence was the Baroness Administrator of Bespin's Cloud City some time before Lando Calrissian took over the facility.
Ghufran was a pilot with the New Republic Defense Force. He joined Rogue Squadron after the death of Grand Admiral Thrawn in 9 ABY.
Reme Pollar was a female Human who joined Rogue Squadron following the death of Grand Admiral Thrawn at the Battle of Bilbringi.
Ib-Dunn was a blue-green Smotl male who worked for Soergg the Hutt in Cuipernam, the capital of the planet of Ansion.

Soergg Vosadii Bezhin was a gray Hutt bossban on Ansion in 22 BBY. Based in Lower Cuipernam, his majordomo was Ogomoor, and his aide was Ib-Dunn. He had two Yuzzem bodyguards and at least four concubines: a Human, a Brogune, and at least two of an unknown species.

Tolut was a male Armalat who was one of the seven delegates of the Unity Council on Ansion in 22 BBY. It appeared that Tolut was slightly Force-sensitive, however he was never considered for training in the Jedi Order.

Kandah was a female Ansionian who was one of the seven delegates of the Unity Council on Ansion in 22 BBY. She had a clouded brown eye and long vertical face-lines. She opposed the Galactic Republic. Her family owned estates in Korumdah.

Ranjiyn was a male Ansionian who was one of the seven delegates of the Unity Council on Ansion prior to the start of the Clone Wars. He appeared to be the first among equals of the group, and dyed his hair in alternating black-and-white stripes.
Induran was a female Ansionian who was one of the seven delegates of the Unity Council on Ansion in 22 BBY.

Tam Uliss was a squat, muscular Human male from Corellia, living on Ansion in 22 BBY. The industrialist supported Ansion's attempt to secede from the Old Republic, meeting secretly with conspirators in a Quadrant H-46 cantina and an orbiting transport above Coruscant.

Kyakhta was a male Ansionian enforcer for Soergg. He had ragged red hair and had a crude prosthetic to replace his missing right arm. He was an Alwari who had been cast out from his Tasbir clan to the cities as a child due to his mental illness.

Zyne Kinahay was the son of Eben Kinahay, an antiques dealer. Zyne was a tall lanky man with a muscular frame. He was known as a criminal in the Core Worlds, but he was also a devotee of the dark side.
Mazong was the Highborn of the Yiwa clan of the Alwari tribes of Ansion in the Separatist era, before the Clone Wars.
A female Saarai-kaar served as the leader of the Jensaarai following the death of Nikkos Tyris.

Tooqui was a male Gwurran (an Ansionian pygmy) who attempted to steal Jedi Barriss Offee's provisional food while she and her companions were on a mission to prevent the planet Ansion's secession from the Galactic Republic in 22 BBY, before the Clone Wars.
Baiuntu was a male Ansionian and a non-traditional Alwari tribesman who was the chief trader of a Qulun clan on the planet Ansion.
Chine Gabbard was a native of Rehemsa, but worked as a botany researcher on Garqi.

Fargane was a male Ansionian who was one of the seven delegates of the Unity Council on Ansion during the Clone Wars. He was the tallest, oldest, and best educated of the Ansionians on the Council, and apparently its leader. He was from Hurkaset.
Garil Volune was a Human man who lived on Ansion and one of the delegates to the Unity Council. He was not present at the official Jedi greeting on the planet.

Bayaar was a male Ansionian sentry and scout of the Situng Borokii clan of the Alwari nomads, who roamed the hill country and vast plains of the planet Ansion during the time of the Separatist Crisis, before the Clone Wars.

Tarnis was a male Duros who hijacked a load of specialized processing chips from Tendrando Arms new rehab droid factory. Lando Calrissian and Tendra Risant Calrissian put up a million credit reward for the chips.

Droekle was a male Hapan who was one of Queen Mother Tenel Ka Djo's courtiers and had lost his left hand in a "fencing accident" to the Queen Mother as did most of her courtiers to mirror the loss of her hand to Jacen Solo.
Lonn was a male Human who may have been a security officer for the Bornaryn Trading company or the Tradewyn.
Gundar was a male Human bodyguard who served Aryn Dro Thul aboard the Tradewyn following the Yuuzhan Vong War's end.

Aleson Gray was a Hapan male who served as the Dukat and Duch'da to Lady AlGray of the Relephon Moons as of 35 ABY. The ninth cousin of Queen Mother Tenel Ka, he commanded the Kendall during the Swarm War.
Zardra Vykas was a Human female and the sister of Zarandro Vykas. She traveled the galaxy in her modified YT-1300 freighter, the Firebrand.
Jalus Nebl was a male Sullustan who was working as a freighter pilot for the Besadii Hutts' spice operation on Ylesia at the same time as Han Solo.

Larad Noon was one of Exar Kun's followers during the Old Sith Wars. When the Sith were defeated he fled to the moon Susevfi where he discovered the lightsaber-resistant cortosis ore and crafted a suit of armor from it, convinced that the Jedi would one day follow him there.
Beda Ies was the wife of Daxar Ies and the mother of Eremay Ies.
Eremay Ies was the daughter of Daxar and Beda Ies.

Wurf'al was a male Bothan who was a captain onboard the Admiral Ackbar who was related to Avke Saz'ula by marriage, which gave him a disdain for Jedi, and was the great nephew of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu. He was killed by Gorog assassins trying to save a bust of the "great" Admiral.
Dorset Konnair was a Human female who flew an A-wing as part of General Edor Crespin's training group Blue Squadron, alongside what would become Wraith Squadron, on Folor.

Avke Saz'ula was a male Bothan gunnery officer onboard the Avengeance. He served in MaxSec Eight along with the rest of the crew attempting to find Zonama Sekot in order to finish the Bothan ar'krai. He was a cousin to Admiral Nek Bwua'tu's third wife.

Grendyl was a female Human member of the Galactic Alliance Navy, stationed onboard the Admiral Ackbar. Part of the starfighter team stationed on the Ackbar, she was present when the ship was ambushed by the Colony's forces during the Qoribu Crisis.
Tola was a Mon Calamari officer with the Galactic Alliance Defense Force onboard Admiral Ackbar during the Dark Nest Crisis.
Vero'tog'leo was a male Chiss Lieutenant in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force.

Arruna was a local resident of Najiba, and the lover of another Najiban, Lathaam. Lathaam had a big mouth, and when Adalric Cessius Brandl arrived on Najiba seeking passage to Trulalis, Lathaam was the first to speak up.

Reuther was a male Najib and the owner of a bar, Reuther's Wetdock, on Najiba that was frequently occupied due to its proximity to the local spaceport. Reuther was also a retired bounty hunter and speaker of Old Corellian and was familiar with several Corellian customs.
Etnam was a fleet officer and admiral in the Imperial Navy.

Kama Elias was a participant of the Katharsis, the game founded by the failed Jedi Xanatos and the Telosian treasurer Vox Chun. Eventually, Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi discovered that it was a fraud.
Riva was the owner of a guest house in Telos IV, where Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi hid in.
Rolo was a participant of the Katharsis, the game founded by the failed Jedi Xanatos and the Telosian treasurer Vox Chun. He was disabled in a game of Katharsis.
Tamor was a participant of the Katharsis, the game founded by the failed Jedi Xanatos and the telosian treasurer Vox Chun.
O-Nena was a female Human Keganite who was sent to the Re-Learning Circle.
O-Uni was a young Keganite sent to the Re-Learning Circle.
O-Yani was an old Keganite who looked after the children of her Living Circle. She was the grandmother of V-Onin.

Scurry was a young ferbil native to Kegan. It was one of V-Davi's two pet ferbils. Owning pets was forbidden in Kegan, so when O-Bin discovered it, she ordered V-Tarz to eliminate Scurry, along with V-Davi's other baby ferbil and two lizards.
V-Brose was a Human male who served as a Security Guide and guarded the Learning Circle school on the planet Kegan.
V-Ido was a student at the Learning Circle on Kegan.
V-Mina was a student at the Learning Circle on Kegan.
V-Onin was a young Keganite sent to the Re-Learning Circle. He was the grandson of O-Yani.
V-Taun was a student at the Learning Circle on Kegan.
Wali was V-Davi's pet that he kept with him when in the Re-Learning Circle. Wali was a small, furry creature with a thin tail.
Zuulan Sentar was a Gran intergalactic slaver during the time of the Jedi Civil War.

Hronk was a male Wookiee from the planet Kashyyyk. A member of the same clan as the albino Wookiee Tojjevvuk, who had been killed by a Wookiee named Chewbacca, Hronk was determined to uphold a blood feud declared against Chewbacca by Tojjevvuk's father, Tvrrdko.

Derra'makin was the Grand Daern of the Marasan people. He headed the Marasan government, called the Mindnet, making decisions based on information from the lesser Marasan elected officials (the Electnodes.) Like almost all Marasans, he was a cyborg, with a sophisticated comput…
Jem was a male Human, who lived on the planet Dalicron-4.
Able-472 was a clone trooper who fought at the Battle of Muunilinst as a member of The Muunilinst 10. During the battle, they were put in charge of the artillery bombarding the city of Harnaidan.
TK-342 was a stormtrooper commander present at the pacification of Ghorman.
Stec was the nickname of an Advanced Recon Commando who fought in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Phillip Santhe was a member of the Santhe family that controlled the Santhe Corporation and its subsidiaries Santhe/Sienar Technologies and Santhe Security.

Kashan Santhe was a member of the Santhe family that controlled the Santhe Corporation and its subsidiaries Santhe/Sienar Technologies and Santhe Security. He was the son of Phillip Santhe and the grandson of Lady Valles Santhe. Like his father he was an Engineer by trade.

Astrinol Hja was a Dathomir Witch and the leader of the Dreaming River Clan in 12 ABY. Along with the rest of her clan, Hja was imprisoned by Imperials in 11 ABY. They were later rescued by the Jedi Knights, who were sent to arrest Dal Konur.

Barit Saiy was a Corellian male born on Coruscant to the owner of the Saiy Engineering Workshop. During the Second Galactic Civil War, he met and befriended Ben Skywalker in the Corellian part of Coruscant. Barit told Ben that he was planning an attack on Coruscanti civilians.
Goran Beviin was a Human male Mandalorian commando, a bounty hunter, and a contract killer active under the New Republic and into the early years of the Galactic Alliance.
Bu was a baby Senali, daughter of Garth and Ganeed, and niece of the King Meenon of Senali.
Drenna was a young Senali, daughter of Garth and Ganeed, and niece of the King Meenon of Senali. She was a great archer.
Frane was a male Rutanian who was the King of Rutan and the father of Leed and Taroon. He often had mood swings and could quickly loose his temper.

Tol Cressa was a male who served as the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during the Mandalorian Wars. The Chancellor worked to restore the Republic from the devastation that was brought by the Great Sith War and Jedi Civil War.
Vocatara was an individual who served in the Army of the Galactic Republic as a rocket-jumper sometime before the year 4800 BBY.

Dojundo the Hutt was an emissary from the Hutt Empire. He was the first Hutt to find Vodran, a planet in the Si'Klaata Cluster, and wanted to recruit the native Vodrans for the Hutts' war with Xim the Despot.
Ulabore was a male lieutenant in the New Sith Wars in the years leading up to the Seventh Battle of Ruusan.

Lucia was a Human female Sith trooper who fought for the Brotherhood of Darkness during the New Sith Wars. She served as a sniper in the Gloom Walkers unit under the command of Lieutenant Ulabore, and took part in the Battle of Phaseera.
Aralina Silk was one of the infamous Emperor's Hands, one of many Force-sensitive agents used by Emperor Palpatine to undertake whatever missions the Emperor wished them to do.

Jubben was an individual who worked as a senator. Prior to the plot to assassinate Galactic Republic Senator Padmé Amidala in 22 BBY, Jubben was killed by ASN-121, a custom assassin droid owned by the bounty hunter Zam Wesell.

Wazado was a male baron. Prior to the plot to assassinate Galactic Republic Senator Padmé Amidala in 22 BBY, Wazado was killed by ASN-121, a custom assassin droid owned by the bounty hunter Zam Wesell.
Jori Lekauf was a Human male officer of the Galactic Alliance Guard, the secret police of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.

Ganeed was the sister of the King Meenon of Senali. She was married to Garth and had five children; Hinen, Jaret, Drenna, Tinta and Bu. She welcomed Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi when they visited Senali.

Garth was the husband of Ganeed, the sister of the King Meenon of Senali. He had five children: Hinen, Jaret, Drenna, Tinta, and Bu. He welcomed Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi when they visited Senali.
Hinen was the son of Garth and Ganeed, and nephew of the King Meenon of Senali. He was a member of the Banoosh-Walores clan.
Jaret was the son of Garth and Ganeed, and nephew of the King Meenon of Senali. He married Mesan and had one child, Tawn.
Leed was the Prince of Rutan, the son of King Frane of Rutan.
Meenon was the King of Senali in 44 BBY, and the father of Yaana.
Mesan was the wife of Jaret, the nephew of the King Meenon of Senali. She had one child, Tawn. She welcomed Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi when they visited Senali.
Neece was a Rutan prison employee. He controlled the entries into this prison. Three of these entries were Qui-Gon Jinn, Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Drenna.
Nin was an old Senali who worked for the Senali Royal Family as their assistant. She cooked and took care of Bu.
Nonce was the sister of the King Meenon of Senali. She had one child, Wek. She welcomed Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi when they visited Senali.
Kaysil Verwood was the Refugee Relief Movement spokesbeing during the Clone Wars.
Taroon was a male Rutanian and the son of King Frane of Rutan.
Tawn was a young Senali and the daughter of Jaret and Mesan.
Tinta was a young Senali, son of Garth and Ganeed, and nephew of the King Meenon of Senali.
Tonai was an old Senali, father of Ganeed, Nonce and King Meenon.
Wek was a young Senali, son of Nonce and nephew of the King Meenon of Senali.
Yaana was the Princess of Senali, the daughter of King Meenon of Senali.
G'vli G'Sil was a male Human politician during the Second Galactic Civil War. A senator in the Galactic Alliance Senate, G'Sil was appointed the head of the Galactic Alliance's Security Council.
Uv Gizen was an individual who served as an aide of the Galactic Republic's Supreme Chancellor Palpatine during the Separatist Crisis.
Lord Rodin Hlian Verpalion was an Imperial noble.

Bhu Cranna was a young Sorrusian, son of the chief of the tribe, Goq Cranna. He and his father showed Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi and Astri Oddo location of the hiding place of the bounty hunter Ona Nobis.
Cholly was a thief and friend of Weez and Tup.
Goq Cranna was a male Sorrusian who served as chief of a Sorrusian tribe.

Nanno L'a was a criminal who owned the technical data of all commissioners and petitioners that appeared before the Senate. He was friend of Didi Oddo and helped Astri Oddo to find bounty hunter Ona Nobis.
Nil was a male Quint who worked for Jenna Zan Arbor. He worshiped the scientist for her brilliance, but she didn't seem to acknowledge his praise.
Tino was the flatmate of Ren S'orn. While he was working in a warehouse, the bounty hunter Ona Nobis attempted to kill him, but the Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi and Astri Oddo were able to save him.
Tup was a thief and friend of Cholly and Weez.
Von Taub was a prestigious scientist who attended the meeting led by Jenna Zan Arbor, in CoCo Town. Then, he helped Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi and Astri Oddo to find the bounty hunter Ona Nobis.
Weez was a thief and friend of Cholly and Tup.

Yamele Polidor was a prestigious Rindian scientist who attended the meeting led by Jenna Zan Arbor, in CoCo Town. Then, she helped Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi and Astri Oddo to find the bounty hunter Ona Nobis.

Yur T'aug was a male Bothan who lived on the planet Coruscant during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. T'aug served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force (CSF) and, by 43 BBY, had achieved the rank of captain.
Commander Lyal Frel was an Imperial officer in command of the garrison on Ord Mynock.
Grom Goluum was the owner of a docking bay in Ord Mynock Freeport on the planet of Ord Mynock. He was an honest, hardworking Sullustan starship mechanic.
D'zor was a Kajain'sa'Nikto male who was a resident outlaw of Mos Espa in 32 BBY. He and his thugs camped out in the back of Barbo's store, keeping a repeating blaster for protection.
The "technobeast Jedi" was a male Jedi Knight who lived during a subset of the New Sith Wars called the Sictis Wars.
Ivo Muna posed as a doctor at the Sorrus Medical Center in order to aid Ona Nobis in apprehending Astri Oddo and Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Joli K'atel was a Human female who is the daughter of the leader of Belasco, Min K'atel. She was affected by the bacterium created by Jenna Zan Arbor. Finally, she could get cured.

Min K'atel was a male Human and the leader of Belasco. His daughter, Joli, was affected by the bacterium created by Jenna Zan Arbor. Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and Adi Gallia looked into the case of the contaminated water to find Zan Arbor.
Ned was the son of a female mechanic living on Belasco. It was he who helped the Jedi Masters Qui-Gon Jinn and Adi Gallia to identify Jenna Zan Arbor and Noor R'aya.
Doctor Rai Unlu worked at the Sorrus Medical Center.

Kot Murno was an officer of the Peace Brigade force commanded by Captain Imsatad which attacked Yavin 4 in 26 ABY. Claiming to hold the rank of Lieutenant, he commanded the group of five or six starships sent down to attack the Jedi academy directly.
Haly Dura was a male Twi'lek mechanic who worked at Centax-2, repairing the Jedi starfighters during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Kern was a male bounty hunter living during the Galactic War. Having witnessed eight killings and over fifty assaults by the pair of the Wookiee smuggler Jakarro and his droid partner C2-D4, Kern became determined to stop the long-lived pair from wreaking havoc across the gala…

Nort Fandi was a shuttle pilot who lived onboard the BioCruiser. A tall, balding Human, he transported Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker from the planet Hilo to the Biocruiser so that they could investigate it.
Rhe Pabs was a male Pho Ph'eahian technician who served aboard the BioCruiser, a massive, nomadic ship owned by the company UniFy (Offworld Mining Corporation).

Tarrence Chenati was the alias of a spy who infiltrated the Jedi Starfighter Program in order to sabotage it. A former member of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence, though he was reported to have died in 62 BBY, his identity was reactivated in 42 BBY by the Galactic Senate.
Trisdin Gheer was one of Ta'a Chume's retainers, at the time of the Yuuzhan Vong invasion, as well as a member of the Ni'Korish faction.
Jerf Huxley was a heavyset Human male who worked as a smuggler in the Outer Rim and was once part of Talon Karrde's organization, and did not take kindly to being cut off from it in 22 ABY.
Mirta Gev was a female Mandalorian bounty hunter of Clan Fett around the time of the Second Galactic Civil War.

Bursthed was the Imperial Governor of Ruten during the New Republic era. He was known to be an evil and corrupt man but also an efficient bureaucrat. He considered his appointment as governor of Rutan beneath him and hoped that an effective term would lead to promotion.

Dragite was an Iron Knight and High Marshal of the Galactic Republic. He became one of the many Iron Knights to guard Dweem when Master Aqinos and the rest of the Iron Knights were excommunicated by the Jedi Council.
Sinker was a male smuggler who was born around 6 ABY and worked with Jerf Huxley's Huxlings, a group that worked for Talon Karrde of the Smugglers' Alliance in the Outer Rim Territories.
Fisk was a member of the Huxlings, working for Jerf Huxley as of 22 ABY. As a young boy, he met Mara and Luke Skywalker.
Golfhan was a male Caridan who served as ambassador for the government of Carida during the end of the Separatist Crisis.

Erling Tredway was the son of Jedi Knight Axton Tredway. As a Force-sensitive, Erling had the ability to use the Jedi power of instinctive astrogation. Erling and his sister, Dena, were raised in the Sil'Lume asteroid belt on the asteroid 24 Tredway, owned by their family.
Ikt was a Mustafarian who explored the ruins of Mustafar.

Rathe Palror was a male Tunroth mercenary who served as a member of Churhee's Riflemen during the Galactic Civil War. He also was a crew member of the Hopskip that was sent on a mission by Grand Admiral Thrawn in 2 ABY.
DS-55-6 was the call sign of an Imperial Navy TIE pilot who served during the Galactic Civil War fought between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A TIE pilot operating under the call sign DS-73-3 served in the Imperial Navy by 0 BBY. That year, DS-73-3 participated in the Battle of Yavin, where the Alliance to Restore the Republic attempted to destroy the Galactic Empire's DS-1 Orbital Battle Station superweapon, and nu…

TK-119 was a clone stormtrooper who was aboard the Galactic Empire's Death Star battle station in 0 BBY. That year, a group of soon-to-be operatives of the Alliance to Restore the Republic infiltrated the Death Star to rescue one of its prisoners, Princess Leia Organa.

DV-692 was a clone stormtrooper officer of the Galactic Empire who served in the 501st Legion during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he was stationed aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Devastator under the command of the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader.
DV-523 was a clone stormtrooper who served in the Galactic Empire's 501st Legion during the Galactic Civil War.
KE-829 was the designation of a clone stormtrooper in service to the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

TK-875 was a clone stormtrooper who served in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he was present on the Empire's Death Star battle station when a group of Alliance to Restore the Republic operatives infiltrated the station to rescue one of its prisoner…

DS-29-4 was the call sign of a TIE pilot who served in the Imperial Navy by 0 BBY. In that year, the Battle of Yavin occurred, during which Alliance to Restore the Republic starfighters attempted to destroy the Galactic Empire's DS-1 Orbital Battle Station.

DS-55-2 was the call sign of an Imperial Navy TIE pilot who served by 0 BBY. That year, during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, the Alliance attempted to destroy the Imperial DS-1 Orbital Battle Station superweapon du…

Reginald Barkbone, Scourge of the Seven Sectors, was a swashbuckling pirate pursued by the Empire during the Galactic Civil War. A Poss'Nomin male, he was the figure of much myth, infamous for many audacious heists and daring escapades in his flagship, the Robber Baron.

Larm was an admiral in the Imperial Navy who was in charge of forces in the Antemeridian sector under Moff Getelles. Larm was a by-the-book sycophant who ingratiated himself with Moffs while never relaxing his warrior image.
Riao Siao was a female Felacatian and the girlfriend of Reymet Autem.

Heol Girdun was a male Human Galactic Alliance Guard officer at the time of the Second Galactic Civil War, a galactic conflict between the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and the Corellia-led Confederation.

Lon Shevu was a Human male GAG trooper and officer in the Galactic Alliance Guard during the Second Galactic Civil War. Prior to his service with GAG, Shevu was a police officer of the Coruscant Security Force.

This Mandalorian sergeant was a member of the Mandalorians Clan Ordo under Mandalore the Preserver, the current Mandalore. He watched and commanded the Battle Circle, an area where Mandalorians would pit against each other for practice and competition.
Mol Arcasite was a bounty hunter who was among the five bounty hunters that were hired by Granta Omega to capture Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker for a large sum of money.

Zem was a Human miner who worked on the planet Vanquo around the time of the Mandalorian Wars. Unconcerned by the Mandalorian threat nearing Vanquo, Zem worked the night shift at their outpost's comm system.

Diva Arroquitas was a female Theelin who was the master of ceremonies in the Priole Danna Festival on the planet Lamuir IV just one year before the Clone Wars began. However, the festival was canceled due to the Separatist Crisis.

Grarwwaar was one of a group of Wookiee warriors who attempted to track down Rulan Prolik in the Shadowlands. Rulan managed to separate Grarwwaar from his party and brutally killed him, assuming the Wookiee's identity for himself.

Chaeloe Dantin was a female privateer who raided Imperial shipping for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. She was the captain and owner of Dantin's Folly, and operated under a letter of marque and reprisal that had been issued by Ral'Rai Muvunc.
Ral'Rai Muvunc was a Twi'lek male serving the Alliance to Restore the Republic as the head of Ordnance and Supply (OaS) during the Galactic Civil War.

Trophan Thanis was an Imperial governor of Noonar some time during the Galactic Civil War. Facing serious problems with pirates raiding ships from Nebula Consumables in the Noonian system, he sent a message to Moff Gergris in the Halthor sector pleading for greater Imperial Fl…
Gergris was the Imperial Moff of the Halthor sector during the Galactic Civil War.

Kozar was an Imperial general stationed in the Noonian system some time during the Galactic Civil War. He discovered an abundance of goods stolen by pirates from Nebula Consumables ships in the Noonian system when a Rebel Alliance base on Movris was shut down.
Celis Mott was a famous pirate during the Galactic Civil War. A rotund Human, Mott possessed a beard and kept his eye brows dyed and trimmed in the Peluchian style.

Fein was a Human male smuggler who worked for Talon Karrde. He was present at the Whistler's Whirlpool Tapcafe on Trogan, when Karrde called a meeting of smuggler chiefs. Fein fought against the Imperial troops that attacked the smugglers, and emerged from the battle unscathed.

Cris Pieterson was a Human male who was conscripted into the Galactic Empire's service, being trained by Ensign Colclazure. During the Thrawn campaign of 9 ABY, Pieterson served Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Chimaera.
Dolman was a Human male Imperial officer during the Galactic Civil War. Captain Dolman's shuttle was shot down on approach to the Emperor's Retreat, on the planet Naboo, by Rebels in 1.5 ABY.
Kaja Or'Zee was the human female who served as chamberlain for Emperor Palpatine, seeing that all his needs were met, in the Emperor's Retreat on the planet Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.

Adanar was a male Senior Trooper in the Brotherhood of Darkness army during the New Sith Wars against the Galactic Republic. He joined the Sith army in 1003 BBY, on the same day as Dessel, a Human who later became his friend.
Pollux Poi was a male Anx engineer who was considered to be both brilliant and insane. He was contracted by the Shell Hutts to develop assassin droids to battle the Gejalli kajidic.
Otalp was a male Squidge and the den-brother of Remoh who lived long after the death of Luke Skywalker. His species was being oppressed by the Vindar.
Vor'en Kurn was a blue-skinned Human mercenary who wore a modified Kubaz face mask to protect his identity.

This captain was the lead Imbat serving the Offworld Corporation on Bandomeer. Obi-Wan Kenobi used the Force to get the captain to let Obi-Wan and Guerra Derida get to the box with the broken circle on it.

Eron Stonefield was a beautiful, red-haired woman who took up the profession of bounty hunting during the time of the Galactic Civil War, though before this time, she had mastered several martial arts.

Lakwii Varrscha was a female Human and an officer in the Imperial Navy—she was a tall, muscular woman who seemed diligent but was generally regarded by her superiors to be no more than ordinarily competent.
Lieutenant Gorev was the gunnery officer of the Super Star Destroyer Lusankya during the Bacta War.
Arl was a male Human colonel and a TIE Fighter commander for the Galactic Empire.
Ironclaw was a brown Kentra who encountered a group of Rebels. He was astounded that the Rebels spoke Bas'c, the language of the holy prophet Tandre. He took the Rebels to see the Kentra King Jerius.
Bright Eye was a brown Kentra during the Galactic Civil War. He was Ironclaw's nephew, and, while not as experienced as Ironclaw, he had an incredible ability to acquire new skills very fast.

Jerius was the king of the Kentra during the Galactic Civil War. He was wise and a devout follower of prophet Tandre's teachings. He was very cautious and thoughtful and had great visions for his people and was mildly annoyed at the ambitious Lord Grumman Mogotah.

Grumman Mogotah was a Kentra lord of the city Ironwall on Orellon II during the Galactic Civil War. He was very ambitious and was suspected to be planning to overthrow King Jerius. However, he was not evil as such, but just very ambitious and opportunistic.
The High Priestess was a strikingly beautiful female Kentra, who had forsaken her name and was a follower of the holy prophet Michael Tandre.

Lyyr Zatoq was a female Quarren pilot in Rogue Squadron from Mon Calamari. Lyyr's X-wing was shot down in battle above the moon Distna in the Corvis Minor system by Delak Krennel's TIE fighters and bombers. Her body was recovered by Booster Terrik and Mirax Terrik.

Saadoon-Kauldi was a Force-sensitive Kadri'Ra slave who was freed by members of the Twi'lek Badawzi family. Out of gratitude, Saadoon-Kauldi became an indentured servant to the Badawzis, and he eventually parted from them on good terms.

Deegan was a male lieutenant in the New Republic from the planet Corellia. In 6 ABY, while Wedge Antilles was reforming Rogue Squadron, an elite fighter group, Deegan was chosen as a potential member.
Dack, also known as Tymmo, was a male Human candidate for Luke Skywalker's New Jedi Order.

Mistal was a Human female who was the duchess of Dargul as of 11 ABY. When she reached the marrying age in 9 ABY, she attempted to find the perfect consort. A man named Dack sliced into Palace Dargul's computer system and placed himself as the perfect consort for her.
Slish Fondine was a male Human who owned a blob corral on Umgul.
Clorr was a former prison worker on Kessel.
Pillik was a young male Omwati who was taken by the Empire to be trained (along with several other young Omwati children, including Qwi Xux) to build superweapons for the Empire.

Glena was a descendant of the colonists of Eol Sha that were relocated to the world of Dantooine. Glena was the wife of Warton early in the Galactic Empire's rule. She was one of the many settlers who was vaporized by an AT-AT during Admiral Daala's attack on Dantooine in 11 ABY.
Babalabbet Swoont was a Sullustan who was a very respected cybernetic engineer on his planet.
Janna Tammok, often called "Officer Sunshine" by her staff, was a Lieutenant Commander in the Imperial Service, who served on Bothawui as chief of security for Consul-General Dandamont Pring.

This Sith, a male Twi'lek, was a member of the One Sith faction around the time of the Sith–Imperial War, a cooperative effort by the One Sith and Roan Fel's Galactic Empire to eliminate the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.
A member of Darth Krayt's One Sith, this Quarren Sith was one of many Sith led by Darth Nihl in the Massacre at Ossus in 130 ABY, purging the Jedi Praxeum on Ossus and scattering the New Jedi Order.

A Gotal Sith was a member of the Sith Lord Darth Krayt's Sith Order. Around 130 ABY, Krayt ordered his Hand Darth Nihl to lead a group of Sith in an attack on the Jedi Temple on the planet Ossus and leave no Jedi alive.
Chubb was a small burrowing reptile pet and companion of the boy Fidge.

A member of Darth Krayt's One Sith, this Mantellian Savrip Sith was one of many Sith led by Darth Nihl in the Massacre at Ossus in 130 ABY, purging the Jedi Academy at Ossus and scattering the New Jedi Order.
Jeseej was a male Sljee who operated as a forger, fortune teller, and information dealer. The owner of the restaurant Zlato's Place on Coruscant, Jeseej used it as a front for his forgery business.
Max was a demented, diminutive, and destructive member of the bunny species. Over the course of his career, he worked with several different beings, such as a dog and New Republic agent Kyle Katarn.

Spadda was a Hutt crime lord who lived on the planet Aikhibba. The smuggler Uxbeg was set to deliver a load of spice from the royal governor of the Thokosia system to Spadda, but Lo Khan intercepted the shipment and delivered it himself.
Yubookoo, an enslaved Wookiee on Geonosis, was forced to fight in the gladiator arenas. In order to fight without impediment, he trimmed his fur to a short stubble.
Erli Prann was a male Human adventurer, pirate, and scavenger who operated during the Grand Admiral Thrawn crisis and later during the Yuuzhan Vong's invasion of the galaxy.

Tris was a Chiss female and a librarian of the Inrokini family on Csilla. She helped Luke Skywalker and his expedition search through the Expeditionary Library to help find clues to the location of Zonama Sekot.

Sir Mac was a Bith. During a night in 22 BBY, Mac visited the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. The Bith added to the interplanetary feel of the club that night.
Jace Forno was a Human female from Corellia who served as the pilot of Olag Greck's personal shuttle. She was thin, and wore an eye patch over her right eye.

Seth Cambriel was a Human male who resided on the resort planet Spira during the Galactic Civil War. A self-made multi-millionaire playboy, Cambriel posed as a genteel gentlemen of leisure, moving within the high society of Spira's elite while also working as a spy for the All…
Regenald Hanniper Snopps III was a Human male from the planet Corulag. He was the youngest son of Zafiel Snopps, the planetary Imperial governor and former senator for the planet.
Rundil ot Sulem was a male Human rancher living on Dantooine during the time of the Jedi Civil War.

Grov Bricker was a Human male who worked as a Corellian pirate, and was once captured by Hapans. He wrote a memoir of the incident, titled Planet of the Amazons: The Tale of the Pirate Ship Mourning Glory, which became a bestseller for several months.
Marina Stele was the wife of Kerek Stele and mother of Maarek Stele.
Kerek Stele was the father of Maarek Stele and husband of Marina Stele.

Mordon was an admiral in the Imperial Navy and the commander of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vengeance during the Galactic Civil War. A native of a lush world in the Corellian sector, Mordon became a transport pilot before entering the Imperial Academy.

Carith was an Imperial Flight Officer, nicknamed Grommet, who was befriended by Maarek Stele. Grommet first met Stele aboard the Nebulon-B frigate Fogger during a series of Imperial attacks against Alliance forces that culminated in the destruction of the Calamari Light Cruise…
Alimet was an Imperial Flight Officer befriended by Maarek Stele.

Ketcher was a flight officer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Battle of Hoth, Ketcher was stationed on the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Fogger, where he befriended his fellow pilots Carith, Alimet and Maarek Stele.
Trilli was a Human male who lived on the Outbound Flight Colony in 22 ABY. He served as one of the Peacekeepers, helping to keep order within the remains of the original Outbound Flight vessel.
Oliet was one of the Peacekeepers of the Outbound Flight Colony in 22 ABY.
Ronson was one of the Peacekeepers of the Outbound Flight Colony in 22 ABY.
Dalla was a rubbery brown Hutt and an old acquaintance of Han Solo. Dalla allowed Solo into the sabacc game in which he won the planet Dathomir from the Drackmarian warlord Omogg.
Secciah was a Hapan princess, the second-eldest of the several daughters of the Queen Mother Ni'Korish, and thus the younger sister of Ta'a Chume and the aunt of the princes Kalen and Isolder.
Tannath was a female Dathomiri Witch of the Singing Mountain Clan. She was one of the few who believed that Gethzerion should have been killed when she fell to the dark side of the Force.
Shen was a female and a Dathomirian witch. By 8 ABY, she had an infant child and agreed to battle against Gethzerion and her Nightsisters.
Azbeth was a female Dathomiri of the Singing Mountain Clan who decided to fight against Gethzerion and her Nightsisters.
Ooya was a female Dathomiri witch of the Singing Mountain Clan who had made a pass at Isolder.
Varr was a female Dathomiri Witch who was friends with Teneniel Djo and later fell to the dark side and became a Nightsister.
T'da died on the planet Felucia where she was buried by Aayla and Quinlan Vos. Aayla herself would eventually be killed there as part of Order 66.
Taxer Sundown was a land baron who controlled much of the moisture farming property on Ord Mantell in 37 BBY, during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.

Kitha Farlander was an Agamarian female who was raised in Tondatha, a small town on Agamar, during the Imperial Era. Early in the Galactic Civil War, an Imperial attack on the town killed her mother and father and left her with severe burns.
Bithabus the Mystifier was a Bith stage magician who became famous across the galaxy for his performances at the Hologram Fun World's Asteroid Theater.
Litassa Colay was a female Human and the Director of Offworld Special Events on Chibias.

Luscen was a Jabiimi jailor during the Galactic Civil War. Placed in charge of guarding Princess Leia Organa, Nera Dantels and Jorin Sol (who had been captured by the Jabiimi rebels), he was killed during the Imperial attack against the Jabiimi Loyalists' headquarters.
Trigg was a Jabiimi Loyalist during the Galactic Civil War.
Dunaub was a Human male who served as a Jabiimi Loyalist commander.

Ndranth Poussan was a starfighter pilot in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. A native of the planet Agamar, Poussan joined the Alliance after a speech there by Chief of State Mon Mothma.
Sunnar Jan-lo was a native of Agamar and a member of the Agamar Resistance who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic after attending a recruitment speech by the Rebel Chief of State Mon Mothma.

Breth Gart was a male Agamarian starfighter pilot in the Alliance Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War. Gart joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic at the age of sixteen after attending a recruitment speech by Chief of State Mon Mothma on Agamar.
Elke Vetter was a Human Imperial Knight who served the Fel Empire before Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt deposed Emperor Roan Fel at the end of the Sith–Imperial War.

Darth Ruyn was an aged Twi'lek Sith Lord who served the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt and his One Sith. He instructed several apprentices in the Sith arts, including the female Twi'lek Darth Talon.

Brogar was a male Advozse who owned Brogar's Safe House and Cantina on the planet Lok, a cantina that doubled as a safe house for those who needed a place to lay low. Brogar used armed droid bouncers to keep the peace within his establishment.
Boss Banjeer was a Human male who served as the Governor of Baramorra during the Galactic Civil War.

Jahnar-Kooda was a male Herglic bounty hunter in the service of Boss Banjeer as of 11 ABY. He and other hunters were hired to keep the local Baramorrans in line. When local elders objected, Banjeer killed them.

Pamr was a young Corellian female that was being harassed by Ilir Post and two of his friends, in the aftermath of a Harvest Festival. She was rescued by Soontir Fel, who not only thrashed all three young men, but reported their crime to CorSec.
Ilir Post was the son of the director of the Allied Grain and Roughage on Corellia.
The impersonator of the Galactic Republic Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi was an Galactic Empire actor altered by plastic surgeons to resemble Obi-Wan Kenobi, under orders from Darth Vader.
Grigor was the human male Imperial Governor of the planet M'haeli in 0 ABY.
Merrik was a male Human who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Umgullian blob 14 was an Umgullian blob owned by Vob Bitas. During a race on Fondine Blob Raceways on Umgul, Bitas enhanced his blob with viscosity-enhancing substances. They were found in the blob at the end of the race, and Bitas was sentenced to death for cheating.
Zelen was a pilot in the 6th squadron squadron of the 37th Imperial Fighter Wing in 7 BBY.
Laine was a pilot trained by Soontir Fel at the Prefsbelt IV Naval Academy. He mocked Tycho Celchu for being from pacifistic Alderaan.
Rens was a pilot trained by Soontir Fel at the Prefsbelt IV Naval Academy.

Harrandatha Estillo, also known as Harran, was a Human male prince who served as a member of the royal family of Eiattu 6, a Mid Rim world (possibly capital of Ado sector) which retained its monarchical government under the New Order.

Kerred Santhe was a Human male industrialist from Lianna and a member of the Santhe family. He acquired a controlling share in Sienar Technologies and its subsidiary Republic Sienar Systems around 99 BBY.
Bels was one of the Peacekeepers of the Outbound Flight Colony in 22 ABY.
Amberson was a male Human and one of the Peacekeepers of the Outbound Flight Colony in 22 ABY.

Perry was an individual who served a term as one of the law-enforcing Peacekeepers of the Outbound Flight Colony, the government established by those who survived the Galactic Republic's survey ship Outbound Flight after its crash in a star cluster called the Redoubt.

Quinze was serving a term as one of the Peacekeepers in 22 ABY. As such, Quinze enforced the laws of the Outbound Flight Colony, the government established by those who survived the Galactic Republic's survey ship Outbound Flight after it crashed in a star cluster called the R…

Vedd Deviss was a pilot born in the swamps of Naboo. He was a merchant and knew the backcountry of Naboo extremely well. As an exceptional guide, he could find reclusive smugglers, concealed hideouts, and secret bases.
Grendel was a wing-clipped hornagaunt and a pet to the administrative droid 8t88.

A clone trooper was one of the many clones who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, he participated in the Battle of Brentaal IV under the command of Jedi General Shaak Ti.

Purpsh was a male Vagaari who accompanied Vagaari Empire Supreme Commander Estosh, General Bearsh, and another Vagaari, all of which posed as Geroons, during their infiltration of a Chiss mission to the Redoubt in 22 ABY.
Rowel was a male Ferroan who lived on Zonama Sekot.

Karkan was a Tevellan male who worked at a bacta production plant on his species' homeworld of Tevel. After the First Order annexed Tevel and took control of the bacta plant, forcing the Tevellans to work at the threat of their children being harmed, Karkan contacted the Resis…
Flax'Supt'ai was a Force-sensitive female Duinuogwuin who lived on Iego. She arrived on the planet in pre-Republic times, in the time of the Cronese Sweeps.
Eg'ros Akala was a male Caamasi who lived on Coruscant during the Imperial era. Around 3 BBY, he was arrested at the Imperial Palace for trying to buy a meal at one of the palace's restaurants.

Gogol owned the Lucky Star, which was one of the largest casinos in the Kushal Vogh on Elerion. He planned to help Nescan Tal'yo give his Rebel holocube to the Galactic Empire, but his plan was foiled by the Quetzal Sisters and Leia Organa, who destroyed the cube.
Nescan Tal'yo was a wolf-like information broker. His bodyguard was Hermos. He killed a Rebel courier on Farwell Station and captured a holocube detailing the locations of the Rebellion's main bases.
Sorn Argos was a male Human spacer who once tried to pick up Leia Organa in the Lucky Star casino.
Morely was a Human male who served as an officer assigned to Commander Shad.
Baydo Chasdy—"Bay" to his friends—was a Human male who owned the HyperDive Cantina on the planet Mon Calamari during the Galactic Civil War.
Typtus of the 33rd Egg was a Geonosian aristocrat of the Gehenbar hive. Named after the famed Gehenbar leader Typtus the First, he aimed to bring back the glory of his namesake.
Dunan Par'Ell was a male Human and owner of a security firm named Universal Guardians, Incorporated and head of security at the Ace of Sabres gambling resort.
Jenorri Delegam was a associate of Grappa the Hutt.

Phlygas Grynne was an assassin, once known as the best operative in the Core Worlds in the years around 12 ABY. It was said that he demanded a pay of 100,000 credits per job. He was possibly hired by Roganda Ismaren to kill the scientist Stinna Draesinge Sha.

Harme Kiela was a male Human and a lieutenant of the Eiattu pirates who attempted to trap Air Marshal Von Asch into rejoining the Galactic Empire. Asch quickly rejected the offer, though, claiming that the pirates were a disgrace to the Empire.
M'nista was a male Human aide to Baron Ragez D'Asta.

Nima Maas was a Human female who was the daughter of Governor Ilov Maas and an Imperial agent who pretended to work for the Rebel sympathizer Temo Dionisio. She had to kill the Rebel politician, but Nok Derrick kidnapped the man before she could do her job.
Temo Dionisio was a Human male politician who sympathized with the Rebel Alliance.
Nok Derrick was a freelance male entrepreneur who attempted to get some information about the Rebel Alliance to sell it to the Galactic Empire, by kidnapping the politician Temo Dionisio.

Falaem Onn was a humanoid member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic team called the Rebel Four. By 0 BBY, Onn and the team went on a mission to the Outer Rim planet Vatleria and confirmed the presence of an Imperial base there.

Grimgrim was a Wookiee who served as a member of a Rebel Alliance unit the Rebel Four during the Galactic Civil War. By 0 BBY, Grimgrim participated in an assault on a secret Imperial base on the planet Vatleria.

Soo Rcharrz was a humanoid member of the "Rebel Four," a team affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. They operated alongside the team's leader, F4-MF, and fellow members Falaem Onn and Grimgrim.

A Rodian Sith of Darth Krayt's One Sith was one of four Sith who ambushed four Jedi—Ahn Rasi Tuum, Wolf Sazen, Shado Vao, and one other—on the planet Daluuj in 137 ABY. The Rodian was decapitated by Shado Vao at the end of the skirmish.

Mimya was the aunt of Keyan Farlander who lived with her husband, Trinn on Oorn Tchis. After the Imperial attack on Tondatha, Farlander asked his aunt and uncle to look after his sister, Kitha, who was injured in the attack.
Trinn was the uncle of Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot Keyan Farlander and lived with his wife, Mimya, on Oorn Tchis in the Lahara sector.
Miaria Prrt was the female Felacatian Princess of Felacat and became Queen during the Clone Wars.
Charger was a captain in the Rebel Alliance who served on the Independence during the Galactic Civil War.
Pezzle was a Human on Karfeddion. One day he entered the Tipsy Mynock to collect payment from a mercenary named Lope.
A Force-sensitive Sith Governor was appointed to govern Taris when the Sith Empire conquered the planet during the Jedi Civil War.
Fossco was a Toydarian male, and served as one of Jabba Desilijic Tiure the Hutt's accountants. During a visit to Kessel, he was the first individual to find Warden Dewt Kluskine's dead body.
Mugshub was the alpha-female of the Klagg clan on Pzob in 12 ABY. She was captured by the Imperial battlemoon the Eye of Palpatine along with the many male members of her clan.

Jevax was a male Mluki and the Chief Person of Plett's Well on Belsavis in 12 ABY. Jevax was small for his species, although standing up straight instead of with his back inclined would have made him taller, and wore jewelry such as silver and blue shellwork imported from Eriadu.
Chatty was a male Human who lived on Belsavis as of 12 ABY.

Oso Nim was a female Duros with orange eyes who was living on Belsavis in 12 ABY. She was known as something of a gossip; she spoke to Han Solo about Drub McKumb's disappearance while he and his wife visited the planet in search of clues about the Jedi.

Bran Kemple was a brown-haired smuggler with pale green skin. When Han Solo first met him, he was a small gunrunner in the Juvex systems. He later became town boss of Plawal after the disappearance of Nubblyk the Slyte.
Mubbin was a male Whiphid who searched under Plett's Well for treasure.
Kinfarg was a male Gamorrean who was possibly the alpha-male of the Klagg clan. He was captured by the Eye of Palpatine where he and many warriors of his clan were indoctrinated by The Will.
Claine was a male Human and the uncle of Callista Ming. He lived on an ark on Chad with Callista and her father.

Bloodletter was the nickname of a corporate spy hired in 31 BBY by the Vratix Ashern group to infiltrate the Bacta Cartel. Surviving a close encounter with a Mandalorian in blue and silver armor, Bloodletter discovered the existence of the hybrid kolcta.

Framjen Spathen was a male holovid star in 12 ABY. Han Solo, while watching an "old" holovid that depicted a heavily muscled Spathen with long glowing hair, recalled that it was fifteen years old, and that he had seen it in dozens of cheap clubs in the past.
Sadie was a male Abyssin working as a bartender in the Jungle Lust on Belsavis in 12 ABY.
Elizie Magrody was a female Arkanian, the wife of Nasdra Magrody and the mother of Shenna Magrody. She was taken into custody by the Galactic Empire so Nasdra would work with them.
Shenna Magrody was a female Arkanian, the daughter of Nasdra and Elizie Magrody. She, along with her mother, were taken into custody by the Empire so her father would work with them.
Dro was Callista Ming's uncle. He didn't like having fun and believed others shouldn't.
Stinna Draesinge Sha was a programmer and teacher at the Magrody Institute of Programmable Intelligence, and a brilliant AI programming theoretician.
Yun Genda was a male Human Sith trooper stationed on the planet Taris in 3956 BBY.
Sarna was a female Human Sith trooper and Sith officer stationed on the planet of Taris in 3956 BBY as part of the Sith occupation of that planet. She had the rank of Junior Officer First Class.
Xant Flashheel was a male Nosaurian from Phemiss, on New Plympto. He was a rambunctious adolescent with a short temper, and had broken two horns in fights.

Glarc Leapfar was a Nosaurian poacher of Clan Leapfar from New Plympto. He led a gang of poachers who collected rikknit ovum sacs. However, he respected nature and was always careful not to disturb the balance of the ecosystem or harm the rikknit.

Repelled at Zeltros by a combined force, Sereno allied his forces with Dark Lady of the Sith Lumiya to defeat their mutual enemy: the Alliance of Free Planets, which had since reorganized into the New Republic.

Exozone was an insectoid bounty hunter that sometimes worked with Boba Fett and Dengar. During the events surrounding the return of the resurrected Emperor, he helped the other bounty hunters chase Han Solo and Princess Leia through the streets of Nar Shaddaa.
Rojarra was a Wookiee diplomat who was killed by Kaox Krul during the New Sith Wars.
Beuga Odell, the crime boss of Imperial City, was a heavy-set Human female in her seventh or eighth decade of life.

Hokkor Long was the Secretary in Charge of Scheduling for the Imperial Entertainers' Guild. In a communication to Viceprex Hirken on Stars' End, Hokkor Long apologized for rescheduling a visiting troupe of entertainers the Vice-President had requested.
Corlin Quarle Deld was one of the co-founders of the Verkuylian BactaCo.
Parco Ein was a former Human male Colonel who served in the Imperial Army until he became the Imperial governor of the planet Verkuyl during the Galactic Civil War.
Kam was a Human male smuggler fence who operated out of the Science Outpost on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Aaren Larker was a male Samarian who served as the Prime Minister of Samaria during the Clone Wars.

Naithol was a male Sullustan executive of Seinar Corporation. He was in a meeting with Roganda and Irek Ismaren on Belsavis in 12 ABY about the Eye of Palpatine, where he also disputed Irek's relationship with Palpatine and Drost Elegin.
Lord Vensell Picutorion was the head of House Picutorion in 12 ABY. He was presumably from Picutorion, and had been present at Leia Organa's Senatorial debut.

Stusjevsky was a male Chadra-Fan living and working on Belsavis in 12 ABY as a sniffer in a vine-coffee garden. He aided Han Solo and Chewbacca in finding Leia Organa Solo, who had been kidnapped by Roganda Ismaren.

Carbinol was the Lady of House Carbinol in 12 ABY who met with Roganda and Irek Ismaren about the Eye of Palpatine. She had an athletic build, and, despite pledging her support, did not trust Ismaren.
Theala Vandron was the Lady of House Vandron in 12 ABY. Theala was described as heavyset and stately.

Drost Elegin was the Lord of House Elegin in 12 ABY and was considered a playboy and a gentleman who attended many of Emperor Palpatine's private parties on Coruscant. His brother joined the Imperial Navy. Drost Elegin was commonly featured in the Court Gazette magazine.
Triv Pothman was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire who was stationed on the planet Pzob in order to wait for pickup by the Eye of Palpatine. He was the company armorer.

Ugbuz was the alpha-male of the Gakfedd clan in 12 ABY who wore a helmet adorned with other Gamorrean's ears and wielded an axe made of blast shielding. On Pzob, the Gamorrean was captured by the Imperial battlemoon the Eye of Palpatine.

Krok was a male Gamorrean and the junior husband of the alpha-female of the Gakfedd clan, Bullyak. He, along with Ugbuz, Bullyak, and several other Gamorrean warriors were captured the Eye of Palpatine.

Bullyak was the alpha female of the Gakfedd clan who was captured by the Eye of Palpatine in 12 ABY. She and Ugbuz dressed and splinted Luke Skywalker's leg when the Jedi was injured in a battle against the opposing Klagg clan.
Margolis Mingla was the daughter of a Jedi Knight and the mother of Cray Mingla. She watched over the children at Plett's house on Belsavis including her daughter's future fiancé, Nichos Marr.

Brigantes Ustu was a female Ho'Din who was in charge in watching over a Forceful children in the catacombs of Jedi Master Plett's house on Belsavis during the time of the Great Jedi Purge.Nichos Marr recalled her being nearly two meters in height.

Fligh was a petty thief and informer for Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Didi Oddo. He was a tall, slender male Human with a bright green prosthetic eye to replace one he had lost in a strife with Hutts. Fligh had a long face and prominent ears.
Helb was a male Neimoidian broker for stolen tech equipment in a gang called the Tech Raiders on Coruscant. He once hired Fligh to steal a datapad from Senator Uta S'orn.
Sula Autem was a female Human who was the wife of Sagoro and the mother of Reymet and Lissa.
Lissa Autem was a female Human who was the daughter of Sagoro and Sula, and the younger sister of Reymet.
Wyrrhem was the Imperial Moff who controlled the Aparo sector during the time of the New Order.
She had a computer chip implant within her brain that allowed her to interface with computers and droids.

Lune Oddo Divinian was a Force-sensitive Human male who was the son of Astri Oddo and Bog Divinian. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Divinian received basic training in the ways of the Force as well as the tenets of the Jedi Order by fugitive Jedi Masters Ry-Gaul and G…
Quintus Farel was a male Samarian who died along with his parents in a speeder accident at the age of two.
Nogdra was a captain in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War, who later defected to the Rebel Alliance.
Alani was a Human female who was the daughter of Ewane and twin sister of Eritha.
Eritha was a female human who was the daughter of Ewane and twin sister of Alani.

Irini was a female member of the Workers on New Apsolon. She was part of a group of Workers that wanted to bring the Absolutes to justice. She worked at the Absolute museum on the planet as a tour guide. Irini disliked Jedi.

Tanlin Sha, an un'Yala of the Rellarin people, was a principal advisor to the Swaze during the Galactic Civil War period. Though Sha never left the Rellarin homeworld of Rellnas Minor, the Swaze leaders would visit Sha and other Rellarin sages once every standard year.

Moshene Tre was the un'Yala, or chief, of the Cas'ta tribe of the Rellarin people of Rellnas Minor. As expected of a Rellarin un'Yala, he was a peaceful person, with a strong sense of ethics and justice.

Jor Ul Kurax was an Aqualish merchant during the Jedi Civil War who mistakenly transferred Crate 42-B7, a shipment of gizka, to Revan and the Ebon Hawk crew at Docking Bay 32 of Anchorhead on Tatooine.

An Aqualish Sith was one of four of Darth Krayt's Order that ambushed four Jedi—including Ahn Rasi Tuum, Wolf Sazen, and Shado Vao—on the planet Daluuj in 137 ABY. He was cut in two at the torso by Master Sazen during the skirmish.

Ren S'orn was the son of Senator Uta S'orn. He was Force sensitive and was identified at a young age for Jedi training. Senator S'orn, not wanting to part with her son refused to allow him to go and train within the Jedi Temple.

Jett Nabon was a Human male smuggler, probably from Corellia. He adopted Fenig Nabon when she still was a child living on the street of Coronet. He was known as a man of great compassion, and had worked with the Mistryl Shadow Guard on several occasions.
Lexhannen Torlock was the Imperial Governor of the planet Corulag. He was incredibly paranoid and believed that the Rebels were planning to capture Corulag.

Essara was a Tarasin. He once posed as a double for Va'Lonis, a member of the band Distraction. Along with doubles of the other band members, he was escorted off the ship Sleemo Poya Jeedai by Xydge, as part of a security ploy.
Rhys was a male Human who served as a sergeant in the army of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Kerl was a young male Human from Naboo who served as a starfighter pilot in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps' Echo Flight.
Harlaan was a pilot who served the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps as part of Echo Flight. In 33 BBY, they flew as Echo Six in the attack on Station TFP-9.
Challep was the male governor of Agamar in 33 BBY. During this year, he sought to bolster Agamar's planetary defences, in particular the starfighter contingencies.
Chack was the name of a saurian quadruped who sniffed out contraband for the Eriadu Customs and Immigration security forces.
Sorran was a male Agamari pirate and commander of the Velumina. In 33 BBY he was hired to attack Station TFP-9 to capture several N-1s.
Evenyl Yob was a teenage female Human from Naboo who served as a starfighter pilot in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps' Echo Flight.
Keela Egast was a Human female pilot in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps' Echo Flight.

Dren Melne was a Human male from Naboo. As a young man he left his homeworld, becoming a mercenary. He later returned and joined the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps, becoming the lover of his commanding officer, Essara Till before betraying Space Fighter Corps in an unsuccessf…
Utris was a Sith Warrior who was healed by Sith Lord Rin Shuuir when he was incapacitated in battle.
