Uueg Tching, a male member of the Kitel Phard Dynasty and the fifty-fourth Emperor of Atrisia, was famous for his ability to keep order through espionage, assassination, and deception.
Alyssia was a princess of the Hapan Royal House, a niece of Ta'a Chume, to whom she bore a close physical resemblance. She was also the younger sister of Chelik.
Chelik was a princess of the Hapan Royal House, a niece of Ta'a Chume, and the older sister of Alyssia. She was believed to harbor ambitions to usurp the throne and become Queen Mother of Hapes.

Vitor Reige was a male human who became the first democratically-elected Head of State of the Imperial Remnant and had served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy, and had been a shuttle pilot for the Jagged Fel during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Reist was a nightmare demon of Droxine, one of the few to have survived his species' extermination prior to the Clone Wars.

Irin Fossyr was a member of Alliance Intelligence and worked directly under Airen Cracken. Iella Wessiri used the name as a pseudonym in order to slip onto Coruscant before its capture by the New Republic.
Ute Raek was a Dathomirian priestess for the Singing Mountain Clan on Dathomir.

Salculd was a sterile female Selonian with sleek black fur everywhere except her belly, which was light brown. She was a member of the Hunchuzuc Den living on Corellia. She was bred to be a pilot and flew primitive Selonian cone ships.
Dalla Solo, also known as Dalla Suul or Dalla the Black, was a Human male of Corellian ancestry who became a notorious pirate around the time of the Clone Wars.

Dalla Suul was a human male native to the Core World Corellia, as well as a notorious Corellian pirate. Following Tobias Beckett's raid on the planet Kessel, a Crimson Dawn enforcer claimed that the Corellian Han Solo was Suul's grandson.

Rohlan Dyre, also called the Questioner, was a Human male Mandalorian Crusader and a former commander who fought in the early skirmishes of the Mandalorian Wars. He deserted the wars multiple times in an attempt to find answers pertaining to the war itself.

Ritinki was a Bimm male crimelord. Around 0 ABY, Ritinki attended a meeting with Rodian kingpin Vop on the Ithorian Herdship Song of the Clouds; during the summit, the Bimm was killed by the thief Cecil Noone and his crew, and his yacht Asaari Wind was stolen by the outlaws.

Rutt was the loyal Houk servant of Krish business magnate Tyro Viveca, and also assisted him in his hunting excursions on the planet Kabal. Rutt was killed on a hunt in 0 ABY after he was attacked on Viveca's Palisade estate by a female Florn Lamproid.

Dawson was a male Tynnan demolitions operative and a member of thief Cecil Noone's crew as of 0 ABY. An expert in explosives who loved playing water-wall and creating and detonating bombs in his youth, Dawson fled his homeworld of Tynna after being chosen by lottery to fill a …

Guttu was a Hutt gangster who employed thief Cecil Noone and his associates around 0 ABY. He was double-crossed by Noone after the latter stole a Hapan Gun of Command prototype. Shortly afterward, Guttu put a bounty on the thief's head.

Hass Sonax was a Sluissi slicer in the employ of Cecil Noone around 0 BBY. A cyborg, she used a BioTech Industries Borg Construct Aj^6 cyborg headband in her work. Personal experience led her to despise Imperials.
Treetower was a male Ugnaught Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Nyik was an Ebranite operative for the Rebel Alliance.
Tor'ara was an Ebranite operative for the Rebel Alliance.

Grasheel was the Wookiee partner of Shamus Falconi. They formed their partnership at a cantina named the Airlock on Algor. Falconi had just inherited his grandmother's starship and was celebrating, when he awoke the next day Grasheel revealed that he was now his partner.
Jouffer Talamiin was a Rebel infiltrator.
Aven Cholus was a Human Rebel infiltrator and pilot.
Senn Cholus was an Imperial officer who later defected to the Rebel Alliance.
Korgath was a Taloron infiltrator agent for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Opit-Wenbrugh was a Tren and a Rebel infiltrator.

Stoer Kilos was a Force-sensitive living on the moon Rori during the Galactic Civil War. Roughly half a day before the Battle of Restuss started, he went out into the field to meditate and returned to find the city of Restuss in ruins, in the middle of the battle.

Kels Turkorn was a female Human thief living around 0 ABY who partnered herself with Cecil Noone. She, along with Noone, the Sluissi slicer Hass Sonax, and the Tynnan demolitions expert Dawson double-crossed their Hutt employer after stealing a Hapan Gun of Command and made of…
Gilad Halsek was the Imperial Consul-General on Kothlis.
Dutra Zeneta was a male Jin from the Zchtek worlds who joined the growing resistance that became the Alliance to Restore the Republic shortly after the Galactic Empire subjugated his homeworld.

Thilis-Brin was a female Ishi Tib serving with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. A technician, she was assigned to the Mon Calamari Shipyards as a troubleshooter after completing recruit training.

Dheendo was a male Rodian who served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Shroud Team during the Galactic Civil War. Originally a bounty hunter operating out of the planet Kazlin 5, Dheendo joined the Alliance after a less-than-stellar career.
Tamo Lan was a male Carosite field medic who served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Gondara was an Aqualish female from the planet Ando. She was raised by her older brother, Karlon, after their parents were killed by the Galactic Empire.

Harovan Toth was a Human male Infiltrator who served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. A native of the planet Reynon, Toth joined the resistance forces on his homeworld before joining the Alliance proper on the planet Dantooine.
Gort was a Houk male who, during the height of the Clone Wars, frequented Maggot's Cantina, located in the planet Anzat's spaceport.

Feldrall Okor was a male pirate who had been attacking Imperial shipment's in the sector Governor Isis was based in. The bounty hunter Boba Fett captured him for the governor after she put a bounty of 50,000 credits on him. Okor lost an arm in the process.

Polipe was a multi-tentacled alien who served as Booster Terrik's co-pilot on the Pulsar Skate in the years before the Battle of Yavin. He and Booster kept Wedge Antilles safe when the Bonestar Pirates destroyed the fuel depot operated by Wedge's parents on Gus Treta.

Magus was a male Human bounty hunter who worked the blood trade in the years leading up to the Battle of Naboo. He was hired by the Corporate Alliance many times, often for clandestine and illegal missions.
Alexander Julstan IV was an Imperial Moff.
Lexia Ginorra, known superstitiously as "the Sith," was a female Human Jedi Padawan serving the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Shoto Eyefire was a male Defel. He made his living as a professional blastfighter and criminal with a local reputation. He made his home near Horn Station.

Maximillian Seerdon was an Imperial commander who worked in the Intelligence Division of the Imperial Security Bureau. His father was Moff Kohl Seerdon, who arranged for him to receive his high-ranking position.

Izbela Saarrj was a Human female lieutenant in the Imperial Forensic Intelligence who filed a report concerning the crime lord, Tyber Zann, shortly after the Battle of Yavin. This report would eventually be looked into by Maximillian Seerdon for Emperor Palpatine.
Scay Danson was a member of the Imperial Security Bureau. A few months following the Battle of Yavin, Danson filed a report regarding the possible threat of the Bounty Hunters' Guild.
Clyngunn was a male ZeHethbra with mostly black fur covering him from head to toe, with the exception of a wide white stripe running from his nose, up over his head and down his back.

Muzzle, also known as ARC-66, was a defective clone trooper who served as an Advanced Recon Commando in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Gavin Zmitt was a member of the Imperial Security Bureau who worked in the office of Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin. A few months following the Battle of Yavin, Zmitt filed a report regarding the Smuggler's Run.

Udin was a Kubaz bounty hunter who was hired by Eugene Talmont to track down Han Solo after the Battle of Yavin. He took the commission aspiring to get a better position off of the planet Tatooine if he succeeded in capturing the bounty.

Xob was a Gamorrean henchman to Olag Greck. He was sometimes seen with Greck during his reign. He was one of few Gamorreans to carry a gun, bazooka, or any modern weapon of that time on a regular basis.
Huba was the captain of the Indobok Pirates.
Urai Fen was a Force-sensitive Talortai who served as lieutenant of the Zann Consortium and its crime lord Tyber Zann's loyal bodyguard.
Daven Quarle was a male Human aide to the Imperial governor Parco Ein during the Empire's occupation of the planet Verkuyl.
Shabba was a being with the New Republic crew members stationed at the Rogue Squadron base on Cilpar during the rebellion era.
Malta was a Hutt who associated with Jabba and Embra at Jabba's Palace on Tatooine. He owned the luxury freighter Brownstar.
Jozzel Moffet was a female near-Human handmaiden in the service of Malta the Hutt before the Battle of Yavin.

Farquil Ban'n was a female Bith from Clak'dor VII who served as Embra the Hutt's assistant in 0 BBY. When Embra participated in a competition with fellow Hutts Malta and Jabba Desilijic Tiure to see who could hire the the most effective contractors to retrieve the valuable Yav…

Boshuda was a Kashyyyk bolstyngar that placed second in the Annual Mid-Rim Domesticated Sub-Sentient Show. When the winner, a wilwog named Itipiniwi won, it became excited, thus annoying the sensitive bolstyngar.

Rolsat "Rolstone" Noviee was a male Clawdite. For nine standard years, he posed as a Lannik for the New Osler Flejj Beasts, a Pugil team. Exposed by a random blood test in 22 BBY, he immediately fled the planet Lannik.
Greel was the co-owner of The Broken Tusk alongside his brother Gorge. Greel was the brains of the two brothers and managed the business side of their cantina.
Gorge was a Gamorrean. Along with his brother, Greel, he owned the Broken Tusk on Reuss VIII, a planet in Portmoak sector. While his brother managed the business, Gorge was in charge of security.

Ketku was a starfighter pilot and member of Red Squadron's Renegade Flight under Commander Narra when the group of fighters were escorting a Rebel convoy that was carrying supplies from Derra IV to Echo Base on Hoth.

Qid Proko was a male Quarren Jedi Knight and a survivor of Order 66, which Supreme Chancellor Palpatine issued in an attempt to wipe out the Jedi Order following the Clone Wars. Proko managed to evade the Great Jedi Purge and traveled the galaxy for a time.
King Marlox was the ruler of the Quorks of Quork City on Endor.
Shuma was a displaced Hutt businessman on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War.
Sardu Sallowe was a Tusken Raider from Tatooine who eventually left his home planet to search for his fortune off-world as a bounty hunter.
Tinketh Fo, sometimes called "Boss," was an astute male Pinurquian who served as the planetary leader of Keyorin during the Galactic Civil War.

Vu Chusker was a male member of a blue-skinned species who was an associate of the crime lord Cabrool Nuum. In the year 5 BBY, shortly after Nuum's death, Chusker was killed by the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Smarteel.
Ebab was an Ewok who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, he was tasked with guarding an Ewok artifact known as the bridge crystal, but he fell asleep on the job and the crystal was stolen.
Minch was a member of a short-statured tridactyl species and Jedi Knight who lived during the Golden Age of the Old Republic.
Kovacs was a stormtrooper stationed on the Forest moon of Endor prior to 4 ABY.

Dazen Mok was a a male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the years leading up to the Clone Wars. Voluntarily retiring from the Order, Mok began a long journey exploring the Cularin system and its unusual events.
Kerlo was a criminal employed by Shoto Eyefire, a Defel crime boss who controlled Horn Station. He was a thug and professional gunman, and usually got into fights because of his brute temper.

Bnugor was a male Gamorrean who had a pet snuzzleguff called Snowball. The Gamorrean lost Snowball on Mynock 7 Space Station but later recovered it at the Farrimmer Cafe owned by the old Filvian H'nib Statermast.
Burg was a Gamorrean who worked for Elwis Bontraar as a guard onboard the Masquerade.

Norba Nuum was a Near-Human alien female who was the daughter of Cabrool Nuum and the sister of Rusk Nuum. Although she seemed to be quiet and reserved alongside her brother, Norba was in fact the most ambitious of Cabrool's children.
Rusk Nuum was a Near-Human alien male who was the son of Cabrool Nuum and the brother of Norba. Like his sister, he had his eyes on their father's criminal empire.
Yith Ganar was a female Kel Dor and a tech specialist. She was 1.6 meters tall and had black eyes and dusky red skin.
Doln Tok was a Force-sensitive male Kel Dor masseur.
Rufus Trammel was a smuggler who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.
Kon Uuln was a Kel Dor living outside his homeworld of Dorin. He was married and had two children. Kon bought Dorin gas from the captain of the independent freighter named Renegade.

Breela was a female Farghul bounty hunter, and leader of Crimson Nova, a chapter of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. She was the daughter of Mika, a bounty hunter who worked during the Clone Wars and hated Jedi.
Bellek was a moisture farmer on Tatooine before and during the Clone Wars. Raala Ponchar was one of his employees.
Fleet Admiral Krieg was a Zabrak Imperial stationed at Kachirho on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.

Durmag was a force-pike-wielding Gamorrean mercenary. He worked as muscle on Socorro for the Twi'lek gangster Abdi-Badawzi before he was traded to Ploovo Two-For-One for a previous favor and became a member of Ploovo's Protocol Team.

Dalmeidan Kretch was a minor Imperial bureaucrat and part-time bounty hunter. To almost everyone who knew him, Kretch was a lonely, unhappy man with a domineering spouse and a minor position in his planet's bureaucracy.
Demolinn was part of the security detachment aboard the New Republic Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Liberator when it was downed over Coruscant. General Wedge Antilles assigned Demolinn and Mr.
Mr. Greybird was one of the security personnel aboard the New Republic Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Liberator when it was downed over Coruscant.
Fruck was a Gamorrean boar. He was one of Captain Ugmush's husbands and a gunner onboard her ship, the Zicreex.
Gar was a muscular Gamorrean who worked for the Squib crime lord Slythor on Korad. He wore armor made from a reptilian creature and typically carried a large vibroglaive.
Glongfurrp was a Gamorrean guard who was employed by Toln ne Yerres as a servant and bodyguard.

Nyantolo was a Rodian scout who was part of an expedition exploring the swamps of Wyndigal 2. During the expedition, he came too close to an unknown creature. The creature suddenly swept Nyantolo's legs out from under him, and crushed his head with its strong beak.
Decca Besadii Diori, also known as Decca the Hutt, was daughter of Gardulla Besadii the Elder and the sister of Gardulla Besadii the Younger.
The Death Star prisoner was a male Human Jedi who had served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Tolo Kad was a male politician from Onderon. He was the aide to King Ommin.

B'ante Hatcher was the leader of the Resistance on Agamar, a local group opposed to the Galactic Empire during the early years of the Galactic Civil War. He attended a secret rally held by Mon Mothma to encourage the Agamar Resistance to become part of the Rebel Alliance.
Beme was a male captain and recruiter for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Pylokam was an aged Human male who sold health food in the Mos Eisley marketplace in 0 BBY. He sold food without sugars, salts, or artificial additives. Predne Balu held a watch at his stand while looking for Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Manex was a Human male who was the brother of Roan and the Supreme Governor of New Apsolon during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Gorug was a Gamorrean who served as a soldier on the modified Nebulon-B frigate, the Free Lance, commanded by Urias Xhaxin.
Gruk, or Green Gruk, was a male Gamorrean pirate who was the leader of a small pack of other Gamorreans.
Tarkil Hroka was a former Gamorrean soldier and was subsequently one of the best pit-fighters on the planet of Jenenma.
Kirry was a female Human native to Horn Station. She once met a Human Jedi, "Pinky," who was on a mission to liberate the planet from Shoto Eyefire's tyranny.
H'buk was an Atzerri glitterstim dealer. He flew an old Z-95 Headhunter.
A male Bith was the dealer in the Cloud City Sabacc Tournament final where Han Solo won the Millennium Falcon from Lando Calrissian.

Micah was the Cathar adoptive child of Nat Skywalker, then going by the alias "Bantha" Rawk, and Droo, and the step-sibling of Ahnah and Skeeto, who lived during the time of the Second Imperial Civil War. Micah had cybernetic legs, built by Nat himself.

Wac Bur was a male Rodian who worked as a counterfeiter and forger. In 24 ABY, he sold fake art to Gebbu the Hutt who, in retaliation, sent the bounty hunter Boba Fett after him. Fett tracked Bur down on the Core world of Coruscant.
Gebbu was a Hutt art collector. Wac Bur sold him fake art in 24 ABY, and so Gebbu sent Boba Fett after him.
Wartogg was a male Gamorrean trader who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted dead by Jabba the Hutt for switching allegiances to Gardulla.
Ughok Snorg was a loyal, loutish, dull-witted male Gamorrean with dark green skin, black eyes and numerous scars on his face from knife and blaster wounds.

Menugg was a Gamorrean male who worked as a successful soldier on his homeworld of Gamorr. He was eventually persuaded to leave the planet by a group of off-worlders and began working as a mercenary throughout the galaxy.

Steef was a Gamorrean who worked for the Chev businessman Orman. He was loyal to Orman but was quite lazy and preferred to sleep than fight. In a fight he would often find a way to quietly leave the action.
Ithmir was a Gamorrean who owned a small cantina called the Thorip Norr, which was located in the city of Lola Curich on the planet Lianna.
Balto was a male Human from Kalarba. He was the husband of Lilta, and the couple had several kids together. Balto helped Baron Pitareeze escape the clutches of Olag Greck.
Slaff was a Gamorrean who worked at the Desert Survey Office as Telowe's assistant. The Desert Survey Office was located in Mos Eisley.
Venorra was a Gamorrean and a member of the Groogrun clan. Venorra sold Ortugg into Jabba the Hutt's service.
Sar Omant was a Zabrak mercenary working for the Separatists during the Clone Wars.
Rich was a young Human male technician in the Rebel Alliance. He was stationed at Yavin 4 at the time of the battle there and was an admirer of Luke Skywalker.
Uurk was a Gamorrean peace officer on the planet Emmer.
G'Nung was a Gamorrean who appeared to work as an enforcer for Jasta Finn. He actually worked directly for Chiron Drebbick.
Gorrt was a powerfully built Gamorrean who served as the bodyguard for a Jawa called Akkik. The pair worked for Jabba the Hutt collecting protection money.

Holgurn was a diminutive Gamorrean who worked for Jabba the Hutt as a messenger. He was more articulate than most of the Gamorreans within Jabba's ranks. Prior to the Battle of Yavin he delivered a message to Han Solo from Jabba asking him to help recover the Yavin Vassilika.

Grrtok was a male Gamorrean who was the leader of a mercenary group called Grrtok's Band. During the Galactic Civil War, Grrtok was a warrior well past his prime, but still a formidable combatant by other species' standards.

Jargool Muus was a Gamorrean bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War. He was one of a group of bounty hunters led by Zinn Classet that were tasked by authorities representing the Spice Mines of Kessel to hunt several Alliance to Restore the Republic operatives who had free…
Karadbria was a male free-trader who tried to make a board game marketed towards Gamorreans, gambling on the idea that they were more intelligent than believed.

Snogrutt was a Gamorrean engineer and master weapon maker who was part of the Groogrun clan. Snogrutt was a minnow in the world of weapons manufacturing, and was known for producing some of the crudest vibro-axs on the market.
Urg was a Gamorrean who worked for Elwis Bontraar as a guard onboard the Masquerade.
Wallanooga the Hutt, also known as both Walla and Nooga, was one of the most powerful arms dealers in the Outer Rim until his death.
Shebba Kalshi Desilijic was a Hutt of the Desilijic kajidic who lived on the agricultural planet Shawti.

Glott was a Gotal bounty hunter who worked for the Galactic Empire. As a Gotal, he had the ability to sense when people were going to attack. This ability helped Glott to become one of the best known and feared bounty hunters around.
Gundruk was a female Gamorrean of the Bolgoink clan from Gamorr. She was one of the elder daughters of the clan matron Kufbrug and held the Nudskutch region of the Bolgoink territory.
Rog was a Gamorrean male who was married to Gundruk. He was the Warlord of the Nudskutch holding of the Bolgoink clan and brother of the Clan Warlord Vrokk.
Guth was a Gamorrean tusker from Gamorr. He was the brother of the trading captain Ugmush. Guth was small by Gamorrean standards but was aggressive and dedicated to his goals.
Grissuk was a male Gamorrean who initially worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure before he switched his allegiance to Gardulla Besadii the Elder during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Tolra was a Gamorrean male who lived on Coruscant with his family. He contracted the Krytos virus when Ysanne Isard released it upon the capital. Tolra realized that he was unwell and separated himself from his family to prevent them from contracting the virus.

Vrokk was a Gamorrean male and clan warlord of the Bolgoink clan. He was married to the clan matron Kufbrug and brother of Rog. Rog was married to Kufbrug's daughter, Gundruk, and the pair arranged for Vrokk to be killed by a kheilwar.
Carnuss Gorguul was an ancient Gamorrean whose citadel ruins became the site of a podracing event during the waning days of the Old Republic before the rise of the Galactic Empire.
Ishenn was a Gamorrean who was employed by Thaddeus Ross and Trep Winterrs to lead a diplomatic security detail. Ishenn failed to protect the ambassador they were assigned to protect.

Kufbrug was a female Gamorrean and the clan matron of the Bolgoink clan. She was a huge sow at nearly two meters in height and weighing over two hundred kilograms. She wore her long green-brown hair in braids and was covered with a large number of morrts.
In 22 BBY, a Givin Jedi was an active member of the Jedi Order and an officer in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Alec Pradeux was a privy advisor to Emperor Palpatine.

Okto was a Human male captain in the Imperial Army who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was in charge of the Imperial bunker during the Battle of Restuss, and directed troops to destroy Rebel comm antennas and kill the Rebel leader Captain Vrinko.

Exov was a Human male captain in the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He directed stormtroopers in disrupting Rebel supply lines, and capturing stolen sensor arrays during the Battle of Restuss in 1 ABY.
Roth was an Imperial female Zabrak captain for the Imperial Army who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Gregor was a Human male lieutenant in the Galactic Empire who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He ordered troops to Talus to eliminate Rebel Commandos being sent to Rori during the Battle of Restuss.
Luthus Tadrin was the Imperial Governor of the Tadrin sector, one of three sectors that made up the Cassandran Worlds. He was a descendant of Cassander Tadrin, the namesake of the Cassandran Worlds.

"Pinky" was the insulting term used to label an undercover male Human Jedi Knight during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. A member of the Jedi Order, this man liberated Horn Station from the tyranny of Shoto Eyefire.
Seaan was a Corellian who served as a member of Red Hand Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. He participated in the capture of Helot's Shackle alongside Bria Tharen.

Rianna Saren was a female Twi'lek slave escapee who became a criminal and, afterward, a Rebel Alliance heroine. Early in her life, Saren was sold into Imperial slavery to the Zabrak Zarien Kheev, only to escape on the planet Coruscant to follow a criminal path.
Pakka was a male Trianii who, while still a cub, participated in the liberation of the Corporate Sector prison Stars' End in 2 BBY.

Qlaern Hirf was a Vratix member of the Ashern Circle and a verachen on the planet Thyferra. Hirf made contact with Rogue Squadron during the Krytos threat, alerting them to the location of deadly bacta aboard a space station around Yag'Dhul.
Rars Lefken was the male captain of the light freighter Lefken's Dreams. He was bearded and had a thick mop of hair, with a creature living in it.
Sabol was an Imperial Lieutenant who was stationed in Bestine during 1 ABY.
A Bith worked as a bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War.
A green-skinned satyr-like alien worked as a bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War.
Keeheen was a male Trianii who served in the elite Trianii Rangers on the frontier of Trianii Space during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

This individual was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Surviving the rise of the Galactic Empire with his Padawan, Drakka Judarrl, this Master was eventually found and executed by Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Nivek'Yppiks was a Ffib heretic. He was wanted by his Ffib "brothers" for his heresy.
Veren Gal was an ancient Sith archaeologist who spent many years on Korriban during the era of the Jedi Civil War, researching the tombs in the Valley of the Dark Lords.
Gates Harnik was a Human male grocer supplying the local resistance on the planet of Cilpar in 4 ABY.
Boren Tascl was a Human Moff of the Galactic Empire, who was based on the planet Cilpar during the Galactic Civil War. He was a man of average build, with a goatee and long mustache.
Chang was a member of Elscol Loro's Cilpar-based resistance in 4 ABY.
Jollie was an human male ambassador who appears to have been attached to the staff of Grand Moff Lynch Hauser in 0 ABY.
Jalose was a Human female who served in the Rebel Alliance as a guerrilla fighter during the Galactic Civil War.
Camax was a Human male lieutenant in the Alliance Intelligence, a branch of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, in 0 ABY.

Kubariet was a Humanoid male Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order, and a member of New Republic Intelligence. When the galaxy came under invasion by the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong species, Kubariet worked to combat the alien invaders.

The Peragus Mining Facility Maintenance Officer was responsible for droid repairs throughout the complex during the Dark Wars. He was killed in 3951 BBY by the facility's own droids when an HK-50 assassin droid hacked them during its search for Jedi Exile Meetra Surik.
Jodeen was a Human male who served as captain in command of Durkii Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Harran was a Human male Rebel officer holding the rank of captain in 0 ABY. He was of slightly above average height, and had red hair.
Petro was an Imperial TIE/LN starfighter pilot in Crimson Squadron, stationed at Kiidan on Cilpar in 4 ABY.
Grode was an Imperial TIE/LN starfighter pilot, who held the ranks of Major and Wing Commander on the planet Cilpar in 4 ABY.
Aldrich Kugel was an Imperial TIE/LN starfighter pilot serving in Crimson Squadron on Cilpar in 4 ABY.
Finn was a male Human who served as an Imperial TIE/LN starfighter pilot who was attached to Crimson Squadron when it was stationed on Cilpar in 4 ABY.
Rebel Rock was the codename given to a sniper in the resistance movement on Cilpar in 4 ABY.
Tap was a young human male who lived in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, working as an assistant for the collector Dok-Ondar.
Galen was a short stocky Radnoran, with curly brown hair and very muscular legs. He was a scientist and weapons engineer who lived in the years prior to the Clone Wars.
Curi was a Radnoran who lived in the years prior to the Clone Wars.

Dol Heep was an ambassador to the planet Radnor from Avon who tried to convince the Radnoran brother-and-sister scientific team Galen and Curi to sell to the Avoni the new bio-weapon they were developing.
Ruuin was a Radnoran who was among many of the looters in league with the Avoni after a bioplague terrorized the planet of Radnor. He was brought into custody by Anakin Skywalker and Tru Veld.

Wilk was a Radnoran who was believed to be immune to Radnor's bioplague, as he was seen in the Isolation Sector without a protective bio-isolation suit looking for his wife. Later on, it turned out that he was not immune.
Zonnos Anjiliac Priare was a Hutt of the Anjiliac kajidic. He was framed for the murder of his father, Popara Anjiliac Diresto, by his brother, Mika Anjiliac Chiera, the real murderer.

Zonnos the Great was the Hutt who ruled the Anjiliac kajidic prior to Popara Anjiliac Diresto's reign. Popara named his firstborn child Zonnos Anjiliac Priare to honor Zonnos the Great. The junior Zonnos was given an informal nickname of "Zonnos the Lesser" by his peers.
Snagel was a member of the Imperial Select Committee in 0 ABY.
Yenley was the Prime Minister of the planet Aguarl III in 0 ABY.

Amber Jevanche was a Human female holovid star, known for her honey-sweet, throaty voice. She was especially popular among young males in the first years of the New Republic. The Gamorrean Ugmush used the voice of Jevanche in her transliterator.
Falud was a Selonian Rebel agent who operated on the Outer Rim world of Vorzyd V during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Sebastin Onyx was a Human protocol liaison and translator who worked at Jugsmuk Station on Gamorr. Physically he was a small man with fair hair and a shy personality but was quite enthusiastic and happy.

Aidus was a Rattataki warrior who lived on the planet Rattatak during the Clone Wars. He was a loyal subject of the Dark Jedi Asajj Ventress when, in 22 BBY, they imprisoned Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and his clone officer Alpha-17 in their fortress on Rattatak.

CR57 was a clone trooper commander who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, CR57 was part of a Republic task force sent to bring the planet Thustra back into the Republic camp.
Groshik was a Neimoidian cantina owner on the mining world of Apatros in the decades leading up to the Battle of Ruusan in 1000 BBY. He operated the cantina in Apatros' only colony.

Culoph was an individual who served as a Sky Judge on the planet Tython before the founding of the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic. The individual was renowned for being a legendary swordsman who had many victories during wartime.
Jimas Veltraa was an admiral in the Republic Navy who served in the early days of the Mandalorian Wars.

Demagol, born Antos Wyrick, was a male Zeltron scientist who joined the Neo-Crusaders during the Mandalorian Wars. During his childhood, Wyrick was captured by Iskalloni slavers from Wild Space where whom he learned his infamous surgical techniques.
Ran Harkas, also known by the nickname Hardcase, was a Human male who served as a sergeant in Joker Squad, which was part of Company C, 9th Battalion, of the 407th Stormtrooper Division.
Jes Gistang was a Corellian Human female who served as a stormtrooper in Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire circa 137 ABY, during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Vax Potorr was a bald Human male, originally a thief from the underlevels of Coruscant. During the Sith–Imperial War he decided to serve with the Fel Empire rather than the Galactic Alliance, who were protecting the Yuuzhan Vong.
Hondo Karr was a Human male Mandalorian who served next to Mand'alor Chernan Ordo in the Battle of Botajef.

Anson Trask was a Human male stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War. Following in his father's footsteps, he joined the 407th Stormtrooper Division, where he was assigned to Joker Squad.
Darth Maleval was a male Quarren Sith Lord of the One Sith, serving under Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt and his Empire, after Krayt deposed Galactic Emperor Roan Fel.
Kaimer was the mayor of Wayfar around 0 ABY. Originally a moisture farmer, he ran for mayor after retiring.
Fadoop was a female Saheelindeeli who, during the era of the Galactic Civil War, worked as a local wheeler-dealer on her home planet of Saheelindeel in the Tion Hegemony.
Gordun was a captain who served in the Aerial Plankton Uprising. With the help of Ebenn Q3 Baobab, he vanquished the Kinkees.
Hissal was a Brigian academic who, during the era of the Galactic Civil War, served on the Committee for Interinstitutional Assistance of the Tion Hegemony's University of Rudrig.
Keek was a male Brigian who served as Chief of the Internal Security Police of the planet Brigia's New Regime.
Zackery was a Human male and the head of Imperial Senate security.

Remy was a clone trooper sergeant who served in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army during the Clone Wars. At some point during the conflict, he was placed under the command of Jedi General Sev and his Padawan, Joc Sah.
Bellican was a judge sent to the Penumbra Spaceport for the trial of Roan Lands and Dona Telamark on the True Justice, along with Tomay Alcorn, the attorney, and Sam Weller, the law clerk.
Prisoner 677780 was an intimidating prisoner at Dontamo Prison. No one tangled with him, and if anyone did, they would end up dead. He stole other prisoners' food on several occasions.

Dinua Jeban was a Human female Mandalorian commando who fought in the Yuuzhan Vong War. She was one of Boba Fett's supercommandos from the outbreak of the invasion, although she was only fourteen at the time.
Viurre was a Human female university student taking courses in nonhuman ethnology at the University of Rudrig.
Kiili was a Human female university student taking courses in nonhuman ethnology at the University of Rudrig.
R'all was the twin brother of J'uoch and leader of a criminal mining outfit.
Kasarax was a male member of the sauropteroid Swimming People of Dellalt, who served as a fearsome example of his species with fangs longer than a Human forearm.
Sam Weller, along with Judge Bellican and attorney Tomay Alcorn, was sent to the Penumbra Spaceport so that they could trial Dona Telamark and Roan Lands on the True Justice.

Dicken was a male Human who served as an officer in the Imperial Navy during the early years of the New Order. He was stationed aboard the Imperial prison ship True Justice as the vessel's first officer, serving under the command of Captain Tran.
Tran was a Human male who served as captain of the Imperial prison ship True Justice.

Hunti Pereg was a skilled bounty hunter who, along with five others, was hired to capture Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. He was incapacitated while throwing thermal detonators at the Jedi.
Shazeen was a large, one-eyed male of the sauropteroid Swimming People of Dellalt who served for a time as "Top Bull" of a pack of Swimmers on the Tion Hegemony world of Dellalt.
Jakob Biddyn was a venerable male Alliance Special Operations Group Leader during the Galactic Civil War.

Voegliss, a member of an unknown species of predatory sentients, was an Imperial assassin and commando. His mouth was filled with sharp teeth, which he used in combat, along with his clawed hands. His skin formed a hard, red carapace, and his eyes were hooded.

Kas'im was a male Twi'lek and Dark Lord of the Sith who lived during the New Sith Wars. Bought from slavery by the Sith Lord Na'daz, Kas'im became his chosen apprentice before he could walk, and spent the following years training in the Sith arts.

The mother of Jango Fett was the wife of the Journeyman Protector of Concord Dawn, Fett. They had two children: a daughter, Arla, and a son, Jango. The mother, along with her husband, was killed by the Death Watch.
Jona T. Stark was a Senior Master Sergeant who trained Maarek Stele and several other TIE pilots.

Nasda was an officer in the Imperial Security Bureau, holding the rank of general. Following the defection of Imperial Army units on Wazta, the defection of several Imperial Navy vessels, and the loss of personnel suffered during the Battle of Yavin, General Nasda authored a c…
The Emperor's physician was Emperor Palpatine's personal medical care provider during his return in the form of several clone bodies.
Nor Wedd was a Quarren official who represented Mon Calamari in the Senate after former Senator Tikkes joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Barthis was a Human male and the father of Elsen Barthis.
Wil Asani was a male Human who lived through the Clone Wars and into the dark times.

CT-9/85 was a clone trooper who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, he was stationed on the supercruiser Nexu, where he served as communications technician under Admiral Arikakon Baraka.
Samish Kash was a Human male who ruled the planet of Delaluna at the time of Lorian Nod's death during the Clone Wars.
Renn Volz was a human male Kesselian professor and inventor who, in 0 ABY, developed the Ionic Ring Ship, which could control a planet's weather.

Ganda Kaitoova was a green-skinned, gray-eyed male Twi'lek who lived in the City of Anchorhead on the Outer Rim desert world of Tatooine during the Jedi Civil War. He was a fan of the swoop races, and visited a swoop track owned by Motta the Hutt.
Greej was an elderly male Near-Human who was held prisoner by Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie, until Price Coby, Jann Tosh, and his droids set him free.

Bzorn was a Human male who served as a Captain in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 ABY, Darth Vader personally tasked Bzorn with devastating a series of Rebel-held planets—he carried this out by commandeering the Ionic Ring Ship, a weather control device d…
Jax was a Human male who served as the leader for a delinquent youth gang called the Freelies that operated on the planet Vorzyd V.
Bemmie was a male Vorzydiak who was a member of the Freelies youth gang on his homeworld of Vorzyd V during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Cilia Dil was a Human female citizen who lived on the planet Junction V with her husband Jaren Dil during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Janzor served the Galactic Empire as an Imperial Navy officer. He was in command of a platoon of two hundred stormtroopers sent by Moff Wilhuff Tarkin to Kashyyyk, just prior to its Imperial occupation.
Dalia was a male who served as a First Sergeant and a GeNode, and for a brief time, stormtrooper. Shortly before the Imperial occupation of Kashyyyk, the sergeant was dispatched to Janzor's platoon.
Sterns Yennich was a private and a GeNode, and for a brief time, a stormtrooper. A member of Janzor's platoon, at the start of the Imperial occupation of Kashyyyk, he was dispatched to the surface.

Tak Bazierre was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire with the rank of First Sergeant. Like other GeNode clones of his batch, an early one that was eventually discontinued, he was a man with greasy black hair and a face that Corporal Wayson Dower regarded as cruel.
Wayson Dower was a stormtrooper just after the end of the Clone Wars. He was a corporal in Janzor's platoon, and was friends with Milo Strander.
Milo Strander was a male GeNode clone who served Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper. During the Imperial Era, he was a corporal in Captain Janzor's platoon and was friends with Wayson Dower.

Oswald Strepp was a GeNode who held the rank of First Sergeant, and for a brief time, served as a stormtrooper. Shortly before the Imperial occupation of Kashyyyk, he was dispatched to Janzor's platoon.
Dane was a Human male Bounty hunter who was the brother of Floria.
Floria was a Human female bounty hunter from Thracior in the decade before the outbreak of the Clone Wars. She was part Hnsi and Tantt.
Robior Web, a former Guardian on Junction 5, was a male bounty hunter who was active during the Clone Wars.

homeworld: One of the Inner Ferro systems
x: Gann was a strong male Ferroan living in the Middle Distance on Zonama Sekot in 29 BBY after immigrating there nearly 60 years prior. He was an instructor and greeter for those who came to Zonama Sekot to obtain a Sekotan Personal Starship.
Sheekla Farrs was a female Ferroan living on Zonama Sekot in 29 BBY. Her husband was Shappa. An airship pilot, she was tall and muscled.

Shappa Farrs was a male Ferroan living on Zonama Sekot as of 29 BBY. His wife was Sheekla. He helped introduce clients to their prospective seed-partners and to design their Sekotan vessels. He was short, slender and had black hair and prominent cheekbones.
Nilesk was a female Rodian who lived during the Galactic Civil War. A member of the Goa-Ato, Nilesk served on a committee that matched hunters with bounties.
Paxxi Derida, or "Pilot", as his disguised name, was a Phindian pilot for Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Dur Gejjen was a Human male from Corellia and a politician at the time of the Second Galactic Civil War.

In 29 BBY, the populace of Vjun went insane because of the experiments he performed with midi-chlorians. In their collective descent into madness and paranoia, they all committed murder against each other, killing off the entire planets population.
Nov Gejjen was a Corellian politician and the father of Dur Gejjen.
Beluine was a very expensive and talented Coruscant-trained physician.
Novoc Vevut, of Clan Vevut, was a Human male Mandalorian soldier who lived on the planet of Mandalore during the time of the Second Galactic Civil War.
Ghes Orade was a Human male and a member of the Mandalorians, serving as a soldier under the leadership of Mand'alor Boba Fett during the time of the Second Galactic Civil War.
Ram Zerimar was a male Human Mandalorian sniper during the time of Boba Fett's stint as Mandalore c. 40 ABY.
Briike was a Mandalorian soldier under Mandalore Boba Fett's leadership.

Venku Skirata, also known to family and close friends as Kad Skirata, was the Force-sensitive Human male who was the son of the clone commando, RC-1136 a.k.a Darman, and the Jedi Knight Etain Tur-Mukan, and thus a biological "nephew" of Boba Fett and the millions of other Jang…

Koa Ne was the Prime Minister of Kamino during the Second Galactic Civil War. He met with Boba Fett to discuss Taun We's whereabouts and the cloning information she had stolen after she fled Tipoca City.
Vagno was a male Langhesi who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 29 BBY, he helped create Jabitha.
Makin was a Mon Calamarian admiral serving the Galactic Alliance during the Second Galactic Civil War. Makin was the commanding officer of the Third Fleet.
Cheb was an admiral serving in the the Fifth Fleet during the Second Galactic Civil War. The Ansta was one of the warships assigned to the admiral's command.
"Uncle" Vanya was a Twi'lek crime boss from the Corporate Sector. It was Vanya who gave the Outrider, a Corellian YT-2400, to a pilot in his employ named Dash Rendar.
Kastays was a male Aaris who lived on the planet Aaris III several thousand years before the Galactic Civil War. A noted scholar, he worked from a tower that overlooked one of the Aaris cities.

Fask Eelak was a female Rodian member of the An'yettu clan. Eelak also managed to become a member in the prestigious Goa-Ato and one of the few bounty hunters allowed to leave the planet, sometime after the Battle over Coruscant.

Vio was the flag lieutenant onboard the Ocean in 40 ABY. He operated the Ocean's main comm console during the Blockade of Corellia, where he predicted to Jacen Solo that Jabiim and Rothana would come to the aid of Corellia first.

Captain Mignay was a female Human Commander of the Rim Merchant Einem, who had once been in the Trade Defense Force before being transferred to the Judicial Forces during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Puth was a male Nimbanel, who lived around the time of the Second Galactic Civil War. Earning a living as an accountant, Puth worked for the infamous bounty hunter Boba Fett.
Charr was the senator of the Corellian sector in 40 ABY who believed the Galactic Alliance Guard's roundup of Corellian citizens was an abuse of sentient rights.

Wirut, a Human male native of the planet Coruscant, was an officer who held the rank of Sergeant in the Galactic Alliance Guard in 40 ABY. He also served as a soldier of the 967 Commando, a company of elite GAG troopers led by Colonel Jacen Solo.
Cotin was a member of the Five Worlds in 40 ABY working as insurgents on Coruscant during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Bolf was a Human member of the Five Worlds.
Abadaner was a member of the Five Worlds in 40 ABY working as insurgents on Coruscant during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Wulf was a Human male lieutenant in the Imperial Navy who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was in charge of the Imperial air strikes on the Rebel fleet during the Battle of Restuss.

Hogar was a male Human who developed a technique to make the HR-211 powersuit more comfortable. A side-effect of the powersuit was that it made the user uncomfortably warm. Hogar developed a technique to decrease the heat created by the suit by deflecting the heat with myoflex.
Paldis Doxin was a Human male Imperial scientist and engineer within the Magrody Institute. In 22 BBY, he was involved in hypermatter research at the Ministry of Science.
Aneesa Dym was a female Pa'lowick smuggler, born on the planet Nar Shaddaa, and pilot of the Dusty Duck.
Vol Barad was the Deputy President of Corellia in 40 ABY and revealed the news to the citizens of Corellia of President Thrackan Sal-Solo's assassination.

Lungru Nokko Vimmas was a female Hutt who lived during the time of the New Republic. A member of the Nokko kajidic, Lungru was born into a wealthy family and owned a summer palace on the planet Joodrudda where she was attended to by a retinue of Cerean attendants and maintaine…
Narbuj Desilijic Preor was a Hutt crime lord during the reign of the Galactic Empire. At one point, he hired the Outer Rim pirate Stormtrooper X as a mercenary and smuggler.
Gorr Desilijic Ebelt was a Hutt of the Desilijic kajidic.

Parella Jiramma Baco, also known as Parella the Hunter, was a Hutt crime lord and a member of the Jiramma kajidic with a masculine persona who lived on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the era of the New Republic.
Herogga was a male Hutt who was one of the few members of his species to attempt to gain control of Tatooine's criminal operations during the era of the New Republic.

Kalna was a young Hutt who was a member of the Hutt organization Ramesh kajidic when they killed a leader of the Black Bha'lir smuggler society. Kalna never made it back to his clan, as they were all eradicated by the smugglers.

Nullada was a male Shell Hutt, a clan of the Hutt species. By 1 BBY, the immense being, who used a repulsorlift cylinder to stay mobile, was one of the elders and leaders of the Shell Hutts on their planetoid base of Circumtore.
Tagoonta was a Shell Hutt who ran a small criminal empire. He fled Hutt Space during the New Republic's rule, and had a base in the abandoned Imperial transfer station on the planetoid Murk.
Beeda was a Hutt who owned a floating casino.

Brebu the Hutt ordered the starship ProfitSmasher shot down, after her crew failed to pay a debt they owed to him. Years later, Brebu himself returned to the crash site and turned the starship's hulk into a base of operations and his own headquarters.
Corpo was a Hutt who lived on the planet of Ord Mantell during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Corugg the Hutt lived during the New Order. The Hutt participated in a high-stakes sabacc game on Cloud City with the likes of Lando Calrissian, Queen Sula of Presteen, Moff Elior, agents of the Rebellion, and a number of other players.
Dengula was a slavelord who owned property in Mos Espa.

Draskha was a Hutt who paid Sienn Sconn to steal Rythani Products' latest prototype weapon from Moff Caerbellak. Draskha's empire began to grow after the death of Emperor Palpatine and the beginning of the New Republic.
Ganis was a rival of Nawnam during the Galactic Civil War. When Ganis learned that Nawnam had tried to kill him and take over his empire, Ganis placed a bounty on Nawnam's head.

Glorga was a Hutt crimelord, based on Hollast Seven in the Hollastin system. At one time he employed the Tunroth, Kiran Tatch, who grew disgusted at the Hutt's behavior. Tatch eventually spat on Glorga.

Gorbu Dalo was a Hutt crime lord and the rival of Yearo Seville. He was killed by MdZ-BLK, an unstable droid sent by Seville as a "gift." The pirate Siro Simito once attacked a transport owned by Dalo.

Jelasi was a Hutt whom many believed was to be the heir of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire. After Jabba's death, chaos took hold of clan Desilijic. After a brutal round of infighting, Jelasi, along with Kumac emerged as joint clan leader.
Jolla was a male Hutt crime lord based on Nar Shaddaa. He was allied with Torga.

Jurga was a Hutt crime lord that operated in the galaxy. He was known to openly wear a DX-2 disruptor pistol, built by the criminal Tenloss Syndicate, on a sash to symbolize his power in defiance of laws that were in place on many planets, which made the ownership of disruptor…

Krova the Hutt was a minor Hutt female crime boss who operated from a base on the planet of Alvorine, in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, Krova made herself an enemy of the Rebel Alliance when she sold vital information to the Galactic Empire.

Kumac was a Hutt crime lord who emerged as joint leader of the Desilijic clan in the aftermath of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's death. Kumac worked as one of Jabba's most trusted operatives before his death, and was known for her efficiency and loyalty.

Kutuab controlled his own small empire around Meirm City on Sriluur, answering ultimately to Jabba the Hutt. His base of operations was a bunker several hundred kilometers from the city, in the middle of the desert.
Moska was a Hutt who employed Nomo Sliken at some point of his life.
Natja was a Hutt crime lord and slaver who was killed by Marg Sonat, who poisoned her with a vernelian parasite.
Nawnam was a Hutt crimelord and a rival of Ganis the Hutt.
Prebda Thok was a Hutt art collector who owned one of the most valuable properties on the planet Boztrok.

Puullo was a Hutt male criminal who served as a lieutenant with fellow Hutt Shettora's criminal faction on the planet Brentaal IV. He effectively controlled the black market on Brentaal IV and was fair in his dealings.
Ribba was a Hutt. Some time after the Battle of Yavin, Ribba owned a textile business which was, on its surface, legitimate.

Riboga the Hutt was a former crime lord of the Cularin system. Referred to as the "Exalted Disgusting One" at least twice, the first time he heard it, he found it funny; the second time he heard it, he demanded a tribute, or simply the "Exalted Riboga the Hutt," Riboga control…

Shettora was a Hutt who was a crime lord in 0 ABY. By that year, Shettora controlled a criminal faction that operated out of the Core Worlds' planet Brentaal IV, in which a fellow Hutt by the name of Puullo served as a lieutenant.
Shiltu was a Hutt who worked for the Black Sun crime syndicate during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. In the syndicate, they held the rank of vigo, or lieutenant.
Smebba Dunk was the head of the Hutt Ruling Council when the Galactic Empire deployed armed forces to Nar Shaddaa 's Corellian Sector.

Sonnos was a Hutt who lived during the first years of the Galactic Empire. After the Human Deggar Feps angered Sonnos, he attempted to flee the planet Nal Hutta aboard the starship Lost Lady, hoping to escape from the Hutt.
Briika Jeban was a Mandalorian bounty hunter and mercenary. She was a widow with one daughter, Dinua Jeban. Dinua was thirteen years of age, and by Mandalorian tradition was considered a full adult.

Tiranga was a Hutt who owned and operated Tiranga's Loft. A spinal cord injury as a young worm left him partially paralysed from the waist to the end of his tail. The injury stunted his growth at only two-point-five Imperial standard meters.

Tobba was a Hutt who operated on the fringes of the Si'Klaata Cluster during the Galactic Civil War. Based on a massive Hutt ship, Y'Tobba, he owned Krayt dragons that he brought to his ship from Tatooine trying to impress Jabba the Hutt.

Torga was a male Hutt. He worked from Nar Shaddaa during the rule of the Galactic Empire. He supplied many things that were illegal even on Nar Shaddaa. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Torga was the target of a failed assassination attempt.
Velrugha was a Hutt who commanded a military force during a number of invasion attempts made on the Hutt Space planet of Riileb.

Zochaeb was a Hutt leader who negotiated with the Nimbanese Krovalis clan. The Krovalis offered Zochaeb and the Hutts the allegiance of the Nimbanese people and free access to information in Nimbanese databanks.
Uta was a Hutt artifact smuggler who smuggled military artifacts and sold them for a high profit. He was arrested on that charge later on. His fate after his arrest is unknown.
Grath was a male dark trooper assigned to Dark Jedi Zasm Katth and Baddon Fass during their search for the starship Millennium Falcon on the moon Nar Shaddaa in 10 ABY.

Nfoota was a patron of the Byss Bistro at the Imperial Freight Complex on the planet Byss in 10 ABY. Another patron informed Nfoota that the Empire had just received a shipment of X-1 Viper war droids.

Duman Yaght was a Yuuzhan Vong Commander of Domain Yaght during the Yuuzhan Vong War. The commanding officer of the Exquisite Death, he received seventeen Jedi captives from Fitzgibbon Lane, who was in truth Lando Calrissian, in the plot to deliver the Jedi to Myrkr for the Mi…
Luwingo was a male Yaka smuggler. Like others of his species, Luwingo possessed a cyborg brain and was implanted with intelligence modifications that greatly enhanced his mental abilities.
Netro was a Ganathan mechanic who worked on repairs of the Millennium Falcon on the orders of King Empatojayos Brand.

Vintul Qat was a warrior of the Yuuzhan Vong. At the time of the Yuuzhan Vong occupation of Wayland, Vintul was the Commander of a warship, and attempted to intercept the YZ-775 transport, No Luck Required.
Ussor was the Ganathan captain of the Robida Colossus. Ussor was put in charge of the Ganathan space fleet by King Empatojayos Brand.
Neeka Sot was a Yuuzhan Vong female from an assassin sect who served the priest Harrar as a bodyguard in 27 ABY.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: Ntthan was a Human male starship captain who served the New Republic as a major. Following the destruction of the New Republic headquarters on the moon Da Soocha V by the reborn Emperor Palpatine, Ntthan was assigned to run supply convoys to the new temporary hideout on the wo…

While on Duro, Varesh heard the retelling of the story of how the shamed warrior Vua Rapuung had come to accept the Jedi Knights on Yavin 4 and helped Anakin Solo. He later relayed the story to Vuurok I'pan.
Sh'simm was a Yuuzhan Vong Shamed One who lived in the ruins of Coruscant.
Ekma was a Yuuzhan Vong Shamed One who lived in the ruins of Coruscant beneath Yuuzhan'tar, along with Vuurok I'pan. He venerated the Jedi Knights after the death of Ganner Rhysode.

Urlor Sette was a Lusankya prisoner around the same time as Rogue Squadron Lieutenant Corran Horn. A large man, he had lost part of one hand, leaving him effectively crippled. He was a personal assistant to fellow prisoner Jan Dodonna, a Rebel General.
Gottu, along with Idow, was an urban combat specialist of Lieutenant Judder Page's special forces team called the Katarn Commandos.

Idow, along with Gottu, was the urban combat specialist of Lieutenant Judder Page's special forces commando team called the Katarn Commandos. They were known for their capture of an Imperial outpost near the city of Bruzion on Jendorn using only a vibro-ax and two blasters.
Mian Hoob was a Sullustan technician within the Katarn Commandos, which was lead by Lieutenant Judder Page. Korren was the team's other technician.

Korren was a male Human from Alderaan who served as a technician within the New Republic Special Forces and was assigned to the Katarn Commandos. He worked with the team's other technician, Mian Hoob.
Kasck was a Bothan infiltrator and a member of the Katarn Commandos, which was lead by Lieutenant Judder Page. He favored using a vibroknife.

Vandro was the heavy weaponry and repulsorlift specialist of the Katarn Commandos which was lead by Lieutenant Judder Page. He was part of the assault team assigned to Moff Kentor Sarne's stronghold on Kal'Shebbol in 8 ABY.
Syla Tors was a Corellian pirate who later joined the Katarn Commandos as a pilot. The commando team was lead by Lieutenant Judder Page.
Jortan was the Katarn Commandos' medical specialist under the leadership of Lieutenant Judder Page. He carried a specialized medpac.
Bri'vin was a member of the Katarn Commandos, serving as the unit's scrounger and procurement specialist.

Cryle Cavv was a Human male thief who served as a former member of Cracken's Crew. He was the owner of the R2-series astromech droid, R2-RC and the ship, G Cat, and was instrumental in the rescue of Rivoche Tarkin and the capture of the Super Star Destroyer Guardian.
Losca was a Rebel lieutenant who died on Hoth at Echo Base during the Battle of Hoth. She gave M-3PO his extremely useful scrounging program.

Ha-ran was a male Eickarie, of the Family Mish-ra and the Clan Sha-kae. He was a prince of the Tribe Si-shae-ral and a member of the resistance on his homeworld against The Warlord and his Lakran mercenaries.

The Warlord was a member of an unknown alien species from an unknown system who became a tyrant on the world of Kariek around 28 BBY. He was defeated by the Empire of the Hand 501st Legion during the Eickaries uprising on Kariek in 22 ABY.

Hirshoot was the personal servant of Orko the H'uun; secretly doing undercover work for Gorga the Hutt while under Orko's service. Because of his "miserly salary", he took up Gorga's offer to kill Orko, eagerly. He tried to kill Orko numerous times and failed.
Mika'sai'Malloc was the daughter of Kardue'sai'Malloc. She witnessed the execution of her father after he was captured by Boba Fett and placed in a field with a quarra.
Joddar was a Lizard Warrior from the Valley of the Lizard Warriors on Endor.

Opdoa was a male Rodian who lived during the Galactic Civil War. A member of the Goa-Ato, Opdoa served on a committee that matched hunters with bounties. It was he and Nilesk who sent Fask Eelak of the An'yettu clan to apprehend the Wookiee Gerraba.
Edbit Teeks was a male Human who served as an officer in Republic Intelligence during the Clone Wars.

Tharb was the codename of a Galactic Republic informer on Tarhassan. His species is unknown, he was short though, with a deep voice. He worked at Corgan's Gustatorium restaurant as a server, which is where he gave information to Republic Intelligence officer Edbit Teeks.
Zazana Renkel was female Human who served as an agent of the Tarhassan Planetary Security and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Kirst was a Human female starfighter pilot who flew in the Rebel Alliance's Rogue Squadron in the year 4 ABY. She was close with her fellow Rogue, Wister.
Livintius Sazet was a male Falleen academic-turned-intelligence operative who served Republic Intelligence during the Clone Wars.
Tinian Hanther was a female Human who served as an agent to the Galactic Republic and the Republic Intelligence during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Cherek Tuhm was a human male civil servant in the Ministry of Licenses and Permits until he decided to work for the Republic Intelligence during the Clone Wars. He was also hand-to-hand combat champion for eight straight years.

Mapper was the name of an Advanced Recon Commando who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Mapper was one of the ARC troopers assigned to the attack on Pengalan IV, which turned out to be a Separatist trap.

Sirak was a male Zabrak who trained as a Sith apprentice at the Academy on Korriban during the New Sith Wars. For much of his time at the Academy he was the top apprentice and was favored by many of the Sith Masters there, particularly Qordis.
Mingo Bovark was a Nimbanel Imperial Captain loyal to Roan Fel. In 137 ABY, he met with Admiral Gar Stazi at the Wheel for negotiations of an alliance with the Galactic Alliance Remnant.

Brafid was a male Elomin who worked as an officer on the Trader's Luck and was, therefore, permitted to walk around the vessel while armed. His weapon of choice was a type of electric prod that he liked to refer to as a "tingler." He was close friends with Nooni Dalvo.

Ion Team's spec-one was a clone commando who served in Ion Team as the group's comlink specialist. When Commander Salvo issued Order 66, the spec-one, along with the rest of Ion Team, questioned and disobeyed the order, allowing Jedi Masters Roan Shryne, Bol Chatak, and her Pa…

Jay-Jay Bin was the partial name of a Gungan that enrolled in Fett Club to become a Mandalorian. However, they were killed by the Mandalorian instructor, as they were ineligible to apply due to the seventh rule of Fett Club: "No Gungans. Ever."

CT-5/501 was a clone trooper pilot stationed on Raxus Prime during the Clone Wars. He was the co-pilot, along with CT-4/619, of a LAAT/i gunship while attempting to capture Count Dooku, but ended up rescuing Raxus Prime "orphan" Boba Fett.
Zarfeen was a female Rodian bounty hunter.

Marka Durn was a Human trader during the Galactic Civil War and a friend of the Rebel Alliance. With his droid R2-C9, this expert navigator roamed the Nanth'ri Route in his battered Ghtroc freighter, DeepHopper.

Kala Kevv, code-named Prodigal-One, was a Sullustan male pilot during the Galactic Civil War. While flying for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Kevv's Y-wing starfighter crashed on NCW-781. The resulting rescue operation retrieved both him and his datacard.

Chin was a Human male smuggler and chief associate of Talon Karrde's organization. A native of the planet Myrkr, Chin was one of Karrde's longest-serving and most trusted associates, and served as the smuggler's chief of operations for Karrde's headquarters on the planet.
Levier was a porcelain maker who was famous on Corellia.
Lanal Darklighter was the third wife of Huff Darklighter, and the stepmother of Dera. She was also the sister of Silya Darklighter, making her Gavin Darklighter's aunt on both sides of the family.
Babel Torsch was the Imperial Customs office head in the Minos Cluster. He was known as a by-the-book customs official with no tolerance for the slightest infraction.

Zip Beeline was the pseudonym of a Drall professional speeder racer on Coruscant. He then legally assumed the name after an impressive debut with good fan reaction. His speeders, swoops, and podracers were customized for his small stature.

The impostor Gilad Pellaeon was a double arranged by the Supreme Commander to sleep in his assigned room during the negotiations with Five World Prime Minister Aidel Saxan of the Corellian system in 40 ABY.
Ardal was a male native of the planet Solem during the Galactic Civil War. He was part of a resistance movement against the planetary Governor, Malvander Bren.
Naia was a green-skinned medic native to the planet Solem. During the Galactic Civil War she was part of a resistance movement against the planetary Governor, Malvander Bren.
Tark was a native of the planet Solem during the Galactic Civil War, and part of a resistance movement against the planetary Governor, Malvander Bren.

Rabutz was a native of the planet Solem during the Galactic Civil War. He worked as shoemaker in the city of G'ai Solem and was a contact of a resistance movement against the planetary Governor, Malvander Bren.
Daron was a young native of Solem during the Galactic Civil War, and part of a resistance movement against the planetary Governor, Malvander Bren.

Yarda was a native of the planet Solem during the Galactic Civil War, and part of local rebel forces against the planetary Governor, Malvander Bren. He was killed by Boba Fett while trying to protect his leader, Yolan Bren.

Filla was a female lieutenant in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. In 6.5 ABY, Filla was serving as the aide of Admiral Ackbar, the Supreme Commander of the New Republic Defense Forces, on the planet Folor.

Merno Blask was an Imperial governor of the planet of Trevura. He was opposed to droids, his open dislike for them resulting in an underground droid insurgency meant to put an end to his governorship. The assassin droid S-R6 was hired to kill him.

Tetsu was a companion to a Force-sensitive individual. When the Force-user employed the Force power Sense Path to divine their future, they had a vision of Tetsu, crying and scared, standing atop a column of rock half a meter wide in the middle of a volcano.

Tenko was a Ankura Gungan from the planet Naboo and the Boss of the city of Otoh Jahai. During a war between the Gungan tribes in the year 3000 BBY, Boss Gallo of Otoh Sancture approached Tenko with a request that they stop fighting other tribes and join their forces to Gallo'…

Copek was an Ankura Gungan and the Boss of the city of Otoh Urs on the planet Naboo in the year 3000 BBY. During a war between the Gungan tribes around that time, Otoh Urs regularly suffered attacks from native predatory bursa creatures.

Cobak was a Bith bounty hunter. Cobak was born on the Bith homeworld Clak'dor VII in the Colu system. Zorba the Hutt, the father of the notorious Jabba the Hutt, wanted Leia Organa to be punished for the death of his son, so he hired Cobak.

A clone scout trooper served as part of a battle group under the leadership of Clone Commander Faie and utilized a BARC speeder during the group's search for Quinlan Vos as per Order 66. The trooper was Force pushed by Vos off his speeder.
The mother of Fable Astin was a female Human Jedi Knight who managed to survive Order 66.

Heeth Panteer was a male Human native of Alderaan, who was fortunate enough to be off-planet when the first Death Star destroyed his homeworld. He and his brother Raal were in the Ryloth system, where they owned a moon due to being the only heirs of their family.
Raal Panteer was a Human male Alderaanian who hailed from the blue-blooded House Panteer and was fortunate enough to be absent from Alderaan at the time of its destruction.

Yo-Hann Innk was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto who was active during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. The Nikto was imprisoned but managed to escape his confinement and fled to the planet Tatooine where he came to be affiliated with Gardulla Besadii the Elder.
Utrop was a male Jokhalli who served as the leader of the Jokhalli on Blimph 3.

Guchluk was a Human bounty hunter contracted by Quaffug the Hutt to participate in the tradition of Duff-Jikab on the moon of Blimph 3. Guchluk's only visible weapon was a long sharp blade attached to the outside of his left arm.
Four-Eighteen was the designation of a stormtrooper who served in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War between the New Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Four-Twenty was the designation of an individual who served as a stormtrooper in the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the New Republic.

Pirgi was an individual who served the New Republic as a sentry at Rogue Squadron's base on the planet Talasea in 6 ABY. Pirgi was killed during an Imperial raid on Talasea, which was designed to eliminate Rogue Squadron, an elite New Republic starfighter squadron.
Carter was an individual who served the New Republic as a sentry in 6 ABY at Rogue Squadron's base on the planet Talasea.

Greg Somax was a male mathematics instructor at the Imperial Naval Academy, and a Special Agent working for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. His position put him in contact with many Academy cadets, allowing him to come across likely candidates for Alliance recruitment.

Greelossk was a Trandoshan male criminal from the planet Trandosha who was affiliated with arms dealers and smugglers. He was wanted by the Republic Security Force for a wide variety of high crimes against the Galactic Republic.

Van Secura was a male Twi'lek and Nat Secura's older brother. He was the original heir apparent to Clan Secura but due to his untimely death, Nat became next in line. Nat commented that their father, Lon Secura, always liked Van more.
Ne'Chak was a green Rodian male, who worked as a security specialist and mercenary.

Harm was an male Imperial technician who monitored shielding on the planet Borleias during the First Battle of Borleias in 6 ABY, in which the New Republic sought to capture Borleias as a base for an eventual assault on the planet Coruscant.
N'Mrith was an associate of Jabba Desilijic Tiure on Formos. He was a fish-like creature who appreciated warm, humid environments.
Drybal was a male Yarkora employed by Raze's criminal organization during the Galactic Civil War.
Rivi-Anu was a Human who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, a galaxy-spanning conflict between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Eon was a humanoid Jedi serving the Jedi Order and Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Around 19 BBY, Eon was promoted to the rank of Jedi Knight and was placed under Jedi Master and General Ki-Adi-Mundi's charge.

Oron Jaeger was a Human male general who served in the Fel Empire during the Sith–Imperial War. At the end of the war, when Sith Lord Darth Krayt overthrew Roan Fel and declared himself Emperor, Jaeger and the 501st Legion of stormtroopers feigned loyalty to Krayt's Empire but…
Dael Levare was a member of one of Corellia's richest families during the early years of the Galactic Empire. He played Net-ball, and was once engaged to Bria Tharen.
Piani was a comely young female Ryn, in charge of the refugee communications center on the planet Duro in 26 ABY.
Harthis was a Human male who served as a major in the New Republic. In 26 ABY, he was the administrative assistant to Rogue Squadron commander Gavin Darklighter.

Thrag was a captain in the service of Thrackan Sal-Solo. He commanded the assault boat used to capture the planetary repulsor on Drall. He was a short, overweight man who enjoyed drinking more than serving Sal-Solo.
Sidris Kolb was a meteorologist assigned to Leia Organa Solo's SELCORE staff on Duro in 26 ABY. He was constantly at odds with colleague Aj Koenes over materials required by both their projects.
Putney was a Human male from Bakura, and was the commander in charge of the assault troops sent to seize the planetary repulsor activated on Drall during the Battle of Centerpoint Station.

Abbela Oldsong was the personal aide assigned to Leia Organa Solo during her coordination of the Senate Select Committee for Refugees refugee project on Duro in 26 ABY. She was killed by a tkun in the Battle of Duro.

Aj Koenes was a male Talz water specialist assigned to Leia Organa Solo's SELCORE staff on Duro in 26 ABY. He was constantly at odds with colleague Sidris Kolb over materials required by both their projects.
Kiefer was a lieutenant in the Imperial Army stationed on the planet Bastion. After Emperor Roan Fel was overthrown by the Dark Lord Darth Krayt, a number of Imperials remained loyal to Fel.

Burbu studied the jevesects on the planet Herzob. Some unknown factor caused the death of jevesects within 48 hours of being removed from their planet, and Burbu sought to isolate this factor. This would gain him personal fame.
Hishinu Booj was a male Rodian playwright.

Oleson was a Human male who served as a general in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was the commanding officer of the New Academy for Space Pilots, where he also operated as a flight instructor.
Lunasa was a female Human bounty hunter, who operated in the years prior to the Invasion of Naboo. The body armor she wore appeared to be Mandalorian in origin.

Arajen Turmen was an Imperial pilot and gunboat commander during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed on Tatooine during the Battle of Endor, and later became the leader of the settlement created from the former Eidolon Base facility after the fall of the Galactic Empire.

Feena Shaan was a native gang leader on Mawan in 25 BBY, when Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi were sent there to make peace. Feena controlled most of the goods and services sold to the majority of citizens harbored beneath the capital city of Naatan.
Ehartt Brihnt was a wealthy male Rodian hunter.
Slerog Fenn was a male Rodian. Fenn presented himself in flashy clothes, and often adorned himself with earrings.

Gulek Lohn was a green male Rodian, who worked on Darknon Station. There he managed the Stormview Lounge. Lohn was frequently to be found behind the bar, keeping an eye on his patrons in case he recognized any of them as criminals with bounties on their heads.

Safonne Pendon was a male Rodian pirate leader. Pendon commanded a modest, though effective, fleet of ships from his corvette flagship Safonne's Sword. He targeted New Republic convoys, forcing the crews to surrender, while taking possession of both the ships and their cargoes.
Slimego was a male Rodian bounty hunter. Working with the Barabel Slizzik and the Taloron Hunter Crutag, Slimego pursued a group of Rebels to the jungle world of Trinta.

Tulagn was a grizzled male Rodian, living on Wroona. The owner of Tulagn's Starship Outfitters, Tulagn was a shrewd entrepreneur, loyal to his Wroonan contacts but ready and willing to rip off offworlders. He often wore a dirt-smeared "Starship Outfitters" apron.
Uopled was a male Rodian black marketeer.
Zindra was a female Rodian. She worked for Hyperspeed Express as an office manager at the Bilbringi Shipyards, and was very helpful with requests.
Narnee Bomu was a male Rodian soldier and a member of the Bomu Clan.
Seedar Bomu was a male Rodian soldier and a member of the Bomu Clan.

Ormann Bomu was a male Rodian of the Bomu Clan. Along with his brother he worked for Zonnos of the Anjiliac kajidic. Onboard the light freighter Vengeance, they led raiding parties against enemy ships.

Clarani was an old Ryn woman refugee on the planet Duro during the Yuuzhan Vong War in 26 ABY. Her husband died in the evacuation of the Jubilee Wheel. Clarani later bunked in Settlement 32 with Rogue Squadron pilot Jaina Solo.
Camarata was a female Ryn refugee working as a cook in Settlement 32 on Duro in 26 ABY.
Fidge Tadrazan was a young Biituian who befriended R2-D2 and C-3PO at the time of their encounter with the Great Heep on the planet Biitu.

Teyora Rekab was a female Enso who purveyed hydroponic seeds and equipment. She was the captain of her own starship, which her fellow Ensos crewed, and she used the vessel to ship hydroponics around the galaxy, including the planet Tatooine.
Plee was a male Ho'Din plant development specialist whom the New Republic Senate Select Committee for Refugees assigned to a team working on terraforming the surface of Duro in 26 ABY.
Cawa was a Quarren research scientist who was an expert in water purificiation. The scientist was assigned to Leia Organa Solo's Senate Select Committee for Refugees staff on Duro in 26 ABY.
Lenya was a female Ryn refugee on Duro in 26 ABY. She was one of Settlement 32's communications operators.
Ducilla Brarun was a female Duros and the sister of Durgard Brarun. Living on Bburru Station, she began giving fiery anti-Jedi and anti-New Republic speeches in 26 ABY.
Agapos the Tenth was a male Sunesi and the tenth of the priest-princes of Monor II. He ascended to the throne in 24 ABY, succeeding Agapos the Ninth.

Gallie Wover was a female Gunnery Sergeant who served with the New Republic Defense Fleet. She was stationed aboard the cruiser Adamantine when the vessel transported Chief of State Leia Organa Solo to Nam Chorios in 13 ABY, and later died of the Death Seed plague.
Vop the Usurer was a male Rodian tyrant. He had a reputation for an abrasive style and an odor of cheap raava.

Deebo Chak was a male Rodian actor. One of his earliest parts was as the charismatic Soldier in Hishinu Booj's The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma. His character encouraged farmers to resist the heavy taxes imposed by the baron. Chak portrayed his character with a gravelly voice.
Lernik De'Yago was a male Rodian arms merchant.

Adray Terson was a female Human living on Coruscant prior to and during the early stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War. She and her husband, Hasville, owned and operated the Terson Comfort Carriers air taxi company. Adray and Hasville had a son, Hasray, who was killed by Denua Ku.

Hasville Terson was a male Human living on Coruscant prior to, and during, the early stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War. He and his wife, Adray owned and operated the Terson Comfort Carriers air taxi company. Hasville and Adray had a son, Hasray, who was killed by Denua Ku.

Hasray Terson was a Human male with long black hair. His parents, Adray and Hasville Terson, were the owners of the Terson Comfort Carriers air taxi company on the galactic capital world Coruscant, as well as the starship, Ugly Truth.

Slabba Drewl was a chef captured by Corpo the Hutt. He was later rescued by Micah Giiett and Plo Koon. He was very short and had a blunt head with blue skin. He had small beady eyes and a large mouth.
Gnosos was a male Sunesi who worked as a CorDuro Shipping steward on Bburru Station in 26 ABY. He did not support the company when they decided to turn Duro over to the Yuuzhan Vong.
Juno was a male Fregan who loyally worked as an assistant for the criminal syndicate ruled by the Cobral family.

Sholh Dorr was a moisture farmer on the planet Tatooine, and the owner of Dorr Farm. He was a neighbor and friend of Cliegg Lars, and was crippled by Tusken Raiders when he assisted Lars in searching for his missing wife Shmi.
Espan Balfed was a Lord of the noble Balfed family.

Bad-eye was the nickname Mara Jade gave to a Human male member of the Peace Brigade who advised Admiral Darez Wuht during the Battle of Duro. She named him so due to the fact one of his eyes seemed to be a malfunctioning prosthetic.
