Slump-shoulder was the nickname Mara Jade gave to a Human male member of the Peace Brigade who advised Admiral Darez Wuht during the First Battle of Duro. She named him so due to the fact that one of his shoulders was lower than the other. He had close-cropped hair.

Lieutenant Rone Taggar was a male Human who served as the commander of the 21st Recon Group of the New Republic Fifth Fleet. His mother had been the Rebel pilot of a Y-wing during the Battle of Endor, where she was shot down by the Imperials and died.
Snowball was the name of Bnugor's pet snuzzleguff.
H'nib Statermast was the Filvian proprietor of the Farrimmer Cafe aboard the Mynock 7 Space Station.

Grosteek was a Vaathkree and part-owner of the Farrimmer Cafe. Along with his partner, H'nib Statermast, who had taken in the poor sentient when he was on his last few credits, Grosteek helped Bnugor recover his pet snuzzleguff, Snowball.
Naroon Cuthus was Jabba Desilijic Tiure's majordomo for decades. When he finally retired, the Hutt crime lord ordered Cuthus's assassination, lest he spill secrets to Jabba's enemies.
Par Lankin was the Human male Imperial Moff of the Lambda sector. Following the Battle of Endor, he became one of the many Imperial warlords, keeping his strategic area under control.

Burba of Strekk was a male Swokes Swokes flatstender who worked on maintaining and guarding the Tract of Makem Te. Thirty-six hours every Makem Te day, he would travel the Tract in an old speeder searching for broken squares, schinga carcasses, and lost supplicants.
Hamman Flatt was a Abridon Human male who served as the leader of the Abridon Nationalists on the planet during the Galactic Civil War.

Nil Posondum was a former head accountant for Trans-Galactic Gaming Enterprises Corporation and a thief who found a bounty of 12,500 credits on his head from the Hutts after switching allegiances and stealing private data.

Wyle Artis was a male Sullustan amateur hunter who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he resided on Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.

Irving was a male Twi'lek who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he was present at Tansarii Point Station, a space station located near the planet Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system. During that time, Irving and Pacus frequented the station's cantina.
Jord Kraas was an officer serving as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Brahle Logris was an Human male assassin who specialized in poisoning his targets.

Oph Nar Dinnid was a Lyunesi comm handler on the run from bounty hunters after a huge bounty was placed on his head following an affair with a member of a supreme liege-lord's family in the Narrant system.

Killium Neb was one of the 45 stormtroopers stationed on Pzob to board the Eye of Palpatine. Waiting for the ship that never came, he eventually got tired of waiting, in which he chose to mutiny against the commander and got into a fight.
Brusela was a Human female who was the grandmother of Bria Tharen.

Hric Dalhney was a Human male Alderaanian politician who served as Deputy Minister of Security and was a trusted member of Viceroy Bail Organa's cabinet during the early years of the Galactic Empire. He was also part of Alderaan's resistance movement.
Lanah Malo was a member of the Corellian Resistance during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Grinner was one of the Cavrilhu Pirates under the command of the pirate leader Zothip. He was responsible for patrolling the Kauron asteroid base.
Lord Superior Bosmihi was the leader of the Kroctari people, and their government, the Unified Factions.

Dankin was Talon Karrde's subordinate aboard the Wild Karrde. He masqueraded as Abel Quiller, Captain of the Hab Camber, when Karrde went to Bilbringi to witness Mazzic's attack against the shipyards.
Modigal Glave was an experienced Imperial commando who became a Storm Commando during his career.
Wuwuhuul was a Revwien Thuwisten who was the longtime companion of the Rebel sympathizer and former pirate Grindol Maal.

Lachton was a Human smuggler in Talon Karrde's organization. By 9 ABY he was co-pilot of the Wild Karrde. His duties carried him with Talon Karrde to Bpfassh where he witnessed Grand Admiral Thrawn's hit and fade Star Destroyer attack against the planet.
Grindol Maal was an ex-pirate with Rebel sympathies.
David later commanded the force from the Air-Space Fleet posted to prevent Exocron from the incoming pirate fleet of Rei'Kas, pursuing a vendetta against Karrde.
Horzao Darr was a Human male from the isolated planet of Exocron within the Kathol Outback, a largely unexplored section of the galaxy in the Outer Rim Territories.

Entoo Needaan E-elz, a male Human who preferred to go by Entoo Nee, was an employee of Jorj Car'das after Car'das retired to Exocron. He was often mistaken for a droid given his name and odd protocol droid-like behavior.
Codeq Santhananan was an individual that was in the business, among others, of transmitting messages on the behalf of customers that included Dengar.
Breen was one of the Affytechans taken aboard the Eye of Palpatine in 12 ABY, where he was indoctrinated into believing he was a doctor.
Taffy was the name of one of Tia Organa's pet pittins. Taffy died in the destruction of Alderaan.
Fluffy was the name of one of Tia Organa's pet pittins. Fluffy died in the destruction of Alderaan.
Winkie was the name of one of Tia Organa's pet pittins. Winkie died in the destruction of Alderaan.

Nesdin was a Human male. He was the pilot of the ship Jade's Fire. After the resolution of the First Corellian Insurrection, Mara Jade surmised that he was most likely dead, but hoped there was a chance he had only been captured or had hidden on Corellia.
Condren Foreck was a wealthy farmer's daughter on the agriworld of Azbrian, one of the potential brides considered by Lando Calrissian.
Galinda Norsh was a female Jedi Initiate within the Jedi Order who lived at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant several decades before the start of the Clone Wars circa 89 BBY.
Tri'byia was a Bothan who served as the Field Controller of the shield generator on Drev'starn, the capital city of the planet Bothawui.

An unknown Corellian served as the Five Worlds' first Minister of War. He had been in office for at least a year before being sacked and replaced by Thrackan Sal-Solo at the start of the Second Galactic Civil War in 40 ABY.
Garonnin was the Human male leader of House Garonnin and a Senex Lord.
Noma Sommos was a female admiral in the Republic Navy who served in the Outer Rim during the Mandalorian Wars.
Babbnod Luroon, or "Babb" for short, served as first mate aboard Jynni's Virtue under the command of Captain Naz Felyood. When the Virtue crashed near the Valley of Golg on Korriban.
Tvrrdko was a male Wookiee and the father of Tojjevvuk.
Ssoh was a Trandoshan slaver, whose name in Dosh meant "Stealth".
Framjem Spathen made psychedelic music videos around 3 BBY.

Deja was an adventurous but lazy Jawa from Tatooine who made his living as a mechanic, but was troubled by prophetic dreams. He was unkempt and foul-smelling, rarely washing his robes, and spoke in disjointed Basic with incorrect verb tense.
Cecil Noone was a male Human thief and the son of two members of Freedom's Sons.

Wehutti was a leader of the Melida in the generations-long war on the planet Melida/Daan. He was Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi's contact when the Master and Padawan team were sent to the planet to rescue Tahl, a Jedi who had been kidnapped by the Melida after peace negotiati…

Coolie was an aunt of Luke Skywalker. When Callista Ming told Luke about her uncle Dro's opposition to anyone having fun, the Jedi Master laughingly remarked that Dro must have been related to Coolie.
Shorty was the nickname Luke Skywalker gave to one of the leaders of the Jawas taken aboard Eye of Palpatine in 12 ABY.
Erwithat was a famous Corellian author who wrote The Fall of the Sun.

Tenn, nicknamed Peewo by Clone Commander Gett, was a clone trooper stationed in the ops room of the Acclamator-class Assault Ship Fearless during the Clone Wars, where he acted as the principle weapons officer for Improcco Company.
Sol Windtide was a Human male who resided in the city of Bestine on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was a friend of a Jedi named Nos'lyn.
Vytor Shrike was a Gand bounty hunter and findsman who was active on Tatooine. In appearance he resembled Zuckuss, and may have dressed to capitalize on the similarities in order to get more clients.
Jungen was a male Trandoshan outlaw and a former member of the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire. He later joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Gregar Typho was a human male Naboo and a captain of the Royal Naboo Security Forces for Senator Padmé Amidala during the Separatist Crisis and the Clone Wars, ensuring the senator's safety at all costs.

Arno, also known as Old Arno, was a male Human settler on the planet Tatooine in 0 ABY. Arno was one of the "oldsters", colonists who travelled aboard the Dowager Queen and settled on Tatooine after it crashed.

Koril Bekam was a pilot in the New Republic. He owned R2-Z13; who aided him while piloting in Blackmoon Squadron While recovering in bacta, Wedge Antilles used Bekam's X-wing to aid in the evacuation of Borleias.

Tsaa Qalu was a male Yuuzhan Vong of the warrior caste. He was one of the chosen elite within his caste known as Hunters. In 26 ABY, he was serving as a commander with the forces occupying the world of Wayland.

Orrk was Guildmaster of the Metalsmiths Guild of Vandelhelm during the Galactic Civil War. A longtime Imperial collaborator, Orrk continued to conspire with Imperial admiral Mordur in the aftermath of the Battle of Endor, attempting to keep Vandelhelm's valuable metal producti…

Mordur was an Imperial admiral during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY—after the Empire's climactic defeat in the Battle of Endor—Mordur was involved in a plot to undermine the Alliance of Free Planets' control of the key shipbuilding world of Vandelhelm.
Winfrid Dagore was a female Human commander who served in the Tethan resistance during the Galactic Civil War.

Pofko was a Human male lieutenant in the Galactic Empire who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was in charge of obtaining weaponry, and restocking munitions during the Battle of Restuss.

This individual was a Jedi who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. After surviving the initial stages of the Great Jedi Purge, this individual went into hiding on the planet Talasea.
Port was a male Vorzydiak who was the Chairman of Vorzyd IV, in 39 BBY. He was the husband of Bryn and father of Grath.
Bryn was the wife of Chairman Port of Vorzyd IV and mother of Grath.
Grath was the son of the Chairman of Vorzyd IV, Port, and Bryn. He also was the leader of the Freelies.

Grizzid was male humanoid and a notorious free-trader and smuggler. He was hired by the Bothan merchant Grendu to transport a rancor from the Tarsunt system. However, the rancor killed Grizzid and his crew and his ship crashed on Tatooine.
Josen Shire was a Human male slave of the Serpent Masters of Ophideraan during the era of the Galactic Civil War, and the father of Tanith Shire.

She, like all Freelies, sabotaged the factories of Vorzyd IV, to make the people realize that the job was not the main thing in a perfect society that the Vorzydiaks tried to built. She was a supporter and a good friend of Grath.
Zarien Kheev was a Zabrak slave master of the Galactic Empire whose defining attribute was his sadistic personality.

Henrietya Antilles, commonly known as Corellia Antilles, was a Human female xenoarchaeologist who was a student of the historian Bleys Harand. She held the academic title of Doctor and worked mostly for the New Republic. Dr.

He, like all Freelies, sabotaged the factories of Vorzyd IV, to make the people realize that the job was not the main thing in a perfect society that the Vorzydiaks tried to build. He and Tray opposed Grath, because of his ways of leading the youth gang.
Pel was a female Vorzydiak and a member of the Freelies.
She was retired in the worker world of Vorzyd IV, and this meant that anyone who did not work, died. Ina was lucky, because her granddaughter used to visit her and have a talk.
Felana was the Chairwoman of Vorzyd V, in 39 BBY.
Nalo was a male Vorzydiak teacher of a learning complex of Vorzyd IV.
Nella Bold was a young woman living on Ord Mantell, daughter of moisture farmer Orin Bold.
Colton was a lieutenant in the New Republic Defense Fleet. They were the weapons officer on Home One.

Mazicia Organa was a Human female who served as the Queen of the planet Alderaan during the period leading up to the Clone Wars, a pan-galactic conflict. She was also the mother of Bail Prestor Organa, who became the last Viceroy and First Chairman of the Alderaan system.

Agapos the Ninth or Agapos IX was a male Sunesi and the ninth of the Priest-Princes of Monor II. He ascended to the throne after his father Agapos the Eighth. Agapos was Force-sensitive and a follower of The Maker.
Pianat Torbul was a short, dark-haired Corellian Human male who was Bria Tharen's commanding officer in the Corellian Resistance, and later the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Mara was a Jedi Master who was killed by droids on M4-78. She was the Master of the Twi'lek Jedi Tourath.

Na'daz was a male Twi'lek Sith Lord who lived near the end of the New Sith Wars who was exceptionally skilled in the art of lightsaber combat. While on a visit to Nal Hutta, Na'daz found the young Force-sensitive Twi'lek slave Kas'im and bought him.

Dallan Morvis was the second-in-command aboard the Courageous during the Mandalorian Wars. He fought at the battles at Vanquo, Serroco, and Omonoth and was later promoted to the rank of captain and placed in the command of his own capital ship, Veltraa.
Trif was a former Imperial who defected and joined the Alliance of Free Planets.
Maggie was a former Human female Imperial who defected and joined the Alliance of Free Planets as a pilot and officer during the Galactic Civil War.

Handa was a Cathar male who served as a Jedi Master during the last decades of the New Sith Wars. He instructed multiple Padawans, including the Humans Githany and Kiel Charny, who developed a romantic relationship with each other.
Mary was a Human female inhabitant of the planet Solay, who served as the leader of the local resistance against King Blackart, along with Raggold.

Blackart was the king of the planet Solay, ruling the planet with an iron fist for about 50 years until 4 ABY. Blackart's tyranny gave rise to an Imperial-backed popular uprising that finally, with the aid of Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker, overthrew his rule.
Raggold was as human male who served as one of the leaders of the Solay resistance against King Blackart, spending 50 years of his life fighting Blackart's tyrannical rule.

Vost Tyne was a Force-sensitive Human male Imperial Navy admiral who ran a hyperbaride synthesis plant on the planet Marca. Tyne served the Galactic Empire in its navy and, after attaining the rank of admiral, began working very closely with the Dark Lord Darth Vader.
Jamson Caglio was the male Human who served as Moff of the Bormea sector during the Galactic Civil War. While not on the planet Coruscant, Caglio resided in Corulag's capital of Curamelle.
A Huttlet was born to Anachro and Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo, the grandchild of Orko the H'uun and a great-nephew of Jabba the Hutt.

Weeba Weeba was a Human male Rancor keeper in Jabba's Palace. He was present in the lower levels of the palace when Luke Skywalker killed Jabba's rancor. He promptly shoved Luke out of the Rancor pit following its demise.

Lesim was an Imperial Army major during the Galactic Civil War. Stationed aboard an All Terrain Armored Transport that was patrolling the Forest Moon of Endor in 4 ABY, Lesim encountered Rebel Alliance Commander Luke Skywalker, who surrendered himself to the major and his stor…
Neeamesh Dym was the designer, engineer, and original pilot of Dusty Duck.
Lalu Morwan was a Hapan female and a former flight surgeon onboard the Kendall during the Swarm War.

A male Kajain'sa'Nikto bounty hunter fought against Din Djarin in an attempt to capture Grogu, on the desert planet of Tatooine. He was accompanied by three other hunters; Biran Redben, a helmeted humanoid male and a small alien of the same species as Scrapjaw Motito.
This aged Human male controller served the Alliance to Restore the Republic at Echo Base on the planet Hoth in 3 ABY.
A H'nemthe with blue-gray skin was present in the palace of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure on Tatooine in 4 ABY.
Kryss P'teska was a Human male orphan rescued by Han Solo after the Battle of Ylesia. He was later dropped off on Corellia with the other rescued children.
Horodi was a pilot the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served aboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence during the Galactic Civil War.
Pedna Scotian was a starfighter pilot who flew for the New Republic. A female Chev, she flew with Rogue Squadron during the Zsinj campaign in 8 ABY.
Risso Nu was a Corellian bounty hunter who organized an ambush to kill Boba Fett and assume his identity.

Doman Beruss was a member of Clan Beruss. The male senator Doman Beruss of Illodia was named after this ancestor. The female senator Doman Beruss of Corellia was also given her older relative's name out of respect.
Lowghen Badra was a Human pilot and friend of the Jedi Master Niquon.

Borta was a Dolandu from the moon Skalokor. He was an old friend of Jedi Master Niquon and was known to go to the Jedi for help. During the time of the Old Republic, Borta came across a dismantled assassin droid.
Von Totha was a Dark Jedi. More competent than another apprentice in the group, Totha was sent to Skalokor with some droids and Rodian mercenaries to eliminate the Jedi Master Niquon.

Chantu Solk was an old acquaintance of Lando Calrissian. He was a shrewd starship broker who made his fortune during the Galactic Civil War, playing both sides when necessary, but favoring the Rebel Alliance. Eventually he grew very sick.
Troomis was a Human male Alliance to Restore the Republic Intelligence agent.
Creeve was a male Human captain in the Galactic Empire.
Ioth was an alien male Alliance Intelligence agent.
Zgorth'sth was a male Mon Calamari who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as an agent within Alliance Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War.

A Corellian pirate was part of the group that escorted Jabba the Hutt to Docking Bay 94 in Mos Eisley to confront Han Solo. Minutes prior he had been drinking in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina, along with Boelo and Gela Yeens.
A male Human Force-sensitive had traveled with a young Yoda hundreds of years before the Battle of Yavin and the two crash-landed on an unknown swamp world.
Janelle Harcourt was a female Human and the wife of Imperial Navy captain Aron Harcourt.

Lorn Moonrunner, born as Corvus Langlier, was the original owner of the astromech droid R2-4B. When he was younger, he dreamed of becoming an Imperial soldier and eventually attended the Raithal Army Academy on a scholarship.

This swoop biker rode a Flare-S swoop in Mos Eisley and startled a ronto and its Jawa riders when Luke Skywalker was about to meet Han Solo in the Mos Eisley Cantina. He was a mercenary and likely part of a Tatooine swoop gang. He wore a tall shock-helmet.
Lirin Banolt was a conman who operated on the planet Tatooine.

Rover was a male Meduza pet belonging to Doctor Cornelius Evazan, a wanted criminal who trained the creature to act as a bodyguard. Rover proved to be skilled at the job, as he was highly loyal to his master, and Evazan had little difficulty in training him.
Huff Zinga was a male Gungan who was the director of the Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility located in Kaadara on the planet of Naboo.
Darth Karnage was a Sith. As with many Sith Lords throughout history, Karnage's name included the Darth title.
Darth Kruhl was a Sith Lord and assassin in the One Sith Order, being one of many to serve under Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt during his reign as Galactic Emperor.
Kella Rand was a female Human reporter who worked for the Galactic News Network and the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Shek Barayel was a male Indu serving as chief councillor on the Indu Council. He was murdered in an attempt by Imperial loyalists to frame the New Republic and bring the Empire (and its credits) back to Indu San.
Dictio L'varren was a male Human who served as the New Republic ambassador to the Indu San system.

Sprool, also known as Sprool the Trader, was an Ithorian relic trader who lived on Dennogra. He was contacted by Han Solo shortly after the Battle of Yavin, and purchased a crate full of Sith treasure for 500,000 credits.

Kaleb Darme was a male Indu who was the former bodyguard of Imperial Governor Ekam Ouwray, and served as an Authority Officer on the Council Authority of the Indu Council during the Galactic Civil War.

Tev Aden was a male who served as New Republic Ambassador Dictio L'varren's aide on Indu San. He was murdered by Council Authority Officer Kaleb Darme in an attempt to frame the New Republic and bring the Galactic Empire back to the Indu San system.
Crislyn was a female reporter who worked for the Galactic News Network at the Indu GNN bureau on Indu San.
Robbe Nostler was a male reporter who worked for the Galactic News Network. He was the Bureau Chief at the Indu GNN bureau on Indu San.
Juloff was a male reporter who worked for the Galactic News Network at the Indu GNN bureau on Indu San.

Vors Voorhorian was an Incom Corporation engineer who designed the T-65 X-wing starfighter. After being arrested by the Galactic Empire following the seizure of the X-wing prototypes by Alliance to Restore the Republic agents, he escaped and set up his own factory on a remote …

Koh'shak was a male Twi'lek and was a member of Clan Shak. Koh'shak worked for the Twi'lek Cazne'olan, helping handle negotiations for the whereabouts of Firith Olan between Rogue Squadron and Marl Semtin.
Rogor was an Imperial spy during the Alliance to Restore the Republic occupation of Yavin 4.
Tolok was a Human male Alderaanian aristocrat who escaped its destruction in 0 BBY. He was suspected by Leia Organa to be an Imperial spy, but this later turned out to be false.
Darlen was a female Human Alderaanian aristocrat who escaped its destruction by the Death Star.

Lord Vartonis was a Dark Jedi operating on Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War. He had hoped to capture a mysterious crystal left on the planet by the Jedi thousands of years ago, but an anonymous spacer, with the help of Obi-Wan Kenobi's Force ghost, was able to defeat him…

Fohargh was a Makurth male student at the Sith Academy on Korriban during the New Sith Wars. He attended the Academy alongside such notable apprentices as Bane, whom he bested in a lightsaber training duel early on in the Human's own tenure.
Lady Chawkroft was the Imperial Minister of Corrections in the years preceding the Battle of Yavin and co-sponsor of Stars' End.
Gar was a resident of Annoo during the early years of the Galactic Empire. He helped out on Demma Moll's farm and became part of her resistance movement.

Neera Opatajji-Hirken was a Human female who was married to Corporate Sector Authority Viceprex of Corporate Security Mirkovig Hirken. A member of a noble family, Opatajji-Hirken had a privileged upbringing before marrying Hirken, a fast riser in the Corporate Sector hierarchy.
Laph Rapuung was a Yuuzhan Vong of the warrior caste.
Barnley was a Human native of Corellia and member of the Human League. He was much larger and more rotund than the Human average.
Flautis was a Human native of Corellia and member of the Human League, which was also on the planet Corellia.
Gahg was an individual who became the first Finance Minister of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY shortly after its creation at the end of the Clone Wars.
Braxis was a Pho Ph'eahian who served in the Imperial Senate during the early days of the Galactic Empire.
Mulleen served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars and declared his allegiance to the Galactic Republic's successor state, the Galactic Empire, upon its formation in 19 BBY.
Frang Colgter was the husband of Condren Foreck who was a wealthy farmer's daughter on the agriworld of Azbrian.
Mox Slosin was a member of the Inquisitorius and one of the Emperor's distinguished High Inquisitors.

Krynda Draay, born Krynda Hulis, was a female Near-Human Jedi Master of the pre-Ruusan Old Republic. Born to a Human mother and the Miraluka Jedi Master Noab Hulis, she was apprenticed to Vodo-Siosk Baas and became a Sage Master.

Saluc was a Mon Calamari officer in the New Republic, serving under a Duros onboard the Dewback's Burden. The ship was ambushed by the Eiattu pirates who left the crew to die slowly as their oxygen gave out. In this manner Saluc died.
A Gungan scout used Gungan farseein to scout the Great Grass Plains for reinforcements from the Royal Naboo Security Forces during the occupation of Naboo in 32 BBY.

The Mayor of Sernpidal City was the elderly Human male mayor of Sernpidal City in 25 ABY. When Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Anakin Solo arrived on Sernpidal in the Mission to Sernpidal, he met them and informed them of the situation as Sernpidal's moon Dobido was slowly pulled int…

Munin Skirata was a male Human Mandalorian soldier, and member of Clan Skirata. On a particular mission to the planet Surcaris, he found a young boy named Falin Mattran, living on the war-torn streets and surviving on his own.

An original manuscript by Ha'lathin could be found among the artworks in the yacht Imru Ootmian. It had been a gift from the previous owner of the yacht to the then-current owner, Popara Anjiliac Diresto.

The Vibrodagger Killer was a dangerous criminal who committed several murders, presumably with a vibrodagger. The Empire turned a blind eye to his gruesome crimes, because all his victims had been Alliance sympathizers.
Gil Cassel was a Human male born on Bastion to a pro-Imperial family. He was the brother of Jared Cassel, who, like Gil, joined the Imperial Army.
Jared Cassel was a Human male born on Bastion to a pro-Imperial family. The brother of Gil Cassel, Jared joined the Imperial Army.
Liviani Sarno was the head of the Galactic Games Council on Euceron in 26 BBY.
This Mos Eisley beggar was one of the spaceport's many destitute citizens forced to live in the streets and beg for money.
Reina March was a Human female criminal from the planet Coruscant who was the leader and head lieutenant of the anarchist organization Edge-9.
This Mos Eisley droid merchant manipulated funds and Imperial tax codes, and bought droids from Jawas to sell to the Rebel Alliance.
An engineer worked at the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Great Temple base on Yavin 4 during the Galactic Civil War, serving as a crew chief.
Thanaer ke Sekae was a male Human Adumari blastsword duelist from the nation of Cartann on the planet Adumar.
Caleb was a Human male healer who resided on the abandoned world of Ambria. He was killed by Darth Zannah in 990 BBY.
Kirth was a male Human who was a member of Roons Sewell's acting troupe. He was present at the performance where the Galactic Empire killed Masla.

Uso Yso was a swoop bike shop owner on the planet Euceron. He was two meters taller than Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi. He had fifteen fingers on each hand that were the size of a bantha haunch, and possessed two beating hearts.

Kar Plaushe was a Human female socialite from the planet Coruscant who frequented the Outlander Club. In 22 BBY, she visited the club at the same time the bounty hunters Jango Fett and Zam Wesell did.
This freighter captain was one of many former members of the Ralltiir home defense force who became smugglers and scouts hoping to help liberate Ralltiir from the Galactic Empire.

Medrit Vasur was a Mandalorian Human male who was a soldier and a blacksmith. His husband, the Mandalorian bounty hunter Goran Beviin, was often away for long stretches while Medrit remained on Mandalore.

Besum was a four-eyed individual who was employed by Uso Yso. During the Galactic Games, Bog Divinian, a member of the Galactic Games Council in charge of seating the Senators, told Obi-Wan Kenobi that Besum gave him the seating chart for the Senators so he transferred the cre…
Ruler Three was a member of the Ruling Power of Euceron. He was a tall Euceron living and administering in the capital city of Eusebus.
A tall, unidentified Calibop was one of the Mandalorian Protectors serving with Boba Fett at Caluula Station in 29 ABY.
A golden-furred unidentified Bothan was a Mandalorian Protector. The Bothan served with Boba Fett at Caluula Station in 29 ABY.
Ryn one-one-five was the codename of a member of the Ryn Network operating on Vortex during the Yuuzhan Vong War. In 29 ABY he helped engineer the prisoner escape on Selvaris.
Will Neluenf, a native of Tatooine, was a Podracer in an illegal Podrace on Euceron during the Galactic Games of 26 BBY.

Tibor was a Barabel bounty hunter who assisted Zorba Desilijic Tiure during his trip to Jabba Desilijic Tiure's palace on Tatooine. He later accompanied Zorba to Cloud City to help capture Princess Leia Organa.

Redkihl Rokk, also known as the Scavenger of the Galaxy, was a Huralok pirate salvager who was destroyed by Han Solo among the wreckage of the first Death Star. In order to keep his body from failing him, Rokk had to inject himself with drugs and nutrients.
Sanglui was a male Squalris who secretly led a Rebel cell on the planet Vorzyd V during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Mardig was a male who desperately needed to catch his shuttle flight to the planet Carsanza as it was the last one for a week and he did not wish to be fired from his job.
Herylcha Baakos was a female councillor in the Galactic Republic.
Tantor was the father of Brenn and Dellis Tantor. His first name is not known.

Darth Desolous was a male Pau'an Jedi Master prior to becoming a Sith Lord. Born around 3522 BBY, he studied Sith teachings and fell to the dark side of the Force, he was expelled from the Jedi Order.
Dafi was a female member of a green-skinned near-Human species and a member of a gang led by Human thugs Lemo and Sanda based on the planet Arcan IV during the Imperial Period.
Lemo was a Human male who sported a thick beard and long, ginger hair that he tied back with a white headband.
Sanda was a female Human criminal who, together with Lemo, led a gang of thugs. She had ginger-colored hair.

affiliation: Alderaan Select Academy for Young Ladies
x: Madame Vesta was the headmistress of Alderaan Select Academy for Young Ladies. She was known for her strictness and was described as "a rancor of a Nanny" by one of her students, Princess Leia Organa.

Liak ke Mattino was a Human male pilot and captain of the Strike the Moons Flightknife from the planet Adumar. He and his flightknife were the first Adumari pilots to fly against Red Flight, the New Republic diplomatic group sent to Adumar, in a non-live-fire battle.

Lojrak Shrag was a salt-smuggling male Arcona criminal who lived on Cona before the outbreak of the Clone Wars. Godiban Bakoosta was his lieutenant. In 22 BBY, Shrag was arrested by Jedi Tassida Judrelle, Quarmall, and Stass Allie prior to the First Battle of Geonosis.
Godiban Bakoosta was the lieutenant of Lojrak Shrag, and helped him run a salt-smuggling operation on Cona prior to the Clone Wars. He was killed in a Jedi raid.

"Eel" was a sea eel owned by a young Boba Fett during the period of time when he lived on the planet Kamino. Known only as "Eel," Fett's pet ate sea mice. When Boba and his father, Jango Fett, left Kamino to travel to Geonosis, Boba threw Eel into the Kaminoan sea.
Vit was a human male Imperial Remnant general who took over of the planet Dathomir in 12 ABY.
Vol Hamame was a Human male who made his living as a thug and was once a member of Big Gizz's swoop gang before seeking greater profits with Phedroi during the Galactic Civil War.

Phedroi was a male individual who worked in partnership with Vol Hamame to seek profit. A sentient with a mucus-lined nasopharynx and dirty ringlet beard, he was responsible for the death of Codeq Santhananan and wanted part of the reward that could be gained from taking in th…
Talnin owed Wlinc Tchrr (a Hutt bookmaker) money from gambling bets. He unsuccessfully tried to pay his debt with travel vouchers, which Tchrr didn't accept.
Nyrat Agira was a human member of the Zealots of Psusan cult who was a patron of the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY.
Daxar Ies was one of Emperor Palpatine's private accountants. He embezzled two billion credits from Palpatine's personal funds, and stashed it into several accounts across the galaxy.
Hammond Ballater was a male criminal. He was a member of the Black Sun syndicate on Corellia before he left the organization to work for Shalera the Hutt.

An unidentified Neimoidian was present at the Battle of Muunilinst. The Neimoidian oversaw the battle along with other Muuns via hologram from within the InterGalactic Banking Clan's commander center .
Dev Breeger was a criminal who worked as a double agent for both the Black Sun syndicate and Shalera the Hutt's organization on Corellia.
Grk'kkrs'ar was the name of a mythic Tusken Raider who, according to Sand People legend, never showed fear, even when facing a krayt dragon.
A Human male moisture farmer lived in a farm on the edge of the Dune Sea, where his family had lived for generations on Tatooine.
Tenel Ka Djo was a female Hapan Jedi Knight and the daughter of Prince Isolder, Chume'da of the Hapes Consortium, and the Dathomiri witch Teneniel Djo.
1047 was a Human male stormtrooper who served as a sergeant in the Galactic Empire's Desert Sands unit by 0 BBY.
Mychael Ologat was a short but muscular Imperial recruit who shared a room with Davin Felth and Geoff f'Tuhns while in training to become a stormtrooper.

Nonce was a Radnoran who was in detention most of his life on Radnor. During the Mission to Radnor, when a toxin was released on Radnor, Ruuin, a Radnoran raider who worked for the Avoni, who wanted to invade the planet, claimed that he was paid a wage and a share of the spoil…

Gana Lant was a stormtrooper who served under General Brenn Tantor for most of the Galactic Civil War. Lant was intensely loyal to Tantor, and later defected to the Rebel Alliance along with Tantor and nine other stormtroopers.
Wehda Jochi was a stormtrooper who served under General Brenn Tantor for most of the Galactic Civil War.
Otome Mafai was a stormtrooper who served under General Brenn Tantor for most of the Galactic Civil War.
Graaqu Namec was a stormtrooper who served under General Brenn Tantor for most of the Galactic Civil War.
Cancl Rosan was a stormtrooper who served under General Brenn Tantor for most of the Galactic Civil War.
Javda Tawas was a stormtrooper who served under General Brenn Tantor for most of the Galactic Civil War.
Spevi Wiwas was a stormtrooper who served under General Brenn Tantor for most of the Galactic Civil War.

Shay Jelavan was a Human male resident of the world Taris who was the younger brother of Jedi Padawan Shad Jelavan. Orphaned as a young boy in 3966 BBY, Jelavan lived in Taris' Middle City with his older sister, Shel, supported by Shad's stipend.

Oxbel was a Devaronian, one of only three who lived on Tatooine. He was friends with Kardue'sai'Malloc, also known as Labria. He once attempted a scam along with Kardue'sai'Malloc where they pretended to be brothers, which failed.

Hoff was the Human son of Colby Hoff, a former business competitor of Black Sun crime lord Prince Xizor. Colby fell into ruin and then committed suicide after failing to outsmart his rival, leading the younger Hoff to blame Xizor for his father's murder.
Tyrral was a male Chiss merchant who lived during the Galactic Civil War fought between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Shalera, known as "Lady Hutt" because she identified as female, was a Hutt who abided by a moral code; a rare trait for her species. Formerly a member of Black Sun, she joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Empire.
The Dargulli Dark Jedi was a Human female Dark Jedi who lived during the Great Jedi Purge.
Rif Taranu was a male smuggler who supported the Rebel Alliance in his ship, Dead Reckoning during the Galactic Civil War.

Samiam was an Imperial stormtrooper. Stationed in a detachment under the command of Colonel Beri Tulon, Samiam was assigned to participate in the Massacre on Abridon, but never got the chance as Tulon attempted to defect to the Rebel Alliance, killing his entire squad, includi…

Unco was an Imperial stormtrooper. Placed in a detachment under the command of Colonel Beri Tulon, Unco was assigned to participate in the Massacre on Abridon, but never got the chance as Tulon attempted to defect to the Rebel Alliance, killing his entire squad, including Unco.

Solm was a Feeorin member of the Antarian Rangers. He led a group of Rangers against the Galactic Empire during the period prior to the Battle of Yavin, one of the few branches of that organization to act openly.
Kaskutal was a male Gotal who lived about six centuries before the Clone Wars. He was the founder of the Antarian Rangers.
Lord Tritum XI was the High Lord of House Mecetti around 4000 BBY. He realized that there was a risk of inbreeding within his house and sought a noble suitor outside of the Tapani sector.

Kuep was a Human corporal who served as a seasoned member of the Cloud City security forces during the early years of the Galactic Civil War. Kuep was also a miner by trade and prospected Tibanna gas pockets while off duty.
Airten was a light-skinned Human sergeant of the Bespin Wing Guard, the main security force of Cloud City on the gas giant Bespin, during the Galactic Civil War.

Hakin was a Human native of the planet Alderaan during the Galactic Civil War. A skiff racer, Hakin had learned to bargain on the black market and later joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic—which valued his black market bargaining skill—shortly before the Battle of Yavi…
Precht was a fair-skinned Human trooper recruit in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War fought between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire.
Koth Barak was a male Human and a midshipman of the New Republic warship Adamantine. He was the first victim of the Death Seed plague in Meridian sector in 13 ABY though no one knew it at the time.
Alain was a Human private in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, fighting for the oppressed inhabitants of the galaxy.

AF-119 was a Human who served as a Imperial stormtrooper during the Galactic Civil War. The trooper was stationed in a garrison on Bespin's Cloud City after the planet was occupied by Imperial forces led by the Sith Lord Darth Vader in the year 3 ABY.
ST-4402 was the designation of a Human who served as an Imperial sandtrooper squad leader assigned to a garrison on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

TK-577 was a Human who served as a stormtrooper in the Imperial Army, holding the position of fire team leader. By some point following the Battle of Yavin, TK-577 had deserted the Empire and become one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild's top ten most wanted fugitives.

AF-27 was the designation of a Human who served as an Imperial stormtrooper during the Galactic Civil War. He was armed with an E-11 blaster rifle. Ambitious and motivated, AF-27 constantly sought opportunities to advance in rank. He was also a natural born sniper.

TK-420 was the designation of a Human Imperial stormtrooper serving in an inspection crew during the Galactic Civil War. TK-420 was tasked with examining supply shipments to the Death Star battle station.

ST-103 was a Human who served as an Imperial sandtrooper squad leader assigned to a garrison at Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. During ST-103's assignment on Tatooine, the stormtrooper rode a dewback.

TK-104 was a Human Imperial stormtrooper during the Galactic Civil War. At some point, TK-104 was present in a location with an orange sky, alongside the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader and an airborne YT-1300 light freighter, with both being reflected in the visor of TK-104…

RGA-972 was a Human snowtrooper in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. He was an assault specialist with training in the use of many heavy weapons, including the E-Web heavy repeating blaster.
NT-311 was an Imperial stormtrooper who served in the 501st Legion during the Galactic Civil War. He served as the point man in his squad.
Nar Millich was a Human major who served as a Security Chief in the Imperial Navy during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.
PS-29-2, nicknamed Mynock, was a TIE pilot in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. He was part of the Imperial Shadow wing and flew under the call sign Shadow Two.
PS-29-3, also known as "Hammer," was a TIE pilot in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. PS-29-3 flew under the call sign Shadow Three in the Imperial Shadow wing.
Liiria Beldonna was the female Human leader of an organization of mercenaries known as Beldonna's League, also referred to as "Beldonna's Legion."
Tutti Snibit was a Chadra-Fan bounty hunter, but his small size prevented him from becoming renowned or recruited by important potential employers.
Kurjj was a male Drovian. He worked for Jabba the Hutt as a security guard at his Arena Citadel in Mos Espa. He was especially suited to this job because of his hulking size.

Garu Hral Eschen was a male Drovian. He was killed, along with his whole family by Gopso'o warriors. Though his manner of death is unknown, he was apparently disemboweled. His descendant Knezex Hral Piksoar would later work for the New Republic.

Knezex Hral Piksoar was a male Drovian who lived on the swamp planet Nim Drovis. He was a direct descendant of Garnu Hral Eschen, who was killed by Gopso'o warriors. Knezex worked to avenge this death by fighting against Gopso'o terrorists.

Wes Janson was a human male pilot from Taanab who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War, Janson was a member of Rogue Squadron and participated in the Battle of Hoth as the gunner for Wedge Antilles.

Ur was a male Tusken Raider who lived on the desert planet of Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He was famous for slaying two Gamorrean guards during a territorial skirmish with the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

Urur was a male Tusken Raider who lived on the desert planet of Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He was the younger brother of the Tusken Raider Ur. Urur was restricted to defending his tribe. If Ur was killed, Urur would take his older brother's place.

Tiatha was a male Jawa who lived on the desert planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Tiatha stole his brother's ion blaster, a family heirloom, to use as his personal weapon. After four seasons, the blaster earned Tiatha enough wealth to retire.

Kreigg was a Human commander in the Galactic Empire who served as a tactical advisor during the early years of the Galactic Civil War. A loyal Imperial soldier, Kreigg earned Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin's favor for his cunning during a Rebel attack on the Moff's flagship.
Ururur was a Tusken Raider who lived on the desert planet of Tatooine during the early years of the Galactic Civil War. Ururur was the leader of a Tusken tribe.
The Sand People chieftain was the leader of a Sand People tribe residing in an enclave within the Dune Seas of Tatooine, southwest of Anchorhead during the Jedi Civil War.
Ash B'risko was a Human male freighter pilot.
Toosog was one of the bounty hunters sent by Risso Nu to catch Boba Fett on Ma'ar Shaddam. One of his eyes was cybernetic, possibly as a result of a previous encounter with Fett, as his scars were.

Nagyan was one of the bounty hunters sent by Risso Nu to catch Boba Fett on Ma'ar Shaddam. At some point in his career, he came into conflict with Fett and sustained several scars as a result of their altercation.

Mudmub was one of the bounty hunters sent by Risso Nu to catch Boba Fett on Ma'ar Shaddam. A Sullustan, he was the partner of a Rodian bounty hunter. Mudmub died when he was strapped with explosives that were detonated.
Drex was the crimelord of the Gallapraxis system. One of his sons, Gavron Sil, was killed by Boba Fett. He conspired with his other son, Feleen Bantillian, to kill the bounty hunter.

Gavron Sil was the son of Drex and the brother of Feleen Bantillian. He was killed by Boba Fett. His father and brother conspired to take revenge on Fett, but their plot was unsuccessful and they soon met the same fate as Sil.
Feleen Bantillian was the son of Drex, crime lord of the Gallapraxis system, and the brother of Gavron Sil.
Brylin was a Human male who served as Spokesman for the ruling Herdessan Guild on his home planet of Herdessa during the Galactic Civil War.
Tof was a Human male who was an influential member of the ruling Herdessan Guild on his home planet of Herdessa during the Galactic Civil War.

Joshua Jinzler was a patron of the Outlander Club when Jedi Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi were pursuing the bounty hunter Zam Wesell. Jinzler had short, almost white hair and was wearing a reddish vest.

Stacy was an X-wing pilot serving the Rebel Alliance under General Carlist Rieekan around the time of the Battle of Yavin. Shortly after the battle, she was attracted to and flirted with Han Solo, who returned her attention, mostly to antagonize Princess Leia Organa.
Onie Arkmen was a Human female native to the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. She was a participant of the party scene on her homeworld.
Betl Oxtroe was one of a select few female officers to ascend the ranks of the Imperial Navy, becoming an admiral.

The "Tipper" was a Corellian businessman-turned-hacker. He called himself "Tipper" because he had found a way to "tip" the contents of other people's bank accounts into his own. He founded the gang of the computer hackers known as the Skaak Tippers.
Jonni Skaak, formerly Jonthol Mazoon, was the leader of the Naboo branch of Skaak Tippers until he was assassinated by agents of the Royal Naboo Security Forces.

Bendu Fry was an obese Devaronian male criminal wanted dead or alive by the Black Sun criminal syndicate. Boba Fett, a bounty hunter, tracked Fry down in a cantina in the company of two female Twi'leks and told him to surrender.

Larbo was a Human male who lived on Kuat during the Separatist Crisis and a year before the Clone Wars begun. He was one of a large number of people who worked as virtual slaves for the barons of Kuat City.

Desolous was a Sith Lord who was active in the galaxy long before the year 35 ABY. The Sith Eternal cult, which was active during that time, had a custom of naming their Sith trooper detachments after ancient Sith.
Green Wing was the call sign of a male member of Green Squadron, a Rebel Alliance RZ-1 A-wing interceptor unit that fought during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

Winslau Da'k was a male Dark Jedi that was once a student of a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. Da'k was lost to the dark side of the Force after an encounter with Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader, and he imprisoned his old Jedi Master in a fortress on the Unknown Regions world…
Haazen was a failed Padawan-turned Sith Acolyte who lived during the time of the Great Sith War and Mandalorian Wars.

Seb Arkos, nicknamed Arky, was a male Human Corellian criminal who specialized in forgery of documents. He was of tall but lanky stature. Arkos was originally caught by Hal Horn and eventually sentenced to an unknown amount of years of hard labor in the Spice Mines of Kessel.
In 0 BBY, Darth Vader and two stormtroopers came to his long-abandoned fortress to look for the Death Star plans. A stormtrooper told the other fellow stormtrooper about Yorn's legend.
During 0 BBY, a Mos Eisley cop was part of the local law enforcement in Mos Eisley that was hunting BoShek for running an Imperial blockade and destroying four TIE Fighters in the process.
Cuddles was Nightsister Silri's pet rancor. It was trained by Silri to work for the Zann Consortium and attacks only enemies, not Zann Consortium members.

Iving Creel was a famous Pleader on the planet Concord Dawn during the early years of the Galactic Empire. Circa 13 BBY, Creel visited an imprisoned Journeyman Protector—Boba Fett, going by the name Jaster Mereel—who had been detained after murdering a corrupt fellow Protector.

Hallolar Voors was an entrepreneur on Jubilar. The son of a wealthy local businessman, Voors trafficked in spice, and was apparently able to find a source of the substance independent of the Hutts, who controlled the spice trade in the local sector.
Alisia was a male Gran who worked as a station nurse in the medical bay of Tansarii Point Station during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Mister Tom Morrow was a customer of the Star Tours travel agency. A public address announcer asked him to see a Star Tours agent at gate number four, shortly before a Star Tours vessel departed and became involved in a battle.
Tarneel was a Human male who headed the Peace Brigade on Ord Sedra during the Yuuzhan Vong War. During the Battle of Ord Sedra, he was Force-pushed by Kyle Katarn and taken into custody.
Bilman Dowd was a representative of the Bounty Hunters' Guild and had worked there for many years.

Gaarn was an admiral in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, Gaarn was tasked with protecting the Eclipse, a Super Star Destroyer orbiting Kuat, when it was attacked by the forces of the Zann Consortium, led by the crime lord Ty…

Subject 4D668493X was a bioengineered carnivorous predator created by a Galactic Empire contractor. Allegedly, it was a specimen from a program dedicated to create a creature that could aid Imperial officers in their efforts to track down and apprehend criminals.
Incavi Larado, also known as Incavi Baker after her short-lived marriage with Miagi Baker, was the mayor of the city of Dying Slowly on Jubilar, and one of Boba Fett's informants.

This bounty hunter was employed by Jabba Desilijic Tiure in an attempt to execute Tyber Zann just before his prison break. Urai Fen killed him, while he sneaked past the hunter undetected using a cloaking device.

A male Muun was captured after the Battle of Muunilinst. He provided a code to the Galactic Republic in order to see holographic transmissions sent to Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray's Neimoidian mechno-chair's holotransceiver.
Adion Lang was a Human male native from Lankashiir, who served as a Lieutenant of the Imperial Security Bureau during the Galactic Civil War.
Stenn Glidrick was a male Human who commanded the Kuari Princess in 0 BBY.
Borbor Crisk was a Corellian crime lord who competed with Zekka Thyne.
Jing was a Human male miner on Katanos VII. He was killed by the colony's own cloned cyborg creatures.
Andru was a Human male miner on Katanos VII. He was afraid of the Jedi, but let Obs Kaj escape, ending up exiled from the colony.
Happer was a Mos Eisley police guard on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Stiv Kram was a Human male who led the mining colony on Katanos VII.

Fenald was the chief of security for Kuat Drive Yards in 4 ABY and, in particular, a lackey to the Kuat of Kuat. Fenald secretly plotted with Kodir of Kuhlvult to take control of a shipyard during the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Raine Durasha was a Human male Imperial soldier. His unit was deployed to Ralltiir during the Imperial subjugation of the world. Durasha was killed when his unit was ambushed by Rebel forces at the spaceport shortly before the Battle of Yavin.
Chester was the short Rodian sidekick to Gorm Maldorf. Chester accidentally killed him by strangling him with wire in the Cage, and tried to blame Gorm's rival, Luke Skywalker.

Gorm Maldorf was a male from the Azerbaz Region of Tatooine. His Rodian sidekick was Chester. A bully and a cheater, Maldorf was accidentally killed by Chester when they were rigging the Cage for a race against Luke Skywalker.

Sorna was an Human woman who lived on the desert world of Tatooine. She was an old friend of Shmi Skywalker. After Shmi Skywalker's death, in 22 BBY during the Separatist Crisis, she used to place flowers on her grave at the Lars homestead every year.

Krynda Draay's sister was the half-sister of Krynda Draay. She died in the Great Sith War, apparently in 3997 BBY. Her death, as well as that of her husband and Jedi Master, hit Krynda very hard. It took four years for her to resume training Padawans.
Barrison Draay was a male Human Jedi Knight during the time of the Great Sith War. He was the husband of Krynda Draay and the father of Lucien Draay.
Lookout was one of the subnodes of the legendary Assembler arachnid Kud'ar Mub'at.
Orin Bold was a male Human moisture farmer who lived on Ord Mantell. He was also the father of Nella Bold.

Bialy was a female Human Sergeant who served as a member of the Royal Naboo Security Forces and a partner to Lieutenant Quarsh Panaka around 36 BBY. Together, they went on a mission and took the Gungan Kroke Modbom from Port Landien and delivered him to Maris Magneta.

N'a-kee-tula was a Shadda-Bi-Boran child from the planet Shadda-Bi-Boran. In 38 BBY, the Shadda-Bi-Borans were evacuated from their dying homeworld by the Refugee Relief Movement, including the Naboo Padmé Naberrie, who felt N'a-kee-tula was a special child.
Paxaz Izhiq was a male Falleen criminal who worked on the planet Coruscant with Vinna Jiss, a GAR logistics center clerk, during the Clone Wars.
Hela Madiry was a female clerk in the accounting division at the Grand Army of the Republic logistics center on the planet Coruscant.

Alyn Rae was a male Gotal entrepreneur who by around 29 ABY, had developed the cone sock, a chemical-based garment worn on a Gotal's sensitivity head cones to protect them from disorientating and painful electromagnetic emissions produced by droids and other technology.

Haduran was a captain in the Army of Light and a friend of the Jedi Order. He fought in the Ruusan campaign and was one of the members of the Army of Light who survived the Thought bomb unleashed by Lord Skere Kaan and the Brotherhood of Darkness due to his lack of Force-sensi…
Orilltha was a Sith Lord in the Brotherhood of Darkness who served as an instructor at the Sith Academy on Korriban alongside Borthis, Hezzoran, Kas'im, Shenayag, and Qordis.
Shenayag was a Sith Lord in the Brotherhood of Darkness who served as an instructor at the Sith Academy on Korriban alongside Borthis, Hezzoran, Kas'im, Orilltha, and Qordis.
Hezzoran was a Sith Lord in the Brotherhood of Darkness who served as an instructor at the Sith Academy on Korriban alongside Borthis, Kas'im, Orilltha, Shenayag, and Qordis.
Borthis was a Sith Lord in the Brotherhood of Darkness who served as an instructor at the Sith Academy on Korriban alongside Hezzoran, Kas'im, Orilltha, Shenayag, and Qordis.
Llokay was a male Zabrak Sith apprentice, and later a Dark Lord of the Sith in the years leading up to the Seventh Battle of Ruusan.
Yevra was a female Zabrak Sith apprentice, and later a Dark Lord of the Sith in the years leading up to the Seventh Battle of Ruusan.

A Killik Sith individual resided on the planet Alsakan long prior to 27,000 BBY. Fleeing persecution, he fled to the world Sarafur, where he came to reside in a building used by a native species for bathing in sulfurous mineral waters.
Birok was the leader of a gang on the planet of Diado. The members of his gang also called him "Boss".

Na-Jia was a female human living as a thief on the planet Diado during the Clone Wars. After stealing Saesee Tiin's lightsaber, he paid her for its return. She was later captured by Confederate forces, who believed her to be a Republic spy along with Tiin.
Grlubb was a weapons runner and petty dictator on Peridon's Folly. A small, rodent-like creature, Grlubb was the first person to hire IG-88B as a bounty hunter.

Sanani was a pet voorpak, a non-sentient species from the planet Naboo, who was owned by the Naboo child Ryoo Naberrie. Naberrie loved Sanani and often dressed the voorpak up to engage in imaginary adventures, which amused her mother, Sola Naberrie.
The Emperor Uthorrferrell Cartha was a Human male who served as the ruler of Eiattu 6 during the period of the New Order's dominance of the galaxy.

Langro Dis was a male Dug from the planet Malastare who operated as a bounty hunter shortly after the Battle of Endor. Langro was distinguished from his kind by his near-albino appearance; having pale, white skin and flame-red eyes.
Swee-beeps was the Gran great-uncle of convicted killer Ree-Yees. He supposedly taught him "culinary resusperation": "Smelling salts so powerful, it bring the dead back to life!"
Fenrol Jarkey was a male Twi'lek resident of Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
Adrianna Nyras was a female senior naval officer who served in the Brotherhood of Darkness during the New Sith Wars.
Bolton Kek was a scientist at Holowan Laboratories and one of the neural network designers of Project Phlutdroid, which resulted in the production of IG-88 and his counterparts.
This Human male red-haired Jedi was a member of the Army of Light in the Ruusan campaign in 1000 BBY. He fought alongside Kiel Charny in a battle on Ruusan.
Primor was a male Inleshat who was the leader, or "The First to Swim," of the Iskalonian School on Iskalon in 3 ABY.
Karka was a pilot in the Rebel Alliance who served aboard the MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser Independence.
Dontal was a pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance who served aboard the MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser Independence during the Galactic Civil War.

Misch'an was a pilot who sometimes served in the Rebel Alliance's Red Squadron aboard the MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser Independence during the Galactic Civil War. A popular pilot, Misch'an was often seen with fellow pilots Karka and Dontal aboard the Independence.
Urzan Krag was an Aqualish bounty hunter who worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure. He tried to kill Boba Fett, but the young boy destroyed Krag's ship in a space battle.

Kkrax was a Sullustan male who resided in the city of Restuss on the moon Rori. Sometime following 0 BBY, Boba Fett tasked a spacer with the job of hunting down an individual named Uff Wogo, who had a high bounty on his head.
Wuioe Opca was a male Devaronian who worked as a chef during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Jost Ellon was a young Human male who lived on Dodz as a scavenger during the Imperial Era. His family was killed by the planet's governor, Kugg, who imposed his will upon the populace through the use of a killer droid named the Destroyer.

VeerTa was a female Meerian who was the leader of the Home Planet Party on the planet Bandomeer in 45 BBY. She unintentionally aided the Dark Jedi Xanatos in his plan to destroy Bandomeer and kill Qui-Gon Jinn. She was arrested by SonTag.
SonTag was a female Meerian governor of the planet of Bandomeer in 45 BBY. A calm leader, she was a supporter of the Home Planet Party and its leader VeerTa.
RonTha was a Meerian who lived on the planet Bandomeer. He was a strict follower of rules and protocol, and believed in doing everything according to regulations.
Barr Moutil was the captain of the Imperial Interdictor Cruiser Stellar Web, under the command of Admiral Rogriss.
Koong Eeth was a male Human who served as Governor of Saleucami during the Galactic Civil War.

Tanda the Hutt was a spaceport director who was in charge of part of Nal Hutta's imports and exports during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he was kidnapped by the Zann Consortium.
Ral Falan was a high ranking Human commander in the Galactic Empire.

Malinth was a Human male Imperial Fleet Commander who was stationed on the Outer Rim planet Honoghr during the Galactic Civil War. He was killed when the Zann Consortium crime syndicate attacked Honoghr.
Chiithii'n was a male Sullustan lieutenant commander in the Rebel Alliance and navigator on the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence during the Galactic Civil War.
This Gladiator fought in the Cauldron on Rattatak. He belonged to a humanoid species with three large, clawed toes on each foot. He fought Nilo before being slain by Asajj Ventress.
A Gossam was seen on Bassadro with Shu Mai and her aide Cat Miin during the Clone Wars.

Keesa was the Pa'lowick assistant of Dama Whitesun Brunk at the Sidi Driss Inn, a hotel in Anchorhead. In 8 ABY, when Imperial remnant troops raided the town in search of the famous moss-painting, Killik Twilight, who assaulted Keesa.

A Techno Union scientist was a male Skakoan, and the lead engineer who managed the experiments performed on the Nelvaanians for the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 19 BBY. He was killed by Anakin Skywalker during the Battle of Nelvaan.
Arnothian was a male human who was once a general of the Galactic Empire.

Droon was an Imperial admiral who helped Frija Torlock try to rule Corulag by killing Wrenga Jixton. After discovering the plot, Jixton handed Droon to Darth Vader who forced him into a duel with a lightsaber, where he was defeated by Vader and executed.
Kikipi was a king who put himself on currency within the Toong'l system after its secession from the Galactic Republic and resultant rejection of the Republic credit in 22 BBY.
Ungarr Daris was a powerful Human politician from Thyferra.
Dalken Hol was an admiral in the Imperial Navy. Some time after the Battle of Yavin, Dalken was captured on Carida by Bossk and turned over to the Zann Consortium.

Veermok was a Human male who ran a secret, illegal facility on Naboo during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. The lab contained incriminating evidence about either Palpatine or King Veruna. He was executed by Sate Pestage.
A Padawan was apprenticed to Jedi Master Vrook Lamar in the time period before the Mandalorian Wars, a galaxy-spanning conflict between the Galactic Republic and Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders.

A Jedi who was a member of the Jedi Order in the time period prior to the Mandalorian Wars. That Jedi was the Master of the Jedi Knight Meetra Surik and trained her on the planet Dantooine, where a Jedi Enclave was located.
The Harbinger was commanded by a Human captain in 3951 BBY.

Twitch was a Gungan who was the champion of the Taris dueling ring. At some point after the Battle of Yavin, he was mutilated by the Nightsister Silri as a means for the Zann Consortium to intimidate and gain control of Taris.

Olodondo Berzix was a male Selkath who was the unscrupulous owner of Ahto Luxury Resorts during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He had an office in East Ahto and published the Guide to Beautiful Manaan.
Alhond Robari was chief chef of the Firaxa Room. He specialized in cooking Selkath for Hutt patrons.

Fewash Welko was a Selkath member of the Order of Shasa. He was one of the Shasan adepts who, shortly before the Battle of Endor, met a dark-suited Human Jedi and was convinced to rise up against the Imperial forces occupying Ahto City.

Vill was a clone of the deceased bounty hunter Jango Fett. Originally a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, Vill became one of the first stormtroopers after the Galactic Republic was reorganized into the Galactic Empire.
Kaa was a Dark Jedi who was very close to her twin sister Lii. They were able to sometimes trick people into thinking that they were simply one individual.
Lii was a female Dark Jedi and the twin sister of Kaa. She was so similar to her sister that they were sometimes able to trick others into thinking they were simply one individual.

Faron Tolis was a human member of the Alliance of Free Planets, following the Battle of Endor. A scout, Tolis was dispatched in 4 ABY to investigate strange life readings on the desolate planet Kinooine, only to discover the vanguard of the Nagai expeditionary force preparing …

Davith Sconn was an officer of the Imperial Navy, who rose to be first officer of a Star Destroyer, but was later confined at the Jagg Island Detention Center for his role in the bombardment of Gra Ploven.

This female Dark Jedi or Sith was present inside the Sith Academy on Korriban between the arrivals of Revan in 3956 BBY and Meetra Surik's in 3951 BBY. She left a Sith holocron inside the former Academy master's room and sealed it with her lightsaber.
Weblin was a Regional Governor serving the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire as a Grand Moff.
Captain Eistern was an officer of the Imperial military, apparently an engineering specialist.
Dobbatek was an Imperial officer from Black Sword Command, taken prisoner by the Yevetha in 4 ABY.
Jarrat was a male Human and an Imperial officer serving with Black Sword Command. He was captured by the Yevetha in 4 ABY.
Ezrakh was one of Leia Organa Solo's Noghri bodyguards. In 13 ABY he was infected by the Death Seed plague and died. While guarding Leia, he told her of his wife and children.

Jian Paret was a human male military officer seving the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, eight months after the Battle of Endor, he was serving with Black Sword Command at N'zoth.

Zeven Mallat was an Imperial Security Bureau agent still serving the New Order in 16 ABY. In that year, he responded to a request from Grand Moff Gann of Sector 5 for information on the Yevetha by forwarding a report assembled by Obo Rin, author of the Catalog of Intelligent L…
Wister was a male Human pilot in Rogue Squadron.
Tiarri was one of the wives of King Sha-Mar Ma-dred, the ruler of Kashir. Before the clone wars Anakin Skywalker and his master Obi-Wan Kenobi were sent to a meeting with Sha-Mar Ma-dred.

Rory was a Human male member who served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. He was one of the survivors of the attack on the transport Bright Hope during the Battle of Hoth and assisted Toryn Farr when she took command of the surviving passengers.
Kheann was one of the wives of King Sha-Mar Ma-dred of Kashir.
Mirrix was one of the wives of King Sha-Mar Ma-dred of Kashir.

Ashala Ma-dred was one of the four wives of King Sha-Mar Ma-dred of Kashir. When the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker were asked by the King to help in protecting his wives, Ashala stole Skywalker's lightsaber while he was distracted by her beauty to lure him to her to…
Fem Nu-Ar was an archaeologist who worked alongside Dr. Ualp Xathan during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Schurk-Heren was a Yarkora smuggler, and captain of the vessel Uhumele.
Lynaliskar K'ra Snyffulnimatta, also known simply as Sniffles, was an Elomin male who served as the navigator on board the vessel Uhumele, guiding the starship alongside the pilot, Crys Taanzer.

Crys Taanzer was the female Human from Nadiem, serving as a pilot of the vessel Uhumele. She was the mother of Kennan Taanzer, who joined the Jedi Order and escaped Order 66 during the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Mezgraf was a white-furred Togorian, and a member of the crew of the Uhumele. Prior to joining the crew, he was a slave on Orvax IV. A much-scarred slaver's mark was still visible through the fur on his right shoulder and Mezgraf often wore a long-sleeved jacket to cover it.
Ko Vakier was a male Blood Carver who served as a member of the crew of the Uhumele.
Meekerdin-maa, also known as Ratty, was a male Tintinna who worked as the engineer of the smuggler vessel Uhumele. He had an assistant named Janks.

Janks was a male Phindian who served as a crew member on the smuggling vessel known as the Uhumele following the Clone Wars. On the ship he served as an assistant to the chief engineer, a Tintinna named Meekerdin-maa, and also cooked for the crew.
Mesa Greenbark was a female Nosaurian who married Bomo Greenbark, a commander of the New Plympto resistance who fought against the Galactic Empire.
Resa Greenbark was the daughter of Bomo Greenbark, a Nosaurian Commander in the resistance movement on their homeworld of New Plympto in 19 BBY.
Limbfree was an individual who, by 19 BBY, held the rank of commander in the Nosaurian resistance on the planet New Plympto.
Girov Dza'tey was a Force-sensitive male Bothan operative trained in the martial arts of Jeswandi.
Garnak Fey was the head of the Fey family and the comptroller of the Silica Tab production lines, which were the main source of income for the family-owned organization.

Jaren Dil was a Human male citizen who lived on the planet Junction V with his wife Cilia Dil during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. He helped Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi find Cilia so that they could get information from her.

Sarl Random was a security officer on Cloud City. She was promoted to acting Security Chief of the city by Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian after bringing him evidence that his former security chief, EV-9D9, was responsible for destroying a quarter of Cloud City's droid po…
Toalagar was a pilot in the Rebel Alliance who was captured by the Galactic Empire and sent to the penal colony at Stars' End along with friend and fellow pilot Captain Samuel Raider.
Nathanjo Nirrelz was a Gotal who worked for the government of Antar 4. In 22 BBY, he was sent as an emissary to the neighboring planet of Atzerri to secure bacta for his homeworld.
Shagrad Loset was a Gotal who led the Gotal Foreign Affairs Commune on Antar 4 during a hostage standoff on Atzerri in 13:4.

Paxin was a Rebel agent operating on the "Gambler's World" of Vorzyd V during the era of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Paxin was captured by Imperials along with prominent Rebel leaders Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa, and a Selonian fellow operative named Falud.
Xeran was a Xamster who helped Boba Fett get into Wat Tambor's fortress. Xeran gave Boba an orb of spores from the malvil-tree Malubi that would weaken the Mazariyan around Wat Tambor's fortress.
Governor Crollick was the senior Imperial representative on N'zoth in the Koornacht Cluster, at the time of the Imperial evacuation in 5 ABY, eight months after the Battle of Endor.
Vani Korr was a female Human journalist on Corellia, working for the Corellia Times in Coronet City during the Galactic Civil War.
Ahsmar was a male starfighter pilot who served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Tan'tro was a pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Gokus was the king of Alzar during the time of the Galactic Empire. He at one time owned C-3PO and R2-D2. He was the father of Prince Plooz.
Jagoda was a Human male Prince of R-Duba. At one time, he owned C-3PO, who saved the prince's life from the assassin droid BX-00.
Rin Hawaz was an officer serving with the New Republic Intelligence Service, specifically the Special Threats Division, having attained the rank of major.

A Kaleesh holy man met with fellow Kaleesh Grievous prior to the general's departure to fight in the renewed Huk War. Grievous bowed before the Kaleesh at a landing site, where the latter anointed him with red markings and called on their ancestors to watch over him.
Vinian Ska was a renowned male Quermian Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order in the final days of the Galactic Republic.
Kindee Ya was a renowned female Quermian Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order in the final days of the Galactic Republic.
Loo Raelo was a renowned male Quermian Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order in the final days of the Galactic Republic.
Trebla, a male Jinda, was a magician and a member of the Travelling Jindas troupe that wandered across the Forest Moon of Endor in the year 3 ABY.
This unidentified Neimoidian was a wealthy plantation owner on the planet of Neimoidia.
Vaerganth was the governor of Venaari, and a great source of annoyance for Major Gaevril Daraada during the New Republic era.
Shandria L'hnnar was a young Human female serving in first the Rebel Alliance and subsequently the New Republic.
Celida Noerr was an agent of the Rebel Alliance infiltrating the Imperial Institute of Higher Studies on Ferrhast. There she befriended the ambitious Shandria L'hnnar.

affiliation: Loosely affiliated with the New Republic
x: Sienn Sconn was a male Human thief, hailing from Ryvellia in the Avhn-Bendara system.
Drek Drednar was a pirate roaming the space lanes during the Galactic Civil War, especially the Carto Asteroid Belt. His base of operations was based on Taraloon, and his flagship was the Sable III.
Karn Graznor was the captain of the pirate ship, Sable II. He was greedy and did not share the booty fairly with his crew.

Virtrol Devin was a pirate serving under Drek Drednar. Virtrol was Drednar's security expert and also the leader of Drednik's boarding team. Devin was typically armed with a blaster pistol and a vibroknife, and carried a breath mask, comlink, and security bypass kit.

Tron Nixx was a male Human who worked as a pirate, serving with Drek Drednar as his main astrogator. Nixx had an uncanny sense of direction and his navigational skills rivaled even those of Sullustans. This was due to his Force-sensitivity, which he was unaware of.
Chillo Sanpona was a bloodthirsty Rodian pirate, serving first on the Sable II under Karn Granzor, and subsequently on the Sable III under Drek Drednar.

Seely was a female Twi'lek who worked as a pirate during the Galactic Civil War, serving under Drek Drednar with whom she was also quite infatuated. Using her natural charms and skills learned from her youth, she became a very successful and well-liked part of Drednar's crew.

Quammo was a Sludir majordomo working for gangster Guttu the Hutt around 0 ABY. At that time, Guttu said he had not moved by his own means since at least 150 BBY, which explains some of Quammo's responsibilities.

Qesya Vth'naar was a female Sludir. She was the mate of Rokarn Vth'naar, and the sister of Quyik Vth'naar. During the early years of the New Republic, she was a slave of Moff Kentor Sarne, and was later a member of the crew of the FarStar.

Quyik Vth'nnar was a male Sludir, brother to Qesya Vth'naar and slave of Moff Kentor Sarne in Kal'Shebbol. Sarne forced both of them, as well as Qesya's husband Rokarn Vth'naar, to fight as gladiators.
Rokarn Vth'naar was a male Sludir, husband to Qesya Vth'naar and slave of Moff Kentor Sarne. He was slain in gladiatorial combat by his brother-in-law, Quyik Vth'naar.
This Skakoan was an Elder of the Power Mounds on the planet of Skako.

Laspevar was the leader of the Taloraanian Denfrandi tribe during the Galactic Civil War. He was a wise man who preferred peaceful negotiations to violent solutions, and was much respected by his people.
Genogri was the leader of the warlike Wind Raider tribe of Humans on Taloraan.

"Speedy" was the nickname of a Sullustan pilot in the Rebel Alliance who served aboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence during the Galactic Civil War. He was called Speedy by the other pilots as they could not pronounce his real name.

Slugga was the Queen of the Gorphs. She was looking for a wife for her son Vork, and had decided that she wanted him to marry a princess. When she saw Latara, she decided that she was the Ewok that her son should marry.
Vork was the Prince of the Gorph's tribe on Endor, and son of Queen Slugga. He, at one time, intended to marry the Ewok Latara, believing her to be a princess.
Chla C'cHaan, also known as Chal Haan, was a Duros who led a number of his species in colonizing the planet Neimoidia around 25,000 BBY.
Omze'kehr Kahr, known as Omze was a Sludir and the older brother of Quintik Kahr.
Hoban was captain of the transport ship Star Dream. The jizz band Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers were transported to Tatooine by Captain Hoban.
Yin Vocta was a male Anomid businessman on the planet Lianna. He was the enigmatic owner of Bantha Traxx and the long-term friend of Kaylo NaKuda. He was also a crime lord.

Lott Kemp was a male crystal merchant from the planet Dodz. Through the Intergalactic Droid Agency, Kemp acquired C-3PO and R2-D2 as servant droids. However, before they arrived, Kemp came under pressure to pay heavy taxes to the corrupt Governor Kugg.
Althon was a Human male who lived on the planet Dodz. In 15 BBY, as the Head Councilman of the Citizen's Council of Dodz, he tried to stand up to the governor, Kugg, who imposed heavy taxes.
San Hill was a Human male and the Chairman of the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the Rebellion era.

Captain Loftus later joined the New Republic Intelligence Service, still based on Tatooine. By 12 ABY, Loftus led a recovery and incarceration team to recover survivors from a raid by New Republic agent Kyle Katarn on an Imperial Remnant recruiting base on the planet.
An unnamed senator represented Bilbringi in the New Republic Senate.
Maana Demknot was a male Duros who resided in Anchorhead on Tatooine during the Jedi Civil War.
Dayso Cooh was a male Duros conservationist on Tatooine who complained to Czerka Corporation about their attempts to kill a whole tribe of Sand People in 3956 BBY.
Ben Hu'al was a male Sith student at the Sith Academy on Korriban during the Jedi Civil War.
Suskafoo, or Foo to his friends, was a pale green Verpine.
Bastila Shan's father was a Human male and was known to have been a treasure hunter. Bastila had a good relationship with him.
Lucos Dannt was originally a headmaster at the Naboo Royal House of Learning.

Lialla Tane was a member of the Naboo Underground resistance group established after the Trade Federation's Invasion of Naboo. Her parents had been captured and held prisoner by the Trade Federation. Her father, Kyu Tane, was the Naboo Minister of Culture.

Kyu Tane was a Human male who was the Naboo Minister of Culture around the time of the invasion of Naboo. He and his wife were arrested by the Trade Federation troops, but their daughter managed to escape and join with the Naboo Underground.
Savor Kibbs was a Human male and Force-sensitive who was rejected for Jedi training by the Jedi Council.
Ruto Graven was the Assistant Minister of Internal Affairs for Queen Amidala.

Ela Sivel was a Naboo artist. She was arrested by the Trade Federation during their Invasion of Naboo. She eventually participated in a prison break along with some captured agents of the Naboo Underground. She appeared to be generally pessimistic about the entire situation.
Boraso was a Human male and a member of the Royal Naboo Security Forces.
Lagra was a Hutt who lived during the Old Republic era.
A member of an unspecified felinoid species with brown hair and yellow eyes, she was a proficient commando and a skilled slicer.
Bendak was a Human male criminal, who was tracked by the bounty hunter Boba Fett on the planet of Sathiemon. Bendak tried to hide in a deep hole in the ground, but Fett located him.
Yarr Gatonne was a Human male working as an independent bounty hunter in the Testarr sector during the Galactic Civil War. He had been trained by his father, Resh Gatonne, also a bounty hunter.
Terrlarn was a male Gotal mercenary active some time before the outbreak of the Galactic Civil War. He was the first notable kill by the Tiss'shar gunslinger Uul-Rha-Shan.
Io Desnand was a Human male Imperial Governor of the Aida and Lomabu systems.
