Feebee Desnand was a female Human and the wife of Io Desnand, who served as the Imperial Governor of Aida.
Hannah Balmor was the second wife of Jedi Master Haaran Balmor and lived on the planet Damualer Triac.
D'Lew was a Human male mercenary. He served in the same mercenary unit as Garrett and Darca Nyl. He was killed in a battle over a spaceport.
Tyew Fordrod was a snobbish member of the yellow-skinned Polosich species, and was a passenger aboard the Kuari Princess when it was attacked by the Riders of the Maelstrom.

Parla Tentase was a Kiffar passenger aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess when it was attacked by the Riders of the Maelstrom. Tentase was a "veteran vacationer," and had a vague feeling of strangeness about the voyage.

Saduu Nagag was a male Aplocaph tourist aboard the Kuari Princess when it was attacked by the Riders of the Maelstrom. He was a very fastidious being, who, in hopes of attracting romance, would make an effort to gleam his skin on an almost hourly basis.
Anorad Estuan was a renowned Dactrurian actor. The Estuan Theater aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess was named in their honor.
Evilo Nailati was a B'omarr Monk who lived in Jabba's Palace.
Robbyn Sark was the Roshan delegate chosen to go to Samaria and speak with Bog Divinian, the Imperial governor, about his charges of all kinds against Rosha and its people.
Firefolk was an old male who was part of a resistance on Samaria.
Dinko was the code name of a resistance member on Samaria, fighting to overthrow the Galactic Empire.

Unda Lagor was a male Quara Aqualish who enjoyed violence, murder, and destruction. After serving with a mercenary group, he went on a wild killing spree through a starport on the planet Kal'Shebbol in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Opeli Mors was a female Human member of the newly formed Jin'ri trade syndicate during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Blue Wing was the call sign of a Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot who served in Blue Squadron as Blue Leader Merrick Simms's second-in-command.

Bosk-toth was a minor Quara Aqualish crime lord. He worked from a base in Quantill City, on the planet Ando. Bosk-Toth illegally captured Andoan mineral-fish, selling the extracted sedrellium on the black market during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Calfta Bongi was the Aqualish Head Nurse aboard the Kuari Princess during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Torith was a male Grand Moff in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. He became an important and powerful figure in the Imperial regime by taking control of sectors which were on the verge of joining the Rebellion and bringing them back into the fold of the Empire.
Pulsipher was a member of the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders whose fascination with Force artifacts led him to unearth the powerful Sith relic known as the Muur Talisman during the Mandalorian Wars.

Glomkettle Hierogryph was a female Snivvian native of the planet Cadomai Prime and the mother of famed con artist Marn Hierogryph and another son who went on to become an actor. Married to Garl Hierogryph, Glomkettle often had trouble telling her two sons apart.
Morst Tayl'skar was a Bothan from Clan Askar and a Rebel Alliance agent. He was transported to Dressel by Pyrron Nox where he was attempting to contact Orrimaarko.

Sissalik, also known as "Slick", was a male Mon Calamari from the planet Dac. He was enslaved then purchased by an Imperial officer named Farvakine on Tatooine, whom Sissalik later killed by lacing his food with Chuba poison.

This Human Jedi was present at the briefing led by Obi-Wan Kenobi prior to the First Battle of Kamino. He flew a Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor with a team of other Jedi as the starfighter defense of Kamino.

A Shistavanen Jedi fought on Kamino, when the Separatists invaded the planet. The Jedi fought on the side of the Republic alongside a group of clone troopers in the corridors of the Security Sector Six.

Dhas Fenoep Vedij was a Human male member of the Vedij family, and a naval officer who served the Galactic Empire until he led a mutiny aboard the Far Orbit, after which he became a privateer and commander to the Rebel Alliance.

Terra Derida was a female Phindian. She was the sister of Guerra and Paxxi Derida and the daughter of Duenna Derida. She was also a member of the Syndicat on Phindar and the assistant of the crime organization's leader, Baftu.
Uran Lavint was a female smuggler from Bespin during the Second Galactic Civil War. She owned a ship called the Breathe My Jets.

Baftu was the leader of the Syndicat on Phindar. He was in league with Prince Beju, who had stripped his people of bacta, and was going to get some from Phindar to look like a hero to the people of Gala.

Duenna Derida was the mother of Terra, Guerra, and Paxxi. After Terra had been memory-wiped, the girl had turned dark. She had forgotten completely who she was. Working for the Syndicat ensured Duenna residence at Syndicat headquarters, where she remained to watch over Terra.
Gavele Lemora was the head of the Ministry of Intelligence for the Corellian system during the Second Galactic Civil War. She was a middle aged Human woman with a round face.
Mal Hyb was a Human employed by crime lord Jabba the Hutt as an assistant to the mechanic Barada. In 4 ABY, she worked on Jabba's sail barge with Barada in the hanger of Jabba's Palace.
A male Poldt named Fanta was a spectator of the Boonta Eve Classic in 32 BBY. at some point during the event he bickered with Jar Jar Binks.
This Human Jedi fought in the Battle of Jabiim during the Clone Wars.
Aurin Leith was a Human female doctor who served as a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
The Supreme Strategist was a high-ranking official of Mandalore and a Clan Chieftain. He was of an unknown species, and commanded a Keldabe-class cruiser.
Teehl was a mercenary and pirate. She wore a battle-scarred but well-repaired black and gold spacesuit. Her faceplate was polarized but her voice over the comlink sounded melodious.

Hume was a Rebel pilot and spy shortly after the destruction of the first Death Star. After a long reconnaissance mission with Princess Leia Organa, their ship was forced to enter Imperial space in need of supplies.
Rbann was a Kubaz Imperial spy who worked directly for Blackhole, the shadowy Director of Imperial Intelligence.
Choyd was a male Selonian who was a member of the Freelies gang on his homeworld of Vorzyd V during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Anduvil was a female Ogemite who worked with the Rebel Alliance as an intelligence operative. While working for the Rebels, Anduvil stumbled upon a mysterious outbreak of Bledsoe's disease that appeared to be connected to the destruction of nearby Rebel outposts.
Calus was a worker at the Port Tarkin forced labor camp on Phelarion.
Sparv was a worker at the Port Tarkin forced labor camp on Phelarion.
Nardo was the chief of Lady Tarkin's security forces at Port Tarkin on Phelarion.
Qua was the chancellor of the Zenox Star Cluster circa 1 ABY.
Mzerc was the husband of a former Imperial senator.

Shea Hublin was a renowned Human male pilot of the Galactic Empire known as "the Rebel Destroyer." Born around 35 BBY, Hublin grew up on the planet Talcene before joining the naval forces of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars at the age of sixteen.
Greldo Farnor was a Khil from Belnar, working as a droid parts merchant on Alderaan. After the destruction of Alderaan, he became an anti-Galactic Empire terrorist and pirate.
Mira Volz was a Human female who was the daughter of the inventor Renn Volz, both inhabitants of the planet Little Kessel. Mira assisted her father from a hidden lab within the Giant Fungi Forest.

Tana was the proprietor of Tana's Resort on the planet of Rion. An acquaintance of Han Solo, Tana opened her resort as a refuge for the people of Rion when the world was devastated by the Imperial-commandeered Ionic Ring Ship, which rendered Rion a frozen wasteland.

Stafuv Rahz served as a major in the Imperial Military during the Galactic Civil War. A Gektl male from Hoszh Iszhir who later betrayed his own people for power as an Imperial, Rahz maintained his planet's shield system, which was used to protect the world from greedy magnates…

Kova Naan was a male Lannik who was a member of the New Osler Flejj Beasts, a Pugil team on the planet Lannik. His teammate, Rolsat Noviee was exposed as a Clawdite changeling 22 BBY. Afterwards, Naan quipped even his reporter could be Noviee in disguise.
Barada M'Beg was the legendary Klatooinian leader who signed the Treaty of Vontor for Klatooine and its people, some time around 25,100 BBY.
Hasek was a Sith officer of the Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War who served at the Sith Embassy in the capital of the planet Manaan, Ahto City.
The Mandalorian Guard Captain was a Mandalorian of clan Ordo. He could be found guarding the entrance to the Neo-Crusader compound on Dxun.
Amel Bakli was an Imperial governor who ruled over the Core World of Caprioril, a normally tranquil planet.

Grendel, the great space slug, was the antagonist of Rogar Farnoster's seminal work The Slug Named Grendel. He was the target of Flandon Sweeg, a spacer who sought the great slug in its home in the Borkeen Belt.
Flandon Sweeg was a male character in Rogar Farnoster's The Slug Named Grendel, published by TriPlanetary Press sometime after 22 BBY.

Harravan was a Hapan pirate who had kidnapped and murdered Kalen, Isolder's older brother. After spending nearly two years on the fringe, the prince tracked down and arrested him with the purpose of interrogating the pirate to find out who had hired him; however, Harravan was …
Fuffle was a Hoojib who accompanied Plif, C-3PO, Chewbacca and several other Hoojibs into a tunnel under the Alliance to Restore the Republic base on Arbra to look for R2-D2.
Phoggus Maxx, or Phoggy, also known as The King of the Back Alley Deals, was a con man roaming the back alleys of Nexus City on Entralla, looking to make profitable deals with shady characters.
a: The King of the Back alley Deals

x: Reina Gale was a female Human swindler and deal maker residing on Entralla in the early days of the New Republic where she and her friend Rollos were always on the look to strike deals with anyone who could pay them.
Rollos was a Gigoran swindler, and friend and business partner of Reina Gale. Together with Gale, he roamed Entralla hunting for shady business deals of various kinds.

Neddoo was an Ewok who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, the Ewok Teebo, who was being affected by a loonee bird, threw a bundle of reeds at Neddoo's hut as the former was attempting to repair it, destroying the structure.
Mentis Qinx was a mechanic on the planet Tatooine. There, he owned a docking bay where he extended credit to those who needed it, requiring large fees in return.
Estral was a male Etti who worked as a gamemaster in the Mos Espa Grand Arena for Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine.
Asha was a female Human who lived on the world of Naboo. When Obi-Wan Kenobi met her, he sensed something special about her, indicating a possible Force-sensitivity.
Koris Haslam was a Human male and the leader of a commando group serving within the Rebel Alliance. His impressive reputation as a commando was known throughout the Rebellion's military.
Captain Mantrony was a female Bakuran naval officer who served under Admiral Hortel Ossilege. She commanded the Namana-class light cruiser Watchkeeper.

Bril Parry was the chief duty officer assigned to the communications station on board the MC80a Star Cruiser Naritus. Together with Rogue Squadron pilot Wedge Antilles, Parry witnessed the destruction of Thanta Zilbra during the Starbuster Plot.
Falco, ostensibly "Captain" Falco, was a male human high-ranking officer in the Human League serving Thrackan Sal-Solo during the First Corellian Insurrection.
Illyan Webble was a Human male and the president of Seraphan Industries.
Rooty was a Cragmoloid gambler that frequented the casinos on Nar Shaddaa. He was also a moderately successful smuggler, traveling onboard the CRX-Tug Solar Grazer.
Vandolae was a Shi'ido and a Senior Anthropologist in the Galactic Empire, employed at a university on Coruscant.
Vik Idd was a Human male who worked alongside his sister Nikki and father Lonn in the business of droid repair during the Imperial Period.

Napvansa Tadavv was a female Sluissi who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic and served as an expert engineer on starships during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 ABY, Tadavv was on the shadowport known as StarForge Station.

Tem was a member of the Mandalorian Protectors guarding the captured bounty hunter Dengar in 3 ABY. When C-3PO cut the rope holding Dengar's cage, Tem and his fellow guard were knocked out as the cage landed on top of them.

Nikaede Celso was a female Wookiee who was the companion of Drake Paulsen. She was 2.4 meters tall, which was large for her species. She was also very clever and a talented technician. She was patient and diligent, but did have a tendency to whine during a crisis.
Xad was a Falleen who was a minor aristocrat. On a quest of sorts to see the galaxy's wonders, the Falleen was on the space station known as StarForge Station in 0 ABY.

Pao-Neh-Lo was an experienced Tiss'shar pirate. She was cold-hearted and showed little mercy but was highly disciplined and would follow a strong leader to the end. Like most of her species, she wore no clothes apart from a tool harness from which she hung weapons.

Melenna Seltrayne was a female Human who served as a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. She grew up on the streets of Ord Mantell, and was recruited into the Alliance following a botched attempt to pickpocket Koris Haslam.
Gowan Ch'lessan was a Human male slicer and a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A male Wookiee from Kashyyyk, Liak joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic when his friend and hunting partner Zherriak was killed during an Imperial slave raid of their homeworld.
Lhojugg was a male Nimbanel who worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure in the Hutt's town house in Mos Eisley. He was the cousin of Mosep Binneed.
Saris Uli was Director of the University of Sanbra's Hall of Biological Research. He was interviewed by HoloNet News in 22 BBY regarding the infestation of stone mites on Ord Tiddell.

Shimrra Jamaane's brother was the twin of the Yuuzhan Vong Shimrra Jamaane who would become Supreme Overlord of the Yuuzhan Vong empire. Twins were very uncommon in Yuuzhan Vong history, with only three documented sets of twins in the entire existence of the species.
Teluron Thacker was a member of a species that hailed from the planet Eeyyon. He was the contact for the Jedi on Korriban, who was to give them information on the whereabouts of Granta Omega.
Auben was a black market dealer on Korriban who lived inside the abandoned Sith Monastery.
Entora Zar was a Hapan native of the planet Terephon where she served at Villa Solis, the private hunting retreat of Ducha Galney.

Living windmill was the nickname Han Solo gave to his first opponent in The Big Game on The Wheel. This opponent was a tall, muscular Ultaarian Greenback with pink skin except for on the neck, shoulders, and skull, all of which were covered in green scales.

An individual encased entirely in plates of silvery armor with only a glass-encased brain and yellow-goggled eyes visible was in a relationship with a furry female individual, and the two were sometimes seen at Locru's Central Saloon.
Pig-face was the nickname Han Solo gave to a sapient, brown-furred, bipedal primate he accidentally bumped into during a brawl with Warto at Locru's Central Saloon.
Rorf Willems was head of the Ministry of Defense for the five worlds of the Corellian system during the Second Galactic Civil War. His voice was 'gravelly' and he was said to act like a thug.
Selby Sel Jarrad was a female Human native of Averill and a New Republic Intelligence agent.
Willoc was a Royal Naboo Security Forces sergeant during the Galactic Civil War. He was tasked to investigate the Old war bunker, situated just outside Kaadara, that was overran by the Skaak Tippers.
Brak was one of the bodyguards of Prince Isolder during the time of the Second Galactic Civil War and wasn't fond of Jedi like many other Hapans.
Gwad Raatu was a male Rodian police officer with the rank of detective in the Coruscant Security Force. He was sent to investigate the death of Jedi Master Tresina Lobi.

Chal Tozr was the male Bith police officer who worked for the Coruscant Security Force with the rank of detective. He, along with his partner Gwad Raatu, were sent to investigate the death of Jedi Master Tresina Lobi.

Galney was a Hapan female noble and the Ducha of Terephon. She was a member of the Heritage Council, a group who wished to overthrow Hapan Queen Mother Tenel Ka Djo. The Heritage Council was inadvertently assisted by Galney's younger sister, Lady Galney, a loyal aide to Tenel Ka.
Whelmo Darb was a dark-skinned Human male who served as a sergeant in the Galactic Alliance Guard.
Beta Ioli was a female Duros Junior Lieutenant in the Galactic Alliance Guard who was a part of the crew of the Anakin Solo.
Barsoulentinial Enkhet was a Human male pilot who served as a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

The Mother Queen was a female urnsor'is who lived on the planet Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War. A spacer was hired by two Wookiee members of the Myyydril tribe to kill the beast, and this spacer was successful in this mission.

Briessen was a male Human and a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served as a commander in the Rebel SpecForces. He was Koris Haslam's superior officer, and assigned Aurin Leith to Haslam's team for a mission to Selnesh.

Tanogo was a male Bith Chief Petty Officer. He had served in the New Republic Defense Fleet prior to Ben Skywalker's birth, and later in the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet before joining the Galactic Alliance Guard as part of the crew of the Anakin Solo.

Moreem Espara was a female Hapan Major in the Hapan Royal Guard. She was sent by Queen Mother Tenel Ka to serve as Jacen Solo's command liaison and advisor onboard the Anakin Solo when he went to arrest Ducha AlGray.
Roh was a female Hapan officer under Moreem Espara.

Orlopp was a male Jenet and lieutenant of the Galactic Alliance Guard onboard the Anakin Solo during the Battle of Hapes. He served as Darth Caedus' administrative aide, and was described as being 'cheeky.'

Twizzl was a Human male commander of the Galactic Alliance Guard, the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances covert police force led by Colonel Jacen Solo. A silver-haired native of the galactic capital world of Coruscant, he spoke with a Coruscanti accent.
Meala was a female Hapan doctor who gave Allana Solo a special weapon that had a poison that lasted until the antidote was given.
Gim Sorzo was the male Twi'lek gunner on board the Rover during the Second Galactic Civil War. He went under the name Spacer First Class Sorzo.
Blatta was a Hutt who Uran Lavint owed credits and was her co-pilot onboard the Breathe My Jets when she was running a large shipment of smuggled supplies to the Corellians.

Ebbak was a female Human who was a civilian employee in the Galactic Alliance military. After observing her skill at data analysis, Jacen Solo asked her to leave her position on board the Anakin Solo to serve as his personal assistant.

Miagi Baker was a Human living on Jubilar. He married Incavi Larado, but died shortly afterward. Although it was suspected that Incavi was behind his death, there was never sufficient evidence to prove she killed him.
Tegg was an Ugnaught member of the Peace Brigade during the Yuuzhan Vong War serving on Esfandia Long-Range Communications Base.
Ace was the nickname Han Solo gave to a Human contender in The Big Game. Ace was not a Corellian. He had long, brown hair, pale skin, and wore a silver bodysuit.
Big bruiser was the nickname Han Solo gave to one of his opponents in The Big Game. The big bruiser was a hulking green humanoid. He was felled by a blow from Chewbacca.
Persistent was the nickname Han Solo gave to one of his opponents in The Big Game. Persistent was a red-skinned humanoid who persistently tried to shoot Han Solo.
Tuz was a tall, overweight Mon Calamari pirate and trader who operated during the reign of Emperor Palpatine.
Dera Jynsol was a wealthy, eligible woman living on Ord Pardron during the early years of the New Republic. She was one of the top five candidates chosen by Lando Calrissian to marry.
Lady Lapema Phonstom was a wealthy, eligible woman living on Kabal during the early years of the New Republic. She was one of the top five candidates chosen by Lando Calrissian to marry.

Madame Boble was a Bakuran female and an acquaintance of Gaeriel Captison. She took on the task of looking after Gaerial's daughter Malinza Thanas while Gaerial was away with the Bakuran fleet during the First Corellian Insurrection.

Lady Corwell was a Bakuran female and an acquaintance of Gaeriel Captison. She aided in the task of looking after Gaerial's daughter Malinza Thanas while Gaeriel was away with the Bakuran fleet during the First Corellian Insurrection.
Skud was a red-skinned humanoid henchman of Jabba. He accompanied the Hutt to Orleon, but was killed in a blaster fight with Han Solo and Chewbacca.
Uri was a male Gotal who worked as a bouncer at Merl's, a cantina in the Old Town of the spaceport Muracie on Centares during the Imperial Era.
Glocken was a male Sakiyan who worked as a bouncer at Merl's, a cantina in the Old Town of the spaceport Muracie on Centares during the Imperial Era.
Fortune was a Human male from the planet Corellia who served as a commander in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Natala Vanden was a female Vorzydiak who served as President of Vorzyd V in 1 ABY. With her planet buckling under heavy gambling taxes levied by the Galactic Empire, Vanden began secret dealings with the Alliance to Restore the Republic, becoming their high-level contact withi…

Stalnus was a Riorian male. He was an anomaly among his species as he preferred settling an argument with violence, rather than with calm reasoning. Much of his criminal career was spent in the Tendo system, where he managed to elude capture by authorities.

Mordran was a male Wookiee employed by Borvo the Hutt during the early years of the Galactic Civil War. After a lot of hard work, he became one of Borvo's champions. His next mission was to go to the Gungan Sacred Place and wipe out a group of Gungan traders that crossed Borvo.
Trynic was the Devaronian male pilot and owner of the modified YT-1300 light freighter Solar Flare.
Pash Galae was a young and overconfident Human male who spent his childhood on the planet of Utrost, near the planet Coruscant.
An unidentified Deck officer was a crewmember aboard Admiral Mils Giel's flagship, the Helmsman. His duties appeared to be carrying necessary equipment to different areas of the ship.
Mako was a Human male musician who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was part of a band that performed in the Bright Jewel system, playing the nalargon.
Knave Three was the callsign of a male Human pilot serving in the New Republic Starfighter Corps during the later stages of the Galactic Civil War.

Nakaron was a Trandoshan criminal who was wanted by the New Republic for assassination and murder of New Republic personnel, assault on New Republic personnel, theft of New Republic property, reckless endangerment, and manslaughter. The reward for his capture was 60,000 credits.
A Togruta Jedi youngling was onboard a J-1 shuttle when Cade Skywalker and Shado Vao left Ossus.
A female Jedi Master lived sometime in the years between 800 and 200 BBY.
A male Jedi Master served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Golden Age of the Old Republic and was responsible for the training of Jedi Vima-Da-Boda.
Deppo was a native of the planet Eriadu who served as an Imperial Calibration Engineer on board the World Devastator Silencer-7 during Galactic Emperor Palpatine's attempted reconquest of the galaxy.
The horned priest was one of the High Elders of the Order of the Sacred Circle on Monastery. He accompanied the green priest and Domina Tagge to Yavin 4 to bring Luke Skywalker to Monastery.
A Jedi Master was a member of the Jedi Order around the time of the conclusion of the New Sith Wars in 1000 BBY.

Worra was a womp rat who lived during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. Prior to the Battle of Yavin, the Human male Boelo, a henchman of the crime lord Jabba the Hutt, owned Worra as a pet.

Dielo was a Human female who was nearing middle age and served as Jiliac Desilijic Tiron's majordomo on Nar Shaddaa during the first years of the Galactic Empire. She had red hair and an appearance that Han Solo found striking.
This Nautolan Jedi youngling was onboard a J-1 shuttle when Cade Skywalker and Shado Vao left Ossus.
Gondry was an Abyssin mercenary and partner of the Sakiyan bounty hunter Djas Puhr.
Sabodor was a male Rakririan, one of the few to leave his homeworld of Rakrir.

Raskta Fenni was a female Echani who lived before the Jedi Civil War. She was considered one of the greatest duelists of her time, and many Echani foils were crafted in her honor. Unfortunately, they were mass-produced and lacked quality, often breaking in combat.

Lord Warsheld personified his Houses conservative outlook. He carefully steered Calipsa through the many crises that arose after the fall of the Old Republic and the instillation of the New Order through astute business deals and careful fiscal management.

Jono Dunn was a Galacian male who lived on the planet Gala, serving as an attendant to the Queen Veda in her royal palace. He had been raised in a family that had been loyal to the Beju-Tallah dynasty, and would always serve them.
Veda was the queen of Gala, and the mother of Prince Beju.
Namrhe was originally from Bestine IV but became a nomad when the population were driven from their homeworld by the Galactic Empire and joined the Rebel Alliance soon after.
Omin-Oreh was a pilot in the Rebel Alliance, originally from a star system at the bottom tip of the Outer Rim. He spoke rarely, and was soft-spoken when he did.

Benald Orlan was male human criminal who was wanted by the New Republic for treason, espionage, accessory to murder of Alliance to Restore the Republic and New Republic personnel, accessory to theft of Alliance and New Republic Property as well as accessory to destruction of a…

Ral Shawgrim was a turn-coat Rebel technician, who was wanted by the New Republic for treason, espionage, and theft of Alliance and New Republic material. The New Republic had issued a bounty of 35,000 credits on his head, and he was also hunted by the Imperial Remnant.
The voxyn queen was the name given to the genetic template for all of the voxyn, Jedi killing creatures created by the Yuuzhan Vong.

The Alzoc III Food Commissioner gave food to the miners of Alzoc III. He was farming multiple shaaks when Tyber Zann and a squad then killed ten shaaks and brought their skulls and spines to him to intimidate him into doing their bidding.

Sha-Mar Ma-Dred was the King of Kashir. He had four wives: Tiarri, Kheann, Mirrix and Ashala. Shortly before the First Battle of Geonosis the King and his wives traveled to Coruscant to meet with the Jedi Order and discuss Kashir's admittance into the Galactic Republic.
Oweg was a male captain serving in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. He commanded the Valiant.
Mister Mxil was a Mon Calamari refugee from Dac who found sanctuary on Port Haven where he operated the only tavern, Haven's Water.
Vleen Argoe managed the Shvash Gas Cooperative located at Gelgelar Free Port on the planet Gelgelar.
Beta Omega was the designation for one member of the Rebel Alliance.

Karak was the male Sedrian bishop of war. He wore a blue armband with an engraved broken shell pattern. He was power hungry, wanting the Golden Sun to himself, and was the leader of a group of renegades. He had a daughter, Fala, and a pet razort, Tooch.

The Guardian of Mount Tantiss was a Force-sensitive assigned by Emperor Palpatine to guard his storehouse at Mount Tantiss on the planet Wayland. According to the Psadan, the Guardian sought control over the natives of Wayland.

Redding was a male Nautolan captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He directed Alliance operatives to take out dark troopers during the Battle of Restuss.
This Mandalorian Commander was a Humanoid male Mandalorian who led a small unit of Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders in the lower Shadowlands of Kashyyyk during the Jedi Civil War.

Faarl, called "Faarl the Conqueror" or "The Child Conqueror", was a male human pirate, slaver, and warlord who managed to conquer several low-technology planets in Wild Space before his twentieth birthday.

Reddjak was a member of the Red Fury Brotherhood, and the captain of the Blood Brother. A pirate of near-Human blood, Reddjak worked for the Galactic Empire in its early years, but eventually operated independently around the planet of Majoor.

Voakar Duset was a Neimoidian on Mustafar some time during the Galactic Civil War. He spent his time lingering around a camp of Mustafarian miners on strike, although his reasons for doing so were uncertain.
Thulls was an Ithorian who owned and ran the Slippery Gelgelar Eel dining establishment at the Gelgelar Free Port on Gelgelar.

Loro Ecls was a male Sullustan who managed the Gelgelar Free Port on the planet Gelgelar with the assistance of his large family. They lived in a warren of water-tight tunnels dug underneath the settlement.
Elam'shak was a Twi'lek member of the Clan Shak and was the brother of Koh'shak, Troa'shak and Wrou'shak. He served as the Fan Master at the Kala'uun Starport.

Mal'aa was a Twi'lek female who owned and operated Mal'aa's Kitchens at the Kala'uun Starport on Ryloth. She had been outcast from her original clan and cooked meals for spacers to earn enough credits to survive.

D'rag was a starshipwright and the co-owner of Starshipwrights and Aerospace Engineers Incorporated along with their partner Vinda on the planet Oslumpex V. In 2 BBY, Corellian smuggler Han Solo owed them 2,500 credits for their work on his starship, the Millennium Falcon.
Elarles was a Human male waiter at a tavern located in one of the Imperial energy mining facilities on Circarpous V.
Troa'shak was a Twi'lek member of the Shak clan and was the brother of Koh'shak, Elam'shak and Wrou'shak. He served as the Water Keeper at the Kala'uun Starport.

Benni was a young pack tracker at the Kuat Passenger Port. Using a repulsorcart, he would offer his services as a porter to passengers moving through the space station. Extremely knowledgable about the Port and its working, Benni was friendly and chatty with his customers.
Con'varra was a Twi'lek from a city on the planet Ryloth who was sold into slavery to the enslaving lord Quintik Kahr.

Reina Solov was a Professor of archaeology at the University of Byblos during the Imperial Era. Solov specialist area of study was ancient cultures and during the Galactic Civil War investigated the Fellowship of Kooroo religion.

Trauger was a bounty hunter. While pursuing a bounty on Socorro, Trauger threatened to kill an Ibhaan'I woman if a member of the tribe would not lead him to his bounty. The woman's son, Oceke, agreed to aid Trauger if he would let his mother go.
Jid'yda was a male Bothan who served the New Republic as an admiral during the Galactic Civil War.

Futor was a Sullustan infochant who operated Futor's Network onboard Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport. He was shorter than the average Sullustan. His eyes were squinted from long period of time looking at datascreens.
Shal'mak was a wealthy Kian'thar from Shaum Hii who was wife to a derlac herder and fanatical crime lord of the Black Sun.
Sergeant Nethius was Darknon Station's customs official and security guard.
Selnia Gergeroe was a female Imperial Customs agent on the planet

Colclazure was an ensign and a tractor beam officer on the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Chimaera during the Thrawn campaign. The tall man was responsible for the training and supervision of the tractor beams' crew, and was stationed on the bridge of the warship.

Deen Voorson was a Human male Rebel Alliance technician who helped in the evacuation of Hoth and was a friend of Voren Na'al. While on Hoth, he was one of the technicians who converted the T-47 airspeeders to the cold.
Mavis was a young Human female child who participated in the evacuation of Yavin 4. She had a brother named Tarn.
Tarn was a child who participated in the evacuation of Yavin 4. He has a sister, Mavis.

Earnst Kamiel was a Human male Alderaanian who disagreed with his homeworld's pacifist stance during the Galactic Civil War. This led him to establish the Justice Action Network (JAN), with the parents of Jan Ors.
Maber Yeff was a male member of the Peace Brigade. In 26 ABY, he led the scout party that searched the Jedi Praxeum for Jedi students during the Peace Brigade attack there.

Halm was a male Human member of Talon Karrde's organization and was assigned to go to Yavin 4 with Karrde, Shada D'ukal, and Ferson to protect the Jedi students. He was shot and killed by a member of the Peace Brigade as they blockaded the Yavin system.

Opur was male individual who served as security officer on the Wild Karrde in 26 ABY during Talon Karrde's mission to rescue the Jedi trainees from a Peace Brigade attack at the Jedi Praxeum on the moon Yavin 4.
Eager to rob the convoy of starships that accompanied Zell, Reddjak launched torpedoes at the ambassador's ships, but Llez and the droids were able to self-destruct the weapons from Reddjak's vessel.
Llez was the son of Ambassador Zell of Majoor who purchased the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO. During his diplomatic mission to Armath, he ordered the droids to serve as tutors and companions to Llez.
Poy was a male Twi'lek slave of the Yuuzhan Vong on the moon Yavin 4 alongside the Jedi Anakin Solo in 26 ABY.

Daric LaRone was a human male instructor within the 501st Legion of the Empire of the Hand born on the planet Copperline. While serving on the Reprisal, LaRone became unsatisfied as a stormtrooper to the Galactic Empire after being ordered to massacre civilians on Teardrop.
Hallomar was a reclusive big game hunter and the de facto governor of the smuggling retreat on Port Haven.
Rexis Lovech was the controller at the Darknon Station during the Galactic Civil War.
Olev Madak was a Duros mechanic who worked at Darknon Station during the Galactic Civil War. He repaired starships and indifferently maintained the space station.
Zareb Syn was a Human male who was the the father of Jariah Syn and an associate of the space pirate Rav, who appeared to respect the man, and confessed to being in his debt at one time.

A Bith Jedi was present at the Jedi Temple during the Yinchorri Uprising and played a role in helping the Jedi Council. He was present during the Raid on the Jedi Temple and was one of the Jedi who fought the Yinchorri there.

Sedriss was a Twi'lek slaver. The right-hand Lieutenant of Zarien Kheev on Tatooine, Sedriss operated an Imperial slave prison. He met Boba Fett on Tatooine, who reported that he had downed Rianna Saren's starship and showed a hologram of its wreck.
Dirin Maj'o was a member of the New Republic Relief Corps stationed on Ithor. Dirin was present on the world when it was attacked by the Yuuzhan Vong.
Vilhona was the Aquar leader of the Sisters of the Crimson Mark vigilante group opposed to Nexcore Mining Corporation operations on the planet Velusia. She was slender and had blue-green skin.
Smalyun was a male Human captain in the Bank of Aargau Security's customs division during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Chiba was the pet of Aron Peacebringer, a powerful warlord of the Calian Confederacy, during the era of the Galactic Civil War. A large crocodilian creature, Chiba was often by Peacebringer's side in his palace on Shiva IV.
Vomak was a male reptilian who lived on Tatooine in the twilight years of the Galactic Republic. By 32 BBY, he worked at the Grand Arena of Mos Espa.
Nandi was a Human female who worked at House Naberrie's retreat house, Varykino, in Naboo's Lake Country, during the years leading up to the Clone Wars.
Domo Jones was a young Human male nerf herder from Tatooine who successfully helped the Alliance to Restore the Republic by sabotaging an Imperial purchase of proton torpedoes.
JillJoo Jab was a female Twi'lek waitress who worked in the Mos Espa cantina during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
Bowman Gavin was a Human male pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance and later the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Magris Quill was a male Anomid criminal dealmaker.
Slythor was a Squib crime lord and owner of the R4-series agromech droid R4-B11. He worked from a base on Korad during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Shiri'ani was a Twi'lek and the owner of the Lucky Star casino in Mos Entha. She was a protégé of Lady Valarian.

Termo was an Imperial admiral during the Galactic Civil War. He was the commanding officer of the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Liquidator in 0 ABY. His ship arrived in the Yavin system after the Death Star's attack on Yavin 4.
Tix was an Imperial Communications Officer during the Galactic Civil War. He later defected to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Skeezer was an Imperial captain during the Galactic Civil War. Skeezer was dispatched by Admiral Termo to the Yavin system to determine the fate of the first Death Star in 0 ABY. There, he was shot down by Rebel forces and captured.
Yara was a Human female pilot in Kyp's Dozen at the time they attacked the Yuuzhan Vong shipwomb at Sernpidal in 26 ABY.
Celia Durasha was a female Human native of Lankashiir and the sister of Raine Durasha, one of three brothers, and was a member of the Durasha family. She was nicknamed Crimson by Detien Kaileel.
Voralla Morbo was female Human who owned the Thyferran cantina Morbo's Place. She was sympathetic to the Rebellion, helping transport bacta and keeping a docking bay clear for them.

Reha Logg was a light-skinned and dark-haired Human considered a fashion victim. During a night in 22 BBY, Logg visited the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall in the Uscru Entertainment District of the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.
Abso Bar Binks was the son of Jar Jar Binks.
Guff was a Gamorrean guard that worked at the Plastoid Pitt.
Guff was a male Gamorrean guard that worked at the Plastoid Pitt.
Plurra was a Vratix slave that worked at the Plastoid Pitt.

Cathea was a young Human female whose parents went to Ylesia as "pilgrims" with her. During the Battle of Ylesia, which took place during the Galactic Civil War, Cathea and other children such as Kryss P'teska, Aeron and Tym were abandoned by their parents, who had been enthra…

Chertyl Ruluwoor was a female Selonian sent to Corran Horn's CorSec unit for training under a cultural exchange program. In the traditional leadup to the annual CorSec Officers' Ball the younger Horn got to know her, eventually taking her to the event.
Spid was a Rodian bounty hunter who worked with a Human woman and a Whiphid.
Sedan Anang was a male xenobiology professor who accompanied author Rogar Farnoster when he was writing his book The Slug Named Grendel.
Nofre Ecls was an Sullustan who ran Nofre Repair Bay at Gelgelar Free Port on the planet Gelgelar. She was the sister of Loro Ecls who managed Gelgelar Free Port.
Glovan Thule, more commonly known as the Wise Man of Kooroo, was a male Human who lived on the world of Gelgelar around the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Golben was a Jillsarian who worked as a technician onboard Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport during the Galactic Civil War.
Seeker was a Twi'lek male who ran scrap and salvage operations at the Kala'uun Starport on the planet of Ryloth during the Galactic Civil War.
Wrou'shak was a Twi'lek member of the Shak clan and was the brother of Koh'shak, Elam'shak and Troa'shak. He served as the Wind Master at the Kala'uun Starport.

Galle was a Clone Lieutenant who served in the the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 19 BBY, they were stationed on the planet Felucia and served alongside Jedi General Aayla Secura.

"F'quallix" was the alias of a Nalroni male spice-jacker active in 10 ABY. Well-known for numerous crimes, "F'quallix" nonetheless shied away from excessive violence during jobs, and often employed local muscle.
Tao was a Human male from the world of Shumari who trained as a Jedi Knight. He was part of a small group of Jedi that avoided Order 66 and the immediate decimation of the Jedi Order.

Tains was a Human male who served as captain of the bulk cruiser Cerebus in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. He was part of the Corrupter Task Force that was assigned to locate the Defiance Task Force.
Jak was a male Human TIE pilot who served the Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Nemlix was a Human male captain of Vigiliance, an Imperial Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that formed part of the Corrupter Task Force. He was assigned to locate the Defiance Task Force.
Kraven was a Human male who served as commander of the CR90 corvette Badlands during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, he was assigned to Corrupter Task Force and later became an admiral.
Linder was commander of the CR90 corvette Malice assigned to the Corrupter Task Force.

Ollender was an officer in the Imperial Navy during the time of the Galactic Civil War. They were the captain of the Assassin-class corvette Kraken, which had been assigned to the Corrupter Task Force around 3 ABY.
Morg Nar was a Houk strongbeing employed by the Cloud City crime lord Wonn Ionstrike.

Voss Parck was an individual who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire's navy, commanding the Venator-class Star Destroyer Strikefast. While leading a scouting party on an uncharted world, Parck encountered the Chiss warrior Mitth'raw'nuruodo.
The Great Zorbak was a holographic gymnast that performed acrobatics in a circus on Lumpawaroo's holographic table. She was introduced by the Ring-Master.

Sorn was a Chiss male pilot who served the Empire of the Hand. Sorn scouted the Bastion system during the Caamas Document Crisis for signs of Grand Admiral Flim, who was posing as the Chiss Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo.

Mama was an information broker on Ord Mantell. As a member of the Columi species, Mama possessed a large hairless head, which weighed a fifth of her total body weight and was supported by a tiny bipedal body. She had black unblinking eyes.
Grumme Vinn was a male Duros spacer and free-trader who operated during the Galactic Civil War. He was the captain of the Corsa-Vinn, and aided the Rebel Alliance in resisting the Galactic Empire.

This Sith, a Nautolan male, was a member of Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt's One Sith Order. He joined Krayt's Hands, Darth Talon and Darth Nihl, at a skirmish on the planet Vendaxa in 137 ABY where the crew of the starship Mynock was delivering the Fel Empire princess, Mar…

Mortimon Galli was a retired fortune hunter. He owned the Last Stand Casino and was fond of antiques and artifacts. While he showed no allegiance to the Rebel Alliance or the Galactic Empire, he deeply despised the latter.
Lobb Gerido was a Twi'lek who was Jabba Desilijic Tiure's majordomo and valet on Tatooine prior to Bib Fortuna. He was treated terribly during his time with Jabba.
Iguni was a Jedi Padawan around the time of the Clone Wars, having previously trained in Yoda's youngling classes.

Edly "Pot-Shot" Fasalk was a male Human gunner who claimed to have had a major role in several of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's most historical events, including the capture of the Tantive IV, and the battles of Hoth and Endor.

Vegath Tist was a salt-addicted male Arcona and an outcast from his family. A speculator, Tist spent much of his life traveling the galaxy dabbling in get-rich schemes and questionable endeavors in an effort to make a fortune and keep himself supplied with salt.

T'achak T'andar was a male Chadra-Fan with a passion for speed and racing. Originally a design engineer, T'andar found the work boring and became a test pilot for prototype airspeeders and landspeeders.
A male individual held the title Kuat of Kuat, the leader of Kuat Drive Yards, prior to his Kuat of Kuat, and after his own father. His son's mother died giving birth to the Kuat of Kuat.
Zeami was a female Near-Human Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Zoi was a male Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Kern Fallon was a Senior Lieutenant in the Imperial Navy stationed on the Dreadnaught Imperial Destiny based on Teth. He was the aide to Admiral Greelanx.
Commander Rosk was the navigator on the Imperial Dreadnaught Pride of the Senate. He served under Captain Soontir Fel.
Dann Drugah was a shy droid expert who was part of the FarStar crew during the hunt for Moff Kentor Sarne.
Krudar was a male Duros soldier and gunner who served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic, pirates, and the New Republic during his career.
Lak Jit was a male Devaronian information broker, who worked indirectly for Talon Karrde.

"Black-Eye" Cahoon was a male Clantaani criminal who was an associate of the Tatooine gang leader Longo Two-Guns. During his time on Tatooine, he was believed to have played a role in the kidnapping of some of Jabba the Hutt's Twi'lek dancing girls.

Malan Tugrina was a Human male who served as one of Mon Mothma's faithful assistants as well as her bodyguard. His past was full of devoted service to the Chief Councilor. He had a perfect memory, likened to a protocol droid's ability to retain information.

Nima'tar, also known by her nickname Mina, was a female green-skinned Twi'lek scholar, remembered for her theories and writings regarding Hutt society. She was Jabba Desilijic Tiure's personal slave dancer just before the position was filled by Oola and later Leia.
Harris Sanseon was a reporter for HoloNet News. Along with Jedi Masters Dav-Wes Renno and Jocasta Nu, they made a special feature called "Who is Count Dooku?."
Jhordvar was a male Noghri assassin who worked briefly for the crime lord Jabba the Hutt during the Clone Wars.

A Tatooine moisture farmer was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley when Luke Skywalker met Han Solo for the first time in 0 BBY. He was engaged in conversation with one of the Tonnika sisters, whom unknown to him was actually Karoly D'ulin in disguise.

Sone was a female Clawdite and the daughter of bounty hunter Zam Wesell and an unidentified male Clawdite she met on the planet Denon. She disappeared shortly after her mother's death on Coruscant in 22 BBY.

Arvan Carrick was a Human male banker from the planet Phaeda who lived during the era of the Mandalorian Wars. Married to Reiva Carrick and father of five children, Carrick had one son, Zayne, who was accepted for Jedi training at the age of five.
Plakhmirakh was a Noghri male bodyguard in the employ of Talon Karrde's organization and worked closely with the smuggler and information broker's many agents, most notably Moranda Savich.

Dob Moomo was a male Ithorian and the brother of Del. Dob always wore a green scarf, while Del always wore red. During the Mandalorian Wars they worked as bounty hunters (referred to as the Moomo Brothers), although their success rate was low.

Del Moomo was a male Ithorian who served as one half of a notorious bounty hunting partnership with his brother Dob during the era of the Mandalorian Wars. Del always wore a red scarf where his brother Dob wore green.

Chainly was an Imperial captain who assisted Darth Vader on his mission to Samaria in 18 BBY. They tried to track down the slicer Astri Oddo Divinian who was only known under the name "Quintus Farel." When Chainly and his stormtrooper team finally discovered Astri's the secret…

Tourou was a male Ferroan who lived on Zonama Sekot, during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He kidnapped Danni Quee under Sekot's influence. Jacen Solo later persuaded Tourou to take him and Saba Sebatyne to his leader as well.
This unidentified soldier was a native of the planet Solem during the Galactic Civil War, and part of a resistance movement against the planetary Governor, Malvander Bren.

species: Zeltron, with Arkanian and Sephi genes
x: Chantique was a female Zeltron slave who lived during the Mandalorian Wars and eventually rose to become the leader of the Crucible, a massive slaving organization.
Korlo Brightwater, call sign TBR 479, was a Human male who served the Galactic Empire as a scout trooper. Brightwater went on to join the Empire of the Hand.
Saberan Marcross, also known under his service number TKR 175, was an Imperial stormtrooper at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Joak Quiller was a stormtrooper pilot on the Reprisal as of 0.5 ABY. His identification number was TKR 2014. He later became a member of the Hand of Judgment. He was part of Daric LaRone's "party" escaping the Reprisal because of being part of Major Drelfin's death.
Shakko was a Human male pirate. He was the captain of the Cavalcade. Mara Jade killed him and six other pirates when she boarded the ship to find where pieces of art came from.
Tannis was a Human male pirate. He was a member of the BloodScars, a pirate organization active in Shelsha sector.
Caaldra was a Human male mercenary as of 0.5 ABY. He was extremely average in build and appearances and had a bland face, but was a capable fighter.
Thillis Slanni was an Ishi Tib male who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. During the war, he was director of planning for Shining Hope.
Barshnis Choard was the Human male Imperial Governor of Shelsha sector in 0.5 ABY. He had broad shoulders, black hair, and a bad temper. He had a son named Crayg.

Yeeru Chivkyrie was a male Adarian from the planet Shelkonwa in the Shelsha sector. During the early years of the Galactic Civil War, he was the head of a Rebel Alliance organization named Republic Redux.
Cav'Saran was a Human male Patroller Chief of Janusar on Ranklinge during the Galactic Civil War.
Ydor Vokkoli was the Mungra male head of Freedonna Kaisu in 0.5 ABY.
Slak Sagar was a male Human serving with the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Talien was a male Yarkora who played Han Solo in sabacc and lost while on Onadax. He wore several gold rings in his nose.
Ren was a male Givin who played a game of Sabacc against Han Solo on Onadax and lost.

Dantos Vigos was the Chief Medical Officer onboard the Pride of Selonia during its missions to Galantos, Bakura, Onadax and Esfandia. Before the missions, he had two decades of service as a medical officer in the New Republic and the Galactic Alliance.

Selwin Markota was Todra Mayn's second in command onboard the Pride of Selonia during its missions to Galantos, Bakura, Onadax and Esfandia. He was a male Human with a receding hair line, solidly built and an excellent administrator who was good in crisis'.

Comeg was an admiral who served in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. Around 10 ABY, Comeg was commanding a fleet that was stationed in the Core Worlds, and contained a prototype World Devastator, Silencer-7.

Tescia was a young Ferroan girl living on Zonama Sekot during the Jedi's visit at the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. She told Jacen Solo that his grandfather had killed the Blood Carver without the use of a lightsaber.

Enton Adelmaa'j was a male Chiss pilot designated as Twin Eight in Twin Suns Squadron during the Battle of Esfandia. During the battle he helped Jagged Fel with his "surprise" for Grand Admiral Pellaeon to secure the northern flank.

Jocell was a female Chiss pilot designated as Twin Four and one of wingmates of Jagged Fel during the Battle of Esfandia. She was a member of Vanguard Squadron and Twin Suns Squadron for a brief time.

Eniknar was a male Noghri who was the Chief of Security at the Esfandia Long-Range Communications Base. He was believed to be the traitor at the base until he willingly sacrificed his life to destroy an antenna after the console was destroyed.
Idrish was a follower of the Jeedai heresy as a subordinate acolyte and rival of Yu'shaa. A Shamed One, he lived in the bowels of the newly crafted Yuuzhan'tar where he flocked to hear Yu'shaa speak.
V'tel was a subordinate acolyte and rival of Yu'shaa in the Jeedai heresy.
Chreev was a Yuuzhan Vong Shamed One who took the position Shoon-mi Esh held after his attempted assassination of Yu'shaa.
Arth Gxin was a male Human Sergeant in the Imperial Remnant during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Gxin served under Grand Admiral Gilad Pellaeon on the Right to Rule during the invasion.
Fan Gantree was a female Sullustan engineer at the Esfandia Long-Range Communications Base.
Balig was a smuggler who worked for Talon Karrde for many years. He was a turbolaser gunner on Wild Karrde during the Raid on Bilbringi.
Lex was a Human male who operated a syntonium crystal mine on Cirus II in 68 BBY.
Jabba's champion was a pet name for the large humanoid reptilian that was Jabba Desilijic Tiure's champion fighter in 32 BBY.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: Vurrulf was a Klatooinian starfighter pilot in the New Republic's elite Rogue Squadron. While the Rogues were hunting the Invid pirates in 11 ABY, Vurrulf served as a member of the squadron's Three Flight.
Tyresi Gurtt was Captain of Bolt and part of the Khuiumin Survivors.

Crimsol Vaighn was a scientist who worked for the Mummer terrorists during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he was the Chief Scientist of the organization and stationed in the Mummer bunker, the organization's local headquarters, located near Theed.

Jaye Hawkson was a male criminal. He was slightly overweight, bald and had red facial tattoos. Hawkson was a member of the criminal Mummer terrorists on the planet Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.

Furi Nistola was a Planetary Governor for the Galactic Empire. He was given a RA-7 protocol droid by Emperor Palpatine. Once he learned of its spying abilities, he abandoned it and lied about how he lost it.

Fulin Gor was a Human male from Iotra. For many years during the Galactic Civil War, he worked as a member of the Iotran Police Force. Primarily, his role was off-world, pursuing lawbreakers anywhere in the galaxy, apprehending them and returning them to Iotran Space for trial.

Achonnko was a Wookiee Master Trail Guide of the Rryatt Trail, who had navigated the entire trail himself. He helped many adventurers survive the Rryatt Trail, and he always wore his ceremonial armor.

Tarim was a colleague of Arhul Hextrophon who was of the opinion that the loss of Coruscant to the Dark Empire in 10 ABY was a shattering blow to the New Republic. Hextrophon did not share his belief.

Bahni was an associate of Arhul Hextrophon who believed the loss of Coruscant in 10 ABY was a shattering blow to the New Republic. Hextrophon did not believe that the situation was a dire as Bahni believed.
Wholding was a Zabrak Imperial lieutenant who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He participated in the Battle of Restuss.
Karenna Dunnels was a Human female who served as a Royal Naboo Security Forces Lieutenant and science officer during the Galactic Civil War.

Mercious Bragg was a Human male who served as a sergeant in the Intelligence Division of the Royal Naboo Security Forces during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, a section of Theed fell victim to a terrorist attack.

Ivo Laibach was an Imperial Security Bureau-trained CompForce battalion commander. A few months before the Battle of Endor, Zevulon Veers was assigned to be Laibach's bodyguard while he interrogated Rebels captured in a standard police operation.

Kane Griggs was a Human male from the frozen planet of Kerensik in the Botor Enclave. Griggs eventually traveled off-world to attend an Imperial university, where he studied politics and planned on living a comfortable life as an economist.
Marfa Thorbin was a Human female from Alderaan.

Wirartu was a Kerritamba Wookiee, the former Arena Champion. When a village individual completed tasks to help Chief Kerritamba, though, Wirartu became very angered, because he thought that he should have been the one to be honored by completing these tasks.
The Sayormi Queen was the leader of the Sayormi, an evil cult, believed to be ghosts with strange powers that lived in the low levels of the Kkowir Forest, and in the Dead Forest on Kashyyyk.

Dr'xureretue was the owner and operator of Docking Bay 87 in Mos Eisley, a settlement on the planet Tatooine. A member of the Ishi Tib species, he insisted on being called "Drue," as he knew his name was difficult to pronounce by numerous beings.
Kal Lup was a female Shistavanen who owned Lup's Wares and Supplies with her husband Tar Lup. Kal was nice and friendly to customers, but she didn't like anybody poking into her business.
Tar Lup was a male Shistavanen who owned Lup's Wares and Supplies with his wife Kal Lup. Although Tar was generally easygoing, he had an old blaster carbine hidden beneath the counter.
Moplin Jarron was a male Sullustan who ran Heff's Souvenirs at Mos Eisley. He bought the place when Heff died.

Heff was a male Lepi who emigrated to Tatooine on one of the original colony ships that settled the planet in the early period of the Galactic Empire. There, he set up a shop known as Heff's Souvenirs, which he ran with his daughter Tebbi.
Norun Gep was the Whiphid co-owner of Gep's Grill at Mos Eisley. He met Fillin Ta, his partner, in jail when they were streeturchins. They remained friends even since.
Fillin Ta was the male Whiphid co-owner of Gep's Grill in Mos Eisley. He met Norun Gep, his partner, in jail when they were street urchins. They remained friends even since.

Omon Gantum was a male Quarren who ran the Spaceport Express service at Mos Eisley on Tatooine. After starting to smuggle illegal goods delivered by Norun Gep and Fillin Ta, business had turned to be very good for Omon.

Trommer was an human male admiral under the command of Grand Moff Lynch Hauser and was the father of Ranulf Trommer. He saved his son from being shot by Hauser by "accidentally" bumping into the Grand Moff, throwing off his shot.
Jubel was the Devaronian clerk who aided Cornelius Evazan at the Cutting Edge Clinic at Mos Eisley.
Cyrans the Unfeeling was usually found near the entrance to the Dead Forest in the Kkowir Forest on Kashyyyk, and, as his name implies, he could not feel, which suggested he was dead.
Voldez was a female Chiss captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She participated in the Battle of Restuss.
Klork was a male Bothan captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He participated in the Battle of Restuss in 1 ABY.
Romer was a male Nautolan lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He participated in the Battle of Restuss in 1 ABY.

Jeng Seth was a male Human and the leader of The Skulls, a swoop gang that menaced the Hook Nebula. He founded the Skulls on Stend VI when he was seventeen years old, having became tired of simple thievery and intimidating frightened store owners.
Mavikk Jumka was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto gang member and criminal active during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.
Zeb Maddaan was a male Human member of the Republic Correctional Officers' Union in the years before the Uprising on Naboo.

Ala Kimbo was a male Human from Corellia who was wanted by the Hutt Clan for unknown reasons. He believed that he could escape the Hutt Clan by masquerading as a prison guard at Desolation Alley. In 32 BBY, Jango Fett claimed the bounty and proved him wrong.
Seer Lonnel was a male Ugnaught engineer who worked for the Helmet Squad in Desolation Alley during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Joth Katrane was a male Human from Corellia who was present at Desolation Alley on Oovo IV during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by someone who cheated him out of his pension by reporting his 'extra' income to the warden.

Klev was the 36th generation of his family to attend a prestigious military academy. He was a high-ranking veteran of the Clone Wars. After the end of the war, he settled on Alsakan and married the heiress of a wealthy trading company. They had a son, Titus.
Maree Yad was a male Dug wanted by Pixelito Grand Council for dealing death sticks to the Gran youth of Pixelito.

Gazurga was a male Dug who worked for Sebolto. He was wanted dead by the infamous podracer Sebulba for betting against him at the Boonta Eve Classic. Sebulba considered him a traitor believing that Gazurga was bad luck to him.

Ixnoltah was a male Dug who worked for Sebolto during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Around 32 BBY, he earned a bounty on his head by the Pixelito Grand Council for dealing death sticks to the Gran youth of Pixelito. His bounty was claimed by Jango Fett.
Lokk Gimble was a male Ugnaught who worked for Sebolto during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

"Rachet" Gramzee was a male Ugnaught who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. "Rachet" might have been his nickname. The Corporate Alliance placed a bounty on his head for stealing a chemical process used in the production of death sticks.

Edderon "Torque" Soth was a male Ugnaught who owed the Ugnaught Mechanics Union over standard time parts in unpaid Union dues. When a bounty was placed in 32 BBY, he was caught by the Mandalorian-turned Bounty hunter Jango Fett.
Ingri was a Human female lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She participated in the Battle of Restuss in 1 ABY.
Olvog was a Human male lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He participated in the Battle of Restuss in 1 ABY.

Lucinta Cal-Meg was the Physics Professor and Student Adviser at the Academy of Carida when Han Solo and Mako Spince were cadets training to become officers. Cal-Meg noted Cadet Solo's innate intelligence and the fact that he had attempted to improve his grades.
Gandl Vorkosigge was Chief Technical Proctor at the Academy of Carida. Vorkosigge participated in the expulsion trial of Cadet Mako Spince.

Horace Wyrmyr was Academy Dean of the Academy of Carida who participated in the expulsion trial of Cadet Mako Spince. Wyrmyr lived in the Dean's Residence and was the seventeenth and final dean to have ZZ-4Z, whom he disliked, serve as his housekeeper.

Palpatine II was an editor and main broadcaster of the Galactic Weekly NewsStack. Not much was known about this individual except that traces had led Imperial COMPNOR investigators to the Outer Rim Territories.
Moff Giiedt was the liaison officer to Tiss'sharl. After his death, his position was taken by Commander Demmings.
Julynn Kentas was the president of Industrial Automaton in 22 BBY.
Kevell was an Imperial lieutenant stationed aboard the Liquidator.
Untrilla was a Delrakkin who aided the Rebel Alliance during the faux Rebel attack on Delrakkin.
Gwann was a male Delrakkin warrior who aided the Rebel Alliance during the faux Rebel attack on Delrakkin. Led by Untrilla, he welcomed a pilot from the Alliance after some convincing by Untrilla.
2249 was an Imperial pilot who was killed during the faux Rebel attack on Delrakkin.

Sten Thanas was an Imperial officer from a long line of military officers (including Pter Thanas). Serving on the Hydra as a part of Admiral Daala's fleet, he was the first mate until the ship's captain was killed in an accident in a turbolift.
Prentiss was a crewmember of the Consular-class space cruiser that crash-landed on an unnamed planet many years before the Battle of Yavin.

Cassander Tadrin was a male Esselian space explorer who discovered a planet in what became the Cassander system one hundred years before the fall of the Galactic Republic. He then went on to form the colony which would expand to become the Cassandran sectors.
Cromag was a large humanoid beast "owned" by Mosh Pelkan. He was two and a half meters tall, with huge eyes with overdeveloped shoulders and arms. He was described as having a shape like a "V".
Squik was a member of an underwater dwelling sentient species who lived in an Underwater Kingdom on the forest moon of Endor.
Oran was the chief communications officer onboard the Adamantine when it was infected by the Death Seed plague in 13 ABY and as a result, she died.
Gasto was a midshipman serving the New Republic Navy onboard the Adamantine when it was infected with the Death Seed plague in 13 ABY.
Cho P'qun was the Chief Engineer of the Adamantine when it and its crew were infected with the Death Seed Plague in 13 ABY.
Ioa was the Captain of the Borealis when it was infected with the Death Seed Plague in 13 ABY.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: Ssyrmik was one of Chief of State Leia Organa Solo's Honor Guard during her meeting with Seti Ashgad, where she died of the Death Seed Plague. She was a female Lieutenant, a graduate of the New Republic Space Academy, and sometimes made Leia feel as if she were old.
Gshkaath was one of Leia Organa Solo's Noghri bodyguards along with Ezrakh. He died of the Death Seed plague when the Borealis was infected with it in 13 ABY.

Bliss Shargael was an Imperial Moff. With the disintegration of the Empire following Galactic Emperor Palpatine's death at the Battle of Endor, in the leaderless vacuum, the title of “Warlord” was hijacked by power-hungry Imperials of nonexistent integrity.
Greglik was a handsome Human male pilot who flew for the Rebel Alliance during the early days of the Galactic Civil War.
Cotetchtle was the Ishi Tib quartermaster aboard the Free Lance.
Arvid Scraf was a male Human who lived on Nam Chorios. He may have been of Alderaanian or Corellian descent and was six or seven years younger than Luke Skywalker.

Gin Scraf was a Human female who was one of the earlier settlers of Nam Chorios. She was the aunt of Arvid Scraf and lived during the Galactic Civil War. Living in Ruby Gulch, she influenced the Newcomers in order to help Luke Skywalker get a job in Hweg Shul.

Gerney Caslo was one of Ruby Gulch's water sellers on Nam Chorios and the cousin of Booldrum Caslo. He fixed many water pumps the Therans left to rot. He was shot when taking down cannon at Bleak Point Station in the aftermath of Bleak Point Invasion.
Umolly Darm was one of the Newcomers on Nam Chorios.
Booldrum Caslo was the cousin of Gerney Caslo. He was a neep and the owner of one of the largest libraries in Hweg Shul on Nam Chorios.
Tinnin Droo was a Newcomer living on Nam Chorios as of 13 ABY where he owned a machine shop which included a smelter.

Nap Socker was a Newcomer employed as a smelter worker on Nam Chorios in 13 ABY. When Luke Skywalker used the Force while stranded there, accidentally creating a Force Storm, Nap and his employer, Tinnin Droo, were severely burned when the smelter overturned on them.
Bortrek was a male Human and the Captain of the Pure Sabacc.

Sandro the Hook was a criminal who bought stolen goods. He was a junk dealer living on Celanon who had past dealings with Captain Bortrek. Occasionally, he would sell them for high prices to willing buyers with a large amount of money.
Vowluss was a Whiphid drop point agent on Ropagi II.
Snaplaunce was a male Ithorian and a member of the Hweg Shul Municipal Police. He and his partner Grupp saved Luke Skywalker from near death at the hands of Taselda's followers.
Grupp was a fat male Human and a member of the Hweg Shul Municipal Police. He and his partner Snaplaunce saved Luke Skywalker from near death at the hands of Taselda's followers.

Croig Jacamden was a male Duros and the owner of Croig's Fix-It Barn in the capital city of Hweg Shul on Nam Chorios. While on Nam Chorios in a search quest for Callista Ming in 13 ABY, Luke Skywalker took up work as a mechanic at the Fix-It Barn for a short time.
Gayman Neeloid was a S'kytri musician who wrote the song The Sound of Her Wings.
Igpek Droon was a male Human small-time trader raised by Agro-Militants.
Yarbolk Yemm was a male Chadra-Fan reporter for the TriNebulon News and was investigating Loronar Corporation.
Tuuve was a female Gotal and the Chief medical officer onboard the Lycoming.
Be was a Force-sensitive Human male Theran Listener who worked as a healer.

K'inn was a warlord of the Silver Unifir on Pedducis Chorios who entered into a contract with Admiral Daala for one and a half billion acres on Pedducis for her and several thousand former Imperial settlers to colonize and live as they saw fit.
Myrette "Rette" Davani was a Human female, the daughter of Nils and Haryette.
Mogurk was the commandant of the Coruscani Pilot Institute around 0.5 ABY.
Haryette Davani was a Human female. She was the wife of Nils and the mother of Myrette. She lived on Beheboth and thought that Shira Brie was "a snob." She cooked harza cake.
Nils Davani was a Human male. He was the husband of Haryette and the father of Myrette. Living on Beheboth, he appeared to be a former military pilot.

Tahbotza was a male Dug who worked for Sebolto during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by the Malastare Special Service for attempting to blackmail members of Senator Ask Aak's staff.
Gre'ento was a Human male who made his home on an unnamed forested planet, where he worked as an information broker.

Ghazdik Jah was a male Dug who was employed by Sebolto during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he, along with Mazanga, was wanted by Senators Ask Aak and Aks Moe for the murder of special assistants to the Malastarian Senators.

Jahrunba was a male Dug under Sebolto's employ during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted for being one of three Dug brothers, the others being Nahrunba and Sahrunba, who smuggled numerous death sticks to the Gran Youth Council of Pixelito.
Nahrunba was a male Dug who served under Sebolto's employ during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Jenatahza was a male Dug who served under Sebolto's employ during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by the Malastare Special Service for being part of a plot to assassinate Representative Ainlee Teem.

Hexum'Baz was a male Dug who served under Sebolto's employ during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was wanted dead by an anonymous person for unknown reasons. In 32 BBY, the person being quoted said that he just wanted the "worthless" Dug dead.

Zap'Ulga was a male Dug under Sebolto's employ and was also involved with pirate activity and Nexu poaching. He was wanted by Senator Ask Aak for connections to a series of raids on Republic freighters carrying relief supplies to Malastare.
Sahrunba was a male Dug who served under Sebolto's employ during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Mazanga was a male Dug who served under Sebolto's employ who, along with Ghazdik Jah, was wanted by Senators Ask Aak and Aks Moe for the murder of special assistants to the Senators of Malastare. In 32 BBY, his bounty worth 3,500 credits alive and 3,000 credits dead.
Rogh'ma Ixsan was a male Dug who served under Sebolto's employ and was also involved with a crime syndicate called RavinsBlud during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Xucaabo was a male Dug who worked for Sebolto during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was also employed by the Pixelito Puppeteers Union, and was a skilled and well-known puppeteer.

Mawshunba Zee was a male Dug who served under Sebolto's employ during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He also worked for Sesstian Hesser. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by the Galactic Wildlife Liberation Front for the illegal breeding of wild Nexu.
Shish was the communications officer on the Errant Venture as of 19 ABY. His attitude on the job was very casual and uncaring.

Bodwae was a male Laerdocian who worked as a sensor officer on the Errant Venture as of 19 ABY. He spoke with his species' characteristic accent, inserting J's before I's so that, for example, "ship going to get hit" became "shjip gojing to get hjit." He continued to serve as …
C'taunmar was an A-wing commander who controlled the starfighter base on Di'tai'ni. She fought under General Garm Bel Iblis in the Battle of Yaga Minor.
1219 was an Imperial stormtrooper around the year 0 ABY. He was present aboard the Victory I-class Star Destroyer Decimator when it was attacked by 12-4C-41.

Cedo Partu was a pioneer and early settler of Mos Eisley, a town on the planet Tatooine. When Mos Eisley was a boomtown, Partu, a town leader, built a blockhouse that would serve as a fortification against Tusken Raiders, a sentient species indigenous to Tatooine.
"Deadeye" Klintee was a male Clantaani and an associate of Longo Two-Guns. He was wanted by Jabba Desilijic Tiure for murdering three of the Hutt's slaves. This bounty was claimed by Jango Fett.

Ona Kragg was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto who worked for Longo Two-Guns during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Jabba the Hutt for killing four of his own personal staff. The bounty worth 6,000 credits dead or alive was claimed by Jango Fett.

Eela Valotta was a female Twi'lek who was an agent of the so-called "Freedom Convoy" during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Her associate was Tray'la Sheek. She was wanted by Jabba Desilijic Tiure for kidnapping several Twi'leks from the Hutt's personal harem.
Tray'la Sheek was a female Twi'lek who was an agent of the so-called "Freedom Convoy," and was affiliated with Eela Valotta during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Naktu Jeera was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto working for Longo Two-Guns. In 32 BBY, Jeera was wanted by Jabba Desilijic Tiure the Hutt for ambushing a convoy of Twi'leks that were en'route to Jabba's Palace.

Frossk was a male Trandoshan who worked for Longo Two-Guns during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by crime lord Jabba the Hutt for being loyal to Longo. He was captured by Jango Fett who claimed the bounty sometime before the Battle of Naboo.

Jiktha was a male Jawa junk peddler who lived in Mos Espa during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Jabba the Hutt for selling him a faulty droid. Eventually, Jango Fett claimed the bounty on Jiktha some time after the Battle of Naboo.

Noss Prisht was a male Mrlssi who served as an aide to President Gyr Keela of the Mrlsst Academy. In 4 ABY, he introduced Wedge Antilles to Keela and assisted Rogue Squadron during the Phantom Affair.

Kompa was a Human male residing on Mrlsst during the time of the Phantom Affair. He was advising his friend on which history texts to study, as he himself had passed a course on the subject, when an escaped prisoner burst into the room.

Dee Savyest was a male Mrlssi scientist that worked at the Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy during the Galactic Civil War. During the war, Savyest helped design parts that were used in the construction of the Imperial battle station known as the first Death Star.
Dunstal Noft was a male Shistavanen and smuggler. He eventually became a pilot for the Damarind Corporation, captaining a trawler that searched Yavin Prime for Corusca gems.

Grk'Urr'Akk was a Tusken Raider who was active during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he commenced multiple raids on Gardulla Besadii the Elder's outposts. For this, the Hutt placed a bounty on his head of 3,000 credits alive and 1,500 dead.
Oosk Kassa was a male Trandoshan who worked for Gardulla the Hutt during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Jabba the Hutt for killing several of his servants.

Garrolkah was a male Dug who served under Sebolto's employ. He was also a member of the Bazurkah Clan in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Like all members of the clan, he was wanted dead by Bog'Ruhx for supposed slander.

Skahrolta was a male Dug who was a member of Sebolto's clan during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by the Pixelito Grand Council for being a peddler of death sticks to the Gran youth.

Drossk was a male Trandoshan who worked for Gardulla the Hutt during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted alive by multiple entities for questioning in connection to Hutt accounting practices by the Senate Investigative Committee.

Vorkeesk was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto who worked for Gardulla the Hutt during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he had a bounty placed on his head in the same year by Watto because he killed somebody who owed Watto money.

Hakma Kinto was a male Weequay enforcer who worked for Gardulla the Hutt during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was also wanted by the InterGalactic Banking Clan for hijacking a cash transport on Sriluur.
Redge Dunlak was a male Human who worked as a Podracing official during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Kiatha was a male Jawa who was active during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Coruscant Police for mishandling a Ronto, resulting in extensive property damage.
Romi Moola was a female Twi'lek who formerly served Jabba the Hutt during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Gahseelik was a male Trandoshan who disgraced his clan by leaving Trandosha to work for Gardulla the Hutt during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. For this a bounty was posted on his head by Trossilik.
Chandrex Grenn was a male Iotran bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War.
Susejo was the sarlacc of the Great Pit of Carkoon. Formerly a male Choi, Susejo fell victim to the Great Pit of Carkoon on Tatooine before his conciousness was merged with that of the sarlacc.

Selene was Human female who convinced her friend, Dustil Onasi, to join her as a Sith Acolyte at the Sith Academy on Korriban. Regarded by Headmaster Uthar Wynn as an obstacle to Onasi's progress, she was killed on Wynn's orders.

During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, a human artist lived and worked on the planet Naboo. In his studio at the base of an abandoned castle just outside the capital city of Theed, the artist repeatedly painted images of nothing but suns and moons.

Radd Hardwikk was a male Clantaani who belonged to a gang of criminals in Mos Espa led by Longo Two-Guns. He was wanted by Mos Eisley security forces for inciting a riot in the crowds of a podrace by handling and exploding chubas.
Morgana Onasi was the wife of Carth Onasi and the mother of Dustil Onasi.
