Clem "Trigger" Vaneer was a male Clantaani working for Longo Two-Guns. He earned a bounty on his head by Jabba Desilijic Tiure the Hutt because he owed the Hutt sixty percent of a generous loan. The bounty was claimed by Jango Fett, who was able to kill him.

Hyos was a female Codru-Ji doctor on Munto Codru while Chief of State Leia Organa Solo made a diplomatic visit there in 14 ABY. When a pressure bomb had gone off, and the Solo children had been kidnapped and Chewbacca was badly injured, she was the doctor who treated him.
Kirl was the ambassador for the province of Kirl on Munto Codru. He was a male Codru-Ji with a grandiose manner.

Thelaa was a Human female student who attended at the University of Alderaan and worked as a composer of notable skill during the Galactic Civil War. Originally born on a backwater Outer Rim agrarian world, Thelaa possessed short blond hair and overlarge eyes.

Salyer was a composer from Alderaan who lived centuries before the Battle of Yavin. His largely uninspired compositions were forgotten by the galaxy at large until it was plagiarized by the ill-fated student Thelaa.
A female was a diplomat in the New Republic. She had a pet saw-toothed grank.
Adria Reyn was a female Human who, through political maneuvering and corrupt activities, was appointed Moff of the Callia sector of the Inner Rim during the early years of the Empire's reign.
Charis Enasteri was the wife of the Jedi Knight Neth Enasteri.
Nadra Enasteri was the daughter of the Jedi Knight Neth Enasteri and Charis Enasteri.
Lord Sloan Rusper was a well known, experienced hunter from Naboo, and supporter of the Rebel Alliance.

Romort Raort was a sadistic criminal from the planet Irith. Raort eventually joined with the Elaginn gang, a group of spice-jackers, and was responsible for tracking down the spice smugglers from whom the group stole.

Elaginn was the leader of the Elaginn gang, a group of spice-jackers who also included Romort Raort as a kneebreaker. Elaginn met with a terrible accident, jumping out of a window after flexi-pasting himself to a chair.

Linjak Mosa was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, he was wanted by Jabba the Hutt for destroying several of the crime lord's spice freighters.

Keejik Ganz was a male Weequay who was affiliated with Gardulla Besadii the Elder during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. The criminal stole several freighters from the Techno Union who placed a bounty on his head for the crime.

A Human male Jedi lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic and into the reign of the Galactic Empire. A slender, green-eyed man with blond hair, the Jedi fathered a child who became parent to the New Jedi Order Knight Tahiri Veila.

Alisia was a Human female musician who performed with Alitra, O'choa Detera, Mako, and Mestral in the cantinas aboard both Tansarii Point Station and Nova Orion Station in the Bright Jewel system during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Alitra was a female Zabrak musician who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she was part of a band that performed in the Bright Jewel system, playing the kloo horn.
O'choa Detera was a female Zabrak dancer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Mestral was a female Twi'lek dancer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she was part of a band that performed in the Bright Jewel system. The band also included another dancer, O'choa Detera, and three musicians, Alisia, Alitra and Mako.

Anniya was a female Zabrak merchant who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she resided aboard Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above the planet Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.
Serissu was a female Bothan who worked as a pilot trainer for the Car'das.

Morti was the talent agent for Shirley, the Chanteuse of the Stars, a popular singer during the era of the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, Shirley refused to perform at a diplomatic summit on Kabray Station, throwing Morti into a panic.
Roek was an officer in the Starfleet of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Endor, Roek served as an admiral and commanded the Super Star Destroyer Aggressor.
Ranon Djelkh ("Ranny" to his few friends) was a veteran smuggler who aspired to be Tatooine's finest Devaronian crime lord.

Tanda Marelle was a Human female senior reporter who worked for the NewsNet Galactic Resorts shortly before the Clone Wars and during the Galactic Civil War. She was also a master art and jewel thief, called the "Tombat" and believed to be male by the galactic media.

Gretta Spinbalio was a female who worked as a representative of High Inquisitor Halmere's office. She was the official spokesbeing during the case of the discovery of Canna Omonda's affiliations with the Rebel Alliance.

Rall Teedra was the head of Bethal's Commerce Council during the Galactic Civil War. Teedra gave a statement to Colonial News Nets regarding the greddleback termite plague that threatened the planet's apocia trees.

Kemel Trowe was an Imperial admiral who worked with the NAVCOR Command. After the destruction of Alderaan, Trowe spread Imperial propaganda stating that Bail Prestor Organa was working on a biowar program against the Empire and that the destruction of the planet was the only w…

Keenal Dene was a leader of the Alliance to Restore the Republic in its early development. According to a report published on Imperial HoloVision in 1 ABY, Chandrilan senator Mon Mothma resigned from the Imperial Senate and disappeared, although she had actually fled the galac…
Wanda Windrow was a reporter for Galactic Resorts during the Galactic Civil War.

Kermen commanded the defense of Milagro in 5 ABY, fighting the New Republic in a months-long siege. Eventually, Kermen destroyed much of the planet with a Base Delta Zero bombardment to deny its resources to the New Republic before being forced to abandon the system.
Azarin was an Imperial Army general who served the Galactic Empire. Azarin was killed on the planet Lafra in an accident involving a CSPL-12 projectile launcher.
Eyrgen was an Imperial Moff. Eyrgen vied with Moff Utoxx Prentioch for control of the Wornal sector following the Battle of Endor.
Vetter Piin was a non-Human Rov and revolutionary who was aided by Han Solo in overthrowing the Satab who ruled the planet.

Layn Wynest was a Human female crewperson on the Krayt's Honor. She often posed as the ship's captain, despite the fact that the real one was Siqo Vass. It was believed they did this due to Humanocentrism.
Alema was a female Twi'lek who died at some point during the Republic Era. Between 32 BBY and 22 BBY, the Twi'lek Daesha did a ritual which woken up many spirits including Alema.
Naftrat Odarr was a Sullustan research and development officer who, like most Sullustans, originally worked for SoroSuub Corporation.
Magur Torigai was a male Mon Calamari zoologist.
Risha Sinan was a female Human scientist. She lived in the city of Restuss before it was destroyed in the Battle of Restuss.
The Merchant Quarter Guard was a guard on Onderon during 3951 BBY. He was an officer who patrolled the Merchant Quarter in Iziz.
Bregius Golthan was an Imperial Advisor. A massive, but unnaturally lean man, he dressed, like many of the Advisors, in dark robes and a peculiar hat.

Villis Andal was a male Human and the Moff of Elrood sector during the New Order. A young man from a well-connected family, he became lazy in his secure job. Andal promoted the rivalry between his sector fleet's two top captains: Tanda Pryl and Akal Zed.
Deena Kinnet was a wealthy female Human. She worked as a doctor. Later in her life, she became a spy working for the Galactic Empire. She owned Q-3PO.
Kiv'arwa was a male Poss'Nomin explorer who worked for Rim Commercial Mining.
Mindra Nox was a female criminal who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Janqual Mor was the owner of the Coronet Mining Corporation.
Dovor Dowwn was an Aqualish gang leader on Corellia. As he got older, he had to face more and more challenges from his underlings.
Broak Vessery was a male Human TIE fighter pilot who held the rank of colonel in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire.
Telik was a major of the Imperial Army following the death of Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Thaffe was an Imperial drill instructor. He was once a suspect in a murder, but was cleared by Spurch Goa, an investigator for Imperial Navy Intelligence. He became friends with Goa, and after retiring from the military the pair became Sector Rangers.

Halla Ettyk was a Human female New Republic commander and criminal prosecutor from Alderaan who fought against the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. She survived the Death Star's destruction of her homeworld by being off-planet trying to depose a witness.

A male warlord ruled the Ottethan Empire several decades before the Clone Wars. He was known for being autocratic and vulgar. After falling to the dark side, Neema-Da-Boda and her group of friends joined with him, and Neema became his mistress.
Ivo was a communications technician on the Liberator when it was downed over Coruscant. He survived, and detected signals from the incoming New Republic rescue fleet.
Toln ne Yerres was a Twi'lek who worked for Jabba the Hutt, managing the lucrative Holiday Towers in Cloud City on Bespin. He was always accompanied by his Gamorrean bodyguard, Glongfurrp.
Vall Kumauri was a warlord living around 10,000 BBY. That year, the young Kumauri designed and built a line of revolutionary battleships.
Cloak Leader was a TIE/LN starfighter pilot in Grand Admiral Thrawn's fleet circa 9 ABY.

Skids was Esege Tuketu's gunner onboard their K-Wing bomber. He was a bit of a jokester and his mother expected him to be more than a pilot with the New Republic. Skids was killed at the Battle of ILC-905 when he and Tuketu sacrificed their lives to destroy a Yevethan shipyard.
Vor Duull was Nil Spaar's Proctor of Information Science aboard the Aramadia.
Norda Proi was a male lieutenant who served in the defense fleet of the New Republic.

Oolas was the male captain of the Steadfast during Operation Flotsam. He came from a planet that had never been occupied by the Galactic Empire. His species possessed upper tentacles and a narrow neck.
Makki was the operator of DA-1, SM-1 and SM-2 onboard the New Republic ship Steadfast.
Jiod was an officer of the New Republic who served in the tracking team onboard the Glorious when hunting Teljkon Vagabond in 16 ABY.
Taisdan was an officer onboard the Glorious.

Marty was the deck officer aboard the New Republic Defense Force Fifth Fleet flagship Intrepid as staff officer to General Etahn A'baht for the duration of the fleet's deployment in the Farlax sector during the Black Fleet Crisis.

Ji was an individual who lived in the Fallanassi religious order's village Ialtra on the planet Lucazec with the Fallanassi Toma and Norika. Ji also neighbored a girl named Akanah Norand Goss Pell, and the pair were friends.
Toma was an individual who lived in the Fallanassi religious order's village Ialtra on the planet Lucazec with the Fallanassi Ji and Norika. Toma also neighbored a girl named Akanah Norand Goss Pell.

Tanea was the Senior Surveyor onboard the Astrogator-class probe ship Astrolabe employed with the Astrographic Survey Institute in 16 ABY. She had nearly three thousand overflights of star systems during her career yet had only set foot on half a dozen worlds.
Rulffe was the Junior Surveyor onboard the Astrolabe and had nearly five hundred overflights. He had only set foot on his homeworld when the Astrolabe was destroyed by the Yevetha in 16 ABY.

Vol Noorr was a male Yevethan who served as the Primate of the Purity. When the Astrolabe was spotted making a reconnaissance run within the Koornacht Cluster, he ordered his gunners to fire on the vessel.
Negus Nigekus was a male Brigian colonist on New Brigia who was killed when the Yevetha attacked the planet in 16 ABY.

Stanz was the Captain of the cargo hauler Freebird who offered to buy ore cheap from the colonists on New Brigia. Negus Nigekus, a colonist believed him to be a pirate at heart because he gave them very little credits for their ore.
Plat Hovath was the husband of Fall Topas and the father of Plat Mallar. He was stationed on the planet Polneye until his death when the Yevetha attacked it. In life, Plat was a droid mechanic.
Sleeth was a Molavaran gangster, whose mother Magon was the reigning crime-lady of the city Malcraan. He often troubled the local moisture farmer Byrom.
Tere Metallo was a female Riileb free trader.
Armed with a hunting blaster and two concussion grenades, Krendan was also a skilled hand to hand combatant and trained in demolitions and survival.

Maidtha Fait was a gambler who served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Fait was at the Rebel outpost on the planet Taul when the Victory-class Star Destroyer Dominator invaded the world.

Warl Thimbus was a quixotic Jedi serving with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Stationed at the Rebel outpost on Taul, Thimbus led Parody squad when the Victory-class Star Destroyer Dominator assaulted the planet.
K'vin was a male individual who was the disembodied leader of the Most Perfect Order of K'vin, a Tatooine-based cult he claimed was a sect of the B'omarr Order.
The Holy Advisor was aware of her infidelity, and hoped to ruin her with this information and put her in the king's disfavor.
Grollo was a female Twi'lek lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Solum'ke was a female Weequay bounty hunter and the mate of Diergu-Rea Duhnes'rd. At some point, she, along with Duhnes'rd, participated in a treasure hunt on Zelos II while vacationing there.

Diergu-Rea Duhnes'rd was a Weequay bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War, and the mate of Solum'ke. A devoutly religious being, Duhnes'rd preferred to take low profile bounties with a high chance of success, building up a reputation as one who excelled at his trade.

Huegu Eib was a Sullustan farmer who founded Gryseium Incorporated. Eib later sold to Rigis Corazon after finding that the policies of the New Order made it difficult for non-Humans to run an honest business.
Gar Stazi was a male Duros admiral serving in the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet at the time of the Sith–Imperial War, as commander of the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet.

Pol Temm was the male Kel Dor administrator of the Wheel as of 137 ABY. He had spent most of his life on the station, working on a number of posts from a casino bouncer to become the leader of the station security.
Janq Paramexor was Guildmaster of House Paramexor, a house of the Bounty Hunters' Guild.

Bequin Fobas was a Nimbanel attorney, and was considered famous during the Separatist Crisis. Fobas worked for the Hutt crime lord Zorba Desilijic Tiure, and on the date 13:3:21, Zorba was convicted of illegally mining ulikuo gemstones, which were prized for their aesthetic, i…

Farvakine was a male Imperial officer and water merchant on the planet of Tatooine. At some point, Farvakine bought the Mon Calamari slave Sissalik, and treated him cruelly. Sissalik later killed him by poisoning his food with Chuba poison, which triggered a deadly stroke.

t: Unidentified Jedi (Brink of the Celestial Wake)
x: A green-skinned individual was a male Jedi who served the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.
After the Jedi expedition aboard the Jade Shadow fled from the Battle of Bastion, they arrived in Yaga Minor.
Magon was the mother of Sleeth and was the reigning crime lord of Malcraan, a city on Molavar around the time of the Invasion of Naboo. She, along with her son, routinely terrorized local farmers.

Tooth was a native Molavaran leading a convoy of settlers on Molavar. Upon arriving on Molavar, former mercenary Darca Nyl journeyed with Tooth's convoy for some time. Later, Darca called upon Tooth's people to help a local homesteader, Byrom, from a criminal gang led by Magon.
Iona Retter was once a loyal servant of the Galactic Empire who eventually grew to see her belief in it shattered and so became a spy for the Rebel Alliance and later the New Republic

Arundel was a Moff in the Galactic Empire who discovered that Iona Retter was a Rebel spy. It was because of this that she had to leave her position in Imperial Intelligence, and so she vowed revenge against Arundel.

Ai-Ari Kuldi was a Jedi who served the Galactic Republic during the time of the Clone Wars and became the commander of the Republic's Fifth Fleet. During the conflict, the Cularin system seceded from the Republic and became a sovereign star system.

Lisstik was a male Kamarian Badlander who served as a leader for his people in 2 BBY. That year, Corellian smuggler Han Solo and his Wookiee partner Chewbacca visited the Kamar Badlands while repairing their starship, the Millennium Falcon, and Lisstik traded with the pair of …

Tonas Vueral was a male Tunroth. As a Tunroth Hunter, he attained the high rank of chirlan (nineteenth), and was a renowned tracker. He often worked in the Anthos sector, home to many Tunroth on worlds such as Berchest.
Engret was a male native of the Corporate Sector who was a member of Rekkon's group searching for missing loved ones.
Ihu Niopua was a male senator who served in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Grif was a male officer who served in the New Republic Defense Force during the Galactic Civil War. In 16 ABY, he was the Director of New Republic Fleet Intelligence, but by 25 ABY, was succeeded by Ayddar Nylykerka.

Josala Krenn was the partner of Kroddok Stopa and an archaeologist with the Obroan Institute for Archaeology. She along with her partner were sent to Brath Qella to excavate the Qella culture in order to learn more about the Teljkon Vagabond.
Garch was a captain with the New Republic who served on the Marauder and later was reassigned to the Glorious.
Hierko Nochet was a male Babbet adventure guide and one-time acquaintance of Lando Calrissian. He was bested in sabacc by Lando in 15 ABY.

Taisden was a New Republic officer onboard the Glorious. When Colonel Ejagga Pakkpekatt volunteered to search for Lando Calrissian, Lobot, C-3PO and R2-D2; Taisden, along with Pleck and Bijo Hammax, volunteered as well.

Pleck was a Lieutenant with the New Republic and was an agent with the New Republic Intelligence Service. He was sent to serve on board the Glorious under Colonel Ejagga Pakkpekatt in the search for the Teljkon Vagabond.
Ors Dogot was a male Human and former Captain in the Imperial Navy.
Sojis was a Lieutenant in the Grand Imperial Navy. They served onboard the Bloodprice until its destruction at the hands of the Teljkon Vagabond.
Eelen Li was a Triffian who hailed from the planet Triffis and worked as a senator in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic.
Cligot was a Yeoman onboard the Bloodprice in 16 ABY.

Po Reggis was a male Human agricultural technician in the city of Griann on Teyr and the husband of Jiki Reggis who had lived on Teyr for twenty-eight years when Luke Skywalker and Akanah Norand Goss Pell arrived searching for the Fallanassi in 16 ABY.
Jiki Reggis was a female Human who was the wife of Po Reggis.
Ton Raalk was a male Yevetha and the Proctor of Giat Nor in 16 ABY.

Lieutenant Warris was a Corellian recruiter with the New Republic on Coruscant during the Black Fleet Crisis. When he and his supervisor turned down Plat Mallar, they both received an earful from Admiral Ackbar.

Bowman York was male Grannan who served in the New Republic during the Black Fleet Crisis. He served as Plat Mallar's flight instructor on Polneye until he perished when the world was invaded by the Duskhan League.
Jojo was a pilot with the 24th Bombardment Squadron, and used the designation Red Four during the Battle of Doornik-319.
Dopey was a starfighter pilot who served in the New Republic. In 16 ABY, Dopey was killed in action while piloting a K-wing in the Battle of Doornik-319.
Pacci was a male pilot who served in the New Republic's Fifth Fleet.
Nooch was a New Republic pilot killed at the Blockade of Doornik-319.
Brakka Barakas was an elder of New Brigia. Brakka taken as a hostage by the Yevetha during the attack on the Brigian colony of New Brigia.

Liekas Tendo was a Morath mining engineer hostage. Tendo was taken by the Yevetha during the attack. Along with the other hostages taken during the Yevethan Purge, Tendo was forced to record a message begging the New Republic not to fire on Yevethan ships carrying prisoners.
Tal Fraan was a male Yevetha, unusual in his xenophobic society for his interest in the attitudes and behavior of other species.
Kol Attan was a male Yevetha who served as the proctor of defense for the spawnworld.
Barth was a lieutenant and flight engineer in the New Republic Defense Force.
Arik Stijhl was a Human male who served in the Republic Navy and later as a Field Commander in the Rebel Alliance.
Anselme Miclyne was a male Verpine who served as a technician aboard the Hearst, working for Freedom Galactic News. He was known among the rest of the crew for smoking cigars.

Murble was a poor Human beggar and street-corner animal trainer who wandered through the corridors and bazaars of the Southern Underground on Coruscant. He was a small man with pale skin from years of underground living. He had dark patches under his eyes and a sickly appearance.

Fierce was a female bursa, domesticated and trained by Coruscant street-corner animal trainer Murble. Fierce was sickly and stooped with age, with dirt and garbage stuck in her matted fur, ribs showing through her skin, and surrounded by a cloud of floater fleas.
During the Battle of Kathol System, Brannij arrived to protect Kathol from the New Republic attack, led by Bothan commander Kursk Mal'ia.
Crystalboy was a past employer of Boba Fett and one of several galactic big shots who owed Fett favors.

Abam Tev was a female Imperial governor of a poor, outlying system. Kuat Drive Yards outsourced production of the A-9 Vigilance interceptor to her world and Tev ran her shipyards without any concern for the welfare of the workers.
Arndall Lott was a Human male, born in 48 BBY on the planet Kwenn. Lott joined the Imperial Army where he showed considerable aptitude for walker operations.

Shasheva Astopone was a wealthy, dark-haired Human female, well respected among high society. The Astopone family became prosperous in the export business, and Shasheva was the heir to the family fortune.

Migg was assigned the task of "verifying the loyalty" of all citizens on Coruscant, which he attempted to do by haphazardly and unexpectedly conducting inspections of various homes, businesses, starships, or even random citizens encountered on the street.

Brin Hesk'l was a Human male adventurer and treasure hunter who lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic. Around the time of the Clone Wars, Hesk'l investigated the temporary disappearance of Cularin system from the galaxy.
Brivyl Goss was a male Human, a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire, who served in the remote Belgaroth star system.
Surl was a Human customs agent for the Cormond spaceport on Brentaal IV. He had a red trimmed beard, was heavy and rotund, and seemed to be perpetually sweating.
Ryk Osentay was a male reporter for "Eye on Cularin," a Cularin Central Broadcasting program.

Elan Sel'Sabagno, also known as Elan Sleazebaggano, was a male Balosar death stick dealer on the planet Coruscant during the Separatist Crisis. A chance encounter with Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and his mind tricks resulted in Sel'Sabagno deciding to take up a more honest life.

Bezz Drexx was a male senator in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He received bribes from Passel Argente's uncle who was affiliated with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Homuhr was a male Aqualish who worked on the Rig in the Stenness Node during the Clone Wars.
Riun Riev was a male Sullustan engineer who worked for Incom Corporation around the time of its nationalization by the Galactic Empire in 1 BBY.
Jaysa Namoor was a media critic and the president of the Core World Critics Association in 22 BBY. She was known for heavily criticizing summer holofilms.
Ytavarg Aleema was a Keed from Keedad who was a member of Rebel Alliance Intelligence working as a Foster Agent.
Erg Krow was a male senior Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Great Sith War.
Miko Beski was a commando who participated in various missions in the service of Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Jorin was a Human male living on the planet Coruscant and worked as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force.
Lu'daal-ud was a Gand findsman from the planet of Gand and the second cousin of fellow findsman Zuckuss.
When Galactic Republic forces met those of Wedd at the Battle of Amaltanna, the Baron remained inside the fortress, safeguarded from invasion.

Keleman Ciro was a Human male from the planet Dolomar. Along with his brother, Noell, he was a member of one of the planet's resistance groups and assisted in the ousting of Imperial forces from his homeworld.

Dasha Defano was a female Wroonian pilot from the planet Wroona. An accomplished flier, Defano was a member of a Wroonian privateer gang before leaving the group after the destruction of a civilian transport during a raid.
Ir'khaim was a male Noghri and the Dynast of clan Kihm'bar.
"Three Tentacle" was a male Quarren living in the Coruscant Underworld in 40 ABY. He helped guard the World Brain.
Kirith was the Imperial Governor of Byss following the Battle of Endor. At some point, he was intimidated by agents of the Zann Consortium.
Marshian was Admiral Pellaeon's shuttle pilot fifteen years after the Battle of Endor. He was stationed on the Chimaera.
Mavron was a lieutenant assigned to the Chimaera around the time of the Caamas Document Crisis in 19 ABY.
Hurati was an Umbaran male who served as a captain in the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, under the command of the former Mandalorian mercenary Ghez Hokan.

Pallas Quintell was a Alliance agent working on the planet Kallistas during the times of the Empire. A former gunner for pirate captain Jondrell Inx, Quintell decided to leave Inx's crew and join the Rebel Alliance due to the depth of his beliefs.

Tarquin Zian was a male Twi'lek smuggler who worked in the times of the Galactic Empire. He was the only crewman of Red Fang. Zian was contacted by Prefect Dengless Rinn of Kallistas, who wanted to make a coup against Governor Linrec.

Sirenas Firil was a novice female bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War. She worked with a small guild out of Port Evokk, but also freelanced. Firil was part of a job to hunt down Alliance agent Pallas Quintell.
Jondrell Inx was a Human male who worked as a pirate in opposition to the Galactic Empire's presence in the Parmel sector.

Governor Linrec controlled a part of Parmel sector during the Galactic Civil War. He operated from his palace on Revkinn V. Linrec fathered a daughter, Cressis Linrec, and he arranged her wedding to Moff Raiss.
Raiss was the Moff of Parmel sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Cressis Linrec was the daughter of Imperial Governor Linrec. Linrec had arranged Cressis' wedding to Moff Raiss. However, disliking Raiss, she ran away with a local pirate, Jondrell Inx.
Dengless Rinn was a male Human official of the Galactic Empire, serving as the prefect of the planet Kallistas. An ambitious bureaucrat with a high opinion of his skills, Rinn coveted a higher rank.
Gawynn Karastee was a criminal psychiatrist who worked in a penal facility on the planet Coruscant.

A Hapan woman became the first Queen Mother of the Hapes Consortium around 4030 BBY. After the Jedi under Arca Jeth defeated the Lorell Raiders, who controlled Hapes and its large population of female slaves, the women of Hapes vowed that they would never again be ruled by a man.
Puddra was a stormtrooper who was assigned to the detention area of the Imperial energy mining facility on the planet Mimban.

Bos was a lieutenant in the New Republic and commander of Bravo Flight, a group of T-65BR X-wing reconnaissance fighters that had escorted the fleet shuttle Tampion before it was ambushed and captured by the Yevetha. Bravo Flight were later debriefed by New Republic Intelligence.
Frekka was a Lieutenant in the New Republic and a flight simulation controller on both Coruscant and the Venture during the Black Fleet Crisis.
Ragsall, also known as Rags, was a Lieutenant in the New Republic and one of the pilots who flew cover for the Tampion before it was captured by the Yevetha.
Jiprirr was a female Wookiee whose mate died while on the hrrtayyk.
Grayyshk was a female Wookiee whose mate died after succumbing to the Yellow-blood malaise after going on a hrrtayyk ceremony.
Tomas was a male individual who was one of the leaders of the Jaliss Group.
Martaff was a male Human Commodore who fought in the Battle of N'zoth.
Poqua was a female Human Commodore in the New Republic and commander of Task Force Gemstone during the Black Fleet Crisis.
Grekk 9 was a male Norak Tull in the New Republic Navy. He was promoted to Commodore just prior to the Black Fleet Crisis, in which he commanded a task force.
Notoganarech was an Elomin who predicted the Rebel Alliance's victory over the Galactic Empire with an Elomic physical calculus.
Voba Dokrett was a Human male and the Captain of the Gorath and a former Imperial.
Frega was the Navigation master onboard the Grand Imperial Navy and former Imperial ship Tobay.
Nillik was the sensor master onboard the Grand Imperial Navy and former Imperial Navy starship Tobay.
Ekand was a lieutenant and the commanding officer at the New Republic's installation on Utharis.
Notha Strome was a male native of Utharis and Depot manager of Starway Services.
Taratan was a Kubaz captive of the Yevetha from Doornik-319. He along with all the other Yevethan captives escaped thanks to the help of the Fallanassi Enara.
Fogg Alait was a male Grannan captive of the Yevetha from Polneye. He, along with all the other captives of the Yevetha, escaped due to the help of the Fallanassi Enara and the Star Morning.
Jara ba Nylra was a Morath captive of the Yevetha from Kojash. He, along with all the other Yevethan captives, escaped thanks to the help of the Fallanassi Enara and the Star Morning.

Cathacatin was a Paqwe from Paqwepori and part of Belezaboth Ourn's diplomatic consul to Coruscant during the Black Fleet Crisis. He was a licensed breeder-keeper of Toko birds and killed all the remaining ones before returning home to keep them from suffering.
Llotta was a Hassarian Captain of the Trenchant who died at Morning's Bell.
Ilar Paqwe was a male Paqwe. He told Belezaboth Ourn not to return home.

Graf was an Admiral with the New Republic and a part of the New Republic Fleet Intelligence during the Black Fleet Crisis. He was questioned about how classified information was sent to him after Belezaboth Ourn turned over a black box used to communicate with Nil Spaar.

Formayj was a male Yao and an old associate of Han Solo and Chewbacca who worked out of Tholatin. When Chewbacca went to rescue Han during the Black Fleet Crisis, he went to Formayj to find information about the Yevetha and the Koornacht Cluster.
Drawmas Sma'Da was a gambler and businessman who ran his own self-developed gambling operation called the Invisible & Ineluctable Casino.
Cheva was a Female Human biologist and part of Doctor Ovolot Qail Uthan's team of scientists who worked on a nanovirus made especially to decimate the Republic's clone army.
Meg Pitareeze was a female Human from Kalarba, the wife of Jarth and mother of Nak. She owned and operated Kalarba Safari alongside the rest of the Pitareeze family.
Jarth Pitareeze was a male Human from Kalarba, the husband of Meg and father of Nak. He owned and operated Kalarba Safari alongside the rest of the Pitareeze family.

An individual served as an admiral in the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Revan's Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War, a galactic conflict between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. The admiral served as commander of the entire Sith fleet.

The Bothan ambassador was the head of Bothawui's delegation to the Galactic Alliance Senate. When a large number of True Victory Party members began to be assassinated by the Galactic Alliance Guard on Coruscant, he withdrew his delegation from the Senate in protest, which all…

Salla C'airam was a Bergamasque and the owner and operator of a high-class cantina frequented by the successful gambler Drawmas Sma'Da. Out of respect for his wealthy patrons, C'airam made sure that no weapons could enter the establishment with the use of his pet ergovores.
Gleed Ontondon was a large creature of unknown origin who was a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild and Guild Council.

Kiran Tatch was a male Tunroth from Jiroch-Reslia. He excelled as a hunter, attaining a high level in the Tunroth Hunters. He later took up bounty hunting and joined the Granse Confederacy, an elite team, with special animosity to the Rebel Alliance.
Foag was a male colonel in the New Republic Fifth Battle Group serving on the Agave-class picket ship Folna during the Black Fleet Crisis under Commodore Turk Brand.
Madis was a captain in the New Republic and the commander of the picket ship Folna during the Black Fleet Crisis.

Threld was a Lieutenant in the New Republic Defense Force who served as a bridge officer on the Indomitable during the Black Fleet Crisis. During the Battle of ILC-905, he took over at the first officer's duty station when Captain Theb Tobbra was relegated to his quarters.
Par Drann was a Yevetha and also the Primate of the thrustship Tholos during the Battle of ILC-905. He failed to protect the installation and died in combat with the New Republic.
Inadi was a female officer who served in the New Republic Defense Forces during the Galactic Civil War and the Black Fleet Crisis.
Dogo was an E-wing pilot during the Battle of ILC-905.
Tuomis was a male field researcher with the Obroan Institute who worked on the planet Maltha Obex and acquired shelter fever during the Galactic Civil War.

Aama was a female Major with Alpha Blue, a group within the New Republic Intelligence Service. In 17 ABY, Aama was one of Hiram Drayson's senior facilitators who informed Drayson the location of the Millennium Falcon.
Lin Prell was a Yevetha and the senior tender of Viceroy Nil Spaar's breederies aboard the captured Executor-class Star Destroyer Intimidator.
Enara was a woman who lived in the Koornacht Cluster, either baseline Human or perhaps Andalese. In 17 ABY, she was captured by the Yevetha and held on the Pride of Yevetha during the Great Purge.
Jarrou was the commander of the Endurance-class fleet carrier Intrepid during the Black Fleet Crisis.
Ssiew was a Captain in the New Republic and the Commander of the Thunderhead. He fought in the Battle of Doornik-319 and in the Battle of N'zoth where he died when the Thunderhead was destroyed.
Sarra Dolas was a female whom Lando Calrissian was attracted to until she sided with Narka Tobb during a Sabacc game.
Narka Tobb was a male individual who was enemy of Lando Calrissian who somehow managed to gain the support of Sarra Dolas.
Salak Weet, also known to the Sanyassan King Terak as the star traveler, was a Humanoid male explorer whose starship crashed onto the Forest Moon of Endor around the year 26 BBY.

Moxin Tark was a Human mercenary and one of the most successful bounty hunters during the Galactic Civil War. The son of two wealthy supporters of the Galactic Empire, Tark could have lived a life of luxury and grandeur in the Tark family estate on his homeworld of Bandonia.

Vensell was a male Moff. During the Galactic Civil War, Vensell was present on board the Valiant, and he commanded a force of ships including the Strike-class medium cruiser Shador that departed the planet Jerijador.
Kutu was a Ho'Din. She traveled to Kirtania to study the plants there.
Gathal Danager was a free-trader during the Galactic Civil War.
Danu was a Human female who was the sister of Queen Sarna of Drogheda, who reigned during the Galactic Civil War.

Parl was an Imperial Security Bureau officer who served in the Investigations branch. Alongside fellow officer Huorne, the pair engaged in a series of gambits against the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Gial Ackbar that made them famous.

Huorne was an Imperial Security Bureau officer serving in the Investigations branch. Alongside Parl, Huorne engaged in a series of gambits against the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Gial Ackbar which made them famous.

Pouquor Elegin was the code-name of an individual working in the Sedition branch of Imperial Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War. Elegin gave orders to Murtan Andes to dismantle system cell Tatooine/3 and relocated to the Al'Nasrl sector.

Murtan Andes was the name of an Imperial Intelligence operative based on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Andes commanded system cell Tatooine/3, and cultivated ties to the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure while on the planet.
Rhanken was a competent captain, who dropped out of hyperspace just outside of star systems and scanned their communications before jumping all they way in.
Hyndis Kogler was a legendary officer in the Infiltration branch of Imperial Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War.

Captain Valton was a New Republic officer and commander of the Xiytiar-class transport Sungrass during the Zsinj campaign. He was tall and tan, and though he looked weathered, Wedge Antilles surmised that the man had several years of fight left in him.

Lowan was the smug student leader of Lara Notsil's training group at New Republic pilot school. He was given the duty of informing Notsil that she had been transferred to Colonel Atton Repness's Screaming Wookiee training squadron for remedial pilot training.

Pilot Candidate Lussatte was female Sullustan and an X-Wing pilot-in-training during the Hunt for Zsinj. She was a member of the training group Gold Squadron under Captain Sormic, along with Lara Notsil and Lowan.

Vox was a female Defel and informant born during the rule of Emperor Palpatine. She matched bounty postings to available hunters to maintain their anonymity. In this way, Vox arranged for an illegally posted bounty to be placed on Narloch.

Geothray Camber was a Sector Plexus technician working in Imperial Intelligence. Camber proposed the creation of the Hyperspace Orbiting Scanner, a device capable of eavesdropping on virtually any computer by bypassing its security systems.
Lindu Sencker was a doctor who headed the team that developed the Hyperspace Orbiting Scanner, using the original proposal of Geothray Camber.
Matt Turhaya was a Human male and the husband of Anii Degarienne as well as the father of their child, Alexandra Winger.
Whistler was a male Ortolan who designed and built Whistler's Whirlpool Tapcafe. He designed the tapcafe around a whirlpool, hoping for an exciting view, while still maintaining a luxurious décor.
Ariela was a Human female from Alderaan who later lived on Tatooine.

Fugo was a Chadra-Fan scientist and a member of Project Decoy. Their task was to design and create a Human replica droid for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The prototype, resembling Leia Organa, met its end at the hand of Bertroff Hissa.

Ilon Drez was a senior admiral in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Drez led a group of vocal admirals who stressed the need for an anti-starfighter ship, believing that the lack of adequate screening vessels contributed to the des…
Major Stoghin Learz was a Kuati officer stationed aboard the Razor's Kiss during its construction at the Kuat Drive Yards.

He complained that "Qatya" made too much noise during her first encounter with a member of the Kuati security aboard the Star Dreadnaught, but was subsequently impressed with her performance as she silently eliminated or incapacitated the rest of their opposition.
Lieutenant Bradan was an officer of Warlord Zsinj.
Deerian was a Human male general of the Galactic Empire's military who served Imperial Moff Glovstoak. The general had a granddaughter who was born in 17 BBY.
Bentro was a Fleet Admiral in the Imperial Navy.
Vor'corkh was a Noghri dynast who encountered Leia Organa Solo, the Mal'ary'ush, in 9 ABY.
The maitrakh of clan Kihm'bar was the leader of Khabarakh's family in clan Kihm'bar during the Thrawn campaign.
Linds was a trooper in the Imperial Army.
Tensiger was an officer in the Imperial Army. During the Galactic Civil War, Tensiger commanded the 6th regiment during the Raid on Picutorion.
Sreethyn was the captain of The Lucky Find around the time of the Battle of Yavin. He was licensed to recover Imperial Navy surplus from waste dumps.
Kanda was a male Human Jedi Master stationed on Ilum in 3640 BBY, when he was killed.
Kanda Farral was a female spacer. Although inexperienced in zero-g operations, she signed onto The Lucky Find, a salvage ship commanded by Captain Sreethyn by lying about her experience.
Hast was a Human male who served with both the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Ten-Abu Donba was a male Talid from Ando Prime who served as a High Priest of the Order of Dai Bendu.

Smekt was a female Noghri who worked as a clerk for Hyperspeed Express on Wayland. Dal Konur used a Force mind trick on her, and impersonating the Jedi Knight Streen, convinced the Noghri to help him in his goals of acquiring cargo and a lightsaber.
Seledrood was a captain in the Imperial Navy who commented about Fleet Admirals. Seledrood died some time after making the observation.

Carlinson was a Moff and contemporary of Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin. Carlinson was believed to be either politically well-connected or extremely competent enough to be able to receive as many as fifteen additional warship squadrons to augment the Moff's Sector Group.
Anselm was a male Human engineer in the Alliance Fleet.

Tomrus was a Human male born on Cloud City. His parents had emigrated there from elsewhere in the Outer Rim decades earlier and worked at Bespin Motors. From an early age he showed an aptitude for gambling, con games, and especially engineering.

Shen was a technician in the New Republic Defense Fleet under Lieutenant Anselm. Anselm selected him to be on the team that Han Solo and Luke Skywalker brought along to the Katana fleet. He was seriously wounded while defending the Katana.

Kline was a technician in the New Republic Defense Fleet under Lieutenant Anselm. Anselm selected him to be on the team that Han Solo and Luke Skywalker brought along to the Katana fleet. He was tasked with restoring the computer systems aboard the fleet.

Svan was a Human male and villager on the planet Jomark. He and Tarm became involved in a dispute over wage payment. Luke Skywalker and Joruus C'baoth sensed the disturbance from outside the house and arrived intending to mediate.
Tarm was a Human male villager residing on the planet Jomark under insane Dark Jedi Joruus C'baoth's rule.

Topas dosLa was an individual who ruled the agriworld Ukio as Overliege during the Separatist Crisis. On 13:4:18, the Overliege and the other world leaders of the Abrion sector chose to secede from the Galactic Republic and join the fledgling Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Tol dosLla was a Human native of the planet Ukio. The eldest son of Gol dosLa, the Ukian Overliege, dosLla served as the spokesman for the government. A capable and renowned politician, dosLla was expected to succeed his father.
Etab Lapha worked as a Quality Assurance Investigator for the Republic Sienar Systems corporation, during the years leading up to the Clone Wars.

The alien leader of the Galactic Spice Mining Guild, Groff Zugga further served as a guild boss on the spice mining world of Mon Gazza during the year 32 BBY. Under Zugga's leadership, the mines were considered second only to the operations located on the planet Kessel.

Maja Fey'ja was a female Majan priestess and queen from Baroonda who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, she hosted podraces in Baroo, for her subjects enjoyed them greatly.

Ni Khess was a Yuuzhan Vong, probably of the warrior caste. He wore vonduun crab armor and had earned the insignia of significant escalation, and he was almost certainly involved in his people's invasion of the galaxy in 25–30 ABY.

Und'l was a stocky male Buzchub with blue fur. He was born on Harrandarr in the Outer Rim Territories. He tended to waddle when he walked, and often perched an oversized hat at a jaunty angle on his head.

Calk Fen was a male accountant in the employ of Jabba the Hutt. He was responsible for maintaining Han Solo's debt file in the years following the Battle of Yavin, which rose from 224,190 credits to more than 1.5 million over the course of three years.
Traeda was an Imperial Grand Moff. He was a rival of Grand Admiral Rufaan Tigellinus, and envied his opponent's quick rise to power.
Vanko was an Imperial Moff during the Galactic Civil War.

Darvon Jewett was the governor of the Boeus sector in the Expansion Region during the Galactic Civil War. Following the death of Emperor Palpatine at the Battle of Endor, the Imperial Military withdrew from the sector, retreating to Coruscant.
Alecs Brellar was a Human male who served in the Imperial Navy.

Can Lar was a Gathi who worked for CoMar Combat Systems. While there he designed the v-150 Planet Defender; however, CoMar rejected it, stating that it was useless and impossible to build. Lar quit CoMar and was hired by Kuat Drive Yards, who produced his design.
Fingal was a small Berchestian man who worked overtly as an aide in Governor Staffa's office, and covertly as a spy for Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Ovkhevam clan Bakh'tor was the Noghri caretaker of the kholm-grass cleansed mountain region on Honoghr during the Thrawn campaign. He walked the lands to make sure the plants were growing, and also kept an eye on the fugitive Khabarakh.

Stavan was an officer under the command of Admiral Galak Fyyar of the Empire Reborn, a faction of the Imperial Remnant. Holding a rank of commander, he was stationed in an outpost located on the planet Kejim around 12 ABY.
Bagitt was a Human male technician in Engine Central of Nomad City on Nkllon.
Vak Somoril was a male Human who served as a colonel in the Imperial Security Bureau. In 0.5 ABY, he was assigned to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Reprisal.

Lishma was a Gotal smuggler who worked for Mazzic. He accompanied the Corellian Myke to the Whistler's Whirlpool Tapcafe on Trogan for what became the first meeting of the Smugglers' Alliance. When Lieutenant Reynol Kosk and his men attacked, Lishma was killed in the firefight.
Reynol Kosk was a male Human who served in the Imperial Army.

Dokus was a member of the Imperial Army. Whilst on deployment to Tatooine, Dokus used a DEMP gun on work droids belonging to a moisture farmer that were denying access to their master's evaporation station.

Harburik was a Human male Imperial stormtrooper lieutenant who was stationed in Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War. He had a good impression of the CSPL-12 projectile launcher. As Chief of Police, Harburik was the face of Imperial law and order in the starport.
Reydon was an Imperial Army soldier who served in the Battle of Keskin manning an E-Web heavy repeating blaster alongside Ohvan.
Ohvan was an Imperial Army soldier who used an E-web at the Battle of Keskin alongside Reydon. Ohvan was killed in the fighting.

Hayvlin was a male commander in the Imperial Army. During the Galactic Civil War, he commanded the All Terrain Armored Transports stationed aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Avenger. He led an assault on an Alliance to Restore the Republic base.

Alton Lochner, born Tiris Warren, was a Rebel Alliance Intelligence officer serving with Eclipse Team.

Gortz served in the Imperial Army. He was the driver of Hammer 3:2, a repulsortank in the Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit commanded by Sergeant Arbmab. He served in the assault on Alliance to Restore the Republic forces on Protazk during the Kwymar Suppressions.

Bannidge Holt was a member of a prestigious naval family and an officer in the Imperial Navy. Earning the rank of captain at a young age, Holt served in Admiral Wullf Yularen's fleet during the Listehol Campaign of 18 BBY, helping to stop pirate and slaver raids on shipping in…

Danos was a Training Lieutenant in the Imperial Navy. Danos lectured on inter-service cooperation between Naval and Imperial Army forces, citing that negative attitudes toward Army personnel was counter-productive. In private, however, Danos had a low view of the Army.
Gaaqu was an Moff serving the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Moff Gaaqu once gave a graduation speech at the Prefsbelt IV Fleet Camp.
Slyssk was a male Trandoshan ship thief, who joined Marn Hierogryph and Jedi Zayne Carrick through their adventures in the Mandalorian Wars.

Harlov Jarnek was an Imperial Moff who governed Tandon sector during the Galactic Civil War. Jarnek graduated from the Imperial Naval College, and was known as a coldly efficient leader.
Nancer was the assistant of Bog Divinian during the Imperial era.

Nek, taking the name from the ferocious battle-dog, was the name of a resistance member on Samaria. She tried to help Ferus Olin by finding information about bribing ministers of Samaria by Bog Divinian. Nek, like her friends, was unsuccessful in doing so.

Cladus Glynn was an officer in the Imperial Security Bureau, and was stationed on Kothlis during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Breezer Nos-Carron was an agent of the Imperial Security Bureau who posed as a drifter who wandered the streets of Mos Eisley. He was stationed to Tatooine after it was learned that Luke Skywalker was a native of the planet.
A Human male was an officer in the Corellian Security Force.

Wadewarn was a smuggler who worked for Talon Karrde on Myrkr. In 9 ABY he was present at the evening meal with Lando Calrissian and Han Solo which was interrupted by the arrival of Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Phalaf was a male non-Human peasant who, along with the Rov Vetter Piin, violently opposed the Satab monarch's rule over Ventooine during the Imperial Period.

Nikki Idd was a Human female who in her youth worked for her father, the droid designer Lonn Idd, aboard his droid repair space station.

Nak was a male Human bartender and owner of the Ardak Point cantina in Kessan's Landing, on Ord Mantell, during the Third Galactic War.

A male Tarnab represented some constituency as a diplomat. He had a pet clodhopper.
A Dug was a diplomat on the planet Coruscant during the time of the New Republic. The Dug had a pet saw-toothed grank.
A long-necked non-Human served as a diplomat on the planet Coruscant during the regime of the New Republic. The individual owned a pet otta.

Bixon was a male member of the Indobok Pirates. He was a former cook along with the rest of the gang, he was forced to work in a crystal mine after Olag Greck framed the chefs for an attempted poisoning of Boonda the Hutt.

Muptupp was a male Human who served under Captain Huba in the Indobok Pirates. Formerly a cook along with the rest of the gang, he was forced to work in a crystal mine after Olag Greck framed the chefs for an attempted poisoning of Boonda the Hutt.

Ripter was a male who served under Captain Huba in the Indobok Pirates. Formerly a cook along with the rest of the gang, he was forced to work in a crystal mine after Olag Greck framed the chefs for an attempted poisoning of Boonda the Hutt.

Plodgett was a servant of the Satabs of the planet Ventooine. A sentient of unknown origin, Plodgett served the final Satab by spying on his wife, Chrysalla. When Han Solo came to Ventooine, Plodgett spied on the foreigner under the Satab's orders.
Luskin Exovar was a male Human scout from Lessuris who retired from the Republic Scout Service in anticipation of the Galactic Republic's downfall.

Odanni was a female Mon Calamari and the proprietor of Fathoms, which was a resort complex in Wildwater City on the planet Dac. She was also a ruthless crime lord who dominated the underworld of Wildwater City.

Chrysalla was the near-Human Tieress of the planet Ventooine for a period during the reign of the Galactic Empire. As Tieress, Chrysalla lived a life of luxury as the favored ward of the reigning annual Satab.
Garron was a male Sullustan pilot under the employment of crime lord Jabba the Hutt.
Vareth was a short female Human pilot under the employment of crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

Pilester Binalie was a Human male who was the father of Corf Binalie, a friend of Jedi Master Jafer Torles, and the owner of Spaarti Creations on the planet Cartao during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Kaori Batta was a Human male and one of the greatest big game hunters in the galaxy. Kaori made a name for himself pursuing the galaxy's most dangerous creatures, often selling live specimens to zoos.
Cohden K'Reye was an infamous, loudmouthed Corellian gambler. He was well-traveled and knew several stories and secrets connected to establishments like Bantha Traxx and Exovar's Emporium.
A Human male with pale skin, orange eyes, and gray-brown hair cut close in a striped pattern, Argos had achieved the rank of Sith Lord in the resurgent Empire by the year 3640 BBY.
Taxtro Grave was a Human male who served the Galactic Empire as a Stormtrooper sniper.

Drelfin was a Human male Imperial Security Bureau officer. He came aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Reprisal in 0.5 ABY to help direct combat against the local rebels; this included overseeing the Teardrop massacre. He was second in command to Vak Somoril.
Lieutenant Natrom was a stormtrooper stationed aboard the Reprisal in 0.5 ABY. He was the commanding officer of Korlo Brightwater.

Mink Bollis was a Human that served as one of Imperial Moff Glovstoak's aides. In 0 ABY, he attended one of his superior's parties in his palace, where he met Emperor's Hand Mara Jade as Countess Claria after being introduced to her by Imperial General Deerian.
Casement was the code-name of a Rebel Alliance undercover agent working with Porter under Winter on Drunost in 0 ABY.
Porter was the code-name of a male Rebel Alliance undercover agent working with Casement under Winter on Drunost in 0 ABY.
Bisc was a pirate and member of the BloodScars gang who served aboard the Cavalcade.
Vickers was a pirate aboard the Cavalcade.
Chavers was a corrupt port guard in Janusar, Ranklinge.
Krinkins was an old man who ran the fueling station at the Janusar spaceport.
Atmino, a colonel and senior officer, was one of the honest patrollers of Janusar who was forcibly retired when Cav'Saran took over.
Pwwoz Pwwa was an Ithorian geologist who was present at the Mensix Mining Facility on Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War in 1 ABY.
Brock was one of the ISB officers serving on the Reprisal under Colonel Vak Somoril. He was killed by the BloodScar pirates.
Gilling was one of the Imperial Security Bureau officers serving on the Reprisal under Colonel Vak Somoril. He accompanied the Colonel in an investigation into a group of defecting stormtroopers.

Badji was a pirate working for Captain Andel in the Shelsha sector. A short time after the Battle of Yavin, Andel's group attempted to pirate a freighter in the space in Purnham system. However, they were stopped by the Hand of Judgment with help from Millennium Falcon.
Andel was the male captain and leader of a small pirate gang operating in the Shelsha sector. The BloodScar-pirate, Caaldra, was disposed to recruiting Andel's group and propositioned him to join.
Capper was a member of the BloodScar traffic control on Gepparin. When Mara Jade visited the Commodore, Capper told her where to land.
Bobbler was a member of the BloodScars on Gepparin.
Jorhim was a member of the BloodScars on Gepparin.
Vinis was a member of the BloodScars on Gepparin.
Waggral was a member of the BloodScars on Gepparin.
Rer'chof was a member of the BloodScar pirate gang stationed on Gepparin. When Emperor's Hand Mara Jade visited the Commodore, Rer'chof came along with her to the Commodore.
Nirsh was a member of the BloodScars on Gepparin. He was the bodyguard of the Commodore.

Corf Binalie was a Human male and the son of Pilester Binalie and lived on the planet Cartao. When he first met the Jedi, Jafer Torles, he was in awe of him, but after a Republic gunship destroyed his family's Spaarti Creations facility, he lost faith in his former idol.

Vicria was a female Mungra with orange eyes and red-tawny hair. She ran a tapcafe in Makrin City on Shelkonwa. In 0.6 ABY Vicria let the Alliance to Restore the Republic leader, Leia Organa, work in her tapcafe while she was a fugitive on Shelkonwa, wanted by the Galactic Empire.
Crayg Choard was the son of Governor Barshnis Choard.
Polcyc was an Abyssin scavenger who was a member of the Wreckers, a loose affiliation of scavengers operating on the ice world Hoth.
Gjeel Dhantra was a male Advozse who worked as Pok Nar-Ten's majordomo. It was said that Pok trusted him like a brother.
"The Commodore" was a Human male who was the head of the BloodScar pirate gang.

Sandi Maba was an Aqualish mother of two left stranded on Coruscant when Ando left the Galactic Republic in 22 BBY, just before the start of the Clone Wars. The Refugee Relief Movement settled her and her family on Alderaan, and she planned to stay on the world permanently.

Orogor Binn was a male Aqualish who was stranded on Coruscant when Ando left the Galactic Republic in 22 BBY, just before the start of the Clone Wars. The Refugee Relief Movement resettled him on Alderaan, although he hoped to eventually return to Ando.
Ellorrs was a Duros hero. In the Duros legends, he brought traders from other systems to Duro.
Sorol was a politician in Duros legend who was said to have helped found the Galactic Republic.
Doimo was a female Duros who became famous for their role as a military commander. Due to their fame as an officer, there were female members of Doimo's species named after them.

Haskit was a female Bothan who was a matriarch and was able to influence her species' government on the Bothan home planet of Bothawui for fifty years. After her death, she was famous for the role she played in politics, and there were female Bothans who were named after her.

Rakikta was a Wookiee security controller in the city of Cjaalysce'I on Socorro. He was known as a perfectionist and was never lax on the rules when dealing with spacers. Rakikta, whose name meant "strongarm," had six brothers, the eldest of which was Kuykenda.
Kuykenda was a Wookiee, the brother of Rakikta. Kuykenda was the bodyguard of Pret Swain.
Dahon Indupar was King of Indupar and its Crown Worlds during the Galactic Civil War, as well as a member of the ancient House Indupar.
Adrell was an individual who served as a Moff in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Maris Brood was a female Zabrak Jedi Padawan, who survived the initial stages of the Great Jedi Purge. She spent many years in hiding with Jedi Master Shaak Ti on the planet Felucia during the Imperial Era.
Ferob was an officer in the Imperial Navy, captain of the Iron Fist.
Hap Daniel was the owner of the YKL-37R Nova Courier light freighter Lord's Mistress. According to the station master of the Dantooine Space Station, he was "a real vengeful cuss."

Brinkan was Moff of the Tragan sector, in the Outer Rim. Moff Brinkan placed a bounty on Ral Shawgrim, an Alliance technician who attempted to steal technical data and failed to deliver it to the Empire.

Joss Leskwin was an Imperial Moff, who controlled an area of the galaxy which contained the planet Hjaff. He had difficulty in subduing the native Tarc and hoped to gather enough forces to eventually overwhelm the alien natives.

Keelen Ma was a Mrlssi, who was the chair of the Republic Measures & Standards Bureau in the years leading up to the Clone Wars. From the city of Mennaa on Mrlsst, Ma commented on the issue of calendar reform for HoloNet News.
Ekhrikhor was a Noghri of the Clan Bakh'tor.
Garv Debble was a New Republic archaeologist who insisted that relics plundered by the Galactic Empire from other worlds should be returned to their proper owners.
Galen Marek (pronounced /ɡeɪlən ˈmæɹɛk/) was a Force-sensitive human male who became an accomplished warrior during the Imperial Era.

Lancer Brunou was a Human male doctor of archaeology at the University of Byblos during the Galactic Civil War. Loyal to the Galactic Empire, Brunou despaired for the stability of the galaxy following the death of Emperor Palpatine at the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
Solla Deremot was a Human female from the planet Kal'Shebbol in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Jelok was a Human male scientist who served in the forces of Imperial warlord Moff Kentor Sarne in 8 ABY. Assigned to research team MS-133, Jelok was part of an expedition dispatched to the planet Aaris III in the Kathol sector.

Grigor Tansad was a male scientist who served in the forces of Moff Kentor Sarne, Imperial warlord of the Kathol sector. In 8 ABY, he was assigned to science team MS-133 which was charged with excavating extensive ruins on the planet Aaris III.

A male member of a family and the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy was the cousin of Human Captain Voss Parck. He commanded Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader's starship during a mission to the planet Honoghr, during which Vader discovered the Noghri species.
Kavren was a lieutenant in the Imperial Army in the early weeks of its existence.

Craw was a male Targonnian who served as the self-styled Dictator-Forever of Targonn during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was extremely self-absorbed and cared little for the troubles of his people, creating a 99 percent tax rate, and forcing child labor.
Ulda was the first wife of Kitster Chanchani Banai, who had left her for an employee of Ulda's, Tamora Spice.

Larr Haverel was an Imperial general who was dedicated to the welfare of his men and suspicious of aliens. He was assigned to the Star Destroyer Admonitor as commander of the Imperial Army infantry complement on Grand Admiral Thrawn's mapping expedition to the Unknown Regions.

Klar was a lieutenant and a TIE/LN starfighter pilot during the Galactic Civil War. He served aboard the Admonitor, a Star Destroyer under the command of Grand Admiral Thrawn. Assigned to map the Unknown Regions, the ship came across a craft belonging to the Ebruchi.

A male Ebruchi, Creysis was a pirate captain in charge of an scout squadron that he commanded from his Ebruchi command ship. In 2 ABY, the Ebruchi's scout squadron encountered the Galactic Empire Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Admonitor.

Taryn Clancy was a Human female courier captain operating during the Galactic Civil War. Born in 16 BBY to Kal Clancy, captain of the starship Lassen, Taryn often tried to join his crew, once even resorting to stowing away, and he finally let her join as his copilot when she w…
Del Sato was a thirty-year employee of Core Courier Service and first mate aboard the starship Messenger, under the command of Taryn Clancy.

Commander Voldt served aboard the Interdictor cruiser Requital, during the New Republic retreat from Coruscant in 10 ABY. He was responsible for catching the many small ships that escaped the Imperial blockade.

Kal Clancy was a freighter pilot and father of Taryn Clancy. He was disappointed that his daughter, when she grew up, chose a career with the Core Courier Service rather than a more dashing profession. Though he did not tell her, he grew to be proud of her.

During their excavations, members of the team uncovered a strange artifact that began to manipulate their feelings, causing them to act in suspicious and homicidal ways. Attacked by the primitive descendants of the native Aaris, Theda was badly wounded by blaster fire.
Ktlin was the name given to a domesticated mosgoth owned by Togorian Mlatar Thon Gra. Mlatar used Ktlin as a flying transport in the cities of Zuliria as an alternative to the more common ruori.
Mlatar Thon Gra was a male Togorian Zulirian Swordmaster.

Obersken was an elderly, muscular Chiss male who served the Chiss Ascendancy and the Empire of the Hand as the chief mechanic of the Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy on the Unknown Regions planet Rhigar.

Fenlish was a Chiss cadet who was a member of the Chiss Ascendancy's Chaf family and studied at the Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy, which was located on the Unknown Regions planet Rhigar. The cadet served the Empire of the Hand.
Khana was a Chiss student at the Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy. Khana was assigned to collect weapons during the attack on the academy.
Tlarik was a Chiss student at the Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy. Tlarik was assigned to collect weapons during the attack on the academy.
Gintish was a Chiss student at the Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy. Gintish was assigned to pump the oxygen out of the outer corridors of the base during the attack on the academy.

Itipiniwi was a wilwog that won Best in Show at the Annual Mid-Rim Domesticated Sub-Sentient Show in 22 BBY. Upon winning, Itipiniwi and its owner celebrated, annoying the runner-up bolstyngar named Boshuda, which devoured Itipiniwi.

Mohrgan Fel was an Imperial Knight and the cousin of Emperor Roan Fel. He served his cousin loyally as a bodyguard for many years, and when the Sith emerged during the Sith–Imperial War, he longed to match his skills against theirs.
Blackwing was a Nihil pirate serving under the Storm Jinnix in Pan Eyta's Tempest. Blackwing was killed by the Twi'lek mercenary Lourna Dee during the raid in the Abrion sector.
Creb was a TIE fighter pilot and lieutenant in the Imperial Navy.

Terkuss was a corporal in the Imperial Army under General Freja Covell. He originally resisted being drafted, only acquiescing when the Imperials threatened to raze his home. However, Terkuss was a bully at heart, and soon grew to enjoy serving as an Imperial soldier.
Seenlu Kir was a female Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Lyrre T'enna was a zoologist active during the height of the New Republic. For many years, she traveled from planet to planet, studying the physiology and behavior of many wild non-sentient creatures and reporting on them in her field journal.
Salina was an Ewok who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, Salina was talking with Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka when the princess found an exotic flower, pointing it out to Salina.

Plooz was an Alzarian prince and the son of King Gokus. While still very young, Plooz was effectively kidnapped by Gokus's general, Sludd, as part of an elaborate plot to seize control of the planets Alzar and Sooma. Plooz was taken to the latter world, where he met King Zornog.
Briff was a licensed bounty hunter and black marketeer in the Ord Mantell system.

Kiara Olvidan was a Human female who was the daughter of Faskus Olvidan, who was sent by Byalfin Dyur under the direction of Lumiya to hide the Amulet of Kalara in a cave on Ziost as part of an elaborate test for Ben Skywalker.
David West Reynolds was a captain in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, he wrote a brief manual outlining the virtues of the TIE/LN starfighter.
Vel Terno was a colonel in the Galactic Empire's navy, and served as the fighter wing commander for the SilverWing and GoldWing TIE Series starfighter squadrons in 0 ABY.

During Jai's interrogation on Zelos II two months after the Battle of Endor, she related to Dirk Harkness that she had been engaged to him, but implied in her tone that Krül had perished before the couple could get married.

Gara was a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. Alongside Grand Master Yoda, Gara briefed the Jedi Mace Windu on the creation of coaxium ultra, a new form of coaxium, on the moon Ro Mira and the consequences if it were to fall into the hands of criminal organizations.
This Human male was a bounty hunter working for the Exchange in the aftermath of the Jedi Civil War.

Annikin Starkiller was the son of Kane Starkiller and the Jedi-Bendu Padawan Learner to Luke Skywalker, as well as the protector and later, lover to the Princess/Queen of his home planet of Aquilae, Leia.
His wife was Queen Breha. She ordered General Luke Skywalker to take Leia to Ophuchi to gain the help of the Chrome Companies and place her daughter on the throne.

Roper Slam, a native of the Core world of Mamendin, was a young Humanoid male con man, and founder of the Slam gang, a notorious gang of expert thieves made particularly infamous by its heist of the Vuma treasury. He owned a Ubrikkian star yacht.

Hiksri Jith was a male Rodian who served in the pirate crew headed by Erli Prann. Prann and his fellow pirates gained control of a Golan II Space Defense SpaceGun following the death of Grand Admiral Thrawn, also discovering one of Thrawn's prototype cloaking devices which the…

Eisen Kerioth was a Human male who as the Imperial Moff of Doldur sector during the Galactic Civil War. He pioneered an effort to improve the effectiveness of stormtrooper armor in repelling blaster fire after he was injured by a Rebel attack.
Valadon, a native of the Core world of Mamendin, was a young Humanoid female identity thief, an expert in her field.

Becka, a native Romin, was the grand palace security officer for Romin's tyrant-dictator Roy Teda, who gave refuge and protection to galactic criminals in exchange for hefty bribes disguised as "charitable contributions" paid to his "charity" deputy.

Hansel was the Romin charity deputy (bribe collector) for planetary dictator Roy Teda, who harbored galactic criminals for hefty "contributions" (bribes) that he expected them to pay for such refuge and protection.

Sinthia Pulchatt was a female Kibnon spice merchant, who worked as a liaison between her own boss and the Hutt crime lord, Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Groomed for the position from an early age, she worked in Mos Eisley and was known to frequent Chalmun's Cantina.

Beeyon Nace was once an aspiring logistics clerk on Coruscant. After being caught with the Governor's daughter, he was sent to Tatooine where he served as an assistant to the Imperial Prefect. His duties included logging the incoming and outgoing ships at the local spaceport.

Varnier was an Imperial Moff who controlled the Wyloff sector during the Galactic Civil War. He was less concerned about government than recreation, and spent much of his time away from the actual leadership of the sector.

Tregar was an Imperial Moff who controlled Merel sector during the Galactic Civil War. He was known as an extremely competent man, and was considered to be too influential to be promoted to the rank of Grand Moff.
Reshton Severindas was the leader of the Ragnar Syndicate, a group of bounty hunters, during the Galactic Civil War.

Prevaro was a Rodian who came with information of interest to Azool, whom he believed to be Prince Xizor in disguise. It turned out that Azool was actually Xizor's niece, who intended to take over Black Sun, and for that end she took Prevaro as her lieutenant.
Kos was a Human male who served as the Vice Chairman of Galactic Accounts for the InterGalactic Banking Clan, during the years surrounding the First Battle of Geonosis.
Kiviett was a lieutenant and planetologist who served in the Galactic Empire's Survey Team IX3244-B as second-in-command to Captain Toss.
Toss was an Imperial captain who served as the commanding officer of IX3244-B, a Survey Team tasked with finding a construction site for the Galactic Empire's Death Star II battle station.
Spinda Caveel was a rogue scientist who had a nefarious plan to do some droid reprogramming of his own.

Groshim was a Kashirim male who was one of King Sha-Mar Ma-dred's most trusted guards. He accompanied the King and his four wives to Coruscant, shortly before the First Battle of Geonosis, to protect the royal family while it petitioned for admittance to the Galactic Republic.

Zevel Hortine was a notorious Corellian male glitterstim smuggler who operated in the years surrounding the formation of the Galactic Empire. Hortine briefly owned the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 after winning them in a game of Liar's Cut.
Jubei was a male Weequay who, along with Gonlo, was the personal bodyguard of Saquesh in the aftermath of the Jedi Civil War.
Gonlo was a male Weequay who, along with Jubei, was the personal bodyguard of Saquesh in the aftermath of the Jedi Civil War.

Tre-na served as the captain of the New Republic Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser Peregrine, the flagship of General Garm Bel Iblis during the Battle of Yaga Minor in what would prove to be the last battle of the Galactic Civil War.

Gray Wing was the call sign of a Rebel Alliance pilot who flew as a subordinate of Gray Leader Colonel Horton Salm with Gray Squadron, one of the four main Rebel battle formations participating in the Battle of Endor.

Ido Glayyd was a Human female member of the venerable House Glayyd on the Corporate Sector planet Ammuud. Glayyd's father Agmor was the Mor, or clan patriarch, of House Glayyd, and upon his death in 2 BBY her younger brother Ewwen ascended to the role.

Gaor Tembon was a Sullustan smuggler who operated in the Borderland Regions during the first years of the New Republic. His base of operations was in the Nexer system and he traveled in Nestt-class freighter called the Miv'rah Firestorm.

Joylin was the native Romin leader of the Citizens' Resistance group operating on the planet of Romin in the years prior to 23 BBY. Upon the downfall of the oppressive Teda regime, Joylin assumed the revolutionary leadership of the new government prior to the Clone Wars.

Neil Barani was the co-owner and chief engineer of the Yen-2 mining colony. In order to provide Major Stipling with information about Sprax's connections to Jatayus Outbound, Xizor Transport Systems, and Black Sun, he created the Barani List.
He and his team were captured by Bel Att in Yen-2. The destruction of their shuttle killed them all.

Zenfrei was a male Human living during the era of the Clone Wars and the early years of the Galactic Empire. He served as an aide to Baron Orman Tagge, and assisted his recovery after Darth Vader burned out Tagge's eyes.
Kaggle was a prominent Force-sensitive crime lord who operated on the planet Lanthrym and was native to Elrood sector. Like all Dazouri, Boss Kaggle had two forms: rest and rage.

Osleo Prennert was a Human male member of the Rebel Alliance. The corporal and sentry served the Rebels on the moon Yavin 4 in 0 BBY. Prennert was on duty at recon-tower four when the starship Millenium Falcon landed at Massassi Site on the moon.

Protas was the younger brother of Elis. He was one of the miners on Anobis that sided with the Galactic Empire to ensure good trade with the Empire, he survived until the end of the Civil war on Anobis.

Diblen Harleys was a Human male from the planet Coruscant. The son of an Imperial bureaucrat, Harleys grew up believing that the Galactic Empire stood for order and justice, so he wanted to join the Imperial Survey Corps.
Cass Maston was an Imperial Security Bureau field agent who was assigned to the Brak sector during the Galactic Civil War.

Viran Qol was an Alliance SpecForce Major who was considered an expert on Imperial fortifications. He lectured on Imperial garrison design and tactics at the hidden Alliance Officer's Candidate School.

Raad Hak was a male Mon Calamari Major who served as a deck officer in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. He was in charge of Oracle Base's hangar deck in the Brak sector and disliked the use of smugglers in the Alliance Navy.
Rilctur was a General in the Imperial Navy. The Rilctur carbine was named after him.
Rappapor was a member of Gillespee's smuggler group.
Shirlee Faughn was a female Human smuggler who served to Samuel Tomas Gillespee's organization and later in Talon Karrde's.
Niles Ferrier's wraith was a male Defel who worked with the ship thief. Ferrier simply referred to him as "wraith".
Tagdel was a wealthy female Human who was employed by the Ministry of Finance of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Griv was a Rodian smuggler who worked for Mazzic. He was the pilot of Raptor and one of Mazzic's guards. Along with Amber, Griv was assigned to attack Niles Ferrier as he escaped from Hijarna.
K'lial Khzrry was a con artist of the Xi'Dec species. K'lial and Diskio Khzrry were the only survivors of the Khzrry family unit, which was once well respected in the Xi'Dec community.
Elis was a leader of a mining village on Anobis. He was one of the leading members in the civil war on that planet.
Equa Felens was a Human male who served in the Rebel Alliance.

Trep Reskan was formally a BSDF General before he joined the Rebel Alliance following the Amma protest massacre. He served as the commander of Alliance military forces in the Brak sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Ilko Deminar was the head of the Cryptanalysis Department and Sub-Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence during the Clone Wars. The ILKO code may have been named after him.
Driggs was a male Drall servant of Marcha at her estate on Drall who had served her longer than Ebrihim had lived.

Sakul Ondondanax was a swoop racer on Manaan who reached the title of Manaan Sector Champion during the Jedi Civil War. Ondondanax was present at the Season Opener on Taris in 3956 BBY and was killed shortly afterward when the forces of Darth Malak bombarded the planet.
"Blue" Imcrix was an infamous male Taloron crime lord who was involved in spice smuggling in the Moddell sector around the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Nelinik was a Zabrak assassin who lived some time before the Jedi Civil War. Nelinik killed the Echani High Protector using battle droids. In retaliation for this event, Nelinik was killed by Sanasiki.

T'less was a member of the Yuuzhan Vong species who belonged to the Shamed Ones. Alive during the Yuuzhan Vong War, T'less worked on the captured planet of Yuuzhan'tar and secretly practiced the Jeedai heresy, a belief that members of the Jedi would save lowly Yuuzhan Vong.
Quintama was captain of the Melida Liberation Force just before the Twenty-First Battle of Zehava, in which he was killed. Quintama was the husband of Pinani and father of Renei and Wunana.
Grandon Holleck was Imperial Governor of Chandrila during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.
Debin Seylas was an Imperial Moff who governed the Mektrun sector which included the Joralla system during the Galactic Civil War.
Renei was the sibling of Wunana, child of Quintama and Pinani, and grandchild of Bicha and Tiraca. Renei perished alongside Wunana in the Twenty-Second Battle of Zehava.

Wunana was a member of the Melida people of the planet Melida/Daan. Their parents, Quintama and Pinani, were both killed during the Melida's conflict with the Daan people. By 49 BBY, Wunana and their sibling Renei were killed in the Twenty-Second Battle of Zehava.
