Defeen was a Defel who served the Galactic Empire.
Gwig was a young male Ewok who lived on the forest moon of Endor. He came of age and received his hood—together with Malani and Mookiee—at the Festival of Hoods.
Hideaz Quill-Face was a three-meter-tall smuggler of an alien species. He was often seen at the Byss Bistro with his partner, Spog.
Spog was a smuggler who could often be found with his partner, Hideaz Quill-Face, at the Byss Bistro.

Ferra was a female Dathomiri Witch of the Singing Mountain Clan. During the Battle of Dathomir, she was killed when her neck was broken by a Nightsister causing Teneniel Djo to lash out in anger and use the Force to kill the Nightsisters.
Zayl Braith was a smuggler, a bounty hunter, and a member of the Granse Confederacy.
Kl'ietu Mutela was a Vodran diplomat who lived around 25,100 BBY.
Nnaksta graduated from GOSS in 12 BBY as part of a highly successful class, before returning to the Greel Wood Logging Corporation.
Meysen Kayson was an entrepreneur, founder and owner of Greel Wood Logging Corporation, which harvested greel wood from Pii III and Pii IV. Kayson was also a supporter of the Rebel Alliance.
Eriann Strathmore was an arrogant Lady and model Imperial citizen. She detested the weak and had a particular dislike of inferior alien races.

The administration officer of the Peragus Mining Facility was the head of the mining colony at the time of the Skirmish at Peragus II in 3951 BBY, when Meetra Surik escaped a Sith ambush on the Republic warship Harbinger, and docked the Ebon Hawk with the station for critical …
Sadras Koyan was a Human male from Tralus and the Head of State of that planet. He was a wide-shouldered man with thinning hair, and a member of the Centerpoint political party.

Seha Dorvald was a Jedi Knight during the Second Galactic Civil War. Born on Coruscant around 22 ABY, most of Dorvald's family was killed following the Yuuzhan Vong's invasion of the galactic capital, and she was orphaned after the subsequent death of her father during the occ…

Bescat Offdurmin was a holo-entertainment mogul and pleasure-seeker from the Corporate Sector. He was the original owner of the Love Commander, which he lost in a game of sabacc to Lando Calrissian. His drunkenness at the time may have contributed to his loss.

Genna Delpin was a female Human who served as an admiral in the Corellian Defense Force, where she was considered a rising star in the Corellian military. She led the assault fleet at the Battle of Hapes.

Jenna Lars was a short Human woman who had a distinctive Liann appearance with black hair and olive skin. During the Galactic Civil War Jenna was a physically strong woman in her mid-forties and was overweight.
Tathak K'roylan was a male Bothan covered in black fur with tan patches, one directly over his eyes. He was the deputy intelligence leader for Bothawui.
Slizzik was a female Barabel, and the mate of Balluzikik. While working together with the Rodian Slimego and the Taloron Hunter Crutag, Slizzik pursued a bounty posted on a group of Rebel agents.

Kisquar was a Mriss Black Sun operative. He was Sprax's chief lieutenant in the Sisar Run. Kisquar was in charge of shipjacking, stolen starship and parts fencing and an information broker. Before joining Black Sun, he was a prominent smuggler, shipjacker and pirate.

Saras Krenin was a female Rodian bounty hunter of House Benelex. She was the associate of several Rodians killed by Han Solo, and she found a particular joy in hunting the Corellian smuggler down, though even she realized the chances of her capturing him were slight.
Gilthor Breen was a Balmorran man and the public face of Lyster Innovations, a company on Drewwa.
Aliniaca Verr was a young holodrama actress from Balmorra popular around 40 ABY. She was short with long black hair and black eyes and considered cute. She was Gilthor Breen's favorite actress.
Veild-danol was a male Yarkora independent merchant who operated a regular trading route on the edges of the Kathol sector in the Outer Rim Territories during the early years of the New Republic.
Stonias Leem was a being that was a representative of Tendrando Arms on Drewwa who was presented with the Amulet of Kalara by the victors of the Insurrection of Iliabath.
Kelen Wordkal was a pilot who worked as a captain of the Mos Eisley Police Authority on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine. Wordkal often patrolled the Tatoo system in a Z-95 Headhunter.
Byaflin Dyur was a male Bothan pirate who was the captain of the Boneyard Rendezvous. As of 40 ABY, he and his crew were contacted by Sith Lady Lumiya.

Hirrtu was a male Rodian communications officer, tail gunner and cook for the Boneyard Rendezvous. He was a typical light green Rodian with the exceptions of several splotches of blue he painted on every fifth scale of his body.

Hemalian Barkid was a male businessperson from Drewwa. He worked for Trang Robotics, and as of 40 ABY had been assigned to Kuat. He owned a Y-wing which was stolen by Ben Skywalker during his mission to acquire the Amulet of Kalara.
Faskus Olvidan or Faskus of Ziost was a male Human from Almania who became part of the plot of Lumiya. He worked as a courier in the Tendrando Arms building on Drewwa.
Krav Noblis was the editor of The Adjudicator, a Holofeed specifically for bounty hunters, during the era of the Mandalorian Wars.
Boto del ibn Garl was the local administrator of Vaufthau Processing Industries on Goroth.

Tord Gamb was a con-artist and gambler who was born on Port Evokk. He was known to have engaged in confidence schemes in the Sluis Van, Bimmisaari, Maphus Tria, Algarra II, and Asmall systems. The New Republic placed a 25,000 credit bounty on his head.
Keldan was a Human male TIE fighter pilot onboard the Boneyard Rendezvous who attempted to kill Ben Skywalker on Ziost, but returned to the Boneyard after Skywalker lifted a rock in his way.

Myrat'ur was a pirate flying with Byalfin Dyur and the Boneyard Rendezvous as of 40 ABY. Dyur was going to order him to go down to the surface of Ziost in one of the freighter's TIE fighters and kill Ben Skywalker, after fellow pilot Keldan had failed.

Mezer was a Sergeant in the Corellian Security Force as of 40 ABY. He piloted Silfinia and Najack Ell's transport to the designated retrieval zone for the supposed meeting of the Confederation at Gilatter VIII, unaware that the 'Ells' were in fact Jacen Solo and Sith Lady Lumiya.
Breyf T'dawlish was a white furred Bothan. He was one of the Confederation hosts who greeted "Silfinia" and "Najack Ell" at the supposed meeting at Gilatter VIII.
Squinn was a male Quarren and a captain who served in the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet. He was the commander of the Galactic Voyager when the warship fought at the Battle of Gilatter VIII.
Ovvit was a male Chev pirate who worked as a pilot with the Boneyard Rendezvous. He was ordered by his captain, Byalfin Dyur, to kill Ben Skywalker following Lumiya's orders.
Glasfir'a'lik, called Glasfir for short, was a Defel crime lord who effectively controlled the planet Demesel.
Galleros Nul was the Mandated Commander of the People of Zelos, after declaring martial law, and the governor of Zelos II in 4 ABY.

Nooni Dalvo was a Sullustan female who worked as the navigator aboard the Trader's Luck, serving under its captain, Garris Shrike. She was friends with Brafid and often walked about the vessel armed with a scaled-down blaster pistol.
Mahk'khar was a Gotal crime lord who built a three-story castle on Tuulab.
Vertag was a male Zeltron governor from the Northern Province of Zeltros. He had five daughters, that the Zeltron aides—Marruc, Rahuhl, Bahb and Jahn—were involved with before they fled the planet.

Odra, colloquially known as the Duchess of Sleet, was a nefarious Frost Sprite who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. She became mistress to the Snow King, and she froze his heart, making him selfish and mean.
Podlong Foahl was a male Givin who worked as a luggage loader aboard the Aurorient Express, under Chief Purser Waverton.

Bix Arden-Govia was a male Human and the scion of two prominent families on Bakura. He left to become a ship's boy and was aware of the Ssi-ruuk before their invasion of Bakura. He owned the Silver Cratsch.

Salia Arden-Govia was the niece of Bix Arden-Govia. A native of Bakura, she lived in its capital city Salis D'aar and grew up to be a starfighter pilot. She was a member of a patrol squadron in the Bakuran Defense Fleet.
Kitalic Nirasic was a male Svivreni miner and mining manager.

Sawthawne was a Lutrillian gangster who operated out of Bespin. He was the unofficial "boss of port town" on Cloud City. He was also controlling a deserted part of Tibannopolis. Sawthawne had the odd habit of wearing antique optical spectacles.
Omow Moder was a male Ithorian student who studied ecology on Clak'dor VII.
Prozzen Fosky, also known as Prozzen "Mozzy" Fosky, was a male Bith jazz musician who lived on the Bith homeworld Clak'dor VII.
Talrin Youp was a Bith female from Clak'dor VII who worked as a computer programmer and professor during her lifetime.

Reen was a male Human enslaved by clan mother Mintinee on Dathomir. He was a message carrier for the clan mother, which helped him in his role as the covert leader of a male slave intelligence network.

Cobb Salfur was a scout and roughneck from Ovise III. He was a member of the Endor commando team. After the Battle of Endor, the New Republic hired him to keep watch on Endor. Salfur proceeded to build a trading post on the forest moon.

Dharus was a privateer associated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. A member of a little-known species, he was provided with information about Imperial activity and prize starships in the hyperlane called Leisure Corridor, and in exchange he shared his profits with th…
Erkwil was a Pacithhip male who lived on Tatooine. He was a spice dealer and an ex-convict.
Mirash Peet was a Human male who served as the Imperial governor of the Induparan Crown Worlds. During the Galactic Civil War, he faced an aggressive pirate presence in his territory.

"Pori Nate" was the alias given to a fifteen-year-old drug abuser for an interview in an article written by Anjet Okeco for HoloNet News. "Nate" lived in the Jrade District of Coruscant and illegally visited alien bars and clubs, where he purchased death sticks.

Dherik Rule was a Coruscant Security Force detective for the area of Taung Heights on the planet Coruscant. In 22 BBY, Rule was on duty when he took a report from Latika Garboren who claimed finding a Sith emblem in a dollop of pastebread.

Reda Jalooz was a female student of the Force shortly after the Galactic Republic was founded, c.25,000 BBY. She stole the Kashi Mer talisman, an heirloom of the Kashi Mer Dynasty that was rumored to possess a dark power.
Critolus Masse was a male Rodian who was a underlord of the criminal Darkwalker gang on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
Solon Gaw was a Human male who was an aegis guard for the criminal Darkwalker gang on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.

Marcus Gaw was a Human male who was a bloodlord of the Darkwalkers during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, he was killed by an officer of the Royal Naboo Security Forces during the rescue of Karl Eckener, who was held hostage by the Darkwalkers i…
Beel Acton was a Force-sensitive male Human who grew up on Brentaal IV as the son of a businessman.

Durrei was a Human male native of Elrood and a Force-sensitive. His family was killed by stormtroopers when he was very young, and it was during their executions that Durrei first used his latent Force abilities, using the dark side to kill the Imperials.

Bataal Bandu was a descendant of the early Sith/Dark Jedi cross-breeding experiments who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Part of the Sith Order who acted against Darth Vader, he delighted in spreading the Sith teachings to other cultures.
Shepprd Barron was a major in the Corellian Security Force.
Mal Biron was a Shistavanen smuggler and bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War.
Lesan Ramier was Moff of the Brak sector.
Omo Taj was a leader of the Carosite people during the rule of the New Republic. Taj allowed the construction of the secret New Republic outpost on Carosi XII which was commanded by Balderik Rajana.

Balderik Rajana was the commander of the secret New Republic outpost on Carosi XII. At the time he took command of the newly-built base, he was young and idealistic, having fought the Empire for most of his life.

Daggath Darklighter, nicknamed Dag, was a member of the Cularin Militia during its conflict with the Navy of Thaere. Originally a native of Cerea, Darklighter moved to the Outer Rim Territories world of Tatooine after viewing images of the devastating Separatist attack on Cerea.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Bront Autin was a member of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's Coalition for Progress. Autin was assigned to the Sanbra Sector Monitor, as part of the Art Group, working under Executive Director Kem Tija.
Snopel was a Human male who, according to stories, likely served the Galactic Republic as a soldier during the very beginning of the Clone Wars.
Deel De was a Force-sensitive female Twi'lek from Ryloth. Born to a noble family on her homeworld, she grew up privileged and pampered.

Ereen Agar was a female Zabrak from Anobis. Early in her career, she worked as a guard, defending shipments for a transport company in the Mid Rim. During the Galactic Civil War, Ereen defended the crime lord, Vurrha Chur from a band of pirates on Tatooine.

Granakk was a female Wookiee who was exiled by her species from her homeworld of Kashyyyk. After her banishment from her home planet, Granakk became one of the most feared bounty hunters in the galaxy.
Iris Snow, also called Lady Snow was the owner of the Corellian Slavers Guild.

Keedo, often called Judge Keedo, was a local magistrate. He ruled a remote area where typical governments had little say. He ruled with an iron fist and was a bully at heart, which contributed to his ruling style.

CT-307 was a Galactic Republic clone trooper who fought in the Clone Wars. CT-307 was created on the planet Kamino by the Kaminoans. Developed from the genetic template of bounty hunter Jango Fett, CT-307 was a Human male clone who had tan skin and a height of 1.83 meters.

Keeth Anak was a Force-sensitive male Zabrak who operated as a bounty hunter. His mother died of unknown causes when he was young and as a teenager he killed his abusive father. Keeth and his sister, Odon Anak, fled their home and went on to work together as bounty hunters.
Kelna Toodo was a Duros gambler. Early in his career, Toodo had been a pilot's apprentice when he discovered the lure of gambling.
The mustachioed Fat Man was a thin, black-haired male Human living on the planet Nadiem during the final decade of the Galactic Republic.
Kurgan Dala was a male Human starfighter pilot from Naboo.
Roxi was a female member of the Gatherers at Savi and Sons Salvage in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. She used a hoverchair.
Ker-Zakk was a Weequay born in 44 BBY. He was arrested in 22 BBY for fighting in Eastport, and tried to attack his Houk rival Egome Fass.

Zegret Wan was a Elomin male who served as the captain of the Ranphyxes smashball team during the Separatist Crisis. In 22 BBY, in only his fourth season, he was close to gaining the smashball accolade of having 50 goals in 50 games.
Maur "Hyperspace" Howins was a famed Lafrarian smashball player. In 60 BBY, he set the record of gaining 50 goals in 50 games.
A Vratix from the planet Thyferra, Yopaxtul was an athlete who was active during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Pumav was a Selonian sprinter from the planet Selonia. In 23 BBY, they won the annually-hosted Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings race held on the world Teyr.

Yeep was a Teek who found his way onto the starship of space-farer Tuner Ryna by 22 BBY. Although unsure if "Yeep" was in fact the stowaway's name, Ryna entered him in the annual "Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings" event on the planet Teyr.
Mogoyu was a Rakririan who competed in the 22 BBY Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings. The athlete barely came in second in the decaped-plus final, losing to Shimer Londalin.

Malia was a female Human from Coruscant. She grew up in the lower levels of the planet-wide city during the Galactic Civil War, fighting to survive. However, her luck changed for the better when she got a job at the Rose Nebula. She worked as a relaxation specialist and spy.

Larith De was a Twi'lek itinerant aristocrat representing Ryloth. He traveled around the galaxy to represent his homeworld, along with his wife, Deel De. But De was little more than a puppet of his wife.
Tev Driscull was a Corellian Human male. He was a commodities shipper and the original owner of the Nova Whisper. He soon lost it at Elshandruu Pica to a privateer named Dharus.
This individual was a male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final days of the Galactic Republic.

Mrs. Tyerell was a female Aleena and the the wife of professional podracer Ratts Tyerell. She attended the Boonta Eve Classic that was held in 32 BBY, during which she was widowed when Ratts died in a fatal crash.
Mudmub's Rodian partner was a bounty hunter that took part in Risso Nu's coup to kill Boba Fett.
Viqi was a female Deltron and one of Brisha Shard's children. She had a brother, Alarik, and a sister, Bellen.
Marsden Latham was a dark-skinned member of the of the Alderaanian Internal Security Force who caught Han Solo trying to sell glitterstim in Aldera. He carried no weapons.

Darak Lyll was a tall, long-haired and bearded Human criminal who lived on Alderaan. To earn money, Han Solo, on his visit to Alderaan in the year 10 BBY, tried to sell Darak Lyll the glitterstorm charge of the Ylesian Dream.
Palazidar was a t'landa Til Sacredot who once fell asleep while performing the Exultation on the Mountain of the Exalted on the planet Ylesia.
Ngyn Reeos was captain of the Helot's Shackle. He tried to arrest Han Solo when he escaped from the Ylesia onboard the Talisman. With the help of Jalus Nebl, Solo managed to escape.
Dewt Kluskine was the warden of the Imperial Correctional Facility at Kessel.
Gyylghrard was a male Wookiee prisoner at the Imperial Correctional Facility on Kessel.

Vessery was a human male who served as a TIE fighter pilot within the Galactic Empire with the military rank of colonel. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Vessery wore standard Imperial pilot uniform and gear, and flew a TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter.

Bodis-Ker Vitan was a Jedi Knight and the Jedi Watchman of the world Cadinth in the Mid Rim. Cadinth supported the Galactic Republic against a militant secessionist faction during the Separatist Crisis, but by 22 BBY a pro-Separatist uprising broke out in the planet's capital …
Spade was an Advanced Recon Commando and one of a group of clone troopers left behind on Pengalan IV after their LAAT/i was shot down during a full scale Republic retreat.
Wrench was an Advanced Recon Commando and one of a group of clone troopers left behind on Pengalan IV after their LAAT/i was shot down during a full scale Republic retreat.
Spots was an Advanced Recon Commando and one of a group of clone troopers left behind on Pengalan IV after their LAAT/i was shot down during a full scale Republic retreat.
Hash was an Advanced Recon Commando and one of a group of clone troopers left behind on Pengalan IV after their LAAT/i was shot down during a full scale Republic retreat.
Parq Yewgeen Plancke was the manager of the Imperial Bank when Han Solo came to close his "Jenos Idanian" account.

Dorzo was a male Rodian who served as Jiliac Desilijic Tiron's majordomo. It was he who greeted Vykk Draygo (the alias of Han Solo while employed on Ylesia) and Jalus Nebl when they arrived at Jiliac's palace on Nal Hutta, carrying a message and gift from Zavval.

Haako was a Chadra-Fan male who worked as an informant and scout during the Second Imperial Civil War. A long-time inhabitant of the Wheel space station, he kept no strict allegiance to any faction and worked for everyone who offered him credits at a given time.
Jor Torlin was a Human male agent who worked for the Sith Intelligence and Assassination division of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War.
"Army" was a Human who served in the Republic Army during the Mandalorian Wars.
Patra Tebut was a female watch officer on the starship Anakin Solo.

Mecht was a middle-aged Human male soldier who served as a member of Red Hand Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to his service in the Rebellion, he was a slave of the Galactic Empire until he was freed. He participated in the capture of Helot's Shackle.

Biurk was a Devaronian captain who commanded the Shamunaar during the Second Galactic Civil War. The Shamunaar was the flagship of the picket screen monitoring the Bothans, who had declared their support for Corellia and readied assault fleets which the Galactic Alliance was k…
Shren Whist was the Proconsul of the planet Caprioril during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Vence Tabok was an Imperial admiral who was put in charge of Zirtran's Anchor after it had been occupied by the Empire. Tabok disappeared along with the space station when it vanished under mysterious circumstances, and was never heard from again.

Whisk the Elder was an ancient Geelan who was sent to confer with Admiral Vence Tabok. Whisk warned the admiral that if he did now withdraw his Imperial forces from Zirtran's Anchor a great tragedy would strike. The admiral did not believe him.

Chabak was a male Twi'lek and the original owner of Chabak's, located aboard the Zirtran's Anchor. He disappeared when the space station vanished under mysterious circumstances; upon its reappearance, two of his relatives, Padda and Quink, took over the gambling den.

Padda was a male Twi'lek who resided at Zirtran's Anchor and was a co-owner of Chabak's with his cousin Quink. Padda and Quink were relatives of Chabak's original owner, who took over when he disappeared mysteriously.

Quink was a male Twi'lek who resided at Zirtran's Anchor. He was co-owner of Chabak's with his cousin, Padda. The two of them, who were relatives of Chabak's original owner, took over when he disappeared mysteriously.
Vygar was a former Imperial bounty hunter, and the original owner of the Death Mark which they integrated into Zirtran's Anchor.

Oodonnaa was a female Twi'lek information broker on Nar Shaddaa. On his first visit to Nar Shaddaa, she provided Han Solo with directions toward the Corellian sector of the moon and instructions on how to contact Mako Spince.
Adri Reenogga was one of the Reenogga triplets and co-owner of Reenogga Personal Services, Cubed. She was the main pilot and technician, making sure that the RPS craft were always in top shape.
Vella Reenogga was one of the Reenogga triplets and co-owner of Reenogga Personal Services, Cubed. She was the firm's spokesperson, business manager, and client liaison.
Kara Reenogga was one of the Reenogga triplets and co-owner of Reenogga Personal Services, Cubed. She was known for her fiery temperament and stubbornness.
The Dread Pirate Mendel Cutter was a pirate captain of the Rusted Cutlass. Upon retirement, he settled at Zirtran's Anchor attaching his ship permanently to the space station.
Ace of Staves was the unofficial leader of the group of criminals calling themselves the Bartog Syndicate and a resident at Zirtran's Anchor.
Odon Anak was a female Zabrak. She and her brother, Keeth Anak, were skilled bounty hunters.
Fa'Zoll was a male Zabrak and a member of the Imperial Inquisitorius.
Vrke was a member of the Imperial Inquisitorius.

A Padawan was apprenticed to Jedi Master Zez-Kai Ell prior the Mandalorian Wars. At some point during the Galactic Republic's conflict with the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, the Jedi Padawan joined the Jedi Knight Revan's faction and entered the war.
Relans was an Imperial Moff and a rival of Moff Feleea. After the debacle of the Battle of Endor, Relans made sure to remain within the Deep Core.
Feleea was an Imperial Moff, and a rival of Moff Relans. He went rogue after the Battle of Endor.
Gozric was an Imperial Moff who governed the Wyl sector during the New Order.

Valin Draco was a male Human Jedi Knight who was the student of Jedi Master Denia during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Following the outbreak of the Clone Wars, he fought for the Republic against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Galasett was a Kerestian male bounty hunter who tracked outlaw bounty hunters. He started doing so when two overzealous bounty hunters brutally killed his friend Reglis Taal's brother. When he discovered it, he decided that he would become a vigilante for other hunters.

Sturn Brunwin was a humanoid front desk attendant at the Lucky Despot hotel in Mos Eisley, Tatooine along with their twin, Anton Brunwin. The two were swindlers, and also ran a money laundering business in addition to working the front desk.
Vossuk was a Quarren information broker who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Nir Rinit was an Imperial Security Bureau agent who operated on the planet Naalol during the Galactic Civil War.

Rhain Towith was an Imperial Moff who governed the Kadok Regions during the New Order. Although Towith was officially on good terms with Guiteica, the Moff was at a loss as to how they could bring the native Bitthævrians, and especially the m'Yalfor'ac Order, under Imperial co…
Torpin was an Imperial Moff during the Galactic Civil War.
Gegren Throsen was an Imperial Moff who governed the planet Salliche during the Galactic Civil War taking over the operation of Salliche Agricultural Corporation and the planet's parliament.
Tendd was an Imperial Moff whose territory including the planet Bethal in the Tapani sector's Pelagia Province during the Galactic Civil War.
Ree Duptom was a bounty hunter—a notably unpopular one—during the Galactic Civil War and pilot of the Venesectrix.
The medical officer at the Peragus Mining Facility oversaw the colony's medical facilities by the time of the Skirmish at Peragus II in 3951 BBY.
Kadlo was a Duros king. King Kadlo Tower was named after him. Admiral Cov of the Alliance to Restore the Republic claimed Kadlo as an ancestor.
Tallis was an Imperial Moff who governed the Parmel sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Newen Streeg was a Human male Imperial Governor who governed Periphery sector, located near the Sisar Run, during the New Order. His flagship was the Ion Storm, a Strike-class cruiser.
Irnst Stavveld was an Imperial Moff who governed the Ado sector during the New Order.

Borval Mish was an Imperial lieutenant who worked for Imperial Customs as a customs officer. He patrolled the cargo bays in Byblos Tower 214. He was described as energetic and of short stature, and was said to be quite a nervous person.
He claimed to know freighter codes inside out and would punish starship crews for even the smallest violations. He was practically immune to any bribe and would arrest anyone who would try to do so.

Shinda was an Human male Imperial Moff who governed the Spirva sector during the Galactic Civil War. He banned the 50th annual publication of Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology for safety concerns during his tenure.
Shendar was an Imperial Moff during the early years of the New Republic.
Sakai was an Imperial Moff who governed Thuris sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Ixxis Cranata was an Ithorian storyteller from Ithor, regarded as one of the best his people had ever known. Every day he would sit and relate tales to anybody who would listen.

Neomen's ambition outshone his ability. He grew bored and that was when he became corrupted by Black Sun agents. He collected Expansionist Era art, specifically from the pre-Hutt Klatooinians and Niktos periods.

Lieutenant Atallo was a male officer in the Telos Security Force following the Jedi Civil War. He oversaw the Czerka landing bay Urban 38-3 on Citadel Station, and used his position to cover up the illicit Czerka weapons trade on the station.
Danalis was a homeless Human girl who was picked up by Garris Shrike.

Padra was a homeless Human male who was picked up by Garris Shrike. He was one of many street children Shrike used to beg and steal for him as he traveled from world to world in the Trader's Luck on smuggling runs.

Hydra was the assistant of the Grand Inquisitor Malorum and later replaced Malorum as Grand Inquisitor after his death six months after the rise of the New Order during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Garthus Hal was a Human explosives expert and bomber for hire.
Ish'tay was an Ithorian ecologist and Force Adept with ocher-colored skin. He was deeply spiritual, though not orthodox by Ithorian standards.

Sala Natu was an officer who served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Stationed at Echo Base on Hoth at the time of the Imperial assault on that world, he was a specialist who possessed expertise in survival in cold environments.

Lord Barthos Okeefe was a Brentaalan Human of the prominent House Okeefe merchant house. He had a long and successful career as a financier and director of Brentaal's orbital HoloNet relay station, then retired around the age of sixty to a planetside resort villa on the north …
Pelles was an Imperial Moff who governed the Torch Nebula during the Galactic Civil War. Pelles was critical of Moff Abran Balfour's stewardship of the Parmic sector.
Malcom was an Imperial Moff who governed Brema sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Ariss Lyjan was an Imperial Moff who governed Nuiri sector in the Outer Rim Territories during the Galactic Civil War.
A clone of Darth Vader was created on Dantooine, and was killed by the real Darth Vader.

Ka-Tu-Un was a male Cerean Force-adept who lived during the later years of the New Republic. He trained as a member of the Cerean Ner Yan tradition, translating into Basic as "mind chord." This group trained their minds to attune to the Force, linking their minds together.
Groz Niclari, also known by his HoloNet handle "QuasarKing327," was a male fan of the original Quest for Quasar, and hosted the largest fan-run Quest for Quasar infocache.
Totoplat was Jabba and Jiliac's chef at their residence on Nar Shaddaa and occasionally accompanied them on trips.

Kyl Ransen was an Imperial Moff who governed Polith system during the early years of the Galactic Civil War. After witnessing the virtual subjugation of the Vratix people on Thyferra as a youth, he vowed to help them when he grew older.
Ammar was the Imperial Moff who governed Portmoak sector during the Galactic Civil War.

Chorkun was an Imperial Moff who governed Parmorak sector during the Galactic Civil War. Chorkun controlled Parmorak sector until he was mysteriously eliminated by an unknown assassin. It was rumored that his killer was Kassar Kosciusko, an Alliance Intelligence operative.

Kassar Kosciusko was a male Tarro assassin who later became the owner and proprietor of the Royal K Hotel and Casino on Kwenn Space Station as well as a secret undercover operative of the Rebel Alliance.
Jadonna Veloz was a dark-skinned Human female who captained the starship Wayward Girl during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Goure Conor was a male Ryn who was staying on Bakura. He greeted the Solo family upon their arrival, and became a friend to Tahiri Veila.
Kiottja was a male Jawa, leader of the Salt Steppes clan.

Garven Meccamitta was a male Human doctor of noble heritage who was known for his medical genius. He was the chief surgeon and dean of the Rhinnal State Medical Academy located in Rhire on the Core Worlds planet of Rhinnal.
Isshaddik was a Wookiee male criminal who was exiled from his homeworld of Kashyyyk and joined the crew of the starship Trader's Luck along with his mate, Dewlannamapia.

Vuldo was a Kalarban who was once involved in illegal blaster building. He had forced Q-E, 2-E, and U-E to build the blasters for him. When the droids started to question his intentions, Vuldo shot U-E. He was eventually caught by C-3PO, R2-D2, and Nak Pitareeze.

Commander Surlev was the second-in-command of the Strike-class medium cruiser Ion Storm under Captain Barse Neomen. Surlev acted as the commanding officer of the Ion Storm whenever his captain was away, which was quite often.
Ugarte was a male Ugnaught that lived in Cloud City on Bespin.
Myk Bidlor was a Human male who served as the leader of the team of forensic specialists hired by Durga to perform a thorough autopsy on Aruk's corpse.
Arly Bron was a stocky, aging Human male smuggler with a genial air and sharp tongue who frequented the Corellian Sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Motamba was a male Wookiee munitions expert who served in the Wookiee underground resistance movement during the Galactic Civil War.
Osman was a male Chevin who served as one of Durga's majordomo during the Galactic Civil War.
Vabrick Axo was the male owner of the Sampo's, one of Commenor's most famous restaurants.
Nena Wo was the manager of Chasin City's Plenty's store.

A princess of the Royal Family of Eiattu, daughter of Emperor Uthorrferrell Cartha and elder sister of Isplourrdacartha Estillo, Kassen was murdered by rebellious Eiattuan nobles together with the rest of the royal family.

Dulorr was a princess of the Royal Family of Eiattu, daughter of Emperor Uthorrferrell Cartha and elder sister of Isplourrdacartha Estillo. She was murdered by rebellious Eiattuan nobles together with the rest of the royal family.

Rankwin Fopow was the Prime Oligarch of the Cadinth Oligarchy, speaker for the Mid Rim planet Cadinth in 22 BBY. He, and therefore Cadinth, supported the Galactic Republic during its conflict with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Kais was a female Human who lived on the planet of Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she operated at the Nightsister Stronghold. There, she served the Nightsisters as a culinarian.
Illia Setag was the Chairman of Cybot Galactica in 22 BBY, at a time when Galactica was moving from the Universal Socket Interface to their own proprietary Advanced Appendage Bus.
Rowen Foce was the Corps Director of the Space Rescue Corps.
Losibaru Jenks was the Finance Officer of the Salliche Agricultural Corporation.
Koner Blihrad was the leader of the Melody Fellowship, a group of musicians and agents that formed in response to the increased danger artists traveling the galaxy.
Hoipa Vonill was the Technology Lead of Balmorran Arms, that would develop the RO-D-series droid for the Melody Fellowship.
Dayvid Midanyl was one of Sena Midanyl's sons.
Peter Midanyl was one of Sena Midanyl's sons. He and his brother Dayvid served aboard Senator Garm Bel Iblis's Dreadnaughts, the Harrier.

The Rogue Assassin was an ex-Republic Advanced Recon Commando who began work as a hired gun. During an internal dispute between the Trade Federation and the Techno Union, the Rogue Assassin used the opportunity to take out key CIS officers.

An unidentified Jabiimi was captured by the Galactic Empire during the subjugation of Jabiim of the Galactic Civil War. She and her husband Goran were two of the prisoners sent to the detention center on Kalist VI.
This clone trooper commander was stationed on the Venator-class Star Destroyer Impavid. He wore armor with red markings, a pauldron, and a jetpack.
Landric was a male Human and the Imperial Moff who governed Emmo sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Cyl Sant was a female Human from New Bornalex. She was married to a Theelin with whom she had a daughter, Rystáll.

Onici Wen was a female who became mistress to Bib Fortuna, the majordomo of the planet Tatooine's crime lord Jabba the Hutt, by 4 ABY. That year, Fortuna sent his errand-runner, Doda Bodonawieedo, to Tatooine's city of Mos Eisley to deliver a love-letter to Wen.
Veedo Vaocan was a Rodian male who served as a doctor and a member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Unlike most members of his species, Veedo was a pacifist.
Karrison Lee was a smuggler who was fond of gambling even though he was not particularly good at it. He was a patron at the Ace of Sabres on the planet Kluistar.
Willum Kamaran was leader of the mercenary group Nova Force under the employ of Xizor.
Lyndelah Jenwald was a a Human female who served as a trooper in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. She was wounded during the Battle of Ylesia.
Kaj Nedmak was a Human male smuggler from the planet Drall who served as one of the atmosphere guides during the Battle of Ylesia.
Aricos Dreleene was an Imperial Moff who governed Toblain sector during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Sarrah was a male Togorian who served as a member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Tym was a young Human male who was the son of Ylesian pilgrims. He was rescued by Han Solo and Chewbacca after the Rebel raid on Ylesia. He and three other children helped Han load and tie spice that had to be jettisoned in order to evade arrest.

Treeska was a Human male who served as a loyal bodyguard to Bria Tharen and two Rebel officers, Feltran and Darnov during the Galactic Civil War. He was aboard the Queen of Empire where he and the crew were on their way to Nar Shaddaa to meet up with the Hutts.
Feltran was a Human male Rebel officer who served Bria Tharen during the Galactic Civil War.
Darnov was a Human male Rebel officer who accompanied Bria Tharen aboard the Queen of Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Osss-10 was a male bounty hunter who was active during the Galactic Civil War, in the aftermath of the breakup of the Bounty Hunters' Guild in 0 BBY.

Crovessk was the CEO of Trandosha's Revessa Global Shipping. He scheduled an appeal to the Senate through contacts with Trade Federation Representative Lott Dod. When Senator Yarua heard this, he withdrew his delegation from peace talks being held with the Trandoshans.
Lorindan was a Kubaz who worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure as a rancor keeper. He was reputed to be a relative of the spy Garindan. He also worked as a spy, always looking for information to sell.

Lana was a Human female who was on the planet Taris in 3956 BBY. In that year, she was tricked by the con artist Jergan, who promised Lana to arrange a backstage meeting with the Bith band in the Upper City Cantina for a fee of twenty credits.
An Ewok who was the grandfather of Logray once told his grandson the tale of how the Ewoks migrated from the forest of Simoom to the other side of the moon of Endor.
Crin Harson was an Imperial Moff during the Galactic Civil War.
Heedra was an Imperial Moff who governed Baxel sector, which was located in the Outer Rim Territories, during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Dahl was a male Samarian who served as an aide to Aaren Larker, a liaison to the Samarian resistance in the time immediately after the Clone Wars' end.

A Duros lived in the South Apartments of Taris with his friend Ixgil, both of whom were members of the Duros species that were harassed by Sith patrols. At one point, Ixgil's friend was arrested by the Sith, and held in the local Sith base. He was eventually freed by Revan.
Axton Tredway was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the final years of both institutions.

Sodarra was a loyalist Imperial captain and commander of an elite stormtrooper unit. Sodarra's loyalty to Darth Vader put him in conflict with the renegade Imperial Governor-General Nox Vellam in the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin.

Rrynt'vor was a male Nautolan warrior who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Overlord Rrynt'vor was the overseer of the Rak'qua, a tribe of bellicose Nautolan warriors that had taken control of Station Gamma, an asteroid-carved space station in the…

The Fat Man was a greasy, scar-faced individual with small eyes and a rotund build under the employ of Jabba the Hutt. He was the audience for Arica's audition as a dancing girl and in the end hired her for the Hutt.

Gantu was an Ogre native to the forest moon of Endor in the Outer Rim Territories around the time of the Galactic Civil War. Gantu had little use for work, typically acted only for self-interest, and was a short-tempered individual—though he was also afraid of the dark.

Cha-Val Sha-Vak was a former bounty hunter and criminal who was said to have the death sentence in five systems. He wore a cloak and mask that made it impossible to identify his species. He was presumed to be a male because of his size and bulk.
Bedran Veb was a sentient who once told a story to his grandchildren Nara, Frim, and Roop, of the times before the Galactic Republic.
Lenz was the leader of the Workers, in 41 BBY. His face was marked by the paralyzing drug that the Absolutes used on their prisoners.

Shaina Kreen was an Alliance special operative who posed as a waitress at the exclusive Sabre Club of the Ace of Sabres casino. She used her position to gather intelligence on the powerful elite clientele at the club.
Aubro Ahntanda was a male Sullustan slaver who operated the Ahntanda slaving ring.

Naima was a native of the planet Bellassa who was a member of the Eleven resistance group. Around 18 BBY, while Naima and fellow resistance member Terris were piloting V-wing starfighters, they encountered an Imperial starship above Bellassa.

Terris was a member of the Eleven, a resistance group based on the planet Bellassa. Around 18 BBY, while Terris and fellow resistance member Naima were piloting V-wing starfighters, they encountered an Imperial starship above Bellassa.
Laetin A'shera was a Human male pilot for the Car'das during the Galactic Civil War.

Bun'Del was a slightly overweight Human male who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he was present at Tansarii Point Station, a space station located near the planet Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.
Loche Crestingsky was a Human male marksman who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Rydel Delan was a male Sanyassan fighter and martial artist who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Delo was a Rodian male con artist who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he resided aboard Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above the planet Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.

Dreryn was a Arcona officer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Dreryn worked on Tansarii Point Station, a space station near the planet Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.

Mot Draken was a male Bith who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to the Battle of Yavin, he visited Tansarii Point Station, a space station located near the planet Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.
Falrey was a male Human officer of the Galactic Empire who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Jake Felan was a male Human smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Raylen Finn was a male Human hunter who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Frelka was a male Rodian explorer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Lercer Gaia was a male Bothan spy who was living during the Galactic Civil War.
Garek was a male Sullustan spy who worked for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Idau was a male Ithorian who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he was present at Tansarii Point Station, a space station located near the planet Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system. During that time, he expressed frustration at a broken clone terminal.

Deavyn Gils was a male Rodian who lived during the Clone Wars and during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he reside onboard Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.

Rund Jesela was a male Bothan who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he reside onboard Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.

Jolka was a male Zabrak mechanic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he worked at Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.

Jesi was a male Bith merchant who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he resided on board Tansarii Point Station, in the Bright Jewel system, where he worked as a resource vendor.
Antom Moria was a male Human officer who was living during the Galactic Civil War.
Anvar Keyis was a Human businessman who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Dartas Pytin was a Human male ace pilot for the Car'das during the Galactic Civil War.
Aleas Rans'ery was a female Zabrak pilot for the Car'das during the Galactic Civil War.
TK-363 was a male Human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Tiarsis was a Twi'lek businesswoman who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, she resided aboard Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above Ord Mantell in the Bright Jewel system, where she owned the local cantina.
Raine Taske was a male Human trader and artisan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Pacus was a male Human who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he was present at Tansarii Point Station, a space station located near the planet Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system. During that time, Pacus and Irving frequented the station's cantina.
Thrum, a broad-faced, male Fia, was the assistant primate to Primate Persha.
Maghr Scutu was a male Aquala Aqualish criminal who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Mira T'rani was a female Twi'lek entertainer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Ratheb was a male Devaronian who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was the brother of Fidaval, and was married.

Adery Shrial was a female Twi'lek spy who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, she reside onboard Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.

Persha was a female Fian who served as the Primate of Al'solib'minet'ri City on the planet Galantos. Fian Councilor Jobath Knox tasked Persha with greeting Leia Organa Solo and Han Solo, along with the rest of a group of individuals representing the Galactic Federation of Free…
Ysanna was a human female who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Trace was a Human male who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he lived on Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system.
Grell Panib was a human male who served as general of the Bakuran Defense Fleet during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Mota was a member of the Workers class who lived on the planet of New Apsolon. He sold weapons illegally, while the leader of the Workers, Lenz preferred obtaining their weapons legally.

Calquad Dominé was a male member of the Naboo Moon Mining Union and captain of the mining transport Pickaxe. In 23 BBY he protested the opening of Naboo's main ports to refugee transports by refusing to move his ship from Slip 45-J in Kwilaan Starport.
Kalzutan Opreka was the chairperson of the Naboo Moon Mining Union in 22 BBY.
Cromf was a male Garoos bounty hunter working for Mazzic to find the Devaronian Lak Jit. He was successful in his hunt.
The Old Recluse was an ancient Morish spy for the Imperial Remnant at the end of the Galactic Civil War.
Vriss was an admiral in the New Republic. During 19 ABY, he headed to Morishim with an Assault Frigate, the crew of which consisted primarily of Bagmims, Humans, and Povanarians.

Pinchers was a male smuggler who brought supplies to the Kauron system for the Cavrilhu Pirates. In 19 ABY, Jedi Master Luke Skywalker put him in a healing trance on Wistril in order to use his ship to infiltrate the Cavrilhu's base.

Wesselman was the employer of Pinchers who worked out of Amorris and was one of the primary subordinates of the Cavrilhu Pirates. He was in charge of the delivery of shipments to the Kauron system base.
Fulkes was a male pirate with the Cavrilhu Pirates in 19 ABY. Along with Grinner, Fulkes attempt to hunt down Luke Skywalker when he infiltrated their base.
K'Cink was a pirate with the Cavrilhu Pirates in 19 ABY. He worked with Pap in a electronics shop.
Hensing was a male Defel with the Cavrilhu Pirates in 19 ABY.
Krickle was a smuggler in Talon Karrde's association during 19 ABY, serving under Shirlee Faughn aboard the Starry Ice.
Elkin was a male Human smuggler and a member of Talon Karrde's organization in 19 ABY. He was stationed aboard the Starry Ice as a gunner under Commander Shirlee Faughn.
Pormfil was a male Kerestian engineer on board the Wild Karrde in 19 ABY.

Rayl'skar, a male Bothan, was the Clan Askar leader partly blamed for a riot on Bothawui. He and Han Solo were accused of firing on unarmed protesters, while in fact they had been fired on by Imperial Intelligence agents.

Reggi was a male Human with whom Lando Calrissian tried to negotiate in order to hire the Soskin Guard to protect his mining shipments from Varn. Reggi requested 50,000 credits a month for the Guard to work for Calrissian, a payment Lando refused.
Perris was a New Republic commander and the starfighter flight coordinator for the Peregrine during the Caamas Document Crisis.
Sabmin Devist was a clone of Soontir Fel.
Dobrow Devist was a clone of Soontir Fel.
Lacy Devist was a female Human who was married to Carib Devist as of 19 ABY.

Tabric Devist was a clone of Soontir Fel. He was part of a sleeper cell of Fel clones planted by Grand Admiral Thrawn on the planet Pakrik Minor. He later met all of the other members of their sleeper cell, Dobrow, Carib, Sabmin and Hovarb.
Hovarb Devist was a clone of Soontir Fel.
Gharakh was one of Leia Organa Solo's numerous Noghri bodyguards. He accompanied Organa Solo to a meeting with Shada D'ukal at the Orowood Tower during the Caamas Incident.
Yanci was a female Human miner who studied medicine and sympathized with Workers of the planet New Apsolon during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Torgas was at one time the head of the Assassin's Guild. He attempted to assassinate Princess Leia Organa, but was killed by Giles Durane.
The Sentinel, was the name given to the creature that protected an underground city on the planet Alashan. The creature was the byproduct of an ancient complex within the city.

Anarine was a massive Human male and soldier in the Galactic Empire. He held the rank of Fleet Sergeant and was the personal bodyguard of Major Wil'm Grau, serving him throughout the crisis dealing with the Guardian of Forever.
Wil'm Grau was a Human male who served as a commando in the Galactic Empire and held the rank of major around the time of the Battle of Yavin.
Éger Djambo was a Human male stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire.
Voss was a Human male and stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire.
Kevreb Bebo was the captain of the Misanthrope, a ship that crash-landed on D'vouran, a planet that was "created" as part of Project Starscream.

Wes Apice was a male Human civilian who lived on a Confederacy of Independent Systems–controlled planet at some point during the Clone Wars. He; his brother, Bryn; and their friend, Rayt dressed up as clone troopers in order to get off of their war-torn world.
Harch was a Human male who served in the Galactic Empire.
Chal was a crewman of the Wild Karrde in 19 ABY, sometimes serving as a gunner.
Barksy was a young male Human Swoop bike gang member on Pembric II in 19 ABY.

Raines was a Major assigned to the Chimaera around the time of the Caamas Document Crisis in 19 ABY. He was well-versed in AT-AT walker combat, which very likely points to a posting an armor officer within the Imperial Army.
Annowiskri was the medic onboard the Wild Karrde in 19 ABY who treated Shada D'ukal after she was injured.
Jutka was a male Tuhgri from the moon Dayark in the Kathol Outback. In 8 ABY, he was commander of a small starship.

Xern was a male Human slaver and pirate who worked for Rei'Kas in 19 ABY. He and a group of Rei'Kas' men approached Talon Karrde in the Ithor Loman on Dayark threating Talon and scaring off Entoo Nee.
Daberin Devist was the son of Carib and Lacy Devist and brother of Keena Devist.
Keena Devist was the daughter of Carib and Lacy Devist and sister of Daberin Devist.
Uday was a colonel and an Imperial Intelligence analysist who analyzed the recordings of the Clawcraft.
Kerf was a major in the Imperial Remnant and part of spaceport control on Bastion. He informed Moff Vilim Disra of Admiral Gilad Pellaeon's arrival on one occasion.

Sukarian was a Vicebaron on the planet M'haeli who Lando Calrissian and Mara Jade tried to get information out. Mara despised the assignment as she had to play a giddy, no-brained girl due to Sukarian's sexism towards females.
Dreel was a male Chiss pilot of the Hand of Thrawn fortress on Nirauan. He was part of the effort to get Mara Jade there in 19 ABY.
Brosh was a male Chiss soldier who was stationed at the Hand of Thrawn fortress on Nirauan in 19 ABY.
Proy'skyn was an investigator with the Drev'starn Department of Criminal Discouragement who was sent to the Exoticalia Pet Emporium on a tip from Moranda Savich about a break-in.

Morv'vyal was a male Bothan tech with the Drev'starn Department of Criminal Discouragement taking fingerprints and other clues in the break-in of the Exoticalia Pet Emporium. When the others of his team smelled smoke, they suspect there was a fire in the building.
Tanneris was General Garm Bel Iblis' sensor officer onboard the Errant Venture during the Battle of Yaga Minor.
Simons was one of General Garm Bel Iblis' helmsmen onboard the Errant Venture during the Battle of Yaga Minor.
Laynara was a member of Raze's criminal organization.
Ah Kwan was a stocky knife-wielding Human thief with black hair and slanted eyes who was hiding out in Jabba's Palace with his partner Quella in 4 ABY.
Quella was a pale, slender female Human with brown hair. A thief like her partner Ah Kwan, the pair used Jabba's Palace as a hideout in 4 ABY.

Nuuta, a Phindian, was the father of Kaadi. One of the renewed, he had been sent to Alba. He was most likely alive as of 44 BBY, when Kaadi and the Derida brothers, Guerra and Paxxi, overthrew the Syndicat.
Kaadi was a Phindian who was good friends with the Derida brothers, Paxxi and Guerra, and assisted them in their uprising against the Syndicat in 44 BBY. Her father, Nuuta, was one of the renewed.
Pash Deven was a Rebel commander. Deven was in charge of the failed operation on Dennaskar.
Kayala Ravein was a female Human from Alderaan.

Rava Teb'lya was the female Bothan owner of the Rose Nebula massage parlor, located on Coruscant. She used her Bothan spying skills and experience in extravagance to glean information from her influential clients and sold it to the highest bidder.

Tanner Helton was a male Alliance SpecForce urban guerrilla and smuggler. Ebenn Q3 Baobab once provided Tanner with funds to smuggle medical supplies past Imperial blockades and into the Outer Rim, though Baobab oddly claimed that the funds were for deceased Supreme Chancellor…

Gundark was the alias of an arms dealer who led his own arms ring and published the illegal datalog Gundark's Gear Datalog. He operated primarily in the Outer Rim, having been spotted on Elshandruu Pica, in the Minos Cluster, and the Parmic sector.
Delta 42 was Delta Squad's LAAT pilot who gave them various air support and extractions. They helped Delta Squad out of an exploding Core ship on Geonosis.
Russell Wake was a male individual who worked as a security officer in a company of Bellassa until he became a janitor at the very end of the Clone Wars.
Bini was female Human miner who sympathized with the Workers of the planet New Apsolon.

Kevta was a male Human miner who sympathized with the Workers of New Apsolon. In 41 BBY, he, along with Yanci and Bini were confused by Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn, Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi and Eritha, believing that they were members of the Absolutes.
Shaara was the daughter of moisture farmers who, at the age of fifteen, performed a "droid" act wrapped in kelsh in a cantina on the edge of Mos Eisley owned by Dakkar the Distant.

Kamma was the son of moisture farmers on Tatooine with two siblings: A brother who became a skiff guard for Jabba the Hutt and Shaara, who performed a "droid" act in Mos Eisley. He was killed when stormtroopers were chasing Shaara.
The last Satab of the planet Ventooine ruled with absolute power over his people for about one year some time before the Battle of Yavin.

Nautag d'al' Gargan II was an Askajian, the son of Nautag and Yarna d'al' Gargan and brother of Luka and Leia d'al' Gargan. He was named after his father who died trying to prevent his family's enslavement by Jabba the Hutt.
Graekus Shubelle was the administrator of Hologram Fun World, a space station and amusement park located in the Zabian system of the Outer Rim Territories, by 22 BBY.
Nura Tinall was a Rebel who operated near Moenia, Naboo.
Kane Starkiller was the Jedi father of Annikin Starkiller and his brother Deak Starkiller. His homeworld was Aquilae.
Murquan was an Imperial Moff who governed the Lorn system during the Galactic Civil War.
Arlem Demonhunter was a Black Sun starfighter ace during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Demonhunter was a hero of the Blacksun and rumored to have taken on a whole Car'das fleet single-handedly.
Shela Jalahafi was a dark-haired female Human and a Dark Side Adept who was part of a team entrusted by Emperor Palpatine to infiltrate spies and agents into the ranks of the Rebel Alliance.
Teles Jalahafi was a male Human and a Dark Side Adept, whose home planet was Edan II. The brother of Shela Jalahafi, Teles Jalahafi served the Galactic Empire as a Dark Side adept, like his sister.
Kairn was a boy from Necropolis who befriended the visiting Zak Arranda. He was known as a daredevil, and led a group of adventurous boys.
Stagorr was a Force-sensitive male Ice Demon who resided on the forest moon of Endor. He had the ability to freeze surfaces with even a passing touch, as well as a remedial talent in Force lightning.
The Security Officer at the Peragus Mining Facility oversaw the security of the station by the time of the Skirmish at Peragus II in 3951 BBY.
Dark Mara was a Force-manifested doppelgänger that appeared to Mara Jade on Dromund Kaas in 10 ABY.
The dock officer at the Peragus Mining Facility was responsible for the hangar where the Ebon Hawk landed.
Tandres was an admiral in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Tandres was present at a ceremony near the Kuat system where Executor was officially commissioned.
Tavares was a Human male and an Admiral who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

Kamida was an Ewok princess during the era of the Galactic Civil War. Kamida was courted by Tippet, a respected Ewok warrior, in 4 ABY, when Hiromi saboteur Hirog—looking to incite conflict between the Ewoks and the Lahsbees—framed Kamida for having an affair with a Lahsbee de…

Wrrlevgebev (or Wrrl to his friends) was a male Wookiee bodyguard who served the I'att Armament on Druckenwell after the founders' granddaughter, Tinian I'att saved him from the beatings of a slave dealer. This earned I'att a life debt.

Strephan I'att was a Human male who was the co-founder of I'att Armament, along with his wife, Augusta in Il Avali, Druckenwell during the Galactic Civil War. With a length of Imperial service under his belt, that was precisely whom he sold his weapons to.
Augusta I'att was a Human female who co-founded I'att Armament with her husband, Strephan and was the grandmother to Tinian and great-grandmother to Tam Azur-Jamin respectively.

Twilit Hearth was the blue-eyed female Human who worked as a singer of a band and partner of Sprig Cheever at Happy's Landing on Druckenwell. She wore clothes enhancing her physical shape. She allowed Tinian I'att to take her place on stage in order to avoid stormtrooper pursuit.
Sprig Cheever (nicknamed Cheeve) was a bearded Human male KeyBed player of a band at Happy's Landing on Druckenwell.
Yccakic was a male Bith Bottom Viol player who was part of a band in Happy's Landing on Druckenwell during the Galactic Civil War.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: Ninora Birt was a former freelance smuggler and owner of the Record Time. She joined the New Republic Defense Force during the Yuuzhan Vong War, serving in the Battle of Borleias as the captain of the Record Time and later as a pilot in Blackmoon Squadron under Luke Skywalker …
Jubal was a Devaronian who was living on the planet Tatooine in the years immediately before the Battle of Yavin.
Janos Marsh served as the starship computer expert on board the scout vessel Bright Seeker.
Raptor was a fish-like bounty hunter who joined Magus and three other bounty hunters to assassinate twenty planetary leaders at a conference on Rondai-2.
Woyiq was a loud Human male with a large build and connections to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Comus specialized in creating false or duplicate identification, such as the one for Twilit Hearth.
Wert Jopi was a Gungan on Naboo who was believed to be Force-sensitive.

An unidentified Queen of Naboo reigned sometime during the Gungan-Naboo War. Because the last heir of the then-current dynasty died in combat and had not decided who would succeed him, the Naboo elected a queen to lead them in the war.
Rinto Liprus was a male personal assistant of Ebenn Q3 Baobab.
Jesco Comark was a human male Chandrilan Moff of the Galactic Empire who was installed as governor of Chandrila during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.
In her new role as an Alliance spy, Comark came across information on her father's new project, Operation Death-Hunter.
Tardon Golor was a Twi'lek starship thief, who operated during the early years of the New Republic. Golor even managed to steal B-Wing and X-Wing starfighters from the New Republic.
Ulicx Vinaq was a Devaronian merchant known for his many facial piercings.
Desh was a male Imperial Governor who controlled Gandrossi VI, located in the Perinn sector in the Outer Rim Territories during the Galactic Civil War.
Marius was a Human male who served as vizier on a technologically-inept planet to his brother, King Cleroff. He was also the uncle of Cleroff's daughter, Princess Risa.

Dælar vuv Tertarrnek was a male Covallon who worked as a mole for the Rebel Alliance. Due to his species bestial appearance the Rebels were able to pass him off as a pet and gift him to Moff Harlov Jarnek.

S'ybll was a Mind-witch who lived on the planet Seidhkona for many years until being encountered by an exploratory team sent by the Galactic Empire. S'ybll leeched the life energy from the Imperial force and discovered that the draining of their energy had made her young again.

Zal Tuag Th'Trar was a Coynite from the planet of Coyn who was sympathetic to the Rebel Alliance. Due to this, he met with many offworlders and regularly reported back to his father on the events of the Galactic Civil War. Fellow Coynite, Zal Afreg Kt'Aya was a rival of his.
Zal Afreg Kt'Aya was a Coynite who lived during the Galactic Civil War. His chief rival at the time was Zal Tuag Th'Trar.
Adana Vermor was an Imperial Economics Advisor who monitored economic activities of the Galactic Empire. She was unknowingly Force sensitive, which helped her in managing the Empire's resources.

Kyli Ned'Ix was a male Verpine adventurer and technician. Able to repair or modify almost any type of equipment, Ned'Ix found himself on the planet Kal'Shebbol in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories in 8 ABY.
Zo'Tannath was a female Human bounty hunter who worked for the highest bidder.
Farnak was a tamed male husk lizard who was the pet of Sanglui. He would perch on his master's arm and yip beseechingly whenever food was near.
Regul Staganac was an operative for the Rebel Alliance who worked at the Tallaani Shipyards, shortly after the Battle of Hoth.

Ten Dorne was a Sluissi who worked on Admiral Gial Ackbar's Shantipole Project, the development of the A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter with complete access to Verpine shipyard facilities in the Roche asteroid field.
Pendor Gyrr was a female Givin criminal active during the days of the New Republic. Although she tried her hand with smuggling and black market sales, she made her fortune by counterfeiting credits.

Fizz was a member of the Senate Security Committee, where he had a brilliant career and became an acquaintance of Qui-Gon Jinn, meeting the young apprentice, Obi-Wan Kenobi, through him. After that, he worked as a mechanic on the Kronex spaceport.
Vortia Kwis was the captain of the Pure Sabacc. Kwis agreed to ferry refugees from Dubrillion to Dantooine shortly after the Battle of Dubrillion.
A male Firrerreo was forced to watch the destruction of his homeworld and then held captive aboard one of Procurator of Justice Hethrir's passenger freighters.
Dice Ibegon was a Force-sensitive Lamproid, a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and the lover of Lak Sivrak, whom she convinced to join the Alliance.
Kolor Delan was the founder and leader of Pendarran's Revenge, an armed organization that fought against the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Gendal Delan was a male Human and the founder of the Pendarran Warriors, who fought alongside the Jedi Order and the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Sires Vant was a male Devaronian loanshark and member of Valis Lorn's organization during the early years of the New Republic. Vant was based on Andasala and controlled much of the underworld money-lending on the planet.
Ghundrak was an Imperial Moff who governed Thrasybule sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Gorliz was an Imperial Moff who oversaw the trial of Reson Nath and Imperial Prefect Adar.
Reson Nath was a female Human who worked as a bounty hunter, operating during the Galactic Civil War. She was a member of House Paramexor.
Jennie Lee Taggar was a starfighter pilot with the Rebel Alliance. She flew a Y-wing at the Battle of Endor. She died while attacking a Star Destroyer.
A Neimoidian captain captained Aurorient Express, a luxury liner owned by Clode Rhoden.

Riit Jandi was an Imperial Moff who seized control of Elshandruu Pica shortly after the Battle of Endor. His wife, Aellyn, some forty years younger than Riit, conducted a secret affair with Sair Yonka.

Linis was an Imperial Moff who governed Zaric sector from Korev VII during the Galactic Civil War. Linis placed a 25,000 credit bounty on the head of the Wookiee Cherioer, who often assisted the Rebel Alliance.
Halabar was an Mon Calamari professor during the Galactic Civil War.
Marakoloon was a male Whiphid bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War.

Sartar was an Imperial Moff who directed the development of Fire-Rain 3, a deadly bio-agent. The chemical weapon was developed at supply depot I-389, located on Tatooine, sometime after the Battle of Yavin.
Renquet was an Imperial Moff during the Galactic Civil War.
Tranira Trell was the mother of Vimran Trell. When the Empire invaded their homeworld, Yutusk, Tranira and her husband, Francill were executed as suspected Rebel Alliance sympathizers.

Francill Trell was the father of Vimran Trell. It was he who taught his son to cook. When the Empire invaded their homeworld, Yutusk, Francill and his wife, Tranira, were executed as suspected Rebel Alliance sympathizers.

Vimran Trell was a Human from the planet Yutusk who was a chef and Rebel spy, during the Galactic Civil War. He served on board the Star Destroyer Adjudicator around 0 ABY where he fed vital intelligence to the Rebellion.
Lorin was an Imperial Moff who governed the Fakir sector during the Galactic Civil War. He was considered a prime candidate for rule in the power struggles following Emperor Palpatine's death.
Jaan was an Imperial Moff during the Galactic Civil War. Jaan attended the New Year Fete Week alongside Grand Admiral Rufaan Tigellinus and Grand Moff Traeda.
Elior was an Imperial Moff during the Galactic Civil War. He was known as a skilled sabacc player.
Nebin Cray was a male Imperial Moff who governed the Trans-Nebular sector and the planet Goroth Prime during the Galactic Civil War.
Sludd was a male Alzarian First General to King Gokus of Alzar's forces. He was behind an elaborate scheme to overthrow the king and conquer the nearby planet Sooma.

Van P. Quist was a male Human who owned The Droid Store on R-Duba. The droids R2-D2 and C-3PO counted on him to find them a new master, which he did. They were different masters, however, causing the droids to be separated.

Kirk Windjammer was a Human male from the planet Vanqor. His profession was the shipping of goods in his anti-grav loader, the Seaskimmer. Upon losing a droid at sea, he purchased R2-D2 as a replacement from droid salesman Van P.
Gavern Starlock was a baron and advisor to Prince Jagoda of R-Duba. He purchased C-3PO to act as a translator to the prince.

Nikk Zavod was a Human male who worked as a bounty hunter. He claimed to know the location of Chewbacca, whom he intended to collect the bounty on. Needing a ship, he seduced Mala Mala, lured her to enter the exhaust of her own ship while he was in the cockpit, and blasted off.

Krag was a captain of the Zorbian space pirates. During the Imperial Era, he sought a valuable Gemwood tree. Knowing that such a plant was owned by the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village, he led an expedition to the Forest Moon of Endor.
Dooni was a baby Foonar who lived on the forest moon of Endor. He was the offspring of the herd's leader.
Nerrowr was a Wookiee who, along with the Rodians Nesha, Besha, and Kesha, once worked for Riboga the Hutt.

Vant fled in terror back to Jerne City on a jetpack as his stormtroopers were slaughtered, where he was confronted by the Sith Lord Darth Vader, who had come to Jerne to spring a trap of his own—he intended to lure Skywalker and Organa into an ambush at Adony Station with rumo…

Meeka Reen was a Human female leader of insurgent forces on the planet Jerne. Between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, she encountered two Rebels, Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa, who revealed to her the whereabouts of an ancient crystal that could supposedly control time.
Skutch was a Human male who fought as one of Meeka Reen's anti-Imperial pirates-turned-guerrillas on Jerne during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
He tried to sell Millennium's newest prototype, the Millennium Falcon, to the Galactic Empire.
Carp was a Human male in the employ of Millennium Astro-Engineering. He was apparently an aide or an advisor to Zoltan Starkid.

Terri Karl was a female Human member of the Rebel Alliance based on Lianna during the later years of the Galactic Civil War. Karl used her cover as a socialite to conceal her true role, a cell organizer for the Alliance.
Darren T. Weeb was a smuggler and captain of the freighter Arcadia during the Galactic Civil War.
Salishh Tilloman was a Devaronian con-artist during the Galactic Civil War.
Venlyss Pnorr was a well-known male Gand findsman, a Force-sensitive religious tradition of bounty hunters, during the Galactic Civil War.

affiliation: Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services
x: Korren Starchaser was a scout for the New Republic's Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services since its inception, and flew his own custom-built starship, the Jedi Dreamer. He was the first to chart the Serias system and recovered artifacts from The Gulch.

Ty Matthews was a young male Human Lieutenant who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic around the time of the Bakura Truce in 4 ABY. He joined the Rebellion on his fifteenth birthday. His father was Colonel Tev Matthews.
Valtis was a member of the Virgillian Free Alignment and the Rebel Alliance. He was the pilot of the Flurry.
Ellsworth was an aide of Imperial Governor Wilek Nereus on Bakura.

Vane was a male Bakuran who was sent by Wilek Nereus to start trouble with the Rebel Alliance on the landing pad they were assigned to. He and several others mistook a Mon Calamari for a Ssi-ruu, resulting in the deaths of two Bakurans.

Rigell was the captain of the Compellor, an Immobilizer 418 cruiser. Rigell joined with Battlegroup Orion to pursue and destroy the Liberty. However, the Liberty wanted the Compellor to pursue them so that they would be lured into an ambush.

Chirita was an Ewok female who lived in the Bright Tree Village on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, she participated in the fight against the Imperial Doctor Raygar's droids, although she was no match for them and was defeated.

Buzzy was a Human male who lived in Tropis-on-Varonat on the planet Varonat. He was employed by Gamgalon, a Krish crimelord who used Morodin-hunting expeditions as a front for growing and harvesting chemically altered aleudrupe berries.
Fleck was a male Human under the employ of Gamgalon on Varonat in 8 ABY. He and Buzzy greeted Talon Karrde and Quelev Tapper when they arrived on Varonat.
Tamish was a male Thennqora hunter who traveled to Varonat to hunt Morodin. He bagged a Morodin alongside the Saffa, Cob-caree.

Cob-caree was a wealthy Saffa male who embarked upon a Morodin-hunting expedition on the planet Varonat in 8 ABY. Joining an expedition led by the Krish, Falmal, Cob-caree was successful in killing a Morodin alongside the Thennqora, Tamish.
Falmal was a male Krish who was part of the organization controlled by Gamgalon. One of his most trusted lieutenants, he was often employed in positions of authority.
Hav was a male Duros hunter who traveled to Varonat with Jivis in order to hunt for Morodin.
Jivis was a Duros male hunter who participated in a Morodin safari on the planet Varonat with Hav.
Detien Kaileel was a male Kabieroun who served as a Security Chief on board the Kuari Princess during the Galactic Civil War.
Elta Besk was the head of Dynamic Automata, a droid design and manufacturing corporation. She inherited the role from her father, Metron Besk, who founded the company.

Durne was a Cantrosian intelligence operative. In 4 ABY, Durne was hired by the Nagai commander Knife to sow conflict between two Rebel Alliance–supporting resistance groups in the Cantros system by convincing the members of each faction that the other was loyal to the Galacti…

Grakkata was a female Wookiee who managed to escape from Imperial slavery some time during the Galactic Civil War. She hid out within Elrood sector and eventually became a pirate, attacking Imperial convoys with her starship, the Treespirit.
Maga was a garoo or medicine-man of a Dantari tribe on Dantooine. One year after the Battle of Yavin, Mammon Hoole and Zak and Tash Arranda sought refuge from the Galactic Empire among Maga's tribe.

Bobringi Mafusa was a Mon Calamari who celebrated his Life Day aboard the luxury star-cruiser Star of Empire. He was served special Mon Calamari crab-stuffed creampuffs. Over his table was hung a banner reading "Happy Life Day, Bobringi Mafusa. You're one fine Mon Calamari".
Karkas was an t'bac-addicted murderer wanted in two dozen systems. He killed over ninety-one individuals, marking their foreheads with the letter "K".
Qan Gindoch was a male Human who made his living as a smuggler during the Galactic Civil War.
Graf Yonna was a native of the planet Bront and fought with the Rebel Alliance against the Empire around 0 BBY.
Rokna was Princess Kneesaa's bordok. Kneesaa took Rokna with her when looking for her long-lost sister, Asha.
Katykam was a male albino Wookiee who worked as Crying Dawn Singer's stage manager. He wore loose black pants and a red vest, and smoked a clay pipe.

Ranzar Malk, also known as "Ran," was a human male criminal who operated on the Roost space station. He was a former partner of bounty hunter Din Djarin, and continued to work after Djarin left his crew.

Lunkar An was a male Rellarin scout and a veteran of the Galactic Outdoor Survival School. Powerfully-built, An was noticeable because of his thick dark brown skin, his small black eyes and his oversized hands.
Norrion Glidamir was a Lorrdian Human and a major in the Rebel Alliance.
Maashan was a male Kamarian Badlander and a Rebel Alliance member.
Larq Thur was a scout and a member of the Rebel Alliance.
Atin Attan was a Sullustan pilot who was a member of the Galactic Outdoor Survival School's Twilight Class who later joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Kiras Torla was a Human living during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Around 10 BBY, Torla was a member of Twilight Class at the Galactic Outdoor Survival School. During her studies, Torla became a close friend of the GOSS staff, including the dean Barosa Warren.
Clenna was a former Imperial sergeant and later a drill sergeant for the Galactic Outdoor Survival School.
Dorlar was a Brubb instructor at the Galactic Outdoor Survival School. In 0 ABY, Dorlar met Myo on Tatooine. A friendly individual and generous with drinks, Dorlar soon became Myo's friend.
Stren Grier was a former Human male Imperial scout and later a staff member of the Galactic Outdoor Survival School.

Casti Tholon was a female Human scout. Hailing from the Core Worlds world Sardoran, she was raised by Duros foster parents in a Duro system space city where she only knew Duros and their culture, to the point where she considered herself a Duros and felt more comfortable among…

Barosa Warren was a male Morellian lawman, an expert survivalist, and chancellor of the Galactic Outdoor Survival School, with a personal vendetta against those former students of his who had joined the Rebel Alliance.
Diran Miciluz was a weapons designer working for Hydrospeare Corporation.
Sere Lure was a Chief Systems Engineer working for Hydrospeare Corporation.
Mosara Thiirn was a Human female Rebel technician, and later a field engineer for Hydrospeare Corporation. She began working as a Rebel SpecForce technician, stationed aboard a technical frigate.
Shaparo was a Rebel Alliance agent. He was the owner of the astromech droid R2-Q8. He used its Intellex IV droid brain to access prison records of the Dnalvec garrison on Sriluur.
Tolum Harous was a scientist working for Hydrospeare Corporation during the times of the Galactic Empire.
Plo Smarx was a scientist working for Hydrospeare Corporation.
Randle Clanse was a female Brosin and a local hero on Brosi due to her role as founder and leader of the Brosin Underground.
Vuraj Marn was a Brosin resistance fighter and a member of the Brosin Underground.
Abil Vilorin was an agent with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Wasith was a supervisor for the Corporate Sector Authority. The commanding officer of the CSA on Brosi, Wasith was responsible for the Zinsian processing plants. Wasith found trouble when dealing with the Brosin Underground, a resistance group opposing to the CSA's methods.
Callandri was a female Human assassin and the leader of the Granse Confederacy.
Tiron Til was a Sullustan gangster, owner of a criminal syndicate. At some point before 1 ABY, Til contracted fugitive smuggler Zayl Braith, which led to a good relationship between both of them.
Arcuse was a male Ubese bounty hunter and a member of the Granse Confederacy.
Rodick Tag was an Iotran Braceman who later became a bounty hunter working for the Granse Confederacy.
Milacass was a Kerestian bounty hunter and a member of the Granse Confederacy.
