Vadon Lenitor was a female Rodian bounty hunter and a member of the Granse Confederacy.

Kalon Lenitor was a Rodian and a legendary ghestslayer. He lived with his family in an island south-east of Equator City. He fathered an only child, his daughter Vadon, and he and the rest of the loving family raised her in their ways.

Unni Yerudi was the name taken by a claqa, or group mind, of Bilars. Like other Bilar claqas, Unni Yerudi was made up of several Bilars which, while capable of only animal intelligence on their own, formed a sentient collective intelligence when together.
Ne'lear was a Kian'thar loan shark. Some years before 2 ABY, Ne'lear hired Gand findsman Lu'daal-ud.
Patel Odfath was a Rebel operative. Odfath was holding some key datafiles when he was captured by bounty hunter Lu'daal-ud around 1 ABY or 2 ABY.
Durm was the New Republic captain of the First Citizen during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Tavier was badly wounded in a botched assassination attempt by the traitorous Jael Ganton Farvash; Ganton was sentenced to execution, though he used an old Bitthævrian tradition to force an injured Tavier into accepting a hand-to-hand a…
Major Jael Ganton Farvash was a Bitthævrian, a member of m'Yalfor'ac Order and a would-be usurper.
Zoul Minchov Dwæer was a female Bitthævrian.
Kaltor Naklian was a Ka'hren scholar, swordmaster, scalp hunter and founder and priest of the Ni'Shaw-Dak Ministry.
Tyrimm Wyln was a female Togorian farmer.
Cene Gilvent was a female Ocsinin swordsbeing.
Ther-das was an Arcona weapons expert and the leader of the Zulirian Swordmasters.
Denuab Venithon was an Ithorian pirate and one half of the Venithon Twins.
Dorin Venithon was an Ithorian pirate and a half of the Venithon Twins.

Ompiach was an infamous Nalroni pirate and the leader of the Hy'thor pirate group by 2 ABY. Operating solely in the Outer Rim's Mieru'kar sector, Ompiach created a leadership council to manage certain affairs in his rigidly hierarchical organization, designing it so that the c…

Ssach'thirix was a Shatras bounty hunter operating during the Galactic Civil War. He usually carried a light repeating blaster, a blaster pistol, and grenades as weapons of choice, plus manacles and an Imperial Peace Keeping Cerfiticate.
Larkor was a Barabel and a member of the Rebel Alliance. A bounty on Larkor's head was claimed by bounty hunter Ssach'thirix.
Thlan-sa was a Kath and a member of the Rebel Alliance. A bounty on Thlan-sa's head was claimed by bounty hunter Ssach'thirix.
Kichiir was a Wookiee associate of Rebel agents Xenon Nnaksta and Adazian Liebke.
Kal-tan-shi was a male Tiss'shar who worked as a bounty hunter during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Tfin was a Rebel general. Tfin was captured alongside General Wuvnir by bounty hunter Kal-tan-shi on Yuhli Docking Port 32, sometime before 2 ABY.
Wuvnir was a Rebel general, who was captured alongside General Tfin by bounty hunter Kal-tan-shi on Yuhli Docking Port 32 sometime before 2 ABY.

Tir'uh was a Noehon female criminal and a high-ranking member of the Mytaranor Slaving Council. A successful slaver, Tir'uh was considered a threat by the Task Force on Alliance Security, who mistakenly believed her to be the leader of the Council.
Rian Rann was a Sullustan pilot and a high-ranking member of the Mytaranor Slaving Council.

Fru Kalg was a Quarren who served as an operative in the Rebel Alliance. Kalg was captured while on the shipyards of Dac sometime between 1 ABY and 2 ABY. Talas Piran of the Mytaranor Slaving Council was suspected of being the person responsible for Kalg's disappearance.
Karalan was a Krish smuggler and a member of the security staff of the Mytaranor Slaving Council.
C'ar L'andara was a Twi'lek female dancer for Moff Julstan during the Imperial Era before she escaped his palace located in the Arkanis sector around 2 ABY.

Talas Piran was a Locan male who had been a slave. Later in his life, he became the leader of the Mytaranor Slaving Council. From the world of Loce, he had light purplish-blue skin and black mottled arms.
Beatas was a dark-green-skinned Klatooinian mercenary and the operative leader of Ploovo's Protocol Team.

Thar Lasan was a Gotal Loan shark working in the Corporate Sector. The criminal organization led by Lasan included Klatooinian mercenary Beatas. Around 5 BBY, Lasan died unexpectedly, probably due to some intervention by rival crimelord Ploovo Two-For-One.

Shanda Dok was a colonel in the Rebel Alliance. During the subjugation of Fitca Prime by Imperial Intelligence interrogator Mox Slosin, Dok took part in the first Alliance support wave on Fitca Prime. Unfortunately, she was captured and interrogated by Slosin.
Llalik's family included his wife, Dr. Loran Llalik and three children: a son (the eldest child), Dr. Nashiak Llalik, and Rebel agent Saren Llalik.

Loran Llalik was a Human female scientist and doctor who lived on the planet Plavin 6 with her family. Llalik's family included her husband, Doctor Nash Llalik, and their three children: An oldest son, Doctor Nashiak Llalik, and Rebel agent Saren Llalik.

Yansan was a Ho'Din male saboteur. An ecology student on his native Moltok, Yansan always despised technology to a fanatic extent—even for a Ho'Din. He concluded that the evils of technology were too big and that he should "free" the galaxy from technology.
Callow Batta was a university teacher and a pirate.
Cinto Alaras was a male Human medical engineer.

Sommen was an agent who worked for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. As a part of an infiltration mission, Sommen worked as a medical engineer for Neuro-Saav Corporation on Tauber. He was design-station neighbor to Dr. Cinto Alaras.
Lina Mardec was a Human female. She lived in Jalor City with her husband Riic, a cab driver, and two daughters, Sale and Fora.
She lived in Jalor City with her parents Riic and Lina, and a sister Fora.

Fora Mardec was a Human female who lived in Jalor City with her parents Riic and Lina, and a sister Sale. In 2 ABY, all of the Mardecs save Riic died in the crossfire when the Galactic Empire attacked a Rebel cell.
Risiev Credal was a male Human lieutenant who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Yurdak Fav was a female Shistavanen scout.
In 2 ABY, Blazer, as a member of the Rebel Alliance Task Force, wrote several intelligence reports of threats to the Alliance.

affiliation: Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services
x: Deeve was an Arpor-Lan scout who served the Rebel Alliance. Using skills he had learned on his native planet Arporatal-Lanin, Deeve became one of the most respected scouts in the Alliance after scouting Wild Space and the Unknown Regions, as well as exploring the planet Apliri…
Tynan Ryln Mei was a Togorian criminal and Rebel Alliance intelligence agent.
Ayla Shar was a miner and a Rebel Alliance Intelligence lieutenant.
Tole Warren was a half-Human, half-Morellian officer of the Rebel Alliance.

After the end of the Rebel Alliance, Lieutenant Commander Liebke joined the Special Forces of the New Republic and survived an assassination attempt staged by his former partner turned fugitive Ma'w'shiye.
Sisquoc was a male Samuac scout and a member of Rebel Alliance Intelligence.

Clanson was a member of Alliance Intelligence. Major Sisquoc, a scout and fellow Intelligence officer, requested that Clanson and any other willing operative to accompany him and other members of his team when they planned to confront Barosa Warren, who had been targeting form…
Tirranna was a female Wookiee and a member of the Rebel Alliance Task Force.
Grunts was a male Weequay owned by Lady Valarian on the planet Tatooine, before being won by Han Solo in a game of Sabacc. Solo set Grunts free as soon as they left the Lucky Despot.
Chackron Nasplek was an Mon Calamari who started a courier delivery service sometime after the Galactic Civil War.
Garrik Trier was an Admiral in the Imperial Navy.
Oshay was a member of Samuel Tomas Gillespee's group of smugglers during the early years of the New Republic.
Wutzek was the last remaining Force demon known to exist during the Imperial Era. A member of an extremely powerful race that once ruled the galaxy in its distant past.
Orun Depp was the Imperial Prefect of Mos Eisley at the time of the Battle of Yavin, appointed by Governor Tour Aryon. He was killed by the assassin droid IG-72 in the year 0 ABY.
Llalik was also the younger sister of Doctor Nashiak Llalik, a developer of armor technology who, unlike his sister, chose to work for the Galactic Empire.
Andrephan Stormcaller was a Rebel Alliance officer.
Detta Rotan was a Rebel Alliance cell leader, based in Jalor City on the planet Gotida.

Zhir-Khan found fugitive Zayl Braith during a routine stay on Ord Mantell. Braith should not have been on Ord Mantell, as she had recently made an attack there. Curious about her presence, Zhir-Khan assigned Agent Shofeld to keep an eye on her.
N'tain Xalis was an agent who served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Carlio was a Rebel agent and a member of the Sandwind Team on Tatooine. Carlio, along with Swanze, was one of the Sandwind operatives to spot the Jundland Banshee. The Banshee was at Beggar's Canyon.
Swanze was a Rebel agent and a member of the Sandwind Team active on Tatooine. Swanze spotted the Jundland Banshee at Nomad Gulch.
Palpatine Essex Yerac, more commonly known as P. Essex Yerac, was a Rebel Alliance Lieutenant Colonel.
Stieg Wa was a transport pilot during the time of the Old Republic.

Illiv Orfa was a Twi'lek Dark Jedi on Mustafar in 1 ABY. During her time on Mustafar, she stole a serpent-like crystal from a sleeping Mustafarian. The Mustafarian, Ikt, hired a spacer to hunt her down and retrieve his crystal.
Celia was a female Codru-Ji dancer. She worked for Mawbo Kem and was present when the Killik Twilight was stolen by Kitster Chanchani Banai. Han Solo and Celia had met previously.
Braedic Ekirk was a Human male Imperial officer who served the Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Voss Parck's father was a native of Corulag who pursued a career in the navy, eventually captaining a capital ship. His son, Voss Parck, graduated from Corulag Academy and fought for the Galactic Republic in the Clone Wars.

Voss Parck's grandfather was a Corulag native who received a commission in an unknown fleet and eventually rose to the position of captain of a capital ship. He fathered at least two children, one of them a son.

Arali Dil was a female Twi'lek student at Garqi Agricultural University and friend of Dynba Tesc. She was one of many students who were disgruntled with the Galactic Empire and began slicing into their mainframe on Garqi.

Sihha was a male Bothan student of astrogation at Garqi Agricultural University and friend of Dynba Tesc. He was one of many students who were disgruntled with the Galactic Empire and began slicing into their mainframe on Garqi.

Saricia was a Devaronian crewmember of the Star's Delight. He had one broken horn and several missing teeth. He and the rest of the crew of the Delight were captured on Garqi by Imperials after trying to sell parts of a X-wing starfighter.
Dap Nechel was an alien engineer onboard the Kuari Princess in 0 BBY who enjoyed watching B'shingh matches between Celia Durasha and Detien Kaileel.
Kelsa Vilrein was the hostess and ticket taker aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess. She was a dark haired woman.
Jak Durasha was a Human male who was one of Reise Durasha's sons and served on board the Relentless during the Galactic Civil War.

Reise Durasha was a Human male from Lankashiir who served as Commander in the Imperial Army during the Galactic Civil War. He was also the father of Jak and Bern Durasha and the twins Celia and Raine Durasha.
Bern Durasha was a Human male who was one of the sons of Reise Durasha and brother of Celia Durasha. He was a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire with an armored battalion in the Atrivis sector.

Raban was a security officer onboard the Kuari Princess under Security Chief Detien Kaileel. He reported an incident to Kaileel regarding a fight between two passengers occurring in the Galleria Shop.

Brankton was a security officer onboard the Kuari Princess, working under Security Chief Detien Kaileel. While orbiting Mantooine, Brankton was assigned to deal with a fight between two passengers in the Galleria Shop.

Shannon Voorson was a Human female who joined the Rebel Alliance at the age of nine. Born in 6 BBY to Kuat Freight Port officials Johan and Nell Voorson, she lived the first nine years of her life on Kuat.

Nell Voorson was a Human female who was the wife of Johan Voorson, the mother of Shannon Voorson and the aunt of Deen Voorson during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, she had been promoted to Senior Docking Officer for Kuat Freight Port.
Johan Voorson was a Human male technician who was the husband of Nell Voorson, the father of Shannon Voorson, and the uncle of Deen Voorson.

Boo Rawl was a Human male independent freight hauler from the planet Hazzard. A staunch believer in the proposition that individuals were free to run their lives as they chose without governmental interference, Rawl possessed one of the largest private music collections by art…
Caton was the Human male commander of the Imperial prison on Selnesh.

Lex Kempo, nicknamed Mad Vornskr, was a mercenary with the Red Moons. Earlier in his career he had been a Scout trooper with the Galactic Empire and claimed to have been in a dozen different private armies and militias.

Brixie Ergo, or Miss Brix as she was called by Lex Kempo, was a former medical student and female mercenary with the Red Moons who joined Red Moon with the motivation to free her parents who had been enlisted by the Pentastar Alignment as field surgeons.

Sully Tigereye was a Trunsk who had been a former Elite Commando infiltrator unit member with the New Republic serving directly under Colonel Andrephan Stormcaller and who followed him to the mercenary group, Red Moons.

Hugo Cutter was a son of Imperial nobility who was enrolled at the Imperial Engineers Academy, but instead of fixing things, he gained a love for demolitions and was disbarred from the academy for destroying equipment.

Greezim Trentacal was a bulky slavemaster for the Karazak Slavers Cooperative on Gabredor III who worked with the Pentastar Alignment and kidnapped two children of a businessman who was trying to defect to the New Republic.

Vex was the personal bodyguard of Greezim Trentacal and ran the Karazak Slavers Cooperative outpost on Gabredor III. He killed a mute slave girl after she may have killed Greezim and then fought the Trunsk Sully Tigereye, who tore him to pieces.
Tamaron was a male clan leader of the Airam who agreed to join the Alliance to Restore the Republic during their campaign into the Airam sector.

Massif was a prisoner within the Cog Hive Seven facility by the year 33 BBY. Massif was a member of the Bone Kings gang and a lieutenant to the gang's leader, Vasco Nailhead. Security guard Augustine Smight considered Massif an "animal."
Dustini Spa Ronii was a male Duros archaeologist from the planet Duro. He appealed to the Alliance for help for his subjugated world. His cousin was Dustangle.
This Queen Mother ruled the Hapes Consortium around 3100 BBY, and was responsible for sealing its borders to the outside galaxy, a situation that would last until 8 ABY.

Yarith Figg was a lesser noble female from Alderaan and the wife of explorer Ecclessis Figg. Yarith met her husband on a luxury liner running along the Corellian Trade Spine, where Ecclessis ended up saving her life.

Whoever was a loyal Imperial captain stationed in the Interrogation Center on Selnesh under the command of Commander Caton. He was an alert, helpful, unchallenging man, but easily swayed by flattery, which allowed the escape of Gebnerret Vibrion.
Icanis Tsur was a male Mugaari pirate. He was killed during the reign of the Galactic Empire when his ship, the 80-Vag, was destroyed in the Hoth asteroid field.
Anton Kale was a Captain in the Imperial Army, who volunteered to command the forces of the Galactic Empire on Kuat.
Huberdink Bufflin III was a male being and the husband of Milli Bufflin. Both natives of Corulag, the couple were vacationing on the world of Amfar during the growing Separatist Crisis.

Milli Bufflin was the wife of Huberdink Bufflin III. Both natives of Corulag, the couple were vacationing on the planet Amfar during the growing Separatist Crisis. Due to the steep drop in tourism, the Bufflins found that they had many of the resorts facilities to themselves.
Sabran was a bounty hunter and former Imperial Navy officer during the Galactic Civil War.

The being only known as Omwat shaman was an Omwati from the Outer Rim world of Omwat. He was the leader of a smuggler gang on the planet Naboo during the Galactic Civil War and was also involved in other crimes.

Lon Wert was a male Vulptereen from the Deep Core's planet of Vulpter. At the time of the rise of the Galactic Empire, Lon Wert was a talented pilot, and among the people of his homeworld he had earned a reputation as the most skilled racer since Dud Bolt.
Hipan Voge was a male textile merchant from Naboo.
Kanlee Fentetta was a prominent citizen of Naboo.
Wila Prammi was a female Human who became the first democratically elected Monarch of Gala, after Queen Veda decided to abdicate the throne.
Nave Vengaris was a Human female who served as the governess of Aquilaris during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Baysden was a Human Imperial stormtrooper sergeant during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, Baysden was among the sandtroopers brought to the desert planet Tatooine by Captain Alima to search for the fugitive Rebel droids C-3PO and R2-D2.

Xandel Carivus's clone was created by Black Sun as part of a plan to take control of the Interim Ruling Council by replacing its members with clones. He was part of the group sent to assassinate the real Xandel Carivus.
Drezzel was an Imperial Captain in command of the Imperial outpost on Seoul 5 just after Battle of Endor.

This angry individual was an aggressive male Rodian who resided in tower 214 on Byblos. The Rodian, who disliked droids, may unwillingly have been part of U-THR's scheme to liberate Crimson from Imperial Customs.

Ilay was a clan leader of the Airam. Unlike most of her rival clan leaders, Ilay believed that joining the Alliance to Restore the Republic was a serious mistake, and instead remain with the Galactic Empire.

Nele was one of the six Erv Lekauf clones trained to be a stormtrooper. He once helped stop a mini-revolt by rebellious Sa Cuis clones along with his brethren and Darth Vader by suggesting they use flamethrowers.
Seteem Ervic was a farmer who lived on Saffalore.

Niclara Varnillian was a female human Alderaanian who joined the Imperial Navy. She was part of the operations crew that tested the Death Star superlaser on the planet Alderaan. The destruction of her homeworld did not affect her in the least.
Bobor Kalranoos was a weapons engineer who designed the Kalranoos carbine.
Arawynne was a Ghostling princess who was sold to Gardulla the Elder. Anakin Skywalker and Kitster Chanchani Banai freed her from the Hutt's estate.

Parnath was a Carosite cyberneticist who trained on Carosi XII; however, he was exiled from the planet for his unethical practices. Most repulsive to the Carosites was his wholesale pursuit of credits.

Eyleen was a Human female who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she was part of a group of thugs who lived in the slums of Mos Espa. This group also included Hilbrun, Tiomvo and Guz'Ordnak.

Ra-Zyrth was a male Massassi who served the Sith Empire during the time of the Great Hyperspace War. He became one of the top commanders of Naga Sadow, the leader of the Sith Empire, and Sadow used dark side alchemy to transform Ra-Zyrth into a mutated monstrosity.
Sajsh was the owner of a curio shop in the Treasure Ship Row on Corellia in 3 ABY, but in actuality, his business was a front for meetings with Black Sun.

Arl Nidder was one of the underlings of Zekka Thyne who dreamed of becoming a bounty hunter and owning a suit of Mandalorian armor. He was shot and killed by Grand Admiral Thrawn in disguise as Jodo Kast while daydreaming that the hunter would take him under his wing.
Promk was a Human male underling of Zekka Thyne. He was also a member of the Brommstaad Mercenaries.
An unknown male was the Galactic Republic's Admiral of the Fleet during the Mandalorian Wars. He was based on Coruscant.
Viddarie was a male who was, by the year 3963 BBY, the security chief on the Republic Navy battleship Courageous, serving under Admiral Saul Karath.

affiliation: The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania
x: This male Arkanian was the fifth Lord of the House of Adasca and father to Argaloh Adasca. The head of Adascorp three generations before the Mandalorian Wars, their reign resulted in much wealth and advancement.
Zadawi was an Arkanian Offshoot female who lived on the outskirts of the city of Adascopolis, ancient capital of the planet Arkania, during the time of the Mandalorian Wars.

This old woman was an offshoot Arkanian who was forced to live in a slum in Arkania by the purebreds, along with her son and her granddaughter, Zadawi. Despite her situation, she had great respect for Arkoh Adasca and Adascorp and was convinced things would get better soon.

A man was an the father of Zadawi. He was an Arkanian Offshoot who was forced to live in a slum in Arkania by the purebreds, along with his mother and his daughter. He worried over his mother and did not like Zadawi antagonizing her.
Mal Coramma was a male Chagrian who worked for the Black Sun.

Zarandro Vykas was the brother of Zardra Vykas and a drug addict. He worked as an intergalactic criminal with his sister, traveling the galaxy in her ship, a modified YT-1300 freighter called the Firebrand.
Ia was a Human female police officer on the planet Coruscant who held the rank of lieutenant with the Coruscant Security Force Traffic Division.
Anniha Nega was a Human male who became one Coruscant's premier bounty hunters by his early twenties.

Ocka Dwei was an advance scout for the Yuuzhan Vong, serving much the same purpose and function as Nom Anor, Yomin Carr, and various other clandestine operatives of the Praetorite Vong, a secretive power on the edge of the galaxy that served as the spearhead of the intended in…

The jocular, upbeat Tuchap was a race bookie and information broker in the Coruscant underworld. Overweight and violently allergic to cigarra smoke, the ordinarily jovial Farghul's mood would turn frosty and hard-bitten towards those who disappointed him.
Lorac Nonnaihr was a Human male who served as a Alderaanian businessman and high society member by using his mercantile operations as cover for an illegal arms-dealing ring.
Tor Aramatha was a male Human and the governor of Aldera, Alderaan's capital, from the era of the Clone Wars up until the planet's destruction in 0 BBY.
The eccentric, opinionated Cristoph Jam was a Human male member of the Alderaanian nobility, and a secret purveyor of vigilante justice.
Arhul Holt served the Imperial Navy as a Fleet Admiral for nearly four decades, but eventually found that he no longer agreed with its principles.
Fellion was an enforcer for the Black Sun criminal syndicate on Brentaal during the years leading up to the death of Prince Xizor.

Elek D'cel was a skilled Caamasi male diplomat who had been offworld when Caamas was destroyed. Returning to his homeworld, he became both founder and administrator of Refuge City, an active reclamation project that had been intended to return Caamas to a livable state.

Tall and dignified, Jovive Centi was the governor of the Chandrilan capital of Hanna and an influential member of the democratic Chandrilan House during the years leading up to and immediately following the Battle of Yavin.
Tristan Pex was a Human male who left Chandrila in the aftermath of the Clone Wars, joining up with the Benelex Guild and becoming a bounty hunter.
Grugosh was a large green-skinned alien. He was the partner of the conman Vundar who was the brains to Grugosh's muscle.

Born and raised on the planet of Corellia, Eryk Kroogar, also known as Talonscar, was one of millions of young men who found inspiration and guidance in the exploits of Han Solo, the most famous Corellian of his time.

Hadis Alto was a male Human and one of the first cadets to pass through the Corulag Imperial Academy. A level-headed, unremarkable Colonel, Alto served several tours of duty in the Outer Rim Territories, honing his skills as a sniper and VIP bodyguard.
Reni Wajetta, a slender, effeminate, sharp-dressed man with an easygoing manner hiding brutal ambition, made a career of blackmailing and bribing the rich and famous from the safety of his hometown.

Leader of the Lost Ones street gang, Trunks Bibo was a lanky, tattooed Ortolan who despised everything and everyone; the rich and powerful, the police, and even his own subordinates, taking pleasure only in theft, violence, and torturing new gang members.
A heavyset Drall with graying fur, brightly-painted claws, and pierced ears sporting several intricate dangling ornaments, Duchess Sarella represented her family's interests for over thirty years.
Traut was a Human male smuggler who worked with Platt Okeefe and Tru'eb Cholakk. He was in Platt's team that raided the Galactic Research Academy in order to find a safe heaven for smugglers.

Thar'quan was a combat-trained Defel miner and a saboteur for the Rebel Alliance. Working as an intelligence agent for General Airen Cracken, Thar'quan carried out attacks on assets of the Galactic Empire, including the capture of Alpha Outpost.
Sasnak Toxis, sometimes abbreviated to Sas, was a Defel officer, a member of the Rebel Alliance, and a personal enemy of the pirate Chordak.

Caerbellak was an Imperial Moff who governed Rydonni Prime during the Galactic Civil War. An adept politician and skilled military commander, Caerbellak saw himself as the man who could destroy the fledgling New Republic and restore the New Order after surviving the Battle of …

In 6 ABY he served on the Corusca Rainbow, an Immobilizer 418 interdictor cruiser under the command of Uwlla Iillor, in preparation for the assault on Coruscant. Three years later, he was promoted to captain.

Rensen was a captain in the Imperial Navy and commander of the Direption. When Admiral Delak Krennel ordered him to raze a village that had housed a would-be assassin of the admiral, Rensen refused; Krennel crushed his throat with his prosthetic hand and gave command of the Di…

Vict Darron was a Human male commander who served in the Imperial Navy and former executive officer to Admiral Delak Krennel. When Krennel seized the Ciutric Hegemony, Darron moved his family there in order to prevent them from having to live with nonhumans.

Harsis was a short, slender, dark-skinned Human male. A lieutenant in the Imperial Navy, he served as the sensor officer on the Direption under the command of Commander Vict Darron in the battle for Liinade III.

Around 4 ABY, the Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard, using a Spaarti cloning cylinder from the late Emperor Palpatine's storage, grew a clone of herself aboard her Executor-class Star Dreadnought Lusankya, which was hidden beneath the surface of the galactic capit…
Deena Mipps was a noblewoman-turned-journalist who worked for Darpa SectorNet during the Galactic Civil War. She was also a Rebel cell leader and spy.
Cyslo was a lieutenant in the New Republic Defense Fleet and the helmsman of the Swift Liberty.
Tal'kina was a Twi'lek commander in the New Republic Defense Fleet and the sensor officer of the Swift Liberty.
Alendar Jarvis was a male journalist who worked for the New Order Progressive. Jarvis wrote a fake news report about Wilhuff Tarkin's death in a shuttle crash.

Nada Synnt was a common alias used by a male smuggler who was in charge of a group of operatives. He was sometimes mentioned in Cynabar's InfoNet reports. Synnt liked to use punny aliases, including "Tosin Dice" and "Benner Dunnit."

Danken worked for the smuggler Nada Synnt's organization. During the Galactic Civil War, Danken and several others were headed to Ralltiir in an attempt to run the Imperial blockade in orbit to take advantage of the increased need for personal expendables, luxury foodstuffs, s…
761 was the designation of an Imperial stormtrooper guarding a dam near Valleyport on Liinade III in 9 ABY. He was stunned by Corran Horn.

Ivey was a Human female with a troubled past who worked for the Rebel Alliance, and later the Red Moons, as a procurement specialist. She joined the Rebellion shortly after the destruction of the first Death Star. Among her specialties were code breaking and data slicing.

Horch was a male crime lord who was the leader of the Kheedar Ring, on the planet Kheedar. When the planet was attacked by the Galactic Empire, his palace was targeted due to the presence of laser emplacements.

Wynt Kepporra was a Human male from Alderaan, a classmate of Delak Krennel at the Prefsbelt IV Naval Academy. Kepporra participated in the Thespian Union, and later became a captain in the Imperial Navy.
Buran Borsil was a Nord scout and SpecForce agent serving the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Roland Warren was an agent of the Rebel Alliance. Warren was the son of Morellian scoutmaster Barosa Warren and an unidentified mother. He was on bad terms with his father, especially since Roland joined the Rebel Alliance, opposing Barosa's wishes.
Danlea Lochner, also known as Tara Warren, was an agent of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Pari' Notgoth was a Gotal crimelord operating in Tamarin sector. For a time, Notgoth employed the bounty hunter Milacass. However, around 3 BBY, there was an attempt on Notgoth's life, and the plot was tracked to Milacass.

Nim Zanti was an Ororo Transportation lieutenant assigned to Vergesso Base in the Vergesso III asteroid belt during the Galactic Civil War. As the chief Ororo representative, she was the ruler of the Base.
Baz Korral was a Human male who had been a prisoner in the spice mines of Kessel.

Baz was a male human who served the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy as an ensign during the early years of its reign. He was assigned to serve on Sentinel Base, a construction project under the command of Moff Wilhuff Tarkin on a moon in the Outer Rim Territories.
Phulik was a captain in the Imperial Navy, and commander of the Binder.
The oldest son of Nash and Loran Llalik had two younger siblings: Nashiak, a boy, and Saren, a girl. All of them were born on Plavin 6.

Korta Sarc was a Shistavanen Alpha Premier who lived during the of the Imperial Era. Sometime by 8 BBY, Sarc suddenly disappeared and the Uvena System Constabulary assigned two Shistavanen scouts, Lak Sivrak and Yurdak Fav, to join the search.

Kena Shont was a Rebel undercover agent working as a medical technician at BioTech Industries. Shont was assigned by fellow Rebel Saren Llalik to download secret data from Llalik's 2-1B droid to her personal datapad, and then give the information to the Rebel command.

Brullian Dyll was a musician who was deemed to be a threat to the stability of the Galactic Empire, which ruled much of the galaxy during his life. Despite the renown of his work, Dyll was executed by Imperial authorities, and his music was suppressed.
Quiv was a male Sullustan lieutenant who served in the New Republic Defense Fleet and a communications officer onboard Home One.

An unnamed Human technician, identified by IG-88A only as Target Number One, was the first person killed by the assassin droid. The technician, employed by Holowan Laboratories, was one of several scientists assigned to Project Phlutdroid.

Nomo Sliken was a Clawdite assassin who worked for Moska the Hutt during the height of the New Order. It was he who murdered Nak Simm, then took the Zabrak's place at a meeting that was scheduled to cement an alliance between the Hutt crime lords Torga and Jolla.
This Mandalorian officer was the leader of a small contingent of Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders who had crash-landed on Lehon some time either prior to or during the Mandalorian Wars or Jedi Civil War.
Dedro Needalb was an old man who served as an Imperial Customs Inspector on Nar Shaddaa. He also secretly worked for the Hutts.

Khlor was a highly skilled bounty hunter who specialized in live capture and tracking. Adorned in dark clothes and a full-body cloak, and with a jet-black Velusian fursnake named Sting coiled around his neck and shoulders, he presented a harrowing image to client and prey alike.
Yorlin was a stormtrooper that served aboard the Iron Fist under Warlord Zsinj.

A male Twi'lek bounty hunter was present in the cantina when Zorba Desilijic Tiure learned of his son's death. The Twi'lek also ambushed Luke Skywalker, but was killed along with another bounty hunter.
An Aqualish bounty hunter was present within the Mos Eisley Cantina when Zorba Desilijic Tiure learned that Leia Organa had murdered Zorba's son.
The father of Windy Starkiller lived on Tatooine with his wife and their son. He and his wife sometimes visited the Lars homestead.
The mother of Windy Starkiller lived on Tatooine with her husband and their son. She and her husband sometimes visited the Lars homestead.

Kassler was a grizzled old spacer, and the captain of the tramp freighter, the Ravelev. His ship plied the Anarid Cluster. He employed Platt Okeefe for two years before she left to work for the Klatooinian Trade Guild, against his advice.
Naia Sendar was a female Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic.

A male Zabrak Jedi Knight served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Stationed at the Coruscant Jedi Temple at the end of the Clone Wars, he defended many Jedi Initiates during Operation: Knightfall.

affiliation: Resistance movement against the Galactic Empire
x: This unidentified zone runner was one of the zone runners on an unidentified Outer Rim Territories world, where he fought against the Galactic Empire. He worked as a team with Ved and Wyl Tarson.

affiliation: Resistance movement against the Galactic Empire
x: Ved Tarson was a member of a resistance movement on an unidentified world located in the Outer Rim Territories. He and his younger brother Wyl fought alongside each other against the Galactic Empire as zone runners.
Derral was a Human male councilman who lived on the planet Ahakista during the Galactic Civil War.
This man was a councilman on the planet Ahakista and a friend of Councilman Derral.
Dunlan was the leader of a resistance movement against the planet Ahakista's Imperial-backed government.

Sardoth was a Male Iktotchi Jedi Knight who fell to the dark side before the Clone Wars. Allying himself with the Galactic Empire, Sardoth aided the Inquisitorius in hunting down his fellow Jedi as the Jedi Order was exterminated during the Great Jedi Purge.
Erla was a female Kaminoan who resided on the planet Ahakista and was an associate of Sardoth. Erla was likely an employee of Raze, Sardoth's employer, as well.
Baco Par was an extremely talented lockbreaker who was counted among the galaxy's best prior to his retirement.
Mussat Nasrabi was a male Mon Calamari who served aboard the Sullustan cruise liner, the Starlite Cloud, as chief engineer. It was here that he became good friends with the smuggler Platt Okeefe.
A male Hutt, Mondo-Mod was the owner of the Arena of Doom, a gladiatorial fighting ring, in the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Stalgis was a stormtrooper lieutenant in the Imperial Remnant during the Yuuzhan Vong War, serving onboard the Widowmaker. He was born around 2 BBY.

Vikar Dorn was a Human governor from Munto Codru who formerly served the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances until he swore his allegiance to Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Kassek-Ka was a male Codru-Ji clan leader. In 137 ABY, another clan head named Rikkar-Du was contacted by Darth Kruhl with a proposal of giving him power over the clans of Munto Codru if he submitted to the Empire under Darth Krayt.

Tarl was a stormtrooper in the Imperial Remnant during the Yuuzhan Vong War, serving under Lieutenant Stalgis aboard the frigate Widowmaker. On a mission to Munlali Mafir, he was infected with a Jostran which was removed by Tekli, a Jedi Knight who was part of the mission.
Resinn was a prosecutor in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served aboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence during the Galactic Civil War.
Ogl'woxz was a male Gran scientist who worked on "Project Durge" at the Warren during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Nabkess was an Ortolan female who crewed aboard the freighter Isilia under Captain Adriav Kavos.
Laera was the wealthy Bakuran woman who adopted Malinza Thanas after the deaths of her parents, Pter Thanas and Gaeriel Captison.

Vyram was a Human male from Bakura who worked as a slicer during the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. He was one of the core members of the Freedom resistance movement, and a close friend of its founder, Malinza Thanas.
Habba Kee was a male podracer who raced before 32 BBY, and he was considered one of the best in the Outer Rim Territories. Kee hit part of Obitoki's destroyed pod, wrecking his own racer as well.

Obitoki, a non-Human Podracer, competed against a Dug named Sebulba sometime before 27 BBY. During the race, Sebulba disabled Obitoki's pod by shooting flames into one of its engines after Obitoki tried to overtake him.

Jjorg was a female Human who was a member of the Freedom resistance movement on Bakura. Her blonde hair was drawn into a ponytail, with the sides of her skull shaved. She was killed by Salkeli in Blaine Harris' office.
Salkeli was a Rodian member of the Freedom resistance movement. However, he betrayed them to Deputy Prime Minister Blaine Harris.

Quist was an Admiral in the Imperial Navy and head of the fleet which succeeded in pushing the Rebellion off of Yavin 4. His ship was frequented by Darth Vader during this time, and he had his own meditation chamber aboard the vessel.

An Ortolan merchant was a salesman on the planet Dantooine. After the Rebellion relocated to Hoth following their evacuation of Yavin 4, Princess Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker arrived on Dantooine to secure supplies for the base.
Abel was a criminal on the planet of Dantooine. He was the muscle in a group of thugs who roamed a major city on the planet.
Schifil was a security guard in Salis D'aar, Bakura.

Riggins Delahrg was the Imperial Governor of Tallaso who, following the Battle of Endor, traveled from Imperial world to Imperial world, securing or creating high-paying, low-effort employment on any planet with an Imperial bureaucracy.
Renzii was a male waiter who worked at Dex's Diner during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Jakaitis was a Bakuran male who served as the supervisor of a cleaning crew for the Bakur Memorial Building during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
T'nadar Nadar was the Chadra-Fan proprietor of the Galaxy Shop, a general store located on Darknon Station
Makin Marec was a Human male Mandalorian, who came into contact with the bounty hunter Ailyn Vel some time prior to the Yuuzhan Vong's invasion of the galaxy.

Gaitzi was a female Human who lived on Bakura around the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. She was employed as part of a cleaning crew, known as the Tripod, reporting to Jakaitis. In 28 ABY, Tahiri Veila impersonated her when sneaking into the Bakuran Senate Complex.
Yon was a male on Bakura, a member of a cleaning crew reporting to Jakaitis. In 28 ABY, Arrizza impersonated him when sneaking into the Bakuran Senate Complex.

Scod was a male living on the world of Bakura during the Yuuzhan Vong War in 28 ABY. A member of a cleaning crew reporting to Jakaitis, Goure Conor impersonated him in order to successfully infiltrate the Bakuran Senate Complex along with Jedi Knight Tahiri Veila.

Tamora Spice was the second wife of Kitster Banai and mother of Ji and Elly Banai. After Kitster stole the painting Killik Twilight during the auction held at Mawbo's Performance Hall, she, Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo went to search for Kitster.

Vooz Nooxoo Una, Bocce for "The Patriot," was an alias used by a Human male biogeneticist–turned–vigilante crime fighter in the lower levels of Coruscant. Una was able to develop a suit of armor made out of engineered plant fibers, which he tested on himself.
An unidentified female Jedi was captured by a sarlacc on Tatooine in 3996 BBY and was digested into oblivion in 2996 BBY, three thousand years before 4 ABY.

Dom Pricina was a wealthy Human female. She had in her possession the Ankarres Sapphire, and charged people dearly to make use of its supposed healing powers. She was fond of rich foods, and had dessert courses with every meal, and as a result was quite obese.

Kuhqo was a Yuuzhan Vong shaper who became a Shamed One. He joined the Jeedai heresy and used a genetic splicer to access an Executor's qahsa, searching for planets that might be the Prophet's living world.
Monfre was a Human male who served as captain of the Nebulon-B2 frigate Cerebus during the Galactic Civil War.
Yurf Col was a male Duros from Duro. Following the Battle of Duro, he became the commander in charge of Duro Squadron, and fought in the battle in the Duro system.
Raf Othrem was born in 8 ABY. In 28 ABY, he joined Twin Suns Squadron.
Mynor Dac was a Twi'lek starfighter pilot who flew with Twin Suns Squadron in 28 ABY under the command of Jaina Solo.
Rolai Frac was a male Bothan member of a squad of young mercenaries that trained secretly at the elite Leadership School of Andara before the Clone Wars.
Tulah was a male Muun who was a member of a squad of young mercenaries that trained at the elite Leadership School on Andara during the final years of the Galactic Republic before the Clone Wars.

Hurana was a female student who was a member of a squad of young mercenaries that trained at the elite Leadership School of Andara during the final years of the Galactic Republic before the Clone Wars. She was in charge of arranging transportation for the group.
Ze was a male Humanoid member of a squad of young mercenaries that secretly trained at the elite Leadership School on Andara during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Boll Trinkatta was the Kloodavian founder of Trinkatta Starships. He supervised the company's starship factory on the planet Esseles a short time before the Invasion of Naboo.

Berra Sane was a female Human native to the Core Worlds planet Rhinnal. She had been a lifelong resident of Austogie, a southern Rhinnal village falling within the region controlled by the Kieger clan.

Hidu Rezodar was a gangster from Phaeda who imprisoned bounty hunter Sintas Vel in carbonite. Rezodar was killed shortly after Sintas' imprisonment, and the slab of carbonite containing Sintas Vel was held in storage by Phaedan authorities for almost forty years.
Fae Kalena was a businesswoman who owned and operated the successful StarLiners transport company in the Brak sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Har Kalena was an Human that lived in the Brak sector during the height of the Galactic Empire.
Weegee was a human male who lived on a planet in the Huru system where he mined farium. He was a friend of Kanina Nico.
Zam Ghanol was a wiry, old Human woman with gray hair.
Vel was a Toydarian slicer and pirate under Erli Prann.
Ukert was an Ugnaught smuggler, the leader of clan Ubskai who ran a small criminal operation on the planet Kothlis.

Maxeena Sov'lya was a petty crime lord and member of Kothlis' high society. After her parents returned to Bothawui, Sov'lya took control of the family enterprises and transformed it into a business empire.

Uncle Dravos was a Bothan criminal who managed the criminal empire of Maxeena Sov'lya. He was a distant relative of her and acted as a buffer between Sov'lya and her criminal enterprises. He spent most of his time at the Tal'cara spaceport making payoffs and brokering deals.
Margo "Pepper" Flarestream, a Human female born around 35 BBY, defected from the Imperial Academy to the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the early days of the Galactic Civil War.
Ph'dan was a male H'drachi leader in 0 ABY. He was killed by Glott after giving him information about Mora.
Nei Rin was a Yuuzhan Vong female who rose to the rank of Master Shaper before 122 ABY. As a crafter of Yuuzhan Vong biotechnology, she was highly respected among her species.
Liaan Lah, along with Choka Skell, was a Yuuzhan Vong warrior assigned to protect Master Shaper Nei Rin on Ossus.

Choka Skell was a Yuuzhan Vong warrior assigned to Master Shaper Nei Rin at the Jedi Temple on Ossus. Skell and Liaan Lah accompanied Nei Rin on a fact-finding mission on the sabotage of the Ossus Project, only to return and find that all the Yuuzhan Vong at the temple had bee…
Dustangle was a Duros archaeologist who hid in the underground caverns of Duro after the Empire subjugated his world. His cousin was Dustini Spa Ronii.
Llats Ward was a Human Mandalorian mercenary, selected by Jango Fett to train Jango's clones on Kamino as part of the Cuy'val Dar.
Airen was a Human female who served as the mayor of Espelar Settlement on the planet of Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

This Cerean Jedi Master fought at the First Battle of Ruusan against the Brotherhood of Darkness where she used her mastery of battle meditation to hold the Sith fleet off until her death, and the death of the two Selkath Padawans who joined her at the hands of former Jedi and…

Noell Ciro was a Human male from the planet Dolomar. Along with his brother, Keleman, he joined one of his homeworld's resistance groups and assisted in the liberation of the planet from Imperial forces.

Monjai was a female Elomin who served the New Republic. Following the liberation of the planet Kal'Shebbol in 8 ABY, Monjai was appointed to the post of Governor since it was felt that she would better relate to the large non-Human population on the planet.

This orange-skinned Jedi student was a trainee at the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4. This student was there training when Kyp Durron and Dorsk 82 were dispatched to Corbos on a mission for the New Republic.
A brown Jedi student was a trainee at the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4. She was there training when Kyp Durron and Dorsk 82 were dispatched to Corbos on a mission for the New Republic.
The gray Jedi student was a trainee at the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4. This student was there training when Kyp Durron and Dorsk 82 were dispatched to Corbos on a mission for the New Republic.
An unidentified Quarren Jedi student was a trainee at the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4. He was present at the Jedi wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade.
Kist was an Imperial captain, notable for designing the Class I Defense Droid.

Dorn was a Human male captain who served in the Navy of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War. He was the son of Governor Vikar Dorn and the commanding officer of the Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer Dauntless.
Hordis Boil was the Chief Executive Officer of Arakyd Industries during the Clone Wars.
Vincent Gatharard was a male Human Imperial lieutenant, serving in the Imperial Navy.
Sai'da was a member of the B'omarr Monk order. He was a tall, thin Human, and had a keen interest in history outside of the order, separating him from the other monks.

The Governor of Corulag was the New Republic governor of Corulag during the Yuuzhan Vong War. After the Battle of Coruscant, the governor surrendered to the Yuuzhan Vong and ruled as a collaborationist.
Deflector was a male member of the Rebel Alliance. He was put on a courier mission for the Alliance Fleet in 0 ABY with Tracer a few weeks after the Evacuation of Yavin.
Ukchet was a Jawa scout of Nebit's tribe. He was the first to spot R2-D2 in the Jundland Wastes.

Enjikket was a Jawa of Nebit's tribe. A scouting mission for R2-D2 in the Jundland Wastes was his and his brother Yeelhoy's first hunt. He was the youngest member of the scouting party, and a nephew of scout leader Dathcha.
Yeelhoy was a Jawa of Nebit's tribe. A scouting mission for R2-D2 in the Jundland Wastes was the first hunt for he and his brother, Enjikket.
Ezjenk was a Jawa of Nebit's tribe. He was the tribe's restraining bolt applier. He wore a cuirass made of woodoo-leather. He also put the restraining bolt on R2-D2 and C-3PO.
Piris was a male Quarren captain in the Galactic Alliance Defense Force. He commanded the Alliance warship Bounty during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Thella was a Human female and the leader of a Rebel Alliance Infiltrator team.
Huffreys was a burly Human male and First Officer of a Rebel Alliance Infiltrator team.
Redeye, nicknamed "Deadeye," was a member of the Turazza species who worked as head of security for Luskin Exovar at Exovar's Emporium.

affiliation: Galactic Empire, various criminal organizations, freelance
x: Daxtorn Lethos was a cunning bounty hunter who used an advanced holographic belt to capture his marks. He had combed-back black hair and sported a mustache and a goatee. He was the owner of the Gorgon.

Jir Yomaget was the head of MandalMotors at the time of the Second Galactic Civil War. Yomaget came to the meeting of the clans in Keldabe on Mandalore, which many other Mandalorians also attended, where he gave half of MandalMotors profits to Mandalore to aide in the rebuildi…

Neth Bralor was a Human male Mandalorian who lived during the time of the Second Galactic Civil War. In the year 40 ABY, Bralor attended a meeting of Mandalorian clan leaders on behalf of his clan at MandalMotors Hall in Keldabe, the capital city of the planet Mandalore.

Isko Talgal was a female Mandalorian warrior who lived prior to and during the Second Galactic Civil War. Talgal was a grim-faced woman with graying black hair. She was present at a meeting between Boba Fett and several other Mandalorians in Zerria's Bar on Drall in 40 ABY.

Baltan Carid, in Mando'a Car'ika was a male Human Mandalorian warrior during the Second Galactic Civil War. He had a dark blue tattoo of a vine starting somewhere below his armor line and ending right under his chin.
Tash Scrambas was the father of Pello Scrambas.
Gefal Keb was a Gossam senior civil servant in the Public Protection Department of the Galactic Alliance government on Coruscant.

Shella Motti was a Human female and a member of the Motti family. At some point following the Clone Wars, she was abducted by agents of the Nebula Front. Despite the efforts of Wilhuff Tarkin, her uncle by marriage, to rescue her, Motti refused to return to her family.
Cherit was a gang boss who operated out of Bador and was killed in a firefight with Jaing Skirata.
Serku was a male Hamadryas who served as a bodyguard for the criminal L. Fraig while living in Kuat City.
Almak was a male Human member of the Galactic Alliance Guard who welcomed back Ben Skywalker after he returned from his mission.

Deputy Strey was an Imperial clerk at the Galactic Research Academy on Koaan. He worked in the underground processing facility at the facility, and a consequence, he looked pale and sickly from too much time indoors. He had a sour demeanor.
Krox was a two-headed sentient who gave Mungo Baobab the map to the Roon system in a cantina on the planet Manda. He left the cantina when two Imperial stormtroopers arrived.
Nav Ekhat represented Murkhana in the Galactic Alliance Senate in 40 ABY.
Sarrissa Jeng was a human member of the Jedi Order during the Separatist Crisis. In 22 BBY, Jeng was one of the 212 Jedi who traveled to the planet Geonosis to rescue the Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi.

Guardsman 22716 was the designation of a member of the Emperor's Royal Guard. A combat veteran, Guardsman 22716 was serving in a regular Imperial Army unit as his rotation back into active combat service after already serving a tour of duty as a stormtrooper.

Tetrum was a male Imperial official who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 ABY, he served under Moff Kentor Sarne in the Kathol sector and was appointed as governor of the planet Kolatill.
Kause was a male living on the planet of Kolatill located within the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Rigorra was a Hutt Warlord from Balmorra and the brother of Groodo.

Lon Bennor was a male who lived in the city of Domaz on the planet Kolatill, located within the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 8 ABY, Domaz was assaulted by TIE bombers from the Imperial Ton-Falk-class escort carrier Kathol Protector.

Graad was a Human male Mandalorian, who lived on the planet Mandalore—the cultural homeworld of the Mandalorians, located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories—by the start of the Second Galactic Civil War.
L. Fraig was once a member of Cherit's gang until Jaing Skirata killed Cherit. Working from the Tekshar Falls Casino, he maintained some legitimacy in his business and gathered many contacts.
Gellus was a female Human senior civil servant in Fleet Supply on Coruscant.
Biris J. Te Gaf was the senior purchasing agent for the Galactic Alliance Engineering Support network on Coruscant.

Duvil was a a Human male commando who served in the Galactic Alliance Guard during the Second Galactic Civil War. Described as a tall and hairy man, he was not suitable for silently sneaking up on targets.

Herik Vorad was site foreman on a dig site north of Enceri where he and his team examined some odd metal, metal which turned out to be a new vein of Mandalorian iron. He immediately sent a message to Goran Beviin, as Mandalore Boba Fett was away on business.
Jintar was a Human male Mandalorian and the husband of Dinua Jeban. He had two children with her, Shalk and Briila.
Shalk was the son of Jintar and Dinua Jeban and the brother of Briila. Both Shalk and Briila witnessed the awakening of Sintas Vel.

Briila was the daughter of Jintar and Dinua Jeban and the sister of Shalk. Both Briila and Shalk were there for the awakening of Sintas Vel where Briila would asked for possession of Sintas' items and equipment under the circumstances that she was dead.
Sass Sikili was a Verpine negotiator who spoke at the opening of BastEx.

Limm was a Human female soldier who served in the Galactic Alliance Guard during the Second Galactic Civil War. In the year 40 ABY, Limm and another GAG trooper, Sergeant Wirut of the 967 Commando, arrested Chief of State Cal Omas for treason by order of Colonel Jacen Solo.

affiliation: Murkhanan Department of Trade and Industry
x: Hebanh Del Dalhe was a representative of the Murkhanan Department of Trade and Industry; he transmitted a message to the Verpine criticizing their allegiance with the Mandalorians during the Second Galactic Civil War.

Cikartan was a Mandalorian and the owner of a tapcaf in the city of Keldabe, the capital of the planet Mandalore. Cikartan's tapcaf was in operation during the Second Galactic Civil War, and its patrons were acquainted with the Mandalorian soldier, Venku Skirata.

Hayca Mekket was a female Mandalorian veterinarian who treated Mandalore Boba Fett for his terminal illness by injecting him with the bone marrow of Jaing Skirata. All she asked for payment was a thick, red quilt and told Fett he shouldn't have anymore children.

Shula Pakasj Shevu was at first Lon Shevu's live-in girlfriend, then later his wife. She gave him a gold chain which he never went on patrol without. When she met Ben Skywalker, she thought he was a nice, polite boy.
Plarx was a Frezh male who commanded the Frezh blockade of the planet Sif'kric, the homeworld of the Sif'krie species, during the Caamas Document Crisis in 19 ABY.
Maren Kelsome was a Human male soldier of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Gor Lequar was a Fleet Admiral in the Imperial Navy who commanded the Third Ado Superiority Fleet.
Gold Wing was the call sign of a member of Gold Squadron, a Rebel Alliance starfighter squadron, during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
This clone commando sniper was a member of a squad of the Grand Army of the Republic's clone commandos who carried out special forces missions for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Kuuztin was the captain of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Courageous during the Galactic Civil War. In 3.5 ABY, Kuuztin was selected to join Grand Admiral Thrawn's task force during his campaign against the traitorous Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin.
Crying Dawn Singer was one of the most famous singers in the galaxy, performing for many audiences during the Galactic Civil War.
Rrowv was a young male Togorian who taught Han Solo how to control a mosgoth during Solo's short stay on Togoria.
Alongside the fellow kusak Scourge, Razor guarded the pirate warlord Nym in his base on the planet Lok.
Scourge was one of the two Kusak guardians of pirate warlord Nym. This beast, along with Razor, guarded Nym in his base on the planet Lok.
The bugle boy was a male Human recruited into the Army of Light during the New Sith Wars.

An unidentified skiff guard worked on Jabba's sail barge in 4 ABY and told Boba Fett of how his sister Shaara evaded being eaten by the Sarlacc. The son of moisture farmers, he also had a brother named Kamma.
Sparbo was a duke who lived during the height of the New Order. He once transmitted the Bureau of Ships and Services, where he was picked up by CZ-54.
Beatonn was a member of the Rebel Alliance and commander of the frigate V'nnuk'rk. She was Fable Astin's commanding officer.
This individual was a Republic soldier that was stationed at the secret Hrakert Station, located on the ocean floor of Manaan, near the Hrakert Rift.

Miktiss was a male Saurton warrior from the planet Essowyn in the Trax sector. A loyal supporter of the Des'mar, a faction of Saurtons who supported the mining companies that dominated their homeworld, Miktiss participated in military operations against the Quenno, a group opp…
Ginzet was a Saurton pirate and a member of the Des'maric Pirates during the New Republic's reign over the galaxy.
Yun was an Aqualish mercenary, and member of the Des'maric Pirates. One of Miktiss' trusted lieutenants, Yun commanded one of the group's three Skipray Blastboats.
Jerri was a young Human and member of the Des'maric Pirates. Jerri earned Miktiss's trust quickly, and became one of his lieutenants, gaining command of one of the group's Skipray Blastboats.

Clode Rhoden owned and governed the gas giant planet of Yorn Skot in the years prior to the Battle of Naboo. Roden made millions of credits from mining tibanna from the Yorn Skot mining station, but also made a number of enemies.

Madam Rhoden, also Herr Rhoden, was the wife of Clode Rhoden, the ruler of Yorn Skot. Dissatisfied with her husband, she began an affair with her personal trainer Buck, a member of an the eco-terrorist group Green Forge.
A Human male member of the New Republic Senate during the Yuuzhan Vong War escaped the Yuuzhan Vong attack on the planet Coruscant by commandeering the New Republic warship Alamania.
"Senator Scramblefree" was the main nickname given to a male Sullustan senator by a group of angry New Republic officers during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

An unidentified Phindian captain was an officer of the New Republic Defense Fleet who served as the captain of Pride of Honor during the Battle of Coruscant and later confronted Senators "Sneakaway" and "Scramblefree" on Mon Calamari in 28 ABY.

Weutta was the Head of Security on Phindar approximately 42 BBY. He was responsible for dealing with rebels against Baftu and Terra Derida's rule of Phindar and after a state of emergency was declared on the planet he brought all rebels before Baftu.
Big Burke was an Ewok who lived on the forest moon of Endor in Bright Tree Village. Big Burke was an eligible Ewok male, and around 3 ABY he was old enough to attend the Shadow Night Festival.

Tak was an Ewok who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor in Bright Tree Village. He was an eligible Ewok male and was sought after by many females in the village for his handsome fur. Around 3 ABY, Tak was old enough to attend the Shadow Night Festival.
Erron Kell was a pilot for the Rebel Alliance who fought at the Battle of Endor. He later became a mercenary.
Desdemona was a Human female who piloted the freighter Blind Luck during the Galactic Civil War.
Marconea was a sterile female Selonian who worked as a servant for the Tharen family on Corellia.

Nici "The Specialist" was an expert counterfeit ID maker who had contacts inside the Imperial offices on Coruscant. His counterfeits were so good that the Imperials were unable to recognize them as fakes.

Danta Belissa was a food and souvenir merchant who ran a small souvenir and antique shop in the planet Bespin's Cloud City by around 1 ABY. In that time, Belissa's store ran into trouble when the criminal Wonn Ionstrike sent thugs to Belissa's store for protection money.
Bo-Attal was a Codru-Ji clan leader in 137 ABY. The clan chief opposed the leadership of Rikkar-Du, believing it followed the plans of the One Sith to build an Imperial base on Munto Codru.

Rikkar-Du was a male clan chief of the four-armed Codru-Ji species and native of the planet Munto Codru. At some point he was kidnapped by a rival clan, and eventually married Tassa, the daughter of that clan's chief.
The Codru-Ji male Jassar was the son of clan chief Rikkar-Du and a woman named Tassa on the planet Munto Codru.
Tassa was a female Codru-Ji and the daughter of a clan leader. Her clan kidnapped Rikkar-Du, a member of a rival clan, and they eventually married and had a son, Jassar.

Tohri Challon was a Human who was loyal to Roan Fel and his Empire-in-exile. Challon originally served Emperor Fel in the capacity of Imperial Adjunct and greeted Vikar Dorn when he arrived with the Imperial Star Destroyer Dauntless.
Bular was a Human male councilman who lived on the planet Ahakista during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 ABY, he was killed by Darth Vader for failing to destroy Dunlan's forces.
Astor was a male Human rebel against the Imperial-aligned government of the planet Ahakista.

Sirad Far was a Human male slicer who lived on the planet Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure helped Sirad by eliminating his rivals, the skilled slicer became indebted to his criminal empire.
Volu Nyth was a Kuati pilot who joined Rogue Squadron during the siege of Borleias and flew in that series of battles.
Barak was a member of the underworld who tasked smugglers to deliver crates of contraband to various sources.

Mourno Draver was a representative of the Corporate Sector Authority on the planet Talus. He was a criminal, doing business with the Hutts and ruthlessly killing those who posed a threat to his operations.
Arissa Fawn was an Imperial lieutenant of flexible ethics who served as a liaison officer on Starlyte Station.

This individual was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. The Curator of Records at the Jedi Temple, this man was the last to hold this post, escaping the Temple during the start of the Great Jedi Purge.
A Human female served as the protocol officer for Czerka Corporation's branch office in Anchorhead settlement, on the desert world of Tatooine during the Jedi Civil War.
This corporal was a member of the Rebel Alliance stationed at Haven Base on Arbra. His tasks included maintaining the camouflagued T-47 airspeeders used to patrol the planet's surface.
Meis, a captain in the Imperial Navy, was one of Han Solo's commanding officers during Solo's first year of service.
Glarret was an aged male Rodian who worked as Xaverri's assistant until Han Solo and Chewbacca took over for him.
Genna Seedar was a medical student who was a member of a small resistance group on Kal'Shebbol. She later signed onto the FarStar as a medic.

Malessa was one of the mistresses of Admiral Winstel Greelanx. When Han Solo came to deliver a gift to the Admiral, his aide Senior Lieutenant Kern Fallon used her name in whisper, when Solo tried to gain admittance to the admiral.

Lady Greelanx was the wife of Imperial Admiral Winstel Greelanx. She was disliked by the admiral, who had two mistresses. The two of them had two grown children, a son and a daughter and had a grandchild on the way in 4 BBY.

"Gammer" Firdaaz was a Human male scout from the planet Socorro who spent the majority of his life exploring other worlds. An alcoholic, Firdaaz spent a lot of his time drunk, but he had a wealth of knowledge and survival skills.
Cobb Unser was a free trader pilot and member of the FarStar crew.
Scoryn was an outlaw and member of the security contingent onboard the CR90 corvette FarStar.

Meela was the daughter of a local professor on Jandoon by the name of Oron. She was captured and handed back by Durrei, along with 10,000 credits to crimelord Mahk'khar, in exchange for the Kashi Mer talisman.
Doctor Oron was a professor of archaeology on the planet Jandoon. He was sold a communications base on Delari Prime during the Galactic Civil War. He had a daughter named Meela.
As the Mother of the Hiironi irstat, the largest irstat on Cularin, Mother Dariana was viewed as the wisest of all Tarasin.
Meirana was a Tarasin female, the sister of Dariana and Liriana.
Liriana was the leader of the Wyrd, a group of Tarasin dark side witches. She was the elder sister of Meirana and Dariana.
Cryalira was a female Tarasin who served as the Irstat-Kes of the Hiironi irstat, the largest Tarasin irstat on Cularin.

Fisonna was a male Tarasin. When Fisonna was a child, he was the troublemaker of the Hiironi irstat. Despite his grandmother Cryalira being the Irstat-Kes, her position did not shield him from punishment.

Riggs Ashar was a male Human who was born on a planet located in the galaxy. As a youth, Ashar used his toughness and strength to gain power over his fellows, who were reluctant to fight back due to his durability.
Barnab Chistor was a Human male who served as the governor of Gadrin in the decades leading up to the Clone Wars and the formation of the Galactic Empire.
Westa Impeveri was a Human male who was an elected senior counselor of the Hedrett Town Council during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Karid Blakken was a male politician who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Kim Klib was a young man who lived in Gadrin. His day job was as a messenger and stockboy for one of the local emporiums, but on the side he was an underworld mechanic. He was developing contacts in the underworld of Gadrin and Hedrett.
Ta'Shal was the baron administrator of Bollin as of 31 BBY.

Urdruua was a Hutt gangster on Nar Shaddaa generally being seen accompanied by a Gran assistant. During the Clone Wars he tried to kill Aurra Sing to get back at her for a past misdeed she had done to his family.

Hlisk Squin was a Human male who was the proprieter of a zoo known as the Bollin Exotic Animal Emporium, in the platform city of Bollin, in Cularin. His favorite "pet" was a fully-grown rancor. He presented the appearance of an earnest businessman.
Gareth was the Shalamite king of Shalam in 19 ABY. A keen laro player, he traveled to Coruscant where he cheated at the card game but got out-swindled by Han Solo when he lost to the then-general.
Desric Fol was a Human male Scout who owned and operated the freighter Blind Luck during the Galactic Civil War.
Klag was a blue skinned humanoid who served as the navigator of Blind Luck, Desric Fol's freighter, during the Galactic Civil War.

Brezzic Marr was a male Human who served in the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War. He was assigned as the commanding officer of the 105th Stormtrooper Platoon while the unit was stationed aboard Starlyte Station.
Maris was the name of a boy who traveled alongside an old man claiming to be a Jedi Knight named Jocko that Han Solo helped run an Imperial blockade with at some point in his past.
Jocko was the name of an old man with perceived delusions of being a Jedi Knight traveling with Maris who Han Solo helped run an Imperial blockade with at some point in the smuggler's past.

Dirneele was a dancer who worked in a noisy club in Tindark, one of the platform cities of Cularin. She had dark hair and eyes, but used wigs and eye implants to change her appearance for her performances.

Kyun Squnn was the second administrator of the SoroSuub Corporation regional offices in Tindark on Cularin. She was a capable bureaucrat and was fiercely loyal to SoroSuub, though she could be a bit naïve, especially when told that an action would ultimately benefit SoroSuub.
Kurth San was a male Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He joined the military of the Thaere system, and eventually attained the rank of major.

A hundred years after Reidi Artom surveyed the Cularin system, an expedition was mounted to visit Cularin's molten moon, Rennokk. Tusskrek was a member of that expedition. The expedition was attacked by a lava creature.

A hundred years after Reidi Artom surveyed the Cularin system, an expedition was mounted to visit Cularin's molten moon, Rennokk. Kum'Jushkin was a member of that expedition. The expedition found a metallic city in a gigantic cave, but was attacked by a lava worm.
Hiem Bryl was head of operations for Verga Mer Mining Company's operations on Tilnes. He was a gaunt Sullustan with slightly sunken cheeks. He did not speak Basic well, so he tended to speak slowly.

Maris Gen was the owner of "The Underground", a cantina on Tilnes. He was a Rodian who liked living in the tunnels. He was highly allergic to sunlight, which caused his skin to flake off if exposed to it for more than a minute.
Qar Jalunn was a wealthy male investor who had business dealings in the Cularin system around the time of the Invasion of Naboo.
Fenic was a member of Dunlan's resistance movement on the planet Ahakista.

Miim Te'Suub was the Director of Formal Activities for SoroSuub Corporation on Edic Bar, a city of Genarius. He was a cousin to the Executive Officer of SoroSuub, who gave Te'Suub the position because of a favor owed to Miim's mother. The position held little real authority.

Juuus was one of three Trandoshans living in Edic Bar. He worked as a street sweeper, which he claimed let him know what was going on without being noticed. He also sometimes worked as hired muscle for SoroSuub, paying visits to those who tried to manipulate the corporation.

Suuda was a male Hutt. Along with Moosh, he was one of four rival Hutt gangsters to reside on the planet Sleheyron in 3956 BBY during the Jedi Civil War. He was involved in an intra-planetary smuggling plot which culminated with the Jedi Revan being asked to assassinate Suuda.
Erd Lumas was an Ithorian pilot who flew a Bubbleship for Daedalus Gas Mines on Genarius.

Tchaw Fenn was a Bothan information broker who lived in Friz Harammel on Genarius. He used to work exclusively for Riboga the Hutt, but after the Hutt left the Cularin system, Fenn worked as a free agent. Gathering information came naturally to him, and he reveled in the process.
Rezunin Starwing led a group of pirates who operated in the Naboo system.

Hid Toqema was a gray-skinned Twi'lek who worked for Daedalus Gas Mines in Friz Harammel. The Twi'lek Daedala family, which ran Daedalus, hired nearly one hundred Twi'lek engineers, including Toqema, to work at Friz Harammel as part of a "cultural unity" movement from their ho…

Loa Tibeeme was a Rodian slicer who had been caught by Naescorcom after she had infiltrated their systems. Instead of turning her over for prosecution, they offered her a chance to work for them, in a sort of indentured servitude.
Nui Gneppe was a male Filordus archivist who worked for the Trade Federation for over a decade until he grew bored with them and went to work for Naescorcom on Ipsus.
Lalo was a Twi'lek assassin who lived in Tolea Biqua on Genarius. Her cover was that of a masseuse who was sent as a gift to her targets.

Bez was a Human male waiter who served drinks on Riboga the Hutt's floating barge in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Riboga used to enjoy pitting his favorite waiter in combat in combat with various creatures.

Piknab Carsels was a Gungan pilot who operated out of Varna Biqua. He left Naboo at a young age seeking adventure and enrolled at one flight school after another. He tried to learn how to fly every type of ship he could, but his favorite were starfighters.

Tan Shilley was a female Morganian, and the proprietor of Shilley's, a cantina on the planet of Questal. Intelligent and cautious, she was not in the habit of endangering herself to assist others. She possessed the keen bright eyes and the pale skin typical of her species.
Tanner Carzyn was a teenage Imperial technician serving under Moff Kentor Sarne on Kal'Shebbol. He later became a member of the crew of the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar.

Gunthar was a Yvarema royal explorer. Captured by slavers on his maiden voyage, he was sold to Moff Kentor Sarne on Kal'Shebbol. Forced to fight as a gladiator, he was eventually freed by the New Republic and joined the crew of the FarStar.
Setongah was a male Dug who was a member of Sebolto's clan as of 32 BBY. He was wanted by the Pixelito Grand Council for peddling death sticks to Gran youth. His bounty was claimed by Jango Fett.
Boom was a Guudrian explosives expert and pyromaniac. He served on-board the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar during the hunt for Moff Kentor Sarne.

Xav Verivax was a playboy freighter captain and occasional smuggler living in the Cularin system in the times before the Clone Wars. Although Verivax had worked for the local criminal Organization, he was mostly a freelance.
Calson was a Human male trainee starfighter pilot who was under the command of Ranna Gorjaye at some point during the Galactic Civil War.
Steggus was a male Targonnian who held the rank of Captain.
Shay was a male Targonnian and leader of a rebellious splinter-group dedicated to the overthrow of Craw.

Galliwig was a Human male who owned and ran Galliwig's Cantina. Sometime prior to 8 ABY, Galliwig encountered the Twi'lek Loh'khar the Finder, a free-trader who was in possession of three seemingly worthless eggs.
Sazaar was a male Targonnian who revolted againt Craw.
Rizzal was a Turazza who worked for Loh'khar the Finder. She was the Twi'lek's information gatherer.
Vizzal was a Turazza who worked for Loh'khar the Finder. She specialized in procuring materials that Loh'khar or his clients needed.
Nizzal was a female Turazza who worked for Loh'khar the Finder. She acted as his dealer.
Brandis Turgah was a New Republic technician and Bothan informer onboard the CR90 corvette FarStar.

Marja Lang was a Human female who served as the Imperial Vice-Governor of the planet Gandle Ott in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A staunchly loyal Imperial, she was more dedicated to the ideals of the Empire than Moff Kentor Sarne, the sector's ruler.
Blath was a tired Bith medic for Chay Praysh on Torpris. His duty was to ensure the health of the Drach'nam's slaves toiling in the nutrient slime pits in the bowels of Praysh's fortress.

Diax was a female Human who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she operated at the Nightsister Stronghold. There, she served the Nightsisters as a Rancor Tamer.

Fath H'ray was a female Human who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she operated at the Nightsister Stronghold. There, she served the Nightsisters as a Mistress of the Rancor.
Shabell was a Nightsister on Dathomir. When Han Solo tried to take a thermal detonator into Warlord Zsinj's war room, she detected and deactivated the device using the Force.
Bran Isken was a Human male Corellian mechanic who often worked as an outlaw tech during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Gilloma was a male Ithorian junior scientist who worked at the Forard research station.
Rena Laut was a female Human former missionary, repulsorlift rental manager, and guide.

Sarken Rimk was a Gungan who ran a dive instruction business out of his home on Whitesand Island on Dorumaa. He was an impatient teacher, and would irritably flip his ears when somebody grated on him. He would also mutter insults under his breath.
Drac Gerrat was a fisherman. In 31 BBY, he owned and operated a fishing vessel, the Icon, on Dorumaa.

Mar Daghreb, colloquially known as the "screaming beast-woman" among her workers, was the Head Manager of the Dorumaa Resort. She was skilled in making each visitor to the Resort feel important, and was credited with much of the Resort's return business.

Saelt-Marae's mate was a female Yarkora who had mated with Saelt-Marae, a member of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's court. Their relationship was documented in a collection of digital recordings made by Marae, which were discovered on an unnamed planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Thurm Loogg was a male Caarite who served the Metatheran Cartel's envoy to the Cularin system after Velin Wir. He headed the Cartel's offices on Cularin and oversaw their mining operations on Tilnes, but was more of a spokesman and facilitator than a true executive.

Len Markus was one of Nirama's lieutenants. He was not Nirama's second-in-command, but rather was a representative of the smugglers in Nirama's organization, and held a bit of power in the Organization.

Tamaron Rill was the leader of an underground Rebel network in an Imperial controlled city. The local Imperial governor hired a bounty hunter named Rill—known by the governor to be Tamaron's own daughter—and bring him in. She accepted the mission.

Rill was a Human female bounty hunter who often worked for the Empire. On the recommendation of Sener of the Imperial Security Bureau, Rill was hired by an Imperial governor to capture the leader of an underground Rebel network in an Imperial controlled city.
Nadin Paal was a male Gran lieutenant who served in Nirama's organization based out of the Cularin system during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Maxig Kress was a Human Female from Tibro accused of stealing valuable experimental crystalline compounds from the Gandalom Paramedicinals, Incorporated corporation's facility on Corvanni IV.
Radlin was an Imperial sergeant stationed in the hidden garrison on Zelos II.

Leong was a member of the Infiltrators. On assignment to Bevell Three, the five-man team including Leong and Jai Raventhorn was ambushed by a squadron of TIE Bombers after the Empire was tipped-off to their presence.

Char'Shen Larcuna was a soldier who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. When an Imperial stormtrooper tapped Larcuna's arm with a force pike, the resulting wound necessitated the limb's amputation; this was a testament to the power of such a weapon.

Tramsig had been a devoted officer since his first days, being a talented soldier who made all the available efforts to obtain promotions. Intelligent and manipulative, he was effectively promoted, although he made a few enemies in the process.
Tira Wils was a female individual who worked as Jir Tramsig's bodyguard and unofficial chief of security.
