Russok was a Trandoshan male and the founder and administrator of Nub Saar, the first city built in Genarius.

Doune was a Herglic gambler who was involved in a dispute with Nyo and Kinnin Vo-Shay over credits. He had the lightsaber that a young Human, Nyo, wanted for his own. Having lost a game of sabacc with Vo-Shay over ownership of the lightsaber, he departed, leaving the lightsaber.

Harbo Wiis was an unsuccessful Corellian smuggler residing on Tatooine. He was once hired to bring a container of tirginni cologne to crime lord Ranon Djelkh, but badly botched the transaction when he sold it to another buyer and had it sent to the wrong docking bay.
Oggun Bantha-Horn was the Devaronian enforcer of Ranon Djelkh.

Serra was a Force-sensitive female Human born from Ambria who was the daughter of the healer Caleb. After attempting to kill the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Bane to avenge her father's death, she was killed by Darth Cognus.

Mother Missira was the Mother of the informal "irstat" of Tarasin students studying at the Almas Academy. When young Tarasin started going to the academy, the elders were concerned that they would not cope well with life away from Cularin and the tribes.
Graskt was the Assistant Director of the Treitamma Political Center on Anchoron. He was killed in an explosion planned to assassinate Garm Bel Iblis, the Rebel leader.

Tsserk was born on Trandosha and trained as a warrior. A drunken brawl forced him to leave his homeworld in disgrace. He eventually made his way to Coruscant and was hired by the Bothan, Rava Teb'lya, as a bouncer for her massage parlor, the Rose Nebula.

affiliation: Birtraub Brothers Storage and Reclamation Center
x: Pirtonna worked as an enforcer for the Birtraub Brothers Storage and Reclamation Center on Crovna, in 0.5 ABY, during the height of the Galactic Empire.
Egron was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire as the Imperial Governor of Chibias during the Galactic Civil War.
Markko was a male Human who posed as Imperial Counselor Raines, a member of Egron's staff on Chibias, shortly after the Battle of Endor. In reality, he was an Alliance Intelligence agent.
Jonas Stern was a humanoid male who was a baron, and who served as a senator and ambassador in the New Republic in the years following the Battle of Endor.

Womwa was an Ithorian male who left his homeworld and settled on a remote planet. He liked the planet so much, he decided to remain, and opened a cantina known as The Haven. The cantina was a front, however, for Womwa's lucrative spice smuggling operations.
Zethe Raskin was a female Human politician.
Vhell Kursoc was a member of the Blood Raptors gang on Genarius. He was ready to take Scar Blenner's place if Scar ever screwed up.
Nalan was an enslaved Twi'lek dancing girl. In 8 ABY she was to be taken to Nal Hutta but was involved in the elaborate scheme by Ghitsa Dogder and Fenig Nabon to scam Durga the Hutt.

Scar Blenner was a large Human, and a member of the Blood Raptors gang on Genarius. When the Rodian Teeloo accidentally destroyed a Blood Raptor snubfighter, Blenner went to Teeloo's docking bay and ambushed the Rodian.

Vell Narot was a blonde news anchor who worked for CSN. In 32 BBY, she reported on a story of somebody sneaking into the Bollin Exotic Animal Emporium after hours and falling into the rancor enclosure.
Gael Kinner was a Human male pilot and member of the Blood Raptors gang.
Teeloo was a male Rodian pilot who owner the Neeva-Beelo, a YT-1210 transport during the time of the Clone Wars.
Daniel was a male Mon Calamari who was paired up with a loved one during the Ewok Festival of Love. L-O53 tasked a spacer with finding a loved one for Daniel.
Hap was a male Latero bartender and chef who operated Hap's Sap Tap on the forest planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era.
Essenton was a Captain of an Imperial Remnant Starfleet during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Groggin was an Ugnaught engineer who supervised Smelting Core D, one of Cloud City's most efficient metal processing incinerators.

Tolga was a Rodian thug who worked as an enforcer for a crime lord. He almost apprehended the smuggler Blaine Hansom but the interference of Platt Okeefe thwarted his capture. He later had a chance for revenge against Okeefe when he teamed up with the bounty hunter Boddu Bocck.

Galt was a Human man who grew up on Dagobah. His parents were part of a survey team from the Galactic Republic that arrived on the planet 40 BBY. However, all their equipment broke down and they were unable to leave the planet.

This unidentified Jedi Knight served as a general during the Clone Wars. Taking part in the Outer Rim Sieges, they led units of clone troopers into battle alongside fellow Jedi Ki-Adi-Mundi, Rivi-Anu, and Eon.

In 7 BBY, Haxim's previously flourishing Haxim's province was contaminated with an incurable flesh-eating bacterium after a mishap in a local Imperial biological weapons laboratory. The bacterium spread throughout the region, infecting natives and ravaging lands.
Pok Nar-Ten was a flashy Nimbanel who worked for the Klatooinian Trade Guild, a proxy for Hutt criminal activities. He was their representative on the planet Boztrok.
Nazrita Villache was a Human woman and chief mechanic for the Klatooinian Trade Guild syndicate on Boztrok. She gave Platt Okeefe a tour of her first ship, the Brentaal Princess.

Allia was a male customs officer at the Wroona starport. He was susceptible to flirtatious women and being bought alcohol. In this manner, he let much contraband onto the planet. The smuggler Platt Okeefe dealt with him on a number of occasions.
Sassallo was a Hutt crimelord that was allowed by Moff Adria Reyn to rule Ord Vaxal. Sassallo specifically controlled the Oubliette shadowport and was a member of the Besadii kajidic.
Iep Tumu was a Corellian merchant who owned the Merasy.
Geld Bernar was a trader during the Galactic Civil War.
Vacasor was a Devaronian merchant during the Galactic Civil War.
Naneb Pefan was an Ithorian trader and co-pilot.
Sordaan Xris was a male Rodian who lived on the planet Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.
Whool was an unpleasant and rude Rodian who owned a general store in a Hunting lodge of homeworld during the Galactic Civil War.

Arber was a male Human lieutenant in the service of the Imperial Remnant during the Yuuzhan Vong War. At the Battle of Borosk, Lieutenant Arber was in charge of the gravitic amplitude modulator fitted to the Star Destroyer Defiant, a device capable of jamming yammosk war-coord…
Ansween was a commander in the Imperial Remnant serving under Grand Admiral Gilad Pellaeon as the commanding officer of the Star Destroyer Right to Rule during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
This individual was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as the High Master during the Golden Age of the Old Republic.

Kip was a man who was in Vanster Enan's Sop House during the 200th anniversary celebrations in Gadrin. He was hitting on Amaya and Suki, and hooked up with Amaya. He was greasy and had a thin mustache.

Darin was a young Human with dirty-blonde hair who worked for House Hirskaala on Cularin. He believed that the Metatheran Cartel was involved in illegal operations, and discovered something which he believed would sink the Cartel.
Nim'Ri was a Cularin-born Trandoshan male security manager and a resistance fighter in the years before the Clone Wars. Unlike most Trandoshans, Nim'Ri did not have a problem with Wookiees.
Velin Wir was a male Caarite business manager, Force Adept and the Metatheran Cartel's envoy to the Cularin system before Thurm Loogg.

Amaya was a Human woman who attended the celebrations in Gadrin for the 200th anniversary of the city's founding by Reidi Artom. She and her friend Suki went to Vanster Enan's Sop House to try to find men to party with.
Oosk was a patron of Vanster Enan's Sop House during Gadrin's celebrations for the 200th anniversary of the city's founding. He spent most of the day arm-wrestling with Varoca.

Varoca was a patron of Vanster Enan's Sop House during Gadrin's celebrations for the 200th anniversary of the city's founding. He spent most of the day arm-wrestling with Oosk. Despite Varoca's greater strength, he only beat the Trandoshan about half the time.

Nance was a patron of Vanster Enan's Sop House during Gadrin's celebrations for the 200th anniversary of the city's founding. He watched the arm-wrestling matches between Oosk and Varoca, and was willing to take bets on the matches, giving 3:1 odds against Oosk.

Kerner was a member of a group of pirates that had been stealing shipments of high tech supplies from around Gadrin. The pirates were using a landing platform hidden in Cularin's jungles west of Gadrin.

Bont was a member of a group of pirates that had been stealing shipments of high tech supplies from around Gadrin. The pirates were using a landing platform hidden in Cularin's jungles west of Gadrin.
Lori was a rather gaunt Caarite who was Velin Wir's secretary. Velin Wir would often disappear without telling her where he was going.

Banol Starkiller was a male Rodian alive during the Galactic Civil War. During the early years of the war, Benol was seen on Kashyyyk in the Etyyy Rodian Hunters' Camp among other members of his species.
NeHimmep was a legendary Duros explorer, merchant, and starship captain.

Corporal Dregz was formal and businesslike, not the usual broad-smiled friendliness of a Caarite. He followed orders to the letter, and was reluctant to give out information as he did not believe it was his place to do so.

Henk Lorin was an Office of Peace and Security lieutenant stationed in Gadrin with a very serious demeanor. While not happy with the Metatheran Cartel's increased presence, she had reviewed their security forces and found them to be competent.

Mirchidi NeMall was a Duros, who, shortly before the Battle of Yavin, bought the NeHimmep, a freighter which he named after the famed Duros explorer of the same name. NeMall never made a good living, but a fear of Imperial Customs put him off smuggling.
Lenri Darv was a planetary customs official during the Galactic Civil War. Corrupt and greedy, Darv often accepted bribes to allow illegal cargo to pass through the spaceport.
Alijah Orr was an Imperial Customs Officer during the Galactic Civil War. He was regarded as the second most powerful man in the Shesharile system, after the Imperial Governor.
Oro was a male Mon Calamari who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Vanster Enan was the Ithorian owner and barkeep of Vanster Enan's Sop House. He was proud of his establishment and had a selection of drinks from across the galaxy.
An Amanin chief was present during the Battle of Maridun.
Phrusaani was a Chevin who operated the Docking Bay bar on the Life Level on Vergesso Base.
Phylus Mon, sometimes known as The Mon, was an infamous Chevin slaver and secretly a Dark Side Adept who lived during the last years of the Old Republic.
Reseros Meh was a female Chevin who owned and ran a diner on Gamorr. She disliked other Chevin as well as members of other species. An excellent cook, she was very grumpy and had a gruff demeanor.
Rorq was a male Mawan, and a native of Mawan.

Borus Ferthyn was a local homeless man in Gadrin and Hedrett. He was grizzled in appearance, with a thick beard, and one wandering eye. He was considered to be crazy and was usually seen in crowds whenever anything interesting was going on.

Renna was a female Rodian who was the owner of Renna's Transport Service. She was tall for a Rodian and had a very businesslike demeanor. Renna was known to offer a job on the spot to people who impressed her.
Viera Cheran served as Chief Technician for Rogue Squadron and crew chief, responsible for overseeing the maintenance of the squadron's starfighters and all flight deck operations.

Dalea Trovin was one of the few female Imperial Customs officers. She worked in Votrad, a city on the planet Brentaal during the Galactic Civil War. She was responsible for seizing a huge warehouse full of raw materials, belonging to smugglers.
Kora was the daughter of an Imperial Customs Hewat. She lived on Yityl during the Galactic Civil War.

Hewat was a Human female who served as an Imperial Customs agent during the Galactic Civil War. She was committed to exposing the Rybet Moruth Doole, administrator of the spice mines of Kessel, as the head of an illegal spice distribution network.
Fen was an Imperial Customs agent who worked at the starport in Quantill City, on Ando, during the Galactic Civil War.

Terno was a Kitonak musician who lived during the Galactic Civil War. A vital member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the Minos Cluster, Terno led a Kitonak band in Cairn's Flying Circus, a traveling circus that was actually a front for the Alliance.

Stanfeld Duffit was the Human mayor of Montrol City, the capital of Gandle Ott in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 8 ABY, Imperial warlord Moff Kentor Sarne's defeat at Kal'Shebbol by the New Republic led him to retreat to Gandle Ott.

Dana Cadwell was a Human female reporter on Gandle Ott, a planet located in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A noted figure on the planet, she worked primarily for the KatholNet NewsNet, as well as being TriNebulon News' planetary correspondent.
Brandy MacMillian was a Human female from the planet Corellia. A freighter captain, MacMillian was a member of the Corellian Merchants' Guild, and at some point earned a Corellian Bloodstripe.
Birket was a Human male who achieved the rank of Major within the Imperial Security Bureau. In this capacity, he had a number of dealings with the bounty hunter Boddu Bocck.
Villian Dance, nicknamed Vil, was an Imperial TIE Fighter pilot who defected to the Rebel Alliance after becoming disillusioned with the Empire.

Celot Ratua Dil was a male Zelosian smuggler. Sentenced to a life of hard labor on the prison planet Despayre for theft, he escaped to the Death Star, which at the time was being built above the planet.
Tenn Graneet was a Human male Imperial gunner who was master chief gunnery officer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Teela Kaarz was a female Mirialan political prisoner who worked on the construction of the first Death Star.
Atour Riten was a Human male commander and librarian who served in the Janissariad in the Balduran Civil War and the Imperial Navy in the Galactic Civil War.
Rodo was a male Ragithian Human Branded Aesthete and a former member of the Strikebirds who worked as a bouncer for Memah Roothes at the Soft Heart Cantina.
Nova Stihl was a Force-sensitive Human male Guard Sergeant in the Imperial Marines and a Death Star Trooper stationed aboard the first Death Star in 0 BBY.
Memah Roothes was a female Rutian Twi'lek who owned and operated the Soft Heart Cantina on Coruscant, at some point prior to 6 BBY.
Kriyystak was a Wookiee who was the best tracker in Chewbacca's family. Han Solo met Kriyystak during his first visit to Kashyyyk in 2 BBY.
Cala Worner was a female Human recruiter for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Tagg Pierce was the leader of the Laramus Base Irregulars mercenary group. A former lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, he displayed a contempt for line officers.
Falto Dragen was a Human male stormtrooper officer who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Trabler was a male Human agent of Imperial Intelligence known for an unwavering allegiance to the Empire who had once wrenched the head off of an Ithorian with his bare hands, testifying to his personal strength.
Qes Dollis was the manager of the Sandstorm Shipping Concern, located at Mos Eisley on Tatooine.

Teer'aa was a female Twi'lek assassin, who worked in partnership with Seer'aa. Once slaves from Ryloth, they killed their Masters and then became bounty hunters known as the Twin Suns, armed with deadly blades along with personal energy shields.

Seer'aa was a female Twi'lek assassin, who worked in partnership with Teer'aa. Once slaves from Ryloth, they killed their Masters and then became bounty hunters known as the Twin Suns, using deadly blades along with personal energy shields.
Thek was a male Feeorin. He was a member of a Believers cell on Tolea Biqua during the Clone Wars, which was commanded by Alina Impeveri. He liked to use vibro weapons.
Dragen was a male Human captain of the Justicars' Brigade during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he conducted several interrogations of Rikael Lysannis, a man suspected of ties with the Black Sun.
A male Quarren Jedi Knight served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
This individual was a male Ishi Tib Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
This individual was a male Jedi who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Leanna Carella was an customs officer and later the wife of captain Dav Kathis of the Longrunner. Once he mysteriously disappeared, Carella took control of his ship to make a living and to look for him.
Dav Kathis was an officer of the Imperial Navy and later a highly regarded free-trader in the Enarc Run, as well as husband to Leanna Carella and father of a son.
Mandus Fouc was an Imperial Customs officer and captain of the customs ship Impounder during the Galactic Civil War.
Tammala was an Ewok hermit and inventor present on the Forest Moon before the destruction of the Second Death Star. He was exiled from Bright Tree Village by Logray for his experiments with gliders.
Kisa Shaki was the boss of the Swift Hutt Spacer's Service Depot in Mos Eisley on Tatooine.

The Majjvara was the monarch and progenitor of the Yvarema species, laying eggs and creating the various classes of Yvarema society. At the end of their lifespan, each Majjvara created a replacement Majjvara to carry on.

Morana Fal was a female born on the planet Ord Mantell. She was a criminal who was sentenced to death in gladiatorial combat in the Soruus system. She was among the combatants provided with a JX4 Gladiator Prototype battle armor in order for the model to be tested.
Fycor was a young bounty hunter who was in possession of a DZ 17X Nemesis battle armor. Unfortunately for Fycor, his armor was damaged while he was engaged in range combat with a wanted felon.

In 8 ABY, Sarne was evicted from his capital on Kal'Shebbol by the New Republic. Falling back to Shintel, Sarne took everything of value from the depot and stranded Heget and his troops on the planet by destroying the hyperdrives on all the base's starships.

Following the betrayal by Moff Sarne, Danthe believed that the Moff would return, and pressed for the completion of the blastboat landing field. He maintained that the Moff's actions had been to preserve the security of the depot.
Tawn Porew, also known as Leaf One, was a Human female who worked for the Rebel Alliance.
Tereb Ab'Lon was a male Bothan politician who later joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Morrina Reugus worked at Brentaal IV spaceport during the Galactic Civil War as a senior traffic controller.

Tellix was an Imperial Customs Officer stationed on Manforgon. He once met an individual known as Anderun, and inquired about their last port of call and current cargo. Tellix learned that Anderun was carrying a cargo of sand wine from Tatooine.
Vonce was a Hapan male pirate, and Benwick Chell's co-pilot. He was a member of the Peace Brigade. In 27 ABY he was killed by Yuuzhan Vong assassin Neeka Sot.

Benwick Chell was a male Hapan and Vonce's co-pilot. A soldier of the Hapan Royal Navy at the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War, he was a dissenter who disliked Tenel Ka's involvement in the war. He therefore joined the Peace Brigade.

affiliation: The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers
x: Matt Talon was a Human male who served as a light scout trooper in the First Sun Mobile Regiment mercenary organization during the Galactic Civil War.

Hogun Rath was a bounty hunter during the Galactic Empire, and one of the leaders of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. He was a famed hunter who acquired a large amount of notoriety over the years, though he was neither flashy nor overbearing.

Hesha Lovett was a Hapan female who served as captain of the Hapan royal vessel during the Yuuzhan Vong War. In 27 ABY, Lovett cleared Jaina Solo to land on Hapes in a stolen Yuuzhan Vong ship and then handed the comm over to Ta'a Chume.

Odoof Grunda was a male Gungan artist who lived on the Naboo moon of Rori. He was talented, but also eccentric and didn't like the city life. One of his paintings showed legendary sculptor Sidoras Bey crafting a statue of Emperor Palpatine.
Tovric was a male Human who was employed as an assassin during the Galactic Civil War, a galaxy-spanning conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
Kollrin was a Sullustan ambassador during the Galactic Civil War.

Ubris was a female Hapan warrior that served the royal family of the Hapes Consortium for two generations, including as a personal guard to Prince Isolder during the Yuuzhan Vong War. She was with the prince when an assassin attempted to kill him from atop a blizcot.

ConJob was a Human male infochant and florist who plied his trade on Tanquilla Beach, a shadowport in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Previously a resident of the planet Siluria III, ConJob lost his family during an Imperial attack upon the population.

Bequesh, also known as The Cardinal, was the Human male administrator of the Tanquilla Beach shadowport located in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Born before 92 BBY, Bequesh was a member of an outlaw-tech group that took possession of a strip mined asteroid.
Hella Brün was a Human female bodyguard who had served Bequesh, administrator of the Tanquilla Beach shadowport, for twenty years as of 8 ABY.
Spang was a Human male starship engineer. He owned and operated Spang's, a repair bay which was located on the Tanquilla Beach shadowport in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Fia was a Human female hypernautics engineer born in 11 BBY who operated out of the Tanquilla Beach shadowport in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories in 8 ABY.
Crimpler was an undefeated Lorellian kickboxer who was drafted into the Hapan Royal Navy during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He saw defeat at the Battle of Fondor and defected to become a pirate.

Dawn Arkanian was a female Sullustan, and the sister of Jedi Master Darrin Arkanian. She often went under the name Thila, and secretly worked for the Alliance to Restore the Republic while undercover as a slaver.
Trox was a captain in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. He served as a TIE pilot instructor on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vengeance where he trained Maarek Stele.
Angela Krin was a female Human Lieutenant Commander who served in the Corporate Sector Authority's fleet.

Kebbo was a Rodian male who served as the Chief Magistrate of the Pembric Security Legion in 8 ABY. A career criminal, Kebbo was also a member of crime lord Crev Bombaasa's cartel on the planet Pembric II in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories, and the Security Legi…

Gaelin was a slicer on Pembric II during the early years of the New Republic. An apprentice tech to the Keiffler Brothers, he assisted in their work on the FarStar when it was under Moff Kentor Sarne's control.
"The Wraith" was the codename of a Human male who served the Galactic Empire as a spy, assassin, and saboteur during the early years of the New Republic.

Redda Macrebe was a male Human who served as a Rebel Alliance agent tasked with acquiring supplies. He was the center of a network of agents and had a vast network of contacts. He primarily operated within the Trax Tube space lane systems.
Mister Tisilan was the alias of a male Bith who served as a Rebel Alliance agent tasked with acquiring supplies.

Vo Lantes was a Rebel Alliance agent tasked with acquiring supplies. He was part of the network set up by logistics agent Redda Macrebe. He owned and operated a chain of used droid lots along the Trax Tube.
Nell Indigo was a female Wroonian mercenary who frequented the Outer Rim Territories.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic

x: Borun Call was an infamous Quarren slaver active since the days of the Old Republic. He was responsible for introducing Slar-dan ti Gardi to the slave trade. When Gardi was briefly captured by Tauran Nartal, Call rescued his former partner and captured Nartal in the process.

Rethorn was a prominent Ithorian crime lord in the Mid Rim region. He was responsible for inciting several revolutions against both Imperial and New Republic interests after the Battle of Endor. His criminal activities primarily included weapons dealing.

Wilkadon was a Grand Moff who governed Askaj. In 8 ABY, Wraith Squadron was dispatched to capture Wilkadon, but the theft of the Killik Twilight, which held the Shadowcast transmission codes, nearly scuppered the mission.
Kendel was an admiral stationed at the shipyards at Kuat.
A male Jedi Master served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a member of the Jedi High Council during the Clone Wars.
This individual was a Gran Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a member of the Jedi High Council during the Clone Wars.

Borno was an Askajian leader of a caravan of refugees, who sought asylum on the planet Tatooine. He was responsible for sneaking Han Solo, Princess Leia, Chewbacca, C-3PO, and three Squibs out of Anchorhead into a desert canyon known for occasionally sheltering Jawa sandcrawlers.
Saarai, a Chagrian female, was a Sith apprentice and the daughter of the Sith Lord Darth Wyyrlok, who was the Dark Lord Darth Krayt's Voice and second-in-command of the Empire and One Sith.
XoXaan was a humanoid who, along with eleven other Jedi defectors, became the first Lords of the Sith.
Seth was one of Jagged Fel's best Hapan recruits. He encountered the Jedi Master Kyp Durron while being attacked by Yuuzhan Vong coralskippers.
Bipopa Bogzider, better known as Bippi to his crewmates, was a male Aqualish and the captain of the Nanda's Luck.
Mr. Halley was a member of the crew of the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar. He served in the cee-cee as officer of the watch during the Battle of Galtea.

A humanoid henchman of the Confederacy of Independent Systems' leader, Count Dooku, administered the Cauldron gladiator arena on the planet Rattatak during the Clone Wars. The henchman provided Dooku with combatants in the count's search for a new minion.
Jak was a male Nautolan who grew up in the Coruscant underworld, where he befriended the Jedi Padawan Cade Skywalker, a frequent visitor of the planet's underlevels.

Vocis Kenit was a Human male who entered the Galactic Empire's Navy sometime before 12 BBY. Rising to the rank of captain by 0 ABY due to his frequent reporting on the flaws of other officers, Kenit was assigned the command of the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Far Orbit.

Elon Vedij was Human male TIE pilot from the Imperial Navy, who was the younger brother of Dhas Fenoep Vedij and the son of Baron Admiral Ronnan Tyla Vedij. In 0 BBY he was posted to the same ship as his brother, who was serving as executive officer on board the Far Orbit.

Fehlaaur'aitel'loro, also known as Fehlaaur, was a Chiss diplomat of the Chiss Ascendancy. He was the Ascendancy's liaison to the Fel Empire and was placed in the service of the Imperial Diplomatic Corps as a sign of solidarity between the two governments.
Cet Willak was an Alliance Special Operations Major assigned as an Alliance observer aboard the Far Orbit in 0 ABY.
Coh Veshiv was a Human male Imperial Advisor who oversaw the Bormea and Darpa sectors, as well as the Ringali Shell, by 0 BBY.
Venslas Beeli was a Human male pirate who served as captain, operating originally in the Outer Rim before relocating to the Core Worlds during the Galactic Civil War.

Starter was a Human male who served as a starfighter pilot with the New Republic Defense Fleet. He was also loosely affiliated with the Black Curs smuggler gang, and flew a T-65B X-wing that had been modified and customized.

Yves Arsen was a male Cerean and the owner of Spirited Spirits. In 31 BBY, his head of R&D, Shayne Gerrare, disappeared along with most of his stockboys, to join the Cularin resistance. Arsen regretted only Gerrare's absence.

Ree Shala was a Twi'lek crime lady in the Corva sector who bought the moon Jaresh around 7 ABY and set up her floating base there. In 9 ABY, she had outgrown it and was hired by the mysterious Human Durrei.
Polg was a male Human Imperial lieutenant who was stationed on the planet Garos IV.
Manion Basca was the male Twi'lek owner of the Jax Warehouse. He employed political activist Gerta Haman as his inventory supervisor, never thinking about her political positions.
Yaeger Doru was a young Human with a habit of biting his fingernails. He worked for House Hirskaala
Secles Usopos was the male Sluissi councilor to the Twi'lek crime lord Abdi-Badawzi on Socorro.

Tra'Parr'Sratt was a Coynite male warrior who worked for the Twi'lek crime lord Abdi-Badawzi. He was a close friend of Kaine Paulsen. When Kaine's wife was dying, Tra'Parr'Sratt helped deliver Kaine's son, Drake, whom he dubbed Lom, as a Coynite term of endearment.
Squig was a Jawa who worked as a technician for freighter captain Elias Halbert.
Shayne Gerrare was a male Cerean who resided on the planet Gadrin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Sansia Bardrin was the daughter of the wealthy industrialist Ja Bardrin. While running technology for her father on Makksre, she was captured by pirates, who in turn handed her over to Chay Praysh's slaver consortium.

Gerta Haman worked as an inventory supervisor at the Jax Warehouse in Hedrett, but was better known as an outspoken political activist. She spoke passionately about the importance of the Tarasin retaining their own culture.
Aervis Wint was a Gungan of middle years who worked for Gungan Security in Gadrin.

Alic Surn was a human male and one half of one of the most famous brother and sister bounty hunter teams, alongside his older sister, Vika Surn. They operated through House Neuvalis, hunting in the Inner Rim.

Vika Surn was one half of one of the most famous brother and sister bounty hunter teams. The other half was her younger brother, Alic Surn. They operated through House Neuvalis, hunting in the Inner Rim.

He had a son who attended the Syndaar Military Prep School. When his son was killed in an attack by the Ho'Din terrorist Ort Hoogra-D'En, he used every Imperial ship at his disposal to track down the Ho'Din, including his personal command ship, the Carrack-class light cruiser …
Lieutenant Reiss was an Imperial officer assigned to the Marduk under Systems Sub-Commander Jared Brojtal.
Babel Senjorg was a Bith merchant with ties to smuggling and terrorism. He worked with the Ho'Din terrorist Ort Hoogra-D'En after Ort cured him of a fatal illness.
Peet was a pilot in Talon Karrde's smuggling organization. In 7 ABY, he flew the Empress' Diadem under Melina Carniss.

Poxall was a Sith magician who served as one of the beings whose essence was contained in the Sith holocron owned by Krova the Hutt. Poxall was known for his ability to create deadly poisons, and was a bitter rival of Mondrak's during his life.
Tirsan was an Esoomian guard who worked for Glorga the Hutt.
Klepish was a Rebel Alliance operative assassinated by the Nikto Ma'w'shiye.
Saloor was a Rebel Alliance operative assassinated by the Nikto Ma'w'shiye.
Candra was a Rebel Alliance operative. They were assassinated by the former Rebel Alliance sharpshooter Ma'w'shiye—who had deserted—using a gun sometime between 4 ABY and 7 ABY.

Karin Orlan was an Admiral in the New Republic in command of the New Republic frigate Resolve. She was from Quian. Her son was the criminal Benald Orlan. Her husband and other children were killed on Quian when Benald betrayed them to the Empire.

Dred Priest was a Human male Mandalorian warrior who was accepted into Jango Fett's invitation to train clone commandos on the planet Kamino as part of the Cuy'val Dar. During his time on Kamino, Priest earned the ire of some of his fellow Mandalorian Cuy'val Dar.
Debret Nightmoon was a female Human smuggler who worked as a courier with her ship, a Starfeld Industries Z-10 Seeker named Starlady.
Nopan was a male Quarren employee of the crime lord, Jarafok.
Salle Serpa was a major in the Galactic Alliance Guard. He was especially noted for his willingness to utilize excessive force when the situation called for extraordinary measures.
Kris Wahl was male Human from the planet Cularin during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Cade Umarian was one of four pirate brothers who were imprisoned aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator. He participated in a jailbreak in which a group of sympathizers with the Alliance to Restore the Republic managed to escape from the Imperial warship.

Ferm Umarian was one of four pirate brothers who were imprisoned aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator. He participated in a jailbreak in which a group of sympathizers with the Alliance to Restore the Republic managed to escape from the Imperial warship.

Jole Umarian was one of four pirate brothers who were imprisoned aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator. He participated in a jailbreak in which a group of sympathizers with the Alliance to Restore the Republic managed to escape from the Imperial warship.

Pano Umarian was one of four pirate brothers who were imprisoned aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator. He participated in a jailbreak in which a group of sympathizers with the Alliance to Restore the Republic managed to escape from the Imperial warship.

Preela Dorat was the daughter of the Imperial Admiral Chel Dorat. Her mother died when Preela was very young, and her father was often away on naval business, so Preela was raised by the family's servants and nanny droids.

Chel Dorat was a naval admiral resident on Jerrilek and the father of Preela Dorat. Considered something of a strategic genius, Dorat served in both the Republic Navy and the Imperial Navy before becoming disillusioned with the Galactic Empire, ultimately defecting to the Alli…

This cocky officer was a young officer who was serving in the Imperial Navy aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Devastator some time after the Battle of Yavin. He lead a boarding team that took a group of Rebels into custody near Jerrilek.
Jovan Vharing was captain of the Interrogator.
Ranes was an Imperial admiral who at some point was choked to death with the Force by either Darth Vader or Antinnis Tremayne.
Nolaan was an Imperial captain who served aboard the Interrogator under the command of High Inquisitor Antinnis Tremayne.
Hennat was an Imperial admiral and friend of Jovan Vharing.
Uland was an Imperial lieutenant and a member of the executive staff aboard the Interrogator.
Leeds was Senior Lieutenant aboard the Interrogator.
Waleran was Senior Lieutenant aboard the Interrogator.

Dr. Wahl was a biotechnical surgeon who specialized in cybernetics and lived in Hedrett. Her career brought her great wealth, allowing her to own the only residence within Gadrin and Hedrett that stood over two stories. Her husband did not work, living off his wife's money.

Mr. Wahl was a slacker who lived off the fortunes of his surgeon wife, Dr. Wahl. He shared a number of bad habits with his wife, such as gambling, which his son Kris also picked up. When it came to Kris's efforts at philanthropy, Mr.

Pellna Gril was a lieutenant in New Republic Intelligence Service, specifically Special Threats Division. As an Intelligence agent, one of Gril's assignments was to review the Black Fleet Crisis. He was a primary source on data regarding the Fallanassi and the White Current.
Trennt Ferinn was a colonel who served in the New Republic Intelligence Service.
Hesh Verbon was the Portmaster at Kwilaan Starport in Keren, on Naboo in 32 BBY.

Nyrkar was a Wookiee who worked for the Dry Goods Emporium in Hedrett. He was in charge of food preparation and dietary consultation, and was considered by his employer, Cal Majjer, to be the Emporium's most valuable employee.

Cal Majjer was the owner of the Dry Goods Emporium in Hedrett. He was generally a grumpy old man, and was used to getting his own way. He employed young Caarites as stockboys, providing them with the work experience they would need to work for the Metatheran Cartel.
Stuart Zissu was a Human male Rebel pilot and the son of the governor of Delantine, Trux Zissu. His mother died before he was twelve.

In the Holy City on Jedha, the fugitive cyborgist used his ghastly medical techniques to produce more of the Decraniated from insurgent victims. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, Evazan and Baba were patrons in the Mos Eisley Cantina on Tatooine.
Nia Reston was a Force-sensitive Human who took on a number of humanitarian causes, usually in association with fellow Force-sensitive San Herrera.
San Herrera was a Force-sensitive Human who took on a number of humanitarian causes, usually in association with fellow Force-sensitive Nia Reston.

Jothel Merritt was a male Grueshite arms dealer and an early associate of Ponda Baba. When the bounty hunter Jodo Kast offered Baba one half of Merritt's bounty, the Aqualish betrayed his friend without a second thought and assisted Kast in catching him.
Broof Yurdel was a male Gungan soldier, security agent and resistance fighter who lived in the years before the Clone Wars.

Trux Zissu was to be instated as governor on Delantine by the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was accompanied by his son Stuart Zissu, 4B-X, R2-D2, and C-3PO from Yavin 4 in the Timespan. While traveling, the Timespan was ambushed and boarded by stormtroopers.

Shella Harin was a Human lieutenant in the New Republic Intelligence Service, specifically Special Threats Division. As an Intelligence agent, one of Harin's assignments was to compile a report on the planet Leria Kerlsil with the help of Professor Bin Binnari.
Ooloos D'Lrint was a Astrographer and member of the New Republic's Astrographic Survey Institute.

Rennie Gallou was a female individual who served as a supply officer in the military arm of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Alliance victory at the Battle of Yavin, Gallou worked at the Massassi Outpost on Yavin 4.

Raije was a ZeHethbra bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. He was hired to kill the Devaronian Brinaloy N'Vaari on the Core Worlds planet Abregado-rae, and came into conflict with a team of amateur hunters during the job.

Devon Fuller was a Human male who worked as a smuggler before joining the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. He helped the Rebels at their Ansarra Rebel base until it was raided by stormtroopers.
The Cobral father was a male Fregan from the planet Frego. He was the husband of Zanita Cobral and father of three sons, Solan, Bard, and Rutin, He died circa 44 BBY of natural causes.
Keena was an individual who went to Screecher's Reach with Daal, Quinn, and Baython.
Scamp was a young thief on the planet of Solay.
Elibet Dav was a female Zabrak from the planet Iridonia who was the sister of Kaysil Verwood. She joined the Rebel Alliance with her sister during the Galactic Civil War.
The father of Soontir and Todr worked for Allied Grain and Roughage together with his wife.
Icus Traft was a male Human who served as a colonel in the Imperial Army. He was assigned as the commander of the Imperial fuel-ore processing plant on the backwater world of Gap Nine.
Kyle Pym was one of Senator Drextar Pym's two sons.
Dirv Pym was one of Senator Drextar Pym's two sons.
Sella Marik was a reporter for Galaxy 9 News during the New Republic. She reported on the assassination attempt on Senator Drextar Pym.
Ordrin Masst was an elderly male Human who ran the landing field in Storrd Township on Seregar. He had two sons, Burdek and Nofft, who ran the repair facility in Storrd Township.
Nofft Masst was a male Human. He was the son of Ordrin Masst. He ran the repair facility in Storrd Township on Seregar with his brother Burdek.

Lorek was the male Human bartender of the CrossWind Saloon in Storrd Township on Seregar. He was a hard-looking man with tattoos on both arms. He didn't keep up with the affairs of Storrd Township but he would watch and report any interesting things to his boss, Daralla Errine.
Tendler Vek was a male Human gambler who cheated a group of nobles in the Core Worlds and was forced to flee to the Rim. He frequented the CrossWind Saloon in Storrd Township on Seregar.
Daralla Errine was a female Human who owned the CrossWind Saloon in Storrd Township on Seregar.
Cather Taan was the male Human owner of Cather Taan's Gun Shop in Storrd Township on Seregar. He was stocky and heavy-set.

Zurric Que'stiil was a male explosives expert who worked for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. He was tall and pale with dark eyes. He preferred clothes of white and dark blue. He enjoyed using his skills to get revenge against the Empire.
Pira Bland was a male Chandrilan Human spice runner who visited Mos Eisley frequently when he was on Tatooine during the start of the Galactic Civil War.
Bek Nataal was a male Corellian smuggler. He was responsible for saving Tere Metallo from slavery and was killed during an Imperial inspection a few years later.
Shuzz was a male Kubaz who frequented the Lazy Bergruutfa Cantina on Betha II.

Arada Turhaya was a Human male from Corellia. He served as a commander in the Grand Army of the Republic and was a hero in the Clone Wars. He was the father of Jamie and Matt, and had died by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

A military man, Gaege Xarran served in the Imperial Army, first as a member of the Emperor's Royal Guard, and later as a general. Dedicated to the armed forces, Xarran was placed in command of an Imperial garrison on the planet Vryssa during the height of the Galactic Empire.
Rivo Xarren, later known as The Storyteller, was a slicer and brother to Gaege Xarran.

Dezono Qua was a Human male from Esseles. He was the sole heir of a wealthy family, and was not well-liked. He lived alone at his family villa with droids as his only companions. He had a small army of IG-series droids, an H2 pilot droid, and a protocol droid nicknamed "E-10."
Orso Meeto was a Chagrian enslaver who worked on the planet of Orvax IV, where he lived in the upper levels.
Darrik was a young boy from Brentaal during the Galactic Civil War.
Ort Hoogra-D'En was an infamous male Ho'Din terrorist wanted by the Galactic Empire. Despite his anti-Empire feelings, he had no interest in joining the Rebel Alliance.
Sykar was a Nalroni who worked as a Nalroni Merchant Council Executive, conducting business for the Council and making sure trade went smoothly, barring unforeseen accidents.
Shesstellek was a male Devaronian spice merchant active in Storrd Township on Seregar. He was extremely thin, and always seemed nervous and edgy.
Neechak was a male Rodian gunrunner who worked for Tern Ashandrik. He stayed at the Callamvor Hotel when on Seregar. He was killed in his room there.
Gorrul Wyke was a male Human skiff pilot who worked for Tern Ashandrik. He was often responsible for picking up supplies for Ashandrik's base on Seregar from Sutloo's Trading Post every few weeks.
Tyrix served as a commander in the Imperial Army at the garrison on Vryssa. He had thirty years of military experience, which possibly made him a veteran of the Clone Wars.
Byrga served in the Imperial Army to the garrison on Vryssa as lieutenant with a habit of smacking his lips when nervous.
Grejj served in the Imperial Army to the garrison on Vryssa as lieutenant.
The Sith pureblood male Larith served the Sith Empire as a Sith Lord during the Great Galactic War against the Galactic Republic.

Commander Biros Baran was a Human male Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service agent who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, he was assigned to Eyrie Base on the planet Karatha.
Horvat was a Rodian henchman of Guldus Bemm who worked on the planet of Canyon. Under orders from Bemm, Horvat attempted to lead a group of New Republic representatives into an Imperial trap.
Arecelis Acosta was a male Coynite-Human hybrid who was a member of the Rebel Alliance Harrier Infiltration Team where he served as the technical officer for the group.

Hethar was a Human male who served as a member of Red Hand Squadron, holding the rank of lieutenant. In 0 BBY, he was part of a team that were to take over the workings of the Helot's Shackle after it's capture from Ylesian slavers.
Feldron was Bria Tharen's agent in the Rebel Alliance, who accompanied her on her trip onboard the Queen of Empire.
Renkov was a Human male business manager who served the Rebel Alliance. He accompanied Bria Tharen on her trip aboard the Queen of Empire.

Nackhar was Wuher's Nartian assistant behind the bar of the Mos Eisley Cantina. He was assigned to clean up the mess from Ponda Baba's lightsaber injury in 0 BBY. He also ran a fast-food stand in the Mos Eisley marketplace.

Tebbi was a female Lepi with soft white fur and pink-tipped ears. She was the daughter of Heff, one of only three surviving members of the original colony ships to settle Tatooine in the early years of the Galactic Empire.

Blevon was a member of the Rebel Alliance and was codenamed Rainbow One, responsible for operations management during the Battle of Ylesia. Stationed on the Liberator, he often spoke with Bria Tharen, who commanded the operation on the ground.

Aeron was a young male Human who was the son of Ylesian slaves during the Galactic Civil War. He was rescued by Han Solo and Chewbacca after the Rebel raid on Ylesia. He and three other children helped Han load and tie spice that had to be jettisoned in order to evade arrest.

B'arin Apma was a Human who was one of the seventy-five Mandalorian warriors who were selected by Jango Fett to help train elite clones on Kamino, as part of the one hundred members of the Cuy'val Dar.
Mij Gilamar was a Human male doctor and Mandalorian warrior who served the Cuy'val Dar during the Clone Wars.

Isabet Reau, nicknamed "Issy" by Dred Priest, was a female Human who was one of the 75 Mandalorian warriors that were selected by Jango Fett to help train elite clones on Kamino, as part of the 100 members of the Cuy'val Dar.

Granit was the leader of cave dwellers who was tall and muscular with a glistening black beard, who Stuart Zissu, C-3PO, R2-D2 and 4B-X encountered on Da'nor. He spoke N'or and carried a spear with him. Granit beat Zissu in space poker and won their azurite and their lives.

Korvit Domesa was the Drama Editor for HoloNet News shortly before the outbreak of the Clone Wars. Among the plays Korvit reviewed was The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma, which was produced by Senator Onaconda Farr.

affiliation: The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania
x: Suprin was one of the doctors aboard the Arkanian Legacy. Lord Arkoh Adasca once assigned him to tutor the Mandalorian scientist Demagol, disguised as Rohlan Dyre, in science.
Madame Darvla was responsible for dressing dinner guests onboard the Arkanian Legacy.

affiliation: The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania
x: Alok Adasca was the seventh Lord Adasca, son of Argaloh Adasca, and the next head of Adascorp sometime prior to the Mandalorian Wars. He was the father and mentor of his successor, Arkoh Adasca.
Naem Yrros was an Imperial general in command of a base on Rhamalai aged 54. Naem attended the Raithal Academy where he graduated with the top honors in his class.
Woetar was a Zarian con man. Sometime between 5 ABY and 9 ABY, he won 1,500 credits in a game of sabacc against a spacer on the planet Tekurr'k.

Kodir of Kuhlvult was named Kuat Drive Yards' head of security after she revealed the last head of security, Fenald, to be a spy. Although she revealed the man to be a spy, she herself was no better as she had deposed the last head only to further her own agenda.

A Knight of the Sith wore a face mask and black robes and carried a red-bladed lightsaber. Flying a Banta Four starfighter in the Kessil system, he discovered and attacked Kane Starkiller and his sons Annikin Starkiller and Deak Starkiller on the Fourth Moon of Utapau.

Crispin Hoedaack was a functionary and the commander of the New Galactic Empire's attempt to annex the Aquilaean system. He was entitled Governor and First Lord of the Aquilaean System and Surrounding Territories.
Vantos Coll was a highly obese member of the Supreme Tribunal, in league with Crispin Hoedaack and Darth Vader as they plotted to take control of the New Galactic Empire.
Seeqov Thranx was a Vratix of the Seeqov hive-clan who identified more as female than male. She was a field inspector and research scientist.

Alastar Treen was a male Human Senator who represented Corulag in the Galactic Senate during the waning years of the Republic. In 22 BBY, before the battle of Geonosis, an assassination attempt was made on his life by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Seig Darklighter was a Jedi, commonly believed to have led the Jedi Rebellion, though the real Jedi commander was Luke Skywalker.

Burt Jaxton was a retired Nova Scout during the early years of the New Republic. Jaxton loved the spaceways and space, and believed a scout needed a particular mindset in order to both succeed and love their job.
Jommillia was a fierce Wookiee warrior on Yavin. Jommillia wore a plumed decorative helmet and armed himself with a battleaxe and spear.

Chuiee Two Thorpe of Kissel was the padawaan of Mace Windy. He was the son of Han Dardell Thorpe, and a graduate of the Intersystems Academy. He remained with his Master even after Windy was cashiered from the position of Warlord for the Alliance of Independent Systems.
Han Dardell Thorpe was a male head pilot of the famed galactic cruiser Tarnack. They were the father of Chuiee Two Thorpe, the padawaan of Jedi-Bendu Mace Windy.
Ril Garn was an officer in the Imperial Army and held the rank of lieutenant during the Galactic Civil War.
Lliegis'Nevz was a male Kian'thar who worked as the bartender for the HyperDive Cantina. His natural Kian'thar abilities allowed him to better interact with customers.

Ruusaan Skirata, nicknamed Ruu, was the youngest child and only biological daughter of the Mandalorian mercenary Kal Skirata and his non-Mandalorian wife Ilippi. She was the youngest and only sister of Ijaat and Tor Skirata.
Tor Skirata was the eldest child and son of Mandalorian mercenary Kal Skirata and the Corellian Ilippi Skirata. He was also the eldest brother of Ijaat and Ruusaan "Ruu" Skirata.

Jund Voon was a male Ishi Tib who ran the Wave Works gift shop in the Fathoms resort of Wildwater City on Dac. He was also part of Odanni's criminal organization operating as a dealer in black market merchandise.
Kei No Kay was a female Qwohog and Wavedancer who worked as a slave for the Ishi Tib Jund Voon. She was forced to make intricate items which Voon sold in his shop, Wave Works.
Nollo Kanx was a male Quarren thug who worked as an enforcer for the Mon Calamari crime lord Odanni. He was one of the most feared inhabitants of Wildwater City on Mon Calamari.
Ijaat Skirata was the middle child and youngest son of the Mandalorian mercenary Kal Skirata, and Ilippi, a non-Mandalorian. He was the brother of Tor Skirata and Ruusaan "Ruu" Skirata.
Geffa was a male Rodian spice dealer who did business with the Mon Calamari Odanni. When he tried to jack up the price of a spice shipment, Odanni had him poisoned for his attempted double-cross.
Koll was a male Qwohog who served as a medical technician for the Rebel Alliance.
Memcha-Badawzi was a female Twi'lek and daughter of the infamous Socorran crime lord Abdi-Badawzi.
R'Kayza was a former Gand findsman, who left his homeworld to pursue a career first as a bounty hunter, and later as an assassin.

affiliation: Senate Head of Public Affairs Office
x: Mar Rugeyan was a male Human who served as the Senate Head of Public Affairs during the Clone Wars. His office was located on floor 391 of the Support Services Center, Coruscant.

x: Jarsa was a female scout who served the Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services. She served alongside Deeve on the NRSS scout ship Founder, which she was capable of repairing and piloting.

The "Energizer Bunny" was a small male lagomorph-like creature that used an Energizer battery attached to his back to keep going and going. Around 3 ABY, the Sith Lord Darth Vader was sent by his master, Emperor Palpatine, to take the Energizer Bunny's battery.

Aay Zavos was a male member of the Galactic Traders Guild who served as an emissary to King Kayos for the Chrome Companies. He was partial to the Independent Systems in their struggle against the Galactic Empire because of the trade restrictions in the Empire.
Pir Cuvin was a male Umbaran who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems as one of the lieutenants of Ghez Hokan, a Mandalorian mercenary operating on the planet Qiilura.
Timma Briss was a Human female from Corulag. She worked as a slicer at Boztrok spaceport until she stole some important files from docking bay owner and crime lord Pok Nar-Ten.
Coelle was a Togorian, and an associate of the freighter captain Theol Dunoche.
Vaskau Farg was a Gand findsman who once tracked a Sakiyan witch to Arkania. He did not like cold temperatures and felt that Arkanians were an ugly, arrogant race.
Hyrim Focela was a male Arkanian Security Master of Novania. He was middle aged, arrogant, had never been in a fight in his life, and wanted to keep things that way.

Vondri Deeq was a male Ortolan chef. He was the perfectionist and irritable head chef of the Three Jetties Gourmet Restaurant in Lamaredd, a establisment serving only seafood from Bartyn Gourmet Delicacies, always cooked under the personal supervision of Deeq.

affiliation: Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services
x: Glaennor was a scout with the Rebel Alliance and later with New Republic Scout Service's Eighth Nebulan Scout Corps who was known to occasionally express satisfaction at her income.

Kn'ik Th'ronik was a Fnessian of that species' thos gender who smuggled droids and weapons. At thirty-five years old, Th'ronik was wanted by the SoroSuub Corporation for the alleged theft of their freighter, the Morgannier, when it was docked on Ord Mantell.

Namuura Din was a commander in the Imperial Navy, serving as one of Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's top commanders and later joining him when he splintered off from the Empire and founded a new faction during the Galactic Civil War.

Vardias Tyne was a Human male who lived in the town of Anchorhead on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. While there, he faced trouble with the Dim-U monks, after having killed a bantha that was destroying his vaporators.

Rhalia Jinsari was a female Zabrak bounty hunter, who lived during the Galactic Civil War. During 1.5 ABY, she was sent by the Dim-U monks to kill Vardias Tyne, after he ended up killing a bantha that was destroying his vaporators.
Zavirk was a male Human who served as a trooper in the Galactic Alliance Guard during the Second Galactic Civil War. He professed to have joined the army in order to see the galaxy.
Lliandri was a female green-skinned Twi'lek who worked as a bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War.
Tergeth Dilorr was a male Human who was a part of the Ho'Din terrorist Ort Hoogra-D'En's network.
Vigrriev was a member of the Elom species who served the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure as a thug and enforcer.
Revidjasa was a male Rodian present in Jabba's Palace in 4 ABY.
Lien-Tsai Qel-Droma was a Human female Jedi Master of great repute from Alderaan who served the Galactic Republic in the years preceding the Great Sith War.
Inkur was the dealmaker for the Irden tribe of Ugnaughts. He resided on Cloud City, located on Bespin.
Harbold Taft was a Rebel spy on Spira. He was a slim and mousy fellow, and had brown hair. He worked as a clerk in the Ataria Island spaceport.
Cabet Lom was a Twi'lek male who had a starship repair and outfitting business in Ord Mantell during the Galactic Civil War. He lived and worked in a penthouse suite in the Pink Sky Casino.
Fiz Cor'gril, better known as Fizzi, was a male Bith who lived on Trevi IV where he ran a used-ship warehouse known as Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships.
Serdo was a male Twi'lek pilot who owned the yacht Firerider, which he used as part of a charter service for wealthy clients.

This Warmaster was the first of three members of Domain Jamaane to be Warmaster of the Yuuzhan Vong, sometime in between the tenures of Yo'gand and Czulkang Lah. Three Warmasters were considered to be anomalously high for any single Domain to hold.
Puln was a male Near-Human who worked for Black Sun Vigo Green.
Vam Margan was a Major, stationed on Vergesso Base where he commanded a battalion of Natori Association soldiers.
Zirlig was a male Ishi Tib assassin who was a member of the Antar Band.
Tasin was a female Nalroni who ran the Jatayus Trading Consortium.
Nim Abek, whose real name was Nim'abek'shy-wedell, was a male Kajain'sa'Nikto pirate who worked for the Black Sun Vigo Sprax.
Liane was a Human female handmaiden to Queen Kylantha of Naboo who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Morteos was an assassin who killed the New Republic General Crix Masst on the planet Sinded. The assassination was carried out by way of Morteos wiring a bomb into the repulsorlift generator of the general's personal airspeeder, so that it would detonate when the craft was eng…
Kilon Tarlok was an elderly Near-Human who was responsible for administering Terman Station. He was unaware that Black Sun paid his salary.
Ujin Voli was a male Gotal who was the leader of the Antar Band, a criminal organization active in the area of space around the Sisar Run.

Ar'wa Nonshik was a male Aramandi who worked for the Antar Band, a criminal organization active in the space around the Sisar Run. Nonshik was a bodyguard until his employer was killed by the Gotal Ujin Voli. Voli was impressed by Nonshik and offered him a job.
Mi was a Human princess and the daughter of King Arturo of Orocco. In 2 ABY, she was kidnapped by a small band of criminals led by Grintlok, who demanded ransom in exchange for her release.

Grodon Lakky was a brutal, sadistic man who was placed in command of the slave pool at the Maw Installation. He derived great pleasure from breaking his slaves. However, he received no respect from his superiors.

Col Serra was a Human male smuggler who operated during the Galactic Civil War and was an old friend of fellow smuggler, Han Solo. After the Battle of Yavin, Serra was asked by Solo, who had joined the Rebel Alliance, to assemble a new unit of trained soldiers for the Rebellion.
Ib Dekeet was a Galactic Empire and Pentastar Alignment governor who was stationed in the Outer Rim Territories.

Irrv was a male general in the Army of the Galactic Empire. He rose to his position through his support of Emperor Palpatine's New Order, and was assigned by the Emperor to subjugate the planet Culroon III.

Glah Ubooki was a Bimm merchant who owned a shop in Glastro on Bimmisaari who had specialized in imports from all over the galaxy, selling virtually everything from technology to pets, but was also known to offer his customers debris from the Destruction of Alderaan as well as…
Tregor was an Imperial Army officer stationed in Pyramid One on Ahakista which housed the Hub, a supercomputer which coodinated the vast Imperial Navy.
A Human male, Rayt wanted to nothing more than to leave his homeworld by the time of the Clone Wars, an intergalactic war that eventually ravaged parts of the planet, including where Rayt had lived.
Bryn Apice was a male Human. Bryn, his brother Wes, and their friend Rayt were in the midst of journeying off-planet with when they discovered a funds transfer in a local bank.
Trillan Katos was a Human male who worked as a banker on a planet during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Sevv Sunb was a Sullustan accountant. He started his career managing the finances of a group entertainers. Sunb helped them expand into the smuggling business, to earn the band more money. However, they were caught in the act and their ship was impounded.

Victor Jun was a male Human Force-sensitive who suffered from schizophrenia, and he thought the voices in his head were those of gods and obeyed what they told him to do—which occasionally involved murder—and in turn, the gods gave him glimpses into their power.
Gamine was a telepathic Constancian female who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

This unidentified stormtrooper was a stormtrooper in the Imperial Army. He fought at the Battle of Maridun, where he was killed when he was stabbed in the back by an Amanin spear. After seeing the man's death, Janek Sunber realized he would never know the fallen trooper's name.

Jek Tono Porkins, nicknamed "Piggy," was a male human trader and pilot from Bestine IV. He decided to abandon his homeworld after the Galactic Empire moved in and built a new military base there, and he ended up joining the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Sharlee was a Constancian female. She came from thirty generations of a proud warrior family that specialized in the use of battle armor.

Triogor Sllus was a male Quarren who was a pilot-candidate within the New Republic Starfighter Corps. With his career already in jeopardy, Sllus agreed to transfer into the starfighter/commando squadron that Commander Wedge Antilles was putting together.

Gyla Petro was a Human female from Kalgo 13. An Imperial scientist and a member of the Senex-Juvex region's House Petro, she was the only surviving member of a research party massacred by plants on Kashyyyk. She later joined Han Solo for a journey to Constancia.

Gharon was a male colonel who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Special Forces. Gharon helped in planning Operation Cobolt, in charge of infiltration of an Imperial orbital base over Mantooine.

Toombs was a Colonel serving in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Special Forces. Toombs assisted in planning Operation Cobolt, and, along with Gideon, led the assault teams assigned to penetrate the Imperial orbital base over Mantooine to recover a new Imperial Intellige…

Nin Nemb was a male pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Holding the rank of Commander, Nemb participated in Operation Cobolt, a mission to retrieve an Imperial Scandoc decoding computer from an orbital base over Mantooine.
Komok-Da was a Sith Lord of the old Sith Empire, hailing from the Sith species, and a weapons master. His spirit dwelt in Bo Vanda's holocron along with her spirit, and that of Lord Kla.
This "Jawa Hero" was a Jawa who greatly endangered the economy of its clan, but eventually managed to save it as it appropriated some valuable Imperial material.
This "Old Jawa" was the leader of the Jawa clan, an angry mechanic and a scarred warrior. The clan leader normally used a piece of mechanical equipment as a walking cane.
This scarred Jawa was a member of a clan who salvaged an X-wing starfighter and later managed to steal a TIE advanced starfighter from a trio of salvagers on Tatooine.
A moisture farmer hoped to purchase some droids from a Jawa clan only to learn that they were not able to sell him any, as one of their number had destroyed the entire stock of droids.
The disappointed moisture farmer's son was a male Human child who lived on Tatooine whose father was a moisture farmer.
The disappointed moisture farmer's daughter was the teenage daughter of a Human farmer on Tatooine. She was disappointed when her father was not able to purchase any droids from a clan of Jawas.

The disappointed moisture farmer's wife was the wife of a Human farmer on Tatooine. Along with the rest of the family, she was disappointed to learn that her husband had not been able to purchase any droids from a clan of Jawas.
This Rebel pilot was an X-wing pilot who crash-landed on Tatooine. When approached by Imperial stormtroopers, the pilot surrendered, but was killed nonetheless.

This Zabrak male salvager was a member of a group of scavengers who managed to salvage a TIE Advanced starfighter on Tatooine. He was planning to sell the fighter to Jabba the Hutt. Unfortunately for him and his associates, a Jawa stole the TIE fighter.

This Bith salvager was a member of a group of scavengers who managed to salvage a TIE Advanced starfighter on Tatooine. The group was planning to sell the fighter to Jabba the Hutt, and the Bith announced that he was going to use his share of the profit on alcoholic beverages.
This Rodian salvager was a member of a group of scavengers who managed to salvage a TIE Advanced starfighter on Tatooine.
The Shrag Brothers were sneak-thieves on Nar Shaddaa around the time of the Battle of Calamari. They were known to strip Hutt Caravels to earn credits.

Fargus Deel was a famous swoop racer. On several occasions, he performed at the tracks on Coruscant. While still new to the sport, he often raced against Han Solo, who Fargus "constantly" lost to. Fargus was known to wear a red uniform and race a custom SoroSuub racing swoop.

Menddle was a Mon Calamari pilot. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, he was the only pilot at the Mensix Mining Facility on Mustafar willing to fly a group of spacers into a volcano to battle the assassin droid HK-47.
Kirima Kalinda was the mother of free-trader Jak Kalinda, who discovered the Kalinda system. Jak named a planet in the system after her.
Ikree was a Nazzar princess and the daughter of the last Emperor-King, Prrit Qabaq. She was murdered by a member of her father's court.
Prrit Qabaq was the last emperor-king of the Nazzar.
Vrrk Jikat was a Nazzar who trained Qrrrl Toq in the ways of the Ulizra.

Yarroq was a male Trandoshan and gang leader, whose name in his native Dosh literally meant "Hunts Without Effort.". He kidnapped the Alliance spy Renci Tosh when her Z-95 Headhunter crashed on Ord Mantell shortly after the Battle of Yavin.

Ikvizi was a male Geonosian scientist who worked at the old Geonosian research station on Yavin 4 a few years before the Battle of Yavin. After he left the station, Ikvizi journeyed to the city of Kachirho on the planet Kashyyyk to study the Wookiees.

Grodin Tierce's clone was a Human male. A clone of the Royal Guardsman Grodin Tierce, he, along with the con artist Flim and Moff Disra, attempted to bring the Imperial Remnant from the brink of defeat by the New Republic.
Kroke Modbom was a male Gungan who worked for the Naboo known as Veermok. Kroke and Veermok opposed the Monarchy of Naboo, and sought evidence of corruption within its ranks.
Byxle Pedette was a Mon Calamari chef and businessman who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Gida Luroon was a female Twi'lek who had a purple skin tone and bore a scar across her left eye. She worked as a bounty hunter on the world of Ord Mantell some time during the Galactic Civil War.

Moldisin was a female Reigat who served as a Rebel agent and a member of the Sandwind Team on Sriluur during the Galactic Civil War. Rather than serve as the group's muscle, Moldisin worked as the Sandwind Team's tech and medic.
Plin Shardona was a young Human male who served as a Rebel agent and a member of the Sandwind Team on Sriluur.
Ka'i'lorshin was a Kajain'sa'Nikto who served as a Rebel agent and a member of the Sandwind Team on Sriluur. Ka'i'lorshin served as the team's sharpshooter.
Redlio was a Twi'lek female who worked as a huntress for crime lords in the Inner Rim region of the galaxy.
Rallan was a male Tratlin who served as a Rebel agent and a member of the Sandwind Team on Sriluur.
Jodar Frein was a male Near-Human who served as a Rebel lieutenant and commander of the Sandwind Team on Sriluur. He was known to be a veteran of several battles during the Galactic Civil War.
Blalock was a male Near-Human who was in charge of security for Abek's Station, a shadowport run by the Nikto criminal Nim Abek. He was a blocky humanoid with leathery, bluish skin and a bald head.
Grisserno was a male Rodian who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Welinarro was a male Rodian who worked as the squadron commander of a small starfighter contingent of Nwarcol Point.
Tolad Dor was an Ithorian gangster active in the Nilg system.
Jhyarra was a very popular dancer who performed at the GlitterGlow Nightclub and the Ace of Sabres casino.

Hron was an Abyssin who played as the star shock-back for the Rampa Rancors. Prior to a match between the Rancors and the Dargul Dianogas at the Innerdome Arena of Nwarcol Point, he refused to throw the game for the Black Sun Vigo Sprax.
Ivar was a male Tammuz-an who worked as a weapons dealer in Meirm City on Sriluur after fleeing his homeworld of Tammuz-an. He knew Limna Yith and was on friendly terms with Kutuab the Hutt.
Puchek was a male Rodian who worked for the Nikto pirate Nim Abek. He resided on Abek's Station.

Mors Odrion was a male Human diplomat who worked for the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Diplomatic Corps. Along with the Mon Calamari Rekara, he investigated the planet Sedri during the Galactic Civil War, where he was captured by the Sedrian bishop of war, Karak.

Ovarra was a female Wookiee Chieftain who lived in the city of Kachirho on the planet Kashyyyk. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, Ovarra was one of the judges at the trial of Ikvizi, a Geonosian scientist whom a group of Trandoshan slavers had framed for planning heinous cri…

Tosh was the herd-mother of a rancor tribe that belonged to the Singing Mountain Clan on Dathomir. According to a New Republic Intelligence report, Tosh was the largest and oldest rancor ever cataloged.
White Eyes was a prominent Sith Lord of the early One Sith. Alema Rar encountered him in the Valley of the Dark Lords on the planet Korriban, in 40 ABY.

Kora Primo was a female Human who served as the head of Imperial Intelligence on the planet Kirima after the Battle of Endor. She came from a long line of intelligence agents and had over nine years of experience.

Laita Durake was a Human female who served as an Imperial Customs agent at the Customs office on her homeworld of Kirima during the height of the Galactic Civil War. She remained at her post after the Battle of Endor, serving aboard the light corvette Impounder.

Issan Len was a cyberneticist in Cloud City on Bespin who created the prototype droid X0-X1, in an experiment to create a droid that could self-reprogram and manage the myriad administrative functions of a space station.
Grot was a male Zabrak admiral in the Imperial Army during the Galactic Civil War. He was one of the key commanders at the Battle of Restuss on Rori.

affiliation: Senate Head of Public Affairs Office
x: Jayl was a Human female who worked for the Senate Head of Public Affairs Office during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, she was employed as an assistant to Mar Rugeyan, the Senate Head of Public Affairs.
Dalls Petothel was a male Human who served as an officer within Imperial Intelligence during the first years of the New Order. He was the father of Gara Petothel and husband of Edallia Monotheer.
Morto was a male Togorian Sith in the One Sith.

affiliation: The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania
x: Aurora Adasca was a female Arkanian Jedi and the niece of Lord Arkoh Adasca, head of the Adasca Corporation.

affiliation: The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania
x: Argaloh Adasca was the sixth Lord of the House of Adasca. His reign resulted in much wealth and advancement. He was the father of Alok, the seventh Lord Adasca, and grandfather of Arkoh, the eighth Lord Adasca.

affiliation: The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania
x: Artonian Dobolond was the director of Project Black Harvest, which researched the exogorths for the benefit of Adascorp. He cooperated with lead scientist Gorman Vandrayk on that project.
Alexis Cov-Prim was a female holovid star who played in The Empire and the Glory, Marked by a Hunter, and A New Order, among others. Alexis's agent was Malthorn, a part-time bounty hunter.
A Sith was a member of the One Sith that served as the predecessor of the Sith Lord Darth Nihl in the position of the Hand of the Dark Lord of the Sith and leader of the One Sith Darth Krayt.
Teerik was a male Rodian savrip hunter on Ord Mantell during the Galactic Civil War.

Ratobo was a Bith admiral in the Galactic Alliance Navy and the new commander of the Galactic Alliance Fourth Fleet during the Second Galactic Civil War. He commanded forces at the Second Battle of Balmorra, where he met his death.
Nak Simm was the Zabrak lieutenant of Torga the Hutt. He was killed by Nomo Sliken.
Thraka Duroth was an Arkanian lieutenant of Torga.

Bigluu was a Herglic bouncer at the Corusca Gem Casino. He had a severe gambling addiction, and although he dreamed of opening his own casino someday, he generally wasted all his money gambling instead of saving it.

Naj Pandoor was a male Human freelance smuggler. As a teenager Pandoor was a student of xenoarchaeology at the University of Ketaris. Soon after the school went bankrupt, he decided to be a smuggler. Pandoor went with Doctor Frayne and Jyl Somtay on an expedition to Geonosis.
Madd Markos was a space pirate. He was seen in the Tatoo system in 1 ABY, attacking other spacecraft in his BTL Y-wing starfighter.
Dyrra was an Imperial colonel in command of a scout training facility on the plant Moorja.

Veril Acamma was a female from Sucharme. As a major in charge of the Tallaga Garrison's starfighter wing, she helped lead the planet's citizens in revolt of the Trade Federation's occupation some time prior to the Invasion of Naboo.
Aneash Maglea was the reigning champion of the Spira Regatta Open yacht race.

Castion Vogol was a corporate executive of Kuat Drive Yards who attended the Spira Regatta Open yacht race. Vogol, who attended Aneash Maglea's private reception prior to the regatta, dressed in a septsilk suit and used a jeweled walking stick.

Tovir Daglear was a male governor. He had a security droid named Ganth who accompanied him to the Spira Regatta Open yacht race, along with Aneash Maglea's private reception prior to the start of the regatta.

Darby Willers was a female holovid action star. She attended the annual Spira Regatta Open yacht race in Ataria City. There, she was spotted by the media attending Aneash Maglea's private reception prior to the race while wearing her noted firegem tiara.
Aladaire Curovao-Simo was the family spokesperson for the Curovao family and its business, Curovao ImpEx.
Simith Gorofila was the head of the Brentaal Dissidents League. She fought the security increases of Curovao ImpEx, accusing the Curovao family's company of shady dealings with the Galactic Republic.

Shellar owned a junkyard on Tatooine, located two miles from Mos Eisley. He was sympathetic to the Alliance and often allowed Rebel operatives to scavenge his junkyard for parts as long as they had the credits to pay for them.
Kritus Morven was a Human male crime lord who lived on the planet Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
Fekk Trunkel was a thug who worked for Borvo the Hutt on Naboo. In 1 ABY Trunkel delivered a business offer from Borvo to a courier of Kritus Morven near Keren.
Dagrus Rhine was a corrupt officer of the Royal Naboo Security Forces on Naboo. Rhine was bribed several times by local criminal Kritus Morven.

A clone scout trooper was a member of the 41st Elite Corps and assisted Jedi Master Yoda, alongside clone trooper commander Gree, during the Battle of Kashyyyk. When Order 66 reached Kashyyyk, Gree commanded the trooper to help him execute the Grand Master.
Dekker was a courier working for Borvo the Hutt on Naboo.
Atoko was an admiral in the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet and, as of 40 ABY, the commander of the Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet.
Lady Aros was a Hapan female and the lady-in-waiting to the Queen Mother Tenel Ka of the Hapes Consortium as of 40 ABY. She was present during the kidnapping of Allana by Darth Caedus.

Ozlo was a Mon Calamari Jedi Knight. In 40 ABY, while still young, he was among those Jedi at the Ossus Academy when the Galactic Alliance Guard attempted to "secure" it, holding the students hostage.

Jerga was a Mon Calamari Jedi Knight. In 40 ABY, while still young, Jerga was among those Jedi at the Ossus Academy when the Galactic Alliance Guard attempted to "secure" it, holding the students hostage.

Vis'l was a young Jedi Knight. In 40 ABY, after Vis'l returned from the a final training mission with a Jedi Master, the Jedi was at the Ossus Academy when the Galactic Alliance Guard (GAG) attempted to "secure" it, holding the students hostage.

Loli was a Jedi Knight. In 40 ABY, while still a teenager and just back from the Jedi Trials, Loli was among the Jedi who were present at the Ossus Academy when the Galactic Alliance Guard—GAG—attempted to secure it, holding the students hostage.

Alfi was a male Jedi Knight. In 40 ABY, whilst still a new Jedi Knight, Alfi was among those Jedi at the Ossus Academy when the Galactic Alliance Guard attempted to "secure" it, holding the students hostage.
Hedda was a female Jedi Knight who served the New Jedi Order during the Second Galactic Civil War. In 40 ABY, she was stationed at the Ossus Academy.

Jela'han was a male Twi'lek who owned a starship repair and modification facility on Tatooine. He obtained most of his part from Shellar with whom he had a deal to overcharge clients for referrals to the others business.
Toronaxx was the public face of Dugs-for-Democracy. She issued public statements following the death of Senator Aks Moe and the appointment of his successor Ask Aak.

affiliation: Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military
x: Moradmin Bast was a human male bureaucrat and military officer who served as a general in the ground forces of the Galactic Empire, the successor state of the Galactic Republic.

Praji was a male human who served as a commander in the Imperial Military. In 1 BBY, he served on the Devastator, Darth Vader's flagship, where he was tasked with capturing R2-D2 and C-3PO on Tatooine.
Lennox was a Human male smuggler who operated near the Palace of the Woolamander during the Galactic Civil War.
Larin Vost was a male Human who was the head of Corporate Expansion for the Corporate Sector Authority following the Battle of Endor. He had a daughter named Aarica Vost who also worked for the CSA.

Aarica Vost was a female Human who worked as an intelligence agent for the Corporate Sector Authority on the planet Kirima following the Battle of Endor. She worked under the alias "Bren-Aarica Rordan," and was the daughter of Larin Vost, head of Corporate Expansion.
Jor Nieler was a male Human who worked for the Corporate Sector Authority. He served as a squad leader for a group of Espos stationed on the planet Kirima following the Battle of Endor.
Cort Flavian was a male Human who worked for the Corporate Sector Authority in the Security Police, though he was secretly an agent working for Imperial Intelligence to spy on the CSA.
