Russ Jarib was a male Human who worked for the Corporate Sector Authority as an intelligence agent. Following the Battle of Endor, he was assigned to the planet Kirima under Kora Primo, the head of CSA intelligence on Kirima.
Cor Mynus was a male Human lieutenant in Imperial Intelligence. Following the Battle of Endor, he was assigned to the planet Kirima.

Baruche Sloane was a Male Human who worked for the Corporate Sector Authority as a naval officer. Following the Battle of Endor, he was made Fleet Commander of a small CSA fleet assigned to seize the Kalinda system, and commanded the Victory I-class Star Destroyer Enforce.
Milo Phineas was a male Human who worked for the Corporate Sector Authority as a naval officer. Phineas was a former captain in the Imperial Navy who later went to work for the CSA.
Anton Standish was an Admiral who served as the New Republic Sector Fleet Commander in Vilonis sector following the Battle of Endor.
S'lixike was a New Republic Captain who served as the commander of the 32nd Cruiser Squadron following the Battle of Endor.
Alinda Solaris was a New Republic Sector Naval Intelligence Officer. Solaris held the rank of Commander of Naval Intelligence in Vilonis sector following the Battle of Endor.
Ree was a young male Twi'lek podracing pilot working for the Hutts, until he decided to leave them and work in a criminal scheme for up-and-comer crime lord Kaeline Ungasan.

This Sullustan Jedi was a Jedi who had survived Order 66. He fell victim to the Great Jedi Purge when Darth Vader killed him in the Battle of Shumari in which Imperial forces clashed with a group of Jedi survivors. The Sullustan Jedi wielded a green lightsaber.

This Gran Jedi was a Jedi who had survived Order 66. He fell victim to the Great Jedi Purge when Darth Vader killed him in the Battle of Shumari in which Imperial forces clashed with a group of Jedi survivors. The Gran Jedi wielded a yellow lightsaber.

This Twi'lek Jedi was a Jedi who had survived Order 66. They fell victim to the Great Jedi Purge when Darth Vader killed them in the Battle of Shumari in which Imperial forces clashed with a group of Jedi survivors.
This bearded Human Jedi was a Jedi who had survived Order 66. He fell victim to the Great Jedi Purge in the Battle of Shumari in which Imperial forces clashed with a group of Jedi survivors.

Drixa Dreul was an elderly Human female who lived on Tatooine in the city of Mos Eisley. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin a spacer who was working for Dyxle Pedette's Tasty Dried Critters came by her house to deliver an order of fast food.

Tiz was a Galactic Alliance Guard trooper stationed on Ossus during the Second Galactic Civil War. She encountered Alema Rar, but was persuaded to let her pass. Alema also told her and her partner to have some fun and they began "pulling at each others utilities."
Ralpe was a sharpshooter in the Galactic Alliance Guard. He was killed during the Battle of Ossus when Jaina Solo shot him in the head.

Guris was a male Nimbanel who worked at the logistics center of the Grand Army of the Republic located on Coruscant. He took a rather superior attitude towards clones, notably Corr, and had a strained relationship with fellow GAR logistics worker Besany Wennen.

Rina Fio was a female individual who was president of Viper Sensor Intelligence Systems. Shortly before the outbreak of the Clone Wars in the year 22 BBY, she was ousted when Arakyd Industries took over VSIS following an 18-month-long between the two companies.
Soontir Fel's mother was a female Human and the mother of Soontir and Todr Fel.
Ivr Drop was a Human male who served as the director for the Allied Grain and Roughage corporation at the time of Soontir Fel's brief employment at an agro-combine operated by that company.

A male Human served as an officer in the Imperial Military of the Galactic Empire during the early stages Galactic Civil War. He greatly resembled another Imperial, the General Moradmin Bast, and bore the same ranking plaque as him.

Prisoner 934890 was a prisoner in Dontamo Prison. In 19 BBY, he gave cellmate Ferus Olin information on the rules of the prison and what to avoid when Olin arrived. However, he went contradictory to his own advice and faked illness in order to be sent to the infirmary.

Kendle was an Inleshat female who briefly took over as leader of the Iskalonian School on Iskalon in 3 ABY. The wife of Mone and daughter-in-law of Primor, the School's leader, Kendle became an Imperial informant after the Empire's brutal subjugation of the Iskalon system.

Anya Darklighter was a female Human and the daughter of Jula and Silya Darklighter from the planet Tatooine. Her siblings were Rasca Darklighter and New Republic pilot Gavin Darklighter. In 8 ABY, she found Shmi Skywalker's journal near a moisture vaporator.

Janus Bonn was a Human male captain of the Imperial Military of the Galactic Empire and a native of the planet Corulag. He was the son of a wealthy noble, attending the best schools and eventually volunteering for service to the New Order upon graduation.
Vondruln was a male Human officer who formerly served in the Imperial Navy.

Elya Omas was a Human female who was the daughter of Cal Omas, Galactic Alliance Chief of State. When Cal was held captive, he was allowed by sergeant Jonat to use her comlink to contact his daughter.
Moosh was one of several members of the Hutt species on the planet Sleheyron around 3956 BBY. One of Moosh's rivals was Suuda, another Hutt on the planet.

Plu Makor was a Near-Human male Rebel Alliance operative who ran a ship repair shop on G-Station Seven, a space station that orbited the planet Genesia. He was distinguished from a typical Human by his red eyes and the short barbs which surrounded his eyes and temples.

Pricene was a male Human who served as a starship captain for the Lant Mining Corporation. He had been assigned to command of the LMC Hauler One-Six, the lead ship of Convoy LMC-55c, when it was captured by an Alliance corvette and a squadron of Y-wings.

Erils was a female who worked for the Lant Mining Corporation. She was the navigator of LMC Hauler One-Six, the lead ship of Convoy LMC-55c, when it was captured by an Alliance CR90 corvette and a squadron of Y-wings.

Riane was a captain in the Rebel Alliance who operated in the Brak sector during the Galactic Civil War. Captain Riane commanded a force consisting of a CR90 corvette and a Y-wing squadron during the successful capture of Convoy LMC-55c.
Natara was a general in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, serving in Sector Command. General Trep Reskan of the Brak sector reported the completion of Oracle Base to Natara.
Dara Gion was a Human female who served in the Rebel Alliance.
Rogar Garret was a New Republic General who served as Sector Commander of the Vilonis sector following the Battle of Endor.
Toshan Gant was an inventor and manufacturer of droid security breakers which came into widespread use in the era of the Jedi Civil War.
Jamie Turhaya was a Human male who was the owner of Turhaya's Landspeeder Repair Shop, and the sibling of Matt Turhaya.
Babo was a male Bothan Admiral in the Bothan Navy.
This raspy-voiced woman was a female member of the One Sith by the year 40 ABY, based in the Valley of the Dark Lords on Korriban.

Ralph was a male employee who served for the Azzameen family company Twin Suns Transport Services. He managed to escape from the facility when the Galactic Empire confiscated the business and its assets.

Dooni's mother was a quadruped who lived on the forest moon of Endor. The protective mother of Dooni, she was the leader of her Foonar herd. She was once enslaved by a species of green-skinned harvesters from another world.
Norton was a male employee for the Azzameen family company Twin Suns Transport Services. When the Galactic Empire confiscated the business and its assets, he managed to escape from the structure.

Ayo Morota was female who led the Red Hand organization on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. Ayo and the Red Hand were under the direct command of Darth Sidious and were responsible for the political assassinations during the Clone Wars.
Alpiett Gredge was a male Human from Brentaal IV, and an officer in the Imperial Navy during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Niai Fieso was a confidence trickster from Veterned, Troiken. Born into poverty, he roamed the streets of Veterned, not able to hold down a job until he found work in Freon Drevan's criminal organization as a factory worker, producing counterfeit Gasgano podracing merchandise.

Drayk was a Human male who served as an abbot at the Dim-U monastery during the height of the Galactic Civil War. Drayk was concerned with order and precision, and he controlled the monastery with a military style.

An Ithorian was a member of Chodo Habat's herd and later became a Jedi. The energy cell fixture from this Jedi's lightsaber later fell into the possession of Habat, who offered it to Meetra Surik for her aid in bringing the Telosian Restoration Project to fruition.

affiliation: The Dark Side of the Planet
x: Tul Bulba was a Twi'lek who owned and managed a cantina called The Dark Side of the Planet, in Nuba City, Nubia.
Resh Gatonne was a Human male independent bounty hunter and the father of the bounty hunter Yarr Gatonne.

Boes Tark was a male who was married to his wife, Lanaxa. In 23 BBY, while on the planet Bandonia, they had a child. Naming the young boy Moxin, they raised him in a life of luxury and privilege on the Tark family estate.

Oneron Fil'vye was a Bothan male who owned and operated the shipping company Fil'vye Transport during the Galactic Civil War. His corporate headquarters resided within Fil'vye Transport Tower, which was located off the shores of Streysel Island on the world of Vaynai.

Roark Slader was a male Human who was once a commander in the Entrallan Militia before he left to become a smuggler and pirate, plying his 'trade' some time during the early years of the New Republic.

Odan was a male Human who served as a colonel with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Based on the ice world of Akuria II around 0 ABY, Odan and his men utilized a powerful vehicle known as the War Sled to great effect, running successful hit-and-run attacks against the Imp…

Jaris Affric was the High Lord of the Sarin sector during the Galactic Civil War, and the Imperial governor of the planet Santarine. He controlled several corporate and criminal interests, and had considerable hereditary holdings throughout the Sarin sector.

Vekki was a female Jedi Initiate in the Bantha Clan at the Jedi Adademy on Ossus. In 40 ABY, she (along with the rest of the Academy's students) was marched out to the Academy's courtyard by Galactic Alliance Guard troops under the command of Major Salle Serpa.

Maddie Macatten was a female Bith who was considered to be old by 8 ABY. Formerly a slave on the planet Kal'Shebbol in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories, Macatten was freed when her master was killed by the Aing-Tii—a mysterious species that hated slavers—while on…
Varel DeVay was a Human female xenobiologist from the Core. Growing up in a pampered environment, DeVay enjoyed the finest education, and worked for several research companies throughout the galaxy.
This unidentified Hutt lived on the world of Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. Calder Nettic was rumored to have had business ties with this Hutt prior to his death in 3956 BBY.
Dara Gunto was a near-Human female. She worked as a performer at The Chasm, located in Gadrin on the planet Cularin, during the final years of the Old Republic.

Eelien Kirat was a tall, muscled near-Human who was distinguished by his silver eyes, white hair, and dark gray skin. A stubborn man, Kirat had been abandoned by his parents on Genesia, and he grew up in the streets.
Lynnori was a Near-Human female who was the Captain and owner of the Starbound Misfit, a modified YT-1930 transport purchased for her by Talandro Starlyte and modified by his friend, Scizzic.

Pargo was a Human male from Kuan who became an Imperial stormtrooper during the Galactic Civil War. Growing up during the civil war with neighboring Bordal, Pargo joined one of the swoop gangs which operated illegal competitions on his war-torn homeworld.
Vlaydm Churhee was the founder of the mercenary organization known as Churhee's Riflemen.
Bho Vendoll was the captain of the Tragic Flaw. He worked as a smuggler for the criminal empire Black Sun. He worked directly under Kisquar.

Putten Beatus was a near-Human female. She was an outcast who found work as a customs inspector at the Mos Eisley Spaceport. She was different from a normal Human by her gray skin and large ears. Because of her looks, she was known to attract quite a few stares.
Arlan Barrezz was a male Human Commander in Imperial Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War.

Gunman was the alias of a member of Churhee's Riflemen and consequently of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Primarily a combat technician, he often made unorthodox use of droids and weaponry to ensure his unit's survival and to outsmart his opponents.
Coross was an officer in the Imperial Navy who was appointed as acting Admiral of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vengeance after the death of Admiral Mordon.

Fivvic was a Barabel officer with the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars and the Task Force Commander for the survey team assigned to scout the planet Dagro. Like the rest of his species, Fivvic was highly respectful of Jedi Knights.
Wend Dinard was a Human criminal who worked for the Hutts on Tatooine.
TD-334 was a Human male who served in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps under Lieutenant Harburik. During his service as a sandtrooper, TD-334 was stationed on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine.
Quich Marae was a male Ishi Tib junk dealer. During the Galactic Civil War, he bought and sold goods at a pirate outpost on Dantooine.

Daiv Dekven was a male Human scout in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Dekven was wounded on Dantooine while searching for a new place to hide in case of discovery by the Empire. He had to recover in a hospital at a pirate outpost.
Rane Yarrow was a male Human freelance pilot. He had two younger brothers, Fern and Kess.
Fern Yarrow was a male Human pilot in the Imperial Navy. He was the brother of Kess and Rane.
Kess Yarrow was a male Human pilot in the Rebel Alliance. He was the brother of Fern and Rane Yarrow.

Nevik was a Human male who served as captain of the Devastator of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. While hunting Rebel spies, he was killed by Sollaine by disagreeing over their position.

The Twins were a pair of ancient Jedi Knights whose history was long lost to the tides of time. However, their story and that of their master did survive as a myth and a fable, passed down for generations among the Jedi Knights.

Rrr'ur'R was the nickname of the Tusken Raider warrior URoRRuR'R'R's bantha. He was the alpha male of his herd, and raised by RR'uruurrr, bantha tender of the tribe. Rrr'ur'R has trampled many Jawas while being ridden by URoRRuR'R'R.
Lob Dizz was a female Gungan engineer who specialized in submersible transport engines and guidance systems. She was famous on Naboo for her work on high-speed bongos.
Mukit was an Ubese mercenary who had been hired by the Mandalorian Ghez Hokan to work with him and several other mercenaries on the planet Qiilura.
Bycha was a Human female commanding general for the planet Typha-Dor.
Chorh-dha was a Rodian member of the Black Sun criminal organization during the Galactic Civil War. He was a member of the Chattza Clan.
Chooru Delb was a noted Rodian actor shortly before the outbreak of the Clone Wars. His most famous part was the title role in The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma.

Kassar Forge was a Human teacher who worked on a Galactic Republic program on Kessel to educate inmates on how to re-enter society upon release. He is the father of Lujayne and Inyri Forge, who both became Rogue Squadron pilots.
The director of Harlequin Station was a male individual who was in charge of deliveries to and from Harlequin Station during the Galactic Civil War. He was also in charge of Station defenses.

Edallia Monotheer was a Human female, and the wife of Dalls Petothel. She was also the mother of Gara Petothel. Monotheer was trained as an actress and also as an Imperial Intelligence agent working for Director of Imperial Intelligence Armand Isard.
This individual was a Rutian Twi'lek Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Sirlul was a female Quarren from the Mon Calamari homeworld, Dac. She was a commander in the New Republic's navy who served as a bridge officer on the Mon Calamari cruiser Home One under Admiral Ackbar.

Myda Forge was a Human female who had been sentenced to labor in the spice mines of Kessel. During her time there, she reformed her life and became a teacher who worked on a Galactic Republic program on that world whose objective was to educate inmates on how to re-enter socie…
Jax the Hutt lived during the time of the Old Republic.
Zabin was a Kubaz queen. She presided over the Zabin Hive on Kubindi. Her offspring included Garindan and Udin.
Bizzin Uz was a Kubaz guide who was sympathetic to the Alliance to Restore the Republic and would often help offworlders. He was killed by a spydr in 0 ABY.
Olan Dewes was an Imperial General who was the commander of the Tafanda Bay.

Breakman was a mercenary employed by the false Jedi Taxer Sundown on Ord Mantell in 37 BBY. Breakman was killed by savrips led by Mawkran as they assaulted Sundown's mountain retreat, which he was guarding together with fellow hired gun Crawley and others.

Crawley was a mercenary employed by the false Jedi Taxer Sundown on Ord Mantell in 37 BBY. Crawley was killed by savrips led by Mawkran as they assaulted Sundown's mountain retreat, which he was guarding together with fellow hired gun Breakman and others.
The father of the child Norky was a male persta, the same species as his son. Norky's father lived with their son's mother and Norky on the Forest Moon of Endor.
The mother of Norky was a female individual. Norky's mother lived with her husband and her son on the forest moon of Endor.

Dwin Arnae was a male Human captain in the Imperial Customs in the Minos Cluster. He was known for being a perfectionist. His goal was to apprehend and prosecute every customs violation, no matter how small the infraction was.

N'zaet Nir was a human male who is from Mayro and a member of the Direx Board, the executive committee of the Corporate Sector Authority. During the Clone Wars, he was one of six civilians taken hostage in the Galactic City spaceport hostage siege by Korunnai terrorists.
Vengnar Heiff, Master Torturer, was the head of the Galactic Empire's Department of Punishment during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War.
Greeb was an Imperial admiral, whose fleet held station over Ithor in 0 ABY. His fleet was driven away from Ithor by the forces of Admiral Gial Ackbar, during a battle at Ithor.
Boma Inondo was an Imperial Ithorian, who attempted to capture Momaw Nadon on the Tafanda Bay in 0 ABY. He failed, and was subsequently killed.
Ffaseer effet Ihsss was the Margrave-sister of Togoria. Being the sister of the head of state, she would play host to visiting dignitaries.
Fassool was a male Togorian and head of the Mindnight Fire clan.

Fordwyn was a Rebel agent. He masqueraded as an Imperial officer in 0 ABY, appointed Imperial Navy Captain of the Victory-class Star Destroyer Valiant near Togoria. He aided Han Solo by throwing three pursuing bounty hunters off his trail.
Gallo Memm was a Nimbanel crime lord who owned Streysel Island on the planet Vaynai. He was an enthusiastic collector of rare artifacts.
Dmaynel Kiph was a male Devaronian who lived in the Invisec area of the planet Coruscant.
Liska Dan'kre was a wealthy Bothan female.
The unidentified Rebel soldier was a male Human who joined the Rebel Alliance shortly after the Battle of Yavin due to the invasion of his homeworld by the Galactic Empire.
Herrit Gordon was a short, balding New Republic diplomat.

Tatavan Gordon was married to Herrit Gordon, a New Republic diplomat. When he was stationed on Bothawui, she picked up Bothese and became popular with the locals in the social circles in which the Gordons moved.
Farl Cort was a Human male who served as the leader of the moon colony on Halanit during the Galactic Civil War.
Pelvin was an Imperial captain. He was stationed aboard the Decimator in 0 ABY.
Dylak was an Imperial Communications officer. He was stationed aboard the Decimator in 0 ABY.
Groot was an Imperial Admiral. He was stationed aboard the Decimator in 0 ABY.

Errad Brytok was a Human male lieutenant in the Imperial Navy, and a Sergeant Major during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he was second in command to Captain Gilad Pellaeon, aboard the Chimaera.

Butler was the pirate who discovered the planet of Butler's Cove. He hoped to use it as a base from which to raid the Demophon system, but was killed on his first raid. All additional information on the planet perished with him.

Thon's Jedi Master was a Jedi Master who trained Thon in the ways of the Force. He arrived on the planet of the Tchuukthai species, deep in the Unknown Regions, where he discovered that the Tchuukthai, commonly thought to be unintelligent beasts, were in fact beings capable of…

Averen was a male Human fleet officer in the Imperial starfleet who served as captain of the Star Destroyer Monarch during the Seizure of Coruscant, during which he surrendered to the New Republic after sustaining serious damage.
Twitch was a swoop biker in the employ of Jabba Desilijic Tiure. An alien with blue skin, Twitch developed a deep hatred for droids as he was replaced, in a former career, by one.

Vennido T'all was a male Bith musician who lived on Clak'dor VII. His music was notable for its strong anti-Republic sentiment, and in 21 BBY, he composed a song that contained samples from the Jabiimi separatist commander Alto Stratus' speeches to the Confederacy of Independe…
Kalbrac was a Mon Calamari councilor in the Mon Calamari Council and a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Ruke Chowall was a Quarren journalist who worked as the editor of the newsnet Bends during the last decades of the Galactic Republic stationed out of Morjanssik on Dac.
The Kete Queen was the leader of the Kete hive on the forest moon of Endor. As the Queen, she was the largest of the Ketes, appearing to be more than twice the size of a normal Kete worker.

Crin was a soldier in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, stationed on Endor following the climactic battle over the moon. A volatile individual, he was drawn into conflict with the smuggler Rik Duel, a situation only resolved through the intervention of Luke Skywalker.
Dilrath was a Skrilling junk merchant, who owned his own salvage ship. In 0 ABY, he sold a droid, B-1D4, to a group of Rebel agents.
Kassihm was a Kadas'sa'Nikto pirate, and captain of the M'hendosat during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.
Burra Stone was a Force-sensitive Human Imperial officer who served the Imperial Department of Redesign as an interrogator.
Rollo Morsai was a female Human smuggler and former actress who operated in the Minos Cluster during the time of the Rebellion era.
Korkeal Hai was a hyperkinetic smuggler who loved tinkering with her freighter, the modified Gymsnor-3 freighter called the Riff-Raff.

Wicket Wystri Warrick (sometimes shortened to Wicket W. Warrick) was a male Ewok who served as a scout and warrior on the "forest moon" of Endor, a wild, temperate moon which orbited the massive gas giant of the same name.
Phelon was a male Columi who resided on Coruscant. Despite being a creature of diminutive stature, his head was so large that it required repulsorlift assistance to stay upright.
Choupek was a self-styled warlord who ruled a significant portion of the Coruscant underworld. He was guarded by at least six armed beings.
Mtara Vinram was a Human female who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. She was a member of the Corellian Security Force before choosing to become a criminal.
Lizardman the Slave was a male Trandoshan who ended up stranded on the Forest Moon of Endor during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Jarred Sneel was a male Human who was the leader of the Mechanical Liberation Front, or MLF, who conducted hit-and-run terrorist strikes against droid manufacturers during the New Order.
Dania was a Human female who was a member of the Rebel Alliance on Brentaal IV and the lover of Surl, a corrupt customs agent and undercover spy.

Elamm was a male Drall wingrider, the traditional Drallish police force and messenger service, and a member of Duchess Sarella's clan. Like most wingriders, he was smaller and shorter than a typical Drall.

Santor was a diplomat from the planet Shawken, who helped lead Shawken's temporary government after the Galactic Empire abandoned the world following the Battle of Endor. In 4 ABY, Santor hosted a delegation from the Alliance of Free Planets led by Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker.
Ta'al Pierc was a short, overweight, and middle-aged Human male agent who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the planet Toprawa during the Galactic Civil War.

Druth Anamor was a male Human and the Head of Research at the Imperial Research Station on Toprawa. High in the hierarchy of Imperial scientists, Anamor was favored by Emperor Palpatine himself. Anamor had a large apartment in the research station, entirely decked out in red.
Mordak was an Imperial captain who served the Galactic Empire. He joined Darth Vader in an expedition to Malagarr, but later defected to the Rebel Alliance.
Rhirren was a Wookiee of the Myyydril tribe that lived in the Myyydril Caverns on Kashyyyk. He worked as a guard, protecting his village from threats like the Urnsor'is.

Rhylis was a male Wookiee member of the Shoartu tribe of the Kerritamba Village on the planet Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War. By the time following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he and Hwruarca worked as arena guards at the Kerritamba Village Arena.
Chase Piru was a Human female Padawan of the Jedi Order who was stationed in the Jedi chapter house on Bogden 3 near the end of Clone Wars.

Frap Radicon was an Imperial scientist who helped Bevel Lemelisk design the Death Star I. Following one of Lemelisk's deaths and the destruction of the Death Star over Yavin, Radicon was involved in a scheme to invent new gravity well projectors.
Kylaena Haley was a female Human who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was a member of the Sith Shadows on Dathomir.
Emiel Skoff was an intellectual who sought out the means by which the Alliance to Restore the Republic could defeat the Empire.
Rass M'Guy was an underworld kingpin who hired Celia Durasha and Kaj Nedmak to run several missions.

Dyans ke Vasan was a male Human Adumari starfighter pilot from the planet Adumar. ke Vasan and his flight challenged New Republic pilot Wes Janson to a duel upon Red Flight's—a group composed of Rogue Squadron veterans—diplomatic visit to the planet.

Buan ke Shia was a male Human Adumari starfighter pilot from the planet Adumar who challenged General Wedge Antilles to a duel upon Red Flight's—a group composed of Rogue Squadron veterans—diplomatic visit to the planet. He and his entire flight were shot down by Red Flight.

Uliaff ke Unthos was a male Human Adumari from the nation of Cartann on the planet Adumar. He served as the Minister of Notification and was responsible for sending out notification letters to the family members of Cartann duelists, informing them of the death of their kin.

Dovel was a male Human police officer who lived on the planet Coruscant. He served with the Coruscant Security Force and, by the beginning of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Dovel had reached the rank of Lieutenant.
Joz Larutur was a male Human who was the husband of Cira Larutur and one of the hostages that were taken during the Galactic City spaceport hostage siege.
Cira Larutur was a female Human who was the wife of Joz Larutur and one of the hostages taken during the Galactic City spaceport hostage siege during the Clone Wars.
Cobb Vartos was a dark-skinned, male Human Major in New Republic Intelligence who led a team of Intelligence officers to liberate Verkuyl from the Galactic Empire.
Berin B'naian was a Coruscant Customs officer on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. He was one of the hostages taken during the Galactic City spaceport hostage siege.
ke Fanax lost the duel and ke Hanadi gave the choice of his survival to Antilles as a sign of honor. Hesitant to kill someone senselessly, Antilles spared his life.

Jeapird ke Fanax was a male Human Adumari starfighter pilot and blastsword duelist from the planet Adumar. He fought in the finals of the Cartann Ground Championship against Cheriss ke Hanadi to whom he ultimately lost.
Vun Merett Jai was a senatorial aide on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Vun Merett Jai was one of the hostages that were captured by terrorists.

Berandis was a male Human Adumari who served as the assistant manager of the Challabae Admits-No-Equal Aerial Eruptive Manufacturing Concern, a missile manufacturing plant on the planet Adumar. Berandis was in charge of public concerns for the company.
Mawbo Kem was the owner of the reasonably disreputable Mawbo's Performance Hall in Mos Espa on Tatooine. She was well-known among the locals for having many lovers.

Irasal ke Voltin was a male Human Adumari who had a feud with fellow Adumari Garatty ke Kith. Intending to ambush ke Kith as he returned home, ke Voltin tried to enter his apartment but after learning that it was locked, he then tried finding a hiding spot to wait.
Garatty ke Kith was a male Human Adumari from the nation of Cartann on the planet Adumar. He had a feud with fellow Adumari Irasal ke Voltin, who ambushed him as he was going in to his apartment.

Eneboros ke Shalapan was a male Human Adumari starfighter pilot and blastsword duelist from the planet Adumar. ke Shalapan challenged Cartann Ground Champion Cheriss ke Hanadi for her title before the perator's announcement of world government for Adumar.

Phalle ke Seiufere was a male Human Adumari starfighter pilot and blastsword duelist from the planet Adumar. ke Seiufere was the second challenger of Cartann Ground Champion Cheriss ke Hanadi for her title before the perator's announcement of world government for Adumar.

Trayos Toreggen was an ancient Jedi Master who wrote the text Becoming One with the Force. Within this tome he cautioned Jedi from seeking an easier path to power; recognizing the Jedi Path was a difficult one to walk, he knew the dark side of the Force to offer quicker, more …

Gilder Varth was a male Human who served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. Around 17 BBY, Varth was tasked by the Galactic Empire with exposing the seditious behavior of Bail Organa, a leading senator from the world of Alderaan.

Darga Jiramma Mionne was a young Hutt crime lord who carved out a small empire on Cato Neimoidia. Though he was nowhere near as successful or mighty as other members of his clan, he believed that his dealings with the Galactic Empire would put him on a fast track to power.

Escalion was a male Human Adumari and the perator of the Yedagon Confederacy on the planet Adumar. He provided sanctuary to Red Flight, Iella Wessiri, Cheriss ke Hanadi and Hallis Saper, who at the time were fleeing from the nation of Cartann.

ya Sethes was a female Human Adumari who served as a general in the Yedagon Confederacy on the planet Adumar. She assisted Red Flight—a New Republic veteran starfighter group—in planning strategies leading up to the Adumari Civil War.

Janus was a human male who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he was the warehouse manager of Tosche Station. At some point, he bought some stuff to the Jawa traders of Sand Crawler 345.
Grembae was a Human female Adumari who served as a mechanic for the Yedagon Confederacy on the planet Adumar. She worked on General Wedge Antilles's X-wing starfighter before the Adumari Civil War.

Hwruarca was a female Wookiee member of the Shoartu tribe of the Kerritamba Village on the planet Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War. By the time following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she and Rhylis worked as arena guards at the Kerritamba Village Arena.

Geng Salaban was a male Human and commander of the Quasar Fire-class bulk cruiser Battle Dog, which served in Group Two of the Solo Fleet during the hunt for Warlord Zsinj. Later, Salaban was given the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Allegiance as his command.
A Human male captain served with the Imperial Navy, commanding an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer during the aftermath of the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.
Vasnish Kay was a Bimm bard who traveled with her merchant family across the galaxy when she was young.
Denia was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, despite her advanced age.
Circa 17 BBY, Aldrete attended the launch event on the world of Alderaan for her family's new luxury hovertrain.
Baltke was a male Chiss commander of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet who served as a battle surgeon and interrogator.
Kazdan Paratus was a male Aleena Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Peeja Mobet was the owner of Peeja Mobet's Holo Emporium.

Fizzy Fon Margan was a ronto dealer on the desert planet of Tatooine. In 1 ABY he was at feud with an enraged buyer who thought that Margan had cheated her after she discovered that the ronto she bought from Margan was infested with mites.

Quenton was a commander aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Chimaera, reporting directly to Captain Gilad Pellaeon. When Grand Admiral Thrawn returned, he eventually took the Chimaera to the planet Tatooine in an attempt to recover the painting Killik Twilight.

Helfin Hundi was a Nikto who operated in Coronet City, Corellia sometime after 0 BBY. An information broker, he was engaged in selling Imperial shipping manifests to the Rebellion. He was arrested by a bounty hunter working on behalf of Captain Gilad Pellaeon.
Xoron Gulfel was the male Corellian leader of an industrial espionage ring. Gulfel came to the attention of the Imperial authorities, who had him killed outside Coronet City sometime after 0 BBY.
Geg Winthazen was an Imperial major and non-com posted to the Emperor's Retreat on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. He was later based out of the city of Narmle on Naboo's moon of Rori.
Gib was a Human male smuggler who operated on Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War.
Wilhalm Skrim was a human male government official who served as secretary to Tour Aryon, the governor of Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Akkar Plint was a gangster who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He was member of the Swang's Swoopers gang.
Gohn Bimmin was an Imperial officer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Snrrrlagga was a male Wookiee slave who was employed by the Hutt cartels during the Galactic Civil War. After involving himself in affairs that would damage the career of Eugene Talmont, he was assassinated by a hired spacer.

Nwilla Thar'lyat was a female Bothan spy who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, attempted to discredit Eugene Talmont by providing an ISB officer with details on his operations. She was killed by an Imperial spacer who was sent by Talmont to eliminate her.
Klaua Jik was a female Zabrak who served as an employee for the Imperial Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War.
Harbo Linn was a Human male Inquisitor who served the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius during the Galactic Civil War.
Trondor Pyn was a spy for a pair of feuding Kuati merchant houses.

Stephin was a security expert and a friend of Cilia Dil. He accompanied Cilia, Qui-Gon Jinn, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Aeran on a secret mission to Delaluna to steal the plans for the Annihilator to free Junction V from the oppression of the Guardians.
Aeran was a female Human weapons expert who lived on Junction V and was a close friend to Cilia Dil during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Beckman was a male Human officer who served as a Commander in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

A Rodian contact was a male Rodian who lived in Tatooine's Mos Eisley spaceport. A few months after the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance to Restore the Republic dispatched Renegade Squadron to Mos Eisley to free a group of Rebel prisoners who were being held by the Hutt Cartel.

Rei Soffran was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Soffran served as a instructor at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant and taught the intermediate level students.
Oden Malksch was a male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic before the rise of the Empire and the dissolution of the Jedi.
For'o was a male Bothan admiral who fought in the Bothan navy at the time of the Second Galactic Civil War.
Kaoln was a male Jedi who crewed aboard a YT-1300 light freighter under the command of Captain Nuendo Rash.
Frayne was a middle-aged Human woman who served the Galactic Republic military as a weapons researcher and scientist, during the years leading up to the Clone Wars.
Jorus Trass was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as the Chief Linguist of the Almas Academy, an experimental Jedi academy located on Almas in the Cularin system.
Asran Headows was the Master Curator of the Galactic Museum on Coruscant in the years leading up to the Clone Wars.

Deksi Fivvl was an old Aqualish that served as Naz Felyood's longtime engineer aboard the pirate ship Jynni's Virtue during the height of the New Order. Fivvl also served as the ship's part-time historian, since one of his primary hobbies was studying the history of the galaxy.
Garginoolaara, or Gargi for short, grew up in the Roche asteroid field. Many of his modifications were deemed too dangerous, even for the Verpine themselves, and he was cast out by his hive.
Groex Gal was a religious male Ebranite around 0 BBY. He was able to communicate in the Ayrou language.
This male Human owned an eopi named Elrod and lived on the planet Nadiem.

gender: Varied. Male during the hunt for the royal eggs
x: Jesson Di Blinth was a X'Ting from the volcano Di Blinths on the planet Ord Cestus. During his time as a male, he went on a mission with Obi-Wan Kenobi to retrieve two Royal X'Ting eggs in 21 BBY.

A Sith sorceress inhabited the world of Ambria centuries before the Great Hyperspace War. As a practitioner of the dark side and a follower of the Sith Order, she spent hundreds of years enslaving Ambria's populace, overseeing the construction of a large obelisk.

Duriet was the wife of musician and former Corellian militia member Grondorn Muse. When the Galactic Empire blacklisted their husband because of the political content of his songs, both Grondorn and Duriet joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic prior to the Battle of Yavin.

Devers was a human male Imperial Army trooper stationed at Eiattu 6 during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Endor, he was under the command of Moff Leonia Tavira and often feared that if he failed, he would be punished harshly.

This unnamed scout trooper was an Imperial scout trooper who served and died during the Evacuation of Yavin. During the battle, he was able to infiltrate the Rebel Alliance's temple base and obtain a datapad containing secret information about the Alliance.

Volks was a Lieutenant in the Imperial Army that was stationed on Eiattu 6 under the command of Moff Leonia Tavira. Shortly before the liberation of Eiattu, he was sent to find the body of the Rebel X-wing pilot, Nrin Vakil.

This unidentified Rebel Vanguard was a male Human who was recruited by Commander Col Serra to join Renegade Squadron, the Rebel Alliances' new elite fighting unit. During his career as a Rebel he was trained and became a member of the Rebel vanguard division.

Chrag'mak'al was a Givin pirate who operated during the reign of the Galactic Empire. A former priest, Chrag'mak'al left his homeworld after becoming disillusioned with his predictable life, and began working as an astrogator on a series of heavy freighters.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Myleena Dystra was a Human female who served as an agent with the New Republic Security Force. Born on the planet Coruscant to wealthy Coruscanti parents, Dystra grew up in the environment of palatial estates and private schools.
Osira Mavron was a Human female who served in the Imperial Army until she defected to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Blair Temquill was a female Human from Ralltiir.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Ash Lynn was a female Human and an attendee of the Jrade District COMPNOR drive in 19 BBY on Coruscant. Her background check by the Inquisitorius did not pass, and he fell under Imperial Intelligence suspicion along with Bray Kopedon and Jodd Sonta.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Bray Kopedon was a male Human and an attendee of the Jrade District COMPNOR drive in 19 BBY on Coruscant. His background check by the Inquisitorius did not pass, and he fell under Imperial Intelligence suspicion along with Ash Lynn and Jodd Sonta.
Vincol Dunker was a male militia officer and musician. He was a member of the Fighting 357th Serenaders, a militia band from Bela Vistal on Corellia.
Pytor Tuko was a male militia officer and musician. Sometime following 0 BBY, he was the leader of the Battling 166th Troubadours, a militia band based in Bela Vistal on Corellia.
Liam Byrne was a Human male and an Imperial Commander during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Around 1 ABY, he was posted to Yavin 4 as part of a team investigating the abandoned Rebel base there.
Trever Flume's father was the father of Trever Flume. He was killed right after the Clone Wars ended. A doctor during the war, he lived on Bellassa and worked in the city's defense department.
A four-eyed Jedi Master served on the Assembly of great Masters of the Jedi Order around the time of the Great Sith War.
Haro Whitesun was the brother of Beru Whitesun Lars and Dama Whitesun Brunk. He was killed on the planet Naboo for supporting the Rebel Alliance in their fight against the Galactic Empire.

Hes Jor-Sharu was a Human Jedi archivist of the New Jedi Order. After the end of the Galactic Civil War, Jor-Sharu compiled a history of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's fight against the Galactic Empire for the Jedi Archives in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant when their te…
Lesle Andreya was a female Human from the planet Neree. One of the Rebellion's top agents, she prevented several Imperial ambushes on her fellow Rebels.

Lar Maendin was a Human male who served as a scout for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War Maendin sold the locations of Rebel bases to the Galactic Empire, necessitating the evacuation of the bases before Imperial forces destroyed them.
Vin Kollis was an officer of the Imperial Army, the commander on Nishr during the Galactic Civil War.

A Human stormtrooper commander served as an officer in the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps's elite 501st Legion during the Galactic Civil War. He served on the Imperial Star Destroyer Devastator under the command of the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader.

This stormtrooper was a Human male stationed aboard the first Death Star, who participated in the Millennium Falcon capture and ordered a scanning crew to board the ship and check it. Not too long afterward, the Battle of Yavin commenced, with the Death Star's destruction.

A stormtrooper participated in the Battle of Endor. He shot Leia Organa as she and Han Solo attempted to enter the shield generator. The stormtrooper held Organa and Solo at gunpoint along with another; both stormtroopers were subsequently killed by Organa's blaster pistol.

This stormtrooper was a Human with the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps during the early part of the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed aboard the original Death Star as part of the battle station's guard contingent in 0 BBY, just prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Morna Faenarm was a Human female who was a professional athlete before becoming an accountant for Incom Corporation as well as an operative that passed information along to Alliance Intelligence.
Ki Largo owned a cantina in Mos Espa that was named after himself.
This unidentified separatist commander was a male cyborg in charge of the Separatist Droid Army on an unidentified planet during the Clone Wars.

Lude was a male Human TIE/LN starfighter pilot in the Imperial Navy that served as part of Alpha Squadron, under the command of Lieutenant Commander Villian Dance, that was assigned to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Steel Talon.

Benjo, or ST-1-2, was a Human and the the second-in-command of the TIE/LN starfighter Alpha Squadron assigned to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Steel Talon. Benjo flew as the right panelman for the squadron leader Villian Dance.

Raar Anyell was a Human male Corellian TIE/LN starfighter pilot in the Imperial Navy that served as part of Alpha Squadron, under the command of Lieutenant Commander Villian Dance, that was assigned to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Steel Talon.

S'ran Droot was a male Chagrian Chief Petty Officer in the Imperial Navy. While assigned to the Port Heavy Blaster Station of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Steel Talon prior to the Battle of Yavin, he shared quarters with Tenn Graneet.

Rax Exeter was a Human male Captain who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he was assigned to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Steel Talon before the Battle of Yavin started.
Velvalee was a Chief Petty Officer in the Imperial Navy. While assigned to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Steel Talon prior to the Battle of Yavin, he shared quarters with Tenn Graneet.

Nast Hoberd was a male Human captain in the Imperial Navy. Prior to the Battle of Yavin, he served as commanding officer of the Port Heavy Blaster Station on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Steel Talon.
Luah was a Human male Lieutenant Colonel in the Imperial Navy who served as Admiral Motti's assistant on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Steel Talon prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Olzal Erne was a male Human Chief Petty Officer in the Imperial Navy.

Numbers was the nickname of a male Givin who was conscripted by the Galactic Empire prior to 0 BBY. In that year, he worked as a non-commissioned officer aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Steel Talon.
Fafnir was an Akurian from the planet Akuria II. He was apparently second in command to Colonel Odan after the capture of the majority of Odan's forces during an attack on his War Sled.
An Impostor of Odan was an Imperial commander on Akuria II during and around the time following the Battle of Yavin.

Etsero was an Adnerem gangster who ran the largest gambling house on the planet Adner, The Red Lisken. Although successful at first, Etsero soon found himself in debt to several people, including Jabba the Hutt.

Beyla Rus was a "gentleman pirate" who operated a CR90 corvette, along with approximately sixty other beings, who made up the vessel's crew. A Human male from Tibro, he and his ship were active during the Galactic Civil War.
Lanaxa Tark was the wife of the Imperial Lieutenant Boes Tark and, in 23 BBY, they had a son named Moxin on the planet Bandonia.

Bley-San was a female living on Tatooine in 22 BBY. She owned a cantina in Mos Espa. When Boba Fett killed Gilramos Libkath to receive a bounty from Jabba the Hutt, Ygabba Hise said that Bley-San would help the kids find their families and relatives back since she still owed h…
Bi-Dar Tyunda was the founder of the planetary government of Cerea.

Nuutu Plunb was a female Sullustan dispatcher employed by Xizor Transport Systems. She was in charge of small cargo routing in a starport sector on Lianna. A perceptive being, she was an able businessperson and a discreet functionary of the Black Sun crime syndicate.

Breg was a starfighter pilot of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. While on a reconnaissance mission during the early years of the Galactic Civil War, Breg crash-landed on Kalist VI, where he was imprisoned in the planet's Imperial labor colony, though his captors were unaw…
Tojjelnoot was a male Wookiee and member of the Tojj clan who, in 40 ABY, was the aged council leader of his species' homeworld of Kashyyyk.
Sniddly was a male humanoid who worked for Mondo-Mod the Hutt at his Arena of Doom, a stadium which housed gladiator fights. He was known to announce the upcoming fights and also take bets.
Trask was a male sergeant who served under Lieutenant Bella in Sabaoth Squadron prior to the onset of the Clone Wars.
Honn Dangel was a Meri meteorologist working in Cloud City.
Antilles was a member of the Mere Resistance around the time of the Occupation of Karthakk. He commanded a Mere cruiser during the battle with Cavik Toth's Sabaoth Squadron over Geonosis.
Race Kartan was a notorious male Human smuggler who flew a personal starfighter called Duergo around the time of the Occupation of Karthakk.

t: Unidentified Rebel Vanguard (Second Battle of Sullust)
x: This unidentified Rebel Vanguard was a male human who was recruited by Commander Col Serra to join Renegade Squadron, the Rebel Alliances' new elite fighting unit. During his career as a Rebel he was trained and became a Rebel Vanguard.
This unidentified Wookiee rebel was a male Wookiee who was recruited by Commander Col Serra to join Rebel Alliances' new elite fighting unit, Renegade Squadron.

The unidentified Rebel Vanguard was a male Human who joined the Rebel Alliance and became a member of the Rebel vanguard division. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin he accompanied Admiral Ackbar on a scouting mission to Boz Pity to look for a new base for the Alliance.
Barlex was a Republic clone trooper sergeant, and senior Non-commissioned officer (NCO) of Parjai Squad during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Levet formerly known as CC-3388/0021, also joking referred to as Commander Tactful, was a clone commander stationed on the planet of Qiilura under General Etain Tur-Mukan in 21 BBY.

Du Mahn was a Human female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. Assigned to the Order's training facility on Bogden 3 during the Clone Wars, Mahn looked after the group of Jedi younglings known as the Soaring Hawkbat Clan there.
Garl Hierogryph was the husband of Glomkettle and the father of Marn.
Loopy "The Lip" Leverby was a notorious criminal during the Mandalorian Wars and an associate of Marn Hierogryph. He operated the Leverby smuggling ring.

Nunk "No-Neck" Plaarvin was a male Chevin who was a notorious criminal during the Mandalorian Wars. A member of Raff Syndicate, he was a former associate of Marn Hierogryph. In 3963 BBY Hierogryph, under the alias of "Professor Gryphomarn," tried to con him on Metellos 3.
Sull, known by the designation Alpha-30 or A-30, was an Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando. He served as a lieutenant in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Rak'k was a Barabel living on Korriban around 40 ABY. A member of the ground crew at Korriban's spaceport, he agreed to tell Alema Rar the location of the One Sith, over the objections of his companions, Yas'tua and a Human, in return for Alema's ship in the event she didn't r…
Yas'tua was a Bothan living on Korriban around 40 ABY. He was a member of the Korriban spaceport's ground crew, and was the taskmaster of Rak'k and a Human.
Willks was a male Imperial TIE/LN starfighter pilot, and the wingmate of Ranulf Trommer. He was killed on Aguarl 3 by Rebel Alliance forces.

This unidentified Rebel commando was a male Human who joined the Rebel Alliance and became a member of the Alliance Special Forces. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin he accompanied Admiral Ackbar on a scouting mission to Boz Pity to look for a new base for the Alliance.
This Unnamed Devaronian was part of the commando team lead by Nym to disable some shield bunkers protecting the Trihexalon factory on Nod Kartha.
Jhaveek was a male Mrlssi philosopher. In 0 BBY, Sergeant Nova Stihl studied Jhaveek's dissertations on metaphysics while stationed on Despayre.
Amira Nasra was a Mon Calamari who owned and operated the Illuminated Aquean casino on the planet Vaynai during the Galactic Civil War.

Delpho was a Human male who served as a soldier with the Galactic Alliance Guard. He was a member of Major Salle Serpa's battalion, which occupied the Jedi Academy on Ossus during the Second Galactic Civil War.

HOB-147 was a clone pilot who flew a V-19 Torrent starfighter for Light Brigade Division in the Grand Army of the Republic. He was shot down in a space battle during the Clone Wars, but survived in his starfighter, and floated through space, unconscious.
Angrail Ryhl was a Human xenoarchaeologist. During the course of the Galactic Civil War, he discovered the Ch'hosk Cave Drawings on Antmuel VI.
Bon was a male Human Jedi Initiate who studied with the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Andras Pell was the husband of Akanah Norand Goss, despite the fact that he was thirty-six years older than her. A year after their marriage, he died and she inherited his ship, a Verpine Adventurer.

ST-297 was an Imperial stormtrooper who held the rank of Lieutenant and was part of the ambush squad for Leia Organa Solo and Han Solo during their quest to retrieve moss painting Killik Twilight on the planet Tatooine.

ST-347 was an Imperial stormtrooper who was the squad leader of the ambush squad for New Republic members Leia Organa Solo and Han Solo during their quest to retrieve the moss painting Killik Twilight.

Kerri was a human female who lived on the planet Kenari with her brother Kassa. At a young age, Kerri was separated from her brother, who was taken offworld and later became known as Cassian Andor. Many years later, Andor still searched for his long-lost sister.

Niobi was a female Human subject obtained by Sly Moore, servant of Darth Sidious, for a series of biological experiments the Dark Lord of the Sith ordered scientists Mammon Hoole and Borborygmus Gog to carry out.
Hoclaw was a Corellian who served as captain of the Valorum, a Victory-class Star Destroyer serving in the Corellian decoy fleet in 40 ABY during the Second Galactic Civil War.

Caregg Oldathan was a male pilot from the planet Commenor who was called out of retirement in 40 ABY to fly a BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter against the forces of the Galactic Alliance in the Second Galactic Civil War.
Danen was a K-wing bombardier-gunner and lieutenant in the Commenorian defense force. During the Battle of Commenor his pilot was Lieutenant Caregg Oldathan.
Neic Norim was an old male Sullustan pilot and smuggler. He lost his right arm while working as a test pilot for SoroSuub Corporation and switched professions to smuggling.

Sanola Ti was a niece of Kirana Ti and one of the young Jedi Knights in Luke Skywalker's New Jedi Order during the Second Galactic Civil War. Sanola was described as a good, studious Jedi who had inherited her aunt's skills as a pilot.
Rinn Renado was the Human male leader of a corporate resistance movement on Metellos. He specialized in guerrilla tactics and concentrated his efforts against CarsinShare and Nonsu targets.
Shaclor was an adventurous Selonian assigned to be a digger and explorer for the Chanzari Den. She was tasked to explore the outer reaches of Chanzari land, both above and below ground.
Magalak was an expert Selonian warrior of the xenophobic Kurtuln Clan residing underneath the Kystes' Spine on Talus. She was unusually independent for a Selonian and was considered odd by her sept.

Eelie was a Twi'lek dancer who became, in middle age, a dance teacher for young girls in Kala'uun. Eelie was born into slavery, but earned enough to buy her freedom at a young age. She spent her youth traveling the galaxy, having a long series of wild adventures.
Zam Stenza was a male medical orderly assigned to the N-One Medcenter of the first Death Star during the Galactic Civil War.

Mantologo was a Human male and a non-commissioned Imperial Marine officer who was assigned to the first Death Star, during its construction above the planet Despayre, who quartered in the G-12 Barracks with Nova Stihl.
Nond Kendo was a Human male lieutenant who served in the Imperial Navy as a TIE pilot onboard the first Death Star. He was killed in a training accident prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Mekkar Doan was a Human male chief petty officer in the Imperial Navy assigned to Superlaser Fire Control on the first Death Star during the Galactic Civil War.
Kameda was a Human male captain who served in the Imperial Navy under the command Admiral Daala prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Flight Commander Drolan was an officer in the Imperial Navy assigned to the first Death Star.

Dician, a female Human, was a Sith Lord and member of the One Sith, serving at the time of the Second Galactic Civil War. In 40 ABY, long before the One Sith had revealed themselves to the galaxy, Dician acted as an agent operating away from the Sith world of Korriban.

Ithila was Hapan woman of middle age who was lean and beautiful except for a pattern of burn scars on the right side of her face she suffered as a result of an explosion on board a Hapan Battle Dragon she served on during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Meeshal was a Human Imperial Navy Captain to Darth Krayt and the One Sith. He served under the command of the Sith Lord Darth Stryfe.
Hedon Istee was a Twi'lek initiate in the B'omarr Order during the Galactic Civil War.

An individual was an Imperial officer in the Imperial Army that was in command of the Imperial garrison on Sullust during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly before the Battle of Endor, during the Battle of Sullust, he commanded the Imperial troops during the Rebel attack.

Gormer was a male Mandalorian Neo-Crusader who served under the command of Cassus Fett during the Mandalorian Wars. He had a son. He was killed by Raana Tey at the Jedi Tower during the Siege of Taris.
Nahk was one of two children of Sector Constable Noana Sowrs of the planet Taris. Nahk and sibling Tallie were kidnapped by Brejik and Griff Vao.
Tallie was one of two children of Sector Constable Noana Sowrs of the planet Taris. Tallie and sibling Nahk were kidnapped by Brejik and Griff Vao.
This male was the son of Gormer at the time of the Siege of Taris.

Yakasoba worked for Nagem Dr'Lar as part of an Imperial salvage operation on the moon Yavin 4 after the Battle of Yavin. When Dr'Lar was threatened at their salvage site by a spacer paid by Hutt operative Osae Meilea, Dr'Lar ordered Yakasoba to kill the spacer.
Craddock Karath was a journeyman laborer, an officer in the Republic Navy, and the father of five children, the oldest of whom was Saul Karath.

Benits Stinex, also known as "the Old Man", was a well known architect who designed a series of apartments in the Manarai Hills district of the planet Coruscant. He later became the chief architect and head of interior design and construction board the Death Star.

t: Unidentified scout trooper (Skirmish on Ord Mantell)
x: This man was a scout trooper that was stationed in the Imperial garrison on Ord Mantell shortly after the Battle of Yavin IV.

Balahteez was a Pho Ph'eahian spice smuggler who was captured by the Galactic Empire and transported to Despayre. Balahteez developed numerous information contacts over the years, many of whom ended up on Despayre with him. He lived in Slashtown Prison Colony.
Breac Slaus was an Ithorian collector of rare items.
Jener Mich was a Human male who collected rare items. He spent his entire life searching and collecting valuable and rare items throughout the whole Galaxy.
Parja Bralor was a female Human Mandalorian who was the niece of former Cuy'val Dar Rav Bralor. She was a talented engineer and loved to fix things, from a broken chrono to a sick Nuna chick.

Huetrin Jones was a human who served as a captain and Flight Officer in the Resistance during its war against the First Order. Circa 34 ABY, Jones assisted Lieutenant Kaydel Ko Connix in evacuating the Resistance base on the planet D'Qar.
Brenkris Anen was a male small-time criminal with whom "Lips" Meyer was affiliated.
Var'Rotha Fin'Rotha was a Tolanese bounty hunter who operated out of the Outer Rim prior to the Galactic Civil War.
Kram Balut was a Dug crime lord. One of Balut's contacts was Jah-kii Vaargaz who was wanted by Republic Security Force; her bounty was later claimed by Jango Fett.

affiliation: Jervis Gloom, Ruceba Ahid, Stu Hemphawar
x: Oejoe Hitewa was a Human smuggler who, along with his accomplices, Stu Hemphawar and Ruceba Ahid, worked out of a tiny apartment close to the Uscru Entertainment District of Coruscant.
Mas Missur was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Fiula Blay was a Yuuzhan Vong female who acted as an undercover agent leading a resistance cell within the Imperial Navy during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Blay utilized an organic cloaking device known as an ooglith masquer to appear Human.
Torvin Xyn was a Yuuzhan Vong spy. Even in his Human disguise, he had shoulders as wide as a Wookiee's.
Wip Sheff was a male Human Correctional Authority guard wanted by the Hutt Clan for skimming profits from an inside smuggling operation. He was described as a crooked prison guard.
Jik'Tal was a male Jawa who left Tatooine to seek a life of adventure, eventually finding work as an enforcer at Bantha Traxx on the planet Lianna.
Mawat was a male Human member of the Young on the planet Melida/Daan. While initially he followed the leaders Nield and Cerasi, soon after peace was declared he began to crave power.
Lozira Briil was a smuggler who, along with their twin Rewinda, worked as part of an underworld crew led by Roa on Nar Shaddaa during the Imperial Era.
Rewinda Briil was a smuggler who, along with their twin Lozira, worked as part of an underworld crew led by Roa on Nar Shaddaa during the Imperial Era.
A male Nautolan Padawan served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Jo'Ara Gier was a female Cerean technician working with the Cularin resistance. When the forces of the Metatheran Cartel attacked the resistance's base within the Cloud Mountain mines in 31 BBY, it was Gier who discovered that one of the datapads with Cartel information recent…

Bovit Leebo was a famed Rodian holographer. Leebo captured the famous image of Ka'Pa the Hutt which would later be featured in Riccix's Revised Basic Holodictionary. The image fell into public domain after the Rodian holographer was killed by Ka'Pa's agent.
Trossilik was a Trandoshan who placed a bounty on Gahseelik for disgracefully leaving the clan on Trandosha to work for Gardulla the Hutt. Jango Fett would then collect this bounty.
An unidentified prisoner was a Human male from the world of Bakura, who had been sentenced by the Galactic Empire to a life term on the prison-world of Despayre.
Ortin was also in place to assist these outsiders get out of jail should they have been caught breaking and entering the Cartel's offices.

Jyll Xon was a secretary working in the Metatheran Cartel's operations office in Gadrin. When most of the Cartel's personnel had been transferred to their base in the jungle, she and her supervisor, Manod Fea, were the only employees working in those offices.

Manod Fea was an office manager working for the Metatheran Cartel on Cularin. During a time when most of the Cartel's operations were transferred to their base in the jungle, only their operations office remained open in Gadrin, and Fea and his secretary, Jyll Xon, were the on…

Branox was a Hrakian spacer who, in 1 ABY, made a stop at Vorzyd V. Branox was getting drunk in a spaceport cantina when he had an encounter with the Rebel droids C-3PO and R2-D2, who were on the hunt for a Hrakian pilot.
Oochee was an Ewok from the forest moon of Endor. He lived in Bright Tree Village and fought with spears against the Empire. Oochee was named for a child from Ewok mythology.
Zubwen was a Jawa. Because of his height, well above-average for a Jawa, he was known as "the Tower." He belonged to Nebit's tribe.
A male Twi'lek trained as a Jedi in the New Jedi Order. He was present at the Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade where he stood alongside Cilghal. He used a blue-bladed lightsaber.
Vojak was a Humanoid alien male, whose brother was assassinated by the assassin droid, C-3PX, on Bonadan.
Pachwenko was a male Jawa of Chief Nebit's tribe.

ZG-35 was the callsign of an Imperial TIE/LN starfighter pilot who almost killed Leia Organa in 1 ABY. It was ZG-35 who killed the Rebel agent Hume. At this time he was directly under Darth Vader's command.
Fidaval was a male Devaronian who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was the brother of Ratheb.
Arslynd was a male individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Eocade was a male Bothan merchant living during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He had light brown hair, brown eyes, and brown skin.
Kafleer Tredahl was an amateur holocam operator native to Corellia.
Zayna was the mother of the holocam operator Kafleer Tredahl, and was briefly kidnapped by terrorists.

Francis, nicknamed "Francis the pink Wookiee" for his uniquely decorated armor, was a male Wookiee bounty hunter who joined Renegade Squadron—an elite fighting unit of the Alliance to Restore the Republic created by former smugglers and composed of fringers with Rebel sympathi…

Ginder was a furred Bimm male from the Genarius-orbiting city of Tolea Biqua who operated as a scavenger and information broker in the Cularin system. Around 31 BBY, while going through a shipment of scrap, Ginder came across the head of an L8O-series protocol droid, L8O-RC.

Garrbo V'Droz was a male renowned as the galaxy's best architect. However, he was also very arrogant and disliked by many people because of his boastfulness, although due to his skill he was still frequently hired.

Akh'laht was a Noghri of Clan Kihm'bar and one of the Noghri Death Commandos. After the Empire's deception to the Noghri was revealed, he informed Rukh, the bodyguard of Grand Admiral Thrawn, of this revelation.
Debeli was male human negotiator that worked for President Gyr Keela at the Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy on the planet Mrlsst.

O-625 was a shadow stormtrooper serving under Cronal. In 1 ABY, he was among the Blackhole agents who surveyed Luke Skywalker on Vorzyd V. He tracked Skywalker until he lost him in district 3054 and had to alert the surface surveillance team in that area.
Merf was a male Vorzydiak member of the Freelies gang on the planet Vorzyd V during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Teck Randon was a member of the Thaereian military serving in the Cularin system. Discovering that Ginder the Bimm was trying to sell the head of L80-RC, a droid that probably had records from its former owner Riboga the Hutt, Randon tried to obtain it alongside subordinate so…

Joq Landhauler was a male member of the Thaereian military serving in the Cularin system. Landhauler was part of a Thaereian squad that tried to obtain the head of L80-RC from Ginder the Bimm, alongside fellow soldier Kirla Shorg under the leadership of Teck Randon.

Kirla Shorg was a member of the Thaereian military serving in the Cularin system. Shorg was part of a Thaereian squad that tried to obtain the head of L80-RC from Ginder the Bimm, alongside fellow soldier Joq Landhauler under the leadership of Teck Randon.
Jubieck was a Sullustan criminal who operated on Tolea Biqua. He found out that Ginder the Bimm was trying to sell the head of L8O-RC, which had once belonged to Riboga the Hutt.

Orix and his fellow Trandoshan, Dimogog, were a pair of leg-breakers who accompanied the Sullustan Jubieck in trying to obtain the head of L8O-RC from Ginder the Bimm. Orix started a three-way battle for the head when he tried to make a grab for it.
Dimogog and his fellow Trandoshan, Orix, were a pair of leg-breakers who accompanied the Sullustan Jubieck in trying to obtain the head of L80-RC from Ginder the Bimm.

Salin Glek was a male Quarren who grew up in the bowels of Dac. One of Gial Ackbar's lieutenants; he was working on the Shantipole Project, until Glek betrayed the admiral to Bane Nothos. He stole the Out Runner to make his escape.
A Nautolan Jedi discovered Mace Windu as an infant.

Elth Nardah was an older Human male, with wizened skin and stooped shoulders. He was known to have dressed well, in the style of the Old Republic. He held the title of doctor and was a member of the Alliance Diplomatic Corps.

Karvinna Raen was a shy and quiet researcher who worked with Elth Nardah. She was fascinated by how beings coped both with and apart from the presence of the Empire and the Alliance. She carefully cultivated a plain appearance, with short brown hair and dark eyes.
Darryn Edalm was a male human who served as an Imperial bureaucrat. He was wiry, paranoid, and compulsive, and he tried to fit into the image of an Imperial governor.
Dresk Kist was a female Slith with dark stripes down her scales.
Sssiii was a male Slith of red coloration, weighing 60 kilograms. He was somehow obtained by the Galactic Circus and toured with them on a number of worlds, including Tatooine.
Joh'hanna Ghibbyyns was an infamous and hip bounty hunter from Talus. She was the first to use a Tchotchee pistol.

Ellu Viss was a male Jedi Padawan in 130 ABY. Viss survived the Battle of Ossus, where the Padawan managed to recover Tionne Solusar's records, recorded nearly a century prior. Viss, using Solusar's records, recorded the Jedi Order's plight against the One Sith.
The Giant Wampa Creature was a large wampa and the master of a large ice cave on the planet Hoth by 3 ABY.
Ingo Wavlud was a suspected Sith sympathizer from Byss. He was the author of the Wavlud Manuscript, which covered such elements of the Sith dynasties as the Darth title.

Gannod Chant was a special investigative agent for the New Republic Council on Security and Intelligence and later the Galactic Alliance Security and Intelligence Council. He translated the Wavlud Manuscript in 40 ABY and included his findings in the Jedi knowledge compendium.

Poteet was a Sector admiral who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he sent the librarian droid P-RC3 to the Death Star Library for duty, where the droid worked under Commander Atour Riten.

Dorma was an inhabitant of Bellassa, and was the proprietor of a dining establishment known as Dorma's Cafe in the Cloud Lake District of Ussa, during the last years of the Galactic Republic and the early part of the Galactic Empire.

Varnillian was an Imperial weapons technician who held the position of Gunnery Chief within the armed forces of the Galactic Empire. At one point during her career, Varnillian served in a control room.
Rikel, known as Vibro to many, was a male crewman aboard Centerpoint Station during the Second Galactic Civil War in 40 ABY, serving as the head technician.

Turl Nevil was a male ensign serving in the Second Fleet of the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet during the Second Galactic Civil War. The son of decorated Galactic Alliance Captain Kral Nevil, he served as a weapons officer aboard the frigate Cheesmeer.

Tiom Rordan was a Human male who served as a starfighter pilot in the Galactic Alliance during the Second Galactic Civil War. Stationed aboard the frigate Mawrunner, he began dating Syal Antilles, to the tacit disapproval of her father, Wedge Antilles.

Noldan was a Force-sensitive male Trandoshan who lived in Aurilia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was a master of melee combat and was known to train outsiders who were working for the good of Aurilia.
Kennan Taanzer was a male Human Jedi Initiate within the Jedi Order during the time of the Clone Wars.
Eozlin was a Force-sensitive male Ithorian who lived in the village of Aurilia on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Jonat was a female sergeant in the Galactic Alliance Guard and was one of Heol Girdun's favorite undercover agents. She was assigned to guard former Chief of State Cal Omas. She became friendly with him where she allowed Omas to use her comlink to speak with his daughter.
Qilqu was a male Bith doctor who served onboard the Anakin Solo. Qilqu tried to coerce Jacen Solo into resting after the Duel on the Anakin Solo, a suggestion Jacen refused and sent him away for.
Lando Calrissian Junior, nicknamed Chance, was a Human male born around 41 ABY to Tendra Risant Calrissian and Lando Calrissian, Senior.
Vurly was a Human male who served as an Imperial medical technician during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he was stationed on the medical frigate MedStar Four orbiting Despayre.

The Nothoiin Taray served as one of the few non-Human members of the Wing Guard of Cloud City. He was more concerned with upholding the spirit of the law, and sometimes technically broke laws in order to do so.

Hotise eventually transferred to the Death Star himself where he assumed command of the N-One Medcenter and once again became Dr Divini's superior. He was presumably killed onboard the Death Star during the Battle of Yavin.
Keiran Valn was a male Jedi Knight who lived during the time of the Old Republic. At a banquet held by his family on his homeworld of Alderaan, Valn was murdered by a successful poisoning attempt.

Berd Lin was a Human male living on the planet of Harix during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Lin's mother Myoris and a number of classmates were kidnapped by Imperial forces acting under the command of Darth Vader, who intended to use the children as bait to draw out sever…
Deel Draav was a male Human politician on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. He was the mayor of Kor Vella until he was murdered by the Chirq Council in 1 ABY.
Alexir Lands was a male Human native to Bellassa and the father of Roan Lands. He lived in the city of Ussa with his wife Enna.
Enna Lands was a female Human native to Bellassa and the mother of Roan Lands. Together with her husband Alexir, Enna lived in the city of Ussa.

Flinn was a Human male who served as a young recruit in the Coruscant Naval Academy during the Empire's rise for power. After attending the academy, he, along with fellow cadet Kestrel, were selected to monitor a new talented recruit named Lune Oddo Divinian.

Tobin Gantor was a male Human scientist. In 18 BBY, Gantor and his assistant Linna Naltree helped Jedi Master Ry-Gaul to hide from Imperial forces when Emperor Palpatine issued Order 66. Tobin had earlier married Linna.

The "Imperial Ace" was a TIE pilot in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. The Ace participated in the Battle of Mygeeto in 3 ABY, during which the Galactic Empire attempted to regain control of the Outer Rim planet Mygeeto from the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A male Andoan senator was the Aqualish benefactor of Doctor Cornelius Evazan, who was studying immortality.

Sivarra Mecheaux was a Force-sensitive female Human who lived in Aurilia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was the village's medic and was kept busy healing those left wounded from the attacks of the Dark Jedi Mellichae and his Sith Shadows.

Marite was a Force-sensitive female Trandoshan. She was cast out of her clan on Trandosha because of her force-sensitive abilities and lived in Aurilia on Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Danzigorro Potts was a male Padawan of the Jedi Order serving the Galactic Republic at the time of the First Great Schism.

Yara Grugara was a reporter for Cularin Central Broadcasting's Eye on Cularin, who interviewed Jedi Master Lanius Qel-Bertuk about the Jedi and love. She would also interview the Cularin crime lord Nirama.

Kan Pojo was a lieutenant in the Republic Navy before the Battle of Naboo. Pojo was an expert marksman, recognized as the fleet shooting champion with several weapons. He was also the arms instructor aboard the training ship Overt.

Blendri was a female Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order on Ossus during the Order's early years. Joining several other Jedi, Blendri became a Jedi Renunciate and a Legionnaire of Lettow, one of the many followers of Xendor during the First Great Schism.
Cuthallox was the Padawan of Jedi Knight Blendri serving the Jedi Order on Ossus during the Order's early years.

Jook-jook H'broozin was a male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order on Ossus during the Order's early years. Joining several other Jedi, H'broozin became a Jedi Renunciate and a Legionnaire of Lettow, one of the many followers of Xendor during the First Great Schism.

Talnar was an Alliance procurement officer. When he was 45 years old, Talnar was forced to crash-land on the primitive world of Naalol when his ship, the Golden Jewel, was irreparably damaged by Imperial forces.
Cavis Bault was a follower of the religious organization H'kig. He had every inch of his arms decorated with elaborate tattoos disappearing into his plain habit.
Ray Carantar was a smuggler on the planet Marotan. He had a twisting and curving tattoo on the right side of his bald head.

Ushka Et was the Devaronian lead singer of the band Distraction. She stood out from other people because of the design of her tattoo; half of her face was tattooed to look like she had been in a horrible disfiguring accident, although with a close-up view it became apparent th…

Kerd K'Kerren was a famous podracer who had every inch of his hands, face and neck covered in intricate tattoos of green and gold. The left side of his head was shaved and tattooed with swirls and checks.

Sa'arli was a female Tarasin who served as an aide to Senator Lavina Wren of Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. She had a tattoo of a snakelike lizard whose tail ran from her jawline to up around her ear-slit.

Vazus Mandrake was a Human male from the planet Corulag. Born during the waning years of the Galactic Republic and middle-aged by the time of the Clone Wars, Mandrake commanded a mercenary unit that had been hired by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, a separatist governm…
Sirona Okeefe was a Human female from Brentaal IV in the time prior to the Clone Wars. The aunt of Platt Okeefe, Sirona became a smuggler and thus earned the scorn of her noble family.
Hora Graneet was a Human male who served as a navy spacer aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer, Battle Lance during the Galactic Civil War.
Vran Tristen was a Human male Darkwalker who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
