0761 was a stormtrooper who was stationed on Ciutric IV one year after the Battle of Endor. When the New Republic attacked Ciutric in an attempt to free Sate Pestage, they were killed in a minor skirmish outside of Daplona when a Trandoshan member of Commando Team One snapped …
Torel Vorne was a male Reussi. He was the most powerful crimelord on the planet Reuss VIII.
Oberhaur was a commander and Imperial Pilot Trainer in the Imperial Navy.
Surdu was a statesman of the Black Shred Water clan. The Dug Podracer pilot Sebulba traced his linage back to Surdu, which to him was an honor that inflated his ego.

Wayniss was the chief pilot of the Poison Moon. He was an aging ex-pirate and smuggler who knew nothing of the Force. He also did not know that those who had been employing him were Sith and would have reacted incuriously if he had.
Red Twenty-Four was a call sign used by a starfighter pilot in a Red Squadron operating a few months after the Battle of Endor.
Red Thirty was a callsign used by a starfighter pilot in a Red Squadron operating a few months after the Battle of Endor.

Bender was a young rancor owned by the crime lord Nirama. A naming day gift from Riboga the Hutt circa 53 BBY, Bender was not much bigger than a Wookiee, with his name tattooed on his left shoulder in both Basic and Huttese.

Myoris Lin was a female Human teacher who lived on the planet Harix during the Galactic Civil War. The mother of a young boy named Berd, Lin taught at a school with ties to the Rebel Alliance, which drew the attention of the Galactic Empire in 1 ABY.

Karii was a male Jedi Padawan under the tutelage of Jedi Master Dajjun. During the Clone Wars, he and his master, along with several other Jedi and the droid 4-B4, were dispatched by the Jedi High Council on a mission to recover a data droid belonging to the Sheyasti Trade Syn…

Dajjun was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order actively during the height of the Clone Wars. He served the Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the conflict.
Sabel Axis Corazon was a Human female who inherited the Corazon Industries from her father after he was killed by rivals during the Galactic Civil War.
Jer Blankuna was a Twi'lek agent of the Desilijic Hutt clan. He was married to Gelune Blankuna.

Xalto Sneerzick was the leader of the Droid Abolitionist Movement. He had the back of his hand decorated with a tattoo of a purple cog being struck by a lightning bolt, signifying his devotion to freeing all droids throughout the galaxy.
Tantos was a feared Firrerreo pirate lord—brutal and dangerous— whom many considered to be a barbarian. His arms were covered with three-dimensional tattoos of strange beasts.
Morvis was a Human female senator who represented Chandrila in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Mandalorian Wars. In 3963 BBY, she was in her third term.
Orlo was an Ewok male who lived in Bright Tree Village on the Forest Moon of Endor. He worked as a bordok master and was responsible for sweeping the village's bordok stables.
Resk was a Human who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. When a bounty was placed on Resk around 17 BBY, the fallen Jedi Master and bounty hunter A'Sharad Hett tracked Resk to Korriban.
Celeste Morne was a Human female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Covenant as a Covenant Shadow, an agency that consisted of Jedi whose identities were erased from the Order's records.
Mack Oides was a Human male who was a member of The Cell, a group trying to oust Nirama from control of the Cularin system's crime in 31 BBY.
Blarg was a Trandoshan female who was a member of the Cell, a group trying to oust Nirama from control of the Cularin system's crime in 31 BBY.
Horssk was a Trandoshan male who was a member of the Cell, a group trying to oust Nirama from control of the Cularin system's crime in 31 BBY.
Beebo was a Rodian female who was a member of the Cell, a group whose aims included attempting to oust Nirama from control of the Cularin system's criminal element in 31 BBY.
Re'Nicu was a Cerean male who was a member of the Cell, a group trying to oust Nirama from control of the Cularin system's crime in 31 BBY.
Gebs was an Ithorian who was a member of the Cell, a group trying to oust Nirama from control of the Cularin system's crime in 31 BBY.
Duus was a Tarasin male living in Nirama's public asteroid.

T. Alvak was an Imperial pilot and astrogator. Raised in a naval family, Alvak desired to be a pilot from an early age. Enrolling in the Imperial Naval Academy, Alvak graduated as a navigator and served with the 98th "Laser Storm" Forward Observer Shuttle Wing for several years.

Wad'e Tay'haai was a Human male who was one of seventy-five Mandalorian warriors that were comprised in the Cuy'val Dar, a group of training sergeants hired by the Kaminoans to train the clone commandos they created on the planet Kamino.
Jobril was a male Twi'lek, and Nirama's master of properties on Cularin.
Moz, designated CT-6200/8901, was a Covert Ops clone trooper trained by Null ARC N-10.
Olun, designated CT-0368/7766, was a Covert Ops clone trooper trained by Null ARC N-10.

Hahrynyar was a Wookiee who was enslaved by the Galactic Empire during the construction of the first Death Star, where he served as the shift chief on a subsector of Sector N-One on the armored battle station.
Neet Alamant was a male Human who served as a recruiter for Civilian Adjunct to the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

Vindoo Barvel, also known by the moniker "The Shooter," was an Imperial starfighter pilot who met the standards for ace status multiple times and was one of the most decorated TIE pilots in the Imperial Navy.
Linesse Hoberd was the wife of Nast Hoberd. Together they had two children.

Imono Durshana was a Force-sensitive Human male who resided on the Core Worlds planet Rhinnal. Although originally a staff member of the Rhinnal State Medical Academy, Imono Durshana, motivated by a desire to be part of something greater than himself, volunteered to work at th…
Brun was a Human male prisoner who worked as the cargo crew boss of the night shift at the Slashtown Prison Colony guard compound on Despayre.

Rewello was a Lorrdian male who lived around the rise of the Empire. Rewello was an accomplished mime and comedian, having performed for the Regent of Alderaan. He was known to have entertained his niece, Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla, with tales of show business.
Varlo Brim was a professional male criminal arsonist who was officially blamed for the destruction of Grid 19 of the Southern Underground in Imperial City.

Telti Obrim was a female Human and the wife of Coruscant Security Force Captain Jaller Obrim, the head of the Anti-Terrorism Unit. They lived with their two teenage sons in the Rampart Town section of the planet Coruscant.
Trepler Darklighter was a Human male and a member of the Darklighter family.
Nagat Keris Ratua was a Zelosian First Counselor. He had a Tertiary Wife named Feelah Derin with which they bore a son, Celot Ratua Dil, Nagat's second.
Feelah Derin was the Tertiary Wife of Nagat Keris Ratua and the mother of Celot Ratua Dil.

Divo was a strong, Human male who served as a squat power-lifter and a student of Nova Stihl's Teräs Käsi lessons onboard the first Death Star during the Galactic Civil War. He had a tendency to ask more questions in the class than anyone else.
Claria Labreezle was a young girl that Jedi Master Plo Koon encountered and ultimately rescued while on a mission to apprehend Dreed Pommel on Metellos.

Gar Gratius was a male Twi'lek philosopher who lived during the Galactic Civil War between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire. Sergeant Nova Stihl studied his discourses on eclectic deontology while stationed on the Death Star.
Tunia was a male Zelosian and the uncle of Celot Ratua Dil.

Rex Shaxrigge was a male holostar during the rise of the Galactic Empire. While on Etti IV, a Corporate Sector Authority official tried to arrest him for stealing industry secrets; Shaxrigge had allegedly been romancing female executives in order to do so.

Dagmar Vozda was a female Corporate Sector Authority agent who worked for the Office of the Auditor-General. Vozda was responsible for recruiting Fiolla into the ranks of the Authority after she aided Vozda in apprehending fugitive holostar Rex Shaxrigge.

Naven Crel was a male Auditor-General for the Corporate Sector Authority. While undercover, he learned of corrupt actions by the Prex and was subsequently taken prisoner by Fiolla under trumped-up charges of industrial sabotage.

Chils Melpin was the Prex of the Corporate Sector Authority. After Auditor-Generals Fiolla and Naven Crel learned that he had been selling CSA secrets to the Galactic Empire, he dispatched his assistant, Akeeli Somerce, to eliminate both of them discreetly.

Akeeli Somerce was the assistant to the Prex, Chils Meplin. She was dispatched to discreetly kill Fiolla and Naven Crel after the latter learned about Meplin's leaking of CSA secrets to the Galactic Empire.
Leb Chura was a male green Twi'lek pilot who was hired to pilot a shuttle that delivered six construction droids, dry-lining materials and Chief Scientist Ko Sai to the planet Dorumaa.
ArrGack was the Chief Tax Chaplain of the Ugor species. He and his underling, GrrKack, were bribed by the Alliance shuttle Bonderium for entrance into the Paradise Sector.
The Old Man was the nickname of a Human male who served as the leader of Ghost cell during the Cold War. Around the final year, he was killed by Cipher Nine.
"The Horn" was the nickname for a notorious Advozse assassin.

Luco was a Rodian who lived on Nirama's public asteroid in 31 BBY. He was sometimes seen in Hutt's Tail cantina running a game that involved shuffling three chips. He was quite skilled at cheating using sleight-of-hand tricks, and took in a lot of money with his game.
Kor Pastar was a female blue-skinned Twi'lek. She was the daughter of Vel Pastar, and would find new hires on Nirama's public asteroid and direct them to talk to her father.

Dov was a clone commando born and bred on the planet Kamino to serve in the Grand Army of the Republic sometime after or during the year 32 BBY. A clone of the Human bounty hunter Jango Fett, the teen-aged Dov was killed during training at some point before 21 BBY.
This Rodian was among a crew of male Rodian smugglers that were held prisoner aboard the Leviathan, Darth Malak's flagship, under the command of Admiral Saul Karath in 3956 BBY.
Qulo Ecls was the Sullustan owner of Gelgelar Outfitters, a general store located in Gelgelar's starport.
Armanda Durkin was a Human female and the CEO of the Notsub Shipping Company, located on the northern edge of Mos Eisley. She lived a double life as a pirate, bearing the alias of Duchess.
Kant Aryon was a Force-sensitive male Human and the husband of the Imperial Governor of Tatooine, Tour Aryon. Kant was the son of a Baron and Baroness, growing up in the lap of luxury on Bethars.

Melnea Arnthout was a leader of a group of colonists on Tatooine. One of the crew members who crashed the Dowager Queen into Tatooine, Arnthout helped found Tatooine's first settlement. She owned a 2PO-series protocol droid that was captured by Jawas.
Eet Ptaa was a male Jawa clan leader who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. His fortress was destroyed by Tusken Raiders.
Hrar Kkak was a Jawa trader. Het Nkik purchased a DL-44 heavy blaster pistol from Hrar.
Norta was a male Toydarian slaver who arranged a shipment of Imbat guards to Bandomeer with the Offworld Mining Corporation.

Korshnak was a male Barabel clan leader on Barab I. Though vigorous in his youth, as indicated by his battle scars, he grew less fearsome and plumper with age. He controlled his clan with his wits, sending his underlings out to deal with enemies.

Dromo was a Hutt who was attacked by a Shenbit bonecrusher during a safari on Barab I. He was accompanied by his Sullustan assistant Ullumub who survived the encounter and offered a reward to those who rescued her employer.

Ullumub was a female Sullustan who worked for the Hutt Dromo. When her master was attacked by a Shenbit bonecrusher during a safari on Barab I, she offered a reward to those who rescued him from the predator, with extra reward if they could also save her master's favorite Twi'…
Wilber Flagesso was a member of the Cloud City Wing Guard on the world of Bespin. Flagesso held the rank of commander within the Guard.
Vurrha Chur was a male Quarren and the leader of a criminal group known as Vurrha's Blood.
Degred Hon was a male Bith from Clak'dor VII who developed a gene bomb to alter the planet's ecology and return it to its original state.

Bleys Harand was a famous Corellian historian, philosopher and merchant who lived during the Imperial Era. He was a noted Ximologist and his theory of the Ash Worlds being a remnant of the lost Kiirium Reaches of Xim's empire was generally accepted and proved.
Tu'rsc'yulir was a female Nikto smuggler who set up a processing station near the Yawari Cliffs on Endor. She was a lieutenant in the Kintan Gunrunners.
Amisus Funti was a Ruurian ecologist who taught at the Garqi Agricultural University.
Phontos Ojo was an Ithorian geneticist who taught at the Garqi Agricultural University.

Monn was a male prison guard who lived in Slashtown Prison Colony on Despayre during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he was described by Celot Ratua Dil as being more harsh than Nova Stihl. He was presumably perished in the Destruction of Despayre.

Corinna A'Daasha was a female Human from the planet Corellia. After growing up in an opulent household, she left to explore the galaxy before settling down with her twin sister, Kandria A'Daasha, on the planet Adarlon. The twins founded and co-owned the Glow Dome nightclub there.
Coli Carinth was a female Human spacer and owner of the YT-1300 light freighter Archai.
Woorta Woorta, formerly known as Woorta Cent, was a female Swokes Swokes who lived in the city of Thousand Thousand on Makem Te. She was the daughter of the Sassa district caliph.

Fabswa the Mutilated was a male Swokes Swokes and the First Glorious Assassin of the Temple of the Beatific Razor. He had a comlink implanted in his head to receive instructions from his superiors. Fabswa's name most likely was because of a unique attribute he possessed
Kyla Latrel was an ambitious woman who worked for Tampson Consolidated, Incorporated during the Galactic Civil War period. She took part in the Vor-cal shortly before the Battle of Endor.

Casimir Everard was a bounty hunter who was hired by the Tapani Noble House Barnaba to participate in the Vor-cal hunt shortly before the Battle of Endor. He used four ASP-4 hunter droids during the hunt.

Krett was a male Neimoidian who commanded a Lucrehulk-class battleship during the Clone Wars. After the end of the war, he was exiled to Cato Neimoidia where he established the Federation's Folly cantina in the city of Zarra.
Adrian Verana was a male Human who served in the Alderaanian Resistance as the captain of the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Resurgence.

Roa was a Human male doctor who served aboard the first Death Star I during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he participated in the surgery to save Admiral Daala's life after she was injured in the attack on the first Death Star.
Abu Banu was a male Cerean doctor who served aboard the first Death Star.

Dahz Thulaka was a Force-sensitive male Twi'lek who started off as a promising doctor but became embroiled in the dark side of the Force. He joined forces with Talandro Starlyte to kidnap and torture visitors to Starlyte Station around 0 BBY.
Chugg was a male Reigat who served as the personal bodyguard to Kaylo NaKuda as well as serving as the bouncer to the bar on Stend VI known as The Pits.
Seegree was a female Mon Calamari and the administrator of Foamwander City. She also was a key member of the Calamarian Council.
Riklon Tost was a male Iotran who served as captain of the Iotran Guard on Muunilinst during the Clone Wars. He was one of the few non-Muuns admited to the inner ranks of the IGBC officers.
Esa Parna was a female Human who served the New Republic as a member of the New Republic Intelligence Service.

Five-Seven was the callsign of a clone trooper pilot assigned to Traffic Interdiction Vessel TIV Z766/2, in which he was ordered to retrieve ARC Trooper Null-5 and clone commando RC-3222 from the Outer Rim planet Olanet in the year 21 BBY.

Wishful Thinking was a Cracian thumper who raced at the Heatherdowns Hotel and Track. During a race that occurred while the Herglic merchant Hamar-Chaktak met with a group of Rebel agents regarding a bacta theft, bookmakers gave Wishful Thinking 5:2 odds.

Second Wind was a Cracian thumper who raced at the Heatherdowns Hotel and Track. During a race that occurred while the Herglic merchant Hamar-Chaktak met with a group of Rebel agents regarding a bacta theft, bookmakers gave Second Wind 7:1 odds.
Beller was a Human male who served as the master chief gunnery officer of one of the alternate shift superlaser gunnery crews onboard the Death Star.
Reshias was a Human male who served as the master chief gunnery officer of one of the alternate shift superlaser gunnery crews onboard the Death Star.

Rik-tak was a cab driver and a Justice Action Network operative who operated in the Tapani sector during the Galactic Civil War. He overheard a lot of information from his passengers that was of interest to the JAN.

Kelsek was the leader of the Justice Action Network (JAN) cell that operated on Mrlsst during the Galactic Civil War. He was a student of Doctor Arkeld and was one of the original members of the cell.
Emily Janse was Mining Guild officer and the director of five mines in Reena Province during the Galactic Civil War.

Alix was a male Human member of the stormtrooper squad led by Sergeant Nova Stihl to respond to the prisoner breakout at Detention Block AA-23 on Level 5 of the first Death Star. He was presumably killed onboard the Death Star during the Battle of Yavin.

Dash was a Human male who served as a member of the stormtrooper squad led by Sergeant Nova Stihl to respond to the prisoner breakout at Detention Block AA-23 on Level 5 of the first Death Star. He presumably perished in the Death Star's destruction during the Battle of Yavin.
Dex was a Human male who served as a member of the stormtrooper squad led by Sergeant Nova Stihl to respond to the prisoner breakout at Detention block AA-23 on Level 5 of the first Death Star.
Kai was a Human male who served as a member of the stormtrooper squad led by Sergeant Nova Stihl to respond to the prisoner breakout at Detention Block AA-23 on Level 5 of the first Death Star.

Mahl was a Human male who served as a member of the stormtrooper squad led by Sergeant Nova Stihl during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he was on duty when Han Solo and Luke Skywalker liberated Princess Leia Organa from Detention Block AA-23 on Level 5 of the first Death Star.
Nate was a Human male who served as a member of the Stormtrooper squad led by Sergeant Nova Stihl to respond to the prisoner breakout at Detention Block AA-23 on Level 5 of the first Death Star.
Cy was a male Human who served as a member of the Stormtrooper squad led by Sergeant Nova Stihl to respond to the prisoner breakout at Detention Block AA-23 on Level 5 of the first Death Star.
Zack was a Human male who served as a member of the Stormtrooper squadron led by Sergeant Nova Stihl to respond to the prisoner breakout at Detention block AA-23 on Level 5 of the first Death Star.
Mendel Baudo was a reclusive Aqualish who owned a shipwright company along with small shipyards that produced the Baudo-class star yacht during the height of the New Order.

Elio Bonton was a high-class gambler who made a living separating young Tapani nobles from their money. The young nobles found him very entertaining and he always had an interesting tale or amusing story to tell.
Brogan Ley was an ambitious male Human Tapani who was a high-ranking executive in TamCo by the time he was only thirty-two years of age.
Walon Vau's father was the abusive father of Walon Vau and the Count of Gesl on the isolated, feudal ocean world of Irmenu.

Bur Veujarij was a doctor who worked at the Imperial Institue of Military Medicine and studied the aging of clone troopers sometime around 8 BBY. He wrote the article "Aging and Tissue Regeneration in Kaminoan-cloned Troops" for Imperial Medical Review 1675.

Pooja was a female individual who was the maternal grandmother of Darred Janren Naberrie. In 26 BBY, Darred's wife Sola Naberrie gave birth to their second daughter, whom they named Pooja Naberrie after Darred's grandmother.
The sister of Tarrin Datch was a Human female, one of several children born to her parents, though she was the only girl.

Wud Mortull was a male Human Padawan of Jedi Master Pernicar who fought in the New Sith Wars under Master Pernicar, but went missing some time during the fighting. Mortull would reappear eight years later as a member of the Brotherhood of Darkness.

Nuck Lyu was a male Jedi Master of the early Galactic Republic and Watchman of Esseles. He and his contemporary Jedi Master Sar Agorn had been searching for Force-sensitives in the outlying systems of the Corellian sector when they encountered a youth named Cope Shykrill.
Cope Shykrill was a male Padawan of Jedi Master Sar Agorn, and a member of the early Galactic Republic and Jedi Order, circa 25,000 BBY.
Dorok Zalaster was a pirate who had his bald head covered with tattoos of swirling designs, a scar ran from the top of his head, down the left side of his face.
Cebz was a dominant female Marit who participated in the Battle of Gaftikar. Before the battle, she led RC-1136 and RC-3222 to Eyat City for reconnaissance of the city.

Gaib was a young male Human who was the partner and mechanic of TK-0. He and TK specialized in stolen industrial technology as a kind of high tech bounty hunters. They had been hired by Kal Skirata to find someone trying to beat the Republic's cloning ban.
Jilka Zan Zentis was a female Human who worked with and was a friend of Besany Wennen in the Galactic Republic's Treasury office in Corporate Tax Enforcement.
Den Skeenah was Human male who served as a senator from Chandrila during the Clone Wars.
Tavo was an Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando serving in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Ven was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Like his clone brethren, he was a Human male who stood 1.83 meters tall.
Bek was a clone trooper in the 35th Infantry under the command of Levet. Bek was called for by a wounded brother on Qiilura.

Tel was a clone trooper sergeant in the Grand Army of the Republic in the 35th Infantry who fought in the battle on the planet Gaftikar. During the battle he brought Omega Squad with him to take out the HoloNet center in Eyat.
Irtanna was a female Human Republic soldier who joined the Army of Light during the New Sith Wars.
Bordon was a Human male native from Ruusan who was one of the many non-Force-sensitive members to join the Army of Light during the Ruusan Reformation.
Rell was a male Human mercenary and a non-Force-sensitive member of the Brotherhood of Darkness during the New Sith Wars.

Lergan was a Human mercenary and a non-Force sensitive member of the Brotherhood of Darkness. Lergan fled from the Seventh Battle of Ruusan after the Army of Light managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the Sith camp.

Hansh was a Human mercenary and a non-Force sensitive member of the Brotherhood of Darkness. Hansh fled from the Seventh Battle of Ruusan after the Army of Light managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the Sith camp.

Pad was a Human mercenary and a non-Force sensitive member of the Brotherhood of Darkness. Pad fled from the Seventh Battle of Ruusan after the Army of Light managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the Sith camp.
Derrin was a male Human mercenary and a non-Force sensitive member of the Brotherhood of Darkness.
Tallo was a Human male who was the eldest son of Bordon, and the older brother of Wend.
Wend was a Human male who was the youngest son of Bordon, and the younger brother of Tallo.
Ballifore Figg sometimes known as "Balli the Horn" was Bith musician who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Kelad'den, known as Kel for short, was a male Lethan Twi'lek who lived on the Outer Rim world of Serenno around 990 BBY.
Hetton was a Human male whose family was distantly related to House Demici, one of the Great Houses of Serenno.
Paak was a male Human who was a member of the Anti-Republic Liberation Front which formed on Serenno following the end of the New Sith Wars.

Cyndra was a female Chiss who served as a member of the Anti-Republic Liberation Front. She, along with Paak, survived and fled from the Duel on Serenno, a failed kidnapping attempt on Tarsus Valorum. Later, on orders from Hetton, she forcefully led "Rainah" to her leader.

Loranda was the mother of Hetton. She never knew of her son's Force-sensitivity until he was in his twenties, at which point she hired the Duros bounty hunter Gula Dwan to train her son in the ways of the Force.

Gula Dwan was a Duros bounty hunter and assassin. A Force-sensitive, he was selected by the wealthy Human Loranda to teach her son, Hetton, about the Force. However, Hetton found Dwan to be a worthless teacher, and after a short time, he killed him.
Jardra was a musician who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was the daughter of Chop Harlison and his wife, Sharda.

Chem was a Human male who was in his youth during the Yuuzhan Vong War, a conflict spurred by the invasion of the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong in 25 ABY. His mother was a diplomat who collected pristine starfighters.

Dannik was a male Tarasin who lived on Cularin and was a teenager during the time of the Clone Wars. After there were some riots in the city of Gadrin, Dannik and the Human Kal were sent by the Cularin Militia to tail the Heroes of Cularin.

Worror Dowmat was a male Ithorian Jedi Master. Being a healer by profession, he was known amongst his peers to have never wielded a lightsaber, instead providing support for his allies in combat through his proficiency with Jedi battle meditation.

Sarro Xaj was a human male Jedi Knight who lived during the Golden Age of the Old Republic and was known to have had a massive physique and studied under Master Raskta Lsu, and fought alongside her in the New Sith Wars on Ruusan.

Raskta Lsu was an Echani female Jedi Master and a soldier in General Hoth's Army of Light. She was named after the legendary Echani Raskta Fenni, who was also regarded as the greatest warrior of her time.
Ched Varga was a starfighter pilot who joined the Rebel Alliance at some point during the Galactic Civil War and became noted as a Y-wing pilot.

Vir Nurb was a male Sullustan con artist who owned the modified Dartiss-5 Caravel space barge Lost Lady. He used the ship as the basis of his smuggling career and the schemes he ran between Nal Hutta and Nar Shaddaa.

Nalia Adollu was a female Human Jedi Padawan from the Expansion Region planet Corsin. Following the Battle of Ruusan in 1000 BBY, Adollu was chosen to be the Padawan of the Pyn'gani Jedi Master Anno Wen-Chii.

Anno Wen-Chii was a reclusive Pyn'gani Jedi Master who lived near the end of the New Sith Wars. In 995 BBY, he and his Padawan, Nalia Adollu, went to his homeworld, Polus, to study life-forms; they were not seen on Coruscant for the next five years.
Barra-Rona-Ban was a Cerean Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as the Chief Librarian of the Jedi Temple Archives in the years after the New Sith Wars.
The Pelagia Duplex Command Assault Gunship ("Orphanmaker") was developed to protect the Tapani sector from the chaos of the Great Sith War.
Haka Hai was an Ishi Tib crime lord who had a base on Mimban. The Gotal Lumbra worked for Hai.
Lumbra was a male Gotal criminal who worked for the Ishi Tib Haka Hai before betraying him.
Barclo was a male colonel in the Darkknell Defense Agency.
Thykele was an officer with the Darkknell Defense Agency who accompanied Nyroska and Barclo on an attempt to capture Moranda Savich.

Koa Delko was a Quermian male who served as the Minister of Defense for the Galactic Republic during the Mandalorian Wars. He was present at the trials of Demagol and Dorjander Kace as the prosecutor.

Graw was a male Ithorian Senator who represented Ithor in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Mandalorian Wars. In 3963 BBY, he was later killed after he called for tariffs against the Tapani sector due to their high prices.
Flossin Noz was a male Gungan who lived on Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War and was the zealot chief of a violent religious group called the Muskegs.

Czic was one of Chay Praysh's numerous Drach'nam bodyguards. He, along with Brok, was sprayed in the face with a flammable mix of chemicals by Mara Jade, during her mission to rescue Sansia Bardrin from slavery.
Brok was one of Chay Praysh's numerous Drach'nam bodyguards. He along with Czic had a flammable mix of chemicals sprayed in their faces by Mara Jade during a rescue attempt of Sansia Bardrin.
Nia was a female Human Jedi Initiate who studied with the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Hurd Coyle was a junk salvager. Following the Battle of Utapau, Captain Coyle rescued the clone pilot HOB-147 who was drifting in space and had missed Order 66.
Rajine was a countess and Jedi who lived during the final centuries of the Galactic Republic. Additionally, she was an Energy Vampire and was capable of draining an individual's life-force.
Josek Haime was a Bakuran from Gesco City. The Bakuran Senate selected Haime to be their representative to the Alliance of Free Planets following the Bakura Truce.

Mason Simpson was a mathematics professor at Salis D'aar Academy. He was consulted by Voren Na'al who was researching the Ssi-ruuk for the Alliance of Free Planets. Simpson was tall, causing him to stoop, and he enjoyed telling stories.
Brco was an Ilwizzt male who lived on G'rho and served in the G'rho Defense Force.
Tolaris Shim was a Jedi Master. Shim was an active member of the Jedi Order during the time of the Great Sith War.
Cori was a female Mere cruiser captain, who fought for the Galactic Republic before the onset of the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, she fought in a space battle during the First Battle of Geonosis.
Qiina was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic in the years following the Ruusan Reformation.

Gamy was a male Human who served as a member of the crime lord Haka Hai's gang. In the year 19 BBY Hai was based on the planet Mimban, where he set up a deal with an old friend named Schurk-Heren, to purchase an artifact known as the Jebble Box.
The New Republic Envoy to Gyndine was a distinguished man who served during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Mohs was an aged and stooped Sharu male belonging to the Toka culture. He was the High Singer of the subintelligent Toka, and he knew all their legends about the ancient, advanced, and supposedly extinct Sharu species. Mohs lived in the city of Teguta Lusat on Rafa IV.

Samuro was a Jedi Knight who lived centuries before the onset of the Clone Wars. He recognized the threat posed by the energy vampire Countess Rajine and imprisoned her and the victims of her life-draining powers on a remote world.
Ilanka was a basso-toned, at times sarcastic, New Republic Commander that oversaw the evacuation of Gyndine during the Battle of Gyndine at the beginning of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Brin'shak was a male Twi'lek from the Shak clan and was a talent agent on Ryloth who sent several female Twi'leks to work for Durga Besadii Tai on Nal Hutta.

This unidentified Sullustan rebel was recruited to join the Rebel Alliance's new fighting unit, Renegade Squadron. He fought with Renegade Squadron when they were ambushed on Ord Mantell. He survived through the Battle of Endor.

Dreed Pommel was a criminal during the time of the Stark Hyperspace War in 44 BBY. Kel Dor Jedi Master Plo Koon was assigned by the Jedi Council to find and apprehend Pommel shortly after the death of his Master, Tyvokka.
A male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the wanning years of the Galactic Republic, this man was escorting the dangerous former Jedi Lycan back to Coruscant when his ship crashed.
Motto Shemson was a male communications technician who worked for the New Republic.

Gingal was a Mon Calamari who served as the New Republic's Watch Commander at the Xyquine base. As Pash Cracken's commanding officer, he was prepared to order a retreat from Xyquine when Imperial forces attacked; it was the quick counter order by Cracken that allowed the bulk …
Altapi T'mman was a female pilot who served with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War as the captain of a CR90 corvette.

Emen Rooshan was a male Twi'lek from Ryloth. One of the greediest of the Rooshan clan who ran the small mining town of Lohema, he grew so resentful of the nearby city of Joreikna that he hired assassins to kill some of the ruling clan of that city, the Ku'rys.
Tho'natu was a male Twi'lek Jedi during the final years of the New Sith Wars. As a Jedi Knight, he fought in the Ruusan campaign, and by 990 BBY he had ascended to the rank of Jedi Master.
Sesh Durgo was a male Human scoundrel who searched for a treasure on Ryloth.
Hunvar was a Hutt slaver based in Kala'uun on Ryloth. The floor of his residence's dining hall had a hole through which spectators could watch slaves engaged in combat for their entertainment.
Reelov Hooth was a male Twi'lek official at the main customs office of the Rylothian city of Kala'uun.
Kel Dandu was a male Human holovid director who planned to make a documentary on Twi'lek slave girls. As a child, Dandu was a slave himself.
Ru'up Benpo was a male Twi'lek and member of the head-clan in Kala'uun.
Stano Hapin was the head of the Disac pirates. Ket Maliss killed Hapin during the Galactic Civil War.
Kitak Hu was a male Paigun who ran Hu's Emporium, a weapons store marketed towards droids on the crime-ridden "Gambler's World" of Vorzyd V.

Diedrich Greyshade was a Moff of the Commonality. A cousin of Simon Greyshade, it was due to Diedrich's influence that Simon's culpability in the death of their cousin Jheramahd Greyshade was never discovered, allowing Simon to become Senator of the Commonality.
Maggis was a teacher in the days before the Galactic Empire. He was a professor of navigation and sublight technology at the Celestial School of Spaceflight Engineering on Argus.

Srimaur was a Human male who lived in Mos Espa on Tatooine. In 1 ABY, he hired a spacer to collect some Tusken Raider relics from the Tusken relic cave. After the spacer brought him the relics, he sent the spacer to help fellow Mos Espa resident Kav Goldor.
Kav Goldor was a Human male who lived in Mos Espa on Tatooine. Some time after 0 BBY, he hired a group of spacers to defend Mos Espa from an attack by Tusken Raiders.

Rin Mako was a Nautolan Commander who lived during the Clone Wars. During the war between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, he fought in a battle against the Separatists.
Ixsthmus was a male Ithorian who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Alpha-956 was a male Human who served as a stormtrooper with the Empire Reborn. In 12 ABY he was stationed at the hidden Cairn Installation as part of the base's large contingent of guards.
Meghan Rivers was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who escaped the Battle of Hoth aboard the GR-75 medium transport Bright Hope.
Bindu was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who escaped the Battle of Hoth aboard the GR-75 medium transport Bright Hope.
Crimmins was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and combat specialist who escaped the Battle of Hoth aboard the GR-75 medium transport Bright Hope.
Seito was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who escaped the Battle of Hoth aboard the GR-75 medium transport Bright Hope.
An individual known only as Darklighter was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He escaped the Battle of Hoth aboard the GR-75 medium transport Bright Hope.

Jonas Nova was one of the two founders of Nova Orion Industries, along with his old friend Garrick Orion. However, sometime following 0 BBY they nearly split the organization due to their growing mutual suspicion and distrust.

Klarymére was a male S'kytri and Lord of the Highland Clans of the planet of Skye. Serving as the people's Patriarch at the start of the Clone Wars, he resided in the planet's capital city, the City of the Winged People.
Nazish was a Rishii Zulirian Swordmistress. She was one of only three individuals to have mastered the aerial sword combat known as Trispzest.
Zeta Magnus, also known as K'am'ir Zaarin, Saturna the Garu and Eon Null, or the Great Tyrant was a male Arkanian abomination and a genetic terrorist.

Beylyssa was a Human female bounty hunter who occasionally worked with Boddu Bocck, and tried to capture Platt Okeefe and Darrik while they were on Bespin. She was later present on the Vengeance when Dirk Harkness and Jai Raventhorn destroyed the ship.

Wolver was a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy who served on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vengeance during the Galactic Civil War. Nine months after the Battle of Yavin, Wolver and Lieutenant Tier accompanied Captain Thrawn on a trip to S'krrr to study S'krrr art.

Tier was a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy who served on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vengeance during the Galactic Civil War. Nine months after the Battle of Yavin, Tier and Lieutenant Wolver accompanied Captain Thrawn on a trip to S'krrr to study S'krrr art.
Sh'shak was a S'krrr who became famous among his people during the Galactic Civil War for his skill as a warrior and his Wing-song poetry.

Vroon was the S'krrr caretaker of the Sikadian Gardens. A follower of an ancient cult which worshiped drog beetles, he used his position to kill the garden's predatory shreevs in order to allow the drog population thrive. He was eventually killed by the insects.

Yuun was a young female Bouncer who followed Darovit around while he walked the Ruusan forests. She was with him when they discovered that the Senate was building a monument to the one hundred fallen Jedi in the Seventh Battle of Ruusan.
Mnor Nha was a Gotal who lived in the Invisec area of the planet Coruscant.
Jonox Forb was the leader of a smuggler group that occupied the natural ice caves of Hoth that would later be used as the template by the Alliance Corps of Engineers to construct Echo Base.
Mad Gass'kin was a Bothan male who owned and operated Mad Gass'kin's Used DroidNet. He ran an advertisement for his services on the DroidNet.
Garoush was a wealthy Rodian gambler. He was present in a casino in the space station at Issagra when a group of spacers who were avoiding bounty hunters arrived.

Tiethiagg was the first great poet and philosopher of the Ithorians. He was adept at understanding the Ithorian's herd culture and its relationship with the individual, and how each individual needed to contribute to the health of Ithor as a whole.
Hev'sin was a female Bothan who served as a spy for the same criminal organization that employed Nuri on Aargau.
Jorli was a junior aide on Parco Ein's staff who contacted Daven Quarle to seek his advise on a few groups who would not leave the Verkuylian Imperial Governor's Hall after a party held by Ein.

Tafno was an officer in the Imperial Navy who promised aid to Parco Ein for Verkuyl in the form of two Dreadnaughts after Ein learned of a New Republic fleet that was in position to liberate Verkuyl from Daven Quarle.

Claris was a member of a New Republic Intelligence team sent to aid in the liberation of Verkuyl. She worked with the Verkuylian resistance to set explosives around Verkuyls main communications transmitter to cut off the Imperials from outside aid.

Feemor was a Human male Jedi Knight who served the Galactic Republic. The first Padawan to Jedi Knight Qui-Gon Jinn, Feemor was successfully trained to Knighthood by Jinn, who was in turn granted the title of Jedi Master.
Bob was a Human male stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire. Sometime between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, Bob stole the diary of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Bama Vook was a Talz pilot who worked for Trinkatta Starships around the year 33 BBY. He had a son named Chup-Chup who was kidnapped by Bartokk assassins hired by Groodo the Hutt.
Gar was a huge Talz male who collaborated with the forces of the Imperial occupation of Alzoc III. In exchange for special favors from the occupiers, he helped to keep his fellow Talz in line.
Anise I'Zak was a Human female Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Tirog was a male Human bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. A skilled marksman, pilot, and hunter, he frequently found himself in the midst of combat and conflict during his eventful career.

Kreg was an Ithorian patron in 7-Gee Lounge at Mos Espa Arena during the time of the Invasion of Naboo. He was a friend of Watto's flunky, who also was present at that cantina, when Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn was searching for Watto.
Luke Skywalker's best friend was a Force-sensitive childhood friend of Luke Skywalker and lieutenant in the Rebel Alliance who participated in the battles of Yavin, Hoth and Endor.

Wass was a boy who had Force potential but was ultimately unworthy of becoming a Jedi Knight and was sentenced to work on Dantooine. He organized his friends to fight against the Separatist droids when they attacked the planet.
Zac was a boy who showed Force potential, but was not chosen to progress on to a Jedi Knight, but instead assigned to work on Dantooine.
Gaber Rollobad was a Sullustan male smuggler who owned the YT-1210 light freighter Boolarg.
Jasten was a young male individual who lived on the planet Ganlihk. His parents were Elisha Merew and Locris. Jasten was one of the first colonists to make contact with the animals known as ludos.
Houlilan was an Ithorian who provided shelter to several Rogue Squadron and Alien Combine members after they were attacked by Imperial troops on the planet Coruscant.
Clabburn the Elder was a Mugaari space pirate notorious for targeting the Greater Javin region of the Outer Rim Territories during the final decades before the fall of the Galactic Republic.
Clabburn the Younger was a Mugaari space pirate who sought to fashion his pirating career after his father, Clabburn the Elder.
The "Hooded Wookiee" was a member of the Cell, a group of dissidents within the Cularin system's criminal organization who wanted to oust Nirama in 31 BBY.
Tika was a Coruscanti orphan used by Darth Caedus as a double to switch out for his daughter Allana in his kidnapping plot to retrieve her from Hapes in 40 ABY.
Lira Mimb was a high-ranking member of Nirama's personal security forces aboard his public asteroid. She was on the tall side for a Sullustan, and had piercing eyes.
Bettle's sister was the sister of Bettle, and one of two daughters of Ralltiir resistance leader Jerell. She died as a result of the actions of Dennix Graeber, the Imperial governor of Ralltiir.
Vel Pastar was a grizzled and grumpy old Twi'lek who had been working with the smugglers in the Cularin system since Riboga the Hutt first came to power within the system.

Hugo Bartyn, known as The Slayer among the Menahuun sentient species, was a male Human field agent of the exploratory branch of the Outer Rim Oreworks corporation during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Hirael Chindiaye was a Human male who was present in the Adventurers' Guildhall in Aurilia on Dathomir in 1 ABY.
Skolitz was an Imperial Navy Captain serving in the faction loyal to the usurper Emperor Darth Krayt. The captain was also an aide to Moff and Grand Admiral Rulf Yage.
Follnor Callat was a male Human who, as an academic scholar, used his talents to make a career in treasure hunting during the years of the New Order and early Galactic Civil War.
A stormtrooper was the leader of a platoon assigned to the forest moon of Endor. Years later, he reminisced about his time on Endor in a bar.
Kloo was a Trandoshan member of the Organization working on the Darkside station. He spent some quality time in 32 BBY incarcerated in cells on Tolea Biqua.
Maya was a Human female who served as a Alderaanian Security agent and a member of Senator Bail Organa's personal security detail during the Clone Wars.

Drikl Lecersen was a human male who served on the Council of Moffs of the Imperial Remnant from 41 ABY and onward. A supporter of Gilad Pellaeon, Lecersen was an conservative Moff who believed strongly in doing one's duty and keeping combat-ready at all times.

Quille was a male who served as Grand Moff of the Imperial Remnant and led the Council of Moffs in 41 ABY. A rival to Gilad Pellaeon, who had returned to as Supreme Commander. Quille oversaw a faction of Moffs on the council in opposition to the aged Pellaeon.

Rosset was a member of the Council of Moffs in 40 ABY who opposed Grand Admiral Gilad Pellaeon. He was aboard the Bloodfin during the Second Battle of Fondor and supported Quille's coup against Pellaeon.
Telissa was an aide to Galactic Republic Senator Uta S'orn of the Expansion Region planet Belasco prior to S'orn's resignation from the Galactic Senate in 43 BBY.
Lola was a perky and talkative Twi'lek dancer who went to Darkside on one payday along with the band that Nirama had sent. During a break, she had a short conversation with one of Nirama's spies.
Guro was a male Sullustan and first mate on the CR90 corvette Stellar Damsel.

Osaf Hamud was Galactic Republic scholar who wrote a document about orbalisks. He came up with the one solution on how to remove the dangerous parasites. His paper, titled An Examination and Exploration of a Most Dangerous and Resilient Organism, was on record in the Jedi Temple.

Shas Vadde was a Fondorian who served as the president of Fondor during the Second Galactic Civil War. In 41 ABY, he supported the Confederation, but after Jacen Solo began bombing Oridin in the Second Battle of Fondor he surrendered to Admiral Cha Niathal.

Hoge was a Human officer in the Imperial Navy. By 137 ABY, Hoge held the rank of captain of the Relentless, flagship of the Outer Rim Third Fleet. The captain was present during the execution of Kel Dor Admiral Sha Dun by Sith Lord Darth Azard.

Dru Valan was a Human Imperial Navy admiral who was originally loyal to the Fel Empire. During the Sith–Imperial War, he was made responsible for ensuring that Admiral Gar Stazi of the Galactic Alliance did not escape Caamas.
Sha Dun was a Kel Dor who held the rank of admiral in the Imperial Navy during the Second Imperial Civil War—the insurrection against the Sith-controlled Empire led by Emperor-in-exile Roan Fel.
Darth Azard was a Quarren Sith Lord of the One Sith, serving under Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt and his Empire.
Moolie was a Human male member of Lumbra's criminal organization.
Callow was a Human male member of Lumbra's criminal organization.
Seddwia was a female Rutian Twi'lek Jedi youngling who served the Jedi Order and escaped Order 66 with K'Kruhk and Chase Piru.
Andal Sait was a male Human who served as captain in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he commanded the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Blackguard.
Arno D'Vox was a commander in the Imperial Military. He was in command of Bannistar Station during the Galactic Civil War.
Cisvin was a male Mustafarian junk dealer on Nova Orion Station in 1 ABY.
Erikson was a male Mon Calamari merchant who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he worked as a junk dealer on Station Gamma, a space station in the Bright Jewel system.
Nathan Blyskipper was a Human male who worked as a junk dealer in Mos Taike on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War
Ollobo was a Quarren male. Sometime after 0 BBY, he worked as a junk dealer in Jabba's Palace on Tatooine.
Deara Antilles was a Human female who was the sister of Queen Breha Organa. Around 18 BBY, she served as her sister's advisor and the caretaker of Breha's adopted daughter, Leia.
P'arghat was a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy who served under Admiral Mordon on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vengeance during the Galactic Civil War.

Reeveid was a Rodian bounty hunter. Tirog, a fellow bounty hunter, arranged to meet with Reeveid in a cantina. Tirog waited half an hour for Reeveid. Thannik, another bounty hunter, also once arranged to meet with Reeveid in a cantina on business.
Makezh was a Human male from the planet Danoor in the Kathol Outback, an isolated region of space in the Outer Rim Territories.

Rolf Treidum was a Human male who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. During his service while stationed in the Deep Core, Treidum encountered a young officer named Kentor Sarne and became one of his staunchest supporters.
Rolf was a male Human who, by c. 19 BBY, had became a member of a group of Believers on the planet Genarius, under the command of Alina Impeveri.

A male Jedi Master trained Jedi Winslau Da'k. The Master was imprisoned on Morcanth by his former student, as Da'k had been corrupted to the dark side of the Force by Darth Vader. Later, the Master was released and served his rescuers as a teacher in the ways of the Force.
Solimon Dambrizi was a male Human who was a police officer before discovering that he was force-sensitive and he left his position to study the ways of the Force.
Jimbo Kinnison was a failed member of the Jedi Order of Force-users who was active during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.

Jog Saveen was a Force Adept tainted by the dark side of the Force. Like many individuals touched by the dark side, she faced the possibility of experiencing the debilitating long-term effects of dark side corruption.

Karae Nalvas, also known as Boss Nalvas and sometimes known by the pseudonym Fesvk Wefos, was a male Human who was a former Jedi Knight who fell to the dark side and became a rogue Jedi during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Vara Nreem was a Human female who served as a Jedi Knight during the days of the Old Republic. Believing she could learn the secrets of the Sith without allowing herself to fall to the dark side, Nreem traveled to the planet of Krayiss II in the year 4000 BBY, where it had bee…
A member of the Lightning Battalion holding the rank of sergeant, Beez served during the Icarii Campaign under Colonel Abal Karda.

Linna Naltree was a Human scientist during the time of the Clone Wars. After being taken from her homeworld and sent to Despayre, Naltree was assigned to work at the Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center where she was noticed by Jenna Zan Arbor.
Mab Kador, a young and eager male Aleena Podracer pilot, took part in a Podrace held at the Tatooinian Mos Espa Grand Arena in 22 BBY with his retrofitted pod, White Panther.

Chros-filik, a Phuii Podracer pilot of the planet Phu, took part in a race held at the Tatooinian Mos Espa Grand Arena in 22 BBY. A famous Podracer, Chros-filik was among names of the competitors' neophyte bounty hunter Boba Fett could recognize as an appreciator of the sport.
LobwuWa Loba was an Ualaq Aqualish from the planet Tatooine and an aspiring podracer pilot in 32 BBY, when Loba attended the Boonta Eve Classic as a spectator in the Mos Espa Grand Arena.

This scavenger was a criminal in Mos Espa who sold parts scavenged from destroyed podracers. In 32 BBY, he sent an underling to steal Anakin Skywalker's plasma ignition capacitor just minutes before the Boonta Eve Classic podrace began.

Riva Denais was a legendary female holo-starlet known for her beauty. For a time, Denais dated the businessman Iaco Stark, but a sometime prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars, Denais was reported missing following an incident in Corporate Sector in which Stark and his partn…

Bruce McBrain was a male Aqualish who worked for Jabba the Hutt in 1 ABY. After one of Jabba's minions betrayed him, so as to lessen a sentence, McBrain hired a spacer to locate and destroy the minion's CR90 corvette en route to a council of Galactic Judges.

Nict was a Human admiral serving the Galactic Alliance in 130 ABY. During the Battle of Caamas, the admiral's Pride of Corellia and other ships of the fleet were unable to escape from Caamas and into hyperspace due to the Fel Empire sabotaging the lanes.

Jaius Yorub was a Sullustan who served in the Galactic Alliance Defense Force as a naval officer. He was captain of the MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser Indomitable during the Sith–Imperial War of 127–130 ABY.

Lodrex was the male bartender and owner of the tavern at Trevalis, a mining settlement on Kallistas. He was a former miner until he lost his left arm due to an accident with a mining laser. His poverty meant that the missing limb was never replaced by a cybernetic arm.

t: Unidentified Jedi Knight (Shaak Ti's first Padawan)
x: A male Jedi Knight was the first Padawan of Jedi Master Shaak Ti. Soon after achieving knighthood, he was murdered by a vicious killer.

Memily was a Human female who served as a loyal servant to Bail Organa and worked at the Royal Palace on the planet of Alderaan where she did most of the cooking, cleaning, and taking care of the young Princess Leia Organa. She made a type of pastry nicknamed Memily's basket.

Jal was a Pathfinder serving in the Alliance Special Forces. Jal was assigned to Team Razor, and was part of the team that established Outpost Cinder. The commanding Major ordered Jal to figure out a retrieval plan, assigning Henle and another trooper to assist.

Star Wing was a Duinuogwuin male, 80 meters in length. His underbelly was silver, while the scales on his back were a pale blue color. Star Wing lived for centuries in The Drift before deciding to explore other parts of the galaxy.

Kandria A'Daasha was a female Human and the co-owner of the Glow Dome nightclub, located on the world of Adarlon, along with her twin sister Corinna. She was secretly being preyed upon by Ziakas, a dark side creature that was devouring her very essence.
Avery Linnix was a male art dealer who lived and worked on the planet Procopia in the Tapani sector during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Tex Vandale was a male executive on the board of Tapani Starship Cooperative during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Alandra Mipsy was a female reporter for the Colonial News Nets in the Tapani sector during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Dermeg was the Imperial Governor of the planet Ansillivog. He was an overbearing, egotistical man, who was dangerous to his opponents and somewhat mentally unstable, prone to sudden changes in mood.
Zekka Thyne was a Bothan criminal with Prince Xizor's Black Sun organization. He could be found in Coronet on Corellia. He sent a spacer to kill Wililikin and Wedu Belar in 1 ABY.

Teva Karne was a male middle-level employee of the Procopian Transportation Ministry on the planet Procopia during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Harissa Shoti was a female Human actor who was slated to play the role of Jonava Billane in a holofilm depicting the events surrounding Baby Ludi.

Ahlya was a female Human operative who worked for the Darkside, a repair station in the Cularin system asteroid belt. She was also a member of The Cell, a criminal faction wanting to oust and replace local crimelord Nirama.
Dor Balse was an operative working on Darkside, a repair station in the Cularin asteroid belt. He was also a member of The Cell, a criminal faction wanting to oust and replace local crimelord Nirama.
Michael was an operative working on Darkside, a repair station in the Cularin asteroid belt. He was also a member of The Cell, a criminal faction wanting to oust and replace local crimelord Nirama.

Ch'been was a H'drachi spiritualist and holofilm director with a reading ability known as the "timestream" that would allow him to see into the future. His work included such holofilms as A Shadow Falls, Tyranny Reborn, and Dark Romance.

Kruss Gaal was an operative working on Darkside, a repair station in the Cularin asteroid belt. He was also a member of The Cell, a criminal faction wanting to oust and replace local crime lord Nirama.

Caske was a male individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Shortly after the Battle on the planet Hoth, Caske held the rank of Major and served within the Alliance High Command.
Jan Hailbrock was an arms dealer who operated in the Tapani sector during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Republic.
Gwadj was a Bordali agent during the Galactic Civil War. He commanded a mission to Kuan which captured Maarek and Marina Stele, along with Pargo.

Ves Volette was a male Caamasi light sculptor who lived on the galactic capital Coruscant and was the lover of Dejah Duare. He was born in the Jualya Village on Caamas. In 19 BBY, Ves was murdered by the Umber 3PO unit shortly after unveiling a new lightsaber-inspired work.

Dejah Duare was a female Zeltron living on Coruscant and the partner of Ves Volette, a famed Caamasi light sculptor. After the Destruction of Caamas, she feared for Volette's safety and contacted former Jedi Jax Pavan for help in escaping Coruscant.

Monia Gahan was a Mon Calamarian pilot serving the Galactic Alliance Remnant in 137 ABY. She was a member of the famed Rogue Squadron. Her uncle Gial Gahan joined her as they flew around the Imperious-class Star Destroyer Imperious.
Gial Gahan was a Mon Calamari member of the Galactic Alliance. He had been a Senator for Dac in the Galactic Alliance Senate and by 130 ABY, he was a member of the Triumvirate.
Anj Dahl was a Human pilot who served the Galactic Alliance Remnant during the Second Imperial Civil War. As a member of the Rogue Squadron, she participated in the Battle of Mon Calamari.
Jhoram Bey was a male Weequay who served the Galactic Alliance Remnant as Rogue Leader and later captain of the Alliance during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Andurgo was a Dug pilot who left Malastare and served the Galactic Alliance Remnant in 137 ABY. He was a member of Rogue Squadron and wingmate to Monia Gahan, and he considered himself the finest pilot of the squadron.
Strom Dubrok was a Human who held the rank of lieutenant in the navy of Lord Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Fosin Dreed was a male Rodian actor. One of his roles was as The Paladin in Hishinu Booj's "The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma." His character remarked that the farmers' unrest sounded like the acts of a former comrade, foreshadowing the deviant behavior of another character, the So…
Nu Toreena was an Ithorian member of the Galactic Alliance. In 130 ABY, she was a member of the Triumvirate, the organization in charge of the Galactic Alliance government.

Piers Petan was a Human Rear Admiral of the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet during the Sith–Imperial War. Petan was tricked by Imperials in the Battle of Caamas and defeated, causing the fall of the Galactic Alliance.

Bail Antilles, a Human male, was a politician who rose through the ranks of the Galactic Alliance bureaucracy and became one of the three members of the government's ruling Triumvirate at some point before 130 ABY.

Cham Detta was a male Human Mandalorian, the brother of Suvar Detta, and a member of the Mandalorian Protectors. Along with his brother, he was trained by Boba Fett as the new generation of Mandalorian Supercommandos.

Niffla was a Toydarian information broker. In 137 ABY, she sold information to Imperial Admiral Dru Valan about Gial Gahan's part in Gar Stazi's plan to capture the Imperious, an Imperious-class Star Destroyer that was under construction at the Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards.

Ronto was a Klatooinian pilot who served in the Galactic Alliance Remnant during the Second Imperial Civil War. During the Battle of Mon Calamari in 137 ABY, Ronto's CF9 Crossfire starfighter was destroyed, but not before the pilot ejected into space.
George R. Binks's wife was a female Otolla Gungan. George R. Binks chose to marry her not out of love, but because she had the ability to bear him an heir—Jar Jar Binks.
Gornash was an Imperial Intelligence agent and a false Prophet of the Dark Side.

Osos Niskooen was a Verpine who was a member of the soldier caste during the Battle of Roche. He acted as a guide for Mandalore Boba Fett and Jedi Knight Jaina Solo, but his thorax was split during the battle, killing him.

Nain Lup was a male Rodian who worked as an arms dealer, and who used the alias Karbo Jaxx when dealing with customers. Lup worked primarily in the Outer Rim specializing in the sale of small personal weapons as well as some custom armaments.

Ruu San was a deadly Human who was a member of the Galactic Empire's Special Operations. As part of the organization, her role entailed protecting the secrecy of Operation Dark Trooper at all costs around the time of the destruction of the Empire's first Death Star at the Batt…

Reerookachuck was a male Wookiee born on the planet Kashyyyk, and taken from his home before he could speak. He was raised by Human slaves, and thus never learned the ways of his culture, and did not interact with other Wookiees until he was seventy.

Joha Marik was a privateer working aboard the Free Lance under Urias Xhaxin. However, he disagreed with Xhaxin's affiliation with the Alliance to Restore the Republic and was expelled from the crew, captured by the Imperial security forces as a result.
Rana Halion was a female Ierian who served as the ruler of the Ieria during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Veema was a Human female pilot who served as a lieutenant in the New Republic–affiliated starfighter unit Kyp's Dozen during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Yasil Senerio was a man who managed a farm on the planet Freliq, during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was an adamant supporter of the idea that the lepusa were an intelligent species, especially after seeing his daughter be rescued by a lepusa's handiwork.

Jullisa Senerio was a Human female from the world of Freliq, and was the daughter of the farmer Yasil Senerio. One day, while out playing, she accidentally slipped of a ledge, but managed to grab a plank of wood and hold on.
Lox was a male Human farmer from the planet Freliq. He worked for manager Yasil Senerio for many years, and was one of the few to witness the rescuing of Yasil's daughter Jullisa.
Jiro was a Zabrak Jedi youngling who escaped Order 66 with K'Kruhk and Chase Piru.

Empideera Kkek was a Jawa trader who lived on Tatooine during the height of the New Order. He considered himself an "exalted master scavenger", and was one of the few Jawa's to give refunds for damaged or defective merchandise.
Deena Shan's father was a Human male from Etti IV. He had always dreamed of leaving his world, but was forced into an early marriage by the birth of his daughter.
Lens Reekeene was a Human female born around 54 BBY. She worked as a mercenary commander for the Sartran Corporation until the Galactic Empire imprisoned her on false charges in 14 BBY.

This Jedi Padawan was a Human male living during the Great Galactic War. During the war, he and his master, Jerbhen Hulis, were tasked by the Jedi High Council to discover the truth behind a Sith turncoat who had been providing the Republic Military with strategic information …
Estalle Balis was a High Lady of House Mecetti during the Galactic Civil War. She was the director of High Lord Bodé Leobund XI's spynet and a member of the Mecrosa Order.

Andra was a male Human captain in the Freeworlds Common Navy and commanded a cruiser during the Galactic Civil War. A dignified and distinguished looking man in his fifties, Andra was a career military man who graduated from the Neona Military Academy.

Serra Hailey was an actress in holovids, and considered by many to be a diva. She tried to revive her career during the Galactic Civil War, maintaining her beauty, and her fan base, well after the New Republic's founding.

Valara was a Cathar male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the war with the Sith Empire. For years, he operated on Imperial planets by helping Sith apprentices in doubt escape from their ruthless training and join the Jedi.
Urothko was a Wookiee warrior from Kashyyyk.

Nab H'aas was a Bith Senator during the height of the Second Galactic Civil War. H'aas represented his homeworld in the Galactic Alliance Senate, and was a witness to the argument between Mara Jade Skywalker and Jacen Solo, along with fellow Bith Senator Ph'Olla regarding the …

Ph'Olla was a Bith Senator in the Galactic Alliance, who along with Nab H'aas, overheard Mara Jade Skywalker threaten the life of Darth Caedus and accusing him of being a Sith. Neither of them knew what that was.

Xot was the owner of a three-story bar located near the spaceport of the city of Belgar on the planet Belgaroth. His identity was shrouded in mystery: over the years, more than three dozen beings of various species and genders had visited the bar, each claiming to be Xot.

Remolo was a sergeant who served under the command of Admiral Gar Stazi during the Battle of Mon Calamari in 137 ABY. The sergeant was part of an Alliance team led by Hondo Karr that hijacked the Imperious-class Star Destroyer Imperious.
Snufftalon was a big Wookiee and the bouncer of the Shilley's cantina in Questal.

Zaree Lolvanci was a female reporter for the Kuati First Holo-News. She tried to interview Rogue Squadron Commander Wedge Antilles after he took the witness stand in fellow Rogue Tycho Celchu's trial.
This man was the father of Barit Saiy and owner of an engineering company on Coruscant.
Levet was a Mandalorian who owned a small farm on the planet Mandalore. Located near the capital city of Keldabe, it was situated just down a dirt road from the Beviin-Vasur farm.
Kenb was a male Sullustan Operations Center Commander on Coruscant in 41 ABY, and was present when Cha Niathal made a surprise visit for what Darth Caedus had planned for the Second Battle of Fondor.
Lamburt was a lieutenant in the Imperial Remnant's navy and junior deck officer of the Bloodfin who informed Gilad Pellaeon of a red headed woman's arrival, being too young to know her true identity.

Loccin was a male junior officer aboard the Anakin Solo, and the replacement of Patra Tebut after her death at the hands of Darth Caedus. He feared Caedus, but informed him of the destruction of the minelayers outside of Fondor shortly before the Second Battle of Fondor.

Lenovar was the son of Purton and Boba Fett's superior officer in the Journeyman Protectors when Fett was living on Concord Dawn under the alias of "Jaster Mereel" during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
During the Galactic Civil War, Arnama was the chairman of the Plasma Energy Trade Commission and, as such, was considered to be among the most powerful people on Naboo.
Helvan was a male Human Imperial Special Intelligence operative cell leader of the Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front. He was assigned to Intelligence agent Kirtan Loor on the planet Coruscant.
Hydan was a male Rodian slicer who was part of the crew of the New Republic corvette FarStar during its mission to hunt down Moff Kentor Sarne in 8 ABY.
Hoot Calin was an engineer who worked for Calin Industries. Calin developed a medium plating for droids.

Voleyy was a Human male guard in the New Republic detention center located on the planet Coruscant. In 7 ABY, Voleyy arranged for Rogue Squadron commander Wedge Antilles, and Tycho Celchu's lawyer, Nawara Ven, to visit Celchu in prison.

Dinge was a captain in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps, who was based in the Theed Royal Palace on Naboo. In 1 ABY he took on a spacer as a new recruit to the Fighter Corps, who he set a number of missions to combat Black Sun forces operating in the Naboo system.

Kaydine was a captain in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps in 1 ABY. He was Naboo's most decorated starfighter pilot, president of the Flying Color Guard, the Chamcellor-elect of the Naboo Betterment Society and an all-round local celebrity.

Dulios was a Commander in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he was based in Theed Royal Palace, from where he sent a spacer to perform a number of tasks.
Duv-Horlo was a junior officer onboard the Anakin Solo during the Second Battle of Fondor.

Inondrar was an executive officer on board the Anakin Solo during the Second Battle of Fondor who was ordered by Darth Caedus to disable the Anakin Solo's comms to keep Cha Niathal from persuading any on board to join her.
Siralt was a male who served as Grand Moff of the Imperial Remnant. He was on board the Turbulent-class star destroyer Bloodfin during the Second Battle of Fondor and replaced Quille as Grand Moff.

Nartlo was a male Human who sold bacta on the planet Coruscant during the outbreak of the Krytos virus. Nartlo was caught and turned into an informer by Imperial Intelligence agent Kirtan Loor, who was then running the Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front.

Jun Tarpilan was a captain in the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet who fought at the Second Battle of Fondor who was acting very much unlike himself during the battle, due to Darth Caedus' battle meditation. He was known to be an old-school type of commander and very formal.
Bargos was a Mon Calamari weapons officer aboard the Galactic Alliance warship Ocean, during the war between the Galactic Alliance and the Confederation.

Pichaff was a colonel in the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and the Rapid Deployment Commander for the attack on the Fondor Shipyards. Pichaff didn't believe Darth Caedus' plan to attack Fondor was sound and questioned his sanity.
A male Human was the son of Natasi Daala who went on to have a daughter of his own.
The granddaughter of Natasi Daala and Liegeus Vorn was a female Human who was the child of Natasi Daala's son.
The female Quarren was the wife of Kral Nevil and mother of Turl Nevil.

This female was the wife of former Jedi Knight Bardan Jusik, with whom she had numerous adopted sons, daughters and grandchildren. It was remarked by Jusik that she had died many years prior to when Jedi Knight Jaina Solo came to him for advice on handling her brother.

Igren Demos was a Force-sensitive male Neimoidian criminal in service of the crime boss Jiramma, adjutant of the Hutt Darga Jiramma Mionne, on Cato Neimoidia during and immediately after the Clone Wars.

Etha Naru was a professor. For a time, she had worked for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, before being thought to be killed by Imperial troops. In fact, she went on to work for the Galactic Empire as a scientist.
The wife of the Human male Handon Guld lived with him on the agrarian Outer Rim planet of Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire.

"Red Two" was the call sign of a male Human starfighter pilot who fought at the Battle of Endor. He piloted a Y-wing starfighter and shot down at least three TIE Interceptors, the first of which shot down Red Three.
Gellak, nicknamed Gunmetal Gellak, was a notorious pirate. A group of privateers were hired to catch the pirate; ending his business during the time of the New Republic.
A male Human Jedi Master served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
TK-8H2 was a stormtrooper for the Galactic Empire. In 1 ABY, TK-8H2 was stationed in the Theed Royal Palace, alongside Nial Declann and another stormtrooper, designated TK-9H4.
Dartan Ziemba was an Alderaanian who gave the Empire a tip about a Force-sensitive toddler living on Alderaan. He had a wife named Sona and a daughter named Tula.
Tula Ziemba was an Alderaanian child whose parents were Dartan and Sona Ziemba.

Sona Ziemba lived on Alderaan, and informed Ferus Olin about native flowers which only bloom for one day in Alderaan, and about the festival that is held on that day. She was later interrogated by Ferus and Hydra about whether she knew anything about a Force-Sensitive toddler.
Deggar Feps was a rogue Human male scout who had a knack for getting himself into difficult situations.

Dr'aan was a Sullustan clone. He was discovered at an abandoned Alliance base in 0 ABY, by Tash Arranda and Shi'ido Mammon Hoole. Dr'aan appeared to be an exact double of the Rebel naturalist Dr'uun Unnh.
Blizz Pinnix was a retired swoop and speeder bike racer. They were a veteran of more than forty years of racing, and could always be seen wearing a full-face helmet.
915 was the designation of an Imperial stormtrooper stationed on the spaceport of the planet Thyferra.

73 was the designation of an Imperial stormtrooper stationed on the spaceport of the planet Thyferra. During the Bacta War in 7 ABY, a short firefight ensued on the spaceport when another stormtrooper tried to arrest Rogue Squadron pilot Corran Horn, who was under disguise.

Pall was a male Zabrak who lived in Mos Eisley on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime after 0 BBY, he owed Han Solo a favor, which he paid off by giving a spacer a customization kit that could change the color of a speeder.
Kallukoras was the Trandoshan leader of the Armorers' Confederacy during the early years of the New Republic. He specialized in armor crafting and weapon repair, and was a native speaker of Rodese.

Nyyv was a Sullustan native to the oceanic world of Vaynai. He owned and operated Uncle Nyyv's Floating Eatery, found on Streysel Island, during the height of the New Order. He was a native speaker of many languages, including Rodese.

Darth Homiiz was a Sith Lord with a rotund appearance, featuring tan skin covered in tattoos ranging from tan to purple coloring. On Homiiz's face, there were blue markings between the eyes, and an eye patch covering the Sith's right eye. Homizz also had a black beard and tail.
Arno was a Human male stormtrooper who was stationed aboard an All Terrain Armored Transport on the Forest Moon of Endor in 4 ABY.
Frazznik was a male Zabrak who lived on the Outer Rim world of Taris during the era of the Mandalorian Wars.
Orrsa was a Wookiee bartender at the Swirling Vortex, a cantina aboard a space station near Duro, during the Yuuzhan Vong invasion of the galaxy.
Veré was a female character in a legend of the planet Naboo's Futhork calligraphy who was said to be eternal lovers with the male character Set.

Set was a male character from a legend originating in the planet Naboo's Futhork calligraphy, in which he was the eternal lover of a woman named Veré. In 22 BBY, these names were used as aliases by Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker and Republic Senator Padmé Amidala, respectively.
Jesfa was a male Human security officer that used to work for the Zaltin Corporation on the planet Thyferra.
Vekka Lodik was a female Nuknog who served as the personal assistant of the Dug actor Seboca. During a botched attempt to murder her employer, she was killed by the detective Slyther Bushforb.
Elicia was a female Human who served as a secretary for Minister of Trade Fliry Vorru on the planet Thyferra during the Bacta War in 7 ABY.
Carsa was a male Human lieutenant on the Imperial Star Destroyer Freedom. He died when a monitor exploded in his face during the Battle of Thyferra.
Issen was a male Human ensign on the Imperial Star Destroyer Freedom. He participated in the Battle of Thyferra against Ysanne Isard's Thyferran forces.
Phelly was a male Human lieutenant on the Imperial Star Destroyer Freedom. He participated in the Battle of Thyferra against Ysanne Isard's Thyferran forces.

Ardle was a male Human who served as a captain and TIE fighter pilot for the Thyferran Home Defense Corps. Ardle and his squadron fought against former members of the New Republic starfighter unit Rogue Squadron at the Graveyard.
Bascome was a Human pilot of Elite Squadron, which was part of the Thyferran Home Defense Corps, the military force comprised of Thyferran personnel.
Teksli Yenak was a Rodian bounty hunter and member of the Chattza Clan. He had a decent scoring but "unremarkable" vital stats as a new hunter in the ancient guild of Goa-Ato.
Feyyaz Ferdusi was a Nduuati bounty hunter as well as an accomplished swoop racer. He lost a swoop race only once to a rookie named Jobany Cyrs on Najiba.
A male Ho'Din Jedi Master served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
A Human Padawan served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
This Jedi served as messenger for the Dantooine Enclave Council during the Mandalorian War. He received a message from accused Jedi Zayne Carrick for Master Vandar Tokare.
Jhorag Corconnan was an Alliance Intelligence operative sent to the planet of Tasariq to organize Rebel resistance cells.
Sho'ban Do was a Near-Human male from Pitann. In 8 ABY, he served as one of his planet's senators on the Kathol Republic Senatorial Council.
Chandra Hobat was a female Ithorian politician, agriculturist and ecologist from Dayark in the Episol system. In 8 ABY, she served as the President of the Kathol Republic.
When the distress call was answered by the legitimate New Republic ship FarStar, Udine believed them to be in league with the Lance.

Hendric Faile was the fleet commander of the Kathol Republic Navy, and commanded the Marauder-class corvette Triumph. In 8 ABY, Faile responded to a distress call from the Bravado III following the Battle of Episol.
Sal Olbeg was a genetically engineered Human senator from Dayark. He was a political opponent of Sho'ban Do.
Wargo was a Drovian member of the notorious Tarisian swoop gang known as the Black Vulkars who later joined the rampaging Mandalorian Neo-Crusader army in the early stages of the Mandalorian Wars.
Drako was a male Codru-Ji from the planet of Coruscant.
Uta T'Cha was a female Human droid programmer and mechanic. She was a former member of the Sabiador Slavers.
Aerin Dlarit was a Human male and the father of former New Republic Rogue Squadron pilot Erisi Dlarit.
A low-ranking commercial officer for Systech Corporation became HK-47's fourth known owner after the previous owner was accidentally killed by the droid.

A senator was a Human male who served in the Galactic Republic's Senate on the planet Coruscant during the Jedi Civil War. He came into possession of the assassin droid HK-47, and used the droid to eliminate his political adversaries.
Bors Kenlin was a Human and the captain of the Bacta Tanker Xucphra Rose.

Barst Roite was a Human who served as a major for the Thyferran Home Defense Corps. Roite handled the day-to-day operations of the Defense Corps, despite Aerin Dlarit, a high ranking member of the Xucphra Corporation, being assigned as the general of the Corps.
