Virile Lead was the callsign for the commander of Virile Squadron, a TIE/LN starfighter squadron of the Thyferran Home Defense Corps. During the Battle of Thyferra, Virile Squadron went against Rogue Squadron and lost ten units on the first pass.
Parrot was an Imperial TIE/LN starfighter pilot, and the wingmate of Ranulf Trommer. He was killed on Aguarl 3 by Rebel Alliance forces.
Yasinda Bardak was a well-educated Human female from Coruscant who was the daughter of the owner of TranStar Construction.

affiliation: Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military
x: Conan Antonio Motti was a human male bureaucrat and military officer who served as an admiral and naval chief for the Galactic Empire, the fascistic successor state of the Galactic Republic.
Evinn Dastt was a Human male pilot who served with the Rebel Alliance's starfighter corps.
Darth Phobos was a female Theelin Sith Lord who was born on the planet Korriban and lived thousands of years before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

Asori Rogriss, born in 15 BBY, was the daughter of Teren Rogriss, an admiral in the Imperial Navy. When Teren Rogriss defected in 13 ABY, General Wedge Antilles promised to get word to her and offer her and her brother Terek the opportunity to escape the Imperial Remnant and j…
Terek Rogriss was the son of Admiral Teren Rogriss. Born in 11 BBY, when he came of age he followed his father into service in the Imperial Navy.
Garul was a male Bothan working with the Alliance to Restore the Republic, moving refugees from Cloud City to Kaliska. He used the alias Silver Fur while on the job.
Govin Thane was an Imperial captain in the Imperial Security Bureau, stationed in Cloud City after the Battle of Hoth.
Linna was a Human female who piloted an A-wing under Pash Cracken's Ace Squadron, a New Republic starfighter unit.
Imal Valesovich was a count who was an old school duelist. He employed The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers to procure ancient duelling swords and vibroblades.

Urrurrowo was a Wookiee from the Kashyyyk city of Rwookrrorro. Around 19 BBY, shortly after the Clone Wars had ended, Urrurrowo and his friend, Murrwooro, were severely injured when a large swarm of flame beetles attacked them and exploded.
Jelph Marrian was a Human male Jedi Knight who served in the Jedi Covenant as a Covenant Shadow, an agent whose records of existence had been erased and was notably familiar with the planet Taris.

Bataui Zeel was a Jedi Knight who served in the Jedi Covenant as a Covenant Shadow, an agent whose records of existence had been erased and who was known only to a few of the Covenant's members. Zeel was notably familiar with the planet Taris.
Veerdo Veerone was a Rodian dramatist and author of the famous play The Unquiet Spirit Arises From the Swamp.

Hatchepants was a diminutive red-skinned humanoid information broker living in the Quarren Sector of Crevasse City on Kalkovak in 1 BBY. He conversed briefly with Han Solo concerning the location of Illyan Webble during the hunt for the Yavin Vassilika.
Vhiin Thorla was a Twi'lek male who served as a Jedi Master in the decades prior to the Clone Wars. His Twi'lek given name was Vhiin'Thorla.
Dorv'Tilsta, or Dorv Tilsta, was a young male Lethan Twi'lek Jedi Initiate who was brought into the Jedi Order in the years prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
Rexellian Marshall was a male Rebel soldier who served under the command of General Crix Madine during the Galactic Civil War.
Kan Deans was a Rebel soldier who served under the command of General Crix Madine.
Bellum was a forger, also known as Bellum the Forger, who lived on Cloud City. She was killed by droids acting under the influence of X0-X1.
Widget was a diminutive alien who counted Helm Iskraker as his only friend. He lived on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
Prior to the Battle of Endor, one particular Rebel got separated from the Rebel strike team and was marooned on the forest moon.

This particular clone scout trooper was part of the Imperial unit, assigned to guarding the Endor shield generator bunker, Tempest Force. The scout trooper was given the task of holding his position on the far side of the Endor while stationed there.

Karness Muur was once a respected Knight of the Jedi Order. However, his lust for power caused him to study the nature of the dark side. He became one of the Dark Jedi during the Hundred-Year Darkness, alongside XoXaan and Ajunta Pall.
Jacynith was a female Twi'lek who lived at The Enclave, on Ryloth, in the years prior to and during the Clone Wars.
Fend'Allomin was a Twi'lek female who lived during the time of the Clone Wars and was enslaved for the vast majority of her life.
Lumia'Silbossa was a Twi'lek female who resided on Ryloth before the fall of the Galactic Republic.

Dath was a male Twi'lek child who lived on Ryloth during the era of the Clone Wars. He was born into a life of slavery, but was rescued shortly after his fourth birthday by the exiled Jedi Master Vhiin Thorla.
Tror was a male Twi'lek child who lived on Ryloth during the era of the Clone Wars. Tror, like many Twi'lek children, was sold into slavery by his parents at a young age.
Meeva was a female Twi'lek child who was born on and lived her early years on Ryloth during the years of the Clone Wars.
Kento Marek was a Human male who lived as a Knight of the Jedi Order. Upon the outbreak of the Clone Wars, he fought on the side of the Galactic Republic alongside his fellow Jedi.
Drigor Tarrens was a male Human scientist from a colony in the Kathol Outback, a largely unexplored sector of space within the Kathol sector.
A female Human was the second marriage|wife of Huff Darklighter and the mother of their daughter, Dera Darklighter.

Trann Shoame was the leader of the Qektoth Confederation in 8 ABY. Under Shoame's leadership, the Confederation cut a deal with Moff Kentor Sarne to trade biological weapons for ships and crews, and forged ahead with the development of a deadly biological weapon.

Fasha Dansun was a xenoarchaeologist who spent several years studying the cultures of the Kathol sector before crossing the Marcol Void and heading into the Kathol Outback. She ran into the Qektoth Confederation, and was captured.

Darsin was a male Human who served as the apprentice of the Sith Lord Darth Rivan during the New Sith Wars. He resided in Rivan's Sith fortress on the planet Almas, where his master subjected him to experiments and dark side rituals.
Constanten was a female Tarasin Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Orsk was captain of the Star Destroyer Dauntless. Lira Wessex contacted Orsk during her mission to rendezvous with Doctor Vreen on Cloud City; the Captain was the only person other than her to know of her visit there.
Vansic was a Mustafarian male who worked as a junk dealer. As of 1 ABY he run his own shop, Vansic's Scrap & Trade Market, in the hidden Township of Aurilia on Dathomir.

Thannik was a male Human bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. In the course of his career, he associated with smugglers, other bounty hunters, known Rebels, and other figures on the fringe of galactic society.

affiliation: Office of the Chief of State
x: Darth Caedus, born Jacen Solo, was a Human male who became a Sith Lord and turned against his family and friends, betraying his former principles and leading the Galactic Alliance he once championed into a reign of terror as he attempted to bring order and stability to a fract…

Am Serro was a lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Along with Lens Reekeene, Mikka Reekeene and Santhou Lazith'chika, Serro debriefed Rebel operative Tay Vanis at the modified freighter Home after Vanis had completed his twentieth …
Mosh Pelkan was a male Mephitisian Turf Boss on Questal during the Galactic Civil War.

Loruna Scathe was a member of the Mistryl Shadow Guard, but when she discovered the truth about it, she found it to be morally untenable and left it. She set up a rival mercenary organization, the Azure Cabal, but maintained very high secrecy and made it very hard to join.

Chedgar was a male pilot within the New Republic Starfighter Corps. With his career in jeopardy, Chedgar agreed to try out for the starfighter/commando unit that Commander Wedge Antilles was putting together.

Banna was a male Human pilot and slicer in the New Republic Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War. In 7 ABY, Commander Wedge Antilles began forming a new X-wing squadron that would be as capable in commando missions on the ground as they were in a starfighter.

Voushon was a Rodian smuggler who worked for small-time crime lord Big Bunji. Voushon was said to have more morals than most smugglers, and he took up the job knowing that few people would get hurt. He could speak Basic fluently, albeit with a nasal and squeaky tone.
Rungs was a large Tintinna and a patron at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the planet Tatooine. It was fond of the nightshift bartender Ackmena.
Porgryn was a female Zabrak. When she was young, she longed to become a warrior, but her dreams were shattered when she accidentally inhaled a caustic gas.

Tweego was a formidable but reclusive Rodian hunter who spent his time perfecting his hunting skills in the harsh wastelands of Tatooine. His life changed one day when he was out on safari, as he discovered a crashed speeder and rescued Loruna Scathe from the wreckage.

Propti Xaroon was a female Twi'lek mercenary who lived at the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was one of the leading members of the Azure Cabal, a mercenary organization that operated in many parts of the galaxy.

A ducklike individual was present on Rion in 0 ABY. After the planet was hit by the Galactic Empire with the Ionic Ring Ship, turning it into an ice planet and depriving the locals of food, the feathered being joined a crowd of upset inhabitants demanding to be fed.

Jak Chucka was a male Gungan who lived on Naboo. He had a shifty personality and idolized Boss Rugor Nass, but aspired to become Boss himself one day. He was a member of the Azure Cabal and was one of Broma Lak's local contacts.

Burr El was a male Aqualish. In 1 ABY, he slew several innocent patrons in The Lucky Star in Mos Eisley on Tatooine and as a result became one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild's top ten most wanted fugitives. An unknown bounty hunter tracked him down and killed him.

Ronald Varim was a corrupt Imperial officer. In 1 ABY, he became one of the Bounty Hunter Guild's top ten most-wanted fugitives, for neglecting his duties and spending Imperial funds for personal gain. An unknown bounty hunter tracked him down and killed him.

Delia Visi was a female Human terrorist. In 1 ABY, she was involved in the "Rori Incident" bombing of an Imperial military facility in the Naboo system and as a result became one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild's top 10 most wanted fugitives.

Vatoono was a male Rodian and a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. In 1 ABY, he became one of the guild's top 10 most wanted fugitives, for "accidents" involving the deaths of some of his Guild colleagues, which turned out to be deliberate murders.

Kylaena was a female Twi'lek assassin. In 1 ABY, she became one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild's top ten most-wanted fugitives, for the assassination of Ead Vionor, a major shareholder in Bunkurd Corporation.

Oppio Sliveri was a male Human. In 1 ABY, he became one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild top 10 most wanted fugitives when he stole the entire content of the Imperial Major Romal's summer villa, including an urn containing the ashes of his deceased mother.

Vo'karr Er To was a male Trandoshan. He was a dangerous criminal and, when he escaped from a maximum security Imperial prison in 1 ABY, he became one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild top ten most wanted fugitives. An unknown bounty hunter tracked him down and killed him.

Mei Lai was a female Human Nightsister, who in 1 ABY became one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild's top ten most wanted fugitives for unauthorized use of the Force. An unknown bounty hunter tracked her down and killed her.
Rune was a male Force-sensitive Mon Calamari Jedi who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the final decades before the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Rovessh was a male Trandoshan, who was a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. In 1 ABY, he went to the Bestine cantina on Tatooine to hire a bounty hunter to catch the Guild's ten most wanted criminals, Burr El, Ronald Varim, Delia Visi, Vatoono, Kylaena, Oppio Sliveri, TK-577…
This female individual was the wife of pilot Bors Kenlin who resided on the planet Thyferra.

Grendle was a light-skinned Human merchant who lived on the planet of Tatooine in the city of Mos Espa where he sold fresh dried chokie just outside of the Mos Espa Grand Arena. He was related to a fellow merchant, Anabar, but in what way is unknown.

Anabar was a male Human merchant who lived in the city of Mos Espa on the planet of Tatooine during the blockade of Naboo in 32 BBY. He sold bowls of dweezel and baskets of pallie just outside of the Mos Espa Grand Arena and was an acquaintance of fellow merchant, Grendle.
Jag Murrock was an accomplished spacer and asteroid miner in the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Rel Bentin was a male captain in the Galactic Empire. After Imperial Captain Thrawn failed to comprehend the Kaleesh species' culture by studying their art, he bombarded the Kaleesh planet Oben, destroying the headquarters of the Kaleesh commander, warlord Bentilais san Sk'ar.
Sevik was a male Human, who, along with several other members of his ship's crew, worked to dupe two Weequays into helping them find the treasure of Zelosian's Chine.
Hanugar was an older male Human who, along with several other members of his ship's crew, worked to dupe two Weequays into helping them find the treasure of Zelosian's Chine.

This female Human was the wife of Bordon and mother of Tallo and Wend. She fought for the Army of Light during the Ruusan campaign and was killed in battle by the Brotherhood of Darkness during the Fourth Battle of Ruusan.
This Muun was a contact of Darth Bane's used for face-to-face meetings to set up an extensive information network using funds taken from the Brotherhood of Darkness, especially from Lord Qordis.

A individual was Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic after Tarsus Valorum's two terms ended in 992 BBY. Valorum had made extensive preparations for her to take over his work of bettering the Republic for its people.

This male Dathomirian was the husband of Kirana Ti and father to their daughter. When Kirana went to train at the Jedi Praxeum he and their daughter were left behind but may have later reunited when Kirana returned to Dathomir after the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War.

This female Dathomirian was the daughter of Kirana Ti and her husband. When Kirana went to train at the Jedi Praxeum she stayed behind with her father. It is unknown whether or not if she joined the New Jedi Order.
A Fian Padawan studied with the Jedi Order during its formative years in the centuries following the Force Wars and the abandonment of Tython.
A Nosaurian Padawan studied with the Jedi Order during its formative in the centuries following the Force Wars and the abandonment of Tython.
A Human Padawan studied with the Jedi Order during its formative in the centuries following the Force Wars and the abandonment of Tython.
This Human male was the brother of the fallen Jedi Cope Shykrill. He died three years before the birth of Cope.
Mendor Typhoons was a Matukai, who had two apprentices c.580 BBY. He was approached by Bodo Baas after the Jedi Order's failed attempt to return the Zeison Sha into the Order's fold.

A female Falleen Jedi brought news of the death of Qui-Gon Jinn and the acceptance of Anakin Skywalker into the Jedi Order to Shmi Skywalker. Along with the message, she delivered a Tobal lens, which had been a gift from Qui-Gon.
A Toydarian was interviewed by Darth Vader at Bast Castle on Vjun and showed a great amount of resistance to Vader's Force suggestions up to the point that Vader began to torture the Toydarian.
Belina was a girlfriend of Wedge Antilles when he was growing up. She had spent several nights with Wedge during their days on Tatooine.
Zom Dubrotin was a male Advozse who was head of the powerful Bomminde family and later served as chief administrator of Dozu Lam during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
E.C. "Easy" Nerwal was a TIE pilot in the Imperial Navy who became the commander of the Avenger Squadron, a unit of TIE/ad starfighters.
This Imperial commander was in charge of a group of Imperial slavers on the planet Mandalore around 3 ABY.

This Imperial operative was a spy under the command of Admiral Griggor Tower. He was deployed on the planet Iskalon where he gathered information and reported it back to the Gamandar Citadel on Iskalon's sister planet.
This Imperial Governor was in charge of the planet Kabray. During a diplomatic summit at Kabray Station, the governor held a private meeting with a diplomat from the planet Pursin.

Shirley was a talented singer who was known by her stage name, the "Chanteuse of the Stars." Shirley was particularly known for performing in front of celebrities and politicians, with her hit song I'm Just His Satellite being regarded as elevating the jaunt style of pop music…
This Imperial Officer was in charge of a small contingent of stormtroopers and a Delta-class shuttle during the Galactic Civil War in 3 ABY.
This Mandalorian was enslaved in the City of Bone on the planet Mandalore. During a lunch break, this slave began to complain about the poor quality of the food being served.

This doorman was employed at Kabray Station, where he announced incoming delegates that frequented the high class space station. He had two stormtroopers at his disposal, and they assisted him in keeping out uninvited guests.

This cook was the head chef at the luxurious Kabray Station. A heavy-set individual, he was very protective of his kitchen, and when Rebel agent, Leia Organa entered the cooking area of the space station searching for a message left by a fellow Rebel, Tay Vanis, the cook immed…

Mart Stevez was a member of the Atrisian Royal Corps and later the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The Imperials killed his whole family while he was on a training mission. They claimed that his father had become politically unstable and needed to be removed.

Vu Nin was a Rebel trooper native to Alderaan, but she was off the planet when it was destroyed by the first Death Star. When she heard about the destruction of her homeworld, she applied for a position in the Special Forces team.

Whumparrin was a male Wookiee who was rescued from an Imperial slave camp by an Alliance Special Forces unit. After that, he decided to join the Alliance Military. His first assignments were fire-support.
Parton was a Human female who served as a yeoman with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
This sergeant was a Human male and a member of the Rebel Alliance stationed at Haven Base on Arbra.

Tripp Rar was a female Rodian and wealthy hunter during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was one of four hunters who resided in Etyyy and established big-game hunting safaris within the Rodian Hunting Grounds on Kashyyyk.

Grelk Micabra was a male Advozse from the volcanic planet of Riflor. He was a skilled swoop racer during the waning years of the New Order, and could often be seen participating in swoop competitions in the Corellian sector.

Cornelius Wagglehorn was a male Human and a professor at Corellia University. In 1 ABY, he was present in Tyrena on Corellia, from where he hired a spacer through his assistant to find out what had happened at the Corellia University research outpost on Talus, with which he ha…
Ku-Kak was a Force-sensitive male wampa and the bodyguard of the Chevin slaver Phylus Mon.

Mischa Vorfren was an Anzat male Force-sensitive mercenary, dark side adept and an unwilling slave to Phylus Mon. Like all of Phylus Mon's slaves, Vorfren had an injected explosive that would kill him should Phylus Mon die for any reason.
Luthus Ferlani was the criminal leader of the Ferlani family on the planet Esseles, during the waning years of the Old Republic and on into the New Order.
Zannen was the Imperial Governor of Peekoine. He resided in Landslasher-4.
Yuma Zannen was the daughter of Imperial Governor Zannen. She resided in Landslasher-4, on Peekoine.
Gamusha was the leader of the swoop gang, The Gutterwipes. He was good friends with Yuma Zannen.
Baajik was a Chadra-Fan male who served as a double agent to both the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Hutts. In 3 ABY he was killed on Ord Mantell by bounty hunter Cypher Bos.

Tura Omega was a female Human who was the wife of Xanatos and the mother of Granta Omega. When her son was three years old, she flew with him to Nierport VII, where she worked at the gas station for years on the moon.
Luke Starkiller was a human Jedi who wielded a yellow lightsaber.
Saujutta-Ok-Topii was a Pan-preneur businesswoman who was a marketing lieutenant for Trigdale Metallurgy, leading their marketing division during the height of the Galactic Empire.
A red-haired woman was a prostitute on the planet Arcan IV during the height of the Galactic Empire.
This Near-Duros criminal was a member of Lemo and Sanda's gang.
This Tusked criminal was a member of Lemo and Sanda's gang on the planet Arcan IV. He was present in the gang's base during the gang's encounter with "Captain Drebble," Lando Calrissian in disguise.

This skull-faced pirate was a member of Lemo and Sanda's gang on the planet of Arcan IV. He was present in the gang's base during the arrival of Lando Calrissian, under the guise of "Captain Barpotomous Drebble." The pirate backed up his bosses, Lemo and Sanda as they confront…

Gibb was a port mechanic in the city of Lesvol on Prishardia where he tried to repair the hyperdrive of the Star Lady. When Ghitsa Dogder, Fenig Nabon and Kyp Durron came under fire from the Rook, Gibb came to the rescue in the repaired Star Lady.
Ral was a Human Hutt counselor who worked for the Desilijic kajidic. In 12 ABY, Ral had Ghitsa Dogder kidnapped and interrogated to learn about Durga Besadii Tai's investments in Orko Skymine.
Culan Brasli was a Human male who served as an enforcer for the Desilijic kajidic and knew how to maximize pain while minimizing long-term damage to those he interrogated.
Yarrku was a male Barabel from whom Nyo tried to buy passage from to Nar Shaddaa aboard his ship, the Night Raider before Kinnin Vo-Shay offered to take him for a cheaper price.
Rotha Tol'min was a Human hoping to establish himself as a crime lord on Socorro sometime between 130 ABY and 137 ABY. Cade Skywalker, Deliah Blue, and Jariah Syn were contracted to take him out.
An Ithorian bartender was the owner of the Mos Espa Podracer Cantina. He served drinks to whoever came by, especially a lone Jawa.
Jasha was a male Human officer of the Galactic Empire who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
This Imperial Officer was in charge of Dead Castle on Dennaskar around 3 ABY.

Andrid was a male Human who served as a General in the Galactic Empire, reporting directly to Darth Vader. Andrid was stationed in the Belderone sector and was part of an effort to stop rising Rebel support on the planet Kulthis.
Maldrod was a Human male Colonel in the Imperial Military during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Darth Vader's boot polisher was a young man who aided Darth Vader in the Belderone sector. During a briefing with several of the officers that ruled over the sector, this man hovered around Vader's boots, attempting to polish them, even as the Dark Lord gestured wildly to his …
Garrick was a Human male who worked as the chief traffic controller at Tatooine's Mos Eisley spaceport during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Remulus Dreypa was a male Baron and Jedi Admiral who fell to the dark side during the Hundred-Year Darkness.

Allying with the Mon Calamari Rangers, Sinde assisted them by advising them on military tactics and strategies, and helping them defend the Mon Calamari refugees who had taken refuge on the planet's ocean floor.

Sola Hus was a Human male officer of the Corellian Security Force who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Sergeant Hus was investigating some thefts committed by the Braggan's Fist thugs.

Wilfred Quelsh was a male Human from Corellia who was a highly decorated law enforcement officer of the CorSec until it was discovered that he had framed and murdered a fellow officer at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kal Braggan was a male member of CorSec, later turned criminal, who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War
Homack was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. While fighting as an X-wing pilot, Homack saw action over Atrivis but was shot down and pursued by Imperial storm commandos planetside.

Sarna was the Queen of Drogheda during the height of the Galactic Empire. During her younger life, she had been romantically linked with Lando Calrissian. However, Calrissian had primarily pursued her intending to marry her for her money.
Sarna's father was the father of Sarna and Danu on the planet Drogheda. He was the head of the Drogheda Mining Company, and he had set up his eldest daughter, Sarna to take over the company.

Harlech was a Human male who served as Commander of the Drogheda Royal Guard on the planet Drogheda. He was the personal shield and closest confidant of Queen Sarna, and led her forces against a popular revolutionary force that aimed at replacing the monarchy with a democratic…

Ladra was a Human female servant of the monarchy on the planet Drogheda in 4 ABY. An aide to Queen Sarna, she showed smuggler Lando Calrissian to his quarters when the man came to stay in the Drogheda Citadel during the Drogheda Civil War.
Lugus was a Human male who served as part of a popular revolutionary movement that aimed at replacing Drogheda's monarchy with a democratic government after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

Dar was a member of the Drogheda Revolutionaries during the civil war on the planet Drogheda. He was stationed in the Mount Meru Mine, but was swept out of the base when Lando Calrissian destroyed several water tanks in the mine with a thermal detonator, flooding the mine.
Bellarius Drade was a male Dark Side Adept assigned to protect and monitor the Imperial Precipitator Minas-Coth Cray.

Yar led a party of bounty hunters to Almas after the destruction of Almas Academy, in an effort to capture any Jedi survivors. In the attempt, they encountered a group of salvagers called the Stalfonauts, and the ensuing fight left both parties all dead.

Teracca Torrh was a female Pathfinder who served as a member of the Alliance Special Forces during the Galactic Civil War. A skilled marksman and demolitions expert, she also commanded Outpost Cinder.
Krussk was a male Trandoshan mercenary who tried to stop Kyle Katarn during his battle against the Empire Reborn on Bespin.

Jaxxon's mother was a female Lepi from the planet Coachelle Prime. She was the mother of thirteen children, among them, the infamous smuggler Jaxxon. She attempted to instill a sense of family values in her young son, but he remained too rambunctious for her to control.
Tyro Gehu was an uncle of Vook Gehu. He was killed in the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Xeshen Kra was a Vratix involved with the production of bacta during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Shortly after the Battle of Yag'Dhul, he helped expose a Yuuzhan Vong infiltrator on Thyferra.
Bodé Leobund XI was the High Lord of Tapani House Mecetti during the Galactic Civil War. Sir Tazur Pheron was Lord Leobund's grand-nephew.

Eve Yarrow was the daughter of Evin Yarrow, the head of Yarrow Industries. She was from Sood, the capital of the planet Acherin. Her mother died when she was a young girl, so she was raised by her father.
Kei Loo Bross was a Jedi Master probably living during the New Sith Wars.
Milak Sonloam was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the time of the Clone Wars.
K'kur was a male Twi'lek Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Tresten Agai'i was a female Human Jedi Knight living during the times of the Clone Wars. A student of the Almas Academy, she received an education that varied from that taught at the academy on Coruscant.
Vorlocca was a male Wookiee Jedi Knight who, during the Clone Wars, was based on the planet Almas, where they helped guard the Almas Sith fortress.
Valiri was a male Skrilling Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Janiah was a young Twi'lek Padawan at the Almas Academy.

Treibeiu was a Human female Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. Treibeiu was stationed at the Almas Academy, a Jedi academy located on the planet Almas, and, around 20 BBY, in the aftermath of an incursion made by the Chevin enslaver Phylus Mon into a …
Kobbu was a green-gray male Toydarian with warts and a pathological liar.

Along with fellow Cragmoloid Noba, Ook was kidnapped in Cragmoloid native world Ankus, and both of them soon ended in the slave "zoo" of slaver Phylus Mon (who could have kidnapped them in the first place).

Along with fellow Cragmoloid Ook, Noba was kidnapped in Cragmoloid native world Ankus, and both of them soon ended in the slave "zoo" of slaver Phylus Mon (who could have kidnapped them in the first place).
Bin Kohal, sometimes known by the alias Halin Bok, was a Shistavanen male assassin and slave.
K'Mi was a Kushiban male slave. When accused of being called cute, he would respond with "Cute? I'm not cute. I'm dark and dangerous."
Kor Essen was a male Nagai scout and slave of Phylus Mon.
Vor Essen was a male Nagai scout and slave of Phylus Mon.
Honna was a Tarasin female Force-sensitive slave.
Tiscak was a Tarasin Force-sensitive slave.
Li'Iri was a Tarasin Force-sensitive slave.

Bish was a Quarren male pilot and slave. He bragged of his piloting skills. In around 20 BBY, Bish was captured by slaver Phylus Mon and kept in a cell in Mon's slave zoo aboard the Animiasma. Phylus Mon surgically inserted an explosive near the heart of each of his slaves.
Zeth Bresque was a Balosar female slave. She was also an addict to death sticks.
Alianda was a round-headed Human female slave.
Niv was a Force-sensitive male Chev slave.
Drik was a Force-sensitive Chev male slave.
Tosh was a Force-sensitive male Chev slave.
Ke Len was a female Blood Carver bounty hunter and slave.

Ptor was a tall, muscled man who looked after Trever Flume during his early days living on the streets of Bellassa. During the Imperial occupation of the planet, Ptor and other displaced citizens lived in a makeshift city inside an abandoned warehouse near the Moonstone District.
Kaarror was a pale-furred Wookiee male slave, criminal, and bounty hunter.
Gorak was a Trandoshan female mercenary and slave.
Yerj was a black-scaled Barabel male Force-sensitive bounty hunter and slave.
Nalz, also known as Spiky-boy, was a male Spiner bounty hunter and slave.
Miza was a Chiss who was part of the squadron that supported Jagged Fel's mission to the New Republic, shortly before the Battle of Yuuzhan'tar.

Bathos was the High Lady of Tapani House Cadriaan around during the Galactic Civil War. She was born into one of the lesser noble families of House Cadriaan, but rose in society through a series of shrewd marriages.

Raik Muun was a Force-sensitive female Human half-breed who became a Dark Jedi during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Muun joined the Jedi Order and studied at the Almas Academy, a Jedi school that was located on the planet Almas in the Cularin system.

"Father" was an elderly, obese Rodian who worked as a curator for the Obohn Gallery of the Industrial Aesthetic. He made use of a hoverchair to move around and worked alongside the Muun Dremullar Obohn di Garthos.
Pychor was a Human male who as captain aboard the Devastator during the Galactic Civil War.

Dillwit was a Human male Sergeant who had been stationed on the Death Star during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, Dillwit recently engaged to which he celebrated with his friends, along with Nova Stihl.
Bretton was a Human male who served as a member of the stormtrooper squad led by Sergeant Nova Stihl to respond to the prisoner breakout at Detention Block AA-23 on Level 5 of the first Death Star.
Esture was a a male Human Lieutenant who was stationed on the Death Star.
Rawst was an Imperial TIE/LN starfighter pilot and the wingmate of Ranulf Trommer. He was killed on Aguarl 3 by Rebel Alliance forces.
Spaeth was the captain of an Imperial dreadnaught that was transporting Ranulf Trommer to M'haeli. Spaeth thanked Trommer for defending the ship from a Rebel attack.

Selth was part of a group of bounty hunters hired by Governor Grigor on M'haeli to capture the rebel Mora. When the group's leader, Glott, incapacitated her and was subsequently attacked by Ranulf Trommer, he handed his captive off to Selth, who delivered her to Grigor.

R'han was a H'drachi Rebel on M'haeli and son of Lord Ph'dan. He was presumed dead after an Imperial attack in 0 ABY, but was in truth captured and put to work in Governor Grigor's dragite crystal mine.
Armen Arandis was a male Human who served as a Lieutenant and Imperial tactical officer stationed on the Star Destroyer Assiduous.

Szygar was a Devaronian male competitor in the Cloud City Sabacc Tournament on the planet Bespin in about 17 BBY. He was eliminated in the third day of competition and accused Armen Arandis of cheating.
Creeska was a male Rodian competitor who attended the Cloud City Sabacc Tournament on the planet Bespin in about 17 BBY. In the tournament, he was cheating with a skifter.

Captain Koroma Moro was a Twi'lek male who hauled cargo under the employ of Switch. Switch funded Moro's entry into the Cloud City Sabacc Tournament on the planet Bespin in about 17 BBY, in an effort to grab a share of the winnings.
Silas Draver was a competitor in the Cloud City Sabacc Tournament on the planet Bespin in about 17 BBY.
Vorn Zaday was a minor female Neimoidian dignitary in the Trade Federation, stationed aboard a Separatist starship during the Clone Wars.
Geffen was the first officer onboard the Imperial Navy Torpedo Sphere stationed near Tallaan, in the Tapani sector, during the Galactic Civil War. His commanding officer was Captain Edric Darius.
Edric Darius was the Captain of an Imperial Navy Torpedo Sphere stationed near Tallaan, in the Tapani sector, during the Galactic Civil War. His first officer was Geffen.
Raik was the female Utai proprietor of the gambling den Raik's Parlor in the Coruscant Underworld during the High Republic Era.
Seth was a Human male Imperial pilot who was stationed on the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Ravagor during an attack on Aguarl 3 in 0 ABY.
Pake was an X-wing pilot in the Rebellion in 0 ABY. During an attack on an Imperial dreadnaught near M'haeli, three Rebel pilots were killed by Ranulf Trommer, including Pake.

Jonton was a X-wing pilot who served in the Rebellion against the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. During an attack on an Imperial dreadnaught near M'haeli in 0 ABY, Jonton, along with three Rebel pilots were killed by Ranulf Trommer.
Spenter was an X-wing pilot in the Rebellion in 0 ABY. During an attack on an Imperial dreadnaught near M'haeli, three Rebel pilots were killed by Ranulf Trommer, including Spenter.
Aeradin was a male professor of system geography and assistant dean at the Leadership School on Andara. He hosted the General Information Contest in the Great Hall of Learning.
Win Totem was a professor of geopolitics at the Leadership School on Andara. Described as having a regal bearing, she was tall, had blue skin and often wore a white septsilk gown.

Sirrik Olyeg was a Chagrian female fisherperson, captain of a trawler for Bartyn Gourmet Delicacies in Lamaredd and later, when working conditions became unbearable, the first syndical leader in the planet, founder of the Sailor's Union.

Callen Troyt was a member of the Dagger Squadron. He was the gold Dagger and an experienced B-wing starfighter pilot. He and the Daggers were going to be ordered by Admiral Ackbar to go to Ansion, but the order was never given.
Vin Nothos was a member of Dagger Squadron and participated in the squadron's assault on Bannistar Station.
Constanten was a female Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Bouyardy was a Human male who served as the chief systems engineer on the Aurorient Express.

Waverton was a Human male chief purser on the Aurorient Express. He was in league with a band of pressure pirates. In return for forcing an evacuation of the ship, he would receive a cut of the salvage recovered by the pirates.
Torgo Tahn was a male Anzat who trained Aurra Sing.

Anis was a male Anzati who, prior to 36 BBY, had become a clan leader amongst his species. Whilst in this position he was indebted to the criminal Wallanooga the Hutt and agreed to train Aurra Sing, the Near-Human slave the Hutt had purchased, as an assassin.
Puloh was a male Anzati and part of a group that learned the assassins' arts from Torgo Tahn. He was killed by Tahn during a training session sometime before 36 BBY.

Chandra Conrad was a female Zabrak individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She had information about the Black Sun crime syndicate, and came forward sometime after 0 BBY as part of an investigation by Corran Horn of the Corellian Security Force.
Obrio Caldori was male Bothan who became involved with the Black Sun crime syndicate, rising to a position as a mid-level administrator during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Voydd Blancken was a Rodian male who served the Black Sun criminal syndicate's presence on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Kestrel was a male Imperial cadet that attended the Coruscant Naval Academy. He and Flinn were assigned by Maggis to monitor the newly arrived Lune Oddo Divinian.

Disk Moosea was a member of the Torgaigne crime syndicate. Moosea was acquainted with Corellian smuggler Han Solo during the era of the Galactic Civil War, who regarded Moosea as relatively non-threatening.
Leelu was a male Humanoid member of the Torgaigne crime syndicate, active on the planet Attahox during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Vor Childermoss was a Human leader of the Torgaigne crime syndicate, based off of the planet Attahox during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Madame Kanta was a female Morse Rebel contact on the planet of Karlatt.
Suzal was a Human male member of the Five, a reclusive evil-worshipping cult that lived within the region of space known as the Hellhoop.
Koobaree was a Human female member of the Five, a reclusive evil-worshipping cult that lived within a remote section of space known as the Hellhoop.
Mavin was a Human male member of the Five, a reclusive evil-worshipping cult that lived within the mysterious region of space known as the Hellhoop.
Chell was a Human male member of the Five, a small evil-worshipping cult that lived within the remote section of space known as the Hellhoop.
Chokla was a Human female member of the Five, a small evil-worshipping cult that lived within the remote section of space known as the Hellhoop.
Bura Veujarij was a doctor who served as a member of the Imperial Institute of Military Medicine, studying the aging of Clone troopers as part of Imperial Medical Review 1675.

Skeeto Rawk was a Human male and a Force-sensitive who was the adopted son of Droo Rawk and Nat Skywalker, then going by the alias "Bantha" Rawk. Skeeto had an older sister, Ahnah Rawk, and a brother, Micah.

Droo Rawk was a female Kiffar of Clan Vos who was once part of the Kiffu Guardians. She was the mother of Ahnah, and had a husband Nat Skywalker, who was going by the alias of "Bantha" Rawk. She proceeded to adopt Skeeto and Micah with him.

Ahnah Rawk was a Kiffar female living around the time of the Sith–Imperial War. She was the daughter of Droo, the stepdaughter of Nat Skywalker, and the stepsister of Skeeto and Micah. She was born 119 ABY. She served as a Kiffu Guardian.

Taryn Zel was an officer in Hapan Security in 41 ABY, the daughter of a half-brother of Isolder, making her the first cousin of Tenel Ka Djo, the Queen Mother. She was the identical twin of Trista Zel, and the two were very valuable officers to Tenel Ka.

Trista Zel was an officer in Hapan Security in 41 ABY. Trista was five minutes older than her identical twin sister Taryn Zel and the first cousin of Queen Mother Tenel Ka Djo. She and her sister were almost identical in appearance to their cousin, Tenel Ka.

Jowar was one of the Moffs who helped develop the nanovirus at the end of the Second Galactic Civil War. During the First Galactic Civil War, Jowar served on Palpatine's personal staff as a young officer in the Imperial Navy.

Bodo Linx was a Nuxan male who worked as an informant. The Galactic Empire killed his family, setting him against them. He met with Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, Han Solo and Sana Starros on Barnahof, giving Organa the details for a contact of his on Brentaal IV.
Beata Reesh was a Rodian actor who starred in "The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma."
Vosdia Nooma was the main character in the Rodian play The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma. The role was played by Chooru Delb shortly before the Clone Wars.
Sef Falken was a Tapani sector Lord from House Melantha and a boyhood friend of the Bal Jaset. He became one of the High Lords most trusted advisors.
Balmai Wyngarde was a Baroness of House Melantha that governed the Melantha Province of the Tapani sector.
Nesha was a female Rodian who, along with her friends Besha and Kesha, worked with the Wookiee Nerrowr.
Kesha was a female Rodian who, along with her friends Nesha and Besha, worked with the Wookiee Nerrowr.
Falsswon, or False One, was a blue-skinned humanoid who lived in the city of Tolea Biqua on Cularin. He was once interviewed by Melanda Forswoth for Eye on Cularin.
A Nimbanel had a bounty placed on its head by the Black Sun criminal syndicate by the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Melanda Forswoth was a reporter for Eye on Cularin, after leaving the field of meteorology. While replacing Yara Grugara, she ran a series on the Caarite and their home of Caarimon.
This Jedi Master was one of the first members of Luke Skywalker's New Jedi Order.
Vuras was a Jedi of the Jedi Order. At some point by 33 BBY, Vuras adopted his enemy's tactics to exact revenge against them. However, Vuras' efforts in defeating his foes destroyed him.

Crant was a nighthunter. He lived on Parein II 4 and attacked the injured Jedi Knight, Valin Draco. They almost killed each other in the resulting fight and Crant bit off Draco's thumb and clamped his jaws around his neck.
Bojam Rees was a tattoo artist who had a shop on Starstation 12.
Torba was a member of the Commerce Commission. He was killed when his ship exploded in hyperspace due to a faulty hyperdrive.
Fulmrick was a hired hand who worked as a pilot for Jace Forno. He traveled with Forno to Indobok on a mission to retrieve rare crystals.
Red Rishyk was a captain in the Imperial Military and head of security on Bannistar Station.
Bardo was a Human male who worked aboard Olag Greck's droid barge. He was in charge of transporting IG-88B to Hosk Station.
Nallen was a servant of the Panteer brothers, Raal and Heeth, of Alderaan. In 0 ABY, he was working on the Panteer estate in the Ryloth system, and thus survived the destruction of Alderaan.

Eida Sharden was a Human female from the planet Exocron. A wealthy entrepreneur and businesswoman, she was also a spy for the Corsairs from the western canyons, and heavily opposed to the rule of the Devisors.

Pagda Gevtes was a Human male from the planet Exocron. He was a Master Devisor and the adjunct to the Ruling Council. He used his position to manipulate and control the council to do the Devisors bidding.
Chaz was one of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's most notorious smugglers. The original owner of the moody protocol droid R-3PO, Chaz "accidentally" left the droid at the Rebellion's Echo Base.

Azlyn Rae was a Human female who, throughout her life, was trained in the ways of the Force by both the Jedi Order and the Imperial Knights. During her childhood, she was apprenticed to the Jedi Master Rasi Tuum while training to be a Jedi on Ossus.
Second-in-command to the Beast-Lord Oron Kira, Gobee was a Human male citizen from the Inner Rim world of Onderon.
Zovaren was a male Snivvian poet during the time of the Galactic Republic. He and his people were freed from Thalassian slavers.

A mercenary pilot served the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure in 4 ABY. In that year, he traveled to the Great Pit of Carkoon on the planet Tatooine to guard the execution of the Jedi Luke Skywalker. During the execution, Skywalker fought back and killed the pilot.
Lysko Buelia was the commissioner of Nuna-Ball League and a former holomag mogul.

Shia Letap was a female Human Jedi Initiate. While hiding from the clone troopers of the 501st Legion attacking the Jedi Temple, Letap was killed along with Sors Bandeam, Jeswi Ele, and several other younglings by Darth Vader as part of Operation: Knightfall in 19 BBY.
A Weequay male guard was employed by Jabba the Hutt. He was a guard on the Khetanna during the Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon in 4 ABY.

A male Weequay was employed by Jabba the Hutt. He was a guard on the first skiff during the Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon in 4 ABY, where he was killed by Luke Skywalker when the Jedi jumped back on the skiff.
Angela was a Human female who lived on the planet of Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Renneyn was a Clawdite from Zolan in the Zolan system. In 2 BBY, Renneyn discovered that he had developed Zithrom's Disease, which was a kidney disorder that usually affected elderly Human males.
This Jedi was a member of Luke Skywalker's New Jedi Order one year after the Jedi Academy on Yavin 4 was founded.
Korraj was a battle-scarred t'landa Til bull. He was the leader of a pirate group on Thonner.
A Mandalorian prisoner was captured by the Sith during the Jedi Civil War.
Saqc'or was a Svivreni male metallurgist and miner. He worked for many years on the planet Ovise III before retiring with his fortune on Thonner.
Voryam Bhao was a young male who served as a member of the Moff Council during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Meex was a Human male who was a Rebel Elite Commando. He accompanied Leia, Chewbacca, Han Solo, and Luke Skywalker to Kiva on a mission to stop Project Starscream.

"CeeCee" was a Human female who served as a captain with the Galactic Alliance Guard. She was stationed aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Anakin Solo as of 41 ABY, during the last days of the Second Galactic Civil War.
Rarta Dal was the owner of the Three Moons, a hotel in Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine. She hired Kitster Chanchani Banai as a steward.

Jodd Zarfane was a retired officer of the Imperial Remnant. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, a senator from the New Republic dispatched a team to convince him to aid them in their fight against the Yuuzhan Vong. However, the man they met with was not Jodd Zarfane.
An Unidentified Jawa was present at the Mos Espa Podracer Cantina during 36 BBY to 32 BBY.

affiliation: Independent settlement on the planet Belgaroth
x: Belgar Overlord was a self-appointed explorer who, together with his partner, Roth Skimm, discovered the rundown planet Belgaroth in the Core Worlds six hundred years before the rise of the Galactic Empire.

affiliation: Independent settlement on the planet Belgaroth
x: Roth Skimm was a self-appointed explorer who, together with his partner, Belgar Overlord, discovered the rundown planet Belgaroth in the Core Worlds six hundred years before the rise of the Galactic Empire.
Oorn Noth was a Zabrak noble and renowned pilot.
Donloor Noth was a Zabrak noble and the father of Oorn Noth.
Gurlok was a Human Imperial Navy captain who followed Cade Skywalker and his crew to the planet Iego in 137 ABY.
Cecil Vane was a male Human who operated The Credit Chip casino on Sel Zonn Station during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Byra Fenn was a Human female doctor who served the Delgas Medical Supplies on Sel Zonn Station. She was a known associate of the droid information broker known as Switch.
Vcikas was a Mon Calamari who was imprisoned by the Ayrou. When he escaped and was nearly killed by a Zoun mauler he claimed to have seen the Tessent on Thonner.
Livette was a stern-jawed Hapan who did not bother with the usual Hapan vanities. She made a principle of leaving her gray hair and an old blaster wound burn across her cheek unaltered.

Kjazhed-Uhl was a Human male stormtrooper stationed under Darth Vader in the Galactic Empire. Sometime between 0 ABY 3 ABY, Kjazhed-Uhl encountered his fellow stormtrooper Bob during a lunch break, where Bob revealed he had stolen the diary of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

Arviz Linden was a male who ran a hyperbaride plant on Marca by Dynamic Synergetics, Inc. Linden used the droid M-3PO-C as his secretary. Linden kept the plant's production at a minimum to protect the native Sekct, and M-3PO-C admired him for that.
Carn'ar was an Aqualish female bounty hunter who plied her trade during the Galactic Civil War.

Garim Ayrvn was a Human male who had served as the warden of an Imperial prison facility until an assault team from the Alliance to Restore the Republic raided the complex, freeing all of the prisoners.

Qual'om Soach was a Twi'lek crime lord in the Brak sector of the Expansion Region. Soach owned the modified Action V transport Invisible Star, which served as his home as well as his base of operations for both legal and illegal runs.

Dixon Dadeferron was the owner of the Kail Ranges and a critic of the Corporate Sector Authority. He was the father of two sons, Trevim and Torm, the former of whom would inherit the Ranges in the event of Dixon's death.
Haras Jundop was a male officer in the military of the Rebel Alliance. Jundop served as Ground Marshal of army soldiers in Alliance Special Forces.

Mooren was also a member of the Danoor Resistance, and opposed Minister Waric Nane's plans to enact a totalitarian regime across the planet. Aware that Nane had met with a representative from the Galactic Empire, he feared that he had struck a bargain to crush the Resistance.
Ure'monbarak, a Shipmaster, owned or worked at the Starlight Yards on Dac. "Bantha" Rawk created drives for him before Darth Krayt shut down all of the Mon Calamari Shipyards.
Belyssa Romey was a Human who served as an officer for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire from 2 BBY to 4 ABY.

Tili Qua was a female Chadra-Fan Jedi Master and member of the Jedi High Council at the Hidden Temple, following the destruction of half of the Jedi Order at the hands of the One Sith order and the Fel Empire.
Tobias Sun was a Human Jedi Master at the Hidden Temple who kept Deliah Blue and Jariah Syn company while Cade Skywalker and Shado Vao met with the Jedi Council.
Mai was a Zabrak Jedi Master who served the New Jedi Order during the Second Imperial Civil War. Surviving the Jedi Purge, Mai traveled to the Hidden Jedi Temple and lived around 130 ABY.
Borjak was a Feeorin warrior from the planet Odryn who in 3963 BBY ascended to the revered position of Exalted among his people.
Vanb was a male Sullustan bartender working at a cantina in the Wroona starport during the reign of the Empire.
Gusepp was an ancient Trandoshan tyrant known for being defeated by Iunist, an ancient Jedi, getting his arm severed. Gusepp's arm was preserved and was prized in the Imperial era.
Pilot was a bounty hunter who died in 39 BBY.
Helina Dow was a Genian female who served as a Separatist spy hired by Passel Argente during the Clone Wars. She was also Talesan Fry's Executive in charge of production and distribution.

Harwakokok the Mighty was a Wookiee male and a member of the Wookiee resistance on Kashyyyk. He was killed during a three-way battle aboard the Avatar Orbital Platform between the resistance, the Blackscale slavers, and a team of spacers sent by a rival Trandoshan slaver group…

Ekam Ouwray was the second Imperial Governor of the Outer Rim Territories planet Indu San. He was a New Order fanatic, which resulted in a rebellion of the planet's populace. Ouwray fled the planet, which was liberated by the New Republic. Kaleb Darme was his bodyguard.

Beryl was a male Human scout of the Galactic Republic on the planet Voss during the Galactic War. Stationed at the Kri-Ta Outpost in the Pelath-Ri Marches, he discovered a Gormak plan to use artillery to target the Shrine of Healing and asked a Republic hero to put a stop to it.
Minos was a male Yuuzhan Vong warrior who served under commander Sha'kel. After the Battle of Artorias in 25 ABY he was stationed on the slaveship Tsam P'ah in orbit of the planet.
Roegr was a male Mandalorian who fought at Nickel One alongside Jaina Solo, Mirta Gev and Vatok Tawr. He held a great dislike—if not hatred—for the Jedi.
Vatok Tawr was a Human male Mandalorian. During Jaina Solo's training under Boba Fett, Tawr would spar against her on several occasions, and eventually grew fond of her.
Moburi was a male Mandalorian who fought in the Battle of Roche.

Worlohp was the Ithorian captain of the Short Range Transit Shuttle SST-67 Fair Gale. Circa 32 BBY, he was contracted through Republic Sienar Systems to serve the Royal House of Naboo by ferrying passengers within the Naboo system.

Derek was a senior Jedi apprentice during the Second Galactic Civil War in 40 ABY. During the Battle of Uroro Station against Darth Caedus, he served alongside Jagged Fel as a gunner on the Millennium Falcon.
Requud was a Ducha in the Hapes Consortium. Like other known holders of this title, she was female.
Dex was a male Human who served as an officer in the Galactic Alliance Guard during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Rezer was a male Human Moff and member of the Moff Council and was on the Anakin Solo during the Battle of Uroro Station.
Berit was a commander aboard the Anakin Solo, he was assigned to the Dark Deck. Communication with him was lost after the Jedi's StealthX attack during the Battle of Uroro Station.

Garsi was a male Human guard of the Galactic Justice Center and a guard in the Galactic Alliance Guard. Along with Wyrlan, Garsi guarded Ben Skywalker as Tahiri Veila tortured Lon Shevu to death in front of them.

Wyrlan was an officer in the Galactic Alliance Guard who was with Ben Skywalker when he had made his first kill during a raid on suspected Corellian terrorists. He would later guard Ben along with Garsi as Tahiri Veila tortured former GAG officer Lon Shevu to death.
Kosimo Westermal was a male Human Moff and member of the Moff Council who was on Nickel One when Darth Caedus approached the Moff Council about an alliance with the Galactic Alliance.

Krom Rethway was a flabby-necked Moff and member of the Moff Council. When Darth Caedus approached the Moff Council on Nickel One, he was one of many who wanted nothing to do with Caedus or the Galactic Alliance.
Sangi was a female Human Ensign and technician in the Imperial Navy who was knocked unconscious by Jaina Solo during the Second Battle of Roche, after she pulled out her blaster.
Qade was a police officer on the Galactic Alliance capital planet Coruscant during the Second Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Alliance and the Confederation.

Jat'ho was an Arconan male who lived on the planet Coruscant during the Second Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and the Confederation. He served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force along with his partner, Tobyl.

Tobyl was a Human male living on the planet Coruscant during the Second Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and the Confederation. He served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force along with his partner, Jat'ho.
This unidentified majordomo, a male Twi'lek with mottled blue-green skin, served an unknown Nar Shaddaa-based member of the Exchange.
This unidentified bartender was a Devaronian male living on Nar Shaddaa in 3951 BBY.
Lulu was a Gungan female who worked as a dancer in the repair asteroid station Darkside. She moved her ears front and back while talking.
Kar'sylic was a Kintan strider kept by the Nikto smuggler Tu'rsc'yulir.

Arrud Barsoomu was a male Twi'lek criminal who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Barsoomu was a member of Jabba the Hutt criminal organization and served as the crime lord's right hand enforcer in Mos Eisley.
Kilth Saanu was a female Zabrak criminal who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. She was the leader of the gang of swoopers known as the Desert Banshees.
Kavas Urdano was a female Chiss criminal who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Duska Murgo was a female Chadra-Fan assassin who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She really appreciated IG-series assassin droids and owned at least one of those droids.

Idu Taanfaar was a male farmer from the the planet Kwevron, who served the Rebel Alliance as a contact during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 ABY, he was discovered and killed by stormtroopers under the command of Falto Dragen.

Mist was a Human female bounty hunter operating during the early years of the New Republic. Born Shella Inion on the planet Kal'Shebbol, she was a minor actress who disappeared from public view after the death of her family and her own partial disfigurement following a suspect…

Samala Loené was a female pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the lead-up to the Galactic Civil War. Assigned the callsign of Red Leader, she was the leader of Red Flight, a group of T-65B X-wing starfighters.

Rane was a Force-sensitive human witch within the coven of Mother Aniseya in a fortress on the planet Brendok. Serving as an ensign and an advisor, Rane attended the Rite of Ascension for Aniseya's twin daughters, Verosha and Mae-ho in 148 BBY.

Ead Vinor was a major shareholder in Bunkurd Corporation. He was assassinated by the Twi'lek Kylaena, something that caused her to become one of the Bounty Hunters' Guild's top ten most wanted criminals.

Petty Officer Colton served onboard the CR90 corvette FarStar during the hunt for Moff Kentor Sarne. He was one of the few regular navy men assigned to the ship, and was often on duty in the ship's cee-cee.

Sena Pakkallo was a medical doctor who served the Galactic Empire during and prior to the Galactic Civil War. During the course of her career, she was posted to a number of undesirable planets and she grew disillusioned by the requirements of her profession.

Herk Bloomi was the manager of new accounts at Bank Niro Eleven during the beginning of the Imperial reign. In 18 BBY, he was visited by Clive Flax and Astri Oddo, who were looking for information about Eve Yarrow.
Djinn Kylo was a male Force Adept who lived on Ord Mynock.
Croym was an extremely powerful male Dark Jedi who was in possession of the Heart of the Universe during the Galactic Civil War.

Moro Y'Arano was a male Genian who was Talesan Fry's Executive in charge of business outreach at Fry Industries. At the time of the Clone Wars, Y'Arano was completely sealed off from the outside world in 20 BBY.
Dellard Tranc was a male Genian who served as Talesan Fry's head of Security at Frys business complex.
Minas-Coth Cray was an Imperial Precipitator that Dark Side Adept Bellarius Drade was sent to protect and monitor.
Fane Peturri was a historian and a friend of Schurk-Heren, the captain of the crew of the Uhumele who was willing to trade Dreypa's Oubliette.

Krunch was a Wookiee who worked as chief mechanic for Bolabo Hujaan in Bolabo's Garage on Byblos. They met each other working together in a smuggler's starship, and Krunch accompanied Bolabo when he became emancipated.

Dyril was a male maintenance technician at the Q'Maere Research Facility. Formerly a member of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order, his loyalty came under suspicion and he was sent to the Re-Education branch to be "re-brained".

Hoke was an obese male maintenance technician at the Q'Maere Research Facility. Formerly a member of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order, his loyalty came under suspicion and he was sent to the Re-Education to be "re-brained".

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Elma was a male technician in charge of maintaining the droids at the Q'Maere Research Facility. Formerly a member of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order, his loyalty came under suspicion and he was sent to the Re-Education branch to be "re-brained".

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Phloid was a male technician in charging of maintaining the computer systems at the Q'Maere Research Facility.
Phalla enjoyed his job, and was extremely intense. Always polite, Phalla was also perpetually cheery.
Merrilet Gorron was a Devaronian trader who operated around the time of the Battle of Yavin. Gorron was a known associate of Ulicx Vinaq.

Hobbrock was a giant walking fish that lived in the Coruscant underworld. It was the pet fish of Phelon, a criminal mastermind hiding in an ancient castle on the shore of what locals referred to as the burning water.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: Under the ministrations of Doctor Langstyn Kraay, Chase was subjected to an intense series of breakdown techniques and mental torture.

Corla Unser was a Human female who traveled with her free-trader brother, Cobb. Cobb was constantly in debt, and resorted to desperate measures to change their situation, and Corla was along for the ride. Unfortunately, everything he tried slid them further and further into debt.
The Mongo Beefhead Tribesman was a member of the nearly-extinct Mongo Beefhead Tribe from Tatooine. The tribesman, like the rest of the group, supported the Rebel Alliance.

Trevim Dadeferron was the first-born son of Dixon Dadeferron, a wealthy landowner from Kail. Like his father, Trevim was a critic of the Corporate Sector Authority, which was engaged in a dispute with their family over the issue of land-use rights.
This male Mixtwirk and his Rodian companion were in the Stock Lights cantina when Cryle Cavv first explained to his nephew Sienn Sconn that he wanted to steal a Star Destroyer.
Hallem Celaar was a professor hailing from Naboo. He was greatly admired in academic circles for his studies on plant life.
Sakme Kelene, hailing from Naboo, graduated from the Theed School of Technology and Engineering in her youth. She was good friends with Kharl Vanneb.

affiliation: Theed School of Technology and Engineering
x: Kharl Vanneb, hailing from Naboo, graduated at the top of his class from the Theed School of Technology and Engineering in his youth. He was sent to Ohma-D'un, where he was to serve as a Third Grade Assistant Technician.
The Stilt Monster was a being who ran into Rycar Ryjerd, while walking through the streets of Mos Eisley.
Brute was a Gungan male from Naboo. He chose to work as a shoe salesman, which, due to Gungans not wearing shoes, required him to leave his homeworld.

The man known as the Exalted was a male Human living on the Eternal Empire capital of Zakuul. He was the leader of the Heralds of Zildrog, a cult worshipping the mythical serpent-god Zildrog that controlled the Old World of Zakuul due to the deal made with Emperor Arcann.

Pinani was the widow of Quintama, a captain of the Melida Liberation Force. She was the daughter of Bicha and Tiraca, supposedly great heroes. She died in an attack on the town of Bin that was fought to avenge the Twenty-First Battle of Zehava.

Herut was part of a four-man sniper task force sent to greet and/or kill the Jedi Knights Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn. He was led by Wehutti. The other members of the task force were Moahdi and Kejas.

Kejas was a male Melida from the planet Melida/Daan. He served as part of a four-man sniper task force with Moahdi, Herut, and their leader, Wehutti while waiting for emissaries from the Jedi Temple to arrive.
Moahdi was a male Melida from Melida/Daan. He was part of a sniper task force led by Wehutti. The other members of the task force were Herut and Kejas.

Towan was a member of the Young. He encountered Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn when they came to the headquarters of The Young. When he made a derogatory joke about Melida and Wehutti, Nield choked him for it, but not fatally.

Combat Director Ss'ess was a Verpine who, for a time, guided Boba Fett and Jaina Solo through Nickel One after Niskooen was killed. Ss'ess was killed along with other Verpines when the Imperial Remnant released a nanokiller onto the asteroid.

Charls Ginsbrack was a scientist who was affiliated with the Rebel Alliance. During the Galactic Civil War, he led a scientific team on the isolated moon of Barcola, that was trying to develop new hyperdrive technology to aid the Alliance's war effort.

Brakiss's mother was a female Human from the planet of Msst who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The woman became the mother to a Force-sensitive child called Brakiss, but as a baby, he was taken away from her by agents of the Empire to be trained as a spy.
Jeswi Ele was a female Human Jedi Initiate enrolled in the Jedi Order's Temple academy on Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
This soldier served aboard the Harbinger as its Navigation Officer in 3951 BBY.
The unnamed Harbinger Medical Officer served aboard the Harbinger in 3951 BBY
This Harbinger Soldier served on the Harbinger in 3951 BBY
Crivor was an inmate at Moff Kentor Sarne's penal facility on the planet of Q'Maere. In 8 ABY, he was rescued by the crew of the FarStar, and volunteered for duty onboard the vessel.

Taska Rorn was one of the crewmembers assigned to the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar. Rorn's duties included navigational and helm duties, and she was on duty in the ship's command center when the ship was hit by a lightstorm in the Kathol Rift.
Kinakt Losron was a Human male research engineer who was imprisoned by Moff Kentor Sarne at the Q'Maere Research Facility. He was freed by the crew of the FarStar, and joined them.
Alec was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic and operated before the Clone Wars.

Kueller was an Almanian army general who lived hundreds of years before the Almanian Uprising. He overtook Almania and then the entire Almanian sector. In his later years, he was a beloved leader who was known for his compassion and his decisiveness.

Fritz was a male Sullustan who worked as a pilot in and around the Cularin system. He frequently stole items from his clients' cargoes, and he also looked down on most of them. In 31 BBY, he visited Depatar and, as was customary in the city, wore an ornate mask while there.

Durrsk was a Quarren crime lord on Nar Shaddaa. A large debt was owed to him by Tyrnia Masak's mother. When she defaulted on it, Durrsk took her daughter instead. His fighting master trained the girl as a gladiator, in which she excelled.

Zef Ando was a male Rodian moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War After the Battle of Yavin, he lived as a squatter in the Lars homestead In 1 ABY, he purchased some reconditioned droids off some Jawas who visited the farm with their sandcrawler.
Akal Colzet was a Human male lieutenant who served in the Imperial Storm Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.

Neevat was a Rodian hunter living on Rodia, and a rival of Harno. In order to damage Harno's reputation, Neevat spread rumors that Harno or his associates drugged creatures before his hunts, thereby making them easier targets.

Kursma was a female Barabel middleweight shockboxer. Native to Barab I, Kursma traveled the Outer Rim on the shockboxing circuit. Against the advice of her manager, she also spent time in between fights acting as hired muscle to various crime lords.

Thasca Knarr was a Snivvian merchant. He was a sneaky and resourceful individual who ruthlessly pursued the accumulation of credits. Unlike many of his species, he did not have any artistic talents. He secretly desired to take over Exovar's Emporium.

A Defel male was trained as a Jedi in the New Jedi Order. During the Swarm War the Defel was training to become a Jedi at the Ossus Academy. When Chiss Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano visited the academy, he was partaking in a game of Skorch, serving as the referee.
A female Kitonak was trained as a Jedi in the New Jedi Order. During the Swarm War this individual was training to become a Jedi at the Ossus Academy.

This male Rodian was trained as a Jedi in the New Jedi Order. During the Swarm War this individual was training to become a Jedi at the Ossus Academy. When Chiss Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano visited the academy, the apprentice was partaking in a game of Skorch.

This unidentified Squib was a Jedi Apprentice in the New Jedi Order. During the Swarm War this individual was training to become a Jedi at the Ossus Academy. When Chiss Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano visited the academy, the apprentice was partaking in a game of Skorch.

A male Wookiee was trained as a Jedi in the New Jedi Order. During the Swarm War the Wookiee individual was training to become a Jedi at the Ossus Academy. When Chiss Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano visited the academy, the apprentice was partaking in a game of Skorch.

This unidentified Rebel prisoner was captured during an Imperial assault on a Rebel Alliance outpost on Thaldo. She was freed from her cell by Luke Skywalker, and gave him an ID card that helped him reactivate the outpost's ion cannon so the Rebels could evacuate.

This pilot was on the planet of Tozeer when Luke Skywalker arrived to rescue C-3PO. The pilot traded with Skywalker for a part he needed to repair his A-wing fighter. In exchange, he gave the Rebel an item he needed to complete his mission.
Ryley Ancum was a bass vye player in a dusk band Far Cry.
Tev Matthews was a colonel in the Rebel Alliance. He was the father of Lieutenant Ty Matthews. He was tortured to death by the Empire.
Jana Jarel was a female bounty hunter who fought against the smuggler Roark Garnet during the Galactic Civil War.
Yoshi was a female individual who attended the University of Bar'leth on the Core Worlds planet Bar'leth during the Imperial Era.

Harno was a Rodian big-game hunter who fled his homeworld of Rodia after accidentally killing a rival hunter named Neevat. Ending up on the planet Trandosha, he began working for the native Trandoshans as a hunter on the nearby world of Kashyyyk.

Ahn was a Cathar male and one of the Rasi Tuums, a trio of littermates that also included Zho and another who went by only Rasi Tuum. They were born years before the Sith–Imperial War. During that time, they served in the New Jedi Order.
Tallamitta was a brown-haired member of the Wookiee species. Tallamitta wore a piece of clothing that covered their chest, and wielded a bowcaster, a projectile weapon used by many Wookiees.
Zobyteeg was an individual who served as a General Council Assistant in the locale Lutris on the Expansion Region world of Tynna.
The granddaughter of Borjak was a female Feeorin from Odryn. She had a short conversation with Zayne Carrick and Marn Hierogryph while they were imprisoned by the Feeorin.
Jan was an Imperial stormtrooper involved in the Galactic Empire's plan to start a war between S'krrr and Rabaan. He was killed by Mika Streev on the Combat Moon.

Sanna was a member of the Rebel Alliance. A short Human female with curly hair, she helped establish a strike base on the Combat Moon. During a skirmish between locals and the Empire, the leader of the base was reluctant to intercede, fearing discovery.

The unnamed priest of H'kig was captured during the First Battle of Obroa-skai. The male Gotal was one among hundreds brought to Harrar of the Yuuzhan Vong priest caste, who oversaw the selection of those individuals worthy of being sacrificed to the gods after the military vi…

A Human man served as the double of Roan Fel, Galactic Emperor of the Fel Empire, in 130 ABY. He was with Fel on the galactic capital of Coruscant in that year several days after the Empire defeated the Galactic Alliance in the Sith–Imperial War and won control of the galaxy.
Erdin Giblo was the head of the Commex corporation.

Ghazhak, along with his clan-brother Kohvrekhar, was one of Darth Vader's Noghri bodyguards. After the duel on Cloud City between Vader and Luke Skywalker, the two Noghri were tasked with locating Luke's lost lightsaber and severed hand.
Kohvrekhar, along with his clan-brother Ghazhak, was one of Darth Vader's Noghri bodyguards.
This female Human member of the Hidden Beks swoop gang guarded the entryway to the Beks' base of operations.

Bie Breil'lya was a Bothan of Clan Alya and first cousin of Tav Breil'lya. In 3 ABY, Breil'lya was captured by the bounty hunter Nariss Siv Loqesh, who planned to use the Bothan as bait to trap other hunters seeking the bounty.
Crote was a Bimm who served as a go-between when the Empire commissioned a group of bounty hunters to track down Han Solo and Leia Organa after the Battle of Hoth.
Ichor was a rancor, the daughter of herd-mother Tosh, who served the witches of the Singing Mountain Clan on Dathomir.
Una Poot led an Alliance to Restore the Republic cell on Silver Station. She had lost several lovers to the Galactic Empire, one of whom was Force-sensitive.
Nee was a female Sunesi healer who lived on Monor II during the Galactic Civil War.
Urek was a Human male who served the Rebel Alliance who infiltrated the Galactic Empire after posing as a stormtrooper named Conor.
Brago was a Human male who served as the Imperial Administrator of Monor II during the Galactic Civil War.
Fugueé was the former Imperial Administrator of Monor II.
Toalar Yalom Yalom was a male Gotal who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic alongside Woyiq during the Galactic Civil War.

San was a male Twi'lek who was the owner of Mechanical Allies, a droid shop on Sel Zonn Station. In 17 BBY, San was able to keep his business open under the Empire despite his nonhuman status and untrustworthy nature.

The Cathar Zho, one of the Rasi Tuums, was a Jedi of the New Jedi Order around the time of the Sith–Imperial War. He was born years before into a litter with two other Cathar, Ahn and another known only as Rasi Tuum.

Haninum Tyk Rhinann was a male Elomin hailing from Elom. Following the Declaration of a New Order in 19 BBY, Rhinann was destined for a life of slavery under the Galactic Empire, but was saved from that fate by the Sith Lord Darth Vader, Emperor Palpatine's enforcer, who enlis…

Chirome was the male Head Chef aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess. He oversaw a capable staff who worked to serve artistically created fine cuisine to the liner's passengers dining in the ship's five stately dining rooms.
Vangar was a Barabel pirate lord in the sector that contained the planet Prexiar where his base was located.
Hal Dallin was a Rebel starfighter pilot in Green Squadron during the time between the Battle of Hoth and the Battle of Endor. He was the wingman of Stevan Makintay.

Dru Gifford was a Rebel starfighter pilot in Green Squadron, stationed at Eyrie Base. He served during the time between the Battle of Hoth and the Battle of Endor. He died in a raid on Imperial starships in 3 ABY.

Kufra Ahara was a Murachaun mechanic who was skilled in modifications of spacecraft. Her work on the ships of the Sanjin Green Hawks allowed them to take Laakteen Depot, and she was even granted access to the Massassi Temple on Yavin 4.

Bash Fateau was a Human Male Corusca gem fisherman who fashioned a crew to find Corusca stones on Yavin Prime. As a young man, he flew agriflitters on Montitia, but spent all his savings to become a skiff pilot.

Old Ezil was an aged inhabitant of Almas, where he had lived his entire life. He claimed to remember when the Almas Academy was just getting established on the planet. He had met the crimelord Nirama on a couple of occasions, as well as Xav Verivax.

Grenal was the Whiphid chief security officer of Neftali in the Socorro system. He gained the prestigious title of Spearmaster shortly after his arrival on Neftali and was the tribal and spiritual leader of his people on that planet.

Jarstein was the master of a droid with the designation of M-3PO. When M-3PO was enlisted by the smuggler Roark Garnet to smother a guard with a feather boa to escape from a prison, the droid fretted that Jarstein would not approve of him doing such a thing.

Joh Steen was the captain of the Red Star Shipping Lines vessel designated Transport A-175. When Steen encountered a Nebulon-B frigate en route from the Nopces system to join a convoy at the Brentaal system, he cooperated fully with the instructions given to him by this appare…
Brawk was an Imperial naval officer who attained the rank of lieutenant and served aboard a customs frigate during the Galactic Civil War.

affiliation: Birtraub Brothers Storage and Reclamation Center
x: Birtraub was the male boss of Birtraub Brothers Storage and Reclamation Center during the height of the Galactic Empire. He was the brother of Pirtonna.

Tionne Solusar's grandmother knew much Jedi lore, which she imparted to her granddaughter, the future Jedi Tionne Solusar, before her death. She also owned a double viol, which Tionne took when she left home.
Ashii Nermani was a female Human who worked for the Galactic Empire's Imperial HoloVision as of 0 ABY.
Warwick was an Ewok who hid on a ridge alongside Wicket, Paploo, Teebo, and the Endor strike team as the latter discussed how to infiltrate the shield generator bunker on the forest moon of Endor.

Tantos Dree was a bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. For a time, he travelled with the smuggler, Roark Garnet, aboard the light freighter Dorion Discus alongside Jill Farseeker and Jackson Farseeker.
A Kel Dor member of the Koon family was Force-sensitive, serving as a Knight in the Jedi Order. They were an uncle of the Jedi Master Plo Koon and was also related to Koon's niece Sha Koon.
Crusher (or Cruncher) was a 150-kilogram male Trandoshan antenna-breaker who had a run-in with Nick Rostu. He was eaten by a dianoga.
Rokko was a Hutt crime lord who operated on the planet of Coruscant in 19 BBY. A member of the Besadii clan, he operated mainly in the Yaam Sector, trafficking in stolen merchandise.
Lex Rogger was a male Nautolan member of the Whiplash resistance organization in 19 BBY.
Laranth Tarak was a female green-skinned Twi'lek Jedi Knight and a Gray Paladin, a marginalized group of Jedi that fought with more weapons than just a lightsaber.
Raveen was a commander in the Imperial Navy and then the splinter government fleet of rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin.
A brown biped was enslaved by the Totem Master on the forest moon of Endor. While under the Totem Master's control, his eyes took on a red glow, signaling his subservience to the thief.
