A blue biped was enslaved by the Totem Master on the forest moon of Endor. While under the Totem Master's control, his eyes took on a red glow, signaling his subservience to the thief.

This unidentified green arthropod was enslaved by the Totem Master on the forest moon of Endor. While under the Totem Master's control, his eyes took on a red glow, signaling his subservience to the thief.

Zelebitha Effhod was the First Minister of the Coruscant Ministry of Ingress during the Separatist Crisis. She oversaw the closure of immigration to Coruscant due to security reasons, and died of Quannot's Syndrome before the Battle of Geonosis.
This obstetrician assisted in the delivery of Jacen and Jaina Solo. He was the only organic medical practitioner present at the event, and was assisted by two MD-series droids.
Sprettyn was an Ensign serving under Warlord Zsinj aboard Zsinj's flagship Iron Fist. He was caught at least twice playing a TIE interceptor simulator game while on bridge duty.
"Fugitive" Fod was a male Yuzzum from Endor who left the forest moon and became an outlaw singer in a musical troupe in the Corporate Sector during the era of the New Jedi Order.

Jaiteh Yasin was a Twi'lek ambassador who visited the Cularin system. He was once interviewed by Melanda Forswoth for Eye on Cularin with regard to knowledge on the Caarites and their homeworld of Caarimon.
Rowrrhaffee was a Wookiee who worked for Ma'Haffee Shipyard alongside Adic Ma'an in the Cularin system.
Adic Ma'an was a male Sullustan who worked for Ma'Haffee Shipyard alongside the Wookiee Rowrrhaffee in the Cularin system.
At some point during the Clone Wars, Count Dooku tamed and kept a krayt dragon.
Thrawn's subordinate was an officer who served Grand Admiral Thrawn during the Galactic Civil War. He stood beside Thrawn's command chair and briefed Thrawn on several developments.
Mag Doum was a businessman and Imperial spy who operated on the planet Arda II during the Galactic Civil War.
Kiros Zorad was a Human male from Arda II who by 1 ABY found himself heavily in debt to local businessman and Imperial spy Mag Doum.
Josie was a Gungan colonist of New Otoh Gunga known for watching lots of holovision.
Portillo was a member of the Gungan species who worked as a physician during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.

Unda was a Jedi Hunter and bounty hunter. He was a lieutenant of the Jedi Hunter Anda and fought alongside him against the Jedi Lah Kara on an abandoned starship. Unda wielded an electrostaff and also used his round hat as a weapon.
Drach Coven was the captain of the Far Ranger during the Imperial Period. He was a smuggler, and was aided in his job by the Weequay Mok.

Mok was a male Weequay smuggler who served as co-pilot aboard the freighter Far Ranger in 19 BBY with Drach Coven. The two were approached by the Empire to capture the Korun Nick Rostu, and the pair agreed to abduct him.
Tanna was the male captain of Darth Vader's Lambda-class T-4a shuttle during the early Imperial era.
Tait Ransom was a Corellian smuggler who was the rival of Kaine Paulsen.
Hagk Baht was a Duros smuggler who owned and operated the Singing Savrip during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Dwess was a male Rodian who worked as a spice merchant in Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War. He was a con man, offering to sell spice at a discounted rate to smugglers who could then sell the spice to any number of dealers.
"Faddo" was a male Rodian con artist who worked as a wandering Tredwall sales representative, selling defective NR knockoffs on the Vohai Unirail in the year 2 BBY.
Falloon, who was really the former Black Sun accountant Soolehad, was a Rodian who lived on the planet Sriluur during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Jabdo Garrink was a Rodian who worked in Jugsmuk Station, on the planet Gamorr, selling specialty items that were smuggled onto the planet.
Geska Gesse was a Rodian of the Neetakka clan, who, following the tradition of this young clan, became a bounty hunter and member of the Goa-Ato during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Toob Ancher was a male Human smuggler who worked for the crime lord Saadoon-Kauldi. He was the brother of Karl Mathieu Ancher.
Fahs Oxsor was an Issori smuggler who was well known for his flamboyant escapades against the Galactic Empire.
Noble Calder was an Imperial Navy Lieutenant who flew as part of Veerpal Squadron. He participated in the defence of the Star Galleon-class frigate Aremin during the Galactic Civil War.

Linder Kroford was a Morse from Karlatt who was sent to the planet Serob 6 for psychiatric treatment. Linder Kroford was one of the only living individuals, at the time of the Galactic Civil War, that knew the secret code to destroy the AI and the location of Temple Maudit on …
Elda was a female humanoid pilot. She was hired to fly Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn to Kodai in 39 BBY.

Dool Pundar was a Neimoidian captain in the Trade Federation navy who deserted just prior to the blockade of Naboo and became a pirate lord. During the Clone Wars, he clashed with Breakout Squad and was captured.
Valek was the captain of the Imperial Nebulon-B escort frigate Revenant during an attack on Communications Research Station Epsilon Nine in the Cron Drift in 4 ABY.

Max's companion was a female Human living in the House of Max in the city of Barons Hed on Sulon. She was an ally of Max the Bunny who also lived at the House of Max. After leaving the House of Max on an errand, she returned to find Kyle Katarn waiting at her door.
Tar'eelok was a Jedi Master. When Revan arrived at the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine in 3956 BBY, she was training her apprentice Garrum.

Majjen was a colonel in the Imperial Military following the Clone Wars. Shortly after the end of the conflict in 19 BBY, Majjen was assigned to judge the loyalty of former Grand Army of the Republic officer Nick Rostu.
Myrrack was a renowned Mon Calamari artist. In 0 BBY, he was tasked with repairing the Dro ceremonial fountain, unknowingly saving it from destruction.
Doc was an announcer at Corpo the Hutt's extravagant culinary contests who worked alongside his partner Fookooey.
Fookooey was an announcer at Corpo the Hutt's extravagant culinary contests who worked alongside his partner, who he nicknamed "Doc."

Dussk was a Trandoshan who lived on the planet Genarius during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Dussk and fellow Trandoshan Corrsk owned and operated the cantina Riboga's Barge, a sail barge that was formerly owned by the Hutt Riboga.

Dro Prack was a member of the Dro family and second cousin of Raynar Thul. She was captain of the Tryst. Under the command of the Tradewyn she received Raynar with his friends aboard the Shadow Chaser and the Rock Dragon in 24 ABY.
A male Human Padawan served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Mandalorian Wars.
Finn Shallo was a Human male journalist who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
A Thisspiasian female, Oppo Rancisis's sister was the Blood Monarch of Thisspias around 186 BBY. She was killed by revolutionaries in that year within her own alcazar on Ratamesh.

This female Thisspiasian was the Blood Monarch of Thisspias before 200 BBY. She had two children. One of them was Jedi Master Oppo Rancisis. The other was her daughter who became the next Blood Monarch.
Swifty Yonsen was a mercenary with a reputation which made hardened criminals take pause. Most people who were aware of Yonsen's reputation would back down or panic when faced with him.

Cemma the Younger was a Human gunslinger from a backwater world. Although he had gained a reputation as a deadly quickdraw, in fact he preferred to shoot unsuspecting victims in the back rather than challenge them openly.

Mii Heswop claimed to be a competent spacer and computer technician who had traveled extensively as a crew member on many different ships. In fact, the stout man had no real skills, and little ability to learn.
The father of the Jedi candidate Seha Dorvald lived on Coruscant during the Yuuzhan Vong War until he was killed by an insect of the Yuuzhan Vong in 27 ABY.
Suvar Detta was a male Human Mandalorian bounty hunter and mercenary who served under Boba Fett during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Katiz Xemir was a Human male mercenary who hired himself out against Imperial targets after the Empire killed his family.

Kanarak, also known as Kanarak the Slayer, was a vicious and undisciplined killer, he habitually carried a Flash 4 heavy blaster pistol, a vibro-ax, and a "death necklace" made from the bones of his victims.

Miech Conar was a male Captain who served as a commanding officer of the Imperial escort frigate New Star. Conar was an intelligent, competent officer who was loyal to the Empire, however he did not wish to die in a pointless battle.
An individual was a member of the Jedi Order who lived for centuries. He witnessed the conflicts known as the Hundred-Year Darkness and the Great Hyperspace War.
Tiroc Vhon was a Mandalorian bounty hunter and mercenary who served under Boba Fett during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Mole was a renegade Imperial spy who tried to defect to the Rebel Alliance after escaping from Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader's clutches. He was then sought after by the bounty hunter Boba Fett on a bounty.

Mangol was a male Human space explorer who was searching for a legendary Jedi library on the abandoned space station of Nespis VIII. When he arrived, instead of finding the library, he discovered many valuable gems.

Lara Notsil was a farmgirl on Aldivy who was killed when Admiral Apwar Trigit bombarded her home of New Oldtown in response to the farming community's refusal to provide him with supplies. Few records existed about Lara Notsil or any of the other slain New Oldtown residents.

Bickey was a New Republic pilot candidate in the Screaming Wookiee Squadron, a remedial Y-wing training squad considered by most pilots as a "last resort" for pilots on the verge of washing out. The squadron was run by Atton Repness aboard the Nebulon-B Frigate Tedevium.

Carmal was the governor of Lavisar during 7.5 ABY. He enjoyed sunfruit liqueur, which Wraith Squadron planned to present as a gift when they approached the neutral Lavisar in seeking the planet's allegiance in the battle against Warlord Zsinj after the Battle of Lavisar.

This reptilian Jedi trainee was a female Jedi student at Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4 in 12 ABY. She was present at a meeting inside the Great Temple that was held just after the Galactic Empire began an attack on the academy, to decide what the Jedi could do.

Machook was a dark-furred Ewok present on Endor around 4 ABY. After the Battle of Endor, Machook was involved in the brief conflict between the Ewoks and their fellow Rebellion allies, the Lahsbees, which developed at the instigation of the Hiromi known as Hirog.

Anson Trask's father was a male stormtrooper who served in the 407th Stormtrooper Division of the Imperial Army. His son, Anson Trask, later followed in his footsteps and joined the same division during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Soleric was a Commodore in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. He was in command the 16th Escort Force that was tasked with the protection of commercial starships traveling between the Induparan Crown Worlds in the Ado sector.
Markand was a High Admiral in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. He received a copy of a message from Governor Mirash Peet of Indupar to Commodore Gor Lequar.
Teprimal was an New Republic captain and starfighter instructor about the Nebulon-B Frigate Tedevium. He worked with Colonel Atton Repness, and was a conspirator in the colonel's black-market scheme.
Jacen Corbit was the Director of the Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations (IOCI) during the Galactic Civil War.

Oeana Tching, known as the Invisible Empress, was the leader of the Atrisian Empire five hundred–fifty years before the reign of the New Republic. She was known to be a highly successful leader, and she mastered Uueg Tching's Sayings.
Eoaq the Expansive was a Human who at one point served as the Atrisian Emperor of the Atrisian Empire.
Fasald Ghem was one of the preeminent investigative holojournalists for the HoloNet on the planet Vannix at the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Tenga Javik was a female Human survivor of the Battle of Coruscant. She became a community leader of sorts near the ruins of what was once the Catier Walkway.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: Warrant Officer Urman Nakk was a security officer for the New Republic Defense Force on the planet Borleias around the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. On duty when Tam Elgrin warned of a Yuuzhan Vong infiltrator, Nakk did not believe the warning.

Ryuk was a male Human survivor of the Battle of Coruscant. Though he survived the Yuuzhan Vong bombardment and Vongforming of the planet, he had the misfortune to come under the influence of Irek Ismaren.

Ti'wyn listened calmly as Yakown Reth aired his grievances against General Wedge Antilles, Jaina Solo, and the leadership of the New Republic in general. Ti'wyn urged his squad leader to keep calm and remain patient.
Yassat was a male Human survivor of the Battle of Coruscant. He banded together with a community near the ruins of what was once the Catier Walkway.
Skiffer was a male Human survivor of the Battle of Coruscant. He was part of a group that came into conflict with the "Walkway Collective," the survivors near the Catier Walkway, led by Tenga Javik.
Mosh Barris was an individual who served as a colonel in the Imperial Army. He was the senior troop commander aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Strikefast.
Walter Emanus was a professor at the Corellia University, where he was friends with Cornelius Wagglehorn.

Coric was a clone trooper sergeant who served in the 501st Legion's Torrent Company in the early months of the Clone Wars. Bred on Kamino, Coric was trained as a clone trooper medic and became a first aid specialist in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Holt was a Star Destroyer captain in the Imperial Navy and commanded a mission to recover Celeste Morne in 0 ABY.

A Rebel ensign served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a communications officer in the secret base on Yavin 4 in 0 ABY. When Luke Skywalker cut off all communications between his ship and the Rebel base, Leia Organa ordered the ensign to boost the receiving power.

Orth Maag was a Zabrak bartender at The Hutt's Last Laugh cantina on Jenenma. He had a great deal of information on local happenings for those with enough curiosity and credits, and also helped run a pit fighting ring in the back of the cantina.

Dej Vennor was a deadly and proficient male humanoid bounty hunter active in the year 0 ABY. Vennor accepted only bounties that targeted pirates. He was rumored to be a former Imperial scout trooper, as he wore a set of modified scout trooper armor.

Pex was a Human male merchant who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he visited theaters on various planets such as Tatooine and Naboo to sell props which storytellers could use for retelling exciting stories.

A male member of the Sunrider family was the Human son of Jev Sunrider and the father of Andur Sunrider. He lived on the planet Darada with other members of his family, and owned a small garden on his families' land in which Andur worked in.
In 14 ABY, the Grand Coruscant Theatre presented her Hyperdrive Tour on Coruscant and Corellia.
A Rodian male was the senator of Rodia during the first weeks of the Galactic Empire.
Sharka'k was a Gree artisan who created the Sharka'k Noor, but died before he was able pass the secrets of the Sharka'k Noor on to his apprentice.

Vril Vrakth was a male Zabrak who lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic. He was raised on a colony world where life was harsh, and the settlers there soon became divided in a series of violent wars.
Koorst was a male Trandoshan bounty hunter who was taken as an apprentice by the Zabrak Vril Vrakth. He accompanied Vrakth to Nizon in 19 BBY.
The retired clone trooper was a clone trooper who claimed to serve with the 501st Legion from the first battle of the Clone Wars to the Battle of Hoth in the Galactic Civil War.
The father of the navigator Makezh lived in the city of Eror Zeen on the planet, Danoor. He worked in the irrigation system underneath the city, and would often take his son along while he worked.

A Human male was a New Republic Army commander stationed on the New Republic base on the planet Altyr V in 10 ABY. He was in charge of the base when it came under attack from two Imperial artificial asteroids.
Ezra Du'Re was a female agent who served the Cularin Office of Public Safety. While investigating a warehouse in Tolea Biqua on Genarius, she was kidnapped by the gang of the slaver Gomalo.
Thook Lafrell was the Human male lieutenant who served the slaver Gomalo.
Teeko Soonca was a quiet, reserved Rodian male. He served as a sales executive for a Rodian-run company with Ruku Kooff and Mannee Swaano.

Mannee Swaano was a young male Rodian. An ambitious and overly-aggressive braggart, he was a sneaky sales executive who would say anything to close a deal. His coworker, Ruku Kooff, was not particularly fond of him.
Ruku Kooff was a female Rodian sales executive.

Ged was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Ged was a member of the 501st Legion's Torrent Company, and served in the battles of Christophsis and Teth before he was killed in action on the Outer Rim planet Teth during the Republi…

WRATH was the code-name of a highly skilled and accomplished Imperial Intelligence special agent who was charged with tracking down and disrupting the activities of the Rebel Privateer frigate Far Orbit.

Nolor was a Human member of the Jedi Order who fought during the Clone Wars. Near the end of the conflict, he fell to the dark side of the Force while fighting the Separatist forces, and he became a fugitive after the declaration of Order 66—Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's dire…
Toral was an ancient Coynite leader, at a time when the Coynite species was veering dangerously toward extinction. He was considered the strongest and most influential member of his clan.
Chokoo Thool was the leader of a group of Rodian thieves on Coruscant. He wore the uniform of Rodia Consolidated Refineries, and may have worked there at one point.
Nonul Weran was a Human male who served as an agent of the Imperial Security Bureau and specialized in undercover operations. He occasionally served as a double for fellow ISB agent Lesan Dos.
Arl'Toral was an ancient Coynite warrior, son of the influential leader Toral. He acted in his father's stead to further improve the welfare of Coynite society.

Rigis Corazon purchased Gryseium Incorporated from founder Huegu Eib. Corazon attempted to use Gryseium Incorporated to corner the food market on Demophon, but failed due to a lack of a contract with the Demophonian government or the Galactic Empire.
Lunn was a clone trooper during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Lunn was closely involved with Sergeant Coric at Teth. During the Battle of Teth, Lunn was killed along with most of his company.
Sisla was a Devaronian bounty hunter. Along with a group of fellow Devaronians, he once tracked the Sullustan Resh to a warehouse in The Works on Coruscant.
Gelnar Tol was a male Duros starship designer who was forced to serve the Galactic Empire. After being abducted by the Empire, he was among a group forced to work on the Sarlacc Project.
Talee was a Human male who served as an Imperial Customs agent in charge of inspecting vessels arriving at Cloudscape Platforms on Coruscant.

Ruba was a mute Ortolan of unusual size for his species. He often grew uncomfortable in the heat of Mos Espa and sought refuge in a bathhouse, where at times he was attended by Rutian females, and on one occasion even met Jar Jar Binks.

Palmer was a female pilot from the planet Naboo and an officer in the Royal Naboo Security Forces during the Trade Federation Invasion of Naboo. During the conflict, she was captured by the Trade Federation and later released by her fellow officer, Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes.

Faltun Garr was a well-respected Imperial Colonel during the height of the New Order. After serving as a command officer at various Kuat Drive Yards and Sienar Fleet Systems facilities, he was relocated to the Coromon Islands on the planet Fresia, where he was placed in charge…
Maki Salak was a Ho'Din environmental extremist during the waning years of the Old Republic. He strongly protested the killing of the crab-like rikknits on the planet New Plympto.

Resh was a Sullustan who once worked as an enforcer for Darga the Hutt. After Darga's death and a failed attempt to seize control of his organization, Resh became the target of an Imperial bounty and fled to the lower levels of Coruscant while searching for a way off-planet.
Vischera was a partially insane Human male who served the Galactic Empire during the months following the end of the Clone Wars.
Marcus Sione was a freelance technology guru during the height of the New Order. Known as "The Wizard" among his peers, Sione had worked off-the-grid on the industrial world of Kuat since his youth.
Aranei was a rancor that was owned by the Nightsisters on Dathomir. In 1 ABY, she was killed at the Nightsister Stronghold by a spacer who was trying to obtain the Shard of Obedience.
Gord Ves was a member of the Jedi Order in the Old Republic and may have been a contemporary of Nomi Sunrider and Arca Jeth.

Namman Cha was a Human male and an aspiring Dark Jedi in league with the Galactic Empire who believed that he could become a Dark Lord of the Sith through the discovery of ancient relics, like the Codex of Tython.

Rachi Sitra was a female Twi'lek archaeologist, and Commander in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, during the Galactic Civil War. Sitra had once been a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order before going into exile following its downfall.

Eobbim Figh was a Mhingxin gossiper and informant roaming Mos Eisley's cantina's and streets. He once told bounty hunter Bossk some interesting information about Bossk's failing popularity in the bounty hunter trade and the whereabouts of Bossk's enemy Boba Fett.
Jeffren Brek was a male Human who served in the Imperial Security Bureau. His ISB training taught him that smugglers were assets like any others, used when needed to complete the mission.

Coret Bhan was a Zabrak male who was a former colonist in a harsh Mid Rim region. He had a strong hatred of the Galactic Empire and became a Captain in the Rebel Alliance. He was an intense fighter who led by example.
Hyperdrive was the Mattic family pet on Alderaan. It was taken by Elam Mattic's brother to Tatooine when he decided to become a miner.
Brek was a Trandoshan male who was a member of Veneb Drassk's clan. He was present during the confrontation between Veneb Drassk and Qyzen Fess on Taris.
Serimirl was a mysterious near-Human loyal to the crime lord Jabba the Hutt. She was installed as the head of one of the Hutt's dummy corporations in the Outer Rim Territories around 2 BBY.
Aden was a Human male lieutenant of the Galactic Empire.
Sasana was a female salesperson who worked for Kontag. Around 76 BBY, she invited Jedi Master Dooku and his Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn to a factory where she gave information on Lorian Nod's whereabouts.

Yura Telamarch was a male Bezim who became the ruler of his homeworld. He was in an alliance (resulting in the creation of the Mid Rim gateway, Station 88 Spaceport) with Lorian Nod of Junction V, Samish Kash of Delaluna, and Glimmer Uziel of Vicondor.

Glimmer Uziel was the leader of Vicondor. She was in an alliance (resulting in the creation of the Mid Rim gateway, Station 88 Spaceport) with Lorian Nod of Junction V, Samish Kash of Delaluna, and Yura Telamarch of Bezim.
Anyara was a Cathar Jedi Knight of the Old Republic. In 3957 BBY, Anyara was part of a Jedi and Republic operation led by Bastila Shan to capture Darth Revan aboard his flagship.
Aldren Dayos was a Human Jedi Knight of the Old Republic. In 3957 BBY, Dayos was part of a Jedi and Republic operation led by Bastila Shan to capture Darth Revan aboard his flagship.

Shandy Fanaso was a crewmember of the One Two Many during the Imperial era. Previously, he had been the captain of the Corellian Gambit, a light hauler. Once, on a trip to the Pangarees, Fanaso had chosen to stop over in the Triton Moons, specifically Triton Besh.

Garragor was a member of the Jedi Order who lived in 3963 BBY. He was a member of the Jedi Covenant, a secret Jedi organization trying to prevent the returning of the Sith, and was completely loyal to its founder, Krynda Draay.

Klydeker was a member of the Jedi Order who lived in 3963 BBY. He was also a member of the Jedi Covenant, a secret Jedi organization trying to prevent the returning of the Sith, and was completely loyal to its founder, Krynda Draay.

Kurt was a Human male native to the Inner Rim Territories world of Onderon. A member of the Beast Riders of Onderon's wilderness, Kurt was the flight leader of several squads, or "wings," of drexl-mounted warriors in the Beast Rider army.
Gallagane was a lieutenant in the Imperial Military.
Mactimentus was a Tritonite who resided on Triton Besh. He represented the Domains of Triton and greeted newcomers at Triton Besh Port with a copy of the Rules of Law for the Domains of Triton.
Saman was the bartender of the Triton Besh cantina.
Janzel Helot was the ship's boy aboard the One Two Many.
Devoris was a crewmember aboard the One Two Many.
Redline was the call sign of the Commander of Black Eight Squadron, succeeding Juno Eclipse after her reassignment by Lord Darth Vader following the Bombing of Callos.
Drexl Roosh was a male Rodian scavenger leader of the Rodian Salvager's Cartel during the Imperial Era.
Britt was an Imperial Stormtrooper who was stationed on Kashyyyk among the forces of Captain Ozzik Sturn by 3 BBY.

Ozzik Sturn was a Human male Imperial captain and big game hunter. Using family connections, Sturn rose through the ranks of the military. When assigned to various worlds, he would spend time hunting native creatures, taking their heads as trophies.

Pol Haus was a male Zabrak living on the planet Coruscant who served as a police officer for many decades with the Coruscant Police. When the Galactic Empire was formed in 19 BBY, the planetary police force was renamed the Imperial Sector Police.
Kol Nurn was an Advozse and patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in 0 ABY, during the Imperial mandated curfew. He sat near a Tintinna, Rungs.
A Human was a senator in the Galactic Senate, during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. The Senator was still serving on Coruscant—the capital world of the Republic—in 32 BBY.
Del was a clone trooper during the Clone Wars who was part of the famed 501st Legion's Torrent Company.

Zeer was a clone trooper who served the Grand Army of the Republic and a member in Torrent Company during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Teth in 22 BBY, he served as one of Torrent Company's combat engineers and was one of six clones to survive the battle.
Hez was a clone trooper sergeant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Attie was a clone trooper during the Clone Wars who was part of the famed 501st Legion's Torrent Company.

Ayar was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic. In 22 BBY, he fought as a part of Torrent Company in the Battle of Teth. During the ensuing battle, Ayar was killed by battle droid forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Adem Antin was a Human male who was the son of Doctor Amie Antin, a member of the Eleven. He lived on the planet Bellassa, in the town of Ussa. In 19 BBY he was ten and would walk himself to school.
Vlaçan Umber was a male Vindalian baron, art connoisseur, and the patron of the Caamasi light sculptor Ves Volette. He was one of the initial suspects in Volette's murder, but was exonerated.

Kirma Umber was the wife of Baron Vlaçan Umber. She began to feel that her husband may have had an affair with Dejah Duare, the partner of Caamasi artist Ves Volette. She went to see Volette alone to demand that he leave Dejah immediately, but he refused and Kirma left in a fury.
Frrflin was a Mrlssi commercial investigator. He tried to portray a tough persona, but, like most of his species, he was much better at analyzing information than physical confrontations.

Joli Ti Eddawan was a female Human and the daughter of Senator Galim Eddawan who represented Tyan in the Galactic Senate of the Republic. In 76 BBY, Lorian Nod used her voice to let Dooku and his Padawan believe that she was on his ship.
Yerem was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the final decades of the Republic's rule.
Davar Hamalcal was a hunter from a primitive culture who stowed away on a Rebel shuttle. Hamalcal subsequently joined the Alliance.

Oro Freatt was a crime lord who was the de facto ruler of the planet Shownar during the Galactic Civil War. Although a criminal, Freatt was also largely responsible for the success of Shownar's booming tourism industry.
Lennox, also known as "The Rat", was a male Human thief who operated during the Galactic Civil War. Originally a teacher, Lennox was fired for sadism and turned to a career as a criminal.
Gradress Nall was a bounty hunter who was a member of the House Salaktori chapter of the Bounty Hunters' Guild.
Janildakara was a bounty hunter who was a member of the House Renliss chapter of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. A young Human female, she had a prominent slave brand on her neck.

Stavrin Hevix was a young, relatively unknown bounty hunter. Hevix entered the profession not for the money, but rather because he enjoyed the challenge of setting up elaborate traps for his targets. Hevix always attempted to capture his targets alive.

Wexlann Tarn was an unusual bounty hunter, in that his motivations for entering the profession were very different from most. Like many hunters, Tarn was in it for the money—what was unusual was his purpose for seeking this money.
Evin Yarrow was the Human male father of Eve Yarrow and the head of Yarrow Industries on the planet Acherin.

Aglar Orin was a former TIE fighter pilot turned bounty hunter. Reasoning that he should receive better pay if he were to continue to risk his life for his work, Orin resigned from the Imperial Navy at the end of his mandatory term of service, and began his career as a bounty …

Ravallian Dast was a bounty hunter with a strict moral code. Dast believed that the Galactic Empire was an illegal and immoral government, and therefore refused to accept any contract offered by any Imperial law enforcement agencies, considering that the laws of the Empire wer…

Demtri, brother of Gerlun, was a member of the Malevolence, a Dark Jedi cult that lived in Andeddu's Keep on Prakith. When Darth Wyyrlok III appeared at the Keep to learn Darth Andeddu's secrets, Demtri and the other Dark Jedi confronted the Sith Lord.

Gerlun was a member of the Malevolence, a cult of Dark Jedi living in Andeddu's Keep on Prakith. In 137 ABY, Darth Wyyrlok III appeared at the Keep to learn Darth Andeddu's secrets and use them to aid Darth Krayt, the Dark Lord of the Sith.
Endrigorn was a Rakririan dealer who dealt in light sculptures, holo-art and precious gems.
Kars Korthos was a male Human who was part of Nick Rostu's team in Whiplash.

Berren Sid Té was a human Rebel Alliance operative who was a member of Sleeper Cell V-16. Sid grew up an orphan in Fabrillan city on the planet Malthor but was able to build out a large vending empire.
Sayar Dun'La was a Bothan Jedi healer present at the Jedi Order's Hidden Temple when it was visited by the bounty hunter Cade Skywalker in 137 ABY during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Drok was a male Nikto Jedi Master who served the New Jedi Order during the Second Imperial Civil War. In 137 ABY, Drok was present at the Jedi Order's Hidden Temple when the bounty hunter Cade Skywalker visited it in 137 ABY, seeking to gain the Jedi Council's help in assassin…
Dossa was a female Nautolan smuggler. She was a long time assignment of Haazen during his time as a Padawan on Arkania.
Mitsurugi was a skilled swordsman from an unidentified world.
Toh Revo Chryyx was a male Cerean grifter. He was wanted by Rokko the Hutt, who placed a bounty of fifteen thousand credits on the Cerean, alive only.
Taki was a Human female and a skilled fighter, who originated from an unknown world outside the known galaxy.
Losk Tenchi was a pudgy middle-aged Human who operated illegally in the Tapani sector during the Galactic Civil War period. He appeared older than he actually was due to his weather-beaten face.

Gorgo was a Hutt artist. He created images of Nal Hutta by exposing prothium gas to the world, resulting in "frozen" images of Nal Hutta from Gorgo's time. His artwork was extremely rare. Rokko the Hutt owned the last pieces of his art.

This unidentified Whiphid was a member of the Erased in 18 BBY, along with Dexter Jettster. In an unneccesary entanglement with Ferus Olin and Trever Flume he threw them around with his rather large tusks.
Saren Valek was a male Near-Human Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic in the decades leading up to the rise of the Galactic Empire.
Deca Brun ran for governor in the Galacian Gubernatorial election in 44 BBY. He received widespread support, as he promised reform and prosperity.

Lonnag Giba was the head of Queen Veda's Council of Ministers on the planet Gala. He conspired with Deca Brun against the Queen during the Galacian Gubernatorial election, imprisoning her and attempting to take over the city of Galu.
Dana was a male Galacian and member of the Hill people who lived on the planet Gala. He was a trusted lieutenant of Elan, leader of the Hill people.

Tema was a member of the Hill people who lived on Gala. She was the mother of Elan, the leader of the Hill People. Tema left the Hill People to go to Galu, the capital city of Gala, to see the world outside. She was an artisan and heard that the palace needed workers.
Xerius Ugg was a male Besalisk commander in the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Metrisse was a Fondorian composer who lived at the Poloda Place apartment complex on the Galactic Republic capital planet Coruscant by 38 BBY. While there, he composed the Études of Time and Space, a piece of music that was considered famous by 18 BBY.

Jinjur Tomas was a Mining Guild recruiter who worked in the Tapani sector. She discovered the location of Alabard's Comets' secret base, shortly after the Battle of Hoth, but accepted certain payments in exchange for her secrecy.

Chop'aa Notimo was a Human male Mandalorian mercenary and crime lord who fought for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. After the end of the conflict, he briefly joined the Black Sun criminal syndicate before striking out on his own.

Kleef was a male Otolla Gungan veteran of the Battle of Naboo who briefly served in Senator Jar Jar Binks's security detail on the galactic capital of Coruscant before choosing to follow a criminal's path. During the Clone Wars, Kleef operated as a bounty hunter.
Formmn Badees was a young Duros pilot who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Mallie Marek was a Human female who served in the Clone Wars as a Jedi Knight of the Galactic Republic.
The Viceroy of Bheriz was a male leader of the Bherizian who lived during the Clone Wars.

During the Clone Wars, an ARC trooper served under the command of the Weequay Jedi General Sev. In the war's final year, the clone trooper accompanied Master Sev and his Padawan Joc Sah to the Outer Rim world Ragmar V, which was considered a vital staging planet for a planned …

A.J. was a female Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the years preceding the Clone Wars. She studied and graduated from the Academy on Almas, having past the tests of her master, the lightsaber instructor Kirlocca.
Darth Voren, originally known as Voren Renstaal, was a male Human who served Darth Revan's Sith Empire as a Sith apprentice.

Cov was the squad leader of Yayax Squad. He was in one of the squads trained by Rav Bralor on Kamino. He wore a gray-and-brown dazzle-pattern Katarn armor like the rest of his squad. He was also seen with brown coloring on his armor.
Glor Jal was a male Ugnaught union leader in Cloud City's Port Town. Jal was known to be corrupt and had a weakness for Corellian lum.
Gurgle was a Quarren underworld boss on Dac.
Alvor Cano was a member of the Iotran Braceman Council and once put together a casefile on the pirate Clabburn.

VAB-927 was the number assigned to a Bothan prisoner held on the Death Star. The alien was transferred from Detention Block AA-23 to Docking Bay 28-C while the prison was under Code-Red security status.
Vaize was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic. In 22 BBY, he fought in the Battle of Teth, where he was killed by battle droids.
Sheryc Seka was a Yarkora thief and smuggler. She maintained a professional relationship with the pirate Salmakk, who provided her with many rare weapons.

apprentices: Various members of the Agents of Ossus
x: Jin-Lo Rayce was a Human male Jedi Padawan apprenticed to the Jedi librarian Jocasta Nu during the Clone Wars. At the conclusion of the war and the beginning of the Great Jedi Purge, Rayce escaped the attack on the Jedi Temple led by the Dark Lord Darth Vader.

Herron Morvis was an influential economist during the Restoration Period and the Mandalorian Wars. In 3985 BBY, he authored the Coruscant Financial Exchange Establishment Act which helped the Galactic Republic rebuild its infrastructure following the devastation caused by the …
Fannis Gult was a female Human and a veteran member of the Guild Enforcers. She once led an investigation into a series of pirate attacks on FiggEx transports in the Greater Javin sector.

Razelfiin was a Tynnan and leader of her people on the Expansion Region world Tynna shortly before the onset of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY. Two months after her election by lottery, the Tynna Central Government Building in Lutris collapsed due to a stone mite infestation.
Cag was the captain of the transport vessel, the Argo Moon.
G'hinji Dros was a male Em'liy who served as Eldest of the Argwin caste on Shalyvane during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
The father of Ommin was a Human male native to the Inner Rim planet of Onderon.
This Imperial scout was a member of the Galactic Empire Exploratory Division and the person who rediscovered the lost planet Seoul 5.

Aven was a Human male, and a clone of Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. Born on the planet of Kamino, Aven was one of one hundred Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commandos that made up part of the Grand Army of the Republic's special forces.

S'hrah was a male doctor active during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Known to have no tolerance for any discipline outside medicine, he taught many pupils. One of S'hrah's students was the Corellian Jos Vondar.
This Mandalorian was a soldier on an unidentified planet in Mandalorian space.

Bur'lorr was a Yuuzhan Vong subaltern. He worked for Nom Anor and contacted Goran Beviin and some other Mandalorians, after the Battle of New Holgha. Bur'lorr commanded them to hunt down the Jedi, Kubariet, who was wounded and attempting to escape the planet.

This green tusked pirate was a member of Lemo and Sanda's gang a short time after the Battle of Endor. He was tasked with keeping watch on Han Solo and Chewbacca after they had been placed in energy binders.

A bald pirate was a member of Lemo and Sanda's gang sometime after the Battle of Endor. Alongside a Near-Duros, he was on Keyorin, the "Hunter's World," when he spotted Han Solo, "Captain Drebble," and his Wookiee companion alongside Han Solo.
Jax Lerrian was an Imperial Customs inspector, who had held that job for nearly a decade as of the Galactic Civil War.
Ciran Ern was a male Human representative of Junction V during Galactic Republic's reign. Though he cooperated with Lorian Nod for a long time in the scheme involving the Annihilator.

Soshu Londahl was an Ithorian author. Londahl wrote "Life's Memories," which was published in his anthology Lyrical Metaphysics: Ode on an Odon by Coruscani Publishing. It was later quoted by San Herrera and Nia Reston in their paper also named "Life's Memories."

Kite was the name for a clone trooper commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he was assigned to the Venator-class Star Destroyer Laudable under the command of the Phuii Jedi General Ares Nune.
Nyreen Vollen, known as Ny for short, was a freighter pilot who assisted Kal Skirata and his adopted clan near the end of the Clone Wars.
Joni Ree was a female scientist who served the arms manufacturer Czerka Corporation during the Jedi Civil War, as the chief administrator of the research facility Czerka 431.
Krova served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Alliance and was Co-Chief of State Jacen Solo's personal communications officer onboard the Anakin Solo during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Norman was a newscaster working for the HoloNet News program A Galaxy Divided during the Clone Wars.
Ultana Anya was a female newscaster who worked at the Coruscant News Desk during the Clone Wars.
Lyrax Pentigure was a debate show host working for the HoloNet News program A Galaxy Divided during the Clone Wars.

affiliation: Techno Union Research and Development Wing
x: Bunt Dantor was a Skakoan scientist who worked at the Techno Union Research and Development Wing during the Clone Wars.
Rachael Tikaris was a physician. Din Tinray, one of her patients, required an ear for her deafness. Tikaris was able to successfully create and install an ear for the deaf Sullustan.
Ergric Betos was the bodyguard of Prince Anod on the planet of Velmor around 3 ABY. He witnessed the death of Anod at the hands of Imperial agent, Zeta Traal but failed to stop it in time.

Chozz Wardle was the royal physician to the House of Lorac on the planet Velmor. When Prince Denid returned to his homeworld in 3 ABY, after nearly 20 years of exile, Wardle was the one to verify his identity.
A Beast Rider accompanied Commander Gobee in the defense of Kira Fortress, the forest stronghold of the planet Onderon's Beast Rider society.
A Beast Rider accompanied Commander Gobee as he searched the tunnels under the Royal Palace of Iziz, the capital and only city of the Inner Rim world of Onderon.

An Individual who was a member of an unidentified species of Squid, was a servant in King Elbo's Coral Castle. It served as a makeshift prison for those that King Elbo had sought to punish. The guard had eight legs, which acted as prison bars when draped over a prisoner.
Tiny was the name given to a large fish on the forest moon of Endor by the Ewoks. Teebo claimed that this fish might be the cousin of his other fish friend.
Raouul was a Tarasin who worked for Cularin Central Broadcasting. On one broadcast with Yara Grugara, Raouul hid behind a bush in order to simulate a member of the Wyrd attacking Grugara.
This individual served as an admiral in the Galactic Republic's Navy during the Clone Wars.
Uburluh was a male doctor and physicist who had the knowledge of prosthetics and a member of the Brotherhood of the Sith.
Jex was a citizen of Cularin who lived in Hedrett.
Koblus "Ko" Sornell was a female Devaronian Mandalorian warrior who served the Neo-Crusaders during the Mandalorian Wars. In 3963 BBY, she served as a signals expert during the invasion of Zongorlu.

Karnak Tetsu, also known as Karnak the Maleficent, was a Force-sensitive Sith Offshoot who lived during the years following the Great Sith War. They became the leader of the Sorcerers of Tund, a Force sect based on the planet Tund.
Duqua Dar was a Zabrak Jedi Knight in the time of the Galactic Republic's war against the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, which began in 3976 BBY.
Na'Ilia was a Tarasin on Cularin. On one occasion Na'Ilia helped Mother Dariana record a message on a datachip regarding Liriana and the Wyrd.

Gor Kolomo was a male Twi'lek who traveled to Uffel to investigate it for mineral exploitation. However, he and his companion were killed when their ship crashed. He was survived by his droid QS-2D who eventually claimed its own independence.
Soronna was a female Twi'lek who worked as a waitress at the Kragget restaurant, an all-hours cantina located on the planet Coruscant.
S. Pelbion was a male Human doctor who served as the deputy chief administrator of the Valorum Center on the planet Coruscant.

Jun Hokan was a male Human Mandalorian and a comrade of Munin Skirata. He questioned whether Skirata was being too aggressive in training Falin, a young orphan that Munin took under his wing while they were on a job on the planet Mes Cavoli
Lord Gajakur Biul was a Human Force-sensitive who was affiliated with the Kilian Rangers.

Aola Blen was a female Twi'lek and the younger sister of Mala Blen. Together, the Twi'leks ruled Thaere Privo in a complex interplay of power politics. The sisters had some contact with the Hutt crime lord Riboga from the neighboring Cularin system.

Mala Blen was a female Twi'lek and the older sister of Aola Blen. Together, the Twi'leks ruled Thaere Privo in a complex interplay of power politics. The sisters had some contact with the Hutt crime lord Riboga from the neighboring Cularin system.
Bal Ferensil was a male Bothan who rose to the top ranks of Thaereian politics following the deaths of the Twi'lek sisters Aola and Mala Blen.

Aponte was a male individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was sent by Jabba the Hutt to promote and inform people about the Galactic Moon Festival created by the Hutt.
Eelo Begraas was a Bothan male from the planet Bothawui. Working initially as a Podracer, Begraas later trained as a fighter pilot, going on to become a legend throughout the Mid Rim.

Tamarc was the leader of a squad of Alliance to Restore the Republic agents sent to track down Enid Vahr after he went missing on Demophon. The squad's starship was shot down over Demophon. Only Tamarc, rebel agents Almera Zan and Grashk, and free-trader Roz survived.
Tewn was a male Wookiee mechanic in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. While on Berrol's Donn, he served under Commander Zeke Rondel.

An Imperial engineer worked on the Death Star project in the Maw installation during its final stages of construction, while Bevel Lemelisk received a bacta treatment after being choked by Darth Vader.
Ralera was a male Wookiee who served as a member of the Wookiee underground resistance movement, and worked with Katarra.

Zeke Rondel was an officer of the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the days after the Battle of Yavin. A Captain, Zeke Rondel approved a mission where analyst Fulkrehm Protial worked undercover pretending to be a drunkard to obtain information.
Flyby was a clone trooper pilot who served in Shadow Squadron, a starfighter unit in the Republic Navy.
Acaadi was a Zabrak male Jedi during the time of the Galactic Republic's war against the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders.
Jirany Sha was a female Miraluka, who was a practitioner of the Luka Sene Force tradition. Acaadi once traveled to her homeworld, to study traditions.
Darok-Tho was a male Draethos, who was a practitioner of the Keetael Force tradition. Acaadi once traveled to his homeworld, to study traditions.
Rokon was an admiral with the Galactic Republic navy during the galactic-spanning Jedi Civil War, fought between the Republic and Darth Revan's Sith Empire from 3959 BBY to 3956 BBY.

Kosa-Yin Hadu was a Gungan male Sith cult member who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Originally a member of the Jedi Order, Hadu trained as the Padawan of Jedi Knight Kin-Ya Dosun, a fellow Gungan.
Merik Darou was the personal assistant of Senator Lavina Wren of the Cularin system. He was a frequent visitor to Gadrin and Hedrett. His duties included meeting Tarasin ambassadors, city governors.

Sersae Jenreal was a social analyst in the Cularin system. Later in 31 BBY, she ran an exposé on Cularin's Senator Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren looking at whether she was actually related to Reidi Artom, her influence in the Senate, and the relationship between her administration…

Ussin Fajinak was a male Lieutenant Commander in the Republic Navy, who was first officer of the Aurodia during the Clone Wars. He died during the conflict and his name was included on a war memorial, which his wife visited.
Devidia Vennsiol was a Human woman from the planet Sacorria. The daughter of a powerful local official, she was spoiled as a child and began using her good looks and charisma to manipulate boys.
Cryle was a male Human Jedi Initiate enrolled in the Coruscant Jedi Temple's academy during the final decade of the Galactic Republic.

Skawn Bonduna was a Twi'lek male celebrity and musician during the last years of the Galactic Republic. During the later reign of the Galactic Empire, he performed the lead role in the band Sonic Free, which rebelled against the new Imperial laws on music.
Traggissk Reosss was a male Trandoshan and a member of Winnard Clan.

Scranton Toon was a male Rodian pilot working for the pirate, Plook Hartar. He was known to be arrogant and extremely skilled. He lost his left eye in a swoop racing crash and had it replaced with a cybernetic photoreceptor enhancement.
Jolluc was a male Human Maujasi leader that led the Mauja clans in raiding Galactic Republic supplies en route to the city of Hadde during the Clone Wars.

Baris was a male clone trooper, who was a clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. They were born and trained on the planet Kamino to serve the Galactic Republic in the Grand Army of the Republic as a clone commando in the Clone Wars, which raged between 22 BBY and 1…

Red was the nickname of a clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. He was born and trained on the planet Kamino to serve in the Grand Army of the Republic as a clone commando during the Clone Wars.

Kef was a male clone trooper, who was a clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. They were born and trained on the planet Kamino to serve in the Grand Army of the Republic as a clone commando during the upcoming Clone Wars.

Tam was a clone trooper, who was a clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. The clone was born and trained on the planet Kamino to serve in the Grand Army of the Republic as a clone commando during the Clone Wars. Between 22 and 19 BBY, Tam was killed.
A clone commando named Lio served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars of 22 BBY–19 BBY against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Forr was a clone commando, who was a clone of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. Like all clone commandos, Forr was born and trained on the planet Kamino to serve as in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, which lasted from 22 to 19 BBY.

Vil was a police officer who served with the Coruscant Security Force on the planet of Coruscant. When Order 66 was issued—condemning all Jedi as traitors to the Galactic Republic—Vil was piloting a CSF assault ship and flying patrol with a CSF akk dog handler and Republic Com…
Jossie was an akk dog that belonged to the Coruscant Security Force. It would accompany its handler—who was a police officer—on patrol of the planet of Coruscant.

Sevan Domna was a majordomo who worked for the Hutt Jabba Desilijic Tiure and his criminal empire. Domna was one of Jabba's most loyal majordomos, and the crime lord considered him to be the best of all of them.
Luszgoti was an ensign in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. He was a member of COMPOR and was unpopular with his comrades.

Trask was a Bothan who lived during the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War, which began in 25 ABY. He was captured by the Yuuzhan Vong, an extra-galactic species that invaded the galaxy, and was enslaved to work on a Yuuzhan Vong seedship, which was a kind of freighter.

Wurokkk was an eccentric and avant-garde Wookiee musical composer who joined the percussion group Shluur. He gained an interest in the brainwaves of the Bith species while attending Shluur concerts on the planet Clak'dor VII, the Bith homeworld.

Seff Hellin was a Jedi Knight who served during the time period following the Second Galactic Civil War. He had been a student at the Jedi Academy on Yavin 4 and was approximately fourteen when it was evacuated during the war with the Yuuzhan Vong.

Reye Nenilin was a male Human doctor who was an expert in genetics during the time of the Clone Wars. He was approached in the Haunch of Nerf on Coruscant by Mandalorians Mij Gilamar, Kal and Mereel Skirata, who gave him a part of some genetic research that had been obtained f…
Foocl'd was a pilot in the Imperial Navy who served aboard the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Fogger during the Galactic Civil War.

Yutsen was a Rodian reporter for TriNebulon News. During the Clone Wars, Yutsen gave the Gungan Jar Jar Binks information on Outer Rim traffic in return for an interview with Naboo Senator Padmé Amidala.

Pillon Miner was a Human who lived during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He was captured by the Yuuzhan Vong, a species that had invaded the galaxy, and was forced to work on a Yuuzhan Vong seedship, a type of freighter.

Yover was a clone commando and a member of Yayax Squad, who was born on Kamino and trained by the Mandalorian Rav Bralor. He participated in the Battle of Coruscant and later defected from the GAR and traveled to Mandalore along with the rest of Yayax Squad.

Jind was a clone commando and a member of Yayax Squad who was born on Kamino and trained by the Mandalorian Rav Bralor. He participated in the Battle of Coruscant and later defected from the GAR and traveled to Mandalore along with the rest of Yayax Squad.

Dev was a clone commando and a member of Yayax Squad, who was born on Kamino and trained by the Mandalorian Rav Bralor. He participated in the Battle of Coruscant and later defected from the Grand Army of the Republic and traveled to Mandalore along with the rest of Yayax Squad.
Simi Noor was a Force-sensitive individual who was a Padawan in the Jedi Order who lived during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Regent of Garis was a being who visited Grievous on Utapau during the Clone Wars, despite supposedly being allied with the Galactic Republic.

Arbian J. Lemmeloth was a male Human Republic Intelligence agent who was tasked with spying on Republic Treasury Audit Division agent Besany Wennen. While tailing her through the streets of Coruscant, he was surprised from behind by Null Arc Ordo Skirata and the Wookiee Enacca.
Erran Sif was a Human female spy who lived on Corellia and Talus during the Galactic Civil War. She was considered a Rebel by the Empire, but was in fact wanted by both sides.

A Dark Jedi Master served the Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War. He was in charge of the Sith Embassy on the planet Manaan, and was also responsible for the dark side education of several young Selkath.
Ellik was a female Human who worked for the Republic Intelligence.

Onyx was a male Zygerrian slave trader and a captain of a slave vessel. During the Clone Wars, he encountered a group of Jedi consisting of Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Ahsoka Tano who were searching for the missing people of Kiros.
A Nautolan female Force-user lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Tingel was the codename of a Rebel operative who formed and lead the Tingel's Ghost resistance cell on Mrlsst in the Tapani sector

Ap Kormar played center for the Quent Assassins shockball team. He was a non-Human. When a distant Moff suspected Kormar of harboring Rebel sympathies, he arranged for Kormar to be assassinated by a team of seven individuals posing as Shad Furies fans.
Lorne Prestar was a Human male, who was the Chief of Security in Mos Taike on Tatooine, and a Mos Taike veteran guard during the Galactic Civil War.

A male Human using the call sign Red Leader was an X-wing starfighter pilot who commanded the Alliance of Free Planets Red Squadron during a battle with forces of the Galactic Empire over what appeared to be a third Death Star battle station.

Hirib Bassot was a media pundit broadcasting on the HoloNet. On a political show, Bassot argued that the threat of the Separatist armies was overinflated, and hinted that this was part of a government propaganda effort to continue the Clone Wars beyond reasonable means to main…
Teek was a Zygerrian slave trader who served aboard captain Onyx's ship during the Clone Wars. He was captured with the rest of the crew by Jedi Knights Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.
Ikis was a male Zygerrian slave trader who served aboard captain Onyx's ship as a mechanic during the Clone Wars.

Arhul Crace was a lieutenant in the Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War. Along with a squad of stormtroopers, he was sent to capture the leading members of the Osaji Syndicate and tracked them through Tirahnn and Centares, before confronting Osaji Hux on Muskree.

Snowmass was an albino rancor in Molpol's Traveling Circus. After the Black Hole Pirates forced a landing by a small fleet of ships maintained by the circus to land on the moon of Regosh, the pirates stole the circus' lander.
A Human male Imperial officer succeeded Admiral Amise Griff as the commander of the Super Star Destroyer Executor shortly after its completion in 0 ABY.

Tenebrae—known to the Old Sith Empire as Darth Vitiate, his reconstituted Sith Empire as the Sith Emperor, Vitiate, and his Eternal Empire as the Immortal Emperor, Valkorion—was an ancient dark-side entity of enormous power who manipulated galactic affairs for nearly 1,500 years.

Margan was a diplomat from the planet of Shawken, and a part of Santor's government in 4 ABY. Margan was present during Santor's meeting with diplomats from the Alliance of Free Planets, and proposed Santor to represent Shawken in the new galactic government.
Tan Dicium was a Human princeling from Sifuchi. During the Galactic Civil War, he traveled to Tirahnn to visit the Great Tirahnn Fair along with his four Yuzzem bodyguards.

Dania Francis was a female Iskalonian from one of the eleven minor species in the School. In 4 ABY, Dania Francis was the chief aide and lover of Iskalonian First to Swim, Mone. She discovered that Kiro had indeed survived from his trip to Kinooine and had returned to Iskalon.

Boar Benu was a resistance leader after Anakin Skywalker became Darth Vader. In 18 BBY, he perished during a meeting of resistance leaders on the secret asteroid that Ferus Olin and Trever Flume set up together with others as a secret base for planning operations against Galac…
Pilia Tonth was the captain of the Imperial Survey Corps Far*Reach IV PQR Wanderer at the time of its crash on the crystalline world of Isis.
Stripe was the name of a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. They were recognized among their brothers by a white-colored stripe on their black hair.
Bouncer was the name of a clone trooper who served on the planet Pastil in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars.

Flissar was a Noghri who worked as a caretaker at a warehouse in New Nystao on Wayland in 12 ABY. Dal Konur broke into the warehouse by using a mind trick on Flissar and then stealing the Noghri's keys.

Ingah Muloha was a Human female who served as a commanding officer of an Imperial stormtrooper garrison on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Troopers under her command discovered a Bafforr tree grove created by Momaw Nadon in the desert and informed Muloha.

Centa Sonhan was a male Gamorrean crime lord and an Imperial sympathizer who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. At some point during the war, Imperial commander Ingah Muloha contacted him, asking him to help capture the Ithorian Momaw Nadon.
Begas Tok was a Human Male crime lord on the planet Entralla.
Reeho was a male Human who worked for the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Ishale Meahonon was a scout serving under Captain Pilia Tonth aboard the Far*Reach IV PQR Wanderer when it crashed on Isis.

Donher Ty was a Human male who was employed by crime lord Centa Sonhan on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He was the chief mechanic aboard Centa Sonhan's sail barge. He was on board when the sail barge was attacked by agents of the Rebel Alliance.

Ladira was a female Devaronian Information broker, who operated in Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War. She pretended to be sympathetic to both the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, so that she could get business from both factions.

Matiby Silcap was a Human male snowtrooper major within the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps. He participated in the Battle of Hoth during the Galactic Civil War as part of the Imperial Blizzard Force, and was killed by Rebel troops inside Echo Base.
Blainekie was a professor, who worked as a researcher for the Rebel Alliance, stationed at Echo Base. He investigated wampas in Wampa Valley during the lead-up to the Battle of Hoth.
Kentara was a male Wookiee who became a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Monsurra was a male Wookiee artisan who served as the tailor of the Myyydril tribe during the years prior to the Clone Wars. He was infected by the Poltur Virus.
Montacca was a male Wookiee ex-mercenary with an out-of-the-ordinary fascination with technology of all sorts, going so far as to touch the technology of near-strangers out of intense curiosity.
Syychi was a female albino Wookiee. She stood nearly 2.4 meters tall, and was generally a silent individual when her temper was not aroused.

This unidentified warrior was a Yuuzhan Vong commander who fought at the Battle of the World-Well. He refused to use poison against Ganner Rhysode because he found it dishonorable, and he knew that it could kill the World Brain.
Klime was the Imperial governor of the Ishanna system.
Nial Pedrin was a male Human Imperial major who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Sona Lerenga was a scout serving aboard the Imperial Survey Corps Far*Reach IV PQR Wanderer at the time of its crash on the crystalline world of Isis.
Rengor Talke was a scout serving on the Imperial Survey Corps Far*Reach IV PQR Wanderer at the time of its crash on the crystalline world of Isis.
Brektate was the pilot of the Imperial Survey Corps vessel Wanderer at the time of its crash on the crystalline world of Isis. Brektate died in the crash of the ship.
Esteren Higgs was a Human male engineer of the Imperial Survey Corps vessel Wanderer at the time of its crash on the crystalline world of Isis.
Higgs, also known to his owner Pelf Pachoola as Higgsie, was a male Kobarian swamp dog who was born during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Tilotny was one of the non-corporeal spirits that inhabited a region near the Bedlam Pulsar and the first of her kind to take on a shape as they experimented with time and space.

A Kerkoiden commander served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, the commander participated in the Battle of Christophsis and commanded battle droids from his Armored Assault Tank.
Tenno was a young Human male, born and raised on the planet of Ceriun around 1000 BBY.
Tobb Jadak was a Human male from Balmorra and one-time pilot of the Stellar Envoy during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Membe was a violent Aqualish who took refuge for the night in Tosche Station on Tatooine during a particularly violent sandstorm.
Verzon Tennd was freighter pilot from Naboo who took refuge for a night in Tosche Station on Tatooine, along with his droid R2-D9, during a particularly violent sandstorm.

Wilk was a male sentient wolf from the Forest Moon of Endor who was born a mutant. Upon the discovery of Wilk's mutation, his mother abandoned him, leaving him to fend for himself. Wilk was then found by the hermit Bloch, who took him in and taught him how to speak.
Grembae's son was a mechanic of the Yedagon Confederacy. He made delta-shaped wedges on Wedge Antilles's helmet as a decorative motif before the Adumari Civil War.

Norlin Wennen was a male Human and the father of Republic Treasury Audit Division Besany Wennen. When Besany was ten years old, Norlin's wife left them sometime after their vacation to the jewel-caves of Birsingrial.

This individual was the female Human wife of Norlin Wennen and the mother of Republic Treasury agent Besany Wennen. She left their family shortly after their vacation to the jewel-caves of Birsingrial.
Yelnor was the second-in-command of the Independent Company of Settlers, while Natasi Daala was President of it.
Darth Reave was a Devaronian Sith Lord who served as a member of Darth Krayt's One Sith in 137 ABY. During the Second Imperial Civil War, Reave was stationed on the Deep Core world of Had Abbadon.

Splendid Ap was one of the four Bedlam Spirits that inhabited the region near the Bedlam Pulsar. During the Galactic Civil War, they learned to take on physical forms and encountered Princess Leia Organa on the planet Bedlam, where she had been forced to land by Imperial forces.
Iponta was a Gutretee warrior living on Isis during the Galactic Civil War.
Yustavan was the shaman of Iponta's tribe.

A blonde-haired, blue-eyed Human was an Imperial Knight who served Emperor Roan Fel of the Empire-in-exile during the Second Imperial Civil War. In 137 ABY, she sparred with Fel on the Imperial fortress world of Bastion—the planet of the Empire-in-exile.
This unknown male with a wispy-beard was an Adumari who served as the Minister of Cognitive Machinery for the nation of Cartann on the planet Adumar.
Chreeto, also known as the self-titled Chreeto the Defiant, was a Rodian bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War.

Z'ozpheratu was a yellow-eyed male Twi'lek who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he helped organize the Galactic Moon Festival in Mos Eisley and Moenia in the name of Jabba the Hutt himself.

Lobar "Ion Fist" Aybock was a male Calian from Shiva IV. During the Galactic Civil War, Aybock was captured by Imperial forces during the destruction of his hometown of K'avor. Deemed unworthy to be a stormtrooper, Aybock was put into the service of Zygerrian slavers.
This unidentified man was a consort to Hapan Lady Galney, but was secretly a spy for the Heritage Council, a group of Hapan nobles bent on overthrowing Hapan Queen Mother Tenel Ka Djo.
This Jedi was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during its final years. His apprentice, Kento Marek, outlived him by several years following the Jedi's death during the Great Jedi Purge.
Aren Folee was a female Antarian Ranger and an ally of the Republic Group stationed on Toprawa in Salik City.

Ensign Hocce was a Human male medical technician who served aboard Death Star I during the Galactic Civil War. He looked older than his years, with shoulders bent over, as though carrying the weight of the Death Star on his back.
Dezix was an Imperial Security Bureau officer serving aboard Death Star I.
Calders was a Human security guard who served in the Galactic Empire's detention camps on the planet Odik II, quickly moving up the ranks and becoming the entire prison facility's warden.
This unknown individual was a lean male Adumari man with an artificial leg, the result of being hit with shrapnel from his own Blade-28 after ejecting from the disintegrating fighter.
Tontruk was an Esoomian shockboxer. Some time between 3 ABY and 6 ABY, Calian shockboxer Lobar Aybock defeated Tontruk during the second phase of a bout on the planet Vycinyth.

Eedund Cus was a male Chevin. Some time after 3 ABY, Cus purchased Lobar Aybock from Zygerrian slavers in order to train him as a shockboxer. Aside from teaching Aybock the art of shockboxing, Cus also taught the Calian to speak Basic and understand Aurebesh.
Horliss-Horliss was one of the four Bedlam Spirits, transdimensional beings that resided in the Bedlam Pulsar and appeared to have completely omnipotent powers over time and matter.

Preena Jallop owned Preena's Repair Bay on the planet Vaynai during the Galactic Civil War period. She also operated an educational facility known as Preena's Academy that sought to teach impoverished children the skills required to make a living as a repair technician.
Bratt was a commander in the Grand Army of the Republic who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Emil Kerseage was the pilot of the shuttle that brought Kinman Doriana to Cartao. After the First Battle of Geonosis the transport company Kerseage had owned had been run out of business by a poorly worded regulation the Prackla Trade Council had issued.
Azook of Denden was a Swokes Swokes caliph. A stash of firegems was rumored to lie beneath his memorial stela in the Tract of Makem Te.

Gueni was the leader of the Daan Council in 44 BBY during the long-time Melida/Daan Civil War. He was forced to wear a breath mask to keep him alive due to injuries received during the war. His grandson, Rica, was a member of the Young.
Rica was the grandson of Gueni, who lead the Daan faction of the ongoing Melida/Daan Civil War in 44 BBY.
Roenni was a young girl who was a member of the Young. When Qui-Gon Jinn left the underground to meet with the Melida and Daan leaders, he asked Roenni to care about the injured Tahl.

Stitchy was a Gungan doctor from Naboo. Prior to the rise of the Galactic Empire, Stitchy served as court physician for Queen Apailana. Losing his job during the Imperial occupation, Stitchy went on to become the medic for champion shockboxer Lobar Aybock.

Resik was a male Jillsarian bartender at the Broken Tusk circa 6 ABY. Having been harassed multiple times by the Galactic Empire, Resik was an occasional informant to the Rebel Alliance and later New Republic.
Mygo Skinto was a female Human who devoted her life to helping the disaffected children of various war-torn worlds. This stemmed from the disappearance of her parents at an early age.

Magar Jaros was a Sullustan male counterfeiter operating in 10 ABY. He was wanted for forgery and criminal conspiracy, although he maintained he performed the forgery because of the "creative challenge." He used computerized magnifocals to correct his defective vision.

Valis Lorn was a criminal operating in 10 ABY. Lorn's operations covered the planet Andasala. Lorn's associate, Sires Vant, operated as a loan shark there. Lorn also sent Gamorrean slave Ughok Snorg to work as a henchman for one of his main agents on Andalasa.

Amm Natejeka was a Human Rebel Alliance Fleet captain and the commanding officer of the GR-75 medium transport Treasure Trove, stationed at the Alliance High Command headquarters of Echo Base on the ice planet Hoth by 3 ABY.
Juhm was a Muun male who served as an overseer of the Gwori shipyards on the planet Gwori during the Clone Wars.

Tracer was the adopted name of a BTL-B Y-wing starfighter clone trooper pilot who served in the Republic Navy's Hunter Squadron during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, Hunter Squadron was assigned to destroy the Banking Clan shipyards at Gwori.

Toomer was a clone trooper who the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, Toomer was a member of a Jedi-led Republic strike team that went to the planet Gwori in an attempt to pinpoint the location of local Confederate shipyards and target them for destruction…
Dina Mertz was a female Human chief tech officer in Cularin system's criminal Organization. She was a pretty young girl who tied her hair in two bouncing but stiff tails that looked similar to lekku.
Mirax was a male Kajain'sa'Nikto who was an enslaved worker at the Shipyards of Gwori during the Clone Wars.
Kirraa was a female Human slave who worked at the Shipyards of Gwori during the Clone Wars.
Tavik Moern was a male Human who worked for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars until he joined the Galactic Empire after the war ended.
This Imperial admiral served under the command of Darth Angral during the Sacking of Coruscant.
Tekkur was a male Quarren who worked as a bouncer in the Invisible Hand cantina on Coruscant.
Klef was a Gran male who lived with his family in the Gnawer's Roost district of Coruscant and who worked as a bartender in the Invisible Hand cantina.
Ziss't was a male Trandoshan who worked as a laborer and lived in the Gnawer's Roost district of Coruscant.
Q'elliss was a Trandoshan who worked as a laborer and lived in the Gnawer's Roost district of Coruscant.
Kar'eme was a Corellian Human male lieutenant in the Imperial Security Bureau during the Imperial era.

Misha Vekkian was a Human female who trained as a Jedi Padawan during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. After the formation of the Galactic Empire, she was turned to the dark side by the Inquisitorius, a group of Dark Side Adepts who served as the Empire's Jedi hunters.
Lily Langtree was a red-haired human female entertainer from the planet Kiss who served as an undercover agent for the Galactic Empire during the Rebellion era.

The father of Lobar Aybock was a male Calian who lived on Shiva IV. He fought in constant conflicts between the Calian Confederacy and Twelve Tribes of T'Syriél. His son Lobar Aybock was a Calian who went on the become a successful shockboxer.
Lady Marri was a fictional Adumari female Human who holodocumentarian Hallis Saper fooled New Republic pilot Wes Janson into thinking that sent him a private letter.

Melen Toobo was the head of the Coruscant Wildlife Management Department during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He had the department carry out a secret project on Coruscani ogres, to try and turn them into cyborg laborers.

Tisocco was a male Reussi who worked for New Republic Intelligence. In 6 ABY he was part of a mission led by Major Bren Derlin to stop the illegal organ donation trade being perpetuated on the Reussi by crime lord Torel Vorne and the Reuss Corporation.

Vin Tal'benes was a male Bothan and the main authority figure in the asteroid repair station Darkside, which was in turn under the control of Nirama's criminal Organization. Tal'benes was a short, dark-furred Bothan who commonly touched his goatee in a tic.
Nala Noos was a female Trandoshan resident of the Cularin asteroid belt.
Kaarl was a male Ithorian and a member of Nirama's criminal Organization who worked on the Darkside asteroid station.

Bli'Mora was a male Cerean and a member of Nirama's criminal Organization who worked on the Darkside asteroid station. He was mostly a paranoid, disgruntled, austere person who did not like to drink even in the traditional drunkenness of paydays.
Cold Danda Sine was one of the four Bedlam Spirits, transdimensional beings that resided in the Bedlam Pulsar and appeared to have completely omnipotent powers over time and matter.
Gilac was a man who aspired to be an ace starfighter pilot.
Bartle was a male Coruscani ogre who resided on the planet Coruscant during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Nysis Belzara was a male Bothan Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. Around 31 BBY, Belzara greeted a starship arriving on the planet Coruscant that was transporting a Mandalorian iron box on behalf of the Jedi.
Blaise was a male individual who served the Believers Sith-worshipping cult during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.
Colara was a female Wookiee who was employed as a bouncer in Saludi's, a cantina in the Coruscant Undercity. Around 31 BBY, while on duty at Saludi's, Colara ejected a drunken Gamorrean from the bar.

Dure was a Trandoshan who lived in the Coruscant Undercity. After a speeder flown by a group of Believers crashed in the Undercity, a group of spacers that were pursuing it arrived shortly afterwards and Krood was among a group including the Human Ilok, the Coruscani ogre Bart…
Es'Loma was a Tarasin female member of the Wyrd, a coven of Force witches that operated on the world Cularin during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Bleth Fahr was a Force-sensitive male Omwati who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. Fahr served the Jedi Order but later abandoned the Jedi and joined the Believers, a Sith-worshipping cult that operated in the Cularin system.
Ilok was a male Human who lived on the planet Coruscant during the last years of the Galactic Republic. Around 31 BBY, Ilok witnessed a speeder crash in the Coruscant undercity.

Krood was a Trandoshan who lived in the Coruscant underworld. After a speeder flown by a group of Believers crashed in the Undercity, a group of spacers who were pursuing it arrived shortly afterward and Krood—along with the Human Ilok, the Coruscani ogre Bartle and the Trando…

Malyas was a male Human who served the Believers Sith-worshipping cult during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. Around 31 BBY, Malyas was attacked and defeated at a secret Believer hideout in the undercity of the planet Coruscant by a group of spacers.

Chez O'nder was a male Human who worked as a bartender in the cantina Saludi's on the planet Coruscant during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. Around 31 BBY, O'nder encountered a group of Jedi-allied agents who had ventured to Saludi's while tracking some Sith cultists.

Sounac was a Trandoshan who lived in the Coruscant Undercity. After a speeder flown by a group of Believers crashed in the Undercity, a group of spacers that were pursuing it arrived shortly afterwards and Krood was among a group including the human Ilok, the Coruscani ogre Ba…

Wojarra was a Wookiee male who lived during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. Around 31 BBY, Wojarra joined the crew of a starship that was to ferry a Mandalorian iron box from the planet Almas to the world of Coruscant on behalf of the Jedi Order.
Teepo was a male Jedi Lord and a member of the Jedi Order who lived during the New Sith Wars, fighting alongside Lord Hoth as part of the Army of Light.

Duumas was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order around the time of the Ruusan Reformation. Circa 1002 BBY, Duumas foretold the coming of the powerful child Caeleb sacrificed himself on the planet Dalicron-4 to create a spot devoid of the Force for the boy to live at.

Jhor-Kai was an elderly Human Jedi. He lived to an old age, surviving on the planet Altikar IV, and eventually called through the Force to a young Twi'lek girl, Sha'lia, asking her to be his apprentice.
This Falleen male was the King of Falleen during the Clone Wars.
Zoalin was a male commander who served in the New Republic Defense Fleet aboard the Adamantine. In 13 ABY, he was aboard the ship when it traveled to Nam Chorios as part of a New Republic task force.

Dalia was the leader of a group of Inner Rim colonists who settled the planet Dalicron-4, approximately 800 years before the Galactic Civil War. The colonists hoped to escape the hectic life of the Galactic Republic.
Marshak was a friend of Lando Calrissian. He was a Corellian smuggler, and tricked Han Solo, misinforming him of the true nature of the Kessel Run.
Danna Fajji was the Baron Administrator of Hologram Fun World during the Galactic Civil War. He was a short, rotund man with rosy cheeks and a scruffy red goatee.
