Fumiyo was a Godoan male who was the only known member of his species to speak Galactic Basic. As such, when the Alliance of Free Planets arrived on his planet to attempt to help the citizens in their fight with Godoan's disease, Fumiyo helped inform the Alliance of the plight…

Cix Trouvee was a male human gambler and pilot of the YT-1300 light freighter Millennium Falcon during the Imperial Era. In 5 BBY he took part in the battle of Yag'Dhul, betting on the outcome of the skirmish in a contest set up by a group of Hutts.

Wuglik was a Gamorrean, who lived on Dorumaa. He worked in Dorumaa Spaceport, as a cargo handler for Intergalactic Freight. He was a patron of the Cantina Oceana, which he visited several times a week.
Yatter was an Ithorian who lived on Dorumaa. He worked for the Dorumaa Ecological Renovation Team and would spend his days researching and investigating Dorumaa's various species of flora and fauna.
Otee Nom was a female Rodian Force Adept who lived in the Cularin system around 31 BBY. She helped train other Force adepts as organized by Taleah Novran and Lony Hertz.

Chay Tebbic was a female Sullustan who worked as a bartender in the Cantina Oceana in Dorumaa City on Dorumaa. After she had worked there for several years, she witnessed a fight between Echari Di'San and Rysko Barnt in the cantina.

Hukno Rit was a male Human who worked as a waiter in the Cantina Oceana on Dorumaa. The Zabrak Thon Larimhor paid him to provoke a Cularin Trade Alliance pilot into beating him up, which resulted in Rit receiving a few broken ribs and some bruises.
Sai Sircu was a member of the Nightsisters of Dathomir during the time of the Clone Wars.
Yansu Grjak was a member of the Nightsisters of Dathomir during the time of the Clone Wars.
Pearce Naturian was a male doctor who worked in Polis Massa's medical facility and reportedly an old friend of the Jedi Master Yoda. He remained loyal to the Galactic Republic.
Kalani was a Human female who lived on Dorumaa.

affiliation: Department of Merchant Safety and Security
x: Solen Kove was a Twi'lek who worked for the Cularin Trade Alliance as Director of the Department of Merchant Safety and Security.

An Adarian child lived in Makrin City, the capital of the planet Shelkonwa in 0 ABY. One day, when housebreakers tried to break into an apartment of a theater's employee, Leia Organa—who hid from the Empire in Shelkonwa—felt obligated to save the child.
Echari Di'San was a Vultan who was President of the Cularin Trade Alliance during the time of the Clone Wars.
Dec was a male Human clone commando sergeant in command of Vevut Squad during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Yanix Dev was a distribution manager for the Karazak Slavers Cooperative in 6 ABY. He sold captured slaves, although he appeared to be an expensively-clothed businessperson. Some people believed his great ego would be his downfall one day.
Avril Gresh was a male Human farmer who became a acquisitions specialist for the Karazak Slavers Cooperative.
Although Ir's origin was a mystery, he was believed to be a pariah in his hive.

Janissa Locrin was a reclusive holovid star who used Devaronian watchbeasts to protect her house. Even with that security measures, Seland' Ir from the Karazak Slavers Cooperative organized a raid in her home to kidnap her, so that they could ask the producers for a ransom.
Fenrij was a member of the Karazak Slavers Cooperative. Fenrij took part in an operation to kidnap holovid star Janissa Locrin, following Seland' Ir's scheme.
Keshid was a male member of the Karazak Slavers Cooperative. He took part in an operation to kidnap holovid star Janissa Locrin, following Seland' Ir's scheme.

Kimp Minmirn was a Quarren scientist who aided Imperial Lieutenant Mils Giel in developing deadly Tirrith on Beheboth. In 8 ABY, Giel and his aide, Malka, decided that the Quarren's usefulness had ended, and killed him.
Turino was a Swokes Swokes caliph, one of several who ruled over various portions of the city Thousand Thousand on the planet Makem Te. The caliph lived in a palace in the center of the city.
Ullu was a Swokes Swokes caliph, one of several who ruled over various portions of the city Thousand Thousand on the world Makem Te. The caliph lived in a palace at the center of the city.

Verken was a Swokes Swokes caliph, one of several who ruled over various portions of the city Thousand Thousand on the planet Makem Te. The caliph lived in a palace in the northern portion of the city.
Wuckem was a Swokes Swokes caliph, one of several who ruled over various portions of the city Thousand Thousand on the planet Makem Te. The caliph lived in a palace at the center of the city.
Zugen was a Swokes Swokes caliph, one of several who ruled over various portions of the city Thousand Thousand on the planet Makem Te. The caliph lived in a palace an the center of the city.
Pyash Yopayomba was a female Quara pirate on the planet Ando, where she was known as the Pirate Queen of Ando. Her flagship was the Majestic.
Saber was the alias of a female Twi'lek Republic Strategic Information Service agent active during the Cold War.

A wampa fought in the Cauldron arena on the planet Rattatak in 22 BBY, at the same time that Asajj Ventress entered the battle. The wampa attempted to kill Ventress after she had slain all the other gladiators, but before it could do so, it was cut down by Giant Flog.
Organa was the male Human Viceroy of Alderaan before he was succeeded by his son, Bail Organa. He was also the father of Rouge, Tia and Celly Organa.
Burdo Loquoy was a male Human moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine with his wife Lorna and his daughter Jent.
Lorna Loquoy was a female Human moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine along with her husband Burdo and her daughter Jent.

Jent Loquoy was a female Human who lived on Tatooine along with her moisture farmer parents Burdo Loquoy and Lorna Loquoy. She owned a T-16 skyhopper and had a reputation among her friends as a hot-shot pilot who would sometimes exaggerate things for effect.

Tholote B'Leph was a politician who served as an opposition leader on the planet Ter Abbes during the reign of the New Republic. The Yuuzhan Vong agent Nom Anor hired Goran Beviin to assassinate B'Leph, whose death resulted in a year-long civil war.
Wassak was a Jawa who lived on Tatooine and liked to tell a story about how he once encountered a group of seemingly intelligent womp rats.
Pleni was a female Human native of the planet New Apsolon during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Bier was an individual who lived during the waning decades of the Galactic Republic. He was a miner who worked for the Offworld Mining Corporation on an offshore mine on the planet Bandomeer in 44 BBY. While mapping the ocean floor of Bandomeer, his aquasuit's oxygen ran out.
Andoran was a male and was a regular visitor of Didi Oddo's café.
Nadarr was a male and a regular patron of Didi Oddo's café.
Pilus was a regular patron of Didi Oddo's café. He was known to have made a fortune as a smuggler.

Kin Kian was a Human Rebel pilot who served in Aggressor Squadron and Rogue Squadron. In 4 ABY, he participated in the Battle of Endor, serving as the gunner for Gray Leader Colonel Horton Salm's BTL Y-wing starfighter as part of the Alliance Fleet component that attacked the …
Kin Kian was a Sullustan male gunner who served in Aggressor Wing six months after the Battle of Endor.
Syub Kyak was a Sullustan who worked for the SoroSuub Corporation.
Pinkie was a Gamorrean female who served as an enforcer in the crew of Dahara the Hutt.
The bartender at Locru's Central Saloon was a grizzled Human male. He made no protest nor demand for reparations after Warto and Han Solo started a bar fight.
Aril Kyak was a female Sullustan who was the wife of Syub Kyak and the mother of Fiev Kyak and Sien Kyak.

Fiev Kyak was a Sullustan, who was the son of Aril Kyak and Syub Kyak, and the brother of Sien Kyak. During the Clone Wars, he went on vacation in the Cularin system with his family and stayed aboard the space yacht Crest of Dawn.

Sien Kyak was a Sullustan, who was the son of Aril Kyak and Syub Kyak, and the brother of Fiev Kyak. During the Clone Wars, he went on vacation in the Cularin system with his family and stayed aboard the space yacht Crest of Dawn.
Amasi was a female Tarasin who was a member of the Wyrd. She wore street clothes and was armed with a blaster and a dagger.
Kua was a female Tarasin who was a member of the Wyrd. She wore jungle clothes and was armed with a blaster and a dagger.

Lady VenHalgon was the wife of the aristocrat Sargo VenHalgon and she lived with him in Cinnagar. During the Clone Wars, they went on vacation to the Cularin system and stayed aboard the Cularin Star Tours yacht Twilight's Kiss.

Cannison was a Minister who was married to Mrs Cannison and joined Lord Sargo VenHalgon on a vacation to the Cularin system around the time of the Clone Wars. They landed on Cularin and Cannison, VenHalgon and Worrita went off hunting.

Worrita was a professor who was married to Mrs. Worrita and joined Lord Sargo VenHalgon on a vacation to the Cularin system around the time of the Clone Wars. They landed on Cularin, where Worrita, VenHalgon and Cannison went off hunting.

Mrs. Worrita was the wife of Worrita and she accompanied her husband aboard the yacht Twilight's Kiss in the Cularin system when he traveled there with Sargo VenHalgon for a vacation. VenHalgon had the Kiss land on Cularin and went off hunting with her husband.

Mrs. Cannison was the wife of Cannison and she accompanied her husband aboard the yacht Twilight's Kiss in the Cularin system when he traveled there with Sargo VenHalgon for a vacation. VenHalgon had the Kiss land on Cularin and went off hunting with her husband.

Xirossk was a Trandoshan who served in the Cularin Militia as a Major during the Clone Wars and commanded its Militia Intelligence division. He once coordinated an operation to locate bases used by the Wyrd in the Cularin jungle.
1137 was a clone trooper who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
1139 was a clone trooper who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Gammack was a Mon Calamari Captain who served in the Third Battalion during the Battle of Calamari in the Galactic Civil War.
C fire 4 was the callsign for a pilot that fought in the Battle of Calamari in the Galactic Civil War.
Vreet Harak was a third-generation male Human nerf herder who worked for the Grand Horn Ranch Corporation on Fennesa. He had the appearance of a typical nerf herder and did not smell that nice.
Nar Hida's daughter was the daughter of Luptoomian clothing salesman Nar Hida.
Nar Hida's wife was the wife of Luptoomian clothing salesman Nar Hida. They had a daughter together.

Janus Greejatus's father was a male Human from Chommell Minor and the father of Janus Greejatus, who would become a member of the Imperial Ruling Council following the Clone Wars and the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Varesk Bura'lya was a male Bothan undersecretary who worked for the Bothan embassy on the planet Coruscant. Shortly after the formation of the Empire, he feared for his life and contacted the resistance movement Whiplash seeking help for safe passage offworld.
Mowan Mowadon was an Ithorian transport pilot.

Garrus Tharydine was a male Human admiral who oversaw the occupation of the planet Mon Calamari. It was Tharydine who carried out the Emperor's orders to destroy three cities floating on the planet's surface when local resistance was formed on the planet.

Thune was a Human female bounty hunter who owned and operated the starship Faceted. As a youth, she had hoped to one day enroll in the Imperial Academy and serve the Galactic Empire with honor, but her hopes were dashed as she was continually passed over in favor of men.

Bloch was a hermit who lived on the forest moon of Endor. In his old age, he encountered a mutant Wolf named Wilk. Wilk had somehow acquired sentience, and Bloch taught the wolf how to speak. With Bloch as his teacher, Wilk learned about the world around him.

El Borak was the friend of the mutant Wolf, Wilk. The two roamed the galaxy together, until they came in contact with Doctor Ames. The two friends allowed themselves to be recruited by the doctor into helping him complete an insane quest.

Doctor Ames was a male scientist active during the height of the Galactic Empire. He eventually came into contact with El Borak and Wilk, a mutant Wolf that had acquired the ability to speak. Ames recruited the two into helping him complete an insane quest.
Sharpie was a humanoid female whose body was covered in bone spurs which resembled knives. She visited Canto Bight in 34 ABY.

Meeko was a Talz who served as the servant of criminal Didina Lippinoss. In 2 ABY, Crev Bombaasa, another criminal working for Shalera the Hutt, one of Lippinoss's competitors, sent a spacer to meet with Meeko in the wilderness of Corellia.

Morrng was a Trandoshan bounty hunter. He was a member of the Bounty Hunters Guild, but was quite inexperienced. Sometime following 0 BBY, he was hired by Didina Lippinoss to kill Crev Bombaasa, who had been blackmailing her.

Didina Lippinoss was a criminal on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. Operating from the city of Tyrena, she performed various unsavory tasks for Corporate Sector Authority Viceprex Karrek Flim, which eventually brought her into direct conflict with aspiring crime lord Cr…
Garth Ezzar was a Human male Dark Jedi who served the Sith Lord Darth Sidious during the time of the Clone Wars. Raised on a Rim Worlds colony, Ezzar was bullied by other children from a young age.
Garth Ezzar's master was a female Dark Jedi who trained Garth Ezzar.

A clone trooper served in Green Company, a unit in the Grand Army of the Republic, during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Separatist Council member Nute Gunray was captured on the planet Rodia, and the Venator-class Star Destroyer Tranquility was dispatched to the planet.
Darth Vitus was an individual who became a Sith at some point before the time of the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War, at which point he was considered an ancient Sith.
Sarn Vals was a Quarren Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Blark was male Wookiee soldier and weapon dealer who worked for the Organization in 32 BBY.
Gorssk was a Trandoshan male who worked in Rothe Gate, a weapon storage asteroid for the criminal Organization. He was an underachiever, as most Trandoshans in Rothe Gate were believed to be.
Cyria Dombasle was a female Human working as inventory supervisor in the weapon storage asteroid Rothe Gate, in the Cularin asteroid belt.
Maarten Haal was a male Human working as inventory supervisor in the weapon storage asteroid Rothe Gate, in the Cularin asteroid belt.
Gal O'Wei was a female Sullustan who was working as security specialist in the weapon storage asteroid of Rothe Gate, in the Cularin asteroid belt.
Plu Markeela was a male Ithorian working as operations manager in the weapon storage asteroid Rothe Gate, in the Cularin asteroid belt.

NT-757 was a Human Imperial stormtrooper who wielded an E-11 blaster rifle during the Galactic Civil War. A fearless soldier in the Stormtrooper Corps, NT-757 had a knack for controlling local populations during important Imperial operations.

Reeze Duurmun was a Human male who was Tobb Jadak's co-pilot during their missions for the Republic Group aboard the Stellar Envoy, he was previously known to have flown spice, making the acquaintance of crime boss Rej Taunt.
Jodoo Kreen was a male Quermian Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic throughout the Clone Wars.

Ari Melast was a female sentient and one of the lieutenants of crimelord Nirama. Unbeknownst to Nirama, Melast was a member of The Cell, a faction of his criminal Organization that aimed to oust and replace Nirama, and restore slavery to the Cularin system.

A member of Darth Krayt's New Sith Order, this Devaronian Sith was part of a group that attacked Emperor Roan Fel during the execution of Operation: Thunderstroke on the planet Agamar. He fought against Imperial Knight Azlyn Rae but was killed in the process.
Cheelru was powerful Tarasin Force witch and a member of the Inner Circle of the Wyrd. By 19 BBY her commitment to the Dark side of the Force had driven her insane.
Carlton was a Human male smuggler who operated near the Imperial Encampment on Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Andershan was a male Mon Calamari who attained the rank of general within the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He briefed a teams of Rebels on a mission to destroy the Imperial Data Processing Facility on Tazan.
Gavin Bresch was a male Human who served in the Cularin Militia as a lieutenant. He worked in the Militia's counterintelligence division under the leadership of General Xirossk.
Rydna was a male Human member of the Believers.

Cheese was a Sullustan female who led a group of Tunnel Rats in Tolea Biqua. In 19 BBY, she oversaw their interrogation of the captured Believer, Rydna. She was taller than most members of her species.
Karrek Flim was a Viceprex of the Corporate Sector Authority.
Sli'woon Biul was a Bothan informant who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

This Krath military officer served as Aleema Keto's attaché during the Krath's invasion of Coruscant in the Great Sith War. He was the the officer who relayed Keto's orders to Mandalore the Indomitable to withdraw his troops from that battle.
Vastin Caglio was a Human male who was the eldest son of Moff Jamson Caglio of the Bormea sector. He was engaged to marry Rivoche Tarkin, niece of the late Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, in 2 ABY.
Cham Teleus was a Tynnan industrialist who made a fortune on the Expansion Region planet Tynna along with their significant other Nog Teleus.
Nog Teleus was a Tynnan industrialist who made a fortune on Tynna along with Cham Teleus. Together, the pair decided to relocate to the Cularin system.

This unidentified Weequay was an employee of Barrga the Hutt, and served him as an enforcer. The Hutt crime lord sent the Weequay on a smuggling run during the Great Galactic War alongside the Nikto Musk.
Signaler was a subnode created by Kud'ar Mub'at to assist him. Signaler's main priorities were to notify Kud'ar Mub'at when a foreign ship was approaching his web.
Quip Fargil, later known as Vec Minim, was a Rebel agent and pilot, and the man who named the Millennium Falcon.

Dinky was a rancor who was kept as a pet by the criminal Nirama. He was kept in a holding cell in Nirama's public asteroid and was the father of Bender. After the asteroid was abandoned, Dinky escaped from his cell and ranged around the Red Sector area of the asteroid.
Grug was a Trandoshan thug. Along with the Trandoshan Gurg, he was hired by Len Markus in 19 BBY to attack the Heroes of Cularin in a hangar bay in the town of Hedrett on Cularin.
Gurg was a Trandoshan thug. Along with the Trandoshan Grug, he was hired by Len Markus in 19 BBY to attack the Heroes of Cularin in a hangar bay in the town of Hedrett on Cularin.

Acan was a blond-haired Human who worked as a courier. In 19 BBY, he was sent by Nirama to Hedrett on Cularin, to give a message to the Heroes of Cularin. He was killed shortly afterwards by the Trandoshan thugs, Grug and Gurg.
Xanai Sowan was a female Twi'lek who served as an engineer aboard the pirate ship Mourning Glory.
Zilnor was a scruffy Human scavenger who worked for the Rebel Alliance. On one occasion, he helped C-3PO find Fulstar plates. He wore an eye patch over his left eye.
Zephyrus was a slavemaster who, in 1100 BBY, outfitted the slave caravel Sickly Tremor with durasteel cages to bring slaves he claimed could heft a cargo skiff in one hand to Ovise III.
This Yinchorri commander was present during a plot by the Galactic Empire to assassinate Princess Leia Organa.
This Yinchorri pilot was involved in a plot by the Galactic Empire to kill Princess Leia Organa by luring her into a trap on the planet Yinchorr.

Kluuus was a Gamorrean soldier who served the Dark Jedi Len Markus in 19 BBY. The Darkstaff imbued Markus with some of the powers of a Sith battlelord, allowing him to not be hurt when Kluuus was alive and within thirty meters of him, as injuries inflicted on him, would instea…
Willer Clines was a male Human who lived on Tazan. He supported the Alliance to Restore the Republic and was the head of the Clines family.
Flaenella Clines was a Human female who was the daughter of Willer Clines and the older sister of Jastina Clines. Like her father, she was also a Rebel sympathizer.
Jastina Clines was a female who was the daughter of Willer Clines.

An Alderaanian served as a soldier and TIE pilot in the Galactic Empire. Although originally a servant in the household of the Royal family of Alderaan, he left the world to become a trooper in the Imperial Military.
Li-Suun Niik was a Human male crime lord operating on the banking planet of Aargau.
Goort was a Trandoshan working for the Rebel Alliance.
Sha'lia was a female Twi'lek Force-sensitive working for the Rebel Alliance.
Balazausa was a sentient female who, around 3 ABY, was a high-level bureaucrat within the Bank of Aargau, which was headquartered on the planet Aargau.
Meekah Hozard was a Duros who led the Blood Tachs swoop gang.
Grrandash was a Trandoshan Force Adept who worked as a pit-boss in the Prosperity Casino and Entertainment Center, aboard the Cularin Trade Alliance ship, the TAV Prosperity.

Niya Giedan was a male Duros. He was a facilitator during the Imperial occupation of Duros. He was later employed by Pri-Andylan Propulsion Systems and was known for keeping projects on schedule through his efficient and militaristic techniques.
Syril was a member of Alliance Intelligence. He debriefed C-3PO and R2-D2 regarding their participation in Operation Third Law.
Rrawkee was a Wookiee who lived on Cularin. He was a professional fighter and wore a bandolier with medallions and other tokens of his victory, to show off his fighting successes.

Verenar was a Corellian who was sent by BlasTech Industries to represent them at the Cularin Trade Show during the Clone Wars. He exhibited the companies DLT-20A blaster rifle and boasted about its enhanced damage capability. He was very proud to work for BlasTech.
Drokka was a Rodian who worked as a bounty hunter. He also worked for Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc., as a sales rep.

Nenneb was a Sullustan engineer who worked for the SoroSuub Corporation. He was sent to represent the company at the Cularin Trade Show during the Clone Wars and he exhibited their Firelance blaster rifle there.
Osten Dal'Nay was a Human male who served as one of the co-leaders of the Cularin Militia, after defecting from the Thaereian military during the Clone Wars.

Salovan Fische was a male Human pirate from Corellia who lived several centuries before the rise of the Empire. He was notable for establishing a secret base within the bowels of Resh 9376, a comet whose existence was largely unknown to galactic society.

Jallar Golin was a Human male Emperor's Hand who served Emperor Palpatine during the Galactic Civil War. Born in the turbulent Outer Rim Territories, Golin eventually joined the Imperial Army on Coruscant, where he caught the attention of the Emperor.

Jeeval was a male Rodian who served aboard the Rebel Alliance transport Griffon's Wings during the Galactic Civil War. At some point after the Battle of Yavin, Jeeval was killed over the planet Yorgraxx during an attack on Griffon's Wings by the Galactic Empire.
Pol Virten was a male Clawdite thief who, upon stealing a number of Sith artifacts from a museum, aspired to become a Dark Lord of the Sith.

Nar Chan was a Twi'lek Dreamdancer who lived at the Poloda Place apartment complex on the Galactic Republic capital planet Coruscant by 38 BBY. While there, Chan held unruly bacchanal events inside its court, each of which lasted for a week's time.
Arlumek was a male Cragmoloid who was the third son of Boulad, an information broker and slicer.

Boulad was a male Cragmoloid who worked as a slicer and information broker. During his hunt for the killer of Senator Padmé Amidala, Captain Typho paid Boulad five thousand credits for information regarding the whereabouts of any Sith at a specific time and planet.

Shulf'aa was a male Vernol merchant and art dealer. He owned two sculptures of famed light sculptor Ves Volette, which he obtained through illegal channels. Former journalist Den Dhur was arrested for impersonating a police officer while interrogating Shulf'aa for information.

The Sith Warrior, also known as the Dark Apprentice, was the incarnation—created through the Force—of the darkness that resided within Starkiller, a young Human male who was secretly trained in the ways of the dark side by the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

Sele was a male Cathar and the leader of the bodyguards for the criminal Spa Fon's. He wore a silver diadem with a single mangana aqua cabochon that signified his stature as the mightiest warrior of his clan. He fought former Jedi Jax Pavan upon the orders of Fon.
Spa Fon was a male Lonjair who dealt in stolen and wanted goods. He supplied art collector Shulf'aa with two Ves Volette light sculptures.
Regera Girawn was a Force-sensitive Kruskan noblewoman who turned to the dark side, becoming a Force Witch.

T'Teknulp was a Chadra-Fan Jedi General during the Clone Wars who fought in many perilous battles. When the planet Farquar III aligned with the Separatists, the Republic sent its forces to destroy a droid factory on the world, giving T'Teknulp command of a division of clone tr…
M'a Jong was a female Duros who owned a successful casino on the planet Elerion. Faced with numerous competitors, she commissioned projects to develop completely new games of chance.

Broon was a human male scrumrat of the White Worms gang on the Core Worlds planet Corellia. Around 13 BBY, they and the fellow human scrumrat Fixit helped prepare for a raid on a Corellia shipyard by monitoring the facility in shifts, often taking turns with the Rodian scrumra…
Hol't Deb Orah was a reporter who worked for the Corellia Times during the Galactic Civil War and was sent by them to report on Life Day.
Rule Davenbay was a male HoloNet News anchor working at Dateline Coruscant.
Shiana Trist was a female Human bounty hunter who operated during the Clone Wars.
Jasso Toryn was a Human male who served as a senator within the Galactic Senate, the governing body of the Galactic Republic.
A clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic who served under promoted Jedi Knight Nahdar Vebb and Commander Fil during the Clone Wars.

This Shawkenese Guard was a native of the planet Shawken. He was assigned to guard the entrance to an excavation site on the planet, but he neglected his post after being confronted by the Zeltron Dani.

This Shawkenese woman was native to the planet of Shawken and was an aide to the planet's unofficial leader, Santor. Following the Battle of Endor, she joined Santor and his other aide, Margan, during a meeting with diplomats from the Rebel Alliance.
A Bosph bounty hunter was among the many bounty hunters who answered Darth Vader's call to hunt Han Solo and the Millennium Falcon during the Hoth campaign of 3 ABY.

Greeley was the Director of Cartography and Surveying, Sector O-1, in the employ of the Galactic Republic. Greeley was the recipient of a Survey Team Report - STR 2434, completed by Commander Trask, recommending that the planet Trinta was unsuitable for Republic colonization.

This unidentified alien bounty hunter was among the many bounty hunter applicants who arrived aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor in 3 ABY to join the hunt for Han Solo and the Millennium Falcon.
This woman was the commanding officer of the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Redemption during the Galactic Civil War.
Gaza was a Human male who was a leading member of the ruling Herdessan Guild on his home planet of Herdessa during the Galactic Civil War.
Suzu was a Human female from Herdessa who was a major leader of a lower-class revolution that toppled the Herdessan Guild's rule over her homeworld in 4 ABY.
Finn was a Human male native of planet Herdessa, who helped lead a lower-class revolution that toppled the ruling Herdessan Guild in 4 ABY.
T'Seely was a male Hasikian Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.

Talia Moonseeker was a female Aargauun Jedi Knight who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Moonseeker was trained by Jedi Master Va'too and successfully passed the Jedi Trials, becoming a Knight.
Va'too was a Jedi Master who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Sometime before 22 BBY, the Jedi Master took the female Aargauun Talia Moonseeker as a Padawan apprentice.
Vokara Che was a female Twi'lek Jedi Master and a highly accomplished Jedi healer who served the Jedi Order at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during the time of the Clone Wars.

Olum was a Chief engineer in the Imperial military during the Galactic Civil War. He served aboard Blackguard, an Imperial-class Star Destroyer commanded by Grand Admiral Andal Sait. He was involved in the schemes of a Rodian smuggler Ubis Reendorr.
Gelune Blankuna was a Twi'lek agent of the Desilijic Hutt clan. She was married to Jer Blankuna.
Jylle Tend was a Human from Alderaan. Tend and Tend's relative Sumda bought a mansion in the orbit of Alderaan that the Desilijic Hutt clan had previously used.
Sumda Tend was a Human from Alderaan. Sumda and Sumda's relative Jylle Tend bought a mansion in the orbit of Alderaan that the Desilijic Hutt clan had previously used.
Davon Gitta was a Human bounty hunter and mercenary, and an employee of the Desilijic Hutt clan.

Kaeline Ungasan was a Human male employee from the Corporate Sector, a podracing producer, and an up-and-coming crime lord. He dared to defy the Hutt control over Ando Prime. At different points, he employed Benkudi, Ree, and Rikal Stargunner.

Benkudi was a Dug male criminal who operated in Mos Espa, Tatooine. He had worked for the Hutts and for Human aspiring crime lord Kaeline Ungasan. He was also a casual friend of Ree, a Twi'lek podracer working for the Hutts.

Rikal Stargunner was a Human male who worked as a bodyguard for the Corporate Sector Authority member and aspiring crime lord Kaeline Ungasan. When his boss tried to subvert the Desilijic Hutts' financial control over the planet Ando Prime, Stargunner accompanied him.
Byam Awson was a male Human and the local constable of Elesa, a town on Ando Prime, when Kaeline Ungasan began his project of the Ungasan Cross Country.

Geon Justic was a Human male who served as head of the Elesa Mining Union in the small mining town of Elesa, in Ando Prime. At that point, Justic had some professional relation with Feena Ghel, a local Rodian who owned a repair shop.
Feena Ghel was a female Rodian operating a repair shop in the mining town of Elesa, on Ando Prime.

Quorlac Fornayh was a male Near-Human Sith Lord who lived over a thousand years before the Galactic Civil War. After the course of a war with the Galactic Republic turned against the Sith, Fornayh took shelter at his hidden fortress on the planet Yorgraxx.
Daphry was a member of the Lok Revenants in 32 BBY.
Nolo was a mercenary employed by the Trade Federation around the time of the Invasion of Naboo.
Reese was a male member of the Lok Revenants around 32 BBY.

The Lunar Shadow Captain was a male Weequay who enjoyed frequenting the Jekk'Jekk Tarr; he was known to stay in the cantina until he lost consciousness, eventually stumbling back to his quarters in the flophouse located on the Nar Shaddaa Docks.

Frex Junara was a Human who was alive during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He served the Empire for years, including after the Battle of Yavin, and eventually became an ace bombardier.
Ofar Tan-Doov was a male Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Adrick was a male Human, who served in the Ground Forces of the Galactic Empire.
Hatabbas was a male Rodian crime lord. He kept a pet svaper in his lair, and he let it loose on those who refused to repay debts to him or angered him other ways.
Jiree was a Rodian male. He worked for Eelien Kirat and the Nalmar crime family as a bodyguard. Jiree would often accompany Elana Nalmar on undercover missions.

Jombo was a male Rodian hunter and criminal. Around 8 ABY, after learning that the crime lord Gamgalon was organizing safaris on Varonat to cover a gunrunning operation, Jombo joined Gamgalon's criminal organization. He said little, keeping his opinions to himself.
Zeelo Fas was a Rodian who supported the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the planet Ralltiir.
Teeko was a male Rodian. Along with Teeku, he was one of the uncles of Greedo, a bounty hunter active during the Imperial Period.
Menth Paul was a treasure hunter who resided in the Mensix Mining Facility cantina on Mustafar.
Zaa Vashee was the Togruta princess of Shili during the Clone Wars.

Thel Erelen was a male Rebel diplomat during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he organized a meeting with Duros executives, including Serrol Gathip, at the Duro Delta Twelve, only to have it crashed by COMPNOR agent Sedret Fain.
Serrol Gathip was a Duros executive who met with Thel Erelen, a Rebel at the Duro Delta Twelve shipyards, only to have meeting crashed by COMPNOR agent Sedret Fain.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Sedret Fain was a COMPNOR agent who crashed a meeting between Rebel diplomat Thel Erelen and Duros executives, including Serrol Gathip, at the Duro Delta 12 shipyards in 0 BBY.

Rokure was an Imperial Navy captain loyal to Darth Krayt and the Sith. The captain served under Darth Wyyrlok and commanded the Relentless, a vessel that took Lord Krayt and his closest and most powerful Sith Lords to Had Abbadon, where they would be ambushed by a strikeforce …
Ego was an Imperial officer who was stationed at an Imperial garrison on Cilpar and held the rank of Major in 4 ABY.
Roweedu was a female Rodian bounty hunter who tried to make a name for herself following the collapse of the Bounty Hunters' Guild.
Eldewn Sarvool was a Force-sensitive Human female, born on the planet of Romin.
Elsae Sarvool was a Force-sensitive human who was born on Romin.
Nio was a Rodian residing on Redcap during the Galactic Civil War. He often drank daranu, becoming intoxicated, though this affected his ability to drive properly.

Sordu Gogg was a male Rodian information broker operating on the planet Socorro. He worked out of private booth at the Custom Stop, arranging work for spacers ranging from legitimate cargo run to smuggling gigs.
Morgotou was a male Rodian crime lord working with the Kessel Spice Corporation.
Nurla Slinthiss was a female Twi'lek criminal who lived at the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was the Vigo of the criminal Black Sun syndicate on the planet Talus.

Neen Niuv was a Sullustan crime lord, who was based in the remains of an old mining facility in Hutt Space. He owned a modified Shieldship called Penumbra, which he used to escort guests or captured ships to his base, so that he could have them gutted for spare parts.
Koi Quire was a Firrerreo female who worked as an assistant for Lestra Oxic, a noted attorney.
Rophele Masan worked for Empire Freight Company shortly before the Battle of Yavin and had a number of smuggler contacts on Lamuir IV in the Tapani sector.
Whuvumm was an Ithorian and proprietor of the Jungle Vault, an underground cantina on the planet Vaynai.
Guzerre was an aging Twi'lek who operated a small medical center in the caverns on Streysel Island on the resort world of Vaynai during the Galactic Civil War.
A scout trooper functioned as an aide for Lieutenant Spilik during the Battle of Kattada, during the Galactic Civil War.

Owen Sareth was an agent for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Sareth was a friend of the smuggler Devon Fuller, and possessed a degree of business acumen that helped Fuller's financial situation considerably.
Taarna was a Human male CorSec agent who lived on Talus during the Galactic Civil War.

Hajj was the captain of the luxury cruise ship, Star of Empire. His ship experienced engine trouble which prompted an evacuation order from SIM. When SIM deemed the incident under control, him and his crew members were attacked by reprogrammed droids.
Tershan was a shipjacker who lived in the skull of a sea creature in the Krasho Salt Rifts of the planet Sarafur.

Saml Previl was a man that held the rank of Prime Abseiler of Alsakan in the Kingdom of Archais many years before the Battle of Yavin. The ancient man supposedly rode the Tessent of Alsakan into battle against the dukes of the Ten Valleys.

Barzur Antilles lived at some point by 3 ABY. They once gave a testimony at the Moddell sector's Annaj House of Detention in which they claimed to have seen one of the two artifacts known as the Tessents.
Res Nels was a captain in the Alliance. He was in command of the operation to rescue Lieutenant Talnar on Naalol.
Drofo III was a Toydarian who owned and operated the Hotel Drofo on the planet Oseon 6845 during the Galactic Civil War.
O'lif Khaz was a male Kubaz holovid director.
Phaldri Nex was the Twi'lek manager of the vocalist Ema Slake.
Sosten Freet was an Advozse who acted as Ema Slake's agent.
Omkoo was an Aqualish male who lived on Talus during the Galactic Civil War.
Haleen Snowline was a female Human who worked as the Minister of Protocol for Hagrin Zeed, the Prime Minister of Talus. She lived and worked in Dearic.
Tayvor Mandirly was a Human male agricultural expert who was the uncle of Bail Organa and lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Gorbacca was a Wookiee who served in the Rebel Alliance.

Lonni was a passenger aboard the ship Misanthrope which crash-landed on D'vouran. She was a friend of the pilot, Kevreb Bebo, and was marrooned on the planet with him and eighteen other survivors of the crash.

Chood was an Enzeen who lived on the planet D'vouran, a planet that was "created" as part of Project Starscream. He was the leader of the Enzeen who were relocated to the planet as part of the project.

This individual who served as the Regent of the planet Mek va Uil lived sometime around 62 BBY. The Regent received a rebuke from Mand'alor Jaster Mereel regarding the Regent's negative attitude of hiring mercenaries to fight their war.
Korbel was the nickname of a medic-trained clone trooper captain serving in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Mygg Morb was a Sullustan who lived on Gravane station. He worked for Morgra and arranged all of the Hutt's audiences.

Morgra was a male Hutt who operated as a crime lord during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. After engaging in a dispute with the rival Hutt Riboga, Morgra was exiled to the Gravane system, where he established a power base for himself aboard the installation Gravane …

Radlee Mathiss was a Human who lived in Dearic on Talus. In 1 ABY, he hired a spacer to pick up a package for him from a Corporate Sector Authority courier. The courier was captured by the Hutts, so Mathiss had the spacer free him.
Champhra Biahin was a Bothan who was the planet Drall's ambassador to Talus, where he lived in the town of Dearic. He could often be found in the Dearic Medical Center.
Ezak was a Jedi youngling who studied to use the Force in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. An orphan, he knew a great deal about the Jedi Order who raised him.

Mox Freedan was a Jedi Initiate training at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. Freedan was a member of Wolf Clan—one of several Jedi clans that young Jedi were placed in when they commenced their Jedi training as Padawans—alongside fellow members Kiri, Lina Lascol, Larta…

Kiri was a trainee in the ways of the Force as a Jedi youngling, alongside Lina Lascol, Lartan, Mox Freedan, and Ezak. The younglings were members of Wolf Clan, one of several clans that young Jedi were placed in when beginning their Jedi training as Padawans.

Lartan was a Jedi youngling who studied to use the Force alongside fellow younglings Kiri, Lina Lascol, Ezak, and Mox Freedan. They were all members of Wolf Clan, one of several Jedi clans that young Jedi were placed in when they commenced their Jedi training.

Lina Lascol was, alongside Kiri, Lartan, Mox Freedan, and Ezak, a trainee in the ways of the Force. The Jedi younglings were members of Wolf Clan, one of several Jedi clans for younglings who commenced their Jedi training.
H449-B7, or Aitch, was a stormtrooper in the Imperial Remnant who was a part of a group assigned to secure Nickel One after the Second Battle of Fondor.

Haakon was a gambler who mortgaged his family holdings to pay a gambling debt to Narloch. Haakon claimed the sabacc match had been rigged, but Imperial officials determined that the match had been fair and required Haakon to pay.

Rych Ha'andeelay was a Nikto who faced prejudice from members of his species for having characteristics of two Nikto subspecies. His treatment was noted in sentientologist Tem Eliss's book The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life.

Veneziano Haas was a representative of Nirama, a crime lord in the Cularin system, during the Clone Wars. He was a skilled negotiator and an accomplished pilot. Despite his well-dressed appearance, he was considered a scoundrel.

T'Charek Haathi was a Wroonian female who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as both a starfighter pilot and Special Operations team leader. Born on the planet Wroona, Haathi deplored stability and being bored.
Jasis Temm was a male individual who once owned and operated the company Hadlress Defense Systems, Limited on the planet Hadlress. The company was sold for 4.6 billion credits.

Alinta was a Human female who served as a member of the Friends of the Republic, an organization dedicated to covertly help the Galactic Republic during the start of the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Kruy Mulacks was a male Carthasian and host of the Kruy Mulacks Show. His holoshow recording crew was present at the opening of the Temple of Tet-Ami in the city of Carthas, on Benja-Rihn.
Cipiter was a male Chev enslaved by the Chevin criminal Nunk Plaarvin, and a member of the Raff Syndicate.

Xamus/Sumax was a two-headed, four-armed sentient who was imprisoned on M'Bardi during the Clone Wars. He was possessed of two distinct personalities, one for each of his heads: one head was a peaceful, gentle being, and the other violent and angry.
Kandar Vallan was a Human member of the Rebel Alliance.

Herc was a clone trooper pilot captain in command of the Eighteenth Battalion under Jedi Master Bant Eerin during the Clone Wars. He led his forces, together with Eerin's Padawan, on the Trandoshan moon Akoshissss against the Separatist Droid Army in the Battle of Akoshissss.

Akial was a Jawa male who served the Jedi Order, having ascended to the rank of Jedi Knight shortly before a celebration that took place between around 21 BBY and 19 BBY on Dorumaa, the moon of the planet Almas.

Krin D'bis was a Kel Dor female member of the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. She trained at the Almas Jedi Academy, where she specialized as a Jedi Guardian, and, after participating in the Jedi Trials, graduated and became a Jedi Knight.
Momaw Mowadan was an Ithorian doctor who worked in the infirmary of the ship Kuari Princess. Mowadan was on board when the luxury liner was attacked by the Riders of the Maelstrom.
The second commander of Triton Squad was a clone stormtrooper conceived from the progenitor genetic template of the bounty hunter Jango Fett.
Beljo Phtre was a stormtrooper who served under General Brenn Tantor for most of the Galactic Civil War.
Noj Smialliw was a noted classical composer who wrote Spirit of the Republic during the Clone Wars. The piece was written in response to Vennido T'all's anti-Republic music.
Va'Lonis was a Tarasin who played the keyboard in the band Distraction

Aquella Firth was a Human female and when she was sixteen, she met Niklas Cories at a Distraction concert and dated him. She eventually dismissed him, as she considered him to be too young and too dangerous.
Stydge was a Trandoshan who worked as a security guard for the band Distraction, along with his brothers Rydge and Xydge.
Xydge was a Trandoshan who worked as a security guard for the band Distraction, along with his brothers Rydge and Stydge.
Rydge was a Trandoshan who worked as a security guard for the band Distraction, along with his brothers Stydge and Xydge.
Halbard was a notable shipping magistrate in the Mid-Core and Mid Rim regions during the Galactic Civil War. He was a native of Chandrila.
Lobis Lobin was a Jedi Knight who lived during the waning days of the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Lobin served the Republic as a Jedi General.

Kydra was a Jedi Knight who fought for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Kydra served the Republic during the Fall of Falleen. Confederate forces completely destroyed the Republic task force, killing Kydra and seven other Jedi in the process.
Tafasheel Arkan was a Jedi Knight who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Arkan, along with seven other Jedi, was stationed on the planet Falleen in 22 BBY.
A clone commando captain served as the leader of a team of clone commandos on Asturias.

Kirr Cyrs was one of the first beings to scout the planet Socorro. He was also the historian of the first colony established on the planet. Kirr Cyrs was generally credited with saying that all life born on Socorro eventually dies on Socorro. He was an ancestor of Jobany Cyrs.
Jobany Cyrs, a descendant of Kirr Cyrs, was a native of Socorro, and at twenty-three years of age was contracted by Alliance member Idris Ro to scout the planet's suitability as a base of operations.

Bitt Panith was a male Muun cyberneticist who assisted in the creation of General Grievous' robotic body. Similar to Grievous, Panith had multiple cybernetic parts installed to his arms, legs, and head. He had a secret laboratory on the Trandoshan moon, Akoshissss.
Zim Zimley was a Bith who worked as manager for the band Distraction. He viewed the band as a way to make money, so was always focused on getting them to play at concerts.

Gindo was a Herglic, who acted as a double for Enni Anni, a member of the band Distraction. As part of a security ploy, he was escorted off the Sleemo Poya Jeedai by Xydge, along with doubles of the other band members.
Enni Anni was a male Herglic who was a member of the band Distraction. He played the Kloo horn. He fidgeted a lot and liked breaking things. He also encouraged violence during Distraction concerts.

Rossi Kildaon was a Human female who was a double for Tzeel, a member of the band Distraction. She was escorted off the ship Sleemo Poya Jeedai by Xydge as part of a security ploy to protect the band.

Bal Serinus was a female Dark Jedi guardian that lived during and after the Ruusan campaign. While searching for Sith artifacts in the palace of a Hutt slaver on Nar Shaddaa, she encountered the fallen Jedi Set Harth.
Talon Slyter was a native of the planet Draethos and a noted practitioner of the martial art Teräs Käsi, during the years leading up to the First Battle of Geonosis.
Lungrolph Isher was a native of the planet Krish and a noted practitioner of the martial art Teräs Käsi, during the years leading up to the First Battle of Geonosis.

Trask was a Commander in the Galactic Republic, leader of Survey Team 63529 to the planet Trinta on a mission to make a report to Director Greeley. The report concluded that the planet Trinta was unsuitable for Republic colonization.

Vayla Sevren was a Human who was a Major in the Thaereian military. She commanded the base on Dorumaa and led Thaereian forces there during the Battle of Dorumaa. After the battle, she met with Major Ren Terlo of the Cularin Militia, to negotiate the base's surrender.

Ren Terlo was a Human who was a Major in the Cularin Militia. He commanded their forces during the Battle of Dorumaa and afterward, he met with Major Vayla Sevren of the Thaereian military, to negotiate the base's surrender.
Serving as a captain in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army on the planet of Coruscant, the clone trooper pilot Archer led a squadron of starfighters.
Thul Kariss was an alien of unknown gender who served under Cala Worner during the early years of the Galactic Civil War co-piloting the Midnight Star, a modified YV-545 light freighter.
Halle was a Human female from Acherin who was married to Alder.

Sunchoo was a female Wookiee living on Kashyyyk during the Clone Wars. Stolen from her village by the bounty hunter Crovan Dane, she was sold into a life of slavery in the service of a Neimoidian Trade Federation official, Gama Bankor.
Bant Eerin's Padawan was a male Human Jedi Padawan. He served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Jaylen Kos was an Iridonian Zabrak youngling stationed at the Coruscant Jedi Temple during the Clone Wars. His best friend was Bant Eerin's Padawan. He stowed away on his friend's Jedi starfighter when the pilot was going to aid his master in the Kashyyyk system.

Krossen, also known as XK-7, was a Force-immune cyborg created during the Clone Wars by the Muun cyberneticist Bitt Panith. Krossen looked as if he was put together from many different creatures: His arms were from a gundark, and his legs from a Gamorrean.

Lex was a clone trooper sergeant and clone commando who served in the Eighteenth Battalion, a unit of clone troopers led by Jedi Master Bant Eerin and Clone Captain Herc during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, the battalion participated in a battle on the Trandoshan moon Akoshissss.
Korman Lao was the leader of a group of fanatics known as the Kanzer Exiles, who originated from the Valtaullu Rift in the Unknown Regions.

Dova Brigger was a freelance trader operating in the Corellian system. She and her brother Kal shipped whatever they could find between Corellia and other worlds; to do so, they flew a modified YT-1300 light freighter named Hardwired.

Viss was a male bodyguard to Rej Taunt, an up and coming crime lord on Nar Shaddaa in 18 BBY. He went to school with Bammy Decree but was expelled. Immediately afterward, he took up work as Taunt's bodyguard. He was a very tall, sturdy man.
Virec Xan was the Sable Dawn's administrator in Point Nadir.
Kalback was a Mon Calamari Admiral of the New Republic and a distal pod-cousin of Admiral Gial Ackbar. He was in his sixties at the time of his final command.
An unidentified Aqualish technician served the Confederacy of Independent Systems on Skytop Station.
Uublu was a female Ithorian who worked as a medic during the Clone Wars and accompanied Strike Force Cularin on their mission to the Ando system.
Meeba was a Human who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.

San Maxus was a male Devaronian podracer that competed in the race in the Mon Gazza Maze against Ahsoka Tano during the Clone Wars. He was also a Separatist spy that was called Agent Sixteen by Dooku himself.

X-1 was a Human male assassin who, along with six other men, was hired to participate in Project Omega. Commander Rezi Soresh made this experiment to create the perfect assassin, who would then go on to serve the Galactic Empire.
X-2 was a Human male assassin who, along with six other men, was hired to participate in Project Omega, an experiment by the Galactic Empire to create the perfect assassin.

X-3 was a Human male assassin who, along with six other men, was hired to participate in Project Omega. The operation was an experiment by Commander Rezi Soresh to create the perfect assassin who would then go on to serve the Galactic Empire.

X-4 was a Human male assassin who, along with six other men, was hired to participate in Project Omega. An experiment by the Galactic Empire to create the perfect assassin, which was overseen by Commander Rezi Soresh.

X-5 was a Human male assassin who, along with six other men, was hired by Commander Rezi Soresh to participate in Project Omega. The operation was an experiment by the Galactic Empire to create the perfect assassin.

X-6 was a Human male assassin who, along with six other men, was hired to participate in Project Omega. The project was an experiment by Commander Rezi Soresh to create the perfect assassin, who would then go on to serve the Galactic Empire.

Sheel was a Tarasin female member of the Wyrd Force witch coven who lived during the time of the Clone Wars. Around 20 BBY, Sheel was sent to meet with the Confederacy of Independent Systems regarding a plot to discredit the Jedi Order.
Isibray was a commander in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, they commanded a Republic cruiser in Anakin Skywalker's task force during the Battle of Bothawui.
Vontifor was a commander who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, they commanded a Republic cruiser in Anakin Skywalker's task force during the Battle of Bothawui.
A Mandalorian female was the mother of Parja Bralor. A member of Clan Bralor, the woman was also the sister of the Cuy'val Dar training sergeant Rav Bralor.

A male Bpfasshi was the leader of a group of Dark Jedi during the Golden Age of the Old Republic. He was the cause of the dark-side energies and phenomena that would occurred in what became known as the Dark Side Cave on Dagobah.
A Bpfasshi was part of a group of Dark Jedi.
Draughckt was a Gamorrean who had met a young Jedi named Gerrick on Seltos. The two met again a year later.

Liash Keane was a female Ubese technocrat who founded Epsis, an organization made up of con artists, slicers, outlaw techs, and general thieves. Epsis was the second largest ruling syndicate on Point Nadir.
Prello Anjiliac was a Hutt crime lord and part of the Anjiliac clan.

Oxic found Tobb Jadak, pilot of the Stellar Envoy and holder of the key to the Insignia's location, in a coma on Nar Shaddaa and paid for his recovery at the Aurora Medical Facility, which took some forty years.

Walon Vau's mother was one of Walon's family members who disowned him after he joined the Mandalorians. She was considered to be a religious fanatic. She had a bauble of shoroni sapphires that Walon stole from the Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank on the planet Mygeeto.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: The Alliance to Restore the Republic Special Forces soldier Vildar Blin had a brother who betrayed his family by joining the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order.

Troy was a clone trooper sergeant serving in the Eighteenth Battalion during the Clone Wars. An outspoken trooper, Troy questioned the sense of following Bant Eerin's new padawan whom he referred to as a "youngling." Although Troy quickly silenced himself after being chastised…
Lazlo Ardine was a male Human who served as a Colonel in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Kvarn Mandel was the head of Fabritech, Inc., an important manufacturer of sensors and control systems for starships. Mandel was an aristocrat who was a strong supporter of the Empire, as well as being a devoted family man.

Varo was a Human male from Alderaan who served as a military adviser and combat instructor of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. During his career, he served as an instructor to Senator Bail Organa.

Jenson Drever II was the managing director of Drever Corporation, a minor weapons manufacturing corporation in the Parmel sector. A short, stocky near-Human with greenish-gray skin, Drever was known for his usually calm, almost emotionless demeanor.
Madel Wharen was a Human male researcher and developer for the Drever Corporation, a minor weapons manufacturing company located in the Parmel sector.
Zlash was an assassin, living in the Cularin system during the Clone Wars. He usually worked alongside Haque.

Larbo Nelik was a female Podracer who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. Sometime before 32 BBY, Nelik participated in a Podrace on the planet Tatooine. During the race, Nelik had a massive crash and was killed.

A clone trooper pilot flew with the Galactic Republic's Blue Squadron early in the Clone Wars, participating in the Battle of Muunilinst as a V-19 Torrent starfighter pilot under Jedi Commander Anakin Skywalker.
A clone trooper pilot served in the Battle of Muunilinst as leader of Gold Squadron. He was killed by enemy Nantex-class fighters forcing Gold Two to lead the squadron.
Gold Two was the call sign of a clone trooper pilot who served in the Battle of Muunilinst. He took command of Gold Squadron after Gold Leader's death.
This clone trooper pilot used the callsign "Red Leader" served in the Battle of Muunilinst. He was commander of Red Squadron.
Kir-Tja Dilsn was a Human Jedi Knight who was active during the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY, an injured Dilsn stopped over on the moon Iktotch to recover.
Renij Jaa was an Iktotchi male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Sheeka Tull's sister was a woman who lived in the galaxy in the later years of the Galactic Republic. Along with their elder sister, Sheeka Tull, they were orphaned during a range war on the astronomical object Atrivis 7 in the Outer Rim Territories.
A stormtrooper was stationed at Kejim Outpost in 12 ABY. Upon discovering an opening in Sector 7, he submitted an application for it and it was accepted.

Squeerie was a Squib scavenger who operated on the planet Almas under an exclusive contract from Klis Joo, a former Jedi and the mayor of Forard. He led a salvage team made up of fellow Squibs and a Trandoshan named Korq.

Jeremos was an independent Squib sanitation engineer who operated from a planetary headquarters and took contracts to work on capital ships. She was noted in her field and had many different employers over her career.
Sybegh Abya was a Rebel Alliance contact on the planet Sedesia. He was assisted by A2-B4 and he bred breedtash.
This Solay Rebel was a mercenary on the planet of Solay.

Alexem was the elder of a village of Squibs on the planet Holador. His tribe was descended from a group of Squibs who crash-landed on the world circa 221 BBY and had since adopted a primitive lifestyle.
Jiminaldo-mabbramsti (Jimi) was a Squib scavenger who worked for another Squib, named Squeerie, on the planet Almas.
This general was commander of the Imperial ground forces in and around the city of Tiems during the Galactic Civil War.

Scamp's father was the head of a large family that lived in the slums of the planet Solay. He was an abusive man that often struck out at his children, hitting them for no other reason than that they were in his way.
Khiss was a hulking Dug mercenary and friend of Sebulba.
Brady was a Human male who served as an Admiral in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Hoot was a male spy who worked for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

T. Morrow was a Human male who served as a General in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. When Admiral Brady of the Imperial Navy was given the task of ridding the galaxy of vacant houses and structures, the spy Hoot contacted Morrow and reported this to him.
Pala Kwi'teksa was a female Twi'lek slave and a student of Madame Vansitt's Charm Academy on Tatooine.

This stormtrooper was stationed at Kejim Outpost in 12 ABY. On the day that Kyle Katarn and Jan Ors infiltrated the outpost, the stormtrooper was ordered to guard a chamber that housed fuel valves and two containers of an unidentified flammable substance alongside two other st…
Arrejis Mellaha was a Squib male shopowner and information broker who operated Serooin's Gear in Betha Starport on the smuggler's planet Betha II. He sold a variety of legal and illegal merchandise.

Maja was a Squib scavenger. In 3.5 ABY, he negotiated the right to salvage parts from the spare pile of Rithgar's Shadowport on the second moon of Kothlis. There, he found a Tech 4 PDV that looked like it might make a good starship with the proper modifications.

Veeter was a Squib trader. In 3 ABY, Veeter thought he traded for a ship held in an Imperial supply station, a Lone Scout-A scout ship. The Imperials did not recognize his claim to the ship, and upon departing with it, he came under fire.

A stormtrooper was stationed at Kejim Outpost in 12 ABY. On the day that Kyle Katarn and Jan Ors infiltrated the outpost, he was stationed in an isolated level whose primary purpose was experimentation on Artusian crystals.

Sheebareevadee (Sheeb) was a Squib shop owner who, in 13 ABY, ran Sheebareevadee's Emporium of Interstellar Goods in Jugsmuk Station on Gamorr. The shop was an unkempt affair that offered general goods. Sheeb hated Gamorr and had become more and more depressed from living there.

Ganga Lor was a male Chevin crime lord residing on Sel Zonn Station, an XQ2 Platform space station that orbited the Core Worlds planet of Brentaal IV. Lor was a longtime enemy of the protocol droid crime lord Switch, who had arrived at Sel Zonn Station at the same time as Lor.
Mack Jasper was a Human male who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. He was a proficient officer of the Corellian Security Force.
Dalgas was a male Rebel pilot, and a major in the Alliance Fleet. Following a patrol mission near Ord Mantell in 1.5 ABY, Dalgas was transferred to Freedom Station in the Outer Rim Territories.

Rueb was a General of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. As of 1.5 ABY she was in command of Freedom Station, an Alliance space station in the Outer Rim Territories that served as the base for attacks on a nearby Imperial travel route.

Toric Bisilt was a Bothan male who served as a lieutenant in the Thaereian military during the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY, Bisilt was assigned to customs duty in the Cularin system in the Expansion Region, serving aboard the CR90 corvette Thaere Runner.

A bosun served on the bridge of the Star Dreadnought Executor around 3 ABY. He notified Darth Vader that a Rebel starship, the Millennium Falcon carrying Luke Skywalker, escaped the skirmish at the Krake Data Vault.
Mongorrt was a male Chev, who was a slave to his Chevin master Nunk Plaarvin, and a member of the Raff Syndicate.

Kwilper was a Squib trader. He left Skor II in search of the junk heap of the ancients. In the process, he discovered a talent: he could collect cast-off junk (sometimes by shadowing Imperial capital ships) and refashioned it into art.
Desic Malboan, was a Sullustan male who served in the Thaereian system, an armed force from the Thaereian system, during the Clone Wars.
Fenix was a Besalisk information broker who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Bernil was a female Sullustan, who worked in Gadrin on Cularin, as a supervisor for Renna's Transport Service.
Trent was a male captain in the New Republic Defense Force. In 5.5 ABY, he served as commander of the Regulator, serving the Rapid Response Task Force during the campaign against Lord Shadowspawn.
Kidd Kareen was a male Rutian Twi'lek podracer who lived during the Clone Wars.

Tegist Byrg was a human male who served as the governor of the planet Glova. Supposedly leading a neutral planet, he was secretly working with the Galactic Empire, so the New Republic conducted a mission to reveal his plot.

Robet Makina was a one-time supporter of the Galactic Empire who joined the Rebel Alliance after witnessing the viciousness of the Empire. He was loyal to the New Republic after the Battle of Endor and eventually became the New Republic ambassador to Glova.

X-7 was a Human male assassin created by Rezi Soresh in an experiment to make the perfect assassin. He was used to hunt down Luke Skywalker, but in the process rediscovered his emotions. After a run-in with Skywalker on Belazura, X-7 betrayed Soresh and died in the battle.
The individual known only as Idret was an Imperial Intelligence agent active during the Galactic Civil War.

Malfosa was a legendary Sher Kar who roamed the Burning Plains of Mustafar. This scorpion-like beast would wipe out entire mining colonies before retreating to its lair. Uprisings were common, but ill-prepared hunters were no match for the mighty Malfosa.
Lindy was an old friend of Derek Klivian who assisted Klivian and Biggs Darklighter in defecting to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Kelyan was a Twi'lek bounty hunter who worked on a team with Clargod, Dee'Hars, and Kiimo. In 21 BBY, the group took several contracts from Riboga the Hutt, who was reestablishing his criminal dominance over the Cularin system.
Chan Dash was a Mirialan who lived during the Imperial era. On the planet Coruscant, he sought to help from the former Jedi Jax Pavan and his team.
Thi Xon Yimmon was a male Cerean who was the leader of the resistance group Whiplash, which was based on Coruscant. Though not a Jedi himself, he lived by many Jedi ideals.
Freema was a female Sullustan who was the aunt of journalist Den Dhur.
This individual was a Gungan who worked as a cook on the bar Emperor's Board on the planet Coruscant sometime during 18 BBY. He was secretly a Whiplash operative.
Mas Sirrah was a Corellian Human male who served as a member of the Imperial Inquisitorius.

Yral Chael was a Human Force-sensitive and a member of the Imperial Inquisitorius. The Dark Lord of the Sith Vader assigned him and fellow Inquisitor Mas Sirrah to Inquisitor Probus Tesla in order to capture Jedi Knight Jax Pavan and I-Five.

Bey Savaros was a male Human farmer and the father of Force-sensitive Kajin Savaros. When an Imperial Inquisitor visited their world, Bey and his wife decided to send their son to the planet Coruscant, hoping someone from the Jedi Order would take him in and train him.
Darth Ramage was a male Dark Lord of the Sith and scientist who was part of the lineage of Darth Bane.
Phobos was a Sith Lord who was considered ancient by the year 35 ABY. The Sith Eternal, a Sith cult operating at that time, adopted the tradition of naming its Sith trooper units after ancient Sith.

Jang was a female Rodian podracer pilot. She drove an emerald pod whose color matched that of her scales. At one point, she participated in an edition of the Boonta Eve Classic on Tatooine, which was ultimately won by the Jawa racer Haza.
Vor Harkass was a Force-sensitive Human who served as an Imperial scout during the Galactic Civil War.

Shiv was a clone cold assault trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. During the war, Shiv enjoyed writing to fellow clone trooper Flanker, even after Flanker's death during the Battle of Christophsis.
Flanker was the nickname of a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Along with his hatchmate, Shiv, he underwent desert training in 22 BBY.

Mag was a clone cold assault trooper commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he and his squad were stationed at Glid Station, a Republic outpost on the ice planet of Orto Plutonia.
Oolovv was a Wookiee freedom fighter. He helped to organize the Life Day festivities following 0 BBY in the towns of Dearic, Wayfar, and Doaba Guerfel.

Sstrigge was a Trandoshan trader. When the Wookiees and the Rebel Alliance tried to organize Life Day festivities in the cities of Dearic, Wayfar, and Doaba Guerfel in 1 ABY, Sstrigge helped the Galactic Empire disrupt their efforts.

Blasnic was a Squib infochant who operated on Burnout space station in the Thaereian system. He grew up on the station, a tough environment that prevented many typically Squibbian traits from taking hold in his psyche, and turned to a career of brokering information.

Vul Isen was a Force-sensitive Givin male who served the One Sith as a scientist. Born into the One Sith on Korriban, his talents did not lie in combat, but in science, so he was never given the coveted "Darth" title.
Faniel was a Mon Calamari who went into hiding from Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire in order to avoid the Genocide on Dac.
Troax was an Imperial Army lieutenant who participated in the Skirmish on Dac, serving under Commander Sturves on board the Sea Lion.

Tanquar was the Mon Calamari leader of the Mon Calamari Rangers during the Second Imperial Civil War. With the advice and aid of the Imperial Knight Treis Sinde, Tanquar led a resistance on Dac to the genocide of the Mon Calamari by the Galactic Empire of Darth Krayt.

Sturves was a Commander in Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire who participated in the Skirmish on Dac. He commanded the Acklay Battle Fortress, Sea Lion, as he and his battle group attempted to track down and exterminate Mon Calamari refugees.
Bor Alsek was a Sluissi who served in Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire. During the Skirmish on Dac, he was placed aboard the Acklay Battle Fortress, Sea Lion, where he served as Chief Mechanic.
Shark Leader was the callsign for the leader of Shark Squadron during the Second Imperial Civil War and the Genocide on Dac. He fought in an underwater battle against the Mon Calamari Rangers.
Kajin Savaros, nicknamed "Kaj", was a teenage male Human Force-sensitive living on Coruscant during the Great Jedi Purge.

Probus Tesla, also called The Bloodfiend, was a Human male Corellian who served as an Imperial Inquisitor assigned to find Jax Pavan and I-5YQ. He was wounded in a battle with untrained Force adept Kajin Savaros when Savaros threw a ball of condensed repulsor energy at him.
Kuthara was a male Falleen Force-sensitive and Inquisitor. He was Probus Tesla's Master in the College of the Inquisition.

A male Human senator gave the Confederacy of Independent Systems information on the Galactic Republic's plans as they were holding his family captive. The Jedi High Council decided to send Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi and a group of clone troopers to find him on Coruscant.
Kal Brigger was a Human male freelance trader who, along with his sister, Dova Brigger, bought the YT-1300 light freighter Millennium Falcon, known at the time as YT 492727ZED, in 48 BBY.
Wlinc Tchrr was a Kajain'sa'Nikto bookmaker who worked for the Hutts on Tatooine at the time of the Galactic Civil War. He did not talk much about his business to strangers.
Mindt F'abul was a cybernetic specialist who operated out of the Theed medical center.
This unidentified stormtrooper sergeant fought and died in the Battle of Anoth.
Wren was a Human male smuggler who operated out of Mos Entha during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
This individual was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.
Cobak was a xandank from the volcanic world of Mustafar. He belonged to a Jedi Knight that operated on Mustafar at the end of the Clone Wars.
Malory Lands was the cousin of Roan Lands, one of the founding members of the resistance group The Eleven on Bellassa. She was the daughter of Roan's Aunt Lilia.
The mother of Diblen Harleys was a Human female who lived on the galactic capital of Coruscant during the early years of the Galactic Empire. She died when her son was around the age of fifteen.
The father of Diblen Harleys was a Human male who lived on the galactic capital of Coruscant during the early years of the Galactic Empire. He served as an Imperial bureaucrat.

Jakohaul Lessor, who preferred to be called simply "Jako," was a computer technician at the Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center. He was very conscious of not working up to his abilities and was notorious for sleeping on the job.
Ludlo Lebauer was a Jenet casino owner on Pavo Prime with a brusque demeanor, a flair for the ostentatious, and an appreciation for fine art, beautiful women, and luxurious living.
Aeona Cantor was a red-haired Human female who was the lover of Nick Rostu during the Galactic Civil War.

Ember Chankeli was a Human female who contracted Dass Jennir for a job on Cato Neimoidia and owned an inn on her home planet, known as Telerath. She would later accompany Jennir on his travels and become his lover.

The mother of Zev Senesca was a resident and free-trader of Kestic Station, a trading outpost on the fringes of the Bestine system. The Senescas were known for dealing in goods of just about any kind of nature.

The father of Zev Senesca was a resident and free-trader of Kestic Station, a trading outpost on the fringes of the Bestine system. The Senescas were known for dealing in goods of just about any kind of nature.

Morrax Nabin was a male Human and avid holochess player who served as Imperial governor in the years following the end of the Clone Wars. Around 17 BBY, Nabin attended a gala on the planet Alderaan to mark the launch of a new luxury hovertrain.
Taezii was a voorpak that was owned by the Twi'lek fashion designer, Lynaa.
Lu Esi was a smuggler who was a friend of Toob Ancher. He died crashing his freighter while running from sector authorities on Vedis IV.
Bronwynn Koft was Vice President of the Galaxy Tours starline and spoke out against the transit tax shortly before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
Tash Metonae was a senator from Alderaan.

Frix was a Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic. Along with their successors Kalpana and Finis Valorum, Frix's chancellery allowed the Galactic Republic decline under a stagnant bureaucracy and political corruption to continue unabated.
Maree Praji was the wife of Tannon Praji and the mother of Onnelly Praji. After the Clone Wars, she and her daughter moved from Coruscant to Byss.
Hower Jerimott was a male Behebothan doctor in the city of Prosperity on the planet Beheboth.
This male Human individual was the great-uncle of Mils Giel, a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy.
Pers'lya was a Bothan male politician who became the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic around 12,000 BBY.

Crovan Dane was a male Human Padawan who left the Jedi Order and became a bounty hunter during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Dien Suub was a male Sullustan who was one of the executives for the SoroSuub Corporation in the years following the end of the Clone Wars. He once traveled to Alderaan, to attend the launch of the luxury repulsortrain, the Gem of Alderaan.

Khyyynett was a Wookiee male musician who attended the launch of a luxury hovertrain on the planet Alderaan in around 17 BBY. A group of Trandoshan mercenaries raided the train and Khyyynett was killed in the attack.
Dyni Endarsin was a female Zeltron artist. She attended the launch of the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan, on Alderaan.

Cednah Faenel was a female Human Alderaanian noblewoman who lived on Alderaan. She loved dancing, and spent a significant amount of money to restore the Grand Theater in the city of Belleau-a-Lir. She attended the launch of the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan.
Mahg-Raet Duumont was a female Herglic who worked as a financier onboard the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan, whose launch she attended on Alderaan.
Anjeru Valett was a male Human who worked as an attorney following the Galactic Empire's establishment. In 17 BBY, he attended the launch of the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan on Alderaan.

Griff Praji was a male member of the wealthy and influential House Praji of Coruscant, the capital world of the Galactic Republic. They had two younger brothers, Tannon and another brother. Their mother instilled an appreciation for culture and the fine arts on the brothers.

Triven was a pirate and a member of the Red Fury Brotherhood, a pirate gang active in the Cularin system before the Clone Wars.
Naand was a pirate and a member of the Red Fury Brotherhood, a pirate gang active in the Cularin system before the Clone Wars.
Ytram was a pirate and a member of the Red Fury Brotherhood, a pirate gang active in the Cularin system before the Clone Wars.

Tar Jiloma was a male Twi'lek with green-gold skin. He had a minor job in the Conkesta, the secret flying fortress built by Karae Nalvas.

Smooch was a female Tarasin. She was seen in Depatar, the City of Masks, in 31 BBY. Like all the visitors and many inhabitants, she was in disguise, particularly with a mask of Caarite and a costume covered with the repeated word "Oink." The frisky Smooch was having a good tim…

Maltok was a male Trandoshan permitor associated to House Renseth. A boisterous, egotistic and vain person, Maltok lived and worked in Depatar. He despised any outsider who used the services of other permitors.

Furran, sometimes known as Furran of the Intari, was a Filordus individual who worked as a permitor in Depatar. He was associated with the House Intari, and had a name that was common for the Filordus species.

Gusimin the Honest was a male Caarite permitor working in Depatar. Unlike other permitors, Gusimin was not associated to any House, and as such was not biased to guide his customers to any specific business related to the House.

Koyi Kobad was a female Twi'lek permitor working in Depatar. She was affiliated to the House Pthen and specialized in guiding customers to luxury business and getting them permits to enjoy their stay in Depatar.
Farfer was a male Ithorian who lived in the city of Depatar in 31 BBY. Farfer was a regular at the Grande Game casino.
Sebaracca was a female Wookiee entrepreneur and the owner and manager of Club 111, a drinking and dancing venue in the city of Depatar, in the gas giant Genarius.

Bael was a male Wookiee who, along with Touda, worked as a porter to Club 111, a drinking and dancing venue in the city of Depatar, in the gas giant Genarius. Bael and Touda analyzed the disguise of any prospective customer before letting him in.

Touda was a male Wookiee who, along with Bael, worked as a porter to Club 111, a drinking and dancing venue in the city of Depatar, in the gas giant Genarius. Bael and Touda analyzed the disguise of any prospective customer before letting him in.

Ulo Enan was an Ithorian masseur, and Vanster Enan's distant cousin.

Bora Edtuth was a naïve female Gungan seen in the Sanads of Rorkee hotel in 31 BBY. Attractive for a Gungan, she enjoyed dancing and watching the effect her movements caused in others, even if she could not completely understand why.
Nan Syboeseb was a female Human waitress-in-training working in the restaurant of the Sanads of Rorkee hotel. She was clumsy, but shrewd.
Ylla Nalooma was a female Twi'lek waitress who worked in the restaurant of the Sanads of Rorkee hotel. A pompous person, she believed that her work was beyond her capabilities.

Mik was a male Gungan seen in the restaurant of the Sanads of Rorkee hotel in 31 BBY. He was playing the Otoh Gunga variant of sabacc with fellow Gungan Donn, as both of them mistrusted others too much to play with anyone else.

Donn was a male Gungan seen in the restaurant of the Sanads of Rorkee hotel in 31 BBY. He was playing the Otoh Gunga variant of sabacc with fellow Gungan Mik — as both of them mistrusted others too much to play with anyone else.

Barma Fel'Lona was a female Rodian sabacc ringer working for the casino of the Sanads of Rorkee hotel.
Kli-Klu Niib was a male Sullustan sabacc ringer working for the casino of the Sanads of Rorkee hotel.
