Tyler Sapius Praji was the Governor of Kaikielius, one of the original Founding Parents of the Galactic Republic in 25,000 BBY, and the progenitor of House Praji.

Ardia Terrsyn a female Human who worked as an actress around the time of the Clone Wars and the formation of the Galactic Empire. She acquired a taste for sabacc, after playing it while researching a role in a holodrama about a Hutt criminal family.

Dr. Stae-Fahnti Koelbayr was a male Human, who worked as a commentator. He attended the launch of the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan, on Alderaan.

Sparky was a male Human mechanic from the planet Artorias.

Lorrb was an individual who worked in a spaceport on the planet Beheboth by around 8 ABY. Due to the Quarren scientist Kimp Minmirn not paying his docking fees, the Peacekeeper Darial Anglethorn ordered Lorrb to place an impoundment transmitter in his starship.

This unidentified Imperial commander served as the immediate successor of the admiral in command of the Super Star Destroyer Executor during its maiden voyage. After Darth Vader executed the admiral for doubting him, this Imperial officer assumed command.

Berpo was a Toydarian criminal who worked for Zelice Sturm on Tolea Biqua during the Clone Wars.

During the Clone Wars, a male slicer used the handle wampa1 as his user ID while posting on HoloNet message threads. The user, whose posted comments did not relate to the wampa species in any way, was a poor speller with a particularly confrontational attitude.

Ulseh was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Berrida was a portly man who served as a general in the Imperial Remnant, reportingly directly to Moff Kurlen Flennic.
Binalu was an elderly Human female who served for many years as one of the "twin rulers" of Typha-Dor, alongside Talus, in the years leading up to the Clone Wars.

Raikhssa was a male Trandoshan who served as War Chief of Trandosha during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he negotiated with Bant Eerin's Padawan shortly before the Battle of Akoshissss in order to prevent Trandosha's militia force from partaking in the conflict.
Semmix was a male Argullian doctor who lived during the Clone Wars.
Turyit was a male Argullian medical supplies merchant who lived during the Clone Wars.

Uz Bonearm was a male smuggler at Byss Bistro. He helped Shug Ninx, Salla Zend, and the New Republic when the reborn Emperor attempted to take over the galaxy. He was the captain of the Bespin Bandit.

OS-72-8 was the designation of a TIE pilot who served in the Imperial Navy by 3 ABY. By that year, the pilot was stationed aboard the Star Destroyer Devastator, and had also joined the Imperial Obsidian Squadron, flying under the call sign of Obsidian 8.

This unidentified Rebel Special Forces soldier was part of Able and Leia Organa's squad that was part of the task force that stroke at Bannistar Station.
Voyla was a male Twi'lek on Ryloth during the Clone Wars.

Doyle Skims was a Human male Y-wing fighter pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he was killed during the assault on the first Death Star. He was posthumously awarded a medal of valor.

Lyda Skims was a Human female who served as a Rebel Alliance spy, code named Skimmer. During the time of the Galactic Civil War, she was responsible for stealing information on a secret Imperial project called Project Dead Eye.

Femi was a female Rutian Twi'lek who lived during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire in the year 3653 BBY.

The Unidentified Alderaanian agricultural researcher was a female Human scientist who was working on a civilian agricultural research vessel on the planet Alderaan in 0 BBY.
Calliose, a Nikto bounty hunter, served as Skahtul's principle partner during the hunt for Luke Skywalker.

Cana was the one time King of Gala. He was married to Veda, who ruled in his stead, after his death. He was married to Tema before his arranged marriage, and fathered Elan Tallah. As king, he fathered Prince Beju and taught him everything about sword dueling.

Parsol d'Ahndole was a hero and adventurer who was active during the early days of the Galactic Republic. The deeds performed by d'Ahndole were considered by many to be decidedly heroic in nature and were dramatized in a series of holofeatures.
Watesk was a male Human who served as the governor of the planet Viamarr 4 during the Galactic Civil War.
Nojin Koolb was a male Human and the governor of the planet Xartun during 7 ABY.

Hakaen Bousch was a male Mon Calamari physician. He attended the launch of the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan, on Alderaan.
Tavid Ahkoeri was a male Human gambler. He attended the launch of the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan on Alderaan.

Zalar Rishek was a male Human of the House of Rishek family who lived during the years following the end of the Clone Wars. Around 17 BBY, Rishek attended the maiden journey of a luxury hovertrain on the planet Alderaan.

Lynaa was a middle-aged female Twi'lek fashion designer. She regularly did charity work for wildlife groups and went everywhere with her pet voorpak, Taezii, which she carried in the pockets of her robes.
Notru'denn was a male Twi'lek who lived around the time of the formation of the Galactic Empire.
Chasa was a hulking man who owned and operated a bar on Dolis 3. It was favored by Banner Sumptor and his Imperial comrades during the New Republic.
Ozuun was a male Argullian who lived on Argul during the Clone Wars.
Vestara Khai was a Force-sensitive female Human born to Sith Saber Gavar Khai and his wife, Lahka, on the remote planet Kesh in 27.5 ABY.
Melsa Dor was a female sentient being who lived during the time of the Clone Wars.

A Tiss'shar assassin attempted to assassinate President Si-Di-Ri of the Tiss'sharl League approximately eight months after the Battle of Yavin. The assassin was unsuccessful, but managed to escape alive.
Charl Sstena was a male Jawa smuggler from the planet Tatooine who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
The Meatlump King was the Human ruler of the Meatlumps, a gang labeled by the Corellian Security Force authorities as "fanatical" and "somewhat stupid" progress haters.

Cammel Atarul was an investigator for the Galactic Empire who worked on Tinnel IV, a planet in the Quanta sector. Atarul was tasked with investigating a theft at the estate of Moff Tiaan Jerjerrod shortly after the Battle of Yavin.
An alien was a scientist working for the Confederacy of Independent Systems. They were the creator the Planet Killer.
Orla Defra was a female Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Bertrek Moy'nast was a male Bothan who lived during the time of the Clone Wars.
Mub Tyeb was a male Sullustan who lived in Soboll on Cularin during the Clone Wars.
Lalande was a woman who served in the Cularin Militia during the Clone Wars.
Jimmer was a member of the Mostlaa species, and worked as executive assistant to smuggler Nilya Fek'ra.

Lenc was the Bith administrator of a brutal mining colony on Weldii III. During the Galactic Civil War, he put out a bounty on gunrunner Praaelon Di, after Di provided weapons to both sides of a violent uprising on Weldii III.

Joshi served as a captain and commanded the escort frigate Provocateur under Warlord Zsinj.

Vanter Raffin was a male Human and native to the planet Ession. He served as the chief officer for Pakkerd Light Transport. He was a supporter of Warlord Zsinj and was described by the Warlord as someone who's nervous and complains too much.

Hola Paskalian was a female Human and the head of security for Pakkerd Light Transport on the planet Ession. She was a supporter of Warlord Zsinj and was recommended by Zsinj to succeed Vanter Raffin as the chief officer when he retired.

This female Human individual was the wife of Imperial Captain Zurel Darillian. She died when Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard launched the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Lusankya from its berth on the planet Coruscant, destroying the building the Darillians call…
Laramont was a male mechanic on the planet Storinal during the New Republic's campaign against Warlord Zsinj.
Jotay was a male Human who worked as a guard on Revos's spaceport planet Storinal.
This Rebel general commanded Gamma Base on Hoth in 0 BBY.
This Rebel officer served at Gamma Base on Hoth in 0 BBY.

Tuatara Lone was a female Human holo actress from the planet Sluis Van. She was known for portraying madcap girls with odd lifestyles or nosy investigators capable of bluffing their way out of any problem.
Arratan was a male Human pirate chief who based his gang on Blood Nest, the third moon of M2398-3 on the M2398 system.
Rondle was a male Human and the unarmed combat instructor for Hawkbat, a supply ship in the fleet of Warlord Zsinj.

Partus was a female Human and the navigator for Hawkbat, a supply ship in the fleet of Warlord Zsinj. Partus and a few of the Hawkbat crew were treated to drinks by Yokel Group, members of the New Republic starfighter commando unit Wraith Squadron, during their mission to the …
Barthalemew Windsloe was a male Human and Rebel Alliance sympathizer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Lubo was a Twi'lek child who lived in the city of Nabat on Ryloth during the Clone Wars. Lubo was showing Numa and another friend a gutkurr chick shortly before the forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems invaded around 21 BBY.

Tronda was a Twi'lek who the father of the girl Numa knew for her foresight. While at the city Nabat on the planet Ryloth in 22 BBY, Tronda warned Numa's mother about a storm they had foreseen through their bones, inspiring the mother to clear out the shelter in her residence.

Opelle was captain of the Valiant in 3951 BBY. When Czerka Corporation took over Citadel Station in its bid for control of the Telosian Restoration Project, Meetra Surik informed Opelle of the situation.

This girl was a Lethan Twi'lek girl who lived on in the city of Nabat on Ryloth during the Clone Wars. She was playing with her friends Numa and Lubo shortly before the forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems invaded her home around 21 BBY.

This female served as the waitress for the Iziz Cantina in Iziz, on the planet Onderon, during the time leading up to the Onderon Civil War. She was hired by Bahima, the owner of the cantina, following the repeated destruction of his serving droids.

Hesoc was a starfighter pilot serving in the Alliance Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War. He flew a T-65 X-wing starfighter and was known as "Hotshot Hesoc" due to his skills in the cockpit.
Grimblade was a skilled pilot, last seen flying an X-wing starfighter. He wore red and black colored R.I.S. armor.
Siobhan Stern was a female Human who served as a Lieutenant in the Thaereian military during the Clone Wars.
Rigo Devane was a male Human who served in the Cularin Militia during the Clone Wars.

Raido was a Devlikk Podracer pilot who flew a yellow J930 Dash-8 Podracer around 22 BBY. That year, Raido participated in a qualifying race for the Mon Gazza Maze course located on the Mid Rim planet of Mon Gazza.

Coniel was a young Ghostling slave boy that was rescued from the sand drains of Mos Espa by Anakin Skywalker, while Skywalker was attempting to free Arawynne and the other Ghostlings from Gardulla the Hutt.
Purvis Arrison was a male Human soldier who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

Alduq Besene was a male Human who lived in Mos Eisley on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He worked as an artisan for Jabba the Hutt and was always looking for new talent. In 1 ABY, he paid a spacer to create a number of tools, to test the spacer's ability.
Niko Brehe was a Human male who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Conno was a male five year old Ghostling. Along with Princess Arawynne, he was captured by Djas Puhr and brought to Mos Espa to be sold as a slave, but was rescued by Anakin Skywalker.

Bonic Tarracus, codenamed Corewatch, was an extremely reliable agent throughout the Galactic Civil War. An agent for the Rebel Alliance, Tarracus was stationed amongst the Core Worlds for most of the war.

Kal was a male Human, who lived on Cularin and was a teenager during the time of the Clone Wars. After there were some riots in the city of Gadrin, Kal and the Tarasin Dannik, were sent by the Cularin Militia to tail the Heroes of Cularin.

Berooken was a male Mon Calamari politician who served as the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during the latter days of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Orgus Din, also known as the "Plain Jedi" among his fellow Jedi, was a male Human Jedi Master from the planet Rishi who served the Jedi Order during the Great Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Harron Tavus was a Human male lieutenant and later captain in the Republic Special Forces who fought in the Great Galactic War. He was friends with and fought alongside Jedi Orgus Din during the offensive in the Minos Cluster.
Basal Moor was an Alliance Intelligence operative who was rescued from TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated headquarters on Pako Ramoon by the Xi'Dec extraction agents K'lial and Diskio Khzrry.
Kara Via wrote a report on the rescue of Basal Moor from TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated headquarters on Pako Ramoon by the Xi'Dec extraction agents K'lial and Diskio Khzrry.
Deathswarm was a particularly large and dangerous Uwari beetle found in the upper levels of the Myyydril Caverns on Kashyyyk.
A Human male Dark Jedi was part of the Sith Empire of Darth Malak, the newly proclaimed Dark Lord of the Sith, in 3956 BBY.

Caled Galfridian was a Human male from Artorias during the Yuuzhan Vong War in 25 ABY. He was the King of Artorias and lived with his queen, Nina, and two children, Finn and Kaye.
Nina Galfridian was a Yuuzhan Vong Shamed One female and Queen of Artorias living with her Human husband Caled and his two children Finn and Kaye when the Yuuzhan Vong invaded in 25 ABY.

Kron was an ambassador from Alderaan. Around 32 BBY, during the time of the Battle of Naboo, he was acting as ambassador to Naboo from Alderaan. He was trapped on Naboo during the Trade Federation blockade and ensuing invasion of the planet.
Elis' Gan was a male, who served in the Thaereian military during the Clone Wars. He was the commandant of Thaereian Security Facility Number 12, a security facility in Gadrin on Cularin.

Guller was a male pirate that belonged to the Blood Nest pirate group. During Night Caller's visit to the M2398 system, he was assigned to the system's asteroid belt as a lookout before the battle occurred.
Rast'tul was a Human male who served as a colonel in the armed forces of the Thaereian system during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.
Niklas Cories was a male Human, who worked as an assassin. He often used thermal detonators to eliminate his targets.
The Spirit Guide, also called Spirit Healer, was a Wookiee mystic that watched over the Nyenthi'Oris Graveyard on Kashyyyk.

This male Twi'lek Force-user lived during the Galactic Civil War and was a practitioner of the dark side of the Force. He wielded a red-bladed lightsaber and at one point used the Force to crush an enemy's body both inside and out.

Davtokk was an ambitious male bounty hunter operating during the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY, the hunter was invited to the planet Keyorin for a job interview with Duros bounty hunter Cad Bane, though Davtokk actually intended to collect the bounty on Bane's head.
A Force-sensitive individual served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order around the time of the Mandalorian Wars and trained a Human male Padawan who was eventually known as Darth Bandon.
Bardron was a male Krish who ran the swoop-dueling Solo Aerials on Jervo's World above Pantolomin.
Aubin Kleej, nicknamed the Goethar's Shame, was a male Gotal and the son of a famous swoop-duelist Goethar Kleej.
Goethar Kleej was a male Gotal who was kidnapped by Crucible slavers around the time of the Mandalorian Wars to compete in swoopdueling matches for the Franchise entertainment firm.
Jarro Freen was a Human male who lived in Gadrin on Cularin during the time of the Clone Wars. He was a member of Borus's Boys, a street gang that liked to hang around near Gadrin Dump.

Fallon was a male Human teenager who lived in Gadrin on Cularin during the Clone Wars. He was the leader of Borus's Boys, a street gang that hung around near Gadrin Dump, but he was also friends with the speeder bike gang, the SkyHawks.
Flinor Tekkirl was a scout for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. His starship was the Atrivis Advancer.
Garren was a boy who lived on Cularin during the Clone Wars.
Rakzen Krayle was a male Human, who served as a Lieutenant in the Thaereian military during the Clone Wars.
Janna was a female Sullustan, who lived on Cularin during the time of the Clone Wars.
Sossk was a male Trandoshan, who lived on Cularin. He purchased and ran the cantina Krakin's Alehouse and by the time of the Clone Wars, he had owned if for about fifteen years.

The Corellia Star captain was the pilot of the YT-1300 light freighter Corellia Star during the Galactic Civil War. He was killed by Imperial forces while trying to deliver information on the TIE Phantom project to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
"Mother Calrissian", also known as "Mom", was one of the parents of Lando Calrissian. In his adulthood, Calrissian recalled that she had the ability to remember hundreds of songs and poems.

A female individual was the mother of Landonis Balthazar Calrissian. Calrissian considered her to be the "most amazing woman" he had ever known. Calrissian owned an aurodium ring with his mother's name inscribed in it.
This Imperial officer served aboard the Super Star Destroyer Terror during the Galactic Civil War.
Finious Crab was a smuggler and the captain of the Lambarian Crab.
Fillio Androu was a Wroonian smuggler and the partner of Linx Mallicker.
Linx Mallicker was a Wroonian smuggler and the partner of Fillio Androu.
Lord Cravus was an ancient ruler and noted warlord from the very early history of Esseles. Known as a cruel ruler, Cravus brutally took control of the planet with a collection of battle droids.

Dorset was a female individual worker of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After her duty expired Pso sold her and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire. But Jyn Erso captured the crew of the spaceship and rescued them.
Tinya was a young female Padawan serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Night Forael Wren was a female Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
"Skoot" Jarik was an educated Human male droid engineer who unsuccessfully attempted to earn a living first as a droid technician, and then an information broker on his Outer Rim homeworld of Biewa.
Alina Impeveri was a female Human Dark Jedi cult member, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Dac Axfow was a male Human Imperial officer with the rank of Colonel. In 1 ABY he was stationed in Kor Vella on Corellia, where he always stayed close to the city's starport.
This unknown executive was the president of the second largest mining company on the planet Belthu. This president was a supporter of Warlord Zsinj and supplied him regularly with refined durasteel.
This unknown executive was the chairman of the mining company coalition that controlled the planet of Belthu. The chairman was a supporter of Warlord Zsinj.
Eryk Chinn was a Human male shadow stormtrooper who served as a sergeant in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War.
Logro Elsin was a Human male pilot who served in the Imperial Military. He held the rank of Lieutenant. In 1 ABY he was assigned to the paranoid Colonel Dac Axfow on Corellia.
A pilot flew for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. At some point, the pilot was on patrol in a B-wing starfighter, along with Hootkins.
Ezrim, also called Old Ezrim, was a moisture farmer on Tatooine once caught in Tosche Station during a sandstorm.

Parlay Thorp was a female Human doctor. A renowned expert on aging and rejuvenation, Thorp headed research at Obroa-skai's Aurora Medical Facility, following stints at facilities of her own creation on Hijado and Enferm, and having traveled to many other planets in the Tingel …

Raymas Daal was a Human criminal from the planet Naboo who secretly worked for the Trade Federation. In 32 BBY, Trade Federation agents contracted Daal to disrupt a sensor array outside the Naboo city Kwilaan.
Joveh D'a Alin was a blue-skinned female scientist, an expert in the field of planetary tectonics and mineralogy, who lived in the years before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

Control Aleph-One was the callsign of a male Human assigned to Revos Spaceport's Bunker Aleph-One on the planet Storinal. During Wraith Squadron's Mission to Storinal, Garik Loran and Atril Tabanne stormed the bunker.

This female Human was the wife of Kissek Doran and the mother of Kell Tainer. When Doran died during a mission against the Galactic Empire, she learned the truth from somebody that he died at the hands of Wes Janson, his squadron mate in the Tierfon Yellow Aces.

This unknown female bunker officer was assigned to Revos Spaceport's Bunker Aleph-One on the planet Storinal. In 7 ABY, During Wraith Squadron's Mission to Storinal, Garik Loran and Atril Tabanne stormed the bunker and killed her colleague when he tried to draw his blaster.

Romor was a Jedi apprentice of the New Jedi Order. She was the nurse on duty in the Halls of Healing during Valin Horn's escape from the Jedi Temple in 43.5 ABY. Horn knocked her out before taking her lightsaber and leaving. Romor had a concussion but would recover soon.
Nannat was a female Human, who lived on Thaere Privo during the time of the Clone Wars.

Vrannin Vaxx was a male Human mercenary from the planet of Dorvalla. He won fame during the Yuuzhan Vong War, but was nearly killed in a personnel shuttle crash near the end of the war. His family obtained a black market YVH 1 droid and made it into a cybernetic body for Vaxx.

Zharia Vos was a female Kiffar who led the Kiffu Guardians as the Sheyf of Kiffex and Kiffu. In 137 ABY, Vos allowed former Guardian Droo Rawk and her family to settle on Kiffex, and soon after contracted Droo's husband, "Bantha" Rawk, to create a suit of life-preserving armor…
Tila Mong was a Force-sensitive Kel Dor female, and a member and leader of the Baran Do Sages on Dorin as of Luke Skywalker's visit in 43.5 ABY.

This unidentified male Kiffar was the first husband of a woman named Droo of clan Vos and a member of the Kiffu Guardians. Some time after he died in the service, Droo married a man named Nat Skywalker.

Kin-Ya Dosun was a Gungan Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Dosun trained the Jedi Padawan Kosa-Yin Hadu, a fellow Gungan. The pair disappeared around 33 BBY while on a mission from the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.
Rulo was a male Rodian who served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Knight during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Lo Pelkar was a male Human Padawan who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, specializing to become a Jedi Guardian.
Gnost-Dural was a male Kel Dor Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War and the ensuing Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
This unidentified Koorivar male was a Sith Acolyte, who served the One Sith during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Darth Baras was a Human male Dark Lord of the Sith of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War waged between the Empire and the Galactic Republic as well as the brother of Darth Ekkage.

Paran Am-ris was a male Cerean politician who served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic, and was before the senator from Cerea who signed the Treaty of Coruscant with the reconstituted Sith Empire on Alderaan.
Koro Ziil, also known as the Hidden One and hu'aac-du'ul-staranjan—which, translated from his native language to Basic, meant "the one who dwells in darkness"—was a male Force-sensitive Kel Dor.
Tokra Hazz, later known as the Hidden One, was a Force-sensitive Kel Dor who was a member of the Baran Do Sages, a Force-based organization on the planet Dorin.
This Imperial officer was a commander on the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator prior to the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY.
Sollima was a male Aleena crime lord active during the early years of Galactic Civil War, and the owner of the casino world Hollow Moon.
A Force-sensitive individual only known as "Twilight" lived around 900 BBY. She was rumored to have once been a member of the Jedi Order who had left that organization in search of a new beginning.

Billal Batross was a male Human scoundrel who operated during the early years of the Galactic Civil War. He was raised on the Trader's Luck, a decommissioned troop ship owned by Garris Shrike, and was one of the many orphans whom Shrike used in confidence tricks and thefts.

Bazel Warv, nicknamed Barv, was a Ramoan male from the planet of Ramoa, and a Jedi Knight in the New Jedi Order. He was good friends with fellow Jedi Yaqeel Saav'etu, Valin Horn, and Valin's sister Jysella.

Wyss was a male Kel Dor servant of the Hidden Ones in 43 ABY. He was serving under the Hidden One formerly known as Koro Ziil when former Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker and Jedi Knight Ben Skywalker freed the Hidden Ones from their caverns after a duel of Force powers betwee…
Dravin Razorbrain was a male slave gladiator who fought in the arena on the Hollow Moon.

A Bith served Hutt crime lord Ziro Desilijic Tiure during the Clone Wars. When he saw two Jedi in the bar of Ziro's Palace he ran off to alert a palace guard. He managed to find an IG-100 MagnaGuard, but the Magnaguard could not understand the Huttese the Bith was speaking.
Burra was a Force-sensitive Kel Dor male from the planet Dorin and a member of the Baran Do Sages, a Force-based organization on Dorin.
Savar was a Human male captain in Galactic Alliance Security. He and a group of Security troops arrested Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker in 43.5 ABY for dereliction of duty.

Charsae Saal was a male Kel Dor and Baran Do Sage who was born during the Galactic Republic and was a young child when the Jedi Order was purged. He was trained as a Baran Do Sage by Master of the Order Koro Ziil and later became the Order's senior combat instructor.
Around 32 BBY, in the aftermath of the Battle of Naboo, a young new recruit was brought to the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant and placed under the responsibility of Jedi Master Yoda.

Dhidal Nyz was a male Quarren bounty hunter and inventor who specialized in creating imprisonment-related technologies. In 43 ABY, he was hired by Galactic Alliance Security to assist in the arrest of Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker.
Tistura Paan was a Force-sensitive Kel Dor who lived in the Baran Do temple and trained among the Baran Do sages.
A male Human individual lived during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, in the year 3653 BBY.
This male individual served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Knight during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Ithia was a Force-sensitive Kel Dor female from the planet Dorin. She became a member of the Baran Do Sages, a Force-based organization on Dorin, and later joined the Hidden Ones, a secret sect of the Baran Do dedicated to preserving their knowledge.

Zyk-yadoon was a Rodian artist, who made a holoplacard depicting Jedi Master Ood Bnar during the Battle of Ossus. The holoplacard was part of the collection of artifacts on show in Remembrance Hall, a Jedi museum in Forard, on Almas.
Tantron Dow was a male Duros Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Alkin Saad was a male Human Padawan training within the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

The father of Komad Fortuna was known to have gained fame by killing a krayt dragon. His son killed a much larger krayt dragon with help from Revan and succeeded his father, thus earning him and Revan respect from fellow hunter Dorak Quinn.
Synred Vols was a male Sullustan Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

A Human male officer served as a commander in the Imperial Army. He participated in the search for a rogue Imperial Moff Kalast, who had been feeding the Rebel Alliance with secret information concerning the newest Imperial superweapon, the Death Star.

The pirate leader was a Black Sun marauder situated on the frozen planet of Ilum during the Galactic Civil War. He supplied the Alliance to Restore the Republic military detachments under former Galactic Empire Moff Kalast with weapons.
Chrethbac was a young male Tarasin Force Adept, who served as an ally to the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Seeth'tal was a male Zabrak Jedi Knight, serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He briefly came under the sway of the dark side of the Force on a search mission for Jedi Master Kirlocca in the Almas Wastelands.

Trevon Rey was a male Human Jedi Knight, serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He came under the sway of the dark side of the Force on a search mission for Jedi Master Kirlocca in the Almas Wastelands.
Hary'nkel was a male Twi'lek Jedi Padawan who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Fesjo Negleem considered the operation to release the Candorian plague on the planet Dentaal to be a failure (referring to the event's perpetrators as "Bunglers") and had a more devious scheme for Sedesia.
Yaqeel Saav'etu was a female Bothan Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order, and wielded an amber-colored lightsaber.
This Imperial captain served as the commander of the Super Star Destroyer Executor during Darth Vader's search for Luke Skywalker near the planet Kothlis in 3.5 ABY.

This Imperial officer commanded the Super Star Destroyer Executor during the Battle over Coruscant in late 3 ABY, in which the Executor destroyed the skyhook Falleen's Fist, killing Dark Prince Xizor of Black Sun.
Deila was a female Human and a member of the Young on Melida/Daan. A contemporary of Nield and Cerasi, she fought in the Young–Elders War.
Kritz Drassarb was an individual who served as a member of the Jedi Order during the later years of the Galactic Republic.
Lan Demoal was a conspiracy theorist and freelance reporter. He traveled the Sisar Run looking for major stories.

Oric Harfard was a Human male captain in Galactic Alliance Security in 43.5 ABY. He led the Security forces that were sent to the Jedi Temple to arrest the Jedi Knight Valin Horn, who had recently gone on a destructive rampage as the result of a psychotic breakdown.

Syr Tal-Soten was a male Ithorian Jedi Knight, serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He came under the sway of the dark side of the Force on a search mission for Jedi Master Kirlocca in the Almas Wastelands.
Korq was a male Trandoshan, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
D'randq was a male Barabel who was a member of the Believers during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

A male served as a captain in the forces of Warlord Zsinj. He commanded the Serpent's Smile, an old Victory-class Star Destroyer, at the Battle of Vahaba, where Zsinj directed him to advance upon the Immobilizer 418 interdictor cruiser Stellar Web and either destroy the interd…

The father of Carnor Jax was a member of the Sun Guard of Thyrsus and a secret agent of Darth Sidious. In 29 BBY, Sidious sent him to retrieve the holocron of the Sith King Adas from the dark side student Norval.
SG-567 was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire as a Scout trooper.
SG-619 was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire as a scout trooper.
Misha Quor-Din was a female Human Padawan who served the the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Sylvet Depp was the brother of Imperial Prefect Orun Depp. Sylvet worked as a clerk in Mos Eisley's branch of Zygian Savings and Loan during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Caeleb was a Human male born during the reign of the Galactic Empire who possessed an exceptional to connection to the Force.

He had heard the Stormtroopers talking about Vader threatening Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian with leaving a garrison on the Cloud City, and feared that he would be the one to carry it out.
Garvin Delquist was a male Human who lived on Almas during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Gorsick Dommaro was an Imperial lieutenant that was stationed on the Death Star as part of the Security Sector. The A68 Market, one of the most active black markets on the entire station, was under Dommaro's direct control.

Donal was a male Human native of Coruscant during the first years of the Galactic Empire. After the Great Jedi Purge began and the Jedi Temple was emptied, Donal met up with the woman named Solace.
Moppo Dop was a burly professional gulliball player. A Gungan, he accused Captain Roos Tarpals of cheating during the Big Nasty Free-For-All.

Dorn was a young Bothan in Mos Espa. A friend of young Anakin Skywalker, Dorn was enslaved by Jabba the Hutt, who was training him to be a spy.
Gaar was a Trandoshan male who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Chatook was a male Wookiee living in Kachirho on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1 ABY. He was the father of Takook, who was friends with a fellow Wookiee named Lobarorr.

Takook was a male Wookiee living in Kachirho on the planet Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War. In circa 1 ABY, Takook went on a hunting trip to the Rryatt Trail with his father Chatook's Kashyyyk bladestick and his friend Lobarorr.
Kallaarac was a male Wookiee who served as the chieftain of the Myyydril tribe, a group of beings who lived in the Myyydril Caverns in the Kkowir Forest on the planet Kashyyyk.
Athnalu was a female Wookiee who lived in Kerritamba Village on the planet Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.

Justor Ferral was an Imperial scout trooper that had earned the rank of Sergeant during the Galactic Civil War. He was dispatched to Cloud City, after the Battle of Hoth. He used a floating battle disk in battle.
Mant Buume was a male Human, who worked for CreedCon Construction during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Tedney Sorrent was a male Human, who worked for CreedCon Construction during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Fara Telon was a female Bothan, who worked for CreedCon Construction during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Bur'n Ikle was a female Twi'lek, who worked for CreedCon Construction during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Walda Ceen was a Near-Human female who worked for CreedCon Construction during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Yope Kogote was a male Human who worked for CreedCon Construction during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
During the Battle of Hoth, Rebel soldiers Vildar Blin and his assistant stormed out of the Echo Base defensive trenches to attack a downed Imperial All Terrain Armored Transport.

Polearm Five flew an A-wing as part of the New Republic's Polearm Squadron. During the campaign against Warlord Zsinj, this pilot died in the battle for the Razor's Kiss from a turbolaser shot from the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Iron Fist.
A pilot flew an A-wing as Polearm Leader of the New Republic's Polearm Squadron. During the campaign against Warlord Zsinj, Polearm Leader participated in the battle for the Razor's Kiss.
Sh'alla was a female Tarasin youth, who lived on Cularin during the time of the Clone Wars.

An Imperial lieutenant was a member of Moff Kentor Sarne's military in 8 ABY. He was commander of a security detachment assigned to the science team MS-133 during their expedition to Aaris III, a planet in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories, doubling as the team's …
Lunus often used wild and dangerous animals for interrogation and punishment purposes. In 1 ABY the Moff tried to acquire more such dangerous beasts.
Hylo Visz was a female Mirialan smuggler active during the Great Galactic War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
T'doshok was a male Trandoshan bounty hunter during the Clone Wars, the conflict between the Galactic Republic and a separatist faction that had seceded from the galactic government.

A pilot flew a B-wing under the callsign "Nova Four" as part of the New Republic's Nova Squadron. During the campaign against Warlord Zsinj, this pilot participated in the battle for the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Razor's Kiss in 7 ABY.

This Nova Three flew a B-wing as part of the New Republic's Nova Squadron. During the campaign against Warlord Zsinj, this pilot participated in the battle for the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Razor's Kiss.

A citizen of the planet Naboo, a Human merchant was imprisoned by the Trade Federation during its invasion of the planet in 32 BBY. According to the merchant, the arrest was a result of attempting to organize a resistance group against the invaders.

Watto's flunky was a Human male who lived in Tatooine, in the city of Mos Espa, and sometimes helped the Toydarian junk dealer Watto sort junk. In 32 BBY, he met the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn, who asked the flunky about a T-14 hyperdrive generator, which the Jedi needed to buy.

The friend of Anakin Skywalker was a male Pacithhip. When Jedi Knight Qui-Gon Jinn introduced himself as Anakin's friend, this Pacitthip gave him a medpac. While interacting with Qui-Gon Jinn, the Pacithhip wore a green jumpsuit similar to Bok Askol's.
Escra Fey'lya was a female Bothan, who was a member of the Office of Peace and Security during the time of the Clone Wars.
Jural was a female Bothan who worked for the Corellian Times during the Galactic Civil War in 1.5 ABY. She was best known for her investigative reports on galactic exploration.

This alien individual was accomplice to a criminal scavenger in 32 BBY. Before the Boonta Eve Classic podrace began, he stole Anakin Skywalker's plasma ignition capacitor for the scavenger, only to be pursued and cornered by Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn.
Kav Lepkin was the leader of the Krayt Draggers, a swoop gang with about fifteen members that was based in Anchorhead, on the planet of Tatooine.

Bessen was a Human male born around 26 ABY. He was a trooper in Galactic Alliance Security, and in 43 ABY, he took part in the arrest of Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker, who had been charged with dereliction of duty.
Torel Fey'jia was a male Bothan and a member of Clan Ojia, whose clan-ancestors migrated and colonized the planet Kothlis.

A Human male worked as a Sith diplomat on the planet Manaan during the Jedi Civil War in 3956 BBY. The diplomat represented a group of Sith soldiers in the Ahto High Court during a hearing that was the result of a brawl between his clients and a group of Republic soldiers.

Jon "Dutch" Vander was a male human ace pilot from Onderon who first served in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy before defecting to the rebellion. By 2 BBY, he served as the leader of Gold Squadron, a squadron made up of BTL Y-wing light bombers, with the rank of captain.

Gandin T'Noull was a Human male who served as the manager of the Ace of Sabres during the Galactic Civil War. He was a slick smooth businessman able to talk fast and often without saying anything of real substance.
Min was a female Human living in the Neebray Garrison on Balmorra during the Cold War. She asked an Imperial not to destroy a power generator on which she and other Balmorran refugees depended.

Fissona was a young Tarasin and was a troublemaker within Hiironi irstat. Prior to the Battle of Naboo, when Fissona was nine years of age, he was often caught and punished for his misdeeds; despite being the grandson of Cryalira.
The Master in White was the name taken by the leader of the Wookiee Liberation Front. Leader of the Five Masters, and maintained the White Gallery at the Training Hall outside Gadrin.
The Master in Violet was a female Zabrak and one of the Five Masters, the leader of the Five Masters on Cularin.

The Master in Green was a massive Wookiee and one of the Five Masters who taught the art of Wrruushi at the Five Masters Academy on Cularin. Following the end of the Clone Wars, the Master in Green was killed during the attack that led to the destruction of the Academy.

The Master in Red was a Cerean male and one of the Five Masters, who taught within the Five Masters Academy on Cularin. Like the others Masters, the Master in Red was killed when the Training Hall was destroyed in a massive fire.

Brinojja was a Hutt who operated as a crime lord during the time of the Galactic Civil War. The Hutt employed the Trandoshan Verkoss as the chief enforcer for Brinojja's crime operation and in 4 ABY, Brinojja sent Verkoss and a group of thugs to apprehend the Human information…
Kills was a female Human, who worked for Riboga the Hutt during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
A Gran male was employed as a worker at the testing facility orbiting the planet of Bormus, where he was assigned to the BTL-B Y-wing starfighter, a new model of bomber.
Ren Voilis was a man who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Jaxa Lian was a female smuggler who operated out of Tatooine for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. She was considered one of Hantor Loftus' most reliable operatives.

Lidek Baws was a native of Naboo that was recruited into the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was placed in their recruiting division and operated out of Tatooine. However, he was in fact a spy for the Galactic Empire and fed them information regarding Alliance smugglers.

T'Chttrk was a female T'kkrpk officer in the New Republic Navy. Her exact age was unknown even to her, since her species started to calculate time according to the Galactic Standard Calendar only after her homeworld's Great Reconciliation circa 95 BBY; by this time she had alr…

Chask Fragan was a male B-wing pilot in the New Republic Navy's 23rd Combat Starfighter Wing. In 5.5 ABY, he perished alongside his gunner Kort Habel when their ship was cut in half by a gravity slice during the Battle of Mindor.

Kort Habel was a male B-wing starfighter gunner in the New Republic Navy's 23rd Combat Starfighter Wing. In 5.5 ABY, he perished alongside his pilot Chask Fragan when their ship was cut in half by a gravity slice during the Battle of Mindor.

Fendrilon Koozar was one of Emperor Palpatine's Advisors during the Galactic Civil War. He had a habit of sticking his nose where it was not welcome and often dined at the exclusive Manarai restaurant on Coruscant.
In 3.5 ABY, Va'ran nervously obeyed Guri's order to secretly murder Imperial Advisor Fendrilon Koozar for prying into Black Sun's business.
Jarik Vuintor was a man, who lived in the Cularin system during the time of the Clone Wars.
Thavish was a male officer of the Fleet Intelligence of the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

A clone trooper commander served in the Galactic Republic's Green Company during the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY, Green Company was sent to the planet Rishi to recapture exonium mines taken by Geonosian forces.
Ozzmos Roberts was a male Bith banker worked for the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the Galactic Civil War.
Starbolt was a woman, who was a Major in the Cularin Militia during the time of the Clone Wars. She featured in a number of Militia posters.
Morad'Ka was a female Tarasin who lived on Cularin during the time of the Clone Wars. She was the leader of the Jaraana irstat, a Tarasin tribe.

Kartill was a male Glassferran officer in the New Republic Navy. In 5.5 ABY, he participated in the Battle of Mindor as the executive officer aboard General Lando Calrissian's Mon Calamari Star Cruiser, the Remember Alderaan.
Baltor Yfridian was a male Human, who served in the Thaereian military during the Clone Wars.
Meriones was a Human male lieutenant who served in the Republic Navy as an aide to Captain Gilad Pellaeon of Leveler during the Clone Wars.
Rumahn was a male who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, he was the first lieutenant aboard Leveler, serving directly under Captain Gilad Pellaeon in the Clone Wars.
Lammin was a male Human who served as a chief engineer of the Leveler, serving under Captain Gilad Pellaeon during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Pastav Rone was a starfighter pilot who served the New Republic as part of Twin Suns Squadron during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He fought at Borleias but was injured during the initial skirmish to retake the planet. He recovered, however, and later returned to the fray.

"Shady" Pers was a male Human smuggler living among the Myyydril in the Myyydril Caverns during the Galactic Civil War in 1 ABY. The Myyydril claimed he was their chef, but also said that he did not know the difference between Muon Gold and bofa treats.
This Imperial controller served aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor circa 0.5 ABY. From aboard the Executor, he monitored incoming traffic through the Imperial blockade of Shelkonwa.
Vulta Daanat was a Dark Jedi, who trained as a Sith member of the Brotherhood of Darkness under the Dark Lord of the Sith Skere Kaan during the time of the New Sith Wars.
X2 was a Force-sensitive clone trooper secretly created by the Kaminoans prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

X1 was a Force-sensitive clone trooper created from the template of the Jedi Knight Falon Grey, who served both the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire before proclaiming himself a Sith Lord.
Kyoopid was an Ewok who represented his species during the Ewok Festival of Love.
Alet Komain was a male Human, who was born on the planet Daimar during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He later became its senator and represented it in the Galactic Senate.

Foss was a male Human who served as a key member of the royal family's staff on the planet Naldar during the era of the Galactic Civil War. Foss was present on Naldar in 4 ABY, when Imperial forces violently subjugated the world, killing among others Prince Denin.

Verkoss was a male Trandoshan who worked as an enforcer for the Hutt Brinojja during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, Verkoss unsuccessfully attempted to capture the information merchant Rat for Brinojja on the moon Nar Shaddaa.
Mina Dhori Tolas, originally known as just Mina Dhori, was a female Human who served as a senator in the Imperial Senate and later joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Fredja was an male Imperial stormtrooper captain who served as commander of the Maw Installation's Imperial Garrison. He continually found himself in the midst of conflicts between his commanding officer, Admiral Natasi Daala and Tol Sivron, the director of the Maw.

Freeda was a Imperial admiral, based on the planet Ord Grovner during the Galactic Civil War. He ordered the strike against the Eyttyrmin Batiiv pirates, sending the Crusader and the Bombard to wipe them out.
Daymont Praji, also known by the nickname "Veracity," was a member of House Praji and a commodore of the Galactic Republic's navy during the Pius Dea Era.
Edouard Fenel was a Human Imperial admiral who was loyal to Roan Fel's Empire-in-exile during the Second Imperial Civil War. Fenel was placed in command of the Bastion Second Fleet.
Hallena Devis was a Human spy for Republic Intelligence during the Clone Wars, and was the lover of Captain Gilad Pellaeon.

Dee-Lynn Cance was a male Cerean Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Consular. After leaving the Order, Cance retired to Cularin to live out the rest of his life as a philosopher. During his stay there, he founded the Blue Star Centre.
Hagrana Memuna was a female Sullustan, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Yaru Korsin was a Human male starship captain who served Dark Lord of the Sith Naga Sadow's Sith Empire during the era of the Great Hyperspace War.
Lohjoy was a Ho'Din engineer who served aboard the starship Omen in 5000 BBY, at the onset of the Great Hyperspace War fought between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Olaris Rhea was a female Human Sith Lady in the Lost Tribe of Sith from the remote planet of Kesh. In 41 ABY, Rhea was appointed to be the Master of Sith Tyro Vestara Khai after Khai had encountered a Sith Meditation Sphere named Ship.
Ravilan Wroth, nicknamed Rav by Captain Yaru Korsin and the "crimson man" by the Keshiri, was a male of the Sith species.

Frei Aycen was a noted Corellian pirate operating during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. An idealistic woman, she saw through the corruption that plagued the Galactic Senate, and was known to steal cargoes and supplies while ensuring that her victims were not harmed…

Borrath Freelan, otherwise known as Big Haul, was one of the many independent starship owners whose business was affected negatively by the closure of the Cularin system's borders after the end of the Clone Wars.

Saidle Frex was a Human male mercenary who lived during the decades before the Battle of Naboo. Frex attempted to smuggle veermoks off of the planet Naboo, despite the environmental restrictions placed on them.
Teraeza Furloti was a female Human from Corellia, who served as an operative for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Commander Fuzzel was a member of the Imperial Armed Forces and stationed on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Fuzzel managed to arrange a deal with Jabba Desilijic Tiure, in which Jabba turned over certain criminals to Fuzzel for their rewards.

Peto Kelsan was a Human officer in the Imperial Navy who pledged loyalty to Darth Krayt when Emperor Roan Fel was ousted from the throne by the Sith Lord in 130 ABY. Holding the rank of admiral, Kelsan was placed in command of the Coruscant Third Fleet.

Tikk was an uvak that belonged to Sith Tyro Vestara Khai. Khai obtained Tikk in a competition in 37.5 ABY and subsequently used Tikk as transportation on the planet of Kesh, on which she lived with the other members of the Lost Tribe of Sith.
Pestrak was a member of the Naboo Royal Security Force. He was contacted by Quarsh Panaka to provide backup in a pursuit of a felon.
Dunni was a Human male who was a member of the Naboo Royal Security Force. He was contacted by Quarsh Panaka to provide backup in a pursuit of a felon.

Seelah Korsin was a Human female healer and miner who eventually rose to become one of the foremost leaders of the planet Kesh's Lost Tribe of Sith. Born a slave to Sith Lord Ludo Kressh on the planet Rhelg, Seelah escaped a life of servitude after the execution of her family.

Devore Korsin was a Human male officer in the Sith mineralogical corps during the time of the Great Hyperspace War. The son of a veteran admiral in the Sith navy, Korsin started work with the Sith mineralogical service after a spice addiction derailed his naval career.
Boyle Marcom was a Human male navigation officer who served for decades as part of the Sith Empire's navy during the time of the Great Hyperspace War.
Jariad Korsin was a male Human High Lord of the planet Kesh's Lost Tribe of Sith in the years following the Great Hyperspace War.
Furske was a Kajain'sa'Nikto who served as a captain in the Navy of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire. By 137 ABY, Furske was stationed aboard the Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer
Vaclen Tor was a Human male captain, who served in the Navy of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire.

Tiem Rutnar was a male scientist who lived on Tatooine at the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Jabba Desilijic Tiure's head mechanic Barada requested Tiem Rutnar to decode a datadisc containing the self-destruct code for a storehouse of the Valarian Syndicate.
Scrib Leras was a male accountant for Jabba Desilijic Tiure during 1 ABY.
Phinea Shantee was a patron of the Bestine cantina.
Om Aynat was a former chef who owned and operated a food stand in Mos Entha during the Galactic Civil War.
Nitra Vendallan was a Human female captain of the Rebel Alliance who operated out of the town of Anchorhead on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Mikos Denari was an unarmed townsperson skilled in melee combat who resided on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Lilas Dinhint was the curator of the Museum of Tatooine located in the capital, Bestine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kormund Thrylle was a male Human spy of the Rebel Alliance who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Saes Rrogon was a male Kaleesh Jedi-turned-Sith Lord serving the Old Sith Empire during the onset of the Great Hyperspace War.

Gloyd was a male Houk officer in the navy of the Sith Empire, and later one of the top ranking members of the Lost Tribe of Sith. Gloyd was originally a member of a crew of brigands, who stumbled across the Sith Empire while searching for treasure in the Stygian Caldera.
Drusa was a female member of the Drall species who owned the Luminous Gardens health spa on the planet Drall, and provided the Duchess Sarella with information about local and galactic politics.

Canduri was a female Human who served the Believers Sith cult during the time of the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY, Canduri was stationed at a Believer laboratory on the planet Genarius at which the cultists were developing a virus fatal to the Caarite species.

Gibberous Crumb was a Kowakian monkey-lizard who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was raised by a Hutt, but was eventually abandoned by his master and entered the care of the crime lord Nirama.

Gaan was a Human who led a settlement of pariahs on the Outer Rim planet Ragmar V in 19 BBY, during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the war, he and his group fought the forces of the Galactic Republic.
Gaarx was one of the only Tchuukthai ever to be seen off the species homeworld.

Gabbera was a male Klatooinian who worked for Zonnos the Hutt as a translator, during the rule of the Galactic Empire. Gabbera had been born into slavery, and was turned over to Zonnos as payment for a gambling debt.
Gadsle was a noted Twi'lek Spheroids player during the reign of the Galactic Empire, although he lost more often than he won.
Elwis Bontraar was a wealthy Bothan, who lived on Coruscant with his family during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Gall was a male Human who served as the sheriff of the Landing, on the planet Engebo V. A former miner employed by Outer Rim Oreworks, he lost an eye in a mining accident for which he was given a huge compensation and the position of security chief at the ORO mines.

Gallada was a noted crime lord or Crimex, who worked on the planet Lianna during the final years of the Galactic Republic. A massive police operation was formed to ensure his capture, after it was learned that he was moving goods and information through the Tion Commerce Tower.
A clone trooper served the Galactic Republic's Grand Army during the Clone Wars. He once served on a planet, where he was designated to Post 473 by his superiors.

Mooney was a Human male bounty hunter who worked for another bounty hunter around 20 BBY. At some point in his life, he attempted to capture the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his master Obi-Wan Kenobi in Death Canyon.
Dalton Iselen was a male Human, who lived during the time of the Clone Wars.
Kait was a woman who worked for the Oblee crime lord Nirama during the time of the Clone Wars.

Darth Malgus was a Human male Sith Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire during the time of the Great Galactic War to the Third Galactic War. He was born under the name Veradun within Imperial space, and raised by his adoptive father.
Ara Garren was a female Imperial Intelligence agent during the years following the Battle of Yavin.
Ep Gart was a brash, small-time criminal based out of Mos Zabu, on Tatooine, during the Galactic Civil War.
Garv was a male Pho Ph'eahian mechanic who was a friend of Han Solo during the Dark Times. He helped repair the Millennium Falcon.
Shae Vizla, later Mandalore the Avenger, was a female Human Mandalorian who gained notoriety during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Gatral was a bounty hunter aligned with Crutag while he tracked a team of Rebel Alliance agents on Kwenn Space Station and Trinta. Encountering ex-Jedi Halagad Ventor, the Jedi used the Force to drive the bounty hunters insane.

Crymsin Ost was a Force-sensitive Human female who became a member of the Jedi Order during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. Ost later succumbed to the dark side of the Force and became a member of the Believers, a Sith cult that operated from the Cularin system.
Blik was a male Shistavanen who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Disch'l was a Force-sensitive Ithorian male and a member of the Believers during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Ven Zallow was a Human male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Great Galactic War. When a pair of intruders—Darth Malgus and Eleena Daru—entered the Jedi Temple on the Republic capital of Coruscant, Zallow, accompanied by his colleagues, was quick to confront the two.

Eleena Daru was a female Rutian Twi'lek, and the lover of the Sith Lord Darth Malgus during the Great Galactic War. She was originally a slave in the slave pens on Geonosis, until saved by Darth Malgus. She participated in the Sacking of Coruscant in 3653 BBY.
This Dractuvian Warrior lived on the planet of Dractu, and was a member of the sentient Dractuvian species.
Margo was a Holessian male and a Chief Justice of Holess. In 43 ABY he presided over the case of Colla-Arphocc Automata versus the Galactic Alliance and was interviewed just before the trial's start.
Gecee was a Gran smuggler and a rival of Fenig Nabon. Gecee's ineptitude usually meant that Nabon beat him to the good jobs, a fact that rankled the Gran.
A tattooed Human was a Sith active by 1000 BBY. He traveled to the planet Ceriun when a Jedi starfighter carrying a Jedi holocron had crash-landed there.
Azca was a Yuuzhan Vong commander of the Yuuzhan Vong empire who commanded a miid ro'ik cruiser as part of one of the empire's fleets.
Naatu was a male humanoid businessman of unknown species in operation during the Great Galactic War.

Nok Drayen, was a Human male crime lord whose operations during the Great Galactic War made him an underworld legend, and also a leading member of the fabled Star Cabal. Born the grandson of King Arak Drayen III of Dubrillion, he was the father of Risha, his heir to the throne.
Lithio Motti was a male individual who lived at some point during the last centuries of the Galactic Republic.

Barin Trevina was a male Balosar and accomplished thief. He was born on Balosar but soon migrated to Mos Eisley on Tatooine in search of opportunities. He was known for his ability to get in and out of tight spaces.

Oora Gellandi was a young female Chagrian who lived on the planet Cularin, during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Her lethorns were covered with inlaid rings of various metals and stones, accenting her blue skin.

Lohn Genden, a native of Alderaan, left the planet at the age of twenty-five, some twenty-two years before the planet was destroyed by the first Death Star. In the time before Alderaan's destruction, Genden joined a mercenary organization that worked for Imperial Intelligence.

species: Human, surgically altered to resemble a Mon Calamari

x: Ferroh was a Cathar male who served as a Jedi Knight during the Galactic Republic's war against the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, who were invading Republic space.

Naja Delan was a male Duros who lived with his family on Cularin several years before the onset of the Clone Wars. Serving as Duro diplomats on Cularin, they were highly respected by the other inhabitants of the world.
Gervruche was the Minister of all Imperial Special Corrections Facilities prior to the commencement of the initial negotiations for the Stars' End project.

Mils Gessak was a Human male who served the Rebel Alliance as a scout during the Galactic Civil War, locating small planetoids and asteroids for use as remote bases and sensor posts. He was the leader of reconnaissance team D812.

Noric Gestal was a male Gotal slaver around the time leading up to the Clone Wars. Gestal spent a great amount of time on the planet Ryloth, searching for beautiful Twi'lek females to sell to his customers.

G'hengle was a communications officer serving under Adar Tallon aboard the Alliance to Restore the Republic Mon Calamari Star Cruiser, Silent Water. G'hengle was part of the crew during the engagement at Heterkus.
Eph was a male Human, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Brollyx was an Assistant-Viceprex employed by the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division and stationed on Etti IV.

Joc was a clone trooper who underwent Kaminoan flash training and served in Torrent Company during the Clone Wars. He participated in the Battle of JanFathal against the Confederacy of Independent Systems, and helped to rescue Republic Intelligence agent Hallena Devis.
Torphceris was the last Argazdan Regent of the Argazdan Redoubt during the last years of the Kanz Disorders leading up to the Myrialites defeat in 3670 BBY
Agmor Glayyd was a Human male who served as the Mor of House Glayyd on the planet Ammuud. He groomed his son, Ewwen, to take his place as the head of the clan.
Jona Grumby was a male naval officer who served in the Imperial Navy, and later in the Corporate Sector Authority's Picket Fleet.
Eldrak Korsin was a Human male admiral for the Sith Empire's navy in the time before the Great Hyperspace War. Korsin was a highly respected spacer, never losing a ship during his lengthy career.

Shaey Kayr was a Human male present on the Wookiee world of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1.5 ABY. He was an explorer and had begun his trek across Kashyyyk by first taking in the sights of the Kkowir Forest.
Ren'Salla was a Zabrak female living in the Myyydril Caverns within the Kkowir Forest on the Wookiee planet of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1.5 ABY.
Echrhin Isdan was a male Tulgah living among the Myyydril tribe within the Myyydril Caverns in the Kkowir Forest on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1.5 ABY.

Yraka Nes was a Twi'lek female who worked as a medical nurse. She lived among the Myyydril tribe within the Myyydril Caverns in the Kkowir Forest on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1.5 ABY.
Kkatamik was a Wookiee who sought to spread the ideals of Life Day.
Oraalarri the Elder was an albino Wookiee who sought to spread the ideals of Life Day. He was an elder within his four person family.
Anarra was a Wookiee who sought to spread the ideals of Life Day. She was one of four Wookiees within her family.
Radrrl was a Wookiee who sought to spread the ideals of Life Day. He was one of four Wookiees within his family.
Tebeurra was a Wookiee who sought to spread the ideals of Life Day. She was one of four Wookiees within her family.

Mssikss was a female Trandoshan who resided in a slaver camp on Kashyyyk. Viewing Wookiees as little more than animals, she tasked a pilot with securing a shipment of slaving collars to be used on them.
Boshaz was a Trandoshan who resided in a slaver camp on Kashyyyk.
Gellar Domo was a male Human, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Mari-Elan Nora was a female Lorrdian and a member of the Jedi Order around the time of the emergence of the new Sith Empire.
Gibbs was a shape-shifter who had been hired to aid in the assassination of Senator Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren of Cularin.

Peert Ginzork was the assumed name of an ex-Imperial and the leader of The Shield. Patient and an experienced soldier, Ginzark deserted from the Imperial Army where he had been serving as an assault trooper.
Biron, callsign name "Snow Raptor" was a Human male captain of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

t: Unidentified Imperial officer (Boba Fett's Executor escort)
x: This low-ranking Imperial officer served on the Super Star Destroyer Executor, the flagship of Darth Vader, during the Hoth campaign of 3 ABY.
Den Sait Glass was a member of the Renatasian Confederation, a vigilante organization made up of natives of the Renatasia system, looking to avenge the conquest of their home by the Galactic Empire.
This unidentified female Yuuzhan Vong Shaper appeared in the far reaches of the Argazdan Redoubt during the Kanz Disorders, several decades prior to 3970 BBY.
This trader was a female Hig, a slender blue-skinned species. She owned an automated ore hauler which, in 24 ABY, she donated to the Diversity Alliance, a pro-alien, anti-Human organization.

A male individual was lived on a planet during the Clone Wars, when the planet was overrun by forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. He met Jedi Master Yoda in a cantina. After Yoda destroyed an entire army of droids, this individual thanked him.

Shrandhnrignh, or Sandi, was a female Wookiee, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Jeru was a Human male who was a member of the Wind Raiders tribe on the planet of Taloraan during the Clone Wars.
