Stormwing was a name of the personal fleft-wauf of the Wind Raider Jeru from Taloraan. In 21 BBY, the bird saved the life of Ahsoka Tano by catching her while she was falling from a great height. Later, it managed to destroy at least one Confederate Vulture Droid.

Fortris Gall was a male human Jedi Knight at the time of the Great Galactic War, a conflict fought between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was an apparent practitioner of Jar'Kai, utilizing two lightsabers when a situation called for it.
Buryn was a Togruta male who served as a member of the Republic Military during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Mandalore the Lesser was the title bestowed upon the Human male leader of the Mandalorian warrior clans during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War. Before becoming Mandalore, the man was a young member of the then-scattered warrior clans.
Lucien Bender was a scientist and a criminal who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Haari Ikreme Beeerd was a Phlog crewman who served on podracer Gilag Pitaaani's racing team, which was sponsored by the Muun Chenik Kruun.

Haj was a Human male who founded the Haj Shipping Lines. Supplying the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, Haj secretly allowed Rebel Alliance agents to stowaway aboard his ships, raking in the extra income from their passage fares.
A Dark Jedi apprentice was sent to the planet Yabosta along with some Rodian thugs to eliminate an agent of Jedi Master Niquon. Unknown to her masters, the agent was actually a Jedi Padawan.
Sean Trenwell was a Director of Commerce for Bestine. Throughout 1 ABY, he ran against Victor Visalis in a series of elections, vying for the position of Mayor of Bestine.

Old Warris was a Human male villager and member of the Myyydril tribe. He lived in the Myyydril Caverns along with the rest of his tribe, within the Kkowir Forest on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1 ABY.

Chasuli was a Human female villager and member of the Myyydril tribe. She lived in the Myyydril Caverns along with the rest of her tribe, within the Kkowir Forest on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1 ABY.

Erriya was a male Wookiee who was a former member of the Myyydril tribe and resident of the Myyydril Caverns within the Kkowir Forest on his homeworld of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1 ABY.

Ildisa was a female Wookiee member of the Myyydril tribe. During the Galactic Civil War in 1 ABY, Ildisa's tribe dwelt within the Myyydril Caverns of the Kkowir Forest, on her homeworld of Kashyyyk. She served was one of their mystics.
Patla Soo was a female Caarite, who worked for the Metatheran Cartel during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

A female musician, Janet Lalasha was a Dorenian Beshniquel player who lived during the time of the Galactic Empire. Deemed to be a suspicious individual by the regime, Lalasha was subsequently persecuted and executed, and her music was suppressed by the Imperial authorities.
This Unidentified Sith lived during Great Galactic War. He was killed during a duel at the Troida Military Workshop on Balmorra by Fortris Gall.

Madrix Hansor, leader of Hansor's Hooligans, was a male who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Hansor was previously a member of the Imperial Army. While fighting Rebel forces in the Dalcretti system, the unit was cut off.

Hante was a smuggler and a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic active during the Galactic Civil War. Operating out of Merich's Bend Tavern on Ifeoma, Hante supplied weapons and supplies to Rebels operating throughout the Core Worlds and Expansion Region.
Mister Haque was an assassin residing in the Cularin system during the Clone Wars and partner of Mister Zlash.

Duran Har was a male Human employed by Corellian Translines as a transport captain at the time of the Galactic Civil War. During his time with the company, he was stationed aboard the SV-45, a StarSpeeder 3000.
Hardin was a spacer operating out of Corulag during the Galactic Civil War. He continually modified his L2 Base Labor Droid, surprised that it still operated.

Den Hardon was a criminal who was wanted by crime lord Gornt Seron. Hiring Kin Laron to assassinate Hardon sometime after the Battle of Endor, Laron was able to intercept Hardon's ship while it was fleeing for the Outer Rim.
Adari Vaal was a Keshiri female geologist who led a resistance movement against the Lost Tribe of Sith on the planet Kesh in the years after the Great Hyperspace War.
Gali was a female individual who was a member of the Altisian Jedi during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

A clone who served as a shock trooper with the Coruscant Guard accompanied Commander Stone and several other troopers of the Diplomatic Escort Group with Senator Kharrus and Representative Jar Jar Binks to Florrum.

Clough was a Human male officer who served Galactic Empire during the Galactic Empire. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Captain Clough was assigned to an Imperial space station in the Outer Rim Territories, along with Lieutenant Alin, Warrant Officer Snopell, Lieutenant…
A female individual member of the Rebel Alliance served as a Rebel contact on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Tellulon was a male Human spy who served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Arlo was a male Human technician who served the Galactic Empire, and later defected to the Alliance, during the Galactic Civil War.
Verks was a male officer within the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Jubai Laetlii was a Human male commando who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Laetlii was stationed at the Imperial Oasis, on the planet Tatooine.
A clone trooper commander, in service with the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, participated in Operation: Knightfall under the command of the newly-christened Darth Vader.

Binna Jode was a Human female small-time criminal, bartender and the owner of the Cheapside Cantina, a venue in the Imperial-controlled capital of Bestine on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Bren Kingal was a Human male resident who lived in a small town of Mos Taike on Tatooine and served as a junior officer to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Chaw Troillya was a Bothan information broker and spy who operated near Mos Taike, Tatooine.
Neile Janna was a noted holovid actress, director and producer. Janna returned from a twenty-year hiatus shortly after the Battle of Yavin to work on a holofilm called Kallea's Hope.
Dr. Lytos Urtell was a male Sullustan scientist, best known for his invention of SenseLights, which contributed to fantastic light shows at the Glow Dome on Adarlon.
Gordus Grime was a famous shockball star who purportedly used a muscle-exercising myostim unit during his athletic career to stay in shape with little effort.

Ziakas was a Derriphan who lived in Adarlon's Glow Dome, feeding upon the life essence of females who were dazzled by the light shows in the Glow Dome. One of its hosts was the Glow Dome's co-owner, Kandria A'Daasha.

This clone navigation officer served under General Aayla Secura on the bridge of her Star Destroyer, the Liberty, during the Sky Battle of Quell. He informed her of the arrival of General Skywalker and the Resolute.

Mezdec was a Human male spy during the Separatist Crisis who sent strategic information on Typha-Dor to the planet Vanqor while posing as a communications officer working for the Typha-Dor resistance at a surveillance outpost on the moon TY44.
Sivill was a male Human Captain who commanded a Sith warship in the navy of the resurgent Sith Empire in the period just after the signing of the Treaty of Coruscant.
The Prophet was a male Aing-Tii who lived around the time of the Second Galactic Civil War. He was known for making many specific predictions, all of which came true.
Hargar was a merchant working on the planet Onderon during the decades after the Mandalorian Wars.

Chop Harlison, along with his younger brother, Roy, were orphans who lived on the planet Shesharile 5. After their parents were killed by a swoop gang in their home in Gallisport, Harlison was forced to drop out of school without any funding.

Kend Harlow was a gambler indebted to the Rodian crimelord Hatabbas. In exchange for payment, the Rodian forced Harlow to fight his pet svaper; if he won he could go free, if he failed he would die. Harlow was unable to defeat the beast, and was consumed in battle.

Harn was a Duros male employed by Osaji Varane. Serving Varane as his personal secretary and majordomo, Harn surrendered when Varane was apprehended and killed. In exchange for his life, he gave the killers information on the whereabouts of Osaji Uhares.
Mlaske was a general in the Grand Army of the Republic during the later stages of the Clone Wars.

Bynder Zebb was a corporate Twi'lek male scout who worked for TaggeCo. He had visited worlds including Chandrila and Kal'Shebbol, and was considered an expert in dealing with the creatures native to the planets he was scouting.
The Nalroni Weezo ran Weezo's Gun Shop, a personal armament store which was located in the market of the space station StarForge Station.
Wisel was a Nalroni who owned a weapons shop on Vergesso Base.
Kkral'Nas was a Kian'thar Rebel operative.

Llleag'Mak was a male Kian'thar crime lord who operated as one of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's most favored lieutenants. After Jabba was killed, Llleag'Mak implemented intimidation and bribery to take control over bits and pieces of Jabba's empire.
Ttul'Thar was a Kian'thar businessbeing who worked as a mediator for MadisCorp.
Plook Hartar was a crimelord during the Galactic Civil War. A rival of Servid Norn, both Hartar and Norn believed that they employed the best pilots in the galaxy.

Harthusa was a male Devaronian slaver based on the Imperial world of Deysum III. Although cunning, Harthusa's cowardice was evident. He resided within a luxurious domed apartment where he entertained females of all races. He owned the yacht known as Harthusa's Pride.
Hartin was an independent male spacer who worked with several crime lords during his career. These connections granted him knowledge of many of their schemes to sneak pass the legal system.
This commander was a clone SCUBA trooper that accompanied Jedi General Kit Fisto to Rodia to investigate reports by Rodian scouts of Separatist battle droids seen near an abandoned station.

Ema Slake was a copper-skinned Albingi female who lived on Oseon 5631, known throughout the Centrality for her massive music collection, which was said to contain over twenty-five percent of the known music in the galaxy.
Tauht was a Human male who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Wieler was a Human admiral who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Wieler and their battle group, including Wieler's flagship, the Star Destroyer Resilient, were paired with Jedi Generals Kit Fisto, Plo Koon, and Tauht.
Kortha Hatanga was an old Human male and the captain of the starship Galax Titan. The Titan served as an ore runner operating in the Elrood sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Jopari Haines was a male Rodian who worked for the company Genasys during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Mody was a Caarite, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Flib was a Caarite, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Havaal was a Duros who served as Gallo Memm's chief steward. Charged with overseeing the security of Streysel Island, he stayed on Vaynai while Memm was away on business.

Mareesh was a male Rodian representative of Rodia in the Galactic Senate in 3653 BBY, prior to the Treaty of Coruscant which ended the stalemated Great Galactic War. Under the punitive treaty, the Sith Empire annexed Rodia and several other Republic systems.
Adaroo was a male Khormai from Khorm who served as leader of the Khormai resistance during the Clone Wars. He assisted Jedi Masters Plo Koon and Kit Fisto during the Battle of Khorm.
Jark was the name of a clone cold assault trooper who served in the Devil Dogs unit of the 44th Special Operations Division in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Fixer was a Clone cold assault trooper who served in the Devil Dogs of the 44th Special Operations Division of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Sharp was a clone trooper captain who served in the Devil Dogs unit of the 44th Special Operations Division.

Dace Golliard was a Human male who served the Galactic Republic as a naval officer during the Great Sith War. He later became a member of The Crucible slavery organization. Golliard was the Fleet Captain of the Gladiator.

Qohn was a male Nazzar who in 3963 BBY was a slave to the Sungrazer cooperative, an organization that used slaves for deadly risky comet mining. Qohn managed to survive five dives, which was a record as none have survived more.
This unidentified clone trooper served during the Clone Wars on Khorm. He was beheaded by Asajj Ventress.

Sariyah Budan was a female Koorivar and the leader of the Sungrazer cooperative, an organization that used slaves for deadly comet mining. Based on the Sungrazer, the organization received the slaves from the Crucible and forced them to mine thorilide crystals on the comets.
Hagark was a male Felucian who lived during the early months of the Galactic Empire.
Kargrek was a Felucian, who lived during the early months of the Galactic Empire.

Rikard was a Force-sensitive Filordus who, like other Filordi, had no gender. A youth during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, Rikard lived in Efellis on the planet Caarimon and worked as an errand runner.
Rycus Kilran was a Human male who served as Grand Moff of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and the Galactic War.
Haast Aath was a male Zabrak who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Tysara was a female Tarasin who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Gusha was a green-furred, red-eyed Lepi whose name translated from Huttese to Galactic Basic Standard as "Lucky." As the owner and bartender of the Gusha's Luck cantina in the planet Tatooine's spaceport city of Mos Eisley, Gusha was on-duty in 137 ABY when the bounty hunter C…

Bushman Krentz was a Human male pilot who was regarded as both a drunk and an imbecile by his peers. In 137 ABY, an intoxicated Krentz was passing through the city of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine when he encountered a beautiful female humanoid in a dark back alley.
Brevis Taug was a man who lived during the Rise of the Empire era.
Ross was a clone trooper who underwent Kaminoan flash training and served in Torrent Company during the Clone Wars.
Boro was a clone trooper who underwent Kaminoan flash training and served in Torrent Company during the Clone Wars.
Hil was a clone trooper who underwent Kaminoan flash training and served in Torrent Company during the Clone Wars.
Vere was a clone trooper who underwent Kaminoan flash training and served in Torrent Company during the Clone Wars.
Percival Vale was a force-sensitive male Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Higgie Sethven was a male Cerean who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Ribuk was a male Dug who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Arum Oru was a male Gotal, who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Di'hal'uma was a female Twi'lek who worked as an private investigator during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
This unidentified Imperial soldier was stationed at an Imperial outpost on Vaal, during the Galactic Civil War.
Kruc was a male Kitonak who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Nitram Con Queecon was a male Ranat, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Cadrath was a TIE pilot in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed on a corvette shortly before 3 ABY and was assigned as the first wingmate of rookie pilot Maarek Stele, teaching Stele how to properly check his flight suit prior to launch.

Relin Druur was a male Human Jedi Master active around 5000 BBY. After his first Padawan, the Kaleesh Saes Rrogon, turned to the dark side, Druur and his second apprentice, Drev Hassin, began tracking Rrogon.

A male Neimoidian commander commanded the forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Battle over Kothlis. When he was informed that the Galactic Republic's forces nearly equaled those of the Confederacy, he chose to retreat.

Eulyn was a Keshiri female who lived on the planet Kesh around 5000 BBY. The mother of widowed geologist Adari Vaal, Eulyn cared for her two grandchildren, Tona and Finn, in a wooden house in the city of Tahv inherited after the death of her son-in-law, Zhari Vaal.
Muuta was a female Chagrian, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Izri Dazh was a Keshiri male member of the planet Kesh's ruling Neshtovar, active in the era of the Great Hyperspace War.
Ori Garran was an individual who sent their son to learn from scholars after his work at a mill proved dissatisfactory.

Nink was a male member of the avian uvak species who lived on the planet Kesh in the years following the Great Hyperspace War. Hatched in 5015 BBY, Nink eventually became the personal steed of the Keshiri Zhari Vaal, a member of the world's Neshtovar ruling council.

Hestus was a Sith male who served the Sith Empire during the age of the Great Hyperspace War. A cyborg, Hestus worked as a translator during the war, and in 5000 BBY was aboard the Sith dreadnaught Omen when it was knocked off course as it jumped to hyperspace and crash-landed…

Zhari Vaal was a male Keshiri who was a member of the planet Kesh's ruling council, the Neshtovar, in the era prior to the Great Hyperspace War. As a member of the Neshtovar, Vaal was a skilled uvak-rider, although he often mistreated his flying uvak beast, Nink.

Tona Vaal was a male Keshiri agent of a Keshiri resistance group active on the planet Kesh in the years after the Great Hyperspace War. Vaal was born the youngest son of geologist Adari Vaal and her husband, Zhari Vaal.
Finn Vaal was a male Keshiri native of the planet Kesh who lived in the era of the Great Hyperspace War.
Qwallo Mode was a Duros Jedi Knight who served in the New Jedi Order during the time following the Second Galactic Civil War. He was believed to have perished during a mission in 42 ABY.

Matas Havel was a Human trader and the first owner of the YT-2400 transport later called the Lambarian Crab. At some point, Havel modified the ship, adding extra cargo space and enhanced shielding to deal with pirates.
This unidentified Imperial commander was stationed on Coruscant during the Galactic Civil War.

Geo Cthon was a male Human, who lived on the planet Coruscant during the time of the Clone Wars. He was married to Jeela Cthon and together, they owned and operated Lucky You, a service that used amateur actors to allow people to pretend that they had a better life.
Jeela Cthon was a female Human, who lived on the planet Coruscant during the time of the Clone Wars.
Hawj was a Bothan diplomat and author from the planet Thoran during the Galactic Civil War. During the early years of the Galactic Empire, Hawj pursued a business alliance with Skydove Freight.
Razor Leader was a male pilot for the Thaereian military during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Hawra was an Imperial captain serving as the commander of security at the Lotide Technical Branch Outpost.
Vinzel Haylon was a Human male Imperial warden who served in the Dathomir Prison during the Galactic Civil War.
Carlitina Semla was a female Twi'lek who worked for the pharmaceutical company Culpharm during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Beem Dwaller was a male Sullustan, who lived on the planet Cularin during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Ta'Mara was a female Tarasin, who lived on the planet Cularin during the time of the Galactic Republic. She worked as a cleaner at the house of the Cerean Waz-alem Amir, in the city of Hedrett.
Blut was a male Sullustan, who worked for the company Culpharm on the planet Cularin, during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Mien was a male Sullustan, who worked for the company Culpharm on the planet Cularin, during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Galdovar was a Human male Galactic Republic Intelligence agent who was in contact with Hallena Devis on JanFathal in the city of Athar during the Clone Wars.
Massin served as a Chief on the Republic Assault Ship Leveler under Captain Gilad Pellaeon. In 22 BBY, they escorted young Padawan Ahsoka Tano to her cabin.
Ollo was an engineer who worked in the navy of the Galactic Republic. In the Dantus sector in 22 BBY, Ollo served aboard the Republic assault ship Leveler under the command of Captain Gilad Pellaeon.

Bren was a clone trooper who served as a petty officer on the Republic Navy's Republic assault ship Leveler under command of Captain Gilad Pellaeon, in 22 BBY. While aboard the ship in the Dantus sector, Bren came across Pellaeon while the latter was touring the lower decks.
Talie Heathe was a slender Human female scientist from Alderaan specializing in oceanics, who lived in the years before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
Bas Bishop was a male Human who worked for the pharmaceutical company Culpharm on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Mol Hedron was a Human Imperial spy from Swarquen. Serving the Galactic Empire for many years before the Battle of Yavin, he went to ground after Emperor Palpatine's death at the Battle of Endor.

Noshy Heer was a vagrant forced to scrounge for credits after gambling all his money away in the Relatta system. Trying to return home to Alderaan, where the rest of his money was stored, the planet was destroyed before he made it.

Heggel was a Human male who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Heggel held the rank of Admiral and was assigned to command the Trax Sector Group.
Waz-alem Amir was a male Cerean, who worked for Culpharm on the planet Cularin, during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Arrogha was a male Wookiee who worked as a security guard for the company Culpharm on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Caleb Clancy was a male Human, who worked as a security guard on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Heigren was a male Zeltron governor who served as the Northern Province of Zeltros at a point after Governor Vertag's tenure.

Hela-Tan was a male Togorian pirate active directly before the Battle of Naboo. Hela-Tan was sent to search Darth Maul's ship, Scimitar, after his band of pirates succeeded in surrounding Maul as the Zabrak assassin journeyed to Tatooine.
Helm, along with his partner, Vandel, were independent prospectors who were the first beings to discover the planet Vandelhelm, with the planet eventually being named after them.
Heloan Yagen was the wife of Bovo Yagen. The fifth planet in the Bovo Yagen system was named after her.
Mourne Blee was a male Twi'lek, who worked for the company Uniformal Attire during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Mambo Farls was a male Human who worked as a designer on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Gelly Farls was a female Human who lived on the planet of Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Varti was a Human male criminal who was a citizen of Athar on the planet JanFathal during the Clone Wars.
Merish Hath was a Human female and a citizen of Athar on the planet of JanFathal.

Shil Kaval was a Human male criminal who was a citizen of Athar on the planet JanFathal during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he and his girlfriend Merish Hath met with Orla Taman, who was revealed to be an undercover agent of the Galactic Republic.

Derel was a clone naval officer who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. Holding the rank of lieutenant, he served as a principal warfare officer of Leveler, under command of Captain Gilad Pellaeon.
Baradis was an officer in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, he served as a deck officer of Leveler, under command of Captain Gilad Pellaeon.

This Dazouri was a male farmer from the remote planet of Gibbela. Like the rest of his species, the farmer was polymorphic, being able to change into a small, weak form, and a larger, dangerous form with claws.
Sargon was a male Imperial Army Captain who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Hennilrum was a trader who worked the spacelanes of Trax sector during the Galactic Civil War. Sympathetic toward the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Hennilrum used his connections with Treffelt Wuin to leak information on the Galactic Empire's supply base in the Bissillirus…

Veritts was an Admiral in the Imperial Navy during the Rebellion era. Veritts commanded the Carnifex, and at one point fabricated a plan to capture Rebels by having HoloNet News report a fake story involving a missing shipment of bacta.

Aven Rolk was a male Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Surviving the execution of Contingency Order 66 after being stranded in an escape pod frozen, Jedi Rolk tried and failed to reestablish the Jedi Order on Zissh.

This Nikto was the captain of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's Nikto guards during the Clone Wars. After Jabba's son, Rotta, was kidnapped from his sail barge, Jabba ordered the captain to execute the crew of the sail barge in order to show that failure on their scale would not be tole…

Lieutenant Hereven was a male Human serving in the Galactic Scout Corps, nearly half a century before the Battle of Yavin. When Milac Troper returned to from an unknown jungle planet reporting Hereven's death, the Corps filled his death as unexplained and moved on.

An officer was an Imperial officer in the Imperial Army. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the officer was part of a small Imperial task force sent to the remote planet of Gibbela to conquer the planet for the Empire.

Nyronusa was a male Tarasin, who lived in the Cularin system during the time of the Galactic Republic. He disliked the Metatheran Cartel and during the Clone Wars, attempted to attack a celebration that the Cartel was holding on the moon Dorumaa.
Xinishia was a female Tarasin, who was a member of the Wyrd, a group of Force witches who operated on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Barrarro was a male Wookiee, who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Chywarra was a male Wookiee, who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Risstenni was a Wookiee who lived on the planet Cularin during the time of the Clone Wars. Circa 21 BBY, Risstenni's son, Chywarra, was abducted by the Wyrd, a group of Tarasin Force witches.
Surracca was a male Wookiee, who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Delinna was a female Wookiee, who lived on the planet of Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Deadeye was the name of a clone cold assault trooper who served in the Devil Dogs unit of the Grand Army of the Republic's 44th Special Operations Division during the Clone Wars.
Sten was a clone cold assault trooper who served in the Devil Dogs of the 44th Special Operations Division of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Blunt was a clone cold assault trooper who served in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army during the Clone Wars.

This male admiral was a member of the New Republic Defense Force, serving during the early years of the New Republic. In 8 ABY, he commanded the task force that liberated the planet Kal'Shebbol, the capital of the Kathol sector.
Teelasin was a female Tarasin, who worked as a customs officer on the planet Cularin.
Ethan Adare served the Imperial Mission, an organization dedicated to the Fel Empire's "Victory Without War" program, on the planet Tatooine during the Second Imperial Civil War.
Nad Baron was a male Human, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Gorruth was a male Human, who worked as a security guard during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Ul-Modo was a male Cerean, who worked for the Cularin Militia during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Jyn N'oram was a female Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
D'yra Calisse was a female Twi'lek, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Vicca Drane was a female Human, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Josa Kenn was a male Duros who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Enja Ode was a Human woman, who worked as a pilot during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Arturo was a Human male King of the planet Orocco during the Galactic Civil War. In 2 ABY, his daughter Mi was kidnapped by a small band of criminals led by Grintlok, who demanded ransom in exchange for her release.
Dust was a male bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. In 2 ABY, he was contracted by Raze to find the kidnapped daughter of Orocco's King, Arturo.
Druuven Herr was a male Human native to the planet Lianna. A strong supporter of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, he was known to be slow-witted in conversation.
Geddy was a Dressellian male, who, along with Grintlok, Kubla and an unidentified Feeorin kidnapped Mi, the daughter of King Arturo, to demand ransom for her release.
Grintlok was a male Barabel, who, along with Geddy, Kubla and an unnamed Feeorin kidnapped Mi, the daughter of King Arturo, to demand ransom for her release.

A Selkath Padawan took part in the First Battle of Ruusan alongside another Selkath Padawan under a Cerean Jedi Master in the Army of Light. She was choked to death by Lord Kopecz, while the other was fatally struck by Kopecz's Force lightning.

A Selkath Padawan took part in the First Battle of Ruusan alongside another Selkath Padawan under a Cerean Jedi Master in the Army of Light. He was killed by Lord Kopecz's Force lightning, while the other Padawan was choked to death.
Morturr Heth was a Human pirate and a member of the Disac gang. After Ket Maliss destroyed the gang, Heth, one of the few survivors fled, stealing Az-Iban's ship and heading for safer space.
Kubla was a male Devaronian, who, along with Geddy, Grintlok and an unidentified Feeorin kidnapped Mi, the daughter of King Arturo, to demand ransom for her release.

Tookra was a male Geonosian who, in 2 ABY, resided in the Kishpaugh spaceport of the Nelvana Gas Cluster. He hired Han Solo to deliver him a shipment of parts, but Solo turned up eight months later than arranged.
This male Feeorin, along with Geddy, Grintlok and Kubla, kidnapped Mi, the daughter of King Arturo, and demanded a ransom for her release.
Mronk was a male Wookiee who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Rrooogli was a female Wookiee who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Tanora was a female Tarasin, who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Tensa Voll was a dark-skinned female Zabrak who served as a Jedi Knight during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Barnaby was a male sensor technician who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, he served on board the Liberty under the command of Admiral Yamarus.
Kasslan was a female Tarasin, who lived on the planet of Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Niroida was a female Tarasin, who lived on the planet Cularin. She was the Mother of the Vriisan irstat a Tarasin tribe, until about 30 years before the Clone Wars, when she was succeeded by Kasslan.
Talon Raal was a female Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. She worked as a soldier and a scout.
Jalina was a Tarasin female who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Naelora was a female Tarasin, who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Torunin was a female Tarasin, who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Baeshana was a female Tarasin and a member of the Wyrd Force witch living on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Veshin was a female Tarasin, who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Savina was a female Tarasin who lived on the planet of Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Kosaa was a female Tarasin, who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

The Black Sun captain worked for Czethros, a criminal mastermind involved in the Black Sun criminal organization. The captain was involved in Czethros' attempted takeover of the Spice Mines of Kessel.
Fitre was a Kubaz, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Lanitha was a female Twi'lek who lived on the planet Ryloth during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Deellsta Maroojj was a male Twi'lek, who lived on the planet Ryloth during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Dovoul was a male Besalisk, who lived on the planet Ryloth during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Jan-Ira Toru was a female Human who served as a member of the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Cheib'Kalla was a corpulent Twi'lek, who lived on the planet Ryloth during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He owned and ran the Fungus Pit, a cantina.
Jebbiz'Foreanda was a male Twi'lek, who lived in The Enclave on Ryloth during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Jarrti'Klomas was a male Twi'lek, who lived on the planet Ryloth during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Renci Tosh was a Human female and a Rebel spy and recruiting agent during the Galactic Civil War.
Pakku was a male Human who served as a stormtrooper in the Imperial Navy. He was assigned to the stormtrooper contingent aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Imperator as of 1 BBY.

The Yuuzhan Vong had deployed two siege creatures—Tu-Scart and Sgauru—and with Galfridian at his side, Le'Ung led the troops in an attempt to distract the creatures long enough for Skywalker to rescue the refugees.

The Commander ordered the presence of Nina Galfridian for a meal in his throne room, but received her daughter Kaye instead. He stabbed her with a coufee to show her the Yuuzhan Vong way of embracing pain. He was beheaded by Arbeloa in a revolt of slaves led by Kaye.

Bry was a clone commando who was a member of Galaar Squad, trained by a Corellian sergeant of the Cuy'val Dar to fight for the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

This Titterbug princess was royalty among the Titterbugs of the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, she was considered as a potential bride for Vork, the prince of a tribe of Gorphs. Despite Vork's interest in the insectoid princess, his mother, Queen Slugga, did not approve.
Vylagos was a male Skakoan engineer from the Core World of Skako who built experimental weapons and war matériel for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Jark was a male Human CorSec officer who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
A Human male commander was in service of the Galactic Empire in the years before the Battle of Yavin.
Sessaly was a Human resident of the planet Gibad. Sessaly was also a distant cousin of Separatist scientist Ovolot Qail Uthan.

Tani was a female Mandalorian warrior and the wife of Mij Gilamar. Tani met Gilamar while he was a doctor, and the two fell in love. At some point later, they were married, and Gilamar was adopted into the clans, becoming a Mandalorian.
Talte was a Human male who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. He was an officer of the Corellian Security Force.
This Ithorian had two hostile confrontations with Prince Coby at the Zallakesh spaceport.
Tobar was the owner of Honest Tobar's Used Spacecraft at the spaceport of Zallakesh on Chuzalla.
Dathnaeya Loessin was a Human female who served as a member of the CorSec on Talus during the Galactic Civil War.
Jilam Kester was a male Human member of the Antarian Rangers.

Churg Anaris Hej was the Deputy Head of Imperial Procurement shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. Hej made a report regarding the stockpiling of beskar and the possible difficulty of acquiring Mandalorian metalsmiths to work on the beskar.
Vamilad was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Keenah was a male captain in military service to the Galactic Empire in 3 ABY. He was dispatched by the Galactic Empire to assist Lord Starkiller during a mission to search for Rebel commander Luke Skywalker, who had been leading the Alliance's forces for some time.

Ferroda was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He was killed during Order 66 by Force-sensitive clone trooper X2 on the planet of Cato Neimoidia.

Falon Grey was a male Human Jedi who lived in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. A Padawan of Jedi Master Rahm Kota, Grey was badly injured on one occasion, prompting Kota to request aid from the Kaminoans.
Aoloiloa, literally "the one before Lo and after Il," was a Cephalon who lived on Coruscant around 19 BBY, shortly after the end of the Clone Wars and the rise of the Galactic Empire.
Price was a doctor living during the Galactic Civil War. He suspected that Trandoshans were infecting the captive Wookiees with a disease that lowered their life expectancy.
Stroon was the owner of the Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie as well as the captain of a Starhunter menagerie ark.
Roly Melusar, nicknamed "Holy Roly" by the commandos he commanded, was the new commander of the Imperial Commando Special Unit, replacing Sa Cuis, shortly after the birth of the Galactic Empire.
Ennen, also identified as IC-4447, was a clone commando and a member of Galaar Squad, trained by a Corellian sergeant of the Cuy'val Dar to serve the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Feeana Tala was a female Mawan. She became a crimelord after a civil war broke out on the planet of Mawan.
Ubis Reendorr was a male Rodian smuggler and information broker from Corellia.

Rede, designated TK-70558, was a clone commando created in Spaarti cloning cylinders on Centax-2 around 20 BBY. He was created from second-generation clone material, and was grown in the span of just one year.

White was a soldier of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vector in 1 BBY. He survived the Blackwing disease and was one of the last survivors on board the derelict Star Destroyer. He later died saving Zahara Cody.

species: Genetically engineered creature, comprised of a Cannok, Boma, and Blar
x: Seventeen was a genetically engineered creature created by Passel Argente's modified T-series tactical droid, "Doctor."

Zorajas Garamin was a Human male farmer who lived on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. A very delusional individual, Garamin believed he could actually farm droids by planting them in the ground.

Vordell was a male Human smuggler from Corellia. He was known for being ruthless and not having a conscience. He was overweight and wore oversized shirts to hide his girth, and had a thick goatee of brown hair that matched the wavy, but graying, hair on his head.
Lorka Gedyc was a Mandalorian warrior of Clan Gedyc, and a member of the radical Mandalorian splinter group known as the Death Watch.
This Imperial commander was an Imperial officer from Kemla who was assigned as the garrison commander on the Galactic Empire's garrison on the planet Mandalore.
Jarkyc was a male Mandalorian who resided in the planet of Mandalore in 19 BBY. He wore a deep brown armor and his knuckles were tattooed with Mando'a runes.
Hayar was a Mandalorian who resided in the planet Mandalore in 19 BBY.
This male Mandalorian resided in the planet Mandalore sometime before 19 BBY. He was the brother of Hayar, who was also a Mandalorian.

Sude Raalo was a Neimoidian arms merchant who operated out of Mos Eisley spaceport on Tatooine. He operated as a supplier for the Hutts and as a go-between for smugglers. Raalo was considered to be a relatively honest trader.

Iggjel was a male Ithorian who was part of the Wayland Herd. Sometime before 3951 BBY, the tender-in-training felt the call of the Mother Jungle, the planet-spanning jungle of the Ithorian homeworld Ithor.
Borik Yelgo was a male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Marga Captison was a female Human who was the wife of Dol Captison, a public prosecutor. She was a spokeswoman for Imperial Relations on the planet, but was secretly involved in the Bakuran resistance, and died for it in 1 ABY.

A Duros lieutenant served in Galactic Alliance Security in 43.5 ABY. After the failed arrest of psychotic Jedi Knights Yaqeel Saav'etu and Bazel Warv by Security Captain Atar, the Captain ordered that Jedi Knight Jaina Solo and Imperial Head of State Jagged Fel, who had helped…
Hunde Decan was a male Zabrak who lived on the planet Lok during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Amyva Va'new was an female Ithorian cook, who lived in Nashal on the planet Talus during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Darkstone was a male Zabrak, who served in the Imperial Military as a Colonel during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Spraug was a Vratix low-scale criminal living on Nar Shaddaa during the Yuuzhan Vong War. He had in his possession a holocron with Yuuzhan Vong spies in the galaxy.
Da'la Socuna was a Human female who served the Rebel Alliance as a pilot during the Galactic Civil War.
Montrus was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kath Scarlet was the female Human captain of the Binayre Pirates, a band of pirates and smugglers that operated within the Corellian sector during the Galactic Civil War.

A Corellian was recruited into the Cuy'val Dar by bounty hunter Jango Fett to help train the clone commandos in the Grand Army of the Republic. As a Corellian, he was one of the few non-Mandalorian sergeants in the Cuy'val Dar.
Flitcher Poste was a Human male from the moon Nar Shaddaa.
Lennart was a male corporal in the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Marutz was a Human male serving as a Rebel Alliance general. He was captured by the Empire following the Battle of Hoth and imprisoned on the planet Etorasp before being taken aboard Darth Vader's Star Destroyer. He was eventually rescued by Luke Skywalker.
Mihalik was a male Svivreni miner working in the mines of Af'El during the first days of the New Republic.
Torsteen was a male Svivreni crimelord who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Kinch Sunka was an individual who became a Beast-Lord, the leader of the Beast Riders of the planet Onderon. Sunka lead the first Beast Rider attack on the city Iziz, beginning a conflict on Onderon that would last for centuries.

Bug-Eyes was a male pilot belonging to the sentient species native to the planet Xantar. He met Luke Skywalker after the Rebel Alliance officer destroyed an Imperial cloning facility. The pilot brought Skywalker to Xantar aboard his starship.

Keelyvine Reus was a Human female Jedi General during the Clone Wars. She had the tutelage of the Padawan Tyzen Xebec foisted upon her during the conflict after Xebec's former Master, Bolla Ropal, was slain by the bounty hunter Cad Bane.

Dron was a Human male admiral in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In the early stages of the conflict, he served with Jedi Generals Keelyvine Reus and Kit Fisto during an expedition to the vital agriworld of Ukio.
Satyr Azzlectico was a king, who reigned during the time of the Galactic Empire. He was toppled by the Ailon Nova Guard, who defeated him by using scouting and ambush tactics.

Maydla Churhee was the wife of Vlaydm Churhee, the leader of the mercenary force Churhee's Riflemen. Whilst on a mission for the Galactic Empire in the Y'Trella system, the Riflemen became pinned down and were abandoned by Imperial forces, who had promised to back them up.

Ralen was a male Human from the planet Corulag, who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. He attained the rank of Captain and commanded the Venator-class Star Destroyer Solidarity during the Battle of Tirahnn.
Braxus Lyn was a Force-sensitive female Clawdite, who worked as a mercenary during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Ezar Elasra was a male Barabel Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Shara-Or was a female Draethos who lived on the planet Tirahnn during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Toluz Cheq was a male Rodian Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, commanding a fleet of Venator-class Star Destroyers.
Bern Nuladeg was a Renatasian fighter pilot who became one of the final warriors avenging his fallen homeworld during the Imperial Era.
A Human sergeant in the planetary defense force of the moon Gall served during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Narl was a Rodian male who held the rank of colonel during the Galactic Civil War. His followers were mercenaries, sworn to keep trespassers away from the Jedi ruins on Mustafar.
Baylis Archan was a male Human Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as an apprentice to Jedi Knight Sha Koon.
These two aliens of unknown species came to Governor Koong's headquarters to trade.
Harko Vane, a Human male, was the King and Viscount of Valahari, a member of the House of Vane, a close friend of Dooku, Count of Serenno, and the father of Tofen Vane.
Omi Vane, a Human female from Valahari and a member of the House of Vane, was the wife of Tofen Vane who died around 22 BBY.
Elodore Vane, a Human female from Valahari and a member of the House of Vane, was the Lady of Harko Vane, the Viscount of Valahari.

Vesek was an Imperial Corrections Officer aboard the Imperial prison barge Purge in 1 BBY. He was part of the boarding party sent to scavenge for parts aboard the Star Destroyer Vector. He unknowingly contracted the Blackwing Virus and helped carry it back to the Purge.

This Neimoidian navigator served Daultay Dofine on the bridge of the Revenue. When Arwen Cohl and his crew infiltrated the ship, he, Dofine and the rest of the crew flew to the Acquisitor and escaped before the Galactic Republic caught them.

This Sullustan communications technician served Daultay Dofine on the bridge of the Revenue. When Arwen Cohl and his crew infiltrated the ship, he, Dofine and the rest of crew flew to the Acquisitor and escaped before the Galactic Republic caught them.
Brukarra was a Human female communications officer who served aboard the Black Talon, a Gage-class transport serving the reconstituted Sith Empire's Navy during the Cold War.
This Gran officer served Daultay Dofine on the bridge of the Revenue. He controlled the central computer op the Lucrehalk-class battleship.
Sylas was a Human female lieutenant and executive officer of the Black Talon, an Imperial transport ship serving the Sith Empire under Captain Revinal Orzik during the Cold War.

An Ishi Tib assistant served Daultay Dofine on the bridge of the Revenue. When Arwen Cohl and his crew infiltrated the ship, he, Dofine and the rest of the crew flew to the Acquisitor and escaped before the Galactic Republic caught them.

This individual was a humanoid male Sith Master in the Sith Triumvirate who lived in the time of the Dark Wars. He oversaw the Tomb of Freedon Nadd located on Dxun, a jungle moon of the Inner Rim planet of Onderon.
H.F. Marigand was an officer who worked for Imperial Intelligence shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire.
Varan Cormin was a male Human who worked as a technician for the Galactic Empire during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Mazzi was a Human male colonel who served in the Nimbus commandos of the Nationalist Army during the Clone Wars.
Barkin served in the Republic rocket-jumper c. 4789 BBY under the rank Master Jumper.
G. Bresch was an individual who served as a lieutenant in the Cularin Militia, during the time of the Clone Wars.

Saell-Terae was a male Yarkora who claimed to be a dealer in antiquities. The owner of the ship Lost Reef, he spent a time mapping the Unknown Regions for unclear reasons. After a brush with Grand Admiral Thrawn, Saell-Terae was forced to abandon his ship, at least temporarily.
Balliol was an individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic aboard a corvette during the Galactic Civil War.

A Sith captain was an officer in the Sith Empire during the Sith Civil War. The captain was posted on Dxun, and was the fifth officer to hold the post after his predecessors were killed either by the beasts of Dxun or their Sith superiors.

Lassin was a Jedi Knight in the New Jedi Order, who died soon after the Disciples of Ragnos crisis around 14 ABY. In 41 ABY, Lassin—along with Jedi Master Kam Solusar, Mara Jade Skywalker, and the Sith Lady Lumiya—appeared to Jedi Knight Jaden Korr in a Force vision.

Anskow was a Human who lived on the planet Coruscant during the early days of the Galactic Empire. During that time, he served as a part time community police officer with the Coruscant Security Force.
Forrie was a male Human thief on the planet Coruscant.
Kimm was a male Human thief on the planet Coruscant.
A male Bothan was a thief on the planet Coruscant.
A male Rodian pilot was once stuck on the Mezeg sector freight terminal during an inspection by stormtroopers on all departing ships for stowaways.

Harkan Resch was an independent merchant and prior owner of the Mystic Burn. Following the Blockade of Naboo by the Trade Federation, he was forced to sell the ship, hoping to make enough to live comfortably for the rest of his life.
Pilba Dalohog was a male Em'liy who chose to travel off Shalyvane after its devastation, making him one of the few Em'liy to do so.
Mar'holt Kisfrel was an Em'liy General during the Galactic Civil War.
Daltrid was a male S'kytri who served as Lord of the Lowlands of Skye during the Galactic Civil War.
Kailél was a male S'kytri who served as Lord of the Outlanders of Skye during the Galactic Civil War.
Governor Spenori was a Zeltron governor of the Southern Province of Zeltros at a point after Governor Vertag's tenure.
Elav Feen was a Twi'lek male who owned the popular spacer bar The Swirling Vortex.
Jizal Taphan was a female Duros pirate who targeted Corellian ships passing through the Duro system, specifically shipments carrying spice and other illegal cargo.
Card Captor, also known as "The Captain," was the codename for the male Sullustan who ran the Rebel Alliance cell on Cloud City since a year before the Battle of Hoth.
Doc Drase was a female Human doctor that worked on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
Spensor Kluub was a male Twi'lek slicer living on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
Batral Orcel was the male Human son of a wealthy Cloud City family.
Tereez Tey'flah was a female Bothan and member of the Rebel cell on Cloud City led by Card Captor.

Kal Vorusk was a male Human working with ISB agent Govin Thane to stop a group of Rebel agents on Cloud City. He was a hulking man who attempted to murder the Twi'lek slicer Spensor Kluub in Room 564 of the Grand Bespin Hotel in Cloud City.

Blue Eight was a Rebel Alliance fighter pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Serving as a member of Blue Squadron, the Rebel stationed onboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Defiance until being killed in the months before the Battle of Endor.

Green Two was a X-wing fighter pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, Green Two escorted the freighter Otana past Imperial Star Destroyers during the Battle of Hoth, alongside Green Leader.

Green Leader was a X-wing fighter pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the pilot escorted the freighter Otana past Imperial Star Destroyers during the Battle of Hoth, alongside Green Two.
Malva Greeku was a male Rodian, who worked for Black Sun during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Lev Palik was a male Human, who worked as a sniper for the Recon team 05, a special unit of the Rebel Alliance during the First Galactic Civil War.

Wren Cristol worked as a spotter for the sniper Lev Palik and together, they formed recon team 05. During a conflict on a world, recon team 05 were ordered to take up a position near to an enemy bunker.
Noth was a male near-Human active during the New Republic era.
Miera Lij was a female Human slicer who worked for the Security Forces of the Alvorine Authority during the time of the New Republic.

t: Unidentified Imperial ambassador to Rhamsis Callo
x: The Imperial ambassador to Rhamsis Callo was an Imperial official assigned to Rhamsis Callo, the homeworld of the feline Schenor species.

Destor was a male Ukian from the planet Ukio who served as an assistant to the Liege during the Clone Wars. A downcast individual, Destor was present to welcome a Galactic Republic team led by the Zabrak Padawan Tyzen Xebec to inspect Ukio's defenses.

Sanya was a Devaronian female member of the Agricultural Corps, serving as a delegate for the Galactic Republic on the agriworld Ukio. During the Clone Wars, she met the Padawan Tyzen Xebec, who labeled her a "washout" inadvertently.

A male Ukian liege served on the agriworld Ukio during the Clone Wars. The world was being targeted by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, prompting the Galactic Republic to dispatch a task force led by Jedi General Keelyvine Reus to Ukio, to ensure that the planet was wel…
Tonzet was an male Ukian farmer from Ukio. He had no love for the Galactic Republic and argued against Ukio's willingness to supply the Grand Army of the Republic with victuals during the Clone Wars.
This Ukian worker lived on Ukio during the Clone Wars. He was a friend of Tonzet and helped him. He met Sanya when she and Tyzen Xebec went to Ukio to inspect the planet's energy shield.
The brother of Marn Hierogryph was a Snivvian male and a citizen of the Galactic Republic who recorded pro-Republic propaganda broadcasts during the Mandalorian Wars.
Peawp R'dawc was a female Zabrak and combat expert who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. She was the owner of the R'dawc Bodyguard Agency.

Zim Zam Blattis was a male Gungan leader of a smuggling gang during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following 0 BBY, a spacer was tasked by Gavyn Sykes to eliminate Blattis, in which the spacer succeeded.

Ilaani Soresh was a Human female and the wife of Imperial commander Rezi Soresh. When her son Kimali Soresh joined a group of Rebel sympathizers, Ilaani tried to help her son escape capture. She confided the whole matter to her husband so that he may bid his son farewell.
Kimali Soresh was the son of Rezi Soresh.

Cunbus Locb was a Sullustan gambler, conman, and collector of art who piloted the Corellian XS-800 light freighter Distant Wind. He tricked Moff Ammar of Portmoak sector to get the Chandrilan flatsculp "Stars and Moons."
Visacc was a Tarc, and held the position of Keddek—the elected ruler of Hjaff.
Fascyn was a Tarc who worked as an assassin and bounty hunter for House Salaktori.

Nho'Apakk was an Ewok warrior from Bright Tree Village on the Forest Moon of Endor. During the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, he helped Rebel Alliance forces defeat Galactic Empire stormtroopers. Nho'Apakk had off-white fur and wore a greenish hood.
A member of the Jedi Order, an Aqualish Jedi of the Quara race served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. The individual had brown hair, gray eyes and brown skin.
A Human individual served as a Jedi during the Clone Wars. At one point, they wielded dual lightsabers in battling a B3 ultra battle droid.
A male individual of the Codru-Ji species trained as a Jedi in the New Jedi Order sometime after the year 40 ABY. The four-armed man had fair skin and long, brown hair that he wore loose.
A member of the New Jedi Order, this Human fought in a battle and was badly injured. After the battle, the Jedi was found by Chief Healer Cilghal, who healed him.

A member of the Jedi Order, this Human served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. After surviving Order 66, they did battle with Dark Jedi Namman Cha, pitting the power of Faalo's Will against their opponent.

Ona Antilles was a female Human Lieutenant who served in the Galactic Alliance Remnant. A member of the Antilles family, Ona was the daughter of former Galactic Alliance Triumvirate member Bail Antilles.
Tealart was a Mon Calamari shipman who served in the Galactic Alliance Remnant.
Delt Nerris was a starship pilot and a sympathizer of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Elga Arbo was a Corellian woman and the captain of the modified Starfeld Industries Z-10 Seeker Redshift Runner. She specialized in fast deliveries.
Maceb Joodsen was the co-pilot and mechanic of the Redshift Runner under captain Elga Arbo.

Brother Xando was a male insectoid alien of the Norclu Order. In 0 BBY, Xando and his sect were on a pilgrimage to their holy planet Norclune and searched for a pilot in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on Tatooine who could take them there.

Krion Grail was a Human admiral in the Navy of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire. At the time of the Second Imperial Civil War, Grail was the commanding officer of the First Coruscant Task Force, with the Devaronian Captain Shantillen as second in command.
Shantillen served as a captain in the Navy of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire at the time of the Second Imperial Civil War.
Ton Arashai was a male Nagai secret agent who gained access to the upper echelons of Coruscant society through his employment as a maintenance worker in the Senate District.

Dal Zorfenn was a male Nagai commander in the Nagai expeditionary force. Alongside his subordinate, Lieutenant Cyn Jodu, Zorfenn was tasked with securing the planet Kinooine that it might serve as the primary base of operations for the Nagai fleet's planned invasion of the gal…

Cyn Jodu was a female Nagai lieutenant in the Nagai expeditionary force. Alongside her superior officer, Commander Dal Zorfenn, Jodu was tasked with securing the planet Kinooine that it might serve as the primary base of operations for the Nagai fleet's planned invasion of the…
Dromios was a Mon Calamari shipman who served in the Galactic Alliance Remnant and would participate in the Battle of the Arkanis sector.

Silara Panteer was a female Human from the planet Alderaan and a member of the noble House Panteer who served as the Queen of her homeworld for several decades during the Great Galactic War and Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Raurlu Eloz was an individual from Glakka. When a Rebel operative, posing as a Glakka merchant, approached ISB captain Jeffren Brek, he was asked if he knew Raurlu Eloz or Zoort.
Loza Sil'ban was a female Bothan member of Bothan Spynet, operating during the Galactic Civil War.
CT-5/373, also known as 5/373, and Seven-three, was a male clone warrior who served in the Grand Army of the Republic. As a clone soldier, 5/373 was created on the planet Kamino by the Kaminoans.
Lon Cope was a male Human CorSec officer who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Griggs Pe'et was a Balosar who met Han Solo at Kislov's Gambling Palace in 0 ABY. Pe'et wanted Solo to get a "valuable shipment" from an Imperial satellite.

Cleroff was a Human male who served as king of half of a technologically-inept planet during the Galactic Civil War. He was the brother of Marius who served as his vizier, and the father of Princess Risa.
Risa was a Human female Princess from a technologically primitive planet. She was the daughter of King Cleroff, the niece of the royal vizier Marius, and the girlfriend of Prince Gil.
Gil was a Human male prince from a technologically-inept planet. He was the son of a king who ruled the side of the planet closest to the night, and the boyfriend of Princess Risa.

A Cathar served as a Jedi during the Great Hunt. He accompanied Shaela Nuur, Duron Qel-Droma, and Guun Han Saresh during the Cleansing of Tatooine. During the cleansing, he was killed by a Terentatek. His body was then taken back to Dantooine.

Dromboid was an Amorphiian male who worked for an Amorphiian company that distributed technologies around the galaxy. He hosted an instruction cassette video that accompanied a brand of mini-transmitter sold outside the company's base in the Amorphiia system.

An officer of the Galactic Empire made announcements regarding interplanetar travel restrictions and curfews. He was also responsible for broadcasting instructions and requests for communication to Imperial patrols via common wallscreens.
Gat was a male Devaronian who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was distinguished by his broken horn, which reputedly gave him a lopsided appearance.

A Neimoidian controller worked for the Trade Federation around 32 BBY. Their job was to monitor the power generators in the hangar bay of the cargo freighter Saak'ak. During the Federation's blockade of the planet Naboo, they worked in a small computer room in the Saak'ak.
Moritz Nor was a male Ortolan musician and the leader of the band Hyperdrive.
Blandings was a man who served the Galactic Empire as an engineer during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Greeley was a man who served the Galactic Empire as an engineer during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Phibes was a man who served the Galactic Empire as an engineer during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Quatermass was a Human male who served the Galactic Empire as an engineer during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
To-yel was a Gotal male who lived on the TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated-owned planet Narg in the Rayter sector. Unlike most non-Humans on Narg, he was content with his lot.
Gilles Sartoris was a Human man who lived during the time of the Galactic Empire.
Pauling was a man who served in the Imperial Navy during the time of the Galactic Empire.

Qa'till was a member of the Laboi species. Gaining control of the starship maintenance on the planet Hypotria, Qa'till became a crime lord. Some of the Laboi's employees killed a deep-cover Rebel agent, who was also the owner of R2z-DL.
Koedi Raef was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She piloted a BTL Y-wing starfighter, on which she discovered a hidden data packet from the R2z Starship Maintenance Droid R2z-DL.

Xivhkalrainik, known to others as Xalek, and derogatorily referred to as bone-face by Overseer Harkun, was a Kaleesh male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War and the war against Zakuul.
Khem Val, also known as Shadow Killer or Devourer, was a male Dashade servant and warrior of the Sith Lord Tulak Hord and centuries later the heir of Aloysius Kallig, the future Darth Nox.
Lucius Rothingham was a former engineer working for the Galactic Empire as a spy. His Imperial career also involved kidnapping, interrogation and sometimes killing.

The father of the pirate leader Hondo Ohnaka was a male individual. Hondo's father lived on Sriluur during Ohnaka's childhood. He and his wife were poor swindlers and they sold Hondo as a slave to "honor" the Weequay god Quay.

Farsten was a male individual who embarked on a mission with Jackson Farseeker, a retired Imperial captain. Farseeker was in possession of an alien device known as the ou'tranoi. Being an excellent bargainer, Farsten offered him a hundred credits for it.
Jav Patrell was a male Human and a captain in the New Republic Navy following the death of Emperor Palpatine at the Battle of Endor.
Austin served the Galactic Empire as an Imperial Corrections Officer during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Joth was a Human male who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. He was an officer of the Corellian Security Force.

Roff Volane was a male, who served in the military and attained the rank of Captain. During a conflict on the planet Pleida, he assigned a group of agents to escort the surgeon Lieutenant Pleth Juun to the base Camp Kavel, where a number of officers had been injured.
Pleth Juun was a Human woman, who became a surgeon and joined the military.
Fonker Dahk was a male Human and the bartender of the Event Horizon cantina on Rangorah.
Tripp was a male Human who was part of Aeona Cantor's group that was opposed to Shadowspawn's rule on the planet Mindor.
Boakie was a male Human who was part of Aeona Cantor's group that stood against Lord Shadowspawn's rule on the planet Mindor during the Galactic Civil War.
Norris Prang was a male Human pilot who served as a wing commander in Lord Shadowspawn's army.

S. V. Skynx was a Ruurian who was a famous military historian. By between 11 BBY and 3 BBY, a statue of Skynx was displayed at the University of Bar'leth on the Core Worlds planet Bar'leth depicting the Ruurian wearing a jacket.

Kathos Loof was a miner during the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War. He was mining chief working in the Graveyard of Alderaan when Darth Vader "requested" Loof allow a team of Imperial Intelligence agents use his station as a base of operations in a trap set to capture Prince…
Dal Rogos was an Human male agent of the Imperial Security Bureau during the Galactic Civil War.

DRN-38 was an individual who commanded a unit in the Trade Federation Droid Army. Between the years 39 BBY and 36 BBY, DRN-38 was sent to the moon Alaris Prime, where the droids in DRN-38's unit ambushed the Wookiee Attichitcuk, nearly killing him.

Medd Tandar was a male Cerean Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order who lived during the Golden Age of the Old Republic where he served the Council of First Knowledge in their quest to locate and recover all remaining Sith artifacts across the galaxy following the New Sith Wars.
Sal Ransen was a male scholar known for his work regarding Xim the Despot. Sal was affiliated with the Obroan Institute for Archaeology.
Hylei Indrexu Cortess, often called just Indrexu, was the queen of Ranroon circa 25,100 BBY.

Voor was a crooked captain of the Skeebo City Constabulary on the planet Skeebo. Voor thought very highly of himself, and thought himself to be even higher than Boba Fett. Voor would often alert Skavers of right beings arriving on the planet.

Aldanna was a Republic admiral active during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, the Republic attempted to establish blockades of neutral worlds that provided military aid to the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Gerran was a Human male prince of the planet Doan who lived during the Golden Age of the Old Republic. Sometime after 1000 BBY, he contracted Idolian fever, from which he was cured by the healer Serra.
Oziaf was the most trusted counselor of Xim the Despot. When Xim's empire first encountered the Hutt Empire, Xim sent Oziaf to lead negotiations with the Hutts on the planet Ko Vari.
Ferece was a man, who once served as the King of the Kingdom of Cron.
Maslovar Tiatiov served as the military leader of the planet Desevro.
Nuyu was a Lafrarian who worked as a tattoo artist and a body decorator in the market of the space station known as StarForge Station, as of 0 ABY.
Clea Sook was a Human female mercenary who was active during the Galactic Civil War. She was a hard-edged woman and was distinguished by the black tattoos covering her face and hands.
Kyrisa was a Human Nightsister witch from the planet Dathomir, banished by her clan following a fierce battle for leadership.

Obba was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the Golden Age of the Old Republic. A contemporary of Worror Dowmat and Valenthyne Farfalla, who he served together as Padawans in the Army of Light during the New Sith Wars.
Ma'ya was a female Twi'lek Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order following the New Sith Wars and the Ruusan Reformation.
Pendo was a male Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order following the New Sith Wars and the Ruusan Reformation.
Winnoa was a female Human Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order following the New Sith Wars and the Ruusan Reformation.
Ross Mysliwiec was a male Jedi who served the Jedi Order long before the Clone Wars.

Waglin was a male Weequay and friend of Cix Trouvee. He flew with Trouvee as the co-pilot of the Millennium Falcon in the years leading up to the Galactic Civil War, flying with him during the battle of Yag'Dhul in 5 BBY, when the Imperial forces targeted the gamblers on one o…

This commander was the leader of the Yag'Dhul insurgents, a group of resistance fighters on Yag'Dhul. They were attacked by Imperial forces in 5 BBY; their base was destroyed and they were forced to flee into hyperspace.

This individual was the commander of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Desolator during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 5 BBY, this individual commnaded the force that was sent to attack a group of insurgents on the planet of Yag'Dhul.

This Mudgub princess was royalty among the Mudgub tribe of the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, she was considered as a potential bride for Vork, the prince of a tribe of Gorphs. Despite Vork's interest in the princess, his mother, Queen Slugga, did not approve.

Jedder was a male living during the time of the New Sith Wars. He fought during the wars in the Army of Light against the Sith of the Brotherhood of Darkness. After the end of the war in 1000 BBY, he became a senior member and Captain of the Doan Royal Guard.
Argel Tenn was a human male antique dealer who dealt in the trade of illegal Sith artifacts during the time following the New Sith Wars.
Gelba was a female Human from the planet Doan who represented a group of miners who rebelled against the Doan Royal House during the time following the New Sith Wars.

Quano was a male Rodian bartender who lived on the planet Doan. In 980 BBY, he took the Jedi Knight Medd Tandar to meet with Doan's mining caste; however, the Jedi and miners were all assassinated by an Iktotchi assassin.

Pommat was a male Human smuggler and janitor living on the planet Doan around 980 BBY. He worked in a spaceport, where he broke into several unsuspecting travelers' ships and hid shipments of the spice glitterstim in them, which would then secretly be picked up by one of his c…

Fen Teak was a Muun painter, whose portraits bore an unmistakable style, and who was considered brilliant by the Sith Lord Darth Zannah. By 980 BBY, Dark Jedi Set Harth had acquired several of Teak's portraits and set them for display in his mansion on the planet Nal Hutta.
Unna Lettu was a painter from the planet Antar 4, the homeworld of the Gotal species. Lettu was considered the planet's most famous painter by 980 BBY.

Jood Kabbas was a renowned Duros sculptor whose works were available in the galaxy by 980 BBY. By this time, Dark Jedi Set Harth had acquired several of Kabbas' sculptures, which he displayed in his mansion on the planet Nal Hutta.

Sapphire was a female Human smuggler born circa 22 BBY whose parents died in an accident due to an error made by the Imperial officer Dane Tizzin. Following their deaths, Sapphire became a smuggler and helped the scoundrel Kevas Startron in his last run.
Dane Tizzin was an Imperial officer of an influential family. He was raised in the Imperial Navy ranks to become a commodore, hiding a youthful crime caused by his incompetence.
Kevas Startron was a smuggler, the owner of the ship New Cov Quasar and a collaborator of Sapphire and Airen Cracken.
Aelon Reglis was a gambler and family man from Chandrila.
Lynx Reglis was a female Human officer of the Galactic Empire, an impersonator to the smuggler Sapphire and later a fugitive to the Empire.

The father of Gerran was a member of the Doan Royal House and King of the planet Doan during the time following the New Sith Wars. He was the father of Prince Gerran, and he opposed to Gerran's marriage to Serra.

Mitar was the King of Daimar during the last years of the Galactic Republic and the leader of the Lamont Dynasty of Daimar. His children were Erra, Rondar, and Torrin and his granddaughter was Princess Winera.
Torrin was the son of King Mitar and of the Lamont Dynasty of Daimar. His siblings were Erra and Rondar, and was the uncle of Princess Winera.
Winera was a Princess of Daimar. Her mother, Erra was of the Lamont Dynasty of Daimar and her grandfather was Mitar, the king of Daimar during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Draado was a bearded Human male miner living on Doan around 980 BBY. Draado dug up Sith artifacts on Doan, which he claimed as his own.
An Elomin commanded a task force of capital ships and starfighters that served the New Republic Military during the Galactic Civil War.
Sthonnart was a major in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

In 5 ABY, Tirossk participated in the Battle of Mindor. When General Luke Skywalker's flagship Justice was destroyed by Lord Shadowspawn's gravity bomb, Tirossk became the unofficial commander of the Rapid Response Task Force by virtue of his seniority.

GWC-04 was an individual in the service of the Droid Army of the Trade Federation during its colonization effort on the moon Alaris Prime between 39 BBY and 36 BBY. GWC-04 commanded an outpost which contained a troop center that produced B1-series battle droids.
Lyechusas was a famous Lisst'n dramatist.

Hogrum Chalk was a Force-sensitive Human male who served Emperor Roan Fel until Fel's death in 138 ABY. Originally one of the Emperor's Imperial Knights, Chalk was maimed in an accident and consequently fitted with a cybernetic suit of life-preserving cyborg armor.

This male Arkanian offshoot lived at some point between the Great Sith War and the Mandalorian Wars. He was a medical student and became involved as a researcher in the project of Antos Wyrick, a Zeltron Mandalorian scientist, who sought to create Force-sensitive children at h…

A female Arkanian offshoot lived at some point between the Great Sith War and the Mandalorian Wars. She was a medical student and became involved as a researcher in the project of Antos Wyrick, a Zeltron Mandalorian scientist, who sought to create Force-sensitive children at h…

The father of Gharn was a male Nagai. His son was a boy with the strong connection to the Force who was sent to train into the Jedi Order. Gharn, however, was murdered by his own Master Xamar during the Padawan Massacre of Taris.

This female Falleen was the biological sister of Kamlin, a female Falleen Padawan training at the Jedi Tower on Taris in the years following the Great Sith War. In 3964 BBY, Kamlin was slain by her own Master Raana Tey during the Padawan Massacre of Taris.
This male Ho'Din was the grandfather of Oojoh, a boy with a strong connection to the Force who was training at the Jedi Tower on Taris in the years following the Great Sith War.

Rrabel Dage was a Duros Loyalist from the planet Duro. During the Yuuzhan Vong War and just prior to the Battle of Duro, he protested allowing refugees to relocate to Duro and planned to use his contacts with the Bburru Docking Authority to sabotage emergency supplies being tr…
Dulse Tethin was a Duros from the planet Duro. He served as the Administrator of the Vydat Stardock.
Roax was the leader of the Myneyrsh tribe living on Wayland following its devastation by the Yuuzhan Vong.

A male Devaronian worked as a senior magistrate on the planet Concord Dawn. He was sympathetic to the anti-Human Diversity Alliance, and delivered some Human prisoners from Concord Dawn to Ryloth for the Alliance.
Grev T'Ran was an individual who served as a commander in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Jez Planchet was a Human male member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. He served as a lieutenant in the Alliance Military. In 1 BBY, Planchet went on a deep covert mission to the planet Malastare without being able to transmit to the Alliance.

Salto Zendar was a male Meerian criminal who lived during the Golden Age of the Old Republic. Zendar and his three brothers attempted to kidnap a high-ranking Muun officer in the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

This bounty hunter was a male Twi'lek who lived around the time following the New Sith Wars. In 987 BBY, the bounty hunter tracked Salto Zendar to a hospital on Bandomeer in an attempt to win the substantial bounty which had been set forth by the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

t: Unidentified clone trooper commander (Christophsis rescue mission)
x: This clone trooper was a commander in the Grand Army of the Republic. In 22 BBY, he led a squad of clone troopers during the Battle of Christophsis to rescue 25 prisoners that had been captured by the Separatists.
The partner of the Rodian Luugro was a Rodian with black eyes and green skin who was present on the Outer Rim planet Taris during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Urgiluu was a baby krayt dragon owned by the Muun Nal Kenuun on the planet Muunilinst. Kenuun's unusual devotion to the creature—at odds with his typically cold demeanor—was well known within his community, to the point that others laughed at him behind his back.

Mak Luunim was a Muun who resided in the city of Pilaan on the planet Muunilinst. Aside from being a collector of art based on himself, Luunim also supported the Rebel Alliance by handling its secret financial accounts.
Mak Luunim's employee was a Muun who served Mak Luunim, a member of the Rebel Alliance and an avid collector of art, in his home in the city of Pilaan on the planet Muunilinst.

A Zabrak was an associate of the space pirate Rav. In 137 ABY, the Zabrak was present on Zeltros when Rav offered Cade Skywalker a bounty on a "local pest" on Wayland. The Zabrak attacked Cade after witnessing Cade kill Rav's other associate.
The Kajain'sa'Nikto was an associate of the space pirate Rav. In 137 ABY, the pirate was present on Zeltros when Rav offered Cade Skywalker a bounty on some natives on Wayland.

Torv Keist was a commander in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Serving in the Hitak Harriers, Keist fought against the Galactic Empire's Hell's Hammers repulsortank unit at the Battle of Turak IV.
An Eodon was living on the Forest Moon of Endor in 3 ABY. At some point, the Eodon its tusks, and they ended up in the possession of a merchant named Mooth who operated a trading post on the moon.
This individual was a male that was a commander of a starship. He assisted Jedi Knight Gira and the Jedi's group of Padawans in escaping the forces of the Galactic Empire during the Great Jedi Purge.
Maraki was the name of a Hoth hog that had been altered in size and appearance by genetic engineering.
Ploob was a monster employed at Horville's Hut of Horrors. He looked like a small green ball with a long tube-like nose and hair along his spine.
Sera Jossi was a Human female who lived on the planet of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.
