Wrhisch was a male Wookiee who lived on the planet of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War. He was once afflicted by a strange disease that turned him mad, along with his Wookiee followers, until a spacer put him out of his misery.
Choster was a Twi'lek male engineer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He had a sister, Sheeli.

During the Invasion of Naboo, a Yarkora citizen lived in a house in the Slave Quarters Row in Mos Espa. During the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn's visit on Tatooine, the citizen's house was overtaken by a group of criminals, who tried to rob Vek Drow.
Mott Besup was a male technician who worked in the Undercity of Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
Ren Savroon was a male Rodian who repaired craft for the Galactic Republic's armada during the Clone Wars.

Los Dor was a Sith Colonel during the Great Hyperspace War. He served under Saes Rrogon aboard the Sith dreadnaught Harbinger, and served as a spy for Naga Sadow, keeping tabs on Rrogon's actions and worthiness to be a Sith.
A clone of Jango Fett served as an AT-TE gunner during the Clone Wars.

Ageaughu was a carax who lived during the Galactic Civil War. It was the pet creature of Overlord Rrynt'vor of the Rak'qua tribe. After the Battle of Yavin, the beast lived in a cave of Station Gamma, in the Bright Jewel system.

Krepauk was a male Wookiee who was the Huntmaster of the Rryatt Trail on the planet Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War. As Huntmaster, Krepauk tested the hunting prowess of the travelers of the trail by giving them a variety of different hunts to undertake.
Nilsson was a lieutenant of the Galactic Empire and planetary record keeper of Dantooine.
Dender was a Human male junk dealer who did business out of the city of Marmle on Naboo's moon of Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Maximilian Vox was a male Human officer of the Galactic Empire who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Ubbal Fenn was a female Human lieutenant of the technology-hating Meatlump gang who lived on Corellia at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Hershel Sheridan was a male Human politician that lived on Corellia at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Menchi Lerann was a male Gran spice addict who lived on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Vuul Sarlin was a male Zabrak spice dealer boss who lived on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Annor Fash was a Rodian male Chirq Council lieutenant who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Vella Corse was a Human female Chirq Council lieutenant who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Vora Anjek was a female Twi'lek Chirq Council adjutant who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Jzoro Quanera was a male Human underboss of the Chirq Council who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.

Durr Roddack was a Human male who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He was a manager in the White Thranta Shipping Company, a front for the illegal activities of Jabba the Hutt's criminal organization.

Brok Ziam was a Human male who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He was the Director of Operations of the White Thranta Shipping Company, a front for the illegal activities of Jabba the Hutt's criminal organization.

Polard Manfred was a male smuggler individual who owned his own YT-1300 light freighter. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he was captured while flying his YT-1300 in the Corellian system.
Drev was a Chiss male sergeant in the Imperial Diplomatic Service of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. He was stationed aboard the Ziost Shadow.
This sniper was a Human mercenary who was hired by Arwen Cohl, under the orders of Eru Matalis, to assassinate Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum.

Haasi was a male Human from the planet of Valahari who fought in the Clone Wars under the Confederacy of Independent Systems. He participated in the Battle of the Veil Nebula and perished in the fight.

Striker was the name of a clone trooper who served in the Galactic Republic's Shadow Squadron during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Striker participated in a battle in the Veil Nebula against the forces of the Confederate ace pilot Tofen Vane.

This merchant was an elderly Human male who worked on the planet Taris. In 3956 BBY, he failed to repay a debt he owed to crime lord Davik Kang. Kang sent two bounty hunters after him, cornering him in the Upper City.

Malik was a male Human technician who worked aboard the Haj Shipping Lines luxury liner Star of Empire in the year following the Battle of Yavin. Malik was secretly working for the Galactic Empire, tasked with installing the SIM into the liner's computer for its first test.
Sephani was the Mosciive Empress of the Inner Rim planet known as Simocadia, the mother of prince Yojan and a good friend of the Jedi Master Mace Windu.
Yojan was the son of Empress Sephani and Prince of the Simocadia royal family.

Demo was a male Mosciive right-hand of prince Yojan of the Inner Rim planet Simocadia. He was loyal to the prince and supported him in his attempt to destroy the agrocite mines with an ancient Ardana Shadex in order to make both sides of the Clone Wars lose interest in their p…

Tobin was a male Mosciive soldier and a loyal supporter of the Empress Sephani of his homeworld of Simocadia. During the Clone Wars, the CIS launched an assault on the planet and Tobin was one of the last men standing to defend the Empress in her palace.

Carl Mosik was a male Human hunter living on the Rryatt Trail on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1.5 ABY. He was an active, undercover member of the Wookiee resistance, a group against the Empire's endorsement of Trandoshan slavery of the Wookiee people of Kashyyyk.

Orrin was a male Neimoidian ally of the CIS during the Clone Wars. He was convinced by the prince Yojan from Simocadia to sponsor the operation of excavating and reactivating an Ardana Shadex - an ancient stone giant build by a mysterious Simocadian race.
A pink skinned Pachydermoid pirate who was part of the crew of pirate Captain Gir Kybo Ren-Cha.
Ronald Rinzler was a male Human who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant. He was a politically minded boy who sported a somewhat formal hairstyle and was voted president of the student council.
A crew member of the pirate Captain Gir Kybo Ren-Cha served as a co-pilot aboard the Dianoga.

Grunta was a Dug podracer who lived in the city of Pilaan on the planet Muunilinst. In 0 ABY, a few months after the Battle of Yavin, Grunta encountered the Rebels Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Tobin Elad on the outskirts of Pilaan.
A insectoid pirate who was present in the courtroom of Captain Gir Kybo Ren-Cha on the planet Tarnoonga.
This individual was a male Muun bartender who worked in a cantina on the city of Pilaan on the planet Muunilinst.
Lurrexu was the name of the pet rancor of the Dathomirian Arch Witch Azzenaj from the Singing Mountain Clan.
Gilag Pitaaani was a male Nuknog podracer who resided on the planet Muunilinst. He was under the employ of the Muun Chenik Kruun.
Chenik Kruun was a Muun male who resided on the planet Muunilinst. He was the employer of the Nuknog podracer Gilag Pitaaani.
Gorvo was the pet rancor of the Dathomiri Witch Nandina from the Nightsisters. He was as fierce as his mistress and would defend her to the death.

Nandina was a Human member of the Nightsister clan of the Dathomiri Witches during the Galactic Civil War. She was imprisoned in the Chamber of Banishment; however, at some point she escaped along with her pet rancor Gorvo.
A blue skinned pirate of unidentified species who was part of the crew of pirate Captain Gir Kybo Ren-Cha.
The Executioner was a dark side Force-user who was an unwilling follower of Exar Kun.
The Embraced Chaos of Exar Kun was a dark side Force-user who was an unwilling follower of Exar Kun.
The Lingering Harmony of Exar Kun was a dark side Force-user who was an unwilling follower of Exar Kun.

The Promised Vengeance of Exar Kun was a dark side Force-user who was an unwilling follower of Exar Kun. A powerful disciple, Promised Vengeance was specially trained to dominate others with his vast knowledge of the Dark Side.
The Unquenchable Wrath of Exar Kun was a dark side Force-user who was an unwilling follower of Exar Kun.
The Exar Kun Wordbearer was a dark side Force-user follower of Exar Kun, devoted to the worship of his master and little else.
Treetor was a Rodian in the employ of Jabba Desilijic Tiure as a hired thug. At some point, a businessman named Bennova gifted a starship to Treetor.
This crew member of pirate Captain Gir Kybo Ren-Cha served aboard the Dianoga and was later present at the pirate headquarters on Tarnoonga.

Watkins was a pilot who fought in the Galactic Civil War on the side of the New Republic. A member of Grey Squadron, a military unit under the command of the Jedi Knight X2, Watkins participated in a mission to the planet Dathomir in search of the Imperial warlord X1.
A pirate was under the command of Captain Gir Kybo Ren-Cha who was present at the pirates base on Tarnoonga, and also served as part of the crew of the Demolisher.

Nal Kenuun was a Muun male who resided in the city of Pilaan on the planet Muunilinst. He was a wealthy and powerful gambler who held high-stakes games and participated in illegal Podracing by sponsoring his own Podracer pilot, Grunta.
Luthik Uwyr was a male Human dark side adept who served the Galactic Empire during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

A Human male clone stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire served in the 501st Legion during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he was stationed aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Devastator, under the command of Lord Darth Vader.

Vaxan was a male Verpine who worked in the Yarith Bespin casino, in Cloud City on the planet of Bespin. He failed to turn up for work one day, causing the casino's droid dealers to become worried about what had happened to him.

Darth Glovoc was a male humanoid Sith Lord who served Darth Revan's Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War. In the final years of the conflict, Glovoc led several highly successful campaigns against the Galactic Republic.

Dosin was a corpulent, bald Imperial engineer in charge of high-energy concepts at the Maw Installation weapons facility. The only hair on his head were eyebrows, which were dark and narrow. His lips were so thick that when he smiled, he could balance a stylus on them.
Jet Nebula, born Jeke Kerron, was a male smuggler who was active during the Cold War.
Shin-Ay was a male T'surr member of Ken-Kiba's spice runner gang who resided on the planet of Telerath.

Red Wing was the call sign of a member of Red Squadron, a Rebel Alliance starfighter squadron which was also referred to as "Red Wing." The Rebel pilot designated Red Wing was second-in-command to Red Leader Wedge Antilles and was tasked with overseeing the individual units th…

Chet was a male Human customs officer who worked at the primary spaceport in the capital city Daplona on the planet Ciutric IV. He commonly attended the Theta-class T-1 vessel Victory, the personal shuttle of Darth Zannah—whom he knew as "Allia Omek".
Keek was a pilot in the New Republic Fifth Fleet who was killed in the Battle of Doornik-319.
A male Human was the father of Dado and the husband of Nikollane. He worked as a fisherman before abandoning his family on the planet Telerath.

Kymayrr was a female Wookiee living in Kachirho on the planet Kashyyyk. In 1 ABY, her son Rroot was captured by a group of Trandoshan slavers known as the Blackscale Clan. She hired a spacer to travel to their camp in the Rryatt Trail and rescue him.

Ieerat was a Drall chemist. Ieerat carried out a study of the atmosphere of the planet Boonta and the results suggested that a catastrophe that had occurred in the planet's past probably happened after the time of Xim the Despot.
Axkatta was an individual who served the Hutt Empire during the time of the Xim Wars, as the chief financial planner of Clan-General Kossak Inijic Ar'durv.
Pupaku was a Klatooinian male who lived during the Xim Wars.

Ryder was a Human male member of the New Republic Grey Squadron, which was commanded by the Force-sensitive clone X2. Ryder was among the Grey Squadron pilots who accompanied X2 to the planet Dathomir in an effort to locate X2's brother, X1, an Imperial warlord.

Tavoy was the name of a pilot in the New Republic's Grey Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. At some point between 11 ABY and 19 ABY, Tavoy participated in a mission to track the Imperial warlord X1 to the planet Dathomir.

Chonyo was a Yuuzhan Vong warrior who crewed aboard the Crimson Axe at some point before the year 137 ABY. The Crimson Axe was a vessel captained by Rav, a notorious Feeorin pirate whose opportunistic crew helped him attack ships and settlements throughout the galaxy.
Heartstriker was the name given by Jariah Syn to the Yuuzhan Vong amphistaff he tamed on Wayland in 137 ABY.

Zenoc Quah was a member of the Yuuzhan Vong shaper caste who lived during the Yuuzhan Vong War and in the aftermath of the death of Supreme Overlord Shimrra Jamaane, surviving well into the Sith–Imperial War and the Second Imperial Civil War.
Fionah Ti, the non-Force-sensitive daughter of two Jedi, learned other skills from the Jedi and the Yuuzhan Vong on Zonama Sekot, including basic Shaper skills.

Thoax Osaax, along with his brother Farge Osaax, was a Neimoidian scout around 3700 BBY. In competition with Freia Kallea, he and Farge extended parts of the Hydian Way. However, her tenacity forced the Osaax to hire Duros Banu Hydia to eliminate her, which did not go as planned.

Farge Osaax, along with his brother Thoax Osaax, was a Neimoidian scout around 3700 BBY. In competition with Freia Kallea, he and Thoax extended parts of the Hydian Way. However, her tenacity forced the Osaax to hire Duros Banu Hydia to eliminate her, which did not go as planned.
This Mandalorian warrior was a member of the Death Watch during the Clone Wars.
This male was part of the Mandalorian Death Watch during the Clone Wars.

Shalini was a Human female Typha-Dor resistance fighter stationed on TY44. She served as crew leader of the hidden satellite outpost; her husband, Mezdec, served as first officer, responsible for communications.
Drophan was a male Massassi warrior serving under the Sith Lord Saes Rrogon aboard the dreadnaught Harbinger prior to the Great Hyperspace War.
Guzald was an old Devaronian male and former slave to the Galactic Empire. After being freed by the Kadri'Ra crime lord Saadoon-Kauldi, Guzald willingly served Kauldi as his personal translator.

Pret Swain was the manager of the Socorro-based Caelli-Merced Syndicate, a manufacturer of illegal and semi-legal technology. Swain's parents, both of whom were University of Alderaan scholars, were killed in the destruction of Alderaan.
Alpha was a clone of Jedi Master Kam Solusar, created by Imperial scientists on the orders of Grand Admiral Thrawn. He was the mate of Hunter with whom he sired two daughters, Blessing and Grace.
Darth Rauder was a humanoid female who served as a Sith Lady in Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt's Order and Galactic Empire.
Milsin was a male Human who resided in the city of Farpoint on the planet Fhost. He was the owner of the Black Hole cantina in 41.5 ABY.
Xic was an individual, who lived during the Pre-Republic era. Xic was the son of King Xer of the Kingdom of Argai, and the brother of Xil, Xim, Xom and Xuc.
Xil was an individual, who lived during the Pre-Republic era. Xil was the son of King Xer of the Kingdom of Argai, and the brother of Xic, Xim, Xom and Xuc.
Xom was an individual who lived during the Pre-Republic era. Xom was the son of King Xer of the Kingdom of Argai, and the brother of Xil, Xim, Xic and Xuc.
Xuc was an individual who lived during the Pre-Republic era. Xuc was the son of King Xer of the Kingdom of Argai, and the brother of Xic, Xim, Xom and Xil.

When Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived to Mandalore, this Mandalorian guard said that Duchess Satine Kryze was waiting for him. He then brought Kenobi to the Palace where he would meet with the Duchess.
Bail Falcris was a male Human who worked as a Senate Guard during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Domino was an alias that was used by a member of the Galactic Senate during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Darth Vurik was a male Sith Lord who served Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt's One Sith order during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Thela was a human bellhop who worked in the Palmo Plaza hotel on the planet Ghorman. At twelve years old he survived the Tarkin Massacre, which took place in the plaza and claimed the life of his father.
Pylum was the Master of Cerements on Necropolis. During the year 0 ABY, he participated with Doctor Cornelius Evazan as part of the Project Starscream.

Bergan was a Human male who was a Rebel Elite Commando of the Rebel Alliance Special Forces during the Galactic Civil War. He accompanied Leia, Chewbacca, Han Solo, and Luke Skywalker to Kiva on a mission to stop Project Starscream.
Tino was a Human male who was a Rebel Elite Commando. He accompanied Leia, Chewbacca, Han Solo, and Luke Skywalker to Kiva on a mission to stop Project Starscream.
Rax was a Human male who was a Rebel Elite Commando. He accompanied Leia, Chewbacca, Han Solo, and Luke Skywalker to Kiva on a mission to stop Project Starscream.
Sikes was a Human male who was a Rebel Elite Commando. He accompanied Leia, Chewbacca, Han Solo, and Luke Skywalker to Kiva on a mission to stop Project Starscream.
Kalf Arranda was a Human male from Alderaan and the father of Tash and Zak Arranda.
Milessa Arranda was a Human female from Alderaan, and the mother of Tash and Zak Arranda.
A Rodian hermit lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he guided a young adventurer in becoming the Hero of Tatooine.
Feruun Lern was a male member of the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders during the time of the Mandalorian Wars.
Kolas was a male Cathar who resided in the city of Farpoint on the planet of Fhost. He was a regular on the Black Hole cantina and often engaged Khedryn Faal—a salvage jockey—in friendly banter.
Stellet was the captain of the ship Starfire. He was a regular on the Black Hole cantina and often engaged Khedryn Faal, a salvage jockey, in friendly banter.
Borgaz was a Houk who resided in the city of Farpoint on the planet Fhost. He worked as a bouncer in the Black Hole cantina.

Lus-Nati Fellaus was a male Cerean ambassador who was killed in his residence by the assassin Melo Centris. Security recordings showed Fellaus's sister entering and leaving the residence, but she was on the far side of the galaxy when the murder occurred.
Lee-Chee Mukmuk was a yellow Kowakian monkey-lizard who was seen in Slum district G17 alongside two Weequay criminals during the Clone Wars.
Amar Cros was a male Human, who served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Knight during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.

Imar Deez was a Jedi who lived around the time preceding the Great Hyperspace War. While serving in the Jedi Order, Deez taught the Human Relin Druur how to use the Force to shield himself from the effects of the dark side, a technique Druur later passed on to other Force-sens…
The King of the Dragonsnakes was a large dragonsnake living on Dagobah in the Dragonsnake Bog near Yoda's hut during the years of the Galactic Civil War.
D'krn was a commander in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Tria Bartyn, known as Benevolent Tria was the Administrator of Lamaredd, working for the Outer Rim Oreworks as the successor of her parent, Hugo Bartyn. She was well-liked among her subjects.
Traggat was the oldest son to Hugo Bartyn, the Administrator to Lamaredd.

Guther Bartyn was the Administrator of Outer Rim Oreworks' Mining Station LM0228 in Lamaredd, as well as the mayor of the local town known as Bartyn's Landing and the owner of the company Bartyn Gourmet Delicacies, holding all of these ranks because he was the inheritor to the…

Jerrahg was the Human male bartender and owner of Tailfin Cantina, in the Center Sphere district of Bartyn's Landing, in Lamaredd, as of 29 BBY. By that point, Jerrahg was already old and considered to be friendly and gruff at the same time.

affiliation: The Even Cut Sabacc Parlor and Casino
x: Nyubuna Bulul was a female Mon Calamari and the owner of The Even Cut Sabacc Parlor and Casino, in the Center Sphere District of Bartyn's Landing (Lamaredd) as of 29 BBY.
Bamfurd was an Ankura Gungan living in Bartyn's Landing as of 29 BBY. Bamfurd owned and operated the business Bamfurd's Tapcafe and was the personal waiter of any customer, particularly the new ones.
Gillis Hayner was a person living in Bartyn's Landing as of 29 BBY. Hayner owned and operated the business Hayner's Mercantile.

Khreenk was a male Trandoshan living in Bartyn's Landing from at least 130 BBY to 29 BBY. He owned and operated the business Khreenk's Smithy. He had several apprentices that forged the orders, but he supervised personally the work if the order was important enough.

Trusty Trikker was a male Quarren living in Bartyn's Landing as of 29 BBY. Initially an outlaw, he lost one eye in a firefight decades before 29 BBY. He then decided to stop being a criminal and start a safer line of work selling and maintaining weapons.

Olsini Turpo was a middle-aged female Snivvian who lived in Bartyn's Landing during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Around 29 BBY, she owned and operated the business Olsini Turpo, Tailor and Haberdasher.

Mix Liddell was a male Mon Calamari harpooner working for Bartyn Gourmet Delicacies and, later, the Security Chief of the coastal town of Bartyn's Landing in the planet Lamaredd from 69 BBY to 29 BBY.
Kurline was a Quarren shipping manager and the administrator of the Sailor's Union Landing Union chapter circa 29 BBY.
Miss Mylla was a female Falleen of unclear age and undisputed grace living in Bartyn's Landing, a town of Lamaredd, during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.

Eeytch was a Menahuun shaman living in the secret community of Hua'bal near the city of Bartyn's Landing in Lamaredd. During his time, the alien inhabitants of the Landing believed the Menahuun to be extinct, but the Menahuun were preparing their reappearance.

Grubber Vapps was a Human male Sailor who worked at 222 fishing trawler in the town of Bartyn's Landing in Lamaredd, until he was recruited by his friend the recently-appointed Security Chief Mix Liddell as one of his Seconds.
Byrch Dyshkava, known as The Padawan, was a Jedi apprentice learning under a Jedi Master, until his eventual fall to the dark side of the Force during a mission.

Ertine was the Chief of Security of Bartyn's Landing circa 69 BBY, by then an old man. Although technically an employee of Outer Rim Oreworks, Chief Ertine served the citizens of the Landing as their constable, along with the Security Chief's Seconds.
A male Jedi Master served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. During this time, the Jedi Master trained Byrch Dyshkava as his Padawan.
Burloo, known as "Bantha" Burloo, was a burly Chagrian bouncer who worked at Miss Mylla's Saloon in Bartyn's Landing, a town on Lamaredd.
The Red Quarren was the only known name of a sea pirate that attacked sailors on the planet Lamaredd c. 29 BBY. A bounty was offered for the pirate's capture.

The Mighty Musstoro was a hulking Ankura Gungan street wrestler operating in the Center Sphere District of Bartyn's Landing, Lamaredd as of c. 29 BBY. Using a street barker as his representative, the Mighty Musstoro challenged bystanders to a test of strength, with bets.

Boom Boom was a male Gungan constable in Lamaredd. As of 29 BBY, he was a Security Chief's Seconds at Bartyn's Landing, and one of the few Seconds in whom the Security Chief Mix Liddell completely trusted.
Howe Walwahd was a female Mon Calamari who worked as an independent sailor in the seas of Lamaredd.
Nida Korsin was a Human female member of the planet Kesh's Lost Tribe of Sith who eventually became Grand Lord of the dark side order.
Kerra Holt was a female Human Jedi Knight during the New Sith Wars. She was the daughter of Aron and Mercia Holt but she was separated from her parents during the Sith invasion of Aquilaris.
Takara Korsin was the mother of Yaru Korsin, making her the grandmother of Nida. Yaru had the Takara Mountains on the planet Kesh named after her.

Swift was a clone trooper sergeant who fought in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Sometime between 22 BBY and 21 BBY, they participated in a raid on the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Tambor Deep Space Centre.
Gorem was a Keshiri servant of the Lost Tribe of Sith on the remote planet Kesh. Gorem worked as a bearer in the Sith ward-room, where he grew close to a woman named Orlenda.

Tilden Kaah was a Keshiri who lived on the planet Kesh in the years after the Great Hyperspace War. Kaah worked as the personal aide to Seelah Korsin, a member of a group of crash-landed Sith who assumed the position of rulers of the world after their arrival in 5000 BBY.

Orlenda was a Human female member of the Lost Tribe of Sith in the years following the Great Hyperspace War. Orlenda worked as an aide to Seelah Korsin, wife of Lost Tribe Grand Lord Yaru Korsin, in the sick wards that Korsin ran, and the two became good friends.

Ebya T'dell was a Human female born on the planet Kesh around 4992 BBY. She was the daughter of Sith Nafjan and Kanika T'dell, who were crewmembers of the Sith dreadnaught Omen when it crashed on Kesh in 5000 BBY.

Nafjan T'dell was a Human male who in 5000 BBY served as a miner aboard the Sith starship Omen during the Great Hyperspace War. That year, the Omen was bumped off course while jumping to hyperspace after a Jedi attack and crashed on the remote planet Kesh.

Kanika T'dell was a Human who in 5000 BBY served as a bridge cadet aboard the Sith starship Omen during the Great Hyperspace War. That year, the Omen was knocked off course during hyperspace jump after a Jedi attack, and crashed in a mountain range on the remote planet Kesh.
Fezrik Bendledon was a male Zabrak smuggler who lived in Kachirho on the planet Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.

Chrilooc was a Wookiee male who lived in the city Kachirho on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War. He once sent a spacer to steal medical supplies from a group of Gotal Bandits. Chrilooc could sometimes be found with his associate Johnson Smith at an Arcona compound in Etyyy.

Shell was a Human male from Alderaan. When his homeworld was destroyed by the first Death Star, both of Shell's parents were killed and he became an orphan. His grandmother took him in but died shortly due to the shock.

Shell's grandmother was a Human female who resided on the planet Delaya. In 0 BBY, her grandson Shell paid her a visit when Alderaan was destroyed by the Galactic Empire's first Death Star. Due to the shock, she later died, leaving Shell an orphan.
TB-137 was the designation of a stormtrooper that served the Galactic Empire.
TB-278 was the designation of a stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire. In 0 ABY, TB-278 was among those sent to retrieve a captured Princess Leia Organa on the planet Delaya.
TB-2954 was the designation of a stormtrooper that served the Galactic Empire.
TB-31 was the designation of a stormtrooper that served the Galactic Empire.
An Imperial Officer was sent to the planet Delaya in 0 ABY to take Princess Leia Organa from a faction of Alderaanians who captured her.
This male was part of the Mandalorian Death Watch during the Clone Wars.

A Human male Jedi served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, the Jedi Council dispatched the Jedi to track down and apprehend the female Jedi Knight Vydel Dir'Nul. After six months of searching, the Jedi found and confronted Dir'Nul on the planet Perilious.

Elcho Kressh, also known as Kressh the Younger, was the son of the Sith Lord Ludo Kressh. The senior Kressh began to fear for his son's safety as his rival, Naga Sadow, levied for the Sith Empire to wage the Great Hyperspace War against the Galactic Republic.
Cassio Prentiss was the brother of Pol Prentiss. Sometime before the destruction of the planet Alderaan, Cassio and Pol attended a party held in the Grand Ballroom of the Aldera Royal Palace.
Pol Prentiss was the brother of Cassio Prentiss. Sometime before the destruction of the planet Alderaan, Pol and Cassio attended a party held in the Grand Ballroom of the Aldera Royal Palace.
A cyborg was a pilot who perished on Aduba-3 in 0 ABY. He had light skin and black hair, and cybernetics covered the left side of his body. He had a small sack of coins on him when he died.

Lan was a Human male from the planet Alderaan. The day before Alderaan was destroyed by the Galactic Empire's first Death Star, Lan went to Alderaan's sister planet Delaya with his brothers, Mazi and Jez, to watch a smashball tournament.

Jez was a Human male from the planet Alderaan. The day before Alderaan's destruction in 0 BBY by the Galactic Empire's first Death Star, Jez went to Delaya, the sister planet of Alderaan, with his brothers, Mazi and Lan, to watch a smashball tournament.
A male mine operator was in charge of a plasma mining camp affiliated with Borvo the Hutt and the Trade Federation on the planet Naboo around the time of the Federation's invasion of the planet.

When bounty hunter Gunner Groth attempted to capture Mara Jade on the planet Rishi in 9 ABY, he used a decoy to aid in the attempt. Groth coerced the man's involvement through means unknown, implied to be some form of threat.

Driscoll Bruhnej was a Human male from the planet Alderaan and the twin brother of Trey Bruhnej. In 0 BBY, Alderaan was destroyed by the Galactic Empire's first Death Star, sending Driscoll and Trey, as well as thousands of Alderaanian refugees to Alderaan's sister planet Delaya.

Trey Bruhnej was a Human male from the planet Alderaan and the twin brother of Driscoll Bruhnej. In 0 BBY, Alderaan was destroyed by the Galactic Empire's first Death Star, sending Trey and Driscoll, as well as thousands of Alderaanian refugees to Alderaan's sister planet Delaya.

This female Human was the mother of Lan and resided on the planet of Alderaan. The day before Alderaan's destruction by the Galactic Empire's first Death Star, Lan and his friends, Mazi and Jez, went to Delaya to watch a smashball tournament.

This male Human was the father of Lan and resided on the planet Alderaan. The day before Alderaan's destruction by the Galactic Empire's first Death Star, Lan and his friends, Mazi and Jez, went to Delaya to watch a smashball tournament.
Victor Strang was an admiral in the Imperial Navy and a former storm commando. After the Battle of Yavin, he was given command of a superlaser-equipped Star Destroyer named the Conqueror.

This male Pau'an served as an interrogator for the Galactic Empire sometime around 0 ABY. When Princess Leia Organa was captured by the Empire on the planet Delaya, the Pau'an was tasked to interrogate Organa to learn the identity of the Rebel pilot who destroyed the Death Star.

Earsh was a male Human gambler. In 41 ABY, he was present at the Black Hole cantina on Fhost during a sabacc game. He was killed there when a deadly brawl broke loose after Khedryn Faal won the final hand.

Kallin was a male Human Commander of the Coruscant Security Force during the war against Zakuul. Following the death of the Eternal Empire Empress Vaylin and the formation of the Eternal Alliance in 3629 BBY, Kallin, connected to the former Supreme Chancellor Leontyne Saresh, …
Zenn Bien was a Sullustan female smuggler, Rebel Alliance demolitions expert, and later beautician.
Glip Page was a young Jedi Padawan during the Clone Wars.
Pal-Nada was a Force-sensitive Cerean crime lord. He used his abilities to establish a lucrative starship-trafficking business on Jenenma during the years of the New Order.
Pek was a male Sedrian priest who gained powers similar to those of Force users after he was exposed to the Golden Sun. Pek's father was High Priest Cardo.

Mazi was a Human male from the planet Alderaan. The day before Alderaan's destruction in 0 BBY by the Galactic Empire's first Death Star, Mazi traveled to Alderaan's sister planet, Delaya, with his brothers, Lan and Jez, to watch a smashball tournament.
Trayl Caltos was a male who served as a Lieutenant in the Royal Naboo Security Forces on the planet Naboo during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Kal Jorek was a Corellian, who worked as a weapons smuggler for the Hutt Cartel.

An orange-skinned Devaronian was a Jedi who served the New Jedi Order at some point before 130 ABY. The Devaronian was considered a rarity, as there were not many Jedi of their species. The Jedi had orange eyes, wore brown Jedi robes, and carried a lightsaber with a silver hilt.
This ticket vendor, a male Chevin, sold tickets to the Tatooine Boonta Eve Classic during the time of the Invasion of Naboo.

Taria Damsin was a female Human from the colony world of Ghaina, who served as a Jedi Master and Shadow of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. A contemporary of fellow Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, she was dying from a disease known as Borotavi syndrome.
Hira was a Jedi Master during the Second Imperial Civil War who wielded a yellow-bladed lightsaber.
Belai Kaleeg was a male Duros corporate official.
The female Codru-Ji clan leader was present when Rikkar-Du called a meeting of all clan leaders so that they could oppose Darth Krayt's Empire.
Fireball, or "Fib" for short, was a Captain and clone trooper pilot who led Gold Squadron.

Mem was a female Imroosian from the planet Lenahra. By 41 BBY, she was one of a dozen children and teenagers remaining alive on Lenahra who were discovered by Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi when he arrived in search for information about the Jedi Wayseeker Orla Jareni.

Trig was a Human male chief in the Galactic Republic's reconstruction forces on the planet Taris during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire. He reported to Governor Leontyne Saresh on the effect that the Rakghouls were having on his team's efforts.

Sothais Saar was a male Chev serving as a Jedi Knight in the New Jedi Order. He conducted a report on slavery in the galaxy following the Second Galactic Civil War, shortly before falling prey to a psychosis caused by the dark side entity Abeloth.
Haydnat Treen was a female human who served as senator of Kuat in the Galactic Alliance. In the first years of the Galactic Empire, Treen served for one year as a senator in the Imperial Senate.
Tarth Vames was a docking pad chief on the planet Dathomir in 43.5 ABY. He attempted to prevent Luke and Ben Skywalker from landing due to terms of his exile from the Jedi Order.
Dyon Stadd was a Human male and former Jedi Candidate who lacked the strength to become a Jedi Knight. In 43.5 ABY he joined up with Ben and Luke Skywalker on Dathomir.

Tyric was an Imperial Intelligence agent on the planet Garrthinius in 4 ABY. Due to the widespread hostility towards the ruling Imperial government, there was a heavy Intelligence presence on the planet, and he was part of a wider effort to frustrate attempts by the local popu…

Kiro Chen was a Human male from the planet Alderaan. In 0 BBY, the Galactic Empire destroyed his homeworld with the first Death Star, making Chen and thousands of Alderaanians refugees to Delaya, Alderaan's sister planet.
Tofli Argala was a classical composer from the planet Naboo who was alive during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Farious Gletch was a Human male criminal who resided in a humble abode in the capital city of Bestine on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Crix Yarrow was a male clerical worker who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Splice was a clone trooper medic who served in Excelsior Company.
Ace, also identified by the number 18, was a clone trooper lieutenant who served in Excelsior Company, under the command of Clone Commander Vargus during the Clone Wars.
This woman was the wife of New Republic navigator Kane Griggs. The two had a child together.
This child was the offspring of New Republic navigator Kane Griggs and Griggs's wife.

A Force-sensitive Seylott stole the Infant of Shaa from General Ashaar Khorda. In 27 BBY, Jango Fett was hired to recover the artifact. He tracked the Seylott to the planet Seylott, where he confronted the native.

Morla Maalet was a small-time male Sullustan smuggler when he met crime lord Qual'om Soach. As Soach's criminal empire expanded, Morla became Soach's personal pilot, taking command of the Invisible Star.

Oll Maccabe was a male Twi'lek who had been a professor of anthropology at the Alderaan University before the destruction of Alderaan by the first Death Star in 0 BBY. Having been offworld at the time, Maccabe became a supporter of the Rebel Alliance.
Mack was an alias used by a Human member of the Cularin Militia when he decided to speak out against the Expansion Manifesto, along with his comrades Pac and Grunt.

This Muun official was a high-ranking member of the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the time of the Golden Age of the Old Republic. Around 987 BBY, four Meerian brothers, including Salto Zendar, attempted to capture the official.

Sarasu Taalon was a male Keshiri High Lord of the Lost Tribe of Sith around the time following the Second Galactic Civil War. A native of the planet of Kesh, he sat on the Lost Tribe's Circle of Lords by 43.5 ABY.

Bandy Geffer was a male Human Jedi apprentice of the New Jedi Order. He was at the Jedi Temple when Mandalorian warriors hired by the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances Chief of State Natasi Daala raided the temple.
Monarg was a male mechanic living on Dathomir on 43 ABY, operating the mechanic's shop Monarg's Mechanic Works out of the planet's primary spaceport with the assistance of a group of mechanic droids.

Wister Tolann was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire as a Commander under Grand Admiral Thrawn. Thrawn had a low opinion of the man, and composed fitness reports that kept Tolann from rising above the rank of Commander.
Pietrangelo was the captain of the Republic cruiser Unitive during the time of the Clone Wars.
Plort was a Targonnian in the employ of Dictator-Forever Craw. Plort led an attack on Zorneth's Ithorian Herdship.
This female was at the controls of the Wild Karrde in 9 ABY when the ship happened upon the stranded Luke Skywalker and R2-D2 in deep space.

Elyas Caran was a Human male emissary serving the Galactic Alliance. In 43.5 ABY, Caran was sent to the planet Mon Calamari to escort ex-Admiral Cha Niathal to Coruscant to stand trial for dereliction of duty during the Second Galactic Civil War.

Dresdema was a female Nightsister who lived on the planet Dathomir. She was tall and broad-shouldered with gray hair, and her skin was dotted with the blotches characteristic of Dathomiri users of the dark arts.

Alysssa Maggrit was a twelve-year-old Duros girl running numbers for her uncle in the city of Tolea Biqua at the start of the Clone Wars. When the slicer wampa1 revealed her name on the HoloNet, mistakenly believing her to be the slicer alyssaroxu, her cover was blown.
Viun Gaalan was a male Keshiri Lord of the Lost Tribe of Sith who was admired by others for his physical beauty.
Tilas Magore was an Imperial adviser to Emperor Palpatine during the Galactic Civil War. He was responsible for overseeing the subjugation of Brak sector, and Moff Lesan Ramier reported to him.
Mardek Mool was a Bith who represented the former Jedi Tahiri Veila during her trial after her first lawyer, Nawara Ven, was prohibited by the Galactic Alliance courts to represent her.
Hacina was a female Dathomiri witch who lived on the planet Dathomir. She belonged to the Red Mud Potters Clan though she was also secretly a member of the Nightsisters.
Sarita Consta was a Human female holodrama actress and the older sister of Yliri Consta. Yliri used to perform Sarita's stunt work but subsequently stopped when Sarita switched to performing comedy.

Jonoin was an individual who served as an admiral in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. During the latter stages of the conflict, Jonoin lead a Republic attack on a Confederate base that was located on the planet Garia.

Shul Vaal was a middle-aged male Twi'lek Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order. He served as a Jedi healer and aide to Jedi Master Cilghal at the Jedi Temple when Jedi Knight Sothais Saar was brought in after suffering the same illness that a group of Knights had contracted.

Walads was an ambassador on the planet Bresallis. Bresallis was plagued by a criminal underworld ran by the Hutts. Ambassador Walads opposed the Hutts, trying to disrupt their businesses whenever possible.
Tannon Praji's mother was a Human female. She was the mother of Griff Praji, Tannon Praji and his brother.
Tannon Praji's brother was one of the brothers of Tannon Praji alongside Griff Praji.

Sesara Sihn was a Dathomirian female and the only child of Olianne Sihn, war leader of the Raining Leaves Clan on the planet Dathomir. When Sesara was eight years old, she contracted a fever and later died.
Keal Roscon was a Sullustan pilot and was a member of The Shield around 0 BBY. He was also secretly a member of the Rebel Alliance.
Baarak Kalaim was a Klatooinian and the main mechanic for the The Shield's vehicles and starships. He was also secretly a Rebel Alliance operative.

Reginna Bel Typolla or Gina was a Human female from the planet Malthor. After a period off-world in which she became involved in weapons smuggling, she returned to her home planet and became an administrative worker in the spaceport in the city of Fabrillan, where she was recr…

A Hapan male was the father of Tasander Dest, founder of the Broken Columns Clan. Sometime after 8 ABY, when the Dathomiri witch Teneniel Djo married the Hapan Prince Isolder, a Hapan compound was built on the planet Dathomir, where Tasander Dest's father brought his family to…
Merratt Jaxton was a Human male General who served in the Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command and the Chief of Starfighter Command during the time following the Second Galactic Civil War.

Vagan Kolvy was a male who lived on the planet Dathomir. He used to belong to the Scissorfists Clan, a clan that feuded with the Blue Coral Divers Clan, which was another clan that settled near the sea.

Kani Asari was a female Human Padawan of the New Jedi Order. Stationed at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant as of 43 ABY, she was assigned as Interim Grand Master Kenth Hamner's personal assistant as he was dealing with the crisis between the Order and the Galactic Alliance.

Tribeless Sha, born Sha'natrac Tsu, was a Dathomiri female, formerly part of the Blue Coral Divers Clan, a clan that allowed both men and women to rule. The Blue Coral Divers Clan engaged in a feud with the Scissorfists Clan, another clan that was based near the sea.
Elea Poista was a female Human and senior Exex of Bespin Motors' shipping department. Under the alias "Kel," Poista sold weapons on the black market during the Galactic Civil War.
Pok was a male Yuzzem slave to a merchant of Anchorhead on Tatooine. He was a friend of Luke Skywalker while the young moisture farmer lived on Tatooine.
Kthira'shi'ktarloo, better known by his core name, Ashik, was a male Chiss who served as a bodyguard and an aide to Jagged Fel, the Head of State of the Imperial Remnant.

Daiman, along with his older brother and major rival Odion, was a male Human who was one of the most powerful Sith Lords during the Republic Dark Age and ruled an area in the Grumani sector known as the "Daimanate," one of the rump states which emerged from the collapse of the…
Odion, along with his younger brother and major rival Daiman, was a male Human Sith Lord who ruled an area of the Grumani sector which came to be known as the Odionate during the Republic Dark Age.

Vannar Treece was a male Human Jedi Master who fought during the New Sith Wars and the former master of Kerra Holt. During the Republic Dark Age, he led several military missions against Sith forces in the Outer Rim Territories.
This female doctor was based on the Dathomir Spaceport on the planet Dathomir.
Biliril was Force-sensitive, and a Jedi. A senior Padawan in the Jedi Order, the Padawan was at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
Dorf was Force-sensitive, and a Jedi. A senior Padawan in the Jedi Order, the Padawan was at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
Brays was a captain in the Senate Building Security.
A lieutenant served the Galactic Empire in the Imperial Navy, but was court-martialed by Admiral Natasi Daala.
Kaminne Sihn was a female Dathomiri Witch and chief of the Raining Leaves Clan as of 43.5 ABY. Around this time, she led her Clan during its conclave with Tasander Dest's Broken Columns Clan.
The father of Dathomiri Witch Kaminne and Olianne Sihn was a male Dathomirian. They belonged to the Raining Leaves Clan on the planet Dathomir.

This female Dathomirian was the mother of Dathomiri Witch Kaminne and Olianne Sihn of the Raining Leaves Clan on the planet Dathomir. Sihn's mother was the only female in their family line who did not have a problem rearing a child.
A female Dathomirian was the oldest sister of the Dathomiri Witches Kaminne and Olianne Sihn of the Raining Leaves Clan on the planet Dathomir.
A male Dabi bartender worked at Zerria's Bar, located on the planet Drall. He was present in 40 ABY when Mirta Gev destroyed the vocabulator of the serving droid Forre Musa.

At some point, a Hardex ambassador visited Craw, the self-titled Dictator-Forever of the planet Targonn. Craw told the Hardexian ambassador a joke about three Hardex and a bantha, though the latter was not amussed by a protocol droid's translation of the joke.

Halliava Vurse was a Dathomirian female witch from the planet Dathomir. Feigning allegiance with the Raining Leaves and its successor, the Bright Sun Clan, Vurse was actually a spy, working with the Sith apprentice Vestara Khai on behalf of the Nightsisters, to instigate attac…

The father of Tessala Corvae was a male general who had gained notoriety during the Clone Wars. He was a member of a long line of military officers, and his influence led to the admission of his daughter into the Imperial Academy on Carida.

An individual served as a deputy minister of trade for the Imperial Remnant in 43 ABY, and was responsible for perishable goods. That year, she was stationed at the Galactic Empire Embassy on the planet Coruscant.

Tasander Dest was a male Hapan who was raised on the planet of Dathomir by his father. When Dest's father decided to leave, Dest chose to remain on the planet and eventually founded the Broken Columns Clan, a tribe composed of men.
This female Sith Saber served as the personal aide of the Sith Lord Viun Gaalan. She joined her Lord when he went to the surface of the planet Dathomir to rendezvous with the Nightsister witches.

Gull Tuldok was a large booming pirate and gambler who led one of Tuldok clan's three raiding fleets. He had spent most of his life in space, returning to Recopia every five years or so to resupply, take on new crew members, and visit his family.

Arsitta Kushoe was a female X-wing starfighter pilot with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She was the reason the pirate Evram Darkmere reformed himself and began aiding the Alliance. Kushoe later went missing in action.
This pilot was a female Quarren who, at one point in her life, piloted A-wings. She served as a speeder pilot for Moff Drikl Lecersen in 43.5 ABY, during Operation Duusha.

Dayla Kev was a female Human mission commander with the Galactic Scout Corps in c. 40 BBY. She was believed to have been killed by a gasnit on an uncharted jungle planet, when a member of her team, Milac Troper returned with that report.

Milac Troper was a male Human who served the Galactic Scout Corps around 40 BBY before joining the Imperial Diplomatic Corps. During his career as a scout, Troper and his partners, Mission Commander Dayla Kev and Lieutenant Hereven, traveled to an undiscovered jungle world.
Fost Bramsin was a male Human Galactic Alliance Senator who represented Coruscant during the time following the Second Galactic Civil War.
An assistant served as a personal aide to the retired Galactic Alliance Admiral Cha Niathal around 43 ABY.
Olianne Sihn was a female Dathomiri witch and the war-leader of the Raining Leaves Clan, a traditionalist and matriarchal Dathomiri Witch clan led by her sister, Kaminne Sihn.
Aradasa Vurse was a female Dathomiri Witch and daughter of Halliava Vurse, the chief trainer of scouts for the Raining Leaves Clan.
Dasan was a male Dathomirian who was resided on the planet Dathomir. Dasan was a tall warrior and part of the Broken Columns Clan, a tribe composed of men.
Lina Adonais was a female Qonto space urchin.
Loswilla was a female snowy-white fluffy humanoid. She was aboard the Kuari Princess when a group of Alliance to Restore the Republic went undercover.

Trace Polters was the owner and operator of Ma'Haffee Shipyards in the Cularin star system. He allied himself with the Jedi satellite academy on Almas during the Clone Wars. Prior to that, he assisted the Jedi Order by providing them with starships.

Til was a male Kubaz information broker and slicer known as "Crunch." He was a hacker and information gatherer with considerable skill. He had a disturbing appetite for organs from mutated fefze beetles found on Duro.

Terrus was a Koorivar who served as a Confederacy of Independent Systems general during the Clone Wars. He along, with his droids and the 313th Legion were transported from the planet Ando Prime by a hyperspace warping device invented by the Skakoan scientist Vylagos.

"Dr. Gray" was the codename for a Human female scientist working in Grand Admiral Thrawn's of the Galactic Empire lab on a Sith–Jedi hybrid. Dr. Gray made several logs in a computer chip that was found by Jaden Korr.

Dribba Vermilic Scaiti was a Hutt of the Vermilic clan and the author of Huttese Ain't What It Used To Be, an account of how the writing schemes of Galactic Basic Standard had influenced the writing schemes of non-Basic speakers.

A Human male was the father of Seelah Korsin, a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith. As a descendant of the original Tapani refugees that had crash-landed on the planet Rhelg, he and his people excelled at science.
Hal Razor was a criminal who founded and commanded the Razor Runners, a group of bandits who operated on the volcanic planet of Mustafar.
This individual was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
This individual was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
This individual was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Voontara Fa'athra was a powerful Hutt who lived during the Galactic War era between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He was an opponent of Suudaa Nem'ro, a member of the rival Nem'ro clan, seeking to take over Nem'ro's turf.
Kester Tolann was a male Human who served the Imperial Remnant. He was the grandson of Imperial Commander Wister Tolann, who had been held back by Grand Admiral Thrawn during his military career.

Zorbazat Xong was a male Yevetha Minister of Homeworld Security on N'zoth. Xong learned Basic to communicate with outsiders, which he viewed as shameful but necessary. Although he despised all non-Yevetha, Xong tolerated outsiders' business for the economic benefits.

Topuc Ti was a male Kaminoan who worked at the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center as an assistant to Nala Se during the Clone Wars. After Padawan Ahsoka Tano was treated in the hospital ward, she asked Ti for permission to contact the Jedi Temple.

Hylo Visz's father was a male Mirialan droid designer living on Balmorra with his wife and daughter during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire. The Mirialan was killed during the Empire's initial raid on the planet during the Battle of Balmorra.
Hylo Visz's mother was a female Mirialan who lived on Balmorra with her husband and daughter during the Great Galactic War.
Barrga was a male Hutt alive during the Great Galactic War. Based out of Nar Shaddaa, Barrga was a moderately powerful crime lord and a member of the Hutt Cartel.
Jannpyr was a Jiivahar tour guide working on Carest 1. He was the best known in his industry.
Klevb was a Jiivahar from Carest 1. He was made an outcast from his talin and subsequently left his homeworld. He became a gun-for-hire.

An Imperial captain commanded a scout vessel during the Galactic Civil War. The captain's vessel ambushed a lone T-65 X-wing starfighter piloted by Rebel General Lens Reekeene, eventually defeating and capturing her.

Leona Makk was a female pilot who captained the bulk hauler Voxen Tass for Shang Lines during the Galactic Civil War. She was a supporter of the Rebel Alliance and used her position at Shang Lines to supply the Rebels with information on local shipping.
Moor Malas was a New Republic general who commanded the ground forces during the siege of Coruscant.
Habbala Brupt was a male Sullustan and a spy for the Galactic Empire.
Metron Besk was the founder of Dynamic Automata, a droid-manufacturing company. Besk built the company from a single firm that supplied logic-enhancement circuits to third-degree droids.
Dom, also known as Bruiser, was a clone trooper during the Clone Wars. A member of Excelsior Company, the clone served as the company's demolitions expert.
Stubble Trel was a male Human marble miner on the planet Ralltiir.

Tama Burr was a Human woman who dealt in bird commerce on Recopia. Her manor was equipped to meet the needs of a variety of exotic species. She had provided numerous rare animals for the Abersaith Aviary on Corulag.
Izzat was a male Twi'lek involved in the murder of Kaine Paulsen. Izzat was later killed in reprisal by Paulsen's son Drake Paulsen and his associates, Nikaede Celso, Thaddeus Ross and Tait Ransom.
A stealth pilot was assigned to Jedi General Anakin Skywalker as the co-pilot of the prototype stealth ship used during the Clone Wars at the Battle of Christophsis.

Crik was a male Imperial general during the early years of the New Order. Stationed at Tremor Base on the forested planet Otavon XII, Crik oversaw the construction of All Terrain Armored Transports in 19 BBY.

Musk was a male Nikto who lived during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Musk was employed as an enforcer for the Hutt Cartel based out of Nar Shaddaa and Nal Hutta.
Marsen was a male lieutenant in service to the Galactic Empire in 3 ABY. He was present during the Battle of Hoth in which he was acting as a lieutenant with the Imperial ground battle group.
A constabulary officer was a political prisoner at Stars' End in 2 BBY.
This portmaster's deputy was employed by the Corporate Sector Authority on Etti IV, in 2 BBY.
Zan Porpu was a pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He went missing during the Galactic Civil War when his BTL Y-wing starfighter disappeared in the Esstran Cordon.
Oln Pressig was a male who served the Imperial Remnant around 43 ABY. Achieving the rank of Lieutenant, Pressig became Imperial Head of State Jagged Fel's day-shift Security Chief.

A male Bothan communications officer worked for Galactic Alliance Chief of State Natasi Daala. In 43.5 ABY, at the request of Daala, he contacted former Admiral Cha Niathal's assistant, who patched him through to Niathal.

A black-haired Human male was a member of the Imperial Knights in 137 ABY. In that year, he and many other members of his order accompanied Roan Fel, Emperor of the Empire-in-exile, to Agamar in order to conduct peace talks with representatives of the Jedi Order.

A Human male with a mustache and goatee was an Imperial Knight in 137 ABY. He was part of a large group of Knights that accompanied Emperor Roan Fel of the Empire-in-exile to the planet Agamar in that year, serving as a bodyguard while Fel conducted peace talks with members of…

A black-haired Human male was an Imperial Knight in 137 ABY. In that year, he was among a group of Knights who acted as bodyguards for Emperor Roan Fel of the Empire-in-exile as Fel met with several Jedi on the planet Agamar to negotiate an alliance against Darth Krayt's Galac…

A Human female with brown hair was a member of the Imperial Knights in 137 ABY. She was one of many Knights who served as a bodyguard to Roan Fel, Emperor of the Empire-in-exile, as he traveled to the planet Agamar to conduct peace talks with members of the Jedi Order.

A light-haired Human was an Imperial Knight in 137 ABY, and was one of many Knights who accompanied Emperor Roan Fel of the Empire-in-exile to the planet Agamar in that year as he conducted peace talks with representatives of the Jedi Order.
Rodius Tharn was a Rodian male and Rebel soldier during the Galactic Civil War.
Reen Loruk was a male Twi'lek spy of the Rebel Alliance who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Joi was a Human female smuggler who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Gil Burtin was a male Mon Calamari privateer.

This Security Police major was a battalion commander stationed at the Corporate Sector Authority's detention facility at Stars' End, on Mytus VII. The major had an officious, almost gruff appearance harboring a quick temper. He also carried a black swagger stick.

Hirken was a Human male Admiral and a member of the Hirken family who fought for the side of Alsakan in the Fifth Alsakan Conflict. He was remembered for his tenacious defense of Alsakani colonies in the Northern Dependencies in 12,980 BBY, which ultimately decided the war.
Gor'telp was a male Kler'terrian. He worked as a bartender for Tan Shilley at her establishment Shilley's.

Basile was a Human Imperial Navy Captain loyal to Emperor Roan Fel. During Operation: Thunderstroke, Basile served aboard the Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer Dauntless as second in command to Admiral Tohri Challon.

Kedar Blackgate was a male Human who served as the warden of Dorthus Tal Prison. He was a fierce upholder of Sacorrian law. He had short black hair, a trimmed beard and goatee. Blackgate had a pair of loyal massiff pets that he named Emperor and Merciless.
Nia Adea was a Human female who worked in the Thirsty Bantha, a cantina located on the planet Tatooine. She was a traveler and an adventurer who rarely stayed on a planet for more than a few days.

Griff was a Human male who served as a member of the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He participated in the Battle of the Emperor's Citadel where he operated the weapons aboard an X-1 Viper commanded by Generals Lando Calrissian and Wedge Antilles.

A member of Darth Krayt's New Sith Order, this Dashade Sith was part of a strikeforce sent by Regent Morlish Veed to capture Emperor Roan Fel during the execution of Operation: Thunderstroke on the planet Agamar.

A member of Darth Krayt's One Sith, this Nautolan Sith was part of a strikeforce that attacked Emperor Roan Fel during the execution of Operation: Thunderstroke on the planet Agamar. This Sith fought against Jedi Master Hira, killing her with Force lightning.
Tassaa Bareesh was a Hutt crime lord and a matriarch of Bareesh Cartel operating off of Nal Hutta.
Headhunter Leader was the callsign used by Han Solo when flying with Headhunter Flight during the Battle of the Outlaw Tech Base, in 2 BBY.

Headhunter Two was the callsign used by Han Solo's wingman when flying with Headhunter Flight during the Battle of the Outlaw Tech Base, in 2 BBY. He was a member of the Vandangante outlaw techs and was a lanky, soft-spoken young man.
Headhunter Three was the callsign used by Jessa Vandangante when flying with Headhunter Flight during the Battle of the Outlaw Tech Base, in 2 BBY.

Headhunter Four was the callsign used by Jessa Vandangante's wingman when flying with Headhunter Flight during the Battle of the Outlaw Tech Base, in 2 BBY. He was a member of the Vandangante outlaw techs and was a gray-skinned humanoid from the planet Lafra.
Headhunter Five was the callsign used by one of Jessa Vandangante's mechanics when flying with Headhunter Flight during the Battle of the Outlaw Tech Base, in 2 BBY.
Headhunter Six was the callsign used by one of Jessa Vandangante's mechanics when flying with Headhunter Flight during the Battle of the Outlaw Tech Base, in 2 BBY.

Drola Kinn was a Dathomirian male member of the Broken Columns Clan, a group of male Witches of Dathomir. He was young and single at the time of the Conclave between Broken Columns and the Raining Leaves Clans. He had one many of the games held during the conclave.

Dendro was a Human male Jedi Padawan apprenticed to Jedi Master Hylon during the final years of the Galactic Republic. In 19 BBY, Dendro and his Master survived the initial stages of the Great Jedi Purge, which was ordered by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.
Ruchikila was a Jedi Initiate training in the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.
Ban-yaro was a male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars as the communications chief at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

Hylon was an Ovoni male Jedi Master who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic. In 19 BBY, Hylon and his Jedi Padawan, Dendro, survived the initial stages of the Great Jedi Purge, which was ordered by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.
Minala Lodilyn was the female Human who served as an assistant to Senator Bail Organa of Alderaan during the Clone Wars.
Yliri Consta was a Hapan female who lived on the planet Dathomir in the aftermath of the Second Galactic Civil War, and was the sister of holodrama actress Sarita Consta.

Gayle Sertim was a Human female mercenary who led the civilian security force at a hyperbaride synthesis plant on the planet Marca. After the death of the plant's original Managing Director, Arviz Linden, Sertim suspected the involvement of the Empire.
"Huttsbane" was a male Evocii and an enemy of the Hutt Cartel during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he resided in a village near Jiguuna on Nal Hutta.
Alcra was a middle-aged Human mercenary who worked with a civilian security force at a hyperbaride synthesis plant on the planet Marca.
Darci Sertim was a Human female mercenary attached to a civilian security force guarding a hyperbaride synthesis plant on the planet Marca, along with her twin sister Marci and older sister Gayle.
Marci Sertim was a Human female mercenary attached to a civilian security force guarding a hyperbaride synthesis plant on the planet Marca, along with her twin sister Darci and older sister Gayle.
Chilla was a female undercover agent of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

In 3956 BBY, a male Aqualish resided in the North Apartments in the Upper City of the planet Taris. He hated Darth Malak's Sith Empire, and stole their uniforms for the Hidden Beks swoop gang in order to undermine the Sith rule of Taris.

A member of Darth Krayt's New Sith Order, this Zabrak Sith was part of the strikeforce sent by Regent Morlish Veed to capture Emperor Roan Fel on the planet Agamar. The Zabrak fought against Jedi Knight Shado Vao but was killed in the process.
TBR-312 was the designation of a human male stormtrooper who serve the Galactic Empire. During the First Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, he was stationed on Belazura.

Reegas Vance was a male Human gambler who lived around the time of the Second Galactic Civil War. In 41.5 ABY, at the Black Hole cantina in Farpoint, on the planet Fhost, Vance played a game of sabacc against Earsh, Khedryn Faal, and Flaygin, using Corellian Gambit rules.
Quillin Arkell was a male Velabri and a member of the elite Velabri Lancers. He worked alongside Cryle Cavv and Finn Varatha in the extraction of deep-cover agent Rivoche Tarkin.
Finn Varatha was a female Human bounty hunter who renowned for her expertise at disguise, able to appear as friends and loved ones of her targets.

The father of Roly Melusar, head of the Imperial Commando Special Unit, was a male Human. Melusar's father was a native of the planet Dromund Kaas, where he tried to encourage the natives to change the world themselves.

Llerd was a Human male serving the Dark Lord Naga Sadow's Sith invasion fleet in 5000 BBY as a lieutenant aboard the Sith dreadnaught Harbinger. He unhesitatingly accepted orders from his superiors and enjoyed watching his enemies die.
Robb was the Besalisk owner of the cantina Thirsty Bantha in Mos Entha on Tatooine. Before settling down, he made a living as a bounty hunter.

This operator worked for Bakura Orbital Control in 28 ABY. His shifts coordinated with Jagged Fel, commander of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances starfighter unit Twin Suns Squadron, when an out of control YT-series freighter, the Jaunty Cavalier threatened to impact t…

Wunda was a Hutt who resided and owned several businesses in Mos Entha on Tatooine around the time of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, Wunda visited the Thirsty Bantha, a cantina owned by the Besalisk Robb.
Varak'Cha was a Devaronian loan shark who resided in Mos Entha on Tatooine around the time of the Galactic Empire. The Besalisk bartender Robb owed him a large amount of credits.
Olaf was a Human moisture farmer who resided in Mos Entha on Tatooine, around the time of the Galactic Empire. He was a patron of the Thirsty Bantha cantina.
Tikkit was a male Jawa who resided in Mos Entha on Tatooine around the time of the Galactic Empire. He was a patron of the Thirsty Bantha cantina, and dreamed of one day becoming a starship captain.

Mogrugg was a male Gamorrean who resided in Mos Entha on Tatooine around the time of the Galactic Empire. He worked as a bodyguard for Wunda the Hutt, and was a patron of the Thirsty Bantha cantina. He planned to one day pursue his true passion: flower arranging.
Jac'Ril was a male Twi'lek smuggler and patron of the Thirsty Bantha cantina in Mos Entha on Tatooine around the time of the Galactic Empire.
Neelir was a Rodian bounty hunter who was a patron of the Thirsty Bantha cantina in Mos Entha on Tatooine around the time of the Galactic Empire.
Dave was a stormtrooper and a patron of the Thirsty Bantha cantina in Mos Entha on Tatooine around the time of the Galactic Empire.

Eison Gynt was a Nautolan male Jedi Padawan of the Old Republic, born to a family line of Jedi. In his youth, he was considered the most talented Padawan in the Jedi Order, and was taken as an apprentice by Master Barel Ovair, a spy for the Sith Empire.

Barel Ovair was a prestigious Human male Jedi Master and scholar of the Old Republic. He was the scion of a respected line of Jedi Knights who were all secretly spies working for the Emperor of the reconstituted Sith Empire.

A female individual married the Human male Maximilian Veers, and the two had a son named Zevulon Veers. The family embodied the Galactic Empire's propaganda ideals given Maximilian's service in the Imperial Army. The woman died on a holiday prior to the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY.
Dursa Conegan was a colonel in the Alliance Special Operations during the height of the Galactic Empire. Conegan operated in a mission group that was based in the Jaemus system.
