x: Dremullar Obohn di Garthos was a curator of the Obohn Gallery of the Industrial Aesthetic. Alongside him was his co-curator, a Rodian named "Father."

Ordomire, nicknamed "Lucky" Ordomire for his uncanny ability to avoid the consequences of running a criminal business, was a talented counterfeiter that operated on the outskirts of Lumchugger's Hub on the planet Bescane.

"Tigress" was the codename of a Rebel spy that operated in The Core, working as a librarian in the Imperial Archives. She was an invaluable source of information to Alliance Intelligence and her information had a high percentage of accuracy, over 80%.
Cooper Dray was a washed-up swoop racer that ran a swoop gang known as Cooper's Swoopers on the planet Bescane.
Farn Klin was a Jedi Initiate in the Jedi Order who studied the ways of the Force at the Coruscant Jedi Temple during the Clone Wars.
This Sekct was the She-Who-Speaks of Hissest's tribe. Her skin was so light that it was almost white and she wore a necklace made of bones.
Tra-Skan-Lor was a male Tiss'shar, who served as the Director of the Special Acquisitions Branch of the Library of the Republic some centuries before the Imperial era.

A captain was the commander of an Acclamator-class assault ship. He was among the few survivors of the Death Star's destruction. He reminded the few forces that remained under his command that his ship was still in need of repairs, much to the amusement of Tyber Zann.
Danar Len was a male who worked for Mandal Hypernautics during the years following the Clone Wars.

A Human male was a member of the Rebel Alliance strike force sent to recover an Imperial weapon. During the mission, he was attacked by a rakghoul and later transformed into one. Princess Leia Organa witnessed firsthand how he changed into a rakghoul.
The New Republic included a diplomat of a reptilian species that had large frills on their necks and a broad tail. This diplomat wore a pale blue, loose-fitting garment owned a pet rugger.
A Twi'lek was a diplomat in the New Republic. The Twi'lek had a pet saw-toothed grank.

Teebo's lucksprite was a lucksprite whose services were requested by the Ewok Teebo to help Wicket Wystri Warrick pass his skills test to be a warrior. The lucksprite never mentioned that it was actually a bad lucksprite, and it thwarted Warrick's performance.
Larin was a individual who, when they were between the ages of fifteen and twenty-five, lived on the planet Siline and, in 134 BBY, participated in that year's Crowning Convocation.
Tugnut was a Dug prisoner onboard the Imperial prison barge Purge. After the Purge broke down, it came across an abandoned Star Destroyer.

Falovan was a professional expeditor working on Revkinn V during the Galactic Civil War. He could be hired for a 300-credit fee and, in a few hours, Falovan discovered public information on the individual he had been asked to research.
Zerik was a male Bothan who worked as an agent for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Bethanie Melan was a woman who lived during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Darth Thanaton was a Human male Inquisitor and Dark Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War.

Qawohl, also known as Maggot, was a male Abyssin slave who accompanied Teneb Kel around 3678 BBY during the Great Galactic War. Maggot was present during the Invasion of Begeren, where he killed a large number of Republic soldiers, but was wounded in the fight.

A male Quarren officer served with Galactic Alliance Security in 43 ABY. When Jedi Knight Jysella Horn developed a psychosis that caused her to believe that everyone had been replaced by impostors, a team of Galactic Alliance Security troopers, including the Quarren, captured …

Lord Calypho was a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire and the Sith Master of Darth Thanaton. According to the Dark Council, Calypho overstepped his bounds and sought power he had not earned, causing him to be arrested.

Tulu Kinn was a male Dathomirian member of the Broken Columns Clan on the planet Dathomir, and the brother of Drola Kinn. Tulu was present during the conclave between his clan and the Raining Leaves Clan in 43.5 ABY, when the two clans joined to form the Bright Sun Clan.

Morningfire was a Jedi General of the Jedi Order who led Vornskr Company, a clone trooper company within the Grand Army of the Republic, during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Firen Nuln was a female Dathomiri Witch who lived around the time of the Second Galactic Civil War. She was the rancor trainer for the Raining Leaves Clan.

A male individual served Prince-Admiral Delak Krennel in the naval forces of the Ciutric Hegemony as a captain of the Victory-class Star Destroyer Aspiration. After the Battle of Distna, his ship was sent to check the site of the battle for any survivors.

This male Sith Saber was a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith from Kesh who lived around 43 ABY. In that year, the Sith Saber served under Sith Lord Viun Gaalan when Gaalan traveled to Dathomir to retrieve Sith apprentice Vestara Khai, the sole survivor of a strike team that had…

This female Sith Saber was a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith who lived around the time following the Second Galactic Civil War. In 43.5 ABY, she served as a member of Sith Lord Viun Gaalan's strike team sent to retrieve the Sith apprentice Vestara Khai from Dathomir.
Lorgrombo was a Lugubraa elder, renting out the services of his horde as mercenary forces for those in the Unknown Regions.
Mnggal-Mnggal was a sentient entity known throughout the Unknown Regions.
The Steward was the overseer of the treasure vaults of Xim the Despot, located on the planet of Dellalt, in 1 BBY.
The Mission Commander was one of the elite Survivors entrusted with the guardianship of Xim the Despot's treasure vaults on the planet of Dellalt, in 1 BBY.
Carson Vance was a male Bith and pet lover who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Peaches was a male Durni that lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War and was the pet of the Bith Carson Vance.
Jonathan Squire was a male Human, who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

This first officer was a naval commander in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. He was the second in command to Grand Admiral Miltin Takel in the Mandalore sector, helping to patrol the Grand Admiral's homeworld of Gargon.

Phadreas Kole was the Imperial governor of Rhinnal in 0 ABY. He had little involvement in politics, focusing instead on his landspeeder collection rather than the conversion of Rhinnal to Imperial standards.

Kosta was a female X'Ting, and the eldest member of the Hive Council on Ord Cestus by the time of the Clone Wars. Loyal to the hive, Kosta held contempt for Cestus Cybernetics and its puppet member of the Council, Caiza Quill.

Sibyl was the Zeltron wife of Demagol. She lived at some point between the Great Sith War and the Mandalorian Wars. She became involved in Demagol's research, the goal of which was to create Force-sensitive children at his school on Osadia.

Checkers was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He initially served under Jedi General Kit Fisto in Laser Company before the unit was depleted all except for him at Kessel.
Elin Garza was a Human female who served the Galactic Republic as a General in the Republic Army during the Great Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Jicoln Cadera was a Human male Mandalorian who lived during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He was an opponent of Mandalore the Vindicated.

Comran was a crewman aboard the Haj Shipping Lines luxury liner Star of Empire who was killed when the Imperial artificial intelligence known as Systems Infiltration Manager took control of the ship eleven months after the Battle of Yavin.
Quingarus was a Toong droid factory owner.
A Banking Clan representative accompanied Chairman San Hill to visit the Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory.

Nastuonodon was an ancient (c. 20,000 BBY) sultan on the planet Mourn who was responsible for commissioning the construction of "Electric Caliphs". Thousands of years after Nastuonodon died, the Electric Caliphs lay in wait, unused for millennia.

The grandfather of Barel Ovair was said to be a Sith spy of the Sith Empire ostensibly operating as a Jedi historian of the Jedi Order. He visited the tomb of a deceased Sith Lord in order to eliminate it as a threat prior to the invasion of the Galactic Republic.
Tolkar was a male Barabel, who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Merillion Tarko was a Human male baron hailing from the Core World of Anaxes. Coming from a family that possessed ties to the Galactic Republic's government and military, he attended the Anaxes Citadel, from which he graduated with the highest honors.
Luthos Garral was a Human male who worked as a scientist and a garrison commander for the Galactic Empire.

Goorth was a Neo-Bespinian, a member of an ancient species native to Bespin. They were a long-lived species characterized by their gaseous appearance and ability to hide within the clouds of the planet's atmosphere.
Dotyk was a Human female from Corellia. She was born a mutant and somehow acquired the ability to paralyze and strike fear in those at whom she looked.

A bodyguard worked for the Black Sun Vigo Nep Chung. Like this employer, the bodyguard was a Phuii. The bodyguard was killed by the Sith Lord Darth Maul during his attack on the Black Sun leadership on Ralltiir.
A Phuii Podracer pilot participated in the Ungasan Cross Country on Ando Prime sometime before 27 BBY. The Phuii fatally crashed in the Juaka Canyon.

The father of Barel Ovair was said to be a Sith spy of the Sith Empire ostensibly operating as a Jedi historian of the Jedi Order. He visited the tomb of a deceased Sith Lord in order to eliminate it as a threat prior to the invasion of the Galactic Republic.
Zerex was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire as a governor, and later as a moff.
Brult Kiais was a Muun who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Greddin Zel was a Human who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
An Advozse served as the Republic governor of the planet Begeren during the Great Galactic War. He was slain by Teneb Kel, a Sith apprentice, during the Imperial Invasion of Begeren.
Klorma Draill was a female Human, who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

The "Nightsister Matriarch" was a Human female Nightsister native to the planet Dathomir and active during the administration of the New Republic. In that time, the Matriarch led a group of Nightsisters in an attack on the planetary base that belonged to the Imperial warlord X1.
Meren Siefel was a female assassin who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Siefel carried out a number of killings for Zerex, the governor of the planet Ord Adinorr.
Blessed Toxmalb was one of the oldest members of the entropy worshiping organization known as the Sorcerers of Rhand.
Raspir was a pure-blooded Sith released from a Rakatan mind trap when Elder Ruthic used the same device to banish her opponents. Raspir once served Sith King Adas as court magician.

Grish B'reen was a male Chistori pilot and mercenary during the Galactic Civil War. Soon after the Battle of Yavin, Grish was hired by the assassin X-7 to hunt down and kill Luke Skywalker as part of a mercenary group led by Lune Oddo Divinian.
Elo Panil was a male Kaminoan scientist that headed a project funded by the Galactic Empire to create an amphibious super-weapon.

Fallon Pollo was a mercenary humanoid pilot active for 10 years, 2 months. Just after retiring in style, Pollo began working for the highest bidder again, unable to stop working because of the action.

Slis Tieeer Dualli was a male Kobok pilot and mercenary during the Galactic Civil War. He was invited to be a part of a mercenary team, put together by the assassin X-7, to hunt down and kill Rebel pilot Luke Skywalker.
Lerred was a Cerean Dark Jedi, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Lyrrad was a Cerean Dark Jedi, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Yrral was a Cerean Dark Jedi, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Rilly Raadun was a female Force Adept, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Dole Happ was a Twi'lek Force Adept, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Taleah Novran was a female Tarasin Force Adept, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Clarin Karagan was a male Human Jedi Knight who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Serving the Jedi Order as a Consular, Karagan was active in the galaxy during the years of the Sith resurgence in the prelude to the Clone Wars.
Gila Yarg was a male Tarasin Jedi who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Anoush Rahn was a female Cerean Jedi who served the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
D'Nica Jongales was a female Human, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Garwooken was a male Wookiee, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. During the the SoroSuub Anniversary celebration in 31 BBY in the city Tolea Biqua on the planet Genarius, Garwooken was present in Vanster Enan's Cantina.
Barsus was a diminutive male Near-Human who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Civil War.
Farh j'Hien was a Sith battlelord, who lived during the time of the Old Republic.

Darth Ekkage was a female human Dark Lord of the Sith and Dark Councilor in the times of the Great Galactic War. She was the sister of Darth Baras and one of the greatest Sith assassins to have ever lived.
Lord Malichose was a Human male Sith Lord who lived during the time of the Great Galactic War. A fluent speaker of the old Sith tongue, Malichose had achieved the rank of Sith Lord by 3678 BBY.

Jayn was a male Phindian mercenary pilot during the Galactic Civil War. He had a ship called Leilana's Dagger, named after his long-lost love Leilana. Jayne ultimately met his fate on the moon of Iope, in the Rinn system, while his skills were tested by the Imperial assassin X-7.

Garazeb Orrelios, commonly known as Zeb, was a male Lasat rebel who helped man the starship the Ghost. Prior to joining the Spectres rebel cell, Orrelios was a Captain of the Lasan Honor Guard and was trained to fight with a bo-rifle.

Taunt was a female Lethan Twi'lek treasure hunter during the pan-galactic Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She was a known associate of the Twi'lek slave-turned-criminal Vette, Plasmajack, and Flash.

t: Unidentified Twi'lek female (Kardem's first Twi'lek victim)
x: This Twi'lek female made a living as a dancer during the final years of the Galactic Republic. She became romantically involved with a freighter pilot named Ash B'risko, who was in turn involved with the Jedi Knight Vydel Dir'Nul.

This male Human was a soldier in the Galactic Republic and fought in the Foundry Uprising during the Great Galactic War. He was killed on the planet Begeren in 3678 BBY by Sith apprentice Teneb Kel during the Invasion of Begeren.
A man served as a crew member aboard the Super Star Destroyer Allegiance during the Battle of Calamari.

This Lamproid was present on the planet Kabal in 0 ABY. He had grey-green skin and white fangs. He was hunted down and killed by the Krish big-game hunter Tyro Viveca, who then had the body taxidermied. Viveca displayed the Lamproid as a trophy in his estate on that world.

A Lamproid was present on the planet Kabal in 0 ABY. In a run-in with the Krish big-game hunter Tyro Viveca, her mate was killed and she was captured, placed in a force cage, and sedated so that Viveca could hunt her down on a later date.
This female Human Thyferran was the secretary of former Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard during her tenure as Chief Operating Officer on the planet Thyferra.
D. L. Travos was an Imperial soldier who served on board the first Death Star. Travos was very proud to have been assigned to the Death Star and was impressed by the power of the battle station.

Phyll was an individual of a plant-like alien species. Phyll played sabacc with Lando Calrissian during his visit on Rafa IV, in 4 BBY. In order to be understood in Galactic Basic Standard, they employed an electronic synthesiser that poorly translated their speech in real-time.
Arran Flekk was a Human who served as an Imperial scout during the Galactic Civil War.
Zonsoe was a member of the Blazing Chain Force-using organization. Zonsoe was the Adacap, or leader, of the Blazing Chain Blackshackle fleet.
Grazdoc was a Nebalite trader in the Unknown Regions. Whenever he needed a face-to-face agent, he sent his protocol droid X-17-D. At some point, he was kidnapped by raiders.

Subo was a Hutt crime lord who reigned over a sector of the Unknown Regions. Subo had an interest in the lost planet Endelaan, believing the planet had a means with which he could extend his life indefinitely.
Renarra was a female Wookiee enforcer of Subo the Hutt, a crime lord. Renarra was considered ruthless, and while she was known for her legendary temper, she often maintained self-control.

Vipsanis was the leader of a group of Mandalorians. He believed that he was destined to become the next Mandalore, and at one point led a fleet headed by the battlecruiser Victus to invade the lost planet Endelaan in order to prove to his followers that he was worthy of the ti…

Akero was a Mandalorian, and the second-in-command of Mandalorian leader Vipsanis. He was a young, capable fighter who was in search of fame. As the planet Endelaan was attacked, Akero got his commander in charge of the troops ordered to occupy the planet.
This Omwati male was a shaman and the leader of a gang of smugglers and other criminals operating in Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
Bounty hunters hired personally by Lady Marina for the Syndicate were exempt from the usual selection process and from paying an annual fee to the Syndicate.
Gode Takrab was a male Neimoidian trade officer and holo faker working for the Trade Federation during the Naboo crisis of 32 BBY.

Grabathar was a famed Wookiee war hero who fought in the Battle of Kashyyyk in the Clone Wars. Playing off his status as a war hero, Grabathar started ThrillSpace Travel, a travel company that offered tours of exotic locations across the galaxy.

Amada Lakhasa was a Twi'lek scout. Although he left Ryloth with little more than than a beat-up freighter and a few credits, he became the head of one of the most long-running scout organizations in the galaxy, the Lakhasa Caravan.
Ruthic was a Rakata elder who was the head of the Tulpaa tribe. At some point, Ruthic released the former Sith court magician Raspir from a Rakatan mind trap.
Succate was a chronicler from Carrivar who, around 80 BBY, assembled a large collection of information about the Sorcerers of Rhand.
A Force-sensitive Selkath Jedi served in the Clone Wars, a galaxy-wide conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A Bith Jedi Scholar served the Jedi Order as a Lore Keeper. At some point during the Jedi's life, the Bith fought a droid commando in a jungle-like environment, and used the Force to cause the vines to ensnare and trap the droid.

An Imperial scientist on the Star Destroyer Vector, this Human male became infected with the Blackwing virus when crates containing the contagion were breached in the vessel, and proceeded to decimate the entire crew.

This driver, a young Myneyrsh male, piloted a landspeeder on the planet Drongar in 20 BBY. He was hired by Admiral Tarnese Bleyd to ferry him to Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7, a mobile temporay hospital for clone troopers injured while combating the Confederacy of Independen…
Kozzel Qwok was a male Pacithhip, who worked as a smuggler during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Bortis was a Taurill. In 22 BBY, Bortis showed the ability to play the sport of Greenputt with some degree of skill.
Koro Ferbin was a male alien, who worked as an information broker during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Quenelle was a Human female who, in 23 BBY, was both the Margravine and secretly the Skull Queen of Nallastia, a direct descendant of the Margrave Octan.
Klay Firewell was a Human boy who was a native of Corulag.

Calvaria was a Human female who, in 23 BBY, was the 18-year-old princess of Nallastia. Her mother was the Margravine Quenelle, the Skull Queen of Nallastia, and she was raised in the Skull Queen's fortress on Mount Octan.
Satrank was a male member of the Anointed People from the planet Masterhome who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was a Godling, a member of the species's nobility.
Grissom was a male Godling, a member of the ruling class of the Anointed People from the planet Abonshee.
Trisstan was the Godking of Masterhome, supreme monarch of the Anointed People, from c. 39 BBY to at least 0 ABY.
Collan Eislo was a male Human, who desired to become a Sith apprentice, and led a Sith cult called the Apex Society.
Dorin Se'ol was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Mol Beldun was a male Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Halle Dray, a Human female and a native of the planet Alderaan, was one of the thousands of Alderaanian refugees who fled to the planet Delaya following the Destruction of Alderaan by the Imperial Death Star battle station.
Exal Kressh was a Sith female who was apprenticed to the Sith Emperor of the resurgent Sith Empire during the early years of the Great Galactic War.

Ringoot was a male individual who served the Jedi Order as a Padawan during the time of the Clone Wars. Circa 21 BBY, a friend of Ringoot was assigned to travel to the planet Dorin and become the apprentice of Jedi Master Plo Koon.
This individual served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi Knight.
This individual served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Knight during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Vorena was a woman, who lived during the early years of the Galactic Empire.

Mickey Mouse, also known as Jedi Mickey, was a pint-sized Jedi Master who belonged to a species of sapient mice. On occasion, he fought alongside the equally diminutive Yoda, the Grand Master of the Order.
Draba was a Hutt crime lord who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Solvek was a male Ubese, who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Narp Pilyev was a man who worked as a bureaucrat for the Galactic Empire during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Gamma Three was a clone commando, who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Gamma One was a clone commando who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Gamma Two was a clone commando, who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Wenny Boggs was one of the planet Tatooine's moisture farmers. While hunting a herd of womp rats one day, Boggs discovered that he had traveled too far into the desert to return home under the safety of daylight.
Pippa Rosheed was a Human female who worked as a doctor and a xenobiologist. She was a member of Lexi Fernandin's scouting expedition to Yavin 4 a couple of years after the Battle of Yavin.
Yuln was a humanoid Sith who served Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War.
Bokar was a humanoid Sith who served Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Madhi Vaandt was a female Devaronian freelance news reporter active after the Second Galactic Civil War. Vaandt honed her craft under the guidance of Tyl Krain, a man with whom she worked her entire career.
Eshkar Niin was an Iktotchi member of the Imperial Knights, a Force-using Order loyal to Emperor Roan Fel of the Galactic Empire.

Jorm Alvic was a male Human and a long-time friend of Chevin reporter Perre Needmo. He was middle-aged following the Second Galactic Civil War, and by 44 ABY he had become the director of Needmo's show, The Perre Needmo Newshour.
Barada was a male Klatooinian who lived on Klatooine around 44 ABY. He had a son named Kelkad, and worked as a fruit vendor in the capital city of Treema.

Darima Kedari was a male Klatooinian who served as the Chancellor of the Klatooinian Council of Elders. During his early life, he was a gambler, and he came into contact with Lando Calrissian, although he eventually turned away from his gambling ways.

Kunor Bann was a male Human Jedi Knight who lived around the time following the Second Galactic Civil War. In 44 ABY, Bann developed a psychosis brought on by the dark side entity Abeloth, causing him to believe that everyone he knew had been replaced by impostors.

Turi Altamik was a female Human Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order. She fell prey to a Force psychosis in 44 ABY, and the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances demanded the Jedi Order to turn her over, laying siege to the Jedi Temple.
Sima Shadar was the female producer of the Chevin Perre Needmo's show, The Perre Needmo Newshour.
Vette, born Ce'na, was a female Twi'lek thief, pirate, assassin and escape artist born on Ryloth during the Great Galactic War.
Rohan Wayside was the leader of a trading village in the swamps of Naboo during the planet's invasion in 32 BBY.

A Human owned a homestead on the planet Naboo's countryside at the time of the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY. Early during the invasion, the Trade Federation launched an attack on Naboo civilians to quell any potential uprisings.
Qyzen Fess was a male Trandoshan hunter who allied with the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order during the time of the Cold War and the Galactic War.
Ku Chusar was an artist who made several abstract paintings. He was recognized as one of the most famous artists of his time.

Tooga Jallissi Gral was a Hutt who lived during the time after the Second Galactic Civil War. In 44 ABY, a group of Sith attacked the Fountain of the Hutt Ancients on Klatooine, which the Hutts had sworn by treaty to protect in return for the Klatooinians' servitude.

Leeha Faal was a female Keshiri Captain of the ChaseMaster frigate Winged Dagger. She served under the command of High Lord Sarasu Taalon, when the Sith fleet allied with Luke Skywalker and his son, Ben, to eliminate Abeloth in the Maw.
Tura Sanga was a Force-sensitive member of the Lost Tribe of Sith on the planet Kesh. Sanga was a famous maker of shikkars—glass weapons utilized by members of the Sith Tribe.
Tarynd was a young Human male who lived in the Coruscant underworld. In 44 ABY, he was the subject of a series of news reports by Madhi Vaandt on what he had to endure in Coruscant's slums.
Xanif was a female Twi'lek who worked at Maya Armus, a spa owned by the Hutt Azzim Anjiliac Atirue located at Napdu, the moon of Da Soocha.
Eramuth Bwua'tu was a male Bothan who served as a respected and successful attorney from the family Bwua'tu, always defending his beliefs, and the uncle of Galactic Alliance Admiral Nek Bwua'tu.

Sul Dekkon was a male Chagrian lawyer, appointed to act as prosecution in the trial against former Jedi Tahiri Veila, who was being tried for the murder of Gilad Pellaeon during the Second Galactic Civil War. He squared off against Bothan defense attorney Eramuth Bwua'tu.

Barada K'lar was a male Klatooinian who served as a docking control agent operating out of Klatooine's capital city, Treema. In 44 ABY, he welcomed Jedi Luke and Ben Skywalker, and the Sith Vestara Khai to Klatooine.

Kelkad was a young male Klatooinian fruit vendor, who worked alongside his father, Barada, in the capital city of Treema on Klatooine. In 44 ABY, he sold pak'pahs to the Jedi Ben Skywalker and his Sith acquaintance, Vestara Khai.

Kitaya Shuul was a young female slave native to Tatooine, in the servitude of Truugo the Hutt. She was an aspiring member of Freedom Flight, a group that aimed to eliminate slavery throughout the galaxy.
Truugo was a Hutt who lived on Tatooine in 44 ABY. Kitaya Shuul was one of his slaves, and he often sent her out to conduct espionage missions around Mos Eisley.
Yol Saan was a male Toydarian gambler who lived on the planet Tatooine around 44 ABY. Saan frequented Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the city Mos Eisley.
Abara Mun was a Klatooinian detention officer who ran the Treema Courthouse and Detention Area in Klatooine's capital city, Treema.

Darric Tevul was a reporter for The Perre Needmo Newshour in 44 ABY. Sima Shadar, the show's producer, suggested Tevul to report on the growing discourse regarding slavery on worlds such as Tatooine, Karfeddion and Thalassia but Perre Needmo shot down the idea and asserted the…

Anyul was a blonde, female Human born on Kesh in 20 ABY. She attained the rank of Sith Saber by 44 ABY, when she accompanied High Lord Sarasu Taalon's strike force to Dathomir to ally with Luke Skywalker in order to eliminate Abeloth.

Kaara was a Human female Sith Saber in the Lost Tribe of Sith and the sister of fellow Saber Vran. In 44 ABY, Kaara and Vran were part of the crew of the frigate Starstalker when it was on a mission to capture the Force-entity Abeloth.
Brukal was the Chevin owner of The Drunken Ootak on Vinsoth.

Guumak was a male Chevin regular of The Drunken Ootak cantina on Vinsoth. In 44 ABY, he engaged in a drinking game with Devaronian journalist Madhi Vaandt, to whom he lost his Chev slave, Shohta Laar.

Shohta Laar was a male Chev slave of Chevin cantina regular Guumak on Vinsoth. In 44 ABY, he was bet in a drinking game by Guumak, who lost him to Madhi Vaandt. Vaandt then freed Laar and hired him as part of her reporting crew.
Tyl Krain was a male human cam operator for the Devaronian journalist Madhi Vaandt. He was blond-haired and considered to be good-looking by Mahdi.
Syndor was a male Sith who served as the captain of the frigate Winged Dagger in the Lost Tribe of Sith's armada.
Vyn Holpur was a male Human Sith Saber in the Lost Tribe of Sith and the Captain of a ChaseMaster frigate in the Lost Tribe's fleet, the Starstalker.
Marjaak was a male Keshiri Sith Saber in the Lost Tribe of Sith. By 44 ABY, he had joined the Tribe's armada as a crewmember of the Starstalker, under the command of Captain Vyn Holpur.
Turg was a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith born approximately 0 ABY. He joined the Tribe's armada, becoming a crewmember of the Starstalker under Captain Vyn Holpur.

Vran was a Human male Sith Saber of the Lost Tribe of Sith, and a crewmember of the Starstalker alongside his sister, Kaara. They took place in the endeavor to acquire wintrium from the Fountain of Ancients on Klatooine, and they were met by resistance from Klatooinian guards.
Mashu Tek Barik was an elderly female Klatooinian Elder Governor on Klatooine around 44 ABY.

Belok Rhal was a Mandalorian who in 44 ABY was contracted by Galactic Alliance Chief of State Natasi Daala to lay siege to the Jedi Temple in order to retrieve two fugitive Jedi, Sothais Saar and Turi Altamik.

Sumar was a female Sith member of the Lost Tribe of Sith. In 44 ABY, she served aboard the ChaseMaster frigate Winged Dagger under the command of Captain Syndor. Syndor was replaced by Leeha Faal, however, at the orders of High Lord Sarasu Taalon.

Remmik Kulavinar was the male Twi'lek pilot of the Shooting Star. In 44 ABY, he piloted journalist Madhi Vaandt and her reporting crew across the galaxy in the ship while she was doing a continuous segment for The Perre Needmo Newshour on the existing practices of slavery thro…
Kossak the Younger was a Hutt who lived during the time of the Galactic Republic, about 700 years before the Battle of Yavin.

Rommul was a male Klatooinian who worked as a guard in the Treema Courthouse and Detention Area on Klatooine. In 44 ABY, he guarded the psychotic Force-sensitive Dyon Stadd until Luke Skywalker and his son, Ben, arrived to take custody over him.
Jella was a female Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Roya was a female Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Maliiki was a male Jawa spy. While he was attempting to rebuild an escaped droid in Mos Eisley, another assassin droid cut the ropes holding a catwalk where he stood. As he fell, a crate tumbled over him, trapping the Jawa.
Tret was a male Sullustan who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Nikolo was a male Rodian, who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

A Human was a member of the self-proclaimed Sith Lord X1's faction of the Galactic Empire, which opposed the New Republic in the Galactic Civil War. At one point, he was stationed at the Imperial prison on the planet Dathomir, which X1's forces controlled.
Philinda was a female Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Kimaru was a Human Nightsister who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kirasha was a female Human follower of the Wyrd, a coven of Force witches active on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Trantos, known also as Alpha 58, was a Alpha-Class Advanced Recon Commando who fought for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Ro Vacca was a Nikto who lived during the last millennia of the Galactic Republic.

Sarlin was a male Twi'lek smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Draknus was an Ithorian male swooper who resided on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he managed a swoop racing track in Mos Entha with his droids RC-1Z, RC-2X and RC-3T.
Drognuz was a male Gamorrean who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He served as a guard for Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Leeta Poandeu was a female Human slicer of the Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization who lived on Talus during the Galactic Civil War.

Mark Hieks was a Human male who lived on Talus during the Galactic Civil War. He was a mercenary and spy for the Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony, and later served as a member of the Corellian Security Force.

Lejo Daramus was a male Mon Calamari scientist who resided and experimented on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Daramus needed a new place to conduct his research but was short of funding.
Myssith was a female Trandoshan slaver active on the planet of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1.5 ABY. She was killed by a spacer hired by a rival, her sister named Ysith.
Brother Vrovel was a male Bith who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Vortex Squadron, stationed on Dantooine.
Teria Alessie was a female entertainer who served as an agent of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Alger was a male Human smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He operated out of Anchorhead on Tatooine.
Borra Setas was a female Rodian who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Carh'la Bastra was a female Twi'lek who served as a Captain in Rebel Alliance Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War.
Cuan Talon was a male Bothan alive during the Galactic Civil War. He ran Tosche Station after the Battle of Yavin, along with his warehouse manager Janus.
Droma Ordo was a male Chiss who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Gleezwuq was a male Rodian criminal who was a member of Blix Lanister's gang during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Jerrol Chupapa was a male Arcona who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Brody Johnson, who went by the name Johnson Smith after he went into hiding, was a male Zabrak alive during the Galactic Civil War.
Kara Corlon was a Chiss female who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was a hunter who resided on Kashyyyk in Etyyy with a group of Arcona.
Ryoo Finn was a male Arcona who lived at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Dalya was a Human female smuggler who operated out of the city of Bela Vistal on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Ging Darjeek was a male Human who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Siv'rool Linnaie was a male Bothan who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

S'larr S'loann was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Macz Cynthisa was a Human male Gravestone bandit leader who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Zyyacah Kolzaar was a male Rodian major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Thark was a male Aqualish Imperial informant who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was killed by a spacer, fooled by Mos Taike citizen Bren Kingal into believing that Thark was a crook.
Kli Sithrin was a male Zabrak Imperial who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Bren Kingal of Mos Taike sent a spacer to find him.
Jespral Farandan was a male member of the Imperial Security Bureau who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was killed by a spacer sent by Bren Kingal.
Trone Thanamiroc was a male master of disguise, and member of the Galactic Empire who lived during the Galactic Civil War. According to Bren Kingal, he was also murderer who went on killing sprees.
Jaaves was a male servant for Commander Jatrian Lytus during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Greenfinger was a Rodian thief who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He did business with Farious Gletch in Bestine.
Gordul Koga was a male Aqualish thug that lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Ripper was a male henchman of Jabba's who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Tover Blackmoor was a Human male chemist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Krix Swiftshadow was a human male that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Prat was an Imperial Watch Captain who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Uff Wogo was a male individual that lived during the Galactic Civil War. Boba Fett was searching for him on Rori due to the high bounty on his head. Ogveer rescued him and took him to Dantooine. He was known to be a heavy drinker.
Jawl was a male Kajain'sa'Nikto that lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY he worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure and could be found in his palace on the planet Tatooine.
Walda was a female Sayormi who frequented the Wayfar cantina on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

Rando M' Kabe was a male pilot who operated for the Valarian Syndicate on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Jabba the Hutt's supervisor droid EV-9D9 sent a spacer to infiltrate the Valarian Depot to retrieve droid disciplinary devices stolen by the Valarians.
Gotan was a male Twi'lek smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Grogur was a Gamorrean male who worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure as a guard during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY he was one of the guards at Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine.
Beissa was a female Rodian who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was a trainer for the Smugglers' Alliance and could often be found at Jabba's Palace on Tatooine.

An Ithorian was attacked by a nexu while attending the Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition. He was injured in the leg. Luckily, Leia Organa Solo killed the nexu, and people near him rescued him from the nexu's jaws.

Ras Andromias was a Human male Dark Jedi who lived during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Stationed at the Jedi Temple on Dantooine, he and his minions encounter a spacer and were defeated.

Talan Joben was a male Corellian businessman who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Joben was the owner of the Joben Crate Company, a crate manufacturing company based near Coronet.
Riyan Kiner was a male Human adventurer turned terrorist who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Leb Slesher was a Human male who worked as a covert agent for the Imperial Security Bureau during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Slesher worked undercover at the Kaadara cantina on Naboo.

Mullud Bombo was a male Otolla Gungan who resided in the small oceanside city of Kaadara during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Bombo worked closely with the wealthy socialites of Naboo, handling deliveries and other odd jobs.
Sentellus Gavrel was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Wilson Tchorshel was a male Mon Calamari Alliance Special Agent who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Nalskel was an up-and-coming Otolla Gungan politician on the Mid Rim planet Naboo who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, political opponents in the Nal Raka Criminal Empire sent a Nikto bounty hunter named Soris to kill Nalskel.
Soris was a male Nikto bounty hunter who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Eom Nia was a Human male non-commissioned officer who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, Nia was holding the rank of sergeant and resided in Kaadara.

Dakk was a male Gotal that lived during the Galactic Civil War. He worked as the armorsmith for the Hutt crime lord Borvo in the city of Kaadara on the planet Naboo. In 1 ABY, a spacer brought him pieces of the carapace of Borvo's acklay that the spacer had killed.
Fenton was a male Gungan smuggler who lived in Kaadara during the Galactic Civil War.

Lonnley Bolgar was a Human male Beachcomber smuggler leader who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. He might be related to Phranis Bolgar, a Beachcomber leader arrested by Royal Naboo Security Forces agent Jonthol Mazoon.
Harriet Mazoon was the mother of former Royal Naboo Security Forces agent Jonthol Mazoon, later known as the Skaak Tipper Jonni Skaak. She died some time before 1 ABY and was buried in Kaadara.

A Human male was on the Dibrook Space Station, where he watched the reporter Cianba on the HoloNet when the space station was attacked by Yuuzhan Vong Yorik-Vec starships. The attack tore a hole in the space station and the man was blown out into space.
Avrey was a female Human communications officer who served onboard the cruiser, Indomitable, during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Unluto was a male Mon Calamari who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Borantok was a male Trandoshan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Negal Tek'lon was a Human male who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Flash Harrison was a Human male pilot that lived during the Galactic Civil War. He worked as a mining pilot for the Corellian Engineering Corporation.
Rroow was a female Wookiee who lived on the planet of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she resided in Kachirho and worked with the Human woman named Sera Jossi.
Stren Colo was a Human male Imperial officer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Dorn Nareusu was a Human male pirate who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Dorn Nareusu and his band of Mining Pirates raided and destroyed numerous transport ships in the Kashyyyk system. Nareusu himself piloted an ARC-170 starfighter.
Belga Daeri was a Human female who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she resided in Kachirho, on the planet Kashyyyk, and served as a spaceport official.
Tien Wallub was a male Sullustan bartender who lived on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Wallub worked in a cantina in Kachirho.
Orooroo the Betrayer was a male Wookiee who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Cerca 1 ABY, Orooroo betrayed his fellow Wookiees, and offered his services to the Trandoshan Zssik Clan.
Drrlirm was a male Wookiee that lived at the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was an expert on surviving the wilderness of Kashyyyk and worked as an informant for queen Kylantha of Naboo.
Richards was an Imperial Commander who was present on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.

Gurnst was a Human male mercenary officer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Colonel Gurnst was hired by the Galactic Empire in order to squelch the Wookiee resistance on Kashyyyk.

Vosc Traaer was a Arcona-like alien male supplier for the Galactic Empire who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. However, he was dismissed from the Empire when it was discovered he was an embezzler.
Pressk was a male Trandoshan that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Ssiksik was a male Trandoshan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Rawarok was a Wookiee that lived during the Galactic Civil War. They were once a slave to a band of Trandoshans from the Zssik Clan, but escaped in 1 ABY with help from a spacer.
Jessk was a male Trandoshan gambler who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Vryyyr was a male Wookiee who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He served as the leader of the hunters who resided in Kachirho. He made a living by taking off-world hunters into the Shadowlands of Kashyyyk's forests to track down and kill dangerous creatures.
Wrelaac was a male Wookiee that lived during the Galactic Civil War. He resided in Kachirho on Kashyyyk.
Mada Johnson was a female Zabrak that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Vritol was a male Wookiee that lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was a creature trainer who lived along the Rryatt Trail.
Rroot was a male Wookiee who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was captured and enslaved by Trandoshans from the Blackscale Clan in 1 ABY. His mother hired a spacer to rescue him.

Hss'kas was a male Trandoshan Broodmaster of the Blackscale Clan who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Gursan Bryes tasked a spacer with killing Broodmaster Hss'kas.
Marium Valmont was a Human female who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She resided in Kachirho on Kashyyyk. She helped the local Wookiees fend of the Zssik Clan.
Criss Ne'Pomi was a male Mon Calamari doctor who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Haf Mandrox was a Human male lieutenant for Borvo the Hutt's Nal Raka Criminal Empire during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Lergo Brazee was a Human male that lived during the Galactic Civil War. Around 1 ABY, he could be found on the planet Naboo in the Keren cantina where he gave out mercenary work to spacers.
Big Blismo was a male Gungan general who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Ogden was a Human male who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. He worked as a smuggler and operated out of the city of Keren. Ruab was an associate of Ogden.
Baldwin was a Human male smuggler who operated out of Nym's Stronghold during the Galactic Civil War.
Cam'doen was a male Mon Calamari mercenary who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Trussk was a male Trandoshan slaver who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was a slavemaster of the Blackscale Clan and resided in the city of Keren, on the planet Naboo.

Arrworr was a male Wookiee who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Arrworr was captured by a group of Trandoshan slavers of the Blackscale Clan led by the slavemaster Trussk.

Ardon was a Human male who lived in the Kerritamba Village in the Kkowir Forest on the Wookiee world of Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1.5 ABY. He was an elder of the village and adviser to its chief, Kerritamba.
Zhadran was a Human male member of the Outcasts of Kkowir Forest on Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He and his people were enemies of the Kerritamba Village.
Kinuagha was a Human female junk dealer and member of the Kerritamba Village on Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She and her people were enemies of the Outcasts of Kkowir Forest.
Meust was a male Wookiee who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he hired a spacer to kill several Sayormi.
Olayyyk was a male Wookiee who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was a fighter for the Kerritamba Village.
Perusta was a female Wookiee who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was a scientist who used many native Kashyyyk plants in her experiments.
This clone of Feena D'Asta took her place after the real Feena D'Asta was kidnapped by Grappa the Hutt in 7 ABY.

Shon-Ju was a tall and muscular fallen Padawan-turned-cult leader who taught himself to direct the Force into his hands in the place of fighting with a lightsaber. He then went on to find other Force-sensitives to whom he taught his methods.

Brother Chonar was a male Dim-U monk that lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. During 1.5 ABY, he sent a bounty hunter named Rhalia Jinsari to kill Vardias Tyne after he ended up killing a bantha that was destroying his vaporators.
Breggs Ker'tani was a male Bothan information broker who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Slyd Shu'ril was a male Twi'lek who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In around 1 ABY he was being chased by a bounty hunter and asked Lergo Brazee to hire a spacer to escort him out of the wilderness of Naboo to the nearest city.
Linay Sind'lir was a female Bothan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Sertild was a male Twi'lek assassin and informant for the Kashyyyk Outcasts who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Shaedra Valouri was a Human female Corellian Security Force lieutenant who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was murdered after it was discovered that she helped her friend, Denell Kel'Vannon.

Snee-Roos was a Gran male who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY he was visiting the Core World Corellia on vacation. During his stay on the planet, he recorded a poacher illegally killing a Gronda near Kor Vella.

Skinkner was a Human male criminal that lived during the Galactic Civil War. He worked for the Black Sun syndicate and could be found in a cantina in Kor Vella on Corellia. Skinkner was a member of the Brommstaad Mercenaries.
Lasha Bindari was a Human male criminal that lived during the Galactic Civil War. He worked for Shalera the Hutt and could be found in a cantina in Kor Vella on Corellia.
Brangan Zapakaj was a male courier who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Lasha Bindari tasked a spacer with rendezvousing with him.
This clone trooper pilot flew one of three Plo's Bros gunships sent to Vanqor during the Clone Wars to rescue Jedi Master Mace Windu and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker.
Wardell was a Human male smuggler who operated out of the city of Kor Vella on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Crowley was a female Twi'lek who served as a Rebel Master Sergeant during the Galactic Civil War.
Jaylon Geissler was a male Bothan spice dealer who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Olivia Bain was a female Rodian who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was the mother of Civius Bain.
Civius Bain was a male Rodian ryll smuggler who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was the son of Olivia Bain.
Jaryn Minoze was a male Nikto spice smuggler who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Oret Sturm was a Human male spice smuggler who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Ladonna Poe was a Human female spice smuggler who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Oldksam was a male Rodian who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Untas was a Human male mercenary who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Bosshand Faeto was a male Bith criminal who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Taibela was a Human female who lived in on the desert planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
Sleash was a male Nikto thug who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Benn Calder was a Human male who worked in a laboratory on Corellia as an administrative head during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Pirt Rawklin was a Human male who worked in a laboratory on Corellia as an administrative head during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Rond Fenimer was a Human male who worked in a laboratory on Corellia as an administrative head during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Jenson was a male beast master who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. Jenson was the brother of Jeridel. After the Battle of Yavin, both worked in an illegal lab on Corellia, a lab specialized in bio-engineering creatures through dangerous genetic experiments.

Rovim Minnoni was a Human male who lived in Varykino on the Mid Rim world of Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War. By 1 ABY, he worked at the Lake Retreat Hotel, where he oversaw the needs of visiting tour groups.
Zazzi Yown was a male Gungan tour guide and mercenary who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Bevon Cordh was a male herbalist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Cordh traveled with a group of tourists from the world of Duzay to Naboo.

Nion Lip'to was a male explorer who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Rovim Minnoni tasked Lip'to with finding a lost tour group from Duzay near the retreat of Varykino on Naboo.

Lareen Dantara was a female Human that lived on the planet Naboo at the time of the Galactic Civil War. She worked at the Lake Retreat, a private retreat in the mountains of Naboo that belonged to the Naberrie family.
Layton was a Human male smuggler who operated out of Varykino during the Galactic Civil War.
Mikfa Faaus was a male Gungan who lived near the Lake Retreat on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. He used to repair kitchen refrigerator units and other devices.
Eteto Topan was a male Devaronian who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Kerhi hi-Lak was a female Mon Calamari who lived in Mos Taike during the Galactic Civil War.

Tombl Blaus was a male Weequay who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, he stayed at a camp on Naboo's moon of Rori which was the site of many battles between poachers and creatures, including vrobals and vicious squalls.
Lepwalk C'han was a male Bith who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He lived in a small abode on the planet Dantooine.
Nore Brrea was a Human female who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Jace Lorrin was male Human diplomat and Viceprex for the Corporate Sector Authority.

In 3998 BBY, Tetan socialites Aleema and Satal Keto met the curator of Coruscant's Galactic Museum while on a trip to the galactic capital. The curator escorted the Ketos through the museum's newly unveiled exhibit, The Dark Lords of the Sith.
Direus'pei was a Hutt playwright. He wrote Evocar.
The one known as "Lurdo" was a Human male who lived during the Imperial Period. A wealthy individual, the Human studied at a prominent university for several years, before touring the galaxy.

A member of the Jedi Order participated in the Clone Wars, fighting for the Galactic Republic against the Confederacy of Independent Systems between 22 BBY and 19 BBY. The Jedi, serving as a general for the Republic, was vaporized by Separatist fire during the Battle of Altyr V.
Kavafi was a doctor and a friend of Mammon Hoole, dedicated to improving the lot of sentient beings.

Devlin was a male spokesman who worked for a group of Corellian Engineering Corporation union leaders who defected to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War due to dissatisfaction with Imperial labor laws.

Iris was a union leader for Corellian Engineering Corporation workers. She and several of her fellow leaders met with Wedge Antilles after the Galactic Empire promulgated labor laws that they found unsatisfactory.
Graise was a male Human Imperial general non-com.
Boize was a male Human who served in the Galactic Empire as a General. Boize was known as a yes-man.
Weir's aide was a Human male who served as an aide to General Weir.
A Human prisoner had been convicted of cheating at Sabacc on the planet Concord Dawn. Unknown to the Sabacc player, cheating was a capital offense on Concord Dawn.

The rider of a Ubese Thorn-Back War Dragon wielded a modified lightsaber. The individual also possessed a blaster rifle, which they slung on the neck of their War Dragon, and also wore armor that encased their body.

A Human guide led Doctor Indiana Jones and his companion Short Round through a jungle on the planet Earth between the years 1942 and 1943. The group was searching for the location of the legendary "Sasquatch," which was really the stranded Wookiee Chewbacca.

Ysho was a male Ithorian lawyer who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was the advocate of Lady Valarian, the leader of the Valarian criminal syndicate on Tatooine.
Cie Vos was male Zabrak criminal who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Ki'shai was a friend of Kavas Urdano who lived on the planet Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was a member of a Lady Valarian's criminal syndicate.

Una Gitori was a male Ualaq Aqualish criminal who lived on the planet Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he was a member of the Valarian Syndicate, a criminal organization led by Lady Valarian.
Soobu Javeedo was a male Rodian spice dealer who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Ind was a female Gran criminal who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. She worked for Lady Valarian.
Kaesii DuPree was a Human female spy who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Sneg, nicknamed Sneg the Hand, was a male Devaronian junk dealer who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he worked as a junk dealer in Lady Valarian's Lucky Despot cantina in Mos Eisley.
Jag Silon was a male Twi'lek who acted as a rewards agent for the G.V.B.D.M. He set up shop on one of the lower levels of the Lucky Despot cantina in Mos Eisley, Tatooine.
Shamdon Kree was a Human female pilot of the Smugglers' Alliance who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Indar was a male Sanyassan Marauder who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Quinton was a Human male smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was a smuggler and partner to Harding. They had an operation on the forest moon of Endor.
Etta was a Human male smuggler who operated on Lok, a considerable distance east of Nym's Stronghold during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Driton Fitch was a male Trandoshan Mauler who operated out of Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
Hrath Koo was a Human male member of the Meatlump gang who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Pech Seki was a Human male member of the Meatlump gang, a group of technology-hating thugs based on the Core World Corellia at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Teilo Monnro was a Zabrak businesswoman who lived on Corellia at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Blink was the nickname of a male Bothan who served as a member of the galaxywide anti-slavery organization Freedom Flight.
In 25 ABY, a Quara Aqualish was employed as a lieutenant to Big Bunji, the owner and operator of the Jubilee Wheel space station over Ord Mantell.
Olon Lono was a male Mustafarian scout who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He assisted a number of spacers who were about to fight in the Battle of Koseyet.
Jo Keslev was a male Mustafarian surveyor who operated out of the Mensix Mining Facility on Mustafar during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Nurfa Laz'op was a male Mustafarian foreman who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Renlo Hens was a male Mustafarian miner that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Selan Ellison was a Human female who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, she was present for some time in the city of Moenia, on the planet Naboo.
Valance Serth was a Human male who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Bertos Goodner was a male Twi'lek who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. Posing as a dancer, he was in fact a spy of the Rebel Alliance.
Radanthus Mandelatara was a Human male playwright who lived on Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Dair Coladel was a female lieutenant who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Dagorel was a male Quarren criminal who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
Brigham was a Human male smuggler who operated out of the city of Moenia on the planet Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.

Smurdap was a former member of Imperial Customs and later the Chief of Fornax Security on Fornax Station. He was dedicated to his work but was deposed when two smugglers outwitted him in his duplicity.

Abominelle was a Venan Human female, and the Royal Margravine of Vena. While touring Fornax Station on the eve of her wedding, she was interrupted by Han Solo and the plan concocted by the station's security officer, Smurdap, to capture the smuggler.
Jeres Moridon was a male lieutenant in the Galactic Empire who was stationed on the moon of Endor during the Battle of Endor.
Rixen was a female Human member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was operating in the Core Worlds.
Sergeant Mokem was a male Gungan soldier living on Naboo.
Nuun Pargen was a male captain of the Crescent.
Inea Pargen was a female who was the daughter of Nuun Pargen. At a young age, she was wounded during an attack on her father's ship, the Crescent, during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY.
Chee Mobok was a male Twi'lek textiles merchant that spoke very little Basic.

After the Yuuzhan Vong Warmaster Tsavong Lah called for the blood of the Jedi, a Yuuzhan Vong priestess began hunting them. She managed to kidnap several Jedi Knights, but was defeated by the Jedi Knight Jorallen and the scientist Danni Quee.

Nathaniel Camaran was a Royal Naboo Security Guard on Naboo. In 32 BBY, when the Trade Federation invaded Naboo, Lieutenant Camaran quickly became one of the leaders of the Naboo Resistance. Camaran was in charge of security for a particular cell of the Resistance.

Oti Trinta was a member of the Naboo Diplomatic Corps. In 32 BBY, when the Trade Federation invaded Naboo, Trinta quickly became one of the leaders of the Naboo Resistance. Trinta was in charge of general operations for a particular cell of the Resistance.

Janna Relasi was a female bounty hunter who worked for the House Salaktori of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. Salaktori assigned her a starship and an AD-series weapons maintenance droid, GSAD-43, to help her in her missions. During those, Relasi and the droid bonded intimately.
Ogo was a police officer who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was a lieutenant in the Mos Eisley Police and served as planetary record keeper.
Allura was a Human female entertainer who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she resided in Mos Eisley and used to perform in Chalmun's Cantina.
Kazen Harn was a Human male medical professional and scientist who worked at the Mos Eisley Medical Center on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Anetia Kah'ryn was a female Twi'lek entertainer who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Toggi Bok was a male Trandoshan who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He was known to do business with Jabba the Hutt.

Lurval was a male Talz who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he resided in Mos Eisley and worked at the Spaceport Cantina. In 1 ABY, the cantina owner Chalmun hired a clumsy waiter who kept smashing glasses.

Muna Skish was a male Aqualish bartender who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he resided in Mos Eisley and worked at the Spaceport Cantina. In 1 ABY, the cantina had a problem with its spiced tea distributor.
Nogri Hessen was a male Trandoshan who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he resided in Mos Eisley's.

Jano Bix was a male Twi'lek swoop gang leader operating out of Mos Eisley, Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, upon ordering four gorg combos from Tasty Dried Critters, the creatures attacked Bix.
Radeld Siwar was a male Rodian smuggler that lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He could often be found in the Mos Eisley Combat Hall.

Ellis Arrison was a Human male military officer who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, Ellis Arrison resided in Mos Eisley along with his brother Purvis.

Gendra was a male Quarren who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he resided in Mos Eisley. He was a friend of Chalmun, the owner of the Spaceport Cantina, and his employees Muna Skish and Lurval.
Kaden was a Human male smuggler who operated out of Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War.
Escara Frei was a Human female who lived on the desert world Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Nillika was a Human male who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he worked as the administrator of the Mos Eisley Medical Center.
Kaleb was a Human male smuggler who operated out of Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War.

Orga Presari was Trandoshan male slaver who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, a Mon Calamari by the name of Ikka Gesul tasked a spacer with killing Presari and his two bodyguards outside the city of Mos Entha on T…

Taln Solwind was male technician who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, a Mon Calamari by the name of Ikka Gesul tasked a spacer with delivering a message to Solwind outside the city of Mos Entha on Tatooine.
Eyan McDermitt was a male pirate leader who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Sadelli was an enslaved female Twi'lek and the older sister of Soolami who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Triddle "Flip" Flipinigan was an individual who worked with Kaeline Ungasan during the Galactic Civil War.
Sil Onda'tek was a male henchman for Jabba the Hutt during the Galactic Civil War.
Iza Paatzee was a male Zabrak assassin who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Trace Lyson was a Human male journalist who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Lyson resided in the city of Mos Espa. During that time, Tusken Raiders in the region of Mos Eisley had become very hostile and directly threatened the city.
Dorn Gestros was a Human male who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

Tiomvo was a Human male who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was part of a group of thugs who lived in the slums of Mos Espa. This group also included Hilbrun, Eyleen and Guz'Ordnak.

Hilbrun was a Human male who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was part of a group of thugs who lived in the slums of Mos Espa. This group also included Eyleen, Tiomvo and Guz'Ordnak.

Guz'Ordnak was a male Trandoshan who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was part of a group of thugs who lived in the slums of Mos Espa. This group also included Hilbrun, Eyleen and Tiomvo.
Qord D'Baelor was a Human male who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Krin Vel was a Twi'lek moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Drik Bandrik was a male slaver that operated on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Thermal Det was a Kitonak slicer and friend of Kitster Chanchani Banai on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Diala was a Human female smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Sont Toipo was a male Aqualish vigilante leader who worked on Drik Bandrik's payroll on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Deeng was a Rodian henchman that worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Chastina Rile, otherwise known as Mrs. Rile, was the wife of Gramm Rile. Gramm was the mayor of Mos Taike, a small city on the Outer Rim planet of Tatooine.
Merg Thando was a male moisture farmer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Mayor Gramm Rile sent a spacer to find him.

D'Mayna Stallaphalat, known as Stella for short, was a female Bith who lived at the time of the Galactic Civil War. She owned and ran the Third Sun Cantina in the small desert town of Mos Taike on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine.
Ulek Talstin was a male brigand who worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Galactic Civil War. He was killed by a spacer dispatched by D'Mayna Stallaphalat.
Bent Spur was an individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War. D'Mayna Stallaphalat sent a spacer to find Spur, who owed her money.
Kara was a Human female smuggler who operated out of Mos Taike during the Galactic Civil War.
Edwyn was a Human male smuggler who operated on Mount Chaolt during the Galactic Civil War.

Janelle was a Human female and chief of the Mountaintop smugglers who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, she acquired a ring from Herman Pate as a payment of a debt. The ring was a family heirloom previously lost by Vance Groten to Herman Pate during a Sabacc game.
Bant'ena Fhernan was a Human female Corellian from the planet Corellia who lived during the Clone Wars.
Flaygin was a retired salvager who resided in Farpoint on Fhost at the time that Jaden Korr came to the planet. He was one of four players in the sabacc game that ended in a brawl.

Vedo Anjiliac Atirue was a Hutt male who was the leader of Anjiliac kajidic, the uncle of Azzim Anjiliac Atirue, and a member of the Hutt Grand Council during the Second Imperial Civil War. He was also a close friend of Queen Jool.
Telan Medon was a Pau'an from Utapau and the Port Administrator of the planet's Pau City during the Second Imperial Civil War.
Muerdo was an Utai spy under the employ of Hutt crime-lord Vedo Anjiliac Atirue. In 138 ABY, Muerdo used a mouse droid to learn of Admiral Gar Stazi's presence on the world of Utapau.
Dol Narlock was a male Mon Calamari Commander who served aboard Republic transport ship Esseles during the Cold War. He would reach the rank of Vice Admiral by 3627 BBY.

Rorworr's father was a male Wookiee. Sometime after his child, Rorworr, was born in 49 BBY, he was assigned to act as an ambassador for Kashyyyk on Naboo. His station allowed his son to attend school in Naboo's capital, Theed, at the Royal House of Learning.
A member of Darth Krayt's One Sith, a Neimoidian Sith stood guard before XoXaan's Temple's Chambers of Persuasion on Korriban.

Jaleela Bindoo was a Human female who lived in the city of Narmle on Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she planned to participate in the Narmle Arts Gala.

A Jedi Master who lived in the final decades of the Galactic Republic took the Human female Tohno as a Padawan, teaching her studies in architecture and engineering, as well as the Jedi ways. The Jedi died during the Clone Wars, and Tohno was left without a Master.

Xizor's mother was a Falleen female, the wife of King Haxim and the queen of his provincial kingdom. She perished in 7 BBY during an orbital bombardment of Falleen executed by the Galactic Empire. She was survived by her son, Xizor, but her two daughters and husband perished.
This female Falleen was the sister of Xizor, and daughter of Haxim.
This female Falleen was the sister of Xizor, and daughter of Haxim.
One of Huoba Neva's parents was a Sullustan who served on the Executive Board of the SoroSuub Corporation. Their position within the company helped Neva to attain a place at the Imperial Academy.
Crat Dakerno was a male military strategist in the Galactic Empire. He traveled with a troop contingent to the planet Ab'Bshingh where he studied the two native species, the Waroot and the Farangs.
Sherbin Tork was a Human male, and proprietor of The Black Nova Tapcafe.

Kelon was the Chief Directory Assistant of the Woostri HoloScan Database, a library located on the planet Woostri. They had a Borg Construct Aj^6 cybernetic headband, which they used to access information for work.

"Slide" Brombek was a Human outlaw tech. They had brown hair, light skin, dark eyes, and a purple tattoo of abstract design on their right hand. The Human wore a cream-colored undershirt, a brown tunic over it, brown pants, brown boots, and a belt with many pouches.

Trel "Scourge" Skutu was an Imperial TIE pilot and flight leader, going by the callsign of "Scourge". Despite his dislike for the Rebel Alliance, Skutu admitted he respected the aggressiveness and ability of Rebel starfighter pilots.
Marck Linth was a Human male and member of the Alliance Special Forces 5th Regiment, commonly known as SpecForce Infiltrators. Linth held the rank of colonel.

This Human male impostor of Galactic Empire Commander Rezi Soresh was used in Soresh's deceptions against the Heroes of Yavin in 1 ABY. When the Rebels landed near Soresh's compound in the Sixela system, this man was there to meet them.
Goomi was a male bounty hunter who worked for Ziro Desilijic Tiure during the Clone Wars. At one point he attacked ex-Padawan Crovan Dane, but was killed by Tahnchukka.

Barev was a male Human Colonel serving the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY he was stationed on Lanteeb and served under General Lok Durd and was placed in charge of the effort to capture the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.
Chivas was a senior Jedi Padawan who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. A Force-sensitive, Chivas received training in the ways of the Force at the Coruscant Jedi Temple's academy.
Tabrungi was a senior male Jedi Padawan who was enrolled in the Jedi Order's academy on Coruscant.
Laksh'atz was a senior Jedi Padawan enrolled in the Jedi Order's academy on Coruscant.
T'boor was a senior male Jedi Padawan who was enrolled in the Jedi Order's academy on Coruscant.
Baggro was a senior male Mon Calamari Jedi Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Veneka was a senior Jedi Padawan who was enrolled in the Jedi Order's academy on Coruscant.

Michka was a senior female Jedi Padawan who enrolled in the Jedi Order's academy on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. Soon after the Battle of Kothlis, Michka joined in a competition led by Master Taria Damsin and played on Damsin's Blue team.

Brandeh was a female Lanteeban doctor who was a citizen of the mining town of Torbel on the planet Lanteeb during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Nagme was a female Yuuzhan Vong Master Shaper. At the start of the Yuuzhan Vong War she was stationed on Dibrook interrogating Yuledan. Her work included changing people from the galaxy into monsters for an army, though they were only partially effective.

A male Rodian rebel was a member of the Rebel Alliance team sent to investigate Gobindi. The Galactic Empire soon put the world under lockdown as it tested the influenza necrosi virus, declaring the reason for the lockdown to be piracy.
A male Human Rebel, who had a large scar running from his left eye to the right side of his jaw, was a member of the Rebel Alliance team sent to investigate Gobindi.

A male Bothan Rebel was a member of the Rebel Alliance team sent to investigate Gobindi. The Galactic Empire soon put the world under lockdown as it tested the influenza necrosi virus, declaring the reason for the lockdown to be piracy.
This male sergeant served as an All Terrain Armored Transport training instructor at the Imperial Academy of Carida shortly before the Battle of Yavin.
Kaith was a human female cyborg with a cybernetic right hand and was one of Janq Paramexor's consort.

Nak Farool was the Special Assistant to Moff Nile Owen. He organized the abduction of Crying Dawn Singer supposedly to help Owen gain the support of the Shashay species; however, Farool was really conspiring to depose Owen and replace him with his brother Braig Farool.

Braig Farool was the planetary governor of Narg and the brother of Nak Farool. Nak conspired to depose his boss, Moff Nile Owen, and replace him with Braig. To do so, Nak arranged the abduction of artist Crying Dawn Singer by pirate Yearo Seville as a charade.
Ogden served as a captain in the New Republic Defense Fleet on Dibrook Space Station under Commander Bylsma in 25 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Yuledan was a male Jedi who served the New Jedi Order during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Dray was a former Human male Jedi Padawan during the Clone Wars. The apprentice of Jedi Master Salmara, he was part of a mission involving the renegade Sith Lord Darth Maul and his brother, Savage Opress.

Cianba was a journalist during the start of the Yuuzhan Vong War and covered the creation of the Outer Rim Alliance. She belonged to a felinoid species covered with black fur, feline eyes, long ears, whiskers, and sharp teeth.
Tala'oree was a female Twi'lek patrol squad member in the Myyydril Caverns on the planet Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Nawika was a female Wookiee cantina patron who resided in the Myyydril Caverns on the planet Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kivvaaa was a female Wookiee who lived during the Galactic Civil War as the patrol leader for the Myyydril, a tribe that lived in the Myyydril Caverns on the planet Kashyyyk.
Ivesa was a Twi'lek female villager of the Myyydril Caverns on the planet Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kiaanta was a male Wookiee patrol squad member in the Myyydril Caverns on the planet Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Seri'leo was a male Wookiee villager of the Myydril Caverns on the planet Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Oxil Sarban was a Human male who lived in the city of Narmle on Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he was the Minister of Arts for the Narmle government and gave some assignments to a spacer.

Biribas Tarun was a Human male captain who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was in charge of Narmle's security, a city on Naboo's moon of Rori. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he assigned a spacer a number of tasks.
Zeelius Kraymunder was a Human male con artist who lived on Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Sindra Lintikoor was a Human female who lived on Rori during the Galactic Civil War. She was the Minister of Education for the city of Narmle.
