Ingon Lakbo was a male scholar and philosopher who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He resided in the city of Narmle, on Naboo's moon of Rori, and was considered a great mind.
Bieque Lozan-Lippod was a male scholar and philosopher who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He resided in the city of Narmle, on Naboo's moon of Rori, and was considered a great mind.

Sidoras Bey was a Human male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He once was a sculptor, and a portrait made by Gungan artist Odoof Grunda depicted him sculpting a statue of Emperor Palpatine.
Silaras Bey was the Human offspring of Sidoras Bey, both of whom lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kaila Min was a Human female who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Kaila Min frequented Narmle's Gambling Hall on Naboo's moon of Rori.
Wolff Kalos was a male Rebel Alliance officer who operated on Rori during the Galactic Civil War.
Jonda Trask was a male noble who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Alwynn was a Human male smuggler who operated out a camp on Naboo's moon of Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Ria was a female Twi'lek smuggler and contraband dealer who operated out of the city of Narmle on Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Deckland Carper was a male Human Alderaanian who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic after Alderaan's destruction during the Galactic Civil War. He was ultimately killed by the bounty hunter Thune. His droid, U-THR, was also taken by Thune.
Treytis Prash was a gun-runner for the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was eventually captured by Thune. He later died when caught in a Z-95 Headhunter's strafing run.
A female security guard worked at Mungo Baobab's Quilken casino, Club Baobab. She was killed by the bounty hunter Thune.
Beidlo was a Rodian who worked as a bodyguard for Treytis Prash. He was killed by Celia Durasha.
Kurvis was a Krish who worked as a bodyguard for Treytis Prash. He was killed by the bounty hunter Thune.
The manager of Obroa-skai's libraries was an Ithorian, who was eventually hunted down and killed by the Imperial Security Bureau.
Gresh Manaa was a Human male who served as the Prime Minister of Delaya during the Galactic Civil War.
Var Lyonn was the deputy to Prime Minister Gresh Manaa on Delaya. General Carlist Rieekan suspected that Lyonn was in fact the true power broker on the planet.

An Imperial took part in the Battle of the Sixela system against the forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was onboard Darth Vader's Interdictor Star Destroyer during the battle and communicated with Leia Organa when she tried to stop the fighting.

Slooni Jong, referred to as pookie by one of his female cabinet members, was the Human male Chief Administrator of Nashal, a city on the Twin World of Talus. Jong lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Igbi Freemo was a male Rodian member of Black Sun who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he conducted business out of the city of Nashal on Talus.

Sigrix Slix was a male Bith musician living during the time of the Galactic Civil War who resided on Talus. He hired a spacer in 1 ABY to carry out tasks that were supposedly legal, but the spacer was forced to smuggle spices to other criminals.
Wooral was a female Selonian who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Grovo was a rancor from Dathomir that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Daverda was a female Human Nightsister who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY Diax tasked a spacer with killing her.
Espernia was a female member of the Singing Mountain Clan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Aelta was a female Human witch who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Morris was a Human male smuggler fence who operated out of the Nightsister Stronghold on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Pletus Croix was a Human male archaeologist who investigated Mustafar's Smoking Forest during the Galactic Civil War.
Relgon Starkill was a Human male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Byrec was a male Trandoshan who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He resided on Nova Orion Station.
Maikia was a Human female who operated on the Nova Orion Station during the Galactic Civil War.
Rassthern was a male Quarren who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Vothinyak was a male Nautolan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Skyron Waurie was a male Rodian Nova Orion Station security supervisor who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Willard Wassleman III was a male Twi'lek that lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed on the Nova Orion Station.
Evie Denigh was a female Zabrak Humanoid Resources Advisor who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Cyll Annora was a female Rodian who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Nemdon Ralleck was a male Sullustan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Garrick Orion was a Human male who lived on Nova Orion Station during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was one of the two founders of Nova Orion Industries, along with his old friend Jonas Nova.
Dexen Eronoss was a male Mon Calamari that lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was working as an shift foreman for Nova Orion Industries on the Nova Orion Station.
Mazzlo was a male Bothan broker who worked in the Nova Orion Station during the Galactic Civil War.
Fen Ackdo was a male Bothan chassis broker who conducted business on Nova Orion Station during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Andria E'liyha was a Human female criminal outcast who lived on Lok during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she was planing to eliminate other criminals of the planet in order to become the leader of her own band of outcasts.

Talia v'laenya was a female Bothan spy who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Early during the conflict, she joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic and was a member of the Alliance Spy Network.
Moore was a male Human who served as sub-officer in the Imperial Army until he was discharged during the Galactic Civil War.
Kaibe was a male Chiss slicer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He worked for the pirate warlord Nym in Nym's Stronghold on Lok.
Ramna was a CorSec Commander who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She trained newer members of CorSec as pilots. Ramna also often visited Nym's Stronghold on Lok.

Warvog Arkon was a male Twi'lek who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He led the Havoc Squadron, a group of Alliance to Restore the Republic pilots. Warvog resided on Lok, in Nym's Stronghold. This shows that he had ties to Nym and the Lok Revenants.
Nateba Kurr was a male Rebel pilot that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
E'Dycu was a male smuggler who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Vixur Webb was a Human male musician who frequented the cantina in Nym's Stronghold during the Galactic Civil War.
Harding was a Human male smuggler who served as a partner of Quinton during the Galactic Civil War. They had an operation on the forest moon of Endor. Harding mostly smuggled illegal blaster pistols.
Vrak was a male Rodian that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Yras Shen-jen was a Human male self-employed pilot who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Jori was a male a CorSec agent turned criminal who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
I'klee'trao was a male Ithorian that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Montage was a Human male Imperial sergeant who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
A Bothan pilot was a member of Rogue Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. The Bothan was killed in the course of a secret mission and later replaced with Karie Neth.
Deasie A'Fresel was a female entertainer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was the sister of Officer Tennelt, and the wife of Captain Taergle.
Tennelt was an ISB Officer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was the brother of Deasie A'Fresel, and defected to the Rebellion sometime after 0 BBY.
Fnast was a male Bothan slicer and information broker that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Montrasword was a Rebel captain and First Lieutenant who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Taergle was a male Rebel Captain and First Lieutenant who was rescued by a Rebel working for C-3PO during the Galactic Civil War. He was also the husband of Deasie A'Fresel.
Drexsler was a Rebel captain and first lieutenant who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Lance was a male Human Rebel Lieutenant who operated out of the hidden Rebel base on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Teslo Ten'Doora was an officer of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he operated out of the hidden Rebel base on Corellia.

Booto Lubble was a male Gungan who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Stationed at Zephyr Base on Rori, he served as a liaison between the Gungans of Naboo and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Luhin Jinnor was an Imperial Warrant Officer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed on Rori and killed on orders of Booto Lubble, a Gungan liason for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Rohd Gostervek was an Imperial Captain that lived during the Galactic Civil War. Booto Lubble, a Gungan of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, ordered him killed.

Zarvold was an Imperial colonel who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. The colonel commanded an Imperial Army battalion stationed on Naboo's moon of Rori, where Zarvold's forces regularly patrolled the wilderness in opposition to the Rebel Alliance presence at Ze…
Raxa Binn was a female Zabrak commando trainer who served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Vordin Sildor was a Human male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He operated out of Zephyr Base on Naboo's swamp moon of Rori. He held the rank of commander with the Alliance to Restore the Republic
Ufwol was a male Mon Calamari Rebel General who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he was present at the Zephyr Base on Rori.
Alec was a Human male smuggler fence who operated near the Research Outpost on the Forest Moon of Endor during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kilnstrider was an Admiral in the Imperial Storm Squadron, and a Imperial pilot trainer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Draya Korbinari was a Human female who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Indintra Imbru Yerevan was a Human female socialite in the city of Restuss on Naboo's moon of Rori. During the time of the Galactic Civil War, she was known for hosting salons and orchestrating the prestigious Great Conversation debates, where Restuss and its rival city of Nar…
Briska Gil was a friend of Indintra Imbru Yerevan who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Shaultra Loraweet was a female individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Hefsen Zindalai was a Human male who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
A male hunter lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was hunting on the moon Rori with Lord Sloan Rusper.
Jinderliss Prason was a friend of Ajuva Vanasterin who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Emory was a Human male smuggler who operated near Restuss on Rori during the Galactic Civil War.
Marles Jacobe was a Human male reporter for the Corellia Times who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Ortha Ledox was a male Rodian who lived on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.
Pirus Gue was a male Rodian who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Kerssoc was a Rodian male hunter alive during the Galactic Civil War.
Hiram Bish was a Human male who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. He was a member of the Corellian Security Force before choosing to become a criminal.
Zola was a Human female smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Tressk was a male Rodian who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was hired to kill two poachers on Kashyyyk. On the planet, he saw the lost Rodian hunters at Rryatt Trail as an embarrassment, and so asked a spacer to eliminate them.

Zhailaut was a male Wookiee that lived in the village of Kachirho on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War and loosely associated with a Wookiee resistance group. In 1 ABY, Zhailaut sent a spacer and the Bothan Gursan Bryes to kill the Trandoshan slaver Cyssc Blackscale.

Arnecio Ulvaw'op was a male Bothan who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He deserted the Galactic Empire sometime during the war and joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Crimson Phoenix Squadron as a pilot under major Eker on the planet Dathomir.
Ravi Thienta was a Selonian female who lived on Talus during the Galactic Civil War.
Tika Sileste was a Selonian female who lived on Talus during the Galactic Civil War.
Lika Fimente was a Selonian female who lived on Talus during the Galactic Civil War.
Aveso Ars was a female Zabrak who lived on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.
Risyl was a male Chiss member of the Outcasts of Kkowir Forest on Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He and his people were enemies of the Kerritamba Village.
Rhuiw was a male Bothan junk dealer who a member of the Outcasts of Kkowir Forest on Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He and his people were enemies of the Kerritamba Village.
Cryl Kydris was a male Trandoshan that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Rhiek Okina was a male Sayormi member of the Outcasts of Kkowir Forest on Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He and his people were enemies of the Kerritamba Village.
Magnus Grenz was a Human male coadjutor in the Cult of Exar Kun who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Selia was a female Dathomirian Witch who served as a member of the Singing Mountain Clan during the Galactic Civil War between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire.
Izaryx was a Witch of Dathomir and a member of the Singing Mountain Clan during the Galactic Civil War.
Greti was a young Lanteeban girl living in the mining town of Torbel during the Clone Wars. A Force-sensitive, she was the daughter of Teeba Bohle.
Bohle was a female miner who lived in the mining town of Torbel during the Clone Wars. The mother of Greti, Bohle was a worker who suffered from damotite poisoning.

The impostor posing as Prince Harrandatha Estillo was a man who resembled Prince Harrandatha Estillo of Eiattu 6. Brainwashed into believing he was Estillo by circuitry contained within Estillo's signet ring, he served Leonia Tavira, Moff of Eiattu 6, as a pawn and lover.
Girov Dza'tey's second-in-command was a Bothan who served as chief lieutenant to Girov Dza'tey on an expedition to Malrev IV.

Tarin was the Human in charge of the production of FEX-M3 nerve gas grenades during the Clone Wars. Reep Tonith threatened to turn him in to Dooku if he did not complete the order soon. He was later shackled by Sergeant Marrt as the Czerka factory burnt down.
An individual served as the Imperial governor of Herios IV. The governor failed to capture Baraduk.
An unnamed Mosciive was a member of Yojan's squad on Simocadia. Along with the rest of the squad, he participated in the rescue of Mace Windu when the Jedi was captured by a race of unknown demons.
Shigar Konshi was a male Kiffar Padawan who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Eldon Ax, born Cinzia Xandret, was a Human female Sith living around the time of the Great Galactic War and the Cold War. Born the daughter of technician Lema Xandret, she was separated from her family and trained in the Sith Academy under Darth Chratis.

Dao Stryver was a Gektl female Mandalorian warrior who was active during the Cold War. She enabled Lema Xandret to bring herself and her followers to Sebaddon and was thought to have disappeared into a black hole during the Independent Operation Sebaddon, but later tracked dow…
The Ma'aood chief designer was responsible for designing the Ma'aood funerary temples. He made sure all obvious passages contained traps; traps enticing enough to lure in visitors to the temples.
Ula Vii was a male Epicanthix who served as an agent of the Intelligence division during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Larin Moxla was a former Special Forces Republic trooper of the Blackstar Squad during the Cold War. She was a Kiffar with dark hair and green eyes. She had the distinctive markings of Clan Moxla tattooed on her cheeks.

A Neimoidian cyborg was an officer in the navy of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, he commanded a Munificent-class star frigate during the Battle of Simocadia.
Arvin Tadle was a male Human in charge of the New Republic's embassy on the planet Ergeshui, located in Outworlder City.
Fae Coven was a female Jenet Jedi Master and the Grand Master of the Jedi Order following the Ruusan Reformations, serving until her death sometime after 896 BBY.
Crix Sunburris was a male Human Jedi Master and an ace pilot within the ranks of the Jedi Order's Starfighter Corps.
Skarch Vaunk was a female Anx Jedi Master and the Battlemaster at the Coruscant Jedi Temple in the years preceding the Ruusan Reformation.
Bowspritz was a Tynnan Jedi Master, a noted biologist, and the beastmaster at the Coruscant Jedi Temple in the years preceding the Ruusan Reformation.

Sabla-Mandibu was a female Miraluka Jedi Master of the Council of Reconciliation and a renowned Seer of the Jedi Order. Serving at the Coruscant Jedi Temple in the years preceding the Ruusan Reformation, Master Mandibu was an expert at analyzing holocrons.

Gal-Stod Slagistrough was a male Nuknog, and a leading member of the Jedi Service Corps branch, the Agricultural Corps, during the years proceeding the implementation of the Ruusan Reformations of the Galactic Republic.
Zideera was a Witch of Dathomir and a member of the Singing Mountain Clan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Aujante K'lee was a witch of the Singing Mountain Clan who lived on Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War.
Aldiae was a Human female servant who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Vhuransa was a female Nightsister who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Jhuryx was a member of the Singing Mountain Clan that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Vhaunda was a Witch of Dathomir who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, she was a culinarian of the Singing Mountain Clan.
LX-613 was a Stormtrooper Patrol Leader and sergeant who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Peila was a female Human Nightsister initiate who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Gilsaria was a female Human witch of the Singing Mountain Clan who lived on Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War, a major conflict fought between the Galactic Empire and Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Shando was a rancor of the Singing Mountain Clan that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Mau'fel was a rancor of the Singing Mountain Clan that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Tomi Skaak was a Human male and a member of the Skaak Tippers who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Dee Skaak was a Human female member of the Skaak Tippers who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Chawroo was a male Wookiee who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Olima Grunc was a Human male who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Ysith was a female Trandoshan who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was the sister and rival of Myssith.
Dakar was a male Trandoshan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Mosolium was a male Trandoshan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Hssissk Bloodscale was a male Trandoshan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Lesnorr was a male Trandoshan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Tempal B'uncho was a male Twi'lek who had business on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.
Grrallo was a male Wookiee who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Kelson Sharphorn was a male Devaronian who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was part of a group of slicers that was based in a building not far from Nym's Stronghold, on the planet Lok. The group also included Skaelor Tay and Byd Chillings.

Skaelor Tay was a male Bothan who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was part of a group of slicers that was based in a building not far from Nym's Stronghold, on the planet of Lok. The group also included Kelson Sharphorn and Byd Chillings.

Byd Chillings was a male Ithorian who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was part of a group of slicers that was based in a building not far from Nym's Stronghold, on the planet Lok. The group also included Skaelor Tay and Kelson Sharphorn.
Eyd Tommsin was a Human male who operated out of the Endor Smuggler Outpost during the Galactic Civil War.
The Ice Cream Man was a Human male who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He had a droid named Otonon Tracks.
Xos was a Human Force-sensitive who was present on Mustafar during the time of the Galactic Civil War and was being hunted by the Inquisitorius of the Galactic Empire.
Lislot Bloodscar was a female Trandoshan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Aquillia was a female Twi'lek archaeologist who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, she was studying the culture of the Rak'qua, a Nautolan tribe that inhabited Station Gamma, an asteroid-carved space station in the Bright Jewel system.

Fiask Nidori was a male Aqualish chef who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he visited Station Gamma, an asteroid-carved space station in the Bright Jewel system in order to find a new kind of meat.

Zakar was a Yuuzhan Vong warrior during the Yuuzhan Vong War. In 25 ABY he fought on the uninhabitable planet Dibrook against New Republic troopers searching for refugees captured during the Battle of Dibrook.

Evan Strehk was a Human male Strehkforce commander who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He operated out of a Strehkforce camp outside of the city of Dee'ja Peak, in the Gallo Mountains, on the planet Naboo alongside Commander Maris Fahrs.

Maris Fahrs was a Human female Strehkforce commander who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She operated out of a Strehkforce camp outside of the city of Dee'ja Peak, in the Gallo Mountains, on the planet Naboo alongside Commander Evan Strehk.
Sul Prine was a male Human speeder bike racer who lived on the core world Talus during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he owned a house near the city of Dearic.
Strilath Farles was a Human male Meatlump criminal who lived in the Corellian system during the Galactic Civil War.
Xalox Guul was a Human male commander of the Galactic Empire who was based out of the Imperial Outpost on Talus during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Ceth Laike was a Human male Imperial officer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
MacDougal, also known as "Black Jack" MacDougal, was a Binayre pirate who lived in the Corellian system during the Galactic Civil War.
Hakasha Sireen was a Zabrak female who operated as an Imperial pilot trainer for Black Epsilon out of the Talus Imperial Outpost during the Galactic Civil War.
Prisk Kith'Vys was a Bothan who trained prospective Imperial pilots.

Sulale Kallor was a male starfighter ace who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Sulale and his brother Sulale were veteran Car'das pilots. In 1 ABY, they were stationed in the Bright Jewel system and flew Z-95 Headhunters.

Waris Kallor was a male starfighter ace who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Waris and his brother Sulale were veteran Car'das pilots. In 1 ABY, they were stationed in the Bright Jewel system and flew Z-95 Headhunters.
Terry was a male terrorist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he inhabited the Tansarii Point Station, in the Bright Jewel system.

Skar was a Dark Jedi who resided on Mustafar near Berken's Flow during the Galactic Civil War. She held a piece of a tablet sought by Epo Qetora. To retrieve this tablet, Epo Qetora enlisted the help of a spacer, who defeated Skar.
Talper was a male Bothan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Peshosloc was a holowright who lived between 15,762 BBY and 15,609 BBY. He was the author of Xim at Vontor and ninety-odd other holoplays written about Xim the Despot, included in the vast literary collaboration known as The Despotica. He wrote in Mid-Galactic Standard.
Alita Sweetwater was a female individual who was murdered by Blix Lanister in Anchorhead on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

A pirate captain encountered the Jedi Knight Zekk in 41 ABY. The Jedi found himself at her mercy while he tried to contact the Jedi Order and was unable to discern the pirate captain's agenda, who was loyal only to herself.
Cara Raeth was a Human female who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Vryim Raeth was a Human male who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Teniel Waray was a Human female Corellian Security Force agent who lived on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Crale Forte was a male Rodian elite councilor in the Chirq Council who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Atlan Dubreas was a male Trandoshan elite councilor in the Chirq Council who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Mathazar Zayet was a male Twi'lek elite councilor in the Chirq Council who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Rallyn Secura was a male Zabrak elite councilor in the Chirq Council who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Ruwan Tokai was a Human male technical sergeant of the Galactic Empire who was posted to the Great Temple of the Massassi on Yavin 4 during the Galactic Civil War.
Gins Darone was an Imperial Lieutenant Commander who operated out of the Massassi Temple during the Galactic Civil War.

Leger DeMain grew up on the planet Erysthes in the Corporate Sector. His parents worked as indentured harvesters on the chak-root farms, but the young Leger wanted to avoid their fate. He developed a plan to escape.

Snugli Explevey was a male Human Meatlump criminal who lived on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, he operated out of the Meatlump Hideout in Coronet City.

Joe was a male Human Meatlump who lived on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, he operated out of the Meatlump Hideout in Coronet City.

Balia Alloo was a Human Meatlump who lived on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Alloo operated out of the Meatlump Hideout in Coronet City.
Coptszt was a male Human Meatlump who lived on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Captain Coptszt resided in the Meatlump Hideout in Coronet City.

Newin Seedel was a Human Meatlump who lived on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Seedel operated out of the Meatlump Hideout beneath Coronet City.

Loman Vosso was a female Human Meatlump who lived on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, she was a captain of the technology-hating Meatlumps and operated out of the Meatlump Hideout in Coronet City.

Cyru Sarkee was a male Human Meatlump who lived on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he was a lieutenant of the technology-hating Meatlumps and operated out of the Meatlump Hideout in Coronet City.

Ximo Tacx was a male Human Meatlump who lived on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he was a decider of the technology-hating Meatlumps and operated out of the Meatlump Hideout in Coronet City.

Dorvin Kanu was a female Human Meatlump who lived on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, she was a lieutenant of the technology-hating Meatlumps and operated out of the Meatlump Hideout in Coronet City.

Gitchur Lumpback was a Human Meatlump who lived on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Lumpback operated out of the Meatlump Hideout in Coronet City.
Jaalib Rigel was a Human male environmentalist who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Hurley Klakk was a Human male Corellian Security Force agent who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Chun Solso was a Human male Corellian Security Force agent who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Dain Pax was a Human male Chirq Council sub-councilor who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Tettsel Anker was a female Zabrak Chirq Council sub-councilor who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Koran Lassk was a Human female Chirq Council elite councilor who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Markus Gilder was a female Zabrak Chirq Council elite councilor who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Braganti Hooge was a Human male Chirq Council elite councilor who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Zuld Mar-Shayal was a Human male Chirq Council elite councilor who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Janos Zarbo was a Human male Chirq Council elite councilor who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Phy Hudgen was a Human male Imperial contract worker who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Mirla was a Human female Imperial worker who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She worked in the Imperial Research Facility on the planet Dantooine known as the Warren. When chaos erupted in the Warren, Mirla's husband, another Imperial worker, was killed.
M'anx Try was a Human male Imperial researcher who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He worked in The Warren on the planet Dantooine.
Heff was a Human male Imperial captain who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Jerrd Sonclim was a Human male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he was hired by the Galactic Empire to guard a room in the Imperial Research Facility on the planet Dantooine known as The Warren.

Knag was a Human male doctor who worked for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. By the time following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Doctor Knag was posted as a researcher at the Warren, a top-secret Imperial Research Facility on the planet Dantooine.
Dirk Maggin was a Human male cyborg who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Dubbin Sharr was a male Gungan Muskeg zealot chief who operated outside of Theed on the planet Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Ados Jarkey was a male Twi'lek who lived on Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was the father of Fenrol and Hunnos Jarkey. His son Hunnos was a murderer wanted by the Royal Naboo Security Forces.

Harvin Franchels was a Human male and a Major in the Royal Security Force during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he was the RSF officer in charge of the situation during the terrorist attack in Theed.

Toff Henrou was a Human male Skaak Tipper who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was based in Theed where he was tasked to blackmail Hugo Eckener, the father of the indebted Karl.

Jorgellansel was a male Zabrak who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. He was an adjutant of the Darkwalkers gang. After the Battle of Yavin, he was based in Theed where he was tasked to blackmail Hugo Eckener, the father of the indebted Karl.
Colten was a Human male smuggler who operated out of Theed during the Galactic Civil War.

Dorian Janarus was a human male who was served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during a period when the Sith reigned over the galaxy. He replaced the interim chancellor Paran Am-Ris after being unanimously elected by the Galactic Senate.

Fekk was a Sullustan pirate who served under Captain Jet Nebula aboard the starship Auriga Fire. The ship originally worked for the Republic, but eventually the crew became more inclined to answer the Hutt Cartel.
Gelss was a Sullustan smuggler and pirate who was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Hunet L'Beck was a male Bimm bureaucrat who served the senator of Bimmisaari in the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.
Nikil Nobil was a male Thisspiasian Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as a member of the Jedi High Council during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Shinqo was a male Rodian smuggler who served as Jet Nebula's First Mate aboard the Auriga Fire during the Cold War.
Owal Sopil was a male smuggler who served Black Sun, one of the most feared criminal organizations in the galaxy.
Reik Sopil was the brother of Owal Sopil, a minor smuggler for Black Sun, one of the most feared criminal organizations in the galaxy.

Isis was a female Imperial governor. At some point after the Battle of Endor, Isis put a bounty of 50,000 credits on the pirate Feldrall Okor, who had been interfering with Imperial shipping within the sector the governor was based in.

Reagal Eron served as the adjutant to Imperial governor Isis. At some point after the Battle of Endor, Eron was present in Isis's office when the bounty hunter Boba Fett brought the pirate Feldrall Okor to Isis, whom the governor had put a bounty on.

Maulkiller was a hybrid clone created on the planet Kamino by Darth Vader, Dark Lord of the Sith. Maulkiller was created by combining genetic material from the Dathomirian Zabrak Sith apprentice Darth Maul and the deceased Human Galen Marek.
This Gamorrean farmer was working on her farm when Han Solo and Chewbacca arrived on a smuggling run.
A Sith was a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith around 44 ABY. During that year, the Sith was chosen to be part of a strike team assembled to capture the female dark side being Abeloth on her planet.
Darth Howl was a male Sith Master, Dark Lord of the Sith and a member of the Dark Council who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic.

A male being was a functionary in Finis Valorum's office in 33 BBY. He discovered that Staff Aide Sei Taria intended to buy a packet of information from a person in a Trade Federation brokerage house on Corulag, and that she was to send her team of "troubleshooters," who would…
Darth Chratis was a male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire who served the Imperial mission during the Cold War.
Hanna S'kiyah was a female Twi'lek who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, her sister was kidnapped by the Naboo pirates and kept prisoner for ransom.
Diness Imler was a Human female that lived during the Galactic Civil War. She resided in Theed on Naboo. She sometimes did favors for officers in the Royal Naboo Security Forces.
Tierce Martano was a Human male gambler who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Maximillian was a male Arcona who lived in Aurilia during the Galactic Civil War.
Kakirk was a female Mon Calamari Nexus collector who lived in Aurilia during the Galactic Civil War.

Appleton was a male Human Imperial Major and investigator who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was tasked with retaking the Star Destroyer Blackguard from the traitorous Imperial Captain and self-proclaimed Grand Admiral Andal Sait.
Thulough was a Rebel lieutenant intelligence officer who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He once went on a mission to Aurilia on the planet Dathomir.
Torvin was a male Gran who resided in Aurilia during the Galactic Civil War.
Wallaw Loowobbli was a male Ithorian naturalist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Loisya Starkos was a Human female who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she encountered a Force user wearing a Jedi robe at the Trade Outpost.

Subject 1157 was a clone of the Human male Galen Marek, the Sith Lord Darth Vader's apprentice. Subject 1157 was raised in a cloning tank at a cloning facility on the planet Kamino around 1 BBY by the Galactic Empire.

This clone trooper accompanied Jedi Knight Rii'ke En to the planet Honoghr, after engaging the Separatist Lucrehulk-class core ship Gahenna. They were searching for the Scientific Instrument Package, which contained data on the virus Trihexalophine1138.
Tahnchukka, nicknamed Tank, was a one-eyed male Wookiee smuggler who was the companion of the bounty hunter Crovan Dane.
Russell was a Human male who served as a leader in the criminal underworld during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Nirame Sakute was a male Rodian that lived during the Galactic Civil War. He served the Lok Revenants as a trainer and often worked with the Smugglers' Alliance. After the Battle of Yavin, Nirame was working from the cantina in the Trade Outpost on Dathomir.
Doogo was a male Rodian slythmonger who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Hal Horn tasked a spacer with meeting with him on Corellia.

Noren Krast was a Human male who worked for the Corellian Engineering Corporation and thought of himself as one of their "bigwigs" during the Galactic Civil War. He lived in Tyrena, a city on Corellia that was sympathetic to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Fugue was a male slicer who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Banyon Craddok was a Human male Corellian Security Force investigator who on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Jeter Corona was a male courier who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Joz Jodhul was a Human male individual that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Veega Madish was a male officer of the Rebel Alliance who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Cal Handro was a Human male smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Vekker was a member of the Imperial Intelligence who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Sergeant Vekker was serving under the orders of Lieutenant Jevan Monsul who was based in Bestine, on the planet Tatooine.
Jevan Monsul was a Human male Imperial officer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Moxxar Krieg was a male individual who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Krieg and Doctor Edvar Vang discovered the existence of a new kind of spice.
Karena Keer was a female Zabrak who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She worked for Shalera, a Hutt member of Black Sun and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Sinis was a Human male merchant who on Corellia lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Yorick was a Human male slicer who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
In 32 BBY, the Trade Federation invaded the planet of Naboo. One Human Naboo citizen, a tough-looking woman, fled into the swamps surrounding Naboo's Capital city, Theed.
Madison Silene was a Human female who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Osto Grissom was a male Human starship captain who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Edbr Yamagh was a male Human that lived on Corellia at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Jom Irimore was an officer in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Irimore was stationed in Tyrena, on the planet Corellia.
Bre'ano Umakk was a male Mon Calamari Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order before the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Quillara Adeen was a Human female Dark Jedi who existed during the time of the Galactic Civil War. By the time following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she guarded an old Jedi statue on the jungle moon of Yavin 4.
Aqzow was a Trandoshan male who served as Lieutenant Colonel and Rebel pilot trainer in the Havoc Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. He operated out of the Yavin 4 Labor Outpost.
J'pai Brek was a Human female Rebel pilot coordinator who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Doane Watki was a Human female who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. She was the podracer champion of the Valarian Syndicate.
Vinya Maysor was a Human female who worked for Viceprex Karrek Flim during the Galactic Civil War.
Isbel was a female Twi'lek smuggler who operated on Vreni Island on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Triggo Binz was a male Twi'lek thug who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Silm'an Voueen was a female Bothan spy who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Deela Quellor was a female spy who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Wizzel was a male Rodian majordomo who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Dagonel "Digger" Dimms was a male miner who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Palu Zerk was a Human female townsperson from Naboo's moon of Rori who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Feinu Zerk was a Human female townsperson from Naboo's moon of Rori who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Imo Vledmo, also known as S'lee, was a male Trandoshan who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Stanic Wavingstar was a male Twi'lek thug who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Jalen was a Human male smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Boulo Siesi was a female Bith artist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Siesi resided in the town of Wayfar on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine where she created three works of art, titled Golden Petals 1, 2, and 3.
Benton was a Human male smuggler fence who operated on Yavin 4 during the Galactic Civil War.
Ewrosa Soci was a male Twi'lek who operated out of the Yavin 4 Labor Outpost during the Galactic Civil War.
Eker was a major in the Rebel Alliance and a Rebel pilot trainer for the Crimson Phoenix Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Zelma was a Human female smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Jonna was a male individual that lived during the Galactic Civil War. He worked in Nagem Dr'Lar's salvage team, searching for debris of the destroyed Imperial Death Star in the jungles of Yavin 4.

Vanvi Hotne was a male Trandoshan artist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Hotbe resided in the city of Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine where he created four works of art, titled Blumbush, Boffa Plant, Mattberry Plant, and Ronka Plant.

Kahfr Oladi was a female Twi'lek artist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Oladi resided in the city of Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine where she created two works of art, titled Mon Calamari Eye 1 and Mon Calamari Eye 2.

Giaal Itotr was a male Zabrak artist and explorer who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Itotr resided in the city of Mos Espa on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine where he created two works of art, titled Krayt Dragon Skeleton and Lucky Despot Wreckage.

Klepa Laeel was a male Bothan artist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Laeel resided in the city of Mos Espa on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine where he created two works of art, titled Rainbow Berry Bush and Raventhorn Plant.
Klinn Innala was an individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Ting'ral Trin was an individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Sarvik Frey'nra was an individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Deehan was a Human female who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, a spacer dispatched by Binna Jode gave Deehan a toy to give to the children of a family injured by Imperial stormtroopers.
Maikeen Storn was a female who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Aroy Sekun was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Melios Purl tasked a spacer with escorting him.

Sev'eere'nuruodo, with the core name Veeren, was a female Chiss and Aristocra of the Nuruodo family during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, she communicated with the Galactic Republic's Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and agreed to meet a Republic representative in Chiss space.

Ravilan's aide, who was referred to as being "Yilanna" or "Illyana" by Seelah Korsin, was a Human female of the Lost Tribe of Sith who served as an aide for the Red Sith Ravilan Wroth around the year 4985 BBY.

Ando was the name of a clone trooper sergeant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic. In 21 BBY, during the Clone Wars, Ando was part of a battle group that was sent to the planet Kothlis to stop a Confederate invasion.
Kixiaralu, nicknamed Kixi for short, was a female Mirialan who lived on the Republic capital of Coruscant in the aftermath of the Great Galactic War.

Quillan, a male Human Sith, was the twin brother of Dromika and one of the youngest children of Sith Lord Chagras and the younger siblings of Arkadia Calimondra. During the New Sith Wars, Byllura was controlled by the Chagras Hegemony.
Dromika, a female Human Sith, was the twin sister of Quillan and one of the youngest children of the Sith Lord Chagras and the siblings of Arkadia Calimondra.
Arkadia Calimondra was a female Human Sith Lord who was the eldest daughter of Lord Chagras, and the older sister of Dromika and Quillan.

Jackson Farseeker was the grandfather of Jill Farseeker, and a retired Imperial captain. During the Galactic Civil War, Farseeker and his granddaughter traveled with her father, Roark Garnet, aboard his freighter Dorion Discus.

Jill Farseeker was the granddaughter of Jackson Farseeker and daughter of Roark Garnet. During the Galactic Civil War, she crewed aboard her father's freighter, Dorion Discus, alongside Garnet, Farseeker, and Tantos Dree.

This woman was the matriarch of the Datch family, which included Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot Tarrin Datch, his brothers, one sister, and their father. The Datch parents were the proprietors of Pellezara station, in the Duro system.

The father of Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot Tarrin Datch was a Human male. Datch also had brothers, one sister, and a mother. The Datch parents were the proprietors of Pellezara station, in the Duro system.

The kleptomaniac pilot was among the rejected pilot candidates for Wraith Squadron. A male Human from Etti IV, he was subject to a court-martial for theft when he interviewed with Wedge Antilles for a position in the Wraith Squadron.
Vuub was a female Neimoidian Senator in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Lema Xandret was a droid-maker affiliated with the reconsituted Sith Empire and the mother of Cinzia Xandret, a Sith apprentice.

Drev Jalok was a male captain and owner of the freighter Skyjumper which he operated with his Sullustan co-pilot Sullub Soonin. Jalok was ambushed en route to the planet Altier by Drek Drednar's pirate band. After a short skirmish, Jalok surrendered to Drednar.

Gadren was a Besalisk from Corellia. After his family was sold into slavery by the Galactic Empire, he joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic; serving in its 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company.
This Human Sith was one of five members of the One Sith who ambushed a group of Jedi on Daluuj in 137 ABY. He killed a Human female Jedi before being struck down by Wolf Sazen and Shado Vao.

Braganta was a Human female naturalist who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Braganta became concerned when a cargo vessel carrying illegal merchandise began leaking chemicals all over the landscape of Naboo, infecting a large percentage of local herbivores.
Silverline was a pilot and officer in the Starfighter Corps of the Galactic Empire during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Tarko was a baron associated with the planet Cato Neimoidia. After the Clone Wars, he bought a Sheathipede-class shuttle for personal use. He shared his name with Tarko-se, one of the cities on Cato Neimoidia.

Ia Nirvin was a male Human diplomat and envoy of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he was sent by the Empire to Nal Hutta, in order to bid on several items that were offered by the Hutts in an auction and came from a spaceship named Cinzia.
Ridil was a Communications officer who was stationed on the Esfandia Long-Range Communications Base, before and during the Battle of Esfandia.
Tolan Nokkar was a moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Hetchkee was a male Kel Dor Lieutenant who served in the military during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Stantorrs was a Duros male who served as the Supreme Commander of the Galactic Republic military during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Watcher Three was the call sign of a Human male Imperial Intelligence officer during the Cold War. Before joining the Intelligence, he managed HoloNet security for the Ministry of Logistics.
Shullis Khamarr was a female and the Minister of Logistics for the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War as late as 3643 BBY.
Donbar was a male sergeant in the Republic Military serving in the Republic Special Forces Division of Blackstar Squad in the years following the Treaty of Coruscant.
Tengrove was a Jedi Master and the Watchman of Kiffu's sector around the time of the Great Galactic War.
Robann Potannin was a male Humanoid who served as a Soldier in the Senate Security during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Damalia Korde was a Human female who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was interested in nature and biology. Korde had traveled to the city of Dee'ja Peak on Naboo to study the local wildlife and never left again because she liked the place very much.
Kima Nazith was a Human female that lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was an active member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and worked as a bodyguard for Pooja Naberrie.
Drenn Biktor was a Human male Imperial Army non-com who defected to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Vil Sembian was a male Twi'lek who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was the son of Daw Sembian, a famous weaponsmith who left him his schematic for a new type of blaster which could tip the scales in the Galactic Civil War.
Hlaano Dunlix was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Drillen Foyle was a Human male agent of the Imperial Security Bureau who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Egan Garrud was a Human male member of the Corellian Security Force who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Fadulk Di'keer was a male Bothan information broker who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kalia Kulmina was a female Zabrak bounty hunter who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Needia Solum was a female informant for the Rebel Alliance who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Gizda Ramani was a Human female from Coruscant who served as a pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Herosk Bal'far was a male Bothan who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Pooja Naberrie tasked a spacer with locating Bal'far and escorting him back to the city of Dee'ja Peak on Naboo.

Turon Adala was a Human male officer of the Royal Naboo Security Forces during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Pooja Naberrie tasked a spacer with locating Adala and escorting him back to the city of Dee'ja Peak on Naboo.

Lim Paddu was a female Gungan aristocrat during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Pooja Naberrie tasked a spacer with locating Paddu and escorting her back to the city of Dee'ja Peak on Naboo.
Melloc Fitzal was a male servant who lived on Naboo during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Boona Tanje was a female individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Reefa Been was a Human female individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, the male Gungan known as Rep Been tasked a spacer with locating Reefa Been in the Naboo countryside, and escorting her back to Rep Bee…
Vajoo Jinssa was a Human male stormtrooper commander who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Jaanie was a Human female handmaiden for Queen Kylantha of Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Yith Seenath was a female Zabrak Rebel sergeant who operated out of a camp on Yavin 4 during the Galactic Civil War.
Eso was a male Trandoshan captain of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who conducted combat activities out of a camp in the Val'Arnos Jungle on Yavin 4 during the Galactic Civil War.
Jeremes Kelton was a Veteran Rebel Army Captain who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Tamvar Senzen was a Human male who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was present in a hotel in the city of Kaadara, on the planet Naboo.
Bardo Klinj was a Human male criminal who lived on the planet Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
Dilvin Lormurojo was an author that resided in Moenia during the Galactic Civil War.

Ronin Lightrunner was a male Mon Calamari biologist who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he worked at the Moenia University, in the city of Moenia, and studied the veermoks.

Bor Ting was a male individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He worked as a courier on the planet Naboo. In 1 ABY he was sent to Dee'ja Peak to deliver a datadisc to Damalia Korde that contained information about the Berserker Virus.
Faleera Tuhlnya was a female Selonian separatist who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Jermo Tharrn was a male thug who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Tormyll Fassoola was a male slicer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Preedu III was the ruler of the planet Tamban prior to the rise of Palpatine's Galactic Empire.
Maytoc Kollene was a one-legged male Human and the captain of the VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug Worthless Fool.

Dwin Wisheel was the Rayter sector's Fleet Supervisor in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He took delivery of the VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug Worthless Fool after it was purchased by a young procurement officer from Yearo Seville.

The clone Cinzia Xandret was created on Sebaddon by Lema Xandret, the mother of the original Cinzia, after she had been taken by the Sith Empire for Sith training. Lema Xandret also created hex combat droids to protect her cloned daughter at all costs.

Drossh was a Trandoshan smuggler who lived during the Clone Wars. He and his partner, Rezzo, were smuggling weapons when they had a disagreement, and accidentally set off an explosive, killing both of them in the blast.
Droog was a Hutt purser who worked in Tassaa Bareesh's palace on Nal Hutta in 3643 BBY. That year, Shigar Konshi and Larin Moxla bribed him to allow them admission to the palace.

Yeama was a male Twi'lek enslaved by the Hutt crime lord Tassaa Bareesh in 3643 BBY. That year, he served as a guide to two visitors to Bareesh's palace; Sith apprentice Eldon Ax and Sith envoy Ia Nirvin.

Akshae Shanka was a male Mandalorian donned with silver and blue Mandalorian armor and a notorious bounty hunter who operated out of Nal Hutta around 3643 BBY. He was greatly feared by the populace of Nal Hutta, and had come in second in two separate Great Hunts.
Encaasa Bareesh was a junior nephew of Hutt crime lord Tassaa Bareesh. Bareesh oversaw the security detail of a spaceport on Nal Hutta in 3643 BBY.
Sagrillo was a Twi'lek employee of Hutt crime lord Tassaa Bareesh in 3643 BBY.

Pedisic was a female specialist in the Sith military during the Cold War. Around the year 3643 BBY, Pedisic and Sith Acolyte Eldon Ax were called to the Paramount in order to extract information from the memory of a hex droid.
Kalisch was a male colonel who served in the Sith fleet during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he served on the bulk cruiser Paramount and was one of the commanders who fought in the Battle of Sebaddon.
Pipalidi was a female Anx captain in the Galactic Republic navy during the Cold War. She was in command of the cruiser Commenor when she fought against the hex droids at Sebaddon.

Ses Jopp was a male Zabrak soldier in the Galactic Republic military during the Cold War. Jopp held a hatred of Larin Moxla, calling her "Toxic Moxla." However, when dispatched to Sebaddon to help eradicate the hex droids, he assisted Moxla and befriended her.

Nahrung was a male soldier in the Galactic Republic military during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he and several other soldiers were called to Sebaddon to eliminate an army of hex droids that planned to to wipe out the entire galaxy.
Ozz was a soldier in the Sith military during the Cold War.
Mond was a male sergeant who served in the military during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Adamek was a female lieutenant in the Sith military who lived during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Around 3643 BBY, she participated in the Battle of Sebaddon against the witch-produced hex droids.

"Dr. Green" was the codename for a scientist working in Grand Admiral Thrawn's lab on a Sith–Jedi hybrid. Dr. Green was killed when the Sith–Jedi clones turned mad and killed everyone in the lab. The Doctor's corpse was still present in the lab as of 41.5 ABY.

A female Twi'lek bodyguard protected Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian in the Bespin settlement of Cloud City. In 1 ABY, she accompanied Calrissian to the city's maintenance levels, after the bounty hunter Bossk had sent a fake emergency report to lure him into a trap.

A chief engineer worked in Cloud City, the tibanna mining colony above the planet Bespin. In 1 ABY, Dominic Raynor gambled away the city in a game of sabacc against Lando Calrissian, who became the new Baron Administrator.

This very old Jedi was the Jedi Master of Shayoto. This Jedi lived many centuries, and his master lived for hundreds of years as well, having lived through the Hundred-Year Darkness in 7000 BBY and the Great Hyperspace War two thousand years later.

During the Galactic Civil War, an undercover agent worked for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Some time after the Battle of Yavin, that agent was as tasked with locating a hidden droid factory on the planet Tatooine, where the Galactic Empire had developed a new series o…

A salesman worked as a starship merchant. He claimed to have a slightly used starship in peak condition with less than a 1,000 light-years of use for sale for 25,000 credits. He told prospective buyers not to worry about the corrosion on the power cables.
Dram Parkins was a male gambler. During the Galactic Civil War, Parkins traveled aboard a starship and frequented its sabacc table.
Green Laser was a male Drall that lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Hodor was a male baron of the planet Teyr. He was thought to have been the inventor of Pikatta Pie.
Harmon Vintollo was a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. He was stationed at Kaadara on Naboo and oversaw an operation at the Geonosian Bio-Lab on Yavin 4.

This individual was a member of the Agee species, living on Coruscant. In 17 ABY, it was present in the Crystal Jewel casino when the establishment was rocked by the Bombing of the Senate Hall. The Agee was stuck on a collapsing portion of the ceiling until Han Solo rescued it.

This individual was a female Agee. She visited the anteroom of Chief of State Mon Mothma in 17 ABY, but quickly left after the astromech droid R2-D2 made a shrill sound in response to something his counterpart C-3PO was about to say.
A trooper served with the Rebel Alliance as a soldier stationed at Echo Station 3-8 on the ice planet Hoth in 3 ABY.
A resistance fighter was stationed at a Naboo resistance base during the course of the Trade Federation's Invasion of Naboo in the year 32 BBY.
Atlee Thanda was a male Zygerrian slaver and leader of the Thanda clan who was apprehended by a group of spacers.

Dr. Vacca was a doctor who helped to develop the Dead Eye Prototype. During its production, he was in a dilemma concerning whether he should give the formula to the Rebellion or to the Empire, the latter of which killed his family in the Destruction of Alderaan.
Ott Klemp was a member of the Rebel Alliance who served in the Scavenger Squadron around 4 ABY.
A prisoner was a member of the Brigian species. He was an assassin until interred in the prison world Despayre. There, he became infamous for killing a virevol with only a stick.

Narsk Ka'hane was a male Bothan spy during the Republic Dark Age who worked as an independent operator, serving several different Sith Lords within the Calimondra family including Odion, Arkadia Calimondra, and the family matriarch Vilia Calimondra.

A Human female lived in the settlement of Anchorhead on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine. She was aged by the time of the Battle of Yavin, and she wore a metallic sun shawl to protect herself from the twin suns of the Tatoo system.
Wonn Uzalg was a Rebel Alliance attaché during the Battle of Endor.
A clone trooper served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
This Senator represented the planet Nyny in the New Republic Senate in the year 17 ABY. He was killed in the Bombing of the Senate Hall.
The Elder of Kadnessi was the senior member of the Kadnessi family, a ruling family from Kuat around 4 ABY. He had given an oath of loyalty to the Elder of Knylenn many years before that.

Rovan Tresario was the founder of House Tresario, a group of bounty hunters loyal to the Bounty Hunters' Guild and one of the ten houses that the Guild was comprised of. Tresario was also a high-ranking Imperial aristocrat and an officer in the Imperial Navy.
Ruceba Ahid was a male Human smuggler who, along with his accomplices, Stu Hemphawar and Oejoe Hitewa, worked out of a tiny apartment close to the Entertainment District of Coruscant.
The Elder of Knylenn was the eldest and most respected member of the Knylenn family, a ruling family of the planet Kuat.
This male Human was a Tarisian noble. Among his ancestors was a member of one of the founding houses of the planet Taris.
Lile Gorsek was a scout. Gorsek scouted Yavin 4 on behalf of Wetyin's Colony.
Mase was a Zabrak male who led the Wolf Squadron Rebel unit during the Galactic Civil War.
Cal was a Human male who was part of the Wolf Squadron Rebel unit during the Galactic Civil War.
Marny was a Twi'lek female who was part of the Wolf Squadron Rebel unit during the Galactic Civil War.

Elliah Fel was a female Human who was Empress of the Fel Empire ruled by Emperor Roan Fel, with whom she had a daughter, Marasiah Fel. Her brother, the Imperial Knight Hogrum Chalk, characterized both mother and daughter as warriors who sacrificed much for the Empire.
Jerbhen Hulis was a male Miraluka Jedi Master who lived during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War.

Marca was part of the FarStar crew during the search for Imperial Moff Kentor Sarne. During the attempt to defeat DarkStryder and Sarne, Marca was attacked by a Maoi that had been confined to sickbay.

Gorlan Palladane was a former Human male Jedi who stayed on Chelloa after the Sith conquest in order to help his people, living as a relief worker and miner. On Chelloa, he married Roah with whom he had two children, Aneese and Jalen.
The α-foreman was the chief foreman at the Kuat Drive Yards construction docks. Answering only to the head of KDY, there was only one α-foreman and hundreds of β-supervisors.
Clarrisa was a Human female who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, a companion of hers took her on a surprise vacation to Mustafar.
Mattac was an outlaw technician who grew up on Nar Shaddaa, and eventually took a job with a local smuggler. After escaping an Imperial

Dovin Maur was an old man who claimed to have survived the beginning of the New Order and Emperor Palpatine's destruction of the Jedi. Maur revered the Jedi and after relocating to Lazerian IV, he did not reveal the location of the Jedi ruins on the continent of Laz.

Nistola was the Imperial governor of the planet Basilisk during the few years following the Battle of Endor. When forces of the New Republic invaded the planet, Nistola surrendered after the Katarn Commandos infiltrated his heavily armed flying fortress.
Garret was a general in the New Republic Defense Force in the years following the Battle of Endor. He commanded a siege of the planet Basilisk, which was under Imperial control.
Marjan Neuvalis was one of the managers of House Neuvalis.
Feras Neuvalis was one of the managers of House Neuvalis.
Gratina Renliss was a Human female bounty hunter who co-founded House Renliss, an all-female chapter of the Bounty Hunters' Guild, with her sister Jalindas Renliss.
Jalindas Renliss was a human female cyborg bounty hunter who acted as one of the managers of House Renliss alongside her sister Gratina Renliss.
Mazara was a female Falleen journalist who lived in the capital city of the planet Falleen. She was the leader of a group that led protests against large corporations and their business practices.

Bross was a starfighter pilot in the New Republic's Gold Squadron, and the wingmate of Wing Commander Greni. Both were shot down during a battle over Hettsk, which was located in the Borderland Regions.

Coruscant was the nickname given to a tall, blond-haired Human who was held prisoner on Selvaris by the Yuuzhan Vong in 29 ABY. The nickname referred to his homeworld, as many of the prisoners were referred to by such rather than their name.

In 29 ABY, three Bith prisoners at a Yuuzhan Vong facility on Selvaris went by the nickname Clak'dor in reference to their homeworld, Clak'dor VII. Many of the prisoners were referred to by such rather than their name.

In 29 ABY, three Bith prisoners at a Yuuzhan Vong facility on Selvaris went by the nickname Clak'dor in reference to their homeworld, Clak'dor VII. Many of the prisoners were referred to by such rather than their name.

In 29 ABY, three Bith prisoners at a Yuuzhan Vong facility on Selvaris went by the nickname Clak'dor in reference to their homeworld, Clak'dor VII. Many of the prisoners were referred to by such rather than their name.
During the Battle of Yuuzhan'tar at the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War in 29 ABY, Bacta Squad, a unit of Judder Page's Katarn Commandos, battled Yuuzhan Vong warriors near Shimrra's Citadel.

A Sith trooper was a member of the Sith Lord Darth Krayt's Sith trooper army in 138 ABY. Highly sensitive to the Force, the trooper was physically augmented and improved by Krayt for decades beneath the surface of the planet Korriban and forged into an unquestionably loyal ser…
The Human woman Gana Lavin's father, whom the younger Lavin referred to as "Daddy," was a powerful man who lived during the Jedi Civil War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

A Shashay individual was a scout pilot who crash-landed her starship on Kashyyyk circa 8 BBY. The native Wookiees repaired the ship and she paid them with an evening of music. The natural talent for music of the Shashay species was then discovered.
A female Sith apprentice served under Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Howl, but was replaced by Eldon Ax after Howl became dissatisfied with her. According to Darth Howl she liked to keep pets.
Gerald was a male Sullustan who was paired up with a loved one during the Ewok Festival of Love.
Stec Eddis was a member of the Renatasian Confederation, a vigilante organization made up of natives of the Renatasia system, looking to avenge the conquest of their home by the Galactic Empire.
Mors Eth was a member of the Renatasian Confederation, a vigilante organization made up of natives of the Renatasia system, looking to avenge the conquest of their home by the Galactic Empire.
Glee Jun was a member of the Renatasian Confederation, a vigilante organization made up of natives of the Renatasia system, looking to avenge the conquest of their home by the Galactic Empire.

Kenow was a Human male who served as part of the Renatasian Confederation during the era of the Galactic Civil War. Kenow grew up on a farm in the Renatasia system, before joining military service in time to serve in the bloody Battle of the Rood.

A Mon Calamari Jedi participated in the Clone Wars. Early in the war, in 22 BBY, they were in charge of a Galactic Republic blockade of the planet Valahari, operating from the Venator-class Star Destroyer Majestic.
Urlik was a Human male Valahari who lived during the Clone Wars. He was killed by a Mon Calamari Jedi during the Battle of Valahari.
Yeesre Mee was a Gran and the lead investigator of the events involved in the death of Senator Aks Moe shortly before the Clone Wars.

Dana Meimonda was a female actress from the planet Dakshee. After the subjugation of her homeworld by the Galactic Empire she and her husband escaped to Esseles. There, she entertained Imperial troops and was also a spy for the Rebel Alliance.

t: Unidentified Hutt crime lord (Aayla Secura's master)
x: This Hutt crime lord resided on Ryloth prior to the Invasion of Naboo. Although the Hutt illegally bought a trafficked wampa as a guard animal, the creature ended up killing the crime lord and would have killed one of the Hutt's slaves, Aayla Secura, had Jedi Padawan Quinlan V…
Williar Barrog was the captain of the Imperial cruiser Kana's Steel.
Sahreel was an Imperial Admiral under the orders of Moff Nile Owen aboard the Star Destroyer Impending Doom.
Shoan Kilian was a human Corellian male officer who held the rank of Admiral in the Galactic Republic Navy during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A bodyguard was employed by the Galactic Republic senator Bezz Drexx sometime during the span of an intergalactic event known as the Clone Wars. The bodyguard was the only known member of Drexx's security force that was not a Klatooinian.

Meldark was a male Human who proclaimed himself the preeminent information broker on Level 35 of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the reign of the New Republic. He spent a good deal of time at the Dark Melody bar, where the spice variation, tempest, was actively discussed.
Brianna was a Human Jedi apprentice who served as a crew member of the freighter Blind Luck during the Galactic Civil War.
Thulian Merast was an Imperial Navy captain who commanded the Eradicator during the beginning years of the New Republic.

Bruce Mercy was a near-Human male space smuggler from a high-gravity world, who was associated with three other smugglers: Morph, Durquist, and Ptak-Sok. Mercy's ship, the Black Widow acted as their command ship.
Morph was a Polydroxol smuggler who was associated with three other smugglers: Bruce Mercy, Durquist, and Ptak-Sok.
Durquist was a Conjeni smuggler pilot who was associated with three other smugglers: Bruce Mercy, Morph, and Ptak-Sok.
Ptak-Sok was a Arachnoid smuggler mechanic who was associated with three other smugglers: Bruce Mercy, Morph, and Durquist.
Plako was a Chikarri mechanic who knew the location of the legendary ship Fool's Gold. Bruce Mercy and his pirate band attempted to steal this information.
Yem Nemnin was a Kel Dor assassin. He was known for his unique method of killing his victims, by using his own antiox breath mask to poison them to death.
This individual was a member of the Revwien species. It had a green body and a yellow seed case. It was present on Tatooine in 0 BBY outside Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.
This individual was a member of the Revwien species. It had purple skin. It was present in a space-freighter's hangout in 1 ABY at which time Han Solo was engaged in a bar-brawl.
This individual was a member of the Revwien species. It was present on Fornax Station, observing the Five Fire Rings of Fornax, sometime between 2 BBY and 1 BBY.

Dongal Tezrin was the male captain of the Bayonet-class light cruiser Rintonne's Flame. He was assigned to patrol the Elrood sector during the Rebellion era. He was said to be a very irritable person.
Kader Tentrata was a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy in command of the GAT-12j Skipray blastboat Greetbos. He was assigned to patrol the Elrood sector during the Galactic Civil War.

Darvis Tret was an Imperial lieutenant sent to investigate the Elrood sector during the Rebellion era. After six months of observation, he recommended, in his report, to seize and occupy the planet Derilyn, and establish a naval base there.
Frenil Alagar was an Alliance to Restore the Republic representative sent to investigate the Elrood sector during the Galactic Civil War.

An individual was the Padawan of Jedi Master Toluz Cheq during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Cheq's fleet of Venator-class Star Destroyers was attacked in the Rial Kroon system by modified Confederate Vulture droid starfighters.

Quar Rohk was a male Trandoshan thief-for-hire that lived and operated during the Clone Wars. He was present at the Battle of Teth, attempting to steal crystalline vertex from the B'omarr Monastery on the Outer Rim planet Teth.

This youngling lived on the planet Teth around the time of the Clone Wars. He was present at the B'omarr Monastery during the Battle of Teth, and encountered the Trandoshan thief-for-hire Quar Rohk, who was attempting to steal a Crystalline vertex from the monastery, as well a…
Peder was a Human youngling from Teth. He was friends with another youngling from Teth. In 22 BBY, Peder was present at the Battle of Teth.
Alrym II was the male governor of the planet Lanthrym. He was a plain looking, spindly man. Alrym II did not go anywhere without his six Gamorrean guards and his two female companions.

Devron Zal was Chief Contractor Liaison for Radell Mining Corporation, he was in charge of hiring temporary and contract employees. He joined Radell at an early age as a prodigy, and rocketed to his position as Chief Contractor Liaison.

Lud Chud was a Rakaan gangster boss who settled on the planet Torina. Lud had influence, property and henchmen throughout the Elrood sector but it concentrated its activities on Torina, Lanthrym and Elrood.
"Blue Six" was the call sign of a clone trooper pilot who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he was killed during the Second battle of Valahari.

Erisi Dlarit's uncle was the brother of Aerin Dlarit and the uncle of Erisi Dlarit. He was a prominent investigator with the Xucphra Corporation bacta company on Thyferra, and discovered a contamination the Ashern rebels introduced into Lot ZX1449F.

Elmyo was a Human male who worked as a new recruit for the planet Atzerri's Air Traffic Control in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 22 BBY, he and his Gotal associate intercepted the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett's ship after he entered Atzerri's atmosphere.
A Gotal male worked as a traffic controller for the planet Atzerri's Air Traffic Control during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Kang was a Rigellian who rescued the human Maggie Simpson from a fleet of TIE/ln space superiority starfighter along with Kodos.
A librarian was employed at a library within the Theed Royal Palace on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War, sometime after the Battle of Yavin.
This Er'stacian soldier was a member of a clan of Er'stacians whose warriors were distinguished by their red armor.

An individual was the first Padawan of Jedi Knight Daakman Barrek and served the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order. Their master successfully trained them to Knighthood and later took on a new Padawan, Sha'a Gi.
Wanuri was a Falleen who worked as an employment officer for the Blackwater Systems corporation on the planet Falleen.

Grea, also known as Grea the Orfite, was a female Orfite bounty hunter who operated in the Elrood sector. She used her highly developed sense of smell to track people. She owned a custom built starship, the Neverquit.
This Bilar was killed when the Kerestian bounty hunter Milacass flew into a fit of rage after he had lost a hand of sabacc with a gambler from Oseon VII.
Shep Contopault was a male Human living on Naboo during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY. He was known as a criminal to the Sector Rangers, and served as a confidential informant.

Nalia was a female Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul living during the war against Zakuul. For three years she was a neighbor to a man named Arron until she was arrested as the enemy of Zakuul.
Keanna Li'kyna was a Human female secretary to Victor Visalis who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Wetram Farege was a Human male who worked for the Iskalloni after the Battle of Endor.

Kood Gareeda was a male Rodian comedian, who operated throughout the Outer Rim Territories during the Imperial era and was one of a string of owners of the Cybot Galactica LE-series repair droid LE-BO2D9, nicknamed Leebo, after the droid was stolen from the portmaster at Essel…

Minnix was a male Trandoshan drug dealer based on Nar Shaddaa. He spent his time in Kuzbar's Cantina waiting for clients to whom he sold common drugs and tempest spice. Addicted to the spice himself, he purchased most of his supply from dealers in the Dark Melody tapcafe.

In 20 ABY, this individual worked at the Reflection Gardens on Coruscant. A Human woman, she spotted two suspicious looking men (Imperial commandos Chik Apla and Chala Venan) among the trees several days before the Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade.
Trap was a clone trooper who served as a Clone Lieutenant in Tango Company during the Clone Wars.
Knuckles was the nickname of a Human male clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic's 182nd Legion during the Clone Wars.
Recon was the nickname of a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic's 182nd Legion.

Chatter was the name of a clone trooper with the Grand Army of the Republic's 182nd Legion. During the early years of the Clone Wars, he participated in a reconnaissance mission to the planet Belgaroth, along with fellow troopers Recon, Knuckles, and Sergeant Marrt.

Reep Tonith was a male Muun and a member of the influential Tonith family. During the Clone Wars, he was secretly supplied with weaponry by Tarin, a treacherous head of the Galactic Republic Czerka factory on the planet Belgaroth.
Yan So was a Kaminoan who oversaw the education of young clones in Tipoca City on the planet Kamino.

Gorrga was a Mandalorian at the time of the occupation of the planet Taris by the Mandalorians. In 3963 BBY, they left a Davaab-type starfighter on top of the Highport Banking Tower but the craft was soon pushed over the side of the building by Koblus Sornell to make way for a…
