A clone trooper pilot was a member of Gold Squadron, a Republic Navy starfighter unit, during the Clone Wars. Piloting a V-19 Torrent starfighter, the clone trooper participated in a battle in the Both system in 22 BBY.
Moorlu was a bounty hunter who attempted to kill Boba Fett in an ambush during the search for Bornan Thul. However, he failed and was killed by Fett instead.
Morgo was a young Kalarban boy who was helped by droids Q-E and 2-E before they exposed Vuldo's blaster plans.
Nigella Mure was a Human female captain who served in the Desrini Rescue Ops on Coruscant during the Separatist Crisis.

"Jen" was the name given to a male Jenet slave owned by the crime lord Bwahl the Hutt. The Jenet was presented to Bwahl by the Hutt's servant, Lotkha. Although the Jenet resisted the new moniker at first, he eventually came to accept it—out of fear, according to Bwahl.
Murra was a Ysanna tribesman on Ossus who aided Okko in an attempt to defeat Luke Skywalker and Kam Solusar when they first arrived on the planet.

Bowdaar was a male Wookiee slave forced by his masters into becoming a gladiatorial fighter in arenas spanning the galaxy. His prowess as a warrior and undefeated record earned him the names "The Killer from Kashyyyk," "Deathmountain," and "Boneshatterer."
Varn was the chief scout of the Serpent Masters, a group of lizard-riding bandits that ruled the barren world of Ophideraan, and the right-hand man of Supreme Serpent Master Tyrann.
Iych-thae was the Ithorian commander of the Varnay, a Shepherd-class Herdship.
Salem Victory was a male smuggler and mercenary that was considered the leader of the Happy Blasters. He and his group traveled around the galaxy aboard the starship Starcat.

Jaanu was a female witch-like minion of the Sith Lord and Separatist leader Count Dooku who lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic. She wielded twin red-bladed lightsabers and piloted a skiff.
Jaeth was a smuggler who worked as a dockhand on the moon Pinett during the first years of the Galactic Civil War.

A Human commander was in charge of Desolation Station, a facility that supplied the Imperial Death Star superweapon project. When the facility was destroyed by the Rebel Alliance, the commander was blamed and executed for the incident by the project's overseer, X1.
Christoph Jam was a male Alderaanian who was the owner and operator of Descorp. He maintained one of the largest spy networks on the planet, with a majority of the information focusing on criminals.
Hen Jamos was a male Human who earned a living as a merchant during the Galactic Civil War.
Janvar Jan was a middle-aged male scoundrel and confidence artist who founded the Cularin Star Tours in the Cularin system.

Janah was a female pirate who served aboard the freighter, Jynni's Virtue, captained by Naz Felyood. During an attempt to escape an Imperial patrol, the freighter and its crew crash-landed on Korriban.

Lorimar Lebauer was a male Jenet, uncle of Ludlo Lebauer, and the leader of the Invisible Shell, a criminal organization. He was also a wanted bacta counterfeiter. At some point, Ludlo took over in his place as head of the Invisible Shell.

Alto Janss was a female Human smuggler who often visited Tolea Biqua, in orbit over Genarius, during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. She was frequently found in the Near Vacuum Cantina in the company of her two lieutenants, who also acted as her bodyguards.

A Ryn member of the Ryn Network aided Han Solo, Leia Organa Solo, Tahiri Veila, and several of their friends on Galantos in 28 ABY. He later reported to Droma, the leader of the network, giving positive feedback about Veila.
Jarin was a male Human and a criminal active on the planet Edan II during the Galactic Civil War.

Trent Jaspar was a Force-sensitive male who discovered his ability with the Force shortly before the Battle of Yavin. In an effort to find a teacher, he joined the Rebel Alliance and was assigned to Edan Base after the attack by the Imperial Star Destroyer Havoc.

Jauxson was the Gotal captain of a gang of pirates who operated on the planet Clak'dor VII. After serving with various pirate crews throughout the galaxy from childhood, Jauxson split off to form his own band.
Ivhin Jayme was a male commando who served in the Imperial Army on Merikon before defecting to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Lexi Fernandin was an Human male explorer who ran Fernandin Scouting Expedition, a scouting company during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. After the Battle of Yavin he led a team to explore the Yavin system.
Blake was a Rebel who was at Echo Base during the Battle of Hoth, and later became a general in the New Republic.

Jeffers was a colonel in the Imperial Army. At one point between 19 BBY and 9 BBY, Colonel Jeffers served as an aide to General Irrv during the Galactic Empire's attempt to occupy the planet Culroon III.

Jengus was a Jawa who left Tatooine with his family after an entire Jawa clan was eliminated by an Imperial stormtrooper. Hoping to join his nephew Squig, the family was stranded at Cordel Cove on Neftali due to starship repairs.
As member of the Muunilinst 10, this ARC trooper lieutenant participated in the Mission to Hypori, where he was sent to rescue the surviving Jedi Knights from General Grievous.

This unnamed Gand was a bounty hunter who tried to collect the bounty on Connor Freeman, a Human who owed a lot of credits to a powerful crime lord named Tayand. The bounty hunter tracked Freeman to a bar, who was sleeping on the bar's counter.
This female Human was married to a clone deserter from the planet Kamino and the mother of Connor Freeman.
Gilean was a male Muun who served as Boba Fett's banker, handling his financial and bounty assignments.
A Kadas'sa'Nikto was one of several of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's men who traveled with Ki-Adi-Mundi into the Jundland Wastes in search of the lost Jedi Sharad Hett.

This ARC Trooper Lieutenant participated in the Mission to Hypori along with the rest of the Muunilinst 10, where the ARC Troopers were sent to rescue the surviving Jedi Knights from General Grievous.
An unidentified thug was one of several of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's men who traveled with Ki-Adi-Mundi into the Jundland Wastes in search of the lost Jedi Sharad Hett.

This Gotal assassin was a criminal living on Nar Shaddaa in 31 BBY. He pretended to be a Jedi to fool Quinlan Vos, whom he intended to kill. Vos, with the aid of Vilmarh Grahrk, saw through his disguise and killed the Gotal in a lightsaber duel.

This Mandallian Giant assassin was a criminal living on Nar Shaddaa in 31 BBY. He pretended to be a Jedi to fool Quinlan Vos whom he intended to kill. Vos, with the aid of Vilmarh Grahrk, saw through his disguise and killed him with a blaster.

Tallov Kersk was a Human male settler and farmer on the planet Muzara. He came to the planet with his family—his wife, his brother-in-law Karn, his sister, his son Vettle, and his niece Cavvie—in 4000 BBY.
Number Two was the callsign of the second in command aboard Captain Cautious's freighter. He disliked working under Captain Cautious and regularly complained about him to his colleagues.

Tayand was a male Sakiyan crimelord who operated from a base on the planet Cilare. Connor Freeman bet his inheritance in a game of Sabacc against him and won, but Tayand, unwilling to accept defeat, claimed Freeman cheated and sent his men after Freeman, who escaped, but witho…
Jergo was a Kubaz male who earned a living as an information broker in Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine.

A Human male was a clone of the bounty hunter Jango Fett and was part of the clone army being developed for the Galactic Republic on the planet Kamino. Having no desire to be a soldier, the clone escaped from the planet to live a life of his own.

Jerru was a male Ithorian craftsman who was highly skilled in the ancient craft of plant-forming. Jerru plied his trade aboard the Ithorian Herdship, Bazaar, where he additionally acted as a front for Poliss, a Rebel recruiter.
During the Jedi Civil War, a Human male Republic soldier was a crew member of the Hammerhead-class cruiser Endar Spire.
An individual in a blue tunic was one of several of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's men who traveled with Ki-Adi-Mundi into the Jundland Wastes in search of the lost Jedi Sharad Hett.

Lajaie was a human male who served in the Alliance Military during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire, first serving as a major within the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Massassi Group, and subsequently serving as a naval commander and commanding officer of…
Jezzable was a strikingly beautiful Human female who was often seen touring the bars in Celanon City on Celanon.

Tirgee Benyalle was a Human female who worked as a crime boss on Kaal and used her control of the illegal gambling operations on the planet to take control of Kaal in the wake of the Galactic Empire's withdrawal.

Eaden Vrill was a male Nautolan who served as co-pilot on Dash Rendar's Outrider. Along with the rest of the crew Vrill was hired to protect Javul Charn from her stalker. Vrill was killed by an assassin called Edge sent after Charn by the Galactic Empire.
Javul Charn was a Human female holostar and member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

In 22 BBY, the actress, a protester of the Clone Wars, starred in a holovid entitled Republic Medcenter. Their performance and the film itself were given negative reviews by Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and Senator Padmé Amidala.
Tyla Jinn was a Human female criminal who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.

Rorak was a male individual who lived on the planet Coruscant during the Galactic Civil War. He was present, along with his son Jak, in Monument Plaza after the Battle of Endor, when Coruscanti citizens toppled a statue of Darth Sidious, the fallen sovereign ruler of the Galac…
Jjerrol was a male criminal on Tatooine during the first years of the Galactic Empire.
Wheade Daud was a male Quarren demolitions man on the planet Lianna. He was employed as a thug by the Chevin club owner, Orman.

Xasha (nicknamed "X") was a female bounty hunter who, in 1 BBY, lived with Boba Fett on Nar Shaddaa and wore a customized armored-suit composed of pieces from both Mandalorian and clone trooper armor.

Puko Naga was a Nikto who worked for Jabba the Hutt during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Puko Naga along with another guard greeted and accompanied Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi into Jabba's Palace so he could negotiate with Jabba an agreement between the Hutts and the Republic.

Adon'aris was a male Twi'lek thug who was employed by the club owner Orman on the planet Lianna. He was considered quite handsome but had few other interesting qualities and in battle preferred stealth to open combat knowing his physical limitations.

Sandi was a female Human and con artist on the planet Lianna. She was trying to make a name for herself through the club owner Orman whom she worked for as a thug, however few of his other employees took her seriously.
A clone trooper was part of the 212th Attack Battalion and ventured to the catacombs of Geonosis during the Second Battle of Geonosis.

D'Trel B'Rar Jok was a female Gorothite, native to Goroth Prime, who was the Rel'Kan of her people. Although she was little more than a figurehead, she used all of her available power to help the Gorothites during the Galactic Civil War.
Joli was a member of the Scavenger Young on the planet Melida/Daan. During the Young–Elders War, he and Deila informed Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi of Mawat's treachery.

Jolsz was a male pirate aboard the freighter, Jynni's Virtue, captained by Naz Felyood. During an attempt to escape an Imperial patrol, the freighter and its crew crash-landed on Korriban. Not long after, Jolsz was killed by Korriban zombies and his corpse was reanimated.

Fish was a human male thug who worked for the club owner Orman on the planet Lianna. He was the newest of Orman's thugs and was rather small and wiry, making him rather unintimidating. He also lacked co-ordination, strength and common sense and was generally unpopular.
Tanith Sorn was a female Human who served as a Lieutenant Commander in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Bail Antilles was an alias that was used by a male individual during the Galactic Civil War.

Duroc was a male Gamorrean and part of a contingent of pirates hired by the Hutts as security for a secret base in the Valsedian asteroid belt. The group came under attack by Dark Acolyte Asajj Ventress and Duroc was Force-choked and hurled against a wall with crushing force.

Jaklin was a female Human teacher who served as a loyal deputy to Chief Rikkard in the village of Torbel on the planet Lanteeb during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict between the Republic and the Separatists.

Davis Joness was an administrator of the Coruscant planetary government before the start of the Clone Wars. After the establishment of the Galactic Empire, he was unable to cope with the new Imperial regulations and was demoted to waste collector.
Ein Truminn was a man who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
This Twi'lek pirate was a part of a contingent of pirates hired by the Hutts as security for a secret base in the Valsedian asteroid belt. The group came under attack by Dark Acolyte Asajj Ventress.

This Twi'lek female pirate was a part of a contingent of pirates hired by the Hutts as security for a secret base in the Valsedian asteroid belt. The group came under attack by Dark Acolyte Asajj Ventress.
K'cri Elban was the owner of K'cri's Cafe on Figg Avenue, Cloud City.

Berkelium Shyre, also known by the codename "The Repairman," was a Human male technician who lived on the planet Malastare. By the year 1 BBY, he secretly worked for the Rebel Alliance, an insurrectionist organization that had declared war on the Galactic Empire.
Debin Karre was a modest-seeming, middle-aged Human male who had wanted to join the Imperial Military as a young man, but a childhood accident left him with a decided limp.
Becca Westone was a Human female from Coruscant.
Dean Lado was the leader of the Spiders swoop gang, which terrorized his home city of Gallisport, on Shesharile 5, during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

A male Mandalorian police captain served in the Mandalorian Guard during a poisoning attack by the Moogan smugglers on Mandalore. The police captain was stationed at the New Mandalorians' capital city of Sundari.

In 3956 BBY, an Aqualish bounty hunter worked for the crime lord Davik Kang on the planet Taris. That year, Kang dispatched him and a Human bounty hunter to collect 100 credits from one of his debtors, an aged merchant.

This Human bounty hunter worked for the crime lord Davik Kang on the planet Taris in 3956 BBY. Paired with a fellow Aqualish bounty hunter, he tried to extort 100 credits from a merchant, who owed them to Kang.
Quayce was a female Human who was the leader of the Rabid Mynocks swoop gang on Shesharile 5.

Hewi was a small alien who worked for Taloron Hunter Crutag, whose gang pursued a group of Rebels to the jungle world of Trinta. Whilst on the planet, Crutag was angered when his ship, the Scent of Fear, inexplicably disappeared.
This orderly was a Mandalorian doctor who worked in the Sundari hospital in the New Mandalorian capital city Sundari on Mandalore during the Clone Wars.
A Mandalorian Royal Guard was seen with Duchess Satine Kryze and Senator Padmé Amidala on Mandalore at a dock where black market merchants were unloading poisonous tea.

Slavin was a male human Imperial officer who served as a captain during the Imperial occupation of Ryloth. He served under Grand Admiral Thrawn when several members of the Phoenix Cell attacked Ryloth to retrieve the Syndulla clan's Kalikori.

This Taloron served as a lieutenant to the Taloron Hunter and bounty hunter Crutag. When the Taloron lieutenant died during a hunt, the Rodian Slimego assumed that he would eventually take the Taloron's place as Crutag's right-hand being.
Kant Graf was a male Devaronian architect who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Graf sought to begin construction on an area of land occupied by a family of Gungans.
Sathme Forr was a female Rodian artist who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Yvana Bailer was a female Twi'lek actress who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Seevi Nyed was a male Zabrak chef who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Pannaqa was a farmer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Grizzlo, also known as Old Grizzy or Grizzy Two Tone, was a male Twi'lek who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. At some point he was a musician, but later retired.
Torin Gundo was an elderly Human soldier who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Erim Thelcar was a female Zabrak that lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was the sister of Josef Thelcar.
Sola Nosconda was a female Bothan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Par Doiae was a surveyor who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Kaul Dysen was a politician who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Keicho was a male Zabrak who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Menchi was an environmentalist who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Luha Kellaro was an ecologist who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
J'er Nahj was a Human male and a native of the planet Alderaan.

Salek Panaka was an undead male Human who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Panaka was present on the planet Dathomir when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.

Jop was a male soldier serving in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was part of a platoon, under the command of Sergeant Hork, that was assigned to take an Imperial strongpoint during the Galactic Civil War.

This Infiltrator was part of the Alliance to Restore the Republic force that was assigned to take an Imperial strongpoint. The night before a big push, this Infiltrator and several others went behind enemy lines to stir up confusion.

This Ithorian lived on the planet Taris by 3956 BBY with his life mate. That year, he was attacked and injured by two children with anti-alien sentiments. He didn't fight back for fear of being arrested.

Brooser was a large, simian looking Human male born on the planet Celanon. At a height of 2.2 meters and weighing over 150 kilograms, his bulk consisted of all muscle except for a Jargridian Brandy belly around his middle.
Jurvi was one of the many sargheet farmers who suffered through the economic hard times that befell the planet Dagro, during the height of the Clone Wars.
Darsie Vundt was a Human female Rampa III native and grew up in a middle-class family but despised the life she was born into. She lashed out at society by slicing into local information networks.
Sam Waurie was the son of a famous Corporate Sector Authority Security Division executive.
Darth Scabrous was a Sith Lord and alchemist who served as the headmaster of the Sith academy on the frozen world of Odacer-Faustin.
D'we'mouk was the Nikto representative who signed his species into Hutt servitude as part of the Treaty of Vontor.

Andar Suquand was an ancient Ithorian revolutionary. Their actions were remembered by the time of the Clone Wars, becoming known as "casting sand in the gears of the machine." The Separatist spy Klo Merit thought of Suquand's strategies before bombing a Galactic Republic MedSt…
Johzan B'oh was a Herglic information broker and compulsive gambler. B'oh could usually be found at an establishment known as Ace of Sabers.
Cord Barzon was male Human who is the son of Carl Barzon. After the death of Cord's mother, his father was the only family member.

Cdera was an Imperial officer who served at the primary customs checkpoint on Sarahwiee during the early years of the New Republic. Chief Duty Officer Cdera was on duty when Tere Metallo, Gil Crosear, and Alex Winger arrived on the planet in an effort to rescue Carl Barzon.

Warlin was an Human male from the planet Acherin. He was the only survivor of the group of Eluthans who were rescued from an Imperial prison by the freedom fighter known as Flame, during the early months of the New Order.
Vansitt was the owner of a Mos Espa establishment that educated potential slaves in a variety of skills and disciplines, including assassination and political blackmail.
Alamar was a young Ghostling child was captured, along with Princess Arawynne, by Djas Puhr and brought to Mos Espa to be sold as a slave. Alamar was just five and a half at the time.

A male Bith who worked as a scientist was present on Nal Hutta's moon, Nar Shaddaa, during the final days of the Dark Wars in 3951 BBY. A former Jedi Knight, Meetra Surik, met him in his laboratory in the Nar Shaddaa Docks and questioned him about what he was doing.

Nitram was a male Bothan and a member of the Rebel Alliance who served alongside Juno Eclipse on the Salvation during the first year of the Galactic Civil War. He acted as Eclipse's second-in-command during a brief battle over Cato Neimoidia.
Genarra was a female Jedi Master who served as the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic and the leader of the Jedi Order during the New Sith Wars, circa 1032 BBY.

Cards was an Advanced Recon Commando and Clone Commander who served in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems, spanned from 22 BBY to 19 BBY.

In 32 BBY, a Gotal was riding a red speeder bike down a street on the planet Coruscant. When the Gungan Jar Jar Binks ran into the street without looking for oncoming traffic, the Gotal narrowly avoided a collision with the Gungan.

Tet Tramys was a Human male who supported the Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Tramys left his homeworld, Tuttin IV, with Tendis and Jioie Ancum, in order to ensure that they reached their off-world cell without any trouble.
A clone trooper who served under Lieutenant Trap in Tango Company as part of the Pelta-class frigate TB-73 crew during the Clone Wars.

A Human male worked as a Republic diplomat on the planet Manaan during the Jedi Civil War in 3956 BBY. The diplomat represented a group of Republic soldiers in the Ahto High Court during a hearing that was the result of a brawl between his clients and a group of Sith soldiers.

Half-Moonsing was a male Weequay Jedi and the caretaker of the speeder pool at the Coruscant Jedi Temple in the finals years of the Galactic Republic. While he failed to pass the Jedi Trials, Half-Moonsing was permitted to stay in the Temple while maintaining the title of Jedi.
Squire Kinning was a female Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. She participated in quelling the Arkanian Revolution.

Homonix Rectonia was a member of the Jedi Order during the early Manderon Period, which began in 7000 BBY. One of Rectonia's lasting contributions to the Order was the transcription of the Jedi Code in its classical form.
Qui-Ko was a male Human seer serving the Je'daii Order on Tython before the Force Wars.

Rouggle was a member of the Jedi Order during the last century of the Galactic Republic. A Force-sensitive, Rouggle trained as a Jedi and reached the rank of Padawan, but did not pass the Trials of Knighthood.

Shaptives was a male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order in its final years as a member of the Jedi Starfighter Corps. A Jedi ace, Shaptives was an acquaintance of the young Padawan Anakin Skywalker when he joined the Order in 32 BBY.

Skwelli was a Priapulin who served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Master at some point before 1000 BBY. He was a skillful duelist, and his abilities were recorded in one of the Order's holocrons, which were kept in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.
The captain of the Sith Interdictor-class cruiser Dying Sun was a male who served under the Sith Lord Darth Glovoc toward the end of the Jedi Civil War.

Tabor's brother was an Aleena. He fought as a gladiator against the Drovian Silus, but was defeated and killed. Later, his brother Tabor tried to avenge his death but was also killed by the violent Drovian.
Derec was a Human male and a crew member of the Jynni's Virtue. After the Jynni's Virtue was forced to crash-land near the Valley of Golg, he was killed on the planet Korriban by unknown forces.

Yat-De Viedas was a male Rodian who served as a commodore in the Rebel Alliance during its early years. In 1 BBY, he had a base on Nordra and fought during the Assault on Kamino, under the command of General Rahm Kota.
Bouris Ulgo was a Human male who lived during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War, hailing from the Core World of Alderaan.
Diab Duin was a Sullustan male who served as a politician in the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Flash was a male Twi'lek treasure hunter who lived during the Cold War fought between the Galactic Republic, the reconstituted Sith Empire, and their proxies. Flash was a known associate of the female Twi'lek criminal Vette.
Plasmajack was a male Twi'lek who was a known treasure hunter and partner with Vette, Taunt, and Flash during the galactic Cold War between the Galactic Republic and reconstituted Sith Empire.

Dorvin Eltrom was a male Cerean Jedi who fought against the remnants of the New Sith Empire during the New Sith Wars and was a member of Jedi Master Vannar Treece's strike team during Operation Influx. In 1032 BBY, he and his comrades infiltrated the planet Oranessan.

Mrssk was a male Trandoshan Jedi who served the Jedi Order during the New Sith Wars and a member of Vannar Treece's strike team. He participated in Operation Influx on the planet Chelloa in 1032 BBY. Mrssk and his comrades infiltrated the planet Oranessan in 1032 BBY.

Berluk was a male Quarren Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the New Sith Wars and a member of Vannar Treece's Jedi strike team during Operation Influx. He and his comrades infiltrated the planet Oranessan in 1032 BBY.
In 17 ABY, a gray-haired Gotal visited the Crystal Jewel casino on Coruscant, the galactic capital, and entered into a game of sabacc against a Brubb, a Ssty and a Tin-Tin Dwarf.

In 17 ABY, a Gotal was present in the Crystal Jewel casino on Coruscant, the galactic capital, when an explosion occurred nearby. The shockwave damaged the casino, and, believing it signified an attack on the capital, many of the casino's patrons fled the premises.

In 17 ABY, a man was present in the Crystal Jewel casino on Coruscant, the galactic capital, when a nearby explosion rocked the gambling hall. The casino sustained damage, and, believing it signified an attack on the capital, many casino patrons fled the premises.
A dark-skinned Human female Sith Saber was a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith on the planet Kesh. In 41 ABY, Sith Tyro Vestara Khai was summoned to the ruling Circle of Lords.

This Shadow Guard was a Human male who was part of the Emperor's Shadow Guard, and was stationed on Nar Shaddaa. He was killed when Darth Vader's apprentice, Galen Marek, arrived on the planet in search of Jedi Rahm Kota.
Hespecia Tik'kla was a female Caamasi philosopher and lawgiver who lived during the early years of the Galactic Republic.
Unskette was a male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order nearly 900 years after the Ruusan Reformations of the Galactic Republic were passed.

Violia was a Force-sensitive female who was a member of the Jedi Order during the last century of the Galactic Republic. She was a friend of the future Jedi Master Thame Cerulian when both were Initiates at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant but did not become a Padawan like Cerulian.

Plautopseum was an ancient member of the Jedi Order who had attained the rank of Master. Ancient accounts kept safe by the Order claimed that Plautopseum had passed into the Force upon dying and transcended death by returning as a phantom.

Galong-Tal was an ancient member of the Jedi Order who had attained the rank of Master. Ancient accounts kept safe by the Order claimed that Galong-Tal had passed into the Force upon dying and transcended death by returning as a phantom.
This male Mrlssi was a police detective in the Coruscant Security Force in 32 BBY.
A male Sullustan police detective served in the Coruscant Security Force in 32 BBY.

This unnamed Shadow Guard was a Human male Emperor's Shadow Guard. He was stationed on Raxus Prime at the Imperial Ore Facility. He was killed by Darth Vader's apprentice Galen Marek when he stormed the facility and dueled the guard.
Snar Extruct was a Dashade Jedi and a survivor of the destruction of Urkupp living in the years proceeding the passage of the Ruusan Reformations of the Galactic Republic.
A female individual was the Princess of Quanducial and shared their title with the Outer Rim's Quanducial system during the last century of the Galactic Republic.
This individual was a Troxan male who served his species and homeworld, Troxar, as the under-palatine for patriotic liaisons and the first diplomatic legatee during the Clone Wars.

t: Under-palatine for the Bureau of Patriotic Defense (Clone Wars)
n: Under-palatine for the Bureau of Patriotic Defense
x: This individual was a Troxan male who served his species and homeworld, Troxar, as the under-palatine for the Bureau of Patriotic Defense during the Clone Wars.
This individual was a Troxan who served as the assistant to the under-palatine for patriotic liaisons during the Clone Wars.

This individual was a male Troxan who served his species as a diplomat during the Clone Wars. On Coruscant, this Troxan visited the Jedi Temple to deliver an incendiary packet addressed to High Master Yoda.
In 3963 BBY, this Mandallian Giant competed in the final round of the Tandem Open. Wearing gold armor plates and a purple loincloth, they rode a swoop bike large enough to accommodate their size.

Coril Daskmin was a male Corellian who was a famous gambler. During the celebrations surrounding the Bazaar Star Challenge, a sabacc deck that was once owned by Daskmin was on sale from Nenmo's Curios, on the planet Cularin.

In 3963 BBY, this Night-Soarer competed in the semi-final round of the Tandem Open. They were eliminated from the competition when "Spikes" and Goethar Kleej simultaneously fired their blasters at the Night-Soarer.

t: Unidentified Coruscant Police officer (Corellian Embassy riot)
x: A Human male individual served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force in 40 ABY. He was present at a riot in front of the Corellian Embassy on Coruscant, the Galactic Alliance capital planet.

Torpo the Hutt was a Hutt and distant cousin of Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Around 21 BBY during the Clone Wars, Torpo was suspected by Jabba for brokering a deal with the Confederacy of Independent Systems to access the Valsedian asteroid belt in Hutt Space, which was in violation…

An individual was a gray-haired male of the Gotal species. He served as a guard in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and was stationed aboard the Home One Star Cruiser immediately after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
Hirsch Sif was a Human male member of the Sif mercenaries who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. A powerful soldier, Hirsch was the brother of Doak and Erran Sif.
Doak Sif was a Human male member of the Sif mercenaries who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. A powerful soldier, Doak was the brother of Hirsch and Erran Sif.

This individual was a male Pacithhip who served as a member of the Black Hole Pirates during the Clone Wars. Like the rest of the pirates, the Pacithhip lived aboard the Random Mallet, trapped within the Unknown Regions by the gravitational pull of a black hole.
The Dark Apprentice, also known as "Starkiller," was a clone of Galen Marek, a Force-sensitive Human male taken on by the Sith Lord Darth Vader as his secret apprentice, also codenamed "Starkiller".
Subject 1138, also known as "Starkiller," was a clone of Galen Marek, a Force-sensitive Human male trained by the Sith Lord Darth Vader as his secret apprentice.
Mokshok was a Swokes Swokes diplomat and, later, pirate.

Anspi'shel was a female Twi'lek who lived during the time of the Cold War and was an associate of the Rattataki Kaliyo Djannis. She had gang connections and she used them to raid ships. At one point she and Kaliyo raided an Exchange ship with out realizing it.
Nohn Veyaiko was a Neimoidian male who served the Hutt crime lord Voontara Fa'athra as a lieutenant on the planet Nal Hutta.

The Wheezer was a Human male anarchist who became the leader of the Revolutionary Edge Brigade on Brentaal IV during the time of the Cold War, and the former mentor of the Rattataki criminal Kaliyo Djannis.
Vanus Cruor was a gangster who ascended the ranks of the galactic crime syndicate known as the Exchange to become one of its top agents.

Darth Simi was a female priestess affiliated with the Sith tradition of Force-users. She was kept alive for millennia through a process of sacrificing young Jedi—the ideological antithesis of the Sith—to the dark side of the Force.

Frank was a Feeorin male gladiator at the Tarko-se Arena on the planet Cato Neimoidia. He was the cousin of Nym, a Feeorin pirate who was sympathetic to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Dea Tore was a Human female doctor who stayed on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.

Arrek Von Sarko was Human male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he would frequent the cantina in the city of Moenia on the planet Naboo.

Athok Dinvar was a Human male criminal who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he resided in the city of Keren, along with his boss, Kritus Morven. The latter has a strong rivalry with the Hutt crime lord Borvo.

Ayn Eckener was a Human female citizen of the planet Naboo who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War, sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY. She shared the same surname as Karl and Hugo Eckener, prominent members of Naboo society.
Bab Esrus was a Human female biosculptor who lived on the Mid Rim world of Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
Brennis Doore was a criminal residing in Keren during the Galactic Civil War.
Mia Magansitty was a grandmother who resided on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
Temir Tonnalo was a male individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was a friend, albeit a rather exploitative one, of Brennis Doore.

Niles Emmert was a Human male who served as a member of the Jedi Agricultural Corps and an attendant at the Marfa agricultural labs during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Arljack, nicknamed "Arl", was a Human male who served as a medical technical at the Odacer-Faustin Sith academy during the Cold War. After a duel between Rance Lussk and Wim Nickter, who was kidnapped by Darth Scabrous, Arljack was present with several patients.

Gree was a Bothan male drunken smuggler that frequented the Kwenn Space Station during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. One time in 3645 BBY, he met the Jedi Rojo Trace who was searching for his sister.
Maggs was a male Human Sith student during the Cold War who trained at the Sith Academy on Odacer-Faustin.
Skarl was a Nelvaanian male bounty hunter and a partner of Dranok during the Cold War. The bounty hunters were hired by Darth Scabrous to deliver to him a Murakami orchid.

Niim Stroolg was a male Caarite who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He worked for the Metatheran Cartel and eventually became an executive in charge of "resource investigation", serving as an overseer to some of the Cartel's mining operations.
Ranlaw was a male human Sith Acolyte who trained at Darth Scabrous's Sith academy on Odacer-Faustin.
Rucker was a fifth-year Human male Sith Acolyte who trained at Darth Scabrous's Sith academy on Odacer-Faustin.
Detiz was a male Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He became a member of the Red Fury Brotherhood, a pirate organization that operated in the Cularin system, and in c.

Limmiz was a male Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He served as a member of the Red Fury Brotherhood, a pirate organization that operated in the Cularin system, and in c.

Szep was a male Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He served as a member of the Red Fury Brotherhood, a pirate organization that operated in the Cularin system, and in c.
Noggox was a male Hutt independent of the Hutt Grand Council who resided on the planet Affa. Noggox and his retinue were killed by the Dark Acolyte Savage Opress.

Norch was a male and a lieutenant in the Republic Army during the Cold War. He, alongside Captain Tekla Ansgar and the Jedi Rojo Trace, was part of the team that investigate a crashed Sith starship on the planet Geonosis. He was a very bureaucratic man and argued with Trace.

Tekla Ansgar was a female and a captain in the Republic Army during the Cold War. She was the leader of the team that investigated a crashed Sith starship on the planet Geonosis, alongside Lieutenant Norch and the Jedi Rojo Trace.

Dranok was a Human bounty hunter who operated during the Cold War. He usually partnered with the Nelvaanian Skarl. They were two of the many bounty hunters who were hired to hunt down and find the Murakami orchid for Darth Scabrous.

Dail'Liss was a Neti male Sith and the librarian of the Odacer-Faustin Sith academy. He spoke with a strange accent, in which he pronounced "yes" as "jess," and he served as caretaker of the academy library after the death of Darth Drear.
Xeelo, also known as Twitcher, was a Rodian who operated a starship during the time of the Clone Wars.
Tk-216 was a Human male stormtrooper for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Flen Luzo was a male Human Sith Saber of the Lost Tribe of Sith. Around 3960 BBY, for his devotion to the Grand Lord Lillia Venn, he was promoted, with his younger brother Sawj Luzo, to the rank of Sith Lord after the events of the Korsinata.

Sawj Luzo was a male Human Sith Saber of the Lost Tribe of Sith. Around 3960 BBY, for his devotion to the Grand Lord Lillia Venn, he was promoted, with his elder brother Flen Luzo, to the rank of Sith Lord after the events of the Korsinata.

Sonie was the supposed aunt of Cerasi, a female Melida from the planet Melida/Daan. In order to create a diversion for Jedi Knights Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi, Cerasi told two guards that she was looking for her father Wehutti in order to tell him that Sonie had been kill…

A male Keshiri bartender tended a bar on the planet Kesh. Kind to his patrons, he always tried to have a decent meal to serve for the poor. He offered the Jedi Jelph Marrian food and advice when the Human entered his bar in 3960 BBY.

A female Zabrak Force-user was a student of the rogue former Jedi Shon-Ju in the year 21 BBY. Shon-Ju had been rejected from the Jedi Order and spent time in exile, learning new ways to use the Force.
A male Twi'lek scoundrel participated in an ambush set up for Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian in the Bespin settlement of Cloud City in 1 ABY.

Roah Palladane was a female Human who was the wife of the former Jedi Knight Gorlan Palladane, the leader of the miners in Jenith on the Outer Rim planet of Chelloa during the Republic Dark Age. She and Gorlan had two children, Aneese and Jalen.

Aneese Palladane was the older prepubescent daughter of the covert Jedi Knight Gorlan Palladane and Roah Palladane in the Outer Rim world of Chelloa during the Republic Dark Age. She and her family lived in the mining colony of Jenith.

Jalen Palladane was the infant son of the covert Jedi Knight Gorlan Palladane and Roah Palladane in the Outer Rim world of Chelloa during the Republic Dark Age. He was the younger brother of Aneese Palladane, and their family lived in the mining colony of Jenith.
Tyla Gallamby was Human female scientist who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Illrian Nhagy was male Sullustan who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Liam Waurie was a male Human who served as an officer in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
TK-488 was a stormtrooper during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed in Coronet on the planet Corellia.

A muscular male Force user was a student of the rogue former Jedi Shon-Ju in the year 21 BBY. Shon-Ju had been rejected from the Jedi Order and spent time in exile, learning new ways to use the Force.
Sabat was a male mercenary who acted as the chief of security for Attuma Duum. He was killed in personal combat by the rogue Force-sensitive Shon-Ju in Attuma Duum's headquarters in the year 22 BBY.
Skodo was a Rodian male mechanic who lived in the mining settlement of Jenith on the Outer Rim world of Chelloa during the Republic Dark Age.

The building manager of the Zorp House apartment tower of Galactic City on Coruscant was a male Neimoidian who assisted the planet's security force and members of the Jedi Order during the investigation into the activities of Lumiya, Dark Lady of the Sith.
Stinger, who flew under the callsign "Arrow Nine," was a clone trooper pilot who served in Arrow Squadron, a Republic starfighter unit, under the command of Jedi General Anakin Skywalker.
Quilsen was a Spiner who had become down-and-out and used the phetaril spice by the time of the Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon in 4 ABY.
The father of Roenni was a male Human from the planet Melida/Daan. He worked as a starfighter mechanic, giving Roenni familiarity with all types of aerial vehicles.

Wingnut was a clone trooper pilot who fought at Kothlis with Hammer Squadron during the Clone Wars. A greenie flying under the callsign Hammer Two, his ship was damaged by two droid starfighters and he was forced to return to the Pioneer for repairs.

Drayk was a clone trooper captain who served in the Grand Army of the Republic. In 21 BBY, during the Clone Wars, he was part of a battle group that was sent to the planet Kothlis to prevent a Confederate invasion—led by General Grievous—from eliminating the Bothan Spynet.
Keth-Keth was a male Jawa who lived on the planet Cularin during the time of the Clone Wars.

Gadin Badolfa was an architect from the planet Kesh who worked for the Lost Tribe of Sith, the world's ruling body. While not a Sith, Badolfa nevertheless had powerful connections within the Lost Tribe's hierarchy, and his services were constantly in demand.

Sutloo was the owner and operator of Sutloo's Trading Post on Seregar. He was an older, pot-bellied man who was one of the original settlers on Seregar. He made a meager living but was happy with his life. He enjoyed meeting new people and lived very simply.
Gavvix Sironna was an individual who served as a general in the Alderaanian military during the time of the Galactic Empire.
Rusha was an elderly woman who was a person of great importance on Eckless. She was considered the leading candidate to be elected President of the Council of Eckless.

Taun was a male Human from the planet Melida/Daan. He headed the Young's Utilities Squad after the Battle of Zehava. Taun was determined to help the citizens of Zehava left without heat and power as a result of the multiple conflicts of the Melida/Daan Civil War.
Nena was a Human from the planet Melida/Daan that headed the Housing Squad after the Battle of Zehava.
Pei was a Daan from Quadri on the planet Melida/Daan. Pei was one of the parents of Leidra.

Treve was the nickname of a clone trooper lieutenant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, he fought in a battle on the planet Kothlis, serving under the command of Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Theron Shan was a Human male of the Shan family, the secret son of Jedi Grand Master Satele Shan and Supreme Commander Jace Malcom of the Republic Military.
By 3951 BBY, a woman was married to an officer in the Onderonian military named Gelesi; the pair lived on the planet Onderon while caring for a four-year-old daughter together.

In 3955 BBY, a female, the daughter of an officer in the Onderonian military named Gelesi, was born. By 3951 BBY, Gelesi was married to a woman; the couple and their daughter lived on the planet Onderon.
Old Oglaw was a grizzled old freighter captain who was stuck in Iritsa for several months while he worked through some contractual problems with a shipment.
Heimkes was an individual employed by the mercenary Attuma Duum during the Clone Wars. In the year 21 BBY, he worked in Duum's asteroid base.
Orqiti Aneofo was a merchant who resided in the city of Bestine on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Mi'raj was a Twi'lek artist who created the painting known as Corellian Seaside.
Darth Vich was a young Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire when his Emperor launched a war against the Galactic Republic.

Bogg was a Geonosian engineer who designed and operated the landtank known as the Bogg Behemoth. Bogg was captured and imprisoned by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, and the 501st Legion of the Galactic Republic, on the planet Makem Te during a land ba…
This being was a biologist serving in the Imperial Science Bureau of the reconstituted Sith Empire and the adoptive father of Veradun (later known as Darth Malgus).
A Quarren mercenary lived on Coruscant in 137 ABY.

Nawara Blen was a Twi'lek criminal who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Blen worked for a smuggling operation established by a Human and at some point during the Clone Wars, Blen was present in Tolea Biqua on the planet Genarius, with the Rodians Teeku a…

Koobis was a Rodian criminal who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Koobis worked for a smuggling operation established by the Humans and, at some point during the Clone Wars, Koobis was present in Tolea Biqua on the planet Genarius, with the Rodian Teeku …
Fewn Hew was a military officer of the Galactic Republic who lived during the Old Sith Wars.
Acun Solari was an officer in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Fyn was a clone trooper sergeant and NCO who fought in the battle of Kothlis. He single-handedly saved some clone trooper when they were in trouble. After the battle, he brought a datapad with updated data on the previous battle.
Jefris was a Human male who served as commander of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Mata Fhernan was a Human female who lived during the Clone Wars, and mother to Bant'ena, Chai, and Ilim Fhernan.

Sinissima Bel was a female smuggler active in the Post-Imperial Period. One planet she was known to visit was Gamorr where she would smuggle in illegal goods including poison and dangerous creatures to those who hired her to.

Gethnu Cheeve was a Devaronian smuggler active in the Post-Imperial era. One planet Gethnu was known to visit was Gamorr where the Devaronian would smuggle in illegal goods including poison and dangerous creatures to those who hired them specifically.
Galuf Cardaan was a Human male miner who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.

A Zabrak male served as a member of the Jedi Order during the Great Galactic War. This Jedi participated in the Battle of Alderaan at the height of the conflict, and engaged in personal combat with the Sith Lord Darth Malgus during the Imperial retreat from the world.
Vorin was a Human male who served as a member of the Jedi Order during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Falad Prok was a male Human who worked for Jorga Sune in Iritsa. He was barely out of his teens, but had worked as an errand boy, spy, thief and special messenger.
Dellko was a male Rodian who worked for the Tourism Council of Oluna Biqua on the planet Genarius during the time of the Clone Wars.

Morth was a male Human who lived on the planet Genarius during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was employed in the retail sector, but later made a career for him self as an information broker in the city Oluna Biqua.
Syun Nagguth was a male Sullustan who lived on the planet of Genarius during the time of the Clone Wars, working as a parade pilot in the city Oluna Biqua.

This Gand bounty hunter was present on the Rig when Mace Windu arrived to demand to know who in the Bounty Hunters' Guild posted bounties on the Jedi. This hunter was killed by Windu after attempting to attack him.

Korvalis was an individual who became a sergeant in the Cularin Militia, a military force that was active in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. During the time of the Clone Wars, Korvalis and Sergeant C.
This Gand bounty hunter was present on Ord Mantell during the hunt for Quinlan Vos. This individual was seen firing at Vos from a high vantage point, after which the Gand was not seen again.
A Gand individual was seen in a cantina on Onadax in 28 ABY.
A Gand served as a crewmember aboard Nabrun Leids's ship, a Ghtroc Industries Class 720 freighter called the Scarlet Vertha.
This Moogan smuggler was part of Tee Va's crew of smugglers active during the Clone Wars.

Jans Tolen was a male individual who served as an officer in the Thaereian military during the time of the Clone Wars. He eventually became the captain of the cruiser Stark Wing and in c. 21 BBY he commanded the ship during an assignment in the Cularin asteroid belt.
Jander Bibbbi was a male Sullustan who worked for the crime lord Nirama during the time of the Clone Wars, serving as the captain of the YT-1300 light freighter Jackpot.
Amick Mudd was a male Human who worked as an engineer on the space station Burnout during the time of the Clone Wars.
Valdo was a male individual who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was a friend of Blackie, a street person from the planet of Genarius.

Prengahl Kreen was a wily Twi'lek arms dealer operating in the Empartheca system during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance. The Outer Rim hidden base Breshkall was his refuge, and it housed his family and friends.

Ji'Ni Sil was a Jawa who lived during the Galactic Civil War on Tatooine. After the Battle of Yavin, Sil worked as the trader at the Jawa Mountain Fortress. He owned a protocol droid named C4-ZX as a translator.
Nolar Fe'li was a Jawa junk dealer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Meso Laloo was a Jawa junk dealer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Ribbo Qua'lu was a Jawa junk dealer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Hibli Bet'ario was a Jawa junk dealer who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Jusani Zhord was a Human male and former Moff who operated out of a hotel in Nashal during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Baboo was a Human male who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he worked at the Lucky Despot, a cantina owned by the criminal leader Lady Valarian in Mos Eisley.
This officer was a part of the Mandalorian Guard and a part of Prime Minister Almec's team of smugglers.

Yadfre was a male Trandoshan who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, working in Gadrin on the planet Cularin as a sergeant in the Office of Peace and Security, a local law enforcement unit.

A Ri'Dar managed a casino on the planet of Coruscant in 8 ABY. After a bribe from Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker, this Ri'Dar provided the Human with information about Han Solo's visit to the casino at a previous date.

Arigo was the nickname of a Human male agent of The Exchange on Ord Mantell, working in weapons trafficking. He was Zeerid Korr's contact until 3653 BBY, when Arigo was presumed killed by a group of pirates or mercenaries, which included Scar and No Scar.

Oren was a male handler of the Exchange who was involved in weapon and spice trafficking. When Zeerid Korr joined the Exchange, Oren was assigned as his handler. Korr knew almost nothing about Oren. Oren gave different assignments to Korr, mainly weapon smuggling operations.
Oteg was a revered male Jedi Master and Fleet Admiral who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War and the ensuing Cold War.
Mirri Thebes was a female Twi'lek who worked as the finance director of the trading concern Mothven Star Trading during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Shivanek was a Sith captain who lived during the Cold War. He was killed by an elite Republic strike team.

Tiny was the chief bodyguard of the Geeloniran, leader of the Geelan species, sometime after the event known as the Vanishing. Tiny accompanied the Geeloniran whenever the leader made a trip to the space station known as Zirtran's Anchor.

A Geelan served as the Great Geel, or leader, of the Geelan species sometime after the event known as the Vanishing. The Great Geel made occasional visits to the space station known as Zirtran's Anchor.
Ripper was a pet jurgoran owned by Shivanek, a captain in the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
A furry ball-shaped creature lurked in the Shadowlands of Kashyyyk in 0 BBY. When the young Wookiee Lumpawarrump explored the Shadowlands in search of wasaka berries, the creature lunged at him.

A Human female underdweller was working for the IT-3 Interrogator droid "It" in 8 ABY. When "It" and several other underdwellers brought a stolen datapad and the young Wookiee Lumpawarrump to the secret Imperial detention center where the female was stationed, she was ultimate…
Friggy Squig was a male Gungan bongo racer alive during the build up to the Clone Wars on the planet Naboo.

Varner Hilts was a Human male who served as the mild-mannered caretaker of Sith lore for the Lost Tribe of Sith in 3000 BBY. He grew up during the tumultuous Time of the Rot which lasted almost a millennium and devastated much of the continent of Keshtah Minor.

Dorri Canas was a middle-aged woman from Iritsa who was very concerned about the relations between the Clog-dwellers and Stone-dwellers. She wore a long robe favored by diplomats and was very critical of Jorga Sune.
Zyru Tokkip was a male officer of the Iritsa Civil Guard. He patrolled the South Market in Iritsa. He was tall and had dark hair.
A Human male commander in the Galactic Empire's military helped enforce martial law on the planet Kashyyyk during an Imperial blockade of the world during the Life Day holiday of 1.5 ABY.
A male Human was a technician and an officer in the Galactic Empire during the early years of the Galactic Civil War. He served under the command of an unidentified commander on Kashyyyk in 1 ABY.
Ranso Li was a Twi'lek who worked for Nirama, an Oblee crime lord who operated a smuggling concern in the Cularin system.
Cruva Lenda was a Twi'lek who lived during the era of the New Republic and was employed by the organization of Nirama, an Oblee crime lord based in the Cularin system.

Kir Sesad was a male Cerean who worked for the Hutt Lungru Nokko Vimmas, as an advisor. On one occasion, Sesad accompanied Lungru to a party that was held by the Hutt Popara Anjiliac Diresto on the moon Nar Shaddaa.

Miltar Dolor was a male individual who worked for the Corporate Sector Authority. He once acted as a CSA representative at a party that was held by the Hutt Popara Anjiliac Diresto on the moon Nar Shaddaa.

Min Gost was a male Sullustan who worked as an information broker, operating from Kuzbar's Cantina on the moon Nar Shaddaa. Following the murder of the Hutt Popara Anjiliac Diresto, a group of individuals that were investigating his death paid Gost to give them some information.

Sorgoth was a male Evocii Force Adept who lived on the moon Nar Shaddaa. By the time that he had reached the age of one hundred and fifty, Sorgoth had became the leader of a clan of about thirty Evocii.

Derrend Montis was a wealthy Corellian explorer. He obtained a TL-1200 transport, which he named Shadowfire, that he modified to increase the craft's combat capabilities. Following his death, ownership of the Shadowfire passed to a shipping company.

A cam operator worked for the journalist Javis Tyrr in the time following the Second Galactic Civil War. In 44 ABY, Wynn Dorvan organized the arrest of Tyrr for illegal espionage with the help of the cam operator.

Battz was a male human forger from Argovia that often offered his services, no questions asked. He occasionally did work for the Rebel Alliance. While a skilled forger, he was less skilled at his gambling habit, and often found himself in debt.
Nikal Kam was a male Human pirate captain.

Val-Aruun was a male chef who worked on the planet Cularin around the time of the end of the Clone Wars. When making the foodstuff kaavo, Val-Aruun always cut the product into tenths, despite the fact that all other chefs cut kaavo into sixths.
Sw'isi was a Mashi Horansi male who was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Myrgaanti Shi-Iki was a Gorvan Horansi member of the Rebel Alliance's SpecForce Infiltrators. He and his longtime friend and fellow Infiltrator Bryce Agoris deserted the Rebellion shortly before the Battle of Endor, taking over two million credits of matériel with them, includ…

Lady Saro was a female Atoan and the High Priestess of Atoa. She claimed that her ability to speak Basic stemmed from a ritual she performed on a captured stormtrooper, in which she removed and consumed the trooper's tongue.
Gaffa was a clone trooper sergeant who was selected to become a clone engineer and served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars in the 38th Armored Division.

A Human female mercenary was a non-Force sensitive member of the Brotherhood of Darkness. She fled from the Seventh Battle of Ruusan after the Army of Light managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the Sith camp.

A Human male mercenary was a non-Force-sensitive member of the Brotherhood of Darkness. He fled from the Seventh Battle of Ruusan after the Army of Light managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the Sith camp.
A male announcer worked in the Taris dueling ring in the cantina in the Upper City of the planet Taris.
During the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire, a Human male dueling fan lived on the Outer Rim city world of Taris.

During the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire, a Human female dueling fan lived on the Outer Rim city planet of Taris. In 3956 BBY, she was unable to get tickets for a dueling match in the Upper City Cantina and was forced to watch it on a viewscreen.
Scar was the nickname of a bearded male Human criminal with a facial scar, who was the alleged leader of a group of mercenaries or pirates on Ord Mantell in 3653 BBY.
No scar was the nickname of a bearded male Human criminal who was a member of a group of mercenaries or pirates on Ord Mantell in 3653 BBY.
A male Twi'lek biker resided on the Galactic Republic's capital planet, Coruscant, during the Clone Wars.

Vrath Xizor (birth name unknown) was a male Human who served the Imperial Army as a sniper during the Great Galactic War. By 3653 BBY, he had left the army and become a mercenary who worked for a Hutt Cartel.

Shyn was the uvak owned by Sith Saber Orielle Kitai, a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith on Kesh. When Kitai was condemned to slavery following the assassination attempt in the Korsinata, Kitai had to hide the creature in the barn belonging to Jelph Marrian, as slaves were not …
A male Twi'lek scoundrel and some other fringers accompanied the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk to Cloud City, a mining colony on the planet Bespin.

At some point between 1008 BBY and 992 BBY, a pilot was transporting a shipment of chemicals when his cargo exploded. The pilot received severe burns, and the resulting pain drove him mad. The pilot's friends took him to Caleb, a healer on the planet Ambria.
Maxina Sensis was a Human female xenoarchaeologist who worked at Daxis Outpost in the Jandolhoon system as the Chief Researcher.
Sal was a male Human who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
This Sith Commander was stationed on Taris and patrolled an apartment complex there, at the time of the Sith occupation of the planet, before it was destroyed.
A Sith guard lived on the planet Kesh in 3960 BBY. Following the assassination attempt on Grand Lord Lillia Venn, the guard watched the former High Lord Candra Kitai, who had been made a slave.
A male Keshiri florist lived on the planet Kesh around 3960 BBY, and frequently purchased plants from the farmer Jelph of Marisota.
This elderly Keshiri man was a slave in the service of Candra Kitai at her mansion on Kesh, called Starfall.

Val was a Human female who lived during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Val was the sister of Natala Yooms, the wife of Zeerid Korr, and the mother of Arra Yooms.
Natala Yooms, known by her family as Nat, was a Human female who lived during the Great Galactic War. Yooms was the sister of Val, who died in an airspeeder accident prior to the Battle of Alderaan.
Guard K23M9 was the number of a Syndicat guard who was killed by Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi
Kressis was a male Trandoshan who lived on the planet Almas during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, working as the lead harvester on a kaluthin farm ran by the farmer Rashen Sotose.

Jahan Cross, born 33 BBY, was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire as an Imperial Intelligence agent. Growing up during the Clone Wars, Cross lost his mother and younger sister during the Battle of Coruscant.

A servant of the slave trader Lady Ucce was of a species that had hairy protuberances. This individual traveled to Crseih Station aboard her starship, and was on board when Leia Organa Solo boarded, seeking the whereabouts of her kidnapped children.
Jard was a male Human Sith commander in the Imperial navy who was in command of the battlecruiser Valor that belonged to the Sith Lord Darth Malgus.

Droq'l was the bartender at Shanko's Hive on Borgo Prime. He had three arms, two eyes centered in the middle of his head, another in the back, and one on top of his bald, blue skull. He also had glossy black teeth, and the ability to smile.
Hudu Shiv was a Human male member of Death Watch during the Clone Wars. He was regarded as one of their best snipers.

This unidentified, green-skinned Twi'lek male was hired as a messenger for the Mandalorian mercenary Canderous Ordo during the latter's employment as Davik Kang's enforcer on Taris during the Jedi Civil War.

Ch'irrk Felt was a legendary male Jenet who featured in the epic poem, "The Ballad of Shan'Gredor." According to the poem, danchaf—also known as tree goblins—killed and ate Felt's relatives, an indignity that spurred Felt's retaliation: a trap of pots, pans, and phospowder.

Chirr't Ferr was a Jenet war hero who, according to Jenet legend, helped lead the Jenet species during the Great Conquest, a conflict in which the Jenet took control of the surface of the planet Garban from the danchaf tree goblins who had previously held domain there.

Rhet H'rrr was a Jenet war hero who, according to Jenet legend, helped lead the Jenet species during the Great Conquest, a conflict in which the Jenet took control of the surface of the planet Garban from the danchaf tree goblins who had previously held domain there.
"Moonface" was a nickname given to a male Jenet by Leia Organa Solo. "Moonface" was a member of the criminal syndicate known as the Invisible Shell.
"Tall" was a nickname given to a male Jenet by Leia Organa Solo. "Tall" was a member of the criminal syndicate known as the Invisible Shell.
Verm was a male Jenet who served as a crony to Ludlo Lebauer, the ostensible leader of the criminal syndicate known as the Invisible Shell.
An umbrella-like creature lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. The creature had two long, purple legs, each of which sported a clawed, two-toed foot.
This Nautolan trooper served the Sith Lord Daiman at the Battle of Gazzari in 1032 BBY. A spice addict, the trooper clung tightly to a container of spice when he spotted the Jedi Knight Kerra Holt.
Tavri was a Twi'lek mercenary active during the Galactic Civil War. Tavri worked with the detective Nim Bola for a time.

A male Jenet served as a member of the Peace Brigade during the Yuuzhan Vong War. When the Jedi Knights Jaina Solo and Lowbacca were attacked by the brigade, the Jenet participated. He was knocked out of the fight by a kick to the face by Solo.

A male Jenet was sent to spy on the Twi'lek mercenary Tavri and his boss, Nim Bola. The Jenet used an Imperial listening device to do so. The spy employed two Ossan toughs to monitor the premises while he did his work.
Syd Thardis was a male Human who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, working for the organization of the Oblee crime lord Nirama.
Rorvek was a male Wookiee who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, working for the organization of the Oblee crime lord Nirama.
Ulis was a Trandoshan who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, working for the organization of the Oblee crime lord Nirama.
Rexx was a Trandoshan who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, working for the organization of the Oblee crime lord Nirama.
Kropporrr was a Wookiee who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, working for the organization of the Oblee crime lord Nirama.
Kilon was a Trandoshan who lived in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, working for the organization of the Oblee crime lord Nirama.
Keers Dorana was a member of High Council of Alderaan from a unknown time period before the Great Galactic War that at 3653 BBY was effiged on a statue in the High Council building.

Velben Orr was a member of High Council of Alderaan from a unknown time period before the Great Galactic War that at 3653 BBY was effiged on a statue, alongside Keers Dorana, in the High Council building.
Kerse was a male Sith captain in the Imperial army who was in command of a squad of elite special forces Sith troopers that was in the service of the Sith Lord Darth Malgus.

Makk was a male Sith lieutenant in the Imperial navy who was the bridge weapons officer of the battlecruiser Valor that belonged to the Sith Lord Darth Malgus. Makk was one of the officers under the command of Commander Jard during and immediately after the Sacking of Coruscant.

Kalla was a Jedi Knight during the Great Galactic War. In 3653 BBY, she was present at the Jedi Temple immediately before the attack of the Sith Empire, and was one of the many Jedi to fall during the battle.
This individual was a Force-sensitive member of the Vrassh, a group that was decimated by the Pas'sic.

Bynin was a Jedi Knight present at the Jedi Temple during the Great Galactic War, immediately before the Sith attack. He, alongside Alara, Kursil, Ceras and others, was one of the many Jedi to fall during the battle.
Kursil was a Jedi Knight present at the Jedi Temple during the Great Galactic War, immediately before the Sith Empire's attack. Alongside Alara, Bynin, Ceras and others, he fell during the fighting.
Ceras was a Jedi Knight present at the Jedi Temple during the Great Galactic War, immediately before the Sith Empire's attack. Alongside Alara, Bynin, Kursil and others, he fell during the fighting.
A Force-sensitive Bith Jedi recruit was accepted into the New Jedi Order in 13 ABY. The founder of the Order, Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, was surprised that a Bith was among the recruits.
A male Bith worked as a flight controller at the Jedi Academy on Ossus.
Deron was a mercenary employed by Vrath Xizor in 3653 BBY for the purpose of tracking the smuggler Zeerid Korr.

Keene was a mercenary member of the Vrath Xizor's team in 3653 BBY for the purpose to track the smuggler Zeerid Korr. Keene was Vrath's speeder driver in his team and he picked up the survivors of the team after a skirmish that year.

Kabat was a noted male Twi'lek broker of illicit goods. During the Galactic Civil War, he worked from a base on the planet Corellia. He didn't like smugglers that stole cargoes or skipped out on deals.
Tomer was a male Human who worked as a hangar controller in the Bilbringi Shipyards during the time of the New Republic.
Soolami was a Twi'lek slave and younger sister of Sadelli who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Woff B'tar was a Trandoshan slavemaster who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
A male Quarren assassin and some other fringers participated in an ambush set up for Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian by the bounty hunter Bossk.
A male who was the brother of Five World Deputy Prime Minister Denjax Teppler served the Corellian Security Force in 40 ABY.

In 40 ABY, an individual served as a look-alike body double of Denjax Teppler, the Minister of Justice of the planet Corellia. Teppler was a dark-haired Human male whose features were considered by others to be bland yet handsome and confidence-inspiring.

A Jenet criminal was present in a cantina in the Lizil nest in 35 ABY. Luke Skywalker, Mara Jade Skywalker, and Saba Sebatyne witnessed the Jenet accepting visitors in the cantina during the Swarm War.
Okean was a Jedi Knight, one of the many Jedi to fall during the battle at the Jedi Temple during the Great Galactic War.
Draerd was a Jedi Knight. Draerd was one of the many Jedi to fall during the battle at Jedi Temple during the Great Galactic War.

The Duros Dooku was a male Duros who attended the Galactic Costume Extravaganza held by Elwis Bontraar onboard his ship the Masquerade the year his daughter went missing. The Duros's costume at the party was based on old images of the Sith Lord Count Dooku.
Krass was a male Trandoshan bounty hunter who worked for the Hutts and was a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild.

Rian Ry was a female Human who lived during the Galactic Civil War, working as an official on an orbital navigation station that was located near to the planet Kashyyyk. In circa 1.5 ABY, she put a spacer into contact with the Civilian Protection Guild.
A Nazzar male served as an icecrawler driver on the planet Syned for the Arkadianate in the year 1032 BBY.
This Aqualish was a mercenary working for Attuma Duum around 21 BBY. During that year, the Jedi Knight Aayla Secura attempted to arrest Duum, but she was forced to flee.
This Duros was a mercenary working for Attuma Duum around 21 BBY. During that year, the Jedi Knight Aayla Secura attempted to arrest Duum, but she was forced to flee.
This Gotal was a mercenary working for Attuma Duum around 21 BBY. During that year, the Jedi Knight Aayla Secura attempted to arrest Duum, but she was forced to flee.
This Human male was a mercenary working for Attuma Duum around 21 BBY. During that year, the Jedi Knight Aayla Secura attempted to arrest Duum, but she was forced to flee.
This Trandoshan was a mercenary working for Attuma Duum around 21 BBY. During that year, the Jedi Knight Aayla Secura attempted to arrest Duum, but she was forced to flee.
This individual was a Padawan of the Ho'Din Jedi Knight Iwo Kulka who served in the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A Jedi Master served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi General during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 19 BBY, the Jedi Master was fighting in the conflict alongside their Padawan, the Chalactan Klossi Anno.

This unidentified individual was a Jedi serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. A General within the Grand Army of the Republic, this individual was serving alongside clone troopers when Contingency Order 66 was initiated.
An Imperial Intelligence Agent was a Human male who served in the Imperial Intelligence and was stationed on the Inner Rim world of Poderis.

A Human individual had a twin brother named Sheckil, who was native to Concord Dawn, an Outer Rim Territories planet. By 3 ABY, the individual became a famous mercenary while Sheckil became a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire.
This individual was a Qiraash bartender on the planet Vaced.
Anoura was a female Cerean information broker for the Bothan Businessman Elwis Bontraar. Her death caused her sister Zascha to enact revenge on Elwis and kidnap his daughter.
Anim Kahn was a female Human pilot who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Roon Neele was a male Sith officer of the Imperial Navy in the reconstituted Sith Empire. He acted as an attaché for the Sith Lord Darth Angral during the Sith-martial law occupation of Coruscant immediately after the Sacking of Coruscant.
Keevo was a male Rodian Padawan of the Jedi Order, serving the Galactic Republic at the end of the Great Galactic War and the start of the Cold War with the Sith Empire.
A male Duros mercenary accompanied the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk in an ambush set up for Cloud City Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian.

A Human female mercenary was a non-Force-sensitive member of the Brotherhood of Darkness. She fled from the Seventh Battle of Ruusan after the Army of Light managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the Sith camp.

Mother Ves'ad was the name of the massive queen spider of the wyyyschokk, or webweavers, present in the Webweaver caverns of the Kkowir Forest on the planet Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War in 1.5 ABY.

Shinnan was a Human female from Another Hopetown on Ennth, who was married to Rastur. She had sepia eyes and dark brown hair. She was a friend of Zekk and died during the evacuation process when a groundquake struck.

Shakra was female reptilian bounty hunter who, along with Ailyn Vel, finally corseted Bornan Thul. Thul escaped however aboard Zekk's ship, the Lightning Rod. When he left, he set his ship to self-destruct.
Ma'thu was a Sullustan tactical officer who served the Diversity Alliance.

Gil Kogan was a petty criminal who had a passing resemblance to Hahz Fallone. In order to ingratiate himself with Hahz, he agreed to be a stand-in during a kidnapping attempt by several bounty hunters.

Tag Raynor was a male Clog-dweller. He offered to sell the Black Sphere to a group of bounty hunters by arranging a meet in the Gold Plaza. He was however an employee of Hahz Fallone and was merely setting them up so Jorga Sune would try and get the artifact which was a fake.

Jorga Sune was a male minor crime lord in Iritsa. He was popular in The Clog. He had an intense rivalry with Hahz Fallone due to a business deal that went bad. Hahz had the coordinates to a lost colony world and needed Jorga's assistance to plunder it.

Touler served the Galactic Empire as Fleet Commander in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Touler was present during the assault on Kamino, an attempt by the Rebel Alliance to take out the cloning facilities of the planet Kamino, in 1 BBY.
An Aqualish male served as a senator in the Republic Senate during the Clone Wars. At one point, a Nikto senator rallied the other senators to not show weakness, and this Aqualish agreed.
Gama Bankor was a male Neimoidian diplomat who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the time of the Clone Wars.
"First" was the name given to a female Human by Sith apprentice Vestara Khai. Once enslaved on B'nish, the girl stowed away aboard a Damorian S18 light freighter around 41.5 ABY.

The father of the Dubravan female Nevana owed a large debt to the bounty hunter Sarma in 0 ABY. His daughter tried to clear his debt by selling Sarma the name and location of Luke Skywalker, the pilot who had destroyed the Death Star and was wanted by the Galactic Empire.

A male Dubravan worked as a starship merchant on the planet Dubrava in 0 ABY. That year, the Dubravan sold a starfighter to the Rebel Alliance pilot Jal Te Gniev, who was fleeing from the world to warn Luke Skywalker that the Galactic Empire was on its way to get him on the pl…
Dewlannamapia was a Wookiee who attended the dedication of a memorial portrait to the late Chewbacca at the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Ruku Myal was a male Sith Saber in the Lost Tribe of Sith on Kesh. A good friend of Gavar Khai, Myal participated in an attack on a Damorian S18 light freighter circa 41.5 ABY.
Ivaar Workan was a male Human Sith Lord in the Lost Tribe of Sith who served on the ruling Circle of Lords on the planet Kesh.

Smasher was a mimph who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, Smasher and two other mimphs, led by a fourth, Masher, captured the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick, with Smasher helping by tightening the ropes used to detain him.

Thrasher was a mimph who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. Thrasher was missing a tooth, which had been lost in a fight. In 3 ABY, the mimph helped capture the Ewok Wicket Warrick and bring him back to the mimph village.

Masher was a male mimph from the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, he led a hunting team that captured the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick, who was unconscious due to a fight he had had with a beast known as a hanadak.

This unidentified Sullustan was a male prisoner in the Imperial Correctional Facility on the planet Kessel, sometime during the Galactic Civil War. He befriended the Wookiee prisoner Gyylghrard, giving him several flimsis and a stylus to write a journal.

D'Voras Brin was a Human male smuggler. He was know to work for both sides during the Galactic Civil War, willing to take work from either the Galactic Empire or the Alliance to Restore the Republic if the money was good.
Stannik Nhaa was a young Rebel who teamed up with the Wookiee Gaartatha.
A Wookiee pirate worked for Xishel, a Falleen competing for control of the fractured Nanth'ri Pirates, a loose assortment of brigands who plundered the Nanth'ri Route under Celis Mott.
A Squib spacer was present at a bar called The Maze at some point during the Galactic Civil War. When a would-be Rebel Alliance operative bumped into the Squib, she yammered angrily at the bumbler.
This Sith trooper was a member of the army secretly assembled in 138 ABY by Darth Krayt, Dark Lord of the One Sith.
An informant told the Rebel Alliance where to find a hidden Imperial base on the planet Vatleria.
This unidentified Twi'lek was a crime lord who lived sometime during the Galactic Civil War. The Twi'lek once visited the Imperial Correctional Facility on the planet Kessel.

Shenes was a Human Imperial Navy Captain loyal to Emperor Roan Fel, whom Shenes regarded as the true Emperor. In 138 ABY, Shenes commanded the Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer Fist of the Empire during the Battle of Coruscant.
Burner was an Advanced Recon Commando and clone trooper captain who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
A Human female worked as a nurse at a medical facility on the galactic capital planet Coruscant during the Great Galactic War.
Tal was a male Human nurse who was working at a medical facility on the galactic capital planet of Coruscant shortly after the Sacking of Coruscant in 3653 BBY.

A Human male merchant tended a warehouse located on the planet Vulta that contained medical supplies. In the year 3653 BBY, the man, who was a former nurse, sold smuggler Zeerid Korr a hoverchair and a course on how to run it.
