This unidentified Mandalorian mercenary was a male commander sometime in 5.1 ABY. He and around six hundred Mandalorians were hired by the Galactic Empire to defend a certain planet in an Inner Rim system, with explicit orders to deny it to the New Republic.

Ree Ohr was a Galactic Republic-affiliated female Human xenobiotics specialist active during the Clone Wars. In 20 BBY, they were stationed on the planet Drongar, the site of a battle between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Gwend was an individual who deserted the Galactic Empire. He helped several Askajians, including Borno, escape their homeworld of Askaj, which was being oppressed by the Imperial Grand Moff Wilkadon, and relocate to the desert planet Tatooine.

This Wookiee lived in the settlement Kiirloor on the planet Cularin during the time of the Clone Wars, with his mate Risstenni and their son Chywarra. In circa 21 BBY, Chywarra was abducted by the Wyrd and Risstenni was captured by them while searching for her son.
In around 21 BBY female Tarasin was killed and transformed into a dark side spirit by the Wyrd witch coven.

A Clawdite shape-shifter bounty hunter took the identity of the Galactic Republic Clone trooper Sharp during the Clone Wars during the Mission to Kynachi in 22 BBY. The Clawdite joined Breakout Squad and Padawan Nuru Kungurama along with the crew of the vessel Hasty Harpy.

Zaboshka was a male Toydarian engineer who was known around Kashyyyk's Royal City as an informant of information to whoever paid enough credits. In 21 BBY, he was present at a spaceport on Kashyyyk, where he met youngling Jaylen Kos and Jedi Master Bant Eerin's Padawan.

A captain, in the employ of the Zann Consortium, was responsible for the unauthorized extortion of Mandal Hypernautics on Mandalore that led to the acquisition of the Keldabe-class battleship and the Canderous-class assault tank by the Zann Consortium.
An Unidentified Sith Lord was present on board the Star Destroyer War Hammer during the Attack on the Hidden Temple, and acted as the Sith overseer to the crew of the War Hammer.

Zherriak was a Wookiee who hailed from the planet Kashyyyk. For a long time, they lived a peaceful life, maintaining a close friendship with their hunting partner, the Wookiee Liak, with whom they had sworn an honor bond.

Langu Sommilor was a male individual who was the Commissioner of Kynachi. During the Clone Wars in 21 BBY, his planet was liberated from a ten-year Techno Union occupation by the Galactic Republic's Breakout Squad.

Priam was an Imperial Admiral in 0 ABY who was sent to the planet Troska with a commendation for Lieutenant Treyz Manech, who had uncovered the corruption of the Kyber family and the rogue Imperial officer Sev Buzk.

The mother of Jowdrrl was a female Wookiee. Jowdrrl's mother once advised her that dropping a Wroshyr louse on any male Wookiee she desired and then offering to groom his fur would betrothe him to her forever.

Vollen Sor was a male Jedi Knight of the Old Republic in 3653 BBY. Sor and Keevo, his Rodian Padawan, were on the planet Alderaan during the Alderaan peace conference between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

A shaggy-haired individual was a Wookiee who lived in a village on the Mid Rim planet of Kashyyyk, and was a member of the village's tribe. At some point in 22 BBY, several residents of the village were kidnapped by the bounty hunter Crovan Dane.
An Imperial officer led the Imperial troops in an attack on the Rebel forces on Lubang Minor. The officer was killed by the clone trooper BL-1707.

Lem Krarr was a Human male criminal during the early years of the New Republic. Krarr had a substantial bounty on his head, totaling ten thousand alive and six thousand dead. In 13 ABY, Kir Kanos tracked down Krarr and delivered him to the authorities alive.
Orykan Tamarik was a female Rutian Twi'lek Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during Supreme Chancellor Thoris Darus' administration.
This individual was a male Human that was exiled to the Undercity on the ecumenopolis world of Taris for crimes against the government of Taris. He was the father of Rukil.
This individual was a male Human that was exiled to the Undercity on the ecumenopolis world of Taris for crimes against the government of Taris. He was the grandfather of Rukil.

A Human female Jedi Knight served the Jedi Order during the time of the Great Galactic War. In 3653 BBY, a Sith Imperial force led by Sith Lord Darth Malgus launched an attack on the Jedi Temple on the capital planet Coruscant.
Raahan Ma'ase was a male Kel Dor who lived in the city Dor'shan on the planet Dorin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Sashal was a Keshiri female who served as a Sith Lady of the Lost Tribe of Sith, one whom sat on their Circle of Lords. According to a source, Sashal was a petite woman, and according to Grand Lord Darish Vol, she was stupid.

Krin Koda was a legendary scout in the early years of the Galactic Empire. At some point, he discovered Koda's World, a planet which was eventually named after him, and saved the native sentient species Tempestro from a ravaging disease.

For more than a thousand years, the malevolent spirit of a long-dead Sith Master served as the protector of an ancient spellbook forgotten within a hidden armory of dark side lore deep in the jungles of the planet Onderon.

Raice Liq was a male Muun spy stationed on the planet Coruscant, who operated on behalf of the InterGalactic Banking Clan President San Hill at the time of the Clone Wars. Liq's job was essentially to gather information about weapons used by troops of the Galactic Republic.
A Mon Calamari male droid supervisor gave orders to droids working at the Star Tours spaceport, including R2-D7 and I.D.A., a droid that was difficult to motivate..
A number of members of the Mon Calamari species worked at two different Star Tours travel company ports over the years.

Brug D'Shar was a male Sakiyan who worked as an aide-de-camp to Senior Counselor Westa Impeveri. During the time of the Clone Wars, D'Shar participated in a discussion on the nature of the benefits and problems caused to the planet Cularin by the world's platform cities.

Kaguya was a female Tarasin who lived on the planet Cularin. During the Clone Wars, Kaguya participated in a discussion on the nature of the benefits and problems caused to Cularin by the world's platform cities.

Mirt was a male Bothan from the planet of Thaere Privo. During the Clone Wars, Mirt participated in a discussion on the nature of the benefits and problems caused to Cularin by the world's platform cities.
Pac was an alias that was used by a male Cerean who served as a private in the Cularin Militia during the time of the Clone Wars.
Grunt was an alias that was used by a male Trandoshan who served as a private in the Cularin Militia during the time of the Clone Wars.
Liora was a female Human High Priestess who lived on the planet Telos IV during the reign of the Galactic Republic.
Blak was a male individual who worked for the organization of the Oblee crime lord Nirama during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Varrak was a Human female SOB agent who worked for the Galactic Republic.

Raxl was the male research assistant of Bant'ena Fhernan's, and occasionally her lover, during the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY, Raxl traveled with a group of scientists to Taratos IV in order to carry out investigations.

Ilim Fhernan was a Human male who was the brother of Bant'ena Fhernan, and had a wife and child during the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY, he was kidnapped by General Lok Durd in order to force Bant'ena to develop a bioweapon for the Confederacy of Independent Systems (CIS).

Samsam was a Human male Corellian scientist who was a friend to Bant'ena Fhernan during the Clone Wars. As Bant'ena was captured by the separatists in 21 BBY, Samsam was used as leverage against Bant'ena under Lok Durd's command.

Tam was a male Human and the younger brother of Irek. During the Clone Wars, General Lok Durd showed a hologram of the two children playing in the park and warned Bant'ena that if she refused to help the Separatists, he would kill them.

Irek was the young Human nephew of the scientist Bant'ena Fhernan, and the older brother ofto Tam. During the Clone Wars, Lok Durd showed a hologram of the two children playing in the park and warned Bant'ena that if she refused to help the Separatists, he would kill them.

Darth Nox, formerly known as Kallig, also known by the call sign Rage, and by the titles Heir of Tulak Hord and Kallig and Master of the Dead, and worshiped as the Great Dragon by the Cult of the Screaming Blade, was a powerful Dark Lord of the Sith that served the Sith Empire…
Racket was a Human male clone commando created on the planet Kamino from the genetic template of Jango Fett.
Salld Nrump was a male Sullustan who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
This garage owner lived on Klatooine, who acquired the Klatooinian Barada from his parents. Barada was sold due to being a disrespectful child and became the garage owner's indentured servant.
Yarian Kak was a male Cerean who worked as a trade advocate for the Metatheran Cartel during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Drom Virbilge was a male individual who worked for the Thaereian military during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, serving as a captain in Thaereian Military Special Ops.

A Trandoshan individual was an arms dealer who worked with the Human Weazel on Tatooine in 32 BBY. The two were set up at the trading site Mochot Steep when the Trandoshan was shot in the head and killed by an advancing Tusken Raider party who then attacked the site.
Renning was a corpulent male Human Sith Lord and the Sith Master of Malora and Dominique who had many resources made available to him by the Dark Council so that he could further the Sith knowledge.

Darth Malora was a female Human Dark Lord of the Sith of the reconstituted Sith Empire who originally served as an apprentice to Lord Renning during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Asteria was a minor crime lord active during the Galactic Civil War. The criminal operated from a fortified townhouse. Soon after being exiled from the planet Kashyyyk, the Wookiee Snoova worked as an indentured mercenary for her.
A Sullustan executive once hired the mercenary group known as Aurodium Sword to protect him. While under the organization's care, the Sullustan came under fire from an industrial assassination squad.

A Wookiee mercenary served as a member of the group known as Aurodium Sword Executive Security at some point during the Galactic Civil War. On one assignment, the mercenary joined a rogue ARC trooper known as Muzzle and fellow Wookiee Snoova to protect a Sullustan executive.

Gaharrag was an adult male Wookiee who indulged in a life of crime prior to the Second Galactic Civil War. His spree of murder was brought to an end by the Jedi Tahiri Veila, and Gaharrag earned a prison term at the Armand Isard Correctional Facility.
Furan was a Mon Calamari male criminal of ill repute who operated just prior to the Second Galactic Civil War.

Leurm was a male Hutt who lived life as a notorious murderer prior to the Second Galactic Civil War. His criminal tendencies were curtailed by the intervention of the Jedi Tahiri Veila, which saw Leurm sentenced to a prison term in the Armand Isard Correctional Facility.
Dolo Karenzi was a male sergeant of the Galactic Alliance. He was stationed on the planet Borleias after the Second Galactic Civil War.

Hallaf was a Human male smuggler who owned Meliflar Station. After Abeloth's visit to the station and her infection of his daughter, Fala, his crew, led by Cardya, mutinied against him. He was put into the brig along with his daughter.
Cardya was a female Human smuggler who owned Meliflar Station. In 44 ABY, Cardya was part of a group that was sent to Luke Skywalker, Ben Skywalker, and Vestara Khai and capture the Jade Shadow.
Vez was a male Rodian corporal of the Galactic Alliance stationed on the planet Borleias after the Second Galactic Civil War.

Morton was a male Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, serving sergeant within the Office of Peace and Security, a law enforcement agency that operated on the planet Cularin.

This Imperial major was affected to the Chimaera during the Thrawn campaign and served under Grand Admiral Thrawn. He led the strike team which landed on Myrkr to capture Luke Skywalker. His stormtroopers eventually caught him in the Great Northern Forest.

Sallinor Parova was a Human female who replaced Admiral Nek Bwua'tu as Chief of Naval Operations of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances. In 44 ABY, she also became a conspirator in a dual coup against the Imperial Remnant and the Galactic Alliance.

Taru Durn was a male Theran and Oldtimer, as well as the head of the healer hall of Hweg Shul, Nam Chorios. A Master Theran Listener, he taught Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker the technique of mnemotherapy.

Nenn was a male Oldtimer and senior Master of the Theran Listeners. He was taken by Abeloth and used as a way to turn the Oldtimers and the Theran Listeners against the Skywalkers and Khai who pursued her.
Querdan Dei was a male Human born on Kesh in 4 ABY. He had become a Sith Saber by 44 ABY, and was usually assigned to difficult assignments that were often unrewarding.
Cura was a female Theran Listener adept whose dead body was, in 44 ABY, discovered by her fellow Therans with signs of what appeared to be torture.

Cagaran Wei was a male scientist and doctor who lived in Hweg Shul, the capital city of Nam Chorios. For twenty years, he was married to a woman jeweler who died in a landspeeder accident. A Latecomer, Doctor Wei disappeared inexplicably in 44 ABY without a trace.

Javon Thewles was a male Human who served as a lieutenant in Galactic Alliance Security. In 44 ABY, he became romantically involved with Jedi Knight Seha Dorvald, who was known to him as pilot "Sela Dorn." When Dorvald was named as a suspect in the attempted murder of multiple…

Casieck Akinslesh was a respected member of the Jedi Order in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Akinslesh's death in 53 BBY was mourned by Grand Master Yoda and the Jedi High Council, as well as Orykan Tamarik, the Twi'lek Padawan Akinslesh had been training.

This unidentified mechanic settled on Nam Chorios around 29 ABY. Having previously served the Imperial Navy, he restored several Imperial vessels and sold them to private owners. Snaplaunce purchased a disarmed TIE/sh VIP shuttle from him and named it Vote Snaplaunce.
Hunor was a Falleen male who served as Captain of the Galactic Alliance CC-7700 frigate Fireborn and supported the Imperial-Alliance conspiracy.

Grunel Ovin was a male Klatooinian freedom fighter who led the anti-slavery organization known as the Sapience Defense Front. In 44 ABY, Ovin was arrested by forces of the Galactic Alliance and taken into custody onboard the CC-7700 frigate Fireborn.
Tola Annax was a female Keshiri Sith Saber in the Lost Tribe of Sith from the planet of Kesh. She served under Gavar Khai and led the Sith forces on the ground during the Battle on Nam Chorios.
A Human male worked on Coruscant during the Clone Wars as a power generator engineer. He was killed in an attack on the Coruscant power generator.
Fuzzy was a nickname given by Han Solo to a Bothan who served as Chief of State Natasi Daala's secretary in 44 ABY.
In 44 ABY, a female Quarren Alliance Security Corporal was stationed outside the Galactic Senate Rotunda, effecting crowd control during the Jedi coup of the Galactic Alliance.
Tuvar was a Human male journalist who was on assignment for Independent Voice News at the Galactic Senate Rotunda during the Jedi coup of the Galactic Alliance.

Kandra Nilitz was a humanoid female journalist with yellow colored skin who was on assignment for Landing Zone NewsNet at the Galactic Senate Rotunda during Plan Delta. She worked with camera operator Beurth Ogh.
A female ambassador of the Hapes Consortium was present in the Chief of State when the Jedi Order enacted their coup against the Galactic Alliance.
Zeiers was a Human female who served as a lieutenant within Galactic Alliance Security.

Deggan Rockbender was a Human male who served as the Senator for Tatooine in the Galactic Alliance. In 44 ABY, he spoke out against slavery and introduced the Senate for a request on trade goods that were produced in areas with legalized slavery.
Padnel Ovin was a male Klatooinian freedom fighter who assumed leadership of the Sapience Defense Front following the death of his brother and predecessor, Grunel.
Nialle Aker was a female Chev freedom fighter who served as the aide to Padnel Ovin, leader of the Sapience Defense Front.

Reni Coll was a female Klatooinian freedom fighter and leader of the Freedom Advocacy Movement. In 44 ABY, she took part in negotiations with the Galactic Alliance that addressed the previous slave revolts on Klatooine.
Azmar Huun was a male Human from Tatooine and a member of the radical Freedom Flight anti-slavery organization.

Beurth Ogh was a Gamorrean male camera operator who, alongside journalist Kandra Nilitz, who was on assignment for Landing Zone NewsNet at the Galactic Senate Rotunda during the Jedi coup of the Galactic Alliance.
Hara was a Keshiri female who served the Sith of the Lost Tribe under the command of the Sith Saber Querdan Dei.
Raharra Lapti was a female Klatooinian youngling.

The legendary Neti Jedi Master T'ra Saa sacrificed herself to create an opening in the Sith-Imperial fleet for her allies to escape the Jedi Hidden Temple on the planet Taivas during the Sith attack there in 138 ABY.

Sazat was a Keshiri male who served as the archive analyst on the Cryptic Warning. During a mission, Sazat presented his findings of the diplomatic meeting on the planet, which was also attended by Tenel Ka.
Viti was a Human female who served the Sith of the Lost Tribe onboard the Cryptic Warning.
Otha Tevarkian was a Human male attorney hired to represent deposed Galactic Alliance Chief of State Natasi Daala.
Yasvan was a female Saber of the Lost Tribe of Sith.
Lev Kepzen was the captain of the Galactic Empire's EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Feral sometime around 0 ABY.
Osaji Varane was a male Human who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Varane worked for the Osaji Syndicate, a criminal organization that was ran by his father, Osaji Shimka.

Currsk was a male Trandoshan who worked as a bounty hunter, along with his brother, Keerag. After the Human Deggar Feps angered the Hutt Sonnos, Feps attempted to travel from the planet Nal Hutta to the moon Nar Shaddaa, by gaining passage aboard the starship Lost Lady.

Keerag was a Trandoshan male. Both he and his brother Currsk were bounty hunters. After the Human Deggar Feps angered the Hutt Sonnos, Feps attempted to travel from the planet of Nal Hutta to its moon, Nar Shaddaa, by gaining passage aboard the starship Lost Lady.

Skerrick Das was a male Corellian pirate. On one occasion, Das was present on the planet Nal Hutta and he sought passage aboard the Dartiss-5 Caravel Lost Lady to the moon Nar Shaddaa, where he planned to rejoin his starship.

Sarlacc-Face was a Clone Lieutenant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems that spanned from 22 BBY to 19 BBY.
A Human female with brown hair was an Imperial Knight in 138 ABY. During the Attack on the Hidden Temple, she served under Master Treis Sinde aboard a Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer

Fala was a Force-sensitive Human female who lived on Meliflar Station in the Mendenbatt system. She was the daughter of Hallaf, a smuggler who owned the station. After Abeloth visited the station, she infected Fala with her dark side energy.

Darth Mekhis was a Human female Dark Lord of the Sith of the resurgent Sith Empire who served as the head of the Sphere of Technology during the entire Great Galactic War and most of the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.
Hahz Fallone was a minor crime lord who operated out of Iritsa on the planet Chazwa. He was a rival to Jorga Sune, who felt that Hahz had betrayed him on an earlier raid on the planet Eckless.

This individual was appointed a Moff in the Galactic Empire and given responsibility for the Morshdine sector. The Moff oversaw construction of an Imperial Intelligence Ubiqtorate center on Tangrene, a planet in the sector's Tangrene system.
Garit was an individual who served as a member of the Believers, a Sith cult that was based in the Cularin system.
Imber was an individual who served as a member of the Believers, a Sith cult that was based in the Cularin system.

Vellna was a male Ithorian who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Vellna worked in the Gadrin wilderness outfitter shop Life Vines, as an assistant to store's owner, Lowban Terlq.
Lujei was a female Human who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, working in the resort city Rorkee.
Syo Bakarn was a Human male Corellian Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a healer during the Great Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Bela Kiwiiks was a female Togruta Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War, the Cold War, and the Galactic War with the resurgent Sith Empire.
Jaric Kaedan was a Human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire.

Corrsk was a Trandoshan who lived on the planet Genarius during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Corrsk and fellow Trandoshan Dussk owned and operated the cantina Riboga's Barge, a sail barge that was formerly owned by the Hutt Riboga.

Hyx Modant was a male Bothan who served in the Thaereian military as a colonel. During the time of the Clone Wars, Modant represented the Thaereians during a panel discussion on the subject of whether the Thaereian military should continue to be involved in the affairs of the …

Slillek was a male Tarasin scout who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He was a member of the Hiironi irstat and in circa 31 BBY, Slillek was assigned to guide the Heroes of Cularin to Cularin's Ishkik caverns.

Sparkle was the name given to a cu-pa owned by the family of Thei, a female Human from Nam Chorios. When Thei was five years old, she and her mother rode Sparkle from their farmstead to Ruby Gulch. Two days later, only Thei returned with no memory of what happened.

Ojim Srellq was a male individual who was a member of the Metatheran Cartel during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Circa 31 BBY, a number of Srellq's cargo shipments were stolen by the Rock Rogues, a pirate group that operated in the Cularin system.

Thei was a female Human farmer living on Nam Chorios. When Thei was five years old, she and her mother rode her cu-pa Sparkle from their farmstead to Ruby Gulch. Two days later, only Thei returned, with no memory of what happened.

Thei's mother was a female Human farmer living on Nam Chorios, mother of Thei. When Thei was five years old, she and Thei rode her cu-pa Sparkle from their farmstead to Ruby Gulch. Two days later, only Thei returned with no memory of what happened.
Thei's husband was a male Human Newcomer who worked as a speeder mechanic on the planet Nam Chorios. He was the husband of Thei, a woman who needed help from Theran Listener.

This snowspeeder pilot was a member of the Rebel Alliance. During a battle with Imperial walkers, the pilot warned a Star Tours travel agency vessel to stay clear of the area when the ship accidentally flew directly into the combat zone.

Robbi was a male street kid who lived in Forard, on the planet Almas. In circa 31 BBY, Lavina Wren, the senator of the Cularin system, became engaged to the former Jedi Jarid DeBell, and the pair planned to marry in Forard.

In 44 ABY, a male Sullustan inmate resided in the Armand Isard Correctional Facility. He, along with several other prisoners led by the Mon Calamari thief Furan, confronted former Jedi Tahiri Veila, but was soundly beaten.
A female Chev served as a scheduling secretary for Chief of State Natasi Daala in 44 ABY. The secretary was present during a Jedi coup in that year.
Furan's buddy was an unidentified male criminal that was part of the criminal gang Furan's social club and in 41 ABY, was arrested with his boss by Jedi Tahiri Veila.

An Aqualish was a Sith student who attended the academy on Korriban. Along with two other Sith prospectors, the Aqualish was supposed to stand where he was and prove himself worthy to enter the academy.
Ven was a clone trooper sergeant who fought at the planet Kothlis during the Clone Wars. When the battle was over he coordinated the troops with Sergeant Ando and Captain Drayk.
A Padawan served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Darth Vindican was a male Pureblood Sith Lord who served the Sith Empire in the early days of the Great Galactic War.
Kao Cen Darach was a Zabrak male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the years preceding the Great Galactic War in 3681 BBY.
Nico Okarr was a male Human smuggler captain who achieved great fame in the years before the start of the Great Galactic War.

A male slicer operated in the Cularin system. During the time of the Clone Wars, the slicer traveled to Artom Station with the Dark Jedi Garth Ezzar and hacked into the computer system of the Comet Broom Service, altering the company's navigational data and planting a Trojan p…
A Human male Imperial Advisor was a member of the Ruling Council of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Veris was a tattooed, female Human who underwent surgery to make her look like a Devaronian, and she acted as a double for Ushka Et, the Devaronian leader singer of the band Distraction.
Tzeel was a female Human who was a member of the band Distraction, serving as the band's percussionist. She traveled to the Hutt yacht after the band was hired to perform aboard the ship.

Kloofus was a male Gran who served as the second-in-command of the transport Skinchanger. The starship was captained by the Clawdite Prit Kessek, a courier who worked for the Zygerrian slavers, and Kloofus accompanied the craft when it traveled to Bazarre, a space station in t…
Cale Herron was a male Zabrak slicer who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

Jarad Gastin was a male Sullustan officer of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Lieutenant Gastin was stationed on the planet Tatooine and operated out of a tavern in the city of Anchorhead.

Blackie was a male individual who lived in the city Tolea Biqua, on the planet Genarius in the Cularin system. During the time of the Clone Wars, Blackie recorded a monologue, in which he discussed Rufus Trammel, a crime lord who was leaving the Cularin system.
Pierce was a Human male who served as a black ops in the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Blizz was the nickname of a male Jawa who traveled with the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt, a bounty hunter during the Cold War.
Jarg Fleffant was an individual who served in the Gadrin division of the Office of Peace and Security, a Cularin-based law enforcement agency, holding the rank of corporal.
Levi Schoen was an androgyne Alderaanian holovid star who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Tam was an Iyra who lived on the planet Krinemonen III. When Tam's cousin, the sentientologist Tem Eliss, fled persecution by the Galactic Empire, who were angry over his pro-alien attitudes, Tam gave the scientist safe haven.

Teff'ith was a female Twi'lek slaver who lived during the Cold War. She is reputed to be a hired killer for Rogun the Butcher, stolen for the Migrant Merchants' Guild, slaving for the Black Sun and affiliated with the Ziost Liberation Front.
Ngani Zho was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War and Cold War against the Sith Empire.
The father of Bungo Bung owned a boaboo fungus farm that produced boaboo juice. His son would sell the resulting product in the markets of G'rinn Go city.

This male Human was the son of doctor Cagaran Wei who lived in Hweg Shul, the capital city of Nam Chorios. A few years after his mother died in a landspeeder accident, Wei's son went to Corellia to study medicine.
This unidentified male was the mechanic of Doctor Cagaran Wei on the planet Nam Chorios.
Gelpog the Tyrant was the warlord of several asteroid-occupied hives. During the Great Galactic War, the designs of Gelpog were challenged by the efforts of the Jedi Knights of the Galactic Republic.

During the Galactic Civil War, a friend of Dasha Defano's was traveling on a civilian transport when it was attacked by privateers. The band destroyed the transport to stop it sending out a distress signal.
The father of Dolo Karenzi was a spacer. His son, Dolo Karenzi, was a sergeant in the Galactic Alliance.

S'itl Thirr was a male Abinyshi, short, thin, and reptilian like other members of his species. During the Galactic Civil War, Thirr visited the office of the Iyra sentientologist Tem Eliss in the University of Sanbra's Sentient Studies Department in an effort to dispel misinfo…
At some point during the Galactic Civil War, an Iyra with at least five tentacles was suspended in a cage at a cantina known as Shilley's on the planet Questal.
Theras was a male prophet who served as the original leader of the Theran Listeners, a Force-based organization that operated on the planet Nam Chorios.

Jos was a male Human from the planet of Lianna who lived during the time of the New Republic. Jos served as an engineer aboard the freighter G'mi Moa and was sold into slavery after the ship was captured by the pirate Gunda Mabin.

A Barabel was a male prisoner and trustee guard in the Imperial Correctional Facility on the planet Kessel, sometime during the Galactic Civil War. He only had one eye and was known to be very brutal to the prisoners.

A male Human bounty hunter followed retired bounty hunter Garris Shrike for the bounty on Han Solo's alias, Vykk Draygo. After tracking Solo down through Shrike on Coruscant, he shot and killed Shrike. However, Solo proved too much for the mercenary.
This Tunroth joined the crew of the Far Orbit, a Rebel privateer Nebulon-B Escort Frigate aligned with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Ariella was an individual who lived on the planet Almas during the time of the Clone Wars, taking care of seventy abandoned children.

Tryn was a male Bothan who lived in the city Tolea Biqua on the planet Genarius. In about 19 BBY, a number of members of the Believers, a Sith cult that operated in the Cularin system, were sighted in Tolea Biqua.

Bunurrut was a male individual who served in the Peace Brigade during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Bunurrut was the captain of the Corellian gunship Vigor and at some point during the conflict, Bunurrut led the Vigor and the YV-929 armed freighter Blunt Force during a scheme to pose …
A Human male street vendor worked in the streets of a settlement on Gus Talon, a moon of Corellia, in 2 BBY. Mala knocked over and broke several of the glass sculptures he was selling.
Jayshon Korden was a male member of the noble house House Korden who became a Jedi Master during the time of the Galactic Republic.

Haddius Korden was a male merchant from the planet of Corulag who lived during the time of the Galactic Republic. In about 12,000 BBY, Korden reformed his family's business into Korden Outfitting and Surveying, a firm that supplied equipment to colonists.
Jent Koush was an Imperial lieutenant who was stationed on the planet Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Rone Mothin was a male Human who served as a New Republic Army officer. In 9 ABY, Rone Mothin was commander of the New Republic garrison on Sheris. He defended the planet when the Imperial forces attacked it during the Thrawn campaign.
295.902/V8 was the designation of a Human officer who served in the Imperial Army and held the ranks of Major and Commander.
Cha was a male Rellarin in the service of the Galactic Republic. By circa 3643 BBY, he had ascended to the rank of major. He was killed the same year during Independent Operation Sebaddon.

A secretary worked for Imperial Remnant Head of State Jagged Fel in his offices on Coruscant, the capital planet of the Galactic Alliance. In 44 ABY, Jedi Knight Jaina Solo, Fel's fiancée, arrived at the offices for a visit.

This unidentified prisoner was a female Wookiee who was sent to the Imperial Correctional Facility a few years before the Galactic Civil War. Even though she was young for Wookiee standards, she became the leader of the group comprised of other young Wookiee prisoners.

Kiyr Gir'sku was a female Bothan noble who was one of the most prominent organic members of the Droid Equality Foundation, a large and powerful droid rights group. A master litigator, Gir'sku took on large court cases on the Foundation's behalf.
Tsillog was a male Quarren ambassador who participated in peace negotiations between the Quarren and the Mon Calamari.

Loodux was an insane male Rodian assassin. At some point during galactic history, the Mon Calamari ambassador Nuukol hired Loodux to murder the Quarren Tsillog outside the Quarren embassy. However, Loodux's assassination attempt failed and he was defeated by a group of agents.

Bandor Ootka was a male Aqualish spy who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. At some point during the conflict, Ootka stayed at a Separatist safe-house on the planet of Clak'dor VII while on leave from a Techno Union starship.

Doon Gorot was a male Duros weapon smuggler who lived during the time of the Clone Wars. Gorot acted as a go-between for a crime lord who was working for the Confederacy of Independent Systems and at some point during the conflict, Gorot traveled to a Separatist safe-house on …
Tarzen Tagge was a Human male crime lord from the planet Tepasi who lived during the time of the Galactic Republic.

Halven was a Human male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Republic. Halven was the brother of Tarzen Tagge, the owner of the Tagge Company. At Halven's suggestion, Tagge attempted to locate and mine resources, to grant TaggeCo its own supply chain.

The mutant womprat was a large womp rat that lived on Tatooine in 0 BBY. It was believed to be the result of unspecified radiation testing carried out at a secret Imperial base. It escaped the laboratory and terrorized Tusken Raiders for months prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Chelah Voh was a female Ho'Din who became caught up in the hunt for the missing Devaronian Brinaloy N'Vaari during the Galactic Civil War.

N'Vaari was the Provincial Governor of Le Yer until assassinated at the order of A'jidre Skrigatov, who coveted his position. Five years later, Skrigatov sought to marry N'Vaari's granddaughter, Brinaloy.

Maxin Davers was a male Human Republic trooper member of the Forty-fifth Battalion serving the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War. Davers fought during the Battle of Rhen Var and was severally wounded in battle.
A Human male lived on the planet Greater Marianas in the Outer Rim Territories. He was a yaggie man for forty years.
Blackie was a thief who, with his partner Cravel, took over a junkyard in Vorrnti City with the intention of using a derelict AT-AT walker it contained to steal some spice.

Cravel was a thief who, along with his partner Blackie, commandeered a junkyard in Vorrnti City with the intention of fixing up a derelict AT-AT it contained and using the Imperial walker to steal some spice.

Nym's Girlfriend was a female pharple native to the planet Lok that lived during the Galactic Civil War. It was named after the leader of the Lok Revenants Nym by a rival group, the Sulfur Lake Pirates.

A clone trooper served in the Grand Army of the Republic as a lieutenant on the planet Drongar in 20 BBY. During his stay on the planet, the lieutenant witnessed the explosion of a carrier transporting bota, a plant with substantial medicinal qualities.

A Gungan harvester served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars on the planet Drongar. Around 20 BBY, the Gungan harvested bota, a local plant that was able to cure several diseases, for the Republic.
A stormtrooper served in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. He was ordered to shoot a yaggie man.

Spanner was a clone trooper corporal who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. They were stationed in the Jedi Temple hangar with Sergeant Joker. The sergeant often told jokes to pass the time, which Spanner often did not understand.
An eye patch-wearing Human lived on the planet Greater Marianas, where he was shot by a young Human.
In 32 BBY, a Draag supervisor worked in the hangar of Haugg Nerf Industries in the industrial district of the planet Coruscant.

In 32 BBY, a Guineo guard worked in the hangar of Haugg Nerf Industries in the industrial district of the planet Coruscant. While the Guineo was still new to the job, a speeder arrived that the worker assumed contained nerf meat.

Kea Moll's father was a native of the Outer Rim planet Annoo. During the early years of the Galactic Empire, he lived on a farm with his partner, Demma Moll, and their daughter, Kea. He was killed on a mission for the local resistance cell sometime before 15 BBY.

This guard was a member of the Fromm Gang criminal organization during the early years of the Galactic Empire. In 19 BBY the guard caught the young Humans Kea Moll and Jord Dusat attempting to sneak aboard gang leader Sise Fromm's starship.
A Human male served as the leader of the Nightsisters' Lizard Keepers in 31 BBY. That year, he was killed by Jedi Knight Quinlan Vos, who was on a mission to Dathomir.
A young princess was kidnapped by skyboat pirates in the years prior to the Invasion of Naboo. She was later rescued on Xoman III by the Jedi Knight Quinlan Vos and his Padawan Aayla Secura.
Marcus Trant, known to his subordinates simply as the Director, was a Human male spy for the Galactic Republic who notably served as Director of the Strategic Information Service (SIS).
Nason was a female Human who was the youngest daughter of Crion, governor of the planet Telos IV. Her brother was Xanatos, a Padawan of the Jedi Order. She was considered to be a Telosian princess.

Spindrall was a male Human Sith Master adherent of the Sith Order during the Great Galactic War. By the time of the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, Spindrall was an elder Sith prophet and Lord who had made his home on the Sith's holy w…
Ydnen was a male Padawan of the Jedi Order. He was able to use the Force to run horizontally along walls, combining telekinesis and Force speed in order to achieve this feat.
Borke Valkanhayn was a criminal trader from the planet Kalab.

Koren Buck was a con artist active on the planet Glova. He used to play himself up as the galaxy's greatest warrior. He demanded only 200 credits up front for his services, with 800 upon completion of a successful job.
Alistay Vaganon was a woman who came to Glova in answer to Governor Byrg's invitation. However, she was unhappy with the facilities and was looking for a change of setting.
Writ Tsall was a mercenary who has found his way to the planet Glova after a variety of misadventures.

A Rodian male was incarcerated on the prison-world of Kiffex and resided in the city of Deadend. In 30 BBY, his cloak was stolen by the criminal Vilmarh Grahrk for Jedi Knight Quinlan Vos, and the Rodian attempted to retrieve it from Vos at the Black Hole cantina.

A Whiphid male was incarcerated on the prison-world of Kiffex and resided in the city of Deadend. In 30 BBY, he attacked Jedi Knight Quinlan Vos at the Black Hole cantina but was put to sleep by the Jedi.
A Human male officer was stationed on a pleasure cruiser commanded by Captain Quasar before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

A male Human served the Galactic Republic on the planet Drongar in 20 BBY. While at Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7, the Human witnessed an explosion of a bota carrier and, together with a clone and an Ishi Tib technician speculated what had caused the explosion.

A male Ishi Tib technician served the Galactic Republic on the planet Drongar in 20 BBY. While at Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7, the Ishi Tib witnessed an explosion of a bota carrier and, together with a clone and a Human speculated what had caused the explosion.
An officer served the Galactic Empire and announced the Imperial protection of Greater Marianas.
Garvan Spasso was a criminal trader on the planet Kalab.
A Caamasi male member of the A clan mated with a female of the Kla clan, resulting in the birth of Elegos A'Kla.
A Caamasi female member of the Kla clan mated with a male of the A clan, resulting in the birth of Elegos A'Kla. This Caamasi was also the sibling of famed Jedi Knight Ylenic It'kla.
A training officer trained recruits to become stormtroopers.

A Human stormtrooper served in the Galactic Empire's 501st Legion. In 0 BBY, he served aboard Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader's flagship, the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator, and took part in the Devastator attack on the Alliance to Restore the Republic's CR90 cor…
A dreadlocked Human was executed by a stormtrooper.

Daw Sembian was a male Twi'lek weaponsmith who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was the father of Vil Sembian. When he died, he left his son a schematic for a new type of blaster which could tip the scales in the Galactic Civil War.

During the time of the New Republic, an Amaran bursa dealer on the planet Coruscant showed a bursa, a creature native to the swamps of the planet Naboo, to a Pacithhip buyer who was interested in reselling the beast to Hutts.

During the time of the New Republic, a female Pacithhip buyer considered purchasing a creature known as a bursa from an Amaran dealer on the planet Coruscant. The Pacithhip was considering reselling the beast to Hutts.

While another Amaran negotiated the sale of a creature known as a bursa with an interested Pacithhip buyer, an Amaran child prostrated between the legs of the bursa in question and talked with a Veknoid.

On the planet Coruscant during the time of the New Republic, a Veknoid wearing a purple vest and purple shorts was addressed by a young member of the Amaran species who was lying between the back legs of a creature known as a bursa.
Rebu was an individual who lived during the Imperial Era. In addition to bearing the title of Moff, Rebu also served as an Inspector-General for the Galactic Empire.

Veela Ordo was a female Mandalorian and the wife of Canderous Ordo. After the death of Mandalore the Ultimate at the hands of the Jedi Knight Revan, Clan Ordo fell apart. Veela felt that Canderous was the clan's greatest warrior and should have taken the mantle of Mandalore.
Till'in was a male Kel Dor Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Senya Velop was a medical doctor who was working at the Rhire Medical Academy in 22 BBY, during the Separatist Crisis.

A Troig diplomat was at one point the owner of G2-9T, a G2-9T repair droid. The Troig eventually lost possession of the droid, which eventually appeared in a fire sale where buyers could purchase items for prices based on the mass of their acquisitions in kilograms.

An unidentified Troig performed in a circus on the planet Coruscant at some point during the regime of the New Republic. The Troig artist performed fire-eating, an act that involved extinguishing a flame by suffocating it inside one's mouth.

A Givin was one of the crewmembers of the Hinthra, a freighter captained by the slaver Elis Helrot, in 3 ABY. Along with another Givin and a Human male, the Givin served aboard the ship when it took on the Sisar Run at the behest of the Shistavanen smuggler Mal Biron.
A Human Sith was one of five members of the One Sith who ambushed a group of Jedi on Daluuj in 137 ABY. He was killed by Wolf Sazen and Shado Vao.
A Human Sith was one of five members of the One Sith who ambushed a group of Jedi on Daluuj in 137 ABY. He was killed by Wolf Sazen and Shado Vao.
A male N-1 starfighter pilot had the call sign Bravo Twelve in the Royal Naboo Security Forces. He flew in Bravo Flight around the time of the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY.
A female N-1 starfighter pilot flew as Bravo Eight with the Royal Naboo Security Forces' Bravo Flight during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY.
Ran Machado was a Human male who worked for the Lok Revenants, a group of pirates led by a Feeorin named Nym.

A male signals officer was a member of the Galactic Empire. In 1 BBY, the signals officer informed the Sith Lord Darth Vader that several large vessels had entered the Kamino system. Vader told him to inform Fleet Commander Touler that it was time to begin the battle.

Tegris Ordo was a Mandalorian warrior who served as the chieftain of Clan Ordo during the tumultuous period of time known as the Mandalorian Wars, a bloody conflict between the Mandalorians and the dominant political body in the galaxy at the time, the Galactic Republic.

Edric Ordo was a male Human Mandalorian, and a member of Clan Ordo. A close friend of clan mate and cousin Canderous Ordo, following the end of the Mandalorian Wars and the death of Clan Ordo's leader, Tegris Ordo, Edric and Canderous were separated as Clan Ordo became scattered.
Jaye Vuhld was a male Keshiri aide of Caretaker Varner Hilts. He was a talented mathematician who was skilled with calculations.
A Mon Calamari pilot flew an A-wing for the Rebel Alliance during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

Kenev was a member of Lema Xandret's colony on Sebaddon and served aboard the Cinzia. During the Cold War, Marg Sar and Kenev encountered a privateer and blew up their ship, and themselves, in order to the ship's cargo a secret.

Marg Sar was a member of Lema Xandret's colony on Sebaddon who served on the crew of the Cinzia alongside Kenev. During the Cold War, Marg and Kenev encountered a privateer, and blew up their ship, and themselves, in order to the ship's cargo a secret.
A female humanoid sniper was the previous owner of Larin Moxla's armor. The sniper killed a crime lord on Tatooine during the Great Galactic War.
A Carosite physician worked on the hospital ship Sudden Restoration during the reign of the New Republic.

During the days of the New Republic, a male bounty hunter was hired by a crime lord to attack the Carosite medical ship, Sudden Restoration, a vessel that provided free medical care to all, regardless of species or political affiliation.
An Imperial officer received medical treatment aboard the Carosite starship Sudden Restoration during the days of the New Republic. A crime lord hired a bounty hunter to assassinate the officer.
Kenki Spriow was a Human major of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was killed during the Battle of Hoth.
Scohen Shnaus was a Human lieutenant of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was killed during the Battle of Hoth.
Kelkon Slavir was a Human commander of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was killed during the Battle of Hoth.
Scodo Simas was a Human captain of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was killed during the Battle of Hoth.
Alebry Slemic was a Human lieutenant of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was killed during the Battle of Hoth.

Auddo Slokay was a Human male snowtrooper captain in the Galactic Empire. He participated in the Battle of Hoth during the Galactic Civil War as part of the Blizzard Force. Stationed in a room south to the Medical Bay of Echo Base, he was killed by rebel forces.

Amniva Silvoi was a Human male snowtrooper lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. He participated in the Battle of Hoth during the Galactic Civil War as part of the Imperial Blizzard Force, and was stationed at the entrance of Echo Base.
Kisoyt Soliger was a Human male snowtrooper commander in the Galactic Empire. He participated in the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY during the Galactic Civil War as part of the Blizzard Force.

Pepise Slamen was a Human male snowtrooper lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, he participated in the Battle of Hoth as part of the Blizzard Force, and was stationed at the Ion Capacitor room of Echo Base. He was confronted and killed by rebel forces.
A Givin was one of the crewmembers of the freighter Hinthra, which was captained by the slaver Elis Helrot in the year 3 ABY.
A Human woman of Coruscanti ancestry gave birth to at least one of four children fathered by the Morellian scout and outdoorsman Barosa Warren.

Iliana Hilts (née Merko) was a Force-sensitive female Human who was a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith, the descendants of Human Sith who had become stranded on the Wild Space planet of Kesh during the Great Hyperspace War.

Korsin Bentado was a Force-sensitive Human Male. He was a well-built and bald man who had a black moustache. Korsin was a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith, the descendants of a group of Human Sith that had become stranded on the planet Kesh during the Great Hyperspace War.

Neera was the scar-faced Force-sensitive leader of the Force 57 on the 3000 BBY. She was a big-built Human woman who had many scars on her face and her hand had only three webbed fingers, but was the least gruesome of her group.

The Imperial lieutenant who was ordered to collect a blood sample from the Mandalorian Mirta Gev by the Council of Moffs was a Human female in service to the Imperial Remnant during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Ironfist was a human male Mandalorian mercenary active during the Cold War. He has never been captured, defeated, or even driven back.
A female individual was a companion of Pizztov and was referred to by him as "Annoying Female". She tried to coax Pizztov into giving her the box, although he struck her for talking out of line.
Haken was a male Human Republic officer who was second in command of the Esseles during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Vyn Asara was a female Rutian Twi'lek who served the Galactic Republic as an ambassador during the Cold War.

Hadios Gek was an Imperial starfighter pilot in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Gek held the rank of major and patrolled the Corellian system in a TIE/IN interceptor.

Asperago was a starfighter pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Asperago held the rank of lieutenant and was spotted flying a BTL Y-wing starfighter near a Rebel space station in the Corellian system.

Hex Metoni was a starfighter pilot of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Metoni held the rank of major and was spotted flying a B-wing starfighter in the Corellian system.
Kopri was a female Twi'lek who served under New Republic Chief of State Borsk Fey'lya as Captain of the Palace Guard at the Imperial Palace on Coruscant.

A male Quarren informant worked for the Senate Guard in 32 BBY. He infiltrated the Black Heth gang on the planet of Coruscant but was discovered and captured. The Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi was sent to rescue the informant from the construction site he was being held at.

A male commander was in command of a line cruiser in the Imperial Navy. During the early years of the Galactic Civil War, his cruiser was charged with engaging Alliance to Restore the Republic forces evacuating a base on the planet Refnar.
Civ Darklancer was an Imperial officer who served as a starfighter pilot in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

An prisoner escaped the Nightsisters on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War. He was among the strongest of their enslaved individuals and therefore selected to work in their mines at the Nightsister Forced Labor Camp.
Welrin Maduk was a male Duros who worked in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Sherk was a male Human who lived during the Clone Wars, working as a customs officer in the city Tolea Biqua on the planet Genarius in the Cularin system, where he was responsible for inspecting starships that arrived in the city.

A male mercenary leader was employed by the Trade Federation during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY. He flew a specialized craft and fought Bravo Flight when the Trade Federation attempted to kidnap the Queen of Naboo and killed Essara Till.
Reggi Tirver was a male Gran who worked as a junk dealer in Nym's Base on Lok in 1 ABY.
Ralia Reeven was a female Rodian member of the Lok Revenants who lived on Lok at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
A male Human doctor served the Fel Empire and the subsequent Empire-in-exile in 138 ABY. He examined a captured Sith trooper on the planet Bastion following the Attack on the Hidden Temple.

Zanza Gata was a Special Enforcement Officer with the rank of Inspector in the Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations. In 1 ABY, Gata was assigned, at the behest of Moff Landric, to bring the art thief known only as the "Tombat" to justice.
Jorund Redd was a Human male who lived on the desert world Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

Meteor was the callsign of a soldier in the Republic Army who led Havoc Squad, the premier unit in the Republic Special Forces Division, during the Cold War and Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Larence Zaprin was a human male who lived on Naboo with his family at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Tomin was a male Human who served as a security officer in the Chibias concert hall.
Jayx was a male Human who served as a security officer in the Chibias concert hall.
SecOps Four was a member of the Bothan Spynet and personal bodyguard to Bothan Spymaster Koth Melan.
SecOps Five was a member of the Bothan Spynet and personal bodyguard to Bothan Spymaster Koth Melan.
SecOps Seven was a member of the Bothan Spynet and personal bodyguard to Bothan Spymaster Koth Melan.

Danel was a male individual who was a member of the Crystal Wasters, a group of surfers that were based on the moon Dorumaa during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Circa 20 BBY, Danel began working for the organization of the crime lord Rufus Trammel.

Caranna was a female Twi'lek who worked as a bounty hunter during the Clone Wars. At some point during the conflict, she and the bounty hunter Tendin Vought met with a droid, who sought to hire the pair to attack a star liner.
Tendin Vought, known to his employers and targets as Razor, was a male individual who worked as a bounty hunter during the Clone Wars.
HB7 was an individual who worked for the Verga Mer Mining Company during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Mia Zaprin was a female Human who lived on Naboo with her family at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Jowres Zaprin was a male Human who lived on Naboo with his family at the time of the Galactic Civil War. His sister Mia called him Jowy.
Vord'lya was a male Bothan member of the Bothan Spynet and supporter of Borsk Fey'lya's Spynet faction.
Whizzer was an aging Twi'lek with ties to Jabba the Hutt's cartel on Tatooine.

Lemayne was a Human male Alderaanian noble who held the title of baron during the New Sith Wars. He founded the mercy organization Grace Command as a cover for his intelligence operations in the service of the Galactic Republic.
Sheani was a female Twi'lek who worked as a junk dealer at the Lake Retreat on Naboo sometime following 0 BBY.

Amatha Fetz was a Human female from the planet Lianna. She worked her way from the lower classes through hard work, a head for business, and a little piracy. Fetz was eventually accepted by the Liann upper class by owning her own shipping firm, Tion Hauling.
Fessi was an Human female who worked as a dancer in Orman's Sky Palace on the planet Lianna.

To'iir was an elderly Twi'lek male smuggler and the owner of the light freighter Seventy-Seven Stars. During the Galactic Civil War, he mentored the young Human girl Liadden, one of his many partners.
Liadden was a young smuggler and the co-pilot of the freighter Seventy-Seven Stars. She was mentored by To'iir, the ship's captain, who considered her to be his apprentice in the smuggling trade.
Rithgar was a former pirate and the master of the Kothlis shadowport.
Vaantaar was the leader of a group of Troukree refugees, who had escaped from their homeworld, when the planet had been threatened by Warlord Nuso Esva's troops before 0 ABY.
Cartha, who attained the nickname of "Chaser," was an Imperial TIE pilot who served in Black Eight Squadron by 3 BBY.
Roarke was smuggler who was active in 3 ABY. He was known by Tru'eb Cholakk, who mentioned him in a conversation at the Kothlis shadowport.
Artur Manliss was the head of Manliss Enterprise, and the de facto leader of Mandroxan. Manliss was a member of the Council of Three with Parmella Trillidor and Sehvorah.
Bok Yost was a male administrator who rigged an election on Elegasso to earn his post. He suspected that the rogue stormtrooper group Hand of Judgment would seek to stop him and laid a trap for them.

Sehvorah was a Herglic member of the Council of Three, the governing body for the criminal alliance called Mandroxan. Other members of the Council were Artur Manliss (the de facto leader) and Parmella Trillidor.
Parmella Trillidor was a female member of the Council of Three, the governing body for the criminal organization called Mandroxan. Also in the Council were Artur Manliss and Sehvorah.
Canthar was an Epicanthix warrior-chief and poet. He was the author of the poem "Making War Is Love."

The male Ho'Din Oo Wen was owned as a slave by Gardulla Besadii, a crime lord of the Hutt species. Wen was a gardener and, together with several other Ho'Din foresters, populated Besadii's luxurious if notorious indoor pleasure garden with exotic and dangerous plants.

Thrung Alewune was a male Ho'Din pirate, who worked for Armanda Durkin. He enjoyed rejecting Ho'Din stereotypes, showing no gentleness and preferring technology to nature. He disagreed with Durkin's code against killing, and suggested that she retire.
Vewin was a male member of the Rebel Alliance. Rixen considered him to be an outstanding Rebel operative.

Nadia Grell was a female Sarkhai who became a Padawan, later a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the Galactic War. She also replaced her father, Tobas Grell, after his death as the senator of Sarkhai until the outbreak of the war against Zakuul.
Scratch was a particular large minstyngar that lived in the Shadowlands, the dark ground level of the forests of the planet Kashyyyk.
Vimriss was a member of the Black Sun criminal organization during the Galactic Civil War. He was used as a messenger or proxy for Vigo Green.
A collector was on the planet of Commenor. The collector was in possession of the Scepter of Ragnos before the year 14 ABY when Dark Jedi Tavion Axmis murdered him and took possession of it.

Corso Riggs was a Human male mercenary during the Cold War. Born on Ord Mantell, he was the employee of Viidu. He was later betrayed by his coworker and joined forces with a smuggler, enemy to the infamous Skavak.
Lar-Odo was a male Cerean who frequently played sabacc at the White Door Cantina in Akmalla with the Human Jokot and the Duros Bonna Noot.
Miri Santhe was the daughter of Phillip Santhe and the sister of Kashan Santhe. She was a member of the Santhe family, one of the ruling houses of Lianna.
Evif Sulp was a Devaronian male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was a spice dealer for Sola Nosconda.
Wallugget was a particularly large and dangerous Walluga skullsmasher that lived in a group of wallugas on the Common Paths of the Rryatt Trail on Kashyyyk.
Rotclaw was a particularly large and dangerous bloodclaw mouf that lived in a group of moufs on the High Grounds of the Rryatt Trail on Kashyyyk.
Goretongue was a particularly large and dangerous minstyngar thrasher that lived on the Wroshyr Canopy level of the Rryatt Trail on Kashyyyk.
A Twi'lek lived in the South Apartments of the Upper City on the planet Taris during the Jedi Civil War, in 3956 BBY. They had pale yellow skin and blue eyes.
Fellan was young male courier who worked in Narloch's casinos on Reaper's World. He approached a group of bounty hunters and offered to sell them proof that Narloch was working for Jabba the Hutt.

Crazy Van Kyle was a member of the swoop gang Hurt Vectors. The criminal carried two vibro-shivs in concealed wrist-sheaths, and was involved in a battle with a group of bounty hunters at the swoop gang's hideout.

A male Jedi warrior served as the Master of the Zabrak Padawan Maris Brood, teaching her aboard the starship Gray Pilgrim. Stationed in the Outer Rim Territories at the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY, he and Brood did not fall victim to Order 66, which saw many Jedi killed.
An Ithorian with light blue eyes and light gray and yellow skin lived in the South Apartments of the Upper City on the planet Taris during the Jedi Civil War, in 3956 BBY.
Oecax was a male Ithorian chef who lived at the time of the Galactic Civil War. He worked in the Nashal cantina on Talus.
Harvey was a male Mon Calamari who was paired up with a loved one during the Ewok Festival of Love.
Robeir XXIII was the head of the House of Cron and the ruler of the Cronese Mandate during the Galactic Civil War. He paid court to Emperor Palpatine and ruled as a client king.

Benoni Ulte was an Ibhaan'I shaman, or Bronwen, who lived apart from his tribe as tradition dictated. Settling in Vakeyya to learn more about his Corellian ancestors, Ulte visited new arrivals to Soco-Jarel Spaceport.
Barden Golah was a Human captain of the Imperial Reclamation Service.

An elderly scarred male Felucian shaman served as the chief of the Felucian Sanctuary. Soon after the end of the Clone Wars, he assisted a group of Senator Bail Organa's agents in their quest to raid the Imperial prison facility called the Vanishing Place and liberate Admiral …

Soon after the Clone Wars, a male Felucian warrior from the Felucian Sanctuary served as a guide for a group of Senator Bail Organa's agents in their quest to raid the Imperial prison facility called the Vanishing Place and liberate Admiral Gilder Varth.
Cyrus was a male member of the Royal Naboo Security Forces on the peaceful planet Naboo. He served during the Invasion of Naboo in the year 32 BBY.

A Dulok with arrows painted on his belly was a member of King Gorneesh's tribe of Duloks on the Forest Moon of Endor. He was a typical green-furred member of his species, although he had a pair of arrows painted on his belly.
Wevat Midian was an administrator on The Wheel. Midian supplied information to Narloch.
Lira Rimrunner was a female convicted criminal and former smuggler. Despite this, she was elected to the position of Governor-General of Dalos IV.

M'Kyas Love, originally also known as Grandyl Grieve, was a male Latarzian who was a dangerous assassin trained by the Empire. Sometime after the Battle of Endor, Grieve switched sides and began working for the the New Republic in their Intelligence Service.

HJ-377 was a soldier that fought for the Galactic Empire alongside another soldier during Emperor Palpatine's reign before the year 1 BBY. While fighting a rebel group, explosions and concussions shook the ground.

An Imperial Human stormtrooper fought alongside another soldier, HJ-377, against a rebel group sometime before or during the year 1 BBY. After defending a hill for three months, the Imperial forces were running low on supplies and were fighting in hard conditions.
Despite her royal pedigree, the child of King Gorneesh and Queen Urgah—rulers of a tribe of Duloks who lived in a swamp on the Forest Moon of Endor—was a troublemaker.

In 3 ABY, the combined misbehavior of a Dulok cub and the child's brother and sister proved so intolerable that Urgah, the child's mother and the queen of a tribe of Duloks who lived in the swamp on the Forest Moon of Endor, demanded that her husband, King Gorneesh, find a bab…
Bristow was a male Human Imperial captain on Shramar in 25 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War, fighting in the Battle of Shramar alongside Kaye Galfridian against the Yuuzhan Vong's ground forces.

Sek'nos Rath, called Seki by adoring women, was a male Sith Je'daii Ranger who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign. He was a bold Je'daii who was fond of weapons and longed to achieve the greatness of the Je'daii of myth and stories.
Tasha Ryo was a female Twi'lek Je'daii Journeyer who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Shae Koda was a female Human Je'daii Ranger who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.

Hawk Ryo was a male Twi'lek Je'daii Ranger who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign. A member of Clan Ryo, Hawk Ryo was the brother of the notorious Baron Volnos Ryo and the brother-in-law of Je'daii Temple Master Kora Ryo.
Kora Ryo was a female Twi'lek from the planet Shikaakwa who was a Je'daii Master in the Je'daii Order.

Ketu was a Human male Je'daii Temple Master who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign. He was considered to be one of the Order's most powerful and wise masters of the era, and served as the leader of the Je'daii Council.

A Human male guard of the Royal Naboo Security Forces was wounded during the Invasion of Naboo in the year 32 BBY. He led ten troops against a Trade Federation Armored Assault Tank, but his troops were killed, and he suffered an injury to his leg.

A male Human guard of the Royal Naboo Security Forces was wounded during the Invasion of Naboo in the year 32 BBY. He was wounded after the Trade Federation entered the city of Theed, the capital of the planet Naboo.
A Human male guard of the Royal Naboo Security Forces was wounded during the Invasion of Naboo in the year 32 BBY.
A light-skinned Human male grenadier was a member of the Royal Naboo Security Forces in the year 32 BBY. As a grenadier, he wore a uniform similar to that of the Queen's Palace Guard.
Jane was a Human female who lived during the Galactic Civil War
Squad Leader Naboo-1 was a Human male pilot in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps. He was active in 32 BBY and was captured by the Trade Federation during the Invasion of Naboo.

Jawiin Danod was an Ithorian male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Danod was present on the planet Dathomir when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.

Orn was the uncle of Jedi Knight Jaden Korr and lived on the planet Coruscant during the time of the New Republic. In 14 ABY, Korr built his own lightsaber, and his uncle had him enrolled in the Jedi Academy.
Seer was a clone of the Sith Lady Lumiya that was created in an Imperial research facility on a frozen moon in the Unknown Regions.
TX-840 was a stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Soldier, also known as the Prime to the One Sith organization, was a Human male clone created around 9 ABY from the DNA of Jedi Knight Jaden Korr.

The Iteration was a clone of the Human male Jedi Knight Jaden Korr. He was created at some point before 41 ABY by the resurgent One Sith order and was kept in suspended animation on the planet Korriban.

Tremel was a Human male Sith Overseer at the Sith Academy, on Korriban. During the Cold War, he was tasked in selecting worthy acolytes to become Sith. He was responsible for the arrival and initiation of a promising acolyte, who would become his protégé.

Jendan Blyes was a Human male Mantellian Trooper who served the Galactic Republic-backed Ord Mantell Central Authority as part of the Mantellian Army, and he fought against the Mantellian Separatist Movement in the Separatist War.

Krizta was a female Tarasin Force Adept who lived on the planet Cularin during the Clone Wars. Circa 21 BBY, while she was still a child, Krizta, her brother Trik, and a number of other Tarasin were kidnapped by the Zabrak slaver Haast Aath and taken to a slave compound on the…

Trik was a male Tarasin Force Adept who lived on the planet Cularin during the Clone Wars. Circa 21 BBY, while he was still a child, Trik, his sister Krizta, and a number of other Tarasin were kidnapped by the Zabrak slaver Haast Aath and taken to a slave compound on the plane…
The Nadon's grove was a grove of bafforr trees that grew on planet Tatooine. It was located in the mountains south of the Mos Eisley city.

Krael was a dim-witted male Human who worked for the Twi'lek crime lord Ilb Toranda during the Clone Wars. Circa 21 BBY, Toranda dispacted Krael and the Rodian Vreego to purchase some illigal weapons from a women in the city Hedrett on the planet Cularin.

Marden was an individual who worked for the Human crime lord Reegas Vance. Marden served aboard Vance's YT-2400 light freighter Blackstar and accompanied the starship when it traveled to salvage a derelict ship in the Unknown Regions.

Verra was a male who worked for the Human crime lord Reegas Vance. Verra served aboard Vance's YT-2400 light freighter Blackstar and he accompanied the starship when it traveled to salvage a derelict ship in the Unknown Regions.

A male Imperial cloning technician worked in the cloning facility in Timira City on the planet Kamino around 1 BBY. The cloning technician monitored clones like Subject 1157, a copy of the Human male Galen Marek.

During the Great Galactic War between the years 3681 and 3653 BBY, a commander led a portion of the reconstituted Sith Empire's armada in an effort to take the Brema sector from the Galactic Republic.
Nyss Nenn was an agent of the One Sith around 41 ABY. He was assigned to capture the Force-sensitive clone Soldier, as well as Jaden Korr.

Moren Chonk was a male Quarren who lived on the planet Mon Calamari during the Galactic Civil War. After working as the leader of the Morjanssik Sanitation Bureau, Chonk was elected as the Chief Manager of the city Morjanssik.
Kelmut Wolg was a male Quarren who lived on the planet of Mon Calamari during the Galactic Civil War.
Kruluk was a male Quarren who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Kruluk resided in the city Morjanssik on the planet Mon Calamari, where he worked as a bartender in the Long Drink, a local bar.
Vuhlg Worrik was a male individual who served as the head of the Morjanssik Mine on the planet Mon Calamari during the Galactic Civil War.
Thulwuk Thur was a male Quarren who worked as a foreman in the Morjanssik Mine on the planet Mon Calamari.
Drusan was a racer from Rodia who participated in the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally on Coruscant. He flew a Recardian C-18 in the race, placing second, after Thrar of Coachelle Prime.
Ferrouz's wife was a woman who married Bidor Ferrouz, Imperial governor of the remote Candoras sector. Together, they had a six-year-old daughter.
Ferrouz's daughter was the daughter of Bidor Ferrouz, Imperial governor of the Candoras sector, and his wife. She was six-years-old as of eight months after the Battle of Yavin.
Darth Nyriss was a female Pureblood Dark Lord of the Sith who sat on the Dark Council for more than twenty years (the third-longest tenure at the time).

Scourge was a pureblood Sith male who served as a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire and later as the Emperor's Wrath, the personal enforcer of the Sith Emperor, before he allied with the Jedi Knight known as the Hero of Tython in order to prevent the Emperor from exti…

Walif Merv was a male Quarren who lived on the planet Mon Calamari during the Galactic Civil War. After the Galactic Empire enacted a project to prevent Mon Calamari from supplying starships to the Alliance to Restore the Republic, a team of Imperial saboteurs disrupted mining…
