A red-haired Human boy lived in the city of Theed on the peaceful planet Naboo with his mother. The Trade Federation undertook the Invasion of Naboo in the year 32 BBY.

A Human woman lived in the city of Theed on the peaceful planet Naboo with her son. She was light-skinned with brown hair and eyes. The Trade Federation invaded the planet in 32 BBY and the mother was separated from her son when the Trade Federation Droid Army entered Theed.

A Human male fisherman ran a boat the Solleu River, in the city of Theed on Naboo. During the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY, he met Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi, who held a conversation with the fisherman before continuing his mission. The fisherman was later killed.

Vahss was a bald male Human member of the Republic-affiliated mercy organization Grace Command during the New Sith Wars. Vahss fought and was killed during an ambush by Hutt crime lord Zodoh's forces in 1032 BBY.

"Old Man" Padgett was a male Human living on Aquilaris during the New Sith Wars. The Jedi Knight Kerra Holt knew him from her childhood and met Padgett again when she come back on the planet alongside Devil Squadron.

Joad Kreel was a male Human living on Aquilaris Minor during the New Sith Wars. He was a childhood friend of Jedi Knight Kerra Holt, but by the time she returned to the planet alongside Devil Squadron in 1032 BBY, Kreel had become completely addicted to the spice Deluge.

An old woman lived in the city of Theed, the capital of the planet Naboo. The light-skinned woman had a home near the Theed Royal Palace. She lived in Theed during the time of the Invasion of Naboo in the year 32 BBY.

Sechel was a non-Force-sensitive male Pureblood Sith who served as an advisor and envoy of the Dark Councilor Darth Nyriss of the reconstituted Sith Empire, and previously served in the Imperial Intelligence.
Hunter was a female clone of an unknown Sith or Jedi Human that was created in an Imperial research facility on a frozen moon in the Unknown Regions.

A vendor sold vinefish near Yinta Lake on the planet of Vulta. The vendor attempted to sell some the freshly grilled vinefish to smuggler Zeerid Korr in the year 3653 BBY. Korr was on his way to meet with his daughter, Arra Yooms, when the vendor called out to Korr.

Emo Aucellis was an individual who worked as an explorer and a historian. During the Galactic Civil War, the entertainment park Aucellis Park was established on the moon Keriba VI, which chronicled Aucellis' life and work.

Evin Telbre was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. At some point Telbre established a shipping company and shortly after the business had begun trading, Telbre's best friend was killed when the smuggler Balthazar Sim bombed a transit shuttle…
Balthazar Sim was a male smuggler who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Hoogi Grym was a male Bothan mercenary who served the Galactic Empire during the time of the Galactic Civil War, working as the head of security at the entertainment park Aucellis Park on the moon Keriba VI.
Puriv was a Stromma who served the Empire of the Hand as a stormtrooper of the Stromma contingent. He understood the Quesoth species' Quesoth Soldier Speak language.
Kicker was a stormtrooper who served the Empire of the Hand. In 8 ABY, Kicker participated in a battle on the planet Quethold, fighting against the forces of the Quesoth species.
An indignant male staffmember of the Epsilon Nine Communications Research Station was throttled by Dark Lady Lumiya as her forces subjugated the defected Imperial space station.

Philo was the brother to bounty hunter Reglis Taal. He was hunted and killed by the bounty hunters Raxine and Krestock. However, the posting had been a mistake. Reglis Taal subsequently killed Krestock in retaliation.
A female individual was living during the time of the New Republic. She was married to the Turian New Republic senator, Luralon Odaay, with whom she had one child.
Cabe Maquez was a male Human assassin who attempted to kill Leia Organa Solo during her time as Chief of State of the New Republic.
An individual was living during the time of the New Republic. The individual was the child of a Turian New Republic senator named Luralon Odaay, and his wife.

Cyreltov was a Chiss male bounty hunter who operated during the Clone Wars. He worked for the Dark Acolyte Asajj Ventress and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during a battle on the planet Bogoa, tracking the rogue B1-series battle droid Coppertop.
Jydu was an Adarian ambassador to the New Republic in 25 ABY. Jydu believed the warnings Leia Organa Solo gave about the nascent Yuuzhan Vong threat.

A female individual was the first wife of the Human Caled Galfridian, the king of the planet Artorias and the leader of the royal Galfridian family. She gave birth to two children, Finn and Kaye Galfridian.
Andro Hoverdale was a male conman who lived at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Hoolar Freeb was a female Ithorian mercenary who lived at the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was a member of the Azure Cabal, a mercenary group lead by Loruna Scathe.

Foehorn was a huge and furious tulrus that lived on the volcanic world Mustafar at the time of the Galactic Civil War. These creatures usually didn't bother anyone unless provoked, but Foehorn was exceptionally aggressive.
A teaching assistant at the Corellia University worked for Professor Cornelius Wagglehorn at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Stoneleg was a particularly strong and dangerous walluga that lived in the Etyyy region on the planet Kashyyyk at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Balkin was a Human male Stormtrooper Commander who served Grand Admiral Thrawn's Empire of the Hand as the commander of its 501st Legion. In 8 ABY, Balkin attended a strategy session aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Admonitor over the Unknown Regions planet Quethold.
Simo Oron was a male Bothan spy of the Rebel Alliance who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Amminius Goodner was a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. Admiral Ackbar tasked a Rebel to locate Amminius Goodner on Dantooine, after he made indications of wishing to aid the Rebellion. However, it turned out to be a trap.

T'licl Zanedi was male Ithorian scientist who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. He was a sympathizer of the Rebel Alliance and provided information about an Imperial scientific project to the Rebellion.
Erisi Plmary was a male Bothan Spynet operative who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Jotil Denive was a Human male Imperial officer and major in the Imperial Security Bureau who later defected to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Jorund Saleem was a Blood Razor captain who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Mahar Spince was a henchman of Nym's who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In an attempt to reconcile their differences, and convince Nym to help the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Han Solo tasked a Rebel operative with finding and killing Spince, who had by …
Kehel Sinan was an Imperial general who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Barthis Belangus was a Trandoshan assassin working for the Galactic Empire who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Stromgald Rholar was an Imperial general who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

A Human was a hyperspace scout. The Human had fair skin, no hair, and dark eyes. At least one time, they wore a pair of goggles, a white shirt, and a vest while he looked at a hyperspace map with another hyperspace scout.

A Human was a hyperspace scout. The Human scout had light brown hair, dark eyes, and fair skin. On one occasion, they looked at a hyperspace map with another hyperspace scout while wearing a gray shirt and a brown jacket.
A Givin Sith was part of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire and the One Sith, he was one of the many Fury-class starfighter pilots.
Mother was a Rakatan entity imprisoned in an unnamed space station of the Infinite Empire design tethered to a dead and barren world located in an irradiated system within the Unknown Regions.
Nyama was an aggressive Stromma male who was the Stromma council's liaison to Grand Admiral Thrawn's Empire of the Hand.

Syll Nenn was a female Umbaran who was the twin-sister of Nyss Nenn. The siblings appeared to be Force-dead to other Force-sensitives, and while they weren't able to necessarily access the Force, they had a power that allowed them to dampen the abilities of Force-sensitives an…

Runner was a genetic clone of Jedi Master Kyle Katarn, commenced during the Thrawn campaign. He was born on an unnamed frozen moon alongside several other clones located in the Unknown Regions. Runner was one of the most devout of the clones' leader, Seer.
Grace was a female Human, and one of two daughters of Hunter and Alpha, two Force-sensitive clones produced on a frozen moon in the Unknown Regions.

This female attendant lived in the Outbound Flight Colony in 22 ABY. That year, she was assigned to watch after the colony's Force-sensitive children while they were quarantined due to fears that they could be trained as Jedi. She worked alongside an older woman.
Scar was a clone of a Force-sensitive female Human that was created in an Imperial research facility on a frozen moon in the Unknown Regions. Her mate was Maker.
Wry, originally designated "Subject H," was a male clone created from Jedi and Sith DNA in an Imperial research facility on a frozen moon in the Unknown Regions at some point around 9 ABY.
Maker was a male clone of an unknown Sith or Jedi human who was created in an Imperial research facility on a frozen moon in the Unknown Regions.
The Rodian Base Security Chief was a male Rodian member of Sordaan Xris' hunting operations in the Kashyyyk system at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Tremorfoot was a particularly strong and tough tulrus that lived on the Tulrus Nesting Grounds on Mustafar at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Jirvin was a male Quesoth Midli who lived on the planet Quethold during the time of the New Republic. Jirvin was the brother of Trevik and he worked as the overseer of a group of Quesoth Workers that serviced lighting equipment in the Red City.

An individual served as an Imperial controller aboard a Star Destroyer during the Battle of Hoth. She communicated with Zuckuss, a Gand bounty hunter, concerning the ninety Rebels that he was rescuing from a downed transport.
Blessing was one of the two daughters of Hunter and Alpha, two Force-sensitive clones produced on a frozen moon in the Unknown Regions.
Gift was the only surviving male son of two clone members of the Community, the Force-sensitive clones produced on a frozen moon in the Unknown Regions.
Two-Blade was a clone of a Force-sensitive male human that was created in an Imperial research facility on a frozen moon in the Unknown Regions.
Lhagva was a male Stromma who served the Empire of the Hand, as part of stormtrooper contingent that was assigned to the Star Destroyer Admonitor.

Tasse was a male individual who served as a general in the military of the Empire of the Hand. In 8 ABY, Tasse co-ordinated the movements of Imperial juggernauts during an Empire of the Hand attack on the planet of Quethold, against the combined forces of the alien warlord Nus…

Trevik was a male Quesoth member of the Quesoth Midli caste of the planet Quethold's Red City, overseeing the Quesoth Workers. The Midli, who was born on Quethold, had a brother, Jirvin, who oversaw several Workers that handled equipment in the Red City.

Bragger was a Human male stormtrooper who fought for the Empire of the Hand during the time of the New Republic. In 8 ABY, Bragger participated in an Imperial attack on the planet Quethold, against the combined forces of the alien warlord Nuso Esva and the Quesoth species.
A mimph with pink and pale fur lived in a village on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, the mimph was still an infant, and was cared for by an older mimph of the same species.

A mimph lived in a village on the Forest Moon of Endor and cared for a mimph infant in 3 ABY. In that year, a hunting team led by the mimph Masher captured the young Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick and brought him back to the village, where they tied him behind a curtain.
Xzuhal was a Falleen scout operating near the Unknown Regions.

Goontirk was a male Snivvian who owned the Madman's Fortune, a museum exhibit ship that he flew as part of a traveling freak show. At some point during galactic history, Goontirk purchased the mummified remains of Vardovin IV, the "Lost King of Duro," from a Ryn merchant.
Lurbi was a female Gotal from the moon Antar 4. Lurbi operated Lurbi's Mercantile, a cantina that was located in the Landing, a settlement situated on the planet Engebo V.
Mandalore the Conqueror was an individual who took up the title of Mandalore, the leader of the Mandalorian warrior culture, sometime between 7000 BBY and 3996 BBY.
Jaffro Davengatt was a male Human entrepreneur who established the farm Davengatt's Double-Zed Nerf Ranch on the planet Engebo V at some point during galactic history.

Nell Davengatt was a female Human who was the daughter of Jaffro Davengatt, the owner of Davengatt's Double-Zed Nerf Ranch on the planet Engebo V. After her father became reclusive, Nell was forced to take over the day-to-day running of his business, a job that she disliked.
Jagged Fang was the name of a particularly strong and dangerous varactyl that lived on the planet Kashyyyk at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Xornu Plox was a musician who was a member of the jizz band the Sozzenels. Plox trained under the reputable mozz box player Rem Yonka.
Greyclimber was a particularly strong Kashyyyk bantha that lived in the Etyyy region on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.
Spiketop was a particularly strong and dangerous uller that lived in the Etyyy region on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.
Silkthrower was a particularly large and dangerous webweaver that lived in the Etyyy region on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.

Sheffel Nan was a female Human who worked as a concert promoter in the Nessem Shipyards during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She had many friends within the music world and was also acquainted with the Trandoshan mercenary Ssorku.
Trivyakna Korl was an individual who served the Galactic Empire as an administrator during the time of the Galactic Empire.

Roald Lasdal was a male individual who lived in the Nessem Shipyards, a space station located near to the planet Nessem, during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Lasdal had three children and he worked as a shift foreman, overseeing the construction of capital ships.

Brightclaw was a particularly strong and dangerous mouf that lived in the Etyyy region on the planet Kashyyyk at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Paleclaw was a particularly strong and dangerous mouf that lived in the Etyyy region on the planet Kashyyyk at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Hella Cordoni was a Human female trade delegate from the planet Chandrila. After the Trade Federation's attempted invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY she traveled to the planet with her family to try and negotiate a trade contract with the government there.

Van Kellen was a Human Male Trade Master from the planet Corellia. After the Trade Federation's attempted invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY he traveled to the planet with his family to try and negotiate a trade contract with the government there.

Oodora was a senator who represented the planet Manaan for four consecutive terms, serving in the Galactic Senate for over twenty years in the decades before the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Deniv Corsignis was a male Chagrian who headed the Corsignis Property Alliance, a trading concern that operated on the moon Pinett during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Nari Beksen was a female Human who worked for the Corsignis Property Alliance during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Daetan Taakses was a male Rodian who lived on the moon of Pinett with his nephew, Oryel Taakses, during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Oryel Taakses was a male Rodian who lived on the moon of Pinett during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Looca B'Nash was a male Duros who lived on the moon Pinett during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Zascha was a Force-using female Cerean who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Zascha's sister Anoura worked as an information broker for the Bothan Elwis Bontraar and after Anoura died during a routine assignment, Zascha vowed to have revenge against Bontr…

Jennalyn Bontraar was a female Bothan who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Empire. After Jennalyn's father, Elwis Bontraar, earned the ire of the Cerean Zascha, the Cerean kidnapped Jennalyn and arranged to return her to Elwis in exchange for a ransom.
An Imperial controller served aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor during the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.
Lar Ndigo was a human male in the New Republic Defense Fleet.

Bimbam Toop was a male Gungan who lived on the planet Naboo during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Toop worked as the foreman of a Gungan work crew and in about 32 BBY, he and his crew visited the bar Frundle's Cantina in the city Keren.
Keff was an individual who served in the Royal Naboo Security Forces during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

A Bothan male New Republic civil services employee was brainwashed by agents of Warlord Zsinj in 7 ABY. The Bothan attempted to blow up a power station on the planet Coruscant, but was stopped by his supervisor.
A Sullustan New Republic pilot was brainwashed by agents of Warlord Zsinj in 7 ABY. The Sullustan attempted to crash a starship on the planet Coruscant, but was stopped by another Sullustan officer.
Paladin was a male individual who led the eco-terrorist group the Army of Life during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Xbrr-Zinngogg was a Gran male diplomat from Rhommamool who later served as a loyal individual to the New Republic.
Shurgg was a female Quarren thief who worked for the Cerean Force adept Pal-Nada at some point during galactic history.

Gorg Pomar was a female Human criminal who worked for the Cerean Force adept Pal-Nada. At some point during galactic history, Pomar became involved in a starship theft ring that Pal-Nada operated and the Cerean's Twi'lek lackey Esm Arkhee lured a group of agents to a hangar wh…
Esm Arkhee was a male Twi'lek who worked for the Force adept Pal-Nada at some point during galactic history.

Al'art was a General of the Royal Naboo Security Forces, a starfighter ace, and a so-called "Royal Forces Vindicator." Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Al'art was seen on patrol in a Z-95 Headhunter in the Naboo system.

An Imperial captain served aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor as the first officer under the command of Admiral Bentro six months after the Battle of Yavin, during the Executor blockade of Shelkonwa.

Squedge Eepsey was a male Duros who lived in the city of Sahl-Evin on the planet Jenenma. Eepsey was a patron of the cantina The Hutt's Last Laugh in the Blinders district of Sahl Evin, and at some point during galactic history, a group of agents visited the cantina and encoun…

Jerren Durs was a male Human who operated a leisure ranch on the planet Froswythe. Around the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War, a group of individuals stayed at Durs' ranch while on a vacation and early one morning, Durs and his guests rode out on ycaqts to round up a herd of bant…

Fegred Ewd was a male Human who lived during the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. After committing crimes on various worlds in the Core, including the planet Corellia, Ewd became a wanted criminal. He subsequently went into hiding on the planet Froswythe and he lived as a hermit.
Rel Acoi was a male Human who led the Oquan, a group of bounty hunters that operated on the planet Naalol during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Patch was a male Human who served as a lieutenant with the Oquan, a bounty hunter group that operated on the planet of Naalol.
Selana was a female Human who served as a lieutenant with the Oquan, a bounty hunter group that operated on the planet Naalol.
This Walrus-faced individual was a male Aqualish who worked as a freelance spy for the Galactic Empire. He was active on a planet located in the Dona Laza sector of the Expansion Region.
Prit Kessek was a female Clawdite who lived during the time of the Galactic Republic. Kessek was the captain of the transport Skinchanger and she worked for the Zygerrian slavers as a courier.
Liskran Dulce was a male Bothan who was the majordomo of the slaver Atlee Thanda, the leader of the Zygerrian Thanda clan.
A female individual was the adoptive mother of the Jedi Jaden Korr. His only memory of her was the fruity scent of her hair. The woman died in a shuttle accident when Korr was very young.

Mirana Fioro was a female Hapan con artist who lived during the early years of the Galactic Empire. Fioro specialized at performing scams while in disguise as a Hapan noblewoman, and circa 17 BBY, she entered in the Cloud City Sabacc Tournament on the planet Bespin at the behe…
Skig Banos was a male Human who lived on Sel Zonn Station, a space station in orbit of the planet Brentaal IV, during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
An Imperial commander served aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor during its mission to Shelkonwa in 0.5 ABY.

Krin was an Imperial captain during the Galactic Civil War.
During the early years of the Galactic Empire, a Twi'lek thug worked for the criminal organization of the protocol droid Switch, as Switch's majordomo.
During the early years of the Galactic Empire, a male individual worked for Alderaanian Security, a security force from the planet Alderaan, as an agent.
Fyren was male Ugnaught who worked for the Parliament of Guilds in Cloud City on the planet Bespin during the Imperial Era.
Krygg was male Ugnaught who worked for the Parliament of Guilds in Cloud City, on the planet Bespin, during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Jacc Mandelbrot was a man who operated the Royal Casino in Cloud City, on the planet of Bespin.
TK-813 was an Imperial stormtrooper stationed on the garrison planet Hockaleg in 3 ABY.

TK-529, also known as "Grimes" among its comrades, was a stormtrooper stationed on Hockaleg with a garrison during the Galactic Civil War. His job was to oversee the workers for the super weapon Tarkin, which is under construction over the planet.
A Human male was a cousin of Queen Breha Organa of Alderaan. During the Clone Wars, he served as a tactical officer aboard the Galactic Republic naval ship Bespin Dancer.

Sprywing was a mountain capper spineflap that lived in the Gallo Mountains near Dee'ja Peak on Naboo. In 1 ABY, the hunter Walker Luskeske asked a spacer to kill the creature and bring him her talons as a trophy.
Following the formation of the Galactic Empire, when Wilena was 15 years old, Daimar refused to submit to the new regime and the Empire blockaded the planet.

Sliver was a male Human who worked for Daimar Intelligence, an intelligence organization that operated on the planet Daimar. Following the formation of the Galactic Empire, Daimar refused to submit to the new regime and the Empire blockaded the planet.

Desson was a male Neimoidian laborer who lived in the city Zarra on the planet Cato Neimoidia, during the early years of the Galactic Empire. Zarra had been damaged during the Clone Wars and Desson participated in an effort to rebuild the city.

Borlo was a male Neimoidian who lived in the city Zarra on the planet Cato Neimoidia, during the years following the end of the Clone Wars. Borlo was an informant for the Galactic Empire, which he provided with information about anything unusual that took place in Zarra.
Salitt was a male Neimoidian beggar who lived on the streets of the city Zarra, on the planet Cato Neimoidia, during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Shass was a female Neimoidian businesswoman who was born during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Vigro was a male Neimoidian speeder-repairman who lived on the planet of Cato Neimoidia during the early years of the Galactic Empire. He owned the landspeeder repair shop Vigro's Repulsorlifts, which was located in the city Zarra.

Nillia was a female Neimoidian who worked as a spaceport administrator in the city Zarra on the planet Cato Neimoidia, during the early years of the Galactic Empire. She found her job boring and she longed to leave Zarra.

A male individual served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. During the Battle of Hoth between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance in the year 3 ABY, he was the captain of the Mon Calamari cruiser Champion, which was present above the pla…

Gome was a male Duros moneychanger who worked for the Hutt crime lord Darga Jiramma Mionne. Gome entered Darga's employ after the Hutt first rose to power and the Duros was responsible for handling Darga's finances, to ensure that no data trails could be traced back to the Hutt.
Kessra was a female Human who led the mercenary unit known as the Vipers.

Warrick Raden was a male Devaronian criminal who lived in the city Zarra on the planet Cato Neimoidia during the early years of the Galactic Empire. Raden worked for the Hutt crime lord Darga Jiramma Mionne and he carried messages and extorted money on Darga's behalf.

Victra Sinde was a female Human spy who served the Imperial Security Bureau during the Imperial Era. Circa 17 BBY, Sinde was tasked with an undercover mission on the world of Alderaan to obtain evidence that the senator Bail Organa had committed treason against the Galactic Em…

Zayda was a male Rodian gladiator who lived during the early years of the Galactic Empire. At some point, he acquired the custom-made battle droid RX-7246 for use as his personal combat assistant and he entered the service of the Hutt crime lord Darga Jiramma Mionne.
The Duke of Cron Robeir II was a noble Cronese man, possibly fictional, from the Tion Cluster who lived during the Xim Wars.
Vaner Shan was the son of Revan and Bastila Shan, two famous Jedi Knights and heroes of the Jedi Civil War that was fought between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Vaner was a Human male lieutenant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. Vaner was stationed on the planet Ilum as a weapons vendor.
Reesa Shan was the daughter of Vaner and Emess Shan, and the granddaughter of Revan and Bastila Shan. She had a brother named Bress Shan.

Ressa was a female individual who lived during the days of the Old Republic. She was the queen of the planet Drezzi for some time before 3954 BBY. During Ressa's reign, her homeworld was conquered by the resurgent Sith Empire and Ressa's husband was executed.

Bress Shan was a Human male, the son of Vaner and Emess Shan and the grandson of the famous Jedi Knights Revan and Bastila Shan. Born sometime before 3900 BBY, Bress was older than his sister Reesa, and both children had inherited their grandparents' Force-sensitivity.

Emess Shan was a female Human who was the wife of Vaner Shan, the son of the renowned Jedi Knights Revan and Bastila Shan. Emess was younger than Vaner, who had been born in 3954 BBY, and Vaner's mother initially disapproved of their relationship on account of her age.
Ms. Sharockk was a receptionist at the Santhe/Sienar Technologies Headquarters on the planet Lianna during the Galactic Civil War.
Jornel Savas was a Human male CorSec agent who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Varias was a Human male CorSec officer who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Druno Kener was a Human male CorSec officer who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Mener was a Human male CorSec officer who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Darth Igrol was a Sith pureblood male who became a Dark Lord of the Sith and served on the Dark Council of the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Dramath was a male Sith Lord of the Old Sith Empire, who ruled over the planet Medriaas in the years before the Great Hyperspace War.
Worhven was a captain of the Imperial Navy in command of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Dominator during the Galactic Civil War.

Flashpoint was a clone trooper who served in the unit Gold Squadron during the Clone Wars, under the callsign Gold Seven. In 21 BBY, Flashpoint flew a starfighter during a battle for control of the planet Kothlis.
Bern was a male Human who was the husband of Chai, and fathered a number of sons during the Clone Wars.
Chai was a female Corellian Human who was married to the man Bern during the Clone Wars.

Didjoa was a Corellian Human woman who was a friend of the scientist Bant'ena Fhernan. During the Clone Wars, Fhernan was captured by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and was subsequently forced to work for them by claiming that they would kill Fherman's friends and fami…

Nevhra was a friend of Bant'ena Fhernan during the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY, Fhernan was captured by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Separatists subsequently forced her to work for them by claiming that they would kill Fherman's friends and family, including Ne…
Scraps was a clone commando and the captain of a squad in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Scraps wore white Katarn-class commando armor with red markings.

Murtog was a Human male who served as captain of security for the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Nyriss. Nyriss was a member of the Dark Council of the reconstituted Sith Empire, and around 3954 BBY, she became entangled in a plot to unseat the Sith Emperor.
Dramath the Second was a Sith Lord of the ancient Sith Empire. Dramath the Second was the son of Dramath the elder, who ruled the world of Medriaas prior to the Great Hyperspace War.
A Human woman of Coruscanti ancestry was one of two such women to give birth to at least one of four children after being impregnated by the Morellian scout and outdoorsman Barosa Warren.
A male Imperial officer was the commanding officer of the clone stormtrooper Contrail in 17 BBY. When CT-4981's clone gunner was wounded in battle, the officer ordered CT-4981 to kill him.

A male clone stormtrooper served as the gunner of the clone stormtrooper Contrail in 17 BBY. When the gunner was wounded in battle, CT-4981's non-clone commanding officer ordered the latter to kill him.
Kira Carsen was a Human female Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Gjo'Fomaan was a male Coynite warrior and Tawws'Kroyn champion. He was a noted arena gladiator fighter during the years leading up to the Clone Wars and a strong supporter of the Galaxy Gladiator Federation.

Kreshan was a male Advozse who served the Advozse Hegemony as a warlord. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, he controlled the salvaged Republic space station known as Hammer Station.
Grizzer was a young male Mandalorian member of Clan Ordo. He was a pilot of Basilisk war droid on Rekkiad.

An individual was serving as a scanner operator and technician in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire.

A male individual was the husband of Queen Ressa of the planet Drezzi. After Drezzi was conquered by the reconstituted Sith Empire years prior to 3954 BBY, the man was executed. Ressa and her children, however, were spared by the Sith Lord Darth Nyriss.
A Twi'lek slave personally attended the Dark Councilor Darth Nyriss of the Sith Empire, and was killed alongside her master.
Yarri was a female Pureblood Sith captain of the Imperial Guard on the Imperial capital of Dromund Kaas in direct service of the Sith Emperor of the Sith Empire.

Ugroth was a warlord whose sector was conquered by the reconstituted Sith Empire around 3966 BBY in order to suppress possibilities of rebellion. He swore fealty to Darth Nyriss, a member of the Empire's ruling Dark Council and the head of the Imperial attackers.
Tibbale was a lieutenant who served the Galactic Empire's navy as the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Chimaeras duty security officer.
Geronti was a Lieutenant Commander in the Imperial Navy, where he served as the chief of the main engine control room onboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Chimaera.
Greterine was a captain in the Imperial Army's defense department of the governor's palace stationed on the planet Poln Major.

Frisan was a Moff of the Galactic Empire who served as the governor of the Outer Rim Candoras sector, which included the planets of Poln Major and Poln Minor. They designed an emergency safe room underneath their palace on Poln Major.
Salaban was an Arkanian featured in the Song of Salaban, an Arkanian legend. According to the legend, they lost everything after making the wrong choices.
Mikhtor Doss aka "Cheerful" was a male Human leader of a licensed paramilitary group in the sector containing Elegasso and Pickerin.
A Storm-hair assuming the name "Ranquiv" was the commander of a squadron of Chosen, the warriors of the Storm-hair warlord Nuso Esva and his realm.

Erick was a Male Rebel Alliance soldier who was part of the contingent invited to the Candoras sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

Flind was a Rebel Alliance soldier part of the contingent invited to the Candoras sector. Alongside Erick, he was ordered by General Airen Cracken to accompany the smuggler Han Solo and his partner Chewbacca back to their ship, the Millennium Falcon, in order to question the t…
Baldy was a Human male thug working for the Warlord Nuso Esva on the planet Poln Minor.

Bams was a Human male thug who worked for Warlord Nuso Esva on the planet Poln Major. In 0 ABY, the group's leader on the ground, Dors Stelikag, ordered Bams to contact one of their companions, Kofter, via the comlink, unaware that the Jedi Luke Skywalker had already killed him.

Kofter was a Human male thug working for Warlord Nuso Esva on the planet Poln Major. He held the Jedi Luke Skywalker at gunpoint with a blaster but ultimately died when Skywalker defended himself with his lightsaber.

Mikks was a thug who worked for the realm of Storm-hair Warlord Nuso Esva on the Candoras sector planet Poln Major. In 0 ABY, Mikks and other thugs under the command of Dors Stelikag, one of Esva's agents, discovered the dead corpse of one of their thug colleagues, Kofter.

Dors Stelikag aka "Moustache" aka "Stelig" was a Human male low-rent thug working for Nuso Esva on Poln Major. He organized a riot that commenced a skirmish against Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire forces.
Spikes was a male Human thug working for the Warlord Nuso Esva on planet Poln Minor.
Kinker was a male private guard working for Mikhtor Doss.
Shippo was a male private guard working for Mikhtor Doss.

Roland Quarry was a Jedi Master who trained Elzar Mann as their Padawan during the High Republic Era. They gave Mann and his Padawan friends Avar Kriss and Stellan Gios the nickname "the three firebrands." Long after training with Quarry and even after becoming a Jedi Master, …

Trilinae Untaire was a female Human from the planet Corellia, who was the twin sister of the smuggler Milinae Untaire. During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, Untaire joined the Jedi Order and became a friend of Jedi Master Darrus Jeht.
Lethbridge Grimes was a male Human who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Jee Sallis was a diminutive female Sullustan who lived on the planet of Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
A being of a reddish-purple species with black eyes worked as a communications operator for the Rebel Alliance at an base in an asteroid field.
A Human was the assistant manager of a cantina called the Wookiee's Codpiece on the planet Nim Drovis. In 13 ABY, the protocol droid C-3PO auditioned to perform music at the Wookiee's Codpiece.

Darth Gravid was a human male who reigned as the Dark Lord of the Sith in the lineage of the Order of the Sith Lords. During his tenure as a Sith Lord, Gravid took a Twi'lek female as his apprentice, naming her Darth Gean.
Ffon Althe was a male Pureblood Sith Acolyte who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic.
A Daimanate flight commander was an officer in Sith Lord Daiman's starfighter corps during the Aquilaris campaign in 1032 BBY.
Hanes Croft was a male Cerean who served as a lieutenant within the Office of Peace and Security, a law enforcement agency that operated on the planet Cularin.
Amin Galingal was a male Cerean philosopher who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Gars Croft was a male Cerean who was the brother of the Office of Peace and Security lieutenant Hanes Croft.

Roos Londabir was a male Rodian scoundrel who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In about 31 BBY, Londabir offered to help Dersa Welles, the leader of a criminal organization known as the Intarsa League, to established a shell company.
A female individual was the second wife of Marcus Trant, the Director of Republic Strategic Information Service. He later divorced her.

Kycina was a female Human Nightsister who lived on the planet Dathomir and was the mother of the Sith Lord Darth Maul, as well as his brothers Savage Opress and Feral. She was affiliated with the Witches of Dathomir, a cult of Force-sensitive beings led by Mother Talzin.
Jun Seros was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as the Order's battlemaster during the Great Galactic War and the ensuing Cold War.
Cavill Arin was a Human male Balmorran businessman who delivered anti-stealth devices to the Imperial occupation forces to help them reveal stealthed resistance fighters.

Barlen was a male merchant of the Gran species. During the Cold War, he sold weapons in the town of Jiguuna, on the planet Nal Hutta. He operated a market stall next to the Hutt crime lord Suudaa Nem'ro's palace and paid some of his profits to the criminal.
Hallow Voice was a male Esh-kha patriarch who was born thousands of years ago during the height of his people's reign in the galaxy.
Blarnak was a Gamorrean male bartender who worked in the bar found within Nem'ro's Palace in the industrial town of Jiguuna on the planet Nal Hutta.

Burnok was a Human male and good friend of the Mandalorian Oren Ward. During the Cold War, the pair were on the planet of Nal Hutta where Oren attempted to sneak into the palace of the Hutt crime lord Voontara Fa'athra to steal treasure from the criminal.

Dzoun was a Human male individual of the Sith Empire that joined a Sith cult known as the Revanites. During the Cold War, Dzoun lived in a camp near Kaas City on the planet Dromund Kaas when he introduced himself to a new cult member, who was secretly hired by Emic Sandor to s…

Ceta Farr was a Human female Mandalorian who was a member of the Sith cult known as the Revanites during the Cold War. During the War, she lived near Kaas City on the Sith Empire's capital planet of Dromund Kaas, where she trained other Mandalorian warriors.
Jeelg was a Human male officer who served the reconstituted Sith Empire as a captain on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas.
Gentius Parl was a male Human brawler who served as the leader of a criminal gang that operated in the Qaestar Steps on the planet Talus.
Fizik was a Human male captain who served the reconstituted Sith Empire on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas.
Van Jahan Surgoth was a male Human stabman who was a crewmember of a nagak canoe that patrolled the waters of the Sea of Jarad, on the planet Tralus.
Eben Kinahay was a male Human from the planet Talus. Kinahay lived on an estate located on an island on the Sapphire Lake, in the settlement Hollowtown on Centerpoint Station.

Old Gloxix was a male styanax—a species of aquatic predator—that dwelled in the seas of the planet Tralus. 14 meters in length, Old Gloxix was scarred and stingerless, and he had a black-colored hide.

Sting was a Velusian fursnake owned by Khlor, a Human bounty hunter with a hideout on Velusia, the native planet of Velusian fursnakes. The reptile had black fur. Khlor kept Sting curled around his neck and shoulders at all times.

Sharpest Eye was a male Esh-kha who lived thousands of years ago during the height of his people's reign in the galaxy. During that time, he became a devoted disciple of the new patriarch Hallow Voice who proposed a path of co-existence with alien species.
Hidden Blade was a male Esh-kha who was born thousands of years ago during the height of his people's reign in the galaxy.

Red Walker was a male Esh-kha who was born thousands of years ago in a period in the galaxy where his people were at their height. In this time, a new patriarch was born known as Hallow Voice who proposed a foreign line of thinking that involved co-existence with alien species.
Skull Shatter was a male Esh-kha warrior who was born thousands of years ago during the height of his people's reign in the galaxy.

Ragate was a female Human Sith of the reconstituted Sith Empire and an overseer at the Korriban Sith Academy. During the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, she administrated the rite of blood and bone at the Academy.
This individual was a Human female and a Nightsister from the planet Dathomir. Her name was unknown, and other people only referred to her as "She".
Jonas Tylers was a male Human scientist and adventurer. As a renowned archaeologist, he worked at the University of Coruscant.

A male was the son of the individual Ori Garran. Garran sent their son, whose work at a mill they deemed dissatisfactory, to learn from scholars including geologist Adari Vaal. The male learnt of several theories which contradicted the Keshiri beliefs from the academics.

Rylee Dray was a female Human living on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. Formerly a member of the Cult of the Screaming Blade led by Sith Lord Paladius, she and Destris Veran left the cult after realizing that all of the Sith Lord's promises were false lies.
Qayhuk was the Secretary of the Yinchorri Council of Elders. He petitioned Hego Damask for help in admitting Yinchorr to the Galactic Senate.
Pax Teem was a male Gran senator during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He represented the Gran Protectorate of Malastare in the Galactic Senate.
Lauréna Tylers was a female Human, the daughter of archeologist Jonas Tylers.

Heart Rend was a male Esh-kha who lived during the height of his species reign thousands of years ago. During this time, his race had acquired the wrath of the Infinite Empire due to their marauding of the Rakatan slave worlds.
Jisk Barer was a Quarren Podracing fanatic that visited the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY to see the Boonta Eve Classic. Barer sat in Watto's box next to Breedo and Bok Askol.
Orrin Loneozner was a Human unemployed mechanic on Tatooine. They watched the Boonta Eve Classic from Watto's box in 32 BBY, standing almost directly behind Watto.
Orin Nyell was a male crime lord, smuggler and racketeer. Some time prior to 32 BBY, Nyell came into conflict with a Fluggrian crime boss named Borzu Nale.

A Dathomirian Zabrak male was the father of the eventual Sith Lord Darth Maul. They were a member of the Nightbrothers, a group of warriors who operated on the Outer Rim Territories planet Dathomir and were subservient to the Nightsisters coven of the Witches of Dathomir.
A Quarren male owned an HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class freighter parked in the Galactic City on Coruscant around 21 BBY, during the Clone Wars.
Malik Pendron was a Selonian junk dealer who resided in Bela Vistal during the Galactic Civil War.
Klex Fulgor was a Human male Imperial Inquisitor who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Oranda was a female Human Senator who represented Agamar and the Lahara sector in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Doli-bur Barc was a male, bearded Human Senator representing his constituents in the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the resurgent Sith Empire.
Heerimus was a male Human representative who served Senator Doli-bur Barc in the Galactic Republic Senate during the Cold War with the resurgent Sith Empire.
Kyra 'Naa was a Rodian male who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Thoris Darus was a Human male Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during its final decades, holding office from 60 to 52 BBY. Darus was from the planet of Corulag, and was the successor of Vaila Pecivas.
Alec Efran was a Human male who served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Beryl Thorne was a Human female smuggler operating during the Cold War and Galactic War.
Hurdenn was a male Human Moff who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Dracen was a male Human Imperial Moff stationed on Quesh during the Cold War.

Spirakris Zarem was a female Human who worked as a Senate page. She represented a group of individuals who supported their ideal of the True Republic during Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
A Bith starship dealer was present on the planet of Nal Hutta around 21 BBY and sold two ships to Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, who was disguised as bounty hunter Rako Hardeen.

A Bith male owned a refueling station on the bleak world of Orondia, a planet near Nal Hutta. His brother sold a ship to the trio of bounty hunters Cad Bane, Moralo Eval and Obi-Wan Kenobi, disguised as Rako Hardeen.
Ianna Cel was a Human female doctor who was employed by the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Mal was a Human male police officer with the Coruscant Security Force during the time of the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. Officer Mal was assigned to the Old Galactic Market district of the planet Coruscant.

D was a male Human who worked for the Hutt Riboga during the time of the Clone Wars. In about 21 BBY, Riboga planned to seize control of a criminal organization that was operated in the Cularin system by the Hutt's former accountant Nirama, and in preparation for Riboga's retu…
Salarr was a Human male criminal who held a leadership position in the Black Sun criminal syndicate during the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Yonlach was a male Human Jedi Master who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War. He was confronted and defeated by Darth Baras' apprentice in the latter's quest to eliminate Jaesa Willsaam, one of Yonlach's former Padawans.

Reldar Kandik was a male Duros pilot. Kandik served with the Republic Starfighter Corps as a Captain in Rana Squadron during the Cold War. While on a mission on Taris, Kandik and the rest of his squadron were shot down, and Kandik was the only survivor.

Nurls Yorksin was a female Twi'lek who lived on Coruscant and served as an undercover agent for the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War. Yorksin was tasked with stopping contraband shipping from entering Coruscant.

Tema Folaris was a Human female who lived on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. She served as a police officer for the Coruscant Security Force, working as an undercover agent in the Black Sun territory.
Meh'ur was a Gungan captain who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Marco Vahn was a booking agent who operated in Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War.
Margaret was a female Twi'lek who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Viil Corvii was a male Sullustan who operated out of Providence as a chief mechanic during the Galactic Civil War.
Margon, nicknamed "the Red," was a criminal who operated as a pirate captain during the Galactic Civil War.
"Devin" was a male humanoid individual who lived on the pirate base of Providence during the Galactic Civil War.
This clone trooper participated in the Battle of Kamino around 21 BBY.
The individual was a male Weequay Jedi who served the Galactic Republic as a member of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

One of the Kagles, a trio of furred sentients who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor, was distinguished from his fellows by the fact that he wore a yellow shirt. The Kagle had brown fur and a shock of orange hair atop his head. He had light yellow eyes.

Charle Remmot Organa was a male Human male who was the duke of House of Organa during the Alderaan Civil War, which was part of the larger Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Jake Fenn was a male Human Je'daii Temple Master serving the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Arfan Ramos was a male Human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order and leader of the Green Jedi during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Republic and the Sith Empire.

Calleh was a female Selkath healer of the Je'daii Order on the planet Tython who was the mate of a fellow Selkath, Naro. The two Je'daii jointly held the position of Temple Master of Mahara Kesh, the Temple of Healing on Tython.
Naro was a male Selkath Je'daii Temple Master serving the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.

Quan-Jang was a dark-skinned Humanoid male Je'daii Temple Master living on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign. The administrator of Anil Kesh, Quan-Jang was a master alchemist and wore goggles over his eyes.
Ruhr was a Wookiee Je'daii Temple Master serving the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Tem Madog was a male Cathar Je'daii Temple Master serving the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Lha-Mi was a Talid Dai Bendu monk and a Je'daii Temple Master serving the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Miarta Sek was a female Sith Je'daii Temple Master serving the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Tave was a Noghri male Je'daii Master who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Xesh was a Force-sensitive Human male who was captured and enslaved as a child by the Infinite Empire of the Rakata species.

Skal'nas was a male Rakata Predor of the Infinite Empire. Considered ruthless even by the standards of his people, and adept at treachery and combat, Skal'nas reached his high rank by fighting his way up from low beginnings and had a bad temper.
Tul'kar was a male Rakata who served the Infinite Empire of his species as a Predor, a military commander.
Rori Fenn was a female Human Je'daii Ranger who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.

Ni Timor was a male Kaminoan scientist from the planet Kamino. He was present along with fellow Kaminoan scientists Lac Nor and Ko Sai when Magister Hego Damask inquired the possibility of cloning a Yinchorri.

Hadiya, the Despot Queen, was a female Twi'lek who united the crime barons of her homeworld of Shikaakwa and then conquered the rest of the Tython system. When the Je'daii Order challenged her in 25,805 BBY, Hadiya led the Despot Army to the planet Tython to begin the Despot War.

Lac Nor was a male Kaminoan scientist from the planet Kamino. He was present along with fellow Kaminoan scientists Ni Timor and Ko Sai when Magister Hego Damask inquired the possibility of cloning a Yinchorri.

Mals Tonith was the Muun High Officer of the planet Muunilinst during the 9th century of the Great Peace of the Republic period. As a personal favor to Tonith, InterGalactic Banking Clan member Caar Damask accepted administratorship of the planet Mygeeto.
Daegen Lok was a male Human from the Tython system who was a member of the Je'daii Order, having been trained by Je'daii Master Quan-Jang.

Cabra was a male Dug Black Sun vigo. He had many offspring with Darnada being the youngest. Cabra was given leave to operate on Nar Shaddaa as part of the deal Magister Hego Damask brokered with Gardulla Besadii the Elder.
Trill was a Force-sensitive humanoid slave of the Infinite Empire, trained as a Force Hound by the Rakata. She was a servant of Predor Skal'nas and rival of fellow Force Hound Xesh.
Thok Rath was a male Sith Je'daii Master serving the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Forris was a Human male who served in the Mantellian Army during the Cold War, fought between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

A child sensitive to the Force lived on the planet Orto during the last century of the Galactic Republic. At some point prior to 103 BBY, Jedi Master Unskette and his Padawan Thame Cerulian came across the child while on Orto together.

Wildra Selin was a Human female Imperial Intelligence operative serving the Sith Empire during the Cold War, training other agents in the arts of combat and espionage on the Imperial capital planet of Dromund Kaas.
This Gungan warrior was an Otolla Gungan who served in the Gungan Grand Army as a Militiagung during the Clone Wars around 21 BBY.

Manda was a Human male who served the Sith Empire on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas as a contact for Imperial Intelligence during the Cold War. While hanging out in the local cantina, another operative was directed to Manda by Minder Twenty.

A Jawa lived on the planet Tatooine around 32 BBY. When the Sith Darth Maul landed his ship on Tatooine, the Jawa captured one of Maul's tracker droids in a net. The tracker droid dragged the Jawa along with it, and was seen during the duel between Darth Maul and Qui-Gon Jinn.
Toro Irana was a male Pantoran Jedi Knight who served as an apprentice to Jedi archivist Mander Zuma in the New Jedi Order.
Charky was a male Trandoshan child who was orphaned during the Clone Wars.

Vistis Garn was a male Rodian smuggler living on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War. Garn worked primarily for the criminal group known as the Migrant Merchants' Guild, but he would work for any organization that offered the right price.

An Imperial stormtrooper served at the Imperial Kalist VI labor colony shortly before the Battle of Yavin. Circa 0 BBY, the stormtrooper attempted to stop two prisoners, Breg and Dak Ralter, from escaping the camp.

Vorten Fett was a cyborg Human Mandalorian Commander in the time of the Cold War. He served as the skilled military commander of the Mandalorian encampment on Taris, leading a thousand warriors on the planet under the payment of the Sith Empire.
A Clone tank gunner served under Clone trooper commander CC-3636.

Garvimm was a Human female who served the reconstituted Sith Empire as a stimulants vendor on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas. She was stationed in a small camp near the planet's capital, Kaas City, where she served under Captain Jeelg.

Jhorval was a Human male who served the Sith Empire on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas. At some point either prior to or during the Cold War he joined the cult known as the Revanites, in which he worked his way up to the rank of Elder.
Guyvar was a Human male Sith officer who served as a captain in the Sith Empire.
Kunoa was a Duros male who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Swaine Lothar was a Human male Major of the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY, his team uncovered several artifacts in the Dark Temple and went insane.

Esker was a male individual who worked as a security specialist aboard the star liner White Nova during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In about 31 BBY, the White Nova traveled to the Cularin system in preparation for a voyage to the planet Coruscant.

The Bloodfiend was a monstrous k'lor'slug that resided in the Sith Academy of Korriban. When an acolyte took the rite of blood and bone, they had to confront and defeat the Bloodfiend. The initiation rite had been perpetuated at the Academy for millennia.

Maraad was a male member of the Sith species and a Sith who served the Sith Empire as an apprentice on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas. He was stationed in a small camp near the planet's capital, Kaas City, alongside Captain Jeelg.

Naytha Alutana was a female Twi'lek escort who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Alutana began life as a slave; she was eventually purchased from a slaving pen by Thurm Loogg, a senior Metatheran Cartel official, and she entered the service of the Cartel.
The King Kilassin was a gigantic kilassin, a species of large, non-sentient reptile, that resided in the jungles of the planet Cularin.

A landing controller worked at Desolation Alley, a Republic Correctional Authority prison facility on the asteroid Oovo IV. When the supply ship 1729 entered the Oovo system, the controller gave the starship's captain permission to land.
An Ebruchi pirate known as "Common Cork," who was a member of an Ebruchi clan, held the rank of high captain and commanded an armada of the Ebruchi fleet.
Lain-Ricie was a female Nautolan during the Cold War. She was a vendor who operated along the Woodland Path within the Juran Mountains on Alderaan.

Jaffkee was a Human male who lived on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. At that time, Agent Jaffkee served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force.
Vemec was a Count of Serenno. He was involved in negotiations with the Jedi Order and Damask Holdings over taxation of Celanon hyperwave broadcasts into the Corporate Sector.

Vissfil's brother was a male Brolf who worked for the resistance leader codenamed Patriot in 27 BBY. Patriot was in turn working for Kinman Doriana codenamed 'Defender' who was building a missile that he said was to assassinate Passel Argente.
Aleth Par was an individual who had an interest in the Heroes of Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Kelkan D'vrosh was a male Human drug dealer who resided in the city Gadrin on the planet Cularin.
Chary was a male bodyguard of Ars Veruna, serving under Captain Maris Magneta.
A Human Mandalorian female worked as a bartender at a cantina in the small town of Enceri on the Outer Rim world of Mandalore.

Raptus, regarded as the "Weaver of Nightmares", was the unofficial leader of the Dread Masters, a powerful group of dark side sorcerers with immense power, capable of inducing fear into an entire army.
Tyrans, also known as the "Tactician of the Masters," was a member of the Dread Masters, a group of powerful dark side sorcerers. He wielded a black and white bladed lightsaber.
Lord Styrak, styled as the Corrupter of Darvannis, was a Lord of the Sith and a member of the Dread Masters. His powers were close to those of fellow Dread Master Raptus.
Lord Calphayus, also known as the "Prophet of the Masters", was a powerful Sith Lord and a member of the Dread Masters. He wielded a cyan bladed saberstaff.
Brontes, also known as the "Architect of Fear", was a powerful female Sith sorceress and member of the Dread Masters.

Bestia, also known as the "Keeper of the Dread Seeds", was a member of the Dread Masters, powerful Sith sorcerers. She and Brontes were the only female Masters. She wielded a red one-bladed lightsaber, and was considered the most powerful of her colleagues.
Synnoran was a female Human Lieutenant of the Sith Empire during the Cold War.

homeworld: Unidentified world in the Inner Rim

A Matukai fought with Jedi Padawan Thame Cerulian by 103 BBY. A member of the Matukai organization of Force adepts who used the physical body to channel the Force, the warrior proved to be a challenging opponent to Cerulian.

Griz was a male Trandoshan who was the leader of the Rancor Riders, a street gang that operated in the city Tolea Biqua on the planet Genarius during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

A Talid who was known as Gra'pa to a peer lived on the planet Ando Prime as a monk of the Order of Dai Bendu. A tan-furred Talid with white hair, Gra'pa had yellow eyes and wore heavy hooded robes with gold ornaments.
Dee'Hars was a male Bothan who made a living as a bounty hunter during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, working in conjunction with fellow bounty hunters Clargod, Kelyan and Kiimo.

A male Human served as the captain of the New Republic Dauntless-class heavy cruiser Endor. In 13 ABY, he took the Endor on a patrol near the planetoid RZ7-6113-23 and intercepted two TIE/sr starfighters. They tried to follow the starfighters only to be led into a trap.

A male Human served as an ensign aboard the New Republic Dauntless-class heavy cruiser Endor. In 13 ABY, the Endor went on a patrol near the planetoid RZ7-6113-23 and intercepted two TIE/sr starfighters.

Milosh Muhrlein was a Human male who served the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire during his lifetime. Obtaining the rank of colonel under the Empire, he was put in charge of Imperial Research Station 61 on the planet Wayland.
The fan-eared bounty hunter was a male alien. He had scaly green skin, sharp fingernails, clawed feet, and fan-like fins for ears. He worked for Jabba the Hutt as an assassin.
Royd Pew was a male Human scientist who worked in the Tech Section of Imperial Intelligence. He was in charge of creating and modifying technology for field agents.
Elshuu was an ancient and powerful male Rakata who was imprisoned by the Infinite Empire within a Mind prison thousands of years ago.
Harun was a female Devaronian youngling who was a Je'daii initiate in the Je'daii Order on the planet Tython.

Resi was a male Human youngling who was a Je'daii initiate in the Je'daii Order on the planet Tython. Born after the end of the Despot War, a conflict that was fought between the Je'daii and the Despot Army of the Despot Queen Hadiya, in 25,805 BBY, Resi had fair skin with fre…
Ore'mun was a Force-sensitive Rakatan who served in the species' Infinite Empire as a spy for Predor Skal'nas, a Rakatan overlord.
Urbax was a male Cathar who was a high-ranking member of the Black Sun during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and reconstituted Sith Empire.
Brehg was a male Neimoidian smuggler who lived at the time of the Cold War.
A female prisoner was held by Moff Kentor Sarne, Imperial warlord of the Kathol sector, during the early years of the New Republic.

Cessik was a male Colicoid who lived by the time of the Cold War. In that time, he was a member of the Colicoid Creation Nest and stationed on Balmorra. He was responsible for providing Colicoid DNA for a series of experiments in the creation of a mutant strain.
Hannis D'lund was a member of the dusk band Far Cry from Tuttin IV during the start of the Galactic Civil War.
Erik Lauderslag was a member of the dusk band Far Cry from Tuttin IV during the Galactic Civil War.

During the Clone Wars, an unidentified Trandoshan was being held as a prisoner in the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center in the Galactic City on Coruscant. He wore an orange colored prison jumpsuit.

Lonai was a male Kumumgah and the son of an older Kumumgah who adorned his head with a large headdress. He lived on Tatooine during the Infinite Empire's rule, when the planet was conquered by the Rakata and his city burned.

Karagga, known as Karagga the Unyielding, was a Hutt crime lord that lived in the years of the Cold War. The Supreme Mogul of the Cartel, Karagga held a number of titles, such as Supreme Power of Hutta, Unquestioned Ruler of the Hutt Domain, and Paragon of the Hutt species.
Semasalli was a Dressellian crew member of the freighter Woebegone.

Holiday was a fully sentient holographic lifeform who was Tharan Cedrax's assistant. During the Galactic Cold War, the two accompanied the Scorekeeper's Herald on a mission to stop the spreading of the Dark Plague.

Talva Ko'lib was a Bothan Force Adept who was raised on the planet Bothawui during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Life on Bothawui taught Ko'lib the value of social maneuvering and the Bothan became well placed to gain a position of power on the planet.

Vylanthar Merric was a Human noble who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Merric was raised on a planet that was favored by the Emperor and while still a youth, Merric was brought to the Imperial Court on the planet Coruscant.
Babbo was a male momong born on the Trandoshan moon of Wasskah. This orange-skinned creature lived during the Clone Wars, and was the pet of a spacer.

Lex Dewiller was a male Human fringer who lived on the planet Tazan during the Galactic Civil War, where he owned an operated the cantina Happy Landing in Tazan City. In 0 BBY, Dewiller usually kept himself up to date with all the gossip regarding what was going on in Tazan City.

Lucas Bartmoss was a male Human who worked for the Galactic Empire as a janitor in the Imperial Data Processing Facility on the planet Tazan.
Gleeson Wells was a male Human who worked for a Galactic Empire as a technician in the Imperial Data Processing Facility on the planet Tazan.
Mavrix Varad was a male Mandalorian warrior who lived during the time of the Cold War, a conflict waged between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Solence was a male Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, he served as an Overseer of Sith Academy on Korriban. Solence was killed when a Republic strike team was sent to secure Sith datacrons and artifacts on Korriban.
Maric Tovar was a Force-sensitive male Human, who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later, the New Republic.
Hervey Douglas was a Human who served the Galactic Empire as a military clerk during the Galactic Civil War.
