Siva Smail was a female Twi'lek who had a set of lekku that were adorned with intricate patterns that were red and yellow in color.

Tylan Londar was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire as an Imperial officer. Londar was based in the Imperial Data Processing Facility on the planet Tazan and sometime after the destruction of the planet Alderaan, he encountered a team of Rebel Alliance agents that had…
Dacr Vrolm was a member of the Red Fury Brotherhood, a pirate organization that operated during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.
Ooorlak was a male Wookiee who lived on the planet Cularin, and he became one of Cularin's reigning arm-wrestling champions.
Amille Razna was a female Twi'lek agent who served in the Republic Security Force during the Cold War.

A stormtrooper was stationed in Timira City on the planet Kamino in the year 1 BBY. When Starkiller, a clone of Sith apprentice Galen Marek, escaped the planet to get away from Marek's former master, Sith Lord Darth Vader, the Human male stormtrooper encountered the clone.
Amir D'Vail was a male individual who operated House D'Vails, a merchant house that was based in the city Taggon on the planet Druckenwell.
Arris Rossum was a female Human who was the first wife of Iaco Stark and the mother of Iaclyn, as well as Elli after she had an affair with another man. She died in an accident in 15 BBY.
Ilyan Regus was a Human male Grand Moff of the reconstituted Sith Empire and head of Operation Dark Ice, a plan to use the Adegan crystals of Ilum to develop stealth technology for the Empire.

Cestus was a male Human Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. He was also an Overseer of the Korriban Sith Academy during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. Cestus was killed in 3637 BBY when a Republic strike team was sent to secure Sith datacrons and artifacts on Korriban.

Duanna Falos was a female individual who had a reputation for being a fearless hunter. At some point during galactic history, Falos traveled to the planet Durace in the Unknown Regions along with her lover, her bodyguard and her Mon Calamari servant, because she wanted to test…
The Holopix News photographer assassin was a member of an unknown species. He was a member of the Assassin's Guild.
Somminick Timmns was a male Mirialan Jedi Master who was trained by Nomen Karr during the Great Galactic War and prevented the liberation of Darth Ekkage from the Republic Prison on Belsavis.
Elexia Nis'tar was a female Near-Human who served the company Tangan Industries, and she was married to Durro, one of the younger Tangan brothers. She had dark skin and platinum blonde hair.
Durro was a male individual who was one of the younger Tangan brothers, the owners of the company Tangan Industries.

Anoon'olan was a Twi'lek who held a vice-presidential postion within the company Tangan Industries. Tangan tasked Anoon'olan with administering the city Shirkel on the Tangan-controlled planet Iol, in the Unknown Regions.
Tol Ferin was a male Chadra-Fan who served the company Tangan Industries as a Vice President. In 28 BBY, Tangan appointed Ferin to run the city Menelath on the planet Iol in the Unknown Regions.

Kai Lunn was a Human who lived on the planet Iol at some point during galactic history. Lunn acted as the leader of the Miners' Union, a trade union that sought to uphold the rights of workers on Iol.
Kin Thalin was a male individual who was the owner of a small cantina that was located in the city Haven, on the planet Iol.

Kryo Tinwole was a male Force Adept who was among the first colonists that settled on the planet Veroleem, in the Unknown Regions. While carrying out a scouting expedition on Veroleem, Tinwole discovered the ruins of an ancient Sith laboratory.
Carto was a male Human agent of the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire. During the Galactic War he was stationed on the Vaiken Spacedock.

In 19 BBY, the Oyu'baat tapcaf was staffed by a male Mandalorian bartender. The bartender was both sarcastic and sympathetic toward his fellow Mandalorians, providing warnings for when a patron of the Oyu'baat had been placed on the galactic bounty hunting list.
Irem Gehldon was the acting ambassador of Chandrila at the time of the destruction of Alderaan.
Jonas Davan was a male Human major who worked at the Chandrilan Embassy on Coruscant at the time of the destruction of Alderaan.
Joll Kohan was a grizzled man from a military background who was affiliated with a resistance group that opposed the Cult of Veroleem, a religious sect that ruled Veroleem.
Vorli was a male Human who was affiliated with a resistance group that opposed the Cult of Veroleem, a religious sect that ruled the planet Veroleem.

Vallkos was a male Human pirate who was the brother of Mallikhan. At some point during galactic history, Vallkos and Mallikhan traveled to the planet of Volik in the Unknown Regions, as part of a large band of pirates.

Mallikhan was a male Human pirate who was the brother of Vallkos. At some point during galactic history, Mallikhan and Vallkos traveled to the planet Volik in the Unknown Regions, as part of a large band of pirates.

Dilta was a male Anarrian child who lived in the city Rastar on the planet Altiria/Anarris. At some point during galactic history, Dilta was wandering through Rastar's starport when he became hungry, and he determined to steal some food from some cargo containers that were bei…
Lunaara was an ancient Anarrian hero. A statute of Lunaara was located in the center of Lunaara Square, a public meeting place situated in the city Rastar on the planet Altiria/Anarris.
Ralebedth was a male Mandalorian vendor operating out of Kaas City on the Sith capital planet Dromund Kaas during the Cold War.

Braum Bourne, also known as "Zakkeg", was a male Mandalorian living during the Cold War. Having been sent their way by Rally Master Merrk Kelborn on Vaiken Spacedock, he and Gen Vizla helped give tips to the future Grand Champion of the Great Hunt, becoming very impressed with…
A Dathomirian Nightsister lived on the planet of Dathomir around 20 BBY and participated in the Battle of Dathomir against the droid army led by Separatist Supreme Commander General Grievous.
A Human security guard lived on the planet of Naboo around 21 BBY when Supreme Chancellor Palpatine visited the planet to preside over a public ceremony, the Festival of Light.
The Mountain were five exceedingly tall Kadas'sa'Nikto brothers who lived on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Bareesh Fenn'ak Torill, also known as Bareesh the Hutt or simply Bareesh, was a Hutt crime lord on Nar Shaddaa of the Bareesh Clan which was a part of the Hutt Cartel. He was also the leader of the Kintan Kings before being overthrown by five brothers known as The Mountain.
Nilya Fek'ra was a Human female criminal operative who served as the elegant but ruthless right-hand of an unnamed Cotellier-based crime lord during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.

Bleeker was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence on the planet Coruscant by the year 3 BBY. In that year, they worked in the Tech Section of Intelligence under the scientist Royd Pew, who had them test experimental parawings being developed by Tech.

Sli'Lon Tahar was a Human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Great Sith War. After the Battle of Deneba, he left the Jedi Order and joined the Galactic Circus, under the alias "The Great Brotzman".

Baron Deathmark was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto announcer for the Huttball games played by the Hutt Cartel between 3643 BBY and 3630 BBY. At some point, he commentated on a match between the Frog-dogs and the Rotworms.
Emesh Nar was a Human male who served as an aide to Ambassador Blains Vorlin. He was stationed at the Imperial embassy on Etti IV in the Corporate Sector.

Gelleric was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. When Quinlan Vos made his notes in the Book of Sith, he reflected that since Gelleric was the only Jedi whom he could think of who wielded a double-bladed lightsaber, it was possible…
Dah'lis Stark was a female Nautolan and former dancer who was the second wife of Iaco Stark, and the step-mother of Ellie and Iaclyn Stark.

Sibyl was an impressionable female individual. At some point during galactic history, Sibyl encountered a pair of traveling priests from the Cult of Veroleem in a starport and she agreed to travel to the distant planet Veroleem and become a new recruit of the cult.

Bale was a male individual who was native the planet Veroleem, in the Unknown Regions. Bales was a member of a resistance cell that opposed the Cult of Veroleem, a religious sect that ruled the planet, and the cultists eventually captured Bale and imprisoned him in a jail in t…

Elli Stark was a female Human, the daughter of Arris Rossum and a man other than her husband. Arris was married to Iaco Stark and Stark raised her as his daughter, with Elli not knowing the truth of her parentage. Iaclyn Stark was her half-brother.
Iaclyn Stark was a Human male, the son of Iaco Stark and Arris Rossum and the half-brother of Elli Stark.

An Nikto Dark Side Adept was trained by the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious. This adept was subjected to the effects of orbalisks by Palpatine, but could not handle the immense pain caused by the creatures.
Blains Vorlin was a Human male diplomat who served as the ambassador of the Galactic Empire to the Corporate Sector Authority on Etti IV in the Corporate Sector.
Vodal Kressh was a Dark Lord of the Sith who lived a thousand years before the Cold War.
Twintan was a male Pureblood Sith Inquisitor and Sith Lord who served Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.
Vereta Fraabaal was a Human female Sith apprentice in the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Fraabaal was a Human Admiral serving in the Sith Empire's navy during the Cold War.
Grathan was a male Human Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic.
Reen Irana was a female Pantoran spacer who was the sister of the Jedi Knight Toro Irana. She worked alongside Bothan Eddey Be'ray.
Mika Horn was a Human male who served as a soldier in the army of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Morrun Dokaas was a Chagrian male Sith of the Sith Empire on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas. He was secretly a member of the Sith cult known as the Revanites in which he helped to test new members during their pilgrimage to join the cult.
Nonzo Oshorr was a Chevin male who resided on the reconstituted Sith Empire's capital planet of Dromund Kaas during the Cold War.
Nexwig was a Human male who served the Sith Empire on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas where he sold equipment to Sith Warriors.
Thana Vesh was a female Human who became one of the apprentices to Darth Gravus during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
An Imperial captain served aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor, flagship of the Dark Lord Darth Vader, during the Imperial occupation of Bespin in 3 ABY.

Bulga the Crude was a female Zabrak bounty hunter who lived during the Cold War and the Galactic War. Residing on the Sith Empire's Vaiken Spacedock she also shared her knowledge with others alongside Deagan Farrell.
Gen Vizla was a Human Mandalorian and a member of Clan Vizla, living during the Cold War. On Vaiken Spacedock he worked with fellow Mandalorian, Braum Bourne to help train promising bounty hunters.

The Hunter, also known by the callsign Scree, was the nickname of a famous bounty hunter and mercenary that rose to prominence during the Cold War, winning the Great Hunt bounty hunting competition and earning the title of Grand Champion of the Great Hunt.

A male Devaronian once tried to pick up Princess Leia Organa while in a sleazy cantina in the Tatooine spaceport of Mos Eisley. After several attempts to dismiss him, the Princess finally succeeded in doing so by brandishing a blaster.

Sundar was a male Human Sith Lord on Korriban during the Cold War. At some point during the war, Sundar turned against the Sith Empire and took residence in the Tomb of Tulak Hord in the Valley of the Dark Lords.
Velmin was a female Human of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War she was stationed in the Dorn Base on Hoth, where she managed armor and equipment.
Quen-Ton was a female Chiss ally of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Stationed in the Dorn Base on Hoth, she managed the supplies of stimulants.
Jik Noyid was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto bounty hunter living during the Cold War. Around 3643 BBY he resided in the Dorn Base on Hoth, teaching his knowledge to others.
Besk was a male Human officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Stationed in the Dorn Base on Hoth, he also handled the requisitioning of armor upgrades.
Officer Mayin Yerol was a male Human officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War, serving in the Drift Hills Imperial Outpost on Hoth as a stims vendor.
The "Spineless Headcheese" was a small, seven-legged invertebrate. He was Orion Ferret's companion and often rested on Ferret's shoulder or clung to his head.
During the Clone Wars, a clone sergeant was based on the space station New Dawn, a Galactic Republic military installation that was located in the Druckenwell system.
Corbro Stanch was a male Human Mandalorian who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Njanner-Pok was a male Human Mandalorian living during the Cold War. Residing in the city of Mos Ila on the planet Tatooine, he managed a vendor stand and sold armor.
Amzartho was a male Human Mandalorian who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Thron was a male Human Mandalorian serving as a Heavy Armor Vendor in the city of Mos Ila on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War. He wore blue Mandalorian armor.
Branger was a male Human Mandalorian serving as a Stims Vendor in the Outpost Rennar on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War. He wore blue Mandalorian armor.
Gezda was a male Human Mandalorian warrior residing in Outpost Rennar on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War. He wore blue Mandalorian armor.
Dorrick was a male Human Mandalorian warrior residing in the Outpost Rennar on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War. He wore blue Mandalorian armor.
Zola Arvannus was a female Human member of the Imperial Diplomatic Service residing in the Mandalorian Outpost Rennar on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War.

Shai Tenna was a male Weequay who was the leader of a group belonging to the White Maw pirates, during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Ku'ar Danar was a male Jedi who lived before the Second Great Schism and later was considered a Sith Lord by some.
Capri Otti was a female individual who worked as a courier on the planet Tatooine during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Layek Davos was an admiral in the Imperial Navy of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War and the subsequent Cold War. He fought in the Imperial victory at the Battle of Hoth.
Kyobuk was a female Wookiee merchant and captain who, along with her partner, the Advozse Sars Tarquhar, frequently operated on Bannistar Station during the reign of Emperor Palpatine.
Sars Tarquhar was a male Advozse merchant who, along with his partner, the Wookiee Captain Kyobuk, frequently operated on Bannistar Station during the reign of Emperor Palpatine.
Zam Basdor was a male Human dignitary of the Imperial Remnant and the right hand man of Admiral Gilad Pellaeon.

Nanika Senoj was a Human female smuggler during the reign of Emperor Palpatine. Around 2 BBY, Senoj and the Sullustan Dwanar Gher were wanted by the Imperial Security Bureau for helping to rescue some wanted criminals from the Imperial authorities.
Shalath was a female Human Sith Lord and Sith alchemist who served the Sith Empire on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas.
Sarnova was a Human female captain, nicknamed Duchess by her troops, who served the reconstituted Sith Empire on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas.
Laskin was a Human male lieutenant of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.
Lodish was a Togruta male serving in the Republic Military of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.

Greik was an admiral of the Galactic Republic's naval fleet during the Great Galactic War. Around 3670 BBY, after the Sith Empire's victory in the Seswenna sector, Greik caught wind of an Imperial plan to attack the Mid Rim world of Bothawui.

Rora Seake was a Sith pureblood female who served as an assassin for the Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. Known as a master of beasts, Seake kept two massive creatures known as jurgorans as her pets and controlled them in combat.
Watcher One was codename for a Human male Intelligence Operative of the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Tharis Orne was a male Human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. He was considered one of the greatest Jedi Masters of the Order during his time, and his wisdom, knowledge, and personality was later imprinted on the Noetikon of Science.

Tarro Blood was a Human male Mandalorian-turned bounty hunter who operated during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He was a competitor in the Great Hunt, going to great lengths in order to sabotage his fellow competitors.

The Voidhound, a member of the Coruscant Aegis who also went by the callsign "Ace," was a smuggler who served as a privateer for the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. The captain was still not found in the last five years during the Eternal Empire's raid.
Vinson was a Human male major who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Leebo Nobim was a male Ortolan colonist residing on Hoth during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY his camp was attacked by Gamorreans from the Unstoppable Horde and Leebo retreated to the Outpost Cresh. He later asked a Republic individual to deal with his problem.
Nolan Pars was a male Duros citizen of the Galactic Republic who lived during the Galactic War. Stationed on Hoth in 3642 BBY, he asked a fellow Republic citizen to re-calibrate seismic

Cadix was a Human male lieutenant of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed at the Outpost Cresh on Hoth, where he helped decipher sensitive information retrieved from a corpse of a Chiss defector by a Republic citizen.
Leeha Narezz was a female Nautolan Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Dorjander Kace was a male Human Jedi Master who was captured by the Mandalorian Crusaders during the Great Sith War and spent the remainder of the war in captivity. There, he fell in love with a Mandalorian named Varda.

Edell Vrai was a Human male who was a member of the Golden Destiny faction in 3000 BBY. The then-Caretaker Varner Hilts regarded him as being one of the most forward-looking members of the Golden Destiny. He later became a High Lord during the Hilts Restoration.

Kayala Fei was a Human female Sith Saber in the 44 ABY disguised as an announcer at the BAMR News that advised the citizens of the plot of the Jedi spice cartel. She was killed by Octa Ramis on Coruscant during the the Jedi attack.
Suhale was a Human female Sith of the Lost Tribe of Sith in the 44 ABY on Coruscant disguised as a Captain of the Coruscanti Immigration Service stationed at the Galactic Center Spaceport.
Modt was a Duros inspector in the Coruscanti Immigration Service. He was responsible for finding neutron pixie spice which undercover Jedi Knight Bazel Warv was carrying.

A sergeant fought for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The historian Arhul Hextrophon prefaced a section in the ground combat chapter of his report entitled "Report on Growth, Organization, Equipment, Activities, and Objectives of the Rebelli…
Wole Vahn was a male Human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. He lived sometime before the Great Galactic War, and he was considered one of the greatest Jedi Masters of the Order during his time.

Avik Lore was a Human male overweight smuggler. He was once contracted to deliver a ship of Rock wart eggs to Siskeen. Avik took up smuggling after failing to make a living as a musician, a gambler, and a cantina owner.
Master Sav was a muscular Human male and the leader of the Hailstorm Brotherhood pirate sect operating on the planet Hoth.
A Muun named Hego Damask was Caar Damask's clan father, who named his own son—and Hego Damask I's grandson—after him.
Brutann was a male Human Beast-Lord of Onderon and a Sith serving the reconstituted Sith Empire on the planet of Hoth during the Galactic War.
Heljus was a female Zabrak Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.
Elsor was a male Bith Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.
During the Cold War, the Beast-Lord Brutann controlled many of the planet Hoth's most vicious creatures in service to the Sith Empire. Among Brutann's Force-dominated beasts was a wampa.

Clados Vader was a mysterious changeling entity who dwelled in the oceans of Iskalon. It was a giant deformed shark, and it could turn into the shape of the Sith Lord Darth Vader. In 0 ABY, Clados was killed by Luke Skywalker for having captured the golden droid C-3PO.
Devon Race was a male Human Padawan of the Jedi Order serving the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.

A young Muun was among a group of younglings brought to the crystalline world of Mygeeto by one of the wives of Caar Damask, the Muun administrator of the world, for the sole purpose of being a playmate for their son, Hego Damask.

Ahrens, also known by the callsign Blade Three, was an Imperial pilot who was a member of Blade Flight, a starfighter unit that flew Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighters and formed part of the 77th Air Wing.

A Force-sensitive Muun female was the mother of Sith Lord Darth Plagueis. She was a disciple of Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Tenebrous. She was instructed to seduce Caar Damask of the InterGalactic Banking Clan and carry his child.
A Khormai accompanied another member of the Khormai species in the casino within Attuma Duum's headquarters on an asteroid near Cavamina Minor c. 21 BBY.
A Khormai was present in the casino in Attuma Duum's headquarters on an asteroid near Cavamina Minor c. 21 BBY along with another member of the Khormai species.
Kuthak was a male Talz commando who served in the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War where he fought the resurgent Sith Empire on the planet Hoth.

Gavon Kroan was a male human sergeant serving the Galactic Republic on the planet Hoth during the Galactic War. Stationed at the Drift Hills Republic depot, he sent the first squad of Recon Company — men he personally trained — on a routine check into nearby caves.
Rieekan was a Human male Bureau Chief who served the Republic Strategic Information Service and was in charge of SIS operations on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.

Sasori Vader was a changeling entity who lived in a Jawa sandcrawler on the planet Tatooine at the time of the Galactic Civil War. Its true form was that of a giant scorpion with red glowing eyes, but it could turn into the shape of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Chaskar was a male Pureblood Sith Overseer who served the Emperor of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

A male Bothan individual with pale gold fur served as a police officer for the Coruscant Security Force during the invasion of the galaxy by the Yuuzhan Vong. In 26 ABY, the Bothan held the police rank of captain and was monitoring planetary space traffic.
Kaiya Stas was a female Miraluka Jedi serving the Galactic Republic on the planet Hoth during the Cold War.
The White Terror was the name given to a legendary wampa who stalked colonists on the planet Hoth during the Cold War.
Yoren was a Human male Moff of the reconstituted Sith Empire who was captured during the Cold War by the Terror Brigade group on the planet Hoth and offered conditionally to the Galactic Republic.
Ujooku was a large wampa that the Terror Brigade included among its warriors in its combat challenge called the Onslaught on the planet Hoth during the Cold War.
Kanen was a Human male captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire fighting on the planet Hoth during the Cold War.
During the Cold War, a hulking wampa on the planet Hoth was in possession of an ancient Sith holocron that the reconstituted Sith Empire thought to be destroyed years earlier.

P'laang Ri was a Zabrak that lived during the Galactic Civil War. Ri owed the smuggler Han Solo a few favors, and Solo collected when he left his ship the Millennium Falcon in Ri's hangar on Siskeen for safekeeping.

Daleen was a young Human female who was rumored to be a Princess of a royal house until she became a student at the Orsis Academy during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 39 BBY, she was absent from the academy more often than Maul, a fellow student.
Noosh Feteel was one of the founding fathers of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. A painting of Feteel was displayed on Pisquatch's Place.
A Human female, the mother of a boy named Durrei, lived on Elrood. Shortly after 13 BBY, she was accused of treason by the Galactic Empire. When her husband resisted, they were both executed.
The father of Durrei was a Human male. Durrei's father lived on Elrood. He and his wife were murdered by Imperial stormtroopers shortly after 13 BBY.

Soleks was an Imperial engineer on the planet Hoth during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY, Soleks was tasked with placing navigational beacons around a volcanic sinkhole located in the Northern Snowdrift Hills in the Clabburn Tundra.

Viatar was a Human male captain who served the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY, he had been stationed at the Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison on Hoth, an outpost that was about to be undermined by a team of Republic sappers.
Loyat was a female Human Sith Lord who was the apprentice of the Dark Councilor Darth Arho during the Cold War.

Korol Tander was a male Twi'lek who worked as a Special Agent with the Galactic Republic's Strategic Information Service during the Cold War. Tander was stationed on Nar Shaddaa, under Bureau Chief Rieekan.
A male Gungan was the Security Chief during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY, and was responsible for security concerns in Gungan society.
Palpatine's first brother was one of at least three male children of Naboo aristocrat and head of House Palpatine Cosinga Palpatine and his wife.
Palpatine's second brother was one of at least three male children of Naboo aristocrat and head of House Palpatine Cosinga Palpatine and his wife.

Palpatine's first sister was one of at least two female children of Naboo aristocrat and head of House Palpatine Cosinga Palpatine and his wife, and sister to Palpatine, future Dark Lord of the Sith as Darth Sidious, Senator of Naboo, Supreme Chancellor of the Republic, and Em…

Palpatine's second sister was one of at least two female children of Naboo aristocrat and head of House Palpatine Cosinga Palpatine and his wife, and sister to Palpatine, future Dark Lord of the Sith as Darth Sidious, Senator of Naboo, Supreme Chancellor of the Republic, and E…

Vorzoth was a male nekghoul who entered into an agreement with Ryler Dorant, a scientist and soldier of the Sith Empire, where Vorzoth would provide Dorant with rakghouls for his research in exchange for help attacking the Galactic Republic on Taris.
Shassium was an ancient Republic philosopher. In 34 BBY, Shassium's words came to Palpatine's mind while he was listening to a speech being given by Chancellor Finis Valorum in the Galactic Senate.

Ortan Cela was a member of the early Sith Empire, an apprentice to the Dark Lord of the Sith Tulak Hord. He would walk with a Dashade shadow assassin called Veshikk Urk, the greatest rival of fellow assassin Khem Val.

Veshikk Urk was a Dashade Shadow Killer and servant of Ortan Cela, the apprentice of Tulak Hord. He was the greatest rival of his fellow Dashade assassin Khem Val, who served under Lord Hord's command. Khem Val considered Veshikk a weakling and a slave to Ortan Cela.
Amaya Kymeri was the clan mother of the Howling Crag Clan, a clan of Dathomiri Witches that lived on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War.
Denkra Kymeri, who later assumed the name of Voidsister Warrior, was a Dathomirian Witch during the Galactic Civil War.

Naija Kymeri, who later assumed the name of Voidsister Huntress, was a Dathomirian Witch during the Galactic Civil War. She was a member of the Howling Crag Clan, which was headed by the clan mother Amaya Kymeri.
Thestriel Kymeri, who later assumed the name of Voidsister Spellweaver, was a Dathomirian Witch who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Trakri was a male Human Republic soldier who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. He held the rank of Private, and he was stationed on the Republic's Carrick Station. Trakri trained others in the skill of armstech, which was the art of making weaponry.
Tebien Ros was a Human male who lived on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. He had a shop on the Promenade, where he built and sold blasters and other weaponry.

Cha'nagh was a male Flesh Raider who lived on the planet Tython during the time of the Cold War fought between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Cha'nagh had blue eyes and pink-colored skin, utilized a vibrosword in combat, and wore thick, silver-colored shoulder armor.
Nak'har was a male Defel criminal who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Matare was a male Human Jedi Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the resurgent Sith Empire.

Rusa was a female Rutian Twi'lek who lived on Tython during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. She was the daughter of Bahlea and her husband, who were Pilgrims from Ryloth.
Dendim was a male Twi'lek merchant who lived on Tython during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Badmil was a male Twi'lek merchant who lived on Tython during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Ocera was a Human male Jedi Master who served as one of the masters of Ashara Zavros during the Cold War between the Republic and the Sith Empire. He was killed on Taris when he and Ryen engaged a Sith Lord named Kallig, but they were easily defeated.
Poronth Ghon was a male Lethan Twi'lek Pilgrim who lived on Tython illegally during the Cold War between the resurgent Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Beejinz was a male Twi'lek merchant who lived on Tython during the Cold War with the resurgent Sith Empire.
Armala was a male Human Republic soldier who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. He was stationed on the Republic's Carrick Station, where he built armor in a small shop.

Keshk was a male Flesh Raider who held the position of Grand Chieftain among the Flesh Raider species on their homeworld of Tython during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
"Lefty" Grandarak was a male Arcona smuggler who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Mariyk was a female Twi'lek who worked in the Drunkard's Vote cantina in the Senate Commercial District during the Cold War. Her cantina was a favorite haunt for smugglers during the war.
Qet was a male Human Sith Lord who was trained by the Sith Lord Darth Vowrawn during the Galactic War.
A female individual owned a traveling air rodeo, which at some point featured trained thrantas, a species of large, winged creatures.

A male individual who was married to a woman who was the owner of a traveling air rodeo that used thrantas. At some point, his wife was captured by an animal rights group who planned to starve her to bring about end of the use of thrantas in traveling air rodeos.

Jonos Triv was a human male who worked as a smuggler during the Cold War. While on Coruscant, he frequented the Senate Commercial District where he would spend his time at the Drunkard's Vote cantina.
Thugo was a male Rodian merchant who lived on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. He had a small shop on the Lower Promenade, where he sold equipment modifications.

Arias was a Human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. Originally a Jedi Consular before he achieved the rank of Master, Arias was stationed on Nar Shaddaa.

In 3.5 ABY, Dark Prince Xizor of the Black Sun crime syndicate ended his relationship with one of his many mistresses, leaving her with an extravagant dwelling in Coruscant's Imperial City as a going-away present.

A TIE pilot of the Galactic Empire fought in defense of the Imperial-controlled moon of Gall during a Rebel Alliance attack in 3.5 ABY. Flying a TIE/LN starfighter, the zealous pilot went head-to-head with Rogue Leader Luke Skywalker but was destroyed in the encounter.
Valion Pyron was a Human male Moff of the resurgent Sith Empire and an ally to Darth Nox during the Galactic War.
Kerred Santhe the Second was a male Human who was the son of industrialist Kerred Santhe, the Chief Executive Officer of Santhe/Sienar Technologies.

Bettin was a yellow-skinned Human male who served as a sniper and exotic weapons expert member of Wraith Squadron in 13 ABY. He was present on a mission to Ryvester that eliminated Imperial Admiral Kosh Teradoc.

Barik was a male Human merchant who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He had a shop on Carrick Station, where he sold speeders and swoop bikes.
Beshel was a Human male who lived on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. He had a shop on the Lower Promenade, where he built and sold armor, as well as armor upgrades and materials.
During the latter years of the Galactic Republic, a male Yinchorri was convicted for murdering six other members of his species.

Breshin was a female Cathar who worked as a geologist during the Cold War. She specialized in recovering powerful lightsaber crystals. Breshin had a shop on Carrick Station, where she sold her findings to the Galactic Republic's forces.
Varad Zagg was a Human male Sith who lived at the ruins of the Sith Academy on Umbara during the Clone Wars.

Huli was an Arcona Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order. The young Jedi was one of the thirty apprentices promoted to the rank of Knight after the evacuation of the New Jedi Order from the Jedi Academy on the planet Ossus and sent on Coruscant as reinforcement in the fight agains…

Ramud was a male Duros Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order. He was one of the thirty apprentices promoted to the rank of Knight after the evacuation of the New Jedi Order from the Jedi Academy on the planet Ossus and sent on Coruscant as reinforcement in the fight against the Lo…

Jayk was a female Ryn Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order. She was one of the thirty apprentices promoted to the rank of Knight after the evacuation of the New Jedi Order from the Jedi Academy on the planet Ossus and sent on Coruscant as reinforcement in the fight against the Lo…
An unidentified woman was the sister of a candidate for the Naboo throne and the mistress of Cosinga Palpatine, despite that Cosinga was already married.

Rivai was a Jedi Knight of the New Jedi Order. The young Jedi was one of the thirty apprentices promoted to the rank of Knight after the evacuation of the New Jedi Order from the Jedi Academy on the planet Ossus and sent on Coruscant as reinforcement in the fight against the L…

Cafian was a male Human Republic lieutenant who was stationed on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. He monitored the Lower Promenade from his base there, and would gladly help out any fellow trooper who happened by.

An unidentified Queen of Naboo reigned some 240 years before the Battle of Naboo. One of her royal gowns was adorned with elegant beaded emblems. More than two centuries later, those ornaments were reused to decorate Queen Amidala's foreign residence dress.
This male individual was a member of Naboo's aristocracy, and a candidate for the planet's throne in the year 65 BBY.
A Hutt attended a reception on Grand Moff Lynch Hauser's personal Star Destroyer. A rarity amongst the Hutt, this individual had hair, which he or she would style in locks.
Prudy was a female Lethan Twi'lek from the planet Coruscant who worked as a doctor during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Starsnow was a Human male Jedi Master and the son of Senator Starsnow. He died during the Sacking of Coruscant, and his journal was recovered by a traveling hero for Starsnow's father.

Waarin was a male Human orphan who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. He, along with several other orphans, lived in the hydrosupply chambers in Black Sun territory after their parents died in the Great Galactic War.
Mira was a female Mirialan Jedi who lived during the Cold War. She was assigned to Carrick Station, where she sold powerful relics and armor to the forces of the Galactic Republic.

Zooki was a male Rodian who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. He worked for Gambo, a Black Sun enforcer. Zooki met all of Gambo's visitors in the Dealer's Den, and warned a traveling hero that he shouldn't try to arrest Gambo.

Marren Elna was a Human female who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. She had a small shop in the Senate Commercial District, where she sold synthetic fabrics and other materials for synthweaving.
Uwin Lokk was a Human male who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. He was a weaponsmith with a shop in the Senate Commercial District where he taught his trade.
Briqui was a male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
A Belugan guard lived on the planet Quarzite and worked for Major Rigosso during the Clone Wars.
A Belugan guard lived on the planet Quarzite and worked for Major Rigosso during the Clone Wars.
During the Galactic Civil War, Emperor Palpatine employed a gardener to maintain the extensive botanical gardens on his personal skyhook.

Korelei was a female Keshiri Lord of the Lost Tribe of Sith who became one of the final host bodies of Abeloth and was killed at the New Jedi Temple when Abeloth and the Lost Tribe of Sith were defeated.

A Human male worked at the Foerost Shipyards in 3996 BBY, during the time of the Great Sith War. That year, Sith Lord Ulic Qel-Droma attacked Foerost and killed the employee when he refused to yield to Qel-Droma's demands for the operations codes for the shipyards' new Republi…

A bald Human male once played a game of sabacc with five other players, including Lando Calrissian, in the Flip of the Credit casino on the planet Rodia in 3.5 ABY. The bald man folded one of his hands in response to Calrissian's bold play, not realizing Calrissian was bluffing.

The brother-in-law of Dremullar Obohn di Garthos, both members of the Muun species, was the constable of the Core Worlds planet Ralltiir. At some point in his life, di Garthos's brother married his Muun consort and held a wedding party with the entire Ralltiiri police force.

An alien cardplayer once played sabacc with four other players, including Lando Calrissian, in the Flip of the Credit casino on the planet Rodia in 3.5 ABY. In one hand the alien player folded in light of Calrissian's bold play, not realizing Calrissian was bluffing.
Encot was a male Human who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He was the sheriff of Anchorhead.
Bakishan was a male Twi'lek constable for the Tatooine city of Anchorhead during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Axeman was a vibro-ax-wielding Human male swooper who rode with the crime lord Jabba the Hutt's swoop gang by 3.5 ABY.
A male swooper wearing a graysuit rode in the crime lord Jabba the Hutt's swoop gang during the gang's failed assassination attempt of the Jedi Luke Skywalker on the planet Tatooine in 3.5 ABY.

A female individual served as the makeup artist of Imperial Head of State Jagged Fel moments before he participated in the Great Election Day Debate, which was the live debate held between all the candidates before the polling ended.
This creature was a tusk cat that Queen Padmé Amidala rode during the Victory Races of Naboo.
Geeda was a male Rodian merchant who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. He had a shop down in the Old Galactic Market's Concourse Bazaar where he sold synthleather jackets.
Grund'messel was a male Nikto merchant who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. He owned a stand in the Old Galactic Market's Concourse Bazaar, from which he sold heavy armor.
Edvaalda was a female Twi'lek who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. She worked as a bartender in the Dealer's Den cantina in the Old Galactic Market.
Nizkif was a male Advozse who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. He frequented the Dealer's Den cantina in the Old Galactic Market.
Jin Kalosi was a Mirialan male who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. A biochemist, Kalosi taught his trade in a small shop in the Senate Commercial District.
Qoen Dervul was a Twi'lek male who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. Dervul bought, sold, and created artifacts and relics from his shop in the Senate Commercial District.
Kevan Orr was a Human male who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. Orr bought, sold, and built cybernetics and robotics at his shop in the Senate Commercial District.

Anev Xydes was a male Human Sith Adept who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. He was part of the Sith team that infiltrated the ruins of the Jedi Temple in search of an astrogation computer.

A female Jinda dancer served as the assistant to Trebla the magician during the Travelling Jindas' performance to the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village in 3.5 ABY. He used his "powers" to levitate her, but in actual fact she was lifted from the ground via ropes and harness.
Jokskk Quosto was a male Selkath who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War with the resurgent Sith Empire.
A Padawan served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Dark Jedi Conflict, an event which took place in the Cularin system in 181 BBY.
During the last millennium of the Galactic Republic a female individual served within the Jedi Order as a Jedi Knight, specializing as a Jedi Consular.
Serdarn was a Human male who served in the Republic Military during the Cold War. He was stationed on Carrick Station, where he sold a wide variety of items to the Republic forces aboard.

Ivok was a Zabrak male who worked as a bioanalyst during the Cold War and Galactic War. As a bioanalyst and a doctor, Ivok worked aboard Carrick Station, where he kept a small shop. There, he bought and sold valuable plants and medicines.

Parkanas Tark was a male Human Jedi who lived during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War. Left behind during an expedition to Malachor III, he came under the sway of the spirit of the ancient Sith Lord Terrak Morrhage and fell to the dark side, adopting the name Lord Vivicar.

Tela Rovas was a female Human Sith Lady of the Lost Tribe of Sith disguised as Chief Justice of the Court of Justice. She was one of the few Sith to survive the firsts phase of the Liberation of Coruscant thanks to her use of Robr Selvi, a fellow judge, as a human shield.

Katei Elinari Panteer was a Human female Alderaanian who was Princess of House Panteer and a survivor of the family following the death of Queen Silara Panteer during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Diyaz was a Human Male agent with the Strategic Information Service during the Cold War. Diyaz was part of a task force along with Special Agent Korol Tander and commandos from Blackstar Squad who destroyed the files of the Galactic Republic's secret Power Guard Project after …

Singe was a male Rodian who worked as a smuggler during the Cold War. While on Coruscant, he frequented Mariyk's cantina in Coruscant's Senate Commercial District. He sold powerful weapons and armor to other smugglers for a price.
Chax Jernil was a male Devaronian who lived during the Cold War. An underworld trader, Jernil made his base at the Drunkard's Vote cantina in Coruscant's Senate Commercial District.
Palo Pevv was a Sullustan male who worked as a treasure hunter during the Cold War. He could be frequently found in the Drunkard's Vote cantina in Coruscant's Senate Commercial District.
Dommu was a male Zabrak who lived during the Cold War. Dommu owned a shop in the Senate Commercial District of Coruscant, where he sold item modifications and upgrades.
Ferav was a Human male Sith Inquisitor who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.

Marcovic was a male Human who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. A lieutenant in the Imperial Military, Marcovic was assigned to a secret listening post on the planet Ord Mantell in the later years of the Cold War.
Ottau was a Human male who worked for the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Daresha was a female Human corporal of the Republic Army during the retaking of Corellia in the Galactic War. However, she was actually a Child of the Sith Emperor and shut down the Republic defenses. She was defeated and killed by the Barsen'thor.
Sarkh was a Trandoshan pirate serving in the Trandoshan Pirates during the Battle of Umbara. A Jedi Knight defeated his captain, Dheeb and his peer, Grahssk at the Trandoshan Pirate's outpost.
Klug was a male Gamorrean who lived during the Clone Wars.
Jynx was a Gungan male who lived during the Clone Wars. During that time the Gungan accompanied a spacer to Coruscant and possibly other planets.

General Ennodius was a male Umbaran who lived during the Clone Wars. He and his people sided with the Separatists during the Battle of Umbara. He was the commander of Bunker Grek, one of three underground Umbaran bases.
Warren Sedoru was a male Human Jedi Padawan who lived during the Great Galactic War, the Cold War and the Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
In 32 BBY, a pilot flew an N-1 starfighter with the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps during the Invasion of Naboo.

Jomar Chul was a Zabrak male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He was very skilled in collecting information and infiltrating hostile territories.

General Farr-Nees was a male Umbaran who lived during the Clone Wars. He and his people sided with the Separatists during the Battle of Umbara. He commanded Bunker Usk, one of three underground bunkers, during the battle, but was defeated by a Jedi nonetheless.
Jero Jal-Song was a male Meri who lived on the planet Merisee during the reign of the Galactic Empire, where he was a member of the Jedi-worshipping Cult of Those Who Redeem.

Mrash was a Trandoshan pirate gunner who served in the Trandoshan Pirates during the Battle of Umbara. He assisted Commander Krussk with his takeover of Bunker Krill, which was controlled by the Umbaran militia and their Confederacy of Independent Systems allies.
Duppa was a male momong born on the Trandoshan moon of Wasskah. He served as the loyal pet of a spacer.
Shendan was a male Human Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Vector was a convor from Wasskah. He served as the loyal pet of a spacer during the Clone Wars.
Sivar owned the Imperial transport Suprosa during the Rebel Alliance raid in 3.5 ABY that netted the Alliance the plans to the second Death Star battle station.

Tsiat was a male Keshiri Sith Master of the Lost Tribe of Sith present at the New Jedi Temple during the last battle between Abeloth and the Jedi; he was ordered to keep watch to their prisoner Wynn Dorvan, but Wynn managed to liberate himself and took Tsiat's blaster.
The Master in Black was a small Humanoid who was one of the Five Masters, the leaders of the Wookiee Liberation Front.
Lin was a Human female who lived with her husband, Bellis, on the planet Ord Mantell during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

VYRUS was a radiation-scarred male Ugnaught who lived during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, VYRUS was present in the city Tolea Biqua on the planet Genarius, where the Cularin Central Broadcasting reporter Ryk Osentay attempted to interview him.

Eskella Gryton was a Human female Sith Acolyte of the Sith Academy during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. She was the daughter of Tremel, an Overseer of the Sith Academy on Korriban.

Skrisst was a Trandoshan pirate medic who served in the Trandoshan Pirates during the Battle of Umbara. He assisted Commander Krussk with his takeover of Bunker Krill, which was controlled by the Umbaran militia and their Confederacy of Independent Systems allies.
Grahssk was a Trandoshan pirate serving with the Trandoshan Pirates during the Battle of Umbara. A Jedi Knight defeated his captain, Dheeb, and his peer, Sarkh, at the Trandoshan Pirate's outpost.

Yul-Li was a young Human male Master of the Jedi Order who served as a loyal bodyguard to Master Yonlach on Tatooine during the waning years of the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Nils Cridmeen was a Human male mechanic who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
The father of Juno Eclipse was a male Human who lived during the final years of the Old Republic and into the era of the Galactic Empire.

Mad'ahn was a female Twi'lek who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War with the Sith Empire. A rare Lethan Twi'lek, she had a small shop in the Senate Commercial District where she sold weapons and armor.
Yael was a female Cathar who lived on Ord Mantell during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Shei Harsi was a female Human reporter for the Imperial News Network. In 44 ABY, she covered the report on the destruction of Natasi Daala's–a candidate for the Imperial election–campaign headquarters on the planet Hagamoor 3.
Jaska was a female Falleen Jedi Knight who eschewed Jedi teachings for Mandalorian culture during the Mandalorian Wars.
An unidentified male provided his deep voice for the Imperial News Network's narration sometime in 44 ABY.

Vray was a Duros male commander who served the Galactic Republic as part of the Mantellian army during the Cold War. He was stationed on the planet Ord Mantell during part of the war, where he fought the Mantellian Separatist Movement in the Ord Mantell Civil War.

Wentell Pron was a Rodian male smuggler who worked with the Galactic Republic army during the Cold War. He stayed on the planet Ord Mantell during part of the war, where he aided in the fight against the Mantellian Separatist Movement in the Ord Mantell Civil War.

Tweeta was a Rodian female smuggler who worked with the Galactic Republic army during the Cold War. She stayed on the planet Ord Mantell during part of the war, where she aided in the fight against the Mantellian Separatist Movement in the Ord Mantell Civil War.
Kra'ake was a male Togorian Neo-Crusader Rally Master who fought during the Mandalorian Wars.

Glorzo was a Hutt individual who lived around the time of the Cold War on Nal Hutta. He collected rare technology and once owned the hologram program named Holiday but according to Tharan Cedrax, he disregarded the hologram's potential.
A female member of a felinoid species served as a member of Dorjander Kace's Mandalorian Knights. Like her comrades she wore silver-colored Neo-Crusader armor and wielded a bronze-bladed lightsaber.
Hurwell was a male Human who served as a corporal in the army of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
This cloned individual served as a pilot in the Sky Battle of Quell and operated a Consular-class cruiser.
This clone pilot participated in the Sky Battle of Quell and operated a Consular-class cruiser.
Falco Sang was a Human male bounty hunter who specialized in assassinations.
Shonbla was a male Human archaeologist who lived during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.
A female Chagrian served as a member of Dorjander Kace's Mandalorian Knights. Like her comrades, she wore silver-colored Neo-Crusader armor and wielded a bronze-bladed lightsaber.

The Red Blade was a notorious pirate who lived during the Great Galactic War and the subsequent Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. A ruthless killer, Red Blade's identity was assumed by an Imperial Intelligence operative.
Womprat was a male Togruta scavenger who lived during the Cold War. He had a shop on Carrick Station, where he bought and sold valuable materials and metals.
Frira was a female Human who worked as a slicer during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. She had a base on Carrick Station.
Abiss Sol'oras was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto who was one of the leaders of the Migrant Merchants' Guild during the Cold War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Krand was a Human who worked in the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War with the Sith Empire. A tan-skinned female with black hair and brown eyes, they were stationed on the planet Coruscant as an analyst under Agent Galen in the Senate Tower.
Wesner was a Human male who served in the Mantellian army during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.
Dooce Everton was a Bith male who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Deringon Lobacc was a Human male who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Tephan was a male Human Jedi Knight who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He was stationed on Coruscant, where he sold weapons and armor to other Knights from the Jedi base in the Senate Commercial District.

Arzanon was a male Human Sith Inquisitor of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was the head of security at the Sith Academy, and worked with an Intelligence officer to search for traitor acolytes who wanted to throw down the Emperor's Order.

Ozurist was a male Lethan Twi'lek who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. A chief engineer who was employed in The Works throughout much of the Great Galactic War and the Cold War, Ozurist developed a strong devotion to both his fellow biologicals and the machines he served.
Zeer was a Human male who worked for the criminal organization Black Sun during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Jaynes was a Human male who served as a sergeant in the Republic Army during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Yajak was a Human male Commander of the Republic Military who was stationed on Taris as part of the Taris Resettlement Initiative, where he commanded Waypoint Station Morne during the Cold War.
Gilroh was a Human male who served in the Republic Military during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. He deserted after five years on Taris, and escaped thanks to a traveling hero.

Berric lived on the planet Coruscant and served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic the Sith Empire, he supplied his fellow officers with weapons from a small shop near the taxi station in Black Sun territory.
Shassa lived on the planet Coruscant and served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force.
Tomin-brel lived on the planet Coruscant and served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force.
Kennerlo Erlo lived on the planet Coruscant and served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force.
Teven Liss'ard was a Human lieutenant in Black Sun during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

In the year 3.5 ABY, a small group of bounty hunters under the leadership of the Barabel Skahtul captured the Jedi Luke Skywalker on the planet Kothlis with the intention of cashing in on the bounty placed on him by the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader.

A male Barabel bounty hunter was among a combined group of bounty hunters under the leadership of the Barabel Skahtul who captured the Jedi Luke Skywalker on the planet Kothlis in 3.5 ABY with the intention of cashing in on his bounty placed by the Dark Lord Darth Vader.
A female Human was among the many Jedi who defied the orders of the High Council and went to the aid of the Republic during the Mandalorian Wars.

Dreho Dreho was a male Mirialan treasure hunter who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He had a base on Carrick Station, where he bought and sold artifacts and relics from other travelers.
Belkan was a Human male who served in the Republic Military during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Ghorroh was a gundark that lived during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems that lasted from 22 BBY to 19 BBY. He had red skin and brown hair.
Jarett Hurgen was a male Human who lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, where he made a living as both an actor and a con artist.

Kosul Ayada was a male Herglic Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic faithfully for many years, dying several decades before the outbreak of the Clone Wars and the eventual rise of the Galactic Empire.
Harson Nild was a male Human who served as the Director of Core World Operations in the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.
Hunter was a Human female operative for the Star Cabal, who posed as a male Agent with the Galactic Republic's Strategic Information Service during the Cold War and the Galactic War.

Rikael Lysannis was a Human male who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. A member of the powerful Lysannis family, Rikael was secretly a member of the Black Sun criminal syndicate.

Yelzrin was a Human male colonist who led a settlement on the planet Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY, the Sith assassin Rora Seake was sent to wipe out the colony.
A Rebel recon officer was part of the personnel at Ghost Base, a Rebel installation on the planet of Krant, between 0.5 ABY and 2 ABY.
Synoda was a female Togruta doctor who worked on Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
In 52 BBY, a Maladian assassin killed Senator Vidar Kim of Naboo from her speeder. She then committed suicide to avoid capture and interrogation by the Jedi Order.
This woman was married to Naboo's Senator Vidar Kim. In 54 BBY, she and her two sons were killed in a starship accident over the city Kaadara, on Naboo.
This male was the son of Senator Vidar Kim of Naboo. In 54 BBY, he died in a starship accident over Kaadara, a city on Naboo, along with his mother and one of his brothers.
This male individual was one of the sons of Senator Vidar Kim of Naboo. In 54 BBY, he died in a starship accident over Kaadara, a city on Naboo, along with mother and one of his brothers.
Juno Eclipse's mother was a female Human who lived during the early period of the Galactic Empire. Together with her husband and daughter, the Eclipse family resided on the Core world of Corulag.

Braedon Agareth was a male Human who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. He was forcibly pressed into service by the Justicars' Brigade, but he was freed by a Republic-allied individual who was asked by his sister Renalda to save him.

Renalda Agareth was a Human female who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War. When her brother Braedon was forcibly pressed into service by the Justicars' Brigade, she asked a Republic-allied individual to help save him.

Jessa Bo'den was a female green-skinned Twi'lek who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. She was a high-ranking member of the Justicars' Brigade, a vigilante militia that controlled a portion of Coruscant.

Daria Felton was a female who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. She was the girlfriend of Rikael Lysannis, and she testified against her boyfriend to the Justicars' Brigade.

Wendin was a Human male who served in the Republic Military during the Great Galactic War and the subsequent Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War, he commanded the Republic forces on Coruscant.

Thalo Terrix was a male Human who lived on Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was a high-ranking member of the Justicars' Brigade, a vigilante militia that controlled a portion of Coruscant.
Harro was the Chief Maintenance Officer in The Works on Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Jonkan was a Human male scientist who worked on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.
Numinn was a male Zabrak fleet admiral who served in the Republic Navy's Fifth Assault Fleet during the Great Galactic War and the subsequent Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Gef Olazon was a Human male who served the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances as a member of the Galactic Alliance Marines, specifically the specialized Void Jumpers unit. By that year 44 ABY, he had risen to the rank of Sergeant Major.
Fayem Schall was a male Human refugee who lived on Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Kata the Hutt was a Hutt crime lord on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Dobe was a female Miraluka who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. While the rest of the Order rebuilt on Tython, she was assigned to Carrick Station.

Vepp was a male Human who served on the Republic cruiser Esseles during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. When the ship was attacked, Vepp and his superior Salen were trapped in the engineering deck with the rest of the engineering crew.

A little man once worked as an informant to the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader in the year 3.5 ABY. The little man supplied Vader with information regarding Dark Prince Xizor's veiled attempts to assassinate Vader's son, Luke Skywalker.

Averdon was a Human male who worked as an ambassador for the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was assigned to Nar Shaddaa, where he attempted to negotiate an alliance with members of the Hutt Cartel.
Dakka Fasser was a female Human lieutenant who worked for the Security Police on Etti IV.
Vidas Kawats was a male Human refugee who lived on Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Semist Bada was a male Human refugee who lived on Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Kosh Teradoc was the younger brother of Treuten Teradoc and also an Imperial admiral and a warlord.
