Kashim was a male Duros who served as general in the Republic Armed Forces and was in command of all Republic forces on the Core World of Alderaan during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Sunmantle was a male Kynachi, who was a pilot for KynachTech Industries. In 21 BBY, he and Pikkson were assigned to escort Commissioner Langu Sommilor to Coruscant. Sommilor and the two pilots were replaced by Black Sun impostors, who were later assassinated.

Parvux was a male Zabrak scientist who worked on the Death Mark laser project on Alderaan for the Republic during the Cold War. When the Sith apprentice Lord Nefarid attacked the project, Parvux was saved by the Jedi Master Orgus Din.

This woman was married to Moff Tharil Tavira, the Imperial governor of Eiattu 6, at some point during the Imperial era. Tavira's mistress, Leonia Tavira, arranged her "accidental" death, and married the Moff herself.
A Human male individual served as a captain with the Coruscant Security Force during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
A male servant attended domestic duties at the service of Mother Augwynne Djo, leader of the Singing Mountain Clan, a coven of benevolent Force Witches from the planet Dathomir.
A Human individual served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a sergeant at some point during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire.
A humanoid Sith Master eventually reigned at some point between Darth Cognus and Darth Gravid. In his tenure as the Dark Lord of the Sith, he would take a male Devaronian as his Sith apprentice.
A male Devaronian was a Dark Lord of the Sith who wielded a saberstaff, heir to the lineage of Darth Bane and the apprentice of a humanoid Sith Master.
Magnus was the captain of the cruiser Stardream during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
This male individual was one of the pilots of Senator Vidar Kim of Naboo. In 54 BBY, he died in a starship accident over Kaadara, a city on Naboo, along with Vidar Kim's wife and one of his sons.
This male individual was the co-pilot of Senator Vidar Kim of Naboo. In 54 BBY, he died in a starship accident over Kaadara, a city on Naboo, along with Vidar Kim's wife and one of his sons.

Tirs Maladane was a lieutenant from Little Mochot on the planet Tatooine, serving as a gunner on the Galactic Alliance Star Destroyer Anakin Solo, under the command of the Jedi Knight Jacen Solo, the Galactic Alliance's Chief of State.
A soldier in the People's Liberation Battalion on Eiattu 6 was captured and tortured by Moff Leonia Tavira in 4 ABY.

An Imperial captain was the commanding officer of Imperial Grand Vizier Sate Pestage's private yacht. When Pestage fled Coruscant after Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard accused him of treason in 4 ABY, he gave the yacht to its captain.

During the Imperial era, an Imperial governor was appointed to govern the Suarbi system. After the death of Emperor Palpatine, he was killed and replaced by the rogue Imperial Admiral Leonia Tavira when he rebuffed her advances.
Kai Rees was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the decade preceding the Clone Wars.
A Klatooinian was captain of a freighter belonging to Noggox the Hutt during the Clone Wars.

A client of the smuggler Mirax Terrik Horn asked her to make some inquiries into the pirate group known as the Invids after they raided his vacation home and stole some valuable items from his collection of antiquities in 11 ABY.
Bree Starlighter, nicknamed the "Princess of PR," was a female Human who served as Chief Holo-Communications Officer and galactic travel liaison for the interstellar Star Tours travel firm.
This long-faced humanoid worked as a bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War.
This pointed-eared humanoid worked as a bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War.
Zzzzyxxx, also spelled Zzyxx or Zyzx, was a male officer who worked for Star Tours as a security guard for spaceport customs.
Garm Trodask was a bounty hunter and commander of the bounty hunting team known as Grim Destiny. He led the team when they pursued the Hutt, Mennac, on the planet Trendivar.

Mennac Vanderijar, commonly referred to as Mennac the Hutt, was a Hutt (with a female personality) and a middle-level gangster in the criminal organization of the Vanderijar clan. Her palace/fortress was located on Nal Hutta.
Jobwah was a Hutt gangster and consort of Mennac the Hutt of the Vanderijar clan.
Lyns Skutroo was a Verpine master crafter who lived in the years following the Waymancy Storm, a conflict waged in 7811 BBY between the Galactic Republic and the Signatories of Waymancy.
Che'nash was a female Geranite mercenary operative working as part of the Shrikaansi Reconnaissance Company for the reconstituted Sith Empire at the end of the Cold War.

Saens Sukko was a Galactic Republic chief sergeant who served during the Subterra Period. During the Waymancy Storm conflict of 7811 BBY, he helped collapse the Clowse Glowstack structure of the Republic's enemy, the Signatories of Waymancy.

Ursela Kuat was a member of House Kuat who was the principal director of the shipyard company Kuat Drive Yards by 311 BBY. By that year, Kuat traveled in their star yacht along the Rothana Route hyperlane in the Outer Rim Territories.

TD-5144 was a female individual from the world Pargaux who served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper within the 291st Legion Dalisor. From her compatriot TD-4388's recollections, TD-5144 was apparently very vicious, as she noted that she was "twice as mean" as a Houk.

A Neimoidian pirate was part of Dool Pundar's crew, serving on the Lucrehulk-class pirate ship Profit in 21 BBY. The Neimoidian pirate had green skin and red eyes common to the species, though a scar ran across the right eye.

A male brown-skinned, brown-haired Snivvian was a lieutenant onboard a freighter owned by Noggox the Hutt. In 21 BBY, the ship was carrying droid brains to the Fondor Shipyards when it was intercepted near Shipwrights' Trace by a pirate ship.
Ershack was a colonel in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was responsible of the operations in the Kubilaï system and its vicinity.

"TD-1123" was a female individual who served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper in the 291st Legion Dalisor. She was killed while fighting on the world Jiroch-Reslia, and she was later mentioned in the memoirs of her compatriot Isila Drutch.
A Rodian with green skin and black eyes served onboard a freighter owned by Noggox the Hutt. In 21 BBY, the Rodian was at the controls of the ship, along with a Human.

A Human male with black hair and light skin served onboard a freighter owned by Noggox the Hutt. He had a scar running across his face. In 21 BBY, he was at the controls along with a Rodian when the ship was carrying droid brains to the Fondor Shipyards.
Sélima Kim was a female individual who operated as a pirate during an unknown era.
Hilma Kim was a female individual who operated as a pirate during the Galactic Civil War.
Sven Kim was a male individual who operated as a pirate during the Galactic Civil War.
Sythluss Leethe was a Sluissi black-market droid manufacturer. He owned The Maker and created the Doom Slayer assassin droid.

Quiberon Kuat was a male individual who worked for Kuat Drive Yards as an engineer. In about 800 BBY, KDY acquired deed to the mineral-abundant planet Rothana in Wild Space and Quiberon Kuat was subsequently dispatched to the world along with thousands of workers, to establish…
Kuvuta Pindi was a green-skinned Twi'lek woman. In 22 BBY, as part of a slavery operation, she abducted 10 war orphans from Abregado-rae and took them to the planet Fondor.

A six-armed alien served on-board a freighter owned by Noggox the Hutt. The alien was vaguely humanoid, with two legs, six arms, and a head. In 21 BBY, the alien was on ship's bridge when it was intercepted near Shipwrights' Trace by a pirate ship.
Yashu-Vo was a female Voss living on Voss during the Galactic War.
Gheedor Sornell was a male Devaronian Mandalorian who joined the Neo-Crusaders during the Mandalorian Wars.

Haarm Sornell was a male Devaronian Mandalorian warrior who served the Neo-Crusaders during the Mandalorian Wars. In 3962 BBY, he spent his time in the war alongside his wife Koblus Sornell and their son Gheedor Sornell.
Beldiss was a male Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Gidd was a legendary Cerean female warrior who supposedly traveled from the stars.
Gith was a Zabrak female historically known for providing food under miraculous circumstances.
Inun was a blind Twi'lek, famous in Twi'lek mythology for crossing the Bright Lands of Ryloth.
Deacon Eso was a Human engineer in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Caf Treblanc was a Human soldier in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict fought between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire. By 0 ABY, Treblanc had attained the position of chief in the Alliance.
Jubieck was a famous Sullustan warrior who sacrificed himself in order to save his home city.

Morts Werl was a Human who lived during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire. Fair-skinned with gray hair and a mustache, Werl joined the Alliance by 0 BBY.
Markan was Human male who achieved the rank of assistant Overseer in the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War, between them and the Galactic Republic.
Fau-Kes was a Cathar male agent in the Republic Strategic Information Service, the intelligence branch of the Galactic Republic, during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Important Merchant was a male Human merchant who lived in the city of Mos Espa on the planet of Tatooine during the blockade of Naboo. He sold various supplies at a stand, being a great asset to Qui-Gon Jinn during his stay at Tatooine.

Gesen was a Human male Sith Inquisitor who served the Sith Empire on the Sith planet of Korriban. During the Cold War, he could be found inside the Tomb of Ajunta Pall. He was studying a dead K'lor'slug while helping guard the one of the entrances.
Vell Narroc was a male Anomid who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the resurgent Sith Empire.
Garon Borm was a male Togruta Mandalorian Field Marshal who fought during the Mandalorian Wars. He also served as the commander of the Kandosii-type dreadnaught known as Parjai.
Deedoh was a male Rodian Mandalorian during the Mandalorian Wars, serving under Dorjander Kace during the Battle of Halthor.
Gummig was a male Human Mandalorian who fought in the Great Sith War and then during the Mandalorian Wars, serving under command of Mandalorian Knight Dorjander Kace during the Battle of Halthor.
The father of Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot Thurlow Harris served as a captain in the Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Harris spent most of his life in his father's shadow.
Yashia was a Human female Imperial soldier who served under the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, she was stationed on Korriban, guarding the entrance to the Tomb of Naga Sadow.

Samus was a male Human Sith Lord and Sith Inquisitor who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. He resided in the Sith Academy on the planet Korriban, where he provided martial training for Sith Acolytes.

A Human female agent worked for the Sith Empire during the Cold War. She was seen on Korriban working with an Inquisitor Arzanon, searching for traitor acolytes in the Sith Academy who wanted to throw down the Sith Emperor's order.

Before the Thrawn campaign of 9 ABY, the Chiss Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo, core name "Thrawn," sent a spaarti cloning cylinder to the Hand of Thrawn fortress on the planet Nirauan, storing a clone of himself in the cylinder, hiding it in a secret chamber.
Pir'pwn was a male Gungan warrior who resided on Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

A Wistie was captured by thugs of Gardulla Besadii the Elder and transported to Tatooine. There, the Wistie child was released into a garden to serve as illumination. The Wistie met the Ghostling princess, Arawynne, and guided her through the garden, aided by the Ho'Din, Oo Wen.

A Wistie was part of a group owned by Gardulla Besadii the Elder and transported to Tatooine. There, the Wistie child was released into a garden to serve as illumination. The Wistie and the others of her kind joined up with a group of Ghostlings that were hiding from the Hutt.
Krevan was a male Human Sith Acolyte of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was found on the outskirts of the Lower Wilds on Korriban where he was working for his master, Lord Varacen.

Varacen was a male Human Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Stationed on Korriban, he could be found at the Wilds Laboratory where he was collecting tuk'ata bone marrow.
Ephran Zell was a Human male Imperial archaeologist who resided on Korriban during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.
Tavan was a Human male sentry who served in the Imperial Army and was stationed on Korriban during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Garus was a Human male Sergeant in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was stationed on the Sith holy world of Korriban during the Cold War. He was looking for research supplies that were stolen from him by berserk troopers and acolytes.
Tamin was a Human male vendor who served onboard the Republic's Carrick Station during the Cold War.

An individual was the captain of the Bhishana Bhaga, a guardian corvette owned by Arakyd Industries. He was killed when the corvette experienced a hyperdrive malfunction, dropped out of hyperspace in an asteroid belt, and crashed on the planet Krykas V.
Jarobi was a male human Inquisitor of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. He resided in the Sith Academy on Korriban.
Prithor was a male Human Sith of the Sith Empire and an Overseer at the Korriban Sith Academy.
Isila Drutch was a female from the New Territories planet Parshoone, born prior to 10 BBY into a family affiliated with the Galactic Empire.
Urinth was a female Human Inquisitor of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Quorian Dorjis was a Human male Jedi that served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the Sith Empire. He was once sent on a mission to infiltrate the Sith Academy on Korriban which he failed and eventually was captured.
Cinderclaw was an oversized jundak from Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War.

Xanta was a Human female who served the Sith Empire in the Imperial Army during the Cold War between the Sith and the Galactic Republic. During the war, they held the rank of private and was stationed on the Sith homeworld of Korriban, where they worked as a vendor.
Ara Barotta was a female Twi'lek Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the decade preceding the Clone Wars.
Cho Zeh'Bra was a male Bith Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the decade preceding the Clone Wars.
Zeetara Maan was a female Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the decade preceding the Clone Wars.
Kehel was a male Human Acolyte of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War, he was seen at the entrance of the Sith Academy on Korriban, talking with Nataya and Telo.
Telo was a male Human apprentice of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War he was seen at the entrance of the Sith Academy on Korriban, talking with Kehel and Nataya.
Kasi Sha'Rhil was a female Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the decade preceding the Clone Wars.
Fenella Druce was a female Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the decade preceding the Clone Wars.
Tren Alvar was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the decade preceding the Clone Wars.
Ortosin was a Human male Sith apprentice who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Krillis was a corpulent male Human Sith Lord of the resurgent reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War against the Galactic Republic, he was assigned by Lord Zash to oversee her new apprentice.
Yenoa was a female Miraluka Sith Inquisitor of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. She was present in the Imperial Citadel on Dromund Kaas.
Zain Quelrak was a male Human Sith Inquisitor of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War on Kaas City.

Irex was a Human male Sith apprentice who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. In 3643 BBY, he served his master, Darth Skotia, inside his bunker on the planet of Dromund Kaas.

Satik was a Human male Sith apprentice who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. In 3643 BBY, he served his master, Darth Skotia, inside his bunker on the planet of Dromund Kaas.

Ogathu was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, he served inside Darth Skotia's bunker on the planet of Dromund Kaas. He was the warden of the Trandoshan relic that Darth Skotia used to control his Trandoshan bodyguards.

Kullin was a male Imperial soldier of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, he was stationed on Dromund Kaas, guarding the entrance to the planet's inner jungles under orders from Captain Tolto.

During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a Human male officer was stationed on Dromund Kaas as Commander Rilan's lieutenant, and led one of his Imperial commando teams on a mission to investigate the unusual beasts' behavior on the p…
Sy was a Human male Logistics Officer of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, he was stationed on Dromund Kaas, selling specialty goods.

Captain Tolto was a Human male Sith officer of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, he was stationed on Dromund Kaas near Kaas City Spaceport when a traveler came and delivered Kullin's report about the Imperial outpost at the entrance of the planet…
Venich was a female Human ambassador of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. She was at one point present in the cantina on Dromund Kaas.
Jogotha was a female Human Mandalorian underworld trader on Dromund Kaas during the Cold War. She wore blue Mandalorian armor and could be found in one of Kaas City's cantinas.

Weng Wrightsyn was a male Human citizen living on Dromund Kaas during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He felt that justice wasn't being applied by the Security Forces and that killers ran free, so he asked a traveler to investigate.

Renegin was a male Devaronian bounty hunter and Mandalorian who worked on the planet Dromund Kaas in around 3643 BBY. There, he was hired by a group of Sith to tag random citizens around Kaas City, although he was given no explanation as to why he was marking them.

Vort Norman was a male Mandalorian Twi'lek mercenary living on Dromund Kaas during the Cold War. When the Mandalorian Deth Kregg issued a personal challenge, Norman carried word of it to Outpost Tempest near Kaas City and maintained a pool of credits to be claimed by the one w…

Dumat was a Human male Sith apprentice who served the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. In 3643 BBY, he served his master, Darth Skotia, inside his bunker on the planet of Dromund Kaas.

Quilon was a Human male Sith apprentice of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, he served his master, Darth Skotia, inside his bunker on the planet of Dromund Kaas. He was killed when Lord Zash's apprentice infiltrated the base and defeated him.

A Human male Imperial technician worked at a manufacturing plant on Imperial Center in 7 ABY. In one of the plant's warehouses, he was met by undercover agents of the Alien Combine and the New Republic's Rogue Squadron, who were trying to slip him rigged memory cores to be ins…
Shamel was a male smuggler running a small criminal organization during the Galactic Civil War.

Heb Nee was a Gungan male warrior who lived on Naboo's moon of Rori during the Galactic Civil War. He was a member of the Rorgungans, a group of extremist Gungans who violently opposed Boss Rugor Nass's support of Naboo's human population during the Invasion of Naboo and rejec…
Dar Singe was a male Zabrak Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the decade preceding the Clone Wars.
Elana Thul was a female Human who served as Lady of the House of Thul and loyal to the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
An unidentified Ishi Tib worked as a mechanic for the podracer Teemto Pagalies. They were present at the Boonta Eve Classic in 32 BBY and worked on Teemto's pod there.
A Dathomirian female was the firstborn daughter of Mother Talzin, matriarch and shaman of the Witches of Dathomir's Nightsister coven on the Outer Rim Territories planet Dathomir.
Orion of Dwaincast was a young noble from the Gasharn Kingdom who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A podrace gambler stood in Watto's box to view the Boonta Eve Classic in 32 BBY, and bet on Anakin Skywalker to win the race.

Lomrokk was a Gamorrean warlord and later executioner for Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Lomrokk became famous across the Outer Rim Territories for his talent for killing in pit fighting matches.
A Rodian warlord lived during the Rise of the Empire era, and gave a gift of a RHTC-560 Hunter Trainer droid and RHTC-560 HT Drones to Imperial Captain Aron Harcourt prior to 3 BBY.

A Human Imperial stormtrooper served on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Anya Karu under Captain Aron Harcourt prior to 3 BBY. The stormtrooper most likely perished when the Anya Karu was sabotaged by Rebel agents, causing it to crash on a distant planet.

A male individual served as a customs official on the capital world of Imperial Center (also known as Coruscant) in 7 ABY. In that year, he boarded a Dairkan Starliner, the Jewel of Churba, when it entered the Coruscant system.
Torrun was a male Human Revanite who resided in the Revanite Compound on Dromund Kaas during the Cold War. He then served The Master and his students as a curator of Revanite artifacts.
Verhandle was a male criminal around the time of the Galactic Civil War. At some point during his life, Verhandle met the Corellian smuggler Han Solo.

Theovor Mindak was a Human male scientist in the employ of the rebellious Sith Lord Grathan on Dromund Kaas. Mindak actively colluded with Grathan and the Eagle's network and oversaw his own lab within Grathan's estate.
In 40 ABY, a female Quarren employee of the Veterans' Mental Care Hospital on Coruscant was possessed while on duty and asleep on the job by Dark Lady of the Sith Lumiya.

Samara Mindak was a Human and social high-flier within the upper class scene on Dromund Kaas. Mindak harbored a disdain for her father, Theovor Mindak, and was nonchalant when approached by Cipher Nine, an agent of Imperial Intelligence demanding information on his location an…

Shellaster was a Human male and major within the reconstituted Sith Empire serving on Dromund Kaas. At one point during his career, he was stationed outside Kaas City where he was tasked to dealing with an invasion of off-world troops under the command of the rogue Sith Lord T…
Raymon was a Human male Sith of the Sith Empire. By the time of the Cold War he had joined the cult known as the Revanites and lived in their camp near Kaas City on the planet of Dromund Kaas.

Major Pathel was a Human male who served as major of the Imperial Army until he joined a Sith cult known as the Revanites during the Cold War. He was head of security at the Wall on the reconstituted Sith Empire's capital planet of Dromund Kaas.
Tari Darkspanner (known by her followers as the Master, later known as Lord Darkspanner) was a Human female Sith who was the master of the Sith cult known as the Order of Revan during the Cold War.
Lord Duen was a male Human Sith Lord who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War. Stationed near the Dark Temple, he was tasked with recovering artifacts.

Dorian was a Human male slave on Dromund Kaas. Driven insane by Force phenomena within the Dark Temple, his fellow slaves and archaeologists -- previously tasked with recovering data -- began to worship him as an omnipotent leader, after he was briefly influenced by the ancien…

Pharshol was a male Dark Lord of the Sith who died and was buried within the Dark Temple on Dromund Kaas centuries ago. In life, he oversaw the construction of the Dark Temple. During the Cold War, his spirit was disturbed and settled within a Twi'lek workman.

A messenger was employed by the Lost Tribe of Sith on Kesh in 4985 BBY. That year, he informed prominent Sith Seelah Korsin and Ravilan Wroth that the citizens of the town Rabolow had all mysteriously died.
Augin Blaesus was a male Human Force-sensitive who served as representative of the planet Erigorm, one of the Galactic Republic's finances centers for centuries.
Suri was a Human female Sith Inquisitor who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Tannac was a Human male Sith Inquisitor of the resurgent Sith Empire. He was a mysterious Child of the Emperor that appeared on Voss at the time that Kira Carsen and her Master spoke with Suri, Kira's childhood friend.
Dace Vinagar was an apprentice to the Jedi archivist Orb Telorn, and lived during the Great Sith War.

The father of the Human female Ada was a man who owed money to Davik Kang, a crime-lord from the Outer Rim ecumenopolis of Taris. Kang worked for the Exchange, a powerful criminal organization, and was the head of its operations on the planet.
Gaden-Ko was a male Voss Mystic in training at the time of the Cold War.

Isk was a Force-sensitive humanoid slave of the Infinite Empire, trained since his birth as a Force Hound by the Rakata. He was a servant of Predor Skal'nas and was defeated by Xesh in the Arena of Byss during a fight to the Death. Isk begged Xesh to kill him, but he refused.
Hacklin was a male admiral of the Imperial Navy and a loyal ally of Darth Angral, a Sith Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.
Sophia Farash was a female Human Child of the Emperor who acted as an Ambassador of the Republic on Voss during the Cold War.
Zixx was a Human male cyborg who served as a prison operative of the Galactic Republic in its illegal operations on Balmorra during the Cold War.

A Human male enslaver was in the employ of Governor Koong of Tawntoom Province on the planet of Roon in 15 BBY. That year, the slavedriver oversaw a galley full of slaves and forced them to row across the Roon Sea to Koong Island.

Choka Chok was a male Swokes Swokes, who lived on the planet Makem Te during the reign of the New Republic. A member of one of the higher-ranking Swokes Swokes castes, Chok was a nephew of a caliph from the Congress of Caliphs, Makem Te's planetary government.
Aulus G'luun was a male Gand who lived on the planet of Coruscant. He felt that Gands were victims of discriminatory laws and lacked opportunity.
This scavenger was a Gand who worked for Aulus G'luun. When Republic security forces barricaded the Migrant Merchants' Guild on the planet of Coruscant, this Gand was captured.

This individual was a male Rodian who resided in the city of Bestine during the Galactic Civil War. This nervous individual was an informant of Jabba the Hutt. After the Bestine political election, he attempted to gather incriminating information about the mayor Sean Trenwell.
Zsu Val was a male Chiss who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Reyzek was a Human female Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, she was present at a party on Kaas City, the same party that Lord Zash went to cover up her trace of planning Darth Skotia's assassination which her apprentice eventually ex…

Goss was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, he was present at a party on Kaas City, the same party that Lord Zash attended to cover up her trace of planning Darth Skotia's assassination, which her apprentice eventually ex…
Kirnon was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire.
Calaverous was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire.

Koloch was an male Imperial General stationed on Quesh during the Cold War. Koloch assisted Imperial personnel in the downing of the Three Families, Hutt dissidents based on the planet of his military administration's control.
Londrod was an Human male speeder bike vendor who was stationed outside of Mos Ila on Tatooine, just outside of the Sith Imperial settlement there.

Dorotsech was a Human male scientist who worked for the Sith Empire during the Cold War around 3643 BBY. He developed a weapon called the cyber neutralizer that could kill or weaken beings whose bodies were composed of at least fifty percent cybernetics.

Khreusis was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, he had stolen the ancient Sith Lord Aloysius Kallig's mask and was living on Korriban in his own stronghold.
Ashwyn Tejera was a Human male researcher working with Hacken Berge on the planet Taris around the year 3643 BBY.
A military supervisor oversaw a team of O'reenian scientists at an analysis center near the city Orbital Deployment Center on the planet O'reen.
Dejarro was a male Rodian who was a member of the Bomu Clan, a large Rodian clan that was active in the criminal fringe during the era of the New Republic.

A woman belonging to the Farr family of Chandrila was the mother of Toryn and Samoc Farr, both members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The Farrs were loyal supporters of Chandrila's Mon Mothma and staunch opponents of the Galactic Empire.

Kashina Furt was a Male Pa'lowick who lived on the planet Lowick, the homeworld of his species. At some point prior to 19 ABY, the Hutt Parella Jiramma Baco traveled to Lowick on an expedition to hunt the Gorach, a legendary being that he believed to live on the world, and he …

Yem Leksende was a male Human, who was head of Czerka Corporation and a member of Star Cabal who oversaw the entirety of Czerka's actions throughout the galaxy during the Cold War and the Galactic War.
Sir Trilag was a Human male who was one of the leaders of the Mecrosa Order of assassins, and under the codename "the Creeper" he was a member of the Star Cabal during the Galactic War.

Charnoq was a Sith Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was sent alongside Lord Ilikith to recovered the Black Codex from the Imperial Agent Cipher Nine on the Star Chamber in Null Zone.

Ilikith was a Sith Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was sent alongside Lord Charnoq to recovered the Black Codex from the Imperial Agent Cipher Nine on the Star Chamber in Null Zone.

Corin Tok, known as the "Sith Butcher" by the forces of the Sith Empire and Verda Jédii by the Mandalorians, was a male Zabrak Jedi Master of the Jedi Order renowned for his fortitude. His most famous acts were during the Sacking of Coruscant and the Battle of Corellia.

Felix Habel was a former executive of Sienar Fleet Systems who was wanted by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Habel joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and was one of the leaders of the Rebel cell on the planet Lan Barell.
Xig Rollem was a male from Grathus who owned a cantina near one of the planet's larger mud basins. He purchased a Supreme-class droid, which was sent to Grathus by mistake, and named it Threna.

A Human male served as a pilot in the Imperial Remnant's 181st Imperial Fighter Group in 13 ABY. He was one of four pilots who served as emissaries to the planet Adumar in that year; led by 181st commander Turr Phennir, they attempted to convince the government of the nation s…
In 13 ABY, a Human male flew as a pilot in the Imperial Remnant's 181st Imperial Fighter Group. That year saw him and three other 181st pilots travel to the planet Adumar as Imperial emissaries.
A Human male was a pilot in the Imperial Remnant in 13 ABY. He flew with the legendary 181st Imperial Fighter Group, led by Turr Phennir.
This individual was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as the warden of the clandestine prison facility in the depths of Wild Space known as The Prism.
A female Dimok crone lived on the planet Kuthard at the time of the Sepan Civil War between the Dimoks and the Ripoblus.
Arak Drayen III was a Human male who served as the king of Dubrillion before the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Skein was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
A Ho'Din proprietor owned a tapcafe on Drev'starn.

Yan was a young male Human Farmer who was native to the planet Prine and was the older brother of Maddie. One early morning, he was farming outside the gates of the small walled-off community with his sister when a group of slavers attacked.
Diago Hixan was a male Human crime lord on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War. He was a sworn rival of Nok Drayen before his "death".
A thug led a group of ruffians aboard the Wheel in 137 ABY. Imperial agent Morrigan Corde hired him to approach rival agent Jor Torlin due to his resemblance to Cade Skywalker.

A Human male Mandalorian was the brother of Shae Vizla. He was a member of Clan Vizla. Around 3664 BBY, Shae and her brother were tasked with assaulting a Republic political envoy. During the course of the attack, he was slain by Jedi Master Aurei Eadon.

Aurei Eadon was a male Human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who fought during the Great Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire. Around 3664 BBY, Eadon was tasked with protecting a Republic political envoy under attack by Shae Vizla and her brother.
Ransley was a Human male and Captain in the Imperial Navy. He commanded the Acclamator-class assault ship Harvester.

This member of the Tonith family was a male Muun who served as chairman of the InterGalactic Banking Clan. He was succeeded by fellow Muun San Hill. As chairman, Tonith worked with Hego Damask, who, unbeknownst to Tonith, was the Sith Lord known as Darth Plagueis.

Tapalo was the father of Naboo monarch candidate Bon Tapalo. According to the patriarch of House Palpatine, Cosinga Palpatine, his grandfather challenged the elder Tapalo in an honor duel at House Palpatine's ancestral home, Convergence, around 135 BBY upon discovering that th…

The Queen of the Red was the ruler of the Quesoth in 8 ABY. She entered into an alliance with the warlord Nuso Esva but was later killed by him as the Empire of the Hand fought to liberate her homeworld.

Luuuke Skywalker was a clone of the Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, who died in 9 ABY, created by Grand Admiral Thrawn to serve as his agent in the galactic community, which the Admiral controlled secretly using a legion of clones to replace prominent people.
Ara was slave taken from her primitive homeworld. Her master, Deezoth Caraz, was killed at Ord Mynock Freeport while transporting her and another slave, Kema Forge.

Kema Forge was a thief who made his living by running small-time cons on various worlds across the galaxy. Eventually he ran afoul of a local crime boss who wiped Forge out financially. When Forge tried to strike back, he was captured and sold into slavery.
Velnine was a male Zabrak Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was the apprentice of Darth Nurin.
Fara was a male Kelrodoan who lived on the planet Kelrodo-Ai during the early years of the Galactic Empire, and he eventually became a warrior chieftain amongst his people.
Jokull was the proclaimed King of all Gormak on Voss during the Galactic War.
Judd was a male Jedi Master and a member of the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. Judd also had a single-bladed lightsaber pike that emits a blue blade.

Salmara was a female Human Jedi Master and a member of the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. She was the Master of Dray. She also became a victim of the reborn Sith Lord Darth Maul.

Eeksa was a female Ithorian who lived on the planet Torina during the reign of the Galactic Empire. She operated the pet shop Eeksa's Rare Exotics and Pets in the city Brindibarr and at some point during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War, she hired a team of Rebel All…

Scelli was a female Meri who worked as a speeder driver in the city Tekar on the planet Derilyn. During the Galactic Civil War, a group of Rebel Alliance agents hailed Scelli to transport them to Scelli's Arena of Games, and she agreed to drive them to the stadium.
Hondu Firewell was a Human male from the planet Corulag. He and his wife Tattyra were both zoologists, and they had a son named Klay.
Tattyra Firewell was a Human female from the planet Corulag. She and her husband Hondu were both zoologists, and they had a son named Klay.
Glaucus was a retired Imperial Navy captain who became the commander of the luxury liner Stellar Mermaid, following the Battle of Endor.
Tai Cordan was a human male trade secretary of the Balmorran government during the Great Galactic War.

Alto was the Prince of the moon Nallastia's Raptor Clan. He lived a double life as a mechanic named Rench at Fondor Spaceport. Princess Calvaria, the daughter of Nallastia's Skull Queen, was betrothed to Alto, although she did not love him. She secretly loved Rench.
Byluir was a Moff of the Galactic Republic.
Renau was a Moff of the Galactic Republic.

A Human male worked as a guard and an officer in the Imperial Military during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, the man was on leave on the planet Kashyyyk shortly before the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Vader, ordered a blockade of the planet.
Nestor Gain was a security officer with the Freeport Security Force on Ord Mynock. He was tasked with finding the killer of Deezoth Caraz.

An old man lived on the planet Dodz. In 15 BBY, the wizened Human tried to encourage the young boy Jost Ellon to fight back against the ruling governor, Kugg, who had been imposing heavy, unfair taxes; the man reminded Ellon that their ancestors had fought hard to free their l…

Parlan Spinner, also known as the "Death Spinner" and "The Blademaster," was a Force-sensitive Human male rebel who was a member of the Lost Tribe of Sith in 2974 BBY. The Lost Tribe were the descendants of stranded Human Sith who had settled on the planet Kesh in 5000 BBY.
Marg Sonat was a male Ithorian gangster working for crime lord Sard Nightbringer.

Saz Tyrson was an Imperial commander who became a warlord after the Battle of Endor. Tyrson took the forces under his command after the Battle of Endor and controlled over two dozen systems, supported by his military.
Following the Battle of Endor, an Imperial colonel hid out on the planet Antiquity. A New Republic team was sent to find this colonel but they failed.

t: Unidentified Human female Jedi Master (Dass Jennir)
x: This female Human served as a Jedi Master during the final days of the Galactic Republic.
Alilia was a Lethan Twi'lek female who was a slave to the White Maw boss Shai Tenna during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Pharika was a supposed female Sakuubian guide that aided newlyweds Jaina Solo and Jagged Fel in trying to locate a Jedi holocron. Unfortunately, she had her own plans for the holocron and tried to kill them as soon as they gained it.
Gregg was a Human male who served as a Lieutenant in the Imperial Navy. He acted as Supreme Commander Darth Vader's right-hand man during the early months of the Galactic Empire.
Dular was a male Sakuubian whom Jaina Solo Fel and Jagged Fel met during their honeymoon in 44 ABY.

Zama Brak was a Cold War-era smuggler that unwittingly started the rakghoul pandemic, after agreeing to smuggle an infected risp for Doctor Sannus Lorrick aboard the passenger liner, the Stardream, beginning the outbreak.
Mola Haxtor was a Human female who served as one of the three Rakghoul experts on the planet Taris at the time of the Cold War and during the Imperial Invasion of Taris.

Ellos Ripfire was a Rebel agent who worked as a technician for the ComNet Corporation on Ord Mynock. He would use his job as cover in order to be around situations that might provide him valuable information.

Sadus Vraal was a Human male xenobiologist and professor working alongside Mola Haxtor. One of three leading rakghoul experts on Taris, he played a role in the discovery of the nekghouls, a new subspecies capable of using the Force.
These three Duros bankers on Jubalene lived during the Republic Dark Age. In 1032 BBY, they were captured by Sith Lord Odion's principality during an invasion of the Bactranate.

A clone trooper cloned from the Mandalorian bounty hunter, Jango Fett, served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars fought between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A clone trooper commander served on a moon of the Gyndine system during the Clone Wars. At some point during a battle on the surface, he sent a message to the Galactic Senate requesting assistance with their situation of overwhelming battle droid forces on the planet.
This failed Padawan was a member of the Jedi Order, apprenticed to Jedi Master Mace Windu.
Dustin was a Human male smuggler who operated out of Coronet City on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Faraire was a Human male who served as General and a member of the War Trust of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.
Cugle was an Imperial TIE pilot during the Galactic Civil War. The pilot was stationed on the planet Celanon in the years following the Battle of Endor and flew a TIE/LN starfighter.
Vance was an Imperial TIE pilot during the Galactic Civil War. The pilot was stationed on the planet Celanon in the years following the Battle of Endor and flew a TIE/LN starfighter.
Yarnar was an Imperial TIE pilot during the Galactic Civil War. The pilot was stationed on the planet Celanon in the years following the Battle of Endor and flew a TIE/LN starfighter.
Ross was an Imperial TIE pilot during the Galactic Civil War. The pilot was stationed on the planet Celanon in the years following the Battle of Endor and flew a TIE/LN starfighter.

A Duros officer was a Republic Peace Officer with the Judicial Department Republic Guard. In 30 BBY, while on patrol with his squad, the officer was ambushed by the outlaw Aurra Sing. His fellow police officers were killed and the officer was taken and tied by Sing to a building.
Jeren Nolus Organa was a male Human member of House Organa during the Alderaan Civil War and a seventh cousin of duke Charle Remmot Organa.

Ross was a Human female Lieutenant of the Republic military who served the Galactic Republic during the Alderaan Civil War stationed in the Pass. Ross and her forces were under attack from Killik raiders and House Ulgo soldiers, and were in need of immediate assistance.

Major Brom was a male Nautolan who served the Galactic Republic as an aide to the Strategic Advisor to Alderaan for the Republic Army and leader of the First Alderaan Support Division Jace Malcom during the Cold War.
Vohrkrewel Yahrkar was a male Human smuggler, pilot and information broker during the Galactic Civil War.

Amp was a clone member of the 77th Air Wing's Sword Squadron. During the Battle of Kelrodo-Ai in the Western Reaches Operation of the Reconquest of the Rim, he flew under Blade Squadron with the call-sign Blade Two.

Starks was an Imperial pilot within the 77th Air Wing's Sword Squadron. During the Battle of Kelrodo-Ai in the Western Reaches Operation of the Reconquest of the Rim, Starks flew under Dagger Flight under the call-sign of Dagger Leader.

"Dibs" was the nickname of a pilot who served under the 77th Air Wing's Sword Squadron. During the Battle of Kelrodo-Ai in the Western Reaches Operation of the Reconquest of the Rim, Dibs served under Dagger Flight.
Kaal was a member of the 77th Air Wing's Sword Squadron. During the Battle of Kelrodo-Ai in the Western Reaches Operation of the Reconquest of the Rim, Kaal served as Scimitar Flight's leader.

Llohm Dunney was the Vice-Regent Accountant for the Imperial Treasury who operated out of the city-spanning world of Coruscant during the Galactic Civil War. Dunney was responsible for sending out e-mails to galactic citizens who had outstanding debts to the Empire.

Streeen and Luuuke Skywalker created a time machine after the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence. The pair used this to transport the Army they gathered together to the galaxy during the Clone Wars period, when they fought Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi and the Grand Army of the R…

An Imperial governor ruled the world Gerrard V. More than six months after the Battle of Yavin, the governor plotted to smuggle the planet's riches away from the people of Gerrard V, many of whom were Rebel Alliance supporters. He placed the the loot aboard luxury yachts.

Booba Fett was a clone of the bounty hunter Boba Fett. He was cloned by Grand Admiral Thrawn, as one of a series of copies created to replace important citizens of the galaxy with agents loyal to him.
Hraykken Bender was a male Human criminal who lived on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. He was a leader of the Meatlumps.
Keela was a female Trandoshan who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She stayed at a gunrunner camp outside of Mos Eisley, on the planet Tatooine, after the Battle of Yavin.

During the Galactic Civil War, an Imperial captain was stationed on the water world Spira. Assigned to command a modified waveskimmer to escort Regenald Hanniper Snopps III to the wreck, a local tourist attraction, the captain followed orders but did not much care for the youn…

A male Padawan served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the start of the Clone Wars. Like other Jedi during the war, he fell to the dark side of the Force, betraying the Order and joining Count Dooku's Confederacy of Independent Systems.

During the early years of the Rebellion, a Rebel smuggler was present in the city of Glastro on Bimmisaari when the Bimm merchant Glah Ubooki was selling prototype weapons and technology from a crashed Imperial R&D vessel.
"Glah Ubooki" was an alias used by eighteen members of the Ubooki brothers who owned and operated the series of shops known as Glah Ubooki's Strange & Wondrous Imports.

Xiizor was a clone of Xizor, the leader of the Black Sun crime syndicate. When Grand Admiral Thrawn's agent, Luuke Skywalker, was unable to get samples to clone the ancient Dark Lord of the Sith Exar Kun or Callista Ming, a woman whose original body had been destroyed, the Chi…
Gilaad Pellaeon was a clone of the naval officer Gilad Pellaeon. He was cloned by Grand Admiral Thrawn after the creation of Jaacen, a clone of Jedi Jacen Solo.

A male Maladian commander dealt with Sate Pestage as the latter attempted to kill off Vidar Kim. The commander, embarrassed by how Kim's assassination was carried out, told Pestage he wanted to make it up to him through another more skillful Maladian attack, but against who wa…

Quarra Thayn was a Force-sensitive Keshiri female from Uhrar on the continent of Alanciar on the planet Kesh. She was a wardmaster in the Alanciari military and the Chief military administrator of the city of Uhrar.

Chewbaacca was a clone of the legendary Wookiee warrior Chewbacca. He was cloned by Grand Admiral Thrawn. Thrawn used to pit Duurga against him for arm-wrestling. But after Chewbaacca pulled one of Duurga's arms out of its socket during a match, he stopped them.
Nataasi Daala was a clone of Admiral Natasi Daala. She was cloned by Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Duurga was a clone of the Hutt Durga Besadii Tai, created by Grand Admiral Thrawn between 11 ABY and 25 ABY. Thrawn enjoyed arranging arm-wrestling competitions between Duurga and the clone Chewbaacca, which ended after Chewbaacca tore out one of Duurga's arms.
Rehanna Rist was a Human female who was a scion of House Rist.
Duuurga was the second clone of the Hutt crime lord Durga Besadii Tai created by Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn.
Jaagged Fell was a clone of the Human pilot Jagged Fel. He was cloned by Grand Admiral Thrawn.
Anaakin Solo was a clone of the Human Jedi Knight Anakin Solo. He was cloned by Grand Admiral Thrawn. He replaced Anakin with Anaakin at some point.
Jaacen was a clone of the Human Jedi Knight Jacen Solo. He was cloned by Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Maara Jade was a clone of the Human Jedi Master Mara Jade Skywalker. She was cloned by Grand Admiral Thrawn. Thrawn started his spree of cloning by replacing Anakin Solo with Anaakin Solo. When he got away with that, he went on to switch Skywalker with Maara.

Presk was a male Human Engineer of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was part of the escort that accompanied a Republic Senator and Darmas Pollaran to Port Nowhere alongside Kuthana, Matto, and Rowost when Port Nowhere got under attack by the Sith E…

Quarris was a male Human criminal living during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. In 3642 BBY, Quarris worked for Rogun the Butcher and was in the group criminals were ordered to kill the Voidhound and bring his remains to the Crime lord.
Matto was a female Twi'lek who was as a Security Officer of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.

Kuthana was a male Human engineer of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was part of the escort that accompanied a Republic senator and Darmas Pollaran to Port Nowhere alongside Presk, Matto, and Rowost when Port Nowhere came under attack by the Sith …

Rowost was a male Twi'lek Flight Officer of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY, he was part of the escort that accompanied a Republic Senator and Darmas Pollaran to Port Nowhere alongside Kuthana, Matto, and Presk when Port Nowhere came under attack by …
Wertram was a Keshiri male who lived on his homeworld, Kesh, in the era of the Great Hyperspace War. Wertram worked as a tailor in the city of Tahv. He had a wife, and a daughter.
This Keshiri was the daughter of Kesh resident Wertram and his wife. Her father, the tailor of Tahv, sent her to learn from geologist Adari Vaal.

This Keshiri was the wife of Kesh resident Wertram and together they had a daughter. Her husband worked as a tailor in the city of Tahv. Eventually, he placed their daughter under the tutelage of a prominent teacher and geologist, Adari Vaal, a neighbor of theirs.
Yagorn was a Human female Corellian who fought as a defender of Corellia against the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Syrin was a Human male Corellian who fought as a defender of Corellia against the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Gixsa was a Human male Corellian who fought as a defender of Corellia against the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Curske was a female Selonian living on Corellia during the Galactic War. During the Battle of Corellia in 3640 BBY, Curske fought against the Sith Empire together with Jedi Master Sumalee from a Galactic Republic base in the Axial Park.

Delquis was a Human male who served as a member of the Corellian Council. During the Galactic War, Delquis planned on saving Corellia if he and the members of the council would serve the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Vacuus was a male Sith Lord who lived centuries before the Cold War.
Grik Sonosan was a Human male Agent of the Republic Strategic Information Service who served as a spy for the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.
Ralesk was a Human male Sith who served as one of Lord Grathan's top assassins during the Cold War.
Durmat was a Human male who served as an Ensign with the Republic during the Cold War, and was the son of the Imperial spy Rylon.
Eligyn was a Human male who served as Captain of the Republic military during the Cold War.
Mashallon was a Human female Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order as an investigator during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
An Imperial Advisor negotiated peace with the Zygerrians during an Imperial siege of the planet Zygerria.
Dheno Rey was a Zabrak male who lived during the Cold War.
Lila Rawlkiss was a Human female junk dealer who did business out of the Moenia cantina on the planet Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Kiizete was a female Rodian technician for the Rebel Alliance Vortex Squadron who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She owned the 3PO-series protocol droid V3-FX and operated out of the city of Moenia on the planet Naboo sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY.

Cutter was a male Human clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic. In 22 BBY, he was part of a mission to the planet Oznek under the command of Clone Sergeant Banks and Commander Griebs Kishpaugh.

Crazy Legs, was a male Human clone trooper pilot of the Grand Army of the Republic. In 22 BBY, he was part of a mission to the planet Oznek under the command of Sergeant Banks and Commander Griebs Kishpaugh, during which he was killed.
Lanoree Brock was a Human female Je'daii Ranger that lived during the Force Wars. She was the older sister of Dalien Brock.

Syke was a male Human clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic. In 22 BBY, he was part of a mission to the planet Oznek under the command of Sergeant Banks and Commander Griebs Kishpaugh, where he was betrayed and killed by his fellow clone Ghost.
Balic Cormac was a Human male captain in the military forces of House Organa during the Alderaan Civil War and the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Markus Andarius Thul was a Human male member of the House of Thul who lived during the Cold War and the Alderaan Civil War.
Pallos Thessius Organa was a Human male who was the first nephew of the Great Duke Organa and a loyal individual of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.
Isen was a Human male captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Thorus was a Human male Sith-Imperial officer who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Andrik was a Human male who served the Galactic Republic until he joined the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Jonas Balkar was a male Human who served the Galactic Republic as a member of the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War against the Sith Empire.
Zardres was a Human male Major who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Sarven was a Human male Ensign of the Imperial Army during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he was selected as a test subject for Ryler Dorant's work on weaponizing the rakghoul plague on the planet Taris. Dorant infected Sarven with the plague, turning him into a rakghoul.
Mal Sikander was a male High Inquisitor who served the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius during the Galactic Civil War.

Benbul Leedee was a male Gungan informant who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Kima Nazith commissioned a spacer to killing Leedee, after he betrayed the Rebel Alliance and aligned with the Empire.
Hrodius Goragg was a male Trandoshan bounty hunter who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He had connections with Bossk, another more well known Trandoshan bounty hunter.

Kunn Kuroosh was a male assassin who served High Inquisitor Mal Sikander of the Inquisitorius during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was rumored to be a Sith sorcerer, whose targets rarely survived his assassination attempts.
Magus Jocle was a male Devaronian Dark Jedi leader who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Borath Maddeus was a Human male who eventually rose to become the Director of the Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service and the Head of Galactic Alliance Security.
During Yaru Korsin's reign as Grand Lord of the Lost Tribe of Sith on Kesh, this Keshiri was a vocal and prominent dissenter from the commonly accepted idea that the Sith were divine.
Samara Organa was a female Human member of House Organa and ambassador to House Panteer during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Andon Organa was a Human male who served as a diplomat for House of Organa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Prellon Garn was a Human male agent of the Republic Strategic Information Service who went undercover in the Imperial Military during the Galactic War, and discovered the Sith Empire's construction of the Gauntlet.
The Human codenamed "The General" was an officer holding that rank in the military forces of the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War.
An unidentified individual served as the Shadow Hand of the last King of the Sith Hakagram Graush circa 6900 BBY. As a Shadow Hand, they acted as the king's second-in-command.
Rylon was a Human male Imperial spy that served undercover as Commander of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.
Horace Korr was a Human male reporter who lived prior and during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Graedler was a male Imperial Moff who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, his nephew Zim Graedler was kidnapped by a competitor, who lost to him in the Narmle Arts Gala.

Zim Graedler was the nephew of Moff Graedler who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he was kidnapped, but soon rescued by a spacer sent by Jaleela Bindoo.
Dane Windholm was an Imperial courier who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Jaleela Bindoo tasked a spacer with delivering a list of finalists to Windholm.
Mallohe was a Human female lieutenant who served in the Imperial Navy during the Cold War, which saw the reconstituted Sith Empire pitted against the Galactic Republic.
Murtag was a Human male private who fought in the Republic Military's 301st Infantry during the renewed war between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Dromol was a male Twi'lek private in the Republic military attached to the 301st Infantry during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Jogan Halder was a Keshiri male from Uhrar on the continent of Alanciar on the planet Kesh. He was a sentinel at Point Defiance, the southernmost of Alanciar's western watchtowers, shortly before the Lost Tribe of Sith invaded from Keshtah.
Dann Itra was a Human male Grand Lord of the Lost Tribe of Sith before 3000 BBY on the planet Kesh.

Callan Grayne was a Human male who served in the Republic Army during the Great Galactic War against the Sith Empire and later became a general in Republic Strategic High Command during the subsequent Cold War.
Grossh was a Kaleesh male pirate who was the one of the leaders of the White Maw pirate organization during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Wernell Covington was a Human male who lived in the city of Narmle on Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Felicia was the Human female who until her tragic death, was the daughter of Wernell Covington.
Ghulil was a Mon Calamari male commander and war veteran who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Aztin Maru was a Human male who lived on Naboo's moon of Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Maru was part of Vladlun's gang, a minor criminal group led by Vladlun Travan.

Titus Dabrini was a Human male who lived on Naboo's moon of Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Dabrini was part of Vladlun's gang, a minor criminal group led by Vladlun Travan.

Tiaba Charr was a female Zabrak who lived on Naboo's moon of Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Charr was part of Vladlun's gang, a minor criminal group led by Vladlun Travan.
Vladlun Travan was a male Rodian criminal who resided on Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Karhei was a male Chagrian sergeant of the White Maw pirate gang during the Galactic War. After his boss Shai Tenna attempted a failed coup against White Maw Gen'Dai leaders and perished at the hand of the Voidhound, Karhei and other Tenna's men could not return to the White M…

Takan was a male Mandalorian who was a member of the Sith cult known as the Revanites during the Cold War. During the War, he lived near Kaas City on the Sith Empire's capital planet of Dromund Kaas along with the rest of his clan.

Myahh was a male Twi'lek who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. As first lieutenant of the Endar Rebirth, Myahh was part of the ship's mission to investigate devastated ecumenopolis planet Taris as a potential site for the Republic's planned Taris Resettlement I…

Bhoenn was a male Human who served as commander of the Galactic Republic and the Republic Military during the Cold War and the start of the Galactic War against the Sith Empire. Near the end of the undeclared conflict, Bhoenn was assigned to oversee Camp Lytle on Taris.
A male Human was the father of Kattadan leader Mia Ikova. He was at her side when she died at the Battle of Kattada.
Ja'Boag was a male Gossam who served as head of the Rim Commercial Mining and oversaw operations on the planet Moorjhone during the Clone Wars.
Aleksei Dorne was a Human male who served the Sith Empire and later defected to the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Trey Courser was a Human male machine and droid fabricator who served Wraith Squadron and was part of a team to serve in their investigation of General Stavin Thaal's guilt into the Lecersen Conspiracy.

Turman Durra was a male Clawdite actor who served as a member of Wraith Squadron and assisted in the investigation and capture of Galactic Alliance General Stavin Thaal in 44 ABY. He frequented disguises and various personae during the mission as part of his acting specialty.
Argast was a soldier loyal to General Stavin Thaal's Pop-Dogs of Galactic Alliance.
Tookreek was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto who owned and operated Tookreek's Cantina at Dreviad Outpost on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Chomm was a Weequay male criminal who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. In the year 3643 BBY, he visited the cantina of Tookreek, a lieutenant in the gang of Diago Hixan.
Brazzer was a male Twi'lek who worked as a Guard in Diago Hixan's Palace during the Cold War. He was present when the Palace was under attack by the Imperial forces led by Vaverone Zare.
Wynne Organa was a Human male from House Organa, serving as Chief negotiator of the peace talks in order to end the civil war on Alderaan.
Aleyna Hark was a Mirialan female who served as a double agent for the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Yils was a Human male who served the noble House Alde as a guard captain during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Dal was a Cathar male who served as Captain of the Daybreaker during the Cold War.
Khourlet was a male Human who served the Republic Strategic High Command and War Trust during the Galactic War. He and his men engaged a Sith Lord, Darth Baras' apprentice, and were all killed.
Wran Narcassan was a Human male who was the son of Vula Nelprin and nephew of Shalla Nelprin, who was once a member of Wraith Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Drikall Bessarah was a Devaronian male who acted as a field medic for Wraith Squadron, a Galactic Alliance commando unit.
Biller was a Human female police officer with the Kura City Guard. She held the rank of Detective and was partnered up with Detective Sergeant Husin.

Kadd Yinkle was a Human male from the planet Kuratooine. After famous pop star singer Ledina Chott had been kidnapped by Wraith Squadron in 44 ABY, Yinkle tracked the signal of her emergency transponder to a warehouse owned by corrupt Galactic Alliance General Stavin Thaal, fr…

Ledina Chott was a Human female who was a famous interplanetary pop singer who resided on Kuratooine. In 44 ABY, she had received various gifts from a mysterious man named Thadley Biolan, who was really known as corrupt Alliance General Stavin Thaal.
Adra Passik was a Twi'lek female who was the daughter of former Wraith Squadron member Dia Passik. After Dia married fellow Wraith Garik "Face" Loran, Face adopted Adra as his daughter.
Phison was enamored by Drayson's "air-headed heiress" act, which she used to get Phison to give her a tour of the Concussor so that the Wraiths could take over.

Davian was a Bothan male who served as a naval lieutenant in the Galactic Alliance. In 44 ABY, his parents owed Garik "Face" Loran a favor, so Davian decided to pay Loran back by hacking into classified Galactic Alliance files in order to look into the disappearance of Allianc…
Raste was a male Human communications officer who served aboard the Esseles during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Rossin was a Human male Pop-Dog soldier who was loyal to General Stavin Thaal of the Galactic Alliance.
Dobi was Human female sergeant belonging to the Pop-Dogs, a Galactic Alliance Army unit loyal to corrupt Galactic Alliance General Stavin Thaal by 44 ABY on Vandor-3.

Estoric Sandskimmer was a Human male who served as a member of Wraith Squadron, a Galactic Alliance commando unit, during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Enaq was an Evocii male who lived as a refugee on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Darshyn was a male Anomid refugee who lived on the planet Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
Gerrard was a male Human who served as a captain in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.

Kamen Proy was a Human male Republic Strategic Information Service spy who served in the ranks of the House Ulgo. During the Alderaan Civil War, he informed the House of Organa about the U-20 Kingstrike.

Tyuth was a Zabrak male agent who served the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Alderaan Civil War. He learned of Elric Organa betraying the House of Organa and tasked a Republic citizen to either apprehend or kill him.
Elric Organa was a Human male who betrayed the House of Organa in favor of House of Thul during the Alderaan Civil War.

Vakar was a Human male Captain in the Republic Military of the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War and from the House Traders' Circle asked a fellow Republic citizen to strike a final blow to the opposition in King's Pass.

Lirka was a Sephi female who lived in the last years of the Galactic Republic. Along with a colleague, she assisted the Sephi politician Navi in his senatorial duties during the Clone Wars, until he was arrested for crimes against the Republic in 22 BBY.

Danna was a male smuggler who owned a starship with his female partner, Gabriel. During the Galactic Civil War, they were hauling denta beans to Gyndine. During a stopover, Gabriel met a former smuggling associate who sold her that month's codes to access Cynabar's InfoNet.
Drenn was a female Trandoshan mercenary, leader of the Drennics who operated out of Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Narlissa was a female individual who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Gabriel was a female smuggler partnered with the male Danna. She was known as "Gabby" for short, and together they owned a starship and were transporting denta beans to the planet Gyndine during the Galactic Civil War.

Sharky was a smuggler during the Galactic Civil War who led a gang. During the Imperial blockade of Ralltiir, Sharky's gang was reported to have successfully run the gauntlet to deliver goods to the population.

Trynn attempted to reach a compromise, offering surrender terms to the rebel leader, General Camon Udeon, but they were refused. The admiral pulled his troops out of the city and bombarded the urban center of Harazod from orbit.
Hare'en was a Human female seismologist who worked for the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the Sith Empire.

Udeon's small navy was defeated in orbit, and fierce fighting forced the rebels back to the capitol building in Harazod. Admiral Trynn offered terms of surrender to Udeon, but the General refused the terms by shooting the courier.

In 0 BBY, a courier was part of the Imperial task force sent to quell an uprising on the planet Gerrard V.
Kadana Sorrel was a Human female Colonel of the Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command. She was married to an individual who loved to pull practical jokes on her.
Zehrinne Thaal was a Human female who worked as a model. In 12 ABY, at age eighteen, she married corrupt Galactic Alliance General Stavin Thaal.
Voyce Evlen was a Human female whose mother was Admiral Biana Drayce. In 44 ABY, she became captain of the Galactic Alliance corvette Starhook.
Thaymes Fodrick was a Human Male from the planet Corellia.

Huhunna was a Wookiee female member of Sharr Latt's Wraith Squadron in 44 ABY during the mission to prove corrupt Galactic Alliance General Stavin Thaal's involvement with the Lecersen Conspiracy.

Waxx was a Human male journalist and holorecorder who operated on Ord Mantell during the Cold War. While doing a piece on Tatooine, Waxx spent three months living with the Jawas, thinking they were his "spiritual kin".
Dashan Joyl was a Duros male who was the grandson of the infamous Usan Joyl, a con artist and an identity forger.

The Shadow Captain was a male Imperial Commando who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic as a member of the elite shadow commandos.
Dray Ithicus was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Breel'ik Nar was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Lacklo Blant was a male individual who worked for the Black Sun during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Serina was a Human female smuggler who operated out of the city of Tyrena on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Razik was a male Sith Lord who served the resurgent Empire during the Cold War and the Galactic War. A pale-skinned Human with red-orange eyes and short black hair in a double stripe hairstyle, Razik made use of a double-bladed lightsaber and armored robes in combat.

Nuni was a member of the Hill people who lived on the planet Gala. In 44 BBY, Nuni was tasked by Elan, leader of the Hill people, to take all the children and elders to a safe shelter when the royal guards attacked the Hill people's encampment.

Viva was a member of the Hill people who lived on the planet Gala. In 44 BBY, Viva was tasked by Elan, the leader of the Hill people, to gather all of her medicinal supplies when the royal guards attacked the Hill people's encampment.

Domi was a male Galacian and a member of the Hill people who lived on the planet Gala. In 44 BBY, Domi was part of the defense organized by Elan, leader of the Hill people, to engage the proton tanks of the royal guards when they attacked the Hill people's encampment.

Dana Dregond was a female native of the planet Kamori. A Glanthe master, she was the Glanthe school's master painter and was designated as a one of Kamori's "living treasures," a rare honor bestowed upon the masters of the arts, around 9 BBY.

Thane Dregond was the Chamber President of the planet Kamori in 1 ABY. Following a series of groundquakes which sundered cities all over the Zethusian plains, Dregond declared the area a disaster zone, qualifying it for governmental disaster relief, and planned to petition the…
Fawste was an Ascendancy Chiss male who served with Imperial Intelligence during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Monk was a Human male admiral of the Galactic Republic who fought against the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War, while simultaneously working as a double agent for Sith Lord Darth Baras.
Masken was a Human male Imperial Moff who served aboard Darth Vengean's flagship during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Mace was a Sith Warrior who served as an apprentice to the Sith Lord Tahm of the resurgent Empire. A bald and tan-skinned Human male, Mace made use of two orange-bladed lightsabers in combat, and was proficient in casting violet lightning at his opponents.

Tahm was a Human male Sith Lord of the resurgent Empire who fought during the Cold War and the early days of the Galactic War. Tahm wore armored robes and a neck guard while wielding his purple-bladed lightsaber into combat.

A clone trooper pilot served in Hunter Squadron during the Clone Wars. He was involved in an assault on the Gwori shipyards around 22 BBY.
Hirka was a Human female CorSec officer who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Louis Bender was a male Human criminal who lived on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. He was a leader of the Meatlumps.

Gohn Danfeil was the Chief Executive Officer of Gowix Computers in 1 ABY. He presided over the company's move from Corellia to Corulag.

Amier Candle was the department head of Imperial University's School of Public Policy in 1 ABY. Candle commented on the appointment of Gerald Weizel to the post of Governor of Chandrila to Coruscant Daily Newsfeed.
Greng Tabbe was the a member of the Imperial Public Policy Foundation in 1 ABY. Tabbe commented on the appointment of Gerald Weizel to the post of Governor of Chandrila to Coruscant Daily Newsfeed.
Jantaa Binx was the only known Human performer of floubette dance, which was considered aesthetically pleasing when danced by avian aliens but revolting when performed by Humans.

Tarin DeHallo was a female assistant manager of the Marqua Spas on the planet of Gailea. She booked Jantaa Binx, a practitioner of the Floubette dance, to perform at the Marqua Spas Grand Ball without realizing Binx was Human.

Falaco Don-DeMardo was the male general manager of the Marqua Spas on the planet Gailea. After his assistant manager, Tarin DeHallo, booked a Human performer that shocked guests with a vulgar display of the Floubette dance at the Marqua Spas Grand Ball, Don-DeMardo fired her.

Pinac Galous was a male Imperial economic advisor. During the Galactic Civil War, he announced a fifteen percent rise in consumption tax, citing the rising cost of rawmat costs and increasing Rebel activity.
