Norrin was the Imperial Governor of Wroona during the Galactic Civil War.
Rolf Petruma was the male president of Freda. He had been involved with talks with his counterpart from Jante over disputed mining rights in the Rettna system at the behest of Moff Haveland.

Kanno Sebak was a male Sullustan living on Esseles during the Galactic Civil War. He was a member of the Guild of Offworlder Skilled Laborers, and met with President Cambira Ralle following the Faceless bombing on Grande Hyet.
Rumo Takashi was a member of the Imperial Military stationed on Fremond III during the Galactic Civil War. In 2 ABY, he led Imperial forces during the siege of a fortified Rebel warehouse complex.

Kabalard Vinne was a Wroonian outlaw during the Galactic Civil War. A former representative of the Guild of Armament Distributors, Vinne was responsible for an attack on the Victory-class Star Destroyer Rampant, which was undergoing repairs at Wroona Stardock.
Terrin Sandafar was a native of the planet Alderaan who served in the Republic Military for one year before becoming a bounty hunter.

Verre Sydia was a senator who served the Galactic Republic through the Great Galactic War and Cold War with the Sith Empire. A fierce opponent of the Empire, Sydia unknowingly married an Imperial spy who used her Senate resources behind her back.
Eckhorn Baliss was an Alderaanian noble and member of House Baliss who served as a spy for the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

The husband of the Republic Senator Verre Sydia was a deep-cover spy for the Sith Empire through their wife's career during the Great Galactic and Cold Wars until their true allegiances were exposed by the astromech droid T7-O1.
The Eidolon was a male Zabrak assassin and owner of Eidolon Security on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.

Shonn Volta was a Humanoid Force-sensitive female captain, sniper, and assassin of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Clone Wars, she was captured by Jedi Master Kit Fisto and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and imprisoned within The Prism.

Ronko Bist was a male Trandoshan and a member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Bist was the leader of a group of faction called the Free Trandoshans, and served as Count Dooku's liaison to the Bounty Hunters' Guild.

Harrigan Shunt was a male Human who served as Head Engineer of the Separatist army's heavy artillery division. During the Clone Wars, Shunt was arrested by Jedi Master Mace Windu and then imprisoned within The Prism throughout the rest of the war.

Calli Trilm was a female Human who served as commander of the Clysm Fleet and general of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Trilm was known to be a confidante of Count Dooku, and according to the records of Lieutenant Laurita Tohm, she may have been even closer with him.

Ur'Loach was a male general, serving the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, and was considered to be an enforcer of Count Dooku. During the war, Ur'Loach was captured by Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker near the Maw Cluster.

N'won Raines, known by the code name "Big Shadow", was a male cyborg ace pilot allied with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Nearly his entire body had been replaced by cybernetics, including his arms, neck, chest, and facial features.
A. Drax was an Alliance to Restore the Republic NewsNet journalist. Drax reported on the Alliance strike on Onderon during the Galactic Civil War.

S. Moshuddaa was a journalist affiliated with the Hutt-run financial NewsNet, the Nal Hutta Kal'tamok. Moshuddaa reported on several stories during the Galactic Civil War, including Spaaga Core, Inc.'s move into the Corusca stone market. S.

Kail Reimo was a male member of the Bazzel Crimewatch Association. He offered several opinions on the actions of the Khuiumin Survivors, after their attacks waned in 2 ABY, ranging from laying low to catch sector authorities off-guard, or having split their booty and disbanded.
Grady Mannd was the male Defense Minister of the planet Stend VI during the Galactic Civil War.

Tanna Odann was a Viceprex serving the Corporate Sector Authority's Territory Administration. During the Galactic Civil War, Odann issued a press release banning the Corellian Merchants' Guild from the Corporate Sector.

Micja Corneli was a male member of the Friends of Slungerhounds. A slungerhound owner, Corneli was angry that the creatures were banned on his homeworld of Corulag after a high amount of attacks against Humans.
Jerri Gabel was a Core Worlds citizen and member of the pro-Imperial Citizens Against Unrest.
Nalco Farell was the male director of Thimwa precinct on Cmaoli Di. He was worried about the rise in Pinacism among his constituents.

Gans Dent was the associate director of Galladinium Galactic Exports. After Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology was banned in the Spirva sector, Dent confirmed that the company would comply with the edict and cancel all orders originating in the sector.
Von Doobba was a male from the city of Ferronel on Cmaoli Di. He was a representative to the planetary council, and a fervent Pinacist.

Massus Gyne was a High Reverend of the Fellowship of Kooroo. In 2 ABY, Gyne issued a bounty for Andor Javin, a TriNebulon News journalist after Javin made claims disparaging the Fellowship and their beliefs.

Allion Vlenda was an employee of Arakyd Industries during the Galactic Civil War. Vlenda announced the decision to increase the company's Viper probe droid marketability and make it available to the wider public.

Adion Var'alich was a male division head serving Ororo Transportation during the Galactic Civil War.

Pelleo Thog was a rich, successful male Human businessman who owned an estate on the planet Torina in the Elrood sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, he possessed a large collection of exotic animals.

Zeshatt was a male Gen'Dai leader of the White Maw pirates on Hoth during the Cold War. He was killed by the Galactic Republic sergeant Fideltin Rusk during the latter incursion together with the Hero of Tython to the White Maw's base to retrieve a secret Imperial databank.
Karsim was a soldier who served in the Republic Army during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Naja was a soldier who served in the Republic Army during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Eckerd was a soldier who served in the Republic Army during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire before being recruited into the black ops program of the Republic Special Forces Division as part of the assassination squad known as the Surgeons.
Edder was a Human male soldier who served the Galactic Republic as a private in the Republic Army's 301st Infantry.
Vanth was a male human soldier who served the Galactic Republic as a private
Reico was a Human male soldier who served the Galactic Republic as a private in the Republic Army's 301st Infantry.
Voshpar was a male Human soldier who served the Galactic Republic as a private in the Republic Army's 301st Infantry.

Ratoog was a Gamorrean male who lived on the planet Derilyn during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He was a member of the Friends of Paran, an anti-Imperial resistance group, and he served the organization as a droid and computer specialist.

Pons Lo was a Human gambler who was present on Coruscant in 22 BBY. They were inside the Outlander Club when Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi were chasing Zam Wesell. Lo wore dark robes and a small hood that still left their entire face visible.

Eos Morne was a Human female participant in the party scene of the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. During a night in 22 BBY, Morne visited the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall in the Uscru Entertainment District of Coruscant.

Kristoff Vestswe was a Human who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic. In 22 BBY, he was present on Coruscant, where he was walking past the Outlander Club entrance with Onyeth Canavar at the moment Obi-Wan Kenobi caught up with Anakin Skywalker.
Aliza Darsk was a Human present on Coruscant in 22 BBY. They were inside the Outlander Club when the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker were chasing Zam Wesell.

Bille Doshun was a Human present on Coruscant in 22 BBY. He was inside the Outlander Club when the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker were chasing Zam Wesell. Doshun wore an outfit of dark colors like black, maroon, and dark green, as well as black boots.
An Imperial stormtrooper was stationed on the planet of Coruscant in 1 BBY. He shot Skosef after the General killed Grand Moff Bartam.

Qwot was a male employee of Linkaas, who served as his personal aide.

Ranath was a Human male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War, during which he was stationed on Hoth.
Zak Quiglee, who also went by the nickname "Squidfella", was a Gungan male who participated in bongo racing on the planet Naboo shortly after the Invasion of Naboo.

Neb Neb Goodrow was a bongo racer who along with fellow racer Spleed Nukkels was accused of collision, endangering the lives of others, and giving the sport a bad name.

This unidentified guard was Human who lived on the planet Telos IV. Sometime in 44 BBY, the guard was part of the group that escorted the Jedi prisoners Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi to their planned execution.

The father of Andra was a male Human. His child became the founder of the Preserve Our Wild Endangered Resources Party on the planet Telos IV. When Andra was young, he used to take her to the Park of Sacred Pools.

This unidentified technician was a male Human who lived on the planet Telos IV. Sometime in 44 BBY, the technician was in charge of transmitting images of Telox IV as stage background whenever former Jedi Xanatos was giving prizes to the Katharsis winners.

The Hutt crime lord Smada employed several minions from the Gank species on the planet D'vouran, among whom was one who accompanied the Hutt in an outdoor confrontation with the Human children Tash and Zak Arranda.

Tiber Quent was an assassin who worked for the Empire. The assassin's goal was to eliminate as many Rebel agents as possible. Quent traveled to Ord Mynock disguised as an Imperial courier with a datapad that had information on it for Project Firestorm.

Nukss was a male Trandoshan criminal who was affiliated with the Scourge, a pirate gang, during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Corlis Brado Cressen was a Human male who served House Organa as major in the First Organa Regiment during the Cold War. He was the father of Andra Cressen and at least two sons.
Alethios was a Human male during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was a captain stationed at Wardpost Landa in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan.

Urrisov was a male Human who worked as a technician for the Sith Empire during the Galactic War on the planet Hoth.

Gulsh was a narglatch that lived at the time of the Clone Wars.
Kharroh was a Gundark that lived at the time of the Clone Wars. It was available for selling as a pet.
Algrunar was a male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as an instructor during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

A female individual was a Jedi Master at some point in time prior to 41 ABY. In 41 ABY, when New Jedi Order Grand Master Luke Skywalker visited the Jedi enclave on the planet Corellia, a picture—made before Grand Master Skywalker visited the enclave—of her meditating was on on…

This individual was a male Rutanian who lived on the planet Rutan. Sometime in 44 BBY, he served as a Security Police in the city of Testa.
An APC driver served in the Army of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
A male Sanyassan with an eye patch over his right eye was a member of the Sanyassan Marauders of Endor in 3 ABY.

Grohto was a male Ishi Tib Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Akris Ur'etu was a wealthy male Bothan crime lord who, at a relatively young age, became head of the criminal organization known as the Skar'kla Consortium.

A male Human Hutt enforcer was hired by a Hutt rival of the Skar'kla Consortium shortly before the Clone Wars. The Hutt wished for him to harass the rival criminal organization and kill it's leader, the Bothan crime lord Akris Ur'etu.
Grunk was a bounty hunter that was active during the Clone Wars.
Temora was a Human male who was a major business leader on the planet Arda II during the Galactic Civil War.
This clone medical officer was stationed on medical station near Ord Cestus during the Clone Wars.

Kindin was a male Mon Calamari bounty hunter who worked with Xo'ru. The two of them accepted Rogun the Butcher's bounty on a smuggler during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
A male bronze-scaled Trandoshan thug worked as part of the criminal organization known as the Skar'kla Consortium shortly before the Clone Wars, serving the Bothan crime lord Akris Ur'etu.
Zadik Lone was a male Mandalorian who was active around the Great Galactic War and the subsequent Cold War between the Galactic Republic and reconstituted Sith Empire.
A male Weequay worked for the criminal organization known as the Skar'kla Consortium as a security shortly before the Clone Wars.

Jagger was a Mandalorian who lived during the tumultuous period of conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire known as the Cold War, Jagger joined Corridan Ordo and several members of their clan, along with close friend Torian Cadera, on a hunting trip to Dxun,…
Corridan Ordo was a Human male Mandalorian soldier who lived during the time of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire.
Skurvis was a Krish who died in 2 ABY on Ord Simres.
Caicos was a male Human member of the Corellian Council during the Galactic War.
Pak Taldine was a male Zabrak criminal who served The Tomb and fought against the Sith Empire on Belsavis during the Galactic War.
Grazzy Binboo was an individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Farn was a Human male soldier who served the Galactic Republic during the Separatist War and Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Pavan Silar was a Human male scientist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He worked as a courier for the Biological Control Bureau.

Lancoln was a Human male bodyguard tasked with protecting Governor-General Dixton of the Fakir sector. He had been privately hired by Dixton, as the Governor-General did not trust in the abilities of Imperial bodyguards.
Pfistak was a Human male bodyguard who served Governor-General Dixton of the Fakir sector. Not trusting in the abilities of standard Imperial bodyguards, Dixton hired Pfistak to personally guard him.
Mak'o Rad was a Human male Imperial counter-intelligence agent who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was featured on the painting Imperial Agent.
Lith K'alis was a male Bothan who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kalio Uldi was a male Rodian who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Blurga Vuto was a male Aqualish who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

A female Sakiyan served a Hutt as an enslaved worker along with two other Humanoids and a Klatooinian. She sat beside the Hutt with one of the humanoids whilst he met with another Hutt and their slaves. The Sakiyan had black skin, and no hair as was common for her species.

This male Keshiri lived on the planet Kesh in 5000 BBY, and was the uncle of controversial geologist Adari Vaal. That year, as mobs descended upon Vaal's home after she was accused of heresy, Vaal sent her mother and two sons to stay with her uncle.
When Jax Pavan and Nick Rostu visited Gort's, a restaurant on the planet Coruscant in 19 BBY, there was a Sakiyan patron enjoying nexufish sulyet.
Bellis was a Human male who lived on the planet Ord Mantell with his wife, Lin, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Tredo Dopra was the chief trader aboard the Ithorian Herdship Veldt during the Galactic Civil War fought between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire.

A female Sakiyan scientist worked as a contractor for the corporation Arkanian Microtechnologies on their re-engineering project during the Clone Wars. She earned a bounty on her head for her efforts, which brought her to the attention of the Gand Findsman Vaskau Farg.

Attimun was a male Wookiee who served as a general during the Clone Wars in which he became a decorated hero. However Attimun's family were all killed during the war which caused the Wookiee to turn against the Galactic Republic in grief and rage.
A male Wookiee who had reached the rank of sergeant worked as the operator for a Holoscanner at the conference on Kashyyyk during the Clone Wars.

A male Sakiyan was present onboard the The Wheel space station in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars. Whilst he was on the station, the Sakiyan was passed by the Twi'lek Jedi Aayla Secura, whom was disguised as a mechanic named Jaayza and searching for her Jedi Master Quinlan Vos wh…
Mirru was a Twi'lek male who lived on Ord Mantell during the civil war on the planet and the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

A male Sakiyan worked as the bouncer at Quarek'k, a seedy bar in the underlevels of the planet Coruscant. He let the bounty hunter Aurra Sing into the establishment when she bribed him with one hundred credits.
Super Ace was a stormtrooper serving the Galactic Empire before the Battle of Yavin. He often served with fellow stormtrooper Killer.
Killer was a male stormtrooper serving the Galactic Empire before the Battle of Yavin. He often served with fellow stormtrooper Super Ace.
Biff Tarkin was a male individual and a member of the Tarkin family. They were the son of the Human male Wilhuff Tarkin, a Grand Moff of the Galactic Empire.
This individual was a Devaronian male was a reporter before the Battle of Yavin. He was a newscaster for Galaxy Rumors.
Steele was a female Human major serving the Galactic Empire before the Battle of Yavin.
Jeff was a male IT technician before the Battle of Yavin.
Fufu was an Ewok major in the Galactic Empire before the Battle of Yavin.
Harmony was a Human female who was working as a waitress at Dex's Diner shorty before the Battle of Yavin. She met Obi-Wan Kenobi at Coruscant job fair. Kenobi believed the Force was strong with her.

An unidentified spacer from another galaxy traveled through the Dragon's Spine, an asteroid belt in orbit around the barren planet Tatooine, at some point before the Naboo Crisis in 32 BBY. The spacer collided with an asteroid and made a forced landing on the planet.
Bolt was a clone trooper who served the Galactic Republic as a sergeant in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Human female was the daughter of Republic SIS Agent Fieler Dan. The daughter ran a group called "Undercity Assistance" during the Cold War on Coruscant in the Black Sun territory and Justicars' Sector, working with refugees.

Jaen Kett was a Human male doctor residing on the planet of Ord Mantell during its Civil War. He was stationed in a hot zone on the island of Mannett Point, where he kept several war orphan kids, protecting them from the conflict.

In 32 BBY a Tusken war chief resided on the outskirts of Mos Espa among his clan of Tusken Raiders near a Tusken burial site. The remains of a derelict sandcrawler served as their home, where he held the Queen of Naboo hostage as a trophy.

An alien individual acted as an agent of Raskar and was a frequent occupant at the criminal hideaway, Junkfort Station. In 0 ABY, the alien talked with the Wookiee Chewbacca and informed him about a potential lead to the power gem at Antipose.
Enna Tabord was a Human female Jedi who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Harvus was a Moff of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Brant Organa was a male Human member of House Organa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
A male Human was a member of the Alderaanian House Organa during the Cold War. He was the grandfather of Charle Remmot Organa.
Dolin Organa was a Human male who served as a member of House Organa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Elz Organa was a Human male member of the Alderaanian House Organa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Haley Organa was a male human member of House Organa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Hallam Organa was a Human male who served as a member of House Organa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He was the head of the Organa's diplomatic corps.
Lew Organa was a Human male who served as a member of House Organa during the Cold War and the civil war on his home planet.
Vala Organa was a female Human duchess of House Organa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Padrus Organa was a Human male who was a member of House Organa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY, he was kidnapped by Imperial forces.

A Human male was a member of the planet Alderaan's noble House Organa and the father of Nomar Organa. The man was the fourth youngest son of their House in their generation, with their eldest brother serving as the lord of House Organa sometime well before the Cold War between…
Rickard Organa was a Human male member of House Organa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Kobbeth was a Twi'lek male who served the Galactic Republic's military as a sergeant. He was stationed on Belsavis during the Galactic War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Vericks was a male senator during the Cold War who replaced Vanara Kayl as senator of the Coruscant sector following the exposure of her dealings with the Migrant Merchants' Guild in 3643 BBY. By that time, he was on a financial subcommittee, and had a full schedule most days.
Cambra Del was a female smuggler. She spent time on Ord Mynock looking for jobs so she could pay off a loan shark that lent her credits to repair her YT-1000 freighter.

The father of Fir Megsan was a male who served the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3653 BBY, the man was present on the Republic capital planet Coruscant when the Empire attacked the planet.

Lalat'k was an Administrator General of the Gree Enclave during the Galactic War. He contacted the reconstituted Sith Empire for help in dealing with a situation on Asation, a Gree world devoted to the storage of Gree technology.

A Gamorrean dancer performed a dance number at the Podracers' hovel on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY. During that time, Fode, the left head of the bicephalic Troig Podrace commentator Fodesinbeed Annodue, expressed admiration for the Gamorrean's dancing skills.

Argat was a male Colonel who served the armed forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic. In 21 BBY, he accompanied General Lok Durd to a secret base on Lanteeb where they held a scientist captive.

Shuuru was a male Selkath who served as representative of the planet Manaan, the sole producer of Kolto, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He became part of the Rift Alliance at one point.
Voralla was the female Mirialan senator who represented Mirial in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War and Galactic War.
Bammer was a clone trooper who served the Grand Army of the Republic as a pilot of Gold Squadron during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Tryn Netzl was a Human male from Alderaan who served as a biochemist of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Can was a clone pilot who served the Republic Navy's Gold Squadron during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Dandy was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, Dandy was one of the troopers from Torrent Company to serve alongside Captain Rex during the Battle of Lanteeb.

This individual was a male Imbat who worked as a bartender in the Splendor Tavern on the planet Coruscant. Sometime in 43 BBY, Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi went to the Splendor Tavern looking for Helb, a broker for the criminal group Tech Raiders.

Dragob was a male Sedrian from the planet Sedri alive during the Galactic Civil War. During the Sedri civil war he chose to side with the bishop of war Karak and his renegades in which he served as Karak's bodyguard.

This individual was a female Togorian and the innkeeper of the Soft Landings Inn, an inn on the planet Coruscant. In 43 BBY, Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi went to the Soft Landings Inn looking for the bounty hunter Ona Nobis.
Harba was a Human male miner who worked in the Damotit refinery, which processed the produce in the nearby mine, Damotite during the Clone Wars.
Ran Harva was a male Human from Chandrila who served with Senator Mon Mothma of the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars. He was the younger of her two co-Senators for the Bormea sector.

Markl was a Human male and cousin of Yavid who lived on Lanteeb during the Clone Wars. Sometime before the war, he and his cousin left the planet and eventually found work on Alderaan, where they stopped in forestry.

Yavid was a Human male and cousin of Markl who lived on Lanteeb during the Clone Wars. Sometime before the war, he and his cousin left the planet and eventually found work on Alderaan, where they worked in forestry.

Poolin was a female who lived in Torbel, a village on the planet Lanteeb during the Clone Wars. She was given a comlink after Jacklin and Devi convinced Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to provide shelter for the villagers.
Rontl was a Human male miner who worked in the Damotit refinery, which processed the produce in the nearby mine, Damotite during the Clone Wars.

Ryfus was a Human male miner who worked with the Damotit on the planet Lanteeb during the Clone Wars. When Lanteeb was invaded by the Separatists led by General Lok Durd, Ryfus was attacked by Mosquito droids and injured.

Sandcat was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 21 BBY, he became a member of Gold Squadron under the command of Jedi General Anakin Skywalker during the Battle of Lanteeb.
Yancy was a female Human Miner who lived in the village of Torbel during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Usma was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War with the resurgent Sith Empire, and was widely acknowledged as one of the Order's most famous duelists at the time.
A Force-sensitive was the Padawan of the Jedi Master Usma during the final years of the Great Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
A Zeltron ran a brewery on the planet Clendor.

Jex was a Human male Mantellian Separatist during the Separatist War against the Galactic Republic, which was backing the Ord Mantell Central Authority. He was stationed in the Separatist Base on Mannett Point when a sergeant of Havoc Squad infiltrated the base.

Grannin was a Human male Mantellian Separatist during the Separatist War against the Galactic Republic, which was backing the Mantellian Government. He was stationed in the Separatist Base on Mannett Point when a promising Republic trooper infiltrated the base.
Dalern was a Human male Mantellian Separatist Officer during the Separatist War against the Galactic Republic, which was backing the Ord Mantell Central Authority.
Vyru was a Human male who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Bol was a Human male Mantellian Separatist Commander during the Ord Mantell civil war against the Galactic Republic, which was backing the Mantellian Government. He was stationed in the Separatist Base on Mannett Point when a promising Republic trooper infiltrated the base.
Saphrro was a Human male who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Bane Werth was a Human male Imperial lieutenant. He served as the assistant of Dark Jedi Jaalib Brandl at the time of the evacuation of Garos IV.
Gele'ren was a male Twi'lek slaver and underboss in the Hutt Cartel on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.

Domoru Krev was a male Sith warlord who lived at some point before the end of the Hundred-Year Darkness. The armored soldiers who served Lord Krev were known to wear lanvarok gauntlets on their left arms.
Sedyn Kyne was a male Human Mandalorian bounty hunter who lived during the Cold War.
Injaye was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Jaller was a Lethan Twi'lek female Mantellian Separatist who lived during the Cold War, as well as the Separatist War between Ord Mantell and the Galactic Republic, which was backing the government of Ord Mantell. She resided in Oradam village with her husband, Zak.
Zak was a Human male Mantellian Separatist during the Cold War and Separatist War against the Galactic Republic, which was backing the Mantellian Government.

This Republic technician was stationed in Fort Garnik on Ord Mantell during the Separatist War in 3643 BBY. He alerted Lieutenant Aric Jorgan to Havoc Squad's disappearance during their infiltration in the Separatist Base.
Brrik was a male Jawa who worked on the Shock Drum superweapon under the supervision of the scientist Hare'en on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War.

A male Human contractor specialized in magnetic containment vessels. In 1 BBY, he was aboard the civilian transport vessel Nordieus en route to the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station while it was under construction at the planet Despayre.

Mojyn was the daughter of Brandeh and lived on Lanteeb during the Clone Wars. Her mother was killed during the Battle of Lanteeb when Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker were on the planet to try and stop Separatist General Lok Durd.
Arrad was a Human male miner who is the son of Rikkard and lived on the planet Lanteeb during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Brinnie was a Human male miner who lived in the village of Torbel on the planet of Lanteeb during the Clone Wars.

Dahm was a Human male miner who lived on the planet Lanteeb during the Clone Wars. As the planet was invaded by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Dahm suffered a terrible illness from the toxic gases that were unleashed by the Separatist's bioweapon.
Teiki was a Human male miner who lived on the planet Lanteeb during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Javis Koldor was a male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War, Cold War, and Galactic War.
Chiba was a female Human who lived on the planet Lanteeb during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict between the Republic and the Separatists.
Devi was a female villager who was a miner until she was injured. During the Clone Wars, she worked at the power plant in the village of Torbel on the planet Lanteeb.

Leilana was a female Phindian and the lover of Jayn, a mercenary during the Galactic Civil War. Leilana tried to persuade Jayn to retire from mercenary work and to settle with her on the planet Phindar, but Jayn kept putting the idea off until he finished the next job.
Sufi was a female Human nurse who lived on Lanteeb during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
This individual was a male Sorrusian mercenary pilot during the Galactic Civil War. He was among the many pilots who answered the summons of X-7, an Imperial assassin, for a high paying job.

Kaliska was a Force-sensitive female S'kytri and a member of the Doomed on the planet of Kesh. The Doomed were a community of Force-sensitive individuals who were descended from ancient Dark Jedi and Jedi who had become stranded on the planet Kesh following the Hundred-Year Da…

Nikoll was a Male Human who served the Lost Tribe of Sith as a High Lord, soon after The Time of the Rot. During the preparation for Nikoll's wedding in Tahv, all the Keshiri local cake preparators were attacked by the Sith anarchist Parlan Spinner.
A male member of the Voss species served as the Emperor's Voice, the host of the Sith Emperor's essence, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Koval Renge was a male Sith Lord of Human or Sith pureblood descent who served the Sith Emperor of the reconstituted Empire as his Sith Executioner.

Nezhel "Sunspot" Othren was a Republic ace pilot during the Great Galactic War. In the Cold War he commanded a Starfighters squadron and during a skirmish over Saleucami he was shot down by a member of the elite Imperial Empire's Fury Starfighters squadron.
A Trandoshan was piloting an airspeeder on the planet Coruscant sometime in 0 ABY. His airspeeder was almost rammed by another speeder piloted by X-7, an Imperial assassin.
Laeras-Wu was a male Voss who lived on the planet of the same name well before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Shanatka-Lo was a female Voss who lived on the planet of the same name well before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Hanar-Ye was a male Voss who lived on the planet of the same name well before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Phraken-Nal was a male Voss commander who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Rikdine was a Human male captain in the Republic Military who fought in the Battle of Corellia during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Magremme Tharkus was a Human female whose company on Corellia served as one of the chief suppliers for the Republic's war efforts during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire.

Moloch Hoole was a male Shi'ido, a species from planet Lao-mon. He married the Human female Beryl, an aunt to the Alderaanian children Tash and Zak Arranda. His brother Mammon Hoole became an acclaimed scientist during the reign of the Galactic Emperor Palpatine.
Jol Zackin was a Human male who served as the Galactic Republic senator of the planet Corellia during the latter years of the Cold War between the Republic and the Sith Empire.
Brint was a Human male colonel who served in the Galactic Republic's military on the planet Corellia during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire.
Goril Sevintran was an Advozse male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.

During the Great Galactic War, at the Battle of Rhen Var, an Imperial commander served under the Sith Lord Darth Mekhis. The commander was entrusted with utilizing Mekhis's experimental weapons technology.

This assassin was a male Human. In 44 ABY, he, along with two other assassins, tried to kill Wraith Squadron leader Garik Loran. However, as this assassin watched from his airspeeder, Loran killed the other two assassins before returning to his own airspeeder.

An assassin was a male Aqualish. In 44 ABY, he, along with two other assassins, tried to kill Wraith Squadron leader Garik Loran at a pedestrian market on the planet Coruscant. However, Loran killed him instead.

This assassin was a male Sullustan. In 44 ABY, he and two other assassins, tried to kill Wraith Squadron leader Garik Loran at a pedestrian market on the planet Coruscant. However, Loran killed the Sullustan assassin instead by stabbing him with a vibroblade.
Cerik was a Human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War and later the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Shaythin was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was stationed on Taris under the command of Darth Gravus to help stop the Taris Resettlement Initiative. Usually, Shaythin served as field commander of the Sith troops on the planet.

Taymor was a Human female Sith of the Lost Tribe of Sith who served as the thoughtcrier aboard the Candra. She had the ability to project thoughts through the Force. Taymor was a dark-skinned woman who was in her early twenties.

Peppin was a Human female Sith of the Lost Tribe of Sith who served as the uvak-tender and pilot of the Candra during the High Lord Edell Vrai's mission to Alanciar in 2975 BBY. Peppin was known to have auburn hair and served as Edell's lieutenant.
Ulbrick was a young Human male and Sith Saber of the Lost Tribe of Sith who served as a warrior aboard the Candra during High Lord Edell Vrai's reconnaissance mission to Alanciar in 2975 BBY.

Janns was a Human Sith Saber of the Lost Tribe of Sith who served as a warrior aboard the Candra during High Lord Edell Vrai's reconnaissance mission to Alanciar in 2975 BBY. He survived an attack by the Alanciari air force which destroyed the Candra.

A clone trooper was part of a mission to Oznek circa 22 BBY, under the command of Clone Sergeant Banks. After crashing their LAAT/i gunship, the clone troopers were forced to camp in the planet's jungles.
This patrol leader was a male Toma soldier.
This individual was a member of the Yuvernian species. It was present on Fornax Station, observing the Five Fire Rings of Fornax, sometime between 2 BBY and 1 BBY.

Varos was a male Human Sith Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was stationed at the Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison in the Clabburn Tundra region on planet Hoth. He asked a Sith individual to take care of his old master Ranor.
Brother Extok Evin was a male Sullustan pilot trainer for the Rebel Alliance Vortex Squadron who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Vornest Dep-thesel Digarsarg was a male Balinaka sculptor. He was the first to incorporate fragments of gemstones and colored pumice in his ice sculptures, creating what he called the "Crystal of the Stars." This led to the creation of the famed Garnib crystals, and indirectly…

Reyal was a Human male Ensign of the reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Navy during the Cold War between the Empire and Galactic Republic. He was stationed aboard Adamas Space Station, orbiting the planet of Hoth.

A Human male served as a pilot of the navy of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was stationed aboard Adamas Space Station, which orbited the planet Hoth. Around 3642 BBY, he carried several Imperial travelers to Dorn Base on the planet's surface.
Known by his core name, Captain Yudrass was a Chiss male Officer of the Sith Empire, stationed on Hoth during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

Yed'ore'shenai, core name Doresh, was a Chiss male lieutenant in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force stationed at the Sith Empire's Dorn Base on Hoth during the renewed war with the Galactic Republic.
Zarik was a Human male soldier of the Imperial Army during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. He was stationed in Hoth, selling weaponry in Dorn Base.
Miel Muwn was a male Sullustan Peace Officer working for the Sullustan Constable Brigade at the time of the Cold War. He had achieved an Indigo rating for his performance as an investigator.

Vannis was a Human male colonel of the reconstituted Sith Empire, stationed on Hoth during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. He was the commander of Dorn Base and at some point, ventured into the Icefall Plains with a trooper party, going missing soon after.

Milinae Untaire was a female Human Corellian smuggler, who lived during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. Milinae was the identical twin sister of Trilinae Untaire, who, unlike Milinae, was Force-sensitive and joined the Jedi Order.
During the Great Galactic War, a Human male served as a commander in the reconstituted Sith Empire's military.
During the Great Galactic War, a Human male served as a major in the Sith Empire's military.
M'rch was a male Zygerrian colonel and a deserter during the Clone Wars.

Chakham was a male General of the Galactic Alliance Army. When Stavin Thaal defected from the Galactic Empire to the New Republic, Chakham was one of his supporters. A military base on the planet Kuratooine was named after the general.

Tytonus was a female Human Sith Lord during the Great Galactic War era. Sometime before 3643 BBY, Tytonus seceded from the Sith Empire and forged a kingdom of her own on the ancient Sith world of Begeren.

This individual was a male Human and the husband of Vula Nelprin, a hand-to-hand combat instructor for the New Republic. They had a son named Wran Narcassan, who went on to become a sniper for Wraith Squadron, a Galactic Alliance commando unit.

An unidentified cook worked for the Whiphid crime boss known as Lady Valarian at the time of the Galactic Civil War. After Valarian killed her husband D'Wopp in 0 BBY, the body was shipped to planet Toola in a box, with several parts missing.

During the Republic Dark Age, the Human Jedi Knight Kerra Holt had a young sibling in her family. The child was the younger offspring of the skin diver Aron Holt and his wife Mercia, both of them University of Sanbra researchers who had been working on a project searching for …
Mortar was a clone snowtrooper serving in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Zeed Venom was a Guild-sponsored bounty hunter. Venom traveled to Ord Mynock Freeport to collect a bounty. The bounty hunter wore specialized armor.
Norena Chakham was a female general of the Galactic Alliance Army and the daughter of General Chakham.

Galathos was a male Human Sith Lord of the Lost Tribe of Sith who lived during the Hilts Restoration. In 2974 BBY, he was in charge of the city of Eorm in southern Keshtah, which was home to many Sith slaves who had been expelled from the Tribe and condemned to generational sl…
Aves was a male Human general of the Republic Army and the leader of the Republic's military efforts on Corellia during the fighting on Corellia during the Galactic War.
Shai was a male Human admiral of the Republic Navy and one of the commanders of the Republic's military efforts on Ilum during the fighting during the Galactic War.

Zika was a male bounty hunter who lived during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Around 20 BBY, Zika spent two days on Paklan following Darth Maul and Savage Opress to a diner.

Toomey was a male Human on the planet Paklan during the Clone Wars. Around 20 BBY, Toomey was present outside a diner with a band of bounty hunters to assist him in capturing Darth Maul and Savage Opress, who took refuge on the planet.
Kellov was a Human male sergeant of the Mandalorian terrorist group Death Watch who was killed by a Jedi Knight during the Skirmish on Carlac.
Teguar was a Rodian sat at Akim's Munch when Jar Jar Binks attempted to consume a Gorg from the Swokes Swokes Gorgmonger Gragra. Teguar was known as a regulator for various deals.

A male officer with the rank of lieutenant was stationed at the Imperial garrison on the planet Belazura. In 0 ABY, the lieutenant was ordered by Darth Vader to detain Rezi Soresh, the highest commanding officer on the planet.

Chegg was a male Keshiri who served as captain of the Southern Star which was sent by the Lost Tribe of Sith government in Tahv on an exploratory mission to the polar continent of Eshkrene in 2974 BBY.
According to one account, a young Human female served as the Emperor's Voice at some point between 3950 BBY and several years before 3640 BBY.

A Sith male lived in the territory of the Sith Empire sometime during the time period between 3950 BBY and the end of the Great Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. Near the end of his life, the man was utilized by the Sith Emperor as his Voice.
A Human was used by the Sith Emperor as his Voice during the early years of the Great Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

A male Sanyassan with long black hair once assaulted the crew of a StarSpeeder 3000 transport of the Star Tours travel agency. Along with a fellow criminal of the same species, he entered a hangar on Endor, where the Star Tours spacecraft had landed.

Sarge was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Sarge served under Jedi Commander Ahsoka Tano and Clone Captain Rex and alongside Gunner during a battle on Zeenada.
A male singer was the lead vocalist of an all-Human band in the early years of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, that singer's band was popular on planet Kashyyyk, the homeworld of the Wookiees.
A male keyboardist was part of a band with six fellow Humans in the early stages of the Galactic Civil War. Around 1 ABY, the band enjoyed great popularity on Kashyyyk, the Wookiee homeworld.

A stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire was part of an Imperial entourage that searched homes on the planet Kashyyyk during the Wookiee holiday of Life Day in 1 ABY. Searching for ties to the Rebel Alliance, the Empire blockaded the world and declared martial law.

A young Twi'lek girl lived on the planet Ryloth during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, when the Confederacy of Independent Systems invaded her planet, she survived the slaughter carried out against many of her people, and took up residence with Cham Syndulla and his freedom fighter…
Cal Falcone was the Prime Minister of the Corellian Council during the early days of the renewed Great Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Noq Welflet was a male Human Captain who led his troops in battle among the warring tribes of Haariden during the time of the Separatist Crisis.
Fort Turan was a Human male scientist, a space geologist with an "ample body," who lived in the years before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

A Dulok served as the sidekick of the Dulok shaman Umwak and participated in a raid on the Ewok settlement of Bright Tree Village in 3 ABY. Accompanying Dulok King Gorneesh and Umwak, they hoped to steal soap to protect themselves from bugs.
Moritt was a Human male agent of the Republic Strategic Information Service stationed on the orbital station above Belsavis during the Galactic War.

Harlon Fane was a Human male, a savvy corporate tycoon who served as Chairman of the Corellian Corporate Council on Corellia during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Shrona Bel-Il was a Selonian female warrior living on Corellia during the Cold War and the Galactic War.
Halloway was a female Human who worked for the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.

Lachei was a female Selonian scout who worked with the civilian resistance on Corellia during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Lorant was a female Human captain in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire and a member of a black ops team headed by Lieutenant Pierce during the Galactic War.

Exteen was a Zabrak Jedi Knight who served both the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi starfighter pilot and later as an officer in the Republic Navy during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Velash was a female Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire who served in the Battle of Corellia against the Galactic Republic.
Darth Aruk was a Dark Lord of the Sith and member of the reconstituted Sith Empire's Dark Council during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.

Tarandon was a male Human Moff of the reconstituted Sith Empire who served as an advisor to the Sith Lord Darth Decimus during the Battle of Corellia during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
A Human female was among the many rebels who lived on Onderon during the Clone Wars when the Onderon king affiliated with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Krau was a Human male general of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War under the Sith Lord Darth Tormen. Krau was sent by Tormen with his troops to Corellia to help with the battle there, and collaborated with the Tormen's hunter on several missions.
Raddus Venn was a Chagrian male officer of the Corellian Security Force (CorSec) at the time of the Galactic War.

Vorel was a Human female commander of the Imperial Guard of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War stationed on Belsavis. Vorel tasked an Imperial spacer to recover the construction plans of the Tomb with hopes of creating a lookalike space station.
Watcher X, formerly codenamed Watcher Five and codenamed Minder Eight before that, was a Human male operative of Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire.

Jastal was a Human male commander of the Imperial Guard of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. At the Battle of Corellia, Jastal was tasked by Darth Charnus to retrieve the Hull Cracker weapon from the Czerka Corporation.
Darth Zavakon was a male Dark Lord of the Sith of Human or Sith pureblood descent who served as one of the first members of the Sith Empire's ruling Dark Council.

Darth Victun was a Dark Lord of the Sith of Human or Sith pureblood descent and member of the reconstituted Sith Empire's ruling Dark Council around 4043 BBY.
Darth Qalar was a Dark Lord of the Sith of Human or Sith pureblood descent and member of the reconstituted Sith Empire's ruling Dark Council around 4043 BBY.
Darth Nostrem was a Sith Lord of Human or Sith pureblood descent of the resurgent Empire who lived several decades before the Dark Jedi Exar Kun initiated the conflict known as the Great Sith War.

Tasiele Shan was a Human female descendant of the legendary Jedi Revan and Bastila Shan. She served as a Jedi Knight in the century before the Great Galactic War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, and bore a daughter that she named Satele in 3699 BBY on th…

Lyt Re was a female Twi'lek who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Around the time of the Battle of Naboo, Re conspired with the Duros gambler Kelna Toodo to help deceive a group of individuals into acquiring the Barzo cargo freighter Radiant Splendor.
Vira was a female Human from Acherin who was the sister of Alder. She was killed in a civil war during the formation of the Galactic Empire.
Joron Tal'vor was a male captain in the Republic Navy during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Moap was a male Kitonak crime broker who operated on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Moap worked from some of the world's various shady bars, and he also maintained a small office in the mid-levels of the moon's cityscape.
Doronnar was a male Kubaz who served as the lieutenant of the Nar Shaddaa-based Hutt crime lord Moska.
An Ithorian met six crew members of the Far Orbit in the Lean Nuuti Bar and Grill at StarForge Station to discuss it becoming a privateering vessel for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Rymar Quinn was a Human male who served as a colonel of the reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Military during the Great Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Jorkatt, known as Jorkatt the Render, was a Nalroni male crime lord with base of operations on the planet of Celanon. He was known throughout the galaxy as a despicable and devious felon.
Julept was a male Sullustan who often visited Farrimmer Cafe to swap stories and sell scraps of technology he had acquired previously.
Nills was a male individual who served the Galactic Empire as a crew member of a Golan I space station that orbited the planet Poln Major.

Bron Dooku (formally styled as His Grace, Bron Dooku, Count of Serenno) was a Human male member of House Dooku and the son of Adan and Maite Dooku, and the grand-nephew of the infamous Count Dooku.

A unnamed Onderon rebel lived on Onderon during the Clone Wars but when Sanjay Rash affiliated with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, this individual joined the Onderon rebels to recapture the planet.

A Human male individual lived on Onderon during the Clone Wars during the period when King Sanjay Rash affiliated the planet with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. When the Onderon rebels struck in Iziz and destroyed the city power generator, they won this man's support.
A male Human Melida from the planet Melida/Daan was the older brother of Cerasi, one of the leaders of The Young.

Adan Dooku was a male Human who served as count of House Dooku. When his father died, Adan was too young to become Count so his mother became the regent of the House Dooku.

Missa was a female individual who served as the lady-in-waiting of the noblewoman Lady Kalena. During the Galactic Civil War, Kalena and Missa were traveling aboard the corvette Indupar Nova when the vessel was boarded in the Ec Pand system by Rebel privateers, and Kalena and …
Mistik Arka was a Quarren technician who served aboard the Rebel privateer vessel Free Lance during the Galactic Civil War.

Kett was a male Corellian who served as a sensor operator aboard the Rebel privateer vessel Free Lance during the Galactic Civil War. At some point during the conflict, Kett monitored the ship's sensors during an attack on the corvette Indupar Nova in the Ec Pand system.

At some point prior to the Battle of Yavin, a Tusken Raider on the planet Tatooine mourned over the loss of a dying elder by singing a melancholy, dreamy song. The scene was witnessed surreptitiously by the moisture farmer Wenny Boggs.

Mikos Argdran was a male Human who operated as an information broker during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Jurfel was a male Verpine elder who was the Speaker of his hive. He openly rejected Bane Nothos' order to submit or die during Nothos' attempt to take over the Shantipole Project.

Xim'tahal, better known as Xim'tahal the Defaced, was a Kaleesh warlord who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

A male Codru-Ji, the father of Tassa led a clan on Munto Codru. Tassa fell in love with Rikkar-Du, a captive from a rival clan, eventually marrying and uniting the clans. Tassa's father supported Rikkar-Du following the union.

This individual was present on Kalandis Seven when Colonel Jace Malcom attacked an Imperial ship single-handedly. Jace encountered this Sith on the bridge and immediately began firing at her, to which she gracefully evaded his fire.

Saltern was a male individual who served the Galactic Empire as a guard aboard the Imperial prison barge Purge.
Buroy was a male Corellian who served as an agent of Corellian Intelligence during the time of the Second Corellian Crisis.

Trevayne was an individual who was a member of the family of the Sith Lord Vilia Calimondra. In 1032 BBY, Calimondra's grandson Odion seized control of the Helm of Ieldis, a powerful Sith artifact that he planned to use to eliminate his rival Sith Lords.

Jeeree Kayl was a Duros male who lived in the Odionate Sith state during the Republic Dark Age. As a child, Kayl was separated from his parents and sent to live in isolation inside a bubble dome in a facility on the moon Vanahame, where all children in the Odionate were sent t…

Pich was an Imperial aide for Advisor Coh Veshiv in 0 ABY, at the time that Veshiv was on an inspection tour of the planet Esseles.
Numen Brock was a Twi'lek male smuggler who became a Galactic Republic privateer during the Galactic War. He was given the rank of Commander and was working with the Balmorran resistance on Balmorra
Sibar was a male Zabrak and a captain in the Zabrak Army of Iridonia.

Kaplan was a male Journeyman Protector of Concord Dawn.

Trahg was a Human male who served as a Commander in the Imperial Guard during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Dabrin was a Human male admiral of the Republic Navy during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Sith Empire.

Matlo was an Imperial worker who operated out of the Warren, an Imperial Research Facility on the planet Dantooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
A Voss male was the husband of the Voss Tala-Reh and a member of his species' commandos before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The Gungan nicknamed "Yellow" was a member of the Gungan Sling Brigade. He owed his moniker to his yellow uniform and the red paint balls he would throw with his sling.
Oobolo was a male Gran criminal who was captain of the freighter Galactic Princess. He ran a gambling hall on board the Princess as a cover for his operation.
Seta-Le was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who visited the Jedi holy world of Ilum sometime before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
A Sith Pureblood served as the commander of the Sith Empire's battle cruiser Eclipse during the Battle of Corellia and died defending the vessel from the Jedi Knight known as the Hero of Tython.
Avers was a male Human member of the Balmorran resistance during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Nikollan Kord was a male Human who was a high-ranking member of the Balmorran resistance during the Galactic War and the occupation of Balmorra by the resurgent Sith Empire.

An ancient terentatek was imprisoned within Vault S-31 on the Rakatan prison planet of Belsavis during the reign of the Infinite Empire.

Gantrell was a male Human scientist who worked on Belsavis during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Remmy was a Human male engineer who was employed in the Balmorran Arms Factory during the Sith Empire's occupation of Balmorra. Remmy had worked with the combat medic Doc before his capture, and was more than willing to help Doc and a Jedi Knight break into the factory.
Bedd was a male Duros sergeant in the Republic Military during the renewed war with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Erris Wyum was a Human male Corellian who worked as an agent for Corellian Intelligence during the Battle of Corellia between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Guardian of the Inner Sanctum was a male Voss Commando who was part of the Shrine of Healing's guard detail during the Cold War. He was stationed at the door to the inner sanctum of the shrine.

Talan-De was a male Voss from the planet Voss. He aided the Voss commandos stationed at the Shad-Ka Outpost and also aided the visitors to the Nightmare Lands in performing the guarding rituals created by the Voss Mystic Ki-Da that were necessary to protect one from the region…
Graal was a male Human who served as the Assistant Warden of the Republic prison complex on the planet Belsavis during the Galactic War.

Eedan was a captain in the Ordnance and Supply division of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Following the Imperial occupation of Bespin, he was charged with finding a new source of tibanna gas.

In 32 BBY, a male Human served as the Tourist Director of the Tourist Center on Coruscant. That year, Queen Amidala of Naboo and her bodyguard, Captain Quarsh Panaka demanded that the Tourist Director allowed them to access to the company comlinks.
A Tiss'shar was present on Tiss'sharl in 0 ABY. The Tiss'shar kept tabs on President Si-Di-Ri for Darth Vader.
Darrus Alde was a Human male who served as the head of House Alde on the planet Alderaan, centuries after the planet was colonized by Humans around 27,500 BBY.
A male individual served as a crewman aboard the Rebel Alliance GR-75 medium transport Luminous during the Galactic Civil War.

A male individual and the Human Chandrilan Senator Mon Mothma of the Mothma family had a Human son named Jobin. Jobin became a corporal in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, an organization Mothma had founded.

Chelah, was a male Selkath doctor that lived during the Cold War. He was the private medic of the crime lord Nok Drayen. When Drayen was poisoned by his enemies with a unknown substance, Chelah froze him in carbonite to stop the progression of the disease.

Zerba Cher'dak was a male Balosar pickpocket who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 0 ABY, Cher'dak became part of a group of criminals that were gathered together by the smuggler Han Solo to steal the riches of the Black Sun official Avrak Villachor on the plan…

Durik Vesh was a male Human Sith who served the resurgent Sith Empire and was stationed on the planet Voss. He tried to discover the secrets of the Nightmare Lands but went mad and was later captured by agents of the Republic Strategic Information Service.
Custo Ramak was a famous Corellian author who died many years before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Madel Felth was a female Human who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War as an agent of Imperial Intelligence. For part of the war she was stationed on the planet of Nar Shaddaa. She tasked a fellow Imperial with eliminating a Gen'Dai called The Flame.
Veld was a Male Human who served the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was an agent of Imperial Intelligence and at one point in the war served on the planet Balmorra.

Zarkos was a male Duros who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He served in the Republic Army as a major.
Herron was a Human male who served as a sergeant in the Republic Army during the Battle of Corellia against the Sith Empire in 3640 BBY.
Yung was a Human male soldier in the Republic Army during the Battle of Corellia against the Sith Empire in 3640 BBY.

K'Vorn was a Human merchant who lived on the planet Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. A brown haired Human male with brown eyes, he was one of many of his species who settled on Taris.

Roovo was a Rodian merchant who lived on the planet Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Wilkin was a Cathar merchant who lived on the planet Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. A brown-spotted Cathar male with brownish-orange fur and orange eyes, he was one of many of his species who settled on Taris.

This Mandalorian was a male member of Clan Spar during the Cold War. He, along with Akaavi Spar were the last members of the clan. He was captured and executed by the Sith Empire in Balmorra around 3642 BBY, leaving Akaavi as the sole survivor of the clan.
A Skakoan male was a Techno Union representative during the Clone Wars.
Welkins was a Human male who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Wicke was a male Human who served as a soldier in the army of the resurgent Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War in 3642 BBY.

Tyrak, codename Golden by the Republic Strategic Information Service, was a Human male who held the rank of a Moff in the army and commander of the Sixty-third Armored Infantry Division of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.

Andren Biel was a male Human from the planet Coruscant who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Biel was an Imperial citizen and he trained as an actor at various schools throughout the Core Worlds.

Erial was a purple-skinned, black-eyed, tame convor with purple and gray feathers. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the bird was offered for sale in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant as a pet, by the vendor d…
Cinch was an Anacondan male that lived at the time of the Clone Wars. Cinch was adopted as a pet. However, he was a sentient being.
Valon was a Human male pirate who joined the White Maw during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

A male Dulok hunter joined a hunting party to capture wild maramus on the Forest Moon of Endor at the behest of his King, Gorneesh. The Dulok and his fellows were ambushed and forced to flee by an entity known to them as the Red Ghost—in reality, the wild Ewok Asha.
Addy Ingrol was a Human male who worked as a Doctor during the renewed conflict between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Asirr was a Human female who worked as a doctor during the renewed conflict between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Evran was a Human male senator who served in the Galactic Senate of the Republic and was a close personal friend of Supreme Chancellor Dorian Janarus during the Great Galactic War.

A Human male technician was a member of the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders during the Mandalorian Wars. In 3962 BBY, he was among the forces assigned by the Mandalore the Ultimate to the rogue Jedi Master Dorjander Kace.
Chanya Medaal was a Human female member of Alderaan's Order of Extermination living during the Cold War.

A hairless male Sanyassan once entered a hangar on Endor, where a StarSpeeder 3000 transport from the Star Tours company had landed. With the help of a fellow Sanyassan, the criminal assaulted the crewmen of the shuttle.

Blancia Sel was a female Twi'lek smuggler who was active during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. She was present on Belsavis during the Invasion of Belsavis and was wearing a prisoner's uniform.

Brinton was a Human male citizen of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. Stationed on Hoth during 3642 BBY, he worked as a cantina vendor and sold drinks inside Aurek Base Command Bunker.
Calia was a Twi'lek female lieutenant of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Carina was a Twi'lek female who worked for the Galactic Republic's Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War.

Carsiri was a Human male doctor who lived during the Galactic War. On Balmorra, he was forced into working on the Barrager weapon for the reconstituted Sith Empire, but defected to the Galactic Republic at first opportunity.
Veek was a Jawa male who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he tasked a Republic hero to test out his new modified ion gun on some nearby droids.

Agent Protarius was a male Twi'lek who served the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War. Stationed on Balmorra, he tasked a Republic spacer to track down and eliminate the merciless Sith Lord Dakron who had recently landed on the planet.

Dakron was a Human male Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was responsible for the Krikthasi Massacre. Dakron was killed during the Battle of Balmorra by a Republic spacer who was sent by SIS Agent Protarius to eliminate him.

Dolso was a Kel Dor male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War. Stationed on Alderaan, he was visited by a Republic spacer who was able to retrieve a stolen holocron from House Thul.
Hovus Jorrick was a male Klatooinian who served as Chief of Security for Count Rodas Borgin during the Imperial era.
Rinnas Edu was a male Human moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Raith Bannik was a Human male thief who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He tasked a Republic spacer to rescue his loved ones from the offworld pirates who have kidnapped them.
Neiya Chault was a Force-sensitive Human female supporter of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Thoma was a Human male Padawan who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. Stationed on Nar Shaddaa, he went on a mission to investigate alien mercenaries that have trained themselves to join the Empire.

Maya Drin was a Human female who served the Galactic Republic on Hoth, during the start of the renewed war with the Sith Empire. She informed a Republic spacer that Bala D'ur pirates have taken Ortolans from their homes and turned them into slaves.

Mas Avaho was a Chagrian male agent who served the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War. Stationed on Nar Shaddaa, he informed Republic spacers about a shipment of Imperial Intelligence machines that were delivered for a Sith Lord.

Malcom Terrax was a Human male and one of the best agents of the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was assigned to Voss, to profile failed Voss Mystics so Sith Lord Beldiss could recruit them to the Sith ranks.

Lem Trudo was a Human male doctor who worked for the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. Living on Tatooine, he informed a Republic allied individual about an Imperial plot to poison a well in one of the Sand People's encampments.

Lem Karner was a Zabrak male who joined the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He assisted a Republic spacer in finding the Barrager and installing the Power Monitor in the Balmorran Arms Factory.
Cole Darba was a Human male member of the Citizens' Militia during the Cold War.
Dak Williks was a Human male who served the Citizens' Militia during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Grommik Kurthson was a Human male security officer for the Czerka Corporation that operated prior to the Cold War.
Jax Dumont was a Human male who served as a member of the Stardogs, a group of Republic veterans that fought against the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War.
TK-3207 was the designation of an Imperial stormtrooper who participated as the test subject in a weapons test procedure, carried out in Test Bay 94.

Kazzak Hurn was a Gamorrean male criminal who was the leader of the Fire-eaters that remained on Belsavis during the Galactic War. When the Sith Empire invaded Belsavis, Kazzak and the Fire-eaters were offered to work with the Empire and round up the other aliens.
"Deadeye" Dortho was a Human male who served as a weapons vendor in Mos Ila on Tatooine for the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Daru'da was a Twi'lek female scientist who worked in the Senate Tower on Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. During her work, she was visited by Ace who was sent by Momi Andrell to deliver the samples to her.

Reid Gandon was a Human male who worked as an agent for the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War. Stationed on Coruscant, he was working to identify the Justicars' Brigade's supplier. He believed the Empire was helping them, but needed proof.
Luran Gonthor was a Human male who served as a legitimate businessman in Coruscant during the Cold War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Craige Graf was a Human male Imperial Intelligence agent who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Ellis Ruger was a male Human Marshall who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. Stationed on Belsavis, he was killed by an Imperial that was sent to end his activities against the Empire.
Frun was a male Sith apprentice who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Ezra was a female Human who lived on the planet Nal Hutta with her husband Rand in their later life. Rand was employed at the Rust Yards, and the two lived in the nearby worker settlement.
Von Elzif was a Human male vendor who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Dorheek was a male Kubaz who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. During the war, he worked as a merchant on the planet Nal Hutta, the adopted homeworld of Hutt species.
Jiinan E'ron was a Human male who was an exiled Death's Claw pirate captain who lived on Taris during the time of the Cold War.

Fasha Teral-Organa, born Fasha Teral, was a Human female who was the daughter of Lord Teral and a member of House Teral, one of the Great Houses of Alderaan. During the Alderaan Civil War, she agreed to a marriage alliance with the powerful House Organa and married Lew Organa.
Hekton Valkaz was a male individual who served as a diplomat during the Cold War.

Kord Murdok was a Human male mercenary who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. Stationed on Taris, he led a mercenary company, the Blaster Brothers, across the Tularan Marsh until they were ambushed by nekghouls.

Cy Krolo was a Human male who worked for Nem'ro the Hutt during the Cold War. Stationed on Nal Hutta, he tasked an Imperial individual to head into Fa'athra's palace and activate a transmitter on a few cleaning droids so he could get information on the palace layout.
Kai Saddek was a Human male assassin who served House Rist during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Gann Sakoal was a Human male who served as the senior science officer at the Troida Military Workshop during the Cold War.

d'Ashewl was a male Human who worked as an agent for Imperial Intelligence. He had been inserted into the Imperial Court as a spy. In 0 ABY, he worked with Dayja to hunt a Vigo of the Black Sun, the Falleen Qazadi, on the planet Wukkar.

Lieutenant Romm was a Human male soldier of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. When Havoc Squad's new commander infiltrated the Justice to stop Commander Tavus, Romm was tasked with greeting new arrivals to the Justice.

A Gungan villager lived in the city of Otoh Sancture on the planet Naboo in 3000 BBY. At that time, a war was raging between the various Gungan tribes, but Otoh Sancture, under the leadership of Boss Gallo, remained neutral in the conflict.

A Gungan villager lived in the city of Otoh Raban on the planet Naboo in 3000 BBY. During a war between the Gungan tribes at that time, the villager witnessed the kidnapping of the city's leader, Boss Hoxie, by the Gungan warlord Rogoe.
Daksh was a Human male colonel who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He engaged a Republic strike team and was easily defeated.
Hildeborn was a male who served as the Commissioner of the Iltarr City police on the planet Wukkar. He was known to be good at his job despite taking bribes from Black Sun.

Dester was a Human male moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He tasked a Republic spacer to recover the water that was stolen from him by pirates.

Firehawk was a Kadas'sa'Nikto male Agent of the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY, Firehawk was stationed on Belsavis along with Mynock. However, his partner disappeared while he escaped with several Republic traitors.

Mynock was a male agent who served the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Galactic War. Stationed on Belsavis, he went on a secret undercover assignment until he was killed by several Republic traitors.
Aldogh was a male Ortolan who served as a supervisor of the Ortolan colony on Hoth during the Galactic War.
Big Jan was a female Rattataki who worked as a nurse and assistant to Doctor Hope during the Cold War.

Rona Riggs was a Human female living on Coruscant during the Cold War. She was born on Ord Mantell and was the cousin of Corso Riggs.
Bleb-Blek was a Jawa male who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Durren was a Twi'lek male Sergeant who served the Galactic Republic and a member of the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War.
Agent Essor was a Twi'lek female who served the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War, a conflict between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Private Falk was a Human male Soldier who served the Galactic Republic during the start of the Galactic War.

Feero was a Duros male who served as a Republic scout and a member of the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War. He tasked a Republic spacer to help him find probe droids that are trapped inside the contaminated ruins of Traken-4, an Imperial outpost.
Ferrus was a Human male who sold armor and weapon modifications in Farnel Outpost on the planet Balmorra during the Galactic War.
Forrod was a Twi'lek female who was a doctor and archaeologist of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.
Gadux was a Sullustan male merchant. Sometime in the year 3642 BBY, he was in Farnel Outpost, a Galactic Republic base in Bugtown, on the planet Balmorra, where he sold various items.
Guunta was a Twi'lek male who worked as a vendor on Balmorra during the Galactic War.
Sergeant Harrum was a Weequay male who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.
Hollis was a Human male lieutenant of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. He was stationed on Balmorra Orbital Station and directed incoming personnel to Farnel Outpost in Bugtown.

Nakassk was a male Selkath merchant who worked at Farnel Outpost on the planet Balmorra during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Nakassk ran a small shop near the outpost's entrance, where he sold handgear, gloves, handwraps and gauntlets.

During the Clone Wars, this trooper served as a Battalion Commander. He was led by a Jedi Knight and fought in several battles such as the Second Battle of Geonosis, Battle of Umbara, the Skirmish on Carlac, and the Battle of Felucia.

An officer served aboard the Imperial Navy's Far Orbit, and was reported to the Imperial Security Bureau after dissenting to Vocis Kenit's leadership of the frigate. The officer died mysteriously later.
This Je'daii lived on Tython 2,545 years after the Tho Yor arrival.

Phaeris was a Human female Corellian who worked as a smuggler during the Galactic War. She was one of the contacts of the Havoc Squad during the Battle of Corellia, leading a group of volunteer smugglers aiding the Republic.

Arkis Wode was a male Anomid who was leader of the Schism Collective that joined the Darth Malgus' New Empire during the Galactic War.
Sylas Wilkes was a Human male individual during the Cold War and held a high rank within the Tatooine Exchange.
Tove Weylan was a male Sergeant who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire. He was defeated by an Imperial strike team during Balmorra's liberation.

Maven Wedder was a male who was the head of the Lumenatus Club.

Astar Vox was a Human male mercenary during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. Astar fought for House Ulgo during the Alderaan Civil War and laid siege to House Teral's fortress until a Jedi Consular convinced him to change sides.
