Sulan was a male Nautolan Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the time of the Cold War and the renewed war between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
A male individual worked as a doctor during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

High Priest of the nation of Tresycht, Gellack was a male Saurton. Along with the help of the Messert Mines Corporation, Gellack took control of the planet Essowyn and organized what evolved into the Council of Elders.

Semphi Talen was a female living on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force with the police rank of lieutenant.

Kell Bircher was a male Human who was a Rebel spy and nephew of the Rebel leader, Mon Mothma. Following the Battle of Yavin, he used the skills of a Bothan slicer to enter his identity in the Imperial database as a colonel.
An officer was part of an Imperial Military force sent to capture the Galactic Republic's Adrenal Research Base on Quesh when the Sith Empire invaded the planet around 3642 BBY.
This individual was a Utai who, sometime before 0 BBY, worked for the Star Tours travel agency's ground crew. His job was to look after the passengers' luggage.
Ketrian Altronel was a Human female from the planet Hargeeva who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic, convinced by her former fiancée Stevan Makintay to join, during the Galactic Civil War.
Merak was a Human from the planet Alderaan who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Makintay was a Human male from the planet Hargeeva.
Tendis Ancum was a Human male who supported the Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Jioie Ancum was a Human female who supported the Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Shran Etison was a male Human who lived on the planet Tuttin IV. When the Galactic Empire took over the planet, Tendis Ancum and his wife, Jioie, left their son Ryley in the care of Shran while they left for Beltrix III.

Seffi was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as a Consular trainer during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Brohmer was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a combat instructor during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. A dark-skinned Human with green eyes and black hair, Brohmer wore brown and tan robes and carried a lightsaber.

Axis was an Anomid male who served as a supporter to the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. He infiltrated the Hutt Data Center of HoloNet on Nar Shaddaa in order to gain access to its information.
Ilm Vaz-Weplinn was an Assistant-Deputy Viceprex, and eventually Viceprex, of Security Division with the Corporate Sector Authority.
Breerdin was a Human male who served as an officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Intelligence agency during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.

Brundle was a Kadas'sa'Nikto male officer of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed at the Outpost Cresh on Hoth where he asked a fellow Republic citizen to retrieve supplies stolen by the White Maw pirates.
Cedarik Killesa was a Human male from the planet of Alderaan who served as a member of House Killesa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Chane was a Pureblood Sith female who served the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Chull was a male Human Doctor of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.

Major Damarus was a Human male who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Stationed on Nar Shaddaa, he allied with Kabbura the Hutt in order to maintain the integrity of the HoloNet in the Network Access sector.
DeMare was a Human male Lieutenant in the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic, during which he was stationed on Nar Shaddaa.
Eldo was a Zabrak male Major of the Galactic Republic stationed at the Farnel Outpost on Balmorra during the Galactic War.
Elios Maliss was a Human male Sith trooper who served the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Eliss Pim was a Human male individual who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War. Residing on Nar Shaddaa around 3643 BBY, he asked a fellow Imperial to crush the Nova Guard and Crimson Brotherhood mercenary gangs, which abandoned the Empire and went to work for the Galact…

Elsar was a Human male citizen of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3642 BBY he was stationed in Aurek Base on Hoth, where he sold item modifications.
Darb Misken was a male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi combat instructor during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Evonnus was a Twi'lek male who served as a light armor vendor in the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. He carried a blaster pistol and wore a green uniform.

Garel-Mo was a male Voss member of the Voss commandos during the Galactic War. He was posted at the Shrine of Healing, guarding the shrine's grounds where the Voss Mystics went to undergo their trials.
Glort was a Gamorrean male who served the Hutt Cartel during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Goonawaro was a male Ithorian Jedi who served the Jedi Order during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Halykus was a Human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Janner was a Human female who served as a Private in the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Kieral was a Human male lieutenant of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.
Kosh was a Human male Jedi Padawan of Master Bacara who served the Jedi Order during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Kolvin was a Human male general who served the Sith Empire as an officer of the Imperial Reclamation Service during the Cold War.

Narem was a Human male doctor who served the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was stationed at the Imperial fortress on Taral V, where he was studying an ancient Gree navigation computer that allowed the Empire to navigate The Maelstrom nebula.
Brad Narong was a Human male officer who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Natho was a Twi'lek male worker who joined the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Noch was a Rodian male who served in the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War and the civil war on Alderaan. Stationed at the House Traders' Circle in King's Pass, he was the partner of Agent Shyrack.

Obatt was a Duros male lieutenant who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. In the year 3643 BBY, he tasked a Republic hero to protect a House Organa field operative while he dismantled a Ulgo sensor in the area.
Kom Orda was a Human male commander and Field Cannoneer who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire.

Ozzik was a Human male smuggler, a captain of his own ship and a Galactic Republic privateer during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY his and Beryl Thorne's supply fleet got grounded on Quesh by the Voidwolf and Ozzik called a fellow privateer Voidhound for help.
Parren was a Nautolan female Doctor and Scientist who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Rassan was a male Duros doctor living during the Cold War. He used to be a chief scientist of the ChemFlex company. While on Nar Shaddaa, he warned a Galactic Republic citizen about an enemy attack on his lab, which was researching deadly biological weapons.
Surall was a Duros male constable who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Renishi was a Jawa male who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY, Renishi tasked a Republic-aligned spacer to help the Jawas take back their home from the Geonosians.
Sidirri was a Human female Jedi youngling who served the Jedi Order and escaped Order 66 with K'Kruhk and Chase Piru.
This unidentified youngling was a Human male Jedi youngling who escaped Order 66 with K'Kruhk and Chase Piru.
Nable was a Jedi youngling who escaped Order 66 with K'Kruhk and Chase Piru.
Onkya was a Mon Calamari Jedi youngling who served the Jedi Order and escaped Order 66 with K'Kruhk and Chase Piru.
A youngling was a Togorian Jedi youngling who escaped Order 66 with K'Kruhk and Chase Piru.

Genel was a Duros Jedi youngling who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars and was one of the survivors that escaped Order 66 with K'Kruhk and Chase Piru following the establishment of the Galactic Empire.
The mother of Garr was an Excargan who worked as an ore trader during the Clone Wars. When the Separatists attacked Excarga, she and Garr's father hid their child while they were made prisoners.
The father of Garr was an Excargan who worked as an ore trader during the Clone Wars. When the Separatists attacked Excarga, he and Garr's mother hid their child while they were made prisoners.

Uro Koo was a famous Force-sensitive Neti who was trained in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, attaining the rank of Jedi Master. Cuttings from Koo were used to plant a forest, which became known as Northward Park, on the planet Vaklin.
Derrik Reed was a male Human Private who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Kanzhei Opli was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic over seven hundred years after the Ruusan Reformations.
Zindati was a chief mystic Darga from the planet Zender.
Captain Nic'ala was a male Twi'lek who served as Commander of the Republic Special Forces Division during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Oniye Namada was a Human female who served as a major in the Imperial Security Bureau during the Great Jedi Purge. She played an important role in the resolution of the Vaklin insurgency in 19 BBY.
Refour was a Human male captain of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY, he was stationed on Alderaan.
Reicovis was a Human male residing on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War and working as a vendor of exclusive goods.
Letta was a female Twi'lek Smuggler who was allied with the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Ethen Remak was a Human male Commando who served as a Captain in the Mantellian Separatist Movement during the Separatist War against the Ord Mantell Central Authority on the planet Ord Mantell.
Gryffin Remus was a Human male who once served the Balmorran resistance until he joined the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Skohani Ren was a Togruta male who had joined the Jedi Order and attained the rank of Jedi Master by the time the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire began.

Lekern Renald was a male Human who served in Imperial Intelligence of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he served as a station chief in Sobrik on Balmorra, where he assisted Cipher Nine during the Operation: Blackout.
Jela Reneke was a female Cathar smuggler who was a right-hand agent for Rogun Matt'rik during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Revis was a Human male doctor of the Sith Empire who lived during the Cold War.
Korman Reyes was a Twi'lek male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Rhamm was a Human male who served as Foreman for Suudaa Nem'ro during the Cold War.

Rholl was a male Wookiee pirate who was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. According to Kaliyo Djannis, an ex-associate of Rholl, Rholl was a pirate with a bad temper who hijacked Galactic Republic supply ships.

Harman Rike was a male agent of the Republic Strategic Information Service who was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He was killed by an Imperial Intelligence sniper on Trandosha before Andronikos Revel could kill him himself.
Merritt Rineld was a male Count of Dubrillion who was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

This N-1 starfighter pilot was a member of the Rebel Alliance. During a battle with Vulture droids, the pilot and two others escorted a Star Tours travel agency vessel down through the atmosphere of Naboo where it could deliver a Rebel spy to a safe hangar.
Tooch was a pet Razort owned by Sedrian Karak. Karak had managed to tame Tooch and use him as a bodyguard despite the creature's vicious nature, and Tooch obeyed his master without question.
A Human served the Galactic Empire's as part of the Imperial Navy shortly after the Battle of Yavin.
A Human male worked as technician on the Redemption, a frigate of the Rebel Alliance Fleet.
Cardo was the male Sedrian High Priest of the Golden Sun from the planet Sedri. He had a son named Pek.
Dathis Elgin was a Human male who served as an Imperial advisor to House Thul during the Cold War.
Fizz Galko was a male Rodian Doctor who worked as a bioengineer for the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Taya Rinn was a Twi'lek female who was a member of the Balmorran resistance during the Galactic War. From the Moraine Outpost on Balmorra she tasked a Republic citizen with recovering sensitive resistance data that was stolen when the Imperials attacked a nearby base.
Karrus Vayl was a male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Empire who was brought over to the light side of the Force by the Jedi Master Cyman Walz and then inducted into the Jedi Order.

A Sullustan individual lived on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. At that time, the Sullustan served as a Scenes of Crimes Officer for the Coruscant Security Force's Forensics Unit.

An individual served as a police officer with the Imperial Sector Police with the police rank of Centurion. They were in charge of a unit of police officers who violently dispersed a group of students at the Imperial City University. The individual was arrested pending a trial.

Cyman Walz was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. Sometime during the war, he encountered a Sith Lord named Karrus Vayl and turned him to the light side.

A Human male officer who served the Crimson Empire in its final days. As the last Supreme Commander of the Imperial Fleet, he led the Crimson Empire defense of Ord Cantrell as both an admiral in the Imperial Navy and a general in the Imperial Army.
Riloh was a Human male bounty hunter who was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He had a cousin who worked for Black Sun.
Egara was a Human female bounty hunter who was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Scorch was a Human male bounty hunter who was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. His nickname "Scorch" came from his constant use of a flamethrower.
Crysta Markon was a Human female Bounty hunter who lived during the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Fala was the daughter of the Sedrian bishop of war, Karak.
A Human female was the mother of a son and daughter fathered by Davim Cross. The mother and her daughter died during the Battle of Coruscant.
Jens Cross was the Human female daughter of the Republic Ambassador Davim Cross and his wife and the young sister of Imperial Intelligence agent Jahan Cross.
Keta was a female Togorian member of the Cavrilhu Pirates. In 9 ABY, she served as First Mate aboard the Void Cutter.

An Ithorian bounty hunter joined a team of other bounty hunters that included Bossk, Zuckuss, and Furlag, among others, in attempting to steal the carbonite-frozen body of Han Solo away from Boba Fett in the Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave in 3.5 ABY.

The father of Jedi Knight Guun Han Saresh was a male Twi'lek. To commemorate his son's acceptance into the Jedi Order, he commissioned the creation of the powerful Circlet of Saresh, as a gift for Guun Han.

A Human male bounty hunter, along with a group of fellow hunters that included, among others, Bossk and Zuckuss, attempted to steal the carbonite-frozen body of Han Solo from Boba Fett while in the Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave in 3.5 ABY.

Iain Sarkus was a Twi'lek male and a young member of the Hawkeyes during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY, Iain was a reluctant agent of the Sith Empire until he defected to the Galactic Republic and helped the Resistance on Balmorra crack down the Imperial satellite defense system.
Field Agent Burne was a Human male SIS operative who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.
Corporal Ballala was a Human male corporal of the Galactic Republic stationed on Balmorra during the Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire. He sold weapons in Bugtown.

Druan was a Twi'lek male who joined the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire. He was part of the team that followed Tanno Vik, believing him to be on a mission for the Republic.

Drage was a Human male ethics officer who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. He was stationed at Fort Garnik on Ord Mantell as an ethics officer when an individual told him about the "minefield game".
Jhaffus was a Ithorian male merchant who served the Galactic Republic onboard Carrick Station during the Cold War.
Kellik was a Human male soldier who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Shian was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a combat instructor, during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. A Human male with blue eyes and dark skin who wore gray and white robes, Shian carried a single lightsaber.
N'var was a Twi'lek female who served as a speeder vendor in the Republic Operational Headquarters on Quesh. She wore white armor.
Nan-Dijer was a Human male who sold speeders in the vicinity of Castle Organa on Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War.
Plex was a Human male who served as a navigator for the Republic Wanderer-class transport, the Esseles during the Cold War.
Nehimmo was a Twi'lek male merchant who served the Galactic Republic onboard Carrick Station during the Cold War.
Odar was a Human male who lived on Ord Mantell during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Qo'el was a Human female and daughter of Odar who lived on the planet Ord Mantell during the Cold War.

Ot'ona was a female Twi'lek who held the rank of private within the Republic Army, serving on the planet Balmorra during the Galactic War. She distributed armor to other Republic forces at Farnel Outpost.
Prnthik was a Jawa male who worked as a stims vendor on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Security Coordinator Michyl was a Human female who served as a social items vendor on Belsavis during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She wore a tan uniform and had brown hair and green eyes.
Shamuillan was a Twi'lek male who lived on the planet Ord Mantell during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Sheed was a Bith male who joined the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War.
Shura was a Human female who served in the Mantellian Army of the Galactic Republic as an Ordnance officer during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Jalba was a Human male technician who served the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Prand was a Twi'lek male technician who served the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Trezin was a male Captain of the Galactic Republic who fought against the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Trix Skylan was a Human female smuggler who was present in Farnel Outpost, the Galactic Republic's base on the planet Balmorra during the Galactic War.
Trix-Tala was a Human female merchant on Balmorra during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Sergeant Vandal was a Human male soldier who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

"Fast" Vanush Thriin was a male Bith who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the war he worked as a speeder vendor in the city of Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine.
Vessex Ulgo was a Human male and Bouris Ulgo's son who served as a member of House Ulgo during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Witri was a Human male who worked as a stim vendor on Balmorra during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Baron Lorn was a Human male merchant who served the Sith Empire on-board Vaiken Spacedock during the Cold War.

Benna Lodd was a female Mandalorian bounty hunter during the Cold War and Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, where she could be found selling armor to other hunters on Vaiken Spacedock.

Flaz'arrir was a male Chiss residing aboard the Vaiken Spacedock during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, where he shared his knowledge of scavenging with others.
Jiv Trick-Shot was a male Rattataki who served the Sith Empire onboard Vaiken Spacedock.

Vekarr was a Human male who held the rank of lieutenant in the Imperial Military of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed on Balmorra and tasked with overseeing the Gorinth Brig prison.

Nongta was a Ithorian male Merchant who served the reconstituted Sith Empire on-board Vaiken Spacedock during the Cold War. He offered a selection of companion customizations and various other items to any Imperial individual.
Ardran was a Human male Overseer of the Sith Academy on Korriban during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Sathel was a Sith Pureblood female Overseer of the Sith Academy on Korriban during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Toth was a Human female Merchant who served the resurgent Sith Empire onboard Vaiken Spacedock during the Cold War.

A male Human Sith apprentice served Lord Vivicar during the Cold War. The Sith Apprentice assisted Vivicar in the Sith Lord's campaign to destroy the Jedi Order with the Dark Plague. The apprentice was defeated on Coruscant by the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order.
Conrad Gall was a Human male who served as the leader of Dagger Wing during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Retheus Galthe was a Human male who served as the President of Balmorra during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Gamoruk was a male Nikto who worked as a vendor on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He sold weapons to customers in the Alien Arms Bazaar.
Imodin Ganalya was a female Scientist of the Imperial Science Bureau who served the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Ganbar was a Human male Private who served in the First Battalion of the Fifth Infantry in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. His unit was led by Lieutenant Piloc.
Gandra Palis was a Human female who worked as a armor vendor on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Garboza was a Human male who was a Science Officer serving the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Gargun was a Human male commander who served in the reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Intelligence during the Cold War.
Garik was a Human male major of the Galactic Republic during the start of the Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Val DeGoort was a male Human Admiral of the Galactic Empire. He was the commander of the Valor, an Imperial-class Star Destroyer.
A Kel Dor Sith Lord once reigned as a Lord of the Sith. At some point between 40 ABY and 41 ABY, the Sith Lord engaged a group of Galactic Alliance Guard troopers in combat.
Anderton Kloff was a male Human general of the Galactic Empire. He was the commander of the ground forces on the planet of Goroth Prime.

A clone trooper lieutenant led the 212th Attack Battalion's "A" Squad during the Clone Wars. He was involved in the Battle of Sarrish of 20 BBY, falling under the overall command of High Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi and Marshal Commander CC-2224, nicknamed "Cody."
After meeting an individual in a bar, Luona had sent fifty-seven messages to the person's rented quarters on the space station StarForge Station by the following week.

Wampa Vader was a changeling enemy that dwelled on the planet Hoth at the time of the Galactic Civil War. Its true form was that of a wampa, but it could turn into the shape of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
The mother of Roark Garnet was a Human female. She held the opinion that her son's taking of a Driver Education course would one day be useful, but later disowned Garnet when he turned to smuggling.

A member of the Adnerem species who worked as a mercenary at some point joined the M'Yalfor'ac Order. By the reign of the New Republic he had reached the postion of officer within the order, serving second only to Quaal Tavier Catharius, the general and leader of the order.
Elhon Tay was a Tay Industries engineer responsible for designing the D-Wing Space Superiority Fighter.
Matri Bey was a female who served as governor of the Trans-Nebular sector and the Galactic Republic during the start of the Great Sith War.
J'Kek D'rith Kalama was the head of the Gorothite government.

J'Kek M'hoy Trinia was the leader of a faction of political philosophers on Goroth Prime. During the Corellian/Aqualish war, J'Kek M'hoy Trinia was critical of then-Rel'Kan, J'Kek D'rith Kalama and his policy of playing the Corellians and Aqualish were too risky and demanded h…

Jered Pole was a male lieutenant who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Around 0 BBY, he posed as a gambler where he started an information-gathering mission on the planet Goroth Prime.

Jimmy Marbels was a male child during the Galactic Civil War. He ran away from his home to find his brother, Johnny, who was a star pilot. At the age of eight, he encountered the smuggler Roark Garnet and asked to fly his starship.
Johnny Marbels was a male pilot during the Galactic Civil War. He had a younger brother, Jimmy, who was attempting to find him.
The Wookiee bouncer Urartu worked with a small sentient creature who sat on his shoulder and translated his Shyriiwook into Galactic Basic Standard.

While under detention, the smuggler Roark Garnet was supervised by a male guard. Trying to escape, Garnet attempted to convince the droid M-3PO to use a feather boa and wrap it around the guard's breathing slits while he slept. M-3PO's worrying woke the guard.
A five-foot lizard-like alien once attempted to offer his services as a guide to smuggler Roark Garnet when the latter arrived on the planet Spee.

Akure, also known as the Ghost in the Darkness or the Beast of Darkness, was a Sithspawn created by the Sith Emperor of the reconstituted Sith Empire in the centuries before the Great Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

A passenger from the planet Mon Calamari once traveled with the Star Tours agency aboard one of its StarSpeeder 1000s. During the early stages of the Galactic Civil War, that Mon Calamari had boarded the passengers cabin for the spacecraft, next to a Wookiee passenger.

A Wookiee passenger once traveled with the Star Tours company during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War. During their journey, the Wookiee got startled when a Human child took a picture of them without warning.
Mothra was a male official serving the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. As a Tax Inspector, he had several run-ins with the smuggler Roark Garnet.

During the Galactic Civil War, a male naval officer was assigned to a Star Destroyer patrolling the Kessel system. During a routine inspection of a freighter, the Dorion Discus, the naval officer accepted a bribe from the ship's captain, Roark Garnet.

During the Galactic Civil War, a stormtrooper chased the smuggler Roark Garnet on a speeder bike through a canyon on a planet in a trinary system. The pair battled through the canyon, with the stormtrooper attempting to ram Garnet's speeder bike into the canyon wall.

During the Galactic Civil War, a male Imperial was part of the crew of a bathysphere operating in the atmosphere of a Jovian gas giant. At some point, he fought for control of the vessel with the smuggler Roark Garnet.
"Dr. Black" was the codename for a scientist working in Grand Admiral Thrawn's lab on a Sith–Jedi hybrid. Dr. Black was killed when the Sith–Jedi clones turned mad and killed everyone in the lab.
"Dr. Blue" was the codename for a scientist working in Grand Admiral Thrawn's lab on a Sith–Jedi hybrid. Dr. Blue was killed when the Sith–Jedi clones turned mad and killed everyone in the lab.
"Dr. Brown" was the codename for a scientist working in Grand Admiral Thrawn's lab on a Sith–Jedi hybrid. Dr. Brown was killed when the Sith–Jedi clones turned mad and killed everyone in the lab.
"Dr. Red" was the codename for a scientist working in Grand Admiral Thrawn's lab on a Sith–Jedi hybrid. Dr. Red was killed when the Sith–Jedi clones turned mad and killed everyone in the lab.
"Smooth" Banjaxx Wab was a Bith musician during the Galactic Civil War. He was a kloo horn player and leader of Teemo the Hutt's house band, "Smooth" Banjaxx Wab and the Scundereds.

This gatekeeper was a light purple-skinned male individual of canine features who lived on Hoth and could be seen carrying a spear. When Luke Skywalker, along with C-3PO, found him, he initially did not let them pass.
Verpel was a Human male. In 3 BBY, he attended a ceremony at the Imperial embassy on Etti IV. There he met Elli Stark, the daughter of Iaco Stark, and despite being married, started harassing her.
A Human female infiltrated the Republic Service Organization as a saboteur during the Clone Wars, planting a series of detonite charges throughout the RSO center on Coruscant.

The father of Attichitcuk was a male Wookiee who emerged as a powerful Wookiee Chieftain in the last centuries of the Galactic Republic. He once killed another Wookiee in a duel, which provoked a lasting enmity between his clan and that of the deceased opponent.

A Twi'lek Jedi served as a member of a detachment of Jedi sent to aid the Republic Military and the Jedi Knight known as the Hero of Tython in battling the forces of the Sith Empire on the planet Corellia, during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Empire.

Porm was a male Sedrian from the planet Sedri alive during the Galactic Civil War. During the Sedri civil war he chose to side with the bishop of war Karak and his renegades in which he served as Karak's bodyguard.

Abryl was a male humanoid Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. He was stationed in Kaas City, the capital of the planet Dromund Kaas—center of the Sith Empire.
Alya Selray was a Human female Ambassador who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.
Ari Skyff was a male Twi'lek Smuggler allied with the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.
Ava Seldin was a Human female Imperial scientist during the time of the Galactic War.

Berin Fraal was a Human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the time of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He assisted the Three Families on Quesh until they were all killed by an Imperial spacer.
Broga Masrii, more commonly known as Broga the Hutt, was a Hutt who led the Three Families during the Cold War.

Cineratus, born Jevan, was a Human male Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. His father chose the Sith name of Cineratus for him, though Cineratus preferred his birth name.
Darro was a Human male sergeant who served the Sith Empire during the renewed war.
Daven Tam was a Human male who served as a member of the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Rekara was a female Mon Calamari who served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Diplomatic Corps. She was the faithful retainer of diplomat Mors Odrion, and joined him on a mission to the planet Sedri.

Ki Sazen was a female Zabrak Jedi who lived during the Cold War and the Galactic War. She was admired for her many accomplishments despite her young age, but her pride ultimately caused her to fall to the dark side of the Force.

During the early stages of the Galactic Civil War (1 BBY), a Gungan in a Bongo vehicle escorted a Star Tours-owned StarSpeeder 1000 to a Rebel hangar on Naboo via the planet core, after the vessel had dived into the water to avoid Vulture droids from the ensuing battle above, …

Farvin was a Human male General who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War against the Galactic Republic on Taris under the orders of the Sith Lord Darth Gravus. He tasked an Imperial spacer with various missions against the Republic on the planet.
Armaruk was a Talz male and captain who served in the military of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire.

Agrular, also known as Agrular the Mad, was a dangerous male Force-sensitive Gen'Dai who lived during the time of Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was imprisoned on the planet Belsavis for numerous crimes.
Geric was a Human male who lived on Nal Hutta during the Cold War as a supporter to the resurgent Sith Empire.
Godoba, known as Godoba the Hutt and Godoba the Shrewd, was a Hutt crime lord and leader of the Shadow Syndicate on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
Greggo Brudd was a male Twi'lek who supported the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire. He worked for the Duros doctor Rassan.

Zhin was a Zabrak male Jedi Master and instructor of the Jedi Order during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Zhin had brown skin, green eyes, and black hair. They carried a single lightsaber with the belt of their dark brown Jedi robes.
Hedrow was a Human male Sith Lord who served as a Sith Inquisitor trainer on the planet Quesh during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

An individual served as the CEO of House Salaktori, the preeminent members house of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. The CEO personally selected all bounty hunters who were allowed to join the house as all Salaktori CEO's did.
