Horell, nicknamed The Black Death by the inhabitants of Nal Hutta, was a male Human who worked for the Czerka Corporation during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and resurgent Sith Empire.
Toborro was a Hutt crime lord who lived during the Cold War and the resulting Galactic War.

After the death of its parent, this Flesh Raider baby was orphaned and left in the middle of a path. This baby would have died, had it not been for a Jedi Padawan who came across it inside a backpack.
In 26 ABY, an Aqualish security officer ordered the destruction of a starship used by Jedi Knight Dorsk 82 in an attempt to rescue a number of droids from a mob on the planet Ando.
Materrus was a male Sith pureblood who served the Sith Lord Darth Angral as a Sith of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.
Cipher Three was the codename of a Human Imperial Intelligence agent who went rogue. He was the father of Raina Temple, and his daughter hunted him down and killed him before the Sith could.
The mother of Raina Temple was a Human female who worked as a Cipher Agent for Imperial Intelligence of the reconstituted Sith Empire. She married fellow agent Cipher Three.
Minder Five was a Minder within Imperial Intelligence who was assigned to review the status of Samara Mindak and her father Theovor after an agent's operation involving them.

Arim was a male Zabrak who served as a Chief Engineer in the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed at the Outpost Zerek on Hoth, working with Admiral Revald on retrieving the Null Cannon from the Starship Graveyard.
Berrig was a Human male who served in the rank of Lieutenant of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. A member of the Imperial Reclamation Service, he was stationed on Tatooine.

Brega was a Human male who served as Major in the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Around 3643 BBY he was stationed on Tatooine and tasked a fellow Imperial with removing Sand People from a strategically vital oasis in the desert.

Charnagus was a male Rattataki doctor working for the Sith Empire during the Cold War. He had a base of operations on Nar Shaddaa beneath the Club Ufora, where Republic Navy personnel on leave would be drugged and provided to Charnagus as test subjects.

Damrosch was a Hutt who allied the Galactic Republic during the time of the Cold War. He believed that Betterlife Pharmaceuticals was a front company of an Imperial research group, but needed the Jedi to help him prove it.

Donal was a male Human who lived on the planet Nal Hutta during the Cold War. He had a brother who lived on a farm with his family near the town of Jiguuna, but when Donal's brother was unable to pay protection money to the Fa'athra gang, the criminals killed the man and his f…
Gedron Hix was a male Twi'lek who served as one of Nem'ro's agents on Nal Hutta during the Cold War. Around 3643 BBY he asked a passerby to lead an assault on one of Voontara Fa'athra's factories.
Getzo was a Human male who worked as a spice dealer during the Cold War. He claimed to have invented Glitterstim, Novajack and the Corellian Sunburst spices.

Haddon was a Human male corporal in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He led part of Special Operations Group Three during the invasion of Belsavis, but the Galactic Republic's security network allowed the Belsavis prison forces to gain an advantage…
Heshtra was a female Human Agent of the Imperial Intelligence of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Jazen was a Human male who served as Major in the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. He was station on Taris in the Tularan Marsh where he refused the orders of Governor Saresh to hold the outpost and instead gave his soldiers the order to pull out in face of danger.
Klage was a Zabrak male who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. At first he was the leader of the tech organization of the Red Light Lancers.
Kria was a Human female who served as a trainer in the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Leah was a Human female who was married to Donal during the Cold War.
Lodenth Kashar was a Duros male who served the reconstituted Sith Empire as a member of Imperial Intelligence during the Cold War. He held no official rank and as such his duties were flexible.
Malahan was a Human male on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
Nattis was a Human male who worked as a specialist in the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Pel Kwinn was a Human male, orginially from the planet Corellia, who served as a police officer with the Coruscant Security Force on the planet Coruscant. BY 19 BBY, Kwinn, who had achieved the rank of Lieutenant, retired from the police force and returned to his homeworld.
Yarg, also known as Honest Yarg, was a Gran trader who operated the shop Honest Yarg's Droid Emporium in Ploughtekal Market on the planet Coruscant.
Bakko was a Twi'lek male whom after having been the first to join her, served as the chief advisor and general of Queen Hadiya during the Despot War.
Deral Reiko was a male Reussi who worked as an informant.

Ortol was a general in the Mantellian Separatist Movement during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Reconstituted Sith Empire. During his time on Ord Mantell he committed for numerous war-crimes and was responsible for the deaths of thousands of civilians.
A Sullustan lived during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. They had brown skin and black eyes.

At some point during the Galactic Civil War, a humanoid Dark Jedi used the Force to drain life-force from a Human. With flowing black hair and red eyes, the humanoid had white skin with burgundy-striped patterns on their face.
Engar Ret was a captain in the Imperial Navy. He commanded an Imperial scout base on the moon of Tempay, in orbit of Gacerian, during the early years of the New Republic.
Glitch was a clone trooper who believed that he had an ability to use the Force.

A Morseerian child with tan skin was part of a group of children orphaned during the Clone Wars. The Morseerian and the others were kidnapped on the planet Abregado-rae by the Twi'lek woman Kuvuta Pindi in 21 BBY as part of a trafficking ring led by the Neimoidian Dool Pundar.

Rivaz was a professor working at the Imperial Academy on Raithal, during the height of the New Order. A subscriber to "Cynabar's Droid Datalog," Rivaz commented on the GY-I information analysis droid and how it was so useful in analyzing physical phenomena that the science dep…
Klaggus Purgato was a male individual who was rumored to have been one of the main design techs of the IG-series combat prototype.
Brisnell was a Human male who was part of a group of pirates in the Outer Rim Territories. Some time during his lifetime, he was tortured by a modified EV-series supervisor droid.

Molvar was a Human male who served as a sergeant in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire, leading the twelve-man Alpha Squad on the planet Quesh. Molvar had a cousin who became a Sith but died young.
Valoy was a Human male guardsman who served in the Republic's Expeditionary Forces during the Cold War.

Ulbrek Gostech was the Governor of Gacerian during the Galactic Civil War. He lived and ruled from Harmonia, the only city on the planet, and was popular among Gacerites. They called him Gacer'grocinga, meaning "the leader of artists".

Adele Konya was a female general of the reconstituted Sith Empire's Army during the Galactic War. She was a member of the Corellian cabinet before she joined the Empire as commanding officer in the Battle of Corellia in 3640 BBY.

An Argullian child lived on the planet Argul during the Clone Wars. Amid the Battle of Argul, fought on the world between the forces of the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Jedi Master Nemen Ull entered an apartment complex to look for the chil…
Jai was a female Mirialan who lived on Tatooine as a Nurse during the Cold War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Hale Malcolm was a Human male who lived as a farmer on Tatooine during the Cold War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Kralla was a female Felucian that lived on Felucia during the Clone Wars. She had a rancor she loved. One day, soldiers of the Confederacy of Independent Systems attacked and destroyed her village. She was one of the few survivors, and to protect her rancor, told him to leave.
Avamarivash was the male leader of a civilization which occupied the city of Kaleth and the site of the ancient Je'daii Order's Temple of Knowledge sometime after the Force Wars on Tython.
Ina'irolia'kleoni was a Chiss Lieutenant Commander in the Chiss Ascendancy during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

An unidentified Jedi Master who was part of a Jedi Council narrated the events surrounding the Naboo Crisis. After the Supreme Chancellor sent Qui-Gon Jinn and his apprentice Obi-Wan Kenobi to settle the conflict, the Jedi Council decided to create a record of the ongoing events.
Hetter was a male Human who as an Ensign onboard the Black Talon during the Cold War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Vorr was a Human male Corellian who was the brother of Vye and Vexx. He was killed by the future Grand Champion of the Great Hunt on Balmorra.
Vye was a Human female Corellian who was the sister of Vorr and Vexx. She was killed by the future Grand Champion of the Great Hunt on Balmorra.
Rasan-Je was a member of the Voss species from the planet Voss who lived sometime before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Rolend Zavros was a Togruta Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the Great Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Tarrick was a Moff of the Sith Empire who was assassinated by a Imperial black ops unit under the command of Lieutenant Pierce sometime before the year 3653 BBY.
This unidentified individual was a Xexto male podracer who resided on the planet Muunilinst.
This unidentified individual was a Glymphid male podracer who resided on the planet Muunilinst.

Law was a Clone trooper lieutenant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic. At some point during the Clone Wars, Law commanded a squad of clone troopers that accompanied Jedi Knight B'ink Utrila and her Padawan Rennax Omani to the planet Draay 2, on a mission to prevent t…
Cannon was a clone trooper who was raised on the planet Kamino and served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Bas-Ton was a male Voss living on Voss during the Cold War. He was the brother of Therod-Ton and had two children; a son Phi-Ton and a daughter Yana-Ton. He also was the owner of a tea house in the Judicial Quarter of the Voss-Ka city.
Rengor Vanth was a male journalist who worked for the news agency Sektor 242 NewsLine. At some point during the Galactic Civil War, Vanth interviewed the bounty hunter Malis about his profession.

Yerlad was a male individual who served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. After Yerlad killed five men who were affiliated with the Galactic Empire, a bounty was placed on his head and he was captured by the bounty hunter Malis.

Jarmak was a male individual who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire and was known to the Sullustan smuggler Gaor Tembon. At some point, Jarmak and a friend walked down a dark alley and murdered five thugs who served a local Imperial Prefect.

Krestock was a male individual who operated as a bounty hunter during the reign of the Galactic Empire. At some point, Krestock teamed up with the bounty hunter Raxine to claim a bounty on the individual Philo.
Raxine was a female bounty hunter who operated during the rule of the Galactic Empire. At some point, Raxine paired up with fellow hunter Krestock to claim a bounty on the individual Philo.
Parsec was an Advanced Recon Force trooper officer serving in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems, which spanned from 22 BBY to 19 BBY.
Nordia Gral was the first Je'daii Temple Master of Padawan Kesh, serving the Je'daii Order on Tython circa 36,019 BBY.
Vor'Dana was a male Je'daii Temple Master of Stav Kesh serving the Je'daii Order on Tython circa 26,012 BBY.

Deela jan Morolla was a Je'daii Master serving the Je'daii Order on Tython circa 32,920 BBY. She warned that not all Je'daii Journeyer would complete their Great Journey, as Tython and the morality of the Order posed a great many challenges to the youth.

Shall Mar was a Je'daii Master serving the Je'daii Order on Tython circa 28,915 BBY. He was known for having written the A Life in Balance, a book destined to be read by generations of Je'daii that would succeed him. The text was written between 28,930 and 28,918 BBY.
Rupe was a Je'daii Master serving the Je'daii Order at Stav Kesh on Tython circa 27,987 BBY.
Ni'lander was a Je'daii philosopher and a recluse from the Je'daii Order who lived as a hermit on one of Mawr's moons circa 25,805 BBY.
Kin'ade was a Je'daii Master who served as one of the instructors of Stav Kesh for the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Bardian Aelto was a junior chemist for the Galactic Republic on the Republic's capital planet Coruscant during the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

A Twi'lek female Jedi Master served the Jedi Order around the year 4000 BBY. She was one of the Four Masters who built a new Jedi Temple on Coruscant following the devastation of Ossus and the Great Jedi Library located there during the Old Sith Wars.
Dam-Powl was a Cathar female Je'daii Master who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
A humanoid Jedi Master with pointed ears was among the founders of the Jedi Temple of Coruscant, collectively known as the Four Masters.

Saulis Pau was a male individual who served in the Imperial Army. However, after suffering extensive injuries he was discharged from the army and was fitted with extensive cybernetic replacement body parts.

Lafek Iss was a male bounty hunter affiliated with the House Salaktori guild who operated during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Iss was an electronics and computer expert, who also had experience in the fields of droid programming and anti-surveillance measures.

Quantana was a male individual from Lopor Station who made a career for himself as a bounty hunter to raise funds to cover medical bills for his extended family. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Quantana was available for hire in Feris City.
Jeslor Salaktori was a male bounty hunter and the chief executive officer of the Bounty Hunters' Guild chapter House Salaktori during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Xiang was a Sith female Je'daii Master of Bodhi, the Temple of Arts, who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Lanoree Brock's father was a male Human and a Je'daii Master who taught at Bodhi, the Temple of Arts, for the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.

Birra Seah was a Human Force-sensitive female who worked as a systems designer for Kuat Drive Yards around 0 ABY. She was assigned to the construction staff of the second Death Star, the new superweapon of the Galactic Empire.

Darth Acina was a Human female Dark Lord of the Sith who ruled the reconstituted Sith Empire as Sith Empress. Prior to her accession, she was a member of the Dark Council and head of the Sphere of Technology.
Zharen was a male Human doctor who lived during the Galactic War. He was killed during the Battle of Taral V in 3642 BBY.
Ana Zett was a female Human Jedi Knight, serving the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Joti Laike was a male Twi'lek hitman who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he moved to the planet Lok to try his luck at Nym's Stronghold after a death mark was placed on his head.
Branthon was a male friend of Vixur Webb who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Rek Thelcar was a Human male member of the Lok Revenants who lived on Lok during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Stuvany Inglen was a Human female member of the Lok Revenants who lived on Lok during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Mako Ghast was a Chiss male member of the Lok Revenants who lived on Lok during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Grenz Zittoun was an Aqualish male member of the Lok Revenants who lived on Lok during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Cas Vankoo was a male Nikto who roamed the streets of Kimogila Town on Lok during the Galactic Civil War.
Cale Serasai was a Human male pirate who lived on Lok during the Galactic Civil War.
Vekis Kiyanu was a male Twi'lek bounty hunter who operated out of Kimogila Town on the planet Lok during the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
Raynar Cath was a male Rodian miner who lived on Lok during the Galactic Civil War.
Wes Riggers was a male Sullustan miner who lived on Lok during the Galactic Civil War.
Rei Reeven was a male Rodian member of the Lok Revenants who lived on Lok during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Oono Mor'in was a male Gungan who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he moved to the planet Lok after a death mark was placed on his head.
In 25 ABY, a referee presided over an honor duel between Prince Isolder and Beed Thane.

Haemon Alde was a Human male member of the noble House Alde from the planet Alderaan. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, Alde was kidnapped by pirates from his protectors, who were in the service of Alde's ally House Organa, and ransomed bac…
At one point, XR, the professor's personal droid, was reprogrammed and armed by General Koong so that the general could take Smith, Jann, R2-D2 and C-3PO as prisoners.

Drellik was a male Human Moff of the reconstituted Sith Empire in the era of the Great Galactic War. He had at least two sons, and it was his hope that one would be trained as a Sith, and the other would be an officer in the military.
Fixer 103 was a Human male who served in the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was on Alderaan, negotiating with Captain Lieber.

Fixer 308 was a Human female who served in the Imperial Intelligence of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. Around 3642 BBY she was stationed on Hoth at the Frostwake Outpost in the Starship Graveyard.
Neeya was a Nautolan male doctor of xenobiology. During the Cold War he was stationed on Belsavis, where he oversaw the Domination Experiments under the Project Noble Focus.
Nodin-Fe was a male Voss Commando from the planet Voss living during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY he was stationed at the Pelath Point outpost in the Pelath-Ri Marches.

Nokril was a Human male employed by the reconstituted Sith Empire to acquire resources. At some point during the Cold War he was on Nal Hutta to buy a shipment of spice from the Hutt Suudaa Nem'ro, as the Empire had discovered new medical properties of spice.
Nurkolas was a Nautolan male on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War, who was a contact of Bareesh Fenn'ak Torill.

Orawn was a Human male who served in the rank as Lieutenant of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War on Hoth. He and his men were dispatched to reclaim a captured Imperial power station from Talz forces.
An unidentified person acted as the Governor of Telos around 44 BBY.
A Human male was a Child of the Emperor, an agent of the Sith Emperor of the reconstituted Sith Empire, during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Valen Korik was a male Human Mandalorian bounty hunter, he was legendary within the Sith Empire and the Mandalorians during the Cold War, but in violation of the Mandalorian-Imperial alliance, he killed two Sith Lords in Kaas City on Dromund Kaas and as a result, he and his me…

Beckar was a Human male who served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was Commander-in-Chief of the Alliance forces in the Trax sector, and was based at the Trax Sector Command on the planet Entrus.

Vrain was a Human male who served in the rank as colonel of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War on Balmorra. He was head of Imperial Conquest Consolidation Corps used to quell uprisings on newly conquered planets.

Watcher Eight was a Human male who served in the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War on Balmorra. In 3643 BBY he sent an Imperial to the vicinity of the Balmorran Arms Factory to check on his agent Veld.
Vikurs was a Human male who served as an agent of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War on Alderaan.
Vandorn was a Human male who served in the rank as Captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War on Belsavis.

Urduun was a Human male Sith Lord who served in the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War on Alderaan. At some point, Jedi recovered one of their own holocrons which carried historical information on the Sith Empire-aligned House of Thul's past crimes and cruel acts.
Trell was a Human male who served in the rank as Lieutenant of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War on Taris.
Merile Yurrion was a Human male who held the rank of Moff in service of the resurgent Sith Empire. During the Cold War, he acted as the sector overseer of the Arkanis sector.
An individual served as a senator in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic sometime before the beginning of the Great Galactic War between the Republic and the Sith Empire.
Benthar was a Human male from the planet Draenell's Point. He led the gang known as Benthar's Boys, and was involved with a woman named Droxie.
This certain Kessel dealer once scammed Han Solo for 3,000 credits.

This individual was a male soldier of the Sith Empire on Dromund Kaas. In 3950 BBY he was chosen to be part of Murtog's handpicked team that ambushed the Jedi Knight Meetra Surik. He was killed during the brief skirmish.

This female individual was a soldier of the Sith Empire on the planet Dromund Kaas. In 3950 BBY, she was chosen by Murtog, the captain of Dark Councilor Darth Nyriss' security force, along with two other soldiers to be part of a team that would ambush the Jedi Knight Meetra Su…

This female individual was a soldier of the reconstituted Sith Empire on the planet Dromund Kaas. In 3950 BBY, she and two other soldiers were handpicked by Murtog, Dark Councilor Darth Nyriss' security captain, to be part of his strike team that would ambush Meetra Surik, a J…
Jao Assam was a Human male who served Empress Marasiah Fel's Empire as an Imperial Knight. He was mentored by the senior Imperial Knight Yalta Val, who was also his close friend.

A male Mandalorian sentry was a member of Clan Ordo. In 3954 BBY he joined his clan in the search for Mandalore's Mask on Rekkiad. He was part of the group that ambushed the Jedi Master Revan and Canderous Ordo.

One member of King Gorneesh's tribe of Duloks on Endor once helped shaman Umwak capture the young Ewok named Latara when she ventured on their territory. The two Duloks ambushed Latara, starting an avalanche that trapped her within a cave.
Phrayan was a Chagrian male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi combat instructor during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Tera-Su was a female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi combat instructor during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Kendo Ryzak was a Human male mercenary who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Platt Pareja was a male Zabrak mercenary who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Jeran Tarven was a Human male mercenary who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Goll Bardok was a male Trandoshan mercenary who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Wann was a male Imperial Prefect who served as the assistant of Governor Desh during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Helkson Vall was an individual who served the Galactic Empire as a Sub-Prefect on the world Kalandis IV.

Ursellis was a female individual who served the Galactic Empire as an Imperial Prefect. After Ursellis developed a penchant for issuing large numbers of Legal Authorization for Advanced Confinement Documents in order to deal with her enemies, her assistant Sub-Prefect Matagorn…

Carns Capra was a Human male who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. His father had been one of the earliest Rebel leaders, and had been killed on Mantooine defending the power generators.
Denis Rygelli, known as "Reggie", was a Human male technician serving with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Ben Spax was a Human male serving the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He had found the Rebellion on his own, and was an able fighter and pilot. After being screened by the Alliance's IntelTechs, he had requested a posting in Alliance Intelligence.
Trinna Orani was a Human female serving the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Zinn Classet was a Human male bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. He led a team of hunters including fellow Human Andar Sizzton, Gamorrean Jargool Muus, Gotal Uthil Ren'kacal, and Aqualish Negollup.

Trill Dantor was a Gotal male who was part of a rebel group led by the Mon Calamari Rutralli Optor. Operating in the Trax sector, Optor's group was not affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Droxie was a Human female from the planet Draenell's Point. A member of the Benthar's Boys gang, she was involved with the leader, Benthar, until she switched her affections to Herafin, leader of the Vibroblade gang and joined them.

Herafin was the male leader of the Vibroblade gang on Draenell's Point. He later joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic after Alliance operatives interceded in a feud between his gang and their rivals, Benthar's Boys and convinced them to unite in opposition to the Galact…
Drukus Kain was a male Human from Draenell's Point. Ostensibly a "farm tools" manufacturer, he made illegal weapons for the planet's criminal element.
Ensil Moiss was a Human male bureaucrat from Draenell's Point. During the Galactic Civil War, he was summoned to the under-construction Bissillirus Resupply Base.
Krystick Moonskimmer was a male member of the Benthar's Boys gang on Draenell's Point. He became Benthar's lieutenant after Droxie defected to the Vibroblade gang.

Negollup, nicknamed "Scrapper", was a male Aqualish Bounty hunter. During the Galactic Civil War, he was part of a gang led by Zinn Classet charged with hunting down Alliance to Restore the Republic operatives who had freed a Wookiee slave by the authorities of the Spice Mines…

Kelthizar Nimm was a Sullustan male serving the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the planet Entrus. He was used as a point of contact for operative wishing to connect with the Rebel Sector Command on the planet. Nimm's cover was as a dealer in the Tabal Comet casino.

Uthil Ren'kacal was a Gotal male bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. He was part of the team led by Zinn Classet, Ren'kacal assisted in the hunt for Alliance to Restore the Republic operatives who had angered the Spice Mines of Kessel by freeing a Wookiee slave…

Andar Sizzton was a male Human bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. He operated with the team of hunters led by Zinn Classet, who were contracted to track down a group of Alliance to Restore the Republic operatives for the Spice Mines of Kessel for freeing one o…
Olshen was a male who had achieved the rank of major.

Resner was a commander serving the Galactic Empire in the Trax sector. He commanded a Star Destroyer, and was questioned over Alliance to Restore the Republic activity within the sector by Admiral Heggel.

Kesha Weebe was a Human female who ran the Farmer's Folly in Starpoint on the planet Draenell's Point. A widow, she had run the establishment for a quarter of a century by the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Plessus Weege was a male Human thief on Draenell's Point. When the Galactic Empire arrived on the planet, he took to informing on the local citizenry for the Empire.
Rutralli Optor was a male Mon Calamari who led a rebel group in the Trax sector that was unaffiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Treffelt Wuin was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire as a mid-level bureaucrat assigned to the Bissillirus Resupply Base. Passed over for promotion, Wuin started to supply information on the base to the Alliance to Restore the Republic through the merchant Hennilrum.
Kray'geen T'ihar was a male Mon Calamari who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Quintarus Returyl was a male representative of the Spice Mines of Kessel and a slaver. During the Galactic Civil War, he purchased the Wookiee slave Kentara from Harthusa on Deysum III.
Vander was a Human male Republic Army General stationed on Ord Mantell during the Cold War.

Viqui was a female Human commander who was part of the Taris Resettlement Initiative made by the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. During this period Viqui was stationed at Waypoint Station Aurek as commanding officer.
Pharen was a female Twi'lek medic who served as an assistant to Attros Finn during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Laria was a female Human who worked with the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

A male individual served as a major in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Sometime before 3643 BBY, he encountered the Sith Lord Praven, and the Sith Pureblood took offense to what he saw as a lack of respect on the officer's part.

A Talz pilot applied for membership in what became Wraith Squadron, a New Republic starfighter Squadron founded by Commander Wedge Antilles, in 7 ABY. The Talz pilot was rejected due to becoming emotionally unstable when placed in simulated combat environments.

A Hutt owned a palace during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Sometime between 3647–3642 BBY, after a severe groundquake on the planet where his palace was located, the Hutt began to hoard medpacs in his palace and sold them at a high rate in ord…

A Human individual native to the planet Alderaan served as a military officer on the planet during the Galactic Civil War. By the time of Alderaan's destruction by the Galactic Empire's Death Star superweapon in 0 BBY, the individual joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Darred Eloinie was a male individual who served as the CEO of Eloinie Petro-Munitions, an armaments company that operated on the planet Zaraksander.
Zaglis was an individual who held the title of Supreme Leader of the Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangites, a group active on the Expansion Region astronomical object Zaraksander.
Cyrstas Eloinie was a female individual who was the daughter of Darred Eloinie, the CEO of the armaments firm Eloinie Petro-Munitions.
Merrck Nall was a male bounty hunter who was the father of Gradress Nall. During his career Nall wielded a Neural Inhibitor, and he popularized the use of such weapons among bounty hunters.
Carilla was a female Human who operated the shop Carilla's Catering and Wedding Planning in the city Hedrett on the planet Cularin.

A Human singer performed a series of concerts on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars. A series of posters were put up around the city in order to promote them. The Aurebesh caption read "concert every night" – "call 050506".
This Rodian Jedi fought alongside both Lumas Etima and a Twi'lek Jedi at the Petranaki arena during the Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY.

In 33 BBY, a Rodian Jedi helped defend the Coruscant Jedi Temple when it was raided by the Yinchorri. While the Jedi were successful in repelling the invaders, Jedi Knight Tieren Nie-Tan was slain. This Jedi was among those mourning his death.

In 22 BBY, a Rodian Jedi was present at the briefing led by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi prior to the First Battle of Kamino. The Rodian flew a Delta-7 light interceptor with a team of other Jedi as part of the starfighter defense of Kamino.
Komi was a female Human who served as an assistant to Commander S. Geland during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

A Force-sensitive male Rodian was a member of the Doomed on Kesh. He was among the group of Doomed members who encountered Takara Hilts and Parlan Spinner when they landed on the continent of Eshkrene.
"Nails" was the nickname of a Rodian female bounty hunter who was hired by Tarro Blood to get rid of his rival. Nails was inferior to the hunter and was killed in a deadly fight.

Rarsk was a fearsome Trandoshan male bounty hunter who burned an entire village alive on the planet Dantooine. During the Cold War he received the sponsorship of the Hutt crime lord Suudaa Nem'ro to enter the Great Hunt competition.

Lonai's father was a male Kumumgah who lived on Tatooine with his son during the Pre-Republic era. He and his son was among the survivors that were brought before Predor Tul'kar and Xesh during the culling of Force-sensitives.
Bartaph was a female Human who served as a colonel in the Republic Army during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Andan was a Human male operative of Imperial Intelligence who was sent by Darth Malgus as part of a strike team to capture the Allusis.
Magnus was a human male Jedi Consular who was dispatched by Grand Master Satele Shan as part of a strike team to secure the Allusis.
Ezeraline was a Jedi Knight who was dispatched by Grand Master Satele Shan as part of a strike team to secure the Allusis.
Taklan was a smuggler who was dispatched by Grand Master Satele Shan as part of a strike team to secure the Allusis.
Keenor was a Republic trooper who was dispatched by Grand Master Satele Shan as part of a strike team to secure the Allusis.

Smeer Ze-Trios was a male Neimoidian who worked for the Trade Federation. During the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY, Ze-Trios worked as a Settlement Warden for the Federation, overseeing prison camps on Naboo. He was considered to be brutal.
During the Galactic Empire's reign, a Tsyklen from the planet Tsyk became an expert in the forgery of false identifications.
Wiffa Zett was a Human female who was said to be part of Count Dooku's Dark Acolyte army. She was defeated in a duel on Dathomir by a a lone Jedi Knight sent by Grand Master Yoda.
Zak Davies was a Human male who lived as a farmer on Tatooine during the Cold War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Dahl Harris was a Human male who lived as a farmer on Tatooine during the Cold War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Trede Bakvalen was a Human male member of the Bakvalen family, a Human family from the planet Corellia, who served as an admiral in the Republic Navy sometime before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Bannos was a male Human who served as a Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Ter'cay was a Human male Je'daii Master who served as one of the instructors of Qigong Kesh for the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Vader reflected that his willingness to sacrifice a squad of stormtroopers was indicative of a fearful man.
Vulk was a male Je'daii Ranger who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
Lanoree Brock's mother was a female Human Je'daii Master who served as instructor at Bodhi, the Temple of Arts, for the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
An unidentified Valorum was a member of the Valorum family of Coruscant, and served as Supreme Chancellor, some time prior to 62 BBY.

Dena Tredway was a female Human who was the daughter of the Jedi Knight Axton Tredway and the sister of the Rebel Alliance agent Erling Tredway. During the Galactic Civil War, Dena joined the Rebel Alliance at the urging of Rebel leader, Mon Mothma.
A green-skinned pachydermoid alien was a member of the Ante-Endor Association.
A three-horned individual was a member of the Ante-Endor Association.

According to a Kaminoan legend, an aiwha sacrificed himself to save his pod when the god-beast Protas stopped the pod from traveling south for the cold winter. Knowing they would die if they returned north, the aiwha pod fought Protas.
Sludge Kintan was a Kintan crusher who roamed the grounds of Fa'athra's Palace on the planet Nal Hutta during the Cold War. Sludge Kintan wandered outside the edges of the palace foraging.

Foreman Crusher was the name given to a massive Kintan crusher who guarded the entrance to the droid factory in the palace of the Hutt Cartel leader, Karagga, on the planet Nal Hutta after the end of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Gargath was an enormous Kintan crusher who roamed Gargath's Watch, an area of the Clabburn Tundra on the planet Hoth, during the Cold War. The crusher was attacked by a group of offworlders and killed.

Zank Helrott was a Human male bounty hunter who served Rogun the Butcher during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He had a reputation of never bringing in a bounty alive.
Momi Andrell was a wealthy Human female who was the daughter of Senator Wain Andrell and part of a group of animal rights activists that served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Wain Andrell was a Human male senator who represented the planet Ralltiir in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Cold War. He was the father of Momi Andrell, who used his wealth to hire mercenaries to save endangered species.
Tyrka was a female Human member of Eco-strike, a eco-terrorist group active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Baramak was a Human male Colonel of the resurgent Sith Empire living during the Galactic War.

Baranj the Starseeker was a Evocii male Rifle Grenadier and sharpshooter who lived on Nal Hutta during the Cold War. He and a group of other Evocii had acquired a starship, which was cause for alarm for the Hutt Cartel.

The Baratatta Spirit-Leader was a Evocii male who held the title of Spirit-Leader in the village of Baratatta on Nal Hutta during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. His wisdom was respected, even by the great Evocii warrior, Huttsbane.
Charles Reskin was a Human male who served as an officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Sarell was a Human male major who fought for the Galactic Republic during the raging Galactic War. Stationed on Balmorra, Sarell and his troops battled the Empire in Gorinth Canyon until they were poisoned by toxic fumes.

Sarn Ko was a Human male who worked as a freelance assassin during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. After doing sensitive work for the Empire, he was deemed as "knowing too much" and was sent to the Shadow Town prison on Nar Shaddaa.
Wen Seafire was a male Anomid who served as a vendor of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War on Quesh.
Skolin was a Human male sergeant who served in the military of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Weeznod was a male Human Alderaanian Lieutenant of the House Organa during the Cold War and the civil war on Alderaan.
Westro was a Human male captain of the Forty-second Imperial Infantry who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Wixx was a Twi'lek female member of the Balmorran resistance during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire. During the Republic liberation of Balmorra in 3642 BBY she was commanding the Moraine Outpost in the Moraine Territory.
Yelto was a female Togruta who served as Captain onboard Dorin's Sky during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Uli Zhensi was a Duros male who worked for the reconstituted Sith Empire until he decided to join the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.
Vol Kolla was a male Rattataki Mandalorian who worked as a mercenary for the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Vergost was a male Human commander of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was a Human supremacist and viewed aliens as a blight on the galaxy that needed to to be eliminated.
Mark Vempor was a Human male officer of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.
Ukabi was a Human male cyborg who lived on Nar Shaddaa, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Strilth was a Houk male who worked for Rogun the Butcher during the Galactic War. He was sent to Nar Shaddaa to receive the captive slicer Combo from Raskurro the Hutt. However, a smuggler captain arrived to rescue him and killed Strilth.
A Human male was the father of the Myleena Dystra. He and his wife were wealthy Coruscanti who were arrested by the Galactic Empire as members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A Human female was the mother of the Myleena Dystra. She and her husband were wealthy Coruscanti who were arrested by the Galactic Empire as members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Muk Muk Monkey was a yellow Kowakian monkey-lizard with purple hair, who accompanied two Weequays living on Coruscant. When the Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano and her Master Anakin Skywalker were searching for the criminal Car Affa, Muk Muk Monkey noticed Tano's lightsaber.
Lord Tagriss was a male Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire who at one point during the Galactic War pledged his loyalty to the Dread Masters.
Skott Yun was a male Human Je'daii Journeyer who served the Je'daii Order on Tython at the height of the Infinite Empire's reign.
The first Riileb was a mythical figure believed in by members of the insectoid Riileb species native to the planet of the same name.

Sharoleigh was a female Human Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Stationed on Nar Shaddaa, she learned that a Jedi Master was training Force-sensitives in the ways of the Force.
Vago was a paled male Human Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Vadus was a paled female Human Sith Lord who served the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3642 BBY, Vadus was on Taris, where she ordered an Imperial to destroy the rakghoul research of Doctor Vernan.
Zereldspidar was a male Snivvian who became a charismatic, although evil, dictator of the Snivvian homeworld, Cadomai Prime.

Farin was a Human male officer who served Galactic Empire during the Galactic Empire. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Lieutenant Farin was assigned to an Imperial space station in the Outer Rim Territories, along with Lieutenant Alin, Captain Clough, Warrant Officer Sn…

Bailie was a Human male officer who served Galactic Empire during the Galactic Empire. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Captain Bailie was assigned to an Imperial space station in the Outer Rim Territories, along with Lieutenant Alin, Captain Clough, Warrant Officer Sno…

Snopell was a Human male officer who served Galactic Empire during the Galactic Empire. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Warrant Officer Snopell was assigned to an Imperial space station in the Outer Rim Territories, along with Lieutenant Alin, Captain Clough, Lieutenan…

Alin was a Human male officer who served Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Lieutenant Alin was assigned to an Imperial space station in the Outer Rim Territories, along with Warrant Officer Snopell, Captain Clough, Lieutenan…

Taison was a Human male officer who served Galactic Empire during the Galactic Empire. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Major Taison was assigned to an Imperial space station in the Outer Rim Territories, along with Lieutenant Alin, Captain Clough, Warrant Officer Snope…

Skav Mora was a Chagrian male who worked for the Hutt Cartel during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He asked an Imperial to deal a blow to organ thievery going on in Hutt Territory.

Sosa was a Human female minister in the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. A special envoy from the Republic to the Gree Enclave, she received a message from unit Na-TaK regarding a crisis situation on Asation.
Agent Suria was a Twi'lek female who worked for the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Galactic War.
Ganuk was a male Evocii foreman who lived on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Vengo was a Human male Officer who served in the Imperial Reclamation Service of the Imperial Military during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He was stationed on Tatooine around 3643 BBY.
Voklov Adaim was a male Anomid who worked as a bioweapons designer during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Addi'shon was a Human male individual who worked as a vendor for the Sith Empire on Dromund Kaas during the Cold War.
Ka'van Aip was a Twi'lek male shipmaster who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He worked at the Mos Ila Spaceport.
Tavion Alde was a Human male who served as a Pistoleer Commander of House Alde and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War and the civil war on Alderaan.
Kendo was a Rodian male who worked as a bartender in Chalmun's Cantina in the city Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

During the Galactic Civil War, a male Aqualish of the Ualaq sub-species operated as a bounty hunter in the Outer Rim Territories. Clad in a bright orange jacket, he wielded two Model 434 blaster pistols.

Dwanar Gher was a Sullustan male spacer who operated during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Gher was an associate of the Human smuggler Nanika Senoj and around 0 BBY, Gher and Senoj were approached by the Toydarian Unko while in Chalmun's Cantina on the Tatooine, who attempt…

Unko was a male Toydarian who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In about 0 BBY, Unko attempted to find a pilot to transport a cargo of illicit contraband from the planet Tatooine to Imperial Center.

A Wookiee male, Grahuur was a hunter who lived during the time of the Cold War, a period of unrest between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Around the year 3643 BBY, Grahuur had a camp in the swamps outside the city of Jiguuna on the planet Nal Hutta.

A Sith trooper who served in Darth Malak's Sith Empire carried a vial of Rakghoul serum during a mission to the Undercity on the planet of Taris. After they perished, the Galactic Republic soldier Revan recovered the serum and gave it to the doctor Zelka Forn.

During the Galactic Civil War, a Quarren had a bounty place on their head. The bounty hunter Boba Fett tracked the Quarren to a cantina, where he captured the bounty alive, restraining them at blaster-point.

Tre Sana was a Lethan Twi'lek male and a resident of the planet Kalimahr in the Tython system during the height of the Infinite Empire's reign; an empire that Sana and the rest of the system's residents were ignorant to.
Lorus was a Sith male police captain of the Kalimahr militia that was casually involved in the plans of the Stargazers.
A bounty hunter operated during the Galactic Civil War. During one adventure, the bounty hunter had to rescue a child who wrestled a pirate out of a hatch.
A male child lived on the methane planet Farstine during the Galactic Civil War. The child was reserved and well-mannered, intelligent but eager to participate in adventures.

A male child adventured with a bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War. An obnoxious brat, he once wrestled a pirate out of a hatch, forcing the bounty hunter to jump from orbit to the surface of the planet Dantoooine using nothing but an ablative heatshield and a parachut…

A bounty hunter operating during the Galactic Civil War had a younger brother who died at an early age. The hunter eventually met an orphaned child on Farstine; reminded of their brother, the hunter took charge of the child.
D'nar was a Human male bounty hunter who was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Rove was an ambassador of the resurgent Sith Empire to the Hutt Cartel during the Galactic War against the Galactic Republic. He replaced Unar in that position after his predecessor was executed by Supreme Mogul Karagga.
Soopan was a male Duros from the city New Tayana on the planet Duro who was at one time the best friend of Cad Bane.

Febull Dow was a Theelin female negotiator. During the Clone Wars, Dow attended a peace conference that was held within an automated facility on the moon Gus Talon to discuss recent Separatist activity in the region.

Slotho was a Rodian male negotiator and bail bondsman. During the Clone Wars, Slotho attended a peace conference that was held within an automated facility on the moon Gus Talon to discuss how to respond to recent Separatist activity in the region.

Orf Madroo was a Twi'lek female diplomat. During the Clone Wars, Madroo attended a peace conference that was held on the moon Gus Talon to discuss what actions to take in response to recent Separatist activity in the region.
Rancor's Wrath was a pseudonym that was adopted by a tall, slender, male individual who visited the bar Every Delight in Port Town on the planet Rodia in 0 BBY.

An unidentified Dark Side Adept with pale green skin was known to have lived in the galaxy at some point in history. A typical adept of the dark side of the Force, that individual sought to gain power by exploiting the inferiors and the non–Force-sensitive.

An unidentified Sith priestess aroused the interest of Remulus Dreypa, a Human male and fallen Jedi, around 6900 BBY. Along with his fellow exiles, Dreypa had discovered the planet of Korriban, inhabited by the Sith species.
Thranz was a senator who served in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Great Galactic War. Thranz and Senator Falit were rescued by Jedi Knight Ardun Kothe from an assassination attempt.

Falit was a senator who served in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Great Galactic War. Falit and fellow senator Thranz were rescued by Jedi Knight Ardun Kothe from an assassination attempt.
Galvan was a male Moff who served the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic.

Ruehn was a captain in the Alanciari military, stationed at the fort at Garrow's Neck. At some point he lost one of his eyes, leaving him with one good one. When Quarra Thayn was traveling to Point Defiance to visit Jogan Halder, he stopped her and asked for her documents.

Brue Thayn was a male Keshiri who was the husband of Quarra Thayn, and father of their three children, which included at least one adolescent daughter. He was a resident of the city of Uhrar, in northern Alanciar, a continent on the Wild Space planet of Kesh.

Perla was a Human female living on the planet Coruscant who worked for the Imperial Center Sanitation Department. Perla used her job to run a large-scale smuggling operation, utilizing the department's barges. Her successes were based on the lack of inspection on the barges.

In 23 ABY, a conspirator was involved in the bombing of the dining hall of the Hapan Queen Mother's royal residence, Fountain Palace, located on the planet Hapes. The bomb was intended to kill the matriarch of Hapes, Ta'a Chume, and her granddaughter Tenel Ka.

Shalim Avesta was a male Human businessman and political leader from Makeb. He served as Makeb's de facto Chief of State, by dint of his status as head of the Avesta Mining Corporation and the Makeb Business Council, when the planet was conquered by the Hutt Cartel in 3638 BBY.
Ton E'rau was the Eastern Arch Platoon Leader for the Galactic Empire on the planet Cato Neimoidia during the time of said government's reign.
TK-934 was a Human Imperial stormtrooper on the planet Cato Neimoidia sometime during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

At some point between the years 19 and 1 BBY, a Neimoidian spoke with smuggler Adah Meborman in a drinking hole on the planet Tatooine. The Neimoidian claimed to be related to Medd Valii, who had accrued a large amount of money during his lifetime.

Medd Valii was an individual who had acquired a large amount of money during his lifetime. Sometime during the reign of the Galactic Empire between the years 19 and 1 BBY, a Neimoidian talked with smuggler Adah Meborman about Valii.

Wolga was a member of the Hutt species who was suspected of being a gangster sometime between the years 19 and 1 BBY. Just prior to the trial of Wolga, the witness, Brio Tabbett, was removed by bounty hunter Boba Fett.

Belmer Kattun was a Keshiri thoughtcrier who was stationed at Point Defiance. He worked alongside the signal officer Jogan Halder before the Lost Tribe of Sith's invasion of Alanciar in 2975 BBY. He preferred fermented beverages over romance.
Port, was one of two Uvak used to steer the airship Candra. It was berthed on the left side of the airship, whereas Starboard was berthed on the right.
Starboard was one of two Uvak used to steer the airship Candra. It was berthed on the right side of the airship, whereas Port was berthed on the left.
Edra Kothe was a Human who lived on the planet Dantooine in the decades before the beginning of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Neven Kothe was a Human who lived on the planet Dantooine in the decades before the beginning of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Yanila Zavros was a female Togruta Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the Great Galactic War between the resurgent Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Zanbar was a tamed anooba available for sale as a pet during the Clone Wars.
Oppa was a tame and mischievous momong who lived during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Omma was a momong who was available for sale as a pet during the Clone Wars.
Juda was a female Twi'lek who worked for Nem'ro the Hutt on Nal Hutta during the Cold War as his paymaster. She paid a bounty hunter several times for his bounties.
Peblak was a male Ugnaught who lived on Nal Hutta during the Cold War.

Rade-Sa was a male Voss Commando who lived on Voss during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY he was ordered by Pevthak-Fra to assist a Galactic Republic citizen in the assault on the King's Hall of the Gormak King Jokull.
Ensign Rosha was a Human female who served in the Imperial Reclamation Service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Rudd was a Ugnaught male who served in the gang of crime lord Nem'ro the Hutt during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Sachal Kand was a Nautolan male who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. He was stationed on the planet Voss when he witnessed a female Gormak warlord, named Lakkna, salvage war droid parts from a crashed Imperial starship.

Lakkna was a female Gormak warlord who lived on Voss during the Galactic War. After salvaging war droid parts from a crashed Imperial ship, she planned on rebuilding them and using these droids to crush the Voss. She was stopped and killed by a Republic hero.
Sanin was a Human male who served as an Equipment Commendations Vendor on Hoth during the Galactic War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Scov was a Human male who served the Galactic Republic as a captain during the Cold War, in the civil war on Alderaan.
Ceptor was a Moff of the reconstituted Sith Empire who served during the Great Galactic War against the Galactic Republic.

Sej Verlin was a Human male from Balmorra and a member of the Balmorran resistance during the Galactic War. He complained to Republic ambassador Alya Selray when the Mandalorians under Monta Drai kidnapped Balmorran citizens to sell them into slavery.

Serik was a Human male who served as an officer in the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. Stationed on Belsavis, he discovered that the Rattataki found a way to coordinate their movements in the jungle with military precision.

Shar-Da was a male Voss Commando who lived on Voss during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY he was stationed at the medical center in Camp Talanis in the Gormak Lands. He thanked a Republic citizen who brought to him the medical supplies recovered from the Gormak.

A Human Imperial enlisted trooper was stationed on the planet Cato Neimoidia sometime between the years 19 and 1 BBY. At one point during said time, the stormtrooper became intoxicated and attempted to devour fifty Spiced Mynock Wings.

Grataa was a male Kaleesh Great Hunt representative who lived during the Cold War. He was the one who accepted an unidentified bounty hunter into the Great Hunt on the planet Nal Hutta. Mako, the bounty hunter's companion, nicknamed him "Skullface".

Jalta was a Human male from Corellia who served as a member of the Corellian Council during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. He was executed by the Sith for refusing to serve the Empire.

Trabier was a Human male who served as an Sith Empire's Head of manufacture on the planet Balmorra during the time of the Cold War. He had a powerful Sith apprentice bodyguard named Lerek Serrus, who was convinced to defect by a Jedi Consular.
Lady Dak-Ah was a Human female Imperial noble who lived during the Cold War.
A Human female Mandalorian owned a warehouse in the city of Keldabe, capital of the planet Mandalore. From the warehouse, the woman operated a store selling used droid parts and specialty equipment.
Shayl Tasao was a Human female who served as the representative of the Exchange consortium on Tatooine during the Cold War.
Ghar Bodya was a male Houk warlord who was a member of the Exchange, acting on the desert planet of Tatooine during the time of the Cold War.

Agent Shyrack was a Human male who served in the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War and the civil war on Alderaan. Stationed in the King's Pass, he sent a Republic spacer to set House Thul and Baliss against each other.

Squarg was a Gamorrean male criminal living during the Cold War. He was imprisoned on Belsavis by the Galactic Republic until 3641 BBY when the crime lord Ivory arranged an escape of himself and his associates, including Squarg.
Strom was a Human male who served as an aide to Governor Saresh during the Cold War.

Konya Suladi was a Human female who served in the rank as captain of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War on Belsavis. She was assigned to the Imperial Reclamation Service as a special consultant. She send fellow Imperials looking for signs of Rakata teleporter network.
Rand was a male Human worker who lived on the planet Nal Hutta with his wife Ezra in their later life. Rand was employed at the Rust Yards, and the two lived in the nearby worker settlement.

Ayx was a male Human who grew up on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the reign of the Galactic Empire. While Ayx was a child, his mother and father were killed by the Empire and he and his sister Alai Jance were subsequently sent to live with the family of a friend of their father,…
Dagg was a Kadas'sa'Nikto male Mandalorian who worked as a bounty hunter during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Engo Whitt was a male Human bounty hunter who resided on Quesh during the Cold War. He once trained a bounty hunter who had won the Great Hunt.
Karen Dochek was a female Human Mandalorian bounty hunter trainer who resided on Taris. She trained a certain bounty hunter known as the "Grand Champion of the Great Hunt."

A Wookiee worker traveled to the moon Alaris Prime during its colonization between 39 BBY and 36 BBY. Along with four other workers, the Wookiee gathered the resources food, carbon, nova crystals, and ore to sustain a base on the moon.

A Wookiee worker journeyed to the moon Alaris Prime at some point between 39 BBY and 36 BBY to take part in its colonization. Alongside a group of fellow workers, the Wookiee gathered resources such as food, carbon, nova crystals, and ore to sustain a base on Alaris Prime.
A Wookiee worker was one of three members of its species who gathered resources to sustain a colony on the moon Alaris Prime during its colonization.

Suva-Rak was a male Voss Commando who lived on Voss during the Galactic War. He was stationed as a guard at the Pilgrim Retreat at the Old Paths, where he asked an off-worlder to cleanse the monuments on the road to the Shrine of Healing that were defiled by Gormak.
Lenan Organa was a Human female Alderaanian who was a general of House of Organa army during the Cold War.

At some point in history, an unidentified traveling explorer visited the skies of Endor, a forested moon of the Moddell sector, in a hot air balloon. He or she crashed on top of the Explorer's Crag, a steep peak located near Endor's Happy Grove.
"One Shot" Wrenas was a Twi'lek male bounty hunter living during the Galactic War. At one point he resided on the planet Voss and passed his knowledge to the bounty hunter who had won the Great Hunt.

Ada Klee was a female Imperial Agent trainer during the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. She resided on the planet of Taris. She trained the Imperial Agent Cipher Nine.
Barr Faldrin was an Imperial agent trainer who made his home training agents on the planet of Corellia. At one point, he trained Cipher Nine.
Beebe was a male Human bounty hunter who made his home on the planet of Balmorra. He worked as a trainer of his fellow hunters in the city of Sobrik.
Charotke Chel was a Zabrak male bounty hunter who residing on the planet Belsavis during the Galactic War. He passed his knowledge a bounty hunter who had won the Great Hunt.
Derish was a Sith Warrior trainer who was stationed on Nar Shaddaa. He once trained the Emperor's Wrath.

A clone trooper served under Commander Cody during the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY, he was part of the team sent to rescue Jedi Master Even Piell, who was being held captive in the Citadel on the Separatist-held world of Lola Sayu.
Seeker was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Nub Jakkak was a Sullustan male who lived during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. In about 21 BBY, during the Clone Wars, Jakkak journeyed to Timira City on the planet Kamino aboard his freighter.
Trechane was a Human male Sith Warrior who served the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was one of many Sith who were deployed on the planet Belsavis during the Imperial invasion.
Sirianna was a Human female Sith Inquisitor of the Sith Empire who lived during the Cold War. Residing on the world of Nar Shaddaa she at one point shared knowledge with the future Darth Nox.

The Beast of Marka Ragnos was a Sithspawn terentatek that was kept as a pet by Marka Ragnos, an ancient Dark Lord of the Sith and ruler of the Sith Empire. Following Ragnos' demise in 5000 BBY, the Beast was left to guard the resting place of its master on the planet Korriban.
Aakars was a male General who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. He was stationed at the Gorinth Canyon on Balmorra around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.

Aarsix was a male humanoid who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire. In 3642 BBY, they were stationed in the Republic Operational Headquarters on the planet Quesh during the Republic–Empire conflict there.
Abalen was a male Bith who worked as a stimulant vendor on Corellia during the time of the Galactic War between Galactic Republic and Sith Empire.
Carg was an ARC trooper captain who served within the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Yorn Nuro was the male Twi'lek leader of the Nuro Pirates. Supporting the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Third battle of Felucia, the pirates captured a Nysillin farm and started supplying the nysillin to the Confederacy.
Krussk was a male Trandoshan commander serving in the Trandoshan Pirates who led a group of fellow Trandoshan pirates in overtaking Bunker Krill during the Battle of Umbara.
This Quarren Rebel pilot was a starfighter pilot in the Rebel Alliance. The Quarren participated in a number of historical training simulations around the same time as Keyan Farlander.
This Rebel pilot was a Human starfighter pilot in the Rebel Alliance. The pilot participated in a number of historical training simulations around the same time as Keyan Farlander.
This Rebel pilot was a Human starfighter pilot in the Rebel Alliance. The pilot participated in a number of historical training simulations around the same time as Keyan Farlander.

Kherr Dawar was a member of the Mandalorian splinter group Death Watch who was assigned to await the arrival of a Jedi Knight in a captive Ming Po village on Carlac during the skirmish there. She combated the Knight with her wrist-mounted knives, but was eventually killed.
Lazhae was a Human male scientist who was imprisoned by the reconstituted Sith Empire in their Shadow Town prison facility on Nar Shaddaa for his horrific experiments on alien creatures.

Mord Jayran was a member of the Mandalorian splinter group Death Watch who served in a captive Ming Po village on Carlac during the skirmish there. He awaited the arrival of a Republic agent, a Jedi Knight, whom he fought in the center of the village.
Kro Lann was a member of the Mandalorian splinter group Death Watch who served in a captive Ming Po village on Carlac during the skirmish there.
In 23 ABY, a Mairan ambassador came to Reef Fortress Island to discuss his grievance against the Vergills with Tenel Ka, the Hapan-Dathomiri princess.

Atetu was a Jawa who lived on the planet Tatooine during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, shortly before the rescue of the captive former smuggler Han Solo from the palace of the crime lord Jabba the Hutt, Atetu fellow Jawa Tweetu spent some time with the Jedi Luke …

Tweetu was a Jawa who lived on the planet Tatooine. During the Galactic Civil War, Tweetu and the Jawa Atetu spent some time with the Jedi Luke Skywalker in a run-down tavern on Tatooine shortly before the rescue of Luke's associate Han Solo from the palace of the crime lord J…

Ory Lam was a Human male bounty hunter. At one point in history, his career brought him to Kaas City, the capital of Dromund Kaas for the Great Hunt. He was killed by an unidentified bounty hunter in the Grand Melee.
A chef worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the rule of the Galactic Republic. The chef served Tiure loyally and prepared food, including chuba stew, for the Hutt.
Purvis was a male Human who served as the chief droid technician for Avrak Villachor, the sector chief of Black Sun on the planet Wukkar.
Pickwin was a male Human who served as a security guard for Avrak Villachor, the sector chief of Black Sun on the planet Wukkar.
Barbas was a male Human who served as a guard for Qazadi, a Black Sun Vigo, during his visit to the planet Wukkar to meet with sector chief Avrak Villachor.
Narkan was a male Human who served as a guard for Qazadi, a Black Sun Vigo, during his visit to the planet Wukkar to meet with sector chief Avrak Villachor.
A Wookiee worker was sent to the moon Alaris Prime during its colonization to assist with a base that was being manned by three other workers.
A Wookiee worker was sent to the moon Alaris Prime during its colonization to assist with a base that was being manned by four other Wookiee workers.

Voloren was a male agent of the Strategic Information Service of the Galactic Republic during the time of the Great Galactic War and the subsequent Cold War. In the course of his service, he was pursued by the Imperial officer Malavai Quinn.
A Duros male worked as the sheriff of New Tayana during the Clone Wars.

During the early formation of the Galactic Empire, the Sith Lord Darth Vader murdered the son of a wealthy industrialist. As a result, the father arranged for a hit on Vader via nine assassins, eight of whom were killed.

During the formation of the Galactic Empire, an industrialist of considerable wealth placed a hit on the Sith Lord Darth Vader, as revenge for the latter murdering his only son. He sent out nine assassins, eight of which ended up dead at Vader's hand.

A male Human individual from the planet Corellia worked as a smuggler by the year 3 BBY, by which time he had also begun working with a Wookiee co-pilot. In 3 BBY he played Sabacc with the Riileb Tere Metallo on Tatooine.
A male member of House Malreaux served as the ninth count in the history of the house, which was one of the richest families on the planet Vjun.

During the Galactic Civil War, a Shadow Guard was in the service of the Galactic Empire. Force-sensitive and trained in the dark side of the Force, the Shadow Guard was one of the Empire's most feared servants. Armed with a lightsaber pike, the guard killed a Twi'lek.
Mandalore the Binder was a male Mandalorian born the son of a rug weaver on Harswee, a celestial body known for its luxurious loom-woven carpet exports.
Mandalore the Hammerborn was a Mandalorian who grew up in alleys on the astronomical object Kol Atorn, far from the Mandalorian homeworld of Mandalore.

Relik was a Human male captain in the Arkinnea Militia during the early years of the Empire's reign. In 19 BBY he served as the leader of a militia unit that slaughtered the off-world refugees, and for this had trouble with the fugitive Jedi Master K'Kruhk and his younglings.
Teron was a male Human Commander in the Republic Navy, and later in the Imperial Navy.
A male Vrot served as a mercenary in the employ of Soergg the Hutt. In 22 BBY, he took part in a skirmish that took place in Cuipernam, the capital city of the planet Ansion.
Kessk was a Trandoshan male who worked as a bounty hunter during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.

Esu was a Gand bounty hunter who operated during the Clone Wars. In about 21 BBY, Esu was captured by the Galactic Republic and imprisoned by the Galactic Republic alongside various other bounty hunters aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Tempestuous for transport to the p…

Ditto was a Human male who worked alongside Laurn as the leader of a Swoop gang on Hallitron-7. In 18 BBY, he and Laurn were hired by Ferus Olin to escort him to a spaceport on the planet. He hesitated at first, but Ferus convinced him the credits he had.
Laurn was a Human female who worked for Ditto, leader of a Swoop gang on Hallitron-7. In 18 BBY, she and her boss were hired by Ferus Olin to escort him to a spaceport on the planet.
Tuten was a male Koorivar who owned a shop on Hallitron-7. In 18 BBY, he was visited by Ferus Olin, who wanted to buy a transpirator.
Lilia Lands was a Human female from Bellassa. She was the mother of Malory Lands and aunt of Roan Lands.

Dolan was a Human male who lived in the underworld of Coruscant during the Clone Wars. After the war ended, he didn't believe that the Jedi betrayed the Republic and went on to join Jedi Master Fy-Tor-Ana and The Eleven.

Arlain Zee was a male bounty hunter who earned notoriety during the latter years of the Galactic Republic after he swindled the individual Sli Genchu out of the proceeds of the Lodan job, making him one of the most wanted men on the planet Coruscant.
Reed was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
J'Ruush was a male Whiphid, minion of Szajin the Hutt, serving as a commander of the InterStellar Regulators during the Galactic War. He was killed by an Imperial strike team.

Makos was a Human male in the Arkinnea Militia. In 19 BBY, he was a crewmember on an ore carrier that was supposedly ferrying refugees to a secondary outpost, but was secretly disposing of them by dropping them to their deaths.
A male Human Death Watch soldier fought against the True Mandalorians in a battle on the planet Concord Dawn, located in the Mandalore sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim.
"Bruiser" Groben was a male Rattataki who made a living on the planet of Tatooine as a cantina vendor.
Abbus-Kelo was a Human male who lived on the moon of Nar Shaddaa, working as a stimulant vendor. He was the best on the moon.
Monnda Tebbo was a Duros Chief Navigator who served onboard the Flurry during the Galactic Civil War. He was killed with the rest of the Flurry crew during the battle over Bakura.
Milos Brejik was a swoop racer who lived on the planet Taris before the city-planet's destruction in 3956 BBY at the hands of the Sith Lord Darth Malak.

Sonko Fromm was the oldest son of the Annoo-dat Blue gangster Sise Fromm, the older brother of Tig Fromm, and a member of the Fromm Gang. As Sise's right-hand man, Sonko was assigned to a transport raid but botched it.

Jaggard was a Human male Imperial stationed on the war torn planet of Balmorra. At one point, he asked a fellow Imperial to retrieve a bio weapon encased in a canister that was located on a crashed shuttle and hid somewhere in space debris by a Republic spy.
Medle was a male Human and captain in reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Intelligence during the Cold War.
Viran was a Muun male banker who lived during the years prior to the rise of the Galactic Empire. He was the banker of Ja'Boag.
Rand Lokta was a male Human Imperial agent trainer who resided on the planet of Balmorra. At one point in history, he trained the Imperial agent Cipher Nine.
Hepswick was a female Human corporal who resided on the war torn world of Balmorra during the Cold War. She made her living as a light armor vendor.
Edease was a male Human corporal who lived on the planet of Balmorra. He made a living by selling heavy armor to the citizens of the Sith Empire.
Hebesh was a male Human corporal affiliated with the reconstituted Sith Empire who resided on the war torn planet of Balmorra. He made his living as a medium armor vendor.

Aidan Vurt was a male individual who served as the political advisor of the Twi'lek Leontyne Saresh, a Senator in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Republic's Great Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Jorthal was a male Human corporal who lived on the war-torn world of Balmorra. He made a living as a vendor by selling light armor to the reconstituted Sith Empire's citizens.
A male individual from the planet Coruscant was the third husband of the Republic Army officer Elin Garza.
Lida was a male Human corporal who lived on the planet of Balmorra. He made his living as a vendor selling heavy armor.
Fubini was a female Human who was affiliated with the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Liko'da was a Human male who served the Sith Empire on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas. He made his living by selling stims to the Sith Empires citizens.

An unidentified Chagrian had business on both the planets of Coruscant and Alderaan around the year 32 BBY. He or she was present in Galactic City, the planet-wide city of Coruscant, when the Queen of Naboo Padmé Amidala came to plead her people's case before the Galactic Senate.

Aramis Kariya was a pilot of the Rebel Alliance. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Kariya hid near the Lesser Misty Falls region on the plant Dathomir, only to later be killed by an Imperial agent sent by Darth Vader.
Alim'Gen was male Human who worked as a stims vendor on the moon of Nar Shaddaa.
Chessiq was a male Human who resided on the moon of Nar Shaddaa. He made his living as a stimulant vendor.
Saik was a female Human loyal to the Nightsisters of the planet Dathomir. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she operated at the Nightsister Stronghold as a gatekeeper.

N'um was a female Human who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she operated at the Nightsister Stronghold as a Nightsister Sage.

Satra was a female Human Nightsister who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she operated at the Nightsister Stronghold as a herbalist.
Dok'madd was a male Twi'lek who resided on the war torn planet of Balmorra. He made a living by working as a cantina vendor. Dok'madd had an average height along with yellow skin.
Elek was a male Human who made a living on the polluted planet of Balmorra. He worked as a modifications vendor, selling products to the reconstituted Sith Empire's citizens.

Eriquel was a Human male who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire and resided on the planet of Balmorra. He made his living by working as a crew skill trade vendor.

Heron Jorael was a Human male Sith Inquisitor who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire on the planet of Balmorra. Jorael was a Human of average height with brown hair and tan skin.

Chorlen was a male Human who served the Sith Empire on the capital planet on Dromund Kaas. He made his living by working as a vendor, selling various products to the Empire's citizens. He was of average height for a Human being and had light, tan skin.
Jin-Olori was a female Human who served the reconstituted Sith Empire as a vendor during the Cold War on the planet of Balmorra. She was of average height for a Human and had light, tan skin.
Jelph Merrian's mother was a single mother on the planet of Toprawa. When her son, Jelph Marrian was younger, she told him stories about when the Sith had occupied Toprawa during the Great Sith War.

An individual on Kesh gained his freedom from slavery and took the name of Korsin as a title for himself. He devoted his life to live like the first Grand Lord, and a century later many other Sith would pattern themselves after him, also taking the title of Korsin.
Hereven Kev was a Force-sensitive male Human who was born to Dayla Kev and Hereven, two scouts who were stranded on a hostile jungle world.
