Venra Andsof was a female Lorrdian diplomat who served as the assistant to the ambassador Milac Troper. At some point during galactic history, Andsof accompanied Troper to the herdship Galactic Horizon, to attend some peace talks.
Farenan was a female Human who was located on the moon of Nal Hutta, Nar Shaddaa. She made her living as a stims vendor.
Via was a Human female from the planet Kegan. She worked in the Animal Circle. Friends of Nen and Melie, she taught their adopted son Davi how to care for animals in the Circle.
Sindee was a female member of the furred Bimm species who lived during the early years of the Galactic Empire. A shrewd businesswoman, she operated a one-woman refueling station.

In 3 ABY, an Imperial officer spotted the Rebel Fleet while they were on their way to the Rebel rendezvous point. He then, with his Strike-class medium cruiser and a squadron of nine TIE/LN starfighters, engaged the Rebel fleet.
Maro Vizhen was a Human female who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. She worked as a diplomat in the Imperial Diplomatic Service, and headed Special Operations.
Suzdice was a Clawdite stage actor. Suzdice claimed to find exercise of the Clawdite species' shape-shifting abilities to be excruciatingly painful.
Tellpah was a male Keshiri scholar and Lost Tribe of Sith slave who accompanied High Lord Edell Vrai during a reconnaissance mission to the continent of Alanciar in 2975 BBY.
Ohali Soroc was one of the Quest Knights sent by the New Jedi Order on the Quest for the Mortis monolith.
Bhixen was a senior male Togorian Jedi apprentice in training in the Jedi Academy on Shedu Maad soon after the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence.

Talsa-ko was a female Voss Mystic who lived during the Galactic War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She sided with the rebellious Sith Lord Darth Serevin during the Battle of Ilum.
Zeevar was a male Rodian smuggler during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Sartius was a male colonel who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Tythan Phomm was a Human male living during the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. At one point, he was captured by Morgukai warriors and used as bait to lure in a female Jedi.
Volere was a Human male sergeant during the Cold War, as well as the Civil War on Alderaan.
Murghir was a female Cathar bounty hunter who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Traga un-Vhol was a Human male rebel cultist who served as the leader of the Unchained during the Cold War. During a slave revolt on Dromund Kaas, Traga laughed at his fellow slaves' notions of freedom.

Jacklin was a Human male miner who lived in Torbel, a village on the planet Lanteeb during the Clone Wars. He and Devi convinced Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to provide shelter for the villagers.
Zap was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic's Gold Squadron during the Clone Wars.
Targen was a Human male who worked as the head of a freelance gang on Nal Hutta during the Cold War between the Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Tark was a Human male sergeant who served the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War. When several individuals had valuable knowledge with regard to political allegiances in the Galactic Senate of the Republic, Tark sent an Imperial spacer to free those individuals from…
Mohn was a Human male miner who worked for the Workers. He participated in a secret meeting of a group of miners under the leadership of rini.
Winati was a Human female miner who worked for the Workers. In 41 BBY, she participated in a secret meeting of a group of miners under the leadership of Irini.
Pressik was a male Human who served as an officer in the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Rers Shallit was a male Neimoidian who served on behalf of Morbo the Hutt during the Galactic War. Sometime during the war, he got together with Theron Shan, son of Grand Master Satele Shan and Jace Malcom, who wanted to talk about Teff'ith to Morbo.
Zedania was a female crime lord who served as the leader of the Old Tion Brotherhood during the Galactic War.
Rage Alburass was a Human male criminal who was active during the Clone Wars.
Heff Arcon was a Mon Calamari male who was active during the Clone Wars.
Mell Blank was a Sullustan male who was an impersonator and extortionist active during the Clone Wars.
Bip Boddipy was a Human male who was active during the Clone Wars. He was known to be a kidnapper and a murderer.
Hab Chanzor was a Twi'lek male who was active during the Clone Wars. He was known to be a dangerous criminal and cannibal.
Chicora was a Human male art terrorist who was active during the Clone Wars.
Valon Drass was a Human male from Corellia, who committed terrible crimes during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Rom Niles was a Human male from Tatooine, who lived as a criminal during the time of the Clone Wars.
Foj Nomag was a male Ithorian from Ithor, who was active during the Clone Wars.
Phindo was a Rodian male from Rodia, who lived as blackmailer and perpetrator during the Clone Wars.
Xibert R'aan was a male Bith from Clak'dor VII, who distributed deathsticks during the Clone Wars.
Rosh Rendar was a Human male Corellian criminal who was active as a saboteur during the Clone Wars.
Rukurruka was a Wookiee male criminal from Kashyyyk, who was active during the Clone Wars.
Sedrundra was a Dug male criminal from Malastare, who committed terrible crimes during the waning years of the Republic.
Rkk Hkk Skn was a male Duros data smuggler from the planet Duro, who smuggled data from the Republic.
Voz Suppet was a Rodian male criminal and terrorist from Rodia, who murdered about 15 individuals during the Clone Wars.

A junk trader from the Kalarba system purchased the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 in the year 5.5 BBY. The droids had previously belonged to the Kalarba system's Governor Wena Havid, who flitted across the galaxy in a luxurious starship, but when the governor was bankrupted, most of …
Pyro Gibbtra was a male scientist who worked for the powerful company Sygor Startech Industries during the Galactic Civil War.

Datoro Scorn was a male hired-gun. At one point, Scorn had an encounter with the mercenary Lex Kempo that when poorly for Scorn, who was shot in the face with a blaster bolt, leaving him hideously scarred.
Gunder Vren was a male individual who served as an agent of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Jared Tome was a doctor and Imperial Prefect who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
A red-skinned being worked as an associate of an elite assassin assigned to kill Darth Vader around 19 BBY.
During the early stages of the Galactic Empire, a reclusive male elite assassin lived on a swamp planet. He also had one permanent associate, a red-skinned, draconian figure.
Yalt was a male Human who lived on Nal Hutta and served Nem'ro the Hutt.
Yalt was a female Human who lived on the polluted planet of Nal Hutta.

Telo was a female Dathomirian who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she operated at the Singing Mountain Clan Stronghold. There, she served the Singing Mountain Clan as an herbalist.

Harmon Torvix was a male Chagrian member of the Corellian Council during the Galactic War and secretly the leader of the Coronas gang. He aligned himself with the Sith Empire in the Battle of Corellia, also engaging his gang in the battle.
Szajin was a Hutt leader who held the title of Archon during the Hutt Cartel's occupation of Makeb in 3638 BBY.
Pillaat and Nerro was a Troig male bartender who worked in the Spyder, a gambling establishment located on the planet Coruscant.

Morbiss was a Hutt slaver who operated at some point around the time of the reign of the Galactic Empire. Morbiss was based on the moon Nar Shaddaa and he had enemies throughout the Outer Rim Territories, and he employed a large retinue of thugs to protect him from his rivals.

Omacala was a Gotal male who resided on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Omacala ran the Umbra Club, a cantina and nightclub situated within Sector 1459 of the Coruscant underworld, and he paid a lot of attention to the activities and conversations…
Speng was a Human male death stick dealer who operated the Umbra Club, a cantina and nightclub situated on the planet Coruscant.
Cho'pa'ailor, also known as Chopper, was a Besalisk male who worked for the Pyke Syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Katha Niar was a Human female working for the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. She worked for the Ministry of Logistics until 3638 BBY, when she was chosen to run the support team for the Imperial strike force during the Conquest of Makeb.

Hanthor was a male Cathar officer serving the reconstituted Sith Empire in 3638 BBY. He was promoted to his current position after the reforms enacted after Darth Malgus's coup, wishing to set an example for his people and serve them through the Empire.
Cytharat was a pureblood Sith male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Jovel Nial was a young female of the Bothan species who served as an aide to Senator Trellev Aquem during the early days of the Galactic Civil War.

An unidentified Human female with red hair was staying on Coruscant around the time of the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY. She was present in Coruscant City Tours' terminal when the Queen of Naboo Padmé Amidala came to plead her people's case before the Galactic Senate.

During the early years of the New Republic, the Bothan Bem Lyu'kij was a member of the Bothan Combat Response Element which was watching over the Kathol sector. Specifically, Lyu'kij was tracking Imperial forces still in the sector, such as Moff Kentor Sarne.
Mojo was a Clone trooper captain who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Kalro Mear was a Kubaz chef from Kubindi. Mear was hired by Admiral Spitar P'ton of the Imperial Navy along with a dozen assistants to be his personal chef.
Omad Kaeg was the captain of the mining ship Joyous Roamer in the Chiloon Rift as of 45 ABY. He was a member of the mining cooperative that operated in the Rift and used a T-6 blaster pistol.
Scarn was a Mandalorian mercenary hired by the Qreph brothers to scam Omad Kaeg of his shares from the mining cooperative that he was involved with in the Chiloon Rift.
Jakal was a Mandalorian mercenary hired by the Qreph brothers to scam Omad Kaeg of his share in the mining cooperative he was in in the Chiloon Rift.
Qizak was a member of a species called the Nargons, and he was a biologically-engineered organism created by the Qreph brothers to do their bidding.
Marvid Qreph was a Columi industrialist who worked in tandem with his brother, Craitheus, for several decades.

Knoke was a Rodian bounty hunter who operated at some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire. While on Rodia, the Rodian homeworld, Knoke took on the Nikto Kaa'to Leeachos as a bounty hunting apprentice.
Verannis was a Falleen male who served as an underboss within the criminal organization Black Sun during the Galactic Civil War.
Dauntarist was an individual who reached the rank of commander in the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Larken was a male pirate who owned the starship Pillage. During his career as a pirate he at one stage worked with two other pirate vessels named Trust Me and Profit, the latter of which was piloted by an individual named Druug, in attempted to capture the Helix–class light in…
Druug was a male individual who worked as a pirate and owned the starship Profit.

Craitheus Qreph was a male Columi industrialist who headed a business enterprise with his brother, Marvid, for decades. Together, the brothers took over several major industries that, by 45 ABY, represented the hints of a hostile takeover of the galactic economy.

Savara Two was a Human-Columi hybrid clone of the Force-sensitive mercenary Savara Raine, secretly Vestara Khai. Savara Two was created under Marvid Qreph's supervision, as the Columi crime lord was fond of the original Savara, but thought she needed "improvements," as it were.

Sahr was a female, Blonde–haired individual who worked with the pirate Larken on board his starship Pillage as a gunner. Sahr became Larken's partner and gunner after she sold him a tip as to the location of the Helix–class light interceptor, Kizbon's Box.

Dena Yus was a female Human biot engineered thanks to the funding of Marvid and Craitheus Qreph. She acted as an agent at Lando Calrissian's asteroid refinery on the world of Sarnus in the Chiloon Rift, where the Qrephs tried to swindle Calrissian of his refinery.
Barduun was a Mandalorian mercenary hired by Marvid and Craitheus Qreph to enter the unknown monolith stationed below Base Prime in the heart of the Chiloon Rift.

Ohali Two was a female Duros clone, created by Marvid and Craitheus Qreph of Jedi Knight Ohali Soroc aboard Base Prime, Han Solo nicknamed Ditto. She was mentally deficient due to imperfections from Force-sensitive cloning.
Thill was a clone trooper sergeant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic.
A gray-skinned Female Nightsister was active during the Galactic Civil War. She wore lose robes colored red.

BT-413 was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, The stormtrooper conducted operations as part of the security personnel in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the planet Dathomir.

A Gran male who worked as a bodyguard and a bounty hunter once pursued a weapons smuggler into territory controlled by the Galactic Empire, only to chance a run-in with Rebel Alliance agent Kyle Katarn.

Lenders Ennada was an Imperial Officer who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Captain Ennada conducted operations as a security officer in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the Dathomir.

Jecht Eris was an Imperial Officer who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Lieutenant Eris conducted operations as a security officer in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the Dathomir.

FR-351 was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, The stormtrooper conducted operations as part of the security personnel in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the planet Dathomir.

DS-378 was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, The stormtrooper conducted operations as part of the security personnel in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the planet Dathomir.

TK-108 was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, The stormtrooper conducted operations as part of the security personnel in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the planet Dathomir.

TK-217 was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, The stormtrooper was part of the security personnel in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the planet Dathomir.

Derin Hans was a prison guard who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Hans conducted operations as part of the Galactic Empire's detention staff in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the planet Dathomir.

Arwen Zherooh was an Imperial Officer who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Lieutenant Zherooh conducted operations as a security officer in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the Dathomir.

Shorran Dak was a Human male gangster who acted as the leader of the Black Talon Gang. During the Clone Wars, Dak was contacted by the rogue scientist Blayne regarding a new type of weaponry that the scientist had developed, and Dak and his gang set a course for Blayne's aster…
A male member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic was given a mission by the organization during its period of activity fighting against the Galactic Empire.
Lar'omx was a Trandoshan male who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. At some point, Lar'omx betrayed and humiliated his fellow Trandoshan clansman Tray'Essek.

A light green-skinned, Force-sensitive female Twi'lek was active during the Galactic Civil War. She was part of the Jedi Order at some point, as she carried a lightsaber, but it is unknown whether she was a Padawan or a fully trained Knight at the time of the fall of the order.
During the Galactic Civil War, a female Corellian engineer served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She had light skin and red hair.

Thorsteg was a Mandalorian mercenary hired by Marvid and Craitheus Qreph. During the Qreph's sabacc game with their prisoner Han Solo, Thorsteg served as a table butler by fetching drinks and anything the players needed.
Emlyn Mandel was the wife of Kvarn Mandel, head of Fabritech. She lived on Thorgeld I in her family's mansion with her husband and four children, including Samire and Simmin.

A bureaucrat served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, stationed on a planet with strict weapons control. The bureaucrat asked the smuggler, Roark Garnet, if he had a permit for his sidearm while on the planet.
Rose Maanki was a red-haired female Zabrak slave who took part in a slave uprising near the Unfinished colossus outside of Kaas City, on the Sith Empire capital world of Dromund Kaas.
A male Wookiee navigator served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, especially as a gunner on rebel starships.

Nadrin Tro was a Neimoidian male scientist working for the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was part of the New Thinking Division and was involved in the plans to acquire Isotope-5 for the Imperial strike force during the Conquest of Makeb.
Lemda Avesta was a Human female geophysicist and niece of Shalim Avesta living on Makeb during the Galactic War.
Pollus Avesta was a Human male from Makeb, and the younger brother of the planet's head of state, Shalim Avesta.

Clivis Damand was the New Republic Sector Intelligence Chief of Vilonis sector following the Battle of Endor. Damand attended the briefing to determine the New Republic's response to the Corporate Sector Authority and Galactic Empire's attempt to seize the Kalinda system.
During the Galactic Civil War, a high-ranking Alliance to Restore the Republic officer was under the protection of Shroud Team in Corint City on the planet Pirik.

Tharston Kharl was a male Human who worked in Lando Calrissian's Sarnus Refinery on Sarnus. He had a wife back on Telos but he carried on an affair with Dena Yus, a biot created by Galactic Exploitation Technologies to spy on Calrissian's operations.

Harlas was a male Human who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Sith and the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on the Sith homeworld of Korriban, where he served the Empire as a vendor, working outside the ruins near the Sith Academy.

A Human lived on the planet Xerxes during the Galactic Civil War. At some point, the smuggler, Roark Garnet, asked the citizen to enter a weapons shop on the planet, take a look around, then report back to him. He offered the Human twenty credits if they agreed.
Gundren was a male Human from Serenno. By 3 BBY, he was the warden of the Spike prison.
This Female individual who resided in the planet Telos IV was the wife of Tharston Kharl, an asteroid miner who worked in Lando Calrissian's refinery on Sarnus.
A member of the Kilmaulsi species worked as a guard for the Casino Royale on the planet Vorzyd V during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A member of the Kilmaulsi species was on the planet of Cato Neimoidia in 19 BBY shortly after the end of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Rasmus Blys was a Special Executive and biochemist of Czerka Corporation and was in charge of CZ-198, one of Czerka's many product development facilities. Dr. Blys is well educated on the subject of biochemistry and other sciences. He later worked for Czerka Corporation.
Koong was a general active during the Imperial Period. He sabotaged the droid XR, and attempted to have Jann Tosh, R2-D2, C-3PO, and Dr. Akary Smith captured.

Gar Tosh was the father of Jann Tosh. During his childhood, he was friends with the researcher Akary Smith. He eventually had three children with Plena Tosh, first Jann Tosh, then twin boys, Gessle and Trif.
Vaash Ti was a female Togruta Jedi Padawan. She had red skin with cream-and-white striped montrals and white facial markings. She wore pink-and-tan robes, and carried a blue lightsaber.
An Imperial commander was present aboard the M-Class Imperial Attack Transport Regina Cayli during its mission to New Bakstre during the Galactic Civil War.
A male member of the Human species worked as a courier for the shipping magnate Brevis Taug, while the courier was under the employ of a Hutt controlled company.
A male member of the Houk species worked as a bodyguard for a Human courier hired to deliver a satchel of credits to the Clawdite Prit Kessek.
A female member of the Chadra-Fan species visited the Grand Terminal spaceport on the planet Junction at an age where she was considered elderly and had a stooped posture.

This major in the Rebel Alliance commanded troops in the Battle of Xeron against a Galactic Empire force that included an Imperial warbot, which was captured by the Rebels. Later, the major turned the droid over to Luke Skywalker to get a full technical schematic of it.
Drizan was a Human male who served in the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.

Rossiker was a Human male sergeant in the Republic Military during the Battle of Corellia of the Galactic War. He was stationed at the Drall Library near Capitol Square where he met the Barsen'thor who was in search for the First Son and Guardian Hold One.

Grann was a Human male general who served in the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY, Grann and General Merion were stationed on Corellia where they led their Imperial forces to take over Guardian Hold Four with the assistance of the Children of the Emperor.

Merion was a Human male general who served in the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY, he and General Grann were stationed on Corellia where they led their Imperial forces to take Guardian Hold Four with the assistance of the Children of the Emperor.
A failed Jedi was active during the Galactic Civil War. The Jedi had an alcohol problem, and considered liquor to be a necessity of life.
Thall Joben's father lived with his partner on the planet Beheboth. A champion speeder racer, he was almost killed in a crash two days before the birth of his son, Thall.
Thall Joben's mother lived with her partner on the planet Beheboth. A champion speeder racer, her partner was almost killed in a crash two days before the birth of their son, Thall.
Vendelik was a male Human private in the Sith Empire during the Conquest of Makeb.
Ecklin was a male Mon Calamari representative to the Hutt Cartel on Makeb during the Conquest of Makeb. He was stationed at the Hutt Cartel's embassy in Talaos City, the planet's capital.

Cera was a Human female member of a Republic archaeological salvage team in Olaris, on Taris during the Cold War. Most of her team was lost when rakghouls cut them off, and only Cera and her Sullustan colleague, Garthe, survived.
In 22 BBY, an individual served as an explosives disposal officer with the Coruscant Security Force. He was present at the Galactic City spaceport hostage siege.

Halor Dinnoral was a retired corporate executive and wildlife collector that hired a hunting party to accompany him to an uncharted planet and aid him in acquiring some new specimens for his personal zoo.

A male bounty hunter was active during the Galactic Civil War. Luke Skywalker once extracted information out of the hunter by getting him drunk on Corellian whiskey. The bounty hunter revealed that an individual he referred to as a "furball" was being held at Margess Base.
Klin Kartoosh was a crime lord who dealt in the spice-running racket. Kartoosh operated in the Annoo system and was a known associate of the Desilijic Hutt clan.
Perovius was a Human male who served Baron Peyar Cortess of the House Cortess, serving as his guard captain. When Peyar condemned his wife Chay Cortess for treachery, he ordered Perovius to kill her.
A male alien philosopher was part of the crew of the science vessel Prana Lexander five hundred years before the Galactic Civil War. He was considered to be one of his species' greatest minds.

A leader led a group of pirates based on the planet Sayblohn during the Galactic Civil War. The pirate murdered an Alliance to Restore the Republic contact and stole an art object of religious significance to the Okfili.

An Alliance to Restore the Republic contact lived on the planet Sayblohn during the Galactic Civil War. He was due to meet an Alliance Special Operations to help them recover an art object of religious value to the Okfili, but he was murdered by a local pirate leader.

Odeon Farnish was a Lexlar customs official. Farnish wanted a promotion, so thorough searches were conducted in hopes of catching minor infractions, but serious smugglers willing to offer bribes were allowed to pass.
The Gaddrian ambassador was an individual who originated in the Gaddria system of the Outer Rim Territories' Oricho sector.
An ambassador to the Alliance to Restore the Republic's provisional government served during the Galactici Civil War.

Joram was a male Human Mandalorian hired by Marvid and Craitheus Qreph to serve as security in their asteroid crusher Ormni. Along with his sister Jhan, they were stationed near a turbolift when Jedi Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa Solo burst into the room and took them captive.
Jhan was a female Human Mandalorian hired by Marvid and Craitheus Qreph to serve as security in their asteroid crusher Ormni.
Dewell Bronk was Kedorzhan who served as a senator in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Tyloor was a Kedorzhan who was one of the seven children of the Galactic Republic Senator, Dewell Bronk.
An elderly Twi'lek female was a passenger aboard the Tallaan Clipper transport vessel named the Space Slug in 19 BBY.

An unidentified Dyclops pirate served as a gunner aboard the Blood Brother, a starship commandeered by the notorious pirate Reddjak. As a minion of Reddjak, that Dyclops was part of the Red Fury Brotherhood.
Suuas was a male Sullustan relative of Luewet Wuul, the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances Senator of Sullust and chairman of the subcommittee on mineral taxation.

An individual served as the Sith apprentice of the female Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Gorgos, a member of the ruling Dark Council of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Gharj was a monstrous Sithspawn-like creature that had been created by the Rakata of the Infinite Empire through Force alchemy.

Guyne was a Human male who resided in the isolated village Torbel on the planet Lanteeb. By the time of the Clone Wars, Guyne was an elderly man, and in about 21 BBY, in the aftermath of a theta storm, Guyne and the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker worked together to fix the villa…

Jyml was a male individual who resided in the Damotite mining village on the Outer Rim planet Lanteeb during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. On one occasion, Jyml lost several toes while working in the village's mine, despite wearing protective boots at the time.

Berrille Ada was a sentient arachnid that worked as an outfitter during the Galactic Civil War. Ada maintained an office across the speederway from Mama's on Ord Mantell, doing business with smugglers via a translator.
Selig Kenjenn was a Human male Jedi Knight who served as a member of the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Gutodj was a Chevin merchant who worked on the planet Wielu during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Li'lith was a female Human who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Sith and the Galactic Republic.
Nareen was a male Human who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Sith and the Galactic Republic.
Rance was a male Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire and an Overseer of the Sith Academy on Korriban during the Cold War. Rance was of average height for a Human and had light skin.

Jesef was an individual who the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi was assigned to protect while he was a Padawan. Kenobi failed in his assignment and the Shistavanen criminal T'mott Zoat killed her on the planet Helleguth around 41 BBY.

Bricka Thomor was a female Human merchant who worked on the planet Wielu selling weapons. She agreed to sell a weapon to the smuggler Rook Pryce during the Clone Wars and also provided him with fake information on the location of the criminal T'mott Zoat, for whom he was searc…
Resik was a male Human sergeant of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the period of time known as the Cold War. He served the Empire by selling armor on Korriban.

Stavas was a male Human who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Sith and the Galactic Republic. They served the Empire as a vendor on the Sith homeworld of Korriban—working from a tent near the Sith Academy, selling light armor.

During the Galactic Civil War, an Imperial captain commanded the Star Destroyer Aggressor. He was forced to deal with Imperial Security Bureau officer Mar Barezz during his hunt for the Alliance agent Tay Vanis.

During the Galactic Civil War, a freighter captain was present on the planet Ord Mantell. He was contracted by Raleigh Dawn to take her to a set of coordinates loaded on a datapad, but a power drain stopped them launching.

Bloodskin was a Flesh Raider who lived on Tython during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. Bloodskin and other Flesh Raiders were organized into an army by the Dark Jedi Bengel Morr around 3643 BBY.
Urlos Du'Ram was a male Human pirate of the Death's Claw pirate gang who resided on Taris. Around 3643 BBY, he was killed by a Republic-affiliated individual.

Berr Irichmin was a male Nautolan Jedi Master who lived during the Galactic War. Around 3642 BBY, he resided on Taris and was in the last stand the Galactic Republic made in Olaris, until he was defeated by an Imperial individual.
Maltok was the name of a nekghoul living on Taris around 3642 BBY, when he was killed by an individual affiliated with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Rousaul was a female Twi'lek doctor residing on Dromund Kaas around 3643 BBY, when she was killed by an Empire-affiliated individual. She was part of a secret Republic mission to spy on Kaas City.
Martonn was a male Zabrak inciter residing on Dromund Kaas around 3643 BBY, when he was killed by an Empire-affiliated individual.
Tripton was a male Human who held the position of Field Commander in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire.
Pammel Tarqus was a male Human doctor who worked for the rebellious Sith Lord Grathan on Dromund Kaas around 3643 BBY, when he was killed by an Empire-affiliated individual.
Sharpclaw was the name of a vine cat residing on Dromund Kaas around 3643 BBY, when it was killed by an Empire-affiliated individual.

A Human male known only as the Prophet of Vodal Kressh led the army of Vodal Kressh's followers on the planet of Athiss during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Kneely was a male Nautolan captain of the Galactic Republic. In 3640 BBY he was stationed on a Republic space station above Ilum.
Alie was a female Togruta private of the Galactic Republic. In 3640 BBY she was stationed on a Republic space station above Ilum selling gear components.
Zarius was a male Human Jedi Master. He was present on Ilum in 3640 BBY.
Fandar was a male pirate who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was known as the "Pirate Prince."
Lord Inath was a male Human Sith subordinate of Darth Hadra residing on Dromund Kaas around 3643 BBY, when he was killed by an Empire-affiliated individual.
Howler was the name of a jurgoran residing on the reconstituted Sith Empire's capital Dromund Kaas around 3643 BBY, when it was killed by an Imperial-affiliated individual.

Karric Soik was a male Miraluka Jedi who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. Around 3643 BBY, he resided on Dromund Kaas when he was killed by an Imperial-affiliated individual.
Shekra was a male Trandoshan who was part of an eight-man gang that crossed the Exchange sometime before their capture and incarceration by the Galactic Republic in the Belsavis prison.
Redivus was a male Weequay prisoner who broke out of the Belsavis prison during a break around 3641 BBY. He was hunted down as part of a bounty by the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt.
Noumeian was a male Gamorrean who was part of an eight-man gang that crossed the Exchange sometime before their capture and incarceration by the Galactic Republic in the Belsavis prison.
Palak-Ti was a male Rattataki prisoner who broke out of the Belsavis prison during a break around 3641 BBY. He was killed in the Rattataki Battlewoods sometime after breaking out.
Long Claw was a jurgoran residing on Belsavis during the Cold War. He was killed around 3641 BBY.

Ogun, also known as Ogun the Destroyer, was a male Sith pureblood and Force-user imprisoned on Belsavis by the Galactic Republic. He broke out of the Belsavis prison during a break around 3641 BBY, but was killed sometime after breaking out.
Gorakus was the name of a mawvorr living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Kalahk the Hunter was a male Gormak warrior living on Voss during the Galactic War. He was killed around 3640 BBY.
This Weequay was part of the security personnel for the mag-lev on Coruscant.
Zukkus was the name of a Vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Krakkus was the name of a vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Drumond was the name of a vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Vrakus was the name of a nexu living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Kanis was the name of a vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed in the Pelath-Ri Marches around 3640 BBY.
Grikton, also known as Grikton the Deceiver, was a male Gormak warrior living on Voss during the Galactic War. He was killed around 3640 BBY.
Tittus, also known as Tittus the Destroyer, was the name of a vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Kleiv, also known as Kleiv the Wanderer, was the name of a diseased vorantikus that lived in the Nightmare Lands of the planet Voss, prowling the Sha-Thes Meadow. It was slain around 3640 BBY.
Drakus, also known as Drakus the Devourer, was the name of a vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Vitrous, also known as Vitrous the Vile, was the name of a vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Qusak was the name of a vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed in the Nightmare Lands around 3640 BBY.
Sorak was the name of a Vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Zrak, also known as Zrak the Twisted, was the name of a terentatek living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Tarkunis, also known as Tarkunis the Watcher, was a male Gormak warrior living on Voss during the Cold War. He was killed around 3640 BBY.
Krukal was a male Gormak seer living on Voss during the Galactic War. He was killed around 3640 BBY.

Brakka the Inquisitor was a male Gormak living on Voss during the Galactic War. Brakka was among the Gormak guarding the Gormegan-1 starship while it was under construction. He was killed around 3640 BBY.
Boss Zraska was a female Gormak living on Voss during the Galactic War. She was killed around 3640 BBY.
Kurik the Defiler was the name of a Vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3640 BBY.
Tre'vor Kirieleison was a male Weequay pirate living during the Cold War. He became affiliated with the White Maw pirates on Hoth and was killed around 3641 BBY.
Zakxon Gewchi was a male Nautolan Mandalorian living during the Cold War. He was present at Tauntaun Ridge on Hoth, where he was killed around 3641 BBY.
Kazianna Alvamma was a female Cathar pirate living during the Cold War. She became affiliated with the White Maw pirates on Hoth and was killed around 3642 BBY.
Icefang was a massive Pantran whitefang living on Hoth during the Galactic War. It was killed around 3641 BBY.
Dootu Mu Bacha was a male Talz droid engineer living during the Cold War. He was stationed on Hoth around 3641 BBY, when he was killed.

Stev Brygies was a male Human soldier of the Galactic Republic stationed on Hoth during the Cold War along with Jon Brygies, his relative. Both were killed by Imperial-affiliated individuals around 3642 BBY.

Jon Brygies was a male Human soldier of the Galactic Republic stationed on Hoth during the Cold War along with Stev Brygies, his relative. Both were killed by Imperial-affiliated individuals around 3642 BBY.
Gosular was a male Human commander in service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Around 3642 BBY he was stationed on Hoth, where he was killed.
A Human male commander of the Galactic Republic's Xesh Squad was stationed on Hoth around 3642 BBY, when he was killed.
Karo Dunder was a male Human criminal in the Cold War. Around 3643 BBY he was present in on Nar Shaddaa, where he was killed.
Varus Logan was a male Human and leader of the Street Skifters who was present on Nar Shaddaa during the Galactic War, and was killed around 3642 BBY.
Hogan was a male Twi'lek major of the Galactic Republic present in Republic Power Generation on Nar Shaddaa around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Kallakar, also known as Kallakar the Savage, was a male Nikto residing on Nar Shaddaa around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Kaeden Ta'kor was a male Human residing on Nar Shaddaa around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Kallik Kan was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto residing on Nar Shaddaa around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Sam Ryus was a male Human who served as member of the Jedi Order during the time of the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Skrall was the name of a Sleen which escaped from the Coronet Zoo on Corellia around 3640 BBY and was subsequently killed.
Redris Korin was a male Human who served as member of the Green Jedi during the time of the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Jacus Redick was a male Human who served as member of the Green Jedi during the time of the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Harken was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto commander stationed on Corellia in 3640 BBY, when he was killed.
Krallys the Wild was the name of an Acklay which escaped from the Coronet Zoo on Corellia in 3640 BBY and was subsequently killed.
Jimme Weasle was a male Human residing on Corellia around 3640 BBY, when he was killed.
Eric Ericsen was a male Mandalorian residing on Corellia in 3640 BBY, when he was killed.
Rashal was a male Human Sith Lord residing on Corellia in 3640 BBY, when he was killed by Republic forces.
Kalmic was a male Human admiral of the reconstituted Sith Empire stationed on Corellia in 3640 BBY, when he was killed.
The Crystal Eater was the name given to a guid living on Ilum in 3640 BBY, when it was killed.
Graymane was the name of a guid living on Ilum in 3640 BBY, when it was killed.
Telleon was a male Twi'lek foreman residing on Quesh around 3642 BBY, when he was killed.
Yanu Selke was a male Human residing on Quesh around 3642 BBY, when he was killed.
Saryta was a female Human Jedi Master stationed on Quesh around 3642 BBY, when she was killed.
Rhexa was a male Sith Lord of the Sith species stationed on Quesh around 3642 BBY, when he was killed.
Xoltyr N'lson was a male Human residing on Balmorra around 3642 BBY, when he was killed.
Tynes was a male Human commander of the Sith Empire stationed on Korriban around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.

Vald Inosp was a male Human Jedi who lived during the Cold War. He fell to the dark side and was present on Korriban where he met his demise at the hands of a Sith Acolyte while he was investigating a Rakata Datacron in the Tomb of Tulak Hord that contained a Red Matrix Shard.
Bilinguis was the name of a Barbed ginx living on Makeb until around 3638 BBY, when it was killed.
Grim Tooth was a rancor kept in a containment cell at the Sanctuary research complex on the planet Makeb. During the Conquest of Makeb in 3638 BBY, Grim Tooth was killed.

Nigh Kris was a Male Human spymaster who was employed by Prodoranya the Hutt. During the Conquest of Makeb, Nigh Kris and Prodoranya's assassin J'virgo N'yen accompanied Prodoranya to Solida Hesk's resort on Makeb, where the two were killed.
Ka'pkar was the name of a creature living on Makeb until 3638 BBY, when it was killed.

L'raak was a Mantellian Savrip that, along with Sterrin and Renak, served the Hutt Archon Szajin as a scout during the Conquest of Makeb around 3638 BBY. L'raak was equipped with a cybernetic arm with a mounted cannon, and wore armor.

Sterrin was a Mantellian Savrip that, along with L'raak and Renak, served the Hutt Archon Szajin as a scout during the Conquest of Makeb in 3638 BBY. The trio were assigned to the Cartel mining mesa, where they were slain.

Renak was a Mantellian Savrip that, along with L'raak and Sterrin, served the Hutt Archon Szajin as a scout during the Conquest of Makeb in 3638 BBY. The trio were assigned to the Cartel mining mesa, where they were slain.

Suz-Anz was a female Jedi Master residing on Makeb with her Apprentice, Lyla. The two were outcasts, and both eventually fell to the dark side. They meditated on Makeb together until 3638 BBY, when both were killed.

Lyla was a Cathar female residing on Makeb with her Master, Suz-Anz. The two were outcasts, and both eventually fell to the dark side. They meditated on Makeb together until 3638 BBY, when both were killed.
Tumble Weed was the name of a makrin creeper that lived on Makeb until 3639 BBY, when it was killed.
Jax Stog was a male Human residing on Ord Mantell around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Gajoru the Vault Guardian was a male Weequay residing on Hutta around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Talon was a male who was considered to be a great man, and was talked about in the same breaths as Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.
A pasty-skinned male Twi'lek was part of the Ryloth Senatorial Delegation led by Senator Orn Free Taa in the last years of Finis Valorum's Chancellorship.
Phylo Daan was a Twi'lek male smuggler working for Black Sun on Balmorra around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Grandfather was the name of an aggressive giant bormu living on Balmorra in the year 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Devsh was a Human male captain of the Galactic Republic stationed on Balmorra with his squad around 3643 BBY, when they were killed.

An'bal was a female Human who served the noble House Organa as a Grand Marshal in their military forces during the Alderaan Civil War. She commanded the Organa medical camp in the Juran Mountains, but was slain during an Imperial assault on the camp.
Trapjaw was the name given to a massive wraid that roamed the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Kortawa the Hunt Master was a male Tusken Raider living on Tatooine until 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Seigford Grey was a male Human Jedi Master residing on Tatooine around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Roh'Saren the Red was a male Tusken Raider chief living on Tatooine until 3643 BBY, when he was killed.

Garrok was a male Tusken Raider chief who lived on the desert world of Tatooine during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. In the year 3643 BBY, he was killed whilst amongst the Tusken camps built in the Northern Jundland Wastes.
Brenak the Strategist was a male Geonosian residing on Tatooine around 3643 BBY, when he was killed by a Republic individual.
Nekra, also known as Nekra the Warlord, was a male Geonosian residing in the Mendacious Oasis on Tatooine around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Deshor the Tactician was a male Geonosian residing on Tatooine around 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
Polarin the War Marshal was a male Geonosian residing in the Manister Base on Tatooine around 3643 BBY, when he was killed by a Republic individual.
Towe was a Zabrak male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire residing on Tatooine until 3643 BBY, when he was killed.
An unnamed chief scientist worked for the Imperial Navy and Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin during the Galactic Civil War. He was head of the project in developing the advanced TIE/D Defender.

An unnamed officer served in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. He selected by Darth Vader to be part the crew of the Empirical, a scientific research vessel, around 2 BBY. He was tasked with informing the crew of the ship's status via intercom system.

The First was the name given to an enormous yozusk that lived in the swamps and jungle south of Kaas City on the planet Dromund Kaas. During the Cold War, the First occupied a region of the Malignant Bog known as the Fen of the First until it was killed.
Snowblind was the name of a giant Pantran whitefang living on Hoth until 3642 BBY, when it was killed on the its hunting grounds in the Crystal Wastes.

Subject Alpha was the name given to a massive lurker that roamed the shallow waters of Lake Brell, an acid lake in the Brell Sediment on the planet Taris, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Ancient One was the name of a giant k'lor'slug queen living on Taris until 3642 BBY, when it was killed by Imperial forces during the invasion of Taris.
Zorn was a drouk who was controlled by Handler Murdok, a member of the Warstalkers, on Denova. Toth and another drouk, Toth, were slain in battle in 3639 BBY.

Vorgath was a Human male colonel in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire who was influenced by the Dread Masters into joining the Dread Host on Denova. He was slain in battle in 3639 BBY.
Toth was a drouk who was controlled by Handler Murdok, a member of the Warstalkers, on Denova. Toth and another drouk, Zorn, were slain in battle in 3639 BBY.
Thrasher was the name of a female reek who was killed on Darvannis around 3638 BBY.
Odis P. Valyn was a Human male major of the Galactic Republic stationed on Belsavis during the Galactic War.

A security guard worked at an Imperial factory during the reign of the Galactic Empire. While the guard was working at the facility the rogue MI-series security droid, MI-726 attacked the factory and encountered the guard.

Dorbus Kyrullus was a male individual who was dating the Human Devidia Vennsiol by the time she finished military school. Together with his lover, Kyrullus broke into a laboratory operated by Safidine Industries, a weapons contractor for the Galactic Empire.

A male Human local official on the planet Sacorria was the father of Devidia Vennsiol. When Devidia was a child, he allowed her to do as she pleased with little consequence, spoiling and pampering her.

Vano Baruk was a renowned Rodian male crime lord active during the time of the Cold War, a proxy conflict between the reconstituted Sith Empire and Galactic Republic. He bribed officials of both factions with millions of credits.
An Ewok scout was active on the forest moon of Endor during the Galactic Civil War. He was armed with a spear.

The mother of Bertroff Hissa, a Grand Moff of the Galactic Empire, was a Sephi woman. She and her husband were former political agitators who had chosen to settle on PL-40112-CE-021105, a barren planet of the Wild Space, to lead a "simpler" and "more natural" life.

The father of Bertroff Hissa, a Grand Moff of the Galactic Empire, was a male of the Human species. He and his wife were former political agitators who had relocated on the uncharted planet of PL-40112-CE-021105 in search of a "simple and natural" lifestyle.
Nann was a male Human sergeant of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Residing on Vaiken Spacedock, Nann also shared his knowledge of treasure hunting to others.
