Sectoso was a male Human living during the Cold War. Residing on Carrick Station, Sectoso also shared his knowledge of underworld trading with others.

Hawek Yellip was an employee of Czerka Corporation who worked in the Czerka Sentient Resources Department as a Sentient Resources Specialist during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

During the Galactic Civil War Ydra Kilwallen married a man, and took his last name Sibwarra. Six months before the Battle of G'rho, Ydra was on vacation at her parents' when one of her fellow Force Adepts went missing on Chandrila. She took their son, Dev, and left the planet.
A sarlacc that had lived for centuries on the planet Duroon died of disease around 3643 BBY, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Milosh Varta was Human male living during the Cold War. A member of the Exchange on Tatooine, he lived with his wife Isbet Varta in his estate in the Jundland Wastes.
Mia Hawkins was a Human female terrorist living during the Cold War. She had a sister named Neyla, who was in charge of another terror cell.

Heitor Girard was the Vicebaron of House Girard during the Cold War. The father of Aitalla and uncle of Zacar, Heitor advised his nephew while they were allied with the House of Thul and reconstituted Sith Empire.

Zacar Girard was a Human male Baron of House Girard during the Cold War and his family's alliance with the House of Thul and the resurgent Sith Empire. The nephew of Heitor, cousin of Aitalla, and father of Raffid, Zacar met a bounty hunter who became his House's advocate.

Raffid Girard was the womanizing son of Zacar Girard. Alive during the Cold War, Raffid seduced at least one married Thul woman before his father was murdered by unknown means, though his uncle Heitor Girard suspects Raffid to be the culprit.
Isbet Varta was Human female living during the Cold War. Married to Milosh Varta, she lived with her husband in his estate in the Jundland Wastes on Tatooine.

A male Human with gray hair owned a pet store on Coruscant at the height of the New Republic. Contrary to many other shady businesses in the planet-wide city, his was a perfectly legitimate and well-stocked store. The Human was reputed for managing his shop in an effective way.
A blue-skinned exhibitor was the first sentient to ever display an ysalamir at the Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition, at some point at the height of the New Republic.
Victor "The Shade" Rist was a male Human member of House Rist, a group of elite assassins and nobles of Alderaan.
Dreeson was a Human male sergeant in the Republic Military of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was stationed in the Aurek Base on Hoth in 3642 BBY.

Kitit was a Jawa collector living during the Cold War. Along with fellow Jawas Nbat and Efa, Kitit was the one to discover an old Czerka droid, containing information on the excavation of The Imprisoned One's mind prison.

Nbat was a Jawa collector living during the Cold War. Along with fellow Jawas Kitit and Efa, Nbat was the one to discover an old Czerka droid, containing information on the excavation of The Imprisoned One's mind prison.

Efa was a Jawa collector living during the Cold War. Along with fellow Jawas Kitit and Nbat, Efa was the one to discover an old Czerka droid, containing information on the excavation of The Imprisoned One's mind prison.
Xander was a Human male officer who served in the Mantellian Separatist Movement during the Cold War. Around 3643 BBY, he helped Governor Chornarov seize power on Cademimu V.
Lelek was a Force-sensitive female Jawa Shaman who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Ekayn Liistot was a male Nautolan living during the Cold War. Together with his sister, Sabaya Liistot, he ran an illegal augmentation shop the moon Nar Shaddaa. Around 3643 BBY, the shop was visited by Cipher Nine, who was looking to purchase a dose of Cyclone.

Sabaya Liistot was a female Nautolan living during the Cold War. Together with her brother Ekayn Liistot she ran an illegal augmentation shop on Nar Shaddaa. Around 3643 BBY it was visited by Cipher Nine who was looking to purchase a dose of Cyclone.
Bargos the Hutt was a middle-ranked Hutt Cartel crime lord living on hard times in a palace somewhere on the Outer Rim.
Clayton Balrog was an Imperial Zero-G assault stormtrooper in command of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT.
This Imperial soldier was a male serving in the army of the reconstituted Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra, during the Cold War in 3642 BBY.
Cann Doon was a male smuggler who dealt with Jabba the Hutt. He was present outside Jabba's Palace, unloading cargo from his ship supervised by Bidlo Kwerve, when a Jawa sandcrawler approached.
Kloff was a male Culroon who united the planet Culroon III and ended the continual conflict through the application of imported energy weapons.

Yerkys Neir was a creature handler who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Neir conducted operations as part of the Galactic Empire's support staff in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the planet Dathomir.

Tyris Santorini was a creature handler who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Santorini conducted operations as part of the Galactic Empire's support staff in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the planet Dathomir.

Skrat Horle was a lab assistant who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Horle conducted operations as part of the Galactic Empire's science staff in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the planet Dathomir.

Marpo Glenfik was a Human male lab assistant who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Glenfik was part of the Galactic Empire's science staff in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on the planet Dathomir.

Trex was a Trandoshan bounty hunter in the employ of Hutt Cartel crime lord Teemo, and the former captain and owner of the Krayt Fang, a reddish-brown-colored YT-1300 light freighter that was stolen from him by a group of adventurers while it was grounded for maintenance.

An unidentified regent was appointed on the planet of Alderaan in 32 BBY. He or she served as acting viceroy in the absence of Bail Prestor Organa, who had been forced to abandon his function to become senator of the Alderaan sector.

Rigel was a Zabrak male who was a Director within the Republic Strategic Information Service. Stationed on Republic warship Gav Daragon, he recruited Republic-allied individuals to put a stop to Directive 7, the droid revolution started by the droid known as Mentor.

Arnell Hyland was a female Human who worked for her relative Addalar Hyland's company Galactic Solutions Industries during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Vigilant was a male Flesh Raider from the planet Tython that had been biologically altered to become the living security system for CZ-198, a research facility for Czerka Corporation, at the orders of Special Executive Rasmus Blys.

Iggjel's friend was an Ithorian who was part of the Wayland Herd. A tender-in-training, Iggjel's friend accompanied him when the young Ithorian left for the Mother Jungle sometime before 3951 BBY, although did not join him on the surface.
Januaris was a female agent in Alliance Intelligence, working in the Bespin system under Intelligence Bureau Chief Milo Thirk.

Shiraben Dheas was a male Human bounty hunter and a member of the Bounty Brokers Association living during the Cold War and Galactic War. At the BBA outpost on Carrick Station he handled the bounty contract management.

Eidgar Dheas was a male Human bounty hunter and a member of the Bounty Brokers Association living during the Cold War and Galactic War. At the BBA outpost on the Vaiken Spacedock he handled the bounty contract management.

Ariavos was a male Human living during the Galactic War. At one point he resided on Ord Mantell where he used the Bounty Brokers Association to put a bounty onto ex-Republic Colonel Brogon and his henchmen, who defected and turned to extortion.

Brogon was a male colonel of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. While stationed on Ord Mantell, he and many other soldiers turned to extorting the citizens and refugees and eventually defected from the Republic, taking to crime full-time.

Tam Daral was a male Human living during the Galactic War. Along with other workers of Coruscant he used the Bounty Brokers Association to put a bounty on former Czerka Corporation executive Samovan Bann, who allied himself with the Black Sun.
Samovan Bann was a Human male who worked as an executive of Czerka Corporation around the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Lo'tar was a male Twi'lek living during the Galactic War. A servant of a Hutt on Nal Hutta he was tasked with putting down an Evocii named Grov the Destroyer. Incapable of doing that on his own, Lo'tar simply used the Bounty Brokers Association to put a bounty of Grov's head.
Grov, also known as Grov the Destroyer, was an male Evocii gangster who rose to power on the planet Nal Hutta during the Galactic War.

Manus was a male Chiss officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Stationed in Kaas City on Dromund Kaas, he used the Bounty Brokers Association to put a bounty onto the Sith Lord Trok, who tried to recruit Exchange forces to her service.

Otheros was a male Cathar living during the Galactic War. A proud owner of the Haven's Blaze casino on Nar Shaddaa, he used the Bounty Brokers Association to put a bounty on the gangsters from the rival Lucky Runner casino.
Meerko was a male Jawa living on Tatooine during the Galactic War. He used the Bounty Brokers Association to put a bounty on a Mandalorian Kreegan Ramar, who was terrorizing the Meerko Clan.

Kreegan Ramar was a male Mandalorian mercenary living during the Cold War and Galactic War. He and his henchmen were terrorizing the Jawa Meerko Clan on Tatooine, which caused Meerko to use the Bounty Brokers Association to place a bounty on his head.

Sama Zo was a male Voss commando living during the Galactic War. He used the Bounty Brokers Association to put a bounty on a local Exchange leader Eryn Talosa - an off-worlder solution for an off-worlder problem.
Eryn Talosa was a Twi'lek female Exchange leader on Voss during the Galactic War. A Voss commando Sama Zo put a bounty on her head.

Dariana Frayus was a female Human matriarch of House Frayus of Alderaan during the Galactic War. She used the Bounty Brokers Association to put a bounty on Claw, the leader of a local hooligan band and her son.
Claw was a nickname that a male Human, son of Dariana Frayus of House Frayus of Alderaan, took after he turned to crime and became leader of his own gang.
Domi Omus was a female Human information broker living during the Cold War and Galactic War.

Kelia Freen was a female Human information broker who was active during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Freen had brown hair, orange eyes, and tan skin. They were clothed in a black outfit with white and light green accents.
Marco Zarik was a male Human information broker living during the Cold War and Galactic War.
Torgan was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto information broker living during the Cold War and Galactic War.

Dekk'lar was a Rutian Twi'lek male information broker who was active during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Dekk'lar had blue eyes and skin and was clothed in a black and white armored jacket, red pants, and a utility belt.

Kar'wa was a female Twi'lek criminal who was a henchman of a local crime lord during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Kar'wa's lieutenants were known as "Twin Cannons."

Aja Novar was a female Human criminal who was a henchman of a local crime lord during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Novar carried a large blaster cannon in battle, and her lieutenants were known as "Face Butchers."

Zinda Kent was a female Human criminal who was a henchman of a local crime lord during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. A sniper, Kent was fair-skinned and had blond hair and a cybernetic eye, and her lieutenants were known as "Blade Sisters."

Udo Ensh was a male Human criminal who was a henchman of a crime lord during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. A dark-skinned man with long gray hair and a topknot, Ensh wielded a large vibrosword in battle.
Sogan Sur was a male Zabrak criminal who was a henchman of a local crime lord during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Novane was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto criminal who was a henchman of a local crime lord during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Novane's lieutenants were known as "Cold-Blooded Brothers."
T'rubba was a male Rutian Twi'lek criminal who was a henchman of a crime lord during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

An moisture farmer who was a sympathizer of the Rebel Alliance lived on Tatooine at some point during the Galactic Civil War. A male of the Human species, he owned a moisture farm north-east of the city of Mos Eisley.
Vikto was a male Zabrak Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Solania was a male Human who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi Master during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. A tan-skinned Human with black eyes and a black goatee, Solania wore gray robes and armor or a set of yellow-brown combat armor.

17786 was the designation given to one of the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers. They were the offspring of Nial Declann. At some point, they had been recruited into the Emperor's Hand Arden Lyn's ranks to be trained in Teräs Käsi.
Aphel Jaarn was a Human male cyborg technician during the Cold War.
A starship captain served on the bridge of a consular ship under the command of Ambassador Zell of the planet Majoor during a peace mission to the planet Armath.
Lisum was a male botanist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

A male communications officer was a member of the Galactic Alliance Defense Force in 44 ABY, serving in Starfighter Command. At the time, he was stationed on Skifter Station in orbit over the planet Kuratooine.

Ar'al Anec was a male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War, Anec was a part of a joint team sent by the Empire and House Thul to establish a base in old Jedi ruins in the Glarus Valley on Alderaan.

Gurgot was a male Gamorrean guard who worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he was one of the guards at Jabba's Palace on the planet of Tatooine.

Deral Thul was a male Human member of the Alderaanian Great House of Thul who served as a Sith Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Alderaan Civil War, a part of the galactic Cold War between the Sith and the Galactic Republic.
Dix Tarfait was a Gotal male who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, making a living as a small-time liquor distributor.
Pash was a male Human smuggler pilot that had seen a series of mishaps and hard knocks that ironically kept him from being killed when the planet Alderaan was destroyed by the Death Star.

Saarcheen was a male Wookiee from Kashyyyk. In the second century before the Galactic Civil War, he took part in a dangerous expedition in the Shadowlands with older Wookiees, and he witnessed the untimely death of his best friend Barraak.
Lix was a male, rat-like individual who worked as a slaver. He was active around 185 BBY and was a known associate of a Human named Nishrah and a Talz named Twool.

Barraak was a male Wookiee of the common rwook subspecies. from Kashyyyk. In 185 BBY, Barraak and his best friend Saarcheen accompanied three older Wookiees on an expedition in the Shadowlands of their homeworld, Kashyyyk.

Sibs Monchan was a Siniteen male entrepreneur who lived during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. Monchan made a living designing HoloNet interfaces, helping his firm, Monchantics, to earn him millions of credits.

"Rocket" was the nickname of a pilot within the 77th Air Wing's Sword Squadron during the early years of the Galactic Empire. Rocket fought at the Battle of Kelrodo-Ai during the Western Reaches Operation of 17 BBY.
By the time of the Cold War, a darksider guardian entity was responsible for protecting the ancient Jedi Master Rajivari's sanctuary, named the Fount of Rajivari, on Tython.

Damek-Ol was a male Gormak who studied the Force with the Jedi Order in the ancient past of Voss when Jedi and Sith fought on the planet; However, Damek-Ol's greed and arrogance of the consequences of learning the Force caused the birth of Sel-Makor; in later time during the G…
Vik was a male Devaronian who worked as a bartender at the Mos Shuuta Grill & Cantina in Mos Shuuta on the planet Tatooine.

Ritte Nikols was a Human male who was the son of Captain Arrin Nikols of the InterStellar Regulators mercenary army and his wife Blanca Nikols. A fair-skinned Human with black eyes, Ritte inherited his mother's black hair.

Annileen Calwell, (née Thaney) nicknamed Annie, was a female Human storekeeper who lived in Dannar's Claim, in the Pika Oasis. The widow of Dannar Calwell, she was also the mother of Kallie and Jabe, and a friend of Leelee Pace.

Orrin Gault was a male human moisture farmer and the father of Mullen and the twins Varan and Veeka. Gault led the Settlers' Call Fund, a vigilante organization meant to protect the farmers of Tatooine from Tusken Raiders.
Veeka Gault was a female Human moisture farmer, the daughter of Orrin Gault, the sister of Mullen Gault and the twin sister of Varan Gault.

Varan Gault was a male Human who lived on Tatooine during the waning days of the Galactic Republic. Varan was the son of Orrin Gault, the younger brother of Mullen Gault and the twin brother of Veeka Gault. He died in an accident when he was sixteen years old.
Jabe Calwell was the son of Dannar and Annileen Calwell, two Human Merchants of the Pika Oasis. He was also the brother of Kallie Calwell.
Mullen Gault was a male Human moisture farmer, son of Orrin Gault and brother of the twins Varan and Veeka Gault.
Kallie Calwell, was the daughter of Dannar and Annileen Calwell, two Human Merchants of the Pika Oasis. She was also the sister of Jabe Calwell.
Dannar Calwell, was the male Human founder of the Dannar's Claim in the Pika Oasis. The husband of Annileen Calwell, he was also the father of Kallie and Jabe Calwell.

In 138 ABY, a Human officer was stationed aboard the Star Destroyer Animus. After the ship responded to a distress call from AG-37's freighter with Ania Solo aboard and picked up the freighter, the officer greeted Solo and informed her that Empress Marasiah Fel was impressed w…

Usk Haffa was a Bivall male property magnate who was the largest real-estate owner on the world Protobranch during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. At some point, Haffa accompanied the liner Salin Mariner on a luxury cruise.
Twiggs, also known as Twiggsie was a male Kobarian swamp dog that lived during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.
A twelve-year-old Duros girl named Alysssa Maggrit ran a numbers racket for her uncle in the city of Tolea Biqua above the planet Genarius at the beginning of the Clone Wars.

A female named Alyssa operated as a slicer on the HoloNet under the alias alyssaroxu during the beginning of the Clone Wars. The inept fellow slicer wampa1 misidentified alyssaroxu as one Alysssa Maggrit in a failed attempt to publicly reveal her true name on the HoloNet.
This certain Weequay was the elected president of a meeting of Weequays. The purpose of the meeting was to discover the unknown assassin who had been terrorizing the hallways of Jabba's Palace.

This certain Weequay was the elected secretary-treasurer of a meeting of Weequays. The purpose of the meeting was to discover the unknown assassin who had been terrorizing the hallways of Jabba's Palace.
Ben Moordriver was a man who lived on the planet Tatooine in 19 BBY. He made a living selling sand sculptures out of the back of his repulsortruck.
Pelf Pachoola was a Wroonian who was the daughter of the aristocrat Fume Pachoola. She was spoiled and prone to emotional breakdowns, and marriage was arranged between her and a fiancé.

Fume Pachoola was a wealthy Wroonian male aristocrat who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. Due to his grandfather having amassed a large fortune, Fume never had to work and he lived a life of luxury.

During the time of the Galactic Republic, a Wroonian male amassed a large fortune. As a result, the Wroonian's grandson, Fume Pachoola, was able to live off his grandfather's wealth without ever having to work.

During the latter years of the Galactic Republic, a male individual became engaged to the wealthy Wroonian Pelf Pachoola. However, after Pachoola was kidnapped and held hostage by the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka, her fiancé refused to pay a ransom for her release.
Kaat'o Leeachos was a Kadas'sa'Nikto male bounty hunter who operated during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Grabow was a Wookiee male from the planet Kashyyyk who lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

A female individual was married to the man Rikel, the head technician of the destructive Centerpoint Station during the Battle of Centerpoint Station. They were married in secret, because neither her family nor his approved of them being together.

Factor Jarvus was a male Human of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. He was stationed on Nar Shaddaa and presented a task to a fellow Imperial. He was sent to Nar Shaddaa by the Sith Empire to buy designs for experimental armor.

Raythen Predot was a Human male living during the Cold War. He worked for the VerveGen Corporation on Nar Shaddaa, which in turn was a part of the Eagle's network. He was killed by an Imperial Agent Cipher Nine, who infiltrated VerveGen around 3643 BBY.

Chorto Rinn was a Human male living during the Cold War. He headed the White Wing, a branch of the Eagle's network on the moon Nar Shaddaa, and oversaw the network's dealings with VerveGen Corporation.

Ghoss was a male Devaronian living during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Residing on Nar Shaddaa, he managed a small vendor stand, selling various stimulants.
Thothash was a male Nikto living during the Cold War and a member of the Cult of Ki Sazen, a Nikto cult that worshiped the fallen Jedi Ki Sazen.
Chevuk was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto living during the Cold War and a Chosen of the Cult of Ki Sazen, which worshiped the fallen Jedi Ki Sazen.
Bo'kesh was a male Nikto living during the Cold War and a Chosen of the Cult of Ki Sazen that worshipped the fallen Jedi Ki Sazen.
Fhentar was a male Nikto living during the Cold War and a Chosen of the Nikto cult that worshipped the fallen Jedi Ki Sazen.
Hathox Greb was a male Hrakian spacer living in times of the Galactic Civil War.

Kayd was a female Human Imperial Agent of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War. She was stationed on Nar Shaddaa and asked a fellow Imperial to put a stop to a spice smuggling operation that got many other Imperials addicted.
The Spine Dragon of M'dweshuu was a spine dragon who was killed by the Jedi Padawan Ki Sazen during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Sarnok was a Twi'lek male who, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, sold starship upgrades on Nar Shaddaa.
"Engine Oil" Keratho was a male Human living during the Cold War. Residing on Tatooine in Mos Ila Spaceport, he sold various starship components.

Charnso was a male Human officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Stationed on Tatooine in Mos Ila Spaceport, he acted as a liaison between the Moff Merile Yurrion and a fellow Imperial.
Gorik was a Human male colonel of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Stationed on Tatooine around 3643 BBY, he at one point requested an audience with Moff Merile Yurrion.

Sarinte was a male Human ensign of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Stationed on Tatooine in Mos Ila Spaceport, he directed fellow Imperials arriving on the planet to the local branch of the Imperial Reclamation Service.

Trason was a male Human lieutenant in the Imperial Reclamation Service of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Stationed on Tatooine in Mos Ila, he asked a fellow Imperial to deal with the local sabotage problem.
Danurorus was a male Mirialan living during the Cold War. Residing in Mos Ila on Tatooine, he managed a small vendor stand, selling various modification upgrades.
Pretrex was a male Human living during the Cold War. Residing in Mos Ila on Tatooine, he managed a small vendor stand, selling various stimulants.
Meller was a male Human supply officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War and stationed on Tatooine in Mos Ila.
Undaara was a female Human Sith Warrior of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Residing on Tatooine in Mos Ila, she also shared her knowledge with other Sith.
Vajar was a male Human Sith Lord of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Residing on Tatooine in Mos Ila, he also shared his knowledge with other Sith.
Vilos was a male Human commander of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Stationed on Tatooine in Mos Ila, he asked a fellow Imperial to investigate the rumor of Force-sensitive Jawas.

Datto Wys was a male Human with a droid shop living in the city of Mos Ila on the planet of Tatooine during the Cold War. Around 3643 BBY he unwittingly served as a go-between contact between Mia Hawkins and Cipher Nine.
Herm was a male Human ensign of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War and stationed on Tatooine in Mos Ila.
Veir was a male Human major of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Stationed on Tatooine in Mos Ila, he asked a fellow Imperial to deal with the local Exchange operation.
Phrague was a male Human living during the Cold War. Residing in Mos Ila on Tatooine, he managed a small vendor stand, selling various stimulants.
Freher Wonn was a male Human member of the Sons of Palawa living on Tatooine during the Cold War.

Kawrelak was a general in the Army of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Around 3643 BBY Kawrelak's Sith advisor read the report of Commander Vilos from Tatooine regarding possible sighting of Force-sensitive Jawas.

Berow was a female Human Sith Lord of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War and the apprentice of Darth Serevin. Residing on Tatooine in Mos Ila, she asked an Imperial working for commander Vilos to destroy any Jawas that proved to be Force-sensitive.
Pitkth was a Jawa living during the Cold War. Residing in Mos Ila on Tatooine, Pitkth sold various stimulants.
Thint was a Jawa living during the Cold War. Residing in Camp Can'ali on Tatooine, Thint at one point revealed to an Imperial the details of Czerka's excavation of The Imprisoned One's mind prison.
Lana Corrs was a female Human of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. Stationed on Tatooine in Mos Ila, she asked a fellow Imperial to retrieve a special power generator from the local Jawas.
Kench was a male Human officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War and stationed on Tatooine, where he engaged in selling stimulants.
Viic was a male Zabrak who held the rank of commander within a military force serving the Galactic Republic, during the Cold War between the Republic and the Sith Empire.
Luke Skywalker was a Jedi General for the Aquilae, as well as one of the survivors of the Knights of Sith's attack on the Jedi-Bendu. He was the mentor of Annikin Starkiller.
Deak Starkiller was a male human and the son of Kane Starkiller.
Bail Antilles was a human galactic trader and a confederate of the Aquillian Ranger Clieg Whitsun. He was as a rugged-looking man wearing fur and golden ornaments.

Darth Vader was the name of a male Human who served the New Galactic Empire as the General of its armed forces. A highly decorated officer, he possessed severe scarring on his face, and also had his left eye replaced with a cybernetic, giving off a deep red hue.
Leia was a 14-year-old princess, the spoiled daughter of King Kayos and Queen Breha of Aquilae. She had two brothers, Biggs and Windy.

Montross was an aide to General Luke Skywalker on Aquilae. In a war room, Montross placed everyone on alert and later reported a giant asteroid or moon—an early version of the Death Star—approaching Aquilae.
Biggs was a prince, as well as the son of King Kayos and Queen Breha of Aquilae. He had a brother, Windy, and a sister, Leia.
Windy was a prince, as well as the son of King Kayos and Queen Breha of Aquilae. He had a brother, Biggs, and a sister, Leia.
Trellev Aquem was a male individual who served as a senator in the Imperial Senate on the planet Coruscant during the early years of the Galactic Empire.

Tray'Essek was a male Trandoshan criminal enforcer who was active during the early years of the Galactic Empire. At one point in his past, Tray'Essek was humiliated and betrayed by his fellow clansman Lar'omx.

Sinoca Meeku, also known as Sin, was a Rodian female who lived during the early years of the Galactic Empire. Meeku was born into a family with a long history of working in the bounty hunting profession.

Matwe was a Human male who operated as a smuggler during the early years of the Galactic Empire. Matwe was raised on the planet Coruscant and from an early age, he explored the Coruscant underworld with his brother Rikard and became known within Coruscant's criminal community.

Rikard was a Human male smuggler who was active during the early years of the Galactic Empire. Rikard spent his youth on the planet Coruscant, exploring the seedier districts of the world's undercity with his brother Matwe, and he later entered the service of the Pyke Syndicat…
Middish Sunblade was a male individual who lived during the galactic Cold War, around the time of a duel that occurred on the planet Odacer-Faustin.
Amanza Regalo was an individual who served as a vigo within the criminal organization Black Sun during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Coruum Sa'dia was an Ishi Tib male businessman who owned and operated the shipping concern Zelcomm Industries during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Zarus was a Human male who served as Field General of the Sith Empire during the Cold War.

During the Clone Wars, an unidentified female Sephi served as an aide to Senator Navi, who represented his native Sumitra sector in the Galactic Senate. She shared her duties with another Sephi woman named Lirka.
Abram Zavict was a Human male independent trader who was friends with the Balinaka sculptor Vornest Dep-thesel Digarsarg.

The father of Koth Melan was a male Bothan who worked as a teacher. He disagreed with the philosophy of the Galactic Empire, and attempted to educate his students of the government's nature. He was subsequently arrested by the Empire on false charges of espionage and executed.
A Bothan male served as Koth Melan's chief of security. He would occasionally act as a double for the spymaster and reportedly performed a credible impersonation.
Frang, better known as Frang the Toothless, was a crime lord on the planet Ord Mantell sometime before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Boskirn was a Houk bounty hunter who earned the nickname of "Bantha" Boskirn because of his size and lack of speed.

Adrazar was a beastmaster and Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire who resided in a domicile on the planet Dromund Kaas. Sometime before 3643 BBY, Adrazar sought to tame the scyk, a lizard-like creature from the planet Tatooine, and use the creatures as his servants.

t: Unidentified Jedi Knight (Way of the Guid)
x: A Jedi Knight was the former Padawan of Jedi Master Silvarte who had achieved the rank of Knight by the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The Sith beastmaster Adrazar attempted to train packs of scyks—reptiles from the planet Tatooine—sometime before the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. However, the creatures turned on each other and killed each other in a frenzy.

Tag Rogaren was a male Human from Alderaan who served in the Galactic Empire. During the construction of the first Death Star, Rogaren was chief weapons systems engineer. It was he who conceived and built the superlaser array of that battle station.
Gillehspy was an Imperial officer who held the rank of captain during the early years of the Galactic Empire. He commanded the Venator-class Star Destroyer Hound
Sheeli was a female Twi'lek who lived on Lok during the Galactic Civil War. She was the sister of Choster.
Haisha Su Bnist was a Human female from the Tapani sector who made a living as an information broker and petty thief during the reign of Galactic Empire.

Stephannis Koss was a Human male from the planet Bonadan who worked for the Corporate Sector Authority as a biological engineer. During the Galactic Civil War, when Koss was twenty-seven years old, the engineer developed several new enzymes for the CSA to improve crop production.
Bathoz was a botanist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Bathoz was murdered on Kashyyyk by the Canopy bandits.
Rengar was a botanist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Rengar was murdered on Kashyyyk by the Canopy bandits.
Jillian was a botanist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Jillian was murdered on Kashyyyk by the Canopy bandits.
A companion of Clarrisa was a Human male who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he decided to take Clarrisa on a surprise vacation to Mustafar.
A clone commando who wore yellow Katarn-class commando armor was a member of the High Orbit Precision Entry Squad, also known as H.O.P.E. Squad, around 19 BBY. His helmet made use of a rangefinder.

A clone commando who wore blue Katarn-class commando armor was a member of the High Orbit Precision Entry Squad, also known as H.O.P.E. Squad, around 19 BBY. He and his squad were sent to assist Jedi Master Treetower on Yorn Skot near the end of the Clone Wars.

A clone commando who wore green Katarn-class commando armor was a member of the High Orbit Precision Entry Squad, also known as H.O.P.E. Squad, around 19 BBY. He and his squad were sent to assist Jedi Master Treetower on Yorn Skot near the end of the Clone Wars.
Kalar'naa was a female Twi'lek dancer and agent for the Black Sun criminal syndicate who operated on the planet Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

A Human individual with black hair served as an officer of the Galactic Empire during the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin. Around the time of the Battle of Kalist VI, they were featured in an Imperial propaganda news feed.

t: Unidentified Imperial officer (Imperial cargo ship ambush)
x: In 0 ABY, a Human officer commanded a cargo vessel belonging to the Galactic Empire. However, after the Rebels attacked the convoy in a raid, he attempted to halt the Alliance Special Forces storming the bridge of his ship, but was overwhelmed.
Fivvle was the foreman of a Republic mining outpost that mined for tibanna near Mirial during the Clone Wars.
A clone trooper commander served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
This clone trooper served as a communications officer in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
This clone trooper sergeant served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Four-Four, designated Dash-1044, was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A female individual was a technician aboard the destructive Centerpoint Station during the Battle of Centerpoint Station of the Second Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and the Confederation—a regime that formed to aid the planet of Corellia …

Mairlenn was the female lead for Radanthus Mandelatara's production, Hearts of Empire. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, she lost her pet voorpak named Dotti to a pack of beasts. Angered, she demanded that Mandelatara find a way to 'punish' the beasts.

A male Rodian was a member of Kidd Kareen's Podracer crew around 22 BBY. He and the rest of Kareen's crew agreed with San Maxus to start helping the Separatists and Count Dooku in order to make enough money to retire from podracing all together.

Dotti was a pet voorpak belonging to the female entertainer Mairlenn. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Dotti was eaten by a pack of beasts in the Nabooian countrside. Angered, Mairlenn demanded that Radanthus Mandelatara find a way to 'punish' the beasts.

A male Gamorrean was a member of Kidd Kareen's Podracer crew around 22 BBY. He and the rest of Kareen's crew agreed with San Maxus to start helping the Separatists and Count Dooku in order to make enough money to retire from podracing all together.

A male Toydarian was a member of Kidd Kareen's Podracer crew around 22 BBY. He and the rest of Kareen's crew agreed with San Maxus to start helping the Separatists and Count Dooku in order to make enough money to retire from podracing all together.

A male Aqualish was a member of Kidd Kareen's Podracer crew around 22 BBY. He and the rest of Kareen's crew agreed with San Maxus to start helping the Separatists and Count Dooku in order to make enough money to retire from podracing all together.

A pair of male Kajain'sa'Niktos were members of Kidd Kareen's Podracer crew around 22 BBY. They and the rest of Kareen's crew agreed with San Maxus to start helping the Separatists and Count Dooku in order to make enough money to retire from podracing all together.
Mack was a male soldier of the Sith Empire fighting on Alderaan in the Cold War. He got himself injured and was being treated by Doctor Willem.

Grol was a lieutenant of the reconstituted Sith Empire fighting on Alderaan in the Cold War. He was the commanding officer of Sergeant Pratt and Sergeant Tegan. He was killed when trying to raid the House Alde estate.
Jinz Finzer was a male guild mining representative who operated on the plant Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Labsol Renuffi was a Human male technician who operated out of the Death Watch Bunker on the Forest Moon of Endor during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
A Rodian was a member of a group of pariahs who lived on the Outer Rim planet Ragmar V during the final year of the Clone Wars.
Hetl Darkrunner was a scientist who operated out of the Death Watch Bunker on the Forest Moon of Endor during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Fenn Kay'lay was a female Bothan who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Kay'lay was present on the planet Dathomir when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.

Snotharr was a male Wookiee chef who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Snotharr was present on the planet Dathomir when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.

Navik Geelo was a male Rodian who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Geelo was present on Dathomir when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.

A male Klatooinian was a member of a band of pariahs who lived in a settlement on the Outer Rim planet Ragmar V during the final year of the Clone Wars. The Klatooinian worked closely with another Klatooinian.

Graffam was a male Human Jedi who served the Jedi Order aboard the Galactic Republic space station Carrick Station, selling combat gear during the Cold War between the Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

KL-443 was an Imperial stormtrooper on the Star Destroyer Devastator in 0 ABY. The trooper left his post in the detention bay to check out sounds coming from one of the cells. Two Rebel agents, Wedge Antilles and Luke Skywalker, broke out of their cell in front of him.

Dugo Evnul was a male Sullustan who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Evnul was present on the planet Dathomir when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.

Tal Freykaa was a male Twi'lek who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Freykaa was present on the planet Dathomir when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.

Ool Awmod was a male Ithorian who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Awmod was present on the planet Dathomir when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.

A male agent worked for Duchess Thax of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Arhul Kurumenga was a general within the Imperial Department of Military Research in the Galactic Empire.

Ari was a fair-skinned Sephi. At one point in history, they fought with dual long knives. Sephi had dark eyes, sported long red hair, and favored light clothing that left them unhampered in their movements.

During the Galactic Civil War, an Imperial officer was bribed by members of the Bothan Spynet. The information he provided allowed the spynet to acquire information regarding a secret Imperial project.
An unidentified female Sephi served as a sentry guarding King Alaric's palace at the time of the Clone Wars. Along with a male pilot, she ther crew of the Sephi speeder known as Sentry Seven.

One-Eye was a Human bounty hunter who was active during the time of the New Republic. At some point, their right eye was replaced with cybernetics, which also covered a large scar over the eye, rendering them a cyborg.

Krugon was a Human scout who was active during the reign of the New Republic. Krugon was a bald, light-skinned individual who sported a red mustache and black eyebrows. They also had green colored eyes.

Veamon was a gray-eyed member of a blue-skinned humanoid alien species that worked as a scout during the reign of the New Republic during the years 5 and 10 ABY. Veamon wore dark-colored clothing, including a jacket with a red patch on the front-left side.

Santiago was a Human soldier who was alive during the reign of the New Republic, active during the years of 5 and 10 ABY. Santiago had light-colored skin, brown hair, brown eyes, and black eyebrows. They also had a large vertical scar going down their right eye.

Rugar was a Human soldier who lived during the reign of the New Republic. They wore light-colored clothing with a large red shape in the center of their shirt. Rugar had brown hair and eyes, though their eyebrows were black.
Kliskud was a Glottalphib female piratess who operated during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.

Yime Kalulez was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Naz Tulos was a male Rebel Alliance pilot who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Shalera the Hutt tasked a spacer with rescuing Tulos after he attacked a Corellian Security Force starship, mistaking them for Imperi…
Ulos Varellie was a henchman for Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Khypes was a general in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Dak Linser was a Rebel spy and scout who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Wilhalm Skrim tasked an Imperial operative with killing Linser and two other Rebel scouts.
Nethlek Vaa was a male Rutian Twi'lek informant who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Ananda Dwyce was a Human female who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Armennion Ullgusta was a filmmaker responsible for the holovid documentaries The Edict of Jiaan and Obeisance: Betrayal Within.

Soras Varn was the individual responsible for writing Bounty Hunter Means and Methods: Comparative Psychological Perspectives and Quantifications. It was first published in the proceedings of the Institute of Imperial Psychological Studies.
Parnax of Human or Sith pureblood descent who held the title of Sith Lord in the Sith Empire in the years before the Great Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

Torog was a Houk gladiator who competed in the arena on Besberra sometime before 3643 BBY. Torog fought off waves of wild animals and opponents for an hour before their neck was broken, but the Houk somehow managed to continue fighting for another four hours until they dropped…
"The Corellian" was the nickname of a notorious gangster from the planet Corellia who was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

During her travels, the Jedi Master Yuon Par became blood sister to a chieftain of the Kaleesh species sometime before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
A male individual served as the double of Palpatine, Dark Lord of the Sith and Galactic Emperor of the New Order.
Arjur was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who spent decades living with members of the Kubaz species in their hive in an effort to learn more about their culture through immersion in it.
Horoth Gendi was a Nikto who enslaved by a Hutt well before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

A Human male Imperial Advisor was one of only a few hundred of the Advisors who were genuinely loyal to Emperor Palpatine's New Order, and the individual was therefore appointed as a member of the Imperial Ruling Council during the Galactic Civil War.
Hargrev was a male Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

The master of the Nikto slave Horoth Gendi was a member of the Hutt species, and bequeathed the Nikto Sector, a region of the moon Nar Shaddaa, to Gendi after the Nikto saved the Hutt's life in an act of quick-thinking violence.

Kara was an obese Human female who lived on the planet Kalimahr in the Tython system during the reign of the Infinite Empire; although like all residents of the system, she was unaware of the Rakata and their Empire's existence in the greater galaxy.

Gabriel Ian was a male pilot who served in Rebel Alliance during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Adar Tallon tasked a group of Rebels with rescuing Ian after the Galactic Empire captured him.
The Meatlump Queen was a legendary individual who was believed to be the Queen of the Meatlumps.

Molo was a human male who was a smuggler active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Molo gave his original ear in a gesture of polite respect to a crime syndicate who he accidentally crossed, his replacement ear came from a corporation who manufactured cheap organ replace…
Herkin was a Commander of the Galactic Empire stationed with a unit of stormtroopers in the city of Mos Shuuta on Tatooine.
Kelek the Blue, also known as Kelek the Insensate, was a Tefaun female banker who purchased the Wheel space station during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.
Doffen Gaitag was a male Qiraash who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In the year 84 BBY, Gaitag oversaw the construction of a luxury space station in the Besh Gorgon system.
Qimberly Gaitag-Delio, known by the nickname The Devourer, was a Qiraash female attorney who was the granddaughter of Doffen Gaitag, the founder of the luxury space station the Wheel.
Kifar Itran was a Human male spy who worked for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Itran operated under cover aboard the Rebel MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser Independence in 2 ABY.
Sian Tesar was a Human female X-wing pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 2 ABY, she was stationed aboard the MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser Independence.

Caline Metara was a Human female who commanded the Alderaanian gunship Aegis during the Galactic Civil War. Following the destruction of her homeworld of Alderaan in 0 BBY, Metara and the crew of the Aegis turned to piracy.
Degoren was a Human male who served as commander of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Kearn-sa'Davit was a Videllan male member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Aral tukor Viest was a female Lorrdian who lived as a pirate flightmaster during the Galactic Civil War.

Dannan Kelvan was a Human male who served as a second in command onboard the Aegis during the Galactic Civil War. Following the destruction of his homeworld of Alderaan in 0 BBY, Kelvan and the crew of the Aegis turned to piracy.
Andevid was a male Aqualish pirate who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Anakaret was a Twi'lek female smuggler who lived during the Galactic Civil War. At a pirate clearinghouse, she was forced to participate in a deadly game at the behest of Aral tukor Viest. Her life was saved during the game by Leia Organa Solo.

Alia Terae was a Human female pirate who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Terae was the engineer and weapons officer aboard the Aegis, an Alderaanian gunship that managed to escape the blast that destroyed Alderaan.

Veag Gonwa was a Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. Around 3638 BBY, Gonwa was part of Strike Team Oricon, a unit sent to the moon of Oricon to confront the powerful rogue Sith known as the Dread Masters.

Kyvax was a male Geonosian who was employed during the Cold War by Colonel Gorik of the reconstituted Sith Empire. His job was to construct droid-bombs that were to be used in an attack on the settlement of Anchorhead, on Tatooine.

Gornt Seron was a male Hethas gangster and crime lord who operated during the New Republic era. His base of operation was the planet Korbin. Seron's known employees included two members of an unidentified stalk-eyed species that were on relatively familiar terms with him.

x: A witch of Dathomir, was an Arch Witch of Singing Mountain Clan during the Galactic Civil War.

A Human served as a Jedi Knight at some point by 5000 BBY. Believing that learning the use of the dark side of the Force could help eradicate it, the Knight eventually had an argument with his former master, another Jedi.
A Defel worked as a bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War. He wore a bandolier over his right shoulder and goggles to protect his eyes from all other forms of light other than ultraviolet.
A Human Jedi was murdered by his apprentice.

Hanera was a female owner of the Hanera's Dance Troupe entertainment company on Coruscant during the Cold War. She mentioned to one of her dancers, Ria Deleru, that she never saw someone with as much potential as her.

Agluk was a male Dulok who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, he was captured along with his tribe by a legion of Imperial stormtroopers, who they called "Skull Ones".

Zrani was a Wistie, one of the glowing fairy-folk of the forest moon of Endor, prior to the Battle of Endor. She was captured by the Dulok Agluk, put in a lamp and used to light the way to him and the four adolescent Ewoks in a cave where the Griagh was hiding.

Stemzee was an Ewok who had brown eyes and tan fur with grey stripes who lived in the Bright Tree Village on the moon of Endor. They participated in the Battle of Endor. During the battle they manned a catapult with fellow Ewok Chubbray.

Perosei was a member of the Naboo Palace Guards during the time of the Invasion of Naboo. He was known for his ability to take apart and reassemble a blaster in under a standard minute. During the invasion, he was a prisoner at Camp Four.

Nici Burrén was a human who worked as an engineer for the Royal Security Forces at the Theed Hangar on the planet Naboo. During the Invasion of Naboo, they served alongside another engineer also named Nici.

Ogan-Dei was a Weequay male Jedi Master during the Galactic War. He was one of the leader of the Strike Team Oricon, a unit composed of members of the Jedi Order and the Republic Military that were dispatched to the moon of Oricon to eliminate the Dread Masters.

Coris was an acolyte in the Korriban Sith Academy during the Cold War. He ventured into the Tomb of Naga Sadow along with acolytes Jonos and Kolbrun. Though his fellow acolytes made it out alive, Coris perished there.

The Grand Inquisitor was the title adopted by a Pau'an male Jedi Knight who turned to the dark side of the Force and became the leader of the Inquisitorius, a band of Jedi hunters who served the Galactic Empire.
Jorrk was a Klatooinian associate of the Nimbanel criminal Mosep Binneed who nicknamed Binneed "Monkey Jabba."

An individual was a soldier in the Gloom Walkers during the Battle of Phaseera. They were led by Lieutenant Ulabore in an attempt to destroy the Republic outpost on Phaseera, which would allow the Sith army to destroy the Republic's base camp.

A Kurtzen participated in an auction at Mawbo's Performance Hall on the planet Tatooine in 8 ABY. The Kurtzen bid against the Squib Sligh for a holocube that, the auctioneer claimed, showed an image of the Human Anakin Skywalker at age nine.

Erina To'nos was a female Human requisition officer for the Galactic Solutions Industries present on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Chellemi Gunn was a female Human commander of the Republic Army stationed on the planet Makeb during the stage of the Galactic War known as the Conquest of Makeb.
Gorv Mespit, also known as "Speck," was a Mirialan male smuggler active during the later years of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Paul Klarrk was a male Zabrak Jedi who served the Jedi Order as a combat instructor during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Klarrk was dark-skinned with green eyes and black hair, wore brown and tan robes, and carried two lightsabers.
Vix was a male Human merchant who sold weapons at the Senate Commercial District on Coruscant during the Cold War.
Vanukar was a male Human Jedi Master present on the planet Makeb during the stage of the Galactic War known as the Conquest of Makeb.
Serak was a Devaronian male who, during the Cold War, worked at the Pit on Nar Shaddaa. He provided Huttball players with stimulants and other items.
Yuprel was a male Human merchant living during the Cold War, who sold stimulants in Mos Anek on Tatooine.

Shyon Melkans was a female Human treasure hunter present on the planet Makeb during the stage of the Galactic War known as the Conquest of Makeb.

Zabra was a female Human sergeant of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. She sold starship components in the Rhu Caenus Spaceport while being stationed on Alderaan.

Kreth Donar was a male Human requisition officer for the Galactic Solutions Industries present on Alderaan during the Galactic War.
Dag Feraan was a male Chiss merchant who sold military gear on the planet Makeb during the stage of the Galactic War known as the Conquest of Makeb.

Maire was a female Human corporal in the military forces of House Thul on the planet Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War. She was stationed at the Thul estate, distributing armor to Thul and Imperial forces.
Traa Feaan was a male Rodian merchant who sold military gear on the planet Makeb at the stage of the Galactic War known as the Conquest of Makeb.
Damarcus was a male Human captain living during the Cold War. Affiliated with the House of Thul and wearing their uniform, he sold various weapons near the Thul Palace.
Morgen Hlude'forda was a female Twi'lek Jedi merchant who sold various gear on the planet Makeb during the stage of the Galactic War known as the Conquest of Makeb.

Gatheri was a male Human captain in the military forces of House Thul on the planet Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War. He was stationed at the Thul estate, distributing armor to Thul and Imperial forces.
Caran Ovarug was a male Human slicer who was present on the planet Makeb during the stage of the Galactic War known as the Conquest of Makeb.

Joruk was a male Human lieutenant in the military forces of House Thul on the planet Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War. He was stationed at the Thul estate, distributing armor to Thul and Imperial forces.
Piani Felswoop was a male Human scavenger present on the planet Makeb during the stage of the Galactic War known as the Conquest of Makeb.
Naiad Cormin was a male Human merchant present on Makeb during the Conquest of Makeb.

Melos Tataren was a Human male who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Affiliated with the House of Thul, he sold various items near the Thul Palace cantina.
Alsia Rost was a female Human archaeologist present on the planet Makeb during the stage of the Galactic War known as the Conquest of Makeb.
Kullen was a male Human sergeant in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War, when he was stationed at the estate of the Imperial-allied House Thul.
Jomun Litas was a male Human who lived on the planet Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War, and was welcome on the estate of the reconstituted Sith Empire-allied House Thul.
Dori Taa was a female Human present on Keylander Station during the Galactic War. Taa trained others in the skill of armstech.

Mari-Lucen was a female Human living during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Affiliated with House Thul, she sold various items near the Thul Palace on Alderaan.
Moradin Rar was a male Nautolan present on Keylander Station during the Galactic War.

Taza Ferral was a female Human present on Keylander Station during the Galactic War.
Avan was a male Human sergeant who lived during the Cold War, who sold various specialty goods near the Thul Palace on Alderaan.
Teela Paesante was a female Human present on Keylander Station during the Galactic War.

Kole Hendry was a male Human merchant living during the Cold War, a conflict fought between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He sold various speeders near the Thul Palace on Alderaan.
Dunta Schimbke was a male Human present on Keylander Station during the Galactic War.

Loell was a female Human Sith apprentice who was stationed on Balmorra during the Great Galactic War, the Cold War, and the Galactic War together with her master Sith Lord Tharsis.

An individual who was a Jedi during the end of the Galactic Republic helped the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
A captain commanded the passenger liner Orramas in 3 BBY. He shipped Abal Karda, a fugitive from Imperial justice, to Maryx Minor.

Some time during the Galactic Civil War, this Imperial commander was stationed on the first Death Star. He greeted Darth Vader upon the latter's arrival at the battle station, but was then informed that the Rebel Alliance had stolen the Death Star plans.
Mordekai was a bogwing who was kept as a pet by the Twi'lek Reom, the president of the company IsoTech.
Hal Lars was a Human male who resided on the space station the Wheel during the reign of the Galactic Empire, where he operated the equipment shop Hal's Parts Store.
Ninan was an Aqualish male mechanic and engineer who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Feno Gamoc was a Rybet male who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems as a senior engineer aboard the Munificent-class star frigate Sa Nalaor.
Ketter Yaaran was a Human male pirate who lived on Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he frequented the cantina in the city of Kaadara.

An Ewok scout lived on the Outer Rim moon of the gas giant planet of Endor around 19 BBY, the final year of a war known as the Clone Wars.

A clone trooper was under the command of Jedi General Aayla Secura around during the Clone Wars. He accompanied Secura and her clone trooper commander Bly to the forest moon of Endor around 19 BBY, the final year of the war.

An Ewok chieftain acted as the leader of an Ewok village located on the forest moon of Endor around 19 BBY. The Ewok and his village were constantly under threat from a massive beast they called the Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain.

Lon Prador was a male Kadrillian who served as Lord council of his homeworld Kadril. When members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic visited his world he agreed to provide the alliance with the worlds resources.
Carlon Brandes was a Human male who served as a corporal in the Royal Naboo Security Forces around the time of the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY.

A Klatooinian male was a member of a band of pariahs who lived in a settlement on the Outer Rim planet Ragmar V during the final year of the Clone Wars. The Klatooinian worked closely with the settlement's leader, Gaan, and held some leadership roles.

Pedric Tosh was a light-skinned Human who served as a Palace Guard sergeant for the planet Naboo's eponymous Royal Naboo Security Forces. He carried a S-5 heavy blaster pistol, and wore the typical Palace Guard uniform.
Darth Luft was a Twi'lek Sith Lord of the One Sith. He sported the traditional Sith tattoos all over his body and wielded a red-bladed lightsaber.
Tanye Trila was a sergeant in the Republic Army during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Danzal Galak Sr. was a Human male from the planet of Naboo who served as a Security Guard of the Royal Naboo Security Forces. He held the rank of Sergeant during the Invasion of Naboo, which took place in 32 BBY.

Vekozev Kabir, nicknamed "Zev," worked with Ahakistan resistance groups before he became a member of the Rebel Alliance. At the Battle of Hoth, he attended Princess Leia's pilot briefing before heading to his snowspeeder.

Beryann Raleg was Human male who joined the Rebel Alliance along with Bren Derlin after Senator Galen Derlin's assassination. Prior to the Battle of Hoth, he attended Princess Leia's pilot briefing before heading to his fighter and flying as Blue Eight during the battle.
Adam Swiftgale was a Rockhopper jockey from Manda. At the Battle of Hoth, he attended Princess Leia's pilot briefing before heading to his ship, flying under the callsign Green Three.

Habeer Zignean was a human male from Ord Mirit, who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic to avenge the death of his father. He participated in the Battle of Hoth under the callsign Green Five. He attended Princess Leia's pilot briefing before heading to his ship.

Tosk was a male Mandalorian Trandoshan warden who operated on the planet Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War before he was killed by spacers hired by the Wookiees. He wore a gray set of Mandalorian armor

Kulbart Zamoon was a Centran Human male pilot who fought in the Galactic Civil War for the Rebel Alliance. He joined after the lack of Imperial intervention against the terrorism on his homeworld of Erilnar.

Mitth'raw'nuruodo, born as Kivu'raw'nuru with the core name Vurawn, recognized in his early military career as Mitth'raw'nuru, and better known by his core name Thrawn, was a Chiss male officer of the Chiss Ascendancy and Grand Admiral in the Imperial Navy during the age of th…

This Rebel pilot was stationed at Haven Base on the planet Arbra. Following R2-D2, C-3PO and Chewbacca's ordeal with the Darker, the pilot found the trio and told them Luke Skywalker was looking for them and that their "vacation" was over.

This Rebel pilot was stationed at the Alliance base on Kulthis during an Imperial attack on the Belderone system. The pilot was one of the reinforcements led by Luke Skywalker in an attack against a contingent of AT-ATs on Belderone.
This Rebel was stationed at the Rebel Alliance's Haven Base on Arbra. She watched the broadcast of the hearing that exonerated Luke Skywalker.
Malyssa Raventhorn was a female Zeltron thief and the mistress of Imperial Captain Mulchive Wermis during his time as administrator of The Wheel space station.

A male member of the Human species served at one point in their life as the military governor of Daschua. The governor had several sons, the eldest of whom was named Zertik Strom, who went on to serve in the Imperial Navy.

This Imperial captain was a Human male serving at the Imperial installation known as the Krake Data Vault on Krake's Planet. The captain was allowed to eat in the vault's kitchen by Farlie the cook to avoid the crowd in the mess hall at payday.
An Imperial officer was a Human female serving at the Imperial installation known as the Krake Data Vault on Krake's Planet.

Denimoor was the captain of the Venator-class Star Destroyer Tenacious during the early months of the Galactic Empire. He had previously served under then-Jedi General K'Kruhk during the Siege of Saleucami of the Clone Wars.
A male Yuuzhan Vong warrior took part in his species' attack on the planet Duro in 26 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Kazac was a Nautolan mercenary and a member of the InterStellar Regulators living during the Galactic War. During the Conquest of Makeb in 3638 BBY the Regulators sides with the Hutt Cartel in their occupation of the planet.
