A Human male clone served as a shock trooper with the Coruscant Guard in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic, during the Clone Wars against the Separatists.
Patorr was an Admiral of the Sith Empire. His saying of "Peace is a weapon" was at one point quoted by Zola Arvannus.

Lett-Shara was a female who held the rank of Moff in the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. Considered to be an unpleasant woman by Doctor Eckard Lokin, Lett-Shara was married to an officer of the same name in the Imperial Military.

Thranc Roulus was a soldier of the Sith Empire stationed in the Kwenn system during Eradication Day. During the attack by the Eradicator weapons the personnel tried to abandon the burning station, but Sith Lord Phaaral threatened to kill any deserters attempting to flee.

A Human male Imperial governor was in control of the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War. The governor had arranged the capture and public display of Silri, a prominent member of the native Nightsisters to break the spirit of her people, which resulted in a planetwid…
Phaaral was a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was stationed in the Kwenn system during the Eradication Day.

Roksur was a male Human cyborg hired by Skavak to retrieve a piece of Nok Drayen's wealth from Zone Zero in Transport Station 5 on Taris. Roksur and his gang made it to the vault with great effort, but were apprehended by the future Voidhound and Corso Riggs.
Proh'ven was a male Neimoidian doctor living during the Cold War. In the Network Access on Nar Shaddaa he contracted an individual to test the combat capabilities of a new type of droids.

Ro-San Borokki was a female Human member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. An 18-year veteran of the Guild, Borokki served as Director of Training for the Guild, sometime during the tenure of Cradossk as the Guild's Head.
Chentu Chek was a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. A 23-year veteran of the Guild, Chek served as Armory Master, sometime during the tenure of Cradossk as the Guild's Head.

Ratak Raam'luk was a Vratix member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. Raam'luk served as an Administrative/Personnel Officer, as well as holding a place on the Guild Council, sometime during the tenure of Cradossk as the Guild's Head.

Soganti was a Human male who served as an agent in the Republic Customs Office of the Galactic Republic. During the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, he was assigned to the planet Taris, then in a middle of a restoration effort.

Cibinel was a male Human captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on Tatooine where he and his convoy were ambushed by enemy forces in the Jundland Wastes.
A clone served as a shock trooper with Coruscant Guard during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Separatists. He was stationed at the Republic military base in Galactic City on Coruscant.
A clone served as a shock trooper with Coruscant Guard during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Separatists. He was stationed at the Republic military base in Galactic City on Coruscant.
Esrai was a female, dark-eyed member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

This individual was a Rally Master in Mandalore the Ultimate's Neo-Crusader army. Following his people's defeat in the Mandalorian Wars this man found employment with the GenoHaradan: a secret society of elite assassins dedicated to eliminating enemies of the Galactic Republic.

Gozubb was an Ithorian male who attended a party aboard Drooga the Hutt's luxury travel barge on Nar Shaddaa. Gozubb had the misfortune of stepping out of the barge for a time to make a transaction, during which it moved to the Nikto Sector, leaving him stranded on the Promenade.

Whist was a male Human lieutenant in the Imperial Reclamation Service of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was stationed on Tatooine in Mos Anek where he asked a fellow Imperial to conduct test scans on some hostile droids to determine the threat they posed.
Tyrodall was a male Devaronian smuggler who was alive during the Cold War. A partner of Beryl Thorne, together they came to Taris in search of the pre-bombardment artifacts.

Soprin was a female Human Doctor working for Czerka Corporation during the Cold War. She was part of the team under Director Antayen which worked on Tatooine excavating an ancient alien device, which was in fact an Infinite Empire mind prison holding a Rakata known as the Impr…

Zsinj's father was a Human male from Fondor. Near the end of the era of the Galactic Republic, he and a human female from Chandrila named Maarisa Zsinj produced a male child, Zsinj, who would eventually become one of the most powerful warlords in the history of the galaxy.

Ashy was the name of a Rattataki male pilot in the Republic Navy. Originally adopted by a pair of Imperial aristocrats, Ashy was named due to his species' skin color, and made to believe he could join the Imperial Military, due to his adoptive parents' dressing him up as an Im…

Kendra Novar was a female human pilot in the Republic Military. As a talented slicer, Kendra originally used her skills to rob casinos, but after a brief period in prison, she joined the military. It was stated that she had a good heart.

Oro Wogawa was an Ithorian male who served in the Republic Military as a starfighter pilot. He had a unique take on piloting, viewing each ship as a living being. Regardless of his unusual perspective, he was stated to get excellent results.

Ovold was a male Zabrak engineer living during the Cold War. He worked on Taris as part of the restoration effort and performed deep-core drilling operation to obtain the samples from the planet's core; though the samples were in fact contraband Taris relics.

Lerek was a male Human doctor working for Czerka Corporation before the Great Galactic War. He was part of the team under Director Antayen that worked on Tatooine excavating The Imprisoned One's mind prison.

Klewer was a male Neimoidian sergeant in the Republic Military during the Cold War. He was stationed on Taris as part of the restoration effort, during which time he also took to smuggling certain valuables past his superiors.
Verr was a male Human ensign of the Sith Empire stationed on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War.

During the reign of the New Republic, a Human male cyborg operated the modified T-65B X-wing starfighter Bail Jumper. As a result of his cyborg conversion, the cyborg suffered from cybernetic psychosis, rendering the man insane.
Hundria Kast was a female Human who served the Alvorine Authority as chief of security of Alvorine City on the planet Alvorine.
Aveton Prit was an Imperial informer who operated the drinking establishment Pritt's Free Pit on the planet Naalol during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Helarin was a Human female Jedi Master who served onboard the Republic's Carrick Station during the Cold War.
Pirul was a male Human Flight Commander within the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.

Geris Paelid was a male Human of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. As a member of Imperial Intelligence's Experimental Weapons Division he was dispatched to Tatooine with a mission to test an experimental weapon on unsuspecting locals.

Peyterra was a female Human Sith apprentice studying in the Korriban Sith Academy during the Cold War to become a Sith in the Sith Empire. While performing a mission in one of the tombs in the Valley of the Dark Lords she came across a group of armed slaves.
Roggar Den was a Human male Mandalorian living during the Cold War. Along with fellow Mandalorians Pit Rauhut and Warusman Ordo, he came to Tatooine to participate in a challenging trial.
Warusman Ordo was a male Mandalorian living during the Cold War. Along with fellow Mandalorians Pit Rauhut and Roggar Den, he came to Tatooine to participate in a challenging trial.
Elizhis was a male Human Sith apprentice of Lord Renning studying in the Korriban Sith Academy during the Cold War.
Pit Rauhut was a male Human Mandalorian living during the Cold War. Along with fellow Mandalorians Roggar Den and Warusman Ordo, he came to Tatooine to participate in a challenging trial.

Fabizan was a male Bith starship salesman active during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he was preparing to meet with Skavak in the Coruscant Spaceport's Docking Bay 87, but instead was met by Corso Riggs and the captain of the ship that was being Fabizan and his guards.
Vames was a male Human commander of the Sith Empire stationed on Tatooine in the Ridgeside Sentry Post during the Cold War.
Leisha Vamden was a female Human who lived on the destroyed planet of Taris.

Kasstroff was a male Human commander of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. He was among the small contingent of soldiers who were sent by the Empire to infiltrate the Republic capital of Coruscant itself.

Giana Kayl was a female Mirialan smuggler and the captain of a freighter Meridian Grace during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY she was delivering cargo from Tai Cordan for the Balmorran resistance, a list of major supply caches hidden before the Imperial invasion of Balmorra.
Yavorus was a male Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire who was stationed on Balmorra during the Cold War.

Paus was a male Human journalist of the Galactic Republic living during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was residing on Coruscant and investigating the death of Rikael Lysannis, a member of the powerful family murdered by the Justicars' Brigade.

Vuk Dimitrius was a male Human captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire who was stationed on Tatooine during the Cold War, where he asked a fellow Imperial to deal with Exchange forces under Kiregan Freem.

Morant was a Human male member of the Mantellian Separatist Movement during the Cold War. He was present next to one of Separatists' leaders Dareg at the Separatist stronghold inside Mount Avilatan, an active volcano on Avilatan island, when it got attacked.
Cresken was a male Human officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire stationed on Tatooine during the Cold War, where he asked a fellow Imperial to deal with stealth-equipped Exchange assassin droids.
A clone trooper served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, participating in a mission to the Gwori shipyards. He was killed by a lizard in a cave.

Circa 21 BBY, an acklay was kenneled aboard the Burnout space station. The acklay was released into the station's underground gladiatorial arena to serve as a prized fighting beast in the illegal bloodsport spectacles held in there.

Teek was a male Neimoidian and a twin brother of Jeek. Both brothers proudly claimed themselves as tier-six inventors of Research Corps Eight of the Imperial Science Bureau, a rare feat for non-Humans in the xenophobic Empire.

Jeek was a male Neimoidian and the twin brother of Teek. Both brothers proudly claimed themselves as tier-six inventors of Research Corps Eight of the Imperial Science Bureau, a rare feat for non-Humans in the xenophobic Empire.
Juul was a female Human resident of Coruscant and the sister of Jiik. In 3643 BBY the Justicars' Brigade arrested her brother and Juul had to ask help from the Voidhound to get him out.

Jiik was a male Human resident of Coruscant and the brother of Juul. In 3643 BBY he and his sister worked for the Darmas Pollaran's network as informants. While trailing the criminal Skavak through Justicar territory, he and his sister were separated.
Tremont was a male Human captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire stationed on Tatooine during the Cold War, where he asked a fellow Imperial to help him cripple a local warlord's base of operations.
Bracco was a male Zabrak who threatened Syreena after Rogun Matt'rik posted a bounty on Viidu after Skavak stole Rogun's shipment of blasters.

Piloc was a male Human lieutenant of the First Battalion in the Fifth Infantry of the Imperial Military. In 3643 BBY Piloc and his unit were stationed on Balmorra where they were sent to retrieve the plans for a neutron detonator from the ruins of Bugtown.

Iero was a male Human living on Ord Mantell with his wife Ellis during the Separatist War. Their son Paul disappeared one day and remained missing for years, during which the couple struggled together.

Ellis was a female Human living on Ord Mantell with her husband Iero during the Separatist War. Their son Paul disappeared one day and remained missing for years, during which the couple struggled together.
Jenna was a female residing on Ord Mantell around 3643 BBY. She informed Ellis that she saw her son Paul alive at Mannett Point.
Paul was a male Human son of Iero and Ellis, living on Ord Mantell during the Separatist War. One day, he was kidnapped by Mantellian Separatists, who put him on rage-inducing stimulants.
An unidentified Human Je'daii of female gender was being trained in Qigong Kesh some time before the events of the Rakata invasion of the Tython system.
This unidentified individual was a female Mirialan who was trained in Qigong Kesh some time before the events of the Rakata invasion of the Tython system.
A Devaronian Je'daii of female gender was being trained in Qigong Kesh some time before the events of the Rakata invasion of the Tython system.

The Wild Princess was the daughter of Jonciane, the king of Sainte-Evanëflore during the Galactic Civil War. Unlike her father and most members of her pacifist species, the princess was eager to fight the Galactic Empire.

This Elder Rakatan was a red Rakata and a member of the Elder Council during the Jedi Civil War. This Rakata was a leading member of the Elder tribe along with two other Rakatans and made a deal with Revan before the war.

Brick was a male Human TIE pilot in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, he was stationed aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vengeance, where he showed Flight Cadet Maarek Stele around the concourse of the ship.

Chrimar Noven was a male Human noble of Alderaan who lived during the Cold War. He pretended to ally with House Thul but in truth he supported the Galactic Republic. In 3643 BBY, he was exposed by an Imperial and brought to Lord Jorad Thul for trial and verdict.
Darrok was a male Human Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. He was the one who received the location of Imperial Intelligence deserter Cipher Three, father of Raina Temple.
Virne was a male Zabrak who served in the military of House Thul during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Anora was a female Human who served in the Imperial Diplomatic Service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic. She was the girlfriend of Vector Hyllus until he became a Joiner on Alderaan.
Pharoth was a male Human Alderaanian living during the Cold War. A major of House Thul military forces, he was stationed at the Outpost Bolym in the Juran Mountains.

Kladak was a Hutt crime lord during the time of the Galactic War. He represented the Hutt Cartel and his own interests to the Colicoids organizing the Colicoid War Games. He was accompanied by other Cartel-aligned thugs.
Basuda was a Hutt representative of the Contraband Resale Corporation—a company owned by the Hutt Cartel—residing on Carrick Station during the Galactic War.
The Locust was a male Gen'Dai who was the leader of a violent scavenging criminal group on Taris.

Thurson was a member of the Eagle's network that was present at the Eagle's Nest on Nal Hutta when the hideout was stormed by the forces of the Imperial Intelligence. Despite attempting to get out, Thurson was either killed or apprehended.

Jeryl was a female member of the Eagle's network that was present at the Eagle's Nest on Nal Hutta when the hideout was stormed by the forces of the Imperial Intelligence. Despite attempting to get out, Jeryl was either killed or apprehended.

Tenus Paato was a male Human citizen of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was among the people who in 3643 BBY were abducted by the Darth Jadus and put aboard his Harrower-class dreadnought in the Artus system, made to fight and eliminate each other as part…

Ibellia Ran was a female Human citizen of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. She was among the people who in 3643 BBY were abducted by the Darth Jadus and put aboard his Harrower-class dreadnought in the Artus system, made to fight and eliminate each other as p…

Ri Farrona was a male Mirialan citizen of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. He was among the people who in 3643 BBY were abducted by the Darth Jadus and put aboard his Harrower-class dreadnought in the Artus system, made to fight and eliminate each other as part of Sith's s…

Paril was a male Human ensign in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed on Taris in the Toxic Lake Garrison and provided Cipher Nine information on the whereabouts of Doctor Eckard Lokin.
Needa was a male Human lieutenant in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed on Taris in the Toxic Lake Garrison.

A male Human spymaster was a member and subsequently leader of the Imperial Intelligence in the Sith Empire for many years. He held the rank of Keeper during the Cold War, but following the Eradication Day was promoted to the Minister of Intelligence, replacing his predecessor.

A male Sith served the Sith Emperor of the Sith Empire in 3950 BBY. Garbed in dark robes, the man was summoned to the Emperor's throne room in the Imperial Citadel to take evidence of Darth Nyriss's treachery from the Sith Lord Scourge.
Wyle Ulbreck was a Human male who resided on the desert planet Tatooine in the years surrounding the fall of the Galactic Republic.

Minder Nine was a male Human Minder within Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire. Like all Minders, he processed information from Cipher Agents, like when he relayed Cipher Four's report on the situation on Manaan to Watcher Three.
Kroius was a male Anomid Administrator of a Quesh chemical refinery during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was approached by Cipher Nine, who requested from him the access to Dimalium-6.
Ath'en'terro, also known by his core name Thent, was a male Chiss sergeant in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Leo Furth was a male Human captain in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Pashok the Unyielding was a male Chagrian leader of the Marauders gang of White Maw pirates on Hoth during the Galactic War.

Ojoon "Half-Face" Coi was a male bounty hunter based at the Sriluur Guildhouse of the Bounty Hunters' Guild who was active around the time of the Galactic Civil War. Coi earned his nickname as a result of injuries that he suffered during an encounter with a horde of hostile bugs.
Nirittu Kotta was a male bounty hunter who at one time acted as a partner to the bounty hunter Ro-San Borokki.
Va Gobolungnum was a Human male bounty hunter who was affiliated with the Bounty Hunters' Guild during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Mardu Avoa was the male Human president of the Drearian Defense Conglomerate and after Avoa's son was kidnapped by Thalassian slavers, he was rescued by the bounty hunter Corvastan Benelex.
Chance was the alias of the male Human Republic Strategic Information Service agent active during the Cold War.

Nod Warfield was an individual who served the Galactic Empire as an admiral within the Imperial Navy. During the Galactic Civil War, Warfield oversaw the construction of the Tarkin superweapon in orbit over the planet Hockaleg, in the Patriim system.

Watcher Six was a female Human Watcher within the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire. Along with fellow Watcher Seven and Watcher Nine, she was a new-generation Watcher - the latest achievement of the eugenics program that made their skills superior even to that of Watch…
Fixer Two was a Human male who served as a Fixer in Imperial Intelligence, the espionage agency of the reconstituted Sith Empire, during the Galactic War.

Fixer Seven was a Fixer within the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3664 BBY, Fixer Seven participated in Operation: Undertow, along with Watcher X. Fixer Seven survived the operation, but sustained severe injuries in the process.

Minder Fourteen was a female Human Minder within Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY, when Cipher Nine returned to the Imperial Citadel after a lengthy undercover mission within the Republic Strategic Information Service, Minder Fourteen was assigned to debri…

Omana Tragg was a male Mirialan who was the Representative of the mining colony located on Isen IV asteroid during the Galactic War. He willingly surrendered the colony to the representatives of the Sith Empire, but was met with hostilities nonetheless.

Phytus was a male Human Commander of the small military force of the mining colony located on Isen IV asteroid during the Galactic War. The colony willingly surrendered to the representatives of the Sith Empire, but was met with hostilities nonetheless.

Jonmor Tinto was a male accountant who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. Tinto was employed by a Bank situated on the planet Humbarine, but after Tinto illicitly embezzled funds from the bank, he was imprisoned by the Galactic Republic.

Thoxo was a male Corellian thief. At some point during the early career of the Trandoshan bounty hunter Cradossk, a bounty was placed on Thoxo and the Corellian went into hiding on the planet Yitabo, where he disguised himself as a retired academic from Thyferra.

Watcher Seven was a male Human Watcher within the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire. Along with fellow siblings Watcher Six and Watcher Nine he was a new-generation Watcher - the latest achievement of the eugenics program that made their skills superior even to that of …
Bax Kholer was a male Human operative of the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Kanjon Slyke was a Human male assassin and escape artist active during the Cold War. He was caught by the Galactic Republic along with his brother.
Kanjon Slyke's brother was a male Human criminal just like his brother Kanjon Slyke. During the Cold War the two were caught by the Galactic Republic and sent to a Belsavis prison.

Ohta was a male Human mercenary and bounty hunter active during the Cold War. At one point, Ohta was a Mandalorian, but he was disowned by them for unworthy behavior. Eventually he was caught by the Galactic Republic and sent to Belsavis prison.
Paarkos was a male Gand living during the Cold War, who for unknown crimes was imprisoned in the Belsavis prison by the Galactic Republic.

A Senator of the Echani people served in the Galactic Senate during the Jedi Civil War, before the Senator was assassinated on the order of Darth Revan. In revenge, the Echani general Yusanis attacked Revan, but was killed in battle.
Plennid was a male Human Republic Diplomatic Corps Minister during the period of time known as the Cold War.

Watcher Nine was a female Human Watcher within the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire. Along with fellow siblings Watcher Six and Watcher Seven she was a new-generation Watcher - the latest achievement of the eugenics program that made their skills superior even to that …
Daizanna was a female Human living during the Cold War. She became the Joiner in the Iesei Killik nest and came to fully associate herself with it.

Yana-Ton was a female Voss living on Voss during the Cold War. She was the sister of Phi-Ton and a daughter of Bas-Ton and resided in her father's tea house in the Judicial Quarter of the Voss-Ka city.

The Master of Ceremonies was the nickname of a male Human who organized Life Day activities towards the middle of the inter-Sith Wars period. In 3638 BBY, he and his Life Day Revelers stayed on Vaiken Spacedock, which was property of the Sith Empire.
A Twi'lek Jedi General served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. She was killed in battle while leading a clone trooper charge om Malsuum. CT-5539 picked up her body and continued the charge.
A sea monster that inhabited the oceans of the planet Dac was long dead by the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Phi-Ton was a male Voss living on Voss during the Cold War. He was the brother of Yana-Ton and a son of Bas-Ton and resided in his father's tea house in the Judicial Quarter of the Voss-Ka city.
Therod-Ton was a male Voss living on Voss during the Cold War. He was the brother of Bas-Ton and often visited his tea house in the Judicial Quarter of the Voss-Ka city.

Amin-Le was a female Voss living on Voss during the Galactic War. She resided at the Shrine of Healing, where she held watch over the Vitalicrons. Around 3640 BBY, she was approached by Cipher Nine who asked for information concerning Albathius, also known as the Shining Man.
Keyo-So was a male Voss living on Voss during the Cold War. He held a conversation with the Shining Man that was recorded in his vitalicron.

Murbek Gehn was a male Sith of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Galactic War he was present on Voss where he studied the powers of the Dark Heart. He later aided an Imperial-aligned individual with passage into the Nightmare Lands.
Niya-Ton was a female Voss living on Voss centuries before the Cold War. She was the mother of Zhi-Ton and the distant predecessor of Therod-Ton, Bas-Ton, Phi-Ton and Yana-Ton.
Zhi-Ton was a male Voss living on Voss centuries before the Cold War. He was the son of Niya-Ton and the distant predecessor of Therod-Ton, Bas-Ton, Phi-Ton and Yana-Ton.
Xanar was a male Gormak living on Voss during the Galactic War. He was the first to witness the Shining Man, also known as Albathius, land in the Chamber of Ashes.
Nen-Ji was a Voss female that was one of the members of the Three, the Voss secular government, during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Gunta-Mer was a Voss male that was a member of the Three, the Voss secular government, during the Galactic War.
Sangus was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. At some point before 3640 BBY he used the assets of the Imperial Intelligence.

Karhel was a Republic Strategic Information Service agent during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he was stationed, along with Jaysa Wise and a few other SIS agents, in the Imperial-controlled High Security Lockdown section of Nar Shaddaa.

Yzu was an individual who served as an Imperial officer with the military rank of admiral within the Galactic Empire. As a commanding officer, they were in command of the 15th Deep Core Reserve Fleet, which was stationed in the Empress Teta system.

Ilox was a male Evocii who lived on the sprawling city moon of Nar Shaddaa, working as a private investigator. During the Cold War, he reported to the Galactic Republic that a number of Republic officers disappeared after visiting Club Ufora.
Rale was a male Human lieutenant who served the Galactic Republic.
An unidentified male Human served as the High Hermit of the Ancient Order of Pessimists on volcanic planet of Maryx Minor.
A Human male Jedi Knight served the Jedi Order during the Galactic War, and had some history with the Kaleesh Shakren san Jukii before san Jukii became the Sith Lord Razer.

The son of Falner Oeth - a member of the Imperial Diplomatic Service of the Sith Empire - was a male Zabrak who served in the Imperial military during the Galactic War. Stationed on Balmorra, he was hoping to join the elite Shadow Fist commando unit.

Yoganerr Thenoth was a male governor of Ord Mantell prior to the Galactic War. Some time after he stepped over, the Imperial Diplomatic Service member Falner Oeth tried to obtain sensitive information from him by arranging a meeting with Vector Hyllus, who could turn him into …

Sabini was a member of the Imperial Diplomatic Service of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. Falner Oeth claimed that Terrab and Sabini were among those blocking his efforts to start a Killik-Imperial alliance.
Trage was a male Human captain in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was stationed on Corellia where he participated in the Battle of Corellia.
Vynock Leader was the callsign of a pilot in the Sith Empire and the leader of the Vynock Squadron during the Galactic War.
Sanos was a Human male major in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War against the Galactic Republic.

Nagratha served as the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic circa 7786 BBY. During the Waymancy Storm conflict of 7811 BBY, Nagratha's mother had served with the Squill Sifters intercepting and decoding Waymancy communications.
Asenec was a male Croke from Crakull. A writer and a poet, Asenec was widely discriminated not only because of his species, but also because his poems were considered dark, sickening and offensive.

affiliation: The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization
x: Addalar Hyland was a Human male who founded Galactic Solutions Industries, a personal weapons manufacturing company, on the moon of Nar Shaddaa around 3642 BBY as the Galactic War erupted. He also had a relative named Arnell Hyland who he employed at GSI Headquarters.
Cedral Gend was a male Human Jedi Master and a member of the Jedi High Council active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Zasha Ranken was a female Human admiral in the Sith Imperial Navy during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War.

Bey'wan Aygo was a Bothan male Fleet Admiral of the Republic Navy during the Cold War and Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was born to artistic parents, but when he saw a space battle above his homeworld, Aygo wanted to practice interstellar combat instead.
Lett-Shara was a male Human captain in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Churnis was a member of the Imperial Guard in the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. At the time of the Battle of Corellia, he was on the planet guarding the Imperial Moff Alvon Zamar.
Neyla Hawkins was a Human female living during the Cold War. A sister of Mia Hawkins, both were members of the Eagle's network, which in truth was the proxy of the Sith Lord Darth Jadus.

Langor was a male colonel in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with ties to the Imperial Science Bureau. In 3642 BBY he sent assassins to ambush Doctor Eckard Lokin in one of his safe warehouses.

A female Nautolan was a member of the Star Cabal during 3640 BBY and was present aboard the Star Chamber in the Null Zone when it was attacked by Cipher Nine and the remnants of the reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Intelligence.

Writch Hurley was the name of a Human male engineer in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Known as a genius but with inept communication skills, Writch had a deep appreciation for technology which showed in his work and social life.

Salana Rok was a Chiss female gunnery officer in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Formerly an underworld enforcer, Salana's intensity for violence against her enemies and strong proficiency in weapons are fit for her duties as a starfighter gunner.
Aven Geth was the name of a Human male technician in the Imperial Military. Born to prominent officers of the Imperial Army, Aven was thought to have risen through the ranks with no trouble.
Nanda was a Human female from Naboo who served as an ensign in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Zill Kartay was a Neimoidian consul of the Trade Federation. In 32 BBY, when the Federation successfully invaded the planet Naboo, he was appointed to the Occupation Council overseeing the planet and took up residence in the planetary capital of Theed.
Viff Almay was a Neimoidian biographer who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Aito Laff was a male Neimoidian who served on the bridge of the Invisible Hand.

A Human female lived during the Great Galactic War and was the wife of crime lord Nok Drayen, with whom she had a daughter named Risha. She died before Risha was old enough to have any recollections of her.

In 1 ABY, a Human male gunrunner aided the Chubbit resistance against the Galactic Empire on the Chubbit homeworld of Aridus by smuggling weapons to the reptilians. The gunrunner was affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A male Voss was a member of the Star Cabal during 3640 BBY. He was participating in a holo-conference with other members of the Cabal when the Star Chamber in the Null Zone was attacked by Cipher Nine and what remained of Imperial Intelligence.

Snoo was a Devaronian male who worked as an information broker around the time of the Galactic Civil War. At some point after the Battle of Yavin, Snoo was present at the Rii Jenks Cantina on the planet Formos.

Baleeq Soobo was a male Ortolan colonist who served as Chief Engineer of the Tromper Crags Geothermal Plant on the planet Hoth during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Ennlicher was a Human male sergeant of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed on Hoth as part of an Imperial campaign to trap the Republic in a quagmire and deprive them of resources.

Elias Inkari was a Human male soldier of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed at the Outpost Zerek on Hoth, where he asked a fellow Republic citizen to retrieve valuable data from the sensors in the Starship Graveyard.

Grollix was a male Zabrak captain of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed at the Outpost Zerek on Hoth, where he asked a fellow Republic citizen to deal with invisible Sith assassins.

Panin was a Human male Major of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. Stationed in Aurek Base on Hoth during 3642 BBY, he received orders from Senator Bevera Dodonna to meet with a smuggler later known as Voidhound, but was killed in an Imperial ambush before the smug…
Ando was a Human male general of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he commended a Republic citizen on saving Hoth's Aurek Base from certain destruction.
A Gran male was employed by Urdruua the Hutt, and worked for the Hutt up until three months after the First Battle of Geonosis, the first battle of the Clone Wars, which began during 22 BBY.
Ostan Atur was a a skilled Lowen saboteur who proved to be a hindrance to several key Republic installations like the Qua'Tahc meleenium mines on Af'El under the jurisdiction of the New Republic.
Talak was a Reigat bruiser who worked on a meleenium heist on the New Republic's mines located in Qua'Tahc, the capital of Af'El.
Yaspers was a female Human technician of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY she was stationed at the Prison Administration Center during the Invasion of Belsavis.
Maxhagan was a male Human who settled in Greenwood Station on the planet Nox.

Sleeping Doom was a male Esh-kha who was imprisoned on the planet Belsavis by the Infinite Empire thousands of years before the Cold War. He resided within the Deep Prison when he along with his kind were accidentally freed by the attack of the Sith Empire on the Tomb.

Thorn Maw was a Esh-kha savant male who was freed from imprisonment in the Tomb on Belsavis during the Galactic War. Thorn Maw was among the Esh-kha warriors who took over the canyon known as the Scar, but was slain.

Apex One was a male Human criminal imprisoned on Belsavis by the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. During the Invasion of Belsavis around 3641 BBY he was among the prisoners who managed to escape from their cells following an Imperial attack.
Kanna was a female Human colonel of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY she was stationed at the Prison Administration Center during the Invasion of Belsavis.

Tao was a male general of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY, his forces landed on the Imperial-occupied Balmorra and attempted to stage an assault on the Sundari Flatlands area where the Balmorran Arms Factory was located.
Joral Alde was a male Human member of House Alde and the commander at Fort Alde on Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War. In 3643 BBY, he was killed by Imperial forces that sacked the fort.
A'zabii was a man who was captured by the reconstituted Sith Empire along with his friend Herron on the moon of Nar Shaddaa after they became embroiled in a brawl.
Alaqua was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who wrote Meditations on a Padawan's Journey sometime before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
An elderly spacer of the Duros species lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, and the spacer aided an explorer in tracking down the lost mines of Bos-Una Three.

A member of the Abyssin species worked as a mercenary during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. An abusive individual, the mercenary was killed in 3660 BBY by an eight-year-old Mandalorian child named Akaavi Spar.
A male member of an alien species was a warlord during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

A male noble from the planet Alderaan was particularly famous during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. The nobleman's son was murdered and the suspected killer was arrested and incarcerated.
The son of a famous nobleman from the planet Alderaan was murdered during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

A man was accused of the murder of the son of a famous nobleman from the planet Alderaan, and the man was incarcerated for the crime during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

A noblewoman from the planet Alsakan lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, during which she was part of a proposed marriage alliance with several Mid Rim traders.

Ejal was a Evocii who lived well before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Ejal led his kinsmen in an uprising against the Hutt species, who had stolen the Evocii's homeworld of Nal Hutta and used the Evocii as cheap labor.
A male member of the Evocii species lived well before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
An ambassador to the reconstituted Sith Empire was killed in the middle of the day in a crowded plaza within Kaas City, the Imperial capital city on the planet Dromund Kaas.
A male individual served as the Senator of the planet Belnar in the Galactic Senate during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

A member of the Hutt Cartel worked as an informant for the Republic Strategic Information Service, the Galactic Republic's intelligence agency, during the Cold War between the Republic and the Sith Empire.

A stim trader worked on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He began charging high prices for medicine and stimulants to veteran soldiers, prompting an individual to visit the trader and convince him to lower his prices.

Lorchlar was a male Human who served as a captain within the army of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire. During the war he was stationed in the Republic's secret prison on the planet Belsavis.

Antayen was a male Human employee of Czerka Arms during the Cold War. He was the director of the team that worked on Tatooine excavating The Imprisoned One's mind prison and also included Doctors Di-go, Lerek, Soprin and Grommik Kurthson.

Korventine was a female Zabrak who served as a captain within the army of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire. During the war she was stationed in the Republic's secret prison on the planet Belsavis.

Warr'an was a male Mandalorian commander residing on Tatooine during the Cold War. While station in Outpost Rennar, Warr'an held concerns regarding the Imperials present in the base, to which Zola Arvannus was forced to come in to ensure good relations with the Mandalorians.
A male con man preyed on a number of elderly citizens on the planet Dantooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, conning them out of precious heirlooms.

Melas was a male Human Grand Marshal of Alderaan King's Bouris Ulgo forces during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was stationed at the Castle Panteer - taken over by House Ulgo - where he was killed during an assault on the King Ulgo that resulted in the removal of Bouris Ulgo fr…

Suzoku was a male Human Private of the First Battalion in the Fifth Infantry of the Imperial Military. In 3643 BBY Suzoku and his unit were stationed on Balmorra where they were sent to retrieve the plans for a neutron detonator from the Colicoid-infested ruins of Bugtown.

Nayel was a male Human Supreme Commander of Alderaan King's Bouris Ulgo forces during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he was stationed at the Castle Panteer—taken over by House Ulgo—where he was killed during an assault on the King Ulgo that resulted in his removal from throne.
Lanai was a female Human lieutenant of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY she was stationed near the Thul Palace on Alderaan.

Shellshock was a massive shaclaw that was infected with the rakghoul plague during the resurgence of the plague on Alderaan. It resided in King's Pass until it was killed by individuals working for the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization.
