x: Prewb Abias was a Human male doctor in the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization during the era of the Galactic War.

Philo Strom was a male Human who worked as a bounty hunter during the lifetime of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Boba Fett. Strom came to be considered both honorable and among the best of his trade during his lifetime, a fact for which Fett respected him.
A female crime lord was active on the planet Raisa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

A male jewel thief was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. When the thief stole a priceless bangle that was commissioned for the wedding of a crime lord's daughter, the thief sought help from an underworld individual to smooth over the…
A male crime lord was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, and he commissioned a priceless bangle from a jeweler for his daughter's wedding.

The daughter of a crime lord was due to be married during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, and her father commissioned a priceless bangle from a jeweler for the wedding.

Denov was a Snivvian bounty hunter and a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild during the Galactic Civil War. Denov worked secretly as a mole for the Mandalorian hunter Boba Fett, providing him with information on bounties from the Guild and aiding him in finding his targets.
Somaz was a male Dressellian treasurer hunter active during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Nishrah was a female Human slaver who was active around 185 BBY. In this year she traveled to the planet of Kashyyyk with fellow slavers Twool and Lix, hoping to capture a number of Wookiee younglings to sell.

Twool was a male Talz slaver who was active around 185 BBY. In this year he traveled to the planet Kashyyyk with fellow slavers Nishrah and Lix, hoping to capture a number of Wookiee younglings to sell.
A pudgy man played a game of sabacc with the smuggler Fynn Torve and five other gamblers in the LoBue Cantina on the planet Abregado-Rae Intrigue in the year 9 ABY.

Uunos Gooru was a Trade Baron within the Trade Federation. By 32 BBY, prior to the Trade Federation's invasion of the planet Naboo, Gooru's biography was written by Viff Almay, the Trade Federation Occupation Council's chronicler.
Jeelvic was a male Jawa merchant who living during the Galactic War. He operated near the wreckage of the Stardream in the Dune Sea at the start of the Tatooine rakghoul pandemic.
Virena was a female Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY she was present near the Thul Palace on Alderaan.
Illares was a male Human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY he was present at the Prison Administration Center during the Invasion of Belsavis.

Orkren was a male Bith who served as a sergeant within the army of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire. During the war he was stationed in the Republic's secret prison on the planet Belsavis.
Cherkolotar was a male pureblood Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War he resided in Kaas City on Dromund Kaas.
Savess was a female Human Sith Warrior of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War, she resided in Kaas City on Dromund Kaas.
Denlan was a male member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Chlorus had a relationship history with the warden at the prison, Sadiki Blirr.

Azalie was a Human female who lived during the time period known as the Cold War. The daughter of a Corellian corporation owner, she attended a party on Nar Shaddaa hosted by her father's partner, Drooga the Hutt.

Ezra Bridger was a human male Jedi Padawan, a freedom fighter, and a revolutionary leader in the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire. He was born on Empire Day in 19 BBY to Ephraim and Mira Bridger.
Marl Dak'win was a male bounty hunter living during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY he could be found near the Thul Palace on Alderaan.
Matreyden was a female Human merchant and a citizen of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. She managed a vendor stand, selling various goods in the Kaas City on Dromund Kaas.
Shommox was a female Human merchant and a citizen of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. She worked at a shop selling various goods in the Kaas City on Dromund Kaas.

Vomba was a male Weequay pirate who lived during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he had been caught by bounty hunters and was being handed over to Imperial Corrections at Mezenti Spaceport on Nar Shaddaa when his gang rescued him from custody.
Raim-Ner was a male Human merchant living during the Cold War. He had a small vendor stand selling blasters on the Nar Shaddaa Promenade.

Gula Sem was a male Weequay living during the Galactic War. Employed by Basuda the Hutt of the Contraband Resale Corporation, he resided him with him on Carrick Station selling embargoed items to Galactic Republic.
Tol Feshin was a male Twi'lek living during the Galactic War. Employed by Basuda the Hutt of the Contraband Resale Corporation, he resided on Carrick Station at his master's side.
Hera Syndulla was a Twi'lek female revolutionary leader who became a central figure in the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire and the formation of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Kanan Jarrus, born Caleb Dume, was a Force-sensitive human male Jedi Knight who survived Order 66 during the Clone Wars. Living on thanks to the sacrifice of his Master, Depa Billaba, on Kaller, he met the smuggler Janus Kasmir, who taught him how to survive as a fugitive.

The Hatchet was a prominent crime lord who lived during the Cold War. His name was compared to likes of such masterminds as Nok Drayen and Ivory, however he fell out of picture by the time of the Galactic War.

A male Human hailing from the planet of Naboo worked as a droid designer for Serv-O-Droid, Inc. in the last decades of the Galactic Republic, along with his wife. After years on the staff of that company, they retired to their homeworld.

Wappel-Na was a Voss Mystic living on Voss many years before their planet was discovered by the galactic society. They foresaw the hunger during which the Three must survive, which led to interpreters giving the food to them leaving many other Voss to suffer.

Raklo-Mo was a Voss Mystic living on Voss shortly after their planet was discovered by the galactic society. They saw a vision of Republic and Empire posing a mortal threat to Voss, which the interpreters had deemed false.
Makna-Ha was a Voss Mystic living on Voss many years before the planet was discovered by the galactic society. Their vision showed the need for a civil war between the Voss.
Aarrom was a male Ithorian who owned the cantina known as the Shorn Stabilizer on the planet Nubia during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Jek Bannon was a male Human who worked for the Five Brothers Resort and Casino on the space station known as Centerpoint Station during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Duff Caros, also known as Stumpy was a male Human cyborg who ran the Sleeping Rancor cantina in Nuba City on the planet Nubia during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Mastakatorus Darriovof III was a male nerf rancher who worked on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Corran Costi was a male Lieutenant in the Corellian Security Force during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. Considered a veteran by the time of the war, Costi commanded the "Diligent," a PB-950 patrol boat.
Catrinna was a female Human who lived on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Vepon-Du was a Voss Mystic living on Voss many years before the planet was discovered by the galactic society. They had a vision that required their own death, lest all of Voss be destroyed. Vepon-Du obeyed the vision and took a step from the Step of Harmony platform in Voss-Ka.
Nelom-Wa was a Voss Mystic living on Voss many years before the planet was discovered by the galactic society. His vision led to replacing a great leader of the Three with an infant child.

Lelo-Vo was a Voss Mystic living on Voss many years before the planet was discovered by the galactic society. He had a vision that required sixteen years of the interpreters debating, during which time Lelo-Vo refused to replace them.

Medo-Ja was a Voss healer living on Voss many years before the planet was discovered by the galactic society. Considered the greatest healer ever born, he was the only Voss who could reliable heal Tharal-Ra's disease.

Davel-Ka was a Voss Mystic living on Voss many years before the planet was discovered by the galactic society. He had a vision that prevented a great healer Medo-Ja from helping a dying member of the Three.
Bacara was a Chagrian male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Delsa was a male Human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Ubed Yalla was a female Human Jedi Master who resided on the desert world of Tatooine in the settlement of Anchorhead. At some point in 3643 BBY, she trained a rising Jedi Consular who would later go on to earn the title of Barsen'thor.

Karu was a female Nautolan Jedi Master who resided on the ruined planet of Taris. At one point in the year 3643 BBY, she trained a rising Jedi Consular who would eventually achieve the rank of Barsen'thor.

Anson was a male Human Sergeant who could be found on the frozen and barren planet of Hoth during the time period known as the Cold War. On the world, he made his living as a heavy armor vendor and merchant, selling items to the citizens of the Galactic Republic.

Artok was a male Human who dwelt on the frozen ice planet of Hoth in the year 3643 BBY. He made his living on the world as a vendor and merchant, selling items and material to the Galactic Republic's citizens. He wore a brown and blue uniform.
Bladedust was a male Human armsmaster in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire who was stationed on the planet Taris.
Fianna was the female owner and head chef of the café known as the Draknul Café during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Prahman Su was a Human from the planet Corellia who was considered one of the most disreputable scoundrels in the Corellian system during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Brali Ixxis was a female Chadra-Fan from the planet Corellia who was considered one of the most disreputable scoundrels in the Corellian system during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Conevor was a male individual who worked with the pilot Tala and the Drall Gus during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Gus was a male Drall who was affiliated with the pilot Tala and her comrade Conevor during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Gek was a male Zabrak captain in the Republic Navy during the Cold War, a conflict fought between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Bryint was a male Human Republic soldier who served in the Republic Army of the Galactic Republic's during the Cold War and Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire, during which he was stationed on the space station Carrick Station.

Ba'teil Skaveez was a female Human who resided on the war-ruined planet of Balmorra during the Cold War era. Around 3643 BBY, she was a junk dealer, having set up shop close to Bugtown in the Broken Valley.
Balankin was a male Human sergeant of the reconstituted Sith Empire who was stationed in the Imperial base camp on the planet Ilum during Operation Dark Ice.

Balaro was a male Human who worked as a quartermaster for Imperial Intelligence during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY, Balaro was stationed on the Vaiken Spacedock of the Imperial Fleet.
Kaddreth was a male Human Alderaanian who lived during the Cold War and worked as an assistant to Peema Ahuff, the curator of the House Alde Royal Museum.

Dutonian was a Human male mercenary working on Alderaan during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY Skavak hired him and his men to lay an ambush for the Voidhound in the Hangar RS-32 of Pallista Spaceport on Alderaan.

Bella was a Human female who held the rank of private in the Imperial Military during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, she was stationed on the Vaiken Spacedock in the Imperial Fleet, where she made her living as a vendor.

Brejjan was a male Human private in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. As of 3643 BBY, he was stationed aboard Vaiken Spacedock in the Imperial Fleet, where he served the Empire as a vendor and merchant.
Juran Reb was a Togruta male living during the Cold War and the husband of Audila.

Labine was a Human female living on Tatooine during the Cold War. She was the prisoner of a group of desert-worshiping cannibals. They held Labine her in a cave out in the Dune Sea, where she treated them for the laughing sickness.

Zebulun was a Duros male member of the Balmorran resistance during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he and his squad were sent by Numen Brock to the Malak Memorial Research Base, where they took over Moff Tyrak, a deserter from the resurgent Sith Empire, from the hands of the Voi…
Flayn was a Human male commander in the reconstituted Sith Empire's military during the Galactic War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Geana was a female Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order during the Galactic War. Assigned to Hoth during 3642 BBY, she was protecting Major Panin during an Imperial assault on the Aurek Base and perished in the same blast that claimed his life.

The father of Akaavi Spar was a male Zabrak Mandalorian. By the time of the Galactic War he had passed away, and Akaavi was the last remaining member of Clan Spar. She mentioned her father in conversations with the Voidhound.

Shariss Kartur was a Mirialan female living during the Cold War and Galactic War. She was good friends with Risha Drayen and Sumalee, and the three women were called "the Triple Threat" during their extravagant young years.

Devar Gann was a male Human diplomat of the living Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. His sister Kindra Gann suffered from a rare form of Mizra Syndrome since birth, but was healed following a pilgrimage to the Shrine of Healing on Voss.
Deon Aarlaa was a male Twi'lek in the employ of Clan Ryo as a member of the personal guard of Baron Volnos Ryo, the head of the Ryo Syndicate and brother of Je'daii Ranger Hawk Ryo.
The mother of Devar and Kindra Gann was a female Human of the Galactic Republic living during the Cold War. By the year 3640 BBY she was on her deathbed, apparently from old age.
Kindra Gann was a female Human who lived during the Galactic War. She suffered from a rare form of Mizra Syndrome since birth, but was healed following a pilgrimage to the Shrine of Healing on Voss.
Zak was a male Human smuggler living during the Galactic War.
Yem Ordalien was a male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a combat instructor during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.

Henni was a female Twi'lek who during the Cold War lived on Tython illegally among the Pilgrims. She was one of many Pilgrims who followed Matriarch Kolovish to Tython in the aftermath of the Great Galactic War and the enslavement of Ryloth by the Hutt Cartels.
Eomin Dessain was the male Human director of Dessain Mining on Zerist around 25,793 BBY.

Tholver Shan was a Human male who served the Sith Empire as an ensign on the Sith capital planet of Dromund Kaas. He served under Captain Sarnova, who he and others who served under her referred to as "Duchess."
Nick was a seller of various types of speeders on Coruscant during the Invasion of Naboo. Signs advertising Nick's speeders could be seen throughout the Coruscant underworld.
Bruner was the owner of a restaurant on Coruscant during the Invasion of Naboo. Signs advertising Bruner's establishment could be seen throughout the Coruscant underworld.
Hun Duo was a male Human who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He once met with a Rodian named Greepo in the cantina of Nem'ro's Palace on Nal Hutta.
Greepo was a male Rodian who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He once met with a Human named Hun Duo in the cantina of Nem'ro's Palace on Nal Hutta.
Prothee was a male Human lieutenant who served in the army of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War fought between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Eschul Shaywa was a Human female, born on the planet Coruscant. By the reign of the Galactic Empire, Shaywa was a contributor for Imperial Center Today, and wrote a piece on the history of the ancient Taung and Zhell peoples as remembered through the Dha Werda Verda.
Wratchen was a male Human Sith Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY he was on Voss, seeking to acquire Gormak cyberbeasts from the smuggler Jela Reneke.
Mirev-Ka was a female Voss living on Voss during the Galactic War. She was a member of the Adjudicators and the wife of the diplomat Lokir-Ka.
Desora was a Pureblood Sith female who served the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Naal Turro was a brilliant slicer living before the Cold War. He kept his secrets in a journal that was stored on a holodisc.
Azula-Hej was a male Voss from the planet Voss living during the Cold War. He was among the few of his people who left their homeworld to see the larger galaxy.
Curao was a male associate of Rogun the Butcher during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY Rogun sent the Voidhound to meet Curao on Corellia to try and get to Darmas Pollaran and Bevera Dodonna.

347.609/D5 was an Imperial commander. This commander was in charge of a small group of veteran soldiers, consisting of Explorer Squad Esk-23, Stormtrooper Squad Aurek and Besh, who had been abandoned on Endor after the Battle of Endor.

Bren Harvist was a Rebel commander who was stationed on Endor after the Battle of Endor. He was in command of the Rebel commando group Recon-A who had been assigned to an Ewok village to help its inhabitants recover from the Battle of Endor.

Hreda was a male Drall living during the Galactic War. During the Battle of Corellia Hreda joined the Corellian resistance and Galactic Republic forces in their efforts to drive Imperials off the planet.

343.245/H5 was an Imperial commander in the Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit. During the Battle of Turak IV, this commander was in command of a team of two squads, Squad 5-Aurek and Squad 5-Cresh, that were sent to retrieve a downed, but still operational, repulsor tank, the …

Darth Perash was a Sith Lord of Human or Sith pureblood descent who served the Sith Empire. The Sith spent decades building an elaborate tomb, often ordering the workers to tear down everything they had done and start over.
Larindaz was a male Kubaz mercenary who visited the war ruined world of Balmorra.
Shi Bata's wife was a female Corellian and a wife of Shi Bata who died in 3640 BBY when the Sith Empire invaded the planet.
Oleg Klerren was the male mayor of Anchorhead, a town on the planet Tatooine, during the Cold War. He had two aides named Cohn and Ixa assisting him with his duties.
Ander Onos was a Human male who worked as a requisitions officer for Galactic Solutions Industries on the planet Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War.

Sirinek was a male Human captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY he was stationed on the Harrower-class dreadnought Regnant, the flagship of Admiral Harridax Kirill.
Anlen was a male Human who served as a private in the Republic Army on the planet Balmorra during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. He worked under Sergeant Carness.

Rone was a slicer who was the partner of Chio Fain. After slicing into property of the Galactic Empire, Rone and Fain were pursued and attacked by Imperial TIE fighters above Ryarten. Rone distracted the fighters so that Fain could escape into hyperspace, but was killed.

Clento Rone's son was a Ithorian male son of the Galactic Republic Senator Clento Rone. During the Galactic War he worked as an engineer in the Republic shipyards, which were saved from an Imperial assault by the Voidhound.

Helik was a male Human Fleet Admiral who served in the Republic Navy during the Galactic War with the resurgent Sith Empire. After the Voidhound defeated the Voidwolf during the Battle of Corellia, Helik participated in the ceremony of honoring the smuggler.

Alys was a female Nautolan who worked as an agent for the Galactic Republics' Strategic Information Service during the Cold War. During the conflict, she worked on the moon Nar Shaddaa with her partner Kesler.

Danla Zin was a female Human member of the Balmorran resistance during the Galactic War. Her husband, Magar had stolen an Imperial uniforms and with some of his friends tried to infiltrate the Nebula Research Base in the Gorinth Canyon.
"Beauty Queen" was the nickname used by a female lieutenant of the bleeder gangs in the Red Light Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa.

Magar was a male Human member of the Balmorran resistance during the Galactic War and the husband of Danla Zin. Along with some friends he had stolen Imperial uniforms and tried to infiltrate the Nebula Research Base in the Gorinth Canyon.
Whitat was a male Human who lived on Balmorra during the Galactic War and ran the small settlement of Moraine Outpost.
Bertrin was a doctor who lived on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War. He argued with Galactic Republic Major Sarell over how the Sith Empire's use of toxic fumes should be delt with.
Braigin Helk was a male Zabrak who worked as the leader of the Twin Suns pirates on the planet Tatooine. During the Cold War, he took Sorin Schaff hostage in his own home.

Bruan, known also as The Durasteel Fist, was a male Human who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War. During the War, he was stationed in the Imperial Intelligence Gadget Warehouse on the moon Nar Shaddaa where he was killed by Galactic Republic aligned individuals.

Lycus Mattle was a male Human member of Imperial Intelligence of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was present on Nal Hutta outside Nem'ro's Palace during Cipher Nine's undercover mission as "Red Blade."
Suwan'zi was a male Human citizen of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. He resided in Kaas City on Dromund Kaas, requisitioning weapons to authorized individuals.
Vari'kalwes was a male Human merchant who resided in Kaas City on Dromund Kaas, the capital of the reconstituted Sith Empire, during the Cold War.
Zanler was a male Mirialan living during the Cold War. He resided on Nar Shaddaa, working as a merchant at the Promenade.
Masax was a male Human living during the Cold War. He resided on Nar Shaddaa, working as a merchant at the Promenade.
Rhemer was a Nautolan male sergeant of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. He was stationed at the Republic quarters at the capital of Voss, Voss-Ka.
Tana Jadance was a female Human smuggler living during the Galactic War. She had at one point visited the capital of Voss, Voss-Ka.

Artagan Truax was a Human male inmate of the Cog Hive Seven prison by the year 33 BBY. Truax worked to protect his son and fellow prisoner, Eogan Truax, from the rest of the prison's general population.
Irizon Fawx was a humanoid male soldier in the Republic Army who served on the planet Quesh during the Galactic War. He worked as a merchant at the Republic Operational Headquarters.
Ulios was a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War who was known for conducting a number of operas.
Coyle was a Chadra-Fan male inmate of the Cog Hive Seven prison by the year 33 BBY.

Dakarai Blirr, the Human male brother of Sadiki Blirr, was the operations officer and designer of the Cog Hive Seven prison. He masqueraded as the Twi'lek male Zero while secretly serving the arms dealer Iram Radique, who surreptitiously operated out of the prison.
Eogan Truax was the sixteen-year-old Human male son and fellow prisoner of Artagan Truax at the Cog Hive Seven prison in the year 33 BBY. He had red-brown hair and pale-green eyes.

Vesto Slipher was a Muun male field analyst of the InterGalactic Banking Clan by the year 33 BBY. He was killed in Cog Hive Seven by Maul, when Maul reprogrammed CLL-8 binary load lifter, which sliced Slipher's neck in half.
Vasco Nailhead, nicknamed Vas, was the Human male leader of the Bone Kings, one of two major prison gangs within the Cog Hive Seven prison by the year 33 BBY.

Riv Krasul was a Cathar male who was the son of Zorin Krasul, the Senator of the planet Anaxes in the Galactic Republic's Senate during the Cold War with the Sith Empire. Riv and his brother, Valdon, were the children of Zorin and his wife Ondia Krasul.

Valdon Krasul was a Cathar male who was the son of Zorin Krasul, the Senator of the planet Anaxes in the Galactic Republic's Senate during the Cold War with the Sith Empire. Valdon and his brother, Riv, were the children of Zorin and his wife Ondia Krasul.
Augustine Smight was one of the guards of the Cog Hive Seven prison by the year 33 BBY. He also worked as an undercover employee of Jabba the Hutt.

Logovik was one of the guards of the Cog Hive Seven prison by the year 33 BBY. He was actually a spy working for Jabba the Hutt, who, along with his other minions, infiltrated the Cog Hive Seven to track down arms dealer Iram Radique and gather information about his dealings.

Voystock was one of the guards of the Cog Hive Seven prison by the year 33 BBY. He was killed the same year at the same place by Jagannath. Before his death, he had a deal with the inmate Artagan Truax to get him and his son Eogan out of the prison.
Rook was an Aqualish male inmate of the Cog Hive Seven prison by the year 33 BBY. He served the weapons designer Iram Radique, who operated out of the prison.
Iram Radique was a weapons designer who operated out of the Cog Hive Seven prison during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Byro Ti'mere was the owner of Ti'mere's InfoServices and resided in the Brak sector.
Jyss Cordam worked as a slicer for Byro Ti'mere at Ti'mere's InfoServices.
Dav Wissark was a slicer who worked for Byro Ti'mere at Ti'mere's InfoServices.

Rohn was a male Human general within the Galactic Empire. The Imperial enforcer, Darth Vader assigned him direct command of the Shrouded Offensive, a military operation at the Outer Rim planet of Ostor.

A Human male was a nobleman of the planet Irmenu, and the father of a daughter who held the title of princess. When the nobleman's daughter fell in love with Walon Vau, the son of an Irmenu admiral and count, both the nobleman and Vau's father refused to consent to the match.

Huska was a fictional Hutt character who featured in the holodrama True Tales of the Ancient Republic in Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim, which aired in 114 BBY. In the show Huska was the nemesis of sector Ranger Novan Nune, and at one stage fought him in single combat.
Novan Nune was a fictional Sector Ranger character who featured in the holodrama True Tales of the Ancient Republic in Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim, which aired in 114 BBY.

A Jilruan pirate was held captive by authorities on the planet Belasco during the Kymoodon Era. The pirate revealed to the authorities while in captivity that there was an assault being planned on the planet of Parcovey Minor.

Artar Mothma was a member of the Mothma family from Chandrila. By the year 0 ABY, a few months after the Battle of Yavin, Artar Mothma was dead and buried on the family's grounds in the Chandrilan prairies.

Hu Jibwe was a scholar of military history, employed at the Salmagodro Grand Academy during the Imperial Era. Some time after 15 BBY, Hu spoke with Imperial Center Today contributor Eschul Shaywa, and discussed the Mandalorian Dha Werda Verda chant's history and composition.
Sura was an athletic red-skinned female, Twi'lek who, during the Galactic Civil War, worked on Centerpoint Station for the Five Brothers Resort and Casino.

Boffen Nibs was a male Drall who lived on the planet Drall. The son of Duchess Lassa Nibs, he stole a large diamond known as the Eye of Corell from her which traced their family line back for many generations.
Mari was Human female, who worked as a courier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Adronik Hyllus was a Human who served as a captain in the reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Military. Sometime prior to 3666 BBY, Hyllus married a Human woman native to Jurio after the planet was granted Imperial governance.

A Human at some point served as an officer of the Galactic Empire. They had light skin and blond hair that they wore long and braided. The officer wore a dark-colored uniform with a rank insignia plaque with four blue squares.

The mother of Vector Hyllus was a female Human who was native to the planet Jurio. After the reconstituted Sith Empire conquered their world, they met an Imperial captain named Adronik Hyllus, and the two were married after Jurio was granted Imperial governance.
The Seer of the Temple, or the Swamp Seer, was a native of Gap Nine. The Seer resided in an ancient temple, serving as a guardian of its treasures.
Alexsandr Kallus was a human male revolutionary who served as a rebel spy in the formative days of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and into the early phase of the Galactic Civil War.

Trench, designated Gamma-383, was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic. Born on the planet Kamino, Gamma-383 was created to serve the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Tingo was a male Human private in the Republic Army during the Galactic War. As of 3642 BBY, he was stationed on the ice planet of Hoth, where he sold items as a vendor.
Veemo was a Human male officer in the Republic Navy during the Galactic War. In the year 3643 BBY, Veemo was a vendor who could be found on the frozen ice planet of Hoth.
Mann was a male Human sergeant in the Republic Army during the Galactic War. He was stationed on the frozen ice planet of Hoth, where he sold weapons as a vendor.

Sabine Wren was a Force-sensitive human female Mandalorian warrior and revolutionary leader during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire, and later a Jedi during the early years of the New Republic.

An aide served Associate Governor Mothra during the Galactic Civil War. The aide was given the responsibility for keeping an eye on the smuggler Roark Garnet while he was on planet to ensure he broke no Imperial laws.
Protocol Boi was a male dancer who competed in competitions during the Galactic Civil War.

Marska was a Human female spy who had been ordered by the Emperor to keep an eye on Governor-General Dixton while posing as his vacuous mistress. She was fanatically loyal to the Galactic Empire and was far more capable and ruthless than her outward persona let on.

Lyn was a Human male Imperial bureaucrat who served as a secretary to Governor-General Dixton of the Fakir sector. He was aboard the Curich-class shuttle Resurgence when it was forced to land on the planet Abonshee.

Perspik was a Human male Imperial bureaucrat. He was assigned as a secretary to Governor-General Dixton of the Fakir sector. Perspik was aboard the Curich-class shuttle Resurgence when it had been forced to land on the planet Abonshee.
Sooloot was a Jedi Master and a scholar of the Jedi Order who most notably remarked on the origins of the Prophecy of the Chosen One.

A short, wrinkled Duros served as a loadmaster in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army and was stationed aboard the Acclamator-class assault ship Implacable in 22 BBY, during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Jasta Finn was a male Human bounty hunter, whose base of operations was Seikosha. He worked for the crime lord Janelle Serap.

A crown prince was a Human male member of House Panteer, the royal family of the planet Alderaan. Around 3703 BBY, the prince was arranged to marry a girl from House Organa, but a young Jedi discovered that the bride was in fact a daughter of House Thul—the child had been swit…
A young member of the Jedi Order was active around 3703 BBY, when the crown prince of the planet Alderaan was arranged to marry a daughter of the noble House Organa.

A male was a member of House Organa, a noble house of the planet Alderaan, and served as lord of their house sometime well before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
A male Human member of House Alde, a noble house of the planet Alderaan, held the title of earl sometime before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

At least two individuals were the parents of the Human female Thana Vesh were members of the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire and they raised their daughter in wealth and privilege on the Empire's capital of Dromund Kaas.
A female Imperial agent posed as Chilla, an undercover agent of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, after the latter's cover was discovered.
In 33 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Maul fought a wampa in forced gladiatorial combat while in the space penitentiary Cog Hive Seven.
Shaylai Veila was a female Rutian Twi'lek that served as a secretary to Jedi Master Kai Hudorra following his acquisition of The Lucky Twi'lek on Kestavel.

Amni Ponnar was a young Human female who lived at her parent's homestead on Tatooine around 0 BBY. That year, her life was put in danger after her father's plan to make the local Jawas and Tusken Raiders go to war over food turned wrong.
Ponnar was a Human male moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine around 0 BBY, along with his wife and their daughter, Amni.
Mrs. Ponnar was a Human female who lived on Tatooine around 0 BBY, along with her husband and their daughter, Amni.

Jorsooda was a Hutt crime lord who was the chief rival of Karagga the Hutt. Sometime between 3645 BBY and 3640 BBY, Jorsooda had purchased three pet vorantiki and bet that they could kill Karagga's prized rancor, Bonethrasher.

Bezar One was the protege of Teha Zero, the founder of the cyberneticist cult known as the New Men. When Zero died sometime before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, Bezar One took over the New Men and turned the peaceful group into a…
Teha Zero founded the cyberneticist cult known as the New Men on the planet Metellos sometime before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Grancha Lakand was a male explorer who worked on the planet Quesh in the early years of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire.

A male individual was a notorious pirate who had a number of sons, including one named Shai Tenna. The man's children had an abusive childhood at the hands of their father, and they placed their sons in leadership positions in their pirate crew.
A male Talz was the father of the Talz warrior Broonmark well before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Bryti was a humanoid male that served as a butler to fugitive Jedi Master Kai Hudorra following his acquisition of The Lucky Twi'lek on Kestavel. His wide head was fitted with a Borg Construct Aj^6 headband.
Urtsk was a large Barabel that served as a bodyguard to Jedi Master Kai Hudorra following his acquisition of The Lucky Twi'lek on Kestavel.
Makall was a female Human that worked as a guard at The Lucky Twi'lek on Kestavel.
This supervisor oversaw Star Tours workers that included baggage screener G2-9T. The supervisor scolded G2-9T following reports that the talkative droid was not screening all baggage.
Troov was a male Nothoiin general who aided, allied, and supported the Galactic Republic in the liberation of Nothoiin against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Kal was a muscular male Human that served as a bodyguard to Jedi Master Kai Hudorra following his acquisition of The Lucky Twi'lek on Kestavel.
Dayn was a Bith that, along with Nira, served as a chef to Jedi Master Kai Hudorra following his acquisition of The Lucky Twi'lek on Kestavel.
Nira was a Bith that, along with Dayn, served as a chef to Jedi Master Kai Hudorra following his acquisition of The Lucky Twi'lek on Kestavel.

A male weapons smuggler was active during the Galactic Civil War. The smuggler managed to run afoul of both the Rebel Alliance and another individual while running weapons into an Imperial controlled sector.

Fin Mak'lath was a Human from Kalarcha, the capital city of Athallia. There, he served as a police officer until his wife was killed in food riots. After his wife's death, Mak'lath moved to Bespin and joined the Bespin Wing Guard.

Fantes Mer'darro was a native of Balosar, a planet which was homeworld to the eponymous species. By 3 ABY, Mer'darro joined the Bespin Wing Guard, the main security force of Cloud City on the planet Bespin.
Corman Jeihn was a Human male from Calabosh-2 where he served for a time as a security guard for the weapons manufacturing company Caliban.
Bialar Selis was a Human male from Bespin who served in the Bespin Wing Guard during the Galactic Civil War. He was a rising star in the Guard and led the investigation for the stolen Jewel of Yavin.

Jake Sirrom hailed from Dahvil, and his mother was Gem Sirrom, who worked in the Senate of the Republic and represented Jake's home planet prior to the Republic's dissolution and the Galactic Empire forming in 19 BBY.

Razell Tameron was a male Human from the planet Bespin who served as a member of the Bespin Wing Guard during the Galactic Civil War. He worked as warden of the Wing Guards' base of operations in Cloud City, the Cloud City Security Tower.

Jell Spiel was a Human male from Bespin who served the Bespin Wing Guard as a cloud car pilot during the Galactic Civil War. He co-piloted one of two Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud cars near Cloud City in 3 ABY when the Millennium Falcon arrived there.
Duncan Hikmat was a Human male from the planet Stobar who served the Bespin Wing Guard as a cloud car pilot during the Galactic Civil War, around 3 ABY.
Ark Rutendo was a Human male from Bespin who served with the Bespin Wing Guard during the Galactic Civil War. He was present with other Wing Guardsmen just prior to the Occupation of Bespin in 3 ABY.
Alec Mard was a Human male who hailed from the planet Zhanox. He eventually joined the planet Bespin's Wing Guard.

Gir Endac was a Human male from the planet Mexeluine who served in the Bespin Wing Guard during the Galactic Civil War. He was present with fellow Wing Guardsmen in Cloud City just prior to the Occupation of Bespin in 3 ABY.

Jann Derem was a Human male from the planet Uyter who served the Bespin Wing Guard during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, just prior to the Occupation of Bespin, Derem guarded Lando Calrissian from Chewbacca when Lando entered the cell that contained the angry Wookiee.
Allen Neff was a Human male from the planet Ertegas who moved to Bespin at the age of six, joining the Wing Guard that served the planet's Cloud City by 3 ABY.
The grandmother of Overseer Harkun was a Human Sith. Around 3643 BBY, her grandson would call her twisted and ugly, comparing her repulsive appearance to that of a Gran Sith Acolyte named Argog.

Neff survived the revolt, however, and was instrumental in developing a secret slave circuitry that surviving Imperial captives used to free themselves and their ships from Yevethan control twelve years later.

Ramid was a Human captain of a starship who was a former love interest of Ania Solo, a descendant of the smuggler Han Solo. During the last years of the Second Imperial Civil War, he and Ania Solo were imprisoned at an Imperial prison camp on the planet Drash-So.
Bolo was an Ithorian male who was a regular patron of Cid's Parlor on Ord Mantell. Usually seen with the Weequay Ketch, Bolo wore a translating vocoder in order to speak Galactic Basic Standard.
During the Galactic Civil War, an admiral served the Galactic Empire. The GX1 Short Hauler Long Shot was supposed to be the admiral's, until it was stolen by agents of Reekeene's Roughnecks.
Atticus Farstar was a Human male Separatist general during the Clone Wars. In the aftermath, Atticus guided several surviving Separatists into hiding on the Outer Rim planet Ostor.
Around 0 ABY, a bounty hunter was working for the Galactic Empire on Kwenn Space Station, having been contracted to capture Commander Adar Tallon from hiding on Tatooine.
Around 0 ABY, a bounty hunter was working for the Galactic Empire on Kwenn Space Station. He was hired by the Empire to track down Commander Adar Tallon, believed to be in hiding on Tatooine.

A male Humanoid customs officer was responsible for overseeing Docking Bay 94 in 0 ABY. He accepted a modest bribe of one hundred credits from the crew of the Alabak's Gold, an Alliance to Restore the Republic ship.
Edu Harn was an elderly woman on the planet Tatooine. She had suffered an attack by Tusken Raiders at some point, and was considered to be senile by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Darth Arkous was a Sith male Dark Lord of the Sith and a member of the Sith Empire's ruling Dark Council during the Galactic War against the Galactic Republic. As a veteran in the Great Galactic War, and a strong Imperial loyalist that planned the Assault on Tython.
Lana Beniko was a Human female Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Galactic War against the Galactic Republic she served as an advisor to Dark Council member Darth Arkous.
Bels Lank was a male farmer living on Tatooine with his daughter, Reen. He was killed on his farm around 0 ABY by the bounty hunter IG-72 who was searching for Adar Tallon.

Reen was a daughter of Bels Lank, a farmer living on Tatooine. When the bounty hunter IG-72 arrived at their farm and killed her father, believing him to be Adar Tallon, Reen hid until Alliance to Restore the Republic agents found her.

Ferrid was a male Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War. During the war in c. 3665 BBY, Ferrid managed to steal a Republic superweapon, but was soon captured and send to the Belsavis prison.

Gorm Rons was a male Human who was a commander of House Ulgo's troops during the Cold War. He patrolled the Ulgo Footpaths around and near King's Pass on Alderaan, and was eventually killed by a Republic individual in 3643 BBY.
A male Gungan worked as a librarian in the city of New Otoh Gunga.

A clone trooper was part of the Republic task force that invaded the planet Xagobah in 19 BBY. During the ensuing conflict against the Separatists, the Republic forces, including the clone trooper, besieged Mazariyan, the citadel of the Techno Union Foreman Wat Tambor.

Many generations before the Galactic Civil War, a king ruled over the Phlogs who lived in the land of Simoom on the Forest Moon of Endor. At some point, his subjects decided to build a palace for him, which prompted them to chop down all the trees of the land to build it.

A male Mandalorian died from suffocation due to an allergic reaction to Blisterbug venom. Although his chest started to swell, he refused to remove the breastplate as he believed it would insult his honor.

Kayson was a male alien who ran Kayson's Weapons Shop in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. He had a sour disposition and atrocious manners. He was a hulking ape-like humanoid with short fur, four nostrils, and an optical enhancer worn over his left eye.

Lord Goh was a male Chagrian Sith Lord living during the Galactic War. By 3637 BBY Goh became a member of the Order of Revan and joined a fellow Revanite Darth Arkous in planning and executing the attack on Tython.

A clone trooper fought in the Clone Wars for the Galactic Republic, against a separatist group known as the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 21 BBY, he was aboard the assault ship Prosecutor when it was boarded by Trandoshans and subsequently went missing.
A prominent member of the Imperial Senate took interest in the Human student Harsh while the young man studied at an Imperial Academy, prior to the Galactic Civil War.
An individual was the second Padawan of Jedi Master Roan Shryne during the Clone Wars. In 19.5 BBY, the Padawan was killed in the Battle of Manari.

A male bully used a rock to smash a toy Star Destroyer belonging to the Human child Harsh. Harsh, despite being smaller than the bully, took the rock from the other child and smashed the bully's face with it.

A Force-sensitive individual lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic. At some point before the outbreak of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY, the individual was chosen as Padawan by the Jedi Roan Shryne.
Shooter was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Republic Starfighter Corps Red Group during the Clone Wars. He died sacrificing himself destroying the new CIS ship by crashing into the core.

Lorenn was a male Jedi Master who ran a recruitment center on the moon Nar Shaddaa. He recruited the Mon Calamari con artist Languss Tuno and took him as a Padawan, though Tuno later abandoned his training and left the Jedi Order, stealing Lorenn's lightsaber.
Quarsh Panaka was a human male native to the planet Naboo and a security forces captain who served the Royal House of Naboo as the Head of Security during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Pars Varqom was a retired Palace Guard for the Royal Naboo Security Forces. Varqom served as a "Pearl Hat" for 18 years under seven monarchs, from King Ars Veruna to Queen Mairayni.

The Imperial Station Captain was a female Human in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire who commanded the space station Korriban's Flame during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

A Grand Mage was a Gotal male that held the title of Grand Mage of the Order of the Canted Circle in the decades before the Battle of Naboo being the leader of the group; he courted the wealthy Muun leader of Damask Holdings, Hego Damask, in an attempt to get him to join which…

Goodrow Neb Nob was a Gungan who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. By 33 BBY, Neb Nob lived in Otoh Gunga, the capital city of the Gungan society, under the rule of Boss Rugor Nass.

Wollod was a male Gungan who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. By 33 BBY, he was already an aged Gungan, as reflected by his whiskers. At the time, Wollod served in the Gungan Grand Army, bearing the title of Commander.
The Great Hohokum was a large and ancient Hohokum that was kept in the Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility in the last decades of the Galactic Republic.

Raxxus was a male Zabrak Sith Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Cold War. He fell out of favor with the Dark Council and was imprisoned in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison. He was later killed by a group of Imperial spacers hired by Lord Shaar.
Tolar was a Human male and the king of Arrochar during the early Galactic Civil War. His wife was Queen Tiina, and their son was Prince Kaspar.
Lima Starcourt was a female Human lawyer who spent most of her career on Coruscant. She later moved to Ostor and became one of the leaders of the Separatist group.

An individual served as an instructor for Jedi Initiates at the Jedi Temple on the Republic's capital world, Coruscant in 19 BBY. During that year, the Jedi met the bounty hunter Boba Fett in a corridor at the temple and showed him his quarters.
This male Rodian served as a bounty hunter for the corpulent Rodian crime lord Reelo Baruk during the year 12 ABY.
Yark was the leader of his tribe and the the father of A'Yark and adopted father of K'Sheek. Yark allowed both his daughters to be trained as warriors, and defended the criticism against them.
"Big Mama" was the nickname that Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano gave to a parent of several reptiles that she encountered during a battle on Zeenada.
Rian Darok was a Human male colonel in the Republic Army during the Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Darth Soverus was a male Sith Dark Lord of the Sith of the reconstituted Sith Empire and a member of the Emperor's Dark Council.
Vebb was a male Rodian pilot working for the Old Tion Brotherhood during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY he worked for Gorvich on Nar Shaddaa delivering spice.

Frinn was a male working for the Old Tion Brotherhood during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY he worked for Gorvich on Nar Shaddaa delivering spice, but was shot down and killed on the orders of Morbo the Hutt.

Darth Savik was a female Human who served under Darth Hadra and Darth Acharon during the Battle of Corellia, and later as a Dark Councillor of the Sphere of Scientific Advancement in the resurgent Sith Empire during the third Galactic War.
Grigor was a male Humanoid who served as a Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
A clone trooper served in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

An individual served in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire at some point during its reign. He was selected as a pilot for the Rogue Shadow, the ship used by "Starkiller," the secret apprentice of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Leika was a male Bothan who worked as chief surveyor for a mining company around the time of the Invasion of Naboo. He was medium-sized and possessed a broad nose and beard.

A male captain led a recon force that was tasked with gathering information on the Shaper research facility on Dibrook by Kaye Galfridian. His group was ambushed by Tsalok and other Yuuzhan Vong warriors.

This chief advisor served Craw, the Dictator-Forever of Targonn, for a time. He was one in a line of many. He was influenced by a drug that made him a "Smiler." In 5.5 BBY, the advisor was fired by Craw, who was later attacked by the droids C-3PO and R2-D2.

Vinn was a male Human criminal living on Ziost and working with the Old Tion Brotherhood and the Ziost Liberation Front during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY he helped Theron Shan and Gnost-Dural in their mission.

Lesia was a female from the planet Naboo. She was the great-granddaughter of Pars Varqom, a retired Palace Guard for the Royal Naboo Security Forces. Varqom served as a Pearl Hat for 18 years under seven monarchs, from King Ars Veruna to Queen Mairayni.

Gisseran was a Moff of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. Gisseran acquired a memento from the invasion of Taris, but they were forced to seek outside help when they discovered the memento had been stolen.
Asset R-3 was a male member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Asset R-27 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Asset I-32 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Asset I-12 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Asset I-40 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Asset I-4 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as The Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Asset R-10 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Asset R-31 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Asset C-5 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the The Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Asset O-9 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. O-9 was dispatched to Oricon to investigate the demise of the Dread Masters.
The man known only as the Shroud was a Human male who was a legendary freelance spy active years before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Evie Bo was a Human female spy that was a top lieutenant in The Shroud's organization during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Erbaly Nap'tee was an old Nikto woman who lived on Tatooine at the end of the Clone Wars. She was a frequent patron of Dannar's Claim, where her interactions with Annileen Calwell were typified by dementia that prevented her from remembering Annileen or any other employees of …

Bohmer was a Rodian who was a frequent patron of Dannar's Claim at the end of the Clone Wars. He drank caf every day and never spoke to Annileen Calwell or any of the Claim's other patrons. Bohmer was stabbed in the back by a Tusken Raider during A'Yark's raid on the Claim.
Dr. Mell (known as Doc Mell) was a Mon Calamari Doctor practicing medicine on Tatooine at the end of the Clone Wars. Mell treated many of the patrons of Dannar's Claim, including Bohmer and Zedd.
A Geonosian warrior fought in the First Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY, at the outset of the Clone Wars between the Republic and a separatist group known as the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Yindo was an Ithorian male who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. He was stationed on the Gav Daragon. During the outbreak of the rakghoul plague in the Tion Hegemony, he transported a Republic strike team to Kaon.
Jensyn was a Human male Jedi who served as commander in the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.

Riilna was a Cathar male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who specialized in Force empathy and mental control during the Galactic War. In 3637 BBY, the Jedi participated in the Korriban Incursion and was killed by an Imperial strike team.

Imos was a male individual who served in the rank of major in the Republic Special Forces Division, an elite section of the Galactic Republic's army during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Striking Staff was a powerful male Esh-kha warrior who was imprisoned on the planet Belsavis by the Infinite Empire thousands of years before the Cold War.
Nakar-Sel was a tall male Voss who resided at the Shrine of Healing on Voss. He held the title of First Commando.
The Rock-eater was a vorantikus living on Voss during the Galactic War. It was slain in the Pelath-Ri Marches.
Gez Addar was a male engineer stationed on Makeb during the events of the Conquest of Makeb. He examined the Ark, a massive spaceship built by the Hutt Cartel.
A Galactic Empire admiral was stationed at the Death Star II around the time of the Assault on the Death Star.

Rowralorr was a male Wookiee who worked as a gunsmith at some point between the years 1 ABY and 3 ABY. During this period they lived on the floating mining colony of Cloud City, which was located in the atmosphere of the planet Bespin.

Tezli Odo was a female Rodian who lived on the floating mining colony of Cloud City, located in the atmosphere of the planet Bespin, at some point between the years 1 ABY and 3 ABY. Within Cloud City, Odo ran The Hatchery, a shop which sold exotic pets and various food animals.
Hobi Rann was a male Human merchant who ran a shop known as Hobi Rann's Fine Imported Goods at some point between the years 1 ABY and 3 ABY.
Cidri was a Bothan jeweler who lived on Cloud City, a floating mining colony in the atmosphere of the gas giant Bespin, at some point between the years 1 ABY and 3 ABY.
Henna was a Bothan jeweler who ran the jewellery company Bothawui Jewellers at some point between the years 1 ABY and 3 ABY.

Yawrocca was a female Wookiee who lived in Cloud City on the planet Bespin during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. She frequented the Four-and-a-Half, an illegal cantina located in the Port Town district of the city.
Deelo was an Aqualish who worked as a street tough during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Arend Shen was a male Pantoran who lived on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War. During the war, he hired a group of spacers to steal the Jewel of Yavin, a Corusca gem owned by Marus Grayson, an Imperial whom he had a grudge against.
Moran was a Twi'lek male Jedi Master stationed on Ilum around 3640 BBY.
Hendrick was a Human male Corellian who lived on the planet Corellia during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Oudon was a Human male Corellian who lived on the planet Corellia during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Sherro was a Human male Corellian who lived on the planet Corellia during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. During the Battle of Corellia, at which time Sherro led a resistance cell against the Imperial occupation.
Quil was a female Selonian member of the Corellian resistance movement during the Battle of Corellia.

Marclonus was a Twi'lek male who was a colonel in the Fourth Infantry of the Galactic Republic. He had spent ten years as a Hutt's slave messenger, and was forced to wear a shock collar during that time.

Karloss was a male Human sergeant in the Imperial Military who was deployed at the Battle of Corellia. He, along with most Imperial forces, was withdrawn from Corellia after the Imperial defeat and was temporarily stationed at Vaiken Spacedock while awaiting redeployment.
Vekker was a male Human private in the Second Infantry division of the Republic Military who served at the Battle of Corellia during the Galactic War.
Talash was a Drall agent of the Republic Strategic Information Service who was deployed at the Battle of Corellia.

Volos was a male Duros sergeant in the Republic Military who was deployed at the Battle of Corellia. Volos, his squads, and CorSec's Tactical Response Teams made progress against the Empire's forces near the main rocket tram station in the Government District of the Coronet Ci…
Kelsara Llenkch was a humanoid female who worked as an assassin in the last decades of the Galactic Republic.
Tho-Masfran Ciss was an individual who worked for The Coruscant Holo Net as the Senior Coruscant Correspondent around 23 BBY.

Bhurra was a male Lutrillian who served as a lieutenant for the crime lord Vorse Tabarith on Cloud City. The Lutrillian was assigned to monitor the crime lord's wife, Aris Shen, and during the Galactic Civil War followed her to Market Row.
Bea was a female Human who lived on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Bozzi was a female Ugnaught who ran the Lady Yarith hotel in the Port Town district of Cloud City, on the planet Bespin.
Bree was the shortened nickname of a female Human who lived in Cloud City on the planet Bespin during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Relgar Carrae, also known as the Carbine, was a male Near-Human who worked as a pilot during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. Carrae raced for the Hutt Cartel in the Cloud City Grand Prix alongside his co-pilot Garulo.
Reebo Keen was a Human male, who moved to Ostor and became one of the leaders of the group of Separatists there. Earlier in his life, he was an adventurer and discovered two star systems.

Phootla Veer, along with Lima Starcourt and Reebo Keen, was one of three leaders of a separatist cell that operated on the planet Ostor and remained loyal to the Separatist holdouts long after the Clone Wars ended.
Folex was a male Chiss Commander who joined Darth Malgus' New Empire during the Galactic War. He was killed during the Battle of Ilum.
Ley'arsha was a Human female professor dispatched to the planet Athiss as part of a Republic survey team six-eight-nine-mark-one. She led the excavation of the Sith ruins of Vodal Kressh.
Lk'graagth was a rakghoul supersoldier that was created by the mad Tionese scientist Sannus Lorrick during the Galactic War.

Chak'aghakh was a rakghoul supersoldier that was created by the mad Tionese scientist Sannus Lorrick during the Galactic War. Lorrick hired a pilot named Melarra to unknowingly ferry Chak'aghakh, G'klarg, Lk'graagth and a host of rakghoul supersoldiers to the planet Kaon.

G'klarg was a rakghoul supersoldier that was created by the mad Tionese scientist Sannus Lorrick during the Galactic War. Lorrick hired a pilot named Melarra to unknowingly ferry G'klarg, along with Chak'aghakh and Lk'graagth, to the planet Kaon.

Ondia Krasul was a Cathar female who was the wife of Zorin Krasul, the representative of the planet Anaxes in the Galactic Republic's Senate during the Cold War. She was also the mother of their two children, Riv and Valdon.
Boran was a Human male Sergeant in the Republic Military during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire. He served aboard the Brentaal Star.

Kerek was a male Human bounty hunter who worked as the chief enforcer of the Hutt crime lord Kaltho's criminal empire during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Holt was a Fleet Admiral who served the Galactic Empire in its Navy during the Imperial Period, in which the officer gave an indoctrination speech to cadets at the Naval Academy on Prefsbelt IV.

Maiya Vix was a female Human who served in the Imperial Army as part of the Dread Executioners strike force under Lord Hargrev. She assisted Hargrev and the Imperial forces during the Dread War on Oricon.

The woman Telia became the wife of the rogue clone trooper Hock Malsuum sometime after the Declaration of a New Order. She bore his child as he farmed the land. Malsuum considered her to be a source of warmth in his life.
This unidentified Yuzzem was an assassin who took part in the assassination attempt on the person of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine in 23 BBY.

Tregg the Destroyer was a male Trandoshan leader of Trandoshan warriors that joined Darth Malgus' New Empire during the Galactic War. He was killed during the Battle of Ilum onboard Malgus' space station.
The Beast of Vodal Kressh was a monstrous alchemical snarler that resided in the Tomb of Vodal Kressh on Athiss during the Cold War. It was slain by a strike team sent to investigate the planet.

Frostclaw was a male Skel living on Hoth during the Galactic War. A violent leader, Frostclaw led attacks on Ortolan settlers. The Ortolans requested assistance from the Republic. A strike team was dispatched to eliminate the problem. Frostclaw was confronted in his lair.

Drez Unlin was a male Felucian Podracer who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. At some point during the Clone Wars, he captured the Jedi Master Plo Koon and made him his hostage, until Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano came to their colleague's …
Jarg was a male Kaleesh mercenary in the service of Karagga the Hutt during the Cold War. He served as a bodyguard in Karagga's Palace where he was partnered with the Devaronian mercenary Sorno.
Sorno was a male Devaronian mercenary in the service of Karagga the Hutt during the Cold War. He served as a bodyguard in Karagga's Palace where he was partnered with the Kaleesh mercenary Jarg.

Nefra, formally referred to as Nefra, Who Bars the Way was an alchemically-modified female underwalker created by Dread Master Brontes. Nefra was tasked with guarding the gate to the Dread Fortress on the moon Oricon, and was slain by invading forces during the Dread War.

The Dread Guard Commander was a Human male Dread Commander of the Dread Host during the Galactic War. He was the in charge of a Dread Host's legion that tried to acquire the Aurora Cannon in the Section X on Belsavis but a spacer defeated the Dread Guard Commander and his sold…

Dep Aila was a scientist who lived on the planet Makeb. He was the first scientist to document the amphibian known as the barbed ginx, though he only encountered them by accident—after leaving his landspeeder unattended, he came back to find a small group of ginx had peeled of…
The father of Jhaka Bakarn was a Human male native to the planet Corellia several generations before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Alis Saro-Bakvalen was a Human female member of the Bakvalen family, a noble Corellian family. She was memorialized via hologram in Bakvalen Hall.

Nerrethel was a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Sometime between 3645 BBY and 3642 BBY, Nerrethel grew interested in the structure known as the Dark Heart on the planet Voss, and spent two years studying the structure, comparing its architecture to that of the anci…

Doctor Metzar was a Mirialan male who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. Stationed aboard the Republic Valor-class cruiser Gav Daragon, he sold stimulants.
Lesk "Lightning" Alair was a Human male smuggler who served with the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. He resided on the planet Ilum, where he served as a trainer.

Roan Novachez, sometimes known as "Ro," was a male Human Jedi Knight born and raised on Tatooine. Rejected from Pilot Academy Middle School, his entire life changed when he learned he was strong in the Force and received an invitation to attend the Coruscant Jedi Academy, a Je…
Gan Corla was a Cathar Master armorer living in the Tython system around 25,793 BBY. He helped the Je'daii Ranger Lanoree Brock upgrade and customize the cannons on her ship.
Gharcanna was a male Wookiee warlord living on Ska Gora in the Tythan system some years before 25,793 BBY. He fought the Je'daii Ranger Lanoree Brock to the death and was killed by her.

Ducianne was a female Kalimahr militia member, who answered to Captain Lorus. In 25,793 BBY she was present when a Noghri assassin tried to kill the Je'daii Ranger Lanoree Brock. She was responsible for locating one of the terrorist's toe-claws, which was snagged in her uniform.
Luen was a female Mon Calamari scientist who was lured back to Dac after the Sith genocide by reports of a renewed Dac.
Tikin was a Quarren from Dac who lost his wife during the genocide perpetrated by the One Sith but survived the poisoning of his homeworld's oceans, along with his son, Tilin.
Dieben was a male Nalydian criminal who was wanted for various crimes on his homeworld of Nalyd. He was regarded by Ania Solo as unintelligent and lacking much imagination at lying.
Domm was a male Zabrak criminal living inside the Greenwood Station dome on Nox.
The Lord of Agony was a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire that allied himself to the Dread Masters during the Great Galactic War.

Ssevrek was a male Trandoshan imprisoned on Belsavis during the Cold War. Under his leadership, a gang of Trandoshan prisoners was able to capture and fortify a vault inside the prison's High Security Section.
Arribid Bensen was a male Human who served in the Imperial Army under Darth Marr as Under-Moff. The title Under-Moff was created especially for Bensen as the top military engineer and geologist.
Darth Betton was a female Sith Lord of the resurgent Sith Empire. Moff Tyrak named his JG-1 landspeeder "Betty" after her.

Gar Saxon was a Mandalorian human male who served as a commander of the Mandalorian super commandos in Maul's Shadow Collective during the Clone Wars and later as Imperial Viceroy and Governor of his homeworld of Mandalore during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Travis Chaz was a male from Elrood who worked as The Pit's main bartender for more than 30 years. Chaz was burly and a no-nonsense man, although he was also friendly highly intelligent.

Crix Griff was a con man who lived on Elrood. Griff was a Human of medium build, with thinning brown hair and a thoroughly nondescript appearance. He also used a great many number of disguises, and could alter his appearance with ease.
Im'Toral XV was the En'Tra, or "King-Master" of Coyn during the Galactic Civil War. As En'Tra, Im'Toral ruled over the 29 Ag'Tra, or noble families, and was married to Queen Em'Tora VIII.

Ahalas Svindren was a male scholar from Commenor who became a Major in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. A charismatic debater and legal expert with a notably compelling voice, Svindren became a prominent Republic propagandist.

Kob Mondray was a male Human from the world Ochotl who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. A promising shockball player, he abandoned the sport to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Separatist Crisis over the mistreatment of his homeworld.

Izhsmash was a male Nelvaanian data thief who was incarcerated in the Cog Hive Seven space station prison. Izhsmash was the second-in command to the Noghri Strabo, leader of the prison gang Gravity Massive.
"The Wolf" was the nickname of a Cathar male. He was killed on the planet Hoth around 3641 BBY at the hands of another individual.

Phean Tic'Karcta was a disgruntled (and possibly jealous) tradeswoman from Arkonne III who sabotaged an official vehicle carrying Divina Quri Adner, a woman to whom Wilek Nereus had proposed marriage. In response to the sabotage Nereus killed her and removed her teeth.

Kaspar was a Human male and the crown prince of Arrochar during the early Galactic Civil War.
Toobu was a large and powerful Hutt during the Cold War who acquired the Twi'lek Tivva as a slave.
Kyndern was a male Twi'lek lieutenant in the Republic Military during the Cold War.
Falkun was a female Human captain in the Republic Military during the Cold War.

Jillins was a Human male corporal of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic. In 3643 BBY, he was stationed on Balmorra under Lieutenant Malavai Quinn.
Kligton was a Human male general of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was stationed on Nar Shaddaa, commanding Empire's men under orders of Sith Lord Rathari.

Weggland was a male Human lieutenant of the Galactic Republic during the time of the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was stationed on Nar Shaddaa under commander Naughlen and was defending Republic Outpost Shylon from an Imperial attack led by General Kligton when the apprentice of D…
Naughlen was a male Human commander of the Galactic Republic during the time of the Cold War.

Izzeebowe Jeef was a male Human hermit living on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Considered a soothsayer, he knew the deserts well, and would often direct search parties or predict sandstorms.

Marcum was a Human male Count of the Alderaanian noble House of Thul living during the Cold War. He had a holoconversation with Duke Kendoh Thul and Count Ferrin, when their talk was interrupted by the apprentice of Darth Baras.

Ferrin was a Human male Count of the Alderaanian noble House of Thul living during the Cold War and a cousin of Duke Kendoh Thul. In 3643 BBY Ferrin and fellow Count Marcum had a holoconversation with Duke, in which Ferrin called his cousin an abomination.

This male Rodian was a soldier of the Galactic Republic living during the Cold War. In 3642 BBY, during the early stages of the Galactic War, he was stationed on Taris under a fellow Rodian General Minst.
The father of Nyranos was a Kaleesh male who destroyed an embassy of the Galactic Republic on the planet Kashyyyk sometime well before the Galactic War between the Republic and the Sith Empire.

Maer was a Human male doctor living on Coruscant during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire. Maer's ambulatory was in the Black Sun territory and he witnessed many atrocities while stationed there.

Olhak the Reaver was a Taung who served as a general during the war between the Taung and the Zhell. Some of the general's exploits were included in the Taung poem Dha Werda Verda, written to celebrate their victory over the Battalions of Zhell at the Battle of Great Zhell.
Osamael Or was a frontiersman before the rise of the Galactic Republic who explored the planet Tython, around 35,453 BBY.
Jay Igno was a male Nimbanel who worked as an air taxi driver on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars.

Ollien was a male Human Commander of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Anders was a Human male corporal who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Bail Antilles was a male human politician who served in the Galactic Senate as the senator for Alderaan during the tumultuous final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Sera Fray was a Human female scientist for the Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Breha Organa was a human female Alderaanian who served as queen of her homeworld of Alderaan during the final decades of the Galactic Republic and was one of the founding members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

High Flight Three was a T-65 X-wing starfighter pilot of the New Republic's High Flight Squadron. The pilot flew during the Battle of Selaggis, and was hit by debris in an asteroid field surrounding Selaggis VI when the strike force broke off its attack against Iron Fist.

Finis Valorum was a human male politician from House Valorum who served as the penultimate Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic. His chancellorship was hampered by corruption and bureaucracy in the Galactic Senate, which he was unable to bring under control.
Wilhuff Tarkin was an Eriaduan bureaucrat, military officer, and politician whose career spanned the waning years of the Galactic Republic into the Imperial Era.

Ainlee Teem was a Gran senator who represented the planet of Malastare in the Galactic Senate during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. When the Trade Federation invaded the planet Naboo, the then-Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum was voted out of his office.
The banker Trillan Katos had a Human female wife. With Trillan, she had two sons. When their planet was subjugated to the Clone Wars, Katos's wife shared her planet's anti-Republic stance.
Zia Woog worked in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's accounting department during the Galactic Civil War.
Jaard Reidan was a starfighter pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War, holding the rank of captain.
Mac Rytin was a starfighter pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War, holding the rank of lieutenant.

Tasandra was a female Sith who served the resurgent Sith Empire during the start of the Galactic War. Part of the Sith forces that attacked the Fortitude in 3642 BBY, she fell in battle with the Rift Alliance's bodyguards and the Barsen'thor, though only the Jedi survived the …
Kadon Vul was a male Sith Lord who served the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

A unidentified smuggler worked for the Black Sun on Coruscant during the Cold War. This smuggler was paid by his boss to transport the Noetikon of Light off world inside his body, but Doctor Maer discovered this smuggling ring.

Oklart was a male Human captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY, Oklart was part of Special Operations Group Five, sent to Belsavis on a mission to start a mass riot.

Trill was a female Human colonel of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY, Trill was part of Special Operations Group Five, sent to Belsavis on a mission to start a mass riot.

Kaid was a male Human lieutenant of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY Kaid was stationed on Belsavis and was leading a squad of Sith Lord Melicoste's commandos on a mission to extract Darth Ekkage from Belsavis prison.
Slinte was a male Human officer of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War.
Vana-Xo was a female Voss Mystic on Voss living during the Galactic War. Proficient in the art of healing, she tended to the injured at the Shrine of Healing.
Ono-Mi was a male Voss Commando living on Voss during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY he was assisting Commando Biddeck-Va at his base in the Gormak Lands.

A female Voss served as the attendant at the Shrine of Healing on Voss during the Galactic War. She welcomed the pilgrims that arrived at the Shrine of Healing. When the Barsen'thor and Gaden-Ko arrived at the Shrine, the attendant sent Gaden-Ko to the healers for medical aid.

Biddeck-Va was a male Voss Commando living on Voss during the Galactic War. He possessed the Pendant of Bone, the talisman that opened the doors to the Hall of the Unforgotten in the Dark Heart of the Nightmare Lands, though he was unaware of its importance.

"Mother" was the codename of a Duros female operative in the Rebel Alliance. Working out of Yavin Base, the Rebel's hidden fortress on the moon Yavin 4, she was responsible for recruiting her fellow Duros Vendri DeRalm as a scout for the Alliance around 0 ABY.
Lefry Kaonai was a male Nautolan excavator who was part of a Republic archaeological team led by Doctor Kerrian that ventured in the Deep Cradle on the planet Voss.
Pharen's sister was a female Twi'lek who worked at the Silent Sun cantina in the Black Sun territory on Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Vorlo Stragen was a male Human who worked for the Hutt Cartel on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Doctor Kerrian was a male Human that led a Republic archaeological team that ventured into the Deep Cradle on the planet Voss.
Dajan-Ko was a male Voss who lived during the Cold War. Dajan-Ko raised his grandson Gaden-Ko and noticed the young Gaden-Ko's uncanny intuition, that marked him as a potential Mystic visionary.
Asha-Mu was a female Voss who served as an assistant to Orin-Va, a healer at the Shrine of Healing on Voss at the time of the Galactic War.

Garrett was a male Human captain serving the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War.
