Ovech was a male Human major of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Ovech had served under Moff Broysc along with Lieutenant Malavai Quinn and had a high opinion of him, until Broysc arranged Quinn's reassignment to Balmorra.

Joy was a male spicelord living during the Galactic War. Joy and a fellow spicelord Love accompanied the information broker Krata during his exchange of information with the Twi'lek Vette.
Love was a male spice lord living during the Galactic War. Love and a fellow spicelord Joy accompanied the information broker Krata during his exchange of information with the Twi'lek Vette.

Crystal was a female Twi'lek who oversaw the dancer girls owned by Toobu the Hutt on Nar Shaddaa. During the Galactic War she was approached by a Sith and Vette, who was looking for her sister Tivva, and Crystal helpfully directed her to them.
An Alderaanian woman was the fiancée of the Limmie player Cael of House Hanarist. The fiancée, a charming woman, was a member of one of the Alderaan Noble Houses.

Welleques was a male Human who was one of the leaders of the insurgents against the corrupt Lord Crion on Telos IV. Welleques was not a righteous man and used dirty tactics such as killing Crion's daughter, Nason. Welleques was killed by Dairoki, Nason's lover.
Diida was a female Twi'lek living during the Cold War who was a mother to two daughters, Ce'na and Tivva. Born in slavery, the daughters were separated from their mother at a young age.
Feb'Noota was a male Twi'lek slave of Whuddle the Hutt living during the Cold War. When a fellow slave died from overworking, Feb'Noota took care of her body and arranged for its cremation.

Bobbajo was a male Nu-Cosian with a white beard who lived on Jakku approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor. He carried a group of animals around in cages, including frog-like gwerps, chicken-like pishnes, a lonlan, two zhhee and an ill-tempered worrt named J'Rrosch.

Vendri DeRalm was a Duros holographer who was subjugated by the Galactic Empire. He was recruited into the Rebel Alliance by "Mother" and shortly afterward participated in the Takeover at Whisper Base.
Luke Skywalker, a Force-sensitive human male, was a legendary Jedi Master who fought in the Galactic Civil War during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Rook Kast was a human female Mandalorian warrior who led the Shadow Collective's super commandos during the Clone Wars.
The Human female Zal Artha was a former Imperial pilot who graduated from the Rengali Imperial Naval Academy.
The sister of Troomis was killed following an altercation with Imperial Captain Creeve. Her brother, a member of Alliance Intelligence, vowed to get revenge on Creeve for her.

Boba Fett was a human male crime lord and former bounty hunter whose career spanned decades, from the fall of the Galactic Republic to the end of the rule of the Galactic Empire.
Anakin Skywalker was a legendary Force-sensitive human male who was a Jedi Knight of the Galactic Republic and the prophesied Chosen One of the Jedi Order, destined to bring balance to the Force.
Han Solo, known only as Han until being given the surname Solo, was a human male smuggler and hero of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Leia Skywalker Organa Solo was a Force-sensitive human Alderaanian female politician, Jedi, and military leader who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era and the New Republic and Resistance in the subsequent New Republic Era.
Teckla Minnau was a human female handmaiden to Senator Padmé Amidala during the Clone Wars.

Rex, designated CT-7567, was a veteran Clone Captain, Clone Commander, and Advanced Recon Commando who commanded the Grand Army of the Republic's famed 501st Legion of clone troopers during the Clone Wars.
Tendaar Bel was a Mon Calamari technician who worked under the Galactic Empire before he was freed by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Almec was a male human Mandalorian from the planet Mandalore, and a one-time believer in the pacifist ways of Duchess Satine Kryze.

x: Jhared Montferrat was a human male who served as an admiral in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire. Late in the Galactic Civil War, he commanded the Devastator, one of the most prestigious Imperial-class Star Destroyers in the Imperial fleet.
Darth Sidious, born Sheev Palpatine and also simply known as the Emperor, was a male human Dark Lord of the Sith and Emperor of the Galactic Empire, with his reign lasting from 19 BBY to 4 ABY.

Varnus Orlec was a male Human Moff of the Sith Empire who lived during the Galactic War. Stationed aboard the Harrower-class dreadnought Ziost Shadow, he learned from a captured pirate Shaedo about an upcoming Hutt bazaar on the planet Darvannis and recruited the Empire's best…

Jiak was a male Human Moff of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Stationed above the Harrower-class dreadnought Ziost Shadow, he recruited a strike team to travel to Zadd and put an end to the Directive 7.

Darth Bane was a legendary human male Dark Lord of the Sith and the sole survivor of the destruction of the Brotherhood of Darkness at the hands of the Jedi Order during the Jedi-Sith War a thousand years before the Clone Wars.

Feral was a male Dathomirian Zabrak member of the Nightbrothers, a group of warriors subservient to the Nightsister clan of witches native to the planet Dathomir. He was the younger brother of Savage Opress and Darth Maul, and a son of Nightsister leader, Mother Talzin.
Dengar, also known as Dengar the Demolisher, was a Corellian human bounty hunter operating since the early stages of the Clone Wars.

Savage Opress was the brother of Maul and Feral. A Force-sensitive Dathomirian Nightbrother, he became a Sith apprentice under Count Dooku and later became a renegade Sith Lord, apprenticed to Maul, during the Clone Wars.

Pre Vizsla was a human male Mandalorian warrior who, during the final years of the Galactic Republic Era, led the terrorist organization known as the Death Watch and briefly ruled as the Mand'alor before his death.
Talzin was a Dathomirian female who lived during the final decades of the Galactic Republic's reign and became a formidable figure of power during the Clone Wars.
Maash was a male Human who took part in the assassination attempt on the person of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine in 23 BBY.
Vela was a male Human who took part in the assassination attempt on the person of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine in 23 BBY.
This unidentified Human was an assassin who took part in the assassination attempt on the person of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine in 23 BBY.

Nute Gunray, a Neimoidian male, was a business executive and politician who served the Trade Federation conglomerate, first as its senator in the Galactic Republic Senate and later as its Viceroy, during the final decades of the Republic Era up until his assassination.
Qui-Gon Jinn, a Force-sensitive human male, was a venerable if maverick Jedi Master who lived during the last years of the Republic Era.
Padmé Amidala Naberrie, also simply known as Padmé Amidala, was a human female politician who represented the people of Naboo during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Chewbacca, known affectionately to his friends as Chewie, was a Wookiee male warrior, smuggler, mechanic, pilot, and resistance fighter who fought in the Clone Wars, the Galactic Civil War, the Cold War, and the subsequent First Order-Resistance War.

Poliss was a male Ithorian shopkeeper on board the Herdship Bazaar specializing in droid sales and repair. Poliss was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and often recruited new members with the help of the craftsman, Jerru.

Yoda was a legendary Jedi Grand Master who led the Jedi Order through the time of the High Republic, in the years leading up to its destruction by the Sith, and during the transformation of the Galactic Republic into the Galactic Empire.
Dooku was a Force-sensitive human male Serennian who served as a Jedi Master during the waning years of the Galactic Republic and later Count of House Serenno.
Branno was a Human male Captain of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Bickell was a male Zabrak Lieutenant of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Tarsten was a male Human Sergeant of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War.

Grenthean was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. At the time of the Battle for Kuat he was present aboard Vaiken Spacedock, from where he contacted Admiral Zasha Ranken over the holoterminal.
Darth Krovos was a female Pureblood Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War.

Mericci was a male Human Battalion Commander of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY he participated in the Battle of Corellia, but was pulled out along with the rest of Imperial forces following the Darth Malgus's coup.

Taia was a female Human private serving in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. She participated in the Battle of Corellia as part of Battalion Commander Mericci's detachment.

Gostel was a male Human Captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY he was stationed at the Vaiken Spacedock, administering alien criminals recruited by the Empire on Belsavis prison prior to the Dread Host takeover of Section X.
Sio Bibble was a human male philosopher, the governor of Naboo and a member of the Royal Advisory Council during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Landonis Balthazar Calrissian, otherwise known as Lando Calrissian, was a human smuggler, gambler, and entrepreneur who became Baron Administrator of Cloud City and, later, a general in the Rebel Alliance.
Mace Windu was a revered Force-sensitive human male Jedi Master and member of the Jedi High Council during the last years of the Republic Era.

Tyvar was a male Human agent of the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire, codenamed Lurker. Retired by the time of the Galactic War, he settled on Makeb and lives there with his family: his wife Chiana, son Peron and daughter Syla.

Chiana was a female Human wife of Tyvar, an agent of the intelligence agency of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Retired by the time of the Galactic War, Tyvar and Chiana settled on Makeb and lived there with their son Peron and daughter Syla.

Harlal was a male Chagrian Vice-Commandant of the InterStellar Regulators during the Galactic War. He was among those who were bought off by the Hutt Cartel prior to the Conquest of Makeb.
Tergos was a male Human Vice-Commandant of the InterStellar Regulators during the Galactic War. He was among those who were bought off by the Hutt Cartel prior to the Conquest of Makeb.
Edrii was a female Human Vice-Commandant of the InterStellar Regulators during the Galactic War. She was among those who were bought off by the Hutt Cartel prior to the Conquest of Makeb.

Vorjok was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto enforcer for the Hutt Cartel during the Galactic War. After the Conquest of Makeb in 3638 BBY, Vorjok was posted to guard the Hutt's stockpile of Isotope-5 in the Stronghold One on Makeb's volcanic mesa.
Kai Teyun was a male Human resident of Makeb and one of the few able to operate the Argent Sky Lancers orbital satellites.
Mena was a female Human resident of Makeb and one of the few able to operate the Argent Sky Lancers orbital satellites.

Jar Jar Binks was a male Otolla Gungan military commander and politician who played a key role during the Invasion of Naboo and the Clone Wars that culminated in the fall of the Galactic Republic and the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Bossk'wassak'Cradossk, known more commonly as Bossk, was a male Trandoshan bounty hunter and the son of Cradossk who was known for hunting Wookiees. During the Clone Wars, Bossk worked alongside fellow hunters Aurra Sing and Castas to mentor the orphaned Boba Fett.

An Imperial commando engineer was part of a commando squad of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War on Hoth.

An Imperial lieutenant commanded a squad of Imperial soldiers during the Galactic War on Hoth. He guided an Imperial boarding party tasked with attacked a crashed dreadnaught, home of the White Maw, in an attempt to eliminate the pirate captain Valon, but met the Barsen'thor.
Blanca Nikols was a Human female who was married to Captain Arrin Nikols, a member of the InterStellar Regulators. She had a son named Ritte Nikols. They resided on Makeb during the Galactic War.
Asajj Ventress was a Dathomirian Nightsister who lived through the fall of the Galactic Republic, becoming an accomplished warrior in the Clone Wars.

Adon Fox was a male starfighter pilot who served in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He fought in the Battle of Hoth, and was the Wing Commander of Blade Squadron in the Battle of Endor.
Ki-Adi-Mundi was a Force-sensitive Cerean male and a Jedi who was active during the High Republic. He was a member of the Jedi High Council during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.

Barthow Quince was a black-eyed individual whom Gina Moonsong, a cadet in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, called her mentor. When Moonsong served in the Blade Squadron, her superior Adon Fox reminded her of Quince.
Braylen Stramm was a male human who defected from the Galactic Empire to serve the Rebel Alliance as a starfighter pilot.

Gina Moonsong was a human female who was a smuggler on Coruscant and later served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War as a pilot. She was a member of Blade Squadron and was in a secret relationship with Lieutenant Braylen Stramm.

Darth Plagueis was a Muun Dark Lord of the Sith who secretly trained "the Stranger" and Darth Sidious in the ways of the Sith as his apprentices. Plagueis lusted for immortality, believing the secret lay in science.
Ahsoka Tano was a female Togruta who was a Force-sensitive outcast from the Jedi Order. After the Clone Wars, she helped establish a network of various rebel cells against the Galactic Empire.
Darth Zannah was a Dark Lord of the Sith and the Sith apprentice of Darth Bane. Zannah was trained to carry Bane's teachings and the Rule of Two forward after a war between the Sith and Jedi Orders.
Plo Koon was a Force-sensitive Kel Dor Jedi Master who served as a noble member of the Jedi High Council during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Kit Fisto was a Force-sensitive Nautolan male Jedi Master during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Fisto was known as an expert swordsman, possessing some of the finest dueling skills in the Jedi Order.
Yaddle was a Force-sensitive female being of the same species as Grand Master Yoda and Din Grogu. She was a Jedi Master and was in charge of Jedi Initiates during the High Republic Era.

Trench was a Harch admiral and naval commander who survived a number of presumed deaths throughout his career. Hailing from Secundus Ando, he acquitted himself in engagements with the Galactic Republic, all the while savoring the terror he struck in his enemies.
Cael Hanarist was an Alderaanian from House Hanarist. He served on Team Alderaan, the Limmie group and was one of the fastest players in the galaxy. He had a fiancee from another House.

Wedge Antilles, known as TIE SS-2-5 during his time at Skystrike Academy, was a renowned human male starfighter pilot from Corellia who first served in the Imperial Navy as a TIE fighter pilot until defecting to join the rebellion.
Axtor Bridgeman was an aging tramp freighter captain operating in the Minos Cluster some time during the Galactic Civil War.
Dhar Bullwin was a dark side magician who searched for the Eye of Koda.

Dud Bolt was a Vulptereen male from the planet Vulpter who worked as a podracer pilot and hitman. He flew a Vulptereen 327 and served as a mid-air bodyguard for the Dug podracer Sebulba. In 32 BBY, he participated in the Boonta Eve Classic race on the planet Tatooine.
Lasre Dardano was an Imperial Moff, who, in 0 BBY, led an attack on Onderon. His political rival was Admiral Corlen.

Quinlan Vos was a Kiffar male Jedi Master who lived during the final days of the Galactic Republic. Hailing from the planet Kiffu, he was a maverick within the Jedi Order and garnered a reputation for bending the rules.
The wife of Adon Fox was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic prior to the Battle of Hoth. She and her husband were stationed at Echo Base when it came under attack from Imperial forces.

Gasgano was a Xexto male podracer pilot who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on the desert planet Tatooine during the Invasion of Naboo. Gasgano wanted nothing more than to win the race, piloting his green Ord Pedrovia podracer.

Skifter, further identified as CT-1155, was a clone trooper gunship pilot who fought in the First Battle of Geonosis during the Clone Wars. During the battle, he was responsible for transporting multiple platoons of clone troopers to the battlefield.
Ronto was a clone trooper copilot who fought in the First Battle of Geonosis during the Clone Wars. During his time on Geonosis, Ronto flew in a LAAT/i with Skifter.

Jango Fett was a famed Mandalorian human male bounty hunter and the clone template of the Grand Army of the Republic. Known as the best bounty hunter in the galaxy during the final years of the Galactic Republic, Fett was proficient in marksmanship as well as unarmed combat.

Greedo was a male Rodian bounty hunter and mercenary who grew up on Tatooine in Mos Espa. During the Clone Wars, he was hired by the Trade Federation to kidnap Chi Eekway Papanoida and Che Amanwe Papanoida, the daughters of Chairman Papanoida, but was forced by the chairman to…
Sebulba was a male Dug who hailed from the planet of Malastare. Originally a slave, he bought his freedom after winning several podraces.
Jocasta Nu, a Force-sensitive human female, was a Master of the Jedi Order who served as the Chief Librarian of the Jedi Archives during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Sabé , formerly known as Tsabin, was a human female who hailed from the planet Naboo during the late era of the Galactic Republic.
Carlist Rieekan was a human male from Alderaan. He was a military officer who served as a General in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the military leader of the Rebellion's base on Hoth.

Grievous, born Qymaen jai Sheelal, was a Kaleesh male warlord who served within the military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems as a commanding officer during the Clone Wars in the final years of the Republic Era.
Fanty was a male individual who served as a B-wing starfighter pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was part of the Blade Squadron, under the leadership of Wing Commander Adon Fox.

Sha'Dria was a Human female bartender who worked for Yin Vocta at his nightclub, the Bantha Traxx, on Lianna. She always hid her face behind a mask that she called N'Noch, and would refer to everyone else as being one of "The Unmasked."
Divv was a male criminal who had acquired information on Jabba the Hutt's spy network located on Lianna. He arranged to sell the information to one of Jabba's rivals, an Anomid named Yin Vocta.
Lune Banjeer was a male Admiral who served with distinction during the Ruusan campaign between the Galactic Republic and the Brotherhood of Darkness, which lasted from 1002 BBY to 1000 BBY.

Gantel Dro was a male Defel thief who was captured by Marus Grayson, an Imperial bureaucrat, when the criminal tried to steal the Jewel of Yavin from him. Instead of killing Dro, Grayson offered Dro the chance to live if he agreed to oversee the Jewel's security.
Marus Grayson was a male Human who worked as an Imperial bureaucrat. He owned the Jewel of Yavin, a corusca gem which he hoped to auction.

A male Wookiee was killed in a duel by the father of Attichitcuk, who later emerged as a powerful Wookiee Chieftain. The death of that Wookiee caused a lasting enmity between his clan and that of Attichitcuk.

Irlyn Resk was a Human male who served the Galactic Empire. He was the first lieutenant to lead the Dark Riders, a group of swoop mounted storm commandos that operated on the planet Stend VI to combat swoop gangs.

Teemen Alton was a male Imperial Knight who was killed during the Second Imperial Civil War. Ania Solo was framed for his murder, but in truth the killer was a masked bounty hunter who impersonated the young Solo.
A masked bounty hunter was a female Human and former prison guard from Drash-So who became a bounty hunter in the aftermath of the Second Imperial Civil War.

Pasha was a Human Padawan who went to Jedi Academy. His home world was Obroa-Skai. His father worked at the Obroan Institute for Archaeology. Pasha was a skilled lightsaber duelist. He had a girlfriend at Jedi Academy called Shi-Fara.
Satine Kryze, a human female Mandalorian, was the Duchess of Kalevala and the pacifistic ruler of the New Mandalorians and the planet Mandalore during the final decades of the Galactic Republic Era.

Tiplee was a red-skinned Mikkian female Jedi Master who, along with her twin sister, Tiplar, served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Tiplar was a yellow-skinned Mikkian female Jedi Master who served as a Jedi General within the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. As part of her military service, Tiplar and her twin sister Tiplee led a unit of clone troopers along with Clone Commander Doom.
Sifo-Dyas was a human male Jedi Master from Minashee who commissioned the Kaminoans' creation of the Grand Army of the Republic over a decade before the Clone Wars.

Embo was a Kyuzo male bounty hunter who lived during the era of the Clone Wars. Embo carried a bowcaster and wore a large-rimmed circular hat, which he used as a weapon or a shield. Even as a capable solo hunter, he worked with several different groups throughout the Clone Wars.

Cad Bane, formerly known as Colby, was a Duros male bounty hunter and mercenary in the galaxy whose career spanned from the fall of the Galactic Republic, the reign of the Galactic Empire and into the era of the New Republic.
Bly, designated CC-5052, was an Advanced Recon Commando and clone trooper officer of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, operating as Marshal Commander of the 327th Star Corps.
Gree, named after the species of the same name and designated CC-1004, was a Clone Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the galactic conflict known as the Clone Wars.

Lee-Char was a male Mon Calamari who served as the leader of Mon Cala during the Clone Wars. He was set to take the throne from his father, King Yos Kolina, but his father's assassination led to a civil war on the planet.

Jamillia was a human female who served as the Monarch of Naboo as the successor of Queen Réillata during the final years of the Galactic Republic. She originally ran for the office as Queen Padmé Amidala's term ended in 28 BBY, but lost to Réillata.
Mari Amithest was a Force-sensitive human female and a member of the Jedi Order as a child during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Hermione "Harmony" Bagwa was a female human who worked as a waitress alongside Wanda and FLO at Dex's Diner, an eatery owned by Dexter Jettster and located on the streets of CoCo Town, Coruscant. She grew up within Coruscant's underworld.

Ratts Tyerell was an Aleena podracer pilot who flew a massive podracer during the Boonta Eve Classic podrace which took place during the Invasion of Naboo. Tyerell had a drive to beat the reigning champion, the Dug, Sebulba.
Meelee was a young girl who was in attendance at the Festival of Four Honorings at Marblewood Estate on the planet Wukkar around 0 BBY during the Marblewood Estate heist.

Bakash was a male Human who served as a colonel in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. In 3643 BBY, Bakash and the men he commanded were stationed on the Sith world of Korriban where they were sent to the Lower Wilds region.
Berardesco was a male Humanoid Mandalorian warrior who served the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War against the Galactic Republic.

Bro'orvta was a male Twi'lek who served as a Captain in the Galactic Republic's Army during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the war the captain was stationed on the planet Tatooine in the city of Anchorhead, where he trained other troopers.
Djal was a male Mirialan who worked as a smuggler and held the title of captain during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Labe was a male Human captain in the Eighty-third Platoon of the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on the planet Balmorra.
Laverse was a male Human captain in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. During the war he was stationed on the planet Balmorra.
Lorvon was a male Human captain in the Galactic Republic's Republic Army during the Cold War against the Sith Empire. During the war he was stationed on Carrick Station where he sold equipment.
Qonbla was a male Human captain in the Galactic Republic's Republic Army during the Cold War against the Sith Empire. During the war he was stationed on Carrick Station where he sold equipment.
Varmett was a male Human Captain in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. During the war he was stationed on the planet Balmorra.

Tracer was a Human male captain in the Republic Military of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War and Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the wars Tracer was stationed on Carrick Station where he sold equipment.
Chedd was a male Twi'lek who lived on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Ch'hedt was a male Jawa who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the war the Jawa worked in the Dune Sea and sold various goods that could be used by a number of crafting professions.

Rarkgah was a male Weequay who lived on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the war he held the rank of Security Chief for the Red Light Sector where the Bleeder gang were active.

Proshen was a male Human who served as a colonel in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. During the war Proshen was stationed on the planet Balmorra.
Siturn was a male Human who served as a colonel in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic.
Teeg was a Male Human who served as a colonel in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. During the war he was stationed on the planet Balmorra.
Hunn was a male Human who served as a commander in the Republic Army of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the Sith Empire.
Rak was a male Human who served as a commander in the military forces of the Aldreraanian Great House of Rist during the Alderaan Civil War.

Danbar Hue was a male Human moisture farmer who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He owned a moisture farm in the Jundland area of Tatooine.

Dorcha was a male Duros who worked on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He worked as a merchant in the Jundland area of Tatooine, selling stimulants.

Sarthon Quis was a bodyguard who was among the refugees stranded on the planet Makeb after their transport crashed there during the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian warrior culture.
Kaylah Taprish was a scientist who lived on the planet Makeb more than a hundred years after the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian warrior culture.
The favorite uncle of the scientist Kaylah Taprish was a male who lived on the planet Makeb. The distinctive head crest and pattern of the native vrake supposedly reminded Taprish of her uncle.

Matteus Zaym was a Human male prince of the Tion Hegemony who lived centuries after the collapse of the warlord Xim the Despot's empire. During a period of political turmoil in the Tion Cluster, the Tionese prince fled to the planet Kaon there to avoid assassination.

The Mad Clone of Kaikielius, as he was dubbed by HoloNet commentators, was an aberrant clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic. Like all clone troopers, he was cloned from the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett on the planet of Kamino.

The so-called Lost Prophet was originally a clone trooper who served in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army. Toward the end of the Clone Wars, that trooper crash-landed on the desert planet of Du Mai while piloting an ARC-170 starfighter.
Walinor was the president of a Galactic Republic-allied planet on the border of the Republic during the Galactic War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Milarzen was a male Human and the Prime Minister of an unknown planet that had a Galactic Republic membership.

Havox was a male Human who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the reconsituted Sith Empire. During the war, they worked on the planet Quesh selling various weapons from a stall in the Republic Operational Headquarters.
Zavery was a male Gamorrean who worked for the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire.
Rotta, also referred to as Rotta the Hutt, and nicknamed "Pedunkee Mufkin" (translated as Punky Muffin) by his father and "Stinky" by Ahsoka Tano, was a male Hutt and the son of Jabba the Hutt.
Crix Exohusker was a member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Fife was a Pyke male who served as the majordomo of Marg Krim and was a member of the Pyke Syndicate and Shadow Collective during the Clone Wars.

Ziton Moj was a male Falleen who worked as a Vigo for the Black Sun during the Clone Wars. He served as Captain of the Guard, however later, the Black Sun became a member of Maul Shadow Collective after Savage Opress, Maul's brother, killed the leaders of Black Sun for refusin…
Zir-Daggoth was a pink-skinned, male Gran with black eyes who worked as a merchant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Bonne was a male Human who served as a private in the Republic Army during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Maneros was a bald male Abyssin who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire. During the war, they worked selling stimulants on the planet Quesh from a stall in the Republic Operational Headquarters.

Yezo was a male Zabrak who served the Galactic Republic as an officer during the Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the war he was stationed in Outpost Zerek on the frozen world of Hoth where he sold stimulants to others from a stall.
Rabé Tonsort, also known simply as Rabé, and born as Rabene Tonsort, was a female human who served as one of Queen Amidala's handmaidens during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Saché, born Sashah Adova, was a female human who served as one of the handmaidens of Amidala, Queen of Naboo.

Eirtaé, born Eirtama Ballory, was a female human scientist, engineer, and artist. After the election of Queen Padmé Amidala, Eirtama was recruited by Captain Quarsh Panaka to serve in the queen's retinue of handmaidens, renaming herself as Eirtaé.
A Human served as an officer under Imperial Governor Corwyth on the planet Metalorn during the Galactic Civil War.
Gjonfs, also known as Sawbone Gjonfs was a Advosze warrior who served the Advozse Hegemony during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Vorgan, also known as Vorgan the Volcano was a male Advozse warrior who served the Advozse Hegemony during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The Shot Caller was the nickname used by a male Kitonak who commanded the Gauntlet gang on the moon of Nar Shaddaa. The criminal was killed when a Republic aligned individual attacked the gang in around 3643 BBY.

Farnis was a Human male who served as a captain in the army of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire.

Onto was a male Zabrak who served as a sergeant in the army of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3640 BBY, he was stationed on the planet Ilum while a battle took place there.
Tetsu was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War
Barstead was a male Human Captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY, he was stationed on the Imperial waystation of the planet Ilum.

A Sullustan infant was born sometime during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. Sensitive to the Force, the child was acquired by the Jedi Order and was brought to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, the Republic's capital planet. There, the child began his training as a Jedi.
Kirter was a male Human who served the reconstituted Sith Empire. Stationed on Nar Shaddaa, he trained Imperial Intelligence agents.

Silman was a male human who served as a personal aide to Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum during his time in office. Prior to the Separatist Crisis, Silman accompanied Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas on a mission to Oba Diah.
Veeboo Lunx was a male Rodian bounty hunter who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Conners was a crewmember of the Alliance to Restore the Republic transport Celestial. Conners survived the starship's passage to otherspace, but was dragged off by shadows aboard the Desolate.

Cauley was a human who served as an Imperial Navy ensign aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Ultimatum during the Gorse Conflict in 11 BBY, in which the Imperial cyborg Count Denetrius Vidian attempted to improve thorilide mining efficiency on the planet Gorse and its moon, Cynda.
Nibiru Chamas was a male individual who served as a commander in the Galactic Empire's Navy while he was in his forties.
Oked was a male bounty hunter. During the Clone Wars, he joined up with a syndicate of other bounty hunters in order to complete a job on the planet Quarzite.
Sevik was a male admiral in the Imperial Navy of the Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.
Shaak Ti was a Force-sensitive Togruta female Jedi Master who served as one of the final members of the Jedi High Council before the Great Jedi Purge.
Zalin Lih was a male who was considered the greatest adversary of Gester Noxx, a crime lord active centuries before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Janthir was a male Moff of the Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic who conquered a number of primitive planets in the Outer Rim Territories.

Aila Helano was a corporate researcher who possessed a formula for a new stimulant, a "wonder stim," by 3638 BBY, during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. She sought to sell her formula directly to one of the two galactic powers.
Ajoha Jeh was a female biologist who worked on developing special implants that would enable better exploration of toxic worlds during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Aphiram Clay was a male Senator of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Balionn-Gur was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. Balionn-Gur conquered a planet and, out of a desire to rule through law and order rather than fear, hired diplomats to reassure the populace of his intentions, allowing him to e…
Ban Wan Pollo was a male smuggler with Republic sympathies who was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Republic.
Welex Korofu was an ace Duros pilot who trained in the canyons of the planet Endex. Korofu's crashed starship was later recovered by archaeologists from where it lay in the canyons.

Ronda was a male eccentric bioanalyst known for his brilliance. During the Cold War, he was aboard a shuttle that crashed on the planet Corsin; Ronda was killed in the crash, but fellow scientists recovered specimens from his latest research at the crash site.
Ooroz was a Hutt who lived during the Cold War, and was known for only eating animals and plants that were specially engineered by his scientists in his tasting laboratories.

Fylan was a doctor who was working on developing new medpacs before he died of old age during the Cold War. A corporate espionage report led to further investigation of Fylan's work, and a new formula was created from his notes.
Menoda was a doctor who was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Boles Roor was a Sneevel podracer pilot from Sneeve who had won two Boonta Eve Classic podraces, which had taken place on the planet Tatooine. Roor later participated in another Boonta which took place during the year 32 BBY.

Joseph was a Bardottan member of the Bahk-tov Council during the Clone Wars. During this time Joseph was captured by the Frangawl Cult and imprisoned in a metal cage many meters above a large pit of lava.
Dexter "Dex" Jettster, nicknamed Dexi Jet, was a male Besalisk prospector and diner owner with a colorful background.
Piddock was the Geonosian duke of Gogum Hive. He traded with the Gand bounty hunter Vrixx'tt during the Galactic Civil War.

Dimmock was the Geonosian duke of Trellik Hive and the chief rival of Duke Piddock during the Galactic Civil War. At one point, Dimmock discovered that his rival was involved in a deal with Teemo the Hutt.

Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo was the accountant of the Grand Hutt Council during the Clone Wars. Gorga was the cousin of Rotta, nephew of Jabba, grand-nephew of Ziro and Ebor, grandson of Jabba's father, and the great-grandson of Mama and Papa.

Ody Mandrell was a male Er'Kit who hailed from the planet of Tatooine, home to the famed Boonta Eve Classic podrace. Mandrell eventually joined the sport of podracing, and acquired a team of pit droids that would go on to set podracing records while in his possession.

Erisson Flask was a male member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He fought Imperial stormtroopers on Kwenn Space Station, and flew the starship Silver Bolt with his co-pilot, Polke.
Ewyrin was a female alien student of the Force. She was once tempted by the dark side of the Force on the planet Dantooine, and later successfully entered and exited a state of Emptiness.
Beyorth Gommdora was a male sentientologist with the University of Huvveck. He conducted research on the planet Joralla, including on the extinct Wasilsi species.

Adriav Kavos was a male Human freighter captain. His freighter was the Isilia. He once came into possession of a data disk containing information on the Alliance to Restore the Republic. While preparing to sell it, he landed on Joralla, next to a Wasilsi temple.
Polke was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the co-pilot of Erisson Flask's starship, the Silver Bolt.

Angrigo was a male Duros assassin who was hired by Lieutenant Jenkes of the Galactic Empire's Security Bureau along with the Kratchell twins to kill the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk. However, he was instead killed by his target in Ake's Tavern on Lothal during a brief shootout.

Ferpil Wallaway was a male Xexto pawnshop owner and pickpocket who operated on the planet Lothal. He was the mentor of Ezra Bridger, a young thief and street urchin. He was selling tickets for "Gladiator Night," an illegal event hosted by "The Commissioner".

Borbig Drob was a male Houk who worked as a gladiator during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign and was declared champion of the contest known as the Stormblade Bloodfest on nine occasions.
A Human male captain of a medical supply ship ferried cargo to the Farpoint Medical Center in 41 ABY. He was an overly obese man, with his belly hanging over the belt of his trousers.

t: Unidentified medical supply ship first mate
x: A Human male served as a first mate of a medical supply ship ferrying cargo to the Farpoint Medical Center in 41 ABY.

Fives was an Advanced Recon Commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Due to his clone designation, CT-5555, short for CT-27-5555, he referred to himself as Fives.

A Sith cultist was a member of the Disciples of Ragnos group. He was among the forces sent to Hoth and he cracked into the Rebel Alliance's records, discovering that Luke Skywalker had gone to Dagobah after the Battle of Hoth.

Varko was a male Selkath who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He spent several years learning galactic basic, and eventually became a immigration officer. During his job Darth Arkous was accepted past immigration.

A Sienar Fleet Systems executive was the highest ranking officer at the company's immense facility on Byblos, responsible for all operations and TIE/ln space superiority starfighter production in the sector where the Colonies and The Slice intersected.
Warjak was a male Feeorin who worked as a gladiator during the initial years of the Galactic Empire's reign and was declared champion of the contest known as the Outer Rim Carve-up on many occasions.

Hack Fenlon was a male senator of the Imperial Senate during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. After Gronson Takkaro, a Dug who owed Fenlon a large sum of money, escaped Imperial arrest in three star systems, Fenlon placed a bounty on his head.

Herdringer was a male lieutenant of the Imperial Security Bureau during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. Stationed on the planet Lothal, he was killed by his fellow lieutenant, Jenkes, who had him pushed in front of a speeder bus.

Mundokk was a male Trandoshan bounty hunter from the moon of Wasskah who worked during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. He held an Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate, but at some point it came into the possession of Bossk, another Trandoshan bounty hunter.

Izzar was a Jawa who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Izzar and two other Jawas, Hadiir and Mnek, worked as scrap merchants during the conflict, traveling the galaxy and offering a wide variety of valuable items.

Hadiir was a male Jawa who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Hadiir and two other Jawas, Izzar and Mnek, worked as scrap merchants during the conflict, traveling the galaxy and offering a wide variety of valuable items.

Mnek was a male Jawa who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Mnek and two other Jawas, Hadiir and Izzar, worked as scrap merchants during the conflict, traveling the galaxy and offering a wide variety of valuable items.

Rohu Silgo was a male Selkath who worked on the Galactic Republic space station Carrick Station while it was a part of the Republic fleet during the Great Galactic War between the Republic and the Sith Empire.
Grada Zusi was a male Duros who worked supplying bounty hunters as a merchant of the Bounty Supply Company during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Trok was a female Sith pureblood Sith Lord during the Cold War and Galactic War. She overthrew a crime syndicate on Nar Shaddaa and started moving its members to Dromund Kaas.

Alton Kastle was a human male journalist who worked as a broadcaster on HoloNet News on the planet Lothal during the Imperial Era. As a broadcast journalist, he helped spread propaganda for the Galactic Empire, including propaganda about Wookiees and local unemployment rates.
Couli was an ensign in the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. During the war, she sold modifications for people on Hoth at Vaiken Spacedock.
Dandamont Pring was a Human male who served as Imperial consul-general on the Bothan homeworld of Bothawui during the Galactic Civil War.

A stormtrooper with the designation TK-626 served the Galactic Empire on Lothal several years prior to the Battle of Yavin. TK-626 was a hardened school-bully who was specifically recruited by the Empire due to his aggressive tendencies.
Depa Billaba, a Force-sensitive human female native of the planet Chalacta, was a Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council during the final years of the Jedi Order.

In the years prior to the Battle of Yavin, this Stormtrooper Commander was stationed at an Imperial facility of landed TIE fighters on the planet Lothal. During one of his patrols, he encountered the Mandalorian explosive artist and rebel from the Ghost crew Sabine Wren.
Volq was a male member of Rolo's Ruffians on the prison moon Captivity.
Ajolin was a male Human who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He advertised strongholds by hologram at Vaiken Spacedock and Dromund Kaas.
Pargon Sisto was a male Human who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War.
Kastoni was a male Human who served in the security force of the planet Wukkar. He protected the sector chief of the Black Sun, Avrak Villachor, as a security guard.

Frewin Bromley was a male Human who served as a security guard for the sector chief of Black Sun, Avrak Villachor, on the planet Wukkar. He was offered a bribe by a group of bounty hunters, but due to his loyalty to Black Sun, he refused it and reported it to Villachor.

Manning was a male Human who served in the security force of the planet Wukkar. In collaboration with his companion Tawb, he protected the sector chief of the Black Sun, Avrak Villachor, as a his personal security guard.

Tawb was a male Human who served in the security force of the planet Wukkar. In collaboration with his companion Manning, he protected the sector chief of the Black Sun, Avrak Villachor, as a his personal security guard.

Marvon was a Twi'lek male xenospecialist who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. During the war he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock, a space station within the Imperial fleet.
Tress Aressa was an illegal cyborg living on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War. She owned several other illegal cyborgs and vessels.
Odea Aurora was a female Human merchant who lived in Cloud City's Port Town.

Alroy Kever was a Human who commanded the King's Own Guard, an elite paramilitary unit of the Lazerian army. They were assigned by King Alarik X to watch over the Empeth Crystals during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Alzar Golan was a male Human pilot who flew corusca skiffs in the Yavin system.

Mistress Miaxi, a Falleen female, was a former slave who became consort to the Imperial governor of Speco. Miaxi was said to have ran the system by using her Falleen charms on the enthralled governor.

During the Galactic Civil War, an Imperial governor ruled over the planet Speco. However, it was said that the governor's consort, the former Falleen slave Mistress Miaxi, actually ran the system by using her charms on the enthralled governor.
Iola Linst was a female Human who was Chief Executive Officer of Damarind Fishing Station in the Yavin system.

Tresk was a slicer and vessel who worked for Wonn Ionstrike's Lenushaa gang. He stole information from an Alliance to Restore the Republic cell on Gerrenthum and tried to pass it onto Captain Velantia of the Imperial Security Bureau.
Khom Grelt was a Twi'lek male who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He made his living as a decorations engineer on board Carrick Station.

Estah Kloy was a female Human who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She made her living as a personnel agent on board Carrick Station and Vaiken Spacedock.

Nelva Stato was a female Human who lived during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. A merchant like her relatives Meridat, Felusia, and Clem, Nelva Stato sold furniture and decorations on the space station Carrick Station with Nelva.
Clem Stato was a male Human who lived during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Yolten was a Human male officer of the Galactic Republic's military who served aboard the space station Carrick Station. He worked as a flagship commissioner during the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Nitch was a female Cathar captain who served the Republic Navy aboard the space station Carrick Station, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Landez was a male who served in the Republic Military during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Stationed aboard the space station Carrick Station, Landez held the rank of general.

Teekwo was a male Rodian who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He made his living as a merchant for the Contraband Resale Corporation on board Carrick Station.
Maia Vefri was a female Human who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. She made her living as a merchant for Binary Star Realty aboard Carrick Station.

Zannlyn was a female Cathar who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She worked as a merchant for the Interplanetary Component Exchange aboard Carrick Station.

Caibbest Obarel was a male Human who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He made his living as a merchant for Interplanetary Component Exchange on board Carrick Station.
Bakmar was a male Selkath who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He sold his wares in the Republic Concourse of the Mercantile Plaza.

Fanoste was a Twi'lek male Sith Lord of the One Sith that posed as a diplomat. He commanded a One Sith army that was tasked with the mission of killing the rebellious Darth Wredd on Mala. During the ensuing battle, Wredd killed the Twi'lek.

Sairisi was a male Selkath who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He was the security chief of a secret facility installed by the Order of Revan on Manaan.
Voorpee was a male voorpak on loan from the Naboo Zoo to the Coruscant Jedi Academy on the planet Coruscant circa 195 BBY.
Valen Rudor, operating number: "LS-607," was a male human TIE fighter pilot from Corulag in service to the Galactic Empire on Lothal five years prior to the Battle of Yavin as a Baron of the Empire.
Yogar Lyste, with the operating number LSM-03, was an officer of the Galactic Empire with the rank of lieutenant during the Imperial Era.

Tsoklo was a Rodian male who resided on the planet Lothal several years prior to the Galactic Civil War. Tsoklo served as factory worker, but also worked for the Galactic Empire as an informant who reported to Supply Master Yogar Lyste.
Maketh Tua was a human female that hailed from the planet Lothal, and was a graduate of the Imperial Academy.
Sodoh Reddik was an admiral in the Republic Navy who won many battles during the Great Hyperspace War. He established the Republic Hyperspace Armada.
Jevin Kent was a male Human who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He worked in the Shining Star cantina on Alderaan.
Leria was a female Human who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She worked in the Shining Star cantina on Alderaan.
Jorek was a male Human who sold stimulants and medpacs at Wardpost Duvaal in the Alsakan Lowlands on Alderaan.
Elkin was a Human male marine commander who served House Organa during the Cold War. He was stationed in Wardpost Luurdes.
Nadai Pawaro was a female Mirialan Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.

J'oorj was a male quartermaster for the Galactic Republic who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was stationed in the Strike Team Oricon camp were he sold gear.

Maa Tin was a male quartermaster for the Galactic Republic who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He was stationed in the Strike Team Oricon camp were he sold gear.

Malinna was a female Human who worked as a gear vendor during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. During the war, she operated a stall in the Alien Enclave Market of the city Voss-Ka on the planet Voss.
Usuthas was a male Selkath who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He worked as a gear component vendor on Voss.
Amda Wabo was a male Aqualish who worked as a weapons designer on the planet Garel during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign.
Kemm was a male Human supply officer serving the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. He was stationed on Voss in the Ken-La Outpost were he sold stimulants.
Jho, commonly known as "Old Jho," was a male Ithorian who operated a cantina known as Old Jho's Pit Stop on the planet Lothal fifteen years after the founding of the Galactic Empire.

Rusty was a male smuggler who worked with Tait Ransom. Around 2 BBY, he was on Omman Minor with Ransom when the latter was captured by Imperial forces. Rusty helped Ransom, Karl Mathieu Ancher, Drake Paulsen, and Nikaede Celso escape from Imperial captivity.
Seth was a Human male who lived on the planet of Omman Minor. Around 2 BBY, he worked as the chief of security at the planet's primary spaceport.
Criss was a male Human who held the rank of lieutenant in the Imperial Army. Around 2 BBY, he served under Colonel Veesle on Omman Minor.
Veesle was a male Human who held the rank of colonel in the Imperial Army. Around 2 BBY, he was stationed on the planet Omman Minor.
Dev Farkus was a Human male specialist who worked for the Mantellian Separatist Movement during the Separatist War on the planet Ord Mantell.
Shellaster was a Human male archaeologist who worked for the Sith Empire on the planet Dromund Kaas during the Cold War.
Starforth was a heavyset Human male research assistant who worked for the Sith Empire on the planet Dromund Kaas during the Cold War.

Brel was a male explosives maker who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Brel's cockiness eventually led to his death when one of his baradium charges blew up, killing him.
Manchucho was a male Aleena from the planet Aleen who served as the King of Aleen during the Clone Wars.
Mathiren was a Sith pureblood male who was a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Dezdarmu was a Talz male who was a champion of his tribe during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Thadus was a male Imperial soldier who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. A sergeant in the Imperial Army, he was stationed on Balmorra, where he ferried messages for Darth Lachris.

Brachtor was a Geonosian who held the position of hive commander amongst the Geonosians who had settled in the Northern Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War. He was eventually killed while near the Northern Windfarm.
Simmons was a soldier in the Republic Army who led a squad during the Battle of Corellia between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Urgrec was a Twi'lek male who worked for Suudaa Nem'ro's palace, supplying the beast pens with fresh creatures.
Luunti was a Rodian female who worked on the planet Nal Hutta as part of a gang lead by the Human Targen.
Linh was a Human female operative of the reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Intelligence during the Cold War.

Onway was a Human female major who served in the military forces of House Organa during the Alderaan Civil War. Tan-skinned and dark-haired, she carried a blaster rifle and was stationed at the Organa estate as a combat instructor.

Hammerbeak was a large Mantellian flutterplume that lived on the planet Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War. It frequently hunted in the stretch of the Fornaak River that was located east of House Baliss, between the Alsakan Lowlands and King's Pass.
Herkuun was a heavyset Human male who held the position of Grand Marshal in the military forces of House Thul on the planet Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War.
The Sabas Killik Queen was a female Killik who was the queen of Sabas, a Killik nest that emerged from hibernation in the Kaamos Territory of the planet Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War.

Trina Bek was a Human female smuggler active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Alderaan Civil War, she spent time on the planet Alderaan, in the Shining Star cantina on the grounds of House Organa.
Tanya Mane, known by her nicknamed Tanya "Trickshot" Mane, was a dark-skinned Human female smuggler active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Garla Seyn was a Mirialan female smuggler active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She made frequent stops to the Republic's Aurek Base on the planet Hoth, where she often talked with Lieutenant Dav Pold.

Nina Gallendo was a Human female smuggler active during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. She made frequent stops to the Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport on the planet Corellia, and often gave advice to fellow smugglers.
Beebo was a heavyset Human male who worked at Aurek Base on the planet Hoth as a merchant during the Galactic War.
Watto was a male Toydarian junk dealer and human trafficker who owned a junkshop in Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine.
Mogra'daal was a parent of the Twi'lek Lonay.
The "Creepy Crate Guy" was a Human male who lived during the Clone Wars. He made masks during Halloween and gave them out in the Jedi Temple.
Nuna was a pet tooka that lived during the Clone Wars.
Cercopes was a pet Kowakian monkey-lizard that lived during the Clone Wars.
Tardar was a pet tooka that lived during the Clone Wars.
Elmel was a Human male Jedi Master and combat instructor who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Sin'Dar was a Mirialan female merchant who worked on the grounds of House Organa, the estate of the noble House Organa on the planet Alderaan during the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Melana was a Human female Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. A Sith Inquisitor, she could be found at the House Thul estate on the planet Alderaan.

Paran "The Needle" Sin was a Mirialan female soldier in the military forces of House Organa during the Alderaan Civil War. She was stationed in the Glarus Valley as part of the Organa forces protecting the Panteer Refuge and besieging the Ulgo-held Castle Panteer.
Ardray was a Mirialan male Jedi Master who led a detachment of Jedi and House Organa soldiers to the Elysium on the planet Alderaan, where they protected a number of Padawans studying there.

Hall was a Human male Marine Officer in the forces of House Organa during the Alderaan Civil War. He led a detachment of Organa marine forces to assault Castle Panteer in the Glarus Valley of Alderaan, hoping to retake the castle from House Ulgo, but he and his forces were ins…
Sorchka was a Human male in the Imperial Military who was stationed on the planet Alderaan during the Cold War.

Rolin was a Rodian male researcher who was part of a team sent by Yudin Thul to investigate the Anzaada Cavern in Alderaan's Kaamos Territory in order to recover an important Killik relic during the Cold War.

Ganron was a Human male security officer in the military forces of House Thul during the Alderaan Civil War. Assigned to the grounds of the Thul estate, he was killed by Republic forces and his security codes stolen.
Fellil was a Twi'lek female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

Muir was a Human male lieutenant in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire who was stationed on the planet Alderaan during the Cold War. The assistant to the Sith Lord Darth Viktus, he was stationed at Outpost Ghrent in the Glarus Valley.
Melkket was a Human male Death Watch lieutenant who lived during the Clone Wars. He commanded Camp Ara'nov during the Skirmish on Carlac and was defeated when A Jedi Knight infiltrated the camp.
Ralnar was a Human male Death Watch lieutenant who lived during the Clone Wars. He commanded Camp Beskar during the Skirmish on Carlac and was defeated when A Jedi Knight infiltrated the camp.
Vherr was a Human male Death Watch lieutenant who lived during the Clone Wars. He commanded Camp Kote during the Skirmish on Carlac and was defeated when a Jedi Knight infiltrated the camp.
Haras was a Human male who worked as a technician at the Ariana spaceport on the planet of Garos IV.
Norban was a Human male who served the Galactic Empire as a communications officer on the planet of Garos IV.
Rena was a Human male who served the Galactic Empire. He held the rank of major and around 8 ABY was garrisoned on the planet of Garos IV.
Vilsics was a Human male who lived on the planet of Garos IV. Around 8 ABY he worked as a flight systems coordinator at the Ariana spaceport.

Chanty Colbon was a male passenger aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess when it was hijacked by the Riders of the Maelstrom. Charming and witty, he used a ruthlessness and ingratiating manner to convince other passengers to spend their money on him.
Birn Da'p was a Bith married to Lologin Da'p. The pair were veteran holidaymakers, and traveled aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess when it was attacked by the Riders of the Maelstrom.
Lologin Da'p was a Bith married to Birn Da'p. The pair were veteran holidaymakers, and traveled aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess when it was attacked by the Riders of the Maelstrom.

Jenkes was a lieutenant with the Imperial Security Bureau on Lothal during the Imperial Era. During the fifth year of Emperor Palpatine's reign, Jenkes managed a gladiator arena on the planet of Nyriaan.
Namada was a Human male sergeant in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire who was part of the Special Tactics Group 41-Delta, also known as Bughunter Division.
Pratt was a Human male sergeant in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was stationed on the planet Alderaan.

Tegan was a Human male sergeant in the Imperial Army who was stationed on the planet Alderaan. A veteran officer in Lieutenant Grol's unit, after Grol's death he clashed with the more junior Sergeant Pratt over who would assume command of the unit and continue their mission to…

Mahish was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War who was the Sith Master of Fannatex. He hunted the Jedi Master Fellil on the planet Alderaan, but was killed by Advozse mercenaries who ambushed Mahish in the mountains of Kaamos Territory.

Lanoyo was a Human male corporal in the Imperial Army who was stationed on the planet Alderaan. When his men downed an Organa transport in the northern Kaamos Territory, he eventually allowed House Thul forces to investigate the wreckage—but was furious when they died in the p…

Brobius was a quiet male Bith steward for Omze'kehr Kahr. He rented cabins to spacers traveling on Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport.

In 3.5 ABY, a male client of the smugglers Shella Rinou and Kelric died on the planet Rodia at the hands of local Rodian hunters. The man was scheduled to meet with the smuggling duo to take possession of a cargo of weapons.

An Ugnaught salesman sold jogan fruits on Lothal during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In the years before Battle of Yavin, the Ugnaught, along with his Lothal astromech droid, were stopped by two stormtroopers.
Asset R-12 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Asset R-89 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Asset R-104 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Asset I-44 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Asset SF-5, also referred to as Shroud SF-5, was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Shroud SF-4 was a member of the intelligence network that served the independent operative known as the Shroud during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. SF-4 was sent to Kuat to observe Imperial asset K-33.

Truno was a male Ithorian Lieutenant in the Alliance Special Operations during the Galactic Civil War. During the war, he was involved in a mission on a backwater planet to destroy a Imperial communications hub located there.
Lom Pyke was a male Pyke who led the Pyke Syndicate, a powerful member of the crime families, during the Clone Wars. Pyke allied his Syndicate with the renegade Sith Lord Maul's Shadow Collective.

RT441 was an Imperial stormtrooper who was part of the security complement guarding the secret meeting between Moffs Torpin and Vanko aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess when it was attacked by the Riders of the Maelstrom.
Pujin was an inquisitive old male who was traveling aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess when it was attacked by the Riders of the Maelstrom.
Craxtet Redhand was a male pirate who was the second in command of the Riders of the Maelstrom under Big Jak Targrim. He earned his name because he wore a Mandalorian crushgaunt.
Vern was an old woman who ran the Kuari Souvenirs shop on board the luxury liner Kuari Princess.

Jetok was a Weequay male who was active as a smuggler captain during the Cold War and was hired by House Thul to make deliveries to the planet Alderaan. However, he was cut down by Republic forces along with many Thul soldiers while making a delivery to King's Pass.

Farlonn was a Jedi Master during the Cold War whose Padawan lost her father to the Sand People on the planet Tatooine. Farlonn's apprentice fled her training and headed to Tatooine to avenge her father, but succumbed to sand fever.
Arkon Lok, also known as Arkon "Nine Fingers" Lok due to his lack of one of his fingers, was a member of the military forces of House Rist on the planet Alderaan during the Cold War.

Raikon was a Zabrak male who held the rank of commander in House Organa's military forces. Commander Raikon was stationed at a tent erected outside Wardpost Landa in the planet Alderaan's Juran Mountains during the Cold War.
Brakar was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. He wielded an orange-bladed lightsaber and used the Ataru form of lightsaber combat.

Miles was a Twi'lek male who worked for House Thul during the Cold War. An electronics expert, he came up with a way to retake the Thul droid factory on the planet Alderaan—dataspikes inserted in the factory's terminals allowed him to remotely shut down the factory, retaking i…
Asset K-33 was an Imperial Agent in the reconstituted Sith Empire. K-33 was sent to discover a weakness in the Kuat Drive Yards defense.

This member of the House Kuat married to asset K-33. Unbeknownst to K-33's spouse, K-33 was an Imperial Agent who had used her to get into the Kuat family to get more power. K-33 started shuttling to the Kuat Drive Yards very regularly, sometimes for several days at a time.
This unidentified recruit was a Force-sensitive male child who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Niall Piv was a Twi'lek male slicer who worked for the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

A Rodian male of the Soammei clan named himself the first Inta'si'rin'na, or Grand Protector of the Rodians. As nominal leader of his species, the Grand Protector received the first Galactic Republic scouting mission to Rodia.

During the Galactic Civil War, an Imperial governor ruled over the planet Rodia. The local Rodians maintained good relations with the Empire, and the governor had few conflicts with the Rodian Grand Protector, Navik the Red.

A male member of the Pau'an species lived and worked as a drug dealer on the planet Coruscant shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan in 1 BBY. On Coruscant's Level 1997, he and a Herglic partner met with the fugitive Alderaanian siblings Anandra and Santigo Milon.
An elderly human man operated the grill on a stall known as Hangra's Meat Shack on Level 2142 of the planet Coruscant shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan.

A human woman born on the planet Alderaan, she married a male Alderaanian and moved to the planet Coruscant. She and her husband came to live in an apartment on Level 3204 of the planet, and the pair eventually had two children, Santigo Milon and Anandra Milon.

A female droid mechanic lived next door to the Milon family on Level 3204 of the planet Coruscant by the time of the destruction of the planet Alderaan. Years prior to the destruction, she babysat the Milon's eldest child Anandra Milon.
Lurking Doom was an Esh-kha who was imprisoned by the Rakata on Belsavis, only to be released during the Galactic War. Lurking Doom was a servant of the World Razer.
Karella was a female Human who was part of an eight-person gang that crossed the Exchange sometime before their capture and incarceration by the Galactic Republic in the Belsavis prison.
Masha Mrinx was a female Twi'lek who was part of an eight-member gang that crossed the Exchange sometime before their capture and incarceration by the Galactic Republic in the Belsavis prison.
Reiki was a male Zabrak who was part of an eight-man gang that crossed the Exchange sometime before their capture and incarceration by the Galactic Republic in the Belsavis prison.

Circa 3.5 ABY, an elderly Rodian female stopped at a luxury hunting lodge in the jungles of the planet Rodia while preparing to take her grandchildren on her "last hunt," which involved dying honorably in battle with a predator.

Biggs Darklighter was a human male ace pilot who fought for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the early days of the Galactic Civil War. He grew up on the desert world of Tatooine, where he became a close boyhood friend of Luke Skywalker.

Oola was a green-skinned Twi'lek female from a clan on the planet Ryloth. She was kidnapped by Bib Fortuna—majordomo of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure—who had her taught exotic dancing and told her many lies about the grandeur of Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine.
Lyn Me was a Twi'lek female dancer who performed with the Max Rebo Band at Jabba the Hutt's Palace, and sang vocals along with Greeata Jendowanian, Sy Snootles and Rystáll Sant.

Drugindi was a Neimoidian male doctor who developed the Blood Boiler bioweapon for the Sith Empire during the Cold War. The scientist hired Imperial forces to test it against the Killiks on the planet Alderaan.
Fannatex was a Human male who was the apprentice of Mahish, a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War.

Moreena Krai, sometimes shortened to just Mo, was a female human who lived on the planet Lothal during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. She and her family left the planet after the Empire condemned their farm and took the land from them.

A human male lived on the planet Lothal during the last years of the Galactic Republic's reign, and witnessed the organization transform into the Galactic Empire. On Lothal, he married and had two daughters, Moreena Krai and her younger sister, with whom he lived on his farm.
A human female lived on the planet Alderaan during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. She at some point in her life had a child, who married and had two children on the planet Lothal.
A human girl was born as the younger sister of Moreena Krai on the planet Lothal, where she lived with her family on a farm.
Quarn was a Human male who was a captain in the military forces of House Organa on the planet Alderaan during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Taros Thul was a Human male member of House Thul and commander in their military forces during the Alderaan Civil War. Stationed in King's Pass on Alderaan, he was killed by Republic forces who stole Thul explosives to frame House Thul in an attack on House Baliss.

Verandala was a Human female who held the position of Overseer at the Ulgo shipping facility in Alderaan's King's Pass during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She was killed when the facility was invaded by Republic-allied forces.
Corvan was a Human male Rebel Alliance pilot. He took part in the mission to Sunfall Peak, setting explosives at the communications hub as part of Team Bantha.
Malos Wil was a Human male soldier in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire who sold speeder bikes and other repulsorcraft in the city of Sobrik on the planet Balmorra.

Shehn was a Human male ordnance officer in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire who was stationed in the city of Sobrik on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.
Swamo was a Human male ordnance officer in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire who was stationed at the Sundari Imperial Outpost on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.

Hemmings was a Human male quartermaster in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire who was stationed at the Markaran Imperial Outpost on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.
Granlo was a Human male major in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire who was stationed at the city of Sobrik on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.
Settar Upredas was a Rattataki male merchant who worked for the Contraband Resale Corporation, selling items on Vaiken Spacedock during the Galactic War.

Oliver Novachez, nicknamed Ollie, was the younger brother of Roan Novachez, a boy from Tatooine was unexpectedly chosen to attend Jedi academy despite being rather older than the typical age at which students were admitted. Oliver was a young boy.
Gammy was a male Gamorrean who became the chef at the Jedi academy on Coruscant in Roan Novachez's second year of attendance there.

Tull was a Human male who served as an officer in the reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Reclamation Service, a military unit charged with discovering and recovering ancient artifacts for weaponization against the Empire's enemies, in the rank of major during the Galactic War.

Camm was a private in the Imperial Army during the Cold War who was part of Lieutenant Piloc's squad on the planet Balmorra. Camm was shot by the rest of Piloc's squad on the orders of Piloc, who was an incompetent leader.

Hawk Leader was a Human male Imperial pilot in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire. He led Hawk Squadron while stationed at Balmorra. Hawk Leader and Hawk Squadron attempted several bombing runs on Outpost Victory before its shields were finally taken down.
Ortuno was a male Selkath who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Keroth Ishedur was a Human male who spent long hours discussing with Deel De the nature of the universe, and their shared feelings.

Lennox was a human male who served as a captain in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic, they commanded the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Tyrant as part of the Sith Lord Darth Vader's personal f…
