Skelly was a human male explosives expert who lived on the planet Gorse. A veteran of the Clone Wars, Skelly worked as an explosives expert in the thorilide mines of Cynda during the time of the Galactic Empire.
Hetto was a member of Myder's Mynocks, a division of the Gorse-based surveillance company Transcept Media Solutions. One of Hetto's colleagues and closest friends was the Sullustan Zaluna Myder.
Lal Grallik also known as Boss Lal was a female Besalisk manager of Moonglow Polychemical on Gorse and Cynda. She was married to Gord Grallik.

Okadiah Garson was a male human thorilide miner and owner of the bar called The Asteroid Belt on the planet Gorse. He took Kanan Jarrus under his wing, giving him a home and a place to work at his bar, as well as securing him a job as an explosives freighter pilot for Moonglow.

Zaluna Myder, nicknamed Zal, was a female Sullustan surveillance operator and the supervisor of Myder's Mynocks at Transcept Media Solutions on the planet Gorse. Myder was not married and had no children. She valued her work life over family, and felt as if work was her home.
Rehkta was a Rakata male who held the position of War Chief during the Galactic War. He and his tamed rancor were killed when they attacked offworlders who were pursuing the Order of Revan.

Alli Krieger was a female who lived on the planet Coruscant during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. A small business owner in Galactic City, she had a younger brother named Erek who joined the Republic Army out of a desire to protect his family.

Erek Krieger was a male private in the Republic Army who lived during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. Erek had an older sister named Alli, and he joined the Republic Military out of a desire to protect his family.
Gorima was a male Selkath who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Wellam Adarios was a captain in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Narell Balrekk, also known as Balrekk the Butcher, was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire as a Captain in the Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Mil Stanner was a Human male spice smuggler specialist. In the past he had been betrayed many times and maintained some distance from people, although he kept an easygoing and friendly demeanor.

Ruwee Naberrie was a human male and a member of the Naberrie family. He was the father of Sola Naberrie and Padmé Amidala. During his lifetime, his strongest ally in the Galactic Senate was Onaconda Farr of Rodia.
Jobal Naberrie was a human female from the planet Naboo. A member of the Naberrie family, she was the mother of Sola Naberrie and Padmé Amidala.

Palfa was a male Neimoidian who acted as director of the Cyndan Mining Guild during the time of the Galactic Empire. He was in charge of supervising the Guild's mining operations on Gorse's moon Cynda, which was rich in thorilide deposits.
A Rancor lived on Umbara and used the rancor forest as their hunting grounds. During the Battle of Umbara, a Jedi Knight defeated this Rancor and tamed their child, Fogg.

Janyor, also referred to as Janyor of Bith, was a renowned male Bith painter, poet, and sculptor from Garel who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic, the reign of the Galactic Empire, and the rise and fall of the New Republic.
Yaun was a Human senator who represented Bureaucratosis in the Senate of the Galactic Republic on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
Mas Amedda was a Chagrian male politician who hailed from the planet Champala and served the chancelleries of Finis Valorum and Sheev Palpatine during the final decades of the Galactic Republic Era.

Lott Dod was a Neimoidian male politician who represented the Trade Federation in the Republic Senate during the final decades of the Galactic Republic Era. Dod rose to prominence after the ill-fated Eriadu Conference left a power vacuum in the Federation's leadership.

The "Jundland General" also known as "Tusken Chieftain" was a male Tusken Raider that lived on Tatooine. He built strategic bases for his Tusken brethren, and led various strategic attacks on settlements throughout his home planet.

Twazzi was a Frenk female bounty hunter who lived during the Clone Wars. Many years earlier, Twazzi's acrobatic skills earned praise from Finis Valorum, who at the time was the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic.
Fixer 66 was the codename of a Human male who held the rank of Fixer in the reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Intelligence during the Cold War.
Armin Devonan was a humanoid female employee of Czerka Corporation on the planet Corellia during the Galactic War waged between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Tibris was a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. Considered to be mad, Tibris ordered the extermination of all life on Bhargebba Six, but allowed biologists to take samples prior to the extermination.
Tsheyk was a Trandoshan warlord who owned a game reserve on the planet Vendaxa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Jennica Pierce was a member of the Rebel Alliance that held the rank of colonel during the Galactic Civil War. Before the Battle of Yavin, she was a moisture farmer on Tatooine, but the Empire's search for two droids destroyed both her family and her farm.

Ponda Baba was a male Aqualish thug who rescued Dr. Cornelius Evazan from a bounty hunter. The two formed a partnership and began to smuggle spice for the crime lord Jabba the Hutt, resulting in him becoming a wanted man.

Jan Dodonna was a legendary male human military officer from Commenor who served with the navy of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, within the navy of the Galactic Empire, and later, as a general in the rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Mnesus was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire who created a number of biological experiments during his career. He owned several laboratories during the Cold War.

Pineek was a Rodian male salvager who was famous during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. When he was arrested, Pineek offered information on his best scavenging grounds in exchange for securing his freedom, and he was soon freed from prison.

Kitmum was a female Wookiee Jedi who taught the Physical Education course at the Jedi academy on Coruscant during the time of Roan Novachez's attendance there. She put the students through an exhaustive course that was designed to test them to their physical limits.

Necra Phaest was a female Chiss who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She made her living as a utility decorations engineer on board Vaiken Spacedock.

E. E. Emmons lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. The individual was an adornment specialist who under Imperial law, as a one time gift, would send furniture to purchasers of strongholds if they were properly documented.

Orloth was a male Selkath who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. During the war he lived on his species' homeworld of Manaan, where he worked as a merchant in the Imperial Concourse of the Mercantile Plaza trading platform.

Ramsis Dendup was a human male who served as the king of the planet Onderon during the Clone Wars, in which he tried to remain neutral. Dendup's vow for neutrality backfired, with the Separatists sweeping in and occupying the planet.
Clone 99, or simply 99, was a human male clone of Jango Fett bred to be a clone trooper for the Galactic Republic's Grand Army.

Zett Jukassa was a human male Padawan of the Jedi Order during the time of the Galactic Republic. He was present in the Jedi Archives, the Order's library within the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, in 22 BBY.
Cin Drallig was a Force-sensitive human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as Battlemaster and Chief of Security of the Jedi Temple during the Clone Wars.
Wat Tambor was a male Skakoan who was the foreman of the Techno Union, an executive of Baktoid Armor Workshop, and a general in the Separatist Droid Army.

San Hill was a male Muun and Chairman of the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the Clone Wars. He pledged the support of the Banking Clan to the Confederacy of Independent Systems and served as the financial cartel's representative on the Separatist Council.
Shu Mai was a female Gossam who served as Presidente of the Commerce Guild during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Passel Argente was a male Koorivar who was the Magistrate of the Corporate Alliance and a member of the Galactic Senate representing his homeworld, Kooriva, in the final days of the Galactic Republic.

Agen Kolar was a Force-sensitive Iridonian Zabrak male and was a Jedi Master in the era of the Galactic Republic. At his time in the order, he was considered to be a notable duelist, and sat on the Jedi High Council.
Saesee Tiin, a Force-sensitive Iktotchi male from the moon Iktotch, was a Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Stass Allie, a Force-sensitive Tholothian female, was a Jedi Master who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic. She was also the cousin of Jedi Master and Jedi High Council member Adi Gallia.
Eeth Koth was a Force-sensitive Iridonian Zabrak male native to the planet Iridonia, who also held the title of Jedi Master within the Jedi Order.

Shi-Fara was a female Togruta Jedi Padawan who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant at the same time as Roan Novachez's attendance there. In her second year of attendance, she became the girlfriend of a fellow student, a Human named Pasha. She was a skilled droid creator.
Cronah was a male Zabrak Jedi Padawan who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's time of attendance there. A skilled student, he was nevertheless a bully and troublemaker.
Gaiana was a Human female Jedi Padawan who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant at the same time of Roan Novachez's attendance there. She had already been training at the Academy when he came.

Bill was a male Sullustan Padawan who trained at the Jedi academy at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Like many other Bith, one of Bill's favorite hobbies was music. He was friends with Roan, Pasha, and Egon.
Plorbaas, also known as Plorbaas the Hutt, was a male Hutt who lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Vel was a male Moff of the Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. After a prototype Imperial starship was accidentally scrapped on the junk moons of Axxila, Vel hired scavengers to recover the starship, and launched an investigation afterwards.
Mahreen was a diplomat of the Galactic Republic native to the ocean planet Dac who lived sometime during the Great Galactic War and Cold War between the Republic and the Sith Empire.

Tera Sinube was a Cosian male Jedi Master who lived during the height and later descent of the Galactic Republic. Sinube was the marshal of a Jedi outpost on Derra during the High Republic Era, and sat on the Jedi High Council sometime before the Invasion of Naboo.

A male Yuuzhan Vong assassin who was apprenticed under Domain Shai was sent by Commander Harrar to attack the defector Elan as a means of convincing the New Republic of the authenticity of Elan's actions.
Cyrus was a male Dathomirian Jedi Padawan who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's time of attendance there. A skilled student, he was nevertheless a bully and troublemaker.
Blanaid, also known as Watts was a male human who served as an AT-ST driver in the Imperial Army. During the Galactic Civil War, he took part in the Empire's struggle against the Rebel Alliance.
The mercenary Saponza and his partner ran a gang. The two established a base in the former's old homestead on Tatooine.

Newland, also known as Marquand was a human male in the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, he held the rank of major and served at the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, where he served in Tempest Scout 2, an All Terrain Scout Transport with Lieutenant Blanaid.

Pollux Hax was a male individual who served as the Minister of Information for COMPNOR for much of Emperor Sheev Palpatine's reign. He was tasked with keeping the journalists in check so their reports coincided with the Imperial propaganda.
Bacara, known also by his clone trooper designation CC-1138, was a clone trooper officer who held the military rank of Clone Marshal Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Fox, designated CC-1010, was a clone trooper officer who served as the Clone Commander of the Coruscant Guard during the Clone Wars.
Fez Devvol was the manager of Aqualis Base, a food processing plant on Baralou owned by the Aqualis Food Conglomerate, but secretly was being used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A Gormak male was the leader of a particularly ruthless and savage Gormak clan on the planet Voss. Bloodthirsty, the leaders' group ambushed Jedi Master Bacara and his Padawan, Kosh in the Jedi ruins, killing the former and severely injuring the latter.
Tu-Anh was a female Jedi Master who lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic. She perished on Utapau toward the end of the Clone Wars while investigating a Separatist conspiracy.
Endente was a Sugi arms dealer who at some point made a deal with Governor Torul Blom and Count Dooku to provide the Confederacy of Independent Systems with a giant kyber crystal.
Mars Guo was a male Bardottan who participated in podraces during the reign of the Galactic Republic. The thin nosed Guo preferred a very large podracer which, despite its size, was rather fast.
Toybox was the nickname of a Human male from Balmorra who made electric toys before he was pressed into service as a technical expert by the Sith Empire.
Nakiya was a Rutian Twi'lek female merchant who worked in the city of Sobrik on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Wel-Nolan was a Human male merchant who worked in the city of Sobrik on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Klintok was a mutated Colicoid who was among those that nested in the remains of the Farnel Research Facility on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Torul Blom was a male Pau'an politician who served as governor of Pau City on Utapau during the Clone Wars.
Dineé Ellberger was a human pilot who flew an N-1 starfighter as part of Bravo Squadron, specifically serving as Bravo Five, during the Invasion of Naboo.

Morad Sumar was a human farmer on Lothal, and an old friend of Ezra Bridger's parents. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, he struggled to keep his land from Imperial hands, refusing to sell it to them.

"LS-005" was a the callsign of a stormtrooper who served the Imperial Army. In 5 BBY, whilst stationed on the Star Destroyer Lawbringer, he was assigned by Agent Kallus to guard a cell containing Ezra Bridger.
Mr. Garfield was a male Dathomirian Jedi Master serving as an instructor at the Jedi academy at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's time of attendance there. Mr.

This farmer was a girl who had Force potential but was ultimately unworthy of becoming a Jedi Knight and was sentenced to work on Dantooine. She was encouraged by her friend Wass to fight against the Separatist droids when they attacked the planet.

Wrencess was a bounty hunter whose seductive advances were never rejected by any individual of any species. To pursue bounties, Wrencess would take weeks to romantically engage his targets before revealing his goal.
Sallow Violect was a female bounty hunter who had previously been part of the Ailon Nova Guard. She loudly challenged all of her targets to a public fight.
A male Yuuzhan Vong shaper with a lisp was on Yuuzhan'tar in 28 ABY. At one time, he was approached by Hooley Krekk, who wished to know what the shaping cortexs were.

Garri was a male Toydarian who lived in Pau City on the planet Utapau during the Clone Wars. There, he operated an office building within the city where he was paid to allow a Separatist-backed arms deal to take place.

Gradd was a human male pilot who served as a commander in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire. Late in the Galactic Civil War, he was assigned to the Devastator, one of the most prestigious Imperial-class Star Destroyers in the Imperial fleet under the command of Admiral J…

Porro Dolphe was a pilot in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps. He flew in Bravo Squadron during the Invasion of Naboo as Bravo 2. A decade later, Captain Gregar Typho made Dolphe the lead pilot of the starfighter escort for the Royal Naboo cruiser.
Gerane Metara was a Human female from the planet Alderaan who served as an administrator in the education council. She was the wife of Stavin and mother to Caline.
Stavin Metara was a Human male artist from the planet Alderaan. He was the husband of Gerane and father to Caline.

Shmorg was a Gran bounty hunter operating on the moon of Sulon, in the city of Barons Hed during the year 5 ABY. Along with four other Gran, Shmorg attended a local tavern, where they ordered several refreshments.

Garven "Dave" Dreis, dubbed "Old Man" by the other pilots at Base One, was a male human and ace pilot from Virujansi who served as a commander in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
During the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign, a wealthy, male Chagrian traveled to the planet Lothal in order to view the gladiatorial event Gladiator Night.

A male Bardottan taxi driver worked on the planet Lothal during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. One location he picked up passengers from was the ground transport area in the spaceport of Lothal's Capital City.

A Human male lived on the moon Sulon during the year 5 ABY, where he operated a small tavern located in the city of Barons Hed. At some point, the establishment entertained five members of the Gran species, who were all Imperial bounty hunters.
Savielk Trey'dra was a Bothan male and the Council Chief of the Bothan Council during the Galactic Civil War.
Tott was a Human male colonel in the Republic Army who served in the Battle of Corellia against the Sith Empire.
Tsuusha was a male Selkath who served as the head researcher for the Rift Alliance at Attis Station on the planet Quesh.
A nasty-looking Rodian criminal worked in partnership with a crime syndicate courier.
Gregor, formerly designated CC-5576-39 (shortened to CC-5576), was a veteran Clone Captain and Clone Commander who served in the Grand Army of the Republic's Special Operations Brigade.

A human male Imperial officer served as a captain aboard Transport 651. His ship was boarded by rebels in order to rescue Wookiee slaves, although it was a trap set by Agent Kallus. The ship was captured by Kallus' Star Destroyer.

Handy was a young Human male who lived on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War. During the subjugation of Cloud City by Imperial forces in 3 ABY, Handy was truanting from school with his friend, Allania Jakien in the Ugnaught tunnels.

The father of Allania Jakien lived on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War. He worked in the Tibanna gas refinery. During the take over of Cloud City by the Galactic Empire, he escaped with his family aboard a crowded transport.
Timmy was a human male that worked as a bartender at the Rimmer's Rest cantina on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the year 5 ABY.

Janek Sunber, nicknamed "Tank," was an acquaintance of Luke Skywalker while living on Tatooine. Sometime during their adolescence, Skywalker, Biggs Darklighter, Sunber and some of their other friends explored Beggar's Canyon.

The male Human Noab-De worked as a speeder salesman on the planet Quesh during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Working out of the Imperial Garrison built on the world, the vendor wore a breathmask due to Quesh's toxic atmosphere.

Kanna Deltic, nicknamed Lieutenant Strangechild by her crewmate Commander Nibiru Chamas, was a human lieutenant in the Imperial Navy and the planetary science specialist of the Imperial Star Destroyer Ultimatum during its mission to the Gorse system in 11 BBY.

Frej was a Human male researcher who was part of the expedition led by Jedi Master Cin Tykan on the planet Taris.
Defte was a Zabrak male researcher who was part of the expedition led by Jedi Master Cin Tykan on the planet Taris.

Vachir was a male Devaronian who lived during the Cold War. He worked at the Pit on Nar Shaddaa, providing Huttball players with stimulants and other items.
Joka was a Human male lieutenant who served in the Republic Military during the Cold War and Galactic War. He was stationed on the planet Alderaan during the planet's civil war.
Lucen was a male Human sergeant who served in the Imperial Military during the Cold War and Galactic War. He was stationed on the planet Alderaan during the planet's civil war.

Eris Harro was an individual who served the Galactic Empire as Bureau Chief for the Outer Rim Node of the HoloNet News agency in the city of Phelar, on the Outer Rim planet Eriadu.

A male Gran operated as a bounty hunter during the year 5 ABY. Hired by the Dark Jedi Jerec, he, along with numerous other Gran bounty hunters and Grave Tuskens, was tasked with guarding the city of Barons Hed, located on the moon Sulon.
This Rebel spy was a passenger on board a Star Tours travel agency StarSpeeder 1000 one year before the Battle of Yavin.

Leelee Pace was a Zeltron artisan who lived on Tatooine shortly after the Declaration of a New Order. She regularly visited Dannar's Claim in the Pika Oasis, which was run by her friend Annileen Calwell.

A Human female who resided on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the year 5 ABY was a Rebel sympathizer. She supported the Alliance to Restore the Republic and their endeavors, who during 5 ABY had become known as the New Republic.
Lacunas Subartuk was a Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order some time before the Clone Wars. A long time after his death, Subartuk was considered one of the most vigilant Jedi of the ancient order.

Gren Lavorn served the Alliance to Restore the Republic at Mortex Sector HQ as the base's spacecraft maintenance officer.

Lucas M'benka was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was stationed at Mortex Sector HQ.

Hiram Zataire was a male human who served as a captain in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire. Zataire had a wife, who stayed married to him despite his frequent absences due to long assignments.

Alonzo, billed as the Amazing Alonzo, was a creature trainer with Kersh Lauskner's Traveling Animal/Acrobatic Arcadium. He controlled a trained trompa, and carried an electric prod in case the creature got out of hand.

Tormax Ardellian was a Corellian pirate who smuggled Rebels and equipment to the planet Questal. They were discovered in the act; the Rebels were publicly executed and the pirates locked away in Moff Bandor's palace. Ardellian escaped, although his face was wounded.

Ars Dangor was a male human official who served on the Ruling Council of the Galactic Empire. During the Clone Wars, he served as a Senior Advisor of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine who sometimes acted as a bureaucrat, emissary, or a dignitary in Palpatine's name and one ti…
Var Narek was a Human male from the Outer Rim planet of Ord Radama. His father's anger toward the planet's governor, Ellor Orgraal, rubbed off on him, and extended to the Galactic Empire as a whole.

Ellam, known professionally as Honest Ellam, was a blue-skinned, four-armed humanoid alien who owned Honest Ellam's Speeder Lot in the city of Gralleenya on the planet Questal.

Even Piell, a Force-sensitive Lannik male, was a Jedi Master who served as a senior member of the Jedi High Council in the final decades of the Galactic Republic Era.

Lin Jae was an Imperial officer who served as the commander of Rampart Station, a supply base for ships en route to the planet Geonosis.

Johhar Kessen was a human male and the senator of the planet Dandoran during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Abel LaSal was an individual who served as a commander in the Imperial Navy's officer corps. In 14 BBY, LaSal was deployed aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Sovereign.

Mootai was a male Moorjhoni who lived on the planet Moorjhone in 20 BBY. When his brother Mas tripped when preparing to attack Ja'Boag's mine, Mootai stopped to help him up.

A human male served as the captain of the Carrion Spike, a stealth ship and Wilhuff Tarkin's personal vessel. He had served under Tarkin's command during the Clone Wars.

Cob Tier was a human friend of the Bridger family who introduced Ezra Bridger to the Rodian Tseebo.
Brocky was a male Kaleesh soldier who served the Galactic Republic on Quesh during the Galactic War.

Thew Marstan was a strongman working with Kersh Lauskner's Traveling Animal/Acrobatic Arcadium. Although he stood less than one meter tall, he was immensely strong, able to bend metal bars into a knot and lift a platform laden with audience members above his head.

Madame Suwajda was a fortune teller working with Kersh Lauskner's Traveling Animal/Acrobatic Arcadium. Although she gave the impression that she was mind reader, she was, in fact, highly perceptive and could read people's expressions accurately.
Sheneel was a graceful woman who performed with Kersh Lauskner's Traveling Animal/Acrobatic Arcadium. She had turquoise skin and silver hair.

Chirioff was the humanoid head clown of Kersh Lauskner's Traveling Animal/Acrobatic Arcadium, responsible for hiring and firing the other clowns. He was adept at juggling, sleight of hand, and slapstick.
Kersh Lauskner was the owner of Kersh Lauskner's Traveling Animal/Acrobatic Arcadium and a secret Alliance to Restore the Republic sympathizer.
Rake Corsail was a male pirate and smuggler. He was imprisoned on Questal for smuggling.

Kassius Konstantine was a human male from Coruscant who served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy. He was dispatched to the Lothal system, where a rebel cell occurred.

Davijaan, designated CC-2237 and also known by the callsign "Odd Ball," was a Clone Commander and pilot during the Clone Wars who participated in campaigns such as the Battle of Teth, the Battle of Umbara, the Battle of Coruscant, and the Battle of Utapau.

Jakarro was a male Wookiee smuggler who worked during the Galactic War along with his protocol droid companion C2-D4. The pair was responsible for at least 31 confirmed killings, 216 cases of assault and countless acts of vandalism, theft, and contraband smuggling.
Esano was a Human male whose family ran the Kozinarg Trade Guilds. When members of the Scourge kidnapped his sister, he declined to pay the ransom because she had challenged his power.

Gronson "Shifty" Takkaro was a Dug gambler and former manager of the Daystar Casino on Ahakista. At some point, he worked as a bookmaker for Jenkes, who managed a gladiator arena on the planet Nyriaan.

Bulduga was half of a male Ithorian bounty hunter duo, alongside his brother, Onca. While Onca preferred long-range weapons, such as rifles, Bulduga preferred the quick-and-easily-accessible blaster pistols.

Stellan was a human male case officer at the Imperial Security Bureau for Bracchia, a Koorivar spy for the Galactic Empire. He and Bracchia were interrogated by Emperor Palpatine himself in an attempt to find conspirators within the Imperial security apparatus.

Jen June, a Pau'an female, was the police inspector in Pau City on Utapau during the Clone Wars. She assisted Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker as they investigated the disappearance and death of Jedi Master Tu-Anh.
Crest was a clone trooper who served as a stormtrooper sergeant during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Anora Fair was a human female who worked as a journalist shortly after the rise of the Galactic Empire. Anora was a close friend of the Zygerrian film maker Hask Taff.

Berch Teller was a human male captain in Republic Intelligence who served on the moon Antar 4 during the Clone Wars. He helped trained loyalist Gotal and Koorivar insurgent fighters who fought against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Ranulph Tarkin was a male human from Eriadu and the paternal cousin of Wilhuff Tarkin. He bore an uncanny resemblance to Wilhuff's father, his uncle, so much so that they could have passed for twins.
Jova Tarkin was a human male native to the planet Eriadu. A member of the Tarkin family, he was the paternal grand-uncle of Wilhuff Tarkin.
Magda Ulbreck was the wife of Wyle Ulbreck. Shortly after the Declaration of a New Order, they were living on Tatooine, where Wyle was a moisture farmer.
Ima-Gun Di was a male Kajain'sa'Nikto Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as a General during the Clone Wars. He was killed on Ryloth by Separatist droid forces while helping to save its people.

Tralllnt was an intelligence veteran who worked under Scrivinir Sris Lehhett when the former Fleet Admiral controlled the Centrality during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Tralllnt used Imperial Security Bureau-style intimidation tactics to aid Lehhett in controlling the region.

Osi Sobeck was a Phindian male who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems as a commandant during the Clone Wars. As warden of the Citadel on the planet Lola Sayu, Sobeck was in command of a prison designed to hold fallen Jedi.

Tyrus was a Human male who held the post of City Commander at Sobrik, a city on the planet Balmorra that was under the control of the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was killed during a Galactic Republic attack on Sobrik during the ongoing conflict on Balmorra.

Athal-Je was a Voss Mystic in training. Athal-Je was among the candidates Sophia Farash identified to the Barsen'thor who was on Voss looking for an ally. Farash stated that Athal-Je was gifted, but didn't study much.

Heen-Sa was a Voss Mystic in training. Heen-Sa was among the candidates Sophia Farash identified to the Barsen'thor who was on Voss looking for an ally. Farash stated that Heen-Sa was sympathetic toward the Sith Empire.

Ky Narec was a male human Jedi Knight who served as Asajj Ventress's Jedi Master before his death. He was killed during a battle with Weequay raiders, causing Ventress great distress and starting her on her path to the dark side.

Red Team leader was the commander of a three ship flight of T-65 X-wing starfighters known as Red Team. Assigned to the planet Isis, Red Team was destroyed while pursuing the Imperial Survey Corps Far*Reach IV PQR Wanderer over the planet.

Finn, formerly designated FN-2187 ("Eight-Seven"), was a Force-sensitive human male and former stormtrooper who served the First Order until his desertion and subsequent defection to the Resistance during the First Order-Resistance War.

Ben Solo was a Force-sensitive human male who turned to the dark side of the Force and became known as Kylo Ren, the "Jedi Killer" who rose to power as master of the Knights of Ren and Supreme Leader of the First Order during the New Republic Era.

Miru Nadrinakar was a member of the Corellian Resistance against the Galactic Empire. While attempting to warn the resistance of an upcoming crackdown, she crashed her starfighter on a moon inhabited by Antron Bach.

Cordé, formerly known as Cordyn, was a handmaiden who served Senator Padmé Amidala in the days leading up to the Clone Wars. She was acting as a decoy when she was killed in an attempt on Amidala's life by Clawdite bounty hunter Zam Wesell.
Bozzie Barada was a Vulptereen Podracer pilot who represented the planet Kessel in the Boonta Eve Classic of 32 BBY.

Zuckuss was a Force-sensitive male Gand findsman who worked as a bounty hunter prior to and during the Galactic Civil War. A skilled tracker who often worked with 4-LOM, Zuckuss had a run-in with Han Solo that left his ship, the Mist Hunter, powered down on a strange planet.
Principal Mar was a Kel Dor male Jedi Master and the head of the Jedi academy at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. As principal, his duties included sending letters welcoming new students to the academy.

Orn Free Taa was a male Rutian Twi'lek politician who represented his homeworld of Ryloth in both the Senates of the Galactic Republic and of its successor state, the Galactic Empire. Taa was unpopular on Ryloth, as he was content with amassing wealth for himself on Coruscant.
Egon Reich was a male Zabrak who was a friend of Roan Novachez, Pasha, and Bill at the Jedi academy in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

The human father of Corellian Resistance member Miru Nadrinakar worked as a historian. During the rule of the Galactic Empire, he still believed in the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order until the Empire took action against him.

The Sith Lord of Gairm was a Sith Lord who was befriended by the Jedi Master Vonkhel. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the antiques dealer Antron Bach remembered the story of the unlikely friendship while trying to reassure himself about approaching a downed starfighte…

Nes Ukul was a male padawan of the Jedi Order. He sacrificed himself on a planet which he did not know the name of, defending a species whose language he could not speak. Ukul's master later commented that the padawan's sacrifice was noble.

A master of the Jedi Order took on the male trainee Nes Ukul as a padawan. Ukul sacrificed himself while defending a species whose language he couldn't speak on a planet which he did not know the name of.

Dogran was a Chiss male major in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire who served in the Battle of Ilum. Dogran served under Grand Moff Ilyan Regus and Darth Malgus during Operation Dark Ice.
Madreeg was a Sith Lord of the Sphere of Ancient Knowledge in the Sith Empire who searched for the lost planet of Had Abbadon.
O'kar A'ko was the leader of the Ravagers, a notorious pirate gang on the planet Rishi, in the years prior to the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Darth Ordrem was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He gathered a fleet in the Baros system in order to launch an ambush against the Republic, but was killed in a preemptive Republic strike.
Cynerus was a male Sith Lord who was one of the Sith Empire's top assassins during the Galactic War, with forty-nine confirmed kills of Republic officials.

Evlen was a male Human who served as a captain in the Imperial Navy of the Sith Empire, commanding Darth Tormen's flagship: the Harrower-class dreadnought Tyrant. Evlen was killed when the Tyrant was boarded by Galactic Republic forces during the Battle of Rabaan.
Parson was a male Human who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy of the reconstituted Sith Empire aboard the Harrower-class dreadnought Tyrant.
Galron was a Twi'lek male who lived on Balmorra and was discovered to be a Force-sensitive prodigy during the Cold War. However, he was killed in defense of Cave 52.
Galron was a male Mandalorian who lived with his twin daughters, Mari and Tayn, during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Geates was a male Human who was a commander in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was stationed on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.
Cason was a male Human who was a supply officer in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire. He was stationed on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.
Jin-Rio Akabi was a Human female diplomat for the Rebel Alliance from Colstev.
Boruush was a Trandoshan pirate who Trademaster Kavork of the Red Meteor Consortium pirate gang owed a gambling debt to.
Arlo Grennen was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Ralen Margok was a Zabrak who was a member of the Nova Blades pirates more than a century before 3637 BBY.

Tion Medon was a male Pau'an who served as the Port Administrator of Pau City on the planet Utapau during the Clone Wars, a pan-galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Nianla was a female Human agent in the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire. She was stationed on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War, where she took custody of a set of stolen walker plans that had been recovered from the Galactic Republic forces that had stolen them.

A male Force-sensitive Kumumgah lived on Tatooine during the Infinite Empire's rule. When the planet was conquered by the Rakata, they burned his city and imprisoned the survivors.
Tecknel Shnick was a member of the criminal underworld on the planet Travnin.

Kai Zykken was a male Human who was captain of the Corellian Run Scoundrels, a pirate gang during the Galactic War. A persistent rumor was that Zykken once kidnapped the adult daughter of Viril Shu, a corporate magnate on the planet Denon.

Gorbus was a Hutt active during the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. By 3643 BBY, he possessed six of a set of seven sculptures of a rare striped gizka, a species of reptile.

Uvell was a male member of the Jedi Order with a yellow lightsaber who participated in the Clone Wars, in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. During that conflict, he bore the title of Jedi Master and was noted for his bravery in combat.
The Lost Prince was an infamous male Falleen heir apparent who was kidnapped as a child 20 years before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Vonkhel was a Jedi Master who befriended the Sith Lord of Gairm. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the antiques dealer Antron Bach remembered the story of the unlikely friendship while trying to reassure himself about approaching a downed starfighter, which he thought m…
Rimark was a male Mandalorian warlord during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Varek Tarn was a male Mandalorian warlord during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Dris Mosan was a male small-time fence who managed to acquire a shipment of high-end security droids during the Galactic War. Unable to unload them on his own, he hired additional help to act as his business partner.
Edruu was the Prince of the planet Doan during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Hex Ordin was a male who was a famous sharpshooter during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. When his golden blaster went missing, Ordin offered a reward to whoever found it.

Darth Nephantes was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. Before attending a meeting with a number of other Sith Lords, he had the meeting site inspected and found that the meeting was actually an ambush.
Tinray was one of the Sith apprentices of the Sith Lord Darth Malgus during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, and served under Malgus on the planet Ilum.

Norbo was a Hutt whose enterprises included smuggling to the planet Geldoll during the Cold War. When Geldoll banned all Hutt vessels and agents from the planet in an effort to combat smuggling, he was forced to find new agents to deliver his shipments.

Halron Yehr was a Human male Imperial captain and stormtrooper assault leader. He and two other of his fellow stormtroopers were killed by a Rebel operative dispatched by Captain Gial Ackbar sometime after the Battle of Yavin in 0 ABY.
CV-481 was an elite Imperial stormtrooper serving under Captain Sodarra during the Galactic Civil War.
Taslo Deville was a Togorian who lived on the planet Shador during the Galactic Civil War. Deville was Captain Sodarra's contact on the planet, and an agent of Lord Darth Vader.
Karlo was a Twi'lek mercenary hired by Alfreda Goot during the Galactic Civil War.
Silam Dunerz was a Human male who served as a supply master in the 501st Legion, and held the rank of commander in the Galactic Empire's military by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Bo-Dum was a member of the Hutt species and a minor crime lord. With his fellow Hutt Rarsk, Bo-Dum imposed his rule on a planet of the Outer Rim Territories for a time. Ultimately, the two Hutts were defeated by Han Solo, the famous Corellian smuggler, and his co-pilot Chewbacca.
Jenna was a female Human of Corellian heritage. She and her father were part of a group of colonists that settled a planet of the Outer Rim Territories.
Kolo Lovek, also known by his nickname Kolo "Lightning" Lovek, was a male swoop racer during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
K'torna was an individual who held the position of Aeesthetic Consultant with Ultrastellar Aesthetic Consultancy, a interior decorating company active during the Galactic War.

Lama Su was a male Kaminoan politician who served as Prime Minister of his homeworld, Kamino, during the final decades of the Galactic Republic until his removal from office during the early Imperial Era.

Trebold Raynor was the founder of Raynor Mining Enterprises. Raynor owned a fabled pickaxe that became known as the Platinum Pickaxe, and Gan Alno, a later head of the company, hired treasure hunters to locate the item on Raynor's homeworld.
Lina was a female who was the Queen of the planet Onderon during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

affiliation: University of Rudrig Committee for Historic Preservation
x: Chelli Lona Aphra, also known as "Smallfry," was a human female archaeologist. Born in 24 BBY as the daughter of Korin and Lona Aphra, she learned much about the galaxy due to Korin's scholarly ambitions.
Tarkos Sund was a Human male businessman and inventor who founded Sund Technologies, a technology company during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Offra was a Hutt and a rival of Skeedo the Hutt during the Cold War. Offra hired individuals to deliver an arms shipment to the military on the planet Skeressa. However, the shipment was hijacked by Skeedo's minions.

Sord Trunnel was a gangster who was a high-ranking member of the Exchange crime syndicate during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. By around 3643 BBY, he was present on the Colonies planet Byblos.
Sullivapat was a data slicer from the planet Denevar who was considered legendary around the time of the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Caroline was a Human female who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Francine was a female Trandoshan who was paired up with a loved one during the Ewok Festival of Love.
Jilia was a female Twi'lek who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
An individual served in the Imperial High Command of the Sith Empire as the Minister of War around the year 3643 BBY.

Gorro was a Rodian bounty hunter and Supreme Hunter living on Rishi. He was present in the Blaster's Path cantina, instigating an unprovoked fight with an individual believed to be a "notorious pirate".

Larcet was a male Moff of the Sith Empire during the Cold War who fancied himself an antiquities collector. He hired treasure hunters to retrieve a hoard of artifacts that he learned of from a "trustworthy source," though the source unsuccessfully attempted to betray the Moff.
Ellen was a female Bothan who lived during the Galactic Civil War
Jeffrey was a male Zabrak who was paired up with a loved one during the Ewok Festival of Love.
Matthew was a male Rodian who lived during the Galactic Civil War
Gary was a male Sullustan who was paired up with a loved one during the Ewok Festival of Love.

Preigo was a male Dug circus master who operated Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder during the Clone Wars. Leading a nomadic lifestyle with his performers, Preigo would visit various worlds and perform shows for those weary from the war.

affiliation: Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military

x: Phoca Soot was a Twi'lek male police officer who lived during the early years of the Galactic Empire on the planet Coruscant. Soot served as an Imperial police prefect, charged with controlling crime on Level 1331. He was executed by the Sith Lord Darth Vader for taking bribes.

affiliation: Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military
x: Dodd Rancit was a human male officer who served in the Naval Intelligence Agency of the Galactic Empire, a position he had been appointed to personally by Emperor Palpatine.
Wordro was a Hutt whose shipments were hijacked during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Julio Beni was an underboss in the Hutt Cartel who escaped prison during the Cold War and hired underworld figures to transport thems back to Hutt Space before the authorities could catch Beni.
Iven was a Human male member of the Imperial Guard, the elite protectors of the Sith Emperor of the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Tiffan Nye was a Human female who was part of a team working on the Republic Tarisian Archival Database during the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Leero was a Hutt who was a self-proclaimed artist and director during the Cold War. However, Leero's holodramas were so devoid of taste that they were not sold freely in Hutt Space, so Leero hired individuals to find a market for them.
Roeg was an Imperial Admiral stationed aboard the first Death Star during the Galactic Civil War. He had his own personal guard on the station.

A Herglic lived on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The Herglic dwelt in a fugitive camp built amongst a junkyard on Level 1782 of the planet, where it encountered the Alderaanian fugitive Anandra Milon.
Danah Jor was a Human male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire.
Kell Lapaz was a male Bith mercenary who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Ungo was a Hutt active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Around 3643 BBY, Ungo was looking to hire security to escort a shipment of theirs through the Kellis system, which was full of smugglers.
Gadsle Distombe was a male Twi'lek male Sith Shadow who operated on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Lady of Pain was a female Rattataki crime lord operating on Tatooine during the Cold War.

Xarval was a male Duros who held the position of vice engineer aboard the Theoretika, a mobile research starship operated by Czerka Corporation over a century before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Alon was a Human male medical officer in the Republic Army who served as part of Storm Squad during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Z was a member of the InterStellar Regulators mercenary group who was active on the planet Makeb in the Mid Rim's Aida sector by 3638 BBY.
Ivan Stahl was a Human male who was among those attempting to settle in the Tularan Marsh region of the planet Taris during the Taris Resettlement Initiative.

Borga was a male Gamorrean gladiator fighter who served under Fell Dargun on Tatooine during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, while at the Lady of Pain's compound, Borga fought a bounty hunter in the gladiatorial pits.
Fell Dargun was a male Human who lived at the time of the Cold War on Tatooine. He had a Gamorrean gladiator by the name of Borga in his servitude.
Ann'ya was a female Twi'lek who worked as a dancer at Varath cantina on the planet Tatooine.

Razak was a male Human criminal of the Black Sun at the time of the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, Razak went to an auction hosted by Bilikin Drell concerning the target list of the Great Hunt, as he was anxious that he was a bounty.
Jorland was a Human male in the Republic Army who served as Commander of Storm Squad during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Massey was a Human male in the Republic Army who served as security chief in Storm Squad during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Alvena was a Human female major in the Republic Army who served aboard the Thranta-class corvette Dorin's Sky during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Lok Durd was a male Neimoidian arms developer who served as a general in the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars. He was featured on the anti-Trade Federation poster Taxation Without Federation. He was defeated by Republic forces and was taken into Republic custody.
Marcus was a male commander who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Oppo Rancisis was a Force-sensitive Thisspiasian male Jedi Master who served on the Jedi Council during the High Republic Era, Invasion of Naboo, and the Clone Wars.

Randor Mohl was a male Human Mandalorian chieftain who lived on Tatooine during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, an Imperial individual came to Outpost Rennar with the remains fallen Mandalorian initiates, and brought the dead to Mohl.

In the years prior to the Battle of Yavin, Jai Kell lived with his mother on Lothal. He later joined the Academy for Young Imperials on the planet, where the leadership recognized he may have been Force-sensitive and gave his name to the Grand Inquisitor.
Sindal Reed was a Nautolan male spice boss, and the leader of the Exchange's spice operation on Tatooine. He was killed by an Imperial individual working for Captain Reskin in 3643 BBY.
Kiregan Freem was a male Human and prominent member of the Exchange on Tatooine. In 3643 BBY, he was killed by an Imperial individual working for officer Vuk Dimitrius.
Stivastin, designated Specimen #71, was a Selkath male who was experimented on by the scientist Gorima during Gorima's efforts to create an Infinite Army by fusing Rakata technology to living beings.
Bloodgouge was a fearsome male Tusken Raider chieftain who lived on the planet Tatooine's Southern Jundland Wastes during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Sith Lord Necus had an apprentice who was killed in the second-floor library of the Sith Academy on Korriban by another apprentice, Esorr Kayin.

A male individual held the position of prince-regent in the Tapani sector during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The prince-regent had a number of heirlooms stolen from him, and paid large sums to recover the stolen heirlooms.

The Ratcatcher was a Devaronian male bounty hunter who was renowned during the Cold War and Galactic War, having assassinated a wide variety of targets. He led the mercenary group known as the Specialists on the planet Makeb, where the group was killed.
Cheiko Bes was a female Miraluka Jedi who served during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Specter-12 was the codename of a humanoid male who was rumored to be part of a government black-ops unit before joining the Specialists mercenary unit; Specter-12's training was unlike anything seen during the Galactic War.
Eleo Duboir was a wealthy male who died during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, leaving his wealth to his twin sons.

Kitster Banai was a human male who was enslaved and lived on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine during the Naboo Crisis. As a child, he befriended Anakin Skywalker—a fellow slave and podracing enthusiast.
Wald was a Rodian male who was enslaved and lived on Tatooine during the time of the Naboo Crisis. He was one of Anakin Skywalker's playmates in the Mos Espa Slave Quarters Row.

Glorificent was a Human female who, along with the Twi'lek Tsar'alla, was a slave dancer to the Hutt Suudaa Nem'ro during the Cold War. She often lounged at the foot of Nem'ro's seat in his palace, wearing a Huttese slave-girl costume and a shock collar.

Tsar'alla was a Twi'lek female who, along with the human Glorificent, was a slave dancer to the Hutt Suudaa Nem'ro during the Cold War. She often lounged at the foot of Nem'ro's seat in his palace, wearing a Huttese slave-girl costume and a shock collar.

The Ukunuku Night Herald was a Killik that held the position of Night Herald within the Ukunuku nest on the planet Alderaan during the Cold War. The Killik was killed in the Lanthanide mine in the Juran Mountains.
Obromius Menthaus was a male Human who lived on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Rutau was a male human who served as a lieutenant in the First Platoon of Besh Company in the Second Battalion, a unit in the Imperial Army's Fifth Infantry.

Thorpe was a male Human who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Army during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, when he was stationed on the planet Balmorra.

Latts Razzi was a female Theelin bounty hunter who operated during the Clone Wars. She occasionally worked as part of a syndicate of bounty hunters known as the Krayt's Claw that included Boba Fett, Bossk, Oked, C-21 Highsinger, and Dengar.
Nien Nunb or was a Sullustan male arms dealer and smuggler who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Kutri O'a was a male Bothan Jedi Master living during the Cold War and Galactic War.

The Sith Lord Terrak Morrhage studied under a female Sith Master on the planet Sigil. Morrhage's Sith Master was eventually tracked down and killed by the Jedi Order, and Morrhage swore vengeance upon the Jedi as a result.

Marida Sumar was a human female who lived with her husband Morad on a farm on Lothal in 4 BBY. The two were forced from their home by the Galactic Empire, who had originally wanted to buy it from them but, after Sumar refused the offer, destroyed it and took the couple prisoner.
Yoffar was a male Gotal who worked peddling jogan fruit on the planet Lothal during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign.
Marrok was a male anooba and close companion of the Kyuzo bounty hunter Embo during the Clone Wars, assisting him in his missions.
Ponds, designated CT-411, was a clone trooper officer who held the military rank of Clone Commander. Ponds was bred from the genetic template of the human bounty hunter Jango Fett.
Krismo Sodi was the leader of the Kage Warriors, a band of Kage combatants from the planet Quarzite who opposed the rule of the Belugan dictator Lord Otua Blank.

Castas was a male Klatooinian bounty hunter who worked with Aurra Sing, Bossk, and Boba Fett in a bounty hunter crew during the Clone Wars, helping Boba track down Jedi Master Mace Windu. He was later killed by Sing at a bar on Florrum.

Nahdar Vebb was a Mon Calamari male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order. He was trained to be a Jedi by the Nautolan Jedi Master Kit Fisto, although when Fisto was called elsewhere, Vebb was forced to complete his Jedi training on his own.
Noan Jeraddi was a captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served in the Tatooine Patrol.

Tepra Tseelit was a lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served in the Tatooine Patrol. Sometime during the Galactic Civil War, the Tatooine Patrol discovered Slave I, the personal starship of Boba Fett, abandoned geosynchronous orbit of the planet Tatooine.

Davik's agent was a male human member of the Exchange. He collected credits from those who either owed or just simply paid Davik Kang, a crime lord and long-time member of the Exchange. He worked as Kang's agent on the planet Taris.

Gendar's father was a Human who was sentenced to survive in the Undercity of Taris like his father before him. He led the village like his father did. He eventually had a son named Gendar, who succeeded him as leader.

Gendar's grandfather was a Human who was sentenced to survive in the Undercity of Taris. At some point, he became the village's leader. He was eventually succeeded by his son, who was later succeeded by his son, Gendar.
Leatherback was a male Weequay who lived on the planet Sriluur by the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. He was the owner of Leatherback's bar in Meirm City.
Ganodi was a female Rodian Jedi initiate during the Clone Wars. She attended a Gathering on Ilum, where, along with other Jedi initiates, she would find her lightsaber crystal in Ilum's Crystal Cave.

A male Yuuzhan Vong shaper was on the Baanu Rass in 27 ABY. He accompanied Nom Anor in the pursuit of the escaping voxyn queen. While trying to recapture the voxyn on an area of basal-comb, the shaper was killed by Jacen Solo.
Rune Haako was a male Neimoidian official who was a Settlement Officer of the Trade Federation and closely worked with Viceroy Nute Gunray as his lieutenant during the Invasion of Naboo.

Kandon's bodyguard was a Twi'lek member of the Black Vulkars on Taris and the bodyguard of Kandon Ark. She died when the Republic soldier Revan infiltrated the Black Vulkar Base in order to retrieve the Prototype accelerator for the Hidden Beks.

This Duros was the race announcer for the Tarisian Season Opener in 3956 BBY. He presented Revan as the winner of the swoop race after Revan bested the time of Redros, a member of the Black Vulkars gang in the Lower City.

Elloise Moru was the wife of Ren Moru, living on Rishi during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY the Nova Blades pirates enslaved Ren for his debt of 3,000 credits and forced him to mine exonium for the next two years.

Bric was a male Siniteen bounty hunter who, along with his partner, the Arcona bounty hunter El-Les, was contracted by the Galactic Republic to train clone cadets of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars after the death of Jango Fett.

Rush Clovis was a human male politician and baron from Scipio who became the leader of the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the final year of the Clone Wars. Once a member of the Galactic Republic, Clovis had represented the Banking Clan as a senator in the Galactic Senate.

Sila Kott was a rebel pilot who flew an A-wing as "Red Three" at the Battle of Endor. Kott was a human woman from the planet Toprawa who fell in love with Lante when they were teenage girls under the Galactic Empire's reign; to Kott's chagrin, their neighbors in Toprawa City o…
Arvel Crynyd was a male human pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Danry Ledwellow was a male Er'Kit who represented his species in the senate of the Galactic Republic some time before the Clone Wars.

In the years prior to the Battle of Yavin, the son of Imperial Navy Captain Hiram Zataire became an outspoken critic of the Galactic Empire, attracting the attention of the Imperial Security Bureau. The Empire attempted to locate him for years, while he lived on Alderaan.

Grizz Frix was a male human starfighter pilot who flew for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was recruited into the squadron after the Battle of Hoth and was killed during the Battle of Endor, where he flew under the callsign Red Five.

Ten Numb was a Sullustan male starfighter pilot that flew for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. During the Battle of Endor, he flew a B-wing starfighter under the callsign Blue Five.

The captain of a Republic frigate flagship commanded forces along with Revan at the Battle of Jaga's Cluster during the Mandalorian Wars. The Mandalorian Cassus Fett boarded the starship that held the captain and killed them in hand-to-hand combat, earning him much infamy.
Zona Dreon was a member of the Skakoan species.

Cutup, designated CT-4040 was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. A member of Domino Squad, Cutup was trained on the planet Kamino before being stationed on a listening post on the Rishi Moon.
Ketticus Brayl was a large individual who lived on the planet Gorse with his wife and children during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign.

The mother of the Transcept Media Solutions worker Zaluna Myder was a female Sullustan. Thirty-three years prior to the near destruction of the moon Cynda, she gave Myder a blaster, although her daughter had no reason to use the blaster until over three decades after it was gi…

Sugi was a female Zabrak bounty hunter who operated during the Clone Wars. She befriended the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano while protecting a farming village on Felucia from Hondo Ohnaka and his pirate gang.
Slyyth was a male Ruurian criminal who lived on the planet Lothal during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign.
The youngest daughter of Hiram Zataire was, like their father, a member of the Galactic Empire's naval forces.

A Jedi coordinator used Battle meditation to assist the Jedi and Republic retreat in the Battle of Mizra during the New Sith Wars. The Jedi was shot by a Sith sniper, turning the retreat into a full scale slaughter.

This Unidentified Sith sniper shot the Jedi coordinator in the Battle of Mizra during the New Sith Wars. This disrupted the Jedi's Battle meditation, turning the Jedi retreat into a full scale slaughter.
Doom was a Clone Commander who served Jedi Generals Tiplee and her sister Tiplar in the Battle of Ringo Vinda during the Clone Wars.
Dao was a human who held the rank of admiral within the naval branch of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Keeli was a clone trooper captain who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Under the command of Jedi General Ima-Gun Di, he led the Galactic Republic's Outer Rim garrison against the Confederacy of Independent Systems at the Battle of Ryloth in 22 BBY.
D'kar was a male resistance fighter who worked with Airen Cracken. Once, a group under Cracken's command, including D'kar, were captured by lizard men and held in the hold of a stock light freighter.
Briggs was a male resistance fighter who worked with Airen Cracken. Briggs and several others under Cracken's command were imprisoned in the hold of a light freighter by lizard men.

Teemto Pagalies was a Veknoid podracer pilot from Moonus Mandel. An outcast of his homeworld, Pagalies found fame as a podracer, and eventually went on to compete in a Boonta Eve Classic Podrace on the planet Tatooine.
Cev Rees was a child who once accompanied the bounty hunter Thannik, his protocol droid GT-9R, the outlaw Dirk Harkness, and a pilot named Rhen to the Dancing Dewback cantina.
Davu Golec was a Mandalorian human who lived on the planet Coruscant and worked in the Republic's Ministry of Intelligence during the Clone Wars.

Chata Hyoki was a male Selkath from the aquatic planet of Manaan. During the Clone Wars, Hyoki, along with fellow bounty hunter Robonino, was hired by Count Dooku to intimidate various senators into changing their votes on a Senate bill.

Robonino was a male Patrolian bounty hunter who was active during the Clone Wars, performing several jobs at the expense of the Galactic Republic on Coruscant. He teamed up with Cad Bane, Shahan Alama, and Aurra Sing during the Senate hostage crisis.
Mee Deechi was an Umbaran male who represented the planet Umbara in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars as a member of the Umbaran government.
Ben Quadinaros was an inexperienced Toong podracer pilot who raced on the amateur circuits before entering the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.

Dogh Staya was a male New Republic diplomat. After the death of Senator Jonas Stern on a diplomatic mission to Sluis Van in 6 ABY, Chief of State Mon Mothma appointed Staya to replace Stern as her special envoy.

An Arkanian doctor worked in a medical facility in the city of Adascopolis on the planet Arkania. The doctor was given a blood sample by Jarael, a disguised Arkanian Offshoot—a genetically-altered Arkanian sub-species not allowed in the harshly-segregated city—and was instruct…

Savatte was a Bardottan male and a guard for Queen Julia of the planet Bardotta. After Julia was kidnapped by members of the Frangawl Cult, led by the turncoat High Seneschal Peteen, Savatte, Jedi Master Mace Windu, and Junior Representative Jar Jar Binks, attempted a rescue o…

The Daughter also known as the Winged Goddess was a female Force wielder native to the ethereal world of Mortis. Like her family, the Father and the Son, the Daughter were of a species called Force wielders, who possessed a unique connection to the Force.

Drayson was a female Nautolan who served as a commander in the Republic Military during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. She was one of the commanders during the Korriban Incursion, and was slain by Imperial forces.
Pong Krell was a Besalisk male Jedi Master who, during the Clone Wars, served as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Coleman Trebor was a male Vurk Jedi Master who served as a member of the Jedi High Council before the Clone Wars.
Xarovit Tovar was a male Sith Lord and Imperial Guardsman in service to the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Apailana was a human female monarch who served as the Queen of Naboo during the final days of the Clone Wars and the early days of the Galactic Empire. She was one of the youngest rulers to be elected by the Naboo, succeeding Neeyutnee at the age of twelve.
Tanis Venn's friend was a smuggler who crossed Sith space and got stripped of all their gear. Tanis Venn was a friend who told Revan about them.
This unidentified Jedi tried to make peace between Czerka Corporation and a Tusken Raider tribe before Revan's attempt, but it ended in blood.
Kix, originally designated CT-6116, was a relic clone medic who once served in the Grand Army of the Republic's 501st Legion under the command of Jedi General Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars.

Warthog was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Galactic Republic's 104th Battalion under Jedi Master Plo Koon during the Clone Wars. Throughout the war, Warthog took part in many conflicts and was a veteran pilot.

Barton Coburn was a human male officer who held the rank of admiral in the Galactic Republic Navy. He commanded a task force during the Battle of Lola Sayu and later helmed the Arquitens-class light cruiser Hand of Justice during the Battle of Kadavo.

Jo-Ahn was a female Human Jedi Padawan who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's time of attendance there. She occasionally joined Cronah and Cyrus in bullying other students. Though she enjoyed picking on Roan, she was also rather quiet and rarely spoke.

A human male served the Galactic Empire as a chief petty officer during the early years of its reign. In 14 BBY, she served onboard the Carrion Spike, the personal ship of Governor Wilhuff Tarkin, during a journey from the Imperial construction project Sentinel Base to the pla…

Q'anah was the assumed name used by a female human who led the Senex-Juvex pirate group known as Q'anah's Marauders. The daughter of a former bodyguard, she fell in love with a young noble from House Elegin of the planet Asmeru and joined the pirate crew he secretly led.
Melos was a Devaronian pirate who was hunted down on Ord Mantell by the bounty hunters Koshka Frost, Viktor Hel and "Doctor" Krandak.
Azmorigan was a male Jablogian who was a criminal leader operating in the Outer Rim Territories about four years before the Battle of Yavin.
Katooni was a female Tholothian Jedi youngling who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

A male human native to the Core Worlds planet Brentaal IV was the father of a single daughter. He worked as a bodyguard for House Cormond on his homeworld, but left their service after he accepted a lucrative offer to oversee security for House Elegin of the planet Asmeru.
The youngest son of House Elegin on the planet Asmeru lived a double life as the head of a pirate crew during the final decades of the Galactic Republic's existence.
Lo-Taren was a Trandoshan male and a member of a Trandoshan-exclusive hunting guild specializing in the hunting of other sentient beings.
A pilot competed in Podraces for Team Watto, a Podracing team, during the final years of the Galactic Republic. During the pilot's tenure, they had made friends with fellow pilot Clegg Holdfast.
Aggadeen was a male human who served as an officer in the Galactic Empire. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, he acted as the Imperial Overseer of Weapons Factory Alpha on Cymoon 1.
One of five mysterious beings called as the Force Priestesses, Serenity was a female being that lived on a mystical planet, known as the Wellspring of Life, at the center of the galaxy.

This Unidentified Czerka Corporation warehouse manager managed a Czerka warehouse and was a friend of Ithorian Yuka Laka. The manager got into debt and sold HK-47 from the warehouse to Yuka claiming that "no-one would miss it".

Kwilaan was a male human who lived long before the Clone Wars. He led a group of human colonists from the planet Grizmallt, helping them settle on Naboo. The Naboo calendar used a notation system named after him.
Reskell Twane was an Imperial official who served as Trioculus' predecessor as Lord Overseer of the Spice Mines of Kessel. Prior to becoming Lord Overseer, he was in the service of Jabba the Hutt.
Jeter Snahl was a member of the Followers of Palawa. A hermit, Snahl resided on Bunduki, where he guarded the secrets of the Way of the Warrior.
Katuunko was the King of the planet Toydaria and the Toydarian species during the Clone Wars, born before 54 BBY.
Dugge was a Human male pirate who was a captain in the Death's Claw operating on Taris during the Cold War.

A Human male was the commander of the Imperial Listening Post on the planet Ord Mantell during the Separatist War. The commander was among the Imperial casualties when the facility was raided by a young Jedi Knight.
Nomma was a diminutive and heavily-jowled near-human male who served the Tarkin family in their home on the planet Eriadu during the childhood of Wilhuff Tarkin.
Garnac was a Trandoshan male big game hunter who ran a hunting guild comprised of other Trandoshans, including his son Dar.
Therbon was an individual who served the Galactic Empire as a Moff during the early years of its reign.
Lord was the alpha male of a troop of Eriadu veermok which inhabited an area of the Carrion Plateau region of the planet Eriadu that centered around the hill known as the Carrion Spike.
Dassa Borkannits was the Director of Communications for the Jrade District of the Galactic City on the planet Coruscant.

Beena was a male Rodian smuggler who became infamous for refusing to land while dropping off goods; instead, he would attach homing beacons to cargo containers and drop them out of the airlock after sending his clients a tracking frequency.
Targob Tunall was a male Zabrak smuggler who became famous for only accepting contracts for delivering food, medicine, and propaganda holovids to star systems ruled by tyrants and madmen.

A clone trooper and officer in the Grand Army of the Republic was present during the Battle of Thustra and was discussing strategy with Jedi Masters Tyr and a Tyffix inside the Republic command center when a suicide bomber destroyed the command tent and killed most present, in…
An Imperial worked on the moon Cymoon 1 and was in charge of several slaves who helped keep Weapons Factory Alpha running day and night.

A Czerka Corporation mining team was operated on a sandcrawler on Tatooine and was lead by a captain. Sand People attacked the sandcrawler, immobilizing it and sending multiple waves of Tuskens to finish them off. However Revan intervened and defended the mining team.

Marlena Venn's mother birthed a daughter named Marlena who married Tanis Venn against her mother's warnings. Marlena later programed Tanis's K-X12 probe droids to surround him and explode if he got too close. Marlena left a message mentioning her mother inside the droids.
A human male served Governor Wilhuff Tarkin as an adjutant during the Governor's time as commander of Sentinel Base.
This canyon krayt dragon lived in the Eastern Dune Sea in the Rakatan Ruins on Tatooine. It was killed by Komad Fortuna and Revan by luring it towards banthas and exploding it with mines.

Bay-Yon Siu was a Human male Jedi of the Sanej Temple whose personality was embedded in a holocron. The holocron ended up in the Tularan Marsh of Taris by the time of the Cold War, when Siu began teaching the nekghouls the ways of the Force.
Raimu was a female Zabrak Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire.

Tre Timbal was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire. Timbal, Kirbi, Luquena, and another Jedi attempted to investigate a rakghoul warren on Taris, but they were killed by nekghouls.

Luquena was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the reconstituted Sith Empire. Luquena, Kirbi, Tre Trimbal, and another Jedi attempted to investigate a rakghoul warren on Taris, but they were killed by nekghouls.

Kirbi was a Human female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War against the resurgent Sith Empire. On Taris, Kirbi and a team of Jedi attempted to find a way to reverse the rakghoul plague, but were killed by nekghouls.

Ferreges was a Human female assassin hired by the Galactic Empire to kill the miners Hanos Darr and Zaz Kamiroz. She was a tall, blonde woman with exotic features and was totally ruthless and unemotional.
Heltiss was an Ithorian doctor who ran the medical center in Isttu Village aboard the Ithorian Herdship Bazaar. Heltiss was considered to be one of the finest physicians from Ithor.
Leww was the male shopkeeper of a male clothing store located in Isttu Village aboard the Ithorian Herdship Bazaar during the Galactic Civil War.
Enger Mowen was a male Human who ran the Imperial Recruitment Center in Isttu Village aboard the Ithorian Herdship Bazaar during the Galactic Civil War.
Kapin Toologin was a male Twi'lek insurance salesman. While on holiday aboard the Ithorian Herdship Bazaar, rumors circulated that he was really a powerful crime lord.
Visfuu was a female Ithorian who ran a shop selling data books in Isttu Village aboard the Ithorian Herdship Bazaar. She enjoyed talking with her customers.
Lazlo was a Human male lieutenant in the Republic Navy who served aboard the Carida during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Raynod Menar was a male Human criminal who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Maris Csayni was a Human female agent of Imperial Intelligence during the Galactic War.
Yale Karlsen was a male captain in the Imperial Navy who commanded the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Ultimatum during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Garblaque was a Hutt businessman who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Prakkath was a Devaronian male leader of the Migrant Merchants' Guild on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War. When Senator Vanara Kayl reneged on a deal she had made with the guild, Prakkath met with her in an attempt to convince her to honor their agreement, but it failed.

Deena Riss was a human female agent of the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, when she worked to track down the notorious spymaster known as the Shroud.
Tyrus was a Human male who served as a major in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire, commanding the Fifth Infantry's Second Battalion.

Keresha Yald was a Human female Sith Warrior of the Sith Empire who was stationed on the planet Hoth during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. She occasionally shared her knowledge with other Sith as a combat instructor.

Milen Rort was a Human male agent of Imperial Intelligence who was stationed on the planet Hoth during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. Rort often shared his knowledge with his fellow agents as a combat instructor.
Camrov was a soldier in the Republic Military who joined the Order of Revan along with Mochiri and Orton during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Mochiri was a soldier in the Republic Military who joined the Order of Revan along with Camrov and Orton during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Orton was a soldier in the Republic Military who joined the Order of Revan along with Mochiri and Camrov during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Boushh was a male Ubese from Uba IV who worked as a bounty hunter. Following his little-known demise at the hands of the Black Sun crime syndicate, Princess Leia Organa impersonated him in order to infiltrate Jabba's Palace and free Han Solo.

Balluzikik was a male Barabel bounty hunter and the mate of Slizzik. He was part of the bounty hunter crew formed by the Taloron Hunter Crutag that chased a team of Alliance to Restore the Republic operatives to the planet Trinta.
Krigg was a major in the Imperial Military who joined the Order of Revan on the planet Rishi during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Sorven was a captain in the Imperial Military who joined the Order of Revan on the planet Rishi during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
She Who Greedily Devours was the name given by the Rishii natives of Sky Ridge Island on the planet Rishi to the female kell dragon that settled on their island.
Iri-Do Sahn was a male bounty hunter who competed in the Great Hunt in 3643 BBY. He was disqualified in his sleep, and his competition successfully completed the bounty on Duke Corwin.

Vallis was a Jedi Master who visited the Outer Rim planet of Voss long before the planet's rediscovery during the Cold War. Vallis was memorialized by a shrine in the area later known as the Nightmare Lands.
The mother of Spirakris Zarem was a Human female who served as a Senator in the Galactic Senate Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Barada was a Klatooinian who served the crime lord Jabba the Hutt before 1 BBY, and would continue to serve Jabba up to four years after the Battle of Yavin.

Era Jung was a female sergeant of the Galactic Republic. By 3637 BBY she served in the Viridian Squad under Major Tso, who said on several occasions that a girl from a rich family like Jung was unfit to lead his men.
Lokaibus was a Hutt living during the Galactic War, who ran a series of beast combat rings called the Slavering Arenas.

Kaya was a Human female smuggler operating during the Galactic War. In 3637 BBY, she was part of a crew that made a run to the planet Rakata Prime, and was the only survivor after they were attacked by the native Rakata.

Nerril was a Human male captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Answering to Moff Altiss, he provided reconnaissance support for the Imperial forces during the Battle of Denova.
