Dennik was a Human male captain of the Republic Army living during the Galactic War. Part of the Republic forces deployed to the planet Denova, he assisted the Republic forces in the fighting against Kephess's renegade forces.

Kassor Quade was a male Kaleesh Mandalorian chieftain of Clan Sharratt during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, Quade issued a call for those willing to test their strength against Clan Sharatt's warriors when their Clan were testing a new Imperial combat adrenal, sending threats to …
John D. Branon was a young human rebel pilot who was a member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Cassel was a human male officer serving in Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy, holding the rank of commander.

Jakoli was a male Rodian bounty hunter who was known for never sparing his prey from death. In order to ensure success in the field of bounty hunting, Jakoli felt that it was only necessary to kill his targets.
Mantu was a Selkath bounty hunter from the planet Manaan. He was one of his species' greatest legends, which was not a good thing when concerning the nature of his people.

Charde was a male politician who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Charde hired the male Nikto bounty hunter named Soris with assassinating his political rival, a male Otolla Gungan named Nalskel, of the Imperial …

A Rodian male worked for the Rodian crime lord Reelo Baruk during the year 12 ABY. A bounty hunter, he also served as a bouncer for one of Baruk's cantinas. At some point, the cantina was visited by the New Republic agent and Jedi Kyle Katarn, who was searching for Baruk.
Shann Childsen was a male human who served as a lieutenant in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire's army during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Sixtat, also known as the "Outlands Butcher," was a vicious Sakiyan bounty hunter who operated during the Clone Wars. Sixtat earned his title from the violent methods he employed against his prey, which led to their deaths.
A Human male member of House Organa, one of the Great Houses of the planet Alderaan, attended the War Summit in 3643 BBY as the delegate representing his house.
A Human female member of House Alde, one of the Great Houses of the planet Alderaan, attended the Alderaan Peace Summit in 3643 BBY as the delegate representing her house.

A Human male member of the noble House Alde was murdered around 3663 BBY. During the Alderaan Peace Summit twenty years later, Sidonie Garen falsely accused one of the delegates of the murder, enraging the Alde delegate, the victim's sister.
A Human male member of House Baliss, one of the Great Houses of the planet Alderaan, attended the War Summit in 3643 BBY as the delegate representing his house.
A Human male member of House Cortess, one of the Great Houses of the planet Alderaan, attended the War Summit in 3643 BBY as the delegate representing his house.
A Human male member of House Rist, one of the Great Houses of the planet Alderaan, attended the Alderaan Peace Summit in 3643 BBY as the delegate representing his house.
A Human male member of House Ulgo, one of the Great Houses of the planet Alderaan, attended the Alderaan Peace Summit in 3643 BBY as the delegate representing his house.
A Human male member of House Thul, one of the Great Houses of the planet Alderaan, attended the War Summit in 3643 BBY as the delegate representing his house.

Scorch, also identified as RC-1262, was a clone commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars and in the Galactic Empire's Project War-Mantle and Advanced Science Division with the military rank of Clone Commander.

This Rebel fought during an attack on the Imperial Star Destroyer Vehemence as Rebel Alliance flight leader Wilkins' gunner. Wilkins' BTL Y-wing starfighter started an ion cannon attack run on the Vehemence, during which the pilot was blinded in an explosion.

Sparky was an huge exoboar owned by the Ravagers, a pirate gang based on Rishi. Sparky had a large litter of young exoboars—Dinner, Duke, Grappa, Jwizzix'Xthor, Nerf, North, Precious, Scrapp, Tank, The Boss, Voguz, Deshy Little Pirate, Spike, Mu Na Ya, and Tenebro—that guarded…

Trainer was a muscular Human who was alive by the year 5 ABY, during the reign of the New Republic. Trainer had brown hair, gray eyes, and light colored skin. They carried a lightsaber with a blue blade and a Bryar pistol.

Chong was a Sugi male who worked for the arms dealer Endente during the Clone Wars conflict. During the latter part of the war, the arms dealers had plans to sell a massive kyber crystal to the Confederacy of Independent Systems on the planet Utapau.

Blue Two was the call-sign for a Trandoshan stormtrooper who served the Fel Empire and the Galactic Federation Triumvirate in 139 ABY. He was loyal to Empress Marasiah Fel and wore an orange pauldron on his stormtrooper armor.

Sistros Nevet was a female member of the Four Sages of Dwartii, ancient lawgivers from the dawn of the Galactic Republic. Sistros was involved in the formation of the Republic's original constitution.

Coleman Kcaj was an Ongree male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Kcaj gained a seat on the Jedi High Council and then survived for years during the Great Jedi Purge.

A High Priest of Dim-U was a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild during Cradossk's tenure as guildmaster. Ro-San Borokki, the Guild's Director of Training, praised both his use of a crossbow and his ability to convince fellow religious beings to turn themselves in.

Cut Lawquane was a clone trooper who fought for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Shortly after the First Battle of Geonosis, Lawquane's transport was attacked by Separatist gunships, leaving his fellow soldiers either dead or injured.
Din Suub was a male Sullustan ensign of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY he served in the V'buk Squadron among his fellow Sullustans during the Battle of Ilum.

Yarael Poof was a Quermian Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council during the High Republic Era through the final years of the Galactic Republic. He was both an expert practitioner of Jedi mind tricks and illusions and a skilled diplomat and teacher.
Nuvo Vindi was a brilliant yet insane male Faust scientist who was employed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Dak Haron was a male diplomat of the Imperial Diplomatic Service. During the Galactic War he was quite successful in convincing the unaligned Outer Rim systems into joining the Sith Empire.
Salus-Mok was a Voss Mystic living on Voss during the Galactic War. They had a vision of Gormak logging machines threatening the Voss, which could be destroyed only by outsiders.

Garindan ezz Zavor, sometimes referred to as Long Snoot, was a male Kubaz who had been forced to work as a spy for the Galactic Empire. In private, Garindan loathed his Imperial overlords and sought to return to his clan and free his homeworld of Kubindi from Imperial rule.
Galus Vez was a Besalisk starship parts dealer who owned the space outpost Osisis Station during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Sykar was the Imperial governor in charge of the planet Celanon during the Galactic Civil War.

Meena Tills, a Mon Calamari female, was the Galactic Republic senator from Mon Cala. She served with Tundra Dowmeia as Mon Cala's delegate to the Galactic Senate. By the end of the Clone Wars, Tills was part of the Delegation of 2,000 and signed the Petition of 2,000.

Garrum was a male Human who was serving in the Galactic Republic's SpecForce in the year 3643 BBY. During that year, he was observing the Migrant Merchants' Guild on the planet Coruscant and was assigned by General Garza to give Havoc Squad a mission to neutralize a cyborg inv…
Krel was a male Human cyborg who was working for the Migrant Merchants' Guild on the planet Coruscant during the year 3643 BBY.

Helik was a Nautolan male diplomat from Aquella. His King Lorro was one of several heads of state summoned by the Imperial General Arkos Rakton to a diplomatic summit on Outpost 256, where Rakton seized the heads of state by force.
Vin Feal was a Human male free-trader who operated the 3-Z light freighter The Black Butcher.
Burnal Terrup was a male Devaronian who was second-in-command of the Void Demons pirate gang.
Gezzov-tak was an Arconan male who crewed aboard the freighter Isilia under Captain Adriav Kavos.
Segken Tels was a Quarren female who crewed aboard the freighter Isilia under Captain Adriav Kavos.

Barel-Slathborn was a male Sith Lord of the old Sith Empire who was among the first inhabitants of the planet Dromund Kaas. After his death, Barel-Slathborn's spirit was trapped within the Dark Temple, and it possessed Commander Gargun when the man entered the temple.
Deddo was a Chiss male agent of Imperial Intelligence during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.
Fa'ann was a male Sith Pureblood who was a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War against the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.

Krrsantan, also known as Black Krrsantan, and nicknamed "Santy," "BK," and "Black K" by Doctor Aphra and "Santo" by Garsa Fwip and Boba Fett, was a male Wookiee bounty hunter whose career spanned from during the rule of the Galactic Empire into the era of the New Republic.
Gaylan Della was a male agent of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Letta Turmond was a human female inhabitant of the planet Coruscant. Married to Abyssin Jackar Bowmani, Turmond was an activist who protested against the Jedi Order's participation as military officers for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, holding radical beliefs in…
Tomota was a male Bith who was a member of the Corellian Run Scoundrels, a pirate gang. Tomota was the second in command of Kai Zykken, the leader of the Rishi chapter of the Scoundrels.

Enos Ozzel was a scion of the Ozzel family, and an ancestor to Kendal Ozzel, an officer of the Galactic Empire. He was reputed to have pushed the Cold Coil back into the Unknown Regions during the early Manderon Period.

Ruthbert Ozzel was an officer who served in the Republic Navy during the Waymancy Storm. During the conflict, they earned the sobriquet "the Savior of Mittoblade". A scion of the Ozzel family, they were a distant ancestor of Kendal Ozzel, a captain in the Galactic Empire.

Mak Tennar was a commander within the 501st Legion. He wrote a brief statement about the 501st Legion explaining its functions in the Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide. His printed statement also acted as one of the few official sources available about Operation: Knightfall.
Arok was a male Hutt that led Besadii kajidic of the Five Hutt families and their crime syndicate during the Clone Wars, along with Jabba, Gorga, Oruba, and Marlo.

Marlo was a male Hutt born around 997 BBY that sat on the Grand Hutt Council, the leading governing body of the Hutt Clan on Hutta, during the Clone Wars, along with Jabba, Gorga, Arok, and Oruba. He was also a dealer in Zygerria's slave market.

Gardulla Besadii the Elder was a female Besadii Hutt of the Hutt Clan prior to and during the Clone Wars. Prior to the Clone Wars, Gardulla was the owner of Shmi and Anakin Skywalker, but lost them to Watto in a bet.
Dal Quirz was a female Kadrillian scientist whom Darth Vader forced to cultivate kunda crystals on the planet Kadril.
Rodno was a male Kadrillian who served as a guide for Rebels Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa on the planet Kadril. The Rebels helped reunite Rodno with his lover, Deerna.
Deerna was the female lover of Rodno at the time of Darth Vader attempt to conquer Kadril in 1 ABY.
The Father was a powerful Force wielder who resided in the realm of Mortis. His children, the Daughter and the Son, represented the light side and the dark side of the Force, respectively.
Padyn was the son of Bea and Madel Wharen.

A Jedi Knight referred the young Human Zayne Carrick to the Jedi Enclave on the planet Dantooine in 3977 BBY. The Jedi Knight said that Carrick had "marginal" aptitude for the Force, an assertion supported by Jedi Master Vandar Tokare.

334.556/G7 was the designation of a Commander serving the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. The commander was ordered to attack and hold the village called Chakton with a force of foot soldiers, although mechanized reinforcements were available.
Thickston Deke was a commander serving in the Alliance Military during the Galactic Civil War. Deke had orders to ambush and destroy the Imperial troops intent on capturing the village of Chakton.
Lylos Tannon was a female Twi'lek who worked on the planet Coruscant as a police officer in the Coruscant Security Force during the period of the Galactic War.
Faazah was a Sugi crime lord and smuggler based on the planet Murkhana during the Imperial Era. He was a one-time ally of the Sith Lord Darth Vader, who eliminated his Black Sun predecessor.
BN-749 was the designation of a human male stormtrooper who served in the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps on the planet Lothal.

Bolgm was a male Houk living on the planet Coruscant during the period of the Galactic War. Together with Doctor Zeke, Bolgm worked a scam where he would grab individuals with cybernetics and notify Doctor Zeke who would remove them and then sell the cybernetics on the black m…

Jorus was a male Human pilot who was a flight commander in the Imperial Navy of the Sith Empire. During the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic, Jorus was killed while fighting near the Balmorran Arms Factory on the planet Balmorra.

Chanigresh was a male member of the Imperial Guard, the protectors of the Sith Emperor, who was also a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Imperial forces during the invasion of Belsavis.

Toreshi Xach was a male member of the Imperial Guard, the protectors of the Sith Emperor, who was also a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Imperial forces during the fighting on Hoth in the Galactic War.

Doshcra Vael was a male member of the Imperial Guard, the protectors of the Sith Emperor, who was also a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Imperial forces during the Battle of Corellia in the Galactic War.
Sendesh Xaq was a male member of the Imperial Guard, the protectors of the Sith Emperor, who was also a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Xheoch Den was a male member of the Imperial Guard, the protectors of the Sith Emperor, who was also a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Imperial forces on the planet Alderaan.

Feldrax Kar was a male member of the Imperial Guard, the protectors of the Sith Emperor, who was also a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Imperial forces during the Battle of Ilum.

Djanistak was a male member of the Imperial Guard, the protectors of the Sith Emperor, who was also a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Imperial forces on the planet Tatooine.

Xoc'dal was a male member of the Imperial Guard, the protectors of the Sith Emperor, who was also a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Imperial forces during the Quesh war in the Galactic War.

Utnesi Wesk was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Republic forces on the planet Tatooine.

Rorkys Hesh was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Republic forces on the planet Hoth.

Sarissa Ven was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, she was one of the commanders of the Republic forces during the Battle of Ilum.

Reodan Qan was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Republic forces on the planet Alderaan.

Talena Ancia was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, she was one of the commanders of the Republic forces on the planet Voss.

Qella'tak was a male Twi'lek Jedi Master of the Green Jedi during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Republic forces during the Battle of Corellia.

Aron Onstall was an ace pilot who flew during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Onstall later served the Galactic Empire, but defected to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Karka Vriskar was a Bothan explorer and a member of Clan Askar. In the year 200 BBY, Vriskar was the first off-worlder to discover the planet Dressel, home of the sentient Dressellian species.

A Klatooinian crew member served aboard the spacer Ramid's starship in 139 ABY. That year, the Klatoonian took part in the successful kidnapping of Ania Solo, Ramid's estranged former lover who was wanted by the Galactic Federation Triumvirate for the alleged murder of the Imp…

Ean was a lieutenant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire who was stationed on Balmorra. After Lieutenant Major Pirrell was killed, Ean was tasked with clearing out Pirrell's office and slated ODX-9, Pirrell's secretary, for a memory wipe.
The aunt of Moff Tyrak was a Human female member of the Tyrak lineage. Tyrak's aunt married her uncle, Tyrak's grandfather, continuing the tradition of incestuous marriages in the family.
The grandfather of Moff Tyrak was a Human male member of the Tyrak lineage. Tyrak's grandfather married his niece, Tyrak's aunt, continuing the tradition of incestuous marriages in the family.

The father of Moff Tyrak was a Human male member of the Tyrak lineage. Tyrak's father married a woman who was also a member of the family—his first cousin either once or twice removed—and the two had a son, Tyrak, together.

The mother of Moff Tyrak was a Human female member of the Tyrak lineage. Tyrak's mother married a man who was also a member of the family—her first cousin either once or twice removed—and the two had a son, Tyrak, together.
Illor Ptoc was the Imperial governor of the planet Demophon. He ruled with an iron fist, and prided himself on the low crime rate and the high productivity of Demophon's citizens.

Daria Kellner was a tall, thin Human woman. She was an associate of Thadius Black on Demophon during the Galactic Civil War, where she helped smuggle political prisoners away from the Galactic Empire.
Joren Hunt was a Human male. He was an associate of Thadius Black on Demophon during the Galactic Civil War, where he helped smuggle political prisoners away from the Galactic Empire.

Vernuss was a Sullustan male who favored bright, tacky clothing. He was an associate of Thadius Black on Demophon during the Galactic Civil War, where he helped smuggle political prisoners away from the Galactic Empire.

He led an ISB team that arrested Thadius Black, Daria Kellner, Joren Hunt, and Vernuss, but a group of Black's associates escaped with the political prisoners Black was attempting to smuggle out of the Galactic Empire.
Thadius Black was a Human male living on Demophon during the Galactic Civil War. He was late middle-aged and directed a droid components firm.

Artel was a lieutenant in the Imperial Security Bureau, serving in the Enforcement branch. Artel served under Captain Wallace Fisk on the planet Demophon during the Galactic Civil War, and participated in the arrest of Thadius Black and his associates.

Donson was a lieutenant in the Imperial Security Bureau, and was part of the Enforcement branch. Donson served under Captain Wallace Fisk on the planet Demophon during the Galactic Civil War, and participated in the arrest of Thadius Black and his associates.
Jez was a male archaeologist on the planet Dromund Kaas who was among those sent to dig up artifacts near the Dark Temple.

Kymber Black was a young Human woman living on Demophon during the Galactic Civil War. She was married to Thadius Black. When Thadius Black arranged to smuggle political prisoners off world during the Galactic Civil War, he smuggled Kymber Black and their infant son out as well.
Perth was the father of Thadius Black, and father-in-law of Kymber Black. When Thadius Black smuggled political prisoners away from Demophon, Perth received them on the nearby planet of Mowgle.

The Nightmare Pilgrim was a male Gormak who was corrupted by the Nightmare Lands and became extremely powerful, returning to the nearby Gormak Lands. He commanded a massive creature known as the Thing from the Stars, which resembled a Tarsarian devourer.
Mazzoney was a large, dark-skinned, and very muscular four-armed humanoid over two meters tall. In addition to being the owner of Mazzoney's, Mazzoney often sold information for a price.
Bartell Issk was a sewer technician in Selkren on the planet Demophon. He was middle-aged, and spent some of his time in Mazzoney's cantina.
Kirana Zar was a female Human bounty hunter who was active during the Galactic War. She could often be found on Vaiken Spacedock, selling gear to other hunters.
Tal was a female Human quartermaster and agent of Imperial Intelligence who was active during the Galactic War. She could often be found on Vaiken Spacedock, selling gear to other agents.

Thanar was a Human male who served as a captain in the Imperial Navy of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock, where he dispensed gear to soldiers and other agents of the Empire.

Smythe was a Human male who served as a corporal in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock, where he dispensed gear to soldiers and other agents of the Empire.

Brukes was a Human female who served as an ensign in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. She was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock, where she dispensed starship upgrades to agents of the Empire.
Tanij was a Human male who served as a captain and pilot in the Imperial Navy of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

Emmens was a Human male officer in the Imperial Diplomatic Service of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, he was stationed at the Imperial base camp.

Tunms was a Human male who served as an officer in the Imperial Reclamation Service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on the Imperial space station Vaiken Spacedock.

Merish Alze was a Human female who served as an officer in the Imperial Reclamation Service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, she was stationed in the Imperial base camp.

Sehn Baroule was the director of Premier Provisions, a small ranch on Sprawl 34 of the planet Tyed Kant. Secretly he was also a rebel agent, operating a hidden listening post to spy on the Galactic Empire.

Xun Garret was the Imperial overseer of Tyed Kant. Under his administration there was a planet-wide ban on energy weapons, made necessary by Tyed Kant's volatile atmosphere, and military assistance given to nearby Demophon during its evacuation due to an impending supernova.
Faerz Waleth was the manager of Sprawl 41, a Nebula Consumables-owned floating ranch on the planet Tyed Kant. He was a friend of Sehn Baroule, CEO of rival company Premier Provisions.
J'Quille was a Whiphid male from the planet Toola. During the Galactic Civil War, he worked as a bounty hunter for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine.
Rel Rogock was a Human male miner who lived on Lok during the Galactic Civil War.
Sango Rond was a Human male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Ryek Lauhsin was the second-in-command of Corazon Industries during the Galactic Civil War. He had held that position for almost twenty years, first under Rigis Corazon, then under his daughter Sabel Axis Corazon.

Echo, formerly designated CT-1409 and known as the Hero of Anaxes, was a genetically defective human male clone trooper, veteran Clone Corporal, and former Advanced Recon Commando of the elite 501st Legion.

Tsalesh was a male Selkath private, from the planet Manaan. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire, Tsalesh was part of the Rift Alliance Coalition Forces and stationed on the planet Hoth.
Jaspar Skeete was the City Governor of D'larah during the Galactic Civil War, appointed by the Galactic Empire from a candidate pool of the city residents.
Cradjius Lucern was the owner of Marqo's, which he turned into a casino and cantina. He took over from the former owner when his predecessor fled the Demophon system's imminent supernova.
Jhonterius was the founder of the city of D'larah on the planet Demophon. During the Galactic Civil War a mysterious figure frequenting Jhonterius Park claimed to be his ghost.

Lucius Flint was a Captain in the D'larah City Patrol during the Galactic Civil War. When the impending supernova in the Demophon system was announced, Flint compromised his principles and allied with the G'uotr Network.

Elena Ray, also known as Black Manta due to her corporate battle tactics, was head of Research and Development at Shankti Drive Works during the Galactic Civil War. She was also secretly the leader of the G'uotr Network, a criminal black market.
The Ghost of Jhonterius Park, who claimed to be the spirit of Jhonterius, was a mysterious, dark-robed figure who appeared in Jhonterius Park during the Galactic Civil War.

Altadan Igar was a human male who served in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army as a commander of an shield bunker on the moon Endor. In 4 ABY, the Jedi Luke Skywalker surrendered himself to Igar shortly before the Battle of Endor.

Andus Urshant was a hyperdrive research technician with Shankti Drive Works in the city of D'larah on the planet Demophon during the Galactic Civil War. He was married to Zoam Urshant, and was the father of Aklan Urshant and Fianna Urshant.

Choaaty Mossk was an agent of the G'uotr Network in the city of D'larah on the planet Demophon during the Galactic Civil War. He was a burly, bearded man with a long criminal record and a tendency to disobey the orders of his superiors in the Network.
Zoam Urshant was a programmer assigned to Tumleh Navigation's NGW Hyperdrive Jump Program. She lived in the city of D'larah on the planet Demophon during the Galactic Civil War.

Aklan Urshant was the son of Andus Urshant and Zoam Urshant. He was eight years old when his family evacuated Demophon before its sun went supernova. During this time he wanted to be a stormtrooper when he grew up.

Fianna Urshant was the daughter of Andus Urshant and Zoam Urshant. She was six years old when her family evacuated Demophon before its sun went supernova. During this time she wanted to be a princess when she grew up.

Currahee was a female human sergeant in the Galactic Empire. During his time at Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials, Zare Leonis came into conflict with this lieutenant, who seemed determined to push him to his breaking point.
Merei Spanjaf was a human female and the girlfriend of Zare Leonis. She was tech-savvy, and she used her abilities to help Leonis uncover the truth about his missing sister Dhara Leonis.
Sarkos was an Assistant Vice Minister in the Galactic Empire's Ministry of Agriculture on Lothal, a woman with a rail-thin appearance.

Fixer, also identified by the number RC-1140, was an elite clone commando of the Galactic Republic who served as the second-in-command of Delta Squad, a special forces unit within the Grand Army of the Republic that was active during the Clone Wars.

Charko was a male Chagrian who led a gang of criminals known as the Sarlaccs on the planet Gorse. On several occasions the criminal unsuccessfully attempted to rob the pilot Kanan Jarrus, who broke the Chagrian's horn on the third attempt.

Tarlor Choh was a tall, light-skinned, male Muun who worked for the company Dalborg Mining five years before the Battle of Yavin. Choh served as the companies foreman in Zone Thirty-Nine, an area of the moon Cynda where Thorilide was mined.

Drakka was a male Besalisk who owned and worked as a chef in a diner on the planet Gorse. His skill at cooking kept the business going for several years, as did his strength, which scared away criminals like the Chagrian Charko.
Dael Margok, often referred to simply by the honorific Commodore, was a male Zabrak mercenary and criminal who worked as the commander of the Nova Blades pirate gang during the Galactic War.

Oz was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic's 501st Legion. During the Battle of Umbara in 20 BBY, Oz and fellow soldier Ringo were killed by Umbaran mines while under the command of Jedi General Pong Krell.
Kelric was a Human male who served as Supreme Commander in the military forces of House Organa, a noble house of the planet Alderaan aligned with the Galactic Republic in the Alderaan Civil War.

The Ruur Night Herald was a Killik that held the position of Night Herald among the Ruur Killik hive on the planet Alderaan during the Alderaan Civil War. The Killik was slain by Republic forces that invaded the Ruur Killik Burrows.
Droidbait, identified by the number CT-00-2010, was a clone trooper who served in Domino Squad, a clone cadet squad in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic.
Fezzter was a fat, bald Human who worked as Crying Dawn Singer's road agent and manager, and was known to wear a metallic gold skin-tight bodysuit.
Guerglenar was an Ithorian who worked as one of Crying Dawn Singer's back-up singers with fellow Ithorian Drov.
Drov was an Ithorian who worked as one of Crying Dawn Singer's back-up singers with fellow Ithorian Guerglenar.

Eraski Ven was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Republic forces on the planet Quesh.
A woman named Venta was the grandmother of Garri, a Toydarian who lived in Pau City on the planet Utapau in the Outer Rim Territories.

MB-223 was the designation of a human male stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. In 5 BBY, he was partnered with TK-626 and charged with patrolling an Imperial airfield on the planet Lothal.
Kyramla Gemas'rugam—"Deadly Hairball" in Mando'a—was the name given to a jungle wampa that Shae Vizla's Mandalorians kept on Tracyn Island on the planet Rishi.
Dralne be te Oya'karir—"Strongest of the Hunt" in Mando'a—was the name given to an enormous krak'jya that Shae Vizla's Mandalorians kept on Tracyn Island on the planet Rishi.
Yustapir Kyramud—"River Assassin" in Mando'a—was the name given to an enormous jurgoran that Shae Vizla's Mandalorians kept on Tracyn Island on the planet Rishi.

Hodayc Sur'haai—"Cunning Eye" in Mando'a—was the name given to a large tonitran that Shae Vizla's Mandalorians kept on Tracyn Island on the planet Rishi. The creature was one of a number of challenges that were kept in the Mandalorians' compound to test themselves against.

Adeen Edeemir—"Merciless Bite" in Mando'a—was the name given to a large k'lor'slug that Shae Vizla's Mandalorians kept on Tracyn Island on the planet Rishi. The creature was one of a number of challenges that were kept in the Mandalorians' compound to test themselves against.

Pirun Ut—"Water Slime" in Mando'a—was the name given to a large lurker that Shae Vizla's Mandalorians kept on Tracyn Island on the planet Rishi. The creature was one of a number of challenges that were kept in the Mandalorians' compound to test themselves against.

Cerar Be Kyr'am—"Mountain of Death" in Mando'a—was the name given to a large rancor that Shae Vizla's Mandalorians kept on Tracyn Island on the planet Rishi. The creature was one of a number of challenges that were kept in the Mandalorians' compound to test themselves against.

Fren Nurook was a female Ithorian scientist. She lived in Glare Peak on Tivar II for five years, and was recruited by Rebel Alliance officer Jaxon Brand after she was fired from Roskam Mechanized Systems for suspicion of Rebel sympathies.
Sodilayno Smath was a short, dark-skinned Human male who ran the Narg Starport Souvenir Shop on the planet Narg.

Biull Sangtwo was a Human male from the planet Narg. A farmer, he ran a scam with the protocol droid RT-56/X whereby they would convince offworlders to purchase the droid for a small fee with the intention of reselling it at a higher price.
Tikiman was a four-armed male who worked as a bartender in the The Free Access Grill in Grig on the planet Narg.
Hevy, named for his expertise in the use of heavy weapons, was a clone trooper designated CT-782 who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Barry was a young Human male who worked in the Free Access Grill on the planet Narg.
Daf Spearmaster was a Whiphid male mercenary. When the mercenary cadre he was in were hired to train local security forces on the planet Narg, he traveled to the planet.
Seendar was a male Togorian mercenary who was trapped on the planet Narg. He spent his time in the Free Access Grill.
Ak-rev was a male Weequay who played as a drummer in the Max Rebo Band, whose second drummer was Umpass-stay. He was a bodyguard to Jabba the Hutt.

Doda Bodonawieedo was a male Rodian musician. He played at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina, but ended up getting fired and replaced with the band Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes, protesting as he left the establishment.

Barquin D'an was a Bith who worked as a professional musician and was the younger brother of fellow musician Figrin D'an. After visiting the palace of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure, Barquin ended up playing kloo horn in the Max Rebo Band, house band for Jabba.
Mogg Wacho was a male who was a union commissioner on the planet Mechis III during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Torrig Omal was a Chagrian competitive swimmer during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Greeata Jendowanian was a female Rodian who worked as a singer and dancer for the Max Rebo Band.
Jindo Krey was a male Mandalorian who lived during the time of the Galactic War. When Darth Malgus declared his New Empire, Krey and his Mandalorians followed him.
Jogo, also known as Jogo the Carver, was a Human male Mandalorian of Clan Bralor who was the son of Salus Bralor.
Jet, designated CC-1993, was a Clone Commander who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Bonnie was a young female who worked at the TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center on the planet Narg. She was part of the TransGalMeg Personnel Satisfaction Division.

Huulik was a Force-sensitive male Rodian Jedi Knight who lived in the last decades of the Galactic Republic. He served as a general for the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Stone, designated CC-5869, was a clone shock trooper who held the rank of Clone Commander in the Coruscant Guard, an elite division of the Grand Army of the Republic.

Waxer was a clone trooper who served in Ghost Company, a military unit of the Grand Army of the Republic. During the Clone Wars against the Separatist Alliance, he fought in the Battle of Ryloth and the Second Battle of Geonosis alongside fellow 212th trooper Boil.

Boil was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic as a member of the 212th Attack Battalion's Ghost Company during the Clone Wars. Boil and his fellow clone trooper "Waxer" were considered two of the best soldiers in Ghost Company.
Dogma, whose clone trooper designation was CT-6922, was a Clone Private who served in the 501st Legion of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He was known to always follow orders.
Jesse, also known by his designated number CT-5597, was an Advanced Recon Commando and Clone Lieutenant who served in the 501st Legion during the Clone Wars.

Erlick Frodar was the commander of Asteroid Base on Orflon during the Galactic Civil War. He had previously served in the Imperial Navy before joining the Alliance to Restore the Republic, serving in the Alliance Fleet, then the Alliance Army where he held the rank of colonel.

Ringo was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as part of the 501st Legion. During the Battle of Umbara, Ringo participated in a risky advance orchestrated by Jedi General Pong Krell.

affiliation: Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes
x: "Fiery" Figrin D'an was a male Bith musician who played the Kloo horn as frontman and leader of the band Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes. He was the brother of Barquin D'an.
Piers Roddance was a lieutenant and later a captain in the Imperial Military on the Outer Rim planet of Lothal.
Salus Bralor was a male Human Mandalorian of Clan Bralor who was the father of Jogo. After learning that his son was killed by the Grand Champion, he went to Taris to confront him.
War-Master Rhigoth was a male Mandalorian mercenary who was the leader of a group of Mandalorians that started shaking down merchants in the city of Anchorhead during the Cold War.
Ridge was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as a part of the 501st Legion.
Zenzo was a Human male Mandalorian mercenary during the Galactic War. While on Taris, he offered a bounty to anyone who was willing to fight the Morgukai. He wore blue Mandalorian armor.
Deagan Farrell was a Human male Mandalorian who worked on Vaiken Spacedock with fellow bounty hunter trainer, Bulga, during the Cold War and the Galactic War.

Agerin Minosh was a Human male Mandalorian merchant who lived during the Galactic War. He resided on Corellia, where he built and sold armor in a small shop with the other vendors at the spaceport. He wore brown and silver Mandalorian armor.
Hound was an Advanced Recon Force Scout Trooper sergeant who served in the Coruscant Guard of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A male human was the father of Leo Leonis, and grandfather to Leonis's children Dhara Leonis and Zare Leonis. As a child, the man was looked after by Auntie Nags, a nanny droid which had belonged to the Leonis family for many generations.

Jek was a clone shock trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he served alongside Jedi Master Yoda on Rugosa as part of a small squad and, later, served at the Battle of Kashyyyk under Yoda once again in 19 BBY.

Ames Bunkle, who later went by his operating number DX-578, was a male human who lived with his parents on the planet Lothal. When Bunkle was sixteen he enrolled in the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal, where he ended up specializing in stormtrooper training.

Bower was a bounty hunter and former pirate during the Galactic Civil War. When Kasey gave up piracy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic he followed her, out of loyalty and love, though he did not share her rebel leanings.

Jor Entel was the captain of the pirate vessel Night Wind during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to the Demophon supernova, Entel posed as a humanitarian, evacuating people off Demophon for a low fee. In reality he was murdering his passengers and taking their valuables.

Pari Bunkle was a female human who worked in the Galactic Empire's Ministry of Agriculture on the planet Lothal. She had a child named Ames Bunkle with another researcher at the Ministry, and the family lived in an apartment in Lothal's Capital City.

Jared Fronz was an Imperial relief coordinator during the evacuation of Demophon prior to the Demophon supernova. He was grossly fat and sweated profusely, but his soft appearance hid a menacing undercurrent.

Kasey was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic cell in Byrne City on the planet Demophon during the Galactic Civil War. She was a pirate when she met Enid Vahr and fell in love. He convinced her to join the Alliance.
"Ace" Lorle was the owner of Clubs, a cantina in Byrne City on the planet Demophon. He had a distinctive appearance, a small man with a fat face, hooded eyes, and a neutronium front tooth.

Roz was a free-trader during the Galactic Civil War. He was hired by Almera Zan to transport her group of Alliance to Restore the Republic agents to Demophon, searching for Enid Vahr. His ship was destroyed, and only he, Almera Zan, Tamarc, and Grashk survived.
Jonnas Perrsta was the Chief of Security for the TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center in the city of Grig on the planet Narg.

Enid Vahr was an Alliance to Restore the Republic agent embedded with Vortex Corporation to discover any military contracts or technology affiliated with the Galactic Empire. He was very successful in this endeavor.

Almera Zan was an Alliance to Restore the Republic agent sent to Demophon to find missing agent Enid Vahr. After her squad's starship was shot down over the planet, only Almera, Grashk, Roz, and their leader Tamarc survived. Tamarc was later killed by panicking Sla Kar.

Charger was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic as part of the 501st Legion during the Clone Wars. They were part of a team sent on a mission to Lola Sayu to free Republic prisoners from The Citadel.
Redok Harvast was a Human male Mandalorian who worked as a bounty hunter on Corellia during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Slick was a Clone Sergeant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Early in the war, he came to believe that the Jedi Order, which commanded the clone army, was incompetent and using him and his fellow clone troopers as slaves in their war against t…
Feresyl was a Human Mandalorian female merchant, running an small shop in Corellia Coronet Spaceport during the Battle of Corellia. She wore brown and silver Mandalorian armor.
Jos Beroya was a male Mandalorian warrior and the husband of Valk Beroya. Jos and his wife were members of Clan Vizla, and he wore red and gray Mandalorian armor.
Valk Beroya was a Human female Mandalorian warrior and the wife of Jos Beroya. Valk and her husband were members of Clan Vizla, and she wore white Mandalorian armor with blue and black markings.
A Human Mandalorian Rally Master was a member of the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders during the Mandalorian Wars.
Rellu was an male Human Mandalorian during the Cold War that was one of Tarro Blood's followers, along with Sedyn Kyne.
Zev Senesca was a human male rebel pilot who served the Rebel Alliance as a founding member of Rogue Squadron. While operating on Hoth, Senesca flew a snowspeeder under the callsign Rogue Two.

The Boss was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exobar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War.

Dinner was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exoboar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War.

Duke was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exoboar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War.

Grappa was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exoboar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War.

Jwizzix'Xthor was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exobar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War.
Nerf was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exobar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War.

North was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exobar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Precious was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exobar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War.

Scrapp was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exobar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War.

Tank was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exoboar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War.

Voguz was the name given to one of the exoboars in the litter of Sparky, a large exobar kept by the Ravagers pirate gang on the planet Rishi around the time of the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War.

Droman was an Imperial Army sergeant stationed on the planet Rhamalai. He told General Yrros that it wasn't standard procedure for a general to address new conscripts, but Yrros responded that he sets the precedent.

Markren Pellias was the Planetary Trade Director on the planet Rhamalai. When the Empire begin to conscript the husbands, brothers, and sons of Rhamalai, Pellias argued with General Naem Yrros that it was unfair.

Denel Moonrunner was a Human male, and the son of two hidden Rebels, Lorn and Artis Moonrunner. When the Empire came to Rhamalai in 0 ABY, he was conscripted and given the identification number FR-231. He had a pet gorset named Chaser.
Artis Moonrunner was a Human female and the wife of Lorn Moonrunner and mother of Denel Moonrunner.
Chaser was a gorset owned by Denel Moonrunner on the planet Rhamalai.

Duran Gorr was a Human male Mandalorian raider who lived doing the Cold War. He led a group of Mandalorians that raided a shipment of Republic warheads. However, both he and his men were killed by Republic forces who came for the warheads.

Boost, also identified by the number CT-4860, was a clone of the bounty hunter Jango Fett who served as a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Comet was a Clone Corporal who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Marn was a female Mandalorian who lived during the Cold War. After the death of Salus Bralor's son Jogo at the hands of a bounty hunter, Marn accompanied Bralor to the Taris Orbital Station in order to confront the hunter.
Biguh Johs was a male Jawa who lived on the planet Rishi and ran a taxi service, taking passengers from the city of Raider's Cove on Horizon Island to the nearby Sky Ridge Island.

Sinker was a Clone Sergeant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars along with the rest of Wolfpack throughout the conflict. He served as a sergeant under Jedi Master Plo Koon and Commander Wolffe in the 104th Battalion.

Blearg was a male Gamorrean who lived in the dangerous region of the planet Tatooine known as the Outlaw's Den during the Cold War. He and the Jawa Kezzit made camp at the southeastern end of the area, and Blearg would trade loot he took from those he had killed.
"Shifty" Panaw was a male Jawa who lived in the dangerous region of the planet Tatooine known as the Outlaw's Den during the Cold War. He often traded scrap and other goods to those he encountered.
Jo'dath, also known as Jo'dath the Exile, was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto who lived in the dangerous region of the planet Tatooine known as the Outlaw's Den during the Cold War.

"Collector" Kezzit was a male Jawa scavenger who lived in the dangerous region of the planet Tatooine known as the Outlaw's Den during the Cold War. He and the Gamorrean Blearg made camp at the southeastern end of the area, and Kezzit would trade loot that he found in the area.
Jarr was a male Advozse captain in the employ of the Advozse Hegemony who oversaw the discovery and salvage of the Hammer Station, a Galactic Republic battle station, during the Cold War.

Frod Makora was a male Advozse who lived on the planet Rishi during the Galactic War. Shortly before the Battle of Rishi, the Wookiee Jakarro hired Makora to lend his speeder to Jakarro's allies in order to reach Tracyn Island.

Hal'Sted was a Siniteen pirate who resided on the planet Rattatak. He received the infant Asajj Ventress from the Nightsisters, who were forced to give Ventress to the pirate. Hal'Sted returned to Rattatak with Ventress, where he was later killed.

Redeye was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as a part of the 501st Legion. Redeye was killed along with their friend Mixer on the Coronet while fighting against Senator Tal Merrik SD-K4 assassin probes.
Mixer was the nickname of a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Jun Sato was a human male who commanded the Phoenix Cell, a rebel cell that operated against the Galactic Empire in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Dom Antyll was one of the best starship technicians in all of Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War. He owned Docking Bay 92, which he converted for use in starship repairs.
Kieth Cairn was a victim of Cornelius Evazan's illegal, experimental surgery at the Cutting Edge Clinic in Mos Eisley. His body was buried in the caves below Mos Eisley.
Debrelle was a Near-Human female who worked at the Zygian's Banking Concern branch in Mos Eisley.

Longshot was a clone trooper who served the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars with the 212th Battalion. During an infiltration of the Citadel, Longshot was killed by one of the many traps inside the fortress.
Wooley was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars with the 212th Attack Battalion.
Angor Farn was a Bith hired by Sleeft Docking Bay Maintenance to ship a load of power converters to Corellia in 0 ABY.
Arjon F.M.P., or F.M.P. to her friends, was a card shark and con artist that set up shop in the alley behind Docking Bay 94 in Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War.

Gearshift was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as a part of the 212th Attack Battalion. He was killed during the Second Battle of Geonosis by undead Geonosians under the hive of Queen Karina the Great.

"Mad Akk" Geden was a male Rattataki who was a former Mandalorian and a member of the Terror Brigade. A Force-sensitive who exhibited powers such as Force lightning, Geden fought with a melee weapon in battle, and was defeated by Galactic Republic forces as part of the Onslaug…
Gevrell was the assistant to Mos Eisley's Chief of Security. He was married to a rather unattractive woman, and had an office in Spaceport Customs.
Givvers was the manager of the Mos Eisley branch of Zygian's Banking Concern.

Trapper was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Trapper served alongside Jedi General Mace Windu, Clone Commander Ponds and "Hawkeye" on Malastare where they encountered the Zillo Beast.

Nub, which stood for "Non-Useful Body," was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. They monitored the listening post at the Rishi Station to warn of any impending Separatist attacks near Rishi.
Punch was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. They were part of Clone Sergeant Slick's squad during the campaign on Christophsis.

O'Niner was a Clone Sergeant who served in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he commanded a small and inexperienced unit of clone troopers at Rishi Station, a Republic outpost on the Rishi Moon.

Coral Ohah was one of the directors of Sleeft Docking Bay Maintenance in Mos Eisley. When a mixup resulted in Angor Farn receiving a shipment of Droid parts stolen from the Notsub Shipping Company, Ohah coordinated the effort to find Farn and retrieve the goods.

Yvonne Targis was the proprietor of the Transport Depot in Mos Eisley. She was a Near-Human with green hair, yellow skin, and a nasty disposition. She worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure, whose agents often used the Depot as a drop off point.

Razor, also known by the number CT-6910, was a clone ARF trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. A soldier of Lightning Squadron, Razor served under Clone Commander Ponds as well as Jedi Generals Mace Windu and Adi Gallia.

Peden was a sergeant of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Stationed at the Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison on the planet Hoth, he led Grek team on a priority assault mission against the Republic forces, which ended in failure after the entire platoo…

Krovas was one of Jorkatt the Render's chief lieutenants. His death was officially a swimming accident, although exactly why he went swimming with plasticrete bricks in his pockets was never determined.
Evaan Verlaine was a human female pilot who served as a lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Kade Darven was a Human male operative of the New Republic. He was working on the planet Seikosha with the native Seikoshans.

Chiron Drebbick was a Human male Imperial Security Bureau Infiltration agent serving the Galactic Empire during the years following the Battle of Endor. He was operating on the planet Seikosha as the chief lieutenant of Lydenn Carridon.
Tannor Nuum was a Sullustan working for Janelle Serap on the planet Seikosha. Nuum was killed by Chiron Drebbick.

Sketch was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Christophsis, Clone Commander Cody and Clone Captain Rex conducted an investigation regarding the possibility of a Separatist spy among their ranks.

Stak was an ARF clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic's Lightning Squadron during the Clone Wars and participated in the Battle of Ryloth. They worked closely with fellow ARF trooper Razor.

Flash was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Serving as a member of a company within the 327th Star Corps under Jedi General Aayla Secura and Clone Marshal Commander Bly, Flash participated in a mission to Escander against the C…

Niner was a clone trooper who served within the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, Niner was a part of a Galactic Republic squad of clone troopers commanded by Jedi Knight Nahdar Vebb and Clone Commander Fil, which was ordered to search for the escape…

Alavai was a male Cathar who served as a commander in the Republic Army during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was one of the commanders during the Korriban Incursion, and was slain by Imperial forces.

Bemere was a female Human who served as a commander in the Republic Military during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. She was one of the commanders during the Korriban Incursion, and was slain by Imperial forces.

Ceryss was a male Miraluka who was a member of the Jedi Order and served as commander for the Republic Military during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. He was one of the commanders during the Korriban Incursion, and was slain by Imperial forces.
Bastra was a male Cathar who was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Lankost was a male Kaleesh Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Wytho was a male Human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Teranos was a Nautolan male major of the Galactic Republic living during the Cold War. Stationed on Taris, he posted a bounty offering rewards for retrieving stolen class-seven warheads from the Mandalorians led by Duran Gorr.
Lem-Ofars was an male Human Mandalorian who lived during the Cold War. Residing in Toxic Lake Garrison on the planet Taris, he managed a vendor stand and sold armor. He wore blue Mandalorian armor.
"Green Leader" was the callsign of the clone trooper who led the clone troopers from Green Company, which was attached to the Grand Army of the Republic's 41st Elite Corps during the Clone Wars.
1151 was a clone cadet who was a part of the Clone Youth Brigade during the Clone Wars.
Whiplash, also identified as clone cadet 1174, was a clone trooper cadet who served in the Clone Youth Brigade during the Clone Wars.

Nakari Kelen was a human female who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Born on the desert planet Pasher, Nakari was the daughter of Fayet Kelen, owner of Kelen Biolabs.

Beck Ollet was a student at the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences on the Outer Rim planet Lothal's Capital City a few years years prior to the Battle of Yavin. He was a close friend of Zare Leonis and played fullback on the Academy's grav-ball team, the AppSci SaberCats.
Bel was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars under Jedi Generals Nahdar Vebb and his former master Kit Fisto.
Cameron was a clone trooper who served in the 501st Legion of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Lucky was a clone trooper who served in the 501st Legion of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Miraj Scintel was a female Zygerrian who served as the Queen of Zygerria during the Clone Wars. Seeking to rebuild the Zygerrian Slave Empire that was shut down by the Jedi Knights of the Old Republic, Scintel allied Zygerria with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Buzz was a clone trooper squad leader who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. During the Second Battle of Geonosis, he went with Jedi Master Luminara Unduli to search for and capture Poggle the Lesser to take him into Republic custody.
CT-66-3233 was a clone cadet who served in Bravo Squad, a training unit on Kamino, during the Clone Wars. They were marked with a one on their clone training armor.
CT-66-3238 was a clone cadet who served in Bravo Squad, a training unit, early during the Clone Wars. He was marked with a three on his clone training armor.
CT-66-3339 was a clone cadet who served in Bravo Squad, a training unit, early during the Clone Wars. They were marked with a four on their clone training armor.
CT-27-3555 was a clone cadet who served in Bravo Squad, a training unit on Kamino, during the Clone Wars. They were marked with a five on their clone training armor.

Pandak Symes was a male Imperial cadet who briefly trained at the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal as a member of Unit Aurek of squad LRC077. His parents, Colonel Symes and Major Symes, were career members of the Imperial Army.

Halle Burtoni was a female Kaminoan politician who represented her homeworld of Kamino in the Senates of the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire from the Clone Wars until her removal from office during the early Imperial Era.
Tal Merrik was a human male prince who represented his homeworld of Kalevala in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars, and served as a member of the Galactic Senate's Council of Neutral Systems.

Brisha Shard was a female Deltron who served in the Republic Navy during the early stages of the Clone Wars. She was the captain of the MedStar-class frigate Golandras. She had one son, Alarik, and two daughters, Bellen and Viqi.

Car Affa was a Weequay arms dealer active on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars. Affa sold Republic arms to the Confederacy of Independent Systems until he was arrested by Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano.

Bannamu was a male Patrolian pickpocket living on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, Bannamu managed to steal a lightsaber from Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano's belt and subsequently sold it to the Trandoshan Nack Movers.
Nack Movers was a male Trandoshan assassin who worked as a hitman on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. He shared an apartment with his girlfriend Ione Marcy and hired Cassilyda Cryar as his bodyguard.
Delian Mors was a human female who served as a Moff in the Galactic Empire in the years after the end of the Clone Wars. In 14 BBY, Mors served as the Imperial Moff of the Outer Rim planet of Ryloth.
Alarik was a male Deltron and the only son of Brisha Shard. His two sisters were Bellen and Viqi.
Bellen was a female Deltron and one of Brisha Shard's three children. She had a sister, Viqi, and a brother, Alarik.
Fayet Kelen was the father of Nakari Kelen and founder of the Kelen Biolabs. His business was the largest industry on the planet Pasher.

Bensyn was a male Sith pureblood Acolyte of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. Trained in the Sith Academy on Korriban, as part of his final trial Bensyn was sent by Overseer Harkun into the Valley of the Dark Lords to retrieve the helm of Tulak Hord along with a group of ot…

Greck was a Sith Acolyte of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Trained in the Sith Academy on Korriban, as part of his final trial Greck was sent by Overseer Harkun into the Valley of the Dark Lords to retrieve the helm of Tulak Hord along with a group of other…

Kagan was a female Sith Acolyte of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. Trained in the Sith Academy on Korriban, as part of her final trial Kagan was sent by Overseer Harkun into the Valley of the Dark Lords to retrieve the helm of Tulak Hord along with a group of other acolyt…

A female Zabrak was a Sith Acolyte of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Trained in the Sith Academy on Korriban, as part of her final trial she was sent was sent into the Valley of the Dark Lords to retrieve the helm of Tulak Hord, a task Harkun deemed impossi…
Korkie Kryze was a human male Mandalorian and a cadet of the Royal Academy of Government on the planet Mandalore during the Clone Wars era.
A legendary hero of the S'kytri people, Hormaket the Vanquisher was the leader of the S'kytri in their war against the ground dwellers who threatened the equilibrium of the world.
Rys was the nickname of a male diplomatic service clone shock trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Dellin Sorth was the Chief Executive Officer of Prosperine Entertainment and Distilleries, and the owner of Club Prosperine on the planet Algara II.
Gokim Keeg was a male who served in the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Davin Novachez, known by the nickname "Dav", was a male Human native of Tatooine. He was the big brother of Roan Novachez and Oliver "Ollie" Novachez. He attended Pilot Academy Middle School to become a pilot like his father and grandfather.

Thyswar was a male S'kytri of the Lowland Clans of the planet of Skye. A member of the Supreme Council that governed the planet, he resided in the planet's capital city, the City of the Winged People.
Herana was a female S'kytri of the Lowland Clans of the planet of Skye. A member of the Patriarch's guard, she resided in the planet's capital city, the City of the Winged People.

Nebaél was a female S'kytri of the Highland Clans of the planet of Skye. The Speaker of the Supreme Council that governed the planet, she resided in the planet's capital city, the City of the Winged People.

Cradossk was a Trandoshan male and the father of Bossk. A seasoned warrior and respected bounty hunter, Cradossk shared a rivalry with the Wookiee chieftain Tarfful, and, by the time of the Clone Wars, Cradossk's son gained a reputation for hunting Wookiees.

Chopper was a clone trooper that served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. A soldier in Clone Sergeant "Slick's" squad, Chopper and his fellow troopers were part of the Jedi-led army sent by the Galactic Republic to defend the planet Christophsis from the…
Crys was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Spark, designation CT-1284, was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

CT-1477 was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. When Boba Fett entered the reactor room aboard the Endurance, CT-1477 assumed he was a lost cadet and contacted security to escort him back to his company.
Soniee, a Mandalorian human female, was a cadet of the Royal Academy of Government during the Clone Wars.
Derrown, also known as "the Exterminator" because of the intense electric fields his body produced, was a male Parwan bounty hunter active during the Clone Wars.
Sarsius Torne was a male Thyrsian who served as a Sun Guard mercenary for Zeta Magnus. Based deep in Wild Space, Torne was stationed at Rennek Palace at the heart of the Dark Worlds.

Halsey was a Roonan male Jedi Master active during the Clone Wars. During the Republic defense of the Temple of Eedit on the planet of Devaron, Halsey participated in the battle alongside Clone Commander "Trauma" and his Padawan Knox.

Amita Fonti was a Gossam senator that represented the Commerce Guild in the Separatist Senate during the Clone Wars, a conflict fought between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

CT-327 was a clone trooper who served as a deck officer in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, CT-327 was member of a small unit of clones stationed at an outpost on the Rishi Moon.
Havoc was a clone trooper who served during the Clone Wars in the Grand Army of the Republic's Tango Company.
Edge was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic's Tango Company during the Clone Wars.
Hafner was a male Duros scientist who worked for the biotech company Kelen Biolabs during the Galactic Civil War.
Kalor was a Human male native to the planet Fyodos. Chief of the Roh tribe, he had a wife, Alyak, and two sons, Dubeh and Meerak.
Kalor was a Mirialan male captain in the Personnel Division of the Army of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War and Galactic War.
Alyak was a Human female native to the planet Fyodos. She was the wife of the chief of the Roh tribe, Kalor, and mother to Dubeh and Meerak.
Dubeh was a Human male native to the planet Fyodos. He was the son of Kalor, chief of the Roh tribe, and his wife, Alyak. He also had a brother, Meerak.
Meerak was a Human male native to the planet Fyodos. He was the son of Kalor, chief of the Roh tribe, and his wife, Alyak. Dubeh was his brother.
Tseeach was a Human male native to the planet Fyodos. He was the shaman of the Roh tribe. He had a son, Erloi.
Erloi was a Human male native to the planet Fyodos. He was the son of Tseeach, shaman of the Roh tribe. Erloi was in training to one day become a shaman himself.
Dek Anorik was a male smuggler. After being captured by the Galactic Empire alongside his best friend on Gacerian, Anorik was offered a deal in exchange for his freedom.

Drelmar Bin was a male Human who lived on the planet Korbin during the early years of the New Republic. Originally a corporate employee on an industrial planet, Bin fled when it was discovered that he had been embezzling.
Gus was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He participated in the Battle of Christophsis as a member of Clone Sergeant Slick's squad.

Hawkeye was a clone trooper that served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Malastare in 21 BBY, Hawkeye joined Jedi General Mace Windu, Clone Commander Ponds, and fellow trooper Trapper on the planet Malastare, where they encountered …
Hotshot was a clone cadet who was a part of the Clone Youth Brigade during the Clone Wars.
Jax was a clone cadet who was a part of the Clone Youth Brigade during the Clone Wars.
Jester was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He was known in his squad for cleaning their DC-15 blaster after every mission.

Koho was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, Koho participated in the Battle of Devaron aboard the Separatist Munificent-class star frigate to recover a Jedi holocron that famous bounty hunter Cad Bane had stolen.

Kosmos was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. After the Battle of Malastare in 21 BBY, Kosmos was stationed on Coruscant when a Zillo Beast was brought to the Galactic Republic's capital.
Scythe, designated CT-9544, was a clone trooper who served during the Clone Wars in the Grand Army of the Republic's Tango Company.
Florn was a human male affiliated with the Galactic Empire. Originally a pilot with the Empire, his flying career was interrupted after a crash that left him severely injured.

Tana Chellaine was a female human who flew as a TIE fighter pilot for the Galactic Empire around the time of the Battle of Yavin. She flew in the Imperial Army's Nashtah Squadron, which participated in a battle on the planet Portocari where they lost three squad members.

Huck Trompo was a male human who served as a pilot for the Galactic Empire around the time of the Battle of Yavin. He flew in Nashtah Squadron, a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter squadron in the Imperial Army.

Sully Olvar was a male human who served as a pilot for the Galactic Empire around the time of the Battle of Yavin. He flew in Nashtah Squadron, a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter squadron in the Imperial Army.

Suthers was a pilot who was killed in service to the Galactic Empire. Following the pilot's death, a hologram of Suthers's face was put up amongst a gallery of other deceased pilots displayed in the Zero Angle, a bar in the Imperial Bright Jewel Oversector Flight Base on the m…
Deron Cadoruso was a male Human Mandalorian who lived during the Galactic War. He and his Mandalorians joined with the Order of Revan when Revan returned during the Galactic War.

Ean Ventor was a male Human from Alderaan. He and his wife Zollet were simple archivists working in the Royal Library of Alderaan, but they ended up winning the sympathy of the nobleman Bail Prestor Organa.
Kronn was an officer who served the Galactic Empire in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Eventually, Kronn became captain of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Adjudicator.

Laneet Chekkoo was a female Rodian who lived on the planet Rodia and was a part of the Chekkoo clan. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, she met the aspiring Jedi and pilot Luke Skywalker when he came to Chekkoo Enclave seeking to purchase weapons for the Alliance to Restore th…

The Empress Marasiah Fel's secretary in 139 ABY was a Duros woman who wore a blue dress. When the junk dealer Ania Solo attempted to seek an audience with the Empress to seek clemency for the condemned Imperial Knight Jao Assam, she apologized that the Empress did not have any…

H'Krav was a pirate and member of the crew of the Corellian DP20 frigate Null Space. The ship was surrendered to Imperial Zero-G assault stormtroopers to avoid being killed by the commander, Captain Obigon.
Meekeef was a pirate and member of the crew of the Corellian DP20 frigate Null Space. Captain Obigon surrendered the ship to Imperial Zero-G assault stormtroopers to avoid being killed.
Ione Marcy was a Salenga female thief who lived on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars.

Cassilyda "Cassie" Cryar was a female Terrelian Jango Jumper criminal who lived on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars. She and her secret lover, Ione Marcy, murdered Marcy's partner and Cryar's employer, Nack Movers.
Kren Blista-Vanee was a male human who served as an advisor on the Imperial Ruling Council to Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Drusil Bephorin was a brilliant Givin female cryptologist.
Jerec was a male human who served as a Deputy Minister in the New Mandalorian government of Duchess Satine Kryze.

This stormtrooper was a human male member of the Stormtrooper Corps five years before the Battle of Yavin. During the mission to free Wookiee prisoners undertaken by the rebel crew of the Ghost, this stormtrooper was stationed in the spice mines of the planet Kessel.

Isval was a Rutian Twi'lek female ex-slave who was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement during the reign of the Galactic Empire. She was a lieutenant of Cham Syndulla, the movement's leader and military commander.

Jessa Spanjaf, a human female, was the mother of Merei Spanjaf and the wife of Gandr Spanjaf. She and her husband worked as data-security specialists and were contracted by several ministries of the Galactic Empire.

Gandr Spanjaf was a human male member of the Garel City cell, father of Merei Spanjaf, and husband of Jessa Spanjaf. He and his wife worked as data-security specialists and were contracted by several ministries of the Galactic Empire.

Neyo, designated CC-8826, was an Advanced Recon Commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, rising to become a Clone Marshal Commander and the leader of the 91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps.

In 19 BBY, Colton piloted the Tantive III on the planet Coruscant during the final days of the Clone Wars. Organa used the ship to aid his Jedi friends Grand Master Yoda and Kenobi, now a Master, after the Galactic Republic turned on the Jedi during Order 66.
Macy Yakaro was a male fringer who operated as a guide out of Salfur's Trading Post on the Forest Moon of Endor, and was fond of cigarras.

On the moon Nar Shaddaa, a Hutt spectator watched a fight organized by the Quarren crime lord Durrsk. However, when Durrsk was murdered by his own fighter, Tyrnia Masak, as revenge, the Hutt was also killed. Its family placed a bounty on Masak.

Weni Darooga was a captain of the Galactic Republic's First Fleet living during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire, who worked closely with Fleet Admiral Bey'wan Aygo, overall commander of the First Fleet.
Max was a scientist working for the Hutt Cartel on the planet Makeb during the Galactic War.

Qaraah was a male Rishii living on Rishi during the Galactic War. A self-proclaimed "cantina-talk type", he was comfortable hanging around the outsiders and thuse settled in the town of Raider's Cove and not one his native people's villages.

The father of Kira Carsen was a Human male Sith of the Sith Empire. He and his wife had their child on the Empire's capital of Dromund Kaas, but as a young child Kira was taken by the servants of the Sith Emperor to become one of the Children of the Emperor.

A Human woman was a Sith of the reconstituted Sith Empire and the mother of Kira Carsen. She and her husband had their child on the Empire's capital of Dromund Kaas, but as a young child Carsen was taken by the servants of the Sith Emperor to become one of the Children of the …

Oren Ward was a Human male Mandalorian Jedi killer who was captured by Voontara Fa'athra and imprisoned in carbonite in Fa'athra's Palace on Nal Hutta during the Cold War. Ward's friend Burnok recruited help in rescuing Ward from the palace.

Urtagh was the name given to a bantha living on the planet Tatooine that was infected by the rakghoul plague during the rakghoul pandemic and grew to a massive size. The beast was slain in the Outlaw's Den region.
Tyler Thello was a Human male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
This stormtrooper was a member of the Stormtrooper Corps that was stationed on the Outer Rim world of Lothal four years before the Battle of Yavin.

Betancy was an Imperial cadet who trained at the Galactic Empire's Academy for Young Imperials on the planet Lothal in 5 BBY. They were a member of the promising cadet squad LRC077 with Ezra Bridger and Zare Leonis and were part of the squad's Unit Besh.

Jix Hekyl was a male Pantoran who attended the Vocational School for Institutional Security on the planet Lothal during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In addition, Hekyl worked as a courier for the Gray Syndicate, a minor crime syndicate operating in Lothal's Capital City.

Jiuk'chtna was a male Duros trader. Some time during the Galactic Civil War, he hired a Human spacer to take him to Gemthrop City. He warned the spacer to be careful, as the residents of Gemthrop City did not like Humans.
Illorus was a girl who trained as a cadet in the Academy for Young Imperials on the planet Lothal around five years before the Battle of Yavin.

Bennova was a businessman during the Galactic Civil War. He "gifted" a starship to the Rodian Treetor, a hired thug of Jabba Desilijic Tiure, as a payoff. After Treetor left the employ of Jabba, Bennova hired some spacers to steal it back.

Venarian was a criminal. He was a servant to a major crime lord, but longed to control his own territory. To finance his future operation, Venarian began to siphon funds from his employer, and expanded into smuggling operations.
Kruus Toran was a male crime lord during the Galactic Civil War.

Riff Tamson was a Karkarodon male from the planet Karkaris. Tamson served as a commander and warlord for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars and was placed in charge of operations on aquatic planets such as Mon Cala.
Tula was a human female who served as an officer of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, even after the Imperials destroyed her homeworld of Alderaan.
A Mandallian Giant gladiator participated in The Big Game on The Wheel in 0 ABY.
Malaphar, also known as Malaphar the Savage, was a massive male Massassi warrior who lived on the moon Yavin 4 during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Rand was a Human male who served as the commander of the Infinite Army, a group of supersoldiers implanted with Rakata technology by the Order of Revan.
Savorin Malfus the Seventh was a Human male noble of the planet Alderaan who lived during the Cold War.
Tivlik was a male Rodian who served the Hutt Suudaa Nem'ro as his spice buyer on the planet Nal Hutta during the Cold War.
