x: Nalan Cheel was a Bith musician who played a bandfill as a regular member of the band Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes.

affiliation: Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes
x: Tech Mo'r was a male Bith musician who played an Ommni box as a regular member of the band Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes.
Tey How was a Neimoidian who served as a battleship pilot for the Trade Federation during its blockade and subsequent invasion of the planet Naboo.
Terr Taneel was a human senator for the Senex sector in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Colt was a Clone ARC Commander who served as the commanding officer of Rancor Battalion, along with Commanders Havoc and Blitz, during the Clone Wars, as part of the Grand Army of the Republic. He was killed by Asajj Ventress during the Battle of Kamino.

Naa'leth was a Dathomirian female. She was a member of the Nightsisters during the Clone Wars. She and her sister Karis aided Asajj Ventress in the attempt to assassinate Count Dooku on Serenno, which failed. Naa'leth was killed during the Battle of Dathomir.
Malé-Dee was a human male politician who served in the Senate of the Galactic Republic during the later stages of the Clone Wars.
Parisa, callsign Blink, was a Human female who served as a sergeant in the Republic Army and a member of Eclipse Squad, a Republic Special Forces Division squad created during the Galactic War.
Mak'eef, callsign Babe, was a Human male who served as a lieutenant in the Republic Army and member of Eclipse Squad, a Republic Special Forces Division squad created during the Galactic War.
Revai, callsign Tap, was a Human male who served as a sergeant in the Republic Army and a member of Eclipse Squad, a Republic Special Forces Division squad created during the Galactic War.
Noray, callsign Rigor, was a Human male who served as a sergeant in the Republic Army and a member of Eclipse Squad, a Republic Special Forces Division squad created during the Galactic War.
Udanara, callsign Glory Hound, was a Human female who served as a captain in the Republic Army and a member of Eclipse Squad, a Republic Special Forces Division squad created during the Galactic War.
Nol Corovani, callsign Monarch, was a major in the Republic Army and commanding officer of Eclipse Squad, a Republic Special Forces Division squad created during the Galactic War.

Bellana was a female Cathar who was a captain in the Freebooter's Trade Union during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She often represented the Trade Union on both Carrick Station and Vaiken Spacedock.

Paolen was a male Sith pureblood who served as a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. At various times, he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock and at the contested moon CZ-198.
A male Human was the father of Gann Sakoal, a man who worked as a scientist for the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Mak Plain was a male banker of the Muun species. He worked for the InterGalactic Banking Clan on Coruscant and Scipio, often acting as a liaison between the Bank and the Galactic Republic.

Tikkes was a Quarren senator who represented his homeworld Mon Cala in the Galactic Republic's Senate around the time of the Invasion of Naboo. He had been a businessman before joining the Senate and only became a senator to increase his own fortunes.

Cato Parasitti was a Clawdite female bounty hunter. During the Clone Wars, she was hired by Cad Bane to steal a valuable holocron from the archives of the Jedi Temple, which she managed by impersonating the deceased Jedi Master Ord Enisence and later Jocasta Nu.

Trron Selus was a male soldier in the Republic Army who served as a battle coordinator at Outpost Victory, a stronghold of the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War. Selus was among the casualties when the Sith Empire sacked the outpost.
Torsin was a male who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire, leading a squad on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.
Nalto was a Human male who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.
Tulsar was a Human male who served as a sergeant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.

Treshoda was a Human female who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War. She was tasked by Imperial High Command with studying the Balmorran resistance, and dealt with defectors such as Gryffin Remus.
A Chiss male served as a delegate representing the Chiss Ascendancy to the Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.
A Human male spy in the employ of the Galactic Republic infiltrated an Sith Imperial capital ship during the Cold War, killing sixteen Imperial officers and stealing a sample of a deadly bioweapon.
Caille was a Human female agent of the Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra during the Galactic War. She was among the casualties during the invasion of the Imperial Headquarters in the city of Sobrik.

Carlon was a Human male commander in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra during the Galactic War. Carlon led the Imperial forces that captured the Balmorran resistance's Camp Shadow, and was slain in a Republic incursion to wipe the outpost's files.
Estus was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra during the Galactic War. He was among the casualties during the invasion of the Imperial Headquarters in the city of Sobrik.
Jolus was a Human male technician who was employed by Galactic Republic forces during the fighting to retake the city of Sobrik on Balmorra.
Silas Jarrde was a male Twi'lek member of the Balmorran resistance who led a resistance cell in the Sundari Flatlands during the later stages of the fighting on Balmorra during the Galactic War.
Tabo was a Human male scientist and doctor employed at the Sundari Research Grounds on the planet Balmorra.
"Jailbreaker" Klin was a Human male criminal who was imprisoned by the Galactic Republic in Belsavis prison, a prison facility on the planet Belsavis.
"Deadeye" Grath was a Human female criminal who was imprisoned by the Galactic Republic in Belsavis prison, a prison facility on the planet Belsavis.
"Left Eye" Krolak was a Weequay male criminal who was imprisoned by the Galactic Republic in Belsavis prison, a prison facility on the planet Belsavis.
Tovane was a Human male criminal who was imprisoned by the Galactic Republic in Belsavis prison, a prison facility on the planet Belsavis.
Arzhura was a Human female criminal who was imprisoned by the Galactic Republic in Belsavis prison, a prison facility on the planet Belsavis.
Troughlyn was a Human male criminal who was imprisoned by the Galactic Republic in Belsavis prison, a prison facility on the planet Belsavis.
Damono Deomaley was a short, male humanoid who was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the planet Tatooine shortly before the Battle of Yavin.

A Human Daimanate officer was present at the side of the Sith Lord Daiman during the destruction of Chelloa in 1032 BBY. He and his Sith overlord observed the ground invasion by the rival Sith Lord Odion from a mountain.

Gume Saam was a male Ishi Tib senator who represented the Techno Union in the Galactic Republic prior to and during the Clone Wars. During the conflict, he secretly furthered the interests of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Ciena Ree, known as LP888 in the Imperial Navy, was a human female First Waver villager from the planet Jelucan who fought for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. She grew up as a friend of Thane Kyrell, a second-wave aristocrat.

Thane Kyrell, later designated AV547 in the Imperial Navy, was a human male from the mountainous and remote planet of Jelucan, an Outer Rim Territory that was annexed by the Empire eleven years before the Battle of Yavin.
Crost was a male Twi'lek from the planet Ryloth who was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement during their attempt to assassinate Emperor Sheev Palpatine and the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Steen Borkas was a human male who worked for the Galactic Empire during the early years of its reign, serving on the Star Destroyer Perilous and then being stationed on the planet Ryloth.
Breehld was a human male who was the personal pilot of Imperial Moff Delian Mors, who controlled the planet Ryloth.
Erstin Deez was a human male who served in the Imperial Royal Guard, with the rank of sergeant and later major.
Drim was a male Twi'lek from the planet Ryloth who was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement during their attempt to assassinate Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine and the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Telk was a Human male agent of Imperial Intelligence, the Sith Empire's intelligence organization, during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Keldroth was a Human female Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Torwald was a Human male lieutenant in the Imperial Reclamation Service of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Fereden was a Human female sergeant in the Imperial Reclamation Service of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Plodd was a Human male lieutenant in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

Besprun was a Nautolan male logistics officer who was stationed at Belsavis prison, a Galactic Republic penal colony on the planet Belsavis, prior to and during the invasion of Belsavis by the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Ja'dan was a Human male captain who was stationed in the High Security Section of Belsavis prison, a Galactic Republic penal colony on the planet Belsavis, during the invasion of Belsavis by the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Koep was a Zabrak male sergeant in the Republic Army who was stationed in the High Security Section of Belsavis prison, a Galactic Republic penal colony on the planet Belsavis, during the invasion of Belsavis by the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Dex Tiree was a human male ace pilot from the planet Onderon who flew for the Rebel Alliance during the Battle of Yavin. During the battle, Tiree flew a BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber in Gold Squadron as Gold Two and the wingman of Jon Vander.

Davish "Pops" Krail was a human male from the planet Dantooine who served as a Y-wing pilot for the Rebel Alliance during the Battle of Yavin. Krail flew in Gold Squadron under the callsign Gold Five during the battle.
Pell Baylo was a male human who operated the Defiance Flight Training Institute for nearly fifty years, both under the Galactic Republic and its successor state, the Galactic Empire.
Bultar Swan was a Force-sensitive human female who trained as Jedi Master Plo Koon's Padawan before becoming a Jedi Knight.

Sar Labooda was a human female from the planet Chalacta who was orphaned by space pirates. She and her sister Depa Billaba were then rescued by the Jedi Mace Windu and joined the Jedi Order on the planet Coruscant.

Necus was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire who trained an apprentice during the Cold War. When Necus's apprentice was murdered in the Sith Academy on Korriban, Necus demanded that a full investigation be conducted.

Ptellung was a Ssi-ruu scientist during the Battle of G'rho. After luring the young Force-sensitive Human male Dev Sibwarra aboard a Ssi-ruuvi ship, Th'twirirl brought him to Ptellung's laboratory to be stripped, measured, and probed.
A male pilot serving the Galactic Empire, flew the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle Furious.
Drua was a female Twi'lek who lived on Ryloth in a remote village settlement, along with her grandfather.

Murra was the wife of the Imperial Moff Delian Mors. In 18 BBY, she died in a transport accident on the planet Coruscant. Mors grieved her death for several years after her passing, choosing to adopt a hedonistic lifestyle and becoming apathetic toward her work as a moff.

Tobal Siy was an Imperial commander, who was in charge of the Star Destroyer Thunder. He was often tasked with tracking Rebel smugglers in his sector. This was a great challenge to Siy, as the smugglers seemed to always be a step ahead of Siy.
Andi Tolen was a Tatooinian Human. She worked as a guide, explorer, and bounty hunter.

Tosh was an Imperial Army captain stationed on the planet Rhamalai. He informed General Yrros that the security systems were not yet installed on the planet, but Yrros replied that acquiring food for Imperial troops was their first priority, and Rhamalai was settled by technop…

Amos Granley was a Human male who lived on the planet Rhamalai during the Galactic Civil War. After the Galactic Empire arrived on Rhamalai, they rounded up and forcibly conscripted young men into the Imperial Army, including Granley, his friend Dorn Lister, and his neighbor D…

Dorn Lister was a Human male who lived on the planet Rhamalai during the Galactic Civil War. When the Galactic Empire arrived on Rhamalai, they rounded up and forcibly conscripted young men into the Imperial Army, including Lister, his neighbor Denel Moonrunner, and his friend…

Vedder was an Imperial Army major stationed on the planet Rhamalai during the Galactic Civil War. When General Yrros noticed that Denel Moonrunner looked familiar, and determined that his father was a former Imperial major named Corvus Langlier, he told Vedder to have Denel br…

Janus Greejatus was a human male official who served on the Ruling Council of the Galactic Empire. Prior to the Age of the Empire, he represented the office of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine at the homecoming of Poggle the Lesser on the planet Geonosis.
Hethan Romund was a female scholar and one of the few individuals willing to share any information of the fallen Jedi Order. During her studies she met several individuals sensitive to the Force.

Sate Pestage was a human male official who served on the Ruling Council of the Galactic Empire. During the Clone Wars, he served as a Senior Advisor of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine who sometimes acted as a bureaucrat, emissary, or a dignitary in Palpatine's name and one …

Kromer was the proprietor of the Bargoon Tatooni trading post in Mos Eisley on Tatooine. A few years before the Battle of Yavin, Han Solo visited her to acquire a replacement fulstar plate for the Millennium Falcon.

Itto Bipsmik was an Aleena Han Solo and Chewbacca met on Unagin a few years prior to the Battle of Yavin. She excused her two children for staring at Chewbacca because they'd never seen a Wookiee before.
Stim was a human male alive during the Clone Wars.

Rane Kovach was a male Human who worked undercover for the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Galactic War. Secretly an asset of Supreme Chancellor Leontyne Saresh, Kovach worked for Theron Shan of the SIS, and infiltrated Sith Intelligence on Shan's orders.

Uwa Pareece was a human female from the planet Alderaan who oversaw the Melodic Order, a group of Alderaanian musicians who had taken a vow to only have interaction with Alderaanians in order to preserve the cultural integrity of their music.

Garault was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War and Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire. A tall, broad-shouldered man, Garault bore a scar on his chin that he received while fighting the Empire.
Landai was a female Mirialan Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Sith Empire.
Onok was a Lethan Twi'lek male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Cold War and Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Jora Astane was a human female who held the title of Preserver in an enclave of Alderaanians on the planet Sullust. She led her collective and attempted to stay hidden after the destruction of Alderaan, when the Galactic Empire hunted surviving Alderaanians across the galaxy.

Hunter, formerly designated CT-9901, was a veteran Clone Sergeant who served as the commanding officer of Clone Force 99 in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, fought between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Tundra Dowmeia was a Quarren who served as the senator of Mon Cala during the Clone Wars, replacing Senator Tikkes in the Republic Senate after his defection to the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Gord Grallik was a Besalisk security chief of the mining company Moonglow Polychemical on the planet Gorse eight years after the Clone Wars. He was married to the company's supervisor, Lal Grallik.

Crosshair, formerly designated CT-9904, was a veteran clone commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as part of Clone Force 99. Crosshair possessed genetic mutations that gave him exceptional eyesight and marksmanship skills.

Tech, formerly designated CT-9902, was a clone commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as a member of Clone Force 99, also known as the "Bad Batch," and who later deserted the Galactic Empire.

Wrecker, formerly designated CT-9903, was a veteran clone commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as part of Clone Force 99. Due to genetic mutations, Wrecker was much larger and stronger than the average clone trooper.

Chi Cho was a Pantoran male politician and military leader who served as the Supreme Chairman of the Pantoran Assembly and the Exalted Ruler of the moon Pantora during the final decades of the Republic Era until his death during the Clone Wars.
Chubor was an Aleena Jedi General in the Clone Wars who led the Galactic Republic's effort to evacuate Mahran refugees during the Separatist genocide of their people.
Anger was one of five Force Priestesses who had sustained their consciousness in the Force after death and dwelt on the Wellspring of Life.
Sadness was one of five Force Priestesses who had sustained their consciousness in the Force after death and dwelt inside the Wellspring of Life.

Tivvy was a Sullustan male smuggler who lived on the planet Sullust. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, in 0 ABY, he led Princess Leia Organa of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, the rebel pilot Evaan Verlaine, and the astromech droid R2-D2 to Sullust's Alderaan Enclave.

Va Zhurro was a Jedi Master who was active in the last years of the Galactic Republic. At some point during the Clone Wars, a devastating three-year conflict that pitted the Republic against the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Zhurro spent six months caring for refugees in…

Pok was a Twi'lek male who was a part of the Free Ryloth Movement during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Eight years after the start of the Clone Wars, Pok led a team which hijacked and stole an Imperial transport carrying weapons from the Yaga Minor shipyards.

Fruun was a human male who served in the Galactic Empire in the Ryloth system five years after the end of the Clone Wars. Fruun served as a pilot in the Imperial Military, under the command of Colonel Belkor Dray.
Bornae was a young, light-skinned, human from the planet Alderaan. They lived in the Alderaan Enclave on the planet Sullust following their homeworld's destruction by the Galactic Empire.

Belkor Dray was a human male who served as an Imperial colonel on the planet Ryloth. Belkor, seeking advancement, secretly supported the anti-Empire Free Ryloth Movement in order to undermine his superior, Moff Delian Mors, for years committing treason against the Galactic Emp…

Bowenn was a male Human captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire stationed on Balmorra during the Cold War. Commanding Imperial defenses around the Balmorran Arms Factory, he executed a spy, Danak, that was delivered to him by a local Imperial sympathizer named Ivo.

Danak was a male Jedi member of the Jedi Order during the Cold War against the Sith Empire. He was part of Master Surro's group of Jedi that served as the Galactic Republic's scouts on the planet Balmorra after Grand Marshal Cheketta's defeat at the Balmorran Arms Factory.

Ivo was a male Rutian Twi'lek living on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War. A sympathizer of the Sith Empire, he spotted a man named Danak sneaking around the Balmorran Arms Factory and recognized him as a spy.
Surro was a female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Cold War and Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Stel was a male Human major of the reconstituted Sith Empire stationed on Ziost during the Galactic War.

Harlow Ricks was a male Human living on Rishi during the Galactic War. A friend of Ren Moru, he resided at the Blaster's Path cantina in the town of Raider's Cove and acted as the intermediate between Ren's pirate gang and their boss, delivering to them daily orders and handin…
Rayche Emperva was a female Nautolan living in the town of Raider's Cove on Rishi during the Galactic War.
A Yalbec queen came into conflict with the Galactic Republic's Clone Force 99 while they were on Yalbec Prime, putting down an insurrection during the Clone Wars.

Maz Kanata, also known as Maz Kanata the Usurper, Kanata the Despoiler, Kanata the Benevolent, and Kanata of the Free Fleet, was a Force-sensitive female of an unknown species, who was born over a millennium before the brewing war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Phasma, a human female stormtrooper captain of the First Order, grew up as a member of the Scyre clan on the nuclear-ravaged world of Parnassos, where she became a formidable warrior, eventually becoming the clan's military leader.

The Fifth Brother was a humanoid male Inquisitor of the Galactic Empire several years before the Battle of Yavin. On the orders of the Emperor, Darth Sidious, the Fifth Brother was dispatched by the Sith Lord Darth Vader to hunt the growing rebellion against the Empire.
Rommus was a Human male commander in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire who served during the Battle of Corellia in the Galactic War against the Galactic Republic.

Mul Sanaka was a human who owned and managed the entertainment establishment Club Deeja in the city of Keren on the planet Naboo. During the Galactic Civil War, he employed the Melodic Order, a band of Alderaanian musicians managed by Uwa Pareece.

Quarrie was a Mon Calamari male who built a prototype B-wing starfighter on the remote planet Shantipole some time after the Siege of Lothal. After the B-wing was used in the blockade of Ibaar, Project Shantipole continued under Quarrie's supervision.
Janus Kasmir was a Kalleran male who lived as a scoundrel on the planet Kaller around the time of Order 66.
The Seventh Sister was a female Mirialan Inquisitor who served the Galactic Empire and operated as a Jedi hunter in the years before the Battle of Yavin.
Mixx was the name adopted by a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic, with the military rank of Corporal, during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Gha Nachkt was a Trandoshan salvage ship captain who worked for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the intergalactic Clone Wars.

Mala was a Twi'lek who lived in a remote, technologically primitive village on the planet Ryloth. Around eight years after the start of the Clone Wars, Galactic Emperor Darth Sidious, his Sith apprentice Darth Vader and Sergeant Erstin Deez of the Emperor's Royal Guard arrived…

Nashi was a male Hutt who served Jabba the Hutt of the Hutt Clan. Around eight years after the beginning of the Clone Wars, Nashi was sent as an envoy to visit Delian Mors, Imperial Moff of the planet Ryloth.
Mirsil was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement, a resistance movement that worked to free the planet Ryloth from the Galactic Empire.
Veraul was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement, a resistance movement that worked to free the planet Ryloth from the Galactic Empire.
Div was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement, a resistance movement that worked to free the planet Ryloth from the Galactic Empire.
"Echo" was the call sign of an Imperial TIE/ph phantom pilot during the Galactic Civil War.
Whisper was a female Imperial TIE/ph phantom pilot during the Galactic Civil War. At some point, "Whisper" entered a dogfight, which necessitated entering cloaking mode.

The grandfather of Drua was a male Twi'lek native of the planet Ryloth. He lived in an isolated village with his granddaughter, during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Drua's grandfather took responsibility for Drua after her mother died.

Ellor Orgraal was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire as the governor of Ord Radama. Born around 55 BBY, he was originally a low-level bureaucrat during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, Orgraal managed to rise through the ranks by showing servile deference to…

"Bracchia" was the code name of a male Koorivar spy who worked for both the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire. During the Clone Wars, he assisted Wilhuff Tarkin's anti-Shadowfeed operation on Murkhana.
Morit Astarte was a male human born to the Astarte line of Celanon during the last years of the Galactic Republic. He was the twin brother of Aiolin Astarte and had a yellow lightsaber.

Stalpaac was a Wookiee elder of legend on Kashyyyk. Legend stated that Stalpaac saved Urothko from a Graaa'shad, at the risk of Stalpaac's own life. Urothko responded to Stalpaac's rescue by swearing the first life debt.
Mar Tuuk was a male Neimoidian who bore the rank of captain in the Confederacy of Independent Systems' naval branch during the Clone Wars.
Hathe'k was a Gree who visited the space station Vaiken Spacedock during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Thaln'k was a Gree who visited the space station Carrick Station during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Yuzzum male Wam Lufba, nicknamed "Bam," was born on the moon of Endor, but left on a visiting starship. He ended up being shanghaied into working as a pest exterminator at the palace of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine.
Kel'sara was a female humanoid commander of the Dread Host during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Ciphas was a male humanoid commander of the Dread Host during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Heirad was a male Rattataki commander of the Dread Host during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Dae'o Soset was a male Human bounty hunter who was active during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Seibahn Vabakson was a male Chiss intelligence operative who was active during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Halsia Banso was a female Human Sith Inquisitor of the Sith Empire who was active during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Traxalis Deagua was a male humanoid Sith Warrior of the reconstituted Sith Empire who was active during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Zov was a Human male sergeant in the Galactic Republic's army who served during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Republic.
Amonos was a Duros male lieutenant in the Republic Army who served during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Vannim was a Human female lieutenant in the Imperial Army who served during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Brin was a Human female lieutenant in the Imperial Army who served during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Navrata was a Human male ensign in the Imperial Army who served during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Gialto was a male soldier in the Republic Military who was part of Strike Team Oricon, a Galactic Republic task force assembled during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire to eliminate the Dread Masters on the moon Oricon.

The Galactic Republic soldier Gialto was married to a male individual during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. When Gialto was stranded in the wastes of the moon Oricon during the Dread War, he experienced hallucinations that he shot his husband.

Dumah Ba was a male Selkath who lived on the planet Manaan during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Holding the role of "Transporter," Ba was one of those responsible for overseeing departures from the Mercantile Plaza on Manaan.

Esshai was a male Selkath who lived on the planet Manaan during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Holding the role of "Transporter," Esshai was one of those responsible for overseeing departures from the Mercantile Plaza on Manaan.

Kreshin was a Human female lieutenant in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. A fair-skinned Human with brown eyes, Kreshin had her head shaved and a cranial implant installed.
Travik was a male major in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

Keikodi was a female Zabrak who served as a commander in the reconstituted Sith Empire's forces during the Korriban Incursion, when the Galactic Republic invaded the planet Korriban in 3637 BBY. during the Galactic War.

Rethana was a female Human who served as a commander of the reconstituted Sith Empire's forces during the Korriban Incursion, when the Galactic Republic invaded the planet Korriban in 3637 BBY. during the Galactic War.

Melkans was a male Chiss who served as a commander of the Sith Empire's forces during the Korriban Incursion, when the Galactic Republic invaded the planet Korriban in 3637 BBY. during the Galactic War.

Vang was a male Miraluka Sith who served as a commander of the reconstituted Sith Empire's forces during the Korriban Incursion, when the Galactic Republic invaded the planet Korriban in 3637 BBY. during the Galactic War.
Queneth Li was a Voss male who left his homeworld to accompany the Mystic Talsa-ko, who joined the New Empire of the Sith Lord Darth Malgus at the behest of Darth Serevin.

Minik was a Sullustan male who served as a security officer aboard the Valor-class cruiser Telos, a flagship of the Republic Navy, in the early days of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Starsh was a Chiss Ascendancy ensign during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Gerault was a male commander in the Imperial Guard during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Serving under General Hesker during the Battle of Ilum, Gerault was stationed at the Imperial base camp on the planet Ilum.

Logray was a male Ewok from the forest moon of Endor who served as the chief shaman of Bright Tree tribe during the Galactic Civil War. At one point during the war, Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Chewbacca, R2-D2, and C-3PO were brought to the tribe.

Janus Fhurek was a male human who served as the athletic director at the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences on the planet Lothal. With the academy's heavy focus on athletics, Fhurek was generally believed to hold more power and influence than even the Academy's headmaster.
Banley was a Human male member of the Mantellian Separatist Movement during the Separatist War on the planet Ord Mantell.
Kalyn was a Human female who lived on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War. She was abducted by the cyborg Krel and used as a subject in his experiments; Krel hoped to create "sleeper" cyborgs.

Lox was a Human male who lived on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. He was abducted by the cyborg Krel and used as a subject in his experiments; Krel hoped to create "sleeper" cyborgs.

Parr was a Human male who lived on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was abducted by the cyborg Krel and used as a subject in his experiments; Krel hoped to create "sleeper" cyborgs.
Mathin was a Human male sergeant in the Republic Army who served during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Gaff was a Human male colonel in the Republic Army who served as the local regimental commander of Republic forces on the planet Taris. He was ordered by General Garza to assist a Havoc Squad lieutenant with a mission, but was not told what the mission was.

Tane was a Human male who served as an ensign in the Republic Army during the Cold War. Stationed on the planet Taris, Tane was among a number of soldiers who were captured by the Death's Claw pirate group and imprisoned in Fallenspire Stronghold, but were freed by Havoc Squad.
Tabber was a Human male who served as a corporal in the Republic Army during the Cold War. Assigned to Search and Rescue Squad 204 on the planet Taris, Tabber served under Sergeant Elara Dorne.
Vise was a Human male who served as an ensign in the Republic Army during the Cold War. Assigned to Search and Rescue Squad 204 on the planet Taris, Vise served under Sergeant Elara Dorne.
Marko was a Human male who served as an ensign in the Republic Army during the Cold War. Assigned to Search and Rescue Squad 204 on the planet Taris, Marko served under Sergeant Elara Dorne.
Goran was a Human male who served as a corporal in the Republic Army during the Cold War. Assigned to Search and Rescue Squad 204 on the planet Taris, Goran served under Sergeant Elara Dorne.
Cav was a Human male who served as an ensign in the Republic Army during the Cold War. Assigned to Search and Rescue Squad 204 on the planet Taris, Cav served under Sergeant Elara Dorne.

Cohn was a young Human male who lived in the city of Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War. He worked as an aide to Mayor Oleg Klerren around the time that Anchorhead was the target of terrorist attacks using bomb-carrying local droids.

Ixa was a Human female who lived in the city of Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War. She worked as an aide to Mayor Oleg Klerren around the time that Anchorhead was the target of terrorist attacks using bomb-carrying local droids.
Benett was a Human male who lived in the city of Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War.
Cana was a Human female who lived in the city of Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War.

Johnston was a Human male who served as a gunnery sergeant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War, he was stationed aboard the Justice, and was killed by the elite Republic Special Forces Division unit Havoc Squad when he confronted them during their infi…
Triam was a male Kel Dor major in the Republic Army who led the Thirty-fifth Recon during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Tong was a male Zabrak sergeant in the Republic Army who served during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.

Gramm was a male Human soldier who served as a private in the Republic Army during the Cold War and Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. Private Gramm was stationed on the planet Hoth, and served in a squad commanded by Sergeant Yuun.

Freid was a male soldier who served as a private in the Republic Army during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Sith Empire. Private Freid was stationed on the planet Hoth, and served in a squad commanded by Sergeant Yuun.

Nagis was a male soldier who served as a private in the Republic Army during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Sith Empire. Private Nagis was stationed on the planet Hoth, and served in a squad commanded by Sergeant Yuun.

Orland was a male soldier who served as a specialist in the Republic Army during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Sith Empire. Orland was stationed on the planet Hoth, and served in a squad commanded by Sergeant Yuun.

Artano was a Human male major in the military of the reconstituted Sith Empire. He served as an information control specialist for General Rakton's command group. On Hoth, he tried to stop Havoc Squad from reassembling the umbra encrypter, but was defeated and killed in combat.

Fierros was a Human male colonel in the Republic Army during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Sith Empire. Stationed on Hoth, he was the commanding officer of Yuun until the time Yuun was reassigned to Havoc Squad.
Zareen was a female Cathar salvager and member of the White Maw pirates who tried to steal the Umbra encrypter from under the nose of both the Republic Army and Major Artano.
Keran Vondi was a female Human member of the Republic Navy and the gunnery officer of the Brentaal Star.

Kailur was the Twi'lek Archduke of a Galactic Republic-allied planet. He was one of several heads of state summoned by the Imperial General Arkos Rakton to a diplomatic summit on Outpost 256, where Rakton seized the heads of state by force.
Vonn was the Premier of a Galactic Republic-allied planet during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Lorro was the Nautolan male king of the Galactic Republic-allied planet Aquella. He was one of several heads of state summoned by the Imperial General Arkos Rakton to a diplomatic summit on Outpost 256, where Rakton seized the heads of state by force.

Guard Captain Zess was a Kel Dor member of Belsavis prison guard staff. During the Invasion of Belsavis he directed the Major of Havoc Squad to the location of wrongfully imprisoned Dagger Wing members.

Viray was a member of Dagger Wing, imprisoned on Belsavis along with the rest of the squadron for bombing thousands of Imperial civilians. During the Invasion of Belsavis the Republic decided to pardon Dagger Wing and return them to active duty.
Kal was a Twi'lek male member of Dagger Wing, imprisoned on Belsavis along with the rest of the squadron after the Sith Lord Ondorru tricked them into bombing civilian targets on the planet Fest.
Lin was a Zabrak female member of Dagger Wing, imprisoned on Belsavis along with the rest of the squadron after the Sith Lord Ondorru tricked them into bombing civilian targets on the planet Fest.
Ty was a Mon Calamari male member of Dagger Wing, imprisoned on Belsavis along with the rest of the squadron after the Sith Lord Ondorru tricked them into bombing civilian targets on the planet Fest.
Symo was a Twi'lek male member of Dagger Wing, imprisoned on Belsavis along with the rest of the squadron after the Sith Lord Ondorru tricked them into bombing civilian targets on the planet Fest.
Brok was a Human male guard lieutenant in the security forces of Belsavis prison, a Galactic Republic prison facility on the planet Belsavis.
Gouge was the nickname of a Chagrian male criminal who was incarcerated in Belsavis prison, a Galactic Republic prison facility on the planet Belsavis.
Myles was a male Human who was a pilot in Dagger Wing, a unit of the Republic Navy during the Great Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Synon was a Human male member of the Deadeyes, Republic Army sniper squad. When the Deadeyes were captured by the reconstituted Sith Empire as part of the plan by SIS Agent Zane to trace their locations to Dusk 9, they were split the captives and Synon ended up with Torve and …

Miev was a Sullustan member of the Deadeyes, a Republic Army sniper squad. When the Deadeyes were captured by the reconstituted Sith Empire as part of the plan by SIS Agent Zane to trace their locations to Dusk 9, they were split the captives and Synon ended up with Torve and …

Ridu was a security officer of the Galactic Republic. Stationed on Taris, he briefly commanded Elara Dorne's Search and Rescue Squad 204 during a visit by a Senator. The Senator was killed by rakghouls due to Ridu underestimating the severity of Taris' dangerous environment.
"Deadfall" was the callsign of a notorious Human male agent in the employ of the Sith Empire. Deadfall specialized in subterfuge, creating chaos on planets in advance of an Imperial invasion.

Koru Tama was a Togruta aide to Senator Evran, Republic diplomat on Voss. When the Havoc Squad Major arrived to accomplish several military objectives for Evran, Koru Tama provided him with additional objectives, such as recovering Voss artifacts and destroying Gormak snipers.

Sadoll was a Human male archaeologist working on Voss during the Galactic War. He was acquainted with Koru Tama, aide to Senator Evran, and Tama convinced Havoc Squad to retrieve a number of relics from the Old Paths region and deliver them to Sadoll at Kri-Ta Outpost.

Kellor was a Human male agent of the Republic Strategic Information Service. During the Galactic War, he worked for Senator Evran on the planet Voss, and aided Havoc Squad's search for the Sith Lord Torius.

Gon-Sa was a Voss male who served as a diplomat. He attended a meeting at which Republic Senator Evran and Sith Lord Torius were trying to convince the Voss to join their respective sides for protection.
Pol Blex was a Neimoidian arms dealer operating on Voss. He was questioned by the Havoc Squad Major regarding the location of the ZR-57 orbital strike bomb that was brought to Voss.
Mir-Ki was a Voss commando stationed at the Koss Overlook in Gormak Lands. An outsider brought him the weapons of defeated Gormak snipers, for which Mir-Ki expressed his gratitude.
Ki-Ve was a male Voss mystic who foresaw Sith Lord Torius' plan to detonate a ZR-57 orbital strike bomb at Voss-Ka.

Garen was a member of a Republic class-seven retrieval team capable of handling ZR-57 orbital strike bombs. After one such bomb was almost set off on Voss, Garen and Jak were brought in to safely retrieve it.
Jak was a member of a class-seven retrieval team capable of handling ZR-57 orbital strike bombs. After one such bomb was almost set off on Voss, Jak and Garen were brought in to safely retrieve it.

A'Koba, also known as URoRRuR'R'R, was a skilled but young Tusken Raider who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War and had cousins, A'Vor and A'Vor's twin. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, A'Koba attacked Luke Skywalker before getting scared off by Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Blue Five was a Rebel Alliance pilot of Blue Squadron. Blue Five became an ace during the ambush on Ral's Run.
Cylo was a humanoid male doctor who cybernetically enhanced himself into an immortal system capable of assuming another body when the previous one died.
Sarenda was a Force-sensitive Human female from Taanab who traveled to Spintir in order to find out more about her Force-sensitive nature.
Kaveri Ra was a Force-sensitive Togruta female who traveled to Spintir to hone her Force abilities.
Dao Jodh was a Force-sensitive Zabrak monk who traveled to Spintir to hone his Force abilities.
Tarast Voon was a Force-sensitive Kel Dor male who traveled to Spintir to rescue his former mentor, Hethan Romund.
Pon Edestus was a Force-sensitive Nautolan male and mercenary who traveled to Spintir to hone his Force abilities.
Belandi Feearr was a female Mirialan Force healer who traveled to Spintir to hone her Force abilities and save Hethan Romund.
Wuher was a human male from Tatooine who worked as a bartender at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.

Bob Hudsol was a male human who served as a sector commander and general in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Hudsol was killed when his starship was destroyed during the assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks.
Emmoridg was a male Light Sith Lord who served as an overseer for the resurgent Sith Empire on Korriban during the Galactic Cold War. He secretly trained acolytes in the light side of the Force.

Pikk Mukmuk was a Kowakian monkey-lizard kept as a pet by Hondo Ohnaka alongside his brother Pilf. Pikk was a member of the Ohnaka Gang, helping Hondo Ohnaka to do his dirty work. At some point, Ohnaka lost Mukmuk and stated that he never truly appreciated him until he was gone.
Aiolin Astarte was a female human engineered and trained by Doctor Cylo to replace the Sith Lord Darth Vader as Darth Sidious' Sith apprentice.

Daegin Strell was a male charity worker in Nar Shaddaa. He was well regarded as a leader, enough so that the Strell House was named after him. He was popular enough that even by 3643 BBY, nearly ten years after his death, his name still meant something to the populace.
Dex was a Rebel pilot and a member of Rebel Alliance. She once saved Blue Five from TIE/IN interceptors and became an ace.

Blue Leader was a Rebel pilot and the flight lead of Blue Squadron. During the ambush on Ral's Run, Blue Leader ordered the squadron into action, which resulted in the destruction of the Imperial Protector.

Graaf Savraan, also known as "The Graaf", was a Human known as a noble relative of the governor of Salliche during the early days of the Galactic Empire, and supposedly critical of Palpatine's rise to power and his actions during the Clone Wars.
Jontin was second in command and lieutenant to the crime lord Gornt Seron.

Arkan, also known by the nickname Arkan the Shark, was a Human male who was the owner and "Supreme Executive Officer" of the Lucky Runner casino on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Galactic War, a position he obtained by first murdering his way into the casino and then murderin…

Snoke was a Force-sensitive humanoid male who ruled the First Order as Supreme Leader during the New Republic Era and was considered to be a enigmatic seeker of arcane lore who possessed a dark nature from the Unknown Regions.

Tralls was the Current Events teacher at the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences in Lothal's Capital City. As a teacher, Mister Tralls used his Current Events classes to promote propaganda defending the Galactic Empire's developmental projects.

The wife of Jicoln Cadera was a Human female Mandalorian who married Jicoln, joining Clan Cadera. Jicoln and his wife had a son, Torian, and Jicoln kept the ceremonial marriage knot from his wedding as one of his most prized possessions.

Serrath was a Chagrian male representative of Esstran Exports during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He frequented the Cartel Bazaar on the Republic space station Carrick Station.

Malievo Valaine was a Human male representative of Esstran Exports during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He frequented the Cartel Bazaar on the Imperial space station Vaiken Spacedock.
The Primal Destroyer was a massive terentatek that had been imprisoned in the depths of the Tomb on the planet Belsavis by the Rakata until it was released during the invasion of Belsavis.

Havoc was a Clone Commander and Advanced Recon Commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as a member of Rancor Battalion. He served as part of the Galactic Republic's military leadership during the Battle of Kamino, in which he perished.
Simon Greyshade was a wealthy senator who represented the Vorzyd sector in the Senate of the Galactic Republic shortly before the onslaught of the Clone Wars, in 22 BBY.

Blue Six was a pilot in the Rebel Alliance's Blue Squadron and Blue Five's wingmate. During the ambush on Ral's Run, Blue Six's T-65 X-wing starfighter was damaged and the pilot tried to escape back into hyperspace.

Blue Nine was a pilot in the Rebel Alliance's Blue Squadron. During the ambush on Ral's Run, Blue Nine's T-65 X-wing starfighter was targeted by TIE/IN interceptors which were driven off by other pilots.

Melikah was a female Human Sith who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the start of the Galactic War. Part of the Sith forces that attacked the Fortitude in 3642 BBY. She fell in battle against the Barsen'thor.
Jerrod Lourdas, or Vortex 4 as his designation in Vortex Squadron, was a Human male sandspeeder pilot of the Rebel Alliance who was assigned to Vortex Squadron at Arda Base.
Rarsk was a Hutt who was evicted from the Hutt Cartel, along with Bo-Dum. He had lost his left eye, which forced him to wear an eye patch.

Sana Starros, also called Sanisi by her family, was a human female who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was once a student at the University of Bar'leth, where she had a romantic relationship with Chelli Lona Aphra.
Thongla Jur was an Anx Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Asset I-29 was a female operative for an intelligence network constructed by freelance spy and underground myth known as the Shroud.

Karbin was a Mon Calamari commander born on the planet Mon Cala in the Outer Rim and a member of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Towards the end of the conflict, his starship was damaged, causing him considerable and untreatable injuries.

Bragh was a human male Purge Trooper commander who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Following the destruction of the second Death Star, he fought for Governor Ubrik Adelhard's remnant.

homeworld: Orphaned on Burnin Konn mining colony
x: Riley was a human female thief active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Riley and her younger sibling were orphaned on the mining colony of Burnin Konn.
Faylin was a human female who was part of the Free Ryloth Movement during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Eshgo was a Twi'lek male who was part of the Free Ryloth Movement on the planet Ryloth during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Klirun was a nashtah. When the Tunroth bodyguard Shotarr Kass was attacked, Klirun savagely attacked the assailant, and became Kass's pet.
Ubrik Adelhard was a human male officer for the Galactic Empire who served as the governor of the Anoat sector with the rank of Moff during the Galactic Civil War.
Ria Clarr was a human female analyst and geologist who worked for the Galactic Empire until she became a rebel after discovering lies behind Imperial propaganda.

Brask was a Trandoshan male active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Shortly after the destruction of the second Death Star, he operated a requisitions depot on the planet Burnin Konn, located in the Anoat sector.
This puffer pig belonged to the self-described galactic entrepreneur and gambler Lando Calrissian during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Lilly was a female Near-Human Jedi Padawan learner. She had pointed ears and a canine nose, but otherwise appeared physically Human. In Roan Novachez's third year at the Jedi academy, she was a new transfer student.
This Savrip Warmaker served as the tribal leader of a group of Mantellian Savrips who fought against the Imperial garrison on Ord Mantell.
Ulaaar was a Wookiee male and leader of the Wookiee resistance during the Galactic Civil War. He fought against the Imperial garrison on Kashyyyk together with his fellow Wookiee warriors.

An clone Advanced Recon Commando commander participated in the Battle of Aridka during the Clone Wars. Protecting a city from the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the commander's force consisted of only a handful of clone troopers and another ARC trooper.

A clone Advanced Recon Commando served the Galactic Republic in the Clone Wars, and took part in the Battle of Aridka. During the battle, the ARC trooper's squad was nothing more than a handful of clone troopers in a trench with an energy shield.

Rik Torrence was a skilled and cavalier Human male sandspeeder pilot of the Rebel Alliance who was assigned as the leader of Vortex Squadron at Arda Base around five years after his recruitment after the Galactic Empire shut down a transport corporation in the Outer Rim Territ…
Jovan was a male human who served in the military forces of the Galactic Empire in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin.
TK-517 was the operating number of an Imperial stormtrooper who was stationed on Lothal a few years prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Tulon Voidgazer was a human genius who was engineered and trained by Doctor Cylo to replace the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader as Darth Sidious' enforcer.
MaDall was a Zygerrian female who operated a small enslavement empire on the planet of Oon during the Age of the Empire.
Klaatu was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto gambler who worked for Jabba the Hutt repairing the crime lord's skiffs. Klaatu also took enjoyment in Jabba's executions by rancor in Jabba's Palace.

Toryn Farr was a human female who served as a communications officer in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Toryn and her sister Samoc Farr joined the Rebellion at a young age and became the best in their areas.

Ramset (nicknamed "Ramsy" by students) was an elderly Duros man who coached the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences' grav-ball team, the AppSci SaberCats. He lived in the Capital City of Lothal, an Outer Rim planet that was part of the Galactic Empire.

Fatalissar was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. He declared a Kaggath against his rival, Darth Tormen, while within arm's reach of Tormen on the planet Ziost; however, when Fatalissar decreed the domain of the Kaggath to be the planet's surface, Tormen decapitated him mid-…
Zatch was a bounty hunter in the employ of the Hutt Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo. He was a male humanoid with red skin.
During the ambush of the Goldskin Parade, this Trandoshan mercenary served as the leader of Team Dosho, a team of elite Trandoshan mercenaries under the employment of Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo.

Gor was a roggwart whom Kaleesh General Grievous of the Confederacy of Independent Systems kept as a pet during the Clone Wars. Gor guarded his master's fortress on the third moon of the planet Vassek; he was tended to by the medical droid EV-A4-D whenever Grievous was away.
In 4 BBY, a female human was enslaved as part of an empire of a Zygerrian named MaDall. As such, the human was forced to work in a quarry, under the surveillance of several Falleen taskmasters.

Koth Vortena was a male Human from Zakuul, the capital world of the Eternal Empire. He joined the military and reached the rank of captain by the time Immortal Emperor Valkorion was assassinated and his son Arcann took the Eternal Throne, launching an invasion of the larger ga…
Kharrus was a Gran male politician who served as the senator of Kinyen in the Republic Senate during the Clone Wars. He was an ally of fellow Senator Padmé Amidala.
Turk Falso was a male Weequay member of the Ohnaka pirate gang. Falso was present when Hondo Ohnaka captured Count Dooku—leader of the Separatist Alliance—on Florrum during the Clone Wars.
Arcann was a Force-sensitive male Human who was the son of Senya Tirall and Tenebrae, who possessed the body of Valkorion, the "Immortal Emperor" of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul.

Pilf Mukmuk was a Kowakian monkey-lizard member of the Ohnaka Gang. He also had a brother, Pikk. Mukmuk was responsible for stealing the lightsabers of Anakin Skywalker and Count Dooku, allowing the Ohnaka Gang to capture Dooku on Florrum during the Clone Wars.

Vaylin was a Force-sensitive female Human daughter of Senya Tirall and Valkorion. The younger sister of twin brothers Thexan and Arcann, she displayed incredible potential in the Force since early childhood, but was also difficult to control, causing Valkorion to lock her away…
Thexan was a Force-sensitive male Human who was the son of Senya Tirall and Tenebrae, who possessed the body of Valkorion, the "Immortal Emperor" of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul.

A Human male Imperial officer served at the administration center on Sunfall Peak. He boarded the governor's shuttle to try to stop Rebel Alliance operatives. He tangled with Lieutenant Truno but was knocked out.

Ryenne was a Human engineer who was a member of the Imperial Navy for five years before becoming a resistance fighter on an backwater planet. Ryenne's group joined with the Rebel Alliance to raid the Imperial communications hub at Sunfall Peak.

Trass was a female Bothan spy and a member of a resistance group on a backwater planet. She took part in the mission to Sunfall Peak in 0 ABY. She cased the Imperial communications hub weeks before the raid.

Joreel was a female Gran and a soldier for a resistance group on an backwater planet. She created her own overpowered repeating rifle, but it was prone to overheating. Joreel took part in the mission to Sunfall Peak in 0 ABY.
The Shadow Fist Blademaster was a Chiss female who served in the Shadow Fist, the most elite unit in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. She wielded a vibrosword in battle.
The Shadow Fist Commander was a Human male who led the Shadow Fist, the most elite unit in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
The Shadow Fist Marksman was a Human male sniper who served in the Shadow Fist, the most elite unit in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War.

The Shadow Fist Scorcher was a Human male who served in the Shadow Fist, the most elite unit in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. He carried a large flamethrower assault cannon.

The Shadow Fist Demolitions Expert was a Human female who served as the demolitions expert for the Shadow Fist, the most elite unit in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. She carried a large flamethrower assault cannon.
El-Les was an Arcona male bounty hunter whom the Galactic Republic employed as a drill instructor for the Grand Army clone troopers after Jango Fett died.

A Twi'lek bounty hunter from the planet Ord Mantell who was considered to be a master with a vibroblade attempted to enter the Great Hunt in 3643 BBY, but Tarro Blood had his crew sabotage the Twi'lek, successfully eliminating the vibroblade master as Blood's competition.
Ox was a clone trooper who during the Clone Wars served under Lieutenant Trap in the Grand Army of the Republic's Tango Company.
Pulsar was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic's Tango Company during the Clone Wars.
JJR-579 was a male stormtrooper in service to the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army. In 4 BBY, he was stationed on Grand Moff Tarkin's Imperial Star Destroyer, the Sovereign, based on Lothal.

Fissol was a male Ithorian bounty hunter who worked with the Gamorrean hunter Gowski. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the pair learned of a Jedi on the planet Lothal from a Duros bounty hunter and traveled there in order to claim the bounty on the Jedi.

A criminal lead a group of tomb raiders on the planet Korriban around the year 3643 BBY. The individual, who was known as an eccentric underworld figure, smuggled in mercenaries and other looters in batches of slaves brought to the planet by the Sith Empire.

The Alliance Commander, also known as the Outlander, was a legendary Force-sensitive champion of the Galactic Republic responsible for leading the Eternal Alliance against the tyrannical Eternal Empire and destroying the ancient dark-side entity Tenebrae.

Terrab was a member of the Imperial Diplomatic Service of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. Falner Oeth claimed that Terrab and Sabini were among those blocking his efforts to start a Killik-Imperial alliance.
Nehal was a female Senator of the Galactic Republic who was assassinated along with her aide. After her death, Albathius—an operative of the Star Cabal—gave a speech in which he spoke of her death.

Yanus was a major in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire who commanded the Toxi-Trooper Brigade, a unit that specialized in operating in hostile-environment battlefronts such as the toxic planet Quesh.
Raeda-Ke was a Voss Healer Mystic who was slain by the Gormak chieftain Althu during the Galactic War. A bounty was issued on Althu's head for the crime.

Naria was a Twi'lek who resided in a remote village on the planet Ryloth. By 14 BBY, they were expecting a child. That year, Drua, a fellow villager, welcomed the Sith Lords Darth Sidious and Darth Vader to the village—unaware of their true identities.

Narmn was a green-skinned male Twi'lek from Ryloth who resided in a remote village. He stood guard for the village and was present when Drua—a fellow villager—welcomed Darth Sidious, Darth Vader and Erstin Deez to their village.

Tannrel was a private in the Imperial Army that served on the planet Tatooine. Tannrel's unit was tasked with destroying the Sons of Palawa who had been infected by the Imprisoned One, and destroyed their village with baradium explosives.
Muntanye was a captain in the Republic Military who served under Supreme Commander Jace Malcom during the Conquest of Makeb.

A female individual was the mother of the Twi'lek girl Drua, a child who lived on the planet Ryloth during the Imperial Era. The mother died in a winter season around 16 BBY, which left Drua an orphan, as the girl had never known her father.
Ion Papanoida was a Pantoran male who lived during the Clone Wars. The son of Chairman Notluwiski Papanoida, Ion was the brother of Chi Eekway Papanoida and Che Amanwe Papanoida.
Malakili was a human male from the planet Corellia who spent much of his childhood living in the slums of the moon Nar Shaddaa.

Taggart was a human who served as a captain and notable member of the Galactic Republic's elite Senate Guard during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A male smuggler worked as a black market merchant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, and sought help tracking down lost relics from a dig on the planet Dubrillion.
Darth Nacheria was a powerful female Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.
A male officer served as a commander in the Republic Military during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Jan was a Human male who was recruited into the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. At some point after joining the Rebel Alliance, he was sent on a mission to meet with the smuggler Han Solo on Corellia.
Lassa Rhayme was a Pantoran female pirate who served as the captain of the Opportunity and leader of the Blood Bone Order during the Clone Wars.
Sarin was a Lethan Twi'lek female who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as an undercover agent during the Galactic Civil War.
Tace was a female human musician who was a member of the Melodic Order during the Galactic Civil War. She was also sister to Tula, an Imperial officer.

Paddy Accu was an elderly male human who lived on the planet Naboo shortly before the outbreak of the Clone Wars. He worked as the caretaker of Varykino, an island retreat owned by the Naberrie family in the Lake Country area of Naboo.

Hewex was a male human who served as a major in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Hewex led Imperial Navy Troopers alongside Colonel Dyer.

Merumeru was a male Wookiee chieftain and captain from the planet Kashyyyk. In the last days of the Clone Wars, he led a group of Wookiee warriors into battle against the Confederacy of Independent Systems on his homeworld.

Momaw Nadon, also known as "Hammerhead," was a male Ithorian who was exiled from his homeworld of Ithor as punishment for revealing the agricultural secrets of his species to the Galactic Empire in order to save the planet.

Gachial was a male Moff of the Sith Empire who was captured by the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. Despite a Senator's calls for Gachial's execution, the Moff was treated fairly in reward for providing the Republic Strategic Information Service with valuable intelligence.
A male warlord was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, and actively hunted Republic scout ships that entered his territory.

A male holo-entertainer was particularly popular during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, but took a political stance against the Republic's policies in dealing with the Empire.
Endaw N'gard'm was a journalist who worked for The Coruscant Holo Net newspaper during the Clone Wars. Around 20 BBY, this reporter wrote an article about the devastating battle of Phorose.

CT-1008 was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic. Around 20 BBY, he served under Jedi General Plo Koon during the battle of Phorose. Images of the battle taken from his clone-cam were used by journalist Endaw N'gard'm while writing his report.
Kin Robb was a human female politician who represented the planet Taris in the Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

affiliation: Masse Goskey's Arms Emporium and Explosives Mart
x: Ephant Mon was a Chevin male from the planet Vinsoth who worked as a mercenary before deciding it was less dangerous to sell weapons as an arms dealer than it was to use them.
A Human male officer in the Imperial Military was the member of a prominent family during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
A Sith Lord lived during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, and was known for being particularly irate.
Po Nudo was a male Ualaq Aqualish who represented his homeworld of Ando in the Galactic Republic's Senate around the time that the Trade Federation invaded the planet Naboo.

Saelt-Marae was a Yarkora male who worked as an informant for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. He would pose as a merchant and uncover plots against the Hutt while at Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine.

Korussk was a male Trandoshan bounty hunter who was particularly paranoid about his wealth during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, leading him to implement four-step authentication on all of his accounts.
Moga Berganto was a male financier who, during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, ran the largest pyramid scheme on the moon Nar Shaddaa.
Theron Nett was a human who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a rebel pilot in Red Squadron during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Orrimaarko was a male Dressellian who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
An eccentric admiral had, by 3637 BBY, hinted that he wished to acquire a gold-plated astromech droid owned by Garblaque the Hutt.

Dreed was a human who served the Galactic Empire as a commander during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Dreed was tasked with hunting down Alderaanians who had survived the destruction of their homeworld of Alderaan.
An Alder-Espirion hybrid from the planet Espirion served as the captain of the starship Espirion Multi during the war between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
Sutha was a Hutt who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Sutha served the powerful Hutt Clan, primarily the clan's leader, Jabba.
A Nautolan musician was popular during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Spots Podal was a Gotal male who resided on the galactic capital of Coruscant during the Clone Wars. During the war, Podal encountered Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano, who was on the run from the Coruscant Security Force, in the Coruscant Underworld.
Chiffonage was a human who served in the Rebel Alliance's military as a commander during the Galactic Civil War.
Rangos Lanar was a Human male who was the Duke of House Lanar, one of the Great Houses of Alderaan, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a famous male Mandalorian warrior sought help in identifying a masked opponent that he fought to a draw on the planet Circarpous V so that he could battle them again.

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a female customs officer reneged on a deal to smuggle arms to the planet Tepasi for a local crime syndicate, and was forced to seek help in escaping the syndicate's retribution.

Diirn was the chief engineer of the Theoretika, a research vessel operated by the Czerka Corporation. When the Theoretika became stranded in deep space, Vice Engineer Xarval eventually led a mutiny against Diirn, believing that Diirn was redirecting power to the labs in order …
Ssaria was a human female who served the Galactic Empire as a moff and as the governor of the sector that contained the planet Castell.
Covis was a human male Alderaanian who lived in the Alderaan Enclave on the volcanic planet Sullust during the Galactic Civil War.

Tee Watt Kaa was a male Lurmen who led a village on the Outer Rim world of Maridun during the Clone Wars. A devout pacifist, Kaa refused to engage in any sort of combat, even if his own life was in danger.
Rapotwanalantonee, better known as Rappertunie, was a Shawda Ubb male from the planet Manpha who played the Growdi Harmonique in the Max Rebo Band.

Malefax was a tattooed Devaronian male and a Dark Jedi. He carried robes and an ancient Sith sword. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, he fell under the sway of the fallen Jedi Rav Naaran, who was held in stasis at the Dawn Temple.

During the Jedi Padawan Roan Novachez's third year at the Jedi academy at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, hundreds of clones of the voorpak known as Voorpee were created. The clones were first used as part of a prank against Novachez when he was caring for the voorpak.
Suvaar was a Human male who was the Sith apprentice of Lord Mohgren, a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Mohgren was a Human male who was a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. During the invasion of Belsavis in the Galactic War, Mohgren sought to free the mysterious prisoner Subject 13 from deep within the Tomb on Belsavis, but his expedition of slaves failed to…

The Armored Whisper was a male Esh-kha savant who was freed from imprisonment in the Tomb on Belsavis during the Galactic War. The Armored Whisper was among the Esh-kha warriors who took over the canyon known as the Scar, but was slain.
The Night Jaws was a male Esh-kha priest who was freed from imprisonment in the Tomb on Belsavis during the Galactic War.
Calm Mind was a Force-sensitive male Esh-kha who imprisoned along with the rest of his species in the Tomb on Belsavis until the invasion of Belsavis during the Galactic War.
Concealed Voice was a male Esh-kha who imprisoned along with the rest of his species in the Tomb on Belsavis until the invasion of Belsavis during the Galactic War.

Fatal Elegy was a male Esh-kha who imprisoned along with the rest of his species in the Tomb on Belsavis until the invasion of Belsavis during the Galactic War.
Stands Tall was a male Esh-kha who imprisoned along with the rest of his species in the Tomb on Belsavis until the invasion of Belsavis during the Galactic War.
A male Ranat bounty hunter and his Nimbanel colleague visited Lothal's spaceport about five years before the Battle of Yavin.
This Nimbanel bounty hunter and his Ranat colleague visited Lothal's spaceport about five years before the Battle of Yavin.
Block was an admiral of the Galactic Republic navy, who served aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Vigilance during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Tholme was a male Jedi Master who trained Quinlan Vos.
Plaguehorn was a massive reek that was infected with the rakghoul plague during a resurgence of the plague on the planet Tatooine. It lived in the Jundland Wastes until it was slain.
Pasqual was a human who served the Galactic Empire as a commander onboard the Sienar Fleet Systems Orbital Shipyard CC-24.

Toren, known as Papa Toren, was a Axaleem male crime lord who operated on the planet Castell. After Lando Calrissian recovered one of his trinkets, Toren coerced the smuggler into stealing the Emperor Palpatine's personal yacht Imperialis in order to pay off the rest of his debt.
Korin Pers was a female Ugnaught scholar who held the position of sava at the University of Bar'leth in the Core Worlds during the reign of the Galactic Republic.
Norra Wexley (née Susser) was a female rebel pilot from the planet Akiva who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Habbaz was a Human male who was a captain in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Hayg was a Human male who was a Master Sergeant in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. During the invasion of Belsavis, Hayg was stationed at the deep launchpoint transfer far into the Tomb.
Byten was a Human male who was a commander in Imperial Non-human Relations, a division of the reconstituted Sith Empire operating during the Galactic War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Kav Bayons was a male Chagrian Jedi Knight who fought for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Grang was a Human male who was a commander in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Anhur was a male humanoid who was a field commander in the Republic Military during the Galactic War. During the invasion of Belsavis, Anhur was the chief of security at the Prison Geothermal Collectors in the High Security Section and led a contingent of soldiers and Jedi in …
This stormtrooper was a human male stormtrooper officer of the Imperial Army. He visited Old Jho's Pit Stop with his men in search of a treasonus woman named Ria Clarr.
Jay Jay was a Gungan, one of Jar Jar Binks' children.

Jo Jo was a Gungan, one of Jar Jar Binks' children. When Darth Vader crashed on Naboo shortly after the fall of the Jedi Order, Jar Jar Binks was there to greet him and introduced Vader to his children: Jo Jo, Jay Jay and Jee Jee.
Jee Jee was a Gungan, one of Jar Jar Binks' children.
Armitage Hux was a human male who served as a general in the military forces of the First Order during the New Republic Era.

A male Imperial fleet officer serving under Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin was in charge of the Empire's Subjugation of Mon Calamari. Enslaved during the conflict, the Mon Calamari Gial Ackbar entered the service of the fleet officer as an interpreter and servant.

Beebox was a male bounty hunter of an unknown humanoid alien species active during the Galactic Civil War. After joining Chelli Lona Aphra, Bossk, Krrsantan, and IG-90 on the Son-tuul Pride robbery, Beebox eventually received a bounty to kill or capture Aphra.
Blackout was a special ops Clone Commander who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Chiron was a lieutenant of the Galactic Empire, stationed at the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal. He was an enthusiastic officer who would often lead cadets in song during morning runs.
Blood Scream was a male Esh-kha warrior who was imprisoned with the rest of his species by the Rakata in the Tomb on Belsavis.
Gravak'k was an enormous wampa that was under study by the droids of the Gray Secant research vessel. It was contained in a cave on the planet Ilum until it was released and slain.
Karis was a Dathomirian female member of the Nightsisters during the Clone Wars. She and her sister Naa'leth were both regarded as the strongest warriors of the clan.
Korum was a Human male who was a Master Sergeant in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Locke was a Human male who was a major in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Darth Shaar was a Sith female who was a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Medechas was a Human male who was a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Igro was a Human male criminal who was imprisoned in Belsavis prison until freed by the reconstituted Sith Empire during the invasion of Belsavis in the Galactic War.

Gholan was a Devaronian male criminal who was imprisoned in Belsavis prison during the Galactic War. A crazed Force-sensitive with some training, Gholan somehow survived four execution attempts by the Galactic Republic, forcing the Republic to send him to Belsavis.
Aang was a Roonan senator for the planet Roona who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars, a galaxy-wide conflict between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Snes was a Besalisk who worked as muscle at Club Deeja on the planet Naboo shortly after the Battle of Yavin.

Vaor Khazlan was a male Human and Mandalorian bounty hunter who lived during the Galactic War. In Raider's Cove on the planet Rishi, he helped train fellow bounty hunters who were willing learn from the veteran hunter.

Zarro was a human female who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, her homeworld of Andelm IV was dominated by the gangster Jaum, who forced her and her father, Arrax, to work as slaves in the Andelm beetle caverns after they …

Qor'thest, known as Qor'thest the Guardian, was a Force-sensitive male who was a member of the Dread Host, the armies of the Dread Masters during the Galactic War. During the Dread War on Oricon, Qor'thest was among the defenders of the Dread Fortress, but was slain in battle.

Draxus was a male member of the Dread Host, the armies of the Dread Masters during the Galactic War. During the Dread War on Oricon, Draxus was the Gate Commander of the Dread Fortress, commanding the Dread Host forces that defended the fortress' main gate.

Grob'thok—known as Grob'thok, Who Feeds the Forge—was a cyborg rancor that was altered by the Dread Masters and put to work in the forges of the Dread Fortress on the moon Oricon. During the Dread War in the Galactic War, Grob'thok was killed by invading forces.

Jak was a male individual who lived with his father, Rorak, on the planet Coruscant during the Galactic Civil War. His father raised him to believe that, one day, the Galactic Empire would fall and the galaxy would be a better place.

Gev Hessan, pilot number 45236, was a male Devaronian smuggler who owned the HH-87 Starhopper Rover. He was a friend of Lando Calrissian and was reported to have died in the custody of the Galactic Empire.
Nils Tothwin was a human male who served as an Imperial Navy lieutenant during the Galactic Civil War. He served under Admiral Rae Sloane on board the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vigilance.
