Felusia Stato was a female Human who lived during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. A merchant like her relatives Meridat, Nelva, and Clem, Felusia Stato sold furniture and decorations.

Nala Aldel was a female Human who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. She made her living as a merchant for Binary Star Realty aboard Vaiken Spacedock.

Meridat Stato was a female Human who lived during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. A merchant like her relatives Felusia, Nelva, and Clem, Meridat Stato sold furniture and decorations on the space station Vaiken Spacedock.
The mother of Asajj Ventress was a female Dathomirian Nightsister who lived on the planet Dathomir some time before the Invasion of Naboo.

Windy was a human male who was a childhood friend of Luke Skywalker, a moisture farmer from Tatooine who later joined the Rebel Alliance. Other members of this circle of friends included Biggs Darklighter, Camie Marstrap, Deak, and Laze Loneozner.

Ord Enisence was a male Skrilling Jedi Master who was killed during the Clone Wars. The shapeshifting Clawdite bounty hunter Cato Parasitti posed as the late Enisence as part of Cad Bane's infiltration of the Jedi Temple.
Oollie was a Human female who resided on Coruscant. Sometime after 28 BBY, while Oollie was a teenager, she was familiar with swoop racing in the industrial sector of the Coruscant underworld.

Talus was a Human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. He fought to defend the Republic's Adegan crystal reserves in the Republic crystal refinery on Ilum during the Battle of Ilum, but was slain.
A male individual lived during the final years of the Tionese War, which was fought between the Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion from 24,000 BBY to 23,900 BBY.
Plix was a pilot who flew for the Galactic Empire out of the Imperial Bright Jewel Oversector Flight Base located on the moon Axxila III.

Rakshu was a Mahran female who was a member of the Ashu bloodline during the Clone Wars. She was the mother of Ashu-Nyamal, Teegu, and Kamu. She was killed in space with her family during the escape from Mahranee after Separatist forces attacked the planet.

Ashu-Nyamal, also known as Nya, was a Mahran who was the Firstborn of Ashu, a prominent bloodline of Mahran during the Clone Wars. She was the daughter of Rakshu and the older sister of Teegu and Kamu.

Teegu was a female Mahran who was the Secondborn of Ashu, a prominent bloodline of Mahran during the Clone Wars. She was the daughter of Rakshu, her mother, the younger sister of Ashu-Nyamal, and the older sister of Kamu. She had a gift for soothing any squabble.

Kamu was a male Mahran who was a member of Ashu, a prominent bloodline of Mahran, who lived during the Clone Wars. He was the son of Rakshu, his mother, and the younger brother of Ashu-Nyamal and Teegu. Prior to the attack on Mahranee, he was on his way to becoming an artist.
An alien woman was among the natives of Vyndal who welcomed Yeleb in their village after he landed on their homeworld. They had a son who was easily frightened.
Rill was an Espirion who held the title of consul on his homeworld of Espirion during the war between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
Chatter was a rookie radio communications clone trooper who participated in the Second Battle of Geonosis.
Rodjnik was the communications officer of Moff Broysc.

Yahenna Laxo was a heavyset human male who lived on Lothal. He was the head of a criminal organization, the Gray Syndicate, based in a disused tavern in Lothal's Capital City once known as Ake's Tavern.

Rosey was a female Rodian who was a member of the Gray Syndicate on the planet Lothal. She was killed by stormtroopers when the Galactic Empire raided Ake's Tavern, the headquarters of the Gray Syndicate.

Gort/Vort was the nickname of a human male who worked for the Gray Syndicate. His actual name was apparently either Gort or Vort, but Merei Spanjaf could never remember which and thus came to think of him as "Gort/Vort."
Avorr was a male Sith Pureblood who was a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, where he could be found on Vaiken Spacedock.
Saviel was a female Human Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. She was present on Vaiken Spacedock.

Hold was a male Human Sith Lord who served the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, where he could be found on Vaiken Spacedock and trained other Sith Warriors.

Romorron, known as Romorron the Slayer, was a male bounty hunter during the Cold War and Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, where he could be found selling armor to other hunters on Vaiken Spacedock.
Faliden was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, where he could be found on Vaiken Spacedock and sold armor to other Sith Warriors.

Kassien was a female Rattataki Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic. A merchant, she sold armor to Sith Inquisitors on Vaiken Spacedock.

Tanzu was a male Sith Pureblood who was a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, where he could be found selling armor to Sith Inquisitors on Vaiken Spacedock.

Jolda was a female Human who was a sergeant in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when she was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.
Kidles was a female Human who was a sergeant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when she was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.

Jaral was a male Human who was a major in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.

Damaris was a male Human who was a sergeant in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock and the planet Quesh at various times.
Charol was a male Human who was a lieutenant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.
Hirra was a male Human who was a corporal in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.

Hooll was a male Chiss who was a private in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.
Guon was a male Human who was a private in the Imperial Military of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.
Navik was a male Human who was a major in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.

Noros was a male Human who was a lieutenant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.

Jule was a Human male who was an ensign in the Imperial Navy of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.
Emarra was a female Human who was a major in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when she was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.

Mariin was a female Human who was a lieutenant in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War with the Galactic Republic, when she was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.
Opelan was a male Human who was a sergeant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.
Londar was a male Human who was a sergeant in the Imperial Army of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, when he was stationed on Vaiken Spacedock.

Mot-Not Rab was a male Tarnab senator who represented the Tarnab species in the Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Naboo Crisis and the Clone Wars. During the war he claimed to be a patriot of the Republic and was a steady supporter of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine.

Holshef was a human male native of the Outer Rim Territories planet Lothal. Although he had a great love for his homeworld, Holshef was disturbed by its slow ruination by the Galactic Empire. By 4 BBY, he was an old man with wispy white hair who painted and wrote poetry.
Tarinn was a Human male who served the Sith Empire as a Head Jailer at the Imperial Holding Facility in Camp Conquest on the planet Balmorra during the time of the Cold War.

Lavik was a Twi'lek male private in the Rift Alliance Coalition Forces during the Galactic War. He served under the Lieutenant Felix Iresso on Hoth and assisted the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order during the Jedi's mission to Hoth.

Akar-Deshu (often called "Desh" by his friends) was a male Mahran who served as a Jedi Knight during the Clone Wars. A close friend to Jedi Master Quinlan Vos, Akar accompanied him on multiple missions during the war.
Lazarus Armand was the second in command of the New Republic Intelligence Service in the Vilonis sector.

Prost was an Imperial Navy officer and a Captain of a Victory II-class Star Destroyer. Prost's task force found itself reacting to a rapidly strengthening New Republic, but also a Corporate Sector Authority fleet under Baruche Sloane exploiting the chaos to expand their influe…

Riin Raas was a male Sullustan who served with the New Republic Intelligence Service. He was imbedded on Kirima, operating undercover as a Commission for the Preservation of the New Order Imperial Security Bureau Surveillance agent.

Bren-Jules Rordan was a Commission for the Preservation of the New Order. He joined the Sub-Adult Group as a teenager and became an Observer before joining the Imperial Security Bureau's Surveillance branch.

Bren-Nevin Rordan was a New Republic Intelligence Service agent. A native of Kirima, he joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic after the destruction of Alderaan, trained as an intelligence agent then returned to Kirima.
A Sith Lord ruled on the Outer Rim planet Athiss millennia before 0 BBY. He was betrayed by his allies, killed, and entombed in a sarcophagus deep inside his own temple.

Yarna d'al' Gargan was a female Askajian whose father was a tribal chief back on her homeworld of Askaji. She was captured by enslavers and transported to the desert planet of Tatooine, where the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure bought her.

Darth Atroxa was a Lethan Twi'lek female who was a Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. During the Eternal Empire's campaigns against the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, Atroxa took control of the forces defending the Sith homeworld of Korriban, but was slain by Prince Arcann …
A female Bimm served as an ensign aboard the Anakin Solo in 40 ABY. She was present aboard the ship's bridge during the Battle of Kashyyyk.

A Near-Human male was captain of a Rebel Alliance transport. A few weeks after the Battle of Yavin, he moved a team of operatives from a starport to Titan Base to prepare for a mission. He was laconic and surly, and closed the bridge off during the trip.

The Sleeper was an ancient creature native to the depths of Dathomir. It had two large lavender eyes, a carapace-covered body, antennae, and four appendages, the upper pair resembling sickles with spear-like points while the lower appendages were tentacles.
Kird Telak was a pirate and leader of Telak's Terrors. He was a former Imperial scout for six years until he grew bored of the profession, and so turned to piracy.
Felis Alverite was a Ropagu representative who was the first point of contact for travelers arriving at the Off-Worlders' Quarter on the planet Ropagi II.

Tepha Leonis was a female human who lived on the planet Lothal 13 years after the end of the Clone Wars. Tepha, married to Leo Leonis, was the mother of Dhara and Zare Leonis, both of whom enrolled in the Academy for Young Imperials.
Hawk was a Clone Lieutenant and pilot who served in the Galactic Republic Starfighter Corps during the Clone Wars.
Marse Deboora was the husband of Sinya Deboora, Seltos' Magister of Trade. He was a staunch supporter of the New Republic.

Sinya Deboora was the Magister of Trade for the planet Seltos, and an Imperial spy. She was the wife of Marse Deboora, and was in league with Lieutenant B. Hensworth of the Imperial Army in an effort to return Seltos to Imperial control.
Elevan the Boastful wore polished metal armor, and was torn to pieces by a creature at the roc aeries on the planet Skye.

Shiko Tanderris was the vice-president of the Drearian Defense Conglomerate. After rescuing the DDC president's son from Thalassian slavers, Corvastan Benelex asked Tanderris for a two-million credit loan as well as arms concessions to start House Benelex.
During the Clone Wars, a clone trooper served with a team of Jedi and clones during the mission to infiltrate Skytop Station.
A clone trooper pilot served in the Battle of Quell during the Clone Wars, piloting a LAAT/i gunship that was attacked by a B2-RP super battle droid.

Tessek was a male Quarren who was an accountant for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure, as well as a patron of his, enjoying the decadent atmosphere of Jabba's Palace and frequenting parties there.
Wag Too was a Lurmen healer and the son of Tee Watt Kaa, the elder of Maridun's Lurmen village, who lived during the Clone Wars.

Hermi Odle was a male Baragwin gangster who worked as a weapons specialist and as the personal armorer of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure, helping to craft defenses for the Hutt's palace on the planet Tatooine.
Tub was a Lurmen male who lived in Maridun's Lurmen village. He was a close friend of Wag Too.
Thi-Sen was a Talz male who served as the chieftain of a Talz tribe on Orto Plutonia during the Clone Wars.

t: Unidentified Resolute navigation officer (Battle of Ryloth)
x: A clone navigation officer served aboard the Resolute during the Clone Wars, participating in strategy planning for the Battle of Ryloth.

M'Ba-Tee was a male Besalisk Jedi Master who made a guest appearance at the Jedi academy during Roan Novachez's second year of attendance. In Roan's third year, he became the Jedi mentor to Padawan Shi-Fara and was seen training her in multitasking.

Lackbar was a female Mon Calamari Jedi Master who was the librarian at the Coruscant Jedi Academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's three years of attendance. She taught two classes there. During Roan's third year, she became the Jedi Master to Gaiana.
Marren Dask was a male who served in the Rift Alliance's Coalition Force during the Galactic War. He was killed on Hoth by the White Maw pirate, Valon.

Zaun was a Sullustan male private in the Rift Alliance Coalition Forces during the Galactic War. He served under Lieutenant Felix Iresso on Hoth and received aid from the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order during the Rift Alliance's Mission on Hoth.

Cawelyn was a Human male private in the Rift Alliance Coalition Forces during the Galactic War. He served under Lieutenant Felix Iresso on Hoth and was assisted by the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order during the Rift Alliance's Mission to Hoth.
Kavaros was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was stationed on Voss at the time.
Darsius was a naval commander during the Waymancy Storm of 7811 BBY. He commanded several lines of cruisers at a confrontation at Brightday.
Hench Sina was a male Aqualish who played fullback for the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences' grav-ball team, the AppSci SaberCats.
Zylvarstar was a Human female who was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Shara Bey was a human female pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Kes Dameron was a human male soldier who served as a sergeant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was married to Shara Bey, a Rebel pilot, with whom he had a son named Poe.

Thanoth was a human who served the Galactic Empire as an extremely skilled inspector. He was assigned to the Sith Lord Darth Vader as an adjutant in order to help investigate a large sum of credits confiscated from the Son-tuul Pride being stolen from an Arquitens-class light …
Frid Kelio was a male Rodian who played striker for the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences' grav-ball team, the AppSci SaberCats.

Langer was a male resident of the planet Tatooine during the early years of the Galactic Empire. A relative of Magda Ulbreck, Langer was employed as a security guard on the moisture farm belonging to her husband, Wyle Ulbreck.

Kada Jahr was a female Devaronian who was the daughter of the well-known mercenary Arann Jahr. Kada served as the head of security of Jabba the Hutt between the Battle of Yavin and the Battle of Hoth.
Medcha Wanto was a male Talz who served as scribe to the Talz chieftain Thi-Sen.
Lotho Pelhane was a Human male who resided on the planet Tatooine during the final years of the Galactic Republic and the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Raith Sienar was a wealthy male engineer and starship designer who was active during the reign of Emperor Sheev Palpatine. He was the Chief Executive Officer of Sienar Fleet Systems, one of the Galactic Empire's foremost military manufacturers.
Kekit was a Jawa operating on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Nhego Roolan was an Aqualish male crime lord who was active during the Galactic Civil War. At some point after Battle of Yavin, he bribed Tusken Raiders to steal contraband from Jabba.
Teedo was a green-skinned humanoid scavenger who operated in the wastes of the desert world of Jakku approximately thirty years after Battle of Endor.

Shan was a human who served as a captain in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. Shan commanded one of three Star Destroyers sent to the recover the Imperialis—personal pleasure corvette of Galactic Emperor Palpatine—when it was stolen in the Castell system.

The eldest daughter of Hiram Zataire, a captain in the Galactic Empire's naval forces, ran a vineyard on Naboo. Like the rest of her family, with the exception of her brother, she adhered to the political program of the Empire.
Yarua was a Wookiee male and an elder statesman who, in the last years of the Galactic Republic, represented Kashyyyk in the Galactic Senate.
"Green" was a male swooper who rode with the crime lord Jabba the Hutt's swoop gang.
"Gray" was a male swooper who rode with the crime lord Jabba the Hutt's swoop gang.

This mercenary, a member of a group of mercenaries operating from the space station Falcon's Nest, was part of an attack on the Bothan Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser Tal'cara, which was meeting with the Alliance MC80 Star Cruiser Liberty.
