x: Talek Var was a scout cadet leader training with the New Republic's Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services. During the scout's six-month training mission, Var and his cadets, along with their veteran instructors, discovered a real Imperial hidden base.

Ramsey Lanclo was a Human male who piloted the starship Chicanery, and owned the modified cooking droid XDL-67. Often shipping legitimate cargo, such as power generators and prefab shelters, he occasionally turned to illicit goods when he was low on credits.

Caria Haal was the female Imperial governor of the planet Spintir. She was corrupt, and used her position to get funding for the University of Reles, and house her personal collection of relics in a secure wing of its Museum of Spintir.

Heder Brant was a male Human Imperial Security Bureau liaison stationed at the Imperial garrison on the backwater planet Spintir in 0 ABY. Brant did not like his posting on Spintir, nor the way the wealthy citizens in the city of Reles tried to be sophisticated.

Beon Beonel was an Alder-Espirion hybrid male who lived on the planet Espirion. He acted as chief of the Alder-Espirion population when the Alderaanian Princess Leia Organa sent representatives to the planet in 0 ABY to urge them to join her in rescuing all Alderaanians who ha…

Chanath Cha was a human female bounty hunter who operated during the Galactic Civil War. After her parents Ramat and Bhada were killed by Darth Vader during a hit on Cabarria, Cha swore revenge on the Sith Lord and vowed to kill him.

Jyn Erso, known by the aliases Kestrel Dawn, Jyn Dawn, Tanith Ponta, Liana Hallik, Lyra Rallik, and Nari McVee, was a human female soldier and former criminal who became a pivotal member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic when she led Rogue One in stealing the Death Star …
Tahm Rendu was a male Human who served as member of the Jedi Order during the time of the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Jace Rendu was a male Human who served as member of the Jedi Order during the time of the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Shan Burku was a male Human trooper who served as member of the Republic Military during the time of the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
Clars was a male Twi'lek who served the crime lord Nilya Fek'ra as a doorman. He wore elegant clothing, and carried a comlink with ear receiver and a datapad.
Brefest Torr was the manager of Dravian Starport during the Galactic Civil War. He was a wealthy businessman before accepting the post.

Djeon Thilloch was a male humanoid Force-sensitive Revanite during Galactic War. Around 3637 BBY, he was stationed on the planet of Rishi, where he served as a commander at Revanite Valley Stronghold on Sky Ridge Island.

Yorseg was a minor crime lord who operated out of a base on the moon of Carz. He double-crossed the crew of the freighter Smoking Blaster after first hiring them to deliver a shipment of security droid logic matrixes to Nilya Fek'ra, then setting pirates on them to steal the c…

Riza was a female. During the Galactic Civil War, Riza was chased by a bounty hunter. Both of them flew Ikas-Adno 22-B Nightfalcon speeder bikes. Riza managed to outfly her pursuer, and the bounty hunter crashed into some trees.
Lennar was a Human male con artist and mercenary. Mangy and scarred, Lennar considered himself to be a ladies man, but was in truth repulsive, overbearing, and incompetent.
Byun Tenab was a Sullustan smuggler and scavenger. A skilled pilot, his starship was filled with junk and rubbish.

Defaris Muslo was an Imperial governor who despised the Alliance to Restore the Republic, blaming them from the death of his daughter, Marna. Cruel, cunning, and manipulative, Muslo was known to construct elaborate traps to capture Rebels.

Marna was the daughter of Imperial governor Defaris Muslo, and a operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She was captured and killed by an Imperial interrogation droid; her father did not know of her allegiance, and blamed the Alliance for her death.
Sulahb was a female Sullustan mechanic. A quiet and hardworking person, she was meticulous in her work.
Uris assembled a team of scientists and bankrolled a project to create nanogene droids on the planet Voorsbain.
Nomas was a male Human who ran a salvage yard during the Galactic Civil War. Nomas was overly talkative on occasion, and was not fond of the Galactic Empire due to their taxes on starship parts.
Zenn was a male bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War.
Suljo Warde was a Human male Chandrilan Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Straden was a female Human general in the Republic Army before joining the radicalized Order of Revan during the Galactic War.
Kantale was a male Sith who held the title of Sith Lord in the reconstituted Sith Empire before he joined the radicalized Order of Revan during the Galactic War.
Zunor was a female Cathar who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order before she joined the radicalized Order of Revan during the Galactic War.
Inkari was a female Human officer in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire who joined the radicalized Order of Revan during the Galactic War.

Morfizo was a pale skinned and yellow-eyed Moragan who lived on the planet Moraga shortly after the end of the Clone Wars. When the former Jedi padawan Caleb Dume landed on Moraga in his starship the Escape, Morfizo greeted him as he exited the vessel and asked for his name.

Shortpaw was a male Chadra-Fan who was publicly known as a junk dealer on the mining colony Burnin Konn, but in secret he was the leader of the Trade Spine League, a union/privateer organization which operated in the Anoat sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Khalu was a male Kyuzo member of the South Sector Sinners gang on the planet Burnin Konn. He was killed by the Smuggler for stealing cargo from the Trade Spine League.
The male Zabrak Tryken served as a bodyguard for the gangster "Happy" Dapp on the planet Burnin Konn during the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire.
Brother Claw was a male crime lord who controlled the Brother Claw Gang on the mining world Burnin Konn during the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire.
Dapp, known by his street name "Happy" Dapp, was a human male gangster who operated on the planet Burnin Konn during the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector.
A Sullustan female cryptologist assisted in the training of clone commandos some time before the outbreak of the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 22 BBY.

A male provost oversaw the academy of the Judicial Department during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. He held the post when Wilhuff Tarkin attended the Judicial Academy as a young cadet, and was a friend of Senator Sheev Palpatine.

Salikk was a male Gotal pilot who worked for Berch Teller and his rebel cell when they hijacked the Carrion Spike, the personal vessel of Moff Wilhuff Tarkin. He had worked with Teller on Antar 4 as an anti-Separatist partisan before joining his plan to hijack Tarkin's corvette.

An human male officer served as the captain of the Liberator, a Venator-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy. Short, bearded, and grey-haired, he commanded the Liberator when it was deployed to Nam Chorios in 14 BBY.

Ros was an Imperial Navy commander who acted as the captain of the carrier Goliath in 14 BBY. The Goliath spent time at a dock at Ord Mantell before it arrived at Nam Chorios under Ros' command to aid Moff Wilhuff Tarkin and Darth Vader in defending the planet from a possible …
Fensi Moisk was a Kajain'sa'Nikto spacer who was active in the twilight years of the Galactic Republic. He served as a crew member of the Kintan Comet.

A Twi'lek individual worked as a racketeer for the Black Sun on Murkhana around the time of the Clone Wars. Just after the conflict ended, the racketeer was executed by Darth Vader during one of his first missions as a Sith apprentice.
An administrator managed a refueling facility in orbit of Phindar. He spoke with Moff Wilhuff Tarkin aboard the facility when Tarkin arrived to refuel his corvette.
Jessika Pava, also known as Jess or Testor, as well as the Great Destroyer by droids, was a human female pilot of the Resistance during the war against the First Order.
BoShek was a Force-sensitive Corellian human male from Corellia who worked as a swoop racer, smuggler, and pilot-for-hire during the Imperial Era.
The criminal leader Cabrool Nuum had a wife at some point before his death in 5 BBY.

Quig was a member of an unidentified purple-skinned humanoid species that served as a bodyguard to Cabrool Nuum, leader of the House of Nuum. The fate of Quig and his partner Spunto after Jabba the Hutt killed all members of the family was unknown.

Spunto was a member of an unidentified purple-skinned humanoid species that served as a bodyguard to Cabrool Nuum, leader of the House of Nuum. The fate of Spunto and his partner Quig after Jabba the Hutt killed all members of the family was unknown.

Lonka was a member of an unidentified purple-skinned humanoid species who served as a bodyguard to Cabrool Nuum, leader of the House of Nuum. He guarded Jabba the Hutt while he was kept in the House of Nuum's dungeon.

Brahtikka was a female Wookiee smuggler who often worked as an insertion specialist for the Rebel Alliance. She worked with the navigator Lelu and used the transport Spinster's Loom. She transported a team of operatives to the Shadow Raptor shortly after the Battle of Yavin.
Hylo Sortuli was a female Mirialan from Mirial who owned the pet lizard Bonebark. She was named after Hylo Visz, a millennia-old legend of the Mirialan people.
By Bluss was a male Leyakian who served as a senator in the Separatist Senate during the Clone Wars.
Hura Kogler was the Human daughter of the legendary Hyndis Kogler. Hura joined Imperial Intelligence, and led an operation to place infiltration droids in the Alliance Fleet.
Tam Bastion was a human male leader within the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Leeka Pali was a Mirialan female member of the Trade Spine League during Imperial Governor Ubrik Adelhard's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector. She served as an advisor to Shortpaw, the leader of the league.

Nogba Quush was a Kadas'sa'Nikto male criminal who operated within the Ivax Syndicate during Imperial Governor Ubrik Adelhard's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector. Nogba worked with The Smuggler to eliminate mutual enemies for a time.
Holtz was a male Human admiral of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Galactic War he was stationed on Hoth, where he approved an operation against the Hailstorm Brotherhood.
Umpass-stay was a male Klatooinian who worked as a drummer and bodyguard for the Max Rebo Band at the palace of the crime lord Jabba the Hutt on the planet Tatooine.
A human served as a member of Emperor Palpatine's Royal Guard. She once knew Lando Calrissian, a smuggler from Socorro.

Boaz was a member of the Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War. Not long after the Battle of Yavin, he was part of a team sent to recover the stolen experimental starship known as the Staraker, which they followed to the Alashan system.

Threepwood was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He along with his fellow clones Tracker and Boil and the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker took part in a manhunt on the planet Christophsis for the two Sith fugitives Cou…

Tracker was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Tracker along with Threepwood and Boil accompanied the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker during a mission to hunt down the Sith fugitives Count Dooku and Quinlan Vos, who had…
The father of the merchant Sheb Valaad was a male Koorivar. He took pride in his central cranial horn and decorated it with ornate carvings, as did his son about the time of the Clone Wars.

Sheb Valaad was a Koorivar merchant on Otor's Hub during the Clone Wars. Sheb specialized in trading the goods of people who had met "unpleasant fates." While Valaad usually waited for those makers to die, he sometimes had them killed.

Moregi was a Volpai who lived on Pantora during the Clone Wars with his Rodian wife and their son. Moregi attracted the wrath of the Rang Clan by embezzling funds, leading the Clan to place a bounty on his head.
Moregi's wife was a female Rodian who lived on Pantora and was married to the Volpai Moregi during the Clone Wars. She had a Rodian son through another mate but Moregi loved the child as his own.

The son of Moregi was a male Rodian who lived on Pantora and was the adopted child of the Volpai Moregi during the Clone Wars. His biological mother was a Rodian woman who had produced the child through a relationship with an unidentified Rodian male.
Vram was the son of Marg and Tezzka Krim, the former of whom served as a leader within the Pyke Syndicate during the Clone Wars. Vram was also the older brother of Laalee.
Laalee was the daughter of Marg and Tezzka Krim, the former of whom served as a leader within the Pyke Syndicate during the Clone Wars. Laalee was also the younger sister of Vram.

Marg Krim, formally addressed as the Illustrious Imperator, was a male Pyke who served as the leader of the Pyke Syndicate during the late Clone Wars and early Imperial Era. He was the husband of Tezzka Krim and the father of Laalee and Vram.
Tezzka Krim, a Pyke female, was the wife of Marg Krim, who served as a leader within the Pyke Syndicate during the Clone Wars. Krim was also the mother of two children, Laalee and Vram.
Thurg was a Gamorrean bodyguard who worked for Sheb Valaad, a Koorivar merchant based on Otor's Hub, during the Clone Wars.

Sumdin was a Gossam female who worked as a Separatist informant during the Clone Wars. She leaked information about Count Dooku's visit to Raxus Secundus to the Nightsister Asajj Ventress. Having outlived her usefulness, Ventress then executed her.

Rumi Paramita was a female Frenk who worked as a bounty hunter during the Clone Wars. She was a member of a cadre of bounty hunters led by the Zabrak mercenary Sugi, who were hired to defend a village of Felucian farmers from the Ohnaka Gang on the planet Felucia.
An Aqualish served as a governor and supported the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

An Aqualish female was married to an Aqualish governor during the Clone Wars. She and her husband attended a gala on Raxus Secundus that was held in honor of Confederate leader Count Dooku, the recipient of the Raxian Humanitarian Award.

Shahan Alama was a Weequay bounty hunter who was active during the Clone Wars. He, along with Cad Bane and a group of other bounty hunters and mercenaries, participated in the Senate hostage crisis in order to free the crime lord Ziro the Hutt and deliver him to the Grand Hutt…
Luce was a female Dathomirian who was a Nightsister of Mother Talzin's clan. She fought in the Battle of Dathomir with two blasters until she was killed by the Separatist Droid Army.
Talia was a female Dathomirian who was a member of the Nightsisters, and an assistant of Talzin. She was born on the planet Dathomir along with her twin sister.
Idel was a human male who served as a commodore in the Imperial Navy and commanded his own Imperial-class Star Destroyer.

Arhul Narra was a male human pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, Commander Narra was tasked by Alliance High Command to lead Red Squadron.
A Human female was the mother of Altaca, a noble from the planet Alderaan during the Cold War.
A Human female was a member of the Fraabaal family and the mother of Vereta Fraabaal, a Sith who was the daughter of Admiral Fraabaal in the Imperial Navy.

Waric was a Human male who sold stims at a kiosk in the Republic Strategic Information Service base located in Shadow Town on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Gaidin was a male Duros who sold starship components in Deucalon Spaceport on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Wyjus-Miin was a Zabrak male merchant who sold stimulants with an astromech droid in the lobby of Deucalon Spaceport on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Ralos-Vok was a male Rodian who sold stims in the Red Light Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Big String was an amphibious alien who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire as a crime boss in a fortress they constructed on the Inner Rim planet Amethia Prime.
Vees Nerich was a male Rodian who sold stims inside of Damrosch the Hutt's factory on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
A female Pa'lowick worked as an announcer for the illegal Gladiator Night event held at Monad Outpost on the planet Lothal.
Grakchawwaa was a Wookiee who served as King of Kashyyyk, the Wookiee homeworld, in the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Suu Lawquane was a female Twi'lek refugee who lived on the arid planet Saleucami during the final years of the Galactic Republic, where she raised her two children, Shaeeah and Jek.
Jek Lawquane was a male human-Twi'lek hybrid who was the son of Suu Lawquane and the adopted son of Cut Lawquane during the Clone Wars.

Shaeeah Lawquane was a female human-Twi'lek hybrid who was the daughter of Suu Lawquane and the adopted daughter of Cut Lawquane, a clone deserter, during the Clone Wars. Shaeeah and her family lived on Saleucami until shortly after the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Sarco Plank, also known as the Scavenger, was a male Melitto ronin who made a living off of retrieving valuable artifacts for clients, while also displaying a sadistic side in luring individuals to their deaths in the process.

Kylia Stryder was a female human. A rebel group located in the Anoat sector recruited Kylia as a teenager, despite her being the daughter of an Imperial Commander. Her father never discovered her affiliation with the rebellion.

Hylemane Lightbringer was a regent of the Old Republic. History 'crons recorded fantastic claims such as he was "born in the dust of the Typhonic Nebula" and that he "could not be killed by mortal weapons," the last being proven untrue when he was bludgeoned to death by a chair.
Jom Barell was a human male who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and later the New Republic. Bearing the rank of Sergeant major, Barell served in the New Republic Special Forces.

Tasu Leech was a human male assassin and pit fighter active during the Imperial Era and New Republic Era. Grew up on the Hutt colony planet Nar Kanji, Leech became one of the deadliest pit fighters in the fighting pits of Nar Kanji, being called a child prodigy.
"Guns" Karok was a male Rattataki lieutenant of the Bleeder gang in the Red Light Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.

Torrent, designated TX-828, was a clone who was bred in the final years of the Galactic Republic. Following the formation of the Galactic Empire, Torrent served as a sergeant in the Stormtrooper Corps and worked with Imperial Security Bureau Senior Commander Alecia Beck.

Farnay was a female Devaronian and the daughter of Kivas. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Kivas repaired the Y 4 BTL-S3 Y-wing Starfighter belonging to Luke Skywalker, a rebel who crash-landed near Tikaroo.
Caluan Ematt was a human male soldier who served as a lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

A male human was the father of Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin and married to Tarkin's mother. He bore an uncanny resemblance to Ranulph Tarkin, his nephew, so much so that they could have passed for twins.
The mother of Wilhuff Tarkin was a human female who lived on the Outer Rim planet of Eriadu. She was married to Tarkin's father.

Goss Toowers was a male member of the Shozer species who lived approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor. He was part of the Resistance and served on the technical crew that provided mechanical support to the Resistance's fleet of starfighters.

Randd was a male human that served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War as Grand Moff of the Exterior in the Outer Rim Territories. Sometime after the Rebellion on Akiva, he was considered one of the most elite Imperial officers left surviving.

Zuvio was a Kyuzo male lawman who lived approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor and served as the constable of Niima Outpost, a frontier trading post on the otherwise lawless planet Jakku.

Orkin Kaw was a male commander in the Galactic Empire stationed on Coruscant at the time of the Battle of Endor. After the death of Emperor Palpatine, riots erupted across Coruscant, specifically in Monument Plaza.
Lokmarcha was a Dressellian soldier who served as a major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was killed during the Operation Yellow Moon mission.
Tantor was an individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a general within its armed forces.
Massa was a male Duros with green skin who served as an admiral in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

"Old" Grimshaw was a Kyuzo who lived on the planet Jaresh. Shortly after the Battle of Hoth, Grimshaw's cousin Nyessa met with representatives of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and asked them to aid in confronting the Imperial presence on Jaresh.

Jas Emari was a Zabrak female who worked as a bounty hunter during the Galactic Civil War. She was present at the Battle of Endor and made the decision there to switch sides on the conflict and no longer work with the Galactic Empire.

"Gold Leader" was the callsign of a clone trooper pilot who served as commander of the Y-wing unit Gold Squadron during the Battle of Anaxes. During the battle, Gold Leader led an attack run on the Anaxes assembly complex.

Commodex Tahn was a male human from Naboo. During the last decades of the Galactic Republic, he worked as a military clerk. At some point before the last year of the Clone Wars, his father died, prompting Tahn to leave Republic service and enter the family trade as a mortician.
L'ulo L'ampar was a skilled Duros A-wing pilot in the Rebel Alliance, New Republic and Resistance that was from the planet Duro.
Gallius Rax, once known as Galli and code-named Operator, was a male human who became the Counselor to the Empire during the last days of the Galactic Empire.

Volk Aymeric was an Ishi Tib that served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as captain of the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Remembrance. Aymeric was the leader of a convoy tasked with protecting Alliance leader Princess Leia Organa.

Perrin was a human who served as a junior ensign in the Imperial Navy aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Inflictor. After the Battle of Endor, she and other teenaged cadets were made junior officers even though they were too young.

Snar was an individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire. In 4 ABY, they were killed during the Battle of Endor, which took place over the moon Endor.

Gemma was an individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire. In 4 ABY, they were killed during the Battle of Endor, which took place over the moon Endor.
Tuck Tyrell was a male human who served as a member of the Pathfinders Special forces unit in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

Reet was an individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire. In 4 ABY, they were killed during the Battle of Endor, which took place over the moon Endor.
The Smuggler was a Force-sensitive human male thief and smuggler active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
The individual known as the Smuggler sent a member of their crew to aid Ozz in dealing with the Imperials and earned the resources the king offered.
Owerto Naiucho was a male smuggler who was hired to transport Norra Wexley to the planet Akiva shortly after the Battle of Endor.
Talvee Chawin, better known as the Thorn, was an Iktotchi crime lord of Level 1313 on the planet Coruscant around the time of the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

Lazula was the female companion and cohort of Talvee Chawin, the Iktotchi crime lord of Level 1313 on the planet Coruscant around the time of the Battle of Endor. Lazula was in the custody of the Coruscant police when she was rescued by the youngling Jak.
Mongo Hingo was an individual with a sluggy, jowly face, who at one time acted as satrap of the planet Akiva's satrapy.

Kade Hingo was a male individual who acted as satrap of the planet Akiva's Satrapy while still relatively young. By the time Isstra Dirus held the rank of Satrap on Akiva several months after the Battle of Endor, Hingo had died.

Tin Withrafisp was an individual who served as satrap of the planet Akiva's Satrapy. By the time Isstra Dirus—one of Withrafisp's successors—ruled as Satrap several months after the Battle of Endor, a gold-framed portrait of Withrafisp was displayed in the Satrap's Palace in M…
Pick was an individual who served as a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who flew against the Galactic Empire at the Battle of Endor as a member of Green Squadron.

Olia Choko was a female Pantoran who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later the New Republic as the public relations representative between Chancellor Mon Mothma and the Galactic Senate.

Sinjir Rath Velus was a human male ex-loyalty officer who served the Galactic Empire until the Battle of Endor. Following the destruction of the second Death Star, Sinjir abandoned his post and fled the Empire.

Pensar Luc was a Moff of the Galactic Empire who was appointed governor of the Ciutric Hegemony just after the Declaration of a New Order. Reform-minded, he was committed to clearing up piracy and smuggling in the sector and removing corruption in the Axxila antipirate fleet.
Doowan was a Nautolan male who was an associate of the arms dealer known as the Dragon during the Galactic Civil War.

Parsel, a Weequay, was a member of Hondo Ohnaka's gang of pirates. He served Hondo as a copilot to Jiro on one of Ohnaka's ships. Parsel had a tattoo on his left arm, combat boots and a red scarf that covered his mouth.
Mindak was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the Stormtrooper Corps, a branch of the Galactic Empire's army, during the Galactic Civil War.

Soussho was a Mirialan male and a member of the Data Seekers, a secretive organization that sought to unravel the mysteries of the Anoat sector's shrouded history during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Kendy Idele was a female human from the planet Iloh. She was chosen to attend the Royal Imperial Academy and shared a room with Jude Edivon and Ciena Ree.

Jude Edivon, designated TI803 in the Imperial Navy, was a human female from Bespin who served as an officer in the Galactic Empire. She attended the Royal Imperial Academy on Coruscant and shared a room with Ciena Ree and Kendy Idele.
Amanaman was a male Amani headhunter from the planet Maridun who worked as a bounty hunter for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

Nash Windrider was a human male from Alderaan who served as a commander and lieutenant in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire. He attended the Royal Imperial Academy on Coruscant, and was roommates with the Jelucani cadet Thane Kyrell and Coruscanti Ved Foslo.

Berisse Sai was a human female officer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. She befriended a fellow officer Ciena Ree, and served the Death Squadron aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Devastator following her graduation from the Imperial Academy on Lothal.

Eneb Ray was a human male who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was a spy for the Rebellion and infiltrated the Imperial bureaucracy on Coruscant, working as a tax collector under the codename Tharius Demo.
Nadea Tural was a female Thradian who represented the planet of Thrad in the Imperial Senate during the Imperial Era. In 4 BBY, Tural suffered a crash while she was traveling to Arkanis.
Earll was a human female who served in the military of the Galactic Empire.
Phin-Law Wo was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who was stationed in the Jedi Temple on the planet Vrogas Vas. Wo recorded teachings in a Jedi holocron, instructing to protect it at all costs.
Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi, also known as Grakkus the Hutt, was a Hutt crime lord who lived on Nar Shaddaa during the Imperial Era.
Pavol was a feline humanoid clone. He and his clone lover Aleksin worked as hand-to-hand combat experts at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Darth Momin, also known simply as Momin, was a humanoid male Sith Lord, dark side scholar and sculptor. At a young age, his artwork led to his imprisonment by those who found it disturbing and repulsive for the very materials he had employed.
Bohento Splinth was a male Aqualish. Originally a meteor miner, Splinth turned to robbery and was a scavenger by the time of the Iron Blockade.

Yupe Tashu was a male human historian who served in the Galactic Empire as one of Emperor Sheev Palpatine' closest advisers. Although he could not use the Force himself, Tashu was invested with knowledge of the dark side and a Sith cultist.

Wraith Leader was the leader of Wraith Squadron, a starfighter squadron for the Galactic Empire that was ambushed by the Rogue Shadow sometime before or during 1 BBY during the Galactic Civil War. During this attack, Wraith Leader was killed alongside the rest of the squadron.

Wraith 6 was a member of Wraith Squadron, a starfighter squadron for the Galactic Empire that was ambushed by the Rogue Shadow sometime before or during 1 BBY. During this attack, Wraith 6 was killed alongside the rest of the squadron.
Curtis was a Shistavanen male who worked as a bouncer for the cantina inside the Serendipity, a 1550-LEX yacht owned by Delia Leighton.

Ardin Deltura was a male individual who served as an ensign in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later the New Republic. He was in a romantic relationship with Officer Niriian and was well trusted by Commander Agate.

Kyrsta Agate was a female human who served as a commander in the New Republic Starfleet. She was a part of several meetings of New Republic officials who discussed the evolving mission on the planet Akiva.
Camerand Argell was a corporal in the New Republic. He was responsible for escorting several Imperial officers and stormtroopers who were captured on Coruscant to the holding area on Chandrila.

Corwin Ballast was a male native of the Outer Rim world Mordal who lived on the world with his wife, Lynnta, and his daughter. In 4 ABY, Ballast and his family became trapped in a firefight between rebels and Imperial forces.

Lynnta was a woman from the Outer Rim world Mordal who resided in the city Maborn during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, Lynnta and her family became trapped in a firefight between rebels and Imperial forces.

The Contessa was an alias used by a human female who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Born to high-ranking nobility, her homeworld was annexed by the Galactic Empire and her family killed in the process.

The first wife of Caar Damask was a Muun female. When Caar got a new job from Mals Tonith, on Mygeeto, he left his wife. Over the course of their relationship, Damask and his first wife did not have any children.
Ello Asty was a talented but reckless and singular male Abednedo T-70 X-wing starfighter ace pilot who worked for the New Republic's precision air team.

Valco Pandion was a human male who held the position of Moff in the Galactic Empire by the time of the Battle of Endor. He proclaimed himself as Grand Moff after the death of Emperor Palpatine and his apprentice Darth Vader.

Cutter Poole was a human male who was a new recruit into Blade Squadron, a B-wing unit. Lieutenant Gina Moonsong considered him to be a "glory boy." Shortly after his induction, he was killed during the battle of Malastare when a TIE fighter got behind his craft.

Yori Dahn was a human female who became a new recruit in Blade Squadron, B-wing unit months after the Battle of Endor. She was formerly a first mate of a tramp freighter, but the Galactic Empire executed her crew.

Jordan Karls was a Togruta male who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a pilot. Before entering Blade Squadron, he witnessed events on Bespin. Later, he became a recruit into Blade Squadron, a B-wing unit. He flew a variety of craft before switching to the B-wing.
The Lurker Chieftain was the male leader of a Lurker nest on Anoat. He was killed by a young scoundrel who needed to reactivate a power generator on Tam Bastion's behalf.

Thenn was a blond-haired human female who served in the military of the Galactic Empire. Possessing the rank of captain at the time of the Iron Blockade, she was stationed within the cordoned off Anoat sector, operating on worlds such as Burnin Konn and Bespin.

The Ante was a Givin infochant who worked in the Spire, a floating city hovering above the planet Anthan Prime. He resided in the underside of the Spire and was the Braxant sector's prime information broker.
"The Dragon" was the alias of an infamous male Ortolan arms dealer who operated on the planet Anthan Prime. After the Battle of Yavin, Dr.

Camie Marstrap was a human female who lived in Anchorhead on Tatooine. Her family grew hydroponics gardens, buying the water from Owen Lars. Marstrap frequented the Tosche Station along with her boyfriend, Laze "Fixer" Loneozner and their friends Deak, Windy, and Luke Skywalker.
Mindiz was a young female human from the planet of Lothal. When the Galactic Empire conquered Lothal, the tyrannical government started taking over the local peasants' lands.

Arsin Crassus was one of the main money lenders within the Galactic Empire, who help facilitate the running of the Imperial economy. He performed this role for decades up to the Rebellion on Akiva. During his youth, he was employed by the Trade Federation.
Adison Cray was a Free Agent working for Alliance Special Operations during the Galactic Civil War.

Laze Loneozner, also known as "Fixer", was a male human who lived on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine during the Age of the Empire. He was a childhood friend of Luke Skywalker and the boyfriend of Camie Marstrap.

Gordan was the king of the planet Kheedar. An Imperial supporter who always considered Kheedar an Imperial holding, he was also senile. When the Empire arrived at Kheedar and declared martial law, he defied their approach in his senility and swore to fight.
Selbo was the navigator aboard the freighter Last Legs.

Wince was a member of the Siluria III resistance under Kaiya Adrimetrum. During the assault on the Imperial governor's mansion on Siluria III, Wince's prowess with a rifle, along with a blaster cannon, was instrumental in the resistance's victory.
Bea was the wife of Madel Wharen, and the mother of Padyn.
Cerk Lormin was a fresh-faced individual who served the Galactic Empire as an Imperial officer. He died on the moon of Endor during the Battle of Endor against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Blevins was a captain of the Galactic Empire who was part of Tempest Force. He fought and died during the battle on the moon Endor against the Rebel Alliance in 4 ABY.
Mercy was a female human enslaved by the Sullustan crime lord Surat Nuat. She always treated the crime lord well, and he mostly returned her kindness.

Wynnet Ree was a human female who died a few hours after being born on the planet Jelucan in 19 BBY. Wynnet's twin sister Ciena maintained a special bond with Wynnet despite her passing, and tried to live her life for the both of them.
Yendor Brethen was a Rutian Twi'lek male pilot who fought for the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later the New Republic as a member of Corona Squadron. He held the rank of private.

Kason was a Corporal in the New Republic's Special Forces. In 4 ABY, he was among six SpecForce members selected for a mission to the planet Akiva which aimed to investigate the Imperial presence there and rescue pilot Wedge Antilles.

Gahee'abee was a Kupohan who served as a corporal in the New Republic's Special Forces. In 4 ABY, he was one of six selected to take part in a mission to the planet Akiva to investigate the Galactic Empire's presence there and search for the missing pilot Wedge Antilles.
Torvo Bolo was an Aqualish who operated an outfitter's store in Myrra, capital city of the planet Akiva.

Jenny was a human female from Mos Espa, on the desert planet of Tatooine. In 1 BBY, she worked as a B-girl at Chalmun's Cantina in Mos Eisley. She flirted with Han Solo, a Corellian smuggler who had a woman in every spaceport, on the occasions when he stopped on Tatooine.
H'Raak was a male Tusken Raider who disagreed with the ideas of A'Yark. H'Raak was killed by A'Yark and his bantha was given to her youngest son, A'Deen.
Gr'Karr was a male Tusken Raider. He was the oldest member of his tribe.
Asha Fahn, also known as the "Red Ghost," was a female Ewok of the Bright Tree tribe on Endor. She was one of Chief Chirpa's daughters and along with Teebo, one of the tribe's best hunters.
Muftak, known erroneously to many as the Muftak, was a male Talz abandoned on the planet Tatooine as a newborn.

Hellene was a Twi'lek female who worked as a barkeeper at Kala'uun. She had a thing for starship captains and as such, at some point prior to the destruction of the planet Alderaan, she fell for the charms of Han Solo, Captain of the Millennium Falcon.
Unkar Plutt, a male member of the Crolute species, resided on the remote, lawless world of Jakku approximately 30 years after the Battle of Endor.
TK-5331 was the designation of a male stormtrooper stationed on the planet Lothal.

The husband of Drusil Bephorin was a male Givin. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, he and his two children, including Pentir, were brought to the planet Omereth by the Rebel Alliance to meet with Drusil in exchange for helping the Rebellion against the Galactic Empire.

A Rebel Alliance admiral gave speech on a flight deck following the Battle of Endor. The admiral talked at length about duty, sacrifice, and heroism before awarding the Medal of Bravery to surviving B-wing pilots.
Buboicullaar, or Bubo for short, was a frog-dog male that was kept as a pet by the Hutt crime lord Jabba the Hutt, who used him as a guard dog.
Attark was a brown skinned and black eyed Hoover male owned by the crime lord Jabba the Hutt as a pet. Surprisingly, he had a very high intelligence and was talented at weapon repair work.

Alecia Beck was a female human who served as a senior commander in the Imperial Security Bureau. In the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin, she was tasked with hunting down Lieutenant Caluan Ematt, a member of the enemy Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Bruno Denturri was an enslaver who was an enemy of the Zygerrian Queen Miraj Scintel. As part of his mission to rescue captured Togruta colonists, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker went under the name "Lars Quell" and claimed he had killed Denturri.
Tevrin Dol was a junior executive serving Radell Mining Corporation during the Galactic Civil War. A group of spacers were hired to transport him to Torina via Coyn.
In the year 33 BBY, a Yuuzhan Vong individual was captured and brought to the prison facility known as Cog Hive Seven.

Sondiv Sella was a male individual who served as a cargo pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He later served as a top official in the New Republic, serving alongside Mon Mothma and Leia Organa, among others.

Bizu was a Twi'lek male who was the son of Yendor Brethen, a pilot in both the Alliance to Restore the Republic and New Republic. Yendor was forced to leave Bizu behind on their homeworld of Ryloth when he joined the Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Saff Melor was a Cerean who served as a Captain in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Verala Mishar was a Human female who was paid to deliver supplies to the covert installation Whisper Base. She took a shuttle to the base every two weeks.

Brill was a Tarsunt engineer who was a crew member of the Mighty Oak Apocalypse at the time of the Galactic Civil War, working for the Wookiee captain Lohgarra. Ex-Imperial pilot Thane Kyrell was a fellow crew member of hers for a few months following the Battle of Yavin.

Brisney was a commander in the Imperial Security Bureau, assigned to a commanding position aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Inflictor following the Battle of Endor. Brisney was present when Grand Moff Randd promoted Ciena Ree to captain of the Inflictor.

Erisher was an individual who served the Galactic Empire as a commander aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Inflictor following the Battle of Endor. Erisher was present when Grand Moff Randd promoted Ciena Ree to Captain of the Inflictor.
Cherik was a Lieutenant Commander onboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Eliminator. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, NO-718 and NY-112 were ordered to report to Cherik.
Bisk was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. By the time of the Iron Blockade, Bisk was stationed at an Imperial outpost on Nar Hypa, serving as a taskmaster.

Kaoul was a male human who served in the Galactic Empire. Around two months after the establishment of the Iron Blockade, Kaoul held the rank of agent, and he was stationed at an Imperial outpost on Nar Hypa, in the Mataou system.

Zaul was a human captain who served in the military of the Galactic Empire around the time of the Iron Blockade. Two months into the blockade, Captain Zaul was stationed at an Imperial outpost on Nar Hypa, in the Mataou system.

TK-412 was the designation of a stormtrooper commander in service to the Galactic Empire around the time of the Iron Blockade. Two months into the blockade, the trooper was stationed at an Imperial outpost on Nar Hypa, along with Captain Zaul and another unit leader, TK-408.

Yos Kolina was a male Mon Calamari who served as the King of Mon Cala during the last years of the Galactic Republic. His rule was cut short, however, when he was assassinated by Separatist Riff Tamson. His son Lee-Char later avenged his death by killing Tamson.
Deenlark was a male Commandant and President of the Royal Imperial Academy on Coruscant during the Age of the Empire.

Bryn Shal was the Head Scientist of Project: Wayfarer, a Republic Scout Service exploration program to explore the Elrood and Cegul sectors. He reported to the Senate Committee on New World Discovery and Exploration.
Wuxod was the grandson of Senator Wuxod on the planet Derilyn. He led the resistance movement known as the Friends of Paran.
Temmin "Snap" Wexley was a human male who lived during the Age of the Empire and the time of the New Republic.
Velgar Borf was an Imperial Customs officer stationed on the planet Derilyn. He was slightly overweight with unruly hair, and his uniform was often rumpled and stained.

Melodia Fharm was a Human female from the planet Derilyn. Formerly a nurse and counselor in the city of Tekar, she was married with a son. The Imperiall invasion of Derilyn resulted in the death of her husband, who was visiting the city of Paran when it was destroyed.

Ceezva was a female Teltior con artist. She once bluffed her way into a high-stakes sabacc game with only five hundred credits. During the game, she won the Unnipar system from Archduke Monio of the Dentamma Nebula.

Kabak was a male cadet in Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials. He was assigned to squad LRC077, and was a member of Unit Aurek. He was a replacement for "Dev Morgan," a rebellious cadet who was secretly the undercover rebel Ezra Bridger.
Mothar Drik was a second-wave human male child native to the planet Jelucan. Eight years after the Clone Wars, Drik was present at Jelucan's induction ceremony into the Galactic Empire.

Ved Foslo was a male human who was a native of the planet Coruscant, and son of the Imperial General Foslo. Ved attended the Royal Imperial Academy in the years leading up to the Galactic Civil War. His roommates were Thane Kyrell and Nash Windrider.

Harn was a human Imperial officer who served as a commander at the Royal Imperial Academy on Coruscant in the years leading up to the Galactic Civil War. He oversaw the training of cadets, including Thane Kyrell and Ciena Ree, among others.
Jasten was an Imperial Admiral who served around the beginning of the Galactic Civil War.
Ausec Grogle was a wealthy male Trandoshan trader who had commissioned the SoroSuub Corporation to build him a prototype Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 by 33 BBY.
Tamaron Pol was a Human male con artist from the planet Lanthrym. He settled on Coyn and made a sport of avoiding the local security forces.
Que-Mars Redath-Gom was a male Weequay Jedi Knight who fought for the Galactic Republic in the First Battle of Geonosis at the start of the Clone Wars.

Kidi Aleri was a Cerean signals analyst who joined the Rebel Alliance as a communications specialist in the Galactic Civil War. She was one of several individuals that were part of team headed by Princess Leia Organa for a mission known as Operation Yellow Moon.
Ort was a mustachioed human male who worked as a member of the Gray Syndicate on Lothal. He possessed a thuggish nature and was not known for his intelligence.
Deak was, along with Fixer, Camie, and Windy, a member of Luke Skywalker's group of friends when
Sarla was a female individual who once met Han Solo, Captain of the Millennium Falcon, in Carannia Spaceport on the planet Serenno, where she fell for his charms.
Marfalump was a four-armed alien male who was adopted by a Human family who lived in Iowa on the planet Earth. He loved Star Wars and the soda Pepsi.
Dyro Felldor was an Er'Kit male who acted as a representative of his species during the Galactic Civil War.

Penrie, designated NA811, was a human male from the planet Lothal. He served as a pilot in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. He went to the academy with his fellow officer Ciena Ree, and served Death Squadron aboard the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Executor.

Vontok was a male Nothoiin. By the time of the Iron Blockade, he worked as a demolitions expert and combat engineer in the Anoat sector. A dauntless fighter, Vontok did not hesitate to join his warrior comrades into a full firefight.

Nippet was an Ewok born in 3 BBY as daughter of Zephee of the Bright Tree tribe on the moon of Endor. As the youngest member of the tribe, Nippet captivated those around her and explored the forest with help from her mother.
Romba was a male Ewok from Endor. A hunter, he once slew a boar-wolf, and then fashioned a knife from one of its teeth.

Onn Iria was a female Zabrak. By the time of the Iron Blockade, she worked as a smuggler in the Trade Spine League. As such, she reported to Shortpaw. She was skilled in the use of caltrops and hold-out blasters.

Verge was a human who held the rank of Prelate at the age of twenty years old. Verge was rising star of Emperor Palpatine's Ruling Council, and was the youngest member of said council. It was rumored that Verge was the offspring of one of many of Palpatine's ministers.

Thara Nyende was a human female stormtrooper hailing from the planet Sullust. Nyende's designation was SP-475 and she served in the Galactic Empire's 97th Legion stationed on Sullust. When rebels infiltrated the city of Pinyumb, she captured the rebel Hazram Namir.

Brendol Hux was a human male who served the Galactic Empire. Prior to his service in the Empire, Hux had served as a junior officer in the Grand Army of the Republic, communicating tactics and strategy as determined by Jedi Generals.
Sosha Soruna was a human female monarch who ruled as Queen of the Royal House of Naboo during the Age of the Galactic Empire.

Lerr Duvat was a human male captain in the Imperial Navy. In the immediate aftermath of the Battle of Endor, during which the Galactic Empire suffered a massive defeat at the hands of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Duvat was at the helm of the Imperial II-class Star Des…

Able Nereno was a Rodian male who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, with the rank of private. He worked as a nurse aboard the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Redemption during the Battle of Endor.
A red-skinned Twi'lek male was briefly interrogated by the Imperial Alecia Beck while she searched for Han Solo and his partner Chewbacca on the planet Cyrkon.
A female Abyssin was the mother of Gondry. Gondry was reminded of her when seeing some rocks on Tatooine resembling her shape.
This Lutrillian male was based on Lothal during a time when the Galactic Empire was increasing its operations on the planet and cracking down on dissent.

Kreel, designated Agent 5241, was a human male undercover stormtrooper sergeant and SCAR trooper of the Galactic Empire, serving in the 501st Legion under the direct command of Darth Vader. He operated as the gamemaster in Grakkus the Hutt's arena on Nar Shaddaa.

A male bounty hunter was active on Lothal approximately four to five years before the Battle of Yavin. Yahenna Laxo, the head of the Gray Syndicate, sold the elderly poet Holshef to this bounty hunter as payback for Merei Spanjaf getting on his bad side.
Ndaya was a human male bodyguard. During Imperial Governor Ubrik Adelhard's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector, he was a member of the Trade Spine League.

A male individual was the father of Rebel pilot Shara Bey. During the Galactic Civil War, Bey had her father raise her son, Poe Dameron, on a planet while she and her husband, Kes Dameron, fought in the war against the Galactic Empire.

Donta Gesset was the Governor of the planet Naboo late in the Galactic Civil War. Gesset greeted Princess Leia Organa when she arrived in Theed to secure Naboo's allegiance to the New Republic, and escorted the princess to Queen Sosha Soruna to begin the discussions.
Denner was a male human who served as an Imperial technician. Fourteen years before the Battle of Yavin, Denner was stationed on the Outer Rim world Ryloth and served under Moff Delian Mors.

Everi Chalis was a female human from a remote and impoverished planet in the galaxy. Enrolling in the Colonial Academy to become an artist, she took an apprenticeship under Count Denetrius Vidian of the Galactic Empire.

During the Galactic Civil War, this Imperial Governor governed the Core Worlds planet of Chandrila. According to Rebel founder Mon Mothma, the governor declared the Governing council of Salline to be traitors after they protested the seizure of its citizens by the Imperial Sec…

Hove was a human male who served as captain of the Imperial Star Destroyer Vehement around the time of the Battle of Yavin. He worked with Commander Alecia Beck of the ISB to find the Rebel Alliance Shrike Caluan Ematt.
Sakas was a Mikkian female soldier who fought for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Cala was a male Koorivar and an operations specialist. Five years after the formation of the Galactic Empire, Cala was part of a rebel cell led by Berch Teller. He participated in the theft of the Carrion Spike, personal starship of Imperial Governor Wilhuff Tarkin.

Knotts was a male human from the Core Worlds. In 29 BBY, he relocated to the planet of Lantillies. He established himself as a middleman, bringing clients in want of goods or services together with freelance spacers, taking a credit percentage on each transaction.
Tápusk was a Kalleran male who lived as a smuggler on the planet of Kaller following the time of Order 66.

Sear was a human female who was a member of the Orphans, a group active during the reign of the Galactic Empire led by the bounty hunter Chanath Cha. Like the other members of the Orphans, Sear lived up to the group's name, her parents having died long before.

Vedain was a Kajain'sa'Nikto enslaved individual by the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was killed in 4 ABY after falling into the Great Pit of Carkoon.
Gartogg was a Gamorrean who served the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure as a guard in his palace on the planet Tatooine.

Ironarm was the nickname of a Human male veteran Imperial stormtrooper commander. He was one of the first recruits into the reformed Stormtrooper Corps after the Clone Wars, and served in a brutal but efficient manner without distinction until his squad was assigned to hunt a …

Bazine Netal was an alias used by a human female mercenary. Born on the Inner Rim world Chaaktil, she was raised in an orphanage and began training under the former Kanjiklub pirate Delphi Kloda at his combat school.
Rnthmyr was an ancient male Massassi warrior who lived on Yavin 4 in the time of the Galactic War. He was killed in 3637 BBY during the conflict with the Order of Revan.
A member of the Jedi Order took on Yoda as a Padawan when Yoda was young, more than eight hundred years before the reign of the Galactic Empire.

K'ungfu was the protagonist of a story that the Jedi Master Yoda once heard from his own Master. According to the story, K'ungfu was a wise and strong Jedi Master, although less so than the Great Chuang.
Hurron was a human male who served as an officer in the Galactic Empire. Hurron held the rank of Commandant and was stationed at the Imperial base the Empire had on the planet of Vetine.

The commander of an Imperial Security Bureau black site at the Wretch of Tayron surrendered to the Rebel Alliance special forces team known as the Pathfinders during their raid on the base several weeks after the Battle of Endor.

Tracene Kane was a female human who worked as a journalist on Chandrila during the Galactic Civil War. She was close friends with her cameraman, a Trandoshan named Lug, who perished during a battle at Binjai-Tin on the planet Nag Ubdur in 5 ABY.
Big Bongo was a giant joopa that lived under the crust of Seelos, a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Braconnor Bakiska was a Stennes Shifter who was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the planet Tatooine when the Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and the former moisture farmer Luke Skywalker entered.

Sammo Quid was a Rutian Twi'lek Jedi youngling who served the Jedi Order during the time of the Clone Wars. The boy studied under Jedi Master Yoda at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant alongside Caleb Dume and Tai Uzuma, eventually becoming a Padawan alongside his friends.

Tai Uzuma was a female human Jedi youngling who served the Jedi Order during the time of the Clone Wars. Uzuma studied under Jedi Master Yoda at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant alongside Caleb Dume and Sammo Quid, eventually becoming a Padawan alongside them.
J. Ras-Teker was an admiral in the Imperial Security Bureau (ISB), an agency of the Galactic Empire that ensured the populace and military personnel remained obedient to the government's ideals.
Aldar Beedo was a Glymphid male podracer from the planet Ploo II who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.
Blount was a male human who served as a lieutenant in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Hem Dazon was a grouchy Arcona scout who became stranded on the planet Tatooine after spending all his money on juri juice and salt.
Ebe E. Endocott was a Triffian podracer from Triffis who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic race on the planet Tatooine during the Naboo Crisis.

Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu was a Hutt who was said to have ascended to godhood. To celebrate the deity's ascension, the celebration of Boonta Eve was created. The infamous Boonta Blasters were also named after the Hutt, who allegedly commissioned the first one.

Deng Tharand was a male human who worked as a demolitions and munitions expert. At the time of the Iron Blockade, he was active in the Anoat sector. Tharand was capable of weaponizing about any combination of chemicals and materials.

Neva Kee was a Xamster male podracer pilot who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on the planet Tatooine during the year 32 BBY. During the second lap of the race, Kee flew off course to find a shortcut and disappeared, never to be seen again.

Nabrun Leids was a Morseerian male smuggler and pilot-for-hire who flew the Scarlet Vertha, a Ghtroc Industries 720 light freighter. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, Leids was a patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the planet Tatooine.
Pote Snitkin was a male Skrilling arms dealer and pilot who worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Shasa Tiel was an ambitious Ishi Tib accountant who was in charge of the vast fortune belonging to the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Ree-Yees was a Gran male who worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure and was responsible for watching Buboicullaar, the Hutt's pet frog-dog.

Swamptoe was a tamed Kaadu from the planet Naboo who was used as a mount by the Gungan Captain Roos Tarpals. Tarpals rode Swamptoe around the underwater Gungan city of Otoh Gunga and as part of the Gungan Grand Army during the Invasion of Naboo.
Velken Tezeri was a human male guard and arms dealer who worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

Wooof was a Kadas'sa'Nikto who served the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Galactic Civil War. Jabba placed the Nikto in charge of his fleet of skiffs and his sail barge, the Khetanna.

Springbuck was an officer in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. During the Battle of Endor, Springbuck was one of Admiral Rae Sloane's controllers aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vigilance.
Arleil Schous was an aging Defel fortune hunter who spent time in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the planet Tatooine in 1 BBY.

Kokely was a pilot who flew for the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a member of Green Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. Kokely flew in the Battle of Endor as Green Six and was killed during the battle.
Pons Limbic, nicknamed "Brainiac," was a Siniteen who specialized in calculating the coordinates for hyperspace jumps in his head.

Bom Vimdin was a widely disliked Advozse who worked as a mercenary, smuggler, and black marketeer. He earned a reputation for working with corrupt officials, providing illicit goods to Imperial officers, and became wanted by the Galactic Empire.
Piit, also known by the nickname "Peg Leg Piit", was a Weequay female who served as a member of Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang during the Clone Wars.

t: Unidentified Imperial Security Bureau officer (Burnin Konn)
x: A human male officer served with the Imperial Security Bureau, an intelligence agency of the Galactic Empire. Early in the Iron Blockade, he conducted a contraband sweep on Burnin Konn, searching for an illegal shipment of synthetic kyber crystals.

Senya Tirall was a Human female Force-sensitive native of Zakuul, the capital of the Eternal Empire. Joining the ranks of the Knights of Zakuul, she rose to become a member of the personal guard of the Immortal Emperor Valkorion and caught his interest.

Chuang was a character in a story that the Jedi Master Yoda once heard from his own Master. According to the tale, he was the strongest and wisest Jedi Master of his time, which earned him the nickname the "Great Jedi." The story went that, at one point, Chuang's apprentice died.
Gauron Nas Tal was a snarling Saurin combat trainer who worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Despite this, the trainer aimed to hunt down its employer by 4 ABY.

Geeska Dotalo was a male Xan from the colony planet of Gan Moradir. Dotalo and his people became frustrated with the New Republic after the Galactic Civil War led to an upsurge of crime, poverty, and starvation.
Den was a technician serving the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was stationed as an employee of Premier Provisions, a farming operation on the planet Tyed Kant.

Dalven Kyrell, call sign HJ290, was a human male second-wave aristocrat from the Outer Rim planet Jelucan. He was the older brother of Thane Kyrell, both of whom attended different Imperial Academies and later served in the Imperial Navy.

Smikes was a taciturn human male pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Corona Squadron. After Corona Squadron was permanently assigned to the MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser Liberty, the squadron began to fly recon missions.

Oxenbrigg was an Imperial crew chief of a naval hull-integrity maintenance crew. Due to his expertise in maintaining vessels, he gave a report stating some details on what hazards to look out for when traveling in deep space, in particular fauna that pose a threat to various v…
Len Parvek was a Human male who served in Zakuul's military as part of Koth Vortena's crew and later in the Alliance against his native homeworld.
Tora was a female Human engineer who played part in the war against Zakuul as part of the Alliance.
Jaum was a male gangster who was active during the Galactic Civil War. He had taken over the Outer Rim planet of Andelm IV, enslaving its inhabitants so they would mine Andelm beetles for him.

Yantuh was a Hutt who owned a palace on the Hutt jewel world of Mataou. By the time of the Iron Blockade, in which the Galactic Empire blockaded the Anoat sector, Yantuh was dead and the Empire had constructed a small garrison in the Hutt's palace grounds.

Hyllis was a Sergeant in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. During the Iron Blockade, in which Imperial Governor Ubrik Adelhard blockaded the entire Anoat sector, Hyllis was stationed in a small garrison on the planet Mataou within the sector.

Lohgarra was a Wookiee female who was captain of the cargo transport known as the Mighty Oak Apocalypse (Moa for short). Lohgarra transported only legal cargo, but she operated on the fringes, where Imperial oversight was rarely an issue.
Gurnot was a Gamorrean male enforcer for the criminal Ivax Syndicate. He provided training for the smuggler Riley's sibling on the planet Burnin Konn.

Red Adder was a human male member of the Nexu Claws criminal gang on the planet Burnin Konn. At one time the gang encountered the smuggler Riley and her sibling, placing a bounty on the pair's head after an incident involving speeders.
The Colossal Monolith was the name given to a particularly enormous Monolith, a type of Sithspawn, that existed on the desolate surface of the planet Ziost after the eradication of all life on Ziost.
Maus Monare was a male TIE fighter pilot of the Imperial Navy.
Bhanak was a Trandoshan who joined the Warstalkers, a former mercenary group of Trandoshans that was led by Qyzen Fess during the era in which the Eternal Empire controlled the galaxy.
Narj was a Trandoshan who joined the Warstalkers, a former mercenary group of Trandoshans that was led by Qyzen Fess during the era in which the Eternal Empire controlled the galaxy.
Rossuk was a Trandoshan who joined the Warstalkers, a former mercenary group of Trandoshans that was led by Qyzen Fess during the era in which the Eternal Empire controlled the galaxy.
Possak was a Trandoshan who joined the Warstalkers, a former mercenary group of Trandoshans that was led by Qyzen Fess during the era in which the Eternal Empire controlled the galaxy.

Ronnadam was a male human who served as a captain of the Imperial Security Bureau during the Galactic Civil War. Ronnadam was the senior ISB officer onboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator and later the Executor-class Star Destroyer Executor.

Methwat Tann was a Ithorian maintenance officer aboard the Mighty Oak Apocalypse during the Galactic Civil War. His enormous curved head and neck were wrapped in a scarf specially knitted for him by his captain Lohgarra.

Boorgo Cadevon was a Rodian male member of the criminal Cadevon Family and brother of Duurgo Cadevon. He and his sibling crushed the leg of the smuggler Riley after she disagreed over payment while working for the family. His preferred weapon of choice was a vibroblade.
Tanek was a male Human from the planet Zakuul who served in the Knights of Zakuul, an order of Force-sensitive warriors who protected the Eternal Empire and its ruler, the Immortal Emperor.

Gulin was a human lieutenant in the Imperial Navy. In the immediate aftermath of the Battle of Endor, during which the Galactic Empire suffered a massive defeat at the hands of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Gulin was stationed on the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer To…
Emarr Ottkreg was a male colonel and loyalty officer for the Imperial Security Bureau who was stationed aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vigilance during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
Novo was a male Human and a member of the Knights of Zakuul.
The elderly human male poet known as Holshef had a grandmother who established a family home on the planet Lothal.
