Jol Bengim was a Chevin male who at one time encountered enslavers and slave labor camps on Vinsoth. He later came to live in the settlement of Reestkii on the desert planet Jakku.

JA189 was a TIE fighter pilot who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Hoth, JA189 and three other pilots were sent into the Hoth asteroid belt to chase down the Millennium Falcon.

CR978 was a human male who served as a TIE fighter pilot in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Hoth, CR978 was sent with three other pilots to capture the Millennium Falcon after it fled into the Hoth asteroid belt.
Julyan was a colonel in the Galactic Empire who taught a course on Strategy and Tactics at the Arkanis Academy on the planet Arkanis. He was cadaverous, bald and had a drooping white mustache.
Fenris Sarhl was a male Human who held the rank of major in CompForce, the military wing of the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order.

Cathers was the Imperial governor of the planet Demnadi during the Galactic Civil War. Following attacks and riots perpetrated by the Alliance to Restore the Republic on Demnadi, he asked for assistance in dealing with the threat, and was glad when Major Fenris Sarhl of CompFo…
Draynon Atrus was a male Human who served as a Knight-Captain in the Knights of Zakuul, an order of Force-sensitive warriors who protected the Eternal Empire and its ruler, the Immortal Emperor.
One-Eye was the nickname of an Ortolan male who attempted to claim the lost treasure of the Sith Lord Count Dooku on the planet Ponemah Terminal some time after the Battle of Endor.

JanMincénte was a mustached Human male Jedi Master who lived in 345 BBY. JanMincénte instructed Jedi Padawans in the art of lightsaber combat at the Jedi academy based at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
Venner was a middle-aged male Rebel Alliance member who worked as an orderly in the infirmary on one of the Alliance safeworlds. He was present when the Imperial Intelligence agent Saras was exposed.
FN-2003, nicknamed "Slip," was a First Order stormtrooper who served in the decades following the Galactic Civil War. He served under FN-2187 and was considered the weakest link of their group.
During the Galactic Civil War, Darth Sidious employed a male individual as a body double for his own protection.

Coleet was a human female who served as a spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. She was a Rebel mole inside the Arrth-Eno Prison Complex and joined fellow spy Eneb Ray in a plot to kill Darth Sidious, the ruler of the Galactic Empire.

Ryder Azadi was a human male politician who served as governor of Lothal under the New Republic. Azadi served as the governor of Lothal during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign over the Outer Rim planet.

FN-2000, nicknamed "Zeroes," was a human male stormtrooper in the military forces of the First Order. Assigned to the FN Trooper Corps, Zeroes trained alongside troopers FN-2003, FN-2187, and FN-2199 in the decades following the Galactic Civil War.
FN-2199, nicknamed "Nines," was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order in the decades following the Galactic Civil War. He served alongside his friend and brother-in-arms, FN-2187.

Jae Neb was a male Sullustan and a member of the Data Seekers, a secretive organization that sought to unravel the mysteries of the Anoat sector's shrouded history during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Makara was a female Twi'lek and Oskara's sister.
Gyax was a bounty hunter who worked for the Aqualish thugs on Ryloth. He was Oskara's mentor when she offered her services to the gang leader as an "experienced bounty hunter."
Targada was a Klatooinian male who for a time lived as a slave, but eventually gained his freedom and joined the New Republic Defense Fleet. He saw action during the rebellion on Akiva.

Wheeler was a citizen of the Galactic Empire who attended Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials as an Imperial cadet. During the class's first training exercise at the Well, Wheeler was one of the top three performers, along with fellow cadets de Grom and Kell.

Uray was a Pantoran male who served as an ensign in the New Republic Starfleet during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. He served aboard the frigate Sunspire during the rebellion on Akiva.

Hrrgn was a Wookiee from the planet Kashyyyk who escaped from the spice mines of the planet Kessel and evaded the Galactic Empire alongside Roshyk, Kirratha and three other Wookiees at a time no one else could.
Dasch Nilraan was a male Human who served as a Knight-Captain in the Knights of Zakuul.
Alongside 15 other prisoners from the prison planet Despayre, an unidentified prisoner piloted a stolen Lambda-class T-4a shuttle in an attempt to escape to the Death Star's Minimum Safe Distance.
Dru Velton was a Human female born on Zakuul, in Wild Space who served the Eternal Empire during their rule of the galaxy. A pilot, Velton was capable of operating a walker in combat.
Visler Aqorian Korda III was a male human officer in the military of the Galactic Empire, first serving as a captain and then as a commodore.

Peppi Bow was a female Gungan shaak herder who lived on Naboo during the Clone Wars. After several of her livestock had been poisoned after drinking from a river outside Naboo's capital Theed, Bow learned from Senator Padmé Amidala and Representative Jar Jar Binks that her ani…
Pol Andrissus was a male human who served as a member of the alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry. He defected from the Galactic Empire as a cadet along with his classmate Carver.

Lanever Villecham was a Tarsunt male politician who served as the Chancellor of the New Republic. Villecham, a delegate to the Galactic Senate from the Mid Rim planet Tarsunt, was a believer in the peace initiatives that the New Republic carried out after the signing of the Ga…

Tutso Mara was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi Knight in the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. He trained with Padawan Barriss Offee and taught her how to properly hold her lightsaber.
Thadlé Berenko was a human female senator who represented the planet Naboo in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic. She served during the conflict between the Resistance and the First Order.
Lowhhrick's sister was a Female Wookiee who lived on Kashyyyk before being killed by Trandoshan raiding parties, who had traveled from the nearby planet Trandosha to hunt Wookiees for sport.
Korr Sella, also known by the nickname Korrie, was a female human military officer who served as a commander in the naval forces of the Resistance during the Cold War with the First Order.

Cherff Maota was a male Jedi Master who lived during the High Republic Era, and trained Avar Kriss as their Padawan. Maota served as a seeker in the Jedi Order and encountered the Force-sensitive infant Aloxian Zint in 230 BBY, when he brought her into the Order.

Bala-Tik was a human male who worked as a negotiator for the Guavian Death Gang. He handled a deal with the famed smuggler Han Solo by paying for Solo to haul rathtars, a deal that Solo also made with Kanjiklub.

FN-1824 was a human male stormtrooper who served in the forces of the First Order during the New Republic Era. Following the Battle of Takodana in 34 ABY, FN-1824 was assigned to guard Rey, a Force-sensitive scavenger held captive by Kylo Ren aboard Starkiller Base.
Dosmit Ræh was a pilot who served as a captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She flew an X-wing starfighter and was the leader of the Tierfon Yellow Aces starfighter squadron.
Taslin Brance was a human male officer who held the rank of major in the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order.

Harter Kalonia was a human female who served as a doctor with the New Republic and later the Resistance. She was also a Resistance officer holding the military rank of Major. Kalonia was stationed on the Resistance base on D'Qar thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Coburn Sear was a male Kage Warrior and Colonel for the Confederacy of Independent Systems Droid Army and was also the brother of fellow CIS officer, Captain Rackham Sear.
Paos Adina was a scavenger on the desert planet Jakku who died due to the planet's heat sometime before the First Order's attack on the village of Tuanul in 34 ABY.
Turgot Mynes was an individual who died from the heat of the desert planet Jakku while working there as a scavenger.

Binz Scoty was a scavenger on the desert planet Jakku who died due to the world's heat. By 34 ABY, Scoty, Turgot Mynes, and Paos Adina were all included on a list of scavengers who had messed up and died due to heat written by another scavenger named Rey in a survival guide wh…

Gwellis Bagnoro was a mysterious Onodone male who rarely talked about his past. He worked as an expert forger specializing in transit documents thirty years after the Battle of Endor. He was present in the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata on the planet Takodana in 34 ABY.
Zygli Bruss was a Candovantan with ultraviolet vision who represented the world of Candovant in the New Republic Galactic Senate.
Infrablue Zedbeddy Coggins was a male, brown-skinned Zenezian musician who played the hypolliope horn cluster.
Cratinus was an Ubdurian male and the identical brother of Prashee. The pair were fond of games of chance and would use their identical appearances to swap identities during profitable scams.
Vober Dand was a Tarsunt male from Suntilla who served in the Resistance's Ground Logistics Division as a controller.

Erich S. Datoo was a human male military officer who held the rank of colonel in the First Order. In 34 ABY, Datoo was in charge of the primary fire control room on the First Order's Starkiller Base superweapon.
Thanlis Depallo was a human male politician who served as the senator for the planet Commenor in the New Republic Galactic Senate.

Nahani Gillen was a human female who served as senator for the world of Uyter in the New Republic Galactic Senate. Around thirty years after the Battle of Endor, she was present on the planet Hosnian Prime when it hosted the Senate.
Sudswater Dillifay Glon was a Zenezian male brown-skinned alien musician who played the seven-string hallikset.
Athgar Heece was a male Dybrinthe bounty hunter who operated in the Niima Outpost on the desert planet Jakku during the reign of the New Republic.
Brasmon Kee was an Abednedo male who served as senator for his homeworld Abednedo in the New Republic Senate.

Kaydel Ko Connix was a human female who lived during the era of the New Republic and the subsequent war between the First Order and the Resistance. Born on Dulathia, Connix ultimately joined the Resistance; and was stationed at their D'Qar headquarters.
Volzang Li-Thrull was a human male from the planet Nar Kanji who served as a member of the criminal Kanjiklub gang around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

Mandetat was a human male who served the First Order as a technician on the Starkiller Base superweapon. He was one of the many personnel involved in the process of firing the weapon, manning a station in the primary fire control room of the base.
Davan Marak was a humanoid scavenger who spent time in Niima Outpost on the planet Jakku in 34 ABY, just as it came under attack from the First Order.

Munduri and Sonsigo were Bravaisian podmates who worked together due to their attraction toward glittering gems and metals. Their services also included appraisal of precious stones harvested on newly catalogued worlds, and they would pay top prices for what they sought.
The Ewok Grael had a wife who was the mother to his young son, Ponto. She was a member of the Ewok Panshee tribe.
Pammich Nerro Goode was a human female who served as a lead dispatcher for the Resistance at their base on the planet D'Qar around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Gadde Neshurrion was a human male who served as senator of Ubardia in the New Republic Galactic Senate around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

Praster Ommlen was a male Ottegan gunrunner who gave up crime and joined the Sacred Order of Ramulus sect of worship. Around thirty years after the Battle of Endor, he spent time in the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata, offering spiritual advice to the other criminals there.
Jashco Phurus was a human male pirate who prowled the Arrowhead Region of the galaxy east of the planet Coruscant.

Bollie Prindel was a male Urodel who served the Resistance during their conflict with the First Order. Around thirty years after the Battle of Endor, Prindel was stationed as a ground crew quartermaster in the Resistance's base of operations on the planet D'Qar.

Grevoth Prana IX was a male individual who served as a king of the Kaboryth cluster. A pompous and conceited monarch, he was also a collector and trader of exotic and dangerous creatures, which he kept in his own expansive zoo.

Dasha Promenti was a human female member of the Church of the Force, who lived in Tuanul village on the planet Jakku. There, along with the other villagers, she followed an ascetic lifestyle which rejected comfort, luxury and the trappings of war.

Prashee was an Ubdurian male and the identical brother of Cratinus. The two used their identical appearances to swap identities during profitable scams. In 34 BBY, both brothers were present in the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata on the planet Takodana.

Wollivan was a male Blarina who lived approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor. He worked as an interstellar scout and hyperspace trailblazer; he sold valuable astrogation data and scavenged trinkets to smugglers and traders for a living, though he would sometimes …
Strono Tuggs, also known as Cookie, was a deformed Artiodac male who for centuries served as the cook in the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata.

Sonsigo was a Bravaisian podmate of Munduri. The pair worked together and were attracted to glittering gems and metals, offering their services for the appraisal of precious stones harvested on newly catalogued worlds.

Andrithal Robb-Voti was a human female who served as senator for the planet Taris in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic. Andrithal shared part of her surname with the Clone Wars era senator of Taris, Kin Robb.

Taybin Ralorsa was a human female singer. Around thirty years after the Battle of Endor, she played at the pirate Maz Kanata's castle as part of the band Shag Kava alongside Infrablue Zedbeddy Coggins, Ubert Quaril, and Sudswater Dillifay Glon.

Ubert Quaril, also known as Sticks, was a human male musician who played the xyloxan. Around thirty years after the Battle of Endor, he played at the pirate Maz Kanata's castle as part of the band Shag Kava alongside Infrablue Zedbeddy Coggins, Taybin Ralorsa, and Sudswater Di…

Pru Sweevant was a Narquois male who was born on the planet Narq in around 21 BBY. He worked as a bandit around thirty years after the Battle of Endor. Using contacts in the Mining Guild, he learned the schedules of vulnerable convoys and raided them.
Grummgar was a Dowutin male who worked as a big game hunter and mercenary active around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Crokind Shand was a human male from the planet Nar Kanji who served as a member of the criminal Kanjiklub gang around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

Nastia Unamo was a human female who served the First Order as a chief petty officer on board the bridge of the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Finalizer, the flagship of Kylo Ren and General Armitage Hux, during the Cold War era.
Thanisson was a human male who served the First Order as a Petty Officer on board the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Finalizer, the flagship of General Armitage Hux.

Rodinon was a human male military officer who served as a lieutenant in the First Order. Around thirty years after the Battle of Endor, Rodinon was stationed in the primary fire control room of the Starkiller Base superweapon under the command of Colonel Erich S. Datoo.

Roodown, nicknamed "Crusher," was an Abednedo scavenger on the desert planet Jakku. Roodown angered his employer, the junk dealer Unkar Plutt, who suspected the scavenger was selling salvage to a different buyer.

FN-3181 was a human stormtrooper who served the First Order. In 34 ABY, he was deployed to the planet Jakku as part of a First Order attack on the village of Tuanul in an effort to obtain part of a map showing the location of vanished Jedi Master Luke Skywalker.
FN-9330 was a human male stormtrooper who served in the First Order during their conflict with the Resistance. Shortly before Battle of Starkiller Base, FN-9330 was stationed at the base.
Ushos O. Statura was a human male admiral and senior officer with the Resistance. Statura hailed from the planet Garel and had a scientific background.
Gowrik Felrou was a male Cathar underboss of the Starbolts gang operating in the Free Zone, a black market on Asylum, a space station in Wild Space functioning as a shadowport.
Rosser Weno was a human male who lived approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

Brentin Lore Wexley was a male individual who relayed messages for the Alliance to Restore the Republic prior to the Battle of Endor. Residing on the planet Akiva, Brentin married Rebel pilot Norra Susser, and they had a son, Temmin.

A human male reigned as king over the Kingdom of Shu-Torun during the Imperial Era. In addition, he was the father of Princess Trios and her older siblings, Monthan and Hollian. The king was old and on the verge of death by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Esmelle was a human female who lived on the planet Akiva during the Galactic Civil War. Her sister, Norra, was a pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic; during Norra's absence, Esmelle and her wife Shirene watched over Norra's son, Temmin.

Niima, also known as Niima the Hutt, was an enterprising female Hutt scoundrel who operated far from the borders of Hutt Space, a province of the galaxy that became embroiled in conflict as the Hutts attempted to carve up the deceased crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure's territo…

Shirene was a human woman who lived on the Outer Rim planet Akiva with her wife, Esmelle, during the Imperial Era. In 1 ABY, when Esmelle's sister, the pilot Norra Wexley, left Akiva, she and her wife took Norra's son Temmin Wexley into their care.
Shelkry Zepwim was a Human female underboss of the Blast Crew gang operating in the Free Zone, a black market on Asylum, a space station in Wild Space functioning as a shadowport.
Razoo Qin-Fee was a human male from the planet Nar Kanji, who served as a lieutenant in the criminal gang Kanjiklub around 30 years after the Battle of Endor.
Ilco Munica was an Abednedo male who lived as a member of the Church of the Force in the village of Tuanul on the planet Jakku.

Thromba was a Frigosian female who worked as a cryptosurgeon in the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata. Along with her partner Laparo, she offered cosmetic surgery to her clients, including the criminal Ryn Biggleston.

Trios was a human female monarch who ruled the Kingdom of Shu-Torun during the Imperial Era and the Galactic Civil War. Born into the Shu-Torun royal family, Trios was a princess and the youngest child of the King of Shu-Torun.

Monthan was the eldest child and only son of the king of the planet Shu-Torun and stood to inherit the throne upon their father's death. When the king decided to rebel against the Galactic Empire and attempt to assassinate their representative, the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Quiggold was a male Gabdorin pirate and buccaneer from Gabdor and the First Mate of Captain Sidon Ithano's crew.

Bixene was the daughter of Duke Rubix, who held the position of ore-duke on the planet Shu-Torun. When the Imperial Sith Lord Darth Vader visited Shu-Torun, the King of Shu-Torun arranged for a ball to be held in the Shu-Torun royal palace, which Bixene attended with her father.
Hollian was the eldest daughter and second child of the king of the planet Shu-Torun, and stood to inherit the role of celebrant warlord upon the death of her father.
CT-66-3232 was a clone cadet who served in Bravo Squad, a training unit on Kamino, during the Clone Wars. They were marked with a two on their clone training armor.
Doum Cin was a female Human Nightsister who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was a follower of Axkva Min.
Oxvul Cin was a female Human Nightsister who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was a follower of Axkva Min.
Ekomal Cin was a female Human Nightsister who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was a follower of Axkva Min.
Hur'dem Cin was a female Human Nightsister who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was a follower of Axkva Min.
Dorston was a male individual who served in the security force of the planet Wukkar. He was one of the many security guards working for the sector chief of the Black Sun, Avrak Villachor.
Uzior was a male individual who served in the security force of the planet Wukkar. He was one of the many security guards working for the sector chief of the Black Sun, Avrak Villachor.
Mencho Tallboy was a male individual who served in the security force of the planet Wukkar. He was one of the many security guards working for the sector chief of the Black Sun, Avrak Villachor.
Tarrish was a male individual who served in the security force of the planet Wukkar's sector chief of the Black Sun, Avrak Villachor.
Becker was a male individual who served in the security force of the planet Wukkar's sector chief of the Black Sun, Avrak Villachor.

Mister Hate was a Human male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was the brother to a man known as Doctor Schill, or Mr. Love. During the Festival of Love sometime following 0 BBY, Dr. Schill asked a spacer to show love to his brother.

Osto Elrad was a male Bith major of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, he was killed by a group of Imperial agents under direct orders of Darth Vader in his base on Yavin 4.

Demaia Maru was a female Rodian captain of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, she was killed by a group of Imperial agents under direct orders of Darth Vader in her camp on Yavin 4.

A six-armed alien was present in the Mos Eisley spaceport's Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina when the bounty hunter Boba Fett confronted the patrons of the establishment, demanding the identity of a former local moisture farmer, Luke Skywalker.
Dopheld Mitaka was a human male officer who served the First Order as a lieutenant on board the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Finalizer, the flagship of the Force-user Kylo Ren.

Gettle Tebron was a Human who competed as a professional shockball player during the years leading up to the outbreak of the Clone Wars. Tebron was a member of the Shad Furies shockball team and became a friend and rival of the Eriadu Patriots player Kob Mondray.
A female Chev served as a pilot in the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet. During the Battle of Centerpoint Station, she shot Sadras Koyan dead when he boarded the shuttle Chinnith she was on.
Darth Vua was a Yuuzhan Vong male who was recruited by the One Sith as a Sith apprentice. Vua was a slayer who fought during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Kinalos was a New Republic soldier who served during the Imperial Civil War. He fought in a squad with Sergeant Samels and Varshin.

Tanne Kinalos was the partner of Kinalos, a New Republic soldier. They lived together on Coruscant around the time of the Galactic Civil War. Together they had at least two sons and a daughter, Henia.
Henia Kinalos was the daughter of Kinalos and his partner Tanne. She had at least two brothers.
An Imperial officer was on the Imperial Interdictor when it was destroyed by rebels. He, Brom Titus, and other Imperials escaped in the escape pod.
Sola Naberrie was a human female from the planet Naboo. A member of the Naberrie family, she was a daughter of Ruwee Naberrie and Jobal Naberrie, and the sister of Senator Padmé Amidala.

Gannis Ducain was a Kajain'sa'Nikto male gunrunner who stole the Millennium Falcon from Han Solo, only to have it stolen from him later by the Irving Boys. He later had a change of heart from his less-than-noble ways and joined the Resistance.
"Old Man" Hamedaw was a male who lived on Coruscant around the time of the Galactic Civil War.

After the Second Battle of Coruscant in 10 ABY, the Galactic Empire successfully reclaimed its former capital, but quickly fell into sectarian infighting after disagreements over who would be proclaimed Galactic Emperor. Much of the planet was laid waste.
Varshin was a New Republic soldier who served during the Galactic Civil War. He fought in a squad with Kinalos and Sergeant Samels.
Philap Bygar was a human male who served as a general in the Rebel Alliance's High Command during the Galactic Civil War.

Pok was a male Mon Calamari who worked as a bartender at Pok's Place, a cantina in Myrra, the capital city of the Outer Rim planet Akiva. He was old by 4 ABY, as indicated by the long and thick row of barbels under his chin.

Tegan was a Twi'lek who attended Jedi Academy in 196 BBY, the same time as Roan Novachez. She was also the head of The Padawan Observer, the school paper. Tegan made it to the Lightsaber Fencing Tournament, but lost to Cronah both times.
Nysorly was a human female big game hunter who was active sometime after the end of the Galactic Civil War. At some point, Nysorly went to the planet Ithor to hunt a predatory molsume for its pelt.
This ARC Trooper commander was present on Hurd Coyle's ship near the end of the Clone Wars.

Bojo Boopa was a male Gossam enforcer in the employ of Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine during the early days of the Galactic Empire. Boopa was tasked by his boss with getting the money out of moisture farmer Orrin Gault, which was in debt to Jabba.

Jellion Broon was a famous male holovid actor in the decades before the rise of the Galactic Empire. While in Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine as part of a race story he was acting in, Broon became obsessed with the planet's deserts and wandered off to explore the Jundland Wastes.
Ben Gaddink was a male individual who lived on Tatooine during the early days of the Galactic Empire. Gaddink ran an apothecary in the planet's capital city of Bestine.
Ben Surrep was an Ithorian male individual who lived on Tatooine during the early days of the Galactic Empire.

Zedd Grobbo was a muscular Human male who worked for the moisture farmer Orrin Gault and participated in his faked Sand People raids in order to coerce other farmers to donate their money for the Settlers' Call Fund.
Jayla Jee was a female resident of Tatooine who was a member of Orrin Gault's Settlers' Call Fund initiative.

Jervett was a male Devaronian businessmen based in Mos Eisley on Tatooine in 19 BBY. Orrin Gault attempted to convince Jervett and two of his colleagues to become members of his Settlers' Call Fund. However, Jervett was killed during a Tusken Raider attack on Dannar's Claim.
Yoona was a female Duros who was the wife of the Junix's Joint's bartender on Tatooine.

Gloamer was a male Phindian who worked as a speeder mechanic at Dannar's Claim in the Pika Oasis, on Tatooine. Gloamer ran a vibrant trade and took up the third largest portion of the garages in Dannar's Claim.
Waller Pace was a Zeltron male and the husband of the artisan Leelee Pace, who lived on Tatooine shortly after the Declaration of a New Order.

Orman le Hivre was a male human who trained at the Imperial academy on Arkanis. During his time at the academy, he was selected to become a member of the Commandant's Cadets, a secret student organization led by Commandant Brendol Hux.
Iolo Arana was a Keshian male starfighter pilot who served as a lieutenant in the New Republic Starfleet and as a member of Rapier Squadron.
Solculvis was a male who was the regent of the Mol'leaj system. Solculvis had a long-standing feud with King Prana, as both collected dangerous and rare animals for their expansive zoos.
Jagraan was a male Trandoshan present in the Anoat sector during the Iron Blockade. He eventually joined the crew run by Riley's sibling.
Buford was a male human who worked under the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper. He was tasked to get Darth Vader a new pair of socks with Candace and Baljeet.

A human male Imperial officer served in the Seelos system during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The officer noticed a binary transmission from an old clone unit and reported it to ISB Agent Kallus.
Karé Kun was a human female starfighter pilot who served as a lieutenant in the New Republic Starfleet and as a member of Rapier Squadron.
Varmik was near-feral subhumanoid Hassk thug. Together with their two siblings, frequented Takodana Castle and often itched for trouble. Varmik carried a battered VT-33d blaster pistol.
Gret Deljeevo was a Human male underboss of the Blast Crew gang operating in the Free Zone, a black market on Asylum, a space station in Wild Space functioning as a shadowport.
Lonno Deso was a male human who served as a major in the New Republic. He was assigned to the Republic base on Mirrin Prime, where he briefed Commander Poe Dameron's Rapier Squadron after patrols.

Devi was a human female scavenger on Jakku in 33 ABY. She and her partner Strunk helped Rey scavenge for a long-buried 690 light freighter. The two then absconded with it to escape the planet after Rey piloted it to Niima Outpost.

The mother of Everi Chalis was a female individual who lived prior to the Galactic Empire's rise to power in 19 BBY. They resided in a bombed-out paper mill on a planet with an undeveloped society, sharing a stained mattress with their daughter.
Ergel was a human male bartender who owned a bar on the desert planet of Jakku.

Baasen Ray was a male Mirialan smuggler and a one-time partner of Han Solo before the Battle of Yavin. After Solo joined the Rebel Alliance, Ray became a bounty hunter and pursued the bounty placed on Solo's head by Jabba the Hutt.
Hunter Maas was a male Human space pirate who, in 2 ABY, stole the map to the hyperspace nullifier superweapon designed by the extinct K'kybak from the Imperial astrocartographer Essio Galassian.
Sunnim was a male Bothan pilot who served the Mirialan bounty hunter Baasen Ray during the Galactic Civil War.

Dusty was an individual. An incident involving her was a cause of the grudge between Han Solo and Baasen Ray. Later, when Solo and Ray meet again, Solo offered to apologize for what happened, but Ray felt it would not help.
Garet was a male mercenary who worked for the bounty hunter Baasen Ray in 2 ABY, helping him in at attempt to apprehend Han Solo on Cioran.
Cyr Hassk was a male Trandoshan who lived on the planet Cioran at the time of the Galactic Civil War. Serving as an associated of Japet Saun, he worked as a dockhand at a spaceport.
Coovern was a moff in the highest ranks of the Galactic Empire who attempted to replace Colonel Shakara Nuress as leader of the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing with Captain Jothal Gablerone.
Khemt was a minister among the highest ranks of the Galactic Empire. Around 1 ABY, shortly after the Rebel Alliance began a campaign into the Mid Rim, Khemt and a Moff named Coovern died.
Jorn Kulish was a male pilot who flew a Z-95 Headhunter in Foxfire Squadron of the Ividal Sector Forces in the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Rafana was a male individual who served as a Z-95 Headhunter pilot in Foxfire Squadron within the Ividal Sector Forces during the Clone Wars.
Jens was a male pilot who flew a Z-95 Headhunter within Foxfire Squadron, a unit attached to the Ividal Sector Forces.

Roja was a male soldier and former dock worker who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry, more commonly referred to as Twilight Company, during the time of the Galactic Empire. He served with the company at the planets Mygeeto and Phorsa Gedd.

The First Order stormtrooper FN-417 was one of many deployed to the planet Takodana in 34 ABY to recover the Resistance astromech droid BB-8.
Reely Sugg was a male Chiss who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Shelish was a female Dathomirian and a member of the Nightsister coven of Dathomiri witches. She left her homeworld of Dathomir when she was young and thus consequently, she survived the slaughter of her sisters by the Separatist Droid Army leader General Grievous during the C…

Owacchi was a male Wookiee who used to be part of the Starhowl Pirates. When his comrades betrayed him, Owacchi joined the Nightsister Shelish, becoming her right-hand man and staying with her on the jungle moon Jhas Krill.

Seljin Kuric was a male Rodian major of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served as the second in command and liaison between the Wookiee resistance and Rebel Alliance on Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Rhosk was a male Trandoshan of the Blackscale Clan and Adjudant of Lord Cyssc Blackscale who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Kymayrr tasked a spacer with locating Adjudant Rhosk and capturing him.

TK-338 was a human First Order stormtrooper present at the Battle of Takodana during the early stages of the First Order-Resistance War. Another stormtrooper reported to TK-338 that the targets, consisting of Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Finn, were in custody.

Amrosio was a Nothoiin male who lived in the Anoat sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Able to wield the power of the Force, Amrosio became an acolyte of Xiath, a respected mentor to the reclusive Noble Court.

Izby was a female barghest who was the loyal and protective pet of Gwellis Bagnoro, an Onodone forger. Shortly before the Battle of Takodana, Izby and Bagnoro spent most of their time in the castle of Maz Kanata.

A chief ruled over a village of natives on the planet of Vyndal at some point between the Great Jedi Purge and the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire. One day, he met Yeleb, a marooned human male who pretended to be a Jedi.

An alien boy was among the natives of Vyndal who lived in the village protected by Yeleb, a marooned human who posed as a Jedi. One day, they and their mother encountered Kanan Jarrus, a real Jedi who had been forced to land on Vyndal to repair his starship.
Quorr was a Human male lieutenant of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Galactic War he was stationed on Voss.

These unnamed Shadow Guards were five Human males who was part of the Emperor's Shadow Guard, and were stationed on Cloud City. They were all killed when Darth Vader's apprentice, Galen Marek, arrived on the planet in search of Jedi Rahm Kota.
In the third year before the Battle of Yavin, a human male officer of the Galactic Empire liaised with Fenn Rau, the leader of the Protectors of Concord Dawn, on the third moon of Concord Dawn.
Heff Jofer was a male Bith Corellian collector who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Dool was a Human male officer of the Corellian Security Force who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Sheelya was a Human female who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was married with a member of the Corellian Security Force. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, Sheelya lost her house keys to some Greck thugs while her husband was in mission.
Millbarge was a Human male Dantooine collector who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Drenn Zebber was a male Twi'lek who stayed on Yaivn 4 during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Sundre Korbeth was a female foreman who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Pelig was a male scout who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kalesh was a Hutt assassin who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Gladius was a male Rodian who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Gladius was present in the Jundland Wastes of Tatooine with a group of Rodian gladiators, warchiefs, captains and medics.
Keeper Grigova was a male Rodian who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Yosena Tule was a Human female captain of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and a tactical officer of the Wookiee resistance who operated on Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Fawn Moonraiser was an elderly Human female who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Sener was a member of the Imperial Security Bureau during the Galactic Civil War. Sener recommended the bounty hunter Rill for the mission to claim the bounty on her father, Tamaron Rill.
Ren Parteun was a male Twi'lek who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Denbar was a Human male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kodo Kara was a male Twi'lek who was on board the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Blackguard during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Takouhi McCumber was a male Aqualish who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, he provided information about the Greck criminals to the Tyrena city councilmen Lyman Zavala.
Gipson Coloda was man criminal who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was the right hand of the crime lord Olag Greck.
Alasdair Bumbalough was a male criminal who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he worked for the crime lord Olag Greck.
Raglith was a male Sanyassan who lived on Endor with his fellow Marauders during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
A human served as one of the First Order's stormtroopers assigned to Starkiller Base. They reported a sensor trigger in Hangar 718 to Kylo Ren and sent additional troopers to investigate.

"Bogey" was the nickname of a Kwazel Maw that the Gungan Representative Jar Jar Binks encountered and befriended during a mission to Rodia in the Clone Wars. Bogey later played a key role in capturing the Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray.
Incki Kunzler was a Human female Jedi who stayed on Rishi during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Rand Nalleck was a cadet at the Galactic Empire's Imperial Academy of Carida, located on the planet Carida. Nalleck joined the academy during the year 5 BBY, and graduated in 1 BBY.

Dana Cory was a soldier in the Galactic Empire who trained as a cadet at the Imperial Academy of Carida, located on the planet Carida. Cory joined the academy during the year 5 BBY, and graduated during 1 BBY. Cory's ceremony was presided over by General Rom Mohc.

Chad Longko was a member of the Galactic Empire who trained as a cadet at the Imperial Academy of Carida, located on the planet Carida. Longko joined the academy during the year 5 BBY, and graduated during 1 BBY.

Gron was a Lasat male member of the Lasan High Honor Guard. After the near-extermination of his species, Gron rejected violence in his fight against the Galactic Empire, and along with Chava the Wise he searched for Lira San, a legendary refuge for Lasats.

Chava, also known as Chava the Wise, was a female Lasat mystic who survived the fall of Lasan at the hands of the Galactic Empire. She became a refugee and, along with former Lasan High Honor Guardsman Gron, was rescued from Imperial captivity by the rebel crew of the Ghost.

Ben was a member of the Galactic Empire who trained as a cadet at the Imperial Academy of Carida, located on the planet Carida. Ben joined the academy during the year 5 BBY, and graduated during 1 BBY.

Adrona was a female Prefect serving the Galactic Empire. She was impressed by Moxin Tark's capture of Tellas Lordin and allowed Expeditor Minas Derel to renew Tark's Sector Permit for only three hundred credits after gifting her a case of Hestrian wine.
Dashik was a male gun runner who had a bounty of 20,000 credits on his head for the charges of illegally possessing a weapon, assault, and smuggling.

Sana-Rae was a Voss female from the planet of the same name. A Voss Mystic, she was also member of the Eternal Alliance, leading its Force Enclave, a school for the nurturing of Force-sensitives' Force powers.
Renlo was a bounty hunter who vowed to capture Han Solo. He invested in the best technology and devices credits could buy, and hired private instructors to give himself an edge.
Ra Sara was a male Twi'lek criminal who worked as a jeweler in the Anoat sector during its blockade by the Galactic Empire, which they established following their defeat at the Battle of Endor.

Xuvi Ruun was a female Zabrak who lived in the Anoat sector at the time of the Iron Blockade. She had a background in diplomacy, allowing her to exude compassion and trustworthiness when speaking to people.
Swain was a young human female Imperial officer. At the time of the insurgency on the planet of Lothal, she trained under Kallus to become an agent of the Galactic Empire's Security Bureau.

Cogon was a male human who served as an officer of the Galactic Empire until he deserted a few years prior to the Battle of Yavin. Before he could defect to the rebels, he was captured by the Imperial Security Bureau.
Janard was a male human who lived on Mandalore during the Age of the Empire.
Lyman Zavala was a male Twi'lek politician who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was a city councilmen in Tyrena.
Kune'Gunde was a male Quarren who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Pilar VanDeef was a Human male on Tatooine who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, he was abducted by the criminals of the White Thranta Shipping Company.

Kashi VanDeef was a Human female who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, her husband Pilar VanDeef was abducted by the criminals of the White Thranta Shipping Company.
Surlin Rolei was a Human male member of the Royal Naboo Security Forces who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Taron was a male Trade Federation loyalist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Nej'a Berto'Lo was a male Twi'lek Jedi pilot who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Insurgent of the Galactic Empire squadron Black Epsilon successfully tasked a pilot with killing Berto'Lo while he piloted an RZ-1 A-wing i…

Aigorn was a female Trandoshan who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, she tasked a spacer with eliminating one of the medical staff from the White Thranta Shipping Company and steal medical data from the White Thra…
Begol Toulin was a male Bothan who lived in Mos Eisley, on Tatooine, during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Shan'ri Toulin was a female Bothan who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Shan'ri lived in Mos Eisley where she died after getting hooked on death sticks. Her father Begol later asked a spacer to enact revenge against a number of spice dealers.
Bognar was a male Bith who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Keska' Cay was a male Ualaq Aqualish assassin who lived on the planet Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Keska' Cay worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Lyrissa was a Human female moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Dren Feelu was a Human male moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Dren requested a spacer with retrieving his harvester droid, a retasked LIN demolitionmech, that was stolen by Jawas.
Texe was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Krosh was a female Zabrak Tatooine collector who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Ty'oper was a male individual who was present on Rishi during the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Goll was a Twi'lek male who served in the Free Ryloth Movement during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He helped hunt down Darth Vader and Emperor Sheev Palpatine when the movement destroyed the Star Destroyer Perilous and shot their shuttle down.
Kt'lya was a male commander and pilot of the Rebel Alliance, who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Johun, also known as Johun the Hunter, was a male Mandalorian Trandoshan mercenary active during the time of the Galactic War. He was present at the battle for Kuat Drive Yards, where he was killed in the midst of combat.

Kroger was a pilot who served as a major in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was considered a strategic genius when it came to naval warfare, and an excellent pilot.

Ovlaw Grimclaw was a pilot of the Black Sun crime syndicate during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Warvog Arkon of Havoc Squadron tasked a Rebel pilot with killing Grimclaw and four other Black Sun pilots.

L'kew Rawo was a pilot of the Black Sun crime syndicate during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Warvog Arkon of Havoc Squadron tasked a Rebel pilot with killing Rawo and four other Black Sun pilots.

Rita 'the Razor' was a pilot of the Black Sun crime syndicate during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Warvog Arkon of Havoc Squadron tasked a Rebel pilot with killing Rita and four other Black Sun pilots.

Walwer Bealwo was a pilot of the Black Sun crime syndicate during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Warvog Arkon of Havoc Squadron tasked a Rebel pilot with killing Bealwo and four other Black Sun pilots.

Amos Torq was a pilot of the Black Sun crime syndicate during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Warvog Arkon of Havoc Squadron tasked a Rebel pilot with killing Torq and four other Black Sun pilots.

Roach was a human female and a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company. She was recruited by First Sergeant Hazram Namir and Quartermaster Hober on her home planet of Haidoral Prime in 3 ABY.
Infio Argon was a pilot of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Poew Scar was a pilot of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Uowas Irgon was a pilot of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Walfer Whitehand was a pilot of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Boawa was a pilot and general of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Quixio the Rotten was a pilot of the Hidden Daggers during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Sergeant Rhea of the Corellian Security Force tasked a pilot with killing Quixio and four other Hidden Dagger pilots.
Marten Sirl was a male miner living in the town of Vexen on the planet Kallistas. His twelve-year daughter received a cybernetic arm replacement thanks to Jondrell Inx.
The wife of Ubrik Adelhard, a male human who served as the Imperial governor of the Anoat sector, was murdered by the Kouhun, a secret order of assassins based on the planet of Mataou.

Elenzia was a female human and a member of the Noble Court, an assembly of exiled aristocrats whose ancestors ruled the Anoat sector in the pre-Republic times. She had a brother, who stayed with her for a time in her apartments in Cloud City.

Brother Cyst was a male Duros and a member of the Kouhun, a secretive and mystical order of assassins operating in the Anoat sector. A turquoise-skinned Duro, he had a gouged-out right eye and a humped back. He developed dozens of poisons for the Kouhun.
Line was a member of the Kouhun, a secret society of assassins that operated in the Anoat sector. At some point during the Iron Blockade, Line was asked to either kill or abduct an Imperial enslaver.

Dazur Dar, also known as the Data Broker, was a male Abednedo and a member of the mysterious Data Seekers. Like all his comrades, Dar bartered secrets like currency, but he also traded a vast number of rare items discovered in the Seekers' travels.

Ransolm Casterfo, later identified as Prisoner 876549C during his imprisonment, was a human male politician who served as a member of the Galactic Senate of the New Republic several decades after the Galactic Civil War.
Habbel was a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Ndizz was a male Kubaz and a member of the Trade Spine League. Despite his unquivering loyalty to the League, he had tried to overthrow its leadership twice by the time of the Iron Blockade.

An individual known as Dervish resided on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Dervish belonged to a group known also as the Dervish and was skilled in combat as a carbineer and pikeman.
Vannotte was a female Ithorian who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Onli Shi'en was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto Jedi pilot who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Insurgent of the Galactic Empire squadron Black Epsilon successfully tasked a pilot with killing Shi'ien while he piloted a Firespray-3…

Casiss Midagatis was a male Felucian who was the elder of a nysillin farming village of Akira on the planet Felucia. During the Clone Wars, his village was threatened by the Ohnaka Gang who wanted a portion of the nysillin.
Seripas was a diminutive Ssori male bounty hunter from Ssori Fragments, who wore a mechanical suit of armor to make him appear average humanoid size.

Ooblamon was a Kubaz thief who, alongside his apprentice Vermia, met with several Acolytes of the Beyond on the planet Taris in a business transaction, in which he sold them a lightsaber that he claimed had belonged to the Sith Lord Darth Vader, sometime after the Battle of En…

A Duros male bartender worked at the Junix's Joint cantina in Anchorhead on the desert planet Tatooine during the early days of the Galactic Empire. He was married to Yoona, who also worked at the cantina.

During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the father of Riley and her sibling was a miner on the Burnin Konn mining colony in the Anoat sector. When his children were still young, Anoat was poisoned by an industrial accident, and the news of this hit him hard.

A human male known as the Burnin Konn Champion was one of many individuals who came to the call to defend the mining world of Burnin Konn. He rose to prominence within the defenders, becoming a champion to the people of that planet.
Hortrix Steelarm was a male Chiss smuggler who worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Irenez was a female Twi'lek who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Garett Erlskel was a Human male informant loyal to the Hutts who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Erlskel patrolled the Hutt Claims region of the Tatoo system in his G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter.

Faydo Sha was a male Devaronian supplier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. However, he was dismissed from the Rebellion when it was discovered he was a prolific slaver.
Degno was a male Gran who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Anya Razar was a human female who trained at the Imperial academy on Arkanis. Born on Coruscant, Razar was an ambitious student who strongly desired to become a member of a secretive group at the academy known as the Commandant's Cadets.
Kain Apollyon was a musician who specialized in quenk jazz. Sabine Wren enjoyed listening to Apollyon's quenk jazz music, as well as that of Mooneyes.

Altah was a female handmaiden to Queen Kylantha of Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Emperor Palpatine tasked a loyal subject of the Galactic Empire with safely escorting the handmaiden to the Emperor's Retreat so…
Arno Xan was an Abednedo criminal who lived in the Anoat sector at the time of the Iron Blockade. Xan built a collection of stolen Imperial armors, which notably included a set of stormtrooper armor.

Yushyn was a Moyn male who worked as the boss of a Mining Guild Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery in the year 3 BBY. Staffed by Rodian employees, Yushyn's facility refined Clouzon-36 gas, which was used as fuel by the Galactic Empire.

The Purrgil King was a large male purrgil who led a group of purrgil. He was multicolored showing that he was the leader as well as bigger than the other purrgil in the group. He befriended Ezra Bridger and saved his life.
Magaloof was a criminal Leffingite male from the species' homeworld Almak who worked as a speeder thief on the planet Coruscant.

Yolo Ziff was a human male artist who flew for the Resistance during its conflict against the First Order. In 34 ABY, Ziff created propaganda for the Resistance, and he participated in the Battle of Starkiller Base, flying under the command of Black Leader Poe Dameron.
Cypress was a male human who served as a general in the ground forces of the Resistance, a paramilitary group founded by Leia Organa to monitor and oppose the actions of the First Order.

A male individual came to be the parent of the Twi'lek Numa, who was born four years prior to the Clone Wars. They, along with Numa and her mother, lived within a home in Nabat, a small city on the Twi'lek homeworld Ryloth.
A female individual was the mother of the Twi'lek Numa, who was born four years before the outbreak of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Separatist Alliance.
Bedal Cerroux was a male individual from Eriadu who served as an Imperial cadet at the the Arkanis Academy.

Chan Harra was a female individual who served as an Imperial cadet at the Arkanis Academy. Tall and pale, she had an interest in joining the academy's secretive group of cadets known as the Commandant's Cadets, but had never received an invitation.

Ratch was a male Rutian Twi'lek scavenger and captain of the salvage freighter Raider. He recovered Asajj Ventress from her Ginivex-class fanblade starfighter after she was left to die at the Battle of Sullust.

A human male served as a pilot in the Galactic Empire approximately four years before the Battle of Yavin. He transported Zare Leonis from Lothal to Arkanis following Leonis's acceptance into the ranks of the Arkanis Academy.

Sixess was a female Mirialan who worked in the Shadow Market as a saboteur trainer for the Kouhun at the time of the Iron Blockade. She was skilled in the use of incendiary grenades, ion waves, mines, and sticky bombs.

Tigard Manes was a individual who served as a cadet for the Galactic Empire at the officers' academy on Arkanis. Manes was one of several individuals that Zare Leonis, who had infiltrated the academy in order to try to rescue his sister, met shortly upon arrival.
Sian Tevv was a councillor on the planet Sullust who was affiliated with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Shizu was a Hutt who built the Hutt Guard Droid RZ-4 prior to his death by 4 ABY. A dozen security chiefs had previously disappointed him, inspiring the Hutt to build RZ-4 as their replacement.
De Grom was an individual who served as a cadet for the Galactic Empire at the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal.

Uhika was a female individual who served as a governor at some point prior to the Imperial lock down of the Anoat sector. When she was still alive, Uhika forced the Nikto Cult of Chak'ror to serve as her personal shock troops, threatening to have them annihilated if they refused.
Kinera Tiree was the daughter of the Imperial education minister Fondana Tiree on Lothal. She was a student at Phelarion School, an upper-crust school in Lothal's Capital City.
Nho Vantes was a paranoid black market merchant who was active in the Anoat sector during the Galactic Civil War.

Gel Marcolf was a male Force-sensitive Mirialan who was installed as the Reeve of the tree-city of Quolas by the Jedi Knight Suljo Warde. The keeper of one of Warde's three kyber crystals, Warde had promised to return to Arbooine and complete Marcolf's training.
Kuto Jaral was a male Neimoidian officer of the Trade Federation and a resident of the city Jorra on Cato Neimoidia.
Sanna Olpan was a female Neimoidian and a resident of the city Jorra on Cato Neimoidia.
Kaddo Moll was a female Ithorian Jedi Knight who fought during the Clone Wars, in the last days of the Jedi Order.
Jiv Durael was a male Twi'lek Jedi Knight who fought during the Clone Wars, in the last days of the Jedi Order.

Philo was a Gran male senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars. He was one of the senators who opposed the Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill and called a meeting in the lobby to discuss it, unaware that bounty hunters were in the Senate too.

Jakker-Sun was an Ithorian male senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars. He was one of a small group of senators who wanted to stop a vote on the Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill and attended a meeting of those opposed to the bill in the Senate Building t…

Dantum Roohd was a male human senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars. During the war, Roohd was part of the Council of Neutral Systems, an outlier political wing of the Pacifist faction in the senate.

Zinn Paulness was a human male senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars. During the war, Paulness was part of the Council of Neutral Systems, an outlier political wing of the Pacifist faction in the senate, yet also displayed a hawkish attitude towards t…

Aurilan was a Jedi Knight who at one point in history served the Jedi Order. Among Aurilan's contributions was the authoring of the book, Reflections on Form III: Unraveling the Contradictions of Power and Protection.
Kelin Dass was a Jedi Knight who at one point in history served the Jedi Order. An obscure philosopher within the Order's long history, he authored a series of untitled musings and poetry.
Aurelant, a Draedan native to the aquatic world of Sesid, was born into a family with seventeen brothers and twenty-two sisters.
Odir Tumris was a male Sathari and the Patriarch of the Tumris clan, a powerful family in the city of Quolas on Arbooine.
Jyl Korlis was a female Sathari and a farmer who lived in the city of Quolas on Arbooine.
Koh Helshar was a female Sathari and the Matriarch of the Helshar clan, a powerful family in the city of Quolas on Arbooine.

Draa was a clone trooper who served in the 41st Elite Corps during the Clone Wars. He took part in the Second Battle of Geonosis, under the command of Jedi Master Luminara Unduli and Clone Commander Gree, after the native Geonosians broke free from the Republic control that ha…

Finn Ertay was a Twi'lek female who served the Galactic Republic as a Jedi during the Clone Wars. Ertay and a Kajain'sa'Nikto Jedi encountered the brothers Maul and Savage Opress on a spaceport somewhere in the Outer Rim Territories.

Eekar Oki was a Mon Calamari male who served the Galactic Republic as a Jedi during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, Oki was present in a meeting of members of the Jedi Order after they were contacted by Confederate General Grievous during his imprisonment of Jedi Master Eeth Koth, …

Rod was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. At the Battle of Malastare, he served as the gunner for clone trooper pilot Goji, who deployed an electro-proton bomb prototype that was instrumental in the Republic's ensuing victory.

Goji was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. At the Battle of Malastare, they flew a Y-wing starfighter and was responsible for deploying the electro-proton bomb, an experimental weapon that secured the Republic's victory.
Okuvim the Younger, colloquially known as Okuvim, was a Twi'lek female who served as a scout in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during its war against the Galactic Empire.

Magé was a governor of the Galactic Empire who worked as an administrator on the planet Allst Prime. When the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry attacked the Imperial outpost on the planet, the governor identified the company's starship and spoke about the rebels over her c…
Nordon was a male Twi'lek pilot who served his planet in Cham Syndulla's Free Ryloth Movement. He played a major role in the events following the Destruction of the Star Destroyer Perilous.

Kars Tal-Korla was a pirate who resided in Cloud City, where he became known as the "Scourge of Cloud City." When the Iron Blockade was established by the Galactic Empire, Tal-Korla was hired by Lobot to help apprehend Imperial Governor Ubrik Adelhard, although the pirate was …
Trella Bare'Ah was a female Twi'lek who worked as a dancer and was romantically involved with the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo during the Clone Wars.

Tesser was an X'Ting who lived before the Clone Wars. He was the broodmate and brother of Jesson Di Blinth, a member of the X'Ting Hive Council. He died in a cave while searching for the Royal X'Ting eggs.
Droogan was a male Khramboan vendor on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. They managed to swindle the protocol droid C-3PO out of thirty two credits when the droid was shopping for jogan fruit.
Roo-Roo Page was a female Gungan from Jan-gwa born before the Clone Wars. Unknown to most, Page was Force-sensitive.
Meymik was a male Chadra-Fan who had a criminal career in the Anoat sector of the galaxy. He claimed to have once been a personal enforcer of Jabba the Hutt, but these claims were fabricated.

Wexell was a male Human private in the reconstituted Sith Empire of the Imperial Military. During the Battle of Corellia he was wounded by revolting Wookiees in the Labor Valley and was forced to recuperate.
Destha was a female Selonian who served her den mother Murthil in the latter's Elite Selonian Guard during the Galactic War.
Roval was a male Human who served as a lieutenant in the military of the reconstituted Sith Empire. He participated in the Battle of Corellia in 3640 BBY.
The Sith Lord Kanno of the reconstituted Sith Empire had a young daughter who lived on the planet Korriban during the Galactic War.

Voth Vassakka was a Human soldier of the Galactic Republic's Special Forces Division who fought against the reconstituted Sith Empire at the Battle of Corellia, where the trooper held the Republic's supply schedule for Corellia in the planet's capital, Coronet City.
Project Sav-Rak was the designation given to a Mantellian Savrip that Doctor Sannus Lorrick exposed to the rakghoul plague during the Galactic War.

Krupp was a Human male lieutenant in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire who fought in the Battle of Kuat during the Galactic War, where he was killed aboard the Kuat Defensive Station.
Benes was a Mirialan male major in the ground forces of the Republic First Fleet who fought in the Battle of Kuat during the Galactic War, where he was killed aboard the Kuat Defensive Station.

Kodo was a Human male who served as a private in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, he was stationed in the Imperial base camp.

Sele was a Human female who served as a quartermaster in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, she was stationed in the Imperial base camp.

Fovish was a Human female who served as an captain in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, she was stationed in the Imperial base camp.

Tlels was a Human male who served as a supply officer in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, he was stationed in the Imperial base camp.

Mikaen was a Human male who served as a supply officer in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, he was stationed in the Imperial base camp.
Chalik was a male Talz commander of the Galactic Republic stationed on Ilum during the Battle of Ilum, where he was killed by Imperials.
Thekko Longshot was a male Kaleesh warrior fighting on the side of the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Ilum, where he was killed by the Imperials.
Veggan Quickhands was a male Kaleesh warrior fighting for the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Ilum. He was killed by the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Elder Grorrgh was a male Kaleesh warrior fighting on the side of the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Ilum, where he was killed by the Imperials.
"Coruscant" Erragh was a Kaleesh male warrior fighting on the side of the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Ilum, where he was killed by the Imperials.
Marragh the Edge was a male Kaleesh warrior fighting for the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Ilum. He was killed by the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Gelrex was a male Kaleesh general fighting for the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Ilum. He was approached by personnel of the reconstituted Sith Empire with an offer to join them.

Zarran was a male Zabrak smuggler hired as a privateer by the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, he and two other smugglers were killed while defending Adegan crystals from an Imperial assault.

Selah was a Human female who served as an agent of Imperial Intelligence, the intelligence agency of the reconstituted Sith Empire, during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, she was stationed in the Imperial base camp.

Chiann was a Human male who was a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, he was stationed in the Imperial base camp.
Rasche was a Sith male who was a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, he was stationed in the Imperial base camp.

Genter Fosse was a male Mandalorian who was allied with the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. During the Battle of Ilum, he was stationed in the Imperial base camp.
Avanj was a Human male apprentice of Sith Lord Ranor. They betrayed the reconstituted Sith Empire and were killed along with him on Hoth.
Myshurr was a male Human apprentice of the Sith Lord Ranor, who for betraying the Empire was killed along with him on Hoth.
Terik was a male Human apprentice of the Sith Lord Ranor, who for betraying the Empire was killed along with him on Hoth.
Ranor was a Human male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire, who was killed on Hoth along with his apprentices for a supposed betrayal.
