Barcel was a human male who served in the Galactic Empire's navy as a communications officer on the bridge of Prelate Verge's personal Imperial II-class Star Destroyer, the Herald.

Iania was a Twi'lek female who the Rebel Alliance Captain Micha Evon had feelings for when both of them were at school. Evon later remembered the Twi'lek as his first schoolyard crush in 0 ABY when talking to the young private Hazram Namir on the planet Vir Aphshire.

Fong Do was a Nautolan male who lived in the Coruscant Underworld during the Clone Wars. He was close friends with the bounty hunter, Castas, and frequently enjoyed drinking in bars across the galaxy.
Breyer Chorn was a male Mandalorian warrior at the time of the Eternal Empire's conquest of the galaxy. Breyer was a member of Clan Chorn, and he sported gold and grey Mandalorian armor.

Unkajo was a massive wampa with white fur and black eyes from the planet Hoth, located in the Hoth system of the Anoat sector. According to the Kouhun assassin Loathe, Unkajo was a beast that had grown old and powerful.

Zinn Toa was a male Nautolan child that was born during the time of the Clone Wars. He was kidnapped by the notorious bounty hunter, Cad Bane, at the behest of Darth Sidious, who had planned to use him, along with other Force-sensitive children, to create an army of dark side …
Jenni was a female human assassin who operated in the Anoat sector. Initially, she worked for the Galactic Empire.

Nim Mindbend was a criminal who operated during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. At some point during the war, Mindbend was wanted dead for the act of kidnapping, theft and murder with a prize of 120,000 credits.
Silva was a student who attended the Jedi Academy at the same time as Roan Novachez.

Lodaka was a female Rodian Jedi Master. An unparalleled master of Form III/Soresu, the third form of lightsaber combat. She was also fascinated by the material properties of the various crystals used in lightsaber construction.

Ileris Tik'kla was a female Caamasi who acted as an Ambassador for the Rebel Alliance early in the Galactic Civil War. Along with her aid Niak, she was assigned to negotiate with ambasssador Woz Kaza for weapons for the Alliance.
Niak was a female Neimoidian analyst and aide to Ambassador Ileris Tik'kla of the Rebel Alliance early in the Galactic Civil War.

Woz Kaza was a male Gossam who was as an Ambassador for the Galactic Senate before its dissolution. He then became a smuggler early in the Galactic Civil War. He negotiated with Ileris Tik'kla for weapons, but betrayed her.

TK-462 was the operating number of a human male Imperial stormtrooper. A native of the planet Eriadu, he enlisted in an Imperial Junior Academy against his father's wishes following the death of his younger sister Xea at the hands of rebels during a botched attempt to steal ai…
Lassar, nicknamed "Jogan" after the fruit of the same name, was a veteran clone trooper who fought in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. After the
Xea was a female human from the planet of Eriadu. In the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign, she and her older brother lived with their father and mother, who maintained an air scrubber farm.
The mother of the man who became the Imperial stormtrooper TK-462 was a female human from Eriadu. She lived with her son, her daughter Xea, and her husband, who operated an air scrubber farm.
The father of the man who became the Imperial stormtrooper TK-462 was a male human who operated an air scrubber farm on Eriadu, where he lived with his wife, his son, and his daughter Xea.

An Imperial governor, who was a relative of Wilhuff Tarkin, ruled the planet Eriadu in 14 BBY. When Tarkin visited Eriadu after becoming the first Imperial Grand Moff, the governor awarded him the key to Eriadu City and held a parade in his honor.
A female Zygerrian ruled as the Queen of Zygerria in the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign.
During the Imperial blockade of the Anoat sector, Mercos joined the Smuggler's crew, who dispatched the Rebel on a variety of missions throughout the sector.
Hela was a female Nothoiin who served as the captain of Earl Alner's private guard. She favored melee combats and edged weapons.

Regmus was a male Nothoiin who served the Noble Court-in-exile of the Anoat sector. Once the captain of the Throneship Honorbound, he had lost it to the Galactic Empire by the time of the Iron Blockade, and sought to atone for his failure.
Praji was a Moff of the Sector 4 in the Grand Army of the Republic. During the Clone Wars, this Moff led the Fourth Outer Rim Army from its headquarters on the planet Alderaan.
Durm Bormo was a male Abednedo scout who was active decades after the Battle of Endor. He worked with a team of adventurers on Jakku to discover the secrets of a crashed New Republic corvette.
Fira Bon was a human female soldier who was active during the New Republic Era.
Mhar'li was a human female pilot who was active decades after the Battle of Endor.
Tiras Or'un was a human male explorer who was active during the New Republic Era.
Sulamar was a Moff in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. This Moff led the Javin sector's Nineteenth Army from its headquarters on the planet Javin.
A Rodian male worked as a shopkeeper in a resettlement village on the planet Lothal during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

P'nll Vun was a Nautolan who lived in Reestkii on the planet Jakku. He was taken captive and detained in Reestkii's town hall along with the other residents when his village came under attack by Zygerrian slavers.

A male Hosnian was on the planet Hosnian Prime during the Cold War. In 34 ABY, approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor, the First Order fired the Starkiller Base superweapon at the New Republic capital, destroying Hosnian Prime along with its population.

Om'rahk, a male Whiphid, was a Force sensitive mercenary who was active during the Galactic Civil War. During that time, he accepted the assignment of protecting the village of Torosh and met the mercenaries Nonia and Taelo.
Nonia Daal was a female Iktotchi Force sensitive who along with Taelo was instructed by a teacher during the Galactic Civil War.
Taelo was a female Lannik Force-sensitive who along with Nonia Daal was instructed by a teacher during the Galactic Civil War.
Edern Lars was a human male from Tatooine. He was the son of Gredda and Lef Lars, and the younger brother of Cliegg Lars.

Khundu was a human male who served as a member of the Chromium Kings. During the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector, the Chromium Kings forces were attacked and defeated on the planet Burnin Konn by a smuggler associated with the Ivax Syndicate.

Luitt was a human male captain in service of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy five years after the end of the Clone Wars. He was an officer aboard the Perilous, flagship of Darth Vader and Emperor Sheev Palpatine, during their mission to Ryloth.

Findal Kett was the head of Kett Shipping, a company that carried ore and nova crystals from the planet Cotellier in the Rseik sector up the Sanrafsix Corridor to Kabal, and then grain and other supplies back to Cotellier.

Nara was a bantha who lived on the desert planet Tatooine. During the Age of the Empire, former Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi lived among the bantha herd in which Nara belonged, and the Jedi considered them to be his family.

Dolo was a bantha who lived on the desert planet Tatooine during the Age of the Empire. Obi-Wan Kenobi, a former Jedi Master, lived among the bantha herd in which Dolo belonged, and the human considered the banthas to be his family.

Katrull was a Trandoshan who operated as an employer of smugglers during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to the Battle of Hoth, Katrull offered a job to Han Solo, but the human was reluctant and passed on the deal.
Loo Re Anno was a female Sibettan and a respected racer in the Dragon Void Run. Within the Dragon Void, she was acknowledged as both the greatest and eldest racer present.

Nierre was the last name of the father of the Nierre family, a human family that lived on the planet Jelucan during the reign of the Galactic Empire. They were the descendants of the first wave of settlers who had been exiled to Jelucan for remaining loyal to their king.

Ryn Biggleston was a female human who was partners with the Balosar BeeLee Amdas. After betraying and killing Amdas by poisoning her drink, Biggleston underwent a facial reconstruction performed by cryptosurgeons Thromba and Laparo in a lab rented from Maz Kanata on Takodana.
451.322/S8 was an Imperial squad commander assigned to reconnoiter a deserted command bunker on the planet Rentalles during the Galactic Civil War.
Hov Windell was an Alliance commander assigned to recover a modulator for a hyperwave signal interceptor from an abandoned listening post on the planet Rentalles during the Galactic Civil War.
792.001/Z6 was an Imperial Commander assigned to command Altratonne Station on the planet Altratonne during the Galactic Civil War.
792.664/Z6 was an Imperial Commander assigned to command the patrol that protected Altratonne Station's power generator on the planet Altratonne during the Galactic Civil War.
792.667/Z6 was an Imperial Commander assigned to oversee Altratonne Station's landing platform on the planet Altratonne during the Galactic Civil War.
793.641/Z6 was an Imperial Commander assigned to reconnaissance duty around Altratonne Station's rear entrance on the planet Altratonne during the Galactic Civil War.
Lav Bilsek was an Alliance Commander assigned assault Altratonne Station on the planet Altratonne during the Galactic Civil War.
Yenchara was a Hutt who lived on the planet Boonta. In honor of a three-day holiday known as Boonta Eve, this Hutt created the Boonta Speeder Race in order to generate more profit on Boonta Eve.
Thon was an Imperial officer who served in Rampart Station, a supply base for ships en route to the planet Geonosis.

Baird Kantoo was a human male who lived as a Jedi Master prior to the formation of the Old Republic. Kantoo sought to craft a weapon suitable for the Jedi, so he used his knowledge of the Force to forge several kyber crystals into a single blade, creating the Kyber Saber—the g…

Mercurial Swift, born Geb Teldar, was a human male bounty hunter who was active from the reign of the Galactic Empire into the early days of the New Republic. As a bounty hunter, Swift preferred working alone, even refusing a business proposal from veteran bounty hunter Dengar.
Graballa was a Hutt crime lord and cousin of Jabba Desilijic Tiure. During the Galactic Civil War, Graballa managed an ore mine in the Belgaroth asteroid field on behalf of his wealthier cousin.
Smiley was a nexu owned by the crime lord Graballa the Hutt.

Furlac was the Aqualish landlord of the Freemakers, a family of scavengers who operated a starship and repair business called Freemaker Salvage and Repair on the space station the Wheel. He had a difficult relationship with his tenants who were unable to pay their rent.

Mynock was a male Mandalorian warrior who lived during the war against Zakuul. When Mandalore the Avenger had agreed to help assist the Eternal Alliance and brought the clans to Darvannis, Mynock was among those to answer her call.

Dalash Ard was a female Mandalorian warrior who lived during the war against Zakuul. During the Mandalorian raid on Zakuul droid factory, Dalash was one of the team leaders who assisted The Commander during the attack, helping destroy many Skytroopers.

Bon Yoth was a male human who served in the Rebel Alliance before he argued with General Carlist Rieekan and left the Alliance. He was the contact of Princess Leia Organa on the planet Basteel in the mission known as Operation Yellow Moon.

Silas Fleetfire was a female Rattataki merchant who lived during the war against Zakuul. On Darvannis, she helped assist the Mandalorian clans and the Outlander with the supplies she brought with her to the planet.

Wick Cooper, also known as Mr. Cooper, was a wealthy customer of the scavenger family, the Freemakers. He lived in the Wheel's upper level and at one point owned an antique N-1 starfighter. Mr Cooper was annoyed when Zander took his ship on a joyride and wrecked it.

Grolt was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy five years after the end of the Clone Wars. He was described to be thin like a Whiptree and was an officer aboard the Perilous, flagship of Darth Vader and Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the mission to Ryloth.
The grandmother of Carise Sindian was a female individual from Alderaan. She often sang Carise the Alderaanian lullaby "Mirrorbright" when she felt nostalgic about her homeworld.

A tavern-keeper from Pamarthe was active during the time of the New Republic. He owned a cantina on Pamarthe. Greer Sonnel, a native Pamarthen, and Joph Seastriker entered the cantina when Joph claimed he hadn't been to Pamarthe in a while.
A pilot from Pamarthe operated during the time of the New Republic. During her later life, she was present at a cantina on Pamarthe where Greer Sonnel, a native Pamarthen, drank Port in a Storm.
Khione was a human female who served as captain of the Imperial Star Destroyer Shieldmaiden between the Battle of Hoth and the Battle of Endor.

At some point in time following the Battle of Jakku, a human Padawan hoping to join Luke Skywalker's new generation of Jedi was sent on a mission to the planet Tatooine from Skywalker himself to await a delivery from Han Solo.

Karsted was a human male who hailed from the planet Pamarthe. He was the former partner of fellow racer, Greer Sonnel, and the two split up after he cheated on her. After this, she attempted to ignore Karsted, much to his annoyance.

An individual served as an arbiter and crowned Lady Carise Sindian as the supreme governor of the planet Birren. They gave Sindian the traditional cloth-of-gold mantle and scepter to symbolize they would shelter and defend the people of Birren.

An individual served as Warden of the Treasures during the time that Lady Carise Sindian became supreme governor of the planet Birren. The Warden informed Sindian that she did not need to look through the previous governor, Lord Mellowyn's, things that day.
Ignacio Wortan, also known as Iggy Wortan, was a male Twi'lek who wanted to buy a Wroshyr wood frame from the scavenger family, the Freemakers. He came from the Core Worlds planet of Wortans.
Attiburra was a Wookiee Chief who hired the Freemakers to rescue his son Tantarra from a Trandoshan island fortress. In return, he gifted the Freemakers with a piece of wroshyr wood.

Tantarra was a Wookiee prince and the son of Chief Attiburra. He was held captive by Trandoshans before his rescue by the Freemakers. Tantarra then helped the Freemakers recover the third Kyber Saber crystal.

Durpin was an Imperial officer who served the Galactic Empire following the Battle of Hoth alongside his fellow officer Plumestriker. The two commanded the Blockade of Kashyyyk and patrolled the Emperor Palpatine Museum on Naboo.

Plumestriker was an Imperial officer who patrolled the Blockade of Kashyyyk, the Emperor Palpatine Museum and Echo Base on Hoth with his partner Durpin. During the course of his duties, Plumestriker would encounter the scavenging Freemakers on several occasions.

Roonlo, or Roonlo the Stalker, was an Aqualish male criminal who harassed Riley, sending her monthly Muckrat Skulls prior to and throughout Imperial Governor Ubrik Adelhard's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector. He and Riley's father had issues with one another.

Pentir Bephorin was the son of Givin mathematician and cryptographer Drusil Bephorin. When Drusil was captured by the Galactic Empire and forced to work for them she was separate from Pentir, who was left with his father and other siblings.
Weechee was a male Ewok who lived in Bright Tree Village on Endor. He was the brother of Widdle Warrick and Wicket W. Warrick.
Durs was a member of the New Republic Special Forces who was deployed to the planet Akiva during the Rebellion on Akiva in 4 ABY.

Nautag was the husband of Yarna d'al' Gargan, an Askajian from Askaji. After Jabba Desilijic Tiure bought the family, Nautag was fed to the Hutt's rancor for insubordination, and Yarna was forced to perform exotic dances for the Hutt.

Gazwin was an Uthuthma who spent time on the planet Jakku following the Battle of Endor. They were seated on a stall at Ergel's Bar in Cratertown when the human settler Corwin Ballast took a seat next to them.
Gor-kooda was a Herglic who served the Sullustan crime lord Surat Nuat as an enforcer on the planet Akiva.
Bokwarro was a Wookiee male pirate active during the reign of the Galactic Empire who was a member of the Starhowl Pirates. His preferred weapon of choice was a bowcaster.

The Festering Shaman was a male Lurker shaman who lived on Anoat during Governor Ubrik Adelhard's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector. He attempted, unsuccessfully, to prevent the Smuggler from partaking in the Waters of Change when sent to do such by Shelish.

The human male Rapace served the Galactic Empire as an Imperial officer on the planet Akiva. During the Rebellion on Akiva between the Empire and the New Republic, he was tricked into letting the former Imperial Sinjir Rath Velus into the communications station that he held co…
Tae Boon was a male Twi'lek who served as a second in command to Cham Syndulla of the Twi'lek Resistance during the Clone Wars.

Borgin Kaa was a human male from the planet Onderon who served as a mining baron on a moon of the planet Sevarcos. As an old man, he lived in Cloud City on the planet Bespin where he awaited an implant after suffering heart problems.
Kirratha was one of only a dozen Wookiees alongside Roshyk and Hrrgn who managed to escape from the planet Kessel after their species was enslaved by the Galactic Empire and put to work there.

Imra was a woman that the New Republic hero Han Solo and his co-pilot Chewbacca knew from their days as smugglers prior to the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Margoet was an Imperial who informed Maarek Stele that the "Imperial"-class Star Destroyer "Vengeance" had began procedures to jump to Hyperspace and advised him to return to the ship.

Baash was a male Iktotchi bounty hunter who worked for Graballa the Hutt with his fellow partner, Raam. Under the leadership of the bounty hunter Dengar, he and Raam hunted Rowan Freemaker in order to obtain the Kyber Saber crystals.

Raam was an male Iktotchi bounty hunter who worked for Graballa the Hutt with his fellow partner, Baash. The two bounty hunters worked with the bounty hunter Dengar to hunt Rowan Freemaker in order to find the Kyber Saber crystals.

Amrashad was a general in the Rebel Alliance's military during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, during the Mid Rim Retreat, Amrashad died in the midst of a final effort to escort the Alliance Fleet from the Mid Rim.
Cantompa was a human male fleet trooper within the Galactic Empire's navy during the Galactic Civil War, serving on board the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Herald.
When the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs wanted to host a cooking competition in the kitchen of the pirate Maz Kanata's castle, he had to convince the building's majordomo to allow him to do it.

Frutchoo was a male Advozse biker who collected a spaceport tax on the planet Vaced. He lead a group of bikers which he referred to as his "deputies", but one member of the group did not like being bossed around an preferred the word "associates".
This individual was a Mandalorian mercenary of a clan loyal to Ung Kusp.

Uzall was a cadet in Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials born by 18 BBY. Uzall was assigned to Unit Besh, a unit in the squad LRC077. During the beginning term at the academy, Uzall participated in a training exercise in the Well, a purpose-built training facility.

Ben Neluenf was the first great podracer born on the desert planet of Tatooine. At some point prior to the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY, Neluenf lost his life in a spectacular attempt to scale a broad, flat-topped mountain located between the Desert Plain and the Hutt Flats on …
Oskus Stooratt was a male human who was present in the castle of Maz Kanata on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet.
Blass Tyran was a male human who was present in the castle of Maz Kanata on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet.
Grezor was a Nautolan male Colonel who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.
Raze was a female Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire who lived sometime during their conflicts with the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order.

Mehmet Alovar was a male Mon Calamari from Coral City who was born into the Mon Calamari aristocracy. In his later years, he was a highly respected individual among members of his species and was one of his people's emissaries to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Hobin Carsamba was an alien who worked as a scavenger on the planet Jakku in 34 ABY. Carsamba once joined a queue to trade with the junk dealer Unkar Plutt in Niima Outpost while the scavenger Rey dealt with Plutt at the front of the line.
Hoogenz was a Buktari who, alongside fellow Buktari Anonda, spent time in Niima Outpost on the desert planet Jakku during the reign of the New Republic.
Taryish Juhden was a human male who spent time in Niima Outpost on the planet Jakku around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Thorbo was a major in the Galactic Empire stationed on Outpost D-34 as a senior officer.
Ashe was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic stationed on Rafft. He was a mechanic stationed in a township two hundred kilometers from the Rebel base on the planet.
Colin was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic stationed on Rafft.
Thinker was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic stationed on Rafft. He was a base's technical expert.
Saaryu was an Imperial TIE pilot who was known to be an ace shooter. He was taking part in the Battle of Ottega to finish of Admiral Harkov's fleet that had defected to the Rebel Alliance.

Prakrii was an Imperial TIE pilot, who was recently transferred to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Garrett as part of the Battle of Ottega to finish of Admiral Harkov's fleet that had defected to the Rebel Alliance.
Bolivar Denai was a human male who spent time in Niima Outpost on the planet Jakku around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Tolomar Reez was a human male from the planet Nar Kanji who served in the criminal gang known as Kanjiklub under topboss Tasu Leech.
Jams was a male human who served as an officer in the Imperial Navy in the early years of Emperor Palpatine's reign.
Wi'ba Tuyll was a human male who spent time in the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata on the planet Takodana around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

A human miner worked at a refinery complex on the asteroid Pressy's Tumble, which was owned by the First Order. He organized a strike due to the harsh living and working conditions on the mining colony.
Monn Tatth was a dark-skinned human male who spent time on the planet Jakku around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

Janu Godalhi was a human male lawyer and security expert who worked with Jedi Master Plo Koon to drive pirates from the planet Teth. In 19 BBY, he attended a showing of the opera Squid Lake at the Galaxies Opera House on the planet Coruscant.
Nim Bola was a freelance detective for hire operating on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. He partnered with a Twi'lek named Tavri.
Bregless was the predecessor to Sub-Prefect Neris. He was killed by Gornt Seron.
Varond Jelik was a human male who assisted Han Solo and Chewbacca in smuggling Rathtars for King Prana on Twon Ketee.

Victor Starspeeder, also known briefly as Kaa Vhin, was a Human boy from Naboo. Starspeeder had a Jedi father named Edward Starspeeder who went to the dark side, taking the identity of Krio Vin and skyhopper racing.

Akana-Tok was a male Voss commando living on Voss during the Galactic War. Disobeying the order to avoid the Nightmare Lands, he and a few other commandos ventured into the forbidden territory and were corrupted by the darkness within.
Alli Krieger's sister was a female who lived during the Galactic War. She was a sister of Alli Krieger, a small business owner in Galactic City and Erek Krieger, soldier in the Republic Army.
Altiss was a female Human Moff of the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3639 BBY she commanded the Imperial operations on Denova following the defeat of troops led by Colonel Grezor.
Angol Martilla was one of the Slayers Three, a trio of big-game hunters from a world within the Spawn Nebula, along with his brother Derrus and his sister Bez.
Antar Bintaghr was a male Human soldier of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Arden was a male Human captain of the Republic Strategic Information Service living during the Galactic War.
Ardot was a male Human infantry commander of the reconstituted Sith Empire's forces at the Ilum Jedi Temple during the Galactic War.

Arick Tamso was a male Human doctor living on Balmorra during the Galactic War along with his brother Pol. During the Battle of Balmorra Arick worked along with fellow doctor Tabo on pacifying the Colicoids at the Sundari Research Grounds facility.
Arkin Bel was a male Human spacer living during the Galactic War. Around 3642 BBY he was on Hoth, where Maya Drin asked him to rescue the captive Ortolans, but he refused.

Arrin Nikols was a male Human living on Makeb during the Galactic War along with his wife Blanca and his son Ritte. Arrin was a captain of the the InterStellar Regulators, who had been bribed by the Hutts to help them conquer Makeb in 3638 BBY.
Athleenia Dannuz was a female Human Jedi Master of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War.
Azarea Balawii was a female Human merchant living in the town of Raider's Cove on Rishi during the Galactic War.

Balko was a male Human lieutenant of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. At some point he became part of the Order of Revan and defected from the Empire, joining with the Revanite forces on Rishi's Sky Ridge Island under command of Lord Ivress.

Beraxil was a female Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3637 BBY she was on Ziost when former Sith Emperor Vitiate came to the world and possessed many of the Imperials on the planet, turning them into his puppets to murder civi…
Bestul Pelizmo was a male Human Sith Inquisitor of the reconstituted Sith Empire who visited the town of Raider's Cove on Rishi during the Galactic War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Bez Martilla was one of the Slayers Three, a trio of big-game hunters from a world within the Spawn Nebula, along with her brothers Angol and Derrus.
Biabru was a female Human agent of the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War.
Bizal Mavole was a male Arcona of the Bounty Supply Company stationed on the Vaiken Spacedock living during the Cold War and Galactic War.
Blacaa Maralt was a male Kubaz living in the town of Raider's Cove on the planet Rishi during the Galactic War.
Bo Zarran was a male Zabrak beastmaster living during the Galactic War. In 3638 BBY he took part in a large mercenary gathering on Darvannis along with his trained Reek Thrasher.
Bodakus Emol was a male Human soldier of the Galactic Republic who visited the town of Raider's Cove on Rishi during the Galactic War.
Borik Sabha was a male Duros living in Camp Karnori on Tatooine during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, the camp had problem with the Geonosian raids, during one of which his wife lost her brother.

Vandreen was a female Twi'lek Sergeant of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY she was stationed in the Section X area of Belsavis.

Varus was a male Zabrak archivist living on Makeb during the Galactic War. During the Conquest of Makeb in 3638 BBY he asked a Galactic Republic agent to venture into Tarlam city archives occupied by the InterStellar Regulators and retrieve the Shipwright's Tools - a relic mad…
Vetro was a Human male who sold various stimulants and medpacs at Outpost Salara on Tatooine during the Cold War.

Vodd was a female Pureblood Sith Lord of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. At some point she became part of the Order of Revan and defected the Empire, joining with the Revanite forces on Rishi.

Vom Dresid was a male Human Major of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. In 3638 BBY he was stationed on the Valor-class cruiser Gav Daragon, where he escorted an important figure to a private meeting with the Supreme Chancellor Leontyne Saresh.
Weklae Baso was a male Human living during the Galactic War. By 3637 BBY he was working as a bartender in the Blaster's Path cantina on Rishi.
Wudd was the name of a giant Grophet living on the Sky Ridge Island of Rishi until 3637 BBY, when it was killed.
Yassia Koth was a female Zabrak of the Interplanetary Component Exchange stationed on the Vaiken Spacedock living during the Cold War and Galactic War.

Ziril was a female Twi'lek hyperspace explorer living during the Galactic War. Along with her droid 08-RD she was mapping unexplored space near Rishi Maze using Rishi itself as their resupply point in 3637 BBY, when 08-RD was stolen and dismantled by the Nova Blades pirate gang.

Zyyskel was a male Gand criminal living during the Galactic War. Imprisoned on Belsavis by the Galactic Republic, Zyyskel was forcibly drafted into the Project Noble Focus, which forced alien inmates of different species to compete against each other to learn their strengths a…
Bluuto Karlabasy was a male Nautolan living on Rishi during the Galactic War. In 3637 BBY he visited a Rishii village on a remote island.
Caffi Shish was a male Human living in the town of Raider's Cove on Rishi during the Galactic War.

Vara-Sol was a male Voss commando living on Voss during the Galactic War. Disobeying the order to avoid the Nightmare Lands, he and a few other commandos ventured into the forbidden territory and were corrupted by the darkness within.

Grison Jarn was a Human male farmer. During the Galactic Civil War, Alliance forces commandeered Jarn's gravtrac, giving him a datachip in return so that he could claim it once they were through with it.

Jorrn Kresh, known as Boss Jorrn, was a crime lord who controlled a gang. His gang attempted to force protection money from Grison Jarn but he recounted his misfortunes and told them he had nothing left worth protecting.
Large Luxis was a Gamorrean who worked for a loan shark during the early years of the New Republic.
Ukass was an Imperial Governor during the early years of the New Republic.

Reshig lived on Andasala with his wife and children. He borrowed money from the loan shark Sires Vant and attempted to leave the planet when he was unable to repay the loan. Vexan, a corrupt constable in Vant's employ, stopped him from leaving.
Vexan was a constable on Andasala who was in the employ of the loan shark Sires Vant. He stopped Reshig, who owed Vant money, from leaving the planet.
Pateesa (Huttese for "friend") was a male rancor owned by the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure after his majordomo Bib Fortuna gave it to him as a birthday gift.
Golas Aram was a hover chair-bound Siniteen male who worked as a prison architect for the Galactic Empire and various other organizations.

This Individual was a male Mandalorian mercenary and leader of a clan of Mandalorians on Nar Shaddaa during the Dark Wars. When the Jedi Exile, Meetra Surik, came to the planet, she with Mandalore the Preserver, encountered this clan.
Delan Vook was a male Pantoran pilot and racer in the Dragon Void Run.
Makarial Gravin was a female Koorivar gangster who worked for the Sullustan crime lord Surat Nuat on the planet Akiva shortly after the battle of Endor.
Estoc was a female human Imperial officer of the Galactic Empire, serving as a lieutenant and later as a commander.

Lomus was a cadet in Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials. Lomus was assigned to Unit Cresh, a unit in the squad LRC077. Lomus was part of a group-training exercise in the Well, a purpose-built training facility, but did not do well.
Leesub Sirln was a female Qiraash who was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina shortly before the Battle of Yavin, conversing with others. Sirln had pale pink skin, purple eyes, and black hair.

O'Harlan was a female cadet in Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials. She was assigned to Unit Esk, a unit in squad LRC077. O'Harlan made it through the Academy's orientation training period, but then withdrew from the institution for unknown reasons.

Ohwun De Maal was a Duros male who worked as a freelance flight instructor and occasional smuggler. He owned and operated several docking bays in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine with his spouse, Chachi De Maal.

The Duros flight instructor Chachi De Maal was married to fellow Duros Ohwun De Maal. Together, the pair owned and operated several docking bays in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine, including Docking Bay 94.
Tekku Aylay was an elderly Twi'lek male who lived in one of the many subterranean camps occupied by his people during the Galactic Empire's occupation of their homeworld Ryloth.
Sweitt Concorkill was a Vurk senator for the Galactic Republic Senate and a renowned diplomat with a long career who joined the Delegation of 2,000 during the Clone Wars.

Lak Sivrak was a Shistavanen male who served the Galactic Empire as a scout and hunter. He at one point was a patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine and left the establishment by a backdoor during a brawl.
Fi-Ek Sirch was a Kajain'sa'Nikto Jedi who was a member of the Jedi Order during the Fall of the Republic.
Arsad was a human female who worked as a doctor for the New Republic in a veteran's hospital in Darropolis on the planet Hosnian Prime in 5 ABY.
Ak'ghal Usar, titled as the Last Lord of Urkupp, was a Dashade warrior who survived the destruction of his homeworld, Urkupp.

Terba was a male Ugnaught who previously worked at Reklam Station but was arrested after he tried to escape from the station. At some point after his arrest, Terba and the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka ended up in a prison on the planet Naraka.
Pablo-Jill was an Ongree male Jedi Knight that participated in the First Battle of Geonosis as a part of the Jedi assault team.
Rickert Beagle was an male Alderaanian Communications Officer on board the Sunspire, a frigate that was gifted to the Alderaan Flotilla in 5 ABY.
Pilkey was a male drink-slinger who owned a bar aboard the Imperial superweapon known as the Death Star prior to its destruction during the Battle of Yavin.

Brev was an orphaned male individual from Jakku, along with Gallius Rax—who was nicknamed Galli—and the girl Narawal. Along with the two other orphans, Brev observed a starship owned by Adviser Yupe Tashu land on the Plaintive Hand plateau on Jakku.

Narawal was a female orphan with one dead eye from Jakku. Along with fellow orphans Gallius Rax—nicknamed Galli—and Brev, she observed a starship owned by adviser Yupe Tashu land on the Plaintive Hand plateau on Jakku.

Mersa Topol was a female individual who resided on Jakku, and was the nurse in a settlement. She used ratty bindings to mend the wounds of scavengers and miners who came to her for succor. The bindings she used were sometimes also used as makeshift shoes.

Kolob was a human male who resided on Jakku as a monk and anchorite of the Anchorite sect. Prior to meeting Sheev Palpatine, the young Gallius Rax was warned by Kolob to stay behind and finish his chores, however Rax did not listen and instead snuck on to a starship in the Pla…

The Consecrated Eremite was regarded by the Anchorite sect to be an individual who resided on the Plaintive Hand plateau of the desert planet Jakku thousands of years before the Galactic Civil War, during the time that Jakku was supposedly a lush and vegetated place.

Maratelle was a female individual who was the wife of Brendol Hux, an Imperial officer who served as the commandant of the Arkanis Academy. At some point, her husband had an affair with a kitchen worker, which led to the birth of an illegitimate child named Armitage.
Cargin Eimalgan was one of the earliest ace pilots in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Starfighter Corps. By the time of the foundation of the New Republic, Eimalgan had died.

This female green-skinned Twi'lek was Jabba Desilijic Tiure's enslaved dancer before Nima'tar, Oola and Leia Organa. During a performance for Jabba, he started pulling on her chain, dragging her towards him; she struggled with her end of the leash in protest.
Herf was an Ithorian gangster who worked for the Sullustan crime lord Surat Nuat, who operated on the Outer Rim planet of Akiva during the Age of the Empire.

Bendu was a male Force wielder who resided on the remote planet of Atollon and claimed to represent the center of the Force, between the light side and the dark side. Bendu encountered Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus in 2 BBY.
Nilim Bril was a male Rutian Twi'lek who lived on Ryloth in the city of Nabat with his niece Numa.

Kivas was a Devaronian male who ran a starship repair shop outside Tikaroo, a city on the planet Devaron. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Kivas repaired the Y 4 BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber belonging to Luke Skywalker, a rebel who crash-landed near the town.
Jyn Freila was a Human female from the planet Chandrila who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic after listening to one of Mon Mothma's speeches.
Priban was a male Bith scientist who worked for the biotech company Kelen Biolabs during the Galactic Civil War.
Sakhet was a female Kupohan spy who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, often working with Bothan spies.
The son of the Kupohan spy Sakhet was a male spy of the same species who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, and often worked with other Bothan spies.

This stormtrooper was a human soldier who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, the trooper was stationed in Mos Eisley, a spaceport on the desert planet Tatooine.
Jorrin Turnbull was a male Imperial agent who died on the Sanctuary Moon of the planet Endor. Some time later, Sinjir Rath Velus borrowed Turnbull's identity.
Ruuf Waluuk was a male Kupohan mechanic who worked for Azzur Nessin in the city Tonekh during the Galactic Civil War. When the Desert Jewel arrived with Luke Skywalker, Waluuk worked on the starship.
Migg Birkhit was a male Kupohan mechanic who worked for Azzur Nessin in the city of Tonekh, a city on Kupoh, during the Galactic Civil War.
Barrisk Favvin was a male Gotal ISB agent. On the planet Kupoh, Migg Birkhit contacted him to meet somewhere due to the fact he had important information about Drusil Bephorin and his company.
Azzur Nessin was a male Kupohan who was also a former spy, and the owner of Nessin Courier & Cargo in the city of Tonekh on Kupoh during the Galactic Civil War. He was on the spylist given by Sakhet.

Genthaix Manslayer was a male criminal who used to hunt members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic for a living. By the time of the Imperial blockade of the Anoat sector, he had amassed a large collection of Alliance gear.

Duna Hilaris was a young male Devaronian who worked as a guide in Tikaroo, a city on the planet Devaron. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Luke Skywalker landed on the planet. The Force sent him to look at an ancient temple in the middle of the Devaronian jungle.

Opato was a male Rodian who worked as a guide in Tikaroo, a city on the planet Devaron. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Luke Skywalker landed on the planet. The Force sent him to look at an ancient temple in the middle of the Devaronian jungle.
This female Devaronian was the mother of Farnay, and the wife of Kivas. She lived in Tikaroo, a city on the planet Devaron and died a year before the Battle of Yavin.
Stradd was a commandant of the Galactic Empire who was captured by a team of New Republic Imperial hunters led by pilot Norra Wexley sometime following the Rebellion on Akiva.

Perwin Gedde was a human male officer of the Galactic Empire. With the rank of Vice Admiral in the Imperial Navy, he spearheaded one of the Empire's most brutal biological weapons programs, which included testing "ancient diseases" on subjugated worlds.

Edrio "Two Tubes" was a male Tognath mercenary pilot who flew alongside his eggmate, Benthic. The two shared the nickname derived from the breathing apparatus that allowed their Tognath physiology to process oxygen atmospheres.

Benthic "Two Tubes", also known simply as "Tubes," was a male Tognath mercenary pilot who flew alongside his eggmate and brother, Edrio. The two shared the nickname derived from the breathing apparatus that allowed their Tognath physiology to process oxygen atmospheres.

Nyall was a moff who served the Galactic Empire. In 5 ABY, officials representing the nascent New Republic formed a list of ranking Imperials they wished to have apprehended, on which Nyall was included.

Slussen Urla-fir Kal Kethin-wa Canker, also known as Canker the Red, His Venomous Grace, Keeper of Men and Killer of Foes, the Prince and First Son of Vorlag, Master Scion, or simply Slussen Canker, was a male Vorlaggn slaver during the Galactic Civil War.
Chorn was a male human who served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper under the designation LD-22. Chorn was stationed on the planet Ryloth.

Porst was an old human male who was the owner of the depot in Tikaroo, a city on the planet Devaron. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Luke landed with his BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber near the town.

Oto Vans was a human male who served as a sergeant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. At some point between the Battle of Yavin and the Battle of Hoth, Vans was asked by Colonel Jennica Pierce to assist the Tatooine rebel cell, and as such, the sergeant became involved i…
Rigger was a male pilot who was killed when his ship Streak crashed in a canyon and exploded. He was later remembered by Strater and his friends on the bar Serendipity.

Strater was a male human mercenary who worked for Gannis Ducain. He was bald, but had a tattoo of a Twi'lek on his forehead. Strater and his two partners went to the bar Serendipity to find the Millennium Falcon, owned by the notorious Han Solo.

A female individual was the mother of Armitage Hux. She was a kitchen worker who had an affair with Commandant Brendol Hux of the Galactic Empire, which resulted in the birth of Armitage. As a child, her son Armitage never got the chance to get to know her.

The grandmother of Sinjir Rath Velus was a human female. She was described by Sinjir as being considerably larger than any spider despite being fairly small, however despite this webweaver spiders were as big as her according to Sinjir.

Lug was a Trandoshan camera man during the Galactic Civil War. He was a friend of the journalist Tracene Kane. He perished when he was crushed by a fallen TIE fighter during a battle in the city of Binjai-Tin on the planet Nag Ubdur in 5 ABY.
Ur Ur was a male Tusken Raider whom former senator Johhar Kessen hired as a native guide while hunting a Rancor and a Krayt dragon on Tatooine.

t: Unidentified Small Craft Flight flight commander
x: A human flight commander taught the Royal Imperial Academy's Small Craft Flight course during the Age of the Empire. On one occasion, he set up a training exercise which involved the Imperial cadets flying speeder bikes through Reitgen Hoops in Galactic City.

Krel Noviip was a male Shozer. At some point, he was stranded on the gelid planet of Hoth for nearly a week, but managed to stay alive until the Data Seekers of the Anoat sector found him. Following the rescue, Noviip joined his saviors.

Hika Ten was a female human bounty hunter who operated in the Anoat sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Ten had been hunting bounties since the age of fifteen, and preferred to use exotic explosives.
Walfrey Solanse was a Nothoiin male who lived in the Anoat sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Rank was a human male innkeeper, the husband of Leera and the father of the girl known as Bug. He and his wife ran an inn on the Outer Rim planetoid Sídi.
"Misty" was the nickname of a Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps.

Kagi was an individual who held the rank of captain and worked for the Sith Lord Darth Sidious. Soon after he proclaimed himself Emperor of the First Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, Jedi Master Yoda confronted Sidious in a duel in the Senate Building's Galactic Senate Chamber on th…
Bivvam Gorge was a male human who worked for the Red Key Raiders, a Tatooine-based criminal syndicate led by Lorgan Movellan which rose to power following the death of Jabba the Hutt.

Issa-Or was a female Twi'lek who worked alongside the human Cobb Vanth as a law enforcer on Tatooine following the death of Jabba the Hutt. In 5 ABY, Issa-Or and Vanth rescued the human Malakili from Red Key Raiders, and they offered him a job in Freetown.

affiliation: Office of Imperial Promotion, Galactic Truth, and Fact Correction
x: The assistant of chief informational officer Ferric Obdur was a female individual with pale skin. She was present at a meeting between Obdur and Grand Admiral Rae Sloane concerning the matter of propaganda posters.
An unnamed Wheel doctor tended to Luke Skywalker in The Wheel hospital in 0 ABY

Boss Denedin worked for the Sabrin Ring and was in charge of the Number 12 mine. He was shaving profits off the mine and was discovered by Prestor Mec who arranged for Denedin's enemies to find out about his activities.
Prestor Mec was an indentured servant of the Sabrin Ring. He informed on an escape attempt and arranged for Boss Denedin's enemies to find out about his profit skimming at the Number 12 mine.
Miletta Sabrin was the leader of the Sabrin Ring during the early years of the New Republic.

Rask Odai was a male Mon Calamari crime lord who operated on Lothal during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. As a front for his criminal activities, Odai used the Twin Horns Storage company, whose public face was a Devaronian underling named Cikatro Vizago.

Artemis Oophanoe was a Human boy who attended the Jedi academy based at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. A member of the school's Drama Club, Oophanoe's dark robes led some, such as Victor Starspeeder, to believe that he was secretly training to become a Sith Lord.

In the year 5 ABY, the human Bivvam Gorge and a fellow Red Key Raider found the human Malakili wandering into Red Key territory, so they chased the man down and demanded payment. However, Gorge and his comrade were killed by Cobb Vanth and Issa-Or, self-proclaimed law enforcers.

Hern Kaveen was a bearded Pantoran male who worked as a Staff Sergeant in the New Republic. Kaveen once informed Leia Organa and Chancellor Mon Mothma that Grand Vizier Mas Amedda had arrived on Velusia to surrender himself to the New Republic.
Mi'no Teest was a male human who was present in Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet.

Vex was an individual who was part of the Kouhun, a secret order of assassins operating in the Anoat sector. Although he was one of the Kouhun's most skilled assassins, Vex ended up turning on his comrades and joined a murderous crew of pirates on the planet Hoth.

Slikartha was a doctor who worked for the New Republic. After the death of ex-Vice Admiral Perwin Gedde aboard the Halo, the Halo landed on Chandrila and Wedge Antilles told them that they should call down for droids to take Gedde's body to Doctor Slikartha, who would inspect …
Suroc was a male Human bounty hunter. He once bought a Nashtah on the planet Andasala.

deVores was a general in the Galactic Empire. In 5 ABY, Grand Admiral Rae Sloane was supposed to have a meeting involving troop movements with deVores, yet instead she lied and said that she had a meeting with Ferric Obdur in propaganda, but to Obdur Sloane stated that she had…
The wife of detective Erno was a female individual who left him for artists in the Teeno Village district of Coronet City, the capital city of Corellia.

Shreen was a female detective in Coronet City, the capital city of the planet Corellia. She was killed along with other detectives including Mursey, during the Coronet City revolution, a revolution organized by the Acolytes of the Beyond.
Mursey was a detective in Coronet City, the capital city of the planet Corellia. Mursey was killed in the Coronet City revolution, a revolution organized by the Acolytes of the Beyond.
Jag, also identified with the designation CT-55/11-9009, was a clone trooper captain and pilot, who flew as Jedi General Plo Koon's wingman in the final hours of the Clone Wars.
Splugorra was a Hutt for whom the Siniteen architect Golas Aram once designed a prison.
Hodnar Borrum was a male human who served as an officer in both the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic and its successor, the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire.

Kenner Loring was a human officer who served in the army of the Galactic Empire. After attending the Imperial Academy of Uyter, he came to lead the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing and eventually held the rank of grand general by the late Galactic Civil War.
An unidentified Imperial commander led a fleet of Imperial-class Star Destroyers and later a team of Stormtroopers during the Battle of The Keeper's World.
Brainee was a Siniteen associate of the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo during the Clone Wars.
Gramo Murah was a Human male member of the Ragtag gang who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Erinn Bonette was a Human female Rogue CorSec officer who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Bonette and fellow Rogue CorSec officer Echdo Bervekk worked with another criminal, the Meatlump lieutenant Kaiya Merel.

Echdo Bervekk was a Human male Rogue CorSec officer who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Bervekk and fellow Rogue CorSec officer Erinn Bonette worked with another criminal, the Meatlump lieutenant Kaiya Merel.

Jado Starstrider was a male Nothoiin. By the time of the Iron Blockade, he and his twin sister Zenia were part of the Data Seekers society, whose members had rescued them from a fire on their homeworld of Nothoiin.

A male captain in the Imperial Navy was at the helm of the Star Destroyer Devastator while the vessel was the flagship of Darth Vader. An older man, the captain was afraid of Vader, as were many other Imperial officers, and his fear was palpable.

Trae Baratha was a female member of the Karthakk Group. She flew with Goll, a member of the Free Ryloth Movement, and Hera Syndulla to deliver gattis-root extract intended for native Twi'leks on Ryloth.

Amit Noloff was a male Quarren who was a prominent leader on Iego during the Clone Wars. He lived in Cliffhold. After the planet was sealed off by a Separatist laser field situated in its moons, Noloff began to despair, believing that it was caused by the "curse of Drol".
Gorgon was a Moff who was once hunted by Sinjir Rath Velus and Conder Kyl. Due to this, Velus and Kyl entered a relationship.
Crasher was a Clone Sergeant who oversaw the clone cadets of the Clone Youth Brigade during the Clone Wars.

Fang Zar was a male human senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars representing Sern Prime and its sector. Prior to the war's end, he was part of the Delegation of 2,000 out of concern over various amendments to the constitution.

This Imperial officer was stationed aboard the Imperial light cruiser Tellstar above Lothal in 4 BBY. After being informed by a technician that the astromech droid courier 264 was malfunctioning, he asked what was wrong with the droid, suggesting that the technician check its …

Fil, designation CC-3714, was a Clone Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic. He was assigned to recently promoted Jedi Knight Nahdar Vebb during the Clone Wars for a mission to recapture Viceroy of the Trade Federation Nute Gunray on the third moon of Vassek.
Meggin was a male Humanoid who worked on Skree, a space station.
Sata was an Umbaran female technician hired by Gozetta who temporarily worked alongside Lina and Milo Graf.
Rom was a Rodian male who worked as an enforcer for Twin Horns Storage on Lothal.
Sabo was a male Weequay Pirate who served as a member of Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang during the Clone Wars.

Goru was a hulking Weequay male and a lieutenant of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. Goru, along with the pirate Jiro, betrayed Hondo Ohnaka when the renegade Sith Lord Maul began to assemble forces to attack Hondo's complex.
Shortly after the proclamation of the New Order, a young Imperial ensign served under Captain Visler Aqorian Korda III during his cataloging of gas giants in Wild Space.
Shalla Mondatha, professionally known as "the Shade," was a human female who operated as a bounty hunter.
Broadside was a clone trooper pilot who served in Shadow Squadron, a Galactic Republic starfighter squadron under the command of Jedi General Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars, as Shadow Three.
Relva Jace was a human from Corellia who worked in the kitchen of Takodana Castle under the guidance of chef Strono Tuggs.

Damor Gregon was a human prep cook with a shaved head and massive beard. He worked for Strono Tuggs in the kitchen of Maz Kanata's Castle on Takodana for many years, becoming his longest tenured staff member.

Taquito was a Rodian pilot who lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic on the Outer Rim planet Iego. At some point during the Clone Wars, Iego was captured by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Sassi was a female human waitress at Plop Dribble's on Stobar during the Clone Wars. During this time, the Dathomirian Zabrak Savage Opress arrived at the restaurant, and began to choke Sassi.
Tagoo was a male Patitite scout and warrior during the Clone Wars.
Jimba was a female Patitite scout and warrior during the Clone Wars.
Dannis Veriga was an admiral in the Republic Navy of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
TK-429 Junior was the son of stormtrooper TK-429. He was considered a better shot by his parent.
Kerch Kushi was a male senator who served in the Separatist Senate during the Clone Wars.
Dono was a human female from Onderon who served the Onderon rebels during the Clone Wars.

Quarlo Bridin was a politician wanted in several star systems for influence selling and corruption. Fleeing to the planet Gallienis IV, he convinced the local population that he could use his influence with the Galactic Empire to protect them.
Jarina Gatsori was a journalist working for Andasala Achievement News.
Sellis was a journalist working for Andasala Achievement News.
Dunstain Manliss was a crime lord who control Manliss Enterprise. He was killed by his son, Artur Manliss.
Sallast was the son of Miletta Sabrin. He was killed when Sabrin and her followers fled the Empire in the aftermath of the Battle of Endor.
Bandar Tenloss was the founder of the Tenloss Syndicate, one of the largest criminal operations in the Outer Rim not controlled by the Hutts.
Rodik Xern was a street boss working for the Sabrin Ring. He was Boss of Sabrix's southern continent.
Malforia was a female Human Exarch of Zakuul.

Kasuni Tamm was a female Togruta who was an adventurer. Unbeknownst to her, she was Force-sensitive. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, she and her pet bogwing, Vaxim, became involved in the search for a Holocron at the Well of Shadows.

Markus Dorivonn was a Human male Jedi who served as a Guardian. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, he worked with two other Force-sensitive individuals to search for a holocron at the Well of Shadows.
Zora Sasori was a Force-sensitive Human female who served as a warrior during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Dal Kir was a Force-sensitive male Kel Dor and Jedi Consular. Only a child on Dorin when the Jedi were destroyed, Kir heard tales of their heroics and, upon realizing his connection to The Force, developed a paramount desire to become a Jedi himself and restore their legacy to…

Sor Venge was a Human male Inquisitor. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, he led a contingent of stormtroopers during the search for a group of Force-sensitives and a Holocron at the Well of Shadows.

Swoop was a clone trooper pilot who served with the callsign Blue Six, and later as Group Two Leader of Blue Squadron as part of the Galactic Republic Navy. He and the rest of his squadron were deployed in the Battle of Ryloth in an attempt to break the blockade.
Jan Dez was a male Rutian Twi'lek criminal on Coruscant, and acted as an associate to the Quarren Lauli Wahlo during the early Clone Wars.
Lauli Wahlo was a Quarren who lived in the underworld of the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars and owned a noodle shop called Galaxy Noodles in the planet's Slum district G17.
Higz was shot shortly thereafter, by a group of Dug gangsters, just as Bridger warned Higz and his comrade to take cover.
Rokeg was a male Dug and the leader of the Syvik Delegation, a pirate organization that was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Rel Harsol was a male Human naval officer and captain who served the Galactic Republic prior to the Clone Wars, but defected to the Confederacy at the start of the war. After fleeing to the Outer Rim when the Empire was formed, his ship, the Sa Nalaor crashed on Cholganna.
Tuktee was a male Togruta from the planet Kiros.

Krix was a Trandoshan hunter and pilot during the Clone Wars. They were a member of a Trandoshan guild that captured sentient beings for the purpose of hunting and killing them on a game reserve on the moon Wasskah.
Goron was a Trandoshan male hunter who hunted sentient beings on the moon of Wasskah during the year 20 BBY as a member of a Trandoshan hunting guild.

Clutch was a male Trandoshan big game hunter who was a member of a hunting guild that hunted down sentient prey on the moon of Wasskah. During the year 20 BBY, Clutch served as a pilot for the guild's Trandoshan prisoner ship.
Smug was a Trandoshan male big game hunter who was a member of a hunting guild that operated out of the moon of Wasskah.
Horton Salm was a human male who served as a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was the older brother of Keyser Salm, a pilot of Red Squadron.

Bandis Yong was an individual who once attended the Vocational School for Institutional Security and a friend of Jix Hekyl. Yong had some talent as a slicer, but also an over-inflated opinion of himself.

Joval Rykk was a male human who served in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire. By the time of the blockade of the Anoat sector, Rykk was a ten-year veteran of the Corps, and yet he did not feel any loyalty to his Empire or even his comrades in arms.
Several months into the blockade, Thosk joined the crew of the Smuggler, who sent him on a variety of missions across the Anoat sector.

Kespral was an Advozse male who ran errands for the Kouhun from time to time despite not being a member. During the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector, he joined the crew of the Smuggler, who sent him on missions across the sector.
Lagon was a Trandoshan hunter and part of a group of Trandoshans that hunted down innocent beings for sport on Wasskah, a moon of Trandosha.
Morgo was a gray-skinned Selkath alive during the Clone Wars. Taken captive by a group of Trandoshan hunters, Morgo was held prisoner aboard their prisoner ship, the Vermin-Thrax, in 20 BBY.
Aramis was a human male who served Duchess Satine Kryze and was killed in a plot to assassinate Satine Kryze when his speeder's controls were compromised.
Luta was a Twi'lek female who served as the warden of the Megalox prison. She accepted bribes to allow visitors to visit the prison.

Daen Nark was a female Zabrak and the matriarch of the Blacklip Pirates. When the Galactic Empire blockaded the Anoat sector, she and her crew were trapped there. Nark reluctantly accepted that she had to make allies in the sector to survive.

Ramy was a Trandoshan big game hunter who was a member of a Trandoshan hunting lodge led by the hunter Garnac. During the year 20 BBY, new prey sentient prey was brought to the lodge's hunting reserve on the moon of Wasskah.

Gilas was a male Trandoshan big game hunter who was a member of a hunting guild helmed by the Trandoshan Garnac during the year 20 BBY. The guild's prey at times consisted of sentient prey kidnapped from around the galaxy which were then taken to the moon of Wasskah.

A member of the Noble Court was a contender for the throne of the aristocracy during the Iron Blockade, a time shortly after the Empire's defeat at the Battle of Endor in which the Empire locked down the Anoat sector so that its occupants could not learn about Galactic Emperor…

Tammia Hollusen's mother was a worker in shift 114E on the Imperial factory world of Metalorn. Her daughter was supposed to be in the learning center while she was on shift, but Tammi would sneak out to try to grow plants in the nutrient-starved soil, a practice her mother tri…

The mother of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure was a female Hutt. In his palace on Tatooine, Jabba forced the Askajian dancer Yarna d'al' Gargan to wear special makeup to hide her true beauty and make her look more like his mother.
The mother of Supreme Chancellor Nagratha was a female individual who served as a part of the Squill Sifters, a group of slicers and spies, during the Waymancy Storm of 7811 BBY.

Onurruka was a male Wookiee who peacefully resisted the Galactic Empire's early edicts, drawing public attention to the oppression of his people. Because of that, he was committed to an Imperial prison, where he spent two decades behind bars.
Gureni Telsij was a human who served as a lieutenant and pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Stew was a clone gunner sergeant who served aboard the Galactic Republic Venator-class Star Destroyer Endurance under Admiral Shoan Kilian during the Clone Wars.
Verette was a male human admiral who served in the fleet of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War in 0 ABY.
Ilyenno was a male Mirialan who was the host of Cloud City's finest luxury resort. Due to his line of work, he was very well-connected, knowing every person of importance in the entire Bespin system.
Yeppau was a Toydarian who served as one of the Hutt crime lord Graballa's henchmen during the Galactic Civil War. He accompanied Graballa on his quest to find the Kyber Saber crystals.

Tucker was a clone trooper pilot who flew as Blue Five in the Republic Navy's Blue Squadron during the Clone Wars. He and the rest of his squadron were deployed in the Battle of Ryloth in order to break the blockade.

Slammer was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Galactic Republic Navy's Blue Squadron during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Ryloth, he flew under Jedi Commander Ahsoka Tano as "Blue Three."

Kickback was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Galactic Republic Navy. As part of Blue Squadron, with the callsign Blue Four, he and the rest of his unit were deployed in the Battle of Ryloth to break the blockade around the planet.
Axe was a clone trooper pilot who served within of the Galactic Republic naval forces' Blue Squadron during the Clone Wars.
Matchstick was a clone trooper who served in the Republic Navy as a pilot of Shadow Squadron under the call sign "Shadow Two" during the Clone Wars. Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano knew him by name.

Christina Starspeeder was a Human girl from Obroa-skai. She attended the Jedi academy based at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant and was one of its top-performing students. Christina had a younger brother named Victor Starspeeder who began attending in a later year than her.

Neebo was a Jedi Master in the Jedi Order during the waning decades of the Galactic Republic. Neebo's lightsaber was later found by Jedi Master Kit Fisto in the castle of General Grievous, a well known Jedi killer.
A male human held the rank of admiral in the starfleet of the Galactic Empire. In the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin, in 0 ABY, he was at the helm of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Harbinger.
"Shadow Ten" was the callsign of a clone trooper pilot who served in the Galactic Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
"Shadow Seven" was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars as a member of Shadow Squadron.
"Shadow Twelve" was a clone trooper pilot who served in Shadow Squadron of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
"Shadow Four" was a clone trooper pilot who served in Shadow Squadron, a starfighter squadron in the Galactic Republic Navy.
FN-2112 was a stormtrooper in the First Order. He notably enjoyed spending time in a hot tub in the barracks inside Starkiller Base.
A male Imperial technician served aboard Sentinel Base.
Barsay was an Imperial pilot who flew with Nashtah Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Maysano was a wanted Lutrillian criminal who was active during the Clone Wars.

Gaelan was a male officer who served the Galactic Empire as a Vice Admiral in 5 ABY. He wanted to discuss fleet movements with Grand Admiral Rae Sloane, but she did not want to meet with anyone and lied that she had a meeting with General deVores about troop movements.
Icar Orliss was a male human from Alderaan. A teacher at a university, he survived the destruction of his homeworld by the Galactic Empire.
Hutch was a human male who lived on Onderon and joined the Onderon rebels against the Separatists during the Clone Wars. He was killed by Separatist battle droids during the Onderonian Civil War.

Suralinda Javos was a female Squamatan who lived approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor. Javos served in the New Republic Navy alongside Poe Dameron some time after the Battle of Endor, becoming acquainted and establishing a friendship with him.

Lozen Tolruck was a male human that served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War as a Grand Moff. In this position, he ruled as the governor of Kashyyyk, known as Imperial territory G5-623.

Albee Dewaw was the persona of an enormous hologram created to rule over the civilization on the planet Balnab. However, the figure was in fact being controlled by a group of DUM-series pit droids working from the wreckage of a crashed starship.

Bot was a male Duros who worked as a spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. At some point before the Dragon Void Run, in which Han Solo and Chewbacca took part, Bot was compromised and therefore compelled to kill Aran and other informants working for the Rebel Alliance.
Karz Damascus was a male ensign who served the Galactic Empire in 5 ABY. He was the shuttle pilot who flew Grand Admiral Rae Sloane to Chandrila for negotiations with the New Republic.

Februs Temmt was an Imperial officer who served as Admiral Rae Sloane's archivist during an Imperial summit on Akiva following the Battle of Endor. He was a small, brittle man. Sloane instructed him to refer to the meeting as the Imperial Future Council.

Imrie was a human male who served as a soldier in the Resistance during the conflict against the First Order. Imrie helped General Leia Organa, Finn, C-3PO, and BB-8 collect fuel, ammo, and Wookiee Cookies for the Millennium Falcon shortly before the Battle of Starkiller Base.

Lyra Erso was the human female wife of the scientist Galen Erso. During the Clone Wars, Galen was arrested while researching kyber crystals on Vallt and charged with espionage by Confederate loyalists. While in confinement, Lyra gave birth to their daughter, Jyn.

Trauma was an Advanced Recon Force Scout Trooper and Clone Commander who served the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Under the command of Jedi General Halsey, they led the Jedi Master's unit alongside Jedi Commander Knox.
Monnk was the Clone SCUBA trooper who served in the Clone Wars as a Clone Commander under the leadership of Jedi Master Kit Fisto.
A male human was the grandfather of Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin.
Urian Orlan was a male individual who served as an Imperial Rear Admiral under Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck around the time of the liberation of Kashyyyk.

Hogan Tinmar was a human who served as a sergeant in the Royal Naboo Security Forces. He worked for Senator Padmé Amidala of Naboo early in the Clone Wars, where he often served as her speeder driver.
Stonk was a male Ithorian Senator who served in the Galactic Republic Senate during the Clone Wars.
Maya Phoenix was a female Togruta who attended the Jedi academy based at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. She was known to be a hard and determined worker and was part of the school's drama club.
A male Kaleesh was the father of Xivhkalrainik, who was enslaved and captured by the Sith Empire, but managed to become a Sith apprentice to Lord Kallig.

Xan was a male Human member of the White Maw pirate gang living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he and Ki-Ta Kren were confronted at the Star of Coruscant by a bounty hunter, who sought to collect the bounty on Reneget Vause.

Weylin-Po was a female Voss Adjudicator living on Voss during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY she presided over a hearing between Republic General Thelonia Redrish, Imperial Ambassador Methias Yoran and Hunter.

Webb was a male Human living on Tatooine during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was affiliated with Andronikos Revel, a pirate who hid in a private room of the Siltshift cantina in Mos Ila, and served as his means of contact with outside world.

Vorgrim was a male Human of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he served as a Prison Warden in Shadow Town on Nar Shaddaa where he was killed by a Republic agent seeking to free Phalanx.

Veil Two was a male Human Cyborg living during the Galactic War. Along with cyborgs Veil One and Veil Three, the three presented themselves as a single entity called "The Veil" to the Nar Shaddaa underworld.

Veil Three was a male Human Cyborg living during the Galactic War. Along with cyborgs Veil One and Veil Two, the three presented themselves as a single entity called "The Veil" to the Nar Shaddaa underworld.

Veil One was a male Human Cyborg living during the Galactic War. Along with cyborgs Veil Two and Veil Three, the three presented themselves as a single entity called "The Veil" to the Nar Shaddaa underworld.
Vassek was a male Chagrian apprentice of the Sith Lord Khreusis living during the Cold War. He was present when his master was confronted by Kallig, who sought to acquire his mask.
Varram was a male Secretary to the President of Balmorra Tai Cordan in the aftermath of the Battle of Balmorra during the Galactic War.
Var-Nok was a male Weequay bodyguard of the Cult of the Screaming Blade leader Paladius. In 3643 BBY he and Shar-Nok engaged Kallig alongside their master, but were defeated and killed.

Varek was a male Human Jedi Padawan living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he, along with Cassius, Eli and Ashara Zavros was brought to Taris to train under Jedi Masters Ryen and Ocera, whose philosophy was that Padawans best learned the travails of using the Force throug…

In 3643 BBY, Serjil Javis and his brother Vargai encountered a Sith apprentice in Imperial space and a dispute broke out. The Sith killed Serjil and crippled Vargai, and the incident disrupted an Imperial Intelligence operation involving Karrels Javis.

A male gambler was the owner of the Wookiee slave Bowdaar during the Cold War. Owing a debt to Drooga the Hutt, the gambler left Bowdaar to him as a pledge, but instead of returning and buying him back, simply abandoned Bowdaar to fight in gladiatorial matches.
Theovor Mindak's wife was the female Human wife of Theovor Mindak, with whom she had a daughter named Samara Mindak.

Qualus Sorrel was a Human male who served as an engineer in the Imperial Reclamation Service of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY, he was assigned to an excavation on Hoth, where he served under Lieutenant Talos Drellik.

Sor-Nak was a male Voss living on Voss during the Galactic War. When Voss Mystic Alor-Wan had a vision about a Sith, who would destroy the Voss way of life, Sor-Nak confronted Lord Kallig upon their arrival onto the Voss Orbital Docking Station, but the vision prevented him fr…

Solash was a male Chiss lieutenant of the Hutt Cartel living during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, the Eidolon, a former assassin, whose company Eidolon Security was a competitor to the Cartel, became a target of the Great Hunt and Solash posted on the HoloNet a message from Karag…
Shar-Nok was a male Weequay bodyguard of the Cult of the Screaming Blade leader Paladius. In 3643 BBY he and Var-Nok engaged Kallig alongside their master, but were defeated and killed.

Shah'adrom'illithyr, known as Hadro, was a male Chiss Aristocra of the Chiss Ascendancy living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he posted a Blacklist Bounty on the Trandoshan Pirate Reneget Vause, who had been wreaking havoc on the Chiss-occupied territory on Hoth.
Seran was a female Human apprentice of the Sith Lord Khreusis living during the Cold War. She was present when her master was confronted by Kallig, who sought to acquire his mask.

Sato was a female Human Captain of the Galactic Republic living during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY she was stationed in Republic Power Generation on Nar Shaddaa, where she was killed protecting a Republic power generator.

Sarel Corro was a male Human member of the Balmorran resistance living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was part of a cell led by Zenith that rescued the President of Balmorra Retheus Galthe from Darth Lachris.

Saben was a male Human leader of the Krayts gang living on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. He claimed to be descended from one of the dragons his gang was named after. In 3643 BBY he was killed by Kallig to win the support of Nar Shaddaa's poor.

Ruso Zin was a male Human living during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, he was working for the Lady of Pain, a Rattataki crime lord of the Exchange operating on Tatooine, and brought her the news that her captive Tyresius Lokai had escaped.

Rul Jophen was a Human male who served as a member of the Imperial Diplomatic Service of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Galactic War, he was assigned to negotiate with the Voss regarding a potential alliance with the Empire.
Roop Gawash was a male Human member of the Gawash family, a family of workers during the Galactic War, living in Talaos City on Makeb along with Fillan Gawash and Myrla Gawash.

Rona Riggs's mother was a female Human living on Ord Mantell with her husband during the Cold War. She was the mother of Rona Riggs and the aunt of Corso Riggs. When Corso left home to join the Peace Brigade, Rona left home with him.

Rollo was a male Human Captain of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was stationed on Balmorra, where he was sent by Major Bessiker to assist a Sith in apprehending a defector scientist Iannos Tyrek.

Rogers was a male Human Private of the Imperial Reclamation Service of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was assigned to an excavation on Hoth, where he served under Lieutenant Talos Drellik.

Riss was a male Human Captain of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War with the resurgent Sith Empire. In 3642 BBY he was posted on Taris, where he was wounded trying to protect a group of refugess from a bounty hunter.

Rachari was a male Human Ensign of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. During the Invasion of Belsavis around 3641 BBY he was stationed in the High Security Section on Belsavis when the Empire provoken poisonous local fauna into attacking Republic forces.
Quintis was a male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order living during the Galactic War. At some point he met with Ashara Zavros to discuss the possibility of peace with the Sith Empire.

Quellon was a male Chagrian living during the Cold War. He was a Captain of the light freighter Starrunner that belonged to a group of smuggling scavengers, who looted Yavin 4 a few years before 3642 BBY, removing the sarcophagus of Horak-mul from its grave and carrying it abo…
Pzail was a male Mon Calamari Governor of Tantra at some point before the Galactic War. His recording of the declaration of Tantran independence was kept by Albathius.

Pyther's mother was a female Human Balmorran living during the Great Galactic War. She and her husband both died when the Galactic Republic abandoned the planet and led the Empire take over, prompting their son Pyther to join the Balmorran resistance.

Pyther's father was a male Human Balmorran living during the Great Galactic War. He and his wife both died when the Galactic Republic abandoned the planet and led the Empire take over, prompting their son Pyther to join the Balmorran resistance.

Pyther was Human male member of the Balmorran resistance during the Cold War. His mother and father both died when the Galactic Republic abandoned the planet and led the Empire take over, prompting him to join the resistance cell led by Gray Star.
Paul was a male Human citizen of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Par-Nok was a male Weequay member of the Cult of the Screaming Blade, serving its leader Paladius.
Paal was a male Human criminal in the employ of Sylas Wilkes who was one of fifteen men tasked with guarding a shipment of blasters and a Sith artifact for their boss on Tatooine.

Otokwo was a male Ongree doctor of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. During the Conquest of Makeb in 3638 BBY Otokwo was among the scientists the Republic brought down to the surface of the planet.

Obenth was a male Human citizen of the reconstituted Sith Empire living on Dromund Kaas during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he attended a party in the Nexus Room cantina, where he mingled with Samara Mindak.

Nok Drayen's father was a male Human, who was the son of Arak Drayen III, the King of Dubrillion, who was overthrown and killed in 3749 BBY. The son of the king went into exile and eventually had a son of his own, Nok Drayen.
Nesker was a male Twi'lek living on Balmorra during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY a Balmorran resistance cell led by Zenith rescued the President of Balmorra Retheus Galthe from Darth Lachris.

Nalan Fiskin was a male Balmorran living during the Galactic War. In the aftermath of the Battle of Balmorra, Fiskin ran an election campaign for the new Balmorran government, in which his major opponent was a former Balmorran resistance member, Zenith.
A Sarkhai female was the cousin of Nadia Grell who lived on the Mid Rim planet Sarkhai during the Galactic War. She was the niece of Senator Tobas Grell and the cousin of his daughter Nadia Grell.
