Myrla Gawash was a female Human member of the Gawash family, a family of workers during the Galactic War, living in Talaos City on Makeb along with Roop Gawash and Fillan Gawash.

Muglund was a male Gamorrean member of the White Maw pirate gang during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he and Reneget Vause were confronted by a bounty hunter on Hoth. Vause refused to fight an "unworthy" opponent and left, leaving Muglund alone.
An individual was a male Human living with his daughter Mila Escalus on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.

Mar-Da was a male Voss Mystic living on Voss long before the Galactic War. He discovered a dangerous Forbidden Ritual and after his death remained as a spirit in the Shrine of Healing to protect its secrets.

The male shanjaru was the last male member of shanjaru, a species that was driven nearly to extinction at the time of the Cold War. Drooga the Hutt possessed the last female shanjaru and wished to complete the set in order to serve them as part of his feast.

Lorul was a female Nautolan Private of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. During the Invasion of Belsavis around 3641 BBY she was stationed in the High Security Section on Belsavis when the Empire provoken poisonous local fauna into attacking Republic forces.

Lalya Verron was a female Human living during the Galactic War. A former slave, she received the attention of Darth Jadus when he returned to Dromund Kaas after being presumed dead and became his devout follower.

Kutille was a male Human prison overseer of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. During the Battle of Ilum in 3640 BBY he was posted at an Imperial base at Ilum's Eastern Ice Shelf, where Supreme Commander Rans of the Galactic Republic was held captive.

Krash was a male Houk member of the White Maw pirate gang living during the Galactic War. In 3641 BBY he was overseeing the testing of experimental stims on captured Pantran whitefangs in the Starship Graveyard on Hoth.

Ki Sazen's Master was a male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order living during the Cold War. His Padawan Ki Sazen traveled to the planet Tas-La and killed the Spine Dragon of M'dweshuu, a creature ravaging the homeland of the planet's Nikto.
Khel was a male Chiss of the Chiss Ascendancy living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed in the Dorn Base on Hoth, where he acted as a warden for the captured prisoner Blizz.

Kaylan Jase was a male member of the Balmorran resistance living during the Galactic War. He was trained by Zenith and Gray Star, the latter eventually send Jase on a mission to Nar Shaddaa, giving him the copy of his private journals, ordering to destroy them in the event of …
Kayen was a male Duros Sergeant of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Kamel was a male Bith undersecretary of the Balmorran government during the Cold War. During the Battle of Balmorra Kamel and other Balmorran officials-in-exile were invited by Tai Cordan to join with a Balmorran resistance cell led by a revolutionary named Zenith as they were…

Kalas-Na was a male Voss commando living on Voss during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY he was part of the group of Voss that left the planet as part of the entourage for the Voss Mystic Gaden-Ko, traveling with him on the Barsen'thor's Defender-class light corvette.
The Kag'areth Queen was a female Colicoid Queen of the Kag'areth nest of mutated Colicoids that lived on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.

Jreely Toomb was a male Jawa scavenger living during the Galactic War. Born on Tatooine, he and a fellow Jawa Blizz were recruited by the traveling salvager Slam Streever to work as "ferrets"—individuals he could send into dangerous areas to scout for valuable salvage.

Joris was a male Human officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY, he was the Captain of Darth Achelon's flagship Carnage, which engaged the Republic fleet in battle.

Jarvey was a male criminal living during the Galactic War. He was imprisoned on Belsavis by the Galactic Republic, where due to his comparatively low threat he was kept in the Minimum Security Section.
Jakker was a male Human Commander of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he served as a bodyguard to newly-appointed Dark Council member Darth Zhorrid on Korriban.

Jono was a male individual living during the Cold War, who was at one point a lover of Kaliyo Djannis. Years later she commented to Cipher Nine that he used to have a great body and warned not to mess with her like Jono did.

Izak was a male Human agent of the Republic Strategic Information Service living during the Galactic War. He was hunting a rogue criminal Coral - a former subject of the Project 32, who was hunting down and killing everyone involved in the Project.

Inivon was a male Human Sergeant of the House Organa of Alderaan living during the Cold War. During the Alderaan Civil War in 3643 BBY he served under Lieutenant Dargus and was along with the rest of his men holding the House Ulgo forces at the Dassel Pass.

Ibellia Ran's mother was a female Human living during the Great Galactic War. She was a slave of the Sith Empire, who had a child with an Imperial officer. Their daughter Ibellia Ran became a free citizen of the Empire.

Ibellia Ran's father was a male Human officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Great Galactic War. He had a daughter named Ibellia Ran from an Imperial slave, who became a free citizen of the Empire.
Horn was a male Human Lieutenant in the Imperial Intelligence of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War.

Grummalt was a male Human Captain of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed on Taris, where he and his men were posted at the Republic Resettlement Zone, protecting General Faraire.

Groona Biddle was a male Arcona colonist living on Tatooine during the Cold War. He was approached by an infamous con artist Gault Rennow, posing as "Gellar Roing", who offered to sell him Salt, highly addictive to Arcona and disguised as compound for maximizing water retentio…

Grokan was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto slicer living during the Galactic War. A member of a group of genius techno-criminal Niktos known as the Circle, he was imprisoned along with them on Belsavis by the Galactic Republic.

Graham was a male Human Moff of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY he and Moff Dolus were invited by a fellow Moff Valion Pyron to observe the testing of the Silencer on the Harrower-class dreadnought Doombringer.

Gradak Ungan was a male Advozse living during the Galactic War. He fought for the Galactic Republic in the Great Galactic War, becoming an elite commando with best assignments. However, he was dissatisfied with the pay and eventually left, joining the White Maw pirate gang.

Godan-Ur was a male Voss Adjudicator living on Voss during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY he presided over a hearing between Republic General Thelonia Redrish, Imperial Ambassador Methias Yoran and the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt.

Ghost was a male Neimoidian Information broker operating on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. Upon learning that Imperial Intelligence reports from officer Keeling were intercepted by a gang called the Krayts and was about to the highest bidder, he contacted an Imperial individ…
Ges-Su-Kai was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order living during the Cold War.

Gar-Nok was a male Weequay right hand to the Cult of the Screaming Blade leader Paladius. In 3643 BBY he was sent to confront Kallig whose own cult ottempted to rival his master's, but was killed in the fight.

Gaden-Ko's sister was a female Voss sister of a Voss Mystic-in-training Gaden-Ko. Around 3640 BBY she accompanied Gaden-Ko on his pilgrimage along with their parents, cousins and grandfather Dajan-Ko.
Fillan Gawash was a male Human member of the Gawash family, a family of workers during the Galactic War, living in Talaos City on Makeb along with Roop Gawash and Myrla Gawash.

The female shanjaru was the last female member of shanjaru, a species that was driven nearly to extinction at the time of the Cold War. Drooga the Hutt possessed the beast and wished to obtain the last male shanjaru in order to serve them as part of his feast.

Falch was a male Human Private of the Rift Alliance Coalition Forces living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he was stationed on Hoth under Lieutenant Felix Iresso along with Cawelyn, Marren Dask, Tsalesh, Kree, Lavik and Zaun.

Esdras was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. He was the master of Hiran Bessiker, whom in 3643 BBY Esdras sent to Balmorra to recover a Holocron unearthed by the Republic.
Elin was a female Twi'lek living on Tatooine during the Galactic War. She worked as a dancer in the Siltshift cantina in Mos Ila.

Eli was a male Human Jedi Padawan living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he, along with Varek, Cassius and Ashara Zavros, was brought to Taris to train under Jedi Masters Ryen and Ocera, whose philosophy was that Padawans best learned the travails of using the Force throu…

Eisek was a male Human officer of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY he was the Captain of the Harrower-class dreadnought Doombringer, which was used by Moff Valion Pyron to install and test the Silencer superlaser.

Eben was a male Human Colonel of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Empire. In 3643 BBY he was stationed on Balmorra, where he requested supply vehicles from Major Bessiker.

Eamul was a male Zabrak Minister of the Balmorran government during the Cold War. During the Battle of Balmorra Eamul and other Balmorran officials-in-exile were invited by Tai Cordan to join with a Balmorran resistance cell led by a revolutionary named Zenith as they were abo…
Dunn was a male Human Ensign of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. He served in the Imperial Navy aboard the Harrower-class dreadnought Tyrant.

Dolus was a male Human Moff of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY he and Moff Graham were invited by a fellow Moff Valion Pyron to observe the testing of the Silencer on the Harrower-class dreadnought Doombringer.

Deulo was a male Nautolan Colonel of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY he was posted on Voss, where he commanded a group of soldiers from a base called the Hawk's Nest located in the Old Paths.

Dean was a male Kubaz technician of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY he was on Belsavis, where during the Invasion of Belsavis he and another Republic technician were captured by an escaped criminal Skadge and forced at gunpoint to retrieve…

Davon Kull was a male Human criminal living during the Galactic War. Imprisoned in Belsavis prison by the Galactic Republic, he was among those prisoners who broke free during the Invasion of Belsavis around 3641 BBY.
Darth Vilus's fourth apprentice was a male Sith. He was killed by his master after being caught spying on him.
Darth Andru's son was a male Human Sith, who was a son and apprentice of Darth Andru, just like his sister. The siblings eventually conspired against their master and poisoned him.
Darth Andru's daughter was a female Human Sith, who was a daughter and apprentice of Darth Andru, just like her brother. The siblings eventually conspired against their master and poisoned him.

Dargus was a male Human Lieutenant of the House Organa of Alderaan living during the Cold War. During the Alderaan Civil War in 3643 BBY, he and his men were holding the House Ulgo forces at the Dassel Pass.

Dal-Rin was a male Voss Mystic living on Voss long before the Galactic War. After his death, he became the keeper of the dream-rock located in the Dark Heart of the Nightmare Lands and used in the Forbidden Ritual.

Corso Riggs's uncle was a male Human living on Ord Mantell with his wife during the Cold War. He was the father of Rona Riggs and the uncle of Corso Riggs. When dating offworlders, Rona had her cousin run interference to avoid being caught by her father.

The father of Corso Riggs was a male Human living on Ord Mantell during the Cold War. He was the father of Corso Riggs, whom he taught about responsibility with weapons. During the Separatist War on Ord Mantell he and his wife were killed by the Separatist forces.

Coral was a female Human living during the Cold War. Born as part of the Republic Strategic Information Service Project 32 during the Great Galactic War, Coral was one of twelve near-identical individuals - either clones or otherwise closely related - who were supplied with ex…
Char-Nok was a male Weequay member of the Cult of the Screaming Blade, serving its leader Paladius.

Char-Le was a male Voss who lived on Voss during the Galactic War. A member of the Dream-walkers sub-sect of Voss Mystics, he was a stern guardian of the chambers of the dream-walkers in the Shrine of Healing.

Cassius was a male Human Jedi Padawan living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY he, along with Varek, Eli and Ashara Zavros, was brought to Taris to train under Jedi Masters Ryen and Ocera, whose philosophy was that Padawans best learned the travails of using the Force throu…

Casey Rix was a female Human pirate living during the Cold War. She was part of the crew of the Sky Princess and the girlfriend of its captain Andronikos Revel, until the first mate Sylas Wilkes led a mutiny against him and ejected Revel out in an escape pod.

Carteri was a male Human operative of the Republic Strategic Information Service living during the Cold War. On Nar Shaddaa he was approached by Hunter and Mako, who he mistook for her identical sister Coral.

Carl Norn was a male technician living during the Great Galactic War, who owned the starship Bloodshot Rancor. Norn made his friend Andronikos Revel first mate on the ship and got him into pirate racket, though Norn eventually lost the ship due to gambling problems.

Broken Scar was an Esh-kha living in the early years of the Galactic Republic. He had a group of followers, one of whom was Hallow Voice, an Esh-kha who held unusually pacifistic views, unlike the rest of his species.

Brenna Fash was a female Human doctor of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY she was on Belsavis, when a centuries-old lethal plague was released during the Invasion of Belsavis and infected escaped Gen'Dai, making them the perfect carries for…
Blood Stalker was a Pantran whitefang living on Hothduring the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY it was captured by ex-Mandalorian Terror Brigade and used as a challenge in their Onslaught challenge.

Ayor-v9 was a male Gran member of the White Maw pirate gang during the Galactic War. He was a captain of Reneget Vause and preferred to spend time with his many droids, considering them "his family." In 3642 BBY he was confronted and killed by a bounty hunter, who sought to dr…

Athelis Kallis was a female Sith Pureblood living during the Galactic War. A rare non-Force-sensitive Pureblood in the reconstituted Sith Empire, she joined the Imperial Diplomatic Service and spent years researching the culture of Voss.

Asa-Ku was a male Voss living on Voss during the Galactic War. A member of the Dream-walkers sub-sect of Voss Mystics, he was in the Mind healer's grove around 3640 BBY , where he was approached by the Sith Lord Kallig, who looking for the information on the Forbidden Ritual.

Ares Jansen was a male Human officer of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY he was on Belsavis, when a centuries-old lethal plague was released during the Invasion of Belsavis and infected escaped Gen'Dai, making them the perfect carries for t…

Andreaus Thos was a male Pureblood Sith Lord of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Around 3641 BBY he was assigned the command of the Special Operations Group One sent into Belsavis prison on a mission to free the captured Dread Masters.

Ali-Le was a female Voss commando Adjudicator living on Voss during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY she was stationed at the commando outpost on Koss Overlook in the Gormak Lands, overlooking Gorma-Koss.
Akaavi Spar's mother was a female Zabrak living during the Great Galactic War. A member of the respected Mandalorian Clan Spar along with her husband, they had a daughter named Akaavi Spar.

Punn Rimbaud was a female amphibian senator of the Separatist Senate. Rimbaud was present in the Senate chamber when Mina Bonteri made a plea with the other senators that peace talks should be proposed with the Galactic Senate.

The mother of Moralo Eval was a female Phindian who was killed by her son some time before the riot that occurred at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center. When asked by the authorities why he did it, Eval stated that he was "bored".
The sister of the bounty hunter Sugi, also the mother of Jas Emari, was a female Zabrak. Sugi's sister resided on Iridonia during the Clone Wars and was sent credits by her sister.
Zug Tassik was a male Trandoshan criminal operating during the Clone Wars. At some point during the war, Tassik was wanted dead or alive for mass murder, for a bounty of 300,000 credits.

Omar Toggs was a male Rodian criminal operating during the Clone Wars. At some point during the war, Toggs was wanted dead or alive on the charges of racketeering and extortion for the bounty of 75,000 credits.

Carshotta was a female Togruta who performed in Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder carnival act, alongside another Togruta performer. Her skin was rusty violet and a yellow circle with a maroon circle on her forehead. Curved over the top of the circle was a thin line.
Engle was a clone trooper pilot who served under Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi's command during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, Kenobi's fleet was attacked by a Separatist armada led by General Grievous.

Killer was a clone trooper pilot who served with Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet during the Clone Wars. They were one of several pilots who used a clone Z-95 starfighter when General Grievous led a Separatist assault on the Republic fleet.

Lerux Talley was a human who worked as a tinkerer in the bazaar of Niima Outpost on the desert planet Jakku. He worked with the scavenger Rey and told her that he was from the Core Worlds, although she suspected that it was a lie.
Bort was a male human mercenary who was active during the early Age of the Empire. At some point, he was hired by the big game huntress Gozetta.
Delih was a male Cerean who was in the employ of the big game huntress Gozetta.
The father of Kinera Tiree was a human male and was the husband of Fondana Tiree.

The brother of the Imperial cadet Giles was a male individual. In 5 BBY, he heard a rumor from his friend about a cadet at the Pretor Flats Academy on the planet Lothal who confessed to treason and was consequently taken into custody by stormtroopers.
Sandara Li was a female individual who served as a lieutenant in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

A human male flew under the callsign "Phoenix One" four years before the Battle of Yavin. A member of Phoenix Squadron, a fleet composed of RZ-1 A-wing interceptors that operated under the command of Jun Sato, Phoenix One led the rest of the squadron during a mission to steal …

Rilo Tang was a human male who served as a gunnery officer in the Imperial Military prior to the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY. He was an eager officer who had a reputation as a kleptomaniac. On one occasion, he stole a particularly valuable ring from a Moff.

Tiquip was a Chadra-Fan male and the grandson of Shortpaw, the leader of the Trade Spine League. Two months after the Battle of Endor, Tiquip was marked for execution by the Purge Troopers of the Galactic Empire, but the Chadra-Fan was rescued by a young smuggler.
During the Galactic Civil War, an individual flew under the callsign Blade One four years after the Battle of Yavin.

Pollus Maksim was a human moff of the Galactic Empire who governed the planet Kuat's sector by 0 ABY. At some point, he wrote a foreword for the KDY Corporate Folder brochure welcoming investors to Kuat Drive Yards.

During the Rebellion on Akiva, the New Republic Special Forces soldier Jom Barell encountered a gunnery officer who was manning the turbolaser turret outside the Satrap's Palace in Myrra, the capital of Akiva.

Sharn was a high-ranking member of the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry. She served as second-in-command of the Braha'tok-class gunship Apailana's Promise, which escorted the 61st's CR90 corvette, Thunderstrike.

Hober was a male quartermaster in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, also known as Twilight Company, who served during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, he was the recruiting officer for a recruitment drive on the planet Haidoral Prime.
Maediyu was a female individual who joined the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company, off of the terrestrial body Thession during the Galactic Civil War.

Twitch was a human female soldier who served in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, nicknamed Twilight Company during the Galactic Civil War. She was present with the company during its time on Bamayar and Dreivus.

After the fall of the Empire, underboss Rynscar, one of Gyuti's lieutenants, captured the bounty hunter Jas Emari, informing Emari that she would bring her head back to Gyuti. However, Emari instead convinced her to give information about the location of Han Solo.

Nyarla was a Hutt individual who had, at some point, left the criminal syndicate Black Sun. However, Nyarla eventually returned to Black Sun after the Hutts fell into disarray, and this information was relayed from underboss Rynscar to the bounty hunter Jas Emari.

Cora Vessora was a female witch from an unidentified planet. The Jedi wished for her to join their ranks, but she refused to join them or the Sith. The Sith retaliated by killing her loved ones while the Jedi idly stood by and did nothing.

Qarwell Krass was the son of Yileen Krass and Romwell Krass Junior, and the grandson of Romwell Krass Senior. Qarwell resided on the Hyborean Moon with his family, where his father worked at the black-site prison located there.
Ashur Sungazer was a Human male scholar specializing in Galactic History at Phelar University on Eriadu. He had a special interest in the history and legends of the Jedi Order.
Eren Garai was a Human male proctor of Phelar University and secretly an agent of the Imperial Security Bureau.
An individual was the apprentice of Jedi Master Chuang from a story that Yoda heard from his Master.
Vira Volk was the wife of Johan Volk, who by the time of the assault on the Kuat Drive Yards was a New Republic pilot. It was rumored that the two were resistance fighters on their homeworld.
Sowa Chuan, also known as Ilka, was a female Abednedo whom Agent Terex of the First Order Security Bureau employed as a servant aboard the Carrion Spike. Ilka served Terex his drinks.

Andrew was a Human male who served as a lieutenant in the Resistance 30 years after the Battle of Endor. He helped General Leia Organa, Finn, C-3PO and BB-8 collect fuel, ammo and Wookiee Cookies for the Millennium Falcon shortly before the Battle of Starkiller Base.
Durm Harmodius was an individual who served as the Senator of Chandrila in the New Republic's Galactic Senate in 5 ABY.
Johan Volk was a male individual who served as a pilot in the New Republic's Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. He was married to Vira Volk.
Tane was an individual who served as a captain in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War as part of the Combat Operations Planning. Tane took part in the assault on the Kuat Drive Yards.

Mack was a clone trooper pilot who fought for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The pilot was part of the diplomatic service within the Coruscant Guard.

Claith Bennis was a human male individual who was a member of the grav-ball team AppSci SaberCats at Lothal's Junior Academy of Applied Sciences during Zare Leonis's time on the team as center striker.
Lunker was a Gungan security captain on Naboo during the time of the Clone Wars.
The mother of Roo-Roo Page was a Gungan who lived in Jan-gwa city on Naboo during the Clone Wars.

Kaltho was a wealthy Hutt from a prominent Kajidic. His immense fortune was gained from daily intake of hundreds of thousands of credits earned through his ownership of many large spaceports and loading docks on Nar Shaddaa.

The mother of the pirate Captain Hondo Ohnaka was a female Weequay. She taught him about taking hostages saying that one was good, two was better, and three was good business. She sold him when he was a child.
Gustip was a Drall male who served as majordomo to the billionaire businessman and crime lord, Baron Benton Kaldo.
A Rebel pilot flew under the callsign of Blue Five during the battle of Vrogas Vas.
A Rebel pilot under the callsign Blue Three flew as part of Blue Squadron during the battle of Vrogas Vas.
A human male Rebel pilot used the callsign Blue Leader during the Battle of Vrogas Vas. During the battle the entire squadron was killed by Darth Vader.
A Rebel pilot flew under the callsign Gray Five was killed by Darth Vader during the battle of Vrogas Vas.
Seprine was a female Human corporate transport pilot and captain working for Nebula Consumables in the Expansion Region and Mid Rim.
Kep-She was a Force-sensitive individual who served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Master prior to the Clone Wars.
"Shadow Six" was the callsign of a clone trooper pilot unit in the Republic Navy.
Pa Dua was a Rodian aide who, along with Tox Don, assisted Senator Onaconda Farr in the Galactic Senate of the Republic at the time of the Separatist Crisis.
Tox Don was a Rodian who, along with Pa Dua, served as an aide to Senator Onaconda Farr in the Galactic Senate of the Republic at the time of the Separatist Crisis.

Lekek Poost was a shifty, fast-talking Mon Calamari male who worked in the Anoat sector, acquiring items for a price. During the Imperial Iron Blockade of the sector, Poost joined the crew of the Smuggler and ran missions around the sector for them.
Odair Bel-Opis was a human male from the planet Corellia who served as the attaché to Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck during the Imperial occupation of Kashyyyk in the months following the Battle of Endor.
Viera Creel was a female human diplomat from Corellia. At some point prior to the death of Emperor Palpatine, she was sent to the Anoat sector to represent the interests of her homeworld there.
Elaiza was a female Human Jedi from Nar Shaddaa who survived the Great Jedi Purge.

Melch, designated "Laborer 429," was a male Ugnaught slave laborer who worked on Reklam Station, an Imperial-controlled salvage yard located in the atmosphere of the planet Yarma, which recycled old Y-wing starfighters.
Rikarda was a human female who worked as a freighter captain during the reign of the Galactic Empire, piloting the light freighter Stellar Sun.
Si Pebi, an Aqualish arms dealer, was active in the Anoat sector of the galaxy while it was locked down by Governor Ubrik Adelhard of the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade.

Moroff was a Gigoran male mercenary who was active during the Imperial Era. As a towering gunner, he sought out combat zones across the galaxy with the goal of selling his services to anyone who required it.
Marn Kel was a male Abednedo member of the Data Seekers who used his expert piloting skills to extract operatives from dangerous situations. He also trained other extraction specialists.

Zenia Starstrider was a female Nothoiin and the twin sister of Jado Starstrider. At some point before the blockade of their native Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire, she and her brother were caught in a fire on their homeworld of Nothoiin.

The Red Brine was an alias used by a male Mon Calamari warrior who served the Ivax Syndicate, in the Anoat sector. A real one-man commando squad, he served the Syndicate to the best of his ability by eliminating enemies with great efficiency.
Ango Croom was a Falleen male who led the Varluk Organization.
Norwich was an officer who served in the military of the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War, with the rank of commander.

During the Clone Wars, BNI-393's master stayed on board a Venator-class Star Destroyer the Renown with BNI-393. Later the Renown was hijacked by battle droids and all crewmembers save for droids, BNI-393's master included, were killed.
"Backdraft" was the nickname of a male human TIE fighter pilot in the First Order. Backdraft served as a Special Forces pilot who flew one of the elite TIE/sf space superiority fighters.

Sorka was a female Artiodac who lived in the Anoat sector at the time of the Galactic Civil War. Despite her kind disposition, she served in the criminal Ivax Syndicate for some time, helping many people avoid the wrath of Voras the Hutt.

Ackmena was a human female who worked as the nighttime bartender in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the Tatooine spaceport of Mos Eisley. She operated a "side hustle" with two local pickpockets, Kabe and Muftak.
Raddus was a Mon Calamari male from the planet Mon Cala who served as an Admiral within the fleet of the Rebel Alliance.

Droogan's grandfather was a Khramboan male. When the merchant Droogan haggled the droid C-3PO for credits, he relayed a supposed saying of his grandfather, "Don't watch your credits, watch your health".
Reug Yucon was a Bothan male scientist, with special training in trans-system and galactic atmospherics, who lived in the years before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
A rebel trooper was on a Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette belonging to Phoenix Cell when it was attacked by Maul, a former Sith Lord.
Eira Tay was a Sephi female engineer who served aboard the freighter Eclipse as a member of Krysiant Rheden's crew.

Alkhara was a fearless bandit who, at some point in history, appropriated the B'omarr monastery of Tatooine's Northern Dune Sea for his own use. He hired Tusken Raiders to murder members of the local police garrison. He then betrayed the Tuskens by having them executed.
Senni Tonnika was a woman who, along with her sister Brea, formed the Tonnika sisters, a duo of con artists. At some point, Senni and Brea helped an associate break out of prison.
Jerriko was a male mutant human bureaucrat.

Ayy Vida was a Twi'lek female dancer who was a frequent patron of the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant. She was enslaved by the crime lord Hat Lo, who forced her to entertain his clients, and she was friends with fellow Twi'lek Lunae Minx.

Achk Med-Beq was a human, present in the Outlander Club on Coruscant and conversing with Ayy Vida and Lunae Minx, when Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker showed up in pursuit of the changeling assassin Zam Wesell.

Hat Lo was a human crime lord who visited the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY with his enslaved consort, Ayy Vida. While there, he availed himself of the private bar of the Baath brothers, who owned the club, while Vida entertained his associates and clients.

Dannl Faytonni was a male human and a known associate of Achk Med-Beq. The two were present in the Outlander Club on Coruscant in 22 BBY when the Clawdite assassin Zam Wesell attempted to hide there to escape the pursuing Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.

Omar Berenko was a famous and controversial human Naboo male tragic poet from the Mid Rim planet Naboo who lived during the High Republic Era. Berenko resided at Varykino, a lake retreat in Naboo's Lake Country, in an unconventional community of Naboo and Gungan outsiders.
Sta-Den Eekin was a Klatooinian male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Khaat Qiyn was a female human Jedi who served in the Jedi Order in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In the years leading up to the Invasion of Naboo she apprenticed Bairdon Jace. At some point the two briefly encountered the Sith apprentice, Darth Maul.

The Earl of Vis was a male earl associated with Vis. They were the cousin of a king of the planet Naboo who ruled prior to the reign of Queen Padmé Amidala, which began in 32 BBY. The earl built a banqueting rotunda in Theed, Naboo's capital city.

Jafan was a male member of the Naboo, the human inhabitants of the planet Naboo. Jafan served as a general during the era of the planet's history known as the Time of Suffering, which was characterized by brutal wars between human city-states.

Elis Helrot was a Givin who worked as a pilot and spice smuggler. He spoke with the bounty hunter Bossk about the fugitive Imperial astromech droid 261 in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine in the year 1 BBY.
Myo was a fight-loving Abyssin from Byss. An expert in survival techniques, Myo was a tough Abyssin with regenerative abilities.

Rycar Ryjerd was a Bimm weapons smuggler who spoke Jawaese. Ryjerd was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, Tatooine, on the day that Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker met Han Solo and Chewbacca.

affiliation: Masse Goskey's Arms Emporium and Explosives Mart
x: Masse Goskey was a human male and the proprietor of Masse Goskey's Arms Emporium and Explosives Mart in Mos Eisley, Tatooine.
Het Nkik was a Jawa from Tatooine. Nkik was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina when Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker arrived in search of a pilot to take them to the planet Alderaan.

Garouf Lafoe was a human from Tatooine. A patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, he was present in the bar when Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker were forced into a brawl with Ponda Baba and Cornelius Evazan.

M'iiyoom Onith, also known as Nightlily, was a sharp-tongued H'nemthe female. In 1 BBY, Onith spent time in the back rooms of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.

Merl Tosche was a male individual and the owner of Tosche Station, a power and distribution station located outside the city of Anchorhead on Tatooine. Because Tosche rarely visited, the station was supervised by Laze Loneozner, who spent most of his time there.
Feltipern Trevagg was a corrupt Gotal tax collector who operated in the Mos Eisley district of the planet Tatooine.

Starck was a human colonel in the ground forces of the Galactic Empire's military who had light skin. During the Battle of Hoth, Starck commanded the All Terrain Armored Transport walker Blizzard 4 of Blizzard Force, under the overall direction of General Maximilian Veers.
Eyvind was a human male who worked as a moisture farmer on the desert planet Tatooine during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Rake Gahree was an Imperial cadet at Skystrike Academy who was friends with both Wedge Antilles and Hobbie. He and his friends attempted to defect to Phoenix Cell with the help of rebel agent Sabine Wren.

Vult Skerris was a human male pilot who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire's naval forces during the Imperial Era. As an Imperial pilot, he flew a TIE/IN interceptor with red markings and wore a TIE pilot flight suit with yellow stripes on the helmet and arms.

Goran was a human male officer that served in the Galactic Empire as an instructor. Two years before the Battle of Yavin, he held the rank of commandant, serving as flight instructor of the elite Skystrike Academy on Montross. Under his command was Captain Vult Skerris.

Bidlo Kwerve was a human or near-human employee of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure who competed against the Twi'lek Bib Fortuna for the position of majordomo to the Hutt and as a result ended up as an early victim of the crime lord's pet rancor, Pateesa, in Jabba's P…

Lef Lars was a human male farmer from Tatooine. He was the husband of Gredda Lars and the father of Cliegg and Edern Lars. He and his wife as well as Edern were buried next to each other near the Lars homestead.

Gredda Lars was a human female from Tatooine. She was the wife of Lef Lars and the mother of Cliegg and Edern Lars. She and her husband as well as Edern were buried next to each other near the Lars homestead.

The Sixth Brother, formerly known as Bil Valen, was a humanoid male member of the Inquisitorius. In the year following the end of the Clone Wars, the Sixth Brother, and the rest of the Inquisitors, hunted for Force-sensitive children as well as Jedi who survived Order 66.

Eleodie Maracavanya was a non-binary human pirate ruler after the fall of the Galactic Empire who led zher pirate crew to take control of the Annihilator, a Super Star Destroyer that once belonged to the Imperial Grand General Cassio Tagge, which was renamed to Liberty's Misrule.
The husband of Maz Kanata was a male individual. Prior to 34 ABY, he married Kanata and gave her a stone statue in her image, which she displayed outside of her castle on the planet Takodana.
This Jakku villager was a female human member of the Church of the Force, who lived in the Tuanul village on the planet Jakku.

Cietra was an individual who lived on the moon Raada in a house later claimed by Ahsoka Tano when she arrived there. She moved out of the house after getting married. Tano found the house in such a mess that she assumed Cietra couldn't have been much of a cleaner.
Kaeden Larte was a human female who was the older sister of Miara Larte, living as a farmer on the moon Raada.

Selda was a Togruta male cantina owner on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. His cantina became a frequent meeting place for the resistance against the Imperial occupation. Ahsoka Tano often confided in him during her time on Raada.
Fardi was a human male living on the planet Thabeska during the first year of the Galactic Empire. He was the head of a branch of the Fardi clan, and protective of his many nieces.

Hoban was a human male living on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire, and was the twin brother of Neera. After Imperial forces arrived on Raada, Hoban and Neera joined a resistance group organized by Ashla, a recent arrival on the moon.
The wife of Fardi was a human female living on the planet Thabeska during the first year of the Galactic Empire.
Chenna Fardi was a human female living on the planet Thabeska during the first year of the Galactic Empire.

Hedala Fardi was a Force-sensitive human female living on the planet Thabeska during the first year of the Galactic Empire. She was four years old and the youngest member of a branch of the Fardi clan, a wealthy smuggler family on Thabeska.
Makala Fardi was a human female living on the planet Thabeska during the first year of the Galactic Empire. She was a member of the Fardi clan, and the older sister of Hedala Fardi.

Vartan was a human male farmer who lived on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. He was a farming crew lead, as well as a respected leader within the community. He took Kaeden and Miara Larte into his crew after they were orphaned.

Kolvin was a Rodian male who lived on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. He was a member of the Raada resistance during the Raada Uprising. He was known as an agile climber and was picked on a mission to destroy AT-STs.

Malat's husband was a Sullustan male living on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. After the Empire arrived on the moon, a relative of his back on Sullust got him and his wife jobs, so he and Malat moved back there with their children.

Malat was a Sullustan female who lived on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire's reign. When the Empire established a presence on Raada, Malat and her family decided to move back to Sullust, where a relative of her husband had gotten them jobs.

Neera was a human female who lived on the moon Raada during the early reign of the Galactic Empire. Neera was the twin sister of Hoban. She was killed when the Sixth Brother ordered the location she was in to be shot up.
Jenneth Pilar was a human male Imperial officer who served the Galactic Empire during the first year of its reign.

Tibbola was a human male who lived on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. Sometime after the Empire arrived on Raada, Tibbola stood up to an Imperial officer and was executed by a stormtrooper in Selda's cantina.
Chardri Tage was a human male pilot who worked for Bail Organa during the first year of the Galactic Empire. His copilot was Tamsin.
Tamsin was a human female pilot who worked for Bail Organa during the first year of the Galactic Empire. She was the copilot of Chardri Tage.
Seboca was a Dug holovid star from the planet Malastare. In 22 BBY, the Dug was entertaining Senator Bogg Tyrell while she piloted a speeder through the skylanes of the planet Coruscant.

This individual was a human who was present in the bar of Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet. They were seen talking to Grummgar as Finn left the castle with Sidon Ithano and Quiggold.
This individual was a human who was present in the bar of Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet.
This bar patron was a female human who was present in the castle of Maz Kanata on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet.

A male Nothoiin officer within the Galactic Empire was distantly related to a baron of the Anoat sector's Noble Court. At some point during the Imperial blockade of the sector, he stated his intention to join the Noble Court, offering crystals as proof of his good faith.

Sor Cin'da was a male individual who operated as a code-breaker in the Anoat sector. At some point during the Iron Blockade, the Trade Spine League intercepted coded Imperial data, which only Cin'da could decode. However, he was known to be surly and wary of strangers.

A human man was a warlord in the Inner Rim. At one point, he was assassinated by the Knights of Ren. Later Rey, a Force-sensitive scavenger who hailed from Jakku, saw the assassination in a Force vision.

Isin was a male Advozse who, along with Kan Be and Papa Toren, helped Agent Terex in an attempt to storm Grakkus the Hutt's fortress at the prison Megalox. Their attempt failed when Poe Dameron's astromech droid BB-8 deactivated the prison's gravity field.
Harrgun was a male Wookiee who was killed during the liberation of the Wookiee homeworld Kashyyyk.

Roshyk was a Wookiee who alongside half a dozen other Wookiees including Hrrgn and Kirratha escaped from the planet Kessel after being enslaved by the Galactic Empire. After escaping the group began to work as mercenaries who cared little for the politics of the New Republic.
The father of Rush Clovis served as the personal attaché of one of the head Muun families in the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

This Individual was a male Mandalorian warrior who lived during the Cold War. While on Tatooine, this man lead group of Mandalorians to plan an attack on Outpost Thorazan, but the Security Chief, Barret, was able gain help from Republic spacers to assist in defending the outpo…

Antoc Merrick was a human male ace pilot who served as a General in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 1 BBY, General Merrick participated in the Alliance's acquisition of the Galactic Empire's plans to their ultimate weapon, the Death Star, in the Battle of Scarif.

Zal Dinnes was a human female pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She flew a T-65B X-wing starfighter under the callsign Red Eight in Red Squadron at the Battle of Scarif and died at the Battle of Yavin.
Krev was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement, a resistance movement that worked to free the planet Ryloth from the Galactic Empire.

Xira was a female Twi'lek from the planet Ryloth who was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement during their attempt to assassinate the Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine and the Sith Lord Darth Vader. Xira owned the data processing droid D4L1.

Domm Korgale was a male individual who served as an Imperial Vice Admiral under Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck at the time of the liberation of Kashyyyk. He served as commander of the Star Destroyer Dominion, until it was infiltrated by Han Solo and his team.

An individual was a male Mandalorian warrior who fought on Darvannis with other Mandalorian clans during the war against Zakuul. However, he lost a leg in battle, and it was replaced with a cybernetic prosthetic.

A non-binary agent of Black Sun followed the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano to a planet in the Thabeska system, where they attempted to recruit Tano for the criminal syndicate. Tano declined and fled in her light freighter, with their ship in close pursuit.
Qyp was a male Snee that traveled with the Nu-Cosian Bobbajo, a wandering storyteller of Jakku.

Trey Callum was a human male who served as a sergeant major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Battle of Hoth. He was formerly an Imperial officer who decided to join the Alliance, and served at Echo Base on the planet Hoth in 3 ABY.
Vangos Grek was a human pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Denno Yanglan was a human male who worked as a medical supervisor in the Imperial Surgical Corps of the Galactic Empire. Defecting to the Rebel Alliance on Bakura, Yanglan uncovered a traitor aboard the Wayfaring Stranger and joined the crew in repelling Imperial boarders.

Dervis was an individual who served as a major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The major was part of the Alliance forces stationed in Echo Base on the planet Hoth when it was attacked by the Galactic Empire in 3 ABY.

affiliation: Otu Del's Custom Pods and Swoops
x: Otu Del was an individual who owned Otu Del's Custom Pods and Swoops in Mos Eisley, a major port city on the desert world Tatooine.

Sona Fey'lya was a female Bothan smuggler during the Galactic Civil War. She was the owner of the Blue Flare, which she lost to Logron, a criminal living near Mos Shuuta, a town on Tatooine. She later was able to steal it with the help of the Pero brothers and an adventurer.
Kappo was a male Rodian criminal during the Galactic Civil War, working for a crime lord.
Krandak was a male Trandoshan living during the Galactic Civil War. He studied xenobiology to know the weaknesses of other species.

Logron was a male Human crime lord during the Galactic Civil War. He had a farmstead near Mos Shuuta, a town on the planet Tatooine. At some point, he took away the Blue Flare, Sona Fey'lya's freighter, as payback.
Coson Pero was a male Twi'lek living during the Galactic Civil War. He had a brother, Rels Pero. At some point, they helped Sona Fey'lya to take back the Blue Flare, her freighter, to Logron.

Rels Pero was a Twi'lek male living during the Galactic Civil War. He had a brother, Coson Pero. At some point, they helped the Bothan smuggler Sona Fey'lya to take back the Blue Flare, her freighter, to Logron.

Izak Anzio was a male ranger from the Outer Rim world of Agamar. Anzio dreamed of seeing the galaxy, prompting him to enlist in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Academy program, where he became friends with Kreel, a fellow enlistee.

t: Unidentified former sergeant of Task Force 99
x: A human individual lived during the Imperial Era. At some point, they became a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. By 2 BBY, they had come to serve as sergeant of Task Force 99—an elite stormtrooper unit.

A male individual lived on the Outer Rim world Chagar IX. They—along with a female individual—raised a human son named Kreel. Kreel's father was a fighter in the fighting pits on Chagar IX. By 0 ABY, when Kreel was six years old, his father was killed in the pits in front of him.

A female individual lived on the Outer Rim world Chagar IX where they fought in the world's fighting pits. They—along with a male individual—raised a human son named Kreel. By 0 ABY, Kreel's mother had been killed in the fighting pits.

"Cav" was the nickname of an Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. Cav served as the squad's melee specialist, capable of attacking targets in close quarters combat.

"Aero" was the nickname of a Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. Aero served as the squad's engineer, capable of repairing and hot-wiring vehicles for transport.

"Mic" was the nickname of a Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. Mic served as the squad's slicer, capable of breaking into and decrypting enemy computer systems.

"Shrap" was the nickname of a Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. Shrap served as the squad's demolitions expert, wielding a flamethrower and explosive charges.

"Zuke" was the nickname of a Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. Zuke served as the squad's muscle and heavy weapons expert, carrying a mortar on his back.

A Gungan criminal was active on the Smuggler's Moon, Nar Shaddaa, shortly before the skirmish in Grakkus the Hutt's arena. The Gungan gave information to the bounty hunter Dengar about the Wookiee Chewbacca.

Korin Aphra was a human male who lived during the Age of the Empire. He was the father of Chelli Lona Aphra, his daughter born in 24 BBY with his wife Lona Aphra, and Dellen Aphra. During the Clone Wars, Chelli and her mother moved away to Arbiflux, where her mother was killed.

Lona Aphra was a female human and the mother of Chelli Aphra. She gave birth to her daughter in 24 BBY. Lona split with Chelli's father Korin Aphra, taking Chelli to live on Arbiflux until raiders attacked their home.
Omus Krill was a male Zygerrian who served as a guard during the Clone Wars.
Talus was a young Human male who served as one of the "twin rulers" of Typha-Dor, alongside Binalu, in the years leading up to the Clone Wars.
Van-Ith was a Human male who served as the ruler of Vanqor in the years leading up to the Clone Wars.
Jubnuk was a Gamorrean who served the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure at his palace on Tatooine.

Porcellus was a human who worked as the head chef in Jabba's Palace on Tatooine. Following the death of Jabba, Porcellus partnered with beastmaster Malakili to open the Crystal Moon Restaurant in Mos Eisley.
Dalraga de Cueravon was a propaganda artist in the service of the Galactic Empire. The artist, along with Janyor of Bith, created the pro-Imperial poster Imperius Unitada ober Totallex.
Weel was a male human who served as a lieutenant in the First Order Security Bureau. He was capable with a vibroknife.

T'orn Zorc was a Falleen male who made a bid to take control of the Black Sun crime syndicate during the Clone Wars. His efforts were foiled by the Dark Jedi Asajj Ventress, who killed Zorc on the planet of Callos.
The First Order stormtrooper FN-1044 was one of many deployed to the planet Takodana thirty years after the Battle of Endor to recover the Resistance astromech droid BB-8.

Alrrark was a male Wookiee from Kashyyyk who fought alongside his ruler, King Grakchawwaa, during the Clone Wars. After the war, enslavers raided Kashyyyk and tried to capture Alrrark, but he managed to fight his way to freedom and fled to the Outer Rim Territories.

Fbinti Fith was a Chadra-Fan female who served as a senator in the Galactic Republic's senate. After she retired, the Republic was replaced by the autocratic Galactic Empire, and Fith sought to quietly build local resistance against the new regime early on.

Adame was a human smuggler who was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Along with Selentia, Adame approached another smuggler, Han Solo, requesting to borrow his ship, the Millennium Falcon to travel to the Gomar sector as part of a mission on behalf of Leia Organa.

Selentia was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Along with Adame, Selentia approached the smuggler Han Solo requesting to borrow his ship, the Millennium Falcon to travel to the Gomar sector as part of a mission on behalf of Leia Organa.
Nowk Asil was a female Twi'lek racer who participated in the Dragon Void Run alongside their partner Sotna Reat.
Sotna Reat was a Twi'lek racer who participated in the Dragon Void Run alongside their partner Nowk Asil.

Tomine was a human who served as an officer of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. They interceded in the Dragon Void Run participated in by Han Solo, and attempted to arrest the racers for inciting unrest against the Empire.

Valent was a human officer who served in the Imperial Navy during the reign of the Galactic Empire. At the beginning of his military career, Valent attended the officers' academy on Uyter, along with Kenner Loring.
Nadem Naz was an individual who participated in the Dragon Void Run. During the race, Naz gave up and disqualified himself from the race.

Dorae was a female alien who was a spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. At some point, Dorae owned a rathtar which she intended to use to pay off debts, however the Wookiee Chewbacca killed it.
U'il was a Falleen female who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, and was a friend of Princess Leia Organa.

The grandmother of Loo Re Anno was a founding member of the Dragon Void Run. According to Loo Re Anno, her grandmother was a mapmaker first and foremost but also loved to fly fast. Unusually for her kind, Anno's grandmother did not want to fly alone.
Miwy Joy was a Twi'lek who fought for Cham Syndulla's resistance movement during the Clone Wars. Joy was killed with other Twi'leks by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Samara was a Twi'lek who served under General Cham Syndulla within his resistance force during the Confederacy of Independent Systems' invasion of the planet Ryloth in the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
Luna was a Twi'lek who fought for Cham Syndulla's resistance movement during the Clone Wars.

Spudwee was a Twi'lek who fought for Cham Syndulla during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems' invasion of their homeworld. Spudwee was eventually killed and had their name carved in Aurebesh on a headstone just outside the Jixuan desert.

Silver was a clone captain during the Clone Wars. At the time of the civil war between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic, Silver served the latter as a clone navigation officer in the Republic Navy.

Kan Be was a male Kaminoan who, along with Isin and Toren, attempted to help Agent Terex storm Grakkus the Hutt's fortress in Megalox prison. Their plot was foiled by the Resistance starfighter pilot Poe Dameron and his astromech droid BB-8.

Palo Jemabie was a male from Naboo. As a teenager, he was involved in the Legislative Youth Program alongside Padmé Amidala, with whom he fell in love. The two ended their relationship when Jemabie became an artist, while Amidala pursued a career in politics.

affiliation: Office of Imperial Promotion, Galactic Truth, and Fact Correction
x: Ferric Obdur was a human male officer who served the Galactic Empire. Originally a member of the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic, Obdur was placed in charge of the official media output during the transition into the Empire.
Soara Antana was a high-ranking Jedi Master of the Jedi Order in the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Tavris Bahzel was a Clawdite model and artist during the era of the Galactic Empire. They were known for experimental designs that challenged the notion of species identities. Following the rise of the Empire, they spent years assisting the Wookiee underground.

Santos Bel-Pak was a poet laureate of Kooriva and a professor emeritus at the Lebrasa Argente School for the Arts and Persuasive Sciences. He was celebrated for his mixed media techniques, blending kinetic choreography and procedural with chaos-based rendering techniques.

Psyrel Capanus was a tall, scrawny male scholar working at Phelar University on Eriadu. He had wealth and ambition, and overlooked the faults of the Empire, which was typical for most citizens of the planet.
The wife of Lord Ecclessis Figg was a woman from Alderaan. The buildings of Cloud City's luxury resorts were made of white synthstone in tribute to the architecture of her homeworld.

Ark Roose, known by the nickname "Bumpy" due to his aggressive nature during races, was a dim-witted male Nuknog podracer from the planet Sump. Using a Plug-8G 927 Cluster Array Podracer, he participated in the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.

Venn Eowelt was a minister who worked in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau. In 5 ABY, Eowelt was apprehended by the pilot Norra Wexley's team of New Republic agents, who had been tasked with capturing individuals that Republic officials wished to have detained.

Keong was a moff who served the Galactic Empire. In 5 ABY, Keong was placed on a list of Imperials that New Republic officials wished to apprehend. Not long after, Keong was captured by a team of New Republic operatives led by the pilot Norra Wexley.
Husklf was a Nimbanel male bartender who worked at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.
A male Nimbanel worked as a bartender at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, a spaceport located on the planet Tatooine.

Takeel was a Snivvian male who worked as a mercenary and was addicted to spice. He and his brother Zutton frequented Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the planet Tatooine and were present in the cantina in 1 BBY when the local moisture farmer Luke Skywalker and the Jedi Obi-Wan K…

Naveela Betuine was a communications major from the planet Commenor who became a junior official in the Galactic Senate during the administration of Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum of the Galactic Republic.

affiliation: Ord Canfre Institute for Ethics in Art Criticism
x: Cepa Bonshu was a communications artist from the planet Riosa who was responsible for the creation of the art piece What Will You Do, which protested the Galactic Empire's use of forced conscription into their military on some worlds.
Angilar Bosh served as the art director of a leading advertising agency on Contruum before taking on lucrative freelance work for the Bureau of Ships and Services.

affiliation: Intergalactic Association of Amalgamated Droid Builders
x: Cosweg Budeesho was a veteran holographer and cartoonist who lived on the planet Ando Prime with his wife Seeja and their pet tooka, Yari.
Venthan Chassu was a member of SAGroup, the youth program of the Commission for the Protection of the Republic.
Ganamey Davloterra was the human female art director of the weekly newstack Chrono during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Simeon Densend was a freelance repulsorcraft designer who lived on the planet Onderon during the Clone Wars, but relocated with his family to the galactic capital of Coruscant when Onderon seceded from the Galactic Republic to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Dashira Dobeq was a female sculptor and painter from the planet Ryloth who found residence in the court of Queen Breha Organa of the planet Alderaan after exhibiting her work at the Alderaan Academy of Fine Arts.

affiliation: Commission for the Protection of the Republic
x: Byno Doubton was a fervent loyalist to the Galactic Republic who, with the patronage of fellow Eriadu native Wilhuff Tarkin, helped found the Commission for the Protection of the Republic (COMPOR).
Oba Dunimea was an outspoken sculptor, novelist and composer from the planet Alderaan who was one of the loudest critics of the Galactic Empire.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Coba Dunivee was a female art director and concept illustrator who worked for a Corellian holographic media conglomerate during the reign of the Galactic Republic and executed thousands of pro-Republic pieces of work during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent…

affiliation: Commission for the Protection of the Republic
x: Hamma Elad was a female artist and leading member of the Commission for the Protection of the Republic during the Clone Wars, the galaxy-wide civil war between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Veraslayn Kast was a human artist from the planet Mandalore. A supporter of the Death Watch splinter group and its leader, Pre Vizsla, Kast created art showcasing Mandalorian soldiers in action.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Dasita Lyros was a human female fashion-holographer who became art director of the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order. She found success in glorifying the Imperial Military in her work, despite never having set foot on a battlefield.
Yosyro Modoll was a Zeltron female who worked as an artist during the Clone Wars and was famed for the sensual illustrations she produced for semi-proscribed holo-periodicals.
Tantagru Motts-Danel was a Tarnab sandscribe who hailed from a colony on the desert planet Sriluur. At some point, he married the Weequay Gojuni Motts-Danel.

Gojuni Motts-Danel was a Weequay male artist who married the Tarnab sandscribe Tantagru Motts-Danel. During the final decades of the Galactic Republic's reign, the husbands gained prominence in the corporate art scene and were known for their holography and abstract art.

Gammit Chond was an Ithorian artist. Although he never traveled offworld, with some saying he never even ventured more than a day's walk from his house, Chond created a set of hand-drawn planetary maps based on many travelers' tales he had heard.
Amel Fortoon was an individual who, at some point, served as the Director of the Graf Archive on the moon Orchis 2.

affiliation: Commission for the Protection of the Republic
x: Donclode Onstruss was an independent HoloNet node operator who was recruited by the Commission for the Protection of the Republic after his transmissions and posting caught the attention of the Twi'lek senator Orn Free Taa.
Filris Parbert was raised on the planet Coruscant as a war orphan of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Moshenu Phobi was an Umbaran male who worked in the printing houses of the Plooriod Cluster and drew censure from the Galactic Republic for hiding anti-Republic messages within the official communications he worked on.

affiliation: Commission for a Safe and Secure Republic
x: Sannab Ro was a Xidelphiad female artist. During the Separatist Crisis, she created the The Military Creation Act propaganda poster for the Commission for a Safe and Secure Republic, encouraging individuals to vote in favor of the Military Creation Act.
Seeja was the wife of veteran holographer and cartoonist Cosweg Budeesho who was active during the Clone Wars. The couple lived together on the planet Ando Prime with their pet Tooka Yari.

Vanya Sha was a self-taught female cyborg artist who created the recruitment poster "Join the SAGroup"" for COMPNOR's Sub-Adult Group based on a concept by Imperial Minister of Information Pollux Hax during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Janray Tessime was a female artist who survived the destruction of her homeworld Alderaan in the year 1 BBY and spent the rest of the Galactic Civil War tending to the civilian population of the safeworld New Alderaan.

Yari was a tooka cat who lived during the Republic Era. During the Clone Wars fought between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, Yari was the pet of the veteran holographer and cartoonist Cosweg Budeesho, who lived with his w…

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Chrigeld Tinnine was a male artist based on the planet Alderaan who volunteered his art to the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order including the propaganda poster Report Sedition, which encouraged Imperial citizens to report suspicious activity o…

Warrchallra was a Wookiee male wroshyr wood sculptor from the city of Kachirho on the planet Kashyyyk, who fought in the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

An individual served as the Imperial governor of the Pakuuni sector in 1 BBY. That year, the governor ordered Captain Xamuel Lennox to lead ten Star Destroyers in an attack against Alliance to Restore the Republic warships orbiting the planet Turkana.
Zutton was a Snivvian male who was an artist, as well as a highly-skilled bounty hunter for Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Tyyx was a green-skinned Rodian who made his living selling tips on podracing during the reign of the Galactic Republic.

Anj Rujj was a light-skinned, blond member of the gang of highly educated mercenaries known as the Thugs of Thule during the reign of the Galactic Republic. In 22 BBY, Rujj was in the Outlander Club in the Uscru District of Coruscant, capital of the Galactic Republic.

Galdos Stouff was the Jedi Padawan of the Weequay Sora Bulq. In 22 BBY, both were part of the Jedi assault team that traveled to the planet Geonosis to rescue the Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi from Separatist execution.

A crewman aboard the Haj Shipping Lines luxury liner Star of Empire was among a group of survivors led by Captain Hajj after the Imperial artificial intelligence known as Systems Infiltration Manager took control of the ship eleven months after the Battle of Yavin.

Cane Adiss was a Yuvernian member of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire. He was present in Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine when the Wookiee Chewbacca was taken prisoner there, and also witnessed the capture of Princess Leia Organa after she freed…

In 22 BBY, Solokin Sakellar was the Grand Warden and absolute ruler of the University of Yabol Opa, a planet-wide university on the Colonies world of Yabol Opa. Sakellar owned a lodge on Coruscant, the capital world of the Galactic Republic.
Ecressys was the male governor of the Velcar sector under the Galactic Empire. He went rogue after the Battle of Endor as a warlord.
Wan Sandage was a Devlikk podracer from the planet Ord Radama who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.

The Lady of Coins was a female individual who had dust-shrouded acolytes on the Outer Rim planet Crucival. Like other factions on the planet, she gave her own reasoning on why she wished to claim Crucival as her own.

Corlac, also known as TK-605, was a human male who served as a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire in the Battle of Jakku. After gunning down their corporal, Corlac and the stormtrooper Terex buried their armor and spent a year building an "Ugly" starship to escape Jakku.
Tambo was a male Valltii scientist who worked with Galen Walton Erso. "Tambo" was a day designation in Vallt.

Nurboo was a male Valltii scientist who worked at the Vallt Experimental Fusion Facility on the planet Vallt. At one point, Nurboo worked with Galen Walton Erso on experiments with kyber crystals. At one point, he requested that Jyn Erso be named after him.
Easel was a male Valltii scientist. "Easel" was a day designation in Vallt.
Cappandar was an alien who served in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry. By 3 ABY, he was one of the longest-serving members of the company.
Corjentain Malaqua was a female human member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who had known ties to the Sullustan resistance led by Nien Nunb.

An unidentified Bith musician performed a series of concerts on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars, playing a wind instrument similar to a kloo horn. A series posters were put up around Galactic City in order to promote the Bith's concerts.
Vifra was a human who served as an engineer in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, nicknamed Twilight Company.
Sax Hastur was a human who served as the commanding officer of Nashtah Squadron.

t: Unidentified Captain of the Royal Guard
x: During the mission to Ryloth in 14 BBY, a clone trooper served as the captain of the Emperor's Royal Guard, the personal security to Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine.

In 21 BBY, a member of the Death Watch was dispatched by the Confederacy of Independent Systems to sabotage a Galactic Republic cruiser in a shipyard, only to be discovered. He engaged the forces onboard and was captured.
Brin was the hero of the holodrama The Octave Stairway. The holo recounted the adventures of Brin, who along with his friends sought to return to his home, by ascending the fabled Octave Stairway.

A female Sith serving in the reconstituted Sith Empire, this individual rose to become a Sith Overseer in the Sith Academy on Korriban; a position used not only to instruct the Acolytes in the ways of the Sith, but also to ensure that only the most powerful students pass the t…
Uvqolo was a male member of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Kourterel was a male individual who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. He had a child and a family on the astronomical object Vanzeist. In 3 ABY, Prelate Verge, a member of the Imperial Ruling Council, asked after the child.

The Imperial lieutenant Kourterel had a child. In 3 ABY, Prelate Verge, a young member of the Imperial Ruling Council, asked after the child and promised that a detail of stormtroopers would protect Kourterel's family from rebels on Vanzeist.
Eldra Kaitis, a Force-sensitive Rutian Twi'lek female, was a Padawan of the Jedi Order during the twilight years of the Galactic Republic.
"Scout Two" was a human male who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic in their Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War.
Carver was a human male sergeant who served in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

The mother of Lyra Erso was a female human who lived on Aria Prime and worked as an artist. During the Clone Wars her mother's health began to fail and Lyra suggested to her husband Galen Erso that they relocate to Aria Prime.
The mother of Galen Erso was a female human and the wife of Galen's father. They lived in a poor neighborhood on the planet Grange, where she worked as a preschool teacher.

The father of Galen Erso was a male human. Erso's father worked as a merchant in a poor neighborhood on Grange. He died in a vehicular accident when his son Galen was enrolled in the Republic Futures Program on Brentaal.
"Scout Three" was a female individual who served as a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic in their Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War.
Has Obitt was a male Dressellian who was a smuggler active during the reigns of both the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire. Obitt became a pawn of Orson Krennic in his schemes for power.
Gruppe was a female Valltii who served as a chieftain on the planet Vallt after the death of King Chai during the Clone Wars.

Chai was a male individual who served as King of the planet Vallt. Chai was killed during the Clone Wars when a coup on Vallt occurred. As a result of Chai's death, Marshal Phara ruled the Keep on the planet.
Phara was a female individual who served as a Marshal on the planet Vallt. During the Clone Wars, she contested the rule of the Keep with the incumbent monarch, King Chai.
Prakas was an individual who served as a commander within the Galactic Republic Navy during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Frist was an individual who served as a captain in the navy of the Galactic Republic, during the Clone Wars.

Oyanta was a male human who served as a Lieutenant in the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Oyanta accompanied Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic to Geonosis to oversee the Geonosians production of the top-secret battle station.

Weng was a male individual who served as a major in the Galactic Empire. In the early years of the Empire's reign, Weng was to come from an administrative building to the Imperial research station on Hypori to brief a group of scientists on plans for where they would be reloca…
Rooni was a blue skinned male Valltii who worked for Zerpen Industries with Galen Walton Erso.

Reeva Demesne was a female Mirialan scientist who worked for the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire, specializing in energy research. She was recruited by Orson Krennic and unknowingly aided in the research and construction of the Death Star's superlaser.
Woana was a female Dressellian who worked as a bar maid at the Wanton Wellspring, on the planet Rajtiri. Fellow Dressellian Has Obitt was attracted to her.

Dagio Belcoze was a male Iktotchi who worked as a computer engineer for the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Belcoze worked in Doctor Gubacher's artificial intelligence team that designed enhanced overseer droids to supervise the battle station labor force.

Ranos Yalli was a Nautolan who sometime after the end of the Clone Wars participated in an smuggling operation with a group of smugglers lead by Saw Gerrera—who later became known as the Partisans— to transport Separatist weapons to Samovar.

Arsha Lome was a female human who worked as a lawyer representing Samovar's mining conglomerate. During his time as a Adjutant General, Wilhuff Tarkin knew Lome and claimed she had as sharp a legal mind as he'd ever encountered.

Seamus Kaldo was a male noble from Valahari who lived during the Galactic War. His father's life's work, engine schematics, were once stolen from his family by Nico Okarr, leading Seamus to attempt to track down the infamous smuggler and seek revenge.
The father of Jai Kell was a human male. During the Age of the Empire, he died a couple a couple of years before his son became a cadet of the Imperial Academy on Lothal.

Mart Mattin was the nephew of Commander Jun Sato and the leader of Iron Squadron. After his father died, Mattin took over leadership of the squadron. The Iron Squadron became the only rebel cell on the planet Mykapo and harassed Imperial forces there.

Gooti Terez was a female Theelin who served as member of Iron Squadron and later lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She opposed the Galactic Empire alongside her squadmates, Mart Mattin, Jonner Jin, and the astromech droid R3-A3.
Jonner Jin was a human male member of Iron Squadron, a local rebel cell based on the planet Mykapo. In 2 BBY, Jin and his fellow rebels were involved in a skirmish with an Imperial advance patrol.
Sato, or Mart's father, was the father of Mart Mattin, and the brother of Jun Sato, He was married to Mattin with whom he had Mart Mattin.

Cuata was a Pantoran male who was an expert on kyber crystals. Before the Clone Wars placed Mygeeto and Christophsis in danger, he did research on both planets that interested the scientist Galen Erso.

Marsabi was an individual who did research on kyber crystals. Marsabi's research was followed up to a degree by Galen Erso, however he was more interested in what Cuata had been doing on Mygeeto and Christophsis before the Clone Wars placed them in danger.

A human male Imperial officer served under Grand Admiral Thrawn and Admiral Kassius Konstantine during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The officer was stationed on an Arquitens-class command cruiser during a skirmish over the planet Mykapo.
Hatchet was a Weequay who was a enslaved in an Imperial mining facility on the planet Sevarcos. Hatchet was caught in the middle of a battle between the Empire and the New Republic.
A male Morseerian worked as a scientist for the Confederacy of Independent Systems along with Nan Pakota and Urshe Torr during the Clone Wars.
Urshe Torr was a male Morseerian who along with Nan Pakota and another Morseerian worked for the Confederacy of Independent Systems as scientists during the Clone Wars.
Nan Pakota was a male Morseerian who along with Urshe Torr and another Morseerian worked for the Confederacy of Independent Systems as scientists during the Clone Wars.
A male Koorivar served as a commander for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

A Hutt was based out of Sy Myrthian space. In 19 BBY, concurrent to the conclusion of the Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic, the Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt worked for the Hutt.

Chasen Piian was a politician who served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic. Around 1300 BBY, Piian granted a piece of grass land on Coruscant to the sole surviving members of the B'ankora species.

Roman Herbane was a male human who was the Director of the Helical HyperCom facility on Lokori. Herbane had an executive secretary, Li-Tan, that greeted the Erso family when they first arrived at the Helical HyperCom headquarters in Fucallpa.

Vasp Vaspar was a human male politician who represented the Taldot sector in the Imperial Senate. He was also a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and served as the Minister of Industry in the Alliance Cabinet, part of the Alliance Civil Government.

Tynnra Pamlo was a human female politician who represented her homeworld of Taris in the Imperial Senate during the Galactic Empire Era while also being a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Civil Government as Minister of Education.

Tivik was a human male who served as an informant for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, operating on Jedha as one of Cassian Andor's underground contacts to the insurgent group led by Saw Gerrera.
After Archduke Poggle the Lesser was killed on the Outer Rim planet Mustafar by the Sith Lord Darth Vader in 19 BBY, a new Geonosian archduke was appointed by the Stalgasin hive queen by 18 BBY.
Xosad Hozem was a Twi'lek male who became a resistance fighter during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Biyel Broan was a male Sullustan. He was a leader in Sullust's anti-Imperial Cobalt Laborers' Reformation Front until he was forced out due to his associations with criminals.
Donith Garbis was a dangerous crime lord and the patriarch of the Garbis family. In the few years that led to the Battle of Yavin, he and his family operated on the planet of Thune.
Salahi was a male individual who served as a professor and was the lead scientist of the Galactic Republic's Special Weapons Group during the Clone Wars.

Dajo Koda was a Dug who was present at the Wanton Wellspring on Rajtiri before the Campaign at Salient. Koda sat with a group of smugglers including the Dressellian Has Obitt, who Koda had known since before the Clone Wars.

Ribert was a human male smuggler from the planet Coruscant. While with his shipmate on Rajtiri sometime after the end of the Clone Wars, he and his shipmate were present at the Wanton Wellspring cantina in the city of Jibuto.

The shipmate of Ribert was a human male. Sometime after the end of the Clone Wars, the two were present at the Wanton Wellspring on Rajtiri where the two sat with the Nautolan Ranos Yalli and the Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt.
Zukata was a Rodian female who worked for an organization making atlas or droid upgrades in the period of the Galactic Civil War.
Alger Sodoth was a male smuggler working for the Aqualish smuggler Bandin Dobah during the Galactic Civil War. He utilized a Z-TIE to defend Dobah's hideout.
