Saurval was a member of the Partisans who in 1 BBY was killed during in a fight against Imperial forces on Jedha.
A human female individual served the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era and possessed the military rank of admiral.

A clone trooper commander served on an unidentified planet during the Clone Wars. He was deployed there along with his troops to arrest the bounty hunters that attempted to assassinate Obi-Wan Kenobi, as a means of gaining admission to the Bounty Hunters' Guild.

Cost Niktur was a female human who grew up on Genhu. In 34 ABY, Ymmoss and Niktur were captured by the First Order and Harra who sent them to her stronghold on Vodran. When J-Squadron was captured on Vodran, Ymmoss and Niktur helped J-Squadron escape the stronghold.
Cyslin Myr, a Force-sensitive Mirialan was the Jedi Master who trained Padawan Mace Windu in the ways of the Force.

Kez Velaz was a male Jedi Master who, at some point during the Republic Era, was chosen to oversee the outreach program in the outreach temple on the planet Mathas, a world that had been suffering from the Niffin plague.
"Blackout" was the callsign of a human test pilot for the First Order's TIE/vn space superiority fighters during the war against the Resistance.
Drooz was a male individual who claimed to be a Jedi prophet and healer on the planet Mathas sometime after the Jedi Order established the outreach temple on the world.

An individual was the owner of the Kazerath device. At some point before the mission to Cato Neimoidia, the explorer Lor San Tekka petitioned him to allow him access to the device but the owner denied Tekka's request, preferring to keep it locked up in the Palace of Baron Paw …
Paw Maccon was a male Neimoidian baron of Cato Neimoidia in the decades following the Battle of Endor. A member of House Maccon, he owned large vaults, renting its spaces to clientele.
A male Aqualish was a cadet in the Resistance's J-Squadron.

A male scavenger was an individual who, prior to 20 BBY, was the first man Gallius Rax, future Fleet Admiral of the Galactic Empire, killed when he was a child on Jakku and was overseeing the construction of the Jakku Observatory.
Cabbel was a human who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy and a controller aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Tyrant, a part of the Death Squadron fleet.

Jaahn Liddle was a human member of the Rebel Alliance. After the Battle of Yavin, Liddle traveled to the planet Tibrin as part of a diplomatic mission with fellow Rebels Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa and Tadd Marteens.

Tadd Marteens was a human member of the Rebel Alliance. After the Battle of Yavin, Tadd traveled to the planet Tibrin as part of a diplomatic mission with fellow Rebels Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, and Jaahn Liddle.

Omarlin Fisker was a fair-skinned human. In 34 ABY, they were among a group who gathered in the courtyard of the pirate Maz Kanata's castle on the planet Takodana in order to watch the destruction of the Hosnian system by the First Order's Starkiller Base superweapon.
Bargwill Tomder was a male Cloddogran with brown skin and hair. Tomder wore a red shirt with a vest over it and a brown hat.

Ledick Firest was a human male cold-weather soldier who served as a colonel in the military of the Rebel Alliance. In the year 3 ABY, Firest was with the Rebel forces stationed at Echo Base on the planet Hoth when the Galactic Empire attacked.
Hendri Underholt was a female human who served as an archivist and as an aide to Mon Mothma in the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Feldstrom was a male individual who served as a controller aboard the Vigilance during the Battle of Endor.
Heurys was a female who served as a controller aboard the Vigilance during the Battle of Endor.

Like all graduates of Imperial academies, this human male naval officer was trained in combat tactics and weapon readiness. Not just a crack shot with a blaster, the officer could also call down orbital turbolaser strikes to wreak destruction on Rebel bases.
Graz, more popularly known as Graz the Hunter, was a male Gank bounty hunter during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

This male was the father of the Canto Bight Police Department officer Brawg. He spent eighty years as a police officer in Canto Bight and told his son of the times when the Syndicate was active in the city.

This six-armed alien bounty hunter was seen on Bespin's Cloud City attacking Luke Skywalker. Extremely difficult to defeat, the bounty hunter could evade attacks by quickly "cartwheeling" at or away from their enemy.
Dorin Bell was a male human scientist who served the Galactic Empire. Around 6 BBY, Bell was the first target for Jyn Erso to assassinate on the planet Horuz.
Berk was a male human. He worked under the Zabrak Arane Oreida as one of her partisans during a mission on the planet Inusagi.

Vynder was an individual who served in the Imperial Navy as one of the pilots of the Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wings. Holding the rank of Major, Vynder at one point took a mission on a foggy planet, where she was pursued in a dogfight against a Rebel X-wing.

Karsabi was an individual who served in the Imperial Navy as one of the pilots of the Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wings. Holding the rank of Lieutenant, Karsabi at one point took a mission to intercept a GR-75 medium transport as it was headed to a white, ringed planet.
Brawg was a male individual and a corrupt police officer in the Canto Bight Police Department.

Tryki was a former Zabrak pirate who was arrested for attempting to board a First Order cruiser near Rakata Prime. Her starship was destroyed, but she escaped and eventually joined the Zendiat Collective, a criminal group led by Zool Zendiat.
Dasa was a human female who was the owner of the refinery on the planet Skuhl. When the Galactic Empire arrived and attempted to purchase her refinery, she refused.
Gowayne was a friendly Chagrian male restaurant owner who owned a diner in a town on the planet Skuhl. When Imperial stormtroopers arrived in the town, they took over the diner.
Crawfin was an individual who once chased a smuggler but lost track of him when the smuggler took his ship into Smuggler's Run—an asteroid belt in the Outer Rim Territories.
Bunt was a Gigoran male pickpocket who tried to rob Jyn Erso on the space station Five Points. Erso protected herself while Bunt and his partner escaped.

Lucka Solange was a female human Imperial colonel who served on the space station Five Points. She asked Jyn Erso to make fake credits to pay her debt to the casinos. Allehander Pso found the fake credits, and discovered Solange's involvement in the scheme.

Allehander Pso was a male individual who owned Pso's Palace on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. Pso was a gambling lord who also hired many individuals to extended work contracts, turning them into indentured servants and essentially slaves.

Greyjin Marscopo was a male individual worker of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After his duty expired, Pso sold him and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire.
Kiretim was a male individual who was the master of Captain after his stepfather sold him.

Captain was a male human enslaver who served Allehander Pso. He was a slave for a long time after his stepfather sold him. Captain's first master was the cruel Kiretim, and years later, Pso bought him.

Mathey was a male human enslaver who served Allehander Pso. He sold Pso's indentured service to the Galactic Empire, working on an Amarills-class freighter under the command of an individual known as Captain.
A male Flann was a prisoner at a stronghold owned by Harra the Hutt.

Annjin was a female individual worker of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After her duty expired, Pso sold her and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire. However, Jyn Erso captured the crew of the spaceship and rescued them.

Kathlin was a female individual worker of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After her duty expired, Pso sold her and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire. However, Jyn Erso captured the crew of the ship and rescued them.

Harvey was a female individual worker of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After her duty expired, Pso sold her and his other workers as enslaved individuals to the Galactic Empire.

Laurose was a the child of a worker who served Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. They were siblings with Efford. After their mom's indentured service duty expired, Pso sold Laurose and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire.

Blane was a worker's child of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After her mom's duty expired, Pso sold her and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire. However, Jyn Erso captured the crew of the spaceship and rescued them.

Efford was a child born into slavery, owned by Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. They were siblings with Laurose. After their mom's indentured service duty expired, Pso sold Efford and the other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire.

Owlen was a worker's child of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After his mom's duty expired, Pso sold him and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire. However, Jyn Erso captured the crew of the spaceship and rescued them.
Ylva was a member of the Scyre clan. She had a daughter with one of the clan's leaders, Keldo. They were the parents of the only child in the clan, Frey.
Sweetheart was a rocky three meter tall creature with three hands. She worked in a bath spa named V-333's Silken Parlor and would behave in a grotesque manner to her clients.
Bethava Rocwyn was a female human Imperial admiral who served in the Five Points system aboard the Star Destroyer Authority during the Imperial Era.
Yav Yiyar was a male Rodian member of the Yiyar clan during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Vorin was a male Twi'lek engineer who worked for IsoTech during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was stationned on the planet Nar Shaddaa before going to Scrapheap Point, on Raxus Prime.

Risi Amps was a male Labbo wreck dealer who was a member of a group of rebels led by the Devaronian Blue. He lived on the planet Rumitaka, and in around 3 BBY, purchased a ship from Jyn Erso, which he noticed was full of fake codes.
Talo was a male Sullustan gangster who worked for the Yiyar Salvage Corporation during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Shira was a female Twi'lek who lived during the Galactic Civil War, a major conflict between the Galactic Empire and Alliance to Restore the Republic. She was Reom's sister and worked for IsoTech. She was in charge of the Mid Rim and the Core Worlds business.

Bardbee was a Rayeth male who was a member of Blue's partisans. He was captured by Imperial Admiral Bethava Rocwyn on the planet Uchinao and interrogated on the space station Five Points. He was eventually tortured and gave up his fellow Partisans before dying in the torment.

Blue was a Devaronian female who was the leader of a rebel team in the Five Points system. At some point in the Imperial Era, Jyn Erso was blackmailed by Imperial Admiral Bethava Rocwyn into infiltrating and spying on the cell.

Shawburn was a Krish male pilot and a member of Blue's rebel team in Five Points system. Blue and her group, along with Jyn Erso, who was an undercover agent of the Empire, brought food to the planet Watassay.

Liers Ossnan was an Imperial Security Bureau officer during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was in charge of finding the Separatist Munificent-class star frigate Sa Nalaor.
Burta was a female engineer and a member of Blue's rebel team in Five Points system. Blue and her group, with Jyn Erso, who was an undercover agent of the Empire, brought food to the planet Watassay.

Dwindun was a Ma'cella male who was a member of Blue's rebel team alongside his brother. Blue and her group with Jyn Erso, who was an undercover agent of the Empire, brought foodstuffs to the planet Watassay.

Yalla was a Mirialan cell mate of Jyn Erso in the Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817 on Wobani. She was aggressive and a rebel. She had other rebel friends in this prison. They caused a riot but the stormtroopers defeated the rebellion.

Egil was a male human who was the leader of the Scyre clan where Phasma lived on the planet Parnassos. He was the oldest man of the clan, dying at the age of 40 which was 5 standard years longer than the average deathrate. He trained Phasma and Porr prior to 22 ABY.

Porr was a male human who was a member of the Scyre clan where Phasma lived on the planet Parnassos. He wanted to be the new leader, so he murdered Egil in his sleep and broke the main law of the clan.

Gosta was a female human who was a member of the Scyre and one of Phasma's warriors on the planet Parnassos. She joined Phasma, Torben, Siv, Carr, Brendol Hux, and three stormtroopers on a mission to get Hux back to his ship where he could call for help.

Krin Kallibin was a celebrated jockey that participated in fathier races. He was spotted by Kedpin Shoklop near the main entrance of the Canto Casino Hotel during his visit to Canto Bight. Riding the fathier Vermilion, Krin Kallibin won first place in at least two races.

Thamm was a tiny male Troglof from Troglofa who worked in Canto Casino on the planet Cantonica as a croupier. During the Cold War he managed a Hazard Toss table during a night shift at the casino when the Suerton Dodibin entered into a winning streak while playing at the table.

Leema Kai was a Jinata Security officer and commander of the Opportunity who led Project Resurrection operations on Athulla. At some point, Kai flew a BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber. He was killed when his modified N-1 starfighter was shot down by Iden Versio.
The Master Codebreaker was a human male codebreaker who had an association with the Pirate Queen Maz Kanata and a love for gambling.

Seylon was a guardian who served the Arratu. They encountered Phasma and her team in 24 ABY. After the Arratu's death, Phasma and her team escaped from Arratu Station and killed the guardians who were in charge.
Justinian was a criminal who served the Arratu at Arratu Station on the planet Parnassos. Justinian was killed by Phasma when they attacked them in 24 ABY.

This male individual was the father of Resistance pilot Tallissan Lintra. Lintra learned the basics of piloting from behind the controls of an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor that was used by her father as a cropduster on their farm on Pippip 3.
Temiri Blagg, a Force-sensitive human male, was a child who lived a forlorn existence working as a stable hand in the Canto Casino during the First Order-Resistance War.

Wranderous was the most famous wrestler and fighter in Arratu Station of the planet Parnassos. Wranderous was a hulking and vicious individual, possessed of enormous physical strength and skills in unarmed combat.

Vrod was human male who was the ringmaster and the leader of the guardians in Arratu Station. He had black skin and a white left hand. He helped Phasma and his fellow what they did if they want to got food from the Arratu.
Trypto Buball was an alien male agricultural baron who grew wealthy due to the vast space-fungi farming colonies that his family owned.

Defancio Storsilt was an alien that was in the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY. Defancio had brown skin and gray hair. Defancio was the owner of the racing fathier Hy-Stepping. According to Bargwill Tomder, Storsilt owned almost all of the fathiers in Canto Bight.
Sosear Latta was an alien that was in the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY. Sosear had black eyes and gray hair.
Neepers Panpick was an alien private detective who operated in the city of Canto Bight during the Cold War between the First Order and the Resistance.
Snook Uccorfay was a rich alien male who worked as a raconteur. In 34 ABY, he spent time in Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Edmo Ectacle was a Moldwarp male with gray hair and brown skin. In 34 ABY, Ectacle was in the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight and watched other patrons play at the game tables before speaking with Derla Pidys on one of the casino's balconies.

The Prime Jedi was an individual who was active during the Dawn of the Jedi era. Doing so while following an early version of the Jedi Code, the individual became the first Jedi to ever use the Force.
Aisala was an individual who lived on the desert world of Tatooine before the Clone Wars began.
Oniho Zaya was a human male child who worked as one of Bargwill Tomder's stable hands at the fathier stables in Canto Bight.
Yasto Attsmun was a Ungrila male tyrannical baron from Listehol who was the head of Attsmun Cybernetics and owned the yacht Undisputed Victor.
Parallela Grammus was a female Lukovel who lived in the galaxy. In 34 ABY, Parallela and her twin sister of Rhomby Grammus, were present in the Canto Bight casino
Rhomby Grammus was a female Lukovel who lived in the galaxy. Rhomby and her twin sister, Parallela Grammus, were both present at the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY.

Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion, also known simply as The Countess, was a female Idalowd who was in the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY. Around 34 ABY, she was the Countess of Canto Bight and was a partial owner of Zord's Spa and Bathhouse.
Hue Tico was a male human who was the father of Paige and Rose Tico with Thanya Tico.
Thanya Tico was a female human who was the mother of Paige and Rose Tico with Hue Tico. She flew an ore digger for the Central Ridge Mining Company.

Torbi was a human female who was the child of Siv and either Torben or Keldo. She was born and raised by Siv in a Con Star Mining Corporation facility, Calliope Station, for the first ten years of her life.
This female individual was in the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY where she sported a Nova Sundari-style hairdo.
Shreya Ordassa was a female Togruta professor at the University of Sanbra during the Galactic Civil War. She attended an auction on Cloud City in the hopes of acquiring the Jewel of Yavin.

Mil Mikkir was a male Chagrian manager of of an Outer Rim construction company owned by his father during Galactic Civil War. He spent some of his youth roaming Port Town where he briefly dabbled with a mild form of spice.

Moden Canady was a human male who served as a naval officer in both the Galactic Empire and the First Order. During the reign of the Empire, Canady commanded the Star Destroyer Solicitude of the Imperial Starfleet.
Jaycris Tubbs was a human male who served as a pilot in the Resistance during the evacuation of D'Qar.
Larma D'Acy was a human female who served as a commander in the ground forces of the Resistance, a paramilitary group founded by Leia Organa to monitor and oppose the actions of the First Order.
Brother Letrun Pay was an alien male who spent time in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in the year 34 ABY.

Loatha Sommover was a brown-skinned alien who spent time in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in the year 34 ABY. Sommover wore a neural wave relaxer helmet, a black coat and a ring that was both a comlink and a piece of decorative jewelry.
Glowen Faquidde was a white-skinned member of a humanoid alien species who spent time in the Canto Casino on the planet Cantonica in 34 ABY.

Saile Minnau was a human male who served as a Resistance fleet guard during the war against the First Order. After the fleet was destroyed following the Battle of D'Qar in 34 ABY, the survivors evacuated to the planet Crait to make a last stand.

Riva Rosetta was a human female who served as a technician in the fleet of the Resistance during their war against the First Order. She wore brown overalls with a brown belt, black boots and orange helmet including an insulated ground crew headset.
Pos Podura was a male Twi'lek employee of a small business firm during Galactic Civil War. He attended the University of Sanbra where he developed feelings for one of his professors, Shreya Ordassa.
Guila Angira was a human male lieutenant in the Resistance fleet during their war against the First Order.

Idrosen Gawat was a human male who after retiring from the planetary defense force of the Mykapo system, came to serve in the Resistance navy as captain and executive officer of the MC85 Star Cruiser Raddus during the war between the Resistance and the First Order.

Vorse Tabarith was a male Human crime lord during the Galactic Civil War. Tabarith was a native of Cloud City on Bespin where he owned and operated several casinos and resorts, which were little more than fronts for his racketeering and bookie enterprises.
Aris Shen was a female Pantoran who lived on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War. She was married to the casino owner and crime lord, Vorse Tabarith, who doted on her heavily.
Poldin LeHuse was a human male First Order TIE Fighter Pilot who served in the armed forces of the First Order during their war with the Resistance, in 34 ABY.

SC-4044 was a human stormtrooper who served as an instructor to new troopers aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Absolution. Captain Cardinal, another stormtrooper involved in the training of First Order soldiers, was a friend and colleague of SC-4044.
Lusica Stynnix was a human female junior officer who held the rank of lieutenant in the First Order Navy during the First Order-Resistance War.

Peera Maso was a female human who served in the military branch of the First Order. Holding the rank of gunnery chief, she worked on the Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy, the flagship and headquarters for the First Order.

Brun Obatsun was an individual who served in the military branch of the First Order. Obatsun worked on the Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy, the flagship and headquarters for the First Order, acting as one of the flagship's gunners.
Rumitar Shay was a human male officer who served in the military branch of the First Order, holding the rank of Petty Officer.

Ansiv Garmuth was a human male officer who served in the First Order Security Bureau. Holding the rank of colonel, he served aboard the Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy, the flagship of Supreme Leader Snoke and headquarters of the First Order.
Edrison Peavey was a human male captain in the First Order Navy during the war against the Resistance.

Tritt Opan was a male human who served in the naval forces of the First Order. Holding the rank of captain, he was among the staff of General Armitage Hux, and acted as his hitman to kill anyone who might pose a threat to the general, with some of his devices including a fake …

Lank Paze was a human male who served in the naval forces of the First Order. Holding the rank of Petty Officer, he was part of General Armitage Hux's staff. He reported the transmission of Poe Dameron to Hux. His commemorative armband read "Hal," designating him as squad leader.

Suday Bascus was a human who served in the the naval forces of the First Order during its war against the Resistance. He acted as Warrant Officer under Captain Moden Canady aboard the Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought Fulminatrix during the Battle of D'Qar in 34 ABY.
Gorn Vorrox was a male Duros merchant during the Galactic Civil War. He traded in information and stolen goods in the seedy Seelom District of Jyvus City, the largest space city in orbit over Duro.

The First Guard was an Elite Praetorian Guard who served as a bodyguard of Supreme Leader Snoke, ruler of the First Order. Equipped with segmented plate armor and an electro-bisento, the First Guard eschewed ranged weapons in favor of melee combat.
The Seventh Guard was an Elite Praetorian Guard who served as the personal guard of Supreme Leader Snoke, leader of the First Order. The guard wielded vibro-arbir blades.

The Third Guard was an Elite Praetorian Guard who served as a personal guard of Supreme Leader Snoke, leader of the First Order. While serving the Supreme Leader, the Third Guard used a Bilari electro-chain whip.
The grandmother of Kaljach Sonmi was a Heptooinian female who, by the time Sonmi traveled to Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica, was long gone.

Minn's mother was a Devaronian female director of hospitality at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. After Kaljach Sonmi won a duel against Orisha Okum and give a big tip to her daughter, she hired Kal as a floorwalker in the casino.

The Porg Stowaway was a porg male from the ancient planet Ahch-To who hid away aboard the Millennium Falcon, along with at least three other porgs before the Battle of Crait. During the battle, the stowaway got in the way of Chewbacca's piloting.
Karlus Stee was a fair skinned human male with black hair, who worked as a croupier at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Ronith Blario was a human male who was a pilot for the Resistance fleet during their war against the First Order. He was a reckless rookie who flew an RZ-2 A-wing interceptor. He shared the last name with another Resistance pilot named Ataphen Blario.
Stomeroni Starck was a human male who flew as an T-70 X-wing starfighter pilot and Flight Officer in the Resistance fleet. He served as Blue Two.
Jober Tavson was a human individual who held the rank of Lieutenant and served as the pilot for the personal Upsilon-class command shuttle of Kylo Ren, Supreme Leader of the First Order.
Derham Boyce was a human male who served as sergeant in the ground forces of the Resistance during their war against the First Order.
Nossit Cicer was a human male who served as major in the Resistance during their war against the First Order.
Geno Namit was a human male who served as a captain in the naval forces of the Resistance during their war against the First Order.

This male individual was the father of Resistance Commander Larma D'Acy. After the New Republic demilitarized, despite it having no effect on their home, D'Acy's father was one of the loudest individuals to question the decision, going as far as calling it a shortsighted one.

Slowen Lo was a male Abednedo who resided on Canto Bight. He made a fortune selling driftwood sculptures and lived on the beach in the coastal city on the desert planet Cantonica. In 34 ABY, Lo saw Finn and Rose Tico illegally land and abandon their ship on a Canto Bight beach.

Alcida-Auka was a Lanai female who served as the matron of the Caretakers of Temple Island on the planet Ahch-To. In the year 34 ABY, she encountered the former scavenger Rey in the Jedi village on the island.
Cobel Tansirch was a male human soldier who served as a sergeant in the Resistance during their war with the First Order.

Hesper-Inguza was a fish gutter who lived on the planet Ahch-To. As a male Lanai from Temple Island, he was a member of the group known as the Visitors, which was a fishing and hunting fleet of handcrafted vessels that spent most of its time traveling across the ocean to other…

Grebe-Korora was a male Lanai porter who resided on the planet Ahch-To. Hailing from Temple Island, he was a member of the group known as the Visitors, along with all the other male members of his species from the island.

Arashell Sar was a human female child who worked as a stable hand—one of several street urchins abandoned on the planet Cantonica and employed by Bargwill Tomder—at the fathier stables in Canto Bight. Her fellow stable hands included Temiri Blagg and Oniho Zaya.

Auk-Waimanu was a Lanai male who served as the captain of the Visitors, a group consisting of the male Lanai population of the Temple Island on the planet Ahch-To. The group spent all of their time fishing and hunting while traveling across the ocean to other islands.
Corm-Kairuku was a net-maker for the Visitors, a group consisting of all of the male Lanais from the population inhabiting Temple Island on the planet Ahch-To.
Terna-Gentu lived on Temple Island on the planet Ahch-To and served as one of the Caretakers, a group consisting of all of the female Lanais on the island.
Nodin Chavdri was a human male member of the Resistance where he served as a shuttle and transport pilot.

Thomkins Watam was a human male who worked as a chauffeur in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. He wore an all black uniform including boots, pants, gloves a shirt and a belt along with a formal pointed chauffeur's hat.
Jhat was a Palandag musician. The Palandags were naturally musical due to their powerful exolungs, so Jhat was a leading f'nonc horn performer.

Flufto was the nickname of a batch of cloned and customized tookas owned by the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra. Aphra cloned over sixty of the creatures in a laboratory on the Outer Rim planet Son-tuul.
Dobbu Scay was a Khamarill gambler from Emkhamarill who was present in the Canto Casino on the planet Cantonica in 34 ABY.
Gherd was a male nanak owned by Harra the Hutt that helped J-Squadron escape the stronghold.
Xim, also known as Xim the Despot, was a male tyrannical warlord who lived in a time long before the reign of the Galactic Empire and the First Order.
The 14th Atrisian Emperor, otherwise known as the 14th Emperor of Kitel Phard, was an individual who served as the fourteenth Atrisian Emperor of the Core Worlds astronomical body Atrisia.

A individual served as Jedi of the Old Jedi Order, and was the Jedi master of Dass Jennir. After the execution of Order 66, and while fighting a Chistori thug and his allies, Jennir recalled something his master had once told him years prior.
This Imperial served in the rank of captain in the Imperial Navy. Following the Galactic Empire's establishment, he went on the search for Dass Jennir.
Ubbla Mollbro was a boisterous female Xi'Dec opera singer who spent time in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. Her presence was due to her search for a hatching partner.
Stepheden Thaldree was a human male who served as an officer of the Canto Bight Police Department in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
Sommel Atandu was a human male who served as a sergeant of the Canto Bight Police Department in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Govi was an Ishi Tib who served as the Mariod of the planet Tibrin. On behalf of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Leia Organa met with Govi and another Ishi Tib official to rally the planet to their cause.

Davin Bryce was a human who served as a captain who commanded the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Stormbringer. A battalion of stormtroopers subdued rebel Luke Skywalker and decided to take him to the Stormbringer so Bryce could interrogate him.

Armo Malou was a male alien who worked as head barkeeper at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. In the year 34 ABY, he was present in the casino when the Resistance operatives Finn and Rose Tico entered.
Pemmin Brunce was an Ongidae male who was the head of security for the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Elli-Vaa was an Umbaran female and a member of the Umbaran Shadow Assassins by the time of the Galactic War. During the Crisis on Umbara, Elli-Vaa led a group of Umbaran Shadow Assassins, alongside soldiers of the Umbaran Military, to defend a hovertrain carrying Adegan crystals.

Hhex was a Palandag musician who played f'nonc horn in a band alongside fellow Palandags Jhat and Dhuz. Around 34 ABY, the trio played in the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Dhuz was a Palandag musician who was part of the house band alongside fellow Palandags Jhat and Hhex for the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. All three members of the band played f'nonc horn gas bags.
Pinrado Noza was a jockey who rode fathiers at the Canto Casino's racetrack in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
