Maeve was a female Human citizen of the Eternal Empire living during the Galactic War. A member of the Knights of Zakuul, after the Coronation of Empress Vaylin she went into exile following the disgraced Battalion Commander Tassar.
Majzon was a male pureblood Sith who was a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Galactic War he resided on the Vaiken Spacedock.
Malussa the Gleaming Star was a female Human Jedi living during or after the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Marlon Fenn was a male Mandalorian mercenary living during the war against Zakuul. Following the death of the Eternal Empire Empress Vaylin and the formation of the Eternal Alliance in 3630 BBY, he joined Doctor Alirra Semhess' group of rogue Republic scientists who worked on …
Medjay Milesius was a male Human living on Coruscant during the Cold War.
Miduis was a female Miraluka Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. During the Galactic War she resided on the Carrick Station.
Mil'ri Padanb was a male Ortolan musician living on Cademimu V during the Galactic War.
Nayva Isoder was a female Mirialan Major of the Galactic Republic living during the war against Zakuul. She was a member of Rike's Raiders, a unit led by a strong Republic loyalist General Amos Rike.
Nessl Vaccan was a female Human living during the Galactic War. During the war against Zakuul she became a member of the Eternal Alliance and traveled to the Alliance base on Odessen.

Nil'Duru was a male Chiss Chief Engineer of the Inrokini family living on Copero. In 3629 BBY the ruling Syndic Zenta harbored a fugitive from the Eternal Alliance named Theron Shan on Copero and Aristocra Saganu of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force authorized the Alliance …
Nivi'sec was a male Twi'lek living during the Galactic War. By 3640 BBY he was a top man in Rogun Matt'rik's crime syndicate.
Nymessa was a female Cathar Jedi living during or after the Cold War.

Nyris Ko was a female Cathar living during the war against Zakuul. Following the death of the Eternal Empire Empress Vaylin and the formation of the Eternal Alliance in 3630 BBY, she and her family member Icarr Ko joined Doctor Alirra Semhess' group of rogue Republic scientist…
Nyzes was a male Human colonel of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was stationed on Alderaan.

Oleg was a male Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul living during the war against Zakuul. By the time Empress Vaylin took the Eternal Throne, Oleg was a beastmaster working at the Royal Palace of the Eternal Dragon.
O'Neal was a female Human Captain of the Galactic Republic. During the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire she was stationed on Carrick Station.

Oramis was a female Human member of the Scions of Zakuul living during the war against Zakuul. After head Scion Heskal was killed by Arcann during the Battle of Asylum, the remaining Scions fled wrath of his sister Vaylin, who pursued them across known space.
Orzmod was a male Human Jedi living during or after the Cold War.
Pelissa Marsto was a female Miraluka Jedi of the Galactic Republic. During the Galactic War she was stationed on the Carrick Station.
Penzaren was a male Human Chief Engineer of the Galactic Republic living during the war against Zakuul.
Preeda the Butcher was a female Sith living during or after the Cold War.
Qezzed was a male Sith living during or after the Cold War.

Raena was a female Human Lieutenant of the Coruscant Security Force during the war against Zakuul. Following the death of the Eternal Empire Empress Vaylin and the formation of the Eternal Alliance in 3629 BBY, she joined CSF Commander Kallin, an outspoken critic of the Allian…

Rahser Poth was a male Selkath Doctor of the Galactic Republic living during the war against Zakuul. Following the death of the Eternal Empire Empress Vaylin and the formation of the Eternal Alliance in 3630 BBY, he joined Doctor Alirra Semhess' group of rogue Republic scienti…

Raine was a male Cathar soldier living during the war against Zakuul. He was a member of the Eternal Alliance and was part of the Alliance Recon Unit, created and deployed in response to various uprisings sparkling across the galaxy following the death of the Eternal Empire, E…
Rakesh the Foul was a male Dashade living during the Galactic War. A wanted criminal, he was locked up by the Dust Vipers gang on Tatooine after he tried to chew off their leader Bel Nerodia's hand.
"Night Stalker" Raxine was a female Sith who lived around the time of the Cold War.
Rhyder Umatesh was a male Human soldier of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3630 BBY he was part of the forces brought by the Empress Darth Acina to Iokath.
Rompy was the name given to one of the exoboars of Bergola's pack that was kept in the pens of the Palace of the Eternal Dragon on Zakuul during the Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin in 3630 BBY.

Rorhy Etamuhs was a male Human soldier of the Galactic Republic during the revolt against the Eternal Empire. In 3630 BBY he was part of the forces brought by the Republic Supreme Commander Jace Malcom to Iokath.
Ruvehnimaal was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto living on Nar Shaddaa during the Galactic War who worked at Club Vertica Casino during a Soovada event.

Ryssa Jadeonar was a female Togruta pirate known for being the scourge of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War. She and her bodyguard Kallaaddik visited the planet Taris in 3643 BBY, where both were defeated.
Sellexith was a female Daichyura living on Nar Shaddaa during the Galactic War who worked at Star Cluster Casino as a bouncer during a Soovada event.
Setali Dexsoreco was a female Human captain of the Death's Claw pirate gang living during the Galactic War.
Shakfa Flufm was a Mirialan female living on Nar Shaddaa who worked at Club Vertica Casino during a Soovada event.
Sibba Loto was a wealthy male Ortolan merchant who was killed during the invasion of Ziost in 3636 BBY during the Galactic War.
Silaraz was a male Miraluka Jedi living during or after the Cold War.

An unnamed Sith Entity was kept imprisoned in stasis as a Force ghost onboard the Emperor's Fortress during the Galactic War. During the Battle of Ilum in 3640 BBY, Darth Malgus took control of the space station and proclaimed himself the Emperor of a New Empire.
Skurr was the name given to a large Subteroth living under the surface of Makeb, near the location of an ancient abomination Gethul.

Sterla was a male Human citizen of the Eternal Empire living during the Galactic War. A member of the Knights of Zakuul, following the Coronation of Empress Vaylin he was hand-picked by her to join the new Horizon Guard.

Sunfell was a female Human citizen of the Eternal Empire living during the Galactic War. A member of the Knights of Zakuul, following the Coronation of Empress Vaylin she was hand-picked by her to join the new Horizon Guard.

Takkan Russco was a infamous male pirate living during the Galactic War. He was a captain in the Crimson Fang gang, which following the death of Empress Vaylin and formation of the Eternal Alliance in 3630 BBY took over Port Nowhere by force, planning to use the mobile space s…

Tarnahok was a male Bith Chief Engineer of the Galactic Republic living during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY he was stationed in Section X on Belsavis, where Republic Strategic Information Service agent Bren send him to assist a Republic individual with recovering an HK-51 ser…
Tassar was a female Human native of Zakuul living during the Galactic War. A Battalion Commander of the Eternal Empire, she was the foremost architect of the Star Fortress program.
Thaban was a male Human captain of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY he was stationed in Colonel Gorik's base, the Kalarath Imperial Encampment, on Tatooine.
The Caller in the Dark was a creature of an unknown origin that was found under the surface of Makeb, near the location of an ancient abomination Gethul.

Tragus Rova was a male Human citizen of the Eternal Empire living during the war against Zakuul. A member of the Knights of Zakuul, following the Coronation of Empress Vaylin he was hand-picked by her to join the new Horizon Guard.
Tulo the Fearless was a male Human Jedi living during or after the Cold War.
Turnell was a male Human SpecOps captain of the Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY, he was stationed near an anti-aircraft gun in the Overgrown Trail on Balmorra.

Tyrral Jerikko was a male Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul living during the war against Zakuul. By the time Empress Vaylin took the Eternal Throne, he was a Battalion Commander in the ranks of the Knights of Zakuul.
Urdig was a male Pureblood Sith living during or after the Cold War.
Vella Zarkot was a female Human citizen of the Eternal Empire living during the Galactic War.
Velloc was the name given to a large Underwalker living under the surface of Makeb, near the location of an ancient abomination Gethul.
Vezok was a male Selonian living on Corellia during the Galactic War. During the Battle of Corellia in 3640 BBY he was captured by the Imperial forces, leaving behind some explosives.

Vipp was a female Nautolan science officer serving aboard the Theoretika, a research vessel operated by the Czerka Corporation. One of the ship's primary projects in its final years of activity was a bioengineered jurgoran specimen labeled Specimen Gamma 19.
Voolattar was a male Duros Chief Engineer of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War.

Wrad was a male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War. Following the death of Empress Vaylin and formation of the Eternal Alliance in 3630 BBY, he joined an Imperial splinter faction led by renegade Sith Lords Adacin and Zanisk.

Xoryn Rhas was a male Cathar living during the war against Zakuul. He was a member of the Eternal Alliance, where he held a position of the Emissary to both reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Paonu was a commander in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company. He served as naval captain on the company's CR90 corvette, the Thunderstrike, and was third down the line of command in Twilight Company.
Mzun was an alien who served in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company. After Sergeant Fektrin's death in 3 ABY, Mzun took charge of Fektrin's squad.
TK-5648 was the designation of a stormtrooper who served on the Star Destroyer Stormbringer when it was destroyed by the Ishi Tib fleet.
Time for Flatcakes was a deaf and blind male racing fathier sired by Kreegah who was kept at the Canto Bight racetrack on the planet Cantonica.
Wol Kessix was a male individual who served as an agent of the Resistance around the time of the Hosnian Cataclysm.
Joris was a Heptooinian female who worked at the currency exchange desk of the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Ganzer was a male bartender at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. He was a close friend of fellow employee Kaljach Sonmi and witnessed him defeat the gambler Orisha Okum in a game of pazaak.
Orisha Okum was a Zeltron female, professional gambler who worked for the crime lord Sturg Ganna in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Valis of Kuhlvult was a Kuati diplomat who was the first owner of the Libertine, which Valis originally christened as the Steadfast. The Libertine was eventually owned by Korfé Bennux-Ai until it was stolen on Cantonica by DJ, an amoral criminal and slicer.
Korfé Bennux-Ai was a male individual who purchased and then owned the custom Star Yacht Libertine. He was an arms dealer who sold starfighters.

Franna was a female Human who was part of a colony that resided on a moon affiliated with the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, knowing that this colony couldn't be saved from a Separatist invasion, most of the population evacuated the moon.

Thernbee was a male Human who was part of a colony that resided on a moon affiliated with the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, knowing that this colony couldn't be saved from a Separatist invasion, most of the population evacuated the moon.

Bak Rychuk was a human male pilot that served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Lieutenant Rychuk flew as part of Shepherd Squadron under the callsign Shepherd Two with his astromech droid, Zeetoo-Zeetoo.

This clone trooper captain served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. In around 20 BBY, he was part of a mission to a moon besieged by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Led by Grand Master Yoda, he helped evacuating the last of the moon's population.
Yancee Drai was a human female pilot that served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Captain Drai flew as part of Shepherd Squadron under the callsign Shepherd One.
Olee Beasco was a Twi'lek male pilot who served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Beasco flew as part of Shepherd Squadron under the callsign Shepherd Four.
Noblesse Eiram was a human female pilot that served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Eiram flew as part of Shepherd Squadron under the callsign Shepherd Five.
Hopeata was a Rodian pilot that served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Hopeata flew as part of Shepherd Squadron under the callsign Shepherd Three.
Ektol Traz was a human male who served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy. He commanded the Imperial Interdictor-class heavy cruiser Spectral.
Swaja Malon was a male Rodian who worked as a mechanic in Mos Espa on Tatooine.
Adan Mose was a human male who assisted Han Solo and Chewbacca in smuggling Rathtars for King Prana on Twon Ketee.

Fossil, known as "the Old Lady" by the bomber crews of the Resistance, was a female Martigrade who served as the commanding officer of the Resistance's StarFortress unit that included Cobalt and Crimson Squadron.

Aisha Freitas was a senior analyst within Alliance Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Freitas was in an argument with Colonel Haxen Delto on an unverified intelligence report about another rumored Death Star.
Tropam Givar was a Rellarin Jedi auxiliary, and one of the most commonly requested agents by the Order at the time of the Invasion of Naboo.
Juhrah Yanai was a female human who was in Takodana Castle on Takodana during the destruction of the Hosnian system by Starkiller Base.
Vurluha was a female Twi'lek who was a youngling training at the Jedi Temple.

Chukha-Trok, also called Chukha, was an Ewok that lived on the moon Endor, who participated in a hunting expedition with Ra-Lee and Chirpa. Chukha-Trok set a trap that Ra-Lee and Chirpa drove the boar-wolf they were hunting into.
Scolder was a Dowutin that lived in the galaxy.

Azuroth Khell was a Kalzerian male born in the frigid hills of the Kost province on the planet Kalzeron. His primitive world was occupied by Imperial forces and he fled with a group so they could train and arm themselves to take back their world.

A Weequay pirate was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, he served the gang as a scout on the planet Felucia. During an operation on the jungle world, the scout laid prone on a ridge overlooking the a nysillin farm that the gang were extorting.

The human monitor of First Order General Armitage Hux was on the bridge of the Star Destroyer Finalizer during the Battle of D'Qar. They were the one who intercepted Poe Dameron's message as the pilot contacted Hux from Black One.

Karris was an Imperial Commander who reported to Moff Delian Mors, the Commander of the Imperial Forces on Ryloth. He served under her when the rebel YT-209 freighter Eclipse undertook a smuggling run into Ryloth. Despite their efforts, the rebels eluded Imperial capture.

A pirate was part of the k'Jtari group. By 0 ABY, the pirate taught the human smuggler Sana Starros a hand-to-hand combat technique that consisted of using an arm to hit an individual on the back of their neck.
Nathe was an individual who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars as a member of the Special Operations Brigade, a special forces division of the Grand Army of the Republic.
Sovi was an individual who served as a personal assistant to Senator Padmé Amidala of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Long after 0 ABY, a Whill was tasked with writing the Journal of the Whills, in which the individual was expected to record the history of the galaxy.
Vrei was decorated for bravery during his service, and was outwardly aloof, and treated his crew as subjects, but also played hardball if need be. He was considered to be harsh but fair.

Tarnik was a male individual who resided in the village Torbel on the planet Lanteeb during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. By the time of the Clone Wars, Tarnik was middle-aged and had a scar that ran across both cheeks on his face.

The Shahmistra of J'doytzin III, also known by the sobriquet His Illustriousness, was a male individual who lived during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. In 21 BBY, the Shahmistra held some negotiations with Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, the leader of the Republic.

An Ishi Tib pirate was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. The pirate was skeptical of Hondo Ohnaka's leadership skills and intelligence, as when told to attack a nearby ship, the Crucible, they commented that they believed Hondo was not going to "mess" with Jed…

A Force-sensitive Kajain'saNikto male served as a Jedi under the Jedi Order and Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, the Jedi, alongside fellow Jedi Finn Ertay, encountered two Zabrak brothers, Maul and Savage Opress, at a spaceport in the Outer Rim Territories.
This Weequay pirate was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. This pirate helped to capture Count Dooku for Hondo Ohnaka, and was later present at a Weequay banquet.

Ben Teene was a human male pilot of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 Crimson Bolide during the Evacuation of D'Qar. He spotted incoming First Order starfighters approaching the Resistance Bomber squadrons and advised the rest of the unit.
The father of Commander Zhou was a male individual who served the Galactic Empire and was the superior of his son.
This pirate was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. At some point, General Grievous invaded Florrum for revenge against Hondo Ohnaka, who had held Count Dooku captive.
A human monitor who served the Resistance as a tactical officer was aboard the MC85 Star Cruiser Raddus during the evacuation of D'Qar.
Thull Wulain was a male Sun Guard who was aided by the Sith in his ascendancy to the rank of Supreme Sun Guardian, swearing fealty to the Sith Lord Darth Sidious.

Phi was one of the children of Resistance pilot Jaycris Tubbs. At the time of the Evacuation of D'Qar in 34 ABY, Tubbs' flight helmet was inscribed with Phi's name, along with the names of Tubbs' other children, Ted and Stella.

Ted was one of the children of Resistance pilot Jaycris Tubbs. At the time of the Evacuation of D'Qar in 34 ABY, Tubbs' flight helmet was inscribed with Ted's name, along with the names of Tubbs' other children, Phi and Stella.

Stella was one of the children of Resistance pilot Jaycris Tubbs. At the time of the Evacuation of D'Qar in 34 ABY, Tubbs' flight helmet was inscribed with Stella's name, along with the names of Tubbs' other children, Ted and Phi.
Fodani was a male Jawa who lived on Tatooine. During the Clone Wars, he was kept as a slave in a Separatist camp until he was freed by Grand Master Yoda.
Casca Panzoro was a commander in the united resistance movement Bravo Rising at the time of the Atterra campaign. She was the grandmother of fellow resistance member Reeve Panzoro.
Reeve Panzoro was a member of the united resistance movement Bravo Rising at the time of the Atterra campaign. He was the grandson of fellow resistance member Casca Panzoro.
Ghoel was a Wol Cabasshite male who resided in Jabba's Palace on Tatooine during the period of the Galactic Civil War.
Atenna Olypo was a Rutian Twi'lek who negotiated smuggling routes near the neutral world Arthuria during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Karté was a female human who served as a handmaiden to Senator Padmé Amidala. During the Clone Wars, she was impersonated by the Clawdite bounty hunter Cato Parasitti, who stole her robes and locked her up until she was found by authorities.

Noka was a male Trandoshan enslaver who was part of an acquisition crew working for the Xonti Brothers. He led a mission to Kashyyyk to capture Wookiees for their superiors. However, the Wookiee Krrsantan had set a trap for them and killed all of the hunters except for Noka.

Kryndal was a human male who served in the Rebel Alliance's special forces, receiving four months of training for the role. In 3 ABY, he was stationed at the Alliance High Command's secret base on the planet Hoth.

Malkhan was a warlord and leader of the Malkhanis, a clan on the Outer Rim planet Crucival, during the Imperial Era. Giving his own reason why he should control Crucival, Malkhan and his clan led an insurrection on the planet.
Tresalis was a Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order before the fall of the Galactic Republic at the end of the Clone Wars.

Kreegah was a male fathier who sired the fathier Time for Flatcakes. By 34 ABY Time for Flatcakes had started participating in fathier races at the Canto Casino and Racetrack in the city Canto Bight on the casino planet Cantonica.

Salju was a human female who was the proprietor of Black Spire Station, a filling station and repair shop in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu that serviced vehicles ranging from landspeeders and swoop bikes to small vessels.
Mawdo Larrth was the Ithorian owner of Cladtech, a factory on the Inner Rim world of Gilvaanen, which manufactured stormtrooper armor components during the Imperial Era.

A Cerean Jedi served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. During the Great Jedi Purge, he was captured by the citizens of a desert planet and handed over to the local Imperial authorities. He was put in a cage, which was installed on the square of the local capital.

Oosha Choi was a human who was a detective for Canto Bight's Police Department. Unlike many police officers from the Department, Choi was an honest detective leading him to earn a reputation of sucker.

"Static", known by their title "Omega Ace," was the nickname of a human First Order ace pilot from Omega Squadron, a squadron of TIE/fo space superiority fighters. They were a part of the military of the First Order.
"Null" was the callsign of the human First Order ace pilot from Epsilon Squadron, a squadron of TIE/fo space superiority fighters. They were a part of the military of the First Order.

Saespo Choffrey was an artist who worked for Sienar Fleet Systems. He was the cousin of Resinu Santhe-Caltra, and networked his family relations into a successful illustration career as part of the arms and drive manufacturer.

Val was a female human criminal who worked with fellow outlaw Tobias Beckett during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Val was a no-nonsense and occasionally prickly woman who was a crack shot with a blaster rifle.

Dryden Vos was a near-human alien male who served as the public face of the crime syndicate Crimson Dawn during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He owned the First Light, and possessed a large quantity of wealth as Crimson Dawn's figurehead leader.
This dark side entity appeared in a vision to a young Anakin Skywalker during his training as a Padawan in the Jedi Temple.
Yanjon Zelmar was a member of the Four Sages of Dwartii, controversial lawgiver-philosophers who influenced the Galactic Republic's early laws.
Annaz was a female Falleen gangster who was part of the Malandro syndicate on the planet Tangenine. Her syndicate extorted places like the farm owned by Remba and Kelven.

Kelven, referred to as Ada by other other members of his family, was a male farmer who lived on Tangenine. He and his lover Remba had two children, Lauren Mel Coelho and Julien. The family owned a farm but were being extorted by the Malandro syndicate.
Remba, referred to as Ama by other members of her family, was a female farmer who lived on Tangenine and owned a farm with her lover Kelven and the rest of her family, Lauren Mel Coelho and Julien.
Julien, nicknamed "Ju-ju" by his sister Lauren Mel Coelho, was a male individual who lived on Tangenine. He was born to Remba and Kelven.

One Zillo Beast was believed to be the last member of its kind. In 21 BBY, it was awoken by an electro-proton bomb used by the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Malastare, against the Confederacy of Independent Systems' battle droid army.

Jinsol was a member of the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Following the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, the 61st were making repairs to their CR90 corvette, the Thunderstrike, on the planet Ankhural.
Norokai was a veteran of the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry who joined the company prior to its campaign on the planet Vir Aphshire.
Dixnet Dat was a female journalist for the Undervine during the Galactic Civil War.
Glimmet Ledd was a member of the Luurian Genetic Enclave and served in the Republic Ministry of Science to the Clone Wars.
Shadday Potkin was a human who served as a Jedi Master within the Jedi Order, the guardians of the Galactic Republic.
The father of Jek and Shaeeah Lawquane was a male who was the partner of Suu Lawquane and the father of her children.

Bhada Cha was a human male bounty hunter who was the husband of Ramat Cha and the father of Chanath Cha. In 19 BBY, shortly after the rise of the Galactic Empire, Bhada, Ramat, and Chanath attempted to claim a bounty placed on the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

Ramat Cha was a human female bounty hunter who was the wife of Bhada Cha and the mother of Chanath Cha. Shortly after the rise of the Galactic Empire, Ramat, her husband Bhada and Chanath attempted to claim the bounty placed on the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

Far Mothma was a member of the Mothma family from the Core Worlds planet Chandrila. By the year 0 ABY, a few months after the Battle of Yavin, Far Mothma was dead and buried on the family's grounds in the Chandrilan prairies.

Finna Mothma was a member of the Mothma family from the Core Worlds planet Chandrila. By the year 0 ABY, a few months after the Battle of Yavin, Finna Mothma was dead and buried on the family's grounds in the Chandrilan prairies.

Snet Groot was a male human arms dealer who sold arms to the Separatists during the Clone Wars. Because of that, Senator Padmé Amidala of the Galactic Republic believed that the arms dealer was likely to hire a bounty hunter to disrupt her scheduled meeting with Arthurian dele…
Selder Psalm was a human that had a base on the planet Coruscant with known ties with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
Dobretz was a pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Dobretz was killed during a battle between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire.
Vermeil was an Imperial TIE/rp Reaper attack lander pilot during the Galactic Civil War who held the rank of major. At some point, Vermeil performed a maneuver near the Scarif Shield Gate.
Ebenn Q3 Baobab was a human author and linguist who wrote the Easy Ubese Phrase Book. Baobab served as a dignitary for the Royal House of Naboo.
Tiggs Kaiga was a female Faust who served as the flight surgeon for Cobalt Squadron on D'Qar. She was tall and skinny and known to not have a sense of humor.
Etta was the mother of Hue Tico, who in turn was the father of Paige and Rose Tico.
Traneel was a male Human who served as a commander in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
This unidentified captain was a male Human who served as a captain in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Derrida was a Ketton assassin active during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
A male individual was the brother of the Twi'lek Hera Syndulla. He died by 19 BBY, while he was still young. A design on the Syndulla family Kalikori was included to memorialize him.
Storm was the father of Hue Tico, who in turn was the father of Paige and Rose Tico.
Fyzen Gor was a Pau'an male gangster who was the creator of the Phylanx Redux Transmitter. He was a medical student at Prasteen Braak, the most esteemed med school in Pau City on the planet Utapau.
Mayvlin Trillick was a female human bounty hunter and librarian who crossed paths with the Wookiee Chewbacca and rebel spy droid K-2SO.
A female scout served under Caluan Ematt in the Rebel Alliance's Shrikes recon unit during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to that, the scout had been a member of Saw Gerrera's Partisans.
Dume was a mysterious and abnormally large male Loth-wolf who shared the birth name of Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus—Dume.

LS-261 was the designation of a human male stormtrooper who was stationed in the Imperial Complex on Lothal during the era of the Galactic Empire. He and another stormtrooper were left to guard a drugged Hera Syndulla after she had been interrogated by Governor Arihnda Pryce.
This unidentified Weequay pirate was the captain of a band of Weequay pirates aboard a Corona-class armed frigate.
Glahst Ombra was a Defel mercenary who was hired by the Son-tuul Pride criminal syndicate to undertake a mission to recover the memories of the syndicates leader, 0-0-0, around 1 ABY.

Ovin was a male Human who resided in a Corellian settlement on a planet of the Outer Rim Territories. After witnessing the crash of the Millennium Falcon in the settlement, he commented that its pilot was crazy and could have killed somebody.

The father of Jenna was a male Human. Jenna's father was the sheriff of a Corellian settlement on a planet of the Outer Rim Territories. He was killed by one of the thugs of Hutt crime lord Bo-Dum, leaving the settlers without a lawman to protect them.

Wandara Dekort was the Minister of Justice of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances in 45 ABY. Sullustan Senator Luewet Wuul believed Dekort might have been bribed, blackmailed, or threatened by the Columi brothers Marvid and Craitheus Qreph into overlooking their criminal…

Mishru was a male soldier who lived on the Outer Rim planet Crucival. During the Imperial Era, they were recruited by the human soldier Hazram Namir to join his band. In 1 BBY, the band was invited by the Galactic Empire to help defend Crucival's transmitter tower.

Tar was a male soldier who lived on the Outer Rim planet Crucival during the Imperial Era. They joined a band of soldiers led by the human Hazram Namir. In 1 BBY, the band was recruited by the Galactic Empire to help defend Crucival's transmitter tower from Rebel Alliance forces.
Myan was a diminutive Sullustan male who worked in the Inyusu Tor mineral processing facility on the planet Sullust. He and a number of other workers from the facility were patrons of a cantina.

Rekya was a female inspector on the planet Nakadia. They were the chief inspector of the team of Nakadians who searched New Republic Senator Tolwar Wartol's ship for restricted agricultural products when it was revealed that Chancellor Mon Mothma had smuggled a pta fruit aboar…

LS-515 was a human female scout trooper that served the Galactic Empire. While patrolling an Imperial excavation site centered around the Lothal Jedi Temple, LS-515 and her speeder wing-mate LS-412 were ambushed by the Spectres rebel group.

LS-412 was a human male scout trooper that served in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire. In 1 BBY, he and his comrade LS-515 were knocked out by the rebel Garazeb Orrelios while patrolling the perimeters of the Lothal Jedi Temple.
Veris Hydan was a human male who served the Galactic Emperor Palpatine as an adviser. He also served as the minister of the Ministry for Antiquity.
An individual genetically altered by the Galactic Empire to look like a Twi'lek served as a spy during the Galactic Civil War.
Morai was a female convor with spiritual ties to the Daughter, a Force wielder from Mortis. She appeared in various depictions of the Force wielders alongside the Daughter.

Annea Lavic was a former medical student at the Rhinnal State Medical Academy who fled to the Outer Rim Territories after she accidentally killed the son of a Imperial Governor's chief aide during a medical procedure.
The White Loth-wolf was a Force-sensitive white Loth-wolf from the planet Lothal. He led a pack of Loth-wolves and was able to travel through time and space.
Shin was a male Duros who served as a major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Joon Strephi was a human who served as an officer in the Imperial Officer Corps in the early days of the Galactic Empire.
Corin Ferro was a human male who served as an officer in the Imperial Officer Corps in the early days of the Galactic Empire.
Zorta Bingan was a human male who served as an officer in the Imperial Officer Corps in the early days of the Galactic Empire.
Tomas Azoras was a human male who served as an officer in the Imperial Officer Corps in the early days of the Galactic Empire.
Dors Urtya was a Mon Calamari who served as Grand Admiral of the Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet, Regent of Mon Cala, Dual Protector of the Two People, and Warden of the King in exile.

Jer Croteau was an individual who served the Galactic Empire with access codes to Imperial systems at Level 1A1, which gave Croteau access to the highest levels of the Imperial Executive Building on Coruscant.
Aya-Glon was a twelve-year old Lew'elan who befriended Luke Skywalker when he came to her homeworld to study her people's knowledge of the Force. She owned a wind-truster named Deek-Deek.
Tigo-Lee was the name given to a female wind-truster who was the personal mount of Kailla-Glon-Vow, a Lew'elan elder.

aroraDeek-Deek was the name given to a three-year-old wind-truster who was the personal mount of the Lew'elan Aya-Glon. Deek-Deek was killed when a bolt of lightning struck her while she and her owner flew through a storm.
Coni-Co was the name given to a young wind-truster who was the personal mount of the Lew'elan Tonn-Glon. Luke Skywalker rode the wind-truster while attempting to circumvent the globe of Lew'el.
Tonn-Glon was a twelve-year old Lew'elan who was the twin brother of Aya-Glon.
Kailla-Glon-Vow was a Lew'elan elder who was the grandmother of Aya-Glon.

Zhios was an Imperial Navy Trooper serving aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Herald. During Captain Tabor Seitaron's time on the ship, he gained respect for Zhios and another Navy trooper called Cantompa.

A radio officer served the Galactic Empire on the planet Metalorn during the year 0 ABY. Alongside Governor Corwyth, the radio officer oversaw the hunt for Princess Leia Organa when she infiltrated the planet in the name of the Rebel Alliance.

This male Sullustan was the father of Surat and Rutar Nuat. He was described by Surat as being a soft and pliable man. After he found out that Surat had killed his mother, Surat's father attempted to hit Surat. Surat in response cut his throat with kitchen cutlery.
Gilad Pellaeon was a human male from the planet Corellia who served in the Republic Navy and later as a captain in the Imperial Navy.

Jacen Syndulla was a Force-sensitive male human-Twi'lek hybrid who was born during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was the son of General Hera Syndulla and the late Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus, and the grandson of Twi'lek revolutionary leader Cham Syndulla.
Goneril was a First Order Navy adjutant who served under Captain Moden Canady aboard the Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought Fulminatrix during the First Order-Resistance War.

926 was a human stormtrooper who served the First Order during its war with the Resistance. During his time aboard the Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy, 926 encountered Finn—an ex-stormtrooper who once served with 926 in Batch Eight.

A female Lanai was the mother of Alcida-Auka, the matron of the Caretakers on the planet Ahch-To. At some point before the Battle of Crait, this Lanai had served as the matron of the Caretakers and eventually passed on the title and its responsibilities to Auka.

Tunga Arpagion was a male Clawdite shape-shifter agent who was known to be a professional actor and impersonator. He was recruited by the Alliance to Restore the Republic for a mission they undertook on Mon Cala.

Albus Marinith was an Imperial officer who served as Flag Captain of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Chimaera, the flagship of Grand Admiral Thrawn. An old and reliable Imperial Navy officer, Marinith was handpicked by Thrawn himself, becoming a close colleague.

Zizi Tlo was a Candovantan Resistance ace pilot. In 34 ABY after war broke out between the Resistance and the First Order, Tlo flew an RZ-2 A-wing interceptor in the Battle of D'Qar. She was killed over D'Qar when her starfighter was blown to pieces by First Order TIE fighters.

Eskil Abon Santhe was the Imperial governor of the Outer Rim planet of Garel. Santhe was widely known to accept bribes from several criminal organizations, including the Black Sun and the Broken Horn Syndicate, allowing them to operate on Garel with impunity.

A Jedi scout, whose name was lost to history, used Force-assisted hyperspace navigation to discover the remote planet Ilum thousands of years before the Battle of Yavin. The scout reported Ilum as a great resonance, but did not find any sentient life or ruins on the planet.
Zarda was a human male who served in the Imperial Navy as a captain during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Ferren Barr was an Iktotchi male fallen Jedi who sought to avenge the Jedi Order by overthrowing the Sith-ruled Galactic Empire.

The Tenth Brother, formerly known as Prosset Dibs, was a Force-sensitive Miraluka male member of the Inquisitorius during the early reign of the Galactic Empire. Prior to the rise of Emperor Palpatine, Dibs held the rank of Jedi Master during his time in the Jedi Order.

Rantu was a human who served as a major in the Galactic Empire during the early stages of its reign. Rantu, along with Colonel Bergon and Commander Jordo, were assigned to Governor Wilhuff Tarkin to discourage growing tensions with Mon Cala.

Jordo was a human male commander in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau. Sometime after the rise of the Empire, Jordo was the Imperial Security Bureau officer responsible for the Outer Rim world of Mon Cala, and when tensions between the Mon Calamari monarchy and th…
Telvar was a human who represented the Galactic Empire as ambassador to Mon Cala during the early years of Emperor Sheev Palpatine's reign as part of the Imperial Diplomatic Corps.

Bergon was a human who served as a colonel in the Galactic Empire during the early stages of its reign. In 18 BBY, Bergon, along with Imperial Security Bureau Commander Jordo and Major Rantu, assisted Governor Wilhuff Tarkin in military operations on Mon Cala.

Yago was a male veteran of the Imperial Starfleet. In 34 ABY, he was an officer holding the rank of captain in the First Order on board Supreme Leader Snoke's Mega-class Star Dreadnought, the Supremacy.

Jerserra was a Dathomirian female who was taken from Dathomir and trained by an Inquisitor of the Galactic Empire. She wielded a red double-bladed spinning lightsaber. She eventually killed her master and became a mercenary in search of more power.

Mosep Binneed was a Nimbanel male who worked as an accountant for various criminals throughout his life. During the Galactic Civil War, he spent time in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley in the year 1 BBY.

Odar Firn was a male who worked as an executive in Sienar Fleet Systems, having joined the company during the Clone Wars after Sienar had secured a contract for the manufacture of starfighters for the Galactic Republic.
Suhlarla Tug was a female Duros that captained the freighter Verdant Dawn throughout the Corellian Trade Spine, and made constant transport runs between the Core Worlds and the Outer Rim Territories.

Dicsato Smi was a male who operated a market in the Tann Province on Ryloth during the Clone Wars and then during the reign of the Galactic Empire. During the Clone Wars, Smi struggled to keep his corner market stocked and customers satisfied.

Zanyo Arak was an individual who was assigned by Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo to pilot a starfighter for the Resistance during the evacuation of their base on D'Qar. During the early part of the battle, Arak led a starfighter flight to protect Cobalt Squadron's bombers.
Haddeen Bissel was a male individual who served as a technician and crew chief for the Resistance's Starfortress unit.

A Chadra-Fan male youngling was chased away by an Aleena vendor sometime between 5 BBY and 1 BBY on the planet Ord Mantell. The child later stole the human Jyn Erso's kyber pendant. After fleeing from Erso across rooftops, the child was eventually caught by Erso.
This individual served as the flight engineer of the Resistance bomber Cobalt Hammer during the evacuation of D'Qar.
Onassi was a Human male officer of the Alliance Special Forces. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, he held the rank of colonel and fought during the liberation of the prison planet Ord Vaug.

Endrodanar Tiopuld Shaamador Vandelhelm XXIV, commonly known as Endro, and his older sister Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII were the Venerated Ones of Vandelhelm during the Galactic Civil War.
This individual was a female Aleena merchant living on the planet Ord Mantell during the Imperial Era.

The white Loth-cat acted as a guide to Jedi Padawan Ezra Bridger when he returned to his homeworld of Lothal on three occasions. On the first occasion, Ezra was seeking a prisoner named Ryder Azadi who knew his parents Ephraim and Mira Bridger.

Tan Hubi was a male human who was the Imperial Moff of the Calamari sector. In order to free King Lee-Char from imprisonment, Leia Organa and her team planned to kidnap Hubi so they could use his bio-signature to access the King's prison on Strokill Prime.

Cuvran was a male Quarren explosives expert who lost his family during the occupation of his planet Dac by the Galactic Empire. In 1 BBY, Cuvran assisted Rebel Alliance Captain Juno Eclipse during her mission to undermine the Empire on Dac.
Siric was a Quarren native of his planet Dac, which was occupied by the Galactic Empire during the early Galactic Civil War.
Miré was a human female handmaiden from Naboo who served Queen Padmé Amidala. She wore green velvet robes.
The human Liana Merian served as an aide in the delegation representing the planet Alderaan in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Naboo Crisis in 32 BBY.
The father of Carns Capra was one of the earliest leaders of the Alliance. He was killed on the planet Mantooine.

Vennie was a female individual who during the Atterra campaign served as the pilot of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 Crimson Cutter. On occasion Vennie flew in an a-wing starfighter as an escort for the bombers.
Kaiden Scorbo was an individual who was assigned by Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo to pilot a starfighter for the Resistance during the evacuation of their base on D'Qar.
Cat was a Nefrian male who served as the flight engineer of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber Cobalt Treasure during the Atterra campaign.

Sa'Kalla was a young Drabatan singer who spoke out against the Galactic Empire's tyranny by 1 BBY. In retaliation, the Empire blockaded her home planet of Pipada and held her in captivity, where she was tortured. A movement was organized in her name that opposed the Empire.
This officer was a human male in the Galactic Empire's Officer Corps was involved in a conspiracy against Darth Vader in the early reign of the Empire.

Rexa Go was a human female mercenary equipped with a AJ^3 cyborg construct who served the crime lord 0-0-0 after he took over control of the Son-tuul Pride. She accompanied doctor Chelli Aphra to attack an Imperial settlement on Someilk, which they incinerated.
Bythen Forral was a male officer who served as a captain in the navy of the Galactic Republic aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Vensenor during the Clone Wars and was a starfighter ace.

Leeya was an empress who allied her dominion, the Regency Worlds, with the Galactic Empire. Due to the alliance, the Empire granted moderate taxation and permitted the Regency Worlds a degree of sovereignty.

Yewl was a human commander who was in command of Hivebase-1, an Imperial Tarkin Initiative research and development space station. He led Imperial forces when Hivebase-1 was infiltrated by the Son-tuul Pride, who sought to recover the memories of 0-0-0.

Bini was an alien officer in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War who served as a senior crewmember aboard the Lucrehulk Prime, a rebel flight school, under the command of General Hera Syndulla.

Punfor was a human who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire around 1 ABY. They were stationed at an Imperial settlement on Someilk in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories and was killed when the settlement was destroyed by a group of mercenaries.
A human male served as a major and commanded a brigade in the First Order during their war against the Resistance.

Thespus-V was a female who died at some point before the mutiny on Mon Cala. After her death, the Clawdite Tunga Arpagion understudied her for a week and took on her role for a week before anyone noticed that he had done so.

An Ottegan was a senator of the New Republic's Galactic Senate in 5 ABY. During Liberation Day, a day of celebration held on the planet Chandrila to mark the liberation of rebel prisoners from Ashmead's Lock on Kashyyyk, the senator was in a hall of the Old Gather-House, a his…

A Sith witch led Sith forces during the Great Scourge of Malachor, a battle fought between the Jedi Order and the Sith Empire between around 5000 BBY and 1032 BBY, millennia before the Cold War, a period of risen tensions between the First Order and the New Republic after the …
A clone sergeant served in the 501st Legion during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist Alliance.
Argus "Six Eyes" Panox was a six-eyed Azumel male who lived in the galaxy during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He was present during Lando Calrissian and Han Solo's first sabacc game.
Gola Chall was a female deep-cover resistance recruiting agent that served as a proctor at the Galactic Empire's Vensenor Flight Academy located onboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Vensenor.

A young male cadet was enrolled at the Galactic Empire's Vensenor Flight Academy and caught the attention of Commandant Bythen Forral and Proctor Gola Chall after demonstrating the characteristics of a famed starfighter ace pilot, as well as being popular among cadets at the I…
Thermoculus Krisintvolt Scissorpunch, also known simply as Therm Scissorpunch was a male Nephran from the planet Nepotis who lived in the galaxy for more than three centuries.
Enfys Nest was a human woman who led the Cloud-Riders, a band of rebel pirates who fought the crime syndicate Crimson Dawn and supported the Rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
A Weequay was a pirate captain during the reign of the Galactic Empire that discovered the Gigorans after many surveys of the planet Gigor by the Galactic Republic found it to be uninhabited.

Pol Ipol was a human male who was a detective for Canto Bight's Police Department. Unlike many police officers from the Department, Ipol was an honest detective, which led him to earn a reputation as a sucker.

Moloch was a male Grindalid who lived in the galaxy during the Imperial Era. As a member of the Corellia-based White Worms gang, he made sure none of Lady Proxima's scrumrats worked against the Grindalid matriarch.

A human male served as a captain in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed aboard an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer when the astromech droid R2-D2 boarded the ship to rescue his friend, the protocol droid C-3PO who was being held captive aboard t…

Karjj was a Crocin spacer active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Facing financial and marital troubles alike, he was also an enthusiastic player of the sabacc game, which he enjoyed despite frequently losing money in it.
Roz was a female Flurrg who lived on Takodana.
Lazslo was a human who served as a head mechanic in the Resistance.
PD-528 was a human male who served as an Imperial stormtrooper on the Death Star. He owed thirty-five credits to fellow stormtrooper TD-110.

Jaxxon T. Tumperakki, nicknamed Jax, was a male Lepi smuggler and captain of the Rabbit's Foot. He was an acquaintance of Han Solo, a fellow smuggler turned hero of the Rebel Alliance, whom he regarded as an inferior pilot.
SB-3709, nicknamed "Patch," was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.

A Senate Commando was the pilot of Palpatine's executive shuttle during the Zillo Beast incident. During the incident, the involved Zillo Beast caught the H-2 executive shuttle, and Anakin Skywalker used his lightsaber to cut it in half, causing all aboard the shuttle to fall …

Viron Ghartoth was a male Devaronian explorer who charted fresh hyperlanes in the spinward extremes of the Outer Rim. Ghartoth was also credited with the discovery of the Paralyngian dire slug, a bloated gastropod.
A male Twi'lek child was on Onderon during 20 BBY and was in the Malgan Market with his mother when he was intrigued by a fruit.

Rio Durant was a four-armed Ardennian pilot who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Durant carried out dangerous missions alongside the scoundrel Tobias Beckett for years and was good-natured and up for any challenge.
Agarne was a male soldier who served as a sergeant in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was a member of the New Republic's Third Recon Group and took part in the Battle of Jakku.

A governor served the Galactic Empire on the Outer Rim planet Pipada. By 1 BBY, a movement was formed for the Drabatan singer Sa'Kalla, who was captured and tortured by the Empire for protesting its rule.

Jerdon Bly was a human male who worked as an arms dealer during the Cold War between the Resistance and the First Order. Like many, he sold to both sides of the war, but unlike others was very cavalier and open about it.

A human male worked as a guard onboard the Undisputed Victor, a yacht owned by Baron Yasto Attsmun. In 34 ABY, the guard was on duty on the yacht while the baron hosted a party onboard it on the planet Cantonica.
Vestry was a female Quermian who worked as a pit boss at the Canto Casino. She was considered tall for her species.
Kruno was a male alien belonging to a reptilian species. He died in an explosion on Ammon IV.

Verla, a Force-sensitive human female, was an acolyte of the fallen Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr during the early reign of the Galactic Empire. Unlike Barr's other disciples, Verla's connection to the Force made her a candidate for Jedi training.
Daren was a human male who during the Clone Wars was rescued from two B2-series super battle droids by the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker.

Rebb was a human who lived during the Imperial Era. Witnessing the Empire's forces firsthand, Rebb and their partner Stell decided to resist its rule in the hope of a better life and joined the disciples of the Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr.
Kaasha Bateen was a Rutian Twi'lek female master strategist in the Free Ryloth Movement who was good with a blaster.

Florx Biggles was a male Ugnaught mechanic that loved droids. After Lando Calrissian was attacked by his own protocol droid DRX-7, Calrissian recruited Biggles to travel with him and Kaasha Bateen onboard the Lady Luck to find the Phylanx Redux Transmitter.

Peekpa was an Ewok female hacker for the New Republic, tech genius, and a superfan of the Wookiee Chewbacca after he saved the life of her sister during the Battle of Endor. She frequently operated a datapad.

Taka Jamoreesa was a non-binary Alderaanian human pilot and aspiring scoundrel. About two years after the Battle of Jakku, Jamoreesa was in a crew with Han Solo and Lando Calrissian trying to thwart Fyzen Gor's plot to take over the galaxy using the Phylanx Redux Transmitter.

The gran of Lauren Mel Coelho was a human female. After her parents, Remba and Kelven were killed by the Malandro syndicate leader Annaz, Lauren and her brother Julien lived with their gran for a few years until she died of a fever.

A Duros male was the original owner of the Serendipity. During Han Solo's Cyrkon Extraction, Delia Leighton who now owned the ship, noted that when she worked as a barmaid at a cantina on Lothal, the Duro drank by himself and often told her stories when things in the cantina w…
Primco Farg was a human bounty hunter whom Lando Calrissian was acquainted with, and didn't care much for, at some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Faztoon was an Ithorian who was an old friend of Lando Calrissian. Calrissian encountered Faztoon on Weigh Station Karambola, and called out to the Ithorian, who replied with a wave.
Prita Sven was a female, who at one point was a regional administrator in the Galactic Empire, later becoming Vice Grand Administrator of stormtrooper recruitment.

Frapsen was a male Fromprath musician who played a batanga. Whilst at the castle of Maz Kanata on Takodana around 3 BBY, he played a song about missing Dathomir. Shortly after, he took down a Trandoshan bounty hunter outside of the castle.

A human male prisoner was incarcerated on the planet Wobani in 1 BBY. While being transported on a worker's convoy, the prisoner's transport came under attack by a Rebel Alliance strike team, who sought to liberate another prisoner named Jyn Erso.

A member of the Galactic Empire's force on the planet Metalorn, an Imperial officer served under Governor Corwyth's rule. During the year 0 ABY, the officer investigated a condition red at Post 994-203.
In 18 BBY, a human lieutenant of the Galactic Empire served aboard the Sovereign, and reported to Governor Wilhuff Tarkin.
A male Neimoidian guard was stationed aboard a Lucrehulk-class Battleship in the Blockade of Pantora. He was responsible for guarding a detention block aboard the vessel.

Will Scotian was a human male who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a pilot during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. He survived the Battle of Hoth and continued flying after being recruited into Red Squadron by Wedge Antilles and Wes Janson.

Pentix Graphyt, also known as Special Operative 1312, was a bounty hunter allied with the Galactic Empire during the early years of the New Republic. A large man, he wore a suit of armor including a mirrored helmet that hid his identity.
Vermilion was a fathier that participated in fathier racing at the Canto Casino and Racetrack on the casino planet Cantonica.

A Sullustan male served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a technician during the Galactic Civil War. The technician was tasked with extracting a code from an ID10 seeker droid utilized by Commander Iden Versio of the Galactic Empire's Inferno Squad.
A Krozurbian merchant purchased a herd of savorium-fed thookahs from Ithorian scientist Zorneth and subsequently supplied them to the Krozurbian War Council, which ended the Krozurbian war.

x: A Human male individual was a member of Grey Squadron, a New Republic military unit led by the Force-sensitive clone X2. At some point between the years 4 ABY and 19 ABY, the Human accompanied X2 and the rest of Grey Squadron on a mission to the planet Dathomir.

t: Unidentified Mon Calamari member of Grey Squadron

Beena was a young female Twi'lek whom Lando Calrissian entertained in Cloud City, along with an entire diplomatic brigade of young Twi'leks.
Sullub Soonin was the male Sullustan co-pilot of the Skyjumper under the command of Captain Drev Jalok.
Zil was a female Sarkan and the queen of Sarka at the time of the Galactic Civil War. She had gray-colored skin and a bulky frame yet but a small head, which sported blue eyes.

Roron Corobb was an Ithorian Jedi Master who, alongside the Togruta Jedi Master Shaak Ti and a clone task force, helped to protect Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine from Separatist General Grievous when Grievous stormed Galactic City in an attempt to kidnap Palpatine during t…
A female Ewok was the sister of the slicer Peekpa. During the Battle of Endor, the Wookiee Chewbacca saved the life of Peekpa's sister, causing Peekpa to become attached to the Wookiee.

A human male rebel trooper was a veteran of the Battle of Hoth, in which he lost one of his legs. Two years after the Battle of Jakku, the trooper was present on the Grand Promenade of the Rebellion in Hanna City on Chandrila and asked Lando Calrissian and Kaasha Bateen if the…

Amaiza "Maiz" Foxtrain was a human who worked as a pirate and a smuggler during the Galactic Civil War. She was an associate and ex-girlfriend of Jaxxon, who regarded her as a "class act" and sought to impress her, until she double-crossed him.

Moggee was a member of a sentient species who was part of the criminal trio known as the Gatto Gang alongside Sylvestarr and Ziggee. During the Imperial Era, the trio owed money to Duke Blazor of Black Sun and was subsequently hunted by the bounty hunter assassin droid IG-88.
Ziggee was a member of an unknown species that was part of the Gatto Gang. Later this individual was captured along with the rest of the gang by the assassin droid IG-88.
Sylvestarr was a member of an unknown species that was part of the Gatto Gang. Later this individual was captured along with the rest of the gang by the assassin droid IG-88.

An individual was an agent of the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn during the Imperial Era. Around 3 BBY, an auction for a device known as the Phylanx Redux Transmitter was held by the Wandering Star criminal syndicate in the city Canto Bight on the Outer Rim planet Cantonica, …
Lallani was a silky-voiced Quarren crime lady who was a rival of Jabba the Hutt. She employed a gang of Mandalorian mercenaries. She had a hand in slavery operations.

Krull was a male individual who served as a captain in the New Republic Defense Fleet in 7 ABY. He was stationed aboard the flagship Tribulan Vort in a blockade of the sector where Substation Grimdock was located when a crew including Lando Calrissian and Han Solo were leaving…

Seven-Seven Dirgeos, formerly known as Ruas Fastent, was a male human who served as an admiral in the Galactic Empire prior to the Battle of Yavin. A few years before the battle, he was given an honorary discharge and was shoved into an Imperial asylum on Grava.

A clone trooper serving as one of the Galactic Empire’s first stormtroopers was stationed aboard the Jedi space station Brighthome in 19 BBY. The soldier led several other clone troopers against a perceived Jedi, who was in reality Sith apprentice Darth Vader.

Viz Moshara was a Cosian pirate who was captain of the Radium Destrobar. He and his fellow pirates attempted to protect Substation Grimdock from the New Republic army. He was killed when his ship crashed with another pirate ship under the command of Fyzen Gor.
Sometime before 7 ABY, a famed Zabrak smuggler exported Lee romay from the planet Mon Cala. Eventually the Lee romay were illegally sneaked onto Chandrila.

Bragthap was a bartender who worked at the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata. Around 3 BBY, he put a bubbly concoction in front of Kanata as she sat next to the smuggler Han Solo when he visited the castle as he waited for Sana Starros to show up with the cargo she needed his he…
A Maerdocian Senator was a male member of the New Republic Senate during the Caamas Document Crisis.

Brantis Mo Fresk was a pilot who lived during the New Republic Era and owned a ship known as the Vorantis. In 7 ABY, he participated in the Karee Blockade Clutch, where he beat the starship Brightfox.

An unaffiliated Talz smuggler lived during the Imperial Era. When an auction for a device known as the Phylanx Redux Transmitter was held by the Wandering Star criminal syndicate in the city Canto Bight on the Outer Rim planet Cantonica around 3 BBY, the smuggler attended and …

Quay Tolsite was a male Pyke capo who administered the Pyke Syndicate's operations on Kessel. He was a ruthless individual who enslaved several sentient beings, including Wookiees, to work as miners at the spice mines of Kessel in order to acquire spice for the Pykes.
Rebolt was a young human male criminal who worked for the notorious White Worms gang. He was part of the scrumrat portion of the gang and at one point was considered for the role of Head Boy.

Mozeen Parapa was a male Frizznoth crime lord who was leader of the Parapa Cartel. Around 3 BBY, he was kidnapped and smuggled aboard the Millennium Falcon in a package by Sana Starros so she could use his tech-lords, which Starros claimed were second-to-none, to learn where t…

A female served as a waitress at Freerago's Satellite Diner and Motel in the Core Worlds around 3 BBY.
Arty-Ba was an alien who worked at the Dex Acquisitions Depot on Meor Ain.
Kazuda Xiono, nicknamed "Kaz," was a human male military pilot and later Resistance spy who served in the years following the conclusion of the Galactic Civil War.
A Twi'lek male child was present in the Coruscant Underworld with his mother in 19 BBY.

PB-106 was a human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire who served aboard the first Death Star. He relieved fellow soldier TD-110 of his rifle and escorted the trooper to command with the rest of his unit, as ordered by a Moff.

MG-26 was a loyal human male stormtrooper who served alongside TD-110. He was deployed on the planet Lothal, with his unit backing TD-110's. MG-26 also served aboard the first Death Star, where he met TD-110 on his way to Detention Block AA-23.
Tuuma was a male Hutt who served as the captain of the Wayward Current.
Noira was a Ubese female pirate who eventually became the third Pirate Queen of the Veiled Sorority. During the Galactic Civil War, she decided to target only one organization: the Zann Consortium.
Feroph was an Imperial TIE/rp Reaper attack lander pilot during the Galactic Civil War who held the rank of captain.
"Vizier" was the callsign for an Imperial TIE/rp Reaper attack lander pilot during the Galactic Civil War. At some point, Vizier proceeded to do a flight maneuver while flanked with two TIE Strikers.

Purpruff was a Gigoran who served as a corporal in the Vapetailers unit of the Rebel Alliance Special Forces. During the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire, she traveled to the planet Hoth while scouting for a new location for the Alliance's headquarters.

A female human was the sister of HoloNet News reporter Calliope Drouth. At some point before Drouth attended the Imperial Ball in the Imperial Palace on Coruscant, she wore an ivory dress to her sister's wedding.

Greesto Ftrak was a Pau'an male who was a student at Prasteen Braak and a classmate and friend of Fyzen Gor. He and Fyzen were kidnapped by a group of Pau'ans he thought were members of the Wandering Star crime organization.

Tan Yuster was a human who was the Padawan learner of the Zabrak Jedi Master Agen Kolar. The two were among the Jedi assault team that accompanied Mace Windu on the mission to Geonosis that started the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.
Rees Haslip was the founder of RH Mining Corporation on the planet Garos IV. Haslip's daughter, Keriin, took over control of the company.
Rekias Nodo was a reptilian male criminal and mechanic who ran a shipyard on a jungle planet, stripping down stolen starships for parts.
Essith was a male Human General of the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War.
Nexia Kirill was a female Human daughter of Harridax Kirill, a former pirate known as "the Voidwolf" who became the Grand Admiral of the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Distant Star was a female fathier that mated with the male fathier Hydian Dreams, resulting in the birth of the fathier Kessel Runner around 31 ABY. By 34 ABY, Kessel Runner competed in a fathier race in the city Canto Bight on the casino planet Cantonica.
Trenar Stillijan was the husband of Rees Haslip and father of Keriin. The adventurous type, he left Garos IV and joined the army. Stillijan was killed on a battlefield far from his homeworld.

Vindis was a female Pureblood Sith of the reconstituted Sith Empire living during the Galactic War, who was the apprentice of Darth Tormen. She eventually became a Sith Lord by the time of the war against Zakuul.

Malea Janarus was a female Human living during the Cold War. She was the wife of Dorian Janarus, who served as a Senator of Coruscant and later as the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic until 3640 BBY.
Palabee was a female individual who was the sister of Nipaltoo. At some point, Palabee was taken from her home by members of the Jedi Order to become a Jedi and to have a new and better life.

Beris Ford was a minor gangster who was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. By 9 BBY, he was captured by the bounty hunting duo Zuckuss and 4-LOM, and was kept prisoner aboard their starship, the Mist Hunter, for weeks.
Chela Nayss was a female Nautolan living during the Eternal Empire conquest.

Zera was a female Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. She served in ranks of the Knights of Zakuul and was a partner of the Knight-Captain Senya Tirall, who had saved Zera's life countless time over the years.
Starfall Flanders was a pirate and member of the Phosphura Belt Pirates. He was involved in an oath rigora with another pirate.

Auromae Iselo was a male Melbu bounty hunter. Possessing a strong sense of justice, his frustration with the number of political targets he was assigned by the Galactic Empire inspired him to pursue and punish violent criminals, joining Enfys Nest's Cloud-Riders gang as a vigi…
This female individual was the mother of and Nipaltoo and Palabee. At some point before Order 66, Palabee was taken by members of the Jedi Order.
Alfons Allsing was an individual who, around the time of the Mid Rim Retreat, served as a minister in the Galactic Empire's civil government.
Ander Rendrake was an individual who served as a lieutenant in the military of the Galactic Empire around the time of the Mid Rim Retreat.
Nipaltoo was an individual who served fallen Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr as one of his six acolytes. As a child, their sister Palabee was taken in by the Jedi Order.
Gerba was a male Hutt. One of his employee, Viron Ghartoth, presented him with Paralyngian dire slug in fruit sauce.

G'hhurrlha was a male Wookiee Big-game hunter. He owned an "Explorer" Scout Ship and customized the hull with skulls, bones and chitin shells. The main room was decorated with Krayt dragon, acklay, lylek, rancor and swamp wampa trophies.

Janese was a female pilot during the Galactic Civil War. She once teamed up with the Duros archaeologist Levat and the Chiss big-game hunter Kres'keth'errylu to explore a temple on the planet Rhen Var.

Kres'keth'errylu, nicknamed Keth, was a male Chiss big-game hunter during the Galactic Civil War. He once teamed up with the Duros archaeologist Levat and the pilot Janese to explore a temple on the planet Rhen Var.
Levat was a male Duros archaeologist during the Galactic Civil War. He once teamed up with the Chiss big-game hunter Kres'keth'errylu and the pilot Janese to explore a temple on the planet Rhen Var.

Lemnos, also known as Lem, was a mechanic who was an acquaintance of Captain Hera Syndulla of the Spectres. During the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire, Lemnos worked as a mechanic at the Fekunda Outpost under Commander Zhou and his stormtrooper squad.
Torani Kulda of the Virulli Clan was a female Rodian bounty hunter and assassin who operated during the years of the Galactic Empire.
Burl was a human worker at the Fekunda Outpost under Commander Zhou and his stormtrooper squad. He was also a contact for the early rebellion.

Kylo Batta was a Human male famed for their career as a big-game hunter. While residing on the planet Chandrila, Batta and a noblewoman had a son named Kaori, who grew up during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Ractivelle was an individual who served as a corporal in Stardust unit, a Rebel Alliance Special Forces unit.
Mersh Pellus was a male human scientist who served as a "boffin" aboard the Resistance starship Ninka, under Admiral Amilyn Holdo, during the war against the First Order.

Bonadan Star was a fathier who raced at the Canto Casino and Racetrack on Cantonica, a planet in the Outer Rim, in 34 ABY. During that year, they were owned by Pakkerd Racing and ridden by the jockey Turcotte Bel Mont.
Zhou was a human commander who served the Galactic Empire at the Fekunda Outpost. He led the effort to acquire the outpost's resources for Imperial supply lines.

Lorcu Malshae was a male individual smuggler and captain of the light freighter Moonglow. After losing a lot of money on a deal with Sithless Leethe, Malshae sought to recoup his investment by selling the location of Port Haven to Boba Fett.
Par'tha was the Twi'lek co-pilot of the light freighter Moonglow. She was a trusted companion of the starship's captain, the smuggler Lorcu Malshae.

Brack was the manager of several warehouses located in the southeast section of Gelgelar Free Port. Brack bought vohis mold from the local farmers and sold it to starship captains who then transported it to food companies like Nebula Consumables and Falvin Foods.
Honarius Hanast was the leader of a group of pilgrims from the Fellowship of Kooroo. They contracted a group of free-traders to transport them to the planet Gelgelar.

Darth Atrius was a male Sith Lord who lived during the time the Sith were plentiful and powerful. He wielded two crossguard lightsabers. At some point after the Battle of Yavin, the smuggler Sana Starros recovered his pair of crossguard lightsabers.

Dorius Drevin was a bounty hunter who accepted a bounty on the Sullustan Loro Ecls. Posing as a pilgrim of the Fellowship of Kooroo, Drevin joined a group lead by Honarius Hanast who hired a group of free-traders to take them to Gelgelar Free Port.

Gudren Lagarian was a pilgrim of the Fellowship of Kooroo. He was part of the group led by Honarius Hanast who hired a group of free-traders to transport them to Gelgelar Free Port. During the trip, Lagarian went missing. His body was found crammed into a maintenance shaft.
Varrik was a grizzled Human mechanic who worked for Slerog Fenn at Gelgelar Free Port's Fenn's Landing .
Vee was a Pamarthen pilot who competed in the Gauntlet on Corellia. She dropped out during the middle of the race.
Brophys was a notorious spice merchant and slaver who was said to be responsible for the destruction of Kala'din on the planet Ryloth.
Shan'dira was a young Twi'lek woman from the Dira Clan. She attempted to seek passage off-world with a group of spacers who were visiting Kala'uun.
Thoha'lynda was a Twi'lek merchant. He created leather goods from the hides of rycrits and sold them in the bazaar in Kala'uun.
Choi'olan was a member of the wealthy Olan Clan on Ryloth. Choi'olan offered to pay 25,000 credits for a sheet of transparisteel measuring four meters high, six meters long, and one meter thick.
Kroh'dalla was a Twi'lek who lived in Kala'din. Second supervisor to the Ryll Master, Kroh'dalla became greedy and sold the location of the ryll mines to the spice merchant and slaver Brophys.
Voorg, styled as Voorg the Thandicant, was a slaver who provided "protection" to the Twi'leks of Kala'uun.
Lo'baan was an elderly Twi'lek who repaired ships in Kala'uun. Lo'baan was joined by the Twi'lek Seeker who continued the business after he died.
Watcher was a Twi'lek who was responsible for the raising and lowering of the stone portcullis that protected Kala'uun.

This unidentified operative was hired by the Rebel Alliance after the ecological disaster on Clak'dor VII. The operative provided food supplies and medicine for the Bith, which resulted in their loyalty to the Rebels being secured.
Prizzi was a Livorno female who served as the queen of Livorno.
Kootan was a male Trandoshan enslaver who was part of an acquisition crew for the Xonti Brothers. Led by Noka, the five Trandoshans went to Kashyyyk where Krrsantan set a trap for them.
Orvek was a human who became a disciple of the fallen Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr after their home was demolished by the Galactic Empire following its founding in 19 BBY.

Stell was a human who lived during the rise of the Galactic Empire. After Stell and their partner Rebb witnessed the Empire's forces firsthand, the two decided that they could not raise their children under its control.

Ganjira Rell was a female leader in the Strus clan on Jakku during the Cold War. Rell favored the use of a high-powered blaster rifle at the time when the Strus clan came into contact with a group of nomads over the Starlight Wanderer.
Brana Tsaro was mercenary leader on Jakku during the time of the Cold War. She was betrayed by the Strus clan after saving a family they were trying to intimidate.

Tann Atar was a leader in the Strus clan on Jakku during the Cold War. Atar favored the use of a vibro-ax at the time when the Strus clan came into contact with a group of nomads over the Starlight Wanderer.

Hodeka was a male leader in the Strus clan on Jakku during the Cold War. Hodeka favored the use of a disruptor at the time when the Strus clan came into contact with a group of nomads over the Starlight Wanderer.
D'Trel B'Far Talis was a Gorothite living on Goroth Prime.
V'Sook M'Alra Vin was a Gorothite religious leader and member of j'ber V'Sook. V'Sook M'Alra Vin first preached the tenets of the religious movement that would become known as M'Nes.
Cambion Bayrd was the Director of Operations for Trigdale Metallurgy on Goroth Prime.
Hola Limoth was the wife of Marsh Limoth. The pair had two children.
B'Yen Do V'nel was the last surviving member of j'ber B'Yen, and the leader of the resistance group K'Len J'Bar Kasoon.

E'Sar G'Go B'Kul was the leader of the Gorothite resistance group T'B'Dellyi'Mai. Young, arrogant and aggressive, he had a innate talent for devising insurrection and terrorist tactics. E'Sar G'Go B'Kul hated all offworlders.
Del Obarren served as the Imperial Regional Prefect of the o'beki of A'Lenba on the planet Goroth Prime. A cold and hard individual, Obarren was pragmatic and had no sense of ethics or morality.

S'Ten Gali Ak'Ar was the Gorothite leader of the Gor'Jen'Ar resistance movement on Goroth Prime. A philosopher by nature, she became a warrior and politician in exile to lead the Gor'Jen'Ar resistance movement.

Leito Retinol was a Human male who was the managing director of Karflo Corporation's operations on Goroth Prime. Little was known of his background, save that he once worked for Dynamic Synergetics, Inc. Retinol has extensive knowledge of hyperbaride extraction and cracking.
D'Trel B'Krel D'Naz was a Gorothite during the Imperial reign over Goroth Prime.

Stationed on the planet Lothal, a stormtrooper was tasked to hunt down a Rodian fugitive named Tseebo. During the search, he was with another stormtrooper, who was searching for the Spectres during the Empire Day celebration.
Garudda the Hutt was a Hutt present at Fey's Cantina, where he offered people bounty hunter-related quests. At some point, the cantina's owner, Fey Zara, had enough of Garudda and kicked him out.

Master Shar Seff was a Kel Dor present at Fey Zara's cantina, where he often instructed new and aspiring patrons and offered tutorials and quests for the holotables. Shar owned old military texts and was considered sage and a cunning tactician.
Tezzie was a female Pantoran visitor to the Canto Casino. She had blue skin and played Zinbiddle with Kaljach Sonmi early in the evening. She was a construction heiress and had three grandchildren.

An Ungrila male crime boss was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Some time after the Battle of Yavin, this crime boss made a deal with the infamous smuggler Sana Starros to buy a pair of ancient lightsabers that were once wielded by the Sith Darth Atrius.
Vinn Atrius was a male Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul living during the Galactic War.
Elder Iasento was a Mimbanese tribal leader who was armed and trained by the Galactic Republic's 224th Division during the Clone Wars in order to battle Separatist invaders of his homeworld, Mimban.

Ovan was a human male who was the father of famed smuggler-turned-rebel Han Solo and the grandfather of Ben Solo. He lived on Corellia during Solo's early years, where he worked in the Corellian Engineering Corporation shipyards, building vessels such as YT-1300 light freighters.
Bin Essada was a male individual who served as the Imperial Moff of the Circarpous sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region.
Xodell was a human male Imperial officer who served as a commander in the military of the Galactic Empire. He was part of the 224th Imperial Armored Division and participated in the Mimban Campaign.
Weazel was a human male thief turned freedom fighter from the planet Tatooine who lived in the last days of the Galactic Republic and during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Contispex I was an individual that served as a chancellor who perished by 10 BBY. That year, Contispex's ashes were held in arks aboard the First Light, the personal star yacht of Crimson Dawn crime lord Dryden Vos. Vos considered the arks among his most prized posessions.

The Lost King of Duro was a Duros male king of Duro whose mummified hand was displayed in Dryden Vos' study onboard his yacht, the First Light in 10 BBY. On each of the fingers of the hand were ring lockets that held preserved cell samples of the royal bloodline.

Doelsor Triggant was an individual who served as a Moff of the Galactic Empire. By 10 BBY, Triggant had gifted crime lord Dryden Vos—head of the Crimson Dawn syndicate—a Taozin grub, which Vos kept on display in the study of his personal yacht, the First Light.
TK-5861 was a human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. As such, the trooper was equipped with the standard armor and weapon of the Stormtrooper Corps.
Vell Brank was a human male Imperial fleet officer in the Galactic Empire's navy where he served as a Second Lieutenant.

Staz was a human male major that served in the Galactic Empire's 224th Imperial Armored Division. He led the division during the Mimban Campaign. During a battle, he was killed by an explosion as he yelled orders to his troops.

Drawd Munbrin was a human male recruitment officer who held the military rank of naval captain and chief in the Galactic Empire. By 13 BBY, Munbrin was stationed in Coronet Spaceport, where he encountered the future smuggler Han. Munbrin gave Han the surname Solo.
Danith Nodar was a human female who served as a corporal and Imperial swamp trooper in the Galactic Empire's 224th Imperial Armored Division during the Mimban Campaign.

This human male was the father of the saboteur Val. Due to Val being fiercely guarding about her past, the only information that Tobias Beckett had been able to get out of Val was that her father was a musician and that she was named after the valachord.
