Stromm was a Corporal in the New Republic's Special Forces. In 4 ABY, he was among six SpecForce members selected for a mission to the planet Akiva which aimed to investigate the Imperial presence there and rescue pilot Wedge Antilles.

Vermia was a rat-faced female thief who was the apprentice and cohort of Ooblamon. She and her master went to the planet Taris to sell Darth Vader's lightsaber to the dark side of the Force cult Acolytes of the Beyond.

Linara was a human female dancer and girlfriend of Borgin Kaa. At some point after the Battle of Endor, she lived with Borgin in Cloud City on the planet Bespin, where Borgin awaited an implant after suffering heart problems.

Dardama was a Twi'lek female who was a member of the rebel group led by Yendor Brethen. In the year 5 ABY, Yendor and his team went to relief the planet Ryloth but they only found an abandoned Imperial station with an injured stormtrooper.

Tormo was a Twi'lek male bomb expert who was a member of the rebel group led by Yendor. In the year 5 ABY, Yendor and his team went to relief the planet Ryloth but they only found an abandoned Imperial station with an injured stormtrooper.

affiliation: Minlan Weil and the Tam-honil Three
x: Minlan Weil was a male singer and the head of the Minlan Weil and the Tam-honil Three band.

"Mister Browscar" was a male pilot who served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY. He and a fellow pilot named Miss Scowlface picked a fight with the former Imperial Sinjir Rath Velus prior to the Liberation of Kashyyyk.

"Miss Scowlface" was a female pilot who served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY. She and another pilot known as "Mister Browscar" picked a quarrel with the former Imperial Sinjir Rath Velus.
Scruff-Cheek was the nickname New Republic pilot Temmin Wexley gave to a male desert trooper he encountered during the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.

An Arratu captured Brendol Hux, Phasma, and his company when they were in Arratu Station on the planet Parnassos. The Arratu intended for them be warriors in his gladiatorial games, which would entertain the people of the nearby city.

Haaken Baranar was a free-trader and scout. While on the planet Toola, Baranar was mauled by a snow demon. Baranar was discovered by the Wookiee Spetbecca, who ran the Great Hoary Mastmot Trading Station. While Baranar recovered, Spetbecca was captured by bounty hunters.
Roff was an Imperial Moff during the Galactic Civil War. Roff had crossed paths with the smugglers To'iir and Liadden, causing them to flee into the Outer Rim Territories.
Ry Nymbis was a Twi'lek Sith male who was active during the time when the planet Moraband was still known as Korriban. Nymbis served as the apprentice of the Sith Lord Darth Caldoth.
Misook was a male scoundrel who fled to Batuu after backing out of a deal with a crime boss on Kaspas.
Emim'Ai was a female Mirialan bounty hunter who relentlessly pursued a scoundrel named Misook in order to make a name for herself among her superiors.
This male individual was the father of Izal Garsea. When she was five years old Garsea climbed a rock on Batuu with Jules, and the dress she wore at the time got covered in sweat and dirt.
Belen Rakab was a female individual who was the sister of Julen Rakab, with lived along with her in her apartment. At some point she married Haal.
Haal was a male who was the husband of Belen Rakab, the sister of Julen Rakab. The couple shared an apartment with Julen.

Houliet was a female human who belonged to a small group of pirates during the Imperial Era. In her crew of three pirates, she was the smartest and most deceitful. Before becoming a pirate, Houliet served as a lieutenant in the military.
Kalab was a male Quarren who was part of a small group of pirates during the Imperial Era.

Ark ol Loor was a Force-sensitive female Phydolon who was alive during the Imperial Era. At one point, she sought revenge against the Devaronian bounty hunter known as the "Executioner" for killing her significant other, Alk ol Nojj.
Marath was a male Weequay who was part of a small group of pirates during the Imperial Era.

Alk ol Nojj was a Phydolon who was the significant other of Ark ol Loor and was killed by the Devaronian male bounty hunter known as the "Executioner." Loor attempted to avenge Nojj's lives but was stopped by a Force-sensitive human and offered to teach Loor in the ways of the…
Zharva Kall was an individual who, at one point, became a Jedi outcast. Kall believed that blaster rifles were fun, although they were not elegant or honorable.
Ixel Garsea was a female bounty hunter who was the mother of Izal Garsea. She originally owned the light freighter Meridian.
This female farmer was the mother of Julen Rakab. Two years after she had passed, Julen recalled that she had always warned that every deed carried out was returned in kind.
Damar Olin was a human male smuggler who, for a time, was the partner of Izal Garsea. Olin eventually met Ana Tolla and her crew and joined them.

Ana Tolla was a female smuggler who led a crew by the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance. Tolla made a name for herself in the galaxy by successfully completing jobs no one else would take.

Lita was a Ketzalian member of the smuggler Ana Tolla's crew during the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance. She was known for carrying sweets to share with her colleagues on missions, including java cakes.

Safwan was a human-Twi'lek hybrid male who was the second-in-command of the smuggler Ana Tolla's crew. In 34 ABY, he traveled with his colleagues to the Outer Rim planet Batuu with the intention of destroying Kat Saka's farm.
Oksan was a Zygerrian member of the smuggler Ana Tolla's crew. In 34 ABY, the crew was caught attempting to destroy Kat Saka's farm on the Outer Rim planet Batuu using sodilium detonators.

Pall Gopal was a Rodian male musician and spy. He sold the starship Meridian to Ixel Garsea. Years later, Gopal met with her daughter Izal Garsea, hiring her to deliver a package to Dok-Ondar in Black Spire Outpost, which in turn was delivered to Resistance operatives on Batuu.

Ksana was a Nautolan female who lived on the Outer Rim planet Batuu by the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance. She shared an apartment with her mother, father, and grandmother, Mother Katlock.

Mother Katlock was a Nautolan female native of the Outer Rim planet Batuu. By the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance, she shared an apartment with her granddaughter Ksana and the child's parents.
Mako was Quarren male who lived on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. By the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance, he appeared elderly.
Kuma was a tooka owned by the mechanic Salju.
Schelhorn was a individual who ran a crew that carried wood shipments for The Wooden Wookiee store in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.
Neelo was a Togruta that resided in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. He and the human Fawn were musicians, and occasionally played at Oga Garra's cantina.
Fawn was a human male resident of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, who played in a band with the Togruta Neelo.

Anjali was a smuggler from the Inner Rim planet Onderon. At some point between 21 ABY and 34 ABY, Anjali visited Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu and was given directions by farmer Julen Rakab.
This male individual was the boyfriend of Izal Garsea in her Galactic Politics course at an academy on Eroudac, before she dropped out of the academy.
Nate Grattonius was a young male scavenger who lived in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. He believed in the Force.

Trix Sternus was a spice dealer who came to the Outer Rim planet Batuu in 34 ABY to sell her starship, an Avent100-series light freighter. After touring the ship, the farmer Julen Rakab impulsively bought it from her.

Lee Skillen was a Karkarodon female who resided in the Black Spire Outpost settlement of the Outer Rim planet Batuu. She worked for Ohnaka Transport Solutions, a company founded by the former pirate Hondo Ohnaka, supervising the business when its owner was off-world.
Orin was an employee of Ohnaka Transport Solutions, a shipping company that operated on the Outer Rim planet Batuu during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Kishka was a tooka cat who had tan fur with black stripes. In 34 ABY, Kishka was among a number of other tookas kept for sale in a crate at the Creature Stall operated by the Amani Bina in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu.

Calin was a worker employed by the Ithorian collector Dok-Ondar as an assistant in his antiquities store on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. He became acquainted with two of the store's other employees, the farmer Julen Rakab and the human Tap.

Jac Lodain was a Twi'lek male who worked as a farmer at Kat Saka's farm on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. His parents settled with him on Batuu after his father and aunt fought against the Galactic Empire.
Shari was a human female who worked as a farmer at Kat Saka's farm on the planet Batuu. Her grandparents originally migrated to Batuu to escape after the Clone Wars came to an end.

Lejo was a Mon Calamari male Resistance operative who was based near Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. He accepted a delivery from Izal Garsea and Julen Rakab that had been sent to the collector Dok-Ondar by Pall Gopal.

Delta Jeet was a human female who worked for Ohnaka Transport Solutions in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. When Izal Garsea attempted to retrieve a package for Dok-Ondar that had mistakenly been sent to Ohnaka Transport Solutions, she was forced to stun Jeet.
Volt Vescuso was a human male who resided in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. He worked in Bina's Creature Stall, and was a friend of Julen Rakab.

Lu was a resident of the Outer Rim planet Batuu, who was a friend of the farmer Julen Rakab during his childhood. Around 22 ABY, when Rakab was about seven years old, Lu pushed the farmer into one of the water-filled cenotes of the Black Spire Ruins.

Lucky was a loralora bird that was for sale in Bina's Creature Stall in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. When Julen Rakab opened all the cages in the Creature Stall to distract Delta Jeet, who was searching for him and Izal Garsea, Lucky followed them, bonding with Garsea.

Roola was a Hutt princess and ruler of the moon of Syvris. She defended her territory from the pirate Rance throughout her reign. Princess Roola was kidnapped by Pashda the Hutt after a Mon Calamari named Basz struck a deal with the pirate.
Basz was a Mon Calamari male who struck a deal with the pirate Rance to kidnap Princess Roola the Hutt with the help of Pashda the Hutt.
Rance was a male individual who was a dreaded pirate during the Imperial Era and operated near Syvris. He was often confronted by Princess Roola the Hutt, who controlled the moon.
Pashda the Hutt was a Hutt gangster who was contracted by the Mon Calamari Basz to kidnap Princess Roola the Hutt. Pashda had a stronghold on Toydaria.
Pol Arno was a male individual who, during the Imperial Era, was considered a young noble. Arno was interested in dueling for the location of Lyxas Sor, a renowned lightfoil duelist.

Lyxas Sor was a Force-sensitive female individual who was active during the Imperial Era and was a master of Form II combat. Sor was a once-renowned lightfoil duelist and had won the Tapani Open tournament.
Mey Kilrow was a female individual who served as a sergeant in the Bestine Security Force during the Imperial Era. She was corrupted, and eventually made a deal to protect the Nova Razors gang.
Hawk was a young boy sometime during the Imperial Era who sold low-grade spice in Bsellis City on Bestine IV for the Nova Razors gang, although reluctantly.

At some point between approximately 5000 BBY and many years prior to 1032 BBY, an individual trained the Duros Darth Caldoth—whose career spanned centuries—as a member of the Sith order of Force-users.

The father of the Twi'lek farmer Jac Lodain was a male individual who fought against the Galactic Empire alongside Lodain's aunt. The former had lost his arm, while the latter had died. Jac Lodain was born to his father and mother in 18 ABY.

The aunt of the Twi'lek farmer Jac Lodain was a female individual who fought against the Galactic Empire alongside Lodain's father. The former died, while the latter lost his arm. Lodain's parents later settled with him on the Outer Rim planet Batuu.
The mother of the Twi'lek farmer Jac Lodain was a female individual who settled on the Outer Rim planet Batuu with Lodain's father at some point after their son Jac was born in 18 ABY.
The father of the Nautolan Ksana was a male individual who shared an apartment with Ksana's mother and grandmother, Mother Katlock, on the Outer Rim planet Batuu.

The mother of the human musician Fawn was a female individual that settled on the Outer Rim planet Batuu at some point after 21 ABY. In 34 ABY, they grew to dislike their son's band, the Frozen Wampas, practicing music in their family's house.

Blithane was the Imperial governor of the planet Lo'Uran. Blithane was corrupt, and eventually arrested by the Imperial Security Bureau for stealing equipment and selling them on to criminal syndicates.

Sami was a Cantrosian male and member of a Cantrosian faction loyal to the Rebel Alliance. In 4 ABY, they became involved in a conspiracy in their home system and fought alongside the heroes of the Rebellion against a suspected Imperial cell.
Mrs. Bjornson was a Human female moisture farmer and the neighbor of Ariq Joanson who lived on Tatooine.

Mr. Clay was a Human male moisture farmer who neighboured Ariq Joanson on Tatooine. Clay disliked Jawas and Tusken Raiders as a result of their destructive raid on his storage shed sometime before the Battle of Yavin.

Mr. Jensen was a Human male moisture farmer and the neighbor and friend of Ariq Joanson who lived on Tatooine with his wife. He didn't support Joanson's plan to make peace with Jawas and Tuskens, because they broke five of his moisture vaporators.
Mrs. Jensen was a Human male moisture farmer and the neighbor and friend of Ariq Joanson who lived on Tatooine with her husband. He didn't support Joanson's plan to make peace with jawas and tuskens.
Mr. Olafsen was an old Human male moisture farmer and the neighbor and friend of Ariq Joanson who lived on Tatooine. He didn't support Joanson's plan to make peace with Jawas and Tusken Raiders.

Mrs. Sigurd was a Human female moisture farmer and the neighbor of Ariq Joanson who lived on Tatooine. She opposed Joanson's plan to make peace with Jawas and Tuskens, because once a Tusken threw a gaffi stick that lodged in a rear stabilizer when she was driving into Mos Eisley.

Ariela's mother was a Human female from Alderaan who was the mother of Ariela. She was present in Eyvind and his daughter's wedding ceremony when young Tusken Raiders killed Eyvind and took Ariela. Later Ariq Joanson saved her.
Ariela's sister was a Human female from Alderaan who was the sister of Ariela. She was present at Eyvind and her sister's wedding ceremony when young Tusken Raiders killed Eyvind and took Ariela.
A female duchess of the Mid Rim planet Malastare had a father who waged a number of vicious wars and a daughter who became a Dark Jedi.

A Dark Jedi was the daughter of a duchess of the Mid Rim planet Malastare. By the time Jedi Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn began studying the holocron of prophecy in 67 BBY, members of the Jedi Order considered the Dark Jedi ancient.
Norath Kev was a Duros male from the planet Duro who operated as a Resistance spy on the Outer Rim planet Varkana alongside his astromech droid, 2BR-NTB.

Ax Tagrin was a male Iktotchi bounty hunter active during the First Order-Resistance War. During the War, Tagrin found work from the First Order by capturing members of the Resistance since he believed in getting employed by the winning side.

Asera was a Rekk who was the chancellor of her species. She was imprisoned by the Galactic Empire, and Jaxxon was hired to free her. However, the smuggler was also caught and imprisoned, but was rescued when Lando Calrissian picked up Jaxxon's distress signal.
Drosk was a human lieutenant in the Galactic Empire, who assisted Commodore Visler Aqorian Korda III on Rekkana.
Fetya was a Besalisk female arms dealer who ran the outpost Fetya's Hollow on Arvina. She worked for the crime syndicate known as the Hidden Hand.

The father of Beilert Valance was a human male who, like his own father, was enslaved as a miner. Among the other miners, Valance and his family were liberated by the Galactic Empire, and his father encouraged him to venture out and fly starships.

Grebleips was an Asogian who served as a senator in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate. In 32 BBY, Grebleips was present for a session of the Senate in the Senate Building on the planet Coruscant in which Queen Padmé Amidala of the planet Naboo requested aid with the Trad…
Rani Quanic was a Sullustan smuggler. After the Battle of Endor, Quanic, along with Ostan Atur and Talak, stole 100 kilograms of meleenium from the Qua'Tahc mines on the planet Af'El.

An Aeosian female served as the queen of her species on her homeworld of Aeos Prime. In the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire, her planet housed a rebel outpost, which was later attacked by the First Order during its war against the Resistance.
Edward, or Mervin, Starspeeder (depending on the volume), also known as Krio Vin, was a Sith Lord and the father of Victor and Christina Starspeeder.
Krayt was a krayt dragon that lived on the desert planet Tatooine. According to legend, between 19 BBY and around 7 BBY, a tribe of Tusken Raiders settled near Krayt's nest.
The great-great-grandfather of Ula Vii was fond of collecting ancient Palawan sayings.

During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a Twi'lek male worked as a businessman. While on Coruscant in 3643 BBY, he needed to travel to the Old Galactic Market and argued with a shuttle operator over a travel advisory for that area.

A Human male worked as a shuttle operator for the Coruscant Security Force, the law enforcement agency on the Galactic Republic's capital planet Coruscant, during the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Rake Dee was a male Gran farmer who lived in the Kemalo Farming Cluster on Kinyen. When the farming settlement fell behind on its seasonal quota, Dee suggested hiring the Corellian slicer Skaak Tippers to run the farm through droids.

Skaak Tippers was a Corellian male slicer. The Gran farmers of the Kemalo Farming Cluster hired Skaak Tippers to run their farms remotely through slicing droids, but the slicer blackmailed the farmers, forcing them to pay credits.

A member of the Emperor's Royal Guard served the reborn Galactic Emperor Palpatine's Dark Empire. In 11 ABY, the Guardsman accompanied the Emperor to the planet Onderon during an attempted abduction of the Force-sensitive infant Anakin Solo and remained stationed at the Empero…

Bilk Plessey was a Rodian dejarik player who was ranked top in the galaxy. During the Galactic Dejarik Association Championship Tournament, hosted at Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana, Plessey challenged Kanata herself.

Anster Bach was a Quarren male who represented Canto Bight at the Galactic Dejarik Association Championship Tournament. Maz Kanata bet Bach one hundred thousand credits that she could play against Bilk Plessey in the final match and get him to play with his arms behind his back.

A princess from the Expansion Region planet Cuyacan was a female individual who lived in the galaxy before the war between the First Order and the Resistance. The smuggler Ana Tolla stole a diamond choker from the princess at some point prior to the Hosnian Cataclysm in 34 ABY.
Kup'bree'ak was a male Togruta. He traveled to Cerosha to earn a living as a gambler. He won a fortune in Solace, but by using underhanded methods.

Mathieson was an admiral who served the New Republic. While aboard the space station Brooksdion, the head of Mathieson's protocol droid was stolen, and with it, records of all of the admiral's past conversations for the previous five years.
Quinny was a Besalisk bartender who worked aboard the New Republic space station Brooksdion.

Brooks was a human male admiral in the Galactic Empire. While speaking with Commandant Brendol Hux, Hux's son Armitage was ordered to serve them drinks, but dropped the tray. Both Admiral Brooks and Commandant Hux scolded Armitage for his failure.
Thea was a female Human scavenger who lived during the Galactic Civil War. She was the captain of the freighter Wandering P'orp.
Douzler was a male Rutian Twi'lek scavenger who lived during the Galactic Civil War. He was a crew member of the freighter Wandering P'orp.
A Twi'lek female was the girlfriend of Ohnaka Transport Solutions' Karkarodon employee Lee Skillen. The Twi'lek took issue with the hours Skillen worked her job.
A male individual was the father of Resistance spy Vi Moradi. When Moradi was five years, she was in the market with her father and brother buying bread and fruits for dinner.
A male individual was the husband of Baako, the brother of Resistance spy Vi Moradi. The couple lived together on the moon Pantora.
"Green Leader" was an individual who served in the Resistance as the leader of Green Team during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Arta Kleidun was a Twi'lek female who owned a clothing shop called Black Spire Outfitters in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. Her handmade work was well known and well worn throughout the Outpost, with many residents sporting her Old Republic-era referential clothes.

Dhoran was a Wookiee male who was the lover of Oga Garra, the crime boss of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. Garra caught Dhoran with one of her waitresses, Meeba, and ordered him to leave the planet under the threat of death.
Meeba was a tall Rodian female who was hired as a waitress at Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. The cantina was owned by a Blutopian woman, Oga Garra.
Bubo Wamba was an Aqualish farmer who ran the Milk Stand in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. Four generations of the Wamba family had kept banthas on their farm on Tatooine.
Kamka Lira was a Bith female, the daughter of musician parents, who had a passion for crafting handmade jewelry from a young age.

Kasif was a Trandoshan male hunter and merchant who operated in the town of Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. He ran the company known as Outer Rim Expedition and Supply, selling goods that included starships and weaponry.

Ylena was a human female who worked for Savi as a member of the Gatherers in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. She believed in the Force and supported the cause of the Resistance. When she was in her forties, she met and was recruited by the Resistance spy Vi Moradi.
Dotti was a female individual who worked as one of Savi's Gatherers in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. While she opposed the First Order, she had no interest in supporting the Resistance.
Danjo was a member of the Gatherers, a group of salvagers who worked for Savi in Black Spire Outpost.

Lin was a male resident of Batuu who worked as one of Savi's Gatherers. Upon learning that Vi Moradi, new recruit to the Gatherers, was a member of the Resistance, he was afraid her presence would bring the First Order to the planet.
Madi Ro was one of Savi's Gatherers in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.
Uz was a member of the Gatherers, a group of salvagers who worked for Savi in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.
Da-zorai was a member of Savi's Gatherers in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. Da-zorai had viewed holos of the Resistance's General Leia Organa, and believed that she was smart.

Fenda was a member of the Gatherers in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. After learning that Vi Moradi, new recruit to the Gatherers, was a member of the Resistance, Lin whispered to Fenda, and the two kept their distance from her, scared that her presence would attract the First …
Rusko was a Karkarodon male who worked as the second-in-command of Oga Garra, the crime boss of Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.
N'arrghela was a Wookiee female who worked as muscle for Oga Garra, the crime boss of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. She was strong enough to rip the arm off of a Besalisk and wielded a bowcaster.

Wulfgar Kath, formerly designated CD-0828, was a human male lieutenant in the First Order. In 34 ABY, he was dispatched from the Star Destroyer Penumbra to Black Spire Outpost on Batuu in order to seek out the Resistance spy known as "Starling." He died in orbit when his sabot…

The grandfather of the human bounty hunter Beilert Valance was a male individual who was enslaved as a miner on his homeworld Chorin for his whole life, like generations of the Valance family and the population of the world before him had been for centuries, until they were li…

Dolin was a human male farmer who lived on the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu with his grandmother, Grana. After saving the life of Vi Moradi, Dolin left Grana to join Moradi in the Resistance. He owned a pet truffleboar named Waba.

Grana was an elderly human female farmer who lived on Batuu with her grandson Dolin. Distrusting of anyone outside of their own community, she prevented him from leaving a life of farming and visiting Black Spire Outpost.

Gol was a human male who sold technology from a stall in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. He was abusive and xenophobic towards his Chadra-Fan assistant Kriki. After the Resistance spy Vi Moradi rescued Kriki from Gol's abuse, he reported her to First Order Lieutenant Wulfgar Kath.
Kriki was a Chadra-Fan with skills in improving and modifying technology. She worked for Gol in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, but chose to join Vi Moradi's group of Resistance members.
Reelka was the sister of the Chadra-Fan Kriki. She was present on Hosnian Prime when it was destroyed by the First Order.
Nanz was a bartender at Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. She was a human woman who was older than the Resistance spy Vi Moradi.

Zade Kalliday was a male smuggler who operated from the starship Midnight Blade. When attempting to smuggle cargo onto Batuu, Kalliday was stopped by the First Order, who seized his cargo and killed his partner, Valoss.
Oh-li was an elderly woman who resided in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. She wove baskets and sold fruit and vegetables with her sister, Jenda, from a cart near Oga's Cantina.

Jenda was an elderly female resident of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, who lived there with her sister Oh-li. First Order stormtroopers assaulted Jenda while asking for information on the Resistance spy Vi Moradi.

CF-3363 was a stormtrooper of the First Order, dispatched to Batuu under the command of Lieutenant Wulfgar Kath. Along with CF-3871, CF-3363 confronted Zade Kalliday in Black Spire Outpost, but both stormtroopers were shot and killed by Vi Moradi.

CF-3871 was a First Order stormtrooper who served under Lieutenant Wulfgar Kath. When Kath was deployed to Batuu to find the Resistance spy Vi Moradi, CF-3871 was one of the troopers who accompanied him.
CF-9164 was a female stormtrooper of the First Order. She had trained under Captain Cardinal, who later defected from the First Order and took his former name of Archex.
CE-6675 was a male First Order stormtrooper and the second-in-command of Lieutenant Wulfgar Kath during his deployment on Batuu.

Marin Anke was a male slicer who frequented Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. He supported the First Order, and Resistance recruit Dolin believed that he may have been assisting them with repairing technology broken by their own slicer, Kriki.

Valoss was a Devaronian and the partner of the smuggler Zade Kalliday. When transporting moogyyrko sap from Kashyyyk in their starship, the Midnight Blade, they were stopped at the First Order Star Destroyer Penumbra above Batuu.

CD-5502 was a human stormtrooper in the First Order. In 34 ABY, CD-5502 was deployed to Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu as part of a squad based off the Star Destroyer Penumbra and led by Lieutenant Wulfgar Kath to track down the Resistance operative known as Starling.
Houz was a human male who lived in a farming community on the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. He was recruited into the Resistance through his friend Dolin.

Hawk, designated CT-4547 and also referred to as 4547, was an Advanced Recon Commando for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. He was present for Kaj Loomit's sabotage of a simulation chamber.

Red, designated CC-2357 and also referred to as 2357, was a Clone Captain who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Red fought in the First Battle of Geonosis and saw near constant action ever since.
Yigan Lam was a human female and the Padawan learner to Hallan Krintu. She was present for Kaj Loomit's sabotage of a simulation chamber. She carried a green-bladed lightsaber.
Hallan Krintu was a male Rutian Twi'lek Jedi who was a member of the Exploration Corps and the mentor of Padawan Yigan Lam.

Zinn Kudri was a Dathomirian female aide of Karkarodon politician Tas Gallin in the Galactic Senate. Born in 42 BBY, in her youth Kudri worked as a technician and scavenger, becoming swooped into a life of crime.

Tas Gallin was a Karkarodon female senator who remained loyal to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. She was present with her aide Zinn Kudri for Kaj Loomit's sabotage of a simulation chamber.

Kaj Loomit was a human male technician and scavenger. During the Clone Wars, he posed as a Galactic Republic trader on Kamino. He was actually working as a saboteur for the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Sylvai was a human male farmer who resided on Batuu, and the cousin of Dolin. Dolin attempted to get the inhabitants of his farming community on the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost to fight against the First Order, but they refused to get involved.
Tophin was a resident of a farming community on the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, and a second cousin of Dolin.

Madeli was a human farmer who lived in a farming settlement near Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. When Dolin, a farmer from the community who had joined the Resistance, attempted to convince his friends to fight against the First Order, Madeli and the other farmers were skeptical.
Kimbe was a human who worked as a Gatherer for Savi in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. When Ylena, one of the other Gatherers, wished to see Savi in his personal workshop, Kimbe let her in.
Waba was a truffleboar owned by the farmer Dolin on Batuu. When Dolin left his farming community to join the Resistance, he took Waba with him.
Atty was a Stormtrooper Commander who served the Galactic Empire during its reign of the galaxy. At one point, Atty served as the field commander on Ontotho during a pacification mission.
Tornak Po was a Neimoidian loyal to the Separatist cause during the Clone Wars. After the war he wasn't able to pay his debts due to the Separatists losing the war.
Slider was a mercenary who worked for Domina Tagge.
RS-2112 was a human stormtrooper who served the First Order's 709th Legion. In 34 ABY, RS-2112 was one of several stormtroopers deployed to the Outer Rim planet Batuu.

ZJ-7199 was a human stormtrooper who served in the 709th Legion of the First Order. In 34 ABY, the legion was dispatched to find Resistance operatives on the Outer Rim planet Batuu, and ZJ-7199 was one of the troopers sent into an outpost there, serving under a stormtrooper se…
Nilo, designated RC-1570 was a clone commando and captain of the elite clone commando squad known as Tark Squad, which was part of the Special Operations Brigade of the Galactic Republic in 21 BBY.
Telbus was a bounty hunter who was active during the Galactic Civil War. He spoke a language other than Basic.
Bylsma was a human male from Alderaan who served as a palace guard before the Galactic Civil War. When the Galactic Empire destroyed Alderaan, Bylsma was offworld, surviving the planet's destruction.

A male radar technician worked for the First Order, under Admiral Brooks. In 33 ABY, a shuttle containing both Kylo Ren, the apprentice of Supreme Leader Snoke, and General Armitage Hux was sabotaged, crashing onto a planet.

Lopz was a Sullustan criminal operating during the Imperial Era. He worked for "the Underlord," the leader of Gillanium Syndicate. He operated with the Snivvian known as Kaluub Akjee, and at some point ran into IG-88.

The wife of Jak Bremen was killed when her husband was on a hunting trip. Her husband tracked the killers to a hidden Imperial garrison established by the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order in order to complete a mission. Together, she and Bremen had a daughter.
Micha was a female pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era, holding the callsign Red Four in Red Squadron.

Wenlok Nak was a human male who served as a tech worker and agent of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Clone Wars, Nak was based on Coruscant where he reprogrammed standard droids to conduct attacks throughout Galactic City.

Arzo Suun was a Dathomirian Zabrak male from the planet Dathomir who was formerly part of a clan of the Nightbrothers, a colony of Zabrak warriors, during the Clone Wars. At some point, Suun escaped Dathomir.
Ruul was a Dathomirian Zabrak male from the planet Dathomir who was part of a clan of the Nightbrothers during the Clone Wars.
Mak Eak was a Dathomirian Zabrak male from the planet Dathomir who was a member and former leader of a clan of the Nightbrothers during the Clone Wars.

During the Clone Wars, Nelsel was a female Dathomirian Zabrak member of the Nightsisters, a group of Force-sensitive witches. Hailing from the planet Dathomir, they wore traditional Nightsister robes and wielded a Nightsister energy bow.
Sua Tood was a Gossam male who owned farms on Felucia during the Clone Wars. During the war, several farms were destroyed. The local authorities were too concerned with the war to aide Tood.

Yiprukk was a young Force-sensitive Wookiee male. During the Clone Wars, Yiprukk was kidnapped by a Trandoshan hunter, forcing a group of individuals associated with the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic, along with Wookiees, to track down and rescue Yiprukk.
Yilon Kres was a female Rodian who supervised Warehouse 305 during the Clone Wars. She was part of the black market network on Mandalore.

Wazellman was a Wickwar male from the planet Wick 111 who participated in a game of sabacc on the planet Numidian Prime with the gamblers Han Solo and Lando Calrissian in 10 BBY. Sitting next to Solo, Wazellman saw him eventually win Calrissian's freighter, the Millennium Falcon.
Luma was a tooka female that was lost by her owner on the planet Batuu during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Riyola Keevan was a Pantoran female starship captain for Chandrila Star Line. She served aboard the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Gaya was a Twi'lek female singer who rose to the heights of a galactic superstar during the First Order-Resistance War. She was a highly skilled performer who commanded respect and attention from those she met.
MW-59 was a musician who performed in the Huttese musical track "Batuu Boogie" with fellow artist Chaka Mater Laka.

Chaka Mater Laka was a musician who performed in the Huttese song "Batuu Boogie" alongside MW-59. The duo's song was featured by the droid DJ R-3X in Oga's Cantina, which was located in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu, in the year 34 ABY.

Elee was the nickname given by the human Salju to a pet that her father brought back for her from his travels when she was youngling. Elee was a small and hairy quadruped, and the gentlest creature Salju had ever met.

Divad Masspur was a holopresenter for Coco-Town Sports on Coruscant. At the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally, Masspur, while drunk, approached the Jedi Master Dooku, suggesting an idea for a sport involving Jedi and lightsabers.
Sartori was an inspector for the Coruscant Security Force during the time of the Galactic Republic. Sartori was corrupt, working for the crime lord Cenevax.
Cenevax was a Jenet female crime lord who ran a syndicate on the planet Coruscant and had spies in many places.
Eson was a Serennian male sergeant of Serenno's House Borgin.

Hagi was a Serennian female countess of Serenno's House Malvern. She fought against the Abyssin who invaded the planet. Following the invasion, she discovered a seam of sacanium, that Tirra'Taka brought up during the battle.
A priestess was a female insectoid alien and a user of the dark side of the Force who led a coven of the Presagers of Hakotei on the planet Asusto.
Pars-Valo, also known as Pars, was a Jedi Initiate of the Jedi Order. Around 52 BBY, Jedi Master Dooku taught the marks of contact to a group of Initiates, including Pars-Valo.

This male individual was the stepfather of the smuggler Zade Kalliday. According to Halliday, his stepfather used to drink heavily with his mother to forget the harsh demands of life in the dunes of Tatooine.

This female human was the mother of the smuggler Zade Kalliday. According to Halliday, his mother used to drink heavily with his stepfather to forget the harsh demands of life in the dunes of Tatooine.

This female human was the mother of First Order Lieutenant Wulfgar Kath. Whilst fighting with Resistance spy Vi Moradi, the spy asked Kath if his mother had been a worrt, as she had seen a resemblance between the two, to which Kath coldly replied that he had never known his mo…

Kral Grek was a Quarren male born on the planet Mon Cala around the year 56 BBY. In 22 BBY, Grek was in the Uscru Entertainment District on the planet Coruscant when the Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi landed an airspeeder nearby.
F'ej D'aw was a Klatooinian male henchman. He once worked for the crimelord Nawnam and was at some point during the Galactic Civil War Nawman's last henchman.
An Imperial officer served as the first officer of Captain Gilad Pellaeon of the Galactic Empire's Third Fleet aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Harbinger.
Dyyl was a human male with fair skin who posted a request for help in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Pride Aully was a humanoid scoundrel. Aully participated in a sabacc game on the planet Numidian Prime in 10 BBY, where the outlaw Han Solo won the starship Millennium Falcon from the gambler Lando Calrissian.

Kase Finto was a male individual who led the Finto Gang. Finto tried to sell fake Lothal gemstones to Dok-Ondar in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, but the collector's IG droid BK-86 drew its blaster on him.

Harta was an Ishi Tib male who lived on the Outer Rim planet Batuu with his daughter Salju and owned the Black Spire Station garage. He often traveled the galaxy, bringing home gifts for the young girl. One day, he returned home with a pet therii, whom Salju named Elee.
Berka was a Nautolan resident of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, Berka privately denounced the First Order's presence on the planet.
Albee was an Abednedo who operated for the Resistance on Batuu. Albee reported to Vi Moradi, keeping watch on First Order stormtrooper patrols around Black Spire Outpost.

RF-1634 was a human stormtrooper who served in the 709th Legion of the First Order military regime. RF-1634 was stationed on the Outer Rim planet Batuu during the First Order's occupation there in 34 ABY with the 709th Legion.
LA-233 was a human stormtrooper in the 709th Legion of the First Order military regime. The stormtrooper, along with the legion, was deployed to occupy the planet Batuu in 34 ABY.
CG-412 was a human stormtrooper in the 709th Legion of the First Order. Even though other stormtroopers were taken away from their families as infants, CG-412 claimed to have met a grandfather.

RS-318 was a human stormtrooper who served in the 709th Legion of the First Order military regime. RS-318 was stationed on the Outer Rim planet Batuu during the First Order's occupation there in 34 ABY.

Neva was a human female resident of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. When Neva became behind on her rent payments to Oga Garra, she requested to make up for it by working at her cantina. Garra agreed, assigning her fifty hours of work.

Anjay was a human female officer who served in the armed forces of the First Order during its war against the Resistance. During that time, she was part of the 709th Legion and was among those deployed to Batuu to search for Resistance spies.

Shakel was a human male officer who served as a lieutenant in the armed forces of the First Order during its war against the Resistance. During that time, he was part of the 709th Legion and was among those deployed to Batuu to search for Resistance spies in Black Spire Outpost.

Vurrsk was a Trandoshan warlord and the leader of a tribe on Nameel. When Vurrsk's tribe had credits stolen by Dupei monks who they were attempting to buy outlawed weaponry from, the Trandoshans attacked the monks, and the Jedi Eno Cordova and Cere Junda were sent to resolve t…

Dylanto Daa was a human male historian and the founder of the Daa Corporation. When the planet Ontotho joined the Galactic Republic under a united government, Daa and his corporation entered into an agreement to explore a recently discovered temple within the land of the indep…
An ambassador represented the Fylar region of Ontotho during talks between the Fylari and the Daa Corporation regarding exploration of a temple that had been discovered in Fylar territory.

A sub-governor worked for the Galactic Empire on Sergia. When Luke Skywalker wished to locate Imperial scouts on Sergia, Warba Calip suggested buying the information from the sub-governor's secretary.

A secretary assisted the local Imperial sub-governor on the planet Sergia. While helping Luke Skywalker track down Imperial scouts that were roaming Sergia, Warba Calip advised him to pay the secretary for the information, robbing the local Imperial payroll garrison.

A Sullustan female was a farmer at Kat Saka's farm on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. She was born around 21 ABY and became a harvester of purple Surabat grain under the direction of her farmhand group's leader, Jac Lodain, along with her groupmates Shari and a Gungan.

A Gungan was a farmer at Kat Saka's farm on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. He was born around 21 ABY, and became a harvester of purple Surabat grain under the direction of his farmhand group's leader, Jac Lodain, along with his groupmates Shari and a Sullustan.
Omera was a human female from the planet of Sorgan. At some point, she became a widow. In 9 ABY, a band of Klatooinian raiders attacked her village and people.

The father of Dar Champion was a human male who served as a member of the Imperial Senate. The Senate indicted Champion's father for embezzlement and abuse of office, and the rest of Champion's family was seen as co-conspirators.

The mother of Dar Champion was a human female. When Champion's father was indicted by the Imperial Senate and convicted of embezzlement and abuse of office, Champion and mother were both accused of acting as co-conspirators.
Rorjow was a Wookiee with gray fur who wore a bandolier.

Ulibacca was a Wookiee with brown fur who wore a bandolier and goggles. He was a friend of fellow Wookiee Chewbacca. Ulibacca managed an art school on the planet Kashyyyk, and his art could be found in many art galleries across the galaxy.
Chalkazza was a Wookiee with brown fur who had a cybernetic right eye, left shoulder and left elbow.

Amalak was a human male who was present in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. While on Batuu, Amalak was searching for vehicle components, including the targeting computer of an All Terrain Armored Transport.
Cooper was a human male who operated for the Resistance on Batuu. He requested assistance with performing diagnostics on a T-70 X-wing starfighter.

Tardent was a human male who was present in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. He contacted the collector Dok-Ondar, looking to buy Jedi artifacts.

Jorg was a human male who lived on Batuu during the war between the Resistance and the First Order. Jorg offered to sell a backpack used by the rebels on Hoth to the collector Dok-Ondar, claiming it was one of only two that survived the Battle of Hoth.
Argin was a human male who resided in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.
Bishta was a human male, who, along with his partner Argin, planned to steal from the antiquities store of the collector Dok-Ondar.

Chirja was a human female who lived in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. She experience strange feelings around Savi's Workshop, hearing voices in her head.
Dothan was a human male resident of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. Dothan spoke to fellow resident Chirja about strange experiences she had around Savi's Workshop.

Anta was a human female merchant who sold items in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. The First Order prevented Anta from importing anything she could sell, and as a result her business fell. Anta spoke with fellow resident Bathari, worrying about failing to make Oga Garra's quota.
Bathari was a human female resident of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. She spoke with Anta, who worried about failing to make quotas for Oga Garra due to imports being blocked by the First Order.
Tohago was a human woman who worked as an assistant, representative, and translator for the collector Dok-Ondar.
LivLiv was a female Kowakian monkey-lizard belonging to Hiro in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. When Hiro lost LivLiv, the collector Dok-Ondar promised to watch out to try and find her.
Laki Lembeng was an individual who performed the song "Nama Heh," which was played at Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost.
Vee Gooda was an individual who performed the song "Aloogahoo," alongside Ryco. She got her start on Cloud City.
Ryco was a musical artist who featured on the song "Aloogahoo," performed by Vee Gooda.
Junee Veech was a Rodian female who performed the song "Bai Tee Tee," which DJ R-3X played at Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost.
Gubz was an individual whose performance was featured on "Bai Tee Tee," a song by Junee Veech.

Kra Mer 5 was a musician who performed the Gungan drinking song "Una Duey Dee" in Gunganese. The song was included in the playlist of the DJ droid R-3X while performing in Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu in 34 ABY.
Zano was a musician who performed the song "Goola Bukee," which played in Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.
Fytee was a musical artist. Fytee performed the song "Moulee-rah," featuring RB Snootles, as well as the song "Yocola Ateema," alongside The Sleemos.
RB Snootles was an individual who featured in the song "Moulee-rah" by Fytee.
Elem Zadowz was the performer of the song "Huttuk Cheeka," which was played at Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost by DJ R-3X.

Flitchee was an Ewok warrior who was a member of the Bright Tree tribe that lived in Bright Tree Village on the forest moon of Endor. In 4 ABY, Flitchee was among those Ewoks who aided the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Battle of Endor.
Graxol Kelvyyn was an Anx who viewed the Boonta Eve Classic podracing event from the private box of the Toydarian junk dealer Watto in Mos Espa Grand Arena on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.

Forzaa was a Zeltron female who worked as a fortune teller in the lower levels of Coruscant. When searching for a lost museum on Level 4, Amilyn Holdo visited Forzaa with Leia Organa, and the fortune teller guided them in the right direction.
A human male was the husband of Pitina Mar-Mas Voor. In 26 BBY, he served as a senator for the Galactic Republic, and married Voor on her eighteenth birthday when she was married off by her family.

In 34 ABY, a male valet lived on Canto Bight, a coastal city in Cantonica. When Resistance operative Rose Tico was riding a fathier through the city, Rose saw the valet and shouldered him into a pond full of what she concluded to be carnivorous fish.

The partner of the human Commissioner Exantor Divo lived with him and their two children in Republic City on the New Republic capital Hosnian Prime, where Divo served as head of law enforcement, in 34 ABY.

A Human male served the Galactic Republic as a quartermaster during the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. In 3643 BBY, he was posted on the planet Taris during the Taris Resettlement Initiative.
Riv Garbi was a great male Duros philosopher and author. Around roughly 3630 BBY,it was rumored that one of his long-lost texts was discovered on his home planet in a private collection.
Assessor 34372 was the author of Tactical Report Assessment DNT-2238.553b, in which they argued the reconstituted Sith Empire should interfere on Dantooine.

Ardu Vel was a Duros male seismologist present on Ossus during the invasion of the planet in the opening stages of the third Galactic War. He was trying to get a grip on the plague of Darth Malora's mutant Geonosians.
Tramulek was an Ithorian doctor who lived near the farmsteads on Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus. He worked on a serum to reverse Darth Malora's modifications of the Geonosians.
Marku was a Chiss female who served as a lieutenant of the Sith Empire. During the Dantooine Incursion, Marku was stationed in a hidden Imperial base on Dantooine.

Izar was a Force-sensitive male Sith Lord who served as representative among the Imperial Outreach Division. Shortly before the Dantooine Incursion, Izar contacted Lana Beniko to get in touch with the Commander of the Eternal Alliance.
Darth Hadrin was a male Sith Lord present within the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.
Fural was a male Sith Lord present within the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.
Bay'lor was a Human male Sith Lord present in the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.
Don, known as the Exiled Knight, was a Zabrak male Jedi Knight who lived in exile in a makeshift camp with a bonfire in the canyons of Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.

Herg was a male student from the planet Coruscant who studied under Professor Voren Na'al. A classmate of the Devaronian Pollo Tipn, Herg had a arrogant personality and was prone to badgering Tipn with sarcastic remarks.

Veltzz Arakyd was a male industrialist who founded the droid, starship and weapons manufacturer Arakyd Industries with his children on the planet Vulpter around nine thousand years before the Battle of Yavin.

Ruthford was a human male stormtrooper captain who served with a new generation of stormtroopers during the rise of the First Order. A veteran of the Galactic Empire, Ruthford preferred his original stormtrooper armor over the version worn by younger troopers.

Ara-Nea was a male alien who resided on Necropolis as an overseer of the scavenging there. Ara-Nea tried to swindle Rey out of her money, then kill her. When Rey realized that, his plan did not work out, and Ara-Nea was then imprisoned by his own enslaved workers.
Brilla Wolstenholme was a human female who held the rank of captain within the armed forces of the First Order who was sent to oversee mining operations on the planet Hays Minor.
Richta Blade was a Force-sensitive Human female who served under the reconstituted Sith Empire. She was present in the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Empire's invasion of the planet.
Captain Mayfari was a Human male who served as Imperial soldier under the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was present in the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Empire's invasion of the planet.
T'Bar Ricair was a woman who worked as a smuggler until a fateful encounter with Vi Moradi at Black Spire Outpost, Batuu, prompted her to join the Resistance against the First Order.
"Steely Carl" was a surly male Talpini who worked as a guard for Oga Garra. The nickname was given to him by Zade Kalliday.

A Kubaz operated as a spy for the Galactic Empire sometime during the Galactic Civil War. The Kubaz was present on Sarka and was informed by Lord Rooz that Sarka would continue selling its gems to the Imperials.

A male artist traveled the galaxy and kept a journal of illustrations and stories from his encounters with the many sentient species and creatures of the galaxy. His travels took him to planets including Tatooine, Naboo, Coruscant and Takodana.
Garulo was the Xexto gunner of Relgar Carrae during the Cloud City Grand Prix. He held the record for the most racers disabled in a single year and over the beginning of the competition.
Honest Grek was a male Human living in Cloud City and the owner of Honest Grek's Speeders, selling speeders, swoops or cloud cars during the Galactic Civil War.
Walix Ve'ra was a Force-sensitive male who served under the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was present in the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Empire's invasion of the planet.

Tellus T'arch was a female Mandalorian who served under the reconstituted Sith Empire during the third Galactic War. She was present in the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Empire's invasion of the planet. She wore black Mandalorian tracker armor.
Bra'dda Lui was a Human male who served under the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was present in the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Empire's invasion of the planet.
Faun Esta was a Human male Cyborg who served under the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was present in the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Empire's invasion of the planet.
Krintle Gera was a Human male who served the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was present in the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Empire's invasion of the planet.

Urma Athantras was an Arkanian female who served as a consular during the Imperial Era. Alongside Tione Zrar and Velai, Athantras attempted to protect a village led by Thissa Somori from a group of pirates.

Velai was a Cosian male who believed in the Force. He was sent to protect a village that was threatened by pirates, along with Urma Athantras and Tione Zrar. When the pirates, led by Arra Somori, landed in front of the village, Athantras confronted them, leading to a standoff.

Tione Zrar was a Pau'an female who worked as a consular with Urma Athantras and Velai. When she and her companions prepared to defend a village from a group of pirates attempting to extort them, Zrar studied the pirate captain, Arra Somori.

Thissa Somori was a Pantoran female who led a village that was populated by members of the human, Pantorans and Talz. Somori's daughter, Arra, became a pirate captain, extorting the villagers for payment.
Arra Somori was a Pantoran female who was the daughter of Thissa Somori, the leader of a small village. Somori became estranged from her mother, becoming the captain of a pirate crew.

Kharmoth was a Talz male who served as the elder of a small village. During negotiations with a group of pirates led by Arra Somori, who had been extorting the village for payments, Kharmoth was suspicious of the crew, leading to the aggression of Somori's first mate Elkan.

Elkan was a Zabrak female who served as the first mate of pirate captain Arra Somori. When Somori's pirate crew were forced into negotiations with villagers that they had been extorting for payments, Elkan grew frustrated by the lack of progress, threatening the Talz elder Kha…

Galena Rans was a female Mirialan who served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic. A devoted citizen and retired decorated veteran of the Republic Navy four-thirty-ninth bomber wing who married Supreme Commander Rans.

Jmmaar was a ten-legged, crablike Jedi Master from the planet Vvaw. A member of the Jedi Order, guardians of the Galactic Republic, Jmmaar was slain by the Separatist General Grievous, who won the Jedi's green-bladed weapon and added it to his collection of lightsabers at some…

Brennar was a human male who wished to join the crew of Captain Spikewheel. As a test, the captain stranded Brennar, along with Gritz, Riki, and Seles, on Lotho Minor, making them prove their worth by surviving one night on the junk planet.
Gritz was a Kadas'sa'Nikto male who aspired to join the crew of the Salvage-1, captained by the droid Spikewheel.

Riki was a Theelin female who attempted to join the crew of Captain Spikewheel, along with Brennar, Gritz, and Seles. The droid captain took the recruits to the junk planet Lotho Minor, leaving them stranded for one night as a test to determine their worth.

Seles was a Roonan male who attempted to join the crew of Captain Spikewheel. Along with Brennar, Gritz, and Riki, Seles was left on Lotho Minor by the captain, who wanted them to survive one night on the junk planet before they could join his crew.

Kristoff was a Benathy male who served as the king of his species during the New Republic Era. Kylo Ren of the First Order visited King Kristoff on the Benathy homeworld Benath, ordering him to stop his expansion of the Benathy's territory.
A male individual served as the king of the Benathy species on Benath, an astronomical object located in Wild Space.

Neralli was a female member of the Fylari on Ontotho. When the regions of Ontotho united to form a government in order to enter into the Galactic Republic, Neralli and the Fylari refused to join, seeing no benefit of doing so.

Moroo was a male Fylari who lived in the Fylar region of Ontotho. When the Daa Corporation and the Ontothon government became convinced that the Fylari were hostile after refusing to let the corporation excavate a temple in their territory, Moroo reluctantly got the Fylari for…
Wef was a Melbu arms dealer who operated during the Imperial Era, trading with various individuals for years.

Rebak was an operative of the Rebel Alliance during the Imperial Era. At some point, the Rebellion began doing business with the Hidden Hand criminal syndicate with the intent of purchasing arms from them.

Staaysha Dekkr was a Duros trader who worked for Duro Interstellar Freight and Shipping. While attempting to make a shortcut through a gas cloud in order to reach Klytus V Station, Dekkr became trapped in the nebula.
Hressk was a male Trandoshan and the dock chief of the Landing Bay 124A on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
Gerrol Hunn was the pilot of the Stormhawks, a team sponsored by MandalMotors to race the Cloud City Grand Prix above the planet Bespin.
Xoff Ix was a male Ugnaught who worked as chief foreman for a construction guild in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
Jera was a Human male who worked for Marus Grayson during the Galactic Civil War. He once teamed up with Kerr to find a skilled thief to protect the Jewel of Yavin during its auction in Cloud City.
Gorgara was a female chirodactyl that resided on the planet Dathomir, known in local legends as "the winged daemon of the canyon." When Gorgara began to collect bones, it was a sign of unrest.

Boolio was an Ovissian male who worked as a mine overseer at the Sinta Glacier Colony during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. He was sympathetic to the Resistance and covertly sent supplies their way.

A human male admiral served in the First Order during the New Republic Era. At one point, the admiral accompanied Kylo Ren to a world in Wild Space and prepared forces for a possible battle against the Benathy.
Exar Kun was a Dark Lord of the Sith who flourished thousands of years before Darth Sidious and his Sith apprentice Darth Maul.

Babu Frik was an Anzellan who lived during the time of the New Republic Era and the war between the First Order and the Resistance. He maintained a workshop where he worked as a black market droidsmith among the Spice Runners of Kijimi.
Kerr was a Human who worked for Marus Grayson during the Galactic Civil War. He once teamed up with Jera to find a skilled thief to protect the Jewel of Yavin during its auction in Cloud City.
Leina was a Togruta. During childhood, she was friends with Shreya Ordassa. After Ordassa left Shili, the two did not see one another for some time.
Choran Les was a businessman and the owner of Negri's Processing Vane 5 in the Industrial Levels of Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.

Faa'i Lethax was a male Twi'lek working as bookkeeper for Vorse Tabarith during the Galactic Civil War. During the auction of the Jewel of Yavin in Cloud City, he wanted to joined up with Kaltho's Kajidic.
Leviani was a female Human who worked as chief of security at the Yarith Bespin, a hotel in Cloud City, during the Galactic Civil War.
Jolen Mandar was a male Human and the owner of the Three Beldons Buffet, a restaurant in Cloud City, during the Galactic Civil War.
Thera Morrow was a female amateur racer willing to become professional during the Galactic Civil War.
Naboka was a male Ugnaught slicer in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
Bos Nad'oa was a male Ortolan who worked as chef for Kaltho, a Hutt crime lord during the Galactic Civil War.
Nallith was a male Lutrillian who worked as the Figg & Associates Art Museum's receptionist in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.

Lumat was an Ewok of the Bright Tree tribe on the forest moon of Endor. Along with other members of the tribe, they aided the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Battle of Endor against the Galactic Empire in 4 ABY.

Burr Naxis was a male Corellian working as a security squad leader for Marus Grayson to protect his Jewel of Yavin exposed at the Figg & Associates Art Museum in Cloud City before the auction of the jewel during the Galactic Civil War.
Negri was a male Ugnaught working as the overseer of Processing Vane 5 in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
Ol' Sav was a skilled mechanic working for a different team in every edition of the Cloud City Grand Prix.
Pugsly was a male Ugnaught mechanic working in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
Tarryn Rayzer was a skilled pilot in the Cloud City Grand Prix during the Galactic Civil War but his speeder did not allowed him to win the race.
Taluhann was a male Lutrillian working as the Yarith Bespin's concierge in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.

Babs Terll was a female Human and the owner of Cloudscape Tours, a tour company in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War. After her husband Merll had an accident in racing, she asked him to not race again.
Merl Terll was a male ex-racer who won many times the Cloud City Grand Prix with his partner Honest Grek. After a crash, his wife Babs asked him to not race again.
Chara Tull was the female co-pilot of Gerrol Hunn in the Stormhawks team during the Galactic Civil War. They raced the Cloud City Grand Prix before the auction of the Jewel of Yavin.

Ulumahal was a female Lutrillian who defined the role of Baron Administrator shortly before the Clone Wars. She transformed Cloud City from illegal front to the jewel known during the Galactic Civil War.
Sal Vaneth was the Bothan majordomo of Kaltho during the Galactic Civil War.

Zol Kramer was a criminal who operated on the planet Rattatak. In 34 BBY, along with the warlord Osika Kirske, the criminal Rynn'k-lee, and several other companions, Kramer conspired to kill Jedi Master Ky Narec.

Rynn'k-lee was a criminal who served the warlord Osika Kirske. In 34 BBY, while on the planet Rattatak, Rynn'k-lee, along with Kirske, the criminal Zol Kramer, and other companions, conspired to kill Jedi Master Ky Narec.
Odell was an individual who served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Master during the Republic Era.
Ferana was a convor owned by the Jedi Master Lene Kostana.
Veleckra was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. Veleckra taught Jedi initiates in the art of creating sculptures using the Force.
Rolettan was a creature native to Protobranch. Rolettan was described as having four nostrils, thick scarlet scales, six legs, and a clubbed tail by a young Dooku on a mercy mission to Protobranch.

Lyo was an Abyssin smuggler. Along with Creethe and another Abyssin, Lyo smuggled nerve disruptors to Asusto, waiting for a buyer. The Jedi Lene Kostana, Sifo-Dyas, and Dooku, who were on a mission to Asusto, encountered the smugglers, and Dooku killed them in anger.

Creethe was an Abyssin smuggler. Alongside Lyo and a third smuggler, Creethe smuggled illegal nerve disruptors to Asusto to wait for their buyer. When the Jedi Lene Kostana, Sifo-Dyas, and Dooku went on a mission to Asusto, they encountered the Abyssin smugglers.
Ovana was an Jedi Initiate of the Jedi Order. Around 52 BBY, along with several other Initiates, Ovana learned the marks of combat from Jedi Master Dooku, who asked Ovana to be more precise.
Calleen was a convor owned by the Jedi Master Lene Kostana, replacing her previous convor, Ferana. Kostana named the convor after Calleen, the Altiri goddess of wisdom.
Yeeda was an initiate in the Jedi Order's Heliost Clan. During Heliost Clan's Initiate Trials, Yeeda dueled fellow initiate Ima-Gun Di.

Crucitorn was a Jedi Master who served in the Jedi Order. During the Battle of Nar Shaddaa, that took place before 68 BBY, between the Order and the Flame-Wielders, Crucitorn became immolated by the latter, but managed to endure the pain and fight back.

Lekar Hablis was an individual who was the nine-time Devaronian swoopdueling champion. Hablis was present at the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally on Coruscant. When irritated by Divad Masspur, the Jedi Master Dooku used Hablis's presence as a distraction.
Izal Pre was an Arcona racer who represented Cona at the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally on Coruscant.
Lor Kelasakuroona was a Toong racer who participated in the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally on Coruscant.
Tanan Vetall was a racer from Nithorni. She participated in the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally on Coruscant.

Oster was an Abyssin and one of many mercenaries who invaded Serenno at the request of Count Ramil. Oster and another Abyssin were stationed as guards at an outpost, and were killed by the Jedi Master Dooku, who stole a tank to use against an Abyssin camp.

Ingo Salik was a male human born before 20 ABY who served the First Order under Commander Wanten at the First Order detention center based in Harra the Hutt's stronghold on the planet Vodran in 34 ABY.

Cremp was a human commander in the Galactic Empire's Tarkin Initiative, serving aboard the Star Destroyer Optima. When Governor Wilhuff Tarkin visited the Optima for an inspection, they were hit by a rogue transport, which released a being onto the ship.
Myna was a female individual who resided on Lanz Carpo. She danced with Dar Champion and Han Solo. After Solo accidentally stepped on her left foot, she remarked that he wasn't a good dancer.

Yaltza was an Imperial officer who served the Galactic Empire, holding the rank of major. Major Yaltza was placed in charge of Project Swarm, an Imperial operation that intended to locate the headquarters of the Rebel Alliance.
Rupo Ud was a human male professor and archaeologist. He served the Galactic Empire as an archaeological consultant for its Project Swarm, an operation to track down the base of the Rebel Alliance.

Ranja was a human female who resided in a settlement on the desert planet Sergia. After Luke Skywalker robbed the local Galactic Empire payroll garrison, stormtroopers confronted Ranja, believing that she would know the culprit.

Scraaz was a Rodian smuggler who betrayed the Exchange criminal syndicate roughly a decade prior to 3643 BBY. By that year he had become tired of being on the run and wished to hire someone to slice into official records to list him as dead.

Herra Ros was a female engineer who, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, wished to defect from one faction to the other. She offered information in exchange for an annual salary.

Branwayne Spiftz was a human male who served the First Order as a commander. He took a mission to the backwater planet Minfar in hope of recovering the Echo Horn, a supposed weapon that could control the native Zixon, hiring the professor Glenna Kip for assistance.
Farrat Wrool was an insignificant male smuggler who inexplicably turned into a rich Crime lord over night. Slicers tried to hack his systems and uncover the mystery.
During the hunt, the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Formidable along with its contingent of TIE starfighters were destroyed by bot-drones, leaving Lord Vader stranded on Heva's surface.

Darth Skrye was a female Sith Lord who held the title of Darth in a Force vision of many possible colliding futures experienced by the Jedi Padawan Dooku after encountering the last coven of the Presagers of Hakotei during a mission to the planet Asusto in 82 BBY.
Jem Arafoot was a Zixon who led his species on the planet Minfar. When the First Order arrived on Minfar, Arafoot sent out a distress signal to the Resistance, asking for assistance.
Lim was a Zixon who guided members of the Resistance that arrived to assist her species with First Order forces on Minfar.

Aftab Ackbar was a Mon Calamari male from the planet Mon Cala. In 34 ABY, several Resistance members came to Mon Cala, in part to honor Aftab's father, Admiral Gial Ackbar, who had recently been killed in the fight against the First Order.
Glenna Kip was a Shani female scientist and professor. Possessing a career several centuries long, she worked out of a laboratory on the planet Haileap during the High Republic Era.

Janson Hidreck was a human female who held the rank of commander in the First Order. When Branwayne Spiftz, who had taken a mission to search for a supposed weapon on Minfar, came across retaliation from the Resistance, Hidreck and her Star Destroyer were sent to assist.

Aderat was a human male who served the First Order as a lieutenant. He assisted with Commander Branwayne Spiftz's mission to the planet Minfar, but his failure to make progress led Spiftz to assign his duties to another officer.
Glick was an individual who served the First Order as a lieutenant. He was dispatched to Minfar as part of Commander Branwayne Spiftz's mission to retrieve the Echo Horn, a supposed weapon.
Kander Varak was a human male who served as a major in the First Order. Varak was placed in charge of a bacta production plant on Tevel, in which the native Tevellans were forced to work.

Menon was a Tevellan male who attempted to fight back from First Order control of a bacta production plant on Tevel, along with Karkan and Tarina. The Resistance operatives Finn and Poe Dameron were sent to assist the Tevellans after Karkan requested help.

Tarina was a Tevellan female who was forced to work in a bacta production plant on Tevel by the First Order. Alongside Karkan and Menon, Tarina attempted to fight back, contacting the Resistance for help.

Teza Nasz was a human female individual who served as an officer in the Galactic Empire's naval forces during the Galactic Civil War. At the Battle of Jakku, she served as a strategist aboard the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Ravager.

TR-4018 was a male stormtrooper of the First Order. He served under Major Kander Varak at a bacta production plant on Tevel, guarding warehouse four along with TR-1004, where Varak was keeping Tevellan children imprisoned so that the adults of the species would work for him.
TR-1004 was a stormtrooper who served the First Order. He was stationed at Major Kander Varak's bacta production plant on Tevel, guarding warehouse four with TR-4018.

Ellian Zahra was a human female who held the rank of Commander in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War against the Rebel Alliance. Both cunning and vengeful, Zahra served at the helm of the Star Destroyer Tarkin's Will.

Wen Lu-Dasz was a rich and eccentric merchant active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. By 3643 BBY, he needed replacement parts for his yacht that could not be purchased through normal channels.
Hoske was a male individual who was promoted to admiral during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Maize Raynshi was a half-human, half-Mirialan female hybrid. Maize's parents were the human First Order officer Vroc Raynshi and the Mirialan woman Anaya Raynshi.
"Two-Eyes" Taravak was a male Gran crime lord who lived during the Galactic War. At that time, he gathered with some specialists for a high-stakes heist.
Bazalle Geskrond was a wealthy female industrialist and infamous hoarder who lived during the rule of the Eternal Empire.
The cousin of the human Fawn was a musician. Around 31 ABY, she came from the Core Worlds planet Coruscant to visit the Outer Rim planet Batuu, and farmer Julen Rakab developed feelings for her.

Kuiil was an Ugnaught male who had worked a lifetime to be free of servitude. He came to the out-of-the-way planet of Arvala-7 seeking peace, and worked as a vapor farmer who offered valuable skills to those who could meet his price.
Muller was a woman who served as a TIE fighter pilot in the Starfighter Corps of the Galactic Empire's military. She flew with Nashtah Squadron, a unit assigned to army operations.
Anya was a human female who lived in the Saka homestead on the planet Batuu with her family. While Anya played with her siblings, her brother was kidnapped by the enslaver Sampa Grott.

Sampa Grott was a male criminal and enslaver who operated from a sail barge. Grott often kidnapped children from Batuu in order to enslave them. After Grott kidnapped the siblings of a girl named Anya, she sneaked into Grott's home and confronted him at night.
Zandarreo, also known as the Jetsam of Lasan was a Lasat gladiator who was among the enslaved combatants at the Grakkus Arena on Nar Shaddaa.

"Old Hardshell" was the nickname of an acklay owned by the Hutt crime lord Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi who fought in gladiatorial matches at the Grakkus Arena on Nar Shaddaa, which left the acklay battle-scarred.
Hara Wenfare was a Human female who lived in the Jedi Colony on Ossus. She sold stimulants, peppered bantha steak, and a chilled Corellian cocktail.
A Rodian male smuggler was present in the Jedi Colony on Ossus around the start of the third war between the Galactic Republic and reconstituted Sith Empire.

This individual was a Tah'Nuhnan who was the leader of the Mid Rim planet Tah'Nuhna. Her whiskers showed her age, and she was heavily robed. She was killed during the First Order's destruction of Tah'Nuhna.

Chadkol Gee was a Quarren advisor of General Nossor Ri during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. Gee was fiercely isolationist, and was among a contingent of government personnel who confronted Resistance General Leia Organa when she arrived on Mon Cala.
Jonato was a human who was a general in the Resistance during their war against the First Order. He was stationed on the Resistance Camp on Anoat after the Battle of Crait.

Lacezzi Macran was a Selkath male crime lord who led the Firaxa Syndicate on Coruscant's Level 1313. When a number of individuals disappeared across Level 1313, Macran approached the bounty hunter Asajj Ventress to help find the cause.

Meysor was a male individual who was the adopted son of the crime lord Lacezzi Macran, leader of the Firaxa Syndicate on Level 1313 of the planet Coruscant. Macran hoped for Meysor to eventually inherit control of the Firaxa Syndicate.

224 was the designation of a human officer of the Coruscant Security Force's underworld police. On Coruscant's Level 1313, 224 confronted a criminal, but both the criminal and 224 were grabbed by a sarlacc and pulled away.

Fess was a Gigoran male who was a member of the Fylari in the Fylar region of Ontotho. When the Fylari fought and drove off a small force of the Daa Corporation, Fess doubted that they would be able to defend their land against a larger attack.

Norik was an individual who worked for the Resistance during its war against the First Order. Sometime between 34 and 35 ABY, when the Resistance members Finn and Poe Dameron were sent on a mission to gather supplies, Norik, along with Oron, accompanied them to the Wayward Com…
Oron was an individual who, along with Norik, assisted the Resistance members Finn and Poe Dameron on a mission to the Wayward Comet refueling station.
Basso Mak was an Utai warrior who worked with the Kendoh Gang, led by Kendoh Voss. While on the Wayward Comet refueling station, Remex Io, a member of the crew, spotted the Resistance operative Finn.

A staffer working for the Czerka Corporation lived during the Republic Era. In 40 BBY, he was stationed aboard the Leverage, a Czerka Corporation cruiser, while it was in orbit of the Inner Rim planet Pijal.
Kolloma Ree was an individual who served as a captain of the Jedi Order's Jedi Temple Guard.

A male individual served as a member of the Jedi Temple Guard in 19 BBY. After Anakin Skywalker fell to the dark side of the Force, and was dubbed Darth Vader, he was ordered by his Sith Master, Darth Sidious, with eliminating the Jedi in the Jedi Temple.
Naq Med was a Force-sensitive human male who was trained in the ways of the Force as a Padawan in the Jedi Order by a Master. Sometime before the Clone Wars, he left the Order to pursue his own path.

A human officer served as the subordinate of the Galactic Empire's Governor Ahr. After Darth Vader disobeyed Ahr and was ordered by Emperor Palpatine to follow Ahr's commands, the governor attempted to cause the Sith Lord's death.

A First Order lieutenant was stationed the on bridge of the Thunderer, a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer under the command of First Order Agent Tierny and Commander Pyre during their search for the supertanker fuel depot Colossus.

A female individual was the mother of Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono. They raised their son in a wealthy family on the New Republic capital planet Hosnian Prime, alongside his father, senator of the New Republic Hamato Xiono.
A Toydarian woman played sabacc with Leia Organa on Bastatha. Organa quickly defeated them, having learned the game from her husband Han Solo and his friend Lando Calrissian.

Ado Eemon was the silken-tongued ruler of the planet Caramm V in the last years of the Galactic Republic. Eemon maintained control over a personalized fleet of HMP droid gunships, which he ruthlessly deployed in an effort to eliminate those who threatened his power.
Wom-Nii Gnaden was a Jedi Master who served within the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Ech-Char was the king of the planet Mon Cala at the time of the conflict between the First Order and the Resistance. Like his predecessor King Lee-Char during the last days of his life, Ech-Char was maintained on life support.

A human male individual was present at Fondor on its shipyards during the First Order-Resistance War. When Resistance operatives came to Fondor looking for assistance, the individual refused to help them.

Tonkins was an operative of the Resistance. He, another operative, Finn, Poe Dameron, and BB-8 went to the Moon of Avedot. Unbeknownst to them was the Kendoh Gang's intention of hunting the rebel group down, wishing to turn them in to the First Order for a bounty.
