Niobaya was an individual who served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Master. During the Padawan Tournament, Jedi Master Tera Sinube reminded Jedi Initiate Dooku of what Niboya had written regarding attachments shortly before Dooku's duel with his fellow Initiate Sifo-Dyas.

Crakka was a Hutt who was the cousin of the fellow Hutt Jabba Desilijic Tiure, leader of the Hutt Clan. Crakka became estranged from Jabba after threatening to kill him. Several decades later, Crakka visited Jabba at his Palace on the desert planet Tatooine.

Murro was a fathier who served as part of the entertainment at the Grakkus Arena. By 1 ABY, a preliminary advertisement for a planned Vontor's Eve event at the arena on the moon Nar Shaddaa had been sent to the owner of the arena, Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi, along with a question…

A served as a lieutenant for the First Order during the First Order-Resistance War. After spotting Resistance operative Finn at the Wayward Comet, Kendoh Gang informed the First Order lieutenant, who promptly informed his superior, Armitage Hux.

Dagra Van was a Mirialan beastmaster who served Crakka the Hutt. Van captured a hunanetre on the wastes of Rentalles and brought the creature to Jabba's Palace on Tatooine so that Crakka could give it to Jabba Desilijic Tiure as a gift.

This unidentified Tibanna gas miner was one of the many working on Cloud City for greedy corporations exploiting planetary atmospheres. They were unconcerned with any environmental repercussions from his work.

Ika Sulko was a Mon Calamari pilot who flew an A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter for the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Starfighter Corps. His ability to operate within the fighter's rotatable cockpit was heightened due to his inherent kinesthetic sense.

Contispex XI was a Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic who served the Pius Dea faith. Around 11,591 BBY, Contispex XI instigated the Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade, a conflict waged against the Baragwins of Old Barag.
Cadrin Awel was a female Human from the planet Vandor-3 who was romantically linked to General Stavin Thaal of the Galactic Alliance.
Galek was a human female who served the First Order as a lieutenant, flight instructor, and Special Forces member by 34 ABY.

Ploovo Two-For-One was a male individual who acted as Papa Toren's shadow broker for the Corporate Sector and Tion Cluster. One contract for his services was included in the "gift package" that Toren made to Grakkus the Hutt.
The Fourth Sister, formerly known as Lyn Rakish, was a Force-sensitive Nogratu female member of the Inquisitorius during the Imperial Era.

Rersey was a human who served as an advisor to the Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine early in the Imperial Era. Around 12 BBY, he was sent to the planet Mustafar to convey the Emperor's discontent to his apprentice, Darth Vader.
This trooper was a human who served as a volcanic environment stormtrooper with the military rank of sergeant during the Imperial Era. The sergeant was present during an attack on Fortress Vader.

Beaumont Kin was a human male historian who lived during the New Republic Era. Kin was born on Lerct during the Imperial Era and became an educator who was once on track to become one of the youngest professors at Lerct Historical Institute when he instead joined in the Resist…
Zaril was a Defel thief who masterminded a raid on a Jedi vault on Alaris Prime. He was successful at stealing and hiding treasures from the vault, but was pursued across the galaxy by the Jedi.

Terbus was a porg from the ancient planet Ahch-To who hid away aboard the Millennium Falcon. Terbus watched Resistance personnel take on naval forces of the First Order when the First Order launched an attack on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk.

Nenavakasa "Nena" Nalor was a clever female computer engineer. A Nikto who had been abducted by pirates and enslaved by a Hutt clan as a child, Nalor escaped her homeworld and worked as a contractor using her own starship for the First Order; Nalor believed the Order had won t…

Gork was a Gamorrean male pirate who served as a member of Kragan Gorr's pirate gang during the First Order-Resistance War. He was noted to be a gifted arm–wrestler, though his matches typically ended in brawls.

Sal-Deron was a Human female and Jedi Master during the third galactic conflict between Galactic Republic and Sith Empire. She worked with the Republic Strategic Information Service and was one of their best operatives.
Skikkesk was a Trandoshan from the same clan as the promising young Trandoshan Nokk. He led a hunt for young Nokk's coming-of-age ceremony and out of jealousy ordered her to kill a baby Wookiee.
Daz Crano was a Nautolan who served as a pilot in the Resistance. Crano assisted the Millennium Falcon in landing on Kashyyyk during First Order occupation of the planet.
Deja Nebet was a female Human who served as the senator of the planet Onderon during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Keyser Salm was a male pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was the younger brother to Horton Salm, who also served as a pilot.
Akoru was a male Human Beast-Lord of Onderon who led the Untamed during the third Galactic War. He was brother to the Sith Brutann.
Eesmu was a Rodian female who served as a Hutt Cartel representative to Mek-Sha during the third Galactic War.
Indigo was the male leader of the Dar'manda, a group of former Mandalorians operating in Mek-Sha during the third Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and reconstituted Sith Empire.
Kwaak was an individual who served Jabba Desilijic Tiure as a chef at his palace on Tatooine. When celebrating the return of his cousin Crakka, Jabba instructed for Kwaak to prepare a feast.
Prava was a Hutt in charge of the space station that would come to be known as Mek-Sha, during the Galactic War.

Huttbreaker was a Nikto female and the unofficial Queen of the space station Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY. Originally named Gritha Dar, she was brought to the station as a slave to serve the Hutt Cartel's operation led by Prava.

The client of the Sullustan Neb Munb was a Human male who worked for a corporation that produced moisture vaporators. Representing the corporation's charitable arm, he sold vaporators at a steep discount on Tatooine.

A male individual served as a regional governor in the Core Worlds. The planet Lanz Carpo fell under the governor's jurisdiction, but he had an agreement with the crime lord Boss Carpo and his syndicate, in which Carpo reported rebel operatives to the Empire.
Regalun Petryph was a Human male who served as King of Onderon during the renewed Galactic War between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic.
Dita was one of the porgs that had taken up residence on the Millennium Falcon. Rose Tico, who gave names to the porgs, often fed snacks to Dita.
Tessalie was one of several porgs that resided aboard the Millennium Falcon. Rose Tico named all of the porgs, including Tessalie.
Jord was a porg that had taken up residence on the Millennium Falcon, and was named by Rose Tico.
Na-Ne was a porg who resided aboard the Millennium Falcon. When the Falcon landed on the planet Minfar, Na-Ne was one of several porgs who exited the starship to explore the jungle.

Erci was a porg who had stowed away aboard the Millennium Falcon and was given a name by Rose Tico. While flying the starship, Rey noticed a porg land on the control console, and asked it whether it was Erci or Mady.
Mady was one of several porgs who resided aboard the Millennium Falcon. When a porg landed on the Falcon control console while Rey was flying the ship, she asked whether it was Mady or Erci.
Bolin Volfrham was a male human and a wealthy capitalist during the Imperial Era. He had a wife, Willa Volfrham, and at least two children, Jinko, and a baby Xot.

Anosek was a Human male member of the Onderon Royal Family and, together with his sister Anoser, he was a cousin to King Regalun Petryph of Onderon during the renewed Galactic War, a galactic conflict between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic.

Anoser was a Human female member of the Onderon Royal Family and, together with her brother Anosek, she was a cousin to King Regalun Petryph of Onderon during the renewed Galactic War, a galactic conflict between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic.
Reed Wessel was a lieutenant of the Sith Empire's military around the time of the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on Taris providing armstech training and items.
Gharn Efflered was a soldier of the Sith Empire's military around the time of the galactic conflict with the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on Onderon providing armstech training and items.
Rasha was a commander in the military of the Galactic Republic. She fought at the battle for Corellia during the renewed conflict between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Republic.
A Houk male Exchange leader was handling negotiations with a Hutt Cartel representative named Eesmu, on Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY.
Junker Jott was an engineer who served 30 years in the Republic Navy before retiring to lead Jott's Junkers, one of the five ruling crews on Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY.
Trey Adelair was a Human male Czerka Corporation employee in 3627 BBY. Adelair oversaw the operation of a ground team into Dxun's CI-004 Research Facility.

Yarvok was a male Human lieutenant and leader of the Nova Blades pirate gang living during the third Galactic War. In 3627 BBY, the Nova Blades—who were led by Yarvok and paid by the Sith Empire—launched the Dantooine Incursion.
Nara Safalla was a Human female who worked as a scientist for Czerka Corporation. She was stationed in Dxun's CI-004 Research Facility in 3627 BBY.
Mex Briggam was a Human male Czerka Interstellar employee and Chief Engineer in 3627 BBY. Briggam assisted the operation of a ground team into Dxun's CI-004 Research Facility.
"The Client" was a human male who served as an Imperial officer in the Galactic Empire. After the Empire's fall, he continued with the Imperial Remnant, allying with a faction led by Moff Gideon.
Aster was a Human male commander of the Sith Empire's military. He was killed in the Battle of the Meridian Complex in 3627 BBY.
Yarla was an Elnacon female who was a member of the Tech Masters, the rulers of the junk planet Trionak.
Craykan was a Dyplotid male who was one of three Tech Masters, who ruled the junk planet of Trionak.

Everson was a human male servant of the Tech Masters, the three rulers of the junk planet Trionak. When Luke Skywalker was captured while attempt to retrieve the stolen Rebel Alliance transport Nema from Trionak, the Tech Masters ordered Everson to execute him with a firing sq…
Rhodes was an individual who held the rank of admiral within the navy of the Galactic Empire, commanding a Star Destroyer.

Shrem was a human male who worked as a bartender at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on Tatooine. At some point, he assisted Doctor Chelli Aphra with a job, but betrayed her to work with the Trandoshan Skikkesk.
Pacer Agoyo was a human male whose father was a pilot of the New Republic's Phantom Squadron. When the Resistance recruited a number of allies, Agoyo went in his late father's place.

Mzzrzz was a prophet who lived at some point before the time of the Galactic Empire. Mzzrzz claimed to know of a divine consciousness inside a lump of bantha dung, which he believed could lead the galaxy to a new age of enlightenment.
Obinn was a male Kubaz and wealthy crime lord on Kubindi during the Cold War, who needed a shipment delivered to an anonymous client.
Afflas was a female Zeltron con artist who operated on the moon of Nar Shaddaa in the time of the Galactic Empire and teamed up with Lentsch and Loonoo to run a scam.
Konnari was a male Mon Calamari and quartermaster of the Nova Blades pirates. He participated and was killed in the Dantooine Incursion.
CR-1521 was a First Order Treadspeeder Driver who was stationed in Kashyyyk's Black Forest during the First Order's attack on the planet.
FL-6198 was a First Order Treadspeeder Driver during the First Order's invasion of the planet Kashyyyk, where FL-6198 was stationed alongside CR-1521, another treadspeeder pilot, in the Black Forest.
Likana was a young Neimoidian female who lived on the planet Garel during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Climm was a Human male marshal who lived on the planet Vaced. In 43 ABY, Climm and his deputies met up with Han Solo and his family after the Millennium Falcon had been briefly stolen by Cynner and Remata.
Masel was a male Koorivar who operated on Nar Shaddaa as an arms dealer and information broker.
"Warlock" was a Human female and agent of the Sith Empire. She was present on Onderon in 3627 BBY, where she instructed other Imperial Agents.
A Human male royal attendant served as an aide to King Regalun Petryph. He was present in the Royal Hunting Lodge and advised Petryph regarding the political crisis on Onderon in 3627 BBY.
Hugo was an armored exoboar used by the Nova Blades pirates. It was killed during the Dantooine Incursion in 3627 BBY.
Wen Radler was a male employee of Czerka Corporation around 3627 BBY. He was killed and eaten by the orlax Red during an outbreak on Dxun CI-004 Research Facility.

Red was a female orlax developed in Czerka Corporation's CI-004 Research Facility on Dxun. Around 3627 BBY, an outbreak on the facility led to Red escaping and killing Wen Radler. Soon after, she was killed by a strike team sent to handle the situation.

Denfa was a Twi'lek male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the third Galactic War with the Sith Empire. He and his Padawan were assigned to Onderon during the conflict there and were killed by an Imperial.

Kronissus was a Trandoshan male who raided the CI-004 Research Facility on Dxun, in 3627 BBY. He suffered mutations in the Evolutionary Warfare Laboratory and was killed by a security team soon after.
Hissyphus was a Trandoshan male who raided the CI-004 Research Facility on Dxun in 3627 BBY. He suffered mutations in the Evolutionary Warfare Laboratory and was killed by a security team soon after.

Arhul Corubalni was a scout in the Scout Service of the Galactic Republic. Corubalni wrote the initial survey log for the planet Vandor that was filed into Republic Survey Corps. The Corubalni Spaceport and the Corubalni Pass were named after them.
The unidentified Padawan was a Nautolan Padawan who served under Jedi Master Denfa during the third Galactic War. Both the apprentice and their master were slain on Onderon during the conflict there.
Darth Yun was a female Togruta Sith Lord who served the Sith Empire during the third Galactic War. Yun was stationed on Corellia during the battle there but was slain in combat alongside Lord Feng.
Fennec Shand was a human female bounty hunter, elite mercenary, and Master Assassin who worked for the top crime syndicates during the age of the Galactic Empire.

Qweek was a Chadra-Fan male who was once acquainted with the antiques dealer Dok-Ondar on the planet Batuu. During the New Republic Era, years after parting ways with Dok-Ondar, Qweek was present on the desert moon of the planet Oba Diah.
Damian Siegtreg was a Human male and a Sith of the reconstituted Sith Empire. He was present on Onderon in 3627 BBY, where he instructed others on synthweaving.
Wisco was a Human male and a corporal of the Sith Empire. He was present on Onderon in 3627 BBY, where he sold items to travellers.
Winshur Bratt was a Corellian human male who hailed from the town of Bela Vistal on the planet Corellia. Born in the year following the Battle of Yavin, he was placed in a religious center.

Navah was a human female resident of the planet Corellia, who grew up in the town of Bela Vistal. In Coronet City, Navah encountered her former classmate Winshur Bratt, working for the First Order in the Corellian Engineering Corporation.

Sanrec Stronghammer was a male individual who was a pilot of the New Republic's Phantom Squadron. Stronghammer participated in the Battle of Jakku, and after the Galactic Civil War he worked as a security guard for whoever paid.
Monti Calay was a Corellian male who joined the First Order, working for the Records Department of the Corellian Engineering Corporation as a cadet.
Yama Dex was a human female employee of the Corellian Engineering Corporation's Records Department, working for the First Order under Executive Records Officer Winshur Bratt.

Wesson Dove was a female individual who served as pilot of the New Republic's Phantom Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime before the Battle of Crait, Dove married to Raidah Doon and established on Mygeeto where they worked as long haul cargo pilots.
Charth Brethen was a Twi'lek male who served as an ambassador for the Ryloth Defense Authority, a faction of Ryloth's government that wished to remain free from oppression or slavery.
Feng was a human female Sith Lord from the Sith Empire who served on Corellia during the third Galactic War. Feng was slain alongside Darth Yun on Corellia during the battle there.

Hahnee Brethen was a Twi'lek female who was a pilot for the Ryloth Defense Authority, the sister of Charth Brethen and the daughter of Yendor. She was killed while fighting for the Resistance on Ryloth.

Raidah Doon was a female individual who was an athlete and former Stormsailer champion. Doon was the wife of the New Republic pilot Wesson Dove. Doon and her wife later joined the Resistance and participated on a mission to the planet Bracca.

Ishel was a general in the government of Ryloth during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. According to Yendor of the Ryloth Defense Authority, Ishel would be opposed to providing assistance to the Resistance.
Drelomon was a male statesman who served as the chancellor of the Ryloth government during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Tukalda was an Abednedo female who was the neighbor of Norra Wexley and Wedge Antilles in the city of Myrra on the planet Akiva. Tukalda took a dislike to Wexley after the two found political differences during a community dinner party.

Hevasi Joy was a female singer. After the destruction of Hosnian Prime, Joy publicly condemned the First Order, calling for people to join the Resistance. She was later captured and imprisoned by the First Order.
Hasadar Shu was a Corellian male businessman and politician who led the company Shu Industries. His wife, Nifera, was a benefactor for the organization known as the Collective.
Smokey was a male individual who worked as the bartender of the Dead Aeronaut cantina in Coronet City on Corellia.
Jakir Halcyon was a human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the third Galactic War.

Cutar Har was a male athlete and champion of the sport grav-ball. He was thought to have died during the Turclom Riots, but the presence of a name with Har's initials on a First Order list of prisoners led Resistance pilot Temmin Wexley to believe that Har was alive and a pris…

Kade Genti was a fictional character featured in the program Kade Genti, Master of Section Nine. In the program, Genti was a dashing male individual who hailed from Coruscant. While entering an auction hosted by Nifera Shu on Corellia, Finn used Kade Genti's name as an alias.

FN-1971 was the designation of a human stormtrooper who was a member of the First Order's FN Corps. FN-1971 would sneak in comics based on the animated program Kade Genti, Master of Section Nine, and gave them to a young stormtrooper, FN-2187, to read and enjoy.

Genial was a human male who served the First Order as a colonel. As an officer of the Reform Office, he was sent to Corellia to accompany a group of prisoners that were being handed over to Winshur Bratt.

Nifera Shu was the wife of influential Corellian businessman Hasadar Shu, and a benefactor for the Collective. When the Collective acquired a stolen list of First Order targets and prisoners, Shu held an auction to sell it to the highest bidder.

Seldin was a Selonian Jedi and member of the Green Jedi. Seldin served during the third Galactic War fought between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, and was killed defending the Meridian Complex against an Imperial attack.
Puwanini, nicknamed Puwan, was a female individual who worked for the Scrapper Guild on Bracca after joining around a year before the First Order-Resistance War.

Vindo was a Cathar female and a Major of the Galactic Republic during the third Galactic War. She led the Republic garrison on Dantooine when the planet was invaded by the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Nova Blades.
Kad Solus was a Mandalorian individual who was a foundling and served as the second-in-command to Chieftain Vera Beroya of Clan Awaud, who led a battalion of Mandalorian warriors.

Teroch, nicknamed "Old Teroch," was a Mandalorian human male of the Old Mandalorian faction and was stationed on Vlemoth Port alongside a battalion of Mandalorian warriors led by Clan Awaud. Teroch was also a pilot, and at one point in time, flew a Fang fighter in combat.
Bregan was a male Human of Onderon within the isolationist group known as the Untamed during the third Galactic War.

Loddu was a Hutt who was a low-ranking member of the Hutt Cartel. In 3638 BBY, when the Cartel annexed the planet Makeb, he was tasked with identifying competitors to the Cartel's isotope-5 mining operations.

A female pilot from Corellia, born in the town of Doaba Guerfel, took a mission for the Resistance to steal an encryption key from the First Order. She acquired the key and escaped in a stolen TIE fighter, but was pursued.

A human slicer worked for the Collective, an underground organization on the planet Corellia. On behalf of the Collective, they visited the Dead Aeronaut cantina for a lunchtime meeting with Monti Calay, a cadet who worked in the Records Department of the Corellian Engineering…

Xizor was a Falleen male prince-turned-crime-lord who ruled the Black Sun criminal syndicate. The prince was headquartered in the Southern Underground region of the Coruscant Underworld where he owned a 102-story-high palace.

Tanya Helios was an Atterran female who served as chief instructor of the Firestone Technical Academy on the planet Atterra Bravo and was a member of the Bravo Rising resistance team against the First Order in 34 ABY.

Flanx was a male Gozzo and the cousin of Flix. After Floog's retirement, Flanx took over running the flock's fuel refinery on Drahgor III. He looked down on Flix for leaving to become a cantina singer.

Floog was a male individual who ran the Drahgor III station fuel refinery on the planet Drahgor III with the help of his nephews Flanx and Flix, as well as Flix's cousins—Fleck, Fleez, and Flobb. At some point, Flix stopped working for Floog.

Darrus Rantarovo was an Atterran male who served as foreman of the Big Settlement hydro farm on the planet Atterra Bravo until the planet's hydro farms were taken over by the First Order. He was also a member of the Bravo Rising resistance team against the First Order in 34 ABY.

This Rothkahar philosopher was a philosopher who founded the gaseous planet of Ephemera. They also discovered that the excrement of a certain kind of feline had healing properties due to the fact that there was a high amount of tibanna gas in it.

The mother of Winshur Bratt was a human female who lived in the town of Bela Vistal on Corellia. In his younger years, Bratt's mother used to make her son go to a religious center, much to his disdain.

A human male served as the warden of Sunspot Prison, a Rebel Alliance space station that acted as a prison for Imperial personnel. When Leia Organa and Sana Starros traveled to the prison to hand over Doctor Chelli Aphra, an associate of Darth Vader, the warden met with them.
Ehmyr was as a Human male Jedi Master who served as a Jedi Consular and combat instructor on Onderon during the third Galactic War .
El'Josten was a was as a Human male Jedi Master who served as an instructor for Jedi on Onderon during third Galactic War.
Tuki was a human male pilot who served as a captain in the Rebel Alliance's Black Squadron during the Imperial Era. He was killed on Lokud 7 by Darth Vader after stealing Imperial intelligence.
The pilot Pacer Agoyo had a brother who Agoyo believed was killed by Teza Nasz. Pacer got into a fight with Nasz due to this, wishing to avenge his brother's death.
A female individual was the aunt of Wedge Antilles who once worked for the Corellian Engineering Corporation.

Tarnux was a male Sith Lord that served the Sith Empire around 3627 BBY as an Executioner. He was stationed on Mek-Sha under the command of his master Darth Shaar but was killed there in battle with the Galactic Republic.
Fleck was a male Gozzo and the cousin of Flix. He worked at the flock's fuel refinery on Drahgor III.
Fleez was a male Gozzo and the cousin of Flix. He worked at the flock's fuel refinery on Drahgor III.
Flobb was a male Gozzo and the cousin of Flix. He worked at the flock's fuel refinery on Drahgor III. Flobb owned a blaster pistol, which was kept in a toolbox.
Beskad was a female member of the Dar'manda, a group of former Mandalorians operating in Mek-Sha during the third Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and reconstituted Sith Empire.

A Zygerrian female served as a pirate in the gang led by Captain Gwarm. During Gwarm's search for the supposed lost treasure of the pirate queen Rane Mahal, the Zygerrian accompanied Gwarm and his gang to Kelada, where they pretended to chase fellow pirate Makkeer into The Lab…

Calik was a pirate who served in the crew of the pirate queen Rane Mahal. When the pirate gang led by Gwarm arrived on Sakreen, where Mahal's crew had been stranded, Mahal and her crew stole Gwarm's starship, the Hand of Am-Shak, and escaped the world.
Thok was a Gamorrean pirate who was a member of the gang led by Captain Gwarm. Thok accompanied Gwarm on his search for the supposed lost treasure of the pirate queen Rane Mahal.
The mother of Kyp Durron was a female politician who lived on the colony world of Deyer in the Anoat system during the age of the Galactic Empire and was the mother of two sons, Kyp and Zeth Durron.

Din Grogu, known only as Grogu until being formally adopted by Din Djarin after the Liberation of Mandalore, was a male Force-sensitive Mandalorian belonging to the same mysterious species as the legendary Grand Master Yoda.
A human male bartender worked in a public house on the ice planet Pagodon. In 9 ABY, three trawlers began harassing a Mythrol in the bar, which the bartender watched but did nothing to prevent.

Barlidan was a gray-skinned male Kubaz who worked as a ferryman on the ice planet Pagodon in 9 ABY, the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin approached the ferryman with a bounty he had captured in a nearby cantina, seeking transport to his gunship, the Razor Crest.
"The Armorer" was a human female Mandalorian Armorer from Mandalore who led the Tribe, a part of the Children of the Watch, during the New Republic Era.
"The Fledgling Mythrol", sometimes simply called "The Mythrol," was a Mythrol male who worked for Greef Karga until he stole from him and fled.
The Quarren Trawler was a Quarren who worked on the ice planet Pagodon and harassed a Mythrol in a public house there alongside two other trawlers.
The Alpha Trawler was a human who, along with a human companion and a Quarren companion, threatened a Mythrol in a public house on the ice planet Pagodon around 9 ABY.

The Beta Trawler was a human male trawler during the New Republic era in 9 ABY, along with another human and a Quarren. He watched as his two companions threatened a Mythrol in a public house at the settlement Ferryman's Reach on the ice planet Pagodon.

Pyan Bosen was a human male speeder pilot who worked with the Kubaz ferryman Barlidan to transport customers on the ice planet Pagodon with his landspeeder. In 9 ABY, Bosen drove a bounty hunter known as Din Djarin and his bounty across the ice to Djarin's gunship.
Yuralla Vega, known as Yura, was a human female resident of Chorin during the Imperial Era. She was the lover of Beilert Valance, a miner from Chorin who left to join the Galactic Empire.

A male individual was the father of the human male Pacer Agoyo, who also had a sister named Puwanini and a brother. Agoyo's father flew as a pilot in the New Republic's Phantom Squadron during the Liberation of Kashyyyk in 5 ABY. By 34 ABY, the man had passed away.
Jaro Tapal, a Force-sensitive Lasat male, was a Jedi Master who served the Galactic Republic with distinction as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Frost was a Cathar male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic. Frost was stationed on Taris during the Cold War.

Taron Malicos was a human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi General during the Clone Wars. During Order 66 in 19 BBY, he was attacked by his clone troopers but escaped to the planet Dathomir using his starship.
Sorc Tormo was an Umbaran male crime lord who led the Haxion Brood criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era.
Null Chance was a humanoid bounty hunter who worked for the Haxion Brood criminal syndicate. Chance had a variety of equipment, including a jetpack and a flamethrower.
Eilram was a Force-sensitive Zeffonian, and one of three of their species who were revered as great sages.
Miktrull was a powerful and prideful Force-sensitive Zeffonian sage.
Kujet was a Force-sensitive Zeffonian held up as one of the greatest, if infamous, of the culture's icons.

Merrin was a Dathomirian Nightsister who lived on her homeworld of Dathomir during the Imperial Era. A survivor of General Grievous' massacre of the Nightsisters during the Clone Wars, Merrin encountered the Jedi Master Taron Malicos after he crash-landed on Dathomir following…
Krane was a humanoid female officer of the Galactic Empire who took charge of Project Auger, an Imperial mining operation to excavate the many ancient artifacts on the planet of Zeffo.

Mari Kosan was a human female who served as a lieutenant in Saw Gerrera's Partisans. Kosan assisted with Gerrera's mission to disrupt Imperial supply lines on Kashyyyk, and wished to stay to assist the native Wookiees.

Mirienna was a human female resident of the planet Zeffo during the Imperial Era. When the Galactic Empire occupied Zeffo for their Project Auger, displacing the citizens of a Zeffo village, Mirienna's husband Ostar led several stormtroopers away so that she could escape with …

Ostar was a male individual who was the husband of Mirienna and the father of Sienna. When the Galactic Empire occupied their village on Zeffo, Ostar distracted several stormtroopers so that Mirienna and her daughter could escape alive.

Sienna was a female individual who was the daughter of Mirienna and Ostar, who lived in a village on the planet Zeffo. The Empire occupied Zeffo, and Sienna's father Ostar distracted stormtroopers so that Mirienna and her daughter could escape and was killed in the process.
Shippu was a Human female Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic. During the Cold War she was stationed on Balmorra.
Elder Chettkap was a Jawa male who served as the chief of a Jawa tribe on the planet Arvala-7. Around 9 ABY, the tribe stole parts from the Mandalorian Din Djarin's gunship, the Razor Crest.
Markon was a general who served in the 201st Squadron of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army. Between 19 BBY and 14 BBY, the 201st Squadron visited the Outer Rim Territories planet Zeffo.
Kral was a male Human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who at some point during the Cold War fell to the dark side of the Force and planned to defect to the Sith Empire.
This Clone Commander was a Clone Commander who was part of the military unit led by Jedi General Chiata and Jedi Commander Marseph, and was stationed aboard a Venator-class Star Destroyer.
Mar Ti 'Bucky' Kam'Ron was a venerable Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. He visited the Jedi Temple on the Unknown Regions planet Ilum and established a meditation site on top of the temple.

Ooba-Neba Nocci was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order. Sometime before or during 19 BBY, Nocci oversaw a group of Jedi younglings on the Unknown Regions planet Ilum during the Gathering, a rite of passage in which younglings ventured into the Crystal Caves to retrie…

Chiata was a female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars, training the Padawan Marseph. During a battle against a Separatist dreadnought, Chiata's Venator-class Star Destroyer crashed onto the planet Zeffo.

Bing was a fair-skinned humanoid bounty hunter affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. They wore yellow and white armor and helmet, yellow boots, a brown belt, and a tan shirt and pants.
The Huntsman was a male humanoid bounty hunter affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate. They were struck down by Cal Kestis.
A Clone Commander was the clone trooper officer of the 13th Battalion who served under Jedi General Jaro Tapal during the Clone Wars and held the military rank of Clone Commander.
Hua-Po was a female Lethan Twi'lek and Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. She was stationed on Voss during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The mother of Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs was a female individual who taught her son how to make topato stew upon witnessing his growing passion for cooking.

Ehla Mi was a female Rutian Twi'lek Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. She was stationed on Quesh during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. There she taught Republic citizens how to create artifacts and relics.

Hellencha was a Mirialan female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire she was stationed on Ilum where she taught Treasure Hunting to Republic aligned individuals.

Tseyla was a Mirialan female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire she was stationed on Coruscant where she served as a Jedi Consular and combat instructor.

Sir Chogs was a male humanoid bounty hunter affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate. In 14 BBY, they fought Cal Kestis and were defeated. He was equipped with an A280C blaster rifle, a bracer on his left arm, and flash grenades.
Cehrazad was a humanoid bounty hunter commando affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate. Cehrazad was one of the bounty hunters sent after Cal Kestis.
Mad Midge was a bounty hunter affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate.
Crusher Hagop was a humanoid bounty hunter affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate.

Anti was a fair-skinned humanoid bounty hunter affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. They wore white, blue, and grey armor as well as white boots, a brown belt, and a tan shirt and pants.

Choyyssyk was a Wookiee male commander and member of Chieftain Tarfful's resistance group on Kashyyyk during the Imperial Era. He was captured and imprisoned in the Imperial Refinery, but was freed with the help of Saw Gerrera's Partisans and the former Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis.
Atticus Rex was a bounty hunter who worked for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate. Rex was sent to hunt the Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis during his second mission to Zeffo.
TK-8190 was the designation of a human stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire under its military branch, the Stormtrooper Corps. In 14 BBY, the stormtrooper was stationed on the planet Bracca.
Locke was a Chagrian male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. During the Cold War he was stationed on Carrick Station.

Verston was a male Yuuzhan Vong warrior who served under Commander Tsalok. During the Heart of Artorias's rescue mission on Dibrook in 25 ABY, Verston informed Tsalok that Warmaster Tsavong Lah had made contact with them only to be dismissed by the Master Shaper Nagme.
Henshin was a Zabrak male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic. Henshin was stationed on Taris during the Cold War.
Mika Grey was a Force-sensitive human female archaeologist. Around 31 ABY, she began scouring the galaxy for Sith artifacts, hoping to acquire them before the First Order could.
Raith was a human First Order Raider who led a squad, serving under the First Order Supreme Leader Kylo Ren. The agent led their squad across the galaxy, searching for dark side relics.
Pyloon was a Latero female who was the great-grandmother of pilot Greez Dritus. As Dritus' parents were not present, she raised Greez and taught him several culinary secrets and recipes.
Oovo Adnan was a light-skinned humanoid bounty hunter that worked for the Haxion Brood during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Nohogg, known as "Grand Moff" Nohogg, was a humanoid who worked as a bounty hunter for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era.
Bad Fran was a humanoid who worked as a bounty hunter for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate.

Broonsie was a humanoid individual who served the Haxion Brood crime syndicate as a bounty hunter commando during the reign of the Galactic Empire. They wore a yellow cybernetic right arm, a gray shirt, a blue chest plate, a kama, and a gray and blue helmet.
Dunya was a humanoid who worked as a bounty hunter for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era.
Red Kindie was a humanoid bounty hunter who served the Haxion Brood criminal syndicate.

Ilyana was a female Dathomirian Zabrak Nightsister of the planet Dathomir. A member of Mother Talzin's clan, she was close to her fellow Nightsister Merrin, and the two would sneak out to make potions in the swamps.
Sootun was a male humanoid who was kept as a prisoner of the Haxion Brood on board the criminal group's base of operations, the space station Ordo Eris.

Terow was a Nautolan male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire he was stationed on Ilum where he taught Republic aligned individuals the skill of investigation.
Saucer Head was the nickname of a male sabacc dealer who operated on Vandor around 10 BBY. He dealt for a game between the smuggler Lando Calrissian, the outlaw Han Solo and some other players.
Namala Moffat was a teacher at a school on Merokia. She encountered one student, the Force-sensitive Karr Nuq Sin, wearing a stormtrooper helmet in an attempt to witness a vision from it.
Janu Blenn was a male student at a school on Merokia. His great-grandfather served as a stormtrooper for the Galactic Empire, and Karr Nuq Sin bought his helmet from Blenn.

Zarado was an individual of a species that possessed horns who was a student at a school on the desert planet Merokia during the time of the New Republic, at the same time as the Force-sensitive Karr Nuq Sin. At the age of thirteen years old, Zarado's horns began to grow longer.

Lara was a member of a species that possessed fur who was a student of a school on the planet Merokia alongside the Force-sensitive Karr Nuq Sin during the time of the New Republic. At the age of thirteen years old, Lara's adult coat of fur started to grow in.
Royke was a Besalisk male and a student at a school on Merokia. He often harassed Karr Nuq Sin, a fellow student who was sensitive to the Force.
Kragnotto was an Ankura Gungan male who worked as a teacher at a school on Merokia. He was in charge of the science program. He spoke in a Gungan dialect.
Trag was a male individual who was the older brother of Karr Nuq Sin.

Vroc Raynshi was a human male who served as an officer of the First Order during the era of the New Republic. He was the husband of Anaya Raynshi and the father of Maize Raynshi, who was forced to move between planets often due to her father's job.
Flatakk was a humanoid bounty hunter affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate.

Pango Two-Teeth was a humanoid bounty hunter affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate under the commando position. They had a cybernetic right arm and other cybernetic enhancements created from smuggled droid parts.
Hela Enn was a humanoid bounty hunter affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate.
Looway Nuq Sin was the mother of Karr Nuq Sin, living on Merokia with the rest of her family.
Tomar Nuq Sin was a human male who was the partner of Looway Nuq Sin, living on Merokia with their son, Karr. He was the son of J'Hara and grandson of Naq Med, a former Jedi Padawan.
Cornell was a male individual who was the brother of Tomar Nuq Sin and the uncle of Karr Nuq Sin. He was a teacher at a trade school in Taeltor Province on Merokia.

Sconto was a human male merchant who owned a junk shop in Pau City on the planet Utapau. According to Sconto's mother, whom he did not doubt, his father was a clone trooper who fought in the Clone Wars.
Anaya Raynshi was a Mirialan female, the wife of Vroc Raynshi, and the mother of Maize Raynshi.
Delequia was an Ithorian Female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire she was stationed on Ilum.

Demas was a Male Miraluka Jedi Master stationed on Corellia during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. While on Corellia he taught Republic individuals the skill of Diplomacy.
A female saboteur infiltrated Imperial staging station Lansend Twenty-Six during Nightswan's campaign.

Vranki, known as Vranki the Blue, was a Hutt who ran a hotel and casino. As proprietor, host, and promoter of Vranki's Hotel and Casino, Vranki the Blue's corpulent form glided around his resort, overseeing his massive empire of gambling and racing.
An individual served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic around 85 BBY.

Kupe, designated RC-1573 was a Republic commando and member of the elite clone commando squad led by Captain Nilo known as Tark Squad, which was part of the Special Operations Brigade of the Galactic Republic in 21 BBY.

Ro'tahn was a Human male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic. Ro'tahn was stationed on Corellia during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Jen Feyer was a Human Female Jedi Master stationed on Hoth during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. While on Hoth she taught the skill of Artifice to Republic individuals.

Marseph was a male Jedi Padawan trained by the Jedi Master Chiata. As a member of the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic, Marseph participated in a battle against a Separatist dreadnought, although their Venator-class Star Destroyer was damaged and crash-landed on the Zeffo'…

Krabe was a human male Scout Trooper Commander that served the Galactic Empire in 14 BBY. He was stationed on Bogano and recorded a tactical report on its fauna. Krabe was eventually killed by the Jedi Cal Kestis.

Lesina was a Human female Jedi Master stationed on Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. While on Taris she taught synthweaving to Republic individuals.

Velgat was a Nautolan male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire he was stationed on Taris where he taught Republic individuals the skill of Artifice.
Paz Vizsla was a male human Heavy Infantry Mandalorian from the planet Mandalore who was a member of the Tribe, a part of the Children of the Watch, during the reign of the New Republic.

Samok was a Zabrak male Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic. Samok was stationed on Coruscant during the Cold War. While on Coruscant he taught new skills to any Jedi who wished to learn.

A Mon Calamari nobleman's son was wanted by the Bounty Hunters' Guild after skipping bail and hiding in the ocean dunes of Karnac. A bounty was later placed on him, whose puck was acquired by the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin in 9 ABY.
A Mon Calamari male was a nobleman and the father of a Mon Calamari who hid in the ocean dunes of Karnac after skipping bail during the New Republic Era.
Oos-Rin-Arrek was a Tiss-shar contortionist and member of the Gullet Gang in the Terrabe sector, alongside Cycyed Ock and Kullbee Sperado prior to their joining Saw Gerrera's Partisans.
Tabbers was an acquaintance of the Scrapper Guild Riggers Cal Kestis and Prauf during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 14 BBY, he was on the moon Nar Shaddaa and owed Kestis a favor.
Tallus was an individual who served the Galactic Empire as a lieutenant in the Imperial Military. Around 14 BBY, the officer was stationed at the forested planet of Kashyyyk.

A Human male served as the leader of a Czerka Corporation strike team. In 3643 BBY, the strike team apprehended former Czerka employee Kamus Orden on Tatooine, inside a Republic Strategic Information Service safehouse in Anchorhead.

In 3640 BBY, a Sullustan captain was present in Nar Shaddaa's spaceport during the engagement between Republic Strategic Information Service agent Theron Shan and the forces of the Hutt crime lord Morbo.

A Houk agent was working for the Republic Strategic Information Service on the planet Nar Shaddaa, watching over the Hutt Morbo as part of Operation Transom. In 3640 BBY, he brawled with fellow agent Theron Shan, unaware of his allegiance.
A Cathar sergeant of the Galactic Republic was captured during the Cold War between Republic and Sith Empire.

Deedot Irepip was a humanoid bounty hunter affiliated with the Haxion Brood crime syndicate. They were one of the many bounty hunters sent by the Brood to kill Cal Kestis, only for Deedot to perish at Cal's hands.

A Human male security officer served in a Czerka Corporation strike team. The team attempted to kill former Czerka employee Kamus Orden inside a Republic Strategic Information Service safehouse in Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine, but was stopped by an individual allied with …
During the youth of Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, there was a Sikurdian Jedi Padawan who was rejected from further Jedi training by the Jedi High Council.
Panark was a Human male Jedi Master stationed on Tython during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Xfere Lyoon was a Miraluka male Jedi Master stationed on Balmorra during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

According to legends, Q'rnaf B'lair was a Human Jedi who fell defending the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine from Darth Malak, and was one of the Jedi that Malak kept in stasis to draw power from aboard the Star Forge.
Armatan was a human male Mandalorian who served in the Mandalorian Government Council of the New Mandalorians during the Clone Wars as Minister of the Interior.
Mirli Lok was a female Mandalorian warrior who lived during the third Galactic War.

Orlok, nicknamed the "Gamemaster" by Likana, was a human male who held the title of Director in the First Order Security Bureau. Orlok served on Garel, where he developed new technology to control the entire planet's communications.

Karn was a Human male settler and farmer on the planet Muzara. He came to the planet with his family—his wife, his brother-in-law Tallov Kersk, Tallov's wife, his daughter Cavvie, and his nephew Vettle—in 4000 BBY.

Cavvie was the daughter of Karn and his wife. She settled on the planet Muzara with her family, including her uncle and aunt and cousin Vettle—in 4000 BBY. The family were the first settlers from the Brentaal League to encounter the planet's native species, the Muza.

Vettle was the son of Tallov Kersk and his wife. He settled on the planet Muzara with his family, including his uncle and aunt and cousin Cavvie—in 4000 BBY. The family were the first settlers from the Brentaal League to encounter the planet's native species, the Muza.
Krispus Eleaor was a nobleman from the planet Kashi. Eleaor founded Eleaor Propulsion, a company that produced customized luxury vehicles.

SN-1208 was a human stormtrooper of the First Order. One of the many troopers dispatched to Kashyyyk during the First Order's blockade of the planet, SN-1208 searched for the Wookiee Chewbacca in the Black Forest, but Chewbacca managed to evade the stormtroopers.
Winta was a human female child who lived in a farming village on the planet Sorgan during the time of the New Republic. She was the daughter of Omera.

Caben was a human male krill farmer who resided in a village on the planet Sorgan. He, along with fellow farmer Stoke, attempted to hire the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin to deal with raiders stealing their harvest.

Stoke was a human male who lived as a krill farmer in a small village on the planet Sorgan. He went with another farmer from his village, Caben, to try to convince Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin to deal with raiders taking their harvest.

A Kubaz male operated as a bounty hunter during the era of the New Republic. The Kubaz tracked a target, a child under the protection of the bounty hunter known as the Mandalorian, to the planet Sorgan.
Sastos was a Klatooinian who served as the captain of a group of raiders. Sastos led a number of attacks on a farming village on the planet Sorgan.
Dara Vish was a human female proprietor hailing from the planet Sorgan who worked at the Common House on the world.

This male was the grandfather of the krill farmer Caben. He lived with a tribe in a village on Sorgan prior to the fall of the Galactic Empire. Along with his wife, he was among the farmers who first seeded the ponds to attract the krill that sustained the village.
This female individual was the grandmother of the krill farmer Caben. She lived with a tribe in a village on Sorgan prior to the fall of the Galactic Empire.

KY-1661 was a human stormtrooper who served in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. In 14 BBY, during his secret mission to rebuild the Jedi Order, the Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis overheard two of KY-1661's fellow stormtroopers discuss how KY-1661 had apparently been permanen…

Sai'torr Kal Fas was Saurin female who was a skilled warrior, serving as bodyguard for her cousin Hrchek Kal Fas. Hrchek wisely kept her close when the pair visited Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine in 1 BBY.

This male individual was the father of Mirienna and grandfather of Sienna. After the death of his daughter's husband Ostar on the planet Zeffo, his granddaughter Sienna was sent to live with him on the planet Chandrila.
Marko was a male bounty hunter. He carried a blaster pistol, knife and thermal detonator. Marko was able to speak Huttese, and was skilled in the operation of an Incom Corporation A-24 Sleuth.
Lentsch was a male con artist who operated on the moon of Nar Shaddaa in the time of the Galactic Empire and teamed up with Afflas and Loonoo to run a scam.
Chuppa Chok was a scrivener working for the Varcinius Agglomeration. He was responsible for recording the Smuggler's Guide entry into the Varcinius Repository on Clerion.

Grullbug was a male pirate of the Blazing Claw. He served under the pirate queen Gunda Mabin as part of the Bloody Bones crew. Grullbug killed several opponents during a raid against a Ghtroc star yacht on the Atrian Merchants' Causeway.

Hawson was a male pirate of the Blazing Claw. He served under the pirate queen Gunda Mabin as part of the Bloody Bones crew. Hawson participated in a raid against a Ghtroc star yacht on the Atrian Merchants' Causeway.
Banden Starshaper was a male thief who was part of Gallandro's crew for the Varcinius Repository vault job, serving as seal-cracker. He was a former member of the Marso's Demons.

Kilitz was a burglar and a veteran tunneler during the Malkite land grab, who together with his brother Kling was known as The Twins. He was part of Gallandro's crew for the Varcinius Repository vault job.

Kling was a burglar and a veteran tunneler during the Malkite land grab, who together with his brother Kilitz was known as The Twins. He was part of Gallandro's crew for the Varcinius Repository vault job.

Quo, designated RC-1572, was a Republic commando and member of the elite clone commando squad led by Captain Nilo known as Tark Squad, which was part of the Special Operations Brigade of the Galactic Republic in 21 BBY.

The Marquess was a female criminal who at some point was associated with the pirate Hondo Ohnaka. She assisted Ohnaka during an auction for a fake Maz Kanata's Journal. Hondo and her held three separate auctions, one for each forge Bar the Rotter, made.
Rosallia was a female pirate member of the Blazing Claw. She served under the pirate queen Gunda Mabin as part of the Bloody Bones crew.
Varcinius, seventy-second of his name, was a male leader of the Varcinius Agglomeration.
An Ovissian served as the headmaster of a school on the planet Merokia.

The father of Sconto was a human male clone trooper who fought in the Clone Wars as part of the Galactic Republic's clone army. Like all clone troopers, he hailed from the planet Kamino, where clones were grown using the genetic template of the bounty hunter Jango Fett.
Maslo-Skaff was a Sullustan Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. Maslo-Skaff had a cybernetic eye and arm, white tied hair, and a short beard.

Odu was an Ithorian Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. Circa 40 BBY, the Ithorian wielded a blue-bladed lightsaber, and was sent alongside Jedi Mace Windu, Luminara Unduli, and Maslo-Skaff to assist Eno Cordova and Cere Junda during a war on Ontotho.

Gastum was an individual under the employment of Risha Synata. Gastum was intended to allow for the private visit by Padmé Amidala and Anakin Skywalker to Madam Synata's Genius of A Thousand Faces Museum on board Synata's ship.
Cavic was a human male bounty hunter and former member of the Galactic Empire who was an associate of Beilert Valance. Cavic set up a number of outposts in asteroid fields, hidden from the Empire.
Bek was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala who served alongside Nien Nunb as a pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
"Blue Five" was a woman and a Mirialan. As a pilot for the Resistance Starfighter Corps' Blue Squadron, she helmed a T-70 X-wing starfighter.

"Red Two" was a male Human pilot that flew a T-70 X-wing starfighter for the Resistance. He, along with Poe Dameron and Blue Five, was one of the pilots escorting an Intersystem Transport Ship leaving Batuu carrying new recruits.

An individual was the ex of the Corellian Monti Calay. The two had dated at some point before Calay started working for the First Order. Due to their relationship, Calay's Corellian Security Forces identification card was updated to list the ex as one of his known acquaintances.
The grandfather of Orrin Gault was a Human male.
Toro Calican was a human male bounty hunter during the time of the New Republic. Looking to get into the Bounty Hunters' Guild, Calican took a job to find the assassin Fennec Shand on Tatooine.

Peli Motto was a human female who managed Hangar 3-5 at Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine. Motto was a skilled engineer and made her living repairing and refueling starships. Though scrappy and brutally honest, she was a compassionate and hardworking proprietor.

Riot Mar was a human male bounty hunter working for the Bounty Hunters' Guild. In 9 ABY, he attempted to capture the bounty known as Grogu by pursuing the Mandalorian Din Djarin, a bounty hunter who had betrayed the Guild, in his own customized Helix J-104 starfighter.
Garl Lykan was a human male TIE fighter pilot in the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing of the Galactic Empire. He saved the life of fellow pilot Armenauth shortly after the Battle of Endor.
Threll was an officer serving in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During a mission in a dense jungle, Threll directed the eight soldiers under his command to repair a cargo speeder.

Nacrotis was a poet, known for being eccentric and indifferent to the suffering of others. He was favored by an influential Moff. Nacrotis would ingratiate himself into a person's life, gaining their trust before using his power and influence to destroy them.

A Chagrian served as a middle man for the Hidden Hand criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era. At some point, he learned of a deal between the arms dealer Wef and another crime syndicate, the Pykes, and arrived at their meetup point.
Vusk was a male Kassk pirate in the Warbird gang. He had yellow skin, green eyes, and wore white scout trooper armor with red markings.

Aeliar was a human female officer of the Rebel Alliance. In order to acquire weapons for the Rebellion, Aeliar intended to purchase from the Hidden Hand crime syndicate while Darth Vader was distracted by a group of bounty hunters hunting him down.

Hennix was a Force-sensitive Quarren Jedi Padawan who lived during the New Republic Era, having joined the Jedi Order under Jedi Master Luke Skywalker. Upon the destruction of the Jedi Temple, Hennix along with Voe and Tai questioned Ben Solo.
Voe was a Force-sensitive human female Jedi Padawan who lived during the New Republic Era, having joined the Jedi Order under Jedi Master Luke Skywalker.

Nakano Lash was a Nautolan female bounty hunter active during the Imperial Era. She operated out of a ship called the Starskimmer. She became the mentor of bounty hunter Beilert Valance after saving him from stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire.
Thassilio Smeuse was a human who operated as a deep-cover spy for the Rebel Alliance. During the Galactic Civil War, Smeuse posed as an officer of the Galactic Empire on the world of Ozri II.

Vharn was a human engineer from Sorgal 12 who worked for the Rebel Alliance during the Imperial Era. At some point prior to the Battle of Hoth, Vharn created schematics for a rebel shield generator, and needed to be transported to the cruiser Home One to deliver them.
Cordo was a human who served as a sergeant in the Imperial Military.
This female individual was the mother of Cronal. She had borne Cronal, and shortly after Cronal's birth, Cronal was taken from her. Cronal suspected her to have been a witch from Dathomir.
Xi'an was a Twi'lek female mercenary from Ryloth. At some point, she worked with the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin.

Migs Mayfeld was a human male mercenary who was a former sharpshooter in the Imperial Army. During the time of the New Republic, Mayfeld was recruited by the criminal Ranzar Malk to lead a team to rescue the prisoner Qin from Bothan-5, a New Republic Correctional Transport.

Burg was a Devaronian male who operated as a mercenary during the era of the New Republic. Burg acted as the muscle of a team recruited by Ranzar Malk to rescue the prisoner Qin from the Bothan-5, a New Republic Correctional Transport, which also included Migs Mayfeld, Xi'an, …
Qin, designated prisoner X-6-9-11 after being arrested by the New Republic, was a Twi'lek male mercenary from Ryloth and the twin brother of Xi'an.
Trapper Wolf was a human pilot and officer for the New Republic. He flew an T-65B X-wing starfighter as leader of an attack squadron with pilots Sash Ketter and Jib Dodger.

Jib Dodger was a human male pilot in the service of the New Republic. He was one of three pilots sent to follow a tracker activated by Lant Davan, a crewmember aboard a New Republic prison transport, when a team of mercenaries boarded the ship to rescue the prisoner Qin.

Sash Ketter was a human female pilot of the New Republic. She, along with pilots Trapper Wolf and Jib Dodger, was sent to follow a distress signal sent from the Bothan-5, a New Republic Correctional Transport, that had been infiltrated by mercenaries.

Lant Davan, designated "DC1," was a human male corrections officer who held the rank of lieutenant within the New Republic Correctional Corps. He served as the sole organic crew member on the correctional transport Bothan-5.

Kova was a Force-sensitive Rutian Twi'lek female who pulled off a heist with a crew during the rule of the Galactic Empire after buying weapons from a Toydarian named Nel Henol. She wielded a lightsaber.
Around 14 ABY, the Chironian slave Lusa was sold to an individual who supported the Empire Reborn.

Engels was a human who served as an officer in the military of the Galactic Empire. At the time of the early rebellion against the Empire, he had the rank of captain, and was in charge of a metal factory hovering in the atmosphere of Dooma 4, supervising the production of the …
"Ren" was the alias of a human male Force-sensitive who led the Knights of Ren during the last years of the Galactic Civil War and well into the era of the New Republic.
Trudgen was a humanoid male Force-sensitive who served as a member of the Knights of Ren, under the command of an individual known as Ren, and later Kylo Ren.

Karrst was a human male who had the ability to use the Force. Working with his brother, Filin, Karrst killed at least one hundred people. Ren, the leader of the dark side organization known as the Knights of Ren, sought out Karrst to recruit him into their ranks.

Filin was a human male criminal who worked with his older brother, Karrst. Due to the many murders they committed, and due to Karrst's sensitivity to the Force, the Knights of Ren, a dark side organization led by an individual known as Ren, sought to recruit Karrst into their …
Kuruk was a humanoid Force-sensitive male who served as a member of the Knights of Ren, under the command of an individual known as Ren.

Taur Deeves was an Iridonian Zabrak male who fought in a common house on Sorgan. In 9 ABY, he fought the former rebel shock trooper Carasynthia Dune, who defeated him by making him tap out the Laser Tether that connected the two fighters.

A human male bounty hunter operated as a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild during the era of the New Republic. Around 9 ABY, the hunter was recruited by Greef Karga to steal a force-sensitive child from Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin.
A Kadas'sa'Nikto male operated as a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild during the era of the New Republic.

A Trandoshan male operated as a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild during the era of the New Republic. In 9 ABY, the bounty hunter was recruited by Greef Karga to steal a force-sensitive child from the Mandalorian.
The Skykeeper serving the Pijali monarchy under Princess Fanry was a human individual who lived during the Republic Era.
Dathan, also known to the Sith Eternal as "the Abomination," was a human male hybrid strandcast genetically engineered by Sith cultists on the planet Exegol in 12 BBY.
Vicrul was a Force-sensitive human male who served as a member of the Knights of Ren, under the command of an individual known as Ren.

Ushar was a male humanoid Force-sensitive who served as a member of the Knights of Ren, under the command of an individual known as Ren. Ushar and the other Knights later accepted Ben Solo, who took on the name "Kylo Ren," as their new leader.
Ap'lek was a Force-sensitive humanoid male who served as a member of the Knights of Ren, under the command of an individual known as Ren and later Kylo Ren.

Ochi was a Bestoonian male assassin and cultist of the Sith known as Ochi of Bestoon, hailing from the world of the same name with a career spanning decades, from the twilight of the Galactic Republic, and the subsequent rise of the Galactic Empire to the era of the New Republic.

Cardo was a Force-sensitive humanoid male who served as a member of the Knights of Ren, under the command of an individual known as Ren. Cardo, alongside Albrekh, tended to the weapons and armor of the Knights.

Miramir was a human female who worked as a junk trader during the New Republic Era. Her husband Dathan was the cloned "son"—an artificial Strand-Cast—of Darth Sidious, the Dark Lord of the Sith and Galactic Emperor.

Darth Tenebrous was the Sith Master of Darth Plagueis. Tenebrous was suspected to have designed the Scimitar, the personal starship of the Sith Lord Darth Maul that was officially designed by engineer and starship designer Raith Sienar.
Darth Tanis was an ancient Sith Lord who created the superweapon in the Sith Temple on the planet Malachor. Later, the 17th Legion of the Sith Eternal was named after Darth Tanis.

Revan was a Sith Lord and the namesake of the Sith Eternal army's Revan Legion. Since the history of the Sith was kept hidden from the galaxy, only Sith cultists knew the significance of Revan's name.
Athewn Ozi was an individual who served as a captain in the First Order and was in command of the garrison on the planet Kijimi.
Lodent Cowell was a male human who served as a lieutenant in the First Order and served in the Kijimi garrison.
Barok was a human who served as a lieutenant in the First Order and served in the Kijimi garrison.
Albrekh was a Symeong male metalsmith and Sith alchemist who served Supreme Leader Kylo Ren and the Knights of Ren during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.
Pommet Warrick was a male Ewok who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor during the time of the First Order-Resistance War. Being the son of Wicket W.

Odan-Urr was a Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order. Odan-Urr was one of several Jedi who annotated the sacred Jedi texts, artifacts dating to millennia before the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Ri-Lee Howell was a Jedi Master and historian of the Jedi Order. Howell collected many early accounts of explorations and codifications of the Force in the two volumes of the Aionomica—Aionomicum I and Aionomicum II—carefully preserving the original texts.
Thorpe was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who created the Unsolved Thorpe Theorem, a hyperspace plotting conundrum which was posed to Jedi Padawan learners.
Mott Corbet was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. Within the sacred Jedi texts, Corbet wrote of his dictum "what is, is without" in vertical Tionese.

Lazu Lirona was a smuggler who was active during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. Her former occupation was a track star on Gavriza, but she fell ill with pneumogray, which ended her career.
Amret Engell was a human female who served as a general in the armed forces of the First Order and was also a member of First Order High Command.
Masir Trach was a human who served as a commander and scanner officer in the First Order, and held a rank befitting that of a senior officer.

Frantis Griss was a human male who served as an admiral in the armed forces of the First Order as a member of First Order High Command. He also was the senior fleet officer of the Steadfast and its battlegroup.

Oma Tres was a human male who served as a bartender of the Spice Runners' Den on the First Order-occupied planet Kijimi, where he had been mixing drinks for years. By 35 ABY he had experienced much discord in his position.
Chesille Sabrond was a human who was born on the planet Exegol. She served as a captain in the Sith Eternal's fleet, the Final Order, and helmed the Xyston-class Star Destroyer Derriphan.
Domaric Quinn was a human male who served the Galactic Empire as a junior officer before rising to become a general and key ground forces commander in the First Order.

Kadara Calrissian was a female individual and the daughter of Landonis Balthazar Calrissian. In the years of peace after the Galactic Civil War, Calrissian attempted to start a family, and his daughter was born in 13 ABY.

Bellava Parnadee was a human female who served as a general in the armed forces of the First Order. As the senior ground commander of the First Order military, she sat on Supreme Leader Kylo Ren's First Order Supreme Council and in 35 ABY attended a session on board the Resurg…
ST-I4191 was a human Sith trooper who served in the army of the Sith Eternal during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

ST-A1215 was a human Sith Jetpack Trooper, a variant of the elite Sith trooper, who served in of the Sith Eternal army during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. Born in 14 ABY, ST-A1215 was raised on the planet Exegol as a child of the Sith Eternal cult.

Simero Quonit was a human Sith Eternal Petty Officer during the First Order-Resistance War. Born in the era of the New Republic, Quonit was raised on the hidden world of Exegol, where a cult of Sith loyalists readied an invasion force—the final stage in the First Order's conqu…

Milon Lenwith was a human who served as a lieutenant in the Sith Eternal's fleet, the Final Order. He served in the war between the First Order and the Resistance, forming part of the crew of the Derriphan.
Wilsa Teshlo was a Kessurian who was born a thilas, second in line to the throne. Not wishing to be royalty, Teshlo fled the palace, becoming a pirate in the Veiled Sorority.

Seleno Chandro was a Jaluku bounty hunter who formerly worked with the Bounty Hunters' Guild. Following the Battle of Endor, he gained a reputation for capturing Imperial fugitives, which resulted in him becoming paranoid of reprisals from the First Order.

Corus Kapellim was a human male smuggler from Brix. A self-styled "gentleman flyer," Kapellim specialized in stolen gems and priceless art. As he found bulk smuggling distasteful, he was more concerned about the challenge rather than the riches he stole.
Kuimi Enissa was a human pirate. A former lieutenant of the Lumini pirates, Enissa was the sole survivor of an attack by the First Order.

Zulay Ulor was a human who led Caracara Squadron, a mercenary starfighter squadron. Ulor's squadron offered defense services to systems without their own fleets, but had been chased out of restricted zones by both the First Order and New Republic prior to the outbreak of war.
Kid Malmash was a young Shungbeek who transported fugitives to safe zones in his Lancer-class pursuit craft, the Nebular Kelpie.

Urcos Furdam was a human pilot of the Resistance. While of Alderaanian ancestry, Furdam was born after Alderaan was destroyed. By 35 ABY, he was the co-pilot of the Tantive IV, and regarded General Leia Organa as royalty. Furdam perished at the Battle of Exegol.
Shasa Zaro was a human pilot from the planet Naboo in the Resistance Starfighter Corps who flew a Y-wing starfighter during the First Order-Resistance War.
Lega Fossang was a human Resistance pilot. After serving in the Humbarine planetary defense force, she joined the Resistance with her astromech L4E-R5, flying her BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter.

Garn Stewer, Jr. flew an RZ-2 A-wing interceptor in the Resistance Starfighter Corps. He served the Resistance as a family tradition and in honor of her father, Garn Stewer, a technician for the Rebel Alliance. By 35 ABY, Stewer Jr.
Merl Cobben was a human A-wing pilot in the Resistance. During a skirmish, he was saved by fellow pilot Tallissan Lintra, to whom he then felt indebted.

Dellso Prin was a Cingulon who worked as a used starship seller and mechanic. He was loosely affiliated with the Resistance during its war against the First Order, and after the Resistance established a base on the moon Ajan Kloss, Prin hauled cargo and supplies to it.

Enanan Supa was a human pilot for the Resistance. Following the Battle of D'Qar where the Resistance lost all its MG-100 StarFortress SF-17s and Supa lost her friend, Nix Jerd, she retrained on B-wing Mark IIIs.
Nambi Ghima was a female Aki-Aki who resided on the planet Pasaana. At the Festival of the Ancestors, Ghima gave Rey a necklace. At the festival, she wore blue daswoad-dyed robes.
Tishra Kandia was a human intelligence officer of the First Order. She served aboard the Star Destroyer Steadfast, dealing with evidence and accounts of Resistance activity.
HF-3311 was a human female from Gannaria who served as an electroprod trooper in the First Order during its war against the Resistance.
Tophid Bruster, designated DT-4431, was a lieutenant TIE fighter pilot in the Starfighter Corps of the First Order.

Carid Tamb was a human who served as a junior officer in the First Order during its war with the Resistance. Recruited from a conquered planet, Tamb gained experience through combat simulations and became a technician.

Bon Sequors was a dashing Human male who dressed in fine clothing and wore a blue cape. Sequors was sympathetic to the Alliance, but was not an official member. He had many friends who were, and as such tended to help them out as much as possible.
Randar Dowellin was a male crime lord with a unique collection of Galactic Republic artifacts, including a rare Karltonian Fiskin coin. The collection was tagged with a special chemical tracer.

Aterph was a Devaronian male who visited the Farrimmer Cafe on the Mynock 7 Space Station. He claimed to have run away from home due to the endless nagging of his wife, when in reality, he was a hired assassin who had been contracted to cause chaos on the space station.
Benchar was a Human male who travelled with Carewa, Rosen and the Wookiee Cecil. They visited the Farrimmer Cafe where they engaged in a game of sabacc.
Carewa was a Human male who travelled with Benchar, Rosen and the Wookiee Cecil. They visited the Farrimmer Cafe where they engaged in a game of sabacc.
Rosen was a Human male who travelled with Carewa, Benchar and the Wookiee Cecil. They visited the Farrimmer Cafe where they engaged in a game of sabacc.

Renthor was a Human male from Corellia. Along with Kym and Ulbert, Renthor was a former student of a Force-user who was not quite sane and had corrupted the Jedi Code. Despite having no aptitude for the Force, Renthor and his fellows took their teacher's creed to heart.

Kym was a Human male from Corellia. Along with Renthor and Ulbert, Kym was a former student of a Force-user who was not quite sane and had corrupted the Jedi Code. Despite having no aptitude for the Force, Kym and his fellows took their teacher's creed to heart.

Ulbert was a Human male from Corellia. Along with Kym and Renthor, Ulbert was a former student of a Force-user who was not quite sane and had corrupted the Jedi Code. Despite having no aptitude for the Force, Ulbert and his fellows took their teacher's creed to heart.
Gerthylament was a male Quarren who worked with the Twi'lek Ryo as a smuggler. They visited the Farrimmer Cafe on Mynock 7 Space Station looking for work.
Ryo was a male Twi'lek who worked with the Quarren Gerthylament as a smuggler. They visited the Farrimmer Cafe on Mynock 7 Space Station looking for work.
Sleightan was a Human male con artist. Along with the droid L7-BO, Sleightan ran a scam where he would sell the droid to group of spacers, claiming it was the property of his dead son, Armbrus.

Armbrus was the son of Sleightan, and the original owner of L7-BO. Armbrus was an honest man who made his living flying people and cargo through the Outer Rim Territories. He was caught by the Empire for apparently hauling engine parts and detained.

Pattros Navesh was a human Resistance pilot who left his homeworld of Lantillies for Batuu and life on the Outer Rim. Recruited by Resistance forces operating out of the Black Spire Ruins, he joined the Resistance Starfighter Corps in 34 ABY.

Elna Zibsara was a human pilot. She fought with the New Republic at the Battle of Jakku, but later retired from service. Following the Hosnian Cataclysm, Temmin Wexley recruited the veteran pilot into the Resistance, where Zibsara specialized in training new recruits.
Nimi Chireen was a human female Resistance pilot from the planet Jaymir.

Allie Samta was a human member of the Resistance. Originally an infantry soldier in the Resistance's army, Samta saw the Resistance was in need of new pilots and transferred to the starfighter corps, training under veteran pilot Elna Zibsara.

Clemitt Polus was a human Resistance pilot, and formerly a defense pilot on his homeworld of Drophun III. He eventually joined the Resistance, and was an avid appreciator of classic starfighter designs, eager to fly an X-wing.
Hurrie Chind was a human pilot for the Resistance. In 35 ABY, they were a new recruit serving on the moon Ajan Kloss, where they mourned the death of General Leia Organa after her passing.
Jeyo Garanam was a human pilot in the Resistance, and a new recruit at the Resistance's base on Ajan Kloss.
Miller Worlens was a human who served as a newly recruited pilot for the Resistance at their base on Ajan Kloss.
Renk Narviz was a human pilot who served the Resistance during their war against the First Order. One of many new recruits, Narviz was stationed at the Resistance base on Ajan Kloss.

In 35 ABY, she was present on the moon Ajan Kloss for multiple meetings, including the funeral of General Leia Organa and a session where plans were made for the Battle of Exegol against the Sith Eternal.

Seftin Vanik was a human pilot from Messert who served as a lieutenant in the Resistance. Formerly a stunt flyer in an aerial circus that traveled the Messert system, Vanik was recruited into the Resistance by fellow pilot Poe Dameron, flying an RZ-2 A-wing interceptor in vari…

Kurksel Gartfran was a human who served as a commander in the Resistance. While he did not support the New Republic, Gartfran joined the Resistance to fight against the First Order, which he saw as worse.

Fadros Angon was a human who held the rank of major in the Resistance. A former botanist, Angon had to focus on his duties while at the Resistance base on Ajan Kloss and not be distracted by the wealth of plant life.

Aarton Chireen was a human male lieutenant in the Resistance from Jaymir, where he and his sister Nimi Chireen were recruited by pilot Ello Asty. The siblings were held in reserve until after the Battle of Crait, when they joined the core Resistance group.
Vazzet Dipterz was a Cyclorrian technician. He managed a Cyclorrian swarm that joined the Resistance as a taskmaster and was rarely ever seen off of his loadlifter workframe.
Wizzich Mozzer was a Cyclorrian who served the Resistance alongside the rest of his swarm during its war with the First Order.

Seossra Thwisp was a Caphex female spy who served the Resistance. Keeping tabs on First Order activity along the borderlands, Thwisp was recalled into the Resistance after the Hosnian Cataclysm, and began serving as an intelligence analyst.
Junn Gobint was a post-fledgling Mythrol male who served the Resistance, managing consumables replenishment for starfighters at their base on the moon Ajan Kloss.
Huper Tenrecs was a Talpiddian weapons specialist who served the Resistance as an armorer for the base on the jungle moon Ajan Kloss.
Phenlass Sur was a Reesarian that joined the Resistance with Odla Sur, to whom Phenlass was bonded and married.

Odla Sur was a Reesarian and the mate of Phenlass Sur, who together were a bonded pair. Swearing a vow of companionship as part of their marriage, the two joined the Resistance together, acting as scouts and soldiers at a base on the moon Ajan Kloss.
This Dianoga was a vicious creature that lived inside Garbage Compactor 3263827 aboard the Death Star.

Ibdun Dand was a Tarsunt male and the father to Resistance controller Vober Dand. While Ibdun was originally against his son joining the Resistance, fearing what might happen, he eventually joined himself after the Hosnian Cataclysm.

Yipsit was a Shahkirin mechanic. Born on the planet Bestine IV, Yipsit eventually came to serve the Resistance during the First Order-Resistance War. At the Resistance base on Ajan Kloss, Yipsit helped to refurbish the Tantive IV.
