Twylope Nur was a Mohsenian who served the Resistance as a field medic. He used his ability to smell illness and injury, alongside his natural resistance and defenses, to diagnose his patients and quickly deliver appropriate treatment.
Tanruka Namhi was an Aki-Aki food vendor who attended the Festival of the Ancestors.

Jo-Dapshi Gorobunn was an Aki-Aki farmer who lost one of his trunks in a farm injury. Gorobunn was one of many Aki-Aki who attended the Festival of the Ancestors in the Forbidden Valley. Gorobunn's family's heraldic pennant was on a flag on a 75D skimmer that Rey stole.
Wrushii-Do Elecra was a gray-skinned Aki-Aki who lived on the desert planet Pasaana. As an adult in 35 ABY, Elecra attended the Festival of the Ancestors in the Forbidden Valley.

Jesba-Be Issa was an Aki-Aki resident of the planet Pasaana who acted as a tribal guardian of communally raised children. By 35 ABY, Issa was an adult and attended the Festival of the Ancestors in the Forbidden Valley.

The Aki-Aki Fadda-Rarb Arda worked as a tribal guardian of communally raised children on the planet Pasaana. Having reached adulthood, Arda attended the Festival of the Ancestors in the Forbidden Valley in 35 ABY.
Gusyin Tatam was an Aki-Aki child that attended the Festival of the Ancestors in 35 ABY.

Kazza-Ki Sagree was an Aki-Aki child who was born on the planet Pasaana. Sagree attended the Festival of the Ancestors, an Aki-Aki festival celebrated every forty-two years, alongside a number of other Aki-Aki children in 35 ABY.
Jaiyna Sibinth was a human xenolinguist. She regularly attended the Aki-Aki Festival of the Ancestors on Pasaana, studying the Aki-Aki's ancient language.

Ommo Twilto was an alien mercenary. In 35 ABY, the Festival of the Ancestors was held on the planet Pasaana, and those native Aki-Aki chieftains who could afford it hired offworld enforcers, including Twilto and Dered Karno, to make sure that nothing disrupted the festivities …
Dered Karno was an alien mercenary who, alongside Ommo Twilto, worked as an enforcer. Karno wielded an electroprod staff.

Zabmon Roro was a human who attended the Aki-Aki Festival of the Ancestors on the planet Pasaana in 35 ABY. While at the festival, they walked past the Jedi Rey as she watched a puppet show being put on for Aki-Aki younglings.

Begaral Moghare was a humanoid individual who was a wanted fugitive by the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance. Wearing a facial wrap, Moghare attended the Aki-Aki Festival of the Ancestors on Pasaana.
Sebla Sarobia was a human who attended the Aki-Aki Festival of the Ancestors in the Forbidden Valley of the planet Pasaana in 35 ABY.

Sylphanie Stil was a Kessurian who was a member of a Kessurian dance troupe that also included Vanbec Recliva and Charlu Sisi. The Kessurian dance troupe attended the Aki-Aki Festival of the Ancestors during the war between the First Order and the Resistance, in In 35 ABY.
Vanbec Recliva was a Kessurian member of a dance troupe, alongside Sylphanie Stil and Charlu Sisi. The dance troupe, including Recliva, visited Pasaana for the Aki-Aki Festival of the Ancestors.

Charlu Sisi was a Kessurian dancer who was a member of a Kessurian dance troupe that included Sylphanie Stil and Vanbec Recliva. The dance troupe attended the Aki-Aki Festival of the Ancestors during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Kalo'ne was a female Yokaa who resided on the planet Pasaana, driving a DN-25 treadable that she used to transport passengers and goods. She had worked on the planet for several decades, witnessing many occurrences of the Festival of the Ancestors.

CS-9147 was a human from the Otomok system who served the First Order as a jet trooper. In 35 ABY, CS-9147 and another jet trooper pursued the scavenger Rey and her Resistance allies through the deserts of the planet Pasaana.

Wolentic Dudge was a Frejuke resident of Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi. He was a good fit for the world's cold climate due to his species' heat-retaining blubber, although he also wore a brown vest lined with kybuck fur for added warmth, as well as brown pants, brown shoes,…

Plesko Marno was an Ozrelanso male who was a clerk at the Bureau of Ships and Services for the New Republic. Following the Hosnian Cataclysm, Marno escaped with a collection of navigational data that he had stolen during his years working for the agency.

Tommet Sozach was a Ginmid who led an army of mercenaries to make a living. When predictions of prolonged peace in the galaxy proved true, Sozach left the army to operate on his own and began working as a trick shooter until a fatal accident during a demonstration resulted in …

Amuncie Tidian was a Boosodian forger from the celestial body Boosodia who was assocaited with the Spice Runners of Kijimi, He was active on the planet Kijimi shortly before its destruction in 35 ABY.

Rothgar Deng, possibly operating under an alias, was a Corellian bounty hunter. In an attempt to live and work forever, Deng subjected himself to cybernetic replacements, and turned to black market surgical clinics to replace damaged body parts.
Faddaff Davenspon was a Deymasollian female who, after a life of tinkering and years of interstellar travel, had top-notch technical skills and an innate feel for starship systems.
Carib Diss was a fearsome bounty hunter. The sensory organs of Diss' species, the Skilla, were situated behind an array of large teeth, meaning that in order to see, he had to grimace.
TX-8080 was a human stormtrooper of the First Order, originally born on Hevurion. A snowtrooper commander, TX-8080 served as part of the garrison on Kijimi.

An unidentified droidsmith and scholar was the builder and master of the droid D-O. By 21 ABY, the scholar was present on Primus Cabru, where they were killed by the Sith assassin Ochi when he raided a library there.

Jayelle, formerly known as JL-3621, was a human who formerly served as a stormtrooper in Company 77 of the First Order. When the company was ordered to fire on innocent civilians at the Battle of Ansett Island, they all refused, and defected from First Order service.
Forten, formerly designated JL-4410, was a human who served as a stormtrooper in the First Order's Company 77.
Zeegar was an orbak from Kef Bir who served as the personal mount of Forten, a member of Company 77, a company of defected First Order stormtroopers.
Ferrule was an orbak from Kef Bir, owned by Jannah, the leader of a tribe of former First Order stormtrooper defectors.
Dreanna Conunda was a human pilot who worked as a flight instructor at the New Republic academy on the planet Chandrila, also acting as a test pilot for the Corellian Engineering Corporation.

In 35 ABY, Dyun rode aboard the Fortitude when it carried the Resistance's landing team for an attack on the Sith Eternal on the planet Exegol. There, Dyun entered the cockpit of the Fortitude just before the transport landed on the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Steadfast.

Cassy Algara was a human who served as both a personnel clerk and commando in the Resistance. She often referred to her fellow soldiers by their homeworld rather than their names, having kept tabs on the Resistance personnel.

Dynia Reekeene was a human female fighter in the Resistance. She was the daughter of two Rebel Alliance commanders who had led the Fakir Roughnecks cell in the Fakir sector, and joined the Resistance in honor of her parents.
Wipolo Nagg was a human male who hailed from Batuu. He was recruited into the Resistance, and helped clear out the jungle around the Resistance base on Ajan Kloss.
Bo Rogiave was a Lacertilo member of the Resistance. As a member of an amphibious species, Rogiave had an advantage in low-oxygen areas due to his compound lungs.

Engi Golba was a Didynon from the world Didyma V. He originally worked as a miner, setting explosives in the lommite mines, but escaped his home when it was annexed by the First Order. Golba joined the Resistance, utilizing his talents with explosives.
Elliver Olim was a human male who served as a soldier in the Resistance. Additionally, Olim captured a holographic record of the Resistance's efforts, documenting their fight against the First Order.
Byrco Hansid was a human male from the rustic planet Aris. A member of the Resistance military, Hansid was a specialist in heavy weapons, carrying an HH-12 rocket launcher.

Ataphen Blario was an individual who served as a pilot in the Resistance's Starfighter Corps. They wore a yellow and gray flight helmet, with a black Rebel Alliance starbird on top, and the Aurebesh inscription on the right-hand side that translated to "ROÆHAL"; the same inscr…
Euphaus Biro was an insectoid individual active during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Somaled New was a human who attended the celebrations held at the Resistance base on the moon Ajan Kloss after the Resistance and its allies from around the galaxy defeated the First Order and Sith Eternal on the planet Exegol in 35 ABY.

Juronus Opto was a human individual from Ardennia active during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. Opto wore a hermetically-sealed flight helmet, a duster jacket, and variable mag-grip boots, and also carried a hidden hold-out blaster.
Vaid Bloodfil was a human officer in the First Order, holding the military rank of either major or colonel.
Crysta was the wife of Opun Mcgrrrr. She was one of the number of reasons that Mcgrrrr has any success as a minor crime lord.

Lechee was a Gran male vendor who resided in the Vargo Spaceport on the planet Varkana. He was secretly a contact for the First Order, who moved their shipments and materials through black market channels.
Ka-Pao was a male Drabatan mechanic who was part of the Resistance. He befriended Moxie Freemaker and her B1-series battle droid R0-GR.
Narvin was a male Nikto pirate in the Warbird gang.
Domine Lithe was a female individual who was active during the First Order-Resistance War.

A Clone Captain served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. The clone trooper captain participated in the First Battle of Geonosis alongside Jedi Grand Master Yoda and was present in the forward command center during the battle.
Long after the Galactic Civil War, a Whill talked to another Whill about recording the history of the galaxy.
This human male was the great-grandfather of Janu Blenn who served as a stormtrooper for the Galactic Empire. Karr Nuq Sin bought his helmet from his great-grandson.
The mother of Sconto was a female individual. At some point during Clone Wars, she met a clone trooper.
A human female elder was on the planet Tatooine after the final battle of the war between the First Order and the Resistance in 35 ABY.
A male Pyke at Niima Outpost on the planet Jakku overheard Karr Nuq Sin talk about Jedi. One of his relatives shot down Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas's ship over the desert moon of Oba Diah decades prior.
The aunt of Karr Nuq Sin was a female individual. She died while Nuq Sin was a student at on the planet Merokia, and his parents came to him at school to tell him.
The wife of Sconto was a female married to Sconto, a merchant on the planet Utapau who was the son of a clone trooper.
The great-grandmother of Karr Nuq Sin was a woman married to the former Jedi Padawan Naq Med and mother of J'Hara.
The friend of Anaya Raynshi was an individual who was going to visit her daughter in the Chommell sector.
The daughter of Anaya Raynshi's friend was a female who lived in the Chommell sector.

Mandalore the Great was a Mandalorian individual who first held the title of Mand'alor. According to ancient folklore, Mandalore the Great defeated a mythosaur at its lair in the Mines of Mandalore and then tamed the mythical beast.

A male Mandalorian warrior served as part of the Death Watch group during the time of the Clone Wars. During a Separatist Alliance attack on the planet of Aq Vetina, the warrior rescued the young child Din Djarin from a B2-series super battle droid.

A human male was the father of Din Djarin. When their home came under attack from Separatist forces during the Clone Wars, Djarin's father and mother attempted to hide their son from the enemy battle droids.

A human female was the mother of Din Djarin. Djarin's mother and father escaped their home and tried to hide their son from the droids. Djarin's parents were killed after hiding their son, who was found by a B2-series super battle droid.
Around 3 ABY, the brother of the Wookiee bounty hunter Chenlambec was among the colonists on Gandolo IV.
The grandfather of Shar was a male individual. He knew stories of the conflict between the Sith and the Jedi, which he told to his grandson in his childhood.

7173 was the designation of a human who served as a member of the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire. In 14 BBY, 7173 was stationed on the planet Zeffo as part of a squad guarding an abandoned village and complained to another trooper about the low temperature.
Pont Edisser was a male individual who served the Galactic Republic as a fireman of the Coruscant Rescue Ops aboard the emergency fire suppression speeder captained by Cott Theefe.
Cott Theefe was a individual who served as the captain of an emergency fire suppression speeder in the Galactic Republic's Coruscant Rescue Ops.
The Droid Hunter was a bounty hunter who worked for the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. The Droid Hunter was killed in 14 BBY, after engaging Cal Kestis.

Fen Inor was a male former Mandalorian who operated during the third Galactic War on Mek-Sha. Being an exile from his people, Inor was a member of the Dar'manda, a group of gunrunners and mercenaries comprised of former Mandalorians and other outlaws.

Amleto was an Elomin spy who lived during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. She had red skin and orange eyes. The Elomin wore a light-colored tunic, a belt over brown pants, and a brown neck scarf.

A stormtrooper served as a commander in the Stormtrooper Corps of the First Order. The stormtrooper commander led an operation on the planet Kashyyyk, kidnapping a number of its native Wookiees to be used as slaves.

BT-9093 was a stormtrooper of the First Order. Present during the First Order's blockade of Kashyyyk, BT-9093 and another stormtrooper were ordered to locate SN-1208, who had failed to report in after being incapacitated by the Wookiee Chewbacca.
Darrb was a Gabdorin male vendor who resided on the planet Varkana in 34 ABY. He had a home on Varkana and sold fruits and vegetables in the Vargo Spaceport.
Needle was a male Quermian who served in the Rebel Alliance's Pathfinders. Following the Battle of Hoth, Needle was stationed aboard a CR90 corvette in the Alliance Fleet's Fourth Division.

Frell was a Tholothian who served the Rebel Alliance as a member of the Pathfinders. Frell and a number of other Pathfinders were stationed aboard a CR90 corvette of the Fourth Division after the Battle of Hoth.
Gorr was a human who held the rank of lieutenant in the navy of the Galactic Empire, serving as Commander Ellian Zahra's second-in-command aboard the Star Destroyer Tarkin's Will.
Sylond was an Aquala Aqualish who ran Sylond's Speeder Rentals in Quantill City on the planet Ando. He was a friend of Koral-tae.
Prixqip, known as Prixqip the Mutilator, was a criminal active during the Imperial Era. Prixqip was killed by the droid bounty hunter IG-88, who chose not to claim the bounty straight away.
Oolamalloola was a criminal who operated during the Imperial Era. The assassin droid and bounty hunter IG-88 killed Oolamalloola, but chose not to take the bounty on the criminal immediately.
RJ-909 was the designation of a human TIE fighter pilot who served the Galactic Empire's Starfighter Corps during the Imperial Era.

A clone trooper served on the bridge of the Venator-class Star Destroyer Resolute as part of Resolute command during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Bothawui, they reported that the enemy fleet had reached them, making the trooper ask if they should open fire.
A human female Mandalorian was a lead warrior of Clan Rook. She pledged her clan to the Mandalorian resistance led by Lady Bo-Katan Kryze during the Mandalorian Civil War.
In 1 BBY, a male pilot was tasked with flying Mon Mothma off of Yavin 4 before the Death Star arrived.
A male Alphon hailed from Parsh. The Alphon was betrayed by Wanten sometime before 1 BBY.
A stormtrooper apprehended Doctor Chelli Aphra on Dantooine soon after the destruction of Alderaan. Aphra was able to take the stormtrooper's blaster and escape the planet.
An Alderaanian individual served as a page to Bail Organa in the days before the destruction of Alderaan.
The Unidentified judicial agent was a male judicial agent from Coruscant, who was investigated of the sabotage acitons between Lommite Limited and InterGalactic Ore.
Joy Rekkoff was a Mandalorian ace who flew a Fang fighter and served in Skull Squadron, a unit of the Mandalorian Protectors.
In 5 ABY, the Human male proprietor of Antiques by Dumas, a shop on Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire, was visited by Plumba of the Imperial Ruling Council.
Kuuvat was a Klatooinian mercenary who served as the head of Pok Nar-Ten's guards. A no-nonsense bodyguard, he was loyal to Pok Nar-Ten.
Mag Zaroff was a fierce Force-sensitive humanoid Jedi hunter associated with the Galactic Empire. She could levitate objects to use against her prey and walked with calm confidence.

Agnuk was a Trandoshan male bounty hunter who was member of the Bounty Hunter's Guild. He was a student of the Orsis Academy when he was young. Later he joined the Bounty Hunter's Guild as a bounty hunter.
Chonowoya Seeb was a book editor of Anooba Press. Chonowoya helped Cradossk to make his autobiography Making a Killing.
Osa La was a book designer of Anooba Press. Osa helped designing Cradossk's autobiography Making a Killing.
A male overseer of the Brothers slaver organization handled a trade deal with the Sith Empire and respective contact within the Brothers Oversight Center in 3627 BBY.
The "Manager of Involuntary Labor" was a male Human of the Sith Empire, operating on Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY. He served as contact to the Brothers slaver organization, buying slaves off them.
A female Twi'lek refugee resided in Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY. She was captured by the slavers The Brothers but got rescued by a Galactic Republic-aligned individual.
A Male Wookiee was present during Lurdo's travel to Kashyyyk. The Wookiee offered Lurdo xachibik broth but Lurdo refused, offending the Wookiee who considered Lurdo's refusal an insult to his family.

Ellenne Wune was a female individual who worked as a professor and engineer during the Imperial Era. At one point, one of her students, Pon Kenti, approached her after class and successfully recruited her into the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a spy and sabotage the Gala…
Pon Kenti was an individual who was a student of engineering under Professor Ellenne Wune and was secretly a spy of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Garsa was a Gran who lived during the Imperial Era, along with a wife. Garsa discreetly supplied Captain Raymus Antilles of House of Organa with supplies to assist them in their operations against the Galactic Empire.
Caibol was a human who served Captain Raymus Antilles aboard the Tantive IV during the Imperial Era. When Antilles received supplies from the Gran Garsa, Caibol helped to collect the cargo.
Murray was a male Imperial Royal Guard who was granted paternity leave—as a result of fathering at least one child—to while serving aboard a vessel.

AP-1982 was a human male scout trooper who served in an Imperial remnant led by Moff Gideon during the New Republic Era. Around 9 ABY, he guarded the entrance to Nevarro's city alongside JS-1975, another scout trooper, after Gideon's forces drove the city's residents away.

JS-1975 was a human male scout trooper who was a member of Moff Gideon's Imperial remnant during the New Republic Era. Around 9 ABY, he guarded the entrance to Nevarro's city alongside AP-1982, another scout trooper, when Gideon's forces took control of the city.

FN-0606 was a human male who served in the First Order's FN Corps as a stormtrooper in 35 ABY. When Rey arrived on the Star Destroyer Steadfast to rescue Chewbacca, the young Jedi confused FN-0606 and another stormtrooper with a mind trick.

FN-1226 was a human male who served in the First Order's FN Trooper Corps as a stormtrooper in 35 ABY. When Rey arrived on the Star Destroyer Steadfast to rescue Chewbacca, the young Jedi confused FN-1226 and another stormtrooper with a mind trick.
FN-0878 was a human who served in the First Order's FN Trooper Corps as a stormtrooper in 35 ABY.

FN-2802 was a human who served in the First Order's FN Corps as a stormtrooper in 35 ABY. The trooper identified the Jedi apprentice Rey and her companions as Resistance operatives, and attempted to capture them while stationed on the planet Pasaana during the Festival of the …
The father of Roan Novachez was a Human male pilot. He was the father of two other children, Davin and Oliver Novachez, along with their mother.

In 3627 BBY, a male Arcona enslaver handled a trade agreement with The Brothers enslaver organization aboard the space station Mek-Sha. He was then neutralized along with the other enslavers by an individual affiliated with the Galactic Republic.

Seema Vello was a female Zabrak involved in illicit contraband in the city Iziz on the planet Onderon, in 3627 BBY. That year, she was defeated by an individual fighting the illegal trade and arrested by Iziz city guards.

"Big Bantha" Baan was a male Human involved in illicit contraband in the city Iziz on the planet Onderon, in 3627 BBY. That year, he was defeated by an individual fighting the illegal trade and arrested by Iziz city guards.
Dnalla was a middle aged woman who was a member of the Friends of Paran resistance group on the planet Derilyn. She was friends with Shondra Del.

Kailage Lanis was a woman who was a member of the Friends of Paran resistance group on the planet Derilyn. She was good friends with Sneeze, and although she seemed reserved, her skills at the controls of a speeder showed how daring she was.
A female Myneyrsh soldier served in the Vaklin insurgency against the forces of the Galactic Empire. In battle she wielded a blaster rifle and wore a shift that covered most of her body.
In 5000 BBY, a Keshiri rider of the Neshtovar volunteered to assist the geologist Adari Vaal during her trial.
During the Mandalorian Wars, a male Besalisk worked as a caterer on the planet Taris. In 3969 BBY, he served the Jedi from the Jedi Tower.
The mother of Roan Novachez lived on Tatooine along with her three sons. She was in a relationship with Roan's father.

Wannek was a Northern Mustafarian female who lived on Mustafar during the Imperial Era. Wannek accompanied the priestess of his clan and assisted Lady Corvax's descendant in preventing Darth Vader from activating the Aeon Engine. They also helped eliminate the darkghast.

A female officer from the Core Worlds location Alsakan served in the First Order's High Command. Following the takeover of the Corellian Engineering Corporation by the First Order, she undertook Winshur Bratt's re-employment interview, who was the company's head clerk in the R…
This officer was a human male who served aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Steadfast during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.
Koshka Frost was a bounty hunter who originally mentored Viktor Hel. Later, along with Hel and "Doctor" Krandak, Frost successfully hunted down Devaronian pirate Melos on Ord Mantell.
Balfam Sen was a Chevin male who was a High Inquisitor of the Chevin Conglomerate of Vinsoth near the end of the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Gizka was a female Mandalorian with the Dar'manda. Composed of other former Mandalorians on Mek-Sha, the Dar'manda were a group of gunrunners and mercenaries active during the third Galactic War.

A Duros male valet served the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic the valet was stationed aboard Vaiken Spacedock, where he invited an individual affiliated with the Empire aboard the Imperial transport Black Talon.

Vaughn, designated CT-0292, was a clone of the human Jango Fett who served as a Clone Captain within the 332nd Company, part of a division of the 501st Legion that was assigned to Clone Commander Rex and former Jedi Padawan and Advisor Ahsoka Tano.

Eustacia Okka was a Mirialan female professor who worked for the Shadow University. A former classmate of Chelli Lona Aphra at the University of Bar'leth, Okka launched her own archeological career after being expelled from the Shadow University, who claimed her writings on th…

Ronen Tagge was a human male member of the House of Tagge, a powerful family of the Galactic Empire. He was the son of Adelaide and Felix Tagge, and the nephew of Domina Tagge, who ensured he received anything that he wanted.
Detta Yao was a human female archaeology graduate student at the Shadow University. At one point, she worked with Doctor Chelli Aphra to search for the Rings of Vaale.
Just Lucky was a human male smuggler and assassin. He worked both with and against the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra on multiple occasions.
During the Galactic Civil War, a female bartender worked at a Junari Point bar on the planet Chandrila.

A Human male served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Military of the reconstituted Sith Empire. The lieutenant served aboard the Black Talon, a transport in the Imperial Navy, and was later killed when the Black Talon was hijacked by Imperials working for Grand Moff Rycus Kilran.

The mother of the Karkarodon Ohnaka Transport Solutions employee Lee Skillen was a female who was alive during the First Order-Resistance War. Though Skillen loved her Twi'lek girlfriend, the mother took issue with her species.
A male Quork guard assisted King Marlox in 3 ABY, during the capture of the Ewok Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka.
A male Quork guard assisted King Marlox in 3 ABY, during the capture of the Ewok Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka.
A female Sauvax pet owner participated in the Sok Brok's Fiftieth Annual Pet Show, on the planet Taris in 43 ABY.

During the Mandalorian Wars, the planet Serroco was represented in the Galactic Republic Senate by a senator. The Senator ended with the practice of people issuing false tornado warnings to the planet's native Stereb, from a watchstation in orbit.

At some point before 12 ABY, the Hutt crime lord hired the services of a xenobiologist to work as a scout and discover the hive mind of the Taurill species. After selling the information to Durga, the xenobiologist was killed to protect the secret.
Polly was a mantellian flutterplume living on the planet Dantooine. It was killed during the Dantooine Incursion of the new conflict between Galactic Republic and Sith Empire.
In 4975 BBY, a Keshiri Neshtovar rider and a member of the Keshiri resistance delivered a message to Adari Vaal, revealing the death of her son Tona Vaal.
"Holo" was the nickname of a non-binary human who served as an ace pilot in the First Order Special Forces. "Holo" piloted a red TIE/ba interceptor and wore a matching First Order TIE flight suit.

"Ember" was the nickname of a human who served as a pilot in the First Order Special Forces. "Ember" piloted a red TIE/ba interceptor and wore a matching First Order TIE flight suit. At some point, the pilot flew alongside two TIE/sf space superiority fighters near a red nebula.

"Rush" was the nickname of a human individual who served as a pilot in the First Order during the New Republic Era. Rush piloted a TIE/vn space superiority fighter, and at one point attacked and destroyed another starship above a snowy terrestrial body.

"Vagabond" was the nickname of an individual who served as a pilot in the Galactic Empire. Vagabond piloted a TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter, and performed bombing runs during the Battle of Scarif.

A Sith Lord served the Sith Empire, and taught the Beast-Lord Brutann. Darth Savik recalled in 3627 BBY that this Sith Lord had served Darth Jadus in some unspecified manner before the latter disappeared from galactic prominence.
Grek was a human who served as a commander and later commodore in the navy of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
A mutated Geonosian Queen was the progenitor of the mutated Geonosians, developed by the Sith Darth Malora around the time of the new conflict between Sith Empire and Galactic Republic.

A human train driver drove a train on the planet Milvayne. When the assassin droid 0-0-0 threatened them, the driver reported him to the Informahub and Milvayne Authority drones threw him into the lower levels of Milvayne City.

A female professor taught genetic science at an academy on the world Eroudac. The professor claimed to make potent tea from the haneli flower, though the price of the flowers increased dramatically due to a drought on Haneli.

A Trandoshan female worked as a waitress at a cantina in the crowded and shabby lower district of Actlyon City on the Outer Rim planet Actlyon. In 34 ABY, the waitress took orders from the crew of the smuggler Ana Tolla, though their orders came back to them incorrect.

Arel Trem was a corrupt Customs Officer of the New Mandalorian government. During the Clone Wars, Arel Trem was part of Mandalore Customs and was to accept fifty crates of Corellian Run MultiMeals in exchange for giving 200 credits per case.

Nord Kandende was a human male who served in the Galactic Empire as a pilot and lieutenant of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. During the Galactic Civil War, Kandende had disrupted a welcome party for the Edict crew.

Ardo Banch was a human lieutenant in the Galactic Empire who was stationed on the planet Tatooine. In 3 ABY, Banch greeted the Sith Lord Darth Vader when he arrived in search of information about his son, Luke Skywalker, and directed the Sith to a terminal containing local rec…

Around 3638 BBY, a female Zabrak served as leader of Squad 79, a unit within the InterStellar Regulators. During the Conquest of Makeb, Archon Szajin of the Hutt Cartel assigned Squad 79 to attack a Sith Empire strike team.
This unidentified Jedi was the master to Padawan Arn Peralun during the renewed conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

During the Conquest of Makeb, a male Twi'lek served as captain in the military of the Galactic Republic. Around 3638 BBY, he led a refugee caravan named Whiteraft until he was eliminated by Sith Empire forces.
Kavork was a pirate from the Red Meteor Consortium during the time of the Galactic War. In 3637 BBY, he was based on Rishi. He owed a gambling debt to the Trandoshan pirate Boruush.
Anyan was a human male farmer who was present in Luke Skywalker's vision what Darth Sidious took on his head.
Kako Fantanine's mother was a female Fantanine who was the mother of Kako Fantanine. After Kako removed from his place his cousin Roz Fantanine sent him back to his mother's hive.

Bondeeni was a male Gran entrepreneur who did business with Landonis Balthazar Calrissian, the Baron Administrator of Cloud City, around 1 BBY. He bought transfer codes for 10,000 credits after a failed negotiation attempt.
Bondeeni's cousin was a Gran auditor and working for the Galactic Empire.
During the Galactic Civil War, a human individual served as a major in the Galactic Empire. They accompanied Darth Vader and an Imperial ensign to Accresker Jail.
Hedge Devlin was a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire who served as Chief Imperial Inspector in the Chorlian sector of the Outer Rim Territories, where the lieutenant focused on searching for spice.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Paramiah Shrove was an agent of the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order who confiscated a spacer's strongbox in the Chorlian sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
A Human served with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War, commanding a GR-75 medium transport as part of the main Alliance Fleet.

Avar Kriss was a human female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Noble and selfless, Kriss was an inspiration to many of her fellow Jedi. She served on the Starlight Beacon, a space station on the frontier of the galaxy.
Khamus was a human male criminal who was heir to the Mourner's Wail Syndicate. He had a relationship with Krynthia, the heir to a rival criminal organization named the Unbroken Clan.

T'ongor was a human male bounty hunter and the twin brother of T'onga. He was one of several bounty hunters hired by Khamus of the Mourner's Wail Syndicate as part of a team led by Nakano Lash, whose mission was to attack a sanctuary of the Unbroken Clan on the planet Corellia.

Darth Rivix was a male humanoid Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire in the renewed conflict with the Galactic Republic. He first gained recognition during his dedicated service in the Imperial Diplomatic Service.
Megyn Soone was a human female who served Saw Gerrera's Partisans both as a lieutenant and leader of the Vandal squad.
Dray Nevis was an individual who served the Rebel Alliance as a member of Rogue One alongside K-2SO, Jyn Erso, Senna, Lunak, Ria Talla and Jerris Kestal.
Jerris Kestal was an individual who served the Rebel Alliance as a member of Rogue One alongside K-2SO, Jyn Erso, Senna, Lunak, Ria Talla and Dray Nevis.
Caspus Pillar was an alien active during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.
An individual served as an Imperial Navy captain aboard General Gollin's Imperial-class Star Destroyer during the Imperial Era.

An individual served in the Imperial Military as a general aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Formidable during the Imperial Era. In 1 BBY, a crew of bounty hunters led by the cyborg Beilert Valance went on a hunt for Darth Vader, Galactic Emperor Palpatine's enforcer.
Creed was a bounty hunter. At some point, he ended up on the planet Kathol where he began learning Ta-Ree spells from a Yapi shaman. Creed learned spells including block pain and boost attribute.
By 10 ABY, a Trianii debutante had encountered the gambler Landonis Calrissian. In an attempt to impress her, Calrissian took a swing at the Esoomian brawler Bumblethunk of the Razzi Syndicate.
The Eye of Webbish Bog was a Force-sensitive Sirroning that lived on the planet Mustafar. It was locked in symbiosis with a blind giant, living within a lake near the Corvax Fen.

A blind Arobernos resided on the planet Mustafar. The giant's eyes were squeezed shut, preventing it from being able to see. It was pained by being locked in symbiosis with the spidery Eye of Webbish Bog.
The Jedi Knight Halbret had a sister who lived on the planet Coruscant. The sister had a family, and one of her direct descendants was Jessa Dajus.

Speaker was a Yapi shaman and member of the Red Claw tribe living on Kathol. Speaker was one of the first inhabitants to encounter the crew of the FarStar and helped to ally various tribes and species to aid them in their fight against DarkStryder.
The grandfather of Roan Novachez was a pilot.
Skoogia was a female Megarian bog-worm and Fraulda Rynn's pet. Cikatro Vizago once criticized Skoogia's smell, which angered Rynn and caused her to plot Vizago's death.

Twirm was a male Adarian who served as the submister of the crime lord Latts Razzi while she controlled the Razzi Syndicate. Razzi had him fed to the undercrab after he offered her advice about how to present herself in the criminal underworld.

A male individual was a miner from the mining planet Sorgal 12. By 3 ABY, they had become the father of the human Vharn, and the miner was enslaved along with Vharn's sister by the Galactic Empire after it took over Sorgal 12.

A female individual was the sister of the human engineer Vharn. By 3 ABY, they and Vharn's father were enslaved by the Galactic Empire after it took over their homeworld, the mining planet Sorgal 12, where they worked as miners.
Karyn Sitra was a human female pilot in the Bespin Wing Guard, the security forces for Cloud City on the planet Bespin. She had a son named Elvar.

Elvar was a male individual who lived during the Imperial Era and was the son of Karyn Sitra, a human pilot who served as part of the security of Cloud City on the Outer Rim gas giant Bespin. In 3 ABY, Elvar was young.

373-CR was a customs agent of the Rampa II Port Authority based in Port Hoshim on the world Rampa II. Between 10 BBY and 3 ABY, 373-CR accepted a bribe paid in credits from the smuggler Sana Starros, who wished to claim the belongings of her husband Han Solo and his co-pilot C…
Henris Octavian was an Imperial governor. He was assigned to take over stewardship of Cloud City in the wake of the Imperial occupation.

Restria Venteger was a member of the Cloud City Exex, and governor Henris Octavian's chief aide. Venteger wanted the city's central computer back on line in the wake of the occupation of Cloud City to protect secrets pertaining to tibanna gas.
Mann Do'Kor'chok was a Viceprex for Cobalt Conglomerate. Do'Kor'chok was on Cloud City following the Imperial occupation to win a tibanna gas contract for Cobalt Conglomerate.
Quen Duo was a cyborg slicer. He was employed by Cobalt Conglomerate to help them win a tibanna gas on Cloud City in the wake of the Imperial occupation.
Bevos Zorr was a slicer working for Galentro Heavy Works. He was present on Cloud City in the wake of the Imperial occupation to help his boss, Wyrn Otro, win a tibanna gas contract.
Xavier Gateway was the Chief Executive Officer of Soaring Star Specialized. Lobot on Cloud City alerted Gateway to the danger posed by a planned miners' strike.
Dango Bolter was a troubleshooter working for Soaring Star Specialized. He was determined to save his boss, Xavier Gateway from possible threats.
Loneshot was a bodyguard who served the crime lord Wonn Ionstrike. He was dedicated to protecting his boss.
Braka was an Ugnaught guild leader and forger on Cloud City. Braka worked with Restria Venteger to engineer a tibanna gas miner strike to embarrass the new Imperial governor, Henris Octavian.
Kre Nol-Shod was a fast-draw killer who served as Governor Henris Octavian's bodyguard. Nol-Shod was always by the governor's side.
The wife of Mortimon Galli was reportedly killed by Imperial scouts while Galli was on a fortune hunt. Galli had a holopic of the pair of them hanging above the bar at the Last Stand Casino.
Grungie was a thief who attempted to break into Pandor's Hydrospanner on Ord Mynock. He fell victim to a Vindicator Lockjaw guard droid guarding the establishment.
Jnoofot (pronounced "Geeknew-fot") was an Aqualish mercenary. He resided at Sliteye's Entertainment Emporium where he hired out his services for five hundred credits a day.

Keenos was an entertainer residing in Ord Mynock Freeport. He entertained crowds in the Atrium by juggling clubs lit on fire while reciting stanzas of the poem "The Dread Pirate Kragg." Keenos would often pass around a hat after his performances, asking for donations to the Ol…
Leezoth was the proprietor of Leezoth's Antiquities and Fine Imports, located in the Ord Mynock Freeport.
Lunk was a hulking alien hired by Leezoth to protect his business, Leezoth's Antiquities and Fine Imports.
Zelto Sliteye was the seldom-seen owner of Sliteye's Entertainment Emporium in the Ord Mynock Freeport.
Tinno was an alien bouncer who worked for Mortimon Galli at the Last Stand Casino.
Vasteg was a Devaronian forger who based his operations out of Sliteye's Entertainment Emporium. He was capable of forging Bureau of Ships and Services permits.

Kara Shuba was a failed Jedi who survived the Great Jedi Purge. Surviving by hiding in the shadows of the Ord Mynock Freeport, Shuba cultivated a personality as an annoying and insane old woman to divert attention from herself.
Drew Lokii was the head of Freeport Security Force, and the leader of the local Rebel cell at the Ord Mynock Freeport.
Logan Erstar was a gambler and the former Baron of Filby. Erstar found himself at the Ord Mynock Freeport in the company of Gillian Rayburst and Candor 6612.
Simpi was a juvenile sarlacc from the Outer Rim planet I'vorcia Prime. During the Imperial Era, she was being studied by Doctor Genzhor, prior to a betrayal by his assistant, Ooris.

Reath Silas was a human male Jedi Knight who lived during the High Republic Era. The apprentice of Jedi High Council member Jora Malli, most of his apprenticeship had been spent on Coruscant or in high-level diplomatic meetings, before Malli was appointed the commander of the …
Vernestra Rwoh was a Mirialan female Jedi Master who lived during the High Republic Era. She was also occasionally nicknamed "Vern", although she disliked it.

Lula Mrala-Talisola, known as Lula Talisola before her marriage, was a human female Jedi Padawan who lived on Naboo before joining the Jedi Order and being trained under Jedi Masters Yoda, Torban Buck, and Kantam Sy.

Farzala Tarabal was a Zygerrian male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Stationed aboard the academic cruiser Star Hopper under the training of Jedi Masters Obratuk Glii, Yoda, and Torban Buck, Tarabal was a friend of fellow Padawans Qort and Lula Tali…

A human puppeteer became a member of the Opposition, a political performance troupe, during the Republic Era. While the Opposition was operating on the Inner Rim planet Pijal, the Pijali puppeteer participated in her troupe's staged performances.

Burryaga Agaburry, known as Tall Friend to the charhound Ember, was a male Wookiee Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order who was active during the High Republic Era. The apprentice of Jedi Master Nib Assek, his master learned Shyriiwook so she could communicate with him.
An alien acted as the commentator for the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally on the planet Coruscant.
Tanch was a human who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire. Tanch was stationed as a commanding officer in Cloud City on Bespin after it was occupied by the Empire.

A Herglic bounty hunter operated during the time of the Galactic Empire. The bounty hunter was hired by the Empire to track down the rogue archaeologist Chelli Aphra, alongside a droid and the Wookiee Krrsantan.
Renigus Wight was a male commander within the Imperial Reclamation Service of the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Sokiro Terebin was a Jedi artificer who at one point in history served the Jedi Order. Among Terebin's contributions was the study of resonator technology on the planet Filata.
Walex Cantwell Blissex I was a legendary human starship designer who served as an officer in the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A Poletec test subject was a Poletec captured by the Techno Union to be used as a test subject. Foreman of the Techno Union, Wat Tambor, had the Decimator tested on this Poletec, vaporizing him.
Shil Tervo was a lead engineer at Lantillian ShipWrights. Tervo was responsible for designing the GX1 short hauler, which was initially envisioned as an entry-level yacht.

Manaroo was an Aruzan female who dated the bounty hunter Dengar during the Imperial Era. At some point, she became indebted to the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure, who made her his prisoner and used her as leverage against Dengar.

This unidentified AT-AT commander commanded three AT-AT walkers during a skirmish with Rebel Alliance and Wookiee forces led by Lieutenant Valeria. Though initially confident of victory, his walkers were destroyed by the Arrowhead.

Magnet was an individual who was active during the Imperial Era and served as a deep-cover agent for the Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service on the shipyard of Sienar Fleet Systems that contained the spy ship Darkflare.
Omzo Ivrevi was a male Duros crime lord who dealt with smuggling and black market operations on Duro during the Imperial Era.
A human individual taught Gita how to hunt at some point. On one occasion, the human instructed Gita while on Mytar to wait for an animal to buck as the latter took aim at the creature.

Lidiah Alexakis was an individual who served as a mechanic and sergeant in the Alliance Army of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era. They designed the basis of the Model 40 field repulsor hoist.
A male oil baron hired the smuggler Ana Tolla to eliminate a rival of his, yet the mission resulted in an accident in which an entire city burnt down.
A Togruta child was one of Julen Rakab's childhood friends. They met when a gang robbed and attacked them both when while young.

Ooris Bynar was a Thisspiasian male bounty hunter active during the time of the Galactic Empire. He partnered with Khel Tanna and her crew of scoundrels, undergoing missions for galactic criminals like Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Syphacc was a human male who operated Syphacc's Bountiful Bounties, an organization that handed out bounties to bounty hunters.

T'onga was a human female bounty hunter who was the twin sister of fellow hunter T'ongor. T'onga eventually left the life of bounty hunting behind and lived as a farmer on the Moon of Logal Ri with Losha Tarkon.
Losha Tarkon was a human female and the partner of the former bounty hunter T'onga. Tarkon and T'onga lived together on the Moon of Logal Ri, where they planned to live as farmers.
Asenator was from the planet Naboo; they and their daughter stopped on the planet Batuu because their starship was out of fuel.

The daughter of a senator from the Mid Rim Territories planet Naboo was a female individual with dark hair that she styled in braided ropes. At some point between 21 ABY and 34 ABY, she and her father stopped on the Outer Rim planet Batuu due to lack of fuel for several hours.
Gar Sedonn was an individual who served as an agent in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau.

A Devaronian was a member of a clan of Devaronians during the Imperial Era, who had a bounty placed on them. In 3 ABY, he and his clan engaged in a shootout with the cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance within Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.

Faleer Ayast was an individual who served as an advisor to Queen Cheraama during the Imperial Era. After Queen Cheraama's trade reforms backfired, a wave of pro-Galactic Empire sentiments arose and Ayast was concerned what an Imperial governorship would mean for the freedoms o…

Cheraama was a queen who served as the ruler of Alun and belonged to its royal family. When she ascended the throne during the Imperial Era, she was considered young and inexperienced, and genuinely wanted to serve her people but her reforms backfired.

A spy worked for the Galactic Empire. When the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry held a recruitment drive on the terrestrial astronomical object Demiloch sometime prior to the year 3 ABY, the Imperial spy posed as a recruit.
Gorlan Seba was a human male who lived in the city of Tavuu on the planet Radhii at the time Emperor Palpatine was reported dead and the second Death Star was destroyed.

Vrake was a human male Imperial officer who once forced a tracker named Gorlan Seba to lead an expedition into the the Zoess, a large forest near the city Tavuu on the planet Radhii to locate rebels who escaped imprisonment.

Ommin was a male individual affiliated with the Sith who ruled as a king long before the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance. He was recorded as having worn a mechanical spine known as an Ommin harness.
Jarraban was a male member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, a spicerunner gang who operated on the planet Kijimi. He was the right-hand man of Zorii Bliss, the leader of the gang.
Lluda was a human female slicer and a member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, a gang of spicerunners who operated on the planet Kijimi.

Vibbo was a thug who worked with the spicerunner gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi, alongside Vicii. The two thugs accompanied the Spice Runners' leader, Zorii Bliss, to confront Poe Dameron, Resistance member and former Spice Runner who returned to Kijimi on a mission.
Vicii was a thug who worked with the Spice Runners of Kijimi, a spicerunner gang active on the planet Kijimi, alongside Vibbo.

Jhorstek was an Abednedo black market technician who lived during the Imperial Era. While searching for Nakano Lash, in 3 ABY, the bounty hunter Boba Fett found Jhorstek and interrogated him. Jhorstek provided the location of the graveyard planet Galmerah, and Fett killed him.
Diihara Val was a representative for the Mek-Sha Tradehouse, an auction establishment located on Mek-Sha.
Pintu was a Dinutun who lived on the planet Dinutu. When one of the Kran severed his arm, it was replaced with a prosthetic.

Lokann was a male Rutian Twi'lek who operated on the planet Coruscant in 19 BBY. He and his business partner brokered a deal with Rafa Martez, hiring the young woman to build them three binary loadlifters.
An individual operated as a business partner of the Twi'lek Lokann during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, he brokered a deal with Rafa Martez, hiring the young woman to build three binary loadlifters.

Veek, also known by the nickname Veek the Sneak, was the male Rodian leader of Harido Wald, a smuggling ring operating in Mek-Sha during the third Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire.
Noctur'lan was a giant nightspider who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. It lived in the Eastern Great Grass Plains, near the city of Kaadara.

Phranis Bolgar was a Beachcomber smuggler leader who lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. He might be related to another Beachcomber leader, Lonnley Bolgar. Phranis Bolgar was arrested by Royal Naboo Security Forces agent Jonthol Mazoon.

A male was the harbormaster of the planet Refnu. During the Atterra campaign, Paige and Rose Tico argued with the harbormaster when they arrived on the planet to help and get something warm for themselves.
Orion Chalk was an Atterran male who lived on the planet Atterra Bravo and the uncle of Reeve Panzoro. He was also a member of the Bravo Rising resistance team against the First Order in 34 ABY.
Persid was a captain in charge of the Republic fleet in orbit above Onderon during the new conflict between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire.
Dario was a Nefrian male miner who lived on the planet Refnu. He helped Paige and Rose Tico to find a job with the Refnu Corporation.
Imri Cantaros was a Genetian human male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the time of the High Republic born around 246 BBY.
An individual served as the flight engineer of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 Cobalt Wasp during the Atterra campaign.

This male was a flight engineer of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 Crimson Cutter during the Atterra campaign. On the second run of Attera campaign a the Cobalt and Crimson Squadron were under attack by the First Order.

Ivies was an individual who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, Ivies commanded a number of snowtroopers searching for signs of the Rebel Alliance at Echo Base on the Outer Rim planet Hoth.

Tubleek Ruz was a Kubaz bounty hunter who operated during the time of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, the Kubaz joined the rogue archaeologist Chelli Aphra in a job to steal confiscated Rebel Alliance contraband from the Galactic Empire at Echo Base on the planet Hoth.

This male individual was a pilot of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 Crimson Hailstorm during the Atterra campaign. He also flew in the Battle of D'Qar where he and the rest of the Hailstorm crew perished in 34 ABY.
This male individual was a pilot of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 Crimson Bolide during the Atterra campaign. They took rest only third run of Attera campaign.

The Mauler Usurper was a leader of the Maulers, a criminal group that operated on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he planned to attack the city of Keren with a large force, in an effort to show up the old Mauler leader and take over the Mauler gang for himself.

A Ranat bartender owned a bar on the planet Eriadu during the time of the Galactic Empire. When a thief entered the bar to escape Imperial stormtroopers, the bartender caught the young boy, threatening to kill the thief for bringing trouble to their bar.

A human male individual resided in Phelar Port on the planet Eriadu during the time of the Galactic Empire. The young boy stole ration packs from an Imperial speeder, and was pursued by stormtroopers into a bar.
Kinash Lock was a brown-skinned Twi'lek male who served as the majordomo to King Yaruba of Kessel and the Yaruba Family of Kessel during the Clone Wars.

A Zygerrian male worked as an overseer at the spice mines of Kessel during the Clone Wars. The overseer transferred a shipment of spice to Rafa and Trace Martez in order for them to deliver it to the Pyke Syndicate on Oba Diah.
Romar Kek was the Human male commanding officer of the Defiant Core base on Innton II after the base was able to support a small fleet of airspeeders and speeder trucks.
A female individual lived in the galaxy during the Age of the Republic. She was the mother of Trace and Rafa Martez, and taught her daughters to help others in need.
The father of Trace and Rafa Martez was a male individual who lived in the galaxy during the Age of the Republic.
A Clone Corporal served in the Republic Navy of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Stellan Gios, remembered as the "Fallen Star," was a human male Jedi Master who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Loden Greatstorm was a Twi'lek male Jedi Master who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era and was considered one of the best teachers of the Order.

A Gotal male beggar resided on the planet Oba Diah during the Clone Wars. He encountered Ahsoka Tano and the Martez sisters, Trace and Rafa, who were attempting to escape imprisonment by the Pyke Syndicate.
A Weequay male was a prisoner of the Pyke Syndicate within its fortress on the planet Oba Diah during the Clone Wars, held in a prison cell alongside an Ithorian.
An Ithorian was a prisoner of the Pyke Syndicate on the planet Oba Diah during the Clone Wars, held in a prison cell, alongside a Weequay, within the High fortress of the Pyke Syndicate.
Bern was a commander stationed on Mek-Sha during the new conflict between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire.
Hastemoor was a governor of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, during which he led forces that were fortified in the capital of the planet Troithe.
Heater was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic that was active during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist Alliance.

Dalesham was a General of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. He was the commander of the local Separatist forces on Innton II. After the Nova Defiant crashed on the planet, he ordered the relocation of parts of the ship to the Great Cavern to be build into a base.

A male was an inhabitant of the planet Cianap. He was the only eyewitness who looked on how Darth Vader killed the Ender, the enormous creature that terrorized the planet. He has a Droid Raz, also known as Razzy.

This individual was an X-wing starfighter commander of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, serving the rebel outpost on Jamiri. She and her squadron managed to attack an Imperial starfighter factory on an Imperial supply moon.
This individual was a general for the Rebel Alliance, serving at the rebel outpost in Jamiri. He sent an X-wing starfighter squadron to attack an Imperial starfighter factory on a supply moon.
This individual was a human male who served as a commander in the Galactic Empire. He accompanied the minister when he visited a starfighter factory on an Imperial supply moon.

This individual served as an aide of the Supreme Chancellor in the time of the High Republic. They were believed by some to have had an affair with the Jedi Padawan Klias Teradine, which led to his vanishing from Jedi history.

A Trandoshan male manager worked for the Pyke Syndicate at a spice shipping dock on the planet Oba Diah. During the Clone Wars, Rafa and Trace Martez tried to steal spice from the dock in order to trick the Pykes, but a worker requested assistance from the manager.

A Toong male worker served under a Trandoshan manager at a Pyke Syndicate spice shipping dock on Oba Diah. When attempting to trick the Pykes into releasing their associate Ahsoka Tano, Rafa and Trace Martez tried to steal spice from the dock, claiming they had a delivery order.

An assassin was in the employ of the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Baras around 3640 BBY. An agent for Baras within the ranks of the Republic Strategic Information Service (SIS), this human male operated as an assassin, and was entrusted by the Dark Lord—along with two other ope…
Spince was a lackey of the Siniteen pirate Hal'Sted.
Hakka was a Serennian male and the Count of the Funeral Moon Mantero and was present at the funeral of Countess Anya.
A Poletec was a scout of the natives of Skako Minor, which offered to guide Jedi General Anakin Skywalker and his clone unit to Echo's location after they promised they would leave afterwards.

Crane was a Clone Commander who, in a Force vision experienced by Dooku, served under Jedi Master Jor Aerith during the Clone Wars. During his vision, Dooku witnessed a battle in which Crane executed Order 66 and shot Master Aerith.

Lyr Farseeker was an individual who joined the Jedi Order despite lacking in Force-sensitivity. He would arise to the rank of Jedi Master. He wrote Poetics of a Jedi and numerous other texts that became vital teachings for the Order.

Sapaaga, also known as Sapaaga the Hutt, was a Hutt that was known to bet on the droid races on the Nar Shaddaa Promenade. During the Grand Acquisitions Race, Sapaaga acquired a black and orange sphere which was one of the items hidden by the Chevin Conglomerate.
Var Narek's father was an Imperial who was cheated out of becoming the governor of Livien Magnus by Ellor Orgraal.
An Imperial major was put in charge of a medicinal spice mine on the Mid Rim planet Naboo during the Imperial Era.

Aleos Narek was the brother of Var Narek. He had a family, and a store. He was killed in the Bombing of Rialla Way, along with the store and the rest of his family, minus Var Narek's father, and his brother.

A clone trooper pilot served the Galactic Republic during the Siege of Mandalore in 19 BBY. As the battle began, the pilot transported a number of clone troopers of the 332nd Company to the city of Sundari on the planet Mandalore to assist the Mandalore resistance in taking ba…

Rayar was a male and member of the Car'das intelligence ring during the Galactic Civil War. During the Battle of Tansarii Point Station between Car'das and Black Sun forces, Laetin A'shera's pilots eliminated a Black Sun spy during a patrol mission in the Lucent Ivaya quadrant…
Rikoo was a young Force-sensitive Wookiee male who was just beginning his training as a Jedi youngling by the time of the Third Battle of Geonosis.
An individual was a captain in the fleet of the Rebel Alliance who served aboard the light freighter Trumpet's Call. In 3 ABY the Trumpet's Call was attacked by forces of the Galactic Empire.
Elemack was a Mon Calamari male who served as the commander of Titan Base, a Rebel Alliance starfighter base in the Corva sector.
Shara was a female individual who served as the Logistics Officer of Titan Base, a Rebel Alliance starfighter base in the Corva sector.

A Gungan soldier served in a team led by Sabé, a former handmaiden to Queen Padmé Amidala. Sabé and the soldiers that served her worked as rebels against the Galactic Empire following Amidala's death, having walked with Sabé at her funeral.
Keluda's brother was a male Dug who was one of the workers at the Golden Nyss Shipyards killed when the station was blown up by the Yinchorri. He was the brother of the assassin Keluda.

Mercedes Vanadiaz was the wingman of Jerrod Lourdas. She was cocky and eager to rise in the ranks of the Rebel Alliance. Her bossy attitude gave some a poor image of herself, especially to Jerrod Lourdas.
Sterling was the nickname of a clone trooper of the 332nd Division within the Galactic Republic's 501st Legion who took part in the Siege of Mandalore in 19 BBY.
Beryl Suttrige was an individual who worked at the College of Astrocartography, on the planet Charmath, at some point after the Battle of Endor.
An Imperial technician served aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Executrix during the battle near the Gulf of Tatooine.

Naga Sadow was an ancient Sith Lord and Sith alchemist who, according to the quasi-historical Qel-Droma Epics, led the Sith Empire during the Great Hyperspace War against Empress Teta and the Jedi Order while also triggering the Cron Supernova.
Locphet was an ancient Sith Lord whose likeness was chiseled into the rock walls of the citadel on Exegol by 35 ABY.
Kli the Elder was an ancient Jedi who contributed to at least one chapter of the Rammahgon, a book that compiled the many origin stories of the Jedi Order.
Felkor was a Sith Lord who was depicted in a statue chiseled into one of the interior rock walls of the Sith Citadel on Exegol, a Sith planet in the Unknown Regions.
Kallie Lintra was a female Resistance pilot and sister of Tallissan Lintra. Her sister hailed from the planet Pippip 3 and lived on a farm alongside her parents.
Korryn was a Thalassian Smuggler who was tasked with supplying Arda Base with medical supplies. She was the captain of smuggler crew and had two children.
Mindran was an ancient Sith Lord whose likeness was chiseled into the rock walls of the citadel on Exegol by 35 ABY.
Passk was a Trandoshan male living during the Galactic Civil War. He owned the curiosity shop Passk's Oddities on Martle Station.
Sissiri was an ancient Sith Lord whose likeness was chiseled into the rock walls of the citadel on Exegol by 35 ABY.
Grummart was an individual who held the rank of captain in the First Order military, and was responsible for teaching the regime's stormtroopers.

A human fleet technician served onboard the Xyston-class Star Destroyer Derriphan and under Captain Chesille Sabrond during the Battle of Exegol. The fleet technician was killed when the Resistance destroyed the Derriphan.
Following the Battle of Yavin, an Imperial commander was in charge of a group of troopers including Thane Kyrell, NO-718, and NY-112.

A male overlord ruled as a tyrant over a village on a world in the Horox system. During the Imperial Era, the overlord was angered by the villagers' inability to feed him due to the fact that he had eaten all the village's food and left them to starve.

Clik was the alias of a Verpine, whose name at birth was unpronounceable by non-Verpines. He worked as a quartermaster for the Rebel alliance on Arda I. Clik was skilled at weapon modification, and most of the blasters he revised were more accurate and deadly.
Jikesh Valia was a female individual who was a captain in the Galactic Republic's Coruscant Rescue Ops during the Clone Wars, and led Fire Team Three.
Yalor was a Sullustan who held the rank of Major by the time of 0 ABY. He was the programmer of the Slave circuit that guided pilots through The Gauntlet.

A female bogling living on the planet Bogano encountered the Jedi Padawan Cal Kestis in 14 BBY. The bogling was trapped behind a broken door below the landing area of Kestis' transport, the Stinger Mantis, on Bogano.

Wen Farhope was a member of the armed forces of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Farhope was a sergeant in the Imperial Navy. Wen Farhope was involved in a large recruitment program of new pilots for the Imperial Starfighter Corps.
A female pilot served the Shadow Collective criminal organization, led by the rogue Sith Lord Maul, near the end of the Clone Wars.

Grinko was a Weequay pirate who served as the first mate in the pirate gang led by Scorza. Grinko was present on Scorza's skiff when the gang attempted to find the supposed treasure aboard the wrecked Separatist cruiser Obrexta III, during which Scorza ordered Grinko to fire t…

Zebulon Dak was a long-time speeder race fanatic and skillful engineer. He made money endorsing promising new racers, and ended up founding his own company, the Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation. Dak's company manufactured short run speeders such as the Joben T-85 speeder bike.

A male Imperial served aboard transport three-six-six during the Imperial Era. While the transport was docked in the ISD Executrix hangar, the man contacted an Imperial on the Star Destroyer requesting departure.

The wife of Aleos Narek worked at her father's shop, When she married Aleos, she took control of the store along with him. Around 2 BBY, she was killed along with Aleos Narek and her two children in the Bombing of Rialla Way.

A male Imperial served aboard the ISD Executrix during the Imperial Era. While transport three-six-six was docked in the Star Destroyer's hangar, the man was contacted by an Imperial on the transport requesting departure.

An Imperial served aboard the ISD Executrix during the Imperial Era. Following the attack on the Imperial compound on Agaris, the Imperial asked Governor Wilhuff Tarkin if the Executrix should open fire on the enemy Agarians.

An Imperial officer served aboard the ISD Executrix during the Imperial Era. The officer was reported to by a TIE pilot of C-patrol several times, one of which the pilot needed to be disciplined for inappropriate comments.
A male TIE fighter pilot served in C-patrol aboard the ISD Executrix during the Imperial Era. He was joined by another pilot patrolling the planet Agaris.
During the Imperial Era, an individual served as a Purge Trooper Commander and held the military rank of captain.

An individual served as a commander of Imperial forces on the electromagnetic wind-swept planet Zeffo in 14 BBY. When the fugitive Jedi Cal Kestis undertook a mission to Zeffo as part of a secret mission to rebuild the Jedi Order that year, he killed the commander.
The son of Aleos Narek and his wife. He lived with his family until his death around 2 BBY.
The daughter of Aleos Narek was killed in the Bombing of Rialla Way along with her father, mother, and brother.
Vortex 6 was a Rebel who was affiliated with Vortex Squadron.

A human male served as a rebel trooper during the Imperial Era and took part in a battle. During the fighting, the trooper proclaimed to his comrades about Red Four, who had sacrificed herself to unsuccessfully try to kill Darth Vader.

Jayfon was a male individual who served as a captain in the Senate Guard of the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Jayfon and his Senate Commandos were attacked by Duros bounty hunter Cad Bane and his group of mercenaries in the raid of the Republic Executive Building o…

An individual was the captain of the starship Mandible in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. By 3 ABY, he ferried volatile cargo while under the influence of alcohol, leading to an accident that killed numerous crew members.
Vsin "Cannon" Starbomber was a male Human pirate pilot who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Blot was a feral shaupaut that lived on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Blot and its pack were leaving in the Gallo Mountains, near the city of Dee'ja Peak.
Sam Kenzie was a rehabilitation officer of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Bureau of Punitive Correction who was stationed at the prison Megalox Beta during the Imperial Era.
Domina Tagge was a human female member of the prominent Tagge family and the head of the Tagge Corporation. Tagge held the title of Lady and operated from Tagge Space aboard the starship Acquisitor.

Estat was a Twi'lek individual who served as the sava of the Shadow University. After the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra acquired a fossilized fork-nosed ice worm on Hoth, she delivered it to Estat, who paid her for the find.

Kiehart was a human mercenary who served Ronen Tagge, a member of the powerful House of Tagge. Along with several of Tagge's mercenaries, including Venters, Kiehart once worked alongside Doctor Chelli Aphra in a job on Felucia.

Venters was a Zabrak mercenary who worked for Ronen Tagge of the House of Tagge. At some point, Venters was involved in a job on Felucia with fellow mercenary Kiehart and the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra.

Covik was a human artist who created the sculpture An Empire's Grace, made entirely of beskar. Ronen Tagge of the powerful House of Tagge, who enjoyed collecting artifacts solely to destroy them, acquired the scuplture, along with a painting created by Falber, and brought the …

Falber was a human artist. A painting created by Falber, along with the sculpture An Empire's Grace, made by Covik, was acquired by Ronen Tagge of the House of Tagge, who enjoyed purchasing artifacts to destroy them.
Rax was an individual who was sentenced to prison on the planet Alderaan, sometime between 10 BBY and the Destruction of Alderaan in 1 BBY.
This clone navigation officer served as a Clone Captain in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Borrosel was an Ithorian pacifist who mentored the young Setenna Hase. His death in an Imperial raid led Setenna to join the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

During Darth Momin's destruction of a city, an individual, who was a human male with blond hair, was one of two Jedi Knights who boarded Darth Momin's superweapon and killed the physical body of the Sith Lord Darth Momin, ending his rampage.

During Darth Momin's destruction of a city, a human male individual of the Jedi Order was one of two Jedi Knights who boarded Darth Momin's superweapon and killed the physical body of the Sith Lord Darth Momin, ending his rampage.
A pilot was active on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, he agreed to do a job running spice with the small-time criminal Rafa Martez and supplied both a starship and crew.
A clone trooper officer served as a clone navigation officer aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Tribunal after the Siege of Mandalore.

An Imperial governor ruled on the planet Fallex. The governor oppressed the natives to Fallex, which caused uprising within the natives. With the assistance of the Ardan resistance, the governor and the Imperial occupation of Fallex became eradicated.
Buggine was a Hutt active during the Imperial Era. Among her courtesans were Pompey Pavel-Martinus, who compared Buggine to Ziro Desilijic Tiure.

Ran Deezy was a Jedi youngling of the Jedi Order who was active during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems by the time after the capture of Eeth Koth.

A Falleen male individual was one of the Black Sun crime syndicate's five leaders during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, he and the other leaders were killed when the former Sith Lord Maul had his brother Savage Opress execute them for refusing to join the brothers alliance.
A human served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic as an assistant to Lieutenant Tigran Jamiro of the Alliance Military while both were stationed in Echo Base on the planet Hoth.
"Red One," also designated "R-1," was a pilot in the Resistance Starfighter Corps stationed at the base on D'Qar during the Cold War with the First Order.

A Rodian Jedi youngling was with Trilla Suduri and Cere Junda as they were hiding from the Galactic Empire. Junda left to lure them away, telling Suduri that she'd circle back, instructing her to stay with the younglings.
In 14 BBY, an Imperial technician served as a specialist on Sentinel Base. He informed Moff Wilhuff Tarkin of the specifications of a warship attacking the base.
A member of the Imperial personnel stationed in Jedha City on the moon Jedha was owner of the RA-7 protocol droid KMD-RA-71.
A feared executioner was an ancient Mandalorian whose long ax came into the possession of Ap'lek, a member of the Knights of Ren.
Urel Haydon was a very dedicated Rebel, and after nearly who decades of fighting, he lost multiple limbs in battle. Even though Haydon was battle hardened, he was cheerful and pleasant to be around.

Loren Morrick was the head of the medbay on Arda Base. She was in her late thirties, and was worn down by the war. She had lost many friends and colleagues in battle, but she kept fighting for the Alliance to Restore the Republic because she believed in the Alliance's cause.

During the Battle of the Gauntlet, Imperial forces break into the base of the Ardan resistanceby blowing up a wall. Stormtroopers shoot fleeing Rebels, including a Sergeant tasked with destroying the base by overloading generators.
Dorrian Vodani was a Dressellian Rebel pilot who flew a Z-95-AF4 Headhunter while escaping Arda Base during the Battle of the Gauntlet. He was the commander of Rust Squadron.

Ran Niall was a male Human Imperial turned Rebel. In his time as an Imperial, he was a captain for the Imperial Navy. When Ran saw the atrocities the Empire had committed on Mon Cala, he became a turncoat, and joined the Rebel Alliance.

A princess who was dying in the Kingdom of Tion at some point thousands of years before the Imperial Era taught her pipe-bird to whistle her favorite song. Cornelius Evazan recorded the story of the princess in an entry in the logbook known as the Smuggler's Guide.

A Hisseenian individual held the title of premier in the parliament of the planet Hisseen. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems launched a siege of the planet in 22 BBY, and Count Dooku arranged to meet with the Hisseenian premier, hoping to learn the …
Griffus Pinter was a male pilot who served in the Civilian Defense Force of the Yavin system, and a friend of Kes Dameron.
Bellow was a clone trooper who served in the 501st Legion of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Malee Hurra was a human Rebel Alliance Navy pilot who flew a Scurrg H-6 Bomber during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire.
Gi' a Pei was a female Twi'lek who stayed in Kaadara on Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Isshthar was a short-tempered Wookiee who nearly ripped off the arm of Sarliss because they disagreed about something. When Isshtharr was not using violence to solve problems, he asked his peers to find out how things worked.
Corrimias was a philosopher who preached about equality and peace. Rebel Alliance member Dorrian Vodani looked up to him, going so far as to apply Corrimias' teachings in his daily life.
Mala was a female individual who was beloved to Wedge Antilles. At some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire, Mala, along with Antilles' family, were harmed by the Empire.
Masi Qual was a female Bothan who held the Rank of Lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Considered smug and self-righteous, Qual grew up on Coruscant in a wealthy family.

Urtuaa Haaot was an Ithorian Diplomat who, despite normally being rather calm, held hatred for the Galactic Empire. His hatred stemmed from the fact that the Empire had killed his parents and sent him to a labor camp.

Sanandrassa was the Queen of Naboo who preceded Padmé Amidala on the throne. Unlike her successor, she favored a policy of isolationism. After she retired and was succeeded by Amidala, Sanandrassa planned to open a school for weavers.

Kelleran Beq, nicknamed the "Sabered Hand," was a human male Jedi Master who served in the Jedi Order. He was often assisted by the protocol droid AD-3 and the astromech droid LX-R5, and served aboard the starship Athylia.
This individual Female was the wife of Imperial General Ziering.
Bear was a New Republic pilot who was killed in the Battle of Doornik-319.

Haril Zense was a spy for the Rebel alliance on Ord Radama. Haril was gathering proof about the Rebel Alliance being innocent in the Bombing of Rialla Way. He assisted the Ardan resistance in finding Var Narek, a traitor to the Ardan Resistance.
A human officer held the rank of Sergeant Major in the Galactic Empire. The Imperial officer was stationed at the Imperial Internal Affairs Outpost on Dendada XVII, where they oversaw executions.
A human officer of the Galactic Empire was stationed at the Imperial Communication Relay on Usk Minor.
A human served the Galactic Empire as a comms jockey aboard the Executor, the flagship of Darth Vader.
Kuseph Jovi was a fictitious male individual that Galactic Republic Senator Padmé Amidala created for her cover story while searching for her lost former handmaiden on the planet Batuu in 19 BBY.
A male Muun banker was a member of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, and lived on the planet Scipio. The banker was married with children, and employed a human man as his personal attaché.
A female jeweler was the sister of the human Naboo female Corydn. In 28 BBY, Cordyn began working as a handmaiden to Galactic Republic Senator Padmé Amidala and took on the name Cordé.
Horace Vancil was a human who served as the economic advisor to Queen Padmé Amidala.
Harli Jafan was a female humanoid individual who was the daughter of the planetary director of the planet Jafan. She was tall and hairless, and had light blue skin and delicately webbed fingers.

Tobruna was a human male from Kreeling whose mother was in charge of the planet's refineries. Tobruna's mother sent him to serve as an ambassador in her place at a summit hosted by Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo.

Olan Carrus was an elderly individual who served as an ambassador and representative of the planet Behpour. He represented his planet at a summit held by Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo. Carrus was a good friend of Sio Bibble, Naboo's governor.
Nitsa Tulin was a ambassador for the planet Chommell Minor. She attended the Chommell sector summit held by Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo, but remained disinterested throughout the entire event.

A female individual controlled the refineries of the planet Kreeling, and as a result, held a majority of power over the planet itself. She was the mother of Tobruna, who she sent in her place to attend a summit on Naboo held by Queen Padmé Amidala.

A male individual served as the director of the planet Jafan, and was a descendant of the ruling family who originally colonized the world. He sent his daughter, Harli Jafan, as an ambassador in his place for a summit hosted by Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo.
Usan Ollin was a Neimoidian who served the Trade Federation. When the Trade Federation invaded Naboo, Ollin was placed in charge of Camp Four.

A Chagrian patron visited a cantina in the capital city of the Inner Rim planet Pijal in 40 BBY. While in the cantina, he became intoxicated and tried to garner the attention of the cantina's hostess Selbie, in an attempt to spend time with her.
An unidentified safety spokesperson worked for the Star Tours spaceline around 4 ABY. She reminded travelers of the regulations when flying Star Tours, in a particular language.

Brionelle was an admiral of the Chandrilan Security Force during the Old Republic era. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire, Brionelle served as the commander of the Chandrila Orbital Station.
