Cadro Borrigan was a male businessman who owned a Restaurant in the Cultural District on Ord Radama. Cadro's restaurant was very upscale, and served some of the finest dishes on Ord Radama. There were also a collection of games such as Pazaak for the customers to play.

This Imperial officer served on the Imperial Interdictor and had a run in with Rex and Kanan Jarrus, both disguised as stormtroopers to rescue Ezra Bridger, Jun Sato and the crew from the Liberator. He had a brief conversation with them, noticing Rex's armor was a little tight.
Kamar Th'Marn was a famous Mon Calamari philosopher.

The captain of a light freighter was a male individual who served the Rebel Alliance's military branch during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, he repaired his freighter while stationed in Echo Base on the planet Hoth.
Vakk was a male Gand findsman who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Empire.

Dreja Darmic was a mechanic who worked in the commercial spaceports of Coruscant. Around two years before the Battle of Yavin, Darmic was arrested on charges of tax evasion. His daughter, Maranne, believed otherwise, knowing of his sympathy towards the Rebellion.

A clone served as a shock trooper with Coruscant Guard during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Separatists. He was stationed at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center in Galactic City on Coruscant.
Jabe Rann was a Zabrak male Jedi of the Jedi Order. He often enjoyed watching Duros Jedi Master Wishan sculpt clay using the Force.

Wishan was a Duros male Jedi Master who lived during the High Republic Era. He was proficient at sculpting clay using the Force and used his abilities to create various statues, and he also created an incense from uneti blossoms.

Evor Haris was a male individual who served as a peacekeeper on the world Enujut, welcoming all visitors. After Haris allowed a group of Zemerin onto Enujut, they began to create negativity among the world's residents in order to feed off of it.

A young Mon Calamari male Padawan was a member of the Jedi Order. At some point, the Padawan attempted to steal the clay figures of Jedi Master Wishan but was scared off by Jedi Knight Jabe Rann's sculpture of a dragon.
Eloc Throno was an adventurer, historian, author, and explorer of the galaxy. After leaving his homeworld of Davnar II, he studied cartography at Orchis 2's Graf Archive under director Amel Fortoon.

A female admiral served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. During the war, her speeder was attacked by jungle beasts between the Dromund Kaas spaceport and Kaas City, on the Imperial capital planet of Dromund Kaas.

Quillin Durand was a hero of the Velabri species. During the evacuation of Velabri, a transport carrying Durand's family was saved from destruction by the Imperial invasion fleet by a starfighter piloted by Airen Cracken. Durand swore a Velabri Bloodvow to repay the debt.
Gerind was a member of Alliance Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War. A mousy, small man, Gerind served as General Airen Cracken's assistant.
Rannah was a member of Cryle Cavv's family, and one of the parent's of his nephew, Sienn Sconn. Rannah was killed during the Ryvellia uprising.
Tascin was a member of Cryle Cavv's family, and one of the parent's of his nephew, Sienn Sconn. Tascin was killed during the Ryvellia uprising.

A Zygerrian female cultist ally operated for the Frangawl Cult on the moon Zardossa Stix. After the Frangawl Cult kidnapped Queen Julia of Bardotta and took her to Zardossa Stix to be sacrificed, the Zygerrian was present alongside several other cultists as the kidnappers arri…
A Ming Po male animal trainer worked for the Frangawl Cult. He accompanied several cultists to Zardossa Stix in order to oversee the sacrifice of the captive Queen Julia of Bardotta.
Nela Pentase was a female employee of the Karflo Corporation, working in the accounts department. Doctor Trem DeSelvaine was attracted to her.

"Polly" was the nickname given to Polydroxol captured by the Karflo Corporation. "Polly" was studied by Doctor Trem DeSelvaine, who discovered both its sentience and mimetic capabilities. Polly killed DeSelvaine in an effort to escape captivity.
Keeta was a female Trianii spacer. She worked with Gideon, crewing aboard the Independent Class. Keeta lost an eye when she and Gideon were ambushed by a Polydroxol in the employ of Boss Trome.
Gideon was a human male spacer. He crewed aboard the Independent Class with the Trianii Keeta. While on a stopover at Centares, Gideon killed the Shi'ido Vandolae, who was posing as Pyrron Nox.

Cleven was a spacer who was an associate of Gideon, Keeta, and Pyrron Nox. Eight months after Cleven was killed, Gideon rumbled a Shi'ido posing as Nox by pretending Cleven was still alive and on Kessel.

Russo Berlihat was an analytical programmer who studied at the finest Technical Academy in the Core Worlds. After a stint working under a Moff on Eriadu, Berlihat was contracted to work for Moff Bandor on Questal.
Arno Gallorr was a mechanic who lived in the town of Corestrike on Chrona. He was the son of Mortris Gallorr, and was married to Serise with whom he had a child, Selmar.

Mortris Gallorr was a mechanic who lived in the town of Corestrike on Chrona. Gallorr settled on Chrona before the planet experienced a boom with the discovery of chronamite to start a family and indulge his love of fixing machines.
Selmar Gallorr was Arno and Serise Gallorr's son, and the grand son of Mortris Gallorr. Like his father and grandfather, he had a knack for understanding and mixing machinery.
Serise Gallorr was the wife of Arno Gallorr, and the mother of Selmar.

Kruger, alongside Mortris Gallorr and Arno Gallorr, were part of the Magistrate Council dealing with criminal trials in Corestrike. However, Kruger was also in a romantic relationship with the criminal Themog.

Themog was a criminal operating in the town of Corestrike on the planet Chrona. A former Corellian Security Force officer, Themog retired in disgrace after being injured while trying to shake down a suspect for a higher bribe to look the other way.

affiliation: The Corestrike Repository and Ore Exchange
x: Altros Logan resided in the town of Corestrike on the planet Chrona. He owned The Corestrike Repository and Ore Exchange. Logan employed mercenaries to guard his business since he was afraid of thieves associated with local criminal Themog.

This Imperial officer served under Captain Brunson along with a second officer in her Arquitens-class command cruiser, reporting anything that seemed unusual to her. He got slapped by Brunson when he told her that the rocket trooper squadron had suffered heavy losses.

A human served as a pilot in the Galactic Empire's Helix Squadron as part of the Imperial Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, then later as part of Titan Squadron fighting the New Republic following the B…
A pilot served as a member of the Rebel Alliance in Echo Squadron, and later Vanguard Squadron, of the New Republic under the callsign Vanguard Five.

Keo Venzee was a Force-sensitive Mirialan pilot who served as a member of the New Republic's Vanguard Squadron during the Galactic Civil War and a former professional starship racer. Following the Battle of Endor, Venzee fought against the Galactic Empire's Titan Squadron.

Montra Varn was an undercover Special Agent of the Imperial Security Bureau stationed in the Imperial garrison on Dac. Holding the rank of lieutenant, she was tasked to create discord between the Quarren and Mon Calamari peoples.

Oakie Dokes was a member of the Swokes Swokes species who had pale skin and red eyes. When the bounty hunter Zam Wesell crashed her Koro-2 all-environment Exodrive airspeeder into one of the streets of the Uscru Entertainment District on the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY, Dokes w…

Rowi was a male healer who was one of the hill people, the exiled residents of the planet Gala who opposed the Galacian monarchy. He was the adoptive father of Elan, who was the biological daughter of fellow hill person Tema and her husband King Cana of the Beju-Tallah dynasty.

Zak was a Clone Captain in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars, a galactic conflict fought between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Like their fellow clone troopers, they had been cloned on the planet Kamino from the bounty hunter Jango Fett.
Yates was a female podracer who operated at a racetrack in Mos Zabu on Tatooine. She owned a podracer which she worked on with her friend Oota and their astromech droid Snooze.
Oota was a Twi'lek mechanic who worked with the podracer Yates on the planet Tatooine.
Pako was a male Yuzzum who frequented the racetrack of Mos Zabu on the planet Tatooine. He was known to pester and prank the podracer Yates.
A human male officer served the Galactic Empire aboard the Star Destroyer Bellicose under Commander Tylux. The officer questioned Tylux's persistence in chasing an escaped spy of the Rebel Alliance.
A stormtrooper served as a sergeant in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War.

Darth Sanguis was a male Sith Lord who, according to legend, traveled to Exegol seeking to learn the secrets of immortality. After achieving his goal, Darth Sanguis transformed into a creature over time.
Darth Noctyss was a female Dark Lord of the Sith. Legends said that in the early days of Sith life, Darth Noctyss spent her entire career concentrating on one thing: immortality.

Terisa Kerrill was a human female Imperial officer who served as captain of the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Overseer during the Galactic Civil War. A young officer native to Coruscant, Kerrill was mentored by Captain Lindon Javes.
Bammy Decree was an individual on Nar Shaddaa who could provide passage off the moon without going through customs if one paid up front.
Rufork Tamson, nicknamed "Sharp Tooth", was a Karkarodon stunt racer who became a member of the criminal Gullet Gang.

The Aki-Aki farmer Jo-Dapshi Gorobunn had a grandson who tinkered with his grandfather's Arunskin 75D skimmer. Among his modifications was the decoupling of governors that limited the skimmer's top speed. Eventually, the skimmer was stolen by Rey.

A male munka miner lived on the planet Tatooine with their parents. Sometime prior to the Battle of Endor, the individual was taken captive by Jabba Desilijic Tiure, a Hutt crime lord who wished to take control of the munka mines on top of which the miner's family lived.
Canno Wix was a male Devaronian pirate in league with the Whiphid crime lady Valarian and her gang.

A Wookiee male individual served in Ne'eda's Stalwarts, the organization of the crime lord Ne'eda Frip, on Neral's moon. When the smuggler Lando Calrissian, who owed a debt to Frip, visited the moon, the Wookiee Stalwart brought him to Frip.

A male bounty hunter worked in the crew of the bounty hunter Jeskian Veldar. The hunter accompanied Veldar to Neral's moon in search of the gambler and smuggler Lando Calrissian, who owed Veldar a debt.

A Mon Calamari male bartender worked in the Frozen Kova cantina on the planet Hynestia. The smuggler Lando Calrissian smuggled thirty barrels of illegal purple glandis flower juice onto Hynestia and gave it to the bartender.

Dobra was an individual who served the royal family of Hynestia in their royal palace. Princess Rinetta Gan once tricked Dobra into providing her with two desserts. Zel Gris used this incident to illustrate how clever the princess could be.
The human male was present on the planet Batuu when Senator Padmé Amidala arrived in search of her lost handmaiden in 19 BBY.
Lina Soh was a human female politician who served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era, holding office from 234 BBY.
Hedda Casset was a human female who served as the final captain of the starship Legacy Run during the High Republic Era.
Jary Bowman was a lieutenant of the Byne Guild aboard the Class A modular freight transport Legacy Run, serving as the vessel's first officer under Captain Hedda Casset.
Serj Ukkarian was a human boy who, during the High Republic Era, was a passenger on the freighter Legacy Run, one of thousands of colonists moving to the Outer Rim Territories.

A countess lived on the Core Worlds planet Abregado-rae during the High Republic Era. The woman ordered a saberfish from the Mid Rim planet Tibrin for her private aquarium, which was transported there by Byne Guild Captain Hedda Casset's Class A modular freight transport Legac…
Kalwar was a young Quermian cadet who served aboard the Byne Guild's Class A modular freight transport Legacy Run as a navigator during the High Republic Era.

A female Human hailing from the planet of Naboo worked as a droid designer for Serv-O-Droid, Inc. in the last decades of the Galactic Republic, along with her husband. After decades of work for that company, they retired to their homeworld.

Vitale was a female individual who served as a sergeant in the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry during the Galactic Civil War. Around 5 ABY, the company fought the Galactic Empire through the city districts of the planet Troithe.

Palal Seedia, who was nicknamed "Blink" by New Republic pilots and went by Caulra Spring while undercover, was a human female who served as a TIE fighter pilot, eventually at the rank of lieutenant, in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.
Nasha Gravas was a female individual who served as the second-in-command to Caern Adan in the New Republic's Intelligence.

Draige was a human TIE fighter pilot of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing who served as second-in-command of Squadron Four during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, the New Republic's Barma Battle Group launched an attack on the 204th at the planet Pandem Nai.

Arron was a human TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. The pilot took part in a mission to hunt down the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Hellion's Dare, but was killed in the Oridol Cluster by the time fighter wing's forces were able to elimina…

Darita was a female pilot who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing as the squadron leader of Squadron Two. During her time with Shadow Wing, she and Yrica Quell provided mutual support for each other, despite hardly knowing each other.
Feresk Tssat, nicknamed "Frisk," was a Trandoshan male pilot who flew for the New Republic's Vanguard Squadron. Frisk predominantly flew a BTL Y-wing starfighter.
Yava-Thine was an individual who held the rank of sergeant in the New Republic, serving aboard the Lodestar. She was the nestmate of fellow crewmember P'i.
P'i was an individual who served the New Republic aboard the battleship Lodestar, and the nestmate of Sergeant Yava-Thine.
Fara Yadeez was a female bureaucrat from Troithe. During the Galactic Civil War, she served as an aide to her planet's undersecretary for Imperial affairs.

Denish Wraive was a male soldier in the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry. During the Galactic Civil War, Wraive was selected by the New Republic pilot Wyl Lark to fly an airspeeder in a makeshift squadron, due to a shortage of pilots following an attack by Colonel Soran Kei…

Wisp was a TIE fighter pilot who held the rank of captain and squadron commander in Squadron Three within the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing of the Galactic Empire. She had lost almost all of her squadron during the New Republic's attack on Pandem Nai.
Edineezious Winker was an entrepreneurial pirate. After the New Republic bombarded the garrison world of Verzan, Winker established a cantina named Winker's in the ruins.
Rogart Styll was an individual who served in the Galactic Empire after the Battle of Endor. They served as the captain of the Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier Allegiance.

Ubellikos was a human male soldier of the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry. During the Galactic Civil War, Ubellikos was selected by Wyl Lark to fly an airspeeder in a squadron, due to a shortage of pilots following the attack on Cerberon by Colonel Soran Keize's 204th Impe…

Vann Bragheer was a human male lieutenant TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. He took part a training exercise led by Major Soran Keize, who noted the lieutenant's aversion to zero-thrust turns.

Karli genFries was a human TIE fighter pilot who flew for the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. Around 5 ABY, genFries and eleven other TIE pilots took part in a training exercise led by Major Soran Keize in preparation for an attack on New Republic forces.

Prinspai was an insectoid male soldier of the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry. During the Galactic Civil War, Prinspai was selected by Wyl Lark to fly an airspeeder in a makeshift squadron, due to a shortage of pilots following the attack on Cerberon by Colonel Soran Keize…

Ran Chorda was a human TIE fighter pilot of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. Around 5 ABY, Chorda and eleven took part in a training exercise, led by Major Soran Keize in preparation for an attack on New Republic forces, with eleven other TIE pilots.
Oratio Nenvez was a male instructor aboard the Galactic Empire Star Destroyer Edict. He held the military rank of captain.
Thrail Le-Norra was a TIE fighter pilot of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. He was recruited from an agriworld shortly before the Battle of Endor.

Wilhona Breathe was a human TIE fighter pilot of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. Colonel Soran Keize recognized her name on a casualty report during the Troithe operation. Keize remembered her as a gentle patriot.

Garmen Naadra was a human TIE fighter pilot who joined the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing after graduating from the Imperial Academy. Being mentored by Major Soran Keize, she rose to the rank of lieutenant.
Giginivek was a Ociock who held the rank of captain in the New Republic Defense Fleet, serving aboard the Lodestar.
Let'ij was a female individual who led the Children of the Empty Sun cult on the planet Catadra.
Mardroon was a general of the ancient Tangrada-Nii.

Neihero was a Rodian starfighter pilot who flew for the New Republic's Meteor Squadron under the callsign Meteor Four during the Galactic Civil War. The Rodian had a passing flirtation with another pilot named Wyl Lark over a month.

Creet was a female Imperial TIE mechanic in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. During a celebration, Major Soran Keize, the 204th's commanding officer listened to the stories from crewmembers like Creet, and the mechanic expressed her desire for a counterattack…

Sarvada Dream was a female resident of the planet Catadra. After her partner kidnapped New Republic Intelligence Agent Caern Adan and sold him to a unit of Galactic Empire personnel, Alphabet Squadron pilots Yrica Quell and Nath Tensent were led to Dream while searching for Adan.

Falshoi was a human female TIE fighter pilot who held the rank of lieutenant in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during the Galactic Civil War. Around 5 ABY, the fighter wing fought a New Republic battle group at the Cerberon system.

Mervais Gandor was a human male who served in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. Formally an ordnance specialist, he came to be an Imperial Starfighter Pilot for the fighter wing by 5 ABY.

Ver Iflan was a male individual who, at some point, was imprisoned by the Galactic Empire. Iflan and two other prisoners, Caern Adan and Kairos, realized their interrogation schedule matched up, and Iflan devised a plan to escape, reprogramming their interrogation droid.
Gruyver was a human male member of the Children of the Empty Sun cult.
Nukita was a small child who was a member of the Children of the Empty Sun cult on Catadra.
Jeems was a factory foreman who resided in the Web on the planet Troithe. He provided old transport vehicles to the New Republic during the Troithe operation.
Thage Howless was the husband of Gorgeous Su, a soldier in the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry. At some point by the Galactic Civil War, the pair became separated.

Jorgatha was a Houk male soldier in the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry. Around 5 ABY, during a campaign in the Cerberon system, he and a number of other 61st personnel took refuge at a garage after the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing routed their squads from…
Gorgeous Su was a Houk female member of the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry, and the brother of the New Republic soldier Jorgatha.
Borys was a sergeant in the New Republic who served as chief of the ground crews aboard the Lodestar during the Troithe operation.
Lien Toob was a Sullustan female soldier who served the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry.
Junior was an elderly human male soldier in the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry.
Garrit was one of several brothers of Yrica Quell.
New Dawn was a member of the Children of the Empty Sun cult on Catadra. She had spent a month on Jedha prior to its destruction.

Camm was a human male cadet who attended a flight academy of the Galactic Empire during it's reign. He wished to run away after repeatedly failing his simulator test, and asked fellow cadet Yrica Quell to run with him, who he had feelings for.
Duchas Cherroi was a human TIE fighter pilot in Squadron Three of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the New Republic.
Jidel was a member of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing who died at some point prior to Lieutenant Yrica Quell's defection from the Empire in 4 ABY.
Batriok was a member of the Cavern Angels who knew Chass na Chadic. At some point, Batriok was killed.

Snivel was an individual who flew with the Cavern Angels, but at some point was killed. Fellow Cavern Angel pilot Chass na Chadic loved Snivel, but found herself hardly thinking of him after his death.
The Prophet was the nickname of a Theelin male spice addict who founded the Inheritors of the Crystal cult on Nar Shaddaa in order to amass weapons and followers.

Vukorah was a human female who held the rank of general in the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate. After the rival Mourner's Wail Syndicate bombed and killed Unbroken Clan soldiers on Chorgad, Vukorah attacked Mourner's Wail forces.
A human male was the father of Krynthia and served as the Grand Leader of the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate.

An Iktotchi criminal served the Mourner's Wail Syndicate, delivering spice. While on the Smugglers' Refueling Station in the Kessel sector, the criminal was killed by General Vukorah from their rival, Unbroken Clan.

Orkle was a human female who was the custodian of the Nexus, a floating city above the surface of the planet Quarmendy. When the outpost was taken over by Emir Wat Tambor of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Orkle evacuated her people, but was taken hostage by Tambor.

Corvis was a clone trooper pilot in the Galactic Republic's 104th Battalion. In 22 BBY, Corvis piloted a Republic attack gunship during a mission on the planet Quarmendy. Corvis flew below the enemy scanners and deployed fellow Wolfpack troopers Wolffe, Boost, Sinker, and Comet.
Faddey was an Arcona male spy who worked for the Chadra-Fan Vosa. Under orders from Vosa, Faddey went undercover in the Day Star Hotel to steal secret plans from a Wookiee agent.
Vosa was a Chadra-Fan female who was the boss of the spy Faddey. She sent Faddey on a mission to acquire secret plans from a Wookiee agent at the Day Star Hotel.
A Wookiee male agent possessed secret plans that the spy Faddey was ordered to steal by his boss, Vosa. The Wookiee left the plans in the Day Star Hotel, where they were taken by Faddey.

A human individual resided on Ruusan in 3 ABY. Elderly and blind, the man was old friends with the Nautolan bounty hunter Nakano Lash and met with her on Ruusan sometime after the Galactic Empire's occupation of Bespin.
The Imperial Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin created a creature sometime before the Battle of Yavin as a part of the weapon-manufacturing Tarkin Initiative.
A girl lived in the southern province of the Mid Rim planet Naboo during the Republic Era. By 32 BBY, they were famed for their water sculptures.
"Meteor Leader" was the callsign of a pilot who commanded the New Republic's Meteor Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Magnus the Bloodsoaked was an underboss in the Red Key Raiders, a criminal group active after the fall of the Galactic Empire.

Hussor was a TIE fighter pilot of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. During the attack on Cerberon, Hussor served as the squadron commander of Squadron One during the attack on Cerberon.

"Alphabet Two" was the callsign of a individual who served as part of the Citizens' Fleet, a fleet of starships from around the galaxy which collaborated to destroy the Sith Eternal's navy at the planet Exegol in 35 ABY, after Lando Calrissian sent a broadcast across the galax…

This female individual was the mother of Theelin Alphabet Squadron pilot Chass na Chadic. After she had left Winker's cantina on Verzan and punched a member of the Children of the Empty Sun cult, Chadic returned to her B-wing and began traveling to Troithe.

Jiandy was a male Nautolan. His mother, Clariah, was an old acquaintance of Lando Calrissian. When he was young, he had a dream of building a criminal empire, which his mother disapproved of. Jiandy eventually became a member of the Rebel Alliance.
Jagnar was a male individual who lived in the desert wastelands of the planet Parnassos. He and his tribe encountered the habitable Calliope Station, inhabited by Siv and her daughter Torbi.

Vigilch was a Klatooinian male member of the smuggler gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi. He was one of several Spice Runners that became stranded on the moon Yavin 4 after their pilot was killed.

Marinda Gan was a female Twi'lek bounty hunter who was a member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. Along with several other smugglers of the Spice Runners, Gan was left stuck on the moon Yavin 4 following the death of their pilot.

Gen Tri was a non-binary Pau'an member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi smuggler gang. They were left stranded on the moon Yavin 4, along with several other members of the Spice Runners, when their pilot Beke Mon'z died.
Beke Mon'z was an Ishi Tib male operative of the New Republic Security Bureau. Working for Officer Sela Trune, Mon'z infiltrated the smuggler gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi as a pilot.

Reen was a human female pilot who worked with the droid Kreven. She and Kreven were hired to transport cargo aboard the starship Trustworthy by the Guild of Technicians. Kreven betrayed her, however, and sabotaged the vessel's engines, causing the Trustworthy to crash.

Kevin was an Ewok who stowed away on the starship Trustworthy after it was sabotaged by Kreven, the droid partner of the pilot Reen. Investigating the starship, Kevin inadvertently found a comlink that revealed Kreven intentionally sabotaged the Trustworthy.

Feyodor was a male Human and Corellian who owned and ran Feyodor's Tavern in Capital City on Omman Minor. A noted chef, his establishment was known for its dining options, as well as being a hub for smugglers, bounty hunters, and pirates to find work.

A Trandoshan heavy worked for the gambling syndicate led by the crime lord Cenevax. Around 58 BBY, the Trandoshan, along with two others, were sent to collect the wreckage of the airspeeder piloted by the racer Ramil in the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally—Ramil had ma…
A Candovant served as an ambassador to Candovant. During the time of the Galactic Republic, the ambassador invited the Jedi Master Jor Aerith to attend the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally.

A necrotic queen controlled a star system during the time of the Galactic Republic. The system was liberated from the necrotic queen by the Grand Master Yoda and his Jedi Padawan Dooku, who chronicled the event in his journal.

An aid commander served the Galactic Republic. After a solar storm devastated the floating cities of the planet Protobranch, the aid commander arrived in a Republic starship to rescue both the survivors and the planet's supply of bacta.

A clone trooper was a member of the 501st Legion's 332nd Company during the end of the Clone Wars. After the end of the Siege of Mandalore, the trooper was onboard the Tribunal, a Venator-class Star Destroyer traveling from Mandalore to Coruscant, when Order 66 was issued, for…

The Grandfather of Vice was a male individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, when the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry took refuge on the planet Ankhural to repair its starships, the Grandfather of Vice helped the rebel company avoid trouble with the l…
A female Rutian Twi'lek was the partner of the Rodian Pablo, who owned a pawnshop in Bilbousa Bazaar on Nal Hutta.
Kern was a male Zabrak who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems as a Dark Acolyte during the Clone Wars. He wielded a red double-bladed lightsaber similar to that of Darth Maul.

A Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order visited a diner frequented by two hustlers who had been winning meals off of patrons by rolling chance cubes and offered to play them sometime before the rise of the Galactic Empire. One gambler fled, while the other played him and lost.

Padija Anjeri was a anthropologist and operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The daughter of Jedi Colonel Tyneir Renz, Anjeri studied at the University of Alderaan where she was recruited into the Alliance by Professor Oll Maccabe.

An Abyssin served as a commander of a group of mercenaries that invaded the planet Serenno in a conflict orchestrated by the planet's Count, Ramil. The commander reported to a general at a comm tower in the city of Carannia.

An Abyssin served as a general in a group of Abyssin mercenaries who, at the behest of Count Ramil, invaded the planet Serenno. The general operated at a comm tower in the city of Carannia, where the mercenaries blocked all transmissions.
An Abyssin served as a guard at an outpost on the planet Serenno after it was invaded by Abyssin mercenaries who answered to Count Ramil.
A Weequay was affiliated with the individual known as the Grandfather of Vice during the Galactic Civil War.

An individual was the high-placed lieutenant within the Black Sun criminal organization. By 4 ABY, the colorful and outgoing Theelin-human hybrid female dancer Rystáll Sant had attracted the attention of the lieutenant, who tricked her into enslavement.
Avon Sunvale, also known as and remembered by her family as Avon Starros, was a human female who was the daughter of Galactic Republic senator Ghirra Starros and a member of the Starros Clan.
Dhum was a rancor owned by the Singing Mountain Clan. He was the brother of Ichor and fought in the Battle of Dathomir.

Jax Seldam was a nomad Sevari and Rebel Alliance contact on the planet Sevarcos II. Seldam assisted an Alliance Special Operations team with rescuing Carter Escalon from an Imperial spice-mining prison.
Carter Escalon was an Alliance to Restore the Republic agent. While carrying intelligence data from Coruscant, Escalon was captured by Imperial forces.

Elish was a Force-sensitive girl from Malloran who lived during the Imperial Era, whose mother had been a palace guard. She eventually wound up in an orphanage on the planet Gaaten, which the Grand Inquisitor had been abducting Force-sensitive children from.

Gee'far was a Force-sensitive Kessurian girl who lived in an orphanage on the planet Gaaten during the Imperial Era. She befriended fellow Force-sensitive orphan Elish. Gee'far had shared stories of the Clone Wars with Elish.
Samil was a Force-sensitive boy who lived in an orphanage on the planet Gaaten. At some point after the Clone Wars he was kidnapped by the Grand Inquisitor.
A Force-sensitive woman from Malloran was the mother of a young girl named Elish. She held the position of a palace guard.

The Hieroprince was an individual who was part of the doctrine of the Opaline Creed, a religious faction which was based on the Outer Rim planet Crucival in the time of the Galactic Empire. The Hieroprince was said to have had at least two sons, the second of whom was named Umu.

Ba'kif, previously known as Stybla'ba'kif and his core name Labaki during his time as a member of the Stybla family, was a Chiss male who served as the Supreme General of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet and was a member of the Defense Hierarchy Council of the Chiss Ascend…

Nallok was a Twi'lek female was captured on her homeworld of Ryloth and forced to become a slave dancer on a Hutt yacht. Planning her escape from servitude, Nallok learned how to pick locks, compromise security systems, and move stealthily.

Bennbus Polag was an Arcona entrepreneur and criminal. Starting off by picking pockets and scamming others off their wealth, Polag moved onto to running guns, fencing items, and even operating a salt mine.

Vosa was a Pantoran male Padawan of the Jedi Order. He once attempted to meditate in the Forest of Tranquility on the remote forest moon of Treen, where he was saved from a spikeworm attack by an ape native to the moon.
Kaccen was a slicer and a friend of Vee Naaq. Kaccen forged invitations for some individuals hired by Naaq to attend a gala thrown by Rae Vixe.

Boe Vixe was a shockball athlete, the son of Rae Vixe, and the brother of Cera Vixe. After learning that Vee Naaq hired a group of individuals to help his sister escape her family, Vixe offered them more to walk away from the deal.

Cera Vixe was the daughter of Rae Vixe, and the sister of Boe Vixe. She was in love with Vee Naaq, but her father had banned her from seeing her love. In response, Naaq hired a group of individuals to "rescue" Vixe from her father.
Rae Vixe was a corporate mogul, and the father of Cera and Boe Vixe. He threw a lavish gala at his Vixe Estate to celebrate the Harvest Season.
Aloren Breesa was a Human businesswoman and leader of a partisan group supporting the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the Mid Rim.
Vundar, along with Grugosh, guarded a secret entrance at the back of The Maze, a cantina in a Mid Rim spaceport. The entrance led to a secret Alliance base.

Xantus was a general who commanded the stormtroopers stationed on the planet Ord Radama. A lifelong military man, Xantus took orders from the Imperial Intelligence Service, though the planet's governor Ellor Orgraal believed that he controlled Xantus and the military force on …
Gerro was a friendly Human woman who owned the Scarlet Sword, a cantina on the planet Ord Radama.
Narralla was a Devlikk female who led a resistance movement on the planet Ord Radama against the Galactic Empire. Narralla's hatred toward the Empire began when it killed her parents.

A male warrior of Clan Vizsla of House Vizsla pledged his Mandalorian clan to Lady Bo-Katan Kryze and the Mandalorian resistance against the Galactic Empire along with several other Mandalorian factions during the Mandalorian Civil War after she obtained the Darksaber.

A human Mandalorian member of Clan Kryze pledged their Mandalorian clan to Lady Bo-Katan Kryze and the Mandalorian resistance against the Galactic Empire, along with several other Mandalorian factions following the Mission to Mandalore during the Mandalorian Civil War.

A Mandalorian of the Mandalorian Clan Eldar pledged his clan to Lady Bo-Katan Kryze and the Mandalorian resistance against the Galactic Empire along with several other Mandalorian factions following the Mission to Mandalore during the Mandalorian Civil War.
A human male technician worked on Cloud City, a tibanna gas mining colony on the planet Bespin, having worked on the city for ten years.
A male individual was the grandfather of Acting Governor Fara Yadeez. At some point, he told stories to Yadeez of the Clone Wars and how planets were driven to atrocities by starvation and fury.

A pilot of the Galactic Empire was a member of an elite squadron that flew TIE Advanced x1 starfighters. This pilot attempted to defect from the Empire, leading the rest of their former squadron to pursue under orders to destroy them.
Setenna Hase was a Senior Advisor who helped to found the Ardan resistance. In 0 ABY, Hase was kidnapped by the traitorous Lieutenant Var Narek.
Mezlo was a human strategist from the planet Oru. After Oru was taken over by the First Order, Mezlo led a resistance group of Oruan warriors in an attempt to force the First Order off their world.

A Tarinna, a member of a species that fed on memories, came to reside on the planet Nelgenam. The Tarinna encountered the cartographer Emil Graf in the Lost Library of Nelgenam, and intended to feed on his memories and the tales he had heard.
Vorrel was a general who led the Imperial forces at the Battle of the Gauntlet, an Imperial assault on a Rebel base on the planet Arda I.
Durl and Dekk was a Troig male who was in charge of the vault at the Golden Rocket Bank on Rook Minor. Dekk disliked Durl, who had the only voice that could unlock the vault.

A Gozzo was the boss of the Troig Durl and Dekk at the Golden Rocket Bank on Rook Minor. On one occasion, the Gozzo requested that Durl and Dekk open the vault to retrieve items, but Durl, whose voice unlocked the vault, had his mouth stuck shut with goo-goo-gum given to him b…

A humanoid served as a staff member at Shosho Outpost, a revered cantina located within the treacherous Shosho Belt asteroid field. The humanoid possessed a pair of wings that provided the ability of flight.
A bounty hunter was a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild in the years following the Galactic Civil War and during the early days of the New Republic.
A rebel was a human female who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, she was stationed at Echo Base, the Alliance's base on the planet Hoth.
A male individual was the nephew of the New Republic pilot Vitale who lived on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
Rokey also known as Rokey the Hutt was a member of the Hutt Species, it was said Rokey had treasure buried in the Dune Sea but it was just a prank.

A human male Jedi youngling came to be trained by the Jedi Order sometime before the end of the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, he was present at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant when the newly appointed Sith Lord Darth Vader led an attack against the Jedi.

A human male served as a deck officer for the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Echo Base on the planet Hoth. Shortly before the Battle of Hoth, he was questioned by Captain Han Solo as to the whereabouts of Commander Luke Skywalker.
Tacker, designated TH-313, was a clone trooper who served as a commander under Suljo Warde during the Clone Wars. After the formation of the Galactic Empire, he became a clone stormtrooper.
Pathran Helshar was a male from the city of Quolas. He was the youngest son of Koh Helshar, and founded a resistance movement against Gel Marcolf.
Onrein Hasar was an ambitious Neimoidian who felt an intense hatred for Suljo Warde, the Jedi Knight who took Cato Neimoidia during the Clone Wars. She founded the Whitescar Syndicate
Kirril Jiarlo was a male Sathari merchant who served as the elder of the Jiarlo family.

An alien served as a bouncer at a criminal establishment on the planet Son-tuul. Similar in appearance to an Iktotchi, the bouncer possessed two faces on his head, joined with a singular eye in the middle.

Tuggtar, nicknamed the "TIE Killer," was an Ewok saboteur who resisted the Galactic Empire. At some point, Tuggtar single-handedly sabotaged an entire Imperial landing platform and removed crucial parts from Imperial fighters attempting to escape the Forest Moon of Endor.

LT-514, born Obon Yandro, was a human who, with the assistance of his AJ^6 cyborg construct, served as an Imperial controller within the Imperial Navy starfighter squadron Titan Squadron after the Battle of Endor. LT-514's quiet intelligence career was upturned after Endor.
Ardo Barodai was a Mon Calamari officer in the New Republic's Fleet Intelligence who oversaw operations of Vanguard Squadron.
Salial Devrays was a Human female who served as a Lieutenant in the Imperial Army. She was stationed on Arbooine.

Zerelda Sage was a human who served as the chief mechanic aboard the New Republic flagship Temperance. She developed a lifelong mistrust of droids during her childhood, when her home planet was occupied by the Separatists amid the Clone Wars.
Hinv Opan was a Neimoidian male who lived on the planet Cato Neimoidia. He ran Torna's Cafe, a restaurant located in the city of Jorra.

Bein Krelwic was a male being who lived in the city of Jorra. He was the father of Tohn Krelwic and was employed as a factory worker. Krelwic did not approve of his son joining the Crimson Kreehawks, but believed that he was still a good person at heart.
Tohn Krelwic was a Neimoidian male who lived in the city of Jorra. He eventually joined the Crimson Kreehawks gang.
Gren Olpan was a male being who lived on Cato Neimoidia during the time of the Clone Wars. He was the son of Sanna Olpan.

Tieka Dalken was a Neimoidian female who lived on Cato Neimoidia during the Clone Wars. Unlike most of the planet's residents, Dalken had a high opinion of the Jedi Suljo Warde, for he saved Dalken's and her family's lives during the Galactic Republic's attack on Cato Neimoidia.
Lor Keln was a Neimoidian who led the Crimson Kreehawks gang in the city of Jorra. Keln was easily recognizable by her missing eye.

Tor Haido was a resident of Cato Neimoidia. During the Clone Wars, Tor Haido assisted the Grand Army of the Republic in its occupation of the planet by acting as a spy. Through this work, he came to know the Jedi Suljo Warde well.

Chareg Yim was a human male Jedi of the Jedi Order. On one occasion, Yim responded to a distress signal from a crew of Ugnaught lightning miners on the planet Tish, who were being attacked by creatures native to the planet.

Sskeer was a Trandoshan male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Gruff and opinionated, Sskeer trained the human Keeve Trennis as his Padawan and served on the Galactic Republic installation of Starlight Beacon in the Outer Rim Territories.
Marlowe San Tekka was a human male who was the scion of the San Tekka clan, a family that helped chart new paths through hyperspace for the Galactic Republic and achieved great wealth from doing so.

Vellis San Tekka was a human male who was one of the heads of the San Tekka clan, a family that helped chart new paths through hyperspace for the Galactic Republic and achieved great wealth from doing so.

Zel N'got was a male being who lived on Cato Neimoidia during the Clone Wars, during which he served as a spy for the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Galactic Civil War, he lived in the Residential District of the city of Jorra.
Nex Pavros was a bounty hunter who led a group of hunters that were hired by Erron Irbian to attack the freighter Silver Star and kill its crew.
Ghirra Starros was a female Galactic Republic senator during the High Republic Era. She was the mother of the scientist and aspiring inventor Avon Sunvale.
A four-armed bartender worked in the Eladro City bazaar sometime before 4 ABY. According to Nien Nunb, they "made a mean Novanian grog."
Lushros Dofine was a Neimoidian male who served as the captain of the Providence-class Dreadnought Invisible Hand during the Battle of Coruscant.
A pilot businessed with Karr Nuq Sin. He sold his goggles and warned him not to look straight at Tatooine's twin suns during a double solar eclipse.

This Tusken Raider was the chief of a little tribe which migrated to the other end of Tatooine because of the soil erosion. When they out of stock the elder warriors persuaded him, to go back and bring them food and other goods.
Mitth'ykl'omi, core name Thyklo, was a female Chiss Speaker who represented the Mitth family in the Chiss Syndicure.
A Speaker represented the Ufsa family in the Chiss Syndicure. When the Chiss homeworld of Csilla was attacked, the Speaker demanded that Supreme General Ba'kif learn who carried out the attack.
A Chiss speaker represented the Chiss Ascendancy's Obbic family in the Chiss Syndicure, the ruling body of the Ascendancy.
A Chiss speaker represented the Chiss Ascendancy's Clarr family in the Chiss Syndicure, the ruling body of the Ascendancy, in 19 BBY.
A Chiss aide served Supreme General Ba'kif of the Chiss Ascendancy's Expansionary Defense Fleet, in 19 BBY.
A stealth clone pilot served as the co-pilot of the IPV-2C Stealth Corvette used at the Battle of Christophsis during the Clone Wars.

During the Clone Wars, a Jedi Knight served as the master to Leh'ahnyo Vas. The master wore brown robes and wielded twin blue lightsabers. The master lead a unit of the Grand Army of the Republic alongside their Padawan Leh'ahnyo Vas.
Task was an Imperial captain who commanded the Imperial Customs corvette Gatekeeper. He was killed during the Mission to Quellor, a battle that also caused the destruction of the Gatekeeper.

A clone trooper was part of a unit led by Jedi General Chiata and her Padawan Marseph. He was assigned to Venator-class Star Destroyer. After exiting hyperspace, the ship crashed on Zeffo. The clone trooper died in the crash.
Slick was a gambler who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Alongside Dirk Harkness, Trent Jaspar, and Princess Allegra Amar, he served at Edan Base on Edan II.

A female individual was the great-grandmother of Alphabet Squadron pilot Yrica Quell. Quell's father owned a painted plate, which he had hung by the kitchenette light controls, that he said was his grandmother's.

Kordus Vrak was a Shistavanen male explorer. Despite the appearance of his species, Vrak was often gentle and calm. Vrak was one of several crew members hired by Fionn Tucat and Romina Foss for an expedition to the abandoned moon of Lupal.
Cavrolo Sys was a Togruta male hired by the explorers Fionn Tucat and Romina Foss for an expedition to the long-abandoned moon Lupal.

Fionn Tucat was a human female explorer. Along with her associate, Romina Foss, and a hired crew, Tucat led an expedition to the abandoned moon of Lupal, despite the perilous results of all previous explorers who visited the moon.
Borzul was a one-eyed Lasat male in the crew of the explorer Fionn Tucat, hired for a mission on the moon of Lupal.
Romina Foss was a female individual who was the associate of the explorer Fionn Tucat. The two hired a crew in order to mount an expedition to Lupal, a long-abandoned moon.

Viv was a Sullustan technician assigned to the Rendezvous Point 4 base on Edan II. He supervised the modifications to the light freighter Vindicator into a torpedo bomber for use against the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Havoc.

Kira Vantala, according to legend, was a dark-skinned female Jedi who wielded a bright blue lightsaber. During the Imperial Era, she travelled to an orphanage on the planet Gaaten after hearing of Force-sensitive children being taken by a phantom.
Tara Rashin was a Quarren female pirate who led a cell of the Guavian Death Gang. She had a sinister reputation for spreading fear and intimidation by means of terrorizing ships and hijacking cargo.

Seezelslak was an Azumel male bartender who ran Seezelslak's Cantina on the planet Batuu. While he did not have many customers, Seezelslak had a penchant for storytelling, including a favorite involving the local Jedi temple, Yoda and a Padawan named Ady Sun'Zee.
A droid repair technician was active during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Zeldin was a Dathomirian female Nightsister. According to legend, Zeldin was chosen to use Nightsister magick to infiltrate the mind of the Sith Lord Darth Caldoth, who had stolen a pod containing a dead Nightsister from Dathomir.

Bran Ath'Morath was a legendary Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order. At some point between around 5000 BBY and years before 1032 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Caldoth attacked the Jedi temple on the moon Bathoris, killing many Jedi.
Otis lived in Southview Village on the planet Edan II. He ran a local business, Otis' Livery, from which he sold and repaired farming equipment for the local villagers.

Scruts was a mercenary who controlled a band of outlaws on the planet Edan II. Usually contracted by Edan II's planetary government as mercenaries and scouts, Scruts and his fellows turned to harassing Imperial forces when they arrived on Edan II during the Galactic Civil War.
A male Sullustan was Akkere's brother, living on Telos IV in 3951 BBY. His second wife fell ill and was pregnant but he couldn't afford the Telos doctors. He asked Akkere to bring him some credits.

A human male impostor of the Rebel Alliance operative Luke Skywalker lived in the galaxy during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, he boasted in a cantina about his alleged exploits of destroying the Death Star, hoping he could fool bar patrons and be hired as a pilot.

Terlyn's husband was a Human male, who was a member of the Council of Lords in Iziz on Onderon. He was a strong supporter of Queen Talia and the Republic. Over time he became convinced that General Vaklu was trying to kill the Queen.
Terlyn's son was a one of Terlyn's children in Iziz on Onderon. After his father was killed by General Vaklu, they desperately sought a starport visa to leave the planet.
Terlyn's daughter was a one of Terlyn's children in Iziz on Onderon. After her father was killed by General Vaklu, they desperately sought a starport visa to leave the planet.
Jarus Kai was an Imperial undercover agent deployed to Edan II. He infiltrated a group of outlaws led by Scruts in an effort to get closer to members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Strati was an individual who, while attempting to sneak to a position, managed to leave a clear trail behind him as well as accidentally activating his glowrod.
The father of Gerro was a male being who owned the Scarlet Sword cantina before passing it on to his daughter.
The father of the Bothan rebel Masi Qual was a male being. Prior to the rise of the Galactic Empire, he worked for the Bothan senatorial delegation on Coruscant.
Balta was a male Imperial lieutenant who worked under General Xantus on Ord Radama.
Treaska was an Imperial lieutenant who served under General Xantus on Ord Radama as an AT-ST pilot.
Davim Ak was a male individual who ran the Civilian Defense Force in the settlement on the moon Yavin 4, holding the title of lieutenant.
Guz Austin was a male officer of the Yavin 4 Civilian Defense Force.

Robhar Dern was a male officer of the Civilian Defense Force on the moon Yavin 4 who had once worked with former Rebel Alliance pilot Shara Bey. Accompanied by Guz Austin, Dern visited the home of Bey's husband Kes Dameron after his son, Poe, crashed his mother's A-wing.
Fontis was a Devaronian male bartender that ran Gully's, a cantina in the settlement on the moon Yavin 4.

Elia Litte was a female officer of the Yavin 4 Civilian Defense Force. After Poe Dameron was brought into the Yavin 4 Defense Force station, Litte let him out due to his connection to his father, Kes Dameron.
Chant Osman was a female officer who was a reservist in the Yavin 4 Civilian Defense Force.

Sela Trune was a human female officer of the New Republic Security Bureau. Trune had a vendetta against the criminal gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi after they were responsible for deaths of her family.

Zeva Bliss was a human female criminal who led the gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi after taking control of the group from Zarah Bliss. Unlike Zarah, Zeva was able to unite the Spice Runners into a truly united force. Zeva was also the mother of Zorii Bliss.
Gaithel was the younger brother of the New Republic Security Bureau officer Sela Trune, residing on Yungbrii.

Ledesmar was a Zabrak female mercenary. Formerly a slave of the Pyke Syndicate, Ledesmar escaped with a Moraysian cruiser and its crew of droids, also managing to acquire the helmet of Zeva Bliss, the leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi.

Tomasso was a human male individual who was a high-ranking member of the criminal gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi. However, he was eventually accused of becoming an informant passing information on to the New Republic, and was killed by the gang's leader, Zeva Bliss.

An individual was the high commander of the Zualjinn Syndicate criminal organization. Tomasso, a member of the rival Spice Runners of Kijimi, was sent under the guise of a diplomatic mission to the planet Quintil, where he instead killed the high commander.

A humanoid male individual served as a leader in the Zualjinn Syndicate. On the planet Quintil, the leader and a group of Zualjinn soldiers attempted to find Tomasso, a member of the rival Spice Runners of Kijimi who had killed the syndicate's high commander.

Zatticha was a Kyuzo female criminal who was an associate of Tomasso, a member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. After Tomasso and several other Spice Runners were captured by the Zualjinn Syndicate on Quintil, he sent out a distress signal.
Alfris Sotin was a Fiumarian male smuggler and slaver. Sotin offered a deal to the Spice Runners of Kijimi on Ankot Station, but instead betrayed them to the Guavian Death Gang.

Smaatku was a Gordelian male warlord who resided on the planet Guat'a. He was a rare exception of his species, building a strong organization on Guat'a while being in league with the Osako pirates. He was killed by the Spice Runners of Kijimi during a heist.

Tarand Crowe was a male smuggler and pirate who was active during the time of the New Republic. He was one of the criminals gathered by Zeva Bliss, leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, under the guise of a summit on Kijimi, where Bliss intended to eliminate her criminal alli…

Caryn was a human female smuggler and fence who operated during the Galactic Civil War and the subsequent time of the New Republic. She was invited to the Kijimi summit by Zeva Bliss of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, who intended to kill her guests.

Adlerber was a skittish Arcona dealer who worked with the Kubaz Monigallgh. The two were invited by Zeva Bliss of the Spice Runners of Kijimi to a summit on Kijimi, where Bliss secretly intended to kill the criminals present.
Alugomes was an Iakaru spice dealer active during the time of the New Republic. The dealer was invited by Zeva Bliss of the Spice Runners of Kijimi to a summit on Kijimi.

Civian Bain was a Rodian criminal who operated during the era of the New Republic. Bain was one of numerous criminals invited to the Kijimi summit by Zeva Bliss of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, who intended to kill the guests present.

Gezlar was a Chagrian male guard who worked for the Spice Runners of Kijimi. Gezlar was present at the Kijimi summit, where lead Spice Runner Zeva Bliss gathered numerous criminals in order to execute them.

Sarb Iltage was an Abednedo criminal active during the time of the New Republic. Iltage was invited by Zeva Bliss of the Spice Runners of Kijimi to a summit on Kijimi, where the Abednedo spoke with the pirate Woan Barso.

Jarv was the bartender of the establishment known as Rugova's on the planet Guat'a. While attempting to infiltrate Rugova's to steal from the warlord Smaatku, Spice Runners of Kijimi Zorii Bliss and Poe Dameron distracted a guard by claiming that several Dressellians were atta…

Tolo Mandah was a individual who served as the head of New Republic Intelligence. She contacted New Republic Security Bureau officer Sela Trune to put an end to her vendetta against the Spice Runners of Kijimi.

Monigallgh was a Kubaz female criminal who was the partner of the Arcona dealer Adlerber. She and Adlerber were invited to the Kijimi summit by Zeva Bliss, leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, under the guise of forming alliances in the criminal underworld.

Pheeb was a Sullustan female operative of the New Republic Security Bureau. She was present in the central operations of a New Republic Security Bureau space station, where officer Sela Trune requested to see the prisoner Marinda Gan, a member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi.
Von Tante was a male thief who resided in Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi, and was a contact of the smuggler Tarand Crowe.
Vishar Koss was an Ovissian representative of the planet Krystar in the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Queb was an Ovissian male who served as the regent of the Galactic Republic-aligned planet Krystar. Queb was secretly working with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, holding numerous clone troopers prisoner and selling them to a Trandoshan hunter.
A Trandoshan hunter was active during the Clone Wars, purchasing clone troopers that had been held prisoner by Regent Queb of the planet Krystar.
Uralak was a near-Human male who owned the Meltdown Café on Nar Shaddaa.
Odrell Vorbaal was a Pau'an male who owned The Slag Pit, a gambling den located on Nar Shaddaa. He was also a spice dealer backed by the Black Sun. He primarily sold gliterstim.
Salix was a Bothan male who bartended The Slag Pit, a gambling den located on Nar Shaddaa. He ran the Pit's day-to-day operations while its owner, Odrell Vorbaal, sold spice.
Hopper was an Aqualish male bartended at the Orange Lady, a cantina located in the Corellian Sector of Nar Shaddaa.

Ufsa'mak'ro, better known by his core name Samakro, was a Chiss male who served as the first officer of Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo aboard the Chiss Ascendancy cruiser Springhawk. He held the rank of merit adoptive of the Ruling Ufsa family.

Che'ri was a Force-sensitive Chiss female who served as an ozyly-esehembo within the Chiss Ascendancy. Thalias was her caregiver, or "Momish" while she served on Mitth'raw'nuruodo's ship. She liked to draw on her questis and later with colored graph markers.

Mitth'urf'ianico, also known by his core name of Thurfian, was a Chiss male of the Mitth family who served, at various points in his life, as an Aristocra, Syndic, Syndic Prime, and Patriarch for that family.
Mitth'ali'astov, known by the core name of Thalias, raised as Al'iastov, was a Chiss female Caregiver and former Force-sensitive sky-walker.

However, the Chiss also learnt more and more about him, Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo "Thrawn" uncovered the attempt to cover up the attack on the Paccosh, and later uncovered the occupation of the Rapacc system by Yiv, and later met the general himself at the Vak Combine's…

Qilori was a Force-sensitive male individual associated with Uandualon who was a Pathfinder navigator. He used a sensory-deprivation headset to connect to the Great Presence in order to navigate through hyperspace.
Jayko was a human male smuggler. He traveled with the navigator droid Arch-E, and previously worked with the Gamorrean Tan. After retiring, Jayko published the book A Smuggler's Life.

Tan was a Gamorrean male who worked with the smuggler Jayko. After Jayko retired from being a smuggler, he wrote the book A Smuggler's Life. Jayko mentioned Tan in the book, leading the Gamorrean to become famous.
Narissa was a Twi'lek female who owned the Heartache Bistro, a cantina located on Nar Shaddaa.

Lorgatt was a Hutt member of the Desilijic Kajidic. He oversaw the mining operations on the Hutt homeworld of Varl. He reported directly to the Hutt Ruling Council, but also embezzled money from the operations that he oversaw.

Ulal was a Hutt who, unlike most members of his species, enjoyed spending time in space. Ulal commanded the Potala Um Var, which he used to patrol the space around Varl. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, Ulal had spent around 500 years patrolling the region.
A human served as one of the First Order's stormtroopers assigned to Kylo Ren's flagship the Steadfast.

Buccel Trune was a human male who fought alongside the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War and later became the father of the New Republic Security Bureau officer Sela Trune.

The mother of New Republic Security Bureau officer Sela Trune was a female individual who resided on the Trune family farm on Yungbrii. Trune was close with her mother, and found it difficult to leave to join the New Republic.

The father of Civilian Defense Force officer Elia Litte was a male individual. When releasing Poe Dameron, teenage resident of Yavin 4, from custody and back to his father after Dameron crashed his mother's A-wing starfighter, Litte told him to be thankful of his father's loya…

A human male soldier served in the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry during the Galactic Civil War. Around 5 ABY, while the company was deployed on the planet Troithe, he and half a dozen other soldiers talked with some pilots from the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron.

A Mon Calamari soldier served in the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry during the Galactic Civil War. During the 61st's deployment to the planet Troithe around 5 ABY, the soldier and half a dozen other infantry met with some New Republic pilots.

A male guard served the smuggler gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi. During the Kijimi summit, in which lead Spice Runner Zeva Bliss intended to execute numerous criminal allies and enemies, the guard was stationed at the Dai Bendu monastery.
A male guard worked for the Spice Runners of Kijimi, a smuggler gang that operated on the planet Kijimi.

A male individual served as a lead guard in the smuggler gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi. The guard was in charge of holding several criminals prisoner during the Kijimi summit, in which lead Spice Runner Zeva Bliss gathered numerous allies and enemies in order to ex…

A female medic worked on the planet Kijimi. After deserting the Spice Runners of Kijimi during the Kijimi summit, an injured Poe Dameron was directed to the residence of the thief Von Tante by the smuggler Tarand Crowe.

Maalva was the king of the planet Toydaria following the death of his uncle, Katuunko. Maalva was a harsh ruler who would pit his subjects against each other in the Toydarian seasonal wars for his own gain.
Mallsam O'ne was a smashballer who played with the Corellian Dreadnaughts and the owner of the Tallifax Inn.

A male individual was, according to legend, the owner and wearer of a mask, operating long prior to the year 29 ABY. The mask wearer sought immense power and influence, manipulating powerful individuals in order to do so.

Slokin was a male ambassador and collector of ancient treasures, possessing a vast repository within his estate. According to legend, Slokin purchased a mask from the Ithorian collector Dok-Ondar, and was granted visions of its original owner's exploits and manipulations.

A male king supposedly ruled long before the year 29 ABY. The king secretly made a pact with an enemy of his, not wishing for his subjects to know. A mask-wearing man became aware of this, and used his knowledge to blackmail the king into providing him with a title and land.
A male ambassador represented the planet Hadros. According to legend, the ambassador feared losing his position over information pertaining him that was not known to the public.

A female politician held the title of Madame Secretary long before the year 29 ABY. According to legend, the politician was poisoned by an influential mask wearer, who proceeded to take her role and power.

Gorson was a male government official who was the superior of the ambassador Slokin. According to legend, Slokin, having been granted visions of the exploits of a man by the mask he wore, followed the mask wearer's actions, poisoning Gorson.

A young male individual supposedly served as a footman to a mask wearer, an influential man who gained power and fortune through criminal exploits. While the young footman aided his master's crimes, he eventually grew jealous of the man's power, and killed him, stealing his mask.

Potniss was a male advisor to Ambassador Slokin. According to legend, Slokin exploited visions given by a mask he purchased to gain power and influence, with Potniss aiding his schemes. However, Potniss eventually grew tired of serving Slokin, and killed the ambassador.

Alger Denholm was a human male officer of the Galactic Empire who served aboard the Star Destroyer Exactor. Supposedly, Denholm was promoted after his superior, Lieutenant Marsden, was killed by Darth Vader, but began to see visions of Marsden.
Marsden was a male Imperial officer who held the rank of lieutenant aboard the Star Destroyer Exactor. According to legend, Marsden was killed by Darth Vader, who used the Force to choke the officer.

A male individual served as the captain of the Star Destroyer Exactor in the Galactic Empire. Supposedly, after both Lieutenant Marsden, and then his replacement, Alger Denholm, were killed by Darth Vader, the captain was responsible for promoting an Imperial officer to fill t…
Saul Toten was a male Imperial officer who served on the Star Destroyer Exactor. He was supposedly promoted to replace Lieutenant Alger Denholm, who was killed by Darth Vader.

Nil Idyth was a male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. According to legend, Idyth was thought to be a modest and upstanding Jedi, but only remained as such by burying his darker emotions within an amulet.
Sol Mogra was a human male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order. According to legend, he was the former Padawan of Jedi Master Nil Idyth, and acquired his master's amulet after his death.

Kjus Androth was a male Jedi of the Jedi Order. According to myth, Androth, along with Petano Dreth, was enlisted by Jedi Knight Sol Mogra for assistance in seeking out a mysterious figure rampaging throughout the Coruscant Underworld.

Petano Dreth was a male Jedi of the Jedi Order. Supposedly, Dreth and Kjus Androth were enlisted by fellow Jedi Sol Mogra, who required assistance in finding a mysterious individual causing terror in the Coruscant Underworld.
Great-Gammer Lissar was the matriarch of a Brentaalian family and the founder of its mercantile success. Darrik, who stowed away on Platt Okeefe's freighter, was a member of her family.
Neeta was a gambler who was present on Cloud City shortly after the Battle of Yavin.

Versella was a member of Lissar and Darrik's family on Brentaal IV. As one of the older cousins, she was responsible for ensuring that the young children made it to and from the Brentaal Commerce Academy on a daily basis.
Douglas Sunvale was a human male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era who served as the marshal of the Jedi outpost at Port Haileap.
Honesty Weft was a human male born around 244 BBY, the son of the Dalnan ambassador Weft. He was present aboard the starship Steady Wing, headed for the Starlight Beacon.
Weft was a human male who served as an ambassador for the Dalnans. He was married to a Corellian woman, with whom he had a son, Honesty Weft.

Eila was a female Twi'lek living in Mos Eisley. She was a con artist, involved in a plot with Kollan Xa and Ccalras Corporation to get Beeyon Nace to provide them with information from his post in the Mos Eisley Spaceport Control Tower.
Swang was the leader of a swoop gang that operated in Mos Eisley around the time of the Battle of Endor. He usually wore a red tunic and black pants.
Mossol, also known as Mossol the Menace, was a member of Swang's swoop gang. Mossol led the gang in the kidnapping of Diew Rejeff, and during the Rebellion on Tatooine.

Walt Brennorn was a moisture farmer on Tatooine following the Battle of Endor. Aligned with a crime lord who rose in the wake of Jabba the Hutt's death, Brennorn staged Tusken Raider attacks on neighboring moisture farm.
Domdees was a male Toydarian chef who worked in the Toydor Merchant District. He was once hired by the Toydarian king to cook his famous gabaki goulash.
Thamoss was a Trandoshan weapons dealer who worked on the moon of Nar Shaddaa.
Kef was a female Jawa smuggler who served on Corte Voss's crew.

Corte Voss was a Twi'lek female smuggler who captained the light freighter Titan's Mercy and its crew of five, including the Jawa Kef. During the Imperial Period, Voss made a poor deal with the Gorensla, which lost her a large sum of money.
Venik Rin was a Zabrak male who served a Hutt master as a boddah. Rin was once attacked by a rancor, which seriously mauled him, causing him to walk with a permanent limp.

Shalo Sherin was a male Human noble from the Core Worlds. He was forced out of his family for unknown reasons (though according to rumors, he attempted to have his older brother murdered). He soon turned to crime, which suited him, as he was completely uninterested in morality.
Camerlin was a bodyguard hired to protect Shalo Sherin. He had a close relationship with his fellow bodyguard, Savo.
Savo was a bodyguard hired to protect Shalo Sherin. She had a close relationship with her fellow bodyguard, Camerlin. In combat, she preferred to use a vibro-ax.
Therah Yunin was Shalo Sherin's Twi'lek concubine. She followed Sherin everywhere, and felt that she owned him a debt for "something" he had done for her in the past.

Fondo was a Rodian thug who worked for the Hutt Space-based Rodian assassin Torani Kulda alongside two other thugs. Fondo and the others were eventually brought by Kulda to participate in a potentially deadly competition known as a Granee Noopa.

Tyss was one of three Rodian thugs in the employ of the Hutt Space-based Rodian assassin Torani Kulda. Tyss and Kulda's other thugs were eventually brought by Kulda to participate in a potentially deadly competition known as a Granee Noopa.
Plaado was a Rodian thug who worked for Torani Kulda. Plaado had an extremely similar appearance to that of fellow thugs Tyss and Fondo.
Graayl Nor was a male Barabel bounty hunter. He led a group of three other hunters called the Red Pact.
Harke was a Sakiyan male who owned the Pearl, a space station located in Hutt Space.

Vortga the Hutt was a Hutt lord. In 684 BBY, he traveled to Pybus, a planet considered taboo by other Hutts, and established a hidden complex. Many years later, he began to grow paranoid, and attempted to kill all of his former servants who had known about the base.

Lalkan was a Klatooinian male who served Vortga the Hutt. However, as Vortga grew paranoid in his old age, he attempted to execute all of his servants that knew about his hidden complex. Lalkan was among those targeted, but he managed to escape.
Jacek was a male Human resident of Hutt Space. He owned the Erla Tomvaas, and received information about Vortga's hidden complex from Lalkan.

Nym was a Feeorin male pirate who led the pirate band known as the Lok Revenants. Near the end of the time of the Galactic Republic, Nym and his band of pirates operated on the Rimward end of the Corellian Run and along the Llanic Spice Run hyperspace routes.

A Trandoshan male hunter operated during the Clone Wars. During that time, the Trandoshan hunter kidnapped the young Force-sensitive Wookiee Yiprukk from his family in the city of Rwookrrorro on the planet Kashyyyk.
Iak Wal was a Mandalorian male who served as the landing pad director in the city of Ronion on the planet Mandalore.

Aloen Dresk was a Force-sensitive male individual who was in some way affiliated with the salvage operations for The Oteroan Sky. When a salvage expert retrieved a shard of the Nardithi Cluster, Dresk felt a connection with it through the Force and stole it.
Yeel Dresk was a male descendant of Aloen Dresk who eventually inherited Aloen's fragment of the Nardithi Cluster and hired Quek Rai to add it to the statue Tragic Hope.
Quek Rai was a famous Corellian sculptor who lived in the city of Tyrena. Adept with the Force, she used its visions to shape her sculptures.

Walisi was a Toydarian merchant who bought and sold rare objects, such as the statue Tragic Hope, and operated Walisi's Elegant and Exotic Artifacts. Soon after announcing that he planned to sell the statue, however, Walisi disappeared.
Vorlip was a Chiss female who held the rank of Junior Captain in the Chiss Defense Force and commanded the Tomra.

Mafole was a Chiss female who served as the fourth caregiver of the sky-walker Al'iastov, a young girl who navigated the space outside of the Chiss Ascendancy government's borders using the ability of Third Sight.
Wrecker was a Toydarian mercenary who was hired to kidnap Walisi and steal the statue Tragic Hope. A stubborn haggler, Wrecker was the leader of a band of mercenaries.
"Boss" Trelon was the leader of Jerserra's agents based on Toydaria.

Irrica the Hutt was a Hutt member of the Gorensla kajidic. She led the clan's operations in the Toydarian city of Riar, and was very concerned when Walisi, a Toydarian merchant affiliated with the kajidic, disappeared.
Freff was a Dathomirian Zabrak and a member of the Nightbrothers of Dathomir. He and the other members of his tribe served the Nardithi Nightsister Jerserra.
Prior to the rise of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, a captain served in the Trade Federation aboard an exploratory starship.
Krynthia was a human female and the daughter of the Grand Leader of the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate.
Cadeliah was a human female born to two heirs of rival crime syndicates—Krynthia of the Unbroken Clan and Khamus of the Mourner's Wail Syndicate.

Kin Dragen was a non-binary member of the group known as the Dragens. By 3 ABY, they had a conversation with the House of Tagge scion Ronen Tagge during which, according to Ronen, they said something "terribly rude" about his aunt—Lady Domina Tagge.

Song was a Duros mercenary served in the mercenary unit of Ronen Tagge, scion of the House of Tagge. The Duros and several other mercenaries were sent by Tagge to pursue Doctor Eustacia Okka, who Tagge wished to use to find the legendary Rings of Vaale.

Tucker was a Mon Calamari who served as a mercenary in a unit that worked for House of Tagge scion Ronen Tagge. Tucker, alongside several other mercenaries, was dispatched to find Doctor Eustacia Okka as part of Tagge's search for the artifacts known as the Rings of Vaale.
Nal Henol was a female Toydarian that served as the administrator of Bog Bay, a collection of landing pads located in the Toydarian city of Riar and run by the Gorensla kajidic.

Pravon was a Weequay who led a team of enforcers loyal to the Gorensla kajidic. He had extensive cybernetic implants, which included a cybernetic voice box that allowed him to greatly increase the volume of his voice.
A Human female hailed from the Core Worlds planet Karvoss II and lived at some point between 3996 BBY and 1000 BBY.
Twitch was a clone trooper who served with the Galactic Republic's 501st Legion during the Clone Wars.

Slim was a clone trooper of the Galactic Republic. Early during the Clone Wars, Slim was on the planet Kamino, and got into a fight with the trooper Heater, who had previously deserted from the Grand Army of the Republic.
Wilko Brenggar was a pirate and member of the Happy Blasters. Completely insane, he was recruited into the Happy Blasters after he was found randomly shooting Imperial personnel in a spaceport.
Mac was a technician and member of the Happy Blasters. He did not reveal where he was from, only stating it was about three hours from Coruscant.
Dapp Solus was a cyborg pirate and member of the Happy Blasters. A native of Nar Shaddaa, he stole a ship once he was old enough and started a career as a pirate in the Outer Rim Territories.
Kavakoderakanbnuarria was a Kriek and leader of the Kherkhaman, a tribe that claimed the entire northern continent of Dekok on the planet Kriekaal.
Malketh was a Kriek and kulai advisor to the leader of the Kherkhaman, Kavakoderakanbnuarria. Naturally Force-sensitive, Malketh was believed to be this living voice of the god Br'lai.
Ssiskor was a kulai shaman of the Kriek. According to legend, Ssiskor provoked the goddess Br'lai, who rose up and destroyed an alien force that had tried to claim Kriekaal as their own.
A male individual was the father of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. He was the son of Mama and Papa.

Skutu, nicknamed "Scourge," was a human TIE fighter pilot who served within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Skutu flew a TIE fighter during combat alongside other TIE fighters near a group of Gozanti-class cruisers.

"Youngster" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot who served within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Youngster flew a TIE fighter during combat alongside other TIE fighters near planet Coruscant.

"Wampa" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot who served within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Black Squadron, the pilot flew a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter under the callsign Black Eleven during the Battle of Yavin.

"Chaser" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot who served within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Chaser flew a TIE fighter during combat in the Battle of Yavin, where they were fired upon by a T-65B X-wing starfighter.

Chiraneau was a human who served in the Navy of the Galactic Empire and worked as a Rear Admiral and an advisor to Fleet Admiral Firmus Piett. The Rear Admiral was a part of both the Navy's officer corps and starfighter corps, piloting a VT-49 Decimator.

Zertik Strom was a human individual who served as a TIE fighter pilot within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Strom flew a TIE Advanced x1 and at one point landed in a hangar. Strom also served as an administrator who was considered pitiless.

Maarek Stele was a human individual who served as a TIE fighter pilot within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Stele flew a TIE Advanced x1 and at one point was in a docking procedure from a hangar bay.

Gorgol was an individual who served as a pilot and engineer within the Confederacy of Independent Systems. At one point during the Clone Wars, Gorgol flew a Nantex-class starfighter while on Geonosis but was shot down.

Berwer Kret was an individual who served as a pilot and Hive Guard captain within the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Stalgasin Hive Guard. At one point during the Clone Wars, Kret flew a Nantex-class starfighter in space alongside two vulture droid starfighters.

Chertek was an opportunistic Geonosian who served as an ace pilot within the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic, which lasted from 22 BBY to 19 BBY.

Ralchio Nervi, born Ralchio Sargan, was a human male who served in the navy of the Galactic Empire. The son of Vilola Sargan and Cacique Jans Coorsa of a clan of Confederacy of Independent Systems sympathizers on Gall, Nervi was Force-sensitive.

"Nath Alico" was the alias used by a human female spy of the Rebel Alliance's Intelligence division while undercover as a lieutenant in the task force commanded by Captain Ralchio Nervi of the Galactic Empire.
Ravik was a male individual who served the Galactic Empire as a Grand Moff and controlled the Tolonda Oversector.

Darrus Jeht, a member of the Jedi Order, was a Jedi General during the Clone Wars. At the Battle of Kromus and the Battle of Cularin, events occurring at some point between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, Jeht was the commanding officer of the Galactic Republic's Maelstrom-class battle cru…
Trask was a female Lannik who served as a sergeant in the military forces of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
