TK-147 was the designation of a stormtrooper who served in a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by Moff Gideon, operating at a base on the volcanic planet Nevarro.
5387 was the designation of a stormtrooper who served as part of a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by Moff Gideon, being stationed at a base on the volcanic planet Nevarro.
5389 was the designation of a stormtrooper who served with a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by Moff Gideon, stationed at a base on the volcanic planet Nevarro.
A Mimbanese worker served as a mechanic for the Magistrate Greef Karga while also being a spy for Moff Gideon's remnant of the Galactic Empire.
A male human student attended a school on the planet Nevarro, where his cookies was once stolen by the Mandalorian foundling Grogu.
Gann was a queen of Corellia centuries before the Galactic Civil War. They were mentioned in a Corellian traders' song that was the favorite drinking song of Jothal Gablerone.

Cervil the Uncanny was a Jedi who fought in the Sith Wars. She left behind testimonies about the use of lightwhips—a lightsaber variant with a flexible blade—to defend against Sith Lords using the Forbidden Forms.
Gaff Kilvaari was the leader of an element of the Sullustan Resistance that planned to attack the SoroSuub Corporation. He generally looked down upon the Rebel Alliance.

Beladi Vosi was a female Twi'lek Smuggler who was active during the Galactic Civil War. She accrued a lot of debt since childhood, and learned to be ruthless. She preferred to depart with her stolen goods rather than engage in violence, and was excessively charming.
Noham the Hutt was a male Hutt who during the Galactic Civil War was on the run from his kajidic after bad debts. He held court in Squan Station, backing ventures in exchange for a cut.

Elia Kane, designated TK-2755 under the Galactic Empire and as Amnesty Officer G68 under the New Republic, was a human who served as an Imperial officer for the Galactic Empire, a comms officer in the Imperial Remnant under Moff Gideon, and later a spy.

Heta Kol, a Human female Mandalorian also referred to as Field Marshal Kol, was the leader of a group of disenfranchised Mandalorians known as the Hidden Chain who opposed Mandalore the Avenger during the third Galactic War.

In 9 ABY, a lava meerkat was saved from being beheaded and eaten by a gang of Aqualish by Marshal Carasynthia Dune in the former Mandalorian covert on Nevarro. The creature showed affection to Dune, who gave it something to eat and assured it of its safety.
Shel Prav, also known by her alias Cernsa Ku, was an agent who served in the Imperial Security Bureau.

Fenn Sesslyn was the Security Chief of the SoroSuub Corporation corporate security force in G'rinn Go city. A native of Corellia, Sesslyn was known for being direct with her employees and not showing leniency toward lawbreakers.
Allat Za was the Chieftain of the Quarren species when the residents of the Quarren homeworld of Dac first encountered the Galactic Republic over 120 years after 4500 BBY.

Murell was a member of the Rebel Alliance who worked as a tauntaun handler at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth. Due to the limited number of handlers, Murell's rotation prevented the handler from having time to both visit the mess hall and get enough sleep.

A king ruled the Mon Calamari at the time Dac first made contact with the Republic. Though the king hoped to join the Republic, the leader of the Quarren, Allat Za, did not, forcing the king to make Dac an independent ally of the Republic.

Baesoon was a member of the Rebel Alliance who worked as a tauntaun handler at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth. Due to a shortage of handlers, Baesoon's rotation kept the handler from having time to both get enough sleep and attend the mess hall.
Howlrunner was a human TIE fighter pilot of the Galactic Empire. She served in Theta Squadron, where she flew as Theta Seven.

A Rutian Twi'lek female worked as an agent of the Bounty Hunters' Guild on Carajam during the Galactic Civil War, providing information to Guild bounty hunters regarding their bounties and processing monetary transactions between clients and hunters.
An Ithorian businessman founded the Far Orbit Resort and Lodge on Athiss. He was later bought out by his Rodian partner.
The Rodian business partner of the Ithorian businessman who founded the Far Orbit Resort and Lodge on Athiss bought out the resort around the time of the Clone Wars.
A Twi'lek female was the niece of Gruyver and a member of the Children of the Empty Sun cult. She enjoyed fixing things and speedbiking.

A Hive Mother ruled the Roche system during the Imperial Period. During the Blockade of the Roche system, the Hive Mother was taken prisoner by the Galactic Empire and forced to remain in her quarters under guard so that the Empire could control the system.
A man was the father of Gaiana. He was noted to have been sick for at least a year. One time Roan Novachez's mother asked how Gaiana's father was doing and Roan said he was doing a lot better.
This female was the daughter of Gruyver. He eventually left her and her mother.
A female was the mother of Gruyver's daughter. Gruyver left them and his daughter years before.

This male was the father of Palal Seedia and her twin sister. Seedia once promised her father that she would take care of the family estate, but she broke the promise by leaving the estate in the care of her sister.
The twin sister of Palal Seedia was a human female. Palal once promised her father that she would take care of the family estate, but she broke her promise and left the estate to her sister.
"Flameskull" was the nickname of a TIE pilot who flew as part of Theta Squadron under the callsign Theta Eighteen.
Seb Astro was a human male Bespin Wing Guard in Cloud City working under Lando Calrissian as his top guard.
Bleshk Callor was a male Deaon agent who led the Rebel Alliance's operations on the planet Ord Gimmel.
A human male scientist worked with a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by Moff Gideon, operating at a laboratory in the planet Nevarro's Imperial base.

The man was the father of Pasha. He worked at the Obroan Institute for Archaeology studying Jedi artifacts. When Roan Novachez came to visit, Pasha's father showed them some of his Jedi artifacts in his office.
A captain commanded the New Republic's battleship Temperance around 5 ABY.
A Weequay was enslaved by a Hutt. Before his execution, he sang a ballad of his life.
Father Kashevon was a priest who created the Day of Atonement. Chass na Chadic was heard about him when she was young.

Rainn Poras was a member of the Rebel Alliance who was stationed at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth. He told the kitchen worker Chase Wilsorr to be quiet when Wilsorr kept Poras awake one morning.

Kilmera Skale was a female Force-sensitive criminal active during the Imperial Era. Working with Imperial Security Bureau Special Agent Malor Phiatt, Skale posed as a Jedi Knight to entrap Jedi who had survived Order 66.

Kharrek was a male bounty hunter who operated during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, after Lady Domina Tagge, head of Tagge Corporation, placed a bounty on the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra, Kharrek partnered with the assassin Just Lucky in order to apprehend her.
Beol De'Rruyet was a human male who was the founder of De'Rruyet Industries, operating from the planet Midarr.
Cheyl was a Selonian naturalist residing on the planet Rishi around 3626 BBY. Cheyl attempted to defend Rishi's ecosystem by protecting the few remaining orobirds from food tourists.

Drake was a human pilot who flew for the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy. Around 2 ABY, during the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Avenger attack on a deep space installation fellow pilot Amara Kel heard someone screaming over the comm.
A human male served as a coastal defender stormtrooper squad leader in the Scarif Deployment of the Galactic Empire during the Battle of Scarif.

A soldier served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Invasion of Ossus in around 3629 BBY. A Human male, the Imperial soldier attended to Darth Malgus during the Sith onslaught on the Galactic Republic's Jedi world of Ossus.

Lapin Tagge was a non-binary human who was part of the powerful family the House of Tagge. They were the cousin, secretary, and aide to Lady Domina Tagge, head of the family's Tagge Corporation. They reported to Tagge aboard her flagship, Acquisitor.

Jepha was a human bounty hunter active during the Imperial Era. After Domina Tagge of the House of Tagge placed a bounty on the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra, Jepha was one of several hunters who attempted to capture her on Arveesh Station, alongside Uleen'Arael.

Lang was a human male mercenary who worked for Morgan Elsbeth, serving as the Magistrate's Captain of the Guard in the city of Calodan on the planet of Corvus. He had a long history of loyalty bought by credits.

Morgan Elsbeth was a Force-sensitive human female Nightsister, starship designer, and industrialist who was instrumental in the construction of the Imperial Navy during the reign of the Galactic Empire and a dedicated follower of Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Wing was a human male who lived in the city of Calodan on the planet of Corvus. The city came to be ruled by the ruthless Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth who attempted to give the population employment with the Galactic Empire.

Rav Naaran was a Force-sensitive human male who used the dark side of the Force. Naaran was imprisoned since the Clone Wars. His dark side influence spread throughout the Mount Tellec plateau. He possessed a red-bladed lightsaber.
Sendak was a communications officer in the Rebel Alliance who was stationed at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth.

Oriss Khan was a soldier in the Rebel Alliance who served during the Galactic Civil War. Having training at the rebel base on the moon Yavin 4, Khan worked at a kitchen with fellow trainees Marinna Reynolds and Chase Wilsorr, teaching the latter about different foods from the …
Serenity Meeks was a deck officer in the Rebel Alliance who served at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth.

A human male prisoner was held captive in the city Calodan on the planet Corvus. He was used as a bargaining chip by Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth to prevent the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano from attacking the city.

Tristan Melthabi was a doctor in the Rebel Alliance who worked at the medical facility at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth. During the Galactic Empire's attack on Echo Base in 3 ABY, a cave-in at the corridor to the medical facility trapped Melthabi and three medtechs.
L'cayo Llem was a male humanoid soldier in the Rebel Alliance, serving as part of the Alliance's army in the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Raossk was a Trandoshan male and leader of the swoop gang Pit Screamers during the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally.
Gouge was a Human female and member of the pirate group Dire Skulls based on Mek-Sha.

Veerla Mere was a Twi'lek female swoop racer and course coordinator of the swoop gang Pit Screamers during the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally. Her first victory in swoop racing inspired Raossk to join the Screamers, becoming the gang's leader by 3626 BBY.
Tseekoli was a Rodian female residing on Mek-Sha during the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally. She owned a shipping business and was a friend of the swoop racer Veerla Mere.
Jorn was a Twi'lek male swoop racer of the swoop gang Pit Screamers and brother of Veerla Mere, the Screamers' champion. He was killed around 3627 BBY while practicing in a course on Onderon.
Madon Drees was a Rodian female swoop racer and leader of the swoop gang Horizon's Razor during the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally.

Rida Denru was a female Nautolan and fastest swoop racer of the swoop gang Horizon's Razor. She went missing sometime before 3626 BBY while trying to rescue the Screamers from their debt to the Night Brokers.
Ceret was a trans non-binary Kotabi Jedi Knight, and the bond-twin of Terec. Both twins were stationed at the Starlight Beacon space station during the High Republic Era.
Terec was a trans non-binary Kotabi Jedi Knight and the bond-twin of Ceret. Both twins were stationed at the Starlight Beacon space station during the High Republic Era.
Porter Engle, known as the Blade of Bardotta, was a male Ikkrukkian Jedi Master and cook who lived during the High Republic Era.

"Chuckles" Kandraas was a male Human involved in illicit contraband in the city Iziz on the planet Onderon, in 3627 BBY. That year, he was defeated by an individual fighting the illegal trade and was arrested by Iziz city guards.

Nellow was a female commander of the Sith Empire's Imperial Military. In 3627 BBY, she was overseeing a team of Imperial soldiers doing surveillance around the city Iziz on Onderon when she was tracked and eliminated by a Republic individual.
A New Republic officer served aboard General Han Solo's MC80 Liberty type Star Cruiser during the battle of Pallaxides in 13 ABY.
In 3627 BBY, a Human male commander of the Onderon Royal Guard requested the assistance of a Republic individual in dealing with the Untamed.

A clone trooper officer served as a unit commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems as part of the 41st Scout Battalion of the 41st Elite Corps.
Thene Kross was a Zabrak criminal male arrested by the New Republic, and serving thirty years on Oovo 4 for grand theft starship and resisting arrest.

A human male gunnery officer served in Moff Gideon's remnant of the Galactic Empire, operating aboard Gideon's light cruiser. When the cruiser destroyed the gunship Razor Crest on the planet Tython in 9 ABY, the gunnery officer reported a direct hit to Gideon.
Torbill Danzin was a Tusken Raider male who was serving a twenty-five year sentence in Sunspot Prison for the attempted kidnapping of a senator.
Reegor was a Lepi male and one of Jaxxon T. Tumperakki's many cousins.
Chargutt Lo was a Gamorrean who was serving a fifteen year sentence on Garen IV for aggravated assault.
Carto Deeves was a male criminal who was serving a thirty-five year sentence in Wobani Penitentiary for the assault of a New Republic officer.
Borbin Todds was an Aqualish with black eyes who was serving a twenty-five year sentence on Jubilar for harboring a wanted fugitive.
Vorg Alsum was a Shydopp criminal who served a five year sentence on the Delrian Prison Planet for stealing a speeder.
Ty Yorrick, formerly known as Tylera Yorrick, was a female Tholothian Force-sensitive monster hunter and saber-for-hire who lived during the High Republic Era.
Nilox Cabin-Roves was a human male who was serving a twenty year sentence in Sunspot Prison for the forgery of New Republic credits.

Biran Redben was a human male criminal who worked in a gang as a thief during the New Republic Era. At some point, he was arrested on charges of medical malpractice and was sentenced to serve fifty years on Tamazall for his crimes.
Scurto Tobbs was a human male criminal who was serving a 45-year sentence in the Karthon Chop Fields, for transport of class 4 contraband.
Pretts Rulato was a human male criminal who was serving a 50-year sentence on Clak'dor V for manslaughter and industrial negligence.
Gapgrin Dozito was a Manjtoo criminal who was serving a 25-year sentence on Selnesh for attempted shipjacking.
Yath Endidee was a Quarren criminal who, by 9 ABY, was arrested by the New Republic for attempted murder and resisting arrest and was serving a 40-year sentence on the planet Virujansi.
Avrac Kefundee was a criminal who was serving a 25-year sentence in the Wobani Penitentiary for aggravated assault of a New Republic officer.
Sart Juloss was a Hassk criminal arrested by the New Republic and imprisoned on Selnesh, where he was serving a twenty-five year sentence for shipjacking.

M'dwello Di was a Kajain'sa'Nikto who was serving a 30 year sentence on Tamazall for space piracy. The criminal's profile in the New Republic prison registry was one of several that Marshal Carasynthia Dune looked at from her office on the planet Nevarro in 9 ABY while searchi…
Ghosla Fular was a Mon Calamari criminal who was serving a 30-year sentence in Sunspot Prison for forgery of local currency.
Unga Toba was an Aqualish who was serving a twenty-five year sentence on Lola Sayu for unlawful computer access.

A human male Stormtrooper Commander served in a Galactic Empire remnant led by Moff Gideon. In 9 ABY, the officer held the military rank of captain and, along with his detachment, were dispatched by Gideon to the planet Tython to capture the Force-sensitive infant Grogu.
Sethro Dagri was a criminal who was serving a seventy year sentence on Megalox Beta for murder and extortion.
Torbill Danzin was a human male who was serving a twenty-five year sentence in Sunspot Prison for the attempted kidnapping of a senator.
The Mandalorian foundling and bounty hunter Jango Fett was instructed by a mentor sometime before the former's death at the First Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY.
A codebreaker was hired by the InterGalactic Banking Clan to crack codes for the trade wars against the Hutts.
Jan was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, he fought Imperial troops on the moon Jedha.
Cody was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, he fought Imperial troops on the moon Jedha.
Bangcap was a Weequay male and leader of the Blatant Beks swoop gang during the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally.

Around 3626 BBY, a Togruta female worked as the bartender of the Shining Star cantina on Alderaan. She assisted an individual with tracking a Nexu claw pendant belonging to her favorite swoop gang, the Horizon's Razor.

Around 3626 BBY, a Twi'lek male merchant bought a Nexu claw pendant from the swooper Rida Denru on Alderaan. Later, an individual was sent to retrieve the pendant by the Horizon's Razor, Denru's swoop gang.
An Advozse male swoop rider was a member of the swoop gang Blatant Beks during the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally. He was one of those harassed by a Sullustan fan.
During the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally around 3626 BBY, a Sullustan male HoloNet News show host harassed his favorite swoop gang Blatant Beks for his swooping program.
A Nikto male swoop rider was a member of the swoop gang Blatant Beks during the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally. He was one of those harassed by a Sullustan fan.
A Selonian male mechanic was a member of the swoop gang Blatant Beks during the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally. He was harassed by a Sullustan fan.

In 3 ABY, a male wampa lived with a clan in a cave system that became Echo Base. The establishment of Echo Base threw out the clan while the wampa was out hunting, forcing the wampa to relocate to another cave on his own.
Ziin Mandos was a Gran medic in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Innu Mond was a Sullustan squadron leader in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Old Morta was a Twi'lek female who founded the swoop gang Blatant Beks along with Bangcap. She led the mechanics while Bangcap led the swoopers. By the time of the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally, Old Morta had left the Beks.

Kell Tolkani was a naturalist that served the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the planet Hoth. He chose the place of where Echo Base was to be established, and chose to remain on the world following the Battle of Hoth in order to study its wildlife.
Tev was a male geologist who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was a member of a species that possessed fur and a compact frame.
Karvon Roh was a Human starfighter pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Veyak Ven'ya was a Bothan saboteur in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Rass Ordo was a male Human of Clan Ordo during the third Galactic War. He was the brother of Jekiah Ordo and Layla Ordo.

Bask Sunn was a Dar'manda lieutenant, recruitment officer and a former Mandalorian, who represented the Dar'manda in Heta Kol's organization known as the Hidden Chain during the third Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, around 3626 BBY.
Troya Ajak was a female Ash'ad warrior and former Mandalorian who lived during the third Galactic War.
Tessa Pardax was a Human female commodore of the Sith Empire during the third Galactic War.
Gorga Brak was a Human male Mandalorian warrior of Clan Varad who lived during the third Galactic War.

Tyrus Brokenblade was a male Mandalorian warrior and the leader of Clan Varad who lived during the third Galactic War, and represented Clan Varad in Heta Kol's organization known as the Hidden Chain. He was the nephew of Mavrix Varad.
Durn Wynnward was a male Ash'ad who lived during the third Galactic War and represented the Ash'ad in Heta Kol's organization known as the Hidden Chain.
Fumo was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, he fought Imperial troops on the moon Jedha.
Servant Four was a Sith Pureblood female during the third Galactic War. She was a Servant of the Hand of the Empire.

Minazar was a Human male Force-sensitive and member of the Scions of Zakuul. He was part of the Scions' contingent in the assault on Kira Carsen's ship around 3626 BBY and was killed along with his comrades by the Servants.
Valin Hess was a human male general from the planet Coruscant who served in the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire and later in the Imperial Remnant.
Rintel Aren was a Weequay male pilot who served as a guard to the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
"Echo Leader" was a pilot that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
"Anvil Leader" was a pilot that served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Yotts Oren was a Kadas'sa'Nikto who served in the criminal empire of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine.
Geode was a Vintian male who acted as the navigator of the transport starship Vessel alongside the pilot Leox Gyasi and copilot Affie Hollow. He resembled a tall, dark gray, flinty, flaky rock.

Pra-Tre Veter was a Tarnab male Jedi Master and a member of the Jedi High Council who lived during the High Republic Era. Alongside Yoda and Xo Lahru, Pra-Tre served as one of several active Grand Masters of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Leox Gyasi was a human male pilot who worked for the Byne Guild during the High Republic Era. He flew the starship Vessel, assisted by his co-pilot Affie Hollow and navigator Geode.

Estala Maru was a Kessurian male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Maru was the Jedi head of operations aboard the Starlight Beacon, a space station on the frontier of the galaxy that served as a symbol of unity between the Jedi and the Galactic Repub…
Affie Hollow was a human female who operated for the Byne Guild as the co-pilot of Leox Gyasi aboard the starship Vessel. Hollow was the adopted daughter of Scover Byne, the leader of the Guild.

Kym was a Chagrian Jedi Padawan who lived during the High Republic Era. A friend of Reath Silas, she attempted to cheer him up during the farewell party thrown before he departed Coruscant for the Starlight Beacon space station.

Orla Jareni was an Umbaran female Jedi Master and Wayseeker during the time of the High Republic, operating independently of the Jedi High Council. As the Padawan of Jedi Master Laret Soveral, Jareni was involved in the Eiram–E'ronoh crisis.
Cohmac Vitus was a human male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era, renowned as both a scholar and mystic. He was formerly the Padawan of Master Simmix.
Dez Rydan was a human male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He had golden skin and black hair.

Laret Soveral was a female human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. She was the Master of Jedi Padawan Orla Jareni. Laret and her Padawan, alongside Master Simmix and Padawan Cohmac Vitus, were involved in the crisis between Eiram and E'ronoh.
Simmix was a Fillithar male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He was the master of Padawan Cohmac Vitus, who viewed Simmix as a kind master.
Scover Byne was a female Bivall who was the owner of the Byne Guild, an organization that handled shipping throughout the Galactic Frontier during the High Republic Era.
Thandeka was a human female who was the queen consort of Eiram during the High Republic Era, and was married to the queen regnant, Dima.
Dima was a female individual who ruled as the queen of the planet Eiram during the High Republic Era. She was married to Queen Thandeka, her consort.
Cassel was a Pantoran male who served as the Monarch of the planet E'ronoh during the High Republic Era. He was often seen as unintelligent.
Cham Cham was a male cru that was a pet of Zeen Mrala, a Force-sensitive Mikkian. When Mrala was a young child, she relied on Cham Cham and her friend, Krix Kamerat, to keep her safe and be with her.
Torban Buck, nicknamed "Buckets of Blood," was a Chagrian male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as a healer during the High Republic Era.

Bibs was a Bravaisian Jedi Padawan who lived during the High Republic Era. A member of the class of Padawans training aboard the Star Hopper, Bibs was, along with the rest of the class, dispatched to aid Trymant IV when it fell under threat from the Great Hyperspace Disaster.
Janex was a Pantoran female Dalnan who was part of a delegation that was to be sent from Dalna to meet with the Galactic Republic at the Starlight Beacon aboard the Steady Wing.
A female controller served in remnants of the Galactic Empire on planet Morak in 9 ABY.
A Human male Juggernaut pilot served in a remnant of the Galactic Empire on the planet Morak in 9 ABY. Driving the HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport Juggernaut Five with another Juggernaut pilot.
Jaff was a member of the Dar'manda gun runners. Jaff assisted the Lieutenant Bask Sunn in the purchase of Stardust Gliders.
Lathe was a Kajain'sa'Nikto male who worked in the criminal empire of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

A Twi'lek male vendor sold fresh gorak on Asylum, which he advertised to a customer as being skewered, fried, and roasted shortly after the Rescue of the Outlander on Zakuul.
Sean was a human male Jedi Padawan who lived during the High Republic Era.
Jamie Brasson was the president of Begamor during the High Republic Era in 200 BBY. Rising up to power, Brasson acquired a seat on the Galactic Senate and earned respect from most other senators.
Mostima was a human female Jedi Master who was active during the High Republic Era. Around 203 BBY, she took on a Padawan named Sean.
A Chiss female was the former caregiver of sky-walker navigator Al'iastov. At some point they told Al'iastov not to complain about her feelings.
A Lioaoi was in command when the Chiss spaceship Springhawk visited the Lioaoin heartworld.
The Rutian Twi'lek female was an individual enslaved to fellow Twi'lek male Bib Fortuna, an ex-majordomo who had assumed the throne of his late master, the crime lord Jabba the Hutt.
Marino Pomana was a Latero male who worked as the Head Chef at President Jamie Brasson's estate on Begamor
Wes was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, he fought Imperial troops on the moon Jedha.
Layla Ordo was a Human female and a member of the Mandalorian Clan Ordo. Sister to Jekiah and Rass Ordo, she was killed during an operation on Belsavis.
Jorad Mainos was a human male pilot who served in Moff Gideon's Imperial remnant of the Galactic Empire.

Mott was a human co-pilot who served in the Galactic Empire, being aboard the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station when it destroyed the planet Alderaan in 1 BBY. After the Empire was fractured into remnants, he operated with a remnant led by Moff Gideon.

Jamint was a female Ugnaught who lived in Ugnaught Town on Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. She was one of the aunts of Lonaste.
