Thi'in Lis was an Alliance Special Forces operative during the Galactic Civil War. Lis was a member of the Abinyshi species.
Si Qurr was an Abinyshi poet. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, Qurr had passed away
Wehutti's wife married Wehutti and had two children with him: a daughter, Cerasi, and a son. During the Melida/Daan Civil War, she was killed.

Zaster was an officer of the Imperial Military who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Zaster held the rank of General and commanded the Imperial Second Division on the planet Tatooine.

A sandtrooper captain of the Galactic Empire served in a sandtrooper regiment within the Stormtrooper Corps of the Imperial Army. The trooper traveled to the planet Tatooine to pursue the two rebel droids R2-D2 and C-3PO, who were in posession of the Death Star plans.
A male actor played the Sith Lord Darth Krist-Ov in a play with actress Risha Synata, who portrayed a Jedi.

Meggal was a captain in service to the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, the captain commanded a Longbeam cruiser during efforts to rescue victims of the Great Hyperspace Disaster and subsequent hyperspace debris Emergences, working in a team with the…
Feyn Gospic was a human who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, holding the military rank of colonel within the Massassi Group.

A female individual was the older sister of the Human male Quarsh Panaka, who was born by 62 BBY on the planet Naboo. Panaka's sister was an officer Palace Guard in the Royal Naboo Security Forces, an organization that Panaka also joined.
An individual was the second cousin of the Nihil Cloud Dent. By 232 BBY, they were married to Buggo, a male Strike who served under Dent's command, which led her to consider Buggo family of a sort.

Zoovler Tom was a male Ugnaught who held the rank of Storm in Lourna Dee's Tempest of the Nihil during the High Republic Era. Cloud Ultident Margrona reported to him when the raid she was leading on Elphrona began to go sideways due to Jedi intervention.
Fur-Bite was a member of the Blazing Claw pirate group that sailed under Captain Gunda Mabin on the Bloody Bones.

Tu-Wane Jipps was a Volpai musician who was a gambling partner of the criminal Tobias Beckett. He came to owe Beckett a favor after some nasty business on Malkii and also fell into debt with the Hutts.

Glunge was a Gloovan bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. Around 0 ABY, he worked with fellow bounty hunter Takvax and the swoop racers Kuru and Makta in order to try and claim a bounty on the smuggler Han Solo during a swoop race on the planet Rion.
Csap'ro'strob, known as Apros, was a Chiss male who held the rank of Mid Captain aboard the warship Grayshrike, serving as the first officer of Senior Captain Irizi'in'daro.

Takvax was a gray-skinned alien bounty hunter who was an associate of the swoop racer Kuru. In around 0 ABY, the pair were on the planet Rion when they encountered the smuggler Han Solo, who had a large Imperial bounty on his head.
Scram was a Gloovan gangster who led the Scram Gang during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Kiren was a non-binary mechanic who worked in Cloud City on Bespin alongside their coworker, Baudu. The trio of Kiren, Baudu, and their friend Tal Veridian were opposed to the Galactic Empire.
Coduyo'po'nekri, also known by the core name of Yoponek, was a Chiss male of the Coduyo family and the betrothed of Yomie. Yoponek was a student of history.

Xodlak'phr'ooa, also known by the core name Lakphro, was a male Chiss individual who served as a rancher. Lakphro was married to Lakansu and the pair had a daughter named Lakris. The family lived in Redhill province on the planet Celwis.
Xodlak'uvi'vil, also known by the core name Lakuviv, was a Chiss male who served as a Councilor within the Chiss Ascendancy on the planet Celwis.
Exum Jermit was a Muun who served as Second Vice Chair of the InterGalactic Banking Clan and frequented the Malastare Hunting Club, who would treat them lavishly for their loyalty to them.
TK-9102 was the designation of a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire.

Sheravin was a human who held the rank of admiral in the Galactic Empire. When Beol De'Rruyet, founder of De'Rruyet Industries, planned to unveil a replicated Nihil Path engine, Sheravin contacted Lady Domina Tagge of the Tagge Corporation on behalf of Emperor Palpatine, warni…

Di'reni was a Twi'lek female bartender and owner of Club Lazuli in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. The Twi'lek's club was under the protection of the Sixth Kin criminal organization, led by Wen Delphis.

Koz was a human criminal who operated in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. He owed a large amount of money to the Sixth Kin criminal organization, led by Wen Delphis; as a result, Delphis sent one of her lieutenants, Ariole Yu, and the sniper Just Lucky, to conf…

A Hoopaloo lived during the High Republic Era. Between 241 BBY and 231 BBY, he worked alongside the monster hunter Ty Yorrick in a job on the Outer Rim planet Alzoc III. During the job, however, the Hoopaloo betrayed Yorrick and stole part of her arsenal.
Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam was an individual who served in the Royal Security Forces of Naboo during the Imperial Era and later became an explorer when he retired during the Galactic Civil War.
Andimor Gray was a male human who served as the captain of Mandalorian Duchess Satine Kryze's luxury Nau'ur-class yacht, the Coronet.

Pisk was a male individual from Naboo who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, Pisk and his friend Tinrilo x'Rilsam, a retired Royal Naboo Security Forces agent, decided to dedicate to history and exploration of the galaxy.

A stormtrooper deserter was a former stormtrooper who deserted the Galactic Empire during a mission on the planet Aleen. He joined another stormtrooper deserter and resided on Nothoiin where they looked after an Aleena child.

Mosor was a male military officer who lived on Tatooine long before the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, it was rumored that Mosor was behind the construction of a mysterious maze on Tatooine.
Jherl was a human boy who lived in the city of Mock on the planet of Cerosha. He was killed by the Dark Wraith.

Polen was a male military officer who lived on Tatooine long before the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, it was rumored that a mysterious maze on Tatooine was built because of Polen.
KT-1138, nicknamed "Kaity" and "Kaitlyn," was a human female stormtrooper who served the First Order under General Hux.
Olko Baz was a member of the Clazca, a tribe of the Beast Riders on Onderon during the Galactic Civil War.
A knight was stalked by Ry Nymbis on a night world. Nymbis choked the life from her and took her weapon to create his own.

Foth Shemar was a member of the Clazca, a tribe of the Beast Riders on Onderon during the Galactic Civil War.

Jaddroc Tielg was an Imperial Army scout sent on Onderon by Moff Lasre Dardano to recon the Whisper Base before launching an attack.

A pirate was a member of a pirate gang that fought a battle in the Mirrin sector against the New Republic's Rapier Squadron. When Rapier Leader, Poe Dameron was captured he was sent to the pirate for interrogation.

The father of Affie Hollow was a human male who was in indentured servitude to the Byne Guild and its leader, Scover Byne. He was in a relationship with Hollow's mother, and the two of them piloted the starship Kestrel's Dive for the Guild.

Haplif was a telepathic male Agbui who served the Grysk Hegemony operative "Jixtus." Haplif possessed a talent for reading and analyzing cultures, which he proudly utilized in service to his employer.

Chaf'pri'uhme, core name Afpriuh, was a Chiss male who held the rank of Senior Commander in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. He served aboard the heavy cruiser Springhawk under Senior Captain Thrawn as weapons officer.

Laknym was a Chiss male of the Xodlak family who served the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet, holding the rank of Lieutenant Commander. He served as a plasma sphere specialist aboard the Springhawk, a heavy cruiser commanded by Senior Captain Thrawn.
Erighal'ok'sumf, known by his core name Ghaloksu, was a Chiss male of the Erighal Great Family who held the rank of Senior Commander in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet.

The Magys was a female individual who held the title of Magys, ruling over her people. When her world was devastated in a civil war orchestrated by Haplif of the Agbui under the orders of the Grysk "Jixtus," the Magys and two hundred refugees escaped.
Xodlak'oo'nifis, core name Lakooni, was a Chiss female who was the Patriel of the planet Celwis, a stronghold of the Xodlak family. Lakooni held the rank of blood within the Xodlak family.

Xodlak'ji'iprip, core name Lakjiip, was a Chiss female of the Xodlak family who served as a Senior Aide to Councilor Xodlak'uvi'vil on the planet Celwis. She and Lakuviv were caught up in Haplif of Agbui's scheme to draw the Chiss Ascendancy into a civil war.

Yomie was a Chiss female of the Coduyo family and the betrothed of Coduyo'po'nekri. She and Yoponek embarked on a wandering year prior to their final education, choosing to travel the Chiss Ascendancy.
Ragon was a Besalisk doctor who had a history with Boba Fett, a bounty hunter. In 3 ABY, Ragon was working on Nar Shaddaa and assisted Fett with containing Han Solo in carbonite.
Wyrmen Lictor was a pit warrior who operated on Nar Kanji. Lictor was a successful warrior who, once she climbed to the top of the ranking, remained there as champion for a long time.
Irizi'emo'lacfo, core name Ziemol, was a Chiss male who held the title of Speaker in the Chiss Ascendancy's Chiss Syndicure, representing the Irizi family.

A female individual was the mother of human male historian and Resistance member Beaumont Kin. During Kin's involvement in the First Order's blockade of the planet Kashyyyk in 34 ABY, Kin claimed to Resistance pilot Daz Crano that his mother and father told him he was useless,…

A human male served as an Imperial stormtrooper on the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station. As the battle station entered firing range for its superlaser upon Yavin 4, the location of a hidden Rebel base, the stormtrooper was heading to his station.

Ceeril was a male Skembo who served as the Ambassador of Rion during the High Republic Era. While being treated for injuries at the Starlight Beacon space station, Ceeril attempted to frame some members of the Hassarian species, who were rivals of the Skembo, in an assassinati…
Cah Norne was an individual in charge of an engineering section onboard the Galactic Republic-Jedi Order space station Starlight Beacon.

A female Medoslean patient was being cared for at the Starlight Beacon's medcenter in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster. While being treated by Doctor Gino'le and junior nurse Okana, the patient had a violent negative response to something she was administered.
Jjan was the leader of the Morubas Crime Family. In 19 BBY, Jjan captured Maul, leader of the Shadow Collective.

Krantz was a human member of the Morubas Crime Family. In 19 BBY, the Shadow Collective criminal alliance launched an attack on the Morubas stronghold after the family poisoned the Shadow Collective's leader, former Dark Lord of the Sith Maul, and took him hostage.

A Mon Calamari individual with orange skin and eyes was present in Dac City on the planet Mon Cala, wearing beige clothing. In 34 ABY, a Quarren sabotaged a shuttle that several members of the Resistance were planning on using to leave the planet.
A Quarren male saboteur sabotaged a shuttle on the planet of Mon Cala. The Quarren also served as the personal assistant to Chadkol Gee.
A shock trooper quartermaster served in the Coruscant Guard of the Galactic Republic's military branch during the Clone Wars.

A humanoid Jedi Master served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. At the end of the conflict, the Jedi was stationed in Tipoca City, the capital of Kamino, the planet where the Grand Army of the Republic's clone troopers had been created.

Ciddarin Scaleback, nicknamed "Cid," was a Mantellian Trandoshan female information broker, smuggler, and businesswoman whose career in the galactic underworld spanned the Galactic Republic Era into the early days of the Imperial Era.
Jonny the Sting was a pit warrior who operated on Nar Shaddaa. He was killed by Boba Fett as part of a mission to kill Wyrmen Lictor.
Skullicon was a pit warrior who operated on Nar Shaddaa. The fighter was killed by Boba Fett as part of a mission to kill Wyrmen Lictor.
Bigbot was a male pit warrior who operated on Nar Shaddaa. He was killed by Boba Fett as part of a mission to kill Wyrmen Lictor.
Edmon Rampart was a human male who held the rank of Vice Admiral in the Galactic Republic, and later Galactic Empire shortly after its formation.
A male individual was the grandfather of the Humans Lanoree and Dalien Brock. While his grandson, Dalien, was a child, this individual passed a blaster pistol down to him.
Fauja was a female Aleena merchant who lived on the planet Saleucami at the beginning of the Imperial Era.
Ziliss was a female pureblooded Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Third Galactic War, who functioned as an Imperial Reclamation Service enforcer.

Dogah was a male Imperial Grappler Captain active during the third Galactic War. In 3626 BBY, he, with fellow Imperials Ziliss and Kodo, fought the Commander, Arn Peralun, and Aryn Leneer when they arrived at the Dantooine Jedi Enclave to investigate the whereabouts of Darth M…
Meinar was a male Human captain of the Galactic Republic during the third Galactic War. He served as a Republic Guard in 3626 BBY
Osonu was a female Human lieutenant of the Galactic Republic during the third Galactic War, who specialized as a grappler by 3626 BBY.

A clone trooper was involved in an altercation with the genetically altered clone Omega as well as the members of Clone Force 99. Like all clone troopers in the Grand Army of the Republic, this trooper was cloned from the template of Jango Fett.
Corrik was a female Miraluka sergeant of the Galactic Republic at the time of the third Galactic War, functioning as a Demolitionist by 3626 BBY.
Vinyor Tesh was a Nautolan male Jedi Master during the third Galactic War between Galactic Republic and Sith Empire. Tesh was trained in and specialized in maintaining the Jedi Archives.

Fuzzy was the name of an award-winning Xuvva that was adopted by Yarvok, the leader of the Nova Blades. Krupo, a beast wrangler, lost Fuzzy along with several of Yarvok's other pets after a ship carrying the pets crashed on Dantooine, much to Yarvok's anger.
A Snivvian male individual made an attempt to leave the planet Saleucami shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire.

Frost was an officer of the armed forces of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, Colonel Frost and Major Tery investigated the leadership of the Meatlumps, a group of of technology-hating thugs and terrorists active on Corellia.

Tery was an officer of the armed forces of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, Major Tery and Colonel Frost investigated the leadership of the Meatlumps, a group of of technology-hating thugs and terrorists active on Corellia.
A Tah'Nuhnan individual lived on the Mid Rim planet Tah'Nuhna. Prior to the First Order's attack on the planet, the Tah'Nuhnan reflected on all the Tah'Nuhnan people had done.

ES-04, also known as Firebrand, was the designation of a human female Elite Squad Trooper who served the Galactic Empire during the early days of the Imperial Era.

Flappy was the name of one of Yarvok's award-winning pet Xuvva. Krupo, a beast wrangler, lost Flappy along with several of Yarvok's other pets after a ship carrying the pets crashed on the planet Dantooine, to Yarvok's anger.
Rox was the name of a pet Skar'kla owned by Yarvok, a leader of the Nova Blades pirates. Yarvok raised Rox himself, just like he did his other two pet Skar'kla, Yug and Wa-Vendeg.
Yug was the name of a Skar'kla owned by Yarvok, an officer of the Nova Blades pirates. Yarvok raised Yug himself, just like he did his other two pet Skar'kla, Rox and Wa-Vendeg.

Wa-Vendeg was the name of a pet Skar'kla owned by Yarvok, a lieutenant of the Nova Blades pirates gang. Yarvok claimed to have brought up Wa-Vendeg himself, just like he did his other two Skar'kla, Rox and Yug.

Spike was a Zeldrate owned by Yarvok, the leader of the Nova Blades pirates group. Yarvok was fond of Spike, calling the pet his "beloved." Yarvok felt the same way about his other Zeldrate, Ol' Cronchy.

Ol' Cronchy was a Zeldrate owned by Yarvok, a lieutenant of the Nova Blades pirates. Yarvok was very fond of Ol' Cronchy, calling the pet his "beloved." Yarvok felt similar about his other Zeldrate, Spike.

Kaya Natari was an employee of Czerka Corporation. The corporation sent Natari to investigate the possibility of using "Archaeological site 75-D", Czerka's name for the abandoned Dantooine Jedi Enclave, for future Czerka Corporation endeavors.

A human male refugee was promised transport off the planet Onderon by Saw Gerrera's Partisans. When CT-9904's elite squad hunted down and destroyed the Partisans camp, he asked the refugees for information. The refugee told him he that he had no information.

Vendi Kjleno was a member of the armed forces of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Kjleno fought during the Battle of Yavin and was considered as a war hero. However, by 1 ABY, he was attacked by Imperial forces in the Endor system.
Udi Dis was a Talortai male who served the Nihil marauder organization. Having left his home of Talor, Dis had once been a soldier, carrying wingblades that were his only possession from his home.
Kufa was an elderly female Evereni who was a cousin of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro. She had tattoos on her face that resembled the lightning-bolt symbol of the Nihil marauder organization.

A human female fighter was part of Saw Gerrera's group of Partisans stationed on Onderon at around 19 BBY. While escorting a group of refugees off Onderon, her group was ambushed by CT-9904's Elite Squad, who were there to wipe out Gerrera and his Partisans.
Enowyn was a flight mechanic who dated Davin Novachez at Pilot Academy.
Sunshine was a tauntaun female that was kept at Echo Base on Hoth and was ridden by Jordan Smythe.
ES-02 was the designation of a human female Elite Squad Trooper who was recruited into the military of the Galactic Empire in its early foundation by Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart.
ES-03 was the designation of a human male of the Galactic Empire who was recruited early in its foundation by Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart.

Lenka Mok was a human female who was the Cruise Director aboard the MPO-1400 star cruiser Halcyon during the First Order-Resistance War. A cheerful individual and lover of adventure, she was inspired by the efforts of those who sought to bring peace to a tumultuous galaxy.
Sammie was a human male mechanic who served aboard the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon during the First Order-Resistance War.
Harman Croy was a human male lieutenant who served in the military of the First Order during its war with the Resistance.

The Fixer was a human male criminal who operated during the First Order-Resistance War. A smooth-talking schemer and intellectual, the Fixer used his charms to convince others to assist him in his illicit enterprises.

A genderless Sabetue individual accompanied Kilmo on Corellia to purchase coaxium from one of Lady Proxima's White Worms, the human male Han Solo. When Solo attempted to scam the group, the Sabetue tried and failed to prevent the human from fleeing.
Sandro Alimander was a male musician who lived in the galaxy during the First Order-Resistance War, embarking for the first time aboard the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon.

A human male fighter was a member of the Partisans shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. Serving under Saw Gerrera, the fighter was one of many rebels who refused to accept the Empire's rule and went into hiding in Onderon's jungle.
Frosif was a female Agbui "mid-ager" aboard the Agbui starship on Celwis. She was Shimkif's daughter, and posed as the daughter of Haplif.

A female individual was a resident of the planet Nacronis. She was offworld when the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing destroyed the planet during Operation: Cinder, becoming a survivor of the genocide, which eradicated the population of Nacronis, including members…
A female individual was the director of the Reconciliation Project, an effort undertaken by the New Republic following its defeat of the Galactic Empire and the end of the Galactic Civil War.
Tay Coomsay was a Bosph male who served as navigator of the Alliance Intelligence EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Shadow Raptor.
Hadiss the Vaulted, also known simply as Hadiss, was archduke of the Stalgasin hive, a Geonosian hive on the planet Geonosis.
Eegrig was a Dathomirian Zabrak and a member of the Nightbrothers of Dathomir. He and the other members of his tribe served the Nardithi Nightsister Jerserra.

Ral Garas was a male Ishi Tib who served as an advisor to King Amand of the planet Molos. After the Battle of Yavin, with the support of the Rebel Alliance, Garas helped plan an uprising on the planet with the help of the Alliance sergeant Trask.
Raspar Six was a Sullustan depot manager who oversaw a refueling depot located in Ro Station on the moon Pantora.

A male Gran trader lived on the moon Pantora at the beginning of the Imperial Era. The fugitive clones Hunter and Echo visited his shop to sell some items for credits, but the merchant was not interested in the pyro denton explosive Hunter offered.
Vam Targes was an Aqualish engineer who operated during the High Republic Era. He was famed as an engineer, but had a reputation as being a strict taskmaster.

Ishtah was a male Kaleesh technician who worked in Paolo's Chop Shop on Nar Shaddaa in 19 BBY. Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi visited this shop shortly after the end of the Clone Wars to sell his starfighter, Soulless One.
Riij Brinwell was a Sector Ranger operating in the Parmic sector. Holding the rank of Sergeant, Brinwell was considered to be knowledgeable about space transports and their use throughout the galaxy.
Falk was a Human who grew up on the streets of the city Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine with the Rodian Doda Bodonawieedo as a companion.
Isabalia was a female who lived in Cloud City on Bespin in the year 3 ABY. She idolized bounty hunters like Boba Fett, and was romantically interested in Joy Iya.
A female Pantoran vendor sold fruit in the central marketplace of a Pantoran city at the beginning of the Imperial Era.

Joy Iya was a female resident of Cloud City on Bespin in 3 ABY. A service worker who was concerned with workers' rights, she began organizing a citywide work stoppage to get the attention of Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian and other beings in charge of the city during the…

Caviness Thorn was a humanoid bounty hunter who led the Caviness Thorn crew. Around 5 BBY, Thorn took a bounty on the smuggler Han Solo and attempted to kill the smuggler on the planet Abregado-Rae but was thwarted by Solo's friend, the cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance.

Box O'Rox was a Human male Ragtag criminal who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he lived in Coronet City and served as a henchman for Ames Miss'd, along with Anita B'ath.

Between 41 BBY and 40 BBY escalating tensions between Mandalorian clans led to the outbreak of the Great Clan Wars. During the wars, Kryze emerged as a warlord of House Kryze and gained respect from his enemies, including Death Watch.

Thaneespi was a Mon Calamari who served in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 4 ABY, Thaneespi was first officer of the MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser Home One while present at a briefing shortly before the Battle of Endor.
Halka Four-Den was a female individual who served as an expert commander of a Galactic Republic Alpha Team during the Republic Era.

Ruggle Schmong was a Sullustan male shipwright who developed the idea of funneling energy generated by a starship's propulsion systems back into its weapon systems of batteries, where it would be reutilized by the vessel.

Deland Tyerell was an Aleena and the son of the podracer Ratts Tyerell, who was killed during the Boonta Eve Classic in 32 BBY. After his father's death, Deland founded the Ratts Tyerell Foundation, an organization dedicated to exposing the dangerous aspects of podracing.

Mett Habble was a human who served in the Royal Naboo Security Forces. They died when Senator Padmé Amidala's ship was destroyed by Zam Wesell upon arriving to Coruscant so Amidala could vote on the Military Creation Act.
Porla was a Hutt male who lived on Boonta. Prior to becoming a pirate, the Weequay Hondo Ohnaka served Porla as a cupbearer and adviser.

Ryle Torsyn was a human who served as a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. While in the rebel base on the planet Dantooine, he discovered an Imperial tracking device in a delivery of equipment, which led to the base being evacuated.

Maxiron Agolerga was a human male who was Pontifex of the Brotherhood of Cognizance. In 22 BBY, he was one of only around twenty hermits in the order and became the first Pontifex to legitimise a marriage in over 300 years when he secretly officiated the wedding of Jedi Anakin…

Adar Tallon was a human individual that served with distinction in the armed forces of the Galactic Republic and subsequently as an officer of the Galactic Empire prior to his defection to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
a: Father of the Old Republic Navy

x: Gustab Wenbus was a fearless alien racer who started the modern age of podracing around a century before the Galactic Civil War by entering himself into an event on the planet Malastare with a super-fast podracer designed by the rogue mechanic Phoebos.

Sian Holt was a human female high-end private detective who operated during the High Republic Era. She was enlisted by Chancellor Lina Soh of the Galactic Republic to investigate a mystery with ties to the Jedi Order, encountering the Jedi Emerick Caphtor, who was undertaking …
Emerick Caphtor was a human male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Caphtor was tasked with investigating the mysterious death of Loden Greatstorm on the planet Grizal.

Bokku was a Hutt who served on the Grand Hutt Council of the Hutt Clan during the Imperial Era, operating from a lair in the Outer Rim Territories. He employed Gamorreans, Bith, a Nikto, and a Klatooinian. He also had regular contacts in the Galactic Empire.
A male Zygerrian worked as the auctioneer for the Zygerrian Slave Empire's Royal Slave Auction in 20 BBY, at which he introduced the 50,000 enslaved Togruta from the Kiros system to the crowd.

Boz was a tauntaun who was the offspring of Murra, a tauntaun that was kept by the Alliance to Restore the Republic at Echo Base on Hoth. Leia Organa mentioned Boz to Murra while Luke Skywalker was lost in Hoth's wilderness.

Arno was a tauntaun who was the offspring of Murra, a tauntaun that was kept by the Alliance to Restore the Republic at Echo Base on Hoth. Leia Organa mentioned Arno to Murra while Luke Skywalker was lost in Hoth's wilderness.

FwittsinPru was a Troig spokesperson for the Obroan Oddsmakers. In a report made by the news organization Cynabar's InfoNet, FwittsinPru spoke on the behalf of the Obroan Oddsmakers and criticized the Alliance to Restore the Republic, blaming the Alliance for a mission which i…

Keelak was a tauntaun cow who was part of a herd of tauntauns that were captured and domesticated by the Rebels of Echo Base on Hoth. She eventually challenged Murra, the matriarch of the herd, for a leadership role, though their fight was eventually broken up by Leia Organa.

Pombo was a member of a herd of tauntauns that were captured and domesticated by the Rebel Alliance forces on the planet Hoth. Pombo was present when the herd's matriarch, Murra, was challenged by Keelak, another tauntaun in the herd.
Muchi was an adolescent female rancor owned by crime lord Jabba the Hutt. At some point, she was captured by Zygerrian enslavers and taken to the Mid Rim planet Ord Mantell.
Raney was a Zygerrian male who was the leader of a group of Zygerrian enslavers who operated on the planet Ord Mantell shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire.

Phontos was an Ithorian infochant. He worked out of The Grill, located in Shulell City on the planet Lan Barell. Phontos was on good terms with a number of the spacers who frequented Shulell City spaceport, and his office maintained a tropical atmosphere.
A boy was a Tusken Raider who belonged to a tribe and lived in a village on the planet Tatooine. According to legend, the boy was taken from his mother's arms by the krayt dragon, Krayt.

A female Tusken Raider was a warrior who belonged to a tribe and lived in a village on the planet Tatooine. According to legend, the warrior made it her destiny to find and kill Krayt for the destruction it caused.

A human was the father of Serj Ukkarian, and a passenger on the freighter Legacy Run, one of thousands of colonists moving to the Outer Rim Territories.They were in the twelfth division with their wife during the Great Hyperspace Disaster.

The mother of Serj Ukkarian was a female human. Along with their partner and son, they were one of thousands of colonists traveling to the Outer Rim Territories aboard the freighter Legacy Run when it was destroyed in the Great Hyperspace Disaster.
Galo Thriven was a Human male from Thule who served as an elite commando in the military of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A female individual was the mother of Ruen, a human male who was a skilled technician. Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra came to know Ruen, claiming that the technician would be willing to sell his mother into enslavement to fund a project.

Hawser was a pirate and member of the Blazing Claw, serving under the pirate queen Gunda Mabin as part of the crew of the Bloody Bones. Hawser participated in a raid against a Ghtroc star yacht on the Atrian Merchants' Causeway.
Puckwale was a pirate of the Blazing Claw. Puckwale served under the pirate queen Gunda Mabin as the navigator of the Bloody Bones.
Ratty-Ratty was a thief who was a member of Bandit Billie's crew. She participated in several of Bandit Billie's heists.

Reina Sarapinia was a duchess who met Lando Calrissian at the chance parlor on Makem Te. She left a card for him where she wrote a short note promising that she would always cover for his escapes. Calrissian however never received the card.
Mama Annie was a female custom spice chemist. Han Solo and Chewbacca were introduced to Mama Annie by Sonniod.
Wrollanppf, also known as One-Eyed Volant the Eviscerator, was a female Wookiee gladiator who was among the enslaved combatants at the Grakkus Arena on Nar Shaddaa.
Tova was a tauntaun and an old friend of Murra who was part of a herd of tauntauns that were captured and domesticated by the Rebels of Echo Base on Hoth.
A tauntaun female was the matriach of the herd which her daughter Murra later led.

Gallin Crae was a human male lieutenant in the Sixth Kin criminal organization, led by Wen Delphis. Highly loyal to Delphis, Crae was also the mentor of both Just Lucky and Ariole Yu, having trained them since they were young.

Ebann Drake was a human male arms dealer who led an arms-smuggling ring on Kaderin. He was a distant cousin of Lady Domina Tagge of the Tagge Corporation, whose company was privately involved with Drake.

A Falleen male was captured by a group of Zygerrian slave traders in 19 BBY. He, along with a human and a female Falleen child were kept by the slavers in the ruins of Old Ord Mantell City on the planet of Ord Mantell, overseen by the Zygerrian leader, Raney.

Habria was a female individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a commander. Along with Kell Tolkani, she was part of a team that scouted the planet Hoth in order to determine if it would be a suitable location for a Rebel base.

Ryssle was a female individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a meteorologist. Along with Kell Tolkani, Ryssle was part of a team that scouted the planet Hoth in order to determine if it would be a suitable location for a Rebel base.

Boonda was a reformed male Hutt criminal who held Rebel Alliance sympathies and operated a shipping business with his YT-2000 Light Freighter, the Vo Granee Droi, after failing to graduate from the Corulag Military Academy.
Luca was a smuggler who held Rebel Alliance sympathies and owned the YT-2000 Light Freighter Faithless.

Dana "Deke" Galvason was a female tramp freighter captain from Bakura who owned the YT-2000 light freighter Bakuran Blade, which she used to help the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Galvason was one of the few who had clearance to fly through the Deep Core Security Zone.

A male member of House Valorum worked as a politician. He supported a number of artistic works such as the opera The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths, and he failed in an opportunity to destroy the Nebula Front terrorist group.
A female individual was the mother of Kendal Ozzel. They lived on the planet Carida.
This human male was the father of Kell Tolkani. He worked in a senior position in Incom Corporation.
This human female was the mother of Kell Tolkani. She worked in a senior position in Incom Corporation.
A female ambassador was sent by the Galactic Empire to the homeworld of the Contessa, whose family ruled the planet and turned the ambassador away.

A female was a commanding officer of the Galactic Empire. She was present on the planet Haruun Kal when ground forces led by Lieutenant Canonhaus. The commanding officer of the Imperial ground troops ordered a march to a lake thirty kilometers away.
This Korun boy was present on the planet Haruun Kal when Imperial Forces, led by Lieutenant Canonhaus, a occupied the planet. He met with the lieutenant while he drank from a Lammas.
Bon Tapalo was a male member of the Royal House of Naboo who served as king of the Naboo culture on the planet Naboo.

This human male was a TIE fighter pilot who flew with Amara Kel. Later he was moved in a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle as a pilot, but after one month he led himself back, because he missed the rush and the excitement.

Carter was a human male student who attended Coruscant Jedi Academy the same time as Roan Novachez. He also chastised Roan Novachez for kicking the dodgeball to Gaiana and also introduces the food fight, which made Gammy cry fearfully.

Stybla'rsi'omli, core name Larsiom, was a Chiss male who held the rank of Junior Commander in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. She served as the comm officer of Admiral Ar'alani aboard the Chiss Ascendancy Nightdragon man-of-war Vigilant.

Pilton was a female Lannik Jedi Master who was the math and history teacher at the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's three years of attendance. She was shocked when Cronah complained to her about Roan Novachez drawing a note to Gaiana.
Jax was a human male pilot who lived on Tatooine and knew Roan Novachez. He attended Pilot Academy with Reg. After his spring break, he and Reg got to ride the new starfighter, J-47.
Reg was a human male pilot who lived on Tatooine and knew Roan Novachez. He attended Pilot Academy with Jax. After his spring break, he and Jax got to ride the new starfighter, J-47.
Adam was a human male who lived on Tatooine and knew Roan Novachez.

Gondrin Upal was a Kajain'sa'Nikto tramper who traveled on board the AA-9 Freighter-Liner Jendirian Valley while it transported refugees from the planet Coruscant to the planet Naboo during the Separatist Crisis in 22 BBY.

Kaycee Kollenz was a human freighter tramper who traveled on board the AA-9 Freighter-Liner Jendirian Valley while it transported refugees from the planet Coruscant to the planet Naboo during the Separatist Crisis in 22 BBY.
Si-Yy was an exogorth who took part of the meeting with other exogorths. Si-Yy brought Unark worm's on its stomach.
To-X was an exogorth who took part of the meeting with other exogorths. To-X brought Pylat birds on its stomach.
The Ghost Wookiee was said to be an angry Wookiee ghost who lived on the planet Kashyyyk and attacked travelers.

Albert, also known as Albert the Hutt, was a Hutt professor who wore circular glasses. Around 196 BBY, the student news group The Padawan Observer made several announcements on a Duoday in the fifth issue of their 1012th volume.
A chef worked onboard the Alliance to Restore the Republic MC80 Star Cruiser Home One. According to Wedge Antilles, the chef was surprisingly good.
Gub Vendo was a male Aqualish Jedi Knight who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Nori Ha was a Kaminoan Jedi who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Keff D'irst was a Bith artist who had an art gallery in the Coruscant Gallery of Modern Art in 194 BBY.
Leo was a Human male padawan who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Plitch was a Shistavanen padawan who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Shari was a padawan who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Hugh was a Duros padawan who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Ruki was a Zabrak padawan who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Ketch was a male Weequay who was a regular patron of Cid's Parlor on Ord Mantell. He was usually seen in the company of the Ithorian Bolo.

Rutallaroo was a male Wookiee who lived during the Imperial Era. He was a famous military engineer in Torukiko, who turned a fleet of catamarans into assault ships and designed and directed a three-year covert operation aimed at driving the Galactic Empire out from the planet …
Maromaka was an outlaw Wookiee who belonged to a secret network, and worked to get fugitive Wookiees to a safe place on Kashyyyk.
Tossonnu was an outlaw Wookiee who belonged to a secret network, and worked to get fugitive Wookiees to a safe place.
The Gibbering Gran of Gibraal was an Gran criminal who was caught by the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk.
