x: Ansan Talam was a Human who was one of the first miners to arrive on the planet Tasariq. Independent and liking space and solitude, Talam prospected in unexplored craters for Tasar crystals.

Bersin Sekolah was an Ithorian who served as a scout in for the Republic's Scout Service. Sekolah left the Service after the rise of the Empire, convinced that the Scout Service would become a tool of military oppression and expansion.
Dunclair Gostegion was a Human male hailing from the Corporate Sector. Dissatisfied with the prospect of a corporate job, he joined swoop gangs as a teenager.

Garuk was a Tasari male who led a secret cult on Tasariq that worshipped Tasar crystals. Raised in the cult, Garuk led his cultist through the ancient rites and blood rituals and professed to shun the influence of off-worlders and believed that no Tasari should ever leave thei…

Velerinden excelled in the Army, impressing his drill sergeants and being recommended for officer training at the Academy. He rose through the ranks, and demonstrated his skills as an AT-ST commander.

Mendegar was a female bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. Born Nell Wenn on Deysum III, the young woman aspired to be a police officer, joining the local Police Academy with dreams of eventually joining the Sector Rangers.

Suraya was a Human criminal who ran the black market on the planet Tasariq. A smuggler operating in the Outer Rim Territories, Suraya once upset Jabba the Hutt by praising one of his lieutenants who had, unbeknownst to Suraya, been fed to the Jabba's rancor.

Valjak was a Tasari male and member of the secret order known as Kiana. Members of the Kiana were dedicated to fight against the blood cults that hid among Tasari society. Valjak operated as a guide to off-worlders to cover his activities and to earn a living.

Dem Keval was a Chandrilan who was appointed as Imperial governor of the planet Tasariq. Tasked with governing the world and ensuring that Tasariq remained free as long as the appropriate taxes were paid, Governor Keval levied a heavy tariff on off-world goods.

Samara the Blue was a female Jedi who served the Jedi Order on Genetia sometime before the High Republic Era. During her time there, Samara observed the empathic powers possessed by Force-sensitive Genetian humans and wrote about them.
Tip was a Bonbrak who worked with the Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram in a garage within the Jedi living quarters on the planet Valo. Out of Jomaram's Bonbrak crew, Tip was both the youngest and surliest.
Breebak was a Bonbrak who worked alongside the Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram in a garage on the planet Valo during the High Republic Era.

Barbatash was an individual who, by the time of the Night of Sorrow in 382 BBY, was an Elder in the Path of the Open Hand cult. During the Night of Sorrow, Barbatash escaped from the Path compound on Dalna in a shuttle.

Dean was a young Force-sensitive human male whose family owned a shop on Arkanis. As a boy, he worked as a mechanic for the Hutt entrepenur Graballa on the planet Mustafar when the Hutt was attempting to develop a hotel within Fortress Vader, the former domain of the Dark Lord…
Baksan was a male Rutian Twi'lek seen on Batuu. He used the title "Mayor."
K-AKK was a female individual seen on Batuu.
Gra'la was a Rodian female seen on Batuu.
Sandala Fi was a female individual seen on Batuu.
Shark Goggle was an individual seen on Batuu.

Trot was a Lurmen male criminal who operated with Jega's Squad on the moon Nar Shaddaa. Trot had an inclination for removing limbs, often being held back from doing so by other members of the squad, to Trot's disappointment.
Kaj was a Chagrian female who resided on the moon Nar Shaddaa, and a member of Jega's Squad. She often scolded her friend Trot for his obsession with dismemberment.

Mareesee was a Volpai sniper who resided on Nar Shaddaa, working for Jega's Squad. When the droid bounty hunter 4-LOM—under the control of Doctor Cribiriz Idollax—attacked his partner, Zuckuss, outside of the establishment from which Mareesee's crew operated, the crew, includi…

Hormf was a Besalisk resident of the moon Nar Shaddaa and a member of Jega's Squad. The Besalisk and the other members of the crew, Mareesee, Trot, and Kaj, fought against the droid bounty hunter 4-LOM after he was rebuilt and controlled by Doctor Cribiriz Idollax to kill fell…

Sahm-Ken Feralo was a Cerean male who served as a senator in the Imperial Senate of the Galactic Empire. Senator Feralo was the father of Ko-Tun Feralo, a soldier of the Rebel Alliance who led a rebel cell with the military rank of quartermaster.

Khaleen Hentz was an individual who was the lover of the Kiffar Jedi Master Quinlan Vos. In 19 BBY, Supreme Chancellor and secret Sith Lord Darth Sidious commenced Order 66, a directive in the inhibitor chips of the Galactic Republic clone troopers, demanding the summary execu…

An individual worked as a chef at the food court of Skip 1, an asteroid of the Outer Rim's Smuggler's Run asteroid field. She held a galactic reputation during the smuggler Han Solo's first time at the food court.
Vuld Tansen was a former Imperial officer during the Galactic Civil War.

Ril Bezant was a Twi'lek female psychotherapist who worked at the Aurora Medical Facility on Obroa-skai. In 43 ABY, Bezant was part of Lial Sompa's team of doctors that worked to keep Tobb Jadak alive after his accident in Nar Shaddaa space in 19 BBY.

Erf was a Weequay male who worked for Rej Taunt. In 43 ABY, he and another Weequay working for Taunt accompanied Tobb Jadak and Flitcher Poste on a mission to Holess to capture a Colicoid with a connection to Taunt's rival, Lestra Oxic.

Noneen was a Human male who lived on Hijado. When Doctor Parlay Thorp arrived on Hijado to provide relief and medical assistance to the Hijadoans after the Galactic Empire had bombarded several cities on Hijado, Noneen greeted her and thanked her for her assistance.

Magan was a Human female who lived on Hijado. Like other Hijadoans, Magan was long-lived and was far more older than she appeared. When Doctor Parlay Thorp questioned the apparent lack of elderly people among the Hijadoans, Noneen told her that Magan was 101 years old.

Sonnds was a Human male from Hijado. Sonnds, like most Hijadoans, was long-lived and was far more older than she appeared. When Doctor Parlay Thorp called attention to the apparent lack of elderly people among the Hijadoans, Noneen informed her that Sonnds was 140 years old.

Nido was a Rodian male who resided on Vaced. In 43 ABY, Tobb Jadak and Flitcher Poste arrived on Vaced in search of Quip Fargil. They encountered Nido at the Vaced Spaceport and the Rodian gave the pair the directions to Fargil's cabin.
Druul was a Gran male who owned a droid shop on Vaced. In 43 ABY, Flitcher Poste purchased a slicer droid from Druul's droid shop in order to hijack the Millennium Falcon.
Kiardi was a male spacer. He was distinguished by his jowly facial features and single eye. Kiardi was present at the Triton Besh cantina when Shandy Fanaso visited it.

Drewen Qweebjillan was a Force-sensitive Segredo male who resided during the High Republic Era. While at Kul Kenada Spaceport on the Outer Rim astronomical object Blarrum, Drewen overheard about the monster hunter Ty Yorrick, who had been hired to capture an escaped gundark.

Lens Kamo was a human female treasure hunter alive on Batuu in 34 ABY. Her parents were history scholars, and she worked to keep certain treasures out of the wrong hands. She owned a Gergilla named Ayuu.

Scalder was a female human doctor and scientist who served under the Galactic Empire during the early days of the Imperial Era. As the Head Medical Officer, she had many responsibilities at the Empire's secret facility on Wayland, Tantiss Base.
During the early Imperial Era, a clone trooper served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper and technician.

Karre was a Force-sensitive human male clone who, like his twin sister, Am, was secretly created through the dark side of the Force and raised to become a Dark Lord of a remnant of the Galactic Empire known as the T-Empire.

Am was a Force-sensitive human female clone who, like her twin brother Karre, was created through advanced cloning technology and the dark side of the Force. The two were raised from birth to become Dark Lords of a remnant of the Galactic Empire known as the T-Empire.

Triv Blago was a Faust beast-trader who lived and operated during the High Republic Era. At one point, Blago hired the Tholothian saber-for-hire, monster hunter, and former Jedi Ty Yorrick to capture a gundark on Blarrum.
Ban'Ti was a male individual living around 34 ABY. Pirate Tara Rashin wanted him brought to her.
Shoola was a female Hutt and the owner of Port Tooga during the Galactic Civil War.
Roowarra was a male Wookiee. He was aboard Port Tooga when a group of spacers tried to purchase droids for the Rebellion.
Moheed was a Mon Calamari male who served as crew chief of the Alliance to Restore the Republic EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Shadow Raptor.
Lou, nicknamed "Shirtless Lou", was a human male stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. He was considered to be the last thing sent into combat zones, as he had the words "WE WON" painted on his belly.
Carana-Vey Trana was an Aki-Aki who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.

Faris Karan was a Theelin Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. On the astronomical object Blarrum in 231 BBY, the Theelin and her Master, Carana-Vey Trana, searched for the wanted beast-trader Triv Blago in Kul Kenada Spaceport.

Layton Wyke was a human male from Naratar who founded Wyke Town, a settlement on the Galactic Frontier astronomical object of Loreth. He was the uncle of Pela, who Wyke believed was too frightened and needed to toughen up in order to survive on the frontier.

A human male stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire wrote The Official Stormtrooper Training Manual, a handbook made to train stormtrooper cadets. The stormtrooper wrote the book between 4 ABY and 5 ABY, which talked about the importance of the Stormtrooper Corps.

Pela was a human female who resided in Wyke Town on the Galactic Frontier astronomical object Loreth during the High Republic Era. She was the niece of Layton Wyke, the community's founder, who believed she was often too frightened to survive on the frontier.

Tapel was a Boosodian who was an amateur archaeologist and a resident of Wyke Town on Loreth. After arriving on Loreth, Tapel discovered cave paintings within the mountain named Temple Peak of a creature known as a Gretalax, which the residents assumed were extinct.

Gil Jaretto was a human Jedi Master who was stationed on the waterworld Dubraib. In 231 BBY, he visited the Starlight Beacon space station and helped its staff handle a large brawl that was taking place.

F was a human female Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order. She trained under the Jedi Shad-Rah Varcanella, who was killed in 22 BBY at the Battle of Geonosis. After her master's death, F was traumatized and began wearing a mask to isolate herself.
"The Elder" was a human male Force-sensitive individual. This individual was speculated by Jedi Master Tajin Crosser to be a former member of the Sith who broke away prior to the Order's destruction.

A Pa'lowick attendant worked in the registration center of the Garkata Fighting Arena on the moon Nar Shaddaa in 3 ABY. They gave the bounty hunter Boba Fett information about the fights when he had decided to enter the events.

Tekrit was a humanoid who was in a bar on the moon Nar Shaddaa in 3 ABY, along with their partner Nalita. As Tekrit perused a list of bounties, he noticed one calling for the bounty hunter Boba Fett, who had just entered the bar.

Gronk was a Reigat who worked as a bodyguard for the black marketeer Burgo Teage. He traveled with Teage aboard the Vohai Unirail where he confronted the thief Sienn Sconn when he broke into Teage's cabin.
Kwiggley was a Bimm male junk dealer aboard Port Tooga during the Galactic Civil War.
Kog was a Human male and the first mate of Hura Kogler during an operation to place infiltration droids in the Alliance Fleet.
Keene was the intelligence officer of the Alliance to Restore the Republic EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Shadow Raptor.
Hastings was a lieutenant of the Alliance to Restore the Republic aboard the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Shadow Raptor.
Figlia was a Mirialan male and the communications officer of the Alliance to Restore the Republic EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Shadow Raptor.

"Brave stormtrooper" was the nickname of a human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. For the fourteenth anniversary of the Galactic Empire, the Brave stormtrooper was interviewed for Empire Today Volume IX, where they stated that Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine was usually a…
Duago was a Sullustan and the chief engineer of the Alliance to Restore the Republic EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Shadow Raptor.
Bonebark was a lizard owned by Hylo Sortuli during the Galactic Civil War.
Billdip was a Shatras outlaw tech aboard Port Tooga during the Galactic Civil War.
Aymus was a Weequay male aboard Port Tooga during the Galactic Civil War.

Goonral Monshi was a Latero Jedi Knight who operated during the High Republic Era and participated in the Assault on Mulita, where warriors of the Jedi Order and the Hutt Clan launched a joint offensive on the Great Progenitor and her Drengir progeny in the hopes of putting an…

A junior officer was stationed aboard the Imperial Navy Nebulon-B escort frigate Far Orbit. When part of the ship's crew mutinied, the junior officer remained loyal to Captain Vocis Kenit and was placed in an escape pod and blasted into space.
A companion traveled with the alien Zornak to the Forest Moon of Endor in 3 ABY. The alien assisted Zornak in rounding up the native Ewoks against their will, forcing them to gather gems for Zornak.

Mair Koda was an independent freighter captain and spacer who made a living transporting goods between the planets of the Zuni cluster. Koda grew up on the light freighter Blue Boy with her parents, until her mother ran off with a Wroonian smuggler.
Arn Stonelaw was a chorba farmer who lived on the planet Vernet. He was married to Emmi, and had two sons, Kristoff and Yuri.
Emmi Stonelaw was a chorba farmer who lived on the planet Vernet. She was married to Arn, and had two sons, Kristoff and Yuri.
Kristoff Stonelaw was a resident of the planet Vernet, the son of Arn and Emmi Stonelaw, the brother of Yuri Stonelaw, and foster brother of Mair Koda.

Yuri Stonelaw was a resident of the planet Vernet. He was the son of Arn and Emmi Stonelaw, the brother of Kristoff, and the foster brother of Mair Koda. After the Empire arrived on Vernet and conscripted Kristoff, Yuri resolved to rescue him.
Lorne Turvey was a bartender and part-time operator of the small spaceport in Maz-Verlin on the planet Vernet. He also requested holofeatures from Mair Koda on her trading runs.
Daoud Vari was a resident of the planet Vernet who had lost his legs. As a result, he was not conscripted by the Galactic Empire when they established a base on the world.
Persilla Turvey was a resident of the planet Vernet. She requested that Mair Koda bring her disks with the latest fashions on them on her trading runs, as well as a bolt of vine-silk.
Andrik Keller was an Er'Kit male Nihil marauder. He held the rank of Strike in the Tempest of Tempest Runner Lourna Dee, serving aboard the starship Lourna Dee.

Raleigh was a human technician who served the Galactic Republic aboard Relay Post Epsilon One. While overseeing the operation of the space station, Raleigh forgot to activate the Targes scanner, a device that warned of starships arriving from hyperspace.
During the Imperial Era, an archaeologist traveled to the planet Vandor looking for an ancient temple that she believed was buried beneath the Jirree Glacier.
A human male member of the Son-tuul Pride criminal syndicate attended Crimson Dawn's auction of the carbonite-frozen smuggler Han Solo at the planet Jekara.
Nan Zaizhou was a secretary to Nan Holi and a part of the Nan family. He was killed in 200 BBY,when the Vermilion Birds pirate gang, led by He Shan, attacked the ship Silver Dawn.
A human male assistant served Sith Lord Darth Vader on Coruscant shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. In 19 BBY, the servant approached the Sith while he was meditating in his chamber.

A clone of the Kaleesh general Grievous was created by the Sith Lord Count Dooku for his master Darth Sidious. The Grievous clone was part of an experiment on Kamino to create a clone army for the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Brisch was a Chiss male who served the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet, holding the rank of Lieutenant Commander. He served as a communications officer aboard the Springhawk, a heavy cruiser commanded by Senior Captain Thrawn.
Ovinon was a Chiss male of the Chiss Ascendancy's Krovi family who held the rank of Junior Captain in the Expansionary Defense Fleet.

Savina Besatrix "Sav" Malagán was a Kyuzo female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era, stationed at the Jedi Temple on Takodana. She wielded two purple-bladed lightsabers in combat, and wore brown Jedi robes and a Kyuzo war shield.

A male individual was the father of the human historian and Resistance member Beaumont Kin. During the First Order's blockade of the planet Kashyyyk, in 34 ABY, Kin claimed to the Nautolan Resistance pilot Daz Crano that his mother and father told him he was useless, which was…

Gen-Goma was a Talid male podracer who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic on the planet Tatooine. During one race, Gen-Goma took a wrong turn in the Dune-Pipes, which resulted in him spending his days floating in bacta.
An individual worked as a Senate Guard and was stationed at a door to the Grand Convocation Chamber on the planet Coruscant during an emergency session of the Galactic Senate in 19 BBY.
Tasia was a Cathar female marauder in the Nihil organization. She served as a Storm in the Tempest of Lourna Dee.
Jumpy was a clone trooper who served as a Clone Lieutenant in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He helped escorting a senator to the planet Rylorii Minor for a trade agreement.
Japhod Ngaric was the manager of the Lake Aire hotel. He was a friend of the private investigator Frrflin.

Lup was a human who served as the mayor of a mining planet in the Western Reaches, Rylorii Minor. During the Clone Wars, Mayor Lup and a senator of the Galactic Republic held a trade meeting on Rylorii Minor.
CT2 was the designation of a clone trooper of a unit within the Grand Army of the Republic.

Bareen Krill was a female Er'Kit pirate who was a member of the Nihil during the High Republic Era. Alongside her sister Sabata, Bareen was a member of a cell led by Krix Kamerat, a protégé of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro.

Sabata Krill was a female Er'Kit pirate who was part of the Nihil during the High Republic Era. Alongside her sister Bareen, Sabata was a member of a cell led by Krix Kamerat, the protégé of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro.

Boggs Triff was an Arcona male crime boss who led a mob on Nar Shaddaa. In 3 ABY, the bounty hunter IG-88 was hired to kill Triff. Years later, this incident was noted by Hondo Ohnaka in The Secrets of the Bounty Hunters.

Neeva was a Nobillian female who lived on Nar Shaddaa and had a younger brother Neevaan. After standing up to the crime boss Boggs Triff, Triff had Neevaan kidnapped. Neeva hired the bounty hunter IG-88 to kill Triff.

Gauge was a human male stormtrooper of the First Order who served as a lieutenant. During the First Order-Resistance War, Lieutenant Gauge operated on Batuu, serving as the leader of stormtroopers there.
Nooa was an Urodel Jedi Padawan during the High Republic Era. She was the apprentice of Jedi Knight Ady Sun'Zee and accompanied her Master to a training exercise on Valron.
Quin Carree was a Bivall female Nihil marauder and slicer who was a Cloud in the Tempest led by Tempest Runner Lourna Dee.
Ola Hest was an Ottegan criminal who lived during the High Republic Era. She spent thirty years working as an enforcer for the Hutts.
Jon Wittick was a human male who held the title of Councilor on the Galactic Republic prison ship Restitution.
Oliphan Dairo was a male individual who was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

Fry was a human counselor aboard the Galactic Republic prison ship Restitution during the High Republic Era. She worked alongside Councilor Jon Wittick, and was often more hostile toward the Restitution prisoners than her counterpart.

Charlie was a Jawa in the galactic classic book Charlie and the Droid Factory. In the tale, Charlie won the chance to tour a droid factory, as well as operating it later on. The story also featured Charlie coming into possession of an object known as The Golden Widget.
Buck was a tauntaun in the galactic classic book The Call of the Force. In the tale, Buck is saved from an abusive caretaker by a Jedi while on Hoth.

A Mon Calamari sailor was a major character in the galactic classic book The Count of Mon Calamari. In the tale, the sailor was imprisoned by the Quarren in an island, but later escaped by swimming away. Later, the sailor plotted revenge against the Quarren.
Ferlan was a Human female agent for the Imperial Security Bureau. She gained her position through family politics and favors.

A stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire was deployed to the planet Bogano between 0 ABY and 3 ABY during the Galactic Civil War. While attempting to smuggle native boglings off-world, the trooper was confronted by Rebel Alliance agents Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker.
Lina Naras was a female individual who served the Galactic Empire as the warden of an Imperial detention center on the planet Trivar II. She carried a stun baton.
Regald Coll was a human male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the time of the High Republic Era. He had a sense of humor that he believed was unappreciated by most other members of the Order.

Sslanno was a Trandoshan Nihil pirate who served in the Tempest led by Dowutin Tempest Runner Pan Eyta during the High Republic Era. By 231 BBY, Sslanno lost his scales, which did not grow back, in a plasma blast.

Jano Brayson was a Barolian Galactic Republic pilot in the Republic Defense Coalition. Flying a Z-29 Skyhawk, he was transferred into Firebird Squadron, where he met Teff, an old friend of his who had been assigned to the same squadron.
Teff was a Barolian pilot of the Republic Defense Coalition. He flew a Z-29 Skyhawk in Firebird Squadron, having been transferred from the Kolaador system.

Dal Azim was a human Jedi Padawan, who during the High Republic Era was apprenticed to the Thisspiasian Jedi Master Oppo Rancisis. Around 255 BBY, he assisted Rancisis on a mission to the planet Zygerria, where they attacked a Zygerrian Alliance camp.

Nima Allets was a human Jedi youngling during the High Republic Era. She was stationed on the planet Banchii, under the supervision of Jedi Master Arkoff and Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi, and was best friends with the Togruta youngling Viv'Nia Nia'Viv.

Inun was a Twi'lek male who lived on the Ryloth colony planet Aaloth as a member of the world's lead family. He had two older sisters, Haleena and Lourna Dee. Inun and Dee rode blurrgs on the Sal Plains, though Dee was injured.

An individual was the grandfather of First Order stormtrooper CG-412. During the First Order occupation of the planet Batuu CG-412 remarked to LA-233 that there could be worse places to be stationed on then Batuu and recalled how his grandfather used to say that it was better …
Darth Quellus was a Dark Lord of the Sith who served the Sith Empire. The Sith Lord was dispatched as an emissary to Aaloth, a Twi'lek colony alongside his Sith minions to conquer the planet.

Viv'Nia Nia'Viv was a Togruta Jedi youngling who was stationed at the Jedi temple on Banchii during the High Republic Era. She was best friends with fellow youngling Nima Allets. Nia'Viv wielded a single-bladed blue training lightsaber.
Keerin Fionn was a human male Jedi Padawan who was the apprentice of Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi during the High Republic Era. Along with his master, Fionn was stationed at the Jedi temple on Banchii.
Ru-Ru was an Imroosian female Jedi archivist stationed at the Jedi temple on Banchii during the High Republic Era.

Zaret was a human male who served as a spy for the Nihil pirates on the planet Banchii. Undercover as a farmer, Zaret aided the settler Kooba in bringing a container of Drengir seeds to Banchii, which resulted in Kooba's death and an attack on the local Jedi temple.

Silar was a human doctor who was stationed on the planet Banchii by the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. Stationed at the local Jedi temple, Silar worked alongside the Jedi stationed there to help care for Banchii's settlers.

Kooba was a human male farmer who settled on the Outer Rim Territories planet Banchii during the High Republic Era. Before arriving on Banchii, he was given a container of seeds originating from the Drengir, a species of hostile, sentient carnivorous plants.

Kani was a Hutt who was a member of the Grand Hutt Council during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Kani and the rest of the Council was invited to a auction on the planet Jekara for the carbonite encased body of Han Solo that was hosted by the returning Crimson Dawn…

Agon was an individual who lived on the planet Ridlay during the time of the Clone Wars. In one of the planet's total eclipses—which occurred every fifty years, bringing with it the appearance of beings that Ridlay's inhabitants believed to be ghosts—the beings instead attacke…
An individual led a group of the resident species on the planet Ridlay. The leader had been alive for the total eclipse on Ridlay fifty years before the following one during the Clone Wars.

Crob Vel was a Gamorrean criminal who dealt in illicit merchandise. Vel hired the bounty hunter Boba Fett, who owed him a debt, to delay the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca in bringing him a delivery so that he could then force Solo to continue working for him to make up for it.
Sine Spenning was a news anchor for the galaxy-wide news organization, GoNet. He was most known for his extravagant style of clothing as well as his extreme teeth.

Deej was an Ewok male. They and another Ewok were the parents of four children: Weechee, Widdle Warrick, Wicket Wystri Warrick, and Winda. One winter between 1 BBY and 4 ABY, Deej went with a hunting party and brought essential supplies back to Bright Tree tribe.

Wicket's mother was an Ewok female. They and the Ewok Deej were the parents of four children: Weechee, Widdle Warrick, Wicket Wystri Warrick, and Winda. The mother encouraged Wicket to try new foods and spent time with their family in Bright Tree Village.
Brene was one of several Ubese exiles who were part of a bounty hunter crew led by Boushh. After Boushh rescued her from a rancor, she was the first member to join him.

Hareck was a male Ubese bounty hunter who was married to Ilini, a non-binary Ubese. After Ilini killed their own father, Hareck helped them hide the body. The exiled couple became members of Boushh's crew.
Ilini was a non-binary Ubese bounty hunter who was married to Hareck. The couple was exiled from Uba IV after Ilini killed their own father. Ilini and Hareck joined Boushh's crew of Ubese exiles.

A Human male member of the Rebel Alliance. In 0 ABY, the individual was stationed on Yavin base and questioned the Imperial assassin X-7, who was using the alias of S'ree Bonard, when he landed on Yavin 4.
Retar was an Ardennian technician who served as a delegate for the Ardennian Guild of Technicians during the High Republic Era.
Gidameen was a Jedi Master during the High Republic Era. Gidameen taught Stellan Gios when the latter was a Jedi Initiate and was known for their strict requirements.

An officer served as a clone stormtrooper within the Galactic Empire's 203rd Division. Shortly following the Cleansing of New Plympto, the officer and the 203rd were stationed at a spaceport and blocking any civilian ships from leaving.

Lah Kara was a Force-sensitive human female who was the daughter of the legendary sabersmith Lah Zhima. The two lived together in their home on the planet Hy Izlan, and when Margrave Juro attempted to revive the Jedi Order, Zhima created several lightsabers for him.

A stormtrooper captain served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, the captain, along with the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader, led a company of stormtroopers during a mission to the moon Kalakar Six.
Darpik was a Mon Calamari female who served as the captain of the Rebel Alliance Navy transport Freedom Fighter.

Myra Talcon was a human female who served as a lieutenant in the Alliance Military. During the evacuation of Yavin 4 following the Rebel Alliance victory at the Battle of Yavin, Lieutenant Talcon was an officer on duty and coordinated Base One's defenses while coordinating wit…

Rieve was a Force-sensitive human female from the Core Worlds planet Corellia. After the fall of the Galactic Empire, she fought in the Hunters of the Outer Rim tournament in the Grand Arena on Vespaara, where she affected a Sith Lord persona during competition.
Aran Tal was a human male Mandalorian who was active on Vespaara, where he fought in the Grand Arena in the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition.
Ares Ginn was a male individual who served as a commander in the Alliance Army. After evacuating from Yavin 4 on the Freedom Fighter, he became the senior army officer onboard.

Grozz was a Wookiee warrior and athlete active following the fall of the Galactic Empire. Grozz was a professional huttballer, but he eventually became a Hunter in the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition on the Outer Rim planet Vespaara.

Zaina was a human veteran of the Rebel Alliance and a member of the New Republic following the fall of the Galactic Empire. She wielded a blaster pistol and possessed cybernetic legs. She participated in the Hunters of the Outer Rim tournament on the planet Vespaara.
Imara Vex was a human female bounty hunter who was active from the reign of the Galactic Empire through to the time of the New Republic.

Dizzy was an Ugnaught adrenaline-junkie joyrider active in the Hunters of the Outer Rim tournament at the Grand Arena on the planet Vespaara following the fall of the Galactic Empire. Reveling in roadkill, Dizzy operated a modified droideka.

A Segredo male was the brother of Drewen Qweebjillan. When marauders attacked their village, Drewen and his brother were among those strong enough to work who captured and taken aboard the raiders' starship.

Illaga was a male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. On one occasion, Illaga showed Jedi Padawan Klias Teradine the teachings of Sabracci Sages, a group of Zeffonian Force users, including the ability to use the Force to stand on a vertical surface, af…
Kouru was a female alien Sith and self-styled Dark Lord who led a gang of bandits twenty years after her participation in the failed Sith rebellion. Her gang attacked a village for loot and plunder.

A humanoid Force-sensitive served as an Inquisitor in the time following Order 66, hunting down the Jedi that remained. The Inquisitor wore a set of black armor with a cape and wielded a standard red-bladed lightsaber.

Silas Tagge was a human male scientist who served as Head of Weapons Development at the Tagge Corporation during the Galactic Civil War. A member of the House of Tagge, he was an older brother of Domina Tagge, who chaired the company.

Orman Tagge was a human male who served as Head of Manufacturing at the Tagge Corporation during the Galactic Civil War. A scion of the House of Tagge, he was an older brother of Domina Tagge, who helmed the company. Orman wore goggles or other over-eye instruments.

Ulric Tagge was a human male who served as Head of Public Relations and Messaging at the Tagge Corporation during the Galactic Civil War. A member of the House of Tagge, he was an older brother of Domina Tagge, who sat at the head of the company.

Zadina Mkampa was a human female doctor and a member of the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era. Mkampa possessed a cybernetic left arm, with the left side of the doctor's head also having been replaced by cybernetics.

Brace Tagge-Faulken was a human Imperial officer and member of the House of Tagge during the Galactic Civil War. Brace shared a hyphenated last name with the Head of Talent Acquisition Layla Tagge-Faulken.

Layla Tagge-Faulken was a human member of the House of Tagge who served as the Tagge Corporation's Head of Talent Acquisition during the Galactic Civil War. Layla shared a hyphenated last name with Imperial officer Brace Tagge-Faulken.
Adelaide Tagge was a human member of the House of Tagge who served as one of the Tagge Corporation's two Heads of Finance during the Galactic Civil War.
Felix Tagge was a human member of the House of Tagge who served as one of the Tagge Corporation's two Heads of Finance during the Galactic Civil War.

A male individual was the father of the Ubese Ilini and lived on the planet Uba IV. By 2 BBY, they were killed by Ilini, who then hid the body with help from their spouse Hareck. The incident caused the two to be exiled from Uba IV.
Deek was a male individual who lived on Batuu. Although he planned to become business partners with Dok-Ondar, the two of them became rivals.

Breet was a Rybet who was a member of Pan Eyta's Tempest of the Nihil, serving aboard Eyta's flagship Elegencia. In 231 BBY, during the Nihil's attack on the planet Valo, Breet reported a call from the Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro to Eyta.
Forthe was a human male member of the House of Tagge and an employee of Tagge Corporation during the Galactic Civil War. Forthe's mother was TaggeCo's Head of Talent Acquisition Layla Tagge-Faulken.
Betsy was a female carrion spat owned by the miner Volo Madine during the Galactic Civil War.

A human served as lieutenant of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, he believed he had found Luke Skywalker and called Darth Vader to capture him. The human male he thought to be Skywalker, however, was a double of him, and Vader scolded the lieutenant for wasting his time.

Zarabarb was a Gran male member of the Nihil. In 231 BBY, during the Nihil's attack on the planet Valo, Zarabarb headed to the prison cell where Ty Yorrick, Ram Jomaram, and Mantessa Chekkat were being held.
Ayuu was a male gergilla owned by the treasure hunter Lens Kamo. While attempting to escape the laboratory of Baron Yasto Attsmun, he was injured and captured by the baron.

Zevaas Tellaan was a Chagrian who served as a foreman in the Balmorran Arms Factory on the planet Balmorra while the planet was occupied by the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Zerot was the first male to establish a permanent settlement at an oasis, which eventually became known as The Puddle. The rocky outcropping jutting into the oasis was named after him, becoming Zerot's Point.
LB-1033 was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.
Vin Larel was a captain serving in Alliance Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War. Larel was promoted and transferred from a line grunt to command of an outpost on an artic planet.

An individual served as head of the Tagge Corporation operated by the House of Tagge. During their time as head of the company, the individual created a replication of a Jedi lightsaber. By 3 ABY, Lady Domina Tagge served as the leader of Tagge Corporation.
Trinia was a female individual who served as one of the leaders of the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate alongside Qi'ra and Margo.
A Bith male lived on the planet Monta during the Clone Wars. He was killed during the Monta Massacre, but according to legend, he and the other victims' ghosts returned every Life Day.
Vane Sarpo was a Vuman male trader who operated during the High Republic Era. Originally a mercenary, Sarpo fought alongside the Soikan Velko Jahen in the civil war on Soika.
Clune was a Peasle female who was a trader, working with Vane Sarpo aboard the starship Rapscallion's Heart. Though Sarpo claimed to only be a trader, the two ran weapons for the Nihil marauders.
Homen was a male Jedi who lived without a Jedi Master in a time long after the fall of the Jedi Order.

A human male child was the village chief of a village located on the planet Genbara in the Outer Rim Territories. The village was attacked by Sith bandits approximately two decades after the Sith rebellion against the Empire.

Jee Ken Tsokee, known by the nickname Jay, was a Force-sensitive human male former Jedi Padawan and singer following the Clone Wars. After escaping Order 66 during a Clone Wars battle, he was found by Hutt guitarist Geezer Odajion.

Geezer Odajion, nicknamed "Gee," was a male Hutt musician during and after the Clone Wars. He was a flaming rumble bass guitarist for the band Star Waver. Some time after the Clone Wars, his uncle Jabba Desilijic Tiure put out a bounty on Odajion.
Lan Ar-Shoo nicknamed Lan, was a male individual of a multi-torsoed species and drummer for the band Star Waver. Lan played the versatile cluster drums.

Hanbei was a male alien who served who served as an acolyte of the Sith during an era of war. Long after 35 ABY, Hanbei was one of several Sith who posed as masterless Jedi that were summoned to the Aerial Temple above the planet Hy Izlan by Margrave Juro, who sought to provid…
Roden was a Force-sensitive human male who served the Sith in a time after the fall of the Jedi Order.

Niizo was a female individual who served the Sith in a time after the fall of the Jedi Order. Niizo posed as one of several masterless Jedi that were summoned to the Aerial Temple of Hy Izlan by Margrave Juro, who sought to provide lightsabers to the Jedi and restore the Jedi …

A Sullustan teahouse shopkeep lived in a village located ön planet Genbara in the Outer Rim Territories. The village was attacked by Sith bandits approximately two decades after the Sith rebellion against the Empire.
Tajin Crosser, a Force-sensitive human male, was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the Republic Era.

Zero, previously known as Shad-Rah Varcanella was a Jedi Master active prior to the Clone Wars who at one point took on F as his apprentice. He had roots on the planet Keelia and was acquainted with the explorer Valco. He died during the the First Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY.
Ochō was a human female who lived on the Outer Rim planet Tao during the Imperial Era, and the daughter of a powerful crime family. Her father was Yasaburō.
Senza Mulak was a female Pantoran who attended the Republic Fair on Valo around 231 BBY.
Valco was a human male who was an explorer during the Imperial Era. He was an ally of the fugitive Jedi F, having been a friend of her Jedi Master, Shad-Rah.
A Trandoshan male bounty hunter served as a hired guard commander for a village on the Outer Rim planet Genbara two decades after the failed Sith rebellion.

Izuma was a humanoid male warlord who led a band of raiders that operated in the Outer Rim. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, between 19 BBY and 1 BBY, the raiders found and reprogrammed B1-series battle droids on the planet Keelia, which they used to form an army.
Misa was a human female princess and a royal family member.
AM-501 was a human female stormtrooper who served the First Order.
CP-3643 was a male individual who served the First Order.
ST-307 was a human female stormtrooper who served the First Order.
RY-1618 was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.
BJ-7567 was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.
MM-0228 was a human female stormtrooper who served the First Order.
RR-3142 was a human female stormtrooper who served the First Order.

ZC-1140 was a human stormtrooper who served the First Order. The trooper was stationed at a First Order re-education facility on the planet Batuu, where the trooper believed the local Batuuans needed a slight push to see the truth of the First Order.
JE-1564 was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.
JS-327 was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.
Mitaka was a professor and a Jedi-in-hiding during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Denis was a human male who worked as an attendant on the Innovator at the Republic Fair on Valo 231 BBY.
Leesa was a human female who worked as an attendant on the Innovator at the Republic Fair on Valo in 231 BBY.
HH-012 was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.
JN-411 was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.

Masago was a female human Sith Lord and a royal family member. For some time, she kept her Sith nature in hiding, until finally revealing it by killing her brother, the king, when an opportune moment presented itself. After overthrowing the king, Masago took power for herself.
Kamahachi was a human male travel guide. Along with Senshu, he helped Princess Misa and Jedi Knight Tsubaki reach a royal palace that the princess had been exiled from.
Senshu was a human male travel guide. Along with Kamahachi, he helped Princess Misa and Jedi Knight Tsubaki reach a royal palace that the princess had been exiled from.
Tsubaki a Force-sensitive human male, was a Jedi Knight that fell to the dark side of the Force and became a Sith apprentice. His master was the Sith Lord Masago.
Lah Zhima was a Force-sensitive human male sabersmith who worked for Margrave Juro on the world of Hy Izlan, where he raised a daughter, Lah Kara.
JW-6648 was an individual who served the First Order.

Yasaburō was a Force-sensitive human male who lived on Tao during the Imperial Era, and the leader of a powerful organization. His daughter was Ochō. Ochō befriended a runaway Lepi slave named Lop and convinced Yasaburō to take her into their family.

An individual was a human member of the Yasaburō clan on the planet Tao at some point between 12 BBY and 1 BBY during the Imperial Era. After an attack on Tao's Imperial base led by the clan's leader Yasaburō, his daughter Ochō argued with him over his attack against the Empire.

An individual was a human male in the service of Yasaburō and his clan on the planet Tao during the Galactic Civil War. The clan member was one of many men who participated in a terrorist attack against the Galactic Empire's presence on Tao, led by Yasaburō.
Haru was a Force-sensitive female human who lived in Meevai Village on Keelia between 19 BBY and 1 BBY. She was the granddaughter of the then village chief, and had a sister named Saku.
Saku was a female human who lived in Meevai Village on Keelia sometime after the Clone Wars. She was the granddaughter of the then village chief, and had a sister called Haru.
Asu was a Force-sensitive male human who lived in Meevai Village on Keelia sometime after the Clone Wars. He was married to Haru.

Hen Jin was a male individual who served the Sith in a time after the fall of the Jedi Order. Hen Jin posed as one of several masterless Jedi that were summoned to the Aerial Temple of Hy Izlan by Margrave Juro, who sought to provide lightsabers to the Jedi and restore the Jed…

Toguro was a male individual who served the Sith in a time after the fall of the Jedi Order. Toguro posed as one of several masterless Jedi that were summoned to the Aerial Temple of Hy Izlan by Margrave Juro, who sought to provide lightsabers to the Jedi and restore the Jedi …

Ethan was a human male Jedi who had no master. When he was contacted by Margrave Juro, who was seeking to revive the Jedi Order, Ethan traveled to Hy Izlan, where he met six other Jedi who were waiting to receive lightsabers crafted by the legendary sabersmith Lah Zhima.

Acle was a Pathfinder serving in the Alliance Special Forces. Acle was assigned to Team Razor, and was part of the team that established Outpost Cinder. The commanding Major assigned Acle to set up covering positions for the base.

Henle was a Pathfinder serving in the Alliance Special Forces. Henle was assigned to Team Razor, and was part of the team that established Outpost Cinder. The commanding Major ordered Jal to take Henle and another trooper to establish a retrieval plan.

Razke was a Pathfinder serving in the Alliance Special Forces. Razke was assigned to Team Razor, and was part of the team that established Outpost Cinder. The commanding Major ordered Razke to set up the outpost's command center.

Reku was a Pathfinder serving in the Alliance Special Forces. Reku was assigned to Team Razor, and was part of the team that established Outpost Cinder. The commanding Major ordered Reku to locate suitable spots for surveillance posts.
Tel Terlou was a major in Division Three of the Imperial Taxation Bureau. Terlou led a security briefing regarding smuggling and black market operations at Estaria Central Starport.

A human male served as an admiral in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau. Between 12 BBY and 1 BBY, he became aware of terrorist plans made by Yasaburō, the leader of the Yasaburō clan on the planet Tao.

The Traveler, nicknamed Fox and formerly known as Idzuna, was a Force-sensitive non-binary alien who lived in the time following the Sith rebellion. A musician and storyteller, the Traveler concealed their face with a white vulpine mask.

A male individual served as emperor of the Empire after the Sith rebellion. He had multiple siblings who allowed him to rise to power because the Empire was controlled by various clan lords rather than the Emperor.
Hazziz was a Cyclorrian who worked as a shipmaster at the Cyclor Shipyards during the High Republic Era.

A female Sith witch participated in the Sith rebellion alongside the Dark Lord. The witch resurrected the dead before they could join the Force, making them fight for the Sith in an army of Sith demons.
A Dug male bounty hunter served as a hired guard for a village on the Outer Rim planet Genbara two decades after the failed Sith rebellion.
A Gran male bounty hunter served as a hired guard for a village on the Outer Rim planet Genbara two decades after the failed Sith rebellion.
A male Tusken Raider bounty hunter served as a hired guard for a village on the Outer Rim planet Genbara twenty years after the failed Sith rebellion.

Nittel Karkson, nicknamed "Nit," was a young Gotal male who lived on Coruscant level 4000 with his grandmother during the High Republic Era. Karkson was extremely poor and, as a result, turned to thievery to support himself and his grandmother.
Strok was an individual who was served as a captain in the Final Order fleet and helmed the Xyston-class Star Destroyer Sutta.
A lord of the Empire at one point held power over the Genbara system in the Outer Rim. Posters in the Osou spaceport on Genbara proclaimed the lord's glory and that of his favored prince.
An individual served as the manager of the palace on the planet Alderaan prior to its destruction by the Galactic Empire.
A Rutian Twi'lek rebel served as a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic after the Battle of Hoth aboard the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Redemption.

Pax was an ARF trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic that was active during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist Alliance. In 21 BBY, the clone trooper accompanied Jedi General Mace Windu's Lightning Squadron on a mission to the planet Ridlay.

This Diamalan male individual was the aide of Diamal Senator Porolo Miatamia. During the Caamas Document Crisis, Miatamia and his aide were stranded on the planet Cilpar when their starship berth was blockaded by angry protestors.
Farks was a Patrolian who lived during the High Republic Era. A friend of the pirate queen Maz Kanata, Farks gave her a vonduun crab skull from Zav Alox which Kanata kept in her castle on Takodana.
Kaktorf was a Jedi Master who was the Master of the Kyuzo Savina Besatrix Malagán and head of the Jedi Temple on Takodana during the High Republic Era.

The father of Kylia Stryder, who was a Rebel Alliance operative, was a male human commander of the Galactic Empire in the Anoat sector. Unbeknownst to him, his daughter—his pride and joy—had been recruited by the rebels while she was still a teenager.
A male individual served as an Imperial officer within the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. The officer was in command of a listening post hidden near Esseles.
Torkil Mux was an Arcona individual who was a pilot.

A human girl lived on a world during the conflict between the First Order and Resistance. Between 34 ABY and 35 ABY, the human, alongside others, opposed the First Order's invasion of her world, ultimately coming into direct confrontation with the Order's Supreme Leader Kylo Ren.

A Chiss male served as Patriarch of the Xodlak family, one of the Forty Great Families of the Chiss Ascendancy, during the Nikardun campaigns. The Patriarch managed the Xodlak family's affairs from their homestead on the Chiss homeworld and capital planet of Csilla.
Lepira was a human who served as a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Gold Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.

A Force-sensitive human served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order. Hundreds of years before the Imperial Era, the Jedi traveled to the planet Tao, where he gave his lightsaber to a member of the Yasaburō clan and taught them how to wield it.

A human member of the Yasaburō clan was a native of the planet Tao. Hundreds of years before the Imperial Era, they met a Jedi, who entrusted his lightsaber to the clan member and trained them to use it.

Mirahi was the Force-sensitive daughter of the former Sith wanderer known as the Ronin and the Sith witch who had been his lover during the Sith rebellion. Within a year after the rebellion ended, Mirahi was born on Rei'izu, a planet that had been removed from space.

Yuehiro was a Force-sensitive Twi'lek trans male who was adopted into the Jedi clan led by the Jedi lord Hanrai. As a curious fourteen-year-old apprentice, Yuehiro was not satisfied when higher ranked members of Hanrai's clan would not address the rumors about the Sith demons.

Shogo was a trans male individual from the planet Rei'izu who, as a youngling, was taken by the Sith to become a trooper. Ekiya, a female who shared Shogo's homeworld, became close to him during that time. On the pair's first mission, their commander shattered Shogo's knee.

Ruusstha Vidyarvrikt was an elderly Ongree female Jedi nursemaid from Dalna who served the Jedi Order. The Ongree often sang a nursery rhyme to Jedi younglings who would not go to sleep in an attempt to make them be well behaved.

Ekiya, occasionally nicknamed Kiya, was a female individual from the planet Rei'izu. When she was fourteen years old, the Sith conquered her homeworld and she was conscripted to serve as a trooper in the Sith rebellion; she would later say she must have looked strong enough to…

Chie was a female individual who was an aunty by the time that twenty years had passed since the Sith rebellion. She worked as a bounty hunter and claimed to only take jobs that involved fighting Jedi knights.

Keefar Branto was a human male former criminal who lived during the High Republic Era. Becoming involved in numerous forms of crime, including gun-running, bounty hunting, and a brief stint as a member of the Nihil, Branto eventually attempted to turn over a new leaf, and was …

Urk Panga was a Narquois criminal active during the High Republic Era. Keefar Branto, a criminal who was looking to reform, ingratiated himself with Panga to work on a case, attempting to find out what Panga was up to.
Mitth'omo'rossodo, known by her core name Thomoro and the appellation "the Tragic". She was earlier known as Mitth'omo'ross before she was honored with the Stybla honorific "odo".
The Oracle was a female information merchant and an old friend of Nath Tensent's. Nath sold her information in exchange for the location of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Hargus was an old employer of Nath Tensent when he was escorting and defending cargo ships with his fighter.
Ibti Myrak was a Vurk pilot who held the position of Rogue Five in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Rogue Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
An ensign served on the New Republic's Star Destroyer Deliverance and once had a date with Stornvein.

A Houk was lived on DN-949A outpost on the planet Netalych and asked Yrica Quell and her team for help to get credits for its broken ship and leave the planet. Later the Houk helped Chass na Chadic and Kairos to find Quell.
A human male was the father of the New Republic pilot Vitale. He was a radio operator when he was young.
A human female was the mother of the New Republic pilot Vitale. Vitale was told that her mother had a hard time withstanding aging.
A man was the brother of the New Republic pilot Hadrios who lived on the planet Corellia.

Muglan Tarantyne was a Gloovan female criminal who lived during the High Republic Era. After being arrested, Muglan was a sent to the Galactic Republic prison ship Restitution, where she, along with fellow prisoner Parr, served as a bodyguard to Ola Hest.
Isla Mantra was a pilot who flew under the callsign Rogue Two in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Rogue Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Lyle Kullan was a human pilot who was a spy for the Galactic Empire. After infiltrating Rogue Squadron, Kullan flew under the callsign Rogue Four during the Galactic Civil War.
Hanrai was a male Jedi knight who became a Jedi lord after the planet Rei'izu disappeared in the wake of the Sith rebellion. He led his clan at his home estate on Watoru.

A serving droid worked in a bar on Sran in the Ash Worlds. He served Nihil Strike Andrik Keller who sought to rescue Tempest Runner Lourna Dee from Republic captivity. Also among his patrons was former Tempest Runner Pan Eyta, who sought revenge on Dee for betraying him.
Haleena was a Twi'lek female who lived on the Ryloth colony planet Aaloth as a member of the world's lead family.

A human female was enslaved by the Zygerrian Alliance during the High Republic Era. While held at a Zygerrian camp, the woman contracted a disease from a Gamorrean sow and was declared by the Zygerrian enslavers to be lowering the value of the other "merchandise." The Keeper V…
Parr was an Aqualish prisoner and associate of Ola Hest aboard the prison ship Restitution during the High Republic Era.

Sestin Blin was a Twi'lek who was imprisoned aboard the prison ship Restitution during the High Republic Era. After Nihil Tempest Runner Lourna Dee was imprisoned on the Restitution, Sestin bonded with her fellow Twi'lek over the bad taste of protein mash served to the inmates.

A Morseerian male was the communicator of the New Republic Star Destroyer Deliverance and the brother of the Flare Squadron pilot Lourgh T'oknell. During the Battle of Jakku the Morseerian helped Wyl Lark sending conciliator messages to the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Yudiah Dee was a Twi'lek male who ruled the Ryloth colony planet Aaloth as Keeper and a member of the world's lead family during the High Republic Era. Yudiah was the father of Inun, Haleena, and Lourna Dee.

Bala Waleen was a Twi'lek spicerunner and merchant who staged a coup and usurped rule of the Ryloth colony planet Aaloth during the High Republic Era. He was the lover of Lourna Dee, whose father Yudiah Dee was the Keeper of Aaloth prior to Bala's coup.

Kalla Secaria was a Twi'lek who served as Captain of the Guard for the Palace Guard of the planet Aaloth during the High Republic Era. Secaria helped Bala Waleen stage a coup d'état and seize power as that planet's Keeper.

Reese was a human captain of the Galactic Republic who administered the Carida Military Academy during the High Republic Era. He welcomed Jedi Master Oppo Rancisis and the Twi'lek Lourna Dee when she enrolled in the academy.
Silus was a male individual who was one of two sons of Sestin Blin. Her other son was Ita.
Ita was a male individual who was one of two sons of Sestin Blin. Her other son was Silus.
Lalutin was a Selkath male administrator and emissary of the Galactic Republic on the forest planet Arbra during the High Republic Era.
Wilson was a human administrator of the Galactic Republic on Coruscant during the High Republic Era. He trained diplomats.

Zalem was a Dathomirian Zabrak female who was native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Dathomir. They were the Clan Mother of the Nightsister coven of witches. Her successor was Mother Talzin, who took over after they were killed by Jedi Master Quinlan Vos, by 50 BBY.
Towl was a Nikto Nihil Strike who served under the Storm Jinnix in Pan Eyta's Tempest. He was killed by the Twi'lek mercenary Lourna Dee during the raid in the Abrion sector.
Jinnix was a Colicoid Nihil Storm serving in Pan Eyta's Tempest. Jinnix led a Storm of Eyta's Tempest that raided a shipment of glitterstim in the Abrion sector.
A Colicoid drone-mate of the Colicoid Jinnix lived during the High Republic Era. By 252 BBY, the carnivorous hueche attacked their nest, and the drone-mate failed to protect the queen.
A student of the Graf Archive found a series of maps, which were collected and published as the Galactic Atlas, by Gammit Chond within the Shadow Stacks on the moon Orchis 2.
Boona was a Twi'lek who worked for Keeper Bala Waleen of Aaloth during the High Republic Era. He was killed when the Nihil ship Elegencia attacked the planet.
Delan was a Twi'lek who worked for Keeper Bala Waleen of Aaloth during the High Republic Era.
Sneef was a male Arconan bar patron on Nurasenti during the High Republic Era.
A bar patron was present in a bar on Nurasenti during the High Republic Era. He made bets against Sneef on the outcome of a brawl between Lourna Dee and a Holwuff berserker.
A Holwuff berserker was present in a bar on Nurasenti during the High Republic Era. They fought the Twi'lek mercenary Lourna Dee and died in the fight.

Leela was a female prisoner aboard the Galactic Republic prison ship Restitution in the High Republic Era. She sang the nursery rhyme with the refrain "shrii ka rai ka rai" for two days straight while Lourna Dee was in the sickbay.
A Colicoid female was the queen of a nest which included the Colicoid Jinnix and his drone-mate. By 252 BBY, the nest was attacked by hueches, and Jinnix's drone-mate failed to protect the queen.
A female individual who lived during the High Republic Era was the sister of the human male Jon Wittick. By 231 BBY, they had at least two children, including a son.

Xanaven was a Frong Nihil pirate who, after Eye Asgar Ro asked him to, served as Tempest Runner of his own Tempest during the High Republic Era. He was killed and replaced by the Twi'lek Lourna Dee at the Great Hall of the Nihil.

During the battle, after Ribeiro coolly ordered her second-in-command, Lieutenant Malena, the two formed a protective screen over the entrance of the second Death Star space station's superstructure to prevent TIE fighters from pursuing those inside.

Faie was a human clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic with the military rank of Clone Commander. Serving in the unit of Jedi General Quinlan Vos, Commander Faie's by-the-book and no-nonsense approach aggravated his Jedi superior.

Gor Jolda was a Nikto who was a low-level member of a gang during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Around 3643 BBY, Jolda sought to recruit someone outside of his gang to make a delivery.

Sul Fansord was a human who served as a member of Saw Gerrera's Partisans on the moon Jedha. In 1 BBY, they were part of the Partisan forces that ambushed an Imperial TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank carrying kyber crystals through Tythoni Square in Jedha City, signa…

Kyuu was a male tooka cat who lived in the time after the Sith rebellion. He belonged to the Traveler when they were a Jedi knight serving Hanrai. Kyuu remained behind with Hanrai when the Traveler was sent to Rei'izu and disappeared on their mission.

"The Archivist," formerly known as Madelin Sun, was a human female Force-sensitive individual who was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. She was once a sava at the University of Bar'leth.

Twenty years after the Sith rebellion, a female individual who was old enough to be an aunty carried an apothecary chest on her back as she walked to Osou on the Outer Rim planet Genbara.

Nakirre was a Kilji who held the title of generalirius, and ruled the Unknown Regions Kilji Illumine, the nation of the Kilji species.

A Kanjiklub chief obtained the Smuggler's Guide from lieutenant Razoo Qin-Fee. However, the Smuggler's Guide was stolen from the chief by the Master Codebreaker in the middle of negotiations for the domination of Rim territories on Cantonica.

Irizi'fife'rencpok, known by the core name Zififerenc, was a Chiss who served as the Patriarch of the Irizi family, one of the Nine Ruling Families of the Chiss Ascendancy, during the Nikardun campaigns.

A Kilji known as "Vassal One" served the Kilji nation of the Kilji Illumine as a Kilji vassal, a follower of the Illumine's religious beliefs. In 18 BBY, he served as a pilot aboard Illumine Generalirius Nakirre's Kilji war cruiser Whetstone.

Till-ee was a Mirialan member of the Jedi Order and sibling to fellow Jedi Sidn-ee. During the First Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY, the siblings were the first to reach the outskirts of the Trade Federation's landing zones on the planet, but were unable to prevent the Federatio…

Sidn-ee was a Mirialan Jedi who served the Jedi Order alongside their sibling, Jedi Till-ee. In 22 BBY, at the outbreak of the Clone Wars during the First Battle of Geonosis, the siblings were part of the assault team led by Jedi Master Mace Windu to the planet Geonosis.

Lyssa Votz was a human female Jedi Knight who served as the Jedi archivist of the Jedi temple on the planet Dalna. Votz did not crave adventure or excitement and disliked fighting. She frequently forgot her lightsaber, preferring to instead carry a datapad with her at all times.
Yacek Sparkburn was a human male Jedi Knight who served at the Dalna Jedi temple during the High Republic Era while he was in his early twenties.

Nyla Quinn was a Twi'lek female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. She served as the Master of the Jedi temple on the planet Dalna. Kind and wizened, Quinn did her best to help the people of Dalna despite their suspicion of Jedi.

An elderly male individual who was addressed as an uncle drove a sputtering landspeeder on a particular day, twenty years after the Sith rebellion, when he was traveling to Osou on the Outer Rim planet Genbara.
Arathab Fal was a Tarnab male who was a wanted murderer during the High Republic Era.

Jerserra's master was a female Inquisitor. She was on Dathomir some years after the Formation of the Galactic Empire. There, she discovered Jerserra, a teenaged Dathomirian witch, and a member of the Nardithi Nightsisters.
Jyala Haydenn was a human Imperial officer who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire aboard the Executor, the flagship of Darth Vader, during the Galactic Civil War.

RB-919 was a human cyborg droid engineer who operated during the Imperial Era. As a cyborg, they empathized with droids that were created to perform simple tasks, and disliked instances where they had to destroy such droids.

Twenty years after the Sith rebellion, an uncle led a beast of burden as he traveled to Osou on the Outer Rim planet Genbara. A conversation between other beings on the same path turned to the growing tensions in the Empire.

Cage was the Mikkian female owner of Cage's Tech Emporium, a store located in Delphon City that sold electro-bafflers.

Elise was a female Batuuan from the village of Skirl. She fell in love with and married Menir, a farmer who lived on the outskirts of town.

Iren was a male traveler on the planet Batuu during the High Republic Era. He was invited into the house of the Batuuan woman Elise, which caused her husband, Menir, to fly into a rage and attack him. Iren left the house, leaving behind a small bag containing three seeds.

Cleeve was a Batuuan boy from the town of Skirl. When the town was attacked by monsters known as Drengir, Cleeve disappeared. The farmer Menir later found his corpse, drained of its vitality by the monsters.

Clarr'ivl'exow, core name Rivlex, was a Chiss male who was the Patriarch of the Chiss Ascendancy's Clarr family. He resided on the planet Rhigar, where he had a standing policy that refused landing permission to all non-Chiss vessels.

Stybla'mi'ovodo, core name Lamiov, was a Chiss male who was the Patriarch of the Chiss Ascendancy's Stybla family. Lamiov also held the rank of blood within the family, as well as Stybla the honorific suffix of odo.

Jorinda Boffrey was a Delphidian female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. She operated at a small Jedi temple at Port Haileap.

Rusty, later known as Darth Hammerhead, was a male Ithorian who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Rusty was present for the Rescue of Han Solo, where he saved Lando Calrissian from falling into the Great Pit of Carkoon.

Sherche La Plenn was an Ubdurian Jedi of the Jedi Order and an artist. By 431 BBY, La Plenn had served as the first marshal of the Jedi temple on the astronomical object Sag Kemper and had created a large tapestry that depicted a battle between the Jedi and the Sith.

Josiah was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era who served as a Jedi counselor and helped ensure other Jedi remained balanced after traumatic experiences.

Stybla'ppin'cykok, core name Lappincyk, was a Chiss male who was the Senior Aide to Patriarch Stybla'mi'ovodo "Lamiov" of the Chiss Ascendancy's Stybla family.

Clarr'etu'vilimt, also known by his core name Retuvili, was a male Chiss who served as the Clarr family's Patriel on the Chiss Ascendancy planet Rhigar.
A Chiss receptionist held the rank of lieutenant in the Chiss Defense Force and was stationed at the Defense Force headquarters on the Chiss Ascendancy's capital planet Csilla.

An individual served as an admiral within the naval branch of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A female therapist with a snake-like build and a beard worked at a medcenter on the planet Corulag eleven months after the Battle of Jakku, a decisive final battle in 5 ABY between the Galactic Empire and the victorious New Republic.

Kordi Freemaker was a member of the Freemakers and a relative of both Rowan, Pace, and Moxie Freemaker. According to R0-GR, Pace and Kordi Freemaker would label starships crafted from various parts as uglies.
Graballa was a Hutt male who operated in the Belgaroth asteroid field. He was the cousin of Jabba Desilijic Tiure and remained loyal to his cousin.

Jek-14, also known as the The Maker of Zoh, was a Force-sensitive human who had been an experiment from the Sith, until he was betrayed by them.
Moxie Freemaker was a female human that was part of the Freemakers family.
Pace Freemaker was a member of the Freemakers family and a relative of Kordi, Moxie, and Rowan Freemaker. Pace was also a friend of the B1-series battle droid R0-GR.

Zradca was a Kowakian monkey-lizard who worked with Lena Freemaker in the Ring of Kafrene. Whe the Galactic Empire was looking for the Wookiee Chewbacca, Radka turned Lena and Chewbacca over to the Galactic Empire. The Kowakian monkey-lizard had green skin and purple hair.

A male Cyclorrian was a pilot who served on Cyclor Shipyards while the Nihil attacked the spacehsip Innovator during the High Republic Era. He had a Z-29 Skyhawk fighter.
An individual served as a security officer on the Galactic Republic's Cyclor Shipyards that orbited the Mid Rim planet Cyclor during the High Republic Era.

A Fluggirian was a crew member of Sarn Starbreaker, who held the rank of Cloud in the Nihil marauder organization, serving within the Tempest of Pan Eyta.
A Human male individual at one point served as part of the crew of the pirate Bar-Kooda.

Cygnus Anton was an avian who served the Galactic Empire as a Chief Regional Auditor and was associated with the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Anton visited the planet Calior.

A pontiff held the title on the Expansion Region astronomical object Vincorba during the Imperial Era. The pontiff chose to ally with the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate in hope of power and resources.

A male individual was the younger brother of a pontiff on the Expansion Region astronomical object Vincorba during the Imperial Era. The pontiff, and thus their brother, allied with the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate for protection and support.
Chilla Zin was a four-armed Voridsec male who wielded four blades and was a member of the Assassin's Guild during the Imperial Era.
