Carrax was a human who resided on the planet Calior. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Imperial Chief Regional Auditor Cygnus Anton visited Calior with an escort that included guards of the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate.
Tanka was a Trandoshan who was a member of the Revengers, a group that fought the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate.
Ankala Sahm was a human who led the Revengers, a group that opposed the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate.

S'ira was a Weequay member of the Revengers, a group opposing the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate, alongside Ankala Sahm and Tanka. Like the other members of the group, S'ira's village had been destroyed by Crimson Dawn.
Massif was a diminutive, Force-sensitive humanoid member of the Knights of Ren during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Nomar Tralmat was a human male who served as the Father of Finances in Coronet City on the planet Corellia.

Deebko was a Kubaz who resided on the planet Corellia, running a nuna fighting arena. While plotting against Nihil cell leader Krix Kamerat, Nihil marauders Respriler and Sabata Krill attended Deebko's arena.

A Rodian bartender owned the Carbon Score Cantina on Burnin Konn during the Imperial Era. The bartender was unable to pay for protection from the Kerrakk enforcers after having to first pay off the Hutt Clan, Pyke Syndicate, and Unbroken Clan, leading the Kerrakk to attack and…
Nas Lariin was a Valon who was the mayor of Lonisa City on Valo and the father of Jom Lariin. He was present when the Nihil attacked the Valo Republic Fair.

Oniruko was a female pirate and slicer who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Oniruko was part of a pirate gang led by Eyan McDermitt. In 1 ABY, the gang hijacked a courier ship belonging to the Incom Corporation.

Aered Argyris was an male Alderaanian lieutenant who served in the Glare Peak civilian guard. He was stationed in the eastern part of Glare Peak and because of his anger at the Empire's destruction of Alderaan was sympathetic to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A Mon Calamari member of the the Nihil marauders participated in the organization's attack on the planet Valo. The Mon Calamari wore a cracked visor and carried a bowcaster. During the attack, he found fellow Nihil Zarabarb in a trance induced by the ex-Jedi Ty Yorrick.

A member of the Nihil had purple skin and participated in the organization's attack on the planet Valo. The Nihil pushed past a Mon Calamari Nihil to attack Zarabarb, a Gran Nihil who, after emerging from a trance, was shooting wildly at his fell marauders.
A chief gardener worked in the Republic Gardens on Valo. When the Republic Fair was held there during the High Republic Era, he want to show the gardens to the audience.
This male was the portmaster of the planet Valo during the Republic Fair.

A fire chief lived during the High Republic Era. By 231 BBY, he was interviewed by the reporter Rhil Dairo. During the interview, Dairo exposed the fire chief as corrupt, and ended up spraying him with a fire hose.
An operative of the reconstituted Sith Empire faked his death to escape Imperial service while working undercover on Jocal Four by 3643 BBY.
A traitor was active within the organization of Wordro the Hutt during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Darmin Lerspri was a male Alderaanian diplomat who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
A captain was in charge of Red Squad, a Galactic Republic unit deployed during the Quesh war.
Basel of Tion was a holowright, who, like Peshosloc, had Xim perish after the Third Battle of Vontor in his holoplay.

A Trandoshan member of the the Nihil marauders participated in the organization's attack on the planet Valo. During the attack, he and other Nihil tried to kill Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh. He was killed by Jedi Master Stellan Gios.

Talia was a Togruta female who was a student of Professor Glenna Kip on Port Haileap during the High Republic Era. When Haileap was attacked by the Nihil, Talia warned fellow student Avon Starros of the attack.

Marinda was a humanoid member of the Knights of Ren, a dark side organization led by the Force-sensitive Ren. During the time of the Galactic Empire, Marinda and the other Knights of Ren became the allies of Crimson Dawn, a criminal syndicate under the control of Lady Qi'ra.
Trido Tamaree was a Togruta who was the commander of the Royal Togruta Fleet in 231 BBY. Tamaree took part in repelling the Nihil Attack on Valo.

An Alzarian member of the the Nihil marauders participated in the organization's attack on the planet Valo. He with other members tried to kill Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh and her courtship. He was killed when one of the Chancellor's targon Voru attacked him.

Zallo Blaak was a human male drifter who traveled to Jedha City on the eve of Reflection Day at the behest of his father, who hoped Blaak might find purpose when peering into the Kyber Mirrors at the Dome of Deliverance.

Kasmira was a Pantoran female scholar who studied the Force. On the eve of Reflection Day one year, she traveled on board a transport full of pilgrims to Jedha City on the moon Jedha in order to see all of the sites linked to the Force in the city.

Fezzonk was a Dowutin member of the security crew led by Alys Ongwa on Corellia. When the crew was tasked with protecting Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh during a visit to Corellia, Fezzonk flew as Air Eleven in a craft above the gathering.

Smeemarm was an Arcona female operative in the security team led by Alys Ongwa on planet Corellia. When the crew was tasked with protecting Lina Soh, Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic, during a visit to Corellia's Coronet City, Smeemarm led Tunnel Team Twelve in patr…

Ovarto Bitolo-Bash was a male operative in the security team led by Alys Ongwa on Corellia. When the crew was assigned to protect Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh during a visit to Coronet City on Corellia, Ovarto, alongside Barchibar, reported for Ground Team Six in the crowd pres…

Barchibar was a Weequay member of Alys Ongwa's security crew on Corellia. When the crew was tasked with the protection of Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh during a visit to Corellia, Barchibar accompanied Ovarto Bitolo-Bash in Ground Team Six among the crowd that was watching Soh.
Prybolt Garavult was a Grindalid male operative in the Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection led by Alys Ongwa on Corellia. The Grindalid owned three Corellian hounds: Beeta, Serenata and Sibak.

Tangor was a silverback Wookiee female operative in the security crew led by Alys Ongwa on Corellia. When Ongwa's team was tasked with protecting Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh during a visit to Corellia, the Wookiee reported in from the ground within the crowd that was present t…

Rhal was an individual who had a Mon Calamari daughter named Ghal Tarpfen with another individual named Gera. Tarpfen's mother used to sing her a lullaby when she was a child. In 230 BBY, Tarpfen had a dream that placed her back on her homeworld of the planet Mon Cala.

Gera was an individual who had a Mon Calamari daughter named Ghal Tarpfen with another individual, named Rhal. When Tarpfen was a child, her mother used to sing her a lullaby. In 230 BBY, Tarpfen had a dream that brought her back to her homeworld of the planet Mon Cala.
Mok Shaiz was an Ithorian male who was the mayor of the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine in 9 ABY.

Buck Vancto, known simply as "the Marshal," was a Surpossian marshal active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY Vancto hunted the smuggler Han Solo as he undertook a heist for Jabba the Hutt.
The Deck Master or DM was a human male who worked as Deck Master at the hangar of the Rebel Alliance flagship New Hope around 1 BBY.

Lynela Kabe-Oyu was a Kel Dor Jedi Master who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. During an assassination attempt on the Hynestian royal family, Kabe-Oyu got the royal family to safety.
A Advozse male assassin was sent by Morbo the Hutt to kill the smuggler Teff'ith on Nar Shaddaa, though he was killed by Theron Shan before he could.
Thaya Ferr was a human female member of the Nihil who served as an assistant to the pirate organization's leader, Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro.
A clone trooper served in the Grand Army of the Republic's 327th Star Corps during the Clone Wars. Throughout his service, the clone saw Dark Acolyte Asajj Ventress cut down entire battalions.

The sister of the Human Rebel Bren Kingal had a secret family recipe for a dessert known as Eopie Cream Pie. Kingal considered his sister's pie the best reward in the city of Mos Taike on the planet Tatooine, gifting one of them to a spacer whom he had kill a local murderer.

Kho Phon Farrus was an Alcedian non-binary archaeologist who had an obsession with the dark side of the Force and occult rituals. They were a student at the University of Bar'leth at the same time as Chelli Lona Aphra, Sana Starros, and Eustacia Okka.
Nyla was the human female Queen of the planet Hynestia during the High Republic Era.

Slej Hant was an Imperial Officer who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. In 0 ABY, Hant had attained the rank of First Lieutenant and was tasked by Darth Vader to investigate the identity of the Rebel pilot who had blown up the first Death Star superweapon during…
A deck gunner worked onboard Jabba the Hutt's sail barge during the Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon on Tatooine. He was a Human male with light skin and black hair.
Humajum was a female Besalisk contact of the Gran criminal Oobolo.

A female individual from the Colonies planet Hynestia lived during the High Republic Era. They raised a human son—Imri Cantaros, who was born around 246 BBY,—with a male individual from the Expansion Region planet Genetia.

A male individual from the Expansion Region planet Genetia lived during the High Republic Era. They, along with a female individual from the Colonies planet Hynestia, raised a human son named Imri Cantaros who was born around 246 BBY.
Tiina was a Human female and the queen of Arrochar during the early Galactic Civil War. Her husband was King Tolar, and their son was Prince Kaspar.
Arvi was a Lepi and one of the many cousins of the bounty hunter Jaxxon T. Tumperakki. Tumperakki offered Arvi and the rest of his cousins, Han Solo's services in exchange for help with a job.

Benji was a Lepi and one of the many cousins of the bounty hunter Jaxxon T. Tumperakki. Tumperakki offered Benji and the rest of his cousins, the smuggler Han Solo's services in exchange for help with a job.

Maxx was a Lepi and one of the many cousins of the bounty hunter Jaxxon T. Tumperakki. Tumperakki offered Maxx and the rest of his cousins, the smuggler Han Solo's services in exchange for help with a job to steal transit chips from Amaiza Foxtrain.

Peeta was a Lepi and one of the many cousins of the bounty hunter Jaxxon T. Tumperakki. Tumperakki offered Peeta and the rest of his cousins, the smuggler Han Solo's services in exchange for help with a job to steal transit chips from Amaiza Foxtrain for the Alliance to Restor…
An old woman was the proprietor of the Darlyn Boda jewel shop.
A male individual was a bodyguard to the Black Sun's leader, Dark Prince Xizor.

A individual was an officer in the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire, The officer lead a raid on the hideout of Amaiza Foxtrain on the planet Valtos.

Raamas was a Chiss who held the rank of captain aboard the warship Orisson. Prior to becoming a captain, Raamas had served as the commander of the Orisson, in addition to being first officer to Captain Roscu.

Cribiriz Idollax was a Culisetto male warlord and droid mechanic during the Imperial Era. When Deva Lompop sent Zuckuss, 4-LOM and bounty hunters to kill him, they instead killed his brother, Sribiriz.

Dokk Strassi was a Trandoshan male who was the leader of the Strassi family on the planet Tatooine, working under Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire. Following Jabba's death, the Trandoshans protected the city center and business districts of Mos Espa.

Madam Garsa Fwip was the Twi'lek female owner of the Sanctuary, a cantina in Mos Espa during the New Republic Era. When former bounty hunter Boba Fett established a new criminal empire on Tatooine, he paid a visit to Fwip at the Sanctuary to ensure the longevity of her business.
A Twi'lek male server worked for Madam Garsa Fwip at her cantina, Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary, on the planet Tatooine.
Mok Shaiz's majordomo was a Twi'lek male who served the Ithorian Mok Shaiz, mayor of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine.

Garfalaquox was an Aqualish don who operated on Tatooine. After the bounty hunter Boba Fett took over the palace and criminal empire of Jabba the Hutt, Garfalaquox visited the palace to pay tribute to the new crime lord.
The Tusken Chieftain was a male Tusken Raider who was the chieftain of a tribe of Tusken Raiders.

A male Rodian was a prisoner of a Tusken Raider tribe on the planet Tatooine around 4 ABY. The prisoner was joined by another captive named Boba Fett, a famed bounty hunter. When Fett attempted to escape, the Rodian alerted the Tusken Raiders.

A Lepi member of the Nihil marauders served Zeetar's Tempest in 231 BBY. Stationed at the Nihil gas foundry on the planet Xais, the Lepi was hauling a canister of nagnol gas by the captured Hutt Myarga Anjiliac Atirue when two undercover Jedi Knights, Keeve Trennis and Terec, …
A human male TIE pilot used the callsign "Dark Five" when flying as part of the Galactic Empire's Dark Squadron between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.

A Tusken Raider male youngling was part of a tribe of Tuskens that was active in the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine. While the fallen bounty hunter Boba Fett was held prisoner by the tribe, the child watched over the man and beat him when they first met.

Kief Varris was a Devaronian bounty hunter hired by the First Order to track down the Togruta Moebin Faltus. Varris believed that his name would be famous throughout the galaxy after he captured Faltus and began a chase with Rey and Faltus through a city on the planet Choss.

An Imperial clone commando served the Galactic Empire during the early days of the Imperial Era. As the Imperial Military planned to transition from a clone army to a conscription-based force under Project War-Mantle, this clone commando was part of a group of 50 clone command…
Moebin Faltus was a Togruta male who worked as a smuggler on the black market, smuggling fugitives of the First Order military regime for a high price.
This individual served as the garrison commander in the Imperial garrison stationed on the planet Jaguada.

A Gamorrean guard served under crime lords Jabba Desilijic Tiure and Bib Fortuna before the bounty hunter Boba Fett took over Jabba's Palace and established his own gotra. Sometime after the attack, the Gamorrean and a fellow guard were captured and brought before Fett.

A Gamorrean guard served under crime lords Jabba Desilijic Tiure and Bib Fortuna before the bounty hunter Boba Fett took over Jabba's Palace and established his own gotra. Sometime after the attack, the Gamorrean and a fellow guard were captured and brought before Fett.

A human male landspeeder driver drove around Pantora at the beginning of the Imperial Era. When the bounty hunter Fennec Shand and the child clone, Omega, dropped onto a hovertruck, a chase then occurred between Shand and Hunter.
A bartender of the Bith species worked at a cantina in the city of Kai Pompos on Irudiru. The bartender had just one leg, which was a metal prosthetic.
The Tusken warrior was a female Tusken Raider warrior who was a member of a tribe of Tusken Raiders on the planet Tatooine around 4 ABY.

Ged Ku'rys was an indecisive Twi'lek individual who served as the leader of the Ku'rys clan on Ryloth. Emen Rooshan, a member of the rival Rooshan clan, hired an assassin in an attempt to kill Ku'rys.

Pon Rooshan was an inscrutable female Twi'lek individual who served as the leader of the Rooshan clan on Ryloth. She hired an assassin to pretend to try to kill Emen Rooshan, which she planned to use to cause war with the rival Ku'rys clan.

A female Twi'lek worked as a server in Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary, a cantina in Mos Espa owned by Garsa Fwip. When Daimyo Boba Fett and his assassin Fennec Shand visited the establishment, the server and her partner greeted them and took their helmets for cleaning.
A Clawdite female from the Lambda sector was held as a prisoner at the Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine at the time a munka miner was taken prisoner by Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
A human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire was active on the planet Tatooine until eventually falling into the sarlacc of the Great Pit of Carkoon.
Calister was a human Imperial officer who held the rank of commander in the Galactic Empire. Commander Calister arrived to pick up Imperial spy Lyle Kullan after he sent out a distress signal.
Telma was an individual who had a cousin. Telma one time, told Vanraya that her cousin lifted a ruby for the gangster Wonn Ionstrike and she got her own servant droid.
A individual was the cousin of Telma. The cousin once lifted a ruby for the gangster Won Ionstrike and got herself a servant droid.

A male individual was the Father of the human youngling Moxxin. Moxxin's father believed that the Baron Administrator of Cloud City, Landonis Balthazar Calrissian was a con, which was how he ended up running Cloud City.
A male rebel pilot was the target of a 50,000 credit bounty and was killed on the planet Carajam by the bounty hunter Boba Fett between 2 BBY and 4 ABY.
A human archivist worked in a Jedi temple on a barely named, barely thought of world. During the Galactic Civil War, Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader invaded the Jedi Temple to locate a tablet.

A human male archivist worked at a Jedi temple on a barely named, barely thought of world, with a Twi'lek and human archivist. During the Galactic Civil War, Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader invaded the temple in order to collect a tablet.

A Twi'lek male archivist worked along side a two archivists at a Jedi temple on a barely named, barely thought of world. During the Galactic Civil War, Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader invaded the Jedi temple in an attempt to steal a valuable tablet.

Freeno was a male Er'Kit miner who worked at an aurodium mine on the planet Elphrona during the High Republic Era. One day, while attempting to unearth a valuable kantak crystal, Freeno caused a collapse in the mine.
An Er'Kit individual served as a partner to the miner Freeno on the planet Elphrona.
A human came into possession of some valuable shards on the Outer Rim Territories planet Carajam between around 2 BBY and 4 ABY.
A Hutt male, alongside his twin sister, attempted to claim Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire after the death of Bib Fortuna.
A Hutt female alongside her twin brother, attempted to claim Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire after the death of Bib Fortuna.
The Besalisk criminal doctor Ragon had a sister. At some point, someone believed that Ragon's sister was a Trandoshan, but Ragon replied that it was in fact his sister instead.

A human male worked as a clerk at the city hall of Mos Espa for Mayor Mok Shaiz around 9 ABY. When Daimyo Boba Fett, who believed Shaiz had arranged an assassination attempt on him, arrived to see the mayor, the clerk, working at the front desk, failed to find any arranged app…

A male Pyke traveler ran the transportation of sansanna spice on a Pyke Syndicate repulsor train at the planet Tatooine. Traveling through the Dune Sea, the Pykes conflicted with a Tusken Raider tribe, prompting the Tuskens to launch a counterattack.

A male Tusken Raider served as the craftsman of gaderffii sticks for a tribe of Tuskens in the Dune Sea of Tatooine. He guided individuals in the making of sticks after they had proved themselves worthy of the weapon.

A human male assassin served the Order of the Night Wind during the New Republic Era. Normally only allowed to operate within Hutt Space, he and several other assassins were sent to Mos Espa around 9 ABY to ambush Boba Fett, the city's self-appointed Daimyo.

Santa Claus was a human toy maker. Every year, Santa would deliver presents across the galaxy in one night by traveling in his sleigh that was pulled by the Hoth-native species, tauntauns for the holiday of Sithmas.

Ar Prace was a Fian who served as a maintenance supervisor aboard the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era. Due to her species, Prace was more resistant to radiation than a human.
Alfkenda was an engineer who was a member of the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era.
Imgree was a Jedi Master who served as the head of the Chespea Temple of the Jedi Order on the planet Chespea during the High Republic Era.

An individual who served as the Padawan of Jedi Master Imgree, who served as the head of the Chespea Temple on the planet Chespea during the High Republic Era. As the temple was attacked by the Nihil, Imgree told the Padawan to call the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
Roborhyan was a member of the Nihil pirates who served aboard the Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro's flagship, the Gaze Electric, and had animosity toward the captain of the Nihil starship Spectre.

A female individual was the mother of the Nihil pirate Nan. When Nan was very small, she, her mother, and her father shared one of the bonding rituals of spacefaring families, and in one instance Nan's mother hovered nearby when she took a T-7 anx into her hands.

Cale was a Pau'an male Nihil who served as a technician aboard the flagship of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro, the Gaze Electric. In 230 BBY, Cale was sent alongside fellow techs Werrera and Leyel to carry out the sabotage of Starlight Beacon due to the threes loyalty.

An Imperial carrier captain served in during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire. While serving as a captain for a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier, a mission was carried out by Phoenix Cell Commander Jun Sato to capture the carrier for use by the rebel group in h…

Shenrick was a Mon Calamari male who ruled as the King of Mon Cala during the High Republic Era. Originally a third son who was not expected to gain the crown, Shenrick engaged in an affair with Ghal Tarpfen, a Captain Third Class of the Mon Calamari Guard who was from a low-r…

Jaraki was a male individual who pretended to have medical problems while in a bistro on Naporar. He was able to fake his "attack" with a female companion to distract the bistro's staff, allowing an accomplice to attempt to steal from the bistro.
Lortha Peel was a human male water monger that owned a water shop in the Worker's District of the city Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine.

Boba's rancor was a rancor that was owned by Boba Fett, gifted to him by the Hutts known as the Twins. A rancor keeper assisted Fett by taking care of the rancor, and arrived at Boba Fett's Palace along with the rancor as part of the Twins' tribute.

Drash was a human female leader of a street gang within the Worker's District of the city Mos Espa on Tatooine. She and her gang joined the Fett gotra and took part in the Battle of Mos Espa which saw the Pyke Syndicate driven off Tatooine.

Skad was a human male who was a member of a street gang that operated in the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine. Residing in the Worker's District, the gang's members often stole water due to the high prices and the lack of work available in the city.
A rancor keeper was employed by Daimyo Boba Fett to assist him with taking care of a rancor that was gifted to him by the the Twins.
The Pyke Boss was a Pyke male who led the Pyke Syndicate's operations on the planet Tatooine and, by 9 ABY, controlled the entire syndicate.
An individual served as the captain of the Nihil starship Spectre during the High Republic Era. The captain maintained animosity with Roborhyan, another member of the marauders.
Bodica Venj was a Mandalorian. Bodica was a wrathful warrior who was affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. At one point, Bodica flew on Krownest above the Wren Stronghold.

Dirk Ullodin was a Mandalorian who piloted a Fang-class starfighter during the Imperial Era. A member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Dirk participated in a battle in space and shot down a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter.

Tabakan Pak was a Dug Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. When the Jedi launched an attack on the Nihil marauder base on the planet Dol'har Hyde, Pak, alongside Master Obratuk Glii, piloted the cruiser Star Hopper.

Yeet was a Meerian pirate who held the rank of Strike in Tempest Runner Kara Xoo's Tempest within the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era and had a history of tragically losing new Nihil recruits.

A human male drummer served the Hutt siblings within the Hutt Clan syndicate known as "the Twins" in 9 ABY. He played the drums in front of the Twins' litter when they went to visit Daimyo Boba Fett about the territory they laid claim to.

Squib was a human male member of the Nihil during the High Republic Era. He accompanied Yeet in escorting hostage children inside the Poisoned Barb, and claimed Avon Starros and her allies alongside Yeet for their strike.

Tarnono was a male bodyguard who worked for the gangster Wonn Ionstrike in Cloud City on the planet Bespin. Tarnono wore a red uniform with a gator to cover his mouth. He armed himself with a blaster. The bodyguard was blind in his right eye with scars over the eye.

The husband of Crys Taanzer was a male Human from Nadiem. He was married to his wife during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, and together they had a son, Kennan Taanzer. He was killed during the Separatist invasion of Nadiem in 21.6 BBY.
"Pontriss" was the name the Chiss syndic Mitth'ras'safis, core name "Thrass," gave to a male individual who attempted to rob a bistro on the Chiss Ascendancy planet Naporar by 19 BBY.
Kohta Jarik was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order stationed at the outpost Port Haileap on the Outer Rim planet Haileap during the High Republic Era.

Groonor was a Chevin smuggler. Having retired at some point before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, by around 3643 BBY he had returned for a final job of delivering weapons through dangerous territory.

Venn was a human cadet of the Galactic Empire who was stationed aboard the Executor, the flagship of Darth Vader, during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the Executor was present above the planet Jekara when it was attacked by the Hutt Clan.

A male Chiss individual was the father of Mitth'ras'safis. He and his wife were members of a minor family of the Chiss Ascendancy, and having grown up among the Mitth their son could not recall the name of his parent's original family.

A mynock, posthumously nicknamed Smiley, lived inside the exogorth Sy-O inside one of the asteroids of the Hoth asteroid field. In 3 ABY, it fed on the power cables of the Millennium Falcon when the rebel vessel landed within Sy-O's maw.
A female Chiss individual was the mother of Mitth'ras'safis. Before she was rematched to the Mitth family she and her husband belonged to a very minor family.

A farmer owned a farm on the planet Naboo and at one point experienced difficulties with an unexploded booma, an energy weapon that had been left over from a past battle. She sought help from a mercenary to disarm the weapon.
An Imperial governor governed the Outer Rim Territories' astronomical object of Roon. The smuggler Tryphon Leo planned to bribe the governor to lock down trade in the Spice Triangle.

Gol Ponk was a Kel Dor male who served as the captain of the Purrgil-class starcruiser Halcyon during the High Republic Era. In 230 BBY, Ponk and the Halcyon assisted in towing Starlight Beacon through hyperspace so it could assist in the Dalnan evacuation.
An alien individual served as the majordomo of the Grand Leader of the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era.

A Trandoshan gambler was gambling with some other Trandoshans at the Sanctuary cantina in 9 ABY when they were attacked by the Wookiee bounty hunter Krrsantan. He tried to defend himself by breaking a glass on the Wookiee's back, but Krrsantan immobilized him right after.

Crimson Jack was a human male pirate who, during the First Order-Resistance War, attempted to claim a bounty from the First Order after discovering that someone onboard the Purrgil-class starcruiser Halcyon had sent a transmission to the Resistance.
A bantha was owned by Boba Fett until around 9 ABY when he set her free.
"The Modifier" was a human male cyborg who worked in the Mos Eisley Mod Parlor on Tatooine during the New Republic Era.

A female Chiss was the Patriel for the Irizi family on Avidich around 39 BBY. During the rematching dinner hosted by the Mitth family in their compound, Aristocra Mitth'ras'safis pointed the Patriel out of the crowd to one of the new merit adoptives, called Mitth'raw'nuru.

A female Chiss had a rank of a syndic in the Mitth family of the Chiss Ascendancy. Four months after the pirate attack at Stivic the syndic gave patrol cruiser Parala data to a newly hired Mitth'ras'safis for analysis.
A male Chiss was the captain of a cargo ship owned by the Stybla family. His ship was hijacked by a crew that included members from the Clarr family and set adrift in Glastis 3.

A male Chiss was the pilot of the Stybla family patrol ship Jandalin. When Senior Aide Stybla'ppin'cykok handed the command of the Jandalin to Mitth'raw'nuru, the pilot was initially hesitant to take orders from a Mitth, but later followed a twisting course Thrawn gave him wit…
A male Klatooinian was the boss, also referred to as a don, of the Klatooinian family of the city Mos Espa on the planet of Tatooine.

A human farmer owned a farm on the planet Naboo. They had brown eyes, long brown hair, and light-colored skin. The farmer wore a white long-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled up past their elbows and a beige covering over their legs.
A domesticated massiff was owned by a tribe of Tusken Raiders on Tatooine in the time following the death of Jabba the Hutt.

A Human worked as a guard on the planet Roon. In 15 BBY, they were distracted by the Human Mungo Baobab's mupple pie and mistakenly allowed prisoners to escape from the fortress that they had been tasked with guarding.
Uleen'Arael was a Rutian Twi'lek bounty hunter who was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Tase Somer was a male who served as the Head Curator of the Coruscant Museum during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Sira Folsomn was an employee of Tagge Corporation who became a spy for Crimson Dawn. Her espionage was uncovered and she was confronted by Lapin Tagge during their investigation into employees who had been compromised by the criminal syndicate.

Kaba Baiz was a Klatooinian butcher from the space station Glavis Ringworld, where he worked as the mogul of the Lenapi Meatpacking Degree. Baiz had a 9850-credit bounty placed on him and was tracked down by the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin in 9 ABY.

Reed was a human male X-wing pilot for the New Republic. He held the rank of lieutenant in the New Republic Defense Fleet Starfighter Corps and was paired with Captain Carson Teva during their patrol above the planet Tatooine.
An Aqualish was present on the moon Pantora during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The Aqualish drove a hovertruck while the bounty hunter Fennec Shand attempted to capture the clone Omega.

A male Imperial officer was stationed in the Hangar 2-7 during the Liberation of Lothal. He thought the execution of Protocol 13 was highly irregular and that it should be confirmed, after it was confirmed, he asked the commanding officer, former Imperial Security Bureau Agent…
A Imperial technician was stationed at the "dome" on the planet of Lothal during the liberation of Lothal in 1 BBY.
Deena was an individual who worked for De'Rruyet Industries during the Galactic Civil War at the De'Rruyet Center on the planet Midarr.
Cadil was a human individual who worked for De'Rruyet Industries during the Galactic Civil War at the De'Rruyet Center on the planet Midarr.
A young Rodian child was aboard a passenger starliner when Din Djarin traveled from the starport on the city known as Glavis Ringworld.

Taly was a refugee fleeing Cloud City to join the Rebel Alliance on the safe world of Kaliska. Taly and the other refugees were targeted by ISB agent Govin Thane, but a group of Rebel agents helped them safely reach the transport to Kaliska.
Ouannii was a Rodian keyboardist who often accompanied famous singer Gaya. The Rodian played with Gaya during her time on the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon.

An agent for the New Republic operated in the Corellian system around 7 ABY. While in the system, he intercepted a scrambled transmission from one of the system's planets, which contained plans for a new sublight engine in development by the Human engineer Gen Tiraan.
Darth Norok was a Human male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire.

A human gorgmonger ran a stall in Ord Mantell City—the capital city of the Mid Rim planet Ord Mantell—during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, the gorgmonger attempted to sell gorgs to the bounty hunter T'onga, though she passed on the offer.
Devono Vix was a Gossam arms dealer connected with the Hutt Clan who operated in the Arms Market on the Smuggler's Moon of Nar Shaddaa.
A Mirialan lived during the Imperial Era and was associated with the Wookiee Sagwa, who worked at the Garkata Fighting Arena on the Hutt Space moon Nar Shaddaa.

Ororab was a crime boss who led a criminal group during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, the group were present in aboard a starship above the planet Jekara when the rebel pilot and Jedi-in-training Luke Skywalker baited the Sith Lord Darth Vader into a starfighter …

A Rodian was a member of a criminal group led by Boss Ororab during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, the Rodian accompanied other members of the group aboard a starship to the planet Jekara.
In 3 ABY, an individual served as the captain of a criminal group's starship as the group were present above the planet Jekara.
An Ishi Tib was a guild master on the ringed space station Glavis Ringworld. Around 9 ABY, they hired the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin to bring in the Klatooinian Kaba Baiz.

A Nautolan female was the mother of the bounty hunter Nakano Lash. They died while pregnant with twins and as they tried to protect Lash from an Anselmi hunter. They was later buried with their partner on the planet Galmerah.

A Nautolan was the partner of Nakano Lash's mother and parent to Nakano Lash. They died while they tried to protect Lash from an Anselmi hunter. The Nautolan, along with Lash's mother were later buried on the planet Galmerah.

A Chagrian male was a member of a swoop gang during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, the gang traveled to a cantina on the planet Arkanis after they received an invitation from the resurgent criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn.
A human female was a member of a swoop gang in 3 ABY. After the gang received an invitation from the resurgent criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn, they traveled to a cantina on the planet Arkanis.

A human female served as an assassin for the resurgent criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the assassin traveled with a number of other assassins to an astronomical object that housed the lair of Bokku the Hutt.

Between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, a Rodian who owned a YT-1300 light freighter traveled to the Corellian Engineering Corporation's YT-Series Warranty and Repair Shipyard B33 on the planet Corellia to have their ship fixed.
A human served as an Imperial officer in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era, eventually coming to serve aboard aboard the Executor, the flagship of the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader.
Nalita was a human who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Nalita and their partner, the bounty hunter Tekrit, traveled to a bar on the Smuggler's Moon of Nar Shaddaa.

In 3 ABY, an individual attended an auction for the carbonite-frozen body of the smuggler Han Solo hosted by the resurgent criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn on their Fortress-Flagship, the Vermillion, on the planet Jekara.

A cloaked individual was involved in the drug smash trade during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, they received an invitation from the resurgent criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn to attend an auction for the carbonite-frozen body of the smuggler Han Solo on their Fort…
Scott was a human deputy of Freetown on the planet Tatooine under the authority of Sheriff Cobb Vanth. He was killed in a duel with the Duros mercenary Cad Bane.

A Resistance recruit was a red-haired Human member of the Resistance recruited at Batuu's Black Spire Outpost by Vi Moradi. The youth was fleeing a pair of First Order stormtroopers with a stolen datacard through the outpost until Moradi helped him hide.

Zlarb was a human who operated the poisons shop Zlarb's on Level 2685 on the planet Coruscant. In 3 ABY, the assassin Ochi visited Zlarb in order to acquire poisons that he was to use to carry out a job on behalf of Crimson Dawn leader Lady Qi'ra.
A general served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Late in the galaxy-spanning conflict, the general was in command of Republic forces during the Battle of Slag's Pit around 19 BBY.
A Thisspiasian male was a member of the Nihil Tempest led by the Tempest Runner Zeetar. During the High Republic Era, he infiltrated the Halcyon during a Nihil attack on the starship.

Shug Drabor was a legendary Anzellan male engineer. During the High Republic Era, he oversaw the construction of several MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruisers, including the Halcyon at the Santhe Shipyards on the planet Corellia.
A male Pyke courier worked for the Pyke Syndicate on the planet Tatooine in 9 ABY. He and three other Pykes encountered Marshal Cobb Vanth whilst in the marshal's territories.

Shorr Komrrin was a Tholothian male from the planet Tholoth. During the Clone Wars, Komrrin who was just a child, was present on the Halcyon when Jedi General Anakin Skywalker dueled Sith assassin Asajj Ventress.

The male Pyke courier was a member of the Pyke Syndicate who operated on the planet Tatooine in 9 ABY. He and three other Pykes encountered Marshal Cobb Vanth of the town Mos Pelgo while consulting their cargo in the Mos Pelgo territories.

Joral San Tekka was a member of the San Tekka clan during the High Republic Era who was related to the hyperspace savant Mari San Tekka. He was also known to the Nihil pirate Nan and the scientist Chancey Yarrow.
Danz Borin was a light-skinned, brown-haired human who spent time in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the desert planet Tatooine in 1 BBY.
Betzo was a Lurmen who served in the Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection led by Alys Ongwa on the planet Corellia. A few years before 230 BBY, Betzo left the team to become a bounty hunter.

Teetak was a Bonbrak who lived during the High Republic Era. In 230 BBY, as part of a plan to prevent the Shani singer Crufeela from performing at the Finance Ball on the planet Corellia by having her arrested for attempting to eat a member of a species classified as protected…
Finmos Tagge was a human male who served as Father of Chemicals in Coronet City on the planet Corellia during the High Republic Era. Tagge was short and burly with a red beard.

Deklar Graf was a human male who served as Father of Metals in Coronet City on the planet Corellia during the High Republic Era and had an elaborate mustache. In 230 BBY, Graf was invited by Alys Ongwa to a gathering to honor recent losses in the city.

Ovus Buckell was a human male who lived in Coronet City on the planet Corellia during the High Republic Era. He held the position of Finance Minister. In 230 BBY, Buckell had desires to become Corellia's leader and worked with the Nihil Respriler to achieve this.

Dondar Volt was an individual who taught the acrobat Aytar how to put on his own makeup. At some point before 230 BBY, when Aytar spoke with the Jedi Padawan and his lover Kantam Sy, they told him they didn't know how he did it.

Cozler was a Force-sensitive human male who joined the Jedi Order during the New Republic Era. A student of Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, Cozler learned the ways of the Force alongside other students, including Skywalker's nephew Ben Solo.

Serenata was a Corellian hound owned by the Grindalid Prybolt Garavult along with two other hounds, Beeta and Sibak. Serenata was part of the the Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection bodyguard business led by Alys Ongwa in Coronet City on the planet Corellia.

Crukibolt Nart Adeen, known as Crufeela, was a Corellian Shani female singer who lived during the High Republic Era. Notorious for her penchant for eating creatures from endangered species, Crufeela was wanted in multiple star systems for violating environmental laws.

A female Naboo teenager lived during the High Republic Era. An aspiring musician, the teenager made a voice recording of the satirical song "Corellia for Corellians" while trying to find stardom on the holos.

Koko was a vendor who ran Koko Noodle, a noodle cart at the outpost Port Haileap on the planet Haileap. The Jedi Padawan Imri Cantaros—whose favorite place to eat at the outpost was Koko Noodle—considered Koko's noodles to be the most spiciest and tangiest noodles available.
An Alderaanian wrote the satirical song "Corellia for Corellians" by around 270 BBY, making fun of the planet Corellia's isolationist tendencies for a joke.

A human villager lived in a village on the Outer Rim Territories planet Carajam. Between around 2 BBY and 4 ABY, their village was attacked by the bounty hunter Zingo Gabnit, who killed several villagers and tied up the survivors to lay a trap for his pursuer, the bounty hunte…
Liam was a human male child from the planet Hetzal Prime. According to the Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh, he was no more than ten or eleven years old.

Zian was a Theelin male who was the husband of Hackrack Bep, the Vice President of the planet Dalna. In 230 BBY, the couple's son, Theo, was taken by the Nihil whilst at the south meadowlands and hidden in the Maawat Mountains, though he was eventually found by a group of Jedi…
A Chiss male who held the rank of Mid Captain commanded a task force of warships of the Chiss Ascendancy's Erighal family around 18 BBY.
Beesar Tal-Apurna was a Chadra-Fan female who married the Chadra-Fan Teemank. After her wife was killed by Nihil marauders during the Battle of Kur in 232 BBY, she grieved her spouse deeply.

Moonanoo, nicknamed Moona, was a Chadra-Fan female who was the wife of Doctor Kisma Uttersond, a collaborator of the Nihil marauder organization. Uttersond and Moonanoo lived with a number of fanlings in a house on Chad.

Teemank was a Chadra-Fan female who married the Chadra-Fan Beesar Tal-Apurna. After the Great Disaster in 232 BBY, she trained as a pilot with the Republic Defense Coalition to fight against the Nihil pirate organization.
Skeptical about the assassins' claim that he was an associate of Crimson Dawn, Zanchal ordered his droid to give them access to every room of his residence.
Seddia Chaan was a Human female who worked as a security engineer for Salantech Cooperative.

Vroma was a Nautolan who resided on the astronomical object Hon-Tallos. During the High Republic Era, Vroma took a durga berry from one of the groves, prompting the bully Ghenli to track her down and shove her away.
Deemus Abrus was a female Twi'lek who served as the Chief Inspector of the Coronet City Chapter of the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts during the High Republic Era.
Dizcaro was a Corellian male bodyguard who ran a bodyguard agency which was a rival to Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection, led by Alys Ongwa. He was known by the code name "Team Leader One".

Baynoo Ongwa was a Corellian human female retired bodyguard who previously ran the Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection agency. Around 231 BBY, Baynoo retired and turned the business over to her daughter, Alys.
A male Pommrio Mid Captain of the Pommrio family of the Chiss Ascendancy served the Pommrio family during the Hoxim incident.

Moghra was a Hutt male who worked as a crime lord from a palace on the moon Nar Shaddaa. The freighter pilot Lantra Tan stole thousands of credits from Moghra, but her cousin Jonal, a dancer in Moghra's employ, informed the Hutt about his cousin's heist.

Khel Tanna was a human female scoundrel who worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the reign of the Galactic Empire. She had dark skin, black hair and blue eyes. Tanna detested the smuggler Han Solo, whom she accompanied on a job for Jabba, as well as the Wookiee Chewbacca.
Fambola, nicknamed "Fambola the Noble," was an elder Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.

An Iktotchi Jedi served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Alongside Jedi Master Kantam Sy, the Iktotchi Jedi aided in the evacuation of the cruiser the Voyager Dawn after it was damaged in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster.
A Pyke operated under the Pyke Syndicate. In 19 BBY, the Devaronian Roland Durand attempted to make a name for himself by performing a deal with the syndicate on the planet Ord Mantell.
Griswal, was a diminutive elder Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.

Acantha was a Nephran youth who was a member of the criminal Norikus gang on the planet Coruscant. In around 232 BBY, she, a Lepi, and the gang's leader, Norikus, attempted to rob the thief Nittel Karkson on level four thousand of Galactic City, but after being confronted by J…

A male Pyke worked as a capo for the Pyke Syndicate in 9 ABY. When the syndicate attempted to seize the city of Mos Espa from Daimyo Boba Fett, he led a number of Pyke Syndicate Foot Soldiers on Fett's position.

Kardo was a Mon Calamari individual who served as the captain of a freighter during the High Republic Era. After the Great Hyperspace Disaster, Kardo's freighter was repurposed as a mobile hospital just outside the danger area of the Hetzal system.

Ghenli was a human who resided on the Outer Rim planet Hon-Tallos during the High Republic Era. He and a group of his friends often bullied the Nautolan child Vroma, taking things from her for himself.

A Toydarian royal guard accompanied Toydarian King Katuunko to the moon Rugosa in 22 BBY. Katuunko was to meet there with Jedi Grand Master Yoda in order to negotiate the possibility of the planet Toydaria joining the Galactic Republic.

A female designer in Sienar Fleet Systems led her team in a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter project sometime between 19 BBY and 10 BBY. She wanted to see if the starfighter could handle mounting a pair of H-s9.3 twin laser cannons.

Werrera was a Ithorian Nihil who served as a technician aboard the flagship of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro, the Gaze Electric. In 230 BBY, Werrera was sent alongside fellow techs Cale and Leyel to carry out the sabotage of Starlight Beacon due to their loyalty.

Leyel was a human female Nihil who served as a technician aboard the flagship of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro, the Gaze Electric. In 230 BBY, Leyel was sent alongside fellow techs Cale and Werrera to carry out the sabotage of Starlight Beacon due to the three's loyalty.

Hapl'n Pichem was the chief seamster who created the uniforms worn in the Resistance. Pichem built upon designs once used in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, improving them for comfort and safety.

Svi'no Atchapat was a Taymar female singer who lived on the planet Corellia during the High Republic Era. Performing as part of the Atchapat Family Galan-Kalank Orchestra, she was a celebrity by the time she was a teenager.

Barg'no Atchapat was a Taymar male who was the older brother of Svi'no Atchapat. Like the other members of the Atchapat Family, he worked in a shipyard on Corellia as well as performing in the family orchestra.

Gavyn Sykes is a human male who served in the Royal Naboo Security Forces as an N-1 starfighter pilot. He flew in Bravo Squadron during the Invasion of Naboo as Bravo Six. At the time, he had been assigned the astromech droid R2-C4.
