x: Denolm Orr was a Human male Jedi Master who was the mentor of Sa'har Kateen. During the Third Galactic War, Orr was killed during a mission to retrieve a holocron from the Temple of Nul by the renegade Sith Lord Darth Malgus, who tried to turn his Padawan against him.
Steve was a human soldier who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Sa'har Kateen was a Force-sensitive Twi'lek female who lived during the time of the Old Republic. Separated from her older brother Ri'kan Kateen at a young age, Kateen trained as a Padawan of the Jedi Order under Jedi Master Denolm Orr.
Swarton was a human female captain who served the First Order. After the Battle of Batuu crippling the Finalizer, she commanded the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Steadfast.
Mun Liiv was the Sullustan male governor of the planet Abafar. He led an Abafar mining confederation of the planet's largest rhydonium mines, largely through his control of the Pons Ora refinery.

Jara was a female Nautolan who worked for Chancey Yarrow. She was well-muscled. She assisted in the ambush of several Jedi who arrived on the Everbloom station in the company of Xylan Graf while it was in the Dalnan sector.

Endario Zinn was a female Mirialan who worked as an agent of Chandrila Star Line. In that capacity, Zinn once recorded a video message to passengers who booked a stay on the star cruiser Halcyon in 34 ABY.

In approximately 3900 BBY, a famous Jedi Master blessed an expedition of three starships—Beneficent Tasia, Constant, and Mother Vima—departing from the planet Grizmallt to the galaxy's dangerous southern quadrant.
"Wrath" was the callsign of a human pilot for the First Order. They piloted a TIE/wi modified interceptor. "Wrath" once engaged T-70 X-wing starfighters in their starfighter.
"Nightfall" was the callsign of a Human First Order TIE/wi modified interceptor pilot and veteran of the 709th Legion. "Nightfall" once pursued an RZ-2 A-wing interceptor through rocky terrain.
"Whirlwind" was the callsign of a First Order TIE/wi modified interceptor pilot. "Whirlwind" once flew into conflict in their starfighter against three BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighters.
"Breach" was the callsign of a First Order TIE/se Bomber pilot and ordnance expert. "Breach" once executed an attack run against an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17.
A Quarren individual was present in a back room Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the planet Tatooine in 1 BBY. The Quarren individual had been kidnapped by a crime ring of Gotals.

"Dread" was the callsign of a First Order TIE/se Bomber pilot and was devoted to destruction. "Dread" once flew their bomber in a battle between TIE fighter series starfighters and T-70 X-wing starfighters.

"Grudge" was the callsign of a hateful human who served as a pilot in the First Order's starfighter corps. In 34 ABY, during the war between the First Order and the Resistance, the First Order traced a Resistance transmission to the ice planet Tah'Nuhna.

Darth Nul, born Raniah, was a female Miraluka Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire and fallen Jedi whose records were erased from history by the time of the third Galactic War. She was the co-creator of the Children of the Emperor alongside the Sith Emperor.

Viktor Hel was a Corellian bounty hunter who helped hunt down the Devaronian pirate Melos on Ord Mantell along with Koshka Frost and Krandak. Hel at one point piloted a Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter and fired its weaponry in space.
During the Clone Wars, a clone navigation officer served within the naval forces of the Galactic Republic under the leadership of Admiral Dao within his fleet.

Zint was an Aloxian Jedi Initiate who lived during the High Republic Era. Recruited into the Jedi Order by Jedi Master Cherff Maota in 230 BBY, Zint was present aboard the Padawan Academic Cruiser Star Hopper when the vessel was part of a Jedi task force sent to capture the Ni…

Kronauer was a human male Imperial officer who served as a Warrant Officer aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Tarkin's Will command ship of the Hunter Fleet during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Silver Fyre was an individual affiliated with the Aquaris Freeholders who worked with the smugglers Chewbacca and Han Solo on a job delivering spice. During the job, the Aquaris Freeholders hijacked their spice cargo, which earned them Solo's ire.
Rolan Aun was a Chief Engineer who accompanied Jedi Master Denolm Orr to the planet Elom to investigate a link between the planet and Darth Malgus. He was killed along with the rest of the team.
Gan Enok was a Jedi Master who accompanied fellow Master Denolm Orr to the planet Elom to investigate a link between the planet and Darth Malgus.

Ri'kan Kateen, known to the Hidden Chain as Hibir of Heta Kol, was a Force-sensitive Twi'lek male who lived at the Mek-Sha Home for Lost Children during the time of the Old Republic, and later in life became a Mandalorian and a member of the Hidden Chain.

Lerella Rosral was the governor of the city of Senoloro on the planet Auratera. She served a life term and was despised by some of her constituents due to her never-ending attempts to gain additional power.

A dark-haired human with big blue eyes, she was attached in some way to the Eriaduan consulate on Malastare — host of the gala at which the Dug winners of the Vinta Harvest Classic were being feted. She got drunk and flirted with, at the time, Ambassador, Palpatine.
Krylind was a Kage female child who was kidnapped by the Nihil pirates in 230 BBY. She was held onboard a starship with several other abductees, including Liam, Petri, and Avon Starros.
Tamo was a Mantellian Savrip who worked for the Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection.
A Sullustan female served as pilot of the Gymsnor-3 light freighter Star's Delight under Captain Lai Nootka.

Petri was an Umbaran male child from Hynestia who lived during the High Republic Era. In 230 BBY, he was one of several children kidnapped by Tempest Runner Kara Xoo's Tempest of the Nihil pirates as would-be recruits, alongside the Kage Krylind and the humans Liam and Avon St…
An Ithorian pirate was a member of the Nihil in Kara Xoo's Tempest, who operated an attack that resulted in twenty lost starships. He was executed by Marchion Ro with a sticky charge for his failure.
An Ithorian male worked as a proprietor in a cheap hotel of Coruscant.
The aunt of Jordanna Sparkburn was a member of the San Tekka clan during the High Republic Era. Serving as the San Tekka deputy on Tiikae, they expected Sparkburn to follow in her footsteps.
Lesha was a female individual who owned a club on Neral's moon during the High Republic Era. Sylvestri Yarrow considered her both attractive and cruel.
A Twi'lek female worked for the Ministry of Commerce of the Galactic Republic on its capital planet Coruscant during the High Republic Era.

A flight control operator served in the Trask flight control. In 9 ABY, when the Mandalorian Din Djarin arrived on the estuary moon of Trask, the controller asked him by the radio to reduce the speed of the Razor Crest due the port protocol.
Sha'nai Plouth was a Pantoran female who worked as an apprentice in the military of the planet Dalna during the High Republic Era. For training, she was partnered with the human Honesty Weft.
Jenth was an enslaved human of the Infinite Empire. A child of young age, Jenth had fair skin, short brown hair and brown eyes.

This individual was enslaved by the Infinite Empire. They were a young child with grayish purple skin. Like all Force-sensitive enslaved individuals of the Infinite Empire, they were named after a letter in the Aurebesh and had their letter tattooed on their face.

A Human male waiter worked in the Upper City Cantina on the Outer Rim world of Taris during the Jedi Civil War. In 3956 BBY, the waiter brought drinks to Gana Lavin and a young noble, apologizing for the time it took.

Asreal was a human Pathfinder who served the Rebel Alliance during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Asreal was selected by Sergeant Kes Dameron to accompany him as he attempted to rescue his wife Shara Bey from the Imperial Star Destroyer Tarkin's Will.

Theo was a Theelin male and the son of Dalnan Vice President Hackrack Bep and his husband Zian. In 230 BBY, Theo was kidnapped from Dalna's south meadowlands by the Nihil pirates and held hostage in a remote cabin in the Maawat Mountains.
Hackrack Bep was a Theelin male who served as the Vice President of the planet Dalna during the High Republic Era. Bep had a husband, Zian, and son, Theo.

An Mon Calamari male was an assassin hired by someone to kill Sylvestri Yarrow on the planet Coruscant. After he find Syl in a luxury hotel, he shot the server droid and tried to kill her. But Syl broke his fingers with a heavy statue.

A Hutt operated as an enslaver during the High Republic Era and owned a hauler known as the Fraunesaa. Between 232 BBY and 231 BBY, the Hutt was forced to stop at the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon, where he was intercepted and his ship then confiscated.
This unidentified child was enslaved by the Infinite Empire. They were a Near-Human with fair skin, a flat nose and long blond hair.

Murphis Sewellis was a scientist. Sewellis proposed a theory on the radiant energy of cross crystal focus, which he laid out in a treatise on the structures of Force-attuned kyber crystals and the focusing abilities of a triple-density crystal matrix.

A human Stormtrooper Commander served in the Galactic Empire during its reign of the galaxy. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the Stormtrooper Commander, accompanied by two other stormtroopers, searched the possessions of the former University of Bar'leth Sava Madelin Sun that …
A member of the Galactic Empire served as the governor of a sector that contained the world Antillion, where former University of Bar'leth Sava Madelin Sun sold items between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY.
Kyrie was a female human who was the aide senator to Ghirra Starros on Coruscant.
Macken was a Snivvian who served the Galactic Republic as Station Controller of Relay Post Epsilon One.
Ashdree Marq was a Balosar Female security officer on the planet Coruscant. She came with her team and shot the Twi'lek assassin who killed the the Gungan scientist Thaddeus Wolk.

Around 3643 BBY, a male individual served as the governor of the Mid Rim celestial body Fait d'Fait. The governor pursued strong anti-organized crime policies, and as a result several criminal syndicates sought the help of an off-worlder to help them make the politician recons…
Raithe Kole was a human male who served as the manager of performers such as galactic superstar Gaya, as well as other talented musicians such as Ouannii and Sandro Alimander.

Tracer Lore was a Vodran male who served as the security chief of the Outer Rim Territories planet Dalna in 230 BBY. He had brown skin, pupilless blue eyes, and facial horns. Honesty Weft and Sha'nai Plouth served as his apprentices.
A Kilji known as "Vassal Two" served the Kilji species' nation, the Kilji Illumine, as a Kilji vassal, a follower of the Kilji religion.

A Togruta male was a shipper of Graf family and the captain of the cargo hauler Belt Runner. His ship inexplicably pushed out of hyperspace into the Berenge sector. While he sent a message to his boss his ship were attacked and he killed.

A Gungan male who met once with Sylvestri Yarrow, spoke the common language with such a bizarre dialect that he inevitably seemed frivolous and a little foolish of it: all because it made it easier to free his chosen ones from their credits in the port game caves.

A Twi'lek male was an assassin hired by someone to kill Thaddeus Wolk on the planet Coruscant. After he find his way to his office, he shot the Gungan on his back and tried to escape. He was killed by a security team on the building.
Roy was an Ugnaught male mechanist who lived with his family member Klanna on the planet Tiikae. They were killed by the Nihil after the theft of a puzzle box containing important coordinates.

Klanna was a Ugnaught female mechanist who lived with her family member Roy on the planet Tiikae years before Chancey Yarrow left her daughter Sylvestri Yarrow in their home to study repairing hyperdrives and sublight engines.

Ezvangolt was a Grindalid who lived on Corellia. In 230 BBY, Ezvangolt was a member of the Garavult Clan. When Crash and her team where crossing through the tunnels of Coronet City, Ezvangolt, along with Vanizma, Zazima and Proxima, let them pass through the tunnels.

Vanizma was an Grindalid who lived on Corellia. In 230 BBY, Vanizma was a member of the Garavult clan. When Crash and her team where crossing through the tunnels of Coronet City, Vanizma, along with Ezvangolt, Zazima and Proxima, let them pass through the tunnels.

Zazima was an Grindalid who lived on Corellia. In 230 BBY, Zazima was a member of the Garavult clan. When Crash and her team were crossing through the tunnels of Coronet City, Zazima, along with Ezvangolt, Vanizma and Proxima, let them pass through the tunnels.
Rel was a human male who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic after the destruction of Alderaan. He was the childhood best friend of Max who later joined the Galactic Empire.

Ansh was a female Ithorian who worked for Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection. In 230 BBY, she worked on disguising Ram as a member of the Scarlet Skull Cult. While she disguised Ram she hummed and muttered to herself. She was noted as cheerful.
A Kubaz vendor lived in Coronet City in 230 BBY. The Kubaz sold Ram Jomaram a barat-karabak.
Vondral was a Zabrak female that served the navy of the Sith Empire as a Captain on the Executioner during the renewed conflict with the Galactic Republic.
A human male served as an Imperial officer during the reign of the Galactic Empire. At some point, he became acquainted with Crimson Dawn leader, Lady Qi'ra.

Corbus Tyra was a human male criminal. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, Tyra was contacted by the Kajain'sa'Nikto Vizam about a job with a reward of a million credits: to recover an urn on the planet Corellia that contained the ashes of Krestrel D'Naran, one of Jabba Desilijic …
Jarold was a Jawa residing on Tatooine. At some point, Jarold lost his droid R4-M9 in a sarlacc pit and requested assistance.
Varb Tenart was a male Dug who lived during the High Republic Era. In 230 BBY, he was the chief organizer of the Finance Ball at Coronet City.

Brox Anthar was a light-skinned Snivvian male criminal who lived during the time of the Galactic Empire. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, he was wanted for multiple accounts of grand larceny with the SoroSuub Corporation.

A Pa'lowick bartender worked at Club Silhouette on the planet Hosnian Prime. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, Marshal Buck Vancto traveled to the club in search of information on the Snivvian male criminal Brox Anthar.

A Twi'lek individual lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the Twi'lek provided Marshal Buck Vancto with a job to capture the Snivvian criminal Brox Anthar, who was wanted for multiple acts of grand larceny.
Augustus Graves was a Nimbanel male who was the CEO of the Corellian Engineering Corporation during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Kantuck was a Gigoran who was the personal bodyguard of Matriarch Catriona Graf.

Barus Rava was a Human male who served as an admiral in the Republic Navy of the Galactic Republic. Around 3625 BBY, Rava led a fleet to assist the Republic efforts during the Invasion of Manaan against the Sith Empire.

Beeta was a Corellian hound owned by the Grindalid Prybolt Garavult along with two other hounds, Serenata and Sibak. Serenata was part of the the Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection bodyguard business led by Alys Ongwa in Coronet City on the planet Corellia.

Sibak was a Corellian hound owned by the Grindalid Prybolt Garavult along with two other hounds, Serenata and Beeta. Serenata was part of the the Supreme Coronet City Diplomat Protection bodyguard business led by Alys Ongwa in Coronet City on the planet Corellia.

Graim Torv was a student who lived on Gus Talon during the High Republic Era. He was a third-year biology major and had two older sisters, Brana and Fai. He participated in the union dispute on Gus Talon.
Sachary Jeffington was a human female who was elected as President of the planet Dalna in 230 BBY. She was secretly allied with the Nihil pirates and the Tempest commanded by Tempest Runner Kara Xoo.
The father of the Pantoran Sha'nai Plouth was a male Dalnan. Distrusting anyone not born on Dalna, he disliked Sachary Jeffington when she was unexpectedly elected the planet's president in 230 BBY.
A guard working for the Herdessan Guild worked for the Dark Side Adept Lumiya on the planet Herdessa.

An individual was the Jedi Master of Jedi Knight Ronhar Kim. In 52 BBY, Kim and Senator Palpatine discussed Kim's father, Vidar Kim during the latter's funeral. During that discussion, Kim told Palpatine that he sounded—more and more as he spoke—as his master.

A commander in the Galactic Empire's Special Forces was stationed aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Herald. The commander assembled an infiltration team that infiltrated the CR90 corvette Thunderstrike as part of a hunt for the Imperial traitor Everi Chalis.

Jafloya was a Wookiee female who was the mother of the Wookiee Mallatobuck, who was nicknamed "Malla." At some point before Jafloya's death, when Malla was very young, Jafloya made a Life Day Orb for the Wookiee holiday Life Day for Malla.

Tivbak was human male who lived during the High Republic Era. He was obsessed with Svi'no Atchapat after they dated at a university. He used a tracker to track her, but he stopped when a court ordered him to stop tracking her.

Brana was a female individual who lived during the High Republic Era and was the older sister of Graim Torv. According to Torv, they were one of the more reckless siblings in the Torv family. They participated with taking over a college admissions office on Corellia.

Fai was a female individual who lived during the High Republic Era. They were the older sister of Graim Torv and was one of the more reckless siblings in the Torv family. They participated with taking over a college admissions office on Corellia.
A bodyguard served as General Vukorah's enforcer and assisted the latter in the takeover of the criminal organization known as the Unbroken Clan, on the planet Corellia.

G was a male Caarite who worked for the Metatheran Cartel trading concern at a base on the moon Tilnes during the Clone Wars. Circa 21 BBY, G was exposed to an experimental virus and transformed into a maddened mutant being.

Sinvatt Bovic was a wealthy human male collector who lived on the astronomical object Fytoun. By 22 BBY, he had a debt to the InterGalactic Banking Clan so vast that the bounty hunter Zam Wesell was sent after him; after she called in fellow hunter Jango Fett for assistance, s…
Helder Spinoza was a human male member of the Bespin Wing Guard in Cloud City on the gas giant Bespin.

A clone trooper participated in the Battle of Ryloth under command of Clone Captain Keeli. After helping another trooper blow a mountain pass to slow down pursuing Separatist battle droids, they were killed along with the rest of their unit.

Iglan'tine Nos was a Rutian Twi'lek who served as a sava and the Chair of Occult Archaeological Studies at the University of Bar'leth. During their time at the university, Chelli Lona Aphra and Kho Phon Farrus took Nos' class, where they learned about the Spark Eternal.

Malfac Orfk lived during the High Republic Era. He was a childhood friend of Alys Ongwa, although Crash thought calling him an friend was a bit of a stretch. In 230 BBY, he called Crash about Zeen Mrala using a holoprojector.
An Evereni male individual lived during the High Republic Era and was a member of the Nihil pirates. Years before 252 BBY, they had a son—Asgar Ro—with the woman Shalla Ro.

An Evereni male was the grandfather of the Evereni Asgar Ro and lived during the High Republic Era. They were a member of the Nihil pirates. By 252 BBY, to ensure that the galaxy continued to fear the Evereni people, Asgar's grandfather left the family and Nihil.
Isdam Edian was a human male who worked as a security officer in the Bespin Wing Guard, which was based in Cloud City on the gas giant Bespin.
A monarch of the Inner Rim Territories planet Pijal led the Pijali monarchy during the Republic Era and was a relative of the human princess Fanry.

A clone trooper commander served under Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Tohno. The commander organized the Galactic Republic forces on Zaadja in preparation for the assault on the droid manufacturing center.

A clone stormtrooper served the Galactic Empire early in its reign under Clone Commander Keller and his unit. The trooper was present on Toola following the execution of Order 66, and was part of a group stationed at the Toola Spaceport.
A Bothan served the security of Colliders Casino as a guard when Darth Plagueis and 11-4D visited the casino.

Marda Ro was a female Evereni who lived in 382 BBY as part of the Ro family. At that time, she was on the planet Dalna as part of the Path of the Open Hand cult alongside her cousin, Yana Ro. Marda respected and believed in the cult's leader, the Mother.
Rebel Friend was a human affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic who had light skin and black eyes and wore red-and-black clothing along with a black-and-white helmet and chin strap.

The Eighth Guard was one of eight Elite Praetorian Guards who served the First Order. The Eighth Guard carried a vibro-voulge, and was killed during a fight with Rey and Kylo Ren aboard the Supremacy subsequent to the death of Supreme Leader Snoke in 34 ABY.
Wandering Wookiee was a very friendly Wookiee scoundrel who had traveled across multiple planets and locations in the galaxy.

Taljo Stant was a journalist who worked for the Coronet Independent Media Network on the Core Worlds planet Corellia in 230 BBY. The bodyguard Alys Ongwa, who considered Stant a lowlife, threatened Malfac Orfk by promising to call the journalist and let him get a scoop on Orfk.

A human was the friend of Kes Dameron. Around 4 BBY, she was due to get married, and Dameron decided that to send her off right, they would travel to the betting houses on the casino planet of Galator III for a few days.
A Human male served as the security director of Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system, during the Galactic Civil War.
A Devaronian male worked as an official on the capital planet Coruscant during the High Republic Era. In 231 BBY, he told Sylvestri Yarrow that, she got a new spaceship from Xylan Graf for her work
A female Tarasin served as the second-in-command of the Wyrd witch coven on the planet Cularin during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.
A human female was the mother of Xylan Graf and the daughter of Catriona Graf.
The First Witch of the Wyrd was a female Tarasin Force witch who commanded the Wyrd witch coven during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.
Inaldra's Lieutenant was a female Human who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Osuno Whett was a human individual who was displayed as a statue at the University of Bar'leth on the Core Worlds planet Bar'leth by 3 ABY. The statue depicted Whett wearing a cloak over a set of clothing and had a pendant on their chest in the shape of a semicircle.

A Gran individual worked as a registrar at the University of Bar'leth. On the day they enrolled at the university, Kho Phon Farrus approached the Gran's desk where they asked for Farrus' full name for the new student registration process.
Grapa was a human Imperial officer who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.

A Mirialan male was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. The man had a Force power that allowed them to sense the feelings of others, which Jedi Knight and fellow Mirialan Vernestra Rwoh considered them to be quite adept with.

A human male was the village chief of a village located on the planet Genbara in the Outer Rim Territories. The village was attacked by Bandit Troopers approximately two decades after the Sith rebellion against the Empire.

A bandit commander was a human member of the Sith Bandit Troopers led by Kouru. Kouru led her bandit gang to attack a village for plunder. The bandits, some of whom sported stormtrooper helmets, rounded up the villagers in the square.

A male settler was a woodcutter on the planet Genbara. Once part of a broader group of settlers striving to rebuild their lives far from the turmoil of war near the Core Worlds, he came to live in the countryside of Genbara.

An individual was the cousin of a woman present on the planet Genbara twenty years after the Sith rebellion. One year earlier, the cousin was shot by a bandit with a blaster, and the family struggled to afford his bacta treatment.
A lord was the ruler of the planet Buna. An aunty carrying an apothecary chest shared a rumor about bodies going missing on the little red moon over Buna.

A male was the Crown Prince of the Empire. After the former Sith known as the Ronin destroyed the Jedi lord Hanrai's Imperial Dreadnought, the Reverent, near the Outer Rim planet Dekien, the Crown Prince issued a proclamation through the prime Imperial channel to denounce what…
Cowardly Courier was a Rodian courier who was supposed to deliver supplies to Echo Base.
318 was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire.

764 was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. Whilst attacking the Tantive IV under the command of Darth Vader, Fellow Stormtrooper 184 asked 764 for a password they needed for their mission, only to offend 764 in the process by mistaking them for 318.
184 was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. Whilst attacking the Tantive IV under the command of Darth Vader, 184 required a password to complete a mission for their squad.
A Rebel Commander was a male who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a captain of the Tantive IV.
Eight-eight-six-seven was a clone trooper that served as part of the 212 Attack Battalion's "A" Squad during the Battle of Sarrish.
Eight-eight-six-nine was a clone trooper that served as part of the 212 Attack Battalion's "A" Squad during the Battle of Sarrish.
Drohon was a Nihil pirate who held the rank of Storm in the Tempest led by the Twi'lek Tempest Runner Lourna Dee.

A human guard served the Pijali monarchy during the Republic Era. The royal guard worked under the Pijali Captain Deren in the Pijali palace on the Inner Rim planet Pijal, stationed in the Grand Hall used for monitoring increasingly violent attacks blamed on the Opposition per…

A pilot served the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. In 231 BBY, the pilot was sent in the patrol vessel Moonseeker, alongside the astromech droid Tee-Four, to trace a distress beacon picked up by the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon.
Darvel was a crewmember aboard the Galactic Republic space station Relay Post Epsilon One in the Galov system during the High Republic Era.
Wilkes was a crewmember aboard the Galactic Republic space station Relay Post Epsilon One in the Galov system during the High Republic Era.

A human Imperial officer served as a lieutenant within the Galactic Empire. By 10 BBY, the lieutenant accompanied Captain Tarl Sokoli to the Imperial Naval Academy on the planet Carida where Sokoli was to give a lecture.
An individual was a member of the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

A Falleen individual was a member of the Black Sun criminal syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Falleen visited Ord Mantell City on the planet Ord Mantell with another Falleen.

A Falleen individual was a member of the Black Sun criminal syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Falleen, alongside another Falleen confronted a gorgmonger in Ord Mantell City on the planet Ord Mantell.
Mill Alibeth was a Force-sensitive Zabrak female who served as a Jedi Initiate in the late Republic Era.

Rodrigu Battle was an Iridonian Zabrak pit fighter who fought at the fighting pits on the planet Nar Kanji during the reign of the Galactic Empire, where he was an undefeated champion among his class. In 3 ABY, he fought in a match against the underdog human fighter Tasu Leech.

An individual once served as a Sith Emperor of the Sith Empire during or after 4,000 BBY. The Great Sith Wars Bas-Relief later owned by the Sith Lord Darth Sidious had once adorned the chambers of the Sith Emperor.
A Mimbanese doctor served the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Fletchlin was a humanoid who served as a lieutenant within the Honor Guard of Lady Domina Tagge, head of the Tagge Corporation. In 3 ABY, Fletchlin and other members of the guard participated in tests of the Tagge protoblade with Tagge.

Keln was an individual known to the Ubese bounty hunter Boushh who was born in 9 BBY. By 3 ABY, Keln had died. In that year, on the day that would have been Keln's twelfth birthday, Brene, a member of Boushh's exiled Ubese crew, noticed that Boushh had been feeling off.

A clone trooper officer served within the Grand Army of the Republic's 187th Legion during the Clone Wars. The trooper held the military rank of Clone Commander and served under Jedi General Mace Windu.
Numoda was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi master of the Jedi clan led by Jedi lord Hanrai. Numoda was sent by Hanrai to the Engai system to root out smugglers.

Masamu was a personal aide to the Jedi lord Hanrai in his clan on the astronomical object Watoru. During the period following the disappearance of Jedi master Numoda in the Engai system, Masamu was present outside of Hanrai's study when the Twi'lek Jedi apprentice Yuehiro was …

A Grysk was the captain of the FateSpinner. During the last battle above Sunrise, fought between the Grysk Hegemony's forces and the Kilji Illumine and the Chiss Ascendancy, the Grysk temporarily commanded the FateSpinner, a Shatter-class WarMaster, "Jixtus"' flagship until Ji…

A human served as an officer in the First Order during its conflict with the Resistance. The officer was stationed in the primary fire control room of the Command Center of Starkiller Base at the time of the Hosnian Cataclysm.
Rac was a young, female Human Jedi Knight.
Nitoo was a Kadas'sa'Nikto male who worked as a merchant aboard Carrick Station during the conflict between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

A human criminal was a member of the Kanji Criminal Enterprise during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The Kanji protected the pit fighter Wyrmen Lictor as she won them a lot of money in the Garkata Fighting Arena on the Smuggler's Moon of Nar Shaddaa for winning fights.
By 3 ABY a woman was the wife of the human Danta Belissa, owner of a souvenir and antique shop on Cloud City's level 120.
A human female served as a private in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

A human male served as a corporal in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, the corporal was part of the Eleventh Division that traveled to the planet Ab Dalis following the scattering of the rebel fleet after the Battle of Hoth.

Haba was an individual from the planet Rei'izu. When they were young, the Sith conquered their homeworld and they were conscripted to serve as a trooper in the Sith rebellion. They were part of a group of ten conscripts that included Ekiya, Kabeji, Sae, Shogo, and Unsuke.

Sae was an individual from the planet Rei'izu. When they were young, the Sith conquered their homeworld and they were conscripted to serve as a trooper in the Sith rebellion. They were part of a group of ten conscripts that included Ekiya, Kabeji, Haba, Shogo, and Unsuke.

Kabeji was an individual from the planet Rei'izu. When she was young, the Sith conquered her homeworld and she was conscripted to serve as a trooper in the Sith rebellion. She was part of a group of ten conscripts that included Ekiya, Sae, Haba, Shogo, and Unsuke.

Unsuke was a male individual from the planet Rei'izu. When he was young, the Sith conquered his homeworld and he was conscripted to serve as a trooper in the Sith rebellion. He was part of a group of ten conscripts that included Ekiya, Sae, Haba, Shogo, and Kabeji.

A male individual served as a Jedi knight on Hanrai's clan on Watoru. He accompanied master Hanrai to the planet Dekien. He belonged to a hulking species with horns and hooves, as well as a bristling white mane.

A male human served as a Jedi knight on Hanrai's clan on Watoru. He accompanied master Hanrai to the planet Dekien. Later, he recognized The Traveler but Kouru, who was with them, hit him unconscious.
A human Imperial officer served as a commander in the Galactic Empire aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor, the flagship of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

An unidentified male trader was present in a bar on Lazerian IV, after catching a glimpse of an Akwin near Laz. Having snapped a blurry, unconvincing holoimage of the Akwin, he began to tell other travelers about the supposed sea creature, though most did not believe him.

In 19 BBY an individual served as Patriarch for the Chiss family Ufsa. The individual participated in a Circle of Unity in the same year. She allied with the Grysk known as Jixtus, and after being manipulated by him, resigned.
In 19 BBY an individual served as Patriarch for the Chiss family Plikh. The individual participated in a Circle of Unity in 19 BBY.
In 19 BBY an individual served as Patriarch for the Chiss family Boadil. The individual participated in a Circle of Unity in 19 BBY.
In 19 BBY an individual served as Patriarch for the Chiss family Obbic. The individual participated in a Circle of Unity in 19 BBY.

A commander served as part of the Vak Combine. In around 18 BBY he participated in a battle over Sunrise against the Grysk Hegemony. After the battle, he thanked Mitth'raw'nuruodo for defeated the Grysks.
Sister was the name of a trans female clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Sticks, designated Cee-Cee-Seventeen-Seventy-One (CC-1771), was a Clone Commander who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Fissis Fen was an individual who served as a Sava of the University of Bar'leth.

Sabacc Sav was a Selkath male who worked as a merchant aboard Carrick Station during the conflict between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. He shared his name with the game sabacc.

A clone trooper was stationed on the Venator-class Star Destroyer Tranquility around 21 BBY during the Clone Wars. The Tranquility was assigned to escort Separatist leader Nute Gunray, who had been captured on the planet Rodia, back to Coruscant.

A human served as a technician at the Resistance base on D'Qar during the First Order-Resistance War. As the Resistance was planning their attack on Starkiller Base, the technician handed Leia Organa a message, stating that the First Order was charging Starkiller Base and thei…
A Chiss first officer served the Xodlak family's Midsummer as the ship's first officer with the military rank of Junior Captain. He was a member of the Xodlak family and held the Blood rank.

An Ithorian individual was the Padawan of Jedi Master Sivad during the Republic Era. In the early stages of the Clone Wars, the two were part of a company that fought the Confederacy of Independent Systems in a siege on the planet Hebekrr Minor.

Sivad was a human male Jedi Master during the Republic Era. He was short and stocky, and had a florid, friendly face, as well as white-blond hair. At some point, he took on an Ithorian as his Padawan.
A Chiss male individual was a member of the Chiss Ascendancy's Xodlak family, lived on the planet Naporar, and dealt with the Expansionary Defense Fleet officer corps.
Jeremy was an individual affiliated with the Galactic Empire during the last stages of construction of the second Death Star above the forest moon of the gas giant planet Endor.

A Kilji known as "Vassal Two" served the Kilji species' government, the Kilji Illumine, as a Kilji vassal, a follower of the Illumine's beliefs. In 18 BBY, they served aboard the Kilji war cruiser Anvil sensor station under General Crofyp, an officer of the Illumine.

A Kilji known as "Vassal Four" served the Kilji species' government, the Kilji Illumine, as a Kilji vassal, a follower of the Illumine's religious beliefs. In 18 BBY, he served aboard General Crofyp's Kilji war cruiser, the Anvil, at the warship's comm station.
A Kilji served as a vassal aboard the Kilji Illumine war cruiser Whetstone under the leader of the Illumine, Generalirius Nakirre, in 18 BBY.

A Kilji known as "Vassal One" served the Kilji Illumine, the government of the Kilji species, as a Kilji vassal and followed the Illumine's religious beliefs. In 18 BBY, they served aboard the Kilji war cruiser Anvil under the Illumine's General Crofyp.

A Kilji known as "Vassal Three" served the Kilji species' government, the Kilji Illumine, as a Kilji vassal, a follower of the Kilji religious beliefs. In 18 BBY, they served aboard General Crofyp's Kilji war cruiser, the Anvil.
A Kilji vassal served aboard the Kilji Illumine nation's war cruiser Whetstone as its weapons operator under the command of the Illumine's ruler, Generalirius Nakirre, in 18 BBY.
An individual was a member of the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

An individual was a member of the Mourner's Wail Syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the individual was present in a safe house of the Mourner's Wail in the Undercity of the planet Milvayne with two other members of the syndicate when th…
In 18 BBY, a Kilji vassal piloted the Kilji Illumine war cruiser Whetstone under the command of the Illumine's leader, Generalirius Nakirre.
Zeto was a male human gambler active during the Galactic Civil War. He podracers during the reign of the Galactic Empire on Nar Shaddaa.
Koley Linn was a human male pilot who owned the cargo ship Ace of Staves.
A Grysk soldier who served the Grysk species' military and the Grysk operative "Jixtus" was stationed on the Unknown Regions planet Sunrise around 18 BBY.

A Grysk outrider was stationed on the planet Sunrise in around 18 BBY. The outrider and another Grysk soldier escaped the Paccian slaughter, and met Qilori. They instructed Qilori to bring a message to "Jixtus."
A Paccosh lived in around 18 BBY. Them, along with two other Paccosh confronted Qilori after his meeting with two Grysk outriders.

A young Wookiee was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station, which acted as a daycare program for younglings and was run by the Safari droid M1-RE, also known as "Miree." The droid was tasked with the study and supervision of all…

An Ewok youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station. The Ewok was shy and missed his homeworld of Endor, and the Safari droid M1-RE was tasked to help the Ewok. Sometime later, a Jawa youngling stole the Ewok's spear.
An individual who was a male Neimoidian served as the captain of a Lucrehulk-class Battleship as part of the Confederacy of Independent Systems's navy.

Olnom Grilnor was a Force-sensitive male Ithorian beastmaster who was native to the town of Teron's Bluff. He lived during the Imperial Era, and at some point during the Galactic Civil War, he fell to the dark side of the Force.

Idda was a Mriss female engineer who worked on the Wookiee starship Namrelllew in 22 BBY. Shortly after the beginning of the Clone Wars, Idda encountered Senator Padmé Amidala when she went undercover on the ship on a mission for the Galactic Senate.
Jek 15 was a Human Force-sensitive clone of Jek-14 created in Geonosis' Petranaki arena by Count Dooku around 21 BBY.

A Forceful female, Torva and her sister, Morana, had a falling out when Morana began a life of crime. Torva began training in the ways of the Force in hopes of becoming a Jedi Knight, wielding a lightsaber pike with a blue crystal at its core.
Antraya was a Naboo human female artist who was a member of the Torada Collective, a Naboo artists' group which consisted of individuals who did not feel like they fit in on Naboo.
Kharl was a human male from the Mid Rim planet Naboo. He joined the Torada Collective, an organization of artists who felt they did not fit in on their homeworld.
Xeebi was a Rodian female who, along with her daughter, was freed from slavery on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine by the former Naboo Royal Handmaiden Sabé in 28 BBY.
Oje N'deeb was a Neimoidian male affiliated with the Trade Federation, a Neimoidian-controlled megacorporation.
"Rather Suspicious Witness" was a Gran who lived on Tatooine. They were dating a Twi'lek, and was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley when Han Solo shot Greedo.
A Kilji known as "Vassal Four" served the Kilji species' government, the Kilji Illumine, as a Kilji vassal, a follower of the Kilji religious beliefs.
A skilled agent of the Galactic Republic's Strategic Information Service was forced to go silent to avoid pursuers during the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
An individual served the reconstituted Sith Empire as a military officer while simultaneously working to undermine it during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Norund Tac was a male glitterstim smuggler who worked for the Merchants Guild. In 0 BBY, Tac hired the Corellian smuggler Han Solo to perform a run to the center the Rishi Maze in order to provide supplies to a group of spacers that Tac was fronting for.

A sous-chef worked for the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs, who served as head chef at Takodana Castle on the planet Takodana until the castle's destruction in 34 ABY and then went on to start his own business, Tuggs' Grub.

Heelt was a Gran male criminal who operated during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Heelt stole a silvercore speeder from Boss Gyuti of the Black Sun criminal syndicate, which he intended to sell to two Snivvians.

Zast Tri'vak was a Lannik male senator of the Galactic Republic who represented Lannik. He was suspected of having ties to the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars between the two factions.

A Jawa youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station. The Jawa once threw around a ball with a fellow Jawa youngling, and later played the drums alongside three other younglings.
A Jawa youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station. They liked to scrap and hide parts of the space station.

A Jawa youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station. The Jawa once threw around a ball with a fellow Jawa youngling, and later danced alongside three other younglings playing instruments.
"Cookie Crook" was a human who sold a Wookiee Cookie at the Festival of the Ancestors on the desert planet Pasaana. They possessed light skin, wore brown clothing, and spoke Basic.

A Rodian youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station. The Rodian loved to play ball. On one occasion, the youngling played with the Safari droid M1-RE and he accidentally got stuck to Miree.

Ogara was a male Human Jedi apprentice of Hanrai's clan on Watoru, encharged with leading Yuehiro's cohort in his third year. He accompanied master Hanrai to the planet Dekien. He and his partner Tsuden were killed by a sith named Kouru.

Tsuden was a male Human Jedi apprentice of Hanrai's clan on Watoru, encharged with leading meditations. Tsuden accompanied master Hanrai to the planet Dekien. He and his partner Ogara were killed by a Sith named Kouru.

A clone trooper was a member of the 501st Legion during the Battle of Umbara, serving under Clone Captain CT-7567. After the majority of the 501st's involvement in the campaign, Jedi General and interim commander of the 501st Pong Krell betrayed them.
A Rancor youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station.
A Gungan youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station.
A Gamorrean youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station. The young man could be grumpy and irritable when his upper teeth came out.
Errington was an individual who served as Firebird Leader in the Republic Defense Coalition's Firebird Squadron. He participated in the Battle of Galov, where he died.

A Pijal varactyl served the Pijali monarchy, living in the palace stables of the Inner Rim planet Pijal during the Republic Era. In 40 BBY, it was the mount for Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi during the ceremonial Grand Hunt held before the Pijali Princess Fanry's coronation.
A member of the Galactic Empire's Advisory Council was a distant relation to Hobisan Vandron.
A male individual served as the captain of the Purrgil-class starcruiser Halcyon when it was owned by the Hutt Clan.

Wen Gallo was a Selkath female who was a Colonel of the Manaan Special Warfare Group. Around 3626 BBY when the reconstituted Sith Empire invaded Manaan she was a leader of the Selkath resistance that provided aid to the Galactic Republic.
Murl was a Toydarian slice doc who operated on the planet Corellia during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Erminia was a human individual who worked for De'Rruyet Industries during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

A female individual was the mother of Erminia, a human employee of De'Rruyet Industries. In 3 ABY, they were present outside the De'Rruyet Center on the planet Midarr where a replicated Nihil Path engine hyperdrive was planned to be unveiled at a confluence by Beol De'Rruyet, …

An Aqualish male was present at the diner of Panky's in 27 BBY. At that time, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Padawans Anakin Skywalker and Lorana Jinzler were also present, who were in fact, following Passel Argente's bodyguard, Jerv Riske.
Garm Bel Iblis was a senator of the Galactic Republic who represented the Core Worlds planet Corellia in the Galactic Senate.

Bran was a human who worked as an intern for the company De'Rruyet Industries during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, Bran and another intern was just outside of the De'Rruyet Center on the planet Midarr.

Fyodor was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a member of the Knights of Ren during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Fyodor accompanied the Knights as they undertook a Heist on Vader's Castle on behalf of Lady Qi'ra, the leader of Crimson Dawn.
A Hutt youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station.
Gehren Rand was a human Jedi Initiate who was part of the Kybuck Clan during her time at the Jedi Temple.
"Ren" was a Force-sensitive individual who served as the leader of the Knights of Ren—a group of dark-side practitioners. He wielded a red-bladed lightsaber known as the Ren.

A clone trooper spoke over a restricted military frequency with Republic protocol droid C-3PO, who called for immediate help for Naboo senator Padmé Amidala, who had been apprehended by Separatist forces on the planet of Rodia.
Celena was a human female who founded an anti-violence artist commune on the Outer Rim planet Nooroyo.

A clone trooper pilot served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He flew a Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry gunship during the Second Battle of Geonosis during the initial landings.

Draper was a human who served as a lieutenant in the armed forces of the First Order and was also a member of the First Order Supreme Council, a cabinet of high-ranking First Order officers, during the last days of the First Order-Resistance War.

Petri was one of four Separatist delegates who met with the Jedi Suljo Warde in the aftermath of the Battle of Jorra during the Clone Wars. A Neimoidian, Petri was one of three of the delegates that Warde killed at during the meeting after he had begun to descend into madness.

Niot was one of four Separatist delegates who met with the Jedi Suljo Warde in the aftermath of the Battle of Jorra during the Clone Wars. A Neimoidian, Niot was one of three of the delegates that Warde killed at during the meeting after he had begun to descend into madness.

Anap Ree-Di was a female individual who was a Jedi Knight during the Clone Wars. Ree-Di's connection to the Force allowed her to have a special relationship to historical objects and the ripples they created in history.
Checkbox was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served on the Arquitens-class light cruiser Stellar Rise during the Clone Wars.
A Zygerrian scout operated under the Zygerrian Slave Empire during the early days of the Imperial Era. The scout served under Raney in Old Ord Mantell City on Ord Mantell.
A Sith Lord of the Sith species served as a member of the Sith Empire's ruling council during the time leading up to the Great Hyperspace War of 5000 BBY.

A member of the Grysk species was present at the Sunrise system in 18 BBY. At that time, he was onboard the Grysk warship codenamed "Bogey One" by the Chiss officers aboard the Chiss heavy cruiser Springhawk.
A Human served as a member of the Galactic Republic's Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit. At one point, they were dismissed from service after a training accident that resulted in injuries.

A male pilot piloted Shieldship Nine, one of Administrator Lando Calrissian's shieldships, located at the Expansion Region planet of Nkllon, in 9 ABY.

D'urban Wen-Hurd was a Tholothian Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Keer Stenwyt was a female Jedi Knight and the former Padawan of Ma-Dok Risto who served the Jedi Order and Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Ma-Dok Risto was a member of the Jedi Order during the time of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Ruug Quarnom was a Neimoidian female soldier who served as a commando in the Trade Federation Home Defense Legions and later the Neimoidian Royal Guard during the Clone Wars.

Moragg Bomo was a Kel Dor member of the Jedi Order during the time of the Clone Wars. Shortly after the start of the war in 22 BBY, Bomo attended a ceremony at the Jedi Temple commemorating the advancement of several new Jedi Knights, one of whom was Bomo's former Padawan.
Shortly after the Clone Wars, a clone trooper flew an Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter on patrol around the Imperial space station Brighthome.
A clone trooper served in the Grand Army of the Republic early during the Clone Wars with the military rank of Clone Commander.
An individual served as a pilot in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The pilot fought at the Criigo insurrection where they saved several lives.
A Rodian youngling lived on the planet Hosnian Prime during the Galactic Civil War. She had dreams of flying for the New Republic.

Raptor was a Clone Captain who served during the Clone Wars as part of the Galactic Republic's 302nd Battalion.

Sparks was a Clone Captain who served during the Clone Wars as part of the 302nd Battalion within the Grand Army of the Republic. He served with Clone Commander Theo and Captain Raptor. Sparks wore a helmet with yellow stripes painted on it.
Connis Dav was a Firrerreo Jedi Initiate who was part of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Cyruss Okent was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

At some point in the era of the Galactic Republic, a Jedi Master set out on a mission aboard their personal starship, the Republic GX1 short hauler Intrepid Heart, to recover Sith artifacts. However, the Jedi and their vessel went missing during the mission.

Ami-Kat-Ayama was a Cerean female Jedi Initiate active during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, a few weeks after the beginning of the conflict between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, Ayama and her Initiate Clan were scheduled to undergo the Gathering on…

Rokura was a Gharal female who lived on the planet Langston during the Clone Wars. The eldest sibling of her family, Rokura's parents were killed when the Confederacy of Independent Systems attacked Langston.

Fillen Danisher was a male Governor of the Galactic Empire. He served under Grand Admiral Octavian Grant acting as liaison to the Imperial Army before moving on to project lead of the Imperial Mining Corporation.

Noxi Kell was a Jedi individual who served as the assistant to Chief Librarian Jedi Master Jocasta Nu. Shortly after the First Battle of Geonosis, Kell was sent by Nu to bring new Knight Iskat Akaris to the Jedi Archives for a discussion about her future in the Order.

Flummot was a Male Toydarian fence that operated out of Gandanta Station. Flummot hired some muscle as protection while he dealt with Black Sun agents who had acquired artwork from the Tion Hegemony, though was injured when the deal was interrupted.

Feldus Spar was a Neimoidian politician of the planet Cato Neimoidia's capital city, Zarra. Following the Cadesura disaster in 22 BBY, in which an entire district of the capital was destroyed, Spar oversaw relief efforts for survivors of the bombing.
Alluv Eyam was a Neimoidian politician who served as Cato Neimoidia's minister of defense during the Clone Wars.

Felix Yabir was a Sullustan Jedi Initiate during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he and his Initiate Clan were scheduled to travel to the planet Ilum to undergo the Gathering and earn their kyber crystals.
A female Force-sensitive individual who lived during the Republic Era served as a Padawan of the Jedi Order and was assigned to the Jedi Master Dooku for Jedi training.

Stub was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Galactic Republic and piloted a clone Z-95 Headhunter at the Battle of Umbara during the Clone Wars in 20 BBY.

This clone was a cadet and participated in the Battle of Kamino. During the assault on Tipoca City, this cadet and four other members of his squad got separated from the main group of clones.

Galway was an Imperial Special Agent. He was in charge of intervening in illegal enslavement in accordance to Imperial Law. Idealistic, he did not consider the hypocrisy of the slavery the Empire itself was involved in. He was injured while investigating rumors of slave traders.
Colram Vestig was a human gambler aboard the Halcyon and father of Wilmar.

An individual led a Cloud of the Nihil in 230 BBY. At that time, his Cloud conducted an attack on the Jedi temple of the planet Chespea. The attack was successful, killing all of the Jedi within.

A Gran pilot helped the rebel Wookiee warrior Chewbacca to reach the moon Jedha in 1 ABY.

A terrorist was captured and held in a prison station by 3643 BBY, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. While imprisoned, the terrorist refused to divulge any information.

Mala Thurya was a Twi'lek Jedi Initiate who was part of the Jedi Order during the late Republic Era. Alongside their twin, Alay, Mala was part of an Initiate Clan.
A male individual was the father of the Human male Novar.

Seth Horgon, son of Solk Horgon, was a nerf herder who was murdered by Malisan when he refused to sell Malisan's indenture to Alchibi Des. He looked down on those indentured to him. An attitude that rankled those outside the Horgon family.

Solk Horgon, father of Seth Horgon, was a nerf rancher. After his son's murder, Solk accused Alchibi Des of the deed, and attempted to circumvent the local justice system by convincing Marshal Jacobi Sterne to hang Alchibi without evidence or a trial.
A Trandoshan took part in a hunt, along with several other Trandoshans, in a village of Wookiees on the planet Kashyyyk around 41 BBY.

Ketar Nor was a male Neimoidian member of the Neimoidian Royal Guard who was partnered with Ruug Quarnom. Nor and Quarnom were sent together to visit the Cadesura district of the Cato Neimoidian city of Zarra in the aftermath of its bombing.

During the Clone Wars, a female barfly hung out at Trueping's cantina on the planet Coruscant. Around 21 BBY, she noticed the bounty hunter Rako Hardeen as he entered the bar and flirtatiously addressed him.

A pirate was a male Weequay who served in the Ohnaka Gang as part of Jiro's crew during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, the pirate located a starship with a disabled hyperdrive and main reactor and conveyed the information to Jiro.

A Mon Calamari was a commander during the Battle of Mon Cala during the Clone Wars. He assisted Prince Lee-Char of Mon Cala as well as Captain Gial Ackbar in the fight against the Quarren and their Separatist allies.
Haja Estree was a human male con artist who worked on the planet Daiyu during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Vektol was a human male who served as a captain within the First Order Navy, having command of the Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought Fulminatrix.

Immich was a human female who served in the Galactic Republic Navy with the military rank of admiral. During the Clone Wars, Immich commanded a Venator-class Star Destroyer of the Open Circle Fleet and was personally protected by two 501st Legion elite troopers.

Rothlan was a human general in the in the armed forces of the Galactic Empire who served on board the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Executor.
An individual was the master of the pilot droid PD-28, whom he taught to help others as they would someday return the favor. At some point by 3 ABY, the Galactic Empire stole PD from his master.
A Jabiimi Human male served as a soldier in the Nationalist Army of the planet Jabiim during the Battle of Jabiim between the Jabiimi Loyalists and the Jabiimi Nationalists.

Skora was a female Rodian chemist and underground medic who participated in the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition on the planet Vespaara. A chemistry genius, Skora shot chemically potent darts from her Dart Gun to heal her teammates and hurt her opponents.

Salman Paak was a human male Ferrixian who operated the Repaak Salyard on his homeworld of Ferrix alongside his son, Wilmon, during the Imperial Era.

Nax, a veteran of the Clone Wars, was a human male clone of Jango Fett who once served as a clone trooper in the elite 501st Legion of the Galactic Republic's Grand Army of the Republic.

Groff Ditcher was a brutish human who worked as the foreman of Tibidon Station, a sand whaling station on his homeworld, Tatooine. In 9 BBY, he shoved his employee Padu Cherd and threatened to pay him nothing when Cherd complained at only receiving half pay.
Matthea "Matty" Cathley was a Twi'lek female Jedi Padawan who was the apprentice of Jedi Master Leebon. She operated out of the moon Jedha alongside Oliviah Zeveron in 382 BBY.

Agira was an Imroosian female from the planet Imroosia who served as a handmaiden of the House of Organa on the planet Alderaan. In 9 BBY, Princess Leia Organa convinced Agira to wear her clothing as a disguise, claiming that Queen Breha Organa would find it amusing.
Niano Organa was a human male member of the House of Organa. He was the son of Duke Kayo Organa and Duchess Celly Organa, and the adoptive cousin of Princess Leia Organa.
Padu Cherd was a human male who worked as a laborer at Tibidon Station, a tibidon sand whale–harvesting station on the desert planet Tatooine.

Tetha Grig was a human female who worked as a spice dealer on her homeworld, Daiyu, after becoming separated from her family. In 9 BBY, she approached the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and offered to sell him spice, but Kenobi instead requested information.
Tredgar Volk was a Thuggatoris who scraped by as a bounty hunter. In 9 BBY, he spent time in the courtyard lounge outside the Den on the planet Daiyu before going for a meal of ribs at Swartz BBQ.

A human male was the owner and bartender of a saloon in the spaceport city Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. He had trouble with thieves threatening and stealing from him, but was saved by 9 BBY when the fugitive Jedi Nari intervened.

Syril Karn was a human male civil servant who was employed by the Imperial Bureau of Standards of the Galactic Empire, and had prior been a senior law enforcement officer for the Preox-Morlana as a Deputy Inspector during the Imperial Era.

The Time Grappler was a human who resided on Ferrix. It was his duty to ring in the beginning and end of each day by striking a beskar anvil atop a bell tower on Rix Road. The Time Grappler handled this task with reverence, adopting rhythmic poses before each hammer strike.
Daho Sejan was a male Pau'an senator who represented his homeworld of Utapau in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.

A Boosodian vendor operated an outdoor clothing stand called Chiu Mo Threads on the planet Daiyu. In 9 BBY, the stand was visited by the Jedi-in-hiding Obi-Wan Kenobi and Princess Leia Organa, whom he had been sent to rescue from capture.

Corran was a Force-sensitive human male that lived on the planet Daiyu. Corran and his mother, Nyche, desperately needed to leave Daiyu as Corran's abilities put him in danger. Corran's mother contacted a supposed Jedi named Haja Estree and asked him to get them both off Daiyu.
Gella Nattai was a human female Jedi Knight and Wayseeker who was active during the High Republic Era. She wielded two purple-bladed lightsabers.
Jayco was a human male con artist who worked on the Daiyu during the Imperial Era alongside Haja Estree.

Densin Clord was a human male deck officer who worked at a spaceport on the planet Daiyu. In 9 BBY, he dismissed a traveler seeking help about a delayed transport when he was approached by the fugitive Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, who explained that he was tracking a starship.
Chubbray was an Ewok male of the Bright Tree tribe who lived in Bright Tree Village on the moon of Endor.

Sprocket was a male Mon Calamari medic and programmer who participated in the Hunters of the Outer Rim tournament on the planet Vespaara. Around 9 ABY, Sprocket created the droid J-3DI, who also participated as a Hunter.

A Jabiimi Human female was a cousin of the Jabiimi Nationalists commander Alto Stratus. During the Battle of Jabiim between the Jabiimi Loyalists and the Jabiimi Nationalists, she had been shot in the gut with a blaster, and then, her legs were crushed by a Republic walker.

Pav-ti Tano was a Togruta female from the planet Shili who was the partner of Nak-il Tano and the mother of Ahsoka Tano. Living in a small village, she believed in the traditional ways of her people and wanted to take Ahsoka on her first hunt in 36 BBY, when she was just a baby.
Nyche was a human female from the planet Daiyu who was the mother of Corran, a Force-sensitive boy. In 9 BBY, Nyche and Corran resided on her homeworld.

Erk Zallis was a male Ugnaught who worked for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Before the Battle of Lola Sayu, Zallis was responsible for carrying about the carbon-freezing of the team that would infiltrate the Citadel.

Dardin Shull was a human male who lived on the planet Tatooine. In 9 BBY, Shull was present in a town square in Anchorhead when Inquisitors Third Sister and Fifth Brother interrogated the locals for information regarding the fugitive Jedi Nari.

A human female medic served in the Resistance during the First Order-Resistance War. During the Battle of Crait in 34 ABY she worked to support her fellow soldiers. She wore a Resistance tunic and blue armband with Aurebesh lettering.
Monsalmo was a Happabore that lived on the astronomical object Endovar under the care of Jedi Master Yoda and the Jedi Order.

An individual was present on the planet Tatooine around the year 0 BBY. They were armed with a hold-out blaster and also carried a datapad and a comlink. During a stop in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, they encountered a group of Rebel Alliance operatives.

Lobster Head was a weak and wimpy lobster-headed alien who enjoyed a powerful liquor known as lum. Around 0 BBY, he encountered a group of Rebel operatives in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on Tatooine. Already drunk, he challenged one of them to a lumguzzling contest.

Freck was an affable Condluran who worked as a transport driver for the Galactic Empire on the mining planet Mapuzo, his homeworld. Aligning with the Empire, he gained rapport with the local stormtroopers.

A Rodian worked as a waiter at the Convors Perch Restaurant in the Wealthy District of the planet Milvayne. At some point the waiter became associated with the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate.

Rosbuen Frisk was a female diplomat who served as the Galactic Republic's regional diplomat for multiple star systems. Cato Neimoidia was one planet she represented the Republic for, though she was typically off-world covering her duties in other systems.
Vivert Stag was a female Jedi Initiate whose clan was scheduled to build their lightsabers on the planet Ilum as part of the the Gathering shortly after the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.
Aytar was a male acrobat who worked for a traveling circus. He eventually started a relationship with the then Jedi Padawan Kantam Sy when his circus visited the planet Endovar.
Booma Ball Bob was a male Weequay residing on Tatooine. He was in charge of the Booma Ball Game and would reward the winner a Kyber brick.

Panicking Pedestrian is a character in LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga. They can be found by any gender or species as well as being found on all planets. They are frightened by someone or something and will not care to talk with the player and instead run from them.
Jam Javat was a male individual who carried the rank of captain and was an original member of the Pop-Dogs.

Keer was a bounty hunter and a member of Hal'Lath Quadruplets who was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Lady Domina Tagge of the House of Tagge placed a bounty on rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra.

A human was an intern for De'Rruyet Industries during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, they were present at the De'Rruyet Center on the planet Midarr before Beol De'Rruyet, the company's leader, intended to unveil his replication of a Nihil Path engine hyperdrive.
Neeso was a Rodian who lived on Sedri Minor during the High Republic Era. They were a parent of Julus, who had gone missing by the time of the mission to Sedri Minor.

"Doc" was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Doc fell into a trap within a fortress along with mercenary Asajj Ventress.
Karthata was a coach at a school located on the planet Tinnel IV.
Rees Rishikesh was a male Grand Counselor at a school on the planet Tinnel IV.

Lohim Nara was a boy who lived during the High Republic Era who dreamed of joining the Jedi Order despite not being Force-sensitive. When he was fourteen years old, he traveled from Level 1312 to the Jedi Temple, where he encountered Reina Bilass and Grand Master Yoda.

Kawlan Roken was a human male activist during the height of the Galactic Empire, who operated an underground network known as Hidden Path that smuggled surviving Jedi and Force-sensitives to safety during the Great Jedi Purge.
Wade Resselian was a male human dissident who was part of an underground movement known as The Path that helped smuggle Jedi hunted by the Galactic Empire to safety.
Sully Stark was a human female dissident of an underground movement that helped smuggle surviving Jedi to safety.
Tytan Latimer was a human who served as a security guard in Fortress Inquisitorius on the ocean moon Nur by 9 BBY. The lead security on his level, Latimer held the rank of lieutenant.
A human male with the military rank of captain served as a terminal officer in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army and was stationed on Fortress Inquisitorius on the ocean moon Nur.
An individual who was a human female served as a major in the Galactic Empire. By 9 BBY, the officer was stationed on Fortress Inquisitorius on the ocean moon Nur.
Skarhorn was a human male who served as a general in the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Skarhorn was present at an Imperial Complex on the planet Garel to open a munitions factory.

Jarl was a Weequay male who led a crew on the planet Coruscant by 22 BBY. That year, when the Mirialan Servit asked the Weequay about what price a family droid of his would fetch, Jarl, knowing that the droid was connected to the legend of the moon Shara'Tam, tried to take it …

Maree was a human who was the child of Imperial General Skarhorn and a woman during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, Maree was present when her father gave a speech at the opening of a munitions factory at an Imperial Complex on the Outer Rim world Garel.
The Bridge Troll was a male gurk that lived on the planet Lok during the Galactic Civil War. The beast was trained by the Sulfur Lake Pirates to guard their hideout after the Battle of Yavin.

An individual was a member of the Jedi Sturm Umbrik's Republic Pathfinder team. According to later family legend about her, she was killed during a pirate raid at the moon Shara'Tam in the Outer Rim Territories.

A woman was the wife of the human operative of the Hidden Path Kawlan Roken. She was a fugitive Force-sensitive during the Great Jedi Purge in the age of the Galactic Empire and was hunted down and killed by the Inquisitors of the Empire's Inquisitorius.

An unidentified small man was present on Neral's moon. He noticed Princess Rinetta Gan was wearing a gherlian fur tunic and offered to buy it from her for 1,000 credits. When she refused, he offered 2,000 credits and a hold-out blaster.
Xeebi's daughter was a Rodian female who, along with her mother, was freed from slavery on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine by the former Naboo Royal Handmaiden Sabé in 28 BBY.

A Togruta male individual was part of a crew on the planet Coruscant. In 22 BBY, while chasing after a droid that was known to point to treasure, the crew ended up at Dex's Diner, holding the customers there hostage.

An individual observed Chiss Mitth'raw'nuruodo, who had been exiled to a planet where Chiss Ascendancy Supreme General Ba'kif selected as it was likely that Thrawn encountered the Galactic Empire, from a discreet distance.
Gwark was an individual who was the chief of the Rishii during the Clone Wars. During the war, Geonosian Separatists attempted to take Rishi for its vast deposits of exonium.
Sturm Umbrik was a Pathfinder Jedi who was part of an Outer Rim Exploration Team that discovered the moon Shara'Tam, the location of a valuable statue.

A Mon Calamari male escaped from slavery in the Outer Rim. He was brought to the planet Karlinus in the Chommell sector, where he automatically became a citizen. The Mon Calamari was nervous at first but the Rodian Xeebi helped him comprehend his new freedom.
Tepoh was a genderfluid human hailing from the Mid Rim planet Naboo. The Naboo worker eventually joined the employ of the Naboo diplomatic corps and explored the galaxy outside of zher homeworld.

Zarah Bliss was a female spice runner and pilot who led the Spice Runners of Kijimi. In 40 BBY, Bliss allowed the runaway Jedi Padawan Lizel Liit to travel with her; however, the spice runner ultimately brought Liit to the planet Desinta to be auctioned to the highest bidder.

Varna was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic that held the military rank of Clone Commander during the Clone Wars under the command of Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi. Varna was killed while evacuating from the siege of Devalok aboard a Low Altitude Assault Transport.
A female individual was the mother of the Mirialan Servit. One of her ancestors was a member of a team of Republic Pathfinders centuries before Servit's lifetime.

Perturbed Party Planner was a Lanai residing on Ahch-To. They were a party planner and had set up much music and games, however, no one was dancing. As a result, the Practical Party Planner asked a Protocol droid to help get five Lanai to dance and start the party.
Practical Party Planner was a Lanai residing on Ahch-To. They were a party planner along with the Perturbed Party Planner and had set up much music and games, however, no one was dancing.
A clone trooper was an Advanced Recon Force trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic's 501st Legion during the Clone Wars.
Concerned Resistance Officer was a male Human aligned with the Resistance. He admired the late Admiral Gial Ackbar and wanted to get the rookie soldiers out of the traps on Endor, Crait and Jakku.

Aki-Aki Storyteller was a male Aki-Aki found at the Festival of the Ancestors. He told the story "The Rise and Fall of Panakin Slytalker" which was about a Jedi Knight named Bye-Gon Jim who met a young Panakin Slytalker.

Character Expert was a Aki-Aki found at the Festival of the Ancestors. They were the expert of the characters in the story "The Rise and Fall of Panakin Slytalker" which was about a Jedi Knight named Bye-Gon Jim who met a young Panakin Slytalker.

Rayyne was a Wookiee female navigator who worked on the Wookiee starship Namrelllew in 22 BBY. Shortly after the beginning of the Clone Wars, Rayyne met with Senator Padmé Amidala when she went undercover on a mission for the Galactic Senate.

Naijoh was a Wookiee male captain who worked on the Wookiee starship Namrelllew in 22 BBY. Shortly after the beginning of the Clone Wars, Naijoh met with Senator Padmé Amidala when she went undercover on the ship on a mission for the Galactic Senate.

Servit was a Mirialan male who owned an EX droid that was a clue to the location of a valuable treasure. In 22 BBY, he accidentally revealed the droid to Jarl, a Weequay who wished to take the droid for himself.
Tals Trilby was a Kadrillian male who served as a detective in the Temple District Police on the planet Coruscant during the High Republic Era.
Reina Bilass, formerly known as Reina Ganzee, was a humanoid female Jedi Initiate during the High Republic Era.

Reyé Hollis was a Naboo human and a sergeant in the Rebel Alliance Special Forces. The man from Naboo was one of the rebels who participated in constructing Echo Base. Despite his doubts about the Jedi Order, he soon bonded with the Jedi Luke Skywalker.
Uma Kalidi was a female Jedi Master from Devalok. During her lifetime, Kalidi saved her homeworld by single-handedly defeating an army of fear-naughts.
Hol Okand was a human male who served as a starfighter pilot for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Okand was a member of Gold Squadron within the Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps.

Pasaana Farmer was a Male Aki-Aki who lived in the Pasaana Plains. He was the owner of the speeder bikes that Finn, Rey Skywalker, Poe Dameron, Chewbacca, C-3PO and BB-8 destroyed during the battle with the First Order during the Festival of the Ancestors.

Mar-Ko was a male Human and former First Order Stormtrooper who lived on Kef Bir. He was a member of Company 77. He was digging for treasure after discovering a letter from imperial stationary on the beach.

Injured Wookiee Captain was a male Wookiee who resided on Kashyyyk during the Clone Wars. He was worried that his warriors were not going to live much longer fighting the remaining Clone troopers on Kachirho. He asked for assistance in their cause and to push back the clones.

Wookiee Choir Master was a Male Wookiee who resided on Kashyyyk. He was upset that his bandmates were not in correct positions and were making a mockery of his performance. He wished that he could be a Jedi so that he could use The Force to move them into positions.
A human male Imperial Navy officer was the captain of the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader's Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator.
Sliro Barsha, also known as Sliro Ruback, was a human male who served as a Director in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau.

A human female was the mother of the child Maree, whom they had with General Skarhorn of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, the three traveled to Garel, an Outer Rim world, where Skarhorn gave a speech at the opening of a munitions factory.
Zaycker Asheron was a male individual who served as the commanding officer of Halo Squadron within the New Republic Defense Force. Asheron held the military rank of lieutenant.
Dina Dipurl was a female individual who served as a pilot within Halo Squadron of the New Republic Defense Force. Dipurl held the military rank of flight sergeant.

Lizel Liit was a female Jedi Padawan in the service of the Jedi Order. Sometime between 42 BBY and 32 BBY, Liit began to wonder if she truly belonged with the Jedi Order, and ran away from Coruscant without informing anyone, including her Master.
Sono Molec was a Zygerrian prince and the son of King Atai Molec. He ruled over the Zygerrian Empire slave operations from his palace on the planet Kowak.
Enyo was an orange-skinned Twi'lek female. In 21 ABY, they served as an instructor for the Jedi Order at Jedi Master Luke Skywalker's Academy on the planet Ossus.
An old human female was the magistrate of the planet Hebekrr Minor during the Clone Wars, a pan-galactic conflict between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic.
A female individual was the granddaughter of the planet Hebekrr Minor's magistrate by the time of the Clone Wars conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
