A male colonel in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army served on the Mid Rim planet Haidoral Prime during the Galactic Civil War, policing the governor, Everi Chalis.

Axel Greylark, known in holomags as the "Coruscant Prince," or as "Chaos" to the Mother of the Path of the Open Hand, was a human male who was the controversial son of Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark.
Kilit Leader was the callsign of a male pilot in the Kilit Squadron of the Sith Empire. During the Battle of Corellia he led the squadron during the attack on the Coronet City's Aegis Base.

An individual was the Patriarch of the Chiss Ascendancy Chaf family. Around 18 BBY, the Grysk operative "Jixtus" offered his warships to the Clarr, Ufsa and Chaf patriarchs, who all accepted and gave the vessels safe harbors where the Grysk's ships had access to supplies and f…

Angus Laride was an individual who worked for HoloNet News. In 22 BBY, Laride was working as a field correspondent for HoloNet News on Jabiim. During the Battle of Jabiim, HoloNet News lost contact with both Laride and Jabiimi Loyalists spokesbeing Orliss Gillmunn.
Rokka Rey was a citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. She worked as the announcer for the gladiatorial games at the Arena Grand.

A Separatist male served as the quartermaster on the planet Hebekrr Minor during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Separatist alliance and the Galactic Republic. He occupied Hebekrr Minor and kidnapped a magistrate's granddaughter as well as her family.
A human male was the boss of Tonra who had a Cantin on the planet Tatooine during the Clone Wars.
Scraife was a male Twi'lek Lieutenant of the Galactic Republic. He was stationed on Belsavis during the Invasion of Belsavis by the Sith Empire.

Oliviah Zeveron was a human female Jedi Knight who served as the aide of Jedi Master Leebon, the representative of the Jedi Order on the Convocation of the Force on Jedha around 382 BBY. Zeveron was the younger sister of the eventual cult leader Elecia Zeveron.
Scout Five was the a Sith Empire scout who was stationed on Hoth and reported to Dorn Base.
Barash Silvain was a Kage female Jedi Master who declared herself the sister of the Ikkrukkian Jedi Porter Engle. She accompanied her brother on his adventures as a gunslinger Jedi in 382 BBY.
Werth Plouth, also known as "The Herald," was a Nautolan male who was one of the leaders of the Path of the Open Hand cult during the High Republic Era.

Elecia Zeveron, also known as "The Mother," was a human female from the Core Worlds who was the spiritual leader of the Path of the Open Hand cult around 382 BBY. She was the sister of the Jedi Knight Oliviah Zeveron.
Wan was a member of the White Maw who along with White Maw Guard T'uu was ambushed inside the Star of Coruscant by Languss Tuno and the Voidhound. Both Wan and T'uu were killed during the fighting.
T'uu was a member of the White Maw who along with Wan was ambushed inside the Star of Coruscant by Languss Tuno and the Voidhound. Both Wan and T'uu were killed during the fighting.
A Kailynn was a prisoner at a stronghold owned by Harra the Hutt.

Pharb was a miner who was part of the group working on Ilum for the Minos-Mestra Corporation. The miners accidentally unearthed the burial site of a Kaleesh warrior, and Pharb believed that the small shrine was a worship spot for some long-dead primitives.

Faris was a male Theelin Jedi youngling, who came to be trained by the Jedi Order sometime before the end of the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, he perished at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant when the newly appointed Sith Lord Darth Vader led an attack against the Jedi.

x: Vic Vankoh was a human male musician who once performed on the planet Scarif for an audience that included the Sith Lords Darth Sidious and Darth Vader.
Cath Erangris was a Mon Calamari female Jedi Initiate active at the beginning of the Clone Wars.

A Zabrak worked as a guard at The Den, a spice production facility in Daiyu City. When Obi-Wan Kenobi infiltrated The Den in search of a kidnapped Leia Organa, he was confronted by the Zabrak and a human guard who queried about his presence.

Narissa Delau was working in the Imperial Reclamation Service of the Sith Empire. She was part of an expedition to Yavin 4 that uncovered a set of Sith relics from the era of Exar Kun. The group was attacked by a Massassi, who killed Harris and scattered the rest.

A spicerunner worked as a bounty hunter during the Imperial Era, when they tried to apprehend young Leia Organa at the Daiyu marketplace in an attempt to get her to reveal the location of Obi-Wan Kenobi and claim the bounty on him.

Kaarf was a human who was prey during the Great Hunt of Malastare. Kraaf along with other prey, Jorr were rescued by bounty hunter Bossk, who was secretly using them as bait to kill Second Vice Chair Exum Jermit of the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

A Gran was a hunter for the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the Great Hunt of Malastare. During the hunt he was about to kill Kaarf and Jorr but was instead killed by the bounty hunter Bossk. The Gran possessed a blaster.

A male Dug was a hunter along with his younger brother for the InterGalactic Banking Clan. During the Great Hunt of Malastare, the Dug and his brother set out to hunt the bounty hunter Bossk, believing the kill to belong to their homeworld.

A male Dug was a hunter for the InterGalactic Banking Clan along with his older brother. The brothers decided to go out and hunt the high-profile target, the bounty hunter Bossk before the rest of the party during the Great Hunt of Malastare.
Mahlnor, also nicknamed Mal, was a Twi'lek individual acquainted with Gial Ackbar.
Sal was a miner who was part of the group working on Ilum for the Minos-Mestra Corporation. The miners accidentally unearthed the burial site of a Kaleesh warrior.

A clerk of the same species as Armo Malou was the proprietor of a supply store in the town of Anchorhead on Tatooine. In 9 BBY, he served moisture farmers Owen Lars and Luke Skywalker when they found themselves in need of replacement parts for their speeder.
An individual served as the dean of the University of Bar'leth on the Core Worlds planet Bar'leth at some point between 11 BBY and 3 BBY.
Herron was a man who was captured by the Sith Empire along with his friend A'zabii on the moon of Nar Shaddaa after they became embroiled in a brawl.
A red-skinned Twi'lek female was the partner of Galactic Republic Senator Orn Free Taa.

A male alien was a musician on the planet Tatooine. After his hovervan, and all of his equipment was stolen, he became homeless. After Max Rebo and his band went the same way, he told that the Jawas did it.
Aminar was a female nominally elected leader of the planet Desinta. Aminar served as the leader of Desinta sometime during the years 42 BBY and 32 BBY.

Dagan Gera was a Force-sensitive Arkanian Offshoot male who was a Jedi Knight and renowned explorer during the High Republic Era and a well-respected member of the Jedi Order during his prime, and discovered the paradisical planet Tanalorr on an uncharted trip through the dead…

Darth Voord was a Sith Lord who featured in the story "The Legend of the Noble Bonbrak". Described as "terrifying", Voord was said to have taken great pleasure in using his destructive heat ray to boil oceans.
A Human female was the niece of Huff Darklighter. She lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Sekhmet was a targon female who was owned by the former Acolytes of the Beyond member Komat on the planet Polaar. She was immune to the planets distronic radiation.

Dathan was a Symeong male administrator and slave to the Sith Eternal on the planet Exegol. He was friends with a Strand-Cast who was the son of Emperor Sheev Palpatine. In 3 ABY, Dathan helped his friend to escape Exegol.
Seeral Korrd was a Human male who served as a colonel in the Imperial Army of the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The male overseer of the Outer Rim planet Vernid's worm farming industry employed the man Devon Lhent, in reality the ex-Imperial Major Soran Keize, as a dig-rig worker around 4 ABY.

In 4 ABY, Tyros, a male dig-rig crewmember on the Outer Rim planet Vernid had a crush on a boy the next town over from him. The worker took a shuttle to his crush's town weekly. On one of the nights Tyros visited the boy, his dig-rig crew were at their local cantina.
Wilmar was a human boy aboard the Halcyon and the son of Colram Vestig.

Kardan was a human male who served as a general in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Not long after the destruction of the planet Alderaan, Kardan was present aboard the Halcyon and purchased what he believed was the Crown Jewels of Alderaan from the pirate Ma…
Nikka Xizen was a female individual who served as a commander within the Bespin Wing Guard during the time Lando Calrissian served as baron administrator of Cloud City.
Barbas was a smuggler who had his fortune read by Mila and Sir Kron using Bakurat on Takodana.
A queen was the leader of the Offen people in 17 ABY. She was born in 5983 BBY.

A non-binary Chalhuddan youngling was a Force-sensitive Jedi Initiate of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, they were part of a group addressed by Jedi Anakin Skywalker regarding lessons learned on the way to becoming a Jedi Knight.

TD-3300 was a human who served as a stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Not long after the destruction of Alderaan, TD-3300 was stationed aboard the Halcyon starcruiser under the command of General Kardan.

The Magysine was a fictitious Force-sensitive male of The Magys's species that Chiss Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo "Thrawn" created to confuse his enemy according to the enemy himself, the Grysk operative "Jixtus." Around 18 BBY, on the Unknown Regions planet Sunrise, Thraw…
A female individual lived during the New Republic Era. In 13 ABY, they had a daughter—Kadara Calrissian—with the human Lando Calrissian.

Komat was a human female who was a former member of the Acolytes of the Beyond. During her time as an Acolyte, she used her ability to track when and where starships exited hyperspace to become one of the Acolytes best relic hunters, and she led raids on ships as they exited h…

A Nikardun commander blockaded and occupied the Unknown Regions planet Rapacc with a remnant of the Nikardun species' Nikardun Destiny military forces around 18 BBY under Nikardun General Yiv's command.
A Neimoidian female was the grub mother of Trade Federation Vicelord Siv Kav.
Rajim Armin was a Zygerrian male who served Zygerrian Slave Empire. He was an advisor to Prime Minister Atai Molec during the Clone Wars.

"The Sphox" was a female criminal who operated a crew. In 21 ABY, the Sphox and her crew were hired by the twins Bosvarga and Cerensco to assist the Jedi hunter Ochi in his attempts to find a family and take their daughter to the Sith planet of Exegol.

Xarah Blacwood was a middle-aged female individual who served as a commander in the New Republic and was in command of the New Republic staging outpost in orbit of the planet Adelphi. She had sharp features, and had a bob of bright white hair with a metallic blue sheen.

Plo Mandrill was a criminal known to the twins Bosvarga and Cerensco. By 21 ABY, Mandrill had died, a fact Bosvarga informed his twin of when Cerensco suggested hiring Mandrill to assist them and the Jedi hunter Ochi in locating a young girl for the Sith.
Repreever was a criminal who, in 21 ABY, was hired by the twins Bosvarga and Cerensco to assist the Jedi hunter Ochi in his search for a young girl for the Sith Eternal and Emperor Palpatine.
Stiper was a Balosar male criminal who, in 21 ABY, was part of a crew assembled by the Jedi hunter Ochi to help him find a young girl and take her to the planet Exegol.

Jashei Zigler was a male individual who served as a lieutenant in the New Republic and was the adjunct to Commander Xarah Blacwood, who served as the commander of the New Republic staging outpost in orbit of the planet Adelphi.

A male individual was the father of the New Republic pilot Dina Dipurl. During the time of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, he worked with Zargo Anaximander, who operated Nightside, a station in the Therezar system, and was a supplier for the Alliance.

Orvakor was a Gen'Dai Sith individual who existed at some point prior to the third Galactic War. According to Jedi Master Gnost-Dural, Orvakor was imprisoned in a cell similar in design to the one used to imprison Darth Malgus following the Mission to Elom.
Krastan was a Gran male bounty hunter who wore a burgundy flight suit and was friends with the Balosar Stiper.
Kyra was a human Jedi youngling who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. While on the Starlight Beacon space station around 230 BBY.
CloneKL-555 was the designation of a human clone trooper from Kamino who served the Galactic Republic. At some point, CloneKL-555's doctor recommended that he walk 10,000 steps per day.

TK_9714 was the designation of a human stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire. At one point, TK_9714 rode in a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle, where they disliked the lack of windows and weren't allowed to sit in the front.

A pit fighter fought at the fighting pits on the Outer Rim world Nar Kanji and wielded a knife laced with beskar. By 3 ABY, the individual fought against fellow pit fighter Tasu Leech, who defeated them. In the pit fighter's dying moments, Leech took their blade from their grasp.

A pit fighter fought at the Garkata Fighting Arena on the Smuggler's Moon Nar Shaddaa. By 3 ABY, the fighter was sponsored by the Besalisk Doc Ragon in a fight against the pit fighter Wyrmen Lictor. During the fight, Lictor killed her opponent, costing Ragon a bundle of credits.

A member of the Galactic Empire was a mole for the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the mole sabotaged the reactor of an Imperial starship, which caused seventeen Imperial engineers to be trapped aboard it.
"Sigma 4" was the callsign used by an Imperial Starfighter Pilot during the Imperial Era. Sigma 4 piloted a TIE/IN interceptor as part of Sigma Squadron.
"Sigma 7" was the callsign used by an Imperial Starfighter Pilot during the Imperial Era. Sigma 7 flew a TIE/IN interceptor as part of Sigma Squadron.
Tor Phun was a Mandalorian male who piloted a Fang-class fighter during the Imperial Era, at one point destroying a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter near Sundari.
Vildar Mac was a Kiffar male Jedi Master who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he travelled to the moon Jedha to find himself.
Skarabda, known as Skarabda the Wise, was a Hutt female who served as the chief diplomatic envoy of the Hutt Clan, and later the Hutt Overseer, during the High Republic Era.

A Pantoran male was present in Cid's Parlor in 19 BBY, where he played against Omega in a game of dejarik, watched by a small crowd. During the game, the Pantoran used his Kintan strider to knock out Omega's K'lor'slug.

Viiveenn was a Wookiee female who was the daughter of Galactic Republic Senator Yarua. During the Clone Wars, she accompanied her father and Senator Padmé Amidala on a diplomatic mission to the Moon of Staggec.
Bok was a Kajain'sa'Nikto Morgukai warrior from Kintan.
A Human female worked as an attendant at the spaceport in Anchorhead on the desert planet Tatooine during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

A human woman lived in Anchorhead on the desert planet Tatooine during the reign of the Galactic Empire. She was present when members of the Inquisitorius arrived in Anchorhead searching for a Jedi who had eluded them in Mos Eisley.
The parents of Ketar Nor were artists who lived on Cato Neimoidia whose works utilized the bioluminescent oils procured from the trees native to Cato Neimoidia's surface.

Audj Seedol was a female Mikkian from the planet Lenahra. The sister of Casul Seedol and daughter of Ampher and Chemi, Seedol became the leader of her small community after the deaths of all of the adults who remained on Lenahra after abusing the Power stolen from the planet.

Zae-Brii was a Clawdite from the planet Lenahra. They were one of the older members of a group of children and teenagers who were left to fend for themselves on Lenahra after the deaths of their parents.
A female individual residing on the planet Mrlsst was a famed geneticist and professor and was the mother of the Human Daakman Barrek.
Raga Bua was a Kyuzo that served as the guildmaster for the Bounty Hunters' Guild on Batuu.

Zegundis was a female Dressellian mechanic who worked at Paolo's Chop Shop on Nar Shaddaa. When Zegundis was a youngling, Paolo passed away and Zegundis eventually took up ownership of his shop, where she employed the Kaleesh Ishtah.
Casul Seedol was a male Mikkian from the remote planet Lenahra. He was the brother of Audj Seedol and the son of Ampher and Chemi.
Banda was a yellow-carapaced Chiggnash criminal who operated on Nar Shaddaa, the smuggler's moon of Nal Hutta, shortly after the rise of the Galactic Empire.
Riley was a Chiggnash criminal with a brown-spotted yellow carapace who operated on Nar Shaddaa, the smuggler's moon of Nal Hutta, shortly after the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Loegrib was a male Mikkian from the planet Lenahra. He was the uncle of Audj Seedol and Casul Seedol, being their father's brother. When the Lenahrans discovered the Power, a substance harvested from a cave within the planet, Loegrib became addicted to the substance.

Santar, also known simply as San, was a human Jedi who operated during the High Republic Era and participated in the Assault on Mulita, where warriors of the Jedi Order and the Hutt Clan launched a joint offensive on the Great Progenitor and her Drengir progeny in the hopes of…
Mekedrix was a human male who served in Roon's military defense forces and the Republic Military during the Clone Wars, holding the military rank of commander.
Oron was a human male who served in Roon's military defense forces and the Republic Military during the Clone Wars, holding the military rank of lieutenant.
R'Tess was a Balosar born on the polluted planet of Balosar. At some point, she met the fellow Balosar Stolak Vandello on their homeworld and fell in love with him.
Stolak Vandello was a Balosar criminal and former member of Black Sun. He met fellow Balosar R'Tess on their homeworld of Balosar and fell in love with her.
Miril was a Chadra-Fan female who was the leader of the Ascendant, a cult obsessed with replicating the effects of the Force.
Ghess was a Trandoshan individual who served as the Record Keeper of the Ascendant cult that opposed the Sith during their reign of the galaxy.
