A Toydarian minister was present on the Toydarian Ministry Council on Toydaria during the Clone Wars. He was present in the alongside King Katuunko and a few other ministers when Alderaanian Senator Bail Organa and Naboo Representative Jar Jar Binks approached them and asked f…

A female Neimoidian was a historical figure in Neimoidian society. She was significant enough to be granted a portrait that displayed her in regal clothing posed in front of a hanging drapery. The portrait was hung in a gallery in Lott Dod's Palace.
This Neimoidian, historically famous enough to be granted a heroic portrait that was hung up in a gallery in Lott Dod's Palace, was a historic military commander.

A Neimoidian was a famous figure in Neimoidian history. They were historically significant enough that they were granted a portrait that displayed them posed in front of a golden background. The artwork was hung up in a gallery in Lott Dod's Palace on Cato Neimoidia.
A Toydarian royal guard lived on Toydaria during the Clone Wars. The guard encountered Senator Bail Organa of the Galactic Republic, who had arrived on a diplomatic mission to speak with Katuunko.
A Weequay deputy was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. The individual informed Hondo Ohnaka that there was a transmission coming in from Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Mama Gonk was the mother of Gonker, a EG-6 power droid. They had multiple children, but did not have enough money to send all of them to school, so only Gonker was able to attend.
An individual commanded the palace guard corps that protected the palace of the governor of the Galactic Empire's Candoras sector on the planet Poln Major.
A clone medical officer was stationed aboard a Pelta-class frigate in the Ryndellia system and was killed when the Malevolence destroyed the ship.

Hondo Ohnaka kept a massiff as a pet. It was tended to by one of his gang members. When Ohnaka safely delivered Ahsoka Tano and a group of Jedi Initiates to Obi-Wan Kenobi's Venator-class Star Destroyer aboard Slave I, the mastiff entertained itself by gnawing on the head of a…
A Christophsian senator was one of the senators held hostage by Cad Bane during his raid on the Galactic Senate.

This Twi'lek child and his mother were captured as hostages at a Coruscant train station by Cassilyda Cryar, who was being pursued by Ahsoka Tano and Tera Sinube. The child and his mother were freed when Sinube disarmed Cryar and knocked her unconscious.

This Twi'lek mother and her child were captured as hostages at a Coruscant train station by Cassilyda Cryar, who was being pursued by Ahsoka Tano and Tera Sinube. The mother and her child were freed when Sinube disarmed Cryar and knocked her unconscious.
This Kindalo lived in the Underworld of Aleen during the time of the Clone Wars. He and three others encountered C-3PO and R2-D2 when they fell into the Underworld.
A Kindalo resided in the Underworld on the planet Aleen during the Clone Wars. He encountered R2-D2 and C-3PO when the two droids fell into the Underworld, initially seeing them as intruders.

A Force-sensitive Togruta individual served as a member of the Darkseekers, a group who hunted threats to the Sith. At one point, he led a group of Darkseekers in search of the Chadra-Fan Miril, who led the Ascendant cult.

Fel Ix was a Kessarine male who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. He was one of Ferize's partners along with Er Dal, and in 382 BBY they hatched five children who were then the subject of a Naming ceremony that the Path performed, with one of the leaders of the Path, …

Fe Isle was a Kessarine male who was the child of Ferize, Er Dal, and Fel Ix. When he was born in 382 BBY, he was put through a Naming ceremony that inducted him into the Path of the Open Hand, a cult that his parents were a part of.

Fe Remine was a Kessarine male who was the son of Ferize, Er Dal, and Fel Ix. When he was born in 382 BBY, he was put through a Naming ceremony that inducted him into the Path of the Open Hand, a cult that his parents were members of.

Fe Tale was a Kessarine male who was the child of Ferize, Er Dal, and Fel Ix. When he was born in 382 BBY, a Naming ceremony was held that inducted him into the Path of the Open Hand cult that his parents were a part of.

Bruzo was a Pantoran male who lived at the Barakat Outpost on the planet E'ronoh. In 382 BBY, he challenged Princess Xiri A'lbaran with an archaic E'roni rite, believing that she was not worthy of E'ronoh's throne.
A Kuati senator served as the Galactic Republic senator for their homeworld, the Core Worlds planet Kuat, in 34 BBY.
Aquinton Ficnan was a Mandalorian male and a member of Clan Ha'rangir. He participated in the Showdown on Ruhnuk against Mandalore the Avenger's faction and was killed in the combat.

Valga Djenn was a female Mandalorian shock trooper and a beast master of Clan Ha'rangir. She participated in the Showdown on Ruhnuk against Mandalore the Avenger's faction and was killed in the fighting along with her tinebacks Bite and Bark.
Zavird Bretu was a Mandalorian female and a member of Clan Varad. She participated in the Showdown on Ruhnuk against Mandalore the Avenger's faction and was killed in the fighting.

Kaz Denko was a Mandalorian male and a member of the Ash'ad group. He was the nephew of Rykal Denko. He participated in the Showdown on Ruhnuk against Mandalore the Avenger's faction and was killed in the fighting.

Davran the Inferno was a male Mandalorian shock trooper and a member of the Dar'manda. He participated in the Showdown on Ruhnuk against Mandalore the Avenger's faction and was killed in the fighting.
Dylah Ha'rangir was a Mandalorian female and a lieutenant of Clan Ha'rangir. She was killed during the Showdown on Ruhnuk against Mandalore the Avenger's faction.

Arla Ha'rangir was a female Mandalorian shock trooper and a member of Clan Ha'rangir. She survived the Showdown on Ruhnuk against Mandalore the Avenger's faction but was later captured and brought before Clan Vizla.
A clone trooper served the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Helion Volte was a Mikkian Jedi Master who was part of Galactic Republic Outer Rim Exploration Team Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven during the High Republic Era.
Benj Marko was a human Jedi Padawan during the High Republic Era who was apprenticed to Jedi Master Helion Volte.
Sallee Ooph was a human who was part of Galactic Republic Outer Rim Exploration Team Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven during the High Republic Era.
Grint Rupar was a Britarro who was the medic of Galactic Republic Outer Rim Exploration Team Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven during the High Republic Era.

An Aqualish female individual served the Nihil. In 230 BBY, she was responsible for guarding the Mon Calamari Ghal Tarpfen, whom the Nihil had kidnapped. Tarpfen was able to overtake the Aqualish, however, and escape.

An individual lived during the Imperial Era and served in the bureaucracy of the Galactic Empire. They were also a friend of the Quaraxian criminal Phaedra. At one point the individual came to owe Phaedra a favor.

Castor was a gardener on the Galactic Republic's Starlight Beacon space station. In 231 BBY, Administrator Velko Jahen of Starlight asked Castor to force the station's gardens to bloom for the visiting Galactic Agricultural Alliance, which she felt was a small ask seeing as th…

An unidentified Muun judge presided over the trial of the Core Five, the leadership of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, in 20 BBY. The Core Five faced trial for embezzling funds intended to help refugees displaced by the Clone Wars.

Rev Ferrol was a human male who was the son of Viceroy Ferrol of the planet E'ronoh. In 382 BBY, after E'roni Princess Xiri A'lbaran brought an end to the Eiram and E'ronoh War by deciding to marry Prince Phan-tu Zenn of Eiram, Rev and his father helped form the terrorist orga…

t: Unidentified Guardians of the Whills representative
x: A member of the Guardians of the Whills religious order represented the Guardians on the Convocation of the Force—a council that promoted understanding between a number of Force groups on the Mid Rim moon Jedha—during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY.
Zumeg was a Talpiddian individual who served as an archivist as part of the Disciples of the Whills at the Temple of the Kyber in the Holy City on the moon Jedha in 382 BBY.

Feric Oranalli was a corrupt Dressellian male who worked at the Temple of the Kyber in the Holy City on the moon Jedha as an archivist and the assistant to archivist Zumeg as members of the Disciples of the Whills.
The Thing from the Stars was a giant Tarsarian devourer owned by a Gormak known as the Nightmare Pilgrim. Both were killed on Voss around 3640 BBY.

Forvan was a human male who lived as a member of the Colony of Kezarat in No-Space, where the headquarters of the Nihil, a group of marauders, was once located. Forvan was the son of the Blythe, the captain of the convoy.
This Dragon Lord was the leader of the Dragon Lords of Drexel.
This militiaman warned Biggs Darklighter about the Tusken Raiders.
This rebel soldier was saved by Han Solo after being attacked by the Galactic Empire.

Ick'rik was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. By 382 BBY, Jedi Padawan Silandra Sho crawled into a saphantine creature's burrow while on the astronomical object Taltos with fellow Padawan Creighton Sun, later telling Master Ick'rik that she had done…
Tivva's father was a male Twi'lek father of Tivva and Ce'na. He disappeared early on, and the girls never knew their father.

A male prisoner of the Galactic Empire was held in the prison on the moon Narkina 5, where inmates produced machinery for the Empire. At the end of his sentence in 5 BBY, the prisoner was not freed but instead transferred to a different level of the facility the next day.

Lian Cerox was a human female ambassador of the planet Eiram who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, Cerox and fellow ambassador Tintak were the two chosen representatives for Eiram and E'ronoh at the summit on Jedha.

Tintak was a human ambassador of E'ronoh who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, Tintak and fellow ambassador Lian Cerox were the two chosen representatives for Eiram and E'ronoh at the summit on Jedha.
A Muqularan from Muqular once talked with Lando Calrissian at Sennifer's Beam and Balance.

A female individual was the wife of ISB Supervisor Lonni Jung. Following her daughter's birth at some point between 6 BBY and 5 BBY, her husband wished to resign as an ISB officer and spy for Luthen Rael to instead work at her family's import business, but Rael pointed out to …
Banks was a male member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War, and a companion of Erisson Flask. Banks was wounded in a gunfight on Kwenn Space Station.
Ferrol was a human male who was the Viceroy of the planet E'ronoh and one of Monarch A'lbaran's closest advisors.

This Aleena lived on Aleen during the Clone Wars. When clone troopers arrived on the planet, he welcomed them, and was then part of the group sent to repair and survey the local Republican communication station that was affected by an earthquake.

A male Aleena lived on the planet Aleen during the events of the Clone Wars. He showed Sinker and his team the entrance to the Republic communication station that had been affected by earthquakes on the planet and was under debris.

Tilson Graf was a human male member of the hyperspace prospecting Graf family during the High Republic Era. After mediator Morton San Tekka died, Tilson offered himself to take Morton's place as mediator.
Mesook was a human Guardian of the Whills and friend of Jedi Silandra Sho during the High Republic Era. Around 382 BBY, Mesook met Sho, who was on Jedha undertaking a pilgrimage.
Selik was an Iridonian Zabrak who served as a Guardian of the Whills, and was a friend of fellow Guardian Mesook during the High Republic Era.
Mylas was a Duros child who was one of the Path of the Open Hand's Littles. In 382 BBY, Milus and other Littles found a new home in the Healing house on Jedha. They were protected by Marda Ro.

Naddie was a human female who was one of the Path of the Open Hand's Littles. In 382 BBY, she gave Jedi Master Silandra Sho a flower in the Holy City of the moon Jedha, but was warned about doing so by Marda Ro—an Evereni who served as the Path's Guide—as the Path believed the…
Pela was a Togruta who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. In 382 BBY, Pela lived at the healing house on Jedha with the other members of the Path.
Phinea was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. In 382 BBY, Phinea lived in the Healing house on Jedha together with Marda Ro and other members of the Path.

Wilco was a clone trooper who served as a stormtrooper and Clone Captain in the army of the Galactic Empire following the end of the Clone Wars between 19 BBY and 18 BBY. He oversaw the transfer of the late Count Dooku's war chest from the count's palace on the planet Serenno.

Romar Adell was a human male from Serenno. Adell was, at one time, affiliated with the Confederacy of Independent Systems but eventually lost faith in Dooku, the Separatist Head of State and reigning Count of Serenno as he plundered his own people during the Clone Wars.
CT-8801 was a clone trooper of the Galactic Republic who fought as part of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Har'kin was a Gran Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. During the Battle of Jedha, Masters Har'kin, Vohlan and Xinith Tarl arrived on Jedha to assist Master Creighton Sun and Jedi Knight Aida Forte end the fight.

Vohlan was a human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. During the Battle of Jedha, Masters Vohlan, Har'kin and Xinith Tarl arrived on Jedha to assist Master Creighton Sun and Jedi Knight Aida Forte end the fight.
Xinith Tarl was a Bith Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.

CT-3278 was a clone who served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper in the Imperial Army. Several months after the conclusion of the Clone Wars, CT-3278 was stationed on the planet of Serenno as part of company under the command of Captain Wilco.
Resamond Saous was a human who served as a prefect of the Church of the Force during the High Republic Era.
Blythe was an Abyssin male who was the father of the human Forvan. The two were members of the Colony of Kezarat in No-Space, which Blythe was the captain of.
This gundark encountered Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi on Vanqor, being trapped in a cave by Ahsoka Tano and members of the 501st Legion.

A clone trooper served in the Grand Army of the Republic early during the Clone Wars. After the Grand Army of the Republic repelled the Separatist attack on planet Langston, Jedi Knights Anakin Skywalker and D'urban Wen-Hurd were dispatched on an aid mission there alongside th…

A Jedi Initiate served in the Jedi Order early during the Clone Wars. After the Grand Army of the Republic repelled the Separatist attack on planet Langston, Jedi Knights Anakin Skywalker and D'urban Wen-Hurd and five initiates were dispatched on an aid mission there alongside…

A Neimoidian female who served as a judge in Cato Neimoidia during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, following the Cadesura disaster in the capital city Zarra, she led the trial of Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and found him guilty.

Tavah Whey Term was an Uyterran advisor for the Senator Lexi Dio. Alongside Dio and her other advisors, Mages Jink, Benet Pryer, and Half'pelt Sen, Term brought to the Galactic Republic a healthy distain for centralization of the planet Uyter.
Gren was a Mythrol mercenary and part of Dro-Nal-Pru's mercenary army during the High Republic Era. While working for Dro-Nal-Pru, Gren was scrached by a Xunji and turned into one.
During the High Republic Era, an Evereni woman attacked a Pantoran man because she believed herself to have been slighted.

A clone navigation officer served under the command of Jedi General Even Piell around the time they were captured by the Separatist Alliance and imprisoned at the Citadel on Lola Sayu in 20 BBY during the Clone Wars.
Half'pelt Sen was an advisor for Senator Lexi Dio. They were born on the planet Uyter.
Benet Pryer was an advisor for Senator Lexi Dio. They were born on the planet Uyter.
Mages Jink was an advisor for Senator Lexi Dio. They were born on the planet Uyter.

A female individual was the granddaughter of Human Imperial general Deerian. She was born in 17 BBY. In 0 ABY, Deerian attended a party hosted by Imperial Moff Glovstoak in his palace, where he met the eighteen-year-old Emperor's Hand Mara Jade.
A male Rodian served as the attendant at the desk of the Spider Arms Hostel in slum district G17 of Coruscant's underworld during the Clone Wars.
Bree Menaren was a young Scalvi boy who lived on Turrak during the High Republic Era. Jedi Master Yoda helped him and his family in the struggle against Crulkon raiders.
A Chiss male of the Chiss Ascendancy's Stybla family served as the family's Patriel on the Ascendancy's planet Rhigar.
A member of the Tagge family was known to the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka, who believed them to be unusually chatty.
Cherro was a Tunguray female from the planet Tunguray who spoke Tunguray. She lived on Coruscant.

A Toydarian Royal Guard lived in King Katuunko's palace around 20 BBY. When Savage Opress attacked, the guard informed Katuunko about the intruder and was ordered, along with the rest of the guards, to stop him.
Around 33 BBY, a male Sluissi from Sluis Van served as Senator for the Galactic Senate.
Around 33 BBY, a male Sullustan from Sullust served as Senator for the Galactic Senate.

The Apex Vanguard was a mutant creature developed as a weapon inside Czerka Corporation's CI-004 Research Facility on Dxun. It was eventually killed by the team sent to handle the cleanup of the CI-004 Incident.

Kodo was a male sergeant of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Along with Captain Dogah he accompanied Lord Ziliss to the Dantooine Jedi Enclave where they fought the Alliance Commander, Arn Peralun, and Aryn Leneer and were killed.

A male factory worker was an employee of a decommissioning facility on the planet Corellia during the Clone Wars. With the end of the war and the formation of the Galactic Empire, the Separatist battle droids were decommissioned.
CC-1226 was a clone trooper who was created to serve the Republic Military. During the early Imperial Era, the clone served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper officer in the Imperial Military.
Wyler was a clone stormtrooper who served under the Galactic Empire. Wyler served under the command of Commander Cody and was killed during a mission on the planet Desix.
Nova was a clone stormtrooper who served under the Galactic Empire. Nova served under the command of Commander Cody during a Mission to Desix.

Grotton was a human who served as the governor of Desix early in the reign of the Galactic Empire. When assuming his post, he was held hostage by the unrecognized governor Tawni Ames after he relieved her, who led the planet with the aid of her Separatist holdout.
A drunk Toydarian prisoner was arrested at dawn for urinating on passing speeders on the planet Coruscant's Level 1392 in 382 BBY.

"JM-909" was the designation of a human male Imperial Stormtrooper Commander. In 1 BBY, he was stationed on the planet Tatooine as the unit leader of his squad. He and his squad were eventually ambushed by a band of Tusken Raiders, who stole their rations and weapons.

EQ-005 was the designation of an Imperial stormtrooper. Around 1 BBY, they were stationed on the planet Tatooine as as part of a squad led by JM-909. During a mission, EQ-005 was assigned two other stormtroopers to flank suspected Tusken Raiders from the south.

ND-221 was the designation of an Imperial stormtrooper. In 1 BBY, they were stationed on the planet Tatooine as as part of a squad led by JM-909. Ahead of a skirmish, ND-221 was assigned two other stormtroopers and flanked suspected Tusken Raiders from the north.

A Galactic Republic senator represented the planet Ord Mantell in the Galactic Senate in 34 BBY. During a session of the Galactic Senate that took place in the Senate Rotunda on the planet Coruscant involving a discussion about raising a military force, the senator asked why t…
Representative Nulo was a female Selkath diplomat. She spoke with the Alliance Commander at the end of their part in the Invasion of Manaan of Manaan.

Major Cadmael Benthos Dosk was a military officer of the Sith Empire. He was assigned a key part of retrieving the kolto during the Invasion of Manaan. He came into conflict with colonel Gallo and the Alliance Commander, attempting to kill both of then.
Glotha was a male Hutt. During Glotha's anniversary, the Houk criminal Skadge forced Glotha to devour himself.
Harjaggo, also known as Harjaggo the Grasping, was a male Hutt who served as a minor lieutenant in the Hutt Cartel.

Voostaggano, also known as Voostaggano the Indomitable, was a male individual who was a champion gladiator. The night before a showdown with the Wookiee gladiator Bowdaar, Voostaggano's appetite had caused him to ingest a blood parasite.

Kettch was a dark-furred Ewok present on Endor around 4 ABY. After the Battle of Endor, he was involved in the brief conflict between the Ewoks and their fellow Rebellion allies, the Lahsbees, which developed at the instigation of the Hiromi known as Hirog.
An reek fought and was killed at Petranaki Arena during the First Battle of Geonosis.
An acklay fought and was killed at Petranaki Arena during the First Battle of Geonosis.
A nexu fought and was killed at Petranaki Arena during the First Battle of Geonosis.

A non-Human served the Empire of the Hand as an Armor Commander. In 8 ABY, during a battle between the Empire of the Hand and the forces of the Storm-hair Warlord Nuso Esva on the Unknown Regions planet Quethold, the Armor Commander deployed nine juggernaut tanks under Imperia…
Barnabas Vim was a legendary human Jedi Master who was the Master of Padawan Vix Fonnick. In 482 BBY, Vim traveled with his Padawan to the planet Angcord in search of the Echo Stone.
A royal trooper served in the Royal Naboo Security Forces and lived in a Human Naboo village on the planet Naboo.

A human native of the Inner Rim planet Pijal's moon was a holovid artist who became a member of the Opposition, a political performance troupe active on Pijal, during the Republic Era. At some point, she learned how to track electronic signals.
Jeef was an individual who wanted to know if Caleen Salyard, a salvage yard on the planet Ferrix, was going to join in on a bid for a run to the planet Wobani in 5 BBY.
Bosco Brix, also known as The Mad Bomber, was a racer who participated in Riot Racing on the planet Serolonis.
Grini Millegi was a male Dowutin gangster who was an associate of Ciddarin Scaleback.

Jet Venim was a Nosaurian racer who participated in Riot Racing on the planet Serolonis. He worked under the Dowutin Grini Millegi. Venim was a skilled racer who was accustomed to winning. He spoke in Nosaurian.

Kane, also known as Steel Claw, was a Nikto racer who participated in Riot Racing on the planet Serolonis. Kane worked with another racer Jet Venim to grab hold of opponents who threaten Venim's chance on winning.

A human male coastal defender stormtrooper served the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the trooper was present with other troopers aboard a transport on the planet Bestine IV, serving under the command of the cyborg Beilert Valance, as the tran…

Coromont Vizzle was an alien criminal and associate of pirate queen Maz Kanata during the High Republic Era. A famed outlaw, Vizzle's name was echoed throughout the galaxy in songs, many of which he penned himself.
An announcer that commentated races for the Safa Toma Classic on the planet Serolonis.

A Gran lived during the Imperial Era. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, they was present on the Smuggler's Moon Nar Shaddaa and witnessed the arrivial of the smuggler Han Solo onto the moon aboard the Millennium Falcon.
The father of Sleta Suke served as the ambassador from Orto to Coruscant.

A human worked as a guard at The Den, a spice production facility in Daiyu City. When Obi-Wan Kenobi infiltrated The Den in search of a kidnapped Leia Organa, he was confronted by the human and a Zabrak guard who queried about his presence.

An individual worked as a spicerunner and bounty hunter and, along with another individual, attempted to apprehend young Leia Organa at the Daiyu marketplace in an attempt to get her to reveal the location of Obi-Wan Kenobi and claim the bounty on him.
Drrn was a Muun who lived during the High Republic Era. He was a member of the pirate group Dank Graks and was part of it for over 100 years. He was Force-sensitive to a certain degree.
Saya Keem was a Force-sensitive Iridonian Zabrak who was a member of the Dank Graks during the High Republic Era.

Lavalox Verzen was a Force-Sensitive Cosian Dank Grak who lived during the High Republic Era. At some point she was admitted to convalesce at the Grava Asylum by the Cosian Jedi Master Tera Sinube, who then posed as Verzen to gather intel on the Dank Graks.
Rado was a male officer who lived during the High Republic Era. He was Coromont Vizzle's court-assigned officer. By the year after the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Rado had become a pirate.
Abadoo was a Hoover male technician and pilot of the Venomed Scabbard who lived during the High Republic Era.

A human elder was a lower-class villager who lived on the planet Wayyl. The son of Dagonet, the planet's representative in the Galactic Senate, was kidnapped by her and her fellow villagers, and the Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Dooku were sent to rescue him.
A human served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper. They served under Chief Regional Auditor Cygnus Anton, an operative of the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate within the Empire.
Gheyr was a Trandoshan female who was a Jedi Initiate during the Republic Era.
Thea Starros was a human female who was the matriarch of the Starros Clan during the Imperial Era. She was the grandmother of Sana Starros, who referred to her as "Grammy."
Colden was a human male who was the prince of the city-state Firevale on the planet Gansevor in 382 BBY. He was married to Sicatra, the princess of Bethune.
Keraan was a human female who was the queen of the city-state Firevale on the planet Gansevor in 382 BBY.
Renata was a human who served as Chief Magistrate in the city-state Firevale on the planet Gansevor in 382 BBY.
Sicatra was a human female who was the heir to the city-state Bethune's royal family in 382 BBY. She fled Bethune seeking for asylum in Firevale and eventually married Firevale's heir Prince Colden.

Tozen was a human male Field Marshal of the Bethune army in 382 BBY. He together with Sicatra led an attack on the city state of Firevale whose aim was to force the Queen of Firevale to abdicate. Tozen hired mercenaries led by General Abediah Viess as a show of force.
Razere was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Riak was a leader of the Crulkon who lived on Turrak during High Republic Era. He led many raids on the Scalvi. He was slain by Bree Menaren using Yoda's lightsaber.
Klask was a raider and later leader of the Crulkon on Turrak during High Republic Era. She ended the raids on the Scalvi and made peace with the Scalvi.

A human Jedi was present at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant when Jedi Grand Master Yoda sent a message to inform the Jedi Order he intended to stay with the Scalvi on Turrak. The Jedi brought Yoda's message to Jedi Masters Pra-Tre Veter and Ela Sutan.

A governor of the Galactic Empire was stationed on the planet Pesmenben IV. By 0 BBY, the Human businessman Lando Calrissian conned the governor into leasing the planet by salting its dunes with lithium carbonate; posing as a non-union mine guard, he made the governor lie face…

A royal mistress from the Orthellin system owned the Lady Luck, a model of Luxury 3000 space yacht manufactured by the SoroSuub Corporation. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, she sold it to Lando Calrissian.
An individual served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic decades after 382 BBY, during the High Republic Era.
Arquel was a fictional female thief Misook told Emim'Ai and other bounty hunters about.
A male individual was the fictional father of the fictional thief Arquel that Misook told Emim'Ai and other bounty hunters about.
A female individual was the fictional mother of the fictional thief Arquel that Misook told Emim'Ai and other bounty hunters about.
Malquis was the fictional Weequay and part of a story about the fictional thief Arquel that Misook told Emim'Ai and other bounty hunters.

Mytion was a human disciple of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door during the High Republic Era. At the request of Tilson Graf and the Path of the Open Hand, Mytion led the Brothers of the Ninth Door in bombing several locations on the holy moon Jedha, which eventually sparked t…
Baarla was a Mournish disciple of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door during the High Republic Era.

Inoke was a Force-sensitive Kel Dor disciple of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door dark side religion who lived in the Holy City of the moon Jedha during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, Jedi Master Silandra Sho helped him fix a malfunctioning speeder.

Yoss was a Gungan general who served in the Gungan Grand Army on the planet Naboo. In 32 BBY, the Gungan Grand Army planned to retaliate against the Trade Federation, which had invaded the planet, after forming an alliance with the human Naboo population.
According to a story told by the Mustafarian Tuttel, a Twi'lek girl and her kowakian monkey-lizard Welk were sent by a sorcerer to steal the Gem of the Luminous.
According to a story told by the Mustafarian Tuttel, a Twi'lek girl thought of her mother and her father when she was sent to steal the Gem of the Luminous.
According to a story told by the Mustafarian Tuttel, a Twi'lek girl thought of her mother and her father when she was sent to steal the Gem of the Luminous.
According to a story told by the Mustafarian Tuttel, Welk was a kowakian monkey-lizard and the pet of a Twi'lek girl.
According to a story told by the Mustafarian Lellis, an Imperial trooper went crazy after being sent to Vader's Castle.
A female individual was the Brood-Mother of the Mustafarian Kakan.
Aryssha Starros was a human female who was the cousin of the smuggler Sana Starros and daughter of the artist Mevera Starros. At some point she married the Imperial officer Captain Cerasus Ehllo.
Mevera Starros was a human female artist who was the mother of Aryssha, and was the aunt of Sana Starros.
Hozuk was a Trandoshan who was imprisoned in a cell similar in design to the one used to imprison Darth Malgus following the Mission to Elom.

Hialeah was a female member of the Path of the Open Hand as the minder for the Littles. She refused to let Marda and Yana Ro sleep in the same sleeping quarters as the other Littles due to her belief that their Evereni heritage might cause them to prey on the other Littles, an…

Jand was a Weequay criminal who operated during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Jand worked with the smuggler Sana Starros, and led her to an Imperial warehouse on E'ronoh, informing Starros it contained something rare and valuable.

Yanna was a Wookiee female elder who was leader of a sanctuary on the planet Kashyyyk. Between 19 BBY and 18 BBY, Yanna allowed the Wookiee Jedi Gungi to stay in the sanctuary after he helped rescue a member of her sanctuary and allied her people with him and Clone Force 99 to…
Babwa Venomor was a Trandoshan commander who led others of his species in helping the Galactic Empire to strip the planet Kashyyyk of its resources.
Jorinda was a female member of the Starros Clan. They were the mother of the human twins Phel and Sana Starros, raising them with a male individual on the Hutt Space moon Nar Shaddaa.
The father of the humans Phel and Sana Starros raised the pair on the Outer Rim moon Nar Shaddaa with the children's mother, Jorinda, as part of the Starros Clan.

Luu was a man who helped raise Sana and Phel Starros alongside the siblings' father during the Imperial Era on the Outer Rim moon Nar Shaddaa. Eventually, they and Starros' father retired to the Outer Rim planet Dalna.
Cerasus Ehllo was a human male Imperial officer of the Ehllo family. His father personally knew Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine. Cerasus rose to the rank of captain in the Galactic Empire.
A male individual who lived during the Imperial Era was the father of the human male Cerasus Ehllo, who eventually became a captain in the Galactic Empire.
Coron Solstus was a human male who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Pako was a Nikto who served in an Outer Rim Exploration Team on the Witherbloom during the High Republic Era.

Sula Badani was an human female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order in an Outer Rim Exploration Team on the Witherbloom during the High Republic Era. She was experienced in traveling the Galactic Frontier, where she dealt with civilizations and cultures new to the Galactic Republic.
Seleen was a human envoy sent to Horatio by the city-state Firevale of the planet Gansevor in 382 BBY.
Joth Ver was a human member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi from the planet Mimban who had a bounty on their head during the First Order occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY.

Jaga Badur was a Rawanikola from Jakku, a desert planet where in 34 ABY, Badur walked through Niima Outpost as the scavenger Rey dismounted her speeder with salvage collected from the Star Destroyer Inflictor.

Karoon Bogat was an Aki-Aki from the planet Pasaana. During the First Order occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, there was a 500 credit bounty on Bogat for theft and evading arrest, which was claimed by a visitor to Black Spire Outpost on Batuu who used a thermal scanner …

Greeta Maju was a Alazmec from Tatooine. During the First Order occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, there was a 700 credit bounty on Maju for theft, property damage, evading arrest and tampering with the Ronto Roasters droid.
Strotta was a red-eyed Jawa from Arvala-7, a muddy planet where Jawas from the planet Tatooine had settled.

"Quick Thumbs" was a nickname given to a male Human operative who specialized in slicing computers and acuiring data. During the third Galactic War, he was stationed at the Joint Operations Base arrival platform of the Invasion Zone on Manaan.
During the High Republic Era, a Sorcerer of Tund was expelled from the sorcerer order after embracing the dark side of the Force.
A Duros worked for the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure before escaping to the planet Poln Minor and working for the Storm-hair warlord Nuso Esva's realm.

A Besalisk was present in Jedha City. In 382 BBY, the Besalisk ran into Jedi Knight Vildar Mac and insulted him. Padawan Matthea Cathley then told Vildar that this sentiment wasn't unusual on Jedha.
Gani Riduli was an Ishi Tib politician who represented the InterGalactic Banking Clan in the Senate of the Galactic Empire.

Slip, designated CT-0409, was a clone stormtrooper in service to the Galactic Empire, who served aboard Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart's Venator-class Star Destroyer during the attack on Kamino and the bombardment of Tipoca City.
A Gossam was the senator of the Commerce Guild in the Imperial Senate during the reign of the Galactic Empire, the successor state of the Galactic Republic.

Clone X, also named Sniper X, was a conditioned clone trooper who worked as a clone X operative for the Galactic Empire. His identifying number wiped, he was deployed by Imperial officers to complete high-priority and covert operations for the nascent Empire.

Cade was a clone stormtrooper that served the Galactic Empire. He served aboard Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart's Venator-class Star Destroyer during the attack on Kamino and the bombardment of Tipoca City and was later assassinated when he began to take action to expose Rampart's …
A Pantoran guard protected Senator Riyo Chuchi during the Imperial Era. In 18 BBY, the Pantoran guard was present when Senator Chuchi tracked down Slip, who she was trying to protect.
A male rag-man was present on the Inner Rim planet Jakku in 4 ABY. He attempted to intimidate the traveler Corwin Ballast upon the man's arrival on Jakku, hoping to prey on the newcomer.

Lys Solay was a Pantoran female Jedi youngling stationed on the forest planet Tenoo for further training during the High Republic Era. She had an affinity for animals and was best friends with fellow Jedi younglings Kai Brightstar and Nubs, as well as the pilot Nash Durango.
Cyrus Vuundir was a prince of the planet Vuundalla. Unbeknownst to his parents, he also operated as a pirate under the alias Taborr Val-Dorn.
Zia Zaldor Zanna was a Jedi Master stationed on the planet Tenoo to teach Jedi Initiates during the High Republic Era.
Mindoku was a human male who lived on the moon Jedha during the High Republic Era. He was a disciple of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door, a Force cult affiliated with the dark side of the Force.
Tellion was a male gang leader during the High Republic Era. Shortly before the Battle of Jedha, he sent a Klatooinian member of his gang to rob the tapbar Enlightenment, but they were unsuccessful.

A Klatooinian male gangster was a member of a gang during the High Republic Era. Shortly before the Battle of Jedha, he and other gang members were sent by Tellion to rob the tapbar Enlightenment, but they were unsuccessful.
Mirrian was a female individual who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Mirrian lived in her parent's old home. She was the sister of Rebel Alliance officer Wolff Kalos.

An individual was a member of the Nihil. According to the Blythe who served as captain of the Kezarat Convoy during the Galactic Civil War, years after the convoy were stranded in No-Space during the High Republic Era, the Nihil member was supposedly captured by the convoy.
The Core Worlds planet Kuat was represented by a Kuati individual during a Galactic Senate session in 32 BBY.

A Human innkeeper ran the Mos Eisley Inn in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. Despite the price of rooms being set at ten credits per day, the innkeeper would always attempt to haggle with the customers for more money.

A Sullustan clerk worked at the Spaceport Hotel in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. Despite the price of rooms being set at ten credits per day, the clerk would always attempt to haggle with the customers for more money.

A male individual was the great-uncle of Coby. After his death, Coby was given his great-uncle's inheritance money which he would later use to help Greej return the animals stolen by the Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie.
An Ugnaught individual worked for the First Order and maintained contact with the pilot Marnia Un'la'na and Major Elrik Vonreg.

A human ace pilot hailing from the planet Hosnian Prime traveled to the supertanker fuel depot Colossus in 34 ABY to participate in the All Aces Battle Royale race. The Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono noticed the pilot's arrival and discovered they had the same homeworld.
Flim was a Cragmoloid child who worked for Anst Wozo on Jedha during the High Republic Era. He was killed while Wozo punished all his kid employee.
Marr was a Hiitian who served as a Guardian of the Whills during the High Republic Era. Together with another Guardian, the Hiitian imprisoned Tey Sirrek after the bombing at the Temple of the Kyber.

n: Unidentified human Guardian of the Whills
x: A human served as a Guardian of the Whills during the High Republic Era. Together with Marr, the human imprisoned Tey Sirrek after the bombing at the Temple of the Kyber.

n: Unidentified human Guardian of the Whills
x: A human served as Guardian of the Whills during the High Republic Era. When the Battle of Jedha started, Briff tricked the Guardian into opening the doors of the Temple of the Kyber, and a group stormed the temple in search of the Rod of Daybreak.
A Besalisk was present in Jedha City in 382 BBY. During the Battle of Jedha, the Besalisk was part of a group of rioters that attacked the Convocation of the Force and members of the Jedi Order.
Sed was a human who served as a Guardian of the Whills on Jedha.
Anst Wozo was an Inleshat criminal wanted by the Namoi criminal syndicate, which exploited street children and caused their deaths. He was killed in retaliation by Guardians of the Whills Tey Sirrek.

An individual served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic in 200 BBY. During his mission to Begamor, the Jedi Padawan Sean noticed that despite being part of the Republic, most Begamorians were ignorant of the Supreme Chancellor's identity.
A Gungan worked as a vegetable cook at President Jamie Brasson's estate on Begamor.
Bormo was a Hutt Cartel member whose territorial boundaries were being overstepped by his fellow Hutts. They eventually hired a mercenary to deliver an ultimatum to Bormo and demand a tribute.

Alareen Xie was a Jedi who was active during the High Republic Era. At some point she ended up in No-Space, where the Nihil had their main base. She eventually joined the Colony of Kezarat, and helped defend it from the Nihil.
Benni Baro was a human male thief and ipsium miner on Ipsidon during the Imperial Era.
A Bith worked in the kitchen of President Jamie Brasson's estate on Begamor during the High Republic Era.

Ilith was a Twi'lek male who lived centuries before the Galactic Civil War as a member of the Ascendant cult. At some point Ilith split from the group, and came to lead a splinter faction that pursued a different form of research than that of Miril, the leader of the Ascendant.
A Trandoshan smuggler made a deal with Dil Pexton. Dil received a stash of fake ship IDs he later gave to Auric Graf.

A TIE fighter pilot crashed into a river on Thune while hunting Lina and Milo Graf. He tried to pull himself out of the water into the boat the Graf siblings were escaping in, but he was unsuccessful.
Ashscale was a tanray that lived on Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War.
Deathsting was a kubaza beetle that lived on Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War.
Scorching Terror was a kubaza beetle that lived on Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War.
Ura Jen was a blistmok that lived on Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War.
A senator represented Unzel, their homeworld in the Mid Rim, in the Imperial Senate during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
A Dowutin was a customer at Shalla Mondatha's Moveable Feast. When a small creature tried to eat his food, the Dowutin knocked over a table trying to shoo away the creature.
A trunk-nosed Onodone lackey worked for Cikatro Vizago during the Imperial Era. He was tasked to secure a container of bugs owned by Shalla Mondatha.
A male individual was the uncle of the Rutian Twi'lek Jedi Aayla Secura. At some point, the uncle was murdered, setting Secura on a path towards the dark side of the Force as she hunted the murderer.
DX-491 was a stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire. DX-491, together with DZ-372 and many other Stormtroopers, was taken by the Agarians.
DZ-372 was a stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire. DZ-372, together with DX-491 and many other Stormtroopers, was taken by the Agarians.
A worker was employed by the port control of the Mos Eisley spaceport on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine during the Clone Wars.

Krrsish was a Wookiee who was a Jedi Initiate sometime by 42 BBY. At the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, Krrsish joined the Tibidee Clan and became friends with a Togorian, Jak'zin, and a Trandoshan, Gheyr.
A Yuuzhan Vong high prefect of the Yuuzhan Vong empire's intendant caste led the Praetorite Vong, a spearhead force established ahead of its invasion of the galaxy.
Mokko was a male alien gang boss who operated in Mokkotown on the desert planet Ipsidon during the start of the Imperial Era.
Drake was a human male scavenger and Ipsium miner who worked for the gang boss Mokko. He was in Mokko's inner-circle and was commonly the "top earner" among the crew of scavengers under Mokko.
Bryce was an individual who worked for the gang boss Mokko. During or after 18 BBY, a miner asked if Bryce and Hugh took out the hyperdrive of the Marauder.
Hugh was an individual who worked for the gang boss Mokko. During or after 18 BBY, a miner asked if Hugh and Bryce took out the hyperdrive of the Marauder.
Ambar was a Mournish medic who served in a Pathfinder team on the Witherbloom during the High Republic Era.

An individual acted as a bounty hunter of the Haxion Brood crime syndicate and lived during the Imperial Era. Sometime between 12 BBY and 11 BBY, he encountered the Nightsister Merrin and Jedi Knight Cal Kestis who required information on the location of a Haxion Brood base.
Mwarr Ja'Randa was a Twi'lek bounty hunter who tried to capture Rey on Kashyyyk.
This human male was a miner who worked as part of Mokko's crew in Mokkotown. He caught the Bad Batch while they were fixing the stolen Marauder at Mokkotown.

A captain served the royal fleet of the Pijali monarchy on the Inner Rim planet Pijal during the Republic Era. They commanded a Corellian corvette staffed by several crew members, including a comm officer and a security chief.

A comm officer served the royal fleet of the Pijali monarchy on the Inner Rim planet Pijal during the Republic Era. They worked alongside several other crew members, including a security chief, under a captain who commanded a Corellian corvette.

A Nautolan security chief served in the royal fleet of the Pijali monarchy on the Inner Rim planet Pijal during the Republic Era. He worked alongside several other crew members, including a comm officer, under a captain who commanded a Corellian corvette.
A human colonel served in the army of Firevale under Prince Colden. They were ordered by Prince Colden to brief Porter Engle and Barash Silvain on the status of the city's defenses.

A navigator served as part of a unit of three Galactic Empire stormtroopers in 0 ABY. That year, the unit pursued Princess Leia Organa of the Rebel Alliance to the world Bedlam, where the stormtroopers proceeded to chase her on foot.
"Kyber Swiper" was a Weequay pirate and thief who stole a Kyber brick on the planet Naboo.

A senator from the industrial world Peg Shar I represented the world in the Senate of the Galactic Republic by 32 BBY. That year, the senator's office was located on a lower level of the Galactic Senate Building on the Republic capital Coruscant.

Marl Jibs was a human who worked for the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. At some point, he was present with his Twi'lek girlfriend at a bar on Hon-Tallos when his girlfriend left with an individual who claimed to be Sana Starros, though in reality was Chelli Lona Aphra.

A Twi'lek female was the girlfriend of the human criminal Marl Jibs. At some point, the two were at a bar on Hon-Tallos when the Twi'lek was approached by an individual who claimed to be Sana Starros, though in reality was Chelli Lona Aphra.
Argo was a human who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, the Twi'lek Dregg and his friend tried to steal a sack of ambercrysts from Argo and the Nautolan Ralen.
A Twi'lek who lived during the High Republic Era was the partner of the Twi'lek Dregg. Together they tried to steal a sack full of ambercrysts from the Nautolan Ralen and the human Argo.
A green-skinned individual was a Jedi youngling at the Jedi Temple during the High Republic Era. The youngling fought Porter Engle in Jedi training.

A Jedi instructor served at the Jedi Temple during the High Republic Era. The instructor trained Porter Engle and Barash Silvain as well as multiple other younglings including a green-skinned youngling.
An Eirami solder participated in the Battle of Jedha, where they where slain by a E'ronoh mining loader.
A E'roni commander led the forces of E'ronoh's military at the Battle of Jedha.

Yurtoln was a Sith Overseer of the Sith Academy on Korriban. Decades before the Cold War, Yurtoln trained a shyrack and set the creature on his acolytes. Several years later, the shyrack turned on Yurtoln and plucked out his eye before the Overseer killed the creature.

A tribune served the Pijali monarchy of the Inner Rim planet Pijal during the Republic Era. In 40 BBY, they announced the Pijali Princess Fanry's arrival to a Czerka Corporation-sponsored rally in the world's capital city dome.

Gorian Shard was a male individual of a plant-like species who served as the Pirate King of a gang of pirates, which included the Nikto Vane, leading the gang from his Cumulus-class Corsair warship. He was considered one of the most famous pirates in the galaxy.

Vane was a male Kajain'sa'Nikto pirate who was a member of Gorian Shard's gang as the second-in-command. During the pirate siege on Nevarro, Vane deserted Shard to save his own skin.

Emerie Karr was a human female clone created from the genetic template of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett. At some point, Karr was transported off the planet Kamino as she was needed elsewhere. Eventually, Doctor Royce Hemlock took her under his wing.

Minch was a male Anzellan Droidsmith who was a part of a droidsmith crew alongside Keeto, Bai, and Clang and worked in a workshop on the volcanic planet Nevarro. He tried to repair IG-11 for Din Djarin, but needed a new memory circuit to be able to continue the reparation.
Goggareth was a senator who represented Brentaal IV in the Galactic Senate during the tenure of Supreme Chancellor Dorian Janarus.
A human Imperial officer served as an admiral aboard the Executor, the flagship of the Sith Lord Darth Vader during the Galactic Civil War.
A human served as a captain in the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Santari Khri was a human who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era and was a close friend of Jedi Knight Dagan Gera.
A female individual was the mother of the Gand Zuckuss. Before Zuckuss became a Findsman, he had to undertake the Great Rite with other hatchlings in his clan.

Orin Darhga was a human male Jedi Master who was active during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he and Jedi Knight Gella Nattai visited Axel Greylark at the Republic Correctional Facility on Pipyyr to ask him what he knew about the Battle of Jedha.

Bobert was a Trandoshan Nihil and part of Kara Xoo's Tempest. In 230 BBY, Avon Starros and other children who were kidnapped by Kara Xoo tried to escape by running over Bobert when he entered the prison to bring them dinner.
A skinny Toydarian aide served president Sachary Jeffington in 230 BBY. He and the president were secretly Nihil.
Rascal was a tooka who lived at the Jedi temple on the Outer Rim planet Dalna during the High Republic Era.
Rico was a Gran who served as administrator of Port Haileap during the High Republic Era. He worked with Jorinda Boffrey to make sure everyone was safe after the Nihil attacked Port Haileap.
Royce was a Siniteen Nihil technician and part of Kara Xoo's Tempest. In 230 BBY, Avon Starros had to help him fix the Poisoned Barb, Kara Xoo's ship.

Daq Dragus, also known as Durasteel during his time as a fighter, was an individual who recruited Hunters for Balada the Hutt's Grand Arena on Vespaara. He trained the Hunters and helped them create the character they wanted to portray.

Charr was a Trandoshan male Hunter at the Grand Arena on Vespaara. As a big game hunter, Charr sought out prey on many worlds, including Pagodon, where he hunted ravinak; Felucia, where he battled a sarlacc; and Hoth, where he killed both tauntauns and wampas.

A member of the Sith species served as a member of the Darkseekers, a faction of the Sith Order who hunted for threats to the Sith. Long before 4 ABY, they took part in an attack on the Ascendant temple on Pyrr IX, during which they stabbed Ilith with a Sith lightsaber.
A Dor Namethian male was the trainer of Grozz whilst he was a Hunter in the Grand Arena on Vespaara. According to Rieve, the trainer was tall.
The Hunter Zaina had a non-binary trainer who worked with her as she participated in combat exhibition matches in the Grand Arena on the Outer Rim planet Vespaara for the Hunters of the Outer Rim.
An individual was the trainer of Dizzy during his time as a Hunter in the Grand Arena on Vespaara. Before Rieve had her first fight in the Arena, she saw Dizzy shouting at his trainer.
Rothwell was a human male who was the trainer of Rieve at the Grand Arena on Vespaara. He started working in the Arena two days before Rieve became a Hunter.

Brithik was a Katikoot who lived on the planet Aubadas. In 382 BBY, Jedi Master Silandra Sho's Republic Pathfinder team traveled to Aubadas to investigate what happened to Rok Buran and his Pathfinder team.

Yulon Onning was an Elder of the Path of the Open Hand cult and was a senior member of the Path's council. In 382 BBY, Onning responded to a request from Princess Xiri A'lbaran of E'ronoh as well as two Jedi to land at the Path compound on the planet Dalna.
Sullik was a Katikoot who lived on the planet Aubadas. In 382 BBY, he oversaw Kam and Amos Tillian's work repairing the comms system on Aubadas.

Irei was a Force-sensitive female Kadas'sa'Nikto who invented the Shroud, a device she hoped to build and use to conceal people like herself from the Galactic Empire. She apprenticed at her parents' droid repair shop while trying not to draw notice.
An eccentric individual was the "admiral" of the Junk Armada—a collection of decommissioned ships that was yoked together by magnetic fields and traveled through the galaxy—by 3643 BBY.

Killena was a bounty hunter during the Imperial Era. She and her droid T1L-D4 hunted Cal Kestis, leaving him threat messages as Kestis traveled the galaxy. When the Stinger Mantis crew infiltrated a Haxion Brood base, Killena and T1L-D4 caught up with Kestis and confronted him.
A male individual was the father of the bounty hunter Killena. During the Imperial Era, Killena's father lived in a hilltop mansion on the planet Alderaan that Killena had paid off.

Qeris Lar was a wealthy Omwati man who lived in a Supra-atmo skytower in Chikua City on Hosnian Prime. He used his money for anti-Imperial operations. He helped Chellwinark Frethylrin connect with the Stinger Mantis crew.

Teeno was a bramble lynx who resided on the Outer Rim planet Dathomir. By 20 BBY, she was owned by the Dathomirian Nightsister Merrin. According to Merrin, Teeno began small, and she raised her to become very cute, and she liked to be scratched under her chin.
A Gand was the Master Findsman of the clan Zuckuss was part of. The Master Findsman summoned the clan's hatchlings to undertake the Great Rite.

Zimbokk was a Gand who was a member of the same clan as Zuckuss. Prior to 4 ABY, after Zuckuss was knocked over by Korgoss once he arrived to carry out the Great Rite, Zimbokk helped Zuckuss up and told him to ignore what Korgoss has told him, that they considered him a runt a…

Korgoss was a Gand who was a member of the same clan as Zuckuss, and was born from the same egg as Zuckuss. Prior to 4 ABY, Korgoss, amongst other members of the clan, were to undertake the Great Rite to become a Findsman.
Garkung was a Gand who was a member of the same clan as Zuckuss. At some point before 4 ABY, members of the clan were to undertake the Great Rite to become a Findsman.

Ash-Ke was a Sith Eternal cultist on the planet Exegol. Their Sith training was almost complete when they told a protocol droid that they were concerned that their rival, Gar-Ee, would overshadow their achievements, and asked for assistance in beating them in a fight.

Gabe Bean was a human Imperial officer who served the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Bean was present on Captain Cerasus Ehllo's ship, the Raider-class corvette King's Ransom, as the crew of Ehllo's ship attempted to unlock an heirloom of the…

Lutha was a Gran who worked for Deva Lompop and was familiar with Thea Starros. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, after Thea arrived at a location in the Dalnan sector to speak with Lompop along with her daughter Mevera Starros, and her granddaughter Sana Starros, they were greeted by …
A Rodian was a customer of Peli Motto on the planet Tatooine around 9 ABY.

Nolan was a human male who served the Galactic Empire as a lieutenant during its early reign. During or after 18 BBY, Nolan was dispatched to the planet Barton IV to oversee the collection and transportation of cargo from the planet's Imperial Depot.

Mayday was the name of a Clone Commander who was stationed on the icy planet Barton IV during the Imperial Era. At some point, he and CT-9904 "Crosshair" were tasked by Imperial Lieutenant Nolan with recovering Imperial supplies that had been stolen by local bandits.

Hexx was a male clone stormtrooper that served the Galactic Empire. Under Clone Commander Mayday, Hexx's squad—including fellow trooper Veetch—was tasked with guarding an Imperial Depot on the planet Barton IV.

Veetch was a male clone stormtrooper that served the Galactic Empire under Clone Commander Mayday. Their squad, consisting of several clone troopers, including Hexx, was tasked with guarding an Imperial Depot on the planet Barton IV.

The cyborg mech was the name given to a cyborg scavenger that operated on the deserted planet of Mandalore in 9 ABY. It piloted a Spider Tank as a vehicle to traverse the ruined landscape of Mandalore, fend off other beings and capture them for their blood.
Larti was a Selkath Jedi Master active during the High Republic Era. They rescued Vildar Mac from a Sorcerer of Tund and took him as their Padawan. Larti wielded a green-bladed lightsaber.

Boomka Slay was a male Force-sensitive individual. According to a Galactic Enquire publication released by 1 BBY, Slay was rumored to be the son of "Yak Face," a Yarkoran.

Canon-Man was a male humanoid who had a gray cannon for a head and black eyes. Sometime prior to 1 BBY, a Dressellian named Orrimaarko was at a table with Ponda Baba, a member of the Aqualish species, discussing the potential for the Force-sensitive child Boomka Slay to be the…

Paternok was a male human-looking Eirami soldier with dark skin and braided hair. He accompanied Ambassador Cerox to the Summit on Jedha and at one point visited Enlightenment where he made friends with Piralli, Moona and an E'roni soldier named Kimbral when the Battle of Jedh…

Kimbral was a female E'roni pilot with pale skin and auburn hair. She visited Jedha to attend to the Summit on Jedha. Before the Battle of Jedha started, she was in Enlightenment where she got know the Eirami soldier Paternok.
Erta was a human female who was the girlfriend of Moona during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, shortly before the Battle of Jedha, Moona promised Piralli to introduce him to Erta.

A Sugi arms dealer lived on Murkhana during the Imperial Era. During the Stinger Mantis crew's mission to Murkhana, Cere Junda and Merrin crossed the arms dealer's path and Cere acquired a Circlet by selling them her Mandolin.
A Gungan was present on Abafar during the Imperial Era. At one point Cal Kestis trusted the Gungan, but was later cheated by them.

A stormtrooper was stationed in Mos Eisley, one of the cities on the planet Tatooine. He chased the three members of Aquamarine Squad because they attempted to recruit his wife to the Alliance to Restore the Republic in 3 ABY.
A runner was employed by the Ithorian collector Dok-Ondar in his antiquities store on the Outer Rim planet Batuu and worked alongside Calin, one of their colleagues.

A stormtrooper's wife with brown skin and black hair spoke with members of Aquamarine Squad in the spaceport settlement of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. When he discovered this, their husband chased the rebel troopers away.
Lanse Crowder was a criminal pirate during the Imperial Era.
Eenta was a human who resided on a remote island on Pabu. He was friendly with the mayor, Shep Hazard.
Shep Hazard was a human who was the mayor of the remote island on Pabu. He lived there along with his daughter, Lyana Hazard.
Lyana Hazard was a human who resided in the remote island on Pabu along with her father, Shep Hazard.
A Mon Calamari technician worked on the planet Coruscant. They were part of the team that strapped Doctor Penn Pershing to a Six-O-Two Mitigator.
Anduluuvil was an individual mercenery who often worked with Ochi.
Pysarian was an individual mercenery who often worked with Ochi.

A male was a captain who was on the space station Koke Frost. After Dathan arrived, he gave job on his sun-scooper's engineering team. As such, he gave up his identity and took on the name "Dathan" after the Symeong who had helped him and been his only friend.

Amnesty Officer M34 was the designation of a human male who was part of the New Republic Amnesty Program, a program for former members of the Galactic Empire who were given amnesty following re-integration initiatives so that they could loyally serve the New Republic.

Amnesty Officer G27 was the designation of a human individual who was part of the New Republic Amnesty Program, a program for former members of the Galactic Empire who were given amnesty following re-integration initiatives so that they could loyally serve the New Republic.

Amnesty Officer M40 was the designation of a human individual who was part of the New Republic Amnesty Program, a program for former members of the Galactic Empire who were given amnesty following re-integration initiatives so that they could loyally serve the New Republic.

Goi Ganok was a Roonan male member of the Path of the Open Hand. He and Binnot Ullo were sent by the Mother to reignite the war between Eiram and E'ronoh.
Kirs was a Human male researcher who worked for the Lerct Historical Institute. In 21 ABY, Kirs participated in an expedition on Yoturba.

Plana Van was a middle aged human Eirami woman. She piloted a transport ship, when she witnessed an explosion on Eirie. While she and her coworker Otto investigated, they encountered the Path of the Open Hand members Binnot Ullo and Goi Ganok.

Turgle was a male frog-like alien resident of the planet Koboh, who would typically find himself caught up in trouble with the Bedlam Raiders or other local issues, during the Imperial Era. He spent much of his time in Pyloon's Saloon regaling the locals with his stories.
A human male pilot worked for the Ohnaka Transport Solutions company on the planet Batuu by the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Harli Cogra was a Vurk Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. In the weeks following the destruction of Starlight Beacon in 230 BBY, Cogra began work on the Chronicles of the Jedi, a document which detailed the Jedi of the High Republic and their…
A Gotal female was the grandmother of Nittel Karkson. The two lived in a hovel on level four thousand on the planet Coruscant. To support his grandmother, Karkson turned to stealing.

Fireball was a rogue clone trooper who was a member of the Clone Underground network that was created by Clone Captain Rex early in the Imperial Era.

Silvan Kaan was a Twi'lek criminal who lived during the Imperial Era. In 4 ABY, he traveled to Jabba's Palace on Tatooine.

Xirys Patri was a hyperspace prospector. Sometime millennia before 382 BBY Patri claimed to have crash landed on the mysterious Planet X and nearly died, but had escaped the planet after being miraculously healed of his mortal injuries.

Fe Fer was a Kessarine child of Ferize, Er Dal, and Fel Ix. When Fel Ix was sent on a mission by the Mother, he picked up Fe Fer and wished he could stay with his family.

Merak was a Force-sensitive Gran Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who served as the dedicated archivist of the archive at the Jedi temple on the planet Batuu during the High Republic Era. By 382 BBY, he was considered old by Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani.

Cian Shee was a human. The bounty hunter Kalyn Farnmir unsuccessfully attempted to pin her crimes on Shee, who was her former partner. In 22 BBY, Shee and Farnmir spent time together in the Outlander Club, a nightclub in the Uscru District of the planet Coruscant.
Lirah Danch was a human communications specialist who served as a member of a communications team that worked with the Outer Rim Exploration Team Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven in 382 BBY.
Rol Egry was a Nautolan communications specialist who served as a member of a communications team that worked with the Outer Rim Exploration Team Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven in 382 BBY.

Nemuu was a Jawa and part of the Nkik clan. Nemuu was a spy who was gathering information on a new Imperial assassin droid that was being built on Tatooine.

Charn Roondha was an Ithorian who worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure as a collector of taxes and protection money from a variety of Outer Rim worlds. In 4 ABY, the Gran Ree-Yees sought to take over his role.
Alise Davros was a female Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. She fled Emperor Arcann's oppression into the Endless Swamp where she joined the Zakuulan rebels led by Pashna Veyaad.
Maylur was a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire who served on the planet Eriadu and was responsible for the security of Governor Wilhuff Tarkin's compound, Raven's Peak.

Boz Vega was a Dowutin male who worked as an announcer at the Grand Arena on Vespaara together with L-X1. Viewers of the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition holonet feeds seemed to really enjoy the commentary of he and L-X1.

A human served as a box guard in an Imperial factory facility part of the Imperial Prison Complex on Narkina 5. In 5 BBY, the box guard stood on the left side of the catwalk in room five-two as a new prisoner was lowered into the room.

A female citizen of the Sith Empire was the wife of Sith Lord Calphayus prior to him becoming one of the Dread Masters. After all Dread Masters except him had been killed, Calphayus remembered his prior life and regained memories of his wife.

Frander was a Force-sensitive Lasat who operated a hidden depot during the High Republic Era. The Dank Graks tried to buy Frander's Eviscerators, but Frander didn't want to do business with dark side users.
Irya Kirsch was a human Naboo Fighter Pilot who served as part of Bravo Squadron. Kirsch was shot down during the Battle of Naboo, in 32 BBY.

Ully was a Zabrak female who was a musician in the gonkrock band Corellia's Not Dead.

Gotri was a human male who worked at the sound system of the club Yoshoyan's when the gonkrock band Corellia's Not Dead played there.
Xyla was a female Togruta who worked at an orphanage on Corellia.

Paola was an individual who worked at the Athlethe's spa on Vespaara. She was a friend of the trainer Rothwell.

Diago Velaar was a Miraluka male and a legendary Hunter at the Grand Arena on the planet Vespaara. As his species did not have eyes, he fought only with his hearing. When goons attacked the Arena, intent on causing destruction, Diago found a vantage point to shoot the invaders.
Cippa Tarko was an Arkanian female Jedi Initiate who lived during the High Republic Era. Because she was unusually gifted, she was assigned to Jedi Master Yaddle.

Priv Ittik was an Iktotchi female guard sent by Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark to investigate the Path of the Open Hand's role in the Battle of Jedha together with Jedi Knight Aida Forte, Jedi Master Creighton Sun and another guard, Lu Sweet.

Lu Sweet was a tall human male guard sent by Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark to investigate the Path of the Open Hand's role in the Battle of Jedha together with Jedi Knight Aida Forte, Jedi Master Creighton Sun and another guard sent by Greylark, Priv Ittik.

Doma Dendra was a Waluna female and the owner of Dendra's Antiquities on the planet Koboh during the Imperial Era. She was considered the founding member and unofficial mayor of Rambler's Reach Outpost.
In 9 ABY, Captain Shuggoth commanded the Quarren merchant fleet freighter Hydroid Traveler. She fell in love with a Mon Calamari prince, and the pair eloped aboard the captain's starship.

Helgait was the Head of Security on the planet Plazir-15.
The Duchess was a female human who ruled over her homeworld, Plazir-15, alongside her husband Bombardier.

A Chiss commander served as the commanding officer aboard the Chiss light cruiser Stingfly.

A Gran senator was active during the New Republic Era and Ahsoka Tano's quest to find Ezra Bridger.

Kelnacca was a Force-sensitive Wookiee who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 230 BBY, Kelnacca was sent to the crash site of the Starlight Beacon space station on the planet Eiram to help with the relief effort.
Saifir was an Ugnaught who operated in a workshop on Plazir-15.
Nesguin was a male Iktotchi from the remote planet Lenahra. By 41 BBY, he was one of the oldest of the twelve remaining residents of the planet.

A Jedi Master of the Jedi Order lived during the Republic Era and took the Force-sensitive Bolla Ropal as a Padawan learner at some point by 41 BBY. The Master often brought Ropal to the Jedi Temple's library.

Jarper was a Lepi young individual from the planet Lenahra. By 41 BBY, they were one of a dozen children and teenagers remaining alive on Lenahra who were discovered by Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi when he arrived in search for information about the Jedi Wayseeker Orla Jareni.

Tumber was a Lepi young individual from the planet Lenahra. By 41 BBY, they were one of a dozen children and teenagers remaining alive on Lenahra who were discovered by Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi when he arrived in search for information about the Jedi Wayseeker Orla Jareni.
A pirate who had hidden his treasure became marooned on the habitable asteroid Regretter's Rock by 3643 BBY.

A Quarren crew member served Captain Shuggoth aboard the freighter Hydroid Traveler during the New Republic Era.

An alien female casino gambler often visited Vranki's Hotel and Casino. In 34 ABY, she enjoyed herself while playing at a gambling machine at the establishment.

Zeik was a high-ranking Bedlam Raider during the Imperial Era. On the planet Koboh, his leader Rayvis ordered him to kill the individual Turgle, who had sold to Rayvis a fake version of a relic that the Gen'Dai required to awaken fallen Jedi Dagan Gera.

Darth Ravi, known as Darth Ravi the Bold, was a Force-sensitive Sith Lord considered ancient by the time of the High Republic Era. The Echo Stone was hidden from Darth Ravi on Angcord. Darth Ravi was a powerful Sith Lord in the dark side of the Force.

Julan Van Reeple was a brash human racer who, at one point in time, was involved in a parent-child starfighter race. At another point in time, she snydely asked another individual to remove an object she referred to as a porta potty off of a racetrack.
Li Qiong was a young maid of the Nan family and housekeeper of the Nan family villa in the Aakaash system.

Talla was a female individual who was the sister of Phan-tu Zenn. During a monsoon, Talla was lost in Erasmus Sea, and Zenn never found them.
Idrig Eeba was a crime lord affiliated with the Exchange. Eeba vowed to take revenge against the criminal Skavak for every time he had double-crossed the Exchange.
A scout was a Mandalorian that was loyal to Bo-Katan Kryze.
Janu Coin was a human male warlord and crime lord who led a remnant of the Galactic Empire during the New Republic Era.
