t: Unidentified First Order TIE fighter pilot (Dantooine)
n: Unidentified First Order TIE fighter pilot
x: A human individual was a pilot for the First Order. In 34 ABY, they served as a member of a squadron patrolling a blockade of the planet Dantooine in a TIE/fo space superiority fighter.

A male individual wielded blasters during the Procopian Crisis, which occurred by around 482 BBY. Over a century later, in 382 BBY, the individual's great-granddaughter, Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark, kept the blasters in a cabinet in her Coruscant home a…

Pom Gornay was a Jedi of the Jedi Order who met Jedi Padawan Enya Keen years before 382 BBY. In that year, Gornay was killed in a Jedi attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna when one of their members tackled him and triggered an explosive.

Precoria San Tekka was a female individual who was a member of the San Tekka clan. In 382 BBY, she was the girlfriend of Helis Graf, the brother of Sky Graf, and owned a starship called the Purrgil's Dream.
Den Harrit was a Togruta Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order. In 382 BBY, Harrit participated in an attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna.

Meya Wuk was a Togruta Jedi Knight in the Jedi Order. In 382 BBY, Wuk, along with fellow Togruta Jedi Master Fliss Woora and Knight Den Harrit, fought in an attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna.

t: Unidentified First Order Special Forces pilot
x: A human First Order Special Forces pilot served on the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Thunderer, reporting directly to the vessel's commanders.

A male individual was hired by a mysterious financier with Loegrib to find the planet Lenahra and find the Power. After they arrived he placed a bomb to Obi-Wan Kenobi's by the order of Loegrib. Later he shot by Loegrib.
A guard captain helped Grogu and Kelleran Beq escape Coruscant during Operation: Knightfall. The guard was killed by clone troopers.
A Ottegan was present in the New Republic Senate's Senate chamber on their capital planet Hosnian Prime in 28 ABY.
This ARC trooper commander served the Galactic Republic in the Clone Wars, and was present during the Battle of Nadiem five months after the Battle of Geonosis.
Toorin was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order. In 382 BBY, Toorin participated in an attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna.
Woo was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order. In 382 BBY, Woo fought in an attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna.
Riponjonang was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. In 382 BBY, Riponjonang was part of an attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna.

Equaa was a Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order. In 382 BBY, Equaa participated in an attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna, running alongisde fellow Jedi Toorin, Woo, Riponjonang, Enya Keen, and Char-Ryl-Roy at some point by nightfall.

Grus was a Klatooinian pilot and pirate in a pirate group that was allied with the Mother of the Path of the Open Hand cult. The Mother kept them allied with her by giving them information on where the best raids could happen.
Kenny was a human communications expert for Galactic Republic Pathfinder team 71-B9 alongside pilot Piti.
Lia was the human assistant to Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark in 382 BBY. That year, Lia helped her remove her headress.

Lumbo was a human member of the Path of the Open Hand cult that guarded Jedi Knight Gella Nattai's cell in the underground caverns of the Path compound on the planet Dalna during the Night of Sorrow in 382 BBY.
Piti was a Yarkora pilot and navigator for Galactic Republic Pathfinder team 71-B9 alongside communications expert Kenny.

Zoleh Prin was the Pipyyrian warden of the Republic Correctional Facility on Pipyyr. In 382 BBY, he received a message from the Supreme Chancellors of the Galactic Republic ordering him to transfer prisoner Axel Greylark to the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center.
Sevi was a human male who was a member of and scout for the Path of the Open Hand cult and its sub-group the Path of the Closed Fist.
Heinz Darthenshmirtz was a human Imperial scientist and the inventor of the superweapon known as the Death Star, though its intended design—the Doof Star—was a nutcracker.

A rancor lived in the Sodden Grotto on the planet Koboh in the Outer Rim Territories in 9 BBY. This rancor took the lives of some prospectors, which eventually led to their death when Cal Kestis was attacked by the beast after the Jedi Knight was sent to investigate the prospe…

A Jedi of the Jedi Order was the Jedi Master of eventual Jedi Master Creighton Sun. During the Night of Sorrow in 382 BBY, the Jedi youngling Cippa Tarko told Jedi Master Yaddle that she wanted to help their allies Priv Ittik and Lu Sweet.
Chal was a non-binary Ardennian who was born before around 401 BBY. During the High Republic Era, they joined the Path of the Open Hand cult on the planet Dalna.
A male individual was the father of Monarch A'lbaran of E'ronoh. At one point, A'lbaran was told by his father to be wary of a people who had nothing but good intentions when the stakes were high.

A female individual was the mother of the Arkanian Jedi youngling Cippa Tarko. After Jedi Master Yaddle felt a disturbance in the Force whilst on Dalna, Tarko noticed Yaddle's reaction and asked her what was wrong.

Werla Cayn was a human female Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. At some point, Cerean Jedi Master Char-Ryl-Roy knew Cayn as a Jedi youngling at the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

Severn was a human female member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, she worked with fellow Path members Fel Ix and Chal to hijack communications buoys for the Path at the direction of the Path's leader, the Mother, and using the shuttle the Way of Clarity.

Vaqqi was a tall Zabrak Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, Vaqqi was amongst 5 Jedi who accompanied former Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark in a Beta-class shuttle to the Path compound on the planet Dalna on the request of her so…

Fliss Woora was a Togruta Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, Woora was in the Dalnan system when they received a message from Jedi Master Creighton Sun for help with a situation with the Path of the Open Hand on Dalna.
Jarea Kaela was a Quermian Force-sensitive female beastmaster active during the reign of the Galactic Empire who was hunted by an Inquisitor.

Nussi was a rancor who lived during the Imperial Era. At one point, she was acquired by the Patrolian Wollina for his zoo on the Outer Rim planet Hon-Tallos, after he came up with a contract with the Shani bounty hunter Deva Lompop that involved not breeding the rancor.

Candace, formerly designated TK-90210 during her time in the Galactic Empire, was a human female from the desert planet Tatooine. Candace joined the Empire as a stormtrooper soon after the birth of her brother Phineas Flynn.
Ferb Fletcher, formerly known briefly as Darth Ferb, was a Force-sensitive male human who lived on the desert planet Tatooine. He was a moisture farmer alongside his stepbrother Phineas Flynn.
Blatto was a male Toydarian operated on the desert planet Tatooine.

An individual was the teacher of Din Djarin when he was a foundling rescued by the Children of the Watch. After Djarin became a Mandalorian apprentice, his teacher took him on his journeys until he became a Mandalorian.

Outrie was a Theelin male child who lived during the Imperial Era. Around 3 ABY, they visited the zoo Wild Wollina's Animal Adventures on the Outer Rim planet Hon-Tallos along with their grandparent and a Theelin child when a hragscythe creature was set loose by members of the…

A Theelin individual was the grandparent of the Theelin boy Outrie and lived during the Imperial Era. Around 3 ABY, the individual, Outrie, and a Theelin child visited the zoo Wild Wollina's Animal Adventures on the Outer Rim planet Hon-Tallos.

A Theelin child lived during the Imperial Era. Around 3 ABY, while they accompanied the Theelin boy Outrie and their grandparent to the zoo Wild Wollina's Animal Adventures on the Outer Rim planet Hon-Tallos, a hragscythe creature was set loose and Outrie was separated from th…
Wollina was a Patrolian crime lord who lived during the Imperial Era and led a criminal syndicate. At some point, he built a zoo on Hon-Tallos with the help of the Shani bounty hunter Deva Lompop.

Zorna was a human Imperial officer who served the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. At some point between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Zorna was stationed on the Raider-class corvette King's Ransom owned by Captain Cerasus Ehllo, and worked with another officer to unlock the journa…

A human Imperial officer served the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. At some point between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the officer was stationed aboard the personal Raider-class corvette of Captain Cerasus Ehllo, the King's Ransom, and attempted to unlock the journals of Starros …

t: Unidentified Pantoran Path of the Closed Fist member
x: A Pantoran male youth was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult and its sub-group the Path of the Closed Fist. During the Night of Sorrow, the boy fought with the Path but refused orders from commander Binnot Ullo to fight and kill.

Geth was a human who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult and its sub-group the Path of the Closed Fist. He was in a relationship with the Children of the Open Hand member Shea Ganandra, who eventually became pregnant with their child, though Geth did not know.

Kane was a Weequay male who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult and its sub-group the Path of the Closed Fist traveled with other members of the Path on a starship carrying many eggs of the Nameless species in 382 BBY.

t: Unidentified bearded Path of the Open Hand member
x: A bearded male was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult and its sub-group the Path of the Closed Fist. In 382 BBY, during the Night of Sorrow, at the Path compound on the planet Dalna knocked down Jedi Knight Aida Forte and swung at her with a metal lance.

In 382 BBY, Jedi Initiate Cippa Tarko and Jedi Master Yaddle encountered a child who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult at the Path compound on the planet Dalna while on an undercover mission investigating the cult.
An Eirami elder was a counselor that helped ruled the planet Eiram alongside its Queen Adrialla, her wife Odelia and their son Phan-tu Zenn.
Phineas Flynn was a Force-sensitive human male who lived on the desert planet Tatooine. He worked as a moisture farmer with his stepbrother Ferb Fletcher.

An elderly human male was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult that was found in a hut at the Path compound on the planet Dalna by Jedi Master Yaddle and Jedi Initiate Cippa Tarko shortly before the Night of Sorrow in 382 BBY.

Vin was a Muun Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, after Jedi Master Zallah Macri and her Padawan Kevmo Zink were killed on the planet Dalna, Vin and Jedi Knight Azlin Rell met at the Kyber Arch in the planet Coruscant's Jedi Temple to honor…

Vanessa was a Twi'lek female musician performing in various locations. In 1 BBY, she performed "I'm Feelin' So Low" alongside the Ortolan musician Maximilian Rebo in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the desert planet Tatooine.
A Imperial armored commando served Moff Gideon during the New Republic Era.
A shield commando served Moff Gideon during the New Republic Era.
A shield commando served Moff Gideon during the New Republic Era.
Isabella was a female human pilot who owned the Centennial Chihuahua. The young pilot was a rival to the smuggler Han Solo.

Baljeet was a human male who accidentally joined the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper when he tried to sign up for a physics camp. He was assigned to buy a new pair of socks for Darth Vader with Buford and Candace.
Perry, also known as Perry the Rebel-pus, Perry the Platypus, or simply Agent P, was a Platypus agent for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era.
The mother of Sebulba was a female individual. At one point she criticized Sebulba for dressing like a podracer.

Biana Drayce was a Human female who served as an Admiral for the Galactic Alliance. She was the mother of Voyce Evlen, a Captain in the Alliance. Drayce had tacyodermitis that caused her twitching which she hid from her superiors.

An individual was a human Imperial officer tasked as the commanding officer of Candace under the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, the commanding officer was aboard the Tantive IV to chase after the Rebellions.
A Mandalorian watchman worked on the langskib on the planet Mandalore.

Dan was a human who worked as an officer for the Galactic Empire, and was a friend of their fellow officer Jeff. In 1 BBY, Dan walked in on Jeff with a cup of coffee and proceeded to make fun of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Jeff was an officer working under the Galactic Empire.
Hologram was a major that served during the Galactic Civil War under the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Pord was a young Gamorrean pirate who belonged to Taborr Val Dorn's gang. She once stole fruit from the Kublop Springs marketplace.
A human was a warrior of the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn. In 3 ABY, they took part in an attack on the Mourner's Wail Syndicate but was killed by the nexu Furball.

A soldier served the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, the soldier accompanied General Vukorah and a doctor to an Unbroken Clan safe house on the planet Corellia after Vukorah was wounded by Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra and Sana St…

A human served as a Imperial officer aboard the Executor, the flagship of Darth Vader, during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the officer was present aboard the Executor in the Jekara system as it was attacked by the Hutt Clan.

A human individual was a stormtrooper sergeant of the Galactic Empire who was stationed aboard the Executor, the flagship of Darth Vader, during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the Executor was present above the planet Jekara when it was attacked by the Hutt Clan.
A member of the Galactic Empire was the commander of a group of Imperial cadets, including the human Venn.

A Vak male held the title of premier on the Unknown Regions Vak Combine nation's planet of Primea. In 19 BBY, the premier became acquainted with the Nikardun General Yiv, and the two had spoken at length while the Nikardun was on Primea, as he had hoped to subjugate the Vak Co…

A civilian of Theed was one of Padmé Amidala's many decoys. During the 32 BBY Naboo crisis, Queen Amidala and her forces went to the Gungan Sacred Place to seek an audience with Boss Rugor Nass, leader of the Gungan community.
Ro was an Evereni individual who was a member of the Ro family. Between circa 350 BBY and 330 BBY, they kidnapped the female Mari San Tekka, who had the ability to see paths through hyperspace.
An individual was the Jedi Master of Padawan Hanna Ding.
Lawrence Fletcher was a human male who resided on the desert planet Tatooine. He was the father of Ferb Fletcher and the stepfather of Phineas Flynn and Candace.

t: Candace and Phineas Flynn's biological father
x: The biological father of Candace and Phineas Flynn was a male individual who was married to Linda Flynn-Fletcher and started a family. Linda was later remarried with Lawrence Fletcher sometime after Candace's departure to join the Galactic Empire.
Linda Flynn-Fletcher was the mother of Candace, Phineas Flynn, and Ferb Fletcher who resided on the desert planet Tatooine.
Korej Lim was a bounty hunter who fought Cal Kestis on the planet Koboh.
Vashtan Wolfe was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a green crossguard lightsaber. He also carried a wrist blaster, grenades, and a cloaking device, similarly to Drya Thornne.

Kip Ostar was a bounty hunter and member of the Haxion Brood who fought Cal Kestis on the planet Koboh. Potentially doctored Imperial records held that Ostar had killed more people than the number killed in the Imperial campaign on Subterrel.
Gabs was a friend of Cal Kestis and member of the Stinger Mantis crew. She was a syndicate-trained slicer, and used her skills to enrich herself while fighting the Galactic Empire.
Koob was a Klatooinian male member of the Stinger Mantis crew and friend of Cal Kestis, who he met on Norsid.
Lizz was a Klatooinian female member of the Stinger Mantis crew and friend of Cal Kestis, whom she met on Norsid.
Bravo was a human male that served as the pilot of the Stinger Mantis crew during the Imperial Era. He also served as a soldier and fought alongside Saw Gerrera.

The Lady of Angcord was a human female who was the ruler and Lady of the planet Angcord. In 482 BBY the Lady met with Jedi Master Barnabas Vim and his Padawan Vix Fonnick, who were visiting the planet in search of the fabled Echo Stone, and asked them to help stop their world …
A man served as dockmaster for Port Haileap. He was murdered by Treze.
Selfin Jook was a bounty hunter who fought Cal Kestis on the planet Koboh. They burst onto the galactic stage following a daring escape from a Republic prison.
Anoth Estra was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a cyan double-bladed lightsaber who fought Cal Kestis. Cal found them and killed them in the Chamber of Fortitude on Koboh.
Gido was a Trodatome male prospector who resided on the planet Koboh. Gido was in a relationship with the human Gulu.
Gulu was a human male prospector who lived during the Imperial Era. Gulu resided on the planet Koboh and was in a relationship with the Trodatome Gido.
Kata Akuna was a human female who was the daughter of Bode and Tayala Akuna.
Caij Vanda was a Nautolan female bounty hunter who was active during the Imperial Era.
Tague Louesh was a Bedlam Raider Lieutenant who was considered skilled enough by Rayvis to be gifted a blue double-bladed lightsaber and a whipcord launcher.

Mosey Cimmaron was a human who resided on the planet Koboh during the Imperial Era. From a young age, she was a proficient tracker and hunter and frequently encountered dangerous creatures during individual hunts and with her family members.
Zygg Soza was a human female who resided on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
Navik, known as Navik the Red, was a Rodian of Chattza clan who declared himself Grand Protector of his homeworld Rodia after overthrowing his rivals during an insurrection in 17 BBY.

Meyen Corr was a bounty hunter who fought Cal Kestis on the planet Koboh. Corr's reputation was solid but unremarkable, and she was known to get the job down without the flair of her colleagues in the Haxion Brood.

Kili Oso, also known as "The Closer," was one of Sorc Tormo's top bounty hunters; few survived a fight against him. He was a known survivor of many fights on Ordo Eris' Death Pits and had the distinction of having been denounced and sentenced to death by an Imperial Moff.
Fenn Finau was a bounty hunter who fought Cal Kestis. He was the brother of Masi Finau, and the siblings worked as a bounty hunting team alongside their droid KLE-0.

Masi Finau was a bounty hunter for the Haxion Brood who fought Cal Kestis on II-0810 Satellite Station. He was the brother of Fenn Finau, and the siblings worked as a bounty hunting team alongside their droid KLE-0.

Vaslyn Martz was a bounty hunter who fought Cal Kestis on the planet Koboh. Marta profited from a long career with the Black Sun before being strong-armed by Sorc Tormo, who was impressed by HoloNet-circulated footage of Martz single-handedly dispatching a senator's honor guard.

Corde, known as the Half, was a bounty hunter who fought Cal Kestis on the moon Jedha alongside PR-85T. She took pride in her precise aim and slicer's intuition, a skill she used to upgrade PR-85T. She was further known for cannibalizing parts from droids she considered lesser.

A Zabrak lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 4 ABY, the Zabrak went to the shop owned by the Kajain'sa'Nikto Narin after an incident occurred at the shop. The Zabrak asked Narin if there had been trouble, to which Narin responded it was under control.

Narin was a Kajain'sa'Nikto who ran a shop during the reign of the Galactic Empire, and was an old acquaintance of the smuggler Lando Calrissian, who had helped Narin get a job with Jabba the Hutt at one point.
Rick, known as the Door Technician, was a human scout trooper of the Galactic Empire's scout trooper corps who served as a door technician at Imperial Post 8L-055 on the planet Koboh.
An individual was the sister of Mosey Cimmaron. The pair at one point hunted a fierce creature on the Wild Space planet Farana.

Lank Denvik was a human male commander in the Galactic Empire who served as a chief supervisor for the Imperial Security Bureau. In 9 BBY, he was the commander of the II-0810 Satellite Station in the Nova Garon system.
Skoova Stev was a Sakavian male and a master fisherman who hailed from Sakavi Tar and worked on the planet of Koboh.
Tulakt was a female alien fortune teller who was a visitor of Pyloon's Saloon on the planet Koboh during the Imperial Era.

"Prince" Patren was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant who wielded an orange crossguard lightsaber. Rayvis sent him along with Urjef Mekor and Sebb Eshan in Phon'Qi's Grotto on the planet Koboh. They ambushed Jedi Knight Cal Kestis and tried to kill him.
Urjef Mekor was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a green double-bladed lightsaber. Rayvis sent him along with "Prince" Patren and Sebb Eshan to Phon'Qi's Grotto.
Sebb Eshan was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a purple double-bladed lightsaber. Rayvis sent him along with "Prince" Patren and Urjef Mekor in Phon'Qi's Grotto.
Tayala Akuna was a human female who was the wife of former Jedi Knight Bode Akuna, and mother of Kata Akuna.
Tulli Mu was a female alien individual who, along with her talkative employee Bhima Ook, ran her own Holotactics game in Pyloon's Saloon on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.

San Dersen was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a yellow double-bladed lightsaber who fought Cal Kestis alongside Mads Gresh. After Urgost's death, they were the last two lieutenants of Bedlam Raiders to protect Dagan Gera. Kestis succeeded to kill them after a fierce fight.
Mads Gresh was a lieutenant of the Bedlam Raiders, who wielded a cyan crossguard lightsaber. After Urgost's death, she was one of two last lieutenants of Bedlam Raiders to protect Dagan Gera.
Cleland Cudds was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a magenta double-bladed lightsaber who fought Cal Kestis. Cal found and killed them in the Flooded Bunker on Koboh.

A human male served as a tech stormtrooper of the First Order. In 34 ABY, the tech stormtrooper accompanied Commander Pyre to the supertanker fuel depot Colossus on the planet Castilon to hunt for two orphans from the planet Tehar, Eila and Kel.
A clone trooper officer took part in the Battle of Abrion Bridge.

The First Pilgrim was an alien individual who led the Pilgrim Warriors on the planet Angcord. In 482 BBY the First Pilgrim served the Lady of Angcord when she met with Jedi Master Barnabas Vim and his Padawan Vix Fonnick, who were visiting the planet in search of the fabled Ec…
Moran was a male Mirialan living on Koboh. He formerly worked for the Republic Tax Collection Agency.

Gretta was a human individual who was born on Jedha to a family who were all Fallanassi. At one point she found the kyber crystal specialist Cuata after he fled from the Galactic Empire, brought him to the planet Christophsis and began working with him.

Urgost, Fist of Rayvis served as a smasher in the Bedlam Raiders. He was personally trained in the use of the electrohammer by the raiders leader, Rayvis, coming to treat the weapon as an extension of his own arm.

Sember Vey was a female human Jedi Master who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. She was a protégé of Chief Librarian Jocasta Nu and spent most of her time in the field collecting artifacts and lost knowledge for the Jedi Archives.

Brethupp was an Ewok who lived in Bright Tree Village on the forest moon of Endor. In 4 ABY, Brethupp was present in the village center when a group of rebel captives were brought in by a scouting party.
Elocin was an individual who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire who operated a crew and ran a club. She also came to know the smugglers Lando Calrissian and Han Solo.

Bhima Ook was a male alien individual who, along with Tulli Mu, ran their own holotactics game in Pyloon's Saloon on Koboh. Bhima was technically an employee of Mu, but used his outsized personality to entertain players and spectators alike.

An individual served as a doctor in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era. After the former Imperial Magna Tolvan joined the Rebel Alliance around 1 ABY, the doctor told her that forgiveness was an essential part of healing and moving on.
Raena Zess was a young human who lived on Tenoo during the High Republic Era. She had a rivalry with Nash Durango.
The uncle of Raena Zess lived during the High Republic Era on Tenoo.

Ceeli Durango was the mother of the pilot Nash Durango who lived during the High Republic Era on Tenoo together with their partner, Kryys Durango. They both watched their daughter race in and win the Kublop Classic.

Kryys Durango was one of the two mothers of the pilot Nash Durango. She lived during the High Republic Era on Tenoo together with her partner, Ceeli Durango. They both watched their daughter race in and win the Kublop Classic.
Kaliah Kublop was the first person to visit the planet Tenoo, where she founded the city of Kublop Springs.

Maarla Jinara was a Chadra-Fan female who owned a junkyard on the planet Tenoo. In 232 BBY, she enlisted the help of three Jedi younglings, as well as the pilot Nash Durango, to assist in catching thieves who had been stealing her junk.

Weebo was a Rodian female farmer who grew jellyfruit on the planet Tenoo. Around 233 BBY, her jellyfruit harvest was stolen by pirates just before the fruit was to be used for the Jellyfruit Festival.
Zepher was a Mon Calamari starship engineer who ran a starship repair shop based on the moon Dedoon of the planet Tenoo.

Raxlo was a Gozzo who lived during the High Republic Era and was the head of the Raxlo Corporation. He often used his custom harvesting vehicle to deforest Outer Rim planets in the name of maximizing profits.

Ace Kallisto was a human female master thief who lived during the High Republic Era. She was once the rival of Jedi Master Zia Zaldor Zanna. Around 233 BBY, the Master Thief reunited with her former rival once again by stealing her shuttle.
Faraz was a Houk technician and an old friend of Zia Zaldor Zanna who lived during the High Republic Era.
Ansen Strung was a Dowutin male bounty hunter who later worked as a creature tracker during the High Republic Era. He was hired by the human Raena Zess to find her missing pet kibbin Figgles.
Warok was an Ewok who lived on the forest moon of the planet Endor.
Wini Eres was a female Namara who resided on the planet Koboh.
Grock was a tradesman and mechanic who worked alongside Dana to find treasures on the planet Koboh. In 9 BBY Grock was killed stealing a valuable fuel injector from Imperial territory on Koboh.
Dana was a human mechanic and prospector who worked alongside Grock on the planet Koboh.
Filkus Gorr was a Melbu prospector who repaired B1-series battle droids to sell to the Bedlam Raiders and their leader Rayvis on the planet Koboh.
Pili Walde was an alien botanist who resided on the planet Koboh and worked at Pyloon's Saloon for Greez Dritus.

Toa was a Twi'lek historian who was brought to the planet Koboh, due to her archaeological interest in the planet. She had a keen interest in High Republic history and was eager to study the numerous ruins found on Koboh.

Rugal was a female Jedi in hiding that resided on the desert planet of Golak at some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY. During those years, she ran the Golak Mahal, a roadside motel located on the planet.
Lasro Javeq's wife was a female individual married to Lasro Javeq, a freighter captain for Xizor Transport Systems.
Gar-Ee was a Sith Eternal cultist on the planet Exegol. They were a rival of Ash-Ke, who enlisted the help of a protocol droid to defeat them.

Granny Greenthumb was a woman who resided in the Tuanul Village. She was delivered Tooke-trap plant seeds that came from Gungan Greenthumb. Once they were planted, First Order stormtroopers were alerted of their smuggling onto the planet and attacked her.
Wan'yek Whett was the captain of a crew of fishermen and the ship Grapnel.

Dreyo was Moran's smuggling partner on Coruscant. Once the Empire formed, Dreyo left Moran's smuggling operations because of the Empire's crack down on crime. Moran believed Dreyo was unaware he was alive by 9 BBY.

A human Sith Lord active during a war between the Jedi Order and the Sith, Bichan wore a red face-concealing mask and wielded a lightsaber with an attached whip. At one point, he fought and killed a group of eight Jedi, including the teacher of the Padawan Toul.
Soont Madas was a Gotarite male priorite prospector and technologist who resided on the planet Koboh. He was consumed by greed and tried to access a Jedi Chamber using explosive roller mines.

The Sith Mother was a Force-sensitive near-human female Sith Lord who lived in the galaxy. At some point, she travelled to a planet where she met the young girl Daal, and made the girl her apprentice.

Aau was a Force-sensitive Korban girl who lived on the planet Korba with her father, Abat. On Korba, Aau washed beasts near the entrance of a mine shaft where Abat worked by 19 BBY. After the Jedi Kratu visited the pair's home, they traveled to their respective workstations.
Abat was a male Korban who worked as a miner and lived with his daughter, Aau, on the planet Korba.
Hans R'kov was a Troglof who held the title of Hanna City dance champion from the years 6 ABY to 8 ABY.
Gretchen was a human female pilot who acquainted fellow pilot Isabella and led the Rebellion starfighter squadron Firestar Girls during the Galactic Civil War.
Hytho Pixx was a Bedlam Raider lieutenant wielding a magenta crossguard lightsaber who fought Cal Kestis on the planet Koboh. Cal found him and killed him on the Lucrehulk-class battleship Primacy.
Gatt Medo was a bounty hunter who fought Cal Kestis on the planet Coruscant.

Daal was a Force-sensitive human female who lived on a planet where she worked in an Imperial workhouse as an orphan. At some point, she received an amulet that allowed for communication to a Sith Lord known as the Sith Mother.
Garra was a Rodian prospector on the planet Koboh who hoped to join the Bedlam Raiders in order to stop being seen as weak.

Gluth Andoi was a Morseerian Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he was a member of the Jedi High Council and took part in the Battle of Dalna against the Path of the Open Hand.
Rinn was a Duros Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. He was the marshal of the Jedi outpost on Elphrona.
Loi'e was a near-human cabaret performer and spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era.

Gumar Adraki was an Andraven villager who lived on the planet Andraven in a village. Around 233 BBY, when it came time to migrate the wellagrin creatures from one side of a mountain to the other, he and his brother Jam were joined by a trio of Jedi younglings: Kai Brightstar, …

A human female who lived on the planet Wayyl, this villager owned a pet dog. Between the years 68 BBY and 58 BBY she was residing in her house when her dog went outside, encountering Jedi Master Dooku and Jedi Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn, on a mission to rescue Senator Dagonet's son,…
Dhar Wat was a male Octani who was selling Capacitor parts on the planet Kamil during the First Order-Resistance War.

Mirro Lox was a human male Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Lox and his Padawan Amadeo Azzazzo were called back to Coruscant.
Attu was a Korban who worked as a miner on the planet Korba.
Galamal was a Barabel who owned the starship Bonecrusher.

Jaluka Jianga was a male Gungan hermit who lived on the planet Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, a spacer working for Palo, a Naboo artist, defended Jaluka Jianga who was attacked by an ikopi near the city of Moenia.
Jettero Heler was the president of the Outer Rim planet Hashaulh.

A Twi'lek gang leader was in charge of the Nova Razors, the most ruthless gang on the planet Bestine IV. His gang ran a spice business in the market district of Bsellis City out of the local housing tenement Blue Garden Homes, where they enslaved locals to refine spice.
A Chiss female fighter pilot flew under the call sign of Zark Two as part of Zark Squadron.
Joran Wostikian was the former president of the Outer Rim planet Hashaulh.
Soltan Wostikian was the son of Joran Wostikian and adopted son of Jettero Heler.
Angus Thermopyle was a journalist from the planet Alderaan.

Drooto Sploonore was a Rodian who was wanted for 50,000 credits.
Broont Cloone was an individual who wanted the Trandoshan Traggissk Reosss of the Winnard Clan.
Servid Norn was the leader of a pirate faction, a rival to Plook Hartar, and the brother of Harrid Norn.

The father of a duchess serving the Mid Rim planet Malastare waged a number of wars. By the time Jedi Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn began studying the holocron of prophecy in 67 BBY, the duchess's father was considered ancient among members of the Jedi Order.
A Wookiee child was enslaved by the Czerka Corporation in 40 BBY. On his first day in slavery, his hand was shaved so that a slave-tracking chip could be implanted under his skin.
Jaylen Vrax, born Jaylen Barsha, was a human male crime lord, and heir to the fortunes of his wealthy Corellian business family, the Barshas. He was an associate of Kay Vess during the Imperial Era.

Nix was a merqaal companion of Kay Vess during the Imperial Era. He grew up on an unknown jungle world and was captured by the Sixth Kin to be sold as an exotic pet. However, he was rescued by Kay Vess, becoming loyal partners in crime.

Kay Vess, also known by the alias Toren Valario Nupp, was a young human female criminal from the Worker's District in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica, who was raised and trained by her mother Riko Vess, becoming a professional thief and eventually a scoundrel and outlaw in…
Hétis was a waitress at Loi'e's Follies, and Loi'e's daughter.
Jon was a rebel who worked at Loi'e's Follies.
Loi'e's son was the near-human son of the rebel Loi'e. He served the Galactic Empire after being kidnapped as a child.
Danka Orsato was a Mon Calamari information broker who lived in the time of the Imperial Era.
An Imperial officer was a friend of Danka Orsato during the time of the Imperial Era.
An individual was a lieutenant in the Pyke Syndicate. In 3 ABY, the criminal Kay Vess was hired to steal an object from the lieutenant.

Kala was a human female E'roni who lived in U'ronoh village on the planet E'ronoh during the High Republic Era. She talked with members of the Path of the Open Hand Force religion when they visited the world.
Filias was the brother of the Gotarite Soont Madas who lived on the planet Koboh.
Sovu was a Human male Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire

Thevera was a human female who was the daughter of Aryssha of the Starros Clan and Cerasus Ehllo, an Imperial captain. Their name was a mix of the first names of Aryssha's grandmother Thea Starros and Aryssha's mother Mevera Starros.

Desana was a human female who was the daughter of Aryssha of the Starros Clan and Cerasus Ehllo, an Imperial captain. They were born, along with their twin Thevera, on the Raider-class corvette King's Ransom between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.

Feyra Akaris was the mother of Iskat Akaris. Once a Jedi Padawan, Feyra left the Jedi Order after failing her Jedi Trials, specifically her Trial of the Spirit, and returned to her homeworld of Pkori.

A human Imperial officer served the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. In 4 ABY, Lando Calrissian visited Narin's, a weapons shop ran by the Kajain'sa'Nikto Narin, to acquire a datacard that contained plans for Jabba's Palace which Calrissian needed.

A Dark Jedi was originally a Padawan apprenticed to a Jedi Knight. According to him. Sometime after 4 ABY, his master gave him the lightsaber of Anakin Skywalker. One day he fell to The Dark Side of The Force and years later started a cult.

Catak was a genderfluid Clawdite who served as the assistant of the scoundrel Khel Tanna. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Catak and Tanna were present at the Bounty Hunters Guild Social Club on the planet D'Assem, where Tanna had set up a meeting with the bounty hunter T'onga, so she…
A Twi'lek served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, she participated in an attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna.
A Weequay Jedi served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, they participated in an attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna.
A human was a Dhani chieftain who in 5 BBY led a pilgrimage on the planet Aldhani to the sacred temple Nasma Brani to watch the occurrence of the Eye of Aldhani.

An individual served as the chief executive officer of the transport company Sord Montok. When the Wookiee slave Reerookachuck started a riot and escaped after being taken aboard one the company's slave ships, the eponymous Sord Montok, the CEO issued a sixty-five thousand cre…

Harrid Norn was a pilot and the brother of the pirate leader Servid Norn. In a race against Plook Hartar's pilot, the Rodian Scranton Toon, his brother placed a bounty on Toon to ensure Norn would win.
A human served as a corporal in the Aldhani Garrison as part of the Low Road Unit.

A Qubey lived on the Outer Rim moon Caliban by the time of the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, it became separated from its parent during Separatist General Grievous' invasion of the moon and found itself trapped on one side of a chasm due to the destruction of a lunar ice bridge.
A Gungan of the Otolla subspecies lived on Naboo with their mother as a child during the Clone Wars. The child found and took possession of a Wookiee doll, which secretly contained an artifact.

Eda'Ni was a human Jedi Padawan who lived during the Republic Era. At one point during the Clone Wars, Eda'Ni was one of a number of Padawans who were present at the Sason Temple on the Outer Rim gas giant Sason.
A female Twi'lek was an Elder of the Path of the Open Hand cult on the planet Dalnan.

Val Tula was a female courier of the Galactic Empire who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, she was assigned to the planet Naboo. There, she served under a corrupted Imperial official acquainted with the the Hutt crime lord Borvo.
Mubarr was a male Gungan who lived on the planet Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, the Gungan was indebted to the the Hutt crime lord Borvo.
Kyla Tane was a female individual who worked as a merchant aboard the Vaiken Spacedock.

Regnar Pulip was a generous supporter of the Path of the Open Hand cult on the planet Dalna. The Mother asked him to send special protein supplement for the cult.

A Whiphid individual was a councilor within a governmental body of the New Republic that included chief of state Leia Organa Solo in 13 ABY. The Whiphip insisted on the arrest of Organa Solo's security chief Mirith Sinn after a chain of events in which she was implicated.

A Falleen male was the aide of Lord Gyuti. Lady Qi'ra, the leader of the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate, approached Lord Gyuti, a leader of the Black Sun, to offer Crimson Dawn's services to Black Sun.
Bryen Rowne was a human pilot who served as a captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

Dancer was one of eight reindeer under the ownership of the Jedi Knight Santa Claus, alongside Dasher, Prancer, Vixen, Comet, Cupid, Dunder, and Blixem.

Blixem was one of the eight reindeer owned by the Jedi Knight Santa Claus, alongside Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Comet, Vixen, Cupid, and Dunder. Blixem pulled Claus' sleigh on the annual holiday Christmas, to assist him in his delivery of presents to children throughout the galaxy.

Dunder was one of the eight reindeer owned by the Jedi Knight Santa Claus, alongside Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Comet, Vixen, Cupid, and Blixem. Dunder pulled Claus' sleigh on the annual holiday Christmas, to assist him in his delivery of presents to children throughout the galaxy.

Cupid was one of the many reindeer owned by the Jedi Knight Santa Claus, alongside Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Comet, Vixen, Dunder, and Blixem. Cupid pulled Claus' sleigh on the annual holiday Christmas, to assist him in his delivery of presents to children throughout the galaxy.

Kodom was a Gormak male and the co-leader of the Shrine Restoration Initiative, an organization created to rebuild the shrines and temples of the planet Voss following the Invasion of Voss.

Maton-Ja was a Voss male and the co-leader of the Shrine Restoration Initiative, an organization created to rebuild the shrines and temples of the planet Voss following the Invasion of Voss. As the representative of his species, he sought to preserve Voss history.

x: A human officer in the Galactic Empire was stationed aboard the Sith Lord Darth Vader's Venator-class Star Destroyer. At one point, the officer was tasked to repair Vader's TIE fighter, which had sustained damage.

A human Imperial officer served as a commander in the Galactic Empire's Inspectorate during the Imperial Era. The commander responded to a Rebel Alliance incursion on Coruscant and commanded the Imperial counter actions.

Fennro Drogan was a human native of the planet Ghorman born with a limb difference that gave him a short right arm with only four fingers. He eventually joined the Ghorman Front, a group formed against the Galactic Empire.

Marrok, known at one time as the First Brother, was a mysterious Force-sensitive male humanoid warrior who once served in the Inquisitorius of the Galactic Empire, and the Jedi Order before that.

An individual had a rank of a syndic in a ruling family of the Chiss Ascendancy. The syndic was in charge of a Chiss phalanx and was opposed to Assistant Syndic Soontir Fel and Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx.

Danto Parapa was a brief leader of the Parapa Cartel before running away after being scared of leading the cartel.
Funky Snoke was a humanoid male clone of Snoke who was created on the planet Exegol by the Sith Eternal cult. His cloning process was unsuccessful, leaving him with an altered personality.

A massive creature called the protector lived on Planet X. In 382 BBY, members of the Path of the Open Hand cult came across the creature as they were fleeing from an Under-Dweller, another massive creature that had attacked them after they had taken eggs of the Nameless speci…

An individual was the cousin of the Falleen Lord Xanak Grunseit. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, they were the leader of the criminal syndicate Black Sun. After the Falleen had a death mark placed on them by the Hutts, the cousin hired the bounty hunter Boba Fett to take the hit.
Ordo was a Talpini Nihil marauder who was part of the crew of the Gaze Electric, Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro's flagship.
Hume Tarl was a human stormtrooper who served as a member of the Galactic Empire's Tempest Force legion for six years and earned the rank of sergeant.

Tragor was an Ithorian male scientist and member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. Though his only child Boolan remembered him as a brilliant researcher, Tragor was nonetheless said to have been a troubled individual who was unable to discover a location for him to call home.
Tareen was a Duros pilot who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, he joined a mission to the fabled Planet X to retrieve eggs of the Nameless species aboard the Bonecrusher.

Hal was a human member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, Hal captained the Moon of Sarkhai for a mission to the fabled Planet X to retrieve eggs of the Nameless species, bringing a group of Path members with him on the ship and accompanying the Scupper and the Bon…

Ort was a Reesarian who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, she joined a mission led by prospector Radicaz Dobbs alongside other Path members to the fabled Planet X to retrieve eggs of the Nameless species aboard the Scupper.
The husband of Kaela served the Galactic Empire between the years 19 BBY and 4 ABY. on the world of Torku.
Kaela was a museum guide who worked on the world of Torku.

Anker was a human rebel who fought the Galactic Empire on the world Torku alongside Bazer and Davgar Llian. He was killed by Darth Vader during the mission.
Darsana was a member of the Galactic Republic Senate from the planet Glee Anselm who was a strong supporter of the Military Creation Act.
Tronus was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire who was the apprentice of Darth Xarion, and secretly a member of the obscure Sith cult known as "The Unmasked".
Qrukk was a male Breather Gand who was a Sith Intelligence commander of the Sith Empire during the Third Galactic War against the Galactic Republic, where he participated in the Invasion of Manaan.
A Sith assassin was a former servant of Darth Ekkage of the Sith Empire during her tenure on the Dark Council.

Lumas was a human Padawan of the Jedi Order. In 22 BBY, Lumas was part of a Jedi assault team led by Jedi Master Mace Windu that traveled to the planet Geonosis in order to try and rescue Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Porter was a human pilot who served as a captain in the Starfighter Corps of the New Republic after the fall of the Galactic Empire.
Spider, designated CT-1123, was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who held the military rank of Clone Captain and led a company of troopers.
Sixty-Seven was a Purge Trooper who served in the Inquisitorius of the Galactic Empire.
Blue 22 was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.
Last Man, designated CT-0528, was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Josk Nivar, Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.

Doc was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider. He later executed Order 66 along with the rest of the company on Frong against his Jedi Generals.
Flip was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.

Nexu was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider. They shared their name with the nexu, a predatory feline from Cholganna.
Nic was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.
