Whirl was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.

Lan-Drus was an Arcona bounty hunter hired by the Galactic Empire to assassinate Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma. She was shot by Mon Mothma following the failed assassination attempt on the planet Desinta.
A soldier fought in a number of wars on the planet Crucival, eventually coming to serve the Malkhanis clan.
Noegaud was a human who bullied Niko in a town on an astronomical object somewhere in the galaxy.
Niko was a human who lived on an astronomical object with his mother sometime during the Imperial Era.
The Curse was an extremely powerful creature residing in the Shrine of Silence on Voss.

Vors d'Oesti was a member of Nym's Lok Revenants who lived during the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, Nym formed an alliance with the Detritus Satellites, a group of Vulture-class droids active in the Dantooine system.
A human served as a security guard for the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. In 3 BBY, the guard was stationed on duty at the entrance of the Imperial Navy facility on the planet Coruscant.

Velerie Tide was a Force-sensitive human female who was a member of the Jedi Order. After the Galactic Republic turned on the Jedi during the Great Jedi Purge that began in 19 BBY, Tide hid her identity and blended in among the locals on the astronomical object Athio III, but …
An individual served as a contact for Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano, core name "Formbi," of the Fifth Ruling Family.

Ironstar was an officer and pilot of the Rebel Alliance during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Commander Ironstar was present in the Naboo system where he piloted a X-wing starfighter.

A Nerrian piper was a musician who hailed from the Nerria system of the Outer Rim Territories' Suolriep sector. In 22 BBY, they were employed in the court of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure at his palace on the planet Tatooine in the Outer Rim's Arkanis sector.
A Togruta female was a member of the Nihil who sabotaged the Crashpoint Tower before the attack on the planet Valo.

A hunched Disciple was a member of the Elders of the Path led by Barbatash. After Trymant IV was reduced to an inhospitable desert following an Emergence of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, Barbatash remained on the planet, though the community's numbers and resources continued …

A Zabrak was a member of the Elders of the Path led by Barbatash. After Trymant IV was reduced to an inhospitable desert following an Emergence of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, Barbatash remained on the planet, though the community's numbers and resources continued to dwindle.

Torgo was a male who was the pilot and security officer of the Valo Security Force, operating in Lonisa City on the planet Valo. He was the partner of Idrax Snat, when the captain arrested Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram.
A Dug was one of the operators of Starlight Beacon.
A male individual was a member of the Nihil who attacked the planet Valo. He was killed when Lula Talisola shot his ship. He was the first victim of Lula.

A Qubey parent lived on their homeworld, the Outer Rim moon Caliban, during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 22 BBY, they became separated from their child during the Separatist General Grievous' invasion of Caliban.
Fghai'g Windrunner was a Rodian pilot of the Royal Naboo Security Forces who lived in the Naboo system during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Cien Wenzz was a male Rodian pirate who lived in the Dantooine system during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime around the time of the Battle of Yavin, Wenzz attacked a freighter carrying spice to the planet Dantooine.

Limna Renence was an officer of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, Renence was a recruiting officer in the recruitment office of the Imperial Navy.

Jen Kynlaz was an officer within the armed forces of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, Major Jen Kynlaz was concerned about acts of theft and looting being committed by scavengers in the Dantooine system.
An Imperial soldier serving in the Battle of Hoth was responsible for escorting the captured Rebel General Crix Madine from Hoth to Captain Xamuel Lennox's Tyrant.
Sunghi Silpari was a Kiffar female Jedi Knight who fought in the Clone Wars.

Ghymnon was a sentient acellular pathogen that was the sole inhabitant of the Unknown Regions planet Uokara. For millions of years, the pathogen covered the planet and killed thousands who attempted to conquer it.
Zeeth was a male Rodian Jedi Knight who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Josk Nivar was a male Jedi Knight who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. He was killed during his commanding mission to the planet Thule.

Vghand was an officer within the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, Vghand was stationed in the Dantooine system where he investigated a local criminal organization known as the Zel'iphian Slave Traders G…

Reegesk was a Ranat thief who was lurking in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine when the local moisture farmer Luke Skywalker entered with the Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 in 1 BBY.
Nath was a human who served in the Galactic Empire.

Gorneesh was king of the Duloks known as the Children of Vulgarr on the moon of Endor. During the reign of the New Republic, Gorneesh's Duloks worked with the Ewok siblings Gruekk and Graak to try and take control of Bright Tree Village by kidnapping Chief Chirpa.

A Dulok acted as religious leader for the group known as the Children of Vulgarr on the moon Endor. During the reign of the New Republic, the Dulok was amazed to witnessed the Lepi Jaxxon T. Tumperakki knocked out the Dulok King Gorneesh in a single kick.
A human served as a SCUBA troooper in the First Order in 34 ABY.
A human served as a SCUBA troooper in the First Order in 34 ABY.
Fvorn was a Duros Jedi Padawan who was taken at a young age to the Jedi Temple and trained in the use of the Force.

Heezo was a Force-sensitive Selonian male former Padawan and technician who worked in the Jedi Temple. Secretly an agent of Darth Sidious, he was instrumental in Iskat Akaris' turn to the dark side of the Force and was later murdered by her when she learned the truth.
Nanta was an Ewok in the Bright Tree tribe of the moon Endor. In 4 ABY, Nanta was part of a scouting party that discovered a group of rebel offworlders caught in one of their net traps.
Karie Neth, nicknamed "Krayt," was a human female pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's navy during its war against the Galactic Empire.

Brewhada was a Wookiee toymaker who was captured by the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo. After being tricked by Bennun Glau to capture Brewhada instead of the Sunburst gem, Greedo presented the Wookiee to a confused Jabba.
Bennun Glau was a headliner who worked at Jabba's Palace. Glau eventually stole the Sunburst gem from Jabba and made the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo do jobs for her.

Batten was a human Imperial officer who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Batten led an Imperial mission ordered by Emperor Sheev Palpatine to gather up everything within the Amaxine Station.
"The Curator," also known as the Gatekeeper, was a Cerean who served as the gatekeeper for one of the three holocrons of Spintir's Dawn Temple.
"The Warden" was a Zabrak who served as the gatekeeper for one of the three holocrons of Spintir's Dawn Temple.
"The Jailor" was a Miraluka who served as the gatekeeper for one of the three holocrons of Spintir's Dawn Temple.

A Tusken Raider youngling was having a celebration with other Tuskens that included a cake in 1 BBY. However, Platypus Rebel Alliance agent Perry accidentally fell onto the cake and destroyed it, upsetting the youngling and the other Tuskens.
A child was killed by the bounty hunter Shenda Mol when she was four days old at some point during the Republic Era.
A Whiphid was born by around 228 BBY. At some point by around 66 BBY, they were killed by the bounty hunter Shenda Mol.
Drakko was a Trandoshan who was a part of Bossk'wassak'Cradossk's gang during the Imperial Era.

Evar Orbus was an individual whose death was ironically caused by the musician Figrin D'an of the Modal Nodes, at some point prior to Figrin's younger brother Barquin D'an joining the Max Rebo Band, which had occurred by 4 ABY.

An engineer was a member of the Myke species. By around 40 ABY, the engineer attributed the name of the Aleph-class starfighter from a letter in their language that resembled the twin-tailed starship.

Rilo Grenth was a human male technician who served the Galactic Empire as a civilian contractor. Grenth was sent to the moon of Endor to implement and test the interconnectivity protocols of the Death Star's shield generator's system.

A female individual was the sister of Oola, a Twi'lek female dancer enslaved by the crime lord Jabba the Hutt. By the time of Oola's death in 4 ABY, they lived on the Hutt Space moon Nar Shaddaa with two daughters.

A human male served as a stormtrooper in the First Order during the New Republic Era. In 34 ABY, they accompanied Commander Pyre to the supertanker fuel depot Colossus to hunt for two Tehar orphans, Eila and Kel.

Unger Furnace was a pilot and mercenary during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Furnace was a commander of the Velocity Mercenaries. After the Battle of Yavin, Unger Furnace frequently piloted a YT-1300 light freighter in the Dathomir system.

The mother of the pilots Bly Tevin and Lina was an E'roni woman who hailed from the planet E'ronoh. She lived on the world with her family and sometimes cooked pilafa stew to feed her relatives, which her son enjoyed.

The grandfather of the pilots Bly Tevin and Lina was an E'roni man. At some point during their younger days, they served in the military of their homeworld—the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh—to combat the forces of the neighboring planet Eiram.

The grandmother of the pilots Bly Tevin and Lina was an E'roni woman who hailed from the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh. At some point when she was young, she watched ships from the Outer Rim planet Eiram fly over the Rook, E'ronoh's capital city.
Sep was a male Twi'lek child who was the younger brother of Bruff. He lived on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era.
Metz was a human who was the lead singer and electric vioddle player of the Ku-Bops. He performed on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era.
Braan was a male individual who served in the Galactic Alliance Marines as a member of the Void Jumpers, operating as their demolition man.
Uumay Hawlatha was an ancient Bimm Jedi Master who regularly assisted the Jedi Knight Iskat Akaris in her struggles to find clarity through meditation during the Clone Wars.

Theca was an Arkanian Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the Republic Era and was rumored to be well past two hundred years old. The Jedi sported white hair and maintained a good deal of energy for their age.

The wife of the E'roni pilot Kinni was a woman who lived on the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh during the High Republic Era. When the pilot enlisted in E'ronoh's fleet, she often missed dining with her wife due to the responsibilities of her duties.
Minna was a Human pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance and piloted the light freighter Constant Spirit.
Youk was a Mon Calamari navigator who was a member of the Rebel Alliance and served on the light freighter Constant Spirit.

A Kage male was the brother of a Kage female who eventually changed her name to Abda. The siblings resided on their homeworld Quarzite with their parents as part of a clan and engaged in combat training.
Sellaccc Orryak was a Trandoshan who led a biker gang known as the Ganguls on Tenoo.

A female individual was the mother of Xiri A'lbaran, the princess of the planet E'ronoh. On the day of her wedding to Prince Phan-tu Zenn of the planet Eiram in 382 BBY, A'lbaran wore a gown that had belonged to her mother.
A woman was the grandmother of the human E'roni Princess Xiri A'lbaran of the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh and a member of the world's royal family.
An individual was the assistant of Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark during the High Republic Era.

Tika was a female Iktotchi Jedi Initiate who became best friends with Iskat Akaris during their time at the Jedi Temple. However, during a training exercise, Tika was left with a severe injury to her spinal cord due to Akaris' accidental toppling of a column onto her.
Gobi was a Jedi of the Jedi Order and served as master to the Padawan Zeeth. They both fought in the First Battle of Geonosis, after which Zeeth was knighted.

A female Sullustan served the Jedi Order as a Padawan during the Republic Era and was trained by the Jedi Knight Josk Nivar. The Padawan aided their Master in a diplomatic mission to Chandrila and was later killed during the First Battle of Geonosis.
Brutus was a nekko tended by Mosey Cimmaron on the planet Koboh, in 9 BBY.
Inath was a male individual hailing from the planet Ralltiir. He was a New Republic senator and a member of the New Republic Ruling Council in 11 ABY.
The Warlord of the Tower was a male crime lord on the planet Koboh. He ruled from Riverbed Watch until the rise of the Bedlam Raiders and Rayvis.
A green-skinned Argazdan spacer visited a bar on the astronomical object Rekardia sometime before 382 BBY.

Salas was a male individual who served as a soldier of the planet Eiram during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he was killed by a mine on the planet E'ronoh, and as he died, Princess Xiri A'lbaran of E'ronoh sang the sailor's lament to him.
Neverez was a Jedi who lived during the High Republic Era. Led by Jedi Knight Gella Nattai, he joined an expedition to the planet Orvax as part of a Republic Pathfinder team.
A male member of the Chiss Ascendancy's Inrokini family was the grandfather of the Chiss Syndic Zenta.
Saresh was a Jedi Knight who owned the Circlet of Saresh.

Quez Totark was a legendary Dug composer and musician who mentored the Ortolan Maximilian Rebo and the Kitonak Droopy McCool in that field. He played a stringed instrument and taught his students that music was more important than life and death.
Daladit-Chan was the father of the Klatooinian musician Umpass-stay. In 4 ABY, Daladit-Chan gave the order to his son to kill the Hutt Jabba Desilijic Tiure through a DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid.
Braygh was a Besalisk female who operated on the planet Kundu Minor during the High Republic Era.
Slaygh was a Besalisk who operated on the planet Kundu Minor during the High Republic Era.
Kreb was a Devaronian who was serving a prison sentence in a Galactic Empire prison in 4 ABY.
Micho, also known as Old Micho was a human who served the Galactic Empire. By 4 ABY, Micho was imprisoned in an Imperial prison where he met the Devaronian Kreb.

A human individual served in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau. He interrogated the former Imperial technician Rilo Grenth on the moon Endor due to suspicions of him being a Rebel spy, ultimately ordering his arrest and imprisonment.
In 4 ABY, an Ewok approached the Galactic Empire technician Rilo Grenth while he was on break. The Ewok pulled out a spear on Grenth before they were scared off by blaster fire from a scout trooper.

A human was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the rebel was present aboard the Alliance's flagship, Home One, and spoke with the smuggler Lando Calrissian as he sought to find General Leia Organa about using the …

A human Bespinite lived in Cloud City at the gas giant Bespin during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, after the Galactic Empire took over the city, the human was frozen in carbonite along with other Bespinites by the Empire to be taken to the Imperial Security Bureau for interrogat…

A Lurmen bounty hunter operated during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he had a prosthetic eye and traveled to the Outer Rim planet Eiram to attempt to claim a bounty on Axel Greylark, the son of Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark.
A weak-minded individual was a patron of the Outlander Club in the Uscru Entertainment District of the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY.
Bruff was a male Twi'lek musician and a member of the Ku-Bops. He was friends with fellow band member Metz. He played the rumble bass.
Hamm was a radio communications clone trooper who participated in the Second Battle of Geonosis.
A male Tintinna was married to a Tintinna woman. He was killed in an attack on the city of U'ronoh on the planet E'ronoh. Later it turned out that Axel Greylark killed him.
Jopar Tandil was an individual who worked as staff in Tech Management for the Jedi Order in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.
A Lasat bounty hunter traveled to the Outer Rim planet Eiram in 382 BBY, hoping to collect a bounty on the Republic envoy Axel Greylark.
Senna Strung was a female Dowutin bounty hunter and the younger sister of Ansen Strung.
Inaya was a female human princess of Hazun. While visiting the planet Tenoo for a gift for her father, she was accompanied by the droid PD-4.
Jensen Corbyt was a human who served as a lieutenant in the New Republic Defense Fleet, holding the position of First Officer under Captain Hayle on board the Defender-class cruiser Vesper.

Mycho Zala was a Zekodoan prospector during the High Republic Era. He was an associate of Jedi Master Zia Zaldor Zana and friend of the Jedi Order, and met Jedi Initiate Kai Brightstar and Tenoo pilot Nash Durango on Tatooine around 233 BBY to receive a hyperdrive capacitor.
Dreand Yens was a male individual who served as prime minister of the moon Madurs in 4 ABY.
Draiven Bosh was a Moldwarp thief and collector who lived during the High Republic Era. He owned a droid named K-2PL and an astromech droid named R4-13.
Oswin Dicto was a human male who served as the captain of the Star Cruiser Halcyon during its first voyage free of the Galactic Empire in 4 ABY.

Gamodar was an elderly Ortolan male shopkeeper. He lived in an apartment above his shop on Bar'leth, with several pet tookas. Prior to the First Battle of Geonosis, Gamodar often acquired Jedi and Sith relics, which he traded to Jedi Master Sember Vey.

Jooro Jarrot, also known as "Speeds," was a Quarren member of a biker gang called the Ganguls. When the biker gang expanded into a pirate gang, Jarrot remained as the Ganguls' second-in-command behind their leader Sellaccc Orryak. Jarrot used a net caster in combat.

Toda-Joh was an Anzellan member of the biker gang known as the Ganguls. When the biker gang expanded into a pirate gang, Toda-Joh remained one of the Ganguls' second-in-command behind his leader Sellaccc Orryak.
Varish, referred to by her students as Ms. Varish, was a female Malangsha who worked as a gardening instructor to Jedi Initiates on the planet of Langsha-Raang during the High Republic Era.
Ori was a human male who briefly worked for the biker gang Ganguls as a common thief.
Drahric was a Jablogian bartender who operated in the town of Aklyrr Bend on Tenoo.
Geeli was a Latero who visited his friend, the chef Hap in Hap's Sap Tap.
Muxa was a Mirialan who delivered ingredients for the Latero chef Hap.
Tooba Jinx was an Otolla Gungan who worked with Ace Kallisto and Ishbul Ekwesh to retrieve the Tharnakan Story Stone. Jinx betrayed his crew and stole the Stone to sell it.
Ishbul Ekwesh was a Tharnakan who worked with Ace Kallisto and Tooba Jinx to retrieve the Tharnakan Story Stone.
A Chiss male officer served in the Chiss Ascendancy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The officer wore a black uniform.
Tanteek was a female Corellian hound owned by Raf Thatchburn.

Borrim Shub was an alien that found itself on the streets of the planet Daiyu in 9 BBY. While just trying to get by like everyone else, Shub encountered the human child Princess Leia Organa, who nearly ran into the alien.

Sweebotta was an alien who was also known as Sweetie due to their friendly face. In 9 BBY, Sweebotta was at a street market on the planet Daiyu when Princess Leia Organa ran through the alien's four tall legs while fleeing from the fugitive Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Grelli Cryko was a Melitto from the planet Li-Toran. In 9 BBY, Cryko drank in a saloon in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.
The father of the human Princess Inaya was king of the planet Hazun.

Killian Tagge was a human male who, along with Sanya Tagge, was the head of the Tagge Corporation before their daughter Domina. Killian and Sanya were Separatists, who bid for a contract to supply battle droids, though they failed to secure the contract.
Sanya Tagge was a human female. Along with Killian Tagge, with who they had four children—Domina, Orman, Silas, and Ulric—Sanya was the head of the Tagge Corporation.

Pyt'r Stevar was a Jedi Master from the High Republic Era. They were stationed on Koboh, and were planetside during the Great Hyperspace Disaster, in which an Emergence destroyed Koboh's moon, causing catastrophic damage to Republic installations on the planet.
Ginntho was an Anzellan female slicer recruited by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Rodian individual lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, he met pirates on the Smuggler's Moon Nar Shaddaa to purchase a prototype battle droid that the pirates stole from a Tagge Corporation warehouse on the planet Milvayne.
Sannet Ot'Zien was the appointed Republic ambassador to the Orrik Cluster, which had recently been identified as populated during the High Republic Era.
An individual was the mayor of Aklyrr Bend. He was later chased out of his office by the biker gang Ganguls and fled the town.

An individual was a Jedi of the Jedi Order and the master of Zia Zaldor Zanna, who later became a Jedi master. Around 233 BBY, the Jedi youngling Kai Brightstar had a bad day after waking up late, missing the rest of the younglings who went on a trip to the planet Tiss'ell.
An unidentified Balnab male worked as a bounty hunter during the galactic conflict known as the Clone Wars.

A human male worked as a bounty hunter during galactic conflict known as the Clone Wars. He was part of a cadre of five bounty hunters searching for a bounty with good pay, who were present at the Most Eisley Cantina, where they happened upon the bounty posted on Savage Opress.
A Weequay worked as a bounty hunter during the galactic conflict known as the Clone Wars.

A Separatist official sat next to Tikkes during the Executive Separatist Council's meeting on Utapau in 19 BBY. They were present when General Grievous ordered the relocation of the council to Mustafar.
A individual was a server aboard the Star Cruiser Halcyon. In 4 ABY, they served rebel General Han Solo and Princess Leia Organa a glass of Tristall wine, and informed the two about its origin.

Hayle was a human male who served as a New Republic officer within the New Republic Defense Fleet. Holding the military rank of captain, Hayle previously served in the Rebel Alliance before joining its successor government where he later became the commanding officer of the De…
Murley was a Loth-cat owned by the Mandalorian Sabine Wren during the time of the New Republic, living alongside Wren in the LothalNet comm tower E-272 on the planet Lothal.

Jakris was a Mon Calamari guard who served as a top security officer aboard the New Republic Defense Fleet Defender-class cruiser Vesper in Sector G-38. In 9 ABY, two individuals claiming to be Jedi boarded the cruiser, intending to see a prisoner being held onboard.

A bartender worked at the SaSassis Bar, a bar on the planet Kirima in Verena City's Verena Starport, around 6 ABY. At some point, they became associated with the New Republic Intelligence Service. The bartender was seedy looking.

Myn Weaver was a human male who operated on the planet Corellia as a Regional Supervisor for the New Republic. He was secretly an Imperial loyalist who worked for the industrialist and witch Morgan Elsbeth and her forces.
Johgeshakka, or Jo for short, was a female Wookiee that lived on Kashyyyk during the High Republic Era. She was the grandchild of Whitaggikk.

Callahan was a human pilot who served as a lieutenant in the Starfighter Corps of the New Republic after the fall of the Galactic Empire. She was part of an E-wing starfighter squadron stationed on the planet Lothal, where she flew alongside Captain Porter.
A New Republic comm officer served on a Defender-class cruiser. The officer notified Captain Hayle about an approaching ship that was carrying "Jedi." He was killed during the attack on the Vesper.
By 22 BBY, a Revwien merchant sold a Zephyr-G swoop to the moisture farmer Owen Lars during an auction in the remote town of Mos Nytram on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine.

Velya Faer was a male Evereni born by around 397 BBY, who lived during the High Republic Era. At some point no earlier than 379 BBY, Velya and his twin sister Vika stopped at a space dock orbiting the gas giant Siquay to refuel their ship and were tracked down by the Evereni p…

A female servant worked for the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh's monarchy by 382 BBY. She also a member of terrorist group Children of E'ronoh who attacked the village U'ronoh, took the villagers as a hostage, and captured Xiri A'lbaran and Phan-tu Zenn.
Gronil was the Maintenance Chief of the detention center at Glare Peak on the planet Trivar II during the Galactic Civil War.

Hal Hull was a male Human and the owner of Hal's Goods and Services, a general store in Glare Peak on the planet Trivar II and a sympathizer of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Tol Pirilian was a male Human Assistant City Director in Glare Peak on the planet Trivar II during the Galactic Civil War.

Olom Roskom was a male Twi'lek and the owner of Roskom Mechanized Systems, the main maintenance contractor of the imperial detention center in Glare Peak on the planet Trivar II during the Galactic Civil War.
Tracer was a member of the Rebel Alliance. She was put on a courier mission for the Alliance Fleet in 0 ABY with Deflector a few weeks after the Evacuation of Yavin.
During the Imperial Era, a Dressellian offered a microflora effusion of polysatyrs to the Queen of Ktath'atn, to which the servant Varroa remarked the queen would consider the Dressellian's offering.

Teviy was a human female criminal who lived during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, she was present at Zoulshaus, a nightclub on the planet Galator III where she met the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra.

Zopp was a pirate who operated as part of a pirate group during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the group broke into an old Tagge Corporation warehouse on the planet Milvayne and stole a prototype battle droid.

A Gotal worked at a hotel on the planet Galator III. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Gotal went to inform the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra that her reservation for a room she had stayed the night in was up and that if she wanted to stay for longer she would need t…

Fori Nagor was a female Twi'lek who was born by around 407 BBY. Around 381 BBY, she visited a public house in the oldest settlement on the planet Dantooine. There, she noticed the Evereni pirate leader Marda Ro and became startled when she recognized Ro's species.
A Chiss acted as a messenger for Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo, core name "Thrawn," aboard the Chiss Expansionary Fleet vessel Springhawk in 27 BBY.
A First Order officer alerted Kylo Ren that Rey was not located in Hangar 718.
Garganchie was a male Gargantua transported by SF-R3 to the Sil Gohtta's Nature Preserve during the High Republic Era. It was Jedi Initiate Lys Solay who named Garganchie.
Morgest was a being who dealt in Force artifacts and, prior to 22 BBY, regularly met with Jedi Master Sember Vey to trade them.

In 7 BBY, Salman Paak attended a Separatist meeting on the planet Jondora where he met a woman who told him that if he was serious about politics, he could act as a liaison when he returned to his homeworld. He was sent a fractal radio unit and was paid to keep the radio alive.
A Dhani woman lived on Aldhani while Gorn was stationed on the planet. Gorn fell in love with this woman, who he eventually "lost".
A human officer lived during the Imperial Era and worked for Preox-Morlana's Pre-Mor Security Inspection team in 5 BBY.
A human officer lived during the Imperial Era and worked for Preox-Morlana as an Astro-Traffic Control Officer.
A human female was a member of Alpha, which was a group of children on the planet Kenari.
A human female was a member of Alpha, which was a group of children on the planet Kenari.
A human female was a member of Alpha, which was a group of children on the planet Kenari.
A human male was a member of Alpha, which was a group of children on the planet Kenari.
A human male was a member of Alpha, which was a group of children on the planet Kenari.

A human moisture farmer lived on Tatooine. The farmer suggested that a group of Jawas set up a drive-in cinema on their farm, however the Jawas misunderstood and destroyed the farm to play the holovid Alderaanian Graffiti.

An Imperial clone commando attached to the Advanced Science Division served on Transport 904 during or after 18 BBY. The transport carried a cloned Zillo Beast—Specimen A—that ultimately broke out of captivity and killed the vessel's crew, including the clone commando.

A male Wookiee lived on the planet Kashyyyk during the early reign of the Galactic Empire. The Imperials used Trandoshans to begin stripping Kashyyyk of its resources, with many of the sanctuary's residents retreating further into the jungle to avoid them.
A Trandoshan male was a commander of a team, who helped the imperials to stripping the Kashyyyk of its resources and forcing it under Imperial rule.

A soldier was a member of Saw Gerrera's Partisans during the Imperial Era. In around 18 BBY, the Partisan went with Gerrera on a mission to infiltrate the Raven's Peak, an Imperial compound where several high-ranking Imperials were meeting for a summit.

A female Zeltron served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. Sometime between 19 BBY and 14 BBY, during the Jedi Purge, she was imprisoned by the bounty hunter Jakadis in his fortress on the planet Firrhana.
Jeph Rebo was a musician and the father of the Ortolan musician Maximilian Rebo.
Neb Neb was a Gungan who helped move Maximilian Rebo's Red ball jett organ on the planet Orto with the help of Tup Tup.
Tup Tup was a Gungan who worked with fellow Gungan Neb Neb as a mover. Together, they helped move Maximilian Rebo's red ball jett organ on the planet Orto.
R.H. Chedda was the founder of Cheddatown, a city on the Ortolan homeworld of Orto, and creator of Chedda Toe Jam Lotion, a Chedda-brand foot lotion produced by the Chedda Corporation.
Scumbo was a Gamorrean guard who worked for the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure in his palace on the planet Tatooine.
Thok was a Gamorrean guard that worked at Jabba's palace.
Thug was a Gamorrean guard that worked at Jabba's palace.
Maxxon Senn was a young human who worked on the EV-series supervisor droid EV-9D9 after she spent years powered down in a junkyard following the death of Jabba Desilijic Tiure in 4 ABY.
A Trandoshan sat at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina and barked orders at the bartender droid EV-9D9.
Imj was an old woman who lived in Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine. She was the neighbor of Jess' father Willux. When Willux passed away, Imj wrote a note to alert Jess of her father's death.
Naatke was a Chadra-Fan who worked as a scullery maid in the kitchen of Jabba's palace on Tatooine.
Altair Wyeto was a swooper who lived on the planet Tatooine. He was the boyfriend of Jess, a musician and waitress at Jabba's palace. In 2 ABY Wyeto accepted a chance to join the swoop circuits.

Lurik was an officer in charge of the communications center at Jabba's palace on Tatooine. Jess often cajoled him into allowing her to contact her father, Willux, or to exchange letters with her boyfriend Altair Wyeto.
Cydi Lum was a musician who headlined the band Cydi Lum and the Neurotransmitters.

Damaris Viell was a singer who worked at Jabba's palace and was friends with the human Jess. Before her time working for Jabba, she had been caught by a gang of raiders in the Outer Rim. None of her peers knew much about her life before Tatooine.

Scraps was a male Utai who was born on the planet Utapau. In his youth, Scraps left Utapau, wanting to explore the galaxy. He lived in six different star systems, making a living as a beast healer, and eventually found his way to Corellia.
The Beastmaster Malakili had a mother who raised him on the planet Corellia.

Sigs was a man who lived on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine with his husband, Sion, and their two children—a daughter and a son. In 4 ABY, he asked Sion for a private showing of the Max Rebo Band as a gift for the upcoming holiday season.
The father of the Pa'lowick Sy Snootles raised Snootles on the planet Lowick.
Fond Dachris was an individual who was killed during the Clone Wars by Sim Aloo after he buried him in kernels.
Ràq Malwin was an individual who served as Senator Mon Mothma's aide during the Battle of Endor.
Korrimix was a Dressellian who had an encounter with Landonis Balthazar Calrissian. He was a smuggler who went to live at Bespin. Later joined to the Bespin Wing Guard.
Raab Krao, designated TK-151, was a human male who was a professional racer before joining the Galactic Empire as a scout trooper.
TK-290 was a human male scout trooper who served the Galactic Empire as part of Ghost Lancers company.
The brother of Raab Krao was a mechanic who served as one half of Krao Brothers Racing, with his brother being the racer. At one point, the brothers had lost their parents in a shuttle accident.

Dooze was a stormtrooper who served in the Galactic Empire's Gamma Squad. On the forest moon of Endor, Dooze and the rest of Gamma Squad followed Commander Altadan Igar and searched for the missing Theta Squad.

GR-792, nicknamed "Gir," was a stormtrooper who patrolled the forest moon Endor along with RZ-440. During the Battle of Endor, GR-792 managed to fire a shot at the Princess Leia Organa, but missed and hit her in the shoulder after RZ-440 kicked him in the leg on accident.
RZ-440, nicknamed "Riz," was a female stormtrooper who patrolled the forest moon Endor along with GR-792.
Corl was one of three brothers of Sila Kott. He perished along with his other brothers and his father in an accident on the planet Toprawa.
Gave was one of three brothers of Sila Kott. He perished along with his other brothers and his father in an accident on the planet Toprawa.
Set was one of three brothers of Sila Kott. He perished along with his other brothers and his father in an accident on the planet Toprawa.
Lante was a female who fell in love with Sila Kott. She perished in an accident on the planet Toprawa.
Corr Lerrann was an Imperial weapons technician who served on the Death Star II and worked alongside Tay Kando.
Tay Kando was an Imperial gunner who served on the Death Star II and worked alongside Corr Lerrann.
Pog Degor was an Imperial gunner who served on the Death Star II and worked alongside fellow gunners Corr Lerrann and Tay Kando.
Kasva Jhoff was a member of the Imperial Navy who served as a Flight controller onboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor.
Harclew was the father of Kasva Jhoff and son of Amnen Jhoff.
Amnen Jhoff was the mother of Harclew and grandmother of Kasva Jhoff.
TK-423 was a stormtrooper who served onboard the Death Star II and maintained a journal log on a datapad.
Pollus was a miner on the planet Axxila and the father of Admiral Firmus Piett. He died when Firmus was twelve years old.

Tauk was a Royal Guard who served Darth Sidious and was stationed with another Royal Guard. Tauk perished when his other guard shot at him after the guard betrayed the Galactic Empire after learning that their leader, Sidious, had been killed.
Hoyel, designated TK-814, was a human male who worked for the Galactic Empire as a scout trooper. He was later captured by Ewoks on the forest moon Endor.

Rowe Jascott, nicknamed "Torp," was a Yellow Squadron pilot in the Rebel Alliance who was friends with fellow pilot Karie Neth. In 4 ABY, Jascott helped Neth locate her friend Lanna on the Alliance's flagship Home One.

Lanna, nicknamed Lan by her best friend Karie Neth, was a female technician from the planet Baraan-Fa who was a member of the Rebel Alliance and stationed on its flagship Home One. Neth, a pilot, joined the Alliance with Lanna and was eventually stationed there with her.
Dora Mar was a chronicler who interviewed numerous Alliance to Restore the Republic personnel shortly before the Battle of Endor.
Tele was a chronicler who interviewed numerous Alliance to Restore the Republic personnel shortly before the Battle of Endor.
Garan was an individual from Coruscant who was a part of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Lignu was an individual from Daiyu who was a part of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A human man was a New Republic officer on the planet Coruscant. He was a patron in the Galaxies Opera House hearing Penn Pershing, a former Imperial scientist who once worked for Moff Gideon, speak on his experience in the Amnesty Program.
A female human was a Jedi who was stationed at the Jedi Temple during the last days of the Clone Wars.

Around 9 ABY, a mythosaur resided in the Living Waters, a sacred place beneath the ruins of the capital city Sundari on the planet Mandalore. Lady Bo-Katan Kryze discovered the legendary mythosaur when she rescued Din Djarin from drowning in its depths.
A New Republic comm officer served aboard Home One as part of Fleet Command and Hera Syndulla's fleet during the early New Republic Era in 9 ABY.
A Jawa was a leader who accidentally captured the RJ unit RJ-83 during the High Republic Era.

A human served as a member of a command crew for Myn Weaver, who operated on the planet Corellia as a Regional Supervisor for the New Republic. They were secretly an Imperial loyalist who worked for the witch Morgan Elsbeth and her forces.

A human was a member of a command crew for Myn Weaver, who operated on the planet Corellia as a Regional Supervisor for the New Republic. They were secretly an Imperial loyalist who worked for the witch Morgan Elsbeth and her forces.
Abel Drongite was the proprietor of the saloon in Rambler's Reach Outpost on the planet Koboh at some point prior to 9 BBY.
Taule was a prospector on the planet of Koboh during the Imperial era. At some point prior to 9 BBY, she discovered an extremely large lode of priorite.

Salpu Gilikey was a prospector on the planet Koboh prior to 9 BBY. Local prospectors Gulu and Gido recalled to Jedi Knight Cal Kestis that, at some point, Gilikey came across a large amount of priorite, but upon walking home with a sackful of the mineral, he fell into a sinkho…

Jess was a human female musician who lived in Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine. By 4 ABY, Jess had become a servant of Jabba Desilijic Tiure and was present at his palace during the Rescue of Han Solo.

The group would soon land on Seatos' surface and search for Syndulla's friends, Ahsoka Tano and Sabine Wren. Despite a long search, the two were nowhere to be found. Eventually Syndulla's son, Jacen Syndulla, was able to sense Tano's presence through the Force.

Soon after, the group landed on Seatos. Despite searching for Ahsoka Tano and Sabine Wren, the master and apprentice duo were nowhere to be found. Eventually Jacen Syndulla, Hera's son, was able to sense Tano's presence through the Force and she was located in the ocean.

Ry Harket was the female Bivall dean of student life at Reena University. She monitored the purported "symptoms" her student Axel Greylark was exhibiting of malongo pox, correctly—albeit without proof—assuming that he was faking it.

Petrish Imglor was a Barabel Jedi Knight in the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Imglor had ascended to their rank while still young around 379 BBY, close to the time of Padawan Rooper Nitani's own Jedi Trials.

Around the Clone Wars, between 22 BBY to 19 BBY, a pirate queen was the leader of the matriarchal Veiled Sorority pirate fleet. Allegedly immortal, the female pirate's organization was located within the Outer Rim Territories, where they exclusively harassed criminal transports.
Vryssk was a Trandoshan who was present at Fey's Cantina, where they offered people tutorials and quests for the holotables.

"Bright-Eyes" was a dragonsnake who lived on Dagobah. She was an inquisitive creature and often observed Yoda, noting how peaceful and unafraid he was. At one point she witnessed another dragonsnake attempt to eat the droid R2-D2.
A Red Guard served on board the Death Star II during the Battle of Endor.
A female individual was the mother of the Ewok Nanta, who perished during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
A male individual was the father of the Ewok Nanta, who perished during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
Noor Shan was a female Sullustan who served aboard the MOD-17 container freighter Chilastra.
Yesha Bergeson was a female Human who served aboard the MOD-17 container freighter Chilastra.
Chyvalle is a female Weequay security captain under the crime lord Gallo Memm, guarding his estate on Vaynai.
Lady Debor Fyalko was a female individual from Velmor who wrote about the Velmorian energy sword in her memoirs.
Caya was a male individual who lived on the planet Kavith III during the Imperial Era. One day, Caya and his best friend Hoyel found a Kavith wolf with its leg stuck in a trap.
TK-246 was a human who served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper. They were later captured by Ewoks
TK-093 was a human who served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper. They were later captured by Ewoks
TK-121 was a human who served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper. They were later captured by Ewoks
TK-830 was a human who served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper. While serving on the forest moon of Endor, TK-830 and the rest of their squad were captured by Ewoks.
A human Jedi served as the teacher of the Jedi Padawan Toul during a war waged between the Jedi Order and their ideological antithesis, the Sith tradition of Force-users, at some point by 1032 BBY.
Shana was a priorite prospector on the Outer Rim planet Koboh who, with a human companion, tried to ascend the mountain of Prospector's Folly in search of riches.
This individual was a Human male scout trooper. He got knocked out unconscious by Han Solo after getting into a fight with him by being slammed into ground by Solo.
Beamala was a female Pkorian who lived on the planet Pkori. She was the mother of Feyra Akaris and the grandmother of Iskat Akaris.
This individual was a Human scout trooper. They were killed by Chewbacca after their 74-Z speeder bike was shot down by the Wookiee's bowcaster.
This individual was a Human male scout trooper. He was killed after being distracted by the destruction of Leia Organa's stolen 74-Z speeder bike and crashing into a fallen tree.

This individual was a human scout trooper who was knocked out by Leia Organa after getting distracted from Wicket Wystri Warrick poking at their leg and getting hit in the shoulder by a branch by her.
Ruu was a trans male Lucem who was a Padawan at the Coronet City temple. He asked Jedi Master Conithr to help change his name in the Jedi records, then later to be his master.
Rell was a scout trooper who served in the Galactic Empire's Theta Squad. While serving on the forest moon of Endor, Rell and the other members of Theta Squad were confronted by rebels and killed.
Girard was a human who served the New Republic Defense Fleet, holding the rank of captain and serving as the commanding officer of the cruiser Dawnbringer.
Dumas Mar'Ti was a Kaleesh female who captained the starship Athos during the High Republic Era. She once served as a member of the Byne Guild.

"Two-Six" was the callsign given to a scout guard pilot who flew alongside Shin Hati and Marrok, and was killed during the dogfight in the Denab system when Ahsoka Tano slashed his ship was slashed by Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers.
A New Republic weapons officer served on Captain Girard's cruiser to the Denab system.
A New Republic comms officer served on Captain Girard's cruiser to the Denab system.
Margaret Lenny "Maggie" Simpson was a human child who lived in the town of Springfield on Earth.
Homer Simpson was a human who lived in the town of Springfield on Earth.
Marge Simpson was a human who lived in the town of Springfield on Earth.
An individual served as the dean of theological studies at Reena University on the planet Reena around 396 BBY.
Kodos was a Rigellian who rescued the human Maggie Simpson from a fleet of TIE/ln space superiority starfighter along with Kang.
A member of the Ishi Tib species served the New Republic as a Lieutenant by around 9 ABY. They served aboard Captain Girard's cruiser to the Denab system.
TK-534 was a stormtrooper who served onboard the Death Star II.
TK-848 was a stormtrooper who served onboard the Death Star II.
TK-293 was a stormtrooper who served onboard the Death Star II in the year 4 ABY.

Leyli Romero was a Kilotowan female member of a group of thieves led by Elecia Zeveron, and a former member of the Romero Clan who posed as a student of Reena University. During her time at the university, she had a feigned relationship with fellow student Axel Greylark.

A Twi'lek janitor was employed at Reena University around 396 BBY. The janitor had a daughter that needed to undergo a surgery, and as a result he was forced to ask a dean for an advance on his wages; his request was ultimately refused.

Omo Bouri was a respected Jedi Master who served in the Jedi Order. Bouri trained the Iktotchi Saesee Tiin as their Padawan, and by 40 BBY, Bouri had completed Tiin's training, with their apprentice becoming a Jedi Master.
Aktropaw was a Dathomirian female Nightsister witch, and one of the Great Mothers who allied with Mitth'raw'nuruodo.

Klothow was a Dathomirian female Nightsister witch, who was one of three Great Mothers who allied with Mitth'raw'nuruodo. In 9 ABY, they greeted Morgan Elsbeth and her mercenaries Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati when they arrived on the planet Peridea.

Lakesis was a Dathomirian female Nightsister witch, one of three Great Mothers who allied with Imperial Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo, and called Nightsister Morgan Elsbeth and her forces to the planet Peridea.
Enoch was Grand Admiral Thrawn's Captain of the Guard during his forces' exile from the galaxy on the planet Peridea since 1 BBY.
"Little Noti" was the alias of a member of the Noti species that resided on Peridea alongside a nomadic village of their people.
NE-034, nicknamed "Neo," was a human stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire as a commander and second-in-command of a contingent of troopers.

"Isren" was the alias of an aged Evereni male who went by the Evereni word meaning "old uncle" rather than his name. At some point no earlier than 379 BBY, he was on the Outer Rim world Ryloth, hunting native creatures known as lyleks in the planet's equatorial forests.

Pieter was a pilot who flew for the Rebel Alliance. He piloted an A-wing starfighter and instructed other young pilots to prepare them for combat. He encountered the pilot Arvel Crynyd during a flying exercise and allowed Crynyd to teach the pilots a maneuver.
Raf was a pilot who flew for the Rebel Alliance, flying an A-wing starfighter. In around 1 ABY, she was killed.
A Kel Dor Rebel pilot was a member of the Rebel Alliance's Gold Squadron and used the callsign Gold Six during the Battle of Endor.

Ric Farazi was a female Zeltron reporter who attempted to investigate the Path of the Open Hand on the planet Dalna. Having never sold a story, Farazi wanted to get the big scoop on the Path after their involvement in the Battle of Jedha.
A female individual was the mother of Zeltron journalist Ric Farazi. She called her daughter a "bad traveler" due to her propensity for getting sick on longer space journeys.

Suzi was a female individual who was the wife of journalist Ric Farazi. She rarely saw eye-to-eye with Farazi's mother, except to agree that her wife was prone to getting sick on longer space voyages.

Okoro was an Eirami male who was the captain of the fishing boat Queen Xiri during the High Republic Era. Operating on the planet Eiram with his wife Nelly, crewmember Gorge, and droid 9-0-9, Okoro accepted Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar's request to join his crew.
Nelly was an Eirami female who was part of the crew of the fishing boat Queen Xiri and the wife of its captain, Okoro.
Gorge was an Eirami Twi'lek fisher who was part of the fishing boat Queen Xiri on the planet Eiram during the High Republic Era.
Scaanos was a commodore in the navy of the Galactic Empire who became the commanding officer of the Star Destroyer Steadfast following the Battle of Ponolapo between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.
An Imperial officer served in a remnant of the Galactic Empire that operated under the leadership of Moff Gideon, under whom they held the rank of an officer.
Kelvin Mann was a human Karaxian and influential citizen of Karaxis. His family was captured by Kylo Ren, which forced him to align Karaxis with the First Order.

Vika Faer was a female Evereni born by around 397 BBY, who lived during the High Republic Era. At some point no earlier than 379 BBY, Faer and her twin brother Velya stopped at a space dock over the gas giant Siquay to refuel their ship.
Dinube was a Harch who was an Elder in the Path of the Open Hand cult and was present in the Path compound on Dalna before and during the events of the Night of Sorrow in 382 BBY.
Nindle was an old friend of Garda's mother Yvanna and had attempted to save her husband's life after a farming accident. He had previously diagnosed her with an allergy to a certain legume.

A howler was ridden by Sabine Wren during the quest to find Ezra Bridger on the extragalactic planet Peridea after it was given to her among the provisions Sabine received from Captain Enoch and several Night Troopers.

Haq was a male individual who owned a farm near Ferdan on Dalna sometime before 382 BBY. He was known for being unfriendly, and had no relatives. After Haq died of a heart attack, his farm was purchased by the Path of the Open Hand as a place for their new meeting house.
Athul Taran was a male Gormak who lived on Dalna in 382 BBY. He argued with Path of the Open Hand member Xander Cran near the Ferdan landing strips.
An individual happened to be in the Upper City of Taris at the time when Zayne Carrick was being taken to the Jedi Tower by the bounty hunter Valius Ying during the Mandalorian Wars.
Kelb was a human navigator who was a member of the Rebel Alliance during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Kelb was part of a crew led by Captain Magna Tolvan.
A security guard served the New Republic Defense Force on Coruscant in 9 ABY.

Loran was a Zabrak female event planner who lived on the planet Coruscant. In 230 BBY, she and her friends Alees June, Ellyt, and Sym went about the streets of Coruscant, going to clubs and inviting Jedi Padawan Amadeo Azzazzo to join them.
Ellyt was a human male who lived on the planet Coruscant and had a twin brother, Sym. They were both experts on the history of Coruscant.
Sym was a human male who lived on the planet Coruscant. He and his twin brother, Ellyt, were expert historians of Coruscant.
Kreen was a human Karaxian who lived on the planet Karaxis. When looking outside of the city, General Armitage Hux asked Kreen about the Bramalish.

Campo was a Weequay Karaxian who lived on the planet Karaxis. Campo was interrogated by Kylo Ren for the whereabouts of Kelvin Mann. Later, Campo yelled at General Armitage Hux for releasing Bramalish into the city on Karaxis.
Graygon Eckt was a human who worked with Count Dooku. Eckt later abandoned Dooku and was hunted on Bavana.
Kwarg was a Weequay who hunted down the traitor Graygon Eckt on Bavana along with Nonk.
Nonk was a Devaronian who hunted down the traitor Graygon Eckt on Bavana along with Kwarg.

Yvanna was a female individual who lived on Dalna in 382 BBY. She was barely able to work due to suffering from krinjaffi syndrome, and after her husband died in a farming accident, she and her son Garda were struggling to make ends meet.

Garda was a young male individual who lived on Dalna in 382 BBY. His mother Yvanna struggled to make ends meet after her husband died in a farming accident. He was the first customer at the Path of the Open Hand's soup kitchen in Ferdan, where he ate legumes.
A male aide served as the Chief of Staff to Centrist senator Lady Carise Sindian during her tenure as representative of Arkanis.
A human female served as a repair tech under tech supervisor Oshi Karmo on the Alif-class Longbeam Paxion, Republic Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo's ship, during the High Republic Era.

A man was affiliated with the First Order during the New Republic Era. In 34 ABY, after the Colossus refueling station was sunk into the ocean of the planet Castilon by the Resistance members Jarek Yeager and Kazuda Xiono, the First Order man informed Commander Pyre and First …
Lor Botho was a miner who worked for Red Mine as a leader in the village of Charbana on the planet Mikkia. They mined akassia, which made earthquakes that destroyed Charbana.
Alees June was a Tholothian female who lived on the planet Coruscant.

Furball Two was a Loth-cat owned by the bounty hunter Vukorah around 3 ABY after she left the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate. The tooka accompanied Vukorah to Kirkeide Station, where the hunter hoped to acquire new work from the hybroid Syphacc.
A howler was ridden by Baylan Skoll and later by Ahsoka Tano during the battle of Peridea.

Purry was a Loth-cat who, around 3 ABY, was owned by the bounty hunter Vukorah. The tooka was present on Vukorah's ship when she went to register for work with the hybroid Syphacc at Kirkeide Station.
A human individual served as a stormtrooper in the First Order aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Thunderer.
Govena was a human Jedi Master during the High Republic Era. Govena served in the Jedi Temple armory, constructing lightsabers.
Vilem Vot was a Twi'lek who lived on the Island.

Jenjena Starclay was a human who was stranded on The Island of a planet and became one of the many inhabitants, referred to as Castaways, who called the island home. They had blue hair, black eyes, and dark skin.
An individual worked as part of security aboard the First Order Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Thunderer.
Dessim Peidur was a Weequay scientist who lived on the Island.
Ionis Raskudi was a Twi'lek who lived on the Island. Ionis Raskudi was employed by Bosigg the Hutt.
Omni Ghied was a Sullustan who lived on the Island.
Gil Rowan was a Human pilot who lived on the Island.
Kars Kussix was a human male event planner who lived on the Island of a planet after being stranded there. Kussix was accompanied by 3V-NT, an astromech droid who helped him with his work.
Helden Chu was an Iktotchi who lived on the Island.
Shan Drennon was a Human who lived on The Island of a planet. Ever since she was a kid, Drennon had always wanted to be a podracer.
Mint Yardley was a Human who lived on the Island.
Ros Okslad was a Human pilot who lived on the Island.

Bosigg, also referred to as Bosigg the Hutt or Mr. Bosigg, and formally styled as the Illustrious, Esteemed, Glamorous and All-Around Good-Looking Bosigg the Hutt, was a male Hutt who lived on The Island. He ran the Hippodrome.
A member of House Organa created the draft for the Galactic Constitution, the official document that formed the Galactic Republic in 25,053 BBY.
Vol Garat was a Harch bounty hunter who was a member of the Jedi-hating Path of the Open Hand cult. He fought for the Path in the Night of Sorrow, a battle against the Jedi on the planet Dalna.

A human individual served as a tech stormtrooper in the First Order In 34 ABY, the tech stormtrooper was part of a contingent of stormtroopers that escorted Commander Pyre and Agent Tierny to the planet Varkana in search of Resistance agents.
Zyrka Tuhn was a non-binary human who was a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. They joined Gold Squadron and had no combat experience up until the Battle of Endor.
A clone trooper served with Jedi Knight Tualon Yaluna during the Clone Wars.
A Human individual served as Count and Head of one of the six Great Houses of Serenno during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Jakadis, self-styled Lord Jakadis, was a bounty hunter who specialized in collecting Jedi and related artifacts.

A male heir of the House Demici, one of the Great Houses of Serenno, was the son of Count Demici during the Galactic Civil War. He set out to hunt split-tail dorsallope with a dozen of House Demici Noble Guard and went missing near the House Nalju territory.
An individual served as Count and Head of the House Demici, one of the Great Houses of Serenno, during the Galactic Civil War.
A male heir of the House Nalju, one of the Great Houses of Serenno, was the son of Count Nalju during the Galactic Civil War.
An individual served as Count and Head of the House Nalju, one of the Great Houses of Serenno, during the Galactic Civil War.

An individual served as the Shadow Hand of the King of the Sith Adas around 27,700 BBY. As a Shadow Hand, they acted as the king's second-in-command and his trusted advisor. At the time of his death, Adas had given his holocron to them.

The parents of Jedi Padawan, Burryaga Agaburry, were Wookiees who lived on the planet Kashyyyk during the High Republic Era. When Agaburry was very young, he was afraid to climb the trees of his homeworld.

The "Sith Witch of Mustafar" was said to be a Sith witch who resided on Mustafar. According to the Legend of the Sith Witch, she was a troublesome entity who spread fear. Her arrival was foretold by an angry wail, the woods shaking, and a light filling the swale.
A human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire served Darth Vader in Fortress Vader on Mustafar. After being mistreated by the Sith Lord, the stormtrooper created a Stormtrooper Mech to attack Vader.
An individual was the father of Countess Hagi of Serenno's House Malvern.

Ema's parents were at least two individuals who were parents to the Corellian humanoid Ema, who was born around 27 BBY. They raised her on the Core Worlds planet Corellia, keeping the girl well cared for and fed.

Ema was a Corellian humanoid female who hailed from the Core Worlds planet Corellia. When her parents died around 15 BBY, she was recruited into the White Worms criminal organization in Coronet City as a scrumrat.

Jones was a Human male. In 22 BBY, Jones and a relative, Indiana Jones, were tied back to back on two chairs and hidden behind a bookshelf on the planet Christophsis during a battle there between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
A First Order Raider was part of a squad led by Agent Raith that pursued the archaeologist Mika Grey to Ashas Ree.

A First Order Raider was part of a squad led by Agent Raith that pursued the archaeologist Mika Grey to Ashas Ree. They helped arrest Kazuda Xiono and his colleagues while on world, shoving the children Kel and Eila harshly to keep them moving alongside their counterpart.

During the early years of the New Order that had been founded in 19 BBY, the wife of Jedi Knight Tyneir Renz was murdered by the Galactic Empire alongside their son during a massacre at their homeworld Jiaan, in retaliation for Renz's escape from the Great Jedi Purge.

"Slimetrooper" was the nickname of a human stormtrooper who left the Galactic Empire, and was eventually eaten by an exogorth in an asteroid field while hiding. The exogorth had a lot of candy inside its stomach.

Calle Tharandon was an individual who served as a corporal for the Alliance Army. After the Evacuation of Yavin 4, he served aboard the GR-75 medium transport Freedom Fighter as quartermaster of the ship.

A navigator served on a Galactic Republic Consular-class cruiser on a mission to the Inner Rim planet Pijal in 40 BBY. Upon their entry to the Pijal system, they encountered a struggling soulcraft ship that blackguard soldiers had attacked.
Oren Cole was a human soldier who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He joined Kori Zaran on the galaxy mission.

Burin Kassal was an individual who served as a pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Kassal was a smuggler prior to joining the rebellion, and when he contemplated leaving the rebellion Calle Tharandon convinced him to stay.

Verelea Xhorrun was a Falleen female who served as a high-ranking member in the Black Sun. She was killed by her brother, Alorium, in an attempt to make Black Sun a separate faction from the Five Crime Syndicates that were led under Maul.
Alorium was a Falleen male who killed his sister, Verelea Xhorrun, in an attempt to make the Black Sun leave the Five Crime Syndicates.

Salbee was a female servant who worked for the crime lord Sarkin Enneb in his estate on the Core Worlds planet Corellia. Around 13 BBY, she helped Enneb's enslaved worker Qi'ra acquire her new uniform and gave her a tour of the criminal group's estate.

Tallaria was a Falleen female who met with Dryden Vos after her sister's death. She took over leadership of her sister's faction of the Black Sun. The Falleen revealed that she had some small investments on Thorum when Qi'ra and her team were operating on the planet.

Oggro was a Rodian scrumrat of the White Worms gang on the Core Worlds planet Corellia. Around 13 BBY, he prepared to help raid a Corellia shipyard by taking watch shifts to monitor the facility, often doing so at night due to his ability to see infrared.
Thallia was a Mon Calamari who worked for Crimson Dawn as a slicer.
Olio was a human who worked for Crimson Dawn.
Myem was an individual who worked for Crimson Dawn.
Noyio was a human female who worked for Crimson Dawn as a pilot.

Hilst was a Zabrak who worked for Crimson Dawn. During a dinner meeting on Thorum at the Crimson Dawn house, she talked to Qi'ra and offered her some Uedan noodles. She and Karil took Qi'ra shopping for new clothes after she got settled on Thorum.
Qorsha was a Rodian who worked for Crimson Dawn.
Karil was a human male who worked for Crimson Dawn as a grifter. He and Hilst took Qi'ra shopping for new clothes after she got settled on Thorum.
Lopie was a Twi'lek slicer who worked for Crimson Dawn.
Drex was a Rodian pilot who worked for Crimson Dawn.

Eleera Soi was a female Twi'lek who worked for Crimson Dawn. She was one of the few survivors in a mission to retrieve a Jedi artifact. By 3 ABY, she served as a Crimson Dawn operative and contract on the planet Toshara.
Karsot was an older Grindalid who served the White Worms gang on the planet Corellia.
Corynna was a human female who served as concierge in Crimson Dawn to Dryden Vos. She was executed by Vos after she tried to poison guards meals who worked for Vos.
Cerveteri Slane was a human female who served in Crimson Dawn. Around 13 BBY, Slane worked on the planet Corellia under the Galactic Empire, going under the alias of Manager Veteri.

An E'roni tower guard worked in the mining village of U'ronoh during the High Republic Era. While guarding the village's mining tower in 382 BBY, they were killed by members of the Children of E'ronoh dissident group.

Kish was an individual who served as a corporal in the Alliance Military. Kish participated in the Battle of Hoth, but was one of several Alliance personnel left behind after the evacuation. His family lived on the planet Corellia.

Lesa Benex was a middle-aged, female individual who grew up with Myra Talcon. After the Galactic Empire took over her planet, she left to start Haven, a remote mountain village on Ison. She set up Haven to be a place where people could live in peace, away from all the violence.

Arnot was a woodcutter on the planet Ison in a village called Haven. In 3 ABY, a group of rebels sought refuge at the village, which resulted in Lesa Benex, the leader of Haven, getting kidnapped by the bounty hunter Dengar.
An individual was a Jedi seeker in the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. By 382 BBY, he visited the Force-sensitive sisters Elecia and Oliviah Zeveron to recruit them into the Order.

Petunia was a puffer pig owned by Lando Calrissian. While most puffer pigs were capable of sniffing out valuable minerals, Petunia couldn't due her bad nose. Because of this, Lando Calrissian tried to sell her off to someone else at the Capital City Casino on the planet Lothal.

In 60 BBY, Jedi Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn fell in love with an individual on the Outer Rim planet Felucia. He eventually broke off their romantic relationship to remain in the Jedi Order but nevertheless kept their gift to him—a Mustafar fire diamond—as a cherished memento for many…

Whirrit was a Wookiee male who liberated enslaved Wookiees alongside his mate Ruroviv on the planet Kashyyyk. Whirrit lead a long trail of Wookiees to a Rebel rendezvous point to be taken off-world to safety. Among those Wookiees was his and Ruroviv's son.

Ruroviv was a Wookiee female who liberated enslaved Wookiees alongside her mate Whirrit on the planet Kashyyyk. Ruroviv lead a long trail of Wookiees to a Rebel rendezvous point to be taken off-world to safety. Among those Wookiees was her and Whirrit's son.

Umbra was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic's 104th Battalion. Umbra served under the command of Jedi General Plo Koon and alongside fellow clone trooper Wildfire during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems between 22 BBY and 19 BBY.
According to a story told by the Espirion Saan, Gideon was a human male from the Outer Rim planet Eriadu who was the brother of the future Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin.

Brogo was a portly Toydarian junk dealer who lived on the planet Toydaria. While C-3PO and R2-D2 were on a mission on Toydaria, Brogo captured them and tried to sell them off. A group of rebels were then sent to Toydaria to retrieve the droids from Brogo.

Luk Hutsok was a wealthy Neimoidian male arms dealer who lived in a mansion on the planet Cato Neimoidia with his daughter. At some point during the Imperial Era, Leia Organa was sent to negotiate a deal with Hutsok to provide weapons for the rebellion.

Carok Hittak was a Force-sensitive Jedi of the Jedi Order who owned a plasma shield that would later be owned by Jedi Master Silandra Sho and her Padawan, Rooper Nitani. Around 379 BBY, Nitani was searching for the shield after Sho hid it as part of her Jedi Trials.
"Wrecker-1" was a Duros individual and leader of a rebel saboteur team, the Wreckers. During the Imperial Era, the team was sent to the planet Rodia to blow up an imperial listening post.
"Wrecker-2" was a Duros individual and second in command of a rebel saboteur team, the Wreckers. During the Imperial Era, the team was sent to the planet Rodia to blow up an imperial listening post.
"Wrecker-3" was a Duros individual and member of a rebel saboteur team, the Wreckers. During the Imperial Era, the team was sent to the planet Rodia to blow up an imperial listening post.
"Wrecker-4" was a Duros individual and member of a rebel saboteur team, the Wreckers. During the Imperial Era, the team was sent to the planet Rodia to blow up an imperial listening post.
Anla Shou was the leader of a small team of rebels on the planet Cato Neimoidia. She had a reputation for being a bit of a hothead.
The Neimoidian arms dealer Luk Hutsok had a daughter who lived with him on the planet Cato Neimoidia.
An individual was the father of Candra Tymon. Her father served in a security team as a Chief of Security for Count Adan of House Dooku.
Brotwu was an individual who owned a cantina called Brotwu's on The Island. His father, Brotwu, was the original owner of the cantina before his father passed it down to him.

A Killik female once travelled aboard a passenger car of a train on a mission on the planet Kamil during the First Order-Resistance War. During a mission to secure livestock for the Resistance, Poe Dameron and Finn encountered this Killik and their nest.
Azita Cruuz was a human female pirate who operated prior to the Clone Wars. She had a deadly secret which the Hutt Clan and Galactic Republic wanted to control.
A contact of Lady Qi'ra—the leader of the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn—was one of many she had within the Galactic Empire during her war against the Sith.
At least two individuals were the parents of the human female Imara Vex. At some point, when the girl was too young to remember, she saw her parents for the last time.
The parents of the human female Sear were at least two individuals who died long before the time between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.
Terkas was an individual who served aboard the Rebel Alliance Navy transport Freedom Fighter. She was second in command, behind Captain Darpik.
Bumblehead Bim was a Blarina who spent time in Takodana Castle on the planet Takodana.
Isab Lex was a Zabrak who spent time in Takodana Castle on the planet Takodana.
Tobby was an individual who spent time in Takodana Castle on the planet Takodana.

During the Battle of Jedha, a Trandoshan pirate hunter attempted to slaughter the pirate hunter Raf Thatchburn out of revenge for the Trandoshan's brother, who was killed by a pirate hunter prior to the battle.

The brother of a Trandoshan pirate hunter was killed sometime before the Battle of Jedha. In an act of revenge, the Trandoshan sought to slay the pirate hunter Raf Thatchburn to avenge his fallen brother, but failed to do so and was sliced by Quiet Shan.

An Eirami commander served alongside Ambassador Lian Cerox during the Battle on the moon Jedha. During the battle, the commander encountered setbacks between the Jedi and Guardians of the Whills, which forced the Eirami forces into full retreat.

An influential member of the Hutt species who was involved with crime immensly enjoyed eating Klatooine Crêpes, a dish that the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs included a recipe for in his second cookbook, The Life Day Cookbook, which was published at some point after first cookboo…
Drem was an individual who operated on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Imperial Era. At some point, Han Solo was sent to negotiate with Drem to acquire hyperdrive modules.

Saysmond Varg was a male Black Sun assassin and pilot who lived during the Galactic Civil War. While piloting his Rihkxyrk assault fighter in the Naboo system, he was killed in dogfight by a RSF pilot.

An old Sullustan operated as a merchant in Cloud City on the planet Bespin. She would provide the rebellion with shipments of tibanna gas. She liked to tell stories, like about the time she sabotaged a podrace.
A human lava trooper stood guard at Fortress Vader. Upon investigating a mysterious noise, they became a casualty of an attack on Vader's Castle.

A chef learned to cook at the University of Alderaan in Aldera, capital city of the planet Alderaan. While studying, she learned to cook Aldera Meatpies, which she later served while working on the planet Tepasi following the destruction of Alderaan by the Galactic Empire in 1…
Pilok was a Caamasi who was a member of the Rebel Alliance as part of the crew of Captain Magna Tolvan.
Sheyo was an individual who was a member of the Rebel Alliance as part of the crew of Captain Magna Tolvan.

Brissa was an Ikkrukkian who was a member of the Rebel Alliance as part of the crew led by Captain Magna Tolvan. The crew was called by General Leia Organa to an undisclosed rebel base after taking down an Imperial outpost.
Maia Tsoo was a Pantoran Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era, who served in the Medical Corps.

A human male cyborg operated during the Imperial Era. Around 3 ABY, the cyborg was present on the Outer Rim planet Gallios and briefly fought against the infected assassin droid BT-1 during the massacre on Gallios.

A female individual was the mother of the Twi'lek female Di'reni, who worked as a bartender and owned Club Lazuli in Canto Bight—the capital city of the Outer Rim planet Cantonica—during the Imperial Era.

An exogorth lived in an asteroid field. At some point it ate a large quanity of candy and "Slimetrooper," a stormtrooper who deserted the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, it ate Rebel trooper Kori Zaran while she was was stranded in the asteroid field.
A female individual lived during the High Republic Era and was the mother of the human boy Jerid—who was born around 393 BBY. Jerid also had a younger human sister named Vemian.

Kallenn was a corrupt Imperial officer and associate of Jabba the Hutt. He owned a compound on Nal Hutta where he kept different creatures, including a Rancor he was supposed to deliver to Jabba. Since Kallenn never delivered the pet, Jabba put a bounty on his head.

Ebbe Casset was a ensign of the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. In 229 BBY, she was stationed on Eriadu with her fellow the RDC officers Captain Pikka Adren, Captain Joss Adren and Admiral Pevel Kronara.
Krail was a doctor who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Krail engineered his own "bad batch" of battle droids.

Galek was a man who worked for the Black Sun syndicate. He had a nasty scar across his left eye. During the Imperial Era, Galek traveled to the planet Ylesia for a spice deal with the Gotal Kar Ranth, one of Jabba's representatives.
Kar Ranth was a Gotal smuggler who worked as a representative for Jabba the Hutt. He used to be a spice user, but chose to stop using it and remained sober ever since.

Alfonso was an Ithorian Spanish-language instructor and barber. They were responsible for teaching the protocol droid C-3PO Spanish—an experience C-3PO recalled when he was purchased by the moisture farmer Owen Lars in 0 BBY.

Gladys was an individual who worked in the Galactic Empire's Accounting during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, Gladys was promoted to commander.
Adromie was an Alliance ranger with the military rank of lieutenant within the Rebel Alliance.
Hedda was the child of Joss and Pikka Adren. He was conceived in 229 BBY and later born in 228 BBY shortly after the Battle of Eriadu.
Deggen Sont was a former Imperial who defected and freed the Wookiee Drokkatta from enslavement at a Geonosis mining facility. After freeing the Wookiee, Drokkatta swore a life debt to Deggen Sont.
A chef was born and raised on the Inner Rim desert planet Sergia and worked selling vittles out of a food freighter on the world, with Sand Mynock 'n' Cheese as his specialty.

"Red 9" was an individual who served in Red Squadron of the Rebel Alliance. She flew an X-wing during a mission with Luke Skywalker where they intercepted Imperial Gozanti-class cruisers that were heading to Fondor.

A Bith musician played the guitar at Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary with a band, alongside the Ortolan Maximilian Rebo and R0-1N6.

Teega Kryelle was a human who was a part of the Hidden Path.

The Wookiee female Ruroviv and the Wookiee male Whirrit had a son who lived with them on the planet Kashyyyk. The Wookiee youngling was a very curious child, which often lead to him getting into trouble.

Azudo Chanch was a human male who was an able mechanic and served as a pilot for the Cavern Angels squadron, part of the resistance fighter Saw Gerrera's partisans. In 1 BBY, Chanch was stationed in the Catacombs of Cadera, Gerrera's headquarters on the moon Jedha.

Javroth Meers was a human member of the partisans led by resistance fighter Saw Gerrera. After being arrested for assault by the Milvayne Authority, Meers knocked out an officer, stole their uniform, and escaped.

Dafir Toogan was a mechanic for resistance fighter Saw Gerrera's partisans, attempting to maintain the starships of the group's Cavern Angels squadron during Gerrera's campaigns against the Galactic Empire.
Casitine Loscar was a scout for the resistance fighter Saw Gerrera's partisans while they were based in the Catacombs of Cadera on the moon Jedha.

Miam Lymontra was a human who worked for the Partisans and received a bounty after protesting in riots on Ingo. She convinced the Partisans not to turn her in for the credits and instead to have her join as a fighter.
Belin was a male Ugnaught pilot trapped in the Occlusion Zone after the destruction of Starlight Beacon. He piloted a transport ship, regularly shipping grain.

Brotwu was a male individual and the father of Brotwu. Along with their family whom all shared the same name, Brotwu ended up stranded on The Island of a planet, and became some of the many inhabitants known as Castaways who called the island home.
Ellis Mathes was a human from the planet Alderaan. In 9 BBY, Mathes was 28 years old and was serving in the Alderaan Royal Guard.
Melis Shryke was a female warlord of the Nihil pirate group working under General Abediah Viess. She typified everything about the Nihil that Jedi Knight Bell Zettifar wanted to stop.
Gavi Takitaken was a human male Jedi Padawan. during the High Republic Era.

Kildo was a Alcedian male Jedi Initiate trapped on the planet Valo behind the Nihil Stormwall. He was friends with Gavi Takitaken and Tep Tep, two other Jedi younglings from the Valo Temple, the former of whom he harboured romantic feelings for.

Wotalla was a Toydarian cybernetic mechanic. She owned a cybernetics shop on the planet Toydaria and was the personal cybernetic mechanic for Tress Hacnua. In an effort to escape the Empire, she joined a rebel convoy transporting civilians to a hidden rebel world.
Efrain was a self-taught droid designer and Jarrod Kelvin's mentor. He was an eccentric old man and mechanical savant who owned his own laboratory where he tested new droid designs.

Terro was a human male who grew up on the planet Tatooine with his mother and father. They lived on a moisture farm together until Jabba the Hutt separated his family after his mother refused to pay the imposed water tax.

Shil-Ran was a Cerean female and the mother of Ko-Tun Feralo. In an effort to escape the Galactic Empire, she joined a rebel convoy transporting civilians to a hidden rebel world.

Acota was a major in the army of the Sith Empire during the Third Galactic War. After the mercenary, Jilo Del, was turned in for the eradication of an entire colony, Acota was in charge of interrogating him, and forced him to reveal that Imperial Admiral Hyshiri had ordered th…

Hyshiri was a female admiral in the navy of the Sith Empire during the Third Galactic War. After discovering that her sister, who was planning on defecting to the Galactic Republic, was hiding in a colony, Hyshiri hired the mercenary, Jilo Del, to eradicate the entire colony a…
