Lyx was a Cerean female who worked aboard the bridge of the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon.
The "Big Bad Loth-wolf" was a Loth-wolf character in a story told by the Mandalorian Din Djarin to Grogu. In the story, the Loth-wolf utilized an All Terrain Scout Transport to visit Gamorreans.
Octavion Sorin was a human who served as an officer in the armed forces of the Galactic Empire with the military rank of general.
A human male served the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate as a guard on board the First Light, the personal yacht of syndicate head, crime lord Dryden Vos.

Ai-Dan Yelooc was a human male Jedi who operated during the High Republic Era.

Jawabobo was a Jawa that lived on the planet Tatooine.

Kozmo Sundrel IV was a male lord from the planet Luzalite and a student at Reena University by around 396 BBY.

A Terionese woman was the wife of the teacher Hennah. During the High Republic Era, the two women lived in a residence on their homeworld, the Mid Rim planet Teriona.

Argeel was a Terionese man who lived in the settlement of Strop's End on the Mid Rim planet Teriona. Between around 234 BBY and 232 BBY, they appreciated the efforts of Jedi Master Loden Greatstorm and his Padawan, Bell Zettifar, to help the community of Strop's End.

Sveen was a Terionese individual who resided on their homeworld, the Mid Rim planet Teriona, during the High Republic Era. Between around 234 BBY and 232 BBY, they baked a few loaves of bread as a gift for Jedi Master Loden Greatstorm and his Padawan, Bell Zettifar.
A Terionese man worked as a bartender in the Strop's End's settlement's tavern on the Mid Rim planet Teriona.

Nah'hai was a proose-rider on Madurs. During Han Solo and Leia Organa's honeymoon to Madurs, Nah'hai showed them around the planet on a proose. She was a member of the underground resistance network on Madurs.
Balangawa was a member of the underground resistance network on Madurs as well as being an angler.
Janyn was a member of the underground resistance network on Madurs as well as being an angler.

Blinna was a member of the underground resistance network on Madurs. Blinna and her girls attacked a Galactic Empire comm unit.
Filli was a member of the underground resistance network on Madurs who was tasked to scout out the number of repulsorlifts are supporting the Black tower space station on Madurs.

Diya was a Dusk Weaver of the Had'le Path on the moon Ro Mira.
Muro was a Twi'lek Dusk Weaver of the Had'le Path on the moon Ro Mira.

Yaya Shram was a female Anzellan bounty hunter. She was ruthless and had a reputation for discretion. At one point during the late Republic Era, she was hired by Cuthus of Jabba's criminal empire to retrieve the coaxium ultra formula from the moon Ro Mira.

A Snivvian merchant was present in Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the merchant requested Jabba the Hutt to help him after the Trandoshan clan had been robbing his stores near Mos Elrey.
A Trandoshan clan member was present in Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine during the Imperial Era.
Beeth was a Minister of defense for the planet Sarumo until he was killed by the Mirialan Abediah Viess.
Seurath was mayor on the planet Sarumo in the year 229 BBY. After Sarumo was caught in the Nihil's Occlusion Zone, Seurath and his people resisted Nihil invasion.

A Nameless creature was being transported by the renegade Nihil Doctor Kisma Uttersond to the space station Starlight Beacon as part of a second wave of an attack on the station.
A Nameless creature was unleashed by the Nihil pirates on the space station Starlight Beacon during their destruction of the station.

Gar Faven was an incompetent male employee of Ohnaka Transport Solutions on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. He was born around 9 ABY and often argued with his younger yet more competent coworker Malta Lan.
Malta Lan was a low-level male employee of Ohnaka Transport Solutions on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. Born around 10 ABY, he often argued with his older yet less competent coworker Gar Faven.
Tata was a Force-sensitive human who led the cult of Ankok. She admired the Sith and believed herself to be the successor of the Sith Lord that Ankok worshipped. She was killed by Kako.

A male Dimok served as a representative of the Dimok government in 3 ABY. During the Sepan campaign of the Sepan Civil War, he met with Admiral Harkov of the Galactic Empire who was secretly selling Imperial weapons to both the Dimok and Ripoblus governments.

A son of the Ermiko family was a male individual who lived on their homeworld, the Outer Rim planet Valo, during the High Republic Era. During the Nihil marauders' occupation of Valo in 230 BBY, they became sick.

A Trandoshan male Nihil worked for the captain I'nah's crew aboard her vessel. In 229 BBY, he was in a meeting in the ship's briefing room and attempted to convince Nihil scientist Niv Drendow Apruk not to travel to the Outer Rim planet Valo and instead stay aboard.
Eicho was a Valon Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order, serving in the Outer Rim planet Valo's Jedi temple by training the Jedi younglings Tep Tep, Kildo, and Gavi.
Melchior Votto was a human who served as an officer of the Imperial Security Bureau during the Imperial Era.

Helok was a Valon Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order, serving in the Outer Rim planet Valo's Jedi temple by helping maintain the temple grounds. He was killed in a Nihil marauder attack in 230 BBY while attempting to flee with the temple's younglings into Valo's mountains.

Grendrek was a Nameless male owned by the Nihil scientist Niv Drendow Apruk during the High Republic Era. He was born from an egg that had been recovered by Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro during a mission to Planet X.

The aunt of the Iridonian Zabrak pirate Zyle Keem was part of the Keem family. During the High Republic Era, the woman was able to cook a clear-noodle dish with squeezed greencitrus and sliced yobshrimp, which their relatives greatly enjoyed.

Bubbles was a rathtar that lived in the Lonisa City Zoo on the Outer Rim planet Valo during the High Republic Era. By 230 BBY, Bubbles became injured and broke out of the zoo, encountering the Jedi younglings Kildo, Gavi Takitaken, and Tep Tep.

"The Warden," also known as Herwint Tiks, was a disgraced Nihil enforcer– who served as the prison warden of Korvix Vorn penal ship during the High Republic Era. He asked the Nihil scientist Niv Drendow Apruk to find out which of his prisoners were Jedi.

Ellamak was a female Pkorian who lived on the planet Pkori. She was the aunt of Iskat Akaris.

Jinton was a Jedi trainee of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. While in the Valo Temple on the Outer Rim planet Valo, they participated in a free-for-all lightsaber match and paired off against the youngling Tep Tep as their opponent.

A senator served the Galactic Republic in the Senate. By 22 BBY, they participated in a diplomatic mission and were escorted by Jedi Knight Bavoc Ansho and his Padawan Tualon Yaluna. During the mission, the Jedi fought off a number of bandits.
Gerrin was an imperial officer stationed on Nar Shaddaa during the Galactic Civil War.
Shortatha was a male Wookiee and was put in prison by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Gaarkhan, another Wookiee and a member of the Rebellion led a mission to free him.
Strang was an Imperial during the Galactic Civil War.

Bettyjill was an Eirami fisher hailing from the planet Eiram. During the High Republic Era, she worked alongside her fellow Eirami Nelly and Gorge as part of the crew of the Queen Xiri fishing boat under its captain, Okoro.

Hebsly was a human who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy. In 4 ABY, he was part of a line of Imperial officers on board the Death Star II superweapon that stood by as the Sith Lord Darth Vader arrived in one of the station's hangars.

Mianda was a human who flew as a pilot for the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire, earning the rank of major. He was part of a group of Imperial officers that lined up in a hangar on the Death Star II superweapon for the arrival of Sith Lord Darth Vader in 4 ABY.

A Trandoshan was present on the glacial moon Ro Mira during the Republic Era. When Jedi Mace Windu, visiting Ro Mira on a mission to locate Azita Cruuz and the shipment of coaxium ultra she had obtained, the Trandoshan and a group of associates took notice of him.
Saan was an Espirion female who knew a number of tales that involved the Galactic Empire's First and Second Death Star superweapons.

Deblindrix III, or simply Deblindrix, was a Nameless owned by the Nihil scientist Niv Drendow Apruk during the High Republic Era.

Mina was a youngling on the planet Vuundalla during the High Republic Era. She was the daughter of Renaad. Mina, Renaad and their fellow villagers were subjects of King Pychor Vuundir and Queen Dafne Vuundir, who cared little for their subjects' welfare.

A male celebrity was active by the time of the High Republic Era. At some point, he began using the mycopram regenerative substance to look younger.

Fabarian was a human Agent in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau. The foremost investigator of the planet Coruscant's sector 35, he believed in his career and disapproved of the corruption within the Empire, instead desiring order.
Xanto was a human council member of the Galactic Empire. Over ten years, Xanto embezzled thousands of credits, although he kept only ten percent and gave the rest to members of the Imperial Court.
Masakint was a human cyborg who was a member of the M.A.R. Corps, a team of individuals with extensive cybernetics who fought for the Rebel Alliance.

A Nihil marauder was part of the Nihil captain I'nah's crew on a vessel commandeered from the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era.

Eren Kitt was a scrapper on the planet Bracca during the High Republic Era. She worked very closely with her droid M1-M1. Kitt was also a frequent supplier of starship parts for Durango Shuttle Service. She had cybernetics of the left leg below the knee.

A Imperial weapons technician served aboard an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer, before they where killed around 1 ABY by stormtroopers who mistakenly thought the technician was aiding in R2-D2's infiltration of the vessel.

Dafne Vuundir was queen of the planet Vuundalla. She ruled over the planet with her husband, King Pychor Vuundir. The two leaders were generally apathetic towards their people, but interested in wider galactic politics, particularly in Starlight Beacon.

Ozon Nimbee was a male Keteerian real estate developer who lived during the High Republic Era. Between 233 BBY and 232 BBY, Jedi Padawan Celesta Kami and Jedi Initiates Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs encountered the developer in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet…

Pychor Vuundir was king of the planet Vuundalla. He ruled over the planet with his wife, Queen Dafne Vuundir. The two leaders were generally apathetic towards their people, but interested in wider galactic politics, particularly in Starlight Beacon.
A Terionese shopkeeper lived on her homeworld, the Mid Rim planet Teriona, during the High Republic Era. She operated a shop on the outskirts of the world's Strop's End settlement.

Adnama was a human with light skin and pink hair. In 22 BBY, they attended the Outlander Club in the Uscru Entertainment District on the planet Coruscant and stood with a drink in hand talking with another human when the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker entered the club.
Lunae Minx was a purple-skinned Twi'lek that visited the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY.

Oby Bobissia was a Triffian with light skin and black hair. In 22 BBY, they spoke animatedly with the Nuknog Slyther Bushforb outside Dex's Diner in the CoCo Town district of the planet Coruscant shortly before Bushforb then entered the diner.

An Imperial Navy technician served aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Chimaera during the Battle of Atollon. During the battle, rebel forces, including Ezra Bridger and Sabine Wren, boarded the Imperial Interdictor-class heavy cruiser Constrainer.

Rednax was a Dug with spotted green skin. In 22 BBY, Rednax was sat with a drink in a booth at Dex's Diner in the CoCo Town district of the planet Coruscant with the Nuknog Slyther Bushforb and Dug holovid star Seboca.
Slyther Bushforb was a blue-skinned Nuknog that spoke animatedly with the Triffian Oby Bobissia outside Dex's Diner in the CoCo Town district of the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY.
A Kudon individual was one of hundreds of their species who were enslaved by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and forced to work in a droid foundry on the moon Kudo III.

A Kudon individual lived during the Republic Era. They were one of hundreds of Kudon who were enslaved by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and forced to labor in a droid foundry on the moon Kudo III.

Vigor Struk was a human cyborg criminal active during the chancellery of Finis Valorum who competed with the bounty hunter Jango Fett for a bounty to retrieve a statue known as the Hope of Glee Anselm which had been stolen.

Mox was a young clone cadet who became a prisoner of the Galactic Empire shortly after the end of the Clone Wars.

A clone navigation officer was stationed on the Venator-class Star Destroyer Triumphant in 22 BBY. When the ship was attacked by the Separatist cruiser Malevolence, the officer, along with fellow crew members, was evacuated in an escape pod.

Stak was a clone cadet who became a prisoner of the Galactic Empire shortly after the end of the Clone Wars. Many cadets, including Stak, were transferred off planet Kamino and brought to a secret Imperial medical laboratory overseen by Doctor Royce Hemlock.

Deke was a clone cadet who became a prisoner of the Galactic Empire shortly after the end of the Clone Wars. Deke and many other cadets were transferred off their home planet Kamino and brought to a secret Imperial medical laboratory overseen by Doctor Royce Hemlock.
"The Shroud" was a Force-sensitive Devaronian who was the leader of the cult known as the Had'le Path.
A Devaronian served as a captain to the Durand crime family during the Imperial Era. He was tried and executed for treason by Isa Durand.

A Hynestian female member of the Hynestian royal family served as the queen of the Colonies planet Hynestia during the High Republic Era. Between 230 BBY and 228 BBY, the queen visited the compound of the Nihil pirates on the Outer Rim planet Hetzal Prime for a brunch.

Evat Seth was a Czerialan Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. By around 379 BBY, Seth had grown elderly, and Padawan Rooper Nitani regarded them as the best lightsaber wielder she had ever known.

An female individual was the daughter of a Twi'lek janitor who worked for Reena University on the Colonies planet Reena. When they required surgery, the janitor asked the dean to advance his wages to pay for the surgery, but the dean refused.

Voh was a Bimm male who was the seneschal of Sanctuary Mount, the Jedi Order's outpost on the planet Kwenn. Although not a Jedi himself, Voh served as the outpost's caretaker for much of his life, meeting a number of the Jedi Masters of the Jedi High Council.
Mann was a human male captain of the Galactic Empire. Around 18 BBY, during the early years of the Imperial Era, he was stationed on Lau when he encountered rogue clones Omega and Crosshair.
Cassus Yissik was a musician who performed the song "Rah Rah Rah." The song was played on the Halcyon starcruiser.
Lucky Ferrariss was a musician who performed the song "Stargate Swing." The song was played on the Halcyon starcruiser.
Barūbarū was a musician who performed the song "Nesh Godo." The song was played on the Halcyon starcruiser.
A Trandoshan spent time in a cantina on the planet Lau, gambling against other cantina patrons in the card game balaans.

A street urchin sat outside a cantina on the planet Lau. During or after 18 BBY, the clones Crosshair and Omega crashed on the planet after escaping imprisonment by the Galactic Empire. They entered the cantina while being watched by the urchin.
A ticketing officer worked at the spaceport on the planet Lau. During or after 18 BBY, the clones Crosshair and Omega crashed on the planet after escaping imprisonment by the Galactic Empire.
Eunice Ino was an Ugnaught who used to run a chop shop in a asteroid hangar and was paid by Draiven Bosh to break open a stolen XD-7 speedster.

The Genius Geonosian was a Geonosian who wished to be smuggled from his home planet of Geonosis to the university city of Theed, in order to study. Some Separatist droids attempted to prevent him from doing this. However, he managed to get to Theed.
The thief resided on Coruscant, and at one point stole a taxi in the Federal district of Coruscant, along with several accomplices.

Rich Goldman was a rich Human, who loved to go around in his gold-plated speeders. He is however, prone to crashing them. He crashed two such speeders in Cloud City, and in the Uscru District on Coruscant.
A TK stormtrooper was involved in a shuttle crash on the planet Wayland during or after 18 BBY and was killed alongside their crew by the creatures in the jungle.
An Imperial technician was stationed in Mount Tantiss on the planet Wayland during or after 18 BBY. The technician conversed with the pilot of Shuttle 135 before the shuttle crashed in sector four.

Kela'pi was a Valon woman who hailed from the Outer Rim planet Valo and helped run her family's general store in the Haplak district of Lonisa City. However, the store was ransacked by Nihil marauders following their occupation of Valo in 230 BBY.
The LEGO Maniac—or simply the Maniac—was a Human affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Kal Mpon was the father of the Arcona Kal Nkai, later known as Hem Dazon.

Selea was a Zygerrian Nihil marauder who served in the crew of the Storm Melis Shryke on the Stormship Cacophony during the High Republic Era.

One of the Kagles, a trio of furred sentients who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor, was distinguished from his fellows by the fact that he wore a green shirt.

A talking tree living on the Forest Moon of Endor, where he had put down roots near the Ewok settlement of Bright Tree Village by 3 ABY. The talking tree was well-disposed to the Ewoks neighbors.

Ziravi Chant was a Devaronian artist during the High Republic Era. She specialized in poison pigments, creating paintings that were required to be placed under carefully modulated energy shields that purified the air without distorting the color and texture of the art.

Harth Sparkburn was the husband of Essren Sparkburn and brother of Jordanna Sparkburn. He lived on Arli's moon during the High Republic Era. He and his family evacuated from the moon when it was consumed by the blight.

Parv Dijj was a Sullustan professor of Xenoarchaeology at the University of Ketaris. Parv Dijj was the wife of Groob and had a daughter named Ulsee.

Elping Tsoo was a human male corporal and scientific officer in the Republic Defense Coalition who was stranded inside the Nihil Occlusion Zone with RDC Lieutenant Visma Tarko. In 228 BBY, Tsoo and Tarko met Joss and Pikka Adren.

Visma Tarko was an Arkanian female of the illustrious Tarkos family. However, she lost her family as a child by force, changing her entire life and making her feel helpless in that moment. In that moment, no one tried to help her.

Greer was a human clone of the bounty hunter Jango Fett, created for service in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army of the Republic. By around 18 BBY, Greer had joined the Clone Underground movement which sought to liberate their clone brethren from the Galactic Empire.
CX-2, also known as Sniper CloneX2, was a Clone X trooper that served under the Galactic Empire during or after 18 BBY. He was deployed to Teth in a mission to eliminate another clone assassin, CX-1.
Samson was a clone trooper who eventually joined the clone resistance network that was created by Clone Captain Rex early in the Imperial Era.

Alala Ninbiri was a non-binary prospector who captained a transport. They were known to Spence Leffbruk who avoided dealing with them due to a bad reputation. They often engaged in smuggling activities. In 382 BBY, they were present above Dalna.
Slandarv was a human male baron of the Galactic Empire. He operated a factory on Slandarvia M-9, where he secretly constructed a new model of battle droid.

An E'roni commander had fought on the side of the E'roni during their war with the Eirami in 382 BBY. Their command was to kill innocent civilians in Eirami. Bokana Koss refused his command. The commander tried to kill him, but Bokana was faster and shot the commander.

An individual worked as the chef in Enlightenment, a bar located in the Holy City on the Mid Rim moon Jedha by 382 BBY. During the Battle of Jedha that year, the chef was killed, to the dismay of the bar's owner, the Villarandi Kradon Minst.
Byl, designated 0037, was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A female individual was the daughter of the humans Geth and Shea Ganandra, who conceived the baby by 382 BBY.
An individual was a shipping heir from the Core Worlds planet Coruscant during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, it was announced that the heir was to marry Pamalonia Graf of the Graf family.

A Mikkian female was the older sister of the Mikkian male Treze who lived during the High Republic Era. At some point, the two and their family joined the Path of the Open Hand cult on the Outer Rim planet.

Jessen Pol was an ISB agent who investigated a crime scene in a Tyrenan warehouse alongside fellow agent Darin Gento. The warehouse, which belonged to sculptor Quek Rai, held an altercation between Rai and Jerserra over a shard of the Nardithi Cluster.

Olon was a Rodian doctor and bioengineer of the Chattza Clan. He created an artificial plague called the Nurosk Plague.

Yord Fandar was a human male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. As a Jedi Padawan, he befriended Verosha "Osha" Aniseya. Eventually being promoted to a Jedi Knight, he took on Tasi Lowa as a Padawan.

In 148 BBY, Aniseya hosted Rite of Ascension ceremony for her daughters to become witches. When several visiting Jedi interrupted, and Mother Aniseya agreed to let the pair be tested after Jedi Master Indara insisted.
Jecki Lon was a Theelin-human hybrid female Jedi Padawan who lived during the High Republic Era in 132 BBY. She was the Padawan of Jedi Master Sol and was calm and mature for her age.

Indara was a human female who joined the Jedi Order as a youngling during the High Republic Era. As a Padawan, she trained under her Jedi Master's tutelage before later attaining the rank of Jedi Knight around 161 BBY.

Torbin was a Force-sensitive human male from the planet Bonadan who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Between around 158 BBY and 157 BBY, he became the Padawan of Jedi Master Indara.

Sylar Saris, also known as "The Slayer of Ordo Eris," was an insectoid criminal that was active in the Imperial Era during or after 18 BBY.
A human male was the father of Radicaz Dobbs. He was always drunk.

Jendon was a colonel of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy who co-piloted the Sith Lord Darth Vader's shuttle, ST 321, with Captain Yorr. In 4 ABY, they transported Vader from the Star Destroyer Avenger to the Death Star II superweapon while in the Endor system.
Tok was a human governor who served the Galactic Republic as an undercover agent for Count Dooku during its reign.

Skrawll was an Anselmi male who served as king of their people on the planet Glee Anselm in the time before the Anselmi's war with the Nautolan species.

Vilola Sargan was a member of the Clan Assembly as the patrician of the Sargan family. She had contacts throughout the criminal underworld, including among the Hutts, the Zann Consortium, and the Car'das smuggling ring.

Hordem Molec was a Zygerrian Prince who was the son of King Atai Molec and older brother of Prince Sono Molec. He died sometime after the Clone Wars.

Dooarix Gyll was a male Gand Podracer active during the Galactic Civil War.

An Ualaq Aqualish worked as a bouncer at a secret gambling den on the planet Oosalon during the Republic Era. Around 33 BBY, the bouncer questioned the bounty hunter Jango Fett what the password was after he arrived at the den to collect a bounty inside.
Fissark Tozan was a Koorivar criminal whose bounty was claimed by the Mandalorian Jango Fett.

Llek Huron was a Near-Human male who served as Titan Base's back-up pilot for the Rebel Alliance. He lost one of his eyes during an interrogation.
An individual under the callsign "Scimitar 1" flew a TIE bomber during the Battle of Endor.
Huijari was a Mirialan who acted as an agent of Count Dooku. Undercover, Huijari pretended to be a Judicial in the Galactic Republic's Judicial Forces.

A human warden ran the Megalox prison during the time of the Galactic Republic. The warden released the prisoner Aurra Sing into the custody of Judicial Huijari, accepting a bribe from the latter to keep the act a secret.

Regump was a Lutrillian who worked at an underwater prison complex on the moon Devshi, operating the docking remotes on its surface platform. By 48 BBY, a group of droids from the prison commandeered a skiff that Regump was parking and fled the platform.

Misette grew up in the undercity of Sparth. There she learned about the oppressive ways of the First Order. She would later leave and eventually join the Resistance where she carried out undercover missions.
An individual served as a senator in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. By 382 BBY, the senator had fallen in love with a member of the Jedi Order.
Sorren was a Sullustan and member of the Rebel Alliance. He was the Chief Engineer of Titan Base.

An individual was a Jedi in the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. By 382 BBY, he had fallen in love with a senator in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate, which was eventually reported as one of the newest romances on the holonet.

Jayce Terril was the commander of Titan Base's Nightmare Squadron, an X-wing squadron.

Bhuto was a Toydarian who leased a freighter to Snivvian bounty hunter Vogg Barakk.

A human male was the father of Rebel Alliance pilot Sila Kott. He lived with his family on the planet Toprawa until he and his sons were killed in an accident by 2 ABY.

Trank Varado was a fictitious individual that the Nihil recruit Driggit Parse created as her cousin to be part of a ruse.

Gak was a Narquois Nihil marauder who was stationed on the Outer Rim planet Valo during its occupation by the Nihil. In 229 BBY, they and a Rodian Nihil stopped a treadtruck driven by the Jedi youngling Gavi as it drove into Lonisa City, insisting on searching the vehicle.

A Rodian Nihil was stationed on the Outer Rim planet Valo during its occupation by the Nihil marauders. In 229 BBY, he and the Nihil Gak stopped a treadtruck driven by the Jedi youngling Gavi as it drove into Lonisa City, insisting on searching the vehicle.
A Pau'an civiian used to go bungee jumping in the Utapau sinkholes with Flat Head Edd, but due to an injury Edd sustained, he was banned from doing so.

Eva was a young female Iktotchi who had a high M-count. Eva was taken from her home and kept as a prisoner of the Imperial base at their base on Mount Tantiss, living inside a vault along with several other M-count children, including Jax and Sami, although the Empire insisted…

Jax was a young male Mirialan who was kept as a prisoner in the vault of Tantiss Base, where he was designated SP-32. He, along with two other children named Eva and Sami, were imprisoned due to their high M-count.

Kerun was a Twi'lek male member of a group of thieves led by Elecia Zeveron. During the Queen's Bloom Festival around 396 BBY, Kerun took párt with Zeveron's crew steal valuables from attendees of a party hosted by the House of Reena in Gorag Tower on the planet Reena.

A stormtrooper served as a commander in the unit that accompanied General Armitage Hux and Kylo Ren during their mission to the planet Karaxis after being ordered by Supreme Leader Snoke to subjugate the Karaxians.

Tuntis was a male individual that lived in Peka village on the world Batuu. He was friends with Kaxx, another resident of Peka. By around 379 BBY, Tuntis had grown old.

Hachi was a human mercenary of the Scarabi. She led a group of Scarabi in kidnapping Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma on the planet Uveron. Hachi and her team were successful in kidnapping Mothma, who at the time was remotely attending the trial of Lando Calrissian.
Ailish was a Tarlafar and the mother of the Force-sensitive infant Bayrn, living with him in a mountain city on the world Caraad.
Bayrn was a Force-sensitive Tarlafar and the child of Ailish. During or after 18 BBY, an infant Bayrn was kidnapped by bounty hunter Cad Bane and delivered to the Galactic Empire.

Arkiin Smir was the head of the secret service of the planet Alderaan. After the destruction of the planet, Arkiin Smir was dismissed from his functions due to psychological disorders. He founded the Luminous Knives group, with the goal to eliminate all Imperial forces.
Charywamm was a Jawa Rebel agent based on the planet Aglasis. He was an expert in ship repairs and computer science and was always accompanied by an R2 unit.
Eurus was a Force-sensitive human witch who served as ensign for the Brendok coven on the planet Brendok during the High Republic Era.

A male individual was the father of Marionette, a girl who was eventually taken away by The Dark Wraith after repeatedly misbehaving at her academy.

Esstrop was a Kessurian member of the Path of the Open Hand cult who ventured out into the Galactic Frontier to spread their religion's teachings. As a result, they were not present on the Path's home planet, Dalna, when a battle in 382 BBY culminated in the cult's end.

Kortanio was a Kessurian member of the Path of the Open Hand cult who ventured into the Galactic Frontier in service to the Path and was not present when the cult met its violent end on its home planet Dalna in 382 BBY.
A Force-sensitive green-skinned humanoid man was a refugee during the High Republic Era. At some point no earlier than 379 BBY, he was present in a refugee camp that was attacked by raiders.

Samwa was a scavenger. At some point after 1 BBY, a human scavenger mentioned Samwa and his exceptional scavenging skill while pointing out a kyber brick to an individual in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.

Junhya Havoc was an Abednedo captain of Rogue Squadron during the Battle of Endor whose A-wing was shot down during the battle. Princess Leia Organa later tasked the Ewok Wicket, the protocol droid C-3PO and Brreot Roht on a mission to rescue him.
Sundu Huxia was an Imperial lieutenant and pilot whose ship crashed during the Battle of Endor, and was later saved by the Ewok Wicket and the Rebel operative Major Brreot Roht.
Yash Helgan was a Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order by 33 BBY.

Kylah Lohmata, nicknamed Stowaway, was a human female member of the Riftwalkers gang, led by the pirate Zilastra.

Inisa was a Falleen female who worked for the Poisoned Blades pirate gang. While on the planet Kwenn, she met the Jedi Master Eeth Koth at a hotel on Kinnawah Key.
Graak was a male Ewok who entered a plot alongside his brother, Gruekk, and the Dulok King, Gorneesh, to seize control of Bright Tree Village.

Rasma was a stargazer from the planet Maldroth.

Blaask was a Trandoshan bouncer who worked at a nightclub on Vorah Key on the planet Kwenn. In 33 BBY, the Trandoshan was at his post while the Jedi Master Yarael Poof stood near the nightclub to wait for Master Ki-Adi-Mundi to exit a nearby pub during the Jedi Council's missi…
A Trandoshan was associated with a nightclub on Vorah Key, one of the Gem Cities of the planet Kwenn, during the Republic Era. She was familiar with the nightclub's bouncer, fellow Trandoshan Blaask.

Jodak was a Yinchorri pilot in the Riftwalkers pirate gang. He piloted the Randomizer, the flagship of the Riftwalkers' leader, Zilastra.

Burlug, nicknamed Luggy, was a Feeorin male who was the second-in-command to Zilastra, leader of the Riftwalkers pirate gang. The Feeorin had once led the Riftwalkers, but recognized Zilastra's skill and let her take over.

Bazallo was a Trandoshan who was a member of the pirate gang known as the Vile. After the previous leader, Bobo, was killed by Riftwalkers leader Zilastra, Bazallo claimed leadership of the gang, although his rule was contested by Nanna Frouj, who had claimed a chunk of the Vile.

A Hylobon guard worked as a Hylobon Enforcer for the Crimson Dawn criminal organization during the Imperial Era. While on the First Light yacht around 13 BBY, he caught the enslaved girl Qi'ra on a turbolift as she attempted to escape the vessel.
A warden served the Galactic Empire and commanded the observation tower in the entrance of the Imperial labor camp on the planet Erebus during or after 18 BBY.
Ho-Jon was a Ho'Din chiropractor-homeopath that resided on the planet Pendalanor.

Churo, or Churo the Hutt, was a Hutt scientist who lived during the High Republic Era. He lived in Bilbousa City on the planet Nal Hutta alongside his family, the Devirsivik Clan.
Meela was a female Rodian who lived on Prandril. She and her wife, Boona governed the colony on Prandril.

Lof was a Klatooinian orphaned during the Battle of Jedha, and was later adopted by Moona and Erta.
Mikilanie was an Em'liy resident of Jedha during the High Republic Era who sold sacred icons in a stall in the Wayfarer Quarter, like generations of his family before him.
A Force-sensitive girl of the Yacombe, a group once aligned with the dark side of the Force, was present on the planet Kindosorn during the High Republic Era.

Kwang Buga was a Hutt residing on the asteroid M612 in the Hoth asteroid field. He was a cousin of Jabba the Hutt.

Ghor was a Houk male criminal who operated in the Slice during the Republic Era. He worked alongside The Lobber and Wungo as part of the Idiot Three.
Wungo was a Klatooinian male criminal who lived during the Republic Era. He operated in the Slice alongside The Lobber and Ghor.
Leerah was a human female who lived on the planet Tharben with her husband, Vale, and their two children, a daughter and son, during the Republic Era.

Toln Yurak was an individual who served within the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army with the military rank of colonel.
Krynthia was a Loth-cat owned by the bounty hunter Vukorah around 3 ABY after she had left the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate.
At least two individuals were the parents of the human girl Azita Cruuz. At some point they died on Cruuz's homeworld Haruun Kal during the crossing, leaving the girl oprhaned.

A female Jedi of the Jedi Order lived centuries before 33 BBY. Although she was cut off from any hope of assistance while working in a remote region, the Jedi continued to fight, understanding the role of death in the natural order.
Gorak Palas was an underboss of the Pyke Syndicate and ran their operations on the moon Toshara in 3 ABY.
Ashiga was a queen of the Ashiga Clan who lived in the time of the Imperial Era. She ruled the Ashiga for generations and was admired for resisting the Galactic Empire on Kijimi.
Naraa Chimu was a Sakiyan assassin-for-hire.

Hadaro was a Twi'lek male who lived on the planet Kwenn during the Republic Era. He was a school student on Essafa Key, although like many of his fellow children, did not care to attend classes as a result of the funding cuts from the companies that subsidized the school.
Pop Teeno was an Iktotchi individual who ran a canteen on the fifth floor of the Republic Defense Coalition mobile launch and repair station.

The first Count of the wealthy House Malreaux had been a pirate that operated in the Bay of Tears on Vjun. He extorted a grant of nobility for his house from the nobles of the surrounding territory in an exchange for a loose promise to not plunder their ships in the bay.
Fraxa was a Muun who was the owner of Kwikhaul Livery Corporation on the planet Kwenn. She owned an antique ARC-8 starfighter from the High Republic Era that she attempted to restore.
Dargen Boorho was an individual who was a chef on Starlight Beacon during 231 BBY.
Mither was an individual who served as a captain in Galactic Alliance Security.

An individual who served in the Hutt Cartel was an informer for the Dowutin Nihil Tempest Runner Pan Eyta during the High Republic Era. By 252 BBY, the informer advised Eyta that a shipment of glitterstim spice was being transported on the Roon way hyperspace route.
Carus was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. According to legend, Carus ignored the warnings of his friends and family to explore the Great Ungeness Trench.
Carus's father was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. Their child, Carus died after awaking a squid-like creature at the bottom of the Great Ungeness Trench.
Carus's mother was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. She child, Carus died after awaking a squid-like creature at the bottom of the Great Ungeness Trench.
Surack was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. According to legend he accompanied his friend Carus to the edge of the Great Ungeness Trench during Carus's first attempts to explore the trench.
Athbrin was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. According to legend she accompanied her friend Carus to the edge of the Great Ungeness Trench during Carus's first attempts to explore the trench.
Athbrin's father was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala who served as a soldier.

Noparo Yar was a male Togruta who lived on Miekos with his wife, Fee-Na during the High Republic Era. Her mother Tanabi Yar eventually left her family and became a pirate, but when her wife died, she came back to be a grandmother to her son's and his wife's child.
Fee-Na was a female Nautolan who lived on Miekos with her husband, Noparo Yar during the High Republic Era. She was secretly a member of the Confederation of Haulers.

Kirri was a female individual who lived on Miekos with her wife Tanabi Yar and her son Noparo Yar during the High Republic Era. Tanabi left her family and became a pirate, but when Kirri died, she came back to be a grandmother to her son's and his wife Fee-Na's child.
A Togruta was the cousin of Tanabi Yar and the ruler of Shili after Yar abdicated in favor of her cousin during the High Republic Era.

Teeler was a Togruta who worked as a driver for Kwikhaul Livery Corporation on the planet Kwenn. Along with the rest of Kwikhaul's employees, Teeler lost his job when the company's owner, Fraxa, replaced all the drivers with droids due to being unable to afford paying organic …

Werner Klop was a male Human and a high ranked member of the Confederation of Haulers. He tried to stop Tanabi Yar to fix the communication tower on the planet Miekos and ruined the business of the guild.
An Ithorian male was an assassin who hired by Werner Klop. He and his female partner tried to assassinate Tanabi Yar and her family, but when Vernestra Rwoh helped them, he ran away.

A human female was an assassin who was hired by Werner Klop. In 229 BBY, she received a mission to eliminate Tanabi Yar. On her first attempt to assassinate Yar, her hand was amputated by Vernestra Rwoh using a lightsaber.
Nellis was a helm operator who served under Captain Pell Baylo aboard the CR56 corvette Assurance.
Orl Miscord was a male Skyholme Lucite who masqueraded as a beast tamer with the caravan of exotic beasts owned by Sala Vindako on the planet Weik.

A clone of Obi-Wan Kenobi was created by the mad genetic terrorist Zeta Magnus during the early months of the Clone Wars.
This individual was a pirate in Kragan Gorr's pirate gang.

Hadden Shrag was a Nosaurian male who lived on the planet Kwenn with his wife, Pogee. He owned the Lamplighter Boutique on Kinnawah Key, collecting numerous texts, although rarely sold any of the items, resulting in the boutique becoming full of items.
A clone of Halagad Ventor was created by the mad genetic terrorist Zeta Magnus during the early months of the Clone Wars.

Pogee Shrag was a Nosaurian female who resided on the planet Kwenn with her husband, Hadden. After Hadden, owner of the Lamplighter Boutique, was injured when some of his materials fell onto him and left to rehabilitate on one of Kwenn's moons, Shrag remained at their home wit…

Venom Vee was a Twi'lek female who was the leader of the Poisoned Blades pirate gang. Along with the leaders of the other three pirate gangs of the Slice, Venom Vee was killed by Riftwalkers leader Zilastra.

Darwoh was a human who led the Filthy Credits pirate gang. He was killed, along with the other pirate leaders in the Slice, by Riftwalkers leader Zilastra.

Bobo was a Sanyassan who led the pirate gang known as the Vile. Shortly after ascending to become the leader of the Vile, Bobo became aware of a deal between the Vile and the other gangs in the region.

Jupas was an individual who led the Vile pirate gang. He was replaced by the Sanyassan Bobo, who claimed that Jupas was no longer in charge when the Riftwalkers leader Zilastra questioned what had happened to the former leader.
Tensu Run was a human male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order who survived Order 66. During the Imperial Era, he trained under the Jedi Elan Rast, who convinced him to try and rebuild the Jedi Order.

Spinran was a Halisite who worked on the docks in Jedha City and whose job it was to scrap the hulls of visiting ships. He had a large bone crest on the top of his head that changed color from red to blue depending on his mood.
JP-054 was a human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire.

A clone shock trooper was a member of the Coruscant Guard during the end of the Clone Wars and the early days of the Galactic Empire. The clone trooper was stationed at the Republic Center for Military Operations and, along with another trooper, guarded Barriss Offee's cell.

Ahmar was a Force-sensitive alien Jedi who survived Order 66 and was brought to the moon Nur alongside Barriss Offee and Dante where he was offered the chance to become an Inquisitor.

Sendlak was the Twi'lek Jedi Master of Ashla.
Abrish was a Muun male who worked for a small enslavement empire on the planet of Oon during the Age of the Empire.

Dai Danu was a Sullustan freighter technician in service with the SoroSuub Corporation. After discovering a plot to frame him to have him terminated, Danu committed murder and fled aboard a hijacked cargo vessel. Danu then became a professional shipjacker.

Malia Shariv was the captain of the Gundark's Back. When her ship was stolen by Dai Danu, she attempted to get it back. However, she attacked the wrong transport, as it had the cloned transponder code of the Gundark's Back.
A Force-sensitive human female served as Matron of the Mountain Clan, a clan of Dathomiri witches operating in the mountains of the planet Dathomir, during the Clone Wars.
Moru was a Britarro Jedi Master. At some point by 1032 BBY, Moru served on a warship during a war between the Force-sensitive Jedi of the Jedi Order and the dark side Force-users of the Sith.

Two individuals were the parents of the human Elping Tsoo. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Tsoo joined the Republic Defense Coalition, abandoning his frail and elderly parents on Coruscant.
A human girl lived in a settlement on an unnamed planet during the Imperial Era when the Inquisitors Barriss Offee and the Fourth Sister arrived, searching for a Jedi rumored to be hiding there.
Hila Eder was a manager of a SoroSuub Corporation facility. She framed Dai Danu of exhibiting negligence over a safety recall for hyperdrive motivators.
Sashuk Luth was a Mandalorian male and a member of the Ash'ad group. He was killed during the Showdown on Ruhnuk against Mandalore the Avenger's faction.

Poc was a Mon Calamari Nihil marauder stationed on the Outer Rim planet Valo during its occupation by the Nihil. In 229 BBY, he patrolled the streets of Lonisa City to enforce the Nihil's curfew and stopped to question the aspiring pirate Zyle Keem.
Alkin Neret was a female Dark Jedi who served under Emperor Palpatine and studied the powers of the Sith.
A human girl lived during the High Republic Era. At one point by 382 BBY, she was present in the market of the town Ferdan on the Outer Rim planet Dalna with her father.
Fogo Charu was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. He was the author of a work titled The Wisdom of Master Fogo Charu, Jedi, which was entirely dedicated to fishing.
Vale was a human male who lived during the Republic Era. He had a wife, Leerah, and two children, a daughter and a son.

Erwen Lunn was a Sullustan male and the father of Gala Key Arena worker Lyal Lunn. The Lunn family had lived on Kwenn at least since Erwen's great-grandparents were children, when they had watched the Grand Renewal of Kwenn.
Ak-rev's clan mother was a female Weequay who led a clan of Weequays that lived on Tatooine as servants of Jabba the Hutt.
Annin Gora was a minor bureaucrat who was affiliated with Dai Danu. Gora knew the location of Danu's base in the Caltrop Belt.
An Imperial commander served in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era on an Imperial outpost somewhere in the galaxy.
Rintero was a crime lord who served as the boss of the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate by sometime between 17 BBY and around 13 BBY, preceding Dryden Vos during the early Imperial Era.
Levier was a male Sephi who lived on the planet Isobe during the Imperial Era.

"Bloodbath" was a member of the Staved Skulls pirate gang who, along with another member "Menace Machine," jostled for leadership of the gang after the death of its preceding leader, the self-proclaimed Eviscerator. His appearance was similar to that of his predecessor.

A Knight of Ren traveled to a Jedi temple to retrieve an ancient Jedi artifact. The Knight of Ren was later killed by the temple's defenses. At some point, Qi'ra came across the knight's corpse while visiting the temple.
Ackzat was a Mon Calamari chef who cooked for the rebels.
Bravara was a human captain who served the Rebel Alliance against the Galactic Empire.
Grrraaalf was a Wookiee who took care of farm animals for the Rebel Alliance.
Myrna Rondo was a human scavenger who helped the Rebel Alliance.
Kaalim Puhn was a Bith musician who played the kloo horn.
Mrs. Incredible was a human female who joined Marge Simpson for a Mother's Day trip to Disney Playground Planet.
Mickey was an individual who parked their starship on the Disney Parking Planet, taking away Bob Iger's reserved parking spot.
In 28 ABY, a Centrist senator attended a minor gathering of individuals that were known to be enthusiastic collectors of items linked to the fallen Galactic Empire.
Mak Krissido was a human pilot who served the Rebel Alliance.
Su Sifta was a human pilot who served the Rebel Alliance.

Tam was a man who lived with his daughter Taya in a farming village in a valley. During the Clone Wars, the valley was attacked by Separatist forces with no explanation. Tam and Taya, along with the other villagers, fled to the head of the valley, towards the winding pass.

Taya was a girl who lived with her father Tam in a farming village in a valley. During the Clone Wars, the valley was attacked by Separatist forces with no explanation. Taya and Tam, along with the other villagers, fled to the head of the valley, towards the winding pass.
Stewie was a human youngling who once attended a party held by Marge Simpson celebrating Mother's Day.
Jago was an Ortolan Nihil marauder in the crew of Melis Shryke. By his time in Shryke's crew, Jago was old and scarred, missing one eye and most of the right side of his face.
A human Male lived on Dolgarak and acted as Interpreter to an order that operated on underneath two statues attuned to The Force, representing the struggle between the light and dark side.

A male individual lived during the High Republic Era and was the father of a human girl. At one point by 382 BBY, the father and daughter were in the market of the town Ferdan on the Outer Rim planet Dalna where the girl was given a flower by Marda Ro—an Evereni female Path of…
An individual was the older brother of Mosey Cimmaron. The pair once encountered a Tibidee, they planned on leaving the beast alone before it grabbed the brother and took flight.

In 14 BBY, an individual served as a specialist on the Imperial escort carrier Goliath. He informed Moff Wilhuff Tarkin of the deployment of Commander Abel LaSal, who had been impersonated by the rebel Berch Teller.
Bob Iger was a Human who possessed a reserved parking zone for their starship on the Disney Parking Planet. However, Mickey took down their sign and parked their own car there.

A blurrg was the mount and companion for the Twi'lek freedom fighter Cham Syndulla during the Clone Wars and into the Imperial Era. It fought alongside Syndulla during the Battle of Ryloth in 21 BBY and also during missions on the planet Ryloth against the Galactic Empire.
An individual performed as a fire juggler at Rambler's Reach Outpost sometime prior to 9 BBY. People paid to watch her performances. She ultimately burned down half of the outpost's food silo.

Kurt V was a Humanoid male and leader of the Mécateks. He resembled a pile of recycled carcasses grafted haphazardly around the silhouette of a man. He had experimental brain implants, which drove him mad.
Fan'Goriah was a Twi'lek pirate and one of the leaders of the Princes of Hell.
Grimgot Varad was a Mandalorian male and a lieutenant of Clan Varad. He was killed during the Showdown on Ruhnuk against Mandalore the Avenger's faction.
Pan Morri was a Mandalorian female and a lieutenant of the Dar'manda. She was killed during the Showdown on Ruhnuk against Mandalore the Avenger's faction.
A male individual was the grandfather of the Abednedo Path of the Open Hand member Whool and his brother Grael, and the father of their mother.

An individual was the parent of the Abednedo Path of the Open Hand member Whool and his brother, Grael. After Grael showed signs of being Force-sensitive, Whool's parent and Whool's mother feared that the Jedi would take him, and helped him learn to supress his powers.

A Force-sensitive human was a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. At one point by 384 BBY, they were present in the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant during the Pantoran youngling Kevmo Zink's first day at the Temple.

A Swokes Swokes shopkeeper their shop was visited in a city on an asteroid. Whilst working in their shop, they sold various items to Ara in preparation for her mission to destroy the dark head of the Statues of prophecy.

A human Jedi who served the Jedi Order during a war waged between the Jedi Order and their ideological antithesis, the Sith tradition of Force-users, at some point by 1032 BBY. This Jedi acted as traning partner to Toul at one point after the death of his master.

Ayo Tam was a short alien individual who could be found on Tatooine at some point during 9 BBY. He and an Aki-Aki were seen walking and talking near the Mos Eisley spaceport when exiled Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi made his way towards an outbound passenger transport in an attem…
The Curator was a male Zabrak collector of droids and other historical relics. A recluse, only known by his alias, he amassed a large collection of rare droid parts and schematics.
Cuthus was a human individual working for Jabba Desilijic Tiure in Jabba's Palace on Tatooine as of Jedi Master Mace Windu's mission to Ro Mira.

Gorg Singo was an alien individual who could be found on Tatooine at some point during 9 BBY. Singo was seen departing from a passenger transport parked at the Mos Eisley spaceport, passing by the exiled Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi who intended to board the same shuttle on a mi…

"The Ambassador" was a Rodian ambassador from a planet, and helped provide resources for the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Padmé Amidala undertook a mission to meet with the Ambassador, where they were attacked by B1-series battle droids.

An individual was a member of a cell of Crimson Dawn based at a Crimson Dawn Regional Outpost in the Outer Rim Territories. At one point, they and another member of the cell were contracted by the Savvy Clan to take out a number of targets, which they did.
An individual was a member of a cell of Crimson Dawn based at a Crimson Dawn Regional Outpost in the Outer Rim Territories.
A human patrol trooper of the Galactic Empire acted as a checkpoint officer on Level 2046 of the planet Coruscant's underworld in 9 BBY.
Torcraig was an individual who lived on the planet Brazadann as leader of the Salamander Warriors.
An unidentified Hutt clan lord was rumored to have a stake in the Manarai, an exclusive restaurant on Coruscant.
An ensign served the Galactic Republic during the New Sith Wars.
Klop Nol was a Skrilling who acted as the speaker of a settlement and hired the monster hunter Ty Yorrick to fight off the Nihil.
An Imperial Advisor was allegedly a co-owner of the Manarai, one of Coruscant's most exclusive restaurants.
In 3956 BBY, the leader of a group of Sith thugs was a student at the Sith Academy in Dreshdae, on the Outer Rim planet of Korriban.
In 3956 BBY, a Selkath worked as a bartender in the mercenary enclave located in Ahto City, on the Mid Rim planet of Manaan. The bartender sold stimulants, including adrenals and battle stimulants.

A female individual was the wife of the human Scarabi mercenary Hachi. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, after Hachi led a group of Scarabi that kidnapped Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma, she spoke with Mothma while holding her in a Scarabi safe house and asked her why she had decided…

Tobin was a Human male who owned a pulp enterprise in Calda on Thorum. He was late in paying his protection money to Crimson Dawn so he was visited by Qi'ra, Eleera, Myem and Qorsha who took all of his credits to pay his monthly fee.
An individual served as bureau chief of a law enforcement agency that operated in the city Efavan on the Outer Rim planet Vorzyd V during the High Republic Era.
FN0143 was an individual who wore a standard-issue stormtrooper armor.
Tohan Lege, known as the Lore-weaver, was a Miraluka historian who lived in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu long before the First Order-Resistance War.

Cam Lindon was a human male who served as a Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He used a vocoder after being involved in a hovercar accident on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant and lost the ability to speak naturally.

A human served the Galactic Empire as a Stormtrooper Commander during the Imperial Era. At some point during the Empire's reign, the commander led a garrison of Imperial stormtroopers on a mission to a planet in hopes of finding kyber crystals.
Sassandra was a female Twi'lek mercenary who worked for Jabba the Hutt.
Glix was a human female Nihil marauder who served as the gunner of the Cacophony, the Stormship of the Storm Melis Shryke, during the High Republic Era.
A Jedi Order seeker operated during the Republic Era and brought Dooku from Serenno to Coruscant.
During the existence of the Galactic Republic, an Urodel boy accompanied a group of Republic prison escapees who were hiding on the planet Roxuli.
Snord was a Gamorrean Nihil pirate who served on the Star Hopper alongside "The Warden".

An Azumel child lived in the Osler community on the planet Temerancé during the High Republic Era. Because of their Force-senstivity, the child was captured by the Nihil before being rescued by the monster hunter Ty Yorrick.
A Duros child lived on the planet Temerancé during the High Republic Era. Because of their Force-senstivity, the child was captured by the Nihil before being rescued by the monster hunter Ty Yorrick.

A four-armed alien pirate served the Nihil as a member of a Cloud during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the Cloud abducted several Force-sensitive children on the planet Temerancé, with the Tholothian monster hunter Ty Yorrick being hired to rescue the children.
Tara was a Mon Calamari Nihil pirate that was active during the High Republic Era. At some point, Tara, alongside Karnos, planned to kidnap Chancellor Lina Soh's son, Kitrep Soh, on the planet Abtin.

Karnos was a Nihil pirate that was active during the High Republic Era. At some point, Karnos, alongside Tara, planned to kidnap Chancellor Lina Soh's son, Kitrep Soh, on the planet Abtin. Tara later imagined making Tempest Runners alongside Karnos for the kidnapping.
A Frigosian served as an informant for the Mon Calamari Tara in the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era.
During the Republic Era, an Iktotchi criminal was active on the planet Roxuli. After confronting the bounty hunter Jango Fett, the Iktotchi was gunned down by the Mandalorian.
An Urodel criminal was active on the planet Roxuli during the Republic Era. After encountering the bounty hunter Jango Fett, the Urodel was gunned down by the Mandalorian.

A Mirialan female child lived during the High Republic Era. In 230 BBY, she was one of several children kidnapped by Tempest Runner Kara Xoo's Tempest of the Nihil pirates as would-be recruits, alongside the Kage Krylind and the humans Liam and Avon Starros.
Henry "Typex" O'Reilly was a young bureaucrat and corporal of the Rebel Alliance. He was stationed at Echo Base. He had a wife named Gwen and a son named Henry Junior.
Kent Stars was a captain of the Rebel Alliance. He was a supervisor who was responsible for supplying Echo Base and its outposts.
Henry Strips was a colonel of the Rebel Alliance stationed at Echo Base. He was head of the Fourth Bureau, a military police force of the Army Defense and Investigation Service.

An Aqualish was present at a street market on the planet Caraad sometime during the Imperial Era. After witnessing the Force-sensitive Tarlafar Bayrn use the Force while at a market, the Aqualish hired the Duros bounty hunter Cad Bane to capture the youngling.
Selch was a Falleen Nihil marauder and a follower of General Abediah Viess who was known for her brutality.

Griknaz was a Gamorrean male. A former Arena Champion, with the unique ability to speak Basic clearly and fluently, he later acted as the Captain of the Refinery Security Force members serving Vobbara Yusinduu on Hutta.

Zohra was a female native of Devalok. During the Siege of Devalok, she and her younger brother, Dumuz, spent five days hiding from the Separatist Droid Army in their family's apartment after her parents went to search for supplies at the Enki greenhouse.
"One Eye" was an aged bounty hunter who owned the Meltdown Café on Nar Shaddaa before turning the reins over to Uralak for hunting one final bounty.

A Toydarian was a Nihil and part of Kara Xoo's Tempest. In 230 BBY, Avon Starros and other children who were kidnapped by Kara Xoo and brought them to the planet Dalna. The Toydarian was one of the guards who looked after the kids.

A Quarren was a Nihil and part of Kara Xoo's Tempest. In 230 BBY, Avon Starros and other children who were kidnapped by Kara Xoo and brought them to the planet Dalna. The Quarren was one of the guards who looked after the kids.

A human woman was a resident of the city Saludad on the planet Dalna. In 230 BBY, the Nihil made a big earthquake of Dalna. While Vernestra Rwoh tried to find the President Sachary Jeffington, the woman told her she was a Nihil member.
A female individual was the mother of the Ortolan musician Maximilian Rebo and the partner of Jeph Rebo.

An Mizi female was part of Crimson Dawn. She travelled to Thorum after Qi'ra found out a local criminal organization had detailed maps of the Karthakk sector and was making moves into Crimson Dawn space.

Arryssslesh was an Elia-An medicine artist who lived on Oanne during the High Republic Era. Although a translator droid could not translate her name, it was similar to the Shyriiwook word for "chiming bells." When the Jedi Knights Burryaga Agaburry and Bell Zettifar embarked o…
Verosha "Osha" Aniseya, nicknamed Oshie by her sister, was a Force-sensitive human female Sith acolyte during the High Republic Era.
Blex was a Neimoidian member of the Trade Federation who served as captain of the WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer Fallon.
Fillik was a human who was born on the planet Kwenn around 158 BBY and spent much of his childhood around Kwenn Space Station.

Queya was the Neimoidian Chief Officer of the Trade Federation WD-2250 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer Fallon during the High Republic Era. An ambitious officer, she served under Captain Blex and helped to clean up his missteps while awaiting transfer to another vessel.

Cabuck was a Drezar from Drez who was born around 166 BBY. He served as owner, manager, and bartender of the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop in Point Ueda on the world Ueda during the High Republic Era but resisted customizing it due to a superstitious belief that it was haunted by Lomi…
Tor Bez'lin was a Shorwilt security expert who was arrested in the Corporate Sector during the High Republic Era and imprisoned on board the DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship Palwick.
Cord Taunus was a human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who administered the Jedi temple on the planet Olega during the High Republic Era.

A Gamorrean male served as a guard that worked at Jabba's palace. After the Khetanna was destroyed and Jabba was killed, he was one of the few survivors that found Bib Fortuna in the desert and revived hím.

Od Keder was a Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order who was stationed at the Jedi temple on the planet Olega during the High Republic Era. In 132 BBY, the assassin Mae-ho Aniseya broke in to the temple in a failed attempt to kill Jedi Master Torbin.
Melo Tolicus was a human miner who lived during the High Republic Era. After suffering space psychosis, he killed several fellow miners and was taken prisoner.
Syreth Dunn was a human slicer. In 132 BBY, Dunn and his crew were detained by the Detention Task Force in the Corporate Sector and were being transported on the prison transport Palwick.

Rott Mercer was a cybernetic alien convict who was present on the Palwick, a prison transport, during the High Republic Era. During an escape attempt, the convict managed to disable the pilot droids who controlled the ship.
Kella Antro was a human salt trader from a coastal town. She supported her aging parents by delivering seasoning minerals to the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop on the world Ueda.
Deesh Crozli was a black-skinned alien who left her homeworld and ended up on the planet Ueda, where she kept her ear to the ground for information to trade.
Chit-Chit, also know as Chif-Chaf, was a krinnan male from Kindosorn who was adopted by Terec.
Dennet Clyde was the leader of the Hammers, a criminal organization on Thorum. He was killed by a bomb set by Crimson Dawn after it was determined his syndicate was intruding on Crimson Dawn space.
Meevid was a human scavenger who lived during the High Republic Era. In 132 BBY, Meevid hiked through a forest on the Outer Rim planet Khofar along with the scavenger Manju.

Manju was a human scavenger who lived during the High Republic Era. In 132 BBY, Manju hiked through a forest on the Outer Rim planet Khofar with the scavenger Meevid. When they came across a crashed starship, Manju hoped to find a hyperdrive to strip for parts within it.
Mister X was a mysterious individual who ran a smuggling network in Echo Base. He always acted through droid intermediaries.

Andrew Thomas "Dirty" Cohnely was a human male. Cohnely used to work for the Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations where his impeccable service allowed him to rapidly rise through the ranks, even earning him an Imperial Medal of Honor.

A salmaca creature lived in a cave on the world Batuu. Around 379 BBY, the salmaca began raiding homes in Peka, a nearby village. The raids continued for several weeks, and during one raid, the salmaca killed the villager Tuntis, who had tried to fight back.

A female individual was the grandmother of the Serennian Lady Jenza of House Serenno, who was the daughter of Count Gora and Countess Anya of the planet Serenno and sister of Ramil. Jenza owned a crystal that had previously belonged to her grandmother.

A clone trooper lieutenant of the 55th Mechanized Brigade acted as the camp commander of the Pols Anaxes Republic Detention Center around 19 BBY, after getting an injury that that made him walk stiffly.

A human male was an agent for the New Republic's intelligence branch. In 4 ABY, he was sent to the planet Vernid after intelligence personnel working for agent Caern Adan found a lead on the former Imperial Major Soran Keize.
A human female was an agent for the New Republic's intelligence branch. In 4 ABY, she went to the planet Vernid after a lead was found on the former Imperial Major Soran Keize.
During the High Republic Era, a Neimoidian was ppresent on the space station Starlight Beacon. While there, he helped the Soikan Velko Jahen hang numerous tapestries and banners around the station.
Aila Gris was an individual who served as Adjutant Captain during the High Republic Era. During the assault on Qunatos during the Soikan conflict, Gris was killed by a blaster bolt.
Kirba, the Forgotten, was a mutated Gormak residing in the Shrine of Silence on Voss.
A humanoid male Mandalorian was a member of a Mandalorian covert that existed in the galaxy in 9 ABY.

Errin was an old male individual who worked for Jabba's criminal empire. Prior to joining Jabba's forces, Errin workeed for the Hutt Cartel. He was saved Sion from the Black Sun, and gave him a job in Jabba's palace.
Arfit was a male individual who worked for Jabba's criminal empire. He was one of the guard in Jabba's Palace during 4 ABY.
Nackt was a male individual who worked for Jabba's criminal empire. He was one of the guard in Jabba's Palace during 4 ABY.
A village chief served as chief of Meevai Village on the Outer Rim planet of Keelia. He had a granddaughter, Haru, who was set to marry a man named Asu.

Quint Cresadde was a Weequay gunslinger who lived during the Imperial Era. A former pirate member of the Ohnaka Gang and Gwarm's gang who later worked for the Hutt Clan, she eventually turned away from her lifestyle to become the sheriff of Wayfar on the planet Tatooine.
Aviay was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. After the Guardian Protocols were implemented in 229 BBY, he partnered with the Cathar Jedi Knight Far Linghe.

Far Linghe was a non-binary Cathar Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. According to Jedi Master Avar Kriss, they were well-liked, and Kriss knew them by a reputation which centered on strong piloting and dedication.

A human male was a member of the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the man served aboard the Gaze Electric—flagship of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro—when the Gaze traveled to the fifth moon of the Outer Rim planet Norisyn so Ro could investig…

Bas Ear'lasr was a Nihil pirate who served on the Gaze Electric, the flagship of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro during the High Republic Era. They fed a three-legged tooka within a hangar on the Gaze which eventually came to Ro's attention.

Isrie Fallau was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, a team of Jedi led by Jedi Master Avar Kriss helped to liberate the Mid Rim planet Naboo from the Nihil pirates.
Limal Pakt was a Dyplotid metalsmith who operated a shop in the Federal District on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. She had four narrow golden eyes.
Ba'luun was a Thisspiasian individual who served as a captain in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, she commanded the Star Cruiser Axiom.
Mitker was an individual who served as a captain in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era.
Krivlid was a Nihil pirate who served as part of General Abediah Viess' Ministry of Protection during the High Republic Era.

Dotdat San was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, San was part of a Jedi team who carried out an assault on the Mid Rim planet Naboo in order to liberate it from Nihil occupation.

Ceryl was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, she piloted a Jedi Vector as part of a Jedi team who carried out an assault on the Mid Rim planet Naboo in order to liberate it from Nihil rule.

At least two individuals were the parents of the Force-sensitive human male Elzar Mann. Because their son was Force-sensitive, they sent him to be trained as a Jedi at the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. By 228 BBY, Mann had risen to the rank of Jedi Master.
Jayd was a Kexing who served as an aide of the Nihil Minister of Information Ghirra Starros. Starros considered Jayd to be her best aide.
Ilpatr'ii was an individual who served as a senator of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era.

Striland Gryl was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the Jedi and Republic Defense Coalition destroyed the Nihil Lightning Crash, a space station which house a crystal array that powered the Nihil's Stormwall barrier.

Friielan was a half Theelin non-binary individual who lived during the High Republic Era. They lost their immediate family when the Nihil pirates attacked the Republic Fair on the Outer Rim planet Valo in 231 BBY, and it caused them to develop a warm but sharply focused demeanor.

Shon Felspix was a human Nihil who served as a bodyguard for Minister of Information Ghirra Starros during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, he was present in a cloudscaper on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant that Ghirra had purchased the top ten levels of.

Elisa was an Alderaanian female who served as the third aide of Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh during the High Republic Era. According to Soh, the woman's family had served as senators and aides for generations.
Flik-Lant was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He was stationed at the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, where he worked as the Temple's metalsmith.

Ilsan Kowal was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, he took part in a series of missions carried out by the Jedi and Republic Defense Coalition to cross the Nihil pirates' Stormwall hyperspace barrier using the Sunvale device to rescue ref…

Tearlin was an individual who served as a captain in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era.
Tenedra was a Tholothian female who served as a pilot in the Republic Defense Coalition as a member of Blue Squadron during the High Republic Era.
An individual who lived during the High Republic Era served in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic and was known to Ghirra Starros, a senator who represented the Core Worlds' Hosnian system.
An individual lived during the High Republic Era and served in the Galactic Republic's Defense Coalition.

A female individual served as queen of the Mid Rim planet Naboo, her homeworld, during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, Naboo was brought into the Nihil marauders' Occlusion Zone region of space after the Nihil leader Marchion Ro expanded the Stormwall hyperspace barrier.
An individual served as part of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro's She'ar—elite bodyguards loyal to Ro—during the High Republic Era.
An individual from the Mid Rim planet Naboo lived during the High Republic Era. By 228 BBY, he served as senator of his homeworld in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic.
A three-legged tooka was fed by the Nihil pirate Bas Ear'lasr on the Nihil flagship Gaze Electric during the High Republic Era.
During the High Republic Era, a human Nihil sent out a message to Senator Ghirra Starros which told the senator to disable cameras in the space station Starlight Beacon.
Bram Shano was a Zabrak bartender during the Imperial Era. After retiring from fathier racing, Shano established The Broken Hoof bar in Canto Bight.

Vok'ta was a member of the Hutt Clan and was one of their best shots. Hutt Clan boss Urda Tarr wanted Vok'ta to get replaced, but the former pirate Quint, the Hutt's best option, became a sheriff instead.

An individual served as a Jedi hunter for the Sith sometime after 35 ABY. The individual was tasked with hunting and capturing sabersmith Lah Zhima. After capturing him, this individual pursued the sabersmith's daughter, Lah Kara.

Bee-Toh served as a Jedi hunter for the Sith sometime after 35 ABY. The individual was tasked with hunting and capturing sabersmith Lah Zhima. After capturing him, the individual ordered their partner to pursue the sabersmith's daughter, Lah Kara.
Naasa was a Jumurra female who was a witch elder, augur, and advisor within Mother Aniseya's coven on its adopted homeworld Brendok during the High Republic Era.
Sarria was a humanoid female witch who served as a scout and warrior in the coven of Mother Aniseya on the planet Brendok during the High Republic Era.

A female member of the Greylark family lived during the High Republic Era. They were one of the aunts of the human girl Zenny Greylark, who had an older sister named Lexi. At one point, according to Zenny, it took the aunt seventeen minutes to answer a yes-or-no question.

Jinnjo Blorgh was a Pyke criminal who served under the Pyke Syndicate on the moon Toshara and, after his defection in 3 ABY, the Hutt Cartel on the planet Tatooine.

Cynra Basho was a Rutian Twi'lek merchant who operated a fabric shop in the Worker's District of the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. During the Canto Cup fathier race in the city in 3 ABY, Basho opened the store and had a vial of bacta available for purchase.
Cay Teenu was a Nautolan Jedi who settled in the Copero Villa on Copero during the third Galactic War. Teenu trained the Nautolan Padawan Yshal until he was banished from the Jedi Order.
Yshal was a Nautolan who lived during the third Galactic War. A former Jedi Padawan, Yshal was banished from the Jedi Order and forged a new path on Nar Shaddaa.

Entip was a Jawa trader who resided on the planet Tatooine and traveled in a sandcrawler. In 3 ABY the Jawa exchanged a power injector system and a BT-P7 ion accelerator with the thief Kay Vess in return for various parts and credits.
Tak'Tak Tandishek was a Jawa merchant who operated near Scavenger's Draw in the Wonto District of the city of Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.
Nizuma Chith was a Jawa merchant who operated near Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the Wonto District of the city of Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.
Jet Kordo was an Ugnaught pilot who formerly owned the Trailblazer.Associated with a droid named H1-ON.

Gedeek Obaz, also known as The Toymaker, was a male Rodian droidsmith who was raised in Canto Bight's Worker's District. A former Imperial Engineer, he designed an Alpha Droid variant of the Viper Probe Droid.
Banzo was the name given by the Jedi youngling Tep Tep to a tortle that she utilized while undertaking a mission on the Arkanis sector planet Palagosal.

Franek was an individual who served as a lieutenant in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. He had a husband. At one point, Franek served in a squad led by the Greylark family member Lexi Greylark.
A male individual who lived during the High Republic Era was the husband of Republic Defense Coalition Lieutenant Franek.

Juna Helos was a female Twi'lek who settled in the Copero Villa on Copero during the third Galactic War. Around 3623 BBY, Helos asked the Alliance Commander to retrieve relics from the Massassi on Yavin 4.
Gregmu'ur, known as Gregmu for short, was a Quermian who served as marshal of the town Faydra on the Outer Rim planet Mynos III during the High Republic Era.
Lorko was a Hutt of the Hutt Clan who was the cousin of the Hutt male Churo
Yorn was a Twi'lek bandit hiding on the planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.

Jonkah Rremset was a Mon Calamari merchant who worked from a stall in Mirogana Market on the moon Toshara. They specialized in consumables but sold a variety of items. In 3 ABY, the thief Kay Vess aided Rremset when two Imperial stormtroopers tried to extort the merchant.

Tanhi was a human gambler on the moon Toshara during 3 ABY. They played Kessel Sabacc with the human Daqu and the Rodian Razafi in Mirogana, the capital city of Toshara. Tanhi had light skin, blue eyes and black hair.

Daqu was a human gambler who, during 3 ABY, played Kessel Sabacc with the Rodian Razafi and the human Tanhi in Mirogana, the capital city of Toshara. They claimed to have played sabacc with the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure, who according to Daqu played fairly.
Roba Barev was a Pyke contract broker for the criminal Pyke Syndicate, only providing work to those on good terms with the organization.
Jora Margal was a Pyke scavenger who worked as a merchant for the criminal Pyke Syndicate from a stall in the Pyke Cardroom of the Pyke District in the city of Mirogana on the moon Toshara.

Rooster Trace was a human female mercenary who was active in the years before and during the Galactic Civil War. By 3 ABY, her ship had been destroyed by the Galactic Empire, who confiscated her weapons. Her pet skettlebeast, Thumpo, died with the ship.

Nor'sha Nassko was a Weequay who worked as a contract broker for the Hutt Cartel in the city of Myrra on the planet Akiva. In 3 ABY, Nassko was in the Hutt Cartel District of the city providing contracts only to those on good terms with the Hutts.

Shuma was a Quarren merchant who has been to many star systems. By 3 ABY, the Quarren had visited 117 star systems, including visiting the Outer Rim moon of Toshara and the planet Kijimi. While traveling, they were accompanied by two astromech droids.

Otip Ashtep was a human scavenger who sold goods as a merchant from a corner of the junkyard in Bestine, a small city on the desert planet Tatooine.
Winsub Mari was a human speeder mechanic who worked on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. During which they operated a stall in the city Bestine located in Tatooine's Desert Valley.

Sopa Nandor was an Ualaq Aqualish merchant who operated out of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the city Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. That year, their inventory included direct-energy circuits, quadanium steel, and a Tatooine gunslinger belt.

Raivan Dhavik was a human contract broker who resided on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY During which they offered contracts for various criminal syndicates to freelancers from Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the city of Mos Eisley on Tatooine.

Nibbles was an individual that competed in fights that could be viewed from the Outer Rim planet Tatooine. By 3 ABY, Nibbles had been torn in half while fighting against another contestant named Rock-Claw.
