Raiva Melin was a humanoid merchant who resided on the Mid Rim planet Kijimi in 3 ABY. During which they operated a store in Ridge Terrace section of Kijimi City.
A farmer from the planet Mon Gazza visited the Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.

Kranash was a Trandoshan contract broker with brown skin and yellow eyes who was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. By 10 BBY, he had become well known in the criminal underworld after being involved in a job for the Black Sun crime syndicate on the planet Manaan.

Selik Mynnabah was a Zabrak merchant that operated a store called Selik's in the Thieves' Quarter of Kijimi City on the Mid Rim planet Kijimi. By 3 ABY, they had begun selling amulets secretly containing spice from Selik's to repay a load they took from the Pyke Syndicate.

Neva Yaranu was a human smuggler and merchant who resided on the planet Kijimi in 3 ABY. They ran a store in the Crimson Dawn District of Kijimi City. Yaranu had dark skin, black short hair and brown eyes.

Whaluta Skanni was a Quarren who worked as a contract broker in the town Jaunta's Hope on the moon Toshara.

Trellem Hobarchi was a human who worked as a speeder mechanic and scavenger out of a garage in the town of Jaunta's Hope on the moon Toshara. Hobarchi sold speeder parts, also using provided materials to upgrade speeders, and was capable of upgrading a S-57 Cardinal speeder bike.

Sona Plondu was an Ualaq Aqualish contract broker who operated out of the Bestine Cantina in the city Bestine the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.

Clemah Mudoo was a Sullustan who worked as contract broker for the Hutt Cartel crime syndicate in 3 ABY.

Turgus was a dewback on the planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. He was considered a loving animal by his owner, and would lick the sweat from people's hands if allowed.
Yesula was a child who lived on the Outer Rim astronomical object Veek with her father and their droid, Zeekay, during the High Republic Era.
A male individual of a non-human species was the father of the child Yesula. At a point no earlier than 227 BBY, their home on the astronomical object Veek caught fire.

A female individual was the mother of the child Yesula, a member of a non-human species. By around 149 BBY, the mother died. After her death, between 227 BBY and 149 BBY, the home of Yesula and her father caught on fire.

Slem Slonini was a crime lord who led the Slonini Cartel. By 3 ABY, they had been assassinated by the bounty hunter Vail Tormin, which led to the cartel's collapse. As a result, Tormin's value increased by almost 350%.

Jaffrey Knoice was a male Pantoran that lived on the planet Aricho during the High Republic Era. After Aricho was sucked into the Occlusion Zone by the Nihil, Knoice worked at a processing facility on Aricho as a mechanic for the pirates.
Selli was a human child that lived on Arli's moon during the High Republic Era. After hearing the sounds of the minicruiser Brightbird, Selli hid from the individuals who piloted the cruiser.

An Elomin child lived on the astronomical object Vianax during the High Republic Era. After a skirmish there in 229 BBY, they were among a group of children who watched the Wookiee Jedi Master Kelnacca help with repairs.

A human child lived on the astronomical object Vianax during the High Republic Era. After a skirmish there in 229 BBY, they were part of a group of children who watched the Wookiee Jedi Master Kelnacca help with repairs.

Pak Relda was a Mirialan with purple skin who lived in Black Spire Outpost during the High Republic Era. She bullied a younger human girl named Sadie Bolter, who decided to steal Jedi Initiate Lys Solay's lightsaber in order to stand up to Relda.
A human female was a member of the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era as a part of the a crew on the planet Daedus.
Mitzy was a Hutt lounge singer who was famous on the Hutt Space planet Nal Hutta during the High Republic Era. By 228 BBY, Republic Defense Coalition ensign Welga witnessed a performance of Mitzy.

Urda Tarr was a Twi'lek male who served the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure as an underboss in his criminal empire. He formerly worked with Quint Cresadde, until they parted ways after the Weequay took what she felt was owed to her.

A humanoid individual worked as a skin-scribe during the High Republic Era. By 230 BBY, Jedi Padawan Yarzion Vell—a member of the same species—returned to his homeworld and decided to follow the planet's tradition of being tattooed with the name of one's greatest teacher.
Mig Dryko was a gunslinger who operated on the desert planet Tatooine. He was one of the best blaster hands that the retired mercenary Shepp knew, but had died by 3 ABY.

Shepp was a human who lived in the city of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine and visited Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina there in 3 ABY. While Shepp was at the cantina, the thief Kay Vess approached her and asked who the best gunslinger in the area was.
Freery was a Bith who lived on the planet Arli during the High Republic Era while the planet was trapped within the Occlusion Zone.

Jerchom was an individual who held the title of magistrate while on the planet Seswenna. During the High Republic Era, Jerchom was controlled by the Nihil and allowed them to operate out of Seswenna City.
Vaneer was an individual who served as an admiral in the officer corps of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy.

Kolimaag was a Pantoran gambler on the planet Kijimi during 3 ABY, They frequently played Kessel Sabacc with the Melitto Mehdo the human Arro in Domak Refectory in Kijimi city. Kolimaag had blue skin, white hair and black eyes.
Mehdo was a Melitto gambler. In 3 ABY, Mehdo frequently played Kessel Sabacc against the Pantoran Kolimaag and the human Arro in the Domak Refectory in Kijimi city, on the planet Kijimi.
Badru was a gangster and member of the Sullustan Surat Nuat's gang, which operated during the Imperial Era on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva.

Botto Fna was a news presenter for Holonet News Toshara, a broadcast of the HoloNet News on the Outer Rim moon Toshara during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Fna reported on the weather from the Mirogana Meteo-Tower in the moon's capital city of Mirogana.
Kotera Braal was a presenter for Holonet News Toshara, a HoloNet News segment broadcast on the moon Toshara.
A human female records clerk worked at the Royal Archives on the planet Naboo prior to the rise of the Galactic Empire.
Mayiu was a Melitto contract broker of the Ashiga Clan who operated on the planet Kijimi in 3 ABY. They hired the scoundrel Kay Vess to retrieve a Crimson Dawn archive.
Tizlak Sharr was a Pyke male member of the Pyke Syndicate who served as an advisor to the underboss Gorak Palas in the city of Mirogana on the moon Toshara.

Linh was a female human Jedi Initiate who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. She was part of a group of new Jedi younglings including Bren and Zotti who were brought to the Tenoo Jedi Temple from the Coruscant Jedi Temple.

Zotti was a Rodian Jedi Initiate who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He was part of a group of new Jedi younglings including Bren and Linh who were brought to the Tenoo Jedi Temple from the Coruscant Jedi Temple.
Slabrac Sonosti was a food critic who worked for HoloNet News. In 3 ABY, they reported on the Taste of Jinata Festival in Kestro City on the planet Vardos in the Jinata system.

Mav Gatta was a citizen who was born around 10 BBY. By the age of thirteen, she lived in a Verinti homestead and had watched the holodrama Troops. In 3 ABY, Gatta used survival skills she had learned from the drama in order to save her homestead from raiders.
Qi'us Dnar was a Togruta female living during the third Galactic War.

Phenesta Wesh was a senator in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic who, after leaving the Senate, wrote a tell-all autobiography about his career titled Turmoil which he released during the reign of the Republic's successor state, the Galactic Empire, in 3 ABY.
Eve Byre was a human female who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. After the death of her first Padawan, Zaph Mora, she took on another Padawan, Cam Lindon.
Sicarus was a human male Nihil Child of the Storm under Baron Boolan during the High Republic Era.

Traven was a Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. During the Eternal Empire conquest Traven served in the Eternal Empire military under the command of Captain Koth Vortena and was eventually killed by an explosive on Hoth.

Jorul was a Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. During the Eternal Empire conquest Jorul served in the Eternal Empire military under the command of Captain Koth Vortena and was eventually killed by a walker on Dantooine.

Frel was a Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. During the Eternal Empire conquest Frel served in the Eternal Empire military under the command of Captain Koth Vortena and was eventually killed by an infection on Quesh.

A staffer worked in the Jedi Temple during the year 33 BBY. When the Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi returned from the Ord Jannak Jedi outpost with several effects, the staffer assisted Jedi Master Eeth Koth in documenting the items brought back to the Jedi Temple on the …
A female individual was the wife of the Pantoran male Jaffrey Knoice during the High Republic Era.

A smuggler worked for the Black Sun on Ord Mantell during the third Galactic War. Around 3624 BBY, the smuggler captured the Mantellian Trooper Jendan Blyes and was ultimately stopped by the Alliance Commander of the Eternal Alliance.
Onjo Rhask was a quad racer from the planet Tepasi who participated in the Carida Grand Prix in 3 ABY.

A Kerkoiden served the Nihil as a pirate during the High Republic Era. While on the planet Naboo within the Occlusion Zone, the Kerkoiden and a Twi'lek pirate awaited the arrival of the human musician Cair San Tekka to escort him to the Mirialan general Abediah Viess.

A Twi'lek served the Nihil as a pirate during the High Republic Era. While on the planet Naboo within the Occlusion Zone, the Twi'lek and a Kerkoiden pirate awaited the arrival of the human musician Cair San Tekka to escort him to the Mirialan general Abediah Viess.

A Ho'Din worked as a specialist and a scientist by the year 228 BBY. The Ho'Din created files in relation to the planet Oanne, which the Jedi Knight Burryaga Agaburry researched upon before traveling to the planet.

Wuna Geenic was a former senator who was arrested on the planet Coruscant in 3 ABY for high treason against the Galactic Empire after financial ties were discovered between Geenic and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Umbral was a Force-sensitive Twi'lek male living during the third Galactic War. At some point, Umbral established a cult known as the Master's Top Secret Army to create a dark side army, having been rejected by both the Jedi and the Sith.
Sadie Bolter was a human girl with fair skin and orange hair who lived in Black Spire Outpost during the High Republic Era. She was bullied by an older Mirialan named Pak Relda.

Soonel was an admiral in the officer corps of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy. In 3 ABY, they levied additional sanctions against Karoon following a new investigation of anti-Imperial activities, further limiting access to fuel for terrorists and radicals.
Sparda was a lieutenant within the Galactic Empire's Imperial Officer Corps that led an operation to rescue over forty Imperial service members.

Yuan Howzell was a human Arch-Mage who led a group within the Acolytes of the Beyond during the Galactic Civil War. At one point, the Acolyte member Yupe Tashu planned to send Howzell and her group to Pillio to confront the Jedi Luke Skywalker.
A boy born around 5 BBY organized a fundraiser for a new orbital cannon on the Outer Rim Territories planet Takobo at the age of eight in 3 ABY.
Galdrim was an Altiri who resided on the planet Temerancé during the High Republic Era and had multiple children, including the Force-sensitive Lene Kostana, their oldest daughter.
An informant for the Alliance to Restore the Republic spent three years infiltrating the Galactic Empire's Imperial Bureau of Standards, beginning in 0 ABY during the Galactic Civil War.

A humanoid individual served as a member in a Cloud for the Nihil during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the Cloud partook in the abduction of multiple Force-sensitive children on the planet Temerancé, which led the inhabitants to request the Tholothian monster hunter Ty Yo…
A humanoid individual served as a member of a Cloud for the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era.
A Imperial envoy of the Galactic Empire was the target of a planned attack by a rebel insurgency group on the Mid Rim astronomical object Genassa during the Galactic Civil War.

A Force-sensitive blue-skinned alien served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order. They wielded a single-bladed lightsaber with a blue kyber crystal. Sometime by 19 BBY, they trained a Jedi, who was later known as the Fifth Brother, on the planet Coruscant.

Lendha Drefty was an Iridonian Zabrak who worked as a ship mechanic. In 3 ABY, Drefty operated a business called Tosharan Ships which bought, sold and upgraded starships on Renpalli Station in the Toshaal system. They had light skin and hazel eyes.

Hen Puon was a human merchant who operated a general store during the Imperial Era in the Pyke market within Mirogana, the capital city of the Outer Rim moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, they unknowingly distributed counterfeit credits for the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate.

Brutus was a Shistavanen male pirate captain active during the New Republic Era. He was originally the First Mate of the crew led by Captain Silvo, although the pirates fell on hard times under Silvo's leadership.
Belo Roovin was a Pantoran who worked as a armorer and owned Belo Pawn Spot in the city of Mirogana on the moon Toshara in 3 ABY. That year, Roovin sold an ion casing to the thief Kay Vess.

Lalini Ledeno was a Twi'lek who worked as a smuggler and merchant on the Outer Rim moon Toshara during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, he worked with the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate and operated a black market stall in Mirogana, the capital city of Toshara.

Berek Keehro was a human tailor that worked at a clothing store called Sirei's Stall on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. During which they were associated with the Pyke Syndicate and was willing to pass information along to them.

Valith Nuulvys was a Mirialan mechanic who operated Valith Nuulvys's Goods and Services at Mirogana Spaceport Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. That year, they were capable of upgrading a S-57 Cardinal speeder bike when they had access to the appropriate materials.

Gunter was a male, human cyborg who belonged to a pirate crew during the New Republic Era. Originally serving under Captain Silvo, he swore his loyalty to the new leader, Brutus, in the aftermath of a failed raid on a merchant freighter, ascending to the position of First Mate.

Chaelt was an elderly human space pirate who served under Captain Silvo and Captain Brutus during the New Republic Era.

Jadd Flaxum was a Quarren male spy who worked for the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era. He was the partner of the Crimson Dawn contract broker Dart Subterra, residing on the planet Kijimi.

Dart Subterra was a human male who worked as a contract broker for the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate on the planet Kijimi during the Imperial Era. He was the boyfriend of Jadd Flaxum, a spy who also worked for Crimson Dawn.
Procyon Wy was a Pantoran female pirate leader active during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, she captured the Crimson Dawn spy Jadd Flaxum, intending to ransom him to the Pyke Syndicate.
Soren Chrephontis was a Pyke contract broker for the Pyke Syndicate criminal organisation during the Imperial Era. He operated in the city of Myrra on the planet Akiva.
Karpen Miltik was a Pyke merchant who operated a stall in the city of Myrra on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY.

Yarg'l was a Rodian who served as a Senate Intelligence Officer for the Galactic Republic. After they were captured by the Pyke Syndicate on Black Rock, a mission to the moon was conducted by the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to free him.

Scalesong was a female Trandoshan who served as a captain for the Galactic Republic. While conducting a mission alongside the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to rescue the Senate Intelligence Officer Yarg'l on one of the moons of Varl, Scalesong was consumed by Kayfou…

Torrick was a human Corellian who served as the second mate to Captain Scalesong on the Silence. While conducting a mission alongside the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to rescue the Senate Intelligence Officer Yarg'l on one of the moons of Varl, Torrick was consumed…
EE'zok was a human member of the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate who worked as a contract broker in the city of Bestine on the planet Tatooine during the Imperial Era.

Ays Varga was a human superweapons engineer who served the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Varga defected from the Empire, intending to join the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate through the contract broker EE'zok on the planet Tatooine.

Dim was an Aleena podracer that raced in the galaxy during the Republic Era. The Aleena podracer had a rivalry with the Blarina Barba. While racing on the Varl Circuit in 29 BBY, Dim was fatally shot by Barba which ended their feuding.

An Ugnaught worked as a podracer in the galaxy during the Republic Era. While racing in the Varl Circuit, the Ugnaught racer crashed after her podracer collided with another contestants vehicle, which ultimately killed both of them in the ensuing explosion.

A Gran worked as a podracer in the galaxy during the Republic Era. While racing in the Varl Circuit, the Gran racer crashed after a Bantha tusk decoration on his podracer fell off and went into the engine of the vehicle, causing it to explode.

A Fosh worked as a podracer in the galaxy during the Republic Era. After completing in one of the final places while racing in the Varl Circuit, the Fosh podracer and a Xexto were dragged away by enforcers and subsequently fed to the Kayfoundo Kapa that resided on Black Rock.

A Xexto worked as a podracer in the galaxy during the Republic Era. After completing in one of the final places while racing in the Varl Circuit, the Xexto podracer and a Fosh were dragged away by enforcers and subsequently fed to the Kayfoundo Kapa that resided on Black Rock.

A Squib worked as a podracer in the galaxy during the Republic Era. After completing in last place while racing on the second day in the Varl Circuit, the Squib podracer was dragged away by enforcers and subsequently fed to the Kayfoundo Kapa that resided on Black Rock.

Romtok was an Ithorian who worked as a salvage tow captain while on the moon Black Rock. After being confronted by a battle droid who wanted a datadisc from them, Romtok swallowed the disc so the droid would not obtain it.
A Force-sensitive man served the Galactic Empire as an Inquisitor, though he was once a Jedi of the Jedi Order.
Razze Colbra was a male Twi'lek. He was the leader of Clan Colbra
A human enslaver operated a moisture farm on the desert planet Tatooine using enslaved workers including Amee, Melee, and Seek.

A human thief operated on the planet Tatooine between 3 ABY and 4 ABY. With two accomplices, they killed a vendor for an energy capsule and then sought out the pair who had sold it to him, Kitster Banai and Wald.

Hudi was a Twi'lek scrapper who owned a mechanic's store called Hudi's Depot on the planet Yarrum during the High Republic Era. They had a GNK-series power droid named DV. Hudi had a testy relationship with the pirate Clave Rollek, who had a reputation for dishonesty.
Kote Medrit was a female Human Mandalorian shock trooper who was present on Ruhnuk during the Third Galactic War.
Zaph Mora was a Zeltron male Jedi who was the Padawan of Jedi Master Eve Byre during the High Republic Era. A quiet but confident and considerate individual, Mora appreciated everything around him.

Pola Sheel was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
A humanoid individual was a member of the Nihil marauders. In 229 BBY, they were stationed at a base on the moon Astenban that the Nihil had recently occupied.

A human was a member of the Nihil marauders. In 229 BBY, they were part of a group of Nihil who attacked the planet Banchii under the command of Nihil scientist Niv Drendow Apruk, who wanted to capture Drengir, Force-sensitive sentient plants, to use in experiments.
Carticus was an individual who tutored Sicarus during his time as a member of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door dark side organization.

A Fosh was a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. By 228 BBY, they were elderly. Sicarus, a Nihil Child of the Storm who had once been a member of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door dark side organization, had pulled out the birdlike Fosh's organs.

A human individual was a member of the Nihil marauders and was stationed at a base on the moon Astenban in 228 BBY. After complaining there was nothing to eat on Astenban, the Nihil spotted the Banchiian Shosho, who was performing reconnaissance on the moon.

Zade Winstone was a musician who had performed the song "Warm Jungle, Cold Heart" by 3 ABY. The song's cover art featured Winstone's name written prominently in Aurebesh above a member of the Quarren species.

A humanoid individual was a member of the Nihil marauders. In 229 BBY, they were stationed at a base on the moon Astenban that the Nihil had recently occupied. On the moon, another Nihil complained to them that there was nothing to eat there.

Shukko was a musician who had performed the song "Nightmares and Daydreams" by 3 ABY. That year, their song "Nightmares and Daydreams" could be selected on jukeboxes in the Outer Rim's Toshaal system.
Uvi Yessira was a musician who performed the song "Wings of Time." By 3 ABY, "Wings of Time" could be selected from the jukebox at the Domak Refectory on the Mid Rim planet Kijimi.
Ashton Vol was a female mercenary active during the High Republic Era who worked alongside the combat droid L-77.

Dorian Innes was a trans male medical officer in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. He was assigned on a Republic and Jedi Order mission to the planet Angoth to capture one of the Nameless creatures from the Nihil marauders.
Peleg Ryn was a Force-sensitive Noghri who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Remla Moonis was a Weequay musician. During 3 ABY, he was the drummer for the band Skungy Gungus and the Refractors.
Jenneh Ley was a Force-sensitive human female who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Inith Lowera was a Force-sensitive Pantoran female who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Rynn Zenat was a human female pilot and officer for the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later its successor, the New Republic.

Preeti Delmin was a human pilot of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Following the Battle of Endor, Preeti and Rynn Zenat fought against Imperial TIE fighters in the Anoat sector.
Threeka was a Tholothian female member of the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era. She was stationed at the Nihil base on the planet Angoth.

Skungy Gungus was a musician and member of the band Skungy Gungus and the Refractors By 3 ABY, the Refractors had performed the songs "If These Sands Could Speak" and "Look Up!" which could be selected from the jukebox at the Bestine Cantina on the desert planet Tatooine and f…

Ju'syl was a human gambler on the planet Kijimi during 3 ABY. They played Kessel Sabacc with the human Avrar and the human Torai in the Crimson Dawn District cardroom in Kijimi City. Ju'syl had light skin, brown eyes, and brown hair.

Avrar was a human gambler and member of the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate in 3 ABY. During which Avrar was also a contract for the rebel scoundrel Lando Calrissian who provided him intellinance collected by the Dawn.

Torai was a human gambler on the planet Kijimi during 3 ABY. They played Kessel Sabacc with the humans Ju'syl and Avrar in the Crimson Dawn District cardroom in Kijimi City. Torai had dark skin, brown eyes, and black hair.

An agent worked for the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau during the Imperial Era. At some point by 3 ABY, while on the planet Vassek, the viper probe droid Viper 058-V-2353 learned of the local farmer Roni's plans to steal Imperial generators.
Atsuko was a human member of the Rakanal Run Prize Committee. They contacted Darth Vader after he won the Rakanal Run and didn't claim his prize.

Ghost Leader was a clone trooper pilot who served as leader of the Galactic Republic's Ghost Squadron. During a mission to escort Senator Kharrus to the planet Kinyen, they were attacked by vulture droids, forcing Ghost Squadron to defend the senator.

Green Five was a clone trooper pilot who served in Ghost Squadron. They served under the command of Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi and clone pilot Ghost Leader during an escort mission to the planet Kinyen.
A merchant claiming to sell serums, tonics, and miracle cures operated a stall in the Wonto District market in the city of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.
A black market merchant affiliated with the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate was active during the Imperial Era.
Blue Leader was a clone trooper pilot who served as leader of Star Squadron.

Jurk was a Trandoshan gambler had brown skin and yellow eyes who resided on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. During which they played sabacc at an invite only sabacc parlor in the town Wayfar which was run by the town's sheriff, a Weequay named Quint Cresadde.
"Blue Five" was a clone trooper pilot who served in Star Squadron.
Kyt Borksmit was a human Jedi apprentice born on Corellia, who trained under the Arcona Jedi Master Sammeh. She was a "mechanical genius".

Jihyo Parrk was a Mirialan female Jedi Master. Her ship crashed on planet Unnap and her lightsaber was hidden in a cave. Years later, in 3 ABY, Luke Skywalker found a map to the lightsaber and recovered it.

While roaming the deserts of Tatooine, the Tusken Raider foundling Taggor Bren encountered a woman who was wandering by herself. The woman spoke to Bren in his native language which he had forgotten after some time.
Maya Ranna was a female Jedi who served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Ubog Ozo was a Twi'lek farmer who lived during the Third Galactic War at the Blba Groves on the planet Dantooine.
Brrazz was a Jawa active during the Third Galactic War.
Ears was the nickname of a human volunteer of the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era.

Grampo was the nickname of a human volunteer of the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. He and nine other volunteers from the RDC were sent on a mission to the planet Angoth to capture a Nameless creature from the Nihil marauders.

Fires was the nickname of a human volunteer in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. They were one of ten RDC personnel who embarked on a Republic and Jedi Order mission to the planet Angoth in order to capture a Nameless creature from the Nihil marauders.

Lort was a Sullustan volunteer in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. The Sullustan participated in a mission to capture a Nameless creature from the Nihil marauders on the planet Angoth.

Redano was a Kiffar volunteer member in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. They were one of the RDC personnel who took part in a mission to capture a Nameless creature from the Nihil marauders on the planet Angoth.

Blish was an Ishi Tib volunteer member in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. They were one of ten RDC personnel who embarked on a Republic and Jedi Order mission to the planet Angoth to capture a Nameless creature from the Nihil marauders.
Mendi Dian was a Togruta female who served the Republic Strategic Information Service during the Third Galactic War. She investigated the Master's Top Secret Army.
Vec Vennec was a Nautolan male who served the Sith Intelligence of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Third Galactic War.
Bullgar was a hulking Dowutin member of the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, they were stationed at a base on the planet Angoth.

A male individual who lived during the High Republic Era was the sire of Sicarus, a Force-sensitive human male who was born on the Outer Rim planet Cerosha and grew up as part of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door sect.
A Gigoran bounty hunter lived during the High Republic Era. They once worked for the Hutt Devirsivik Clan, but betrayed them and spied for the Nihil marauders.

T'ra Saa was a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. They were an instructor to the Jedi Initiate Mace Windu. On one occasion, the young Windu had bested Saa in combat within the training grounds of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

Kith Alaytia was a human that operated as a spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, then the New Republic, within the Galactic Empire, serving as a lieutenant in the Imperial Security Bureau who worked under Grand Moff Ubrik Adelhard in the Anoat sector.

Vin-Vin Sunfall was a Metagosan bartender at Vin-Vin's Wheelhouse in the city of New Xaxxis on the planet Metagos. He encountered the undercover Jedi Master Mace Windu when the latter visited the bar during his mission to the planet.

A Zilka male enforcer worked for the gangster Chulok in the city New Xaxxis on the planet Metagos. Alongside a human and another Zilka, he encountered the undercover Jedi Master Mace Windu when he arrived on Metagos. The Zilka wielded a halberd.

A Zilka male enforcer worked for the gangster Chulok in the city New Xaxxis on the planet Metagos. Alongside another Zilka and a human, the enforcer met the undercover Jedi Master Mace Windu. The Zilka wielded a shock prod.
A human male enforcer worked for the gangster Chulok on the planet Metagos. Alongside two other Zilka enforcers, the human encountered the undercover Jedi Master Mace Windu. He wielded a shock prod.

Collins was an officer in the Galactic Empire who served under Ubrik Adelhard in the Anoat sector. Shortly prior to the Gassing of Anoat, Collins argued with another Imperial officer aboard the bridge of Adelhard's Imperial-class Star Destroyer on strategy.

During the Galactic Civil War, an individual served as a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. In 1 ABY, he and another stormtrooper were stationed on the planet Naboo, specifically at the personal retreat of Galactic Emperor Palpatine.

An individual served as a Galactic Empire stormtrooper during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, he and another stormtrooper were stationed at the personal retreat of Galactic Emperor Palpatine on the planet Naboo.
A Rodian lived during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the Rodian was present on the planet Oisin when the Nihil Jedi-hunting Child of the Storm Sicarus traveled to Oisin to hunt Jedi.
Brooks was a Dyplotid mayor of a nerf herding town on an astronomical object during the High Republic Era.
A humanoid individual was part of a group of twenty thieves associated with a casino located on Mount Hakamori, a snowy mountain on an astronomical object.

A human was the leader of a group of twenty thieves who attempted to steal the astromech droid R5-D56 from the former Sith known as the Ronin. After threatening the Ronin and warning their people not to hit the droid, they ordered the thieves to open fire on him.

A Jedi served as master to the Padawan Onielle during the Republic Era. In 22 BBY, the two participated in the First Battle of Geonosis and, a few weeks later, Onielle was promoted to the rank of Jedi Knight.

A Neimoidian smuggler was present on the planet Dromund Kaas around 3643 BBY when a bounty hunter known as the Hunter attempted to steal the smuggler's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft docked in Docking Bay B-04 in the Dromund Kaas spaceport.
Breek Folla was a male Trandoshan leader of a pirate gang. He raided a droid village on Shihan and was later defeated by Din Djarin.
A male individual was the father of Dorian Innes, a trans male medical officer in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era.

Borthas Mitto was a human male who served in the Jedi Temple Guard of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He was posted outside the door to the cell of the former Jedi Azlin Rell in the lower levels of the Jedi Temple.

Aquesh was a Quarren gambler that resided on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY. That year, they played sabacc with the Rodian Fazlee at The Alcazar cantina in Akiva's capital city Myrra while wearing a blue outfit. Aquesh had orange skin, black eyes and spoke Huttese.

Fazlee was a Rodian gambler that resided on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY. During which they played Kessel Sabacc against a Quarren named Aquesh at The Alcazar cantina in Myrra, the capital city of Akiva. Fazlee had orange skin, black eyes and spoke Huttese.

Chalo was a human gambler with light skin, brown eyes, and brown hair that resided on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY. During which they played Sabacc at a cantina in the town of Sashin on Akiva.
Qeel was a Twi'lek gambler on the planet Akiva during 3 ABY. They frequently played Kessel Sabacc with the Sullustan Zoba and Lando Calrissian in Myrra. Qeel had green skin and orange eyes.

Zoba was a Sullustan gambler on the planet Akiva during 3 ABY. During that same year played Kessel Sabacc with the human Lando Calrissian and the Twi'lek Qeel in the city of Myrra. Zoba had tan skin and black eyes.
Aaila was a human female who lived in the settlement Haven on the astronomical object Cethis with her father, Mikal, during the High Republic Era.
Mikal was a male resident of the settlement Haven on the astronomical object Cethis during the High Republic Era. He was the father of the human girl Aaila.

Renaad was a male villager from the planet Vuundalla during the High Republic Era. He had a daughter named Mina. Renaad, Mina and their fellow villagers were subjects of King Pychor Vuundir and Queen Dafne Vuundir, who cared little for their subjects' welfare.
Tern Koyatta was a human male who served as a maintenance technician within the Galactic Empire, a regime which he loyally served.

Massobia was a Sullustan gambler that resided on the jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY. During which they played with a Pyke named Bletel and a Trandoshan named Khossk at a cardroom in the Pyke Syndicate district of Myrra, the capital city of Akiva.

Bletel was a Pyke gambler resided the jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY. During which they played Kessel Sabacc with a Sullustan named Massobia and a Trandoshan named Khossk at a cardroom in the Pyke Syndicate district of Myrra, the capital city of Akiva.

Khossk was a Trandoshan gambler that resided on the jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY. During which they played with a Pyke named Bletel and a Sullustan named Massobia at a cardroom in the Pyke Syndicate district of Myrra, the capital city of Akiva.

Arro was a human Kessel Sabacc gambler on the planet Kijimi. During 3 ABY, they frequently played against the Melitto Mehdo the Pantoran Kolimaag in Domak Refectory in Kijimi city. Arro had tan skin, brown hair and brown eyes.

Kufu was a human gambler on the planet Kijimi during 3 ABY. They frequently played Kessel Sabacc with the Sullustan Fepo near Kijimiko Square in Kijimi city. Kufu had tan skin, brown hair and brown eyes.

Heren Gallack was a human who worked as contract broker offering jobs for various crime syndicates in 3 ABY. During which they operated from a cantina in the village of Sashin on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva. They had light skin, brown hair and brown eyes.
A Twi'lek fortune teller operated from Sashin village on the jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY.

Messpiin was a Pantoran gambler who resided on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. That year, they played Sabacc with the Rodian Nojamill in the cantina in Bestine, a city in Tatooine's Desert Valley.

Balinta was an Eriadu veermok befriended by Sevran Tarkin, a member of the Tarkin family of Eriadu during the High Republic Era.

Sato Bizaz was a Twi'lek tailor with green skin and blue eyes who resided on the planet Tatooine and worked with the Hutt Cartel in 3 ABY. During which they operated a shop called Bizaz across from the Ubrikkian Trade Tower Wonto District of the city Mos Eisley.

Kara Kiloka was a human starship mechanic who resided on the planet Tatooine. During the Imperial Era, they operated a shop called Kara's in the Scavenger's Draw area of Mos Eisley, a city and spaceport on Tatooine. They had dark skin, brown eyes and black hair.
Hetta Pom was a human merchant who resided on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. That year, they sold goods from a stall in the city Bestine in the Desert Valley region of Tatooine.

Kelel was a human gambler who resided on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY During which they played Kessel Sabacc with the Zabrak Eodra and the Sullustan Rellra at the Dizzy Droid Sabacc parlor in the Wonto District of Mos Eisley spaceport on Tatooine.
Trooper was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Fai Kragoth was a human merchant who operated a stall in the South Stretch Worker's District of the city of Canto Bight on the Outer Rim planet Cantonica in 3 ABY. Kragoth had light skin, brown hair and brown eyes.

Eodra was a Zabrak gambler who resided on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY During which they played Kessel Sabacc with a human named Kelel and a Sullustan named Rellra at the Dizzy Droid Sabacc parlor in the Wonto District of Mos Eisley spaceport on Tatooine.

Rellra was a Sullustan gambler who resided on the planet Tatooine in 3 ABY They frequently played Kessel Sabacc with the Zabrak Eodra and the human Kelel in Mos Eisley. They had tan skin and black eyes.

Grrikke was a Rodian gambler who resided on the desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY During which they played Sabacc with the Quarren Kurluk and the human Markin at a cardroom located in the Hutt Cartel district of the city of Mos Eisley. They had orange skin and black eyes.

Kurluk was a Quarren gambler who resided on the desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. During which they played Sabacc with the Rodian Grrikke and the human Markin at a cardroom located in the Hutt Cartel district of the city of Mos Eisley on Tatooine.

Markin was a human gambler who resided on the desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. During which they played Sabacc with the Rodian Grrikke and the Quarren Kurluk at a cardroom located in the Hutt Cartel district of the city of Mos Eisley on Tatooine.
Simrain Kanda was a human merchant who resided on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. During which they operated a store in the Wonto District of the city Mos Eisley on Tatooine.

CC-8675 was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. CC-8675 fought in the First Battle of Geonosis, the Battle of Kamino, and on the planet Felucia.

A green-skinned Twi'lek served in the Nihil as a pirate during the High Republic Era. When the Nihil attacked the planet Palagosal at the Tortle Cove Outpost, the Twi'lek faced against Jedi Knight Raa-lyn Las in a brief skirmish before being overwhelmed by Lexi Greylark in the…
Crundo Dei-Shax was a Weequay mechanic who in 3 ABY, ran a speeder business in the outskirts of the city of Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine.

Tiib was a Rodian gambler who resided on Renpalli Station which orbited the moon Toshara in 3 ABY. They frequently played Kessel Sabacc with the human Jo'sol and the Sullustan Rebem in Renpalli Station cantina. Tiib had green skin and black eyes.

Rebem was a Sullustan gambler who resided on Renpalli Station which orbited the moon Toshara in 3 ABY. They frequently played Kessel Sabacc with the human Jo'sol and the Rodian Tiib in Renpalli Station cantina. Rebem had grey skin and black eyes.

Jo'sol was a human gambler who resided on Renpalli Station which orbited the moon Toshara in 3 ABY. They frequently played Kessel Sabacc with the Rodian Tiib and the Sullustan Rebem in Renpalli Station cantina. Jo'sol had green skin and black eyes.

Nurha was a Twi'lek gambler with teal skin and orange eyes that resided on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. That year they played sabacc in the backroom of a building near the spaceport in the town Jaunta's Hope on Toshara.

Deonis was a human gambler who resided on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY During which they played sabacc against a Gallusian named Bosnok and Trandoshan named Bliziu at Kaslo's Sabacc Parlor in Mirogana, the capital city of Toshara.

Bliziu was a Trandoshan gambler who resided on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY During which they played sabacc against a Gallusian named Bosnok and a human named Deonis at Kaslo's Sabacc Parlor in Mirogana, the capital city of Toshara. They had brown skin and yellow eyes.

Tatz was a Quarren gambler who resided on the moon Toshara in 3 ABY They frequently played Kessel Sabacc with the Twi'lek Port'yr and the Zabrak Ordon in the backroom of Makal's Gambling Parlor in the capital city of Mirogana. They had light skin and black eyes.

Port'yr was a Twi'lek gambler who resided on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY During which they played sabacc with the Quarren Tatz and the Zabrak Ordon in the backroom of Makal's Gambling Parlor in Mirogana, the capital city of Toshara. They had pink skin and blue eyes.

Ordon was a Zabrak gambler who resided on the moon Toshara in 3 ABY They frequently played Kessel Sabacc with the Twi'lek Port'yr and the Quarren Tatz in the backroom of Makal's Gambling Parlor in the capital city of Mirogana. Ordon had dark skin and brown eyes.

Grenner Durangos was a Weequay who worked as a scavenger and merchant on the Outer Rim moon Toshara during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, Durangos operated a stall in the Tosharan town Jaunta's Hope.

This Advanced Recon Commando Trooper was present at the First Battle of Kamino.
During the High Republic Era, a Quarren served as a pirate within the Nihil and was stationed on the planet Angoth.

Bon was an alien who, along with the human Niki, was proprietor of the Niki-Bon Travel Agency on the planet Coruscant. In 3 BBY, the pair were in the agency's back room when Cassian Andor of the Axis network arrived at the building.
Dex was a bulky human who worked as a scavenger on the planet Jakku during the First Order-Resistance War as part of Velorie Sarcon's gang.
Jir was a male Silinese with garnet red facial crystals who, in 134 BBY, when they were between the ages of fifteen and twenty-five, participated in that year's Crowning Convocation.
Var was a Houk male who ran a fighting arena alongside the human Kliva of Arnt on the planet Ruathi during the High Republic Era.

Watcher was a clone trooper who served the Galactic Republic, and later the Galactic Empire. During the Clone Wars, Watcher fought as a member of the 501st Legion. After the war's end, the Republic was reorganized into the Galactic Empire and the 501st Legion was disestablished.

A Duros male citizen was present on the planet Eriadu during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the Duros got into a fight with a Kajain'sa'Nikto in Bri-Phrang City and attacked the individual with both words and actions.
Clava Zeist was a Rodian smuggler and merchant worked with the Hutt Clan on the planet TatooineThey worked out of Jabba's Palace and had green skin, and black eyes in 3 ABY.

A Kajain'sa'Nikto citizen was present on the planet Eriadu during the High Republic Era. While walking through Bri Phrang City on the planet in 228 BBY, the Aloxian Jedi Knight Qort observed both the Nikto and a Duros struggling in an alleyway.

N'Kata Del Gormo was a Hysalrian who, according to rumor, was one of the early instructors of Yoda, future Grand Master of the Jedi Order. Yoda, who spoke little of his early days, himself, began training Jedi as a Jedi Master in 796 BBY.

Marzi was a Tynnan female and an inhabitant of the city New Xaxxis on the Outer Rim Territories planet Metagos. Marzi was widowed and left to care for her three children after her mate Kassis was killed by enforcers working for the gangster Chulok.

Kassis was the mate of the Tynnan Marzi who resided with three children in the city New Xaxxis on the planet Metagos. He was indebted to the gangster Chulok, whose enforcers killed him by 32 BBY. The enforcers continued to demand the widowed Marzi pay Kassis's debt.
Woolif was a Ruurian doctor active during the Republic Era. Educated in medical school as a larva on Alderaan, he served on Zygerria, Mon Cala, and Lothal.

An avian female individual was present in the marketplace of the Sa'ad village Hillia on the planet Metagos in 32 BBY. Accompanied by several children, the avian questioned the vendor about the price of a bracelet.

Chu was a Farakai who bonded with the Rodian Lok to become the gangster Chulok. The Farakai met the Rodian while serving Queen Sybil in the mines of the planet Metagos, and after becoming close allies, offered him a bond.

Lok was a Rodian who bonded with the Farakai Chu to become the gangster Chulok. The pair met while serving Queen Sybil in the mines of the planet Metagos, and Chu saw something special in the Rodian, offering a bond.

A Kajain'sa'Nikto served as a Nihil pirate during the High Republic Era. While on Eriadu, a planet which was currently located in the Occlusion Zone, the Nikto and other marauders attempted to find Sevran Tarkin in hopes of figuring out whether she sided with the Warden or the…

An alien was a member of the She'ar, a faction within the Nihil, during the High Republic Era. The She'ar, along with others, traveled to Planet X in order to capture a Nameless.

Eorgus was an alien individual who lived in the galaxy. While gambling onboard the Casino Yego, a casino ship which was stationed over Glee Anselm, Eorgus was interrogated by the Seventh Sister and Ninth Sister for the whereabouts of Jedi Knight Tensu Run, which he gave.

A Jotaz with an abnormal hide lived in the Undercity Meats of Level 2046 on Coruscant. During his mission to Coruscant in 9 BBY, Jedi Knight Cal Kestis killed a Purge Trooper outside of the Frenzied Jotaz's lair.
Koll Orvenk was a Dowutin mercenary and scavenger hired by Tern Koyatta.

Ardis San Tekka was a member of the San Tekka clan. She was a creature cartographer and artist as a member of the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts. She, along with her safari droid B8-T5, complied a journal about the various creatures of the galaxy.

A Force-sensitive individual served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order and owned a green-bladed lightsaber which they used in a number of battles and killed numerous individuals with. By 0 ABY, the Jedi was killed while holding their lightsaber in their hand.

Wendle was a human male individual who resided on the planet At Attin during the New Republic Era where he lived together with his son Wim. In 9 ABY, Wim found an old starship buried in the woods outside their city.

Brimey was a pet gotis who once belonged to a senator, until he was stolen by Sellaccc Orryak, leader of the Ganguls during the High Republic Era.

A humanoid pirate operated as part of the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the pirate contacted Lonisa City Nihil command on the planet Valo to alert them that "The Warden," a Nihil warlord, was heading to the planet to do a checkup and obt…

A humanoid pirate operated within the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the pirate contacted the Grim Devourer II via hologram and requested to see transpo credentials from the starship, which was operated by the pirate Tanana Keem's crew.
Chrissanta Palus was a human merchant who resided on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. That year They operated from a camp near Typhon's Rock in the Lost Steppe region of Toshara.

Zafi was a thief and junior member of the Crimson Dawn who worked for Eleera Soi. Zafi was one of at least three individuals that had keycards to open the vault in the syndicate's district in Mirogana on the Outer Rim Territories moon Toshara.
Hayna was a human who resided in the galaxy. During the New Republic Era, Hayna encountered the Myykian Neel while on At Achrann.
A human stormtrooper served Grand Moff Ubrik Adelhard's Imperial remnant aboard the Moff's Imperial-class Star Destroyer the Scepter after the Empire's defeat at the Battle of Endor around 4 ABY.

A Toydarian worked as a cook for the Hutt Devirsivik Clan in their palace on the planet Nal Hutta during the High Republic Era. Churo, a young member of the clan, often told the cook—who he considered to be messy—that he was a vegetarian.

A male Hutt individual was the father of the Hutts Churo and Dahara Devirsivik Norri. He was the head of the Devirsivik Clan and a member of the Hutt Council during the High Republic Era. His favorite drink was jorashi grog.

Neyfig was a Hutt that ran an underground podracing circuit on the Moons of Varl.

CT-380 was a clone cadet in the Grand Army of the Republic. Created on the planet Kamino from the genetic template of bounty hunter Jango Fett, CT-380 was a clone who shared Fett's tan skin and height of 1.83 meters (6 ft). CT-380 weighed 80 kilograms.
Gab was a farmer on the planet Tenoo. Between 233 BBY and 232 BBY, the farmer was accompanied by Jedi younglings to establish a new frontier farm.
A Gamorrean worked as a guard in the palace of the Hutt Devirsivik Clan on the planet Nal Hutta during the High Republic Era.
A human individual served as an Imperial officer within the Galactic Empire during its war with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Chalara Matanga was a Bivall Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. She was stationed on Eiram with her Jedi Master Ackmora.
Ackmora was a Mon Calamari male who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He was stationed on Eiram with his Padawan Chalara Matanga.
Ash Masingani was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Orlis was a human Petty Officer of the Republic Defense Coalition who lived during the High Republic Era.
Fido Blick was a Duros male who lived in Barraza City on Eiram during the High Republic Era. He owned a Kowakian monkey-lizard named Pieps.
Khu Fornot was a human male who served the Galactic Empire as a scout trooper and survived the Battle of Endor.
Frangtee was an Ewok and part of the Bright Tree Village.

A Twi'lek Nihil was stationed at a Nihil base on the planet Angoth during the High Republic Era. During a mission to the planet, the Jedi Padawan Amadeo Azzazzo disarmed the Twi'lek before using the Force to incapacitate the marauder.
Maynora was a Twi'lek who resided on the planet Akiva in 3 ABY.
Kazu was a human who resided in a small settlement in the north end of the Myrra Valley on the planet Akiva in 3 ABY.
Tripp was a Weequay who resided at Mozampa Farm in Myrra Valley on the planet Akiva in 3 ABY.
A Castaway lived on The Island after crash-landing on a planet.
Thia Huplo was a Mon Calamari merchant who worked with the rebels of Typhoon Squadron on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY.
Glider was a clone trooper who joined the 501st Legion. While stationed on Kamino, Glider helped stop malfunctioning B1-series battle droids that were used for training.
Corlis Rath, also known as Davros Hex, was a Sinsaran male who lived during the late Republic Era and tried to assassinate Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn.

An individual served as a captain in the Galactic Empire onboard the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station around 4 ABY. The captain was in charge of a unit of stormtroopers on the station that included TK-293, TK-423, TK-534, and TK-848.

The sister-in-law of Dennet Clyde worked as a secretary in his office. She was regularly bullied by Dennet Clyde, who often sought to shift the blame onto her. Clyde was also the leader of a minor crime syndicate known as the Hammers, which operated on Thorum.
A security guard worked for the Quintad during the High Republic Era.

Nox was an Iridonian Zabrak who participated in the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition. Formerly an assassin for the Order of the Night Wind, the acrobatic archer aimed to use the fame of being a Hunter to generate leads about her long-lost sister.
Raalo was a Toydarian junk dealer. He was highly adept at making repairs and modifications to droids, though he was more interested in the business side of his operation.
Kerrithrarr was a Wookiee from the Mid Rim planet Kashyyyk who served as the representative of their species during the Imperial Era.

Jadia Brink was a Force-sensitive Pantoran who served as a Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order. Decades after Jedi Master Barnabas Vim went missing, Brink, their Jedi Master, Atticus Cale, and a Galactic Republic Pathfinder team went to search for him.

Atticus Cale was a Force-sensitive Abednedo who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Decades after Jedi Master Barnabas Vim went missing, Cale, his Padawan Jadia Brink, and a Galactic Republic Pathfinder team went to search for him.

Tuds was an individual who planned to join the Coruscant Security Force while still serving as a lawman in the galaxy.

Zhuna was a female individual who served as an aide to Imperial Senator Mon Mothma during the early reign of the Empire until, after eighteen months of service, she was assassinated.

Lud Marroi was a male individual who represented the Deep Core's Cerberon system in the Imperial Senate during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He was technically a political opponent to Senator Mon Mothma but developed a friendship with her.

Soujen Vak-Nhalis was an Alvadorjian male who grew up on Ylagia. During the Clone Wars, he worked as a mercenary. During the first few months of the Clone Wars, Vak-Nhalis was contracted by the Confederacy of Independent Systems to a mission on Leyoye Prime.
Cowus Roont was a philosopher from Dwartii who was a founder of the Galactic Republic. She was remembered as the so-called 'Fifth Sage' of Dwartii.

A human woman who was a former Separatist lived on the planet Li'eta where she operated a machine shop. She helped Soujen Vak-Nhalis escape Li'eta by providing him with chain codes, an identichip, and credits, after which he killed her.

A Tarsunt male served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. He met with Senator Bail Organa on the Holy City on the moon Jedha and later saved Organa's life by ordering a massacre of protesters outside the senator's Cantham House on the planet Coruscant.
Meli was a Force-sensitive Ithorian who was a Jedi youngling.
Berem Khana was a Force-sensitive human who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era.
During her Infiltration of the Nihil Tempest, Jedi Knight Keeve Trennis claimed to have spoken to a Battrach gunrunner.

TK-289 was a human stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps who held the rank of lieutenant. TK-289 wore standard stormtrooper armor with a black pauldron and carried an E-11 blaster rifle.

Ko-No-Rosu was a senator in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate. In 19 BBY, Alderaanian Senator Bail Organa proposed the Imperial Rebirth Act, which would reduce Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine's authority and give more power to the Senate.

Palok was a senator in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate. In 19 BBY, Hasalia Prederiko, the chief financial officer for the company General Trade Galactic and an agent of the Crymorah Syndicate, offered to prevent Imperial Intelligence from monitoring Senator Mon Mothma if…

Tev Solusar was the son of Jedi Knight Kam Solusar and Fheela, as well as the grandson of Jedi Master Ranik Solusar. According to his father, Tev was very skilled with the Force, displaying a similar aptitude for it as his father and grandfather.
A cargo pilot met with Crime Lord Zorba the Hutt at Mos Eisley after the latter was marooned on Tatooine after running afoul of Trioculus and his Imperial Remnant Faction.

Prata was a Twi'lek farmer with green skin and blue eyes who resided on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. That year, Prata regularly protested the Galactic Empire by giving speeches across from a Daruda Diner in Jaunta's Hope, a town in the Grazing Fields region of Toshara.

A human mother to the farmer Nih lived at a windfarm in the Lost Steppe region of Toshara, a moon in the Outer Rim Territories. In 3 ABY, they tried to convince Nih to remain at the farm instead of working in the moon's capital city, Mirogana.

A human officer in the Galactic Empire was stationed on the moon Toshara in 3 ABY. They had dark skin, black hair and brown eyes. While stationed there, they offered to remove individuals from the Imperial wanted list in exchange for credits.
Monda was a Sullustan member of the Crimson Dawn syndicate that worked under cover in rival Hutt Cartel on Toshara, a moon in the Outer Rim Territories during 3 ABY.
Perrik Droft was a chemist of a science team of the Republic Defense Coalition who lived during the High Republic Era.
Ordiron was a human who served as a governor of the Galactic Empire during the first year of its reign.
A human individual resided on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. During their time on the moon they sold fake VIP tickets to a private suite in Makal's Gambling Parlor from it's entrance.

A human individual who was part of a group that wind fished on Toshara, a moon located in the Outer Rim Territories. By 3 ABY, pirates had repeatedly found the group's camp every season and demanded payment and usually accepted a crate of Aglis flyers.
A Rodian windfisher resided on Toshara, a moon located in the Outer Rim Territories, during 3 ABY.
The pa of Charuk and Rani sent his children away after their village was attacked. His ultimate fate was left unknown to both of them.
TK-4965 was a human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire that was stationed on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY.

PT-969 was a human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire that was stationed on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. That year while patrolling Mirogana Market in the Toshara's capital city Mirogana they wore standard stormtrooper armor and carried an E-11 medium blaster rifle.

A Mon Calamari bookie offered bets under the table while on the casino cruiser Morenia during 3 ABY. He had white skin and green eyes. The bookie was aboard the Morenia for the Okala Five Kessel Sabacc tournament.

A Sullustan cleaner worked on the casino cruiser Morenia during 3 ABY. Shortly before the Okala Five Kessel Sabacc tournament that year, the cleaner's master keycard was stolen by a Scurrier on the ship.
Sarasti Thel was a man who founded the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door which made no distinctions between the Light and the Dark side of the Force.

A Sullustan welcome agent worked on the casino cruiser Morenia during 3 ABY. Shortly before the Okala Five Kessel Sabacc tournament that year, the agent welcomed aboard Kay Vess a scoundrel traveling under the name Toren Valario Nupp.
Minakatso was a Force-sensitive member of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door. He searched for an ancient scroll.

A human officer in the Galactic Empire was stationed on the Mid Rim planet Kijimi in 3 ABY. They had tan skin, black hair and brown eyes. While stationed there, they offered to remove individuals from the Imperial wanted list in exchange for credits.
Ungol Ungrave was an individual who served as chief of staff to Senator Palok of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate.
Saxl Neth was a human male who served as a member of the Nihil during the High Republic Era. He once stood before the Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro.
The owner of the submarine Questor was an individual who lived on the planet Eiram during the High Republic Era.
Dakhmi was an Omwati member of the 4040s on Coruscant. A young individual, Dakhmi was studious and angry, having lost everything that mattered to them during the Clone Wars.
Pieps was a Kowakian monkey-lizard who was owned by the Duros mercenary Fido Blick during the High Republic Era.
Grenda was a female individual who led the Hurricanes, a group of former Nihil pirates, on the planet Eiram after the destruction of Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era.

Renzor was a Twi'lek male who was a member of the Hurricanes, individuals who were former Nihil pirates. The group lived on the planet Eiram after the destruction of Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era.
An Artiodac worked as a bouncer for Mog's Cantina in the market square in Barraza City on the planet Eiram during the High Republic Era.
Scotia Belford-Tapalo was a humanoid female who served as Queen Consort of the planet Naboo as part of the Royal House of Naboo.
Pisc Dowdrena was a Tynnan who became a noted architect and designed the stately City Hall of Mos Espa, a city on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine, by 9 ABY.
This Jangori lead a group of Jangori warrior rebels against the Galactic Empire on their desert home planet of Golak.

Thalvus Agyomenidus was a woodworker from Coruscant's 1649th level who was involved with the 4040s, an Imperial activist group. In an assassination attempt on Chandrilan Imperial Senator Mon Mothma, Agyomenidus killed Mothma's aide Zhuna.

Laevido was a human Imperial activist who led the 4040s, a radical pro-Empire activist group. He had worked in weather control for twenty years before pursuing an education at a university and becoming disillusioned with democracy.

Fowlitz was a human male who was a member of the 4040s, an Imperial activist group active during the first year of the Empire's reign. He was a shuttle pilot by trade, and played Kloo horn for a band in various clubs and bars.
Erinya was a human female who was a member of the 4040s, an Imperial activist group active during the first year of the Empire's reign.
Jayu was a human female who was a member of the 4040s, an Imperial activist group active during the first year of the Empire's reign.

Namenthe was a scavenger who operated on the desert planet Jakku. They salvaged proton bombs from a TIE bomber in the Starship Graveyard, an area of the Goazon Badlands littered with the wreckage of starships destroyed in the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.
A princess of Soun IV visited the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant shortly before the Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY.
An arms dealer from the Corporate Sector planet Bonadan anonymously used the cliffside convent of the Sand Sisters in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica as a pied-à-terre by 34 ABY.
By 32 BBY, a wealthy Hutt clan leader made a deal with the Toydarian junk dealer Watto, who operated a junkshop in the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine.

Maghadi was an alien individual who was present on the desert planet of Golak at some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY. At some point during those years, they ended up in a city where they watched two young refugees, siblings Charuk and Rani, disembark from a hovertrain.

A light-skinned humanoid worked as an assistant bartender to the bartender Bufon Taire at the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant after having been fired from most of the respectable bars on the world.
Dhoona was a human individual who was present on the desert planet of Golak at some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY.
This conductor was a human individual who operated an Imperial-utilized hovertrain planet of Golak at some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY.

This helper was a human individual who helped operated an Imperial-utilized hovertrain planet of Golak at some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY. They were startled when the conductor of the train they worked on suddenly increased the thrusters, knocking the helper off their feet.
A male interviewer worked for Imperial Intelligence by 19 BBY.

Hyerang was a Human female shipjacker. Along with Bostad, she stole the Millennium Falcon from Han Solo. The thieves were stopped by Luke Skywalker and R2-D2 who, unbeknownst to them, were still on board.

Bostad was a male Duros shipjacker. Along with Hyerang, he stole the freighter Millennium Falcon from Han Solo. The thieves were stopped by Luke Skywalker and R2-D2 who, unbeknownst to them, were still on board.

Dreena was a Ghorman human member of the Ghorman Front, a rebel group that opposed the Galactic Empire on the planet Ghorman. In 2 BBY, when the Empire opened the previously barricaded Palmo Plaza, Dreena was one of hundreds to enter the area to protest.
Flaxa was a Human male senator in the Galactic Republic. He was kidnapped by Clan Havac and later rescued by Qui-Gon Jinn.
Rechrimos was a Rodian who worked as a brickmason and re-created forgotten techniques from the Duluur sector before being recruited into the Partisans. He spoke a pidgin form of Huttese.

An Arcona worked for the forger Den Dhallow in his crew on the planet Coruscant during the Imperial Era. Around 19 BBY, the Arcona met with the Senator of Alderaan, Bail Prestor Organa, on Level 1313 who wanted help in knowing where forged documents he possessed came from.

Anra was a member of the staff of Senator Lud Marroi, who represented the Cerberon system in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate. In 19 BBY, Senator Bail Organa proposed the Imperial Rebirth Act, which would limit the powers of Emperor Sheev Palpatine.

Qaterman was an individual who was a member of Saw Gerrera's Partisans during the Imperial Era. Around 19 BBY, Qaterman was killed by a blaster bolt fired by the Heptooinian Haki Zeophrine on Eyo-Dajuritz while they and other guerrillas attempted to overwhelm Zeophrine and Sen…
Bana Rhuus was a Koorivar male who was a member of Separatist Intelligence for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Ro-Yai was an individual who worked as a doctor for the Confederacy of Independent Systems. While stationed on the planet Skako, Ro-Yai had tended to the Alvadorjian Soujen Vak-Nhalis and helped him with his cybernetics.
A force-sensitive individual was employed as a bodyguard by Gardulla Besadii the Elder during the time of the First Order-Resistance War.
Sights was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Sights was trained to wield an orange lightsaber by Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.
Pogo was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Pogo was trained to wield a green lightsaber by Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.
Hyper was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Hyper was trained to wield a blue lightsaber by Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.

Shootout was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Shootout was trained to wield a purple lightsaber by Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.
A snowtrooper of the First Order served in 34 ABY.
Barrug was a humanoid Nihil who fought alongside "The Warden" during the Battle of Eriadu on the planet Eriadu during the High Republic Era.
Brabaum was a human who served as a lieutenant onboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Scepter during the Battle of Jakku.

Wiston Freng was a Pantoran monopod racer. He grew up with a love for racing, and cherished racing his first starship despite its slow speed. He eventually grew to be a talented monopod racer and joined the Monopod Circuit.

Jaj Omie was a Dug monopod racer during the High Republic Era. He primarily spoke Huttese. When the Monopod Circuit first came to the Outer Rim planet Tenoo for the Tenoo Grand Tour, Omie engaged in multiple unscrupulous strategies to sabotage his Pantoran rival, Wiston Freng.

A Utai wrangler worked at a varactyl corral in Pau City on the planet Utapau. In 19 BBY, while Utapau was occupied by the Separatist Droid Army as part of the Clone Wars, the Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi visited the corral, seeking a way to climb the city's sinkhole wall to reac…
A human child lived on the planet Temerancé during the High Republic Era. Due to their Force-senstivity, the youngling was captured by the Nihil before being rescued by the monster hunter Ty Yorrick.
A Gossam woman spoke with Senator Mon Mothma at a gala on the planet Coruscant around 19 BBY. The Gossam woman asked Mothma if she remembered the Courtsilius Wax Revolution.

A Keredian was present on the planet Golak during the Imperial Era. While at the Golak Mahal cantina, the Keredian threatened and fought with his Ugnaught friend after accusing the Ugnaught of throwing a loaf at him. An older woman, Rugal, warned the friends to stop fighting.
A Ugnaught resided on the planet Golak during the Imperial Era. They often fought with their Keredian friend.

At least two individuals were the parents of the human salt trader Kella Antro, who was from a chilly coastal town. By 132 BBY, Antro's parents were aging, and she supported them by delivering seasoning minerals to the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop on the planet Ueda.

t: Guardian of the Tenoo Jedi Temple
x: The "Guardian of the Tenoo Jedi Temple" was a tazi sloth that lived at the top of the Tenoo Jedi Temple. Soon after her arrival to Tenoo, Jedi Master Zia Zaldor Zanna discovered a written record of the creature, and found his nest.
Lomi Usqi was an individual that owned the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop in Point Ueda, capital of the Outer Rim planet Ueda more than one-hundred and sixty years prior to 132 BBY.
Miow Joon, nicknamed the Noodle Peddler, was an alien champion velospeeder rider who worked peddling the noodle-drying rack at the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop on the world Ueda during his training seasons.
Kesmer Faloodi was a Reshtini nicknamed Bottomless because of his gluttonous appetite, though he did not know what his nickname referred to.
Bihun was a genderless Wrosidian "related" to the fellow Wrosidian Basko—who originated from the same stalk—although the two were not siblings.
Zard Zell was a Mimbanese getaway pilot and mechanic for the crew of slicer Syreth Dunn in the Corporate Sector during the High Republic Era.

Orlut was a Lyrobru cyborg employed by the slicer Syreth Dunn as part of his Corporate Sector crew during the High Republic Era. She was arrested along with other members of the crew and placed in a cell on the DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship Palwick in 132 BBY.

Colee Quillo was a human who employed the crew of slicer Syreth Dunn in the Corporate Sector to erase his name from the Corporate Sector Authority's ledger and erase a enormous debt that had left him on the run.

Basko was a genderless Wrosidian who was a "relative" of Bihun, another Wrosidian from the same stalk, although they were not siblings. In 132 BBY, Basko and Bihun were in the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop on the planet Ueda, eating noodles at a table with the Reshtini Kesmer Faloodi.
A human Nihil pirate served onboard the Star Hopper and assisted and notified the Warden about the Battle of Eriadu during the High Republic Era.
Galward Paronis was a human politician who was assassinated on the planet Krassis by the Arcona bounty hunter Lan-Drus before he could be recruited into joining the New Republic.
Eiro was a human who served in the New Republic Starfighter Corps for the New Republic shortly after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
An individual fought for the New Republic as a pilot for their Starfighter Corps shortly after the Battle of Endor.
Renfro was a human who flew an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor for the New Republic Starfighter Corps during the Battle of Jakku.

Kestee Zannacuro was a Czerialan terrorist who lived during the High Republic Era. At some point after the Mirialan General Abediah Viess joined the Nihil marauders in 229 BBY, she recruited Zannacuro into her Ministry of Protection.
Volo Bolus was a non-binary Prae'tus podracer who teamed up with the fellow racer Dug Sebulba.
Later on, Tiks met with General Abediah Viess of the Nihil, who requested his presence to converse about his recent mission.

A tooka lived on the Outer Rim planet Tenoo with her Talpiddian owner during the High Republic Era. Around 232 BBY, the tooka became stuck on the crown of a Tenoo tree, leading three Jedi younglings—Kai Brightstar, Nubs, and Lys Solay—and the Dowutin Ansen Strung to climb the …

Emmett was a human individual who was leader of a group of thieves on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era alongside Chipp and Z-3OR. Emmet led his group in an effort to steal credits from a hovertrain after stealing a group of Dunnels.

Chipp was a male Lannik individual who was a member of a group of thieves on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era alongside Emmett and Z-3OR. Chipp was part of the group's effort to steal credits from a hovertrain after stealing a group of Dunnels.

Freet Chaddio was an Abednedo individual who operated as a miner on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era. He was the owner of the droid MB-4 and programmed the locations of all his gemstone mines into the droid's memory bank, making MB-4 a target of a group of thieves.
A Talpiddian lived on Tenoo during the High Republic Era and owned a tooka cat.
Marjolos was a senator of the Galactic Republic who joined the Delegation of 2,000 during the Clone Wars.
Yadoska Nir was an individual who worked for the Commerce Guild and collaborated with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
An Imperial officer served as a commander of the Galactic Empire and was stationed at an Imperial factory on the planet Selk.
A Rutian Twi'lek was an inhabitant of Crystal City during the Imperial Era. At some point between 19 BBY and 5 ABY, the Twi'lek was accompanied by an orange-skinned Twi'lek companion.
Hasalia Prederiko was the chief financial officer of General Trade Galactic and an agent of the Crymorah Syndicate.
