Marlem Glay was a Nikto who led a Nihil Cloud.

A Koorivar individual was a Strike working for the Nihil Cloud Marlem Glay. They met with Glay at a bar on Zeitooine where the pair complained about the leadership of Marchion Ro and the failed raid on Baori Minor.

Vek Drow Drow attended a briefing on board the flagship of the Alliance Fleet, Home One, where members of the Alliance leadership, including Admiral Gial Ackbar, Mon Mothma, and General Crix Madine, gave a briefing to the assembled rebels on their plans to attack the Empire's …
Marot Luriel was a pilot who operated the Purrgil Wake during the High Republic Era.
A Force-sensitive male alien individual served the Galactic Empire as an Inquisitor. At some point the Inquisitor hunted the Jedi Padawan Lyco Strata, who had survived Order 66.

Lyco Strata was a male Force-sensitive human Jedi Padawan who survived Order 66. During the Imperial Era, Strata allied himself with the Dathomirian Asajj Ventress in a mission to get to the Path for safety.

A male human individual worked as a marshal. During the Republic Era he shot down the gangster Lazlo and later encountered the Duros bounty hunter, Cad Bane, who was an old friend of a deputy seeking revenge for the death of his mentor.

Shale was a Vintian sculptor who lived during the High Republic Era. She worked in metals and operated on the Core Worlds planet Gatalenta. By 232 BBY, while Jedi Master Mirro Lox and his Jedi Padawan Amadeo Azzazzo undertook a mission on Gatalenta, they met Shale.

Yenlit Elio was a Force-sensitive individual who lived during the High Republic Era. They served as crèche-keeper nurse of the Jedi crèche in the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant at the time the Wookiee Arkoff was a Jedi youngling, accompanying the Wookiee and h…

A Colicoid engineer was responsible for designing the protodeka, a giant, crablike siege weapon, on the planet Raxus Prime, which was manufactured by Geonosians and used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Dark Reaper crisis.
A human villager lived in Meevai Village on the planet Keelia. Between 19 BBY and 1 BBY, he served drinks to the Jedi Padawan F and the explorer Valco at the wedding of the villagers Asu and Haru.

A human villager lived in Meevai Village on the planet Keelia. During the wedding of the villagers Asu and Haru, the villager apologized to the Jedi Padawan F and the explorer Valco after another villager disturbed them.

A Force-sensitive individual served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Between 230 BBY and 228 BBY, the Jedi was present in the Nihil pirates' Occlusion Zone region of space and was taken prisoner by the Nihil.

An individual served as a member of the Nihil pirates during the High Republic Era. By 228 BBY, the individual served as part of the Cloud led by the Nikto Marlem Glay, who liked to say she had joined the Nihil for one reason: to get rich and blow things up.
Gibbs was a Duros individual who resided in the galaxy. At some point, they acknowledged that an issue was occurring.
Vance was a human deputy under Niro. At some point, Vance mentioned to Niro that bounty hunter Cad Bane was once their best friend, only for the alien to reply back that time has moved on.
Niro was a male Duros who lived during the later Republic Era. Niro grew up as an orphan on the streets of a crime ridden city together with his friend Colby.
Condola Oquine was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi Padawan in the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
A Mon Calamari was a gambler on a losing streak in 3 ABY while they were in Mirogana, the capital city of the Outer Rim moon Toshara. They had grey skin and yellow eyes.

A Quarren individual with light skin and blue eyes sold fake bacta suits while on Corellia before relocating to the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. Their partner reported them and they were forced to shoot an officer.

A human explorer with dark skin, green eyes and black hair resided on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. That year, they tried to retrieve a stash of trinkets from Typhon's Rock that were previous stole by Aglis flyers, one of the moon's local species.

The mother to the Quarren merchant Sol D'lorak. By 3 ABY their bets on fathier races led D'lorak with more debt than they could work off and D'lorak started a new life on the Kijimi, a planet in the Mid Rim Territories.

An Ualaq Aqualish mechanic was forced to work at the Ashiga weapons factory to repay their debt with the Ashiga Clan. They had gray skin, black eyes and gray hair. In 3 ABY, they were caught by a member of the Ashiga near the Kijimi Spaceport attempting to sneak off the planet.
Rhaygus Strentine was an Imperial governor by around 19 BBY.
Ta'am Khlaides was a Delrakkin senator who served in the Galactic Senate, but eventually left for the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Deblindrix IV, also know simply as Deblindrix, was a Nameless owned by the Nihil scientist Niv Drendow Apruk during the High Republic Era.

A Pyke member of the Pyke Syndicate was stationed on the Outer Rim desert planet, Tatooine in 3 ABY. That year, they were attacked on their way to Beggar's Canyon on Tatooine while trying to make contact with a group of Jawa.
A Twi'lek thug who had been on the Outer Rim desert planet, Tatooine all their life. In 3 ABY, they could be found at a settlement in the Desert Valley near Mos Eisley.
A Human merchant with light skin and green eyes operated a merchant stall in Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine during 3 ABY. That year, they had at least one set of Anzellan goggles.
Mauler was an individual that competed in fights held on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.

A human officer in the Galactic Empire was stationed in the city of Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. While stationed there, she offered to remove individuals from the Imperial wanted list in exchange for credits. She had light skin, black hair and brown eyes.

A Weequay thug with grey skin and blue eyes resided on the desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. That year, they were friends with a corrupt Imperial officer who offered to take people off the Empire's wanted list in exchange for credits.

A human spacer with tan skin, green eyes and brown hair resided on the desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. During which they wore a tan pants with a matching tan shirt, brown gloves, red waist sash, and a brown hat.
Brezark was a Force-sensitive Quarren male who served as a mercenary and master trapper during the High Republic Era.

An Ualaq Aqualish gambler resided on the desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. They had grey skin, grey hair and black eyes. During 3 ABY, they were playing sabacc against Hoss, a Sullustan gunslinger, at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.
A Jedi served as master to the Padawan Fvorn during the Republic Era. In 22 BBY, the two participated in the First Battle of Geonosis, during which Fvorn was killed by Geonosians.

An individual was a mole for the Crimson Dawn syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire. By 3 ABY, the mole had stolen data from the Empire while disguised as an Imperial stormtrooper on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine.
A Zabrak with tan skin, brown eyes and brown facial markings was a smuggler. Prior to 3 ABY, he had a modest pod outside the Casino District in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
A Quarren spacer had a cousin who lived on Yavin 8 during the Battle of Yavin and witnessed the destruction of the first Death Star from the surface of the moon.

The cousin of a Quarren spacer who resided on Yavin 8 during the Battle of Yavin and witnessed the destruction of the Death Star from the surface of the moon. She told her cousin that there was still debris of the station in the moon's atmosphere by 3 ABY.

Soren Gotto was a human born around 14 BBY who grew up on the planet Akiva helping their mom run her nursery. Their experience worked in the nursery taught them all the plants on Akiva as well as how to germinate seeds. Soren had tan skin, blue eyes and black hair.
A female individual was the mom of the Human Soren Gotto who raised them on Akiva, a jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During which she ran a nursery on Akiva and Soren helped her run it.
Theeo Prost was a human merchant with dark skin, blue eyes and black hair who resided on Akiva, a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.
Banktup was a Banchiian. In 228 BBY, they told Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi about a Banchiian village where the Jedi younglings Nima Allets and Viv'Nia Nia'Viv could be protected.
Grymish was an Attendant in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau as an aide to ISB Supervisor Dedra Meero.

Koseyet was a male Mustafarian miner who lived on Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War. At the time of the Battle of Yavin, he was employed by Mensix Corp and was the foreman of the Koseyet Mining Camp.

Romila Kaveh was an individual who served as an acquisition negotiator for the Czerka Corporation during the High Republic Era. While negotiating with the Kenari on the planet with the same name, Kaveh and the group were violently consumed by several Drengir.
Tolor Patewick was an individual who served as a translator for the Czerka Corporation during the High Republic Era.
A bandit was a member of the Bandit Troopers and carried a large flag.
A bandit was a member of the Bandit Troopers and used a missile launcher. During a skirmish on the planet Genbara, they shot their missile launcher and killed the Dug guard
A bandit was a member of the Bandit Troopers and wielded an electropole. During a skirmish on the planet Genbara, they fought a Tusken Raider guard
A bandit was a member of the Bandit Troopers and wore a bandolier.
A bandit trooper with fins that stretched to both sides of their helmet was a human active on the Outer Rim planet Genbara around two decades after the Sith rebellion.
A human male was an elder of the Yasaburō clan. They sat in a hallway in the Yasaburō household with with the clan member Lop while her father, Yasaburō confronted his other daughter Ochō.

A human officer in the Galactic Empire stationed on the Outer Rim planet Akiva in 3 ABY. They had tan skin, brown hair and brown eyes. While stationed there, they offered to remove individuals from the Imperial wanted list in exchange for credits.

A human officer in the Galactic Empire was stationed on the Outer Rim planet Akiva in 3 ABY. They had tan skin, black hair, a mustache and brown eyes. While stationed there, they recruited from The Alcazar, a popular cantina in the capital city Myrra.
A Pantoran broker operated on the Outer Rim planet Akiva in 3 ABY. They had blue skin, yellow facial marking, black hair and blye eyes.

A human researcher working with the Imperial Department of Military Research. They had tan skin, black hair and red–brown eyes. In 3 ABY they were on the Outer Rim planet Akiva as part of a research expedition.

A female, myrmitrix, Melitto scout for the Ashiga Clan dispatched to the jungle planet Akiva to assess the potential for the clan to expand its interest to the planet. By 3 ABY, they had compiled a detailed report outlining Akiva's economy, ecology, government, and terrain.
Roon was a rancher of an unidentified species with green skin and four eyes. During the High Republic Era, she enlisted the help of the Jedi Order on Tenoo to retrieve three lost bantha cubs.

Seba was a Jedi explorer who was considered historical during the High Republic Era. She was active in the Outer Rim Territories and recognized for exploring more of the region than anyone before her.
A Weequay mechanic resided on the jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY. They had grey skin, blue eyes and wore a green jacket over a blue shirt with matching green pants.

A Gran lived in a village on a planet. When a Sullustan told the astromech droid R5-D56 they would get him a new leg, R5-D56 responded in binary that the Sullustan never kept their promises. The Gran then laughed and reported what the droid had said.

A human lived in a village on a planet. At one point, while sitting with other villagers, they greeted the astromech droid R5-D56, who was on an errand for the Sith Okinaa. They then laughed and joked with the other villagers after a Sullustan promised the droid a new leg.

A Trandoshan lived in a village on a planet. At one point, the Trandoshan stood by a group of other villagers sitting around a low table. When a Sullustan promised the astromech droid R5-D56 a new leg, the droid responded that they never kept their promises.
A spray painter was among many individuals enslaved by the Galactic Empire and forced to dig a pit for kyber crystals at some point during the Imperial Era.

A leader of the Ahia-Ko known as the "first gardener of Akiva" was rumored by local legend to have planted all of the asuka trees on Akiva. The legend went on to state that after her death, she was laid to rest beneath the first of the asuka tree to sprout.

A farmer resided on Akiva, a jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories. By 3 ABY, they knew the legend of the first gardener of Akiva as well as their connection to Salea's Hand, a special asuka tree that has red leafs instead of the normal blue.

Quills was a clone trooper medic who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Quills was part of a team of medics who accompanied a platoon of clone troopers led by Jedi General Kit Fisto to Bilbringi Depot.

Trick, formerly designated CT-3301, was a clone trooper who during the Clone Wars had fought in the Grand Army of the Republic under the non-clone Republic captain Hawks. Sometime during the war, Trick was injured in a disaster that cost Hawks their career.

Tel-Rea Vokoss was a Force-sensitive Tognath Jedi Padawan, who sometime after the death of her Jedi Master, became a member of Zero Company during the Clone Wars to complete her late master's last mission.

Luco Bronc was an Umbaran who was a member of Zero Company during the Clone Wars. Prior to joining Zero Company, Bronc fought as a soldier for the Umbaran Militia during the Galactic Republic's invasion of his homeworld Umbara in 20 BBY.
Cly Kullervo was a infamous Mandalorian warrior who was a gunslinger and bounty hunter who was one of the last surviving members of the ancient Mandalorian clan, Clan Verminoth.
Spigh was a friend and the chief of staff of Senator Lud Marroi, who represented the Cerberon system in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate.

A Force-sensitive individual served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era, utilizing a yellow-bladed lightsaber.
An individual served as a stormtrooper in the military of the Galactic Empire. At one point, a psychedelic battle occurred in his haunted psyche while he was on the cusp of defeat.
Niko Jiro was a Force-sensitive non-binary human who served as a Jedi Master during the High Republic Era.

Stinger Tash was the human captain of the Rokana Raiders, a pirate gang that operated in 3 ABY. Tash was smarter and more ambitious than her peers, allowing her to climb up the ranks of her organization.
Barun was a human who lived during the First Order-Resistance War.

Tobue Taizen was an individual who was the son of Kastor Taizen, a former Imperial Royal Guard. He was trained by his father, who sought vengeance against Luke Skywalker and the Jedi for killing Emperor Palpatine during the Battle of Endor.
Tava Ren was a Force-sensitive human female who led the Knights of Ren sometime after Kylo Ren left the group to join the First Order.
Rek Minuu was a droidsmith who operated during the High Republic Era. Minuu built the droid Apexx.

Khrobastra was a senator in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate. In 19 BBY, when Senator Bail Organa brought the Imperial Rebirth Act, which would reduce Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine's authority, to the floor in the Senate chamber on the planet Coruscant, Khrobastra vote…

Hawks was a Human male and a former Galactic Republic military captain who after a disaster that cost them their career, became the leader of the special forces group Zero Company during the Clone Wars.

An Imperial officer served the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. At some point, the officer attacked the astronomical object B-bel and kidnapped a baby from Loi'e, whom he raised as his own son.
A stormtrooper served the Galactic Empire at some point between 1 ABY and 4 ABY on B-bel.
A stormtrooper served the Galactic Empire at some point between 1 ABY and 4 ABY on B-bel.

Luuda Fluxion was business partners with Sebulba around 10 BBY. She took part in Sebulba's crew's heist at the Hutt colosseum on Nar Shaddaa, though the heist failed and Fluxion abandoned the crew.
TK-6937 was a human of the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. In 3 ABY, they were stationed on Tatooine, a desert planet in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
TK-4991 was a human member of the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps who was stationed on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.

A human member of Crimson Dawn posing as a government official for the Satrapy on the jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY. They had tan skin, brown eyes and gray hair During 3 ABY, they looked to by a battle droid for personal security and surveillance.

A Rodian droidsmith and member of the Hutt Clan that sold droids on Akiva, a jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories. In 3 ABY, they operated near the Hutt Cartel district in Myrra, the capital city of Akiva. Their inventory included at least one DL-2 line droid.

A human mechanic resided on the desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. They had dark skin, brown eyes and wore a brown shirt, green pants, gray gloves and matching gray hat. During 3 ABY, they operated a delivery system from Sashin, a village in the Karaba Foothills on Akiva.

Obo was a merchant that operated a stall in the city Myrra on the jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY. That year a member of the Zerek Besh crime syndicate trashed her stall while searching for the thief Kay Vess.
An Alliance to Restore the Republic member was on the planet Yelsain recruiting for the rebellion before being killed by Misty of Task Force 99.
A human rebel member of Typhoon Squadron that operated on the jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY. They had tan skin, brown eyes and black hair.
Rock-Claw was an individual that competed in fights held on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. That year, it tore an opponent named Nibbles in half in one of its fights.
Shanto was a Caphex archaeologist who uncovered the location of an ancient, abandoned starship, which he explored with his friends and colleagues Leeka, Pol-Adi and Tamanuki during the Republic Era.

An Abyssin was a member of a band of raiders led by Lord Izuma. They accompanied him to Meevai Village to take the human Haru hostage, but fled when Izuma's battle droids were deactivated by the explorer Valco.

A Twi'lek was a member of a band of raiders led by Lord Izuma. They accompanied him to Meevai Village to take the human Haru hostage, but fled when Izuma's battle droids were deactivated by the explorer Valco.

The Grand Master was a Force-sensitive human male who served as the leader of the Crusaders, a radical sect of Jedi. He was obsessed with revenge against the former Sith known as the Ronin, who had wounded his face and cut off his legs in battle.
Geeleen was a Gungan shop owner who lived in the small town of Shoril on Naboo. They owned the only eating establishment in the dome of Shoril.
Nakime was a Force-sensitive human Jedi Padawan. At some point, she and her master engaged in a lightsaber duel with the Sith Aman.
This scavenger was a short alien individual who was present on the planet Golak at some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY.
This scavenger was a short alien individual who was present on the planet Golak at some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY.

A human bandit operated alongside two other cohorts on the planet Tatooine. In 34 ABY, the gang of bandits attempted to rob Kylo Ren and Vaneé at the Mos Espa Grand Arena while the two were investigating the past of the late Anakin Skywalker.

Aneé-san was a Twi'lek Sith who worked as a bodyguard for Anzellan gangster Que-Dama, wielding a red-bladed lightsaber. She spent her money on making her body more beautiful. At one point, she faced off against the former Sith known as the Ronin.

A humanoid bandit operated alongside two other individuals on the planet Tatooine. In 34 ABY, the bandit attempted to rob the humans Kylo Ren and Vaneé while the two visited the Mos Espa Grand Arena in regard to the late Anakin Skywalker.

A humanoid bandit operated alongside two other individuals on the planet Tatooine. In 34 ABY, the bandit, accompanied by others, held the humans Kylo Ren and Vaneé at blaster point, demanding they relinquish all valuables on them after the bandits greeted them.
This hawker was a brown Aki-Aki who spoke an alien language and who worked aboard an Imperial-operated hovertrain on the planet Golak at some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY.

A Weequay guard protected the fortress of Gardulla Besadii the Elder on the planet Tatooine. In 34 ABY, the guard conversed with Kylo Ren outside the fortress and ordered him to leave unless he wished to be consumed by a rancor.
This bard was a green four-armed alien individual who was present on the planet Golak at some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY.
A hired gun looking to collect on Kay Vess's death mark from Zerek Besh in 3 ABY. During which they had tan skin, blue eyes, black hair and wore armor over a grey shirt and a yellow scarf.

Crane was a human female princess. Orphaned and exiled following the destruction of her kingdom by the Empire, she later became an operative for the Rebellion. Her childhood guardian was the astromech droid Tor-Tu, who remained her companion and partner in the Rebellion.
Coy Vrizh, also known as the "Smiling Snivvian," was a Snivvian podracer who was active around 10 BBY.
Paghee'Dhe Dahglyn was a Neidorian podracer who was active around 10 BBY.
Raka was a pink Rodian podracer who was active around 10 BBY. They raced as a duo with their twin sister Staka, with whom they shared a telepathic connection due to neuro-implants.
Staka was a pink Rodian podracer who was active around 10 BBY. They raced as a duo with her twin brother Raka, with whom Staka connected telepathically via a neuro-implant.
A Trandoshan entrepreneur with brown skin and yellow eyes worked in the Scavenger's Draw area of the city Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.
Pyya Bocc was a male Twi'lek and good friend of the podracer Volo Bolus in around 10 BBY.
A Huk was present on the upper deck of the To-Ba mobile gambling hall within an AK-BK walker on the planet Olcatz. While there, they wore a hakama over their legs.
Mayze Vice was a Skakoan bounty hunter who impressed the Hutt crime lord Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi enough to become his righthand enforcer.
Trizz Vezcro was a lizard-like alien who was associated with the Dug podracer Sebulba around 10 BBY.
Leon was a human child active at some point following Order 66. They doubted the existence of the Force and encountered the Jedi F.

A human droidsmith that worked with the Hutt Cartel on Akiva. In 3 ABY, they were looking for a volunteer to test SID, a prototype combat droid, in a live fire engagement. They had light skin, black hair and red eyes.

The parents of the Rodian droidsmith Gedeek Obaz. They raised Gedeek in the South Stretch Worker's District of Canto Bight on Cantonica. After being arrested following a failed casino scam Gedeek was forced to join the Galactic Empire.

Thraymus Argent was a Jedi Knight who served in the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. At one point, Argent was sent to the planet Alderaan to investigate feuds and assassination attempts that thwarted House Prestor.

A stormtrooper served under an Inquisitor during the Imperial Era. At some point between 4 BBY and 3 BBY while on an Imperial-class Star Destroyer, the stormtrooper reported to the Inquisitor that they had received a signal from the planet below them, stating it could be a Jed…

The human known as Ren and the Knights of Ren warriors he led had a friend who learned that the human criminal Karrst was Force-sensitive. The friend informed the Knights of Ren about Karrst's abilities, including his penchant for the dark side of the Force.
Fzbol was a Wookiee. They carried the Anzellan Que-Dama in a MSE series droid strapped to their chest.
Que-Dama was an Anzellan who rode in an modified mouse droid strapped to the chest of the Wookiee Fzbol.
Chita was a human female smuggler. During the Imperial Era, she was hired to bring Arluu, a prince being pursued by the Galactic Empire, to safety.

Gleenu was a Force-sensitive Cerean former Jedi who was active during the Imperial Era. After the Great Jedi Purge, they swore allegiance to the Zenarita royal family and helped Prince Arluu evade capture by the Galactic Empire.

Sevn was a human female, former mercenary, turned bounty hunter, who lived during the Republic Era. In her youth, she worked as a mercenary for the Basham but later defected the group and became a bounty hunter.
Kellen was the human owner of a general store on the agricultural planet Mina-Rau. A friendly individual, Kellen was a reliable source of news and rumors for other individuals on Mina-Rau.

Aneth was a human female who owned and operated the Mina-Rau General Store on the planet Mina-Rau with her spouse, Kellen. She disapproved of their daughter, Beela, seeing the undocumented toolie Wilmon Paak and unsuccessfully urged her to stay away from him.

Porko was a pilot who worked for the Axis network during the Imperial Era. In 4 BBY, after stealing a TIE Avenger prototype from the planet 73, the rebel Cassian Andor was scheduled to deliver the starfighter into the hands of Porko on the moon Yavin 4.

Rika was a female human who was a part of the Maya Pei Brigade during the Imperial Era. In 4 BBY, after being stranded on the moon Yavin 4, Rika attempted to pilot a TIE Avenger that was brought to the moon by Cassian Andor for the Axis network.

Crab was a human male who was a member of the Maya Pei Brigade during the Imperial Era. In 4 BBY, the brigade was ambushed and took heavy losses, leaving Crab as part of a group of fifteen survivors that became stranded on the moon Yavin 4.
Gerdis was a male human who was apart of the Maya Pei Brigade during the Imperial Era. In 4 BBY, Gerdis, along with several other members of the brigade, were stranded on the moon Yavin 4.

Bardi was a human who was a part of the Maya Pei Brigade during the Imperial Era. In 4 BBY, Bardi and several members of the brigade were left on the moon Yavin 4 after Bardi's brother departed without them.

Flu was a human member of the Maya Pei Brigade during the Imperial Era. In 4 BBY, Flu was stranded on the moon Yavin 4 alongside other members of the brigade. Flu was subsequently killed by Cassian Andor.

Krole was a human individual who served as a lieutenant for the Galactic Empire. In 4 BBY, the lieutenant harassed the human Bix Caleen and later attempted to sexually assault her while overseeing audits on the planet Mina-Rau.
Pyke was a corporal Imperial Army trooper that served the Galactic Empire in their Imperial Supply Census on the planet Mina-Rau in 4 BBY.
Stang was an Imperial Army trooper in the Galactic Empire, and a sergeant in a contingent led by Lieutenant Krole during an Imperial Supply Census on the planet Mina-Rau in 4 BBY.
The Toad was a glowing toad. He served as a spiritual guide to the Jedi Padawan Nakime, who had lost her eyesight in a duel with the Sith apprentice Aman.
Niya was a human female who worked for Sienar Fleet Systems in Sienar Test Facility 73 on the planet 73.
Yuko was a young human boy with pink hair. At one point, he was present in Mos Eisley on Tatooine with the droid BILY. His parents were Bennet and Myler Sten.

Klavin was an individual who served as a governor during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 4 BBY, he attended the wedding of his friend Perrin Fertha's daughter, Leida Mothma, and fellow Chandrilan Stekan Sculdun, arriving at the Mothma Estate on the planet Chandrila in a n…
Jodi was an alien who attended the three-day wedding of the Chandrilans Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma at the Mothma Estate on the planet Chandrila in 4 BBY.

A sergeant with the Alliance to Restore the Republic that oversaw intake of new recruits at the rebel base on the moon Yavin 4 in 2 BBY. As part of the process the sergeant would have the new recruits place all their weapons on a table to be checked out by Vel Sartha.

A human male was the father to a son who served in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. In 4 BBY, they traveled to Chandrila with their son to attended the wedding of the Chandrilans Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma.

The human Bix Caleen had a child with the rebel operative Cassian Andor. In 2 BBY, Caleen left Andor behind on the moon Yavin 4 to ensure that he would keep fighting for the Rebellion instead of leaving because of his desire for a peaceful life with her.

Gerrus Bariovon was a human male who worked in Imperial Intelligence of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.
Jaylin was a scavenger who lived with a friend in a wrecked Alliance to Restore the Republic freighter near Feressee's Point on the desert planet Jakku.

Leo Bellsfar was an individual who had been dead for years by around 3 ABY according to one individual, who provided a member of the Rokana Raiders pirate group with this information before being shot herself for even mentioning his name.

A clone trooper accompanied Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padmé Amidala and Jar Jar Binks on their mission to raid Nuvo Vindi's laboratory. At a point, Nuvo Vindi shot the clone, who apparently died, falling on Skywalker and Amidala's arms.
An individual served an investigator for the Empire. At one point, Ekiya and her crew concealed illegal kyber shards from them.
A Jedi of the Jedi clans served as an escort for an investigator. While the investigator was searching for illegal kyber shards, the Traveler suggested he lock himself in an escape pod.
LRC-897 was a human Imperial officer of the Galactic Empire who was stationed on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY.

A Force-sensitive individual served as a Jedi of the Jedi clans. During the Sith rebellion against the Jedi clans, the Sith apprentice Kouru killed the Jedi while her master watched and stole their lightsaber.

Elvis was a dog-like creature that could be found on the planet Ghorman during 3 BBY. They wore a collar with their name inscribed in it in the Dixian script of the Ghor language.

Jakob Garn was a human male who served as a senator in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate during the High Republic Era, representing the Airam sector.

Orna was an Ugnaught female who ran Kimnol's Gambling Hall in Port Haileap on the planet Haileap the High Republic Era.

Wack was a Clone Sergeant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars and was present for the Battle of Kashyyyk. After receiving Order 66, Wack led a search team near a lake where they encountered Jedi Master Yoda disguised as a creature.

A brown-haired human with light skin worked as a nurse at Lina Soh Hospital on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 1 BBY, she cared for the patient Faiza and pushed her through one of the hospital's corridors in a med-glide wheelchair.
A human Imperial Security Bureau tactical agent served as a sentry in the Lina Soh Hospital on the planet Coruscant when the wounded rebel Luthen Rael was incarcerated there in 1 BBY.

A four-armed alien was present in a city on a world at some point after 19 BBY. The alien was attacked and killed by the bounty hunters Latts Razzi and C-21 Highsinger, who were assisted by the former Sith assassin Asajj Ventress, with Highsinger shooting him in the face.
A human employee of the Imperial Bureau of Standards that worked at it's Headquarters on the planet Coruscant in 4 BBY.

A female individual lived during the Republic Era. Around 62 BBY, they became a parent to the Duros Colby—later known as Cad Bane—who was born on the planet Duro. At some point, Colby was orphaned and became a street rat.

Dashon was a human male who served Nilsson Summach, an arms dealer, during the High Republic Era. Around 160 BBY, Dashon was killed by the Gigoran Hinra aboard Summach's pleasure cruiser after making the arms dealer upset.
An elderly Cerean male was hired by the arms dealer Nilsson Summach to help construct 47 lightsaber nullifiers on Septra during the High Republic Era.

A Genetian official was present on Spira to discuss the purchase of the 47 lightsaber nullifier alongside others during the High Republic Era. Around 160 BBY, the man, along with another official, listened to the arms dealer Nilsson Summach inform them about the nullifers.

Grizela was a Pantoran female employed by the arms dealer Nilsson Summach. As Summach found running the business part of his organization to be boring, he left much of it to Grizela.

A New Reborn was a member of the Disciples of Ragnos group. They were among the forces sent to Chandrila, guarding the tomb of the Barsen'thor. When Jaden Korr was sent to the planet, they dueled in the tomb's chamber, where Jedi Knight Jaden Korr killed him.
An individual was part of a a group of insurgents backed by the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn that fought against the Galactic Empire on the Inner Rim planet Bestine IV during the Imperial Era.

A male individual was the father and Jedi master of Hanrai, who eventually became a Jedi lord.

Korsaan Dwyll was a human criminal that owed a debt to Jabba Desilijic Tiure in 3 ABY. During that year, while in Hauler's Keep they wore a green shirt, green pants, yellow gloves and a green scarf which obscured their face. They had tan skin, blue eyes and red hair.
Kacin was a Gran smuggler who was active during the New Republic Era.
Sattlar was a Shistavanen who was active during the New Republic Era.

A Sullustan poet visited Hauler's Keep, a space station located in the Khepi system of Wild Space, in 3 ABY. While on the station they began working on a poem about the Khepi people.

Fondar Etzis was a Force-sensitive human who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. At some point, he was assigned to the planet Mina-Rau to deal with Quillian bandits who had been stealing the local farmers' crop yield.

Erial was a Twi'lek male who oversaw the construction of 47 lightsaber nullifiers on the planet Septra for the arms dealer Nilsson Summach during the High Republic Era.
An individual served the Nihil marauder organization and stood on guard alongside a Weequay Nihil outside of the warehouse doors of a lommite processing plant during the Battle of Eriadu.

Sanga was a human individual who resided on the planet Naboo in 34 ABY. While visiting the Varykino Villa on the planet, which they and their companion believed to be cursed, they and their associate were killed not long after encountering Kylo Ren.

The companion of the human individual Sanga resided on the planet Naboo in 34 ABY. While visiting the Varykino Villa on the planet alongside Sanga, they and Sanga were killed not long after encountering Kylo Ren who Force-choked them to death.

Shifty Lin Vane was a pirate who joined the Rokana Raiders by 3 ABY. By that year, they had been caught hiding a stash of treasure along with fellow pirate Paias Reef from the rest of the raiders.
Big-Hands Leduu was an individual who had joined the Rokana Raiders pirate group and was subsequently punished for sleeping through the start of their shift by 3 ABY.

Orr Dayfinder was an individual who had joined the Rokana Raiders pirate group by 3 ABY and was subsequently punished for badmouthing the raider's leader, Stinger Tash, and going against the group's plan to recover treasure from Great Tomb of the Khepi.
Kezrin Almovar was a human prime minister of the planet Pirros and the leader of the Fenril Consortium during the New Republic Era.

Locc was a Twi'lek male who lived in a village on Tenoo with their infant child, Jor. Locc and Jor received help from the Tenoo Jedi Younglings to prepare a large feast, but while picking Lumo Cave Mushrooms, Locc, Jor, and Nubs were trapped after a large Tenoo Tree fell.

Jor was a young Twi'lek living in a Tenoo village with his father, Locc. Locc and Jor received help from the Tenoo Jedi Younglings to prepare a large feast, but while picking lumo cave mushrooms, Locc, Jor, and Nubs were trapped after a large Tenoo Tree fell.

Henck was a Human male who lived during the Third Galactic War. By 3624 BBY, Henck was a security officer for the Mantellian Separatist Movement on the planet Ord Mantell. He was present at Port Granost when he was killed by the Alliance Commander.
An individual was a member of the Zantarrk gang and wore a stormtrooper helmet.

A humanoid individual served as a member of the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, they participated in an attack on the planet Banchii. During the battle, the area was flooded with pollen from plant life aiding Banchii's defenders on behalf of the Drengir.
An individual under the designation of TAC 2C was a human who served as an Imperial Security Bureau tactical agent during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

A friend of the human merchant Kellen that resided at Council Five Hundred on the agricultural planet Mina-Rau in 4 BBY She spoke with Kellen during the Imperial Supply Census of Mina-Rau during which she informed him of the Imperial's activities and numbers.

A human Raydonian mother lived in a Raydonian settlement on the Outer Rim planet of Raydonia during the Clone Wars.

Lafco was a horned alien general and the leader of the Vekurans. After Qui-Gon Jinn and Berem Khana failed to do so, Lafco was convinced by Jedi Master Mace Windu to begin peace talks with the Syrinxian president Hoss.

At least two individuals were the parents of the Force-sensitive non-human Idzuna, who later eschewed their name and became known as the Traveler. They trained as a Jedi in the clan of the Jedi lord Hanrai, and their parents believed Hanrai would improve their behavior.
A Sith served as the master of the Sith Kouru. She was killed at the end of the Sith rebellion aboard the flagship of the dark lord.

At least two individuals were the parents of the humanoid alien female Kouru. Although they wanted to keep her, they were not allowed to because she was Force-sensitive and required by the Empire's lords to become a Jedi.

An individual served the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era and stood on guard alongside another Nihil outside the service entrance of the Arkorayal Cabaret Cantina on the planet Eriadu while awaiting an impending attack on the planet on behalf of the War…

While trapped in the mines of Seswenna during the Farlingan Collapse, Jedi Knight believed she had seen a Kessurian male wearing Jedi temple robes watching over and comforting her.

A Force-sensitive individual served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Around 160 BBY, they were the supervisor of Jedi Knight Indara who was serving as a Jedi archivist in the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

Quintana was a Force-sensitive Devaronian female who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era and was stationed at the Jedi temple on the planet Kryger. She had an Padawan named Princho.
Dunesa Rul was an individual who came from a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Rul grew up helping his family by apprenticing with a local metalsmith.

Adden was a member of the Rokana Raiders around 3 ABY while the pirate group was based at the Khepi Tomb in the Sayma Nebula. During their time serving with the raiders, they became attached to an astromech named Scrapper.

Qorvino was a notorious pirate that raided Imperial shipping lanes along the Hydian Way during the Imperial Era. He eventually came in possession of a starmap that contained the coordinates to the Great Tomb of the Khepi.

A Force-sensitive individual served as a Jedi master of the Jedi clans. Shortly after the young Force-sensitive Kouru was taken by the Jedi, she often became agitated and the master lulled her into quiescence.

A Force-sensitive Jedi knight served as a member of the clan led by the Jedi lord Hanrai. While aboard Hanrai's flagship, the Reverent, they acted as the master to dozens of apprentices practicing forms in an open-air hall.

A Force-sensitive male served as a Jedi guardian in the Jedi clan led by the Jedi lord Hanrai. While aboard Hanrai's flagship, the Reverent, shortly before it was destroyed, he spoke to the former Jedi known as the Traveler, unaware of their identity.
According to a story told by the storyteller known as the Traveler, a Jedi knight was struck down by his brother and later returned to guide a child who brought his brother peace.

A Zabrak farmer resided on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, they tried to barter for water at the Wayfar Cantina, however due to the Galactic Empire's insistence on collecting taxes in credits, the bartender was forced to turn them away.

According to a story told by the storyteller known as the Traveler, a male individual was the brother of a Jedi knight and struck him down. The knight returned as a ghost to guide a child who brought the brother peace.

Cisnero Agate was a human male who lived during the High Republic Era. At one point he served the Republic Defense Coalition alongside Trystian Greylark on the planet Riah where he believed Trystian perished to Blight.

A Senate Tower guard believed that the gardening staff of the Senate Building was compromised after finding a listening device in a plant. The guard went on to recruit an individual to search for additional listening devices by searching plants and scanning senate employees.

A Hutt aunty was the manager of a dockyard in Vermin's Reach, a seedy area of the planet Dekien's capital city of Dazenma. At one point, she spoke with the slicer Shogo in front of her office when the pilot Ekiya arrived to meet with him.

A Force-sensitive individual served as a Jedi guardian in the Jedi clan led by the Jedi lord Hanrai. When Hanrai's Imperial Dreadnought, the Reverent was being evacuated, the guardian attempted to convinced Hanrai to leave.

A Kaminoan male was a guest aboard a pleasure barge operated by Eternity Enterprises on the planet Dekien. As the barge headed toward the Seikara Caverns, the Kaminoan spoke with his Mon Calamari companion and the disguised former Sith known as the Ronin.

An individual was a Dostan who lived on the planet Kundu Minor along with another Dostan during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, this two Dostans had a bad reputation with Braygh and her fellow villagers. They thought that the Dostans often came to steal things.
An individual was a Dostan who lived on the planet Kundu Minor with another fellow during the High Republic Era.

Nej Shif was a Human male and a member of the Black Sun crime syndicate on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War. Shif was killed at the Black Sun Headquarters on Coruscant around 3643 BBY.
Daro Desyk was a Rattataki female and a member of the Black Sun crime syndicate on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War. Desyk was killed at the Black Sun territory on Coruscant around 3643 BBY.

Apago was a Sith pureblood male who served the reconstituted Sith Empire as a Sith Lord during the Cold War. Around 3643 BBY, Apago became involved in a violent power struggle with a rival Sith Lord, Cyone, which escalated into open combat within the Sith Sanctum on Dromund Kaas.

Cyone was a Human male who served the reconstituted Sith Empire as a Sith Lord during the Cold War. Around 3643 BBY, Cyone became involved in a violent power struggle with a rival Sith Lord, Apago, which escalated into open combat within the Sith Sanctum on Dromund Kaas.
A Zygerrian individual ran a luxury shop on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant during the High Republic Era.
A male served as a lord of the Empire. He attempted to kill the former Sith known as the Ronin, but failed, and the Ronin then took his blaster.
Arlen Drax was a Human male who served the Sith Empire and was present in the Sith Sanctum on the planet Dromund Kaas during the Cold War.
Cadan Keeg was a Human male who served the Sith Empire and was present in the Sith Sanctum on the planet Dromund Kaas during the Cold War.
Rix Kilis was a Humanoid male who served the Sith Empire in the Imperial Army and was present in the Sith Sanctum on the planet Dromund Kaas during the Cold War.
Tylo Orum was a Human male who served the Sith Empire and was present in the Sith Sanctum on the planet Dromund Kaas during the Cold War.
Amari was a human who served the Galactic Empire as a Imperial swamp trooper. By around 18 BBY, Amari had the rank of captain and participated in a massacre of the population of a planet.

Dunbai was a former Jedi Knight who left behind his Force training to to serve as lord of Makoma Ko and met the Jedi Lah Kara. He once operated as a merchant in the Outer Rim Territories before assuming leadership of Makoma Ko.

According to a story told by the merchant Jira, a young pregnant woman was murdered, with the only witness being the protocol droid Nobot.

During the High Republic Era, an Ortolan served as a bloodletter. At some point between 234 BBY and 200 BBY, Lohim Nara, dreaming of joining the Jedi Order, paid the Ortolan bloodletter to perform a test on him and write a fake high midi-chlorian count.

A clone trooper pilot was a pilot of the Pelta-class frigate TB-73 during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. They alongside another clone trooper pilot were killed in 21 BBY during a skirmish on the starship.
This individual was a Ryn male and the son of Piani and her mate. In 26 ABY, Piani and her son were among a group of Ryn refugees stranded on the planet Duro during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

A Ryn was the mate of Piani, with whom he had a son. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, he was unable to reach Gyndine's capital city in time to board an evacuation ship and, by 26 ABY, was presumed by Piani to be dead or worse.

This individual was the husband of Clarani, a female Ryn. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, he died during the evacuation of the Jubilee Wheel. By 26 ABY, Clarani was living as a refugee on the planet Duro.

A snowtrooper served the Commander Barro's faction of the Imperial Remnant during the New Republic Era. During or after 11 ABY, the snowtrooper was present for a meeting between Barro and local leaders in which the commander intended to raise their tribute.

Herkum Bjort was the director of the Coruscant Intergalactic Zoo. In 179 BBY, after two Acklays from the zoo, Mr. Growls and Tkaczuk, had disappeared, Bjort insisted to reporters from The Daily Millennium that they had not gone missing.
Mr. Growls was a male acklay that lived in the Coruscant Intergalactic Zoo and went missing along with Tkaczuk, another acklay, in 179 BBY.
Tkaczuk was an acklay that lived in the Coruscant Intergalactic Zoo. In 179 BBY, Tkaczuk and Mr. Growls, another acklay, disappeared from the zoo.

A grizzled, white-haired male individual served as a β-supervisor at Kuat Drive Yards, leader of the shipbuilding team that laid down the central frames of the starships at the KDY docks, during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Kotti was the head of guest relations for the tour company Hyperlight Tours and a member of the crew aboard the tour ship Starfarer. She was friends with Ardent Quay, the daughter of the ship's captain, Hansifred Quay.
Hansifred Quay was the captain of the tour ship Starfarer.
Valor, or just Val, was the son of Audra Quay and Hansifred Quay and brother to Ardent Quay.
A lieutenant of the Galactic Empire served aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Relentless during the Galactic Civil War.
Reno Tsutara was a Jedi Master who trained Lah Zhima and Juro.
Chi Chi was a Gungan, one of Jar Jar Binks' children.
